english_verse: and named the light “Day” and the darkness “Night.” Evening came, then morning—that was the first day. The Second Day
translation_verse: Ni Nyoṅmo̱ tšé̱ la le̱ ſane, ni duṅ le̱ etšé̱le̱ nyōṅ. Ni dše na ni dše tše̱re, ni efe kleṅkleṅ gbĩ le̱.

english_verse: God named the dry ground “Land,” and he named the water “Ocean.” God looked at what he had done and saw that it was good.
translation_verse: Ni Nyoṅmo̱ tšé̱ heni egbĩ le̱ šikpoṅ, ni nui le̱ anābuamo̱ le̱ etšé̱le̱ ṅšo̱. Ni Nyoṅmo̱ na ake̱ ehĩ.

english_verse: God said, “I command the earth to produce all kinds of plants, including fruit trees and grain.” And that's what happened.
translation_verse: Ni Nyoṅmo̱ kē̱: Šikpoṅ le̱ akwẽ dſe̱i, bāi ni woo̱ wui ke̱ tšei ni woo̱ yibii ye̱ eheno̱, ní ewui le̱ yo̱ emli, ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱! Ni efe nakai.

english_verse: The earth produced all kinds of vegetation. God looked at what he had done, and it was good.
translation_verse: Ni šikpoṅ le̱ kwẽ dſe̱i, bāi ni woo̱ wui ye̱ eheno̱, ke̱ tšei ní woo̱ yibii ní ewui le̱ yo̱ emli ye̱ eheno̱. Ni Nyoṅmo̱ na ake̱ ehī.

english_verse: Evening came, then morning—that was the third day. The Fourth Day
translation_verse: Ni dše na ni dše tše̱re, ni efe gbĩ ni dši gbĩ etẽ le̱.

english_verse: God said, “I command lights to appear in the sky and to separate day from night and to show the time for seasons, special days, and years.
translation_verse: Ni Nyoṅmo̱ kē̱: Kanei aba ṅwei atatu le̱ mli, koni ame̱gbla ſane ke̱ nyōṅ mli, ni ame̱tšō okadii ke̱ bei ke̱ gbĩĩ ke̱ afii; Lal.

english_verse: I command them to shine on the earth.” And that's what happened.
translation_verse: ni ame̱tšṍmo̱ kanei ye̱ ṅwei atatu le̱ mli, ní ame̱tšo ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱. Ni efe nakai.

english_verse: God made two powerful lights, the brighter one to rule the day and the other to rule the night. He also made the stars.
translation_verse: Ni Nyoṅmo̱ fe kanei wudši enyo̱ le̱: kane wulu le̱ ní eye ſane no̱, ke̱ kane bibiō le̱ ni eye nyōṅ no̱, ke̱ ṅulamii le̱ hũ. Lal.

english_verse: to rule day and night, and to separate light from darkness. God looked at what he had done, and it was good.
translation_verse: ni ame̱ye ſane ke̱ nyõṅ ne̱, ni ame̱gbla la le̱ ke̱ duṅ le̱ mli. Ni Nyoṅmo̱ na ake̱ ehĩ.

english_verse: God said, “I command the ocean to be full of living creatures, and I command birds to fly above the earth.”
translation_verse: Ni Nyoṅmo̱ kē̱: Nui le̱ awo lōi ni hĩe kāmo̱ nyẽṅẽnyẽṅẽ, ni lofõdši afliki ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ye̱ ṅwei atatu le̱ hĩe.

english_verse: So God made the giant sea monsters and all the living creatures that swim in the ocean. He also made every kind of bird. God looked at what he had done, and it was good.
translation_verse: Ni Nyoṅmo̱ bo̱ ṅšo̱ṅloi wudši le̱ ke̱ bo̱nii fẽ ni hĩe kāmo̱ ní tšio̱ ame̱he ni nui le̱ wo nyēṅẽnyẽṅē ye̱ ame̱heno̱ le̱, ke̱ lofõdši fẽ ni yo̱ fidši ye̱ ame̱heno̱. Ni Nyoṅmo̱ na ake̱ ehĩ.

english_verse: Evening came, then morning—that was the fifth day. The Sixth Day
translation_verse: Ni dše na ni dše tše̱re, ni efe gbĩ ni dši gbī enumo̱ le̱.

english_verse: God made every one of them. Then he looked at what he had done, and it was good.
translation_verse: Ni Nyoṅmo̱ fe šikpoṅ koloi ye̱ ame̱heno̱, ke̱ šĩa koloi ye ame̱heno̱, ke̱ nii fẽ ní wamoo̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ ye̱ ame̱heno̱. Ni Nyoṅmo̱ na ake̱ ehĩ.

english_verse: So God created humans to be like himself; he made men and women.
translation_verse: Ni *Nyoṅmo̱ bo̱ gbomo ye̱ esubãṅ le̱ no̱, Nyoṅmo̱ subãṅ le̱ no̱ ebo̱le̱ ye̱; †nū ke̱ yō ebo̱ame̱. *Ef.

english_verse: God gave them his blessing and said: Have a lot of children! Fill the earth with people and bring it under your control. Rule over the fish in the ocean, the birds in the sky, and every animal on the earth.
translation_verse: Ni Nyoṅmo̱ dšō̱ame̱, ni Nyoṅmo̱ kē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyefo̱a ni nyeyi afáa ni nyeyia šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ obõ, ni nyenānāa no̱, ni nyeyea ṅšo̱ṅloi ke̱ ṅwei lofõdši ke̱ kolo-fẽ-kolo ni tšio̱ ehe ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ no̱. Bo̱f.

english_verse: And I have given the green plants as food for everything else that breathes, including animals, both wild and tame, and birds. And so it was.
translation_verse: ni koloi fẽ ni yo̱ šikpoṅ lē̱ no̱ ke̱ ṅwei lofõdši fē ke̱ nibii ſẽ ni wamoo̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni wala susuma yo̱ ame̱mli le̱, aṅõ dſe̱fo̱ fẽ ahãame̱ ni ame̱ye. Ni efe nakai.

english_verse: God looked at what he had done. All of it was very good! Evening came, then morning—that was the sixth day.
translation_verse: Ni Nyoṅmo̱ kwe̱ nibii fẽ ni efe le̱, ni na, ehĩ naakpa. Ni dše na ni dše tše̱re, ni efe gbĩ ni dši gbĩ ekpa le̱.

english_verse: That's how God created the heavens and the earth. The Garden of Eden When the Lord God made the heavens and the earth,
translation_verse: Ene̱mei dši ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ šišidšē he sãdši, beni abo̱ame̱ le̱, ye̱ gbĩ no̱ ni Iehowa Nyoṅmo̱ fe šikpoṅ ke̱ ṅwei le̱.

english_verse: The Lord made a garden in a place called Eden, which was in the east, and he put the man there.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa Nyoṅmo̱ fe trom ye̱ Eden ye̱ bokāgbe̱, ni eṅõ gbomo ní ešõ le̱ eto dše̱i.

english_verse: The Tigris River that flows east of Assyria is the third, and the fourth is the Euphrates River.
translation_verse: Ni fā ni dši etẽ le̱ gbe̱i dši Hidekel, noni hoo̱ ye̱ Ašur bokãgbe̱ le̱; ni fā ni dši edſe̱ le̱ dši Eufrate.

english_verse: But the Lord told him, “You may eat fruit from any tree in the garden,
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa Nyoṅmo̱ wo gbomo le̱ kitã ekē̱: Trom le̱ mli tšei le̱ fẽ no̱ yibii le̱ ye bo̱ni osumoo̱;

english_verse: except the one that has the power to let you know the difference between right and wrong. If you eat any fruit from that tree, you will die before the day is over!”
translation_verse: ši ekpakpa ke̱ efõṅ lẽ tšo le̱ yibii le̱ kãye eko; edšake̱ gbĩ no̱ ni ooye eko le̱, *gbo oogbo! *Rom.

english_verse: The Lord God said, “It isn't good for the man to live alone. I will make a suitable partner for him.”
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa Nyoṅmo̱ kē̱: Ehĩĩ ake̱ gbomo le̱ kome hĩo̱ ši; mafe hefatalo̱ ko ní sale̱ mahãle̱. Abe̱i

english_verse: So the Lord God made him fall into a deep sleep, and he took out one of the man's ribs. Then after closing the man's side,
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa Nyoṅmo̱ hã wo̱ ni tšī nyõ Adam no̱, ni ewo̱; ni edšie eṅmãwui le̱ eko, ni eṅõ lō etšĩmo̱ nãdšiaṅ.

english_verse: the Lord made a woman out of the rib. The Lord God brought her to the man,
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa Nyoṅmo̱ *ṅõ ṅmãwu ni edšie ye̱ Adam mli le̱ efe yō, ni eke̱le̱ ba Adam ṅõ. *

english_verse: and the man exclaimed, “Here is someone like me! She is part of my body, my own flesh and bones. She came from me, a man. So I will name her Woman!”
translation_verse: Ni Adam kē̱: Agbe̱ne̱ ene̱ dši wu ni dše̱ miwui le̱ amli ke̱ lō ní dše̱ mihelo le̱ mli; aatšé̱ mone̱ yō, edšake̱ nū mli adšiele̱ ke̱-dše̱.

english_verse: That's why a man will leave his own father and mother. He marries a woman, and the two of them become like one person.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nū aašĩ etše̱ ke̱ enye, ni eekpe̱te̱ eṅã he, ni ame̱atšṍ heló kome. Mat

english_verse: Although the man and his wife were both naked, they were not ashamed.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱yi enyo̱ le̱ fẽ ame̱nyie ya-yai, nū le̱ ke̱ eṅã le̱, ni ame̱hĩe gboo he.

english_verse: The woman stared at the fruit. It looked beautiful and tasty. She wanted the wisdom that it would give her, and she ate some of the fruit. Her husband was there with her, so she gave some to him, and he ate it too.
translation_verse: Ni beni yō le̱ *na ake̱ tšo le̱ hĩ hã yeli, ni efeo̱ hĩṅme̱ii ako̱no̱, ni tšo le̱ baä mo tšine, ni etšõo̱ mo nii le̱, †etše eno̱ yibii le̱ eko ni eye, ni ehã ewù ní ke̱le̱ yo̱ le̱ hũ eko, ni eye. *Iak.

english_verse: Late in the afternoon, when the breeze began to blow, the man and woman heard the Lord God walking in the garden. So they hid behind some trees. Sin Brings a Curse
translation_verse: Ni ame̱nu Iehowa Nyoṅmo̱ gbē ní enyie trom le̱ mli, beni gbe̱ke̱nāši kō̱yo̱ ſie le̱; ni Adam ke̱ eṅã le̱ *tē ame̱he ye̱ trom le̱ṅ tšei le̱ ateṅ ke̱-dše̱ Iehowa Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe. *Ier.

english_verse: The Lord God called out to the man and asked, “Where are you?”
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa Nyoṅmo̱ tšé̱ Adam ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Nẽgbe̱ oyo̱?

english_verse: The Lord God then asked the woman, “What have you done?” “The snake tricked me,” she answered, “and I ate some of that fruit.”
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa Nyoṅmo̱ kē̱ yō le̱ ake̱: Mẽba ofe ene̱? Ni yō le̱ kē̱: Onũfũ le̱ lakami, ni miye.

english_verse: You and this woman will hate each other; your descendants and hers will always be enemies. One of hers will strike you on the head, and you will strike him on the heel.”
translation_verse: Ni mike̱ nyē̱ aaṅmẽ oke̱ yō le̱ teṅ, ke̱ oseši ke̱ *eseši teṅ; †eetſa oyitšo nõ, ni **bo hũ ootſa enanetšitši nõ. *Gal.

english_verse: Then the Lord God said to the woman, “You will suffer terribly when you give birth. But you will still desire your husband, and he will rule over you.”
translation_verse: Yō le̱, ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Fá mahā ohedšrame̱ ke̱ oho̱ṅō̃ afá; dšramo̱ mli oofo̱ bii ye̱, ni owù le̱ se̱gbe̱ ootao, ni le̱ *eeye ono̱. *Ef.

english_verse: The Lord said to the man, “You listened to your wife and ate the fruit I told you not to eat. And so, the ground will be under a curse because of what you did. As long as you live, you will have to struggle to grow enough food.
translation_verse: Ni Adam le̱, ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Ake̱ni obo oṅã le̱ toi ni oye tšo le̱ ni miwoö he kĩtã ake̱ okaye eyibii le̱ eko hewe̱ le̱, alomo̱ šikpoṅ sũ ye̱ ohewo̱, dšramo̱ mii ooye eno̱ nii ye̱, owala gbĩĩ abo̱ fẽ.

english_verse: Your food will be plants, but the ground will produce thorns and thistles.
translation_verse: Ni ṅmei ke̱ aṅlẽṅlẽ eewo ehão, ni ṅãno̱ bāi ooye.

english_verse: You will sweat all your life to earn a living; you were made out of soil, and you will once again turn into soil.”
translation_verse: Ohĩe *latšā mli ooye nii ye̱, ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni ookũ ose̱ ke̱-ate šikpoṅ sũ mli, edšake̱ emli adšieo ke̱-dše̱. Edšake̱ sũ dšio, ni sũ mli ookũ ose̱ ke̱-ate! *

english_verse: The man Adam named his wife Eve because she would become the mother of all who live.
translation_verse: Ni Adam tšē̱ eṅã le̱ gbe̱i Hawa, edšake̱ le̱ dši hĩekãle̱i fẽ anye.

english_verse: Then the Lord God made clothes out of animal skins for the man and his wife.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa Nyoṅmo̱ fe wolo atadei ehã Adam ke̱ eṅã le̱, ni eṅõ-woame̱.

english_verse: The Lord said, “They now know the difference between right and wrong, just as we do. But they must not be allowed to eat fruit from the tree that lets them live forever.”
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa Nyoṅmo̱ kē̱: Na, Adam etšṍ *tamo̱ wo̱teṅ mokome, ni ele ekpakpa ke̱ efõṅ; ni agbe̱ne̱ beni afe ni ekakpã enine mli, ni etše wala tšo le̱ yibii le̱ hũ eko, nieye, ni ehĩe mīkã ke̱-mīya nāno̱! *K.

english_verse: So the Lord God sent them out of the Garden of Eden, where they would have to work the ground from which the man had been made.
translation_verse: Hewo̱ le̱ Iehowa Nyoṅmo̱ dšiele̱ ye̱ Eden trom le̱ mli, koni eyahũ šikpoṅ, nõ mli ni adšiele̱ ke̱-dše̱ le̱;

english_verse: Then God put winged creatures at the entrance to the garden and a flaming, flashing sword to guard the way to the life-giving tree.
translation_verse: ni eſie Adam, ni eṅõ *kernbim ke̱ lalile̱i klante ni tšṍmoe̱ ebe eto Eden trom le̱ hĩe ye̱ bokãgbe̱, koni ebu wala tšo le̱ nāgbe̱ le̱ he. *Ezek.

english_verse: Later she had another son and named him Abel. Abel became a sheep farmer, but Cain farmed the land.
translation_verse: Ni efo̱ enyemi Habel efata he; ni Habel tšṍ tōkwe̱lo̱, ni Kain tšṍ šikpoṅhũlo̱.

english_verse: One day, Cain gave part of his harvest to the Lord,
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱ ye̱ mli āhũ le̱ Kain ṅõ šikpoṅ nibānii le̱ eko eyašã afō̱le ehã Iehowa;

english_verse: but not with Cain and his offering. This made Cain so angry that he could not hide his feelings.
translation_verse: ši Kain ke̱ efo̱le le̱, ehĩe eso̱o̱ no. Ni Kain mli wo la naakpa, ni etũ ehĩe.

english_verse: If you had done the right thing, you would be smiling. But you did the wrong thing, and now sin is waiting to attack you like a lion. Sin wants to destroy you, but don't let it!
translation_verse: Aso ke̱dši ofe ekpakpa le̱, ohĩe baṅ nyam lo? ši ke̱dši ofee ekpakpa le̱, eša *bu šĩnā le̱ ši, ni bo ose̱gbe̱ etaoo̱; ši bo le̱ †ye eno̱. *Gal.

english_verse: Then the Lord said: Why have you done this terrible thing? You killed your own brother, and his blood flowed onto the ground. Now his blood is calling out for me to punish you.
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱: Meni ofe nē̱? Onyemi le̱ *lá gbē mīblo̱ mītšé̱mi ke̱-mīdše̱ šikpoṅ sũ le̱ mli! *Mat.

english_verse: And so, I'll put you under a curse. Because you killed Abel and made his blood run out on the ground, you will never be able to farm it again.
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱, alomo̱o ke̱-dše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ ni gble enā ni eke̱mī̃ onyemi le̱ lá le̱ ye̱ odeṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: “You're making me leave my home and live far from you. I will have to wander about without a home, and just anyone could kill me.”
translation_verse: Na, oſiemi ṅme̱ne̱ ke̱-dše šikpoṅ le̱ hĩe, ni matẽ mihe ke̱-dše̱ ohĩe, ni mitšṍ šikpalo̱ ke̱ kobo̱fo ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni aaba mli ake̱ mofẽmo ni aanami le̱, eegbemi. Hiob

english_verse: “No!” the Lord answered. “Anyone who kills you will be punished seven times worse than I am punishing you.” So the Lord put a mark on Cain to warn everyone not to kill him.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱le̱ ake̱: Nohewo̱ le̱ mofẽmo ni aagbe Kain le̱, aato̱le̱ owele toi kpawo. Ni Iehowa kadi Kain, koni kē̱ moko nale̱ ni ekatſale̱ nõ.

english_verse: Later, Cain and his wife had a son named Enoch. At the time Cain was building a town, and so he named it Enoch after his son.
translation_verse: Ni Kain le eṅã le̱, ni ená mũsũ, ni efo̱ Henok. Ni eto maṅ, ni eṅõ ebi Henok gbe̱i ewo maṅ le̱.

english_verse: One day, Lamech said to his two wives, “A young man wounded me, and I killed him.
translation_verse: Ni Lamek kē̱ eṅãmei le̱ ake̱: Ada ke̱ Zila, nyenua migbē; nye Lamek ṅãmei, nyeboa miwiemo̱ le̱ toi! Ši mipilamo̱ hewo̱ migbe nū ko, ni mihe flawõ hewo̱ hũ migbe oblanyo ko.

english_verse: Anyone who tries to get even with me will be punished ten times more than anyone who tries to get even with Cain.”
translation_verse: Ké̱ aato̱ Kain he owele toi kpawo le̱, asane̱kwa Lamek le̱, toi nyoṅmai-kpawo ke̱ kpawo! K.

english_verse: Adam and his wife had another son. They named him Seth, because they said, “God has given us a son to take the place of Abel, who was killed by his brother Cain.”
translation_verse: Ni Adam le eṅã le̱ ekoṅ, ni efo̱ binū, ni ewole̱ gbe̱i ake̱ Set; edšake̱ ekē̱: Nyoṅmo̱ eṅõ seši kroko etomi Habel nãdšiaṅ, edšakē̱ Kain egbele̱.

english_verse: Later, Seth had a son and named him Enosh. About this time people started worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni Set hũ fo̱ binū, ni ewole̱ gbe̱i ake̱ Enoš. No be le̱ mli abõi *Iehowa gbe̱i tšé̱mo̱. *

english_verse: God created men and women to be like himself. He gave them his blessing and called them human beings. The following is a list of the descendants of Adam, the first man:
translation_verse: nū ke̱ yō ebo̱ame̱, ni edšō̱ame̱, ni ewoame̱ gbe̱i ake̱ gbomo, gbĩ no̱ ni abo̱ame̱ le̱.

english_verse: and God took him away at the age of
translation_verse: ni Henok ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱ nyie, ni anaale̱, edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ṅõle̱ ke̱-te.

english_verse: Lamech said, “I'll name him Noah because he will give us comfort, as we struggle hard to make a living on this land that the Lord has put under a curse.”
translation_verse: ni ewole̱ gbe̱i ake̱ Noa, ni ekē̱: Mone̱ baše̱dše wo̱mī ye̱ wo̱nitšume̱i ke̱ wo̱nidšiaṅ to̱le̱i le̱ ni dše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ *lōmo̱ ni Iehowa elomo̱le̱ le̱ bewo̱ le̱ mli. *

english_verse: and this is the story about him. Noah was the only person who lived right and obeyed God.
translation_verse: Mene̱mei dši Noa sešibii le̱: Noa dši *dšalo̱, ni eye emū ye̱ eyino̱bii le̱ ateṅ; ni Noa ke †Nyoṅmo̱ nyie. *Heb.

english_verse: He had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
translation_verse: Ni Noa fo̱ bihĩĩ etẽ: Šem ke̱ Ham ke̱ Iafet.

english_verse: Get some good lumber and build a boat. Put rooms in it and cover it with tar inside and out.
translation_verse: Ṅõ gofertšo ofe adeka ohã ohe, ni ofe tšũi ye̱ adeka le̱ mli, ni owo emli ke̱ ehe amã.

english_verse: Noah did everything God told him to do.
translation_verse: Ni Noa fe nakai; bo̱ni Nyoṅmo̱ fã́le̱ le̱, nakai pe̱pē̱pe̱ efe.

english_verse: I'm going to send a flood that will destroy everything that breathes! Nothing will be left alive.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, na, mike̱ nu afua mība šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, koni mike̱-kpãtã helo fẽ ní wala mumo̱ yo̱ mli le̱ hĩe ke̱-dše̱ ṅwei šiši; nofẽno ni yo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ aaplenē.

english_verse: But I solemnly promise that you, your wife, your sons, and your daughters-in-law will be kept safe in the boat.
translation_verse: Ši mate kpãṅmo̱ ši mamã mike̱o teṅ, ni oobote adeka le̱ mli, bo ke̱ obihĩĩ le̱ ke̱ oṅã ke̱ obihĩĩ le̱ aṅãmei le̱.

english_verse: Take into the boat with you a male and a female of every kind of animal and bird, as well as a male and a female of every reptile. I don't want them to be destroyed.
translation_verse: Lofõdši ye̱ ame̱heno̱, ke̱ koloi ye̱ ame̱heno̱, ke̱ nii ni wamoo̱ ye̱ ame̱heno̱, sro̱toi fẽ enyo̱nyo̱ aba oṅõ, koni ahere ame̱yiwala.

english_verse: Store up enough food both for yourself and for them.
translation_verse: Ni bo le̱, ṅõ niyenii fẽ ní ayeo̱ le̱ eko ke̱-ba oṅō, ni obna nā ohã bodientše̱ ke̱ame̱ yeli.

english_verse: He obeyed God and took a male and a female of each kind of animal and bird into the boat with him.
translation_verse: enyo̱nyo̱ dše̱ ame̱teṅ te Noa ṅõ ye̱ adeka le̱ mli, nū ke̱ yō, take̱ bo̱ni *Ie-howa fã́ Noa le̱. *

english_verse: Seven days later a flood began to cover the earth.
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱ gbĩĩ kpawo le̱ se̱ le̱ nu afua le̱ ba šikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: The water under the earth started gushing out everywhere, the sky opened like windows, and rain poured down for
translation_verse: ni nyoṅmo̱ tue ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ſaneſane ke̱ nyōṅnyōṅ gbĩĩ nyoṅmai-edfe̱.

english_verse: On that day Noah and his wife went into the boat with their three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth, and their wives.

english_verse: The smell of the burning offering pleased the Lord, and he said: Never again will I punish the earth for the sinful things its people do. All of them have evil thoughts from the time they are young, but I will never destroy everything that breathes, as I did this time.

translation_verse: Ni Abram kē̱ Sodom maṅtše̱ le̱ ake̱: Mīwó minine no̱ mītšõ Iehowa ṅwei flōflo Nyoṅmo̱ ni dši ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ tše̱ le̱,

english_verse: Then the Lord told him, “Bring me a three-year-old cow, a three-year-old female goat, a three-year-old ram, a dove, and a young pigeon.”
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Ṅõ tšinayō ni eye afii etẽ, ke̱ tōabotia ní eye afii etẽ, ke̱ tõagbo ní eye afii etẽ, ke̱ kose̱-okpo ke̱ okpobi obahãmi.

english_verse: And when birds came down to eat the animals, Abram chased them away.

english_verse: Sometime after sunset, when it was very dark, a smoking cooking pot and a flaming fire passed between the two halves of each animal.

english_verse: and Sarai gave him Hagar to be his wife. This happened after Abram had lived in the land of Canaan for ten years.
translation_verse: Ni Abram ṅã Sarai le̱ ṅõ Mizraimyō Hagar, eweyō le̱, ehā ewù Abram gblã, beni Abram eye afii nyoṅma ye̱ Kanaan šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱.

english_verse: Later, when Hagar knew she was going to have a baby, she became proud and treated Sarai hatefully.
translation_verse: Ni eba Hagar ṅõ, ni ená mũsũ; ši beni ena ake̱ ehĩe mũsũ le̱, ewura le̱ he guo̱ gbo ye̱ ehĩe.

english_verse: Then Sarai said to Abram, “It's all your fault! I gave you my slave woman, but she has been hateful to me ever since she found out she was pregnant. You have done me wrong, and you will have to answer to the Lord for this.”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Sarai kē̱ Abram ake̱: Mihĩegbẽle ne̱ aakã ono̱! Miṅõ miweyō le̱ miwo omliši; ni beni ena ake̱ ehĩe mũsũ le̱, mihe guo̱ egbo ye̱ ehĩe. Iehowa aakodšo mike̱o teṅ!

english_verse: Abram said, “All right! She's your slave—do whatever you want with her.” Then Sarai began treating Hagar so harshly that she finally ran away.
translation_verse: Ši Abram kē̱ Sarai ake̱: Na, oweyō le̱ ye̱ odeṅ; femo̱le̱, bo̱ni sa ohĩe. Ni beni ebaäle̱ ši le̱, edšo foi ye̱ ehĩe.

english_verse: Hagar stopped to rest at a spring in the desert on the road to Shur. While she was there, the angel of the Lord came to her
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa bo̱fo le̱ nale̱ ye̱ nubu ko he ye̱ ṅã le̱ ne̱, ye̱ Sur gbe̱ le̱ ne̱ nubu le̱ he.

english_verse: and asked, “Hagar, where have you come from, and where are you going?” She answered, “I'm running away from Sarai, my owner.”
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Hagar, Sarai weyō, nẽgbe̱ odše̱, ni nẽgbe̱ hũ oyaä? Ni ekē̱: Miwura Sarai hĩe midšoo̱ foi ye̱ ne̱.

english_verse: The angel said, “Go back to Sarai and be her slave.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa bo̱fo le̱ kē̱le̱ ake̱: Kū ose̱ ke̱-ya owura le̱ ṅõ, ni oba ohe ši ohãle̱.

english_verse: But your son will live far from his relatives; he will be like a wild donkey, fighting everyone, and everyone fighting him.”
translation_verse: Ni e̱etšṍ gbomo ní tamo̱ ṅãṅ tedši; enine aakã mofẽmo he, ni mofẽmo nine aakã ehe; ni eehĩ ši ye̱ enyemimei le̱ fẽ hĩe.

english_verse: Hagar thought, “Have I really seen God and lived to tell about it?” So from then on she called him, “The God Who Sees Me.”
translation_verse: Ni etšē̱ Iehowa ni ke̱le̱ wie le̱ gbe̱i ake̱: Bo dši Mawu ni naämi! Edšake̱ ekē̱: Ani bie̱ ne̱ hũ mikwe̱ moni naämi le̱ yi se̱ lo?

english_verse: That's why people call the well between Kadesh and Bered, “The Well of the Living One Who Sees Me.”
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ atšé̱ ne̱ke̱ nubu ne̱ ake̱ hĩekãlo̱ ni naämi le̱ nubu; na, eye̱ Kadeš ke̱ Bared teṅ.

english_verse: I will keep my solemn promise to you and give you more descendants than can be counted.”
translation_verse: Ni mike̱ mikpãṅmo̱ le̱ aṅmẽ mike̱o teṅ, ni mahã oyi afá babaō dientše̱.

english_verse: I promise that you will be the father of many nations. So now I'm changing your name from Abram to Abraham.
translation_verse: Ni akatšé̱ ogbe̱i Abram doṅṅ, ši moṅ Abraham aatšé̱ ogbe̱i; edšake̱ mike̱o efe dšeṅmãdši asafo yū atše̱. Rom.

english_verse: Abraham, you and all future members of your family must promise to obey me.
translation_verse: Ni Nyoṅmo̱ sā kē̱ Abraham ake̱: Ši bo hũ, ye mikpãṅmo̱ le̱ no̱, bo ke̱ osešibii ni aaba ye̱ ose̱ le̱ ye̱ ame̱yino̱i le̱ amli.

english_verse: As the sign that you are keeping this promise, you must circumcise every man and boy in your family.
translation_verse: Ni aflo̱nye ketia, ni atšṍ kpãṅmo̱ ni yo̱ mike̱ nyeteṅ le̱ he okadi.

english_verse: Any man who isn't circumcised hasn't kept his part of the promise and cannot be one of my people.
translation_verse: Ni nū fōlo̱ ko ní afokole̱ ketia le̱, aafo ne̱ke̱ susuma ne̱ ye̱ emã le̱ṅ aše̱ afõ; edšake̱ ekwa mikpãṅmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Abraham, from now on your wife's name will be Sarah instead of Sarai.
translation_verse: Ni Nyoṅmo̱ sã kē̱ Abraham ake̱: Oṅã Sarai le̱, kātšé̱ egbe̱i ake̱ Sarai doṅṅ, ši Sara dši egbe̱i.

english_verse: But God answered: No! You and Sarah will have a son. His name will be Isaac, and I will make an everlasting promise to him and his descendants.
translation_verse: Ni Nyoṅmo̱ kē̱: Le̱le̱ṅ, oṅã Sara aafo̱ binū ahão, ni oowole̱ gbe̱i ake̱ Isak; ni mahã mike̱le̱ kpãṅmo̱ le̱ amã ši, ni atšṍ *nãno̱ kpãṅmo̱ ahã éseši ni aaba ye̱ ese̱ le̱.

english_verse: However, I have heard what you asked me to do for Ishmael, and so I will also bless him with many descendants. He will be the father of twelve princes, and I will make his family a great nation.
translation_verse: Ni kẽle̱ Išmael hũ hewo̱ le̱ miboö toi; na, midšō̱le̱ ni mahã ewo ſĩei ni eyi afá *babaō dientše̱. †Eefo̱ lume̱i nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱, ni mahã efe dšeṅmaṅ kpeteṅkple. *

english_verse: God finished speaking to Abraham and then left.
translation_verse: Ni eke̱le̱ fõ wiemo̱. Ni Nyoṅmo̱ yiṅ ke̱-dše̱ Abraham ṅõ *ke̱-te ṅwei. *

english_verse: On that same day Abraham obeyed God by circumcising Ishmael. Abraham was also circumcised, and so were all the other men and boys in his household, including his servants and slaves. He was
translation_verse: ni ewehĩĩ le̱ fẽ, mei ni afo̱ame̱ ye̱ šĩa ke̱ mei ni ake̱ šika heame̱ ye̱ gbo̱i adeṅ le̱, aflo̱ame̱ ketia afata ehe.

english_verse: The Lord asked Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh? Does she doubt that she can have a child in her old age?
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱ Abraham ake̱: Meni hewo̱ Sara ṅmõ ni ekē̱ ake̱: Aso le̱le̱ṅ ake̱ mi ni mitšṍ yōmo ne maná hi mafo̱ lo le̱?

english_verse: I am the Lord! There is nothing too difficult for me. I'll come back next year at the time I promised, and Sarah will already have a son.”
translation_verse: *Ani sane ko wa hã Iehowa? Be ni mito le̱ mli le̱ maba oṅõ eko̱ṅ afi nākplo̱ bene̱, ni Sara aaná binū! *Luk.

english_verse: since his family will become a great and powerful nation that will be a blessing to all the other nations on earth.

english_verse: And Abraham asked him, “Lord, when you destroy the evil people, are you also going to destroy those who are good?
translation_verse: Ni Abraham tši be̱ṅke̱le̱ ni ekē̱: Ani ookpãtã dšalo̱ ke̱ gbomo fõṅ fẽ hĩe šikome lo?

english_verse: You surely wouldn't let them be killed when you destroy the evil ones. You are the judge of all the earth, and you do what is right.”
translation_verse: Ene̱ akagbaleo ake̱ ooye ne̱ke̱ sane, ni ogbe dšalo̱ ke̱ gbomo fõṅ šikome, ní dšalo̱ atšṍ tamo̱ gbomo fõṅ! Ene̱ akagboleo! Ani šikpoṅ fẽ no̱ kodšolo̱ le̱ ekodšoṅ dšale̱ kodšomo̱?

english_verse: Abraham answered, “I am nothing more than the dust of the earth. Please forgive me, Lord, for daring to speak to you like this.
translation_verse: Ni Abraham here no̱ ni ekē̱ ake̱: Na, miṅõ-fõ mino̱ ake̱ mike̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ aawie, tše̱ mi le̱, sũ ke̱ lamlu ke̱ke̱ dšimi.

english_verse: Finally, Abraham said, “Please don't get angry, Lord, if I speak just once more. Suppose you find only

english_verse: After speaking with Abraham, the Lord left, and Abraham went back home.
translation_verse: Ni beni Iehowa ke̱ Abraham efõ wiemo̱ le̱, eyiṅ ete; ni Abraham kũ ese̱ ke̱-ba edšē̱he le̱.

english_verse: Lot went to the men who were engaged to his daughters and said, “Hurry up and get out of here! The Lord is going to destroy this city.” But they thought he was joking, and they laughed at him.
translation_verse: Ni Lot dše kpo ni eke̱ ešãhĩmei le̱ ní baw̌e̱ ebiyei le̱ wie ekē̱: Nyetea ši *nyedšea bie̱ ne̱, ši Iehowa bakpãtã maṅ ne̱ hĩe! Ši etamo̱ moni yeo̱ fe̱o ye̱ ešāhĩmei le̱ ahĩe. *

english_verse: Early the next morning the two angels tried to make Lot hurry and leave. They said, “Take your wife and your two daughters and get away from here as fast as you can! If you don't, every one of you will be killed when the Lord destroys the city.”
translation_verse: Ni beni dše tše̱re le̱, bo̱foi le̱ tšire̱ Lot yi se̱, ni ame̱kē̱: Te ši, ṅõ oṅã ke̱ obiyei enyo̱ ni yo̱ bie̱ le̱, koni akalōo aſie ye̱ maṅ le̱ nõša le̱ mli.

english_verse: There's a town near here. It's only a small place, but my family and I will be safe, if you let us go there.”

english_verse: “All right, go there,” he answered. “I won't destroy that town.

english_verse: He destroyed those cities and everyone who lived in them, as well as their land and the trees and grass that grew there.
translation_verse: ni ebutu ne̱ke̱ mãdši ne̱ ke̱ dše̱i niiaṅ fẽ ke̱ mãdši le̱ amli bii fẽ ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ nibii ni ekwẽkwẽi le̱.

english_verse: On the way, Lot's wife looked back and was turned into a block of salt.
translation_verse: Ši eṅã le̱ kwe̱ ese̱, ni etšṍ ṅōkpo̱ ni mã ši. Luk.

english_verse: That same morning Abraham got up and went to the place where he had stood and spoken with the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni Abraham te ši lebi mā̃ṅkpa ete heni edamo̱ Iehowa hĩe ye̱ le̱;

english_verse: He looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah and saw smoke rising from all over the land—it was like a flaming furnace.

translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱, beni Nyoṅmo̱ kpãtã mãdši ni yo̱ dše̱i niiaṅ kutũ le̱ ahĩe le̱, Nyoṅmo̱ kai Abraham ni edšie Lot ke̱-dše butumo̱ le̱ mli, beni ebutu mãdši le̱ ni Lot hī mli le̱.

english_verse: Lot was afraid to stay on in Zoar. So he took his two daughters and moved to a cave in the hill country.
translation_verse: Ni Lot dše Zoar, ni eke̱ ebiyei enyo̱ le̱ yahĩ goṅ le̱ no̱, edšake̱ ẽše Zoar hĩle̱ gbeyei; ni eyahĩ te̱kplo ko mli, le̱ ke̱ ebiyei enyo̱ le̱.

english_verse: One day his older daughter said to her sister, “Our father is old, and there are no men anywhere for us to marry.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni onukpa le̱ kē̱ gbekẽ le̱ ake̱: Wo̱tše̱ egbo̱, ni nū ko be̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni aaba wo̱ṅõ, take̱ bo̱ni afeo̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ fẽ no̱ le̱;

english_verse: Let's get our father drunk! Then we can sleep with him and have children.”
translation_verse: ba, hã ni wo̱hã wo̱tše̱ wein enu, ni *wo̱ke̱le̱ awo̱, koni wo̱ke̱ wo̱tše̱ afo̱ bii. *

english_verse: That night they got their father drunk, and the older daughter got in bed with him, but he was too drunk even to know she was there.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱hã ame̱tše̱ wein enu nakai nyō le̱ṅ; ni onukpa le̱ yiṅ te, ni eke̱ etše̱ yawo̱; ni elee ešikãmo̱ mli lo ešitē mli.

english_verse: The next day the older daughter said to her sister, “I slept with my father last night. We'll get him drunk again tonight, so you can sleep with him, and we can each have a child.”
translation_verse: Ni dšetše̱reno̱ lebi le̱ eba mli ake̱ onukpa le̱ kē̱ gbekẽ lē̱ akē̱; Na, nye nyōṅ le̱ mike̱ mitše̱ yawo̱; hã ni wo̱hãle̱ wein enu nyō ne̱ṅ hũ, ni bo hũ oya oke̱le̱ ayawo̱, koni wo̱ke̱ we̱tše̱ afo̱ bii.

english_verse: That night they got their father drunk, and this time the younger sister slept with him. But once again he was too drunk even to know she was there.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱hã ame̱tše̱ wein enu nakai nyō le̱ṅ hũ; ni gbekẽ le̱ hũ yiṅ te, ni eke̱le̱ yawo̱; ni elee ešikãmo̱ mli lo ešitē mli.

english_verse: That's how Lot's two daughters had children.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni fe ni Lot biyei enyo̱ le̱ ke̱ ame̱tše̱ ná mũsũ ne̱.

english_verse: The older daughter named her son Moab, and he is the ancestor of the Moabites.
translation_verse: Ni kromo̱bi le̱ fo̱ binū, ni ewole̱ gbē̱i ake̱ Moab; le̱ dši Moabbii le̱ atše̱ ke̱-baši ṅme̱ne̱.

english_verse: The younger daughter named her son Benammi, and he is the ancestor of the Ammonites.
translation_verse: Ni gbekẽ le̱ hũ fo̱ binū, ni ewole̱ gbe̱i ake̱ Ben-Ami; le̱ dši Amonbii le̱ atše̱ ke̱ ṅme̱ne̱.

english_verse: he told everyone that his wife Sarah was his sister. So King Abimelech of Gerar had Sarah brought to him.
translation_verse: Ni Abraham kē̱ ye̱ eṅã Sara hewo̱ akē̱: Minyemiyō dšilē̱. Ni Abimelek, Gerar maṅtšē̱ le̱, tšũ ni ayaṅõ Sara ke̱-ba.
