english_verse: And he has given them all kinds of artistic skills, including the ability to design and embroider with blue, purple, and red wool and to weave fine linen.
translation_verse: Ni eke̱ ṅā-tšui ewo ame̱mli obõbõ, ni ame̱ṅa ṅāi sro̱toi ſẽ, niiaṅkpe̱lo̱ ṅā ke̱ ṅāle̱ ní hĩe yo̱ ṅā, ke̱ niiaṅlòlo̱ ni lòo̱ blū nii ke̱ afaseo ke̱ etšuru ke̱ klala fe̱fe̱dši amli, ke̱ mamalòlo̱ nõ, ke̱ mei ní tšuo̱ nitšumo̱-fẽ-nitšumo̱ ni ame̱ṅaä ṅāi fẽ le̱ anõ.

english_verse: If you have any skills, you should use them to help make what I have commanded:
translation_verse: Ni nyeteṅ mofẽmo ní le ṅā ye̱ etšui mli aba, ní ebafe nii fẽ ní Iehowa ekē̱ le̱: (

english_verse: and the finely woven priestly clothes for Aaron and his sons. Gifts for the Lord
translation_verse: ke̱ súomo̱ atadei le̱ ní ake̱-súmo̱ ye̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱, ke̱ oso̱fo Aaron atadei kroṅkroṅi le̱, ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ atadei le̱ ni ame̱ke̱-ye oso̱fo.

english_verse: Moses told the people of Israel that the Lord had said:
translation_verse: Ni Mose kē̱ Israelbii le̱ asafo mū le̱ fẽ ake̱: Wiemo̱ ní Iehowa wie ne̱:

english_verse: olive oil for the lamp; sweet-smelling spices for the oil of dedication and for the incense; or
translation_verse: ke̱ mũ ní ake̱-suo̱ kane le̱, ke̱ tšofã-ke̱-ṅma ní ake̱-fe mũ kroṅkroṅ le̱, ke̱ tšofã-ke̱-ṅma ní ašãa le̱,

english_verse: the sacred chest with its carrying poles, its place of mercy, and the curtain in front of it;
translation_verse: ke̱ adeka le̱ ke̱ ehetšei le̱, ke̱ kpãtãmo̱ sẽi le̱, ke̱ muhō̱ le̱ ní aṅõ-haä he le̱;

english_verse: the table with its carrying poles and all that goes on it, including the sacred bread;
translation_verse: okplõ le̱ ke̱ ehetšei le̱, ke̱ ehenii le̱ ſẽ, ke̱ hĩe-ma-abolo le̱,

english_verse: the incense altar with its carrying poles and sweet-smelling incense; the ordination oil; the curtain for the entrance to the sacred tent;
translation_verse: ke̱ tšofã-ke̱-ṅma-šãlate̱ le̱, ke̱ ehe-tšei le̱, ke̱ mũ kroṅkroṅ le̱, ke̱ tšofã-ke̱-ṅma nī ašãa le̱, ke̱ šihĩle̱he le̱ šĩnā le̱ nā mama le̱,

english_verse: the altar for sacrifices with its bronze grating, its carrying poles, and its equipment; the large bronze bowl with its stand;
translation_verse: šā̃-afo̱lelate̱ le̱, ke̱ ehe akō̱ble afã-bãṅ le̱, etšei le̱ ke̱ ehenii le̱ fẽ, ke̱ lala-kã le̱ ke̱ ekăla le̱,

english_verse: the curtains with the posts and stands that go around the courtyard and the curtain at the entrance;
translation_verse: ke̱ kpo le̱ he muhō̱i le̱, ke̱ mplãṅi le̱, ke̱ ame̱no̱damo̱nii le̱, ke̱ kpo le̱ no̱ agbó le̱ nā mama le̱,

english_verse: the pegs and ropes for the tent and the courtyard;
translation_verse: ke̱ šihĩle̱he le̱ he šiṅmlitšei le̱, ke̱ kpo le̱ he šiṅmlitšei le̱ ke̱ ame̱tãṅkpēi le̱,

english_verse: Moses finished speaking, and everyone left.
translation_verse: Ni Israelbii le̱ asafo mū le̱ fẽ dše Mose hĩe ame̱te.

english_verse: Then those who wanted to bring gifts to the Lord, brought them to be used for the sacred tent, the worship services, and the priestly clothes.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ba, mofẽmo ní etšui mli tale̱, ke̱ mofẽmo ní *ná he tšui le̱, ni ame̱ke̱ Iehowa ne̱wómo̱-nikẽnii le̱ ba ní ake̱-fe kpē-bū le̱ ke̱ ehe súomo̱nii le̱ fẽ ke̱ atadei kroṅkroṅi le̱. *

english_verse: Men and women came willingly and gave all kinds of gold jewelry such as pins, earrings, rings, and necklaces.
translation_verse: Ni hĩĩ ke̱ yei fẽ, mei abo̱ ní yo̱ he tšui le̱ ba, ni ame̱ke̱ tšitšinātše̱nii ke̱ toiiaṅnii ke̱ waogai ke̱ ninešikpotiai ba, fẽ le̱ šika dſinei so̱ṅṅ; ni mofẽmo ní ke̱ šika fō̃-nikēnii ba le̱, eke̱-bahã Iehowa.

english_verse: Everyone brought their blue, purple, and red wool, their fine linen, and their cloth made of goat hair, as well as their ram skins dyed red and their fine leather.
translation_verse: Ni mofẽmo ní ana mama blū ke̱ afaseo ke̱ etšuru ke̱ klala fe̱fe̱o ke̱ abotia hetšo̱i ke̱ tōagbo wodši ní awoame̱ etšuru ke̱ nuṅgbẽ́ wodši ye̱ eṅõ le̱, eke̱-ba.

english_verse: Anyone who had silver or bronze or acacia wood brought it as a gift to the Lord.

english_verse: the bronze altar for sacrifices with its bronze grating, its carrying poles, and its equipment; the large bronze bowl with its stand;
translation_verse: akō̱ble afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱, ke̱ ehe akō̱ble afãbãṅ le̱, ke̱ ehe tšei le̱, ke̱ ehenii le̱ fẽ, ke̱ lalakã le̱ ke̱ ekăla le̱,

english_verse: the curtain with its posts and cords, and its pegs and stands that go around the courtyard; everything needed for the sacred tent;
translation_verse: kpo le̱ no̱ muhō̱i le̱, ekulašĩṅi le̱ ke̱ eno̱damo̱nii le̱, ke̱ kpo le̱ no̱ agbó le̱ nā mama le̱, ke̱ ehe tãṅkpẽi le̱, ke̱ ehe šiṅmlitšei le̱, ke̱ šihĩle̱he le̱ mli súomo̱nii le̱ fẽ, hã kpē-bū le̱,

english_verse: Set up my tent on the first day of the year
translation_verse: Kleṅkleṅ nyõṅ le̱ no̱ kleṅkleṅ gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ ši kpē-bū le̱ šihĩle̱he le̱.

english_verse: and put the chest with the Ten Commandments behind the inside curtain.
translation_verse: Ni oṅõ odaseyeli adeka le̱ owo mli, ni oke̱ muhō̱ le̱ aha adeka le̱ he.

english_verse: Set the altar for burning sacrifices in front of the entrance to my tent.
translation_verse: Ni oṅõ šā̃-afo̱lelate̱ le̱ omã kpē-bū šihĩle̱he le̱ šĩnā le̱ ši.

english_verse: Put the large bronze bowl between the tent and the altar and fill the bowl with water.
translation_verse: Ni oṅõ lalakã le̱ omã kpē-bū le̱ ke̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ teṅ, ni oṅõ nu owo mli.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Ni oke̱ Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ aba kpē-bū le̱ šĩnā le̱ ši, ni oke̱ nu adšu amehe.

english_verse: Dress Aaron in the priestly clothes, then use the sacred olive oil to ordain him and dedicate him to me as my priest.
translation_verse: Ni oṅõ atadei kroṅkroṅi le̱ owo Aaron, ni ofo̱le̱ mũ, ni ofele̱ kroṅkroṅ, koni eye oso̱fo ehãmi.

english_verse: Put the priestly robes on Aaron's sons
translation_verse: Ni oke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ hũ aba, ni owoame̱ flakai le̱;

english_verse: Moses followed the Lord's instructions.
translation_verse: Ni Mose fe bo̱ni Iehowa fã́ le̱ fẽ, nakai efe.

english_verse: And on the first day of the first month of the second year, the sacred tent was set up.
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ye̱ afi ní dši enyo̱ le̱ mli kleṅkleṅ nyõṅ le̱ no̱ kleṅkleṅ gbĩ le̱ no̱ ake̱ aši šihĩle̱he le̱.

english_verse: The stones with the Ten Commandments written on them were stored in the sacred chest, the place of mercy was put on top of it, and the carrying poles were attached.
translation_verse: Ni eṅõ odaseyelinõ ewo adeka le̱ mli, ni eṅõ tšei le̱ eho̱lo̱ adeka le̱ he, ni eke̱ kpãtãmo̱ sẽi le̱ bu adeka le̱ nā;

english_verse: The table for the sacred bread was put along the north wall of the holy place,
translation_verse: Ni eke̱ okplõ le̱ mã kpē-bū le̱ṅ, ye̱ šihĩle̱he le̱ heni ye ke̱-yaä kōyigbe̱ le̱, ye̱ muhō̱ le̱ kpono̱gbe̱.

english_verse: after which the bread was set on the table.
translation_verse: Ni eto abolo le̱ gbe̱dšiano̱ ye̱ ne̱ ye̱ Iehowa hĩe, take̱ bo̱ni Iehowa fã́ Mose le̱.

english_verse: then the lamps were attached to it there in the presence of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni eke̱ ehe kanei le̱ mãmo̱ no̱ ye̱ Iehowa hĩe, take̱ bo̱ni Iehowa fã́ Mose le̱.

english_verse: The gold incense altar was set up in front of the curtain,
translation_verse: Ni eṅõ šika tšofã-ke̱-ṅma-šãlate̱ le̱ ewo kpē-bū le̱ṅ ye̱ muhō̱ le̱ kpono̱gbe̱;

english_verse: and sweet-smelling incense was burned on it. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: ni ešã tšofã-ke̱-ṅma ye̱ no̱, take̱ bo̱ni Iehowa fã́ Mose le̱.

english_verse: Then the altar for offering sacrifices was put in front of the tent, and animal sacrifices and gifts of grain were offered there.
translation_verse: Ni eṅõ šā̃-afo̱le-late̱ le̱ emã kpē-bū le̱ šihĩle̱he le̱ šĩnā le̱ ši, ni ešã šā̃-afo̱le ke̱ niyenii-afo̱le le̱ ye̱ no̱, take̱ bo̱ni Iehowa fã́ Mose le̱.

english_verse: The large bronze bowl was placed between the altar and the entrance to the tent. It was filled with water,
translation_verse: Ni eṅõ lalakã le̱ emã kpē-bū le̱ ke̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ teṅ, ni eṅõ nu ewo mli, ní ake̱-dšu.

english_verse: then Moses and Aaron, together with Aaron's sons, washed their hands and feet.
translation_verse: Ni Mose ke̱ Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ fo̱flo̱ ame̱dẽi ke̱ ame̱nãdši ahe ye̱ mli;

english_verse: In fact, they washed each time before entering the tent or offering sacrifices at the altar. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: ke̱ ame̱te kpē-bū le̱ṅ, ni ke̱ ame̱babe̱ṅke̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱, ame̱fo̱flo̱ö̱ ame̱he, take̱ bo̱ni Iehowa fã́ Mose le̱.

english_verse: Finally, Moses had the curtains hung around the courtyard and at the entrance. The Glory of the Lord
translation_verse: Ni etẽ kpo le̱ ši emã ši ke̱-bo̱le šihĩle̱he le̱ ke̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱, ni eke̱ kpo le̱ no̱ agbó le̱ nā mama le̱ ha nā. Ke̱ke̱ ni Mose gbe nitšumo̱ le̱ nā,

english_verse: then they would set up camp and stay there, until it moved again.
translation_verse: ši ke̱dši atatu le̱ wóó ehe no̱ le̱, bĕle̱ ame̱fãã āhũ ke̱-yaši gbĩ no̱ ní eewó ehe no̱.

english_verse: No matter where the people traveled, the Lord was with them. Each day his cloud was over the tent, and each night a fire could be seen in the cloud.
translation_verse: Ši Iehowa atatu le̱ damo̱ šihĩle̱he le̱ no̱ ſane, ni nyōṅ le̱ la ye̱ mli, ye̱ Israel we le̱ fẽ hĩe, ye̱ ame̱gbe̱nyiemo̱i le̱ fẽ mli.

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head, and I will accept the animal as a sacrifice for taking away your sins.
translation_verse: Ni eke̱ enine aṅmẽ šā̃-afo̱le le̱ yiteṅ, ni eye enãdšiaṅ, koni aṅõ-kpãtã ahãle̱.

english_verse: After the bull is killed in my presence, some priests from Aaron's family will offer its blood to me by splattering it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ni egbe tšinabinū le̱ ye̱ Iehowa hĩe, ni Aaron bihĩĩ ní dši oso̱foi le̱ ke̱ ela le̱ aba, ni ame̱ke̱ lá le̱ abaſã afo̱le-šãlate̱ le̱ ní yo̱ kpē-bū le̱ šĩnā le̱ ši le̱ no̱ ke̱-kpe.

english_verse: Skin the bull and cut it up,
translation_verse: Ni edšie šā̃-afo̱le le̱ hewolo le̱, ni asā.

english_verse: while the priests pile wood on the altar fire to make it start blazing.
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo Aaron bihĩĩ le̱ ke̱ la aſie afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱, ni ame̱to lai le̱ ame̱ſie la le̱ no̱ gbe̱dšiano̱.

english_verse: Wash the bull's insides and hind legs, so the priests can lay them on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. A priest will then send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: ši emlinii le̱ ke̱ enãdši le̱ efo̱ he ye̱ nu mli, ni oso̱fo le̱ ašã fẽ ye̱ afo̱le-šãlate̱ le̱ no̱; šā̃-afo̱le ni, afo̱le ní ake̱ la sãa ní *dšeo ṅma woo̱ Iehowa ni. *

english_verse: If you sacrifice a ram or a goat, it must not have anything wrong with it.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši tōi ní dši tōgwanteṅi lo tōabotiai le̱ eko eke̱-yašã šā̃-afo̱le le̱, nū ni he be̱ kpa ko eke̱-ba.

english_verse: Lead the animal to the north side of the altar, where it is to be killed in my presence. Then some of the priests will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ni egbele̱ ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ mase̱i ke̱-yaä kōyigbe̱ ye̱ Iehowa hĩe; ni Aaron bihĩĩ ní dši oso̱foi le̱ aṅõ ela le̱ aſã afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ ke̱-kpe.

english_verse: Cut up the animal and wash its insides and hind legs. A priest will put these parts on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. Then he will send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: ni emlinii le̱ ke̱ nãdši le̱ eke̱ nu afo̱ he, ni oso̱fo le̱ ke̱ fẽ aba ni ebašã ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱; šā̃-afo̱le ni, afo̱le ní ake̱ la šãa ní dšeo̱ ṅma woo̱ Iehowa ni.

english_verse: If you offer a bird for this kind of sacrifice, it must be a dove or a pigeon.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši loflõ eke̱-bašã šā̃-afo̱le ehã Iehowa le̱, eke̱ kose̱-okpoi lo šĩa-okpobii le̱ eko aba.

english_verse: A priest will take the bird to the bronze altar, where he will wring its neck and put its head on the fire. Then he will drain out its blood on one side of the altar,
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo le̱ ke̱-ba afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ he, ni etše eyitšo ye̱ no̱, ni ešã ye̱ afo̱le-šãlate̱ le̱ no̱, ni elá le̱ atšere aſie afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: remove the bird's craw with what is in it, and throw them on the ash heap at the east side of the altar.
translation_verse: Ni edšie ekpo̱ṅo̱ši ke̱ emlinii le̱, ni eše̱ efõ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ mase̱i ye̱ bo-kãgbe̱, heni lamlu le̱ yo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Finally, he will take the bird by its wings, tear it partially open, and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ni ekũmo̱ efĩdši, ši ekakpŏ̱lo̱ ye̱ he; ni oso̱fo ašã ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ ye̱ lai ní yo̱ la le̱ no̱ le̱ no̱; šā̃-afo̱le ni, afo̱le ní ake̱ la šãa ní dšeo̱ ṅma woo̱ Iehowa ni.

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to give thanks to me, you must use only your finest flour. Put it in a dish, sprinkle olive oil and incense on the flour,
translation_verse: Ni kē̱ moko ke̱ niyenii-afo̱le miba abake Iehowa le̱, eke̱ ṅmā̃ mãmu aba, ni eke̱ mũ aſie no̱, ni eke̱ kro̱bo̱o afata he,

english_verse: If you cook your bread in a pan with a lid on it, you must also use the finest flour mixed with oil.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši onikēnii ní oke̱-bake le̱ dši noko ní ašãa ye̱ nišãnõ no̱ le̱, ṅõ mã ke̱ mũ ofe.

english_verse: You may prepare sacrifices to give thanks in any of these three ways. Bring your sacrifice to a priest, and he will take it to the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ni oke niyenii-afo̱le ni ake̱ ene̱mei fe le̱ abahã Iehowa, oke̱-bahã oso̱fo le̱, ni eke̱-ba afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ he.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Ši noni aaſe̱ ye̱ niyenii-afo̱le le̱ se̱ le̱, Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ anõ ni; Iehowa afo̱lei ní ake̱ la šãa le̱ amli noni yo̱ kroṅkroṅ fè fẽ dši no.

english_verse: Yeast and honey must never be burned on the altar, so don't ever mix either of these in a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: Niyenii-afo̱lei fẽ ní nyeke̱-bahã Iehowa le̱, nyeke̱ *mãša akafea; edšake̱ mãša-fẽ-mãša lo wò-fẽ-wò le̱ nyekašãa eko ye̱ Iehowa la le̱ no̱. *

english_verse: Salt is offered when you make an agreement with me, so sprinkle salt on these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ni *oniyenii-afo̱lei fẽ ní oke̱-bake le̱, wo mli ṅō, ni o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ kpãṅmo̱ ṅõ le̱ akakpa ye̱ oniyenii-afo̱le le̱ mli; ofo̱lei fẽ ni oke̱-bake le̱ ṅō afata he. *Mar.

english_verse: Freshly cut grain, either roasted or coarsely ground, must be used when you offer the first part of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši oke̱ *okleṅkleṅyibii le̱ amli niyenii-afo̱le miba abake Iehowa le̱, ṅõ abletšo ní ašã ye̱ la mli, able kpokploku ní aši obahã ake̱ okleṅkleṅyibii le̱ amli niyenii-afo̱le; *

english_verse: You must mix in some olive oil and put incense on top, because this is a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: ni oṅo mũ oſie no̱, ni oṅo kro̱bo̱o ofo no̱; niyenii-afo̱le dši no.

english_verse: A priest will sprinkle all of the incense and some of the grain and oil on the altar and send them up in smoke to show that the whole offering belongs to me.
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo le̱ ašã ekaimo̱nõ le̱ able ní aši le̱ eko ke̱ mũ le̱ eko ke̱ kro̱bo̱o ní fata he le̱ fẽ; afo̱le ní ake̱ la šãa hãa Iehowa ni.

english_verse: Lead it to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay your hand on its head, and have it killed there. A priest from Aaron's family will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ni eke̱ enine afõ efo̱le le̱ yiteṅ, ni egbele̱ ye̱ kpē-bū le̱ šĩnā le̱ ši, ni Aaron bihĩĩ ní dši oso̱foi le̱ aṅõ lá le̱ abaſã afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ ne̱ ke̱-kpe.

english_verse: Instead of a bull or a cow, you may offer any sheep or goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Ni ké̱ tō eke̱-bašã šidā-afo̱le ehã Iehowa le̱, nū dšio, yō dšio, noni kpa ko be̱ ehe eke̱-ba.

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: ni eke̱ enine afo efo̱le le̱ yiteṅ, ni egbele̱ ye̱ kpē-bū le̱ hĩe, ni Aaron bii le̱ aṅõ elá le̱ abaſã afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ ke̱-kpe.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering for me.
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo le̱ asã ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱; Iehowa la le̱ niyenii dši no.

english_verse: at the entrance to the sacred tent. Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: ni eke̱ enine afõ eyiteṅ, ni egbele̱ ye̱ kpē-bū le̱ hĩe, ni Aaron bihĩĩ le̱ aṅõ elá le̱ aſã afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ ke̱-kpe.

english_verse: One of the priests will put these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering with a smell that pleases me. All fat belongs to me.
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo le̱ ašã nii ne̱ ye̱ afo̱le-šãlate̱ le̱ no̱, ní etšṍ la niyenii ní dšeo̱ ṅma le̱; fo̱ le̱ fẽ le̱ Iehowa nõ ni.

english_verse: This is a sacrifice for sin. So he will lay his hand on the animal's head, before having it killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: ni eṅõ enine efõ tōkpakpo le̱ yiteṅ, ni egbele̱ ye̱ heni agbeo̱ šā̃-afo̱le le̱ ye̱ le̱ ye̱ Iehowa hĩe; eša-afo̱le ni.

english_verse: Then a priest will dip a finger in the blood; he will smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: ni oso̱fo le̱ ke̱ ewao atšo̱ elá le̱ eko, ni ediki afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ kodši le̱, ni etši lá ní eſe̱ le̱ fẽ eſie afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ šiši;

english_verse: He will take a bowl of the blood inside the tent,
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo ní afo̱le̱ mũ le̱ aṅõ tšinanū le̱ lá le̱ eko ni eko̱-bote kpē-bū le̱ṅ;

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he will smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo le̱ aṅõ lá le̱ eko adiki tšofã-ke̱-ṅma-šãlate̱ le̱ ní ye̱ *Iehowa hĩe ye̱ kpē-bū le̱ṅ le̱ no̱ kodši le̱; ni etši tšinanū le̱ lá ni eſe̱ le̱ fẽ eſie afo̱lešãlate̱ ní yo̱ †kpē-bū le̱ šĩnā le̱ ši le̱ šiši. *

english_verse: The priest will take a bowl of the animal's blood inside the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo ní afo̱le̱ mũ le̱ aṅõ tšinanū le̱ lá le̱ eko eke̱-bote kpē-bū le̱ mli,

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: ni oso̱fo le̱ aṅõ ewao atšo̱ lá le̱ mli, ni eke̱-ſã šii kpawo ye̱ Iehowa hĩe ye̱ muhō̱ le̱ hĩe,

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he must smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: ni esā eṅõ lá le̱ eko ediki tšofã-ke̱-ṅma-šãlate̱ ní mã Iehowa hĩe ye̱ kpē-bū le̱ṅ le̱ kodši le̱, ni etši lá ní eſe̱ le̱ fẽ eſie afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ ní mã kpē-bū šĩnā le̱ ši le̱ šiši.

english_verse: As soon as the leader realizes what has happened, he must sacrifice a goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: ké̱ ahã ele eša ní efe le̱, no le̱ eṅõ tōkpakpo ní kpa ko be̱ ehe ke̱-ba,

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo le̱ ke̱ ewao atšo̱ eša-afo̱le lá le̱ eko, ni ediki afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ kodši le̱, ni etši lá ní eſe̱ le̱ eſie afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ šiši.

english_verse: Then he must send all of the fat up in smoke, just as he does when a sacrifice is offered to ask my blessing. By this sacrifice the leader's sin will be forgiven. When Ordinary People Sin The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ni ešã efo̱ le̱ fẽ ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no tamo̱ šidā-afo̱le fo̱ le̱; ni oso̱fo le̱ akpãtã ahãle̱ ye̱ ehe eša le̱ hewo̱, ni aṅõ-fale̱.

english_verse: When any of you ordinary people disobey me without meaning to, you are still guilty.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši maṅbii le̱ ateṅ moko lee be ní eyafe eša ko, ni efe nibii ní Iehowa ewo kitã ake̱ akafe le̱ eko, ni eye sõ le̱,

english_verse: As soon as you realize what you have done, you must sacrifice a female goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: ke̱dši ahã ele eša ní efe le̱, no le̱ eke̱ tōabotia yō ní he be̱ kpa ko aba abahã ye̱ eša ní efe le̱ hewo̱;

english_verse: Lead the goat to the north side of the bronze altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: ni eṅõ enine efõ eša-afo̱le le̱ yiteṅ, ni egbe eša-afo̱le le̱ ye̱ heni agbeo šā̃-afo̱le le̱ ye̱ le̱;

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove all of the fat, just as he does when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. The priest will then send the fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. This animal is sacrificed so that I will forgive you ordinary people when you sin.
translation_verse: ni edšie efo̱ le̱ fẽ, tamo̱ bo̱ni adšieo̱ *šidā-afo̱le le̱ no le̱, ni oso̱fo le̱ ašã ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱, ní edše ṅma ewo Iehowa; ni oso̱fo le̱ akpãtã ahãle̱, ni aṅõ-fale̱. *

english_verse: If you offer a lamb instead of a goat as a sacrifice for sin, it must be a female that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši eke̱ tōgwanteṅ mība abašã eša-afo̱le le̱, eṅõ yō ní kpa ko be̱ ehe ke̱-ba,

english_verse: Lead the lamb to the altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: ni eṅõ enine efõ eša-afo̱le le̱ yiteṅ, ni egbele̱ ní eke̱-fe eša-afo̱le ye̱ heni agbeo̱ šā̃-afo̱lei le̱ ye̱ le̱.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo le̱ ke̱ ewao atšo̱ eša-afo̱le lá le̱ eko, ni ediki afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ kodši le̱, ni etši lá ní eſe̱ le̱ fẽ eſie afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ šiši.

english_verse: After this, all of the fat must be removed, just as when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. Then the priest will send it up in smoke to me, together with a food offering, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ni edšie efo̱ le̱ fẽ, tamo̱ bo̱ni adšieo̱ šidā-afo̱le tōgwanteṅ le̱ fo̱ le̱, ni oso̱fo le̱ ašã ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ ye̱ Iehowa lai le̱ ano̱; ni oso̱fo le̱ akpãtã ahãle̱ ye̱ eša ní efe le̱ hewo̱, ni aṅõ-fale̱.

english_verse: You are guilty if you find out that you have accidentally touched anything unclean that comes from a human body.
translation_verse: alo ke̱dši eta gbomo ní he tšee ye̱ bulemo̱-fẽ-bulemo̱ ní gbomo ṅõ-buleo̱ ehe le̱ he, ni elee, ni fe se̱ ni ebale le̱, eye sõ;

english_verse: As soon as you discover that you have committed any of these sins, you must confess what you have done.
translation_verse: ni agbene, ké̱ ne̱ke̱ nii ne̱ eko he sõ bakã eno̱ le̱, no le̱ edšadše eša ní efe ní eṅõ-tõ le̱,

english_verse: splatter some of its blood on one side of the bronze altar, and drain out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: ni eṅõ eša-afo̱le le̱ lá le̱ eko eſã afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ hewo̱, ni lá ní ſe̱ le̱ atšere aſie afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ šiši; eša-afo̱le dši no.

english_verse: If you are so poor that you cannot afford doves or pigeons, you may bring one kilogram of your finest flour. This is a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness, so don't sprinkle olive oil or sweet-smelling incense on it.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši ebe̱ kose̱-okpoi enyo̱ lo okpobii enyo̱ le̱ hũ yinii le̱, noni eke̱-bahã ye̱ eša ní efe le̱ hewo̱ ne̱: mā efa mlidšāi nyoṅma mli ekome ní ake̱-fe eša-afo̱le; *ekaṅõ mū ewo mli, ni ekaṅõ kro̱bo̱o efõ no̱, edšake̱ eša-afo̱le ni. *

english_verse: Give the flour to a priest, who will scoop up a handful and send it up in smoke together with the other offerings. This is a reminder that all of the flour belongs to me.
translation_verse: Ni eke̱-ba oso̱fo le̱ ṅo; ni oso̱fo le̱ atĩ eko̱ko̱ obõ eke̱-fe ekaimo̱no le̱, ni ešã ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ ye̱ Iehowa lai le̱ ano̱; eša-afo̱le ni.

english_verse: By offering this sacrifice, the priest pays the price for any of these sins you may have committed. The priest gets to keep the rest of the flour, just as he does with grain sacrifices. Sacrifices To Make Things Right (Leviticus
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo le̱ akpãtã ahãle̱ ye̱ eša ní efe ye̱ ene̱mei eko gbe̱fãṅ le̱ hewo̱, ni aaṅõ-fale̱. Ni [noni eſe̱ le̱] atšṍ oso̱fo le̱ nõ *tamo̱ niyenii-afo̱le le̱. *

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do to make things right when they find out they have cheated the Lord without meaning to: If this happens, you must either sacrifice a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay the price of a ram with the official money used by the priests.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši moko tõ tomo̱ ko, ni elee be ní efe eša ko ye̱ Iehowa nii kroṅkroṅi le̱ agbe̱fãṅ le̱, no le̱ esõ-afo̱le ní eke̱-babã Iehowa ne̱: tōi le̱ ateṅ tōagbo ní he be̱ kpa ko, bo̱ni oobu nā ohã ye̱ dſie̱te̱i šekel mli ye̱ hekroṅkroṅ šekel le̱ nā, ni ake̱-fe sõ-afo̱le.

english_verse: The next morning you will dress in your priestly clothes, including your linen underwear. Then clean away the ashes left by the sacrifices and pile them beside the altar.
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo le̱ awo eklala flaka, ni ewo eklala tſakotoi le̱ *eke̱-ke ehe, ni elō lamlu le̱ ní la le̱ ní šã šā̃-afo̱le le̱ ešĩ ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ le̱, ni eke̱-ſie afo̱le-šãlate̱ le̱ mase̱i. *

english_verse: and told him what sacrifices the priests must offer on the morning and evening of the day they are ordained: It is the same as the regular morning and evening sacrifices—half a kilogram of flour
translation_verse: Nikēnii ní Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ ke̱-bahã Iehowa ye̱ ame̱mũfō̱ gbĩ le̱ ne̱ ne̱: ṅmā̃ mã efa mlidšāi nyoṅma mli ekome ake̱ dā niyenii-afo̱le, ake̱ fã aba lebi, ni ake̱ fã hũ aba gbe̱ke̱.

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy, and only the priests may have any part of it.
translation_verse: Oso̱foi le̱ ateṅ nū-fẽ-nū aye eko; nõkroṅkroṅ ní fè fè ni.

english_verse: If the meat was cooked in a clay pot, the pot must be destroyed, but if it was cooked in a bronze pot, the pot must be scrubbed and rinsed with water.
translation_verse: Ni sũ-gbé̱ ní aho eko ye̱ mli le̱ adſra; ši ké̱ akō̱ble gbé̱ mli aho ye̱ le̱, asa he, ni ake̱ nu adšale mli.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to tell Aaron and his sons how to offer the daily sacrifices that are sent up in smoke to please the Lord: You must put the animal for the sacrifice on the altar in the evening and let it stay there all night. But make sure the fire keeps burning.
translation_verse: Wo Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ akitã okē̱: Ene̱ dši šā̃-afo̱le he mla: Šā̃-afo̱le le̱ ahĩ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ nyōṅnyōṅ fẽ ní la ahĩ šiši ke̱-yaši lebi, ni afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ la le̱ ke̱-atšo. Yi.

english_verse: Change into your everyday clothes, take the ashes outside the camp, and pile them in the special place.
translation_verse: Ni edšie etadei le̱, ni ewo atadei krokomei, ni eke̱ lamlu le̱ adše kpo *ke̱-ya nsra le̱ se̱ eyaſie heko ní tše. *

english_verse: The fire must never go out, so put wood on it each morning. After this, you are to lay an animal on the altar next to the fat that you sacrifice to ask my blessing. Then send it all up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: Ni la le̱, ní yo̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ le̱, atšo ye̱ no̱, ekagbo gbĩkogbĩko; ni oso̱fo le̱ ašã lai ye̱ no̱ dā lebi, ni esā šā̃-afo̱le ye̱ no̱ eto gbe̱dšiano̱, ni ešã šidā-afo̱lei ahe fo̱i le̱ ye̱ no̱.

english_verse: When someone offers a sacrifice to give thanks to me, the priests from Aaron's family must bring it to the front of the bronze altar,
translation_verse: Ni ene̱ dši niyenii-afo̱le he mla: Aaron bihĩĩ le̱ ke̱-ba Iehowa hĩe ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ hĩe. Yi.

english_verse: where one of them will scoop up a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the incense on it. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, he will lay all of this on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ni eṅõ mã le̱ ke̱ mū le̱, ke̱ kro̱bo̱o fẽ ní yo̱ niyenii-afo̱le le̱ no̱ le̱, eko̱ko̱ obõ, ni ešã ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱, ní edše ṅma, ni efe kaimo̱nõ ehã Iehowa.

english_verse: Only the men in Aaron's family are allowed to eat this bread, and they must go through a ceremony to be made holy before touching it. This law will never change. When Priests Are Ordained
translation_verse: Aaron bii le̱ ateṅ nū-fẽ-nū aye; Iehowa lai le̱ ahe akpo̱ dši ene̱ hã nyeyino̱i le̱: mofẽmo ní taä he le̱ afe kroṅkroṅ.

english_verse: The Lord spoke to Moses
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose wie ni ekē̱:

english_verse: mixed with olive oil and cooked in a shallow pan. The bread must then be crumbled into small pieces and sent up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ake̱ mũ ašĩ ye̱ ṅe̱sũ mli, ni ke̱ ebè le̱, oke̱-ba, ni okũmo̱le̱ kukudši kukudši ní ašãle̱ ake̱ niyenii-afo̱le, ní edše ṅma ewo Iehowa.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose wie ni ekē̱:

english_verse: how the priests from Aaron's family were to offer the sacrifice for sin: This sacrifice is very sacred, and the animal must be killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Oke̱ Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ awie ake̱: Ene̱ dši eša-afo̱le he mla: Heni agbeo̱ šā̃-afe̱le le̱ ye̱ le̱, dše̱i noṅṅ agbe eša-afo̱le le̱ hũ ye̱, ye̱ Iehowa hĩe; nõkroṅkroṅ ní fè fẽ ni. Yi.

english_verse: The priest who offers this sacrifice must eat it in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Oso̱fo le̱ ní šãa eša-afo̱le le̱ aye; hekroṅkroṅ le̱ aye ye̱, ye̱ kpē-bū le̱ kpo le̱ no̱.

english_verse: and anyone or anything that touches the meat will be holy. If any of the animal's blood is splattered on the clothes of the priest, they must be washed in a holy place.
translation_verse: Mofẽmo ní taä elõ le̱ he le̱ afe kroṅkroṅ; ni ké̱ elá le̱ eko tšeṅe ſie atade he le̱, ofo̱ noni etšeṅe eſie no̱ le̱ he ye̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱.

english_verse: None of the meat may be eaten from the sacrifices for sin that require blood to be brought into the sacred tent. These sacrifices must be completely burned.
translation_verse: Ši eša-afo̱le-fẽ-eša-afo̱le ní aaṅõ elá le̱ eko ke̱-ba kpē-bū le̱ mli ní ake̱-ba-kpãtã ye̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱, akaye eko; ake̱ la ašã.

english_verse: Give me one loaf or wafer from each of these four kinds of bread, after which they will belong to the priest who splattered the blood against the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ni nii ní eke̱-ba le̱, edšie fẽ mli ekomekome ehã, ní ake̱-fe no̱wómo̱-afo̱le abã Iehowa; oso̱fo le̱ ni nõo̱ šidā-afo̱le le̱ lá le̱ eſãa le̱ nõ atšṍ.

english_verse: Don't eat any of the meat that has touched something unclean. Instead, burn it. The rest of the meat may be eaten by anyone who is clean and acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Ni lō ní noko ní he tšee aasa he le̱ akaye, ake̱ la ašã. Ši lō le̱, mofẽmo ní he tše le̱ aye eko.

english_verse: In fact, the priest who offers a sacrifice to please me may keep the skin of the animal,
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo ní sãa šā̃-afo̱le hãa moko le̱, šā̃-afo̱le ní ešã le̱ *wolo le̱ atšṍ enõ. *

english_verse: All other grain sacrifices—with or without olive oil in them—are to be divided equally among the priests of Aaron's family. Sacrifices To Ask the Lord's Blessing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ni niyenii-afo̱le fẽ ní awo mli mũ alo afele̱ egbĩṅ le̱ atšṍ Aaron bihĩĩ le̱ fẽ no, mofẽmo aná bo̱ni enyemi náa le̱ pe̱.

english_verse: Here are the instructions for offering a sacrifice to ask my blessing:
translation_verse: Ni *šidā-aſo̱le ní ake̱-bahã Iehowa le̱ he mla ne̱: *Yi.

english_verse: If you offer it to give thanks, you must offer some bread together with it. Use the finest flour to make three kinds of bread without yeast—two in the form of loaves mixed with olive oil and one in the form of thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: Kē̱ ake̱ *šidā-afo̱le mība le̱, ake̱ šidā-afo̱le noṅṅ akpĩtĩ kāoi ní awo mli mũ ke̱ akpĩtĩ kakai ní ake̱ mũ ekpa he ke̱ mã akpĩtĩ kāoi ní ašã ní awo mli mũ aba. *

english_verse: You must also make some bread with yeast.
translation_verse: Abolo akpĩtĩ kāoi afata ešidā-afo̱le ní eke̱-daä ši le̱ he.

english_verse: When you offer an animal to ask a blessing from me or to thank me, the meat belongs to you, but it must be eaten the same day.
translation_verse: Ni ešidā-afo̱le ní ake̱-daä ši le̱ *lō le̱ aye ye̱ gbĩ ní ake̱-ba le̱ ṅo̱ noṅṅ; akaſe̱ eko ato lebi. *

english_verse: It is different with the sacrifices you offer when you make me a promise or voluntarily give me something. The meat from those sacrifices may be kept and eaten the next day,
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši efo̱le ní eke̱-ba le̱ dši šiwō alo tšuidšũrõnā-afo̱le le̱, aye gbĩ no̱ ní ake̱-ba le̱ noṅṅ; ni ké̱ dše tše̱re eko no̱ hũ, aye kẽ;

english_verse: but any that is left over must be destroyed. If you eat any of it after the second day, your sacrifice will be useless and unacceptable, and you will be both disgusting and guilty.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ moko ye ešidā-afo̱le lō le̱ eko ye̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ etẽ le̱ no̱ kẽ le̱, anáṅ moni ke̱-bahã le̱ he tšui, abuṅ ahãṅ-le̱ hũ; nihĩnii ni, ni moni ye̱ eko le̱, elō musu.

english_verse: to say to the people: Don't eat the fat of cattle, sheep, or goats.
translation_verse: Oke̱ Israelbii le̱ awie ake̱: Nyekayea *fo̱ ko fo̱ ko, tšina nõ dšio, tōgwanteṅ nõ dšio, tōabotia nõ dšio. *

english_verse: If you eat the fat of an animal that can be used as a sacrifice to me, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mofẽmo ní aaye šĩa koloi ní ake̱ šãa afo̱le ahãa Iehowa le̱ eko fo̱ le̱, aafo nakai susuma ní yeo̱ le̱ ke̱-adše̱ emã le̱ṅ aše̱ afõ.

english_verse: And no matter where you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal,
translation_verse: Ni nyekayea *lá ko lá ko ye̱ nyešihĩle̱hei le̱ fẽ, loflõ nõ dšio, kolo nõ dsio. *

english_verse: or you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Mofẽmo ní yeo̱ lá ko le̱, aafo nakai susuma le̱ ke̱-adše̱ emã le̱ṅ aše̱ afõ.

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose wie ni ekē̱:

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If you want to offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, you must bring the part to be burned and lay it on the bronze altar. But you must first lift up the choice ribs with their fat to show that the offering is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Eke̱ le̱dientše̱ enidši ahĩe Iehowa afo̱lei ní ake̱ la šãa le̱ ke̱-ba: fo̱ ní yo̱ tšitši le̱ no̱ le̱ eke̱-ba, ke̱ tšitši le̱ fẽ, koni aṅo-fe *fō̃-afo̱le ye̱ Iehowa hĩe. *

english_verse: A priest from Aaron's family will then send the fat up in smoke, but the ribs belong to the priests.
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo le̱ ašã fo̱ le̱ ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱; ni tšitši le̱ atšṍ Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ anõ.

english_verse: The upper joint of the right hind leg is for the priest who offers the blood and the fat of the animal.
translation_verse: Aaron bihĩĩ le̱ ateṅ moni ke̱ šidā-afo̱lei alá le̱ ke̱ fo̱ le̱ aaba le̱, le̱ noṅṅ enõ ninedšŭrõ le̱ atšṍ ake̱ egbe̱fãṅnõ

english_verse: I have decided that the people of Israel must always give the choice ribs and the upper joint of the right hind leg to Aaron's descendants
translation_verse: Edšake̱ fō̃-tšitši le̱ ke̱ no̱wómo̱-kõṅ le̱ miṅõ ye̱ Israelbii le̱ adeṅ ye̱ ame̱šidā-afo̱lei le̱ amli, ni mike̱-hã oso̱fo Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱, ní efe egbe̱nā ni kã ši hãame̱ dā.

english_verse: While Moses and the people of Israel were in the desert at Mount Sinai, the Lord commanded them to start offering these sacrifices.
translation_verse: noni Iehowa wo Mose kitã ye̱ he ye̱ Sinai goṅ le̱ no̱, ye̱ gbĩ no̱ ní ewo Israelbii le̱ akitã, ake̱ ame̱ke̱ ame̱fo̱lei le̱ abahã Iehowa le̱, ye̱ Sinai ṅã le̱ no̱ le̱.

english_verse: Moses lifted up the choice ribs of the ram to show that they were dedicated to the Lord. This was the part that the Lord had said Moses could have.
translation_verse: Ni Mose ṅõ oso̱fowō-afo̱le tōagbo le̱ tšitši le̱, ni efõ ake̱ fō̃-afo̱le ye̱ Iehowa hĩe; etšṍ Mose gbe̱fãṅnõ, tamo̱ boni Iehowa wo Mose kitã le̱.

english_verse: Then bring the whole community of Israel together at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: ni hã ní asafo mũ le̱ fẽ abo̱ gwa ye̱ kpē-bū le̱ šĩnā le̱ nā.

english_verse: he said, “We are here to follow the Lord's instructions.”
translation_verse: Ni Mose kē̱ asafo le̱ ake̱: Noni Iehowa wo he kitã ake̱ afe le̱ ne̱.

english_verse: After Moses told Aaron and his sons to step forward, he told them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Ni Mose hã Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ ba, ni eke̱ nu dšu ame̱he;

english_verse: Next, he put on Aaron the sacred breastpiece that was used in finding out what the Lord wanted his people to do.
translation_verse: ni eṅõ tšitšino̱nii le̱ eto no̱, ni eṅõ *urim ke̱ tumim le̱ ewo tšitšinonii le̱ amli; *

english_verse: He placed the turban on Aaron's head, and on the front of the turban was the narrow strip of thin gold as a sign of his dedication to the Lord.
translation_verse: ni eṅõ fai le̱ ebu eyitšo, ni eṅõ *šika-fe̱te̱fe̱te̱ ní dši hĩenãnii kroṅkroṅ le̱ eta fai le̱ hĩenā, bo̱ni Iehowa wo Mose kitã le̱. *

english_verse: He sprinkled the bronze altar seven times, and he sprinkled its equipment, as well as the large bronze bowl and its base.
translation_verse: ni eṅõ eko eſã afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ šii kpawo, ni efo̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ ke̱ ehe nii le̱ fẽ ke̱ lalakã le̱ ke̱ ekăla le̱ mũ, koni efe he kroṅkroṅ.

english_verse: He also poured some of the oil on Aaron's head to dedicate him to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni efo̱se mũfō̱-mũ le̱ eko eſie Aaron yiteṅ, ni efo̱le̱ mũ, koni efele̱ kroṅkroṅ.

english_verse: Moses led out the bull that was to be sacrificed for sin, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Ni ehã ake̱ eša-afo̱le tšinanū le̱ ba, ni Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ ṅõ ame̱nidši ame̱ſie eša-afo̱le tšinanū le̱ yiteṅ. Yi.

english_verse: After it was killed, Moses dipped a finger in the blood and smeared some of it on each of the four corners of the bronze altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the altar. This purified the altar and made it a fit place for offering the sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Ni egbele̱, ni Mose ke̱ ewao tšo̱ elá le̱ eko ediki afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ kodši le̱ ke̱-kpe, ni edšie afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ he eša, ni efo̱se lá le̱ eſã afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ šiši, ni efe he kroṅkroṅ, koni ekpãtã ehãle̱.

english_verse: Moses then took the fat on the bull's insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and sent them up in smoke on the altar fire.
translation_verse: Ni eṅõ fe̱ le̱ fẽ ní ye̱ mlinii le̱ ahe le̱, ke̱ noni tšotšŏro mle̱bo le̱ he le̱, ke̱ sabai enyo̱ le̱ ke̱ amehe fo̱ le̱, ni Mose šã ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Finally, he took the skin and the flesh of the bull, together with the food still in its stomach, and burned them outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ši tšinanū le̱ dientše̱ ke̱ ewolo le̱ ke̱ elō le̱ ke̱ efei le̱ eke̱ la yašã ye̱ nsra le̱ se̱, tamo̱ bo̱ni Iehowa wo Mose kitã le̱.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the sacrifice to please the Lord. After Aaron and his sons had laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Ni eke̱ *šā̃-afo̱le tōagbo le̱ ba, ni Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ ṅo ame̱nidši ame̱ſie tōagbo le̱ yiteṅ; *

english_verse: Moses killed the ram and splattered its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: ni egbele̱, ni Mose fo̱se lá le̱ eſã afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ šiši ke̱-kpe,

english_verse: Moses had the animal cut up, and he washed its insides and hind legs. Then he laid the head, the fat, and the rest of the ram on the altar and sent them up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. All this was done just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: ni emlinii le̱ ke̱ enãdši le̱, eke̱ nu fo̱ nomei ahe, ni Mose šã tōagbo mū le̱ fẽ ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱; šā̃-afo̱le ní dšeo̱ ṅma dši no, afo̱le ní ake̱ la šãa ahãa Iehowa ni, tamo̱ bo̱ni Iehowa wo Mose kitã le̱.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the ceremony of ordination. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Ni eke̱ tōagbo ni dši enyo̱ ní dši *oso̱fowō-afo̱le tōagbo le̱ ba; ni Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ ṅõ ame̱nidši ame̱ſie tōagbo le̱ yiteṅ; *

english_verse: and it was killed. Moses smeared some of its blood on Aaron's right earlobe, some on his right thumb, and some on the big toe of his right foot.
translation_verse: ni egbele̱, ni Mose ṅõ elá le̱ eko esa Aaron ninedšŭrõ toi nā, ke̱ eninedšŭrõ goṅtĩ nā, ke̱ enanedšŭrõ goṅtĩ nā.

english_verse: Moses did the same thing for Aaron's sons, before splattering the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ni ehã Aaron bihĩĩ le̱ hũ ba; ni Mose ṅõ lá le̱ eko esa ame̱ninedšŭrõ toi nā, ke̱ ame̱ninedšŭrõ goṅtĩ nā ke̱ ame̱nanedšŭrõ goṅtĩ nā; ni Mose fo̱se lá le̱ eſã afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ ke̱-kpe.

english_verse: He took the animal's fat tail, the fat on its insides, and the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and the right hind leg.
translation_verse: Ni eṅõ fo̱ le̱ ke̱ lei le̱ ke̱ fo̱ fẽ ní yo̱ mlinii le̱ ahe le̱ ke̱ noni tšotšŏro mle̱bo le̱ he le̱ ke̱ sabai enyo̱ le̱ ke̱ ame̱he fo̱ le̱ ke̱ ninedšŭrõ le̱,

english_verse: Then he took from a basket some of each of the three kinds of bread that had been made without yeast and had been dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: ni eko̱ akpĩtĩ kāo kome ke̱ mũ abolo subo̱o kome ke̱ kaka kome ye̱ akpĩtĩ kafũ ní mã Iehowa hĩe le̱ mli, ni eke̱ſie fo̱i le̱ ke̱ nine dšŭro le̱ no̱,

english_verse: Moses placed the bread on top of the meat and gave it all to Aaron and his sons, who lifted it up to show that it was dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: ni eṅõ fẽ ewo Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ adeṅ, ni efõame̱ ake̱ fō̃-afo̱le ye̱ Iehowa hĩe.

english_verse: After this, Moses placed it on the fires of the altar and sent it up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. This was part of the ordination ceremony.
translation_verse: Ni Mose sā hé ye̱ ame̱deṅ, ni ešã ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ ye̱ šā̃-afo̱le le̱ no̱; oso̱fowō-afo̱le ní dšeo̱ ṅma ni, afo̱le ní ake̱ la šãa ahãa Iehowa ni.

english_verse: Finally, Moses sprinkled the priestly clothes of Aaron and his sons with some of the oil for ordination and with some of the blood from the altar. So Aaron and his sons, together with their priestly clothes, were dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni Mose ṅõ mũō̱-mũ le̱ eko ke̱ lá ní yo̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ le̱ eko, ni eṅõ-ſã Aaron ke̱ etadei le̱ ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ ke̱ ebihĩĩ atadei le̱ fẽ ano̱, ni eṅõ-fe Aaron ke̱ etadei le̱ ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ ke̱ ametadei le̱ fẽ he kroṅkroṅ.

english_verse: Moses said to Aaron and his sons: The Lord told me that you must boil this meat at the entrance to the sacred tent and eat it there with the bread.
translation_verse: Ni Mose kē̱ Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ ake̱: Nyehoa lō le̱ ye̱ kpē-bū šĩnā le̱ nā, ni dše̱i noṅṅ nyeyea ye̱, ke̱ abolo ní yo̱ oso̱fowō-afo̱le kafũ le̱ mli le̱, tamo̱ bo̱ni miwo kitã ake̱: Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ aye le̱!

english_verse: and stay near the entrance to the sacred tent until the ordination ceremony ends seven days from now.
translation_verse: Ni nyekadšea kpē-bū le̱ šĩnā le̱ mli gbĩĩ kpawo ke̱-yaši gbĩ no̱ ní aagbe nyeoso̱fowō gbĩĩ le̱ anā; edšake̱ gbĩĩ kpawo dši nyeoso̱fowō gbĩĩ le̱,

english_verse: We have obeyed the Lord in everything that has been done today, so that your sins may be forgiven.
translation_verse: bo̱ni afe ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱, nakai Iehowa wo kitã ake̱ aafe, koni akpãtã ahãnye.

english_verse: The Lord has told me that you must stay near the entrance to the tent for seven days and nights, or else you will die.
translation_verse: Ni nyehĩa kpē-bū le̱ šĩnā le̱ nā gbĩĩ kpawo nyōṅnyōṅ ke̱ ſaneſane, ni nyefea Iehowa gbe̱nānii, koni nyekagboi; edšake̱ nakai awomi kitã.

english_verse: Aaron and his sons obeyed everything that the Lord had told Moses they must do.
translation_verse: Ni Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ fe nibii fẽ ni Iehowa wo Mose he kitã le̱.

english_verse: His sons brought him the blood. He dipped a finger in it, smeared some on the four corners of the bronze altar, and poured out the rest at its foot.
translation_verse: Ni ebihĩĩ le̱ ṅõ lá le̱ bahãle̱, ni eke̱ ewao tšo lá le̱ mli, ni eṅõ-diki afo̱le-šãlate̱ le̱ kodši le̱, ni lá ní eſe̱ le̱ etši eſie afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ šiši.

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the skin and the flesh outside the camp.
translation_verse: Ni lō le̱ ke̱ wolo le̱ eke̱ la šã ye̱ nsra le̱ se̱.

english_verse: After Aaron had killed the ram that was sacrificed to please the Lord, Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ni egbe šā̃-afo̱le le̱ hũ; ni Aaron bihĩĩ le̱ ke̱ lá le̱ bahãle̱, ni eṅõ-ſã afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ ke̱-kpe.

english_verse: They brought him each piece of the animal, including the head, and he burned them all on the altar.
translation_verse: Ni šā̃-afo̱le le̱ hũ ame̱ke̱-bahãle̱, lō ní asa le̱ ke̱ yitšo le̱ fẽ, ni ešã ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: He washed the insides and the hind legs and also sent them up in smoke.
translation_verse: Ni efo̱ mlinii le̱ ke̱ nãdši le̱ ahe, ni ešã ye̱ šā̃-afo̱le ní yo̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ ne̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Next, Aaron sacrificed the goat for the sins of the people, as he had done with the sacrifice for his own sins.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni eṅõ maṅ le̱ afole le̱ ke̱-ba: ni eṅõ eša-afo̱le tōkpakpo le̱ ní dši maṅ le̱ no le̱, ni egbele̱, ni eṅõ-fe eša-afo̱le tamo̱ tšutšunõ le̱.

english_verse: And so, he burned this sacrifice on the altar in the proper way.
translation_verse: Ni eke̱ šā̃-afo̱le le̱ ba, ni efele̱ ye̱ egbe̱nā le̱ nā.

english_verse: He also presented the grain sacrifice and burned a handful of the flour on the altar as part of the morning sacrifice.
translation_verse: Ni eke̱ niyenii-afo̱le le̱ ba, ni eṅõ emli eko̱ko̱ obõ, ni ešã ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ ye̱ lebi šā̃-afo̱le le̱ se̱.

english_verse: Finally, he killed the bull and the ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing on the people. Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni egbe tšinanū ke̱ tōagbo le̱ ni dši maṅ le̱ šidā-afo̱lei le̱, ni Aaron bihĩĩ le̱ ṅõ lá le̱ ame̱bahãle̱, ni eṅõ-ſã afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ ke̱-kpe.

english_verse: His sons placed all the fat, as well as the kidneys and the lower part of the liver
translation_verse: Ni tšinanū le̱ ke̱ tōagbo le̱ fo̱i le̱, lei le̱ ke̱ fo̱ ní ha mlinii le̱ ahe le̱ ke̱ sabai le̱ ke̱ noni tšotšŏro mle̱bo le̱ he le̱,

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the fat on the altar and lifted up the ribs and the right hind leg to show that these were dedicated to the Lord. This was done just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
translation_verse: Ni tšitšii le̱ ke̱ ninedšŭrõ le̱, Aaron fõ eṅõ-fe fō̃-afo̱le ye̱ Iehowa hĩe, tamo̱ bo̱ni Mose wo kitã le̱.

english_verse: He and Moses went into the sacred tent, and when they came out, they gave the people their blessing. Then the Lord appeared to the people in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Ni Mose ke̱ Aaron bote kpē-bū le̱ mli; ni beni ame̱dše kpo ekoṅ le̱, ame̱dšē̱ maṅ le̱. Ke̱ke̱ ni Iehowa anumnyam le̱ dšie ehe kpo etšõ maṅ mū le̱ fẽ;

english_verse: The Lord sent fiery flames that burned up everything on the altar, and when everyone saw this, they shouted and fell to their knees to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: ni *la dše̱ Iehowa hĩe ni ešã afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ šā̃-afo̱le le̱ ke̱ fo̱i le̱. Ni maṅ mū le̱ fẽ na, ni ame̱blo̱ ke̱ mīše̱, ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱hĩeaṅ bumo̱ ši. *

english_verse: Moses sent for Mishael and Elzaphan, the two sons of Aaron's uncle Uzziel. Then he told them, “Take these two dead relatives of yours outside the camp far from the entrance to the sacred tent.”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Mose tšé̱ *Mišael ke̱ El-zafan, Aaron tše̱kwẽ Uziel bii le̱ ke̱-ba, ni ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyetšia nyebaä, ni †nyebaholea nyenyemimei le̱ ke̱-dše̱a hekroṅkroṅ le̱ hĩe ke̱-yaä nsra le̱ se̱. *

english_verse: So they dragged the dead men away by their clothes.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱tši ameba ni ame̱baholeame̱ ke̱ ame̱flakai le̱ ke̱-dše nsra le̱ṅ, tamo̱ bo̱ni Mose kē̱ le̱.

english_verse: The Lord said to Aaron:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Aaron wie ni ekē̱:

english_verse: When you or your sons enter the sacred tent, you must never drink beer or wine. If you do, you will die right there! This law will never change.
translation_verse: Nyekanua wein alo dā̃ ní wa ko, bo ke̱ obihĩĩ le̱ fẽ, be mli ní nyeya kpē-bū le̱ṅ le̱, koni nyekagboi! Nāno̱ akpo̱ dši no hã nyeyino̱i le̱ fẽ, Ezek.

english_verse: You must learn the difference between what is holy and what isn't holy and between the clean and the unclean.
translation_verse: koni nyele sro̱to ní yo̱ nõkroṅkroṅ ke̱ buleme̱nõ teṅ, ke̱ nii ní he tšee ke̱ nii ní he tše le̱ ateṅ,

english_verse: You must also teach the people of Israel everything that I commanded Moses to say to them.
translation_verse: ní nyetšõ Israelbii le̱ akpoi le̱ fẽ ní Iehowa tšṍ Mose nine no̱ wie etšõame̱ le̱.

english_verse: Moses told Aaron and his two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: The grain sacrifice that was offered to give thanks to the Lord is very holy. So make bread without yeast from the part that wasn't sent up in smoke and eat it beside the altar.
translation_verse: Ni Mose ke̱ Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ ní eſe̱ ní dši Eleazar ke̱ Itamar le̱ wie ake̱: Nyeṅõa Iehowa afo̱lei ní ake̱ la šãa le̱ amli niyenii-afo̱lei ní eſe̱ le̱, ni nyeyeale̱ akpĩtĩ ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ mase̱i, edšake̱ nõkroṅkroṅ ní fè fẽ ni.

english_verse: The Lord has said that this belongs to you and your sons, and that it must be eaten in a holy place.
translation_verse: Ni nyeyea ye̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱, edšake̱ *ogbe̱nā ke̱ obihìï le̱ agbe̱nā dši no ke̱-dše̱ afo̱lei ní ake̱ la šãa ahãa Iehowa le̱ amli; edšake̱ nakai awomi kitã. *

english_verse: But the choice ribs and the hind leg that were lifted up may be eaten by your entire family, as long as you do so in an acceptable place. These parts are yours from the sacrifices that the people offer to ask the Lord's blessing. This is what the Lord has commanded, and it will never change.
translation_verse: No̱wómo̱-koṅ le̱ ke̱ fō̃-tšitši le̱ afata fo̱i-afo̱lei le̱ ahe ke̱-ba, koni afõ aṅõ-fe fō̃-afo̱le ye̱ Iehowa hĩe; ni etšṍ onõ ke̱ obihĩĩ le̱ anõ ake̱ gbe̱nā ní kã ši dā, bo̱ni Iehowa wo kitã le̱.

english_verse: When Moses asked around and learned that the ram for the sin sacrifice had already been burned on the altar, he became angry with Eleazar and Ithamar and said,
translation_verse: Ni eša-afo̱le tōkpakpo le̱, Mose taole̱ āhũ, ni na, ašãle̱. Ni emli wo Eleazar ke̱ Itamar, Aaron bihĩĩ ní eſe̱ le̱, la ni ekē̱:

english_verse: “Why didn't you eat the meat from this sacrifice in an acceptable place? It is very holy, and the Lord has given you this sacrifice to remove Israel's sin and guilt.
translation_verse: Mẽba nyeyee eša-afo̱le le̱ ye̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱? edšake̱ nõkroṅkroṅ ní fè fẽ ni; ni ene̱ eṅõ-hãnye, koni nyetĕre asafo le̱ no̱tõmo̱ le̱, ni nyekpãtã nyehãame̱ ye̱ Iehowa hĩe.

english_verse: Whenever an animal's blood isn't brought into the sacred tent, I commanded you to eat its meat in an acceptable place, but you burned it instead.”
translation_verse: Na, ake̱ elà le̱ baa hekroṅkroṅ tšũ le̱ṅ; sa ake̱ nyeye ye̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱, take̱ bo̱ni miwo kitã le̱.

english_verse: Their father Aaron replied, “Today two of my sons offered the sacrifice for sin and the sacrifice to please the Lord, and look what has happened to me! Would the Lord have approved if I had eaten the sacrifice for sin?”
translation_verse: Ni Aaron wie etšõ Mose ake̱: Na, ṅme̱ne̱ ame̱ke̱ ame̱he eša-afo̱le ke̱ ame̱šā̃-afo̱le eba Iehowa hĩe, ni ne̱ke̱ nibii ne̱ ebafemi ne̱; ni miye eša-afo̱le ṅme̱ne̱ dšikũle̱, ani ehĩ ye̱ Iehowa hĩe lo?

english_verse: Moses was satisfied with Aaron's reply.
translation_verse: Ni Mose nu, ni ehĩ ye̱ ehĩe.

english_verse: The only winged insects you may eat are locusts, grasshoppers, and crickets. All other winged insects that crawl are too disgusting for you to eat.
translation_verse: Ši flikilo̱i fẽ ní eſe̱ ní wamoo̱ ní yo̱ nãdši edſe̱dſe̱ le̱ dši nihĩnii hãnye.

english_verse: Moles, rats, mice, and all kinds of lizards are unclean.
translation_verse: ke̱ mampam ke̱ odiṅmo̱lo̱ ke̱ tšũnye ke̱ kõdõ ke̱ obosumaketeo.

english_verse: If something made of wood, cloth, or leather touches one of their dead bodies, it must be washed, but it is still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ni nofẽno ní ame̱teṅ eko ní egbo aagbe no̱ le̱, ehe tšee, tšonii dšio, atadei dšio, wolo lo kpekpe alo nofẽno ní ake̱tšuo̱ nii dšio; aṅõ-ſie nu mli, ni ehe tšee ke̱-yaši gbe̱ke̱; no fẽdã ni ehe aatše.

english_verse: If any of these animals is found dead in a clay pot, the pot must be broken to pieces, and everything in it becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Ni sũnõ-ſẽ-šũno ní ame̱teṅ eko aagbe mli le̱: nofẽno ní yo̱ mli le̱, ehe tšee, ni nõ le̱ hũ nyedſaä.

english_verse: If you pour water from this pot on any food, that food becomes unclean, and anything drinkable in the pot becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Niyenii fẽ ní ayeo̱ ní ake̱ ne̱ke̱ nu ne̱ eko aawo mli le̱, ehe tšee, ni nofẽno ní anuo̱ ní yo̱ ne̱ke̱ noko mli le̱, ehe tšee.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals touches anything else, including ovens and stoves, that thing becomes unclean and must be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ni nofẽno ní ame̱gbohĩĩ le̱ eko aagbe no̱ le̱, ehe tšee, flõnõ dsio, late̱ dšio, adſra; ehe tšee, ni ehe tšee hããnye.

english_verse: A spring or a cistern where one of these dead animals is found is still clean, but anyone who touches the animal becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Ši kẽle̱ nubui-ahĩṅme̱ii ke̱ nubui ke̱ kpākpoi le̱, nomei ahe tše. Ši moni taä ame̱gbohĩĩ le̱ ahe le̱, ehe tšee.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals is found lying on seeds that have been set aside for planting, the seeds remain clean.
translation_verse: Ni kē̱ ame̱gbohĩĩ le̱ eko gbe dũmo̱nii ní adũo̱ le̱ ano̱ le̱, ehe tše kẽ.

english_verse: But seeds that are soaking in water become unclean, if the dead animal is found in the water.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ ake̱ nu awo dũmo̱nii le̱ ahe, ni ame̱gbohĩĩ le̱ eko gbe ṅo̱ le̱, ehe tšee hããnye.

english_verse: If an animal that may be eaten happens to die, and you touch it, you become unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ni ké̱ koloi ní ayeo̱ le̱ eko gbo le̱, moni taä egbonyo le̱ he le, ehe tšee ke̱-yaši gbe̱ke̱.

english_verse: If you eat any of its meat or carry its body away, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ni moni *yeo̱ egbonyo le̱ eko le̱, efo̱ etadei le̱ ahe, ni ehe tšee ke̱-yaši gbe̱ke̱. Ni moni wóo̱ egbonyo le̱; efo̱ etadei le̱ ahe, ni ehe tšee ke̱-yaši gbe̱ke̱. *

english_verse: If you eat any of them, you will become just as disgusting and unclean as they are.
translation_verse: Nyeke̱ wãmo̱nii ní wamoo̱ le̱ eko eko akabulea nyehe, ni nyekawoa nyehe mũdšiye̱ ame̱he, ní ame̱hã nyehe wo mũdši.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must dedicate yourselves to me and be holy, just as I am holy. Don't become disgusting by eating any of these unclean creatures.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ midsi Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, hewo̱ le̱ nyefea nyehe kroṅkroṅ, koni nyehĩ kroṅkroṅ, *edšake̱ kroṅkroṅ dšimi; nohewo le̱ nyeke̱ nibii ní wamoo̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ eko eko akabulea nyehe. *

english_verse: I brought you out of Egypt so that I could be your God. Now you must become holy, because I am holy!
translation_verse: Edšake̱ midsi Iehowa, moni dsienye ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, koni matšṍ Nyoṅmo̱ mahãnye; nohewo le̱ nyefea kroṅkroṅ, edšake̱ mokroṅkroṅ dšimi.

english_verse: I have given these laws so that you will know what animals, birds, and fish are clean and may be eaten, and which ones are unclean and may not be eaten.
translation_verse: koni ake̱-fe sro̱to ye̱ nii ní he tšee ke̱ nii ní he tše le̱ ateṅ ke̱ koloi ní ayeo̱ ke̱ nii ní ayee le̱ ateṅ.

english_verse: Her son must be circumcised on the eighth day,
translation_verse: Ni gbĩ ní dši gbĩ kpānyo̱ le̱ no̱ le̱ afo gbekẽ le ketia.

english_verse: When the mother has completed her time of cleansing, she must come to the front of the sacred tent and bring to the priest a year-old lamb as a sacrifice to please me and a dove or a pigeon as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši egbe ehetšūmo̱ gbĩĩ le̱ anā ye̱ binū lo biyō hewo̱ le̱, eke̱ tōgwanteṅbi ní eye afi aba abahã ní ake̱-sã šā̃-afo̱le, ke̱ okpobi lo kose̱-okpo ní ake̱-šã *eša-afo̱le, ni eke̱-ba kpē-bū le̱ šĩnā le̱ nā eke̱-bahã oso̱fo le̱. *

english_verse: After the priest offers the sacrifices to me, the mother will become completely clean from her loss of blood, whether her child is a boy or a girl.
translation_verse: Ni eke̱-ba Iehowa hĩe, ni ekpãtã ehãle̱, ni ehe aatše ke̱-adše̱ eláhō le̱ṅ. Ene̱ dši mla ní kã ši hã yō ní fo̱ö̱ nū lo yō le̱.

english_verse: If she cannot afford a lamb, she can offer two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice to please me and the other as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ enáá tōbi yinii le̱, no le̱ eṅõ kose̱-okpoi enyo̱ lo okpobii enyo ke̱-ba ebahã, ni ake̱ ekome afe šā̃-afo̱le, ni ekome hũ eša-afo̱le, ni oso̱fo le̱ akpãtã ahãle̱, ni ehe atše.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose ke̱ Aaron wie ake̱:

english_verse: If sores or boils or a skin rash should break out and start spreading on your body, you must be brought to Aaron or to one of the other priests.
translation_verse: Ke̱dsi noko fũ moko hewolo no̱, gbẽi dšio alo noko hãlãhãlã dšio, ni eye ehewolo le̱ mli tamo̱ kpiti hela le̱, ake̱le̱ aba oso̱fo Aaron lo ebihĩĩ ní dši oso̱foi le̱ ateṅ mokome ṅõ.

english_verse: Then if the disease hasn't become any worse or spread, the priest will say, “You are clean. It is only a sore. After you wash your clothes, you may go home.”
translation_verse: Ni ke̱ oso̱fo le̱ kwe̱ ye̱ gbĩ ní dši kpawo le̱ no̱ ekoṅ, ni na, hela le̱ elādše, ni elē̱ē̱ ye̱ ehewolo le̱ no̱ le̱, no le̱ oso̱fo le̱ abule̱ ake̱ moko ní he tše; gbẽi ni; ni efo̱ etadei ahe, ní ehe atše.

english_verse: If it is discovered that the disease has started spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: ní ke̱ oso̱fo le̱ kwe̱, ni na, gbẽi le̱ mīlē̱ ye̱ hewolo le̱ no̱ le̱, oso̱fo le̱ abule̱ ake̱ moko ni he tšee; kpiti ni.

english_verse: Any of you with a skin disease must be brought to a priest.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši kpiti ſie moko he le̱, ake̱le̱ aba oso̱fo le̱ ṅõ;

english_verse: If he discovers that the sore spot is white with pus and that the hair around it has also turned white,
translation_verse: ni ke̱ oso̱fo le̱ kwe̱, ni na, noko ye̱ṅ efũ ye̱ hewolo le̱ no̱, ni emli tšoi le̱ hũ etšṍ eye̱ṅ, ni lō ṅmõṅ tō̃ ye̱ fũmo̱ le̱ mli le̱,

english_verse: he will say, “This is leprosy. You are unclean and must stay away from everyone else.”
translation_verse: bĕle̱ kpiti momo yo̱ ehewolo le̱ mli le̱; ni oso̱fo le̱ abule̱ ake̱ moko ní he tšee; ekaṅã́ eyi, edšake̱ ehe tšee.

english_verse: But if the disease has run its course and only the scars remain, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: ní oso̱fo le̱ kwe̱, ni na, kpiti le̱ eha ehewolo no̱ fẽ le̱, ebu helatše̱ le̱ ake̱ ehe tše: ehe fẽ etšṍ eye̱ṅ; ehe tše.

english_verse: If the sores come back and turn white again, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: ni ké̱ oso̱fo le̱ na lō ṅmõṅ le̱, ebule̱ ake̱ moni he tšee: lō ṅmõṅ le̱ he tšee; kpiti ni.

english_verse: However, if the sores heal and only white spots remain, the priest will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: ni oso̱fo le̱ kwe̱, ni na, noni ſie ehe le̱ etšṍ eye̱ṅ le̱, no le̱ oso̱fo le̱ abule̱ ake̱ moni he tše; ehe tše.

english_verse: If you have a sore that either swells or turns reddish-white after it has healed, then you must show it to a priest.
translation_verse: ni noko ye̱ṅ bafū heni asane le̱ yo̱, lo noko ye̱ṅ hãlãhãlã ní tšuo̱ō ba dše̱i le̱, ahã oso̱fo le̱ akwe̱.

english_verse: If he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Ni ke̱ oso̱fo le̱ kwe̱, ni na, dše̱i enyõ mli fè hewolo kroko le̱, ní emli tšoi le̱ etšṍ eye̱ṅ le̱, oso̱fo le̱ abule̱ ake̱ moko ní he tšee; kpiti ebote asane le̱ mli le̱.

english_verse: But if the white area is only on the surface of the skin and hasn't become any worse, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši oso̱fo le̱ kwe̱, ni na, tšo̱i ye̱ṅ be̱ṅ, ni dše̱i enyõko mli hũ fè hewolo kroko le̱, ni ēlādše, no le̱ oso̱fo aṅã́ eyi gbĩĩ kpawo;

english_verse: If the sore begins spreading during this time, the priest will say, “You are unclean because you have a disease.”
translation_verse: ni ke̱dši ēlē̱ ēſie no̱ ye̱ hewolo le̱ no̱ le̱, oso̱fo le̱ abule̱ ake̱ moko ní he tšee; kpiti ni.

english_verse: If you have a burn that gets infected and turns red or reddish-white,
translation_verse: Alo ké̱ la šã moko, ni la-fla le̱ fe kpo̱ hãlãhãlã ní ye̱o̱ ni etšuo̱ō alo eyeo futā le̱,

english_verse: a priest must examine it. Then if he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “The burn has turned into leprosy, and you are unclean.”
translation_verse: no le̱ oso̱fo le̱ akwe̱, ni na, ké̱ ehetšo̱i le̱ etšṍ eye̱ṅ ye̱ kpo̱ hãlãhãlã le̱ mli, ni dše̱i enyõ mli vō fè hewolo kroko le̱, bĕle̱ kpiti ebote la-fla le̱ mli le̱, ni oso̱fo le̱ abule̱ ake̱ moko ní he tšee; kpiti ni.

english_verse: But if the priest finds that the hair in the infected area hasn't turned white and that the sore is only skin deep and it is healing, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱ oso̱fo le̱ kwe̱le̱, ni na, tšo̱i ye̱ṅ be̱ kpo̱ hãlãhãlã le̱ mli, ni dše̱i enyõko mli hũ fè hewolo kroko le̱ ni ēlādše le̱, no le̱ oso̱fo le̱ aṅã́ eyi gbĩĩ kpawo;

english_verse: On the seventh day the priest will examine you again, and if the infection is spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: ni ke̱ oso̱fo le̱ na ye̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ kpawo le̱ no̱, ake elē̱ eſie no̱ ye̱ hewolo le̱ no̱ le̱, oso̱fo le̱ abule̱ moko ní he tšee; kpiti ni.

english_verse: However, if the infection hasn't spread and has begun to heal, and if only a scar remains, he will say, “Only a scar remains from the burn, and you are clean.”
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši kpo̱ hãlãhãlã le̱ ye̱ bo̱ni eyo̱ le̱ noṅṅ, ni elē̱ē̱ eſiee no̱ ye̱ hewolo le̱ no̱, ši ēlādše moṅ le̱, la-fla le̱ fũmo̱ ke̱ke̱ ni; ni oso̱fo le̱ abule̱ ake̱ moko ní he tše, edšake̱ *la-fladoku ni. *K.

english_verse: If you have a sore on your head or chin,
translation_verse: Ni kē̱ noko ſie nū ko lo yō ko yiteṅ lo etšẽṅ mli le̱,

english_verse: it must be examined by a priest. If the infection seems more than skin deep, and the hair in it has thinned out and lost its color, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: oso̱fo le̱ akwe̱ noni eſiele̱ le̱, ni na, ke̱dši enyõ mli vō fè hewolo kroko le̱, ni tšo̱i tšuru hãṅhãṅ ye̱ mli le̱, oso̱fo le̱ abule̱ ake̱ moko ni he tšee; fafale ni, yiteṅ alo tšẽṅ mli kpiti ni.

english_verse: On the other hand, if he discovers that the itchy spot is only skin deep, but that the hair still isn't healthy, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱ oso̱fo le̱ kwe̱ fafale ni eſiele̱ le̱, ni na, dše̱i enyõko mli fè hewolo kroko le̱, ni emli tšo̱i le̱ hũ dĩko le̱, oso̱fo le̱ aṅã́ moni yeo̱ fafale le̱ yi gbĩĩ kpawo;

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread, if the hair seems healthy, and if the itch is only skin deep,
translation_verse: ni ke̱ oso̱fo le̱ kwe̱ helatše̱ le̱ ye̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ kpawo le̱ no̱, ni na, fafale le̱ elē̱ē̱ eſiee no̱, ni emli tšo̱i le̱ hũ etšuko, ni heni fafale le̱ yo̱ le̱ enyõko mli fè hewolo kroko le̱,

english_verse: you must shave off the hair around the infection, but not those on it. Then the priest will tell you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: ke̱ke̱ ni eše̱ eyi, ši fafale le̱ ekaše̱ no̱, ni oso̱fo le̱ asā aṅã́ fafaletše̱ le̱ yi gbĩĩ kpawo ekoṅ.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread and seems no more than skin deep, he will say, “You are clean; now you must wash your clothes.”
translation_verse: Ni ke̱ oso̱fo le̱ kwe̱ fafale le̱ ye̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ kpawo le̱ no̱, ni na, fafale le̱ elē̱ē̱ eſiee no̱ ye̱ hewolo le̱ no̱, ni dše̱i enyõko mli fè hewolo kroko le̱, no le̱ oso̱fo le̱ abule̱ ake̱ moko ní he tše; ni efo̱ etadei le̱ ahe, ni ehe atše.

english_verse: Later, if the itch starts spreading, even though the hair is still healthy, the priest will say, “You are unclean.”
translation_verse: ni oso̱fo le̱ kwe̱le̱, ni na, fafale le̱ elē̱ ekoṅ ye̱ hewolo le̱ no̱ le̱, no le̱ oso̱fo le̱ akabi ši doṅṅ ake̱ emli tšo̱i le̱ etšu lo; ehe tšee.

english_verse: If white spots break out on your skin,
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši nokomei ye̱dši hãlãhãlã ba nū ko lo yō ko hewolo no̱,

english_verse: but the priest discovers that it is only a rash, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: ni oso̱fo le̱ bakwe̱, ni na, nokomei ye̱dši hãlãhãlã le̱ mīlādše ye̱ hewolo le̱ no̱ le̱, aflimata ní ſieo̱ mo hewolo no̱ ni; ehe tše.

english_verse: If you become bald on any part of your head, you are still clean.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši ehĩenā gbe̱ ke̱ke̱ eyi le̱ kpa ye̱ le̱, hĩenā kpatãtše̱ dšile̱; ehe tše.

english_verse: But if a priest discovers that a reddish-white sore has broken out on the bald spot and looks like leprosy, he will say,
translation_verse: Ni ke̱ oso̱fo le̱ bakwe̱le̱, ni na, noko ye̱ṅ ní tšuo̱ fũ ye̱ eyiteṅ lo ehĩenā heni ekpa le̱, ni etamo̱ kpiti ye̱ hewolo le̱ no̱ le̱,

english_verse: If you ever have leprosy, you must tear your clothes, leave your hair uncombed, cover the lower part of your face, and go around shouting, “I'm unclean! I'm unclean!”
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ kpitiyelo̱ le̱ ní hela le̱ yo̱ ehe le̱ agbla etadei ní enyie eyitšo flo, ni eha enābui ano̱ ni eblo̱ ake: Mihe tšee! mihe tšee!

english_verse: As long as you have the disease, you are unclean and must live alone outside the camp.
translation_verse: Gbĩĩabo̱ ní hela le̱ yo̱ ehe le̱, ehe tšee kwrā; ekometō ehĩ ši, ešihĩle̱he le̱ ahĩ nsra le̱ se̱.

english_verse: because the mildew has spread.” Then he will burn the clothing or the piece of leather.
translation_verse: Ni ašã ne̱ke̱ mama ne̱ lo etšimo̱-kpã lo elõ̀-kpã le̱, kũntũ dšio, klala dšio, alo wolonõ fẽ ní eſie he le̱; edšake̱ kpiti ní fiteo̱ nii ni, ake̱ la ašã.

english_verse: he will tell you to wash the clothing or leather and put it aside for another seven days,
translation_verse: no le̱ oso̱fo le̱ awo kitã, ako̱ afo̱ noni heſiemo̱ yo̱ mli le̱ he, ni esā eṅã́ eyi gbĩĩ kpawo ekoṅ;

english_verse: after which he will examine it again. If the spot hasn't spread, but is still greenish or reddish, the clothing or leather is unclean and must be burned.
translation_verse: ni ke̱ oso̱fo le̱ kwe̱, beni afo̱ noni ſie he le̱ se̱ le̱, ni na, noni ſie he le̱ tšakee ye̱ ehĩe, ni elē̱ē̱ efataa he hũ le̱, ehe tšee; ake̱ la ašã, eka mli ye̱ hĩegbe̱ lo se̱gbe̱, heni ekwa le̱.

english_verse: Later, if the spot reappears elsewhere on the clothing or the leather, you must burn it.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši āna lolo ye̱ mama le̱ lo etšimo̱-kpã lo elò-kpã le̱ lo wolonõ le̱ mli le̱, no le̱ ka eka le̱; ake̱ la ašã nõ he ni eſie le̱.

english_verse: Even if the spot completely disappears after being washed, it must be washed again before it is clean.
translation_verse: Ši mama le̱ lo etšimo̱-kpã lo elò-kpã le̱ lo wolonõ le̱ ní afo̱ he le̱, ké̱ noni ſie he le̱ dše le̱, asā afo̱ he ekoṅ, ni ehe atše.

english_verse: These are the rules for deciding if clothing is clean or unclean after a spot appears on it.
translation_verse: Ene̱ dši mla ní kã ši hã kpiti ní ſie kũntũ lo odonti mama lo etšimo̱-kpã lo elò-kpã lo wolonõ-fẽ-wolonõ mli, ní ake̱-naä ake̱ nõ le̱ he tše lo nõ le̱ he tšee le̱.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose wie ni ekē̱:

english_verse: Then you must once again shave your head, face, and eyebrows, as well as the hair on the rest of your body. Finally, wash your clothes and take a bath, and you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Ni aba mli ake̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ kpawo le̱ no̱ le̱ eše̱ hetšoi fẽ, eyitšo̱i ke̱ etšẽṅ ke̱ ehĩṅme̱ise̱tše̱i, ni ehetšo̱i fẽ tete eše̱, ni efo̱ etadei le̱ ahe, ni eke̱ nu adšu ehe, ni ehe atše.

english_verse: There he will offer one of the rams, together with the oil, as a sacrifice to make things right. He will also lift them up to show that they are dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo le̱ aṅo tōgwanteṅbii le̱ ateṅ ekome eke̱-bahã ake̱ sõ-afo̱le ke̱ mũ log kome le̱ hũ, ni efo ake fō̃-afole ye̱ Iehowa hĩe,

english_verse: The priest will smear some of the blood from this sacrifice on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo le̱ aṅõ sõ-afo̱le lá le̱ eko ni eke̱-sa moni atšūo̱ ehe le̱ *ninedšŭrõ toi nā, ke̱ eninédšŭrõ goṅtĩ nā, ke̱ enanedšŭrõ goṅtĩ nà. *

english_verse: He will then pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni oso̱fo le̱ awó mũ ke̱ log le̱ ni efo eko ewo le̱dientše̱ enine-abeku ko̱ko̱ mli;

english_verse: dip a finger of his right hand into the oil, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: ni oso̱fo le̱ aṅõ eninedšŭrõ wao etšo̱ mũ ní yo̱ ebe̱ku le̱ mli, ni eke̱ ewao atšo̱ mũ le̱ eko *aſã šii kpawo ye̱ Iehowa hĩe, *

english_verse: Next, the priest will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot,
translation_verse: ni mũ ní eſe̱ ye̱ edeṅ le̱ oso̱fo e̱ aṅõ eko asa moni atšūo ehe le̱ ninedšŭro toi nā, ke̱ eninedšŭrõ goṅtĩ nā, ke̱ enanedšŭrõ goṅtĩ nā, ye̱ sõ-afo̱le le̱ lá le̱ no̱;

english_verse: Depending on what you can afford, you must also offer either two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: ke̱ kose̱-okpoi enyo̱ lo okpobii enyo̱ ní enine aše̱ no̱ le̱, ni aṅõ ekome afe eša-afo̱le, ni aṅõ ekome hũ afe šā̃-afo̱le;

english_verse: The priest will offer these to me in front of the sacred tent on the eighth day.
translation_verse: ni gbĩ ni dši gbĩ kpānyo̱ le̱ no̱ le̱ eke̱-ba ye̱ ehetšūmo̱ hewo̱, eke̱-bahã oso̱fo le̱ ye̱ kpē-bū šĩnā le̱ nā, ye̱ Iehowa hĩe.

english_verse: The priest will kill this ram for the sacrifice to make things right, and he will lift it up with the olive oil in dedication to me. Then he will smear some of the blood on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Ni egbe sõ-afo̱le tōgwanteṅbi le̱, ni oso̱fo le̱ aṅõ elá le̱ eko esa moni atšūo̱ ehe le̱ ninedšŭrõ toi nā, ke̱ eninedšŭrõ goṅtĩ nā, ke̱ enanedšŭrõ goṅtĩ nā.

english_verse: The priest will pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo le̱ afo mũ le̱ eko awo le̱dientše̱ enineabe̱ku dẽko̱ko̱ mli,

english_verse: then dip a finger of his right hand in the oil and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: ni oso̱fo le̱ ke̱ eninedšŭrõ wao atšo̱ mũ ní yo̱ ebe̱ku le̱ eko aſã šii kpawo ye̱ Iehowa hĩe;

english_verse: He will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot, just as he did with the blood of the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: ni oso̱fo le̱ aṅo mũ ní yo̱ edeṅ le̱ eko esa moni atšūo̱ ehe le̱ ninedšŭrõ toi nā, ke̱ eninedšŭrõ goṅtĩ nā, ke̱ enanedšŭrõ goṅtĩ nā ye̱ heni sõ-afo̱le lá le̱ yo̱ le̱;

english_verse: And he will pour the rest of the oil from his palm on your head. Then, depending on what you can afford, he will offer either the doves or the pigeons together with the grain sacrifice. One of the birds is the sacrifice for sin, and the other is the sacrifice to please me. After this you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: nii ní enine še̱ no̱ le̱ ateṅ ekome eke̱-fe eša-afo̱le, ni eke̱ ekome hũ afe šā̃-afo̱le efata niyenii-afo̱le le̱ he; ni oso̱fo le̱ akpãtã aha moni atšūo̱ ehe le̱ ye̱ Iehowa hĩe.

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you have leprosy and cannot afford the usual sacrifices to make you clean. When There Is Mildew in a House
translation_verse: Ene̱ dši mla ní kã ši hã kpitiyelo̱ ní nine še̱e̱ nii ní dši ehetšūmo̱nii le̱ fẽ no̱ le̱.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose ke̱ Aaron wie ake̱:

english_verse: After I have given you the land of Canaan as your permanent possession, here is what you must do, if I ever put mildew on the walls of any of your homes.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši nyeba Kanaan šikpoṅ noni midientše̱ miṅõ-hãanye no̱yeli le̱ no̱, ni mihã kpiti ſie šĩa ko he ye̱ nyešikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱,

english_verse: First, you must say to a priest, “I think there is mildew on the wall of my house.”
translation_verse: no le̱ nakai šĩa le̱ tše̱ le̱ aba abatšĩ tã *atsõ oso̱fo le̱ ake̱: Efeo̱mi ake̱ noko tamo̱ kpiti eſie mišĩa le̱ he. *

english_verse: he will have the house closed for seven days.
translation_verse: no le̱ oso̱fo le̱ adše kpo ye̱ šĩa le̱, ni eṅã́ šĩa le̱ šĩnā le̱ gbĩĩ kpawo.

english_verse: If so, he will order someone to scrape the plaster from the walls, remove the stones covered with mildew, then haul everything off and dump it in an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: ni šĩa le̱ mligbe̱ le̱ aṅmlã fẽ ke̱-kpe, ni aṅõ sũ ni aṅmlã ye̱ he le̱ aſie maṅ lẽ sẽ ye̱ heko ní tšee;

english_verse: Afterwards the wall must be repaired with new stones and fresh plaster.
translation_verse: ni akŏ̱lo̱ te̱i krokomei aho̱lo̱ nomei anãdšiaṅ, ni aṅõ sũ kroko amã šĩa le̱ he.

english_verse: the priest will come and say, “This house is unclean. It's covered with mildew that can't be removed.”
translation_verse: ni oso̱fo le̱ ba ni ebakwe̱, ni na, noni eſie he le̱ mīlē̱ ye̱ šĩa le̱ he ekoṅ le̱, bĕle̱ kpiti ní fiteo̱ nii le̱ yo̱ šĩa le̱; ehe tšee.

english_verse: Then he will have the house torn down and every bit of wood, stone, and plaster hauled off to an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: Ni akũmo̱ šĩa le̱ aſie ši, ete̱i le̱ ke̱ emplãṅi le̱ ke̱ šĩa le̱ sũ le̱ fẽ, ni alō ke̱-dše mã le̱ṅ ke̱-yaſie heko ní tšee.

english_verse: Meanwhile, if any of you entered the house while it was closed, you will be unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ni moni aabote šìa le̱ gbĩĩabo̱ fẽ ní aṅã́ nā le, *ehe tšee ke̱-yaši gbe̱ke̱; *

english_verse: And if you either slept or ate in the house, you must wash your clothes.
translation_verse: ni moni aawo šĩa le̱ afo̱ etadei ahe, ni moni aaye nii ye̱ šìa le̱ afo̱ etadei ahe.

english_verse: On the other hand, if the priest discovers that mildew hasn't reappeared after the house was newly plastered, he will say, “This house is clean—the mildew has gone.”
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši oso̱fo le̱ ba šĩa le̱ abakwe̱, ni na, noni eſie he le̱ elē̱ē̱ efataa he ye̱ šĩa le̱, beni amã he le̱ se̱ le̱, no le̱ ebule̱ ake̱ ehe tše, edšake̱ noni ſie he le̱ etã.

english_verse: He will kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water
translation_verse: ni egbe *lofõdši le̱ ateṅ ekome ye̱ sũ kã no̱ ye̱ nu ní hoo no̱; *K.

english_verse: and let its blood drain into the pot. Then he will dip the cedar, the hyssop, the yarn, and the other bird into the mixture of blood and water. Next, he will sprinkle the house seven times with the mixture, then the house will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Ni eke̱ loflõ le̱ lá le̱ ke̱ nu ní hoo̱ le̱ ke̱ loflõ ní hĩe kã le̱ ke̱ tšenedrutšo le̱ ke̱ hisopo le̱ ke̱ munēle le̱ ašã eša-afo̱le ni eke̱-dſira šĩa le̱.

english_verse: Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away, ending the ceremony for purifying the house.
translation_verse: Ni eṅmẽ *loflō ní hĩe kã le̱ he ye̱ maṅ le̱ agbó nā ní eya ṅã le̱ no̱, ni ekpãtã ehã šĩa le̱, ni ehe atše. *K.

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you discover that you are unclean because of an itch or a sore, or that your clothing or house is unclean because of mildew.
translation_verse: koni ake̱-tšo be mli ní noko he tšee ke̱ be mli ní noko he tše; ene̱ dši kpiti he mla le̱.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose ke̱ Aaron wie ake̱:

english_verse: If you are spit on by the man, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ni kē̱ moni he hoo̱ nu le̱ tšẽ ladšõ eſie moko ní he tše he le̱, mo le̱ afo̱ etadei ahe, ni eke̱ nu adšu ehe, ni ehe tšee ke̱-yaši gbe̱ke̱

english_verse: Any saddle or seat on which the man sits is unclean. And if you touch or carry either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ni mofẽmo ní taä noko ní yo̱ moni he hoo̱ nu le̱ šiši le̱ he le̱ he tšee ke̱-yaši gbe̱ke̱. Ni moni woo̱ ne̱ke̱ noko ne̱ afo̱ etadei ahe, ni eke̱ nu adšu ehe, ni ehe tšee ke̱-yaši gbe̱ke̱.

english_verse: Any clay pot that he touches must be destroyed, and any wooden bowl that he touches must be washed.
translation_verse: Ni *šũnõ ní moni he hoo̱ nu le̱ aata he le̱, adſa, ni tšonõ-fẽ-tšonõ le̱ ake̱ nu afo̱ mli. *

english_verse: Seven days after the man gets well, he will be considered clean, if he washes his clothes and takes a bath in spring water.
translation_verse: Ni ké̱ moni he hoo̱ nu le̱ he tã ke̱-dše̱ ehenuhō le̱ mli le̱, ekane gbĩĩ kpawo ehã ehetšūmo̱, ni efo̱ etadei ahe, ni eyadšu ehe ye̱ nu ní hoo̱ mli, ni ehe atše.

english_verse: The priest will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, then I will consider the man completely clean.
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo le̱ aṅõ ekome afe eša-afo̱le, ni eke̱ ekome hũ afe šā̃-afo̱le; ni oso̱fo le̱ akpãtã ahãle̱ ye̱ Iehowa hĩe ke̱-dše̱ ehe ní hoo̱ le̱ mli.

english_verse: Any man who has a flow of semen must take a bath, but he still remains unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši *nū ko henu dše emli le̱, no le̱ eke̱ nu adšu ehe fẽ, ni ehe tšee ke̱-yaši gbe̱ke̱. *

english_verse: If the semen touches anything made of cloth or leather, these must be washed, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ni mama-fẽ-mama ke̱ wolo-fẽ-wolo ní ne̱ke̱ henu ne̱ eko aate mli le̱ ake̱ nu afo̱ he, ni ehe tšee ke̱-yaši gbe̱ke̱.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on is also unclean, and if you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ni kē̱ moko ta noko ni yo̱ esā no̱ lo nofẽno ní etá no̱ le̱ no̱ le̱ he le̱, ehe tšee ke̱-yaši gbe̱ke̱.

english_verse: Any man who has sex with her during this time becomes unclean for seven days, and anything he rests on is also unclean.
