translation_verse: Ši ké̱ nū ko ke̱le̱ wo̱ ni etšũiase̱yānii le̱ eko te ehe le̱, no le̱ ehe tšee gbĩĩ kpawo, ni nofẽno ní ekã no̱ le̱ he tšee.

english_verse: Any woman who has a flow of blood outside her regular monthly period is unclean until it stops, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši yō ko he hoo̱ lá gbĩĩ pī, beni eše̱ko etšũiase̱yā be le̱, alo ehe hoo̱ lá ye̱ etšũiase̱yā be le̱ se̱ le̱, bĕle̱ gbĩĩ le̱ fẽ ní ehe hoo̱ le̱, ehe tšee, tamo̱ bo̱-ni ehe tšee ye̱ etšũiase̱yā gbĩĩ le̱ amli le̱ noṅṅ.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on during this time is also unclean, just as it would be during her period.
translation_verse: Sā-fẽ-sā ní ekã no̱ gbĩĩ abo̱ ní ohe hoo̱ le̱ atamo̱ etšũiase̱yā sā le̱, ni nofẽno ní etá no̱ le̱ he tšee, take̱ bo̱ni ehe tšee ye̱ etšũiase̱yā he le̱ mli le̱.

english_verse: If you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ni mofẽmo ní taä nii ne̱ eko he le̱, ehe tšee, ni efo̱ etadei ahe, ni eke̱ nu adšu ehe, ni ehe tšee ke̱-yaši gbe̱ke̱.

english_verse: Seven days after the woman gets well, she will be considered clean.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši ehe láhō le̱ se̱ fo le̱, no le̱ ekane gbĩĩ kpawo ehã ehe, ni no se̱ le̱ ehe aatše.

english_verse: On the eighth day, she must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Ni gbĩ ní dši gbĩ kpānyo̱ le̱ no̱ le̱ eṅõ kose̱-okpoi enyo̱ lo okpobii enyo̱, ni eke̱-bahã oso̱fo le̱ ye̱ kpē-bū le̱ šĩnā le̱ nā. K.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me; then I will consider the woman completely clean.
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo le̱ aṅo ekome afe eša-afo̱le, ni eke̱ ekome hũ afe šā̃-afo̱le, ni oso̱fo le̱ akpãtã ahãle̱ ye̱ Iehowa hĩe ke̱-dše̱ ehe láhō ni he tšee le̱ mli.

english_verse: When any of you are unclean, you must stay away from the rest of the community of Israel. Otherwise, my sacred tent will become unclean, and the whole nation will die.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni nyetšõ Israelbii ní ame̱le ame̱he ne̱kwe̱mo̱ ye̱ ame̱nibii ní he tšee le̱ ahe ne̱, koni ame̱kagboi ye̱ ame̱nibii ní he tšee le̱ amli, beni ame̱yabule mišihĩle̱he le̱ ní yo̱ ame̱teṅ le̱.

english_verse: Then you will lead the two goats into my presence at the front of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ni eṅõ tōkpakpoi enyo̱ le̱, ni eke̱-badamo̱ Iehowa hĩe ye̱ kpē-bū le̱ šĩnā le̱ nā.

english_verse: where I will show you which goat will be sacrificed to me and which one will be sent into the desert to the demon Azazel.
translation_verse: Ni Aaron afõ tōkpakpoi enyo̱ le̱ no̱ ošiki: ošiki kome hã Iehowa ke̱ ošiki kome hã *Azazel. *K.

english_verse: After you offer the first goat as a sacrifice for sin,
translation_verse: Ni Aaron aṅõ tōkpakpo ní Iehowa ošiki le̱ gbē eno̱ le̱ ke̱-ba, ni eke̱-bašã eša-afo̱le.

english_verse: Next, use a finger to sprinkle some of the blood on the place of mercy, which is on the lid of the sacred chest; then sprinkle blood seven times in front of the chest.
translation_verse: Ni eṅõ tšinanū le̱ lá le̱ eko ní eke̱ ewao le̱ atšo̱ aſã kpãtãmo̱ sẽi le̱ no̱ ye̱ hĩegbe̱; ni eke̱ ewao atšo̱ lá le̱ eko aſã kpãtãmo̱ sẽi le̱ hĩe šii kpawo.

english_verse: Aaron, you must next sacrifice the goat for the sins of the people, and you must sprinkle its blood inside the most holy place, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
translation_verse: Ni egbe eša-afo̱le tōkpakpo le̱ ní dši maṅ le̱ nõ le̱, ni eke̱ elá le̱ abote muhē̱ le̱ se̱, ni eke̱ elá le̱ afe, tamo̱ bo̱ni eke̱ tšinanū le̱ lá le̱ fe le̱, ni etšo̱ eſã kpãtãmo̱ sẽi le̱ no̱ ke̱ kpãtãmo̱ sẽi le̱ hĩegbe̱; Rom.

english_verse: By doing this, you will take away the sins that make both the most holy place and the people of Israel unclean. Do the same for the sacred tent, which is here among the people.
translation_verse: ni *edſira hekroṅkroṅ le̱ ye̱ Israelbii le̱ amũdšinii ke̱ ame̱mlatõmo̱i ní dši ame̱he ešai le̱ fẽ le̱ ahewo; ni nakai efe ehã kpē-bū le̱ ní yo̱ ame̱teṅ ye̱ ame̱mũdšinii le̱ amli le̱. *

english_verse: After leaving the tent, you will purify the bronze altar by smearing each of its four corners with some of the blood from the bull and from the goat.
translation_verse: Ni edše kpo ke̱-ba afo̱lešãlate̱ ní mã Iehowa hĩe le̱ he, ni ekpãtã ehãle̱, ni eṅõ tšinanū le̱ lá le̱ eko ke̱ tōkpakpo le̱ lá le̱ eko, ni eke̱-săra afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ kodši le̱ ano̱ ke̱-kpe;

english_verse: Use a finger to sprinkle the altar seven times with the blood, and it will be completely clean from the sins of the people.
translation_verse: ni eke̱ ewao atšo̱ lá le̱ eko eſã no̱ šii kpawo, ni etšū ehe ni efe ehe kroṅkroṅ ke̱-dše̱ Israelbii le̱ amũdšinii le̱ amli.

english_verse: After you have purified the most holy place, the sacred tent, and the bronze altar, you must bring the live goat to the front of the tent.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱ egbe hekroṅkroṅ le̱ ke̱ kpē-bū le̱ ke̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ dſiramo̱ le̱ nā le̱, eke̱ tōkpakpo ní hĩe kã le̱ aba;

english_verse: Finally, this goat that carries the heavy burden of Israel's sins must be released deep in the desert.
translation_verse: ni tōkpakpo le̱ atĕre ame̱no̱tõmo̱i le̱ fẽ ke̱-ya šikpoṅ ole̱ṅle̱ ko no̱; ni ṅã le̱ no̱ tō̃ eṅmē̃ tōkpakpo le̱ he ye̱.

english_verse: Aaron, after this you must go inside the sacred tent, take a bath, put on your regular priestly clothes, and leave there the clothes you put on before entering the most holy place. Then you will come out and offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices for your sins and for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Ni eke̱ nu adšu ehe ye̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱, ni ewo le̱dientše̱ etadei, ni edše kpo eyašã le̱dientše ešã-afole le̱ ke̱ maṅ le̱ šā̃-afo̱le le̱, ni ekpãtã ehã le̱dientše̱ ehe ke̱ maṅ le̱.

english_verse: The fat from these sacrifices for sin must be sent up in smoke on the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ni eša-afo̱le le̱ he fo̱ le̱ ešã ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: The one who led the goat into the desert and sent it off to the demon Azazel must take a bath and wash his clothes before coming back into camp.
translation_verse: Ni moni ke̱ tōkpakpo le̱ te yaṅmẽ ehe ehã Azazel le̱ afo̱ etadei le̱ ahe, ni eke̱ nu adšu ehe, ni no se̱ fẽdã ní eba nsra le̱ṅ.

english_verse: The remains of the bull and the goat whose blood was taken into the most holy place must be taken outside the camp and burned.
translation_verse: Ni eša-afo̱le tšinanũ le̱ ke̱ eša-afo̱le tōkpakpo le̱ ní ake̱ ame̱lá le̱ te hekroṅkroṅ le̱ ní ake̱yakpãtã le̱, ake̱-dše nsra le̱ṅ ni ake̱ la ašã, ame̱wodši ke̱ ame̱lõi ke̱ ame̱fei le̱ ſẽ.

english_verse: And whoever does this must take a bath and change clothes before coming back into camp. The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Ni moni te eyašãame̱ le̱ afo̱ etadei le̱ ahe, ni eke̱ nu adšu ehe, ni no se̱ fẽdã ni eba nsra le̱ṅ.

english_verse: On the tenth day of the seventh month of each year, you must go without eating to show sorrow for your sins, and no one, including foreigners who live among you, is allowed to work.
translation_verse: Ni ene̱ afe nāno̱ akpo̱ ahãnye: Nyõṅ ní dši kpawo le̱ no̱ gbĩ nyoṅma le̱ no̱ le̱ nyewaä nyehe yi, ni nyekatšua nitšumo̱ ko, nyemã le̱ṅ nyo dšio, gbo̱ ní too̱ gbo̱ ye̱ nyeteṅ dšio.

english_verse: This is the day on which the sacrifice for the forgiveness of your sins will be made in my presence,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ abakpãtã ahãnye, koni atšū nyehe ke̱-dše nyehe ešai le̱ fẽ mli, ní nyehe atše ye Iehowa hĩe. *Heb.

english_verse: The high priest must offer the sacrifices for cleansing from sin, while wearing the sacred linen clothes.
translation_verse: Ni kpãtãmo̱ ne̱, oso̱fo ní afo̱le̱ mũ ni awole̱ oso̱fo, koni eye oso̱fo ye̱ etše̱ nãdšiaṅ le̱, akpãtã; ni ewo klala atadei ní dši atadei kroṅkroṅi le̱;

english_verse: He will offer these sacrifices for the most holy place, the sacred tent, the bronze altar, all the priests, and for the whole community.
translation_verse: ni edſira hekroṅkroṅ fè fẽ le̱ ke̱ kpē-bū le̱ ke̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱, ni ekpãtã ehã oso̱foi le̱ ke̱ maṅ mū le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: You must celebrate this day each year—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness for all the sins of the people of Israel. Moses did exactly as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ni ene̱ atšṍ nāno̱ akpo̱ ahãnye, ni aṅõ-kpãtã ahã Israelbii le̱ ye̱ ame̱he ešai le̱ fẽ hewo̱ dā afi šikome. Ni efe boni Iehowa wo Mose kitã le̱.

english_verse: but in front of the sacred tent. Then a priest can splatter its blood against the bronze altar and send its fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo le̱ aṅõ lá le̱ aſã Iehowa afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ ye̱ kpẽ-bū le̱ šĩnā le̱ ši, ni ešã fo̱ le̱ ní edše ṅma ewo Iehowa.

english_verse: Don't ever turn from me again and offer sacrifices to goat-demons. This law will never change.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱kašã afo̱lei ame̱hã wo̱dši ní ame̱nyieo̱ ame̱se̱ ke̱-bo̱ö̱ adſamaṅ le̱ doṅṅ. Ene̱ atšṍ nāno̱ akpo̱ ahãame̱ ye̱ ame̱yino̱i fẽ.

english_verse: Remember! No one in Israel, including foreigners, is to offer a sacrifice anywhere
translation_verse: Ni okē̱ame̱ ake̱: Mofẽmo ní yo̱ Israel we le̱ lo gbo̱ ní too̱ gbo̱ ye̱ ame̱teṅ ní aašã šā̃-afo̱le lo gbē-afo̱le,

english_verse: I will turn against any of my people who eat blood. This also includes any foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Ni mofẽmo ní yo̱ Israel we le̱ lo gbo̱ ní too̱ ame̱teṅ gbo̱ le̱, ní *yeo̱ lá-ſẽ-lá le̱, madšie mihĩe maka nakai susuma le̱, ni mafole̱ ke̱-adše̱ emã le̱ teṅ maše̱ mafo. *

english_verse: Even if you should hunt and kill a bird or an animal, you must drain out the blood and cover it with soil.
translation_verse: Ni Israelbii le̱ ateṅ mofẽmo ke̱ gbo̱ ni too̱ gbo̱ ye̱ ame̱teṅ le̱, kē̱ eyagbo̱bi ni egbe kolo lo loflõ ní ayeo̱ le̱, efo̱se ela le̱ eſie ši, ni eke̱ sũ aha no̱.

english_verse: The life of every living creature is in its blood. That's why I have forbidden you to eat blood and why I have warned you that anyone who does will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *helo-fẽ-helo wala le̱, ela le̱ noṅṅ mli ewala le̱ yo̱; hewo̱ ni mikē̱ Israelbii le̱ ake̱: Nyekayea lō ko lō ko lá; edšake̱ helo-fẽ-helo wala dši ela le̱; mofẽmo ní yeo̱ le̱, aafole̱ aše̱ afõ. *

english_verse: If you happen to find a dead animal and eat it, you must take a bath and wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ši *mofẽmo ní yeo̱ noko ní enyõ lo noko ní atšere̱ mli le̱, mã le̱ṅ nyo ni dšio, gbo̱ ni dšio, efo̱ etadei ahe, ni eke̱ nu adšu ehe, ni ehe tšee ke̱-yaši gbe̱ke̱; no fẽdã ehe aatše. *

english_verse: If you don't take a bath, you will suffer for what you did wrong.
translation_verse: Ni kē̱ efo̱o̱ etadei ahe ni edšuu ehe le̱, no le̱ esõ akã eno.

english_verse: or a sister of your father or mother.
translation_verse: Kādšie onye nyemiyō yayaiaṅ kpo; edšake̱ onye helo dientše̱ dšile̱.

english_verse: Don't disgrace your uncle by having sex with his wife.
translation_verse: Kādšie otše̱ nyeminū yayaiaṅ kpo, eṅã le̱ kābe̱ṅke̱le̱; ši onyekwẽ ni.

english_verse: And don't have sex with the daughter or granddaughter of any woman that you have earlier had sex with. You will be having sex with her closest relatives, and that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Kādšie yō ko ke̱ ebiyō fẽ yayaiaṅ kpo; kāṅõ ebinū le̱ biyō lo ebiyō le̱ biyō ní odšie ame̱yayaiaṅ kpo; ehelo dientše̱ dšiame̱; musu dši no.

english_verse: Don't have sex with another man's wife—that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Ni oke̱ *onanyo gbomo ṅã hũ akawo̱ ní oke̱le̱ bule ohe. *

english_verse: Don't make yourselves unclean by any of these disgusting practices of those nations that I am forcing out of the land for you. They made themselves
translation_verse: Nyeke̱ ne̱ke̱ nii ne̱ akabulea nyehe; edšake̱ ne̱ke̱ nii ne̱ fẽ dšeṅmãdši ní mibaſie ye̱ nyehĩe le̱ ke̱-bule ame̱he le̱,

english_verse: and the land so unclean, that I punished the land because of their sins, and I made it vomit them up.
translation_verse: ni abule šikpoṅ le̱, nohewo̱ le̱ mibawole̱ enišaianii le̱ ahe nyõmo̱, ni šikpoṅ le̱ bafe eno̱bii le̱ aſie.

english_verse: Now don't do these sickening things that make the land filthy. Instead, obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ne̱ke̱ nihĩnii ne̱ fẽ le̱, šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ bii ní tšṍ nyehĩe le̱ efe, ni abule šikpoṅ le̱;

english_verse: Then the land won't become sick of you and vomit you up, just as it did them.
translation_verse: koni šikpoṅ le̱ akaſenye hũ eſie, take̱ bo̱ni eſe dšeṅmaṅ ni tšṍ nyehĩe le̱ eſie le̱, kē̱ nyebulele̱ le̱.

english_verse: If any of you do these vulgar, disgusting things, you will be unclean and no longer belong to my people. I am the Lord your God, and I forbid you to follow their sickening way of life.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyeyea migbe̱nānii le̱ ano̱, koni nyekafea kusumi ní ahĩa ní afe dãni nyeba le̱, ni nyeke̱-kabulea nyehe; midši Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name by making promises you don't intend to keep. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ni nyeke̱ migbei le̱ akakãa amale kitã, ní oṅõ-bule o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ gbe̱i le̱; midši Iehowa.

english_verse: Breed your livestock animals only with animals of the same kind, and don't plant two kinds of seed in the same field or wear clothes made of different kinds of material.
translation_verse: Nyeyea mikpo̱i le̱ ano̱. Ošĩa koloi le̱, kāhã ame̱mīfutu ame̱mīkwo̱; oṅmõ hũ kāfutu dũmo̱nii odũ ye̱ mli; ni kāwo atade ní ake̱ klala ke̱ kũntũ futu lò.

english_verse: After you enter the land, you will plant fruit trees, but you are not to eat any fruit from them for the first three years.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱ nyeba šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ni nyebate̱o yelitšo-fẽ-yelitšo ní ayeo̱ le̱, nyebua ame̱yibii le̱ ake̱ fōnii. Afii etẽ ame̱-tšṍ fōnii ame̱hãnye, ni akaye;

english_verse: In the fourth year the fruit must be set apart, as an expression of thanks
translation_verse: ši afi ní dši edſe̱ le̱ no̱ le̱ ame̱yibii le̱ fẽ afe kroṅkroṅ ni ake̱-dšie Iehowa yi;

english_verse: to me, the Lord God. Do this, and in the fifth year, those trees will produce an abundant harvest of fruit for you to eat.
translation_verse: ni afi ní dši enumo̱ le̱ no̱ le̱ nyeyea ame̱yibii le̱, koni ame̱nibãnii le̱ afã́ babaō ahānye; midši Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Don't let your daughters serve as temple prostitutes—this would bring disgrace both to them and the land.
translation_verse: Kābule obiyō ní ohã ebo̱ adſamaṅ, koni šikpoṅ le̱ akabo̱ adſamaṅ, ni šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ bayi to̱ ke̱ musu.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves disgusting to me by going to people who claim they can talk to the dead.
translation_verse: Nyekayanyiea *okomfoi ase̱, ni klamo̱i le̱ hũ, nyekataoa ame̱se̱gbe̱ ní nyeke̱wo nyehe mũdši; midši Iehowa. *

english_verse: I command you to show respect for older people and to obey me with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Te ši ye̱ yiteṅwadšiatše̱ hĩe, ni owo nūmo hĩe nyam, ni oše o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱; midši Iehowa.

english_verse: Don't mistreat any foreigners who live in your land.
translation_verse: Ni ké̱ gbo̱ ko bato gbo̱ ye̱ nye-šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱, nyekawaäle̱ yi.

english_verse: Instead, treat them as well as you treat your own people and love them as much as you love yourself. Remember, you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Gbo̱ ní too̱ gbo̱ ye̱ nyeṅõ le̱, nye-buale̱ tamo̱ nyemaṅnyo noṅṅ, ni osumo̱le̱ take̱ boni osumo̱ bodientše̱ ohe le̱; edšake̱ nye hũ nyeyato gbo̱ pẽṅ ye̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱. Midši Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Use honest scales and don't cheat when you weigh or measure anything. I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt,
translation_verse: Nyehĩea nsẽnii ní dša, te̱i ní dša, efa ní dša ke̱ hin ní dša; midši Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ní dsienye ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱.

english_verse: and I command you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyebua mikpoi le̱ fẽ ke̱ migbe̱nānii le̱ fẽ, ni-nyeyea no̱; midši Iehowa.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose wie ni ekē̱:

english_verse: They have disgraced both the place where I am worshiped and my holy name, and so I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people.
translation_verse: Ni mi le̱ maṅõ mihĩe maka nakai gbomo le̱, ni mafole̱ ke̱-adše̱ emã le̱ṅ maše̱ mafõ, edšake̱ eṅõ esešibii le̱ eko ehã Molek, ní eṅõ-wo mihekroṅkroṅ le̱ he mũdši, ni ebule migbe̱i kroṅkroṅ le̱.

english_verse: I will be your enemy if you go to someone who claims to speak with the dead, and I will destroy you from among my people.
translation_verse: Ni moni yanyieo̱ okomfoi lo klamo̱i le̱ ase̱, ní ebo̱o̱ adſamaṅ le̱, maṅõ mihĩe maka nakai mo le̱, ni mafole̱ ke̱-adše̱ emaṅ le̱ maše̱ mafo.

english_verse: Dedicate yourselves to me and be holy because I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ *nyefea nyehe kroṅkroṅ, koni nyetšṍmo̱ mei kroṅkroṅi; edšake̱ midši Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱. *

english_verse: If you curse your father or mother, you will be put to death, and it will be your own fault.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši moko lomo̱ etše̱ lo enye le̱, gbe agbele̱; etše̱ ke̱ enye elomo̱ le̱; ela kã ene̱.

english_verse: If any of you men have sex with another man's wife, both you and the woman will be put to death.
translation_verse: Ni nū ní ke̱ nū ko ṅã kũo̱ gblã mli, ni eke̱ enanyo ṅã kũo̱ gblã mli le̱, gbe ágbele̱, gblãṅkũolo̱ le̱ ke̱ yō ni eke̱le̱ kũ gblã mli le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: It isn't natural to have sex with your daughter-in-law, and both of you will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Ni nū ní ke̱ ešāyō ní dši ebi ṅã le̱ wo̱ö̱ le̱, gbe ágbe ame̱yi enyo̱ le̱ fẽ; hĩegbedšianii amefe le̱; ame̱lá kã ame̱no̱.

english_verse: It's disgusting for men to have sex with one another, and those who do will be put to death, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Ni nū ni ke̱ nū ko wo̱ö̱, take̱ bo̱ni ake̱ yō wo̱ö̱ le̱, nihĩnii ame̱fe le̱; ame̱yi enyo̱ le̱ fẽ le̱, gbe agbeame̱; ame̱lá kã ame̱no̱.

english_verse: It isn't natural for a man to marry both a woman and her daughter, and so all three of them will be burned to death.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši nū ko ṅõ yō ko ke̱ enye fẽ le̱, musu dši no; ake̱ la ášãle̱ ke̱ame̱ fẽ, ní musu akahĩ nyeteṅ.

english_verse: If any of you have sex with an animal, both you and the animal will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Ni yō ní be̱ṅke̱o̱ kolo ko, ni ekàa ši ehãale̱ le̱, gbe yō le̱ ke̱ kolo le̱ fẽ; gbe ágbeame̱; ame̱lá kã ame̱no̱.

english_verse: If you marry one of your sisters, you will be punished, and the two of you will be disgraced by being openly forced out of the community.
translation_verse: Ni nū ní ṅōo̱ enyemiyō, ní dši etše̱bi lo enyebi, ni ekwe̱o̱ eyayaiaṅ, ni yō le̱ hũ kwe̱o̱ eyayaiaṅ le̱, āhĩ no, ni áflo̱ame̱ aše̱re̱ aſie ye̱ ame̱maṅbii le̱ ahĩe; enyemiyō yayaiaṅ kpo edšie le̱; amusu atšĕrele̱.

english_verse: The sisters of your father and mother are your own relatives, and you will be punished for having sex with any of them.
translation_verse: Ni kādšie onye nyemiyō lo otše̱ nyemiyō yayaiaṅ kpo; edšake̱ le̱dientše̱ ehelo yayaiaṅ kpo edšie le̱; ame̱musu atĕreame̱.

english_verse: If you have sex with your uncle's wife, neither you nor she will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Ni nū ni ke̱ enyekwẽ wo̱ö̱ le̱, enyekwẽ yayaiaṅ kpo edšie le̱; ame̱tĕre ame̱he eša; ame̱fo̱ṅ bii ni ame̱agboi.

english_verse: And if you marry your sister-in-law, neither of you will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱ nū ko šõ enyeminū ṅã le̱, eye̱ nyãṅemo̱; enyeminū yayaiaṅ kpo edšie le̱, ame̱fo̱ṅ.

english_verse: The nations I am chasing out did these disgusting things, and I hated them for it, so don't follow their example.
translation_verse: Ni nyekanyiea ye̱ maṅ ní mibaſie ye̱ nyehĩe le̱ akusumi le̱ anā; edšake̱ nii ne̱ fẽ ame̱fe, ni minyãṅeame̱ le̱.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have promised you their land that is rich with milk and honey. I have chosen you to be different from other people.
translation_verse: Ni mike̱nye ake̱: Nye nyeaye ame̱šikpodši le̱ ano̱, ni nii le̱ maṅõ-hãnye ake̱ nyeno̱yelinõ, šikpoṅ ni hoo̱ fufo̱ ke̱ wò le̱. Midsi Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ni midšienye ke̱-dše̱ mãdši le ateṅ le̱.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the holy God. You have been chosen to be my people, and so you must be holy too.
translation_verse: Ni nyefea kroṅkroṅ nyehãami, edšake̱ mokroṅkroṅ dšimi, Iehowa; ni mitšenye ke̱-dše̱ mãdši le̱ ahe, koni nyetšó mimaṅ.

english_verse: If you claim to receive messages from the dead, you will be put to death by stoning, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Ni nū lo yō ní okomfo lo klamo̱ mumo̱ yo̱ emli le̱, gbe ágbeame̱; te̱i átſia-ame̱; ame̱lá kã ame̱no̱.

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses these instructions for Aaron's sons, the priests: Touching a dead body will make you unclean. So don't go near a dead relative,
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱ Mose ake̱: Kē̱mo̱ oso̱foi, Aaron bihĩĩ le̱ ake̱: Nyeteṅ mokomoko ke̱ gbonyo akabule ehe ye̱ emã le̱ṅ; Ezek.

english_verse: or an unmarried sister, who has no husband to take care of her.
translation_verse: ke̱ enyemiyō ní dši oblayō fro ní ke̱le̱ yo̱ ní egbãko, le̱ eke̱-bule ehe.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by attending the funeral of someone related to you by marriage.
translation_verse: Ekawo ehe mũdši ye̱ emaṅbii le̱ ateṅ mokomoko he, ní eke̱-bule ehe.

english_verse: Don't shave any part of your head or trim your beard or cut yourself to show that you are mourning.
translation_verse: Ame̱kakpo̱ ame̱yi, ni ame̱tšẽṅi anāgbēi le̱ hũ ame̱kaše̱, ni asaṅ ame̱kabãmo̱ ame̱hewolo no̱ gbẽi.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have chosen you alone to offer sacrifices of food to me on the altar. That's why you must keep yourselves holy.
translation_verse: Ame̱fe kroṅkroṅ ame̱hã ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ni ame̱kabule ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ gbe̱i le̱; edšake̱ Iehowa afo̱lei ní ake̱ la šãa le̱, ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ abolo le̱, ame̱ ame̱ke̱bahãa, hewo̱ le̱ amefe kroṅkroṅ.

english_verse: because I am holy. And so, you must be treated with proper respect, since you offer food sacrifices to me, the God of holiness.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ obule kroṅkroṅ, edšake̱ o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ abolo le̱, le̱ eke̱-bahãa; mokroṅkroṅ etšṍ ehão, edšake̱ mokroṅkroṅ dšimi, Iehowa, moni feo̱ nyehe kroṅkroṅ le̱.

english_verse: If any of you priests has a daughter who disgraces you by serving as a temple prostitute, she must be burned to death.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši oso̱fo ko biyō bõi adſamaṅbō̱ le̱, ebule etše̱, ake̱ la ašãle̱.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must not mess up your hair or tear your clothes in order to mourn for the dead.
translation_verse: Ni moni dši oso̱fonukpa ye̱ enyemimei le̱ ateṅ, ni *afo̱se mũfō̱-mũ le̱ aſie eyiteṅ, ni awole̱ oso̱fo, ní aṅõ atadei le̱ awole̱ le̱, ekanyie eyitšo flo, ni ekagbla etadei le̱ amli, *

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by going near a dead body, not even that of your own father or mother.
translation_verse: ni ekaya gbonyo ko gbonyo ko he, etše̱ ke̱ enye he tete ekabule ehe.

english_verse: If you leave the sacred place to attend a funeral, both you and the sacred place become unclean, because you are the high priest.
translation_verse: Ekadše hekroṅkroṅ le̱, ni ekabule e-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱, edšake̱ e-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ mũfō̱-mũ le̱ akekre le̱ ye̱ eyiteṅ; midsi Iehowa.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must marry only a virgin
translation_verse: Ni le̱ le̱, eṅõ yō ní dši oblayō fro.

english_verse: from your own tribe. Don't marry a divorced woman or any other woman who has already had sex, including a temple prostitute.
translation_verse: Ekaṅõ yō okũlafo lo moni aſiele̱ lo moni abulele̱ lo adſamaṅ, ši moṅ eṅõ emã le̱ṅ oblayō fro efe eṅã.

english_verse: In this way, your descendants will be qualified to serve me. Remember—I am the Lord, and I have chosen you.
translation_verse: Ni ekawo esešibii le̱ ahe mũdši ye̱ emã le̱ṅ; edšake̱ midsi Iehowa ní feo̱le̱ kroṅkroṅ le̱.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose wie ni ekē̱:

english_verse: to say to Aaron: No descendant of yours can ever serve as my priest if he is blind or lame, if his face is disfigured, if one leg is shorter than the other,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nū-fẽ-nū ní kpa ko yo̱ ehe le̱ ekabe̱ṅke̱: ſilafo dšio, otšō̱lo̱ dšio, gugõ sro̱to tše̱ lo henõ ko ní fá tšṍ tše̱ dšio,

english_verse: if either a foot or a hand is paralyzed,
translation_verse: lo nū ko ní nane ekũ lo enine ekũ,

english_verse: if he is a hunchback or a dwarf, if an eye or his skin is diseased, or if his testicles have been damaged.
translation_verse: lo afũtše̱, lo moni etã lō tšṍ, lo moni te̱ kã ehĩṅme̱i no̱, lo moni he eſie ntſẽṅ lo adšo̱to̱, lo moni egbē̱iaṅwui le̱ edſära.

english_verse: but they may not enter the sacred place or serve me at the altar. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: Ši muhō̱ le̱ṅ ke̱ke̱ ekabote, ni ekatši ebe̱ṅke̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱, edšake̱ kpa ye̱ ehe, hewo̱ le̱ ekabule minii kroṅkroṅi le̱; edšake̱ midši Iehowa, moni feo̱ame̱ kroṅkroṅ le̱.

english_verse: Moses told all of this to Aaron, his sons, and the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ni Mose wie nii ne̱ etšõ Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ ke̱ Israelbii le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: None of you may take part in the sacred meals while you have a skin disease or an infected penis, or after you have been near a dead body or have had a flow of semen,
translation_verse: Nū-fẽ-nū ní dše̱ Aaron sešibii le̱ ateṅ, ní yeo̱ kpiti lo ehe hoo̱ noko le̱, ekaye nii kroṅkroṅi le̱ eko ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní ehe aatše. Ni moni taä gbohĩĩ ahe noko ní he tšee he le̱, lo nū ní ehenu dšeo̱ emli,

english_verse: Only you priests and your families may eat the food offerings; these are too sacred for any of your servants.
translation_verse: Mokpōṅ ko mokpōṅ ko akaye nõ-kroṅkroṅ le̱ eko; oso̱fo ko we gbo̱ lo apāfonyo ko akaye nõkroṅkroṅ le̱ eko.

english_verse: However, any slave that you own, including those born into your household, may eat this food.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši oso̱fo ko ke̱ ešika he gbomo ko le̱, le̱ le̱ eye eko, ni mei ní afo̱-ame̱ ye̱ ewe le̱ hũ, ame̱ye eniyenii le̱ eko.

english_verse: If your daughter marries someone who isn't a priest, she can no longer have any of this food.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši oso̱fo ko biyō yagbã mokpõṅ le̱, ekaye nii kroṅkroṅi le̱ amli no̱wómo̱-afo̱le le̱ eko.

english_verse: But if she returns to your home, either widowed or divorced, and has no children, she may join in the meal. Only members of a priestly family can eat this food,
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši oso̱fo biyō le̱ tšṍ okũlafo lo aſiele̱, ni ebe̱ bi, ni ekũ ese̱ ke̱-ba etše̱ we le̱, tamo̱ bo̱ni eyo̱ ye̱ egbekẽbii-aši le̱, no le̱ eye etše̱ niyenii le̱ eko; ši mokpõṅ ko mokpõṅ ko akaye eko.

english_verse: and anyone else who accidentally does so, must pay for the food plus a fine of
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši moko lee be ní eyaye nõkroṅkroṅ le̱ eko le̱, eto oso̱fo le̱ nõkroṅkroṅ le̱ nãdšiaṅ, ni eṅõ *emlidšāi enumo̱ mli ekome eši no̱. *

english_verse: must have nothing wrong with them, or else I won't accept them. Bulls or rams or goats are the animals to be used for these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Nofẽno ní kpa ko yo̱ ehe le̱, nyeke̱-kabaä; edšake̱ nyeke̱ no esaṅ ehĩe.

english_verse: to tell Aaron and his sons and everyone else the rules for offering sacrifices. He said: The animals that are to be completely burned on the altar
translation_verse: Oke̱ Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ ke̱ Israelbii le̱ fẽ awie ni okē̱ame̱ ake̱: Mofẽmo ní dše̱ Israel we le̱ lo etoo̱ gbo̱ ye̱ Israel le̱ ní ke̱ nikēnii aabahã le̱, amešiwō le̱ nii lo nii ní ame̱hãa ye̱ tšuidšŭrõ nā, ni ame̱ke̱-bahãa Iehowa ní ake̱-šã šā̃-afo̱le le̱,

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, there must be nothing wrong with the animal. This is true, whether the sacrifice is part of a promise or something you do voluntarily.
translation_verse: Ni mofẽmo ní aaṅõ šidā-afo̱le ní dše̱ tšinai lo tōi ateṅ ebahã Iehowa le̱, šiwō no̱ eke̱-yeo dšio, tšuidšŭrõ nā ebahã dšio, eye emū, koni eke̱-sa ehĩe; kpa ko kpa ko akahĩ he.

english_verse: If one of your cattle or lambs has a leg that is longer or shorter than the others, you may offer it voluntarily, but not as part of a promise.
translation_verse: Ni tšina lo tō ní ehenõ ko fá tšṍ lo ſe̱o̱ ehe noko le̱, no le̱ tšuidšŭrõ nā ohã moṅ, ši šiwō nõ le̱ esaa hĩe.

english_verse: As long as you live in this land, don't offer an animal with injured testicles.
translation_verse: Ni noni adſăra lo ašimo̱ lo afãmo̱ lo aflo̱ egbē̱i le̱ hũ nyekaṅõ-hãa Iehowa, ni nyešikpoṅ le̱ no̱ hũ nyekafea nakai.

english_verse: And don't bring me animals you bought from a foreigner. I won't accept them, because they are no better than one that has something wrong with it.
translation_verse: Ni maṅse̱nyo ko tete nyekahea ene̱mei eko ye̱ edeṅ ní nyeke̱-fata nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ abolo le̱ he nyebahãa; edšake̱ ame̱he efite, ni kpa ye̱ ame̱he, ni nyeke̱ no esaṅ ehĩe.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose wie ni ekē̱:

english_verse: Newborn cattle, sheep, or goats must remain with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day, you may send them up in smoke to me, and I will accept the offering.
translation_verse: Ké̱ afo tšina lo tōgwanteṅ lo tōabotia le̱, eke̱ enye ahĩ ši gbĩĩ *kpawo, ši ke̱-dše̱ gbĩ kpānyo̱ le̱ no̱ ke̱-yaä le̱ esa noni ake̱-bašãa afo̱le ahãa Iehowa. *

english_verse: Don't sacrifice a newborn animal and its mother on the same day.
translation_verse: Ni nyekagbea tšina lo tō ke̱ ebi ſẽ gbĩ kome.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to give thanks to me, you must do it in a way that is acceptable.
translation_verse: Ni ké̱ nyemĩšã šidā-afo̱le nyeba Iehowa le̱, nyešãale̱ bo̱ni nyeke̱-asa ehĩe;

english_verse: Eat all of the meat that same day and don't save any for the next day. I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: aye *nakai gbĩ le̱ noṅṅ; nyekaſe̱a eko ní dše mītše̱re no̱; midši Iehowa. *

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings—I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni nyebua mikitãi le̱ ni nyeyea no̱; midši Iehowa.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work, but the seventh day of each week is holy because it belongs to me. No matter where you live, you must rest on the Sabbath and come together for worship. This law will never change. Passover and the Festival of Thin Bread (Numbers
translation_verse: Gbĩĩ ekpa ake̱-tšu nii, ši gbĩ ní dši gbĩ kpawo le̱ hedšō̱mo̱ kpō gbĩ ni, kpe kroṅkroṅ ni; nyekatšua nitšumo̱ ko nitšumo̱ ko, Iehowa hedšō̱mo̱gbĩ ni ye̱ nyešihĩle̱hei le̱ fè.

english_verse: No one is to work on that day—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness, when sacrifices will be offered to me, so that I will forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Nyekatšua nitšumo̱ ko nitšumo̱ ko ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱; edšake̱ kpãtãmo̱gbĩ ni, koni akpãtã ahãnye̱ ye̱ Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, hĩe.

english_verse: The Lord God said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose wie ni ekē̱:

english_verse: None of my people are ever to do any work on that day—not now or in the future. And I will wipe out those who do!
translation_verse: Nyekatšua nitšumo̱ ko nitšumo̱ ko. Nāno̱ akpo̱ dši no hã nyeyino̱i le̱ ye̱ nyešihĩle̱hei le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: Bring two loaves of bread to be lifted up in dedication to me. Each loaf is to be made with yeast and with two kilograms of the finest flour from the first part of your harvest.
translation_verse: Nyeke̱ fō̃-aboloi enyo̱ adše̱a nye-šihĩle̱hei le̱ abahãa; efa mlidšāi nyoṅma mli enyo̱ ṅmā̃ mã nyeṅõ-fea aboloi enyo̱ le̱ ní akē̱ mãša ašã ni ake̱-fe kleṅkleṅ-yibii-afo̱le ahà Iehowa.

english_verse: At this same time, the entire community of Israel must bring seven lambs that are a year old, a young bull, and two rams. These animals must have nothing wrong with them, and they must be offered as a sacrifice to please me. You must also offer the proper grain and wine sacrifices with each animal.
translation_verse: Ni nyeṅõa tōgwanteṅbii kpawo ni kpa ko be̱ ame̱he ní ame̱ye afifi nyefa-taä abolo le̱ he, ke̱ tšina oblanyo kome ke̱ tōagboi enyo̱; ene̱mei afe Iehowa šā̃-afo̱le ke̱ ehe niyenii-afo̱le ke̱dā̃-afo̱le le̱, afo̱le ní ake̱ la šãa ní dšeo̱ ṅma hãa Iehowa ne̱.

english_verse: The priest will lift up the rams together with the bread in dedication to me. These offerings are holy and are my gift to the priest.
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo le̱ aṅõ nii ne̱ ke̱ kleṅkleṅyibii abolo le̱ efe fō̃-afo̱le ye̱ Iehowa hĩe ke̱ tōgwanteṅbii enyo̱ le̱ fẽ; ame̱-tšṍmo̱ kroṅkroṅ ame̱hã Iehowa, ni aṅõ-hã oso̱fo le̱.

english_verse: This is a day of celebration and worship, a time of rest from your work. You and your descendants must obey this law.
translation_verse: Ni nyešie̱ ye̱ no gbĩ le̱ no̱ noṅṅ, ake̱ nyebakpe kpẽ kroṅkroṅ; nyekatšua nitšumo̱ ko nitšumo̱ ko ní wa. Nāno̱ akpo̱ dši no ye̱ nyešihĩle̱hei le̱ fẽ hã nyeyino̱i le̱.

english_verse: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. It is a solemn day of worship; everyone must go without eating to show sorrow for their sins, and sacrifices must be burned.
translation_verse: Asaṅ nyõṅ ní dši kpawo le̱ noṅṅ no̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ nyoṅma dši *kpãtãmo̱gbĩ le̱; nyekpea kpē kroṅkroṅ, ni nyewaä nyesusumai ayi, ni nyeke̱ afo̱le ní ake̱ la šãa abahãa Iehowa. *Yi.

english_verse: This is a time of complete rest just like the Sabbath, and everyone must go without eating from the evening of the ninth to the evening of the tenth. The Festival of Shelters (Numbers
translation_verse: Hedšō̱mo̱gbĩ wulu ni hãnye, ni nye-waä nyesusumai ayi ye̱ nyõṅ le̱ no̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ ne̱hũ le̱ gbe̱ke̱nāši; nyeyea nyehedšō̱mo̱gbĩ le̱ ke̱-dše̱ gbe̱ke̱ ke̱-yaši gbe̱ke̱ ekoṅ.

english_verse: Pick the best fruit from your trees and cut leafy branches to use during the time of this joyous celebration in my honor.
translation_verse: Ni kleṅkleṅ gbĩ le̱ ne̱ le̱ *nyeṅõa tšeiayibii fe̱fe̱dši ke̱ ble̱oi ke̱ tšei kusūi anidši ke̱ fā nā kpãi, ni nyenyã́a ye̱ Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, hĩe gbĩĩ kpawo. *Neh.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose wie ni ekē̱:

english_verse: No one is to do any work on the first day of the festival—it is a time when everyone must come together for worship.
translation_verse: Kleṅkleṅ gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ akpe kpẽ kroṅkroṅ; nyekatšua nitšumo̱ ko nitšumo̱ ko ní wa.

english_verse: For seven days, sacrifices must be offered on the altar. The eighth day is also to be a day of complete rest, as well as a time of offering sacrifices on the altar and of coming together for worship.
translation_verse: Gbĩĩ kpawo nyeke̱ afo̱le ní ake̱ la šãa abahã Iehowa; gbĩ ní dši *gbĩ kpānyo̱ le̱ no̱ le̱ nyekpea kpẽ kroṅkroṅ, ni nyeke̱ afo̱le ní ake̱ la šãa abahãa Iehowa; kpē wulu gbĩ ni; nyekatšua nitšumo̱ ko nitšumo̱ ko ní wa. *Ioh.

english_verse: I have chosen these festivals as times when my people must come together for worship and when animals, grain, and wine are to be offered on the proper days.
translation_verse: Ene̱mei dši Iehowa gbĩĩ dšudši, no no̱ ní nyešie̱ ake̱ akpe kpēi kroṅkroṅi le̱, koni ake̱ afo̱le ní ake̱ la šãa abahã Iehowa: šā̃-afo̱le ke̱ niyenii-afo̱le ke̱ gbē-afo̱le ke̱ dā̃-afo̱le, nofẽno ye̱ egbi no̱,

english_verse: These festivals must be celebrated in addition to the Sabbaths and the times when you offer special gifts or sacrifices to keep a promise or as a voluntary offering.
translation_verse: esŏro Iehowa hedšō̱mo̱gbĩĩ le̱, ni esŏro nyenihãmo̱nii le̱, ni esŏro nyešiwōi le̱ fẽ, ni esŏro nyetšuidšŭrõnãnii le̱ fẽ ní nyeṅõ-hãa Iehowa le̱.

english_verse: Remember to begin the Festival of Shelters on the fifteenth day of the seventh month after you have harvested your crops. Celebrate this festival for seven days in honor of me and don't do any work on the first day or on the day following the festival.
translation_verse: Asaṅ nyõṅ ní dši kpawo le̱ no̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ nyoṅma ke̱ enumo̱ le̱, beni nyebua šikpoṅ le̱ nibānii le̱ anā le̱, nyeyea Iehowa gbĩdšũrõ le̱ gbĩĩ kpawo; kleṅkleṅ gbĩĩ le̱ hedšō̱mo̱gbĩ ni.

english_verse: I command you and all of your descendants to celebrate this festival during the seventh month of each year.
translation_verse: Ni nyeke̱ gbĩĩ kpawo ayea gbĩdšŭrõ abãa Iehowa dā afi. Nāno̱ akpo̱ dši no hã nyeyino̱i le̱; nyõṅ ní dši kpawo le̱ no̱ le̱ nyeyea ne̱ke̱ gbĩdšŭrõ ne̱.

english_verse: For seven days every Israelite must live in a shelter,
translation_verse: Nyehĩa asesei amli gbĩĩ kpawo; Israelnyo-fẽ-Israelnyo ahĩ asesei amli.

english_verse: so future generations will know that I made their ancestors live in shelters when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Beni afe ní nyesešibii le̱ aná ale ake̱ asesei amli mihã Israelbii le̱ hĩ, beni midšieame̱ ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱; midši Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: This is how Moses instructed the people of Israel to celebrate the Lord's festivals.
translation_verse: Ni Mose dšadše Iehowa gbĩĩ dšudši le̱ ahe sãdši le̱ etšõ Israelbii le̱.

english_verse: a broken bone for a broken bone, an eye for an eye, or a tooth for a tooth.
translation_verse: pilamo̱ ye̱ pilamo̱ nãdšiaṅ, hĩṅme̱i ye̱ hĩṅme̱i nãdšiaṅ, nyãnyõṅ ye̱ nyãnyoṅ nãdšiaṅ; bo̱ni epila gbomo le̱ ehã le̱, nakai noṅṅ áfele̱.

english_verse: It's possible to pay the owner for an animal that has been killed, but death is the penalty for murder.
translation_verse: Moni gbe šĩa kolo le̱, eto nãdšiaṅ, ši moni gbe gbomo le̱, ágbele̱.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose wie ni ekē̱:

english_verse: Use your finest flour to bake twelve loaves of bread about two kilograms each,
translation_verse: Ni oṅõ ṅma mã ošã kāoi nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱; efa mlidšāi nyoṅma mli enyo̱ aṅõ-fe kāo kome.

english_verse: then take them into the sacred tent and lay them on the gold table in two rows of six loaves.
translation_verse: Ni otoame̱ klẽmpẽi enyo̱, ekpa ye̱ klẽmpẽ kome no̱ ni ekpa hũ ye̱ klẽmpẽ kome no̱, ye̱ okplõ ní he tše le̱ no̱ ye̱ Iehowa hĩe.

english_verse: Aaron must lay fresh loaves on the table each Sabbath, and priests in all generations must continue this practice as part of Israel's agreement with me.
translation_verse: Dā ke̱ še̱ hedšō̱mo̱gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ etoame̱ gbe̱dšiano̱ ye̱ Iehowa hĩe dāne̱; edši nāno̱ kpãṅmo̱ ní kã ši hã Israelbii le̱.

english_verse: This bread will always belong to Aaron and his family; it is very holy because it was offered to me, and it must be eaten in a holy place. Punishment for Cursing the Lord
translation_verse: Ni atšṍ Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ anõ, ni ame̱ye ye̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱; edšake̱ Iehowa afo̱lei ní ake̱ la šãa le̱ amli noni yo̱ kroṅkroṅ fè fẽ hãle̱ dši no; ni afe nāno̱ akpo̱.

english_verse: Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri from the tribe of Dan, had married an Egyptian, and they had a son. One day their son got into a fight with an Israelite man in camp and cursed the name of the Lord. So the young man was dragged off to Moses,
translation_verse: Ni Israelyō le̱ bi le̱ bo̱ *gbe̱i le̱ he musu, ni elomo̱. Ni ame̱ke̱le̱ ba Mose ṅõ. Ni enye le̱ gbe̱i dši Šelomit, Dibri biyō ní dše̱ Dan akutšo le̱ mli le̱. *K.

english_verse: Finally, the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose wie ni ekē̱:

english_verse: This man has cursed me! Take him outside the camp and tell the witnesses to lay their hands on his head. Then command the whole community of Israel to stone him to death.
translation_verse: Oke̱ moni lomo̱ le̱ adše kpo ke̱-ya nsra le̱ se̱, ni mei fẽ ní nu le̱ aṅõ ame̱-nidši aſie eyiteṅ, ni asafo le̱ fẽ atſiale̱ te̱i.

english_verse: And warn the others that everyone else who curses me will die in the same way, whether they are Israelites by birth or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Ni moni bo̱ö̱ *Iehowa gbe̱i le̱ he musu le̱, gbe ágbele̱; asafo le̱ fẽ átſiale te̱i, gbo̱ dšile̱ dsio, maṅnyo dšile̱ dšio, ké̱ ebo̱ gbe̱i le̱ he musu le̱, ágbele̱. *

english_verse: Death is also the penalty for murder,
translation_verse: Ni moni tſaä *gbomo nõ ní egboo̱ le̱, gbe ágbele̱. *

english_verse: but the killing of an animal that belongs to someone else requires only that the animal be replaced.
translation_verse: Ni moni tſaä šĩa kolo nõ ní egboo̱ le̱, eto nãdšiaṅ, kolo ye̱ kolo nãdšiaṅ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I demand equal justice both for you Israelites and for those foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Mla kome akã ši ahãnye, ahã gbo̱ ke̱ maṅnyo fẽ; edšake̱ midši Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱

english_verse: When Moses finished speaking, the people did what the Lord had told Moses, and they stoned to death the man who had cursed the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni Mose kē̱ Israelbii le̱; ni ame̱ke̱ moni lomo̱ le̱ dše kpo ke̱-te nsra le̱ se̱, ni *ame̱yatſiale̱ te̱i. Ni Israelbii le̱ fe take̱ boni Iehowa wo Mose kitã le̱. *

english_verse: So when you buy or sell farmland, the price is to be determined by the number of crops it can produce before the next Year of Celebration. Don't try to cheat.
translation_verse: Nyã́mo̱-afi le̱ se̱ afii ayikule̱ nā ohe nii ye̱ onanyo deṅ, ni nibānii afii ayikule̱ nā ehõ nii ehão.

english_verse: This is a year of complete celebration, so don't plant any seed or harvest what your fields or vineyards produce.
translation_verse: Ne̱ke̱ afi ní dši afi nyoṅmai-enumo̱ ne̱ atšṍ nyã́mo̱-afi ahãnye; nyekadũa nii ye̱ no̱, ni asaṅ nyekakpaä noni le̱dientše̱ eba le̱, ni nyekabuaä nyeweintšei ní akplo̱o̱ he le̱ no̱ yibii le̱ anā.

english_verse: However, you and your slaves and your hired workers, as well as any domestic or wild animals, may eat whatever grows on its own. The Year of Celebration The Lord said to his people:
translation_verse: ke̱ ošĩa koloi ke̱ koloi ní yo̱ ošikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱; emli nibānii le̱ fẽ atšṍ ame̱-niyenii.

english_verse: or uncle or cousin, or some other family member. In fact, if you ever get enough money, you may buy your own freedom
translation_verse: alo etše̱kwẽ alo etše̱kwẽbi akpõle̱, lo moko ní eſe̱ ye̱ eweku le̱ mli ní be̱ṅke̱le̱ akpõle̱, lo ké̱ ená noko le̱, le̱dientše̱ ekpõ ehe.

english_verse: This fiftieth year is sacred—it is a time of freedom and of celebration when everyone will receive back their original property, and slaves will return home to their families.
translation_verse: Ni afi ní dši nyoṅmai-enumo̱ le̱ nye-feale̱ kroṅkroṅ, ni nyešie̱a *heyeli ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ nyehãa eno̱bii fẽ; etšṍ nyã́mo̱-afi ehãnye, ni nyeteṅ mofẽmo akũ ese̱ ayaṅõ enii, ni nyeteṅ mofẽmo akũ ese̱ aya ewekumei ateṅ ekoṅ. *Ies.

english_verse: In this time of sacred celebration you may eat only what grows on its own.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nyã́mo̱-afi ni, efe kroṅkroṅ ehãnye; emli nibänii le̱ nyeyea ye̱ ṅmõ no̱.

english_verse: If it is a long time before the next Year of Celebration, the price will be higher, because what is really being sold are the crops that the land can produce.
translation_verse: Ké̱ afii le̱ fá le̱, oṅmẽ edšra le̱ no̱, ni ké̱ afii le̱ fáá le̱, otše edšra le̱ no̱; edšake̱ afii le̱ amli nibānii le̱ ayikule̱ ehoo ehõo̱ le̱.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, so obey me and don't cheat anyone.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyeteṅ moko akamõ enanyo, ši še o-Nyoṅmo̱ gbeyei; edša-ke̱ midši Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: If you obey my laws and teachings, you will live safely in the land and enjoy its abundant crops.
translation_verse: Ni šikpoṅ le̱ aaba edeṅ nibale̱, ni nyeaye nyetŏ̱ro̱, ni nyeahī no̱ ſeſēſe.

english_verse: Don't ever worry about what you will eat during the seventh year when you are forbidden to plant or harvest.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši nyekē̱ ake̱: Meni wo̱baye ye̱ afi ní dši kpawo le̱ mli? Na, wo̱dũũ nii ni asaṅ we̱buaa wonibānii anā le̱:

english_verse: No land may be permanently bought or sold. It all belongs to me—it isn't your land, and you only live there for a little while.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ šikpoṅ le̱, nyekahõa kwrakwra, edšake̱ minõ dši šikpoṅ le̱, edša-ke̱ *miwe gbe̱i ke̱ mišĩa gbomei dšinye. *Lal.

english_verse: When property is being sold, the original owner must be given the first chance to buy it.
translation_verse: Ni nyene̱yeli šikpoṅ le̱ fẽ no̱ le̱ nyehãa šikpoṅ kpõmo̱ hegbe̱.

english_verse: if that relative has the money. Later, if you can afford to buy it,
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši nū ko be̱ moko ní aayakpõ, ni ená edeṅ noko ni ena ake̱ aaše̱ kpõmo le̱,

english_verse: you must pay enough to make up for what the present owner will lose on it before the next Year of Celebration, when the property would become yours again.
translation_verse: no le̱ ebu afii ní ehõ le̱ nā, ni noni eſe̱ le̱ eto moni ehõ ehã le̱ nãdšiaṅ, ni ekũ ese̱ eyaṅõ enii le̱.

english_verse: But if you don't have the money to pay the present owner a fair price, you will have to wait until the Year of Celebration, when the property will once again become yours.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši le̱dientše̱ enyẽẽ eyakpõ le̱, no le̱ noni ehõ le̱ ahĩ moni he le̱ deṅ ke̱-yaši nyã́mo̱-afi le̱, ni nyã́mo̱-afi le̱ mli le̱ mo le̱ aṅmē̃ he, ni ekũ ese̱ eyaṅõ enii ekoṅ.

english_verse: If you sell a house in a walled city, you have only one year in which to buy it back.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši moko hõ ešĩa ye̱ maṅ ní atſa gbogbo awo he mli le̱, ahãle̱ kpõmo̱ hegbe̱ afii nãkplo̱ ke̱-dše̱ ehõmo̱ be le̱ mli, gbĩĩ ní eyo̱ kpõmo hegbe̱ dši no.

english_verse: If you don't buy it back before that year is up, it becomes the permanent property of the one who bought it, and it will not be returned to you in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši akpõõ ye̱ afi nākplo̱ le̱ nāgbē le̱, no le̱ šĩa ní yo̱ maṅ ní atſa gbogbo awo he le̱ mli le̱ amã ši ahā moni he le̱ kwrakwra hã esešibii fe; ekaṅmē̃ he ye̱ nyã́mo̱afi le̱ṅ.

english_verse: But a house out in a village may be bought back at any time just like a field. And it must be returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Ši tšũi ní yo̱ akrowai ní gbogbo be̱ he le̱ amli le̱, abu aši šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ṅmõdši ano̱; ahãle̱ kpõmo̱ hegbe̱, ni nyã́mo-afi le̱ mli le̱ aṅmẽ he.

english_verse: If any Levites own houses inside a walled city, they will always have the right to buy them back.
translation_verse: Ni Levibii *amãdši ní dši ame̱no̱yeli mãdši le̱ amli šĩai le̱, nomei le̱, Levibii le̱ ye̱ hegbe̱ ake̱ ame̱kpõo̱ befẽbe. *

english_verse: And any houses that they do not buy back will be returned to them in the Year of Celebration, because these homes are their permanent property among the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši Levibii le̱ ateṅ moko kpõõ ene̱yelinii le̱, no le̱ aṅmē̃ šĩa ní ahõ ní yo̱ emaṅ le̱ mli le̱ he ahã le̱ ye̱ nyã́mo̱-afi le̱ṅ; edšake̱ Levibii le̱ amãdšiaṅ šĩai le̱ dši ame̱no̱yelinii ye̱ Israelbii le̱ ateṅ.

english_verse: No pastureland owned by the Levi tribe can ever be sold; it is their permanent possession. Help for the Poor The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ši ame̱mãdši le̱ ahe šikpõdši le̱ akahõ; edšake̱ ame̱no̱yelinii ní kã ši dā ni.

english_verse: If any of your people become poor and unable to support themselves, you must help them, just as you are supposed to help foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši efĩ onyemi ye̱ omase̱i, ni ké̱ emõ ní ekpee le̱, no le̱ mõ emli, ní ehĩ oṅõ ake̱ owe gbo̱ ke̱ ošĩa gbomo.

english_verse: Don't take advantage of them by charging any kind of interest or selling them food for profit. Instead, honor me by letting them stay where they now live.
translation_verse: Ošika ní ofale̱ le̱ kāhele̱ hekpa, ni oniyenii ní ohãale̱ le̱ hũ kābu eko oſie no̱.

english_verse: Remember—I am the Lord your God! I rescued you from Egypt and gave you the land of Canaan, so that I would be your God.
translation_verse: Midši Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, moni dšienye ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, koni maṅõ Kanaan šikpoṅ le̱ mahãnye, ni matšṍ nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Suppose some of your people become so poor that they have to sell themselves and become your slaves.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši efĩ onyemi ní yo̱ omase̱i, ni *ehõ ehe ehão le, kāyele̱ nyṍṅ; *

english_verse: Then you must treat them as servants, rather than as slaves. And in the Year of Celebration they are to be set free,
translation_verse: moṅ etšṍ tamo̱ apāfonyo ke̱ šĩa gbomo ye̱ oṅõ; ni esúmo̱o ke̱-yaši nyã́mo̱-afi le̱,

english_verse: so they and their children may return home to their families and property.
translation_verse: ni edše oṅõ, le̱ ke̱ ebii fẽ, ni ekũ ese̱ ke̱-ya ewekumei ateṅ ní eyaṅõ etše̱mei ano̱yelinii le̱ ekoṅ.

english_verse: I brought them out of Egypt to be my servants, not to be sold as slaves.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ame̱dši mitšũdši ní midšieame̱ ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱; akahõame̱ tamo̱ ahõo̱ nyõdši.

english_verse: or from the foreigners who live in your own country, and make them your property.
translation_verse: ni gbo̱i ní hĩo̱ nyeṅõ le̱ abii ke̱ ame̱wekumei ní ke̱nye yo̱ ní afo̱ ye̱ nyešikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ ateṅ meikomei nyehea, ni ame̱tšṍmo̱ nyenii,

english_verse: You can own them, and even leave them to your children when you die, but do not make slaves of your own people or be cruel to them.
translation_verse: ni nyešĩame̱ nyehã nyebii ake̱ amegboši gbomei, ni ame̱tšṍmo̱ nyenyṍdši ke̱-ya nāno̱; ši nyenyemimei Israelbii le̱, moko akaye moko no̱ ke̱ yiwale̱.

english_verse: Even if some of you Israelites become so much in debt that you must sell yourselves to foreigners in your country,
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši gbo̱ ko lo mokpoṅ ko ni ke̱o yo̱ le̱ ná nii, ni efĩ onyemi ní ke̱le̱ yo̱ le̱, ní ehõ ehe ehã gbo̱ ní ke̱o yo̱ lo gbo̱ le̱ ſĩei ko ní dše̱ eweku le̱ mli le̱,

english_verse: you still have the right to be set free by a relative, such as a brother
translation_verse: no le̱, beni ehõ ehe se̱ le̱, ahãle̱ kpõmo̱ hegbe̱; enyemimei le̱ eko akpõle̱,

english_verse: by paying your owner for the number of years you would still be a slave before the next Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Ni eke̱ moni hele̱ le̱ abu akontā ke̱-dše̱ afi ní ehõ ehe ehãle̱ le̱ no̱ ke̱-yaši nyã́mo̱-afi le̱ no̱; ni eyinii le̱ abu ye̱ afii le̱ ayikule̱ nā, eke̱le̱ šihĩle̱ le̱ abu tamo̱ apāfonyo gbĩĩ.

english_verse: The longer the time until then, the more you will have to pay.
translation_verse: Ni ké̱ eſe̱ afii fio ke̱ke̱ ní še̱o̱ nyã́mo̱-afi le̱, abu ahãle̱; ehã kpõmo̱nii le̱ ye̱ afii le̱ anā pe̱.

english_verse: And even while you are the slaves of foreigners in your own country, your people must make sure that you are not mistreated.
translation_verse: Eke̱le̱ šihĩle̱ le̱ abule̱ tamo̱ apāfonyo šihĩle̱ afi-fẽ-afi, ekaye eno̱ *ke̱ yiwale̱ ye̱ ohĩe. *K.

english_verse: If you cannot gain your freedom in any of these ways, both you and your children will still be set free in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱-dši akpõõle̱ ye̱ ne̱ke̱ gbè̱i ne̱ ano̱ le̱, no le̱ eṅõ ehe eye ye̱ nyã́me̱-afi le̱ṅ, le̱ ke̱ ebii fẽ.

english_verse: People of Israel, I am the Lord your God, and I brought you out of Egypt to be my own servants.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mitšũdši dši Israelbii le̱; ame̱dši mitšũdši ní midšie ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱; midši Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: You will chase and destroy your enemies,
translation_verse: Ni nyeawo nyehenye̱lo̱i le̱ afoi, ni ame̱anyõnyõi ye̱ nyehĩe ye̱ klante nā.

english_verse: Your barns will overflow with grain each year.
translation_verse: Ni nyeaye kukudabi āhũ, ni nyeadšie emomo le̱ nyeſie ye̱ ehē le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: I will punish you terribly, and you will be ruined. You will be struck with incurable diseases and with fever that leads to blindness and depression. Your enemies will eat the crops you plant,
translation_verse: mi hũ noni mafenye ne̱: mike̱ tšuifā̃ sane ke̱ hela ní wa ke̱ fulu aabaſie nyeno̱, ní aahã nyehĩṅme̱ii afite, ni nyetšui asu; ni nyeadũ nyedũmo̱nii yakatſā, edšake̱ nyehenye̱lo̱i moṅ baye.

english_verse: until your pride is completely crushed. I will hold back the rain, so the sky above you will be like iron, and the ground beneath your feet will be like copper.
translation_verse: ni makũme̱ nyehewō ke̱ nyekue̱ṅwale̱ le̱, ni mahã *nyeṅwei le̱ atšṍ tamo̱ dade, ni nyešikpoṅ le̱ hũ aatšṍ tamo̱ akō̱ble. *

english_verse: Then if you don't stop rebelling,
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši no hũ nyeboṅmi toi, ni nyeadše mihe tše̱i lolo le̱,

english_verse: In fact, you will be so desperate for food that you will eat your own children.
translation_verse: Ni nyeaye nyebihĩĩ le̱ alō, ni nyebiyei le̱ alō hũ nyeaye.

english_verse: I'll wipe out your towns and your places of worship and will no longer be pleased with the smell of your sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ni mafe nyemãdši le̱ amaṅfõi, ni makpãtã nyehei kroṅkroṅi le̱ ahĩe, ni mihereṅ nyetšofã-ke̱-ṅma le̱ ṅmadšē le̱.

english_verse: Your land will become so desolate that even your enemies who settle there will be shocked when they see it.
translation_verse: Ni midientše̱ po makpãtã šikpoṅ le̱ hīe, bo̱ni nyehenye̱lo̱i ni aahĩ no̱ le̱ tete ahĩe aafeame̱ yā.

english_verse: While you are prisoners in foreign lands, your own land will enjoy years of rest and refreshment, as it should have done each seventh year when you lived there.
translation_verse: Gbĩĩabo̱ fẽ ní ekã ši ole̱ṅle̱ le̱ ẽdšō̱ ehe, gbĩĩabo̱ ní edšō̱ō̱ ehe ye̱ nyehedšō̱mo̱bei le̱ amli beni nyeyo̱ no̱ le̱.

english_verse: In the land of your enemies, you will tremble at the rustle of a leaf, as though it were a sword. And you will become so weak that you will stumble and fall over each other, even when no one is chasing you.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱agbēgbē ši, moko kã moko no̱, take̱ bo̱ni agbēo̱ ši ye̱ klante nā, tše̱ foiwolo̱ ko be̱; ni nyenyẽṅ nyehenye̱lo̱i ahĩe nyedamo̱.

english_verse: Many of you will die in foreign lands,
translation_verse: Ni nyehĩe aakpãtã ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ, ni nyehenye̱loi le̱ ašikpoṅ le̱ aayenye.

english_verse: and others of you will waste away in sorrow as the result of your sins and the sins of your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ni mei ní aaſe̱ ye̱ nyeteṅ le̱ aatărã lō ye̱ ame̱nišaianii le̱ ahewo ye̱ nyehenye̱lo̱i le̱ ašikpõdši le̱ ano̱, ni asaṅ ame̱atărã lō ye̱ ametšemei le̱ anišaianii le̱ ahewo hũ tamo̱ ame̱ noṅṅ.

english_verse: I'll keep the promise I made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will bless your land
translation_verse: no le̱ *makai mike̱ Iakob kpãṅmo̱ le̱, ni mike̱ Isak kpãṅmo̱ le̱ hũ ke̱ mike̱ Abraham kpãṅmo̱ le̱ hũ makai, ni makai šikpoṅ le̱. *

english_verse: and let it rest during the time that you are in a foreign country, paying for your rebellion against me and my laws.
translation_verse: Ši šikpoṅ le̱ dša ame̱šĩ, ní eye ehedšō̱mo̱bei le̱, be mli ní ekã ši ole̱ṅle̱ le̱; ni ame̱ hũ *ame̱kplẽ ame̱nifodšianii le̱ ahe nyõmo̱wo le̱, edšake̱ ame̱kwa mimlai le, ni mikpo̱i le hũ ame̱susuma le̱ enyãṅe. *K.

english_verse: No matter what you have done, I am still the Lord your God, and I will never completely reject you or become absolutely disgusted with you there in the land of your enemies.
translation_verse: Ni kẽle̱, ké̱ ame̱ye̱ ame̱henye̱lo̱i le̱ ašikpoṅ le̱ no̱ tete dšiṅṅ, mikwaṅame̱, ni asaṅ minyãṅeṅame̱, bo̱ni makpãtã amehĩe kwrā, koni makũ mike̱ame̱ teṅ kpãṅmo̱ le̱ mli; edšake̱ midši Iehowa, ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: While nations watched, I rescued your ancestors from Egypt so that I would be their God. Yes, I am your Lord, and I will never forget our agreement.
translation_verse: Ni amehewo̱ le̱ makai mi ke̱ *ame̱tše̱mei le̱ akpãṅmo̱ le̱, mei ní midšie †ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ahĩe le̱, koni matšṍ ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, midši Iehowa. *

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws and teachings for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ene̱mei dši akpo̱i le̱ ke̱ gbe̱nānii le̱ ke̱ mlai le̱ ní Iehowa tšṍ Mose nine no eṅõ-to eke̱ Israelbii le̱ ateṅ ye̱ Sinai goṅ le̱ no̱ le̱.

english_verse: you may do so by paying the following amounts, weighed according to the official standards:
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši moko ní eye afii nyoṅmai-ekpa lo nõ le̱, ké̱ nū ni le̱, wo edšra šekeli nyoṅma ke̱ enumo̱, ši yō le̱, šekeli nyoṅma.

english_verse: Ten percent of everything you harvest is holy and belongs to me, whether it grows in your fields or on your fruit trees.
translation_verse: Ni šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ nibii amlidšāi nyoṅma mli ekome le̱, dũmo̱nii dsio, tšei ayibii dšio, Iehowa nõ ni; efe kroṅkroṅ ehã Iehowa.

english_verse: If you have promised to give someone to me and can't afford to pay the full amount for that person's release, you will be taken to a priest, and he will decide how much you can afford.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ edši ohĩafo ní enyẽṅ bo̱ni owo edšra le̱ ehã le̱, no le̱ ake̱le̱ ayadamo̱ oso̱fo le̱ hĩe, ni oso̱fo le̱ awo edšra; bo̱ni moni ewo ši le̱ aana le̱, nakai oso̱fo le̱ awo edšra.

english_verse: Donkeys are unfit for sacrifice, so if you promise me a donkey, you must bring it to the priest,
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši koloi ní he tšee ní ake̱-šãã afo̱le ahãã Iehowa le̱ eko ni le̱, no le̱ ake̱ kolo le̱ ayadamo̱ oso̱fo le̱ hĩe,

english_verse: If this promise is made in the Year of Celebration, the land will be valued at the full price.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši nyã́mo̱-afi le̱ no̱ edše̱ edšō̱ ešikpoṅ le̱ no̱ eke le̱, edamo̱ odšra ní oowole̱ no̱.

english_verse: If you decide to buy back the land, you must pay the price plus an additional
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši moni dšō̱ ešikpoṅ le̱ no̱ eke le̱ mīsumo̱ ake̱ ekpõ le̱, no le̱ eṅõ šika boni owo edšra le̱ mlidšāi enumo̱ mli ekome eſie no̱, ni etšṍ enõ ekoṅ.

english_verse: If you promise me a field that you have bought,
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši edšō̱ šikpoṅ ní he ehe, ši dšee egboši-šikpoṅ le̱ eko no̱ eke Iehowa le̱,

english_verse: its value will be decided by a priest, according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration, and the money you pay will be mine.
translation_verse: no le̱ oso̱fo le̱ abu edšra le̱ nā ahãle̱ ke̱-yaši nyã́mo̱-afi le̱ no̱, ni ehã edšra le̱ nā šika le̱ ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ noṅṅ; ni afele̱ kroṅkroṅ ahã Iehowa.

english_verse: However, on the next Year of Celebration, the land will go back to the family of its original owner.
translation_verse: *Nyã́mo̱-afi le̱ no̱ le̱ šikpoṅ le̱ akũ se̱ atšṍ moni ahe ye̱ edeṅ, ni šikpoṅ le̱ dši egboši-šikpoṅ le̱ nõ ekoṅ. *

english_verse: Every price will be set by the official standards. Various Offerings The Lord said:
translation_verse: Dšra-ſẽ-dšra ní oowo le̱, wo ye̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱ šekel le̱ nā; gerai nyoṅmai-enyo̱ dši šekel kome.

english_verse: Anything that you completely dedicate to me must be completely destroyed. It cannot be bought back or sold. Every person, animal, and piece of property that you dedicate completely is only for me.
translation_verse: Asaṅ nofẽno ní moko aadšō̱ no̱ ake Iehowa ye̱ nii fẽ ní eyo̱ le̱ mli le̱, gbomo dšio, koloi dšio, eno̱yeli šikpoṅ dšio, akahõ, ni akakpõ hũ; nofẽno ní adšō̱ no̱ ake̱ le̱, edši nokroṅkroṅ fè fẽ hã Iehowa.

english_verse: In fact, any humans who have been promised to me in this way must be put to death.
translation_verse: *Gbomo-fẽ-gbomo ní adšō̱ eno̱ ake le̱, akakpõle̱; gbe ágbele̱. *

english_verse: If you want to buy back this part of your harvest, you may do so by paying what it is worth plus an additional
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši moko mīsumo̱ ake̱ ekpõ enibii amlidšāi nyoṅma mli ekome le̱ eko le̱, eṅõ emlidšāi enumo̱ mli ekome eṅmẽ no̱.

english_verse: When you count your flocks and herds, one out of ten of every newborn animal is holy and belongs to me,
translation_verse: Ni tšinai ke̱ tōi amlidšāi nyoṅma mli ekome le̱, nii fẽ ni tšṍo̱ tōkwe̱lo̱tšo le̱ šiši le̱, ame̱mlidšāi nyoṅma mli ekome le̱, afe kroṅkroṅ ahã Iehowa.

english_verse: no matter how good or bad it is. If you substitute one animal for another, both of them become holy, and neither can be bought back.
translation_verse: Akakpa mli ekpakpa ke̱ efõṅ, ni akatšake eko hũ; ni ké̱ moko aatšake eko kẽ le̱, bĕle̱ no ke̱ noni aṅõ-tšake le̱ fẽ atšo kroṅkroṅ ahã Iehowa; akakpõ.

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ene̱mei dši kitai ní Iehowa wo Mose ye̱ Sinai goṅ le̱ no̱ ni eke̱-yahã Israelbii le̱.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with these twelve tribal leaders,
translation_verse: Ni Mose ke̱ Aaron ṅõ ne̱ke̱ hĩĩ ne̱ ní awo ame̱gbe̱ii atã le̱, ame̱fata amehe,

english_verse: called together the people that same day. They were counted according to their clans and families. Then Moses and the others listed the names of the men twenty years and older,
translation_verse: ni ame̱bua asafo mū le̱ fẽ nā ke̱-kpe ye̱ nyõṅ ní dši enyo̱ le̱ no̱ kleṅkleṅ gbĩ le̱ no̱, ní ame̱tsõ ame̱ wekukpã ye̱ ame̱wekui le̱ ke̱ ame̱tše̱mei awei le̱ anā, ye̱ ame̱gbe̱i ayikule̱ nā ekomekome, ke̱-dše̱ mei ní eye afii nyoṅmai-enyo̱ no̱ ke̱-yaä ne̱,

english_verse: The people of Israel did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ni boni Iehowa wo Mose kitã le̱, nakai pe̱pē̱pe̱ Israelbii le̱ fe.

english_verse: But the Levites will camp around the sacred tent to make sure that no one goes near it and makes me furious with the Israelites.
translation_verse: Ši Levibii le̱ abo̱ nsra ye̱ odase šihĩle̱he le̱ hewo ke̱-kpe, ní akagri awo Israelbii asafo le̱; nohewo̱ le̱ Levibii le̱ abu odase šihĩle̱he le̱ he.

english_verse: But those from the Levi tribe were not included
translation_verse: Ši Levibii le̱ ye̱ ame̱tše̱mei akutšo le̱ nā le̱, akaneeame̱ ašii no̱.

english_verse: because the Lord had said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose wie ni ekē̱:

english_verse: When you count the Israelites, do not include those from the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: *Levi akutšo le̱ ke̱ke̱ okakane, ni asaṅ ame̱yikule̱ hũ okabu oši Israelbii le̱ ano̱; *

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites will camp in their own groups and under their own banners.
translation_verse: Ni Israelbii le̱ ateṅ mofẽmo aši ebū ye̱ le̱dientše̱ ensra mli ye̱ le̱dientše̱ eflaṅā šiši ye̱ ame̱safoi anā.

english_verse: Judah and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the east side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The
translation_verse: ni eta le̱ ke̱ ame̱mei ni akane le̱ anā dši mei akpei-nyoṅmai-kpawo-ke̱-edſe̱ ke̱ ohai-ekpa.

english_verse: On one side of Judah will be the tribe of Issachar, with Nethanel son of Zuar as the leader of its
translation_verse: ni eta le̱ ke̱ emei ní akane le̱ anā dši mei akpei-nyoṅmai-enumo̱-ke̱-edſe̱ ke̱ ohai-edſe̱.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Zebulun, with Eliab son of Helon as the leader of its
translation_verse: ni eta le̱ ke̱ emei ní akane le̱ anā dši mei akpei-nyoṅmai-enumo̱-ke̱-kpawo ke̱ ohai-edſe̱.

english_verse: Reuben and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the south side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The
translation_verse: ni eta le̱ ke̱ emei ni akane le̱ anā dši mei akpei-nyoṅmai-edſe̱-ke̱-ekpa ke̱ ohai-enumo̱.

english_verse: On one side of Reuben will be the tribe of Simeon, with Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai as the leader of its
translation_verse: ni eta le̱ ke̱ ame̱mei ní akane le̱ anā dši mei akpei-nyoṅmai-enumo̱-ke̱-ne̱hũ ke̱ ohai-etẽ.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Gad, with Eliasaph son of Deuel as the leader of its
translation_verse: ni eta le̱ ke̱ ame̱mei ní akane le̱ anā dši mei akpei-nyoṅmai-edſe̱-ke̱-enumo̱ ke̱ ohai-ekpa ke̱ nyoṅmai-enumo̱.

english_verse: Marching behind Reuben will be the Levites, arranged in groups, just as they are camped. They will carry the sacred tent and their own banners.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni kpē-bū le̱ afã ke̱ Levibii le̱ ansra le̱ ye̱ nsrai le̱ ateṅ. Boni ame̱bo̱ nsra le̱, nakai noṅṅ ame̱fã, mofẽmo ye̱ egbe̱nā ye̱ ame̱flaṅāi le̱ anā.

english_verse: Ephraim and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the west side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The
translation_verse: ni eta le̱ ke̱ ame̱mei ní akane le̱ anā dši mei akpei-nyoṅmai-edſe̱ ke̱ ohai-enumo̱.

english_verse: On one side of Ephraim will be the tribe of Manasseh, with Gamaliel son of Pedahzur as the leader of its
translation_verse: ni eta le̱ ke̱ ame̱mei ní akane le̱ anā dši mei akpei-nyoṅmai-etẽ-ke̱-enyo̱ ke̱ ohai-enyo̱.

english_verse: So all the Israelites in the camp were counted according to their ancestral families. The troops were arranged by divisions and totaled
translation_verse: Mene̱mei dši Israelbii ní akane ye̱ ame̱tše̱mei awei le̱ anä: mei fẽ ní akane ye̱ nsrai le̱ amli ye̱ ame̱tai le̱ anā le̱ anā šio̱ *mei akpei-ohai-ekpa-ke̱-etẽ ke̱ ohai-enumo̱ ke̱ nyoṅmai-enumo̱. *

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Benjamin, with Abidan son of Gideoni as the leader of its
translation_verse: ni eta le̱ ke̱ ame̱mei ní akane le̱ anā dši mei akpei-nyoṅmai-etẽ-ke̱-enumo̱ ke̱ ohai-edſe̱.

english_verse: Dan and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the north side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The
translation_verse: ni eta le̱ ke̱ ame̱mei ní akane le̱ anā dši mei akpei-nyoṅmai-ekpa-ke̱-enyo̱ ke̱ ohai-kpawo.

english_verse: On one side of Dan will be the tribe of Asher, with Pagiel son of Ochran as the leader of its
translation_verse: ni eta le̱ ke̱ ame̱mei ní akane le̱ anā dši mei akpei-nyoṅmai-edſe̱-ke̱-ekome ke̱ ohai-enumo̱.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Naphtali with Ahira son of Enan as the leader of its
translation_verse: ni eta le̱ ke̱ ame̱mei ní akane le̱ anā dši mei akpei-nyoṅmai-enumo̱-ke̱-etẽ ke̱ ohai-edſe̱.

english_verse: The only Israelites not included were the Levites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Ši Levibii le̱, akaneeame̱ ašii Israelbii le̱ ano̱, *take̱ bo̱ni Iehowa wo Mose kitã le̱. *

english_verse: Israel did everything the Lord had told Moses. They arranged their camp according to clans and families, with each tribe under its own banner. And that was the order by which they marched into battle.
translation_verse: Ni Israelbii le̱ fe nibii fẽ nī Iehowa wo Mose he kitã le̱: nakai ame̱bo̱o̱ nsra ye̱ ame̱flaṅāi le̱ ašiši, ni nakai ame̱fãa hũ, mofẽmo ye̱ ewekui le̱ ke̱ etše̱mei awe le̱ nā. K.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose wie ni ekē̱:

english_verse: In the Sinai Desert the Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose wie ye̱ Sinai ṅã le̱ no̱ ake̱:

english_verse: “Now I want you to count the men and boys in the Levi tribe by families and by clans. Include every one at least a month old.”
translation_verse: Kanemo̱ Levi bihĩĩ le̱ ye̱ ame̱tše̱mei awei le̱ ke̱ ame̱wekui le̱ anā; nū-fẽ-nū ní eye nyõṅ kome lo nõ le̱, kanemo̱le̱.

english_verse: So Moses obeyed and counted them.
translation_verse: Ni Mose kaneame̱ ye̱ Iehowa wiemo̱ le̱ nā, boni afã́le̱ le̱.

english_verse: Levi's three sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, had become the heads of their own clans.
translation_verse: Ni mene̱mei dši Levi bihĩĩ le̱ ye̱ ame̱gbe̱ii anā: Geršon ke̱ Kahat ke̱ Merari.

english_verse: Kohath's sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Ni Kahat bihĩĩ ye̱ ame̱wekui le̱ anā ne̱: Amram ke̱ Izehar ke̱ Hebron ke̱ Uziel.

english_verse: And Merari's sons were Mahli and Mushi. These were the sons and grandsons of Levi, and they had become the leaders of the Levite clans.
translation_verse: Ni Merari bihĩĩ ye̱ ame̱wekui le̱ anā ne̱: Maheli ke̱ Muši. Levibii le̱ awekui ye̱ ame̱tše̱mei awei le̱ anā ne̱.

english_verse: The two Gershon clans were the Libnites and Shimeites,
translation_verse: Geršon nõ dši Libni weku le̱ ke̱ Šimei weku le̱; mene̱mei dši Geršonbii awekui le̱.

english_verse: The Gershonites, under the leadership of Eliasaph son of Lael, were to camp on the west side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ni Geršonbii le̱ atše̱ we le̱ onukpa dši Eliasaf, Lael bi le̱.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the tent itself, along with its outer covering, the curtain for the entrance,
translation_verse: Ni kpē-bū le̱ he nibii ni atu awo Geršon bii le̱ adeṅ ne̱: Šihĩle̱he le̱, ke̱ bū le̱, ke̱ eno̱hãnō le̱, ke̱ kpē-bū šĩnā le̱ nā mama le̱,

english_verse: the curtains hanging inside the courtyard around the tent, as well as the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard and its altar. The Gershonites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: ke̱ kpo le̱ he muhō̱i le̱, ke̱ kpo le̱ ní bo̱le šihĩle̱he le̱ ke̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ ke̱-kpe le̱ nā mama le̱, ke̱ ehe taṅkpēi ní ake̱-tšuo̱ ehe nii le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: The four Kohath clans were the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites, and the Uzzielites,
translation_verse: Kahat no dši Amrambii aweku le̱ ke̱ Izeharbii aweku le̱ ke̱ Hebronbii aweku le̱ ke̱ Uzielbii aweku le̱; mene̱mei dši Kahatbii awekui le̱.

english_verse: The Kohathites, under the leadership of Elizaphan son of Uzziel, were to camp on the south side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ni Kahatbii awekui le̱ atše̱ we le̱ onukpa dši Elizafan, Uziel bi le̱.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the sacred chest, the table for the sacred bread, the lampstand, the altars, the objects used for worship, and the curtain in front of the most holy place. The Kohathites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: Ni nii ní atu awo *ame̱deṅ ne̱: Adeka le̱, ke̱ okplõ le̱, ke̱ kanetšo le̱, ke̱ šãlate̱i le̱, ke̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱ nibii fẽ ni ame̱ke̱-súmoo̱ le̱, ke̱ mama le̱, ke̱ ehe nitšunio̱ le̱ fẽ. *

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron was the head of the Levite leaders, and he made sure that the work at the sacred tent was done.
translation_verse: Ni Levibii le̱ asafoiatše̱mei le̱ anukpa dši Eleazar, Aaron bi ni dši oso̱fo le̱, ni le̱ ekwe̱o̱ mei ní tšuo̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱ he nii le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: The two Merari clans were the Mahlites and the Mushites,
translation_verse: Merari nõ dši Maheli weku le̱ ke̱ Muši weku le̱; mene̱mei dši Merari wekui le̱.

english_verse: The Merarites, under the leadership of Zuriel son of Abihail, were to camp on the north side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ni Merari wekui le̱ atše̱ we le̱ onukpa dši Zuriel, Abihail bi le̱. Šihĩle̱he le̱ mase̱i ame̱bo̱ nsra ye̱, ye̱ kōyigbe̱.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and his sons were to camp in front of the sacred tent, on the east side, and to make sure that the Israelites worshiped in the proper way. Anyone else who tried to do the work of Moses and Aaron was to be put to death.
translation_verse: Ši mei ní abo̱ nsra ye̱ šihĩle̱he le̱ hĩe ye̱ bokãgbe̱, ye̱ kpē-bū le̱ hĩe dši Mose ke̱ Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱, ame̱dši mei ní buo̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱ he ame̱hãa Israelbii le̱; ni *gbo̱ ní aabe̱ṅke̱ le̱, ágbele̱. *K.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Make a list and count the first-born sons at least one month old in each of the Israelite families.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱ Mose ake: Kanemo̱ Israelbii le̱ akromo̱bihĩĩ le̱ fẽ ke̱-dše̱ mei ní eye nyõṅ kome no̱ ke̱-yaä le̱, ni obu ame̱gbe̱ii le̱ anā;

english_verse: They belong to me, but I will accept the Levites as substitutes for them, and I will accept the Levites' livestock as substitutes for the Israelites' first-born livestock.”
translation_verse: ni oṅõ Levibii le̱ ohãmi, Iehowa, ye̱ Israelbii le̱ akromo̱bii le̱ fẽ nãdšiaṅ, ke̱ Levibii le̱ asĩa koloi le̱ ye̱ Israelbii le̱ ašĩa koloi le̱ akromo̱bii le̱ fẽ nãdšiaṅ!

english_verse: Moses obeyed the Lord and counted the first-born sons;
translation_verse: Ni Mose kane, bo̱ni Iehowa wole̱ kitã le̱, ni ekane Israelbii le̱ akromo̱bihĩĩ le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said,
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose wie ni ekē̱:

english_verse: “The Levites will belong to me and will take the place of the first-born sons; their livestock will take the place of the Israelites' first-born livestock.
translation_verse: Ṅõ Levibii le̱ ye̱ Israelbii le̱ akromo̱bii le̱ ſẽ nãdšiaṅ, ke̱ Levibii le̱ ašĩa koloi le̱ ye̱ ame̱šĩa koloi le̱ anadšiaṅ, ni Levibii le̱ atšṍ minõ; midši Iehowa. K.

english_verse: But since there are more first-born sons than Levites, the extra
translation_verse: Ši Israelbii akromo̱bihĩĩ ohai-enyo̱ ke̱ nyoṅmai-kpawo ke̱ etẽ ní dẽṅ Levibii le̱ ayibo̱ le̱ no̱ le̱, akpõame̱; K.

english_verse: For each one, you are to collect five pieces of silver, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: hemo̱ šekeli enumo̱ ye̱ mokome yi; hekroṅkroṅ le̱ šekel le̱ nā ohe ye̱; gerai nyoṅmai-enyo̱ dši šekel kome.

english_verse: This money must then be given to Aaron and his sons.”
translation_verse: Ni oṅõ šika ní ake̱-bakpõ mei ní dẽṅ no̱ le̱ ohã Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱.

english_verse: Then he gave it to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: ni Mose ṅõ kpõmo̱ šika le̱ ehã Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ ye̱ Iehowa wiemo̱ le̱ nā, tamo̱ bo̱ni Iehowa wo Mose kitā le̱.

english_verse: The Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects used in worship at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ene̱ dši Kahat bii le̱ anitšumo̱ ní ame̱batšu ye̱ kpē-bū le̱ he, nii kroṅkroṅi ní fè fẽ le ahe.

english_verse: When the Israelites are ready to move their camp, Aaron and his sons will enter the tent and take down the curtain that separates the sacred chest from the rest of the tent. They will cover the chest with this curtain,
translation_verse: Ke̱dši nsra le̱ bafã le̱, Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ aba ni ame̱badšie no̱hā muhō̱ le̱, ni ame̱ṅõ-ha odaseyeli adeka le̱ he,

english_verse: With another blue cloth they will cover the lampstand, along with the lamps, the lamp snuffers, the fire pans, and the jars of oil for the lamps.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ṅõ mama blū ame̱ha *kanetšo le̱ ke̱ enidši le̱ ke̱ ehe abē̱lei le̱ ke̱ ehe lagbēnii le̱ ke̱ emũto̱i le̱ fè ní ake̱-súmoo̱ le̱ he. *

english_verse: All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather and placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ṅõ eke̱ ehe nii le̱ fè ame̱wo nuṅgbé wolo hehānõ mli, ni ame̱wole̱ tšoṅ.

english_verse: The gold incense altar is to be covered with a blue cloth, and then with a piece of fine leather, before its carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: Ni šika tšofã-ke̱-ṅma-šãlate̱ le̱ hũ, ame̱ke̱ mama blū alē̱ no̱, ni ame̱ṅõ nuṅgbé wolo hehānõ ame̱ha he, ni ame̱ke̱ ewómo̱tšei le̱ aho̱lo̱ mli.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will take blue cloth and wrap all the objects used in worship at the sacred tent. These will need to be covered with a piece of fine leather, then placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ṅõ súomo̱ nibii le̱ fẽ ni ake̱-súmoo̱ ye̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱, ni ame̱ke̱-wo mama blū mli, ni ame̱ke̱ nuṅgbé wolo hehānõ aha he, ni ame̱wole̱ tšoṅ.

english_verse: On that cloth will be placed the utensils used at the altar, including the fire pans, the meat forks, the shovels, and the sprinkling bowls. All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather, before the carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: ni ame̱ṅõ ehe nibii le̱ fẽ ní ake̱súmoo̱ ye̱ no̱ le̱, ṅe̱sũi le̱, ke̱ kpodši le̱, ke̱ lōmo̱nii le̱, ke̱ lalakãi le̱ ke̱ afo̱le-šãlate̱ le̱ he nibii le̱ fè, ni ame̱ke̱ nuṅgbé wolo hehānõ aha he, ni ame̱ke̱ ewómo̱tsei le̱ aho̱lo̱ mli.

english_verse: When the camp is ready to be moved, the Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects and the furnishings of the sacred tent. But Aaron and his sons must have already covered those things so the Kohathites won't touch them and die.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši nsra le̱ bafã le̱, Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ agbe hekroṅkroṅ le̱ ke̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱ nibii le̱ fẽ hehā nā, dãni Kahat bii le̱ aba mli ni *ame̱bahole, ní †ame̱kata nõkroṅkroṅ le̱ he ní ame̱gboi. Ene̱mei dši kpẽ-bū le̱ he nibii ní Kahat bii le̱ batĕre. *

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest will be in charge of the oil for the lamps, the sweet-smelling incense, the grain for the sacrifices, and the olive oil used for dedications and ordinations. Eleazar is responsible for seeing that the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the sacred objects are taken care of.
translation_verse: Ni noni atu awo oso̱fo Eleazar, Aaron bi le̱, deṅ dši kanesū-mũ le̱ ke̱ tšofãi-ke̱-ṅmai le̱ ke̱ dā niyenii-afo̱le le̱ ke̱ mũfō̱-mũ le̱, ke̱ šihĩle̱he le̱ fẽ ke̱ emlinii fẽ ke̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱ ke̱ ehenii le̱ fẽ no̱kwe̱mo̱.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose wie ni ekē̱:

english_verse: for carrying the curtains of the sacred tent, its two outer coverings, the curtain for the entrance to the tent,
translation_verse: ame̱ ame̱tẽre šihĩle̱he le̱ he mamai le̱, ke̱ kpē-bū le̱, enobānō le̱ ke̱ nuṅgbé wolo nohānõ ní ha no̱ ye̱ yiteṅgbe̱ le̱, ke̱ kpē-bū šĩnā le̱ nā mama le̱,

english_verse: the curtains hanging around the courtyard of the tent, and the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard. The Gershonites are to do whatever needs to be done to take care of these things,
translation_verse: ke̱ kpo le̱ he muhō̱i le̱, ke̱ kpo le̱ no̱ agbo le̱ nā mama le̱ ni bo̱le šihĩle̱he le̱ ke̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ he ke̱-kpe le̱, ke̱ amehe taṅkpẽi le̱, ke̱ amehe nitšumo̱ nii le̱ fẽ; ni nitšumo̱ fẽ ní yo̱ he le̱, ame̱tšu.

english_verse: These are the duties of the Gershonites at the sacred tent, and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work. The Duties of the Merarite Clans
translation_verse: Ene̱ dši Geršonbii le̱ abihĩĩ le̱ awekui le̱ anitšumo̱ ní ametšuo̱ ye̱ kpē-bũ le̱ he, ni moni kwe̱o̱ ame̱no̱ dši Itamar, oso̱fo Aaron bi le̱.

english_verse: The Merarites will be responsible for carrying the frames of the tent and its other pieces, including the bars, the posts, and the stands,
translation_verse: Ni ame̱dšatšui ní ame̱batĕre ye̱ ame̱nitšumo̱ fẽ ni ame̱tšuo̱ ye̱ kpẽ-bū le̱ he le̱ nā ne̱: Šihĩle̱he le̱ mplãṅi le̱, ke̱ emlible̱mo̱nii le̱, ke̱ ekulašĩṅi le̱, ke̱ ame̱no̱damo̱nii le̱

english_verse: as well as the posts that support the courtyard, together with their stands, tent pegs, and ropes. The Merarites are to be told exactly what objects they are to carry,
translation_verse: ke̱ kpo le̱ he akulašĩṅi le̱ ke̱-kpe, ke̱ ame̱no̱damo̱nii le̱ ke̱ ame̱he šiṅmlitšei le̱ ke̱ ame̱he taṅkpēi le̱, ye̱ ame̱he nibii le̱ ke̱ ame̱he nitšumo̱ le̱ fẽ nā; ni nyetšõame̱ ame̱dšatšui ní ame̱batẽre le̱ ekomekome.

english_verse: and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work. The Levites Are Counted Again
translation_verse: Merari bihĩĩ le̱ awekui le̱ agbe̱nã nitšumo̱ ní ame̱tšuo̱ ye̱ kpē-bū le̱ he ne̱, ni Itamar, oso̱fo Aaron bi le̱, kwe̱o̱ ame̱no̱.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelite leaders obeyed the Lord and counted the Levi tribe by families and clans, to find out how many men there were between the ages of
translation_verse: Mose nine no̱ atšṍ akaneame̱ ye̱ Iehowa wiemo̱ le̱ nā, mofẽmo ke̱ enitšumo̱ ke̱ edšatšu; bo̱ni Iehowa wo Mose kitã le̱, nakai ekaneame̱.

english_verse: The Israelites obeyed the Lord's instructions. The Penalty for Committing a Crime (Leviticus
translation_verse: Ni Israelbii le̱ fe nakai, ni ame̱-dšieame̱ ke̱-te nsra le̱ se̱, bo̱ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose wie le̱, nakai Israelbii le̱ fe.

english_verse: You must confess your guilt and pay the victim in full for whatever damage has been done, plus a fine of
translation_verse: no le̱ ame̱dšadše eša ní ame̱fe le̱ faṅṅ, ni ame̱to noni ame̱ye yi sõ le̱ nãdšiaṅ, ni ame̱ṅõ mlidšāi enumo̱ mli ekome ame̱fata he ame̱hã mo he ní dse̱ ní ame̱ye fo̱ le̱.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose wie ni ekē̱:
