english_verse: When you make a donation to the sacred tent, that money belongs only to the priest, and each priest will keep what is given to him. A Suspicious Husband
translation_verse: Ni nii ni moko adšō̱o̱ no̱ keo̱ le̱ atšṍ eno, ni noni mofẽmo ṅõ-hãa oso̱fo le̱, eno ni.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose wie ni ekē̱:

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: Suppose a man becomes jealous and suspects that his wife has been unfaithful, but he has no proof.
translation_verse: ni awuṅãyeli mumo̱ te ši ye̱ nū le̱ mli ni eye eṅã le̱ he awuṅã, ni yō le̱ ebule ehe, alo ké̱ awuṅãyeli mumo̱ te ši ye̱ emli ni eye ehe awuṅã, ni eṅã le̱ buleko ehe le̱,

english_verse: He must take his wife to the priest, together with one kilogram of ground barley as an offering to find out if she is guilty. No olive oil or incense is to be put on that offering.
translation_verse: no le̱ nū le̱ ke̱ eṅã le̱ aba oso̱fo le̱ ṅõ, ni eke̱ ehe afo̱le ní dši akoko mã efa mlidšāi nyoṅma mli ekome aba ye̱ ehewo̱; ekafo̱se mũ eſie no̱ ni asaṅ ekaṅõ kro̱bo̱o efo no̱; edšake̱ awuṅãyeli he niyenii-afo̱le ni, ke̱ niyenii-afo̱le ní ake̱-dšieo̱ nõša ši.

english_verse: The priest will lead the woman to my altar and make her stand there.
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo le̱ ahã yō le̱ aba ni eke̱le̱ abadamo̱ Iehowa hĩe.

english_verse: He will then pour sacred water into a clay jar and stir in some dust from the floor of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo le̱ aye̱ *nu kroṅkroṅ le̱ eko awo sũ kpulu ko mli, ni ekpītĩ šihĩle̱he šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ sũ le̱ eko ewo nu le̱ mli; *

english_verse: The priest will write these curses on special paper and wash them off into the bitter water,
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo le̱ aṅmã lōmo̱i ne̱ ye̱ wolo no̱, ni efo̱ ewo nu ke̱ dšōmo̱ le̱ mli,

english_verse: so that when the woman drinks this water, the curses will enter her body.
translation_verse: ni ehã yō le̱ anu nu ke̱ dšōmo̱ ní ke̱ lōmo̱ baä le̱, ni nu ni ke̱ lōmo̱ baä le̱ abote emli ni edšō ye̱ emli.

english_verse: He will take the barley offering from her and lift it up in dedication to me, the Lord. Then he will place it on my altar
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni oso̱fo le̱ ahe awuṅãyeli he niyenii-afo̱le le̱ ye̱ yō le̱ deṅ, ni efõ niyenii-afo̱le le̱ ye̱ Iehowa hĩe, ni eke̱-be̱ṅke̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱;

english_verse: and burn part of it as a sacrifice. After that, the woman must drink the bitter water.
translation_verse: ni oso̱ſo le̱ atĩ niyenii-afo̱le le̱ mli eko̱ko̱ obõ efe šidšiemo̱nõ, ni esã ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱, ni no se̱ le̱ ehã yō le̱ anu nu le̱.

english_verse: If the woman has been unfaithful, the water will immediately make her unable to have children, and she will be a curse among her people.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱ ehã enu nu le̱, aaba mli ake̱ ke̱dši ewo ehe mũdši ni etõ ewù no̱ le̱, no le̱ nu ni ke̱ lōmo̱ baä le̱ aabote emli ni eedšō ye̱ emli, ni emũsũ aafũ, ni eſũo̱dši aašra, ni yō le̱ aatšṍ lōmo̱ ye̱ emaṅbii le̱ ateṅ.

english_verse: But if she is innocent, her body will not be harmed, and she will still be able to have children.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši yō le̱ woko ehe mũdši ni ehe tše le̱, no le̱ ehe aadše mli, ni eena mũsũ ekoṅ.

english_verse: This is the ceremony that must take place at my altar when a husband suspects that his wife has been unfaithful. The priest must tell the woman to stand in my presence and carefully follow these instructions.
translation_verse: lo ke̱dši awuṅãyeli mumo̱ te ši ye̱ nū ko mli ni eye eṅã he awuṅã le̱, no le̱ eke̱ yō le̱ abadamo̱ Iehowa hĩe, ni oso̱fo le̱ afe ne̱ke̱ mla ne̱ he nii le̱ fẽ ahãle̱.

english_verse: If the husband is wrong, he will not be punished; but if his wife is guilty, she will be punished.
translation_verse: Ni nū le̱ he aadše nõša ne̱ mli, ni yō le̱ nõsa le̱ atĕrele̱.

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If any of you want to dedicate yourself to me by vowing to become a Nazirite,
translation_verse: Oke̱ Israelbii le̱ awie ni okē̱ame̱ ake̱: Ke̱dši nū ko lo yō ko dše gbe̱ wo ši ní dši Nazirnyo femo̱ he šiwō, ake̱ edšō̱ ehe no̱ ehã Iehowa le̱,

english_verse: During the time that you are a Nazirite, you must never go close to a dead body,
translation_verse: Gbĩĩ abo̱ fẽ ní edšē̱ ehe no̱ ehã Iehowa le̱ ekaya gbonyo ko he.

english_verse: Then on the next day, bring two doves or two pigeons to the priest at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ni gbĩ ní dši gbĩ kpānyo̱ le̱ no̱ le̱ eke̱ *kose̱ okpoi enyo̱ lo okpobii enyo aba oso̱fo le̱ ṅõ ye̱ kpē-bū šĩnã le̱ ši; *

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me. You will then be forgiven for being too near a dead body, and your hair will again become sacred.
translation_verse: ni oso̱fo le̱ aṅõ ekome ašã eša-afo̱le ni eke̱ ekome hũ ašã šā̃-afo̱le, ni ekpãtã ehãle̱ ye̱ eša ní efe ye̱ gbonyo he le̱ hewo̱, ni efe eyi le̱ kroṅkroṅ ekoṅ ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: But the dead body made you unacceptable, so you must make another vow to become a Nazirite and be dedicated once more. Finally, a year-old ram must be offered as the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: Ni edšō̱ ehe no̱ ehã Iehowa ekoṅ gbĩĩ abo ní ewo ši tšutšu le̱, ni eke̱ tōgwanteṅbinū ní eye afi aba abašã sõ-afo̱le; ši tšutšu gbĩĩ le̱ afe yaka, edšake̱ abule eheno̱dšō̱mo̱ le̱.

english_verse: When you have completed your promised time of being a Nazirite, go to the sacred tent
translation_verse: Ni ene̱ dši mla ni kã ši hã Nazirnyo le̱: ke̱ eheno̱dšō̱mo̱ gbĩĩ le̱ še̱ le̱ ake̱le̱ aba kpē-bū le̱ šĩnā le̱ ši;

english_verse: and offer three animals that have nothing wrong with them: a year-old ram as a sacrifice to please me, a year-old female lamb as a sacrifice for sin, and a full-grown ram as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: ni efo̱le ní ebašã ehã Iehowa dši tōgwanteṅbinū kome ni eye afi ní kpa ko be̱ ehe ni eke̱-šã šā̃-afo̱le, ke̱ tōgwanteṅbiyō kome ní eye afi ní kpa ko be̱ ehe ní eke̱-šã eša-afo̱le, ke̱ tōagbo kome ní kpa ko be̱ ehe ní eke̱-šã šidā-afo̱le,

english_verse: Wine offerings and grain sacrifices must also be brought with these animals. Finally, you are to bring a basket of bread made with your finest flour and olive oil, but without yeast. Also bring some thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: ke̱ ṅmā̃ mã akpĩtĩ kāoi ní awo mli mū, ke̱ akpĩtĩ kakai ní ake̱ mũ ekpa be kafũ kome, ke̱ amehe niyenii-afo̱lei ke̱ amehe dā̃-afo̱lei.

english_verse: The priest will take these gifts to my altar and offer them, so that I will be pleased and will forgive you.
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo le̱ aṅõ ke̱-ba Iehowa hĩe, ni eke̱-šã eša-afo̱le ke̱ šā̃-afo̱le ehãle̱,

english_verse: Once the meat from the ram's shoulder has been boiled, the priest will take it, along with one loaf of bread and one wafer brushed with oil, and give them to you.
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo le̱ aṅõ tōagbo nine ní ahō kome, ke̱ kafũ le̱ mli akpĩtĩ kāoi le̱ ekome, ke̱ akpĩtĩ kaka kome, ni eṅõ-wo Nazirnyo le̱ deṅ, beni eše̱ eheno̱dšō̱mo̱ yi le̱ se̱ le̱;

english_verse: You will hand them back to the priest, who will lift them up in dedication to me. Then he can eat the meat from the ram's shoulder, its choice ribs, and its hind leg, because this is his share of the sacrifice. After this, you will no longer be a Nazirite, and you will be free to drink wine.
translation_verse: ni oso̱fo le̱ aṅõ-fe fō̃-afo̱le ní efõ ye̱ Iehowa hĩe, edši nokroṅkroṅ hã oso̱fo le̱, no ke̱ *fō̃-tšitši le̱ ke̱ no̱wómo̱-kõṅ le̱ fẽ. Ni no se̱ le̱ Nazirnyo le̱ anu wein. *

english_verse: These are the requirements for Nazirites. However, if you can afford to offer more, you must do so. The Blessing for the People
translation_verse: Ene̱ dši Nazirnyo ní woo̱ ši le̱ he mla ke̱ afo̱le ní ešãa ehãa Iehowa ye̱ eheno̱dšō̱mo̱ le̱ hewo̱, sŏro noni eenyẽ ehã efata he; bo̱ni ewo ši le̱, nakai efe ye̱ eheno̱dšō̱mo̱ mla le̱ nā.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless and protect you,
translation_verse: Iehowa adšō̱o ni etoö! Lal.

english_verse: and that he will show you mercy and kindness.
translation_verse: Iehowa ahã ehĩe akpe̱ ye̱ ono̱, ní edroö! Lal.

english_verse: May the Lord be good to you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: Iehowa awó ehĩe no̱ ye̱ ono̱, ni ehão hedšo̱le̱! Lal.

english_verse: with gifts for the Lord. They brought six strong carts and twelve oxen—one ox from each leader and a cart from every two.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱nikēnii le̱ ba Iehowa hĩe, ni nii ní ame̱ke̱-ba le̱ ne̱: ſīlii ní aha yiteṅ ekpa ke̱ tšinai nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱; ſīlii le̱, onukpai enyo̱ nõ ekome, ni tšinai le̱, mokome nõ ekome; ni ame̱ke̱-ba šihĩle̱he le̱ hĩe.

english_verse: “Accept these gifts, so the Levites can use them here at the sacred tent for carrying the sacred things.”
translation_verse: Hemo̱ ye̱ ame̱deṅ ní ake̱-tšu kpē-bū le̱ he nii; ni oṅõ-hã Levibii le̱ ye̱ ame̱teṅ mofẽmo nitšumo̱ nā.

english_verse: Then Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites,
translation_verse: Ni Mose ṅo ſīlii le̱ ke̱ tšinai le̱ ehã Levibii le̱:

english_verse: On the day the altar was dedicated, the twelve leaders brought offerings for its dedication.
translation_verse: Ni gbĩ ní afo̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ he mũ le̱ onukpai le̱ ke̱ *ebulemo̱ nikēnii ba; ni onukpai le̱ ke̱ ame̱nikēnii ba afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ hĩe. *

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Each day one leader is to give his offering for the dedication.”
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱ Mose ake̱: *Onukpai le̱ ke̱ ame̱nikēnii le̱ abahã ekomekome mofẽmo ye̱ egbĩ no̱ ní ake̱-bule afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱. *

english_verse: And so when the altar was dedicated to the Lord, these twelve leaders brought the following gifts:
translation_verse: Ni šidā-afo̱le tšinai le̱ fẽ dši tšinahĩĩ nyoṅmai-enyo̱ ke̱ edſe̱ ke̱ tōagboi nyoṅmai-ekpa ke̱ tōabotiai nyoṅmai-ekpa ke̱ tōgwanteṅbihĩĩ ní eye afifi nyoṅmai-ekpa. Ene̱mei dši afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ bulemo̱nii, beni afo̱le̱ mũ se̱ le̱.

english_verse: kilograms, according to the official standards;
translation_verse: tōkpakpo kome ni ake̱-bašã eša-afo̱le;

english_verse: rams a year old as sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing.
translation_verse: Gbĩ ní dši gbĩ ne̱hũ le̱ no̱ le̱ Benyamin bii le̱ anukpa Abidan, Gideoni bi le̱, ke̱ enikēnii ba.

english_verse: Whenever Moses needed to talk with the Lord, he went into the sacred tent, where he heard the Lord's voice coming from between the two winged creatures above the lid of the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Ni beni Mose yabote kpē-bū le̱ mli, ní *eke̱le̱ ayawie le̱, ke̱ke̱ ni enu gbē le̱ ke̱le̱ miwie ye̱ kpãtãmo̱ sẽi le̱ ní bu odase adeka le̱ nā le̱ no̱, ye̱ kerubim enyo̱ le̱ ateṅ; †nakai eke̱le̱ wieo̱. *

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose wie ni ekē̱:

english_verse: and sprinkle them with the water that washes away their sins. Then have them shave their entire bodies and wash their clothes.
translation_verse: Ni bo̱ni ofeame̱ ní oke̱-tšū ame̱he ne̱: Ṅõ *eša dšiemo̱ nu oſã ame̱no̱, ni †ame̱še̱ ame̱he fẽ ke̱ asōyi, ni ame̱fo̱ ame̱tadei ahe, ní amehe atše. *

english_verse: They are to bring a bull and its proper grain sacrifice of flour mixed with olive oil. And they must bring a second bull as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ohã ame̱ṅõ tšina-oblanyo ke̱ ehe niyenii-afo̱le ní dši ṅmā̃ mã ní awo mli mũ, ni oṅõ tšina-oblanyo kroko ošã eša-afo̱le.

english_verse: where the people will place their hands on them.
translation_verse: ni oko̱ Levibii le̱ aba Iehowa hĩe; ni Israelbii le̱ aṅõ ame̱nidši aſie Levibii le̱ ano̱;

english_verse: This ceremony will show that the Levites are different from the other Israelites and belong to me in a special way.
translation_verse: Ni otše Levibii le̱ ke̱-dše Israelbii le̱ ahe, ni Levibii le̱ *atšṍ minõ. *

english_verse: After they have been made acceptable and have been dedicated, they will be allowed to work at my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ni no se̱ le̱ Levibii le̱ aba ní ame̱-basúmo̱ ye̱ kpē-bū le̱ṅ. Ni otšū ame̱he ni oṅõame̱ ofe fõ-afo̱le.

english_verse: They are mine and will take the place of the first-born Israelite sons.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ake̱ame̱ ehãmi kwrā ye̱ Israelbii le̱ ateṅ; ye̱nofẽno ní gbleo̱ mũsũ nā ní dši Israelbii akromo̱bii le̱ anãdšiaṅ, miṅoame̱ mihã midientše̱ mihe.

english_verse: When I killed the oldest sons of the Egyptians, I decided that the first-born sons in each Israelite family would be mine, as well as every first-born male from their flocks and herds.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ minõ dši kromo̱bi-fẽ-kromo̱bi ye̱ Israelbii le̱ ateṅ, ye̱ gbomei ke̱ šĩa koloi fẽ ateṅ; gbĩ no̱ ní mitſia kromo̱bii fẽ anii ye̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱, gbĩ le̱ mifeame̱ kroṅkroṅ mihã mihe.

english_verse: But now I have chosen these Levites as substitutes for the first-born sons,
translation_verse: Ni miṅõ Levibii le̱ ye̱ Israelbii le̱ akromo̱bii fẽ nãdšiaṅ;

english_verse: and I have given them as gifts to Aaron and his sons to serve at the sacred tent. I will hold them responsible for what happens to anyone who gets too close to the sacred tent. The Levites Are Dedicated to the Lord
translation_verse: ni miṅõ Levibii le̱ *mihã Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ kwrā ke̱-dše̱ Israelbii le̱ ateṅ, koni ame̱tšu kpē-bū le̱ he nii ye̱ Israelbii le̱ anãdšiaṅ, ní ame̱kpãtã amehe Israelbii le̱, koni haomo̱ akaba Israelbii le̱ ano̱, ke̱ Israelbii le̱ babe̱ṅke̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱, *

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelites made sure that the Levites did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ni Mose ke̱ Aaron ke̱ Israelbii asafo mū le̱ fẽ fe Levibii le̱ nakai; bo̱ni Iehowa wo Mose kitã ye̱ Levibii le̱ ahewo̱ le̱, nakai Israelbii le̱ feame̱.

english_verse: The Levites sprinkled themselves with the water of forgiveness and washed their clothes. Then Aaron brought them to the altar and offered sacrifices to forgive their sins and make them acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni Levibii le̱ dšie ame̱he ešai le̱, ni ame̱fo̱fō̱ ame̱tadei ahe, ni *Aaron ṅõame̱ efe fō̃-afo̱le ye̱ Iehowa hĩe, ni Aaron kpãtã ehãame̱ ni etšũ ame̱he. *K.

english_verse: After this, the Levites worked at the sacred tent as assistants to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ni no se̱ le̱ Levibii le̱ ba ame̱-batšu ame̱nitšumo̱ ye̱ kpē-bū le̱ mli ye̱ Aaron ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ ahĩe; bo̱ni Iehowa wo Mose kitã ye̱ Levibii le̱ ahewo le̱, nakai ame̱feame̱.

english_verse: They may help the other Levites in their duties, but they must no longer be responsible for any work themselves. Remember this when you assign their duties.”
translation_verse: ši ame̱wa ame̱nyemimei le̱ ke̱-súmo̱ ye̱ kpē-bū le̱ mli; ši nitšumo̱ le̱ ame̱katšu. Bo̱ni ofe ohã Levibii le̱ ye̱ ame̱gbe̱nā nitšumo̱i le̱ agbe̱fãṅ ne̱.

english_verse: During the first month of Israel's second year in the Sinai Desert, the Lord had told Moses
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose wie ye̱ Sinai ṅā le̱ no̱ ye̱ ame̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ ne̱ dšē le̱ se̱ afi ní dši enyo̱ le̱ mli kleṅkleṅ nyõṅ le̱ no̱ ake̱:

english_verse: in the evening of the fourteenth day of this month and do it by following all the regulations.”
translation_verse: Ne̱ke̱ nyõṅ ne̱ no̱ gbĩ nyoṅma ke̱ edſe̱ le̱ gbe̱ke̱naši nyeye ye̱ ebe ni ato le̱ mli; nyeyeale̱ ye̱ ehe akpoi ke̱ gbe̱dšiano̱tōi le̱ fẽ nā.

english_verse: Moses told the people what the Lord had said, and they celebrated Passover there in the desert in the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ye Hehō le̱ ye̱ kleṅkleṅ nyõṅ le̱ no̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ nyoṅma ke̱ edſe̱ le̱ gbe̱ke̱nāši, ye̱ Sinai ṅã le̱ ne̱; bo̱ni Iehowa wo Mose kitã le̱, nakai Israelbii le̱ fe.

english_verse: Some people in Israel's camp had touched a dead body and had become unfit to worship the Lord, and they could not celebrate Passover. But they asked Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Ši eba mli ake̱ hĩĩ komei ye̱ ní *ame̱yabule ame̱he ye̱ gbonyo ko he, ni ame̱nyẽẽ Hehō le̱ ame̱ye ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ ne̱; ni ame̱ba Mose ke̱ Aaron hĩe ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ noṅṅ; *

english_verse: “Even though we have touched a dead body, why can't we celebrate Passover and offer sacrifices to the Lord at the same time as everyone else?”
translation_verse: ni nakai hĩĩ le̱ kē̱le̱ ake̱: Wo le wo̱yabule wo̱he ye̱ gbonyo ko he; mẽhewo aatšĩwo̱ gbe̱, ní wo̱ke̱ wo̱nikēnii akabahã Iehowa ye̱ ebe ní ato le̱ mli ye̱ Israelbii le̱ ateṅ?

english_verse: Moses said, “Wait here while I go into the sacred tent and find out what the Lord says about this.”
translation_verse: Ni Mose kē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyedamo̱a ši, ní mabo no kitã ní Iehowa aawo ye̱ nyehewo̱ toi.

english_verse: The Lord then told Moses
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ Mose wie ni ekē̱:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you or your descendants touch a dead body and become unfit to worship me, or if you are away on a long journey, you may still celebrate Passover.
translation_verse: Kē̱mo̱ Israelbii le̱ ake̱: Ke̱dši nyeteṅ moko lo nyesešibii le̱ eko yabule ehe ye̱ gbonyo ko he lo edom ete maṅse̱ šoṅṅ le̱, eye Iehowa Hehō le kẽ.

english_verse: But it must be done in the second month, in the evening of the fourteenth day. Eat the Passover lamb with thin bread and bitter herbs,
translation_verse: Ši ame̱ye ye̱ nyõṅ ní dši enyo̱ le̱ no̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ nyoṅma ke̱ edſe̱ le̱ gbe̱ke̱naši, akpĩtĩ ke̱ ſie ní dšōo̱ ame̱ke̱-ye;

english_verse: and don't leave any of it until morning or break any of the animal's bones. Be sure to follow these regulations.
translation_verse: ame̱kaſe̱ eko ní dše mītše̱re no̱, ni asaṅ ame̱kadſa ewui le̱ eko; ame̱ye ye̱ Hehō le̱ he akpo̱i le̱ fẽ nā.

english_verse: But if any of you are fit to worship me, and yet refuse to celebrate Passover when you are not away on a journey, you will no longer belong to my people. You will be punished because you did not offer sacrifices to me at the proper time.
translation_verse: Ši moni he tše ni edomko, ši kẽle̱ ekwa Hehō le̱ yeli le̱, nakai mo le̱ aafole̱ ke̱-dše̱ emã le̱ṅ aše̱ afõ, edšake̱ eke̱ Iehowa nikēnii le̱ baa ye̱ be ní ato le̱ mli; nakai gbomo le̱ atĕre ehe eša le̱.

english_verse: Anyone, including foreigners who live among you, can celebrate Passover, if they follow all the regulations. The Cloud over the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši mokpõṅ ko bato gbo̱ ye̱ nyeteṅ ni ēsumo̱ ake̱ eye Iehowa Hehō le̱, bo̱ni Hehō le̱ he akpo ke̱ gbe̱dšianotō le̱ yo̱ le̱, nakai eyele̱. Akpo kome akã ši ahãnye, gbo̱ dšio, moni afo̱le ye̱ ši-kpoṅ le̱ no̱ dšio.

english_verse: whether it was only one night, a few days, a month, or even a year. As long as the cloud remained over the tent, the Israelites stayed where they were. But when the cloud moved, so did the Israelites.
translation_verse: Ni ké̱ atatu le̱ hĩ šihĩle̱he le̱ no̱ ní etše̱ gbĩĩ enyo̱ dšio, nyõṅ kome dšio, afi dšio, Israelbii le̱ hĩo̱ nsra le̱ mli ni ame̱fãã; ši kē̱ ewó ehe no̱ le̱, ame̱fãa.

english_verse: Whenever you go into battle against an enemy attacking your land, give a warning signal on the trumpets. Then I, the Lord, will hear it and rescue you.
translation_verse: Ni kē̱ nyemīfã ta nyeke̱ henye̱lo̱ ko ní gbaä nyenā ayawu ye̱ nyesikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱, no le̱ nyekpãa te̱tre̱mantre̱i ke̱-bo̱a oše, ní akainye ye̱ Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, hĩe, ni ahere nyeyiwala ke̱-dše̱ nyehenye̱lo̱i le̱ adeṅ.

english_verse: During the celebration of the New Moon Festival and other religious festivals, sound the trumpets while you offer sacrifices. This will be a reminder that I am the Lord your God. The Israelites Begin Their Journey
translation_verse: Asaṅ *nyenyã́mo̱ gbĩĩ le̱ ke̱ nyegbĩĩ dšudši ní ato le̱ ke̱ nyenyõdši hēi le̱ ano̱ hũ le̱ nyekpãa te̱tre̱mantre̱i, beni nyešãa nyešã-afo̱lei ke̱ nyešidā-afo̱lei le̱, ni atšṍ kaime̱no ahãnye ye̱ nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le hĩe. Midsi Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱. *

english_verse: On the twentieth day of the second month of that same year, the cloud over the sacred tent moved on.
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ye̱ afi ní dši enyo̱ le̱ mli nyoṅ ni dši enyo̱ le̱ no̱ gbĩ ní dši nyoṅmai-enyo̱ le̱ no̱, ake̱ atatu le̱ wó ehe no̱ ke̱-dše̱ odase šihĩle̱he le̱ no̱.

english_verse: So the Israelites broke camp and left the Sinai Desert. And some time later, the cloud stopped in the Paran Desert.
translation_verse: Ni Israelbii le̱ fã ni ame̱yiṅ ke̱-dše̱ Sinai ṅã le̱ no̱, ni atatu le̱ yawa ye̱ Paran ṅã le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Judah and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out first, carrying their banner. Nahshon son of Amminadab was the leader of the Judah tribe,
translation_verse: Ni Iuda bii ansra le̱ aflaṅā le̱ fã tšutšu ye̱ ame̱safoi le̱ anā; ni moni tẽre eta le̱ dši Nahašon, Aminadab bi le̱.

english_verse: Nethanel son of Zuar was the leader of the Issachar tribe,
translation_verse: Ni Isakar bii le̱ akutšo le̱ ta le̱ moni tẽre dši Netanel, Zuar bi le̱.

english_verse: and Eliab son of Helon was the leader of the Zebulun tribe.
translation_verse: Ni Zebulon bii le̱ akutšo le̱ ta le̱ moni tẽre dši Eliab, Helon bi le̱.

english_verse: The sacred tent had been taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites carried it, marching behind the Judah camp.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni afã šihĩle̱he le̱, ni Geršon bii le̱ ke̱ Merari bii le̱ ní tĕre šihĩle̱he le̱ fã,

english_verse: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was the leader of the Simeon tribe,
translation_verse: Ni Simeon bii le̱ akutšo le̱ ta le̱ moni tẽre dši Šelumiel, Zurišadai bi le̱.

english_verse: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was the leader of the Gad tribe.
translation_verse: Ni Gad bii le̱ akutšo le̱ ta le̱ moni tẽre dši Eliasaf, Deuel bi le̱.

english_verse: Ephraim and the tribes that camped alongside it marched next, carrying their banner. Elishama son of Ammihud was the leader of the Ephraim tribe,
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Efraim bii ansra le̱ aflaṅā le̱ fã ye̱ ame̱safoi le̱ anā; ni moni tĕre eta le̱ dši Elišama, Amihud bi le̱.

english_verse: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was the leader of the Manasseh tribe,
translation_verse: Ni Manase bii le̱ akutšo le̱ ta le̱ moni tĕre dši Gamaliel, Pedazur bi le̱.

english_verse: and Abidan son of Gideoni was the leader of the Benjamin tribe.
translation_verse: Ni Benyamin bii le̱ akutšo le̱ ta le̱ moni tĕre dši Abidan, Gideoni bi le̱.

english_verse: Dan and the tribes that camped alongside it were to protect the Israelites against an attack from behind, and so they marched last, carrying their banner. Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was the leader of the tribe of Dan,
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Dan bii ansra le̱ aflaṅā le̱ ní nyieo̱ nsrai le̱ ſẽ se̱ le̱ fã ye̱ ame̱safoi le̱ anā; ni moni tĕre eta le̱ dši Ahiezer, Amišadai bi le̱.

english_verse: Pagiel son of Ochran was the leader of the Asher tribe,
translation_verse: Ni Ašer bii le̱ akutšo le̱ ta le̱ moni tĕre dši Pagiel, Okran bi le̱.

english_verse: and Ahira son of Enan was the leader of the Naphtali tribe.
translation_verse: Ni Naftali bii le̱ akutšo le̱ ta le̱ moni tĕre dši Ahira, Enan bi le̱.

english_verse: This was the order in which the Israelites marched each time they moved their camp.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Israelbii fãa ye̱ ame̱tai le̱ anā ne̱.

english_verse: Hobab the Midianite, the father-in-law of Moses, was there. And Moses said to him, “We're leaving for the place the Lord has promised us. He has said that all will go well for us. So come along, and we will make sure that all goes well for you.”
translation_verse: Ni beni ame̱fã le̱ Mose kē̱ eṅã nyeminū Hobab, Reuel bi ní dši Midiannyo le̱, ake̱: Womīfã ke̱-ya he ní Iehowa kē̱ ye̱ he ake̱: maṅõ-hãnye le̱; ba, ní wo̱te ni wo̱o̱feo edšũrō, edšake̱ Iehowa ewo Israel nii kpakpai pī aši! Kods.

english_verse: “No, I won't go,” Hobab answered. “I'm returning home to be with my own people.”
translation_verse: Ši ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Miyaa, ši moṅ mate midientše̱ mišikpoṅ no̱ ke̱ miwekumei aṅõ.

english_verse: “Please go with us!” Moses said. “You can be our guide because you know the places to camp in the desert.
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Ofai ne̱, kāšĩwo̱; edšake̱ gbĩĩabo̱ ní ole hei ni wo̱yabo̱bō̱ nsra ye̱ ye̱ ṅã le̱ no̱ hewo le̱, nyiemo̱ wohĩe.

english_verse: Besides that, if you go, we will give you a share of the good things the Lord gives us.”
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱, ké̱ oke̱wo̱ nyie le̱, edšŭrõ ni Iehowa aafewo̱ le̱, no noṅṅ wo̱ hũ wo̱ke̱-afeo!

english_verse: The people of Israel began their journey from Mount Sinai. They traveled three days, and the Levites who carried the sacred chest led the way, so the Lord could show them where to camp.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱fã ke̱-dše̱ Iehowa goṅ le̱ he ame̱nyie gbĩĩ etẽ, ni Iehowa kpãṅmo̱ adeka le̱ nyie ame̱hĩe gbĩĩ etẽ, koni etšoame̱ šitōhe.

english_verse: And the cloud always stayed with them.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱ ame̱fã nsra le̱, Iehowa atatu le̱ haä ame̱no̱ ſane.

english_verse: Each day as the Israelites began their journey, Moses would pray, “Our Lord, defeat your enemies and make them run!”
translation_verse: Ni eha mli ake̱, heni adeka le̱ fãa le̱, Mose kē̱o̱ ake̱: *Te ši, Iehowa! ní ohenye̱lo̱i le̱ agbe aſã, ni mei ní teo̱ ši woo̱o le̱ adšo foi ye̱ ohĩe! *Lal.

english_verse: And when they stopped to set up camp, he would pray, “Our Lord, stay close to Israel's thousands and thousands of people.”
translation_verse: Ni ke̱ eto ši le̱, ekē̱o̱ ake̱: Kũ ose̱, Iehowa! ke̱-ba Israel akpei nyoṅmai akpei abo̱ le̱ ṅõ!

english_verse: One day some foreigners among the Israelites became greedy for food, and even the Israelites themselves began moaning, “We don't have any meat!
translation_verse: Ši futufutugbomei ní yo̱ ame̱teṅ le̱, nibii bõi ame̱tšinebā, ní asaṅ Israelbii le̱ hũ bõi yāfó ekoṅ ni ame̱kē̱: Namo *aahãwo̱ lō wo̱ye? *

english_verse: In Egypt we could eat all the fish we wanted, and there were cucumbers, melons, all kinds of onions, and garlic.
translation_verse: Wo̱kai lō ní wo̱yeo̱ yaka ye̱ Mizraim, ke̱ agorigoi le̱, ke̱ kõnyõi le̱, ke̱ ſiei le̱, ke̱ sabolāi le̱, ke̱ ayōi le̱!

english_verse: He prayed: I am your servant, Lord, so why are you doing this to me? What have I done to deserve this? You've made me responsible for all these people,
translation_verse: Ni Mose kē̱ Iehowa ake̱: Mẽba oke̱ otšũlo̱ yeo̱ deṅdeṅ ne̱, ni mẽba mihĩe baa nyam ye̱ ohĩe, ni oṅõ ne̱ke̱ maṅ mã ne̱ ſẽ dšatšu le̱ ofõ mino̱ ne̱?

english_verse: but they're not my children. You told me to nurse them along and to carry them to the land you promised their ancestors.
translation_verse: Ani mi miṅõ ne̱ke̱ maṅ mū ne̱ fẽ ho̱, alo mi mifo̱ame̱, hewo̱ ni okē̱mi ake̱: Hĩemo̱ame̱ ye̱ okpo̱ko̱iaṅ, take̱ bo̱ni bihĩelo̱ hĩeo̱ ebi abifao, ke̱-ya šikpoṅ ní okã ame̱tše̱mei le̱ akitã ye̱ he le̱ no̱ le̱?

english_verse: This job is too much for me. How can I take care of all these people by myself?
translation_verse: Mikometō minyẽṅ maṅ mū ne̱ fẽ mahĩe, edšake̱ etšī fèmi!

english_verse: If this is the way you're going to treat me, just kill me now and end my miserable life! Seventy Leaders Are Chosen To Help Moses
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši ne̱ke̱ oke̱mi baye le̱, no le̱, ké̱ mihĩe eba nyam ye̱ ohĩe le̱, *gbemi moṅ nyoṅlo, koni mikane mihĩenāno̱nii! *

english_verse: While I am talking with you there, I will give them some of your authority, so they can share responsibility for my people. You will no longer have to care for them by yourself.
translation_verse: Ni makpleke ši mike̱o abawie ye̱ dše̱i, ni maṅõ mumo̱ ní yo̱ ono̱ le̱ eko maſie ame̱no̱, ni ame̱ke̱o atĕre maṅ le̱ dšatšu le̱, koni okome okatĕre.

english_verse: As for the Israelites, I have heard them complaining about not having meat and about being better off in Egypt. So tell them to make themselves acceptable to me, because tomorrow they will have meat.
translation_verse: Ni maṅ le̱, kē̱mo̱ame̱ ake̱: *Nyefea nyehe kroṅkroṅ nyetoa wó̱, ši nyebaye lō; edšake̱ nyefó nyewo Iehowa toiiaṅ ake̱: Namo aahãwo̱ lō wo̱ye? edšake̱, beni wo̱yo̱ Mizraim moṅ le̱, ehĩ hãwo̱! Nohewo̱ le̱ Iehowa bahãnye lō ní nyeye. *

english_verse: . They turned against me and wanted to go back to Egypt. Now they will eat meat until they get sick of it.
translation_verse: ši moṅ nyõṅ kome so̱ṅṅ, ke̱-yaši beyino ní eedše nyegugõṅ fũ, ni eedše nyetšine, edšake̱ nyegbe Iehowa ní yo̱ nyeteṅ le̱ he guo̱, ni nyefófói ye̱ ehĩe, nyekē̱ ake̱: Mẽba ahã wo̱dše Mizraim mo̱?

english_verse: Even if we butchered all our sheep and cattle, or caught every fish in the sea, we wouldn't have enough to feed them.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “I can do anything! Watch and you'll see my words come true.”
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱ Mose ake̱: Ani *Iehowa nine efo kuku? Agbe̱ne̱ ke̱ miwiemo̱ le̱ aaba mli ahão dsio, ebaṅ mli dšio, obana! *Ies.

english_verse: Eldad and Medad were two leaders who had not gone to the tent. But when the Spirit took control of them, they began shouting like prophets right there in camp.
translation_verse: Ni hĩĩ enyo̱ ſe̱ ye̱ nsra le̱ṅ, mokome gbe̱i dši Eldad ni mokome hũ Medad; ni mumo̱ le̱ yi ame̱ hũ ame̱no̱, edšake̱ ame̱ye̱ mei ní aṅmã ame̱gbe̱i le̱ ateṅ, ši ame̱náá ame̱dše kpo ke-ya kpē-bū le̱ he, ni ame̱gba ye̱ nsra le̱ṅ.

english_verse: A boy ran to Moses and told him about Eldad and Medad.
translation_verse: Ni oblanyo ko dšo foi ebatšĩ tã etšõ Mose ni ekē̱: Eldad ke̱ Medad migba ye̱ nsra le̱ṅ!

english_verse: Joshua was there helping Moses, as he had done since he was young. And he said to Moses, “Sir, you must stop them!”
translation_verse: Ni *Iošua, Nun bi, ní dši Mose súolo̱ ke̱-dše̱ eblahĩaṅ le̱, here no̱ ni ekē̱: Minuṅtšo̱ Mose, tšĩame̱ gbe̱! *

english_verse: But Moses replied, “Are you concerned what this might do to me? I wish the Lord would give his Spirit to all his people so everyone could be a prophet.”
translation_verse: Ni Mose kē̱le̱ ake̱: Mi *oyeo̱ awuṅã ohã ne̱? Mina, ní kũle̱ Iehowa †maṅ mū le̱ fẽ tšṍmo̱ gbaloi, ni Iehowa afo̱se Emumo̱ le̱ aſie ame̱no̱! *Mar.

english_verse: Some time later the Lord sent a strong wind that blew quails in from the sea until Israel's camp was completely surrounded with birds, piled up about a meter high for many kilometers in every direction.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa hã kõyo tſa, ni *elō trako̱ko̱i ke̱-dše̱ ṅšo̱ le̱ he ke̱-baſie nsra le̱ṅ, aafe gbĩ kome gbe̱nyiemo̱ ye̱ bie̱ ke̱ gbĩ kome gbe̱nyiemo̱ ye̱ bie̱ ke̱-bo̱le nsra le̱ kpŭla, ni ame̱ke̱ šikpoṅ dšeke̱mo̱ aafe ninetalo̱i enyo̱. *

english_verse: The people picked up quails for two days—each person filled at least ten large baskets. Then they spread them out to dry.
translation_verse: Ni maṅ le̱ te ši nakai gbĩ mū le̱ fẽ ke̱ eno̱ nyōṅ ke̱ eno̱ dšetše̱remo̱ fẽ ni ame̱yabua trako̱ko̱i le̱ anā; moni náá kwrã le̱, ena homeri nyoṅma, ni ame̱ṅo-kakā ke̱-bo̱le nsra le̱ kpŭla.

english_verse: But before the meat could be eaten, the Lord became angry and sent a deadly disease through the camp.
translation_verse: Lō le̱ ye̱ ame̱dāṅ lolo, ni ame̱náko ame̱ta, ke̱ke̱ ni Iehowa mli wo maṅ le̱ la, ni Iehowa tſia maṅ le̱ nii naakpa dientše̱.

english_verse: After they had buried the people who had been so greedy for meat, they called the place “Graves for the Greedy.”
translation_verse: Ni etšé̱ dše̱i ake̱ Kibrot-Hataawa, edšake̱ dše̱i ame̱fũ *mei ni nii ba ame̱tšine le̱ ye̱. *

english_verse: Israel then broke camp and traveled to Hazeroth.
translation_verse: Ni maṅ le̱ fã ke̱-dše̱ Kibrot-Hataawa ke̱-te Hazerot, ni ame̱hĩ ši ye̱ Hazerot.

english_verse: and told Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to come to the entrance of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iehowa kē̱ Mose ke̱ Aaron ke̱ Miriam trukā ake̱: Nyeyi etẽ le̱ fẽ nyedšea kpo ke̱-baä kpē-bū le̱ he! Ni ame̱yi etẽ le̱ ame̱dše kpo.

english_verse: Then after commanding them to listen carefully, he said: “I, the Lord, speak to prophets in visions and dreams.
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱: Nyeboa miwiemo̱i le̱ atoi ko! Ke̱dši gbalo̱ ko ye̱ nyeteṅ le̱, mi Iehowa, ninā mli mahã elemi ye̱, wo̱lamõ mli mike̱le̱ awie ye̱.

english_verse: But my servant Moses is the leader of my people.
translation_verse: Ši mitšũlo̱ Mose nõ be̱ nakai; ši moṅ *eyeo̱ ano̱kwa ye̱ miwe le̱ fẽ. *Heb.

english_verse: He sees me face to face, and everything I say to him is perfectly clear. You have no right to criticize my servant Moses.”
translation_verse: Le̱ le̱ *nābu ke̱ nābu mike̱le̱ wieo̱ kpetekplē, ši dšee ye̱ abe̱buai amli, ni Iehowa subãṅ le̱ enaä. Bĕle̱ mẽhewo̱ nyešee gbeyei, ni nyewie mitšũlo̱ Mose he le̱? *

english_verse: and the cloud disappeared from over the sacred tent, Miriam's skin turned white with leprosy. When Aaron saw what had happened to her,
translation_verse: Ni atatu le̱ dše bū le̱ no̱; ni na, kpiti ſie Miriam ſutā tamo̱ snō. Ni Aaron yakwe̱ Miriam le̱, na, kpiti eſiele̱.

english_verse: he said to Moses, “Sir, please don't punish us for doing such a foolish thing.
translation_verse: Ni Aaron kē̱ Mose ake: Ofai ne̱, minuṅtšo̱, kāhã awowo̱ nyomo̱ ye̱ kwašiai ní wo̱fe ke̱ eša ní wo̱fe ne̱ hewo̱!

english_verse: Don't let Miriam's flesh rot away like a child born dead!”
translation_verse: Kāhã efe tamo̱ gbonyo ní beni edše̱o̱ enye mũsũṅ bēbe ní ehelo le̱ fã ekpo̱to̱ momo le̱!

english_verse: But the Lord replied, “Miriam would be disgraced for seven days if her father had punished her by spitting in her face. So make her stay outside the camp for seven days, before coming back.”
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱ Mose ake̱: Aso ké̱ etše̱ fẽ ladšo ſie ehĩe le̱, ani ehĩe eſieṅ ši gbĩĩ kpawo lo? Aṅã eyi gbĩĩ kpawo ye̱ *nsra le̱ se̱, ni no se̱ dãni aṅõle̱ ke̱-ba ekoṅ! *

english_verse: The people of Israel did not move their camp until Miriam returned seven days later.
translation_verse: Ni aṅã Miriam yi ye̱ nsra le̱ se̱ gbĩĩ kpawo. Ni maṅ le̱ efãã ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní ayaṅõ Miriam ke̱-ba ekoṅ.

english_verse: Then they left Hazeroth and set up camp in the Paran Desert.
translation_verse: Ni no se̱ le̱ maṅ le̱ fã ke̱-dše̱ Hazerot, ni ame̱yabo̱ nsra ye̱ Paran.

english_verse: In fact, we saw the Nephilim who are the ancestors of the Anakim. They were so big that we felt as small as grasshoppers.”
translation_verse: Ni dše̱i wo̱na oblãṅi agboi ní dši Anak bii ní dši oblãṅi agboi le̱ ateṅ le̱ ye̱, ni ké̱ wo̱kwe̱ wo̱he le̱, wo̱tamo̱ agãi, ni nakai noṅṅ wo̱yo̱ ye̱ ame̱ hũ ame̱hĩe.

english_verse: and find out what those regions are like. Be sure to remember how many people live there, how strong they are,

english_verse: and if they live in open towns or walled cities. See if the land is good for growing crops and find out what kinds of trees grow there. It's time for grapes to ripen, so try to bring back some of the fruit that grows there.
translation_verse: ke̱ bo̱ni šikpoṅ le̱ dientše̱ yo̱, ake̱ ebaä nii lo ebaa dšogbaṅ, ake tšei ye̱ no̱ lo tšei be̱ no̱. Nyehĩe awaä ni nyetše̱re̱a šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ yibii le̱ eko ke̱-baä! Agbene nakai be le̱ dši kleṅkleṅ weinyibii atšu le̱ be.

english_verse: The twelve men left to explore Canaan from the Zin Desert in the south all the way to the town of Rehob near Lebo-Hamath in the north.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱yiṅ ame̱te, ni ame̱yasra ši-kpoṅ le̱ ke̱-dše̱ Zin ṅã le̱ no̱ ke̱-yaši Rehob, heni atšṍo̱ ke̱-yaä Hamat le̱.

english_verse: As they went through the Southern Desert, they came to the town of Hebron, which was seven years older than the Egyptian town of Zoan. In Hebron, they saw the three Anakim clans of Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱tšṍ wuoyigbe̱ le̱, ni ame̱ba Hebron. Dše̱i Ahiman, Šešai ke̱ Talmai, ní dši Anak bii le̱, yo̱. Ši ato Hebron afii kpawo dãni ato Zoan ye̱ Mizraim.

english_verse: After exploring the land of Canaan for
translation_verse: Ni gbĩĩ nyoṅmai-edſe̱ se̱ le̱ ame̱kũ ame̱se̱ ke̱-dše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ sramo̱ le̱ ameba.

english_verse: the twelve men returned to Kadesh in the Paran Desert and told Moses, Aaron, and the people what they had seen. They showed them the fruit
translation_verse: Ni ameba Mose ke̱ Aaron ke̱ Israelbii asafo mū le̱ fẽ ṅõ ye̱ Paran ṅã le̱ no̱ ye̱ Kadeš, ni ame̱yagbaame̱ ke̱ asafo le̱ fẽ, bo̱ni ame̱na, ni ame̱ṅõ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ yibii le̱ ame̱tsõame̱;

english_verse: and said: Look at this fruit! The land we explored is rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: ni ame̱gbale̱ ake: Wo̱te šikpoṅ ní otšũwo̱ le̱ no̱, ni ano̱kwale dši ake̱ *fufo̱ ke̱ wò miho ye̱ no, ni eno yibii ne̱; *

english_verse: But the people who live there are strong, and their cities are large and walled. We even saw the three Anakim clans.
translation_verse: ši mei ní yo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ ke̱ke̱ ni he wa, ni mãdši le̱ atſa gbogbo awo he ní ame̱dăra naakpa, ni asaṅ wo̱na Anak bii le̱ hũ ye̱ dše̱i.

english_verse: Besides that, the Amalekites live in the Southern Desert; the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites are in the hill country; and the Canaanites live along the Mediterranean Sea and the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Amalekbii le̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ wuoyigbe̱, ni Hitbii ke̱ Iebusbii ke̱ Amorbii le̱ ye̱ gõdši le̱ ano̱, ni Kanaanbii le̱ kã ṅšo̱ le̱ nā ke̱ Iordan fā le̱ nā.

english_verse: Caleb calmed down the crowd and said, “Let's go and take the land. I know we can do it!”

english_verse: But the other men replied, “Those people are much too strong for us.”
translation_verse: Ši hĩĩ le̱ ni ke̱le̱ te le̱ kē̱ ake̱: Wo̱nyẽṅ maṅ le̱ hĩe wo̱damo̱, edšake̱ ame̱he wa fèwo̱.

english_verse: Then they started spreading rumors and saying, “We won't be able to grow anything in that soil. And the people are like giants.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ta šikpoṅ ní ame̱yasra le̱ he sane fõṅ ame̱hã Israelbii le̱ ame̱kē̱: Šikpoṅ ní wo̱yakpa no̱ wo̱sra le̱, šikpoṅ ní yeo̱ eno̱ bii ni, ni mei ní wo̱na ye̱ no̱ le̱ hĩĩ oblãṅi so̱ṅṅ ni.

english_verse: and said: We saw the land ourselves, and it's very good.

english_verse: If we obey the Lord, he will surely give us that land rich with milk and honey.

english_verse: So they will no longer be my people. I will destroy them, but I will make you the ancestor of a nation even stronger than theirs.”
translation_verse: Mike̱ gbĕle-hela aaſie ame̱no̱ ni *makpãtã ame̱hĩe, ni maṅõ bo moṅ mafe maṅ wulu ní he wa fèame̱! *

english_verse: that you love to show mercy and kindness. And you said that you are very patient, but that you will punish everyone guilty of doing wrong—not only them but their children and grandchildren as well.
translation_verse: Iehowa le̱ emli fũũ mrã ni emo̱bo̱nale̱ hũ fá, eṅōo̱ no̱tõmo̱ ke̱ efõṅfemo̱ efaä, ši kẽle̱ ehãã no̱tõlo̱ aṅõ ehe aye, ewoo tše̱mei atõmo̱i anyõmo̱ ke̱-tšṍo̱ bii ano̱ ke̱-yašio̱ yino̱bii ní dši etẽ ke̱ mei ní dši edſe̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: I swear that not one of these Israelites will enter the land I promised to give their ancestors. These people have seen my power in Egypt and in the desert, but they will never see Canaan. They have disobeyed and tested me too many times.
translation_verse: *ke̱dši ame̱na šikpoṅ ní mikã ame̱tše̱mei le̱ akitã ye̱ he le̱, fī̃! Ni mei ní gbe mihe guo le̱ ateṅ mokomoko enaṅ. *Lal.

english_verse: But my servant Caleb isn't like the others. So because he has faith in me, I will allow him to cross into Canaan, and his descendants will settle there.
translation_verse: Ši *mitšũlo̱ Kaleb le̱, ake̱-ni sŏro mumo̱ ní ehĩe ni ebomi toi ke̱-wula ši hewo le̱, le̱ le̱ mike̱le̱ aaše̱ šikpoṅ ní ete no̱ le̱ no̱, ni esešibii le̱ anine aaše̱ no̱. *Ios.

english_verse: Now listen, Moses! The Amalekites and the Canaanites live in the valleys of Canaan. And tomorrow, you'll need to turn around and head back into the desert toward the Red Sea. The Israelites Are Punished for Complaining
translation_verse: Ni Amalekbii le̱ ke̱ Kanaanbii le̱ ye̱ dšō̱ le̱ṅ; wó̱ le̱ nyetšṍa nyehe ní nye-tšṍa Ṅšo̱-tšuru le̱ he gbe̱ le̱ no̱ ke̱-yaä ṅã le̱ no̱.

translation_verse: Ne̱ke̱ ṅã ne̱ no̱ noṅṅ nyegbohĩĩ le̱ aaka! Ni nyeteṅ mei fẽ ní akane ye̱ nyensrai le̱ fẽ nā ke̱-dše̱ mei ní eye afii nyoṅmai-enyo̱ ne̱ ke̱-yaä le̱ ní wie hũhū̃hũ šimi le̱,
