english_verse: Even when land is returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration, we will not get back Zelophehad's land—it will belong to the tribe into which his daughters married.”
translation_verse: Ni ke̱-še̱ Israelbii *anyã́mo̱ afi le̱ no̱ le̱, abaṅõ ame̱no̱yelinõ le̱ afata akutšo ní ame̱yadõmo̱ le̱ no̱yelinii le̱ ahe, bĕle̱ adšie ame̱nõ le̱ ke̱-dše̱ wo̱tše̱mei akutšo le̱ no̱yelinii le̱ amli. *

english_verse: So Moses told the people that the Lord had said: These men from the Manasseh tribe are right.
translation_verse: Ni Mose wo Israelbii le̱ akitã ye̱ Iehowa wiemo̱ le̱ nā ake̱: Bo̱ni Iosef bii le̱ akutšo le̱ kē̱ le̱ dša.

english_verse: I will allow Zelophehad's daughters to marry anyone, as long as those men belong to one of the clans of the Manasseh tribe.
translation_verse: Kitã ní Iehowa woo̱ ye̱ Zelofehad biyei le̱ ahewo̱ ne̱: Ame̱gbã moni ame̱sumoo̱ moṅ; ši kẽle̱ dša ame̱gbã ame̱tše̱mei akutšo le̱ mli wekumei le̱ eko,

english_verse: Tribal land must not be given to another tribe—it will remain the property of the tribe that received it.
translation_verse: beni afe ni Israelbii le̱ ano̱yelinii le̱ akadše akutšo kome mli ke̱-mīya aku-tšo kroko mli; ši moṅ Israelbii le̱ ateṅ mofẽmo akpe̱te̱ etäe̱mei akutšo le̱ no̱yelinii le̱ ahe.

english_verse: In the future, any daughter who inherits land must marry someone from her own tribe. Israel's tribal land is never to be passed from one tribe to another.
translation_verse: ni no̱yelinii le̱ akadše̱ akutšo kome mli ke̱-mīya akutšo kroko mli; ši moṅ Israelbii le̱ akutšei le̱ ateṅ mofẽmo akpe̱te̱ eno̱yelinii le̱ ahe.

english_verse: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah the daughters of Zelophehad obeyed the Lord and married their uncles' sons
translation_verse: ni *Mahela, Tirza, Hogla, Milka ke̱ Noa, Zelofehad biyei le̱ gbã ame̱tše̱kwẽmei le̱ abihĩĩ; *

english_verse: and remained part of the Manasseh tribe. So their land stayed in their father's clan.
translation_verse: mei ní dše̱ Iosef bi Manase bii le̱ awekumei le̱ ateṅ so̱ṅṅ ame̱gbã, ni ame̱no̱yelinii le̱ ka ame̱tše̱ wekumei le̱ akutšo le̱ mli.

english_verse: These are the laws that the Lord gave to Moses and the Israelites while they were camped in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.
translation_verse: Ene̱mei dši kitãi ke̱ akpo̱i ní Iehowa tšṍ Mose nine no̱ ewo Israelbii le̱ ye̱ Moab ṅã kplenē le̱ no̱ ye̱ Iordan nā ye̱ Ieriko ṅe̱le̱no̱ le̱.

english_verse: Now, turn around and go back into the desert by way of Red Sea Road.
translation_verse: Ši nye le̱, nyetšṍa nyehe, ni nye-tšṍa Ṅšo̱-tšuru le̱ he gbe̱ le̱ no̱ ke̱-yaä ṅã le̱ no̱!

english_verse: Leave this place and go into the land that belongs to the Amorites and their neighbors the Canaanites. This land includes the Jordan River valley, the hill country, the western foothills, the Southern Desert, the Mediterranean seacoast, the Lebanon Mountains, and all the territory as far as the Euphrates River.
translation_verse: nyetšṍa nyehe ní nyefãa ke̱-yaã Amorbii agõdši ašikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ke̱ hei fẽ ní be̱ṅke̱ dše̱i ye̱ Araba gõdši ašikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ke̱ dšō̱ le̱ mli ye̱ wuoyigbe̱ le̱ ke̱ ṅšo̱ le̱ nā, ye̱ Kanaanbii le̱ ašikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ke̱ Lebanon āhũ ke̱-yaši fā wulu ní dši Eufrate fā le̱ nā.

english_verse: After I gave these instructions to the judges, I taught you the Lord's commands. Men Were Sent To Explore the Hill Country (Numbers
translation_verse: Ni miwonye nihii fẽ ní sa ake̱ nyefe le̱ ahe kitã ye̱ nakai he le̱ mli.

english_verse: You stayed in your tents and grumbled, “The Lord must hate us—he brought us out of Egypt, just so he could hand us over to the Amorites and get rid of us.
translation_verse: ni nyewie hũhū̃hũ ye̱ nyebūi le̱ amli nyekē̱: Nye̱ Iehowa nye̱o̱wo̱ hewo̱ ni eyadšiewo̱ ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, koni eke̱wo̱ abahã Amorbii, ní ame̱kpãtã wo̱hĩe.

english_verse: God has even promised to bless us a thousand times more, and I pray that he will.
translation_verse: Iehowa, nyetše̱mei a-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ahã nyeyi afá fè bo̱ni nyeyo̱ ne̱ toi akpei abo̱, ni edšō̱nye take̱ bo̱ni ewonye ši le̱!

english_verse: even though he had always been with us in the desert. During the daytime, the Lord was in the cloud, leading us in the right direction and showing us where to camp. And at night, he was there in the fire.
translation_verse: tše̱ bĕle̱ enyie nyehĩe ye̱ gbe̱ le̱ no̱, koni eyatao šitōhe ehãnye, nyōṅ le̱ ye̱ la mli, ní eke̱tšõnye no gbe̱ no̱ ní nyetšṍ, ni ſane hũ ye̱ atatu mli.

english_verse: Then all of you came to me and said, “Before we go into the land, let's send some men to explore it. When they come back, they can tell us about the towns we will find and what roads we should take to get there.”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni nyefẽ tſẽm nyetši nyebe̱ṅke̱mi ni nyekē̱: Hã ní wo̱tšũ *hĩĩ komei ke̱-tšṍ wo̱hĩe, koni ame̱yasra šikpoṅ le̱, ni ame̱bagbawo̱ gbe̱ ní wo̱yatšṍ no̱ le̱ ke̱ mãdši ní wo̱yanina le̱ ahe sane. *

english_verse: It seemed like a good idea, so I chose twelve men, one from each tribe.
translation_verse: Ni sane le̱ sa mihĩe, ni miṅõ nyeteṅ mei nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱, akutšo-fẽ-akutšo mli le̱ mokome.

english_verse: They explored the hill country as far as Bunch Valley
translation_verse: Ni ame̱yi mli ni ame̱yakwo̱ goṅ le̱ ni ame̱te Eškol dšō̱ le̱ṅ, ni ame̱yasra dše̱i.

english_verse: Then you came back to the place of worship at Kadesh-Barnea and wept, but the Lord would not listen to your prayers. Israel Spent Years in the Desert Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ni nyekũ nyese̱ ní nyebafófói ye̱ Iehowa hĩe; ši Iehowa kwe̱e̱ nyehīe ni eboo nyegbē toi.

english_verse: You did not want to go into the land, and you refused to obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ši nyesumo̱o̱ ake̱ nyeya, ni nyetše Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, wiemo̱ le̱ hĩe atũa,

english_verse: We are afraid, because the men who explored the land told us that the cities are large, with walls that reach to the sky. The people who live there are taller and stronger than we are, and some of them are Anakim. We have nowhere to go.”
translation_verse: Nẽgbe̱ wo̱o̱tšṍ ke̱-ya? Wo̱nyemimei le̱ ehã wo̱tšui efã, edšake̱ ame̱kē̱: Mei le̱ dăra, ni ame̱ke̱le̱ fèwo̱; mãdši le̱ hũ dăra, ni atſa gbogboi awo he ke̱-yaši ṅwei, ni wo̱na Anakbii tete ye̱ dše̱i!

english_verse: Then I said, “Don't worry!
translation_verse: Ši mikē̱nye ake̱: Nyekahãa ṅmiṅmi mīmõmo̱anye, ni nyekašeaame̱ gbeyei hũ!

english_verse: The Lord our God will lead the way. He will fight on our side, just as he did when we saw him do all those things to the Egyptians.
translation_verse: Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ní nyie nyehĩe le̱, le̱ noṅṅ eewu ehãnye, take̱ bo noṅṅ ní efe ehãnye ye̱ Mizraim ye̱ maṅ fẽ hĩe le̱,

english_verse: And you know that the Lord has taken care of us the whole time we've been in the desert, just as you might carry one of your children.”
translation_verse: ke̱ ṅã le̱ no̱, heni ona ake̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, hĩeo, tamo̱ bo̱ni nū ko hleo̱ ebi, ye̱ gbè̱i fẽ ní nyetšṍ no̱ le̱ no̱ ke̱-yaši beyino ní nyebaše̱ bie̱ le̱.

english_verse: But you still would not trust the Lord,
translation_verse: Ši ne̱ke̱ sane le̱ mli le̱ nyehee Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, nyeyee;

english_verse: You people of this generation are evil, and I refuse to let you go into the good land that I promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši ne̱ke̱ yino̱bii fõdši ne̱ ateṅ moko na šikpoṅ kpakpa ní mikã he kitã ake̱ mike̱-bahã nyetše̱mei le̱ fī̃!

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh is the only one of your generation that I will allow to go in. He obeyed me completely, so I will give him and his descendants the land he explored.
translation_verse: dša Kaleb, Iefune bi le̱, aana, ni le̱ noṅṅ maṅõ šikpoṅ ní eyanyie no̱ le̱ mahã ke̱ ebii le̱ hũ, edšake̱ enyie Iehowa se̱ ke̱-wula ši.

english_verse: The Lord was even angry with me because of you people, and he said, “Moses, I won't let you go into the land either.
translation_verse: Ni mi hũ, nyehewo̱ le̱ Iehowa mli fũmi, ni ekē̱: Bo hũ oyaṅ dše̱i!

english_verse: Instead, I will let Joshua your assistant lead Israel to conquer the land. So encourage him.”
translation_verse: Iošua, Nun bi le̱, moni damoo̱ ohĩe le̱, dši moni aaše̱ dše̱i; wole̱ hewale̱, edšake̱ *le̱ ebadša šikpoṅ le̱ mli ehã Israelbii le̱. *

english_verse: Then the Lord spoke to you again: People of Israel, you said that your innocent young children would be taken prisoner in the battle for the land. But someday I will let them go into the land, and with my help they will conquer it and live there.
translation_verse: Asaṅ nyebifabii ní nyekē̱ abaṅõame̱ nom le̱, ke̱ nyebii ní náko ale ekpakpa ke̱ efõṅ ṅme̱ne̱ le̱, ame̱ ame̱aše̱ dše̱i, ni ame̱ maṅõ-hã, ni ame̱ noṅṅ ame̱aye no̱.

english_verse: Then you told me, “We disobeyed the Lord our God, but now we want to obey him. We will go into the hill country and fight, just as he told us to do.” So you picked up your weapons, thinking it would be easy to take over the hill country.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni nyehere no̱ ni nyekē̱mi ake̱: Wo̱fe Iehowa šiši eša; wo̱o̱te ní wo̱yawu, take̱ bo̱ pe̱ ní Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, efã́wo̱ le̱! Ni nyeteṅ mofẽmo mĩa ke̱ etawūnii, ni nyebule̱ ſe̱mo̱ sane ake̱ nyeakwo̱ goṅ le̱.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Moses, warn them not to go into the hill country. I won't help them fight, and their enemies will defeat them.”
translation_verse: Ši Iehowa kē̱mi ake̱: Kē̱mo̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyekayaä ní nyeyawua, edšake̱ mibe̱ nyeteṅ, koni nyehenye̱lo̱i le̱ akayatſianye nii!

english_verse: I told you what the Lord had said, but you paid no attention. You disobeyed him and went into the hill country anyway. You thought you were so great!
translation_verse: Ni mikē̱nye, ši nyeboo toi, ni nyetše Iehowa wiemo le̱ hĩe atũa, ni nyeši nyetšitši, ni nyekwo̱ goṅ le̱.

english_verse: But when the Amorites in the hill country attacked from their towns, you ran from them as you would run from a swarm of bees. The Amorites chased your troops into Seir as far as Hormah, killing them as they went.
translation_verse: Dšee no ni Amorbii le̱ ní yo̱ nakai goṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ dše kpo ke̱nye bakpe, ni ame̱ſienye, tamo̱ wòbii ſieo̱ mo le̱, ni ame̱hãã nyená ši nyesā gbé ke̱-dše Seir āhũ ke̱-yaši Horma.

english_verse: After we had been in Kadesh for a few months, we obeyed the Lord and headed back into the desert by way of Red Sea Road.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni nyehĩ ši ye̱ Kadeš gbĩĩ pī, tamo̱ gbĩĩabo̱ ní nyele ake̱ nyeye ye̱ dše̱i le̱.

english_verse: until the Lord said: Moses,
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱mi ake̱:

english_verse: And as you go through their land, you will have to buy food and water from them.”
translation_verse: Niyenii tete le̱ nyeke̱ šika ahea ye̱ ame̱deṅ ní nyeye, ni nu hũ nyeke̱ šika ahea ye̱ ame̱deṅ ní nyenu.

english_verse: We went past the territory that belonged to our relatives, the descendants of Esau. We followed Arabah Road that starts in the south at Elath and Ezion-Geber, then we turned onto the desert road that leads to Moab.
translation_verse: Ni beni wo̱ho wo̱nyemimei, Esaubii le̱, ní yo̱ Seir le̱, he ye̱ ṅã kplenē ní dše̱ Elat ke̱ Ezion-Geber le̱ no̱, wo̱tšṍ wo̱he ke̱-yayi Moab ṅã le̱ no̱ gbe̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Don't try to start a war with Moab. Leave them alone, because I gave the land of Ar to them, and I will not let you have any of it.” Tribes That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱mi ake̱: Kāhao Moab, ni asaṅ oke̱ame̱ akawu; edšake̱ mike̱ ešikpoṅ le̱ eko hãṅo; edšake̱ miṅõ Ar mihã *Lotbii le̱ ake̱ ame̱gbe̱fãṅnõ. *

english_verse: The Moabites called them Emim, though others sometimes used the name Rephaim for both the Anakim and the Emim.
translation_verse: Ame̱ hũ abuo̱ame̱ oblãṅi, tamo̱ Anakbii le̱, ni Moab-bii le̱ tšé̱o̱ame̱ Embii.

english_verse: The Lord kept getting rid of them until finally none of them were left.
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱, beni tabilo̱i le̱ fẽ hĩe kpãtã ni ame̱gboi ye̱ maṅ le̱ mli le̱,

english_verse: Then the Lord told me,
translation_verse: Iehowa ke̱mi wie ni ekē̱:

english_verse: Before the Ammonites conquered the land that the Lord had given them, some of the Rephaim used to live there, although the Ammonites called them Zamzummim.
translation_verse: (Abuo̱ no hũ ake̱ oblãṅi ašikpoṅ, oblãṅi hĩ dše̱i sá le̱; ni Amonbii le̱ tšé̱o̱-ame̱ ake̱ Zamzumbii.

english_verse: The Lord helped them as he had helped the Edomites, who killed many of the Horites in Seir and forced the rest to leave before settling there themselves.
translation_verse: take̱ bo̱ni efe ehã Esaubii ní yo̱ Seir le̱, ní ekpãtã Horbii le̱ ahĩe ye̱ ame̱hĩe, ni ame̱ſieame̱ ni ame̱he ši ye̱ ame̱nãdšiaṅ ke̱-baši ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ no̱ le̱.

english_verse: A group called the Avvim used to live in villages as far south as Gaza, but the Philistines killed them and settled on their land. Israel Crossed the Arnon Gorge Moses said:
translation_verse: Ši *Kaftorbii ní dše̱ Kaftor ba le̱ bakpãtã †Avibii, ní hĩ akrowai amli ke̱-yaši Gaza le̱, ahĩe ni ame̱he ši ye̱ ame̱nàdšiaṅ.) *

english_verse: Today I will start making all other nations afraid of you. They will tremble with fear when anyone mentions you, and they will be terrified when you show up. The Defeat of King Sihon of Heshbon (Numbers
translation_verse: Ke̱-dše̱ ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ no̱ le̱ mahã ohe ṅmiṅmi ke̱ gbeyei amẽmo̱ mãdši ní yo̱ ṅwei siši le̱ fẽ, ni ke̱dši ame̱nu ohe le̱, ame̱tšui aafã ni ame̱he aakpokpo ye̱ ohĩe.

english_verse: Please let Israel go across your country. We will walk straight through, without turning off the road.
translation_verse: Hã mahatšṍ ošikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ke̱-ho; gbe̱dšēgbe̱ le̱ no̱ ke̱ke̱ mibanyie, migbaṅ ninedšŭrõgbe̱ lo abe̱kugbe̱.

english_verse: You can even sell us food and water, and we will pay with silver. We need to reach the Jordan River and cross it, because the Lord our God is giving us the land on the west side. The Edomites and Moabites have already let us cross their land. Please let us cross your land as well.
translation_verse: take̱ bo̱ni Esaubii ní yo̱ Seir le̱ ke̱ Moab-bii ní yo̱ Ar le̱ fe le̱, ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní mafo Iordan fā le ke̱-ya šikpoṅ ní Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ke̱-hãwo̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: But Sihon refused to let us go across his country, because the Lord made him stubborn and eager to fight us. The Lord told me, “I am going to help you defeat Sihon and take his land, so attack him!”
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱mi ake̱: Na, mibõi Sihon ke̱ ešikpoṅ le̱ no̱dšō̱mo̱ ke̱ bo hãmo̱; bõimo̱ eno̱yeli, koni ešikpoṅ le̱ atšṍ onõ!

english_verse: We met Sihon and his army in battle at Jahaz,
translation_verse: Ni Sihon ke̱ emaṅ mū le̱ fẽ dše kpo ke̱wo̱ bawu ye̱ Iahaz.

english_verse: and the Lord our God helped us defeat them. We killed Sihon, his sons, and everyone else in his army.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, dšō̱ eno̱ ehãwo̱, ni wo̱gbele̱ ke̱ ebii ke̱ emaṅ le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: Then we captured and destroyed every town in Sihon's kingdom, killing everyone,
translation_verse: Ni wo̱ṅõ emãdši le̱ fẽ ye̱ nakai be le̱ mli, ni wo̱fe maṅ-fẽ-maṅ ke̱ hĩĩ ke̱ yei ke̱ gbekẽbii le̱ musu, ni wo̱ſe̱e̱ mokomeflo.

english_verse: but keeping the livestock and everything else of value.
translation_verse: Koloi le̱ ke̱ke̱ wo̱ha ke̱ mãdši le̱ ní wo̱ṅõ le̱ hũ amli nii.

english_verse: The Lord helped us capture every town from the Arnon River gorge north to the boundary of Gilead, including the town of Aroer on the edge of the gorge and the town in the middle of the gorge.
translation_verse: Ke̱-dše̱ Aroer ní kã Arnon fā le̱ nā le̱ ke̱ maṅ ní kã fā le̱ nā le̱ ke̱-yaši Gilead tō̃ maṅ ko maṅ ko be̱ ní wo̱nyẽẽ, Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, dšō̱ fẽ no̱ hãwo̱.

english_verse: However, we stayed away from all the Ammonite towns, both in the hill country and near the Jabbok River, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Amonbii le̱ ašikpoṅ le̱ ke̱ke̱ he otaa, ke̱ Iabok fā le̱ hewo̱hewo̱ le̱ fẽ ke̱ goṅ le̱ no̱ mãdši le̱ ke̱ hefẽhe ní Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kē̱ okata he le̱.

english_verse: But the Lord told me, “Moses, don't be afraid of King Og. I am going to help you defeat him and his army and take over his land. Destroy him and his people, just as you did with the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon.”
translation_verse: Ši Iehowa kē̱mi ake̱: Kāšele̱ gbeyei; edšake̱ mitule̱ ke̱ emaṅ le̱ fẽ ke̱ ešikpoṅ le̱ miwo odeṅ, ni ofele̱ tamo̱ bo̱ni ofe Amorbii amaṅtše̱ Sihon ní hĩ Hešbon le̱.

english_verse: The Lord our God helped us destroy Og and his army and conquer his entire kingdom of Bashan, including the Argob region. His kingdom had lots of villages and
translation_verse: Ni wo̱feame̱ musu, bo̱ni wo̱fe Hešbon maṅtše̱ Sihon le̱, nakai wo̱fe maṅ-fẽ-maṅ ke̱ hĩĩ ke̱ yei ke̱ gbekẽbii le̱ musu.

english_verse: Sihon and Og had ruled Amorite kingdoms east of the Jordan River. Their land stretched from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, and we captured it all.
translation_verse: Ni wo̱šõ šikpoṅ le̱ ke̱-dše̱ Amorbii le̱ amaṅtše̱mei enyo̱ ní yo̱ Iordan se̱ le̱ adeṅ ye̱ nakai be le̱ mli, ke̱-dše̱ Arnon fà le̱ nā ke̱-yaši Hermon goṅ le̱ he;

english_verse: We captured all the towns in the highlands, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as Salecah and Edrei, two of the towns that Og had ruled. Og's Coffin
translation_verse: ke̱ mãdši le̱ fẽ ní dſere ṅã kplenē le̱ no̱ le̱ ke̱ Gilead fẽ ke̱ Bašan fẽ ke̱-yaši Salka ke̱ Edrei ní dši Og maṅtše̱yeli le̱ mli mãdši ní yo̱ Bašan le̱.

english_verse: At that time I prayed and begged,
translation_verse: Ni mikpa Iehowa fai ye̱ nakai be le̱ mli ake̱:

english_verse: “Our Lord, it seems that you have just begun to show me your great power. No other god in the sky or on earth is able to do the mighty things that you do.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa, bo obõi odale̱ ke̱ oninešiwale̱ le̱ ke̱ otšũlo̱ tšõmo̱; edšake̱ nẽ Nyoṅmo̱ yo̱ ṅwei alo šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ní aanyẽ nii ní otšu ne̱ etšu, alo efe hewale̱nii ni ofe ne̱?

english_verse: The land west of the Jordan is such good land. Please let me cross the Jordan and see the hills and the Lebanon Mountains.”
translation_verse: Mikpao fai, hã ní mi hũ mafo mli ke̱-ya, ní mayana šikpoṅ kpakpa ní yo̱ Iordan se̱ le̱, ne̱ke̱ goṅ fe̱fe̱o ne̱ ke̱ Lebanon le̱!

english_verse: But the Lord was angry with me because of you people, and he refused to listen. “That's enough!” he said. “I don't want to hear any more.
translation_verse: Ši nyehewo̱ le̱ Iehowa mli fũmi, ni eboomi toi; ni Iehowa kē̱mi ake̱: Efá, oke̱mi akawie ne̱ke̱ sane ne̱ he doṅṅ!

english_verse: Climb to the top of Mount Pisgah and look north, south, east, and west. Take a good look, but you are not going to cross the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Kwo̱ ke̱-ya Pisga yiteṅ, ni ohole ohĩṅme̱ii ano̱ okwe̱ anaigbe̱ ke̱ kōyigbe̱ ke̱ wuoyigbe̱ ke̱ bokãgbe̱, koni oke̱ ohĩṅme̱ii ana; edšake̱ ofoṅ ne̱ke̱ Iordan ne̱!

english_verse: Joshua will lead Israel across the Jordan to take the land, so help him be strong and brave and tell him what he must do.”
translation_verse: Ni owo Iošua kitã, ni owole̱ ekã ke̱ hewale̱, edšake̱ le̱ ebanyie maṅ ne̱ hĩe ke̱-foṅ, ni le̱ noṅṅ eedša šikpoṅ ni oona le̱ mli ehãame̱.

english_verse: After this we stayed in the valley at Beth-Peor.
translation_verse: Ni wo̱hĩ ši ye̱ dšō̱ ní kã Bet-Peor ṅe̱le̱no̱ le̱ mli.

english_verse: Mount Sinai was surrounded by deep dark clouds, and fire went up to the sky. You came to the foot of the mountain,
translation_verse: Ni nyetši nyebe̱ṅke̱ ni nyebadamo̱ goṅ le̱ šiši, ni goṅ le̱ here ke̱ la ke̱-te ṅwei šoṅṅ, ni ewo duṅ ke̱ atatu ke̱ oblo̱tu.

english_verse: When God spoke to you from the fire, he was invisible. So be careful
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyekwe̱a nyehe no̱ ní ahĩa; edšake̱ gbĩ no̱ ní Iehowa dše̱ la le̱ mli ke̱nye wie ye̱ Horeb le̱ nyenaa subãṅ ko subãṅ ko:

english_verse: not to commit the sin of worshiping idols. Don't make idols to be worshiped, whether they are shaped like men, women,
translation_verse: koni nyekaye sane fõṅ ní nyefe *amãgã ko ní tamo̱ nū lo yō heno̱ nyehã nyehe, *

english_verse: The Lord was angry with me because of what you said, and he told me that he would not let me cross the Jordan River into the good land that he is giving you.
translation_verse: Ni nyehewo̱ le̱ Iehowa námi mlifũ, ni ekã kitã ake̱ mifoṅ Iordan ni miyaṅ šikpoṅ kpakpa ní Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ke̱-hãao ake̱ onõ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: So I must stay here and die on this side of the Jordan, but you will cross the river and take the land.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mi le̱ mibagbo ye̱ bie̱ šikpoṅ ne̱ no̱ ni mifoṅ Iordan; ši nye le̱ nyebafo ní nyeyanõ nakai šikpoṅ kpakpa le̱.

english_verse: Always remember the agreement that the Lord your God made with you, and don't make an idol in any shape or form.
translation_verse: Nyekwe̱a nyehe ní ahĩa, koni nyehĩe akadše Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kpãṅmo̱ ní eke̱nye ekpãṅ le̱ no̱, ni nyeyafe nibii fẽ ní Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, eguo le̱ eko no̱ amãgã.

english_verse: The Lord will be angry if you worship other gods, and he can be like a fire destroying everything in its path.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, la ní šãa mo kwrakwra dšile̱, Mawu awuṅãyelo̱ ni!

english_verse: In all of your troubles, you may finally decide that you want to worship only the Lord. And if you turn back to him and obey him completely, he will again be your God.
translation_verse: Be mli ní oyo̱ amanehũlũ mli ni ene̱mei fẽ eba ono̱ ye̱ nāgbẽ gbĩĩ le̱ ano̱ le̱, no le̱ ookũ ose̱ ke̱-aba Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ṅõ, ni oobo egbẽ toi.

english_verse: The Lord your God will have mercy—he won't destroy you or desert you. The Lord will remember his promise, and he will keep the agreement he made with your ancestors.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Mawu ní mũsũṅ tšõo̱le̱ dši Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱; ekwaṅo ni asaṅ ekpãtãṅ ohĩe, ni ehĩe kpaṅ otše̱mei le̱ akpãṅmo̱ ní ekã no̱ kitã ehãame̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: When the Lord your God brought you out of Egypt, you saw how he fought for you and showed his great power by performing terrifying miracles. You became his people, and at Mount Sinai you heard him talking to you out of fiery flames. And yet you are still alive! Has anything like this ever happened since the time God created humans? No matter where you go or who you ask, you will get the same answer. No one has ever heard of another god even trying to do such things as the Lord your God has done for you.
translation_verse: Alo Nyoṅmo̱ eka ni eba ebadšie dšeṅmaṅ ko ke̱-dše̱ dšeṅmaṅ kroko mli ye̱ *kāi anā, ke̱ okadii anā, ke̱ nākpe̱nii anā, ke̱ tawū nā, ke̱ ninešiwale̱ nā, ke̱ nine ní akpã mli nā, ke̱ gbeyeinii wudši anā, tamo̱ bo̱ni Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, fe hãnye ye̱ Mizraim ye̱ nyehĩṅme̱iaṅ le̱ lo? *

english_verse: The Lord wants you to know he is the only true God, and he wants you to obey him. That's why he let you see his mighty miracles and his fierce fire on earth, and why you heard his voice from that fire and from the sky.
translation_verse: Ṅwei tō̃ ehã onu egbē ke̱-dše̱, koni eke̱-tšo̱seo, ni šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ hũ ehã ona ela kpeteṅkple le̱, ni ewiemo̱i le̱ onu ke̱-dše̱ la le̱ teṅ.

english_verse: The Lord loved your ancestors and decided that you would be his people. So the Lord used his great power to bring you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Ni edšake̱ši esumo̱ otše̱mei le̱ hewo̱ le̱, ehala ame̱sešibii ní baä ye̱ ame̱se̱ le̱, ni *le̱dientše̱ eke̱ ehewale̱ kpeteṅkple le̱ dšieo ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim, *

english_verse: Now you face other nations more powerful than you are, but the Lord has already started forcing them out of their land and giving it to you.
translation_verse: koni eſie dšeṅmãdši wudši ni he wa fèo le̱ ke̱-dše̱ ohĩe, ni eke̱o aba dše̱i, ni eṅõ ame̱šikpoṅ le̱ ehão ake̱ onō, take̱ bo̱ni eba mli ṅme̱ne̱ ne̱.

english_verse: So remember that the Lord is the only true God, whether in the sky above or on the earth below.
translation_verse: Nohewo le̱ ṅme̱ne̱ ná ole ni oke̱-to otšuiṅ, ake̱ Iehowa le̱, le̱ dši Nyoṅmo̱ ní yo̱ ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱; ese̱ le̱ moko be̱.

english_verse: Today I am explaining his laws and teachings. And if you always obey them, you and your descendants will live long and be successful in the land the Lord is giving you. Safe Towns
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ ye ekpo̱i ke̱ ekitãi ní miwoo̱o ṅme̱ne̱ ne̱ no̱, koni ahĩ ahão ke̱ obii ni baã ye̱ ose̱ le̱, ni ogbĩĩ ase̱ atše̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ ní Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ke̱-hãao le̱ no̱ dā.

english_verse: The Israelites had come from Egypt and were camped east of the Jordan River near Beth-Peor, when Moses gave these laws and teachings. The land around their camp had once belonged to King Sihon of Heshbon. But Moses and the Israelites defeated him
translation_verse: ye̱ Iordan se̱ dšō̱ le̱ ní kã Bet-Peor ṅe̱le̱no̱ le̱ mli, ye̱ Amorbii amaṅtše̱ Sihon ní hĩ Hešbon ní Mose ke̱ Israelbii le̱ gbe le̱, beni ame̱dše̱ Mizraim ame̱ba le̱, šikpoṅ le̱ no̱,

english_verse: and King Og of Bashan, and took their lands. These two Amorite kings had ruled the territory east of the Jordan River
translation_verse: ni ame̱ṅõ ešikpoṅ le̱ ke̱ Bašan maṅtše̱ Og šikpoṅ le̱, mei ní dši Amorbii amaṅtše̱mei enyo̱ ní yo̱ Iordan se̱ ye̱ bokãgbe̱ le̱,

english_verse: from the town of Aroer on the edge of the Arnon River gorge, north to Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: ke̱-dše̱ Aroer ní kã Arnon fā le̱ nā le̱ ke̱-yaši *Sion goṅ ní dši Hermon le̱ he, *

english_verse: Their land included the eastern side of the Jordan River valley, as far south as the Dead Sea below the slopes of Mount Pisgah.
translation_verse: ke̱ ṅã kplenē le̱ fẽ ní yo̱ Iordan se̱ ye̱ bokãgbe̱ le̱ ke̱-yaši ṅã kplenē le̱ no̱ ṅšo̱ le̱ nā ye̱ Pisga goṅ le̱ šiši le̱.

english_verse: Do not murder.
translation_verse: Kāgbe gbomo.

english_verse: That agreement wasn't only with our ancestors but with us, who are here today.
translation_verse: Dšee wo̱tše̱mei le̱ Iehowa ke̱-kpãṅ ne̱ke̱ kpãṅmo̱ ne̱, ši moṅ wo̱ eke̱-kpãṅ, wo̱ ní ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ ní wo̱fẽ wo̱hĩe kã-mo̱ ne̱.

english_verse: but you were afraid of the fire and refused to go up the mountain. So I spoke with the Lord for you, then I told you that he had said:
translation_verse: Mi le̱ midamo̱ Iehowa ke̱ nye teṅ ye̱ nakai he le̱ mli, koni madšadše Iehowa wiemo̱i le̱ matšõnye; edšake̱ la le̱ hewo̱ le̱ *nyeše gbeyei, ni nyekwo̱o̱ goṅ le̱. Ni ekē̱: *

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt where you were slaves.
translation_verse: Midši Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ní dšieo ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ke̱-dše̱ nyṍdši awe le̱.

english_verse: Don't bow down and worship idols. I am the Lord your God, and I demand all your love. If you reject me and worship idols, I will punish your families for three or four generations.
translation_verse: Kādšáame̱, ni kāsúmo̱ame̱ hũ; edšake̱ mi, Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, midši Nyoṅmo̱ awuṅãyelo̱ ní woo̱ tše̱mei atõmo̱i anyõmo̱ ke̱-tšṍo̱ bii ano̱, ke̱-yašio̱ yino̱bii ní dši etẽ ke̱ yino̱bii ní dši edſe̱ ní nye̱o̱mi le̱ ano̱;

english_verse: But if you love me and obey my laws, I will be kind to your families for thousands of generations.
translation_verse: ni minaä mei akpei abo̱ ní sumoo̱mi ní ame̱yeo̱ mikitãi ano̱ le̱ amo̱bo̱.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work,
translation_verse: Gbĩĩ ekpa le̱ otšu nii, ni ofe onii fiā;

english_verse: Respect your father and mother, and you will live a long and successful life in the land I am giving you.
translation_verse: Wo otše̱ ke̱ onye, take̱ bo̱ni Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, woö kitã le̱, koni ogbĩĩ atše̱ ní ahĩ ahão ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ ní Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ṅõ-hãao le̱ no̱.

english_verse: When we were gathered at the mountain, the Lord spoke to us in a loud voice from the dark fiery cloud. The Lord gave us these commands, and only these. Then he wrote them on two flat stones and gave them to me. The People Were Afraid (Exodus
translation_verse: Ne̱ke̱ wiemo̱i ne̱ Iehowa ke̱ gbē ní wa dše̱ la le̱ ke̱ atatu le̱ ke̱ duṅ kpī le̱ mli wie tšo nyesafo mū le̱ fẽ ye̱ goṅ le̱ no̱, ni eke̱ noko fataa he; ni eṅmã ye̱ *te̱i te̱tre̱bii enyo̱ no̱, ni eṅõ-hãmi. *

english_verse: When fire blazed from the mountain, and you heard the voice coming from the darkness, your tribal leaders came to me
translation_verse: Ši eba mli ake̱, beni nyenu gbē le̱ ke̱-dše̱ duṅ le̱ mli, ni goṅ le̱ tšoo̱ ke̱ la le̱, nyetši nyebe̱ṅke̱mi, nyekutšei atše̱mei ke̱ nyenukpai le̱ fẽ,

english_verse: and said: Today the Lord our God has shown us how powerful and glorious he is. He spoke to us from the fire, and we learned that people can live, even though God speaks to them.
translation_verse: ni nyekē̱mi ake̱: Na, Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ehã wo̱na enumnyam ke̱ edale̱ le̱, ni *egbē le̱ hũ wo̱nu ke̱-dše̱ la le̱ teṅ; ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ no̱ wo̱na ake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ke̱ gbomo wieo̱ ni eyi náa wala kẽ. *

english_verse: But we don't want to take a chance on being killed by that terrible fire, and if we keep on hearing the Lord's voice, we will die.
translation_verse: Bĕle̱ mẽhewo̱ wo̱o̱gboi? Edšake̱ ne̱ke̱ la kpeteṅkple ne̱ aašãwo̱ kwrakwra; ke̱dši wo̱kã he wo̱mīnu Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, gbē lolo le̱, no le̱ wo̱o̱gboi.

english_verse: Has anyone else ever heard the only true God speaking from fire, as we have? And even if they have, would they live to tell about it?
translation_verse: Edšake̱ namo yo̱ ádesãi fẽ ateṅ, ní enu Nyoṅmo̱ hĩekãlo̱ le̱ gbē miwie ke̱-mīdše̱ la mli, tamo̱ wo̱, ni eyi ená wala?

english_verse: Now, tell them to return to their tents,
translation_verse: Ya ni oyakē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyekũa nyese̱ ke̱-yaä nyebūi le̱ amli!

english_verse: but you come back here to me. After I tell you my laws and teachings, you will repeat them to the people, so they can obey these laws in the land I am giving them. Moses said:
translation_verse: Ši bo le̱ damo̱ bie̱ ye̱ mimase̱i, ni madšadše kitãi ke̱ akpo̱i ke̱ mlai le̱ fẽ matšõo, koni oyatšõame̱, ní ame̱ye no̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ ní miṅõ-hãa-ame̱ ake̱ ame̱nõ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Follow them, because they make a path that will lead to a long successful life in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
translation_verse: Gbe̱ ní Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ewonye he kitã le̱ fẽ no̱ nyenyiea, koni nyeyi aná wala, ni ahĩ ahãnye, ni nyegbĩĩ ase̱ atše̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ ní nyeyaṅõ le̱ no̱!

english_verse: Pay attention, Israel! Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he promised to give us this land that is rich with milk and honey. Be careful to obey him, and you will become a successful and powerful nation.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo toi, Israel, ni odſẽṅ no̱, ní oye no̱, koni ahĩ ahão, ní nyeyi afá babaō ye̱ šikpoṅ ní hoo̱ fufo̱ ke̱ wò le̱ no̱, take̱ bo̱ni Iehowa, otše̱mei a-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ewoö ši le̱.

english_verse: and houses full of good things that you didn't put there. The Lord will give you wells that you didn't have to dig, and vineyards and olive orchards that you didn't have to plant. But when you have eaten so much that you can't eat any more,
translation_verse: ke̱ šĩai ní ame̱mli eyimo̱ obõbõ ke̱ nibii kpakpai ní dšee bo eke̱-wo mli, ke̱ nubui ní atšatšai ní dšee bo otša, ke̱ weintromi ke̱ mutšei ní dšee bo ote̱o, ni ooye oto̱ le̱:

english_verse: don't forget it was the Lord who set you free from slavery and brought you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: no le̱ kwe̱mo̱ ohe ní ahĩ, koni ohĩe akadše Iehowa, moni dšieo ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ke̱-dše̱ nyṍdši awe le̱ no̱!

english_verse: If you worship other gods, the Lord will be furious and wipe you off the face of the earth. The Lord your God is with you,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Mawu *awuṅãyelo̱ dši Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ní yo̱ oteṅ le̱, koni Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, mli akawoö la, ní ekpãtã ohĩe ke̱-dše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱. *

english_verse: so don't try to make him prove that he can help you, as you did at Massah.
translation_verse: *Nyekakaä Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, take̱ bo̱ni †nyekale̱ ye̱ Masa le̱; *Mat.

english_verse: Always obey the laws that the Lord has given you
translation_verse: Ši moṅ nyeyea Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kitãi le̱ ke̱ edasei le̱ ke̱ ekpo̱i le̱ ní ewoö le̱ ano̱;

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why did the Lord give us these laws and teachings?”
translation_verse: Ke̱dši obi aabio wó̱ ko lo wó̱se̱ ko ake̱: Odasei ke̱ akpo̱i ke̱ mlai ní Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, wonye le̱, té ešišiṅ? le̱,

english_verse: Then you will answer: We were slaves of the king of Egypt, but the Lord used his great power and set us free.
translation_verse: no le̱ okē̱ *obi ake̱: Sá le̱ Farao tšũdši dšiwo̱ ye̱ Mizraim, ni Iehowa ke̱ ninešiwale̱ dšiewo̱ ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim; *Lal.

english_verse: We saw him perform miracles and make horrible things happen to the king, his officials, and everyone else.
translation_verse: ni Iehowa hã okadii ke̱ nãkpe̱nii wudši ní yo̱ gbeyei ba Mizraim ke̱ Farao ke̱ ewe le̱ fẽ no̱ ye̱ wo̱hĩe;

english_verse: The Lord rescued us from Egypt, so he could bring us into this land, as he had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: ši wo̱ le̱ edšiewo̱ ke̱-dše̱ dše̱i, koni eke̱wo̱ aba ni eke̱ šikpoṅ ní ekã wo̱tše̱mei le̱ akitã ye̱ he le̱ ahãwo̱.

english_verse: That's why the Lord our God demands that we obey his laws and worship him with fear and trembling. And if we do, he will protect us and help us be successful.
translation_verse: Ni no aatšṍ wo̱dšale̱ ye̱ Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, hĩe, ke̱dši woodſẽṅ no̱, ní wo̱ye ne̱ke̱ kitãi ne̱ fẽ no̱, take̱ bo̱ni efã́wo̱ le̱.

english_verse: When the Lord helps you defeat your enemies, you must destroy them without pity! And don't get trapped into worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Ni ofite mãdši fẽ ní Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, aatu awo odeṅ le̱; ohĩṅme̱ii akanaame̱ mo̱bo̱, ni kāsúmo̱ ame̱nyoṅmo̱i le̱; edšake̱ no bafe tšõne ahão. Ios.

english_verse: but the Lord chose you because he loves you and because he had made a promise to your ancestors. Then with his mighty arm, he rescued you from the king of Egypt, who had made you his slaves.
translation_verse: ši suomo̱ Iehowa sumoo̱nye, ni ēsumo̱ ake̱ eye kitã ní ekã nyetše̱mei le̱ no̱ hewo̱ ni Iehowa ke̱ ninešiwale̱ dsienye ni ekpõnye ke̱-dše̱ nyṍdši awe, ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim maṅtše̱ Farao deṅ le̱.

english_verse: You know that the Lord your God is the only true God. So love him and obey his commands, and he will faithfully keep his agreement with you and your descendants for a thousand generations.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ ná ole ake̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, le̱ dši Nyoṅmo̱, Mawu ano̱kwafo, ní too̱ kpãṅmo̱ ke̱ mo̱bo̱nale̱ ehãa mei ní sumoo̱le̱ ke̱ mei ní yeo̱ ekitãi le̱ ano̱ ke̱-yaši yino̱bii ní dši akpe no̱,

english_verse: But if you turn against the Lord, he will quickly destroy you.
translation_verse: ni ewoo̱ mei ní nye̱o̱le̱ le̱ hũ nyōmo̱ ye̱ ame̱hĩe, ni ekpãtãa ame̱hĩe; etše̱e̱ ke̱ moni nye̱o̱le̱ le̱ nyõmo̱wo ye̱ ehĩe.

english_verse: so destroy it. If you bring it home with you, both you and your house will be destroyed. Stay away from those disgusting idols!
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ kāṅõ nihĩnii ke̱-mība *owe, ní afeo musu tamo̱ no noṅṅ; nyãṅemo̱ onyãṅeame̱, ni hĩ ohĩame̱; edšake̱ musunii ni. *Ios.

english_verse: If you completely obey these laws, the Lord your God will be loyal and keep the agreement he made with you, just as he promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši nyebo ne̱ke̱ mlai ne̱ atoi, ni nyeye no̱ ni nyeſe le̱, no le̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, aaye ekpãṅmo̱ ní eke̱o kpãṅ le̱ ke̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ ní eka otše̱mei le̱ akitã ye̱ he le̱ no̱,

english_verse: You will no longer suffer with the same horrible diseases that you sometimes had in Egypt. You will be healthy, but the Lord will make your enemies suffer from those diseases. Destroy the Nations and Their Gods Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa aako̱ ohela-fẽ-hela aše̱ afõ, ni eṅõṅ Mizraim helai fõdši ní ole le̱ ekomeflo efõṅ ono̱; ši moṅ eeṅõ-ſie ohenye̱lo̱i le̱ fẽ ano̱.

english_verse: You may be thinking, “How can we destroy these nations? They are more powerful than we are.”
translation_verse: Ke̱dši ookē̱ ye̱ otšui mli ake̱: Ne̱ke̱ dšeṅmãdši ne̱ ayi fà fèmi; té mafe tēṅ ní manyẽame̱ maſieṅ? le̱,

english_verse: But stop worrying! Just remember what the Lord your God did to Egypt and its king.
translation_verse: no le̱ kāšeame̱ gbeyei; ši moṅ kaimo̱ noni Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, fe Farao ke̱ Mizraim mū le̱ fẽ le̱,

english_verse: You saw how the Lord used his tremendous power to work great miracles and bring you out of Egypt. And he will again work miracles for you when you face these enemies you fear so much.
translation_verse: ke̱ kāi kpeteṅkplei hũ ní ona ke̱ ohĩṅme̱ii le̱, ke̱ okadii ke̱ nākpe̱nii le̱, ke̱ ninešiwale̱ ke̱ nine ní akpã mli ní Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ke̱-dšieo le̱. Nakai noṅṅ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, bafe mãdši fẽ ní bo le̱ ošeo̱ame̱ gbeyei le̱.

english_verse: Some of them may try to survive by hiding from you, but the Lord will make them panic, and soon they will be dead.
translation_verse: Asaṅ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, aatšũ sosomotii ke̱-abote ame̱teṅ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní mei ní eſe̱ le̱ ke̱ mei ní etē ame̱he le̱ ahĩe aakpãtã ye̱ ohĩe.

english_verse: So don't be frightened when you meet them in battle. The Lord your God is great and fearsome, and he will fight at your side.
translation_verse: Otšui akafã ame̱no̱; edšake̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ye̱ oteṅ, Mawu kpeteṅkple ní he yo̱ gbeyei ni.

english_verse: As you attack these nations, the Lord will force them out little by little. He won't let you get rid of them all at once—if he did, there wouldn't be enough people living in the land to keep down the number of wild animals.
translation_verse: Ši fiofio Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, bafã ne̱ke̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ aſie ye̱ ohĩe. Kābule ame̱seši šikome, koni ṅāno̱ koloi le̱ ayi akabafá mīwo bo.

english_verse: But when you attack your enemies, the Lord will make them panic, and you will easily destroy them. You will defeat their kings one after another until they are gone, and no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Ni eetu ame̱maṅtše̱mei le̱ ewo odeṅ, ni oohã ame̱gbe̱ii alādše ye̱ ṅwei šiši; mokomoko nyẽṅ ohĩe adamo̱ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní ookpãtã ame̱hĩe.

english_verse: After you conquer a nation, burn their idols. Don't get trapped into wanting the silver or gold on an idol. Even the metal on an idol is disgusting to the Lord,
translation_verse: Ame̱nyoṅmo̱i le̱ amãgãi le̱ nyeke̱ la ašãa; ohĩe akakõ dſie̱te̱i lo šika ní yo̱ ame̱he le̱ no̱ ní oṅõ ohã ohe, koni no akafe tšõne ní edũo; edšake̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, mīhĩ.

english_verse: so he made you go hungry. Then he gave you manna, a kind of food that you and your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was teaching you that people need more than food to live—they need every word that the Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Ni ebao ši ni ehã hõmo̱ yeo, ni eke̱ mána ní olee ni otše̱mei hũ lee le̱ *lé̱o, koni ehã oná ole ake̱ dšee abolo ke̱ke̱ hàa †gbomo yi náa wala, ši moṅ nofẽno ní dše̱o̱ Iehowa dāṅ le̱ hãa gbomo yi náa wala. *

english_verse: So keep in mind that the Lord has been correcting you, just as parents correct their children.
translation_verse: Bĕle̱ ná ole ye̱ otšui mli ake̱, *bo̱ni mo tšo̱seo̱ ebi le̱, nakai Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, tšo̱seo̱o ne̱. *

english_verse: The Lord your God is bringing you into a good land with streams that flow from springs in the valleys and hills.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ke̱o miya šikpoṅ kpakpa no̱, šikpoṅ ní fāi ke̱ nubui ke̱ kpākpoi yo̱ no̱, ni ame̱dše̱o̱ dšō̱i ke̱ gõdši le̱ amli ame̱hoo̱ le̱;

english_verse: You can dig for copper in those hills, and the stones are made of iron ore. And you won't go hungry. Wheat and barley fields are everywhere, and so are vineyards and orchards full of fig, pomegranate, and olive trees, and there is plenty of honey. Don't Forget the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: šikpoṅ ní odāṅ ṅmā̃ ní ooye le̱ he esẽṅ ye̱ no̱, ni nokonoko ehĩaṅo ye̱ dše̱i; šikpoṅ ní te̱i ní yo̱ mli dši dade, ni ootša akō̱ble ke̱-adše̱ eno̱ gõdši le̱ amli le̱.

english_verse: After you eat and are full, give praise to the Lord your God for the good land he gave you.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši oye nii ni oto̱ le̱, dšiemo̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, yi ye̱ šikpoṅ kpakpa ní ehão le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: Make sure that you never forget the Lord or disobey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. If you always obey them,
translation_verse: Kwe̱mo̱ ohe ní ahĩ, koni ohĩe akakpa Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, no̱, ni obayeṅ ekitãi ke̱ emlai ke̱ ekpo̱i ní miwoo̱o ṅme̱ne̱ ne̱ no̱.

english_verse: you will have plenty to eat, and you will build good houses to live in.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱ oye nii ni oto̱ ni omãmo̱ tšũi ſe̱fe̱dši ni ohĩ mli,

english_verse: You will get more and more cattle, sheep, silver, gold, and other possessions.
translation_verse: ni otšinai ke̱ otōi ayi efà, ni odſie̱te̱i ke̱ ošika efà, ni nofẽno ní oyo̱ le̱ eſere le̱,

english_verse: But when all this happens, don't be proud! Don't forget that you were once slaves in Egypt and that it was the Lord who set you free.
translation_verse: ke̱ke̱ ni otšui bawó ehe no̱ ni ohĩe kpa Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, no̱, moni dšieo ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ke̱-dše̱ nyṍdši awe le̱;

english_verse: Remember how he led you in that huge and frightening desert where poisonous snakes and scorpions live. There was no water, but the Lord split open a rock, and water poured out so you could drink.
translation_verse: moni wao ye̱ ṅã kpeteṅkple ní no̱ yo̱ gbeyei le̱ no̱, heni *onũfũi ní nā dšraä ke̱ nyoṅmo̱ṅkrakroi yo̱ ke̱ šikpoṅ ole̱ṅle̱ no̱, heni nu be̱ le̱, moni dšie †nu ke̱-dše̱ tſre̱bo te̱sā le̱ mli ehão le̱; *

english_verse: He also gave you manna, a kind of food your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was testing you to make you trust him, so that later on he could be good to you.
translation_verse: moni ke̱ mána ní otše̱mei lee le̱ lè̱o ye̱ ṅã le̱ no̱, koni eke̱-bao ši, ni eke̱-kao ekwe̱, ní nāgbē le̱ efeo edšŭrõ le̱:

english_verse: When you become successful, don't say, “I'm rich, and I've earned it all myself.”
translation_verse: koni okakē̱ ye̱ otšui mli ake̱: Midientše̱ mihewale̱ ke̱ mininešiwale̱ nā mike̱-ná ne̱ke̱ nii ne̱ fẽ!

english_verse: Instead, remember that the Lord your God gives you the strength to make a living. That's how he keeps the promise he made to your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ši moṅ kaimo̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, edšake̱ le̱ dši moni hãao hewale̱ ní oke̱-náa nii, koni ehã *ekpãṅmo̱ ní ekã otše̱mei le̱ akitã ye̱ he le̱ amã ši, take̱ bo̱ni eyo̱ ṅme̱ne̱ ne̱. *

english_verse: But I'm warning you—if you forget the Lord your God and worship other gods, the Lord will destroy you, just as he destroyed the nations you fought.
translation_verse: tamo̱ dšeṅmãdäi ní Iehowa kpãtãa ame̱hĩe ye̱ nyehĩe le̱, nakai noṅṅ nyehĩe bakpãtã, edšake̱ nyesumo̱o̱ ake̱ nyeboo̱ Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, gbē toi.

english_verse: At Mount Sinai you made the Lord so angry that he was going to destroy you.
translation_verse: Ni Horeb hũ, nyewo Iehowa mlila ye̱ dše̱i ni Iehowa mli fũ ewonye, ní kũle̱ ēhe nyehĩe ekpãtã.

english_verse: Fire was raging on the mountaintop as I went back down, carrying the two stones with the commandments on them.
translation_verse: Dšee no ni mitšṍ mihe ni mikpleke ši ke̱-dše̱ goṅ le̱ no̱, bĕle̱ goṅ le̱ mītšo ke̱ la, ni mihĩe kpãṅmo̱ te̱i te̱tre̱bii enyo̱ le̱ ke̱ minidši enyo̱;

english_verse: I bowed down at the place of worship and prayed to the Lord, without eating or drinking for
translation_verse: Ni Aaron hũ, Iehowa mli fũle̱ naakpa, ni ēhele̱ egbe; ši mikpa fai mihã Aaron hũ ye̱ nakai be le̱ mli.

english_verse: It was a sin for you to make that idol, so I threw it into the fire to melt it down. Then I took the lump of gold, ground it into powder, and threw the powder into the stream flowing down the mountain.
translation_verse: Ši nyenõša ní nyefe, ní dši tšina le̱, miwo ni mišã ye̱ la mli, ni miši ni miw̌ie̱le̱ bo̱do̱bo̱do̱ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní ebó tamo̱ mlu, ni mitši emlumlu le̱ miſie fā ní dše̱o̱ goṅ le̱ mli hoo̱ le̱ mli.

english_verse: You also made the Lord angry when you were staying at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-Hattaavah.
translation_verse: Ni Tabera ke̱ Masa ke̱ Kibrot-Hataawa hũ nyewo Iehowa mliſũ ye̱ dše̱i.

english_verse: Then at Kadesh-Barnea the Lord said, “I am giving you the land, so go ahead and take it!” But since you didn't trust the Lord, you rebelled and disobeyed his command.
translation_verse: Ni beni Iehowa wonye gbe̱ ke̱-dše̱ Kadeš-Barnea ni ekē̱: Nyeyaä ní nyeyaṅõa šikpoṅ ní mike̱-hãanye le̱ ake̱ nyenõ le̱, no mli hũ nyetše Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, dāṅgbē hĩe atũa, ni nyeheele̱ nyeyee, ni nyeboo egbē toi.

english_verse: In fact, you've rebelled against the Lord for as long as he has known you.
translation_verse: Iehowa hĩe atũatšelo̱i dšinye ke̱-dše̱ gbĩ no̱ ní milenye le̱. K.

english_verse: After you had made the idol in the shape of a calf, the Lord said he was going to destroy you. So I lay face down in front of the Lord for
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni miho migbē ši ye̱ Iehowa hĩe ni mikã ši nyōṅnyōṅ ke̱ ſaneſane gbĩĩ nyoṅmai-edſe̱; edšake̱ Iehowa ekē̱ ake̱ ebakpãtã nyehĩe. K.

english_verse: and prayed: Our Lord, please don't wipe out your people. You used your great power to rescue them from Egypt and to make them your very own.
translation_verse: Ni mikpa Iehowa fai ni mikē̱: Nuṅtšo̱, Iehowa! Kākpãtã omaṅ ke̱ ono̱yelinõ ní oke̱ odale̱ ekpõ ni oke̱ oninešiwale̱ edšieame̱ ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim le̱ hĩe!

english_verse: Israel's ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob obeyed you faithfully. Think about them, and not about Israel's stubbornness, evil, and sin.
translation_verse: Kaimo̱ Abraham ke̱ Isak ke̱ Iakob, otšũdši le̱, ni okadi ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱ toiwale̱ ke̱ ame̱nifõdšianii ke̱ ame̱he eša le̱ se̱,

english_verse: If you destroy your people, the Egyptians will say, “The Lord promised to give Israel land, but he wasn't powerful enough to keep his promise. In fact, he hated them so much that he took them into the desert and killed them.”
translation_verse: koni šikpoṅ ní oyadšiewo̱ ke̱-dše̱ no̱ le̱ no̱ bii akakē̱ ake: Nyẽ ni Iehowa nyẽẽ eke̱ame̱ aya šikpoṅ ní ewoame̱ ši ye̱ he le̱ no̱, ke̱ nye̱ ni enye̱o̱ame̱ hewo̱ ni eyadšieame̱ ke̱-te, koni eyagbeame̱ ye̱ ṅã le̱ no̱!

english_verse: But you, our Lord, chose the people of Israel to be your own, and with your mighty power you rescued them from Egypt.
translation_verse: Tše̱bele̱ omaṅ ke̱ ono̱yelinõ dšiame̱, ni ohewale̱ kple ke̱ onine ní akpã mli oke̱-dšieame̱.

english_verse: So I made a chest out of acacia wood, and I chiseled two flat stones like the ones I broke. Then I carried the stones up the mountain,
translation_verse: Ni mife yō̱itšo adeka, ni miko te̱i te̱tre̱bii enyo̱ tamo̱ tšutšunii le̱, ni mikwo̱ goṅ le̱, ni mihĩe te̱i te̱tre̱bii enyo̱ le̱ ye̱ mideṅ.

english_verse: Respect the Lord your God, be faithful, and serve only him, making promises in his name.
translation_verse: Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, gbeyei oše, ni le̱ osúmo̱, ni le̱ ehe oke̱ ohe akpe̱te̱, ni egbe̱i le̱ oke̱-kã kitã!

english_verse: When your ancestors went to live in Egypt, there were only
translation_verse: *Gbomei nyoṅmai-kpawo otše̱mei le̱ ke̱-kpleke ši ke̱-te Mizraim, ni agbe̱ne̱ le̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, †ehã nyeyi efá tamo̱ ṅwei ṅulamii. *

english_verse: Instead, he told me, “Moses, get ready to lead the people into the land that I promised their ancestors.” What the Lord Wants Moses said:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱mi ake̱: Te ši, ni oyanyie maṅ le̱ hĩe, koni ameya ní ame̱yaṅõ šikpoṅ ní mikã ame̱tše̱mei le̱ akitã ye̱ he ake̱ mike̱-ahãame̱ le̱.

english_verse: People of Israel, what does the Lord your God want from you? The Lord wants you to respect and follow him, to love and serve him with all your heart and soul,
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱, Israel, meni Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, *taoo̱ ye̱ odeṅ doṅṅ, ake̱ dša oše Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, gbeyei, ní onyie egbè̱i le̱ fẽ no̱, ni osumo̱le̱, ni osúmo̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ke̱ otšui fẽ ke̱ osusuma fẽ, *Mika

english_verse: and to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. Do this, and all will go well for you.
translation_verse: ni oye Iehowa kitãi ke̱ ekpo̱i ni miwoo̱o ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ no̱, koni ahĩ ahão?

english_verse: Everything belongs to the Lord your God, not only the earth and everything on it, but also the sky and the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Na, Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, le̱ enõ dši ṅwei ke̱ ṅweii amli ṅwei le̱, šikpoṅ le̱ ke̱ emli nii le̱ fẽ!

english_verse: Yet the Lord loved your ancestors and wanted them to belong to him. So he chose them and their descendants rather than any other nation, and today you are still his people.
translation_verse: Kẽle̱ otše̱mei ke̱ke̱ *ahe tšui Iehowa ná, ni esumo̱ame̱ ni ehala nye ni dši ame̱sešibii ní baä ye̱ ame̱se̱ le̱, ye̱ mãdši fẽ ateṅ, take̱ bo̱ni eyo̱ ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱. *

english_verse: Remember your agreement with the Lord and stop being so stubborn.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ *nyefŏ̱lo̱a nyetšuii aketia, ni nyekafea nyehe kue̱ṅtilo̱i doṅṅ! *

english_verse: The Lord your God is more powerful than all other gods and lords, and his tremendous power is to be feared. His decisions are always fair, and you cannot bribe him to change his mind.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, le̱ dši nyoṅmo̱i a-Nyoṅmo̱ ke̱ nuṅtšo̱mei a-Nuṅtšo̱, Mawu ní da ní he wa ní ehe yo̱ gbeyei, moni kwe̱e̱ mei ahĩeaṅ ní ehee nyōṅnii le̱,

english_verse: The Lord defends the rights of orphans and widows. He cares for foreigners and gives them food and clothing.
translation_verse: moni yeo̱ awusã ke̱ okũlafo sane ehãame̱, moni do̱ö̱ gbo̱ he ni ehãale̱ niyenii ke̱ hehānõ le̱.

english_verse: And you should also care for them, because you were foreigners in Egypt.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyedo̱a gbo̱ he; edšake̱ nye hũ nyeyato gbo̱ pẽṅ ye̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Offer your praises to him, because you have seen him work such terrifying miracles for you.
translation_verse: Le̱ dši ohĩenyam, ni le̱ dši o-Nyoṅmo̱, moni tšu ne̱ke̱ nibii wudši ní ye̱ gbeyei ne̱ ní ona ke̱ ohĩṅme̱ii le̱ ehão le̱.

english_verse: But watch out! You will be tempted to turn your backs on the Lord. And if you worship other gods,
translation_verse: Nyekwe̱a nyehe ní ahĩa ke̱ke̱, koni akalaka nyetšui, ni nyekpale, ni nyeyasúmo̱ nyoṅmo̱i krokomei ní nyedšaame̱;

english_verse: the Lord will become angry and keep the rain from falling. Nothing will grow in your fields, and you will die and disappear from the good land that the Lord is giving you.
translation_verse: ni Iehowa mli akafũnye, ní eṅá ṅwei nā, koni nyoṅmo̱ akane̱, ni šikpoṅ le̱ baa edeṅ nibale̱, ni nyehĩe bakpãtã amrõ ke̱-dše̱ šikpoṅ kpakpa ní Iehowa ke̱-hãanye ne̱ no̱.

english_verse: Memorize these laws and think about them. Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and your foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ *nyeṅõa miwiemo̱i ne̱ nyetoa nyetšuii amli ke̱ nyesusumai amli, ni nyeṅõ-fe kaimo̱nrii nyefĩmo̱ nyenidši-aši, ni ame̱tšṍmo̱ hĩenātramo̱nii ye̱ nyehĩṅme̱ii ateṅ. *

english_verse: Teach them to your children. Talk about them all the time—whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Ni nyeṅõ-tsõ nyebii, ni nyewie he, beni otá ošĩa ke̱ beni onyie gbe̱ teṅ ke̱ beni okã ši ke̱ beni ote ši;

english_verse: Write them on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates.
translation_verse: ni oṅmã ye̱ ošĩa le̱ šĩnātšei ke̱ omaṅ le̱ agbói le̱ ahe,

english_verse: Then you and your descendants will live a long time in the land that the Lord promised your ancestors. Your families will live there as long as the sky is above the earth.
translation_verse: koni ogbĩĩ ke̱ obii le̱ agbĩĩ afã ye̱ šikpoṅ ní Iehowa kã otše̱mei le̱ akitã ake̱ eeṅõ-hãame̱ le̱ no̱, tamo̱ bo̱ni ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ gbĩĩ yo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Love the Lord your God faithfully and obey all the laws and teachings I'm giving you today. If you live the way the Lord wants,
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši nyedſẽṅ ne̱ke̱ kitã ní miwoo̱nye ne̱ no̱, ni nyeye no̱, ni nyesumo̱ Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ni nyenyie egbè̱i le̱ fẽ no̱, ni nyeke̱ nyehe kpe̱te̱ ehe le̱,

english_verse: he will help you take the land. And even though the nations there are more powerful than you, the Lord will force them to leave when you attack.
translation_verse: no le̱ Iehowa aaſie ne̱ke̱ dšeṅmãdši ne̱ fẽ ke̱-adše̱ nyehĩe, ní nyeye dšeṅmãdši ní dăra ni ame̱he wa fènye le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: You will capture the land everywhere you go, from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains, and from the Euphrates River west to the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Hefẽhe ní nyenane aasa le̱, dše̱i aatšṍ nyenõ, ke̱-dše̱ ṅã le̱ no̱ ke̱ Lebanon, ke̱-dše̱ fā ní dši Eufrate fā le̱ nā ke̱-yaši anaigbe̱-ṅšo̱ le̱ nā aafe nyehũsũ.

english_verse: No one will be able to stand up to you. The Lord will make everyone terrified of you, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Mokomoko nyẽṅ nyehĩe adamo̱, ni Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, aahã nyehe ṅmiṅmi ke̱ nyehe gbeyei amõ šikpoṅ ní nyeanyie no̱ le̱ fẽ, take̱ bo̱ni ewonye ši le̱.

english_verse: But if you disobey him and worship those gods that have never done anything for you, the Lord will put a curse on you.
translation_verse: ši lōmo̱ dši nyenõ, ke̱dši nyeboo Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kitãi le̱ atoi, ní nyekpale ke̱-dše̱ gbe̱ ní miwoo̱nye he kitã ṅme̱ne̱ ne̱ no̱, nī nyeyanyie nyoṅmo̱i krokomei ní nyelee sá le̱ ase̱ le̱.

english_verse: After the Lord your God helps you take the land, you must have a ceremony where you announce his blessings from Mount Gerizim and his curses from Mount Ebal.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱, ke̱dši Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ke̱o yaše̱ šikpoṅ ní oyaä oyaṅõle̱ no̱ le̱, no le̱ odšadše dšō̱mo̱ le̱ ye̱ *Gerizim goṅ le̱ no̱ ni lōmo̱ le̱ hũ ye̱ Ebal goṅ le̱ no̱. *

english_verse: You know that these two mountains are west of the Jordan River in land now controlled by the Canaanites living in the Jordan River valley. The mountains are west of the road near the sacred trees of Moreh on the other side of Gilgal.
translation_verse: Na, ame̱ye Iordan se̱ ye̱ anaigbe̱ le̱, ye̱ Kanaanbii le̱ ní yo̱ ṅã kplenē le̱ no̱ le̱ ašikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ye̱ Gilgal ṅe̱le̱no̱, ye̱ *More tšei wudši le̱ amase̱i. *

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River to conquer the land that the Lord your God is giving you. And when you have settled there,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nyebafo Iordan ní nyeyaṅõ šikpoṅ ní Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ke̱-hãanye le̱, ni nyeṅõ ní nyehĩ no̱.

english_verse: be careful to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyedſẽṅa no̱, ni nyeyea akpo̱i le̱ fẽ ke̱ mlai le̱ fẽ ní mike̱-ſieo̱ nyehĩe ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: But the nations that live there worship other gods. So after you capture the land, you must completely destroy their places of worship—on mountains and hills or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Kpãtãmo̱ nyekpãtãa *hei fẽ ní dšeṅmãdši ní nyeyaſie le̱ dšáa ame̱nyoṅmo̱i le̱ ye̱ le̱ ahĩe, gõdši groṅṅi ano̱ dšio, goṅkpo̱i ano̱ dšio, tšei ní ebu kusū ašiši dšio; *

english_verse: The Lord has promised that later on he will give Israel more land, and some of you may not be able to travel all the way from your homes to the place of worship each time you are hungry for meat. But the Lord will give you cattle, sheep, and goats, and you can butcher any of those animals at home and eat as much as you want.
translation_verse: Ké̱ heni Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, aahala ní eke̱ egbe̱i aato dše̱i le̱ ke̱o teṅ dšeke̱ le̱, no le̱ gbē otšinai ke̱ otōi ní Iehowa ehão le̱ eko, bo̱ni miwoö kitã le̱, ni oye ye̱ ogbói le̱ amli bo̱fẽbo̱ ní ebaä otšine le̱.

english_verse: It is the same as eating the meat from a deer or a gazelle that you kill when you go hunting. And in this way, anyone who is unclean and unfit for worship can have some of the meat.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni ayeo̱ bāyelo̱ lo ofrote le̱, nakai oye no hũ, moni he tšee aye tamo̱ moni he tše le̱ noṅṅ. K.

english_verse: Do you want the Lord to make you successful? Do you want your children to be successful even after you are gone? Then do what pleases the Lord and don't eat blood.
translation_verse: Kāye, koni ahĩ ahão ke̱ obii ní baä ye̱ ose̱ le̱, ké̱ ofe noni dša ye̱ Iehowa hĩe le̱.

english_verse: All sacrifices and offerings to the Lord must be taken to the place where he chooses to be worshiped. If you offer a sacrifice to please the Lord, all of its meat must be burned on the altar. You can eat the meat from certain kinds of sacrifices, but you must always pour out the animal's blood on the altar.
translation_verse: Ni ošã ošā̃-afo̱lei le̱, lō le̱ ke̱ lá le̱ fẽ, ye̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱, ni *ofo̱lei krokomei alá le̱ atši aſie Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱; ši lō le̱ oye. *K.

english_verse: If you obey these laws, you will be doing what the Lord your God says is right and good. Then he will help you and your descendants be successful. Worship the Lord in the Right Way Moses said:
translation_verse: Dſẽṅmo̱ no̱ ní obo ne̱ke̱ wiemo̱i ne̱ fẽ ní miwoo̱o he kitã le̱ toi, koni ahĩ ahão ke̱ obii ní baä ye̱ ose̱ le̱ ke̱-ya nāno̱, ké̱ ofe noni hĩ ke̱ noni dša ye̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, hĩe le̱.

english_verse: Israel, as you go into the land and attack the nations that are there, the Lord will get rid of them, and you can have their land.
translation_verse: Ke̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, flo̱ dšeṅ-mãdši ní oyaä oyaṅõ le̱ eſie ye̱ ohĩe, ni oyaṅõ ame̱šikpoṅ le̱, ni ohĩ no̱ le̱,

english_verse: But that's when you must be especially careful not to ask, “How did those nations worship their gods? Shouldn't we worship the Lord in the same way?”
translation_verse: kwe̱ ohe ní ahĩ, ní, beni akpãtã ame̱hĩe ke̱-dše̱ ohĩe le̱ se̱ le̱, okayanyie ame̱se̱ ní oyadũ tšõne, ní okatao ame̱nyoṅmo̱i le̱ ase̱gbe̱ ní okē̱ ake̱: Té ne̱ke̱ dleṅmãdši ne̱ súmoo̱ ame̱nyoṅmo̱i le̱ tēṅ? koni mi hũ mafe nakai.

english_verse: No, you should not! The Lord hates the disgusting way those nations worship their gods, because they even burn their sons and daughters as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Kāfe nakai ohã Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱; edšake̱ Iehowa nihĩnii fẽ ní enye̱o̱ le̱ ame̱feo̱ ame̱hãa ame̱nyoṅmo̱i le̱; ame̱bihĩĩ ke̱ ame̱biyei tete ame̱šãa ye̱ la mli ame̱hãa ame̱nyoṅmo̱i le̱!

english_verse: If the prophet says this, don't listen! The Lord your God will be watching to find out whether or not you love him with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: ni okadi lo nākpe̱nõ le̱ ní etšõo le̱ ba mli, ni ekē̱: Hã ní wo̱yanyie nyoṅmo̱i krokomei ní olee le̱ ase̱ ni wo̱súmo̱ame̱ le̱!

english_verse: And when the rest of Israel hears about it, they will be afraid, and no one else will ever do such an evil thing again.
translation_verse: ni otſiale̱ te̱i ní egbo; edšake̱ ētao egblao ke̱-dše̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ní dšieo ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ke̱-dše̱ nyṍdši awe le̱ he;

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives you towns to live in, you may hear a rumor about one of the towns.
translation_verse: koni Israel mū le̱ fẽ anu, ni ame̱še gbeyei, ní ame̱kaye ne̱ke̱ sane fõṅ ne̱ eko doṅṅ ye̱ nyeteṅ.

english_verse: You may hear that some worthless people have talked everyone there into worshiping other gods, even though these gods had never done anything for them.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši oonu mãdši ni Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ṅō-hãao ní ohĩ mli le̱ eko he, ake̱:

english_verse: You must carefully find out if the rumor is true. Then if the people of that town have actually done such a disgusting thing in your own country,
translation_verse: Hĩĩ yakagbomei komei ete ši ye̱ nyeteṅ, ni ame̱tšire̱ ame̱maṅbii le̱ ayi se̱ ake̱: Nyebaä ní wo̱yasúmo̱a nyoṅmo̱i krokomei ní nyelee le̱,

english_verse: you must take your swords and kill every one of them, and their livestock too.
translation_verse: no le̱ bi mli ni otao mli ni obi fitšofitšo; ni na, ke̱dši sane le̱ ano̱kwaṅ ni eye̱ mli le̱le̱ṅ, ake̱ afe ne̱ke̱ nihĩnii ne̱ ye̱ nyeteṅ le̱,

english_verse: That's why you must do what the Lord your God says is right. I am giving you his laws and teachings today, and you must obey them.
translation_verse: Ni kahã musunii le̱ eko *mīka odeṅ, beni afe ní Iehowa mlifũ ní nā wa le̱ se̱ afo, ni enao mo̱bo̱, ni emũsũṅ atšõle̱ ye̱ ohe, ni ehã oyi afá, take̱ bo̱ni ekã otše̱mei le̱ akitã le̱; *Ios.

english_verse: You can eat any clean bird.
translation_verse: Lofõdši fẽ ní he tše le̱, nyeyea;

english_verse: You may eat the meat of cattle, sheep, and goats; wild sheep and goats; and gazelles, antelopes, and all kinds of deer.
translation_verse: ofrote ke̱ bāyelo̱ ke̱ odabo̱ ke̱ soṅãi ke̱ duṅ ke̱ wuo ke̱ otrŏm;

english_verse: It is all right to eat meat from any animals that have divided hoofs and also chew the cud.
translation_verse: ni koloi le̱ ateṅ le̱ kolo-fẽ-kolo ní agba enane kokloto mli ni adša enane kokloto le̱ mli enyo̱ ní ego̱io̱ eniyenii ni etaä le̱, nyeyea.

english_verse: But don't eat camels, rabbits, and rock badgers. These animals chew the cud but do not have divided hoofs. You must treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: Kẽle̱ nii ní go̱io̱ ame̱niyenii ni ame̱-taä le̱ ke̱ nii ní agbla ame̱nane koklotoi amli ni adša mli le̱ ateṅ nii ní nyekaye ne̱: Yoma ke̱ kpẽṅkplẽ ke̱ afutuo̱ko̱; edšake̱ ame̱go̱io̱ ame̱niyenii ni ame̱taä moṅ, ši agblako ame̱nane koklotoi amli: ame̱he tšee hããnye;

english_verse: And don't eat pork, since pigs have divided hoofs, but they do not chew their cud. Don't even touch a dead pig!
translation_verse: ke̱ kplokō hũ, edšake̱ agba enane kokloto mli moṅ, ši ego̱ii eniyenii etaa: ehe tšee hããnye. Nyekayea ame̱lō ni nye-kataä ame̱gbohĩĩ ahe.

english_verse: You can eat any fish that has fins and scales. But there are other creatures that live in the water,
translation_verse: Ni nii ní yo̱ nu mli le̱ fẽ ateṅ nii ní nyeye ne̱: Nofẽno ní yo̱ fĩdši ke̱ nii ní he yo̱ totoi le̱, nyeyea.

english_verse: and if they do not have fins and scales, you must not eat them. Treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: Ši nofẽno ní be̱ fĩdši ke̱ nii ní he be̱ totoi le̱, nyekayea: ehe tšee hããnye.

english_verse: However, you are allowed to eat certain kinds of winged insects.
translation_verse: Lofõdši flikilo̱i fẽ ni he tše le̱, nyeyea.

english_verse: You belong to the Lord your God, so if you happen to find a dead animal, don't eat its meat. You may give it to foreigners who live in your town or sell it to foreigners who are visiting your town. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. Give the Lord Ten Percent of Your Harvest Moses said:
translation_verse: Nyekayea noko *ni le̱dientše̱ egbo; gbo ní hĩo̱ ogbói le̱ amli le̱ oṅõ-hã ní eye, alo ohõ ohã mokpõṅ ko; edšake̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, maṅ kroṅkroṅ dšio. Kāho †tōbi ní tšeko fufo̱. *

english_verse: People of Israel, every year you must set aside ten percent of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: Odũmo̱nii amli nibānii ní ba ye̱ oṅmõši le̱, dšiemo̱ mlidšāi nyoṅma mli ekome dā afi,

english_verse: Also set aside ten percent of your wine and olive oil, and the first-born of every cow, sheep, and goat. Take these to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped, and eat them there. This will teach you to always respect the Lord your God.
translation_verse: ni oye ye̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, hĩe ye̱ heni ehala, koni ehã egbe̱i le̱ ahĩ dše̱i le̱, oble ke̱ owein ke̱ omū le̱ amlidšāi nyoṅma mli ekomekome ke̱ otšinai ke̱ otōi akromo̱bii le̱ fẽ, koni okase Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, gbeyeišemo̱ owala gbĩĩ abo fẽ.

english_verse: But suppose you can't carry that ten percent of your harvest to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. If you live too far away, or if the Lord gives you a big harvest,
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši gbe̱ le̱ yadšeke̱ tšṍ hão, bo̱ni owoṅ nii ne̱ tĕremo̱, edšake̱ heni Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ehala, koni eke̱ egbe̱i le̱ ato dše̱i le̱, ke̱o teṅ dšeke̱ tšṍ le̱, ké̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, edšō̱o le̱,

english_verse: then sell this part and take the money there instead.
translation_verse: no le̱ tšṍle̱ šika mli, ni ofĩ šika le̱ ohĩe odeṅ, ni oyiṅ ke̱-ya heni Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ehala le̱,

english_verse: And since people of the Levi tribe won't own any land for growing crops, remember to ask the Levites to celebrate with you.
translation_verse: ke̱ Levinyo ní yo̱ ogbói le̱ amli le̱, kāšile̱ se̱, edšake̱ ebe̱ gbe̱fãṅnõ lo gbo-šinii ko ye̱ nyeteṅ.

english_verse: Every third year, instead of using the ten percent of your harvest for a big celebration, bring it into town and put it in a community storehouse.
translation_verse: Dā afii etẽ nāgbē le̱ dšiemo̱ onibānii ní ba ye̱ nakai afi le̱ mli le̱ amlidšāi nyoṅma mli ekomekome, ni obua nā oto ogbói le̱ amli,

english_verse: The Levites have no land of their own, so you must give them food from the storehouse. You must also give food to the poor who live in your town, including orphans, widows, and foreigners. If they have enough to eat, then the Lord your God will be pleased and make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: ni Levinyo, ní be̱ gbe̱fãṅnõ lo gbošinii ko ye̱ nyeteṅ le̱, ke̱ gbo̱ ke̱ awusã ke̱ okũlafo ní yo̱ ogbói le̱ amli le̱ aba, ni ame̱baye ni ame̱tŏ̱ro̱, beni afe ní Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, adšō̱o ye̱ onine̱nā nitšumo̱i fẽ ní otšuo̱ le̱ mli.

english_verse: No one in Israel should ever be poor. The Lord your God is giving you this land, and he has promised to make you very successful, if you obey his laws and teachings that I'm giving you today. You will lend money to many nations, but you won't have to borrow. You will rule many nations, but they won't rule you.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, aadšō̱o, take̱ bo̱ni ewoö ši le̱, ni ooṅõ onii ofãle̱ dšeṅmãdši babaō, li ho le̱ ofaṅ noko; ni ooye dšeṅmãdši babaō no̱, ši ho le̱, ame̱yeṅ ono̱.

english_verse: Instead, be kind and lend them what they need.
translation_verse: ši moṅ onine akpo̱ ye̱ eno̱, ni ofale̱ bo̱ni aaše̱le̱ ye̱ efĩmo̱ ní efĩle̱ le̱ nā. Luk.

english_verse: Be careful! Don't say to yourself, “Soon it will be the seventh year, and then I won't be able to get my money back.” It would be horrible for you to think that way and to be so selfish that you refuse to help the poor. They are your relatives, and if you don't help them, they may ask the Lord to decide whether you have done wrong. And he will say that you are guilty.
translation_verse: Kwe̱mo̱ ohe ní ahĩ, ní dſẽṅmo̱ gbonyo ko akaba otšui mli ní okē̱ ake̱: Afi ní dši kpawo ní dši heyeli-afi le̱ eše̱ etã! ní otũ ohĩe owo onyemi ohĩafo le̱, ní ohããle̱ noko, ní eblo̱ etšé̱ Iehowa ewoö, ni etšṍ eša ehão.

english_verse: You should be happy to give the poor what they need, because then the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Moṅ hãle̱, ni kāhã edo̱o ye̱ otšui mli ake̱ ohãle̱; edšake̱ ne̱ke̱ nii ne̱ hewo̱ le̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, aadšō̱o ye̱ onitšumo̱i fẽ ke̱ nofẽno ní oke̱ onine yataä he le̱ mli.

english_verse: But if the animal is lame or blind or has something else wrong with it, you must not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši kpa ko ye̱ ehe, ni efe akpake, lo eſila, lo kpa fõṅ-fẽ-kpa fõṅ ye̱ ehe le̱, kāgbele̱ oke̱-šã afole ohã Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: If the first-born animal of a cow or sheep or goat is a male, it must be given to the Lord. Don't put first-born cattle to work or cut wool from first-born sheep.
translation_verse: Otšinai ke̱ otōi *akromo̱biihĩĩ fẽ ní aafo̱ le̱, dšō̱mo̱ ame̱no̱ ohã Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱; oke̱ otšinai akromo̱bii le̱ akatšu noko, ni otōi akromo̱bii le̱ hũ kāku ame̱he tšo̱i. *

english_verse: People of Israel, if you want to enjoy a long and successful life, make sure that everyone is treated with justice in the land the Lord is giving you. Don't Set Up Sacred Poles or Stones Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Dšale̱ sane, dšale̱ sane se̱ onyie, koni oyi ana wala, ni šikpoṅ ní Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ṅõ-hãao le̱ ahĩ odeṅ.

english_verse: It must be offered at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. Kill the sacrifice at sunset, the time of day when you left Egypt.
translation_verse: ake̱ dša ye̱ heni Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ehala ní eṅõ egbe̱i eto dše̱i le̱, dše̱i ogbe Hehō le̱ ye̱, gbe̱ke̱nāši, beni hũlũ yanyõ ši le̱, beyino̱ ní odše Mizraim le̱.

english_verse: And don't set up a sacred stone! The Lord hates these things.
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ kāṅõ te̱ ko omã ši ohã ohe, noni Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, nye̱o̱ le̱.

english_verse: When you build the altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God, don't set up a sacred pole for the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Kāte̱o tšei oke̱-fe wo̱ṅ-kōi ofata Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, afo̱lešãlate̱ ní obamã le̱ he.

english_verse: When other Israelites hear about it, they will be afraid and obey the decisions of the court. The King Moses said:
translation_verse: koni maṅ mũ le̱ fẽ anu ní ame̱še gbeyei, ni ame̱kaye ame̱tšui nā sane doṅṅ.

english_verse: People of Israel, after you capture the land the Lord your God is giving you, and after you settle on it, you will say, “We want a king, just like the nations around us.”
translation_verse: Ke̱dši oyaše̱ šikpoṅ ní Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ṅo-hãao le̱ no̱, ni oṅõ ake̱ onõ, ni ohe ši ye̱ dše̱i, ni *okē̱ ake̱: Mawo maṅtše̱ mahã mihe, tamo̱ dšeṅ-mãdši ſẽ ní bo̱lemi le̱; *

english_verse: Go ahead and appoint a king, but make sure that he is an Israelite and that he is the one the Lord has chosen.
translation_verse: moni Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, aahala le̱, le̱ noṅṅ oṅõ-to maṅtše̱. Onyemimei le̱ ateṅ moko ohã aye ono̱ maṅtše̱; kāṅõ mokpõṅ ko ní dšee onyemi le̱ oto ono̱ maṅtše̱.

english_verse: The king should not have many horses, especially those from Egypt. The Lord has said never to go back there again.
translation_verse: Ši ekahĩ okpo̱ṅo̱i pī, ni asaṅ eke̱ maṅ le̱ akakũ se̱ ke̱-mīya Mizraim ye̱ okpo̱ṅo̱i *ayifále̱ hewo̱; edšake̱ Iehowa ekē̱nye ake̱: Nyekakũa nyese̱ nyeyatšṍa nakai gbe̱ le̱ no̱ gbĩkogbĩko doṅṅ! *

english_verse: And the king must not have a lot of wives—they might tempt him to be unfaithful to the Lord. Finally, the king must not try to get huge amounts of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ *ekaṅõ yei pī, ni etšui mikpale, ni dſie̱te̱i ke̱ šika hũ ekabua nā babaō ehã ehe. *

english_verse: The official copy of God's laws will be kept by the priests of the Levi tribe. So, as soon as anyone becomes king, he must go to the priests and write out a copy of these laws while they watch.
translation_verse: Ši moṅ aba mli ake̱, beni etã emaṅtše̱yeli sẽi le̱ no̱ le̱, ekwe̱ ne̱ke̱ mla ne̱ no̱ eṅmã eko ke̱-dše̱ wolo ní kã oso̱foi Levibii le̱ ahĩe le̱ mli ehã ehe;

english_verse: Each day the king must read and obey these laws, so that he will learn to worship the Lord with fear and trembling
translation_verse: ni ahĩ edeṅ, ni ekane mli ewala gbĩĩ abo̱ fẽ, koni ekase Iehowa, e-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, gbeyeišemo̱ ke̱ ne̱ke̱ mla ne̱ mli wiemo̱i fẽ ke̱ akpo̱i ne̱ fẽ no̱yeli, ní efe nakai,

english_verse: and not think that he's better than everyone else. If the king completely obeys the Lord's commands, he and his descendants will rule Israel for many years.
translation_verse: koni etšui akawó ehe no̱ fè enyemimei le̱, ni *ekadše kitã le̱ se̱ ní egba ke̱-te ninedšŭrõ lo abe̱ku, beni afe ní emaṅtše̱yeli gbĩĩ le̱ ase̱ atše̱, le̱ ke̱ ebii, ye̱ Israel teṅ. *

english_verse: So when I want to speak to them, I will choose one of them to be a prophet like you. I will give my message to that prophet, who will tell the people exactly what I have said.
translation_verse: Mibatē gbalo̱ ko ši mahãame̱ ke̱-adše̱ ame̱nyemime̱i le̱ ateṅ tamo̱ bo, ni mike̱ miwiemo̱i le̱ aawo enā, ni eewie nii fẽ ní mawole̱ he kitã le̱ etšoame̱.

english_verse: Instead, he will choose one of your own people to be a prophet just like me, and you must do what that prophet says.
translation_verse: Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, bate gbalo̱ ko ni tamo̱mi ši ye̱ nyeteṅ ke̱-dše̱ onyemimei le̱ ateṅ ahão; le̱ toi nyeboa.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Moses, they have said the right thing.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱mi ake̱: Noni ame̱wie le̱ ame̱wie dšogbāṅ.

english_verse: Since the message comes from me, anyone who doesn't obey the message will have to answer to me.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱ moni boṅ miwiemo̱i ní eewie ye̱ migbe̱i amli le̱ atoi le̱, midientše̱ mabile̱ šiši.

english_verse: But if I haven't spoken, and a prophet claims to have a message from me, you must kill that prophet, and you must also kill any prophet who claims to have a message from another god. Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ši gbalo̱ ní aato eyiṅ awie wiemo̱ ko ye̱ *migbe̱i ano̱, ní dšee mi mifã́le̱ ake̱ ewie le̱, ke̱ moni †wieo̱ ye̱ nyoṅmo̱i krokomei agbe̱i ano̱ le̱, nakai gbalo̱ le̱ dša agbele̱. Ier.

english_verse: You may be asking yourselves, “How can we tell if a prophet's message really comes from the Lord?”
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši okē̱ ye̱ otšui mli ake̱: Té wo̱o̱fe tēṅ ní wo̱le wiemo̱ ní dšee Iehowa wie le̱?

english_verse: You will know, because if the Lord says something will happen, it will happen. And if it doesn't, you will know that the prophet was falsely claiming to speak for the Lord. Don't be afraid of any prophet whose message doesn't come from the Lord.
translation_verse: no le̱ ná ole ake̱, ké̱ gbalo̱ ko wie ye̱ Iehowa gbe̱i ano̱ ni sane le̱ be̱ mli lo ebaa mli le̱, bĕle̱ dšee Iehowa wie nakai wiemo̱ le̱; gbalo̱ le̱ dientše̱ to eyiṅ ewie, kāšele̱ gbeyei!

english_verse: For example, suppose you and a friend go into the forest to cut wood. You are chopping down a tree with an ax, when the ax head slips off the handle, hits your friend, and kills him. You can run to one of the Safe Towns and save your life.
translation_verse: take̱ ké̱ biane̱ moko ke̱ enanyo te kō mli ame̱yatō tšei, ni eke̱ enine wó lema le̱ no̱ ní eke̱-yafo tšo le̱, ni lema le̱ fã ye̱ tšo le̱ mli, ni eyatſa enanyo le̱ ni egbo le̱, le̱ le̱ edšo foi ke̱-ya nakai mãdši le̱ eko mli, ni eyi aaná wala,

english_verse: That's why I said there must be three Safe Towns.
translation_verse: Nohewo ni miwoo̱o kitã ake̱: Ohala mãdši etẽ oto le̱.

english_verse: But what if you really do commit murder? Suppose one of you hates a neighbor. So you wait in a deserted place, kill the neighbor, and run to a Safe Town.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši moko mīnye̱ enanyo, ni ewole̱ kã́, ni ete ši ewole̱ ni etſale̱ nõ yiwuiaṅ ni egbo, ni edšo foi ke̱-te ne̱ke̱ mãdši ne̱ eko mli le̱,

english_verse: If that happens, the leaders of your town must send messengers to bring you back from the Safe Town. They will hand you over to one of the victim's relatives, who will put you to death.
translation_verse: no le̱ emaṅ onukpai le̱ atšũ ni ayaṅõle̱ ke̱-dše̱ dše̱i, ni ame̱tule̱ ame̱wo lá he oweleto̱lo̱ le̱ deṅ ní agbele̱.

english_verse: In the land the Lord is giving you, there are already stones set up to mark the property lines between fields. So don't move those stones. Witnesses Must Tell the Truth Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Kātši *onanyo hũsũ ní blemabii le̱ egba ye̱ ogbe̱fãṅnõ ní obaná ye̱ šikpoṅ ní Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ṅõ-hãao ake̱ onõ le̱ no̱ le̱ ke̱-te se̱. *

english_verse: Before you are convicted of a crime, at least two witnesses must be able to testify that you did it.
translation_verse: Odasefonyo kome akate ši mīwo moko ye̱ no̱tõmo̱ ko alo eša ko ní moko feo̱ le̱ hewo̱; ši odasefoi enyo̱ lo odasefoi etẽ dāṅ wiemo̱ nā le̱ sane-fẽ-sane adamo̱ ši.

english_verse: If you accuse someone of a crime, but seem to be lying,
translation_verse: Ke̱dši odasefonyo kũtũmpo̱fo ko te ši wo moko ni eye ehe odase ake̱ etō tõmo̱ ko le̱,

english_verse: If any of you have planted a vineyard but haven't had your first grape harvest, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to enjoy your grapes.
translation_verse: Ni moni efe weintrom ni enáko ebõi *emli yibii yeli le̱, hã ní ekũ ese̱ ke̱-ya ewe, koni ekayagbo ye̱ ta le̱ mli ni mokroko babõi emli yibii le̱ yeli. *

english_verse: When the officials are finished giving these orders, they will appoint officers to be in command of the army.
translation_verse: Ni aba mli ake, ké̱ no̱kwe̱lo̱i le̱ ke̱ maṅ le̱ ewie egbe nā le̱, ame̱to tatše̱mei ní atĕre ta le̱.

english_verse: Whenever you capture towns in the land the Lord your God is giving you, be sure to kill all the people and animals.
translation_verse: Ši ne̱ke̱ mãdši ne̱ ní Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, eṅõ-hão ake̱ onõ le̱ amãdši le̱, *kahã nokonoko ní mũo̱ hĩe mīkã ye̱ mli; *Ios.

english_verse: He has commanded you to completely wipe out the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
translation_verse: ši moṅ femo̱ame̱ musu: *Hitbii le̱ ke̱ Amorbii le̱ ke̱ Kanaanbii le̱ ke̱ Perezbii le̱ ke̱ Hivbii le̱ ke̱ Iebusbii le̱, tamo bo̱ni Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo le, ewoö kitã le, *

english_verse: If you allow them to live, they will persuade you to worship their disgusting gods, and you will be unfaithful to the Lord.
translation_verse: koni ame̱katšõnye ame̱nihĩnii ní ame̱feo̱ ame̱hã ame̱nyoṅmo̱i le̱ afemo̱, ní nyefe Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, šiši eša!

english_verse: When you are attacking a town, don't chop down its fruit trees, not even if you have had the town surrounded for a long time. Fruit trees aren't your enemies, and they produce food that you can eat, so don't cut them down.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši oke̱ maṅ ko mīwu ni obo̱ nsra owo ehe āhũ, koni oṅõle̱ le̱, kādo̱ lema oto ehe tšei le̱ ano̱ ní ofiteame̱; edšake̱ ame̱yibii le̱ eko noṅṅ obaye, kāfloame oſie ši. Ani ṅãno̱ tšo le̱ dši gbomo, ni obo̱ö̱ nsra owoo̱ ehe le̱?

english_verse: You may need wood to make ladders and towers to help you get over the walls and capture the town. But use only trees that you know are not fruit trees.
translation_verse: Ši tšei ní ole ake̱ ayee ame̱yibii le̱ ke̱ke̱ ofite ni oflo̱ oſie ši, ni oke̱-fe kāwo-gbogbo ke̱-bo̱le maṅ ní oke̱-wuo̱ ta le̱ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní ooye eno̱.

english_verse: The judges and other leaders from the towns around there must find out what town is the closest to where the body was found.
translation_verse: no le̱ o-nukpai le̱ ke̱ okodšolo̱i le̱ adše kpo, ni ame̱yasusu ke̱-dše̱ heni agbe mo le̱ ye̱ le̱ ke̱-yaši mãdši ni bo̱le he le̱ amli.

english_verse: The town leaders will wash their hands over the body of the dead cow
translation_verse: Ni nakai maṅ le̱ ní be̱ṅke̱ moni agbele̱ le̱ fè fẽ le̱ mli onukpai le̱ *afo̱fō̱ ame̱dẽ ame̱ſie tšinayō ní afo esẽ le̱ no̱ ye̱ nudšō̱ le̱ṅ, *Mat.

english_verse: and say, “We had no part in this murder, and we don't know who did it.
translation_verse: ni ame̱here no̱ ni ame̱kē̱: Dšee wo̱-nidši ſie ne̱ke̱ lá ne̱ ši, ni asaṅ wo̱naa ke̱ wo̱hĩṅme̱ii.

english_verse: Later on, if you are not happy with the woman, you can divorce her, and she can go free. But you have slept with her as your wife, so you cannot sell her as a slave or make her into your own slave. Rights of a First-Born Son Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši eba mli ake̱ osumo̱o̱le̱ doṅṅ le̱, no le̱ ohã eye ebe ni eya heni esumoo̱, ši obe hegbe̱ ake̱ ohõo̱le̱ oheo̱ šika, ni okayele̱ nyṍṅ hũ, edšake̱ ota ehe.

english_verse: If a son is like that, his parents must drag him to the town gate, where the leaders of the town hold their meetings.
translation_verse: no le̱ etše̱ ke̱ enye le̱ amõle̱, ni ame̱ke̱le̱ aya emã le̱ṅ onukpai le̱ ahĩe ye̱ emã le̱ṅ agbó nā,

english_verse: The parents will tell the leaders, “This son of ours is stubborn and never obeys. He spends all his time drinking and partying.”
translation_verse: ni ame̱kē̱ emaṅ onukpai le̱ ake̱: Wo̱bi ne̱ kaniṅkadšelo̱ ke̱ atũatšelo̱ ni, eboo wo̱gbē toi, nyeṅnyeṅtſibo̱lo̱ ke̱ dā̃tolo dšile!
