english_verse: The men of the town will stone that son to death, because they must get rid of the evil he brought into the community. Everyone in Israel will be afraid when they hear how he was punished. The Body of a Criminal Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ni emã le̱ṅ hĩĩ le̱ fẽ *atſiale̱ te̱i ní egbo, ní odšie mofõṅ le̱ ke̱-dše̱ nyeteṅ, ní Israel mū le̱ fẽ anu ni ame̱še gbeyei. *

english_verse: If a criminal is put to death, and you hang the dead body on a tree,
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši moko fe eša ko ní sa ake̱ agbele̱, ni ose̱ṅle̱ ye̱ tšo no̱ le̱,

english_verse: you must not leave it there overnight. Bury it the same day, because the dead body of a criminal hanging on a tree will bring God's curse on the land. The Lord your God is giving this land to you, so don't make it unclean by leaving the bodies of executed criminals on display.
translation_verse: kāhã egbonyo le̱ *mīhĩ tšo le̱ no̱ ni dše mītše̱re no̱, ši dša ofũle̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ noṅṅ, edšake̱ †moni ase̱ṅle̱ le̱ Nyoṅmo̱ lōmo̱ kã eno̱, koni okabule šikpoṅ ní Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ṅõ-hãao ake̱ onõ le̱. *Ios.

english_verse: Women must not pretend to be men, and men must not pretend to be women. The Lord your God is disgusted with people who do that. Don't Take a Mother Bird Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Yō akawo nū atade, ni nū hũ akawo yō atade, edšake̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, mīhĩ moni feo̱ nakai.

english_verse: If you plant a vineyard, don't plant any other fruit tree or crop in it. If you do plant something else there, you must bring to the place of worship everything you harvest from the vineyard.
translation_verse: Kāfutu nibii sro̱toi enyo̱ odũ ye̱ *oweintrom mli, koni akadšō̱ nibii ní odũ le̱ ke̱ oweintrom le̱ mli nibānii le̱ fẽ no̱ ahã hekroṅkroṅ le̱, *

english_verse: Suppose a man starts hating his wife soon after they are married.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši moko ṅõ yō ni ete eṅõ, ni ehe tšẽle̱,

english_verse: He might tell ugly lies about her, and say, “I married this woman, but when we slept together, I found out she wasn't a virgin.”
translation_verse: ni eflo̱ hĩegbedši asãdši eſie eno̱ eke̱-fite egbe̱i ni ekē̱: Miṅõ ne̱ke̱ yō ne̱, ši beni mibe̱ṅke̱le̱ le̱, minaale oblayō le̱,

english_verse: If this happens, the bride's father and mother must go to the town gate to show the town leaders the proof that the woman was a virgin.
translation_verse: no le̱ oblayō le̱ tše̱ ke̱ enye le̱ aṅõ yō le̱ oblayō he okadi le̱ ni ame̱ke̱-ya mã le̱ṅ onukpai le̱ ahĩe ye̱ agbo le̱ nā,

english_verse: and accusing her of not being a virgin. But he is wrong, because here is proof that she was a virgin!” Then the bride's parents will show them the bed sheet from the woman's wedding night.
translation_verse: ni na, eflo̱ hĩegbedši asãdši eſie eno̱, ekē̱: Minaa obiyō le̱ oblayō, tše̱bele̱ mibiyō le̱ oblayō he okadi ne̱! Ni ame̱ṅõ mama le̱ ame̱lē̱ ši ye̱ mã le̱ṅ onukpai le̱ ahĩe.

english_verse: because he accused his bride of not being a virgin. He will have to pay her father
translation_verse: ni ame̱hele̱ *dſie̱te̱i šekeli oha, ni ame̱ṅõ-hã oblayō le̱ tše̱ le̱, edšake̱ efite Israel oblayō fŏro gbe̱i; ni yō le̱ afe eṅã, ebe̱ hegbe̱ ake̱ eſieo̱le̱ gbĩkogbĩko. *K.

english_verse: the men of the town will take the woman to the door of her father's house and stone her to death. This woman brought evil into your community by sleeping with someone before she got married, and you must get rid of that evil by killing her. Laws about Illegal Sex Moses said:
translation_verse: no le̱ ame̱kpla yō le̱ ke̱-ba etše̱ agbó nā, ni emã le̱ mli hĩĩ le̱ atſiale̱ te̱i ní egbo; edšake̱ efe *hĩegbedšianii ye̱ Israel, ake̱-ni ebo̱ adſamaṅ ye̱ etše̱ we le̱; ni nyedšie mofõṅ le̱ ke̱-dše̱ nyeteṅ. *

english_verse: If an engaged woman is raped out in the country, only the man will be put to death.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši ṅã mli nū le̱ na oblayō ní atše̱ ehe bā le̱ ye̱, ni nū le̱ mõle̱ ni eke̱le̱ wo̱ le̱, no le̱ nū le̱ ni ke̱le̱ wo̱ le̱ ke̱ke̱ agbo;

english_verse: Do not punish the woman at all; she has done nothing wrong, and certainly nothing deserving death. This crime is like murder,
translation_verse: ši oblayō le̱, kāfele̱ noko, efeko eša ko ní sa gbĕle; edšake̱ tamo̱ bo̱ni moko teo̱ ši ye̱ enanyo no̱ ni egbeo̱le̱ le̱, nakai noṅṅ dši ne̱ke̱ sane ne̱;

english_verse: because the woman was alone out in the country when the man attacked her. She screamed, but there was no one to help her.
translation_verse: edšake̱ ṅã mli enale̱ ye̱, ni oblayō ní atše̱ ehe bā le̱ bo, ši moko be̱ dše̱i ní aaherele̱.

english_verse: Suppose a woman isn't engaged to be married, and a man forces her to have sex with him. If he is caught,
translation_verse: Ke̱dši nū ko na oblayō fŏro ko ní moko etše̱ko ehe bā, ni emõle̱ ni eke̱le̱ wo̱, ni anaame̱ le̱,

english_verse: A man must not marry a woman who was married to his father. This would be a disgrace to his father.
translation_verse: Nū ko akaṅõ etše̱ ṅã ní eke̱-mīwo etše̱ hĩe mama no̱.

english_verse: But the Lord your God loves you, so he refused to listen to Balaam and turned Balaam's curse into a blessing.
translation_verse: Ši Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ekplẽẽ ní ebo Bileam toi, ši moṅ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, hã lōmo̱ le̱ tšṍ dšō̱mo hão; edšake̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, mīsumo̱ osane.

english_verse: But Edomites are your relatives, and you lived as foreigners in the country of Egypt. Now you must be kind to Edomites and Egyptians
translation_verse: Kāhĩ Edomnyo hĩe, edšake̱ *onyemi ni. Kāhĩ Mizraimnyo hĩe, edšake̱ oyato gbo̱ ye̱ ešikpoṅ le̱ no̱ pẽṅ. *

english_verse: and let their great-grandchildren become part of Israel, the Lord's people. Keep the Army Camp Acceptable Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ame̱bii ní ame̱afo̱ ye̱ yino̱ ní dši etẽ le̱ mli le̱ aba Iehowa gwabō̱ le̱ mli.

english_verse: When you men go off to fight your enemies, make sure your camp is acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši ofã ta ní oke̱ ohenye̱lo̱i yawu le̱, le ohe no̱kwe̱mo̱ ye̱ nofõṅ-fẽ-nofõṅ he.

english_verse: For example, if something happens at night that makes a man unclean and unfit for worship, he must go outside the camp and stay there
translation_verse: Ke̱dši nū ko ye̱ nyeteṅ ní *he tšee, ye̱ noko ní efele̱ nyōṅ hewo̱ le̱, no le̱ edše kpo ye̱ nsra le̱ṅ ni ekaba nsra le̱ṅ; *

english_verse: until late afternoon. Then he must take a bath, and at sunset he can go back into camp.
translation_verse: ši aba mli ake̱ ke̱-yaä gbe̱ke̱ mli le̱ eke̱ nu adšu ehe, ni ke̱ hũlũ nyõ ši le̱, eba nsra le̱ mli.

english_verse: And make sure that you have a small shovel in your equipment. When you go out to the toilet area, use the shovel to dig a hole. Then, after you relieve yourself, bury the waste in the hole.
translation_verse: Ni ohĩe so̱so̱o ofata otawūnii le̱ ahe, ni aba mli ake̱, ke̱ osõ ši ye̱ nsra le̱ se̱ le̱, oṅõ-tša bu, ni osõ no̱, ni otšĩ noni dše̱ omli le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Instead, you must let them choose which one of your towns they want to live in. Don't be cruel to runaway slaves. Temple Prostitutes Moses said:
translation_verse: Hã ehĩ oṅõ ye̱ nyeteṅ, ye̱ omãdši le̱ ateṅ, heni esumoo̱ ní eehala; kāyele̱ nyṍṅ.

english_verse: People of Israel, don't any of you ever be temple prostitutes.
translation_verse: Israelbiyei le̱ ateṅ mokomoko akafe ehe adſamaṅbo̱lo̱, ni Israelbihĩĩ le̱ hũ ateṅ mokomoko akafe e̱he adſamaṅbolo.

english_verse: When you lend money, food, or anything else to another Israelite, you are not allowed to charge interest.
translation_verse: Kāhe hekpa ye̱ onyemi deṅ ye̱ šika alo niyenii alo nofẽno ní aheo̱ hekpa ye̱ he le̱ he.

english_verse: You can charge a foreigner interest. But if you charge other Israelites interest, the Lord your God will not let you be successful in the land you are about to take. Sacred Promises to the Lord Moses said:
translation_verse: Mokpõṅ dẽ ohe hekpa ye̱, ši onyemi le̱ kāhele̱ hekpa, koni Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, adšō̱o ye̱ nofẽno ní ooṅõ onine ota he le̱ mli ye̱ šikpoṅ ní oyaä oyaṅō le̱ no̱.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you make a sacred promise to give a gift to the Lord, then do it as soon as you can. If the Lord has to come looking for the gift you promised, you will be guilty of breaking that promise.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši owo Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ši ko le̱, kāhã eno̱yeli mītše̱; edšake̱ bi Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, aabi ši ye̱ odeṅ, ni eetšṍ eša ehão.

english_verse: On the other hand, if you never make a sacred promise, you can't be guilty of breaking it.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši onaa owo ši le̱, edšee eša hão.

english_verse: You must keep whatever promises you make to the Lord. After all, you are the one who chose to make the promises. Eating Someone Else's Produce
translation_verse: Noni dše onā le̱, dſẽṅmo̱ no̱ ní oye no̱, bo̱ni owo Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ši le̱, tšuidšŭrõ nā oke̱ onābu wo ši le̱.

english_verse: If you go into a vineyard that belongs to someone else, you are allowed to eat as many grapes as you want while you are there. But don't take any with you when you leave.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši ote onanyo weintrom mli le̱, ye weinyibii le̱ bo̱ni osumoo̱ ní oto̱; ši kāṅõ eko owo onii amli.

english_verse: In the same way, if you are in a grain field that belongs to someone else, you can pick heads of grain and eat the kernels. But don't cut down the stalks of grain and take them with you.
translation_verse: Ké̱ ote onanyo able ní mã ši mli le̱, no le̱ oke̱ onine akũ able le̱ eko, ši nikpamo̱-kakla no̱ ni okawó ye̱ onanyo able no̱. Mat.

english_verse: Suppose a woman was divorced by her first husband because he found something disgraceful about her. He wrote out divorce papers, gave them to her, and sent her away.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši nū ko ṅõ yō ko efe eṅã, ni eba mli ake̱ enáá yō le̱ he mīše̱, edšake̱ ena hĩegbedšianii ko ye̱ ehe le̱, *no le̱ eṅmã mligblamo̱wolo ehãle̱, ni eke̱-wo edeṅ, ni ehã edše ewe le̱. *Mat.

english_verse: If a man and a woman have been married less than one year, he must not be sent off to war or sent away to do forced labor. He must be allowed to stay home for a year and be happy with his wife. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ke̱dši nū ko kpē ayemforo le̱, *ekaya ta, ni akaṅõ nitšumo̱ ko nitšumo̱ ko afõ eno̱; eye ehe ye̱ šĩa afi nākplo̱, ni ehã eṅã ni ekpē le̱ mī aše̱ ehe. *

english_verse: If you are guilty of kidnapping Israelites and forcing them into slavery, you will be put to death to remove this evil from the community. Skin Diseases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ke̱dši ana moko ní *edšu enyemimei Israelbii le̱ ateṅ moko ní ēyele̱ nyṍṅ lo ehõle̱ le̱, no le̱ agbe nakai dšulo̱ le̱; ni nyedšie mofõṅ le̱ ke̱-dše̱ nyeteṅ. *

english_verse: I have told the priests what to do if any of you have leprosy, so do exactly what they say.
translation_verse: Kwe̱mo̱ ohe ní ahĩ ye̱ kpiti hela le̱ hewo̱, koni odſẽṅ no̱, ni ofe bo̱ni *oso̱foi ní dši Levibii le̱ aatšõnye le̱ pe̱pē̱pe̱; nyedſẽṅa no̱ ní nyefea bo̱ni miwoame̱ kitã le̱ pe̱pē̱pe̱. *

english_verse: Wait outside, and they will bring out the item you have agreed on.
translation_verse: damo̱ kpo no̱, ni moni oṅõ nii le̱ ofale̱ le̱ aṅõ awaba le̱ ke̱-dše kpo abahão ye̱ kpo le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Pay them their wages at the end of each day, because they live in poverty and need the money to survive. If you don't pay them on time, they will complain about you to the Lord, and he will punish you. The Death Penalty Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Wole̱ nyõmo̱ ye̱ egbĩ le̱ no̱ noṅṅ, ni okahã hũlũ mīnyõ ši ye̱ no̱; edšake̱ ohĩafo dšile̱ ni no noṅṅ ebo̱leo̱; koni eka-blo̱ etšé̱ Iehowa ewoö ní etšṍ eša ehão.

english_verse: You were slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws. Leave Some of Your Harvest for the Poor Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ni *okai ake̱ oyatšṍ nyṍṅ ye̱ Mizraim, ni Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kpõo ke̱-dše̱ dše̱i; nohewo̱ ni miwoo̱o kitã, koni ofe ene̱ ne̱. *

english_verse: When you harvest your olives, don't try to get them all for yourself, but leave some for the poor.
translation_verse: Ke̱ ōtše omutšei ayibii le̱, kākũ ose̱ oyakpa nidši le̱ ano̱ doṅṅ; ahĩ ši ahã gbo̱ ke̱ awusã ke̱ okũlafo.

english_verse: And when you pick your grapes, go over the vines only once, then let the poor have what is left.
translation_verse: Ke̱ ōtše oweintrom mli yibii le̱, kāyaye kpe̱kpe̱o ye̱ mli doṅṅ; ahĩ ši ahã gbo̱ ke̱ awusã ke̱ okũlafo.

english_verse: You lived in poverty as slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws.
translation_verse: Ni okai ake̱ oyatšṍ nyṍṅ ye̱ Mizraim; nohewo̱ ni miwoo̱o kitã, ní ofe ene̱ ne̱.

english_verse: But suppose the brother refuses to marry the widow. She must go to a meeting of the town leaders at the town gate and say, “My husband died without having a son to carry on his name. And my husband's brother refuses to marry me so I can have a son.”
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši nū le̱ sumo̱o̱ ake̱ eṅõ enyeminū le̱ ṅã le̱, no le̱ enyeminū le̱ ṅã le̱ aya maṅ agbó le̱ nā ye̱ onukpai le̱ aṅõ ni ekē̱: Miwù nyeminū le̱ ekplẽẽ ake̱ eetē gbe̱i ši ehã enyemi le̱ ye̱ Israel; esumo̱o̱ ake̱ efe wùṅyemi femo̱nii le̱ ehami.

english_verse: she must go over to him while the town leaders watch. She will pull off one of his sandals and spit in his face, while saying, “That's what happens to a man who won't help provide descendants for his dead brother.”
translation_verse: no le̱ enyemi le̱ ṅã le̱ atši abe̱ṅke̱le̱ ye̱ onukpai le̱ ahĩe, ni edšie otokota ke̱-dše̱ enane, ni etšẽ ladšō eſie ehĩe, ni ekē̱ ake̱: Ne̱ke̱ afe nū ní sumo̱o̱ ake̱ esā enyemi we le̱.

english_verse: you must cut off her hand. Don't have any mercy. Be Honest in Business Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: no le̱ ofo yō le̱ nine, enii akafeo mo̱bo̱.

english_verse: You were tired, and they followed along behind, attacking those who could not keep up with the others. This showed that the Amalekites have no respect for God.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni ebatuao ye̱ gbe̱teṅ, ni etſia ose̱bii fẽ ní egbo̱dšo̱ ke-nyie ose̱ le̱ anii, beni oto̱ biti ni eto̱o le̱, ní ešee Nyoṅmo̱ gbeyei le̱.

english_verse: The Lord your God will help you capture the land, and he will give you peace. But when that day comes, you must wipe out Amalek so completely that no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ aba mli ake̱, ke̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ehã ohe edšo̱o ke̱-dše̱ ohenye̱lo̱i fẽ ni ebo̱leo le̱ adeṅ, ye̱ šikpoṅ ni Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ṅõ-hãao ake̱ onõ le̱ no̱ le̱, *obule Amalek seši kwrā ye̱ ṅwei šiši. Ohĩe akakpa no̱! *

english_verse: and tell the priest, “Long ago the Lord our God promised our ancestors that he would give us this land. And today, I thank him for keeping his promise and giving me a share of the land.”
translation_verse: ni oke̱-ba oso̱fo ní yo̱ no̱ ye̱ nakai gbĩĩ le̱ amli le̱ ṅo, ni okē̱le̱ ake̱: Ṅme̱ne̱ mike̱ ene̱ mīye odase ye̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, hĩe ake̱ mibaše̱ šikpoṅ ní Iehowa kã wo̱tše̱mei le̱ akitã ake̱ eṅõ-hãwo̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: We called out for help to you, the Lord God of our ancestors. You heard our cries; you knew we were in trouble and abused.
translation_verse: ni wo̱blo̱ wo̱tšé̱ Iehowa, wo̱tše̱mei le̱ a-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ni Iehowa bo wo̱gbē toi, ni ena wo̱haomo̱ ke̱ wo̱deṅmegbomo̱ ke̱ nyṍṅ ní ayeo̱wo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Then you terrified the Egyptians with your mighty miracles and rescued us from Egypt.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ke̱ ninešiwale̱ ke̱ nine ní akpã mli ke̱ gbeyei babaō ke̱ okadii ke̱ nākpe̱nii dšiewo̱ ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim,

english_verse: You brought us here and gave us this land rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: ni eke̱wo̱ eba bie̱ ne̱, ni eke̱ ne̱ke̱ šikpoṅ ne̱ ehãwo̱, šikpoṅ ni fufo̱ ke̱ wò hoo̱ ye̱ no̱ le̱.

english_verse: Now, Lord, I bring to you the best of the crops that you have given me. After you say these things, place the basket in front of the Lord's altar and bow down to worship him.
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱, na, mike̱ šikpoṅ ní bo, Iehowa, oṅõ-hãmi le̱ no̱ kleṅkleṅ nibānii le̱ eko eba. Ni oṅõ-mã Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, hĩe, ni odšá ye̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, hĩe,

english_verse: Every year you are to give ten percent of your harvest to the Lord. But every third year, this ten percent must be given to the poor who live in your town, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows. That way, they will have enough to eat.
translation_verse: Ke̱ ogbe onibānii amlidšāi nyoṅma mli ekomekome le̱ dšiemo̱ nā, ye̱ afi ní dši etẽ ní dši mlidšāi nyoṅma mli ekomekome hamo̱ afi le̱ no̱, ni oke̱-hã Levinyo ke̱ gbo̱ ke̱ awusã ke̱ okŭlafo ni ame̱ye ame̱tŏ̱ro̱ ye̱ ogbói le̱ amli le̱,

english_verse: Then you must pray: Our Lord and our God, you have said that ten percent of my harvest is sacred. I have obeyed your command and given this to the poor, including the Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: ke̱ke̱ ni okē̱ ye̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, hĩe ake̱: Midšie nii kroṅkroṅi le̱ ke̱-dše̱ miwe le̱, ni misā miṅõ-hã Levinyo ke̱ gbo̱ ke̱ awusã ke̱ okũlafo ye̱ okitã fẽ ní owomi le̱ nā; mitõko okitãi le̱ eko, ni mihĩe kpako no̱ hũ.

english_verse: I have not eaten any of this sacred food while I was in mourning; in fact, I never touched it when I was unclean. And none of it has been offered as a sacrifice to the spirits of the dead. I have done everything exactly as you commanded.
translation_verse: Miyeko eko ye̱ miko̱mo̱yeli mli, ni mifiteko eko ye̱ hebulemo̱ mli, ni mike̱ eko hãko gbonyo ko; mibo Iehowa, mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, gbē toi, ni mife nofẽno ní owomi he kitã le̱.

english_verse: Our Lord, look down from your temple in heaven and bless us and our land. You promised our ancestors that you would give us this land rich with milk and honey, and you have kept your promise. The Lord Is Your God, and You Are His People Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Dše̱ ošihĩle̱he kroṅkroṅ ní yo̱ ṅwei le̱ okwe̱, ni odšō̱ omaṅ Israel ke̱ šikpoṅ ni oṅõ-hã wo̱, take̱ bo̱ni okã wo̱tše̱mei le̱ akitã le̱, šikpoṅ ní fufo̱ ke̱ wò hoo̱ ye̱ no̱ le̱!

english_verse: Today the Lord your God has commanded you to obey these laws and teachings with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: Ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, mīwoö kitã ake̱ oye ekpo̱i ke̱ emlai le̱ ano̱, nohewo̱ le̱ oke̱ otšui fẽ ke̱ osusuma fẽ aye no̱ ní ofe hũ!

english_verse: In response, you have agreed that the Lord will be your God, that you will obey all his laws and teachings, and that you will listen when he speaks to you.
translation_verse: Ṅme̱ne̱ ogba mli okē̱ Iehowa ake̱ le̱ dši o-Nyoṅmo̱, ni oonyie egbèi le̱ ano̱, ni ooye ekpo̱i ke̱ ekitãi ke̱ emlai le̱ ano̱, ni oobo egbē toi.

english_verse: Since you have agreed to obey the Lord, he has agreed that you will be his people and that you will belong to him, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa hũ egba mli ekē̱o ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ ake̱ le̱dientše̱ emaṅ dšio, take̱ bo̱ni ewoö ši le̱, koni oye ekitãi le̱ fẽ no̱,

english_verse: The Lord created all nations, but he will make you more famous than any of them, and you will receive more praise and honor. You will belong only to the Lord your God, just as he promised.
translation_verse: ni ehã *okwo̱ godšō fè dšeṅmãdši fẽ ní efe le̱ ye̱ †yidšiemo̱ ke̱ gbe̱i ke̱ anumnyam mli, ni otšṍ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, maṅ kroṅkroṅ, take̱ boni ekē̱ le̱. *

english_verse: Moses stood together with the leaders and told the people of Israel: Obey all the laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: Ni Mose ke̱ Israel onukpai le̱ kpã wo maṅ le̱ toiiaṅ ake̱: Kitãi fẽ ní miwoo̱nye ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ le̱, nyeyea no̱.

english_verse: At this same place, build an altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God. But don't use stones that have been cut with iron tools.
translation_verse: Ni omã afo̱lešãlate̱ ye̱ dše̱i ohã Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, *te̱-afo̱lešãlate̱; kāwó dade no̱ ye̱ ame̱no̱. *

english_verse: Look for stones that can be used without being cut. Then offer sacrifices to please the Lord, burning them completely on the altar.
translation_verse: Te̱i mudši oke̱-mã Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱, ni ošã šā̃-afo̱lei ye̱ no̱ ohã Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Then everyone will look at you and your descendants and realize that the Lord has placed you under a curse.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱atšṍ okadi ke̱ nākpe̱nõ ye̱ bo ke̱ osešibii le̱ ahe ke̱-ate nāno̱,

english_verse: You'll have only a few children, your crops will be small, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats won't produce many young.
translation_verse: Aalomo̱ omũsũṅbii ke̱ ošikpoṅ le̱ no̱ nibānii ke̱ otšinai abii ke̱ otōi abii.

english_verse: He will send dust and sandstorms instead of rain, and you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Iehowa aaha nu ni aane̱ ošikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ atšṍ mlu ke̱ šia: eedše̱ ṅwei ebaſie ono̱ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní ohĩe aakpãtã.

english_verse: The Lord will let you be defeated by your enemies, and you will scatter in all directions. You will be a horrible sight for the other nations to see,
translation_verse: Iehowa ahã atſiao nii ye̱ ohenye̱lo̱i ahĩe; gbe̱ kome no̱ ootšṍ oyatuaame̱, ši gbè̱i kpawo no̱ ootsṍ odšo foi ye̱ ame̱hĩe, ni aagbe̱o aſã šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ maṅtše̱yelihei le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: Your cattle will be killed while you watch, but you won't get to eat any of the meat. Your donkeys and sheep will be stolen from you, and no one will be around to force your enemies to give them back.
translation_verse: Aagbe otšina ye̱ ohĩe, ši oyeṅ eko; aašõ otedši ye̱ ohĩe, ni ake̱-hãṅo doṅṅ; aaṅõ otōi ahã ohenye̱lo̱i, ni onáṅ moko ahereo.

english_verse: Your sons and daughters will be dragged off to a foreign country, while you stand there helpless. And even if you watch for them until you go blind, you will never see them again.
translation_verse: Aaṅõ obihĩĩ ke̱ obiyei ahã maṅ kroko, ni oona ke̱ ohĩṅme̱ii, ni ohĩṅme̱i aašiu ke̱ ame̱gbe̱kwe̱mo̱ dā dšenamo̱, ši onyẽṅ noko ofe.

english_verse: What you see will be so horrible that you will go insane,
translation_verse: Ni ohĩenāno̱nii ní oona le̱ so̱ṅṅ aawoö se̱ke̱.

english_verse: and the Lord will punish you from head to toe with boils that never heal.
translation_verse: Iehowa aahã asãnei ní dsraä ní anyẽṅ atša ahão atšẽrẽ onakutšei ke̱ oſŭo̱dši ahe, ke̱-dše̱ onaneši āhũ ke̱-yaši oyiteṅ pampam.

english_verse: The Lord will let you and your king be taken captive to a country that you and your ancestors have never even heard of, and there you will have to worship idols made of wood and stone.
translation_verse: Iehowa aakplao ke̱ omaṅtše̱ ní ooṅõto ono̱ le̱ ke̱-ate maṅ ní bo lo otše̱mei le̱ lee le̱ mli, ni *dše̱i oyasúmo̱ nyoṅmo̱i krokomei, tšei ke̱ te̱i, ye̱. *

english_verse: People of nearby countries will shudder when they see your terrible troubles, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: Ni ootšṍ *nākpe̱nõ ko, abe̱būnõ ke̱ kpã-lamo̱nõ ye̱ mãdši fẽ ní Iehowa akplao ke̱-ate ame̱ṅõ le̱ ateṅ. *

english_verse: You will plant a lot of seed, but gather a small harvest, because locusts will eat your crops.
translation_verse: Nidũmo̱nii *babaō oke̱-ate ṅmõ mli, ši fio pe̱ ookpa ke̱-ba; edšake̱ bālabii aaye. *Ier.

english_verse: You will plant vineyards and work hard at taking care of them, but you won't gather any grapes, much less get any wine, because the vines themselves will be eaten by worms.
translation_verse: Oofe weintromi ni oohũ mli, ši onuṅ wein le̱ eko ni otseṅ yibii le̱ hũ eko, edšake̱ gõgõmii aaye.

english_verse: Even if your olive trees grow everywhere in your country, the olives will fall off before they are ready, and there won't be enough olive oil for combing your hair.
translation_verse: Ooná mũtšei ye̱ okpokpai le̱ fẽ no̱, ši okpaṅ mũ le̱ eko; edšake̱ omũtšei le̱ ayibii aakpla.

english_verse: Even your children will be taken as prisoners of war.
translation_verse: Oofo̱ bihĩĩ ke̱ biyei, ši dšee onii ni; edšake̱ aaṅõame̱ nom.

english_verse: Locusts will eat your crops and strip your trees of leaves and fruit.
translation_verse: Otukpe̱i aafite otšei ke̱ ošikpoṅ le̱ no̱ nibānii fẽ.

english_verse: Foreigners in your towns will become wealthy and powerful, while you become poor and powerless.
translation_verse: Gbo̱ ní ke̱o yo̱ le̱ aahĩ kwē̱ he godšō fèo, ši bo le̱ šibā he ookã.

english_verse: You will be so short of money that you will have to borrow from those foreigners. They will be the leaders in the community, and you will be the followers. More Curses for Disobedience Moses said:
translation_verse: Le̱ le̱ eeṅõ enii efao, ši bo le̱ onáṅ noko ofale̱; le̱ le̱ eetšṍ yitšo, ši bo le̱ ootšṍ lei. K.

english_verse: Israel, if you don't obey the laws and teachings that the Lord your God is giving you, he will send these curses to chase, attack, and destroy you.
translation_verse: Ni ne̱ke̱ lōmo̱i ne̱ fẽ aaba ono̱, ni ame̱nyie ose̱ ni ame̱aninao ke̱-yaši beyino ní ohĩe aakpãtã, edšake̱ oboo Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, gbē toi, ní oye ekitãi ke̱ ekpo̱i ní ewoö le̱ no̱.

english_verse: If the Lord makes you wealthy, but you don't joyfully worship and honor him,
translation_verse: edšake̱ oke̱ mīše̱ ke̱ tšuidšŭrõ súmo̱o̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ye̱ nii ní ona babaō le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: he will send enemies to attack you and make you their slaves. Then you will live in poverty with nothing to eat, drink, or wear, and your owners will work you to death.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ ohenye̱lo̱i ní Iehowa aatšũ abaſie ono̱ le̱, oosúmo̱ame̱ ye̱ hõmo̱ ke̱ kũmai ke̱ yayainyiemo̱ ke̱ nibii fẽ he ohĩayeli mli, ni eeṅõ dade apã ewo okue̱, ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni eekpãtã ohĩe.

english_verse: Foreigners who speak a strange language will be sent to attack you without warning, just like an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: Iehowa aatē dšeṅmaṅ ko ši *awoö ke̱-adše̱ šoṅṅ, ke̱-adše̱ šikpoṅ nāgbēhei le̱, tamo̱ okropoṅ flikio̱ le̱, maṅ ko ní †onuu ame̱wieme̱, *Ier.

english_verse: They won't show any mercy, and they will have no respect for old people or pity for children.
translation_verse: maṅ ní hĩe wa, ní ame̱hĩe eſiee onukpa hĩeaṅ, ni gbekẽ hũ ame̱naale̱ mo̱bo̱; Dan.

english_verse: They will take your cattle, sheep, goats, grain, wine, and olive oil, then leave you to starve.
translation_verse: ni eeye okoloi abii ke̱ ošikpoṅ no̱ nibānii le̱ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní oofite; edšake̱ eſe̱ṅ able lo wein lo mũ lo otšinabii lo otōbii le̱ eko ehãṅo, ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní eekpãtã ohĩe kwrā,

english_verse: All over the land that the Lord your God gave you, the enemy army will surround your towns. You may feel safe inside your town walls, but the enemy will tear them down,
translation_verse: Ni ame̱asá oyi ye̱ omãdši fiā mli ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní ogbogboi groṅṅi ní wa, ní oṅõo̱ ohĩe ofõo̱ no̱ le̱, aaba ši ye̱ ošikpoṅ le̱ fẽ no̱; ni ame̱asá oyi ye̱ omãdši le̱ fìā mli ye̱ ošikpoṅ ní Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ṅõ-hãao le̱ fẽ no̱.

english_verse: while you wait in horror. Finally, you will get so hungry that you will eat the sons and daughters that the Lord gave you.
translation_verse: Ni ooye bodientše̱ *omũsũṅbii, obihĩĩ ke̱ obiyei ní Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ehão le̱ alō, ye̱ yisámo̱ le̱ ke̱ fĩmo̱ ní ohenye̱lo̱i le̱ aahã afĩo le̱ mli. *

english_verse: Because of hunger, a man who had been gentle and kind will eat his own children and refuse to share the meal with his brother or wife or with his other children.
translation_verse: āhũ po ní ehãṅ ame̱teṅ moko ebii ní eyeo le̱ alō le̱ eko; edšake̱ yisámo̱ le̱ ke̱ fĩmo̱ ní ohenye̱lo̱i le̱ aahã afĩo ye̱ omãdši le̱ ſẽ mli le̱ hewo̱ le̱ nokonoko eſe̱ṅ hãṅo.

english_verse: A woman may have grown up in such luxury that she never had to put a foot on the ground. But times will be so bad that she will secretly eat both her newborn baby and the afterbirth, without sharing any with her husband or her other children. Disobedience Brings Destruction Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: ke̱ efo̱mo̱nii ní dše̱ enãdši ateṅ ke̱ ebii ní efo̱ le̱; edšake̱ eeyeame̱ nĩgĩ ye̱ fĩ ní nofẽno efĩle̱ le̱ hewo̱, ye̱ yisámo̱ le̱ ke̱ fĩmo̱ ní ohenye̱lo̱i le̱ aahã afīo ye̱ omãdši le̱ amli le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: like those you were so afraid of in Egypt.
translation_verse: ni eehã *Mizraim tšẽṅemo̱ helai ní ošeo le̱ fẽ aba ono̱, ni ame̱aka ohe. *K.

english_verse: Remember! If the Lord decides to destroy your nation, he can use any disease or disaster, not just the ones written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ helai sro̱toi ke̱ haomo̱i sro̱toi ní atšĩko tã ye̱ ne̱ke̱ mlawolo ne̱ mli le̱, Iehowa ke̱-aba ono̱ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní ohĩe aakpãtã.

english_verse: There are as many of you now as the stars in the sky, but if you disobey the Lord your God, only a few of you will be left.
translation_verse: Ni nyeyi fio ke̱ke̱ aaſe̱, tše̱ sá le̱ nyeyi fá *tamo̱ ṅwei ṅulamii; edšake̱ nyeboo Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, gbē toi. *

english_verse: The Lord is happy to make you successful and to help your nation grow while you conquer the land. But if you disobey him, he will be just as happy to pull you up by your roots.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱, bo̱ni Iehowa nyã́ he ake̱ eefenye edšŭrõ ní ehã nyeyi afá le̱, nakai noṅṅ Iehowa *aanyã́ he ake̱ eekpãtã nyehĩe ni efitenye, ni aafãmo̱nye ke̱-adše̱ šikpoṅ ní nyeyaä nyeyaṅõ le̱ no̱ aſie. *Abe̱i

english_verse: Those of you that survive will be scattered to every nation on earth, and you will have to worship stone and wood idols that never helped you or your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa aagbeo aſã mãdši fẽ amli ke̱-dše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbēhe bie̱ ke̱-yaši, šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbēhe bie̱, ni dše̱i ooya-súmo̱ nyoṅmo̱i krokomei ní bo alo otše̱mei le̱ lee, ní dši tšei ke̱ te̱i le̱, ye̱.

english_verse: Each morning you will wake up to such terrible sights that you will say, “I wish it were night!” But at night you will be terrified and say, “I wish it were day!”
translation_verse: Lebi le̱ ookē̱: Miná ní dše na! ni gbe̱ke̱ le̱ ookē̱: Miná ní dše tše̱re! ye̱ otšuifā̃ ní hãa ohe kpokpoo̱ ke̱ ohĩenāno̱nii ní oona le̱ ahewo̱.

english_verse: I told you never to go back to Egypt. But now the Lord himself will load you on ships and send you back. Then you will even try to sell yourselves as slaves, but no one will be interested.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa aaṅõo ke̱-ate Mizraim ekoṅ ye̱ le̱dši amli ye̱ gbe̱ ní mikē̱o ye̱ he ake̱: *Onaṅ doṅṅ le̱ no̱, ni aahõhō̃nye ahã nyehenye̱lo̱i le̱ ye̱ dše̱i ake̱ nyṍdšihĩĩ ke̱ nyódšiyei, ni moko heṅnye tete. *

english_verse: Moses called the nation of Israel together and told them: When you were in Egypt, you saw the Lord perform great miracles that caused trouble for the king, his officials, and everyone else in the country.
translation_verse: Ši Iehowa hãkonye *tšui ní nyeke̱-ale nii ke̱ hĩṅme̱ii ní nyeke̱-ana nii ke̱ toii ní nyeke̱-anu nii ke̱-baši ṅme̱ne̱. *

english_verse: When we first camped here, King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan attacked, but we defeated them.
translation_verse: ni wo̱ṅõ ame̱šikpoṅ le̱ ni wo̱ke̱-hã Rubenbii ke̱ Gadbii ke̱ Manasebii akutšo le̱ fã ake̱ ame̱gbe̱fãṅnõ.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord has made an agreement with you, and if you keep your part, you will be successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Nyefẽ nyedamo̱ ye̱ Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, hĩe ṅme̱ne̱ ne̱: nyekutsei-atše̱mei ke̱ nyekutšei ke̱ nyenukpai ke̱ nyeno̱kwe̱lo̱i ke̱ Israel hĩĩ fẽ,

english_verse: When we lived in Egypt, you saw the Egyptians worship disgusting idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold. Then as we traveled through other nations, you saw those people worship other disgusting idols.
translation_verse: koni nū ko lo yō ko lo weku ko lo akutšo ko akahĩ nyeteṅ, ní etšui mīkpale ke̱-mīdše Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, he ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱, ní ete ní eyasúmo̱ nakai dšeṅmãdši le̱ anyoṅmo̱i le̱, ni *tšošišifã ko ní woo̱ ko̱liko̱ ke̱ ebō̱ akahĩ nyeteṅ. *Heb.

english_verse: So make sure that everyone in your tribe remains faithful to the Lord and never starts worshiping gods of other nations. If even one of you worships idols, you will be like the root of a plant that produces bitter, poisonous fruit.
translation_verse: Ni ebaba mli ake̱, ké̱ enu ne̱ke̱ kitã ne̱ wiemoi le̱, ní ehã ehe tšui, ekē̱: Minyie mitsui wadšemo̱ mli moṅ, kẽle̱ mihe badšo̱mi; ní abafite moni eto̱ kpo̱tō̱ le̱ ke̱ moni kũmai yeo̱le̱ le̱ fẽ šikome!

english_verse: The Lord will be furious, and instead of forgiving you, he will separate you from the other tribes. Then he will destroy you, by piling on you all the curses in The Book of God's Law, and you will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Ni yino̱bii ní baba le̱ aagba he sane, — nyebii ní aate ši ye̱ nyese̱ le̱, ke̱ mokpõṅ ní aadše̱ maṅse̱ šoṅṅ aba le̱, ké̱ ame̱na ne̱ke̱ šikpoṅ ne̱ haomo̱i le̱ ke̱ ehelai ní Iehowa ehã eba eno̱ le̱,

english_verse: The Lord will strike your country with diseases and disasters. Your descendants and foreigners from distant countries will see that your land
translation_verse: ke̱ bo̱ni ake̱ swō̱ ke̱ ṅō ešã ešikpoṅ le̱ fẽ, ni adũũ nii ye̱ no̱, ni ebaa nii hũ, ni dſe̱i ko ekwẽẽ ye̱ no̱, tamo̱ *Sodom ke̱ Gomora, Adăma ke̱ Zeboim ní Iehowa butu ye̱ emlifũ ke̱ emlila nā le̱ butumo̱ le̱: *

english_verse: People from other nations will ask, “Why did the Lord destroy this country? Why was he so furious?”
translation_verse: Ni mei aakē̱: Edšake̱ ame̱kwa Iehowa, ame̱tše̱mei a-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kpãṅmo̱ ni eke̱ame̱ kpãṅ, beni edšieame̱ ke̱-dše̱ mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱,

english_verse: And they will be given this answer: Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, but after he brought them out of Egypt and made an agreement with them, they rejected the agreement
translation_verse: ni ame̱yiṅ ame̱te ni ame̱yasúmo̱ nyoṅmo̱i krokomei ni ame̱dsáame̱, nyoṅmo̱i ní ame̱lee ní eṅõ-hãkoame̱ hũ.

english_verse: and decided to worship gods that had never helped them. The Lord had forbidden Israel to worship these gods,
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ ní Iehowa mli wo ne̱ke̱ šikpoṅ ne̱ la, ni eke̱ lōmo̱i fẽ ní aṅmã ye̱ ne̱ke̱ wolo ne̱ mli le̱ ba ame̱no̱ le̱;

english_verse: and so he became furious and punished the land with all the curses in The Book of God's Law. Then he pulled up Israel by the roots and tossed them into a foreign country, where they still are today.
translation_verse: *Nii ní aṅõ-tē le̱ Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, no ni; ši †nii ní adšie kpo le̱ dši wo̱ke̱ wo̱bii anõ ke̱-yaä nāno̱, beni afe ní wo̱ye ne̱ke̱ mla ne̱ mli wiemo̱i le̱ fẽ kwa no̱. *

english_verse: I have told you everything the Lord your God will do for you, and I've also told you the curses he will put on you if you reject him. He will scatter you in faraway countries, but when you realize that he is punishing you,
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱, ke̱dši ne̱ke̱ nibii ne̱ fẽ eba ono̱, dšō̱mo̱ le̱ ke̱ lōmo̱ le̱ *ní miṅõ-ſie ohĩe le̱, ni ookaiame̱ ye̱ dšeṅmãdši fẽ ní Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, eſieo ke̱-te ame̱teṅ le̱ ateṅ, *Yi.

english_verse: to the land that had belonged to your ancestors and make you even more successful and powerful than they ever were.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ke̱o aaba šikpoṅ ní otše̱mei le̱ hĩ no̱ le̱ no̱ ekoṅ, ni oohĩ no̱, ni eefeo edšŭrõ ni eehã oyi afã fè otše̱mei le̱.

english_verse: Then the Lord your God will remove the curses from you and put them on those enemies who hate and attack you.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, aaṅõ ne̱ke̱ lōmo̱i ne̱ fẽ aſie ohenye̱lo̱i ke̱ ohetsẽlo̱i ní waäo yi le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: and he will bless you with many children, large herds and flocks, and abundant crops. The Lord will be happy to do good things for you, just as he did for your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo le̱, aahã oſere ke̱-teke no̱ ye̱ onine nā nitšumoi fe ke̱ omũsũṅbii ke̱ okoloi abii ke̱ ošikpoṅ le̱ no nibānii agbe̱fãṅ, ní ahĩ ahão; edšake̱ Iehowa aaná ohe mĩše̱ ekoṅ ní efeo edšŭrõ, take̱ bo̱ni ená otše̱mei le̱ ahe mĩše̱ le,

english_verse: And you can't say, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are across the sea, and someone must go across, then bring them back and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Ni dšee ṅšo̱ se̱ hũ eyo̱, ní ookē̱ ake̱: Namo aafo ṅšo̱ ahãwo, ni eyaṅõ abahãwo ní wonu ni wo̱ye no̱?

english_verse: No, these commands are nearby and you know them by heart. All you have to do is obey!
translation_verse: Ši wiemo le̱ be̱ṅke̱o kpākpa, eye odāṅ ke̱ otšui mli, beni afe ní oye no̱!

english_verse: Now I call the sky and the earth to be witnesses that I am offering you this choice. Will you choose for the Lord to make you prosperous and give you a long life? Or will he put you under a curse and kill you? Choose life!
translation_verse: Mītšé̱ *ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ ṅme̱ne̱ ní ame̱baye nyehe odase ake̱ mike̱ wala ke̱ gbĕle, dšō̱mo ke̱ lōmo̱ eſie nyehĩe; nohewo le̱ ko wala, koni bo ke̱ oseši fẽ ayi aná wala, *

english_verse: Be completely faithful to the Lord your God, love him, and do whatever he tells you. The Lord is the only one who can give life, and he will let you live a long time in the land that he promised to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: ní osumo̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo le̱, ni obo egbē toi, ni oke̱ ohe akpe̱te̱ ehe; edšake̱ no aahã oyi aná wala ni otše̱ ye̱ dšeṅ, koni ohĩ šikpoṅ ní Iehowa kãt otše̱mei Abraham ke̱ Isak ke̱ Iakob kitã ake̱ eeṅõ-hãame̱ le̱ no!

english_verse: Then Moses called Joshua up in front of the crowd and said: Joshua, be brave and strong as you lead these people into their land. The Lord made a promise long ago to Israel's ancestors that this land would someday belong to Israel. That time has now come, and you must divide up the land among the people.
translation_verse: Ni Mose tšé̱ Iošua ni ekē̱le̱ ye̱ Israel mū le̱ fe hĩe ake̱: Ohe awa ni ofe ekã; edšake̱ bo oke̱ ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱ baya šikpoṅ ní Iehowa kã ame̱tše̱mei le̱ akitã ake̱ eke̱-bahãame̱ le̱ no̱, ni bo noṅṅ oodša mli ohãame̱. Ios.

english_verse: The Lord will lead you into the land. He will always be with you and help you, so don't ever be afraid of your enemies. Read These Laws
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa le̱, le̱ dši moni aanyie ohĩe, le̱ noṅṅ eke̱o aahĩ ši; ešīṅo ni esā ekwaṅo; kāše gbeyei ni otšui akafã!

english_verse: Moses wrote down all of these laws and teachings and gave them to the priests and the leaders of Israel. The priests were from the Levi tribe, and they carried the sacred chest that belonged to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni Mose ṅmã ne̱ke̱ mla ne̱, ni eke̱-hã oso̱foi, ní dši Levibii le̱ ní tẽreo Iehowa kpãṅmo̱ adeka le̱, ke̱ Israel onukpai le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: Moses told these priests and leaders: Each year the Israelites must come together to celebrate the Festival of Shelters at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. You must read these laws and teachings to the people at the festival every seventh year, the year when loans do not need to be repaid.
translation_verse: ké̱ Israel mū le̱ fẽ bapue ye̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, hĩe, ye̱ heni ehala le̱, kanemo̱ ne̱ke̱ mla ne̱ fẽ ye̱ Israel mū le̱ fẽ hĩe owo ame̱toiiaṅ.

english_verse: Everyone must come—men, women, children, and even the foreigners who live in your towns. And each new generation will listen and learn to worship the Lord their God with fear and trembling and to do exactly what is said in God's Law. Israel Will Reject the Lord
translation_verse: ní ame̱bii ní leko le̱ hũ anu ni ame̱kase, koni ame̱še Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, gbeyei, gbĩĩ abo̱ ní nyeahĩ šikpoṅ ní nyeyafo Iordan nyeyaṅõ le̱ no̱ le̱.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses, “You will soon die, so bring Joshua to the sacred tent, and I will appoint him the leader of Israel.” Moses and Joshua went to the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱ Mose ake̱: Na, ogbĕle be eše̱; tšé̱ Iošua ke̱-ba, ni nyebadamo̱ kpē-bũ le̱ mli, ni mawole̱ kitã! Ni Mose ke̱ Iošua ba ame̱badamo̱ kpē-bū le̱ mli.

english_verse: The Lord said: Moses, you will soon die. But Israel is going into a land where other gods are worshiped, and Israel will reject me and start worshiping these gods. The people will break the agreement I made with them,
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱ Mose ake̱: Na, oke̱ otše̱mei le̱ yawo̱, ni ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱ bate ši ayabo̱ adſamaṅ ke̱-nyie šikpoṅ ní ame̱yaä no̱ le̱ no̱ nyoṅmo̱i kpõdši le̱ ase̱, ni ame̱ašĩmi, ni ame̱akũ mikpãṅmo̱ ní mike̱ame̱ kpãṅ le̱ mli.

english_verse: and I will be so furious that I will abandon them and ignore their prayers. I will send disasters and suffering that will nearly wipe them out. Finally, they will realize that the disasters happened because I abandoned them.
translation_verse: Ni mimli aawoame̱ la ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱, ni makwaame̱, ni maṅõ mihĩe matēame̱, ni aayeame̱, ni nifõdši babaō ke̱ fĩmo̱i aaba ame̱no̱. Ni nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ ame̱akē̱ ake̱: Aso dšee Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ní be̱ wo̱teṅ hewo̱ ni ne̱ke̱ nifõdši ne̱ eba wo̱no̱ ne̱?

english_verse: They will pray to me, but I will ignore them because they were evil and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, tēmo̱ mike̱ mihĩe aatē ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ ye̱ efõdši fẽ ní ame̱fe le̱ hewo̱, ake̱ noni ame̱kpale ke̱-te nyoṅmo̱i krokomei aṅõ le̱.

english_verse: Moses and Joshua, I am going to give you the words to a new song. Write them down and teach the song to the Israelites. If they learn it, they will know what I want them to do, and so they will have no excuse for not obeying me.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ agbe̱ne̱ nyeṅmãa ne̱ke̱ *lala ne̱ nyehãa nyehe, ni otšõ Israelbii le̱ ni ame̱kase; ṅõ-wo ame̱dāṅ, koni ne̱ke̱ lala ne̱ atšṍ odase ahãmi ye̱ Israelbii le̱ ahe. *Yi.

english_verse: I am bringing them into the land that I promised their ancestors. It is a land rich with milk and honey, and the Israelites will have more than enough food to eat. But they will get fat and turn their backs on me and start worshiping other gods. The Israelites will reject me and break the agreement that I made with them.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ké̱ mike̱ame̱ yaše̱ šikpoṅ ní fufo̱ ke̱ wò hoo̱ ye̱ no̱ ní mikã ametše̱mei le̱ akitã ye̱ he le̱ no̱, ni ame̱ye ni ame̱tŏ̱ro̱ ni *ame̱ſiſī le̱, ke̱ke̱ le̱ ame̱akpale ke̱-ate nyoṅmo̱i krokomei aṅõ, ni ame̱asúmo̱ame̱, ni ame̱agbe mihe guo̱ ni ame̱akũ mikpãṅmo̱ le̱ mli. *

english_verse: When I punish the Israelites and their descendants with suffering and disasters, I will remind them that they know the words to this song, so they have no excuse for not obeying me. I will give them the land that I promised, but I know the way they are going to live later on.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱, beni nifõdši babaō ke̱ fĩmo̱i eba ame̱no̱ le̱, no le̱ ne̱ke̱ lala ne̱ aaye ame̱he odase; edšake̱ ame̱sešibii le̱ ahĩe kpaṅ no̱ ní edšeṅ ame̱dāṅ. Edšake̱ *mile ame̱dſẽṅmo̱i ní ame̱dſãṅo̱ amrõmrõ ne̱ po, dãni mike̱ame̱ aayaše̱ šikpoṅ ní mikã he kitã le̱ no̱. *Lal.

english_verse: Moses at once wrote down the words to the song, and he taught it to the Israelites.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Mose ṅmã ne̱ke̱ lala ne̱ ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ noṅṅ, ni etšõ Israelbii le̱.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Be brave and strong! I will help you lead the people of Israel into the land that I have promised them.”
translation_verse: Ni ewo Iošua, Nun bi le̱, kitã ake̱: Ohe awa ni ofe ekã; edšake̱ bo oke̱ Israelbii le̱ baya šikpoṅ ní mikãame̱ kitã ye̱ he le̱ no̱, ni mike̱o aahĩ ši!

english_verse: Moses wrote down all these laws and teachings in a book,
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱, beni Mose eṅmã mla ne̱ mli wiemo̱i le̱ ewo wolo egbe nā kwrā le̱,

english_verse: then he went to the Levites who carried the sacred chest and said:
translation_verse: ewo Levibii ní tĕreo̱ Iehowa kpãṅmo̱ adeka le̱ kitã ake̱:

english_verse: This is The Book of God's Law. Keep it beside the sacred chest that holds the agreement the Lord your God made with Israel. This book is proof that you know what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: Nyeṅõa ne̱ke̱ mlawolo ne̱, ní nyeṅõ-toa Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kpãṅmo̱ adeka le̱ mase̱i, ní ehĩ dše̱i ní eye nyehe odase.

english_verse: I know how stubborn and rebellious you and the rest of the Israelites are. You have rebelled against the Lord while I have been alive, and it will only get worse after I am gone.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mile otũatšemo̱ ke̱ okue̱ṅti ní ti. Na, ṅme̱ne̱ ní mihĩe kã ní mike̱nye yo̱ ne̱ po nyemĩtše Iehowa hĩe atũa; bĕle̱ migbĕle se̱ le̱, té aatamo̱ tẽṅ mo̱?

english_verse: So call together the leaders and officials of the tribes of Israel. I will bring this book and read every word of it to you, and I will call the sky and the earth as witnesses that all of you know what you are supposed to do.
translation_verse: Nyehãa nyekutšei anukpai le̱ fẽ ke̱ nyeno̱kwe̱lo̱i le̱ anā abakpea ši ye̱ miṅõ, koni mawie ne̱ke̱ wiemo̱i ne̱ mawo ame̱toii amli, ni matšé̱ *ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ, ní ame̱baye ame̱he odase. *

english_verse: I am going to die soon, and I know that in the future you will stop caring about what is right and what is wrong, and so you will disobey the Lord and stop living the way I told you to live. The Lord will be angry, and terrible things will happen to you. The Song of Moses
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mile ake̱ migbĕle se̱ le̱ nyeafite nyehe kwrā, ni nyeakpale ke̱-adše̱ gbe̱ ní miwonye he kitã le̱ no̱, ni eſõṅ aaba nyeno̱ ye̱ nāgbēgbĩĩ le̱ ano̱, edšake̱ nyeafe noni dši eſõṅ ye̱ Iehowa hĩe, ni nyeke̱ nyenidši anā nitšumo̱i le̱ aawo emli la.

english_verse: Moses called a meeting of all the people of Israel, so he could teach them the words to the song that the Lord had given him. And here are the words:
translation_verse: Ni Mose wie ne̱ke̱ lala ne̱ mli wiemo̱i le̱ fẽ ewo Israel asafo mũ le̱ fẽ toiiaṅ ke̱-yaši egbe nā.

english_verse: but the Lord himself takes care of Israel.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa gbe̱fãṅnõ dši emaṅ le̱, Iakob dši egbošinii ní ená.

english_verse: You made God jealous and angry by worshiping disgusting idols and foreign gods.
translation_verse: Ame̱hã eke̱ nyoṅmo̱i kpõdši ye awuṅã, nihĩnii ame̱ke̱-wo emli la.

english_verse: You offered sacrifices to demons, those useless gods that never helped you, new gods that your ancestors never worshiped.
translation_verse: Ame̱šã afo̱le ame̱hã wo̱dši, ši dšee Nyoṅmo̱ ni, nyoṅmo̱i ní ame̱lee, nyoṅmo̱i hēi ní ba etše̱ko, mei ní nyetše̱mei lee-ame̱ le̱.

english_verse: You worshiped worthless idols, and made me jealous and angry! Now I will send a cruel and worthless nation to make you jealous and angry.
translation_verse: Ame̱hã miye awuṅã ye̱ noni *dšee nyoṅmo̱ ko hewo̱, ame̱ke̱ ame̱yakayakanii le̱ wo mimli la. †Nohewo̱ le̱ mi hũ mahã ame̱ye awuṅã ye̱ mei ní dšee maṅ ko hewo̱, dšeṅmaṅ ko ní hĩe etẽẽ mike̱-awo ame̱mli la. *Ier.

english_verse: You'll be struck by starvation and deadly diseases, by the fangs of wild animals and poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Ame̱atã lō ye̱ hõmo̱ nā, ni he-ladō̱ aayeame̱ ke̱ tsẽṅemo̱ hela ní nā wa; ni matšũ koloi anyãnyõdši ke̱-aba ame̱teṅ ke̱ sũ mli šikpãi anā ebō̱.

english_verse: Young and old alike will be killed in the streets and terrified at home.
translation_verse: Klante aašõ ame̱bii ye̱ blohũi amli ke̱ ṅmiṅmi hũ ye̱ piai amli, oblanyo ke̱ oblayō, fufo̱o ke̱ wadšiatše̱ fẽ.

english_verse: Even our enemies know that only our God is a Mighty Rock.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ame̱te̱sā le̱ tamo̱o̱ wo̱te̱sā le̱, ni wo̱henye̱lo̱i le̱ dientše̱ aaye he odase.

english_verse: Our enemies are grapevines rooted in the fields of Sodom and Gomorrah. The grapes they produce are full of bitter poison;
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Sodom weintšo le̱ eko dši ame̱weintšo le̱, ni Gomora abō̱i le̱ amli edše̱. Ame̱weinyibii le̱ ebō̱-yibii ni, ni ame̱šabii le̱ dšōo̱. Ies.

english_verse: When only a few of the Lord's people remain, when their strength is gone, and some of them are slaves, the Lord will feel sorry for them and give them justice.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa aafã emaṅ le̱ he, ni etšũdši le̱ asane aado̱le̱, ke̱ eena ake̱ ame̱hewale̱ etã, ni mei ní yo̱ maṅ ke̱ mei ní yo̱ akrowaiaṅ ſẽ etã le̱.

english_verse: But first the Lord will say, “You ran for safety to other gods— couldn't they help you?
translation_verse: Ni eekē̱: Nẽgbe̱ ame̱nyoṅmo̱i le̱ yo̱, te̱sā ní ame̱ke̱ ame̱hĩe fõ eno̱ le̱?

english_verse: You offered them wine and your best sacrifices. Can't those gods help you now or give you protection?
translation_verse: mei ní ye ame̱fo̱lei le̱ amli fo̱ le̱, ni ame̱nu ame̱dā̃-afo̱lei le̱ amli wein le̱? *Hã ame̱te ši ní ame̱ye ame̱buanye, ní ame̱fã nyehe ko! *Kodš.

english_verse: Don't you understand? I am the only God; there are no others. I am the one who takes life and gives it again. I punished you with suffering. But now I will heal you, and nothing can stop me!
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ nyenaä ake̱ *mi dši mi, ni mise̱ le̱ nyoṅmo̱ ko be̱! Mi noṅṅ †migbeo̱ ni mitšĩeo̱ hĩe, mipilaä mo ni asaṅ mitšaäle̱, ni moko be̱ ní šõo̱ ye mideṅ. *

english_verse: “I make this solemn promise: Just as I live forever,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ miwóo̱ minine no̱ ke̱-yaä ṅwei, ni mikē̱o ake̱: Mi le̱ mihĩe kã ke̱-mīya nāno̱!

english_verse: I will take revenge on my hateful enemies. I will sharpen my sword and let it flash like lightning.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši midšo̱ miklante ní kple̱o̱ tamo̱ srawa le̱ nā, ni minine mõ kodšomo̱ mli le̱, mato̱ mihe owele ye̱ mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ ano̱, ni mawo mei ní nye̱o̱mi le̱ anyõmo̱!

english_verse: My arrows will get drunk on enemy blood; my sword will taste the flesh and the blood of the enemy. It will kill prisoners, and cut off the heads of their leaders.”
translation_verse: Mahã migãimlibii atŏ̱ro̱ dā̃ ke̱ lá, ni miklante le̱ aaye lō: mei ní agbe ke̱ mei ní aṅõame̱ nom le̱ alá ke̱ henye̱lo̱i le̱ alumei le̱ ayitsei!

english_verse: Tell the heavens to celebrate and all gods to bow down to the Lord, because he will take revenge on those hateful enemies who killed his people. He will forgive the sins of Israel and purify their land.
translation_verse: *Nyedšeṅmãdši, nyeke̱ emaṅ le̱ anyã́a! Edšake̱ ebato̱ etšũdši le̱ alá le̱ he owele, ni eke̱ oweletō̱ baba ehenye̱lo̱i le̱ ano̱, ni ebana emaṅ le̱ šikpoṅ le̱ mo̱bo̱. *Rom.

english_verse: Moses spoke the words of the song so that all the Israelites could hear, and Joshua helped him. When Moses had finished,
translation_verse: Ni beni Mose dšadše wiemoi ne̱ fẽ etšõ Israel egbe nā le̱,

english_verse: he said, “Always remember this song I have taught you today. And let it be a warning that you must teach your children to obey everything written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyeṅõa nyetšuii nyefõa wiemo̱i ne̱ fẽ ní miye he odase mitšõnye ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ le̱ no̱, ní *nyewo nyebii le̱ akitã, ní ame̱dſẽṅ ne̱ke̱ mla ne̱ mli wiemo̱i le̱ fẽ no̱ ní ame̱ye no̱. *

english_verse: The Law isn't empty words. It can give you a long life in the land that you are going to take.” Moses Will See the Land
translation_verse: Edšake̱ dšee wiemo̱ flo dši hãnye, ši moṅ *nyeyiwala ni, ni ne̱ke̱ wiemo̱ ne̱ nyeke̱-ahã nyegbĩĩ ase̱ atše̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ ní nyefoo̱ Iordan ke̱-ya nyeyaṅõ le̱ no̱. *

english_verse: Go up into the Abarim Mountain range here in Moab across the Jordan River valley from Jericho. And when you reach the top of Mount Nebo, you will be able to see the land of Canaan, which I am giving to Israel.
translation_verse: Yakwo̱ ne̱ke̱ *Abarim goṅ ne̱ ní dši Nebo goṅ le̱ ní kã Moab šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ye̱ Ieriko hĩe le̱, ni oyakwe̱ Kanaan šikpoṅ le̱ ní miṅõ-hãa Israelbii ake̱ ame̱-gbe̱fãṅnõ le̱. *

english_verse: Then you will die and be buried on the mountaintop, just as your brother Aaron died and was buried on Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Ni oyagbo ye̱ goṅ ní oyakwo̱ le̱ no̱, ni abua onā afata omei le̱ ahe, take̱ bo̱ni *onyemi Aaron gbo ye̱ Hor goṅ le̱ no̱, ni abua enā afata emei le̱ ahe le̱; *

english_verse: Both of you were unfaithful to me at Meribah Spring near Kadesh in the Zin Desert. I am God, but there in front of the Israelites, you did not treat me with the honor and respect I deserve.
translation_verse: edšake̱ nyetõ mino̱ ye̱ Israelbii le̱ ateṅ ye̱ Meriba nu le̱ he ye̱ Kadeš, ye̱ Zin ṅã le̱ no̱, ake̱-ní nyefeemi kroṅkroṅ ye̱ Israelbii le̱ ateṅ le̱.

english_verse: So I will give the land to the people of Israel, but you will only get to see it from a distance.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ oona šikpoṅ le̱ kã ohĩe moṅ, ši yā ní oyaṅ šikpoṅ le̱ ní miṅõ-hãa Israelbii le̱ no̱.

english_verse: The Lord loves the tribes of Israel, and he protects his people. They listen to his words and worship at his feet. *
translation_verse: Hẽ, edo̱ö̱ emaṅ le̱ he, emei kroṅkroṅi le̱ fẽ ye̱ odeṅ! Ni ame̱ le̱, ame̱kãmo̱ ona-dši anā, ame̱mībo owiemo̱i le̱ atoi.

english_verse: Tribe of Reuben, you will live, even though your tribe will always be small.
translation_verse: Ruben yi aní wala ni ekagbo, ní emei le̱ ayi afá!

english_verse: You teach God's laws to Israel, and at the place of worship you offer sacrifices and burn incense.
translation_verse: ame̱atšõ Iakob okpo̱i le̱, ni ame̱atšõ Israel omlai le̱; ame̱aṅõ tšofã-ke̱-ṅma ame̱ato ogugõ nā ke̱ šā̃-afo̱lei mudši hũ ye̱ ofo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless everything you do, and make you strong enough to crush your enemies.
translation_verse: Iehowa, dšō̱mo̱ edeṅ nii, ni ohã enine nā nitšumo̱ asa ohĩe! Tſiamo̱ mei ní teo̱ ši woo̱le̱ le̱ ahe̱i anii ke̱ ehenye̱lo̱i le̱ hũ, ni ame̱kate ši doṅṅ!

english_verse: Descendants of Joseph, the Lord will bless you with precious water from deep wells and with dew from the sky.
translation_verse: Ni Iosef le̱, ekē̱ ye̱ ehe ake̱: Iehowa adšō̱ ešikpoṅ le̱ ke̱ ṅwei nibii ní dšra wa, ní dši bó̱ le̱, ke̱ bu kwo̱ṅkwo̱ṅ ní yo̱ šiši le̱,

english_verse: The Lord who appeared in the burning bush wants to give you the best the land can produce, and it will be a princely crown on Joseph's head.
translation_verse: šikpoṅ ke̱ eno̱ nii babaō le̱ mli nibii ní dšra wa! Ni moni *hĩ ṅmeitšo le̱ mli le̱ aná Iosef he mīše̱, ni emīše̱ le̱ aba enyemimei le̱ ateṅ †Nazirnyo le̱ yiteṅ pampamso! *

english_verse: The armies of Ephraim and Manasseh are majestic and fierce like a bull or a wild ox. They will run their spears through faraway nations.
translation_verse: Ehewale̱ tamo̱ tšina kromo̱bi nõ, ni eko dši le̱, wuo kodši ni; nomei eṅõ-šimo̱ mãdši le̱ fẽ tſẽm ke̱-ate šikpoṅ nāgbēhei le̱. Ni ame̱dši Efraim akpei-nyoṅma le̱, ni ame̱ noṅṅ dši Manase akpei le̱.

english_verse: Be happy, Zebulun, as your boats set sail; be happy, Issachar, in your tents.
translation_verse: Ni Zebulon le̱, ekē̱ ye̱ ehe ake̱: Nyã́, Zebulon, ye̱ oṅšo̱-hĩe-nyiemo̱ hewo̱; ni bo, Isakar hũ, nyã́ ye̱ obūi le̱ amli!

english_verse: The sea will make you wealthy, and from the sandy beach you will get treasure. So invite the other tribes to celebrate with you and offer sacrifices to God.
translation_verse: Ame̱atšé̱ mãdši ke̱-ate goṅ le̱ no̱, dše̱i ame̱ašã dšale̱-afo̱lei ye̱; edšake̱ ame̱-aye ṅšo̱i amli nifále̱ ke̱ Sia mli dſetrii ní aṅõ-tē le̱.

english_verse: Tribe of Gad, the Lord will bless you with more land. So shout his praises! Your tribe is like a lion ripping up its victim.
translation_verse: Ni Gad le̱, ekē̱ ye̱ ehe ake̱: Aadšō̱ moni lē̱o Gad mli; ebu ši tamo̱ dšatayō, ni etšĕre̱o̱ nine ke̱ yiteṅ pampamso fẽ.

english_verse: Your leaders met together and chose the best land for your tribe, but you obeyed the Lord and helped the other tribes.
translation_verse: Ni eko̱ noni dši kleṅkleṅnõ le̱ ehã ehe; edšake̱ dše̱i mlawolo̱ ní ato le̱ gbe̱nā yo̱. Ni eke̱ maṅ onukpai le̱ nyie, ni eye Iehowa dšale̱ sane le̱, ni ekodšo ye̱ Israel.

english_verse: Tribe of Dan, you are like a lion cub, startled by a snake.
translation_verse: Ni Dan le̱, ekē̱ ye̱ ehe ake̱: Dan le̱, dšatabi ni, eetumo̱ ke̱-adše̱ Bašan.

english_verse: The Lord's greatest blessing is for you, tribe of Asher. You will be the favorite of all the other tribes. You will be rich with olive oil
translation_verse: Ni Ašer le̱, ekē̱ ye̱ ehe ake̱: Aadšō̱ Ašer ke̱ bihĩĩ! Hã enyemimei le̱ asumo̱ esane, ni eṅõ enane etše̱ mũ mli!

english_verse: and have strong town gates with bronze and iron bolts. Your people will be powerful for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Otokotai afe dade ke̱ akō̱ble, ni bo̱ni ogbĩĩ le̱ yo̱ le̱, nakai ohewale̱ aafe!

english_verse: Israel, no other god is like ours— the clouds are his chariot as he rides across the skies to come and help us.
translation_verse: Mokomoko be̱ ní tamo̱ *Iešurun Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, moni táa ṅwei no̱ ke̱-hoo̱, ní ebaye ebuao, ni egbodšē mli le̱ etáa atatui ano̱! *Ies.

english_verse: The eternal God is our hiding place; he carries us in his arms. When God tells you to destroy your enemies, he will make them run.
translation_verse: Nāno̱ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ dši obobāhe, ni nāno̱ nidši le̱ ye̱ šišigbe̱. Ni eeſie henye̱lo̱ le̱ ye̱ ohĩe, ni eekē̱ ake̱: Fitemo̱ame̱!

english_verse: Israel, you will live in safety; your enemies will be gone. The dew will fall from the sky, and you will have plenty of grain and wine.
translation_verse: Ni Israel *aahĩ ši ſeſēſe, ni Iakob nubu le̱ aahĩ ši ekometō ye̱ able ke̱ wein šikpoṅ le̱ no̱; eṅwei le̱ hũ aaso̱o bó̱ aſie ši. *

english_verse: The Lord has rescued you and given you more blessings than any other nation. He protects you like a shield and is your majestic sword. Your enemies will bow in fear, and you will trample on their backs.
translation_verse: Adšō̱o, Israel! Namo tamo̱ bo? Maṅ ní Iehowa ehere oyiwala! Moni dši oyeli-ke̱-buamo̱ tše̱ṅ, ke̱ ogbodšē klante le̱! Ni ohenye̱lo̱i le̱ aaſie ame̱nā ši ahão; ši bo le̱ oonānā ame̱hei groṅṅi le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: The Lord also showed him the land in the south, from the valley near the town of Jericho, known as The City of Palm Trees, down to the town of Zoar.
translation_verse: ke̱ wuoyigbe̱ le̱, ke̱ Ieriko ní dšì tẽṅi amaṅ le̱, dšō̱ le̱ṅ ṅã kplenē le̱ ke̱-yaši Zoar.

english_verse: And so, Moses the Lord's servant died there in Moab, just as the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Mose, Iehowa tšũlo̱ le̱, gbo ye̱ dše̱i ye̱ Moab šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ye̱ Iehowa wiemo̱ le̱ nā.

english_verse: Before Moses died, he had placed his hands on Joshua, and the Lord had given Joshua wisdom. The Israelites paid attention to what Joshua said and obeyed the commands that the Lord had given Moses. Moses Was a Great Prophet
translation_verse: Ni *Iošua, Nun bi le̱, mli yi obõ ke̱ nilē mumo̱; edšake̱ Mose eṅõ enidši eſie eno̱. Ni Israelbii le̱ bole̱ toi, ni ame̱fe bo̱ni Iehowa wo Mose kitã le̱. *

english_verse: There has never again been a prophet in Israel like Moses. The Lord spoke face to face with him
translation_verse: Ni gbalo̱ ko etee ši doṅṅ ye̱ Israel ni tamo̱ Mose ní Iehowa ke̱le̱ kpe *hĩe ke̱ hĩe, *

english_verse: and sent him to perform powerful miracles in the presence of the king of Egypt and his entire nation.
translation_verse: ye̱ okadii ke̱ nākpe̱nii fẽ ní Iehowa tšũle̱ ní eyafe ye̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ etšõ Farao ke̱ etšũdši le̱ ke̱ ešikpoṅ le̱ fẽ le̱ agbe̱fãṅ,

english_verse: No one else has ever had the power to do such great things as Moses did for everyone to see.
translation_verse: ke̱ ninešiwale̱nii ke̱ gbeyeinii wudši fẽ ní Mose fe ye̱ Israel fẽ hĩe le̱ agbe̱fãṅ.

english_verse: Long ago I promised the ancestors of Israel that I would give this land to their descendants. So be strong and brave! Be careful to do everything my servant Moses taught you. Never stop reading The Book of the Law he gave you. Day and night you must think about what it says. If you obey it completely, you and Israel will be able to take this land.
translation_verse: Kãhã ne̱ke̱ mla wolo ne̱ mli wiemo̱i le̱ mikpa ye̱ odãṅ, ši *dſẽṅmo̱ he nyōṅ ke̱ ſane, koni odſẽṅ no̱ ni ofe tamo̱ bo̱ni aṅmã ye̱ mli le̱ pẽpē̱pe̱; edšake̱ no aahã ofe no̱batše̱ ke̱ hĩešikãlo̱. *Lal.

english_verse: I've commanded you to be strong and brave. Don't ever be afraid or discouraged! I am the Lord your God, and I will be there to help you wherever you go. The Eastern Tribes Promise To Help
translation_verse: Ani dšee mi mifã́o? Wadšemo̱ ohe ni ofe ekã. Kāhã ṅmiṅmi mīmõo, ni asaṅ otšui akafã; edšake̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, fĩ ose̱ ye̱ hefẽhe ní oyaä.

english_verse: Joshua ordered the tribal leaders
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iošua wo maṅ le̱ no̱kwe̱lo̱i le̱ akitã ake̱:

english_verse: to go through the camp and tell everyone: In a few days we will cross the Jordan River to take the land that the Lord our God is giving us. So prepare as much food as you'll need for the march into the land.
translation_verse: Nyekpaä nsra le̱ mli, ni nyewoa maṅ le̱ kitã ake̱: Nyetaoa gbe̱ no̱ niyenii nyetoa; edšake̱ bie̱ gbĩĩ etẽ le̱ nyebafo Iordan ne̱, ní nyeya nyeyaṅõ šikpoṅ ní Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ṅõ-hãanye ake̱ nyenõ le̱.

english_verse: Joshua told the men of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh:
translation_verse: Ni Iošua kē̱ Rubenbii le̱ ke̱ Gadbii le̱ ke̱ Manase akutšo le̱ fã le̱ ake̱:

english_verse: conquer the land that the Lord is giving them. The Lord will give peace to them as he has given peace to you, and then you can come back and settle here in the land that Moses promised you.
translation_verse: ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni Iehowa aahã nyenyemimei le̱ aadšō̱ ame̱he, tamo̱ bo̱ni ehã nyedšē̱ nyehe le̱, ni ame̱ hũ šikpoṅ ni Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ṅõ-hãame̱ le̱ aaše̱ ame̱deṅ, dãni nyekũ nyese̱ ke̱-ba nyešikpoṅ le̱ ní Iehowa tšũlo̱ Mose ṅõ-hãnye ye̱ Iordan se̱ ye̱ bokãgbè̱ le̱ no̱ ni nyebahĩ no̱.

english_verse: The men answered: We'll cross the Jordan River and help our relatives. We'll fight anywhere you send us.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱to he ame̱hã Iošua ake̱: Nofẽno ní owoo̱wo̱ he kitã le̱, wo̱o̱fe, ni hefẽhe ní otšũo̱wo̱ le̱, wo̱o̱te.

english_verse: If the Lord our God will help you as he helped Moses, and if you are strong and brave, we will obey you as we obeyed Moses. We'll even put to death anyone who rebels against you or refuses to obey you.
translation_verse: *Mofẽmo ni aatše owiemo̱ hĩe atũa ní eboṅ ogbē toi ye̱ nofẽno ni oowowo̱ he kitã mli le̱, aagbele̱; *wadšemo̱ ohe ni ofe ekã dšogbāṅ ke̱ke̱! *K.

english_verse: Rahab went back up to her roof. The spies were still awake, so she told them:
translation_verse: Ši ame̱náko ame̱kãmo̱ ši ni yō le̱ te ame̱ṅõ ye̱ tšũ le̱ yiteṅ,

english_verse: I know that the Lord has given Israel this land. Everyone shakes with fear because of you.
translation_verse: ni ekē̱ hĩĩ le̱ ake̱: Mile ake̱ Iehowa eṅõ šikpoṅ le̱ ehãnye, ni *nyehe ṅmiṅmi emõmo̱wo̱, ni šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ bii fẽ tšui mĩfã nyeno̱. *

english_verse: We heard how the Lord dried up the Red Sea so you could leave Egypt. And we heard how you destroyed Sihon and Og, those two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ wo̱nu, bo̱ni Iehowa hã *Ṅšo̱-tšuru le̱ mli nu gbĩ ye̱ nyehĩe, beni nyedše Mizraim le̱, ke̱ noni †nyefe Amorbii amaṅtše̱mei enyo̱ ni yo̱ Iordan se̱ le̱, Sihon ke̱ Og, mei ní nyefeame̱ musu le̱. *

english_verse: We know that the Lord your God rules heaven and earth, and we've lost our courage and our will to fight.
translation_verse: Ni amrõ ni wo̱nu le̱, *wo̱tšui fã, ni ekã be̱ nū ko nū ko mli doṅṅ ye̱ nyehewo̱; edšake̱ †Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, le̱ dši Nyoṅmo̱ ye̱ ṅwei ní yo̱ ṅwei šoṅṅ le̱ ke̱ šikpoṅ ni yo̱ šiši le̱ no̱. *

english_verse: Please promise me in the Lord's name that you will be as kind to my family as I have been to you. Do something to show
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ agbe̱ne̱, mīkpanye fai, nyenaä Iehowa nyetšõami ake̱ gbĩĩabo̱ ní mifenye edšũrõ ne̱, nye hũ *nyeafe mitše̱ we le̱ edšũro nakai, ni nyetšõmi ano̱kwa okadi ko, *

english_verse: that you won't let your people kill my father and mother and my brothers and sisters and their families.
translation_verse: ake̱ nyeahere mitše̱ ke̱ minye ke̱ minyemimeihīĩ ke̱ minyemimeiyei ke̱ nii fẽ ní ame̱yo̱ le̱ ayiwala, ni nyedšie wo̱susumai ke̱-dše̱ gbĕle mli!

english_verse: “Rahab,” the spies answered, “if you keep quiet about what we're doing, we promise to be kind to you when the Lord gives us this land. We pray that the Lord will kill us if we don't keep our promise!”
translation_verse: Ni hĩĩ le̱ kē̱ yō le̱ ake̱: Ke̱dši nyeyadšieewo̱ ši le̱, no le̱ wo̱ke̱ wo̱wala aatšake nyenõ; ni aaba mli ake̱, ké̱ Iehowa ṅõ šikpoṅ le̱ ehãwo̱ le̱, we̱ke̱o aaye ye̱ mo̱bo̱nale̱ ke̱ ano̱kwale nā!

english_verse: Rahab's house was built into the town wall, and one of the windows in her house faced outside the wall. She gave the spies a rope, showed them the window, and said, “Use this rope to let yourselves down to the ground outside the wall.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni yō le̱ šiame̱ ke̱ tãṅkpẽ ke̱-tšṍ samfle̱-mli ke̱-yimo̱ ši, edšake̱ ewe le̱ mã maṅ le̱ gbogbo no̱, ni gbogbo le̱ no̱ noṅṅ ehĩo̱.

english_verse: Then hide in the hills. The men who are looking for you won't be able to find you there. They'll give up and come back after a few days, and you can be on your way.”
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyeyaã goṅ le̱ no̱, koni tiulo̱i le̱ ke̱nye akakpe, ni nyetē nyehe ye̱ dše̱i gbĩĩ etẽ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni tiulo̱i le̱ aakũ ame̱se̱, ni no se̱ dãni nyeyi gbe̱.

english_verse: “I'll do exactly what you said,” Rahab promised. Then she sent them on their way and tied the red rope to the window.
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱: Bo̱ni nyekē̱ ne̱, afe nakai! Ni ewoame̱ gbe̱ ni ame̱te. Ni eṅõ tãṅkpẽ tšuru le̱ efĩ samfle̱ le̱ he.

english_verse: The spies hid in the hills for three days while the king's soldiers looked for them along the roads. As soon as the soldiers gave up and returned to Jericho,
translation_verse: Ni ame̱yiṅ ni ame̱yaše̱ goṅ le̱ no̱, ni ame̱hī dše̱i gbĩĩ etẽ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni tiulo̱i le̱ kũ ame̱se̱. Ni tiulo̱i le̱ taoame̱ ye̱ gbe̱ le̱ no̱ fẽ, ši ame̱naa-ame̱.

english_verse: the two spies went down into the Jordan valley and crossed the river. They reported to Joshua and told him everything that had happened.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni hĩĩ enyo̱ le̱ kũ ame̱se̱ ni ame̱kpleke goṅ le̱, ni ame̱fo fā le̱, ni ame̱ba Iošua, Nun bi le̱, ṅõ, ni ame̱ba-gbale̱ sãdši ni ba ame̱no̱ le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: “We're sure the Lord has given us the whole country,” they said. “The people there shake with fear every time they think of us.”
translation_verse: Ni ame̱kē̱ Iošua ake̱: Iehowa etu šikpoṅ le̱ fẽ ewo we̱deṅ le̱le̱ṅ, ni asaṅ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ bii le̱ atšui mīfã wo̱no̱. K.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Beginning today I will show the people that you are their leader, and they will know that I am helping you as I helped Moses.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱ Iošua ake̱: Ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ mibabõi *ohĩe nyamwõ ye̱ Israel fẽ hĩe, koni ame̱ná ame̱le ake̱, †bo̱ni mike̱ Mose hĩ ši le̱, nakai noṅṅ mike̱o bahī ši. *

english_verse: Now, tell the priests who are carrying the chest to go a little way into the river and stand there.”
translation_verse: Ni bo le̱ wo oso̱foi ni tẽre kpãṅmo̱ adeka le̱ kitã ake̱: Ke̱dši nyeše̱ Iordan fā le̱ nā le̱, nyewaä nyedamo̱a ši ye̱ Iordan mli!

english_verse: Joshua spoke to the people: Come here and listen to what the Lord our God said he will do!
translation_verse: Ni Iošua kē̱ Israelbii le̱ ake̱: Nyetšia nyebaä bie̱, ní nyebaboa Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, wiemo̱i le̱ atoi!

english_verse: The Canaanites, the Hittites, the Hivites, the Perizzites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, and the Jebusites control the land on the other side of the river. But the living God will be with you and will force them out of the land when you attack. And now, God is going to prove that he's powerful enough to force them out.
translation_verse: Ni Iošua kē̱: Ene̱ nyeaṅõ-le ake̱ Mawu hĩekãlo̱ le̱ ye̱ nyeteṅ, ni ſiemo̱ eefiẽ Kanaanbii le̱ ke̱ Hitbii le̱ ke̱ Hivbii le̱ ke̱ Perizbii le̱ ke̱ Girgašbii le̱ ke̱ Amorbii le̱ ke̱ Iebusbii le̱ ke̱-adše̱ nyehĩe.

english_verse: Just watch the sacred chest that belongs to the Lord, the ruler of the whole earth. As soon as the priests carrying the chest step into the Jordan, the water will stop flowing and pile up as if someone had built a dam across the river. The Lord has also said that each of the twelve tribes should choose one man to represent it.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱ amrõ pe̱ ni oso̱foi le̱, ni tẽre Iehowa ni dši šikpoṅ le̱ fẽ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ adeka le̱, anãdšiaši aasa Iordan nui le̱ amli le̱, Iordan mli nu ni dše̱o̱ yiteṅgbe̱ baä le̱ bawa, ni eedamo̱ ši tamo̱ gbogbo.

english_verse: until they came to the Jordan River. The water in the river had risen over its banks, as it often does in springtime. But as soon as the feet of the priests touched the water,
translation_verse: ni mei ni tẽre adeka le̱ baše̱ Iordan nā, ni oso̱foi ní tẽre adeka le̱ anãdši sa nu le̱ mli pe̱ le̱ ,

english_verse: the river stopped flowing, and the water started piling up at the town of Adam near Zarethan. No water flowed toward the Dead Sea, and the priests stood in the middle of the dry riverbed near Jericho while everyone else crossed over.
translation_verse: Ši oso̱foi le̱ ní tẽre Iehowa kpãṅmo̱ adeka le̱ wa damo̱ ši šiṅṅ ye̱ šikpoṅ gbĩṅ no̱ ye̱ Iordan teṅ tū̃ntū; ni Israelbii le̱ fẽ tšṍ šikpoṅ gbĩṅ no̱ ke̱-ho, ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni maṅ mū le̱ fẽ fo Iordan tã.

english_verse: After Israel had crossed the Jordan, the Lord said to Joshua:
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱, beni maṅ mū le̱ fẽ efo Iordan etã le̱, Iehowa kē̱ Iošua ake̱:

english_verse: Tell one man from each of the twelve tribes to pick up a large rock from where the priests are standing. Then tell the men to set up those rocks as a monument at the place where you camp tonight.
translation_verse: ni nyewoame̱ kitã ake̱: Nyeholea te̱i nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱ ke̱-dše̱a Iordan te ne̱ṅ, heni oso̱foi le̱ anãdši damo̱ le̱, ni nyetẽre ke̱-fo ni nyeke̱-yamãmo̱ ši ye̱ tōhe, heni nyeyato nyō ne̱ṅ le̱.

english_verse: “Joshua,” the Lord said, “tell the priests to come up from the Jordan and bring the chest with them.” So Joshua went over to the priests and told them what the Lord had said. And as soon as the priests carried the chest past the highest place that the floodwaters of the Jordan had reached, the river flooded its banks again. That's how the Lord showed the Israelites that Joshua was their leader. For the rest of Joshua's life, they respected him as they had respected Moses.
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱, beni oso̱foi le̱ ni tĕre Iehowa kpãṅmo̱ adeka le̱ dše Iordan te le̱ṅ, ni oso̱foi le̱ fãmo̱ amenãdši ame̱mãmo̱ šikpoṅ gbĩṅ no̱ pe̱ le̱, Iordan mli nu le̱ kũ se̱ ba egbe̱he, ni esram etoi le̱ fẽ no̱ ke̱-ho, tamo̱ sá le̱.

english_verse: It was the tenth day of the first month of the year when Israel crossed the Jordan River. They set up camp at Gilgal, which was east of the land controlled by Jericho.
translation_verse: Ni maṅ le̱ dše kpo ke̱-dše̱ Iordan mli ye̱ kleṅkleṅ nyõṅ le̱ no̱ gbĩ ni dši gbĩ nyoṅma le̱ no̱, ni ame̱yabo̱ nsra *ye̱ Gilgal ye̱ Ieriko bokãgbe̱ hũsũ le̱ no̱. *

english_verse: The men who had carried the twelve rocks from the Jordan brought them to Joshua, and they made them into a monument.
translation_verse: Ni nakai te̱i nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱ le̱ ni ame̱hole ye̱ Iordan mli le̱, Iošua ṅõmãmo̱ ši ye̱ Gilgal.

english_verse: Tell them, “The Lord our God dried up the Jordan River so we could walk across. He did the same thing here for us that he did for our people at the Red Sea,
translation_verse: edšake̱ Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, hã Iordan mli nu le̱ gbĩ ye̱ nyehĩe ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni nyefo, take̱ bo̱ni Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, fe *Ṅšo̱-tšuru le̱, ní ehã egbĩ ye̱ wo̱hĩe ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní wo̱fo le̱, *

english_verse: because he wants everyone on earth to know how powerful he is. And he wants us to worship only him.”
translation_verse: koni šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ mãdši fẽ ana ale Iehowa nine le̱ ake̱ eye̱ hewale̱, ni nyeše Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, gbeyei dāne̱.

english_verse: The Amorite kings west of the Jordan River and the Canaanite kings along the Mediterranean Sea lost their courage and their will to fight, when they heard how the Lord had dried up the Jordan River to let Israel go across. Israel Gets Ready To Celebrate Passover
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱, beni Amorbii amaṅtše̱mei fẽ ní yo̱ Iordan se̱ ye̱ anaigbe̱ le̱, ke̱ Kanaanbii amaṅtše̱mei fẽ ni yo̱ ṅšo̱ le̱ nā le̱ nu ake̱ Iehowa ehã *Iordan mli nu le̱ egbī ye̱ Israelbii le̱ ahĩe ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni ame̱fo le̱, †ame̱tšui fã, ni ekã be̱ ame̱mli doṅṅ ye̱ Israelbii le̱ ahewo̱. *

english_verse: This had to be done, because none of Israel's baby boys had been circumcised during the
translation_verse: Ni ame̱bii ni ehã baye ame̱se̱ le̱, ame̱ ketia Iošua flo̱ le̱; edšake̱ fõlo̱i dši-ame̱, edšake̱ aflo̱o̱ame̱ ketia ye̱ gbe̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “It was a disgrace for my people to be slaves in Egypt, but now I have taken away that disgrace.” So the Israelites named the place Gilgal, and it still has that name.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱ Iošua ake̱: Ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ mikoklo Mizraim kpatō le̱ ke̱-dše̱ nyeno̱! Nohewo̱ le̱ awo dše̱i gbe̱i ake̱ Gilgal ke̱-baši ṅme̱ne̱.

english_verse: Israel continued to camp at Gilgal in the desert near Jericho, and on the fourteenth day of the same month, they celebrated Passover.
translation_verse: Ni Israelbii le̱ bo̱ nsra ye̱ Gilgal, ni ame̱ye Hehō le̱ ye̱ nyõṅ le̱ no̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ nyoṅma ke̱ edſe̱ le̱ no̱ gbe̱ke̱, ye̱ Ieriko ṅã kplanā le̱ no̱.

english_verse: The next day, God stopped sending the Israelites manna to eat each morning, and they started eating food grown in the land of Canaan. They ate roasted grain and thin bread made of the barley they had gathered from nearby fields. Israel Captures Jericho
translation_verse: Ni gbĩ ni ame̱ye šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ nibānii le̱ eko le̱ no̱ dšetše̱remo̱ pe̱ ni mána le̱ se̱ fo, ni Israelbii le̱ náá mána doṅṅ; ši Kanaan šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ nibānii le̱ ame̱ye ye̱ nakai afi le̱ no̱.

english_verse: One day, Joshua was near Jericho when he saw a man standing some distance in front of him. The man was holding a sword, so Joshua walked up to him and asked, “Are you on our side or on our enemies' side?”
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱, beni Iošua yo̱ Ieriko mase̱i le̱, ehole ehĩṅme̱ii ano̱ ekwe̱, ni na, *nū ko damo̱ ehĩe ni egbla eklante ehĩe edeṅ. Ni Iošua te eṅõ ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Wo̱gbe̱fãṅ oyo̱ alo wo̱henye̱lo̱i le̱ agbe̱fãṅ? *

english_verse: “Take off your sandals,” the commander answered. “This is a holy place.” So Joshua took off his sandals.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa ta le̱ no̱ tatše̱ le̱ kē̱ Iošua ake̱: *Dšiemo̱ otokota le̱ ye̱ onane; edšake̱ heni odamo̱ le̱ ye̱ kroṅkroṅ. Ni Iošua fe nakai. *

english_verse: Joshua called the priests together and said, “Take the chest and tell seven priests to carry trumpets and march ahead of it.”
translation_verse: Ni Iošua, Nun bi le̱, tšé̱ oso̱foi le̱, ni ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyewóa kpãṅmo̱ adeka le̱, ni oso̱foi kpawo ahĩe nyã́mo̱ te̱tre̱mantre̱i kpawo le̱ ke̱-nyie Iehowa adeka le̱ hĩe.

english_verse: On the seventh day, the army got up at daybreak. They marched slowly around Jericho the same as they had done for the past six days, except on this day they went around seven times.
translation_verse: Ni gbĩ ni dši gbĩ kpawo le̱ no̱ le̱ eba mli ake̱ ame̱te ši mrã, beni dše bõi tše̱remo̱ le̱, ni ame̱bo̱le maṅ le̱ nakai noṅṅ šii kpawo; nakai gbĩ le̱ ke̱ke̱ ame̱bo̱le maṅ le̱ šii kpawo.

english_verse: But you must destroy it and everything in it, to show that it now belongs to the Lord. The woman Rahab helped the spies we sent, so protect her and the others who are inside her house. But kill everyone else in the town.
translation_verse: Ši afe maṅ le̱ ke̱ emlinii fẽ *musu ahã Iehowa; Rahab, adſamaṅ le̱, ke̱ke̱ †yi ana wala, le̱ ke̱ mofẽmo ní ke̱le̱ yo̱ ye̱ ewe le̱; edšake̱ le̱ eṅõ bo̱foi le̱ ni wo̱tšũ le̱ etẽ. *

english_verse: The priests blew their trumpets again, and the soldiers shouted as loud as they could. The walls of Jericho fell flat. Then the soldiers rushed up the hill, went straight into the town, and captured it.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni maṅ le̱ ho̱ oše ni ame̱kpã te̱tre̱mantre̱i le̱. Ni eba mli ake̱, beni mei le̱ nu te̱tre̱mantre̱i le̱ agbē̱mo̱ le̱, ame̱bo̱ oše kpeteṅkple, ni *gbogbo le̱ gbe ši ſe̱tē̱, ni mei le̱ bote mã le̱ṅ, mofẽmo te ehĩe tẽ, ni ame̱ṅõ maṅ le̱. *Heb.

english_verse: After Jericho was destroyed, Joshua warned the people, “Someday a man will rebuild Jericho, but the Lord will put a curse on him, and the man's oldest son will die when he starts to build the town wall. And by the time he finishes the wall and puts gates in it, all his children will be dead.”
translation_verse: Ni Iošua kãame̱ kitã ye̱ nakai be le̱ mli ake̱: Moni aate ši ni eebasā Ieriko maṅ ne̱, alomo̱ le̱ ye̱ Iehowa hĩe! Eke̱ ekromo̱bi *aato šiši, ni eke̱ ebi se̱kpelo̱ aatrá enā agbói le̱! *

english_verse: The Lord helped Joshua in everything he did, and Joshua was famous everywhere in Canaan.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa fata Iošua he, ni egbe̱i hehe ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ fẽ.

english_verse: Then Joshua said: Our Lord, did you bring us across the Jordan River just so the Amorites could destroy us? This wouldn't have happened if we had agreed to stay on the other side of the Jordan.
translation_verse: Ni Iošua kē̱: Ao, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa! Menihewo̱ oṅõ ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱ ke̱-fo Iordan, koni oṅõwo̱ owo Amorbii le̱ adeṅ, ni ame̱kpãtã wo̱hĩe? Wo̱le kũle̱ wo̱kplẽ ní wo̱hĩ Iordan se̱!

english_verse: Everyone will think you weren't strong enough to protect your people. Now the Canaanites and everyone else who lives in the land will surround us and wipe us out.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Kanaanbii le̱ ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ bii le̱ fè banu he, ni ame̱ababo̱lewo̱ kpũla, ni ame̱agbe wo̱gbe̱i ke̱-dše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱. Ni té obafe tẽṅ ye̱ ogbe̱i kpeteṅkple le̱ hewo̱ṅ?

english_verse: I said everything in Jericho belonged to me and had to be destroyed. But the Israelites have kept some of the things for themselves. They stole from me and hid what they took. Then they lied about it.
translation_verse: Israel efe eša, ni asaṅ ame̱tõ mi-kpãṅmo̱ ni miwoame̱ he kitã le̱ no̱, ni ame̱kŏ̱lo̱ musunii le̱ eko tete, ni ame̱dšu hũ, ni asaṅ ame̱tšĩmo̱ no̱, ni ame̱ṅõ-futu ame̱nibii amli.

english_verse: What they stole was supposed to be destroyed, and now Israel itself must be destroyed. I cannot help you anymore until you do exactly what I have said. That's why Israel turns and runs from its enemies instead of standing up to them.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ ni Israelbii le̱ nyẽẽ ame̱henye̱lo̱i le̱ ahĩe adamo̱, ni ame̱tšṍ ame̱se̱ ame̱hã ame̱henye̱lo̱i le̱; edšake̱ ame̱lõ musu. Mike̱nye ehĩṅ ši doṅṅ, dša nyedšie musunii le̱ ye̱ nyeteṅ nyeſie.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel, “Tomorrow you will meet with the Lord your God, so make yourselves acceptable to worship him. The Lord says that you have taken things that should have been destroyed. You won't be able to stand up to your enemies until you get rid of those things.
translation_verse: Te ši, tšūmo̱ maṅ le̱ he, ni okē̱: *Nyefea nyehe kroṅkroṅ nyetoa wó̱; edšake̱ bo̱ni Iehowa, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kē̱ ne̱: Musu ye̱ nyeteṅ, Israel! onyẽṅ ohenye̱lo̱i le̱ ahĩe odamo̱ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní nyeadšie musunii le̱ ke̱-dše̱ nyeteṅ. *

english_verse: and the Lord will show who stole what should have been destroyed. That man must be put to death, his body burned, and his possessions thrown into the fire. He has done a terrible thing by breaking the sacred agreement that the Lord made with Israel.”
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱ moni aamõle̱, ni musunii le̱ yo̱ edeṅ le̱, ake̱ la aašãle̱, le̱ ke̱ nii fẽ ni eyo̱; edšake̱ etõ Iehowa kitã le̱, ni efe hĩegbedšianii ye̱ Israel.

english_verse: Joshua got up early the next morning and brought each tribe to the place of worship, where the Lord showed that the Judah tribe was guilty.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iošua te ši lebi mãṅkpa, ni ehã Israelbii le̱ babe̱ṅke̱ ye̱ ame̱kutšei le̱ anā; ni amõ Iuda akutšo le̱.

english_verse: Finally, Joshua brought each man in Zabdi's family to the Lord, and the Lord showed that Achan was the guilty one.
translation_verse: ni ehã ešĩa le̱ mli hĩĩ le̱ babe̱ṅke̱ ekomekome, ní amõ Akan ní dši Zera bi Zabdi bi Karmi bi ní dše̱ Iuda akutšo le̱ mli le̱.
