translation_verse: Matšṍ etše̱, ni le̱ hũ eetšṍ mibi; ni midšieṅ mimo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱ ye̱ ehe, tamo̱ bo̱ni midšie ye̱ moni nyie ohĩe le̱ he le̱.

english_verse: I will make sure that your son and his descendants will rule my people and my kingdom forever.
translation_verse: Ši mike̱le̱ aato miwe le̱ ke̱ mimaṅtše̱yelihe le̱ ke̱-ate nāno̱, ni emaṅtše̱sẽi le̱ aamã ši šiṅṅ ke̱-ate nāno̱!

english_verse: Nathan told David exactly what the Lord had said. David Gives Thanks to the Lord (
translation_verse: Bo̱ni ne̱ke̱ wiemo̱i ne̱ fẽ yo̱ ke̱ bo̱ni ne̱ke̱ ninā ne̱ fẽ yo̱ le̱, nakai Natan kē̱ David.

english_verse: I am your servant, and you know my thoughts. What else can I say, except that you have honored me?
translation_verse: Meni yo̱ David nā ni ekē̱o̱ doṅṅ ye̱ wō ní owo otšũlo̱ hĩe nyam ne̱ hewo̱? Edšake̱ ole otšũlo̱!

english_verse: David went into the tent he had set up for the sacred chest. He sat there and prayed: Lord God, my family and I don't deserve what you have already done for us,
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni maṅtše̱ David te ni eyatá ši ye̱ Iehowa hĩe ni ekē̱: Iehowa Nyoṅmo̱, *namo dšimi, ni meni po dši miwe le̱, ni ohĩemi ke̱-baši bene̱ ne̱?

english_verse: It was your choice to do these wonderful things for me and to make these promises.
translation_verse: Iehowa, otšũlo̱ hewo̱ ni asaṅ bodientše̱ otšuidšũrõ nā otšu nibii wudši ne̱ fẽ, koni ohã ale nibii wudši ne̱ fẽ!

english_verse: No other god is like you, Lord—you alone are God. Everything we have heard about you is true.
translation_verse: Iehowa, nibii fẽ ni wo̱nu ke̱ wo̱toii le̱ anā le̱, mokomoko be̱ ni ke̱o ye egbo̱, ni asaṅ ose̱ le̱ nyoṅmo̱ ko nyoṅmo̱ ko be̱.

english_verse: And there is no other nation on earth like Israel, the nation you rescued from slavery in Egypt to be your own. You became famous by using great and wonderful miracles to force other nations and their gods out of your land, so that your people could live here.
translation_verse: Ni mẽ dšeṅmaṅ kōme po ni yo̱ šikpoṅ ne̱ no̱ ní ke̱ omaṅ Israel ye egbo̱, ni Nyoṅmo̱ yiṅ ete ní eyakpõ efe le̱dientše̱ emaṅ, koni oke̱ nibii wudši ní yo̱ gbeyei le̱ ahe gbe̱i, ake̱-ní oſie dšeṅmãdši le̱ ye̱ omaṅ ní okpõ ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim le̱ hĩe le̱?

english_verse: You have chosen Israel to be your people forever, and you have become their God.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ oṅō omaṅ Israel ofe bodientše̱ omaṅ ke̱-mīya nāno̱, ni bo, Iehowa, otšṍ ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱.

english_verse: Then you will be famous forever, and everyone will say, “The Lord All-Powerful rules Israel and is their God.” My kingdom will be strong,
translation_verse: Hē̃, hã ní ana ake̱ ano̱kwale ni, ni ogbe̱i le̱ ada kple ke̱-ya nāno̱ ní akē̱ ake̱: Iehowa Zebaot, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, le̱ dši Nyoṅmo̱ ehã Israel, ni otšũlo̱ David we le̱ adamo̱ ši šiṅṅ ye̱ ohĩe!

english_verse: because you are my God, and you have promised that my descendants will be kings. That's why I have the courage to pray to you like this, even though I am only your servant.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo, mi-Nyoṅmo̱, owó otšũlo̱ toi no̱ ake̱ obamã šĩa ohãle̱, nohewo̱ ni otšũlo̱ hũ ná tšui eso̱le ye̱ ohĩe ne̱.

english_verse: You are the Lord God, and you have made this good promise to me.
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱, Iehowa, bo noṅṅ dši Nyoṅmo̱, ni oke̱ ne̱ke̱ nõkpakpa ne̱ ewo otšũlo̱ ši;

english_verse: Now please bless my descendants forever, and let them always be your chosen kings. You have already blessed my family, and I know you will bless us forever.
translation_verse: nohewo̱ le̱ agbe̱ne̱ ná he tšui, ni odšō̱ otšũlo̱ we le̱, koni ehĩ ši ye̱ ohĩe ke̱-ya nāno̱; edšake̱ moni bo, Iehowa, odšō̱o̱ le̱, adšō̱le̱ ke̱-mīya nāno̱!

english_verse: While King Hadadezer of Zobah was trying to gain control of the territory near the Euphrates River, David met him in battle at Hamath and defeated him.
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ David tſia Hadarezer, Zoba maṅtše̱ le̱, nii ăhũ ke̱-yaſie Hamat tō̃, beni eyiṅ ete ni eyaṅõ Eufrate fā le̱ he efe eno̱yelihe le̱.

english_verse: When troops from the Syrian kingdom of Damascus came to help Hadadezer, David killed
translation_verse: Ši beni Arambii ni yo̱ Damasko le̱ ba Zoba maṅtše̱ Hadarezer le̱ yeli-ke̱-buamo̱ le̱, David gbe Arambii le̱ ateṅ mei akpei-nyoṅmai-enyo̱-ke̱-enyo̱.

english_verse: King Tou of Hamath and King Hadadezer had been enemies. So when Tou heard that David had defeated Hadadezer's whole army, he sent his son Hadoram to congratulate David on his victory. Hadoram also brought him gifts made of gold, silver, and bronze.
translation_verse: ke̱ke̱ ni etšũ ebi Hadoram ke̱-ba maṅtše̱ David ṅō ni ebahãle̱ ahekō ní edšō̱le̱, ake̱-ni eke̱ Hadarezer ewu ni etſiale̱ nii le̱; edšake̱ Hadarezer ke̱ Tou ewuwū tai āhũ; ni ehĩe šika nibii ke̱ dſie̱te̱i nibii ke̱ akō̱ble nibii sro̱toi fẽ ke̱-ba.

english_verse: David gave these gifts to the Lord, just as he had done with the silver and gold he had captured from Edom, Moab, Ammon, Philistia, and Amalek.
translation_verse: Ene̱mei hũ maṅtše̱ David dšō̱ no̱ ke Iehowa, eke̱fata dſie̱te̱i ke̱ šika, ní eyalõ ke̱-dše̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ fẽ mli, ke̱-dše̱ Edom ke̱ Moab ke̱ Amonbii le̱ ke̱ Filistibii le̱ ke̱ Amalekbii le̱ adeṅ le̱, he.

english_verse: Abishai the son of Zeruiah defeated the Edomite army in Salt Valley and killed
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ Abišai, Zeruia bi le̱, gbe Edombii le̱ ateṅ mei akpei-nyoṅma-ke̱-kpānyo̱ ye̱ Ṅō-dšō̱ le̱ṅ.

english_verse: Then he stationed troops in Edom, and the people there had to accept David as their ruler. Everywhere David went, the Lord gave him victory in war. A List of David's Officials (
translation_verse: Ni eto asrafoi ye̱ Edom, ni Edombii le̱ fẽ tšṍmo̱ David tšũdši; ni Iehowa hãa David yeo̱ kūnim ye̱ hefẽhe ni eyaã.

english_verse: Joab the son of Zeruiah was the commander in chief of the army. Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud kept the government records.
translation_verse: Ni Ioab, Zeruia bi le̱, dši ta le̱ tše̱; ni Iehošafat, Ahilud bi le̱, dši sãdšiaṅmãlo̱;

english_verse: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were the priests. Shavsha was the secretary.
translation_verse: ni Zadok, Ahitub bi le̱, ke̱ *Abimelek, Abiatar bi le̱, dši oso̱foi; ni Šaweša dši woloṅmãlo̱; *

english_verse: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was the commander of David's bodyguard. David's sons were his highest-ranking officials.
translation_verse: ni Benaia, Iehoiada hi le̱, dši Keretifoi ke̱ Peletifoi le̱ atše̱; ni David bihĩĩ le̱ dši maṅtše̱ súolo̱i le̱ ateṅ onukpai.

english_verse: David said, “Nahash was kind to me, so I will be kind to his son.” He sent some officials to Ammon to tell Hanun how sorry he was that his father had died. But when David's officials arrived at Ammon,
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni David kē̱ ake̱: Madšie mlihĩle̱ kpo matšõ Hanun, Nahaš bi le̱, edšake̱ etše̱ hũ mli hĩ hãmi. Ni David tšũ bo̱foi ke̱-te ake̱ ame̱yahãle̱ kpóo ye̱ etše̱ hewo̱. Ni David tšũdši le̱ yiṅ ame̱te Amonbii le̱ ašikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni ame̱te Hanun ṅõ ni ame̱yahãle̱ kpóo.

english_verse: Joab saw that the enemy troops were lined up on both sides of him. So he picked some of the best Israelite soldiers to fight the Syrians.
translation_verse: Ši beni Ioab na ake̱ ta le̱ egbá ewole̱ ye̱ ehĩe ke̱ ese̱ fẽ le̱, ehala Israel kakabãi le̱ fẽ ateṅ meikomei, ni ehã ame̱gbá ame̱wo Arambii le̱.

english_verse: When the kings who had been under Hadadezer's rule saw that Israel had defeated them, they made peace with David and accepted him as their new ruler. The Syrians never helped the Ammonites again.
translation_verse: Ni heni Hadarezer tšũdši le̱ na ake̱ Israel eye ame̱no̱ le̱, ame̱ke̱ David bakpãtã ni ame̱súmo̱le̱. Ni Arambii le̱ sumo̱o̱ ake̱ ame̱ye ame̱bua Amonbii le̱ doṅṅ.

english_verse: the Ammonite leaders said to Hanun, “Do you really believe King David is honoring your father by sending these men to comfort you? He probably sent them to spy on our country, so he can come and destroy it.”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Amonbii le̱ alumei le̱ kē̱ Hanun ake̱: Ani osusuo̱ ake̱ otše̱ hĩe nyamwō hewo̱ ni David tšũ kpóohãlo̱i ke̱-ba oṅō ne̱? Ani dšee šikpoṅ le̱ sramo̱ ke̱ butumo̱ ke̱ šikpamo̱ hewo̱ moṅ ni etšũdši le̱ ba oṅõ ne̱?

english_verse: Hanun arrested David's officials and had their beards shaved off and their robes cut off just below the waist, and then he sent them away.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ Hanun mõmo̱ David tšũdši le̱ ni eše̱šē̱ ame̱he tšo̱i, ni eflo ame̱tadei le̱ ano̱ ye̱ teṅ tũntu ke̱-baše̱ ame̱dukuii ano̱, ni edšieame̱ gbe ame̱te.

english_verse: They were terribly ashamed. When David found out what had happened to his officials, he sent a message that told them, “Stay in Jericho until your beards grow back. Then you can come home.”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni abagba David bo̱ni afe hĩĩ le̱ ahã, ni etšũ ake̱ame̱ yakpe, edšake̱ abo̱ame̱ ahora naakpa; nohewo̱ le̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ kē̱: Nyehĩa Ieriko ke̱-yašia beyino̱ ní nyetšẽṅi le̱ aatšu, dãni nyekũ nyese̱ nyeba.

english_verse: The Ammonite troops marched to the entrance of the city and prepared for battle, while the Syrian troops took their positions in the open fields.
translation_verse: Ni Amonbii le̱ dše kpo ni ame̱bagbá ta ye̱ maṅ le̱ agbó le̱ nā; ni maṅtše̱mei ní ba le̱ so̱ṅṅ damo afã ye̱ ṅã le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Then he put his brother Abishai in command of the rest of the army and told them to fight against the Ammonites.
translation_verse: Ni maṅ le̱ mli mei ní eſe̱ le̱, etuame̱ ewo enyemi Abišai deṅ, ni ame̱gbá ame̱wo Amonbii le̱.

english_verse: Joab told his brother, “If the Syrians are too much for me to handle, come and help me. And if the Ammonites are too strong for you, I'll come and help you.
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱: Ke̱dši Arambii le̱ anine mītšṍ mino̱ le̱, koni obaye obuami; ši ke̱dši Amonbii le̱ anine mītšṍ ono̱ le̱, koni mabaye mabuao.

english_verse: Be brave and fight hard to protect our people and the towns of our Lord God. I pray he will do whatever pleases him.”
translation_verse: Femo̱ ekã ni ohã wo̱damo̱ ši ake̱ hũ wo̱hā wo̱maṅ ke̱ wo̱-Noṅmo̱ le̱ mãdši le̱; *ni Iehowa afe noni sa ehĩe! *

english_verse: Joab and his soldiers attacked the Syrians, and the Syrians ran from them.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Ioab ke̱ ta ni fata ehe le̱ tši ke̱-yanina Arambii le̱ ni ame̱ke̱ame̱ wu, ni ame̱dšo foi ye̱ ehĩe.

english_verse: When the Ammonite troops saw that the Syrians had run away, they ran from Abishai's soldiers and went back into their own city. Joab then returned to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ni beni Amonbii le̱ na ake̱ Arambii le̱ edšo foi le̱, ke̱ke̱ ni ame̱ hũ ame̱dšo foi ye̱ enyemi Abišai hĩe ni ame̱yabote mã le̱ṅ. Ni Ioab kũ ese̱ ke̱-ba Ierusalem.

english_verse: As soon as the Syrians realized they had been defeated, they sent for their troops that were stationed on the other side of the Euphrates River. Shophach, the commander of Hadadezer's army, led these troops to Ammon.
translation_verse: Ši beni Arambii le̱ na ake̱ Israelbii le̱ eye ame̱no̱ le̱, ame̱tšũ bo̱foi ni ayaṅõ Arambii ní yo̱ fã le̱ se̱ le̱ ke̱-ba, ni Hadarezer tatše̱ Šofak le̱ nyie ame̱hĩe.

english_verse: David found out what the Syrians were doing, and he brought Israel's entire army together. They crossed the Jordan River, and he commanded them to take their positions facing the Syrian troops. Soon after the fighting began,
translation_verse: Ni abagba David, ni eyabua Israel mū le̱ fẽ nā, ni eyafo Iordan, ni eyaninaame̱, ni egbá ewoame̱; ni beni David gbá ewo Arambii le̱, ame̱ke̱le̱ wu.

english_verse: He forced the people of Rabbah to work with saws, iron picks, and axes. He also did the same thing with the people in all the other Ammonite towns. David then led Israel's army back to Jerusalem. The Descendants of the Rephaim (
translation_verse: Ni elō gbomei ni yo̱ mli le̱ ke̱-ba, ni eṅõ akplalai ke̱ dade nigble̱mo̱nii ke̱ lemai eflo̱ ame̱mli. Ni ne̱ke̱ David fe Amonbii le̱ amãdši le̱ fẽ. Ke̱ke̱ ni David ke̱ maṅ mū le̱ fẽ kũ ame̱se̱ ke̱-ba Ierusalem. (

english_verse: Some time later, Israel fought a battle against the Philistines at Gezer. During this battle, Sibbecai from Hushah killed Sippai, a descendant of the Rephaim, and the Philistines were defeated.
translation_verse: Ni ene̱ se̱ le̱ eha mli ake̱ ta bate ši ye̱ Gezer ye̱ ame̱ ke̱ Filistibii le̱ ateṅ. No mli ni *Sibekai, Hušanyo le̱, gbe Sipai ni dši oblãṅ le̱ bii le̱ ateṅ mokome le̱, ni abaame̱ ši. *

english_verse: In another battle against the Philistines, Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath from Gath, whose spear shaft was like a weaver's beam.
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ ame̱ke̱ Filistibii le̱ ná ta ekoṅ; ni Elhanan, Iair bi le̱, gbe Lahẽmi ni dši Goliat, Gatnyo le̱, ni ekplo̱tio tamo̱ mamalòlo̱ agbatšo le̱, nyemi le̱.

english_verse: Another one of the Philistine soldiers who was a descendant of the Rephaim was as big as a giant and had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot. During a battle at Gath,
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ awu ta ekoṅ ye̱ Gat; ni nū nyenyereṅṅ ko ye̱ dše̱i ni yo̱ wābii nyoṅmai-enyo̱ ke̱ edſe̱: enidši wābii ekpa-ekpa ke̱ enădši wăbii ekpa-ekpa, ni le̱ hũ oblãṅ le̱ fo̱le̱ le̱.

english_verse: he made fun of Israel, so David's nephew Jonathan killed him.
translation_verse: Ni beni *etſa Israel mpoa le̱, Ionatan, David nyemi Šimea bi le̱, tſale̱ nõ ni egbele̱. *

english_verse: David and his soldiers killed these three men from Gath who were descendants of the Rephaim.
translation_verse: Mene̱mei afo̱ ahã oblãṅ le̱ ye̱ Gat; ni ame̱nyõnyõi ye̱ David ke̱ etšũdši le̱ anine nā.

english_verse: The Lord said to Gad, one of David's prophets,
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iehowa ke̱ Gad, David ninalo̱ le̱, wie ake̱:

english_verse: Joab refused to include anyone from the tribes of Levi and Benjamin, because he still disagreed with David's orders. God Punishes Israel (
translation_verse: Ši ekanee Levi ke̱ Benyamin ešii no̱; edšake̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ wiemo̱ le̱ fe Ioab tãṅ.

english_verse: “Tell David that I will punish him in one of three ways. But he will have to choose which one it will be.”
translation_verse: Ya ni oyakē̱ David ake̱: Bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Mihĩe nibii etẽ mīſie ohĩe, ko̱ mli ekome, ni mafeo!

english_verse: and David prayed, “It's my fault! I sinned by ordering the people to be counted. They have done nothing wrong—they are innocent sheep. Lord God, please punish me and my family. Don't let the disease wipe out your people.” David Buys Araunah's Threshing Place (
translation_verse: Ni David kē̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ake̱: Ani dšee mi mifã́ ake̱ ayakane maṅ le̱? mi midši moni efe eša ni mife efõṅ naakpa; ši ne̱ke̱ toi ne̱, meni ame̱fe? Iehowa, mi-Nyoṅmo̱, kpã onine mli owo mi ke̱ mitše̱ we le̱ moṅ, ši dšee omaṅ le̱ ni ohaoame̱!

english_verse: David's order to count the people made God angry, and he punished Israel.
translation_verse: Ni ne̱ke̱ sane ne̱ *eṅõõ Nyoṅmo̱ nā, nohewo̱ le̱ etſĩa Israel nii. *

english_verse: David prayed, “I am your servant. But what I did was stupid and terribly wrong. Please forgive me.”
translation_verse: Ni David kē̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ake̱: Mife eša kple ake̱ mife ene̱; ši agbe̱ne̱, mīkpao fai, tši otšũlo̱ nõša ne̱ ohã se̱; edšake̱ miye kwašiai asane naakpa!

english_verse: Gad went to David and told him: You must choose how the Lord will punish you:
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Gad ba David ṅõ ni ebakē̱le̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Ko̱ mli noni osumoo̱!

english_verse: Will there be three years when the land won't grow enough food for its people? Or will your enemies constantly defeat you for three months? Or will the Lord send a horrible disease to strike your land for three days? Think about it and decide, because I have to give your answer to God who sent me.
translation_verse: Kē̱ hōmo̱ afii etẽ dšio, alo foidšē ye̱ ohenye̱lo̱i ahĩe nyõdši etẽ, ní ohenye̱lo̱i le̱ aklante aninao dšio, alo Iehowa klante ní dši gbĕle-hela aba šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ gbĩĩ etẽ, ni Iehowa bo̱fo le̱ akpãtã mei ahĩe ye̱ Israel kpokpai ano̱ fẽ dšio. Nohewo̱ le̱ agbe̱ne̱ dſẽṅmo̱ no hetõ ní mike̱-ate ayahã moni tšũmi le̱!

english_verse: David was miserable and said, “It's a terrible choice to make! But the Lord is kind, and I'd rather be punished by him than by anyone else.”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni David kē̱ Gad ake̱: Efīmi naakpa! hã magbē Iehowa deṅ, edšake̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ fá naakpa; ši akahã migbe gbomo ádesã deṅ!

english_verse: So the Lord sent a horrible disease on Israel, and
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iehowa hã gbĕle-hela ba Israel no̱, ni Israelbii ateṅ mei akpei-nyoṅmai-kpawo gboi.

english_verse: Araunah and his four sons were threshing wheat at the time, and when they saw the angel, the four sons ran to hide.
translation_verse: Ši Ornan tšṍ ehe ni ena bo̱fo le̱, ni ebihĩĩ edſe̱ ní ke̱le̱ yo̱ dše̱i le̱ yatē ame̱he; ši Ornan mīgbē ṅmā̃.

english_verse: Just then, David arrived, and when Araunah saw him, he stopped his work and bowed down.
translation_verse: Ni beni David baä Ornan ṅõ le̱, Ornan tšṍ ehe ni ena David; ke̱ke̱ ni edše kpo ke̱-dše̱ ṅmā̃gbēmo̱he le̱, ni ekoto David ni eke̱ ehĩe bu ši.

english_verse: David said, “Would you sell me your threshing place, so I can build an altar on it to the Lord? Then this disease will stop killing the people. I'm willing to pay whatever you say it's worth.”
translation_verse: Ši David kē̱ Ornan ake̱: Nõ oṅmā̃gbēmo̱he ne̱ ohămi, ni mamã afo̱lešãlate̱ ye̱ dše̱i mahã Iehowa, ṅōhãmi ni mawo nyõmo̱ šišiši, ni ahã *gbĕle-hela le̱ se̱ afo ye̱ maṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Araunah answered, “Take it, Your Majesty, and do whatever you want with it. I'll even give you the oxen for the sacrifice and the wheat for the grain sacrifice. And you can use the threshing-boards for the fire. It's all yours!”
translation_verse: Ni Ornan kē̱ David ake̱: Nõ, ni minuṅtšo̱ maṅtše̱ afe bo̱ni sa ehĩe; na, mike̱ tšinai le̱ mīhã ní ake̱-šã šã-afo̱lei, ke̱ ṅmā̃gbēmo̱-ſīli le̱ ní ake̱-fe lai, ke̱ ṅmã ni ake̱-fe niyenii-afo̱le; mike̱ fè mīhã!

english_verse: David built an altar and offered sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. David prayed, and the Lord answered him by sending fire down on the altar.
translation_verse: Ni David mã afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ ye̱ dše̱i ehã Iehowa, ni ešã šã-afo̱lei ke̱ šidā-afo̱lei; ni beni etšé̱ Iehowa le̱, eke̱ *la dše̱ ṅwei herele̱ no̱ ye̱ šã-afo̱lelate̱ le̱ no̱. *

english_verse: Then the Lord commanded the angel to put the sword away.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iehowa fá bo̱fo le̱, ni eṅõ eklante le̱ ewo ehebo le̱ mli.

english_verse: When David saw that the Lord had answered his prayer, he offered more sacrifices there at the threshing place,
translation_verse: Nakai be le̱ mli le̱, beni David na ake̱ Iehowa eherele̱ no̱ ye̱ Ornan, Iebusnyo le̱, ṅmā̃gbēmo̱he le̱, dše̱i ešãa afo̱lei ye̱.

english_verse: He also brought an endless supply of cedar logs from the cities of Sidon and Tyre.
translation_verse: ke̱ tšenedrutšei babaō bo̱ni anyẽẽ akane; edšake̱ Zidonbii ke̱ Tirobii le̱ bahã David tšenedrutšei babaō dientše̱.

english_verse: He said, “The temple for the Lord must be great, so that everyone in the world will know about it. But since my son Solomon is young and has no experience, I will make sure that everything is ready for the temple to be built.” That's why David did all these things before he died. David Instructs Solomon To Build the Temple
translation_verse: Ši David kē̱: Mibi Salomo le̱, *gbekẽ dšile̱ ni ehĩe esako; ni šĩa ni abamã ahã Iehowa le̱, sa ake̱ eda kpeteṅkple dientše̱ ni eyidšiemo̱ ke̱ enumnyam akpĕle šikpõdši le̱ fẽ no̱; nohewo̱ le̱ mato he nii. Ni David to ehe nii babaō dientše̱ dāni egbo. *

english_verse: David sent for his son Solomon and told him to build a temple for the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni etšé̱ ebi Salomo, ni ewo-le̱ kitã ake̱ emã šĩa ehã Iehowa, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: But some time ago, he told me, “David, you have killed too many people and have fought too many battles. That's why you are not the one to build my temple.
translation_verse: Ši Iehowa wiemo̱ ba miṅõ ake̱: Oſie lá ši babaō, ni asaṅ owuwū tai wudši: kāmã šĩa ohã migbe̱i le̱, edšake̱ oſie lá ši babaō ye̱ mihĩe ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Solomon will build my temple. He will be like a son to me, and I will be like a father to him. In fact, one of his descendants will always rule in Israel.”
translation_verse: le̱ dši moni aamã šĩa ahã migbe̱i le̱, eetšṍ mibi ni mi hũ matšṍ etše̱, ni mahã emaṅtše̱yeli sẽi le̱ amã ši šiṅṅ ye̱ Israel no̱ ke̱-ate nāno̱?

english_verse: Solomon, my son, I now pray that the Lord your God will be with you and keep his promise to help you build a temple for him.
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱, mibi, Iehowa ke̱o ahĩ ši, ni oſere, ni omã Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, šĩa le̱, take̱ bo̱ni ewie ye̱ ohewo̱ le̱.

english_verse: May he give you wisdom and knowledge, so that you can rule Israel according to his Law.
translation_verse: Iehowa ahão nilē ke̱ dſẽṅmo̱ ke̱ke̱, ni etu Israel ewo odeṅ, beni afe ni oye Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, mla le̱ no̱.

english_verse: If you obey the laws and teachings that the Lord gave Moses, you will be successful. Be strong and brave and don't get discouraged or be afraid of anything.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši odſẽṅ no̱ ni oye akpo̱i ke̱ mlai ni Iehowa wo Mose ye̱ Israel hewo̱ le̱ ano̱ le̱, no le̱ ooſere; ohe awa ni ofe ekã; kāše gbeyei ni otšui akafã hũ!

english_verse: I have also assigned men who will cut and lay the stone. And there are carpenters and people who are experts in working with
translation_verse: Asaṅ oye̱ nitšulo̱i hũ babaō: te̱gbalo̱i ke̱ tšo ke̱ te̱ he nitšulo̱i ke̱ mei ni le ṅāi sro̱toi fẽ;

english_verse: gold, silver, bronze, and iron. You have plenty of workers to do the job. Now get started, and I pray that the Lord will be with you in your work.
translation_verse: šika ke̱ dſie̱te̱i ke̱ abō̱ble ke̱ dade hũ alee nā. Te ši ni ofe, ši Iehowa ke̱o ye̱!

english_verse: David then gave orders for the leaders of Israel to help Solomon.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni David wo Israel lume̱i le̱ fẽ kitã ake̱ ame̱ye ame̱bua ebi Salomo, ekē̱:

english_verse: David said: The Lord our God has helped me defeat all the people who lived here before us, and he has given you peace from all your enemies. Now this land belongs to the Lord and his people.
translation_verse: Nto Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kenye ye̱, ni *ehã nyehe edšo̱nye ye̱ hefēhe ke̱-kpe? edšake̱ etu šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ bii le̱ fẽ ewo mideṅ, ni aba šikpoṅ le̱ ši ye̱ Iehowa ke̱ emaṅ le̱ hĩe. *K.

english_verse: Obey the Lord your God with your heart and soul. Begin work on the temple to honor him, so that the sacred chest and the things used for worship can be kept there.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ agbe̱ne̱ nyeṅõa nyetšuii ke̱ nyesusuma! le̱ nyetaoa Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, se̱gbe̱; ni nyetea ši ni nyeyamãa Iehowa Nyoṅmo̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱, koni ake̱ Iehowa kpãṅmo̱ adeka le̱ ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱ nibii kroṅkroṅi le̱ aba šĩa ni abamã ahã Iehowa gbe̱i le̱!

english_verse: Every morning and evening, the Levites are to give thanks to the Lord and sing praises to him.
translation_verse: asaṅ dā lebi le̱ ame̱damo̱ ši ní ame̱da Iehowa ši ni ame̱dšie eyi, ni gbe̱ke̱ hũ ame̱fe nakai noṅṅ, Lal.

english_verse: Gershon had two sons: Ladan and Shimei.
translation_verse: Geršon bihĩĩ dši: Ladan ke̱ Šimei.

english_verse: They were all family leaders among their father's descendants. Shimei was the father of Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran.
translation_verse: Šimei bihĩĩ dši: Šelomot ke̱ Haziel ke̱ Haran, ame̱yi etẽ. Mene̱mei dši Ladan tše̱mei awei le̱ ano̱ onukpai.

english_verse: Later, Shimei had four more sons, in the following order: Jahath, Ziza, Jeush, and Beriah. But Jeush and Beriah didn't have many children, so their descendants were counted as one family.
translation_verse: Ni Iahat dši onukpa, ni Sisa dši moni dši enyo̱; ši Ieuš ke̱ Beria be̱ bihĩĩ pī hewo̱ le̱ akaneame̱ ake̱ tše̱we kome.

english_verse: Kohath had four sons: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kahat bihĩĩ dši: Amram, Izehar, Hebron ke̱ Uziel, ame̱yi edſe̱.

english_verse: Amram was the father of Aaron and Moses. Aaron and his descendants were chosen to be in charge of all the sacred things. They served the Lord by offering sacrifices to him and by blessing the people in his name.
translation_verse: Amram bihĩĩ dši: Aaron ke̱ Mose. Ni *adšie Aaron, koni afele̱ kroṅkroṅ ahã hekroṅkroṅ fè fẽ le̱, le̱ ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ fẽ ke̱-ya nāno̱, koni ame̱šã tšofã-ke̱-ṅma ye̱ Iehowa hĩe, ni ame̱súmo̱le̱, ni †ame̱dšō̱ mei ye̱ egbe̱i ano̱ ke̱-yaši nāno̱. *

english_verse: Gershom's oldest son was Shebuel.
translation_verse: Geršom bihĩĩ dši: Šebuel, onukpa le̱.

english_verse: Hebron, the third son of Kohath, was the father of Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekameam.
translation_verse: Hebron bihĩĩ dši: Onukpa le̱ Ieria, moni dši enyo̱ le̱ Amaria, moni dši etẽ le̱ Iahaziel, ni moni dši edſe̱ le̱ Iekameam.

english_verse: Eleazar had no sons, only daughters, and they married their uncle's sons.
translation_verse: Ši Eleazar gbo ni ebe̱ bihĩĩ, ši biyei ke̱ke̱ eyo̱; ni Kiš bihĩĩ ni dši ame̱nyemimei le̱ w̌e̱ame̱.

english_verse: Mushi the second son of Merari, was the father of Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth.
translation_verse: Muši bihĩĩ dši: Maheli ke̱ Eder ke̱ Ieremot, ame̱yi etẽ.

english_verse: David said: The Lord God of Israel has given his people peace, and he will live in Jerusalem forever.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ David kē̱: Iehowa, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ehã emaṅ le̱ he edšo̱le̱ ni *eehĩ Ierusalem ke̱-ate nāno̱. *Ioel

english_verse: And so, the Levites won't need to move the sacred tent and the things used for worship from place to place.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ ehĩaa ake̱ Levibii le̱ atĕre šihĩle̱he le̱ ke̱ ehe súomo̱ nibii le̱ fẽ doṅṅ;

english_verse: will serve the Lord by helping Aaron's descendants do their work at the temple, by keeping the courtyards and rooms of the temple clean, and by making sure that everything used in worship stays pure.
translation_verse: edšake̱ ame̱gbe̱nā dši ake̱ ame̱wa Aaron bii le̱, ni ame̱súmo̱ ye̱ Iehowa we le̱ ye̱ kpoi le̱ ano̱ ke̱ piai le̱ amli, ni ame̱tšumo̱ nibii kroṅkroṅi le̱ fẽ he, ni ame̱tšu Nyoṅmo̱ we le̱ súomo̱ le̱ he nii,

english_verse: They will also be in charge of the sacred loaves of bread, the flour for the grain sacrifices, the thin wafers, any offerings to be baked, and the flour mixed with olive oil. These Levites will weigh and measure these offerings.
translation_verse: ke̱ hìe-mã-abolo le̱, ke̱ mã ní ake̱-bašã niyenii-aſo̱le, ke̱ akpĩtĩ kakai ke̱ ṅe̱sūi ke̱ nibii ní ašĩo̱ ye̱ mli le̱ ke̱ nikā nibii ke̱ nisusumo̱ nibii le̱ fẽ ahe nii;

english_verse: They must also give thanks and sing praises when sacrifices are offered on each Sabbath, as well as during New Moon Festivals and other religious feasts. There must always be enough Levites on duty at the temple to do everything that needs to be done.
translation_verse: ni ame̱šã šã-afo̱lei fẽ ame̱hã Iehowa ye̱ hedšō̱mo̱gbīĩ le̱ ke̱ nyõdši hēi le̱ ke̱ gbĩĩ dšudši le̱ ano̱ ye̱ yibo̱ nā, bo̱ni ato le̱ dāne̱ ye̱ Iehowa hĩe;

english_verse: They were once in charge of taking care of the sacred tent; now they are responsible for the temple and for helping Aaron's descendants.
translation_verse: ni ame̱tšu kpē-bū le̱ he nii ke̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱ he nii ke̱ Aaron bii ni dši ame̱nyemimei le̱ anitšumo̱ le̱, koni ame̱súmo̱ ye̱ Iehowa we le̱.

english_verse: David divided Aaron's descendants into groups, according to their assigned work. Zadok, one of Eleazar's descendants, and Ahimelech, one of Ithamar's descendants, helped David.
translation_verse: Ni *David ke̱ Zadok ni dše̱ Eleazar bii le̱ ateṅ le̱ ke̱ Ahimelek ní dše̱ Itamar bii le̱ ateṅ le̱ dša ame̱mli ye̱ ame̱súomo̱ le̱ gbe̱dšiano̱tō le̱ nā.

english_verse: groups, and Ithamar's were divided into eight groups, because Eleazar's family included more family leaders.
translation_verse: noni dši nyoṅma ke̱ ne̱hũ le̱ Petahia, noni dši nyoṅmai-enyo̱ le̱ Iehezekel,

english_verse: As each group was assigned their duties, Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the Levite wrote down the name of the family leader in charge of that group. The witnesses were David and his officials, as well as Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the family leaders from the clans of the priests and the Levites.
translation_verse: Ni Šemaia, Netanel bi le̱, ni dši woloṅmā̃lo̱ ní dše̱ Levibii le̱ ateṅ le̱ ṅmã ame̱gbe̱i ye̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ ke̱ onukpai le̱ ke̱ oso̱fo Zadok ke̱ *Ahimelek, Abiatar bi le̱, ke̱ oso̱foi ke̱ Levibii le̱ atše̱mei awei le̱ ano̱ onukpai le̱ ahïe: ké̱ ako̱ tše̱we kome ahã Eleazar le̱, ke̱ke̱ le̱ ako̱ ekome ahã Itamar. *

english_verse: These men were assigned their duties at the temple, just as the Lord God of Israel had commanded their ancestor Aaron. The Rest of the Levites Are Assigned Their Duties
translation_verse: Bo̱ni atoame̱ gbe̱dšiauo̱ ahã ame̱súomo̱ le̱ ne̱, ni ame̱ke̱-ya Iehowa we le̱, tamo̱ bo̱ni ame̱tše̱ Aaron toame̱ gbe̱dši-ano̱ ye̱ Iehowa, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kitã ni ewole̱ le̱ nā le̱.

english_verse: Here is a list of the other descendants of Levi: Amram was the ancestor of Shubael and Jehdeiah.
translation_verse: Ši Levibii ní eſe̱ le̱ ne̱: Amram bii dši: Šubael; Šubael bii dši: Iehĕdeia.

english_verse: Izhar was the father of Shelomoth and the grandfather of Jahath.
translation_verse: Izehar bii dši: Šelomot; Šelomot bii dši: Iahat.

english_verse: Hebron had four sons, in the following order: Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekameam.
translation_verse: Ni Hebron bii dši: Onukpa le̱ Ieria, moni dši enyo̱ le̱ Amaria, moni dši etẽ le̱ Iahaziel, moni dši edſe̱ le̱ Iekameam.

english_verse: Uzziel was the father of Micah and the grandfather of Shamir.
translation_verse: Uziel bii dši: Mika; Mika bii dši: Šamir.

english_verse: Isshiah, Micah's brother, was the father of Zechariah.
translation_verse: Mika nyeminū dši Išia; Išia bii dši: Zakaria.

english_verse: Jaaziah had three sons: Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
translation_verse: Merari bii ní dši ebi Iaazia bii le̱ dši: Šoham ke̱ Zakur ke̱ Ibri.

english_verse: Mushi had three sons: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the descendants of Levi, according to their clans.
translation_verse: Ni Muši bii dši: Maheli ke̱ Eder ke̱ Ierimot. Mene̱mei dši Levibii abihĩĩ le̱ ye̱ ame̱tše̱mei awei le̱ anā.

english_verse: Each one was assigned his duties in the same way that their relatives the priests had been assigned their duties. David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the family leaders of the priests and Levites were the witnesses.
translation_verse: Ni mene̱mei hũ fõ ošiki tamo̱ ame̱nyemimei, Aaron bihĩĩ le̱, noṅṅ, ye̱ maṅ-tše̱ David ke̱ Zadok ke̱ Ahimelek ke̱ oso̱foi ke̱ Levibii le̱ atše̱mei awei le̱ ano̱ onukpai le̱ ahĩe, tše̱mei le̱ ateṅ *onukpa tamo̱ enyemi gbekẽ noṅṅ. *

english_verse: David and the temple officials chose the descendants of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun to be in charge of music. They were to praise the Lord by playing cymbals, harps and other stringed instruments. Here is a list of the musicians and their duties:
translation_verse: Asaṅ David ke̱ asafoiatše̱mei le̱ fãmo̱ *Asaf ke̱ Heman ke̱ Iedutun bii le̱ ateṅ meikomei ame̱hã súomo̱ le̱, koni ame̱ke̱ saṅkũi ke̱ be̱dši ke̱ ṅme̱dši agba. Ni mei ní tšuo̱ nakai nii le̱ ye̱ ame̱súomo̱ le̱ nā le̱ ayibo̱ ne̱: *

english_verse: His sons were under his direction and played cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments during times of worship at the temple. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman took their orders directly from the king.
translation_verse: Mene̱mei fẽ ye̱ ame̱tše̱mei ašiši, ni ame̱ke̱ ṅme̱dši ke̱ be̱dši ke̱ saṅkũi laä ye̱ Iehowa we le̱ ni ame̱ke̱-súmoo̱ ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ we le̱ ye̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ mase̱i, ye̱ Asaf ke̱ Iedutun ke̱ Heman šiši.

english_verse: David assigned them their duties by asking the Lord what he wanted. Everyone was responsible for something, whether young or old, teacher or student.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱fõ ošiki ye̱ ame̱nitšumo̱ ni atu awo ame̱deṅ le̱ hewo̱, gbekẽ ke̱ onukpa, tšōlo̱ ke̱ kaselo̱ fẽ pe̱pē̱pe̱.

english_verse: Obed-Edom had been blessed with eight sons: Shemaiah, Jehozabad, Joah, Sachar, Nethanel, Ammiel, Issachar, and Peullethai.
translation_verse: Amiel dši moni dši ekpa, Isakar dši moni dši kpawo, Feuletai dši moni dši kpānyo̱; edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ dšō̱le̱.

english_verse: Shemaiah was the father of Othni, Rephael, Obed, Elzabad, Elihu, and Semachiah. They were all respected leaders in their clan.
translation_verse: Šemaia bii ne̱: Otni ke̱ Refael ke̱ Obed ke̱ Elzabad, ni enyemimei dši Elihu ke̱ Semakia, ekãlo̱i le̱.

english_verse: Eighteen descendants of Meshelemiah were chosen for this work.
translation_verse: Ni Mešelemia ye̱ bii ke̱ nyemimei, hĩĩ ekãlo̱i nyoṅma ke̱ kpānyo̱.

english_verse: Hosah, from the Merari clan, was the father of Shimri, Hilkiah, Tebaliah, and Zechariah. Hosah had made Shimri the family leader, even though he was not the oldest son. Thirteen men from Hosah's family were chosen to be temple guards.
translation_verse: Hilkia dši moni dši enyo̱, Tebalia dši moni dši etẽ, Zakaria dši moni dši edſe̱; Hosa bii ke̱ enyemimei fẽ dši nyoṅma ke̱ etẽ.

english_verse: The guards were divided into groups, according to their family leaders, and they were assigned duties at the temple, just like the other Levites.
translation_verse: Ne̱ke̱ agbónākwe̱lo̱i ne̱ amlidšāi le̱ ano̱ onukpai le̱ ame̱ye̱ ame̱gbe̱nā nitšumo̱ tamo̱ ame̱nyemimei le̱ noṅṅ, ye̱ Iehowa we le̱ súomo̱ le̱ mli.

english_verse: Each group, no matter how large or small, was assigned a gate to guard, and they let the Lord show them what he wanted done.
translation_verse: Ni afõ ošiki ye̱ *gbekẽ ke̱ onukpa fẽ hewe̱, ye̱ ame̱tše̱mei awei le̱ anã ahã agbó-fẽ-agbó. *

english_verse: Shelemiah was chosen to guard the East Gate. Zechariah his son was a wise man and was chosen to guard the North Gate.
translation_verse: Nibokãgbe̱ ošiki le̱ kpe̱ hã Šelemia; ni afõ ebi Zakaria ní dši adšinafonyo nilelo̱ le̱ hũ he ošiki, ni ešiki le̱ kpe̱ hã kōyigbe̱.

english_verse: Obed-Edom was then chosen to guard the South Gate, and his sons were chosen to guard the storerooms.
translation_verse: Obed-Edom ná wuoyigbe̱, ni ebii le̱ ná nitōhe le̱.

english_verse: four were stationed along the road leading to the west courtyard, and two guards stayed in the court itself.
translation_verse: Ke̱-yaä Parbar le̱ he, ye̱ anaigbe̱ ye̱ gbe̱dšegbe̱ le̱ nā le̱, mei edſe̱, ni mei enyo̱ yo̱ Parbar le̱ dientše̱ he.

english_verse: These were the guard duties assigned to the men from the clans of Korah and Merari. Guards Are Assigned to the Treasury
translation_verse: Agbónākwe̱lo̱i ni dše̱ Korabii ke̱ Merari bii le̱ ateṅ le̱ amlidšāi ne̱.

english_verse: The Levites who were relatives of the Korahites and the Merarites were in charge of guarding the temple treasury and the gifts that had been dedicated to God.
translation_verse: Ši Levibii le̱ ateṅ le̱ Ahia dši moni kwe̱o̱ Nyoṅmo̱ we le̱ nitōhei le̱ ke̱ nii kroṅkroṅi le̱ atōhei le̱.

english_verse: Ladan was from the Gershon clan and was the father of Jehieli. Many of his other descendants were family leaders in the clan.
translation_verse: *Ladan bii le̱, Geršonnyo le̱ bii le̱ Ladan, Ladan tše̱mei awei le̱ ano̱ onukpai: Geršonnyo le̱, Iehiel; *

english_verse: Jehieli was the father of Zetham and Joel, and they were responsible for guarding the treasury.
translation_verse: Iehiel bihĩĩ Zetam ke̱ enyemi Ioel kwe̱o̱ Iehowa we le̱ nitōhei le̱.

english_verse: Shebuel was a descendant of Gershom the son of Moses. He was the chief official in charge of the temple treasury.
translation_verse: *Šebuel, Mose bi Geršom bi le̱, yeo̱ lumo̱ ye̱ nitōhei le̱ ano̱. *

english_verse: Shelomoth and his relatives were in charge of all the gifts that were dedicated to the Lord. These included the gifts that King David had dedicated, as well as those dedicated by the family leaders, army officers, and army commanders.
translation_verse: Ne̱ke̱ Šelomot ne̱ ke̱ enyemimei le̱ dši mei ní kwe̱o̱ nii kroṅkroṅi le̱ atōhei le̱ fẽ, nii ní maṅtše̱ David ke̱ tše̱mei awei le̱ ano̱ onukpai le̱ ke̱ mei akpe-kpei ke̱ mei ohahai ano̱ asafoiatše̱mei le̱ ke̱ tatše̱mei le̱ dšō̱ no̱ ke le̱.

english_verse: And whenever valuable things were captured in battle, these men brought back some of them to make repairs to the temple.
translation_verse: Tai amli nihānii ni ame̱ṅõ le̱ ekomei ano̱ ame̱dšō̱ ame̱ke, koni ake̱-wula Iehowa we le̱;

english_verse: Shelomoth and his relatives were responsible for any gifts that had been given to the temple, including those from Samuel the prophet, King Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah. Other Officers Are Assigned Their Duties
translation_verse: ke̱ nibii fẽ ni Samuel, ninalo̱ le̱, ke̱ Saul, Kiš bi le̱, ke̱ Abner, Ner bi le̱, ke̱ Ioab, Zeruia bi le̱, edšō̱ no̱ eke le̱: nofẽno ní adšō̱ no̱ ake le̱, Šelomot ke̱ enyemimei le̱ adeṅ yo̱.

english_verse: Chenaniah from the Izhar clan and his sons were government officials and judges. They did not work at the temple.
translation_verse: Izeharbii le̱ ateṅ le̱ adšie Kenania ke̱ ebihĩĩ le̱ ní ame̱kwe̱ Israel no̱ ye̱ kpono̱gbe̱nii agbe̱fãṅ: ame̱tšṍmo̱ onukpai ke̱ kodšolo̱i.

english_verse: Joab the son of Zeruiah had begun to count the people, but he stopped when the Lord began punishing Israel. So the total number was never included in David's official records. Officials in Charge of the King's Property
translation_verse: Ioab, Zeruia bi le̱, bõi kanemo̱, ši egbee nā. Ni ene̱ hewo̱ *mlifũ ba Israel no̱ le̱; nohewo̱ le̱ ake̱ nakai yibo̱ le̱ šii akontā le̱ no̱ ye̱ maṅtše̱ David yino̱sãdši le̱ amli. *

english_verse: who was the leader of the Thirty Warriors, and whose son Ammizabad was also an army commander;
