english_verse: During Jehoiakim's rule, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia invaded Judah. He arrested Jehoiakim and put him in chains, and he sent him to the capital city of Babylon.
translation_verse: Nebukadnezar, Babel maṅtše̱ le̱, fã batuale̱, nĩ ewole̱ gbokle̱i, koni eke̱le̱ aya Babel. Ier.

english_verse: The Lord sent King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to attack Jerusalem. Nebuchadnezzar killed the young men who were in the temple, and he showed no mercy to anyone, whether man or woman, young or old. God let him kill everyone in the city.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ lo̱ eyakpla Kaldeabii le̱ amaṅtše̱ le̱ ke̱-ba ameno̱, ni eke̱ klante gbegbẽ ame̱blahĩĩ le̱ ye̱ ame̱hekroṅkroṅ le̱ šĩa le̱, ni emũsũṅ etšõõle̱ ye̱ oblanyo lo oblayō, nūmo lo wadšiatše̱ ko he; etuame̱ fe-tſẽm ewo edeṅ.

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar carried off everything that was left in the temple; he robbed the treasury and the personal storerooms of the king and his officials. He took everything back to Babylon.
translation_verse: Ni Nyoṅme̱ we le̱ nibii fẽ, nii wa-dši ke̱ nii bibii, ke̱ Iehowa we le̱ dſetrii le̱ ke̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ ke̱ enukpai le̱ a-dſetrii le̱, elō fẽ-tſẽm ke̱-te Babel.

english_verse: The survivors were taken to Babylonia as prisoners, where they were slaves of the king and his sons, until Persia became a powerful nation.
translation_verse: Ni mei ni dše klante deṅ le̱, elõame̱ ke̱-te Babel, ni ame̱yatšṍmo eke ebii le̱ atšũdšĩ ke̱-yaši Persia maṅtše̱yeli be le̱ mli.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had forced Zedekiah to promise in God's name that he would be loyal. Zedekiah was stubborn and refused to turn back to the Lord God of Israel, so he rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Ni etše maṅtše̱ Nebukadnezar hũ hĩe atũa, tše̱ ehã ekã Nyoṅmo̱ kitã; ni efe ehe kue̱ṅtilo̱, ni ewadše etšui, hewo̱ le̱ ekpalee ke̱-baa Iehowa, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ṅõ.

english_verse: The people of Judah and even the priests who were their leaders became more unfaithful. They followed the disgusting example of the nations around them and made the Lord's holy temple unfit for worship.
translation_verse: Asaṅ oso̱foi le̱ ateṅ onukpai le̱ fe ke̱ maṅbii le̱ tõ babaō dientše̱ *tamo̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ anihĩnii le̱ fẽ, ni ame̱bule Iehowa we le̱ ni efele̱ kroṅkroṅ ye̱ Ierusalem le̱. *

english_verse: But the Lord God felt sorry for his people, and instead of destroying the temple, he sent prophets who warned the people over and over about their sins.
translation_verse: Ši Iehowa, ame̱tše̱mei a-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, tšũo̱ ebo̱foi ke̱-baä ame̱ṅõ, eteo̱ ši lebi mãṅkpa etšũo̱ame̱, edšake̱ emũsũṅ tšõo̱le̱ ye̱ emaṅ le̱ ke̱ ešihĩle̱he le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: But the people only laughed and insulted these prophets. They ignored what the Lord God was trying to tell them, until he finally became so angry that nothing could stop him from punishing Judah and Jerusalem. Jerusalem Is Destroyed (
translation_verse: Ši ame̱ le̱, Nyoṅmo̱ bo̱foi le̱ ahe fe̱o moṅ ame̱yeo̱, ni ame̱gbeo̱ ewiemo̱i le̱ ahe guo̱ ni ame̱lio̱ egbalo̱i le̱ āhũ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni Iehowa mlifũ te ši wo emaṅ le̱ ní tšábā ko be̱ doṅṅ. Luk.

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar's troops burned down the temple and destroyed every important building in the city. Then they broke down the city wall.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱šã Nyoṅmo̱ we le̱, ni ame̱-kũmo̱kũmō̱ Ierusalem gbogboi le̱, ni emli mõdši fe̱fe̱dši le̱ fẽ ame̱šā ke̱ la, ni ame̱-fite emli fe̱o-nibii le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: In the first year that Cyrus was king of Persia, the Lord had Cyrus send a message to all parts of his kingdom. This happened just as Jeremiah the Lord's prophet had promised.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ Koreš, Persia maṅtše̱ le̱, yino̱ kleṅkleṅ afi le̱ no̱ le̱, beni afe ni Iehowa wiemo̱ ni ewie ye̱ *Ieremia nā le̱ aba mli le̱, Iehowa tšĩe †Koreš, Persia maṅtše̱ le̱, mumo̱ hĩe, ni ehã ašie̱ ye̱ e-maṅtše̱yelihe le̱ fẽ, ni asã aṅmã hũ ake̱: *Ier.

english_verse: Everyone else must provide what is needed. They must give money, supplies, and animals, as well as gifts for rebuilding God's temple.
translation_verse: Ni mofẽmo ni eſe̱ ye̱ hefẽhe ni eyato gbo̱ ye̱ le̱, dše̱mei bii le̱ aye abuale̱ ke̱ dſie̱te̱i ke̱ šika ke̱ nibiinibii ke̱ koloi, ni asaṅ ame̱hã tšuidšũrõnā nikēnii ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ šīa ní yo̱ Ierusalem le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: The others helped by giving silver articles, gold, personal possessions, cattle, and other valuable gifts, as well as offerings for the temple.
translation_verse: Ni mei ni ke̱ame̱ dše ſieka le̱ fẽ wo ame̱nidšiaṅ ke̱ dſie̱te̱i nibii ke̱ šika ke̱ nibiinibii ke̱ koloi ke̱ nibii ni dšra wa, ni asaṅ ame̱hã tšuidšũrõnā nikēnii hũ.

english_verse: King Cyrus gave back the things that Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the Lord's temple in Jerusalem and had put in the temple of his own gods.
translation_verse: Ni maṅtše̱ Koreš hũ dšie Iehowa we le̱ nibii le̱ ní Nebukadnezar yalō ke̱-dše̱ Ierusalem ke̱-ba ni eke̱-bawo enyoṅmo̱ le̱ we le̱.

english_verse: Cyrus placed Mithredath, his chief treasurer, in charge of these things. Mithredath counted them and gave a list to Sheshbazzar, the governor of Judah.
translation_verse: Nomeĩ noṅṅ Koreš, Persia maṅtše̱ le̱, dšie ewo Mitredat, šikatolo̱ le̱, deṅ, ni ekane ehã *Šešbazar, Iuda lumo̱ le̱. *

english_verse: Here is how many people returned whose ancestors had come from the following towns:
translation_verse: Senaa bii le̱: akpei-etẽ ke̱ ohai-ekpa ke̱ nyoṅmai-etẽ.

english_verse: Here is a list of how many returned from each family of priests:
translation_verse: Harim bii le̱: akpe ke̱ nyoṅma ke̱ kpawo.

english_verse: Here is a list of Solomon's servants whose descendants returned: Sotai, Hassophereth, Peruda, Jaalah, Darkon, Giddel, Shephatiah, Hattil, Pochereth Hazzebaim, and Ami.
translation_verse: Šefatia bii le̱, Hatil bii le̱, Pokeret-Hazebaim bii le̱, Ami bii le̱.

english_verse: In fact, the governor told them, “You cannot eat the food offered to God until we find out if you really are priests.”
translation_verse: Ni *amralo le̱ kē̱ame̱ ake̱ ame̱kaye nii kroṅkroṅi fè fẽ le̱ eko, ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní oso̱fo ko aate ši ni ewo †urim ke̱ tumim. *K.

english_verse: When the people came to where the Lord's temple had been in Jerusalem, some of the family leaders gave gifts so it could be rebuilt in the same place.
translation_verse: Ni beni ame̱ba Iehowa we le̱ ye̱ Ierusalem le̱, tše̱mei awei le̱ ano̱ onukpai le̱ ekomei bake nii ye̱ tšuidšũrõ nā ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ we le̱ hewo̱, koni amã ye̱ emā̃he le̱.

english_verse: They gave all they could, and it came to a total of
translation_verse: Ame̱hã bo̱ni ame̱anyẽ ni ake̱-wo nitšumo̱ le̱ he dſetri le̱ mli: šika dalei akpei-nyoṅmai-ekpa-ke̱-ekome, ke̱ dſiete̱i benai akpei-enumo̱, ke̱ oso̱foi atadei oha.

english_verse: Everyone returned to the towns from which their families had come, including the priests, the Levites, the musicians, the temple guards, and the workers.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni oso̱foi le̱ ke̱ Levibii le̱ ke̱ maṅbii le̱ ateṅ meikomei ke̱ lalatše̱mei le̱ ke̱ agbónākwe̱lo̱i le̱ ke̱ so̱lemo̱we súolo̱i le̱ bahĩ ame̱mãdši le̱ amli, ni Israel mū le̱ fẽ hĩ ame̱mãdši le̱ amli.

english_verse: Although work on the temple itself had not yet begun, the people started offering sacrifices on the Lord's altar on the first day of the seventh month of that year. The Rebuilding of the Temple Begins
translation_verse: Nyõṅ ní dši kpawo le̱ no̱ kleṅkleṅ gbĩ le̱ no̱ ame̱dše̱ ame̱bõi šā̃-afo̱leì le̱ ašã ke̱ Iehowa hãmo̱. Ši Iehowa so̱lemo̱tšũ le̱ anáko ato šiši.

english_verse: During the second month of the second year after the people had returned from Babylonia, they started rebuilding the Lord's temple. Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Joshua son of Jozadak, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned started working. Every Levite over
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ beni ame̱ba Iehowa we le̱ ye̱ Ierusalem le̱, eno̱ afi ní dši enyo̱ le̱ no̱ nyõṅ ní dši enyo̱ le̱ no̱ le̱, Zerubabel, Šealtiel bi le̱, ke̱ Iešua, Iozadak bi le̱, ke̱ ame̱nyemimei ní eſe̱ le̱, oso̱foi le̱ ke̱ Levibii le̱, ke̱ mei fẽ ní dše̱ nom-ṅō̃ le̱ mli ba Ierusalem le̱ bõi, ni ame̱-fãmo̱ Levibii ní eye afii nyoṅmai-enyo̱ ke̱-yaä le̱, koni ame̱kwe̱ Iehowa we le̱ nitšumo̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: The Levites in charge of the whole project were Joshua and his sons and relatives and Kadmiel and his sons from the family of Hodaviah. The family of Henadad worked along with them.
translation_verse: Ni Iešua ke̱ ebii ke̱ enyemimei le̱, ke̱ Kadmiel ke̱ ebii le̱, ke̱ Iuda bii le̱ blūblu ho damo̱ ši, koni ame̱kwe̱ Nyoṅmo̱ we le̱ nitšulo̱i le̱ ano̱, ke̱ Henadad bii le̱ ke̱ ame̱bii ke̱ ame̱nyemimei Levibii le̱ hũ. Neh.

english_verse: When the builders had finished laying the foundation of the temple, the priests put on their robes and blew trumpets in honor of the Lord, while the Levites from the family of Asaph praised God with cymbals. All of them followed the instructions given years before by King David.
translation_verse: Ni beni tšũmãlo̱i le̱ to Iehowa so̱lemo̱we le̱ šiši le̱, oso̱foi ní ewowō ame̱-tadei le̱ hĩe te̱tre̱mantre̱i ke̱-damo̱ ši, ni Levibii le̱ ní dši Asaf bii le̱ hũ hĩe ṅoṅoi, koni ame̱kafo Iehowa, take̱ bo̱ni Israel maṅtše̱ David to gbe̱dšiano̱ le̱.

english_verse: They praised the Lord and gave thanks as they took turns singing: “The Lord is good! His faithful love for Israel will last forever.” Everyone started shouting and praising the Lord because work on the foundation of the temple had begun.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱la ni ame̱herehere no̱ ame̱-ke̱-kaſo Iehowa ni ame̱ke̱-dale̱ ši, *edšake̱ ehĩ, edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä ye̱ Israel no̱. Ni maṅ mū le̱ fẽ bo̱ oše wā, beni ame̱kafoo̱ Iehowa ye̱ Iehowa šīa le̱ šišitō le̱ hewo̱ le̱. *

english_verse: Many of the older priests and Levites and the heads of families wept bitterly because they remembered seeing the first temple years before. But others were so happy that they celebrated with joyful shouts.
translation_verse: Ši oso̱foi ke̱ Levibii le̱ ke̱ tše̱mei awei le̱ ano̱ onukpai le̱ ateṅ mei pī, ni dši hĩĩmedši ni *na kleṅkleṅ šĩa le̱, fó ke̱ gbē wā le̱, beni ato šĩa ne̱ šiši ye̱ ame̱hĩe le̱; ši mei babaō hũ bo̱ oše wā ke̱ nyã́mo̱. *Hag.

english_verse: Their shouting and crying were so noisy that it all sounded alike and could be heard a long way off.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ maṅbii le̱ yoo emli noni dši nyã́mo̱ ošebō̱ le̱ ke̱ noni dši maṅbii le̱ ayāfó blo̱mo̱ le̱; edšake̱ maṅbii le̱ bo̱ oše wā dientše̱, ni anu he ye̱ šoṅṅ.

english_verse: In the first year that Xerxes was king, the neighboring people brought written charges against the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ni Ahašweroš maṅtše̱yeli be le̱ mli, beni ebõi maṅtše̱yeli le̱, ame̱ṅmã Iuda ke̱ Ierusalem bii le̱ ahe nãflo̱mo̱ wolo.

english_verse: Later, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and their advisors got together and wrote a letter to Artaxerxes when he was king of Persia. It was written in Aramaic and had to be translated.
translation_verse: Asaṅ Artašasta yino̱ le̱ Bislam, Mitredad, Tabeel ke̱ enanemei ni eſe̱ le̱ ṅmã wolo yahã Artašasta, Persia maṅtše̱ le̱; ni aṅmã wolo le̱ ye̱ Aram niṅmā̃ mli, ni atšõ šiši hũ ye̱ Aram wiemo̱ le̱ mli.

english_verse: This letter said: Your Majesty King Artaxerxes, we are your servants from everywhere in Western Province, and we send you our greetings.
translation_verse: Wolo ni ame̱ṅmã ame̱mãdše maṅtše̱ Artašasta le̱ mli sane ne̱: Otšũdši ni dši mei ni yo̱ fā le̱ bie̱gbe̱ le̱, ke̱ nii.

english_verse: You should know that the Jews who left your country have moved back to Jerusalem and are now rebuilding that rebellious city. In fact, they have almost finished rebuilding the walls and repairing the foundations.
translation_verse: Maṅtše̱ aná ale ake̱ Iudafoi le̱ ni dše̱ oṅõ ba wo̱ṅõ ne̱ eba Ierusalem; ni ame̱mīto atũatšemo̱ maṅ fõṅ le̱ ekoṅ, ni ame̱gbe ehe gbogboi le̱ ana, ni ame̱sã ešišitōi le̱ hũ.

english_verse: You should also know that if the walls are completed and the city is rebuilt, the Jews won't pay any kind of taxes, and there will be less money in your treasury.
translation_verse: Bĕle̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ aná ale ake̱, ke̱dši ato ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱ ekoṅ, ni agbe ehe gbogboi le̱ anã le̱, no le̱ ame̱hãṅ onīa ke̱ ntō ke̱ gbe̱dšē-šika doṅṅ, ni beni yi yawula ši le̱, maṅtše̱mei le̱ enine enyẽ ši.

english_verse: We are telling you this, because you have done so much for us, and we want everyone to respect you.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ ake̱-ni maṅtše̱mṍ le̱ mli ṅō wo̱yeo̱ hewo̱ le̱, esaa ake̱ wo̱o̱kwe̱ ni maṅtše̱ he guo̱ agbo, nohewo̱ wo̱tšũ ni abatſa maṅtše̱ adafi ne̱,

english_verse: If Jerusalem is rebuilt and its walls completed, you will no longer have control over Western Province.
translation_verse: Wo̱ le̱ wo̱mītſa maṅtše̱ adafi ake̱, ke̱dši ato ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱ ekoṅ ni atſa ehe gbogboi le̱, no le̱ onáṅ gbe̱fãṅnõ ko ye̱ fā le̱ bie̱gbe̱ doṅṅ.

english_verse: King Artaxerxes answered: Greetings to Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and to your advisors in Samaria and other parts of Western Province.
translation_verse: Maṅtše̱ le̱ tšũ ake hetō bahā Rehum, adšinafoĩatše̱ le̱, ke̱ Šimšai, woloṅmãlo̱ le̱, ke̱ ame̱nanemei ní eſe̱ ní yo̱ Samaria le̱, ke̱ mei ní eſe̱ ye̱ fā le̱ bie̱gbe̱ le̱ ake̱: Nyehãa omanye abaä! ke̱ nii.

english_verse: After your letter was translated and read to me,
translation_verse: Wolo ni nyetšũ ake̱-bahãwo̱ le̱, akane faṅṅ ye̱ mihĩe.

english_verse: I had the old records checked. It is true that for years Jerusalem has rebelled and caused trouble for other kings and nations.
translation_verse: Ni mifã ni atao mli, ni ana ake̱ ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱ ke̱-dše̱ tetẽte le̱ eteo̱ ši ewoo̱ maṅtše̱mei le̱, ni atšeo̱ atũa ni atšõo̱ mansõ hũ ye̱ mli.

english_verse: And powerful kings have ruled Western Province from Jerusalem and have collected all kinds of taxes.
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ maṅtše̱mei agboi hũ ehĩ Ierusalem, ni ame̱ye fā le̱ se̱ fẽ no̱, ni atšũo̱ onĩa ke̱ ntō ke̱ gbe̱dšē-šika ahãa-ame̱ hũ.

english_verse: I want you to command the people to stop rebuilding the city until I give further notice.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyewoa akpo̱ĩ ní ne̱ke̱ gbomei ne̱ afō maṅ ne̱ tō ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni akpo̱ aadše̱ miṅõ.

english_verse: Do this at once, so that no harm will come to the kingdom.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ nyekwe̱a ni ahĩa, ni nyeke̱ nyehe akafõa ši ye̱ ene̱ mli; mẽhewo̱ aahã fitemo̱ akwẽ ni maṅtše̱mei le̱ anine anyẽ ši?

english_verse: As soon as this letter was read, Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and their advisors went to Jerusalem and forced everyone to stop rebuilding the city. Work on the Temple Starts Again
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ beni akane maṅtše̱ Artašasta wolo ní eṅmã le̱ ye̱ Rehum ke̱ Šimšai, woloṅmălo̱ le̱, ke̱ ame̱nanemei le̱ able pe̱ le̱, ame̱yiṅ ke̱-ba Ierusalem oyá, ni ame̱banina Iudafoi le̱, ni ame̱tšĩame̱ gbe̱ ye̱ no̱nyẽ ke̱ hewale̱ nā.

english_verse: The Jews were forced to stop work on the temple and were not able to do any more building until the year after Darius became king of Persia.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni afõ Nyoṅmo̱ we le̱ ní yo̱ Ierusalem le̱ he nitšumo̱ le̱, ni afõ āhũ ke̱-yaši *Dario, Persia maṅtše̱ le̱, maṅtše̱yeli le̱ afi ní dši enyo̱ le̱ no̱. *K.

english_verse: Governor Tattenai of Western Province and his assistant Shethar Bozenai got together with some of their officials. Then they went to Jerusalem and said to the people, “Who told you to rebuild this temple?
translation_verse: No be le̱ mli noṅṅ le̱ Tatnai ni dši fă le̱ bie̱gbe̱ amralo le̱, ke̱ Šetar-Boznai ke̱ ame̱nanemei le̱ ba ame̱ṅõ, ni bo̱ni ame̱kē̱ame̱ ne̱: Namo fã́nye ake̱ nyemã ne̱ke̱ šĩa ne̱, ni nyesā ne̱ke̱ gbogbo ne̱?

english_verse: which said: King Darius, we wish you the best!
translation_verse: Wolo le̱ ame̱tšũ ake̱-yahãle̱, ni bo̱ni aṅmã ye̱ mli ne̱: Maṅtše̱ Dario nō dši omanye so̱ṅṅ!

english_verse: We also asked for the names of their leaders, so that we could write them down for you.
translation_verse: Ni wo̱sā wo̱bibī ame̱gbe̱ii hũ, koni wo̱hã ole, koni wo̱ṅmã hĩĩ ní dši ame̱nukpai le̱ agbe̱ii.

english_verse: They claimed to be servants of the God who rules heaven and earth. And they said they were rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago by one of Israel's greatest kings.
translation_verse: Hetō ní ame̱hãwo̱ ne̱, ame̱kē̱: Wo̱ le̱ ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ tšũdši dšiwo̱, ni wo̱mīsā šĩa ní amã dšeeṅmō afii babaō ne̱, ni Israel maṅtše̱ agbo ko mã ni egbe nā le̱.

english_verse: We were told that their people had made God angry, and he let them be captured by Nebuchadnezzar, the Babylonian king who took them away as captives to Babylonia. Nebuchadnezzar tore down their temple,
translation_verse: Ši ake̱-ni wo̱tše̱mei le̱ wo ṅwei Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ mlila hewo̱ le̱, eṅõame̱ ewo Babel maṅtše̱ Nebukadnezar, Kaldeanyo le̱, deṅ, ni *ebakũmo̱ ne̱ke̱ šĩa ne̱, ni maṅbii le̱ eṅõame̱ nom ke̱-te Babel. *

english_verse: Sheshbazzar then went to Jerusalem and laid the foundation for the temple, and the work is still going on.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni nakai Šešbazar le̱ noṅṅ ba ni ebato Nyoṅmo̱ we le̱ ni yo̱ Ierusalem le̱ šiši. Ni ke̱-dše̱ nakai be le̱ ne̱ āhũ ke̱-baši be ne̱, ne̱ āmã lolo, ši kẽle̱ agbeko nā.

english_verse: Your Majesty, please order someone to look up the old records in Babylonia and find out if King Cyrus really did give orders to rebuild God's temple in Jerusalem. We will do whatever you think we should.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ agbe̱ne̱ ke̱dši esa maṅtše̱ hĩe le̱, no le̱ ehã atao ye̱ maṅtše̱ nitō šĩa ní yo̱ Babel le̱, ake̱ eye̱ mli ake̱ maṅtše̱ Koreš ewo akpo̱ ake̱ ayamã ne̱ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱ we ne̱ ye̱ Ierusalem lo, koni maṅtše̱ atšũ ní abakē̱wo̱ bo̱ni edſẽṅo̱ ye̱ sane ne̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: Let the Jewish governor and leaders rebuild it where it stood before. And stop slowing them down!
translation_verse: Nyeṅmẽa Nyoṅmo̱ we ne̱ he nitšumo̱ le̱ gbe̱; nyehãa Iudafoi le̱ amralo le̱ ke̱ Iudafoi le̱ anukpai le̱ amã Nyoṅmo̱ we ne̱ ye̱ emā̃he le̱.

english_verse: And don't fail to let the priests in Jerusalem have whatever they need each day so they can offer sacrifices to the God of heaven. Give them young bulls, rams, sheep, as well as wheat, salt, wine, and olive oil.
translation_verse: Ni nii ni hĩaāame̱ le̱, tšinabii ke̱ tōagboi ke̱ tōbii ní ake̱-ašã šã-afo̱lei ahã ṅwei Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ṅmã, ṅō, wein ke̱ mũ, bo̱ni oso̱foi ní yo̱ Ierusalem le̱ aabi le̱, ahãame̱ gbĩ-fẽ-gbĩ ni akafo mli,

english_verse: If any of you don't obey this order, a wooden beam will be taken from your house and sharpened on one end. Then it will be driven through your body, and your house will be torn down and turned into a garbage dump.
translation_verse: Misā mīwo akpo̱ ake̱ mofẽmo ní aatšake wiemo̱ ne̱ hīe le̱, adšie etšũ no̱ mplãṅ, ni ake̱-mã ši ni ase̱ṅle̱ ye̱ no̱, ni ahã ewe le̱ atšṍ tumu ye̱ ene̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: Governor Tattenai, Shethar Bozenai, and their advisors carefully obeyed King Darius.
translation_verse: Ni Tatnai, fã le̱ bie̱gbe̱ amralo le̱, ke̱ Šetar-Boznai ke̱ ame̱nanemei le̱, ake̱-ni maṅtše̱ Dario tšũ abakē̱ hewo̱ le̱, ame̱fe nakai pe̱pē̱pe̱.

english_verse: With great success the Jewish leaders continued working on the temple, while Haggai and Zechariah encouraged them by their preaching. And so, the temple was completed at the command of the God of Israel and by the orders of kings Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes of Persia.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iudafoi le̱ anukpai le̱ mã ni ete no̱ ye̱ gbalo̱ Hagai ke̱ Zakaria, Ido bi le̱, gbale̱ le̱ hewo̱. Ni ame̱mã ni ame̱gbe nā ye̱ Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ kitã le̱ ke̱ Persia maṅtše̱ Koreš ke̱ Dario ke̱ Artašasta akpo̱ le̱ nā.

english_verse: On the third day of the month of Adar in the sixth year of the rule of Darius, the temple was finished.
translation_verse: Ni agbe šla le̱ nā ye̱ Adar nyõṅ le̱ no̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ etẽ le̱ no̱ ye̱ *maṅtše̱ Dario maṅtše̱yeli afi ni dši ekpa le̱ no̱. *

english_verse: The people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned from exile were happy and celebrated as they dedicated God's temple.
translation_verse: Ni Israelbii le̱, oso̱foi ke̱ Levibii le̱, ke̱ nomṅõbii le̱ ni eſe̱ le̱ ye Nyoṅmo̱ we ne̱ *nāgblemo̱ gbīdšũrõ le̱ ke̱ mliflimo̱. *

english_verse: One hundred bulls, two hundred rams, and four hundred lambs were offered as sacrifices at the dedication. Also twelve goats were sacrificed as sin offerings for the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Ni Nyoṅmo̱ we ne̱ nāgblemo̱ le̱ mli le̱ ame̱ke̱ tšinai oha, tōagboi ohai-enyo̱, tōbii ohai-edſe̱ šã afo̱le, ke̱ tōkpakpoi nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱ ni *ake̱-šã eša-afo̱lei ahã Israel mū le̱ fẽ ye̱ Israel akutšei le̱ ayibo̱ le̱ nā. *

english_verse: Then the priests and Levites were assigned their duties in God's temple in Jerusalem, according to the instructions Moses had written. The Passover
translation_verse: Ni ame̱to oso̱foi le̱ ye̱ ame̱safokui le̱ anã, ke̱ Levibii le̱ ye̱ ame̱mlidšāi le̱ anã, ame̱hã Nyoṅmo̱ sũomo̱ ní yo̱ Ierusalem le̱, take̱ bo̱ni *aṅmã ye̱ Mose wolo le̱ mli le̱. *

english_verse: Everyone who had returned from exile celebrated Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni nomṅõbii le̱ ye *Hehō le̱ ye̱ kleṅkleṅ nyõṅ le̱ no̱ gbĩ ni dši gbĩ nyoṅma ke̱ edſe̱ le̱ no̱. *

english_verse: The priests and Levites had gone through a ceremony to make themselves acceptable to lead in worship. Then some of them killed Passover lambs for those who had returned, including the other priests and themselves.
translation_verse: Edšako̱ oso̱foi le̱ ke̱ Levibii le̱ blūblu etšū ame̱he, ni ame̱fẽ ame̱he etše; ni ame̱gbe Hehō tōbii le̱ ame̱hã nomṅõbii le̱ fẽ ke̱ ame̱nyemimei oso̱foi le̱ ke̱ ame̱dientše̱ ame̱he.

english_verse: The sacrifices were eaten by the Israelites who had returned and by the neighboring people who had given up the sinful customs of other nations in order to worship the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ni Israelbii le̱ ni dše̱ nomṅõ le̱ mli ba le̱, ke̱ mei fẽ ní etše ame̱he ke̱-dše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ wo̱ṅdšálo̱i le̱ abulemo̱nii le̱ ahe ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱he ebabo̱ ame̱he, koni ame̱tao Iehowa, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, se̱gbe̱ le̱, ye Hehō le̱,

english_verse: For seven days they celebrated the Festival of Thin Bread. Everyone was happy because the Lord God of Israel had made sure that the king of Assyria would be kind to them and help them build the temple.
translation_verse: ni ame̱ye akpĩtī gbĩdšũrõ gbĩĩ kpănyo̱ ke̱ nyámo̱; edšake̱ Iehowa ehã ame̱-mli efliame̱, ni ehã Ašur maṅtše̱ le̱ tšui emõame̱, koni ewo ame̱nidšiaṅ ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ní dši Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ we le̱ he nitšumo̱ le̱ mli.

english_verse: God helped Ezra, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month of that seventh year, after leaving Babylonia on the first day of the first month.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ kleṅkleṅ nyõṅ le̱ no̱ kleṅkleṅ gbĩ le̱ no̱ ame̱bõi mliyimo̱ ke̱-dše̱ Babel, ni nyõṅ ni dši enumo̱ le̱ no̱ kleṅkleṅ gbĩ le̱ no̱ ebaše̱ Ierusalem *ye̱ e-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ mlihīle̱ nine ni fata ehe le̱ hewo̱. *K.

english_verse: Ezra was a priest and an expert in the laws and commands that the Lord had given to Israel. One day King Artaxerxes gave Ezra a letter which said:
translation_verse: Ši wolo, ní maṅtše̱ Artašasta ṅõ-hã oso̱fo Ezra ní dši woloṅmãlo̱ ní le Iehowa kitãi ke̱ ekpo̱i ní ewo Israel le̱ amli wiemo̱i le̱ dšogbãṅ le̱, mli sane ne̱:

english_verse: Greetings from the great King Artaxerxes to Ezra the priest and expert in the teachings of the God of heaven.
translation_verse: Artašasta, *maṅtše̱mei amaṅtše̱ le̱, ṅmã hã oso̱fo Ezra ni dši woloṅmãlo̱ ni le ṅwei Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ mla le̱ mli dšogbãṅ le̱, ke̱ nii. *Ezek.

english_verse: When you go, take the silver and gold that I and my advisors are freely giving to the God of Israel, whose temple is in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: ní oṅõ dſie̱te̱i ke̱ šika ní maṅtše̱ le̱ ke̱ edšinafoi le̱ eke Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ni ešihĩle̱he yo̱ Ierusalem le̱, ye̱ tšuidšũrõ nā le̱ ke̱-ya,

english_verse: Take the silver and gold that you collect from everywhere in Babylonia. Also take the gifts that your own people and priests have so willingly contributed for the temple of your God in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: ke̱ dſie̱te̱i ke̱ šika fẽ ni ooná ye̱ Babel šikpoṅ le̱ fẽ no̱ le̱, ke̱ tšuidšũrõ-nā nikẽnii ni maṅbii le̱ ke̱ oso̱foi le̱ aake ye̱ ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ we ni yo̱ Ierusalem le̱ hewo̱ le̱;

english_verse: Use the money carefully to buy the best bulls, rams, lambs, grain, and wine. Then sacrifice them on the altar at God's temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: nohewo̱ le̱ bo̱ mo̱deṅ ni oke̱ ne̱ke̱ šika ne̱ ahe tšinai, tōagboi, tōbii, ke̱ ame̱be niyenii-afo̱lei ke̱ dā̃-afo̱lei le̱, ní oke̱-yašã afo̱le ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ ní yo̱ nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ we le̱ ye̱ Ierusalem le̱ no̱.

english_verse: If any silver or gold is left, you and your people may use it for whatever pleases your God.
translation_verse: Ni nofẽno ní sa oke̱ onyemimei le̱ ahĩe ake̱ nyeke̱ dſie̱te̱i ke̱ šika ni aaſe̱ le̱ aafe le̱, nyeke̱-fea ye̱ nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ suomo̱ nā.

english_verse: Give your God the other articles that have been contributed for use in his temple.
translation_verse: Asaṅ nibii ni aṅõ-hão ye̱ o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ we le̱ súomo̱ le̱ hewo̱ le̱, dšiemo̱ ohã ye̱ Ierusalem Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ hĩe.

english_verse: If you need to get anything else for the temple, you may have the money you need from the royal treasury.
translation_verse: Ni nofẽno ní he aahĩa lolo ye̱ o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ we le̱ hewo̱ ní sa ake̱ ohā le̱, yahe ye̱ maṅtše̱ nitōhe le̱.

english_verse: Ezra, you are a priest and an expert in the laws of the God of heaven, and I order all treasurers in Western Province to do their very best to help you.
translation_verse: Ni mi, maṅtše̱ Artašasta, mīwo dſetritolo̱i fẽ ní yo̱ fā le̱ se̱ le̱ akpo̱ ake̱ nofẽno ní oso̱fo Ezra, ní dši ṅwei Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ mla le̱ ṅmãlo̱ le̱, aabinye le̱, abo̱ mo̱deṅ ni afe,

english_verse: They must provide whatever the God of heaven demands for his temple, so that he won't be angry with me and with the kings who rule after me.
translation_verse: Nofẽno ni ṅwei Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ewo he akpo̱ le̱, hã ní abo̱ mo̱deṅ afe pe̱pē̱pe̱ ahã ṅwei Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ we le̱; ši mẽhewo̱ mlifũ aaba maṅtše̱ ke̱ ebii le̱ amaṅtše̱yeli le̱ no̱?

english_verse: We want you to know that no priests, Levites, musicians, guards, temple servants, or any other temple workers will have to pay any kind of taxes.
translation_verse: Asaṅ wo̱mīhā nyená nyele ake̱ oso̱foi ke̱ Levibii ke̱ lalatše̱mei ke̱ agbónākwe̱lo̱i ke̱ so̱lemo̱we súolo̱i ke̱ tšũdši ní yo̱ ne̱ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱ we ne̱ le̱, mokomoko be̱ hegbe̱ ake̱ etšũo̱ame̱ onĩa lo ntō lo gbe̱dšē-šika ko.

english_verse: Ezra, use the wisdom God has given you and choose officials and leaders to govern the people of Western Province. These leaders should know God's laws and have them taught to anyone who doesn't know them.
translation_verse: Ni bo, Ezra hũ, ye̱ o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ nilē ní yo̱ odeṅ le̱ nā le̱, fãmo̱ kodšolo̱i ke̱ saneyelo̱i fẽ ni le o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ mla le̱, koni ame̱kodšo maṅ ni yo̱ fā le̱ se̱ le̱ fẽ; ni mei ni lee le̱, nyetšõaame̱ ní ame̱le.

english_verse: Everyone who fails to obey God's Law or the king's law will be punished without pity. They will either be executed or put in prison or forced to leave their country, or have all they own taken away. Ezra Praises God
translation_verse: Ni mofẽmo ni yee o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ mla le̱ ke̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ mla le̱ no̱ le̱, akodšole̱ ye̱ no nā pe̱pē̱pe̱, ké̱ eheo̱ gbĕle dšio, nanešitũtſã dšio, nihemo̱ dšio, tšũṅwō dšio.

english_verse: Because King Artaxerxes was so kind, Ezra said: Praise the Lord God of our ancestors! He made sure that the king honored the Lord's temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Aadšie Iehowa, wo̱tše̱mei a-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, yi, moni ke̱ ne̱ke̱ noko wo maṅtše̱ le̱ tšuiṅ ake̱ ewula Iehowa we ni yo̱ Ierusalem le̱,

english_verse: God has told the king, his advisors, and his powerful officials to treat me with kindness. The Lord God has helped me, and I have been able to bring many Jewish leaders back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: ni mi hũ ehã emo̱bo̱nale̱ eše̱ mine̱, ye̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ ke̱ edšinafoi le̱ ke̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ lume̱i agboi le̱ fẽ able! Ni Iehowa, mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, *nine ni fata mihe hewo̱ le̱, miná hewale̱ ni mike̱-bua Israelbii le̱ ateṅ onukpai le̱ anā ní ame̱ke̱mi afã ke̱-ya. *K.

english_verse: Gershom of the Phinehas family; Daniel of the Ithamar family; Hattush son of Shecaniah of the David family; Zechariah and
translation_verse: Ni Bigewai bii le̱ ateṅ le̱: Utai ke̱ Zabud, ni hĩĩ nyoṅmai-kpawo fata amehe.

english_verse: I said to the priests: You belong to the Lord, the God of your ancestors, and these things also belong to him. The silver and gold were willingly given as gifts to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni mikē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nye le̱ nyeye̱ kroṅkroṅ nyehã Iehowa, ni nibii le̱ hũ ye̱ kroṅkroṅ, ni dſie̱te̱i le̱ ke̱ šika le̱ tšuidšũrõ nā aṅõ-hã Iehowa, wo̱tše̱mei a-Nyoṅme̱ le̱.

english_verse: I brought everyone together by the river that flows to the town of Ahava where we camped for three days. Not one Levite could be found among the people and priests.
translation_verse: Ni mibua nme̱nā ke̱-te fā ní ke̱ enā yawoo̱ Ahawa mli le̱ ni, ni wo̱be̱ nsra ye̱ dše̱i gbĩĩ etẽ. Ni beni mikwe̱ maṅ le̱ ke̱ oso̱foi le̱, minaa Levinyo ko ye̱ dše̱i.

english_verse: So I sent for the leaders Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam. I also sent for Joiarib and Elnathan, who were very wise counselors.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mitšũ ayatšē̱ Eliezer ke̱ Ariel ke̱ Šemaia ke̱ Elnatan ke̱ Iarib ke̱ Elnatan ke̱ Natan ke̱ Zakaria ke̱ Mešulam, ni dši onukpai le̱, ke̱ Ioiarib ke̱ Elnatan ni dši tšõlo̱i le̱ hũ ke̱-ba.

english_verse: Then I sent them to Iddo, the leader at Casiphia, and I told them to ask him and his temple workers to send people to serve in God's temple.
translation_verse: Ni mitšũame̱ Ido ni dši onukpa ye̱ Kasifia mã le̱ṅ le̱ ṅõ, ni miṅõ wiemo̱i miwo ame̱nā ni ame̱ke̱ Ido ke̱ enyemimei *so̱lemo̱we súolo̱i ní yo̱ Kasifia mã le̱ṅ le̱ ayawie, koni ame̱kpla súolo̱i ni aasúmo̱ ye̱ wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ we le̱ ame̱ba-hãwo̱. *

english_verse: God was kind to us and caused them to send a skillful man named Sherebiah, who was a Levite from the family of Mahli. Eighteen of his relatives came with him.
translation_verse: Ni wo̱-Nyoùmo̱ le̱ mlihĩle̱ *nine ní fata wohe le̱ nā le̱ ame̱ke̱ nū ko ní le nii ni dše̱ Israel bi Levi bi Maheli bii le̱ ateṅ, ke̱ Šerebia ke̱ ebii ke̱ enyemimei nyoṅma ke̱ kpānyo̱ ba ame̱bahãwo̱, *

english_verse: We were also sent Hashabiah and Jeshaiah from the family of Merari along with
translation_verse: ke̱ Hašabia bũ ke̱ Iešaia ni dše̱ Merari bii le̱ ateṅ le̱, ke̱ enyemimei ke̱ ame̱bii, nyoṅmai-enyo̱;

english_verse: Beside the Ahava River, I asked the people to go without eating and to pray. We humbled ourselves and asked God to bring us and our children safely to Jerusalem with all of our possessions.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mišie̱ ṅmā̃hĩle̱ ye̱ dše̱i, ye̱ Ahawa fā le̱ nā, koni wo̱ba wohe ši ye̱ wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ hĩe, ni wo̱kpale̱ fai ni ehã wo̱gbe̱ le̱ adša ahãwo̱ ke̱ wo̱bii bibii ke̱ wo̱nibii fẽ.

english_verse: So we went without food and asked God himself to protect us, and he answered our prayers. The Gifts for the Temple
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ wo̱hĩ ṅmā̃ ni wo̱kpa wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ fai ye̱ ene̱ hewo̱, ni ebowo̱ toi.

english_verse: I chose twelve of the leading priests—Sherebiah, Hashabiah and ten of their relatives.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mĩ̀fãmo̱ oso̱foi le̱ ateṅ onukpai nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱: Šerebia ke̱ Hašabia, ni ame̱nyemimei le̱ ateṅ mei nyoṅma fata ame̱he;

english_verse: Be sure to guard them and keep them safe until you reach Jerusalem. Then weigh them inside God's temple in the presence of the chief priests, the Levites, and the heads of the Israelite families.
translation_verse: Nyebua he ni nyeke̱-toa ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni nyeayaṅmẽ ye̱ oso̱foi le̱ ke̱ Levibii le̱ anukpai le̱ ke̱ Israel tše̱mei awei le̱ ano̱ onukpai le̱ ni yo̱ Ierusalem le̱ ahĩe, ye̱ Iehowa we le̱ piai le̱ amli.

english_verse: The priests and Levites then took charge of the gifts that had been weighed, so they could take them to the temple of our God in Jerusalem. The Return to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni oso̱foi le̱ ke̱ Levibii le̱ lō dſie̱te̱i le̱ ke̱ šika le̱ ke̱ nibii ni aṅmẽ le̱, koni ame̱ke̱-ya wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ we le̱ ye̱ Ierusalem.

english_verse: On the twelfth day of the first month, we left the Ahava River and started for Jerusalem. Our God watched over us, and as we traveled along, he kept our enemies from ambushing us.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni wo̱fã ye̱ Ahawa fã le̱ nā ye̱ kleṅkleṅ nyõṅ le̱ no̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱ le̱ ne̱, koni wo̱ya Ierusalem. Ni wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ nine fata wo̱he, ni edšiewo̱ ke̱-dše̱ henye̱lo̱i le̱ adeṅ ke̱ mei abo̱ ni yawo ká ye̱ gbe̱teṅ le̱ hũ adeṅ.

english_verse: After arriving in Jerusalem, we rested for three days.
translation_verse: Ni wo̱še̱ Ierusalem ni wo̱hĩ dše̱i gbĩĩ etẽ.

english_verse: Then on the fourth day we went to God's temple, where the silver, the gold, and the other things were weighed and given to the priest Meremoth son of Uriah. With him were Eleazar son of Phinehas and the two Levites, Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui.
translation_verse: Ši gbĩ ni dši gĩī edſe̱ le̱ ne̱ le̱ aṅmẽ dſie̱te̱i le̱ ke̱ šika le̱ ke̱ nibii le̱ ye̱ wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ we le̱ awo Meremot, Uria bi ni dši oso̱fo le̱, ke̱ Eleazar, Pinehas bi ni fata ehe le̱ adeṅ, — mei ní fata ame̱he dši: Iozabad, Iešua bi le̱, ke̱ Noadia, Binui bi le̱, ni dši Levibii le̱, —

english_verse: Those who had returned from exile offered sacrifices on the altar to the God of Israel. Twelve bulls were offered for all Israel. Ninety-six rams and
translation_verse: Asaṅ nomṅõbii ni dše̱ nomṅõ le̱ṅ ba le̱ basã šã-afo̱lei ame̱hã Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱: tšinahīĩ nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱ ye̱ Israel mŭ le̱ fẽ hewo̱, ke̱ tōagboi nyoṅmai-ne̱hũ ke̱ ekpa, ke̱ tōbii nyoṅmai-kpawo ke̱ kpawo, ke̱ eša he afo̱le tōkpakpoi nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱, fẽ le̱ aṅò-šã šā̃-afo̱le ahã Iehowa.

english_verse: goats were sacrificed for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Ni Azgad bii le̱ ateṅ le̱: Iohanan, Hakatan bi le̱, ni hĩĩ oha ke̱ nyoṅma fata ehe.

english_verse: Some of those who had returned took the king's orders to the governors and officials in Western Province. Then the officials did what they could for the people and for the temple of God.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ame̱ṅõ *maṅtše̱ le̱ mlaĩ le̱ ame̱hã maṅtše̱ le̱ amraloi le̱ ke̱ lume̱i le̱ ni yo̱ fā le̱ bie̱gbe̱ le̱; ni ame̱wa maṅ le̱ ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱ we le̱. *

english_verse: until the time for the evening sacrifice. Many of our people were greatly concerned and gathered around me, because the God of Israel had warned us to stay away from foreigners. Ezra's Prayer
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mei fẽ ni he kpokpoo̱ ye̱ Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ wiemo̱i le̱ ahewo̱ ye̱ mei ni aṅõame̱ nom le̱ amlatõmo̱ le̱ hewo̱ le̱ babua ame̱he nā ye̱ miṅõ; ši mi le̱ mihe dšõ mihe ke̱-tá šĩ āhũ ke̱-yaši gbe̱ke̱ afo̱lešā̃ be le̱ mli.

english_verse: Our God, what can we say now? Even after all this, we have disobeyed the commands
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱, meni wo̱o̱kē̱ ye̱ ene̱ se̱? Edšake̱ wo̱kwa okitãi le̱,

english_verse: that were given to us by your servants the prophets. They said the land you are giving us is full of sinful and wicked people, who never stop doing disgusting things.
translation_verse: ni otšṍ otšũdši, gbaloi le̱, anine no̱ owo ake̱: Šikpoṅ ni nyeyaä ni nyeyaṅõ le̱, šikpoṅ ni *abule ni, ye̱ šikpõdši le̱ ano̱ bii le̱ abulemo̱nii le̱ ahewo̱, ye̱ ame̱nihīnii ni ame̱feo̱ ni ame̱ke̱-hã mũdšinii eyi no̱ obo ke̱-dše̱ nāgbēhe kome ke̱-yaši nāgbēhe kroko le̱. *

english_verse: And we were warned not to let our daughters and sons marry their sons and daughters. Your prophets also told us never to help those foreigners or even let them live in peace. You wanted us to become strong and to enjoy the good things in the land, then someday to leave it to our children forever.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ agbe̱ne̱ *nyeke̱ nyebiyei akahãa ame̱bihĩĩ agblã, ni asaṅ nyekaw̌e̱a ame̱biyei nyehãa nyebihĩĩ, ni nyekataoa ame̱hedšo̱le̱ lo ame̱ſeremo̱ gbĩko-gbĩko, beni afe ni nyehe awa, ni nyeye šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ nii kpakpai le̱, ni nyešĩ nyehã nyebii ake̱ gbo̱šinii ke-ya nāno. *

english_verse: You punished us because of our terrible sins. But you did not punish us nearly as much as we deserve, and you have brought some of us back home.
translation_verse: Ni nii ní ba wo̱no̱ ye̱ wo̱nifõdši-anii le̱ ke̱ wo̱fo̱ kpeteṅkple ní wo̱ye le̱ hewo̱ ne̱ fẽ se̱ le̱, kẽle̱ bo, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, owokowo̱ nyõmo̱ bo̱ni sa wo̱nišaianii le̱, ni ohawo̱ ſē̱nõ ko kẽ ni tamo̱ ene̱.

english_verse: Why should we disobey your commands again by letting our sons and daughters marry these foreigners who do such disgusting things? That would make you angry enough to destroy us all!
translation_verse: Aso wo̱o̱kũ okitãi le̱ amli ekoṅ, ni wo̱ke̱ wo̱he ayabo̱ mãdši ní feo̱ nihĩniĩ ne̱ ahe ye̱ yōw̌ē̱ gbe̱făṅ lo? Aso omli fū̃ṅwo̱ ke̱-yašiṅ beyino̱ ní ookpãtã wo̱hĩe atã ní akaſe̱ mokomoko, ni asaṅ mokomoko akadše mli lo?

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you have been more than fair by letting a few of us survive. But once again, our sins have made us ashamed to face you.
translation_verse: Iehowa, Israel Nyoṅmo̱, dšalo̱ dšio; edšake̱ ašĩwo̱ ake̱ ſē̱nõ ni wo̱dše mli tamo̱ bo̱ni yo̱ ṅme̱ne̱ ne̱: na, wo̱ye̱ ohĩe ke̱ wo̱fo̱yeli le̱, edšake̱ ene̱ hewo̱ le̱ wo̱nyẽẽ ohĩe wo̱damo̱! Neh.

english_verse: While Ezra was down on his knees in front of God's temple, praying with tears in his eyes and confessing the sins of the people of Israel, a large number of men, women, and children gathered around him and cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Ši beni Ezra kpaã fai ne̱ke̱ ni eke̱ yāfó ke̱ šitſĩamo̱ dšadšeo̱ nii ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ we le̱ hĩe le̱, Israelbii ateṅ mei babaō dientše̱, hĩĩ ke̱ yei ke̱ gbekẽbii, babua ame̱he nā ye̱ eṅõ; edšake̱ maṅ le̱ mīfó naakpa.

english_verse: Ezra, it's up to you to do something! We will support whatever you do. So be brave!
translation_verse: Te ši, edšake̱ bo osane ni, ni wo̱ hũ wo̱fĩ ose̱; ná nŭtšui ni ofe!

english_verse: Ezra stood up and made the chief priests, the Levites, and everyone else in Israel swear that they would follow the advice of Shecaniah.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Ezra te ši ni ehã oso̱foi ke̱ Levibii le̱ anukpai le̱ ke̱ Israel mũ le̱ fẽ kãmo̱ kitãi ake̱ ame̱aye ne̱ke̱ wiemo̱ ne̱ no̱. Ni ame̱kãmo̱ kitãi le̱.

english_verse: Then Ezra left God's temple and went to spend the night in the living quarters of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. He felt sorry because of what the people had done, and he did not eat or drink a thing.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ní Ezra te ši ke̱-dše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ we le̱ hĩe, ni eyiṅ ke̱-te Iehohanan ní dši Eliašib bi le̱ pia le̱ṅ. Ni beni ete dše̱i le̱, eyee nii ni enuu nu hũ; edšake̱ ēye ṅko̱mo̱ ye̱ nomṅō̃bii le̱ amlatõmo̱ le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: The officials and leaders sent a message to all who had returned from Babylonia and were now living in Jerusalem and Judah. This message told them to meet in Jerusalem within three days, or else they would lose everything they owned and would no longer be considered part of the people that had returned from Babylonia.
translation_verse: ni ake̱ moſẽmo ni baa ke̱-yaši gbĩĩ etẽ, ye̱ lume̱i le̱ ke̱ onukpai le̱ aṅāwō le̱ nā le̱, aadšō̱ enii fẽ no̱ ake, ni le̱dientše̱ hũ aafãle̱ ye̱ nomṅõbii le̱ asafo le̱ṅ.

english_verse: Ezra the priest stood up and said: You have broken God's Law by marrying foreign women, and you have made the whole nation guilty!
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo Ezra te ši damo̱ ši, ni ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyetõ, edšake̱ nyeyaw̌e̱ maṅse̱ yei, ní nyeke̱-hã Israel fo̱yeli le̱ afá.

english_verse: Now you must confess your sins to the Lord God of your ancestors and obey him. Divorce your foreign wives and don't have anything to do with the rest of the foreigners who live around here.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ agbe̱ne̱ nyedšadšea nyetšõa Iehowa, nyetše̱mei a-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ni nyefea esuomo̱nānii, ni nyetšea nyehe ke̱-dše̱a šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ bii le̱ ke̱ maṅse̱ yei le̱ ahe.

english_verse: Everyone in the crowd shouted: You're right! We will do what you say.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni asafo mū le̱ fẽ here no̱ ni ame̱ke̱ gbē wāle̱ kē̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni okē̱ le̱, nakai sā ake̱ wo̱o̱fe.

english_verse: But there are so many of us, and we can't just stay out here in this downpour. A lot of us have sinned by marrying foreign women, and the matter can't be settled in only a day or two.
translation_verse: Ši maṅ le̱ yi fá, ni nyoṅmo̱ ne̱mo̱ be ne̱, ni wo̱nyẽẽ blohũ le̱ṅ wo̱damo̱, ni nitšumo̱ lo̱ hũ edšee gbĩ kome lo gbĩĩ enyo̱ nõ; edšake̱ wo̱fe efõṅ babaō ye̱ ne̱ke̱ sane ne̱ mli.

english_verse: Why can't our officials stay on in Jerusalem and take care of this for us? Let everyone who has sinned in this way meet here at a certain time with leaders and judges from their own towns. If we take care of this problem, God will surely stop being so terribly angry with us.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ hã wolumei le̱ adamo̱ ši ahã asafo mū le̱ fẽ, ni mei fẽ ni yo̱ wo̱mādši le̱ amli ni ame̱kpē maṅse̱ yei le̱ aba ye̱ be ní ato mli, ni maṅ-fẽ-maṅ mli onukpai ke̱ emli kodšolo̱i le̱ afata ame̱he, ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní aahã wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ mlifũ ní nā wa ye̱ ne̱ke̱ sane ne̱ hewo̱ le̱ adše wo̱no̱.

english_verse: Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah were the only ones who objected, except for the two Levites, Meshullam and Shabbethai.
translation_verse: Ionatan, Asahel bi le̱, ke̱ Iahezeia, Tikwa bi le̱, ke̱ke̱ te ši ši ne̱ke̱ sane ne̱; ni Mešulam ke̱ Šabetai, Levinyo le̱, fĩ ame̱se̱.

english_verse: Everyone else who had returned from exile agreed with the plan. So Ezra the priest chose men who were heads of the families, and he listed their names. They started looking into the matter on the first day of the tenth month,
translation_verse: Ni nomṅõbii le̱ fe nakai. Ni afãmo̱ oso̱fo Ezra ke̱ tše̱mei awei le̱ ane̱ onukpai le̱ ekomei ye̱ ame̱tše̱mei awei le̱ anã, ní atšĩ ame̱fẽ ame̱gbe̱ii atã; ni nyõṅ ni dši nyoṅma le̱ no̱ kleṅkleṅ gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ ame̱yatrá ši, koni ame̱tao sane le̱ mli.

english_verse: and they did not finish until the first day of the first month of the next year. The Men Who Had Foreign Wives
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ke̱ hĩĩ fẽ ni ew̌e̱ maṅse̱ yei le̱ gbe nā ye̱ kleṅkleṅ nyõṅ le̱ no̱ kleṅkleṅ gbĩ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Hanani and Zebadiah from the family of Immer;
translation_verse: Ni Imer biile̱ ateṅ le̱: Hanani ke̱ Zebadia.

english_verse: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah from the family of Harim;
translation_verse: Ni Harim bii le̱ ateṅ le̱: Maaseia ke̱ Elia ke̱ Šemaia ke̱ Iehiel ke̱ Uzia.

english_verse: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah from the family of Pashhur.
translation_verse: Ni Pašhur bii le̱ ateṅ le̱: Elioenai ke̱ Maaseia, Išmael, Netanel, Iozabad ke̱ Elasa.

english_verse: Those Levites who had foreign wives were: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah , Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
translation_verse: Ni Levibii le̱ ateṅ le̱: Iozabad ke̱ Šimei ke̱ Kelaia Petahia, Iuda ke̱ Eliezer.

english_verse: Eliashib, the musician, had a foreign wife. These temple guards had foreign wives: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
translation_verse: Ni lalatše̱mei le̱ ateṅ, le̱: Eliašib. Ni agbónãkwe̱lo̱i le̱ ateṅ le̱: Šalum ke̱ Telem ke̱ Uri.

english_verse: Here is a list of the others from Israel who had foreign wives: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah, and Benaiah from the family of Parosh;
translation_verse: Ni Israel mli hũ: Paroš bii le̱ ateṅ le̱: Ramia ke̱ Izia ke̱ Malkia ke̱ Miyamin ke̱ Eleazar ke̱ Malkia ke̱ Benaia.

english_verse: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah from the family of Elam;
translation_verse: Ni Elam bii le̱ ateṅ le̱: Matania ke̱ Zakaria ke̱ Iehiel ke̱ Abdi ke̱ Ieremot ke̱ Elia.

english_verse: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza from the family of Zattu;
translation_verse: Ni Zatu bii le̱ ateṅ le̱: Elioenai, Eliašib, Matania ke̱ Ieremot ke̱ Zabad ke̱ Aziza.

english_verse: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai from the family of Bebai;
translation_verse: Ni Bebai bii le̱ ateṅ le̱: Iehohanan, Hanania, Zabaì ke̱ Atlai.

english_verse: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth from the family of Bani;
translation_verse: Ni Bani bii le̱ ateṅ le̱: Mešulam, Maluk ke̱ Adaia, Iašub ke̱ Šeal ke̱ Ieremot.

english_verse: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh from the family of Pahath Moab;
translation_verse: Ni Pahat-Moab bii le̱ ateṅ le̱: Adna ke̱ Kelal, Benaia, Maaseia, Matania, Bezaleel ke̱ Binui ke̱ Manase.

english_verse: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei from the family of Hashum;
translation_verse: Ni Hašum bii le̱ ateṅ le̱: Matenai, Matata, Zabad, Elifelet, Ieremai, Manase ke̱ Šimei.

english_verse: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah from the family of Nebo.
translation_verse: Nebo bii le̱ ateṅ le̱: Ieiel, Matitia, Zabad, Zebina, Iadau ke̱ Ioel ke̱ Benaia.

english_verse: These men divorced their foreign wives, then sent them and their children away.
translation_verse: Mene̱mei fẽ ew̌e̱w̌ē̱ maṅse̱ yei; ni ame̱ṅãmei le̱ ateṅ meikomei efo̱fō̱ bii.

english_verse: They told me, “Those captives who have come back are having all kinds of troubles. They are terribly disgraced, Jerusalem's walls are broken down, and its gates have been burned.”
translation_verse: Ni ame̱kē̱mi ake̱: Nomi le̱ ateṅ mei ni eſe̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱, ame̱ye̱ amanehũlũ kple ke̱ ahorabō̱ mli; Ierusalem *gbogbo le̱ akũmo̱ aſie ši; ni egbói le̱ ake̱ la ešã. *

english_verse: I am your servant, so please have mercy on me and answer the prayer that I make day and night for these people of Israel who serve you. I, my family, and the rest of your people have sinned
translation_verse: Ka otoi, ni ohã ohīṅme̱ii hũ akãmo̱, koni oke̱-bo otšũlo̱ faikpamo̱ ni mi-kpaä ye̱ ohĩe ṅme̱ne̱ ſane ke̱ nyõṅ ye̱ Israelbii ni dši otšũdši le̱ ahewo̱ ni midšadšeo̱ Israelbii le̱ ahe ešai ní wo̱fe wo̱šio le̱ toi; ši mike̱ mitše̱ we le̱ efe eša!

english_verse: by choosing to disobey you and the laws and teachings you gave to your servant Moses.
translation_verse: Wo̱fe efõṅ wo̱šio naakpa, edšake̱ wo̱yeko kitãi ke̱ akpo̱i ke̱ mlai ni owo otšũlo̱ Mose le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: Please remember the promise you made to Moses. You told him that if we were unfaithful, you would scatter us among foreign nations.
translation_verse: Mīkpao fai ní okai wiemo̱ ni oke̱-wo otšũlo̱ Mose kitã ake̱: Ke̱dši nyetõ le̱, magbe̱nye maſã mãdši ano̱ bii le̱ ateṅ!

english_verse: But you also said that no matter how far away we were, we could turn to you and start obeying your laws. Then you would bring us back to the place where you have chosen to be worshiped.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši nyekpale ke̱-ba mĩṅõ ni nyeye mikitãi le̱ ano̱ ni nyefe le̱, no le̱ ke̱dši nye mei ni *aše̱re̱ aſie le̱ yadše̱ ṅwei nāgbēbe tete le̱, mabua ame̱nā ke̱-adše̱ dše̱i tō̃ ni makplaame̱ ke̱-ba he ní mihala koni mahã migbei ahĩ dše̱i le̱. *

english_verse: Our Lord, I am praying for your servants—those you rescued by your great strength and mighty power.
translation_verse: Ni mene̱mei ne̱ noṅṅ dšĩ otšũdši ke̱ omaṅ ní okpo ye̱ ohewale̱ kpeteṅkple ke̱ oninesiwale̱ nā le̱.

english_verse: Please answer my prayer and the prayer of your other servants who gladly honor your name. When I serve the king his wine today, make him pleased with me and let him do what I ask.
translation_verse: Ō Nuṅtšo̱, mīkpao fai ni oka otoi oha otšũle̱ faikpamo̱ le̱ ke̱ otšũdši ní sumoo̱ ogbe̱i gbeyeišemo̱ le̱ afaikpamo̱ le̱; ni mīkpao fai, hã otšũlo̱ aye omanye ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱, ni odrole̱ mo̱bo̱nale̱ ye̱ ne̱ke̱ nū ne̱ hĩe! Ši maṅtše̱ le̱ dā̃wolo̱ dšimi.

english_verse: During the month of Nisan in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was king, I served him his wine, as I had done before. But this was the first time I had ever looked depressed.
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ye̱ Nisan nyõṅ le̱ no̱, ye̱ maṅtše̱ Artašasta yino̱ afi ni dši nyoṅmai-enyo̱ le̱ no̱, ake̱ wein mã ehĩe, ni miwó wein le̱ ni miṅõ-hã maṅtše̱ le̱. Ši mifeko mo̱bo̱mo̱bo̱ ye̱ ehĩe pẽṅ.

english_verse: I answered, “Your Majesty, I hope you live forever! I feel sad because the city where my ancestors are buried is in ruins, and its gates have been burned down.”
translation_verse: Ni mikē̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ ake: Maṅtše̱ yi aná wala ke̱-ya nāno̱! Mẽhewo̱ ni esaa ake̱ mihĩe afe mo̱bo̱mo̱bo̱, beni maṅ le̱ ní dši he ní mitše̱mei asãṅi yo̱ le̱ etšṍ amaṅfõ, ni ašã ehe agbói le̱ hũ ke̱ la le̱?

english_verse: The king asked, “What do you want me to do?” I prayed to the God who rules from heaven.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni maṅtše̱ le̱ kē̱mi ake̱: Meni dši noni otaoo̱? Ke̱ke̱ ni mikpa ṅwei Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ fai,

english_verse: I will need timber to rebuild the gates of the fortress near the temple and more timber to construct the city wall and to build a place for me to live. And so, I would appreciate a letter to Asaph, who is in charge of the royal forest.” God was good to me, and the king did everything I asked.
translation_verse: ke̱ wolo ko hũ ni mike̱-yahã Asaf, maṅtše̱ kõ le̱ kwe̱lo̱ le̱, koni ehãmi tšei ni mike̱-fe mō̃ ni yo̱ šĩa le̱ he le̱, ke̱ maṅ le̱ be gbogbo le̱ ke̱ šĩa ní miyahĩ mli le̱ nā agbói le̱ ahe mplãṅi. Ni maṅtše̱ le̱ hãmi ye̱ mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ mlihĩle̱ *nine ní fata mihe le̱ hewo̱. *Ezra

english_verse: The king sent some army officers and cavalry troops along with me, and as I traveled through the Western Provinces, I gave the letters to the governors.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni miyaše̱ fā le̱ se̱ amraloi le̱ aṅõ, ni miṅõ maṅtše̱ le̱ wodši le̱ mi-hãame̱. Ši maṅtše̱ le̱ fãmo̱ asafoiatše̱mei ke̱ okpo̱ṅo̱iatše̱mei eto mihe.

english_verse: But when Sanballat from Horon and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about what had happened, they became very angry, because they didn't want anyone to help the people of Israel. Nehemiah Inspects the Wall of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ši beni Sanbalat, Horonnyo le̱, ke̱ Tobia, Amonnyo ni dši nyṍṅ le̱, nu le̱, edo̱ame̱ naakpa ake̱ nū ko eba ní ebatao Israelbii le̱ edšũrõyeli.

english_verse: Three days after arriving in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni miše̱ Ierusalem, ni miye gbĩĩ etẽ ye̱ dše̱i.

english_verse: I got up during the night and left my house. I took some men with me, without telling anyone what I thought God wanted me to do for the city. The only animal I took was the donkey I rode on.
translation_verse: Ni mite ši nyõṅ, mi ke̱ hĩĩ fiō ko ni fata mihe le̱; ši migbako mokomoko noni mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ eṅõ-wo mitšui mli ake̱ miyafe mihã Ierusalem, ni mihĩee kolo ko kolo ko hũ, ake̱ dša kolo ni mitá no̱ le̱ pe̱.

english_verse: I went through Valley Gate on the west, then south past Dragon Spring, before coming to Garbage Gate. As I rode along, I took a good look at the crumbled walls of the city and the gates that had been torn down and burned.
translation_verse: Ni mitšṍ dšō̱ le̱ṅ agbó le̱ nā ke̱-dše kpo nyō le̱ṅ, ke̱-tšṍ drako nubu le̱ hĩe ke̱-te tumu agbó le̱ nā, ni misra Ierusalem gbogboi le̱ mikwe̱ bo̱ni ame̱kũmo̱ ame̱ſie ši, ke̱ enā agbói le̱ ni ake̱ la ešã le̱.

english_verse: So I went down to Kidron Valley and looked at the wall from there. Then before daylight I returned to the city through Valley Gate.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mitšṍ fā le̱ nā ke̱-te nyõ le̱ṅ noṅṅ, ni miyakwe̱ gbogbo le̱; ni mi-kũ mise̱, ni mitšṍ dšō̱ le̱ṅ agbó le̱ nā ke̱-ba, ni mikũ mise̱.

english_verse: None of the city officials knew what I had in mind. And I had not even told any of the Jews—not the priests, the leaders, the officials, or any other Jews who would be helping in the work.
translation_verse: Ši no̱yelo̱i le̱ lee beni mite ke̱ noni miyafe, ni Iudafoi le̱ ke̱ oso̱foi le̱ ke̱ abladei le̱ ke̱ no̱yelo̱i le̱ ke̱ mei ni eſe̱ ni tšuo̱ nii le̱ hũ migbakoame̱.

english_verse: But when I got back, I said to them, “Jerusalem is truly in a mess! The gates have been torn down and burned, and everything is in ruins. We must rebuild the city wall so that we can again take pride in our city.”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mikē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyedientše̱ nyemīna no amane mli ní wo̱yo̱, bo̱ni Ierusalem kã ši amaṅfõ, ni ehe agbói le̱ hũ ake̱ la ešã; nyebaä ni nyehãa wo̱-tſaä Ierusalem gbogbo le̱, koni wo̱kato kpa doṅṅ!

english_verse: Then I told them how kind God had been and what the king had said. Immediately, they replied, “Let's start building now!” So they got everything ready.
translation_verse: Ni migbaame̱ mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ nine ni mli hĩ ye̱ mino̱ le̱, ke̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ wiemo̱i le̱ hũ ni ekē̱mi le̱. Ke̱ke̱ ni ame̱kē̱: Nyehãa wo̱tea ši ni we̱mãa! Ni ame̱wadše ame̱nidšiaṅ ame̱hã nitšumo̱ kpakpa le̱.

english_verse: When Sanballat, Tobiah, and Geshem the Arab heard about our plans, they started insulting us and saying, “Just look at you! Do you plan to rebuild the walls of the city and rebel against the king?”
translation_verse: Ši beni Sanbalat, Horonnyo le̱, ke̱ Tobia, Amonnyo ni dši nyṍṅ le̱, ke̱ Gešem, Arabianyo le̱, nu le̱, ame̱ye wohe fe̱o, ni ame̱gbe wohe guo̱, ame̱kē̱: Mẽ sane nyeyeo̱ ne̱? Aso nyeatše maṅtše̱ le̱ hĩe atũa?

english_verse: I answered, “We are servants of the God who rules from heaven, and he will make our work succeed. So we will start rebuilding Jerusalem, but you have no right to any of its property, because you have had no part in its history.”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mihere no̱ ni mikē̱ame̱ ake̱: Ṅwei Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, le̱ eehã wo̱nyẽ wo̱fe; nohewo̱ le̱ wo̱ ni dši etšũdši le̱ wo̱o̱te ši ni wo̱mã; ši nye le̱ *nyebe̱ gbe̱nā ko, lo hegbe̱ ko, lo kaimo̱nõ ko ye̱ Ierusalem! *Ef.

english_verse: The family of Hassenaah built Fish Gate. They put the beams in place and hung the doors, then they added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: .] Ke̱ke̱ ni Tobia, Amonnyo le̱ ni damo̱ emase̱i le̱, kē̱: Noni ame̱tſaä ne̱ po le̱, ké̱ oso̱ tũ yi no̱ le̱, eekũmo̱ ame̱te̱ gbogbo le̱ tete!

english_verse: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, completed the next section of the wall. Meshullam, son of Berechiah and grandson of Meshezabel, rebuilt the next section, and Zadok son of Baana rebuilt the section beside that.
translation_verse: .] Bo toi, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱, bo̱ni agbeo̱ wo̱he guo̱! ni *ohã ame̱horabō̱ le̱ akũ se̱ abua ame̱dientše̱ ame̱yiteṅ, ni ohã agbe ame̱he guo̱ ye̱ nomṅō̃ šikpoṅ no̱! *Lal.

english_verse: The next section was to be repaired by the men of Tekoa, but their town leaders refused to do the hard work they were assigned.
translation_verse: .] Ni kãtšīmo̱ ame̱no̱tōmo̱ le̱ no̱, ni ame̱he eša le̱ hũ akagbe ye̱ ohĩe; edšake̱ ame̱wo omlila ye̱ tšũmšlo̱i le̱ ahĩe!

english_verse: Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah restored Ancient Gate. They put the beams in place, hung the doors, and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: .] Ni wo̱tſa gbogbo le̱, ni gbogbo le̱ fẽ tšá no̱ ke̱-yaši emlidšā, edšake̱ maṅ le̱ ye̱ nitšumo̱ le̱ he tšui.

english_verse: The section after that was close to the home of Jedaiah son of Harumaph, and he rebuilt it. Hattush son of Hashabneiah constructed the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱no̱tšámo̱ le̱ Iedaia, Harumaf bi le̱, basā ye̱ ešĩa le̱ ṅe̱le̱no̱; ni eno̱tšámo̱ le̱ Hatuš, Hašabneia bi le̱, basā.

english_verse: Shallum son of Hallohesh ruled the other half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. Shallum's daughters also worked with him.
translation_verse: Ni eno̱tšámo̱ le̱ Šalum, Haloheš bi le̱, ní dši Ierusalem mlidšā fã no̱ lumo̱ le̱, basā, le̱ ke̱ ebiyei le̱.

english_verse: Hanun and the people who lived in the town of Zanoah rebuilt Valley Gate. They hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. They also rebuilt the wall for
translation_verse: Dšō̱ le̱ṅ agbó le̱ Hanun ke̱ Zanoa bii le̱ basā; ame̱mã, ni ame̱trá enā šĩnāi le̱ ke̱ ame̱he sro̱tōi le̱ ke̱ ame̱se̱ adabãṅĩ le̱; ni ame̱tſa gbogbo ninetalo̱i akpe ke̱-yaši tumu agbó le̱ nā.

english_verse: Malchijah son of Rechab ruled the district of Beth-Haccherem, and he rebuilt Garbage Gate. He hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Ši tumu agbó le̱ Malkia, Rekab bi le̱, ni dši Bet-Hakerem mlidšā fã no̱ lumo̱ le̱, basā; le̱ emã ni etrá enā šĩnāi le̱ ke̱ ame̱he sro̱tōi ke̱ ame̱se̱ adabãṅi le̱.

english_verse: Shallum son of Colhozeh ruled the district of Mizpah, and he rebuilt Fountain Gate. He put a cover over the gateway, then hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. He also rebuilt the wall at Shelah Pool. This section was next to the king's garden and went as far as the stairs leading down from David's City.
translation_verse: Ni nubu agbó le̱ Šalun, Kol-Hoze bi le̱, moni dši Mizpa mlidšã fã no̱ lumo̱ le̱, basā; le̱ emã, ni eha no̱, ni etrá enā šĩnāi le̱ ke̱ ame̱he sro̱tōi le̱ ke̱ ame̱se̱ adabãṅi le̱; le̱ noṅṅ etſa *Šiloa kpākpo le̱ he gbogbo le̱ ye̱ maṅtše̱ trom le̱ mase̱i āhū ke̱-yaši atrakpoi ní kplekeo̱ ši ke̱-dše̱o̱ David mã le̱ṅ le̱ he. *Ioh.

english_verse: Binnui son of Henadad, who ruled the other half of the district of Keilah;
translation_verse: Ese̱ le̱ ame̱nyemimei le̱, Bawai, Henadad bi le̱, moni dši Keila mlidšã fã kroko le̱ no̱ lumo̱ le̱, basā.

english_verse: Baruch son of Zabbai eagerly rebuilt the section of the wall that went all the way to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest;
translation_verse: Ese̱ le̱ Baruk, Zabai bi le̱, ke̱ hĩedō̱ basā fā kroko ke̱-dše̱ koṅ le̱ he ke̱-yaši oso̱fonukpa *Eliašib we le̱ šĩnā le̱ nā. *K.

english_verse: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, built up to the far end of Eliashib's house. Priests Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Ese̱ le̱ *Meremot, ní dši Hakoz bi Uria bi le̱, basā fā kroko ke̱-dše̱ Eliašib we le̱ šĩnā le̱ nā ke̱-yaši Eliašib we le̱ nāgbēhe le̱ tō̃. *Ezra

english_verse: Here is a list of the priests who worked on the wall: Priests from the region around Jerusalem rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Ni ese̱ le̱ oso̱foi le̱, ní dši Iordan he šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ bii le̱, basā.

english_verse: Benjamin and Hasshub rebuilt the wall in front of their own houses. Azariah, who was the son of Maaseiah and the grandson of Ananiah, rebuilt the section in front of his house.
translation_verse: Ese̱ le̱ Benyamin ke̱ Hašub basā ye̱ ame̱we le̱ ṅe̱le̱no̱. Ese̱ le̱ Azaria, ní dši Anania bi Maaseia bi le̱, basā ye̱ ewe le̱ mase̱i.

english_verse: Binnui son of Henadad rebuilt the section of the wall from Azariah's house to the corner of the wall.
translation_verse: Ese̱ le̱ Binui, Henadad bi le̱, basā fā kroko ke̱-dše̱ Azaria šĩa le̱ he ke̱-yaši koṅ le̱ ke̱ heni gbogbo le̱ do̱ eyi ye̱ le̱.

english_verse: Palal son of Uzai rebuilt the next section, which began at the corner of the wall and the tower of the upper palace near the court of the guard. Pedaiah son of Parosh rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Palal, Uzai bi le̱, basā koṅ le̱ ṅe̱le̱no̱ ke̱ mō̃ ni kwo̱ ni tšẽ ke̱-dše kpo ye̱ maṅtše̱ šĩa le̱ he, ni yo̱ *gbokle̱foi akpo le̱ mase̱i le̱. Ese̱ le̱ Pedaia, Paroš bi le̱, basā. *Ier.

english_verse: He stopped at a place near the Water Gate on the east and the tower guarding the temple. This was close to a section in the city called Ophel, where the temple workers lived. Other Builders Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Ši so̱lemo̱we súolo̱i le̱ hĩo̱ Ofel ke̱-yaši nu agbó le̱ ṅe̱le̱no̱ ye̱ bokãgbe̱ ke̱ heni mō̃ ni tšẽ ke̱-dše kpo le̱ yo̱ le̱.

english_verse: The men from Tekoa rebuilt the next section of the wall, and it was their second section. It started at a place across from the large tower that guarded the Temple, and it went all the way to the wall near Ophel.
translation_verse: Ese̱ le̱ Tekoabii le̱ basā fã kroko ye̱ mō̃ wulu ní mã ši somomō le̱ ṅe̱le̱no̱ āhũ ke̱-yaši Ofel gbogbo le̱ he.

english_verse: Some priests rebuilt the next section of the wall. They began working north of Horse Gate, and each one worked on a section in front of his own house.
translation_verse: Oso̱foi le̱ hũ basā ke̱-dše̱ *okpo̱ṅo̱i agbó le̱ he, ame̱teṅ mofẽmo le̱ ye̱ ešĩa ṅe̱le̱no̱. *

english_verse: Zadok son of Immer rebuilt the wall in front of his house. Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, who looked after the East Gate, rebuilt the section after that.
translation_verse: Ame̱se̱ le̱ Zadok, Imer bi le̱, basā ye̱ ešĩa le̱ ṅe̱le̱no̱. Le̱ hũ ese̱ le̱ Šemaia, Šekania bi le̱, ní dši bokãgbe̱ agbó le̱ nãkwe̱lo̱ le̱, basã.

english_verse: Hananiah and Hanun rebuilt the next section, which was the second section for them. Meshullam son of Berechiah rebuilt the next section, which happened to be in front of his house.
translation_verse: Ese̱ le̱ Hanania, Šelemia bi le̱, ke̱ Hanun, Zalaf bi ni dši ekpa le̱, basā fã kroko. Ese̱ le̱ Mešulam, Berekia bi le̱, basā ye̱ epia le̱ ṅe̱le̱no̱.

english_verse: Malchijah, a goldsmith, rebuilt the next section, as far as the house used by the temple workers and merchants. This area was across from Gathering Gate, near the room on top of the wall at the northeast corner.
translation_verse: Ese̱ le̱ Malkia, ni dši šikaṅālo̱ le̱, basā ke̱-yaši so̱lemo̱we súolo̱i le̱ ke̱ dšrayelo̱i le̱ awe le̱ he, ye̱ Hamifkad agbó le̱ ṅe̱le̱no̱ ni ke̱-yaši ṅweitšũ ní yo̱ koṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ he.

english_verse: The goldsmiths and merchants rebuilt the last section of the wall, which went from the corner room all the way to Sheep Gate.
translation_verse: Ni ṅweitšũ ní yo̱ koṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ ke̱ tōi agbó le̱ teṅ le̱, šĩkaṅālo̱i le̱ ke̱ dšrayelo̱i le̱ basā.

english_verse: Even the workers who were rebuilding the wall strapped on a sword. The worker who was to blow the signal trumpet stayed with me.
translation_verse: .] Ni tšũmălo̱i le̱, mofẽmo klante ṅmõ ehe, ni ame̱ke̱-māa; ni te̱tre̱mantre̱kpălo̱ le̱ ye̱ mimase̱i.

english_verse: I told the people and their officials and leaders, “Our work is so spread out, that we are a long way from one another.
translation_verse: .] Ni mikē̱ abladei le̱ ke̱ no̱yelo̱i le̱ ke̱ maṅ ní eſe̱ le̱ ake̱: Nitšumo̱ le̱ da ni efá, ni wo̱mli kã ye̱ gbogbo le̱ no̱, mo ke̱ enanyo teṅ dšeke̱.

english_verse: If you hear the sound of the trumpet, come quickly and gather around me. Our God will help us fight.”
translation_verse: .] Nohewo̱ le̱ hefẽhe ní nyeanu te̱tre̱mantre̱ gbē̱mo̱ ye̱ le̱, nyebuaä nyehe nā ke̱-baã wo̱ṅõ ye̱ dše̱i; wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ aawu ahãwo̱!

english_verse: Every day from dawn to dark, half of the workers rebuilt the walls, while the rest stood guard with their spears.
translation_verse: .] Bo̱ni wo̱tšuo̱ nii le̱ ne̱. Ni mei le̱ fã hĩeo̱ akplo̱i ke̱-dše̱o̱ hũlũ šitē ke̱-yašio̱ beyino̱ ní ṅulamii pueo̱.

english_verse: I asked the men in charge and their workers to stay inside Jerusalem and stand guard at night. So they guarded the city at night and worked during the day.
translation_verse: .] Asaṅ nakai be le̱ mli noṅṅ le̱ mikē̱ maṅbii le̱ ake̱: Mofẽmo ke̱ ewebii awo̱ Ierusalem, koni ame̱bu wo̱he nyõṅ, ní ſane ní ame̱tšu nii.

english_verse: I even slept in my work clothes at night; my relatives, the workers, and the guards slept in theirs as well. And we always kept our weapons close by.
translation_verse: .] Ši mi ke̱ minyemimei ke̱ miwebii le̱ ke̱ hebulo̱i ní yo̱ mise̱ le̱, wo̱ le̱ wo̱dšiee wo̱tadei, mofẽmo tawūnii ye̱ emase̱i.

english_verse: Some of the men and their wives complained about the Jews in power
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni maṅ le̱ ke̱ ame̱ṅãmei le̱ blo̱ wo ame̱nyemimei Iudafoi le̱ naakpa.

english_verse: Others said, “During the famine we even had to mortgage our fields, vineyards, and homes to them in order to buy grain.”
translation_verse: Ši meikomei hũ ye̱ ní kē̱e̱ ake̱: Wo̱ṅõo̱ wo̱ṅmõdši ke̱ wo̱weintromi ke̱ wo̱šĩai wo̱ke̱-totoo̱ awabai, koni wo̱ke̱he able ye̱ hõmo̱ le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: Then others said, “We had to borrow money from those in power to pay the government tax on our fields and vineyards.
translation_verse: Asaṅ meikomei hũ ye̱ ní kē̱o̱ ake̱: Maṅtše̱ onĩa le̱ tšũmo̱ hewo̱ le̱ wo̱yafla šika ni wo̱ke̱ wo̱ṅmōdši ke̱ wo̱weintromi le̱ eto nā.

english_verse: We are Jews just as they are, and our children are as good as theirs. But we still have to sell our children as slaves, and some of our daughters have already been raped. We are completely helpless; our fields and vineyards have even been taken from us.”
translation_verse: Nto wo̱helo tamo̱ wo̱nyemimei le̱ ahelo noṅṅ, ni wo̱bii le̱ tamo̱ ame̱bii le̱, ši na, wo̱ le̱ wo̱ṅõo̱ wo̱bihĩĩ ke̱ wo̱biyei wo̱woo̱ nyṍṅyeli mli, ni ame̱tšṍmo̱ nyṍdši, ni wo̱biyei le̱ ateṅ meikomei ye̱ nyṍṅyeli mli momo; ni wo̱nyẽẽ he eko wo̱fe, ni wo̱ṅmõdši ke̱ wo̱weintromi ye̱ meikrokomei adeṅ.

english_verse: When I heard their complaints and their charges, I became very angry.
translation_verse: Ni beni minu ame̱blo̱mo̱ le̱ ke̱ ne̱ke̱ wiemo̱i ne̱, mimli wo la naakpa.

english_verse: So I thought it over and said to the leaders and officials, “How can you charge your own people interest?” Then I called a public meeting and accused the leaders
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mitšui ke̱mi te adšina, ni miblo̱ miwo abladei le̱ ke̱ no̱yelo̱i le̱ ni mikē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyeteṅ mofẽmo *heo̱ enyemi hekpa ní fè nine. Ni mibo̱ gwa kpeteṅkple miwoame̱. *

english_verse: by saying, “We have tried to buy back all of our people who were sold into exile. But here you are, selling more of them for us to buy back!” The officials and leaders did not say a word, because they knew this was true.
translation_verse: Ni mikē̱ame̱ ake̱: Wo̱ le̱ wo̱fe bo̱ni wo̱o̱nyẽ ni wo̱ke̱-kpõ wo̱nyemimei Iudafoi ni ahõ ahã dšeṅmădši le̱; ni nye le̱ nyesã nyemīhõ nyenyemimei le̱, ni ame̱hõ ame̱he ame̱hãwo̱ lo? Ke̱ke̱ ni ame̱bu ame̱nā, ni ame̱naa noni ame̱kē̱o̱.

english_verse: I continued, “What you have done is wrong! We must honor our God by the way we live, so the Gentiles can't find fault with us.
translation_verse: Ni misā mikē̱: Noni nyefeo̱ ne̱ ehĩĩ! Ani esaa ake̱ nyenyieo̱ ye̱ wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ gbeyeišemo̱ mli, ye̱ dšeṅmãdši ní dši wo̱henye̱lo̱i le̱ ahora ní ame̱-abo̱wo̱ le̱ hewo̱ lo?

english_verse: My relatives, my friends, and I are also lending money and grain, but we must no longer demand payment in return.
translation_verse: Ši mi hũ ke̱ minyemimei le̱ ke̱ miwebii le̱, wo̱faame̱ šika ke̱ able; nyehăa wo̱ṅõa ne̱ke̱ nyõmo̱ ne̱ wo̱kea!

english_verse: Now give back the fields, vineyards, olive orchards, and houses you have taken and also the interest you have been paid.”
translation_verse: Nyefai ne̱, ṅme̱ne̱ noṅṅ nyedãia ame̱ṅmõdši ke̱ ame̱weintromi ke̱ ame̱mũtromi ke̱ ame̱šīai le̱ nyehãa-ame̱, ke̱ šika le̱ ke̱ able le̱ ke̱ wein le̱ ke̱ mũ le̱ mlidšăi oha mli ekome ni dši hekpa ni nyeheo̱ ye̱ ame̱deṅ le̱ hū!

english_verse: The leaders answered, “We will do whatever you say and return their property, without asking to be repaid.” So I made the leaders promise in front of the priests to give back the property.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ame̱kē̱: Wo̱o̱dãi wo̱hã, ni wo̱heṅ noko ye̱ ame̱dẽ; ni wo̱o̱fe nakai, tamo̱ bo̱ni okē̱ le̱. Ke̱ke̱ ni mitšé̱ oso̱foi le̱ ke̱-ba, ni mihã ame̱kãmo̱ kitãi ake̱ ame̱afe bo̱ni ame̱wo ši ne̱.

english_verse: Each governor before me had been a burden to the people by making them pay for his food and wine and by demanding forty silver coins a day. Even their officials had been a burden to the people. But I respected God, and I didn't think it was right to be so hard on them.
translation_verse: Ši sá amraloi le̱ ni nyie mihĩe le̱ waä maṅ le̱ yi, ni ame̱heo̱ abolo ke̱ wein ye̱ ame̱dẽ, sŏro dſie̱te̱ĩ šekelinyoṅmai-edſe̱ le̱ hũ; ame̱webii le̱ tete yeo̱ maṅ le̱ no̱. Ši mi le̱, Nyoṅmo̱ gbeyeišemo̱ hewo̱ le̱ mifee nakai.

english_verse: I spent all my time getting the wall rebuilt and did not buy any property. Everyone working for me did the same thing.
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ ne̱ke̱ gbogbo ne̱ he nitšumo̱ le̱, mihĩe mli wā, ni wo̱hee šikpoṅ ko tete; ši miwebii le̱ fẽ bakpeo̱ ye̱ dše̱i ye̱ nitšumo̱ le̱ he.

english_verse: Each day one ox, six of the best sheep, and lots of chickens were prepared. Then every ten days, a large supply of wine was brought in. I knew what a heavy burden this would have been for the people, and so I did not ask for my food allowance as governor.
translation_verse: Ši nii ni ahōo̱ ahãami gbĩ kome dši tšĩnanū kome ke̱ toi ni eſi ekpa, ni fĩdšiatše̱mei hũ asāa ahãami, ni dā gbĩĩ nyoṅma se̱ le̱ wein sro̱toi fẽ hũ babaō. Kẽle̱ ene̱ fẽ le̱ mibii amralo gbe̱nā niyenii le̱ ši, edšake̱ onĩatšũmo̱ le̱ mli wa ye̱ maṅ ne̱ no̱.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless me for everything I have done for my people.
translation_verse: Mi-Nyoṅmo̱, nibii fẽ ni mife mihã ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱ hewo̱ le̱, *kaimo̱mi, ní ahĩ ahãmi! *

english_verse: Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem, and our other enemies learned that I had completely rebuilt the wall. All I lacked was hanging the doors in the gates.
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱, beni Sanbalat ke̱ Tobia ke̱ Gešem, Arabianyo le̱, ke̱ wo̱henye̱lo̱i ní eſe̱ le̱ nu ake̱ mĩtſa gbogbo le̱, ni heko be̱ ní ekũmo̱ doṅṅ le̱,

english_verse: Then Sanballat and Geshem sent a message, asking me to meet with them in one of the villages in Ono Valley. I knew they were planning to harm me in some way.
translation_verse: Sanbalat ke̱ Gešem tšũ aba miṅõ ake̱: Ba ní wo̱kpe ye̱ Ono ṅã kplanã le̱ no̱ akrowai le̱ eko mli! Ši efõṅ ame̱taoo̱ ame̱femi.

english_verse: So I sent messengers to tell them, “My work is too important to stop now and go there. I can't afford to slow down the work just to visit with you.”
translation_verse: Ni mitšũ bo̱foi ke̱-te ame̱ṅõ ake̱: Nitšumo̱ ní mitšuo̱ le̱ da, hewo̱ le̱ minyẽṅ maba; mẽba mahã afõ nitšumo̱ le̱, ni mašĩ maba nyeṅõ?

english_verse: which said: A rumor is going around among the nations that you and the other Jews are rebuilding the wall and planning to rebel, because you want to be their king. And Geshem says it's true!
translation_verse: ni aṅmã ye̱ mli ake: Ātā ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ amli, ni Gašmu hũ kē̱o̱ ake̱ bo ke̱ Iudafoi le̱ mīdſẽṅ atũatšemo̱, nohewo̱ otſaä gbogbo le̱ ne̱, ni asaṅ, bo̱ni akē̱o̱ le̱, ōtao ame̱no̱ maṅtše̱ oye. Ezra

english_verse: I sent a message back to Sanballat, saying, “None of this is true! You are making it all up.”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mitšũ ate eṅō ake̱: Nii ni okē̱o̱ ne̱, afeko nakai noko; ši bodientše̱ otšui mli sane ofoo̱ otāa ne̱!

english_verse: Our enemies were trying to frighten us and to keep us from our work. But I asked God to give me strength.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ame̱fẽ le̱, wo̱he gbeyei ke̱-ke̱ ame̱taoo̱ ame̱wo, ni ame̱susuo̱ ake̱: Ame̱nidšiaṅ badše wui ye̱ nitšumo̱ le̱ he, ni agõ. — Nohewo̱ le̱ agbe̱ne̱, wadšemo̱ minidšiaṅ!

english_verse: One day I went to visit Shemaiah. He wasn't supposed to leave his house, but he said, “Let's hurry to the holy place of the temple and hide there. We will lock the temple doors, because your enemies are planning to kill you tonight.”
translation_verse: Ni mite Šemaia ni dši Mehetabel bi Delaia bi le̱ we le̱; ši eṅã́ eyi, ni ekē̱: Hã wo̱yakpe ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ we le, ye̱ so̱lemo̱tšũ le̱ mli, ni wo̱ṅã́mo̱ so̱lemo̱tšũ le̱ šĩnāi le̱; edšake̱ ame̱baba ní ame̱bagbeo, nyõṅ po ame̱baba ni ame̱bagbeo!

english_verse: I answered, “Why should someone like me have to run and hide in the temple to save my life? I won't go!”
translation_verse: Ni mikē̱: Aso nū ní tamo̱mi aadšo foi? Ni namo yo̱ ni tamo̱mi ni eebote so̱lemo̱tšũ le̱ṅ, koni eyi aná wala? Miyaa mli!

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that God had not given Shemaiah this message. But Tobiah and Sanballat had paid him to trick me
translation_verse: Ni miyo se̱ ake̱ dšee Nyoṅmo̱ tšũ-le̱, ši moṅ mi egba ne̱ke̱ gbale̱ ne̱ eši, edšake̱ Tobia ke̱ Sanbalat ebo̱le̱ apā.

english_verse: and to frighten me into doing something wrong, because they wanted to ruin my good name.
translation_verse: Ene̱hewo̱ abo̱le̱ apā le̱, beni afe ní maše gbeyei ni mafe nakai, ni *mafe eša, koni ame̱ná sane fõṅ ko ame̱yatã, ni ame̱ke̱-bo̱mi ahora. *

english_verse: Then I asked God to punish Tobiah and Sanballat for what they had done. I prayed that God would punish the prophet Noadiah and the other prophets who, together with her, had tried to frighten me. The Work Is Finished
translation_verse: *Mi-Nyoṅmo̱, kaimo̱ Tobia ke̱ Sanbalat ye̱ ame̱nitšumo̱i ne̱ anā, ke̱ gbalo̱yõ Noadia ke̱ gbalo̱i ní eſe̱ le̱ hũ, mei ni taoo̱ ní kũle̱ ame̱wo mihe gbeyei le̱. *

english_verse: On the twenty-fifth day of the month Elul, the wall was completely rebuilt. It had taken
translation_verse: Ni gbĩĩ nyoṅmai-enumo̱ ke̱ enyo̱ se̱ le̱ agbe gbogbo le̱ nā ye̱ Elul nyõṅ le̱ no̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ nyoṅmai-enyo̱ ke̱ enumo̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: When our enemies in the surrounding nations learned that the work was finished, they felt helpless, because they knew that our God had helped us rebuild the wall.
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱, beni wo̱henye̱lo̱i le̱ fẽ nu le̱, dšeṅmãdšĩ ní bo̱lewo̱ le̱ fẽ še gbeyei, ni ame̱hĩe gboi wo ame̱yitseiaṅ; edšake̱ ame̱yo ake̱ ne̱ke̱ nitšumo̱ ni atšu ne̱, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ deṅ dše̱.

english_verse: All this time the Jewish leaders and Tobiah had been writing letters back and forth.
translation_verse: Asaṅ nakai gbĩĩ le̱ amli le̱ Iuda abladei le̱ ṅmlã wodši pī yahã Tobia, ni Tobia hũ nii ba ame̱ṅõ.

english_verse: Many people in Judah were loyal to Tobiah for two reasons: Shecaniah son of Arah was his father-in-law, and Tobiah's son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berechiah.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mei pī ye̱ Iuda ní ekãmo̱le̱ kitãi; edšake̱ Ara bi Šekania šānū dšile̱, ni ebinū Iehohanan ebaw̌e̱ Berekia bi Mešulam biyō.

english_verse: The people would always tell me about the good things Tobiah had done, and then they would tell Tobiah everything I had said. So Tobiah kept sending letters, trying to frighten me.
translation_verse: Asaṅ ame̱bawieo̱ ehe ekpakpa ame̱tšṍo̱mi, ni mi hū miwiemo̱i le̱ ame̱yagbaäle̱. Ši wodši le̱, mihe gbeyei Tobia ke̱-bawo.

english_verse: Although Jerusalem covered a large area, not many people lived there, and no new houses had been built.
translation_verse: Ši mã le̱ mli le̱ ni eda hũ, ši mei ni yo̱ mli le̱ fáá, ni tšũi le̱ hũ amãmo̱ko.

english_verse: This is a list of how many returned from each family group:
translation_verse: Gibeon bii le̱: nyoṅmai-ne̱hũ ke̱ enumo̱.

english_verse: This is a list of how many returned whose ancestors had come from the following towns:
translation_verse: Senaa bii le̱: akpei-etẽ ke̱ ohai-ne̱hũ ke̱ nyoṅmai-etẽ.

english_verse: This is a list of how many returned from the families of Levites:
translation_verse: Agbónākwe̱lo̱i le̱: Šalum bii le̱, Ater bii le̱, Talmon bii le̱, Akub bii le̱, Hatita bii le̱, Šobai bii le̱: oha ke̱ nyoṅmai-etẽ ke̱ kpānyo̱,

english_verse: Here are the names of Solomon's servants whose descendants returned: Sotai, Sophereth, Perida, Jaala, Darkon, Giddel, Shephatiah, Hattil, Pochereth Hazzebaim, and Amon.
translation_verse: Šefatia bii le̱, Hatil bii le̱, Pokeret-Hazebaim bii le̱, Amonbii le̱.

english_verse: Many people gave gifts to help pay for the materials to rebuild the temple. The governor himself gave
translation_verse: Ni noni maṅbii ni eſe̱ le̱ hã dši šika dalei akpei-nyoṅmai-enyo̱, ke̱ dſie̱te̱i benai akpei-enyo̱, ke̱ oso̱foi atadei nyoṅmai-ekpa ke̱ kpawo.

english_verse: bowls to be used in the temple, and
translation_verse: Reaia bii le̱, Rezin bii le̱, Nekoda bii le̱,

english_verse: And so, by the seventh month, priests, Levites, temple guards, musicians, workers, and many of the ordinary people had settled in the towns of Judah.
translation_verse: Ni oso̱foi le̱ ke̱ Levibii le̱ ke̱ agbónākwe̱lo̱i le̱ ke̱ lalatše̱mei le̱ ke̱ maṅbii le̱ ateṅ meikomei ke̱ so̱lemo̱we súolo̱i le̱ ke̱ Israel mū le̱ fē bahĩ ame̱mãdši le̱ amli. Ni beni še̱ nyõṅ ní dši kpawo le̱, Israelbii le̱ ye̱ ame̱mãdšĩ le̱ amli.

english_verse: Ezra stood on a high wooden platform that had been built for this occasion. Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah were standing to his right, while Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hash Baddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam were standing to his left.
translation_verse: Ni Ezra, woloṅmālo̱ le̱, damo̱ tšo no̱damo̱nõ ko ní kwo̱ ní ame̱fe ye̱ no hewo̱ le̱ no̱; ni Matitia ke̱ Šema ke̱ Anaia ke̱ Uria ke̱ Hilkia ke̱ Maaseia damo̱ emase̱i ye̱ eninedšũrõ, ni Pedaia ke̱ Mišael ke̱ Malkia ke̱ Hašum ke̱ Hašbadana ke̱ Zakaria ke̱ Mešulam damo̱ ebe̱ku.

english_verse: Ezra praised the great Lord God, and they lifted their hands, shouting “Amen! Amen!” Then they bowed with their faces to the ground and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Ezra dšie Iehowa, Nyoṅmo̱ kpeteṅkple le̱, yi; ni maṅ mū le̱ fẽ here no̱ ake̱: Amen, amen! ni ame̱hole ame̱nidši ano̱, ni ame̱mãmo̱ ame̱yi-tšei ašĩ, ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱hĩe bumo̱ ši ame̱ dšá Iehowa.

english_verse: After this, the Levites Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, and Pelaiah went among the people, explaining the meaning of what Ezra had read.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱kane wolo le̱ ní dši Nyoṅmo̱ mla le̱ faṅṅ, ni ame̱tšõ šiši, koni anu noni akaneo̱ le̱ šiši.

english_verse: The people started crying when God's Law was read to them. Then Nehemiah the governor, Ezra the priest and teacher, and the Levites who had been teaching the people all said, “This is a special day for the Lord your God. So don't be sad and don't cry!”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Nehemia ní dši *amralo le̱ ke̱ oso̱fo Ezra ni dši woloṅmālo̱ le̱ ke̱ Levibii ní tšõo̱ maṅ le̱ nii le̱ kē̱ maṅ mū le̱ fẽ ake̱: Nme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ ye̱ kroṅkroṅ hã Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱; nyekayea ṅko̱mo̱ ni nyekafóa hũ! Edšake̱ maṅ mū le̱ fẽ mīfó, beni amenu mla le̱ mli wiemo̱i le̱. *

english_verse: Nehemiah told the people, “Enjoy your good food and wine and share some with those who didn't have anything to bring. Don't be sad! This is a special day for the Lord, and he will make you happy and strong.”
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyeyaä ni nyeyayea nii ni ewo fo̱, ni nyenua nii ni ṅō do̱ko̱do̱ko̱, ni nyeke̱ eko amãdšea mei ni afeko noko atokoame̱ le̱; edšake̱ ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ ye̱ kroṅkroṅ hã wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ le̱, hewo̱ le̱ nyew̌ere̱ akahoa nyehe; edšake̱ Iehowa he nyã́mo̱ le̱ dši nyehewale̱!

english_verse: The Levites encouraged the people by saying, “This is a sacred day, so don't worry or mourn!”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Levibii le̱ še̱dše maṅ le̱ fẽ mī ni ame̱kē̱: Nyefõa, edšake̱ ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ ye̱ kroṅkroṅ, hewo̱ le̱ nyew̌ere̱ akahoa nyehe!

english_verse: When the people returned to their homes, they celebrated by eating and drinking and by sharing their food with those in need, because they had understood what had been read to them. Celebrating the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: Ni maṅ mū le̱ fē yiṅ ame̱te ni ame̱yaye nii ni amenu noko ní ame̱ke̱ ekomei mãdše, ni ame̱ná mīše̱ babaō; edšake̱ wiemo̱i ni adšadše atšõame̱ le̱ ame̱nn šiši.

english_verse: On the second day of the seventh month, the leaders of all the family groups came together with the priests and the Levites, so Ezra could teach them the Law
translation_verse: Ni eno̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ enyo̱ le̱ maṅ le̱ fẽ mli tše̱mei awei le̱ ano̱ onukpai le̱ ke̱ oso̱foi le̱ ke̱ Levibii le̱ babua ame̱he nā ye̱ Ezra, woloṅmālo̱ le̱, ṅõ, koni ame̱babo mla le̱ mli wiemo̱i le̱ atoi.

english_verse: that the Lord had given to Moses. They learned from the Law that the people of Israel were to live in shelters when they celebrated the festival in the seventh month of the year.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱na ake̱ *aṅmã ye̱ mla ni Iehowa tšṍ Mose nine no̱ ewo le̱ mli, ake̱ Israelbii le̱ ahĩ asesei amli ye̱ nyõṅ ní dšĩ kpawo le̱ no gbĩdšũrõ le no, *

english_verse: They also learned that they were to go into the woods and gather branches of leafy trees such as olives, myrtles, and palms for making these shelters.
