translation_verse: Ō, miná ni kũle̱ ahãmi noni mibio̱ le̱, ni Nyoṅmo̱ fe noni miſeo̱ le̱ ehämi!

english_verse: Then I would be comforted, knowing that in all of my pain I have never disobeyed God.
translation_verse: Kũle̱ mimī aaše̱ mihe, ni mimli aaflimi ye̱ minõnā ní ekõõ eflii le̱ mli; edšake̱ mikpako ye̱ Mokroṅkroṅ le̱ wiemo̱i le̱ ase̱.

english_verse: Why should I patiently hope when my strength is gone?
translation_verse: Mihewale̱ enyie, ni mike̱-amīa mi-hĩe? ni mẽ dši mināgbẽ, hewo̱ ni mato mitšui ši?

english_verse: and I have finally reached the end of my rope. My Friends, I Am Desperate
translation_verse: Nto yeli-ke̱-buamo̱ ko be̱ mimli, ni šifĩmo̱ hũ edšomi foi?

english_verse: My friends, I am desperate, and you should help me, even if I no longer respect God All-Powerful. *
translation_verse: Moni héo̱ ato biti le̱, esa ake̱ enanemei amli ahĩ ye̱ eno̱; kē̱ dšee nakai le̱, eekwa Ofe le̱ gbeyeišemo̱.

english_verse: like streams that swell with melting snow,
translation_verse: ni nute̱ so̱ṅṅ ehã nu le̱ ekpo̱to̱, ní snō tēo̱ ehe ye̱ mli;

english_verse: I am like a caravan, lost in the desert while searching for water.
translation_verse: Gbe̱nyielo̱i asafoi dše̱o̱ ame̱gbe̱ le̱ no̱ ame̱gbáa afã, ame̱kwo̱ö̱ ke̱-yadšeo̱ ole̱ṅle̱ no̱, ni ame̱lădšeo̱.

english_verse: thought they would find water. But they were disappointed,
translation_verse: Ame̱hĩe gboio̱ ake̱ ame̱ṅõ ame̱hĩe ame̱fō no̱, kē̱ ame̱yaše̱ he le̱, ni ame̱hĩe ſĩeo̱ ši.

english_verse: just as I am with you. Only one look at my suffering, and you run away scared. What Have I Done Wrong?
translation_verse: Edšake̱ agbe̱ne̱ nye hũ nyedšee fē̱i, nyenaä gbeyeinõ, ni nyešeo̱ gbeyei!

english_verse: Have I ever asked any of you to give me a gift
translation_verse: Ani mikē̱ ake̱: Nyebahãami noko, alo nyeṅõa nyenii le̱ eko nyekoa ye̱ mi-hewo̱,

english_verse: or to purchase my freedom from brutal enemies?
translation_verse: lo nyedšieami ke̱-dše̱a henye̱lo̱ le̱ deṅ, alo nyekpõami ye̱ yiwalo̱i le̱ adeṅ lo?

english_verse: What have I done wrong? Show me, and I will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Nyetšṍami, ni mabu minā, ni nõ mli ni midũ gbe̱ ye̱ le̱, nyehãa malea!

english_verse: The truth is always painful, but your arguments prove nothing.
translation_verse: Kwe̱ boni wiemo̱i ni dša gbe̱ le̱ taä mo mli hãa! Ši nyeyiyimo̱i ne̱, mẽ hĩekãmo̱ yo̱ mli?

english_verse: Here I am desperate, and you consider my words as worthless as wind.
translation_verse: Ani nyedſẽṅo̱ ake̱ nyeakã mo ble ye̱ wiemo̱i ahewo̱? Nto moni hĩe ewo la le̱, ewiemo̱i tamo̱ kō̱yo̱?

english_verse: Why, you would sell an orphan or your own neighbor!
translation_verse: Hẽ, nyefōo̱ awusã no̱ ošiki, ni nye-yeo̱ nyenanyo yi dšra.

english_verse: Look me straight in the eye; I won't lie to you.
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱, nyetẽdšea nyehĩe nye-kwe̱ami, ni mimaleṅ ye̱ nyehĩe ko̱kō̱ko̱!

english_verse: Stop accusing me falsely; my reputation is at stake.
translation_verse: Nyekũa nyese̱, akaye toikōdõme̱ sane, hẽ, nyekũa nyese̱, misane le̱ dša.

english_verse: I know right from wrong, and I am not telling lies.
translation_verse: Ani sane ni edšaa ko ye̱ milile̱i ne̱, alo midā kpaa nibii fõdsi aši?

english_verse: We are slaves in search of shade; we are laborers longing for our wages.
translation_verse: Take̱ boni tšũlo̱ ſeo̱ hõṅ naakpa, ke̱ beni apāyelo̱ kwe̱o̱ epãbō̱nii agbe le̱,

english_verse: God has made my days drag on and my nights miserable.
translation_verse: nakai noṅṅ miná nyõdši abo̱ yakatſā, ni haomo̱-nyōṅnyōṅ hũ akane ahāmi.

english_verse: and my days are running out quicker than the thread of a fast-moving needle. Don't Forget!
translation_verse: Mĩgbĩĩ le̱ hoo oyá fè mamalólo̱ akrokrowa, ni ame̱mītã, ni hĩeno̱kãmo̱ ko be. Ies.

english_verse: I beg you, God, don't forget! My life is just a breath, and trouble lies ahead.
translation_verse: Keimo̱ ake̱ miwala le̱ kō̱yo̱ ni, mi-hĩṅme̱i enaṅ nōkpakpa ko doṅṅ.

english_verse: I will disappear in the grave or vanish from sight like a passing cloud.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni atatu tãa ni elādšeo̱ le̱, nakai noṅṅ moni ekpleke ši ke̱-te gbohĩĩ-adše le̱ hũ ekũṅ ese̱ ebaṅ doṅṅ.

english_verse: And so, I cry out to you in agony and distress.
translation_verse: Nohewo le̱ mi hũ mimũaṅ minā, mawie ye̱ mimumo̱ṅ pĩmo̱ le̱ṅ, maye ṅko̱mo̱ ye̱ misusuma w̌ere̱ ní eho ehe le̱ mli.

english_verse: Am I the sea or a sea monster? Is that why you imprison me?
translation_verse: Ani ṅšo̱ alo bonso dsimĩ, hewo̱ ni otoo̱ bulo̱ ye̱ mihe le̱?

english_verse: I go to bed, hoping for rest,
translation_verse: Ke̱dši mike̱ ake̱: Misa aaše̱dše mimī, miwō̱he aadšo̱ miko̱mo̱yeli le̱ he le̱,

english_verse: I'd rather choke to death than live in this body.
translation_verse: ni misusuma ſeo̱ sẽmĩamo̱ ke̱ gbĕle moṅ fè miwui kratšā ne̱.

english_verse: Leave me alone and let me die; my life has no meaning.
translation_verse: Dšeṅhĩle̱ edše mitšine, dšee nāno̱ mihĩe aakà ke̱-yaši: ṅmē̃mo̱ miho; ši migbĩī le̱ tamo̱ lamo̱!

english_verse: What makes you so concerned about us humans?
translation_verse: Meni dši ádesã, ni obuo̱le̱ agbo, ni oṅõo̱ otšui ofõo̱ eno̱?

english_verse: Why do you test us from sunrise to sunset?
translation_verse: Ši obasraäle̱ dã lebi, ni kpitiokpitio okaãle̱ okwe̱e̱ hũ.

english_verse: Won't you look away just long enough for me to swallow?
translation_verse: Mẽ beyino̱ po oodšie ohĩe ke̱-adše̱ mihe, osā ooṅmẽ mihe, ni mamĩ misẽṅnu?

english_verse: Why do you watch us so closely? What's it to you, if I sin? Why am I your target and such a heavy burden?
translation_verse: Kē̱ mife eša le̱, meni po miná mĩ-feo, bo ádesãi ahebulo̱? Mẽba odšie ohĩe okami, ni mitšṍ dšatšu mihã midientše̱ mihe ne̱?

english_verse: Why do you refuse to forgive? Soon you won't find me, because I'll be dead.
translation_verse: Ni mẽba oke̱ mino̱tõmo̱ le̱ efaami, ni odšie minõša le̱ ke̱-ya? Ši agbe̱ne̱ le̱ sũ mli mibakã, ni kē̱ ōtaomi le̱, mibe̱ doṅṅ.

english_verse: Does God All-Powerful stand in the way of justice?
translation_verse: Ani Mawu tšṍo̱ kodšomo̱ hĩe ebuo̱ ši, alo Ofe le̱ kõdõo̱ etoi eyeo̱ sane?

english_verse: He made your children pay for their sins.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši obii le̱ efe eša ešile̱ le̱, etuame̱ ewo ame̱no̱tõme̱ le̱ deṅ.

english_verse: So why don't you turn to him
translation_verse: ši ke̱dši bodientše̱ otao Mawu se̱-gbe̱ mrã ni okpa Ofe le̱ fai le̱,

english_verse: and start living right? Then he will decide to rescue and restore you to your place of honor.
translation_verse: kē̱ ohe tše ni odša le̱, no le̱ *ehĩe aatšẽ ahão kẽ, ni eebã odšale̱ šihĩle̱he le̱ aſere; *Lal.

english_verse: Your future will be brighter by far than your past. Our Ancestors Were Wise
translation_verse: ni asá šihĩle̱ le̱ aafe bibiõ, ni onāgbē le̱ aada kpeteṅkple.

english_verse: Our own time has been short, like a fading shadow, and we know very little.
translation_verse: Ši wo̱ le̱, nyé ne̱ ke̱ke̱ afo̱wo̱, ni wo̱lee noko; edšake̱ *hõṅ ke̱ke̱ dši wo̱-gbĩĩ le̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱. *Lal.

english_verse: and if the water dries up, they die sooner than grass.
translation_verse: Beni eyo̱ frõfrõ lolo ni anáko afo le̱, eṅălãa ešio̱ dſe̱i le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: Such is the hopeless future of all who turn from God
translation_verse: Nakai mei fẽ ní hĩe kpaã Mawu no̱ le̱ agbè̱i le̱ ye̱, ni mofõṅ hĩeno̱kãmo̱ le̱ aafite.

english_verse: and trust in something as frail as a spider's web—
translation_verse: Edšake̱ eſã le̱ se̱ bafo, ni ehĩeno̱-kãmo̱ le̱ ananu ntãṅ ni.

english_verse: they take hold and fall because it's so flimsy.
translation_verse: Eṅõ ehe ekpasa ešĩa, ši emãṅ ši; eemõ mli wã, ši kẽle̱ ehĩṅ ši.

english_verse: Sinful people are like plants with spreading roots and plenty of sun and water.
translation_verse: Eye̱ frõfrō ye̱ hũlũ hĩe moṅ, ni egbleã nidši ke̱-haã etrom le̱ no̱.

english_verse: They wrap their roots tightly around rocks.
translation_verse: Ešišifãi le̱ blaā te̱kui, etšṍ? te̱sāi ateṅ tete.

english_verse: But once they are pulled up, they have no more place;
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši ekpãtã ehĩe ye̱ ehĩle̱he le̱, no le̱ ehĩle̱he le̱ aatšo ake̱: Minakoö dã!

english_verse: their life slips away, and other plants grow there.
translation_verse: Na, egbe̱ le̱ be nyã́mo̱ ne̱, ni meikrokomei hũ aakwẽ ke̱-adše̱ sù mli!

english_verse: We know God doesn't reject an innocent person or help a sinner.
translation_verse: Na, moni kpa ko be̱ ehe le̱, Mawu kwaale̱, ni asaṅ meifõdši hũ emõõ ame̱mli.

english_verse: And so, he will make you happy and give you something to smile about.
translation_verse: Ni eewo odã obõ ke̱ ṅmlõ, ke̱ onābu hũ ke̱ ošebō̱ so̱ṅṅ. Lal.

english_verse: But your evil enemies will be put to shame and disappear forever.
translation_verse: Ohenye̱lo̱i le̱ aaha hĩegbĕle so̱ṅṅ, ni efõṅfelo̱i abū le̱ aalādše.

english_verse: What you say is true. No human is innocent in the sight of God.
translation_verse: Le̱le̱ṅ, mile ake̱ eye̱ mli nakai, ši te ádesã aafe tẽṅ adša ye̱ Mawu hĩeṅ?

english_verse: God is wise and powerful— who could possibly oppose him and win?
translation_verse: Nilelo̱ dšile̱ ye̱ tšui mli ke̱ hewalo̱ hũ ye̱ nyẽmo̱ mli; namo ete ši ewole̱, ni ehĩ ehãle̱ pẽṅ?

english_verse: God can shake the earth loose from its foundations
translation_verse: moni hosoo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ ehĩle̱he, ni ekulašĩṅi le̱ kpokpoo̱ le̱;

english_verse: or command the sun and stars to hold back their light.
translation_verse: moni fã́a hũlũ yi, ni etee ši, ni eso̱oo̱ ṅulamii ani le̱;

english_verse: Of all the miracles God works, we cannot understand a one.
translation_verse: moni feo nibii wudši ní anaa nā ke̱ nākpe̱ nibii hũ ní alee ame̱yibo̱ le̱.

english_verse: God walks right past me, without making a sound.
translation_verse: Na, ehoo̱ ye̱ mihĩe, ši minaa le̱; efoo̱ṅ hũ, ši miyoole̱.

english_verse: When God showed his anger, the servants of the sea monster fell at his feet.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱ kpãtãṅ emliſũ; bualo̱i hewolo! le̱ tete aakoklo ši ye̱ ehĩe.

english_verse: How, then, could I possibly argue my case with God? Though I Am Innocent
translation_verse: Ni mi ni manyẽ le̱ hetō mahã, lo mahala miwiemo̱i ní mike̱le̱ ayiyi?

english_verse: Even though I am innocent, I can only beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Le̱ le̱, ké̱ dšalo̱ dšimi tete, mi-nyẽṅ le̱ hetō mahã, ši mikodšolo̱ le̱ fai moṅ makpa.

english_verse: And if God came into court when I called him, he would not hear my case.
translation_verse: Ké̱ mitšé̱, ni eheremi no̱ po, miheṅ miyeṅ ake̱ ebo migbē to̱i.

english_verse: He would strike me with a storm and increase my injuries for no reason at all.
translation_verse: Moni ke̱ lasũogbĕle kũmoo̱mi, ni ehãa mifadši le̱ fáa yakatſā le̱.

english_verse: Before I could get my breath, my miseries would multiply.
translation_verse: Ehãã mawo mumo̱, ši ewomi obõ to̱ ke̱ dšōmo̱.

english_verse: God is much stronger than I am, and who would call me into court to give me justice?
translation_verse: Ké̱ āyele̱ hewalo̱i ahewale̱ nā le̱, na, le̱ ne̱! ni ké̱ kodšomo̱ nā hũ le̱, namo aakpēmi ke̱-ate? K.

english_verse: I am not guilty, but I no longer care what happens to me.
translation_verse: Miyee fo̱, mibua misusuma; midšeṅ-hĩle̱ edše mitšine!

english_verse: What difference does it make? God destroys the innocent along with the guilty.
translation_verse: Fẽ ekome, nohewo̱ le̱ mikē̱: Ekpãtãa moni kpa ko be̱ ehe ke̱ mofõṅ fẽ hĩe?

english_verse: When a good person dies a sudden death, God sits back and laughs.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši kplebi gbe mo trukã le̱, no le̱ eeṅmõ mei ní efeko efõṅ ko le̱ ama-nehũlũ le̱.

english_verse: And who else but God blindfolds the judges, then lets the wicked take over the earth? My Life Is Speeding By
translation_verse: Aṅõo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ awoo̱ mofõṅ deṅ, ehaã ekodšolo̱i ahĩe; ké̱ dšee nakai ni le̱, namo ni mo̱?

english_verse: My life is speeding by, without a hope of happiness.
translation_verse: Ši migbĩĩ le̱ ye̱ oyá fè foidšelo̱: ame̱dšo foi ke̱-te, ame̱naa nõkpakpa ko!

english_verse: Each day passes swifter than a sailing ship or an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: Ame̱ho tamo gălã-le̱dši, tamo̱ okropoṅ ní yio̱ kolo no̱.

english_verse: Sometimes I try to be cheerful and to stop complaining,
translation_verse: Ke̱dši mikē̱: Madšie mihĩe ye̱ miko̱mo̱yeli le̱ no̱, masā mihĩe ní matšé̱ mitšui maṅmẽ mimli le̱,

english_verse: but my sufferings frighten me, because I know that God still considers me guilty.
translation_verse: mīše mipĩmo̱i le̱ fẽ gbeyei, mile ake̱ obuṅmi bem.

english_verse: So what's the use of trying to prove my innocence?
translation_verse: Mi le̱, ababumi fo̱ kẽ, mẽhewo̱ migbaä mihe nā yaka ne̱?

english_verse: Even if I washed myself with the strongest soap,
translation_verse: Ke̱dši midšu mihe ke̱ snōnu ní mifo midẽ hũ ke̱ sãmlã le̱,

english_verse: God would throw me into a pit of stinking slime, leaving me disgusting to my clothes.
translation_verse: kẽle̱ ootšími owo bu le̱ṅ, ni midientše̱ mitadei tete aanyãṅemi.

english_verse: God isn't a mere human like me. I can't put him on trial.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ edšee gbomo tamo̱mi, ni mato he mahãle̱, ní wo̱o̱kpe ni wo̱o̱kodšo.

english_verse: Who could possibly judge between the two of us?
translation_verse: Asaṅ sanemlifolo̱ ko be̱ wo̱teṅ, ni aaṅõ enine afõ wo̱yi enyo le̱ fẽ wo̱no̱.

english_verse: Can someone snatch away the stick God carries to frighten me?
translation_verse: Hã ní edšĩe etšo le̱ ye̱ mino̱, ni ehe ṅmiṅmi hũ akamõmi,

english_verse: Then I could speak up without fear of him, but for now, I cannot speak.
translation_verse: ṅo le̱ mawie, ni mišeṅle̱; edšake̱ mibe̱ nakai ye̱ midientše̱ mimli.

english_verse: Don't just condemn me! Point out my sin.
translation_verse: Makē̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ake̱: Kãbumi fo̱! Tšõmo̱mi nohewo̱ ní oke̱mi ená ne̱.

english_verse: Do you look at things the way we humans do?
translation_verse: Ani helo hĩṅme̱ii ohĩe, *alo onaä nii tamo̱ ádesã naä le̱? *

english_verse: Is that why you are so quick to find fault with me?
translation_verse: Hewo ni obio̱ mino̱tõmo̱ le̱ ši, ni odio̱ mihe eša le̱ se̱?

english_verse: Remember that you molded me like a piece of clay. So don't turn me back into dust once again.
translation_verse: Kaimo̱ ake̱ *ošõmi tamo̱ ašõo̱ sũ, ni agbe̱ne̱ obahã matšṍ sũ ekoṅ! *

english_verse: You, the source of my life, showered me with kindness and watched over me. You Have Not Explained
translation_verse: Odromi wala ke̱ nii dšudši, ni osramo̱ le̱ bā mimumo̱ yi.

english_verse: Guilty or innocent, I am condemned and ashamed because of my troubles.
translation_verse: Ké̱ miye fo̱ le̱, kpóo hãmi! Ni kē̱ miye bem tete le̱, miwóṅ miyi no̱, miyi obo ke̱ hĩegbẽle, ni mina mimanehũlũ le̱!

english_verse: No matter how hard I try, you keep hunting me down like a powerful lion.
translation_verse: Ni ké̱ miwó miyi no̱ le̱, ogbo̱bio̱mi *tamo̱ dšata, ni asaṅ ohãa ohe feo̱-mi nākpē̱. *Ies.

english_verse: You never stop accusing me; you become furious and attack over and over again.
translation_verse: Otšakeo̱ odasefoi owoo̱mi, ni ohãa omlifũ le̱ fáa ye̱ mino̱; ta nyie ta se̱ ye̱ mino̱.

english_verse: Why did you let me be born? I would rather have died before birth
translation_verse: Mẽba mo̱ ni odšiemi kpo ke̱-dše̱ mũsũ mli? Kũle̱ mĩtšṍ mihe ní hĩṅme̱i ko enaami!

english_verse: and been carried to the grave without ever breathing.
translation_verse: Kũle̱ mitamo̱ noko ni be̱: midše̱ mũsũṅ noṅṅ ni awomi ke̱-te gbonyobu mli.

english_verse: of darkness and despair, the place of no return.
translation_verse: duṅ kpī šikpoṅ ni tamo̱ nyōṅ teṅ, ke̱ gbĕlehõṅ ke̱ sakasaka šikpoṅ ni ela dši duṅ le̱.

english_verse: So much foolish talk cannot go unanswered.
translation_verse: Aso wiemo̱i babaō ne̱ ahãṅ hetō, alo nū nāfūtše̱ aaye bem?

english_verse: Can you understand the mysteries surrounding God All-Powerful?
translation_verse: Ani oona Nyoṅmo̱ nii ni mli kwŏ̱lo̱ le̱ anā, alo oonyẽ Ofe le̱ ona ke̱-wula ši?

english_verse: They are higher than the heavens and deeper than the grave. So what can you do when you know so little,
translation_verse: Ekwo̱le̱ tamo̱ ṅwei kwo̱le̱; meni oonyẽ ofe? emli kwo̱ vō fẽ gbohĩĩadše; meni ole?

english_verse: If God puts you in prison or drags you to court, what can you do?
translation_verse: Ke̱dšĩ etšẽ ke̱-ba, ni emõo ewo tšũṅ, ni etšē̱o kodšomo̱ le̱, namo aanyẽ enā atšĩ?

english_verse: God has the wisdom to know when someone is worthless and sinful,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ele yakagbomei, ni enaä nõša hũ, kẽle̱ efe tamo̱ noni enaa.

english_verse: but it's easier to tame a wild donkey than to make a fool wise. Surrender Your Heart to God
translation_verse: Koni gbomo ni be̱ dſẽṅmo̱ aná dſẽṅmo̱, ni ṅãṅ tedšibi hũ afo̱le̱ gbomo.

english_verse: Surrender your heart to God, turn to him in prayer,
translation_verse: Ke̱dšĩ bo hũ osã otšui, ni ōgbe̱ onidšiaṅ ye̱ ehĩe le̱;

english_verse: and give up your sins— even those you do in secret.
translation_verse: kē̱ nõša ko ye̱ odeṅ le̱, hã eya se̱ fle̱ṅṅ, ni okahã noni edšaa mïhi obūi le̱ amli:

english_verse: Then you won't be ashamed; you will be confident and fearless.
translation_verse: no le̱ oowó ohĩe no̱ ni kpa ko be̱ he, hē̃, oofĩ ši šiṅṅ, ni ošeṅ gbeyei;

english_verse: Your troubles will go away like water beneath a bridge,
translation_verse: edšake̱ ohĩe aakpa ohaomo̱ le̱ no̱, ookai tamo̱ nu ni eho ete;

english_verse: and your darkest night will be brighter than noon.
translation_verse: ni owala be le̱ mli aatše fè ſane, ni ké̱ duṅ wo tete le̱, eetamo̱ lebi;

english_verse: You will sleep without fear and be greatly respected.
translation_verse: Asaṅ *ookã ši hũ, ni moko woṅ ohe gbeyei; ni mei babaō hū aatao ohĩe gbe̱. *Lal.

english_verse: But those who are evil will go blind and lose their way. Their only escape is death!
translation_verse: Ši meifōdši le̱, ame̱hĩṅme̱ii aašiu, ni ame̱náṅ foidšēhe, ni *ame̱hĩeno̱kãmo̱ le̱ aatšṍ susuma plenēmo̱. *

english_verse: You think you are so great, with all the answers.
translation_verse: Eye̱ mli le̱le̱ṅ, ake̱ nye dši maṅ, ni ké̱ nyegboi le̱, nilē egbo!

english_verse: But I know as much as you do, and so does everyone else.
translation_verse: Mi hũ miye dſẽṅmo̱ tamo̱nye noṅṅ, nyefèèmi; ni namo po lee ene̱mei?

english_verse: Robbers and other godless people live safely at home and say, “God is in our hands!” If You Want To Learn
translation_verse: Odšotſalo̱i abūi ſereo̱, ni mei ní woo̱ Mawu mlila le̱ hũ ye̱ ſeſẽſe, mei ní hĩe ame̱nyoṅme̱ ye̱ ame̱deṅ le̱

english_verse: Any of them can tell you what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Namo lee ye̱ ene̱mei fẽ mli ake̱ Iehowa nine fe ene̱?

english_verse: Every living creature is in the hands of God.
translation_verse: Mo deṅ ni hĩekãle̱i fẽ asusuma ye̱, ke̱ gbomei ádesãi fẽ amumo̱ le̱.

english_verse: We hear with our ears, taste with our tongues,
translation_verse: Nto toi kaã wiemo̱i ekwe̱o̱, tamo̱ bo̱ni dā hũ saä niyenii anā le̱?

english_verse: and gain some wisdom from those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Hĩĩ onukpai adeṅ nilē yo̱, ni walase̱tše̱le̱ mli dſẽṅmo̱ yo̱.

english_verse: But God is the real source of wisdom and strength.
translation_verse: Le̱ edeṅ nilē ke̱ hewale̱ ye̱, enõ dši ṅāwō ke̱ dſẽṅmo̱ hũ.

english_verse: God can hold back the rain or send a flood,
translation_verse: Na, *etšĩo̱ nui anā, ni ame̱mĩo̱; ni esā eṅmẽo̱ame̱ gbe, ni †ame̱butuo šikpoṅ. *

english_verse: just as he rules over liars and those they lie to.
translation_verse: Le̱ noṅṅ edeṅ hewale̱ ke̱ ſeremo̱ yo̱; enõ dši moni ašišiuo̱ ke̱ šišiulo̱ le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: God shames counselors, turns judges into fools,
translation_verse: Ekplo̱ö̱ adšinafoi ahe nii ni eke̱-ame̱ yaä, ni ehãa kodšolo̱i hũ tšṍmoo̱ kwašiai.

english_verse: and makes slaves of kings.
translation_verse: Ešõo̱ maṅtše̱mei adeṅ hewale̱, ni ewoo̱ ame̱he kpã.

english_verse: God removes priests and others who have great power—
translation_verse: Ekplo̱ö̱ oso̱foi ahe nii ni eke̱ame̱ yaä, ni mei ní efĩ ši šiṅṅ le̱ etšire̱o̱ame̱ etſiaä ši.

english_verse: he confuses wise, experienced advisors,
translation_verse: Ehãa ane̱kwafoi to̱ö̱ mū, ni ešõo̱ onukpai adſẽṅmo̱.

english_verse: puts mighty kings to shame, and takes away their power.
translation_verse: Eṅõo̱ heguo̱gbĕle eſĩeo̱ abladei ano̱, ni efẽneo̱ hewalo̱i amlifĩnii.

english_verse: he makes nations strong, then shatters their strength.
translation_verse: Ehãa dšeṅmãdši le̱ ſereo̱, ni esā ekpãtãa ame̱hĩe; elē̱o̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ amli, ni esā elōo̱ame̱ ke̱-yaä.

english_verse: God strikes their rulers senseless, then leaves them to roam through barren deserts,
translation_verse: Ešõo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ maṅbii le̱ anukpai le̱ adſẽṅmo̱, ṅi ehãa ame̱tšomloo̱ ye̱ ṅāno̱ heni gbe be̱;

english_verse: lost in the dark, staggering like someone drunk.
translation_verse: ame̱gbugbūo̱ ši ye̱ duṅ ní la be̱ mli le̱ mli, ni ehãa ame̱dĩdãa tamo dā̃to̱lo̱.

english_verse: I know and understand every bit of this.
translation_verse: Na, mihĩṅme̱i ena ene̱ fẽ, mitoi hũ enu ni ena šiši.

english_verse: None of you are smarter than I am; there's nothing you know that I don't.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni nyele le̱, mi hũ mile; ni nyefèèmi.

english_verse: But I prefer to argue my case with God All-Powerful—
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, Ofe le̱ moṅ mike̱-awie, ni mitao ake mike̱ Mawu ayiyi.

english_verse: you are merely useless doctors, who treat me with lies.
translation_verse: Ši nye le̱, mei ni foo̱ sane tãa dšinye, tšofãtše̱mei gbohĩĩ dši nyefẽ.

english_verse: The wisest thing you can do is to keep quiet
translation_verse: Ō, efãṅ nõ moṅ ní nyebu nyenā, kũle̱ no aatsṍ nyenilē. Abe̱i

english_verse: and not telling the whole truth when you argue his case?
translation_verse: Aso esane le̱ he nyesãa nyehãle̱ ne̱, alo bé nyebéo̱ nyehã Mawu?

english_verse: If you were secretly unfair, he would correct you,
translation_verse: Ke̱dši nyekwe̱o̱ mei ahĩeaṅ ye̱ tē-mo̱ mli le̱, kã kẽ ebakã nyehĩe.

english_verse: Your wisdom and arguments will blow away like dust. Be Quiet While I Speak
translation_verse: Nyekaimo̱ wiemo̱i le̱ lamlu abe̱i ni, ni nyehe fãmo̱hei le̱ sũ hefãmo̱hei ni.

english_verse: Be quiet while I speak, and we'll see what happens.
translation_verse: Nyebua nyena, nyekwe̱ami, koni mawie, ni noni aaba mino̱ le̱ aba!

english_verse: I will be responsible for what happens to me.
translation_verse: Mẽhewo̱ maṅõ mihelo makõ mina, ni mahĩe miwala ye̱ mideṅ?

english_verse: God may kill me, but still I will trust him and offer my defense.
translation_verse: Ké̱ gbe eegbeo̱mi po le̱, le̱ mikwe̱o̱; mafã migbè̱i le̱ ahe ye̱ ehĩe kẽ.

english_verse: This may be what saves me, because no guilty person would come to his court.
translation_verse: Ene̱ noṅṅ baha ahĩ ahãmi; edšake̱ mofõṅ nyẽṅ ehĩe aba.

english_verse: I have prepared my case well, and I am certain to win.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ na, mito misane le̱ gbe̱dšiano̱; mile ake̱ mibaye bem.

english_verse: I ask only two things of you, my God, and I will no longer hide from you—
translation_verse: Nibii enyo̱ pe̱ okafemi, no le̱ mítēṅ mihe ye̱ ohĩe:

english_verse: Then speak, and I will reply; or else let me speak, and you reply.
translation_verse: No le̱ tsé̱mi, ni mahereo no̱; alo oha mawie, ni ohãmi hetō.

english_verse: Please point out my sins, so I will know them.
translation_verse: Minišaianii ke̱ mihe ešai le̱, enyie ni? Tšõmo̱mi mino̱tõmo̱ le̱ ke̱ mihe eša le!

english_verse: Why have you turned your back and count me your enemy?
translation_verse: Mẽba oke ohĩe tēo̱, ni obuo̱mi ake̱ ohenye̱lo̱?

english_verse: Why do you accuse me of horrible crimes and make me pay for sins I did in my youth?
translation_verse: Edšake̱ oṅmã nii ní dšõo̱ ošimi, ni ohã miye miblahĩaṅ tõmoi le̱ amli nii. Lal.

english_verse: You have tied my feet down and keep me surrounded;
translation_verse: Asaṅ obo̱ minãdši apã, ni ohĩe kă migbē̱i le̱ fẽ he; minãdšifãmo̱i hũ owo he hũsũ.

english_verse: I am rotting away like cloth eaten by worms.
translation_verse: Tše̱ mitamo̱ noko ní ešra ni ekpo̱to̱, tamo̱ mama ni omlẽgẽ eye.

english_verse: There's no way a human can be completely pure.
translation_verse: Namo aaná hetšelo̱ ye̱ mei ni he tšee ateṅ? Mokomeflo be̱! Lal.

english_verse: Why don't you leave us alone and let us find some happiness while we toil and labor? When a Tree Is Chopped Down
translation_verse: hewo le̱ dšiemo̱ ohĩe ye̱ eno̱, ni ewo etsui, ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni emī aaše̱ egbĩ le̱ he *tamo̱ apāfonyo! *

english_verse: but at the touch of water, it sprouts once again.
translation_verse: kẽle̱ nu ṅmadšē nā le̱ eehere ekoṅ, ni eetšẽrẽ nidši tamo̱ tšo ni ate̱o.

english_verse: We are like streams and lakes after the water has gone;
translation_verse: Bo̱ni nu tãa ye̱ kpākpo mli, ni fā hũ mĩo̱ ni egbĩo̱ le̱,

english_verse: Will we humans live again? I would gladly suffer and wait for my time.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši gbomo gbo le̱, ani ehĩe aakã ekoṅ? kũle̱ *mitawū gbĩĩ le̱ amli fẽ le̱ makwe̱ gbe̱ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni mitšakemo̱ le̱ aaba! *

english_verse: My Creator, you would want me; you would call out, and I would answer.
translation_verse: Kũle̱ ootšé̱, ni mahereo no̱; ni ootao onine nā nitšumo̱ le̱ se̱gbe̱.

english_verse: You would take care of me, but not count my sins—
translation_verse: Ši agbe̱ne̱ okane minãdšifãmo̱i; okũũ ohĩe ofõõ mihe eša le̱ no̱.

english_verse: you would put them in a bag, tie it tight, and toss them away.
translation_verse: Aso̱o mino̱tõmo̱ le̱ nā awo kotoku mli, ni ohã minõša le̱ efá. Hos.

english_verse: But in the real world, mountains tumble, and rocks crumble;
translation_verse: Ši goṅ tete gbēo̱ ši ni elādšeo̱, ni atšio̱ te̱sā hũ ke̱-dše̱o̱ egbe̱he;

english_verse: streams wear away stones and wash away soil. And you destroy our hopes!
translation_verse: te̱i hũ, nu yeo̱ ame̱he, eyimo̱ le̱ lōo̱ šikpoṅ sū ke̱-yaä, nakai noṅṅ ohãa ádesi *hĩeno̱kãmo̱ le̱ lādšeo̱. *Rom.

english_verse: You change the way we look, then send us away, wiped out forever.
translation_verse: Onine tšṍo̱ eno̱ kwrā, ni ehoo̱ eyaä; ohãa ehĩe tšakeo̱ ni oſieo̱le̱ ke̱-yaä.

english_verse: We never live to know if our children are praised or disgraced.
translation_verse: Ebii ahĩe miba nyam hũ, elee, ame̱hĩe miſie ši hũ, enaa.

english_verse: We feel no pain but our own, and when we mourn, it's only for ourselves.
translation_verse: Le̱dientše̱ ehelo ni yo̱ ebe le̱ ke̱ke̱ waä ehe, ni esusuma ni yo̱ emli le̱ hũ yeo̱ ṅko̱mo̱!

english_verse: you would stop spreading all of this hot air.
translation_verse: Aso wiemo̱ ni he be̱ se̱námo̱ ke̱ wiemo̱i ni nyẽẽ noko atšu eke̱-ayiyi lo?

english_verse: Have you ever been present when God's council meets? Do you alone have wisdom?
translation_verse: Ani onu Nyoṅmo̱ tēmo̱n adšina le̱, ni otšĩ nilē hũ nā ohã ohe?

english_verse: Do you know and understand something we don't?
translation_verse: Meni ole, ni wo̱ le̱ wo̱lee? Meni oyo̱se, ni wo̱ le̱ ebe wo̱mli?

english_verse: We have the benefit of wisdom older than your father.
translation_verse: Wadšiatše̱mei ke̱ hĩĩmedši fẽ ye̱ wo̱-teṅ, mei ní ye otše̱ onukpa āhũ.

english_verse: And you have been offered comforting words from God. Isn't this enough?
translation_verse: Ani obuo̱ Mawu mīše̱dšemo̱i le̱ ke̱ wiemo ní ake̱o wieo̱ ble̱ō le̱ ake̱ noko bibiō?

english_verse: Your emotions are out of control, making you look fierce;
translation_verse: Mẽba otšui šao? Ni mẽba ohĩṅme̱ii etšu ne̱ke̱?

english_verse: that's why you attack God with everything you say.
translation_verse: Ni otšṍo̱ omumo̱ okpeo̱ Mawu, ni ohãa ne̱ke̱ wiemo̱i dšeo̱ onā ne̱?

english_verse: what chance do humans have? We are so terribly evil that we thirst for sin. Just Listen to What I Know
translation_verse: mbasroo moni he yo̱ nyãṅemo̱ ní esra, gbomo ni nno̱ nõša tamo̱ anuo̱ nu!

english_verse: Just listen to what I know, and you will learn
translation_verse: Bomi toi ni matšṍo, ni noni mina ne̱ hũ, magbao;

english_verse: Those who gained such insights also gained the land, and they were not influenced by foreign teachings.
translation_verse: ame̱ ke̱ke̱ aṅõ šikpoṅ le̱ ahã, ni gbo̱ ko gbo̱ ko ebatšṍṍ ame̱teṅ ehoo:

english_verse: Even in times of success, they constantly hear the threat of doom.
translation_verse: Gbē ní yo̱ gbeyei gbē̱o̱ ye̱ etoiiaṅ, hedšo̱le̱ mli po le̱ hĩekpãtãlo̱ le̱ aaba-ninale̱;

english_verse: Darkness, despair, and death are their destiny.
translation_verse: ehee eyee ake̱ ee̱kũ ese̱ ke̱-adše̱ duṅ mli, ni klante dši noni mẽo̱le̱.

english_verse: They scrounge around for food, all the while dreading the approaching darkness.
translation_verse: Etšomloo̱ ke̱-nyieo̱ abolo se̱ ni ekē̱o̱ ake̱: Nẽgbe̱ yo̱? Ele ake̱ duṅ gbĩ le̱ ebe̱ṅke̱le̱.

english_verse: This is because they rebelled against God All-Powerful
translation_verse: edšake̱ ekpã enine mli ewo Mawu, ni ewo ehe no̱ eši Ofe le̱.

english_verse: and have attacked him with their weapons.
translation_verse: Etšẽ ke̱-ba eno̱ ke̱ kue̱ ni mli ti, ke̱ etše̱ni akotose̱ kpakpatakpakpatā;

english_verse: but they will live in the ruins of deserted towns.
translation_verse: ši eehī amaṅfõi amli, šĩai ni esaa ake̱ moko aahĩ mli, ni ame̱mīhé ame̱tāṍmo̱ tšukoi. Ios.

english_verse: Their property and wealth will shrink and disappear.
translation_verse: Enáṅ nii, ni asaṅ enii le̱ etše̱ṅ, ni enibāniì le̱ fáṅ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: They won't escape the darkness, and the blazing breath of God will set their future aflame. *
translation_verse: Edšeṅ duṅ le̱ mli; enidšĩ le̱, lalile̱i aanālãame̱, ni eetši ehe ke̱-ate ye̱ edāṅ mumo̱ le̱ nā.

english_verse: They have put their trust in something worthless; now they will become worthless
translation_verse: Ekaṅõ ehĩe efo yakanii ano̱ ni eke̱-šisiu ehe; edšake̱ yakanii noṅṅ batšṍ enyõmo̱wo.

english_verse: like a date palm tree without a leaf.
translation_verse: Aagbe nā ahãle̱ dãni egbi le̱ aaše̱, ni enine le̱ fro̱keṅ.

english_verse: Or like vineyards or orchards whose blossoms and unripe fruit drop to the ground.
translation_verse: Eetšere̱ eyibii ṅmlikitii le̱ eſie ši tamo̱ weintšo, ni eekpla efofroi lo̱ eſie ši tamo̱ mũtšo.

english_verse: Yes, the godless and the greedy will have nothing but flames feasting on their homes,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ meifōdši asafo le̱ aatšṍmo̱ kenei, ni nyōṅnihãmo̱ būi le̱ hũ la aašã.

english_verse: because they are the parents of trouble and vicious lies.
translation_verse: Ame̱ṅõo̱ haomo̱ ho̱ ni ame̱fo̱ö̱ nõša, ni ame̱mũsũ hū sāa šišiumo too̱. Lal.

english_verse: I have often heard this, and it offers no comfort.
translation_verse: Minu sãdši ni tamo̱ ene̱mei āhũ; nyefẽ le̱, mīše̱dšelo̱i gbohĩĩ dšinye!

english_verse: If I speak, or if I don't, I hurt all the same. My torment continues.
translation_verse: Ké̱ miwie le̱, mipīmo̱ le̱ edšo̱o̱; ni kē̱ mifo hũ, té mihe ni edšo̱miṅ?

english_verse: God has worn me down and destroyed my family;
translation_verse: Ši agbe̱ne̱ ehã eto̱mi; ohã mihe gbomei fẽ etā.

english_verse: God is my hateful enemy, glaring at me and attacking with his sharp teeth.
translation_verse: Etšere̱ mimli ye̱ emlifũ le̱ mli, ni ebe̱mi ewo emli; *ekpeo̱ enyãnyõdšĩ ašišĩ ewoo̱mi, ni etšuo̱ ehĩenme̱ii eſieo̱ mino̱ tamo̱ henye̱lo̱. *Lal.

english_verse: And God is the one who handed me over to this merciless mob. Everything Was Going Well
translation_verse: Mawu eṅõmi ehã mofõṅ, ni eše̱mi efo efõṅfelo̱i adeṅ.

english_verse: for his arrows, and without showing mercy, he slashed my stomach open, spilling out my insides.
translation_verse: Egãitšẽlo̱i le̱ bo̱lemi ke̱kpe; egbla misabai amli, ni ekõõ eflii; efo̱se midro̱ eſie šikpoṅ.

english_verse: and so, in my sorrow I dress in sackcloth and sit in the dust.
translation_verse: Mikpe̱ *kpekpe miha mihewolo no̱, ni miṅõ miklonto le̱ mifo sũ mli. *

english_verse: My face is red with tears, and dark shadows circle my eyes,
translation_verse: Yāfó so̱ṅṅ ehã mihĩe etšu fō̱, ni gbēlehõṅ eha mihĩṅme̱iiase̱;

english_verse: though I am not violent, and my prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: tše̱ yiwale̱ ko be̱ mideṅ, ni mifaikpamo̱ hũ ye̱ kro̱ṅṅ.

english_verse: If I should die, I beg the earth not to cover my cry for justice.
translation_verse: Šikpoṅ, kāha milá le̱ no̱! ni kāhã miblo̱mo̱ le̱ mīná hedšō̱mo̱he!

english_verse: Even now, God in heaven is both my witness and my protector.
translation_verse: Amrõmrõ ne̱ tete na, ṅwei midasefonyo yo̱, ni mĩhefã́lo̱ hũ ye̱ ṅwei flōflo.

english_verse: My friends have rejected me, but God is the one I beg
translation_verse: Minanemei tete miye mihe fe̱o; ši Nyoṅmo mihĩṅmei amli kplaä nu hãa, Yāfó

english_verse: Because in only a few years, I will be dead and gone.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ afii fio se̱ le̱ *mibaya heni ké̱ mite ni mibaṅ doṅṅ le̱. *

english_verse: My hopes have died, my time is up, and the grave is ready.
translation_verse: Mimumo̱ eša, migbĩĩ le̱ hũ etã, gbonyobu mīmẽmi!

english_verse: All I can see are angry crowds, making fun of me.
translation_verse: Kẽle̱ hefe̱oyelo̱i ye̱ mimase̱i, ni ame̱-momlilawōi le̱ mihïṅme̱ii dſere no̱!

english_verse: If you, Lord, don't help, who will pay the price for my release?
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ to awaba! bo noṅṅ, damo̱ mise̱! Namo ke̱mi aata dẽ?

english_verse: They have condemned me, just to benefit themselves; now blind their children.
translation_verse: Moni tšõo̱ nanemei ase̱gbe̱, koni ená mli noko le̱, ebii ahĩṅme̱ii tete aafite.

english_verse: I am almost blind with grief; my body is a mere shadow.
translation_verse: Aw̌ere̱hõ so̱ṅṅ ehã mihĩṅme̱i no̱ efe kusū, ni migbomotšo henii fẽ etšṍ tamo̱ hõṅ. Lal.

english_verse: People who are truly good would feel so alarmed, that they would become angry with my worthless friends.
translation_verse: Mei ni dša le̱ ahe aadšõ ame̱he ye̱ ene̱ he; ni moni efeko efõṅ ko le̱ aagri awo mofõṅ!

english_verse: They would do the right thing and because they did, they would grow stronger.
translation_verse: Ši kẽle̱ dšalo̱ aafī ši ye̱ egbe̱ le̱ no̱, ni moni dẽ tše le̱ aaná hewale̱ ke̱-ya no̱.

english_verse: But none of my friends show any sense.
translation_verse: Nyefẽ nyekũa nyese̱ ke̱-baã! Ši minaṅ nilelo̱ ko nilelo̱ ko ye̱ nyeteṅ.

english_verse: My life is drawing to an end; hope has disappeared.
translation_verse: Migbĩĩ le̱ eho ete, akũ miyiṅtōi ni dši mitšui hedō̱nii le̱ anā.

english_verse: But all my friends can do is offer empty hopes.
translation_verse: Ame̱ke̱ nyōṅ feo̱ ſane, ame̱kē̱o̱ ake̱ la ehe̱ṅke̱, tše̱ duṅ moṅ baä.

english_verse: I could tell the world below to prepare me a bed.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši mikwe̱ gbe̱ hũ, gbohĩĩadše dši miwe; duṅ le̱ mli noṅṅ mibaṅmẽ misā ye̱.

english_verse: Then I could greet the grave as my father and say to the worms, “Hello, mother and sisters!”
translation_verse: Matšē̱ šramo̱ ake̱: Mitše̱ dšio, ke̱ *gõgõmii hũ ake̱ minye ke̱ minyemiyō; *

english_verse: But what kind of hope is that?
translation_verse: bēle̱ agbe̱ne̱ nẽgbe̱ mihĩeno̱kãmo̱ yo̱? ni mihĩeno̱kãmo̱ le̱, namo aana?

english_verse: Will it keep me company in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Gbohĩĩadše adabãṅi le̱ amli eekpleke ši ke̱-ate, beni wo̱fiā wo̱yadšō̱ wohe ye̱ sũ mli le̱.

english_verse: How long will you talk? Be sensible! Let us speak.
translation_verse: Mẽ beyino̱ noṅṅ nyeagbe wiemo̱i anā? Nyedſẽṅa he, dãni wo̱wie!

english_verse: You cut yourself in anger. Will that shake the earth or even move the rocks? *
translation_verse: Bo ni otšere̱o̱ bodientše̱ osusuma ye̱ omlifũ mli le̱, aso ohewo̱ le̱ aašĩ šikpoṅ le̱, ni aatši tesã ke̱-dše̱ emăhe?

english_verse: The lamps of sinful people soon are snuffed out,
translation_verse: Meifõdši akane le̱ aagbo, ni ela le̱ lalile̱i hũ kpeṅ. K.

english_verse: they are trapped in a net,
translation_verse: Tšõne aadũ enanetšĩtši, ni mõmo̱kpā hũ aamõle̱.

english_verse: Terror strikes and pursues from every side.
translation_verse: Ṅmiṅmii aamõle̱ ye̱ ehefẽhe ke̱-akpe, ni eenyie enãdši ase̱ kpākpa.

english_verse: Starving, they run, only to meet disaster,
translation_verse: Ošrã mīye ehe hõmo̱, ni amanehũlũ kpaã ye̱ emase̱i.

english_verse: Those sinners are dragged from the safety of their tents to die a gruesome death.
translation_verse: Aafã ehĩeno̱kãmo̱ le̱ ke̱-adše̱ ebū le̱ṅ, ni aatšire̱ eyi se̱ ke̱-ate ṅmiṅmii amaṅtše̱ le̱ ṅō.

english_verse: Then their tents and possessions are burned to ashes,
translation_verse: Noni dšee le̱dientše̱ enõ le̱, no aahĩ ebū le̱ mli; aagbe̱ awō̱ aſã ešihīle̱he le̱ no̱.

english_verse: and they are left like trees, dried up from the roots.
translation_verse: Ešišifãi le̱ aagbĩ ye̱ šišigbe̱, enidši hũ aaṅãlã ye̱ ṅweigbe̱.

english_verse: thrown far from the light into a world of darkness,
translation_verse: Aaſiele̱ ke̱-adše̱ la hĩe ke̱-ate duṅ mli, ni aawole̱ foi ke̱-adše̱ dše ne̱ṅ.

english_verse: without any children to carry on their name.
translation_verse: Enáṅ bi lo nābi ye̱ emaṅbii ateṅ; asaṅ eſe̱ṅ mokomoko ye̱ ehĩle̱he le̱.

english_verse: Such is the fate of sinners and their families who don't know God.
translation_verse: Bo̱ pe̱ ni mei ni edšaa le̱ ašihĩle̱hei ke̱ moni lee Mawu le̱ gbe̱he yo̱ ne̱!

english_verse: Even if I have sinned, you haven't been harmed.
translation_verse: Ni kē̱ eye̱ mli ake̱ midũ gbe̱ le̱, midientše̱ mino̱ migbe̱dũ le̱ kã.

english_verse: You boast of your goodness, claiming I am suffering because I am guilty.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši nyemītao nyewó nyehe no̱ yo̱ mino̱, ni nyekã mihĩe ye̱ mihorabō̱ le̱ hewo̱ le̱,

english_verse: God has me trapped with a wall of darkness
translation_verse: Efo afãbaṅ ewo migbe̱ le̱ he, ni minyẽẽ maho, ni ehã mitempõṅi le̱ ano̱ ewo duṅ. Yāfó

english_verse: and attacks with fierce anger, as though I were his enemy.
translation_verse: Asaṅ emli wo la womi, ni *ebumi tamo̱ ehenye̱lo̱i le̱ eko. *

english_verse: My guests and my servants consider me a stranger,
translation_verse: Mišĩabii ke̱ mitšũdšiyei buo̱mi tamo̱ gbo, mitšṍ mokpõṅ ye̱ ame̱hĩe.

english_verse: Young children can't stand me, and when I come near, they make fun.
translation_verse: Gbekẽbii tete gbeo̱ mihe guo̱; ké̱ mite ši le̱, ame̱wieo̱ mihe.

english_verse: My best friends and loved ones have turned from me.
translation_verse: Mišientše̱mei fẽ enyãṅemi, ni mei ni misumoo̱ le̱ etšṍmo̱ ame̱hĩe ewomi. K.

english_verse: I am skin and bones— just barely alive.
translation_verse: Miwui ekpe̱te̱ mihewolo ke̱ mihelo he, ni mitẽlo pe̱ eſe̱ ehãmi. Lal.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you for pity! God has made me his target.
translation_verse: Nyenaämi mo̱bo̱, nyenaämi mo̱bo̱, minanemei; edšake̱ *Nyoṅmo̱ nine esa mihe! *Rut

english_verse: Hasn't he already done enough? Why do you join the attack?
translation_verse: Mẽba nyewaämi yi tamo̱ bo̱ni Mawu efemi le̱, ni mihelo le̱ hũ še̱e̱ nyenā? Lal.

english_verse: I wish that my words could be written down
translation_verse: Miná ní kũle̱ aṅmã miwiemo̱i le̱, ni akadi awo wolo mli!

english_verse: I know that my Protector lives, and at the end he will stand on this earth.
translation_verse: Ši *mile ake †mikpõlo̱ le̱ hĩe ka, ni nāgbē le̱ eedamo sũ no; *

english_verse: My flesh may be destroyed, yet from this body I will see God.
translation_verse: ni ke̱dši akpãtã mihewolo hĩe ne̱ke̱ se̱, ní helo be̱ mihe le̱, mana *Nyoṅmo̱! *Lal.

english_verse: Yes, I will see him for myself, and I long for that moment.
translation_verse: Le̱ noṅṅ makwe̱ mahã mihe, ni mihĩṅme̱ii aanale̱, ni dšee mo-kpõṅ ko! Misabai mītã ye mimli!

english_verse: My friends, you think up ways to blame and torment me, saying I brought it on myself.
translation_verse: Ké̱ nyeakē̱ ake̱: Té wo̱o̱fe tēṅ wo̱-wale̱ yi, ni wo̱na sane ko ye̱ ehe? le̱,

english_verse: But watch out for the judgment, when God will punish you!
translation_verse: nyešea klante gbeyei; edšake̱ mli-fũ nyieo̱ no̱tõmo̱i ní sa klante le̱ ase̱, koni nyená nyele ake̱ kodšomo̱ ko ye̱.

english_verse: Your words are disturbing; now I must speak.
translation_verse: Ene̱hewo̱ le̱ midſẽṅmo̱i woo minã ní mahere no̱, no hãa mimli taämi.

english_verse: You have accused and insulted me, and reason requires a reply.
translation_verse: Minu hĩewiemo̱ ni woo̱mi hĩegbēle le̱; ši mumo̱ ní dše̱ midſẽṅmo̱ mli le̱ hãami hetō.

english_verse: Since the time of creation, everyone has known
translation_verse: Aso olee ene̱ ke̱-dše̱ tetẽte, ke̱-dše̱ beyino̱ ní aṅō gbomo ato šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱,

english_verse: Though their pride and power may reach to the sky,
translation_verse: Tše̱ egbodšē le̱ kwo̱ö̱ ke̱-yaã ṅwei, ni eyitšo hū se̱o̱ statuiaṅ, Lal.

english_verse: They will be forgotten like a dream
translation_verse: Eeflĩki ke̱-ate tamo̱ lamõ, ni anaṅ-le, ni aaſiele̱ ke̱-ate tamo nyōṅ ninā. Lal.

english_verse: and vanish from the sight of family and friends.
translation_verse: Hĩṅme̱i ni enale̱ le̱ enaṅle̱ doṅṅ, ni ehĩlehe le hũ hĩṅmei gbaṅ eno̱ doṅṅ. Lal.

english_verse: Their children will have to repay what the parents took from the poor.
translation_verse: Ebii aatao ohīafoi ahīegbe̱, ni enii le̱, enidši aadãi ahã.

english_verse: Indeed, the wicked will die and go to their graves in the prime of life. Sinners Love the Taste of Sin
translation_verse: Ewui amli eyimo̱ obõbõ ke̱ oblabō̱, ši agbe̱ne̱ eke̱le̱ aayakã sũ mli.

english_verse: Sinners love the taste of sin; they relish every bite
translation_verse: Tše̱ nõfõṅ ṅõo̱ do̱ko̱do̱ko̱ ye̱ edāṅ, ni eṅõ-tēo̱ ye̱ elile̱i šiši,

english_verse: Then God will make them lose the wealth they gobbled up.
translation_verse: Emĩ nifále̱, ši eeſe eſie ekoṅ, Mawu aadšie ke̱-adše̱ emũsũ mli tete.

english_verse: They will die from the fangs of poisonous snakes
translation_verse: Eeſo̱ šinõi anā ebō̱; blikã lile̱i aagbele̱.

english_verse: and never enjoy rivers flowing with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Enáṅ fāi ke̱ nsutẽṅi ní hoo̱ wó ke̱ fúfo̱ le̱ ekwe̱.

english_verse: because they cheated the poor and took their homes.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ewaã ohĩafoi ayi ni ekwaä-ame̱; šĩa ní dšee le̱ emã le̱, ešõo̱ ekã nā.

english_verse: Greedy people want everything and are never satisfied.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ emũsũ lee mito̱, hewo le̱ eke̱ enii ní dšra wa le̱ edšeṅ mli.

english_verse: But when nothing remains for them to grab, they will be nothing.
translation_verse: Emĩo̱ nofẽno ni eſe̱e̱ nokonoko, he-wo̱ le̱ edšũrõ ni eye le̱ etše̱ṅ.

english_verse: While running from iron spears, they will be killed by arrows of bronze,
translation_verse: Beni ekē̱ edšoo̱ dade tawūnii anā foi le̱, akō̱ble gãi aagbule̱ ke̱-afroṅ mli.

english_verse: whose shining tips go straight through their bodies. They will be trapped by terror,
translation_verse: Ekaã fã, ni edšeo̱ kpo ye̱ egbomotšo le̱ mli, ni dade kãṅkãṅ le̱ dšeo̱ kpo ye̱ edro̱ mli, ni gbĕle ṅmiṅmi hũ mẽo̱le̱. Lal.

english_verse: and what they treasure most will be lost in the dark. God will send flames to destroy them in their tents with all their property.
translation_verse: Duṅ so̱ṅṅ aṅõ-to ahãle̱ ake̱ edſetri; *la ní mokomoko huu aašãle̱; eešã enii ní eſe̱ ye̱ ebū le̱ mli le̱. *

english_verse: The heavens and the earth will testify against them,
translation_verse: Ṅwei aadšie enõša le̱ kpo, ni šikpoṅ hũ aate ši awole̱.

english_verse: and all their possessions will be dragged off when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: Ewe ſeremo̱ le̱ aaho aya, eeho tamo̱ nu ye̱ mlifũ gbī le̱ no̱.

english_verse: This is what God has decided for those who are evil.
translation_verse: Ene̱ dši mofõṅ gbe̱fãṅnõ ni dše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ deṅ ke̱ egbošinii ni Mawu eto ehãle̱.

english_verse: Why are they allowed to see their children grow up?
translation_verse: Ame̱sešibii buaä ši ye̱ ame̱hĩe fataä ame̱he, ni ame̱ſĩei le̱ hũ ye̱ ame̱-hĩṅme̱iiaṅ.

english_verse: They have no worries at home, and God never punishes them.
translation_verse: Ame̱šïa teṅ dšo̱ö̱, ni gbeyeišemo̱ ko be̱ mli, asaṅ Nyoṅmo̱ moyī-tšo le̱ kãã ame̱no̱.

english_verse: their children play and dance safely by themselves.
translation_verse: Ame̱hãa ame̱bii dšeo̱ kpo tamo̱ tōi-ku, ni ame̱bifabii hũ huruhuruo̱.

english_verse: Those who are evil say to God All-Powerful, “Leave us alone! Don't bother us with your teachings.
translation_verse: kẽle̱ ame̱kē̱o̱ Mawu ake̱; Dše wo̱no̱, edšake̱ wo̱taoo ogbè̱i le̱ wo̱le!

english_verse: What do we gain from praying and worshiping you?
translation_verse: Namo dši Ofe le̱, ni wo̱o̱súmo̱le̱? ni kē̱ wo̱kpale̱ fai hũ, meni wo̱baná ye̱ mli?

english_verse: We succeeded all on our own.” And so, I keep away from them and their evil schemes.
translation_verse: Na, dšee ame̱dientše̱ ame̱deṅ ame̱-edšũrõyeli yo̱; *meifõdši aṅāwõ le̱ akagbalemi fō̃ṅfō! *

english_verse: How often does God become angry and send disaster and darkness to punish sinners?
translation_verse: Šii enyie meifõdši *akane egbo, ni ame̱šrã hũ ebašrãame̱ pēṅ? alo Nyoṅmo̱ †edša amanehũlũ ehãame̱ ye̱ emlifũ mli? *

english_verse: How often does he strike them like a windstorm that scatters straw?
translation_verse: ame̱tamo̱ dſe̱i ye̱ kō̱yo̱ na, ke̱ tutū ní ahum lōo̱ ke̱-yaä? Lal.

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful force them to drink their own destruction from the cup of his anger.
translation_verse: Hã le̱dientše̱ ehĩṅme̱ii ana ehĩe-kpãtãmo le, ni enu Ofe le̱ mlifũ le eko!

english_verse: Because after they are dead, they won't care what happens to their children.” Who Can Tell God What To Do?
translation_verse: Ši mẽ mīše̱ enáa ye̱ ewe ní ešĩ ye̱ ese̱ le̱ he, beni enyõdši ayibo̱ le̱ se̱ efo le̱?

english_verse: Who can tell God what to do? He judges powerful rulers. *
translation_verse: Aso moko aatšõ Mawu nilē, le̱ *moṅ ní ekodšoo̱ ṅweibii le̱? *Dšadš.

english_verse: while others die in poverty, having known only pain.
translation_verse: Ni moko hũ gboo̱ ye̱ esusuma aw̌ere̱hō mli, ni esako enā nõkpakpa ko dã.

english_verse: But we all end up dead, beneath a blanket of worms.
translation_verse: Ame̱fẽ le̱, sũ mli noṅṅ ame̱wo̱ō̱, ni gõgõmĩĩ haä ame̱he.

english_verse: My friends, I know that you are plotting against me.
translation_verse: Na, mile nyedſẽṅmo̱i le̱, ke̱ ṅã ní nyetšṍo̱ nyeke̱-waämi yi le̱.

english_verse: You ask, “Where is the home of that important person who does so much evil?”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nyekē̱o̱ ake̱: Nẽgbe̱ no̱yelo̱ yiwalo̱ le̱ we le̱ yo̱? Ni nẽgbe̱ bū ní meifõdši hĩ mli le̱ yo̱?

english_verse: that those who do wrong never suffer disaster, when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: Ake̱ abaa mofõṅ yi ye̱ amanehũlũ gbĩ no̱, ni grimo̱ gbĩ no̱ le̱ adšieo̱ame̱ ke̱-dse̱o̱ mli!

english_verse: No one points out their sin or punishes them.
translation_verse: Namo aakã ehĩe ye̱ edšeṅba le̱ hewo̱? Ni noni efe le̱, namo aawole̱ he nyõmo̱?

english_verse: Then at their funerals, they are highly praised;
translation_verse: Asaṅ atẽreo̱le̱ ke̱-foo̱ ši ke̱-yaä egbonyobu le̱ he, ni abuo̱ esãṅ le̱ he tete.

english_verse: But empty, meaningless words are the comfort you offer me.
translation_verse: Mẽba nyeše̱dseo̱ mimī ke̱ yaka mīše̱dšemo̱? edšake̱ nyehetōi le̱ apasa so̱ṅṅ ni!

english_verse: If you were completely sinless, that would still mean nothing to God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ani ké̱ dšalo̱ dšio le̱, Ofe le̱ náa se̱ ko ye̱ mli? alo ké̱ oha ogbè̱i le̱ ye emū le̱, enáa noko ye̱ mli?

english_verse: To guarantee payment of a debt, you have taken clothes from innocent people.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ oheo̱ awaba ye̱ onyemimei adeṅ yakatſā, ni heyayaiatše̱mei hũ o kplaä ame̱he mamai.

english_verse: That's why you were suddenly trapped by terror,
translation_verse: Nohewo le̱ tšõnei ebo̱leo ke̱-kpe, ni ṅmiṅmi mõo̱o trukā!

english_verse: God lives in the heavens above the highest stars, where he sees everything.
translation_verse: Nto Nyoṅmo̱ kwo̱ fè ṅwei? Ni kwe̱ ṅulamii akwo̱le̱, bo̱ni ame̱kwo̱ ame̱hã!

english_verse: Do you think the deep darkness hides you from God?
translation_verse: Nĩ okē̱o̱ ake̱: Meni Mawu le? Ani eenyẽ etšṍ duṅ kpī ne̱ mli ekodšo?

english_verse: They rejected God All-Powerful, feeling he was helpless,
translation_verse: Mei ni kē̱ Mawu ake̱: Dše wo̱no̱! Ni asaṅ: Meni Ofe le̱ aanyẽwo̱ afe le?

english_verse: saying, “Our enemies are gone, and fire has destroyed their possessions.” Surrender to God All-Powerful
translation_verse: ame̱kē̱o̱ ake̱: “Le̱le̱ṅ mei ní te ši wowo̱ le̱ akpãtã ame̱hĩe, ni ame̱nii ni ſe̱ le̱, la ešā.”

english_verse: Listen to his teachings and take them to heart.
translation_verse: Nohewo le̱ mõ nitšõmo̱ ni dšeo̱ enā le̱ mli, ni oṅõ ewiemo̱i le̱ oto otšuiṅ!

english_verse: If you return to God and turn from sin, all will go well for you.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši okũ ose̱ ke̱-te Ofe le̱ ṅõ le̱, aatſao amã ši; ke̱dši oodšie musunii ke̱-dše obu le̱ṅ ke̱-ya nenēne le̱ —

english_verse: So get rid of your finest gold, as though it were sand.
translation_verse: ṅõ ošikasũ le̱ owo mlu mli, ni oke̱ *Ofir šika awo fāi amli tei amli! — *

english_verse: and you will find happiness by worshiping him.
translation_verse: No le̱ *omli aaflio ye̱ Ofe le̱ he, ni oowó ohĩe no̱ ohã Nyoṅmo̱. *Lal.

english_verse: God will answer your prayers, and you will keep the promises you made to him.
translation_verse: Ookpale̱ fai, ni eeboö toi, ni oowo ošiwōi le̱ anyõmo̱. Lal.

english_verse: He will do whatever you ask, and life will be bright.
translation_verse: Ooto oyiṅ ye̱ noko hewo̱, ni aahã aba mli ahão; ni la aakpe ye̱ ogbē̱i le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: When others are disgraced, God will clear their names in answer to your prayers.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši ame̱mīmã ame̱nã ši le̱, ookē̱: Aawo no̱! ni hešibalo̱ le̱, aahere eyi wala.

english_verse: Even those who are guilty will be forgiven, because you obey God.
translation_verse: Moni yee bem tete le̱, aadšiele̱: aadšiele̱ ye̱ odeṅ tšemo̱ nā. Lal.

english_verse: Today I complain bitterly, because God has been cruel and made me suffer.
translation_verse: Nme̱ne̱ hũ miko̱mo̱yeli le̱ nā wa; mimanehũlũ le̱ tšī fè mitšo̱idōmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Then I would discover what he wanted to say.
translation_verse: Mana wiemo̱i ni eke̱-ato he ehãmi, ni manu nii ní eekē̱mi le̱ ašiši!

english_verse: Would he overwhelm me with his greatness? No! He would listen
translation_verse: Aso eke̱mi aabé ye̱ ehewale̱ kpeteṅkple le̱ nā? Dabi, toi noṅṅ kẽ eebomi!

english_verse: because I am innocent, and he would say, “I now set you free!”
translation_verse: Dše̱i moni dša le̱ ke̱le̱ aayiyi ye̱, ní madše mikodšolo̱ le̱ deṅ kwrakwra.

english_verse: I cannot find God anywhere— in front or back of me,
translation_verse: Na, ké̱ mite hĩegbe̱ le̱, ebe dše̱i; ké̱ miba se̱gbe̱ hũ, minuu ehe;

english_verse: to my left or my right. God is always at work, though I never see him.
translation_verse: etšuo̱ nii ye̱ abe̱kuiaṅ, ši minaale̱; etēo̱ ehe ye̱ ninedšũrõgbe̱, ši mihĩṅme̱i gbaa eno̱.

english_verse: But he knows what I am doing, and when he tests me, I will be pure as gold. *
translation_verse: Ši ele gbe̱ ní minyie no̱ le̱; ké̱ ekami ekwe̱ le̱, madšie mihe ši tamo̱ šika. Lal.

english_verse: I have never refused to follow any of his commands,
translation_verse: Minane emõ ši ye̱ enanemā̃hei le̱ amli; minyie egbe̱ le̱ no̱ ni midšee no̱.

english_verse: and I have always treasured his teachings.
translation_verse: Kitã ni dše̱ enā le̱, midšeko se̱; edāṅ wiemo̱i le̱ mike̱-to fè mimla.

english_verse: But he alone is God, and who can oppose him? God does as he pleases,
translation_verse: Ši le̱ le̱ eye̱ bo̱ni eyo̱ le̱ noṅṅ, ni namo aakũ enā? Noni esusuma taoo̱ le̱, no efeo̱.

english_verse: and he will do exactly what he intends with me. *
translation_verse: Noni ato ahãmi le̱, no efeo̱ le̱, ni nibii ní tamo̱ ene̱mei pī ye̱ eyiṅ.

english_verse: Merely the thought of God All-Powerful
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ ṅmiṅmi mõo̱mi ye̱ ehĩe; ké̱ miſie miyiṅ le̱, mišeo̱le̱ gbeyei.

english_verse: God has covered me with darkness, but I refuse to be silent.
translation_verse: Ši mito̱ko mú ye̱ mimanehũlũ le̱ lo duṅ kabitī ní eha mihĩe le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: Sinners remove boundary markers and take care of sheep they have stolen.
translation_verse: Atšire̱o̱ hũsũi, ašõo̱ koloikui ekã nā ni alè̱o̱ame̱.

english_verse: They cheat orphans and widows by taking their donkeys and oxen.
translation_verse: Akplaä awusãi atedši ke̱-yaã, ni aheo̱ okũlafo tšina awaba.

english_verse: If they want grain or grapes, they must go to the property of these sinners.
translation_verse: Ṅmõ mli ame̱flo̱ō̱ ame̱koloi aniyenii ye̱, ni ame̱yeo̱ kpe̱kpe̱o ye̱ mofõṅ weintrom mli.

english_verse: and during a storm their only shelters are caves among the rocky cliffs.
translation_verse: Gõdši ano̱ nyoṅmo̱ yio̱ame̱, ni ake̱-ni ame̱be̱ abobāhe hewo le̱, ame̱ho̱lo̱ö̱ te̱sāi ašiši.

english_verse: Children whose fathers have died are taken from their mothers as payment for a debt.
translation_verse: Ame̱tšeo̱ awusã ye̱ fufo̱ nā, ni ame̱-heo̱ awaba ye̱ ohĩafo deṅ.

english_verse: Then they are forced to work naked in the grain fields because they have no clothes, and they go hungry.
translation_verse: Ame̱nyienyieo̱ yayai ni mama be̱ ame̱he, ni ame̱ke̱ hõmo̱ tereo̱ abledšatšui. Ies.

english_verse: They crush olives to make oil and grapes to make wine— but still they go thirsty.
translation_verse: Ame̱gbogboi ateṅ ame̱feo̱ mũ ye̱; ame̱nānāa weinṅã̀tšõnei, ši *kũmai yeo̱ame̱. *Iak.

english_verse: And along the city streets, the wounded and dying cry out, yet God does nothing. Some Reject the Light
translation_verse: Mei dõmoo̱ ntšo̱i ke̱-dše̱o̱ mãdši amli, ni pilafoi asusuma blo̱ö̱; ši kẽle̱ Nyoṅmo̱ edii nakai nõša le̱ se̱.

english_verse: Soon after sunset they murder the poor and the needy, and at night they steal.
translation_verse: Awuyelo̱ teo̱ ši lebi mrã egbeo ohĩafo ke̱ šitſialo̱, ní nyõṅ le̱ etamo̱ dšulo̱ noṅṅ.

english_verse: Others wait for the dark, thinking they won't be seen if they sleep with the wife or husband of someone else.
translation_verse: Ni gblãfitelo̱ hũ hĩṅme̱i kwe̱o̱ hīebule̱ gbe̱, ekē̱o̱ ake̱: Hĩṅme̱i ko enaami! ni eke̱ no̱hānõ hũ haä ehĩe.

english_verse: Robbers hide during the day, then break in after dark because they reject the light.
translation_verse: Duṅ mli ame̱gbulo̱ö̱ tšũi ame̱woo̱ mli; ame̱woo̱ ame̱he tšũṅ ſane, ame̱lee la po.

english_verse: They prefer night to day, since the terrors of the night are their friends. Sinners Are Filthy Foam
translation_verse: Edšake̱ lebi tamo̱ gbĕlehō̃ṅ hãame̱; edšake̱ duṅ kpī ṅmiṅmii le̱ ehomo̱ame̱.

english_verse: Those sinners are filthy foam on the surface of the water. And so, their fields and vineyards will fall under a curse and won't produce.
translation_verse: *Ehoo̱ oyá ye̱ nu hĩe; alomo̱ ame̱-gbe̱fãṅnõ le̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, etšṍṅ ehĩe ke̱-yaṅ weintromi agbe le̱ no̱. *

english_verse: Just as the heat of summer swallows the snow, the world of the dead swallows those who sin.
translation_verse: Dšeṅ hereṅṅ ke̱ latšā hãa snō nui le̱ tãa, nakai noṅṅ gbohĩĩadše hũ lōo̱ mei ní feo̱ eša le̱.

english_verse: Forgotten here on earth, and with their power broken, they taste sweet to worms.
translation_verse: Enye mũsũ tete hĩe kpaä eno̱; gõgõmii nyã́a eyeli he. Akaiṅle̱ kwrakwra doṅṅ; ni aakũ nõfõṅ tamo̱ tšo.

english_verse: Sinners take advantage of widows and other helpless women.
translation_verse: Ehaã yō kene ní fo̱o̱ le̱ nii, ni yō okũlafo hũ, efeele̱ edšũrõ.

english_verse: But God's mighty strength destroys those in power. Even if they seem successful, they are doomed to fail.
translation_verse: Kẽle̱ Nyoṅmo̱ tšṍo̱ ehewale̱ no̱ ehãa hewalo̱i yaä no̱; ame̱teo̱ ši, beni ame̱hĩe kãã wala no̱ doṅṅ le̱.

english_verse: God may let them feel secure, but they are never out of his sight.
translation_verse: Ehãa ame̱hĩo̱ ši ſeſēſe, ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱he fõo̱ no no̱; ši ehĩṅme̱ii dſere ame̱-gbè̱i le̱ ano̱ kẽ.

english_verse: Great for a while; gone forever! Sinners are mowed down like weeds, then they wither and die.
translation_verse: Awóo̱ ame̱no̱, ši be fiõ se̱ le̱ ame̱be̱; ame̱plenẽ, ni abuaä ame̱nā tamo̱ mei fẽ, ni aflo̱ö̱ame̱ tamo̱ abletšei ayiteaṅ.

english_verse: If I haven't spoken the truth, then prove me wrong.
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱ ké̱ dšee nakai le̱, namo aake ake̱ mimale, ni eehã miwiemo̱ le̱ afe yaka?

english_verse: Who can count his army of stars? Isn't God the source of light?
translation_verse: Ani etai le̱ anyẽ akane? ni ela le̱, namo no̱ etee ši ye̱?

english_verse: To him, not even the light of the moon and stars can ever be pure.
translation_verse: Na, nyoṅtšēre tete kpe̱e̱, ni ṅulamii hũ ahe tšee ye̱ ehĩe:

english_verse: So how can we humans, when we are merely worms?
translation_verse: mbasroo ádesã ní dši omlẽgẽ ne̱, lo gbomo bi ní dši gõgõmi ne̱!

english_verse: You have really been helpful to someone weak and weary.
translation_verse: Ei, bo̱ni oyeo̱ obuaä moni be̱ hewale̱ le̱ ne̱! bo̱ni ohereo̱ nine ní mli waa le̱ ne̱!

english_verse: How can anyone possibly speak with such understanding?
translation_verse: Namo owieo̱ otšõo̱? ni namo mumo̱ dšeo̱ omli dšeo̱ kpo ne̱?

english_verse: Remember the terrible trembling of those in the world of the dead below the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Sisai le̱ ahe kpokpoo̱ ye̱ nui le̱ ašiši ke̱ dše̱ibii le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: Nothing in that land of death and destruction is hidden from God,
translation_verse: Gbohĩĩadše kã ši yayai ye̱ ehĩe, ni lãdšemo̱bu le̱ be̱ no̱hānõ. Abe̱i

english_verse: who hung the northern sky and suspended the earth on empty space.
translation_verse: Elē̱o̱ kōyigbe̱ ṅwei le̱ mli etšotšŏroo̱ kō̱yo̱ mli, eṅõo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ etšotšŏroo̱ ši ní dšee noko no̱.

english_verse: and he wraps them around the face of the moon.
translation_verse: Etšĩo̱ emaṅtše̱sẽi le̱ hĩe, ni elē̱o̱ etatu le̱ mli ehaã no̱.

english_verse: And columns supporting the sky tremble at his command.
translation_verse: Ṅwei akulašĩṅi le̱ ahe kpokpoo̱, ni ame̱he dšõo̱ ame̱he ye̱ eyiṅā̃ le̱ nā.

english_verse: By his power and wisdom, God conquered the force of the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Etaã ṅšo̱ le̱ mli ye̱ ehewale̱ nā, ni etſaä ehewõ le̱ nõ ye̱ enilē nā.

english_verse: The heavens became bright when he breathed, and the escaping sea monster died at his hands.
translation_verse: Emumo̱ le̱ nā le̱ ṅwei tšeo̱; enine gbuo̱ *onũfũ ní he yo̱ oyá le̱ mli. *Ies.

english_verse: These things are merely a whisper of God's power at work. How little we would understand if this whisper ever turned into thunder!
translation_verse: Na, egbè̱i le̱ anābunābui ke̱ke̱ ne̱, ni ehe able̱bi fiō ke̱ke̱ wo̱nuo̱ ne̱. Ši ehewale̱ šimo̱ le̱, namo aanu šiši?

english_verse: I am desperate because God All-Powerful refuses to do what is right. As surely as God lives,
translation_verse: Gbĩĩabo̱ kẽ ní Mawu ní tſa misane le̱ fõ le̱, ke̱ Ofe le̱ ní hã misusuma w̌ere̱ ho ehe le̱ hĩe kã ne̱: —

english_verse: Until the day I die, I will refuse to do wrong by saying you are right,
translation_verse: Ene̱ akagbalemi ake̱ mabunye bem; mibemyeli le̱ miṅmẽṅ he ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni magbo.

english_verse: because each day my conscience agrees that I am innocent.
translation_verse: Mihĩe midšale̱ le̱ mli kpẽṅṅ, ni miṅmẽṅ he; *mitšui hũ ewiee mihĩe ye̱ miwala gbĩĩ le̱ eko hewo. *Bo̱f.

english_verse: I pray that my enemies will suffer no less than the wicked.
translation_verse: Mihenye̱lo̱ le̱ aatšṍ tamo̱ mofõṅ, ni moni ete ši ewomi le̱ hũ aatšṍ tamo̱ nõšafelo̱!

english_verse: Such people are hopeless, and God All-Powerful will cut them down,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ meni dši mofõṅ hĩeno̱kãmo̱, beni Nyoṅmo̱ efole̱ eše̱ efō ni eṅõ esusuma ke̱-te? Luk.

english_verse: without listening when they beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Ké̱ fĩmo̱ ba eno̱ le̱, ani Nyoṅmo̱ aabo eblo̱mo̱ toi?

english_verse: And that is what God should do, because they don't like him or ever pray.
translation_verse: Ani emī še̱o̱ ye̱ Ofe le̱ hewo̱, alo etšé̱o̱ Nyoṅmo̱ befèbe?

english_verse: Now I will explain in detail what God All-Powerful does.
translation_verse: Matšõnye bo̱ni Mawu nine yo̱; noni yo̱ Ofe le̱ ṅõ le̱, mišiuṅ no̱.

english_verse: All of you have seen these things for yourselves. So you have no excuse. How God Treats the Wicked
translation_verse: Na, nyefẽ-tſẽm nyena; bĕle̱ mẽhewo̱ mo̱ ni nyedſẽṅo̱ yaka dſẽṅmo̱i ne̱?

english_verse: They may have many children, but most of them will go hungry or suffer a violent death.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši ebii ayi fá babaō le̱, klante ame̱fáa ame̱hāa; ni eſĭei le̱, abolo še̱ṅ ame̱nã.

english_verse: Others will die of disease, and their widows won't be able to weep.
translation_verse: Emei ni aaſe̱ le̱, aafũame̱ ye̱ gbĕlehela mli, ni ekũlafoi le̱ fóṅ tete.

english_verse: The wicked may collect riches and clothes in abundance as easily as clay.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši ebua dſie̱te̱i nā tamo̱ mlu, ni ebua atadei anā eto tamo̱ sũ po:

english_verse: But God's people will wear clothes taken from them and divide up their riches.
translation_verse: ebua nā moṅ, *ši dšalo̱ bawo, ni dſie̱te̱i le̱, mei ní he be̱ tõmo̱ le̱ badša mli. *Abe̱i

english_verse: No homes built by the wicked will outlast a cocoon or a shack.
translation_verse: Emãa etšũ tamo̱ kōkōſrãm, tamo̱ asese ni bulo̱ fe.

english_verse: Those sinners may go to bed rich, but they will wake up poor.
translation_verse: Ehoo̱ ekaa ši ake̱ niiatše̱, ši efeṅ nakai doṅṅ; egbleo̱ ehĩṅme̱ii, ši ebe̱ doṅṅ.

english_verse: Terror will strike at night like a flood or a storm.
translation_verse: Ṅmiṅmii lōo̱le̱ tamo̱ nu babaō, ahum dšuo̱le̱ ke̱-yaä nyōṅ.

english_verse: Then a scorching wind will sweep them away
translation_verse: Bokã kō̱yo̱ wóo̱le̱ ke̱-yaä, ni ebē̱o̱le̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ ehĩle̱he le̱.

english_verse: without showing mercy, as they try to escape.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱ aatšẽ ke̱-aba eno̱, ni ebāṅ eyi; eetao foi edše ke̱-dše̱ edeṅ.

english_verse: At last, the wind will celebrate because they are gone.
translation_verse: Mei aatſatſā ame̱dẽi awole̱, ni ame̱-akpã ble fĩfĩ ame̱awole̱ ke̱-adše̱ egbe̱he le̱.

english_verse: Far beneath the grain fields, fires are built to break loose those rocks
translation_verse: Šikpoṅ le̱, abolo dše̱o̱ mli; ši ešiši le̱ afukuo̱ tamo̱ noni la fe.

english_verse: But where is wisdom found?
translation_verse: Ši nẽgbe̱ aana nilē ye̱? ni nẽgbe̱ dši dſẽṅmo̱ hĩle̱he?

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than coral, jasper, or rubies.
translation_verse: Atsĩṅ tẽṅẽlẽo ke̱ ko̱li tã ye̱ ehĩe, ni ké̱ oná nilē le̱ efè adiagba.

english_verse: All the topaz of Ethiopia and the finest gold cannot compare with it.
translation_verse: Kuš *topasionte̱ le̱ ke̱le̱ yee egbo̱, ni aṅmẽẽ šika kro̱ṅṅ ake̱-hee. *

english_verse: It is hidden from human eyes and even from birds.
translation_verse: Ši aṅõ-tē hĩekãlo̱i fẽ ahĩṅme̱ii, aha no̱ hũ ye̱ ṅwei lofõdši ahĩe.

english_verse: God is the only one who knows the way to wisdom;
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱ dši moni le gbe̱ ní ake̱-yaä he, ni le̱ ele heni eyo̱. Abe̱i

english_verse: he alone sees everything beneath the heavens.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ le̱ ekwe̱o̱ ke̱-yaä šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbēhei le̱, ni enaä ṅwei šiši fẽ.

english_verse: When God divided out the wind and the water,
translation_verse: Ni eṅmẽ kō̱yo̱ tšīmo̱ eto, ni esusu *nu hũ eto ke̱ susumo̱nõ. *

english_verse: and when he decided the path for rain and lightning,
translation_verse: Beni ewo nyoṅmo̱ne̱mo̱ he akpo̱, ni edše gbe̱ ehã nyoṅmo̱šimo̱i asrawai le̱:

english_verse: he also determined the truth and defined wisdom.
translation_verse: no mli ena, ni edšadše etšõ eke̱-mã ši, ni etao mli pe̱pē̱pe̱.

english_verse: God told us, “Wisdom means that you respect me, the Lord, and turn from sin.”
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱ gbomo ake̱: Na, Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ gbeyeišemo̱ le̱, no dši nilē, ni efõṅ hedšē dši dſẽṅmo̱! Lal.

english_verse: I was in the prime of life, God All-Powerful was my closest friend,
translation_verse: bo̱ni miyo̱ ye̱ minikpamo̱ gbĩĩ le̱aṅ, beni Nyoṅmo̱ nanyobō̱ yo̱ mibū le̱ yi-teṅ le̱; Lal.

english_verse: and all of my children were nearby.
translation_verse: beni Ofe le̱ ke̱mi yo̱ lolo, ni mibii hũ ebo̱lemi ke̱-kpe le̱;

english_verse: My herds gave enough milk to bathe my feet, and from my olive harvest flowed rivers of oil. *
translation_verse: beni mike̱ fufo̱ ní efĩ fo̱ö̱ minãdšiaši, ni te̱sā mli hoo̱ mũ fāi hãami le̱;

english_verse: the young leaders stepped aside, *
translation_verse: oblahĩĩ naämi, ni ame̱tẽo̱ ame̱he, ni onukpai teo̱ ši damoo̱ ši;

english_verse: while the older ones stood
translation_verse: lume̱i tete fõo̱ wiemo̱, ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱nidši too̱ ame̱nā;

english_verse: and remained silent. Everyone Was Pleased
translation_verse: abladei agbē lādšeo̱, ni ame̱lile̱i kpe̱te̱o̱ ame̱dāṅ.

english_verse: Everyone was pleased with what I said and did.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši toi nu mihe pe̱ le̱, edšō̱o̱mi, ké̱ hĩṅme̱i nami le̱, ekafoo̱mi.

english_verse: When poor people or orphans cried out for help, I came to their rescue.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ohĩafo ní blo̱ö̱ tšé̱o̱ bualo̱ le̱, midšieo̱le̱, ke̱ awusã ke̱ moni be̱ moko ni yeo̱ buaäle̱ le̱.

english_verse: And I was highly praised for my generosity to widows and others in poverty.
translation_verse: Moni hīe heo̱ akpãtã le̱ dšō̱mo̱ baä mino̱, ni mihãa yō okũlafo tšui nyõo̱ emli.

english_verse: Kindness and justice were my coat and hat;
translation_verse: Dšalo̱ dši mimama ni mibu, midšale̱ saneyeli hũ tamo̱ atade yū ke̱ akekre.

english_verse: I was helpful to the blind and to the lame.
translation_verse: Mitšṍ hĩṅme̱ii mihã ſilafo, ni mi-tšṍ nādši mihã obubuafo.

english_verse: I was a father to the needy, and I defended them in court, even if they were strangers.
translation_verse: Mitšṍ *tše̱ mihã mei ni efĩame̱, ni moni mileele̱ po mitaoo esane mli; *

english_verse: When criminals attacked, I broke their teeth and set their victims free.
translation_verse: ni midſăraä mofõṅ kadā, ni mišõo̱ hānii ye̱ enyãnyõdši amli. Lal.

english_verse: I felt certain that I would live a long and happy life, then die in my own bed.
translation_verse: No mli le̱ mikē̱o̱ ake̱: Mike̱ mitšũ le̱ aagbo, ni mahã migbĩĩ le̱ afá tamo̱ šia.

english_verse: In those days I was strong like a tree with deep roots and with plenty of water,
translation_verse: Mišišifã le̱ nā egble ehã nu, ni bó̱ hũ wo̱ö̱ minidši le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: Everyone listened in silence to my welcome advice,
translation_verse: Mei boo̱mi toi ni ame̱kwe̱o̱mi gbe̱, ni ame̱feo̱ kpō ame̱boo̱ miṅāwō toi.

english_verse: and when I finished speaking, nothing needed to be said.
translation_verse: Ké̱ miwie le̱, moko ewiee doṅṅ, ni miyio̱ wiemo̱i miſieo̱ ame̱no̱.

english_verse: My words were eagerly accepted like the showers of spring,
translation_verse: Ame̱kwe̱o̱mi gbe̱ tamo̱ akwe̱o̱ nyoṅmo̱ne̱mo̱ gbe̱, ni ame̱gbe̱o̱ ame̱dāṅ hatō tamo̱ noni ame̱mĩmẽ gbo ne̱mo̱.

english_verse: and the smile on my face renewed everyone's hopes.
translation_verse: Ké̱ ame̱tšui miye le̱, miṅmõo̱ mitšõo̱ame̱, ni mihĩe ni kpe̱o̱ le̱, ame̱nyẽẽ ame̱hã afe to̱tō̱to̱.

english_verse: My advice was followed as though I were a king leading my troops, or someone comforting those in sorrow.
translation_verse: Mihala amegbe le̱ mihãame̱, ni mitá ši ake̱ ame̱yitšo, ni mitá ši tamo̱ maṅtše̱ ye̱ etai atoṅ, tamo̱ moko ni še̱dšeo̱ ṅko̱mo̱yelo̱i amī.

english_verse: Young people now insult me, although their fathers would have been a disgrace to my sheep dogs.
translation_verse: Ši agbe̱ne̱ mei ni miyeame̱ onukpa mĩṅmõmi, mei ní mibuu ame̱tše̱mei bo̱ni mike̱ame̱ aawo mitōiku he gbēi le̱ ateṅ le̱.

english_verse: And those who insult me are helpless themselves.
translation_verse: Ame̱ninešiwale̱ le̱, mē se̱ mibaná ye̱ mli? mei ní ame̱he wale še̱ṅ hekoheko ne̱!

english_verse: They gather tasteless shrubs for food and firewood,
translation_verse: ame̱tšere̱o̱ ṅõbāi ye̱ kow̌eii amli, ni bāisā šišifãi dši ame̱bolo.

english_verse: And like senseless donkeys they are chased away. Those Worthless Nobodies
translation_verse: obudãṅi abii ke̱ yakagbomei abii dšiame̱, ayiame̱ aſieame̱ ke̱-dše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Those worthless nobodies make up jokes and songs to disgrace me.
translation_verse: Ši agbe̱ne̱ mitšṍ ame̱dāṅ lala, ni mitšṍ ame̱fe̱oyeli wiemo po.

english_verse: They are hateful and keep their distance, even while spitting in my direction.
translation_verse: Ame̱nyãṅeo̱mi, ame̱gbla ame̱he ši ke̱-dše̱ mihe ke̱-te se̱ fle̱ṅṅ, ame̱hĩe gboo tete ake̱ *ame̱fẽ̀ ladšõ ame̱ſie mihĩe. *Mat.

english_verse: God has destroyed me, and so they don't care what they do.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ efẽne mikpã le̱, ni ebami ši; hewo le̱ ame̱še̱ manyofie̱ ame̱fõ ye̱ mihĩe.

english_verse: Without any help, they prevent my escape, destroying me completely
translation_verse: Ame̱fite mitempõṅi le̱, ame̱bo̱ mi-hĩekpãtãmo̱ he mo̱deṅ, tše̱ ame̱be̱ bualo̱ ko.

english_verse: Terror has me surrounded; my reputation and my riches have vanished like a cloud. I Am Sick at Heart
translation_verse: Ado̱ gbeyei nibii ayi ke̱-ba mino̱; ame̱lōo̱ mibladeyeli le̱ ke̱-yaã tamo̱ kō̱-yo̱ lōo̱ nii, ni midšũrõyeli hũ eho tamo̱ atatu.

english_verse: I am sick at heart! Pain has taken its toll.
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱ *afo̱se misusuma aſie ye̱ mimli, amanehũlũ gbĩĩ le̱ emõmo̱ mimli hũ. *Lal.

english_verse: Night chews on my bones, causing endless torment,
translation_verse: Nyōṅ tete agbulo̱ō̱ miwui le̱ ye̱ mimli, ní mei ni kpeo̱mi le̱ wo̱o̱.

english_verse: and God has shrunk my skin, choking me to death.
translation_verse: Emliwale̱ so̱ṅṅ ehã mitade le su etšake; efĩmi tamo̱ mifiaka kue̱.

english_verse: I beg God for help, but there is no answer; and when I stand up, he simply stares.
translation_verse: *Miblo̱ö̱ mĩtšé̱o̱o, ši ohereemi no̱; miteo ši midamoo̱ ši, ni okwe̱o̱mi gā̃. *

english_verse: stirring up a windstorm to toss me about.
translation_verse: Owomi otá kō̱yo̱ no̱, ni eke̱mi mīya, ni oosẽremi kwrakwra ye̱ ahum mli.

english_verse: Soon he will send me home to the world of the dead, where we all must go.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mile ake̱ oke̱mi bahã gbĕle ni dši šĩa ní hĩekãlo̱i fẽ yakpe ye̱ mli le̱.

english_verse: I mourned for the poor and those who suffered.
translation_verse: Ani mifóó mihãã moni yo̱ haomo̱ mli? ni moni efīle̱ le̱, ani esane edo̱o̱ misusuma?

english_verse: But when I beg for relief and light, all I receive are disaster and darkness.
translation_verse: Ši beni *mikwe̱o̱ nõkpakpa gbe̱ le̱, bĕle̱ nõfõṅ moṅ baä; ni beni mihĩe kã la no̱ le̱, bĕle̱ duṅ moṅ baä. *Ier.

english_verse: My stomach is tied in knots; pain is my daily companion.
translation_verse: Mimlinii tſaä ni ame̱fõõ; amanehũlũ gbĩĩ eninami.

english_verse: My days are dark and gloomy and in the city council I stand and cry out,
translation_verse: Mihe edĩ ke̱-nyie, ši dšee hũlũ nā; miteo̱ ši ye̱ asafo mli midamoo̱ ši ni miblo̱ö̱.

english_verse: making mournful sounds like jackals and owls.
translation_verse: Mitšṍ ṅãṅgbēi anyemi, ke̱ dugumayei ananyo.

english_verse: My only songs are sorrow and sadness.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ misaṅkũ le̱ etšṍ ṅko̱moyeli, ni mible̱ le hũ etšṍ yāfóloi agbē. Lal.

english_verse: then others can eat my harvest and uproot my crops.
translation_verse: no le̱ madũ nii, ni mokroko aaye; ni aafãmo̱ miṅmõšinii aſie.

english_verse: then let some stranger steal my wife from me.
translation_verse: no le̱ hã miṅã aw̌ie̱ aha mokroko, ni meikrokomei akoto eno̱;

english_verse: Otherwise, what answer would I give to God when he judges me?
translation_verse: no le̱ ké̱ Mawu te ši le̱, té mafe tēṅ? ni ke̱dši eba sramo̱ le̱, mẽ hetō mahāle̱?

english_verse: After all, God is the one who gave life to each of us before we were born. I Have Never Cheated Anyone
translation_verse: Ani dšee moni femi ye̱ mũsũṅ le̱ noṅṅ fele̱? ni dšee mokome šō wo̱fẽ ye̱ mũsũ mli? Ef.

english_verse: I have never cheated widows or others in need,
translation_verse: Ke̱dši mikãmã ohĩafoi nii ní ame̱-taoo, ni mihã okũlafo hĩṅme̱ii fe šrãkē,

english_verse: and I was praised for supplying woolen garments to keep them warm.
translation_verse: ke̱dši ehe̱ edšō̱ō̱mi, ni mito hetšo̱i hãã ehe afe kulō̱ le̱, —

english_verse: If I have ever raised my arm to threaten an orphan when the power was mine,
translation_verse: ke̱dši miwó minine no̱ ye̱ awusã ko ne̱, edšake̱ mina miyeli-ke̱-buamo̱ ye̱ *koi le̱ ši le̱: — *

english_verse: or taken pride in owning many possessions. *
translation_verse: ke̱dši minyá ake̱ minii ní miná le̱ fá, ni minine eše̱ nii babaō no̱ le̱, —

english_verse: I have never laughed when my enemies were struck by disaster.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši minyã́ ye̱ ošrã ní ešrã mihenye̱lo̱ le̱ hewo̱, ni mimli flimi, beni amanehũlũ eba eno̱ le̱, — Lal.

english_verse: Neither have I sinned by asking God to send down on them the curse of death.
translation_verse: ši miṅmẽẽ minābu gbe̱ ni efe eša, ni mike̱ lōmo̱ atao egbĕle; —

english_verse: No one ever went hungry at my house,
translation_verse: ke̱dši mišīabii le̱ ekē̱ē̱ ake̱: Wo̱teṅ namo yeko edeṅ lō eto̱ko dã! —

english_verse: Many have attempted to hide their sins from others— but I refused.
translation_verse: ke̱dši mitšĩmo̱ mino̱tõmo̱ le̱ no̱ tamo̱ Adam, ni miṅõ minõša le̱ mitē ye̱ mimīnā;

english_verse: And the fear of public disgrace never forced me to keep silent about what I had done. Why Doesn't God Listen?
translation_verse: edšake̱ mīše mei babaō le̱, ni wekumei ahĩegbē mīwo mihe gbeyei, ni mife diṅṅ ni midše̱e̱ mišĩnā le̱ nā midšee kpo le̱. —

english_verse: Why doesn't God All-Powerful listen and answer? If God has something against me, let him speak up or put it in writing!
translation_verse: Ō miná moko ni aabomi toi! Na, minine nā okadi ne̱! Ofe le̱ ato he ahãmi! Miná ni moni ke̱mi ená le̱ wolo ni eṅmã le̱ še̱ mideṅ!

english_verse: Then I would wear his charges on my clothes and forehead.
translation_verse: Kē̱ dšee mikõṅ mike̱-atſa, ni mike̱-afe akekre mafĩ miyi fī̃!

english_verse: And with my head held high, I would tell him everything I have ever done.
translation_verse: Kũle̱ matšõle̱ minãdšifãmo̱i ayiku-le̱, matši mabe̱ṅke̱le̱ tamo̱ lumo̱! —

english_verse: I have never mistreated the land I farmed and made it mourn.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši mišikpoṅ le̱ blo̱ womi, ni eno̱ akofii le̱ wo yăra šikōme le̱, —

english_verse: Nor have I cheated my workers and caused them pain.
translation_verse: ke̱dši miye eno̱ yibii ni miwoo he nyõmo̱, ni mihã nõtše̱mei le̱ lādše ame̱susuma le̱:

english_verse: If I had, I would pray for weeds instead of wheat to grow in my fields. After saying these things, Job was silent.
translation_verse: no le̱ ṅmā̃ nãdšiaṅ le̱ ahã ewo ṅmei, ni able nãdšiaṅ hũ ewo aṅlẽṅlẽi! Hiob wiemo̱i le̱ etã.

english_verse: He was also angry with Job's three friends for not being able to prove that Job was wrong.
translation_verse: emli wo la ewo enanemei etẽ le̱ hũ, edšake̱ ame̱náá hetō ko ame̱hā doṅṅ, ši kẽle̱ *ame̱bu Hiob fo̱. *

english_verse: Elihu was younger than these three, and he let them speak first.
translation_verse: Ni Elihu mẽ dãni eke̱ Hiob wie, edšake̱ ame̱yele̱ onukpa.

english_verse: But he became irritated when they could not answer Job,
translation_verse: Ši beni Elihu na ake̱ hetō ko be̱ hĩĩ etẽ le̱ anā doṅṅ le̱, emli wo la.

english_verse: and he said to them: I am much younger than you, so I have shown respect by keeping silent.
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱ Elihu, Barakel bi ni dši Buznyo le̱, here no̱ ni ekē̱: Gbekẽ dšimi, ši nye le̱, hĩĩmedši dšinye; hewo̱ le̱ miše gbeyei, ni mimĩĩ ni madšadše noni mile matšõnye.

english_verse: I once believed age was the source of wisdom;
translation_verse: Mikē̱ ake̱: *Gbĩĩ moṅ awie, nĩ afii babaō adšadše nilē atšõ! *

english_verse: Age is no guarantee of wisdom and understanding.
translation_verse: Dšee onukpai ni leo̱ nii, ni dšee hĩĩmedši hũ ni nuo̱ sane šiši.

english_verse: That's why I ask you to listen to me. I Eagerly Listened *
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ ní mikē̱: Nyeboami toi; ni mi hũ matšõ noni mile le̱.

english_verse: but not one of you proved Job to be wrong.
translation_verse: Hē̃, mibonye toi āhũ, ni na, nyeteṅ mokomoko be̱ ní kū wo Hiob nā, lo moni ehã ewiemo̱i le̱ ahetō.

english_verse: You shouldn't say, “We know what's right! Let God punish him.”
translation_verse: Nyekakē̱a ake̱: “Wo̱ná nilē; Mawu bakũ enā, ši dšee gbomo!”

english_verse: Job hasn't spoken against me, and so I won't answer him with your arguments.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, eke̱mi eyiyiko, ni asaṅ dšee nyewiemo̱i ne̱ mike̱-bato he mahãle̱.

english_verse: All of you are shocked; you don't know what to say.
translation_verse: Ame̱fe yā, ame̱náá hetō ame̱hā doṅṅ; wiemo̱ ko be̱ ame̱nā ní ame̱kē̱o̱.

english_verse: But am I to remain silent, just because you have stopped speaking?
translation_verse: Ake̱-ni mimẽ ní ame̱wiee, ni ame̱ damo̱ ši diṅṅ, ni ame̱hãã hetō ko doṅṅ hewo̱ le̱,

english_verse: No! I will give my opinion,
translation_verse: mi hũ makē̱ minõ, ni matšõ noni mile.

english_verse: because I have so much to say, that I can't keep quiet.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ miyi obõ ke̱ wiemo̱i; mumo̱ ní yo̱ mimli le̱ tšire̱o̱ miyise̱.

english_verse: I am like a swollen wineskin, and I will burst
translation_verse: Mimŭsũṅ tamo̱ wein ní afāko nā; etamo̱ weinto̱i hēi ní heo̱ afie̱.

english_verse: if I don't speak. *
translation_verse: Mawie, koni mana mumo̱he; ma gble minā, ni mahã hetō.

english_verse: I don't know how to be unfair or to flatter anyone—
translation_verse: Mikwe̱ṅ mokomoko hĩe, ni asaṅ mido̱ko̱n minā mihãṅ gbomo ko.

english_verse: if I did, my Creator would quickly destroy me!
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mileo minādo̱ko̱mo̱ ke̱ mo hãmo̱; kũle̱ bene̱ eſe̱ bibiō, ni mifelo̱ le̱ aaṅõmi ke̱-ate.

english_verse: Everything I will say
translation_verse: Na, agbe̱ne̱ migble minābu, milile̱i miwie ye̱ midāṅ.

english_verse: We each were made from clay, and God has no favorites,
translation_verse: Na, mike̱o ye egbo̱ ye̱ Mawu gbe̱fäṅ; mi hũ *sù noṅṅ ake̱-šõmi. *

english_verse: I have heard you argue
translation_verse: Le̱le̱ṅ, owie ye̱ mitoiiaṅ, ni minu owiemo̱i le̱ agbē ake̱:

english_verse: that you are innocent, guilty of nothing.
translation_verse: “Mihe tše ni no̱tõmo̱ ko be̱ mihe, miye bem, nõša ko be̱ mihe.

english_verse: that he has bound your feet and blocked your path.
translation_verse: ebo̱ minãdši apã, ni ehĩe kã migbè̱i le̱ fẽ he.”

english_verse: But, Job, you're wrong— God is greater than any human.
translation_verse: Na, mito he mahão: Ene̱ mli le̱ osane le̱ edšaa; edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ da āhũ fè ádesã.

english_verse: So why do you challenge God to answer you?
translation_verse: Mẽhewo̱ oke̱le̱ béo̱, edšake̱ enifemo̱-nii le̱ fẽ le̱ ebuu he akontā etšõõ moko?

english_verse: God does this to make us turn from sin and pride
translation_verse: koni ekpale gbomo ke̱-dše̱ enifemo̱-nii le̱ ahe, ni ebu ádesã he ye̱ hewō hewo̱. Lal.

english_verse: Sometimes we are punished with a serious illness and aching joints.
translation_verse: Agblaä etoi ke̱ pīmo̱i ye̱ esā no̱, ni ewuiaṅ nõnā le̱ nā wa,

english_verse: Merely the thought of our favorite food makes our stomachs sick,
translation_verse: āhū ní ewala nyāṅeo̱ abolo, ni noni kpo̱ö ewo̱lo̱mo tete, esusuma hio̱.

english_verse: and we become so skinny that our bones stick out.
translation_verse: Etãa lō ní ehĩĩ kwe̱mo̱; ewui ní tšutšu ní anaa le̱, dšeo̱ kpo;

english_verse: We feel death and the grave taking us in their grip.
translation_verse: ni esusuma be̱ṅke̱o̱ lādšemo̱bu le̱, ni ewala hũ be̱ṅke̱o̱ gbẽle bo̱foi le̱.

english_verse: One of a thousand angels then comes to our rescue by saying we are innocent.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ ke̱dši bo̱fo ní dši mlidamo̱lo̱ ko ye̱ hãle̱, mokome ye̱ mei akpe teṅ, ni eedšadše noni dša etšõ gbomo le, Heb.

english_verse: The angel shows kindness, commanding death to release us, because the price was paid.
translation_verse: ni enale̱ mo̱bo̱ ni ekē̱: Dšiemo̱le̱ ke̱-dše̱ lādšemo̱bu le̱ṅ yā mli; miná kpãtãmo̱nii le̱.

english_verse: Our health is restored, we feel young again,
translation_verse: No le̱ ehelo le̱ aatšṍ efó̱ fē gbekẽ nõ; eekũ se̱ eetšṍ oblanyo ekoṅ. Lal.

english_verse: and we ask God to accept us. Then we joyfully worship God, and we are rewarded because we are innocent.
translation_verse: Eekpa Nyoṅmo̱ fai hũ, ni eedrole̱, ni eena ehĩe ke̱ nyã́mo̱; ni eke̱ no aato ádesã dšale̱ le̱ nādšiaṅ.
