english_verse: When that happens, we tell everyone, “I sinned and did wrong, but God forgave me
translation_verse: No le̱ eela ye̱ mei able ni eekē̱. “Mife eša, ni noni dša le̱ mikõdõ, ši kẽle̱ atokomi nàdšiaṅ;

english_verse: and rescued me from death! Now I will see the light.”
translation_verse: moṅ edšie misusuma ke̱-dše̱ lādšemo̱bu le̱ṅ yā mli, ni miwala mina la.” K.

english_verse: God gives each of us chance after chance
translation_verse: Na, ne̱ke̱ nii ne̱ fẽ Mawu feo gbomo šii enyo̱ ke̱ šii etẽ,

english_verse: to be saved from death and brought into the light that gives life.
translation_verse: koni ekpale esusuma ke̱-dše̱ lādšemobu le̱ mli, ni wala la le̱ atšo ahãle̱. Lal.

english_verse: So, Job, pay attention and don't interrupt,
translation_verse: Ka otoi, Hiob, ní obomi toi; fe-mo̱ diō, ní mawie!

english_verse: though I would gladly listen to anything you say that proves you are right.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši oye̱ noko ni ookē̱ le̱, bĕle̱ to he ohãmi; wiemo̱, ši mītao bo bem mabu!

english_verse: Otherwise, listen in silence to my wisdom.
translation_verse: Ké̱ dšee nakai le̱, bĕle̱ bo moṅ bomi toi; femo̱ diō, ní matšõo nilē!

english_verse: But to tell the truth, Job is shameless!
translation_verse: Nē nū yo̱ ní tamo̱ Hiob ni nuo̱ musubō̱ tamo anuo̱ nu?

english_verse: If any of you are smart, you will listen and learn that God All-Powerful does what is right.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, nye mei ní nyeyo̱ dſẽṅmo̱, nyeboami toi: Ene̱ akagbale Mawu ake̱ eefe nõfõṅ, ke̱ Ofe le̱ hũ ake̱ eefe noko ní edšaa gbe;

english_verse: From the very beginning, God has been in control of all the world.
translation_verse: Namo tu šikpoṅ le̱ wo edeṅ? lo namo to dšeṅ mū le̱ fẽ šiši?

english_verse: If God took back the breath that he breathed into us,
translation_verse: Ke̱dši le̱dientše̱ ehe no̱ ke̱ke̱ edſẽṅo̱ ni ehã e-Mumo̱ ke̱ emumo̱ ni emūo̱ fẽ kpale ke̱-ba eṅõ le̱,

english_verse: we humans would die and return to the soil.
translation_verse: kũle̱ plenēmo̱ helo fẽ aaplenē ši-kome, ni gbomo aakũ se̱ atšṍ sũ ekoṅ.

english_verse: The mighty God is the one who brings about justice, and you are condemning him.
translation_verse: Aso moni nye̱o̱ dšale sane le̱, eenyẽ mei ano̱ eye? Alo oobu moni dša ní ehe wa le̱ fo̱?

english_verse: Indeed, God is the one who condemns unfair rulers.
translation_verse: Ani ake̱o̱ maṅtše̱ ake̱: “Yakagbomo dšio!” ke̱ lume̱i hũ ake̱: “Gbomei fõdsi dšinye”?

english_verse: And God created us all; he has no favorites, whether rich or poor.
translation_verse: Ahũ ní moni kwe̱e̱ onukpai ahĩe, ni ebuu niiatše̱ fè ohĩafo; edšake̱ enine-nā nitšumo̱ dši ame̱fẽ-kwa le̱.

english_verse: Even powerful rulers die in the darkness of night when they least expect it, just like the rest of us. God Watches Everything We Do
translation_verse: Trukā ame̱gboio̱, nyōṅ teṅ po: mei ahe kpokpoo̱ ni ame̱hoo̱ ke̱-yaä; ni alōo̱ hewalo̱i hũ ke̱-yaä, ní dšoe ádesã nine nā.

english_verse: And so, God doesn't need to set a time for judgment.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ehĩaale̱ ake̱ esra gbomo āhũ, dãni eya Mawu ṅõ ye̱ kodšomo̱ mli.

english_verse: Without asking for advice, God removes mighty leaders and puts others in their place.
translation_verse: Ekūmoo̱ hewalo̱i ní etaoo mli, ni eṅõo̱ meikrokomei etoo̱ ame̱nãdšiaṅ.

english_verse: He knows what they are like, and he wipes them out in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Nohewo le̱ ele ame̱nitšumoi le̱, ni ebutuo̱ame̱ nyõṅ, ni ame̱hĩe kpãtãa.

english_verse: And while others look on, he punishes them because they were evil
translation_verse: Eyio̱ame̱ tamo̱ ayio̱ meifõdši ye̱ heni mei fè aana;

english_verse: When God does nothing, can any person or nation find fault with him?
translation_verse: Ké̱ le̱ ēhã hedšo̱le̱ le̱, bĕle̱ namo aabu fo̱? ni ké̱ eke̱ ehĩe tē le̱, namo aanale̱? dšeṅmaṅ dšio, mokome dšio:

english_verse: But still, he punishes rulers who abuse their people.
translation_verse: beni afe ní mofõṅ akaye maṅtše̱, ni ekatšõ̀ maṅ le̱ tšõne.

english_verse: Job, you should tell God that you are guilty and promise to do better.
translation_verse: Ši ani moko ekē̱ Mawu ake̱: “Agbla mitoi, mifeṅ efõṅ doṅṅ;

english_verse: Then ask him to point out what you did wrong, so you won't do it again.
translation_verse: noni minaa le̱, tšõmo̱mi; ké̱ mife nõša dšiṅṅ, mifeṅ doṅṅ?”

english_verse: Do you make the rules, or does God? You have to decide— I can't do it for you; now make up your mind.
translation_verse: Ani bo̱ni ebatšo eto nãdšiaṅ ehã le̱, bo odeṅ ebadše̱? [hewo̱ ni eekē̱o ake̱:] ké̱ osumo̱o̱ ene̱ le̱, bĕle̱ bodientše̱ halamo̱ ye̱ minãdšiaṅ, ni ké̱ ole noko le̱, ké̱mo̱!

english_verse: Job, anyone with good sense can easily see
translation_verse: Mei ní yo̱ dſẽṅmo̱ aakē̱mi, ni nilelo̱-fẽ-nilelo̱ ní boo̱mi toi le̱ aake:

english_verse: that you are speaking nonsense and lack good judgment.
translation_verse: “Hiob le̱, dšee dſẽṅmo̱ eke̱-wie, ni ewiemo̱i le̱, nilē be̱ mli.

english_verse: So I pray for you to suffer as much as possible for talking like a sinner.
translation_verse: Miná ni aka Hiob ke̱-yaši nãgbē ye̱ hetōi ni ehã tamo̱ meifõdši le̱ ahewo̱!

english_verse: You have rebelled against God, time after time, and have even insulted us.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ eke̱ *musubō̱ efata ehe esa le̱ he; etſa edẽ tete ye̱ wo̱teṅ, ni ewie babaō eši Mawu.” *K.

english_verse: Don't you honestly believe it pays to obey him?
translation_verse: Edšake̱ okē̱o̱ ake̱: “Mẽ se̱ obaná? ni meni mibaná ye̱ he fè noni maná ye̱ ešafemo̱ mli le̱?”

english_verse: I will give the answers to you and your friends. *
translation_verse: Mi le̱ mahão ke̱ onanemei ní fata ohe le̱ hetō.

english_verse: Is any good you may have done at all helpful to him?
translation_verse: Ke̱dši odši dšalo̱ le̱, meni ohãale̱? lo meni enaa ye̱ odeṅ? Rom.

english_verse: But after their Creator helps them through hard times, they forget about him,
translation_verse: ši kẽle̱ moko ekē̱ē̱ ake̱: Nẽgbe̱ Nyoṅmo̱, mifelo̱ le̱, moni *hãa alaä lalai nyōṅ tete le̱, *Lal.

english_verse: God won't listen to the prayers of proud and evil people.
translation_verse: No le̱ ye̱ meifõdši ahewō hewo̱ le̱ ame̱blo̱ö̱, ši efoo mli.

english_verse: If God All-Powerful refuses to answer their empty prayers,
translation_verse: Hē̃, Mawu boo yakanii atoi, ni Ofe le̱ ebuu no. Ioh.

english_verse: he will surely deny your impatient request to face him in court.
translation_verse: Āhũ ní ookē̱ ake̱, onaale̱; sane le̱ kã ehĩe, hewo̱ le̱ mẽle̱ ke̱ke̱.

english_verse: Job, you were wrong to say God doesn't punish sin.
translation_verse: Ši agbe̱ne̱, ake̱-ni ewoko nyõmo̱ ye̱ emlifũ mli hewo̱ le̱, otšé̱o̱ ake̱ eyoo hewō kwrā! Dsads.

english_verse: Everything you have said adds up to nonsense.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ ni Hiob gbe̱o̱ edāṅ yakatſā, ni ehãa wiemo̱i ní nilē be̱ mli fáa le̱.

english_verse: Be patient a while longer; I have something else to say in God's defense.
translation_verse: Ṅmẽmi gbe̱ fiō, ni matšõo; ši miye̱ wiemo̱i lolo ni mibawie mahã Nyoṅmo̱.

english_verse: You can rest assured that what I say is true.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ano̱kwa, dšee amale dši miwiemo̱i le̱; moko ni le nii dšogbāṅ damo̱ ohĩe ne̱.

english_verse: The wicked are cut down, and those who are wronged receive justice.
translation_verse: Ehãã mofõṅ yi aná wala, ši mei ni naä amanehũlũ le, eyeo amesane ehãa-ame̱. Lal.

english_verse: God watches over good people and places them in positions of power and honor forever.
translation_verse: Edšiee ehĩṅme̱ii ye̱ dšalo̱ no̱, ši ehãa ame̱ke̱ maṅtše̱mei tráa sẽii ano̱ dā, ni ewóo̱ ame̱no̱ godšō.

english_verse: But when people are prisoners of suffering and pain, *
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši awoame̱ kõsõṅkõsõi, ni ake̱ amanehũlũ kpãi fĩmo̱ame̱ le̱:

english_verse: And if they obey, they will be successful and happy from then on.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši ame̱bo toi ni ame̱súmo̱le̱ le̱, ame̱aye ame̱gbĩĩ le̱ ye̱ edšũrõyeli mli, ke̱ ame̱fii le̱ hũ ye̱ tsuidšũrõ mli.

english_verse: But if they foolishly refuse, they will be rewarded with a violent death. Godless People Are Too Angry
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši ame̱boo toi le̱, ame̱aplenē ye̱ akplo̱ nā, ni ame̱leṅ nii ni ame̱agboi.

english_verse: Godless people are too angry to ask God for help when he punishes them.
translation_verse: Ši mei ní dši meifõdši ye̱ ame̱-tšuiiaṅ le̱ too̱ mlifũ, ké̱ efiame̱ le̱, ame̱-boo ame̱tšé̱é̱ bualo̱;

english_verse: So they die young in shameful disgrace.
translation_verse: ame̱gboio̱ ye̱ ame̱blahĩaṅ, ni ame̱-wala hũ hĩe kpãtãa tamo̱ adſamaṅbo̱lo̱i.

english_verse: Now that the judgment for your sins has fallen upon you,
translation_verse: Ši mofõṅ saneyeli eyi omli obõ, hewo̱ le̱ kodšomo̱ ke̱ dšale̱ saneyeli bamõo.

english_verse: Your reputation and riches cannot protect you from distress,
translation_verse: Aso onifále̱ le̱ dši noko ye̱ ehĩe, lo šika lo ohewale̱ mli nyẽmo̱ le̱ fẽ?

english_verse: nor can you find safety in the dark world below.
translation_verse: Kāfe nakai nyō le̱ṅ, beni alōo̱ mãdši ke̱-dše̱o̱ ame̱gbe̱he le̱!

english_verse: Be on guard! Don't turn to evil as a way of escape.
translation_verse: Kwe̱mo̱ ohe ní ahĩ ni okatšṍ ohĩe ohã nõša; edšake̱ ōsumo̱ ene̱ moṅ fè amanehũlũ!

english_verse: God's power is unlimited. He needs no teachers
translation_verse: Na, Mawu dše agbo ye̱ ehewale̱ le̱ mli; namo dši *tšõlo̱ tamo̱le̱? *Lal.

english_verse: to guide or correct him. Others Have Praised God
translation_verse: Namo aatšõle̱ gbe̱ ní enyie no̱? ni namo anyẽ akē̱le̱ ake̱: “Ofe noko ni edšaa”?

english_verse: Others have praised God for what he has done, so join with them.
translation_verse: Kaimo̱, ní okafo enitšumo̱ ní ádesãi laä ye̱ hewo̱ le̱!

english_verse: From down here on earth, everyone has looked up and seen
translation_verse: Mei fẽ mikwe̱; ádesã hũ naã ye̱ šoṅṅ.

english_verse: how great God is— God is more than we imagine; no one can count the years he has lived. *
translation_verse: Na, Mawu da, ni wo̱yokole̱; efii ayikule̱ le̱ hũ anaṅ nā.

english_verse: God gathers moisture into the clouds
translation_verse: Ke̱dši egbla nukulibii le̱, ame̱tšẽrẽo̱ nune̱mo̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ efua le̱ mli,

english_verse: and supplies us with rain.
translation_verse: ni atatui fo̱seo̱ fieo̱ ši, ni eſieo̱ gbomei pī ano̱.

english_verse: Who can understand how God scatters the clouds and speaks from his home in the thunderstorm?
translation_verse: Ani moko aanyẽ ana atatui amli lē̱mo̱ ke̱ nyoṅmo̱šimo̱i ni dše̱ ebu le̱ mli le̱ nā? Lal.

english_verse: And when God sends lightning, it can be seen at the bottom of the sea.
translation_verse: Na, egbe̱o̱ ela le̱ mli ehaã ehe, ni ehaä ṅšo̱ šiši. Lal.

english_verse: By producing such rainstorms, God rules the world and provides us with food.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ no eke̱-kodšoo̱ mãdšimãdši le̱, no noṅṅ eke̱-hãa niyenii babaō.

english_verse: Each flash of lightning is one of his arrows striking its target,
translation_verse: Eke̱ la haä enidši ahe, ni ewoo̱le̱ kitã ešio̱ henye̱lo̱ le̱.

english_verse: and the thunder tells of his anger against sin.
translation_verse: Ešimo̱ gbē̱mo̱ le̱ gbaä ebe sane, kolokui tete gbaä ake̱ ēba.

english_verse: I am frightened and tremble all over,
translation_verse: Hē̃, ene̱ hewo̱ mitšui tſaä, ni etšio̱ ehe ke̱-dše̱o̱ egbe̱he le̱.

english_verse: when I hear the roaring voice of God in the thunder,
translation_verse: Nyeboa egbē le̱ hōfemo̱ ke̱ gbē̱mo̱ hū ní dše̱o̱ edāṅ le̱ toi! Lal.

english_verse: and when I see his lightning flash across the sky.
translation_verse: Ehãa eyaã ṅwei mū le̱ fẽ šiši, ni ekpe̱mo̱ le̱ hũ yaä šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbẽhei le̱.

english_verse: creating miracles too marvelous for us to understand.
translation_verse: Mawu ke̱ egbē šimoo̱ ní eye̱ nākpe̱, efeo̱ nibii wudši kplei hũ, ni wo̱naa nā.

english_verse: make us stop and think about God's power,
translation_verse: Eso̱oo̱ gbomo-fẽ-gbomo nine nā, koni ádesãi fẽ aná ale enitšumo̱ le̱.

english_verse: and they force animals to seek shelter.
translation_verse: Ṅãṅ koloi yaä ame̱buiaṅ, ni ame̱hĩo̱ ame̱hĩle̱hei le̱. Lal.

english_verse: and the breath of God freezes streams and rivers.
translation_verse: Mawu mumo̱ ní emūo̱ le̱ nā le̱ nu fĩo̱, ni nui ni lē̱ le̱ feo bloblo.

english_verse: Rain clouds filled with lightning appear at God's command,
translation_verse: Eke̱ nu tēreo̱ atatui, egbe̱o̱ ela atatui le̱ amli.

english_verse: to release their cargo— sometimes as punishment for sin, sometimes as kindness. Consider Carefully
translation_verse: gbĩĩ komei le̱ ehãa ebaä ake̱ tšo̱semo̱tšo, ké̱ ešikpoṅ le̱ mihe nakai le̱, gbĩĩ komei hū ebaä ake̱ dšō̱mo̱.

english_verse: Job, consider carefully the many wonders of God.
translation_verse: Bo ene̱ toi, Hiob! Ni odamo̱ ši diṅṅ, ni odſẽṅ Mawu nākpe̱ nitšumo̱i le̱ ahe!

english_verse: Can you explain why lightning flashes at the orders
translation_verse: Ani ole be mli ní Nyoṅmo̱ fã́a ni ehãa la kpe̱o̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ etatu le̱ṅ le̱? Y.

english_verse: of God who knows all things? Or how he hangs the clouds in empty space?
translation_verse: Ani ole bo̱ni atatui se̱ṅ ši, ni dši moni le nii ke̱-wula ši le̱ nākpe̱ nitšumo̱ le̱?

english_verse: You almost melt in the heat of fierce desert winds when the sky is like brass.
translation_verse: bo̱ni otadei amli do̱ö̱ la, beni ehã šikpoṅ efe kpō ye̱ wuoyigbe̱ kō̱yo̱ nā le̱?

english_verse: God can hammer out the clouds in spite of the oppressive heat, but can you?
translation_verse: Ani oke̱le̱ lē̱o̱ atatui le̱ ní mamo̱ ši šiṅṅ tamo̱ aſiſe̱ ni aſie le̱ amli?

english_verse: Tell us what to say to God! Our minds are in the dark, and we don't know how to argue our case.
translation_verse: Tšõmo̱wo̱ noni wo̱kē̱le̱! Edšake̱ he duṅ le̱ hewo̱ le̱ wo̱nyẽṅ noko no̱ mĩ́ wo̱mã.

english_verse: Should I risk my life by telling God that I want to speak?
translation_verse: Aso aagbale̱ ake̱ mibawie? alo moko mīsumo̱ ake̱ akpãtã ehīe?

english_verse: No one can stare at the sun after a breeze has blown the clouds from the sky.
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱ anaa la ní kpe̱o̱ he̱ṅṅ ye̱ atatui ase̱ le̱; ši ké̱ kō̱yo̱ baho le̱, ehãa emli tšeo̱.

english_verse: Yet the glorious splendor of God All-Powerful is brighter by far.
translation_verse: Kōyigbe̱ ni šika dše̱o̱ ke̱-baä, ši Nyoṅmo̱ he yo̱ anumnyam ní yo̱ gbeyei.

english_verse: God cannot be seen— but his power is great, and he is always fair.
translation_verse: Ofe le̱, wo̱ninaale̱, ehewale̱ teke no̱; ši ekõdõõ kodšomo̱ ko̱ dšalo̱ ní fá.

english_verse: And so we humans fear God, because he shows no respect for those who are proud and think they know so much.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ ádesāi ašele̱ gbeyei; mei fẽ ni buo̱ ame̱he nilelo̱i le̱ ebuuame̱.

english_verse: Why do you talk so much when you know so little?
translation_verse: Namo dši moni hãa ṅāwō woo̱ duṅ ke̱ wiemo̱i ní nilē be̱ mli ne̱?

english_verse: Now get ready to face me! Can you answer the questions I ask?
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ mĩamo̱ ohe̱ tamo̱ nū: koni mabio, ni otšõmi!

english_verse: Doubtless you know who decided its length and width.
translation_verse: Aso ole *moni to esusumo̱i? lo moni ṅmõ kpa ye̱ no̱? *Abe̱i

english_verse: What supports the foundation? Who placed the cornerstone,
translation_verse: Meni mli aṅõ ešišinii le̱ atše̱ke̱? lo namo to ekoṅte̱ le̱,

english_verse: Did you ever tell the sun to rise? And did it obey?
translation_verse: Ani oba dšeṅ ne̱ ofã́ ni dše etše̱re pẽṅ, alo otšõ hũlũ hāigblamo̱ egbe̱he,

english_verse: Did it take hold of the earth and shake out the wicked like dust from a rug?
translation_verse: ni emõ šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbẽhei le̱ amli, ni ahwãnyã meifõdši ke̱-dše̱ no̱ aſie?

english_verse: Early dawn outlines the hills like stitches on clothing or sketches on clay.
translation_verse: Etšakeo̱ tamo̱ nāso̱omo̱ dāgre, ni nibii fẽ māmoo̱ ši tamo̱ nii ní wo atade.

english_verse: But its light is too much for those who are evil, and their power is broken.
translation_verse: Ni ašõ meifõdši ala le̱ ke̱-dše̱ ame̱-deṅ, ni akũ nine ní awó no̱ le̱ mli.

english_verse: Have you seen the gate to the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Ani agble gbĕle agboi le̱ anā atšõo? lo ona gbĕlehō̃ṅ agbói le̱ hũ?

english_verse: And how large is the earth? Tell me, if you know!
translation_verse: Ani onaä šikpoṅ le̱ lē̱mo̱ le̱ nā? ke̱dši ole fẽ le̱, dšadšemo̱!

english_verse: Where is the home of light, and where does darkness live?
translation_verse: Nẽgbe̱ gbe̱ ní atšṍo̱ ke̱-yaä la hĩle̱he le̱ yo̱, ni duṅ hũ, nēgbe̱ egbe̱he le̱ yo,

english_verse: I'm certain you must be able to, since you were already born when I created everything.
translation_verse: Ole, edšake̱ no mli le̱ afo̱o, ni oye gbĩĩ babaō!

english_verse: Have you been to the places where I keep snow and hail,
translation_verse: Ani obote snō fiasei le̱ amli, lo ona nyoṅmo̱ṅte̱i afiasei le̱ pẽṅ,

english_verse: until I use them to punish and conquer nations?
translation_verse: nii ni mitšĩ nā mito toigblamo̱be, ke̱ *nõmo̱ ke̱ tawū gbĩ le̱? *Ios.

english_verse: Who carves out a path for thunderstorms? Who sends torrents of rain
translation_verse: Namo gbla nudšō̱i hã nyoṅmo̱ne̱mo̱, lo gbe ehā nyoṅmo̱šimo̱i asrawai le̱,

english_verse: Rain that changes barren land to meadows green with grass.
translation_verse: ni ehã ole̱ṅle̱ ke̱ šikpoṅ flo ato̱, ni esā ehã dſe̱fo̱ hẽ hũ akwẽ?

english_verse: Who is the father of the dew and of the rain?
translation_verse: Ani nyoṅmo̱ne̱mo̱ ye tše̱? alo namo fo̱ bó̱ kulibii le̱ hũ?

english_verse: Who gives birth to the sleet and the frost
translation_verse: Namo mũsũ mli nute̱ dše̱? ni namo fo̱ *ṅwei bó̱ ni efī hũ? Lal.

english_verse: that fall in winter, when streams and lakes freeze solid as a rock? Can You Arrange Stars?
translation_verse: Nu fĩo̱ tamo̱ te̱, ni bu kwo̱ṅkwo̱ṅ le̱ hĩe hũ kpe̱o̱.

english_verse: Can you arrange stars in groups such as Orion and the Pleiades?
translation_verse: Ani ofĩo̱ wuo̱-ke̱-ebii ke̱ tãṅkpēi? lo oonyë *oṅwẽ kpãi le̱ ofẽne? *

english_verse: Do you control the stars or set in place the Big Dipper and the Little Dipper?
translation_verse: Ani oonyẽ odšie ṅulamii ní kple̱o̱ ye̱ ame̱be mli? lo oonyẽ otšõ dšeṅkpawo ke̱ ebii le̱ agbe?

english_verse: Do you know the laws that govern the heavens, and can you make them rule the earth?
translation_verse: Ani ole ṅwei akpo̱i le̱? alo bo oto bo̱ni eye šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ehã?

english_verse: Can you order the clouds to send a downpour,
translation_verse: Ani bo owóo̱ ogbē no̱ ke̱-yaã atatuiaṅ, ni nu afua bahaä ohe le̱?

english_verse: or will lightning flash at your command?
translation_verse: Ani bo otšũo̱ srawai ni ame̱yaä, ni ame̱kē̱o̱o ake̱: Nawo̱! le̱?

english_verse: Did you teach birds to know that rain or floods are on their way?
translation_verse: Namo ke̱ nilē wo sabai amli? lo namo ke̱ dſẽṅmo̱ wo yitšoṅ?

english_verse: on the dry, lumpy soil?
translation_verse: ni akpo̱to̱ö̱ sũ afeo̱ ṅmo̱to̱, ni sũkukulii kpe̱te̱o̱ ame̱he le̱?

english_verse: When lions are hungry, do you help them hunt?
translation_verse: Ani bo omĩo̱ mīle̱lo ohãa dšatayō, ni ohãa dšatabii yeo̱ lō še̱o̱ ame̱nā le̱,

english_verse: Do you send an animal into their den?
translation_verse: beni *ame̱bumo̱ ame̱bui le̱ amli, ni ame̱ho̱lo̱ odo̱to̱i amli ame̱woo̱ ká le̱? *

english_verse: And when starving young ravens cry out to me for food, do you satisfy their hunger?
translation_verse: Namo sāa niyenii ehãa kwãkwãlabite, beni ebii le̱ blo̱ö̱ tšé̱o̱ Mawu, ni ame̱tšomloo̱ ní ame̱be̱ niyenii le̱? Lal.

english_verse: Soon their young grow strong and then leave to be on their own.
translation_verse: Ame̱bii le̱ náa hewale̱, ame̱draä ye̱ dſe̱iaṅ, ame̱dšeo̱ kpo ke̱-yaä ni ame̱kũũ ame̱se̱ ke̱-baa ame̱ṅõ doṅṅ.

english_verse: I alone help them survive in salty desert sand.
translation_verse: Moni miṅõ ṅã kplanā le̱ mife ewe, ni miṅõ mūkpoi ano̱ mife esihĩle̱hei le̱.

english_verse: They stay far from crowded cities and refuse to be tamed.
translation_verse: Eṅmõo̱ maṅ hōfemo̱ le̱; enuu kplalo̱ blo̱mo̱.

english_verse: Would a wild ox agree to live in your barn and labor for you?
translation_verse: Aso wuo aakplẽo súomo̱? alo eeba-wo̱ okoloi aniyeniianõ he?

english_verse: Could you force him to plow or to drag a heavy log to smooth out the soil?
translation_verse: Ani oonyẽ owo wuo kpã ni efe akofi? alo eeninẽ dšō̱i amli ke̱-anyie ose̱?

english_verse: Can you depend on him to use his great strength and do your heavy work?
translation_verse: Ani oke ohĩe aafo eno̱ ye̱ ehewale̱ ní fá le̱ hewo̱, ni oošĩ onitšumo̱ ohãle̱ lo?

english_verse: Can you trust him to harvest your grain or take it to your barn from the threshing place? An Ostrich Proudly Flaps Her Wings
translation_verse: Ani oohele̱ oye ake̱ eke̱ odūmo̱nii le̱ aaba ni eebua nā ewo oboṅo mli?

english_verse: An ostrich proudly flaps her wings, but not because she loves her young.
translation_verse: Duguma tſaä efĩdši amli ke̱ nyã́mo̱; aso bĕle̱ klitšo fĩdši lo tše̱dši ni?

english_verse: She abandons her eggs and lets the dusty ground keep them warm.
translation_verse: Ši ešĩo̱ ewo̱dši ye̱ šikpoṅ, ni ehãa ame̱he do̱ö̱ la ye̱ mlu mli,

english_verse: And she doesn't seem to worry that the feet of an animal could crush them all.
translation_verse: ni ehĩe kpaä no̱ ake̱ nane aadſăra-ame̱, lo ṅãṅ koloi anānā no̱.

english_verse: She treats her eggs as though they were not her own, unconcerned that her work might be for nothing.
translation_verse: Ewaä ebii le̱ ayi tamo̱ noni dšee enii ni; ké̱ ehaomo̱ le̱ fe yaka le̱, ešee gbeyei.

english_verse: I myself made her foolish and without common sense.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ehã nilē ebo̱le̱, ni dſẽṅmo̱ hũ, ehããle̱ eko.

english_verse: But once she starts running, she laughs at a rider on the fastest horse. Did You Give Horses Their Strength?
translation_verse: Beni ewó ehe no̱ ní ebadšo foi le̱, eṅmõo̱ okpo̱ṅo̱ ke̱ eno̱tálo̱.

english_verse: Did you give horses their strength and the flowing hair along their necks?
translation_verse: Ani bo ohã okpo̱ṅo̱ ehewale̱ le̱? bo owula ekue̱ ke̱ tšo̱i ní tſaä le̱?

english_verse: Did you make them able to jump like grasshoppers or to frighten people with their snorting?
translation_verse: Ani bo ohãa ehuluo̱ tamo̱ bālabi le̱? Etšinemo̱ gbē̱mo̱ hũ ye̱ gbeyei!

english_verse: Before horses are ridden into battle, they paw at the ground, proud of their strength.
translation_verse: Egbe̱o̱ ši ye̱ dšō̱ mli, ni enyã́a ye̱ ehewale̱ le̱ hewo̱, edšeo̱ kpo eke̱ tabiloi yakpeo̱.

english_verse: Laughing at fear, they rush toward the fighting,
translation_verse: Eṅmõo̱ gbeyeišemo̱, ni ehe kpokpoo, ni etšṍṍ ehe ye̱ klante nā.

english_verse: while the weapons of their riders rattle and flash in the sun.
translation_verse: Gãimlibii akotoku gbē̱o̱ woo̱le̱, akplo̱ ke̱ tawũnĩi ní kple̱o̱ nyeramnyeram le̱.

english_verse: Stirred by the distant smells and sounds of war, they snort in reply to the trumpet.
translation_verse: Šiiabo̱ ni te̱tre̱mantre̱ gbē̱o̱ le̱ ekē̱o̱ ake̱: Hūui! ni enuo̱ ta be fŭ ye̱ šoṅṅ, ke̱ asafoiatše̱mei ablo̱mo̱ ke̱ ošebō̱.

english_verse: Did you teach hawks to fly south for the winter? *
translation_verse: Ani bo onilē nā ni lālō̱ flikio̱ ke̱-yaä ṅwei, ni egbe̱o̱ efĩdšiaṅ ehãa wuoyigbe̱ le̱?

english_verse: where they can look down to spot their next meal?
translation_verse: Dše̱i edse̱o̱ etaoo̱ eniyenii; ehĩṅme̱ii naä nii ye̱ šoṅṅ.

english_verse: Then their young gather to feast wherever the victim lies.
translation_verse: Ebii le̱ hũ mũo̱ lá, ni *heni mei enyõnyõi ye̱ le̱, dše̱i eyo̱. *Hab.

english_verse: but you have argued that I am wrong. Now you must answer me.
translation_verse: .] Ani oonyẽ oke̱ tãṅkpē awo egugõṅ? lo oke̱ kpoṅ aagbu ekadā?

english_verse: Job said to the Lord:
translation_verse: .] Ani eekpao fai babaō? alo eke̱o aawie nādšo̱le̱ wiemo̱i?

english_verse: Who am I to answer you?
translation_verse: .] Ani eke̱o aakpãṅ ake̱ oṅõle̱ ofe otšũlo̱ ke̱-ya nāno̱ lo?

english_verse: I did speak once or twice, but never again.
translation_verse: .] Ani oke̱le̱ aaſe̱ tamo̱ ake loflõ ſe̱o̱, ni oofĩle̱ ohã oblayei lo?

english_verse: Then out of the storm the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: .] Ani wole̱i asafo aaye enā, ni ame̱adša mli ame̱hã dšrayelo̱i lo?

english_verse: Face me and answer the questions I ask!
translation_verse: .] Ani oonyẽ oke̱ akploi awo ehewodšiaṅ obõ? lo oke̱ lō-gbē akploi aawo eyitšoṅ?

english_verse: Are you trying to prove that you are innocent by accusing me of injustice?
translation_verse: .] Yata ehe okwe̱: ni ookai ta le̱, ni ofeṅ nakai doṅṅ!

english_verse: Do you have a powerful arm and a thundering voice that compare with mine?
translation_verse: Alo oye nine ni tamo̱ Mawu nõ, ni oonyẽ oši ke̱ gbē ní tamo̱ enõ le̱?

english_verse: If so, then surround yourself with glory and majesty. *
translation_verse: No le̱ oke̱ dale̱ ke̱ agbodšē awula ohe, ni oba kpe̱mo̱ ke̱ anumnyam!

english_verse: Show your furious anger! Throw down and crush
translation_verse: Še̱re̱mo̱ omlifù grimo̱i le̱ oſie; kwe̱mo̱ hewolo-fẽ-hewolo̱ hũ ni obale̱ ši!

english_verse: Wrap them in grave clothes and bury them together in the dusty soil.
translation_verse: Ṅõ ame̱fẽ otē sũ mli, ni ofĩmo̱ ame̱hleaṅ ye̱ tēmo̱he le̱,

english_verse: Do this, and I will agree that you have won this argument. I Created You
translation_verse: no le̱ mi hũ makafoö ake̱ oninedšũrõ ehere oyiwala!

english_verse: I created both you and the hippopotamus. It eats only grass like an ox,
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ kwe̱mo̱ nuṅſuo̱ ni mifele̱ ke̱o fẽ le̱; dſe̱i po eyeo tamo̱ tšina noṅṅ.

english_verse: but look at the mighty muscles in its body
translation_verse: Kwe̱mo̱ enyẽmo̱ ní yo̱ ehe̱ mli, ke̱ ehewale̱ hũ ní yo̱ ehewodšiaṅ fãi le̱ amli le̱.

english_verse: and legs. Its tail is like a cedar tree, and its thighs are thick.
translation_verse: Ekpaa elei mli tamo̱ tšenedru, atſẽtſẽ eſo̱dši amli fãi le̱.

english_verse: The bones in its legs are like bronze or iron.
translation_verse: Ewui tamo̱ akō̱ble ododobẽṅi, eṅmãwutšei tamo̱ adabãṅi.

english_verse: I made it more powerful than any other creature, yet I am stronger still.
translation_verse: Le̱ dši Mawu gbè̱i le̱ amli titri ko; moni fele̱ le̱ hãle̱ eklante.

english_verse: Undisturbed, it eats grass while the other animals play nearby. *
translation_verse: Ši gõdši baa niyenii hãale̱, ni ṅãṅ koloi fẽ yaſe̱o̱ ye̱ dše̱i.

english_verse: It rests in the shade of trees along the riverbank
translation_verse: Ekāa ṅmeitšei ašiši, ye̱ heni neṅ ke̱ ṅmiamo̱ yo̱ le̱.

english_verse: or hides among reeds in the swamp.
translation_verse: Nmeitsei haä eno̱ ke̱ ame̱hō̃ṅ le̱, ni fā nā kpãi hũ bo̱leo̱le̱ ke̱-kpeo̱.

english_verse: It remains calm and unafraid with the Jordan River rushing and splashing in its face.
translation_verse: Na, kē̱ fã le̱ nā wa tete, le̱ ehe kpokpoo; ké̱ Iordan yi ke̱-bata edāṅ po le̱, efeele̱ noko.

english_verse: There is no way to capture a hippopotamus— not even by hooking its nose or blinding its eyes.
translation_verse: Ani moko aanyẽ adše ehĩegbe̱ amõle̱? alo ake̱ tšõnei aagbulo̱ egugõṅ?

english_verse: Can you catch a sea monster by using a fishhook? Can you tie its mouth shut with a rope?
translation_verse: Na ehĩeno̱kãmo̱ le̱ efe yaka, nto ké̱ mo onale̱ pe̱, ke̱ke̱ le̱ ogbe ši;

english_verse: and weapons of bronze or iron are as useless as straw or rotten wood.
translation_verse: .] Ebuo̱ dade tamo̱ dſe̱i ní egbĩ, ke̱ akō̱ble hũ tamo̱ tšo ni ešra.

english_verse: Rocks thrown from a sling cause it no more harm than husks of grain. This monster fears no arrows,
translation_verse: .] Gãimlibi hũ woole̱ foi, akromia te̱i le̱ tšṍmoo̱ gbetšelii hãale̱.

english_verse: it simply smiles at spears, and striking it with a stick is like slapping it with straw.
translation_verse: .] Ebuo̱ tšokpoti tamo̱ gbetšeli, ni eṅmõo̱ akplo̱ gbē̱mo̱.

english_verse: As it crawls through the mud, its sharp and spiny hide tears the ground apart.
translation_verse: .] Emliši tamo̱ gbé̱kói ni nā ba; egbe̱o̱ mli tamo̱ gble̱mo̱nõ ye̱ ṅmo̱to̱ no̱.

english_verse: And when it swims down deep, the sea starts churning like boiling oil,
translation_verse: .] Ehãa bu kwo̱ṅkwo̱ṅ le̱ tſaä tamo̱ kukwe̱i, ṅšo̱ tete ekpo̱to̱ö̱ tamo̱ mũgbé̱.

english_verse: and it leaves behind a trail of shining white foam.
translation_verse: .] Ese̱ mò kpe̱o̱, bo̱ni moko aasusu ake̱ nu le̱ edše waṅ.

english_verse: No other creature on earth is so fearless.
translation_verse: .] Noko be̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ní tamo̱le̱; edšake̱ le̱ le̱ afele̱ ni etšui efãã.

english_verse: It is king of all proud creatures, and it looks upon the others as nothing.
translation_verse: .] Ebuu nokonoko ni kwo̱; le̱ dši koloi hewolo̱i fẽ amaṅtše̱.

english_verse: You asked why I talk so much when I know so little. I have talked about things that are far beyond my understanding.
translation_verse: *“Namo dši mone̱ ni ṅõo̱ ṅāwō tēo̱ ni nilē be̱ emli ne̱?” Nohewo̱ le̱ †midšadše noni minaa nā le̱, nii ni feo̱mi nākpe̱ tšṍ ní milee le̱. *

english_verse: I heard about you from others; now I have seen you with my own eyes.
translation_verse: Mitoi ke̱ke̱ mike̱-nu ohe; ši agbe̱ne̱ mihĩṅme̱i enao.

english_verse: Eliphaz, Bildad, and Zophar obeyed the Lord, and he answered Job's prayer. A Happy Ending
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Elifaz, Temannyo le̱, ke̱ Bildad, Šuhinyo le̱, ke̱ Zofar, Naamanyo le̱, yiṅ ame̱te ame̱yafe bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱-ame̱ le̱; ni Iehowa kwe̱ Hiob hĩe.

english_verse: After Job had prayed for his three friends, the Lord made Job twice as rich as he had been before.
translation_verse: Ši Iehowa dšie Hiob ke̱-dše̱ tšũṅwō le̱ mli, beni ekpaä fai ehãa enanemei le̱; ni Iehowa kũ nii fẽ ni Hiob yo̱ sá le̱ ebo̱ he *toi enyo̱ ehãle̱. *

english_verse: In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters,
translation_verse: Esā efo bihĩĩ kpawo ke̱ biyei etẽ,

english_verse: They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.
translation_verse: Ni anaa yei ni he yo̱ fe̱o tamo̱ Hiob biyei le̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ íẽ no̱. Ni ame̱tše̱ *hãame̱ gbe̱fãṅnii ye̱ ame̱nyemimeihĩĩ le̱ ateṅ. *

english_verse: and when he finally died, he was very old.
translation_verse: Ni Hiob gbo, beni egbo̱ ni eye gbĩĩ pī le̱.

english_verse: They are like trees growing beside a stream, trees that produce fruit in season and always have leaves. Those people succeed in everything they do.
translation_verse: *Etamo̱ tšo ni ate̱o ye̱ fāi atoi, ní woo̱ eyibii ye̱ ebe le̱ mli, ní eyibāi kpōṅ; ni nofẽno ní efeo̱ le ſereo̱. *Lal.

english_verse: That isn't true of those who are evil— they are like straw blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Dšee boni meifõdši yo̱ ne̱! Ši moṅ ametamo tutū ní kō̱yo lōo̱ ke̱-yaä. Lal.

english_verse: Sinners won't have an excuse on the day of judgment, and they won't have a place with the people of God.
translation_verse: Nohewo le̱ meifõdši damo̱ṅ ši ye̱ kodšomo̱ mli, ni ešafelo̱i hũ damo̱ṅ ši ye̱ dšalo̱i asafo le̱ mli.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who follows him, but the wicked follow a road that leads to ruin.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa *le dšalo̱i agbe le̱; ši meifõdši agbe le̱ hĩe kpãtãa! *Lal.

english_verse: They say, “Let's cut the ropes and set ourselves free!”
translation_verse: “Nyehãa wo̱kũmo̱a ame̱gbokle̱i le̱, ní wo̱tšere̱ ame̱kpãi le̱ ye̱ wo̱he wo̱ſie!” Ier.

english_verse: In heaven the Lord laughs as he sits on his throne, making fun of the nations.
translation_verse: Moni tá ṅwei le̱ mīnmõ; Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ mīye ame̱he fe̱o po. Lal.

english_verse: Ask me for the nations, and every nation on earth will belong to you.
translation_verse: Bimi, ni maṅõ dšeṅmãdši le̱ mahāo ake̱ ogbošinii ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbēhei le̱ hũ ake̱ ogbe̱fãṅnõ! Dan.

english_verse: Serve and honor the Lord; be glad and tremble.
translation_verse: Nyesúmo̱a Iehowa ke̱ gbeyeišemo̱, ni nyemli aflianye ke̱ hekpokpomo̱! Fil.

english_verse: Show respect to his son because if you don't, the Lord might become furious and suddenly destroy you. But he blesses and protects everyone who runs to him.
translation_verse: *Nyeſo̱a bi le̱ nā, koni emli akafũ ni nyehĩe kpãtã ye̱ gbe̱ le̱ no̱; edšake̱ etše̱ṅ ni emli aawo la. †Adšō̱ mei fè ni yabaäle̱ abo le̱! *

english_verse: I have a lot of enemies, Lord. Many fight against
translation_verse: David lala ni ela, beni edšo foi ye̱ ebi Absalom hĩe le̱.

english_verse: me and say, “God won't rescue you!”
translation_verse: Iehowa, kwe̱ mei abo̱ so̱ṅṅ ní haoo̱mi! mei babaō ní teo̱ ši woo̱mi le̱!

english_verse: I sleep and wake up refreshed because you, Lord, protect me.
translation_verse: Mike̱ migbe boo̱ mitše̱o Iehowa, ni ehereo̱mi no̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ egoṅ kroṅkroṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Ten thousand enemies attack from every side, but I am not afraid.
translation_verse: Mikã ši miwo̱, ni mihĩe tšẽ; edšake̱ Iehowa hĩe mimli. Lal.

english_verse: How long will you people refuse to respect me? You love foolish things, and you run after what is worthless.
translation_verse: Ké̱ mitšé̱ le̱, heremo̱mi no̱, midšale̱ Nyoṅmo̱! Ké̱ efĩmi le̱, bo ofẽneo̱mi; nami mo̱bo̱, ni obo mifaikpamo̱ toi!

english_verse: Offer the proper sacrifices and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyehe akpokpoa ni *nyekafea eša! Nyeke̱ nyetšui awiea †ye̱ nyesā no̱, ni nyefea diō! *Ef.

english_verse: You brought me more happiness than a rich harvest of grain and grapes.
translation_verse: Mei pī kē̱o̱ ake̱: “Namo aaha wo̱na noko kpakpa ko?” Iehowa, *wó ohĩe kpe̱mo̱ le̱ no̱ ye̱ wo̱no̱!

english_verse: I can lie down and sleep soundly because you, Lord, will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Oke̱ mīše̱ ewo mitšui mli fè noni ame̱náa beyino̱ ní ame̱ble ke̱ ame̱wein efá pī le̱.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! Pay attention when I groan.
translation_verse: David lala ní eke̱-hã lalatše̱ nukpa le̱, ní ake̱ be̱dši ala.

english_verse: You are my King and my God. Answer my cry for help because I pray to you.
translation_verse: Bo miwiemo̱i le̱ atoi, Iehowa, ni okwe̱ mikomo̱ ní miyeo̱ le̱!

english_verse: No one who boasts can stand in your presence, Lord, and you hate evil people.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ odšee Mawu ní náa efõṅ he tšui; mofõṅ ke̱o ehĩĩ ši.

english_verse: You destroy every liar, and you despise violence and deceit.
translation_verse: Hepupūlo̱i damo̱ṅ ši ye̱ ohĩe; onye̱o̱ mei fè ni tšuo̱ nišaianii.

english_verse: Nothing they say is true! They just want to destroy. Their words are deceitful like a hidden pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies.
translation_verse: Iehowa, wami ye̱ odšale̱ le̱ mli ye̱ mei ni he tšẽo̱mi le̱ ahewo̱; dšadšemo̱ ogbe le̱ ye̱ mihĩe!

english_verse: Punish them, God, and let their own plans bring their downfall. Get rid of them! They keep committing crimes and turning against you.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ anokwasane be̱ ame̱dāṅ; ame̱mlinii le̱, efõṅ so̱ṅṅ ni; *gbonyobu ní agble nā dši ame̱sẽ; ame̱ke̱ ame̱lile̱i wieo̱ dokobī. *Rom.

english_verse: Let all who run to you for protection always sing joyful songs. Provide shelter for those who truly love you and let them rejoice.
translation_verse: Buame̱ fo̱, Nyoṅmo̱! Hã amenyie ame̱dšinai le̱ ano̱ noṅṅ amegbe ši. Ṅõ-ame̱ otſia ši ye̱ ame̱no̱tõmo̱i babaō le̱ hewo; edšake̱ ame̱tše ohĩe atũa!

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who live right, and you shield them with your kindness.
translation_verse: Ši hã mei fẽ ní baäo abo le̱ amli afliame̱; hã ame̱nyã́ dāne̱, edšake bo ohaä ame̱no̱; hã mei ni sumoo̱ ogbe̱i le̱ amī aše̱ amehe ye̱ omli. Lal.

english_verse: Don't punish me, Lord, or even correct me when you are angry!
translation_verse: David lala ní eke̱-hã lalatše̱ nukpa le̱, ni ake̱ gbē ní dši kpānyo̱ ala.

english_verse: If I die, I cannot praise you or even remember you.
translation_verse: Kũ ose̱, Iehowa, dšiemo̱ misusuma; heremo̱ miyiwala ye̱ omlihĩle̱ hewo̱!

english_verse: My groaning has worn me out. At night my bed and pillow are soaked with tears.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ akaii bo ye̱ gbĕle mli; gbohĩĩadše hũ, namo aadao ši ye̱ dše̱i? Lal.

english_verse: You, Lord, heard my crying, and those hateful people had better leave me alone.
translation_verse: Aw̌ere̱hō ehã mihĩṅme̱i ešiu, mihaolo̱i le̱ soṅṅ hewo le egbo. Lal.

english_verse: You have answered my prayer and my plea for mercy.
translation_verse: Nyedšea mino̱, nye mei fē ní tšuo̱ nišaianii le̱! Edšake̱ Iehowa enu miyāfó gbe le̱,

english_verse: My enemies will be ashamed and terrified, as they quickly run away in complete disgrace.
translation_verse: Iehowa enu mifaikpamo̱ le̱; Iehowa ehere miso̱lemo̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Get angry, Lord God! Do something! Attack my furious enemies. See that justice is done.
translation_verse: no le̱ hã henye̱lo̱ le̱ atiu misusuma ní eninale̱, ni enānā miwala no̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ hũ, ni minumnyam le̱ eše̱ efõ sũ mli!

english_verse: Make the nations come to you, as you sit on your throne above them all.
translation_verse: Iehowa, wó ohe no̱ ye̱ omlifũ le̱ṅ! Wó ohe no̱ ye̱ mihaolo̱i le̱ agrimo̱ le̱ hewo̱, ni ohĩe atšẽ ahãmi, bo ní owo kodšomo̱ he kitã le̱.

english_verse: Our Lord, judge the nations! Judge me and show that I am honest and innocent.
translation_verse: Hã mãdsimãdši asafo le̱ abo̱leo, ni odše ame̱no̱ okũ ose̱ ke̱-ya ṅwei!

english_verse: You see that justice is done, and each day you take revenge.
translation_verse: Mitše̱ṅ le̱ ye̱ Mawu deṅ, le̱ ehereo̱ mei ní dša ye̱ ame̱tsuiiaṅ le̱ ayiwala. Lal.

english_verse: Your deadly arrows are ready with flaming tips.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši moko kpalee le̱, eedšo̱ eklante nā, egāitšo le̱ hũ edo̱ mli eto;

english_verse: An evil person is like a woman about to give birth to a hateful, deceitful, and rebellious child.
translation_verse: asaṅ esā mogbē nibii etole̱; ewo egãimlibii le̱ anā la.

english_verse: Such people dig a deep hole, then fall in it themselves.
translation_verse: Na, ēkõmo̱ ke̱ nõša, ni ehĩe efõṅfemo̱ mũsũ, ni ebafo̱ apasa.

english_verse: The trouble they cause comes back on them, and their heads are crushed by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Etša bu, ni edšie mli, ši le̱ noṅṅ ebagbē bu ní etša le̱ mli. Abe̱i

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You always do right. I will sing about you, the Lord Most High.
translation_verse: Emusu aakũ se̱ abua eyiteṅ, eyiwale̱ le̱ aagbē le̱dientše̱ eyiteṅ pampam.

english_verse: Then I ask, “Why do you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for us weaklings?”
translation_verse: Ké̱ mikwe̱ *oṅwei le̱ ní dši owābii anā nitšumo̱i le̱, nyoṅtšẽre ke̱ ṅulamii ní osā oto le̱: Lal.

english_verse: You made us a little lower than you yourself, and you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: *Meni dši ádesã, ni odſẽṅo̱ eno̱? alo gbomobi hũ, ni osraäle̱ po? *Lal.

english_verse: You let us rule everything your hands have made. And you put all of it under our power—
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ſe̱ fio ke̱ke̱ ni ohã eke̱ Nyoṅmo̱ aye gbo, ni oke̱ anumnyam ke̱ wō fīle̱ akekre.

english_verse: the sheep and the cattle, and every wild animal,
translation_verse: Ohã eye oninenā nitšumo̱i le̱ ano̱; oṅõ nibii fẽ-kwa oto enàdšiaši: Mat.

english_verse: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and all ocean creatures.
translation_verse: Toi ke̱ tšinai fẽ-tfèm ke̱ ṅãṅ koloi hũ,

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth!
translation_verse: ṅwei lofõdši ke̱ ṅšo̱ṅloi, nii fẽ ni nyieo̱ ṅšo̱ mli gbè̱i le̱ ano̱ le̱.

english_verse: God Most High, I will rejoice; I will celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Mada Iehowa ši ke̱ mitšui fẽ, magba onākpe̱ nitšumo̱i le̱ fē.

english_verse: When my enemies face you, they run away and stumble and are destroyed.
translation_verse: Manyá, ni mimli aaflimi ye̱ omli, mala madšie ogbe̱i le̱ yi, bo ṅweinyo le̱.

english_verse: You warn the nations and destroy evil people; you wipe out their names forever and ever.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ofá mihe ni oye misane ohãmi, otá kodšomo̱sẽi no̱ ake̱ *kodšolo̱ dšalo̱. *Lal.

english_verse: You judge the world fairly and treat all nations with justice.
translation_verse: Ši Iehowa le̱, eye̱ dã; esā esẽi le̱ emā ši ehã kodšomo̱. Lal.

english_verse: The poor can run to you because you are a fortress in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Ni ebakodšo dše le̱ ye̱ dšale̱ nā, eebu mãdšimãdši le̱ atẽṅ hũ boni sa pe̱. Lal.

english_verse: You did not forget to punish the guilty or listen to the cries of those in need.
translation_verse: Nyelaã nyedšiea Iehowa, *ní hĩo̱ Zion le̱, yi; nyegbaä enitšumo̱i le̱ ye̱ mãdšimãdši le̱ ateṅ! *Lal.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations fell into their own pits, and their feet were caught in their own traps.
translation_verse: koni *magba oyidšiemo̱i le̱ fè ye̱ Zion biyō le̱ agbói le̱ amli, †mimli aaflimi ye oyiwalaheremo̱ le̱ hewo. *Lal.

english_verse: You showed what you are like, and you made certain that justice is done, but evil people are trapped by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Dšeṅmãdši le̱ egbẽ bu ní ame̱ noṅṅ ame̱tša le̱ mli; tšõne ní ame̱tšṍ ame̱tē le̱ edũ ame̱nane. Lal.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Don't let the nations win. Make them stand trial in your court of law.
translation_verse: Ši ohĩafo le̱, dšee dā hĩe aakpa eno̱, ni nõnalo̱i ahĩeno̱kãmo̱ le̱ elādšeṅ ke-yaṅ nāno̱. Lal.

english_verse: Make the nations afraid and let them all discover just how weak they are.
translation_verse: Wó ohe no̱, Iehowa! Kāhã ádesã miye no̱; hã ní akodšo dšeṅmãdši le̱ ye̱ ohĩe!

english_verse: They are always successful, though they can't understand your teachings, and they keep sneering at their enemies.
translation_verse: Egbè̱i le̱ ye̱ ſeſēſe befẽbe; okodšomo̱i le̱ *edše ehĩe ke̱-te šoṅṅ; efũo̱ ewoo̱ ehenye̱lo̱i le̱ fẽ. *Amos

english_verse: They hide outside villages, waiting to strike and murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Etáa ši ewoo̱ ká ye akrowai ahe, egbeo̱ moni efeko noko le̱ ye̱ nifĩfĩaṅ; edšieo̱ ehĩe ekáa moni efĩle̱ le̱.

english_verse: They are hungry lions hiding in the bushes, hoping to catch some helpless passerby. They trap the poor in nets and drag them away.
translation_verse: Ebuo̱ ši ye̱ tēmo̱he tamo dšata ye̱ ebo mli. Ewoo̱ ká, koni emō nõnalo̱ le̱; kē̱ enine gbe nõnalo̱ le̱, egblaäle̱ ewoo̱ eyã le̱ mli. Lal.

english_verse: They say, “God can't see! He's got on a blindfold.”
translation_verse: Ekē̱o̱ ye̱ etšuiṅ ake̱: Mawu hĩe ekpa no̱; eṅõ ehĩe etẽ, ni *enaṅ gbĩko-gbĩko. *Lal.

english_verse: Do something, Lord God, and use your powerful arm to help those in need.
translation_verse: Iehowa, wó ohe no̱! Mawu, wó onine no̱! Ohĩe akakpa nõnalo̱i ano̱!

english_verse: The wicked don't respect you. In their hearts they say, “God won't punish us!”
translation_verse: Mẽhewo̱ ni mofõṅ lio̱ Nyoṅmo̱, ni ekē̱o̱ ye̱ etšui mli ake̱: Odiṅ se̱?

english_verse: But you see the trouble and the distress, and you will do something. The poor can count on you, and so can orphans.
translation_verse: Le̱le̱ṅ, ona; edšake̱ bo le̱ onaã haomo̱ ke̱ aw̌ere̱hō fẽ, koni atu awo odeṅ; bo odeṅ moni efīle̱ le̱ tuo̱ ehe ewoo̱; bo noṅṅ dši *awusã hefatalo̱. *Lal.

english_verse: Now break the power of all merciless people. Punish them for doing wrong and make them stop.
translation_verse: Kũ mofõṅ le̱ nine, ni otao efõṅfelo̱ *nõfõṅ le̱ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní onaa eko doṅṅ! *Lal.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will always rule, but every godless nation will vanish from the earth.
translation_verse: *Iehowa dši maṅtše̱ ke̱-dše̱ nāno̱ ke̱-yaši nāno̱; dšeṅmãdši le̱ ahĩe kpãtãa ke̱-dše̱o̱ ešikpoṅ le̱ no̱. *Lal.

english_verse: You listen to the longings of those who suffer. You offer them hope, and you pay attention to their cries for help.
translation_verse: Iehowa, onu noni nõnalo̱i taoo̱; owo ame̱tšui hewale̱, ohã otoi enu,

english_verse: You defend orphans and everyone else in need, so that no one on earth can terrify others again.
translation_verse: koni oye awusã ke̱ moni awaäle̱ yi le̱ sane ohãame̱, beni afe ní gbomo ádesã ní dše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ he akahĩ gbeyei doṅṅ.

english_verse: What can an honest person do when everything crumbles?”
translation_verse: Ke̱dši afite šišitōi le̱, bĕle̱ meni dšalo̱ aanyẽ afe?

english_verse: The Lord is sitting in his sacred temple on his throne in heaven. He knows everything we do because he sees us all.
translation_verse: *Iehowa ye̱ eso̱lemo̱we kroṅkroṅ le̱, Iehowa le̱, ṅwei †esẽi le̱ yo̱; ehĩṅme̱ii mīkwe̱, ehĩṅme̱iiase̱ mīka gbomei abii! *Hab.

english_verse: He will send fiery coals and flaming sulfur down on the wicked, and they will drink nothing but a scorching wind.
translation_verse: *Eene̱ srawai eſie meifõdši ano̱; la ke̱ swō̱ ke̱ kō̱yo̱ ni tšoo̱ dši ame̱-kpulu mli gbe̱fãṅnõ. *

english_verse: The Lord always does right and wants justice done. Everyone who does right will see his face.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa le̱, dšalo̱ dšile̱ ni esumoo̱ *dšale̱ nifemo̱; †mei ní dša le̱ aana ehĩe. *Lal.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord! All who were faithful and all who were loyal have disappeared.
translation_verse: David lala ni eke̱-hã lalatše̱ nukpa le̱ ni ake̱ gbē ni dši kpānyo̱ ala.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies, and no one is sincere.
translation_verse: Buamo̱wo̱, Iehowa! edšake̱ hetšelo̱i mītã, edšake̱ ano̱kwafoi ase̱ mīfo ye̱ gbomei abii ateṅ.

english_verse: Won't you chop off all flattering tongues that brag so loudly?
translation_verse: Mofẽmo ke̱ enanyo wieo̱ yakanii; ame̱nā do̱ko̱bī, ni tšui nta ame̱ke̱wieo̱.

english_verse: They say to themselves, “We are great speakers. No one else has a chance.”
translation_verse: Iehowa aflo̱ nābui ni wieo̱ do̱kō̱ le̱ fẽ, ke̱ lile̱i hũ ní wieo̱ nii wudši le̱,

english_verse: But you, Lord, tell them, “I will do something! The poor are mistreated and helpless people moan. I'll rescue all who suffer.”
translation_verse: mei hũ ni kē̱o̱ ake̱: Wo̱lile̱i wo̱ke̱-aye no̱, wo̱ye̱ nābui; namo aaye wo̱no̱ nuṅtšo̱? Lal.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are true to your promises, and your word is like silver heated seven times in a fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Nõnalo̱i ayiwā ke̱ ohĩafoi atšo̱idõmo̱ hewo̱ le̱ agbe̱ne̱ mate ši, Iehowa kē̱, mahere moni ſeo̱ yiwalaheremo̱ le̱ yiwala!

english_verse: You will protect us and always keep us safe from those people.
translation_verse: Iehowa wiemo̱i le̱, wiemo̱i kro̱ṅṅi ni, tamo̱ dſietei ní aka ye̱ šikpoṅ flõnõ mli ní atšū he šii kpawo. Lal.

english_verse: But all who are wicked will keep on strutting, while everyone praises their shameless deeds.
translation_verse: Bo, Iehowa, oobu ame̱he, oohã ame̱yĩ ke̱-adše̱ ne̱ke̱ yino̱bii ne̱ adeṅ dā;

english_verse: Please listen, Lord God, and answer my prayers. Make my eyes sparkle again, or else I will fall into the sleep of death.
translation_verse: Mẽ beyino̱ ṅko̱mo̱yeli aahī misusuma mli, ni ké̱ dše tše̱re le̱, aw̌ere̱hō aahĩ mitšuiṅ ke̱-yaši? Mẽ beyino̱ mihenye̱lo̱ aawó ehe no̱ ye̱ mino̱ ke̱-yaši?

english_verse: My enemies will say, “Now we've won!” They will be greatly pleased when I am defeated.
translation_verse: Kwe̱mo̱, ní oheremi no̱, Iehowa, mi-Nyoṅmo̱! Tšĩemo̱ mihĩe, ni mikawo̱ gbĕle wo̱,

english_verse: I trust your love, and I feel like celebrating because you rescued me.
translation_verse: ní mihenye̱lo̱ le̱ akakē̱ ake̱: Miye eno̱! ní mihaolo̱i le̱ akanyã́ ye̱ mididãmo̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: You have been good to me, Lord, and I will sing about you.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, omo̱bo̱nale̱ no̱ mihĩe kã; mitšui *nyã́a ye̱ oyiwalaheremo̱ le̱ mli. Mala mahã Iehowa, edšake efemi edšũrõ. *Lal.

english_verse: From heaven the Lord looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: *Iehowa dše̱o̱ ṅwei kwe̱o̱ gbomei abii, ake̱ eena ake̱ moko ye̱ ni le nii ni taoo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ se̱gbe̱ lo. Lal.

english_verse: Won't you evil people learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Aso mei fẽ ni tšuo̱ nišaiauii le̱ lee nii, mei ni yeo̱ *mimaṅ le̱, tamo ayeo̱ abolo, ni Iehowa le, ametšé̱é̱le le? *Mika

english_verse: But you will be frightened, because God is on the side of every good person.
translation_verse: Gbĩko le̱ kpokpomo̱ ame̱he aakpokpo; edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ye̱ dšalo̱i asafo le̱ teṅ!

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our Lord, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: Ō kũle̱ Israel yiwalaheremo̱ le̱ adše̱ Zion aba! Ké̱ Iehowa hã emaṅ le̱ kũ ese̱ ke̱-dše̱ nomṅō̃ le̱ mli le̱, no le̱ Iakob aanyã́, ni Israel mī aaše̱ ehe.

english_verse: Who may stay in God's temple or live on the holy mountain of the Lord?
translation_verse: David lala. Iehowa, namo aato *obū le̱ṅ? Namo aahĩ ogoṅ kroṅkroṅ le̱ no̱? Lal.

english_verse: and don't spread gossip; they treat others fairly and don't say cruel things.
translation_verse: moni ke̱ elile̱i yee mo he ošeku, ni efee enanyo efõṅ ko, ni ebo̱o̱ enanyo gbomo ahora;

english_verse: They hate worthless people, but show respect for all who worship the Lord. And they keep their promises, no matter what the cost.
translation_verse: moni nyenyeṅtſi dšee moko ye̱ ehĩe, ši Iehowa šelo̱i le̱ ahĩe nyam ewoo̱; moni ké̱ ekã kitã ní eená amane ye̱ mli po le̱, etšakee;

english_verse: They lend their money without charging interest, and they don't take bribes to hurt the innocent. Those who do these things will always stand firm.
translation_verse: eke̱ *ešika efaa ehee hekpa ní fè nine, ni ehee moni eye bem he nyōnnii. Moni feo ne̱ke̱ le̱, edidãṅ gbĩkogbĩko. *

english_verse: You, Lord, are all I want! You are my choice, and you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Iehowa dši migbošinii ke̱ mikpulu mli gbe̱fãṅnõ; bo ohĩe mišiki mli! Yāfó

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for being my guide. Even in the darkest night, your teachings fill my mind.
translation_verse: Madšie Iehowa moni womi ṅā le̱ yi; misabai tete *wieo̱ tšõo̱mi nyōṅ. *Lal.

english_verse: I will always look to you, as you stand beside me and protect me from fear.
translation_verse: Mike̱ Iehowa too̱ mihĩe dā: ní eyo̱ mininedšũrõ no̱ ne̱, mididãṅ.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will celebrate, and I can safely rest.
translation_verse: Hewo̱ le̱ mitšui enyo mimli, ni *minumnyam le̱ mīnyá, ni mihelo hũ aahĩ ši ſeſēſe. *

english_verse: I am your chosen one. You won't leave me in the grave or let my body decay.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ošĩṅ misusuma ohãṅ gbohĩĩadše, ohāṅ omokroṅkroṅ le̱ ana lādšemo̱bu le̱. Bo̱f.

english_verse: Only you can say that I am innocent, because only your eyes can see the truth.
translation_verse: Hã ní mikodšomo̱ adše̱ ohĩe aba; ohĩṅme̱ii akwe̱ noni dša! Lal.

english_verse: I pray to you, God, because you will help me. Listen and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Mibo mitšé̱o, edšake̱ ooheremi no̱, Mawu; ba otoi ši ohãmi, ni obo miwiemo̱ le̱ toi!

english_verse: Show your wonderful love. Your mighty arm protects those who run to you for safety from their enemies.
translation_verse: Dšiemo̱ *onākpe̱ mlihĩle̱ le̱ kpo, bo, moni oke̱ oninedšũrõ hereo̱ mei ní baäo abo le̱ ayiwala ke̱-dše̱o̱ mei ní teo̱ ši woo̱ame̱ le̱ adeṅ le̱! *Lal.

english_verse: Protect me as you would your very own eyes; hide me in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Bāmo̱ miyi *tamo̱ hĩṅme̱i mli adšaṅmalāte̱, oke̱mi atē ofĩdši ašiši hō̃ṅ le̱ mli, *

english_verse: They have caught up with me! My enemies are everywhere, eagerly hoping to smear me in the dirt.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ ame̱fo sá ame̱wo wo̱nādši-fãmo̱i le̱ ahe kpūla; ame̱dšie ame̱hĩe ame̱klawo̱, koni ame̱tšire̱wo̱ ame̱tſia šikpoṅ,

english_verse: They are like hungry lions hunting for food, or like young lions hiding in ambush.
translation_verse: tamo̱ dšata ní hĩe edo̱ ye̱ eniyenii ahewo̱, ke̱ dšatabi ní ewo ante̱o ye̱ nifĩfĩaṅ. Lal.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Attack and defeat them. Take your sword and save me from those evil people.
translation_verse: Iehowa, wó ohe no̱, ni okũ enā ni otšile̱ ogbe ši! Oke̱ oklante adšie misusuma ke̱-dše̱ mofõṅ le̱ deṅ!

english_verse: Use your powerful arm and rescue me from the hands of mere humans whose world won't last. You provide food for those you love. Their children have plenty, and their grandchildren will have more than enough.
translation_verse: Iehowa, oke̱ onine adšiemi ke̱-dše̱ gbomei adeṅ ke̱-dše̱ dše ne̱ṅ gbomei ni náa ame̱gbe̱fãṅnõ ye̱ walabe ne̱ mli, ni oke̱ onii kpakpai le̱ ewo *ame̱mũsũ obõ, ní ame̱bii fá hãame̱, ní ame̱šĩo̱ ame̱nii ni eſe̱ le amehãa ame̱bii bibii le̱ adeṅ. *Luk.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord, and I will see your face! When I awake, all I want is to see you as you are.
translation_verse: Mi le̱, mana ohĩe ye̱ dšale̱ mli; beni mihĩe aatšẽ le̱, mato ke̱ osubāṅ le̱!

english_verse: Death had wrapped its ropes around me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.
translation_verse: Mabo matšé̱ Iehowa, moni sa yidšiemo̱ le̱, ni aahere miyiwala ye̱ mihenye̱lo̱i le adeṅ.

english_verse: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: gbohĩĩadše kpãi le̱ ebo̱lemi ke̱kpe, ni gbēle tšõnei le̱ hũ edũmi.

english_verse: Darkness was your robe; thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.
translation_verse: Ni etá *kerub no̱ ni efliki, ni eye kō̱yo̱ fĩdši abo̱. *Lal.

english_verse: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens, as hailstones and fiery coals poured down like rain.
translation_verse: Kpe̱mo̱ ni nyie ehĩe le̱ hã nyoṅmo̱ṅte̱i ke̱ ṅãi ní tšoo̱ dše̱ etatui kpīkpī le̱ amli baho.

english_verse: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.
translation_verse: Edšiemi ke̱-dše̱ mihenye̱lo̱ ní he wa le̱ deṅ, ke̱-dše̱ mei ní he tšẽo̱mi le̱ adeṅ, edšake̱ ame̱he wa fēmi.

english_verse: You are good to me, Lord, because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.
translation_verse: Edšiemi ke̱-te heni le̱ hũ, edšiemi, edšake̱ eye̱ mihe tšui. K.

english_verse: I do what you want and never turn to do evil.
translation_verse: Iehowa tomi nādšiaṅ ye̱ midšale̱ le̱ nā, ewomi nyõmo̱ ye̱ mideṅ tšemo̱ le̱ nā.

english_verse: I obey you completely and guard against sin.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ emlai le̱ fẽ ye̱ mihĩe, ni ekpoi le miše̱re̱ko miſieko ke̱-dše̱ko mihe;

english_verse: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: ni *miye emū ye̱ ehĩe, ni mitši mihe ke̱-dše̱ minõša le̱ he. *Lal.

english_verse: You are always loyal to your loyal people, and you are faithful to the faithful.
translation_verse: Hewo̱ le̱ Iehowa ewomi nyõmo̱ ye̱ midšale̱ le̱ nā, ye̱ midẽ ní tše ye̱ ehĩe le̱ nā.

english_verse: You rescue the humble, but you put down all who are proud.
translation_verse: hetšelo̱ le̱, oke̱ ohe tšõo̱le̱ ake̱ moni he tše; ši moni be̱ eṅe̱le̱no̱ le̱, oke̱ ohe tšõo̱le̱ tamo̱ moni be̱ eṅe̱le̱no̱.

english_verse: You, the Lord God, keep my lamp burning and turn darkness to light.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ohereo̱ maṅ ní naa amane le yiwala, ši hewo hĩṅme̱ii le̱, obaä-awe ši. Hiob

english_verse: You help me defeat armies and capture cities.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo ohãa mikane le̱ tšoo̱; Iehowa, mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, hãa miduṅ le̱ mli tšeo̱.

english_verse: Your way is perfect, Lord, and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.
translation_verse: Ši bo mike̱-tšẽo̱ ke̱-yaninaä ta, ni mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ mike̱-huluo̱ mitekeo̱ gbogbo. Lal.

english_verse: You give me strength and guide me right.
translation_verse: Ši namo dši Nyoṅmo̱, ake̱ dša Iehowa? ni namo dši te̱sā, ake dša wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱?

english_verse: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.
translation_verse: ehãa minãdši feo̱ tamo̱ ofrotei anõ, ni eṅõo̱mi edamoo̱ migoṅkpo̱i le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.
translation_verse: Asaṅ oke̱ oyiwalaheremo̱ tše̱ṅ le̱ ehãmi, ni oninedšũrõ hĩe mimli, ni omlihĩle̱ le̱ ehã mitsṍ agbo. Abe̱i

english_verse: I kept chasing my enemies, until I caught them and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Oha *minādšifãmo̱i le̱ amli elē̱ ye̱ mišiši, ni minãdši šãnee. *Lal.

english_verse: I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.
translation_verse: Mitiu mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ ni mininaame̱, ni mikpalee ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni miplenē-ame̱.

english_verse: You helped me win victories, and you forced my attackers to fall victim to me.
translation_verse: Mitſiaame̱ nii, ni ame̱nyẽẽ ši ame̱te doṅṅ, ame̱nyõnyõi ye̱ minãdšiaši.

english_verse: You made my enemies run, and I killed them.
translation_verse: Ni oke hewale̱ emĩamĩ ohã tawū, ohã mei ni tete ši womi le̱ ebakotomi.

english_verse: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
translation_verse: Asaṅ oha mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ etšṍmo̱ ame̱se̱ ame̱hãmi, beni afe ni makpãtã mei ni nye̱o̱mi le̱ ahĩe.

english_verse: I ground them to dust blown by the wind, and I poured them out like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Ame̱blo̱, ši yiwalaherelo̱ ko be̱; ame̱tšé̱ Iehowa, ši efoo ame̱dāṅ. Abe̱i

english_verse: You rescued me from stubborn people, and you made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.
translation_verse: Mišimo̱ame̱ mõnyõmõnyõ tamo mlu ye̱ kō̱yo̱ nā, milōame̱ miſie tamo blohũiaṅ ṅmo̱to̱.

english_verse: They have lost all courage, and from their fortresses, they come trembling.
translation_verse: Kē̱ amenu mihe pe̱, ame̱abomi toi; maṅse̱bii aaba ame̱he ši ame̱hãmi.

english_verse: You are the living Lord! I will praise you. You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Maṅse̱bii le̱ aagbĩ kekrē, ni ame̱adše̱ ame̱kpokplobii le̱aṅ ame̱aba ke̱ hekpokpomo̱.

english_verse: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.
translation_verse: Iehowa hĩe kã, ni aadšie mite̱sã le̱ yi, ni aawo miyiwalaheremo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ hĩe nyam;

english_verse: You protected me from violent enemies and made me much greater than all of them.
translation_verse: Mawu ní to̱ō̱ mihe owele, ni ebaä mãdšĩ aši ewoo̱ mišĩši le̱,

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and I will honor you among the nations.
translation_verse: ehereo̱mi ke̱-dše̱o̱ mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ adeṅ; bo owóo̱ mino̱ ke̱-tekeo̱ mei ní teo̱ ši woo̱mi le̱; odšieo̱mi ke̱-dše̱o̱ nū yiwalo̱ le̱ deṅ.

english_verse: You give glorious victories to your chosen king. Your faithful love for David and for his descendants will never end.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ *madšie oyi, Iehowa, ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ, ni mala madšie ogbe̱i le̱ yi, *Rom.

english_verse: Each day informs the following day; each night announces to the next.
translation_verse: Ṅwei gbaã Mawu anumnyam le̱, ni atatu tšõo̱ eninenā nitšumo̱ le̱. Rom.

english_verse: Yet their message reaches all the earth, and it travels around the world. In the heavens a tent is set up for the sun.
translation_verse: Sane dšadšemo̱ ko be̱ ni wiemo ko hũ be̱, ni anuu ame̱gbē ye̱ mli.

english_verse: It rises like a bridegroom and gets ready like a hero eager to run a race.
translation_verse: Ṅwei susumo̱ kpã le̱ kpēle šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ fẽ, ni ewiemo̱ĩ le̱ hũ še̱o̱ dšeṅ nāgbēhe; eši bū ye̱ dše̱i ehã hũlũ; Rom.

english_verse: It travels all the way across the sky. Nothing hides from its heat.
translation_verse: ni etamo̱ ayemforowu ni dše̱o̱ epia mli dšeo̱ kpo, emli flio̱le̱ tamo ekãlo̱ ni yaä ayada efoi ye̱ tempõṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: The Lord's instruction is right; it makes our hearts glad. His commands shine brightly, and they give us light.
translation_verse: Iehowa mla le̱ hĩ ke̱-wula ši, ehãa susuma tšui nyõo̱ emli; Iehowa odase le̱ mā ši šinn, ehãa kwašia leo̱ nii. Lal.

english_verse: They are worth more than the finest gold and are sweeter than honey from a honeycomb.
translation_verse: Iehowa gbeyeišemo̱ le̱ he tše, ehĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä nāno̱. Iehowa kodšomo̱i le̱ ano̱kwale ni, ni fẽ dša kwrā.

english_verse: By your teachings, Lord, I am warned; by obeying them, I am greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Ame̱ye̱ ako̱no̱ fè šika, fè šika kro̱ṅṅ babaō, ni ame̱ṅõ fè wó ke̱ šẽ. Lal.

english_verse: None of us know our faults. Forgive me when I sin without knowing it.
translation_verse: Asaṅ no noṅṅ tšõo̱ otšũlo̱ nii; ame̱no̱yeli le̱, nyõmo̱wo kple ye̱ mli.

english_verse: Let my words and my thoughts be pleasing to you, Lord, because you are my mighty rock and my protector.
translation_verse: Asaṅ bu mihe ke̱-dše̱ hĩe-ke̱-hekãmo̱ ešai amli, koni ame̱kaye mino̱! No le̱ *maye emū, ni mihe aadše no̱tõmo̱i wudši amli. *Lal.

english_verse: May he remember your gifts and be pleased with what you bring.
translation_verse: Eye ebuao ke̱-dše̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱, edše̱ Zion ewoö hewale̱.

english_verse: May God do what you want most and let all go well for you.
translation_verse: Ekai oniyenii-afo̱le le̱ fẽ-kwa, ni ošã-afo̱lei le̱ asa ehĩe.

english_verse: Some people trust the power of chariots or horses, but we trust you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ mile ake̱ Iehowa ehere moni efo̱le̱ mũ le̱ yiwala, ni eebole̱ toi ke̱-adše eṅwei kroṅkroṅ le̱, ni eke̱ *eninedšũrõ hewale̱ le̱ aaherele̱. *

english_verse: Others will stumble and fall, but we will be strong and stand firm.
translation_verse: Meikomei ſãa fõo̱ ſilii ano̱, ni meikomei hũ okpo̱ṅo̱i; ši wo̱ le̱, Iehowa wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ gbe̱i le̱ no̱ wo̱ſãa wo̱ſõo̱.

english_verse: Give the king victory, Lord, and answer our prayers.
translation_verse: Ame̱ le̱ ame̱bumo̱ ši ni ame̱nyõnyõi; ši wo̱ le̱ wo̱te ši wo̱damo̱ ši.

english_verse: You did what he wanted most and never told him “No.”
translation_verse: Iehowa, maṅtše̱ le̱ mī še̱o̱ ehe ye̱ ohewale̱ le̱ mli, ni kwe̱ bo̱ni emli eflile̱ babaō ye̱ oyiwalaheremo̱ le̱ mli!

english_verse: You truly blessed the king, and you placed on him a crown of finest gold.
translation_verse: Noni etsui ſeo̱ le̱, oṅõ-hãle̱, ni nii ní enābu bi le̱, okãmããle̱. Lal.

english_verse: He asked to live a long time, and you promised him life that never ends.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ oke̱ nii kpakpai amli dšō̱mo̱i le̱ ekpēle̱, oke̱ šika kro̱ṅṅ *akekre efĩ eyitšo. *Lal.

english_verse: The king is highly honored. You have let him win victories that have made him famous.
translation_verse: Eba wala ye̱ odeṅ: ohãle̱, gbĩĩ ni se̱ aatše̱ ke̱-ate nāno̱i anāno̱.

english_verse: You have given him blessings that will last forever, and you have made him glad by being so near to him.
translation_verse: Oyeli-ke̱-buamo̱ hewo̱ le̱ enumnyam le̱ da; oke̱ wō ke̱ agbodšē ehãle̱.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by fire once you are here, and because of your anger, flames will swallow them.
translation_verse: Onine aaše̱ ohenye̱lo̱i fẽ no̱; oninedšũrõ aaše̱ mei ni nye̱o̱o le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: All their plans to harm you will come to nothing.
translation_verse: Ookpãtã *ame̱yibii le̱ ahĩe ke̱-adše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ke̱ ame̱sešibii hũ ke̱-adše̱ gbomei abii ateṅ. *Lal.

english_verse: You will make them run away by shooting your arrows at their faces.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ame̱to ame̱yiṅ efõṅ ye̱ ohe, amedſẽṅ ṅā fõṅ hũ; ši ame̱nyëṅ amefe. Ies.

english_verse: Don't stay far off when I am in trouble with no one to help me.
translation_verse: Midše̱ mŭsũṅ le̱ bo ono̱ aṅõmi afo, ke̱-dše̱ minye mũsũṅ bēbe le̱ bo noṅṅ dši mi-Mawu.

english_verse: Brutal enemies attack me like a pack of dogs, tearing at my hands and my feet.
translation_verse: Mihewale̱ egbi tamo̱ ṅe̱sũkó, ni milile̱i ekpe̱te̱ midāṅ, ni oke̱mi eṅmē gbële sũ mli. Ioh.

english_verse: They took my clothes and gambled for them.
translation_verse: Manyẽ makane miwui fẽ po; ame̱ le̱ ame̱lōo̱ ame̱hīṅme̱ii ame̱kwe̱o̱mi.

english_verse: Don't let lions eat me. You rescued me from the horns of wild bulls,
translation_verse: Dšiemo̱ misusuma ke̱-dše̱ klante nā, *minõkometō ni miſe̱e̱ he le̱ ke̱-dše̱ šifõdši adeṅ! *Lal.

english_verse: and when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Heremo̱ miyiwala ke̱-dše̱ dšata dāṅ; wuoi akodši ateṅ ohereo̱mi no̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't hate or despise the helpless in all of their troubles. When I cried out, he listened and did not turn away.
translation_verse: Iehowa gbeyeišelo̱i, nyedšiea eyi! Iakob sešibii nyewoa ehĩe nyam, ni nyeseale̱, nye Israel sešibii fẽ!

english_verse: When your people meet, you will fill my heart with your praises, Lord, and everyone will see me keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ egbee amanenalo̱ amane he guo̱, ni esa *enyãṅee hũ, ni eke ehĩe etẽkole̱; ši beni ebio etsé̱le̱ le̱, enu. *Lal.

english_verse: The poor will eat and be full, and all who worship you will be thankful and live in hope.
translation_verse: Bo dše̱ ni midšieo̱ oyi ye̱ asafo kple mli; *maye mišiwōi le̱ ano̱ ye̱ mei ní šeo̱le̱ le̱ ahĩe. Lal.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth will remember you, Lord. People all over the world will turn and worship you,
translation_verse: *Amanenalo̱i le̱ aaye nii, ni ame̱-atō̱ro̱; Iehowa se̱gbe̱taoloi le̱ aadšie eyi; nyetšui yi aná wala ke̱-ya nãno̱! *Lal.

english_verse: because you are in control, the ruler of all nations.
translation_verse: Šikpoṅ nāgbẽbei le̱ fẽ aakai ni ame̱akpale ke̱-aba Iehowa ṅõ, ni dšeṅmãdši akutšei le̱ fè aakũla ši ye̱ ohĩe.

english_verse: People not yet born will be told, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Sešibii aasũmo̱le̱; aagba Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ be sane atšõ yino̱bii ní baä ye̱ se̱ le̱. Ies.

english_verse: You let me rest in fields of green grass. You lead me to streams of peaceful water,
translation_verse: Ehãa mibuo̱ ši ye̱ lè̱hei ni yo̱ frõfrõ, ewaämi ke̱-yaä nui ní he dšo̱ le̱ ahe. Ezek.

english_verse: Your kindness and love will always be with me each day of my life, and I will live forever in your house, Lord.
translation_verse: Le̱le̱ṅ, ekpakpa ke̱ mo̱bo̱nale̱ aanyie mise̱ ye̱ miwala gbĩĩ le̱ fẽ mli, ni masā mahĩ ši ye̱ Iehowa we le̱ miwala gbĩĩ abo fẽ. Lal.

english_verse: The Lord God, who saves them, will bless and reward them,
translation_verse: le̱ eena Iehowa deṅ dšō̱mo̱ ke̱ *dša-le ke̱-adše̱ eyiwalaheremo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ṅõ. Ies.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Nye *agbói, nyeholea nyeyitšei ano̱! Nyeholea nyehe no̱, nye nāno̱ šìnāi, ní anumnyam maṅtše̱ le̱ aba mli! *Ies.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, a strong and mighty warrior.
translation_verse: Namo dši anumnyam maṅtše̱ ne̱? Iehowa, hewalo̱ ke̱ ekālo̱ le̱ ni, Iehowa, ta mli ekālo̱ le̱ ni

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Nye agbói, nyeholea nyeyitšei ano̱! Nyeholea nyehe no̱, nye nāno̱ šĩnāi, ni anumnyam maṅtše̱ le̱ aba mli!

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, the All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Namo dši ne̱ke̱ anumnyam maṅtše̱ ne̱? Tai a-Iehowa le̱, le̱ dši anumnyam maṅtše̱ le̱!

english_verse: and I trust you. Don't make me ashamed or let enemies defeat me.
translation_verse: Minyoṅmo̱, bo ono̱ mihĩe kã, kāhã mihĩe migbo; kāhã mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ mīyemi yō̱!

english_verse: Don't disappoint any of your worshipers, but disappoint all deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Le̱le̱ṅ, mei ní kwe̱o̱o gbe le̱ ateṅ *mokomoko hĩe gboṅ; mei ni yeo̱ yaka-kũtũmpo̱o le̱ moṅ ahĩe aagboi, *Ies.

english_verse: guide me by your truth and instruct me. You keep me safe, and I always trust you.
translation_verse: Hã manyie ono̱kwale le̱ mli, ni otšõmi nii; edšake̱ bo dši miyiwalaheremo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, bo gbe̱ mikwe̱o̱ dāne̱.

english_verse: Please, Lord, remember, you have always been patient and kind.
translation_verse: Iehowa, kaĩmo̱ omo̱bo̱nale̱ ke̱ omlihĩle̱ le̱; edšake̱ ame̱ye̱ ke̱-dše̱ nāno̱ bēbe.

english_verse: Forget each wrong I did when I was young. Show how truly kind you are and remember me.
translation_verse: *Kākai miblahĩaṅ ešai ke̱ no̱tõmo̱i le̱; moṅ, kaimo̱mi ye̱ omlihĩle̱ nā ye̱ okpakpafemo̱ le̱ hewo̱, Iehowa! *Hiob

english_verse: In everything you do, you are kind and faithful to everyone who keeps our agreement with you.
translation_verse: Iehowa tempõṅi le̱ fẽ le̱, mlihĩle̱ ke̱ ano̱kwale so̱ṅṅ ni hã mei ni yeo̱ ekpãṅmo̱ le̱ ke̱ edasei le̱ ano̱ le̱.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, by forgiving each one of my terrible sins.
translation_verse: Iehowa, ogbe̱i le̱ hewo̱ le̱ ṅõ minõša le̱ ofami, edšake̱ eda!

english_verse: You will show the right path to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Mofẽmo ní šeo̱ Iehowa gbeyei le̱, le̱ le̱ *eetšõle̱ gbe̱ ní eko̱. *Lal.

english_verse: Then they will have plenty, and their children will receive the land.
translation_verse: Esusuma aabi ši ye̱ hedšo̱le̱ mli, ni *esešibii aaṅõ šikpoṅ le aye. *Lal.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the friend of your worshipers, and you make an agreement with all of us.
translation_verse: Iehowa dšĩeo̱ *eyitšoṅsane etšõo̱ mei ni šeo̱le̱ le̱, ni ekpãṅmo̱ le̱ hũ ehãa ame̱leo̱. *Hiob

english_verse: I always look to you, because you rescue me from every trap.
translation_verse: Dāne̱ mihĩṅme̱ii dſere Iehowa no̱, edšake̱ le̱ ebadšie minãdši ke̱-dše̱ yā mli.

english_verse: My awful worries keep growing. Rescue me from sadness.
translation_verse: Mitšui mli haomo̱i le̱ fá; dsiemo̱mi ke̱-dše̱ mifīmo̱i le̱ amli!

english_verse: See my troubles and misery and forgive my sins.
translation_verse: Kwe̱mo̱ mimanehũlũ ke̱ mipīmo̱ le̱, ni oke̱ mihe ešai fẽ afami!

english_verse: I come to you for shelter. Protect me, keep me safe, and don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Bu misusuma he, ni odšiemi; kāhã mihĩe mīgbo, edšake̱ bo abo mibaä. Lal.

english_verse: I obey you with all my heart, and I trust you, knowing that you will save me.
translation_verse: *Emūyeli ke̱ dšale̱ abā miyi; edšake̱ bo gbe̱ mikwe̱o̱. *Hiob

english_verse: Our God, please save Israel from all its troubles.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱, kpo Israel ke̱-dše̱ ehaomo̱i le̱ fẽ mli! Lal.

english_verse: Test my thoughts and find out what I am like.
translation_verse: Iehowa, taomo̱ mimli ni okami okwe̱; tšūmo̱ misabai ke̱ mitšui he! Lal.

english_verse: I never forget your kindness, and I am always faithful to you.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ omlihĩle̱ le̱ ye̱ mihĩe, ni minyie ono̱kwale le̱ mli hũ.

english_verse: or go with evil crowds.
translation_verse: Minye̱o̱ efõṅfelo̱i agwabō̱ le̱, ni mike̱ meifõdši hũ tráá ši.

english_verse: I wash my hands, Lord, to show my innocence, and I worship at your altar,
translation_verse: Mafo̱ midẽ ye̱ bemyeli mli, ni *mabo̱le ofo̱lešãlate̱ le̱, Iehowa, *Lal.

english_verse: while gratefully singing about your wonders.
translation_verse: koni mahã anu mišidā gbe le̱, ni magba onākpe̱ nitšumo̱i le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: I love the temple where you live, and where your glory shines.
translation_verse: Iehowa, mīsumo̱ owe šihĩle̱he le ke̱ heni onumnyam le̱ hĩo̱ le̱. Lal

english_verse: Don't sweep me away, as you do sinners. Don't punish me with death as you do those people who are brutal
translation_verse: Kākpãtã misusuma hĩe ošĩ ešafelo̱i ano̱, lo miwala oši lášiſielo̱i ano̱,

english_verse: or full of meanness or who bribe others.
translation_verse: mei ní musu yo̱ ame̱deṅ ni ame̱ninedšũrõ eyi ke̱ nyōṅnii le̱.

english_verse: I stay true to myself. Be kind and rescue me.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, emūyeli mli maba midšeṅ ye̱; heremo̱mi, ni onami mo̱bo̱!

english_verse: Now I stand on solid ground! And when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Minane mã heni dša trõmō̃. *Madšie Iehowa yi ye gwabō̱i amli! *Lal.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the light that keeps me safe. I am not afraid of anyone. You protect me, and I have no fears.
translation_verse: David lala. Iehowa dši mila ke̱ miyiwalaheremo̱; namo po gbeyei maše? Iehowa dši miwala hewale̱; namo hĩe po ni mihe aakpokpo ye̱? Lal.

english_verse: Brutal people may attack and try to kill me, but they will stumble. Fierce enemies may attack, but they will fall.
translation_verse: Kē̱ efõṅfelo̱i ni dši mihaolo̱i ke̱ mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ ba ame̱batuami, koni ame̱ye *milō le̱, ame̱atĕre̱ ni ame̱agbegbē ši! *Hiob

english_verse: Please listen when I pray! Have pity. Answer my prayer.
translation_verse: Iehowa, bo miblo̱mo̱ gbē le̱ toi! Nami mo̱bo̱, ni oheremi no̱!

english_verse: My heart tells me to pray. I am eager to see your face,
translation_verse: *Owiemo̱ ní mitšui susuo̱ he ne̱: “Nyetaoa mihĩe gbe̱!” Iehowa, ohĩe gbe̱ le̱ mitaoo̱ ne̱! *

english_verse: so don't hide from me. I am your servant, Lord, and you have helped me. Don't turn from me in anger. You alone keep me safe. Don't reject or desert me.
translation_verse: Kāṅõ ohĩe otẽmi, kāſie otšũlo̱ ye̱ mliſũ mli! Miyeli-ke̱-buamo̱ dšio; kāše̱mi ofõ, ni kākwami, miyiwalaheremo̱ Nyoṅmo̱!

english_verse: Even if my father and mother should desert me, you will take care of me.
translation_verse: Ši mitše̱ ke̱ minye ešĩmi moṅ, ši Iehowa hereo̱mi atū. Ies.

english_verse: Don't let them do to me what they want. People tell lies about me and make violent threats,
translation_verse: Kāṅõmi ohã tamo̱ bo̱ni mihaolo̱i le̱ taoo̱ le̱; edšake̱ amale-odasefoi ete ši ewomi, ame̱mīmũ yiwale̱ po!

english_verse: but I know I will live to see how kind you are.
translation_verse: Ši kẽle̱ mihe miye ake̱ mana Iehowa mlihĩle̱ le̱ ye̱ *hīekãlo̱i ašikpoṅ le̱ no̱! *Lal.

english_verse: Trust the Lord! Be brave and strong and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Kwe̱mo̱ Iehowa gbe̱! Wadšemo̱ ohe ni oná tšui, ni okwe̱ Iehowa gbe̱! Lal.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for answering my prayers.
translation_verse: Aadšie Iehowa yi, edšake̱ ebo mifaikpamo̱ gbē le̱ toi!

english_verse: You are my strong shield, and I trust you completely. You have helped me, and I will celebrate and thank you in song.
translation_verse: Iehowa dši mihewale̱ ke̱ mitše̱ṅ; mike̱ mitšui fõ eno̱, ni eye ebuami; nohewo le̱ miná tšuidšũrõ ni mike̱ milala aadšie eyi! Lal.

english_verse: You give strength to your people, Lord, and you save and protect your chosen ones.
translation_verse: Iehowa dši ame̱hewale̱ le̱, ni le̱ dši moni efo̱le̱ mũ le̱ yiwalaheremo̱ mō̃.

english_verse: Come save us and bless us. Be our shepherd and always carry us in your arms.
translation_verse: Heremo̱ omaṅ le̱ yiwala, ni *odšō̱ ogbe̱fāṅnõ le̱, lè̱ame̱ ni ohīeame̱ ke̱-ya nāno̱! *Lal.

english_verse: All you angels in heaven, honor the glory and power of the Lord!
translation_verse: David lala. Nye *Nyoṅmo̱ bii, nyeke̱-hãa Iehowa, nyeke̱ anumnyam ke̱ hewale̱ ahãa Iehowa! *Lal.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord echoes over the oceans. The glorious Lord God thunders above the roar of the raging sea,
translation_verse: Iehowa *gbẽ ye̱ nui ano̱; anumnyam Mawu le̱ mīši, Iehowa ye̱ nui babaō le̱ ano̱. *Hiob

english_verse: and his voice is mighty and marvelous.
translation_verse: Iehowa gbē le̱ ye̱ hewale̱, Iehowa gbē le̱ mli eyi obõ ke̱ anumnyam.

english_verse: God makes Mount Lebanon skip like a calf and Mount Hermon jump like a wild ox.
translation_verse: ehãa ame̱huluhuluo̱ tamo̱ tšinabi, Lebanon ke̱ *Sirion tamo̱ wuo oblanyo. *

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes lightning flash
translation_verse: Iehowa gbē le̱ gblaä lalileii amli.

english_verse: The Lord rules on his throne, king of the flood forever.
translation_verse: Iehowa tá nu afua no̱, ni Iehowa miye maṅtše̱ ke̱-mīya nāno̱.

english_verse: Pray that our Lord will make us strong and give us peace.
translation_verse: Iehowa *aahã emaṅ le̱ hewale̱; Iehowa aadšō̱ emaṅ le ke̱ hedšole̱. *Lal.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord God, and you healed me,
translation_verse: Makafoö, Iehowa, edšake̱ odšiemi, ni ohãã mihenye̱lo̱i ayemi yō̱. Lal.

english_verse: Your anger lasts a little while, but your kindness lasts for a lifetime. At night we may cry, but when morning comes we will celebrate.
translation_verse: Nyelaä nyedšiea Iehowa yi, nye mei ní dši emei kroṅkroṅi le̱, ni nyedšiea egbe̱i kroṅkroṅ le̱ yi!

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord, and in my prayer I said,
translation_verse: Iehowa, oke̱ omlihĩle̱ le̱ hã migoṅ le̱ mã ši šiṅṅ; ši oke̱ ohĩe tē pe̱ ni mitšui fã.

english_verse: You have turned my sorrow into joyful dancing. No longer am I sad and wearing sackcloth.
translation_verse: Bo toi, Iehowa, ni onami mo̱bo̱! Iehowa, ye obuami!

english_verse: I thank you from my heart, and I will never stop singing your praises, my Lord and my God.
translation_verse: Ohã miyāfó etšṍ mīše̱-dšõ̀ ehãmi; odšie mihe kpekpe le̱, ni oke̱ mīše̱ moṅ eṅmõ mihe, Ioh.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hurry to save me. Be my mighty rock and the fortress where I am safe.
translation_verse: Iehowa, bo abo mibaá, kāhã mihĩe migbo gbĩkogbĩko; oke̱ odšale̱ le̱ aheremi!

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! I am hurting and almost blind. My whole body aches.
translation_verse: ni osáko miyi owōko henye̱lo̱ deṅ; moṅ oke̱ *minãdši emãmo̱ heni le̱. *Lal.

english_verse: I hear the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid!” They are plotting and scheming to murder me.
translation_verse: Hĩe ekpa mino̱ tamo̱ gbonyo ni adšie dſëṅmo̱ ye̱ eno̱; mitšṍ tamo̱ noko ni edſa,

english_verse: My life is in your hands. Save me from enemies who hunt me down.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, bo ono̱ mihĩe kã, Iehowa; mike̱ ake̱: Bo dši mi-Nyoṅmo̱!

english_verse: Silence those proud liars! Make them stop bragging and insulting your people.
translation_verse: Iehowa, kāhã mihĩe migbo, ši mibo mītšé̱o; hã meifõdši moṅ ahĩe agboi, ni ame̱to̱ mṹ ye̱ gbohĩīadše.

english_verse: You are wonderful, and while everyone watches, you store up blessings for all who honor and trust you.
translation_verse: Hã nābui ní maleo̱ le̱ abu ame̱nā, mei ní ke̱ hewō ke̱ heguo̱gbē wieo̱ wiemo̱i ní wa ame̱šio̱ dšalo̱ le̱!

english_verse: You are their shelter from harmful plots, and you are their protection from vicious gossip.
translation_verse: Kwe̱ bo̱ni omlihĩle̱ ni oke̱-to ohã mei ni šeo̱o gbeyei le̱ da hã, no odšieo̱ otšõ mei ní baäo abo le ye̱ gbomei ahĩe!

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for showing great kindness when I was like a city under attack.
translation_verse: Oṅõo̱ame̱ *otēo̱ ohĩe tēmo̱he le̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ mei ayino̱kpãṅmo̱i amli; oke̱ame̱ too̱ bu mli nĩgĩnĩgĩ ke̱-dše̱o lile̱i tſā mli. *Lal.

english_verse: I was terrified and thought, “They've chased me far away from you!” But you answered my prayer when I shouted for help.
translation_verse: Aadšie Iehowa yi, edšake̱ edšie *emlihĩle̱ ni yo̱ nākpe̱ le̱ kpo etšõmi ye̱ maṅ ní wa ko mli. *Lal.

english_verse: All who belong to the Lord, show how you love him. The Lord protects the faithful, but he severely punishes everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱ *mikē̱ ye̱ mitšuifā̃ le̱ mli ake̱: Afomi ye̱ ohĩe afõ ši! Kẽle̱, beni mibo mitšé̱o le̱, obo mifaikpamo̱ gbē le̱ toi. *Lal.

english_verse: You bless them by saying, “You told me your sins, without trying to hide them, and now I forgive you.”
translation_verse: Adšō̱ gbomo ni Iehowa ebuu nõša ko ehããle̱, ní apasa be̱ emumo̱ mli le̱!

english_verse: Night and day your hand weighed heavily on me, and my strength was gone as in the summer heat.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ſane ke̱ nyōṅ fẽ le̱ onine tšī ye̱ mino̱; mimlinu ṅã tamo̱ bo̱ni nii amli nu ṅãa ye̱ latšā be mli le̱.

english_verse: So I confessed my sins and told them all to you. I said, “I'll tell the Lord each one of my sins.” Then you forgave me and took away my guilt.
translation_verse: Midšadše mihe eša mitšõo, ni mi-nõša le̱ mike̱-tēē. Mikē̱ ake̱: Madšadše mino̱tõmo̱ matšõ Iehowa! Ni bo le̱ oke̱ mihe eša nõša le̱ fami. Abe̱i

english_verse: We worship you, Lord, and we should always pray whenever we find out that we have sinned. Then we won't be swept away by a raging flood.
translation_verse: Hã mofẽmo ní dši mokroṅkroṅ le̱ akpao ene̱ he fai, be mli ní aanao le̱; le̱le̱ṅ, ké̱ fāi wudši dše ṅã le̱, ame̱še̱ṅ ehe!

english_verse: You are my hiding place! You protect me from trouble, and you put songs in my heart because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Bo dši mitēmo̱he, oobā miyi ye̱ hehīamo̱ mli; oke̱ dšiemo̱ lalai aabo̱lemi ke̱-kpe.

english_verse: You said to me, “I will point out the road that you should follow. I will be your teacher and watch over you.
