translation_verse: Magble odſẽṅmo̱ mli ni matšõo gbe̱ ní onyie no̱; mawoö ṅā, mihĩṅme̱i kã ohe. Lal.

english_verse: Don't be stupid like horses and mules that must be led with ropes to make them obey.”
translation_verse: Nyekatamo̱a okpo̱ṅo̱ lo tedšiokpo̱ṅo̱ ni lee nii, ni ake̱ manyofle̱ ke̱ ehe kpã wooame̱ dãni ame̱tšio amebeṅke̱oo le̱. Abe̱i

english_verse: All kinds of troubles will strike the wicked, but your kindness shields those who trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Pīmo̱i babaō ye̱ hã mofõṅ le̱; ši moni hĩe kã Iehowa no̱ le̱, mo̱bo̱nale̱ aabo̱lele̱ ke̱-kpe.

english_verse: Praise the Lord with harps! Use harps with ten strings to make music for him.
translation_verse: Nyedaã Iehowa ši ke̱ saṅkũ, nyelaä nyedšiea eyi ke̱ kpãinyoṅma saṅkũ! Lal.

english_verse: He scooped up the ocean and stored the water.
translation_verse: *Ebua ṅšo̱ṅ nui le̱ anā glegle, eke̱ nu babaō le̱ to nitōhei. *Lal.

english_verse: As soon as he spoke the world was created; at his command, the earth was formed.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ le̱ ewie, ni eba mli; le̱ efã́, ni ebamā ši.

english_verse: The Lord blesses each nation that worships only him. He blesses his chosen ones.
translation_verse: Adšō̱ maṅ ni e-Nyoṅmo̱ dši Iehowa, maṅ ní ehala efe le̱dientše̱ egbe̱-faṅnõ le̱!

english_verse: The Lord looks at the world
translation_verse: Iehowa dše̱o̱ ṅwei ekwe̱o̱, enaä gbomei abii fẽ;

english_verse: from his throne in heaven, and he watches us all.
translation_verse: edše̱o̱ ešihĩle̱he le̱ ekwe̱o̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ bii fẽ.

english_verse: The Lord gave us each a mind, and nothing we do can be hidden from him.
translation_verse: Le̱ ešõ ame̱fẽ ame̱tšuii, ni enaä ame̱nitšumo̱i fẽ.

english_verse: In war the strength of a horse cannot be trusted to take you to safety.
translation_verse: Ké̱ oṅõ ohĩe ofõ okpo̱ṅo̱ no̱ ake̱-eehereo le̱, yakatſā ni, asaṅ ehewale̱ pī le̱ enyẽṅ eke̱-here moko. Lal.

english_verse: We depend on you, Lord, to help and protect us.
translation_verse: Wo̱susnma mīkwe̱ Iehowa gbe̱; le̱ dši wo̱bualo̱ ke̱ wo̱tše̱ṅ. Lal.

english_verse: You make our hearts glad because we trust you, the only God.
translation_verse: Emli wo̱náa tšuidšũrõ ye̱, edšake̱ egbe̱i kroṅkroṅ le̱ no̱ wo̱hĩe kã.

english_verse: Be kind and bless us! We depend on you.
translation_verse: Iehowa, hã omo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱ ahĩ wo̱-no̱, tamo̱ bo̱ni wo̱hĩe kã ono̱ le̱!

english_verse: I asked the Lord for help, and he saved me from all my fears.
translation_verse: Nyeke̱mi akafoa Iehowa dale̱ le̱, ni nyehãa wo̱fẽ wo̱wóa egbe̱i le̱ no̱!

english_verse: I was a nobody, but I prayed, and the Lord saved me from all my troubles.
translation_verse: Mei ni ṅõo̱ ame̱hĩe ame̱fõo̱ eno̱ le̱ ame̱he tšeo̱ame̱, ni ame̱hĩe eſieṅ ši gbĩkogbĩko.

english_verse: Discover for yourself that the Lord is kind. Come to him for protection, and you will be glad.
translation_verse: Iehowa bo̱fo le̱ bo̱ō̱ nsra ye̱ mei ni šeo̱le̱ gbeyei le̱ ahe ke̱-kpeo̱, ni edšieo̱-ame̱.

english_verse: Honor the Lord! You are his special people. No one who honors the Lord will ever be in need.
translation_verse: *Nyesaã nyenā nyekwe̱a, ni nyeana ake̱ Iehowa hi; adšō̱ gbomo ní baäle̱ abo le̱. *

english_verse: Come, my children, listen as I teach you to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Efĩo̱ dšatabii ni hõmo̱ yeo̱ame̱; ši mei ní taoo̱ Iehowa se̱gbe̱ le̱, nõkpakpa ko ehĩaṅame̱. Lal.

english_verse: Then don't say cruel things and don't tell lies.
translation_verse: *Namo taoo̱ ake̱ eyi aná wala ni esumoo̱ ake̱ etše̱ ye̱ dšeṅ ní ena nõ-kpakpa? *

english_verse: Do good instead of evil and try to live at peace.
translation_verse: Mõ olile̱i mli ní ekafe efõṅ, ke̱ onābui hũ ní ekawie apasawiemo̱!

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, he will watch over you and answer your prayers.
translation_verse: W̌ī efõṅ, ni ofe ekpakpa, taomo̱ hedšo̱le̱ ni onyie no se̱! Lal.

english_verse: But God despises evil people, and he will wipe them all from the earth, till they are forgotten.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa hīṅme̱i kã dšalo̱i ahe, ni efeo̱ toi ehãa ame̱blo̱mo̱i le̱.

english_verse: When his people pray for help, he listens and rescues them from their troubles.
translation_verse: Efõṅfelo̱i le̱ Iehowa dšieo̱ ehīe ekáa-ame̱, ní efo *ame̱kaimo̱ se̱ ke̱-dše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱. *Abe̱i

english_verse: The Lord is there to rescue all who are discouraged and have given up hope.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱i le̱ blo̱ö̱, ni Iehowa boo̱ toi ni ehereo̱ame̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ ame̱ſĩmo̱i fẽ mli.

english_verse: Not one of their bones will ever be broken.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱ amanehũlũi fáa babaō, ši Iehowa dšieo̱le̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ fẽ mli.

english_verse: The Lord saves the lives of his servants. Run to him for protection, and you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Efõṅ aagbe efõṅfelo̱, ni mei ní nye̱o̱ dšalo̱ le̱ aabuame̱ fo̱.

english_verse: Aim your spear at everyone who hunts me down, but promise to save me.
translation_verse: Gblamo̱ akplo̱ le̱ hũ ni otšī mei ni nyie mise̱ le̱ agbe! Kē̱mo̱ misusuma ake̱: Midši oyiwalaheremo̱!

english_verse: Send your angel after them and let them be like straw in the wind.
translation_verse: Hã ame̱tšṍmo̱ tamo̱ tutū ye̱ kō̱yo̱ nā, ni Iehowa bo̱fo le̱ awoame̱ foi!

english_verse: I did them no harm, but they hid a net to trap me, and they dug a deep pit to catch and kill me.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ame̱tšõ̀mi tšõne ame̱ke̱-tē bu mli ní *dše̱e̱ noko hewo̱, ame̱tša bu amehã misusuma ní dše̱e̱ noko hewo. *K.

english_verse: I will celebrate and be joyful because you, Lord, have saved me.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱ misusuma mli aaflile̱ ye̱ Iehowa mli, emī aaše̱ ehe ye̱ eyiwalaheremo̱ le̱ mli.

english_verse: Every bone in my body will shout: “No one is like the Lord!” You protect the helpless from those in power; you save the poor and needy from those who hurt them.
translation_verse: Miwui le̱ fẽ aake ake̱: Iehowa, namo tamo̱ bo? Ni oodšieo̱ nõnalo̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ moni he wa fèle̱ le̱ deṅ, nõnalo̱ ke̱ moni efīle̱ fẽ ke̱-dše̱o̱ moni tſaäle̱ odšo le̱ deṅ le̱.

english_verse: Liars accuse me of crimes I know nothing about.
translation_verse: Odasefoi kũtũmpo̱foi teo̱ ši; ame̱-bibīo̱mi nibii ni milee.

english_verse: When they were sick, I wore sackcloth and went without food. I truly prayed for them,
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, *ké̱ amehe mīye le̱, mitade ni miwoo dši kpekpe, mike̱ ṅmā̃hĩle̱ waä misusuma yi, miso̱lemo̱ kũo̱ se̱ baſieo mimīnā. *Rom.

english_verse: as I would for a friend or a relative. I was in sorrow and mourned, as I would for my mother.
translation_verse: Minyieo̱ mo̱bo̱mo̱bo̱ tamo̱ noni minanyo lo minyeminū ni, mimãa miyi ši diṅṅ miyeo̱ ṅko̱mo̱ tamo̱ moko ní fóo̱ enye.

english_verse: And when your people meet, I will praise you and thank you, Lord, in front of them all.
translation_verse: Madao ši ye̱ asafo kple mli, ma-dšie oyi ye̱ mei pī ateṅ. Lal.

english_verse: They say hurtful things, and they lie to people who want to live in peace.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ame̱wiee hedšo̱le̱ wiemo̱, ši kũtũmpo̱o sãdši ame̱dſẽṅo̱ ye̱ mei ní yo̱ kpō ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ ahe.

english_verse: They are quick to accuse me. They say, “You did it! We saw you ourselves.”
translation_verse: Ame̱gbe̱o̱ ame̱dāṅ hatō ame̱woo̱mi, ame̱kē̱o̱ ake̱: “Yie̱, yie̱! wo̱na ke̱ wo̱-hĩṅme̱ii!” Lal.

english_verse: You see everything, Lord! Please don't keep silent or stay so far away.
translation_verse: Iehowa, ona; kāfe diṅṅ! Nuṅtšo̱, oke̱mi teṅ akadšeke̱!

english_verse: and prove that I am right by your standards. Don't let them laugh at me
translation_verse: Iehowa, mi-Nyoṅmo̱, kodšomo̱mi ye̱ odšale̱ le̱ nā, ni kāhã ame̱mīyemi yō̱!

english_verse: or say to each other, “Now we've got what we want! We'll gobble him up!”
translation_verse: Kāhã ame̱mīkē̱ ye̱ ame̱tšuiiaṅ ake̱: Yie̱! bo̱ni wo̱taoo̱ ne̱l Kāhã ame̱mīkē̱ ake̱: Wo̱nine egbele̱!

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who are glad to see me in trouble; disgrace and embarrass my proud enemies who say to me, “You are nothing!”
translation_verse: Mei ni nyã́a ye̱ mimanehũlũ hewo̱ le̱, *hã ame̱hĩe agboi, ame̱hĩe agboi ni ame̱hĩe aſie ši; mei ní tšé̱o̱ ame̱he odšei ye̱ mino̱ le̱, hã ame̱ha hĩegbĕle ke̱ he-guo̱gbē tamo̱ mama! *K.

english_verse: Let all who want me to win be happy and joyful. From now on let them say, “The Lord is wonderful! God is glad when all goes well for his servant.”
translation_verse: Mei ní náa midšale̱ le̱ he mīše̱ le̱, hã ame̱bo̱ oše ke̱ nyã́mo̱; ame̱kē̱ dā ake: Iehowa dše agbo, le̱ moni enáa etšũlo̱ edšũrõyeli he mīše̱ le̱! Lal.

english_verse: Then I will shout all day, “Praise the Lord God! He did what was right.”
translation_verse: Ni milile̱i aagba odšale̱ ke̱ oyidšie-mo̱ le̱ he sane dāne̱.

english_verse: They tell deceitful lies, and they don't have the sense to live right.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ elakaä ehe ye̱ le̱dientše̱ ehĩṅme̱iiaṅ, ake̱ anaṅ enõša le̱ ni aanyãṅe.

english_verse: Those people stay awake, thinking up mischief, and they follow the wrong road, refusing to turn from sin.
translation_verse: Edāṅ wiemo̱i le̱, nišaianii ke̱ šišiumo̱ ni; ešī nilē ke̱ ekpakpafemo̱ se̱.

english_verse: Your love is a treasure, and everyone finds shelter in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Odšale̱ le̱ tamo̱ Mawu *gõdši le̱, okodšome̱i le̱ hũ bu kwo̱ṅkwo̱ṅ ni. Iehowa, bo obāa gbomei ke̱ koloi fẽ yi. *Lal.

english_verse: You give your guests a feast in your house, and you serve a tasty drink that flows like a river.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱, kwe̱ bo̱ni omlihĩle̱ le̱ dšra wa hã, ní gbomei abii baä ofĩdši ašiši hō̃ṅ le̱ṅ abo!

english_verse: The life-giving fountain belongs to you, and your light gives light to each of us.
translation_verse: Ame̱atŏ̱ro̱ naakpa ke̱ owe le̱ fo̱ le̱, ni oohã amenu omīše̱ fā le̱ eko. Lal.

english_verse: Our Lord, keep showing love to everyone who knows you, and use your power to save all whose thoughts please you.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo oṅõ *wala nubu yo̱; ola le̱ mlĩ wo̱naä la ye̱. *Ier.

english_verse: Don't let those proud and merciless people kick me around or chase me away.
translation_verse: Hã omlihĩle̱ le̱ se̱ atše̱ ahã mei ni leo le̱, ke̱ odšale̱ le̱ hũ, hã mei ní dša ye̱ ame̱tšuii amli le̱.

english_verse: Look at those wicked people! They are knocked down, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Kāhã hewolo nane minānāmi, kāhã meifõdši anine mīwomi foi!

english_verse: Merciless people make plots against good people and snarl like animals,
translation_verse: Mofõṅ kpãṅo̱ dšalo̱ yi no̱, ni ekpeo̱ enyãnyõdši ašiši eſieo̱ eno̱;

english_verse: but the Lord laughs and knows their time is coming soon.
translation_verse: ši Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ ṅmõo̱le̱, edšake̱ enaä ake̱ *egbĩ le̱ mīše̱. *Hiob

english_verse: The wicked will lose all of their power, but the Lord gives strength to everyone who is good.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ meifõdši anidši aakũmo̱; ši dšalo̱i le̱, Iehowa hĩeo̱ ame̱mli.

english_verse: Everyone the Lord blesses will receive the land; everyone the Lord curses will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mei ní edsō̱ le̱, šikpoṅ le̱ aatšṍ ame̱nõ; ši mei ni elomo̱ le̱, aaflo̱ame̱ aſie. K.

english_verse: As long as I can remember, good people have never been left helpless, and their children have never gone begging for food.
translation_verse: Sá le̱ gbekẽ dšimi ni agbe̱ne̱ mitšṍ nūmo, ši mináko dšalo̱ ko ní akwale̱ lo ní esešibii mīsisẽ abolo pẽṅ. Lal.

english_verse: They gladly give and lend, and their children turn out good.
translation_verse: Dāne̱ enaä mo̱bo̱ ni efaä mo nõ, ni esešibii le̱ tšṍo̱ dšō̱mo̱.

english_verse: If you stop sinning and start doing right, you will keep living and be secure forever.
translation_verse: W̌ī efõṅ ni ofe ekpakpa, ni ohĩ ši ke̱-ya nāno̱. Lal.

english_verse: The Lord loves justice, and he won't ever desert his faithful people. He always protects them, but destroys the children of the wicked.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa sumoo̱ dšale̱ saneyeli, ni ekwaa emei kroṅkroṅi le̱. Abaa ame̱yi ke̱-yaã nāno̱; ši meifõdši asešibii le̱ aaflo̱ame̱ aſie. Lal.

english_verse: God's people will own the land and live here forever.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱i le̱, šikpoṅ le̱ aatšṍ ame̱nõ ni ame̱ahĩ no̱ dä. Ies.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come when good people speak for justice.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱ nābu wieo̱ nilē wiemo̱, ni elile̱i hũ wieo̱ noni dša.

english_verse: The wicked try to trap and kill good people,
translation_verse: Mofõṅ hĩe sãṅo̱ dšalo̱ ni etaoo̱le̱ egbe. Lal.

english_verse: but the Lord is on their side, and he will defend them when they are on trial.
translation_verse: Iehowa eṅmē̃ṅ ehe ewoṅ edeṅ, ni ké̱ akodšole̱ le̱, ebuṅle̱ fo̱. Lal.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and follow him. He will give you the land, and you will see the wicked destroyed.
translation_verse: Kwe̱mo̱ Iehowa gbe̱ ni onyie egbe le̱ no̱, ni eewó ono̱, koni šikpoṅ le̱ atšṍ onõ; beni aaflo̱ meifõdši le̱, oona. K.

english_verse: I have seen brutal people abuse others and grow strong like trees in rich soil.
translation_verse: Mina mofõṅ yiwalo̱ ko, ni ebú tamo̱ tšo kusū ni ená mā̃he; Hiob

english_verse: Suddenly they disappeared! I looked, but they were gone and no longer there.
translation_verse: ši beni miyatšṍ dše̱i le̱, na, ebe̱; mibi eši, ši anaale̱. K.

english_verse: Think of the bright future waiting for all the families of honest, innocent, and peace-loving people.
translation_verse: Sramo̱ moni hĩ ke̱-wula ši, ni okwe̱ moni dša le̱; edšake̱ nakai gbomo le̱, aahĩ ahãle̱ wó̱se̱.

english_verse: But not a trace will be left of the wicked or their families.
translation_verse: Ši notõloi le̱, aakpãtã ame̱hĩe šikōme; meifõdši awó̱se̱be le̱ se̱ aafo.

english_verse: The Lord protects his people, and they can come to him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Ši dšalo̱i le̱ ayiwalaheremo̱ le̱ dše̱ Iehowa ṅõ; le̱ dši ame̱mō̃ ye̱ fĩmo̱ be mli. Lal.

english_verse: The Lord helps his people and saves them from the wicked because they run to him.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa yeo̱ buaä-ame̱ ni edšieo̱ame̱; edšieo̱ame̱ ye̱ meifõdši adeṅ ni ehereo̱ ame̱yi wala; edšake̱ ame̱yabale̱ abo. Luk.

english_verse: You shot me with your arrows, and you struck me with your hand.
translation_verse: Iehowa, kākãmi ye̱ omlifũ mli, ni kāgbla mitoi ye̱ omlila mli!

english_verse: My body is twisted and bent, and I groan all day long.
translation_verse: Mifadši le̱ mīdše fũ, ame̱kpo̱to̱ ye̱ mikwašiafemo̱ le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: Fever has my back in flames, and I hurt everywhere.
translation_verse: Mido̱ ko̱mō̱, ní mimã miyi ši naakpa; dāne̱ minyie mo̱bo̱mo̱bo̱.

english_verse: I am worn out and weak, moaning and in distress.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mihe̱ mli fẽ ewo la, ni mihewodšiaṅ edšo̱o̱mi.

english_verse: You, Lord, know every one of my deepest desires, and my noisy groans are no secret to you.
translation_verse: Migbo̱dšo̱ ni mikũmo̱ kwrā; mitšuiṅ hū̃mo̱ hewo̱ le̱ midſa yāfó.

english_verse: My heart is beating fast. I feel weak all over, and my eyes are red.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱, noni mi fẽ dſere ohĩe, ni mikē̃mo̱ le̱ aṅō-tēkoö.

english_verse: Because of my sickness, no friends or neighbors will come near me.
translation_verse: Mitšui tſaä kplakpla, mihewale̱ mītã, ni mihĩṅme̱iiaṅ ala le̱, no hũ edše mihe.

english_verse: I am completely deaf and can't make a sound.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱ mitamo̱ toimũlo̱, ni minuu nii, ni mitamo̱ mũmũi hũ ní gblee edāṅ. Lal.

english_verse: I trust you, Lord God, and you will do something.
translation_verse: Ni mitšṍ tamo̱ moko ní nuu nii ni sanenādšiemo̱ ko be̱ enā.

english_verse: I said, “Don't let them laugh or brag when I slip and fall.”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo, Iehowa, gbe mikwe̱o̱; bo obahã hetō, Nuṅtšo̱, mi-Nyoṅmo̱.

english_verse: I am about to collapse from constant pain.
translation_verse: Ši mikē̱ ake̱: Ame̱kayemi yō̱! Ké̱ minane šãne le̱, ame̱atšé̱ ame̱he odšei ye̱ mino̱.

english_verse: I told you my sins, and I am sorry for them.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱ mihe magbe ši, ni miko̱mo̱ le̱ ye̱ mihĩe dā.

english_verse: Many deadly and powerful enemies hate me,
translation_verse: Ši madšadše minõša le̱, ni mihe eša le̱ aado̱mi. Lal.

english_verse: and they repay evil for good because I try to do right.
translation_verse: Ši mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ ke̱ ame̱he efõõ ši, ni ame̱he wa, ni mei ni he tšẽo̱mi yakatſā le̱ ayi fá.

english_verse: You are the Lord God! Stay nearby and don't desert me.
translation_verse: Ni mei ni ṅõo̱ efõṅ too̱ ekpakpa nādšiaṅ le̱, etšṍmo̱ mihenye̱lo̱i ye̱ ekpakpa se̱ ní minyie le̱ hewo̱. Lal.

english_verse: You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Iehowa, kāšĩmi; mi-Nyoṅmo̱, oke̱-mi teṅ akadšeke̱!

english_verse: “Please, Lord, show me my future. Will I soon be gone?
translation_verse: Mitšui he do̱ la ye̱ mimli, beni misusuo̱ miyiṅ le̱, la le̱ here, ni mike̱ milile̱i wie.

english_verse: “What am I waiting for? I depend on you, Lord!
translation_verse: Gbomo-fẽ-gbomo nyieo̱ tamo̱ hō̃ṅ, ame̱gbaä ame̱he nā yakatſā; *etīaä nii, ši elee moni baye. *Dšadš.

english_verse: Save me from my sins. Don't let fools sneer at me.
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱, Nuṅtšo̱, meni gbe̱ mikwe̱o̱? bo ono̱ mihĩe kã!

english_verse: You treated me like this, and I kept silent, not saying a word.
translation_verse: Dšiemo̱mi ke̱-dše̱ mino̱tõmo̱i le̱ fẽ mli; kāhã kwašiai mībo̱mi ahora.

english_verse: “Listen, Lord, to my prayer! My eyes are flooded with tears, as I pray to you. I am merely a stranger visiting in your home as my ancestors did.
translation_verse: Ké̱ oke̱ hĩekãmo̱ migbla moko toi ye̱ nõša ko hewo̱ le̱, ohãa ehefe̱o le̱ tãa tamo̱ omlẽgẽ. Le̱le̱ṅ gbomo-fẽ-gbomo le̱, lamo̱ ke̱ke̱ dšile̱! K.

english_verse: Stop being angry with me and let me smile again before I am dead and gone.”
translation_verse: Iehowa, bo mifaikpamo̱ lo̱ toi, ni oka toi ohã miblo̱mo̱ le̱! Kābu onā hũ ye̱ mihĩeyāfónui le̱ ahe! Edšake̱ *owe gbo̱ dšimi ke̱ mokpõṅ tamo̱ mitše̱mei le̱ fẽ. *

english_verse: I patiently waited, Lord, for you to hear my prayer. You listened
translation_verse: David lala ni eke̱-hã lalatše̱ nukpa le̱.

english_verse: You bless all of those who trust you, Lord, and refuse to worship idols or follow false gods.
translation_verse: ni eke̱ *lala he ewo midāṅ, ni dši yidšiemo̱ ní sa wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱. Mei babaō aana ni ame̱aše gbeyei, ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱hĩe aafo Iehowa no̱. *Lal.

english_verse: And so, I said, “I am here to do what is written about me in the book, where it says,
translation_verse: *Afo̱le ke̱ niyenii-afo̱le le̱ onyã́ã́ he, ši moṅ †ogble mitoiṅ. Šã-afo̱le ke̱ eša-afo̱le le, otaoo. *Lal.

english_verse: ‘I enjoy pleasing you. Your Law is in my heart.’ ”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mike̱: Na, miba; aṅmã mihe sane ye̱ wolokpo le̱ mli.

english_verse: When your people worshiped, you know I told them, “Our Lord always helps!”
translation_verse: Mi-Nyoṅmo̱, eṅõ minā ake̱ mafe osuomo̱nānii ni omla le̱ ye̱ mitšui mli.

english_verse: When all your people met, I did not keep silent. I said, “Our Lord is kind. He is faithful and caring, and he saves us.”
translation_verse: Midšadše dšale̱ he sane ye̱ asafo kple le̱ mli; na, mimūako minā, Iehowa, ole! Lal.

english_verse: Please show that you care and come to my rescue. Hurry and help me!
translation_verse: Edšake̱ efõdši ní anyẽṅ akane ebo̱lemi ke̱-kpe; minišaianii le̱ etšṍ mimli, ni minyẽẽ mihĩe no̱ mawó; ame̱fá fè mi-yĩteṅ tšo̱ii, ni mitšui efã ye̱ mimli po. (K.

english_verse: Disgrace and confuse all who want me dead; turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Iehowa, ofai ne̱, ni odšiemi; Iehowa, ye obuami oyá!

english_verse: Our Lord, let your worshipers rejoice and be glad. They love you for saving them, so let them always say, “The Lord is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Mei ni kē̱o̱mi ake̱: Yie̱, yie̱! le̱, hã ame̱he adšõ ame̱he ye̱ ame̱hĩegbĕle le̱ hewo̱. Lal.

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but, Lord God, you care about me, and you come to my rescue. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Hã mei fẽ ni taoo̱ ose̱gbe̱ le̱ anyã́ ni ame̱mī aše̱ ame̱he ye̱ omli; hã mei ni sumoo̱ oyiwalaheremo̱ le hũ akē̱ dã ake̱: Iehowa dše agbo!

english_verse: You protect them and keep them alive. You make them happy here in this land, and you don't hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Adšō̱ moni dſẽṅo̱ ohĩafo no̱! Gbĩ fõṅ no̱ le̱ Iehowa aadšiele̱. Abe̱i

english_verse: My vicious enemies ask me, “When will you die and be forgotten?”
translation_verse: Mikē̱ ake̱: Iehowa, nami mo̱bo̱! Tšá misusuma, ši mife eša mišio. Lal.

english_verse: and they say, “You have some fatal disease! You'll never get well.”
translation_verse: Mei fē-kwa ní nye̱o̱mi le̱, ame̱wieo̱ mihe able̱bi, ame̱susuo̱ mihe efõṅ,

english_verse: My most trusted friend has turned against me, though he ate at my table.
translation_verse: ame̱kē̱o̱ ake̱: “Hela fõṅ ko emõle̱ wā, ni ši ní ekã ne̱, eteṅ ši doṅṅ!”

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! Heal me, so I can pay them back.
translation_verse: Midientše̱ mišientše̱ po ni miheo̱le̱ miyeo̱, moni *yeo̱ mideṅ ṅmā̃ le̱, efã enane ešimi. *Lal.

english_verse: Then my enemies won't defeat me, and I will know that you really care.
translation_verse: Ši bo, Iehowa, nami mo̱bo̱, ni otēmi ši, koni mawoame̱ he nyõmo̱!

english_verse: You have helped me because I am innocent, and you will always be close to my side.
translation_verse: Ene̱ mike̱-aale ake̱ oye̱ mihe tšui, ake̱ mihenye̱lo̱ yeṅmi yō̱.

english_verse: You, the Lord God of Israel, will be praised forever! Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Ni mi le̱, ohĩe mimli ye̱ mimūyeli le̱ mli, ni oke̱mi edamo̱ ohĩe ke̱-mīya nāno̱.

english_verse: As a deer gets thirsty for streams of water, I truly am thirsty for you, my God.
translation_verse: Korabii le̱ ase̱yōmo̱ lala ní ake̱-há lalatše̱ nukpa le̱.

english_verse: Your vicious waves have swept over me like an angry ocean or a roaring waterfall.
translation_verse: Misusuma edo̱ ko̱mō̱ ye̱ mimli, nohewo̱ le̱ mikaio̱o ye̱ Iordan šikpoṅ le̱ ke̱ Hermon gõdši le̱ ke̱ Mizar goṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock. Why have you forgotten me? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: ſane le̱ Iehowa aafã́ emlihĩle̱ le̱, ni nyōṅ le̱ mala mahãle̱, ni maso̱le ma-tšé̱ miwala Mawu le̱.

english_verse: Even my bones are in pain, while all day long my enemies sneer and ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Makē̱ Mawu ní dši *mite̱sā le̱ ake̱: Mẽba ohĩe ekpa mino̱? †Mẽba minyieo̱ mo̱bo̱mo̱bo̱ ye̱ haomo̱ ní henye̱lo̱ haoo̱mi hewo̱ ne̱? *

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Ahora ni mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ bo̱ö̱mi le̱ tamo̱ klante ye̱ miwui amli, edšake̱ ame̱-kē̱o̱mi dā ake̱: Nẽgbe̱ o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ yo̱?

english_verse: I run to you for protection. Why do you turn me away? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo, Nyoṅmo̱, dši mimō̃. Miba oše̱mi ofõ? *Mẽba minyieo̱ mo̱bo̱mo̱bo̱ ye̱ haomo̱ ní henye̱lo̱ haoo̱mi hewo̱ ne̱? *Lal.

english_verse: Send your light and your truth to guide me. Let them lead me to your house on your sacred mountain.
translation_verse: Hã ola ke̱ ono̱kwale le̱ aba, ni ame̱batšõmi gbe̱, ni ame̱ke̱mi aya *ogoṅ kroṅkroṅ le̱ no ke̱ ošihĩlehei le̱. *Lal.

english_verse: Then I will worship at your altar because you make me joyful. You are my God, and I will praise you. Yes, I will praise you as I play my harp.
translation_verse: No le̱ mate Nyoṅmo̱ afo̱lesãlate̱ le̱ he, ke̱ Mawu ni dši *mimliflimo̱ kpeteṅkple le̱ ṅõ, ni madšie oyi ke̱ saṅkũ, Nyoṅmo̱, mi-Nyoṅmo̱! *Lal.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Mẽ ko̱mō̱ odo̱ ne̱, misusuma? Ni mẽ yeyēye ofe ye̱ mimli ne̱? Oke̱ ohĩe afõ Nyoṅmo̱ no̱! Ši madšie eyi kẽ, moni dši mihĩe yeli-ke-buamo̱ ke̱ mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱. Lal

english_verse: You chased off the nations by causing them trouble with your powerful arm. Then you let our ancestors take over their land.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱, wo̱nu ke̱ wo̱toii, wo̱tše̱mei egbawo̱, no nii ní otšu ye̱ ame̱yino̱, blema le̱.

english_verse: Their strength and weapons were not what won the land and gave them victory! You loved them and fought with your powerful arm and your shining glory.
translation_verse: Bo oke̱ onine ſie mãdši le̱, ni ote̱o-ame̱ ye̱ dše̱i; oplenẽ mãdši le̱, ši ame̱ le̱ ohã ame̱gbla nidši.

english_verse: By your great power, we knocked our enemies down and trampled on them.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱, bo noṅṅ dši mimaṅtše̱: fá ní Iakob aná yiwalaheremo̱! Lal.

english_verse: I don't depend on my arrows or my sword to save me.
translation_verse: Bo wo̱ke̱-tšire̱o̱ wo̱henye̱lo̱i wo̱tſiaä ši; ogbe̱i wo̱ke̱-nānāa mei ní teo̱ ši woo̱wo̱ le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: You let us be slaughtered like sheep, and you scattered us among the nations.
translation_verse: Ohãa wo̱tšṍo̱ wo̱se̱ wo̱hãa henye̱lo̱, ni mei ní he tšẽo̱wo̱ le̱ haã wo̱nii.

english_verse: You sold your people for little or nothing, and you earned no profit.
translation_verse: Oṅõwo̱ ohã ni ayewo̱ tamo̱ tōi, ni ogbe̱wo̱ oſã dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ.

english_verse: You made us look foolish to our neighbors; people who live nearby insult us and sneer.
translation_verse: Ohõ omaṅ le̱ ni ohee noko, ni ohãã ame̱yinii le̱ afá po.

english_verse: Foreigners joke about us and shake their heads.
translation_verse: Obo̱wo̱ ahora otšõ wo̱kūṅbii, mei ní bo̱lewo̱ le̱ yeo̱ wohe fe̱o ni ame̱ṅmõowo̱. Lal.

english_verse: But others mock and sneer, as they watch my enemies take revenge on me.
translation_verse: Mihe guo̱ ni egbo le̱ ye̱ mihĩe dāne̱, ni mihĩegbĕle le̱ hũ eha mihe,

english_verse: All this happened to us, though we didn't forget you or break our agreement.
translation_verse: ye̱ ahorabo̱lo̱ ke̱ sopalo̱ le̱ gbẽ hewo̱, ye̱ henye̱lo̱ ke̱ oweleto̱lo̱ le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: We always kept you in mind and followed your teaching.
translation_verse: Ene̱mei fē eba wo̱no̱, ši kẽle̱ wo̱hĩe kpako ono̱, ui wo̱yeko okpãṅmo̱ le̱ he kũtũmpo̱o.

english_verse: But you crushed us, and you covered us with deepest darkness where wild animals live.
translation_verse: Wo̱tšui kpaleko ke̱-yako se̱, ni wo̱nãdši hũ edšeko ogbe̱ le̱ no̱;

english_verse: We did not forget you or lift our hands in prayer to foreign gods.
translation_verse: ši okũmo̱wo̱ butubutu ye̱ ṅãṅgbēi ahĩle̱he, ni oke̱ gbĕlehō̃ṅ eha wo̱no̱.

english_verse: You would have known it because you discover every secret thought.
translation_verse: Edši wo̱hĩe ekpa wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ gbei le̱ no̱ ni wo̱yagbe̱ wo̱nidšiaṅ wo̱hā maṅse̱ nyoṅmo̱ ko kũle̱,

english_verse: We face death all day for you. We are like sheep on their way to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: ani Nyoṅmo̱ taoṅ ene̱ mli? Edšake̱ ele tšuiiaṅ tēmo̱nii le̱! Lal.

english_verse: Why do you keep looking away? Don't forget our sufferings and all our troubles.
translation_verse: Ohĩe atšẽ! Nuṅtšo̱, mẽba owo̱ö̱? Wó ohe no̱, kāše̱re̱wo̱ oſie ke̱-mīya nāno̱! Lal.

english_verse: We are flat on the ground, holding on to the dust.
translation_verse: Mẽhewo̱ oke̱ ohĩe tēo̱, ni ohĩe kpaä wo̱manehũlũ ke̱ yi ni awaãwo̱ le̱ no̱? Lal.

english_verse: Do something! Help us! Show how kind you are and come to our rescue.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ wo̱susuma edo̱ emli ke̱-te sũ mli tō̃, wo̱mũsũ hũ kpe̱te̱ šikpoṅ.

english_verse: and ride out in splendor! Win victories for truth and mercy and justice. Do fearsome things with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Ekãlo̱, oke̱ oklante aṅmõ ohe̱, ke̱ onumnyam le̱ ke̱ ogbodsē le̱ fẽ!

english_verse: You are God, and you will rule forever as king. Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Ogãimlibii le̱ anā ba; mãdši le̱ tſiatſiaä ši ye̱ ohĩe; ame̱tšuro̱ö̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ henye̱lo̱i le̱ atšuiiaṅ!

english_verse: The sweet aroma of the spices myrrh, aloes, and cassia covers your royal robes. You enjoy the music of harps in palaces decorated with ivory.
translation_verse: Osumoo̱ dšale̱ ni onye̱o̱ nifõdšianii; hewo̱ le̱ Nyoṅmo̱, ní dši o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ke̱ mliflimo̱ mũ le̱ efo̱o fè onanemei.

english_verse: Daughters of kings are here, and your bride stands at your right side, wearing a wedding gown trimmed with pure gold.
translation_verse: Otadei le̱ fẽ mli dšeo̱ ṅma ke̱ mire ke̱ aloë ke̱ kasia so̱ṅṅ, saṅkũi ní atſaä ye̱ *ſuo̱wu mõdši le̱ amli le̱ hãa omī še̱o̱ ohe. *Amos

english_verse: Bride of the king, listen carefully to me. Forget your own people and your father's family.
translation_verse: Maṅtše̱mei abiyei ye̱ oyei dšudši le̱ ateṅ; maṅnye le̱ wo Ofir šika ke̱-damo̱ oninedšũrõ no̱.

english_verse: The king adores you. He is your master, so do what he desires.
translation_verse: Bo toi, biyō, ni okwe̱, ni oba otoi ši, ni ohã ohĩe adše bodientše̱ omaṅbii le̱ ke̱ otše̱ we le̱ no̱,

english_verse: All of the richest people from the city of Tyre will try to influence you
translation_verse: ni maṅtše̱ le̱ hĩe ado̱ ohefe̱o le̱ no̱, edšake̱ le̱ dši onuṅtšo̱, nohewo̱ le̱ dšále̱!

english_verse: with precious treasures. Your bride, my king, has inward beauty, and her wedding gown is woven with threads of gold.
translation_verse: Ni Tiro biyō le̱ ke̱ mã le̱ṅ niiatše̱mei le̱ tete ke̱ kẽnii aaba abatao ohĩe gbe̱.

english_verse: Wearing the finest garments, she is brought to you, followed by her young friends, the bridesmaids.
translation_verse: Maṅtše̱ biyō le̱ ni yo̱ mō̃ le̱ṅ le̱, anumnyam so̱ṅṅ dšile̱; etade le̱ ake̱ šika alò mli.

english_verse: Everyone is excited, as they follow you to the royal palace.
translation_verse: Ewo atade ni aye mli ṅābii, awaä-le̱ ke̱-baä maṅtše̱ le̱ ṅõ; enanemei oblayei ní nyie ese̱ le̱, aṅõo̱ame̱ abahãao.

english_verse: Your sons and your grandsons will also be kings as your ancestors were. You will make them rulers everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ake̱ame̱ foo̱ ši ke̱ nyã́mo̱ ke̱ mïi-flimo̱, ni ame̱baä maṅtše̱ mō̃ le̱ mli.

english_verse: I will make your name famous from now on, and you will be praised forever and ever.
translation_verse: Obihĩĩ le̱ aabaye otše̱mei le̱ anā-dšiaṅ; oowoame̱ lume̱i ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ fē.

english_verse: God is our mighty fortress, always ready to help in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Korabii le̱ alala ní ake̱-hã lalatše̱ nukpa le̱, ni ake̱ oblayei agbē ala.

english_verse: God is in that city, and it won't be shaken. He will help it at dawn.
translation_verse: Fā ko ye̱ ní enidši le̱ hãa Nyoṅmo̱ maṅ le̱ mī še̱o̱ ehe, moni yo̱ ṅwei šoṅṅ le̱ šihĩle̱hei kroṅkroṅi le̱. Lal.

english_verse: Nations rage! Kingdoms fall! But at the voice of God the earth itself melts.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱ ye̱ eteṅ, edidãṅ; Nyoṅmo̱ aaye abuale̱ lebi mā̃ṅkpa.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Dšeṅmãdšì le̱ feo̱ hō, maṅtše̱yelii le̱ didãa: Ewoo̱ egbē, ni šikpoṅ le̱ sẽreo̱.

english_verse: Come! See the fearsome things the Lord has done on earth.
translation_verse: Iehowa Zebaot ke̱wo̱ ye̱, wo̱bobāhe dši Iakob Nyoṅmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: God brings wars to an end all over the world. He breaks the arrows, shatters the spears, and burns the shields.
translation_verse: *Nyebaä nyebakwe̱a Iehowa nitsumo̱i le̱, no hĩekpãtãmo̱ ni ehã eba šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱! *

english_verse: Our God says, “Calm down, and learn that I am God! All nations on earth will honor me.”
translation_verse: Ehãa *tai ase̱ foo̱ ke̱-yaã šikpoṅ le nāgbēhei le̱, ekũo̱ gai mli, ni efoo̱ akplo̱ mli, ta ſīlii le hũ ešãa ke̱ la. *Lal.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Nyefea diō ni nyenáa nyelea ake̱ midši Nyoṅmo̱; aawó mino̱ godšō ye̱ dšeṅmãdši ateṅ, aawó mino̱ godšō ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱!

english_verse: The Lord Most High is fearsome, the ruler of all the earth.
translation_verse: Nye mădši fẽ-tſẽm, nyetſaä nyedẽ, nyeke̱ nyámo̱ gbē abo̱a oše ahãa Nyoṅmo̱!

english_verse: God has put every nation under our power,
translation_verse: ši Iehowa ṅweinyo le̱ he ye̱ gbeyei, maṅtše̱ kple dšile̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ fẽ.

english_verse: and he chose for us the land that was the pride of Jacob, his favorite.
translation_verse: Edšō̱o̱ mãdši ahe ewoo̱ wo̱šišĩ, ke̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱, ewoo̱ wo̱nãdšiaši.

english_verse: God goes up to his throne, as people shout and trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Le̱ ehalaä wo̱gbe̱fãnnõ ehãawo̱, Iakob ní esumoo̱ le̱ agbodšē le̱. Lal.

english_verse: Sing praises to God our King,
translation_verse: Nānyoṅmo̱ ete ṅwei ke̱ ošebō̱, Iehowa hũ ke̱ te̱tre̱mantre̱ gbē. Lal.

english_verse: the ruler of all the earth! Praise God with songs.
translation_verse: Nyelaä nyehãa Nyoṅmo̱, nyelaã ko! Nyelaä nyehãa wo̱maṅtše̱ le̱, nyelaä ko!

english_verse: God rules the nations from his sacred throne.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ šikpoṅ le̱ fẽ maṅtše̱ dši Nyoṅmo̱; nyelaä se̱yōmo̱ lalai ko! Lal.

english_verse: Their leaders come together and are now the people of Abraham's God. All rulers on earth surrender their weapons, and God is greatly praised!
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱ yeo̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ano̱ maṅtše̱, Nyoṅmo̱ tá emaṅtše̱sẽi kroṅkroṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: God is there to defend it and has proved to be its protector.
translation_verse: Maṅtše̱ agbo le̱ *maṅ ni dši Zion goṅ ni ye kōyigbe̱ le̱, ešimā̃ †ye̱ fe̱o, šikpoṅ mū le̱ fẽ tšuihenõ ni. *Mat.

english_verse: Kings joined forces to attack the city,
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱ ehã alele̱ ye̱ emli mōdši le̱ amli ake̱ abobāhe.

english_verse: but when they saw it, they were terrified and ran away.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ na, maṅtše̱mei le̱ anā bakpe ši, ame̱baho yū.

english_verse: They trembled all over like women giving birth
translation_verse: Ame̱na ke̱ke̱ ni ame̱he dšõ ame̱he; ṅmiṅmi mõmo̱ame̱, ame̱te tſratſratſra.

english_verse: or like seagoing ships wrecked by eastern winds.
translation_verse: Hekpokpomo̱ mõmo̱ame̱ ye̱ dše̱i, ke̱ hedšramo̱ tamo̱ yō ni kõmoo̱.

english_verse: You are famous and praised everywhere on earth, as you win victories with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱, wo̱susu omlihĩle̱ le̱ he ye̱ oso̱lemo̱tšũ le̱ teṅ.

english_verse: Mount Zion will celebrate, and all Judah will be glad, because you bring justice.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱, bo̱ni ogbe̱i le̱ yo̱ le̱, nakai noṅṅ oyidšiemo̱ le̱ yo̱ ke̱-yaši šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbēhei le̱; dšale̱ eyi oninedšũrõ obõ.

english_verse: Let's walk around Zion and count its towers.
translation_verse: Hã Zion goṅ le̱ anyã́, ni Iuda biyei le̱ amli afliame̱ ye̱ okodšomo̱i le̱ ahewo̱.

english_verse: We will see its strong walls and visit each fortress. Then you can say to future generations,
translation_verse: Nyenyiea Zion he ni nyebo̱leale̱ kpula; nyekanea emli mõdši ni kwŏ̱lo̱ le̱;

english_verse: “Our God is like this forever and will always guide us.”
translation_verse: nyetẽdšea nyehĩe nyekwe̱a egbogboi le̱, nyekpaä emli mõdši le̱ amli, koni nyegbe yino̱bii ní baä ye̱ se̱ le̱,

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Korabii le̱ alala ní ake̱-hã lalatše̱ nukpa le̱.

english_verse: I have in mind a mystery that I will explain while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Minābu aawie nilē wiemo̱, ni mitšuiṅ susumo̱ dši se̱yōmo̱.

english_verse: It costs far too much to buy back your life. You can never pay God enough
translation_verse: Mokomoko nyẽṅ enyemi ekpõ, lo ni eehã Nyoṅmo̱ eyinii,

english_verse: The grave will be their home forever and ever, although they once had land of their own.
translation_verse: Ši ena ake̱ nilelo̱i tete gboio̱, asaṅ kwašia ke̱ bulu fẽ hĩe kpãtãa, ni ame̱-šĩo̱ ame̱nii le̱ ame̱hãa meikrokomei. Dsads.

english_verse: Soon they will die and all their wealth will be left behind.
translation_verse: Ké̱ moko tšṍ niiatše̱ le̱ ní ewe le̱ anumnyam fá le̱, kāše gbeyei; Hiob

english_verse: We humans are praised when we do well, and all of us are glad to be alive.
translation_verse: edšake̱, ké̱ egbo le̱, eṅõṅ emli eko eko ke̱-yaṅ; enumnyam le̱ kplekeṅ ši ke-nyieṅ ese̱. Dsads.

english_verse: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.
translation_verse: eete etše̱mei ayino̱bii ní enaa la doṅṅ le̱ aṅõ kẽ.

english_verse: Our God approaches, but not silently; a flaming fire comes first, and a storm surrounds him.
translation_verse: Wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ miba, ni efeṅ diō. La nyie ehĩe mīšã nii, ni ahum mĩtſa ke̱-mībo̱lele̱. Lal.

english_verse: God comes to judge his people. He shouts to the heavens and to the earth,
translation_verse: Etšé̱ ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ ke̱-ba, koni ekodšo emaṅ le̱: Ies

english_verse: The heavens announce, “God is the judge, and he is always honest.”
translation_verse: Ni ṅwei aadšadše edsale̱ le̱ atšõ; edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kodšolo̱ dšile̱.

english_verse: My people, I am God! Israel, I am your God. Listen to my charges against you.
translation_verse: Bo toi, mimaṅ, ni mawie, ni magba mli kpo makeo, Israel: Midši Nā-nyoṅmo̱ ni dši o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱!

english_verse: I won't accept your offerings of bulls and goats.
translation_verse: Mitaoo owe le̱ tšinanū ko, lo otōi-atšũi le̱ amli tōkpakpoi le̱.

english_verse: Every animal in the forest belongs to me, and so do the cattle on a thousand hills.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ kōṅ lōi fẽ le̱ minõṅ, ke̱ lē̱-koloi akpei abo̱ ní yo̱ gõdši ano̱ le̱.

english_verse: If I were hungry, I wouldn't tell you, because I own the world and everything in it.
translation_verse: Ké̱ hõmo̱ mīyemi le̱, mikē̱ṅo; edšake̱ dše le̱ ke̱ emlinii le̱ minõṅ.

english_verse: I am God Most High! The only sacrifice I want is for you to be thankful and to keep your word.
translation_verse: Ṅõ šidā-afo̱le ohã Nyoṅmo̱, ni oye ošiwōi le̱ ano̱ ohã ṅweinyole̱!

english_verse: But to the wicked I say: “You don't have the right to mention my laws or claim to keep our agreement!
translation_verse: Ši gbomo fõṅ le̱, Nyoṅmo̱ kē̱o̱le̱ ake̱: Ohe sane meni dši ake̱ oodšadše mikpo̱i le̱, ni mikpãṅmo̱ le̱ akã odāṅ? Rom.

english_verse: You refused correction and rejected my commands.
translation_verse: Bo ní onye̱o̱ tšo̱semo̱, ni otšio̱ miwiemo̱i le̱ ohãa ose̱ le̱.

english_verse: You made friends with every crook you met, and you liked people who break their wedding vows.
translation_verse: Ké̱ ona dšulo̱ le̱, osumoo̱ esane, ni *gblãfitelo̱i po oke̱-bo̱ö̱. *Ef.

english_verse: You talked only about violence and told nothing but lies;
translation_verse: Oṅmēo̱ onābu gbe̱ ke̱-yaä efõṅ mli, ni olile̱i foo̱ apasa tāa.

english_verse: you sat around gossiping, ruining the reputation of your own relatives.”
translation_verse: Otáa ši owieo̱ onyemi he, onye bi po ogbeo̱ ebe guo̱.

english_verse: When you did all this, I didn't say a word, and you thought, “God is just like us!” But now I will accuse you.
translation_verse: Ene̱mei ofeo̱, ši ake̱-ni *mife diō hewo̱ le̱, osusuo̱ ake̱ mitamo̱ bo noṅṅ. Ši maka ohĩe, ni mike̱-amãmo̱ ohãe pe̱pē̱pe̱! *Lal.

english_verse: You have ignored me! So pay close attention or I will tear you apart, and no one can help you.
translation_verse: Nyedſẽṅa ene̱ he, nye mei ní nye-hĩe kpaä Nyoṅmo̱ no̱ le̱, koni mikatšere̱ nyemli, ni dšielo̱ ko be̱!

english_verse: The sacrifice that honors me is a thankful heart. Obey me, and I, your God, will show my power to save.
translation_verse: Moni šãa šidā-afo̱le le̱ ēwo mihĩe nyam, ni ēdše gbe̱ ni matšṍ no̱ matšõle̱ Nyoṅmo̱ yiwalaheremo̱ le̱!

english_verse: Turn your eyes from my sin and cover my guilt.
translation_verse: Mihe eša le̱ oke̱ *hisopo adšie, ni mihe atše; dšu mihe †ní maye futā fè snō. *

english_verse: Create pure thoughts in me and make me faithful again.
translation_verse: Hã manu nyã́mo̱ ke̱ mīše̱ he, ko-ni wui ni okũmo le̱ amli afliame̱. Lal.

english_verse: Don't chase me away from you or take your Holy Spirit away from me.
translation_verse: Tēmo̱ ohĩe ke̱-dše̱ mihe ešai le̱ ano̱, ni ogbe minišaianii le̱ fẽ!

english_verse: Make me as happy as you did when you saved me; make me want to obey!
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱, bo̱ tšui ní he tše ohãmi, ni ofe mumo̱ ní fĩo̱ ši ehē ye̱ mimli! Ezek.

english_verse: Keep me from any deadly sin. Only you can save me! Then I will shout and sing about your power to save.
translation_verse: Oke̱ oyiwalaheremo̱ le̱ he nyã́mo̱ le̱ akũ se̱ ahãmi, ni toibō mumo̱ le̱ amõ mimli!

english_verse: Help me to speak, and I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: No le̱ matšõ no̱tõlo̱i ogbè̱i le̱, ni ešafelo̱i aakũ ame̱se̱ ke̱-aba oṅõ.

english_verse: Please be willing, Lord, to help the city of Zion and to rebuild its walls.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ dšee afo̱le otaoo̱, kũle̱ mahã; šã-afo̱le hũ, onáá he tšui. Lal.

english_verse: You plan brutal crimes, and your lying words cut like a sharp razor.
translation_verse: beni Doeg, Edomnyo le̱ ba ni ebatſa Saul adafi ake̱ David eba Ahimelek we le̱.

english_verse: You would rather do evil than good, and tell lies than speak the truth.
translation_verse: Mẽhewo̱ oſãa ye̱ efõṅfemo̱ mli, bo ekãlo̱? Mawu mlihĩle̱ le̱ ye̱ dāne̱!

english_verse: You love to say cruel things, and your words are a trap.
translation_verse: Nifõdši ahe so̱ṅṅ olile̱i dſẽṅo̱, tamo̱ asōyi ní nā ba, bo šišiulo̱!

english_verse: When good people see this fearsome sight, they will laugh and say,
translation_verse: Fitemo̱ sãdši so̱ṅṅ osumoo̱, bo apasa lile̱i!

english_verse: “Just look at them now! Instead of trusting God, they trusted their wealth and their cruelty.”
translation_verse: Nakai noṅṅ Mawu hũ ke̱o aatſa ši ke̱-ate nāno̱, eemõ omli ni eešãtão ke̱-adše̱ oba le̱ṅ, ni eefão ke̱ ošiši ke̱-adše̱ hĩekãlo̱i ašikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: I will always thank God for what he has done; I will praise his good name when his people meet.
translation_verse: Na, nū le̱ ni eṅõõ Nyoṅmo̱ efee ehewale̱, ní eṅõ ehĩe efõ enii afále̱ no̱, ni ehewale̱ ye̱ enifõdšianii amli le!

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless! They are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: David se̱yōmo̱ lala ni eke̱-hã lalatše̱ nukpa le̱, ní ake̱ “ṅko̱mo̱yeli” gbē ala.

english_verse: From heaven God looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Kwašia kē̱o̱ ye̱ etšuiṅ ake̱: Nyoṅmo̱ ko be̱! Ame̱fite ni ame̱nišaianii le̱ ye̱ nyãṅemo̱; mokomoko be̱ ní feo̱ ekpakpa.

english_verse: But all of them are crooked and corrupt. Not one of them does right.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱ dše̱o̱ ṅwei kwe̱o̱ gbomei abii, ake̱ eena ake̱ moko ye̱ ní le nii, ni taoo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ se̱gbe̱ lo.

english_verse: Won't you lawbreakers learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the people of God.
translation_verse: Ame̱fẽ ame̱gbá afã, ame̱fite; mokomoko be̱ ní feo̱ ekpakpa, dabi, mokomeflo be̱!

english_verse: But you will be terrified worse than ever before. God will scatter the bones of his enemies, and you will be ashamed when God rejects you.
translation_verse: Aso mei ní tšuo̱ nišaianii le̱ lee nii? mei ní yeo̱ mimaṅ le̱, tamo̱ ayeo̱ abolo, ní Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ame̱tsé̱é̱le̱ le̱!

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our God, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: Gbīko le̱ kpokpomo̱ ame̱he aakpokpo ye̱ heni hekpokpomo̱ ko be̱; edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ egbe̱ moni foo̱ ohe asá le̱ wui amli eſã. Ohã ame̱hĩe egboi; edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ekwaame̱.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hear what I say.
translation_verse: beni Sifbii le̱ bakē̱ Saul ake̱: Nto David ebatē ehe ye̱ wo̱ṅõ le̱.

english_verse: Cruel strangers have attacked and want me dead. Not one of them cares about you.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱, oke̱ ogbe̱i le̱ ahere miyiwala, ni oke̱ ohewale̱ le̱ aye misane ahãmi!

english_verse: You will help me, Lord God, and keep me from falling;
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱, bo mifaikpamo̱ le̱ toi, ni ofe toi ohã midāṅ wiemo̱i le̱.

english_verse: you will punish my enemies for their evil deeds. Be my faithful friend and destroy them.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ meikpõdši ete ši ewomi, ni yiwalo̱i mitao misusuma se̱gbe̱; ame̱ṅõõ Nyoṅmo̱ ame̱too ame̱hĩe.

english_verse: I will bring a gift and offer a sacrifice to you, Lord. I will praise your name because you are good.
translation_verse: Na, Nyoṅmo̱ dši mibualo̱; Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ dši moni hĩe misusuma mli!

english_verse: You have rescued me from all my troubles, and my own eyes have seen my enemies fall.
translation_verse: Eehã efõṅ le̱ akũ se̱ aba mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ ano̱; kpãtãmo̱ ame̱hĩe ye̱ ono̱kwale le̱ nā!

english_verse: because my enemies attack with loud shouts. They treat me terribly and hold angry grudges.
translation_verse: Bomi toi ni oto he ohãmi! Mináá hedšo̱le̱ ye̱ miko̱mo̱yeli le̱ mli, ni midõmoo̱ ntšo̱i,

english_verse: My heart is racing fast, and I am afraid of dying.
translation_verse: ye̱ henye̱lo̱ le̱ gbē ke̱ mofõṅ le̱ haomo̱ le̱ hewo̱; edšake̱ ame̱foo̱ nõša ame̱fõo̱ mino̱, ni ame̱teo̱ ši ame̱woo̱mi ye̱ mlifũ mli.

english_verse: and corruption. Troublemakers and liars freely roam the streets.
translation_verse: Ame̱nyieo̱ egbogboi le̱ ano̱ ame̱bo̱leo̱le̱ ſane ke̱ nyōṅ; nifõdši ke̱ haomo̱ so̱ṅṅ yo̱ mli.

english_verse: We enjoyed being together, when we went with others to your house, our God.
translation_verse: ši bo gbomo ní mibuo̱o tamo̱ midientše̱ mihe, minanyo ke̱ misientše̱, Lal.

english_verse: All who hate me are controlled by the power of evil. Sentence them to death and send them down alive to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: mike̱o yeo̱ yitšoṅsane ke̱ ṅõmo̱, ni wo̱ke̱ asafo yū le̱ nyieo̱ ke̱-yaä Nyoṅmo̱ we le̱.

english_verse: I ask for your help, Lord God, and you will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Hã gbĕle abatiame̱ ši trukā, ni ame̱kpleke ši ke̱-ya gbohĩĩadše hĩekãlo̱i! Edšake̱ nifõdsianii ye̱ ame̱sihĩle̱hei le̱ ke̱ ame̱mli.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night you hear my concerns and my complaints.
translation_verse: Mi le̱, mablo̱ matšé̱ Nyoṅmo̱, ni Iehowa aahere miyiwala.

english_verse: I am attacked from all sides, but you will rescue me unharmed by the battle.
translation_verse: Maye ṅko̱mo̱ ni madõmo̱ ntšo̱i gbe̱ke̱ ke̱ lebi ke̱ ſane, ni eebo migbē toi.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you will hear me. You will defeat my enemies because they won't turn and worship you.
translation_verse: Ekpõ misusuma ye̱ hedšo̱le̱ mli, ní ame̱nyẽẽ mihe ame̱ta; edšake̱ mei ní ke̱-mi ená le̱ ayi fá.

english_verse: My friend turned against me and broke his promise.
translation_verse: Mawu *ní yo̱ ke̱-dše̱ tetēte le̱ aanu ni eehãame̱ hetō. Edšake̱ ame̱tsakee, ni ame̱šee Nyoṅmo gbeyei. *Lal.

english_verse: His words were smoother than butter, and softer than olive oil. But hatred filled his heart, and he was ready to attack with a sword.
translation_verse: Ewó enine no̱ ye̱ mei ni dši enanemei kpakpai ano̱, ebuleo̱ ekpãṅmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Our Lord, we belong to you. We tell you what worries us, and you won't let us fall.
translation_verse: Enā dšo̱ fè fufo̱, ši ta ye̱ etšui mli; ewiemo̱ĩ amli dšo̱ bo̱dō̱ fè mũ tete, ši kẽle̱ klantei ní agbla ni. Ier.

english_verse: But what about those people who are cruel and brutal? You will throw them down into the deepest pit long before their time. I trust you, Lord!
translation_verse: Še̱ odšatšu le̱ ofõ Iehowa no̱, ni le̱ eehĩe omli; eṅmẽṅ gbe̱ gbīkogbīko ní dšalo adidã.

english_verse: but even when I am afraid, I keep on trusting you.
translation_verse: Mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ mīhemi amĩ dā dšenamo̱; edšake̱ mei ní ke̱mi wuo ye̱ hewō mli le̱ ayi fá.

english_verse: I praise your promises! I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Be mli ní mi mišeo̱ gbeyei le̱, bo noṅṅ ono̱ mike̱ mihĩe fõo̱.

english_verse: Enemies spend the whole day finding fault with me; all they think about is how to do me harm.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱ mli ni midšieo̱ ewiemo̱ le̱ yi ye̱; Nyoṅmo̱ no mihĩe kã, mišee gbeyei; meni helo aanyẽmi afe? Lal.

english_verse: They attack from ambush, watching my every step and hoping to kill me.
translation_verse: Dā dšenamo̱ ame̱tsṍmoo̱ miwiemo̱i ahĩe ame̱bumoo̱ ši; ame̱dſēṅmo̱i ní ame̱dſẽṅo̱ ye̱ mihe le̱, efõṅ so̱ṅṅ ni.

english_verse: They won't get away with these crimes, God, because when you get angry, you destroy people.
translation_verse: Ame̱buaä ame̱he nā, ame̱tētēo̱ amehe, ame̱kadio̱ minãdsifãmo̱i, ake̱-ni ame̱wo misusuma ká le̱.

english_verse: When I pray, Lord God, my enemies will retreat, because I know for certain that you are with me.
translation_verse: Okaneo̱ mitšomlomo̱i le̱, oke̱ mihĩe-yāfónui awo oto̱ le̱ mli! Ani ame̱be̱ owolo le̱ mli?

english_verse: I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱ mli ní midšieo̱ ewiemo̱ le̱ yi ye̱, Iehowa mli ní midšieo̱ ewiemo̱ le̱ yi ye̱.

english_verse: I will keep my promises to you, my God, and bring you gifts.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱ no̱ mihĩe kã, mišee gbeyei; meni gbomo aanyẽmi afe?

english_verse: You will send help from heaven and save me, but you will bring trouble on my attackers. You are faithful, and you can be trusted.
translation_verse: Miblo̱ō̱ mitšé̱o̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ní yo̱ ṅwei šoṅṅ le̱, Mawu ní feo̱ nii fẽ hãami le̱

english_verse: My enemies are fierce, much worse than lions! They have spears and arrows instead of teeth, and they have sharp swords instead of tongues.
translation_verse: Eetšũ ke̱-adše̱ ṅwei ni abahere miyiwala, beni moni heo̱mi amī le̱ bo̱ö̱mi ahora le̱. Nyoṅmo̱ aatšũ emo̱bo̱nale̱ ke̱ eno̱kwale le̱.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Misusuma ye̱ dšatai ateṅ; mikã mei ni mùo̱ la le̱ ateṅ, gbomei abii ni ame̱nyãnyõdši tamo̱ akplo̱i ke̱ gãimlibii, ni amelile̱i tamo̱ klante ni nā ba le̱.

english_verse: I feel wide awake! I will wake up my harp and wake up the sun.
translation_verse: Mitšui enyõ mimli, Nyoṅmo̱, mitšui enyõ mimli; mala ni matſa saṅkũ!

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens; your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Madšie oyi ye̱ mãdšimãdši ateṅ, Nuṅtšo̱; mala mahão ye̱ dšeṅmãdši ateṅ!

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ omo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱ da ke̱-še̱ ṅwei, ni ono̱kwayeli le̱ še̱o̱ atatuiaṅ tō̃. Lal.

english_verse: Do you mighty people talk only to oppose justice? Don't you ever judge fairly?
translation_verse: David lala ni eṅmã ni eke̱-hã lalatše̱ nukpa le̱, ní ake̱ “kãkpãtã hĩe!” gbē ala.

english_verse: You have done wrong and lied from the day you were born.
translation_verse: Dabi, nyetšuo̱ nifõdšianii ye̱ nyetšuii amli, ni nyeṅmẽo̱ yiwale̱nii ni yo̱ nyedeṅ le̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Your words spread poison like the bite of a cobra
translation_verse: Meifõdši bo̱ō̱ kó ke̱-dše̱o̱ mũsũṅ bēbe, kē̱ aſieame̱ ši pe̱ le̱, ame̱dùo̱ gbe̱ ni ame̱maleo̱.

english_verse: that refuses to listen to the snake charmer.
translation_verse: Ame̱mli ebō̱ le̱ tamo̱ opũfũ ebō̱, tamo̱ blè toimũlo̱ ní tšīmoo̱ etoii,

english_verse: My enemies are fierce as lions, Lord God! Shatter their teeth. Snatch out their fangs.
translation_verse: koni ekanu ṅkũnyáyelo̱i lo aſãifelo̱i ni ke̱ ṅā feo̱ aſãii le̱ agbē. Dsads.

english_verse: Let them dry up like snails or be like a child that dies before seeing the sun.
translation_verse: Hã ame̱mĩ tamo̱ nu ni hoo ſimſim; kē̱ etá egãimlibii le̱, hã ame̱tšṍmo̱ tamo̱ nii ní nā egboi.

english_verse: Good people will be glad when they see the wicked getting what they deserve, and they will wash their feet in their enemies' blood.
translation_verse: Dãni nyekukwe̱i le̱ aanu ṅmeitšola le̱ he le̱, eye̱ eṅmõṅ dšio, la efũ he dšio, eke̱ lasũogbĕle aalōame̱ ke̱-ate.

english_verse: Everyone will say, “It's true! Good people are rewarded. God does indeed rule the earth with justice.”
translation_verse: Dšalo̱ aanyã́ ake̱ ena oweletō̱, eefo̱ enãdši ahe ye̱ meifõdši alá mli!

english_verse: Merciless enemies, Lord, are hiding and plotting, hoping to kill me. I have not hurt them in any way at all.
translation_verse: Dšiemo̱mi ke̱-dše̱ mei ní tšuo̱ nišaianii le̱ adeṅ, ni ohere miyiwala ke̱-dše̱ lá suolo̱i le̱ adeṅ!

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you are the God of Israel. Punish the other nations and don't pity those terrible and rebellious people.
translation_verse: Dšee tõmo̱ ko hewo̱ hũ ní ame̱dsoo̱ foi ame̱yasāa ame̱he. *Ohĩe atšẽ, oke̱mi akakpe ni okwe̱! *Lal.

english_verse: My enemies return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Ni bo, Iehowa, Zebaot Nyoṅmo̱, Israel Nyoṅmo̱, wó ohe no̱ ni oyasra dseṅmãdsi le̱ fiā; kāna efõṅfelo̱i kũtũmpo̱foi le̱ eko eko mo̱bo̱!

english_verse: You, Lord, laugh at them and sneer at the nations.
translation_verse: Na, ame̱wieo̱ ame̱dā obõ, klantei ye̱ ame̱nābui, edšake̱ [ame̱kē̱o̱ ake̱]: “Namo nuo̱?”

english_verse: You love me and will let me see my enemies defeated.
translation_verse: Mihewale̱, bo noṅṅ gbe̱ makwe̱; edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ dši mimō̃.

english_verse: Don't kill them, or everyone may forget! Just use your mighty power to make them tremble and fall. You are a shield for your people.
translation_verse: Mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ke̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱ aabakpẽmi; Nyoṅmo̱ aaba *mana noni mitaoo̱ ye̱ mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ ahe le̱. *Lal.

english_verse: My enemies are liars! So let them be trapped by their boastful lies.
translation_verse: Kāgbeame̱, ní mimaṅ le̱ hĩe mikpa no̱; gbe̱ame̱ oſã ye̱ ohewale̱ le̱ nā ni oṅõame̱ otſia ši, bo, Nuṅtšo̱, ní dši wo̱-tše̱ṅ le̱!

english_verse: Get angry and destroy them. Leave them in ruin. Then all the nations will know that you rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Ame̱dāṅ eša ke̱ ame̱nā wiemo̱i ke̱ lōmo̱ ke̱ apasa wiemo̱i ní ame̱wieo̱ le̱ ahewo̱ le̱, hã amõmo̱ame̱ ye̱ ame̱hewō le̱ mli.

english_verse: They search for scraps of food, and they snarl until they are stuffed.
translation_verse: Ame̱kũo̱ ame̱se̱ ame̱baä gbe̱ke̱, ame̱blo̱ö̱ tamo̱ gbēi, ni ame̱bo̱leo̱ maṅ le̱ kpula. K.

english_verse: I will sing your praises! You are my mighty fortress, and you love me.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱ mala ohewale̱ le̱ he lala, ni lebi le̱ mala omo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱ he nyã́mo̱ lala; edšake̱ bo dši mimō̃ ke̱ abobāhe ye̱ mifĩmo̱gbĩ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: You brought hard times on your people, and you gave us wine that made us stagger.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱, ose̱re̱wo̱ oſie, ogbe̱wo̱ oſã, omli efũ; oke̱wo̱ aba wo̱ṅe̱le̱no̱ ekoṅ!

english_verse: You gave a signal to those who worship you, so they could escape from enemy arrows.
translation_verse: Ohã šikpoṅ le̱ ehoso, odſrale̱; tšãrámo̱ ehei ni edſra le̱, edšake̱ ēdidã!

english_verse: Answer our prayers, God! Use your powerful arm and give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Ohã omaṅ le̱ ena nii ni wa, *ohã wo̱nu didãmo̱-dā̃. *Ies.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is the symbol of my royal power.
translation_verse: Koni adšie mei ni osumoo̱ le̱, oke̱ oninedšũrõ ahere wo̱yiwala, ni oto he ohã wo̱!

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin. Edom belongs to me, and I shout in triumph over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱ ewie ye̱ ekroṅkroṅfemo̱ le̱ mli: Mabo̱ oše, madša Šekem mli, ni masusu Sukot dšō̱ le̱.

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress, or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Minõ dši Gilead, ni minõ dši Manase; Efraim dši miyitšo dadefai, *Iuda le̱, mimaṅtše̱tšo ni. *

english_verse: Have you rejected us and deserted our armies?
translation_verse: Moab dši mihedšu-kulo, Edom no̱ madšie mitokota mafõ, mihewo̱ hũ, Filistea aablo̱ wā.

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Namo aaṅõmi ke̱-ate maṅ ni wa le̱ mli? Namo aayawami Edom?

english_verse: You will give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: Ani dšee bo, Nyoṅmo̱, ni oše̱re̱wo̱ oſie le̱, bo Nyoṅmo̱ ní oke̱wo̱ efãã ta le̱ ni?

english_verse: Please listen, God, and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: David lala ni eke̱-hã lalatše̱ nukpa le̱, ní ake̱ saṅkũ ala.

english_verse: Let me live with you forever and find protection under your wings, my God.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ otšṍ abobāhe ke̱ mō̃ ní wa ohāmi ye̱ henye̱lo̱ le̱ hĩe. Lai.

english_verse: Let the king have a long and healthy life.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo, Nyoṅmo̱, onu mišiwōi le̱; oṅõ mei ni šeo̱ ogbe̱i le̱ gbeyei le̱ agbe̱fãṅnõ le̱ ohãmi.

english_verse: I will sing your praises forever, God, and will always keep my promises.
translation_verse: Eehĩ ši ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe *ke̱-ate nāno̱; hã mlihĩle̱ ke̱ ano̱kwale abu ehe! *

english_verse: God saves me and honors me. He is that mighty rock where I find safety.
translation_verse: Hē̃, le̱ dši mite̱sā ke̱ miyiwalaheremo̱ ke̱ mimō̃, mididāṅ! Lal.

english_verse: Trust God, my friends, and always tell him each of your concerns. God is our place of safety.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱ no̱ miyiwalaheremo̱ ke̱ minumnyam kā; mite̱sā ní wa ke̱ mibobāhe dši Nyoṅmo̱. Lal.

english_verse: We humans are only a breath; none of us are truly great. All of us together weigh less than a puff of air.
translation_verse: Nye maṅ le̱, nyeke̱ nyehĩe afõa eno̱ befẽbe, nyefo̱sea nyetšui nyeſiea ehĩe; Nyoṅmo̱ dši wo̱bobãhe!

english_verse: Don't trust in violence or depend on dishonesty or rely on great wealth.
translation_verse: Hē̃, ádesãi abii le̱, kō̱yo̱ so̱ṅṅ dšiame̱, ni amale dši gbomei abii; ké̱ ake̱-ame̱ wo nsẽni mli le̱, ameya ṅwei, ame̱fẽ ame̱tšīmo̱ še̱e̱ kō̱yo̱ tete!

english_verse: and I am very kind.” The Lord rewards each of us according to what we do.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱ ewie šikome, minu ene̱ šii enyo̱: ake̱ hewale̱ le̱ Nyoṅmo̱ nõ ni.

english_verse: I have seen your power and your glory in the place of worship.
translation_verse: Nānyoṅmo̱, bo dši mi-Mawu, matao ose̱gbe̱ lebi mā̃ṅkpa; *ohe kũmai miye misusuma, mihelo mīſeo ye̱ šikpoṅ gbĩṅ keketẽ ní nu be̱ no̱ le̱ no̱! *Lal.

english_verse: Your love means more than life to me, and I praise you.
translation_verse: Nakai mikwe̱o ye̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱, koni mana ohewale̱ ke̱ onumnyam le̱.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will pray to you.
translation_verse: Ši omlihĩle̱ hĩ fè wala; minābui aakafoö.

english_verse: I will sing joyful praises and be filled with excitement like a guest at a banquet.
translation_verse: Ni mihĩe kã ne̱, nakai madšie oyi, mahole minidši ano̱ ye̱ ogbe̱i le̱ mli.

english_verse: I think about you, God, before I go to sleep, and my thoughts turn to you during the night.
translation_verse: Misusuma aato, tamo̱ wuiaṅfo̱ ke̱ fo̱ to̱ö̱ mo, ni midā aadšie oyi ke̱ nyã́mo̱ nābu.

english_verse: You have helped me, and I sing happy songs in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Ké̱ mikaio ye̱ misā no̱ le̱, midſẽṅo̱ ohe ye̱ nyōṅbūbei le̱ amli.

english_verse: I stay close to you, and your powerful arm supports me.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ otšṍ miyeli-ke̱-bualo̱, ni manyã́ ye̱ ofĩdši ašiši hō̃ṅ le̱ mli.

english_verse: All who want to kill me will end up in the ground.
translation_verse: Misusuma kpe̱te̱o̱o gbãgbãlī; oninedšũrõ hĩe mimli hũ.

english_verse: Swords will run them through, and wild dogs will eat them.
translation_verse: Ši mei ni taoo̱ misusuma hĩe ame̱kpãtã le̱, ame̱akpleke ši ke̱-ate šikpoṅ le̱ šiši tō̃,

english_verse: Listen to my concerns, God, and protect me from my enemies' threats.
translation_verse: David lala ni eke̱-hã lalatše̱ nukpa le̱.

english_verse: Their words cut like swords, and their cruel remarks sting like sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Nomi otē ye̱ efõṅfelo̱i adšina ni ame̱yaã ye̱ tēmo̱ mli le̱ hewo̱, ye̱ nõšafelo̱i asafo ní feo̱ hõ le̱ hewo̱:

english_verse: They are determined to do evil, and they tell themselves, “Let's set traps! No one can see us.”
translation_verse: koni ame̱yatšẽrẽ moni eye emū le̱ ye̱ dudšiaṅ, ame̱tšẽrẽo̱le̱ trukā, ni ame̱šee gbeyei. Lal.

english_verse: They make evil plans and say, “We'll commit a perfect crime. No one knows our thoughts.”
translation_verse: Ame̱wadšeo̱ ame̱he ye̱ yiṅtō fõṅ mli, ame̱kpe̱o̱ mli ni ame̱tšõ̀tšõ̀o̱ tšõnei ye̱ tēmo̱ mli, *ame̱kē̱o̱ ake̱: Namo banawo̱? *Lal.

english_verse: They will be afraid and say, “Look at what God has done and keep it all in mind.”
translation_verse: Ni ame̱atſĩa ši, *ame̱dientše̱ ame̱lile̱i aate ši awoame̱; mei fẽ ni aanaame̱ le̱ aahosohosō ame̱yitšei. *Lal.

english_verse: May the Lord bless his people with peace and happiness and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Ni gbomei fiā-kwa aaše gbeyei, ni ame̱adšadše Nyoṅmo̱ nitšumo̱ le̱, ni ame̱-adſẽṅ enifemo̱nii le̱ ahe.

english_verse: Our God, you deserve praise in Zion, where we keep our promises to you.
translation_verse: David lala ni ela, ní eke̱-hã lalatše̱ nukpa le̱.

english_verse: Everyone will come to you because you answer prayer.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱, yidšiemo̱ mimẽo ye̱ Zion, ni bo ayeo̱ šiwõi le̱ ano̱ ahãa.

english_verse: When our sins get us down, you forgive us.
translation_verse: Bo ni oboo̱ so̱lemo̱ toi, bo oṅõ helo fẽ baä.

english_verse: You silence the roaring waves and the noisy shouts of the nations.
translation_verse: moni ṅõo̱ gõdši le̱ mãmoo̱ ši šiṅṅ ye̱ ehewale̱ nā, ni emĩa ke̱ hewale̱ so̱ṅṅ le̱;

english_verse: People far away marvel at your fearsome deeds, and all who live under the sun celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: moni dšō̱o̱ ṅšo̱i ahū̃mo̱ ke̱ ame̱šo̱kei le̱ ahū̃mo̱ ke̱ mãdšimãdši le̱ ahōfemo̱ hũ he le̱. Lal.

english_verse: You take care of the earth and send rain to help the soil grow all kinds of crops. Your rivers never run dry, and you prepare the earth to produce abundant grain.
translation_verse: Mei ní yo̱ dšeṅ nāgbēhei le̱ šeo̱ okadii le̱ agbeyei, ni ohãa bokã ke̱ anai šikpõdši le̱ ano̱ bii le̱ laä ke̱ nyã́mo̱.

english_verse: You water all its fields and level the lumpy ground. You send showers of rain to soften the soil and help the plants sprout.
translation_verse: Obasraä šikpoṅ le̱ ni ohãale̱ nu, ohãa ebaä nii babaō. Nyoṅmo̱ *fā le̱ eyi to̱ ke̱ nu, ni ké̱ osā šikpoṅ le̱ nakai le̱, ohãa-ame̱ able. *Lal.

english_verse: Meadows are filled with sheep and goats; valleys overflow with grain and echo with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Ṅãno̱ dſe̱fo̱i le̱ amli tšereo̱ ſieo̱ ši, ni gõdši le̱ emĩa ke̱ mliflimo̱.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to shout praises to God!
translation_verse: Lala ni ala ni ake̱-hã lalatše̱ nukpa le̱. Nyeke̱ nyã́mo̱ abo̱a oše nyehãa Nyoṅmo̱, nye šikpõdsi le̱ fẽ!

english_verse: You are worshiped by everyone! We all sing praises to you.”
translation_verse: Šikpoṅ le̱ flā-kwa aadšáo ni ame̱-ala amehão, ame̱ala amehä ogbe̱i le̱.

english_verse: Come and see the fearsome things our God has done!
translation_verse: Nyebaä nyebakwe̱a Nyoṅmo̱ nitšumo̱i le̱; ehe ye̱ gbeyei ye̱ nii ni etšuo̱ ehãa gbomei abii le̱ amli.

english_verse: When God made the sea dry up, our people walked across, and because of him, we celebrated there.
translation_verse: Ehã ṅšo̱ tšṍ šikpoṅ gbĩṅ, ame̱fo fā ke̱ ame̱nane: dše̱i wo̱nyã́ ehe ye̱!

english_verse: His mighty power rules forever, and nothing the nations do can be hidden from him. So don't turn against God.
translation_verse: Eke̱ ehewale̱ mīye maṅtše̱ ke̱-mīya nāno̱; ehĩṅme̱i kā dšeṅmãdši le̱ ahe: atũatselo̱i akawó ame̱he no̱!

english_verse: All of you people, come praise our God! Let his praises be heard.
translation_verse: Nye mãdši le̱, nyedšiea wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ yi, ni nyehãa anua eyidšiemo̱ gbē,

english_verse: Our God, you tested us, just as silver is tested.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo, Nyoṅmo̱, okawo̱ okwe̱, *otšū wohe, tamo atšũo dſietei he; *Abe̱i

english_verse: You trapped us in a net and gave us heavy burdens.
translation_verse: oke̱wo̱ eyawo yā mli, oke̱ dšatšu ke̱ tšīmo̱ eſie wogbedši ano̱;

english_verse: You sent war chariots to crush our skulls. We traveled through fire and through floods, but you brought us to a land of plenty.
translation_verse: ohã gbomei ádesãi enyie wo̱yiteaṅ po, *wo̱tsṍmo̱ la mli ke̱ nui amli ke̱-ho, ši odšiewo ke̱-ba heni nii babaō yo̱. *Ies.

english_verse: I will bring sacrifices into your house, my God, and I will do what I promised
translation_verse: Mike̱ šã-afo̱lei aaba owe le̱, maye misiwōi le̱ ano̱ mahão,

english_verse: I will sacrifice my best sheep and offer bulls and goats on your altar.
translation_verse: Mike̱ tōgwanteṅi ni ewo fo̱ aašã šã-afo̱lei mahão, ke̱ tōagboi ní ašãa le̱ aṅmadšē, mike̱ tšinai ke̱ tōabotiai aašã afo̱le.

english_verse: All who worship God, come here and listen; I will tell you everything God has done for me.
translation_verse: Nye mei fẽ ní nyešeo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ gbeyei, nyebaã nyebaboa toi, ni magbanye noni efe ehã misusuma!

english_verse: I prayed to the Lord, and I praised him.
translation_verse: Mike̱ minãbu bo tšé̱le̱, ni ekafomo̱ kã milile̱i no̱.

english_verse: If my thoughts had been sinful, he would have refused to hear me.
translation_verse: Edši misumoo̱ nõša ko ye̱ mitšui mli kũle, Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ boṅmi toi. Abe̱i

english_verse: But God did listen and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Ši le̱le̱ṅ, Nyoṅmo̱ ebomi toi, efe toi ehã miso̱lemo̱ gbẽ le̱.

english_verse: Let's praise God! He listened when I prayed, and he is always kind.
translation_verse: Yidšiemo̱ ahã Nyoṅmo̱, ake̱ etſaa miso̱lemo̱ le̱ efõõ, ni edšiee emo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱ ye̱ mino̱!

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will learn to follow you, and all nations will see your power to save us.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱ anawo̱ mo̱bo̱ ni edšō̱wo̱, ni ehã ehĩe akpe̱ ye̱ wo̱no̱!

english_verse: Make everyone praise you and shout your praises.
translation_verse: Ní ale ogbe̱ le̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, oyiwalaheremo̱ le̱ ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ fẽ ateṅ.

english_verse: Let the nations celebrate with joyful songs, because you judge fairly and guide all nations.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱, hã mãdšimãdši le̱ adšie oyi; hã mãdšimãdši le̱ fẽ-kwa adšie oyi. Lal

english_verse: Our God has blessed the earth with a wonderful harvest!
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱, hā mãdšimãdši le̱ adšie oyi; hã mãdšimãdši le̱ fẽ-kwa adšie oyi.

english_verse: Pray for his blessings to continue and for everyone on earth to worship our God.
translation_verse: *Šikpoṅ le̱ eba enii; Nānyoṅmo̱ ní dši wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ aadsō̱wo̱. *Lal.

english_verse: But let your people be happy and celebrate because of you.
translation_verse: Hũmo̱ame̱ tamo̱ ahũo̱ lasũ le̱; take̱ bo̱ni wò-agbaku sẽreo̱ ye̱ la he le̱, nakai ohã meifõdši ahĩe akpãtã ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe.

english_verse: “Kings and their armies retreated and ran, and everything they left is now being divided.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ bã anu hewale̱ wiemo̱; yei ni *šieo kũnimyeli le̱ fá babaō. *Ies.

english_verse: Why is it jealous of Zion, the mountain you chose as your home forever?
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱ goṅ dši Bašan goṅ le̱, gõdši godšogodšō dši Bašan gõdši le̱.

english_verse: When you climbed the high mountain, you took prisoners with you and were given gifts. Your enemies didn't want you to live there, but they gave you gifts.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱ *ta-ſīlii le̱, akpei-nyoṅma toi akpei-hūhā abo̱ ni; Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ ye̱ ame̱teṅ tamo̱ Sinai hekroṅkroṅ le̱. *

english_verse: You promised to bring them from Bashan and from the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Hē̃, Nyoṅmo̱ aadſãra ehenye̱lo̱i le̱ ayĩtšei ke̱ monĩ yaä no̱ ye̱ efo̱yeli le̱ mli le̱ yitšo ke̱ eno̱ yitšo̱i kusū le̱.

english_verse: Then we could wash our feet in their blood, and our dogs could chew on their bones.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ kē̱ ake̱: Makplaame̱ ke̱-adše̱ Bašan ke̱-ba ekoṅ, makplaame̱ ke̱-adše̱ ṅšo̱ṅ bui kwo̱ṅkwo̱ṅi le̱ amli ke̱-ba ekoṅ,

english_verse: Singers come first, and then the musicians, surrounded by young women playing tambourines.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱, ame̱na *onyiemo̱i le̱, mi-Mawu ní dši mimaṅtše̱ le̱ nyiemo̱i ní enyieo̱ ye̱ kroṅkroṅfemo̱ mli le̱. *

english_verse: They come shouting, “People of Israel, praise the Lord God!”
translation_verse: Lalatše̱mei le̱ nyie hīe, saṅkũtſalo̱i le̱ nyie se̱ ye̱ *oblayei ní šaä fabii le̱ ateṅ *

english_verse: The small tribe of Benjamin leads the way, followed by the leaders from Judah. Then come the leaders from Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Nyedšiea Nyoṅmo̱ yi ye̱ asafoi ateṅ, *nye mei ní nyedše̱ Israel nubu le̱ mli le̱, nyedšiea Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ yi! *Ies.

english_verse: Force the Egyptians to bring gifts of bronze; make the Ethiopians hurry to offer presents.
translation_verse: Kã gălãi amli kolo le̱ ke̱ tšinahĩĩ asafo le̱ ke̱ mãdšimãdši le̱ atšinabii le̱ ahĩe, koni ame̱ṅõ ame̱he ame̱fõ ši ke̱ dſie̱te̱i kukudši! Gbe̱ mãdši ní sumoo̱ ta le̱ oſã!

english_verse: Now sing praises to God! Every kingdom on earth, sing to the Lord!
translation_verse: Lumei aadše̱ Mizraim aba; Kuš he aafe oyá ni ekpa enidši amli ehã Nyoṅmo̱. Ies.

english_verse: Praise the one who rides across the ancient skies; listen as he speaks with a mighty voice.
translation_verse: Nye šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ maṅtše̱yelii le̱, nyelaä nyehãa Nyoṅmo̱! Nyelaä nye-dšiea Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ yi,

english_verse: Tell about God's power! He is honored in Israel, and he rules the skies.
translation_verse: moni tá ṅweii amli ṅwei ní yo̱ ke̱-dše̱ tetēte le̱ no̱ le̱! Na, ewóo̱ egbe ní dši gbẽ ní wa le̱ no̱.

english_verse: The God of Israel is fearsome in his temple, and he makes us strong. Let's praise our God!
translation_verse: Nyeke̱ hewale̱ *ahãa Nānyoṅmo̱! Egbodšē le̱ yeo̱ Israel no̱, ni ebewale̱ le̱ ye̱ atatuiaṅ. *Lal.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, ruler of Israel, don't let me embarrass anyone who trusts and worships you.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱, bo ole mikwašiafemo̱, ni mihe ešai le̱ ake̱-tēkoö.

english_verse: It is for your sake alone that I am insulted and blush with shame.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱, Iehowa Zebaot, kābã mei ní kwe̱o̱o gbe̱ le̱ ahĩe mīgboi ye̱ mihewo̱; Israel Nyoṅmo̱, kāhã mei ni taoo̱ ose̱gbe̱ le̱ ahe guo̱ migbo ye̱ mihewo̱!

english_verse: Rulers and judges gossip about me, and drunkards make up songs to mock me.
translation_verse: Ké̱ mike̱ kpekpe fe mitade ní mi-woo̱ hũ, bẽle̱ mitšṍ abe̱būnõ mihãame̱.

english_verse: But I pray to you, Lord. So when the time is right, answer me and help me with your wonderful love.
translation_verse: Mei ni trá koi ši le̱ gbaä mihe sane, ni mitšṍ dā̃to̱lo̱i adāṅ lala. Hiob

english_verse: Don't let me be swept away by a flood or drowned in the ocean or swallowed by death.
translation_verse: Dšiemo̱mi ke̱-dše̱ ṅmo̱to̱ le̱ mli, ni kāhã mišiu; hã adšiemi ke̱-dše̱ mei ni he tšẽo̱mi le̱ adeṅ, ke̱ nui ní mli kwŏ̱lo̱ le̱ amli!

english_verse: Answer me, Lord! You are kind and good. Pay attention to me! You are truly merciful.
translation_verse: Kāhã nu le̱ mīsumi, ni kāhã bu kwo̱ṅkwo̱ṅ le̱ mīmĩmi, asaṅ kāhã bu le̱ mĩṅã́ enā ewo miyi!

english_verse: Don't turn away from me. I am your servant, and I am in trouble. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Heremo̱mi no̱, Iehowa, edšake̱ omlihĩle̱ le̱ hĩ; omũsũṅtšõle̱ fále̱ nā le̱ tšṍ ohĩe ohãmi!

english_verse: Come and save me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Ni oke̱ ehĩe akatē otšũlo̱, edšake̱ efīmi; heremo̱mi no̱ oyá!

english_verse: You know how I am insulted, mocked, and disgraced; you know every one of my enemies.
translation_verse: Tši obe̱ṅke̱ misusuma ni okpõle̱; ye̱ mihenye̱lo̱i ahewo̱ le̱ dšiemo̱mi!

english_verse: Enemies poisoned my food, and when I was thirsty, they gave me vinegar.
translation_verse: Ahorabō̱ ekũmo̱ mitšui ni ehã hela emõmi; ni mikwe̱ ake̱ moko ke̱mi aabaye ṅko̱mo̱ lo, ši mokomoko be̱, ke̱ *mīšedšeloi hũ, ši minaa mokomoko. *Yāfó

english_verse: Destroy their camp and don't let anyone live in their tents.
translation_verse: Fo̱semo̱ omlila oſie ame̱no̱, ni ohã omlifũ ní nā wa aninaame̱.

english_verse: They cause trouble for people you have already punished; their gossip hurts those you have wounded.
translation_verse: Hã ame̱šihĩle̱he le̱ atšṍ amaṅfõ, ni mokomoko akahĩ ame̱būi le̱ amli. Hiob

english_verse: Wipe their names from the book of the living; remove them from the list of the innocent.
translation_verse: Ṅõ nõša ofata amenõša le̱ he, ni ame̱kabote odšale̱ le̱ mli. Rom.

english_verse: I am mistreated and in pain. Protect me, God, and keep me safe!
translation_verse: Hā agbe *ame̱gbe̱i ye̱ wala-wolo le̱ mli, ni akaṅmã amegbe̱i aši dšalo̱i ano̱. *Luk.

english_verse: I will praise the Lord God with a song and a thankful heart.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, minii ye̱ mo̱bo̱, ni miye̱ pīmo̱ mli. Nānyoṅmo̱, hã oyiwalaheremo̱ le̱ awó mino̱!

english_verse: This will please the Lord better than offering an ox or a full-grown bull.
translation_verse: Mike̱ lala aadšie Nyoṅmo̱ gbe̱i le̱ yi, ni mike̱ šidā aakafole̱.

english_verse: When those in need see this, they will be happy, and the Lord's worshipers will be encouraged.
translation_verse: Ni no aasa Iehowa hĩe fè tšina oblanyo ní yo̱ aklontoi ke̱ koklotoi ni agbla mli. Lal.

english_verse: The Lord will listen when the homeless cry out, and he will never forget his people in prison.
translation_verse: Ké̱ nõnalo̱i na le̱, ame̱mī aaše̱; nye mei ní nyetaoo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ se̱gbe̱ le̱, nyehãa nyetšui anyõa nyemli. Lal.

english_verse: Heaven and earth will praise our God, and so will the oceans and everything in them.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa boo̱ ohĩafoi atoi, ni egbee egbokle̱foi le̱ ahe guo̱.

english_verse: God will rescue Jerusalem, and he will rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there on their own land,
translation_verse: Hã ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ ke̱ ṅšo̱i ke̱ nibii fẽ ni tšio̱ ame̱he ye̱ mli le̱ adšie eyi!

english_verse: and when the time comes, their children will inherit the land. Then everyone who loves God will also settle there.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ aahere Zion yiwala, ni eesā Iuda mãdši le̱, ni ame̱ahĩ mli, ni eetšṍ ame̱nõ.

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Nānyoṅmo̱, femo̱ oyá ní odšiemi; Iehowa, femo̱ oyá ní oye obuami!

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Mei ní kē̱o̱ ake̱: Yie̱, yie̱! le̱, hã ame̱ke̱ hĩegbĕle akũ ame̱se̱ ake̱ ame̱nyõmo̱wo!

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Mei fẽ ni taoo̱ ose̱gbe̱ le̱, hã ame̱nyã́ ni ame̱mī aše̱ ame̱he ye̱ omli; hã mei ní sumoo̱ oyiwalaheremo̱ le̱ akē̱ dā ake̱: Iehowa dše agbo!

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Nānyoṅmo̱, femo̱ oyá ní odšiemi; Iehowa, femo̱ oyá ní oye obuami!

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Mei ní kē̱o̱ ake̱: Yie̱, yie̱! le̱, hã ame̱ke̱ hĩegbĕle akũ ame̱se̱ ake̱ ame̱nyõmo̱wo!

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Mei fẽ ni taoo̱ ose̱gbe̱ le̱, hã ame̱nyã́ ni ame̱mī aše̱ ame̱he ye̱ omli; hã mei ní sumoo̱ oyiwalaheremo̱ le̱ akē̱ dā ake̱: Iehowa dše agbo!

english_verse: I depend on you, and I have trusted you since I was young.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa, dši mi-hĩeno̱kãmo̱, bo ono̱ mike̱ mihĩe fõ ke̱-dše̱ miblahĩaṅ.

english_verse: My enemies are plotting because they want me dead.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ wieo̱ mihe, ni mei ni woo̱ misusuma ká le̱ feo̱ kome yaä apãm,

english_verse: Embarrass and destroy all who want me dead; disgrace and confuse all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Mei ní dši misusuma henye̱lo̱i le̱, hã ame̱hĩe agboi ni ame̱lādse; mei ní taoo̱mi efõṅ le̱, hã ahorabō̱ ke̱ heguo̱gbĕle aha amehe!

english_verse: I will never give up hope or stop praising you.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, maṅmẽ mitšui ši dā, ni mahã oyidšiemo̱ le̱ afá ke̱-ya no̱.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord God, for your mighty deeds and your power to save.
translation_verse: Magba Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa hewale̱ nitšumo̱i le̱, matšĩ bo okometō odšale̱ le̱ tã.

english_verse: You have taught me since I was a child, and I never stop telling about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱, otšõmi nii ke̱-dše̱ miblahĩaṅ, ni midšadše onākpe̱ nitšumo̱i le̱ *ke̱-baši ṅme̱ne̱. *

english_verse: Don't leave me when I am old and my hair turns gray. Let me tell future generations about your mighty power.
translation_verse: Ké̱ *migbo̱ midše waṅ tete le̱, Nānyoṅmo̱, kākwami, ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní madšadše oninešiwale̱ le̱ matšõ yino̱bii ní baä ye̱ se̱ le̱, ke̱ ohewale̱ le̱ hũ matšõ mofẽmo ni baä le̱. *K.

english_verse: Your deeds of kindness are known in the heavens. No one is like you!
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱, odšale̱ le̱ kwo̱ godšō, bo ni ofeo̱ nibii wudši le̱, Nānyoṅmo̱, namo tamo̱o?

english_verse: You made me suffer a lot, but you will bring me back from this deep pit and give me new life.
translation_verse: Bo ní ohã wo̱na amanehũlũi babaō ní dšraã le̱, oohã wo̱yi aná wala ekoṅ, ni osā oodšiewo̱ ke̱-adše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ bui ní kwō̱lo̱ le̱ amli ke̱-aba ṅwei ekoṅ.

english_verse: You will make me truly great and take my sorrow away.
translation_verse: Hã migbodšē le̱ afá, ni otšṍ ohe oše̱dše mimī.

english_verse: I will praise you, God, the Holy One of Israel. You are faithful. I will play the harp and sing your praises.
translation_verse: Mi hũ mike̱ saṅkũ aadšie bo ke̱ ono̱kwale le̱ yi, mi-Nyoṅmo̱; mike̱ obenta aala adšie oyi, bo Israel Mokroṅkroṅ le̱!

english_verse: You have rescued me! I will celebrate and shout, singing praises to you with all my heart.
translation_verse: Beni milaä midšieo̱ oyi le̱, minābu ke̱ misusuma ní okpõ le̱ aanyã́ babaō.

english_verse: All day long I will announce your power to save. I will tell how you disgraced and disappointed those who wanted to hurt me.
translation_verse: Milile̱i hũ aagba odšale̱ le̱ he sane dā; edšake̱ mei ní taoo̱mi efõṅ-le̱ ahĩe egboi ni ame̱hĩe eſie ši.

english_verse: Let the king defend the poor, rescue the homeless, and crush everyone who hurts them.
translation_verse: Eeye maṅbii le̱ ateṅ nõnalo̱i le̱ asane ehãame̱, ni eehere ohĩafoi abii ayiwala, ni eekūmo̱ w̌eiyelo̱ dukuduku. K.

english_verse: Let the king live forever like the sun and the moon.
translation_verse: Gbĩĩabo̱ ní hũlũ ke̱ nyontšẽre yo̱ ne̱, ame̱ašeo gbeyei ye̱ yino̱i le̱ fẽ no̱.

english_verse: Let the king be fair with everyone, and let there be peace until the moon falls from the sky.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱ aafro̱ke ye̱ egbĩĩ le̱ amli, ni hedšo̱le̱ aafá ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní nyoṅtsĕre be̱ doṅṅ.

english_verse: Make other rulers bow down and all nations serve him.
translation_verse: Ni maṅtše̱mei fẽ akũlale̱; dšeṅmãdši le̱ fẽ-kwa aasúmo̱le̱. Lal.

english_verse: Long live the king! Give him gold from Sheba. Always pray for the king and praise him each day.
translation_verse: Ni eyi aaná wala, ni eeṅõ *Šeba šika le̱ eko ehãle̱; ni eekpa fai †ehãle̱ dā, dā dšenamo̱ eedšō̱le̱. *K.

english_verse: Let cities overflow with food and hills be covered with grain, just like Mount Lebanon. Let the people in the cities prosper like wild flowers.
translation_verse: Šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ aaba able babaō ke̱-yaſie gõdši le̱ ayiteaṅ; eyibii le̱ aahoso tamo̱ Lebanon, ni ame̱afro̱ke ye̱ mã le̱ṅ tamo̱ šikpoṅ no̱ bāi.

english_verse: May the glory of the king shine brightly forever like the sun in the sky. Let him make nations prosper and learn to praise him.
translation_verse: Egbe̱i le̱ aakã ši ke̱-ate nāno̱; gbĩĩ-abo̱ ní hũlũ yo̱ ne̱ egbe̱i le̱ aagbla nidsi, ni *aadšō̱ gbomei ye̱ emli; dšeṅmãdsi fẽ aakafole̱. *

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, we praise you. Only you can work miracles.
translation_verse: Yidšiemo̱ ahã Iehowa, Nyoṅmo̱ ní dši Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, moni le̱ ekometō efeo̱ nākpe̱nii le̱,

english_verse: We will always praise your glorious name. Let your glory be seen everywhere on earth. Amen and amen.
