translation_verse: ni aadšie enumnyam gbe̱i le̱ yi ke̱-ate nāno̱, ni šikpoṅ mū le̱ fẽ aayi to̱ ke̱ enumnyam le̱! Amen, Amen. Lal.

english_verse: This ends the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: David, Išai bi le̱, so̱lemo̱-lalai le̱ anāgbẽ ne̱.

english_verse: God is truly good to Israel, especially to everyone with a pure heart.
translation_verse: Asaf lala. Le̱le̱ṅ, Nyoṅmo̱ hĩ hã Israel, hã mei ni tšuii amli tše le̱.

english_verse: because it made me jealous to see proud and evil people and to watch them prosper.
translation_verse: Edšake̱, beni mina bo̱ni *meifõdši ſereo̱ le̱, miye hewolo̱i le̱ ahe awuṅã. *Hiob

english_verse: They never have to suffer, they stay healthy,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ame̱naa pĩmo̱ ko ke̱-yaši gbĕle mli, ni ame̱mũsũṅ edšo̱ame̱ ni ewo fo̱.

english_verse: Their pride is like a necklace, and they commit sin more often than they dress themselves.
translation_verse: Hewo̱ le̱ ame̱kue̱nii dši bewõ, yiwale̱ eha ame̱he tamo̱ mama.

english_verse: Their eyes bulge with fat, and their minds are flooded with foolish thoughts.
translation_verse: *Fo̱ So̱ṅṅ ehã ame̱hĩṅme̱ii ekẽlẽ, amedšĩeo ametšuiṅ dſẽṅmo̱i le akpo. *Hiob

english_verse: They dare to speak against God and to order others around.
translation_verse: Ame̱hãa ame̱nā saä ṅwei he, ni ame̱lile̱i kpẽleo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Yet all goes well for them, and they live in peace.
translation_verse: Na, meifõdši dši mene̱mei, ši kẽle̱ dāne̱ ame̱he edšo̱ame̱, ni nii le̱ ná ke̱ke̱ ame̱náa.

english_verse: What good did it do me to keep my thoughts pure and refuse to do wrong?
translation_verse: Le̱le̱ṅ, yakatſā po mitšumo̱ mitšui mli ni mifo midẽ ye̱ bemyeli mli;

english_verse: I am sick all day, and I am punished each morning.
translation_verse: edšake̱ minaä nõ dā dšenamo̱, ni agblaā mitoi dā lebi.

english_verse: If I had said evil things, I would not have been loyal to your people.
translation_verse: Edši mikē̱ ake̱: Mawie ne̱ke̱ kũle̱, na, miye obii le̱ ayino̱bii le̱ ahe kũtũmpo̱o!

english_verse: Then I went to your temple, and there I understood what will happen to my enemies.
translation_verse: ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní mite Mawu hekroṅkroṅ le̱, ni mikpa ame̱nāgbē le̱ ši.

english_verse: You will make them stumble, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Hē̃, oke̱ame̱ eto hei ní šãmoo̱ trotro, oṅõo̱ame̱ otſiaä ši, ni ame̱kũmoo̱ dukuduku.

english_verse: They will be terrified, suddenly swept away and no longer there.
translation_verse: Kwe̱ bo̱ni ame̱tšṍmo̱ amaṅfõ hĩṅme̱itſa! Alōame̱ ke̱-te, ṅmiṅmi so̱ṅṅ ehã ame̱-tã kwrā.

english_verse: They will disappear, Lord, despised like a bad dream the morning after.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱, kē̱ ohĩe tsẽ le̱, oogbe ame̱-subãṅ he guo̱, tamo̱ lamõ ní ala ni hĩe etšẽ.

english_verse: Once I was bitter and brokenhearted.
translation_verse: Mitšui mli šãmi ni misabai amli tšuro̱mi,

english_verse: I was stupid and ignorant, and I treated you as a wild animal would.
translation_verse: kwašia dšimi ní milee nii, mitšṍ tamo̱ kolo ye̱ ohĩe.

english_verse: But I never really left you, and you hold my right hand.
translation_verse: Kẽle̱ mahĩ oṅõ dāne̱; oomõ mininedšũrõ mli, Rom.

english_verse: Your advice has been my guide, and later you will welcome me in glory.
translation_verse: oke̱ oṅāwō le̱ aatšõmi gbe̱, ni ké̱ fe se̱ le̱, ooṅõmí ke̱-ate anumnyam mli.

english_verse: In heaven I have only you, and on this earth you are all I want.
translation_verse: Namo miyo ye̱ ṅwei? ni ké̱ mina bo le̱, mitaoo noko ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: My body and mind may fail, but you are my strength and my choice forever.
translation_verse: Ké̱ mihelo ke̱ mitšui mītã le̱, Nyoṅmo̱ dši mitšui te̱sā ke̱ migbe̱fãṅnõ ke̱-yaä nāno̱! Lal.

english_verse: All-Powerful Lord God, those who stay far from you will be lost, and you will destroy those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Ši na, mei ní ke̱o teṅ dšeke̱ le̱ ahĩe aakpātā; ofiteo̱ mei fē ní dšeo̱ ose̱ yabo̱ō̱ adſamaṅ le̱.

english_verse: It is good for me to be near you. I choose you as my protector, and I will tell about your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, Nyoṅmo̱ ṅõ hĩle̱ hĩ hãmi; mike̱ Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa efe mibobāke, koni magba onitšumo̱i le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: Our God, why have you completely rejected us? Why are you so angry with the ones you care for?
translation_verse: Asaf se̱yōmo̱ lala. Nānyoṅmo̱, mẽba oše̱re̱wo̱ oſie kwrā, ni omlifũ le̱ dše̱leo̱ woo̱ olè̱he tōi le̱ ne̱?

english_verse: Your enemies roared like lions in your holy temple, and they have placed their banners there.
translation_verse: Ohenye̱lo̱i le̱ hū̃o̱ ye̱ gwabō̱ le̱ teṅ, ame̱ṅõ ame̱kadii le̱ ame̱mãmo̱ ši ame̱ke̱-totō okadii.

english_verse: It looks like a forest chopped to pieces.
translation_verse: Ame̱tamo̱ mei ní holeo̱ lemai ano̱ ye̱ kō hayii amli tšei le̱ ano̱,

english_verse: They used axes and hatchets to smash the carvings.
translation_verse: Ši agbe̱ne̱ le̱, emli nibii ní ayeyē mli ṅābii le̱ fẽ le̱, ame̱ke̱ lemai ke̱ hamedši mīkũmo̱.

english_verse: They burned down your temple and badly disgraced it.
translation_verse: Ame̱ma ohekroṅkroṅ le̱ nā la, ame̱bule ogbe̱i le̱ šihĩle̱he le̱ ke̱-te šikpoṅ.

english_verse: There are no more miracles and no more prophets. Who knows how long it will be like this?
translation_verse: Wo̱kadii le̱ wo̱naa; gbalo̱ ko gbalo̱ ko be̱ doṅṅ, asaṅ mokomoko be̱ wo̱teṅ ní le beyino̱ ní ena aayakpa.

english_verse: Why don't you punish them? Why are you holding back?
translation_verse: Mẽba osuo̱ onine ní dši oninedšũrõ le̱ owoo mli? Dšiemo̱ ke̱-dše̱ omīnā ni okpãtã ame̱hĩe!

english_verse: Our God and King, you have ruled since ancient times; you have won victories everywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Ši Nyoṅ mo dši mimaṅtše̱ ke̱-dše̱ blema bēbe, etšuo̱ yiwalaheremo̱ nitsumo̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: By your power you made a path through the sea, and you smashed the heads of sea monsters.
translation_verse: Bo noṅṅ *ogba ṅšo̱ le̱ mli ye̱ ohewale̱ nā, odſãra bonsoi ayitsei ye̱ nui le̱ amli. *

english_verse: You crushed the heads of the monster Leviathan, then fed him to wild creatures in the desert.
translation_verse: Bo noṅṅ odſãra leviatan ayitsei wo̱tšo̱wo̱tšo̱, ni oṅõ-bā ṅãno̱ koloi ni ame̱ye.

english_verse: You opened the ground for streams and springs and dried up mighty rivers.
translation_verse: Bo noṅṅ *odše nubui ke̱ fāi, ni ohãa fāi ní hoo̱ dā le̱ mĩo̱. *Lal.

english_verse: You rule the day and the night, and you put the moon and the sun in place.
translation_verse: Onõ dši ſane, onõ dši nyōṅ hũ, bo noṅṅ osā ṅulami ke̱ *hũlũ oto. *Lal.

english_verse: You made summer and winter and gave them to the earth.
translation_verse: Bo oto šikpoṅ le̱ hũsũi le̱ fe; la-tsā ke̱ fẽi bei fẽ le̱, bo noṅṅ ofe.

english_verse: Remember your enemies, Lord! They foolishly sneer and won't respect you.
translation_verse: Kaimo̱ ene̱, ake̱ henye̱lo̱ le̱ bo̱ō̱ Iehowa ahora, ni maṅ kwašiai gbeo̱ ogbe̱i le̱ he guo̱!

english_verse: You treat us like pet doves, but they mistreat us. Don't keep forgetting us and letting us be fed to those wild animals.
translation_verse: Kāṅõ okose̱-okpo le̱ susuma ohã koloi, ni ohĩe akakpa onõnalo̱i le̱ awala ne̱ kwrā!

english_verse: Remember the agreement you made with us. Violent enemies are hiding in every dark corner of the earth.
translation_verse: Ohĩe ahĩ okpãṅmo̱ le̱ ne̱, edšake̱ šikpoṅ no̱ hei ní ewo duṅ le̱ eyimo̱ obõbõ ke̱ yiwale̱ šihĩle̱hei!

english_verse: Don't disappoint those in need or make them turn from you, but help the poor and homeless to shout your praises.
translation_verse: Kāhã moni ahaoo̱le̱ le̱ mīkũ ese̱ ke̱ hĩegbĕle; hã nõnalo̱ ke̱ ohĩafo fẽ adšie ogbe̱i le̱ yi!

english_verse: Do something, God! Defend yourself. Remember how those fools sneer at you all day long.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱, wó ohe no̱ ni oye osane le̱! Kaimo̱ bo̱ni kwašia le bo̱ō̱o ahora dā dšenamo̱!

english_verse: The earth trembles, and its people shake; you alone keep its foundations firm.
translation_verse: “Edšake̱, ké̱ mihe le̱ še̱ le̱, makodšo ye̱ dšale̱ nā.

english_verse: You tell every bragger, “Stop bragging!” And to the wicked you say, “Don't boast of your power!
translation_verse: Šikpoṅ le̱ ke̱ eno̱bii le̱ fẽ atšui efã; mi, mike̱ ekulasĩṅi le̱ māmo̱ ši kpẽṅṅ!”

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, victory doesn't come from the east or the west or from the desert.
translation_verse: Nyekawóa nyeklonto le̱ no̱ ke̱-yaä ṅwei, ni nyeke̱ kue̱kuomo̱ akawiea hewō wiemo̱i!

english_verse: But I will always tell about you, the God of Jacob, and I will sing your praise.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa hĩe kpulu ko ye̱ edeṅ, ni wein le̱ mĩtſa afũi, afutule̱ dsogbāṅ, ni no noṅṅ eko efoo̱; ši ešiši-atutru, meifõdši fẽ ní yo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ aaſo̱ anu. Lal.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will destroy the power of evil people, but you will give strength to those who are good.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱ madšadše matšõ ke̱-ate nāno̱, mala madšie Iakob Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ yi,

english_verse: You, our God, are famous in Judah and honored in Israel.
translation_verse: Asaf lala ni ela ní eke̱-hã lalatše̱ nukpa le̱, ní ake̱ saṅkũ ala.

english_verse: There you destroyed fiery arrows, shields, swords, and all the other weapons.
translation_verse: Ebū ye̱ Salem, ni ešihĩle̱he ye̱ Zion. Lal

english_verse: You are more glorious than the eternal mountains.
translation_verse: Dše̱i ekũmo̱ gãimlibii le̱ ye̱, ke̱ tše̱ṅ ke̱ klante ke̱ ta le̱. Lal.

english_verse: God of Jacob, when you roar, enemy chariots and horses drop dead in their tracks.
translation_verse: Ahahā ekãlo̱i ní yo̱ tšui le̱, ame̱tšṍ mli ame̱wo̱wo̱i, ni hĩĩ kãkãlo̱i le̱ ateṅ mokomoko nineṅ be̱ wu.

english_verse: From heaven you announced your decisions as judge! And all who live on this earth were terrified and silent
translation_verse: Bo le̱, ohe ye̱ gbeyei po, ni ké̱ omli efũ le̱, namo aanyẽ ohĩe adamo̱?

english_verse: when you took over as judge, ready to rescue everyone in need.
translation_verse: Ṅwei tō̃ ohã anu otẽṅbū le̱ he ke̱-dše̱; šikpoṅ le̱ še gbeyei, ni efe diṅṅ, Lal.

english_verse: Even the most angry people will praise you when you are furious.
translation_verse: beni Nyoṅmo̱ te ši ebakodšo ni ehere šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ nõnalo̱i le̱ fẽ ayiwala le̱.

english_verse: God destroys the courage of rulers and kings and makes cowards of them.
translation_verse: Nyewoa Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ši ni nyeyea no̱! Mei fẽ ní bo̱le ehe le̱ ke̱ nikēnii abahã *moní he yo̱ gbeyei le̱. *

english_verse: When I think of you, I feel restless and weak.
translation_verse: Mihaomo̱ gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ mitao Nuṅtšo̱ le̱: mikpãa minine mli nyōṅnyōṅ fẽ ni misuu; misusuma ekplẽẽ mīše̱dšemo̱.

english_verse: Because of you, Lord God, I can't sleep. I am restless and can't even talk.
translation_verse: Ké̱ mikai Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, midõmoo̱ ntšo̱i; ni ké̱ miſie miyiṅ le̱, mimumo̱ to̱ō̱ biti.

english_verse: I think of times gone by, of those years long ago.
translation_verse: Ohĩe mihĩṅme̱ii amli ni miwo̱o̱; haomo̱ so̱ṅṅ hewo̱ le̱ minyẽẽ mawie.

english_verse: “Have you rejected me forever? Won't you be kind again?
translation_verse: Mihĩe aaba misaṅkũtſä no̱ nyōṅ, maſie miyiṅ, ni mimumo̱ le̱ aatao nii amli fitšofitšo.

english_verse: Is this the end of your love and your promises?
translation_verse: Aso Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ aaše̱ mo afõ ke̱-ate nāno̱, ni enaṅ mo mo̱bo̱ doṅṅ? Lal.

english_verse: Have you forgotten how to have pity? Do you refuse to show mercy because of your anger?”
translation_verse: Aso emo̱bo̱nale̱ etã kwrā ke̱-mīya nāno̱, ni ešiwō le̱ hũ se̱ efo ke̱-mīya nāno̱ tṍ?

english_verse: Then I said, “God Most High, what hurts me most is that you no longer help us with your mighty arm.”
translation_verse: Aso Mawu hĩe ekpa edromo̱ le̱ no̱? alo eke̱ mliſũ eko̱ kpã efĩ emli?

english_verse: Everything you do is right, and no other god compares with you.
translation_verse: Madſẽṅ onitšumo̱i le̱ fẽ he, ni masusu onifemo̱i le̱ ahe.

english_verse: You alone work miracles, and you have let nations see your mighty power.
translation_verse: Nānyoṅmo̱, ogbe̱ le̱ ye̱ kroṅkroṅ! Namo dši Nyoṅmo̱ kple tamo̱ Mawu?

english_verse: The ocean looked at you, God, and it trembled deep down with fear.
translation_verse: Oke̱ onine kpõ omaṅ le̱, ní dši Iakob ke̱ Iosef bii le̱.

english_verse: Water flowed from the clouds. Thunder was heard above as your arrows of lightning flashed about.
translation_verse: Nui le̱ nao, Nānyoṅmo̱, nui le̱ nao, ni ame̱še gbeyei, asaṅ bui kwo̱ṅkwo̱ṅi le̱ ahe kpokpo.

english_verse: Your thunder roared like chariot wheels. The world was made bright by lightning, and all the earth trembled.
translation_verse: Oblo̱tui le̱ fo̱se nu ſie ši; nyoṅmo̱ ši ye̱ atatui le̱ amli, ni osrawai le̱ hũ gblagblai.

english_verse: You walked through the water of the mighty sea, but your footprints were never seen.
translation_verse: Ošimo̱ le̱ gbé̱ ye̱ lasũogbĕle mli; srawai kple̱ la wo dše le̱ṅ, šikpoṅ le̱ kpokpo ni ehoso.

english_verse: You guided your people like a flock of sheep, and you chose Moses and Aaron to be their leaders.
translation_verse: Ogbe̱ le̱ kã ṅšo̱ mli, ni otempõṅi le̱ kāmo̱ nui pī amli, ni onãdši amãmo̱hei le̱ alee.

english_verse: They stubbornly tested God and demanded from him what they wanted to eat.
translation_verse: ni ame̱ka Mawu ye̱ ame̱tšui mli, ake̱-ní ame̱bi ṅmā̃ ši ame̱hã ame̱susuma le̱,

english_verse: But God gave a command to the clouds, and he opened the doors in the skies.
translation_verse: Kẽle̱ efã ṅwei atatui le̱, ni egble ṅwei šīnãi le̱ hũ,

english_verse: God's mighty power sent a strong wind from the southeast,
translation_verse: Ehã bokã kō̱yo̱ tſa ye̱ ṅwei ni eke̱ ehewale̱ kpla wuoyigbe̱ kō̱yo̱ ke̱-ba;

english_verse: Then God made the birds fall in the camp of his people near their tents.
translation_verse: ni ehã ebaſie ame̱nsra le̱ teṅ ke̱-bo̱le ame̱šihĩle̱hei le̱.

english_verse: But before they had swallowed the last bite,
translation_verse: Ame̱tšinebānii le̱ edšeko ame̱tšine, ame̱niyenii le̱ ye̱ ame̱dāṅ lolo,

english_verse: God became angry and killed the strongest and best from the families of Israel.
translation_verse: ke̱ke̱ ni Nyoṅmo̱ mlifũ te ši woame̱, ni egbegbẽ ame̱teṅ mei ni ewo fo̱ le̱ ateṅ meikomei, ni eṅõ Israel oblahĩĩ le̱ etſiatſiā ši.

english_verse: After he killed some of them, the others turned to him with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Beni egbeame̱ le̱, no ame̱bi eši, ni ame̱kũ ame̱se̱ ni ame̱tao Mawu se̱gbe̱ oyá,

english_verse: They remembered God Most High, the mighty rock that kept them safe.
translation_verse: ni ame̱kai ake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ dši ame̱-te̱sā, ni Mawu Ṅweinyo le̱ dši ame̱kpõlo̱.

english_verse: But they tried to flatter God, and they told him lies;
translation_verse: Ši ame̱ke̱ ame̱dā do̱ko̱ enā, ni ame̱-ke̱ ame̱lile̱i male tšõle̱;

english_verse: they were unfaithful and broke their promises.
translation_verse: ši ame̱tšui damo̱o̱ ši šiṅṅ hããle̱, ni ame̱yee ekpãṅmo̱ le̱ ano̱kwa.

english_verse: Yet God was kind. He kept forgiving their sins and didn't destroy them. He often became angry, but never lost his temper.
translation_verse: Ši le̱ le̱, emũsũṅ tšōo̱le̱ kẽ eke̱ ame̱nõša le̱ faame̱, ni efiteeame̱, ni bei pī etšĩo̱ emlifũ le̱ nā, ni etēē emlila le̱ fiã ši,

english_verse: God remembered that they were made of flesh and were like a wind that blows once and then dies down.
translation_verse: ni ekai ake̱ helo ke̱ke̱ dšiame̱, kō̱-yo̱ ni hoo̱ yaã ni ekũũ ese̱ doṅṅ. Lal.

english_verse: While they were in the desert, they often rebelled and made God sad.
translation_verse: Kwe̱ šiiabo̱ ni ame̱tše ehĩe atũa ye̱ ṅã le̱ no̱, ni ame̱fele̱ nidō̱nii ye̱ ṅã ole̱ṅle̱ le̱ no̱!

english_verse: They kept testing him and caused terrible pain for the Holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ka Mawu no̱tono̱to, ni ame̱-wo Israel Mokroṅkroṅ le̱ mli la.

english_verse: They forgot about his power and how he had rescued them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Ame̱kaii enine le̱ po lo gbĩ ni ekpõame̱ ke̱-dše̱ henye̱lo̱ le̱ deṅ le̱,

english_verse: God showed them all kinds of wonderful miracles near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: beni efe ekadii le̱ ye̱ Mizraim, ke̱ *enākpe̱nii le̱ ye̱ Zoan ṅã le̱ no̱ le̱; *K.

english_verse: He turned the rivers of Egypt into blood, and no one could drink from the streams.
translation_verse: ni ehã ame̱fāi le̱ ke̱ ame̱nsutẽṅi le̱ tšṍmo̱ lá, ní ame̱nyẽẽ ame̱nu le̱;

english_verse: He sent swarms of flies to pester the Egyptians, and he sent frogs to cause them trouble.
translation_verse: ni etšũ ofo̱ii ke̱-ba ame̱teṅ, ni ame̱-yeame̱, ke̱ ko̱ko̱denei hũ, ni ame̱kpãtã ame̱hĩe.

english_verse: God let worms and grasshoppers eat their crops.
translation_verse: Eṅõ ame̱nibānii le̱ hũ ehā agāi, ni eke̱ ame̱nitšumo̱ mli nii le̱ hã bālabii.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees with hail and floods.
translation_verse: Eke̱ nyoṅmo̱ṅte̱i bibii gbe ame̱-weintšei le̱, ni eke̱ nyoṅmo̱ṅte̱i wudši gbe ame̱sikamoretšei le̱.

english_verse: Then he killed their cattle with hail and their other animals with lightning.
translation_verse: Ni eke̱ ame̱lè̱-koloi le̱ hã nyoṅmo̱ṅte̱, ni eke̱ ame̱kolokui le̱ hã srawai.

english_verse: God was so angry and furious that he went into a rage and caused them great trouble by sending swarms of destroying angels.
translation_verse: Ehã emlifũ ní nā wa ba ame̱no̱, ke̱ grimo̱ ke̱ mlila ke̱ haomo̱, bo̱foi fõdši asafo po.

english_verse: God released his anger and slaughtered them in a terrible way.
translation_verse: Edše gbe̱ ehã emlifũ le̱, ni ebāā ame̱susuma yi ke̱-dse̱e̱ gbĕle mli, ši eṅõ ame̱wala ehã gbēle-hela;

english_verse: He killed the first-born son of each Egyptian family.
translation_verse: ni egbe Mizraim kromo̱bii fẽ, mei ní dši hewale̱ šišidšē ye̱ Ham būi le̱ amli le̱.

english_verse: Then God led his people out of Egypt and guided them in the desert like a flock of sheep.
translation_verse: Ši edšie emaṅ le̱ ke̱-dše kpo tamo̱ tōi, ni ekplaame̱ ke-nyie ṅã le̱ no̱ tamo̱ tōiku, Lal.

english_verse: He led them safely along, and they were not afraid, but their enemies drowned in the sea.
translation_verse: ni ewaame̱ ſeſēſe ni ame̱šee gbeyei; ši ame̱henye̱lo̱i le̱, ṅšo̱ ha ame̱no̱.

english_verse: God brought his people to the sacred mountain that he had taken by his own power.
translation_verse: Ni eke̱ame̱ ba ešihĩle̱he kroṅkroṅ le̱ hũsũi le̱ amli, ke̱-ba goṅ ne̱ ni enine-dšũrõ be le̱ be,

english_verse: He made nations run from the tribes of Israel, and he let the tribes take over their land.
translation_verse: ni eſie dšeṅmãdši le̱ ye̱ ame̱hĩe, ni eke̱ ošiki dša mli ehãame̱ ye̱ susumo̱kpã nā, ni ehã Israel akutšei le̱ hĩ nomei abui le̱ amli.

english_verse: But the people tested God Most High, and they refused to obey his laws.
translation_verse: Ši kẽle̱ ame̱ka Nyoṅmo̱ Ṅweinyo le̱ ni ame̱tše ehĩe atũa, ni edasei le̱ hũ ame̱-yee no̱,

english_verse: They were as unfaithful as their ancestors, and they were as crooked as a twisted arrow.
translation_verse: ni ame̱kũ ame̱se̱ ni ame̱ye kūtũmpo̱o tamo̱ ame̱tše̱mei le̱, ame̱tšṍmo̱ afã *tamo̱ gãi gbonyo ko. *Hos.

english_verse: God demanded all their love, but they made him angry by worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ame̱ke̱ ame̱hei groṅṅi le̱ wo emli la, ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱mãgãi le̱ hã eye awuṅā.

english_verse: So God became furious and completely rejected the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Beni Nyoṅmo̱ nu ene̱ le̱, emli wo la, ni enyãṅe Israel kwrakwra.

english_verse: Then he deserted his home at Shiloh, where he lived here on earth.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ ekwa Šilo šihĩle̱he le̱, bū hũ ní eši ye̱ gbomei ateṅ le,

english_verse: He let enemies capture the sacred chest and let them dishonor him.
translation_verse: ni eṅõ ehewale̱ le̱ ewo nom mli, ni etu enumnyam le̱ ewo hetšẽlo̱ deṅ.

english_verse: God took out his anger on his chosen ones and let them be killed by enemy swords.
translation_verse: Eṅmē̃ emaṅ le̱ hũ he ehã klante, ni emli wo egbe̱fãṅnõ le̱ la.

english_verse: Fire destroyed the young men, and the young women were left with no one to marry.
translation_verse: Ame̱blahĩĩ le̱, la šãame̱, ni ame̱blayei le̱ hũ, alaa kpēmo̱-lala ko ahããame̱.

english_verse: Priests died violent deaths, but their widows were not allowed to mourn.
translation_verse: *Ame̱so̱foi le̱ nyõnyõi ye̱ klante nā, ni ame̱kũlafoi le̱ woo yārawō po. *

english_verse: Finally the Lord woke up, like a soldier startled from a drunken sleep.
translation_verse: No ni Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ hīe tšẽ tamo̱ moko ní dše̱ wo̱ mli, tamo̱ kãkãlo̱ ni ke̱ wein bo̱ö̱ oše,

english_verse: God scattered his enemies and made them ashamed forever.
translation_verse: ní etſia ehenye̱lo̱i le̱ ayise̱ nii, nāno̱ ahora po ebo̱ame̱.

english_verse: Then the Lord decided not to make his home with Joseph's descendants in Ephraim.
translation_verse: Ši ekwa Iosef bū le̱, ni ehalaa *Efraim akutšo le̱; *K.

english_verse: Instead he chose the tribe of Judah, and he chose Mount Zion, the place he loves.
translation_verse: ši ehala Iuda akutšo le̱ moṅ, Zion goṅ le̱ ní esumoo̱ le̱.

english_verse: There he built his temple as lofty as the mountains and as solid as the earth he made to last forever.
translation_verse: Ni emã ehekroṅkroṅ le̱ tamo̱ ṅweikwo̱le̱, tamo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ ní eṅõmã ši ke̱-mīya nāno̱ le̱.

english_verse: The Lord God chose David to be his servant and took him from tending sheep
translation_verse: Ni ehala etšũlo̱ David, ni efãle ke̱-dše̱ tōiatšũiaṅ;

english_verse: and from caring for lambs. Then God made him the leader of Israel, his own nation.
translation_verse: ekplale̱ ke̱-dše̱ tōi ní hãa fufo̱ le̱ ase̱ ke̱-ba, koni ebalè̱ Iakob ní dši emaṅ le̱ ke̱ Israel ni dši egbe̱fãṅnō le̱.

english_verse: David treated the people fairly and guided them with wisdom.
translation_verse: Ni elè̱ame̱ ye̱ etšuiṅ emūyeli le̱ nā, ni eke̱ ṅā-nidši tsõame̱ gbe̱.

english_verse: Our God, foreign nations have taken your land, disgraced your temple, and left Jerusalem in ruins.
translation_verse: Asaf lala. Nānyoṅmo̱, dšeṅmãdši le̱ eba ogbe̱fãṅnõ le̱ mli, ame̱bule oso̱lemo̱we kroṅkroṅ le̱, ame̱fe Ierusalem koikoi.

english_verse: All Jerusalem is covered with their blood, and there is no one left to bury them.
translation_verse: Ame̱fo̱se ame̱lá ame̱ſĩe ši tamo̱ nu ke̱-bo̱le Ierusalem ke̱-kpe, ni mokomoko be̱ ni aafũame̱.

english_verse: Get angry with those nations that don't know you and won't worship you!
translation_verse: Fo̱semo̱ omlila le̱ oſíe dšeṅmãdši ní leeo le̱ ke̱ maṅtše̱yelii hũ ni tšé̱é̱ ogbe̱i le̱ ano̱; Ier.

english_verse: Don't make us pay for the sins of our ancestors. Have pity and come quickly! We are completely helpless.
translation_verse: Kākai wo̱blemabii le̱ anišaianii le̱ owowo̱; hã omũsũṅtšõle̱ le̱ ke̱wo̱ akpe oyá, edšake̱ abawo̱ ši naakpa.

english_verse: Our God, you keep us safe. Now help us! Rescue us. Forgive our sins and bring honor to yourself.
translation_verse: Ye obuawo̱, wo̱yiwalaheremo̱ Nyoṅmo̱, ye̱ ogbe̱i le̱ hĩenyam hewo̱, ni odšie-wo̱ ni otšumo̱ wo̱he ešai le̱ ye̱ ogbe̱i le̱ hewo̱!

english_verse: Why should nations ask us, “Where is your God?” Let us and the other nations see you take revenge for your servants who died a violent death.
translation_verse: Mẽba dšeṅmãdši le̱ aakē̱ ake̱: *Nẽgbe̱ ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ yo̱? Hã ní ale ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ, ye̱ wo̱hĩṅme̱iiaṅ, bo̱ni oto̱ö̱ otšũdši alá ni eſie ši le̱ he owele! *Lal.

english_verse: Listen to the prisoners groan! Let your mighty power save all who are sentenced to die.
translation_verse: Hã gbokle̱fonyo ntšo̱idõmo̱ le̱ aba ohĩe; bāmo̱ gbĕle bii le̱ ayi ye̱ ohewale̱ le̱ dale̱ nā, Lal.

english_verse: Each of those nations sneered at you, our Lord. Now let others sneer at them, seven times as much.
translation_verse: ni oto wo̱hegbomei le̱ ahora ni ame̱bo̱o le̱ nādšiaṅ toi kpawo ošãkã ame̱tšitši, Nuṅtšo̱! Lal.

english_verse: Then we, your people, will always thank you. We are like sheep with you as our shepherd, and all generations will hear us praise you.
translation_verse: No le̱ wo̱ ní dši omaṅ ke̱ olè̱he le̱ toi le̱, wo̱o̱dao ši ke̱-ate nāno̱, wo̱o̱dšadše oyidšiemo̱ le̱ wo̱tsõ yino̱i fẽ.

english_verse: for the tribes of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Save us by your power.
translation_verse: Israel tōkwe̱lo̱, bo toi! Bo ní okplaä Iosef tamo̱ tōiku le̱, bo ní *otá kerubim ano̱ le̱, badše hālãṅṅ! *

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Tēmo̱ ohewale̱ le̱ ši ye̱ Efraim ke̱ Benyamin ke̱ Manase hĩe, ni oba obaherewo̱!

english_verse: Because of you, our enemies who live nearby laugh and joke about us.
translation_verse: Ohã ame̱ye yāfónui abolo, ni ohã amenu yāfónui babaō. Lal

english_verse: Then you cleared the ground, and we put our roots deep, spreading over the land.
translation_verse: Oyafã weintšo ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim ke̱-ba, oſie dšeṅmãdši le̱ ni ote̱ole. Ies.

english_verse: Shade from this vine covered the mountains. Its branches climbed the mighty cedars
translation_verse: Osā mā̃he ohãle̱, ni etšẽrẽ fãi ke̱-te šikpoṅ tō̃, ni ekpẽle šikpoṅ le̱ ne̱.

english_verse: and stretched to the sea; its new growth reached to the river.
translation_verse: Ehō̃ṅ le̱ ha gõdši le̱ ano̱, ni enidši le̱ ha Mawu tšenedrui le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: Our Lord, why have you torn down the wall from around the vineyard? You let everyone who walks by pick the grapes.
translation_verse: Egbla nidši ke̱-yamõ ṅšo̱, ni eni-dši fo̱bii yaše̱ fā le̱ ha tō̃.

english_verse: Now the vine is gobbled up by pigs from the forest and other wild animals.
translation_verse: Mẽba okũmo̱ ehe afãbaṅi le̱, ní mei fiā ní hoo̱ ye̱ gbe̱ le̱ no̱ le̱ tšere̱o̱le̱ ne̱? Lal

english_verse: God All-Powerful, please do something! Look down from heaven and see what's happening to this vine.
translation_verse: Ni kõ le̱ṅ batafo le̱ mīkpãtã hĩe, ni ṅãno̱ koloi le̱ mīye.

english_verse: With your own hands you planted its roots, and you raised it as your very own.
translation_verse: Zebaot Nyoṅmo̱, wo̱mĩkpao fai, kũ ose̱! Dše̱ ṅwei ogbo ohĩe ši okwe̱, ni obasra ne̱ke̱ weintšo ne̱,

english_verse: Enemies chopped the vine down and set it on fire. Now show your anger and destroy them.
translation_verse: ni obu noni oninedšũrõ te̱o le̱ ke̱ bi ní olè̱ ohã ohe le̱ he!

english_verse: But help the one who sits at your right side, the one you raised to be your very own.
translation_verse: Ašãle̱ ke̱ la, afole̱ afõ ši; ohĩe yi-ṅã nā le̱ ame̱hĩe mīkpãtã!

english_verse: Then we will never turn away. Put new life into us, and we will worship you.
translation_verse: Hã onine akã nū ní yo̱ oninedšũrõ no̱ le̱ ke̱ gbomobi ní olè̱ ohã ohe le̱ he!

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: No le̱ wo̱kpaleṅ ke̱-dše̱ṅ ohe; hã wo̱yi aná wala, ni wo̱o̱tšé̱ ogbe̱i le̱.

english_verse: Be happy and shout to God who makes us strong! Shout praises to the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Asaf lala ní eke̱-hã lalatše̱ nukpa le̱, ní ake̱ saṅkũ ala.

english_verse: “I lifted the burden from your shoulder and took the heavy basket from your hands.
translation_verse: Eṅõ-fe odase ye̱ Iosef mli, beni etšṍ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ke̱-ho; heni mina wiemo̱ ko ní milee ye̱ le̱.

english_verse: “Listen, my people, while I, the Lord, correct you! Israel, if you would only pay attention to me!
translation_verse: Haomo̱ le̱ mli le̱ oblo̱, ni midšieo, mihereo no̱ ye̱ nyoṅmo̱šimo̱he le̱; mikao hũ ye̱ *Meriba nu le̱ he. *

english_verse: Don't worship foreign gods or bow down to gods you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Bo toi, mimaṅ, ni magba mli kpo makeo; Israel miná ni obomi toi!

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt. Just ask, and I will give you whatever you need.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱ kpõṅ ko akahĩ omli, ni oka-dšá maṅse̱ nyoṅmo̱ ko kwrā!

english_verse: “But, my people, Israel, you refused to listen, and you would have nothing to do with me!
translation_verse: Mi, midši Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, moni dšieo ke̱-dše̱ Mízraim šikpoṅ le̱ ne̱ le̱: gbe̱ odāṅ hatõ, ni mawole̱ obõ!

english_verse: So I let you be stubborn and keep on following your own advice.
translation_verse: Ši mimaṅ le̱ boo migbē toi, ni asaṅ Israel, ekplẽẽmi.

english_verse: I, the Lord, would quickly defeat your enemies with my mighty power.
translation_verse: Mina ni mimaṅ le̱ bomi toi, ni Israel nyie migbè̱i le̱ ano̱,

english_verse: Everyone who hates me would come crawling, and that would be the end of them.
translation_verse: kũle̱ etše̱ṅ ni maba ame̱henye̱lo̱i le̱ aši, ni matšṍ minine mawo ame̱haolo̱i le̱;

english_verse: But I would feed you with the finest bread and with the best honey until you were full.”
translation_verse: kũle̱ mei ni nye̱o̱ Iehowa le̱ aaba ame̱he ši ame̱bāle̱; ši ame̱ le̱ ame̱be le̱ aakã no̱ ke̱-ate nāno̱.

english_verse: Be fair to the poor and to orphans. Defend the helpless and everyone in need.
translation_verse: Nyeyea ohĩafo ke̱ awusã sane nyehãa-ame̱; nyewiea nyehãa nõnalo̱ ke̱ moni be̱ moko moṅ! Ies.

english_verse: Rescue the weak and homeless from the powerful hands of heartless people.
translation_verse: Nyeherea ohĩafo ke̱ moni efĩle̱ le̱, nyedšiea-ame̱ ye̱ meifõdši adeṅ!

english_verse: “I, the Most High God, say that all of you are gods and also my own children.
translation_verse: Mi le̱ miké̱ ake̱: *Nyoṅmo̱i dšinye ni Ṅweinyo le̱ bii dši nyeblublu kwa: *K.

english_verse: But you will die, just like everyone else, including powerful rulers.”
translation_verse: kẽle̱ nyebagboi tamo̱ gbomei noṅṅ, ni nyebanyõnyõi tamo̱ lume̱i le̱ eko noṅṅ!

english_verse: Do something, God! Judge the nations of the earth; they belong to you.
translation_verse: Nānyoṅmo̱, wó ohe no̱, ni okodšo šikpoṅ le̱; edšake̱ bo onõ dši dšeṅmãdši le̱ fẽ!

english_verse: Your hateful enemies are turning against you and rebelling.
translation_verse: Nānyoṅmo̱, kāfe diō, kābu onā ni kāfe kpō, Mawu!

english_verse: They are sly, and they plot against those you treasure.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ohenye̱lo̱i le̱ mīfe hō, ni mei ni he tšẽo̱o le̱ ehole ame̱yitšei ano̱.

english_verse: All of them fully agree in their plans against you, and among them are
translation_verse: ame̱kē̱o̱ ake̱: “Nyebaã, ni wo̱butuaame̱ ni ame̱kāfe maṅ doṅṅ, ni akakai Israel gbe̱i le̱ doṅṅ!”

english_verse: Treat their leaders as you did Oreb and Zeeb, Zebah and Zalmunna.
translation_verse: Mei ní hĩe kpãtã ye̱ Endor, ni ame̱tšṍmo̱ tumu ame̱hã šikpoṅ le̱.

english_verse: Our God, scatter them around like dust in a whirlwind.
translation_verse: ame̱ mei ní ame̱kē̱o̱ ake̱: Nyehãa w̌o̱ṅõa *Nyoṅmo̱ šihĩle̱hei le̱ wo̱fea wo̱-nii le̱! *Lal.

english_verse: Just as flames destroy forests on the mountains,
translation_verse: Mi-Nyoṅmo̱, hã ame̱tšṍmo̱ tamo̱ lasũogbĕle mli mlu, tamo̱ tutũ ye̱ kō̱yo̱ nā!

english_verse: pursue and terrify them with storms of your own.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni la šãa kõ ni lalilei hũ woo̱ gõdši ala le̱,

english_verse: Make them blush with shame, until they turn and worship you, our Lord.
translation_verse: nakai noṅṅ oke̱ ohum le̱ anyie ame̱se̱, ni oke̱ okō̱yo̱ ní nā wa le̱ awo ame̱he gbeyei!

english_verse: Let them be forever ashamed and confused. Let them die in disgrace.
translation_verse: Hã ame̱hĩeaṅ ayimo̱ obõbõ ke̱ hĩe-gbĕle, koni ame̱tao bo, Iehowa, ogbe̱i le̱ se̱gbe̱!

english_verse: Make them realize that you are the Lord Most High, the only ruler of earth!
translation_verse: Ame̱hĩe agboi ni ame̱he akpokpo dādā, ame̱bo̱ ame̱he ahora ni ame̱hao dāne̱,

english_verse: When they reach Dry Valley, springs start flowing, and the autumn rain fills it with pools of water.
translation_verse: Adšō̱ gbomo ni ehewale̱ yo̱ omli le̱; gbe̱dšegbe̱i le̱ ye̱ ame̱tšuii amli.

english_verse: Your people grow stronger, and you, the God of gods, will be seen in Zion.
translation_verse: Ké̱ ame̱tšṍ yāfó dšō̱ le̱ṅ le̱, ame̱hãa etšṍo̱ heni nubui yo̱; agbee̱nā nyoṅmo̱ne̱mo̱ le̱ ṅõo̱ dšō̱mo̱i so̱nṅ ehaä no̱.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Jacob, please answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Ame̱dše̱o̱ hewale̱ mli ke̱-yaä hewale̱ mli ke̱-bapueo̱ ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe ye̱ Zion.

english_verse: You are the shield that protects your people, and I am your chosen one. Won't you smile on me?
translation_verse: Iehowa, Zebaot Nyoṅmo̱, bo miso̱lemo le toi; femo̱ toi, Iakob Nyoṅmo!

english_verse: One day in your temple is better than a thousand anywhere else. I would rather serve in your house, than live in the homes of the wicked.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱, bo ní dši wo̱tše̱ṅ le̱, kwe̱mo̱ ni owo ohĩe no̱ okwe̱ moni ofo̱le̱ mũ le̱ hĩe! Lal.

english_verse: Our Lord, you have blessed your land and made all go well for Jacob's descendants.
translation_verse: Korabii le̱ alala ni ame̱ke̱-hã lalatše̱ nukpa le̱.

english_verse: You have forgiven the sin and taken away the guilt of your people.
translation_verse: Iehowa, oná ošikpoṅ le̱ he tšui, okpla Iakob nom ní aṅõle̱ ke̱-ba ekoṅ.

english_verse: Your fierce anger is no longer aimed at us.
translation_verse: Oṅõ omaṅ le̱ tõmo̱ le̱ ofa, otšĩmo̱ ame̱he ešai le̱ fẽ no̱. Lal.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you save us! Please bring us back home and don't be angry.
translation_verse: Odšie omlila le̱ fẽ ke̱-dše wo̱no̱, okpale ke̱-dše̱ omlifũ ní nā wa le̱ mli.

english_verse: Won't you give us fresh life and let your people be glad because of you?
translation_verse: Aso omli aafũwo̱ ke̱-ate nāno̱? ookã omlifũ le̱ he ke̱-te yino̱i fẽ no lo? Lal

english_verse: Show us your love and save us!
translation_verse: Aso ohãṅ wo̱yi aná wala ekoṅ, beni afe ní omaṅ le̱ anyã́ ye̱ omli?

english_verse: I will listen to you, Lord God, because you promise peace to those who are faithful and no longer foolish.
translation_verse: Iehowa, dšiemo̱ omo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱ otšõ-wo̱, ni oke̱ oyiwalaheremo̱ le̱ adrowo̱!

english_verse: You are ready to rescue everyone who worships you, so that you will live with us in all your glory.
translation_verse: Mabo noni Mawu Iehowa aawie toi; edšake̱ ewieo̱ hedšo̱le̱ wiemo̱i etšṍo̱ emaṅ le̱ ke̱ emei kroṅkroṅi le̱, ni ame̱kakũ ame̱se̱ ekoṅ ke̱-mīya kwašiafemo mli. Lal.

english_verse: Love and loyalty will come together; goodness and peace will unite.
translation_verse: Le̱le̱ṅ eyiwalaheremo̱ be̱ṅke̱ mei ni šeo̱le̱ gbeyei le̱, koni anumnyam ahĩ wo̱-šikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Loyalty will sprout from the ground; justice will look down from the sky above.
translation_verse: Mo̱bo̱nale̱ ke̱ ano̱kwale ebakpe, dšale̱ ke̱ hedšole̱ eſo̱ſō̱ amehe nā.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will bless us; our land will produce wonderful crops.
translation_verse: Ano̱kwale le̱, šikpon ekwẽo̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱, ni dšale̱ dše̱o̱ ṅwei gboo̱ ehĩe ši ekwe̱o̱.

english_verse: Justice will march in front, making a path for you to follow.
translation_verse: Iehowa aṅō nõkpakpa ahã, ni wo̱-šikpoṅ le̱ aaba enii.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord, and answer my prayer! I am poor and helpless.
translation_verse: David So̱lemo̱. Iehowa, gbo otoi ši ni obomi toi; edšake̱ minii ye̱ mo̱bo̱ ni ohĩafo dšimi!

english_verse: Be kind to me! I pray to you all day.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱, nami mo̱bo̱, edšake̱ bo miblo̱ö mitšé̱o̱ dā dšenamo̱! Lal.

english_verse: Make my heart glad! I serve you, and my prayer is sincere.
translation_verse: Hã ní otšũlo̱ susuma anyã́, edšake̱ bo, Nuṅtšo̱, miwoo misusuma no̱ mihãa.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord! Answer my prayer for help.
translation_verse: Iehowa, femo̱ toi ohã miso̱lemo̱ le̱, ni obo miſaikpamo̱i le̱ agbe toi!

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray, knowing you will listen.
translation_verse: Mihaomo̱ gbĩ no̱ le̱ mablo̱ matšé̱o, edšake̱ ooheremi no̱. Lal.

english_verse: No other gods are like you; only you work miracles.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱, mokomoko be̱ ní tamo̱o ye̱ nyoṅmo̱i le̱ ateṅ, ni asaṅ nokonoko be̱ ní tamo̱ onitšumo̱i le̱. Lal.

english_verse: You created each nation, and they will all bow down to worship and honor you.
translation_verse: Dšeṅmãdšimãdši fẽ ní ofe le̱ aaba abadšáo, Nuṅtšo̱, ni ame̱awo ogbe̱i le̱ hĩe nyam.

english_verse: You perform great wonders because you alone are God.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ oda, ni ofeo̱ nākpe̱nii, bo okometō dši Nyoṅmo̱!

english_verse: With all my heart I thank you. I praise you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱, mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, madšie oyi ke̱ mitšui fẽ, ni mawo ogbe̱i le̱ hĩe nyam ke̱-ate nāno̱.

english_verse: Your love for me is so great that you protected me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ omo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱ da kple ye̱ mino̱, ni odšie misusuma ke̱-dše̱ gbohĩĩadše šiši tō̃.

english_verse: Proud and violent enemies, who don't care about you, have ganged up to attack and kill me.
translation_verse: Nānyoṅmo̱, hewolo̱i ete ši ewomi, ni yiwalo̱i asafo mītao misusuma se̱gbe̱, ni ame̱ṅõõo ame̱too ame̱hĩe.

english_verse: But you, the Lord God, are kind and merciful. You don't easily get angry, and your love can always be trusted.
translation_verse: Ši bo, Nuṅtšo̱, Mawu mũsũṅtšõlo̱ ke̱ drolo̱ dšio, omli fũũ mrã ni omo̱bo̱nale̱ ke̱ ono̱kwale fá.

english_verse: Show that you approve of me! Then my hateful enemies will feel like fools, because you have helped and comforted me.
translation_verse: Tomi ekpakpa he okadi ko, koni mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ ana, ni ame̱hĩe agboi, ake̱ bo, Iehowa, oye obuami ni oše̱dše mimī.

english_verse: Zion was built by the Lord on the holy mountain,
translation_verse: Korabii le̱ alala ní ame̱la. Emaṅ ni eto le̱ ye̱ gõdši kroṅkroṅi le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: and he loves that city more than any other place in all of Israel.
translation_verse: Iehowa sumoo̱ Zion agbói le̱ fè Iakob šihĩle̱hei le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: Zion, you are the city of God, and wonderful things are told about you.
translation_verse: Agbaä ohe anumnyam sãdši, bo, Nānyoṅmo̱ maṅ le̱!

english_verse: Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia, Phoenicia, and Ethiopia are some of those nations that know you, and their people all say, “I was born in Zion.”
translation_verse: Matšĩ *Rahab ke̱ Babel tã mafutu mei ní lemi le̱; na, Filistea ke̱ Tiro ke̱ †Kuš fẽ le̱, aakē̱ ye̱ ame̱he ake̱; Afo̱ mone̱ ye̱ dše̱i. *Ies.

english_verse: God Most High will strengthen the city of Zion. Then everyone will say, “We were born here too.”
translation_verse: Ši Zion le̱, aakē̱ ye̱ ehe ake̱: Afo̱ mei le̱ fẽ ekomekome ye̱ dše̱i, ni Ṅweinyo le̱ dientše̱ aahã emã ši.

english_verse: The Lord will make a list of his people, and all who were born here will be included.
translation_verse: Beni Iehowa ṅmãa mãdši le̱ agbe̱i le̱, eekane ni eekē̱ ake̱: Afo̱ mone̱ ye̱ dše̱i.

english_verse: All who sing or dance will say, “I too am from Zion.”
translation_verse: Lalatšemei ke̱ dsõ̀bilo̱i fẽ aake: Minubui le̱ fia-kwa ye̱ omli!

english_verse: You keep me safe, Lord God. So when I pray at night,
translation_verse: Korabii le̱ alala ní ame̱la ní ame̱ke̱-hã lalatše̱ nukpa le̱, ni ake̱ “ṅko̱mo̱yeli” gbē ala. Heman Esrahinyo le̱ se̱yōmo̱ lala.

english_verse: please listen carefully to each of my concerns.
translation_verse: Iehowa, miyiwalaheremo̱ Nyoṅmo̱, miblo̱ö̱ nyōṅ ke̱ ſane ye̱ ohĩe.

english_verse: I am deeply troubled and close to death;
translation_verse: Hã miso̱lemo̱ le̱ aše̱ ohĩe, gbo otoi ši ohã miblo̱mo̱ le̱!

english_verse: I am as good as dead and completely helpless.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ haomo̱i eyi misusuma obõ, ni miwala mībe̱ṅke̱ gbohĩĩadše.

english_verse: I am no better off than those in the grave, those you have forgotten and no longer help.
translation_verse: Abuo̱mi ašio̱ mei ní yaä bu mli le̱ ano̱; mitamo̱ moko ní be̱ hewale̱ doṅṅ.

english_verse: your anger rolls over me like ocean waves.
translation_verse: Oṅōmi ofõ bu kwo̱ṅkwo̱ṅ le̱ mli, ye̱ hei ní ewo duṅ le̱, ye̱ ṅšo̱ šiši tō̃.

english_verse: Do you work miracles for the dead? Do they stand up and praise you?
translation_verse: Amanehũlũ ehã mihĩṅme̱i ešiu; Iehowa, miblo̱ö̱ mítše̱o̱o dā dšenamo̱, mikpaa minidši amli mihãao.

english_verse: Are your love and loyalty announced in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Ani oofe nākpe̱nii otšõ gbohĩĩ? alo sisai aate ši adšie oyi? Lal

english_verse: Do they know of your miracles or your saving power in the dark world below where all is forgotten?
translation_verse: Ani aagba omlihĩle̱ le̱ he sane ye̱ gbonyobu mli? alo ono̱kwayeli le̱ hũ ye̱ lādšemo̱bu le̱ mli?

english_verse: Why do you reject me? Why do you turn from me?
translation_verse: Ši bo, Iehowa, mīblo̱ö̱ mītšé̱o̱, ni miso̱lemo̱ aaše̱ ohĩe lebi mā̃ṅkpa.

english_verse: Your anger is like a flood! And I am shattered by your furious attacks
translation_verse: Ke̱-dše̱ migbekẽbiiaši bēbe le̱ minii ye̱ mo̱bo̱ ni mīhe magbo; ohe ṅmiṅmi emõmi, ni midšidšā.

english_verse: that strike each day and from every side.
translation_verse: Omlifũ ní nā wa esumi, ohe ṅmiṅmi le̱ ekpãtã mihĩe.

english_verse: My friends and neighbors have turned against me because of you, and now darkness is my only companion.
translation_verse: Ame̱bo̱leo̱mi ke̱-kpeo̱ tamo̱ nu dā dšenamo̱, ame̱fo sá ame̱wo mihe ke̱-kpe.

english_verse: You said, “David, my servant, is my chosen one, and this is the agreement I made with him:
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mikē̱ ake̱: Aatſa mo̱bo̱nale̱ amã ši ke̱-ya nāno̱; oke̱ ono̱kwayeli le̱ aamã ší ye̱ ṅwei tõ.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth belong to you. And so does the world with all its people because you created them
translation_verse: Bo okũmo̱ *Rahab dukuduku tamo̱ moko ní enyõ; oke̱ ninešĩwale̱ le̱ egbe̱ ohenye̱lo̱i le̱ eſã. *Lal.

english_verse: and everything else. Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon gladly praise you.
translation_verse: Ṅwei le̱ onõ ni, šikpoṅ le̱ hũ onõ ni; dšeṅ ke̱ emlinii le̱, bo noṅṅ oto šiši. Lal.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who join in the festival and walk in the brightness of your presence.
translation_verse: Dšale̱ ke̱ kodšomo̱ dši omaṅtše̱sẽi le̱ šišitōnii, mo̱bo̱nale̱ ke̱ ano̱kwale nyieo̱ ohĩe. Lal.

english_verse: In a vision, you once said to your faithful followers: “I have helped a mighty hero. I chose him from my people and made him famous.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *wo̱tše̱ṅ le̱, Iehowa nõ ni, ni wo̱maṅtše̱ le̱, Israel Mokroṅkroṅ le̱ nõ ni. *Lal.

english_verse: and I will always be there to help and strengthen him.
translation_verse: mina mitšũlo̱ David, mike̱ mimũ kroṅkroṅ le̱ efo̱le̱.

english_verse: “No enemy will outsmart David, and he won't be defeated by any hateful people.
translation_verse: Minine aahã efī ši, mikõṅ hũ aawo-le̱ hewale̱.

english_verse: I will strike down and crush his troublesome enemies.
translation_verse: Henye̱lo̱ ko yeṅle̱ amim, ni musubi ko hũ waṅle̱ yi.

english_verse: He will always be able to depend on my love, and I will make him strong with my own power.
translation_verse: Ni mabutu mei ní he tšẽo̱le̱ le̱ ye̱ ehĩe, ni mei ní nye̱o̱le̱ le̱, matſiaame̱ nii.

english_verse: I will let him rule the lands across the rivers and seas.
translation_verse: Ni mino̱kwayeli ke̱ mimo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱ ke̱le̱ aahĩ ši, ni migbe̱i le̱ṅ aawó *eklonto le̱ no̱ ye̱. *

english_verse: “I have chosen David as my first-born son, and he will be the ruler of all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Eeho etšé̱mi ake̱: Bo dši mitše̱, mi-Mawu ke̱ miyiwalaheremo̱ te̱sā!

english_verse: My love for him will last, and my agreement with him will never be broken.
translation_verse: Mi hũ mike̱le̱ aafe mikromo̱bi, ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ maṅtše̱mei le̱ ateṅ agbo.

english_verse: “One of David's descendants will always be king, and his family will rule until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: Mahã mimo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱ ahĩ ši ahãle̱ ke̱-ya nāno̱, ni mikpãṅmo̱ ní mike̱le̱ ekpãṅ le̱ aamã ši šiṅṅ. Ies

english_verse: Suppose some of his children should reject my Law and refuse my instructions.
translation_verse: Mahã eseši ahĩ ši dā, ni emaṅtše̱sẽi le̱ aatše̱ tamo̱ ṅwei gbĩĩ.

english_verse: Or suppose they should disobey all of my teachings.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši ebii le̱ kwa mimla le̱ ni ame̱nyiee mikodšomoi le̱ amli le̱,

english_verse: Then I will correct and punish them because of their sins.
translation_verse: ke̱dši ame̱bule mikpoi le̱ hũ, ni ame̱yee mikitãi le̱ ano̱ le̱:

english_verse: But I will always love David and faithfully keep all of my promises to him.
translation_verse: no le̱ mike̱ tšo aabasra ame̱notõmo le̱, ni mayiame̱ ke̱ kpãi ye̱ ame̱nõša le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: “I won't break my agreement or go back on my word.
translation_verse: Ši kẽle̱ midšìeṅ mimo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱ ke̱-dše̱ṅ ehe kwrakwra, ni mihãṅ mino̱kwayeli le̱ se̱ afo.

english_verse: I have sworn once and for all by my own holy name, and I won't lie to David.
translation_verse: Mibuleṅ mikpãṅmo̱ le̱, ni mitšakeṅ noni edše minā le̱.

english_verse: His family will always rule. I will let his kingdom last as long as the sun
translation_verse: Mike̱ mikroṅkroṅfemo̱ le̱ ekã nõ kome he kĩtã; mitšakeṅ milile̱i mihãṅ David:

english_verse: You are now angry, Lord, and you have turned your back on your chosen king.
translation_verse: eemã ši dā tamo̱ nyoṅtšĕre, ni eye ano̱kwa tamo̱ odasefonyo ni *yo̱ atatuiaṅ le̱!” *

english_verse: You broke off your agreement with your servant, the king, and you completely destroyed his kingdom.
translation_verse: Ni bo le̱ oše̱ moni ofo̱le̱ mũ le̱ ofõ ni onyãṅele̱, ní omli efũle̱. La.

english_verse: The walls of his city have been broken through, and every fortress now lies in ruins.
translation_verse: Onyãṅe otšũlo̱ le̱ kpãṅmo̱ le̱, obule ekekre le̱ ni oše̱ ofõ šikpoṅ.

english_verse: You made his enemies powerful and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Mei fẽ ní hoo̱ ye̱ gbe̱ le̱ no̱ le̱ *haäle̱; etšṍ ahorabō̱ ehã ehegbomei le̱. *Lal.

english_verse: But you forced him to retreat because you did not fight on his side.
translation_verse: Owó ehetšẽlo̱i le̱ aninedšũrõ no̱, ohã ehenye̱lo̱i le̱ fẽ enyã́.

english_verse: You took his crown and threw his throne in the dirt.
translation_verse: Osā otšṍ eklante le̱ nā, ni ohãã enyẽ ši edamo̱ ye̱ ta nā.

english_verse: You made an old man of him and put him to shame.
translation_verse: Ohã ekpe̱mo̱ le̱ se̱ efo, ni oṅõ emaṅtše̱sẽi le̱ otſa šikpoṅ.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord? Will you hide forever? How long will your anger keep burning like fire?
translation_verse: Ofo eblahīaṅ gbĩĩ le̱ ano̱ kuku, ohã hĩegbẽle elõle̱.

english_verse: Remember, life is short! Why did you empty our lives of all meaning?
translation_verse: Iehowa, mẽ beyino̱ ooṅõ ohe otē kwrā, ni omlifũ le̱ aatšo tamo̱ la ke̱-yaši? Lal.

english_verse: No one can escape the power of death and the grave.
translation_verse: Kaimo̱ ake̱ miwalabe le̱ *še̱e̱ noko; mẽba obo gbomei abii fẽ yakatſā ne̱? *Lal.

english_verse: Our Lord, where is the love you have always shown and that you promised so faithfully to David?
translation_verse: Nẽ gbomo yo̱ dšeṅ, ni le̱ le̱ enaṅ gbēle, ni eenyẽ esusuma edšie ke̱-dše̱ gbohĩĩadše deṅ?

english_verse: Remember your servant, Lord! People make jokes about me, and I suffer many insults.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱, nẽgbe̱ *osá mo̱bo̱nale̱i le̱ yo̱, nii ní okāmo̱ he kitãi otšõ David ye̱ ono̱kwayeli le̱ṅ le̱? *Lal.

english_verse: I am your chosen one, but your enemies chase and make fun of me.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱, kaimo̱ ahora ní abo̱ö̱ otšũdši le̱, bo̱ni mãdši pī ahorabō̱ dſere mimīnā,

english_verse: Our Lord, we praise you forever. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: ahora ni ohenye̱lo̱i le̱ bo̱ö̱ le̱, Iehowa, ahora ni ame̱bo̱ö̱ moni ofo̱le̱ mũ le̱ nãdšifā-mo̱i le̱!

english_verse: but a thousand years mean nothing to you! They are merely a day gone by or a few hours in the night.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ohĩe le̱, afii akpe tamo̱ nyè, kpakpa nyè, ke̱ nyõṅ būbe pe̱.

english_verse: You bring our lives to an end just like a dream. We are merely tender grass
translation_verse: Olōo̱ame̱ ke̱-yaä tamo̱ fā lōo̱ nii, ame̱tamo̱ wo̱ ni awo̱ö̱; lebi le̱ ame̱feo̱ frõfrõ tamo *dſei. *Lal.

english_verse: Your furious anger frightens and destroys us,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ wo̱mītā ye̱ omlifũ le̱ nā, ni omlila le̱ nā le̱ āhūwo̱ ke̱-mīya.

english_verse: Your anger is a burden each day we live, then life ends like a sigh.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ wo̱gbĩĩ le̱ fẽ hoo̱ ye̱ omlifũ le̱ nā, wo̱yeo̱ wo̱fli le̱ tãa tamoo̱ adesã́ ní atãa.

english_verse: We can expect seventy years, or maybe eighty, if we are healthy, but even our best years bring trouble and sorrow. Suddenly our time is up, and we disappear.
translation_verse: Wo̱fli amli gbĩĩ le̱, afii nyoṅmai-kpawo ni, ni ké̱ efá āhũ le̱, afii nyoṅmai-kpānyo̱, ni ame̱mli ſā̃nii le̱, *to̱le̱ ke̱ yakanii ni; edšake̱ ehoo̱ oyá, ni wo̱flikio̱ ke̱-yaä. *Dšadš.

english_verse: No one knows the full power of your furious anger, but it is as great as the fear that we owe to you.
translation_verse: Namo le omlifũ le̱ mliwale̱ ke̱ gbeyei ni sa ake̱ ašeo ye̱ omlila le̱ nā?

english_verse: Teach us to use wisely all the time we have.
translation_verse: Tšõmo̱wo̱ wo̱gbĩĩ le̱ kanemo̱, beni afe ní wo̱ná nilē tšui! Lal.

english_verse: Help us, Lord! Don't wait! Pity your servants.
translation_verse: Kũ ose̱, Iehowa! mẽ beyino̱ noṅṅ ni? ni ohã otšũdši le̱ anii afeo mo̱bo̱!

english_verse: When morning comes, let your love satisfy all our needs. Then we can celebrate and be glad for what time we have left.
translation_verse: Hã wo̱tō̱ro̱ lebi ke̱ omo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱, koni wo̱nyã́ ni wo̱mĩ aše̱ wo̱he ye̱ wo̱-gbĩĩ le̱ fẽ mli!

english_verse: Make us happy for as long as you caused us trouble and sorrow.
translation_verse: Hã wo̱mĩ aše̱ wo̱he tamo̱ gbĩĩ abo̱ ni ohaowo̱ ye̱ mli, ke̱ afii abo̱ ni wo̱na nōfõṅ le̱!

english_verse: Do wonderful things for us, your servants, and show your mighty power to our children.
translation_verse: Hã otšũdši le̱ ana onitšumo̱i le̱, ni ame̱bii hũ ana onumnyam le̱!

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, treat us with kindness and let all go well for us. Please let all go well!
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, mlihĩle̱ le̱ ahĩ wo̱no̱, ni wo̱nidši ana nitšumo̱ le̱ hã aſere ahãwo̱; ni wo̱nidši anā nitšumo̱ le̱ hã aſere!

english_verse: Live under the protection of God Most High and stay in the shadow of God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Moni hīo̱ Ṅweinyo le̱ tēmo̱he le̱, eehĩ Ofe le̱ hō̃ṅ le̱ šiši.

english_verse: Then you will say to the Lord, “You are my fortress, my place of safety; you are my God, and I trust you.”
translation_verse: Makē̱ Iehowa ake̱: Mibobāhe ke̱ mimō̃ dšio, mi-Nyoṅmo̱ hũ ni mihĩe kã eno̱! Lal.

english_verse: The Lord will keep you safe from secret traps and deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ le̱ ebadšie̱o ke̱-dše̱ *loflõdũlo̱ tšõne mli, ke̱ gbĕle-hela ní nā wa le̱ mli. *Lal.

english_verse: You won't need to worry about dangers at night or arrows during the day.
translation_verse: Ošeṅ nyōṅ ṅmiṅmi gbeyei, lo gãimlibi ni flikio̱ ſane le̱,

english_verse: You will not be harmed, though thousands fall all around you.
translation_verse: Ké̱ mei akpe nyõ ye̱ omase̱i, ni mei akpei-nyoṅma hũ nyõ ye̱ oninedšũrõ no̱ po, bo le̱, ebe̱ṅke̱ṅo.

english_verse: And with your own eyes you will see the punishment of the wicked.
translation_verse: Ohĩṅme̱ii ke̱ke̱ oke̱-akwe̱, ni oona meifõdši anyõmo̱wo. Lal.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is your fortress. Run to him for safety,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo, Iehowa, dši mibobāhe! Oṅõ Ṅweinyo le̱ ofe ošihĩle̱he.

english_verse: God will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ eewo ebo̱foi le̱ akpo̱ ye̱ ohewo̱, ní ame̱bā oyi ye̱ ogbè̱i fẽ no̱; Mat.

english_verse: They will carry you in their arms, and you won't hurt your feet on the stones.
translation_verse: ame̱ahĩeo ye̱ ame̱dẽ, koni okaṅò onane oši te̱ ko.

english_verse: You will overpower the strongest lions and the most deadly snakes.
translation_verse: Onyie dšata ke̱ šikpã po no̱, oonānā dšatabi ke̱ dšeṅ no̱ ye̱ onãdšiaši. Luk

english_verse: The Lord says, “If you love me and truly know who I am, I will rescue you and keep you safe.
translation_verse: “Edšake̱ ēsumo̱mi, hewo̱ le̱ madšie-le̱, mawo eno̱ godšō, edšake̱ ele migbe̱i le̱.

english_verse: When you are in trouble, call out to me. I will answer and be there to protect and honor you.
translation_verse: Eetšé̱mi, ni maherele̱ no̱; mike̱le̱ aahĩ ši ye̱ haomo̱ mli: madšiele̱ ni mawo ehĩe nyam.

english_verse: You will live a long life and see my saving power.”
translation_verse: Mahã eto̱ ke̱ wala se̱tše̱le̱, ni mahã ena miyiwalaheremo̱ le̱!”

english_verse: for an ignorant fool to know or understand.
translation_verse: Iehowa, kwe̱ bo̱ni onitšumo̱i le̱ dăra hã! Ni odſẽṅmo̱i le̱ amli kwō̱lo̱ naakpa. Lal.

english_verse: Though the wicked sprout and spread like grass, they will be pulled up by their roots.
translation_verse: Nū kolo ko lee ene̱, ni kwašia hũ enaa ene̱ šiši.

english_verse: My eyes have seen, and my ears have heard the doom and destruction of my evil enemies.
translation_verse: Ši owó mikóṅ le̱ no̱ tamo̱ wuokòṅ, *afo̱se mũ ṅmōṅ tō̃ aſie mino̱. *Lal.

english_verse: Good people will prosper like palm trees, and they will grow strong like the cedars of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Ni mihĩṅme̱i ena noni mitaoo̱ ye̱ mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ ahe le̱, mitoii enu noni mitaoo̱ ye̱ efõṅfelo̱i ní te ši womi le̱ ahe le. Lal.

english_verse: They will take root in your house, Lord God, and they will do well.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱ le̱ aafro̱ke tamo̱ tẽṅ; eeda tamo̱ Lebanon tšenedru. Lal.

english_verse: They will be like trees that stay healthy and fruitful, even when they are old.
translation_verse: Mei ni ate̱oame̱ ye̱ Iehowa we le̱, ameafro̱ke ye̱ wo-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ kpoi le ano̱. Lal.

english_verse: And they will say about you, “The Lord always does right! God is our mighty rock.”
translation_verse: Ame̱akã he *ame̱wo yibii ye̱ gbo̱le̱ mli tete, ame̱mli aahĩ nu ni ame̱ahĩ frõfrõ, *Lal.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you are eternal.
translation_verse: Omaṅtše̱sẽi le̱ mã ši šiṅṅ ke̱-dše̱ tetēte; bo oyo̱ ke̱-dše̱ nāno̱ bēbe.

english_verse: The ocean is roaring, Lord! The sea is pounding hard.
translation_verse: Iehowa, fāi le̱ ewó ame̱he no̱, fāi le̱ ewó ame̱gbē no̱; fāi le̱ ewó ame̱hũmo̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Its mighty waves are majestic, but you are even more majestic, and you rule over all.
translation_verse: Iehowa ni yo̱ ṅwei le̱ dše agbo fè nui babaō le̱ agbē ke̱ ṅšo̱kei agboi le̱.

english_verse: Your decisions are firm, and your temple will always be beautiful and holy.
translation_verse: *Odasei le̱ ano̱kwa so̱ṅṅ ni; kroṅkroṅfemo sa owe le̱, Iehowa, ke̱-yaši nāno̱. *Lal.

english_verse: They murder widows, foreigners, and orphans.
translation_verse: Ame̱gbeo̱ yō okũlafo ke̱ gbo̱, ni ame̱yeo̱ awusãĩ hũ awui,

english_verse: God gave us ears and eyes! Can't he hear and see?
translation_verse: Moni te̱o toi le̱, aso enuṅ nii? lo moni šō hĩṅme̱i le̱, aso enaṅ nii?

english_verse: God instructs the nations and gives knowledge to us all. Won't he also correct us?
translation_verse: Moni gblaä dšeṅmãdši atoi ní etsõo̱ gbomei anilē le̱, aso ekãṅ mo hĩe?

english_verse: The Lord knows how useless our plans really are.
translation_verse: Iehowa le gbomei adſẽṅme̱i ake̱ kō̱yo ke̱ke̱ ni.

english_verse: You give them rest from their troubles, until a pit can be dug for the wicked.
translation_verse: beni afe ni ohã ehe adšo̱le̱ ye̱ fĩmo̱ gbĩĩ amli, ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni aatša bu ahã mofõṅ le̱! Lal.

english_verse: You won't turn your back on your chosen nation.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa še̱ṅ emaṅ le̱ efõṅ, ni ekwaṅ egbe̱fãṅnõ le̱.

english_verse: Justice and fairness will go hand in hand, and all who do right will follow along.
translation_verse: Ši kodšomo̱ aakũ ese̱ ke̱-ba dšale̱ ṅō, ni mei ní dša ye̱ ame̱tšuiaṅ le̱ fẽ aanyie se̱.

english_verse: Who will stand up for me against those cruel people?
translation_verse: Namo aate ši awo efõṅfelo̱i ahãmi? Namo aadamo̱ ši ašĩ mei ni tšuo̱ nišaianii le̱ ahãmi?

english_verse: When I felt my feet slipping, you came with your love and kept me steady.
translation_verse: Ké̱ mikē̱: Minane mīšãne! le̱, Iehowa, omo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱ hĩe mimli.

english_verse: And when I was burdened with worries, you comforted me and made me feel secure.
translation_verse: Ké̱ ṅko̱mo̱yeli fá babaō ye̱ mimli le̱, omīše̱dšemo̱i le̱ hãa misusuma mī še̱o̱ ehe.

english_verse: But you are opposed to dishonest lawmakers
translation_verse: Ani efõṅfemo̱-sẽi le̱ ní tšṍo̱ mla no̱ eyeo̱ sane fõṅ le̱ ke̱o aabo̱ nanyo?

english_verse: who gang up to murder innocent victims.
translation_verse: Ame̱bo̱ō̱ dšalo̱ susuma he gwa, ni ame̱buo̱ lá ní eye bem le̱ fo̱.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my fortress, that mighty rock where I am safe.
translation_verse: Ši Iehowa dši mimō̃, ni mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ dši mibobā te̱sā.

english_verse: You will pay back my enemies, and you will wipe them out for the evil they did.
translation_verse: Ni eehã ame̱dientše̱ ame̱nišaianii le̱ ababua ameyiteṅ, ni eeflo̱ame̱ eſie ye̱ ame̱nifõdšĩanii le̱ amli; Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, aaflo̱ame̱ aſie.

english_verse: Sing joyful songs to the Lord! Praise the mighty rock where we are safe.
translation_verse: Nyebaã ni we̱laä wo̱hãa Iehowa, nyehãa wo̱bo̱a oše wo̱hãa wo̱yiwalaheremo̱ te̱sā le̱!

english_verse: Bow down and worship the Lord our Creator!
translation_verse: Nyebaã, ní wo̱bumo̱a ši ni wo̱dšáa-le̱, ni wo̱kũlaä ši ye̱ Iehowa wo̱felo̱ le̱ hĩe!

english_verse: Don't be stubborn and rebel as your ancestors did at Meribah and Massah out in the desert.
translation_verse: Nyekawadšea nyetšui, tamo̱ bo̱ni afe ye̱ Meriba le̱, ke̱ bo̱ni afe ye̱ Masa gbĩ le̱ no̱ ye̱ ṅã le̱ no̱ le̱,

english_verse: For forty years they tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: beni nyetše̱mei le̱ tšṍ mĩnā, ame̱kami ame̱kwe̱, tše̱ ame̱na minĩtšumo le.

english_verse: Then God got tired of them and said, “You never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.”
translation_verse: Afii nyoṅmai-edſe̱ so̱ṅṅ ne̱ke̱ yino̱bii ne̱ asane dše mitšine, ní mikē̱: Maṅ ko ni tšui dũo̱ gbe̱ ne̱, ni ame̱sumo̱o̱ ake̱ ame̱le migbè̱i le̱;

english_verse: In his anger, God told them, “You people will never enter my place of rest.”
translation_verse: nohewo le̱ mikã kitã ye̱ mimlifũ le̱ṅ ake̱: Ké̱ ame̱bote mihedšō̱mo̱ le̱ṅ fī̃!

english_verse: sing and praise his name. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Nyelaä nyehãa Iehowa, nyedšiea egbe̱i le̱ yi! Nyegbaä eyiwalaheremo̱ le̱ he sane gbĩ-fẽ-gbĩ!

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Nyedšadšea enumnyam le̱ nyetšõa ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ, ke̱ enākpe̱nii le̱ ye̱ mãdši fẽ ateṅ!

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa da ni esa yidšiemo̱ babaō; ehe ye̱ gbeyei fè nyoṅmo̱i le̱ fiā.

english_verse: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mãdši le̱ fẽ anyoṅmo̱i le̱ yakayakawo̱dši ni, ši Iehowa le̱, le̱ efe ṅwei.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: Wō ke̱ agbodšē ye̱ ehĩe, hewale̱ ke̱ hefe̱o ye̱ ehekroṅkroṅ le.

english_verse: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple.
translation_verse: Nyeke̱ anumnyam ní sa Iehowa gbe̱i le̱ ahãale̱; *nyehĩea nikēnii ke̱-baä ekpoi le̱ ano̱! *Lal.

english_verse: Announce to the nations, “The Lord is King! The world stands firm, never to be shaken, and he will judge its people with fairness.”
translation_verse: Nyekē̱a ye̱ dšeṅmãdšiaṅ le̱ ateṅ ake̱; Iehowa mīye maṅtše̱! Nohewo̱ le̱ dše le̱ mã ši šiṅṅ ni ehosoṅ. Eebu mãdši atẽṅ ye̱ dšale̱ nā. Lal.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures
translation_verse: Ṅwei anyá, ni šikpoṅ le̱ mli aflile̱; ṅšo̱ ahū̃ ke̱ emlinii le̱ fẽ. Lal.

english_verse: and the fields to rejoice with all their crops. Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs
translation_verse: Ṅã abo̱ oše ke̱ nofẽno ní yo̱ no̱, ni kōṅ tšei fẽ ala ke̱ mīše̱

english_verse: to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth with fairness and truth.
translation_verse: ye̱ Iehowa hĩe; edšake̱ eba, edšake̱ ēba ebakodšo šikpoṅ le̱. Eekodšo dše le̱ ye̱ dšale̱ nā, ke̱ mãdši le̱ hũ ye̱ eno̱kwayeli le̱ nā. Bo̱f.

english_verse: Those who brag about the useless idols they worship are terribly ashamed, and all the false gods bow down to the Lord.
translation_verse: Amãgãdšálo̱i le̱ fẽ hĩe aagboi, mei hũ ní ſãa fõo̱ yakayakawo̱dši ano̱. *Nye nyoṅmo̱i fẽ-tſẽm, nyedšáale̱! *Heb.

english_verse: When the people of Zion and of the towns of Judah hear that God brings justice, they will celebrate.
translation_verse: Zion nu ni emī še̱ ehe, ni Iuda biyei le̱ amli fliame̱ ye̱ bo, Iehowa, okodšomo̱i le̱ ahewo̱. Fil.

english_verse: The Lord rules the whole earth, and he is more glorious than all the false gods.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo, Iehowa, dši moni kwo̱ fè fẽ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ fẽ no̱, awó ono̱ godšō ke̱-teke nyoṅmo̱i le̱ fẽ. Lal

english_verse: Love the Lord and hate evil! God protects his loyal people and rescues them from violence.
translation_verse: Nye mei ni nyesumoo̱ Iehowa le̱, *nyenye̱a efõṅ! Ebaa emei kroṅkroṅi le̱ asusumai ayi; edšieo̱ame̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ meifõdsi adeṅ. *Amos

english_verse: If you obey and do right, a light will show you the way and fill you with happiness.
translation_verse: La bate ši ahã dšalo̱ kẽ, ke̱ mīše̱ hũ hã mei ní dša ye̱ ame̱tšuiaṅ le̱. Lal.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people! So celebrate and praise the only God.
translation_verse: Nye dšalo̱i, nyenyã́a ye̱ Iehowa mli, ni nyedšiea egbe̱i kroṅkroṅ le̱ yi!

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! He has worked miracles, and with his own powerful arm, he has won the victory.
translation_verse: Lala. Nyelaä *lala hē nyehãa Iehowa; edšake̱ efe nākpe̱nii. Eninedsũrõ ke̱ enine kroṅkroṅ le̱ eye kũnim ehãle̱. *Lal.

english_verse: The Lord has shown the nations that he has the power to save and to bring justice.
translation_verse: Iehowa ehã ale eyiwalaheremo̱ le̱; edšie edšale̱ le̱ kpo ſaṅṅ ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ahĩe.

english_verse: God has been faithful in his love for Israel, and his saving power is seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ekai emo̱bo̱nale̱ ke̱ eno̱kwayeli le̱ ehã Israel we le̱; šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbēhei le̱ fẽ ena wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ yiwalaheremo̱ le̱. Ies

english_verse: Make music for him on harps. Play beautiful melodies!
translation_verse: Nyeke̱ saṅkũ alaä yidšiemo̱ lalai nyehãa Iehowa, ke̱ saṅkũ ke̱ lala gbē fẽ;

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and horns and celebrate with joyful songs for our Lord and King!
translation_verse: nyeke̱ te̱tre̱mantre̱i ke̱ kōfẽṅ gbē abo̱a oše ye̱ *maṅtše̱ Iehowa hĩe! *

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures, and the earth to shout with all its people.
translation_verse: Ṅšo̱ áhū ke̱ emlinii le̱, dše le̱ ke̱ mei ní hĩo̱ mli le̱! Lal.

english_verse: Order the rivers to clap their hands, and all the hills to sing together.
translation_verse: Fāi le̱ atſatſā ame̱dẽ, gõdši le̱ blublu anyã́

english_verse: Let them worship the Lord! He is coming to judge everyone on the earth, and he will be honest and fair.
translation_verse: ye̱ Iehowa hĩe; edšake̱ ēba ebakodšo šikpoṅ le̱. Eekodšo dše le̱ ye̱ dšale̱ nā ke̱ mãdši le̱ bo̱ni dša pe̱pē̱pe̱.

english_verse: You are praised in Zion, and you control all nations.
translation_verse: Iehowa da ye̱ Zion, ni awó eno̱ ke̱-teke mãdši le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: Only you are God! And your power alone, so great and fearsome, is worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Ame̱adšie ogbe̱i kpeteṅkple ni he ye̱ gbeyei le̱ yi: kroṅkroṅ dšile̱!

english_verse: You are our mighty King, a lover of fairness, who sees that justice is done everywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Maṅtše̱ ní sumoo̱ dšale̱ saneyeli le̱, bo ohã ehewale̱ le̱ mā ši šiṅṅ ye̱ kodšomo̱ mli; bo *okodšoo̱ ni oyeo̱ dšale̱ sane ye̱ Iakob mli. *Ies.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, we praise you and kneel down to worship you, the God of holiness!
translation_verse: Nyekafoa Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ni nyebumo̱a ši ye̱ enaneši māṅō le̱ he: kroṅkroṅ dšile̱!

english_verse: Moses and Aaron were two of your priests. Samuel was also one of those who prayed in your name, and you, our Lord, answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Mose ke̱ Aaron ye̱ eso̱foi le̱ ateṅ, ni Samuel hũ ye̱ mei ní tšé̱o̱ egbe̱i le̱ no̱ le̱ ateṅ; ame̱tšé̱ Iehowa ni ehere-ame̱ no̱. Ier.

english_verse: You spoke to them from a thick cloud, and they obeyed your laws.
translation_verse: Eke̱ame̱ wie ye̱ atatu kutū le̱ mli; ame̱ye edasei le̱ ke̱ akpo̱ ní eṅõ-hãame̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you answered their prayers and forgave their sins, but when they did wrong, you punished them.
translation_verse: Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱, ho noṅṅ ohere-ame̱ no̱; odši Mawu ní ke̱ nõ faä ohãame̱, ke̱ ame̱nifemo̱nii le̱ ahe oweleto̱le̱ hũ.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God, and we worship you at your sacred mountain. Only you are God!
translation_verse: Nyekafoa Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ni nyedšáa ye̱ egoṅ kroṅkroṅ le̱ he; edšake̱ kroṅkroṅ dši Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱!

english_verse: Be joyful and sing as you come in to worship the Lord!
translation_verse: Nyesúmo̱a Iehowa ke̱ mīše̱, nyebaã ehĩe ke̱ nyámo̱ lala!

english_verse: You know the Lord is God! He created us, and we belong to him; we are his people, the sheep in his pasture.
translation_verse: Nyenáa nyelea ake̱ Iehowa le̱, le̱ dši Nyoṅmo̱! Le̱ efewo̱, ni le̱ enii dšiwo̱, emaṅ ke̱ elè̱he le̱ tōi dšiwo̱. Lal.

english_verse: Be thankful and praise the Lord as you enter his temple.
translation_verse: Nyebotea egbói le̱ amli ke̱ šidā, nyebaã ekpoi le̱ ano̱ ke̱ yidšiemo̱; nyedaãle̱ ši, nyedšiea egbe̱i le̱ yi!

english_verse: The Lord is good! His love and faithfulness will last forever.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa hĩ: emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä nāno̱, ni eno̱kwayeli le̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä yino̱i fẽ no̱. Lal.

english_verse: I will sing to you, Lord! I will celebrate your kindness and your justice.
translation_verse: David lala. Mala mo̱bo̱nale̱ ke̱ kodšomo̱ he lala; bo Iehowa noṅṅ oyi mala madšie.

english_verse: Please help me learn to do the right thing, and I will be honest and fair in my own kingdom.
translation_verse: Maba midšeṅ nilē mli ye̱ gbe̱ ni dša no̱; té be ní ooba miṅõṅ? Mike̱ tšui ni eye emū aanyie ye̱ miwe le̱.

english_verse: I refuse to be corrupt or to take part in anything crooked,
translation_verse: Mike̱ noko gbonyo ko etoṅ mihĩe; minye̱o̱ nifõdšianifemo, ekpeteṅ mihe. *Abe̱i

english_verse: and I won't be dishonest or deceitful.
translation_verse: Apasa tšui akagbalemi; nõfõṅ esaṅ mihĩe.

english_verse: Anyone who spreads gossip will be silenced; no one who is conceited will be my friend.
translation_verse: Moni nyieo̱ enanyo šiši ye̱ tẽmo̱ṅ le̱, makpãtã ehĩe; moni yo̱ gẽgēgẽ ke̱ heno̱wómo̱ tšui le̱, mike̱le̱ yee.

english_verse: I will find trustworthy people to serve as my advisors; only an honest person will serve as an official.
translation_verse: Mihĩṅme̱ii aakã šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ano̱kwafoi le̱ ahe, koni ame̱ke̱mi ahĩ ši; moni nyieo̱ gbe̱ ní dša no̱ le̱, le̱ dši moni aasúmo̱mi. Abe̱i

english_verse: No one who cheats or lies will have a position in my royal court.
translation_verse: Moni tšuo̱ šíšiumo̱níí le̱, ehĩṅ miwe le̱; moni maleo̱ le̱, edamo̱ṅ ší ye̱ mihĩe.

english_verse: Each morning I will silence any lawbreakers I find in the countryside or in the city of the Lord.
translation_verse: Dā lebi makpãtã šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ meifõdši le̱ fẽ ahĩe, koni mabule mei ní tšuo̱ nišaianii le̱ fẽ aseši ye̱ Iehowa mã le̱ṅ. Abe̱i

english_verse: My days disappear like smoke, and my bones are burning as though in a furnace.
translation_verse: Kāṅõ ohĩe otēmi ye̱ mifĩmo̱ gbĩ le̱ no̱, ba otoi ši ohãmi; gbĩ no̱ ní mablo̱ matšé̱o le̱, heremo̱mi no̱ oyá!

english_verse: Instead of food, I have ashes to eat and tears to drink,
translation_verse: Mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ bo̱ö̱mi ahora dā dšenamo̱; mei ni eye se̱ke̱ ye̱ mino̱ le̱, ke̱mi lomoo̱.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations will honor you, and all kings on earth will praise your glory.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ otšũdši le̱ atšui kpe̱te̱ emli te̱i le̱ ahe, ni ame̱mũsũṅ tšõo̱ame̱ ye̱ emli sũ le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: You will rebuild the city of Zion. Your glory will be seen,
translation_verse: Ni dšeṅmãdši le̱ aaše Iehowa gbe̱i le̱ gbeyei, ni šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ maṅtše̱mei le̱ fẽ aaše onumnyam le̱;

english_verse: Future generations must also praise the Lord, so write this for them:
translation_verse: Egbo etoi ši ehã šitſialo̱ le̱ so̱lemo̱ le̱, ni egbee ame̱so̱lemo̱ le̱ he guo̱.

english_verse: “From his holy temple, the Lord looked down at the earth.
translation_verse: Aaṅmã ene̱ afõ ši ahã yino̱bii ní baä ye̱ se̱ le̱, ni maṅ ko ni ababo̱ le̱, aadšie Iehowa yi.

english_verse: He listened to the groans of prisoners, and he rescued everyone who was doomed to die.”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ edše̱ ehekroṅkroṅ ní kwo̱ le̱ emā ehĩe ši, Iehowa dše̱ ṅwei ekwe̱ šikpoṅ le̱,

english_verse: All Jerusalem should praise you, our Lord,
translation_verse: koni ebo gbokle̱fonyo ntšo̱idõmo̱ toi, ni efẽne *gbĕle bii le̱, *Lal.

english_verse: when people from every nation meet to worship you.
translation_verse: koni adšadše Iehowa gbe̱i le̱ ye̱ Zion ke̱ eyidšiemo̱ le̱ hũ ye̱ Ierusalem,

english_verse: I should still be strong, but you, Lord, have made an old person of me.
translation_verse: beni abuabuaä mãdšimãdši le̱ fẽ ke̱ maṅtše̱yelii le̱ anā, ní ame̱basúmo̱ Iehowa le̱. Lal.

english_verse: In the beginning, Lord, you laid the earth's foundation and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Mikē̱ ake̱: Mi-Mawu, kāṅõmi ke̱-mīya ye̱ *miwalabe le̱ teṅ! Bo le̱ ofii le̱ kã he ke̱ miya yino̱i fē no̱. Lal.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes. You change them, as you would a coat, but you last forever.
translation_verse: Blema bēbe oto šikpoṅ le̱ šiši, ni ṅwei le onidši anā nitšnmo ni. Heb.

english_verse: You are always the same. You are God for all time.
translation_verse: Ame̱ le̱ ame̱hĩe bakpãtã, ši bo le̱, oye̱ dā: ni ame̱fẽ-tſẽm ame̱basū tamo̱ atade; ootšakeame̱ tamo̱ mama, ni ame̱atšake.

english_verse: Every generation of those who serve you will live in your presence.
translation_verse: Šĩ bo le̱, oye̱ bo̱ni oyo̱ le̱ noṅṅ, ni ofii le̱ etãã gbĩkogbĩko. K.

english_verse: and protects us from death. His kindness and love are a crown on our heads.
translation_verse: le̱ ehereo̱ oyiwala ke̱-dše̱o̱ bu mli; le̱ eke̱ mlihĩle̱ ke̱ mũsũṅtsõle̱ *fĩo̱o akekre; *Lal.

english_verse: How great is God's love for all who worship him? Greater than the distance between heaven and earth!
translation_verse: Ši moṅ, boni ṅwei kwo̱ fè šikpoṅ le̱, nakai emo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱ fá ye̱ mei ni šeo̱le̱ le̱ ano̱. Lal.

english_verse: How far has the Lord taken our sins from us? Farther than the distance from east to west!
translation_verse: Bo̱ni bokã ke̱ anai teṅ dšeke̱ le̱, nakai ehãa wo̱ke̱ wo̱no̱tõmo̱i le̱ ateṅ dšeke̱o̱.

english_verse: Just as parents are kind to their children, the Lord is kind to all who worship him,
translation_verse: Bo̱ni tše̱ mũsũṅ tšõo̱le̱ ye̱ ebii ahe le̱, nakai Iehowa mũsũṅ tšõo̱-le̱ ye̱ mei ní šeo̱le̱ le̱ ahe.

english_verse: because he knows we are made of dust.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ele wo̱su ke̱ wo̱bãṅ, ekaio̱ *ake sũ ke̱ke dšiwo̱. *Hiob

english_verse: We humans are like grass or wild flowers that quickly bloom.
translation_verse: Adesã yo̱ ne̱, egbĩĩ tamo̱ dſe̱i; efeo̱ flòṅṅ tamo̱ dſe̱iaṅ fo̱fo̱i; Lal.

english_verse: But a scorching wind blows, and they quickly wither to be forever forgotten.
translation_verse: ké̱ kō̱yo̱ tšṍ no̱ ke̱-ho pe̱, ebe̱ ni beni emã le̱ leele̱ doṅṅ.

english_verse: The Lord is always kind to those who worship him, and he keeps his promises to their descendants
translation_verse: Ši Iehowa mo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱ ye̱ ke̱-dše̱ nāno̱ ke̱-mīya nāno̱ ye̱ mei ni šeo̱le̱ gbeyei le̱ ano̱, ni edsale̱ le̱ ye ha bii abii, Yāfó

english_verse: All of you mighty angels, who obey God's commands, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Nyedšiea Iehowa yi, nye ebo̱foi le̱, nye *hewalo̱i ekãlo̱i †ní yeo̱ ewiemo̱ no̱, ní nyeboo̱ ewiemo̱ le̱ gbē toi le̱! *Lal.

english_verse: All of you thousands who serve and obey God, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Nyedšiea Iehowa yi, nye etai le̱ fẽ, nye esúolo̱i ní feo̱ esuomo̱nānii le̱!

english_verse: All of God's creation and all that he rules, come and praise your Lord! With all my heart I praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Nyedšiea Iehowa yi, nye *enitšumo̱i fẽ ní ye̱ eno̱yelihei le̱ fẽ le̱! Dšiemo̱ Iehowa yi, misusuma! *Lal.

english_verse: and surrounded by light. You spread out the sky like a tent,
translation_verse: Oha la tamo̱ mama, ni olē̱ ṅwei mli tamo̱ muhō̱;

english_verse: The winds are your messengers, and flames of fire are your servants.
translation_verse: oṅõo̱ kō̱yo̱i ofeo̱ obo̱foi, oṅõo̱ la ni tšoo̱ plamplam ofeo̱ osúolo̱i; Heb.

english_verse: You covered the earth with the ocean that rose above the mountains.
translation_verse: Oke̱ nu eha he tamo̱ mama; nui le̱ damo gõdši le̱ ayiteaṅ.

english_verse: so that the donkeys and other wild animals can satisfy their thirst.
translation_verse: Ame̱hãa ṅãno̱ koloi fẽ nu ame̱nuo̱, ṅãṅ tedšii ke̱-gbeo̱ ame̱kũmai.

english_verse: Birds build their nests nearby and sing in the trees.
translation_verse: Ṅwei lofõdši hĩo̱ ame̱mase̱i, ame̱laä ye̱ tšeianidši le̱ ateṅ.

english_verse: You let the earth produce grass for cattle, plants for our food,
translation_verse: Ohãa dſe̱i kwẽo̱ hã šĩa koloi le̱, ke̱ ſie hũ ni gbomo ye̱ he nitšumo̱, ko-ni šikpoṅ le̱ aba niyenii, Lal

english_verse: Birds nest in those trees, and storks make their home in the fir trees.
translation_verse: heni lofõdši feo̱ ame̱tšũi ye̱; klitšo le̱, se̱se̱oi amli dši ewe.

english_verse: Wild goats find a home in the tall mountains, and small animals can hide between the rocks.
translation_verse: Gõdši somomõi le̱ ano̱ dši dùdši abobãhe, ni afutuo̱ko̱i anõ dši te̱sãi amli.

english_verse: and you made the darkness, so the animals in the forest could come out at night.
translation_verse: Ohãa duṅ woo̱, ni dše naä; no mli kōṅ lōi fẽ dšeo̱ kpo.

english_verse: Lions roar as they hunt for the food you provide.
translation_verse: Dšatabii hũo̱ ke̱-nyieo̱ mīle̱lo Se̱, ni ame̱taoo̱ ame̱niyenii ke̱-dše̱o̱ Mawu deṅ.

english_verse: But when morning comes, they return to their dens,
translation_verse: Ké̱ hũlũ te ši le̱, ame̱gblaä ame̱he ši ni ame̱yabumoo̱ ame̱wō̱he.

english_verse: then we go out to work until the end of day.
translation_verse: Gbomo dšeo̱ kpo yaä enitšumo̱ ni egboo̱ deṅme ke̱-yašio̱ gbe̱ke̱.

english_verse: Our Lord, by your wisdom you made so many things; the whole earth is covered with your living creatures.
translation_verse: Iehowa, kwe̱ bo̱ni onitšumo̱i le̱ fá hã! Nilē oke̱-fe fẽ; šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ eyi to̱ ke̱ onibō̱nii le̱!

english_verse: But what about the ocean so big and wide? It is alive with creatures, large and small.
translation_verse: Ṅšo̱ ne̱, eda ni elē̱ te̱trē̱, nibii ní anyẽẽ akane wamoo̱ ye̱ mli, lōi bibii ke̱ ewudši fẽ.

english_verse: And there are the ships, as well as Leviathan, the monster you created to splash in the sea.
translation_verse: Le̱dši le̱ nyieo̱ dse̱i ke̱ leviatan ní obo̱le̱, koni eſe̱ ye̱ mli le̱.

english_verse: All of these depend on you to provide them with food,
translation_verse: Ame̱fẽ le̱, bo gbe̱ ame̱kwe̱o̱, koni ohãame̱ ame̱niyenii ye̱ be ni sa mli. Lal

english_verse: and you feed each one with your own hand, until they are full.
translation_verse: Ohãa-ame̱, ni ame̱buabuaä nā; ogbleo̱ odē, ame̱tō̱ro̱ö̱ ke̱ nii kpakpai.

english_verse: But when you turn away, they are terrified; when you end their life, they die and rot.
translation_verse: Oke̱ ohĩe tēe̱, ní ame̱haoo̱; odšieo̱ ame̱mumo̱ le̱, ni ame̱plenēo̱, ni ame̱kũo̱ ame̱se̱ ke̱-yaä ame̱sũ le̱ṅ.

english_verse: You created all of them by your Spirit, and you give new life to the earth.
translation_verse: Otšũo̱ omumo̱ le̱ ke̱-baä, ni abo̱ö̱-ame̱, ni ohãa šikpoṅ le̱ hĩe tšṍo̱ ehē.

english_verse: Our Lord, we pray that your glory will last forever and that you will be pleased with what you have done.
translation_verse: Iehowa anumnyam le̱ aahĩ ši ke̱-ate nāno̱, Iehowa aanyã́ enitšumo̱i le̱ ahe.

english_verse: You look at the earth, and it trembles. You touch the mountains, and smoke goes up.
translation_verse: Ekwe̱o̱ šikpoṅ le̱, ni ehosoo̱; etraä gõdši le̱ ahe, ni ame̱dšeo̱ lasũ. Lal.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will sing and praise you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Gbĩĩabo̱ ní mihĩe kã ne̱ mala ma-hã Iehowa, gbĩĩabo̱ ní miyo̱ dšeṅ lolo ne̱ mala madšie mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ yi.

english_verse: I hope my thoughts will please you, because you are the one who makes me glad.
translation_verse: Hã miyiṅ susumo̱ aṅõ enā; manyã́ ye̱ Iehowa mli!

english_verse: Destroy all wicked sinners from the earth once and for all. With all my heart I praise you, Lord! I praise you!
translation_verse: Hã ešafelo̱i atã ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni meifõdši hũ akahĩ ši doṅṅ. Dšiemo̱ Iehowa yi, misusuma! Haleluya!

english_verse: Trust the Lord and his mighty power.
translation_verse: Nyedia Iehowa ke̱ ehewale̱ le̱ se̱, nyetaoa ehĩegbe̱ dā.

english_verse: Remember his miracles and all his wonders and his fair decisions.
translation_verse: Nyekaia enākpe̱ nitšumo̱i ní etšu le̱, enākpe̱nii ke̱ kòdšomo̱i ní dše̱ edāṅ le̱,

english_verse: He will never forget his agreement or his promises, not in thousands of years. *
translation_verse: Ekaio̱ ekpãṅmo̱ le̱ ke̱-yaä nāno̱, wiemo̱ ní eke̱-mã ši ehã yino̱i akpe le̱,

english_verse: when he said, “I'll give you the land of Canaan.”
translation_verse: ake̱: Bo maṅõ Kanaan šikpoṅ le̱ mahã ake̱ nyegbošinii agbe̱fãṅnõ! —

english_verse: God kept crops from growing until food was scarce everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Ni esā etšé̱ hõmo̱ ke̱-ba šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni ekũ abolo-tšo mū le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: Joseph remained a slave until his own words had come true, and the Lord had finished testing him.
translation_verse: ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní ewiemo̱ le̱ ba mli, Iehowa wiemo̱ le̱ tšũ ehe.

english_verse: Then the king of Egypt set Joseph free
translation_verse: Maṅtše̱ le̱ tšũ ayafẽnele̱, mãdši ano̱yelo̱ hã ayadšiele̱.

english_verse: Joseph was in command of the officials, and he taught the leaders how to use wisdom.
translation_verse: koni efĩmo̱ elumei le̱ bo̱ni esumoo̱, ni etšõ emaṅ onukpai le̱ anilē.

english_verse: Jacob and his family came and settled in Egypt as foreigners.
translation_verse: Ni Israel ba Mizraim, ni Iakob bato gbo̱ ye̱ Ham šikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: They were the Lord's people, so he let them grow stronger than their enemies.
translation_verse: Ni ehã emaṅ le̱ yi fá naakpa, ni ehã ame̱he wa fè ame̱haolo̱i le̱.

english_verse: They served the Lord, and he made the Egyptians plan hateful things against them.
translation_verse: Etšṍ ame̱tšui ni ame̱nye̱ emaṅ le̱, ni ame̱ke̱ etšũdsi le̱ ye ṅā mli.

english_verse: God sent his servant Moses. He also chose and sent Aaron
translation_verse: Etšũ etšũlo̱ Mose, ke̱ Aaron, moni ehala le̱.

english_verse: to his people in Egypt, and they worked miracles and wonders there.
translation_verse: Ame̱fe ekadii le̱ ye̱ ame̱teṅ, ke̱ enãkpe̱nii le̱ hũ ye̱ Ham šikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron obeyed God, and he sent darkness to cover Egypt.
translation_verse: Etšũ duṅ, ni ehã ebawo, ni ame̱tšee ewiemo̱i le̱ ahĩe atũa.

english_verse: God turned their rivers into streams of blood, and the fish all died.
translation_verse: Ehã ame̱nui le̱ tšṍmo̱ lá ní eṅõ-gbe ame̱lōi le̱.

translation_verse: Ame̱hĩ Iehowa hĩe dāne̱, ni *efo ame̱kaĩmo̱ se̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱; *Abe̱i

english_verse: He was so cruel to the poor, homeless, and discouraged that they died young.
translation_verse: edšake̱ ekaii mo̱bo̱nale̱, ši moṅ ewa nõnalo̱ ke̱ ohĩafo ke̱ moni tšui ekũmo̱ le̱ yi ni egbeame̱.
