english_verse: “He cursed others. Now place a curse on him! He never wished others well. Wish only trouble for him!
translation_verse: Ake̱-ni esumoo̱ lōmo̱ hewo̱ le̱, eeba eno̱; ake̱-ní enyã́ã́ dšō̱mo̱ he hewo̱ le̱, eke̱le̱ teṅ edšeke̱.

english_verse: He cursed others more often than he dressed himself. Let his curses strike him deep, just as water and olive oil soak through to our bones.
translation_verse: Ewo lōmo̱ tamo̱ atade, ni ebote emlĩniiaṅ tamo̱ *nu, ni ete ewui amli hũ tamo̱ mũ. *

english_verse: Let his curses surround him, just like the belt and clothes he wears each day.”
translation_verse: Hã etšṍ tamo̱ mama ní ebu, ke̱ he̱fīnõ ni eke̱-fĩ emli dā!

english_verse: Those are the cruel things my enemies wish for me. Let it all happen to them!
translation_verse: Mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ ke̱ mei ni wieo̱ misusuma he efõṅ le̱ anyõmo̱wo ní adše̱ Iehowa deṅ ne̱.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord God! Show your great kindness and rescue me.
translation_verse: Ši bo, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa, femo̱ ohãmi ye̱ ogbe̱i le̱ hewo̱; ake̱-ni omo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱ hĩ hewo̱ le̱, dšiemo̱mi.

english_verse: I am fading away like an evening shadow; I am tossed aside like a crawling insect.
translation_verse: Aṅõmi ke̱-te tamo̱ hō̃ṅ ni eho, alōmi ke̱-mīya tamo̱ bālabii.

english_verse: I have gone without eating, until my knees are weak, and my body is bony.
translation_verse: Ṅmā̃hĩle̱ so̱ṅṅ ehã minakutšei amli egbo̱dšo̱, ni mitã lō ni fo̱ be̱ mihe doṅṅ.

english_verse: When my enemies see me, they say cruel things and shake their heads.
translation_verse: Ni mitšṍ ahorabō̱nõ mihãame̱; ké̱ ame̱nami le̱, *ame̱hosoo̱ ame̱yitšei. *Lal.

english_verse: Let others know that you alone have saved me.
translation_verse: koni ame̱le ake̱ onine ne̱, ake̱ bo, Iehowa, ofe.

english_verse: I don't care if they curse me, as long as you bless me. You will make my enemies fail when they attack, and you will make me glad to be your servant.
translation_verse: Ame̱ le̱ ame̱lomoo̱, ši bo le̱ *odšō̱o̱; ame̱teo̱ ši, ši ame̱hĩe aagboi, ši otšũlo̱ le̱ nyã́ eenyã́. *Mat.

english_verse: You will cover them with shame, just as their bodies are covered with clothes.
translation_verse: Hã mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ awo heguo̱gbē, ni ame̱ha ame̱hīegbĕle le̱ tamo̱ mama. Lal.

english_verse: I will sing your praises and thank you, Lord, when your people meet.
translation_verse: Mike̱ minābu aada Iehowa ši babaō, ni madšie eyi ye̱ mei babaō ateṅ!

english_verse: You help everyone in need, and you save them from death.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ edamo̱ ohĩafo ninedšũrõ no̱, koni ehere eyiwala ke̱-dše̱ mei ni kodšoo̱ esusuma le̱ adeṅ.

english_verse: Your glorious power will be seen on the day you begin to rule. You will wear the sacred robes and shine like the morning sun in all of your strength.
translation_verse: Omaṅ le̱ aaba ye̱ ota gbĩ le̱ no̱, ye̱ ame̱suomo̱ nā, *ye̱ hewulamo̱ kroṅkroṅ mli; oblahĩĩ asafo le̱ baä tamo̱ bō̱ dše̱o̱ dšetše̱remo̱ mũsũṅ le̱. *Lal.

english_verse: The Lord has made a promise that will never be broken: “You will be a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Iehowa ekã kitã ni eſaṅ ehe: “Bo dši oso̱fo ke̱-yaši nāno̱ ye̱ Melkizedek gbe̱dšĩano̱ le̱ nā.”

english_verse: He will judge the nations and crack their skulls, leaving piles of dead bodies all over the earth.
translation_verse: Eekodšo ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ, eewo dse̱mei obõ ke̱ gbohĩĩ so̱ṅṅ; eetſa šikpoṅ kpeteṅkple yitšo nõ.

english_verse: He will drink from any stream that he chooses, while winning victory after victory.
translation_verse: Eenu fā ní yo̱ gbe̱ toi le̱ mli nu, nohewo̱ le̱ eewó eyitšo no̱. Fil.

english_verse: The Lord has done many wonderful things! Everyone who is pleased with God's marvelous deeds will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Iehowa nitšumo̱i le̱ dăra, mei fẽ ní naä he tšui le̱ taoo̱ se̱gbe̱. Lal.

english_verse: Everything the Lord does is glorious and majestic, and his power to bring justice will never end.
translation_verse: Wō ke̱ agbodšē dši enitšumo̱i le̱, ní edšale̱ le̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä nāno̱.

english_verse: The Lord God is famous for his wonderful deeds, and he is kind and merciful.
translation_verse: Eto noni ake̱-kaio̱ enākpe̱ nitšumo̱i le̱; drolo̱ ke̱ mo̱bo̱nalo̱ dši Iehowa.

english_verse: He gives food to his worshipers and always keeps his agreement with them.
translation_verse: Ehãa mei ní šeo̱le̱ gbeyei le̱ yeo nii tŏ̱ro̱ö̱; ekaio̱ ekpãṅmo̱ le̱ ke̱-yaä nāno̱. Lal.

english_verse: He has shown his mighty power to his people and has given them the lands of other nations.
translation_verse: Ehãa emaṅ le̱ leo̱ enitšumo̱ hewale̱ le̱, ake̱-ní eke̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ano̱yelinõ hãame̱ le̱.

english_verse: They are true and right and will stand forever.
translation_verse: ame̱mã ši šiṅṅ dā ke̱-yaši nāno̱, ano̱kwale ke̱ dšale̱ mli afeame̱ ye̱.

english_verse: God rescued his people, and he will never break his agreement with them. He is fearsome and holy.
translation_verse: Etšũ kpōmo̱ ke̱-bahã emaṅ le̱; eke̱ ekpãṅmo̱ le̱ emã ši ke̱-mīya nāno̱. Egbe̱i le̱ ye̱ kroṅkroṅ ni ehe ye̱ gbeyei.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the first step to wisdom and good sense. God will always be respected.
translation_verse: Iehowa gbeyeišeme̱ dši nilē šišidšē, mei fẽ ni yeo̱ no̱ le̱ náa se̱yōmo̱ kpakpa; eyidšiemo̱ le̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä nāno̱. Abe̱i

english_verse: They will get rich and prosper and will always be remembered for their fairness.
translation_verse: Ninámo̱ ke̱ nifále̱ aahĩ ewe le̱, ni edsale̱ le̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä nāno̱.

english_verse: They will be so kind and merciful and good, that they will be a light in the dark for others who do the right thing.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱i le̱, *la tšoo̱ ye̱ duṅ le̱ mli hãa-ame̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ drolo̱ ke̱ mo̱bo̱nalo̱ ke̱ dšalo̱ le̱ deṅ. *Lal.

english_verse: Life will go well for those who freely lend and are honest in business.
translation_verse: Gbomo ní mli hĩ ni efaä mo nõ le̱, aahĩ ahãle̱, eeye esane egbe nā ye̱ kodšomo̱ mli. Lal.

english_verse: They won't ever be troubled, and the kind things they do will never be forgotten.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ehosoṅ gbĩkogbĩko; dšalo̱ le̱, aakaile̱ āhũ ke̱-ate nāno̱.

english_verse: Bad news won't bother them; they have decided to trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Ešeṅ sane fõṅ adafitſā ko gbeyei; eye̱ tšui, ehĩe kã Iehowa no̱.

english_verse: When evil people see this, they angrily bite their tongues and disappear. They will never get what they really want.
translation_verse: Mofõṅ le̱ aana ni aado̱le̱, eekpe *enyãnyõdši ašiši, ni enidšiaṅ aadše wui; nii ni meifõdši taoo̱ le hĩe aakpãtã. *Lal.

english_verse: From dawn until sunset the name of the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Esa ake̱ adšie Iehowa gbei le̱ yi ke̱-dše̱ hũlũ šitēhe ke̱-yaši ešinyõhe!

english_verse: The Lord is far above all of the nations; he is more glorious than the heavens.
translation_verse: Iehowa kwe̱ godšō ke̱-teke dšeṅmãdši fẽ, ni enumnyam le̱ teke ṅwei.

english_verse: No one can compare with the Lord our God. His throne is high above,
translation_verse: Namo tamo̱ Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, moni ešitámo̱he yo̱ ṅwei le̱,

english_verse: and he looks down to see the heavens and the earth.
translation_verse: moni mãa ehĩe ši ní ekwe̱o̱ nii ni yo̱ ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ fẽ le̱? Luk.

english_verse: God lifts the poor and needy from dust and ashes,
translation_verse: Eteo̱ hũmi ši ke̱-dše̱o̱ sũ mli, ni ewóo̱ ohĩafo no̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ tumu no̱,

english_verse: and he lets them take part in ruling his people.
translation_verse: koni ehã eke̱ abladei, ni dši emaṅ le̱ mli abladei le̱, atrá ši.

english_verse: When a wife has no children, he blesses her with some, and she is happy. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ehāa yō kene tšṍo̱ šĩanye ni etšṍo̱ biianye ní nyã́a. Haleluya!

english_verse: God brought his people out of Egypt, that land with a strange language.
translation_verse: Beni Israel dše Mizraim, ni Iakob we le̱ dše maṅ ni wieo̱ maṅso̱ wiemo̱ le̱ ṅõ le̱,

english_verse: The mountains and the hills skipped around like goats.
translation_verse: Gõdši le̱ tũmo̱ tamo̱ tōagboi, goṅkpo̱i le hũ tamo̱ tōbii. Lai.

english_verse: Ask the sea why it ran away or ask the Jordan why it flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Ṅšo̱, meni feo̱o ní odšoo̱ foi ne̱? bo Iordan hũ, ni okũo̱ ose̱ ke̱-yaä ne̱?

english_verse: Ask the mountains and the hills why they skipped like goats!
translation_verse: nye gõdši le̱, ní nyetũmoo̱ tamo̱ tōagboi, nye goṅkpo̱i le̱, tamo̱ tōbii ne̱?

english_verse: Earth, you will tremble, when the Lord God of Jacob comes near,
translation_verse: Bo šikpoṅ, hosomo̱ ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ hĩe, ye̱ Iakob Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ hĩe,

english_verse: because he turns solid rock into flowing streams and pools of water.
translation_verse: moni hãa te̱sā tšṍo̱ kpākpo, ehãa tſre̱bo tšṍo̱ nu ni baä le̱,

english_verse: We don't deserve praise! The Lord alone deserves all of the praise, because of his love and faithfulness.
translation_verse: Dšeewo̱, Iehowa, dšeewo̱, ši ogbe̱i le̱ moṅ oṅõ anumnyam ohã, ye̱ omo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱ ke̱ ono̱kwale le̱ hewo̱!

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Ame̱ye̱ nābu, ši ame̱wiee; ame̱ye̱ hĩṅme̱ii, ši ame̱naa nii;

english_verse: Their hands have no feeling, their legs don't move, and they can't make a sound.
translation_verse: ame̱ye̱ nidši, ši ame̱mõõ nõ mli; ame̱ye̱ nãdši hũ, ši ame̱nyiee, ni ame̱tſaa ame̱sẽṅ hũ.

english_verse: Everyone who made the idols and all who trust them are just as helpless as those useless gods.
translation_verse: Mei ní feame̱ le̱ tamo̱ ame̱ noṅṅ, ke̱ mofẽmo hũ ni ke̱ ehĩe fõo̱ ame̱no̱ le̱.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: *Israel, ṅõ ohĩe ofõ Iehowa no̱! le̱ dši ame̱buamo̱ ke̱ ame̱tše̱ṅ, *Lal.

english_verse: Family of Aaron the priest, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: *Aaron we, ṅõ ohĩe ofõ Iehowa no̱! le̱ dši ame̱buamo̱ ke̱ ame̱tše̱ṅ. *Lal.

english_verse: All of you worship the Lord, so you must trust him to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Iehowa *šelo̱i, nyeṅõa nyehĩe nyefoa Iehowa no! le dši amebuamo̱ ke̱ ametše̱ṅ. *Lal.

english_verse: The Lord will not forget to give us his blessing; he will bless all of Israel and the family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Iehowa ekaiwo̱: eedšō̱wo̱, eedšō̱ Israel we le̱, eedšō̱ Aaron we le̱,

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, no matter who they are, will receive his blessing.
translation_verse: eedšō̱ Iehowa šelo̱i le̱, mei bibii ke̱ mei wudši fẽ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will let your family and your descendants always grow strong.
translation_verse: Iehowa aahã nyeſere babaō, nye ke̱ nyebii fiā.

english_verse: May the Lord who created the heavens and the earth give you his blessing.
translation_verse: Nye dši mei ni Iehowa, ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ fele̱ le̱, edšō̱.

english_verse: The Lord has kept the heavens for himself, but he has given the earth to us humans.
translation_verse: Ṅšwei le̱ Iehowa ṅwei ni, ši šikpoṅ le̱ eṅõ-hã gbomei abii.

english_verse: but we will praise him now and forevermore. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: ši we̱ moṅ wo̱o̱dšie Iehowa yi ke̱-dše̱ be ne̱ mli āhũ ke̱-yaši nāno̱. Haleluya!

english_verse: I love you, Lord! You answered my prayers.
translation_verse: Mīsumo̱ Iehowa, edšake̱ eho migbẽ ke̱ mifaikpamo̱ le̱ toi.

english_verse: You are kind, Lord, so good and merciful.
translation_verse: Drolo̱ ke̱ dšalo̱ dši Iehowa, ni wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ mo̱bo̱nalo̱ ni!

english_verse: and treated me so kindly that I don't need to worry anymore.
translation_verse: *Misusuma, kũ ose̱ ke̱-ya ohedšō̱mo̱ le̱ṅ; edšake̱ Iehowa efeo edšũrõ. *Lal.

english_verse: You, Lord, have saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ odšie misusuma ke̱-dše̱ gbĕle mli, mihĩṅme̱ii ke̱-dše̱ yāfónui amli, ke̱ minãdši hũ ke̱-dše̱ šigbēmo̱ mli.

english_verse: Now I will walk at your side in this land of the living.
translation_verse: Manyie ye̱ Iehowa hĩe ye̱ hĩekãlo̱i asikpoṅ le̱ no̱. Lal.

english_verse: I was faithful to you when I was suffering,
translation_verse: *Mihe miye, beni miwie ake̱: Ahaomi naakpa! le̱. *

english_verse: though in my confusion I said, “I can't trust anyone!”
translation_verse: Mikē̱ ye̱ mitšuifã le̱ mli ake̱: *Gbomo-fẽ-gbomo le̱ amalelo̱ṅ! *Rom.

english_verse: What must I give you, Lord, for being so good to me?
translation_verse: Meni maṅō-to Iehowa nādšiaṅ ye̱ edšũrõ fẽ ní efemi le̱ hewo̱?

english_verse: You are deeply concerned when one of your loyal people faces death.
translation_verse: Iehowa mei kroṅkroṅi le̱ agbẽle dšra wa ye̱ ehĩe. Lal.

english_verse: I worship you, Lord, just as my mother did, and you have rescued me from the chains of death.
translation_verse: O Iehowa, otšũlo̱ dšimi le̱le̱ṅ; otšũlo̱ ke̱ oweyō bi dšimi. Ofẽne mikpãi le̱.

english_verse: I will offer you a sacrifice to show how grateful I am, and I will pray.
translation_verse: Mašã šidā-afo̱le mahão, ni matšé̱ Iehowa gbe̱i le.

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people
translation_verse: Maye mišiwōi le̱ ano̱ mahã Iehowa ye̱ emaṅ le̱ fiā hĩe,

english_verse: gather at your temple in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: ye̱ Iehowa we le̱ kpoi le̱ ano̱, ye̱ bo, Ierusalem, oteṅ! Haleluya!

english_verse: All of you nations, come praise the Lord! Let everyone praise him.
translation_verse: Nye dšeṅmãdši fẽ, nyedšiea Iehowa yi, nye mãdšimãdši fẽ nyekafoale̱. Rom

english_verse: Let every true worshiper of the Lord shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Hã Iehowa šelo̱i le̱ akē̱ ake̱: Nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä!

english_verse: With the Lord on my side, I will defeat my hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Iehowa ye̱ mise̱ ake̱ mibualo̱, nohewo̱ le̱ mana noni mitaoo̱ ye̱ mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ ahe le̱. Lal.

english_verse: It is better to trust the Lord for protection than to trust anyone else,
translation_verse: Ehĩ ake̱ abaä Iehowa abo fè noni ake̱ hĩe aafõ gbomo no̱.

english_verse: Nations surrounded me, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ké̱ dšeṅmãdši fẽ bo̱lemi le̱: Iehowa gbe̱i amli le̱ maflo̱ame̱ maſie.

english_verse: They attacked from all sides, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ké̱ ame̱bo̱lemi ke̱-kpe kwrā po: Iehowa gbe̱i amli le̱ maflo̱ame̱ maſie.

english_verse: Their attacks were so fierce that I nearly fell, but the Lord helped me.
translation_verse: Otšimi ní magbē ši; ši Iehowa ye buami.

english_verse: My power and my strength come from the Lord, and he has saved me.
translation_verse: Iehowa dši mihewale̱ ke̱ miyidšiemo̱ lala, ni etšṍ miyiwalaheremo̱.

english_verse: From the tents of God's people come shouts of victory: “The Lord is powerful!
translation_verse: Nyã́mo̱ ke̱ yiwalaheremo̱ gbẽ ye̱ dšalo̱i abūi amli: Iehowa ninedšũrõ tšuo̱ nii wudši.

english_verse: And so my life is safe, and I will live to tell what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Migboṅ, ši moṅ miyi aaná wala, ni madšadše Iehowa nitšumo̱i le̱ matšõ!

english_verse: He punished me terribly, but he did not let death lay its hands on me.
translation_verse: Iehowa egbla mitoi moṅ, ši eṅõkomi ehãko gbĕle.

english_verse: Open the gates of justice! I will enter and tell the Lord how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Nyegblea dšale̱ agbói le̱ nyehãami, ni mabote mli, ni mayada Iehowa ši!

english_verse: Here is the gate of the Lord! Everyone who does right may enter this gate.
translation_verse: Iehowa agbó le̱ ne̱: Dšalo̱i le̱ aabote mli.

english_verse: The stone that the builders tossed aside has now become the most important stone.
translation_verse: Te̱ le̱ ni tšũtſalo̱i le̱ še̱-fō le̱ etšṍ koṅte̱. Ies.

english_verse: This day belongs to the Lord! Let's celebrate and be glad today.
translation_verse: Ṅme̱ne̱ dši gbĩ ni Iehowa fe le̱; wo̱mli aafliwo̱ ni wo̱nyã́ ye̱ mli!

english_verse: We'll ask the Lord to save us! We'll sincerely ask the Lord to let us win.
translation_verse: Ō Iehowa, heremo̱ wo̱yiwala ko! ō Iehowa, hã omanye aba ko!

english_verse: God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! We praise you from here in the house of the Lord.
translation_verse: Adšō̱ moni baä ye̱ Iehowa gbe̱i ano̱ le̱! Wo̱dse̱o̱ Iehowa we le̱ wodšōo̱nye. Mat.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and he has given us light! Start the celebration! March with palm branches all the way to the altar.
translation_verse: Iehowa le̱ Mawu ni, ni ehã la etšo ehãwo̱. Nyefĩmo̱a gbĩdsũrõ-afo̱lei le̱ ke̱ kpãi ke̱-yaã afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ kòdšĩ le̱ ahe!

english_verse: The Lord is my God! I will praise him and tell him how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Mi-Mawu dšio, ni madao ši; mi-Nyoṅmo̱ dšio, makafoö!

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Nyedaä Iehowa ši, edšake̱ ehĩ; edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä!

english_verse: Obeying your instructions brings as much happiness as being rich.
translation_verse: Mimli flio̱mi ye̱ odasei le̱ agbe̱ le̱ no̱, take̱ boni mo mli flio̱ mo ye̱ nifále̱ fẽ he le̱.

english_verse: What I want most and at all times is to honor your laws.
translation_verse: Misusuma efe butū ke̱ ſe ní eſeo̱ okodšomo̱i le̱ befẽbe le̱.

english_verse: I keep thinking about your teachings, Lord, even if rulers plot against me.
translation_verse: Lumei tete tráa ši wieo̱ mihe: ši otšũlo̱ le̱, ogbe̱nāi le̱ ahe edſẽṅo̱.

english_verse: Your laws are my greatest joy! I follow their advice.
translation_verse: Odasei le̱ dši nii ní mimī še̱o̱ he ke̱ midšinafoi hũ ní woo̱mi ṅā. K.

english_verse: I am at the point of death. Let your teachings breathe new life into me.
translation_verse: Misusuma kã mlu mli; hã miyi aná wala ye̱ owiemo̱ le̱ nā.

english_verse: When I told you my troubles, you answered my prayers. Now teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Midšadše migbè̱i le̱ mitšõ, ní oheremi no̱; tšõmo̱mi ogbe̱nāi le̱.

english_verse: Help me to understand your teachings, and I will think about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Hã mana okpo̱i le̱ agbe̱ le̱ šiši, koni madſẽṅ onākpe̱ nitšumo̱i le̱ ahe.

english_verse: Keep me from being deceitful, and be kind enough to teach me your Law.
translation_verse: Tši amale gbe̱ ke̱-dše̱ mihe, ni oke̱ omla le̱ adromi.

english_verse: I am determined to be faithful and to respect your laws.
translation_verse: Mihala ano̱kwayeli gbe̱ le̱, mike̱ okodšomo̱i le̱ eto mible.

english_verse: I follow your rules, Lord. Don't let me be ashamed.
translation_verse: Mikpe̱te̱ odasei le̱ gbãgbãlī; Iehowa, kāwomi hĩegbēle!

english_verse: I am eager to learn all that you want me to do; help me to understand more.
translation_verse: Maša foi ye̱ okitãi le̱ agbe̱ le̱ no̱; edšake̱ ohã mitšui mli elē̱.

english_verse: Help me to understand your Law; I promise to obey it with all my heart.
translation_verse: Hãmi se̱yōmo̱, ní mihĩe akã omla le̱ he, ni maye no̱ ke̱ mitšui mū le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: Direct me by your commands! I love to do what you say.
translation_verse: Hã manyie okitãi le̱ atempõṅ le̱ no̱, edšake̱ no he mimī še̱o̱. K.

english_verse: Make me want to obey you, rather than to be rich.
translation_verse: Do̱ mitšui ke̱-ya odasei le̱ ahe, ši dšee hĩekō̃ he.

english_verse: Take away my foolish desires, and let me find life by walking with you.
translation_verse: Dšiemo̱ mihĩe ke̱-dše̱ yakanii akwe̱mo̱ no̱, ni ohã miyi aná wala ye̱ ogbè̱i le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: I am your servant! Do for me what you promised to those who worship you.
translation_verse: Ši ní owo mei ní šeo̱o gbeyei le̱, hã aba mli ahã otšũlo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Your wonderful teachings protect me from the insults that I hate so much.
translation_verse: Hã mihorabō̱ ní mišee̱ le̱ aho mi-he; edšake̱ okodšomo̱i le̱ hĩ.

english_verse: I rely on your laws! Don't take away my chance to speak your truth.
translation_verse: Kādšie ano̱kwa wiemo̱ le̱ kwrā ye̱ midāṅ; edšake̱ mihĩe kã okodšomo̱i le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: I will keep obeying your Law forever and ever.
translation_verse: Koni maye omla le̱ no̱ dā ke̱-yaši nāno̱.

english_verse: and I trust them so much that I tell them to kings.
translation_verse: Ni mawie odasei le̱ ahe ye̱ maṅtše̱mei ahĩe, ni mihĩe gboṅ he. Mat.

english_verse: I love your commands! They bring me happiness.
translation_verse: Okitãi le̱ ahe mimī še̱o̱, edšake̱ nomei misumoo̱. K.

english_verse: I love and respect them and will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Mahole minidši ano̱ mahã okitāi le̱ ni misumoo̱ le̱, ni madſẽṅ ogbe̱nāi le̱ ahe.

english_verse: I find true comfort, Lord, because your laws have stood the test of time.
translation_verse: Iehowa, mikaio̱ oblema ko̱dšomo̱i le̱, ni mike̱-še̱dšeo̱ mimī.

english_verse: No matter where I am, your teachings fill me with songs.
translation_verse: Ogbe̱nāi le̱ dši milalai ní milaä ye̱ migbo̱tō šĩa le̱.

english_verse: Even in the night I think about you, Lord, and I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Iehowa, mikaio̱ ogbe̱i le̱ nyōṅ, ni miyeo̱ omla le̱ no̱.

english_verse: You have blessed me because I have always followed your teachings.
translation_verse: Eno̱ dši minõ, ake̱ miyeo̱ okpo̱i le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my choice, and I will obey you.
translation_verse: Mikē̱ ake̱: Bo, Iehowa, dši migbe̱fãṅnõ, maye owiemo̱i le̱ ane̱.

english_verse: With all my heart I beg you to be kind to me, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Mike̱ mitšui fẽ mitao ohīegbe̱; nami mo̱be̱ ye̱ owiemo̱ le̱ nā.

english_verse: I pay careful attention as you lead me, and I follow closely.
translation_verse: Midfẽṅ migbè̱i le̱ ahe, ni mitšṍmo̱ minãdši ke̱-te odasei le̱ ahe.

english_verse: As soon as you command, I do what you say.
translation_verse: Mife oyá ni maye okitãi le̱ ano̱, ni mišašaoo ši.

english_verse: Evil people may set a trap, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Meifõdši akpãi le̱ efĩmo̱mi; ši *mihĩe kpako omla le̱ no̱. *K.

english_verse: Your laws are so fair that I wake up and praise you in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Miteo ši nyõṅ teṅ midaäo ši ye̱ odšale̱ kodšomo̱i le̱ ahewo̱. Lal.

english_verse: I choose as my friends everyone who worships you and follows your teachings.
translation_verse: Mei ni šeo̱o gbeyei le̱ fẽ ke̱ mei ní yeo̱ okpo̱i le̱ ano̱ le̱ ananyo dšimi.

english_verse: Our Lord, your love is seen all over the world. Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Iehowa, omo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱ eyi šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ to̱; tšõmo̱mi ogbe̱nāi le̱. Lal.

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord, and you have kept your promise to treat me with kindness.
translation_verse: Iehowa, ofe otšũlo̱ edšũrõ ye̱ owiemo̱ le̱ nā. K.

english_verse: Give me wisdom and good sense. I trust your commands.
translation_verse: Hãmi yitšoṅ kpakpa ke̱ nilē, edšake̱ mihe okitãi le̱ miye.

english_verse: Those liars have no sense, but I find happiness in your Law.
translation_verse: Ame̱tšui eti tamo̱ fo̱; ši *mi le̱, omla le̱ he mimī še̱o̱. *K.

english_verse: I would rather obey you than to have a thousand pieces of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Mla ní dše̱ odāṅ le̱ hĩ hãmi fè šika ke̱ dſie̱te̱i akpei abo̱. Lal.

english_verse: You created me and put me together. Make me wise enough to learn what you have commanded.
translation_verse: Bo onidši femi ni ame̱šõmi; hãmi se̱yōmo̱, koni makase okitãi le̱.

english_verse: Your worshipers will see me, and they will be glad that I trust your word.
translation_verse: Mei ni šeo̱o gbeyei le̱ aanami ni ame̱aná mīše̱; edšake̱ mihĩe kã owiemo̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Your decisions are correct, and you were right to punish me.
translation_verse: Iehowa, mile ake̱ okodšomo̱i le̱ dša, ní ano̱kwayeli *oke̱-bami ši. *K.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord. Comfort me with your love, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Hã omlihĩle̱ le̱ afe mimīše̱dšemo̱, tamo̱ bo̱ni owo otšũlo̱ ši le̱. Lal.

english_verse: I love to obey your Law! Have mercy and let me live.
translation_verse: Hã omũsũṅtšõle̱ le̱ aba mino̱, ni miyi aná wala; edšake̱ omla le̱ he *mimī še̱o̱. *K.

english_verse: Put down those proud people who hurt me with their lies, because I have chosen to study your teachings.
translation_verse: Hã hewolo̱i le̱ ahĩe agboi, edšake̱ kũtũmpo̱o nā ame̱bami ši; ši mi le̱ midſẽṅo̱ okpo̱i le̱ ahe. K.

english_verse: Let your worshipers come to me, so they will learn to obey your rules.
translation_verse: Hã ogbeyeišelo̱i le̱ ke̱ mei ni le odasei le̱ atšṍ ke̱-ba miṅõ.

english_verse: Let me truly respect your laws, so I won't be ashamed.
translation_verse: Hã mitšui aye emū ye̱ ogbe̱nāi le̱ amli, koni mihĩe akagbo.

english_verse: I long for you to rescue me! Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Misusuma mīto̱ biti ye̱ oyiwalaheremo̱ le̱ hewo̱; ši mihĩe kã owiemo̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: I am worn out from waiting for you to keep your word. When will you have mercy?
translation_verse: Mihĩṅme̱ii mīšiu ye̱ owiemo̱ le̱ hewo, mikē̱o̱ ake̱: Té beni ooše̱dse mimīṅ?

english_verse: My life is wasting away like a dried-up wineskin, but I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mitšṍ tamo̱ woloto̱ ye̱ lasũ mli, kẽle̱ mihĩe kpaa ogbe̱nāi le̱ ano̱. K.

english_verse: I am your servant! How long must I suffer? When will you punish those troublemakers?
translation_verse: Otšũlo̱ gbĩĩ le̱, enyie ni? Té gbĩ ni ookodšo mei ní nyie mise̱ ke̱ yiwale̱ le̱ṅ?

english_verse: Those proud people reject your teachings, and they dig pits for me to fall in.
translation_verse: Hewolo̱i ní enyiee omla le̱ nā le̱ etšatsā bui ehãmi. K.

english_verse: They have almost killed me, but I have been faithful to your teachings.
translation_verse: ſe̱ fiō ni ame̱plenēmi ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱; ši mi le̱ mikwako okpo̱i le̱.

english_verse: Show that you love me and let me live, so that I may obey your commands.
translation_verse: Hã miyi aná wala ye̱ omlihĩle̱ nā, koni maye odase ní dše̱ odāṅ le̱ no̱. K.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are eternal! Your word will last as long as the heavens.
translation_verse: Iehowa, owiemo̱ le̱ mã ši šiṅṅ ye̱ ṅwei ke̱-mīya nāno̱; Ies.

english_verse: You remain faithful in every generation, and the earth you created will keep standing firm.
translation_verse: ono̱kwayeli le̱ ye̱ ke̱-mīya yino̱i fõ no̱. Bo oke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ mã ši ni emã ši ne̱.

english_verse: All things are your servants, and the laws you made are still in effect today.
translation_verse: Ame̱ye̱ ke̱-baši ṅme̱ne̱ ye̱ ogbe̱ dšiano̱tōi le̱ anā, edšake̱ otšũdši dši ame̱fẽ.

english_verse: If I had not found happiness in obeying your Law, I would have died in misery.
translation_verse: Ké̱ dšee omla le̱ he mimī še̱o̱ le̱, kũle̱ beue̱ mihĩe ekpãtã momo ye̱ mimanehũlũ le̱ mli. K.

english_verse: I won't ever forget your teachings, because you give me new life when I follow them.
translation_verse: Mihĩe kpaṅ okpo̱i le̱ ano̱ gbĩkogbĩko, edšake̱ nomei ano̱ otšṍ ohã miyi ná wala. K.

english_verse: I belong to you, and I have respected your laws, so keep me safe.
translation_verse: Onõ dšimi, heremo̱mi! edšake̱ okpo̱i le̱ ase̱gbe̱ mitaoo̱. K.

english_verse: Brutal enemies are waiting to ambush and destroy me, but I obey your rules.
translation_verse: Meifõdši woo̱mi ká ni ame̱kpãtã mihĩe; ši midſẽṅo̱ odasei le̱ ahe.

english_verse: Nothing is completely perfect, except your teachings.
translation_verse: Mina emũyeli fẽ nāgbē; ši okitã le̱ mli le̱ naakpa.

english_verse: I deeply love your Law! I think about it all day.
translation_verse: Misumoo̱ omla ake̱ noko! Dšenamo̱ fẽ le̱ no he midſẽṅo̱. Lal.

english_verse: Your laws never leave my mind, and they make me much wiser than my enemies.
translation_verse: Okitãi le̱ hãa mileo nii fè mihenye̱lo̱i le̱, edšake̱ ame̱ke̱mi ye̱ dā.

english_verse: Thinking about your teachings gives me better understanding than my teachers,
translation_verse: Miye yitšoṅ hũ fè mitšõlo̱i le̱ fë, edšake̱ odasei le̱ ahe midſẽṅo̱.

english_verse: and obeying your laws makes me wiser than those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Miyoo̱ sane se̱ fè onukpai po, edšake̱ miyeo̱ okpo̱i le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: I obey your word instead of following a way that leads to trouble.
translation_verse: Miko̱ minane ke̱-dše̱ gbe̱ fõṅ-fẽ-gbe̱ fõṅ no̱, koni maye owiemo̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: You have been my teacher, and I won't reject your instructions.
translation_verse: Midšeko okodšomo̱i le̱ ase̱, edšake̱ bo otšõo̱mi nii.

english_verse: They give me understanding and make me hate all lies.
translation_verse: Okpo̱i le̱ hãa mináa yitšoṅ, hewo̱ le̱ minye̱o̱ apasa gbè̱i fẽ.

english_verse: Your word is a lamp that gives light wherever I walk.
translation_verse: Owiemo̱ le̱ dši kane hã minane ke̱ la hũ ye̱ mitempõṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Your laws are fair, and I have given my word to respect them all.
translation_verse: Mikã kitã ni midamo̱ no̱, ake̱ maye odšale̱ kodšomo̱i le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: I am in terrible pain! Save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Mina nõ babaō; Iehowa, hã miyi aná wala ye̱ owiemo̱ le̱ nā! K.

english_verse: Accept my offerings of praise and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Iehowa, hã tšuidšũrõnā nikēnii ní minābu wo ši le̱ asa ohĩe, ni otsõmi okodšomo̱i le̱. Lal.

english_verse: I never forget your teachings, although my life is always in danger.
translation_verse: Mihĩe misusuma ye̱ mideṅ dāne̱, ši kẽle̱ omla le̱, mihĩe kpaa no̱. K.

english_verse: Some merciless people are trying to trap me, but I never turn my back on your teachings.
translation_verse: Meifõdši tšṍo̱mi tšõne moṅ, ši midũko gbe̱ ke̱-dše̱ko okpo̱i le̱ ahe.

english_verse: I have made up my mind to obey your laws forever, no matter what.
translation_verse: Mido̱ mitšui yi mihã ogbe̱nãi le̱ ano̱yeli dā ke̱-yaši nāgbẽ.

english_verse: I hate anyone whose loyalty is divided, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Dſẽṅmo̱i enyo̱nyo̱ tše̱mei le̱, *minye̱o̱ame̱, ši omla le̱ misumoo̱. *Lal.

english_verse: You are my place of safety and my shield. Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Bo dši mitēmo̱he ke̱ mitše̱ṅ; owiemo̱ le̱ no̱ mihĩe kã. Lal.

english_verse: All you worthless people, get away from me! I am determined to obey the commands of my God.
translation_verse: Nyedšea mino̱ nyeyaã, nye efõṅfelo̱i, koni maye mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ kitãi le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: Be true to your word, Lord. Keep me alive and strong; don't let me be ashamed because of my hope.
translation_verse: So̱omo̱mi ye̱ owiemo̱ le̱ nā, ni miyi aná wala, ni kāhã mihĩe migbo ye̱ mihĩeno̱kãmo̱ le̱ he.

english_verse: Keep me safe and secure, so that I will always respect your laws.
translation_verse: Ye obuami, ni miyi aná wala, ní mihĩe akã ogbe̱nãi le̱ ahe dāne̱.

english_verse: You reject all deceitful liars because they refuse your teachings.
translation_verse: Mei fẽ ní dũo̱ gbe̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ ogbe̱nãi le̱ ahe le̱, obuuame̱ kwrā; edšake̱ apasa so̱ṅṅ dši ame̱šišiumo̱ le̱.

english_verse: I tremble all over when I think of you and the way you judge.
translation_verse: Oheṅmiṅmi nā le̱ mihelo kpokpoo̱, ni mīše okodšomo̱i le̱ gbeyei.

english_verse: I did what was fair and right! Don't hand me over to those who want to mistreat me.
translation_verse: Miyeo̱ kodšomo̱ ke̱ dšale̱ sane; kāṅmē̃ mihe ohã mei ní waämi yi le̱.

english_verse: Take good care of me, your servant, and don't let me be harmed by those conceited people.
translation_verse: Damo̱ mli ohã otšũlo̱ le̱, ni ahĩ ahã-le̱; kāhã hewolo̱i le̱ mīwami yi. Lal.

english_verse: My eyes are weary from waiting to see you keep your promise to come and save me.
translation_verse: Mihĩṅme̱ii ešiu ye̱ oyiwalaheremo̱ ke̱ odšale̱ wiemo̱ le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: Show your love for me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Oke̱ otšũlo̱ aye ye̱ omo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱ nā, ni otšõmi ogbe̱nāi le̱.

english_verse: I serve you, so let me understand your teachings.
translation_verse: Otšũlo̱ dšimi; hãmi se̱yōmo̱, koni male odasei le̱.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! They have broken your Law.
translation_verse: Eše̱ be ní Iehowa hũ aafe noko; edšake̱ ame̱kwa omla le̱.

english_verse: Your laws mean more to me than the finest gold.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ misumoo̱ okitãi fè šika, hē̃, fè šika kro̱ṅṅ. Lal.

english_verse: I follow all your commands, but I hate anyone who leads me astray.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ mibuo̱ okpo̱i le̱ fẽ ake̱ ame̱dša ye̱ nofẽno gbe̱fãṅ; ši minye̱o̱ kũtũmpo̱o gbè̱i fẽ.

english_verse: Your teachings are wonderful, and I respect them all.
translation_verse: Odasei le̱ ye̱ nākpe̱; nohewo̱ misusuma yeo̱ no̱ le̱.

english_verse: Understanding your word brings light to the minds of ordinary people.
translation_verse: Owiemo̱i le̱ anāgblemo̱ hãa la, ehãa kwašiai leo̱ nii. Lai.

english_verse: I honestly want to know everything you teach.
translation_verse: Migbe̱o̱ midāṅ hatō, tamo̱ moni noko baä etšine, edšake̱ mife okitãi le̱.

english_verse: Think about me and be kind, just as you are to everyone who loves your name.
translation_verse: Tšṍ ohe ohãmi, ni onami mo̱bo̱, take̱ bo̱ni ofeo̱ ohãa mei ní sumoo̱ ogbe̱i le̱.

english_verse: Keep your promise and don't let me stumble or let sin control my life.
translation_verse: Hã *minane amõ ši ye̱ owiemo̱ le̱ mli, ni kāhã nõša ko miye mino̱. *Lal.

english_verse: Protect me from abuse, so I can obey your laws.
translation_verse: Kpõmi ke̱-dše̱ ádesã yiwale̱ mli, koni maye okpo̱i le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Hã ohĩe akpe̱ ye̱ otšũlo̱ no̱, ni otšõmi ogbe̱nāi le̱.

english_verse: When anyone disobeys you, my eyes overflow with tears.
translation_verse: Mihĩṅme̱ii amli fo̱seo̱ nufāi ſieo̱ ši, ye̱ omla le̱ no̱ ní ame̱yee le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and your decisions are fair.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱ dšio, Iehowa, ni okodšomo̱i le̱ hũ dša ke̱-yi ši.

english_verse: All your teachings are true and trustworthy.
translation_verse: Owo odasei le̱ ahe kitã ye̱ dšale̱ ke̱ ano̱kwayeli so̱ṅṅ mli.

english_verse: It upsets me greatly when my enemies neglect your teachings.
translation_verse: Mihĩedō̱ le̱ eplenēmi, edšake̱ mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ ahĩe ekpa owiemo̱i le̱ ano̱. Lal.

english_verse: Your word to me, your servant, is like pure gold; I treasure what you say.
translation_verse: Owiemo̱ le̱ he tše keṅkeṅ, nohewo̱ otšũlo̱ sumoo̱le̱.

english_verse: Everyone calls me a nobody, but I remember your laws.
translation_verse: Mi le̱ midaa ni abuumi; ši kẽle̱ mihĩe kpako okpoi le̱ ano̱. K.

english_verse: You will always do right, and your teachings are true.
translation_verse: Odšale̱ le̱, nāno̱ dšale̱ ni, ni omla le̱, ano̱kwale ni.

english_verse: I am in deep distress, but I love your teachings.
translation_verse: Haomo̱ ke̱ fĩmo̱ eba mino̱; ši kẽle̱ okitãi le̱ ahe mīše̱ mináa. K.

english_verse: Your rules are always fair. Help me to understand them and live.
translation_verse: Odasei le̱ dša ke̱-mīya nāno̱; hãmi se̱yōmo̱, ni miyi aná wala.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please answer me. I promise to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Mike̱ mitšui mū le̱ fẽ blo̱o̱: Heremo̱mi no̱, Iehowa! ni maye ogbe̱nāi le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: I beg you to save me, so I can follow your rules.
translation_verse: Mīblo̱ mītšé̱o, heremo̱ miyiwala, ni maye odasei le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: Even before sunrise, I pray for your help, and I put my hope in what you have said.
translation_verse: Mite ši māṅkẽ mrã ni miblo̱; mihĩe kã owiemo̱i le̱ ano̱. K.

english_verse: I lie awake at night, thinking of your promises.
translation_verse: Mihĩṅme̱ii hoo̱ nyōṅbūbei le̱ ahe, koni mawo owiemo̱ le̱ he dſẽṅmo̱,

english_verse: Show that you love me, Lord, and answer my prayer. Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Bo migbē toi ye̱ omlihĩle̱ nā; Iehowa, hã miyi aná wala ye̱ okodšomo̱i le̱ anā. K.

english_verse: People who disobey your Law have made evil plans and want to hurt me,
translation_verse: Mei ní nyieo̱ nifõdšianii ase̱ le̱ mībe̱ṅke̱, ame̱ke̱ omla le̱ teṅ dšeke̱;

english_verse: but you are with me, and all your commands can be trusted.
translation_verse: ši bo, Iehowa, hũ obe̱ṅke̱, ni okitãi le̱ *fẽ le̱ ano̱kwale ni. *K.

english_verse: From studying your laws, I found out long ago you made them to last forever.
translation_verse: Mile ke̱-dše̱ dšeeṅmõ ake̱ oto odasei le̱ ašiši ke̱-mīya nāno̱.

english_verse: I have not forgotten your Law! Look at the trouble I am in, and rescue me.
translation_verse: Kwe̱mo̱ mimanehũlũ le̱, ni odšiemi; edšake̱ omla le̱, *mihĩe kpaa no̱. *K.

english_verse: Be my defender and protector! Remember your promise and save my life.
translation_verse: Ye misane le̱ ohãmi ni okpõmi; hã miyi aná wala ye̱ owiemo̱ le̱ nā.

english_verse: Evil people won't obey you, and so they have no hope of being saved.
translation_verse: Meiſõdši le̱, ame̱ke̱ yiwalaheremo̱ teṅ dšeke̱; edšake̱ ame̱dii ogbe̱nāi le̱ ase̱.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Iehowa, omũsũṅtšõle̱i le̱ fá babaō; okodšomo̱i le̱ anā le̱ hã miyi aná wala.

english_verse: I have a lot of brutal enemies, but still I never turn from your laws.
translation_verse: Miyiwalo̱i ke̱ mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ fá babaō; kẽle̱ midšeko odasei le̱ ase̱.

english_verse: Those unfaithful people who refuse to obey you are disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Minaä kũtũmpo̱foi le̱, ni amenu feo̱mi tãṅ, edšake̱ ame̱yee owiemo̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Remember how I love your laws, and show your love for me by keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Na, misumoo̱ okpo̱i le̱; Iehowa, hã miyi aná wala ye̱ omlihĩle̱ le̱ nā.

english_verse: All you say can be trusted; your teachings are true and will last forever.
translation_verse: *Owiemo̱-tšo mū le̱ fẽ le̱, ano̱kwale ni, ni odšale̱ kodšomo̱ le̱ fẽ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä nāno̱. *Ioh.

english_verse: Rulers are cruel to me for no reason. But with all my heart I respect your words,
translation_verse: Lumei nyieo̱ mise̱ ke̱ yiwale̱ yakatſā, ši owiemo̱i le̱ ahewo̱ mitšui kpokpoo̱.

english_verse: because they bring happiness like treasures taken in war.
translation_verse: Mináa owiemo̱ le̱ he mīše̱ tamo̱ moko ni ená hānii babaō.

english_verse: I can't stand liars, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Minye̱o̱ apasa ni mihĩo̱; ši omla le̱ moṅ misumoo̱.

english_verse: I praise you seven times a day because your laws are fair.
translation_verse: Midšieo̱ oyi šii kpawo dšenamo̱ ye̱ odšale̱ kodšomo̱i le̱ ahewo̱

english_verse: You give peace of mind to all who love your Law. Nothing can make them fall.
translation_verse: Mei ní sumoo̱ omla le̱ ye̱ hedšo̱le̱ babaō, ni nokonoko be̱ ní woo̱ ame̱nãdšiaṅ.

english_verse: You are my only hope for being saved, Lord, and I do all you command.
translation_verse: Iehowa, mihĩe kã oyiwalaheremo̱ le̱ no̱, ni miyeo̱ okitãi le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: I love and obey your laws with all my heart.
translation_verse: Misusuma yeo̱ odasei le̱ ano̱, ni misumoo̱ame̱ naakpa.

english_verse: You know everything I do. You know I respect every law you have given.
translation_verse: Miyeo̱ okpo̱i ke̱ odasei le̱ ano̱; edšake̱ migbè̱i le̱ fẽ dſere ohĩe. Lal.

english_verse: Please, Lord, hear my prayer and give me the understanding that comes from your word.
translation_verse: Iehowa, hã miblo̱mo̱ le̱ aše̱ ohĩe; hãmi se̱yōmo̱ ye̱ owiemo̱ le̱ nā.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns and keep me safe, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Hã mifaikpamo̱ le̱ aše̱ ohĩe; dšiemo̱mi ye̱ owieme̱ le̱ nā.

english_verse: If you will teach me your laws, I will praise you
translation_verse: Minābu aafo̱se yidšiemo̱, edšake̱ otšõmi ogbe̱nāi le̱.

english_verse: and sing about your promise, because all your teachings are what they ought to be.
translation_verse: Milile̱i le̱ *aala owieme̱ le̱ he lala, edšake̱ okitãi le̱ fẽ le̱ dšale̱ ni. *Lal.

english_verse: Be ready to protect me because I have chosen to obey your laws.
translation_verse: To onine, ní oke̱-ye obuami; edšake̱ mihala okpo̱i le̱.

english_verse: I am waiting for you to save me, Lord. Your Law makes me happy.
translation_verse: Iehowa, miſe oyiwalaheremo̱ le̱, ni omla le̱ he *mimī še̱o̱. *K.

english_verse: Keep me alive, so I can praise you, and let me find help in your teachings.
translation_verse: Hã misusuma yi aná wala, ni edšie oyi, ni okodšomo̱i le̱ aye abuami.

english_verse: I am your servant, but I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Please come after me, because I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Midũ gbe̱ tamo̱ *tō ni elādše: taomo̱ otšũlo̱; edšake̱ okitãi le̱, †mihĩe kpaa no̱. *Ies.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray,
translation_verse: No̱kwo̱le̱i alala. Mifĩmo̱ le̱ mli le̱ mibo mitšé̱ Iehowa, ni ebomi toi.

english_verse: “Come and save me, Lord, from deceitful liars!”
translation_verse: Iehowa, dšiemo̱ misusuma ke̱-dše̱ apasa nābu ke̱ šišiumo̱ lile̱i le̱ mli.

english_verse: What punishment is fitting for you deceitful liars?
translation_verse: Meni šišiumo̱ lile̱i le̱ bahão, ni meni ebafe efata he ehão?

english_verse: Your reward should be sharp and flaming arrows!
translation_verse: Etamo̱ ekālo̱ gãimlibii ni nā ba ke̱ bāisã ṅãi-ke̱-la.

english_verse: But I must live as a foreigner among the people of Meshech and in the tents of Kedar.
translation_verse: Kpóo hãmil ake̱ mibato gbo̱ ye̱ Mešek, ni mibahĩ Kedar būi le̱ amase̱i!

english_verse: I have spent too much time living among people who hate peace.
translation_verse: Misusuma ke̱ mei ní nye̱e̱ hedšo̱le̱ le̱ hĩ ši etše̱ tšṍ.

english_verse: I am in favor of peace, but when I speak of it, all they want is war.
translation_verse: Mile, hedšo̱le̱ gbomo dšimi moṅ; ši kē̱ miwie pe̱ le̱, bĕle̱ ame̱ le̱ ame̱nõ dši ta.

english_verse: I look to the hills! Where will I find help?
translation_verse: No̱kwo̱le̱i alala. Mihole mihĩṅme̱ii ano̱ makwe̱ gõdši le̱; nẽgbe̱ miyeli-ke̱-buame̱ badše̱ aba?

english_verse: It will come from the Lord, who created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Miyeli-ke̱-buamo̱ dše̱o̱ Iehowa, moni fe ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱, ṅõ.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, and he won't go to sleep or let you stumble.
translation_verse: Ehāṅ onane ašāne; moni buo̱ ohe le̱ wo̱ṅ wo̱dõi.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, there at your right side to shade you from the sun.
translation_verse: Iehowa dši ohebulo̱, Iehowa dši ohō̃ṅ ye̱ oninedšŭrõ no̱.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you and keep you safe from all dangers.
translation_verse: Iehowa aabu ohe ke̱-adše̱ efõṅ fẽ mli, eebu osusuma he.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you now and always wherever you go.
translation_verse: Iehowa aabu okpodšē ke̱ omlibā he ke̱-dše̱ be ne̱ mli ke̱-yaši nāno̱.

english_verse: It made me glad when they said, “Let's go to the house of the Lord!”
translation_verse: David no̱kwo̱le̱i alala. Mimī še̱o̱ mihe, ké̱ akē̱mi ake̱: Ba ni wo̱te Iehowa we le̱! Lal.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we are standing inside your gates.
translation_verse: Ierusalem, wo̱nãdši mãmoo̱ ogbói le̱ amli!

english_verse: Jerusalem, what a strong and beautiful city you are!
translation_verse: Ierusalem, bo ní atoö ake̱ maṅ ko ní tšăra ne̱ ke̱-kpe!

english_verse: Every tribe of the Lord obeys him and comes to you to praise his name.
translation_verse: Dše̱i, akutšei ní dši Iehowa akutšei le̱ ni dši odase hã Israel le̱ yaã, koni ame̱yada Iehowa gbe̱i le̱ ši.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we pray that you will have peace, and that all will go well for those who love you.
translation_verse: Nyebaä *hedšo̱le̱ nyehãa Ierusalem! Mei ní sumoo̱o le̱ ahĩ ahãame̱! *Zak.

english_verse: May there be peace inside your city walls and in your palaces.
translation_verse: Hedšo̱le̱ ahĩ ogbogboi le̱ ateṅ, toiṅdso̱le̱ ahĩ omõdši le̱ amli!

english_verse: Because of my friends and my relatives, I will pray for peace.
translation_verse: Minyemimei le̱ ke̱ minanemei le̱ ahewo̱ le̱ makē̱ ake̱: Hedšo̱le̱ ahĩ omli!

english_verse: And because of the house of the Lord our God, I will work for your good.
translation_verse: Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, we le̱ hewo̱ le̱ matao bo ekpakpa.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, I turn my eyes to you, on your throne in heaven.
translation_verse: No̱kwo̱le̱i alala. Bo miholeo̱ mihĩṅme̱ii ano̱ mikwe̱o̱, bo moni otá ṅwei le̱.

english_verse: Servants look to their master, but we will look to you, until you have mercy on us.
translation_verse: Na, bo̱ni tšũdši ahĩṅme̱ii kwe̱o̱ ame̱nuṅtšo̱mei anine, ni weyō hĩṅme̱ii kwe̱o̱ ewura nine le̱, nakai noṅṅ wo̱hĩṅme̱ii kwe̱o̱ Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní eenawo̱ mo̱bo̱.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! We have been insulted more than we can stand,
translation_verse: Nawo̱ mo̱bo̱, Iehowa, nawo̱ mo̱bo̱; edšake̱ heguo̱gbē eyimo̱wo̱ obõbõ!

english_verse: and we can't take more abuse from those proud, conceited people.
translation_verse: Wo̱hefe̱o ní mei ní he edšo̱ame̱ le̱ yeo̱ ke̱ wo̱heguo̱ ní hewolo̱i le̱ gbeo̱ le̱, eyimo̱ wo̱susuma obõbõ.

english_verse: The Lord was on our side! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: David no̱kwo̱le̱i alala. Ké̱ dšee Iehowa ní yō̱ wo̱gbe̱fãṅ le̱, hã Israel akē̱ ake̱:

english_verse: would have killed us all, because it was furious.
translation_verse: ni ame̱mli wo la wowo̱ le̱, ame̱-mī̃wo̱ hĩekãlo̱i;

english_verse: We would have been swept away in a violent flood
translation_verse: kũle̱ nui le̱ suwo̱, ni fāi le̱ ha wo̱susuma no̱; Lal.

english_verse: of high and roaring waves.”
translation_verse: kũle̱ nui ní efe hãmãhãmã le̱ ha wo̱susuma no̱.

english_verse: Let's praise the Lord! He protected us from enemies who were like wild animals,
translation_verse: Yidšiemo̱ ahã Iehowa ake̱ eke̱wo̱ hãã ní wo̱tsṍmo̱ amenyãnyõdši anā lō!

english_verse: and we escaped like birds from a hunter's torn net.
translation_verse: Wo̱susuma le̱ edše mli, tamo̱ loflõ lseo̱ loflõdũlo̱i atšõne mli; tšõne kpā le̱ etse, ni wo̱dše mli!

english_verse: The Lord made heaven and earth, and he is the one who sends us help.
translation_verse: Wo̱yeli-ke̱-buamo̱ ye̱ Iehowa, moni fe ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ le, gbe̱i amli. Lal.

english_verse: Everyone who trusts the Lord is like Mount Zion that cannot be shaken and will stand forever.
translation_verse: No̱kwo̱le̱i alala. Mei ní hĩe kã Iehowa no̱ le̱, ame̱tamo̱ Zion goṅ ní hosoo, ši moṅ emã ši ke̱-mīya nāno̱ le̱.

english_verse: Just as Jerusalem is protected by mountains on every side, the Lord protects his people by holding them in his arms now and forever.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni gõdši ehole Ierusalem kpula le̱, nakai Iehowa hũ ebo̱le emaṅ le̱ ke̱-kpe ke-dše be ne̱ mli ke̱-mīya nāno fẽ. Lal.

english_verse: He won't let the wicked rule his people or lead them to do wrong.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nõfõṅ maṅtše̱tšo le̱ ehĩṅ dšalo̱i le̱ agbe̱fãṅnõ le̱ no̱, koni dšalo̱i le̱ akaṅõ ame̱nidši ame̱wo nõša mli.

english_verse: Let's ask the Lord to be kind to everyone who is good and completely obeys him.
translation_verse: Iehowa, femo̱ mei ni hĩ ke̱ mei ní dša ye̱ ame̱tšuii amli le̱ edšũrõ!

english_verse: When the Lord punishes the wicked, he will punish everyone else who lives an evil life. Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Ši mei ní kpaleo̱ ke̱-yaä ame̱gbè̱i kõdõdši ano̱ le̱, Iehowa aalōame̱ ke̱ mei ní tšuo̱ nišaianii le̱ ke̱-ate! *Hedšo̱le̱ aba Israel no̱! *Gal.

english_verse: It seemed like a dream when the Lord brought us back to the city of Zion.
translation_verse: No̱kwo̱le̱i alala. Beni Iehowa kpla Zion *nomi le̱ ke̱-ba le, efewo tamo noni lá wolàa. *Lal.

english_verse: We celebrated with laughter and joyful songs. In foreign nations it was said, “The Lord has worked miracles for his people.”
translation_verse: No mli le̱ wo̱dāṅ yimo̱ obõbõ ke̱ ṅmlõ ní wo̱lile̱i hũ ke̱ nyã́mo̱ lala; no mli le̱ akē̱ ye̱ dšeṅmãdsi le̱ ateṅ ake̱: Iehowa efe nibii wudši ehãame̱!

english_verse: And so we celebrated because the Lord had indeed worked miracles for us.
translation_verse: Iehowa efe nibii wudši ehãwo̱; nohewo̱ wo̱mī eše̱ wo̱he ne̱.

english_verse: We cried as we went out to plant our seeds. Now let us celebrate as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Mei ni ke̱ yāfónui dūo̱ nii le̱, ame̱ke̱ nyã́mo̱ aakpa. Mat.

english_verse: We cried on the way to plant our seeds, but we will celebrate and shout as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Eke̱ yāfó hĩeo̱ dũmo̱wui le̱ ke̱-nyieo̱ ke̱-yaä moṅ; ši eke̱ nyã́mo̱ aahĩe eṅmā̃-yitẽremo̱i le̱ ke̱-aba. Ies.

english_verse: It is useless to get up early and stay up late in order to earn a living. God takes care of his own, even while they sleep.
translation_verse: Yakatſā nyeteo̱ ši māṅkẽ mrã, nyetše̱o̱ āhũ dāni nyeyadšō̱o̱ nyehe, nyeyeo̱ hedšramo̱ abolo: nakai eṅõ-hāa moni esumoo̱ le̱ ye̱ wo̱ mli. Abe̱i

english_verse: Children are a blessing and a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Na, Iehowa gbošinii ní ehãa dši bii, ni nikēnii dši mũsũṅbii.

english_verse: The more you have, the better off you will be, because they will protect you when your enemies attack you in court.
translation_verse: Adšō̱ nū ní ame̱yi egãimlibii akotoku le̱ to̱ le̱! Ame̱ le̱, ké̱ ame̱ke̱ henye̱lo̱i mitā nā ye̱ agbó nā le̱, ame̱hĩe gboii.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you if you respect him and obey his laws.
translation_verse: No̱kwo̱le̱i alala Adšō̱ mofẽmo ni šeo̱ Iehowa, ní enyieo̱ egbè̱i le̱ ano̱ le̱!

english_verse: Your fields will produce, and you will be happy— all will go well.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ooye oninenā nitšumo̱nii; aadšō̱o ni aahĩ ahão hũ!

english_verse: This is how the Lord will bless everyone who respects him.
translation_verse: Na, nū ní šeo̱ Iehowa gbeyei le̱, bo̱ni abadšō̱le̱ ne̱!

english_verse: May you live long enough to see your grandchildren. Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: ní oona obii abii. *Hedšo̱le̱ aba Israel no̱! *Lal.

english_verse: Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: No̱kwo̱le̱i alala. Ame̱gba minā āhũ ke̱-dše̱ miblahĩaṅ, hã Israel akē̱ ake̱:

english_verse: though my back is like a field that has just been plowed.”
translation_verse: Hũlo̱i ehũ mikotose̱, ame̱bo̱bō̱ ame̱kofii le̱ kãkãdãdši. Ies.

english_verse: I pray that all who hate the city of Zion will be made ashamed and forced to turn and run.
translation_verse: Mei fẽ ni nye̱o̱ Zion le̱ ahĩe aagboi ni ame̱akũ ame̱se̱!

english_verse: Don't let them be like wheat gathered in bundles.
translation_verse: noni yii dſe̱isalo̱ deṅ, ni moni fĩmoo̱ le̱ hũ ke̱-sãkãã etšitši,

english_verse: And don't let anyone who passes by say to them, “The Lord bless you! I give you my blessing in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: ni mei ní hoo̱ le̱ ekē̱ē̱ ake̱: *Iehowa dsō̱mo̱ aba nyeno! Wo̱mīdšō̱nye ye̱ Iehowa gbe̱i amli! *Rut

english_verse: If you kept record of our sins, no one could last long.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši ho, Iehowa, okē̱ oodi nišaianii ase̱ le̱, kũle̱, Nuṅtšo̱, namo po aanyẽ ši adamo̱? Lal.

english_verse: But you forgive us, and so we will worship you.
translation_verse: Ši bo odeṅ *ešaifā yo̱, beni afe ní ašeo gbeyei. *Ies.

english_verse: With all my heart, I am waiting, Lord, for you! I trust your promises.
translation_verse: Mīkwe̱ Iehowa gbe̱; misusuma mīkwe̱ gbe̱, ni ewiemo̱ le̱ no̱ mihĩe kã.

english_verse: Israel, trust the Lord! God is always merciful and has the power to save you.
translation_verse: Israel, ṅõ ohĩe ofõ Iehowa no̱! Edšake̱ Iehowa deṅ mo̱bo̱nale̱ yo̱, ni edeṅ kpõmo̱ ní fá yo̱,

english_verse: Israel, the Lord will save you from all your sins.
translation_verse: ni le̱ noṅṅ eekpõ Israel ke̱-adše̱ enišaianii le fẽ mli! Mat.

english_verse: I am not conceited, Lord, and I don't waste my time on impossible schemes.
translation_verse: David no̱kwo̱le̱i alala. Iehowa, mitšui wóó ehe no̱, mihĩṅme̱ii hũ mãmo̱o̱ ṅwei, ni misā minyiee nibii wudši lo nibii ní yo̱ nākpe̱ tšṍ hãmi le̱ ase̱.

english_verse: But I have learned to feel safe and satisfied, like a young child in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: Le̱le̱ṅ, ninẽmo̱ mininẽ misusuma ni mihã efe kpo; tamo̱ bi ní atšele̱ fufo̱ ni yo̱ enye ṅõ, misusuma ye̱ mimli tamo̱ bi ní atšele̱ fufo̱.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord now and forever.
translation_verse: Israel, ṅõ ohĩe ofõ Iehowa no̱ ke̱-dše̱ be ne̱ mli ke̱-yaši nãno̱! Lal.

english_verse: Then we said, “Let's go to the throne of the Lord and worship at his feet.”
translation_verse: Nyehãa wo̱yaä ešihĩle̱hei le̱, wo̱yakotoa ši ye̱ enaneši māṅō le̱ hĩe!

english_verse: Come to your new home, Lord, you and the sacred chest with all its power.
translation_verse: Iehowa, wó ohe no̱ ke̱-ya ohedšō̱mo̱he le̱, bo ke̱ ohewale̱ adeka le̱ fiā!

english_verse: Let victory be like robes for the priests; let your faithful people celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Hã oso̱foi le̱ awo dšale̱, ni omei kroṅkroṅi le̱ abo̱ oše ke̱ nyã́mo̱!

english_verse: David is your chosen one, so don't reject him.
translation_verse: Otšũlo̱ David hewo̱ le̱ kātšṍ moni ofo̱le̱ mũ le̱ hĩe oha se̱!

english_verse: You made a solemn promise to David, when you said, “I, the Lord, promise that someone in your family will always be king.
translation_verse: Iehowa *ekã David kitã ye̱ ano̱kwale mli, ni ekũṅ ekue̱, ake̱: “Maṅõ omũsũṅbii le̱ eko matá osẽi le no! *Lal.

english_verse: If they keep our agreement and follow my teachings, then someone in your family will rule forever.”
translation_verse: Ke̱dši obii le̱ aaye mikpaṅmo̱ le̱ ke̱ midasei le̱ ni matsõame̱ le̱ no̱ le̱, no le̱ ame̱ hũ ame̱bii atrá osẽi le̱ ne̱ dā.”

english_verse: You have gladly chosen Zion as your home, our Lord.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa ehala Zion, ēfele̱ ní eke̱-fe ešihĩle̱he. Lal.

english_verse: You said, “This is my home! I will live here forever.
translation_verse: “Mihedšō̱mo̱he ne̱ ke̱-mīya nāno̱; bie̱ mahĩ, edšake̱ miſele̱.

english_verse: I will bless Zion with food, and even the poor will eat until they are full.
translation_verse: Eniyenii le̱, madšō̱ no̱ babaō, ehĩafoi le̱ hũ, mahã ame̱tŏ̱ro̱ ke̱ abolo;

english_verse: Victory will be like robes for the priests, and its faithful people will celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: eso̱foi le̱, mike̱ yiwalaheremo̱ aawo-ame̱, ni emei kroṅkroṅi le̱ aabo̱ oše ke̱ nyã́mo̱,

english_verse: I will give mighty power to the kingdom of David. Each of my chosen kings will shine like a lamp
translation_verse: *ahã kóṅ ko akwẽ ye̱ dše̱i ahã David, ni masā kane hũ mahã moni mifo̱le̱ mũ le̱. *Luk.

english_verse: and wear a sparkling crown. But I will disgrace their enemies.”
translation_verse: Ehenye̱lo̱i le̱, mike̱ hĩegbĕle aawo-ame̱, ši le̱ le̱, ekekre le̱ aakpe̱ ye̱ eyiteṅ.”

english_verse: It is truly wonderful when the people of God live together in peace.
translation_verse: David no̱kwo̱le̱i alala. Kwe̱ bo̱ni ehĩ, bo̱ni eyo̱ fe̱o, ké̱ nyemimei fe ekome ke̱-hĩ ši le̱!

english_verse: It is like the dew from Mount Hermon, falling on Zion's mountains, where the Lord has promised to bless his people with life forevermore.
translation_verse: etamo̱ Hermon bó̱ ni nyõo̱ Zion gõdši le̱ ano̱ le̱. Edšake̱ Iehowa ewo dšō̱mo̱ ke̱ wala ši ehã dše̱i ke̱-yaši nāno̱.

english_verse: Everyone who serves the Lord, come and offer praises. Everyone who has gathered in his temple tonight,
translation_verse: No̱kwo̱le̱i alala. Na, nyedšiea Iehowa yi, nye Iehowa tšũdši fẽ, ní nyedamoo̱ Iehowa we le̱ nyōṅ le̱!

english_verse: lift your hands in prayer toward his holy place and praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyeholea nyenidši ano̱ nyetšṍa hekroṅkroṅ le̱, ni nyedšiea Iehowa yi!

english_verse: The Lord is the Creator of heaven and earth, and I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion.
translation_verse: Iehowa ní fe ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱, adše̱ Zion adšō̱o! Lal.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! You are his servants, so praise his name.
translation_verse: Haleluya! Nyedšiea Iehowa gbe̱i le̱ yi, nyedšiea eyi, nye Iehowa tšũdši le̱,

english_verse: come and shout praises. Praise the name of the Lord! He is kind and good.
translation_verse: Nyedšiea Iehowa yi, edšake̱ Iehowa hĩ; nyelaä nyedšiea egbe̱i le̱ yi, edšake̱ eṅõ!

english_verse: He does as he chooses in heaven and on earth and deep in the sea.
translation_verse: Nofẽno ní sa Iehowa hĩe le̱, no efeo ye̱ ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ye̱ ṅšo̱i ke̱ bui ní kwō̱lo̱ le̱ fẽ mli.

english_verse: The Lord makes the clouds rise from far across the earth, and he makes lightning to go with the rain. Then from his secret place he sends out the wind.
translation_verse: Moni hãa afuai teo̱ ši ke̱-dše̱o̱ šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbēhe le̱, efeo̱ srawai efataä nyoṅmo̱ne̱mo̱ he, efãa kō̱yo̱ kpo ke̱-dše̱o̱ etōhei le̱; Ier.

english_verse: The Lord killed the first-born of people and animals in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: moni tſia Mizraim kromo̱bii le̱ nii ke̱-dše̱ gbomo ne̱ ke̱-yaši šĩa kolo no̱ le̱;

english_verse: God used miracles and wonders to fight the king of Egypt and all of his officials.
translation_verse: etšũ okadii ke̱ nākpe̱nii ke̱-ba bo, Mizraim, oteṅ, ke̱-ba Farao ke̱ etšũdši le̱ fẽ no̱; Lal.

english_verse: He destroyed many nations and killed powerful kings,
translation_verse: moni tſia dšeṅmãdši pī anii, ní egbe maṅtše̱mei agboi le̱:

english_verse: The name of the Lord will be remembered forever, and he will be famous for all time to come.
translation_verse: Iehowa, ogbe̱i le̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä nāno̱; Iehowa, okaimo̱ le̱ ye̱ ke̱-mīya yino̱i fẽ no̱! Lal.

english_verse: The Lord will bring justice and show mercy to all who serve him.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa aafã emaṅ le̱ he, ni etšũdši le̱ asane aade̱le̱.

english_verse: Idols of silver and gold are made and worshiped in other nations.
translation_verse: Dšeṅmãdši le̱ amãgãi le̱, dſie̱te̱i ke̱ šika ni, gbomei aninenā nitšumo̱i ni.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Ame̱ye nābu, ši ame̱wiee; ame̱ye̱ hĩṅme̱ii, ši ame̱naa nii;

english_verse: They are completely deaf, and they can't breathe.
translation_verse: ame̱ye̱ toii, ši ame̱nna nii; asaṅ mumo̱ ko be̱ ame̱dāṅ.

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who trust them will end up as helpless as their idols.
translation_verse: Mei ní feame̱ le̱, tamo̱ ame̱ noṅṅ, ke̱ mofẽmo hũ ní ke̱ ehĩe fõo̱ ame̱no̱ le̱.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel, come praise the Lord! All the family of Aaron
translation_verse: Israel we, nyedšiea Iehowa yi! Aaron we, nyedšiea Iehowa yi! Lal.

english_verse: and all the tribe of Levi, come praise the Lord! All of his worshipers, come praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Levi we, nyedšiea Iehowa yi! Iehowa šelo̱i, nyedšiea Iehowa yi!

english_verse: Praise the Lord from Zion! He lives here in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Yidšiemo̱ ahã Iehowa, ní hĩo̱ Ierusalem le̱, ke̱-dše̱ Zion! Haleluya!

english_verse: Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Nyedaä nyoṅmo̱i a-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ši; edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä!

english_verse: Praise the Lord of lords. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Nyedaä nuṅtšo̱mei a-Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ ši; edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä!

english_verse: Only God works great miracles. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Le̱ moni ekometō efeo̱ nākpe̱nii le̱; edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä!

english_verse: With wisdom he made the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Le̱ ni efe ṅwei ye̱ nilē nā le̱; edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä!

english_verse: The Lord stretched the earth over the ocean. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Le̱ ni elē̱ šikpoṅ le̱ mli eha nui ano̱ le̱; edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä!

english_verse: He made the bright lights in the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Le̱ ní efe kanei wudši le̱; edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä! *

english_verse: He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: nyoṅtšẽre ke̱ ṅulamii, koni ame̱ye nyōṅ no̱ le̱; edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä!

english_verse: God struck down the first-born in every Egyptian family. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Le̱ ni etſia Mizraim nii ye̱ ame̱kromo̱bii amli le̱; edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä! Lal.

english_verse: He rescued Israel from Egypt. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ni edšie Israel ke̱-dše̱ ame̱teṅ; edša-ke̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä!

english_verse: God used his great strength and his powerful arm. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ke̱ ninešiwale̱ ke̱ nine ni akpa mli; edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä!

english_verse: He split the Red Sea apart. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Le̱ ní egba Ṅšo̱-tšuru le̱ mli enyo̱ le̱; edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä!

english_verse: The Lord brought Israel safely through the sea. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ni ekpla Israel ke̱-tšṍ teṅ ke̱-ho le̱; edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä!

english_verse: The Lord led his people through the desert. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Le̱ ni ekpla emaṅ le̱ ke̱-tšṍ ṅã le̱ no̱ le̱; edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä!

english_verse: Our God defeated mighty kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Le̱ ni etſia maṅtše̱mei agboi anii le̱; edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä!

english_verse: And he killed famous kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ni egbegbē maṅtše̱mei ní yo̱ gbe̱ii le̱: edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hīo̱ ši ke̱-yaä!

english_verse: One of them was Sihon, king of the Amorites. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Sihon, Amorbii amaṅtše̱ le̱, edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä!

english_verse: Another was King Og of Bashan. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ke̱ Og ni dši Bašan maṅtše̱ le̱ hũ; edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä!

english_verse: God took away their land. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ni eṅõ ame̱šikpoṅ le̱ ehã ake̱ gbošinii le̱, edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä!

english_verse: He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: etšũlo̱ Israel gbošinii le̱; edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä!

english_verse: God saw the trouble we were in. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Moni kaiwo̱, beni wo̱fe butu le̱; edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä,

english_verse: He rescued us from our enemies. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ni edšiewo̱ ye̱ wo̱henye̱lo̱i le̱ adeṅ le̱; edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä!

english_verse: He gives food to all who live. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Le̱ *ehãa helo fẽ niyenii; edšake̱ nāno emo̱bo̱nale hĩo̱ ši ke-yaä! *Lal.

english_verse: Praise God in heaven! God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Nyedaä ṅwei Mawu le̱ ši; edšake̱ nāno̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä!

english_verse: Beside the rivers of Babylon we thought about Jerusalem, and we sat down and cried.
translation_verse: Babel fāi le̱ anā le̱, dše̱i wo̱ho wo̱trá ši ye̱, ni wo̱fófói, beni wo̱kai Zion le̱.

english_verse: We hung our small harps on the willow trees.
translation_verse: Dše̱i fā nā kpãi le̱ ano̱ wo̱ṅõ wo̱saṅkũi le̱ wo̱tšotšõro.

english_verse: Our enemies had brought us here as their prisoners; now they wanted us to sing and entertain them. They insulted us and shouted, “Sing about Zion!”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ dše̱i mei ní ṅõwo̱ nom le̱ biwo̱ lalai ye̱, ni wo̱haolo̱i le̱ tao ni wo̱mli afliwo̱, ame̱kē̱: “Nyelaä Zion lalai le̱ eko nyetšõawo̱!”

english_verse: Here in a foreign land, how can we sing about the Lord?
translation_verse: Té aafe tēṅ ní wo̱o̱la Iehowa lala ye̱ meikpõdši adše hũ?

english_verse: Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand go limp.
translation_verse: Ierusalem, ké̱ mihĩe kpa ono̱ le̱, hã mininedšũrõ hĩe adše ehe no̱! Ier.

english_verse: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I don't think about you above all else.
translation_verse: Ké̱ mikaii bo, ni mibuu Ierusalem fè mimīše̱nõ titri le̱, hã milile̱i akpe̱te̱ midāṅ!

english_verse: Our Lord, punish the Edomites! On the day Jerusalem fell, they shouted, “Completely destroy the city! Tear down every building!”
translation_verse: Iehowa, kaimo̱ Ierusalem gbĩ le̱ ohã Edombii le̱, mei ni kē̱ ake̱: “Nyekũmo̱a, nyekũmo̱a ke̱-yamõa ešišitō le̱ tō̃!” le̱. Lal.

english_verse: Babylon, you are doomed! I pray the Lord's blessings on anyone who punishes you for what you did to us.
translation_verse: Bo Babel biyō ní afeo butū le̱, aadšō̱ moni toö nādšiaṅ, tamo̱ bo̱ni ofe-wo̱ le̱!

english_verse: May the Lord bless everyone who beats your children against the rocks!
translation_verse: Aadšō̱ moni ṅõ obii bibii le̱ etſia tesã le! Ies.

english_verse: All kings on this earth have heard your promises, Lord, and they will praise you.
translation_verse: Iehowa, šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ maṅtše̱mei fẽ aadšie oyi, edšake̱ ame̱nu odāṅ wiemo̱i le̱, Ies.

english_verse: I am surrounded by trouble, but you protect me against my angry enemies. With your own powerful arm you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ké̱ minyie haomo̱ mli le̱, ohãa miyi náa wala! okpãa onine mli owoo̱ mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ amlifũ le̱, ni oninedšũrõ hereo̱ miyiwala.

english_verse: You, Lord, will always treat me with kindness. Your love never fails. You have made us what we are. Don't give up on us now!
translation_verse: Iehowa *aagbe misane le̱ nā: Iehowa, omo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä nāno̱, kākwa bodientše oninenā nitšumoi le! *Fil.

english_verse: Before I even speak a word, you know what I will say,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ wiemo̱ ko wiemo̱ ko be̱ milile̱i no̱ ní bo, Iehowa, olee fẽ.

english_verse: If I were to climb up to the highest heavens, you would be there. If I were to dig down to the world of the dead you would also be there.
translation_verse: Ké̱ mikwo̱ ke̱-te ṅwei le̱, oye̱ dše̱i, ni ké̱ miyaṅmẽ misā ye̱ gbohĩĩadše hũ, nao! Amos

english_verse: Even then your powerful arm would guide and protect me.
translation_verse: dše̱i tete le̱ onine aawami, ni oninedšũrõ aamõ mimli tſé̱.

english_verse: But you see in the dark because daylight and dark are all the same to you.
translation_verse: no le̱ duṅ hũ woo duṅ ye̱ ohĩe, ni nyōṅ tšeo̱ he̱ṅṅ tamo̱ ſane noṅṅ: duṅ dšio, la dšio, fẽ le ekomeṅ ye ohĩe! Iak.

english_verse: You are the one who put me together inside my mother's body,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo ofe misabai le̱, bo osõmi ye̱ minye mũsũṅ.

english_verse: Nothing about me is hidden from you! I was secretly woven together out of human sight,
translation_verse: Aṅõõ miwui le̱ atēēo, beni afemi ye̱ tēmo̱ mli, beni ašõmi ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ šiši tõ le̱. Dsads.

english_verse: but with your own eyes you saw my body being formed. Even before I was born, you had written in your book everything about me.
translation_verse: Beni midsi lákukuli ke̱ke̱ le̱, ohĩṅme̱ii na; ni *gbĩĩ ní atotoi ní ame̱teṅ ekomeflo še̱ko le̱, aṅmã fẽ ye̱ owolo le̱ mli. *Hiob

english_verse: Your thoughts are far beyond my understanding, much more than I could ever imagine.
translation_verse: Mawu, *oyiṅtōi le̱ adšra wa ye̱ mihĩe ake̱ noko! ame̱yi fá ake̱ noko! *Ies.

english_verse: I try to count your thoughts, but they outnumber the grains of sand on the beach. And when I awake, I will find you nearby.
translation_verse: Ké̱ mikē̱: makaneame̱ le̱, *ame̱yi fá fè šia; †beni mihĩe tšẽ le̱, miye̱ omase̱i noṅṅ. *Lal.

english_verse: How I wish that you would kill all cruel and heartless people and protect me from them!
translation_verse: Nānyoṅmo̱, miná ní ogbe meifõdši le̱, ní lášiſielo̱i le̱ dše mino̱!

english_verse: They are always rebelling and speaking evil of you.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ame̱tšĩo̱ otã efõṅ, ni ohenye̱lo̱i le̱ hĩeo̱ ogbe̱i le̱ amli yakayaka.

english_verse: You know I hate anyone who hates you, Lord, and refuses to obey.
translation_verse: Iehowa, aso mei ní nyeno le̱ mikanye̱ame̱? mei ní teo̱ ši woo̱o le̱, mikanyãṅeame̱?

english_verse: They are my enemies too, and I truly hate them.
translation_verse: Minye̱o̱ame̱ nye kpakpa, ni mibuo̱ame̱ mihenye̱lo̱i.

english_verse: Look deep into my heart, God, and find out everything I am thinking.
translation_verse: Mawu, taomo̱ mimli, ni ole mitšuiṅ; kāmi okwe̱, ni oyo midſēṅmo̱i! K.

english_verse: Don't let me follow evil ways, but lead me in the way that time has proven true.
translation_verse: Ni okwe̱ ake̱ minyie gbe̱ fõṅ ko no̱ lo, ni okplami ke̱-ya nāno̱ gbe le̱ no! Lai.

english_verse: Rescue me from cruel and violent enemies, Lord!
translation_verse: David lala ni eke̱-hã lalatše̱ nukpa le̱.

english_verse: They think up evil plans and always cause trouble.
translation_verse: Iehowa, dšiemo̱mi ke̱-dše̱ gbomo fõṅ le̱ deṅ, ni obā miyi ke̱-dše̱ nū yiwalo̱ le̱ deṅ;

english_verse: Protect me, Lord, from cruel and brutal enemies, who want to destroy me.
translation_verse: Ame̱dšo̱dšo̱ō̱ ame̱lile̱ii anā tamo̱ onũfũ, *šikpãi anā ebō̱ ye̱ ame̱nābu. *Rom.

english_verse: Those proud people have hidden traps and nets to catch me as I walk.
translation_verse: Iehowa, bu mihe ke̱-dše̱ mofõṅ le̱ deṅ, ni obā miyi ke̱-dše̱ nū yiwalo̱ le̱ deṅ, edšake̱ ame̱to ame̱yiṅ ake̱ ame̱abutu minyiemo̱.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! Please listen to my prayer.
translation_verse: Hewolo̱i le̱ etšomi tšõne ke̱ kpãi, ame̱ṅõ yā ame̱lē̱ ši ye̱ gbe̱ toi, ame̱tšõ̀-tšõ̀mi akpai.

english_verse: Don't let the wicked succeed in doing what they want, or else they might never stop planning evil.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa, bo dši miyiwalaheremo̱ hewale̱, bo oha miyitšo he ye̱ tawū gbĩ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: They have me surrounded, but make them the victims of their own vicious lies.
translation_verse: Iehowa, kāhã mofõṅ le̱ enitaomo̱nii le̱, kāhã eyiṅtō fõṅ le̱ miya no̱, ní ame̱-mīwó ame̱he no̱!

english_verse: Dump flaming coals on them and throw them into pits where they can't climb out.
translation_verse: Mei ní efo sá ewo mihe le̱, hã efõṅ ni dše̱ ame̱dientše̱ ame̱nā le̱ aha ame̱yitšei ahe! Lal.

english_verse: Our Lord, I know that you defend the homeless and see that the poor are given justice.
translation_verse: Nū lile̱itše̱ akahe ši ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱; efõṅ aagbo̱bi nū yiwalo̱ le̱, ní ebutule̱!

english_verse: Your people will praise you and will live with you because they do right.
translation_verse: Mile ake̱ Iehowa aaye amanehũlũ-nalo̱ sane ahãle̱, ni eekē̱ noni dša ehã ohĩafo.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen when I pray and hurry to help me.
translation_verse: David lala. Iehowa, mīblo̱ mītsé̱o, ohe afe oyá ahãmi; ké̱ mibo mitšé̱o le̱, bo migbē toi!

english_verse: Don't let me want to do evil or waste my time doing wrong with wicked people. Don't let me even taste the good things they offer.
translation_verse: Kāhã mitšui *mīdo̱ ke̱-mīya nõfõṅ ko he, ní mike̱ mei ní tšuo̱ nišaianii le̱ mītšu nifõdšianii; ni kāhã miye ame̱-do̱ko̱do̱ko̱nii le eko. *Lal.

english_verse: Everyone will admit that I was right when their rulers are thrown down a rocky cliff,
translation_verse: Aatšire̱ ame̱kodšolo̱i le̱ atſia ši ye̱ te̱sāi ahe, ni ame̱anu migbē ake̱ eṅõ.

english_verse: You are my Lord and God, and I look to you for safety. Don't let me be harmed.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa, ono̱ mihĩṅme̱ii dſere, bo noṅṅ abo mibaä; kãṅmē̃ misusuma he!

english_verse: Protect me from the traps of those violent people,
translation_verse: Bū mihe ke̱-dše̱ tšõne ní ame̱tšṍmi le̱ ke̱ mei ni tšuo̱ nišaianii le̱ akpai le̱ ahe.

english_verse: and make them fall into their own traps while you help me escape.
translation_verse: Hã meifõdši le̱ adũ ame̱dientše̱ ame̱-yāi le̱, ni mi le̱, madše mli so̱kē. Lal.

english_verse: Even if you look, you won't see anyone who cares enough to walk beside me. There is no place to hide, and no one who really cares.
translation_verse: Beni mimumo̱ *to̱ biti ye̱ mimli le̱, bo ole migbe̱ le̱. Ame̱tšṍ tšõne ame̱tēmi ye̱ gbe̱ ní minyie no̱ le̱ no̱. *Lal.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! You are my place of safety, and you are my choice in the land of the living. Please answer my prayer. I am completely helpless.
translation_verse: Kwe̱ ninedšũrõgbe̱, ni oona ake̱ mokomoko be̱ ni lemi; abobāhe ebo̱mi, mokomoko dſẽṅṅ misusuma no̱

english_verse: Help! They are chasing me, and they are too strong.
translation_verse: Iehowa, mīblo̱ mītsé̱o, mikē̱ ake̱: Bo dši mibobāhe, migbe̱fãṅnõ ye̱ *hĩekãloi ašikpoṅ le̱ no̱. *Lal.

english_verse: I have given up hope, and I feel numb all over.
translation_verse: Nohewo le̱ mimumo̱ eto̱ biti ye̱ mimli, mitšui efe šikplikpī ye̱ mimli.

english_verse: Then I lift my hands in prayer, because my soul is a desert, thirsty for water from you.
translation_verse: Mikpaa minidši amli mihãao; *ohe kũmai miye misusuma tamo̱ šikpoṅ gbiṅ. *Lal.

english_verse: Please hurry, Lord, and answer my prayer. I feel hopeless. Don't turn away and leave me here to die.
translation_verse: Ohe afe oyá ni oheremi no̱, Iehowa! Mimumo̱ eto̱ biti po: Kāṅõ ohĩe otēmi, ni mike̱ mei ni kplekeo̱ ši ke̱-yaä bu le̱ṅ le̱ mīye egbo! Lal.

english_verse: Please rescue me from my enemies, Lord! I come to you for safety.
translation_verse: Iehowa, dšiemo̱mi ke̱-dše̱ mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ adeṅ! bo oṅõ miba mibatē mihe ye̱.

english_verse: You are my God. Show me what you want me to do, and let your gentle Spirit lead me in the right path.
translation_verse: Tšõmo̱mi ni male osuomo̱nā-nii, edšake̱ bo dši mi-Nyoṅmo̱; hã omumo̱ kpakpa le̱ atšõmi gbe̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ tre̱nē̱ no̱! Lal.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, and keep my life safe. Use your saving power to protect me from trouble.
translation_verse: Iehowa, ogbe̱i le̱ hewo̱ le̱ *hã miyi aná wala; odšale̱ le̱ hewo̱ le̱ dšiemo̱ misusuma ke̱-dše̱ haomo̱ mli. *Lal.

english_verse: I am your servant. Show how much you love me by destroying my enemies.
translation_verse: Ni omlihĩle̱ nā le̱ flo̱mo̱ mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ oſie ni okpãtã mei ni haoo̱ misusuma le̱ fē hīe, edšake̱ *otšũlo̱ dšimi! *Lal.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! You are my mighty rock, and you teach me how to fight my battles.
translation_verse: David lala. Yidšiemo̱ ahă Iehowa, mite̱sā le̱, *moni tšõo̱ minidši tawū ke̱ miwābii nōmo̱ le̱; *Lal.

english_verse: We disappear like a breath; we last no longer than a faint shadow.
translation_verse: Gbomo le̱, etamo̱ kō̱yo̱; egbĩĩ le̱ hũ tamo̱ *hō̃ṅ ní hoo̱. *Hiob

english_verse: Use your lightning as arrows to scatter my enemies and make them run away.
translation_verse: Hã srawai agbla ni ogbe̱ame̱ oſã; tšẽrẽmo̱ ogãimlibii le̱, ni owoame̱ foi!

english_verse: Reach down from heaven and set me free. Save me from the mighty flood
translation_verse: Kpa onine mli ke̱-dše̱ ṅwei: šõmi ni odšiemi ke̱-dše̱ nui pī amli, ke̱-dše̱ meikpõdši abii le̱ adeṅ,

english_verse: In praise of you, our God, I will sing a new song, while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱, mala lala hē mahão, saṅkũ ní hīe kpãi nyoṅma matſa mike̱-adšie oyi; Lal.

english_verse: By your power, kings win wars, and your servant David is saved from deadly swords.
translation_verse: bo ohãa maṅtše̱mei yeo̱ kũnim, ni ošõo̱ otšũlo̱ David ke̱-dše̱o̱ klante fõṅ nā.

english_verse: Won't you keep me safe from those lying foreigners who never tell the truth?
translation_verse: Šõmi ni odšiemi ye̱ meikpõdši abii adeṅ, *mei ní ame̱nābu wieo̱ yakayakanii, ni ame̱ninedšũrõ dši kũtũmpo̱o ninedšũrõ le̱; *K.

english_verse: Let's pray that our young sons will grow like strong plants and that our daughters will be as lovely as columns in the corner of a palace.
translation_verse: koni wo̱bihĩĩ le̱ adăra ye̱ ame̱-blahĩaṅ tamo̱ *tšei ní ate̱o, ni wo̱biyei le̱ hũ atamo̱ koṅte̱i, ni akoame̱ tamo̱ maṅtše̱mō̃ he te̱i; *Lal.

english_verse: May our barns be filled with all kinds of crops. May our fields be covered with sheep by the thousands,
translation_verse: koni wo̱boṅoi le̱ ayimo̱ obõbõ, ni aná niyenii sro̱toi fẽ ye̱ mli; wo̱tōi hũ afo̱fō̱ akpekpei ke̱ akpei nyoṅmanyoṅmai ye̱ wo̱krowaiaṅ;

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you give these blessings to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Adšō̱ maṅ ni yo̱ ne̱ke̱ le̱! Adšō̱ maṅ ní Iehowa dši e-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱!

english_verse: I will praise you each day and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Madšie oyi gbĩ-fẽ-gbĩ ni mala madšie ogbe̱i le̱ yi dā ke̱-ate nāno̱!

english_verse: They will celebrate and sing about your matchless mercy and your power to save.
translation_verse: Ame̱awie omlihĩle̱ kpeteṅkple le̱ kaimo̱ le̱ be, ame̱ala odšale̱ le̱ he lala.

english_verse: You are good to everyone, and you take care of all your creation.
translation_verse: Iehowa hĩ hã mei fẽ, ni emũsũṅ tšõo̱le̱ ye̱ enitšumo̱i le̱ fẽ he. Rom.

english_verse: They will tell about your marvelous kingdom and your power.
translation_verse: Ame̱awie omaṅtše̱yeli le̱ anumnyam le̱ he, ni ame̱agba ohewale̱ le̱ he sane,

english_verse: Then everyone will know about the mighty things you do and your glorious kingdom.
translation_verse: koni ame̱hã gbomei abii ale ehewale̱ nitšumo̱i le̱, ke̱ emaṅtše̱yeli le̱ nyam ke̱ agbodšē le̱. K.

english_verse: Your kingdom will never end, and you will rule forever. Our Lord, you keep your word and do everything you say.
translation_verse: Omaṅtše̱yeli le̱, nāno̱ maṅtše̱yeli ni, ni olumoyeli le̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaã yino̱i fẽ no̱.

english_verse: When someone stumbles or falls, you give a helping hand.
translation_verse: Iehowa so̱oo̱ mei fẽ ní gbēo̱ ši le̱, ni *eholeo mei fẽ ni edro̱ ko̱mō̱ le̱ ano̱. *Lal.

english_verse: Everyone depends on you, and when the time is right, you provide them with food.
translation_verse: Bo gbe̱ hīṅme̱ii fẽ kwe̱o̱, ni bo ohāa-ame̱ ame̱niyenii ye̱ be ni sa mli. Lal.

english_verse: By your own hand you satisfy the desires of all who live.
translation_verse: Ogbe̱o̱ odeṅ ni ohãa nofẽno ni hĩe kã to̱ö̱ ke̱ nii ní etaoo.

english_verse: Our Lord, everything you do is kind and thoughtful,
translation_verse: Iehowa *dša ye̱ egbè̱i fiā mli, ni drolo̱ dšile̱ ye̱ enitšumo̱i fiā mli. *

english_verse: and you are near to everyone whose prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: Iehowa ebe̱ṅke̱o̱ mei fẽ ní tšé̱o̱le̱ le̱, mei fẽ ní tšé̱o̱le̱ ye̱ ano̱kwale mli le̱.

english_verse: You satisfy the desires of all your worshipers, and you come to save them when they ask for help.
translation_verse: Mei ní šeo̱le̱ gbeyei le̱, efeo̱ noni ame̱taoo̱ ehãa-ame̱, eboo ame̱blo̱mo̱ toi, ni ehereo̱ ame̱yiwala. Abe̱i

english_verse: You take care of everyone who loves you, but you destroy the wicked.
translation_verse: Iehowa bāa mei fẽ ní sumoe̱le̱ le̱ ayi; ši meifõdši le̱, eekpãtãa ame̱fẽ ame̱hĩe.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and everyone will respect your holy name forever.
translation_verse: Minābu aagba Iehowa yidšiemo̱, ni helo fē aadšie egbe̱i kroṅkroṅ le̱ yi dā ke̱-ate nāne̱!

english_verse: Once they die and are buried, that will be the end of all their plans.
translation_verse: Ké̱ *emumo̱ dše emli le̱, ekũo̱ ese̱ ke̱-yaä esũ le̱ mli ekoṅ; nakai gbĩ le̱ noṅṅ eyiṅtōi le̱ lādšeo̱. *

english_verse: The Lord God of Jacob blesses everyone who trusts him and depends on him.
translation_verse: Adšō̱ moni Iakob Mawu le̱ dši ebuale̱, ní ehĩe kã Iehowa, e-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ne̱ le̱;

english_verse: God made heaven and earth; he created the sea and everything else. God always keeps his word.
translation_verse: le̱ efe ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ ke̱ ṅše̱ ke̱ nofẽno ní ye̱ mli le̱; eyeo ano̱kwa ke̱-yaä nāno̱;

english_verse: He gives justice to the poor and food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free
translation_verse: mei ní ayeo̱ame̱ amim le̱, eyeo̱ ame̱-sane ehãa-ame̱; mei ní hōme̱ yeo̱ame̱ le̱, ehãa-ame̱ niyenii. Iehowa fẽneo̱ gbokle̱foi agbokle̱i;

english_verse: and heals blind eyes. He gives a helping hand to everyone who falls. The Lord loves good people
translation_verse: Iehowa gbleo̱ ſilafoi ahĩṅme̱ii; Iehowa *holeo̱ mei ní edro̱ ko̱mō̱ le̱ ano̱; Iehowa sumoo̱ dšalo̱i; *Lal.
