english_verse: The Lord God of Zion will rule forever! Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Iehowa aaye maṅtše̱ ke̱-ate nāno̱, Zion, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ aaye maṅtše̱ ke̱-ate yino̱i fẽ no̱! Haleluya! Lal.

english_verse: The Lord helps the oppressed, but he smears the wicked in the dirt.
translation_verse: Iehowa fĩo̱ nõnalo̱i ase̱, ši meifõdši le̱, etšire̱o̱ame̱ etſiaä ši. Luk.

english_verse: He provides food for cattle and for the young ravens, when they cry out.
translation_verse: Le̱ ehãa kolo eniyenii, ke̱ *kwãkwãlabitebii ní blo̱ö̱ le̱ hũ. *Hiob

english_verse: The Lord doesn't care about the strength of horses or powerful armies.
translation_verse: Okpo̱ṅo̱ hewale̱ esaa ehĩe, ni enáá gbomo ſũo̱dši ahe mīše̱.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased only with those who worship him and trust his love.
translation_verse: Mei ni šeo̱le̱ gbeyei le̱ moṅ ahe Iehowa mi še̱o̱ ke̱ mei ní hĩe kã emo̱bo̱nale̱ no̱ le̱.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, come and praise the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Ierusalem, kafome̱ Iehowa; Zion, dšiemo̱ o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ yi!

english_verse: God lets you live in peace, and he gives you the very best wheat.
translation_verse: Ehãa okpokpai le̱ ano̱ dšo̱ö̱, ehãa *oto̱ö̱ ke̱ ṅmā̃ kpakpa. *Lal.

english_verse: He covers the ground with snow like a blanket of wool, and he scatters frost like ashes on the ground.
translation_verse: Ehãa snō nyõo̱ tamo̱ kafo̱te; egbe̱o̱ bó̱ ní efĩ eſãa tamo̱ lamlu. Lal.

english_verse: God sends down hailstones like chips of rocks. Who can stand the cold?
translation_verse: Eše̱re̱o̱ enute̱i le̱ eſiee̱ ši tamo̱ atrõmãi; namo aanyẽ efẽi le̱ nā adamo̱?

english_verse: At his command the ice melts, the wind blows, and streams begin to flow.
translation_verse: Etšõo̱ ewiemo̱ le̱, ni ebasēreo̱ame̱; ehãa ekō̱ye̱ le̱ tſaä, ni nui le̱ hoo̱.

english_verse: God gave his laws and teachings to the descendants of Jacob, the nation of Israel.
translation_verse: Edšadšeo̱ ewiemo̱ le̱ etšõe̱ Iakob, egbe̱nāi ke̱ ekodšomo̱i le̱ etšõo̱ Israel.

english_verse: But he has not given his laws to any other nation. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Efeko nakai ehãko maṅ ko maṅ ko dã, ní ekodšomo̱i le̱ hũ, ame̱lee. Haleluya!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Shout the Lord's praises in the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Haleluya! Nyedše̱a ṅwei nyedšiea Iehowa yi; nyedšiea eyi ye̱ ṅwei flōflo!

english_verse: All of you angels, and all who serve him above, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Nye, ebo̱foi le̱ fẽ, nyedšiea eyi; nye, etai le̱ flā, nyedšiea eyi! Lal.

english_verse: Sun and moon, and all of you bright stars, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Hũlũ ke̱ nyoṅtšëre, nyedšiea eyi; nye ṅulamii ni kple̱e̱ le̱ fiā, nyedšiea eyi!

english_verse: Highest heavens, and the water above the highest heavens, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Nye ṅweii amli ṅwei ke̱ nui ní yo̱ ṅwei yiteṅ le̱, nyedšiea eyi!

english_verse: Let all things praise the name of the Lord, because they were created at his command.
translation_verse: Hã ame̱dšie Iehowa gbe̱i le̱ yi; edšake̱ le̱ efã́, ni abo̱ame̱. Lal.

english_verse: He made them to last forever, and nothing can change what he has done.
translation_verse: Eṅõame̱ emãmo̱ ši ke̱-mīya nāno̱; ewo akpo̱ ni akũṅ mli.

english_verse: All creatures on earth, you obey his commands, so come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Nyedše̱a šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ nyedšiea Iehowa yi, nuṅloi wudši ke̱ bui ni mli kwō̱lo̱ le̱ fẽ;

english_verse: Sea monsters and the deep sea, fire and hail, snow and frost, and every stormy wind, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: la ke̱ nyoṅmo̱ṅte̱, snō ke̱ lamo̱, ahum ni yeo̱ ewiemo̱ le̱ ne̱ le̱;

english_verse: All mountains and hills, fruit trees and cedars,
translation_verse: gõdši ke̱ goṅkpo̱i fiā, tšei ni woo̱ yibii ke̱ tšenedrui fẽ;

english_verse: every wild and tame animal, all reptiles and birds, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: ṅãṅ koloi ke̱ šĩa koloi fẽ, wāmo̱-nibii ke̱ fĩdsiatše̱mei;

english_verse: Every king and every ruler, all nations on earth,
translation_verse: šikpoṅ no̱ maṅtše̱mei ke̱ mãdši-mãdši fiā, lume̱i ke̱ šikpoṅ no̱ kodšolo̱i fẽ;

english_verse: every man and every woman, young people and old, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: oblahĩĩ ke̱ oblayei hũ, onukpai ke̱ gbekẽbii blūblu:

english_verse: All creation, come praise the name of the Lord. Praise his name alone. The glory of God is greater than heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Hã ame̱dšie Iehowa gbei le̱ yi; edšake̱ ekometō egbe̱i kwo̱ godšō, enumnyam le̱ teke šikpoṅ ke̱ ṅwei fẽ.

english_verse: Like a bull with mighty horns, the Lord protects his faithful nation Israel, because they belong to him. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ewo *kòṅ ko no̱ ehā emaṅ le̱; nohewo̱ le̱ emei kroṅkroṅi fẽ adšie eyi, Israelbii ní dši maṅ ni be̱ṅke̱le̱ le̱! Haleluya! *Lal.

english_verse: People of Israel, rejoice because of your Creator. People of Zion, celebrate because of your King.
translation_verse: Hã Israel anyá *moni fele̱ le̱ he, ni Zionbii le̱ amli afliame̱ ye̱ †ame̱maṅ-tše̱ le̱ hewo̱! *Lal.

english_verse: Praise his name by dancing and playing music on harps and tambourines.
translation_verse: Hã ame̱dšie egbe̱i le̱ yi ke̱ dšõ̀, ni ame̱la ame̱dšie eyi ke̱ mīdši ke̱ saṅkũ!

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with his people, and he gives victory to those who are humble.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa ená emaṅ le̱ he tšui; eke̱ yiwalaheremo̱ ewula nõnalo̱i.

english_verse: All of you faithful people, praise our glorious Lord! Celebrate and worship.
translation_verse: Hã mei kroṅkroṅi le̱ abo̱ oše ye̱ anumnyam mli, ni ame̱la nyã́mo̱ lalai ye̱ ame̱sāi ano̱!

english_verse: Praise God with songs on your lips and a sword in your hand.
translation_verse: Hã Mawu kafomo̱ akã ame̱dāṅ, ni ame̱hĩe klante ke̱ enā nta ye̱ ame̱dẽ,

english_verse: Take revenge and punish the nations.
translation_verse: koni ame̱ke̱-to̱ owele ye̱ dseṅmãdši le̱ ano̱, ni ame̱gbla mãdšimãdši le̱ atoi,

english_verse: Put chains of iron on their kings and rulers.
translation_verse: koni ame̱wowō ame̱maṅtše̱mei le̱ kõsõṅkõsõi, ni ame̱wowō ame̱bladei le̱ dade gbokle̱i,

english_verse: Punish them as they deserve; this is the privilege of God's faithful people. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: ní ame̱ke̱ kodšomo̱ ní aṅmã le̱ akodšoame̱: ene̱ dši anumnyam hã emei kroṅkroṅi le̱ fẽ! Haleluya!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Praise God in his temple. Praise him in heaven, his mighty fortress.
translation_verse: Haleluya! Nyedšiea Mawu yi ye̱ ehekroṅkroṅ le̱; nyedšiea eyi ye̱ ehewale̱ atatu le̱ṅ!

english_verse: Praise our God! His deeds are wonderful, too marvelous to describe.
translation_verse: Nyedšiea eyi ye̱ ehewale̱ nitšumo̱i le̱ ahewo̱; nyedšiea eyi ye̱ edale̱ babaō le̱ nā!

english_verse: Praise God with trumpets and all kinds of harps.
translation_verse: Nyedšiea eyi ke̱ te̱tre̱mantre̱ kpãmo̱; nyedšiea eyi ke̱ obenta ke̱ saṅkũ!

english_verse: Praise him with tambourines and dancing, with stringed instruments and woodwinds.
translation_verse: Nyedšiea eyi ke̱ mīdši ke̱ dšṍ; nyedšiea eyi ke̱ kpãi-asaṅkũi ke̱ ble̱!

english_verse: Let every living creature praise the Lord. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Nofẽno ní mũo̱ le̱ adšie Iehowa yi! Haleluya! Lal.

english_verse: If you are already wise, you will become even wiser. And if you are smart, you will learn to understand
translation_verse: ní nilelo̱ anu ni eſere ye̱ nikasemo̱ gbe̱fãṅ, ní moni yo̱ dſẽṅmo̱ hũ aná ṅā-wō kpakpa,

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of knowledge. Only a fool rejects wisdom and good advice. Warnings against Bad Friends
translation_verse: *Iehowa gbeyeišemo̱ dši nilẽ šišidšē; ši kwašiai gbeo̱ nilẽ ke̱ tšo̱semo̱ he guo̱. *

english_verse: We'll take their valuables and fill our homes with stolen goods.
translation_verse: wo̱o̱ná nibii ní dšra wa sro̱toi fẽ, wo̱ke̱ hānii aawo wo̱šĩai obõbõ;

english_verse: If you join our gang, you'll get your share.”
translation_verse: oke̱ ohe abo̱ wo̱he; wo̱fẽ wo̱o̱hĩe kotoku kome:

english_verse: Don't follow anyone like that or do what they do.
translation_verse: Mibi, oke̱ame̱ akanyie gbe̱ le̱ no̱; ko̱ onane ke̱-dše̱ ame̱tempōṅ le̱ no̱!

english_verse: They are in a big hurry to commit some crime, perhaps even murder.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ame̱nãdši šaä foi ke̱-yaä efõṅfemo̱ mli, ni ame̱he feo oyá ke̱ lášiſiemo̱.

english_verse: They are like a bird that sees the bait, but ignores the trap.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ yakatſā po ake̱ yā lē̱o̱ ši ye̱ lofōdši ahĩe.

english_verse: They gang up to murder someone, but they are the victims.
translation_verse: Ši ame̱ le̱, ame̱dientše̱ ame̱lá ante̱o ame̱woo̱, ame̱mīwo ame̱susumai hũ ká.

english_verse: The wealth you get from crime robs you of your life. Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Bo̱ni hĩedšōlo̱i fẽ anā yakpa ne̱, noni ame̱dio̱ se̱ le̱ noṅṅ ṅõo̱ ame̱wala ke̱-yaã.

english_verse: Wisdom shouts in the streets wherever crowds gather.
translation_verse: Nilẽ blo̱ō̱ ye̱ blohũiaṅ, ewoo egbẽ ye̱ dšadši ano̱;

english_verse: She shouts in the marketplaces and near the city gates as she says to the people,
translation_verse: eblo̱ö̱ ye̱ hei ní efe hō; ewieo̱ ewiemo̱i le̱ ye̱ agboi le̱ anā, ye̱ mã le̱ṅ:

english_verse: “How much longer will you enjoy being stupid fools? Won't you ever stop sneering and laughing at knowledge?
translation_verse: Nye mei ni nyenako dſẽṅmo̱, mẽ beyino noṅṅ nyeasnmo̱ kwašiafemo̱? ni hefe̱oyelo̱i aaná hefe̱oyeli he mīše̱, ni kwašiai aanye̱ nĩlē ke̱-yaši?

english_verse: Listen as I correct you and tell you what I think.
translation_verse: Nyetšṍmo̱a nyehe nyehãa mikāmo̱ le̱! Na, mafo̱se mimumo̱ le̱ mahãnye, ma-hã nyele miwiemo̱i le̱ hũ!

english_verse: You completely ignored me and refused to listen;
translation_verse: Ake̱-ni mitšé̱, ni nyekwa, mikpã minidši amli, ni mokomoko efoo mli, Ies.

english_verse: you rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: ši nyeše̱ miṅãwō le̱ fẽ nyefẽ, ni mikāmo̱ le̱ hũ nyebuu,

english_verse: “So when you are struck by some terrible disaster,
translation_verse: hewo̱ le̱ mi hũ, nyemanehũlũ le̱ mli le̱ maṅmō, kē̱ nyekpokpomo̱ miba le̱, maye nyehe fe̱o,

english_verse: or when trouble and distress surround you like a whirlwind, I will laugh and make fun.
translation_verse: ké̱ nyehekpokpomo̱ le̱ miba tamo̱ ahum, ni nyemanehũlũ le̱ mīte ši tamo̱ lasũogbĕle, ni fĩmo̱ ke̱ tšuĩyeli miba nyeno̱ le̱.

english_verse: You will ask for my help, but I won't listen; you will search, but you won't find me.
translation_verse: No mli le̱ ame̱atšé̱mi, ši mihereṅ no̱; ame̱atao mise̱gbe̱ mrã mli, ši ame̱-naṅmi. Ies.

english_verse: No, you would not learn, and you refused to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ amenye̱ nilē, ni ame̱ko̱o̱ Iehowa šemo̱ le̱;

english_verse: You rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: ame̱sumo̱o̱ miṅāwõ le̱ eko eko, ame̱-gbe mikāmo̱ le̱ fẽ he guo̱;

english_verse: “Now you will eat the fruit of what you have done, until you are stuffed full with your own schemes.
translation_verse: hewo̱ le̱ ame̱aye ame̱gbe̱ le̱ mli yibii, ni ame̱atŏ̱ro ke̱ ame̱ṅāi ni ame̱totoi le̱. Ies.

english_verse: But if you listen to me, you will be safe and secure without fear of disaster.”
translation_verse: Ši moni boo̱mi toi le̱ aahĩ ši ſeſēſe, ni ehe aadšole ni efõṅ gbeyeišemo be̱ṅ.

english_verse: Keep in tune with wisdom and think what it means to have common sense.
translation_verse: koni oba otoi ši ohã nilē, ni oke̱ otšui hā sanese̱ko̱mo̱;

english_verse: Search for wisdom as you would search for silver or hidden treasure.
translation_verse: ke̱dši otao ese̱gbe̱ tamo̱ dſie̱te̱i, ni otao tamo̱ dſetrii ní aṅõ-tē le̱:

english_verse: God sees that justice is done, and he watches over everyone who is faithful to him.
translation_verse: koni ebu dšale̱ saneyeli tempõṅi le̱ ahe, ni ebā emei kroṅkroṅi le̱ agbè̱i le̱ ayi.

english_verse: With wisdom you will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: No dāni oonu dšale̱ ke̱ kodšomo̱ ke̱ noni dša, gbe̱ kpakpa-fẽ-gbe̱ kpakpa šiši.

english_verse: Sound judgment and good sense will watch over you.
translation_verse: dſẽṅmo̱ aabā oyi dšogbāṅ, sanešišinumo̱ aabu ohe,

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from evil schemes and from those liars
translation_verse: ní edšieo ke̱-dše̱ gbe̱ fõṅ no̱, ke̱-dše̱ mei ni wieo̱ nibii kõdõdši le̱ adeṅ,

english_verse: who turned from doing good to live in the darkness.
translation_verse: mei hũ ní šĩo̱ dšale̱ tempõṅi le̱, ni ame̱yanyieo̱ dudšiaṅ gbè̱i ano̱ le̱,

english_verse: Most of all they enjoy being mean and deceitful.
translation_verse: mei ní nyã́a efõṅfemo̱ he ni ame̱-mli flio̱ame̱ ye̱ nibii fõdši kõdõdši ahe le̱,

english_verse: They are dishonest themselves, and so are all their deeds. Wisdom and Sexual Purity
translation_verse: mei ni ame̱tempõṅi ekõdõkõdõi, ni ame̱gbè̱i le̱ etšṍmo̱ afãfã le̱:

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from the smooth talk of a sinful woman,
translation_verse: koni *edšieo ke̱-dše̱ mokroko ṅã deṅ, ke̱-dše̱ yō mokpōṅ †ní wieo̱ do̱ko̱bī le̱ deṅ,

english_verse: who breaks her wedding vows and leaves the man she married when she was young.
translation_verse: moni ekwa eblayeiaṅ wù le̱, ni ehĩe ekpa e-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ kpãṅmo̱ le̱ no̱ le̱;

english_verse: The road to her house leads down to the dark world of the dead.
translation_verse: edšake̱ ewe le̱ ekpa ke̱-mīya gbĕle mli, ni egbè̱i le̱ mīya sisai ateṅ;

english_verse: Visit her, and you will never find the road to life again.
translation_verse: mei fẽ ní yaä eṅõ le̱ ekũũ ame̱se̱ doṅṅ, ni ame̱še̱e̱ wala gbè̱i le̱ ano̱: —

english_verse: Follow the example of good people and live an honest life.
translation_verse: koni onyie gbomei kpakpai agbe̱ le̱ no̱, ni ohĩ dšalo̱i atempõṅi le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: If you are honest and innocent, you will keep your land;
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mei ní dša le̱ aahĩ šikpoṅ le no̱, ni mei ní eye emū le̱ aaſe̱ ye̱ no̱; Lal.

english_verse: Don't ever think that you are wise enough, but respect the Lord and stay away from evil.
translation_verse: *Kābu ohe nilelo̱; še Iehowa gbeyei, ni odše efõṅ he! *Ies.

english_verse: My child, don't turn away or become bitter when the Lord corrects you.
translation_verse: Mibi, kāgbe Iehowa tšo̱semo̱ le̱ he guo̱, ni kāhã ekãmo̱ le̱ mī-dše otšine; Hiob

english_verse: The Lord corrects everyone he loves, just as parents correct a child they dearly love. The Value of Wisdom
translation_verse: edšake̱ moni Iehowa sumoo̱ le̱, le̱ ekãa, tamo bo̱ni tše̱ feo̱ ebi ní eyo̱ ehe tšui le̱! Kpods.

english_verse: Wisdom is more valuable than precious jewels; nothing you want compares with her.
translation_verse: Edšra hũ wa fè tẽṅẽlẽo, ni onii ni dšra wa fẽ onyẽṅ oke̱-to he. Mat.

english_verse: In her right hand Wisdom holds a long life, and in her left hand are wealth and honor.
translation_verse: Gbĩĩ ase̱dšeke̱mo̱ ye̱ eninedšũrõ, ni nii ke̱ anumnyam ye̱ ebe̱ku. K.

english_verse: Wisdom makes life pleasant and leads us safely along.
translation_verse: Egbè̱i le̱ gbè̱i fe̱fe̱dši ni, ni etempõṅi le̱ fẽ le̱ hedšo̱le̱ ni.

english_verse: Wisdom is a life-giving tree, the source of happiness for all who hold on to her.
translation_verse: Walatšo dšile̱ hã mei ní mõo̱ emli le̱, ni moni hĩeo̱ emli le̱, adšō̱le̱.

english_verse: By his wisdom and knowledge the Lord created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Ṅā Iehowa ke̱-to šikpoṅ le̱ šiši, enõ ṅwei emā ši ye̱ dſẽṅmo̱ nā.

english_verse: By his understanding he let the ocean break loose and clouds release the rain.
translation_verse: Enilẽ nā ni bui kwo̱ṅkwo̱ṅi le̱ fĕ̱le̱, ni atatui tšereo̱ bó̱ ſieo̱ ši.

english_verse: My child, use common sense and sound judgment! Always keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Mibi, kāhã ame̱mīdše ohĩe, ṅõ ṅā wō ní hĩ ke̱ dſẽṅmo̱ oto,

english_verse: They will help you to live a long and beautiful life.
translation_verse: ni ame̱atšṍ wala ame̱hã osusuma ke̱ *wulamo̱nõ hã okue̱. *

english_verse: You will walk safely and never stumble;
translation_verse: No dãni oonyie ogbe̱ le̱ no̱ ſeſēſe, ni ote̱ṅ onane.

english_verse: you will rest without a worry and sleep soundly.
translation_verse: Ké̱ oho okã ši le̱, ošeṅ gbeyei, ši ookã ši, ni owo̱ le̱ aaṅõ. Lal.

english_verse: Do all you can for everyone who deserves your help.
translation_verse: Mei ní sa edšũrõfemo̱ le̱, kākãmã-ame̱, ke̱dši efemo̱ ye̱ odeṅ hewale̱ mli le̱.

english_verse: Don't tell your neighbor to come back tomorrow, if you can help today.
translation_verse: Kākē̱ onanyo ake: “Ya ní oba, ní wó̱ ní mahã”, ké̱ oye̱ eko ye̱ onine no̱ le̱.

english_verse: Don't try to be mean to neighbors who trust you.
translation_verse: Kāto onanyo he ṅā fõṅ, beni le̱ le̱ edſẽṅo̱ ake̱ eye̱ ſeſēſe ye̱ omase̱i le̱.

english_verse: Don't argue just to be arguing, when you haven't been hurt.
translation_verse: Oke̱ moko akabé yakatſā, ke̱dši efekoö efõṅ ko le̱.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of cruel people or follow their example.
translation_verse: Ohĩe akakõ yiwalo̱ ko no̱, ni kāko̱ egbè̱i le̱ amli eko eko.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is dishonest, but he lets good people be his friends.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa mīhĩ kũtũmpo̱fo; ši mei ní dša eke̱-bo̱ö̱. Lal.

english_verse: He places a curse on the home of everyone who is evil, but he blesses the home of every good person.
translation_verse: Iehowa lōmo̱ kã mofõṅ we le̱ no̱; ši edšō̱o̱ dšalo̱i ašihĩle̱he le̱.

english_verse: said to me: “If you follow my teachings and keep them in mind, you will live.
translation_verse: ni etšõmi nii ní ekē̱mi ake̱: Hã otšui ahĩe miwiemo̱i le̱ amli; *ye mikitãi le̱ ano̱, ni oyi aná wala! *

english_verse: “If you love Wisdom and don't reject her, she will watch over you.
translation_verse: Kāšĩle̱, ni eebā oyi; suomo̱le̱, ni eebu ohe.

english_verse: The best thing about Wisdom is Wisdom herself; good sense is more important than anything else.
translation_verse: Nilē šišidšē dši ake̱: Otao nilē, ni oke̱ onii ní oná le̱ fẽ atao sanese̱ko̱mo̱!

english_verse: Don't follow the bad example of cruel and evil people.
translation_verse: Meifõdši atempõṅ le̱, kāyi ne̱, ni kānyie efõṅfelo̱i agbe̱ no̱.

english_verse: Their food and drink are cruelty and wickedness.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ efõṅfemo̱ niyenii ame̱yeo̱, ni yiwale̱ wein ame̱nuo̱.

english_verse: The lifestyle of good people is like sunlight at dawn that keeps getting brighter until broad daylight.
translation_verse: Ši dšalo̱i atempõṅ le̱ tamo la ní kpe̱o̱ ní eyaä no̱ ekpe̱o̱ āhũ ke̱-yašio̱ ſane fintī̃.

english_verse: The lifestyle of the wicked is like total darkness, and they will never know what makes them stumble.
translation_verse: Meifõdši agbe̱ le̱ tamo duṅ kpī, ame̱lee nii ní ame̱tē̱re̱o̱ po.

english_verse: My child, listen carefully to everything I say.
translation_verse: Mibi, bo miwiemo̱i le̱ atoi, ka otoi ohã noni mikē̱o̱ le̱!

english_verse: Don't forget a single word, but think about it all.
translation_verse: Kāhã ame̱mīdše ohĩe, ṅõame̱ oto otšui teṅ!

english_verse: Knowing these teachings will mean true life and good health for you.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ame̱dši wala hã mei ni naäame̱ le̱, ke̱ noni tšáa ame̱hewodšiaṅ fẽ.

english_verse: Never tell lies or be deceitful in what you say.
translation_verse: Tši dā kõdõṅ ke̱-dše̱ omase̱i, ke̱ kũtũmpo̱o nābu ke̱-ya flōflo.

english_verse: Keep looking straight ahead, without turning aside.
translation_verse: To ohĩe tē̃, ni ohã ohĩṅme̱iiase̱ akwe̱ ohĩe tū̃ntũ.

english_verse: Know where you are headed, and you will stay on solid ground.
translation_verse: Dšadšemo̱ onãdši amā̃mo̱he le̱ pe̱pē̱pe̱, ni ohã ogbè̱i fiā adša. Heb.

english_verse: Don't make a mistake by turning to the right or the left.
translation_verse: Kātšṍ ninedšũrõ lo abe̱ku; ša onane ke̱-dše̱ efõṅ mli.

english_verse: My son, if you listen closely to my wisdom and good sense,
translation_verse: Mibi, bo minilē le̱ toi, ni oka otoi ohã misanese̱ko̱mo̱ le̱,

english_verse: you will have sound judgment, and you will always know the right thing to say.
translation_verse: koni obā dſẽṅmo̱ kpakpa yi, ni onābu aṅõ nilē ato.

english_verse: But all that you really get from being with her is bitter poison and pain.
translation_verse: ši enāgbē dšōo̱ tamo̱ tatšo, enā ba tamo̱ klante ke̱ enā nta.

english_verse: If you follow her, she will lead you down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Enādši kplekeo̱ ši ke̱-yaä gbĕle mli, efãmoo̱ enãdši ke̱-yaä gbohĩĩadše.

english_verse: She has missed the path that leads to life and doesn't even know it.
translation_verse: Enyiee wala gbe̱ le̱ no̱, hewo̱ le̱ edũo̱ gbe̱, ni elee.

english_verse: My son, listen to me and do everything I say.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ agbene, mibii, nyeboami toi, ni nyekadšea midāṅ wiemo̱i le̱ ahe!

english_verse: Stay away from a bad woman! Don't even go near the door of her house.
translation_verse: Tši ogbe le̱ ke̱-dše̱ ehe ke̱-ya šoṅṅ, ni kābe̱ṅke̱ ewe le̱ šĩnā le̱,

english_verse: Strangers will get your money and everything else you have worked for.
translation_verse: koni gbo̱i akaye onii le̱ ame̱mītŏ̱ro̱, ni onitšumo̱nii le̱ akayadše mokpõṅ ko we;

english_verse: When it's all over, your body will waste away, as you groan
translation_verse: ní okakẽmo̱ ye̱ onāgbē be le̱ṅ, beni ohelo ke̱ ogbomotšo hĩe ekpãtã le̱,

english_verse: I paid no attention to my teachers,
translation_verse: ni miboo mitšõlo̱i agbē toi, ni mifee toi mihãã mei ní tšõo̱mi nilē le̱!

english_verse: and now I am disgraced in front of everyone.”
translation_verse: ſe̱ fiō ní magbē nifõdšianii fẽ mli ye̱ asafo ke̱ gwabō̱ le̱ teṅ!

english_verse: You should be faithful to your wife, just as you take water from your own well.
translation_verse: Nu bodientše̱ onubu mli nu ke̱ nu ni dše̱o̱ bodientše̱ obu ni baã le̱ mli le̱.

english_verse: And don't be like a stream from which just any woman may take a drink.
translation_verse: Aso onu ni baä le̱ agbe̱ aſã, ni etšṍ fai ye̱ blohũiaṅ?

english_verse: Save yourself for your wife and don't have sex with other women.
translation_verse: Hã ehĩ ši ehã okometō ni dšee oke̱ meikpõdši.

english_verse: Be happy with the wife you married when you were young.
translation_verse: Hã onubu le̱ atšṍ noni adšō̱, ni oná oblahĩaṅ ṅã le̱ he mīše̱.

english_verse: She is beautiful and graceful, just like a deer; you should be attracted to her and stay deeply in love.
translation_verse: Hã ni efe tamo̱ ofrote ní he yo̱ fe̱o ke̱ yō̱ ní he yo̱ ako̱no̱; *ekpokuai le̱ asa ohĩe befẽbe, ni esuomo̱ le̱ ahã oyĩtšoṅ akṍneo dā! *Dšadš.

english_verse: Don't go crazy over a woman who is unfaithful to her own husband!
translation_verse: Ši mibi, mẽba mokroko ṅā hãa oyitšoṅ kõneo̱o, ni olōo̱ yō mokpõṅ atū ne̱?

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, and he watches us closely.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mofẽmo gbè̱i dſere Iehowa hĩe, ni edšadšeo̱ etempõṅi le̱ fẽ pe̱pé̱pe̱.

english_verse: Sinners are trapped and caught by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Mofõṅ le̱, le̱dientše̱ enišaianii le̱ noṅṅ aadũle̱, ni ehe eša kpãi le̱ noṅṅ ake̱-afĩle̱.

english_verse: They get lost and die because of their foolishness and lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Ni ekplẽẽ tšo̱semo̱ hewo̱ le̱, eegbo, ni eedidã egbẽ ši ye̱ ebulufemo̱ babaō le̱ hewo.

english_verse: How long will you lie there doing nothing at all? When are you going to get up and stop sleeping?
translation_verse: Hedšõlo̱, mẽ beyino̱ noṅṅ oowo̱ ke̱-yaši? Mẽ beyino̱ po oote ši ke̱-adše̱ owo̱ le̱ mli?

english_verse: Suddenly, everything is gone, as though it had been taken by an armed robber.
translation_verse: No koni o-hĩa le̱ aaba tamo̱ odšotſalo̱, ke̱ ofĩmo̱ hũ tamo̱ nū ní hĩe tše̱ṅ.

english_verse: winking and giving signals to deceive others.
translation_verse: *ebè̱o̱ hĩṅme̱ii, eke̱ enãdši wieo̱, eke̱ ewābii too̱ okadii, *

english_verse: But they will be struck by sudden disaster and left without a hope.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ ehĩekpãtãmo̱ aaba trukā, aakũmo̱le̱ trukā ní ebe̱ tšábā.

english_verse: Those who are too proud or tell lies or murder,
translation_verse: Hewo hĩṅme̱ii, apasa lile̱i, ke̱ ni-dši ni ſieo̱ lá ni eye bem ši,

english_verse: those who tell lies in court or stir up trouble in a family.
translation_verse: amale odaseyelo̱ ní foo̱ Sane tãa, ke̱ moni woo̱ nyemimei ateṅ béi.

english_verse: Obey the teaching of your parents—
translation_verse: Mibi, ye otše̱ kitā le̱ ne̱, ni kāše̱ onye mla le̱ ofõ!

english_verse: always keep it in mind and never forget it.
translation_verse: Fī okpe̱te̱ otšui dāne̱, ni oke̱-ṅmõ okue̱!

english_verse: Their teaching will guide you when you walk, protect you when you sleep, and talk to you when you are awake.
translation_verse: Kē̱ onyie le̱, eetšõo gbe̱; ké̱ okã ši ōwo̱ le̱, eebu ohe, ni ké̱ ohĩe tšẽ le̱, *eke̱o aagba sane. *Lal.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is a lamp, and its teachings shine brightly. Correction and self-control will lead you through life.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ kitã le̱, kane ni, ni mla le̱, la ni, ni tšo̱semo̱ kãmo̱i le̱, wala gbe̱ ni,

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: koni ame̱bā oyi ke̱-dše̱ yō fõṅ deṅ, ke̱ mokroko ṅã lile̱i do̱ko̱bī le̱ nā.

english_verse: Don't let yourself be attracted by the charm and lovely eyes of someone like that.
translation_verse: Kādi ehefe̱o se̱ ye̱ otšui mli, ni kāhã eke̱ ehĩese̱ mīmõo!

english_verse: A woman who sells her love can be bought for as little as the price of a meal. But making love to another man's wife will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ yō adſamaṅ hãa mo yaše̱o̱ abolo kuku no̱, ni yō gbläfitelo̱ gbo̱bio̱ susuma ní dšra wa.

english_verse: If you carry burning coals, you burn your clothes;
translation_verse: Aso moko aadše la aſie emīnā, ni etadei ešāṅ?

english_verse: if you step on hot coals, you burn your feet.
translation_verse: Alo moko aanyie ṅãi-ke̱-la no̱, ni enãdši ešãṅ?

english_verse: And if you go to bed with another man's wife, you pay the price.
translation_verse: Nakai dši moni yaä enanyo ṅã ṅõ le̱; mofẽmo ní taä ebe le̱ yeṅ ehe gbĩkogbĩko.

english_verse: We don't put up with thieves, not even with one who steals for something to eat.
translation_verse: Agbee dšulo̱ he guo̱, ké̱ hõmo̱ mīyele̱ ni eyadšu ni eke̱-hã esusuma ato̱ le̱;

english_verse: And thieves who get caught must pay back seven times what was stolen and lose everything.
translation_verse: ké̱ amõle̱ le̱, etoo̱ nãdšiaṅ toi kpawo, ni eke̱ ewe nii fẽ-tſẽm hãa.

english_verse: But if you go to bed with another man's wife, you will destroy yourself by your own stupidity.
translation_verse: Ši moni ke̱ nū ṅã bo̱ö̱ adſamaṅ le̱, ebe̱ yitšoṅ, moni taoo le̱dientše̱ esusuma hĩe ekpãtā le̱, le̱ efeo̱ nakai.

english_verse: You will be beaten and forever disgraced,
translation_verse: Pilamo̱ ke̱ hĩešiſiemo̱ enáa, ni ekpa ní eto le̱ anyẽṅ atsumo̱.

english_verse: because a jealous husband can be furious and merciless when he takes revenge.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ awuṅāyeli le̱, nū mlifũ ní nā wa ni, ni oweletō̱ gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱, ekõṅ efliṅ.

english_verse: He won't let you pay him off, no matter what you offer.
translation_verse: Ebuṅ kpãtãmo̱nii ko, ni ké̱ ohã nii pī hũ, emī še̱ṅ.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention and don't forget what I tell you to do.
translation_verse: Mibi, ye miwiemo̱i le̱ ano̱, ni oke̱ mikitãi le̱ ato.

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: koni ame̱bā oyi ke̱-dše̱ mokroko ṅã deṅ, ke̱-dše̱ yō mokpõṅ ní wieo̱ do̱ko̱bī le̱ deṅ.

english_verse: From the window of my house, I once happened to see
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mitšṍ miwe samfle̱ ke̱ emli fo̱dši le̱ amli mikwe̱,

english_verse: It was late in the evening, sometime after dark.
translation_verse: etšṍ e-koṅ le̱ mase̱i ke̱-fo mli ye̱ blohũ le̱ṅ, ni etšṍ ewe le̱ gbe̱,

english_verse: One of these young men turned the corner and was walking by the house of an unfaithful wife.
translation_verse: gbĩ le̱ gbe̱ke̱, beni hĩe efe tūtū le̱, nyōṅ teṅ, beni duṅ ewo kpī le̱.

english_verse: She was dressed fancy like a woman of the street with only one thing in mind.
translation_verse: Ni na, yō ko ke̱le̱ bakpe, ewo adſamaṅ atade, etšui esa,

english_verse: She was one of those women who are loud and restless and never stay at home,
translation_verse: enā wa ni etoi esa, etoo enane ši ye̱ ewe le̱ hũ.

english_verse: who walk street after street, waiting to trap a man.
translation_verse: Biane̱biane̱ ete agbo le̱ nā, biane̱biane̱ ete dšáno̱, ni ewoo̱ ká ye̱ koṅ-fẽ-koṅ.

english_verse: She grabbed him and kissed him, and with no sense of shame, she said:
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni emõle̱ ni eſo̱ enā, eple ehĩe ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱:

english_verse: “I had to offer a sacrifice, and there is enough meat left over for a feast.
translation_verse: Kũle̱ *šidā-afo̱le šã kã mino̱; ši nme̱ne̱ noṅṅ miyahã mišiwōnii le̱. *

english_verse: So I came looking for you, and here you are!
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ midše kpo ní mike̱o abakpe, ni mabo̱ mo̱deṅ matao ohĩegbe̱, ni minao ne̱.

english_verse: The sheets on my bed are bright-colored cloth from Egypt.
translation_verse: Mike̱ sāno̱boi eha misā le̱ no̱, ke̱ kentei ni ake̱ Mizraim kpā lò.

english_verse: And I have covered it with perfume made of myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
translation_verse: Mike̱ mire ke̱ aloö ke̱ sinamon ewo misā le̱ mli ṅma.

english_verse: He took a lot of money along, and he won't be back home before the middle of the month.”
translation_verse: ewo šika ke̱ kotoku ehĩe edẽ, nyõṅ le̱ emūyeli mli dãni ebaba šĩa!

english_verse: And so, she tricked him with all of her sweet talk and her flattery.
translation_verse: Eke̱ enāṅõmo so̱ṅṅ hã ekplẽ, eke̱ enā do̱ko̱bī le̱ kplale̱ ke̱-te.

english_verse: At once he followed her like an ox on the way to be slaughtered, or like a fool on the way to be punished
translation_verse: Enyie ese̱ ke̱-te amrõ le̱ noṅṅ tamo̱ tšina ní ayagbele̱, alo tamo̱ se̱ke̱yelo̱ ní ayabo̱le̱ apā,

english_verse: and killed with arrows. He was no more than a bird rushing into a trap, without knowing it would cost him his life.
translation_verse: ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní gãi tšu emle̱bo mli; tamo̱ loflõ he feo̱ oyá ke̱-yaä tšõne mli ni elee ake̱ ewala hewo̱ atšṍ le̱.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, mibii, nyeboami toi, nyefea toi nyehãa midāṅ wiemo̱i le̱.

english_verse: Don't even think about that kind of woman or let yourself be misled by someone like her.
translation_verse: Kāhã otšui mīdo̱ ke̱-mīya egbè̱i le̱ ano̱, ni kādũ gbe̱ ke̱-yadše etempõṅi le̱ ano̱!

english_verse: Such a woman has caused the downfall and destruction of a lot of men.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ epila mei pī eſie ši, ni mei ní egbegbei le̱ ayi fá babaō.

english_verse: Her house is a one-way street leading straight down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ewe le̱, gbohĩĩadše gbe̱ ni, eka ke̱mīya gbĕle piai le̱ amli.

english_verse: “I am calling out to each one of you!
translation_verse: Nye hĩĩ, nye miblo̱ö̱ mitšé̱o̱, ni nye gbomeiabii le̱ miwoo̱ migbē mihãa

english_verse: I always speak the truth and refuse to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ano̱kwale badše midāṅ, ni minābu mīhĩ nifõdšianii.

english_verse: Every word I speak is honest, not one is misleading or deceptive.
translation_verse: Midāṅ wiemo̱i fẽ le̱ dšale̱ ni, emli eko eko be̱ ní ekõdõ lo edši kũtũmpo̱o.

english_verse: I am strong, and I offer sensible advice and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Minõ dši ṅāwō ke̱ ſeremo̱; midši sanese̱ko̱mo̱, hewale̱ le̱ minõṅ.

english_verse: By my power kings govern, and rulers make laws that are fair.
translation_verse: Mino̱ maṅtše̱mei tsṍo̱ yeo̱ maṅtše̱, ni lume̱i woo̱ mla ye̱ dšale̱ nā.

english_verse: Every honest leader rules with help from me.
translation_verse: Mino̱ lume̱i tšṍo̱ yeo̱ lume̱i, ke̱ abladei ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ kodšolo̱i fẽ.

english_verse: I love everyone who loves me, and I will be found by all who honestly search.
translation_verse: Misumoo̱ mei ní sumoo̱mi, ni mei ni dšeo̱ mrã taoo̱ mise̱gbe̱ le̱, ame̱anami.

english_verse: I can make you rich and famous, important and successful.
translation_verse: Nii ke̱ anumnyam ye̱ midẽ, nii ní tše̱o̱ ke̱ dšale̱ fẽ.

english_verse: What you receive from me is more valuable than even the finest gold or the purest silver.
translation_verse: Miyibii le̱ hĩ fè šika, fè šika ṅmīṅmi, ni minibānii le̱ fè dſie̱te̱i kro̱ṅṅ.

english_verse: I always do what is right,
translation_verse: Dšale̱ gbe̱ le̱ no̱ minyiee, ye̱ ko-dšomo̱ tempõṅi le̱ ateṅ,

english_verse: and I give great riches to everyone who loves me.
translation_verse: koni mahã mei ní sumoo̱mi le̱ aye gbošinii, ni mawo ame̱nitōhei le̱ obõbõ.

english_verse: From the beginning, I was with the Lord. I was there before he began
translation_verse: Iehowa ke̱mi fe egbe le̱ šišidšelo̱ dãni ebõi eblema nitšumo̱i le̱. Hiob

english_verse: to create the earth. At the very first, the Lord gave life to me.
translation_verse: Aṅõmi atá no̱ ke̱-dše̱ nāno̱ bēbe, ke̱-dše̱ šišidšē, dãni šikpoṅ le̱ ba.

english_verse: When I was born, there were no oceans or springs of water.
translation_verse: Beni bui ní mli kwō̱lo̱ le̱ be̱ le̱, afo̱mi; beni bui ní baä nu babaō le̱ be̱ le̱.

english_verse: My birth was before mountains were formed or hills were put in place.
translation_verse: Afo̱mi dãni aṅõ gõdši le̱ amãmo̱ ši, dãni goṅkpo̱i le̱ ba,

english_verse: I was there when the Lord put the heavens in place and stretched the sky over the surface of the sea.
translation_verse: Beni esaa ṅwei le̱, miye dše̱i, beni esāa *bu kwo̱ṅkwo̱ṅ le̱ yi ke̱-bo̱leo le̱, *Hiob

english_verse: I was with him when he placed the clouds in the sky and created the springs that fill the ocean.
translation_verse: beni eṅõ atatui le̱ esẽṅ ši šiṅṅ ye̱ ṅwei, ni etšĩ bu kwo̱ṅkwo̱ṅ le̱ mli nu ní baä le̱ nā le̱,

english_verse: I was there when he set boundaries for the sea to make it obey him, and when he laid foundations to support the earth.
translation_verse: beni efõ hũsũ ewo ṅšo̱ le̱ he, ní nui le̱ akatõ ekitã le̱ no̱, beni eto šikpoṅ le̱ šišii le̱: Hiob

english_verse: I was right beside the Lord, helping him plan and build. I made him happy each day, and I was happy at his side.
translation_verse: no mli le̱ miye emase̱i ake ṅālo̱; ni mimī še̱o̱ mihe dā, miſe̱o̱ ye̱ ehĩe befẽbe,

english_verse: I was pleased with his world and pleased with its people.
translation_verse: miſe̱o̱ ye̱ ešikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni *mináa gbomeiabii ahe mīše̱. *

english_verse: Pay attention, my children! Follow my advice, and you will be happy.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, mibii, nyeboami toi! Edšake̱ adšō̱ mei ní nyieo̱ migbè̱i le̱ ano̱ le̱!

english_verse: Listen carefully to my instructions, and you will be wise.
translation_verse: Nyeboa tšo̱semo̱ toi ní nyele nii, ni nyekakwaäle̱ kwrā!

english_verse: Come to my home each day and listen to me. You will find happiness.
translation_verse: Adšō̱ gbomo ni boo̱mi toi ni ebuo̱ migbói le̱ ana dā ni emēo̱ ye̱ mišīnātšei le̱ ahe le̱.

english_verse: By finding me, you find life, and the Lord will be pleased with you.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ moni aanámi le̱, ená wala, ni ehĩe aaba nyam ye̱ Iehowa hĩe.

english_verse: But if you don't find me, you hurt only yourself, and if you hate me, you are in love with death.
translation_verse: Ši moni nine še̱e̱ mine̱ le̱, ēwa le̱dientše̱ esusuma yi; mei fẽ ní nye̱o̱mi le̱, ame̱mīsumo̱ gbĕle.

english_verse: “Everyone who is ignorant or foolish is invited!
translation_verse: Moni nako dſẽṅmo̱ le̱, egbale bie̱! Moni be̱ yitšoṅ le̱, ekē̱o̱le̱ ake̱:

english_verse: All of you are welcome to my meat and wine.
translation_verse: Nyebaä nyebayea miniyenii le̱ eko, ni nyenua miwein ni mifutu le̱ eko!

english_verse: If you want to live, give up your foolishness and let understanding guide your steps.” True Wisdom
translation_verse: Nyefõa kwašiafemo̱, ní nyeyi aná wala, ni nyenyiea sanese̱ko̱mo̱ gbe̱ le̱ no̱!

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of wisdom. To have understanding, you must know the Holy God.
translation_verse: Iehowa gbeyeišemo̱ dši nilē šišidšē, ni Mokroṅkroṅ le̱ lē dši sanese̱ko̱mo̱

english_verse: I am Wisdom. If you follow me, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mino̱ batšṍ ni ogbĩĩ bafá, ni aaṅõ wala afii afata he ahāo.

english_verse: Good sense is good for you, but if you brag, you hurt yourself. A Foolish Invitation
translation_verse: Ké̱ ole nii le̱, ole ohã ohe; ši ké̱ hefe̱oyelo̱ dšio le̱, bo okome obatĕre.

english_verse: Stupidity is reckless, senseless, and foolish.
translation_verse: Yō kwašia le̱, nāwalo̱ ni, ebe̱ dſẽṅmo̱, ni elee nokonoko;

english_verse: She sits in front of her house and on the highest hills in the town.
translation_verse: ni etaa ewe le̱ šĩnā le̱ ši ye̱ sẽi no̱ ye̱ mã le̱ṅ hei groṅṅi le̱,

english_verse: She shouts to everyone who passes by,
translation_verse: koni etšé̱ mei ní hoo̱, ni nyie ame̱gbè̱i le̱ ano̱ tē̃ le̱:

english_verse: “If you are stupid, come on inside!” And to every fool she says,
translation_verse: Moni náko dſẽṅmo̱ le̱, egbale bie̱! ni moni be̱ yitšoṅ le̱, ekē̱o̱le̱ ake̱:

english_verse: None who listen to Stupidity understand that her guests are as good as dead.
translation_verse: Ši elee ake̱ sisai yo̱ dše̱i le̱, emei ní ekpē le̱, gbohĩĩadše bui le̱ amli ame̱yo̱ le̱.

english_verse: At harvest season it's smart to work hard, but stupid to sleep.
translation_verse: Moni buaä nii anā ye̱ latšābe mli le̱, bi nilelo̱ ni; ši moni wo̱ö̱ ye̱ nikpamo̱be mli le̱, bi ní woo̱ mo hĩegbĕle ni

english_verse: Good people are remembered long after they are gone, but the wicked are soon forgotten.
translation_verse: Ké̱ akai dšalo̱ le̱, adšō̱o̱le̱; ši *meifõdši agbe̱i aašăra. Hiob

english_verse: Deceit causes trouble, and foolish talk will bring you to ruin.
translation_verse: Moni *bē̱o̱ hĩṅme̱i le̱, ewoo̱ aw̌ere̱hõ; ši kwašia nāfūtše̱ le̱, eegbē ši. *

english_verse: Hatred stirs up trouble; love overlooks the wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Nyē̱ tēo̱ béi aši; ši *suomo̱ baä no̱tõmo̱i fẽ no̱. *

english_verse: Great wealth can be a fortress, but poverty is no protection at all.
translation_verse: Niiatše̱ nii le̱ dši emō̃ ni wa; ohĩafoi ahĩekpãtãmo̱ dši ame̱hĩa le̱.

english_verse: Accept correction, and you will find life; reject correction, and you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Moni buo̱ tšo̱semo̱ le̱, enyie wala gbe̱ le̱ no̱; ši moni kwaä kãmo̱ le̱, edũo̱ gbe̱,

english_verse: You can hide your hatred by telling lies, but you are a fool to spread lies.
translation_verse: Moni ke̱ nyē̱ tēo̱ le̱, ehĩe apasa nābu, ni moni wieo̱ mo he le̱, kwašia dšile̱.

english_verse: The words of a good person are like pure silver, but the thoughts of an evil person are almost worthless.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱ lile̱i le̱, etamo̱ dſie̱te̱i kro̱ṅṅ; ši meifõdši atšui le̱, ehĩĩ hãã nokonoko.

english_verse: Many are helped by useful instruction, but fools are killed by their own stupidity.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱ nābu lè̱o̱ mei babaō; ši kwašiai le̱, dſẽṅmo̱ ní ame̱be̱ hewo̱ le̱ ame̱-gboio̱.

english_verse: Fools enjoy doing wrong, but anyone with good sense enjoys acting wisely.
translation_verse: Kwašia le̱, efõṅfemo̱ feo̱le̱ mīše̱; ši moni yo̱ dſẽṅmo̱ le̱, nilē feo̱le̱ mīše̱.

english_verse: What evil people dread most will happen to them, but good people will get what they want most.
translation_verse: *Noni mofõṅ šeo̱ le̱, no noṅṅ baba eno̱; ši †dšalo̱ le̱, aahãle etaomonii le. *

english_verse: Those crooks will disappear when a storm strikes, but God will keep safe all who obey him.
translation_verse: Ké̱ lasũogbĕle te ši pe̱ le̱, mofõṅ le̱ be̱ doṅṅ; ši dšalo̱ le̱, eye̱ nāno̱ šišitō.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will be happy, but there is no future for the wicked.
translation_verse: *Dšalo̱i ahĩeno̱kãmo̱ le̱ bafe mīše̱; ši †meifõdši agbe̱kwemo̱ le̱ bafe yaka. *

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who lives right, but he destroys anyone who does wrong.
translation_verse: Iehowa gbe̱ le̱ dši mō̃ hã mei ni eye emū le̱; ši mei ni tšuo̱ nišaianii le̱, edši hĩekpãtãmo̱ bãame̱.

english_verse: Honest people speak sensibly, but deceitful liars will be silenced.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱ nābu dšieo̱ nilē kpo; ši kũtũmpo̱o lile̱i le̱ aafo. K.

english_verse: If you are truly good, you will do right; if you are wicked, you will be destroyed by your own sin.
translation_verse: Moni eye emū le̱, edšale̱ le̱ aahã egbe adša; ši mofõṅ nifõdšianii le̱ aagbēle̱ ši.

english_verse: Good people bring prosperity to their city, but deceitful liars can destroy a city.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱i adšō̱mo̱ ake̱-wóo̱ maṅ no̱; ši meifõdši anābu butuo̱le̱.

english_verse: It's stupid to say bad things about your neighbors. If you are sensible, you will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Moni gbeo̱ enanyo he guo̱ le̱, ebe̱ yitšoṅ; ši moni yo̱ dſẽṅmo̱ le̱, ebuo̱ enā.

english_verse: A gossip tells everything, but a true friend will keep a secret.
translation_verse: Moni nyie ni etãa sane le̱, edšieo̱ tēmo̱sãdšĩ akpo; ši moni yo̱ ano̱kwale mumo̱ le̱, etšĩmoo̱ sane no̱.

english_verse: A city without wise leaders will end up in ruin; a city with many wise leaders will be kept safe.
translation_verse: Heni maṅkudo̱mo̱ be̱ le̱, maṅ gbēo̱ ši; ši ṅāwoloí pī le̱, toiṅdšo̱le̱ ye̱ mli.

english_verse: A gracious woman will be respected, but a ruthless man will only get rich.
translation_verse: Yō ní hĩe yo̱ nyam náa wō, ni yiwalo̱ náa nii.

english_verse: The Lord hates sneaky people, but he likes everyone who lives right.
translation_verse: Iehowa nihĩnii dši tšuikõdõṅtše̱mei; ši mei ni eye emū ye̱ ame̱gbe̱ le̱ no̱ le̱, ame̱saä ehĩe.

english_verse: You can be sure of this: All crooks will be punished, but God's people won't.
translation_verse: Ké̱ ata abasa ye̱ no̱ po, efõṅfelo̱ yeṅ ehe; ši dsalo̱ sešibii le̱, aadšieame̱.

english_verse: A beautiful woman who acts foolishly is like a gold ring on the snout of a pig.
translation_verse: Yō ní he yo̱ fe̱o ni ebe̱ dšeṅba kpakpa le̱, etamo̱ šika ga ní ake̱-wo kplotō gugṍṅ.

english_verse: Good people want what is best, but troublemakers hope to stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱i ataomo̱nii le̱, ekpakpa so̱ṅṅ ni; ši meifõdši agbe̱kwe̱mo̱ le, mlifũ ni. K.

english_verse: Sometimes you can become rich by being generous or poor by being greedy.
translation_verse: Moko ye̱ ní eke̱ nii ſãa, ši eyaã no̱ eſereo̱ kẽ; moko hũ ye̱ ni efeo kpe̱kpē̱ tekeo̱ no̱, ši eyeo̱ ohĩa kẽ.

english_verse: Generosity will be rewarded: Give a cup of water, and you will receive a cup of water in return.
translation_verse: Moni nine kpo̱ö̱ le̱, eewo fo̱, ni moni hãa mei tō̱ro̱ö̱ le̱, le̱ hũ eeto̱.

english_verse: Charge too much for grain, and you will be cursed; sell it at a fair price, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Moni tsĩo̱ able nā le̱, maṅ aalomo̱le̱; ši moni hõo̱ le̱, dšō̱mo̱ aaba eyiteṅ.

english_verse: Try hard to do right, and you will win friends; go looking for trouble, and you will find it.
translation_verse: Moni taoo̱ ekpakpa le̱, ehĩe baä nyam; ši moni dio̱ efõṅ se̱ le̱, eke̱le̱ aakpe.

english_verse: Trust in your wealth, and you will be a failure, but God's people will prosper like healthy plants.
translation_verse: Moni ke̱ ehĩe fõo̱ enii ano̱ le̱, eegbē ši; ši dšalo̱i aafro̱ke tamo̱ bā ṅmõṅ. Lal.

english_verse: Fools who cause trouble in the family won't inherit a thing. They will end up as slaves of someone with good sense.
translation_verse: Moni gbaä le̱dientše̱ ewe nā le̱, kō̱yo̱ aafe egbošinii, ni bulu aatšṍ moni le nii ye̱ etšuiṅ le̱ tšũlo̱.

english_verse: Live right, and you will eat from the life-giving tree. And if you act wisely, others will follow.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱ yibii le̱ *walatšo ni, ni moni le nii le̱, enine še̱o̱ susumai ano̱. *

english_verse: If good people are rewarded here on this earth, all who are cruel and mean will surely be punished.
translation_verse: Na, dšalo̱ po le̱, awoo̱le̱ nyõmo̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, mbasroo gbomo fõṅ ke̱ ešafelo̱!

english_verse: Once the wicked are defeated, they are gone forever, but no one who obeys God will ever be thrown down.
translation_verse: Abutuo̱ meifõdši, ni ame̱be̱; ši dšalo̱i awe le̱ aamã ši šiṅṅ.

english_verse: Good sense is worthy of praise, but stupidity is a curse.
translation_verse: Gbomo nilē nā adšieo̱ eyi; ši moni hĩe kũtũmpo̱o tšui le̱, aagbe ehe guo̱.

english_verse: It's better to be ordinary and have only one servant than to think you are somebody and starve to death.
translation_verse: Moni abuule̱ ní ehùo̱ ehãa ehe le̱ ehĩ fè moni woo̱ le̱dientše̱ ehĩe nyam ni ebe̱ abolo.

english_verse: An evil person tries to hide behind evil; good people are like trees with deep roots.
translation_verse: Mofõṅ dio̱ efõṅfelo̱i ayā mlinii le̱ se̱; ši dšalo̱i ašišifã le̱ woo yibii. K.

english_verse: We are rewarded or punished for what we say and do.
translation_verse: Gbomo dāṅ yibii aahã eto̱ ke̱ nii kpakpai, ni *gbomo ninenā nitšumo̱i ake-awole̱ nyõmo̱. *Rom.

english_verse: Fools think they know what is best, but a sensible person listens to advice.
translation_verse: Bulu yo̱ ne̱, egbe̱ dša ye̱ ehĩe; ši moni dši nilelo̱ le̱, eboo̱ ṅāwō toi.

english_verse: Sharp words cut like a sword, but words of wisdom heal.
translation_verse: Moko ye̱ ní wieo̱ bambam, tamo̱ adũmoo̱ klante; ši nilelo̱ lile̱i tšáa mo.

english_verse: Truth will last forever; lies are soon found out.
translation_verse: Ano̱kwa nābu aadamo̱ ši šiṅṅ ke̱-ate nāno̱; ši apasa lile̱i le̱, hĩṅme̱itſā ke̱ke̱ ehĩo̱ ši.

english_verse: An evil mind is deceitful, but gentle thoughts bring happiness.
translation_verse: Mei ní too̱ ṅã fõṅ le̱, šišiumo̱ ye̱ ametšuiṅ; ši hedšo̱le̱ he ṅāwolo̱i le̱ aaná mīše̱.

english_verse: Good people never have trouble, but troublemakers have more than enough.
translation_verse: Musu ko musu ko yeṅ dšalo̱; ši meifõdši le̱, efõṅ aayimo̱ame̱ to̱.

english_verse: The Lord hates every liar, but he is the friend of all who can be trusted.
translation_verse: *Apasa nābu le̱, Iehowa mīhĩ; ši mei ní yeo̱ ano̱kwa le̱, enáa ame̱he mīše̱. *

english_verse: Be sensible and don't tell everything you know— only fools spread foolishness everywhere.
translation_verse: Hĩetẽlo̱ ke̱ nilē tēo̱; ši kwašiai atšui šie̱o̱ kwašiafemo̱.

english_verse: Worry is a heavy burden, but a kind word always brings cheer.
translation_verse: Gbomo tšui mli ṅko̱mo̱yeli hãa edo̱ö̱ komō̱; ši *wiemo̱ kpakpa hãa emī še̱o̱ ehe. *

english_verse: You are better off to do right, than to lose your way by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱ tšõo̱ enanyo gbe̱; ši meifõdši agbe̱ le̱ hãa ame̱dũo̱ gbe̱.

english_verse: Anyone too lazy to cook will starve, but a hard worker is a valuable treasure.
translation_verse: Anihaolo̱ le̱ nine še̱ṅ emĩle̱lo le̱ no̱; ši mo̱deṅbō̱ le̱, gbomei anoko ní dšra wa ni. K.

english_verse: Living right is a pathway that leads to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Wala yo̱ dšale̱ gbe̱ le̱ no̱, ni gbĕle be̱ etempõṅ le̱ no̱

english_verse: Some who have nothing may pretend to be rich, and some who have everything may pretend to be poor.
translation_verse: Moko ye̱ ní feo̱ ehe niiatše̱, tše̱ ebe̱ nokonoko; moko ye̱ ní feo̱ ehe ohĩafo, tše̱ eye̱ nii babaō. Mat.

english_verse: The lamp of a good person keeps on shining; the lamp of an evil person soon goes out.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱i ala le̱ tšoo̱ he̱ṅṅ; ši *meifõdši akane le̱ aagbo. *

english_verse: If you reject God's teaching, you will pay the price; if you obey his commands, you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Moni gbeo̱ wiemo le̱ he guo̱ le̱, eke̱ hĩekpãtãmo̱ baä eno̱; ši moni šeo̱ kitã le̱, aawole̱ nyõmo̱.

english_verse: Whoever delivers your message can make things better or worse for you.
translation_verse: Bo̱fo fõṅ gbēo̱ nõfõṅ mli; ši otšãmẽ ano̱kwafo tsáa mei.

english_verse: All who refuse correction will be poor and disgraced; all who accept correction will be praised.
translation_verse: Moni ekplẽẽ tšo̱semo̱ le̱, ohĩa ke̱ hĩegbĕle dši enõ; ši moni buo̱ kãmo̱ le̱, awoo̱ ehĩe nyam.

english_verse: Wise friends make you wise, but you hurt yourself by going around with fools.
translation_verse: Moni ke̱ nilelo̱i nyieo̱ le̱, eetšṍ nilelo̱; ši moni ke̱ kwašiai bo̱ö̱ le̱, eena amane.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you sin, but you will be rewarded if you live right.
translation_verse: Ešafelo̱i le̱, efõṅ nyieo̱ ame̱se̱; ši dšalo̱i le̱, ake̱ ekpakpa woo̱ame̱ nyõmo̱.

english_verse: Even when the land of the poor produces good crops, they get cheated out of what they grow.
translation_verse: Niyenii pī ye̱ ohĩafoi aṅmõdši aši; ši mei pī ye̱ ní ame̱hĩe kpãtãa ye̱ dšale̱ sane ní ame̱yee hewo.

english_verse: If you love your children, you will correct them; if you don't love them, you won't correct them.
translation_verse: Moni tšĩo̱ etšo nā le̱, ēnye̱ ebi le̱; ši moni sumoo̱le̱ le̱, edšeo̱ mrã etšo̱seo̱le̱.

english_verse: If you live right, you will have plenty to eat; if you don't live right, you will go away empty.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱ yeo̱ nii še̱o̱ esusuma nā; ši meifõdši le̱, mũsũṅhõmo̱ yeo̱ame̱. Lal.

english_verse: Proud fools are punished for their stupid talk, but sensible talk can save your life.
translation_verse: Bulu dāṅ ehewõ le̱ he tšo yo̱; ši nilelo̱i anābu bāa ame̱yi.

english_verse: Make fun of wisdom, and you will never find it. But if you have understanding, knowledge comes easily.
translation_verse: Hefe̱oyelo̱ taoo̱ nilē, ši enáá; ši moni ko̱ö̱ sane se̱ le̱, nilē waa hããle̱.

english_verse: Wise people have enough sense to find their way, but stupid fools get lost.
translation_verse: Hĩetẽlo̱ nilē dši ake̱ eyo egbe̱ le̱; ši kwašiai abulufemo̱ dši šišiumo̱.

english_verse: Fools don't care if they are wrong, but God is pleased when people do right.
translation_verse: Bulu ṅmõo̱ sõ-afo̱le; ši dšalo̱i le̱, hedšo̱le̱ ye̱ ame̱teṅ.

english_verse: You have no friends if you are poor, but you have lots of friends if you are rich.
translation_verse: *Ohĩafo le̱, enanyo tete nye̱o̱le̱; ši niiatše̱ le̱, esuoloi fá. *

english_verse: It's wrong to hate others, but God blesses everyone who is kind to the poor.
translation_verse: Moni gbeo̱ enanyo he guo̱ le̱, ēfe eša; ši moni naã amanenalo̱i amo̱bo̱ le̱, *adšō̱le̱. *Lal.

english_verse: It's a mistake to make evil plans, but you will have loyal friends if you want to do right.
translation_verse: Ani mei ní tšõ̀o̱ ṅā fõṅ le̱, dšee tõ ame̱tõo̱ le̱? ši mei ní tšõ̀o̱ ṅā kpakpa le̱ anõ dši mo̱bo̱nale̱ ke̱ ano̱kwale.

english_verse: Hard work is worthwhile, but empty talk will make you poor.
translation_verse: Deṅmegbomo̱ fẽ le̱ se̱námo̱ ye̱ mli; ši nābu flo wiemo̱ le̱, ohĩa ke̱ke̱ yo̱ mli.

english_verse: Wisdom can make you rich, but foolishness leads to more foolishness.
translation_verse: Nilelo̱i anii le̱, ame̱kekre ni; ši kwašiai abulufemo̱ le̱, bulufemo̱ noṅṅ ni.

english_verse: An honest witness can save your life, but liars can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Ano̱kwa odasefonyo hereo̱ susumai ayiwala; ši kũtũmpo̱fo le̱, amale sane etãa.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you and your children have a strong fortress
translation_verse: Hĩeno̱kãmo̱ ní mli wa ye̱ Iehowa gbeyeišemo̱ mli, ni moni yo̱ no le̱, ebĩĩ aaná abobãhe.

english_verse: and a life-giving fountain that keeps you safe from deadly traps.
translation_verse: Iehowa gbeyeišemo̱ le̱, wala nubu ni ake̱-dšeo̱ gbĕle tšõnei amli ni.

english_verse: Rulers of powerful nations are held in honor; rulers of weak nations are nothing at all.
translation_verse: Maṅ yifale̱ dši maṅtše̱ anumnyam, ši maṅ yitãle̱ le̱, lumo̱ hĩekpãtãmo̱ ni.

english_verse: It's smart to be patient, but it's stupid to lose your temper.
translation_verse: Moni mli fũũ mrā le̱, eye̱ dſẽṅmo̱ dšogbāṅ; ši moni tšui yo̱ flòflò le̱, edšieo̱ bulufemo̱ kpo.

english_verse: It's healthy to be content, but envy can eat you up.
translation_verse: Tšui ní mli dšo̱ le̱, gbomotšo le̱ yiwala ni; ši awuṅāyeli le̱, *wuiaṅ šăramo̱ ni. *

english_verse: If you mistreat the poor, you insult your Creator; if you are kind to them, you show him respect.
translation_verse: Monĩ waä *ohĩafo yi le̱, ēbo̱ efelo̱ le̱ ahora; ši †moni naä moni efĩle̱ mo̱bo̱ le̱, ēwo ehĩe nyam. *

english_verse: In times of trouble the wicked are destroyed, but even at death the innocent have faith.
translation_verse: Ké̱ amanehũlũ ba mofõṅ no̱ le̱, adšieo̱le̱ atſaä šĩ; ši dšalo̱ náa tšui ye̱ egbĕle mli tete.

english_verse: Wisdom is found in the minds of people with good sense, but fools don't know it.
translation_verse: Moni ko̱ö̱ sane se̱ le̱, nilē hĩo̱ etsui mli; ši kwašiai dšieo̱ noni yo̱ ame̱mli le̱ kpo.

english_verse: Doing right brings honor to a nation, but sin brings disgrace.
translation_verse: Dšale̱ wóo̱ maṅ no̱; ši eša le̱, maṅ ahorabō̱ ni.

english_verse: Kings reward servants who act wisely, but they punish those who act foolishly.
translation_verse: *Tšũlo̱ nilelo̱ le̱, maṅtše̱ hĩe so̱ö̱le̱; ši moni feo̱ hĩegbedšianii le̱, emli fũole̱. *

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Iehowa hĩṅme̱ii ye̱ hefẽhe, ni ekwe̱o̱ meifõdši ke̱ meikpakpai fẽ.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and disobey your parents. Be smart! Accept correction.
translation_verse: Bulu gbeo̱ etše̱ tšo̱semo̱ he guo̱; ši moni buo̱ kãmo̱ le̱, ehĩe tẽo̱. K.

english_verse: The poor have a hard life, but being content is as good as an endless feast.
translation_verse: Nõnalo̱ gbĩĩ fẽ le̱, gbĩĩ fõdši so̱ṅṅ ni; ši moni tšui enyõ emli le̱, dāne̱ ēye gbĩdšũrõ. K.

english_verse: A simple meal with love is better than a feast where there is hatred.
translation_verse: ſie ní suomo̱ yo̱ he le̱ ehī fè tšina ní ewo fo̱ ní nyē̱ yo̱ he.

english_verse: A lazy person refuses to clear a thorny path, but everyone who does right walks on a smooth road.
translation_verse: *Anihaolo̱ gbe̱ tamo̱ ṅmei afãbaṅ; ši dšalo̱i atempõṅ le̱, gbe̱dšegbe̱ ni. *

english_verse: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children despise them.
translation_verse: Bi nilelo̱ hãa etše̱ náa mīše̱; ši gbomo kwašia gbeo̱ enye he guo̱.

english_verse: Stupidity brings happiness to senseless fools, but everyone with good sense follows the straight path.
translation_verse: Moni be̱ yitšoṅ le̱, bulufemo̱ feo̱le̱ mīše̱; ši moni yo̱ dſẽṅmo̱ le̱, edšadšeo̱ enyiemo̱.

english_verse: Without good advice everything goes wrong— it takes careful planning for things to go right.
translation_verse: Ké̱ adšinatō be̱ le̱, yiṅtōi feo̱ yaka; ši ké̱ ṅāwolo̱i pī ye̱ le̱, ame̱damoo̱ ši šiṅṅ.

english_verse: Giving the right answer at the right time makes everyone happy.
translation_verse: Gbomo dāṅ hetō hãa enáa mīše̱, ni wiemo ní awie ye̱ be ní sa mli le̱ ehĩ pam!

english_verse: All who are wise follow a road that leads upward to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Nilelo̱i agbe̱ le̱, wala gbe̱ ní ake̱-yaä ṅwei ni, koni eke̱-dše gbohĩĩadše ní yo̱ šiši le̱ deṅ.

english_verse: The Lord hates evil thoughts, but kind words please him.
translation_verse: Iehowa mīhĩ ṅāi fõdši atō; ši wiemo̱i ní ṅõ le̱, ame̱he tše ye̱ ehĩe.

english_verse: Being greedy causes trouble for your family, but you protect yourself by refusing bribes.
translation_verse: Hĩedšōlo̱ kpãtãa ewe hĩe; ši moni nye̱o̱ nyōṅnii hemo̱ le̱, eyi aaná wala. Lal.

english_verse: Good people think before they answer, but the wicked speak evil without ever thinking.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱ tšui dſẽṅo̱ hetōhãmo̱ he; ši wiemo̱i fõdši dše̱o̱ meifõdši adāṅ.

english_verse: The Lord never even hears the prayers of the wicked, but he answers the prayers of all who obey him.
translation_verse: Iehowa ke̱ meifõdši ateṅ dšeke; ši eboo̱ dšalo̱i afaikpamo̱ toi. K.

english_verse: A friendly smile makes you happy, and good news makes you feel strong.
translation_verse: Hĩetšemo̱-ke̱-mohãmo̱ hãa tšui mī še̱o̱ ehe; *sanekpakpa hũ hãa wuiaṅ woo̱ fo̱. *

english_verse: Healthy correction is good, and if you accept it, you will be wise.
translation_verse: Toi ní boo̱ hĩekãmo̱ ní ke̱ mo yaä wala mli le̱ toi le̱, eehĩ ši ye̱ nilelo̱i ateṅ.

english_verse: You hurt only yourself by rejecting instruction, but it makes good sense to accept it.
translation_verse: Moni ekplẽẽ tšo̱semo̱ le̱, ēgbe le̱dientše̱ esusuma he guo̱; ši moni bōo̱ kāmo̱ toi le̱, enáa dſẽṅmo̱. K.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord will make you wise, and being humble will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: *Iehowa gbeyeišemo̱ dši tšo̱semo̱ ní hãa mo leo̱ nii; ni anumnyam yo̱ ne̱, †hešibā nyieo̱ hĩe. *

english_verse: When we please the Lord, even our enemies make friends with us.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši gbomo gbè̱i sa Iehowa hĩe le, ehãa ehenye̱lo̱i tete ke̱le̱ kpãtãa.

english_verse: We make our own plans, but the Lord decides where we will go.
translation_verse: Gbomo tšui too̱ egbè̱i ahe ṅã; ši Iehowa dši moni kudo̱ö̱ enanefãmo̱i le̱.

english_verse: When a ruler is happy and pleased with you, it's like refreshing rain, and you will live.
translation_verse: Maṅtše̱ hĩe ní etšeo̱ ehãa mo le̱ mli wala yo̱, ni emohe-tšuinámo̱ tamo̱ gbo oblo̱tu.

english_verse: It's much better to be wise and sensible than to be rich.
translation_verse: Ké̱ oná nilē le̱, ehĩ āhũ fè šika, ni ké̱ oná sanese̱ko̱mo̱ le̱, ehĩ fè dſie̱te̱i!

english_verse: God's people avoid evil ways, and they protect themselves by watching where they go.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱i agbe̱dšegbe̱ dši efõṅ he dšē, ni moni hĩe kã egbe̱ he le̱, ēbā esusuma yi.

english_verse: Good judgment proves that you are wise, and if you speak kindly, you can teach others.
translation_verse: Moni le nii ye̱ etsui mli le̱, aatšé̱le̱ hĩetẽlo̱, ni nāṅõmo̱ hãa nikasemo̱ ſereo̱.

english_verse: Good sense is a fountain that gives life, but fools are punished by their foolishness.
translation_verse: *Sanese̱ko̱mo̱ dši wala nubu hã moni yo̱ eko le̱; ši bului atoigblamo̱ dši ame̱bulufemo̱. *

english_verse: You can persuade others if you are wise and speak sensibly.
translation_verse: Nilelo̱ tšui tšõo̱ edā nii, ni ehãa enabu nitšõmo̱ le̱ fáa.

english_verse: Kind words are like honey— they cheer you up and make you feel strong.
translation_verse: Nādšo̱le̱ wiemoi tamo wò-agbaku, ame̱ṅõ susuma nā, ni ame̱hãa wui náa hewale̱.

english_verse: Sometimes what seems right is really a road to death.
translation_verse: Gbe̱ ko ye̱ ní dša ye̱ gbomo hĩe, ši enāgbë le̱, gbĕle gbè̱i ni.

english_verse: The hungrier you are, the harder you work.
translation_verse: Nitšulo̱ le̱ hõmo̱ ní yeo̱le̱ le̱ waäle̱ ke̱-tšuo̱ nii, edšake̱ edā tšire̱o̱ eyise̱.

english_verse: Worthless people plan trouble. Even their words burn like a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Yakagbomo tšaä efõṅ, ni enābu tamo̱ la ní šãa mo.

english_verse: Gossip is no good! It causes hard feelings and comes between friends.
translation_verse: Kũtũmpo̱fo gbe̱o̱ béi eſãa, ni able̱bi-wielo̱ tsere̱o̱ šientše̱mei ateṅ.

english_verse: When someone winks or grins behind your back, trouble is on the way.
translation_verse: Moni mĩaä ehĩṅme̱ii le̱, etoo̱ nii fõdši ahe ṅā; moni kõo̱ enā ablafa le̱, ehãa efõṅ baä mli.

english_verse: Gray hair is a glorious crown worn by those who have lived right.
translation_verse: Waṅ le̱, anumnyam akekre ni, ké̱ anale̱ ye̱ dšale̱ gbe̱ no̱ le̱.

english_verse: Controlling your temper is better than being a hero who captures a city.
translation_verse: Moni mli fũũ mrā le̱ ehĩ fè ekãlo̱, ni moni yeo̱ emumo̱ no̱ le̱ ehĩ fè moni wuo̱ heo̱ maṅ.

english_verse: We make our own decisions, but the Lord alone determines what happens.
translation_verse: Ošiki le̱, ſuo̱ no̱ afõo̱ ye̱; ši bo̱ni enā aayakpa fẽ le̱, Iehowa ṅõ edše̱o̱.

english_verse: A wise slave will be placed in charge of a no-good child, and that slave will be given the same inheritance that each child receives.
translation_verse: Tšulo̱ ní le nii le̱ eeye bi ní feo̱ hīegbedšianii le̱ no̱, ni eke̱ nyemimei le̱ aadša gbošinii.

english_verse: Silver and gold are tested by flames of fire; our thoughts are tested by the Lord.
translation_verse: Niiahetšūmo̱ kukwe̱i le̱, eye̱ hã dſie̱te̱i, ni flõnõ ye̱ hã šika; ši Iehowa dši moni kaä tšuii ekwe̱o̱. Lal.

english_verse: It sounds strange for a fool to talk sensibly, but it's even worse for a ruler to tell lies.
translation_verse: Wiemoi wudši esaa kwašia, blo̱blo̱ ní apasa nābu aasa ablade.

english_verse: A bribe works miracles like a magic charm that brings good luck.
translation_verse: Nõkēnõ tamo te̱ ní dšra wa ye̱ moni náa le̱ hĩe; hefẽhe ní etšṍo le, eſereo̱.

english_verse: You will keep your friends if you forgive them, but you will lose your friends if you keep talking about what they did wrong.
translation_verse: Moni tsĩmoo̱ no̱tome̱ no̱ le̱, ētao suomo̱; ši moni tĩo̱ sane mli le̱, etšere̱o̱ sientše̱mei ateṅ.

english_verse: Cruel people want to rebel, and so vicious attackers will be sent against them.
translation_verse: Atüatšemo̱ ke̱ke̱ efõṅfelo̱ taoo̱, nohewo̱ le̱ bo̱fo yiwalo̱ aatšũ ke̱-ba eno̱.

english_verse: A bear robbed of her cubs is far less dangerous than a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Hã osišibriši ní amõ ebi ke̱ gbomo akpe moṅ, fè kwašia ye̱ ebulufemo̱ mli.

english_verse: The start of an argument is like a water leak— so stop it before real trouble breaks out.
translation_verse: Béi bõimo̱ tamo nu ní afã nā; nohewo̱ le̱ ni nātāmo̱ le̱ mli wako ne̱, ṅmẽmo̱ he!

english_verse: A friend is there to help, in any situation, and relatives are born to share our troubles.
translation_verse: Nanyo sumoo̱ mo bei fẽ mli, ni afo̱le̱ ake̱ nyemi hã haomo̱be.

english_verse: It's stupid to guarantee someone else's loan.
translation_verse: Moni be̱ yitšoṅ le̱, le̱ etaä dẽ, ni edamoo̱ enanyo se̱.

english_verse: Dishonesty does you no good, and telling lies will get you in trouble.
translation_verse: Moni yo̱ kũtũmpo̱o tšui le̱, ehĩṅ hãṅle̱, ni moni lile̱i tšṍmoo̱ le̱, egbēo̱ efõṅ mli.

english_verse: If you are cheerful, you feel good; if you are sad, you hurt all over.
translation_verse: Tšuidšũrõ le̱, tšofā kpakpa ni; ši ṅko̱mo̱yeli mumo̱ le̱, ehãa mo wuiaṅ gbĩo̱.

english_verse: Crooks accept secret bribes to keep justice from being done.
translation_verse: Efõṅfelo̱ heo̱ nikēnii ke̱-dše̱o̱ mo mīnā ní eke̱-tšṍ kodšomo̱ hĩe ebu ši.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom knows what makes good sense, but fools can never make up their minds.
translation_verse: Moni ko̱ö̱ sane se̱ le̱, nilē kā ehĩe; ši kwašia hĩṅme̱ii kāmo̱ dšeṅ nāgbèhe le̱.

english_verse: Foolish children bring sorrow and pain to their parents.
translation_verse: Bi kwašia le̱, etše̱ aw̌ere̱hō dšile̱ ke̱ yō ní fo̱le̱ le̱ tšuiyeli. K.

english_verse: It isn't fair to punish the innocent and those who do right.
translation_verse: Ehĩĩ ake̱ agbla dšalo̱ toi, lo ní ayi abladei ye̱ dšale̱ sane hewo.

english_verse: It makes a lot of sense to be a person of few words and to stay calm.
translation_verse: Moni wiemo̱ ekaa le̱, ele nii, ni moni mumo̱ he dšo̱ le̱, le̱ dši moni ko̱ö̱ sane se̱,

english_verse: Even fools seem smart when they are quiet.
translation_verse: Bulu tete, ké̱ ebu enā le̱, abuo̱le̱ nilelo̱, ni moni mūaä enā le̱, abuo̱le̱ hĩetẽlo̱. Hiob

english_verse: Foolish talk will get you into a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Kwašia nābu woo̱ béi, ni edā tšé̱o̱ mãi ke̱-baä.

english_verse: Saying foolish things is like setting a trap to destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Kwašia dā dši noni kpãtãa eble, ni enābu dši esusuma tšõne.

english_verse: There's nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Able̱biwielo̱ wiemo̱i tamo̱ do̱ko̱do̱ko̱nii, ni ame̱kplekeo̱ ši ke̱-yaä mũsũṅ piai le̱ amli.

english_verse: Being lazy is no different from being a troublemaker.
translation_verse: Mo hũ ní ṅõo̱ enitšumo̱ ešašaoo̱ ši le̱, nii fitelo̱ kpeteṅkple nyemi dšile̱.

english_verse: Everyone with good sense wants to learn.
translation_verse: Hĩetẽlo̱ tšui náa nilē, ni nilelo̱ toi taoo̱ nilē se̱gbe̱.

english_verse: You may think you have won your case in court, until your opponent speaks.
translation_verse: Mo kleṅkleṅ ní badšadšeo̱ esane le̱, efeo̱ tamo̱ noni esane dša; ši ké̱ enanyo le̱ ba le̱, ebakpaäle̱ ši.

english_verse: Drawing straws is one way to settle a difficult case.
translation_verse: Ošiki *hãa béi se̱ foo̱, ni egblaä kãkãlo̱i ateṅ. *

english_verse: Make your words good— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Gbomo dāṅ yibii aayi emũsũ obō, ní enābu nibanii le̱ aahã eto̱.

english_verse: Words can bring death or life! Talk too much, and you will eat everything you say.
translation_verse: Gbĕle ke̱ wala ye̱ lile̱i deṅ, ni mei ní sumoo̱le̱ le̱, ame̱aye eyibii le̱ eko.

english_verse: A man's greatest treasure is his wife— she is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Moni aaná ṅã le̱, ena nõkpakpa, ni ehĩe aaba nyam ye̱ Iehowa hĩe.

english_verse: The poor must beg for help, but the rich can give a harsh reply.
translation_verse: Ohĩafo le̱, fai ekpaä; ši niiatše̱ le̱, mo ebuaä.

english_verse: Some friends don't help, but a true friend is closer than your own family.
translation_verse: Moni bo̱ö̱ nanemei pī le̱, ekã amane gbe̱; ši nanyo ko ye̱ ní kpe̱te̱o̱ mo gbãgbãlī fè nyemi.

english_verse: Dishonest witnesses and liars won't escape punishment.
translation_verse: Amale odasefonyo le̱, eyeṅ ehe, ni moni maleo̱ le, edšeṅ mli. K.

english_verse: If you are poor, your own relatives reject you, and your friends are worse. When you really need them, they are not there.
translation_verse: Ohĩafo le̱, enyemimei fẽ nye̱o̱le̱, blo̱blo̱ ní enanemei ní tšeṅ ame̱he ke̱-yaṅ se̱ fle̱ṅṅ? enyieo̱ ame̱se̱ ke̱ wiemo̱i, ši enaa-ame̱. K.

english_verse: Do yourself a favor by having good sense— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Moni náa yitšoṅ le̱, ēsumo̱ esusuma; moni mõo̱ sanese̱ko̱mo̱ mli le̱, aahĩ ahãle̱.

english_verse: An angry king roars like a lion, but when a king is pleased, it's like dew on the crops.
translation_verse: Maṅtše̱ mlifũ tamo̱ dšatahũmo̱; ši emohe-tšuinámo̱ tamo̱ bó̱ ní dſere dſe̱i ano̱.

english_verse: Caring for the poor is lending to the Lord, and you will be well repaid.
translation_verse: Moni naä ohĩafo mo̱bo̱ le̱, eke̱mīfa Iehowa; ni noni eṅõ-hãle̱ le̱, eetole̱ nãdšiaṅ ekoṅ.

english_verse: Correct your children before it's too late; if you don't punish them, trouble will come their way.
translation_verse: Yi obi, beni hĩeno̱kãmo̱ yo̱ le̱; ši kāhã eba oyiṅ ake̱ oogbele̱. Ef.

english_verse: People with bad tempers are always in trouble, and they need help over and over again.
translation_verse: Moni mlifũ fá le̱, eená mli nyõmo̱wo; edšake̱ ké̱ odšiele̱ le̱, dša okũ se̱ odsiele̱ ekoṅ.

english_verse: Pay attention to advice and accept correction, so you can live sensibly.
translation_verse: Bo ṅāwō toi, ni okplẽ tšo̱semo̱, koni wó̱se̱ ní ole nii.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord brings true life— if you do it, you can relax without fear of danger.
translation_verse: Iehowa gbeyeišemo̱ ke̱ mo yaä wala mli; moni nine eše̱ ne̱ le̱, eeto̱ ke̱-awo̱, efõṅ ebasraṅle̱.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to lift a hand to feed themselves.
translation_verse: Anihaolo̱ ṅõo̱ enine etšo̱ö̱ kā mli, ni emĩĩ ní eke̱-wo edāṅ tete.

english_verse: Stupid fools learn good sense by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being corrected.
translation_verse: Tſa hefe̱oyelo̱ nõ, ni moni náko dſẽṅmo̱ le̱ hĩe aatẽ; kã sanese̱ko̱lo̱ hĩe, ni eele nii.

english_verse: If you stop learning, you will forget what you already know.
translation_verse: Mibi, fõmo̱ tšo̱semo̱ ní hãa adũo̱ gbe̱ ke-dšeo nilē wiemoi le̱ ahe le̱ toibō! Iak.

english_verse: A lying witness makes fun of the court system, and criminals think crime is really delicious.
translation_verse: Odasefonyo gbonyo ṅmõo̱ kodšomo̱, ni efõṅfelo̱i adā mĩo̱ nõša.

english_verse: A stupid fool should expect to be punished.
translation_verse: Asā kodšomo̱i ato hefe̱oyelo̱i, ke̱ kpãi hũ ato kwašiai akotose̱.

english_verse: Good people live right, and God blesses the children who follow their example.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱ ní nyieo̱ emũyeli mli le̱, adšō̱o̱ ebii ye̱ ese.

english_verse: Everyone likes to brag about getting a bargain.
translation_verse: Moni heo̱ nii ke̱o̱ ake̱: Ehĩĩ, ehĩĩ! ši ké̱ eyi gbe̱ pe̱ le̱, ēſã.

english_verse: Sensible words are better than gold or jewels.
translation_verse: Šika ye̱, ke̱ tẽṅẽlẽoi babaō; ši nilē nābu le̱, dſine ní dšra wa ni.

english_verse: Children who curse their parents will go to the land of darkness long before their time.
translation_verse: Moni lomoo̱ etše̱ ke̱ enye le̱, aagbe ekane le̱ ye̱ duṅ kpī mli.

english_verse: Getting rich quick may turn out to be a curse.
translation_verse: Gbošinii ní aha gidigidi ye̱ šišidšē mli le̱, enāgbē le̱, dšō̱mo̱ baṅ no̱.

english_verse: Don't try to get even. Trust the Lord, and he will help you.
translation_verse: Kãkē̱ ake̱: Mato efõṅ nãdšiaṅ! Mẽ Iehowa, ni eehere oyiwala.

english_verse: The Lord hates dishonest scales and dishonest weights. So don't cheat!
translation_verse: Niṅmē̃nii sro̱toi le̱, Iehowa mīhĩ, ni šišiumo̱ nsẽni le̱ ehĩĩ. K.

english_verse: How can we know what will happen to us when the Lord alone decides?
translation_verse: Gbomo nãdšifãmo̱i le̱, Iehowa deṅ dše̱o̱; ši gbomo le̱, té aafe tēṅ ni eele egbe̱ le̱?

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of making promises to God before you think!
translation_verse: Edši tšõne hã gbomo, ake̱ eeša he ekē̱ ake̱: Nõkroṅkroṅ ni! ni šiwō le̱ se̱ le̱ kpako dãni edſẽṅo̱ he.

english_verse: A wise ruler severely punishes every criminal.
translation_verse: Maṅtše̱ nilelo̱ gbe̱o̱ efõṅſelo̱i eſãa, ni eke̱ ſīli-nane tšṍo̱ ame̱no̱. Lal.

english_verse: Our inner thoughts are a lamp from the Lord, and they search our hearts.
translation_verse: Iehowa kane dši gbomo *mumo̱, ekpaä mũsũṅ piai le̱ fẽ mli ekwe̱o. *

english_verse: Rulers are protected by God's mercy and loyalty, but they must be merciful for their kingdoms to last.
translation_verse: Mo̱bo̱nale̱ ke̱ ano̱kwale bāa maṅtše̱ yi, ni mo̱bo̱nale̱ noṅṅ waoo̱ emaṅtše̱sẽi le̱.

english_verse: Young people take pride in their strength, but the gray hairs of wisdom are even more beautiful.
translation_verse: Oblahĩĩ anumnyam dši ame̱hewale̱, ni hĩĩmedši ahefe̱o dši *ame̱wadsi le̱, *

english_verse: A severe beating can knock all of the evil out of you!
translation_verse: Kpãi ní pilaä mo le̱, etšumoo̱ efõṅ, ni yī še̱o̱ mũsũṅ piai le̱ amli.

english_verse: Cheating to get rich is a foolish dream and no less than suicide.
translation_verse: Dſetrii ní ake̱ apasa lile̱i náa le̱, lamo̱ ní hoo̱ ni, ni mei ní taoo̱ le̱, gbĕle ame̱taoo̱ le̱.

english_verse: You destroy yourself by being cruel and violent and refusing to live right.
translation_verse: Efõṅſelo̱i amimyeli lōo̱ame̱ ke̱-yaä, edšake̱ ame̱kplẽẽ dšale̱ saneyeli.

english_verse: God is always fair! He knows what the wicked do and will punish them.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱ le̱ kwe̱o̱ mofõṅ we le̱, bo̱ni abutuo̱ meifõdši, ni ame̱hĩe kpãtãa le̱.

english_verse: A secret bribe will save you from someone's fierce anger.
translation_verse: Dudšiaṅ nikēnii kpãtãa mlifũ, ní nyōṅnii ni ho̱ mīnā le̱ ekpãtãa mlila ni nā wa.

english_verse: When justice is done, good citizens are glad and crooks are terrified.
translation_verse: Efeo̱ dšalo̱ mīše̱ ake̱ eeye dšale̱ sane, ši mei ní tšuo̱ nišaianii le̱, efeo̱-ame̱ gbeyei.

english_verse: Be sensible and store up precious treasures— don't waste them like a fool.
translation_verse: Dſetri ni dšra wa ke̱ mũ ye̱ nilelo̱ šihĩle̱he; ši kwašia le̱, kpãtãmo̱ ekpãtãa hĩe.

english_verse: If you try to be kind and good, you will be blessed with life and goodness and honor.
translation_verse: Moni nyieo̱ dšale̱ ke̱ mo̱bo̱nale̱ se̱ le̱, enaa wala, dšale̱ ke̱ hĩenyam.

english_verse: One wise person can defeat a city full of soldiers and capture their fortress.
translation_verse: Nilelo̱ kwo̱ö̱ ekãlo̱i amaṅ le̱, ni etšio̱ hewale̱ ní ame̱hĩe kã no̱ le̱ etſaä ši.

english_verse: Watching what you say can save you a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Moni mõo̱ enābu ke̱ elile̱i mli le̱, ebaa esusuma yi ke̱-dše̱o haomo̱i amli.

english_verse: If you are proud and conceited, everyone will say, “You're a snob!”
translation_verse: Moni woo̱ ehe ni etšṍo̱ ehe le̱, egbe̱i dši hefe̱oyelo̱, efeo̱ enii hewō ke̱ heno̱wómo̱ mli.

english_verse: But people who obey God are always generous.
translation_verse: Dā dsenamo̱ ne̱ fẽ le̱ taomo̱ ke̱ke̱ etaoo; ši dšalo̱ le̱ ehãa, ni ekãmãã.

english_verse: The Lord despises the offerings of wicked people with evil motives.
translation_verse: Efõṅfelo̱i afole le̱ nihĩnii ni, āhũ ní eke̱-ba ye̱ dſẽṅmo̱ fõṅ mli!

english_verse: If you tell lies in court, you are done for; only a reliable witness can do the job.
translation_verse: *Amale odasefonyo hĩe aakpãtã; ši moni boo̱ sane toi le̱, ehãa ewieo̱ dā. *

english_verse: Wicked people bluff their way, but God's people think before they take a step.
translation_verse: Gbomo fõṅ hãa ehĩe waä; ši dšalo̱ le̱, esaa egbè̱i.

english_verse: No matter how much you know or what plans you make, you can't defeat the Lord.
translation_verse: Nilē lo sanese̱ko̱mo̱ lo adšina ko be̱ ní ke̱ Iehowa aaši mple. Lal.

english_verse: The poor are ruled by the rich, and those who borrow are slaves of moneylenders.
translation_verse: Niiatše̱ yeo̱ ohĩafoi ano̱, ni nifalo̱ le̱, moni fale̱ le̱ tšũlo̱ dšile̱.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who shows good sense, but he frustrates the plans of deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Iehowa hĩṅme̱ii bāa nilē yi, ni etsṍmoo̱ kũtũmpo̱fo wiemo̱i ahĩe ebumoo̱ ši.

english_verse: Don't be so lazy that you say, “If I go to work, a lion will eat me!”
translation_verse: Anihaolo̱ kē̱o̱ ake̱: Dšata ye̱ agbo le̱ nā; aagbemi ye̱ blohũi le̱ amli!

english_verse: All children are foolish, but firm correction will make them change.
translation_verse: Bulufemo̱ kpe̱te̱ gbekẽ tšui he; ši tšo̱semo̱ tšo le̱ aaſiele̱ ke̱-adše̱ ehe ke̱-ate flōflo.

english_verse: Cheat the poor to make profit or give gifts to the rich— either way you lose. Thirty Wise Sayings
translation_verse: Moni yeo̱ ohĩafo w̌ei ní eke̱-ná nii, ke̱ moni hãa niiatše̱ nii le̱, ohĩa kẽ bahĩale̱.

english_verse: You will be glad that you know these sayings and can recite them.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ké̱ oke̱-to omli, ni afĩ akpe̱te̱ onābu le̱, eye̱ fe̱o.

english_verse: I am teaching them today, so that you may trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Beni afe ní ohĩe akã Iehowa no̱ hewo̱ le̱, mītšõo nii ṅme̱ne̱, bo ní dši bo.

english_verse: I have written thirty sayings filled with sound advice.
translation_verse: Ani miṅmãko ṅāwō ke̱ nilē he nibii ni be dšraä mihãkoö,

english_verse: Don't make friends with anyone who has a bad temper.
translation_verse: Oke̱ mlifũtše̱ akabo̱ nanyo, ni oke̱ mlilatše̱ akanyie,

english_verse: You might turn out like them and get caught in a trap. –
translation_verse: koni okakase egbè̱i le̱, ní oná tšõne ohã osusuma.

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker set up by your ancestors. –
translation_verse: Kātši blema šikpoṅ-hũsũ ní otše̱mei le̱ ekadi efõ ši le̱!

english_verse: If you do your job well, you will work for a ruler and never be a slave.
translation_verse: Ké̱ ona nū ní bo̱ö̱ mo̱deṅ ye̱ enitšumo̱ mli le̱, maṅtše̱mei ahĩe tete eedamo; edamo̱ṅ mei ní abuuame̱ ahĩe.

english_verse: Don't accept an invitation to eat a selfish person's food, no matter how good it is.
translation_verse: Moni yo̱ hĩṅme̱i ša le̱, kāye edeṅ abolo, ni kāhã edo̱ko̱doko̱nii le̱ mība otšine.

english_verse: Don't go and stuff yourself! That would be just the same as cutting your throat.
translation_verse: ni oke̱ kakla awo osẽṅ, ké̱ odši moko ní sẽṅ ṅõle̱ le̱.

english_verse: Don't be greedy for all of that fancy food! It may not be so tasty. –
translation_verse: Kāhã edo̱ko̱do̱ko̱nii le̱ mība otšine; edšake̱ niyenii ní lakaä mo ni.

english_verse: Give up trying so hard to get rich.
translation_verse: Kāgbo deṅme oke̱-tao nii, ṅmẽmo̱ bodientše̱ onilẽ ne̱ he.

english_verse: Listen to me, my children! Be wise and have enough sense to follow the right path.
translation_verse: Bo le̱, bo toi, mibi, ni ole nii, ni ohã otšui anyie gbe̱ le̱ no̱ tē̃.

english_verse: Invest in truth and wisdom, discipline and good sense, and don't part with them.
translation_verse: Hemo̱ ano̱kwale, ni okahō, ke̱ nilē ke̱ tšo̱semo̱ ke̱ sanese̱ko̱mo̱.

english_verse: Make your father truly happy by living right and showing sound judgment.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱ tše̱ aanyá babaō; ni moni fo̱ö̱ bi nilelo̱ le̱, emī aaše̱ ehe ye̱ ehewo̱.

english_verse: Make your parents proud, especially your mother. –
translation_verse: Hã otše̱ ke̱ onye mī aše̱ amehe, ni moni fo̱o le̱ hũ anyã́.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention, and gladly follow my example.
translation_verse: Mibi, ṅõ otšui ohãmi, ni ohã migbè̱i le̱ asa ohĩe!

english_verse: Bad women and unfaithful wives are like a deep pit—
translation_verse: Edšake̱ yō adſamaṅ le̱, bu kwo̱ṅkwo̱ṅ ni, ni mokroko ṅã le̱, bu kplokotõ ni.

english_verse: they are waiting to attack you like a gang of robbers with victim after victim. –
translation_verse: Ewoo ká tamo̱ odšotſalo̱, ni ehãa kũtũmpo̱foi ayi fáa ye̱ gbomei ateṅ.

english_verse: Who is always in trouble? Who argues and fights? Who has cuts and bruises? Whose eyes are red?
translation_verse: Namo naä nõ? namo náa haomo̱? namo náa béi? namo náa ṅko̱mo̱yeli? namo náa pilamo̱i yakatſā? namo náa hĩṅme̱ii ni etšu fā?

english_verse: Don't even look at that colorful stuff bubbling up in the glass! It goes down so easily,
translation_verse: Kākwe̱ wein bo̱ni etšu fā le̱, bo̱ni ehĩe yo̱ fe̱o ye̱ kpulu le̱ mli le̱, bo̱ni eyaä kpo le̱;

english_verse: but later it bites like a poisonous snake.
translation_verse: ké̱ fe se̱ le̱ ekõo̱ mo tamo̱ onũfũ, ni efẽo̱ mo tamo̱ blikã.

english_verse: You will see weird things, and your mind will play tricks on you.
translation_verse: Ohĩṅme̱ii aakwe̱ yei krokomei, ni otšui aawie nibii gbohĩĩ.

english_verse: You will feel tossed about like someone trying to sleep on a ship in a storm.
translation_verse: Ni ootšṍ tamo̱ moni kã ṅšo̱ teṅ, lo tamo̱ moni kã le̱le̱ṅtšo yiteṅ.

english_verse: You will be bruised all over, without even remembering how it all happened. And you will lie awake asking, “When will morning come, so I can drink some more?”
translation_verse: Ookē̱ ake̱: “Ame̱tſiami nii, ši ewaa mihe; ame̱yimi, ši minuu he. *Té be ní mihĩe aatšẽṅ? matao se̱gbe̱ ekoṅ kẽ!” *Ies.

english_verse: My children, you must respect the Lord and the king, and you must not make friends with anyone who rebels against either of them.
translation_verse: Mibi, še Iehowa gbeyei, ke̱ maṅtše̱ hũ; oke ohe akaho atũatšeloi ahe.

english_verse: If you let the guilty go free, people of all nations will hate and curse you.
translation_verse: Moni kē̱o̱ efõṅfelo̱ ake̱: “Dšalo̱ dšio!” le̱, maṅ aalomo̱le̱, mãdšimãdšĩ aanyãṅele̱.

english_verse: But if you punish the guilty, things will go well for you, and you will prosper.
translation_verse: Šĩ mei ní kodšoo̱ ye̱ dšale̱ nā le̱, aahĩ ahãame̱, ni dšō̱mo̱ kpakpa aaba ame̱no̱.

english_verse: Don't say, “I didn't know it!” God can read your mind. He watches each of us and knows our thoughts. And God will pay us back for what we do. –
translation_verse: Ke̱dši okē̱ ake̱: “Na, wo̱lee ene̱ le̱!” Ani *moni ṅmẽo̱ tšuii ekwe̱o̱ le̱ dſēṅṅ no̱? ni moni bāa osusuma yi le̱, ani elee? ni †eewo mofẽmo nyõmo̱ ye̱ enitšumo̱ nā? *

english_verse: Giving an honest answer is a sign of true friendship.
translation_verse: Moni hãa hetō ní dša le̱, etamo̱ moni ſo̱ö̱ onā.

english_verse: Wisdom is like honey for your life— if you find it, your future is bright. –
translation_verse: Nakai noṅṅ okase nilē ohã osusuma; ké̱ oná le̱, *aahĩ ahão wó̱se̱, ni ohĩeno̱kãmo̱ le̱ efeṅ yaka. *

english_verse: Get your fields ready and plant your crops before starting a home.
