translation_verse: Sāmo̱ onitsumo̱ ye̱ agbó nā, ni ofele̱ klalo ohã ohe ye̱ ṅmõši; no se̱ dãni omã otšũ.

english_verse: Even if good people fall seven times, they will get back up. But when trouble strikes the wicked, that's the end of them. –
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *dšalo̱ gbēo̱ ši šii kpawo ni eteo̱ ši ekoṅ; ši efõṅſelo̱i gbēo̱ ši kwrā, ké̱ amanehũlũ ba le̱. *Hiob

english_verse: Don't accuse anyone who isn't guilty. Don't ever tell a lie
translation_verse: Kāye odase ošĩ onanyo yakatſā, ni oke̱ onābu hũ akašišiu moko.

english_verse: The Lord will find out and be unhappy. Then he will stop being angry with them. –
translation_verse: ni Iehowa mina, ni ēdo̱le̱, ní edšie emlifũ le̱ ye̱ eno̱.

english_verse: or say to someone, “I'll get even with you!”
translation_verse: Kākē̱ ake̱: Mafele̱ bo̱ni efemi le̱; mawo nū le̱ nyõmo̱ ye̱ enitšumo̱ le̱ nā!

english_verse: I once walked by the field and the vineyard of a lazy fool.
translation_verse: Mitšṍ anihaolo̱ ṅmõ le̱ ke̱ gbomo ní be̱ yitšoṅ le̱ weintrom le̱ he;

english_verse: Thorns and weeds were everywhere, and the stone wall had fallen down.
translation_verse: ni na, eno̱ fẽ etai ke̱ opīa, ni sansrõ so̱ṅṅ eha hĩe, ni ehe te̱-gbogbo le̱ ekũmo̱ eſie ši.

english_verse: When I saw this, it taught me a lesson:
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mi mikwe̱ gā̃, ni midſẽṅ he dšogbāṅ; mikwe̱, ni miná tšo̱semo̱ ye̱ mli.

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: Mawo̱ fio, madšie mĩhĩese̱ flō, makota minidši mawo̱ fiō;

english_verse: Suddenly poverty hits you and everything is gone!
translation_verse: no koni ohĩa le̱ aaba tamo̱ odšo-tſalo̱, ke̱ ofĩmo̱ hũ tamo̱ nū ni hĩe tše̱ṅ.

english_verse: Who can fully understand the thoughts of a ruler? They reach beyond the sky and go deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni ṅwei kwo̱ ni šikpoṅ hũ mli kwo̱ le̱, nakai maṅtše̱mei atšui hũ, ehĩĩ mlitaomo̱.

english_verse: Silver must be purified before it can be used to make something of value.
translation_verse: Dšĩemo̱ dſie̱te̱ifei le̱ ke̱-dše̱ dſie̱te̱i le̱ mli, ni ebatšṍ dſine ye̱ niſielo̱ le̱ deṅ.

english_verse: Don't try to seem important in the court of a ruler.
translation_verse: Kāwo ohĩe nyam ye̱ maṅtše̱ hĩe, ni kādamo̱ gbomei agboi agbe̱he.

english_verse: before you sue someone, or you might lose your case and be embarrassed.
translation_verse: Kādše kpo kplakpla ke̱-miya béi; no le̱ enāgbē mli, beni onanyo le̱ ewoö hĩegbële le̱, té obafe tẽṅ?

english_verse: Others will find out, and your reputation will then be ruined.
translation_verse: Koni moni akanu he, ní ebo̱o ahora, ní ogbe̱i fõṅ le̱ mīka ohe.

english_verse: A messenger you can trust is just as refreshing as cool water in summer.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni snō mli dso̱ö̱ ṅãnī ye̱ nikpamo̱be mli le̱, nakai dši bo̱fo ano̱kwafo hã mei ni tšũle̱ le̱, ehãa enuṅtšo̱mei le̱ atšui nyõo̱ ame̱mli.

english_verse: Broken promises are worse than rain clouds that don't bring rain.
translation_verse: Moni ſãa fõo̱ amale nikēnii ano̱ le̱, etamo̱ oblo̱tu ke̱ kō̱yo̱ ni nyoṅmo̱ne̱mo̱ be̱ mli.

english_verse: Eating too much honey can make you sick.
translation_verse: Ké̱ ona wò le̱, ye bo̱ni aaše̱ onā, koni ekadšieo, ní oſe oſie.

english_verse: Don't visit friends too often, or they will get tired of it and start hating you.
translation_verse: Onane akafo onanyo we ſe̱mo̱, ni osane mīdše etšĩne, ni ehe mītšẽo.

english_verse: Telling lies about friends is like attacking them with clubs and swords and sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Moni yeo̱ enanyo he amale odase le̱, etamo̱ tšokpoti ke̱ klante ke̱ gãimlibi ní nā ba.

english_verse: This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads. And the Lord will reward you.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ṅãi-ke̱-la nā obuaä oſieo̱ eyiteṅ le̱, ni Iehowa aawoö he nyõmo̱.

english_verse: As surely as rain blows in from the north, anger is caused by cruel words.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni kõyigbe̱ kō̱yo̱ ke̱ nyoṅmo̱ne̱mo̱ baä le̱, nakai noṅṅ mohewiemo̱ lile̱i ke̱ hĩetũmo̱ baä.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Fáṅ noni oyabi tšũyiteṅ kpokplobiiaṅ fè noni oke̱ yō hebéilo̱ aahĩ šīa kome.

english_verse: Good news from far away refreshes like cold water when you are thirsty.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni nuhō̃ṅ yo̱ ha susuma ní kũ-mai yeo̱le̱ le̱, nakai dši sanekpakpa nī ake̱-dše̱ maṅse̱ šoṅṅ le̱.

english_verse: When a good person gives in to the wicked, it's like dumping garbage in a stream of clear water.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni nuhĩṅme̱i ní anyie mli ke̱ nubu ni afitele̱ yo̱ le̱, nakai dšalo̱ ní didãa ye̱ mofõṅ hĩe yo̱.

english_verse: Don't eat too much honey or always want praise.
translation_verse: Wò babaō yeli ehĩĩ, ni nii ní wa tšṍ mlitaomo̱ le̱ ewa.

english_verse: Losing self-control leaves you as helpless as a city without a wall.
translation_verse: Moni nyẽẽ emumo̱ no eye le̱, etamo̱ maṅ ni akũmo̱ ní gbogbo be he.

english_verse: Don't make a fool of yourself by answering a fool.
translation_verse: Kāhã kwašia hetō ye̱ ebulufemo̱ le̱ na, koni bo hũ okatšṍ tamo̱le̱.

english_verse: But if you answer any fools, show how foolish they are, so they won't feel smart.
translation_verse: Hã kwašia hetō ye̱ ebulufemo̱ le̱ nā, koni ekabu ehe nilelo̱.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who says, “I'm really smart!”
translation_verse: Ké̱ ona gbomo ní buo̱ ehe nilelo̱ le̱, hĩeno̱kãmo̱ ye̱ hã kwašia fèle̱.

english_verse: A door turns on its hinges, but a lazy person just turns over in bed.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni šĩnā tšṍmoo̱ ye̱ ese̱ sai ano̱ le̱, nakai anihaolo̱ le̱ tšṍmoo̱ ehe ye̱ esa no̱.

english_verse: It's better to take hold of a mad dog by the ears than to take part in someone else's argument.
translation_verse: Moni ke̱ ehe woo̱ béi ko ní dšee enõ mli le̱, etamo̱ moko ní mõmoo̱ gbé ní hoo̱ toii amli.

english_verse: than to cheat someone and say, “I was only fooling!”
translation_verse: nakai dši nū ní šišiuo̱ enanyo ni ekē̱o̱ ake̱: ſe̱ ke̱ke̱ miſe̱o̱! le̱.

english_verse: Where there is no fuel a fire goes out; where there is no gossip arguments come to an end.
translation_verse: Ké̱ lai tã le̱, la gboo̱, ni ké̱ able̱biwielo̱ be̱ le̱, béi se̱ foo̱.

english_verse: Troublemakers start trouble, just as sparks and fuel start a fire.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni ṅãi yo̱ hã lasrẽmi ni lai yo̱ hã la le̱, nakai noṅṅ hebéilo̱ hãa béi mli waä.

english_verse: There is nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Able̱biwíelo̱ wiemo̱i tamo do̱ko̱do̱ko̱nii, ši ame̱kplekeo̱ ši ke̱-yaä mũsũṅ piai le̱ amli.

english_verse: Hiding hateful thoughts behind smooth talk is like coating a clay pot with a cheap glaze.
translation_verse: Nābu dšũrõ ke̱ tšui fõṅ le̱, etamo̱ ṅe̱sũkó ní ake̱ dſie̱te̱i eha he.

english_verse: The pleasant talk of an enemy hides more evil plans
translation_verse: Nye̱lo̱ ke̱ enābu sāa ehe, ši emli-gbe̱ le̱ eke̱ apasa too̱.

english_verse: than can be counted— so don't believe a word!
translation_verse: Ké̱ ewie do̱ko̱bī le̱, kāhele̱ oye; edšake̱ nihĩnii kpawo so̱ṅṅ ye̱ etšui mli.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you will fall in; if you start a stone rolling, it will roll back on you.
translation_verse: Moni dšeo̱ bu le̱, le̱ noṅṅ eegbē mli, ni moni kokloo̱ te̱ le̱, le̱ noṅṅ eno̱ eekũ se̱ egbē. Lal.

english_verse: Watch out for anyone who tells lies and flatters— they are out to get you.
translation_verse: Amale lile̱i nye̱o̱ mei ní epilaame̱ le̱, ni nādo̱ko̱mo̱ dā ke̱ šigbēmo̱ baä.

english_verse: An angry person is dangerous, but a jealous person is even worse.
translation_verse: Mlila yi wa, ni mlifũ le̱, fā ní yio̱ ni; ši namo aanyẽ awuṅãyeli hĩe adamo̱?

english_verse: A truly good friend will openly correct you.
translation_verse: Faṅṅ kãmo̱ hĩ fè suomo̱ ní aṅõ-tē.

english_verse: The sweet smell of incense can make you feel good, but true friendship is better still.
translation_verse: Mũ ke̱ tšofã-ke̱-ṅma hãa tšui mī še̱o̱ ehe, ni gbomo nanyo ṅõ fè le̱dientše̱ etsui mli ṅāwō.

english_verse: Don't desert an old friend of your family or visit your relatives when you are in trouble. A friend nearby is better than relatives far away.
translation_verse: Kākwa bodientše̱ onanyo ke̱ otše̱ nanyo, ni ofĩmo̱ gbĩ no̱ le̱ *kāya onyemi we; ohegbomo ní be̱ṅke̱o le̱ ehĩ āhũ fè onyemi ní yo̱ šoṅṅ. *

english_verse: My child, show good sense! Then I will be happy and able to answer anyone who criticizes me.
translation_verse: Mibi, femo̱ ohe nilelo̱, ni ohã mitsui anyõ mimli, ni maná hetō mahã moni bo̱ö̱mi ahora le̱.

english_verse: Be cautious and hide when you see danger— don't be stupid and walk right into trouble.
translation_verse: Hĩetẽlo̱ naä efõṅ ní baä, ni etëo̱ ehe; ši mei ni nako dſẽṅmo̱ le̱ batšõo̱ he ke̱-hoo̱, ni ame̱naä nõ.

english_verse: A loud greeting early in the morning is the same as a curse.
translation_verse: Moni ke̱ gbē wale dšō̱o̱ enanyo lebi mā̃ṅkpa le̱, aabu ene̱ lōmo̱ ahãle̱.

english_verse: Just as iron sharpens iron, friends sharpen the minds of each other.
translation_verse: Dade dšo̱ō̱ dade nā, ni gbomo hãa enanyo no̱ tšeo̱.

english_verse: Take care of a tree, and you will eat its fruit; look after your master, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Moni bāa agbāmitšo yi le̱, eyeo̱ eyibii le̱ eko, ni moni súmoo̱ enuṅtšo̱ le̱, awoo ehĩe nyam.

english_verse: You see your face in a mirror and your thoughts in the minds of others.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni hĩe dšeo̱ hĩe ye̱ nu mli le̱, nakai gbomo tšui hũ dše gbomo.

english_verse: Death and the grave are never satisfied, and neither are humans.
translation_verse: *Gbohĩĩadše ke̱ hĩekpãtãmo̱-bu le̱ tō̱ro̱ko dã, ni †gbomo hĩṅme̱ii hũ eto̱ko dã. *

english_verse: Gold and silver are tested in a red-hot furnace, but we are tested by praise.
translation_verse: Niiahetšūmo̱ kukwe̱i le̱, eye̱ hã dſie̱te̱i, ni flõnõ ye̱ hã šika, ni gbomo le̱, eyidšiemo̱ ake̱-yoo̱le̱.

english_verse: No matter how hard you beat a fool, you can't pound out the foolishness.
translation_verse: Kē̱ oke̱ fufuitšomlibi ši bulu ye̱ fufuitšo mli tamo̱ ašio̱ able tete le̱, ebulufemo̱ le̱ edšeṅ ehe gbĩkogbĩko.

english_verse: You should take good care of your sheep and goats,
translation_verse: Bo̱ mo̱deṅ ni ole bo̱ni otōi le̱ yo̱, ni okwe̱ okolokui le̱ dšogbāṅ.

english_verse: After the hay is cut and the new growth appears and the harvest is over,
translation_verse: Alō dſe̱i gbĩṅ le̱ ke̱-te, ni dſe̱fo̱ nā edše, ni gõdši ano̱ bāi le̱ ābua nā.

english_verse: you can sell lambs and goats to buy clothes and land.
translation_verse: Tõgwanteṅbii le̱ buo̱o mama, ni ešikpoṅ le̱ yinii dši tōkpakpoi le̱;

english_verse: From the milk of the goats, you can make enough cheese to feed your family and all your servants.
translation_verse: ni ooná abotia fufo̱ bo̱ni aaše̱ bo ke̱ owe le̱ yeli, ke̱ noni oke̱-aalè̱ oweyei le̱.

english_verse: It makes good sense to obey the Law of God, but you disgrace your parents if you make friends with worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Moni yeo̱ mla no̱ le̱, bi nilelo̱ ni; ši moni ke̱ fulo̱i boo̱ nanyo le̱, eewo etše̱ hĩegbẽle.

english_verse: If you don't confess your sins, you will be a failure. But God will be merciful if you confess your sins and give them up.
translation_verse: Moni tšīmoo̱ eno̱tõmo̱ no̱ le̱, eſereṅ; ši moni dšadšeo̱ ni efõo le, anaäle̱ mo̱bo̱. Lal.

english_verse: A heartless leader is a fool, but anyone who refuses to get rich by cheating others will live a long time.
translation_verse: Lumo ní be̱ dſẽṅmo̱ le̱ yiwalo̱ kple ni; ši moni nye̱o̱ hĩedšõmo̱ le̱, ehãa egbĩĩ ase̱ tše̱o̱.

english_verse: Don't give help to murderers! Make them stay on the run for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Gbomo ní eye moko lá yi sõ le̱, ehĩe foidšē ke̱-mīya bu mli tō̃; moko akatšĩ enā!

english_verse: Honesty will keep you safe, but everyone who is crooked will suddenly fall.
translation_verse: Moni nyieo̱ emūyeli mli le̱, aahere eyiwala; ši moni nyieo̱, kõdõṅkõdõṅ ye̱ gbè̱i enyo̱ no̱ le̱, eegbē ši ye̱ ekome no̱.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will have a lot of food; waste time, and you will have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Moni hũo̱ ešikpoṅ le̱, eeto̱ ke̱ abolo; ši moni nyieo̱ yakayakanii ase̱ le̱, eeto̱ ke̱ ohĩa.

english_verse: It isn't right to be unfair, but some people can be bribed with only a piece of bread.
translation_verse: Hĩeṅtšeiano̱kwe̱mo̱ ehĩĩ; edšake̱ abolo atrõma pe̱ hewo̱ le̱ gbomo tõo̱.

english_verse: Don't be selfish and eager to get rich— you will end up worse off than you can imagine.
translation_verse: Moni yo̱ hĩṅme̱i sa le̱, eyeo̱ oyai ní ena nii, šĩ elee ake̱ ohĩa mība eno̱. *K.

english_verse: If you cheat your parents and don't think it's wrong, you are a common thief.
translation_verse: Moni haä etše̱ lo enye nii ní ekē̱o̱ ake̱ edšee tõmo̱ le̱, mohĩekpĩtãlo̱ nanyo dšile̱. Mat.

english_verse: Selfish people cause trouble, but you will live a full life if you trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Moni hĩe dšōo̱ le̱, ewoo̱ béi; ši moni hĩe kã Iehowa no̱ le̱, eewo fo̱.

english_verse: Only fools would trust what they alone think, but if you live by wisdom, you will do all right.
translation_verse: Moni ke̱ ehĩe fõo̱ le̱dientše̱ *etšui no̱ le̱, kwašia ni; ši moni nyieo̱ nilē mli le̱, aahere eyiwala. *

english_verse: Giving to the poor will keep you from poverty, but if you close your eyes to their needs, everyone will curse you.
translation_verse: Moni hãa ohĩafo nõ le̱, nokonoko ehĩaṅle̱; ši moni ṅõo̱ ehĩe etēo̱ le̱, eená lōmo̱i babaō.

english_verse: When crooks are in control, everyone tries to hide, but when they lose power, good people are everywhere.
translation_verse: Ké̱ meifõdši te ši le̱, mei tētēo̱ ame̱he; ši beni ame̱hĩe kpãtãa le̱, bële̱ dšalo̱i ayi mīfá.

english_verse: An honest ruler makes the nation strong; a ruler who takes bribes will bring it to ruin.
translation_verse: Maṅtše̱ ke̱ dšale̱ saneyeli hãa maṅ damoo̱; ši moni sumoo̱ onĩatšũmo̱ tūtu le̱, ebutuo̱le̱.

english_verse: Your sins will catch you, but everyone who lives right will sing and celebrate.
translation_verse: Gbomo fõṅ no̱tõmo̱ le̱, tsõne ye̱ mli; ši dšalo̱ mli aaflile̱ nĩ eenyã́.

english_verse: The wicked don't care about the rights of the poor, but good people do.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱ naā ohĩafoi asane nā; ši mofõṅ le̱, ebe̱ dſẽṅmo̱ ní eke̱-ana.

english_verse: Sneering at others is a spark that sets a city on fire; using good sense can put out the flames of anger.
translation_verse: Hefe̱oyelo̱i mãa maṅ nā la; ši nilelo̱i le̱, ame̱kũo̱ mlifũ nā.

english_verse: Be wise and don't sue a fool. You won't get satisfaction, because all the fool will do is sneer and shout.
translation_verse: Ké̱ nilelo̱ ke̱ bulu mītā nā le̱, *egrio̱ ni eṅmõo̱ ni hedšo̱le̱ be̱. *Mat.

english_verse: A murderer hates everyone who is honest and lives right.
translation_verse: Lášiſielo̱i nye̱o̱ moni eye emū; ni ame̱taoo̱ dšalo̱i asusuma se̱gbe̱.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and quickly lose your temper— be sensible and patient.
translation_verse: Kwašia dšieo̱ emlifũ fẽ kpo; ši nilelo̱ ke̱-too̱ se̱ ni edšo̱ö̱ he.

english_verse: Kings who are fair to the poor will rule a long time.
translation_verse: Maṅtše̱ ní tšṍo̱ ano̱kwale no̱ kodšoo̱ ohĩafoi le̱, emaṅtše̱sẽi le̱ aamã ši ke̱-ate nāno̱.

english_verse: Crime increases when crooks are in power, but law-abiding citizens will see them fall.
translation_verse: Ké̱ meifõdši ayi fá le̱, no̱tõmo̱ fáa; ši *dšalo̱i aana ame̱šigbēmo̱ le̱, *Lal.

english_verse: If you correct your children, they will bring you peace and happiness.
translation_verse: Tšo̱semo̱ obi, ni eehã ohe adšo̱o; ni eehã osusuma mī aše̱ ehe.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who speaks without thinking.
translation_verse: Ké̱ ona nū ni he yo̱ *oyá ke̱ wiemo le, hĩenokãmo̱ ye̱ hã kwašia fèle̱. *Dšadš.

english_verse: A person with a quick temper stirs up arguments and commits a lot of sins.
translation_verse: Mlifũtše̱ tēo̱ béi ši, ni mlilatše̱ le̱, etõmo̱ fáa.

english_verse: If you take part in a crime you are your worst enemy, because even under oath you can't tell the truth.
translation_verse: Moni ke̱ dšulo̱ dšaä nii le̱, ēnye̱ esusuma; enuo̱ *kitãkãmo̱ le̱ moṅ, ši edšadšee. *

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of being a coward— trust the Lord, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Gbomo šemo̱ tšṍo̱ tsõne; ši moni ṅõo̱ ehĩe efõo̱ Iehowa no̱ le̱, aabu ehe.

english_verse: Many try to make friends with a ruler, but justice comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Mei pī taoo no̱yelo̱ hĩe gbe̱; ši gbomo kodšomo̱ le̱, Iehowa ṅõ dše̱o̱.

english_verse: Good people and criminals can't stand each other.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱i anihĩnii dši moni feo̱ noni edšaa; ši meifõdši anihĩnii dši moni gbe̱ dša.

english_verse: I never was wise, and I don't understand what God is like.”
translation_verse: ni mikaseko nilē, ni asaṅ milee Mokroṅkroṅ le̱ he noko.

english_verse: There are two things, Lord, I want you to do for me before I die:
translation_verse: Nibii enyo̱ mibio̱ ye̱ odeṅ; kākãmãmi, dãni magbo:

english_verse: Some people curse their father and even their mother;
translation_verse: Yino̱ ko ye̱ ní lomoo̱ etše̱, ni enye hũ edšō̱ō̱le̱;

english_verse: others think they are perfect, but they are stained by sin.
translation_verse: yino̱ ko ye̱ ní buo̱ ehe ake̱ ehe tše, ši kẽle̱ afo̱ko ehe mũdši le̱ ye̱ ehe;

english_verse: Some people are stuck-up and act like snobs;
translation_verse: yino̱ ko ye̱ ní holeo̱ ehĩṅme̱ii ano̱ ake̱ noko, ni ehĩṅme̱iiase̱ kwŏ̱lo̱;

english_verse: Greed has twins, each named “Give me!” There are three or four things that are never satisfied:
translation_verse: Šiti ye̱ biyei enyo̱, atšé̱o̱ame̱ ake̱: Hami, hami! Nii etẽ ye̱ ni ame̱tŏ̱ro̱ko̱ dã, ni noni dši edſe̱ le̱ ekē̱ē̱ ake̱: Efá!

english_verse: Don't make fun of your father or disobey your mother— crows will peck out your eyes, and buzzards will eat the rest of you.
translation_verse: Hĩṅme̱i ni yeo̱ etše̱ he fe̱o ni egbeo̱ enye toibō he guo le̱, fa nā kwãkwãlabitei aafãmo̱ ni okropoṅbii aaye.

english_verse: There are three or four things I cannot understand:
translation_verse: Nibii etẽ ye̱ ni feo̱mi nākpe̱ tšṍ, ni noni dši edſe̱ le̱ milee:

english_verse: How eagles fly so high or snakes crawl on rocks, how ships sail the ocean or people fall in love.
translation_verse: Okropoṅ gbe̱ ye̱ ṅwei, onũfŭ gbe̱ ye̱ te̱sā no̱, lele gbe̱ ye̱ ṅšo̱ teṅ, ke̱ nu gbe̱ ye̱ oblayō he.

english_verse: An unfaithful wife says, “Sleeping with another man is as natural as eating.”
translation_verse: Nakai yō gblãfitelo̱ gbe̱ yo̱; eyeo̱, ni etšumoo̱ enā, ni ekē̱o̱ ake̱: Mifeko noko fõṅ ko!

english_verse: There are three or four things that make the earth tremble and are unbearable:
translation_verse: Nibii etẽ hãa šikpoṅ hosoo̱, ni noni dši edſe̱ le̱, enyẽẽ mli emõ:

english_verse: A slave who becomes king, a fool who eats too much,
translation_verse: Tšũlo̱ ní eye maṅtše̱, ke̱ bulu ní eye ṅmā̃ eto̱; Dsads.

english_verse: a hateful woman who finds a husband, and a slave who takes the place of the woman who owns her.
translation_verse: yō ni akpō afõ ši ní ená wú, ke̱ weyō nī ebaye ewura nii.

english_verse: On this earth four things are small but very wise:
translation_verse: Nibii edſe̱ ye̱ ni ame̱dăraa ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ši ame̱le nii pam:

english_verse: Ants, who seem to be feeble, but store up food all summer long;
translation_verse: Tšatšubii le̱, maṅ ní he waa ni, ši kẽle̱ ame̱taoo̱ ame̱niyenii ame̱too̱ ye̱ latšābe mli;

english_verse: badgers, who seem to be weak, but live among the rocks;
translation_verse: afutuo̱ko̱i hũ, maṅ ní he waa ni, ši kẽle̱ ame̱feo̱ ame̱tšũi ye̱ te̱sāiaṅ;

english_verse: locusts, who have no king, but march like an army;
translation_verse: bālabii be̱ maṅtše̱, ši kẽle̱ ame̱fẽ ame̱fãa asafoiaṅ;

english_verse: lizards, which can be caught in your hand, but sneak into palaces.
translation_verse: oonyẽ oke̱ onine amõ tšũnye, ši kẽle̱ maṅtše̱mei amõdšiaṅ ehĩo̱.

english_verse: those proud roosters, those mountain goats, and those rulers who have no enemies.
translation_verse: tawū okpo̱ṅo̱ ni ehe mli wa, ke̱ tōkpakpo, ke̱ maṅtše̱ ní moko etee ši woole̱.

english_verse: If you are foolishly bragging or planning something evil, then stop it now!
translation_verse: Ké̱ ofe buluianii ni owó ohe no̱, lo ké̱ odſẽṅ dſẽṅmo̱ fõṅ le̱, oke̱ onine ato onābu!

english_verse: If you churn milk you get butter; if you pound on your nose, you get blood— and if you stay angry, you get in trouble.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ké̱ omĩa fufo̱ le̱, oodšie butru, ni ké̱ omĩa gugõ le̱, lá aadše, ni ke̱ omĩa mlifũ le̱, béi aadše̱ mli.

english_verse: My son Lemuel, you were born in answer to my prayers, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: Ao, mibi, ao, mimũsũṅbi, ao, mišiwōi abi!

english_verse: Don't waste your life chasing after women! This has ruined many kings.
translation_verse: Kāṅõ ohewale̱ ohã yei, kānyie maṅtšemei afitemo̱ gbè̱i le̱ ano̱!

english_verse: Let them drink and forget how poor and miserable they feel.
translation_verse: amenu, ni ame̱hĩe akpa ohĩa no̱, ni ame̱kakai ame̱haomo̱ le̱ doṅṅ.

english_verse: But you must defend those who are helpless and have no hope.
translation_verse: Gblemo̱ odāṅ ohã mũmũi, ke̱ mei ní ašĩame̱ le̱ fẽ asane mli hũ. Hiob

english_verse: A truly good wife is the most precious treasure a man can find!
translation_verse: Yō kpakpa le̱, namo aaná? Edšra wa āhũ fè tẽṅẽlẽo.

english_verse: She is good to him every day of her life,
translation_verse: Ewala gbĩĩ fiā-kwa mli le̱, edšũrõ efeo̱le̱ ši dšee efõṅ.

english_verse: and with her own hands she gladly makes clothes.
translation_verse: Ebo̱ö̱ tōhetšo̱i ke̱ odonti he mo̱deṅ, eke̱ enidši tšuo̱ nii ko̱ tšuidšũrõ.

english_verse: She is like a sailing ship that brings food from across the sea.
translation_verse: Etamo̱ dšrayeli le̱dši; eyaṅõo̱ eniyenii ke̱-dše̱o̱ šoṅṅ.

english_verse: She gets up before daylight to prepare food for her family and for her servants.
translation_verse: Beni dše tše̱reko po le̱, eteo̱ ši, ni ehãa ešĩabii aniyenii ke̱ eweyei le̱ hũ ame̱gbe̱fãṅnii.

english_verse: She knows how to buy land and how to plant a vineyard,
translation_verse: Edſẽṅo̱ abō̱ he̱, ni eheo̱; eninenā nitšumo̱nii eke̱-feo̱ weintrom.

english_verse: and she always works hard.
translation_verse: Eke̱ hewale̱ mīaä ehe̱, ni ewadšeo̱ enidšiaṅ.

english_verse: She knows when to buy or sell, and she stays busy until late at night.
translation_verse: Eyoo̱ ake̱ eguo̱yeli le̱ hĩ; ekane le̱ hũ gboo nyōṅ.

english_verse: and she helps the poor and the needy.
translation_verse: Egbleo̱ enidšiaṅ ehāa nõnalo̱, ni ekpãa enine mli ehãa ohĩafo.

english_verse: Her family has warm clothing, and so she doesn't worry when it snows.
translation_verse: Ešee snō gbeyei ye̱ ešĩabii le̱ ahewo̱, edšake̱ ewebii le̱ fẽ bumoo̱ munẽle.

english_verse: Her husband is a well-known and respected leader in the city.
translation_verse: Ayoo̱ ewù ye̱ koi le̱ ši, ké̱ eke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ onukpai le̱ trá ši le̱.

english_verse: She makes clothes to sell to the shop owners.
translation_verse: Ekpe̱o̱ klala atadei ni ehõo̱, ni eke̱ he̱ſĩnõ hãa guo̱yelo̱. Bo̱f.

english_verse: She is strong and graceful, as well as cheerful about the future.
translation_verse: Hewale̱ ke̱ hĩenyam dši etade, ni *eṅmõo̱ gbĩĩ ni baba le̱. *Hiob

english_verse: Her words are sensible, and her advice is thoughtful.
translation_verse: Egbleo̱ edāṅ ye̱ nilē mli, ni mlihĩle̱ mla kã elile̱i no̱.

english_verse: She takes good care of her family and is never lazy.
translation_verse: Ekwe̱o̱ ešĩabii le̱ ayā ke̱ bā dšogbāṅ, ni eyee hedšõfemo̱ abolo.

english_verse: Her children praise her, and with great pride her husband says,
translation_verse: Ebii le̱ teo̱ ši, ni ame̱dšō̱o̱le̱, ewù le̱ hũ kafoo̱le̱:

english_verse: “There are many good women, but you are the best!”
translation_verse: “Biyei pī bo̱ō̱ mo̱deṅ moṅ, ši bo le̱ otá ame̱flā ame̱no̱!”

english_verse: Charm can be deceiving, and beauty fades away, but a woman who honors the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Hĩenyam le̱ lakamo̱ ni, ni he-fe̱o hũ le̱ yakayakanõ ni; ši yō ní šeo̱ Iehowa gbeyei le̱, aakafole̱!

english_verse: Show her respect— praise her in public for what she has done.
translation_verse: Nyeṅõa eninenā nitšumo̱nii le̱ eko nyehãale̱, ni enitšumo̱i le̱ adšie eyi ye̱ koii le̱ aši.

english_verse: People come, and people go, but still the world never changes.
translation_verse: Yino̱ hoo̱ yaä, ni yino̱ baä; ši šikpoṅ le̱ emã ši ke̱-mīya nāno̱. Lal.

english_verse: The sun comes up, the sun goes down; it hurries right back to where it started from.
translation_verse: Hũlũ teo̱ ši, ni hũlũ sā nyõo̱ ši, ni eyeo̱ oyái ke̱-yaä egbe̱he, heni eteo̱ ši ekoṅ ye̱ le̱.

english_verse: The wind blows south, the wind blows north; round and round it blows over and over again.
translation_verse: Kō̱yo tſaä ke-yaä wuoyigbe̱, ní elo̱go̱ö̱ ehe ke̱-baä kōyigbe̱; ši so̱ṅṅ elo̱go̱ö̱ ke̱-nyieo̱, kō̱yo̱ le̱ kũo̱ ese̱ ke̱-baä ešibo̱lemo̱hei le̱ ekoṅ.

english_verse: All of life is far more boring than words could ever say. Our eyes and our ears are never satisfied with what we see and hear.
translation_verse: Nibii fẽ *haoo̱ amehe, mokomoko nyẽẽ adšadše po; hĩṅme̱i eto̱o̱ ke̱ nikwe̱mo̱, toi hũ yii ke̱ ninumo̱. *Lal.

english_verse: Someone might say, “Here is something new!” But it happened before, long before we were born.
translation_verse: Ani noko ye̱ ni aanyẽ akē̱ ye̱ he ake̱: Kwe̱mo̱, ene̱ le̱ ehē ni! lo? aba momo ye̱ yino̱i ní atšṍ wo̱hĩe le̱ amli.

english_verse: No one who lived in the past is remembered anymore, and everyone yet to be born will be forgotten too. It Is Senseless To Be Wise
translation_verse: Akaii tšutšubii le̱, ni se̱kpēbii ní baba ye̱ se̱ le̱, mei ní hala ye̱ ame̱se̱ le̱ kaiṅame̱.

english_verse: I have seen it all, and everything is just as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Mina nitšumo̱i fẽ ní atšuo ye̱ hũlũ šiši le̱: ni na, fẽ le̱ yakayakanii ke̱ kō̱yo̱ hakamo̱ ní!

english_verse: If something is crooked, it can't be made straight; if something isn't there, it can't be counted.
translation_verse: Noni ekõkõ le̱, anyẽẽ adšadše, ni noni be̱ hũ, ehĩĩ kanemo̱.

english_verse: I said to myself, “You are by far the wisest person who has ever lived in Jerusalem. You are eager to learn, and you have learned a lot.”
translation_verse: Mika mitšui wie ake̱: Na, mihã minilē eda ni efá babaō fè mei fẽ ní tšṍ mihĩe ye̱ Ierusalem le̱, ni mištui ená nilē ke̱ ṅā babaō.

english_verse: Then I decided to find out all I could about wisdom and foolishness. Soon I realized that this too was as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Ni mibi mitšui fõ no̱ ake̱ male nii, ni male se̱ke̱yeli ke̱ kwašiafemo̱ hũ, ni miyo ake̱ ene̱ hũ kō̱yo̱ hakumo̱ ni.

english_verse: The more you know, the more you hurt; the more you understand, the more you suffer.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nilē tūtu le̱, nāgbamo̱ tūtu yo̱ mli, ni moni hãa enilē fáa le̱, ohaomo̱ hũ fáa.

english_verse: Laughing and having fun is crazy. What good does it do?
translation_verse: Mikē̱ ṅmlõ ake̱: Oye se̱ke̱! ni mike̱ mīše̱ hũ ake̱: Meni ofeo̱ ne̱?

english_verse: I did some great things. I built houses and planted vineyards.
translation_verse: Mitšu nitšumo̱i wudši: minãmo̱ tšui mihã mihe, mife weintromi mihã mihe;

english_verse: I had flower gardens and orchards full of fruit trees.
translation_verse: mife abō̱i ke̱ tromi fe̱fe̱dši, ni mite̱o tšei ní woo̱ yibii sro̱toi fẽ ye̱ mli;

english_verse: I got whatever I wanted and did whatever made me happy. But most of all, I enjoyed my work.
translation_verse: Ni nofẽno ní mihĩṅme̱ii taoo̱ le̱, mikãmããame̱; mitšĩĩ mitšui mīše̱ ko mīše̱ ko he gbe̱, edšake̱ mitšui mī še̱o̱ ehe ye̱ mideṅmegbomo̱ le̱ fẽ mli, ni ene̱ dši migbe̱fāṅnõ ye̱ mideṅmegbomo̱ le̱ fẽ hewo̱.

english_verse: Wisdom is like having two good eyes; foolishness leaves you in the dark. But wise or foolish, we all end up the same.
translation_verse: *Nilelo̱ le̱, ehĩṅmeii ye̱ eyitšo he, ši kwašia le̱, duṅ mli enyieo̱; ši kẽle̱ miyo ake̱ ošrã kome šrãa ame̱fẽkwa. *Abe̱i

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that others would someday get everything I had worked for so hard, then I started hating it all.
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ mideṅme fẽ ní migbo ye̱ hũlũ šiši ne̱ edše mitšine: edšake̱ mibašì mahã moni baye mise̱ le̱. K.

english_verse: Who knows if those people will be sensible or stupid? Either way, they will own everything I have earned by hard work and wisdom. It doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Ši nilelo̱ ebafe dšio, kwašia dšio, namo̱ le? Ni kẽle̱ le̱ ebaye nii fẽ ní mike̱ deṅmegbomo̱ ke̱ nilē ná ye̱ hũlũ šiši ne̱ le̱ no̱. Ene̱ hũ yakayakanoko ni.

english_verse: I thought about all my hard work, and I felt depressed.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ mitšṍ mihe ni minidšiaṅ dše wui ye̱ deṅme fẽ ní migbo ye̱ hũlũ šiši ne̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: When we use our wisdom, knowledge, and skill to get what we own, why do we have to leave it to someone who didn't work for it? This is senseless and wrong.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ gbomo ko ye̱ ní ṅā ke̱ nilē ke̱ ſeremo̱ ye̱ edeṅmegbomo̱ mli, ši kẽle̱ ebašĩ ehã moko ní gboko he deṅme ko, ake̱ egbošinii. Ene̱ hũ yakayakanoko ke̱ nõfõṅ kpeteṅkple ni!

english_verse: Our bodies ache during the day, and work is torture. Then at night our thoughts are troubled. It just doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ egbĩĩ le̱ fẽ le̱ aw̌ere̱hō soṅṅ ni, ni ehenāgbamo̱ le̱ nko̱moyeli ni; asaṅ nyōṅ tete le̱ etšui enyõõ emli. Ene̱ hũ yakayakanoko ni!

english_verse: The best thing we can do is to enjoy eating, drinking, and working. I believe these are God's gifts to us,
translation_verse: Nõkpakpa ko be̱ hã gbomo *fè ene̱, ake̱ eye ni enu, ni ehã esusuma aye nii kpakpai amli ṅõmo̱ ye̱ edeṅmegbomo̱ le̱ mli. Ene̱ hũ mina, ake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ deṅ edše̱. *

english_verse: and no one enjoys eating and living more than I do.
translation_verse: Ké̱ dšee le̱ ni le̱, namo aaye nii, ni namo aaná tšuidšũrõ?

english_verse: If we please God, he will make us wise, understanding, and happy. But if we sin, God will make us struggle for a living, then he will give all we own to someone who pleases him. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ gbomo ní sa ehīe le̱, ehãale̱ ṅā ke̱ nilē ke̱ mīše̱ fẽ, ši ešafelo̱ le̱, ehãale̱ henāgbamo̱, ní *eke̱-bua nii anā ni etĩa, ní eṅõ-hã moni sa Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe le̱. Ene̱ hũ yakayakanoko ke̱ kō̱yo̱ hakumo̱ ni. *Abe̱i

english_verse: for crying and laughing, weeping and dancing,
translation_verse: yāfó be ye̱, ni ṅmlõ be ye̱, yărafemo̱ be ye, ni dšõ̀ be ye̱;

english_verse: There is a time for finding and losing, keeping and giving,
translation_verse: taomo̱ be ye̱, ni lādšemo̱ le ye̱; yibāmo̱ le ye̱, ni še̱mo̱-ke̱-fō̃ be ye̱;

english_verse: What do we gain by all our hard work?
translation_verse: Mē se̱ moni tšuo̱ nii le̱ náa ye̱ noni egboo̱ he deṅme le̱ mli?

english_verse: I have seen what difficult things God demands of us.
translation_verse: Mina henāgbamo̱ ní Nyoṅmo̱ eṅõhã gbomei abii, ní ame̱ke̱-gba amehe nā le̱.

english_verse: God makes everything happen at the right time. Yet none of us can ever fully understand all he has done, and he puts questions in our minds about the past and the future.
translation_verse: Efeo̱ nofẽno fe̱fe̱o ye̱ ebe mli, asaṅ eṅõ nāno̱ hũ ewo ame̱tšui mli; na ke̱ke̱ gbomo enaa nitšumo̱ ní Nyoṅmo̱ tšuo̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ šišidšē ke̱-yaä nāgbee le̱.

english_verse: Everything that happens has happened before, and all that will be has already been— God does everything over and over again. The Future Is Known Only to God
translation_verse: Noni yo̱ ne̱, eye ke̱-dše dšeeṅmõ, ni noni baba le̱ hũ, eba momo; ni noni eho le̱, Nyoṅmo̱ ke̱-baä ekoṅ.

english_verse: Everywhere on earth I saw violence and injustice instead of fairness and justice.
translation_verse: Ni misā mina ye̱ hũlũ šiši ne̱, ake̱ heni akodšoo̱ ye̱ le̱, efõṅfemo̱ ye̱ dše̱i, ni heni dšale̱ yo̱ le̱, efõṅfemo̱ ye̱ dše̱i.

english_verse: So I told myself that God has set a time and a place for everything. He will judge everyone, both the wicked and the good.
translation_verse: Mikē̱ ye̱ mitšui mli ake̱; Dšalo̱ ke̱ mofõṅ le̱ fē, Nyoṅmo̱ bakodšoame̱; edšake̱ yiṅtō-fẽ-yiṅtō ke̱ nitšumo̱-fẽ-nitšumo̱ ye̱ ebe.

english_verse: I know God is testing us to show us that we are merely animals.
translation_verse: Nisā mikē̱ ye mitšui mli ake̱: Gbome̱i abii ahewo̱ afe nakai, koni Nyoṅmo̱ akaame̱ akwe̱, ní ame̱na ake̱, ké̱ kaame̱ ke̱ke̱ le̱ ame̱tamo̱ koloi noṅṅ.

english_verse: All living creatures go to the same place. We are made from earth, and we return to earth.
translation_verse: Ame̱fẽ ame̱yaä hekome: *ame̱fẽ ame̱dše̱ sũ mli, ni ame̱fẽ ame̱tšṍo̱ sũ ekoṅ. *

english_verse: Who really knows if our spirits go up and the spirits of animals go down into the earth?
translation_verse: Namo le ake̱ gbomei abii amumo̱ le̱ ṅweigbe̱ eyaä, alo ake̱ koloi amumo̱ le̱ šišigbe̱ eyaä ye̱ šikpoṅ šiši?

english_verse: We were meant to enjoy our work, and that's the best thing we can do. We can never know the future.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ miyo, ake̱ nõkpakpa ko be̱ fè noni gbomo mī aaše̱ ehe ye̱ enitšumo̱i amli; edšake̱ ene̱ dši egbe̱făṅnõ. Ši namo aahã ele noni baba ye̱ ese̱?

english_verse: Then I realized that we work and do wonderful things just because we are jealous of others. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Ni misā mina deṅmegbomo̱ fẽ, ke̱ nitšumo̱ mli ſeremo̱ fẽ hũ, ake̱ no hewo̱ gbomo he tšẽo̱ enanyo. Ene̱ hũ yakayakanoko ke̱ kō̱yo̱ hakumo̱ ni.

english_verse: Fools will fold their hands and starve to death.
translation_verse: Kwašia kotaä enidši, ni eyeo̱ le̱dientše̱ ehelo. Abe̱i

english_verse: Yet a very little food eaten in peace is better than twice as much earned from overwork and chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Dẽko̱ko̱ obõ ni hedšo̱le̱ yo̱ mli hĩ fè dẽko̱ko̱i enyo̱ obõbõ ní deṅmegbomo̱ kō̱yo̱ hakumo̱ yo̱ mli. Abe̱i

english_verse: Once again I saw that nothing on earth makes sense.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni *misā mina yakayakanii ní yo̱ hũlũ šiši ne̱: *

english_verse: For example, some people don't have friends or family. But they are never satisfied with what they own, and they never stop working to get more. They should ask themselves, “Why am I always working to have more? Who will get what I leave behind?” What a senseless and miserable life! It Is Better To Have a Friend
translation_verse: Moko ye̱ ní ekometō ni, ni ebe̱ moko ní fataä ehe feo̱ enyo̱, ebe̱ bi le̱, ebe̱ nyemi hũ; ši kẽle̱ efõõ deṅmegbomo̱, ehĩṅme̱ii hũ tŏ̱ro̱o̱ ke̱ ninámo̱. Ekē̱o̱ ake̱: Namo hewo̱ po migboo̱ deṅme, ni mikãmãa misusuma nii kpakpai ne̱? Ene̱ hũ yakayakanoko ke̱ henāgbamo̱ ní wa ni!

english_verse: You are better having a friend than to be all alone, because then you will get more enjoyment out of what you earn.
translation_verse: Mei enyo̱ hĩ fè mokome; edšake̱ ame̱náa ame̱deṅmegbomo̱ le̱ mli nyõmo̱wo kpakpa.

english_verse: If you fall, your friend can help you up. But if you fall without having a friend nearby, you are really in trouble.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ké̱ ši amigbē le̱, mokome aawó enanyo no̱; ši mokometō le̱, ké̱ egbē ši le̱, kpóo hãle̱, edšake̱ moni tĩa enyo̱ ní aawó eno̱ be̱!

english_verse: If you sleep alone, you won't have anyone to keep you warm on a cold night.
translation_verse: Asaṅ ke̱dši mei enyo̱ kãmo̱ ši le̱, no amehe do̱ö̱ la; ši té aafe tēṅ ní mokometō he aado̱ laṅ?

english_verse: Someone might be able to beat up one of you, but not both of you. As the saying goes, “A rope made from three strands of cord is hard to break.”
translation_verse: Ké̱ moko batua ame̱teṅ mokome le̱, mei enyo̱ le̱ aate ši awole̱; ni kpã ní ake̱-bo̱ he šii etẽ le̱, etšee mră.

english_verse: You may be poor and young, but if you are wise, you are better off than a foolish old king who won't listen to advice.
translation_verse: Fãṅ gbekẽ ohãfo ní dši nilelo̱ moṅ fè maṅtše̱ nūmo ní dši kwašia ní ekplẽẽ ṅāwō doṅṅ.

english_verse: I once saw everyone in the world follow a young leader who came to power after the king was gone.
translation_verse: Mina hĩekãlo̱i fẽ ní nyie hũlũ šiši ne̱ ake̱ ame̱fata gbekẽ ní dši enyo̱ ní baye enãdšiaṅ le̱ he.

english_verse: If you keep thinking about something, you will dream about it. If you talk too much, you will say the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Ké̱ *owo Nyoṅmo̱ ši le̱, kāhã mītše̱ ní oye no̱; edšake̱ ebe̱ kwašiai ahe tšuidšũrõ. Ši ní owo le̱, ye no̱! *

english_verse: God doesn't like fools. So don't be slow to keep your promises to God.
translation_verse: Fāṅ noni owoo ši fè noni owo ši ni oyee no̱.

english_verse: It's better not to make a promise at all than to make one and not keep it.
translation_verse: Kāṅmẽ onābu gbe̱ ní ehã ohelo mīfe eša, ni kākē̱ ye̱ *bo̱fo le̱ hĩe ake̱: Tõmo̱ ke̱ke̱ ni! Mẽhewo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ mli aafũ ye̱ owiemo̱i ahewo̱ ni efite oninenā nitšumo̱ le̱? *Mal.

english_verse: And since the king is the highest official, he benefits most from the taxes paid on the land.
translation_verse: Moni sumoo̱ šika le̱, šika eto̱ṅle̱, ni moni sumoo̱ nifále̱ le̱, enáṅ se̱ ko. Ene̱ hũ yakayakanoko ni! Abe̱i

english_verse: If you love money and wealth, you will never be satisfied with what you have. This doesn't make a bit of sense.
translation_verse: Heni nii fáa ye̱ le̱, yelo̱i hũ fáa ye̱ dše̱i, ni mẽ se̱námo̱ yo̱ mli lă nõ-tšemei le̱, ake̱ dša kwe̱ ni ame̱akwe̱ ke̱ ame̱hĩṅmeii le̱ ke̱ke̱?

english_verse: The more you have, the more everyone expects from you. Your money won't do you any good—others will just spend it for you.
translation_verse: Nitšulo̱ le̱, eye nii fiō dšio, pī dšio ewo̱ ṅõo enā; ši to̱ ní niiatše̱ to̱ö̱ le̱ hãã ewo̱.

english_verse: If you have to work hard for a living, you can rest well at night, even if you don't have much to eat. But if you are rich, you can't even sleep.
translation_verse: Efõṅ ko ye̱ ní wa ní mina ye̱ hũlũ šiši ne̱: no dši nii pī ní nõtše̱ le̱ ke̱-too̱ ní eke̱-yeo̱ ehe awui le̱.

english_verse: I have seen something terribly unfair. People get rich, but it does them no good.
translation_verse: Ni nakai nii le̱ aalādše ye̱ ošrã nā, ni ké̱ efo̱ bi le̱, nokonoko be̱ edeṅ.

english_verse: Suddenly they lose everything in a bad business deal, then have nothing to leave for their children.
translation_verse: Noni edše̱ enye mũsũṅ oba ke̱ ehe yayai le̱, nakai noṅṅ eekũ ese̱ ke̱-ate, bo̱ni eba le̱, ni eko̱ṅ nokonoko ye̱ edeṅmegbomo̱ le̱ mli, ní eke̱-ahĩe edẽ ke̱-ate. Hiob

english_verse: That's terribly unfair. They leave the world just as they came. They gained nothing from running after the wind.
translation_verse: Ewala gbĩĩ fẽ mli le̱ duṅ mli eyeo̱ nii ye, emli woo̱ la baboō, ni hela ke̱ mlifũ kpaale̱,

english_verse: What is the best thing to do in the short life God has given us? I think we should enjoy eating, drinking, and working hard. This is what God intends for us to do.
translation_verse: Mofẽmo hũ ni Nyoṅmo̱ ehãle̱ šika ke̱ nii babaō, ni ehãle̱ hewale̱ ní eke̱-ye eko, ní eṅõ egbe̱fãṅnõ, ní emī aše̱ ye̱ edeṅmegbomo̱ mli le̱: ene̱ hũ Nyoṅmo̱ nikēnii ni.

english_verse: Suppose you are very rich and able to enjoy everything you own. Then go ahead and enjoy working hard—this is God's gift to you.
translation_verse: Ši edſẽṅṅ ewala gbĩĩ le̱ ahe pī ko, edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ehãle̱ noni etšui taoo̱.

english_verse: God may give you everything you want—money, property, and wealth. Then God doesn't let you enjoy it, and someone you don't even know gets it all. That's senseless and terribly unfair!
translation_verse: nū ko ní Nyoṅmo̱ ehãle̱ šika ke̱ nii babaō ke̱ anumnyam hũ ní nibii ní esusuma ſeo̱ le̱ amli eko ebo̱o̱le̱: ši kẽle̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hããle̱ hewale̱ ní eke̱-ye eko, ši *mokpõṅ moṅ yeo̱ le̱: ene̱ le̱ yakayakanoko ke̱ hedšramo̱ ni. *

english_verse: You may live a long time and have a hundred children. But a child born dead is better off than you, unless you enjoy life and have a decent burial.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši moko fo̱ oha, ni eye afii pī, ni efii ní eye le̱ amli gbĩĩ le̱ fá babaō, ši esusuma eto̱o̱ ke̱ nii kpakpai, ni asaṅ enáá fū̃ kpakpa le̱, le̱ le̱ mīkē̱ ake̱: fãṅ šrãkemo̱bi āhũ fèle̱.

english_verse: even if you live two thousand years and don't enjoy life. As you know, we all end up in the same place.
translation_verse: Ni ké̱ eeye afii akpe toi enyo̱ tete, ši eyee nii kpakpai amli ṅõmo̱ ko le̱: ani dšee hekome mei le̱ fẽ yaä?

english_verse: We struggle just to have enough to eat, but we are never satisfied.
translation_verse: Gbomo deṅme ní egboo̱ ne̱ fẽ le̱ edā hewo̱ṅ; ši kẽle̱ esusuma eto̱o̱ gbĩkogbĩko.

english_verse: We may be sensible, yet we are no better off than a fool. And if we are poor, it still doesn't do us any good to try to live right.
translation_verse: Ši meni nilelo̱ ke̱-fè kwašia? ni meni ohĩafo ni le bo̱ní enyieo̱ ye̱ hĩekalo̱i ahĩe le̱ yo̱?

english_verse: It's better to enjoy what we have than to always want something else, because that makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Noni ona he ke̱ ohīṅme̱ii le̱ ehĩ fè noni osusuma feo̱. Ene̱ hũ yakayakanoko ke̱ kō̱yo̱ hakumo̱ ni.

english_verse: Everything that happens was decided long ago. We humans know what we are like, and we can't argue with God, because he is too strong for us.
translation_verse: Nofẽno ni alo le̱, awole̱ gbe̱i momo, ni ale noni gbomo bafe, ni enyẽṅ ni eke̱ moni hewa fèle̱ le̱ abé.

english_verse: The more we talk, the less sense we make, so what good does it do to talk?
translation_verse: Ši wiemo̱i pī ye̱ ní hãa yakayakanii fáa pī, ni mẽ se̱námo̱ yo̱ mli hã gbomo?

english_verse: Life is short and meaningless, and it fades away like a shadow. Who knows what is best for us? Who knows what will happen after we are gone?
translation_verse: Ši namo le noni hĩ hã gbomo ye̱ ewala mli, ewala ni dšee noko le̱ mli gbĩĩ fẽ ní eyeo̱ tamo̱ *hō̃ṅ le̱? Alo namo aagba gbomo noni baba ye̱ ese̱ ye̱ hũlũ šiši ne̱? *

english_verse: A sensible person mourns, but fools always laugh.
translation_verse: Nilelo̱i atšui ye̱ ṅko̱mo̱yeli šĩa, ši kwašiai atšui ye̱ mīše̱ šĩa.

english_verse: Correction from someone wise is better by far than praise from fools.
translation_verse: Ehĩ ake̱ abo nilelo̱ kãmo̱ toi fè noni moko aabo kwašiai alala toi.

english_verse: Foolish laughter is stupid. It sounds like thorns crackling in a fire.
translation_verse: Kwašia ṅmlõ tamo̱ ṅmeii fĕ̱le̱o̱ ye̱ kukwe̱i šiši: ene̱ hũ yakayakanoko ni.

english_verse: Only fools get angry quickly and hold a grudge.
translation_verse: Kāhã omumo̱ mli *mīfu oyá, edšake̱ mlifũ le̱, kwašiai amīnā eyo̱. *Iak.

english_verse: It isn't wise to ask, “Why is everything worse than it used to be?”
translation_verse: Kākē̱ ake̱: Mẽba ni tšutšu gbĩĩ le̱ hĩ fè ene̱mei ne̱? edšake̱ dšee nilē oke̱-bio̱ ene̱ ne̱.

english_verse: I have seen everything during this senseless life of mine. I have seen good citizens die for doing the right thing, while criminals live and prosper.
translation_verse: Mina ene̱mei fẽ ye̱ migbĩĩ ní dšee noko le̱ amli: *dšalo̱ ko ye̱ ní ehĩe kpãtãa ye̱ edšale̱ le̱ mli: ni efõṅfelo̱ ko ye̱ ní ewala se̱ tšeo̱ ye̱ enifõdšianii amli. *

english_verse: Don't die before your time by being too evil or acting like a fool.
translation_verse: Kādše ohe efõṅfelo̱ tūtu, ni asaṅ kāfe kwašia: mẽba oogbo ní obe še̱ko?

english_verse: Keep to the middle of the road. You can do this if you truly respect God.
translation_verse: Ehĩ ake̱ omõ ene̱ mli, ni okadšie onine ye̱ ene̱ hũ he; ši moni šeo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ gbeyei le̱ eedše fẽ mli.

english_verse: Wisdom will make you stronger than the ten most powerful leaders in your city.
translation_verse: Nilē woo̱ nilelo̱ hewale̱ fè no̱yeloi nyoṅma ní yo̱ mã le̱ṅ.

english_verse: Don't listen to everything that everyone says, or you might hear your servant cursing you.
translation_verse: Asaṅ wiemo̱i ní awieo̱ le̱, kādi fẽ se̱, koni okanu ake̱ otšũlo̱ mīlomo̱o.

english_verse: I told myself that I would be smart and try to understand all this, but it was too much for me.
translation_verse: Ene̱mei fẽ le̱ mike̱ nilē eka ekwe̱; mikē̱ ake̱: Makase nilē! ši eke̱ miteṅ dšeke̱.

english_verse: The truth is beyond us. It's far too deep.
translation_verse: Noni yo̱ le̱, šoṅṅ eyo̱, ni omli hũ kwo̱, hē̃, emli kwo̱, namo aana nā?

english_verse: So I decided to learn everything I could and become wise enough to discover what life is all about. At the same time, I wanted to understand why it's stupid and senseless to be an evil fool.
translation_verse: Mitšṍmo̱ mihe ni mike̱ mitšui fõ no̱ ake̱ male, mape̱i mli ni matao nilē ke̱ nibii ašiši, ni male ake̱ nõfõṅfemo̱ le̱ kwašiafemo̱ ni, ni bulufemo̱ le̱ se̱ke̱yeli ni.

english_verse: Here is what I discovered: A bad woman is worse than death. She is a trap, reaching out with body and soul to catch you. But if you obey God, you can escape. If you don't obey, you are done for.
translation_verse: Ni mina ake̱ noko ní dšṍo̱ fè gbĕle dši yō ní etšui le̱ tšõnei ke̱ yāi ni, ni enidši tamo̱ kpãi. Moni sa Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe le̱ aadše odeṅ, ši ešafelo̱ le̱ eedùle̱. Abe̱i

english_verse: With all my wisdom I have tried to find out how everything fits together,
translation_verse: Dšadšelo̱ le̱ ké̱: Na, mina ene̱, mihĩe ekomekome āhũ ni maná dſẽṅmo̱.

english_verse: but so far I have not been able to. I do know there is one good man in a thousand, but never have I found a good woman.
translation_verse: Noni misusuma taoo̱ le̱ minako: mina nū kome ye̱ mei akpe teṅ, ši mínako yō kome ye̱ mene̱mei fẽ ateṅ.

english_verse: I did learn one thing: We were completely honest when God created us, but now we have twisted minds.
translation_verse: Na, ene̱ ke̱ke̱ dši noni mina, ake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ fe gbomo bo̱ni *dša pe̱, ši ame̱ le̱ ame̱taoo̱ ṅai babaō. *Abe̱i

english_verse: The king's word is law. No one can ask him, “Why are you doing this?”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ maṅtše̱ wiemo̱ le̱, hewale̱ ye̱ mli, ni namo aanyẽ akē̱le̱ ake̱: Meni ofeo̱ ne̱?

english_verse: If you obey the king, you will stay out of trouble. So be wise and learn what to do and when to do it.
translation_verse: Moni yeo̱ kitã no̱ le̱, efõṅ ko baṅ eno̱, ni nilelo̱ tšui yoo̱ be ke̱ kodšomo̱.

english_verse: Life is hard, but there is a time and a place for everything,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *nitšumo̱-fẽ-nitšumo̱ ye̱ ebe ke̱ kodšomo̱, ši gbomo he efõṅ fá ye̱ eno̱. *

english_verse: We cannot control the wind or determine the day of our death. There is no escape in time of war, and no one can hide behind evil.
translation_verse: Gbomo be̱ hewale̱ ye̱ mumo̱ no̱, ní eke̱-atšĩ mumo̱ le̱ nā, ni ebe̱ gbĕle gbĩ le̱ no̱ hewale̱, ni ehãã mo gbe̱ ye̱ ta mli; ni nõfõṅ hereṅ moni feo̱ le̱.

english_verse: I noticed all this and thought seriously about what goes on in the world. Why does one person have the power to hurt another? Who Can Understand the Ways of God?
translation_verse: Mina ene̱mei fẽ, ni miṅõ mitšui mifõ nitšumo̱ fẽ ní atšuo̱ ye̱ hũlũ šiši ne̱ no̱: be ye̱ ní gbomo yeo̱ enanyogbomo no̱ ni eke̱-yeo̱ ehe awui.

english_verse: I saw the wicked buried with honor, but God's people had to leave the holy city and were forgotten. None of this makes sense.
translation_verse: Ni nakai noṅṅ mina meifõdši ní afũame̱ ni ame̱bote hedšō̱mo̱ mli; ši mei ní efe nii ní dša le̱ dše hekroṅkroṅ le̱ ame̱te, ni hĩe kpa ame̱no̱ ye̱ mã le̱ṅ. Ene̱ yakayakanoko ni.

english_verse: They commit hundreds of crimes and live a long time, in spite of the saying: Everyone who lives right and respects God will prosper,
translation_verse: Eye̱ mli ake̱ ešafelo̱ feo̱ efõṅ šii oha ni etše̱o̱ ye̱ dšeṅ moṅ, ši kẽle̱ mile ake̱ befẽbe ní fe le̱ mei ní šeo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ gbeyei, ni ame̱šeo̱ gbeyei ye̱ ehĩe le̱, aahĩ ahãame̱. Lal.

english_verse: but no one who sins and rejects God will prosper or live very long.
translation_verse: Ši ehiṅ hãṅ mofõṅ, ni etše̱ṅ ye̱ dšeṅ, etamo̱ hō̃ṅ: edšake̱ ešee gbeyei ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe.

english_verse: There is something else that doesn't make sense to me. Good citizens are treated as criminals, while criminals are honored as though they were good citizens.
translation_verse: Yakayakanoko ye̱ ní afeo̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱: no dši ake̱ dšalo̱i komei ye̱ ní sãdši baä ame̱no̱ koni sa meifõdši anitšumo, ni meifõdši komei hù ye̱ ni sãdši baä ame̱no̱ bo̱ni sa dšalo̱i anitšumo̱. Mike̱ ake̱: Ene̱ hũ yakayakanoko ni!

english_verse: So I think we should get as much out of life as we possibly can. There is nothing better than to enjoy our food and drink and have a good time. Then we can make it through this troublesome life that God has given us here on earth.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mikafo mīše̱; *edšake̱ ekpakpa ko be̱ hã gbomo ye̱ hũlũ šiši ne̱ fè noni eeye nii ní enu ni ená mīše̱; ni ene̱ noṅṅ baka ehe ye̱ edeṅme ní egbo le̱ mli, ye̱ ewala gbĩī fẽ ní Nyoṅmo̱ ehãle ye̱ hũlũ šiši ne̱ nii. *

english_verse: Day and night I went without sleep, trying to understand what goes on in this world.
translation_verse: Beni míke̱ mitšuì fō no̱ ake̱ male nii ni makwe̱ nii ní atšuo̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱, bo̱ni ſane ke̱ nyoṅ fẽ le̱ gbomo enaa wo̱ ke̱ ehĩṅme̱ii le̱:

english_verse: I saw everything God does, and I realized no one can really understand what happens. We may be very wise, but no matter how much we try or how much we claim to know, we cannot understand it all.
translation_verse: keke ni mina Nyoṅmo̱ nitšumo̱ le̱ fẽ, ni mina ake̱ gbomo nyẽṅ ana nitšumo̱ ní atšuo̱ ye̱ hũlũ šiši ne̱ nā; edšake̱ ké̱ gbomo gbo deṅme etao nā ake̱ mẽ, enaṅ; ni ké̱ nilelo̱ ké̱ eele hũ, eleṅ.

english_verse: I thought about these things. Then I understood that God has power over everyone, even those who are wise and live right. Anything can happen to any one of us, and so we never know if life will be good or bad.
translation_verse: Mike̱ ene̱ fẽ fõ mitšui no̱ ní matao fẽ mli: ake̱ dšalo̱i ke̱ nilelo̱i ke̱ ame̱nitšumo̱i le̱, Nyoṅmo̱ deṅ yo̱; suomo̱ ni dšio, nyē̱ ni dšio, gbomo ko lee; fẽ dſere ame̱hĩe.

english_verse: It's terribly unfair for the same thing to happen to each of us. We are mean and foolish while we live, and then we die.
translation_verse: Ene̱ dši efõṅ ye̱ nii fẽ ni afeo̱ ye̱ hũlũ šiši ne̱ mli, ake̱-ní ošrã kome šrãa mei fẽ le̱, *nohewo̱ hũ ni gbomei abii atšuiiaṅ eyimo̱ obõbõ ke̱ efõṅ, ni se̱ke̱yeli soṅṅ yo̱ ame̱tšuiiaṅ ye̱ ame̱wala be mli: ni no se̱ le̱ — ame̱yaä gbohĩĩ le̱ aṅõ.

english_verse: As long as we are alive, we still have hope, just as a live dog is better off than a dead lion.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ moni fata hĩekãlo̱i fẽ he le̱, hĩeno̱kãmo̱ ye̱ hãle̱ kẽ; edšake̱ gbé ní hĩe kã le̱ ehĩ fè dšata ní egbo.

english_verse: Their loves, their hates, and their jealous feelings have all disappeared with them. They will never again take part in anything that happens on this earth.
translation_verse: Amè̱suomo̱ dšio, ame̱nyē̱ dšio, ame̱wuṅāyeli dšio, fẽ eho ete dšeeṅmõ bēbe, ni ame̱be̱ gbe̱fãṅnõ ko doṅṅ ke̱-mīya nāno̱ ye̱ nii fẽ ní afeo̱ ye̱ hũlũ šiši ne̱ mli.

english_verse: So be happy and enjoy eating and drinking! God decided long ago that this is what you should do.
translation_verse: Ya ni oyaye obolo ke̱ mīše̱, ní oyanu owein ke̱ tšuidšũrõ; ši onitšumo̱i le̱ esa Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe momo.

english_verse: Dress up, comb your hair, and look your best.
translation_verse: Hã otadei aye̱ befẽbe, ni mũ hũ akakpa ye̱ oyiteṅ.

english_verse: Life is short, and you love your wife, so enjoy being with her. This is what you are supposed to do as you struggle through life on this earth.
translation_verse: *Oke̱ oṅã ní osumoo̱ le̱ ahĩ ši ye̱ mīše̱ mli, ye̱ owala gbĩĩ ní dšee noko ní ehão ye̱ hũlũ šiši ne̱, ní dši ogbĩĩ ní dšee noko le̱ fẽ mli; edšake̱ owala ke̱ odeṅme ní ogboo̱ ye̱ hũlũ šiši ne̱ mli gbe̱fãṅnõ ní onáa dši no. *Abe̱i

english_verse: Here is something else I have learned: The fastest runners and the greatest heroes don't always win races and battles. Wisdom, intelligence, and skill don't always make you healthy, rich, or popular. We each have our own share of misfortune.
translation_verse: Misā mina ya hũlũ šiši, ake̱ dšee heoyátše̱mei anõ dši foidamo̱, ni dšee ekãto̱i hũ anõ dši ta, ni asaṅ dšee nilelo̱i anõi dši abolo, ni asaṅ dšee sanese̱ko̱lo̱i anõ dši nii ni asaṅ dšee ṅālo̱i anõ dši hĩenyam; ši ame̱fē le̱ be ke̱ ame̱šē̱ mli dše̱o̱. Ier.

english_verse: None of us know when we might fall victim to a sudden disaster and find ourselves like fish in a net or birds in a trap. Better To Be Wise than Foolish
translation_verse: Ši gbomo hũ lee ebe: tamo̱ lōi ní olōo̱ame̱ ye̱ yā fõṅ mli, lo lofõdši ni adũo̱ame̱ ye̱ tšõne mli le̱, nakai noṅṅ adũo̱ gbomei abii ye̱ be fõṅ mli, ké̱ ebaninaame̱ trukā le̱.

english_verse: Once I saw what people really think of wisdom, and it made an impression on me.
translation_verse: Asaṅ ne̱ke̱ nilē ne̱ mina ye̱ hũlũ šiši, ni eda kple ye̱ mihĩe:

english_verse: It happened when a powerful ruler surrounded and attacked a small city where only a few people lived. The enemy army was getting ready to break through the city walls.
translation_verse: maṅ bibiō ko ye̱ ni emli hĩĩ fáá, ni maṅtše̱ agbo ko batuale̱ ni ebo̱ nsra ewo ehe; ni etſa káwō-gbogboi wudši ewo he;

english_verse: But the city was saved by the wisdom of a poor person who was soon forgotten.
translation_verse: ni ana nū ohĩafo nilelo̱ ko ye̱ mli, ni eke̱ enilē le̱ here maṅ le̱ etá ši; ši mokomoko kaii nakai nū ohĩafo le̱.

english_verse: So I decided that wisdom is better than strength. Yet if you are poor, no one pays any attention to you, no matter how smart you are.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mikē̱: Nilē hĩ fè hewale̱; kẽ-le̱ abuu ohĩafo nilē, ni ewiemo̱i hũ aboo toi.

english_verse: Words of wisdom spoken softly make much more sense than the shouts of a ruler to a crowd of fools.
translation_verse: Nilelo̱i awiemo̱i ni ame̱wieo̱ ble̱ō le̱ anuo̱ fè no̱yelo̱ blo̱mo̱ ní eblo̱ö̱ ye̱ kwašiai ateṅ.

english_verse: Wisdom is more powerful than weapons, yet one mistake can destroy all the good you have done.
translation_verse: Nilē hĩ fè tawūnii; ši ešafelo̱ kome fiteo̱ ekpakpa babaō.

english_verse: If you don't sharpen your ax, it will be harder to use; if you are wise, you'll know what to do.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši mo dade nā gbo ni edšo̱o̱ nā le̱, bĕle̱ dša eke̱ hewale̱ pī to he; ši nilē ake̱-feo̱ nõ ni ehĩo̱.

english_verse: The power to charm a snake does you no good if it bites you anyway.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši *onũfũ aakõ mo dãni aye he ṅkunyã le̱, bĕle̱ se̱námo̱ ko be̱ hã ṅkũnyāyeli le̱. *Lal.

english_verse: If you talk sensibly, you will have friends; if you talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Nilelo̱ dāṅ wiemo̱i ye̱ nyam; ši kwašia nābu amĩ le̱dientše̱ ehe.

english_verse: They never tire of talking, but none of us really know what the future will bring.
translation_verse: Kwašia *wieo̱ babaō, ši gbomo lee noni baä, ni noni baba ye̱ ese̱ hũ, †namo aanyẽ agbale̱? *

english_verse: A country is in for trouble when its ruler is childish, and its leaders party all day long.
translation_verse: Kpóo hão, lo šikpoṅ ní omaṅtše le̱ igbekẽ ni; ni olumei ṅmẽo̱ okplõ lebi mrã le̱! *Ies.

english_verse: But a nation will prosper when its ruler is mature, and its leaders don't party too much.
translation_verse: Adšŏ̱o, bo šikpoṅ ní omaṅtše̱ le̱ abladei abi ni, ni olumei le̱ ṅmẽo̱ okplõ ye̱ be ni sa mli, ye̱ hewale̱námo̱ hewo̱, ši dšee dā̃tō̱ hewo̱ṅ le̱!

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to fix a leaky roof— then the house collapses.
translation_verse: Hedšõ hãa mplãṅi wuleo̱ woo̱ mli, ni nidšiaṅ-ṅõmo̱ hãa tšũ dũo̱. Abe̱i

english_verse: Eating and drinking make you feel happy, and money can buy everything you need.
translation_verse: Ṅmlõ hewo̱ aṅmẽo̱ okplŏ, ni *wein hàa hĩekãlo̱i amī še̱o̱ ame̱he, ni šika feo̱ nofẽno. *Kodš.

english_verse: Don't let yourself think about cursing the king; don't curse the rich, not even in secret. A little bird might hear and tell everything.
translation_verse: Kālomo̱ *maṅtše̱ ye̱ oyitšoṅ tete, ni kālomo̱ niiatše̱ ye̱ ose̱tšũ mli; edšake̱ ṅwei loflõ ko aawó ogbē ke̱-ate, ni fĩdšiatše̱ ko aayagba sane le̱. *

english_verse: Be generous, and someday you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Še̱ obolo ofõ nu hĩe, ši wó̱se̱ ko āhũ le̱ oona ekoṅ. Abe̱i

english_verse: Share what you have with seven or eight others, because you never know when disaster may strike.
translation_verse: Dšā mli ohã mei kpawo ke̱ mei kpānyo̱; ši olee nõ efõṅ ní baba šikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: If you worry about the weather and don't plant seeds, you won't harvest a crop.
translation_verse: Moni sraä kō̱yo̱ le̱, edũṅ nii, ni moni kwe̱o̱ atatui le̱, ekpaṅ nii.

english_verse: No one can explain how a baby breathes before it is born. So how can anyone explain what God does? After all, God created everything.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni alee *kō̱yo̱ gbe̱ ke̱ bo̱ni wui feo̱ dăraä ye̱ yōho̱lo̱ mũsũṅ le̱, nakai noo̱ṅ †olee Nyoṅmo̱ ni feo̱ nii fẽ le̱ nitšumo̱. *Ioh.

english_verse: Plant your seeds early in the morning and keep working in the field until dark. Who knows? Your work might pay off, and your seeds might produce. Youth and Old Age
translation_verse: Lebi le̱ dũ odũmo̱nii le̱, ni gbe̱ke̱ hũ kādšie onine ye̱ he; edšake̱ olee emli noni bahĩ, ene̱ dšio, ene̱ dšio, alo ekole̱ enyo̱ le̱ fẽ bahĩ pe̱pē̱pe̱ dšio.

english_verse: Nothing on earth is more beautiful than the morning sun.
translation_verse: Asaṅ la nõ, ni ké̱ hĩṅme̱i mīna hũlũ le̱, eṅõ enā.

english_verse: Be cheerful and enjoy life while you are young! Do what you want and find pleasure in what you see. But don't forget that God will judge you for everything you do.
translation_verse: Oblanyo, hã omī aše̱ ohe ye̱ oblahĩaṅ, ni oná tšuidšrŭrõ ye̱ oblahīaṅ gbĩī le̱ amli, ni onyie otšui gbè̱i le̱ ano̱, ke̱ nii ní ohĩṅme̱ii naä le̱ ase̱: ši ná ole ake̱ ene̱mei fẽ hewo̱ le̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ke̱o bakodšo.

english_verse: Rid yourself of all worry and pain, because the wonderful moments of youth quickly disappear.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ dšiemo̱ aw̌ere̱hō ke̱-dše̱ etsui mli, ni ohã nõfõṅ adše ohelo mli; ši gbekẽbiiaši ke̱ oblahĩaṅ le̱ yakayakanii ni!

english_verse: So our bodies return to the earth, and the life-giving breath returns to God.
translation_verse: ni *sũ le̱ aakũ ese̱ aya šikpoṅ, bo̱ni eyo̱ le̱ noṅṅ, ni mumo̱ le̱ aakũ ese̱ aya Nyoṅmo̱ ní ṅõ-hã le̱ ṅõ le̱. *

english_verse: Nothing makes sense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense. Respect and Obey God
translation_verse: Yakayakanii amli yakayakanõ! dšadšelo̱ le̱ ké̱, fẽ le̱ yakayakanii ni!

english_verse: I was a wise teacher with much understanding, and I collected a number of proverbs that I had carefully studied.
translation_verse: Ake̱-ni dšadšelo̱ le̱ le nii hewo̱ le̱, ekā he̱ e̱tšõ maṅ le̱ nilē, ni edſẽṅ nibii ahe̱ ni etao mli, ni *ebubū abe̱i babaō hũ. *

english_verse: Then I tried to explain these things in the best and most accurate way.
translation_verse: Dšadšelo̱ le̱ tao ní ena wiemo̱i ní ṅõ, ni noni eṅmã ne̱, dšale̱ ke̱ ano̱kwale wiemo̱i ni.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are like the stick a farmer uses to make animals move. These sayings come from a shepherd, and they are like nails that fasten things together.
translation_verse: Nilelo̱i awiemo̱i tamo̱ *tšina kplamo̱-akplo̱i, ni ame̱tamo̱ ple̱kobii ní akăla, tōkwe̱lo kome bua ene̱mei fẽ nā. *Heb.

english_verse: My child, I warn you to stay away from any teachings except these. There is no end to books, and too much study will wear you out.
translation_verse: Ni noni eſe̱ le̱, mibi, hã mawoö ṅā! Wodši babaō femo̱ le̱ ebe̱ nāgbē, ni nikasemo̱ tūtu le̱ ehãa e̱to̱ö̱ helo.

english_verse: Everything you were taught can be put into a few words: Respect and obey God! This is what life is all about.
translation_verse: Nyehãa wo̱boa sãdši le̱ fẽ *nāgbē toi: Še Nyoṅmo̱ gbeyei ni oye ekitãi le̱ ano̱! ši ene̱ dši gbomei fẽ agbe̱nā. *

english_verse: God will judge everything we do, even what is done in secret, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ bakodšo nitšumo̱-fẽ-nitšumo̱ ke̱ tēmosane-fē-tēmo̱sane hũ, ekpakpa dšio̱, efõṅ dšio. Rom.

english_verse: and you smell so sweet. All the young women adore you; the very mention of your name is like spreading perfume. *
translation_verse: Omũi le̱ dšeo̱ ṅma naakpa; ogbe̱i le̱ tamo̱ mũ-ke̱-ṅma ní afo̱se aſie ši, nohewo̱ ni oblayei le̱ sumoo̱o le̱.

english_verse: My dearest, if you don't know, just follow the path of the sheep. Then feed your young goats near the shepherds' tents.
translation_verse: *Bo, moni ohe yo̱ fe̱o fè fẽ ye̱ yei ateṅ, ké̱ olee le̱ dše kpo ni oyadša tōiku le̱ ase̱ mò, ni oyalè̱ otōalotiai abii le̱ ye̱ tōkwe̱loi le̱ abūi le̱ amase̱i. *

english_verse: You move as gracefully as the pony that leads the chariot of the king.
translation_verse: Mišienye; mike̱o mīto Farao ſilii le̱ anā okpōṅo̱i le̱ ateṅ ekome he

english_verse: Earrings add to your beauty, and you wear a necklace of precious stones.
translation_verse: Odabii ye̱ fe̱o ye̱ wulamo̱nii le̱ ateṅ, okue̱ hù ye̱ fe̱o ke̱ dſinei ni atšẽrẽ!

english_verse: Let's make you some jewelry of gold, woven with silver. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Wobafe šika dſinei akue̱nii ke̱ dſie̱tei klo̱pei wo̱hão.

english_verse: My king, while you were on your couch, my aroma was a magic charm.
translation_verse: Meni maṅtše̱ le̱ tá ekplõ le̱ le le̱, bĕle̱ minardo-mũ le̱ mĩdše ṅma.

english_verse: My darling, you are perfume between my breasts;
translation_verse: Misuolo̱ le̱ tamo̱ mire kutša ní kã mifufo̱i aleṅ.

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely, so very lovely— your eyes are those of a dove. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Na, *ohe ye̱ fe̱o, mišienye; na, ohe ye̱ fe̱o! Ohĩṅme̱ii tamo̱ okpo hĩṅmeii. *

english_verse: in the shade of cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: Wo̱tšũ le̱ mplãṅi le̱ tšenedru ni, ni wo̱ṅmoṅmodli le̱ se̱se̱o ni.

english_verse: I am merely a rose from the land of Sharon, a lily from the valley. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Mi le̱ Šaron fo̱fo̱i ke̱, dšō̱i amli ofló̱-fo̱fo̱i dšimi.

english_verse: My darling, when compared with other young women, you are a lily among thorns. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Bo̱ni ofló̱-fo̱fo̱i yo̱ ye̱ ṅmei ateṅ le̱, nakai mišienye le̱ tamo̱ ye̱ biyei le̱ ateṅ.

english_verse: like a deer or a gazelle. Now he stands outside our wall, looking through the window
translation_verse: Misuolo̱ le̱ tamo̱ *soṅãi lo ofrote oblanyo. Na, edamo̱ wo̱gbogbo le̱ se̱, ēkwe̱ samfe̱dši le̱ amli, ēfli samfe̱dši ke̱ ame̱mli fo̱dši le̱ amli. *K.

english_verse: and speaking to me. He Speaks: My darling, I love you! Let's go away together.
translation_verse: Misuolo̱ le̱ here no̱ ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Te ši ní oba wo̱te, mišienye, mimo ní he yo̱ fe̱o!

english_verse: Winter is past, the rain has stopped;
translation_verse: Edšake̱ na, fẽibe le̱ eho, nyoṅmo̱ne̱mo̱ le̱ ekpa ni efõ kwrā;

english_verse: flowers cover the earth, it's time to sing. The cooing of doves is heard in our land.
translation_verse: fo̱fo̱i mīpue ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, lala be le̱ eše̱, ní ānu kose̱-okpo gbē ye̱ wo̱šikpoṅ le̱ no̱;

english_verse: Fig trees are bearing fruit, while blossoms on grapevines fill the air with perfume. My darling, I love you! Let's go away together.
translation_verse: agbãmitšo mīhã eyibii ṅmlikitii le̱ mītšutšui, ni weintšei hũ egbagbā afofroi ni dšeo̱ ṅma. Te ši ní oba wo̱te, mišenye, mimo ni he yo̱ fe̱o!

english_verse: Our vineyards are in blossom; we must catch the little foxes that destroy the vineyards. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Nyemõmo̱a oso̱i nyehãawo, oso̱i bibii ní fiteo̱ weintromi le̱; edšake̱ wo̱weintšei le̱ egba afofro.

english_verse: My darling, I am yours, and you are mine, as you feed your sheep among the lilies.
translation_verse: Minõ dši misuolo̱ le̱, ni mi hũ enõ dšimi, ofló̱-fo̱fo̱ii ateṅ elè̱o̱ etōi le̱ ye̱.

english_verse: Pretend to be a young deer dancing on mountain slopes until daylight comes and shadows fade away.
translation_verse: Misuolo̱, tšṍ ohe ni *ofe tamo̱ soṅãi lo ofrote oblanyo ye̱ gõdši ní agblagbla mli le̱ ano̱, ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní hũlũ nā aaba ši, ni susumai aalādše. *

english_verse: While in bed at night, I reached for the one I love with heart and soul. I looked for him, but he wasn't there.
translation_verse: Meni dše na le̱, mitao moni misusuma sumoo̱ le̱ ye̱ misā le̱ no̱; *mitaole̱, ši minaale̱. *

english_verse: I even asked the guards patrolling the town, “Have you seen the one I love so much?”
translation_verse: Bulo̱i ni kpaä ši ye̱ mã le̱ṅ le̱ baninami, mibiame̱ ake̱: Nyena moni misusuma sumoo̱ le̱ lo?

english_verse: Right after that, I found him. I held him and would not let go until I had taken him to the home of my mother.
translation_verse: Miho ame̱he fiō pe̱, ni mina moni misusuma sumoo̱ le̱. Mimõ emli ní minmē̃ē̃ ehe āhũ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní mike̱le̱ *ba minye we le̱ ke̱ moni fo̱mi le̱ se̱tšũ leṅ.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me by the power of deer and gazelles, never to awaken love before it is ready. The Groom and the Wedding Party Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Nye Ierusalem biyei, mina soṅãii ke̱ ṅãno̱ ofroteyei ake̱: Nyekahosoa ni nyekatšĩea misuomo̱ le̱ hĩe, ke̱-yaši be ní le̱dientše̱ esumoo̱!

english_verse: What do we see approaching from the desert like a cloud of smoke? With it comes the sweet smell of spices, including myrrh and frankincense.
translation_verse: Namo dši moni dše ṅã le̱ no̱ baä tamo̱ lasũ kusū ní teo̱ ši, ni ehe dšeo̱ ṅma ke̱ mire ke̱ kro̱bo̱o ke̱ dšrayelo̱i atšofāi sro̱toi fẽ ne̱?

english_verse: It is King Solomon carried on a throne, surrounded by sixty of Israel's best soldiers.
translation_verse: Na, Salomo akpãkãi le̱ ni! Ekãlo̱i nyoṅmai-ekpa ní dše̱ Israel ekãlo̱i le̱ ateṅ le̱ ebo̱le he.

english_verse: Each of them wears a sword. They are experts at fighting, even in the dark.
translation_verse: Ame̱fẽ-kwa amehĩe klante, ní ame̱he esa ke̱ tawū; mofēmo klante ṅmō ehe̱ ye̱ nyŏṅ gbeyeišemo̱ hewo̱,

english_verse: The throne is made of trees from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Maṅtše̱ Salomo ke̱ Lebanon tšei fe sātšo fe̱fe̱o hã ehe.

english_verse: Its posts are silver, the back is gold, and the seat is covered with purple cloth. You women of Jerusalem have taken great care to furnish the inside.
translation_verse: Ehe akulašĩṅi le̱ eke̱ dſtete̱i fe, ekpasamo̱he te šika ni, etámo̱he le̱ mama afaseo ni, Ierusalem biyei le̱ wala emligbe̱ te ke̱ suomo̱.

english_verse: Now come and see the crown given to Solomon by his mother on his happy wedding day.
translation_verse: Nye Zion biyei, nyedšea kpo nyebakwe̱a maṅtše̱ Salomo ke̱ akekre ní enye ṅō-fĩle ye̱ eyõkpēmo̱ gbĩ ke̱ etšui-dšũrõnámo̱ gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱!

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely, so very lovely— as you look through your veil, your eyes are those of a dove. Your hair tosses about as gracefully as goats coming down from Gilead.
translation_verse: Na, ehe ye̱ fe̱o, mišienye! na, ohe ye̱ fe̱o, ní ohĩmeii *tamo̱ okpo hĩṅme̱ii ye̱ ohĩehãnõ le̱ mli. †Oyitšo̱i tamo̱ tōabotiai aku ní bumo̱ ši ye̱ Gilead goṅ le̱ he. *

english_verse: Your lips are crimson cords, your mouth is shapely; behind your veil are hidden beautiful rosy cheeks.
translation_verse: Onābu tamo̱ kpã tšuru, ni odāṅ ye̱ fe̱o. *Odabii tamo̱ granata fē̱i ye̱ ohĩe-hānõ le̱ mli.

english_verse: Your breasts are perfect; they are twin deer feeding among lilies.
translation_verse: *Ofufo̱i enyo̱ te tamo̱ yō̱bii enyo̱, alo soṅãibii hãdši ní yeo̱ nii ye̱ ofló̱-fo̱fo̱ii ateṅ.

english_verse: I will hasten to those hills sprinkled with sweet perfume and stay there till sunrise.
translation_verse: Mate mire goṅ te ke̱ kro̱bo̱o goṅkpo̱ te no̱ mayašẽra ši, *ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni hũlũ nā aaba ši ni susumai aalādše. *

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely in every way.
translation_verse: Ohe ye̱ fe̱o ke̱-yi ši, mišienye, ní kpa ko kpa ko be̱ ohe! Lal.

english_verse: My bride, together we will leave Lebanon! We will say goodbye to the peaks of Mount Amana, Senir, and Hermon, where lions and leopards live in the caves.
translation_verse: Oke̱mi adše̱ Lebanon, ayemforo, oke̱mi adše̱ Lebanon ke̱-ya, dše̱ Amana yiteṅ oba ní wo̱te, dše̱ Senir ke̱ Hermon, dše̱ dšatai asihĩle̱hei, dše̱ kŏtše̱mei agõdši le̱ ano̱ oba ni wo̱te!

english_verse: My bride, my very own, you have stolen my heart! With one glance from your eyes and the glow of your necklace, you have stolen my heart.
translation_verse: Minyemi, ayemforo, oṅõ mitšui! Oke okwe̱mo̱ ní okwe̱mi šikome le̱ ke̱ okue̱nii le̱ ateṅ ekome eṅõ mitšui.

english_verse: Your love is sweeter than wine; the smell of your perfume is more fragrant than spices.
translation_verse: Minyemi, ayemforo, osuomo̱ le̱ ye̱ fe̱o pi! Osuomo̱ le̱ ṅō āhũ fè wein, omũ le̱ dšeo̱ ṅma fè tšofãi-ke̱-ṅmai sro̱toi fẽ!

english_verse: Your lips are a honeycomb; milk and honey flow from your tongue. Your dress has the aroma of cedar trees from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Ayemforo, onābui tšereo̱ wò ſieo̱ ši; wò ke̱ fufo̱ ye̱ olile̱i šiši, ni oheboi le̱ amli ṅma tamo̱ Lebanon ṅma.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, you are a garden, a fountain closed off to all others.
translation_verse: Minyemi ayemforo te tamo̱ trom ní aṅmẽ nā ke̱ nu ní baä ní aṅmẽ nā ke̱ nubu ní aso̱o nā.

english_verse: Your arms are vines, covered with delicious fruits and all sorts of spices— henna, nard,
translation_verse: Otšeifo̱bii le̱ tamo̱ granatai atrom fe̱he̱o ke̱ tšeiayibii ní dšra wa, kofer fo̱fo̱i, ke̱ nardo fiā,

english_verse: saffron, calamus, cinnamon, frankincense, myrrh, and aloes —all the finest spices.
translation_verse: nardo ke̱ karkom, kānē ke̱ sinamon ke̱ kro̱bo̱o tšei fẽ, mire ke̱ aloë ke̱ tšofāi-ke̱-ṅmai titrii le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: You are a spring in the garden, a fountain of pure water, and a refreshing stream from Mount Lebanon. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Tromi ateṅ nubu ke̱ wala nubu, ke̱ fāi ní dše̱o̱ Lebanon no̱ hoo̱ dšio.

english_verse: Let the north wind blow, the south wind too! Let them spread the aroma of my garden, so the one I love may enter and taste its delicious fruits.
translation_verse: Te ši, kōyigbe̱ kō̱yo̱, ni oba, wuoyigbe̱ kō̱yo̱, ní obatſa ye̱ mitrom le̱ mli, ni etšofãi-ke̱-ṅmai atšere aſíe ši! Hă misuolo̱ le̱ aba etrom le̱ mli, ni ebaye etšeiayibii ní dšra wa le̱.

english_verse: And I yearned for him while he spoke to me, but when I opened the door, my darling had disappeared. I searched and shouted, but I could not find him— there was no answer.
translation_verse: Ši beni migble misuolo̱ te, etšṍ ehe ke̱-te momo. Beni ewieo̱ le̱, mitšui fã. *Mitaole̱, ši minaale̱; mitšé̱le̱, ši ehereemi no̱ hũ. *

english_verse: Then I was found by the guards patrolling the town and guarding the wall. They beat me up and stripped off my robe.
translation_verse: Bulo̱i ní kpaä ši ye̱ mã le̱ṅ le̱ baninami: ame̱tſiami nii, amepilami; gbogbo no̱ bulo̱i le̱ šõ mihĩehādõ le̱.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, if you find the one I love, please say to him, “She is weak with desire.” Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Mīkãnye kitã, nye Ierusalem biyei, ake̱: Ke̱dši nyena misuolo̱ le̱, nyekē̱ale̱ ake̱ šuomo̱ *ewomi hela. *

english_verse: Most beautiful of women, why is the one you love more special than others? Why do you ask us to tell him how you feel? She Speaks:
translation_verse: Meni osuolo̱ le̱ ke̱-fè suolo̱ kroko bo moni ohe yo̱ fe̱o fè fẽ ye̱ yei ateṅ? Meni osuolo̱ le̱ ke̱-fè suolo̱ kroko, hewo̱ ni okãawo̱ kitā ne̱ke̱ ne̱!

english_verse: He is handsome and healthy, the most outstanding among ten thousand.
translation_verse: Misuolo̱ le̱ ye̱o̱ ni etšuo̱, le̱ dši otu ye̱ mei akpei-nyoṅma teṅ.

english_verse: His head is purest gold; his hair is wavy, black as a raven.
translation_verse: Eyitšo tamo̱ šika ṅmīṅmi, eyitšo̱i edŏ̱ro̱dŏ̱ro̱i, ni edĩo tamo̱ kwãkwãlabite.

english_verse: His eyes are a pair of doves bathing in a stream flowing with milk.
translation_verse: Ehĩṅme̱ii *tamo̱ okpoi ní yo̱ fāi ahe, ní edšu ame̱he ke̱ fufo̱, tamo̱ tei ní dšra wa ní ake-trá nibii amli pe̱pē̱pe̱. *

english_verse: His face is a garden of sweet-smelling spices; his lips are lilies dripping with perfume.
translation_verse: Edabii tamo̱ tšokā-ke̱-ṅma akofii, tamo̱ nii ní dšeo̱ ṅma agoṅkpo̱i. Enābu tamo̱ ofló̱-fo̱fo̱i fe̱fe̱o ní mli tšereo̱ mire ṅleṅle.

english_verse: His arms are branches of gold covered with jewels; his body is ivory decorated with sapphires.
translation_verse: Enidši tamo̱ šika gai ní ake̱ krisolito-te̱i etrá mli. Egbomotšo le̱ tamo̱ ſuo̱wu ní akpe̱ ni ake̱ safiro-te̱i eha he.

english_verse: His legs are columns of marble on feet of gold. He stands there majestic like Mount Lebanon and its choice cedar trees.
translation_verse: Eſũo̱dei tamo̱ te̱i ye̱dši akulašĩṅi ní mãmo̱ šika no̱damo̱nii ano̱. Esu tamo̱ Lebanon, eye̱ fe̱o tamo̱ tšenedrutšei.

english_verse: His kisses are sweet. I desire him so much! Young women of Jerusalem, he is my lover and friend.
translation_verse: Edāṅ wiemo̱ ṅõ naakpa, ní ehe nofẽno saä mo hĩe. Misuolo̱ le̱ ne̱, mišientše̱ le̱ ne̱, nye Ierusalem biyei!

english_verse: And I yearned for him while he spoke to me, but when I opened the door, my darling had disappeared. I searched and shouted, but I could not find him— there was no answer.
translation_verse: Ši beni migble misuolo̱ te, etšṍ ehe ke̱-te momo. Beni ewieo̱ le̱, mitšui fã. *Mitaole̱, ši minaale̱; mitšé̱le̱, ši ehereemi no̱ hũ. *

english_verse: Then I was found by the guards patrolling the town and guarding the wall. They beat me up and stripped off my robe.
translation_verse: Bulo̱i ní kpaä ši ye̱ mã le̱ṅ le̱ baninami: ame̱tſiami nii, amepilami; gbogbo no̱ bulo̱i le̱ šõ mihĩehādõ le̱.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, if you find the one I love, please say to him, “She is weak with desire.” Their Friends Speak:

english_verse: Most beautiful of women, why is the one you love more special than others? Why do you ask us to tell him how you feel? She Speaks:
