translation_verse: .] Suomo̱yibii le̱ mīdše ṅma, ni yibii ní dšra wa sro̱toi fẽ ye̱ wo̱šĩnā le̱ ši; ehēi ke̱ ememedši fẽ, mike̱-to mihão, misuolo̱.

english_verse: If you were my brother, I could kiss you whenever we happen to meet, and no one would say I did wrong.
translation_verse: Miná ni kũle̱ otamo̱ minyeminū ní ye minye fufo̱! Kũle̱ ké̱ minao ye̱ agbó nā le̱ maſo̱ onā, ní moko egbeṅ mihe guo̱.

english_verse: Put your left hand under my head and embrace me with your right arm.
translation_verse: Enineabe̱ku ye̱ miyitšo šiši, ni eninedšũrõ mīlōmi atū.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me never to awaken love before it is ready. Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Nye Ierusalem biyei, mikãnye kitã, ake̱ nyekahosoa ni nyekatšĩea misuomo̱ le̱ hĩe, ke̱-yaši be ní le̱dientše̱ esumoo̱!

english_verse: Who is this young woman coming in from the desert and leaning on the shoulder of the one she loves? She Speaks: I stirred up your passions under the apple tree where you were born.
translation_verse: Namo dši yō ne̱ ní dše̱ ṅã le̱ no̱ baä, ní ekpasa esuolo̱ le̱ ne̱? Mitsĩe ohĩe ye̱ akututšo le̱ šiši; tše̱i onye kõmo̱o ye̱, dšei moni fo̱o le̱ kõmo̱ ye̱.

english_verse: Always keep me in your heart and wear this bracelet to remember me by. The passion of love bursting into flame is more powerful than death, stronger than the grave.
translation_verse: Nomi okpe̱te̱ otšui no̱ tamo̱ wolonāso̱omo̱nō, ṅõmi okpe̱te̱ onine no̱ tamo̱ wolonāso̱omo̱nõ. Edšake̱ suomo̱ he wa tamo̱ gbĕle, awuṅãyeli hũ yi wa tamo̱ gbohĩĩadše, earãmãṅi le̱ la osrãmãṅi ke̱ Iehowa lēlilei po!

english_verse: Love cannot be drowned by oceans or floods. It cannot be bought— any offer would be scorned no matter how great. Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Nu babaō nyẽẽ suomo̱ agbe, ni fāi nyẽẽ eno̱ aha. Ke̱dši moko ṅõ ešĩanii fẽ ehã ní eke̱-he suomo̱ le̱, ṅmõ abaṅmõle̱.

english_verse: We have a little sister whose breasts are not yet formed. If someone asks to marry her, what should we do?
translation_verse: Wo̱ye̱ nyemiyō fiō ko ní edšeko fufo̱. Meni wo̱o̱fe wo̱hã wo̱nyemiyō le̱ gbĩ ní aababi eši le̱?

english_verse: I am a wall around a city, my breasts are towers, and just looking at me brings him great pleasure.
translation_verse: Mi le̱, gbogbo dšimi, ni mifufoi tamo̱ mõdši ní kwŏ̱lo̱; ke̱ke̱ ni mitšṍ tamo̱ moko ní ená hedšo̱le̱ ye̱ ehĩe.

english_verse: Solomon has a vineyard at Baal-Hamon, which he rents to others for a thousand pieces of silver each.
translation_verse: Salomo ye̱ weintrom ye̱ Baal-Hamon; eṅõ weintrom le̱ ehã kwe̱foi, koni mofẽmo abahãle̱ dſie̱te̱i kukudši akpe ye̱ emli yibii le̱ ahewo̱.

english_verse: My vineyard is mine alone! Solomon can keep his silver and the others can keep their share of the profits. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Miweintrom ní dší minõ le̱ ye̱ mi-deṅ. Bo, Salomo, ooná akpe le̱, ni mei ní kwe̱o̱ emli yibii le̱ hũ aaná ohai-enyo̱.

english_verse: You are in the garden with friends all around. Let me hear your voice! She Speaks:
translation_verse: Bo moni ohĩo̱ tromi le̱ amli, *nanemei le̱ mībo ogbē toi: Hã mi hũ manu! *Lal.

english_verse: Hurry to me, my darling! Run faster than a deer to mountains of spices.
translation_verse: Dšo foi, misuolo̱, ni otšṍ *tamo̱ soṅăi lo tamo̱ ofrote oblanyo ye̱ tšofã-ke̱-ṅma gõdši le̱ ano̱! *

english_verse: “Who asked you to bring all this when you come to worship me? Stay out of my temple!
translation_verse: Ke̱dši nyeba nyebapue ye̱ mihĩe le̱, namo taoo̱ ene̱ ye̱ nyedeṅ ake̱ nyebanānā mikpoi le̱ ano̱?

english_verse: But if you turn against me, your enemies will kill you. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Condemns Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši nyekplẽẽ ni nyetše atũa le̱, klante moṅ aayenye! Edšake̱ Iehowa nābu ewie.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are like an unfaithful wife. Once your judges were honest and your people lived right; now you are a city full of murderers.
translation_verse: Té fe tẽṅ ní maṅ ní yeo ano̱kwa le̱ etšṍ ehe adſamaṅ ne̱? Sá le̱ emli eyi obo ke̱ dšale̱ saneyeli; dšale̱ hũ hĩ ši ye̱ mli; ši agbe̱ne̱ *awuyelo̱i so̱ṅṅ! *Mat.

english_verse: Your leaders have rejected me to become friends of crooks; your rulers are looking for gifts and bribes. Widows and orphans never get a fair trial.
translation_verse: Olumei le̱ kaniṅkadšelo̱i ke̱ dšulo̱i ananemei ni; ame̱teṅ mofẽmo sumoo̱ nyōṅnii, ni edio̱ nyõmo̱wo se̱; ame̱yee awusã sane ame̱hããle̱, ni okũlafo ko sane hũ baa ame̱hĩe. K.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the mighty ruler of Israel, and I make you a promise: You are now my enemy, and I will show my anger by taking revenge on you.
translation_verse: Nohewo le̱ Nuṅtšo̱, Iehowa Zebaot, Israel hewalo̱ le̱ wiemo̱ ne̱: Ao! maye mihe ke̱-adše̱ mihaolo̱i le̱ adeṅ, ni mato mihe owele ye̱ mihenye̱lo̱i le̱ ano̱!

english_verse: I will punish you terribly and burn away everything that makes you unfit to worship me.
translation_verse: Ni matšṍ minine ke̱-aba ono̱, ni masĕre *odſie̱te̱ifei le̱ ke̱ adi, ni madšie omli futumo̱nii le̱ fè. *K.

english_verse: Jerusalem, I will choose judges and advisors like those you had before. Your new name will be “Justice and Faithfulness.” The Lord Will Save Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ni maṅõ okodšolo̱i le̱ mahão ekoṅ tamo̱ tšutšu le̱, ke̱ odšinafoi le̱ hũ tamo blema le̱; *no se̱ le̱ aatšé̱o dšale̱ maṅ ke̱ maṅ ni yeo̱ ano̱kwa. *Zak.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you will be saved by showing justice; Zion's people who turn to me will be saved by doing right.
translation_verse: Ake̱ kodšomo̱ aakpõ Zion, ni ake̱ dšale̱ aakpõ emli mei ní aakũ ame̱se̱ le̱.

english_verse: But those rebellious sinners who turn against me, the Lord, will all disappear.
translation_verse: Ši mlatõlo̱i ke̱ ešafelo̱i le̱, aakpãtã amefe ame̱hĩe, ni aaplenē mei ní kwaa Iehowa le̱.

english_verse: You will be made ashamed of those groves of trees where you worshiped idols.
translation_verse: Ši ame̱hĩe aagboi ye̱ tšei kplei ni nyedio̱ se̱ le̱ ahewo̱; ni ame̱hĩe aaſie ši ye̱ tromi ni saä nyehĩe le̱ ahewo.

english_verse: You will be like a grove of trees dying in a drought.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nyeatamo̱ tšo kple ko ní eyibāi egbi, ke̱ trom ko ní nu be̱ mli;

english_verse: Your strongest leaders will be like dry wood set on fire by their idols. No one will be able to help, as they all go up in flames.
translation_verse: ni hewalo̱ aatšṍ tamo̱ ananaṅsē, ni enitšumo̱ aatamo̱ lasrẽmi, ní ame̱yi enyo̱ le̱ fẽ-kwa ame̱ašã, ni moko be̱ ni aagbe!

english_verse: Many people will come and say, “Let's go to the mountain of the Lord God of Jacob and worship in his temple.” The Lord will teach us his Law from Jerusalem, and we will obey him.
translation_verse: ni mãdšimãdši pī aate ayakē̱ ake: Nyebaä ní wo̱yakwo̱a Iehowa goṅ le̱, ke̱-yaä Iakob Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ we le̱, koni etšõwo̱ egbè̱i le̱, ni wo̱nyie etempõṅi le̱ ano̱! Edšake̱ mla le̱, Zion ebadše̱, ni Iehowa wiemo le̱, Ierusalem ebadše̱. Ioh

english_verse: Every one of you, go hide among the rocks and in the ground, because the Lord is fearsome, marvelous, and glorious.
translation_verse: *Botemo te̱sā mli, ni oyatẽ ohe ye̱ sũ mli, ye̱ Iehowa he gbeyei ke̱ egbodäē anumnyam le̱ nā! *K.

english_verse: When the Lord comes, everyone who is proud will be made humble, and the Lord alone will be honored.
translation_verse: Gbomei *ahewö-hĩṅme̱ii le̱ aaba ši, aado̱ ádesãi aheno̱wómo̱ le̱ ke̱-aba ši, ni aawo Iehowa kometō no̱ ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱! *

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has chosen a day when those who are proud and conceited will be put down.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa Zebaot gbĩ le̱ aaba noni kwo̱ ke̱ noni yo̱ godšō ke̱ nofẽno ni awó no̱ le̱ no̱, ni eeba ši;

english_verse: The tall and towering cedars of Lebanon will be destroyed. So will the oak trees of Bashan,
translation_verse: ni eeba Lebanon tšenedrutšei ní dãra ní kwō̱lo̱ ke̱-te ṅwei le̱ ke̱ Bašan tšei kplei le̱ fiā no̱,

english_verse: all high mountains and hills,
translation_verse: ke̱ gõdši groṅṅi fẽ ke̱ goṅkpo̱i ní kwō̱lo̱ fẽ,

english_verse: all the seagoing ships, and every beautiful boat.
translation_verse: ke̱ Taršiš le̱dši fẽ ke̱ nibii ní yo̱ fe̱o fẽ no̱!

english_verse: When that day comes, everyone who is proud will be put down. Only the Lord will be honored.
translation_verse: Ni aado̱ gbomei ahewō ke̱ ádesāi aheno̱wómo̱ ke̱-aba ši, ni aawó Iehowa kometō no̱ ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱!

english_verse: Idols will be gone for good.
translation_verse: Ni yakayakawo̱dši le̱ ase̱ aafo kwrā!

english_verse: You had better hide in caves and holes— the Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth.
translation_verse: Ni gbomei aabote te̱kploi ke̱ šikpoṅ bui amli, ye̱ Iehowa he gbeyei ke̱ egbodšē anumnyam le̱ nā, beni eete ši ebahoso šikpoṅ le̱. Luk.

english_verse: On that day everyone will throw to the moles and bats their idols of silver and gold they made to worship.
translation_verse: Nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ gbomo aaše̱re̱ edſie̱te̱i wo̱dsi ke̱ ešika wo̱dši ní afe ahãle̱ ní edsá le̱ aſie ahã obišii ke̱ afutufatai,

english_verse: The Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth— they will hide in caves and in the hills.
translation_verse: koni eyabote te̱kploi ke̱ te̱sāfo̱dši amli, ye̱ Iehowa he gbeyei ke̱ *egbodšē anumnyam le̱ nā, beni eete ši ebahoso šikpoṅ le̱. *

english_verse: Stop trusting the power of humans. They are all going to die, so how can they help?
translation_verse: Nyegblaä nyehe ši ke̱-dše̱a gbomo ní emumo̱ yo̱ ye̱ egugõṅ le̱ he, ši meni mli po abuo̱le̱ ye̱!

english_verse: He will let children and babies become your rulers.
translation_verse: Ni mahã gbekẽbii aye ame̱no̱ lume̱i, ni abifabii aaye ame̱no̱. Dsads.

english_verse: You will each be cruel to friends and neighbors. Young people will insult their elders; no one will show respect to those who deserve it.
translation_verse: Ni maṅ le̱ aawawā amehe yi, ni mofẽmo aawa enanyo yi: gbekẽ aawo ehe ahã onukpa, ni moni abuule̱ aawo ehe ahã moni hĩe yo̱ nyam.

english_verse: Some of you will grab hold of a relative and say, “You still have a coat. Be our leader and rule this pile of ruins.”
translation_verse: Kē̱ moko mõ enyemi ní dše̱ etše̱ we ake: Oye̱ atade, baye wo̱no̱ lumo̱, ni ne̱ke maṅ ni edſa ne̱ ahĩ odeṅ! le̱,

english_verse: But the answer will be, “I can't do you any good. Don't make me your leader. There's no food or clothing left in my house.”
translation_verse: eewó egbē no̱ ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ ake̱: Dšee tšálo̱ dšimi, ni miwe le̱, abolo be̱ dše̱i, atade hũ be̱ dše̱i, nyekawoami maṅ le̱ no̱ lumo̱!

english_verse: Jerusalem and Judah, you rebelled against your glorious Lord— your words and your actions, made you stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Ši Ierusalem edſa, ni Iuda hũ ebutu, edšake̱ ame̱ke̱ ame̱lile̱i ke̱ ame̱nifemo̱nii ete ši ewo Iehowa, koni ame̱tše enumnyam hĩṅme̱ii le̱ ahĩe atũa.

english_verse: Tell those who obey God, “You're very fortunate— you will be rewarded for what you have done.”
translation_verse: Nyekē̱a dšalo̱i le̱ ake̱ aahĩ ahãame̱, edšake̱ ame̱aye ame̱nifemo̱nii le̱ amli yibii.

english_verse: Tell those who disobey, “You're in big trouble— what you did to others will come back to you.”
translation_verse: Kpóo hã efõṅfelo̱ le̱! ehĩṅ hãṅle̱; edšake̱ eninenā nitšũmo̱ le̱ noṅṅ he nyõmo̱ abawole̱.

english_verse: Though you are God's people, you are ruled and abused by women and children. You are confused by leaders who guide you down the wrong path.
translation_verse: Mimaṅ le̱ yiwalo̱i le̱, gbekẽbii ni, ni yei miyeo̱ eno̱! Mimaṅ! ogbe̱tšōlo̱i le̱ hãa odũo̱ gbe ni ame̱fiteo̱ gbe̱ ní onyie no̱ le̱.

english_verse: The Lord is ready to accuse and judge all nations.
translation_verse: Iehowa ete ši ebaye sane, edamo̱ ši ebakodšo mãdšimãdši le̱.

english_verse: He will even judge you rulers and leaders of his own nation. You destroyed his vineyard and filled your houses by robbing the poor.
translation_verse: Iehowa miba eke̱ emã le̱ṅ onukpai ke̱ lume̱i le̱ abakodšo: Ši nye le̱ nyeye weintrom le̱ mli nii; ohĩafoi anii ni ašõ ye̱ nyewe le̱.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says, “You have crushed my people and rubbed in the dirt the faces of the poor.” The Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Té nyedſẽṅo̱ tẽṅ ni nyemĩaä mimaṅ le̱, ni nyeke̱ ohĩafoi ahĩe ſiſiaä ši ne̱? Boni Nuṅtšo̱, Iehowa Zebaot, kē̱ ne̱.

english_verse: The Lord says: The women of Jerusalem are proud and strut around, winking shamelessly. They wear anklets that jingle and call attention to the way they walk.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa sā kē̱ ake̱: Edšake̱ Zion biyei le̱ woo̱ amehe, ni ame̱nyieo̱ ke̱ kue̱ kūmo̱ ke̱ ahoſïbō̱ hĩṅme̱ii, ni kē̱ amenyie le̱, tšĩamo̱ ame̱tšĩaä ni ame̱hãa ame̱nane-sigai le̱ gbē̱o̱, Abe̱i

english_verse: But I, the Lord, will cover their heads with sores, and I will uncover their private parts.
translation_verse: nohewo le̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ aabá Zion biyei le̱ ayiteaṅ aſie gbẽi, ni Iehowa aaba ame̱yayaiaṅ adše kpo.

english_verse: In place of perfume, there will be a stink; in place of belts, there will be ropes; in place of fancy hairdos, they will have bald heads. Instead of expensive clothes, they will wear sackcloth; instead of beauty, they will have ugly scars.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱ fũdšē aabaye tšofã-ke̱-ṅma nãdšiaṅ, ni tãnkpē aabaye mlifĩnii nãdšiaṅ, ni yikpatā aabaye yi ní aho nãdšiaṅ, ni kpekpe aabaye atade wuyā nãdšiaṅ, ni lafladoku aabaye hefe̱o nãdšiaṅ.

english_verse: The fighting men of Jerusalem will be killed in battle.
translation_verse: Ohĩĩ le̱ aanyõnyõi ye̱ klante nā, ni okãkãlo̱i le̱ hũ aanyõ ye̱ ta mli.

english_verse: The city will mourn and sit in the dirt, emptied of its people.
translation_verse: Ni egbói le̱ aaye ṅko̱mo̱ ni ame̱-afe yāra, ni le̱dientše̱ le̱, eeſe̱le̱ eflo ni eeſata šikpon.

english_verse: It will provide shade from the heat of the sun and a place of shelter and protection from storms and rain.
translation_verse: Ni *bū ko aahĩ ši ni šiši yo̱ hṍṅ ye̱ ſane latšā mli, ni eefe abobāhe ke̱ tẽmohä ye̱ ahum ke̱ nyoṅmo̱ne̱mo mli. *

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You take over house after house and field after field, until there is no room left for anyone else in all the land.
translation_verse: Kpóo hã mei ní ṅõo̱ tšũ tšaä tšũ no̱, ke̱ mei ní ṅõo̱ ṅmõ fataä ṅmõ he, ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní gbe̱ be̱ doṅṅ, ni nye ke̱ke̱ nyehĩo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ teṅ le̱! Mika

english_verse: None of them are tired. They don't sleep or get drowsy, and they run without stumbling. Their belts don't come loose; their sandal straps don't break.
translation_verse: Eto̱ṅ ame̱teṅ mokomoko, ni ame̱teṅ mokomoko te̱ṅ, ame̱teṅ mokomoko wo̱ṅ wo̱dõi, ni ame̱wo̱ṅ; asaṅ ame̱he̱fĩnii fẽneṅ, ni ame̱tokotai anā kpãi hũ tšere̱ṅ.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! The lies you tell are like ropes by which you drag along sin and evil.
translation_verse: Kpóo hã mei ni ke̱ amale-kpãi gblaä nõša ni ame̱ke̱ ſīlihe-tãṅkpēi hũ gblaä eša le̱,

english_verse: and so his people know nothing about him. That's why many of you will be dragged off to foreign lands. Your leaders will starve to death, and everyone else will suffer from thirst.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ aaṅõ mimaṅ le̱ nom ní ame̱lee; ni hõmo̱ aagbe enumnyam gbomei le̱, ni esafo yü le̱ hũ aaṅãlã ke̱ kũmai.

english_verse: The world of the dead has opened its mouth wide and is eagerly waiting for the leaders of Jerusalem and for its noisy crowds, especially for those who take pride in that city.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ gbohĩĩadše elē̱ esẽṅ, ni egbe̱ edāṅ hatō, koni ame̱numnyam gbomei ke̱ ame̱safo yū le̱ ke̱ mei ní feo̱ hõ ke̱ mei ní mli flio̱ame̱ le̱ fẽ akpleke ši ke-ya dše̱i.

english_verse: Its citizens have been put down, and its proud people have been brought to shame.
translation_verse: Ni gbomo aaba ši, ni aaba nū hũ ši, ni hewolo̱i ahĩṅme̱ii hũ aaba ši;

english_verse: And you say, “Let the holy God of Israel hurry up and do what he has promised, so we can see it for ourselves.”
translation_verse: mei ní kē̱o̱ ake̱: *Hã ní ehe afe oya ní etšu enitšumo̱ le̱ mrãmrã ni wo̱kwe̱! Hã ní Israel Mokroṅkroṅ le̱ adšina le̱ abe̱ṅke̱ ni eba, koni wo̱le le̱! *Ier.

english_verse: And you are great at drinking and mixing drinks. But you are in for trouble.
translation_verse: Kpóo hã mei ní feo̱ ekã ke̱ weinnumo̱, ni ame̱he waäame̱ ke̱ dā̃ ní wa futumo̱;

english_verse: You accept bribes to let the guilty go free, and you cheat the innocent out of a fair trial.
translation_verse: mei ní buo̱ efõṅfelo̱ bem ye̱ nyōṅnii ahewo, ni ame̱šõo̱ dšalo̱i adšale̱ ye̱ ame̱-deṅ le̱!

english_verse: You will go up in flames like straw and hay! You have rejected the teaching of the holy Lord God All-Powerful of Israel. Now your roots will rot, and your blossoms will turn to dust.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni lalilei šãa gbetšeli ni la ní tšoo̱ šãa dſe̱i gbĩṅ le̱: nakai noṅṅ ame̱šišifã le̱ aakpo̱to̱, ni ame̱fofro le̱ aate ši tamo̱ mlu; edšake̱ ame̱kwa Iehowa Zebaot mla le̱, ni ame̱gbe Israel Mokroṅkroṅ le̱ wiemo̱ le̱ he guo̱.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people, but you made him terribly angry, and he struck you with his mighty arm. Mountains shook, and dead bodies covered the streets like garbage. The Lord is still angry, and he is ready to strike you again. Foreign Nations Will Attack
translation_verse: Ene̱ hewo̱ le̱ Iehowa mli wo emaṅ le̱ la, ni ekpa enine mli ewoame, ni eyiame̱ ní gõdši kpokpo, ni ame̱gbohĩĩ le̱ fe tamo̱ bē̱mo̱nii ye̱ blohũi le̱ amli. *Fẽ le̱ emlifũ le̱ edšo̱ko; ši enine le̱, ekpã mli lolo. *

english_verse: The Lord has signaled for the foreign nations to come and attack you. He has already whistled, and they are coming as fast as they can.
translation_verse: Ni eeši aflaṅā etšõ dšeṅmãdši ní yo̱ šoṅṅ le̱, ni eekpã ble̱ etšé̱ame̱ ke̱-adše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbēhe le̱: Ni na, ame̱he aafe oya ke̱-aba mrãmrã!

english_verse: Their arrows are sharp, and their bows are ready. The hoofs of their horses are hard as flint; the wheels of their war chariots turn as fast as a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Ame̱găimlibii le̱ anā ba, ni ame̱gãii le̱ fiā le̱ ame̱dō̱ro̱. Ame̱kpo̱ṅo̱i akoklotoi tamo̱ tſre̱bo, ni ame̱ſīliĩ le̱ anãdši tamo̱ lasũogbĕle.

english_verse: They roar and growl like fierce young lions as they grab their victims and drag them off where no one can rescue them.
translation_verse: Ame̱hũmo̱ tamo̱ dšata hū̃mo̱, ni ame̱ahũ tamo̱ dšatabii, ni ame̱aši ame̱sẽṅ ni ame̱amō ame̱mīle̱lo le̱ ni ame̱awó ke̱-ate, ni dšielo̱ ko be̱.

english_verse: On the day they attack, they will roar like the ocean. And across the land you will see nothing but darkness and trouble, because the light of day will be covered by thick clouds.
translation_verse: Ni aagbè̱ awole̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ tamo̱ ṅšo̱ gbē̱o̱: ni ke̱ akwe̱ šikpoṅ le̱, na duṅ ke̱ aw̌ere̱hō so̱ṅṅ, ni la hũ aawo duṅ ye̱ eblo̱tuĩ le̱ amli.

english_verse: In the year that King Uzziah died, I had a vision of the Lord. He was on his throne high above, and his robe filled the temple.
translation_verse: Afi no̱ ni maṅtše̱ Uzia gbo le̱, mina Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ ni etá maṅtše̱sẽi ní kwo̱ godšō ko no̱, ni etade nāmūi le̱ eyi so̱lemo̱we le̱ obõ. Ioh

english_verse: One of the flaming creatures flew over to me with a burning coal that it had taken from the altar with a pair of metal tongs.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni serafim le̱ ateṅ mokome ní hĩe ṅãi ni tšoo̱ ní eke̱ abē̱le yako̱ ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ ye̱ edeṅ fliki ke̱-ba miṅõ;

english_verse: It touched my lips with the hot coal and said, “This has touched your lips. Your sins are forgiven, and you are no longer guilty.”
translation_verse: ni eṅõ-sa minābu ni ekē̱: Na, ní ene̱ esa onābu ne̱, *adšie onõša le̱, ni atšumo̱ ohe eša le̱! *Zak.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to go and speak this message to the people: “You will listen and listen, but never understand. You will look and look, but never see.” The Lord also said,
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱: Ya ni oyakē̱ maṅ ne̱ ake̱: Nyenua, ši nyekanaã šiši, ni nyenaä, ši nyekayoa se̱! Mat.

english_verse: “Make these people stubborn! Make them stop up their ears, cover their eyes, and fail to understand. Don't let them turn to me and be healed.”
translation_verse: Hã ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱ tšui akplim, ni ohã ame̱toii awa, ni oſila ame̱hĩṅme̱ii, koni ame̱kana ke̱ ame̱hĩṅme̱ii, ni ame̱kanu ke̱ ame̱toii, ni ame̱tšui hũ akana šiši ni ame̱kakpale, ni atsáame̱!

english_verse: Then I asked the Lord, “How long will this last?” The Lord answered: Until their towns are destroyed and their houses are deserted, until their fields are empty,
translation_verse: Ni mikē̱: Nuṅtšo̱, ke̱-yaši mẽ beyino? Ni ekē̱: Ke̱-yaši beyino ní mãdši le̱ aatšṍmo̱ amaṅfõ, ní mokomoko be̱ mli, ni šĩai le̱ hũ mokomoko be̱ mli, ni šikpoṅ le̱ aatšṍ amaṅfõ kwrā,

english_verse: and I have sent them far away, leaving their land in ruins.
translation_verse: ni Iehowa aakpla mei le̱ ke̱-ate šoṅṅ, ní hei pī aakãmo̱ efodṍi ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱!

english_verse: If only a tenth of the people are left, even they will be destroyed. But just as stumps remain after trees have been cut down, some of my chosen ones will be left.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ ſe̱ emlidšāi nyoṅma mli ekome ye̱ no̱ tete le̱, aakũ se̱ akpãtã ame̱hĩe; tamo̱ tšo kple ko lo odum ko ni atō agbē ši ní eſe̱ ekuku; seši *kroṅkroṅ dši ekuku le̱, *

english_verse: to invade and defeat Judah and Jerusalem and to let the son of Tabeel be king in his place.
translation_verse: Nyehãa wo̱fãa wo̱yatuaä Iuda ni wo̱gbaä enā, ni wo̱ṅõle̱ wo̱hã wo̱he, ni wo̱wo Tabeel bi le̱ maṅtše̱ ye̱ mli!

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise that this will never happen.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Edamo̱ṅ ši ni ebaṅ mli nakai!

english_verse: “Ask me for proof that my promise will come true. Ask for something to happen deep in the world of the dead or high in the heavens above.”
translation_verse: Bi okadi ke̱-dše̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, deṅ oha ohe, gbohĩĩadše tō̃ obi ye̱ dšio, ṅwei šoṅṅ dšio!

english_verse: “No, Lord,” Ahaz answered. “I won't test you!”
translation_verse: Ši Ahaz kē̱: Mibii ni misa mikaa Iehowa!

english_verse: Then I said: Listen, every one of you in the royal family of David. You have already tried my patience. Now you are trying God's patience by refusing to ask for proof.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ekē̱: Nyeboa toi ko, David we! Aso ni nyehaoo̱ gbomei le̱, no fáá hããnye, hewo ni nyebahao mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ hũ ne̱?

english_verse: But the Lord will still give you proof. A virgin is pregnant; she will have a son and will name him Immanuel.
translation_verse: Nohewo le̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ dientše̱ *aahãnye okadi: †Na, oblayō fro aana mũsũ ni eefo̱ binū, ni eetšē̱ egbe̱i **Imanuel. *Mika

english_verse: Even before the boy is old enough to know how to choose between right and wrong, he will eat yogurt and honey, and the countries of the two kings you fear will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ši dãni *gbekẽnū le̱ aale efõṅ kwamo̱ ke̱ ekpakpa ko̱mo̱ le̱, aašĩ maṅtše̱mei enyo̱ ní ošeo̱ame̱ gbeyei le̱ asikpoṅ le̱ afõ ši. *

english_verse: But the Lord will make more trouble for your people and your kingdom than any of you have known since Israel broke away from Judah. He will even bring the king of Assyria to attack you. The Threat of an Invasion
translation_verse: Iehowa ke̱ gbĩĩ ni bako da, ke̱-dše̱ beyino̱ ni Efraim tše ye̱ Iuda he le̱, aaba bo ke̱ omaṅ le̱ ke̱ otše̱ we le̱ no̱: no dši Ašur maṅtše̱ le̱.

english_verse: When that time comes, the Lord will whistle, and armies will come from Egypt like flies and from Assyria like bees.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ ake̱ Iehowa aakpā ble̱ atšé̱ adõdõṅ ní yo̱ Mizraim fāi le̱ anāgbēhe le̱ ke̱ wòbi hũ ni yo̱ Ašur šikpoṅ te̱ no̱ le̱;

english_verse: They will settle everywhere—in the deep valleys and between the rocks, on every thornbush and all over the pastureland.
translation_verse: ni ame̱fẽ ame̱aba ni ame̱abasōmo̱ dšō̱i vōvō ke̱ te̱sāiaṅ fo̱dši le̱ amli ke̱ ṅmeii fẽ no̱ ke̱ dſe̱i fẽ no̱.

english_verse: The Lord will pay the king of Assyria to bring a razor from across the Euphrates River and shave your head and every hair on your body, including your beard.
translation_verse: Nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ ke̱ asōyi ní abo̱le̱ apā ye̱ fā le̱ se̱, ní dši Ašur maṅtše̱ le̱, aabaše̱ yiteṅ tšo̱i ke̱ nãdši ahetšo̱i, ni eeše̱ tšẽṅ hũ.

english_verse: Anyone who is able to save only one young cow and two sheep,
translation_verse: Ni nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ aaba mli ake̱ nū ko aalè̱ tšinabiyō ke̱ tōgwanteṅi enyo̱;

english_verse: will have enough milk to make yogurt. In fact, everyone left in the land will eat yogurt and honey.
translation_verse: ni aaba mli ake̱ fufo̱ ní eená le̱ fále̱ nā so̱ṅṅ le̱ eeye butru; edšake̱ butru ke̱ wò so̱ṅṅ mofẽmo ní eſe̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ aaye.

english_verse: You will go there to hunt with your bow and arrows, because the whole country will be covered with thornbushes.
translation_verse: Gãimlibii ke̱ gãii ake̱-aba dše̱i; edšake̱ šikpoṅ le̱ fẽ aatšṍ kpitikpitii ke̱ ṅmeii so̱ṅṅ.

english_verse: The hills where you once planted crops will be overgrown with thorns and thistles. You will be afraid to go there, and your cattle, sheep, and goats will be turned loose on those hills.
translation_verse: Ni gõdši fẽ ní ake̱ kō̱i hũo̱ no̱ sá le̱ oyaṅ dše̱i doṅṅ, edšake̱ ooše kpitikpitii ke̱ ṅmeii le̱ agbeyei; ni eetšṍ heni aſieo̱ tšinai awoo̱ ke̱ tōgwanteṅi anyiemo̱he.

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me again and said:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa sā kē̱mi ake̱:

english_verse: Meanwhile, I patiently trust the Lord, even though he is no longer pleased with Israel.
translation_verse: Ši mīkwe̱ Iehowa, moni eṅö ehĩe etē Iakob we le̱, gbe̱ ni mihĩe kā eno̱.

english_verse: My children and I are warning signs to Israel from the Lord All-Powerful, who lives on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: *Na, mike̱ †bii ní Iehowa ehãmi le̱ dši okadii ke̱ nākpe̱nii ní dše̱ Iehowa Zebaot ní hĩo̱ Zion goṅ le no le̱ deṅ ye Israel. *Heb.

english_verse: Someone may say to you, “Go to the fortunetellers who make soft chirping sounds or ask the spirits of the dead. After all, a nation ought to be able to ask its own gods
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši ame̱kē̱nye ake̱: Nyeyabia okõmfoi ke̱ klamo̱i ní wieo̱ gugõdšiaṅ ke̱ akromãgbē le̱ anii le̱ [nyekē̱a-ame̱ ake̱]: *Aso esaa ake̱ maṅ ko aabi e-Nyoṅmo̱ nii? alo gbohĩĩ moṅ anii abio̱ abaa hĩekãlo̱i? *

english_verse: what it should do.” None of those who talk like that will live to see the light of day!
translation_verse: Mla le̱ ke̱ odase le̱ nõ ne̱! Ke̱dši ame̱wiee ne̱ke̱ wiemo̱ ne̱ le̱, no le̱ dše tše̱reṅame̱;

english_verse: They will go around in great pain and will become so hungry that they will angrily curse their king and their gods. And when they try to find help in heaven
translation_verse: ni ame̱atšṍ mli ke̱-aho, ni aawa ahãame̱ ni hõmo̱ aayeame̱; ni aaba mli ake̱, beni hõmo̱ yeo̱ame̱ le̱, ame̱mli aawo ame̱he la, ni *ame̱alomo̱ ame̱maṅtše̱ ke̱ ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ni ame̱atšṍmo̱ ame̱hĩe ke̱-ate ṅwei, *Kpods.

english_verse: and on earth, they will find only trouble and darkness, terrible trouble and deepest darkness.
translation_verse: ni ame̱akwe̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ hũ: ni na, haomo̱ ke̱ *duṅ ke̱ hedšramo̱ kpī; ni aaſieame̱ awo duṅ kabitī mli! *

english_verse: The tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh turned against each other, then joined forces to attack Judah. But the Lord was still angry and ready to punish the nation even more.
translation_verse: .] Manase aaye Efraim, ni Efraim hũ aaye Manase, ni ame̱yi enyo̱ le̱ fẽ ame̱ate ši ame̱wo Iuda. *Fẽ le̱ emlifũ le̱ edšo̱ko, ni enine le̱ ekpã mli lolo. *

english_verse: But what will you do when you are fiercely attacked and punished by foreigners? Where will you run for help? Where will you hide your valuables?
translation_verse: Ni sramo̱ gbĩ le̱ no̱, kē̱ fitemo̱ ní badše̱ šoṅṅ aba le̱ mli le̱, té nyebafe tẽṅ? Namo ṅō nyeadšo foi ke̱-ate nyeyaba abo? Ni nẽgbe̱ nyeašĩ nyenii le̱ ye̱?

english_verse: to beat down you godless people. I am angry with you, and I will send him to attack you. He will take what he wants and walk on you like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Matšũle̱ ke̱-ate dšeṅmaṅ fõṅ ko no̱, ni mafã́le̱ mawo maṅ ni mimli efũame̱ le̱ he, koni eyaha nii ni eṅō nom, ni enănā ame̱no̱ tamo̱ anāa blohũiaṅ ṅmiamo̱ no̱.

english_verse: The king of Assyria says: My army commanders are kings!
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ekē̱o̱ ake̱: Nto milumei le̱ fẽ le̱ maṅtše̱mei so̱ṅṅ ni?

english_verse: The Lord will do what he has planned against Jerusalem and Mount Zion. Then he will punish the proud and boastful king of Assyria,
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ aaba mli ake̱, ké̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ tšu enii egbe nā ye̱ Zion goṅ le̱ no̱ ke̱ Ierusalem le̱: *mabawo Ašur maṅtše̱ le̱ hewō dſẽṅmo̱ yibii le̱ ke̱ ehewō hĩṅme̱ii anumnyam le̱ he nyõmo̱. *

english_verse: who says: I did these things by my own power because I am smart and clever. I attacked kings like a wild bull, and I took the land and the treasures of their nations.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ekē̱: Mininešiwale̱ ke̱ minilē mike̱-fe, edšake̱ mihĩe tẽ; ni mitšire̱ mãdšimãdši le̱ ahũsũi le̱, ni miha ame̱dſetrii le̱, ni mitšire̱ mei ní trá maṅtše̱sēii ano̱ le̱ mitſia ši tamo̱ oblaṅ ko;

english_verse: King of Assyria, can an ax or a saw overpower the one who uses it? Can a wooden pole lift whoever holds it?
translation_verse: Aso lema ſãa woo̱ moni hĩele̱ ke̱-foo̱ nii le̱? alo sāo wóo̱ ehe no̱ ye̱ moni gblaäle̱ le̱ no̱? tamo̱ noni *tšo aatsi mei ni wóo̱ eno̱ le̱, alo dẽhĩemo̱tšo aawo moni dšee tšo le̱ no̱! *K.

english_verse: The mighty Lord All-Powerful will send a terrible disease to strike down your army, and you will burn with fever under your royal robes.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ Nuṅtšo̱, Iehowa Zebaot, aatšũ lōtā̃ ke̱-aba emei ní eſiſī le̱ ateṅ, ni eesu la ewo enumnyam le̱ šiši tamo̱ la ní tšoo̱.

english_verse: The holy God, who is the light of Israel, will turn into a fire, and in one day you will go up in flames, just like a thornbush.
translation_verse: Ni Israel kane le̱ aatšṍ la, ni e-Mokroṅkroṅ le̱ aatšṍ lalilei, ni eetšo ni eešã eṅmeii ke̱ ekpitikpitii le̱ gbĩ kome.

english_verse: The Lord will make your beautiful forests and fertile fields slowly rot.
translation_verse: Ni eekpãtã ekō ke̱ eṅmõ kpakpa anumnyam le̱ hĩe, susuma ke̱ gbomotšo fẽ, tamo̱ helatše̱ ní yeo̱ gbĕle-hela gboo̱!

english_verse: There will be so few trees that even a young child can count them. Only a Few Will Come Back
translation_verse: Ni tšei ní aaſe̱ ye̱ ekõ le̱ mli le̱-eše̱e̱ noko, ni gbekẽ aanyẽ ame̱yibo̱ aṅmã.

english_verse: A time is coming when the survivors from Israel and Judah will completely depend on the holy Lord of Israel, instead of the nation that defeated them.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱, mei ní eſe̱ ye̱ Israel le̱, mei ni edše mli ye̱ Iakob we le̱ eṅõṅ amehe ame̱-kpasaṅ moni yiame̱ le̱ doṅṅ, ši ame̱aṅõ amehe ame̱kpasa Iehowa, Israel Mokroṅkroṅ le̱, ye̱ ano̱kwale mli.

english_verse: There were as many people as there are grains of sand along the seashore, but only a few will survive to come back to Israel's mighty God. This is because he has threatened to destroy their nation, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Ši *ké̱ omaṅ Israel yifále̱ tamo̱ ṅšo̱nã šia po, mei ní eſe̱ le̱ ke̱ke̱ aakũ ame̱se̱ aba! Amã hĩekpãtãmo̱ no̱ mí, eyi eteke no̱ ke̱ dšale̱. *Rom.

english_verse: Now the Lord God All-Powerful says to his people in Jerusalem: The Assyrians will beat you with sticks and abuse you, just as the Egyptians did. But don't be afraid of them.
translation_verse: Nohewo le̱ bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱, Iehowa Zebaot, kē̱ ne̱: Mimaṅ ní hĩo̱ Zion, kāše Ašur gbeyei! eke̱ tšo aayio, ní eewó edẽhĩemo̱tšo le̱ no̱ ye̱ ono̱, tamo̱ bo̱ni Mizraim fe le̱;

english_verse: Then they will no longer rule your nation. All will go well for you, and your burden will be lifted.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ ake̱ aadšie edšatšu le̱ ye̱ okõṅ ne̱ ke̱ epã le̱ hũ ke̱-adše̱ okue̱ no̱; ni apã le̱ aafite ye̱ fo̱ ní ewo le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: before crossing the valley and spending the night at Geba. The people of Ramah are terrified; everyone in Gibeah, the hometown of Saul, has run away.
translation_verse: Ame̱tšṍ gõdši ateṅ gbe̱ le̱ no̱: ame̱-yawo̱ Geba; Rama he mīkpokpo, Saul-Gibea mīdšo foi.

english_verse: Loud crying can be heard in the towns of Gallim, Laishah, and sorrowful Anathoth.
translation_verse: Wó ogbẽ no̱ ni oblo̱, Galim biyō! bo toi, Laiša! onii ye̱ mo̱bo̱, Anatot!

english_verse: No one is left in Madmenah or Gebim.
translation_verse: Madmana mīdšo foi; Gebimbii le̱ mīfã.

english_verse: Today the enemy will camp at Nob and shake a threatening fist at Mount Zion in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eyawa Nob ṅme̱ne̱ noṅṅ, eehoso enine etšṍ Zion biyō le̱ goṅ ni dši Ierusalem goṅkpo̱ le̱.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful will use his fearsome might to bring down the tallest trees and chop off every branch.
translation_verse: Na, Nuṅtšo̱, Iehowa Zebaot, ke̱ hewale̱ ni yo̱ gbeyei aaflo̱ tšeianidši le̱: nii ni kwō̱lo̱ godšogodšõ le̱, aaflo̱ame̱ aſie ši, ni nii ni ehole amehe no̱ le̱, aaba ame̱ ši.

english_verse: With an ax, the glorious Lord will destroy every tree in the forests of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Ni eke̱ ededa aagba kō-hayī le̱, ni Lebanon aatšṍ hewalo̱ le̱ nine no̱ agbẽ ši.

english_verse: His greatest joy will be to obey the Lord. This king won't judge by appearances or listen to rumors.
translation_verse: Ni eená Iehowa gbeyeišemo̱ le̱ he mīše̱; bo̱ni ehĩṅme̱ii naã le̱, dšee nakai ebakodšo, ni bo̱ni etoii nuo̱ le̱, dšee nakai ebabu atẽṅ;

english_verse: Honesty and fairness will be his royal robes.
translation_verse: Ni dšale̱ aatšṍ ehe̱fĩnõ, ni ano̱kwayeli aatšṍ emlifīnõ.

english_verse: Leopards will lie down with young goats, and wolves will rest with lambs. Calves and lions will eat together and be cared for by little children.
translation_verse: Ni *klaṅ ke̱ gwanteṅbi aahĩ ši, ni kōtše̱ ke̱ abotiabi aabu ši; ni tšinabi ke̱ dšatabi ke̱ kolo ní ewo fo̱ fẽ aahĩ hekome, ni gbekẽ bibiō aakplaame̱. *

english_verse: Cows and bears will share the same pasture; their young will rest side by side. Lions and oxen will both eat straw.
translation_verse: Tšinayō hũ ke̱ ošišibriši aaye nii, ni ame̱biĩ abumo̱ ši ye̱ hekome, ni dšata aaye dſe̱i tamo̱ tšina.

english_verse: Little children will play near snake holes. They will stick their hands into dens of poisonous snakes and never be hurt.
translation_verse: Fufo̱ō aaſe̱ ye̱ šikpã bu nā, ni gbekẽ ní etše fuſo̱ hũ, aaṅõ enine awo onũfũ bu mli.

english_verse: Nothing harmful will take place on the Lord's holy mountain. Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord. God's People Will Come Back Home
translation_verse: Ame̱feṅ efõṅ ni ame̱fiteṅ nii ye̱ migoṅ kroṅkroṅ le̱ no̱ fẽ; edšake̱ *šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ aayi obõ ke̱ Iehowa he nilē le̱, tamo̱ bo̱ni nu ha ṅšo šiši le̱. *Hab.

english_verse: The time is coming when one of David's descendants will be the signal for the people of all nations to come together. They will follow his advice, and his own nation will become famous.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ ake̱ *Išai šišifã ní dši aflaṅā ní aši ahã mãdšimãdši le̱, no se̱gbe̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ aatao, ni ehedšō̱mo̱he le̱ hĩe aaba nyam. *Rom.

english_verse: When that day comes, the Lord will again reach out his mighty arm and bring home his people who have survived in Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Ethiopia, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, and the land along the coast.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱, Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ aakpã enine mli noni dši ši enyo̱, koni ekpõ emã le̱ṅ mei ní eſe̱ le̱, mei ní eſe̱ ke̱-dše̱ Ašur ke̱ Mizraim ke̱ Patros ke̱ Kuš ke̱ Elam ke̱ Šinear ke̱ Hamat ke̱ ṅšo̱ṅkpo̱i le̱ ano̱ le̱.

english_verse: He will give a signal to the nations, and he will bring together the refugees from Judah and Israel, who have been scattered all over the earth.
translation_verse: Ni eeši aflaṅā ehã dšeṅmãdši le̱, ni eebua Israelbii ní aše̱re̱ame̱ aſie le̱ anā, ni eehã Iudabii ní egbe̱ eſã le̱ adše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ kodši edſe̱ le̱ no̱ abakpe.

english_verse: Israel will stop being jealous of Judah, and Judah will no longer be the enemy of Israel.
translation_verse: Ni Efraim hetšẽmo̱ le̱ se̱ aafo, ni Iuda henye̱lo̱i le̱ hĩe aakpãtã; Efraim he tšẽṅ Iuda doṅṅ, ni Iuda hũ enye̱ṅ Efraim doṅṅ. Ezek.

english_verse: The Lord will dry up the arm of the Red Sea near Egypt, and he will send a scorching wind to divide the Euphrates River into seven streams that anyone can step across.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa aafe Mizraim ṅšo̱nine le̱ musu, ni eke̱ emumo̱ ní nā wa le̱ aahoso enine atšõ fā le̱, ni eetſale̱ nõ ní etšṍ fāi bibii kpawo ní ake̱ tokotai po aafo.

english_verse: Then for his people who survive, there will be a good road from Assyria, just as there was a good road for their ancestors when they left Egypt.
translation_verse: Ni eetšṍ tempõṅ ehã emaṅ le̱ mli mei ní eſe̱ le̱, mei ní eſe̱ ni badše̱ Ašur le̱, tamo̱ bo̱ni etšṍ ehã *Israel gbĩ no̱ ni edše Mizraim le̱. *

english_verse: At that time you will say, “Our Lord, we are thankful, and we worship only you. We will tell the nations how glorious you are and what you have done.
translation_verse: Ni nakai gbĩ le̱ ne̱ le̱ nyeakē̱: *Nyedaä Iehowa ši, nyetšé̱a egbe̱i le̱! Nyehãa alea enifemo̱nii le̱ ye̱ mãdšimãdši le̱ ateṅ, nyedšadšea ake̱ awó egbe̱i le̱ no̱! *

english_verse: Because of your wonderful deeds we will sing your praises everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Nyelaã nyehãa Iehowa! ši efe nii wudši; nyehãa alea ene̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ mū le̱ fẽ no̱!

english_verse: Sing, people of Zion! Celebrate the greatness of the holy Lord of Israel. God is here to help you.
translation_verse: Bo Zion biyō, blo̱mo̱ wā ni onyã́! edšake̱ Israel Mokroṅkroṅ le̱ ní yo̱ oteṅ le̱ da!

english_verse: Cry and weep! The day is coming when the mighty Lord will bring destruction. *
translation_verse: Nyewoa lele, *ši Iehowa gbĩ le̱ eše̱ ši etã; eba tamo̱ hĩekpãtãmo̱ ní dše̱ Ofe le̱ deṅ. *Ioel

english_verse: I will punish this evil world and its people because of their sins. I will crush the horrible pride of those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Ni mawo dše le̱ nyõmo̱ ye̱ ame̱nõ-fõṅ le̱ hewo̱, ke̱ meifõdši hũ ye̱ ame̱nõša le̱ hewo̱, ni mahã hewolo̱i ahetšṍmo̱ le̱ se̱ afo, ni maba yiwalo̱i aheno̱wómo̱ le̱ ši.

english_verse: Survivors will be harder to find than the purest gold.
translation_verse: Ni mahã ádesã dšra awa fè šika kro̱ṅṅ, ke̱ gbomo hũ fè *Ofir šika ṅmīṅmi. *

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am terribly angry— I will make the sky tremble and the earth shake loose.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ mahã ṅwei akpokpo, ni šikpoṅ le̱ aahoso ke̱-adše̱ egbe̱he ye̱ Iehowa Zebaot mlila le̱ nā, ke̱ emlifũ ni nā wa le̱ gbĩ le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: Everyone will run to their homelands, just as hunted deer run, and sheep scatter when they have no shepherd.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱ ame̱afe tamo̱ soṅãi ní afãle̱ ke̱ tōi ní moko be̱ ní buaä ame̱nā: mofẽmo aatšṍ ehe ke̱-ate emaṅ, mofẽmo aadšo foi ke̱-ate ešikpoṅ no̱.

english_verse: The Medes can't be bought off with silver or gold, and I'm sending them to attack Babylonia.
translation_verse: Na, matē Mediabii aši mawoame̱, mei ní ebuṅ dſie̱te̱i, ni šika hũ ame̱nyáṅ he,

english_verse: Their arrows will slaughter the young men; no pity will be shown to babies and children. The Lord Will Destroy Babylon
translation_verse: ame̱gãii le̱ aaṅõ oblahĩĩ atſia ši, ame̱mli etšõṅame̱ ye̱ *bii ní yo̱ mũsũṅ tete he, ni amehĩṅmeii hoṅ gbekẽbii ahe. *K.

english_verse: No one will live in Babylon. Even nomads won't camp nearby, and shepherds won't let their sheep rest there.
translation_verse: Moko ehĩṅ dše̱i gbĩkogbĩko, ni asaṅ ake̱ dše̱i efeṅ šihĩle̱he ye̱ yino̱ ko yino̱ ko no̱; ni Arabianyo tete ešiṅ ebū ye̱ dše̱i, ni tōkwe̱lo̱i le̱ hũ hãṅ ame̱tōi abumo̱ ši ye̱ dše̱i;

english_verse: Only desert creatures, hoot owls, and ostriches will live in its ruins, and goats will leap about.
translation_verse: ši ṅãṅ koloi aakãmo̱ ši ye̱ dše̱i, ni ame̱tšũi le̱ amli aayimo̱ obõbõ ke̱ patui, ni dugumai hũ aahĩ dše̱i, ni sasabonsami aadšò ye̱ dše̱i;

english_verse: Hyenas and wolves will howl from Babylon's fortresses and beautiful palaces. Its time is almost up!
translation_verse: ni klãdši aablo̱ ye̱ ame̱mṍdši le̱ amli, ke̱ ṅãṅgbēi hũ ye̱ ame̱tšũi fe̱fe̱dši le̱ amli. Ni ebe le̱ eše̱ etã, egbĩĩ le̱ hũ etše̱ṅ doṅṅ.

english_verse: The Lord will set you free from your sorrow, suffering, and slavery.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱ gbĩ ni Iehowa aahão hedšō̱mo̱ ke̱-adše̱ ow̌ere̱hō ke̱ ohaomo̱ ke̱ nyṍṅ ní ayeo ní nā wa le̱ mli le̱,

english_verse: Then you will make fun of the King of Babylonia by singing this song: That cruel monster is done for! He won't attack us again.
translation_verse: ooṅõ ne̱ke̱ abe̱ ne̱ obu Babel maṅtše̱ le̱ ni ookē̱ ake̱: Té fe tēṅ ni haolo̱ le̱ be̱ doṅṅ ne̱? ti fe tēṅ ní nāgbamo̱ le̱ se̱ efo ne̱?

english_verse: who were furious and never stopped abusing the people of other nations.
translation_verse: moni ke̱ mlila tſia mãdšimãdši le̱ anii, ni etoo enine ši, ní eke̱ mlifũ yeo̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ano̱, ni eyiwale̱ se̱ efoo le̱!

english_verse: Now all the world is at peace; its people are celebrating with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Šikpoṅ mū le̱ fẽ ená hedšo̱le̱, ni eno̱ edšo̱, ni ame̱mīla nyã́mo̱ lalai. Hab.

english_verse: The world of the dead eagerly waits for you. With great excitement, the spirits of ancient rulers hear about your coming.
translation_verse: Gbohĩĩadše po ní yo̱ šiši le̱, ohewo̱ le̱ ebú ke̱-mība ebakpeo; eta sisai amli ye̱ ohewo̱, ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ onukpai le̱ fẽ, ni ehã dšeṅmãdši le̱ amaṅtše̱mei le̱ fẽ ete ši ke̱-dše̱ ame̱sẽii ano̱.

english_verse: Each one of them will say, “Now you are just as weak as any of us!
translation_verse: Ame̱fẽ-tſẽm ame̱ahere no̱ ame̱akē̱o ake̱: Ani bo hũ ogbo̱dšo̱ tamo̱wo̱ noṅṅ? otsṍ tamo̱wo̱ noṅṅ pe̱?

english_verse: Your pride and your music have ended here in the world of the dead. Worms are your blanket, maggots are your bed.”
translation_verse: *Aba ogbodšē le̱ ši ke̱-ba gbohĩĩadše ke̱ osaṅkūi agbē̱mo̱ le̱ hũ; osā ní aṅmẽ ye̱ ošiši dši omlẽgẽi, ni ono̱hānõ hũ dši gõgõmii. *Ezek.

english_verse: You, the bright morning star, have fallen from the sky! You brought down other nations; now you are brought down.
translation_verse: Té fe tēṅ ní odše̱ ṅwei obagbē ši ne̱, bo tolō ni okpe̱o̱ he̱ṅṅ! Té fe tẽṅ ní afoö afõ šikpoṅ ne̱, bo ni obaã dšeṅmãdši le̱ aši le̱!

english_verse: You said to yourself, “I'll climb to heaven and place my throne above the highest stars. I'll sit there with the gods far away in the north.
translation_verse: Ši bo le̱ okē̱ ye̱ otšuiṅ ake̱: Makwo̱ ke̱-ya ṅwei, ni mawí mimaṅtše̱sẽi le̱ no̱ ke̱-ateke Nyoṅmo̱ ṅulamii le̱, ni maho matá *kpẽ-goṅ le̱ no̱ ye̱ kōyigbe̱ nāgbēhei le̱ tō̃; *Ezek.

english_verse: I'll be above the clouds, just like God Most High.”
translation_verse: makwo̱ ke̱-ateke atatuĩaṅ hei groṅṅi le̱, ni matamo̱ moni yo̱ ṅwei šoṅṅ le!

english_verse: But now you are deep in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Moṅ, aaba oši ke̱-ate gbohĩĩadše, ke̱-ate bu le̱ šiši tō̃!

english_verse: Those who see you will stare and wonder, “Is this the man who made the world tremble and shook up kingdoms?
translation_verse: Mei ní aanao le̱ aakwe̱o diṅṅ, ame̱adſẽṅ ohe ake̱: Ani nū le̱ ní hã šikpoṅ le̱ hoso, ní ehã maṅtše̱yelii ahe kpokpo le̱ ne̱?

english_verse: Did he capture every city and make earth a desert? Is he the one who refused to let prisoners go home?”
translation_verse: Moni hã dše le̱ṅ tšṍ ṅã kpatã, ni ebutu emli mãdši le̱, ní eṅmē̃ē̃ enomii le̱ ahe ni ame̱ya ame̱maṅ le̱ ne̱?

english_verse: When kings die, they are buried in glorious tombs.
translation_verse: Dšeṅmãdši le̱ amaṅtše̱mei le̱ fẽ le̱, ame̱fẽ-kwa ame̱kãmo̱kãmo̱ ši ke̱ anumnyam, mofẽmo ye̱ ewe;

english_verse: We will slaughter your sons to make them pay for the crimes of their ancestors. They won't take over the world or build cities anywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Nyesãa gbēhe nyetoa ebii le̱ *ye̱ ame̱tše̱mei anõša le̱ hewo̱, koni ame̱kate ši ame̱mīṅõ šikpoṅ le̱ ame̱mīfe ame̱nõ ni ame̱wo dše le̱ṅ obõ ke̱ mãdši. *

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has promised to attack Babylonia and destroy everyone there, so that none of them will ever be remembered again.
translation_verse: Ši mate ši mawoame̱, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱, ni mafo Babel gbe̱i ke̱ noni eſe̱ le̱ ke̱ bi ke̱ nābi maše̱ mafõ! Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: The Lord will sweep out the people, and the land will become a swamp for wild animals. Assyria Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Asaṅ mahã etšṍ ko̱to̱ko̱i agbe̱fãṅnõ ke̱ nu kpākpoi so̱ṅṅ, ni mike̱ fitemo̱-blo̱ le̱ aabē̱le̱! Iehowa Zebaot kē̱.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has made this promise: Everything I have planned will happen just as I said.
translation_verse: Iehowa Zebaot ekã kitã ake̱: Le̱-le̱ṅ, bo̱ni misusu le̱, nakai ebaba mli, ni bo̱ni mito miyiṅ le̱, nakai ebamã ši:

english_verse: I will wipe out every Assyrian in my country, and I will crush those on my mountains. I will free my people from slavery to the Assyrians.
translation_verse: ake̱ makũ Ašur mli ye̱ mišikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni manānā eno̱ ye̱ migõdši le̱ ano̱, ni epã le̱ aadše ame̱no̱, ni edšatšu le̱ hũ adše ame̱kue̱ no̱.

english_verse: I have planned this for the whole world, and my mighty arm controls every nation.
translation_verse: Ene̱ dši yiṅ ní ato ye̱ šikpoṅ mū le̱ fẽ he, ni ene̱ dši nine ní akpã mli ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ fẽ no̱.

english_verse: Philistines, don't be happy just because the rod that punished you is broken. That rod will become a poisonous snake, and then a flying fiery dragon.
translation_verse: Bo *Filistea mū le̱ fẽ, kānyã́ ake̱ tšo ní yio le̱ ekũ! Ši šikpã aadše̱ onũfũ le̱ šisĩfã le̱ mli aba, ni ebi aatšṍ onũfũ flikilo̱ ní nā yo̱ la. *Ier.

english_verse: The poor and needy will find pastures for their sheep and will live in safety. But I will starve some of you, and others will be killed.
translation_verse: Ši ohĩafoi amli ohĩafoi le̱ aaná nii aye, ni nõnalo̱i hũ aakãmo̱ ši ſeſēſe; ši mike̱ hõmo̱ aagbe ošišifã le̱, ni omei ní aaſe̱ le̱ hũ, eegbeame̱.

english_verse: Cry and weep in the gates of your towns, you Philistines! Smoke blows in from the north, and every soldier is ready.
translation_verse: Bo agbó, wo̱ lele! Bo maṅ, blo̱mo̱! Bo Filistea fẽ, otšui afã! Edšake̱ lasũ ko dše̱ kōyigbe̱ mība, ni etabilo̱i le̱ ateṅ mokomoko ekpeṅ se̱.

english_verse: If a messenger comes from a distant nation, you must say: “The Lord built Zion. Even the poorest of his people will find safety there.”
translation_verse: Ni mẽ hetõ aahã dšeṅmaṅ le̱ bo̱-foi le̱? No dši ake̱ Iehowa to Zion šiši, ni emaṅ le̱ mli šitſialo̱i le̱ aababa abo ye̱ dše̱i!

english_verse: Everyone in Dibon has gone up to the temple and the shrines to cry and weep. All of Moab is crying. Heads and beards are shaved because of what happened at Nebo and Medeba.
translation_verse: Ete Bait ke̱ Dibon hei groṅṅi le̱ eyafó; Moab mīwo̱ lele mīſie Nebo ke̱ Medeba no̱. Ame̱fẽ *ame̱yĩteaṅ ekpakpai, ni akukū ame̱fẽ ame̱tšẽṅ. *Ezek.

english_verse: In the towns and at home, everyone wears sackcloth and cries loud and long.
translation_verse: Ame̱bumo̱ kpekpei ye̱ ame̱blohũiaṅ le̱ amli; ame̱fẽ ame̱mīwo̱ lele ni ame̱mīfó tšō ye̱ *ame̱tšũi ayiteaṅ ke̱ ame̱dšadši ano̱. *

english_verse: From Heshbon and Elealeh, weeping is heard in Jahaz; Moab's warriors scream while trembling with fear. Pity Moab
translation_verse: Ni Hešbon ke̱ Eleale mīblo̱, ni ānu ame̱gbē ye̱ Iahaz tō̃. Nohewo le̱ Moab tabilo̱ĩ le̱ mīblo̱ wā, esusuma mīkpokpo ye̱ emli.

english_verse: I pity Moab! Its people are running to Zoar and to Eglath-Shelishiyah. They cry on their way up to the town of Luhith; on the road to Horonaim they tell of disasters.
translation_verse: *Mitsui mīblo̱ mīhã Moab, ni efoidšelo̱i le̱ eše̱ Zoar, ní dšĩ afii etẽ tšinayō le̱; ni ame̱ke̱ yāfó mīkwo̱ Luhit, ni Horonaim gbe̱ le̱ no̱ le̱ ame̱wó hĩekpãtãmo̱ he yāfó no̱. *

english_verse: The streams of Nimrim and the grasslands have dried up. Every plant is parched.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Nimrim nui le̱ etă, ni dſe̱i eṅãlã, ni dſe̱fo̱ hũ etã, ni noko frõfrõ ko be̱ doṅṅ.

english_verse: The people of Moab are leaving, crossing over Willow Creek, taking everything they own and have worked for.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nii babaō ní ame̱ná le̱ ke̱ dſetri ní ame̱bo̱ le̱, ame̱alõ ke̱-yafo ṅkũntãṅ fã le̱.

english_verse: In the towns of Eglaim and of Beerelim and everywhere else in Moab mournful cries are heard.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ blo̱mo̱ ebo̱le Moab hūsũi le̱; elelewo̱mo̱ le̱ eše̱ Eglaim, elelewo̱mo̱ le̱ eše̱ Elim nubu le̱ he.

english_verse: The streams near Dimon are flowing with blood. But the Lord will bring even worse trouble to Dimon, because all in Moab who escape will be attacked by lions.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ lá so̱ṅṅ yo̱ Dimon nui le̱ amli, ši mike̱ nii ní fè no aaba Dimon no̱: mei ní dšo foi ke̱-dše̱ Moab le̱ ke̱ mei ní eſe̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱, dšata aaba ame̱no̱.

english_verse: Send lambs as gifts to the ruler of the land. Send them across the desert from Sela to Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Nyeke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱yelo̱ le̱ *gwanteṅbii le̱ adše̱a †Sela amãdšea ke̱-tšṍa ṅã le̱ no̱, ke-yaä Zion biyō le goṅ le̱ no. *

english_verse: Moab's messengers say to the people of Judah, “Be kind and help us! Shade us from the heat of the noonday sun. Hide our refugees! Don't turn them away.
translation_verse: Nyewoa ṅā, nyeyea sane le̱! Hã ohō̃ṅ le̱ afe tamo̱ nyōṅ ſane fintī̃, ni oke̱ mei ní aſieame̱ le̱ atē, kātšõ foidšelo̱i le̱ ase̱gbe̱!

english_verse: We have heard of Moab's pride. Its people strut and boast, but without reason.
translation_verse: Wo̱nu Moab hewõ le̱ he, ēwo ehe tšṍ, ehetšṍme̱ ke̱ ehewō ke̱ emlifũ le̱ ke̱ eſã-wiemo̱i ni be̱ mli le̱.

english_verse: Tell everyone in Moab to mourn for their nation. Tell them to cry and weep for those fancy raisins of Kir-Hareseth.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ Moab aawo̱ lele ye̱ Moab hewo̱, ame̱fẽ ame̱awo̱ lele, nyeaye ṅko̱mo̱ ni nyeafe yeyēye ye̱ Kir-Hareset weinyibii atatalei le̱ ahewo̱.

english_verse: Vineyards near Heshbon and Sibmah have turned brown. The rulers of nations used to get drunk on wine from those vineyards that spread to Jazer, then across the desert and beyond the sea.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Hešbon ṅmõdši le̱ eṅãlã; Sibma weintšo le̱, dšeṅmãdši le̱ anuṅtšo̱mei le̱ ekũmo̱ enidši kpakpai le̱ kwrā; ame̱še̱ Iazer tō̃ ni ame̱kpa ṅã le̱ no̱, enidši le̱ eha ši ke̱-fo ṅšo̱ le̱!

english_verse: or joyful and happy times, while bringing in the crops. Singing and shouting are gone from the vineyards. There are no joyful shouts where grapes were pressed. God has silenced them all.
translation_verse: ni nyã́mo̱ ke̱ mliflimo̱ se̱ efo ye̱ ṅmõdšiaṅ, ni alaa ni ablo̱o̱ ye̱ weintromi amli doṅṅ. Weinṅãlo̱ eṅã̀ã̀ wein doṅṅ ye̱ ṅã̀he le̱, ni lala hũ, mihã ese̱ efo.

english_verse: Deep in my heart I hurt for Moab and Kir-Heres.
translation_verse: Hewo̱ le̱ mimlinii gbē̱o̱ tamo̱ saṅkũ ye̱ Moab hewo̱, mimũsũṅ hũ šãamĩ ye̱ Kir-Heres hewo̱. K.

english_verse: It's useless for Moab's people to wear themselves out by going to their altars to worship and pray.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱, ké̱ Moab yapue ni eyagbo deṅme ye̱ he groṅṅ le̱ ni eba ehekroṅkroṅ le̱ ebaso̱le le̱, ehoṅ.

english_verse: The Lord has already said all of this about Moab.
translation_verse: Ene̱ dši wiemo̱ ni Iehowa wie ši Moab tšutšu le̱;

english_verse: Now he says, “The contract of a hired worker is good for three years, but Moab's glory and greatness won't last any longer than that. Only a few of its people will survive, and they will be left helpless.”
translation_verse: ši agbe̱ne̱ Iehowa mīwie ake̱: Bie̱ afii eti ní *tamo̱ apāfonyo afii le̱, Moab anumnyam le̱ he guo̱ agbo ke̱ emei babaō le̱ fẽ, ni mei ní aaſe̱ le̱ še̱ṅ noko, ni ame̱dšee meikomei. *

english_verse: The villages around Aroer will be deserted, with only sheep living there and no one to bother them.
translation_verse: Ašĩ Aroer mãdši le̱ aſie ši ahã koloikui, ni ame̱abumo̱ ši ye̱ dše̱i, ni mokomoko eſieṅame̱.

english_verse: When that time comes, the glorious nation of Israel will be brought down; its prosperous people will be skin and bones.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ ake Iakob anumnyam le̱ no̱ aagbo̱, ni ehelo ní ewo fo̱ le̱ aatã lō.

english_verse: It will be like an olive tree beaten with a stick, leaving two or three olives or maybe four or five on the highest or most fruitful branches. The Lord God of Israel has promised this.
translation_verse: Ši kẽle̱ kpe̱kpe̱bii komei aaſe̱ ye̱ mli; tamo̱ bo̱ni ké̱ ahoso mũtšo ní ſe̱o̱ yibii enyo̱ alo etẽ ye̱ tšo le̱ yiteṅ tō̃, edſe̱ō, lo enumo̱ō, ye̱ enidši ní ewo pī le̱ amli le̱, Iehowa, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kē̱.

english_verse: At that time the people will turn and trust their Creator, the holy God of Israel.

translation_verse: Nakai be le̱ mli le̱ ake̱ maṅ ní kĕ̱le̱ ní ame̱he yo̱ trotro le̱ *aabake Iehowa Zebaot, ni asaṅ ake̱ meikomei aadše̱ maṅ ní ašeo̱le̱ gbeyei ke̱-yaä šoṅṅ le̱, dšeṅmaṅ ní he wa pam ní nānāa mei ano̱, ní fāi flo̱ ešikpoṅ le̱ mli le̱, ateṅ aba heni Iehowa Zebaot gbe̱i le̱ yo̱ ní dši Zion goṅ le̱ no̱ le̱. *Lal.

translation_verse: Ni Iuda šikpoṅ le̱ he aaba gbeyei ahã Mizraim; mofẽmo ni aatšĩ etã atšõle̱ le̱ eeše gbeyei, ye̱ Iehowa Zebaot yiṅ ní eto ye̱ Mizraim he le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: The Lord will show the Egyptians who he is, and they will know and worship the Lord. They will bring him sacrifices and offerings, and they will keep their promises to him.

translation_verse: Ni Iehowa Zebaot dšie ene̱ kpo ye̱ mitoiiaṅ ake̱: Le̱le̱ṅ ake̱ aṅõṅ ne̱ke̱ nõ-ša ne̱ afaṅnye ke̱-yaši beyino ní nyeagboi! Nuṅtšo̱, Iehowa Zebaot, kē̱.

translation_verse: Na, Iehowa baše̱o afõ, tamo̱ hewalo̱ še̱o̱ nõ fõo̱, ni eemõ omli tſé̱;

english_verse: He will roll you into a ball and throw you into a wide open country, where you will die and your chariots will be destroyed. You're a disgrace to those you serve.
translation_verse: kotamo̱ eekotao koklō, ni eeše̱o efõ šikpoṅ ní da naakpa ko no̱; dše̱i ooyagbo ye̱, ni onumnyam ſīlii le̱ aaka dše̱i, bo ni odši hĩegbĕle hã onuṅtšo̱ we le̱!

english_verse: The Lord is going to take away your job!
translation_verse: Ni maſieo ke̱-adše̱ onitšumo̱ le̱ mli, ni aakpao ye̱ oyelihe le̱.

english_verse: He will give your official robes and your authority to his servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah. Eliakim will be like a father to the people of Jerusalem and to the royal family of Judah.
translation_verse: Ni mike̱ otade yū le̱ aawole̱, ni mike̱ ohe̱finõ le̱ aamīale̱, ni maṅõ ono̱yeli le̱ hũ mawo edeṅ, ní eetšṍ tše̱ ehã Ierusalembii le̱ ke̱ Iuda we le̱.

english_verse: The Lord will put him in charge of the key that belongs to King David's family. No one will be able to unlock what he locks, and no one will be able to lock what he unlocks.
translation_verse: Ni maṅõ David we le̱ samfē le̱ mafõ ekōṅ no̱, ni ké̱ *egble le̱, moko be̱ ni aaṅã́, ni ké̱ eṅã́ le̱, moko be̱ ní aagble. *Kpods.

english_verse: The Lord will make him as firm in his position as a tent peg hammered in the ground, and Eliakim will bring honor to his family.
translation_verse: Ni maṅõle̱ maka heko ni wa tamo̱ šiṅmlitšo, ni eetšṍ anumnyam maṅtše̱sẽi ehã etše̱ we le̱;

english_verse: His children and relatives will be supported by him, like pans hanging from a peg on the wall.
translation_verse: ni ake̱ etše̱ we le̱ anumnyam le̱ fẽ aatšotšõro eno̱, eseši ke̱ eſīei fẽ, ke̱ emlinibii bibii fẽ, ke̱-dše̱ kpudši ano̱ ke̱-yaši gbé̱i ano̱ fẽ.

english_verse: That peg is fastened firmly now, but someday it will be shaken loose and fall down. Then everything that was hanging on it will be destroyed. This is what the Lord All-Powerful has promised.
translation_verse: No gbĩ lo̱ no̱ le̱, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱, šiṅmlitšo ní aṅõ-ka heko ní wa le̱, aafe wo̱ko̱wo̱ko̱, ni aafo afõ ši, ni dšatšu ní tšotšõro no̱ le̱ aafite; edšake̱ Iehowa ekē̱.

english_verse: This is a message from distant islands about the city of Tyre: Cry, you seagoing ships! Tyre and its houses lie in ruins.
translation_verse: *Tiro kodšomo̱ he gbale̱: Nye Taršiš le̱dši, nyewo̱a lele; edšake̱ akpãtã ehĩe, šĩa ko be̱ dše̱i doṅṅ, moko eyaa dše̱i doṅṅ! Kitim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ adšo̱ ahã ame̱le. *Ezek.

english_verse: Mourn in silence, you shop owners of Sidon, you people on the coast. Your sailors crossed oceans, making your city rich.
translation_verse: Nye ṅšo̱nābii, nyeto̱a mṹ! Bo ní Zidon guo̱yelo̱i ní nyieo̱ ṅšo̱ hĩe le̱ ewoö obõ;

english_verse: Your merchants sailed the seas, making you wealthy by trading with nation after nation. They brought back grain that grew along the Nile.
translation_verse: ni nui wudši ahĩe anyieo̱ ni ake̱ Šihor nibānii le̱ ke̱ fā le̱ he nikpamo̱nii le̱ baä emli, ni etšṍ dšeṅmãdši adsāno̱.

english_verse: Sidon, you are a mighty fortress built along the sea. But you will be disgraced like a married woman who never had children.
translation_verse: Zidon, ohĩe agbo; edšake̱ ṅšo̱ ke̱ ṅšo̱nā mō̃ le̱ ewie ake̱: Mikõmo̱ko, ni asaṅ mifo̱ko dã, milè̱ko oblahĩĩ, ni asaṅ mitšo̱seko oblayei dã!

english_verse: When Egypt hears about Tyre, it will tremble.
translation_verse: Ké̱ sane le̱ yaše̱ Mizraim le̱, ame̱-ahao ye̱ Tiro sane ní abagba le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: All of you along the coast had better cry and sail far across the ocean.
translation_verse: Nyefoaṅ ke̱-yaä Taršiš! Nye ṅšo̱nābii le̱, nyewo̱a lele!

english_verse: Can this be the happy city that has stood for centuries? Its people have spread to distant lands;
translation_verse: Aso nyemliflimo̱ maṅ le̱, ni dše̱ tetēte, ní enãdši ke̱le̱ dom ke̱-te šoṅṅ yato gbo̱ le̱, ne̱?

english_verse: its merchants were kings honored all over the world. Who planned to destroy Tyre?
translation_verse: Namo to eyiṅ ne̱ke̱ ye̱ Tiro ní dši akekrehãle̱ le̱ he? *Edšrayelo̱i le̱ lume̱i so̱ṅṅ ni, eguo̱yelo̱i le̱ hũ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ anumnyam gbomei so̱ṅṅ ni! *Kpods.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful planned it to bring shame and disgrace to those who are honored by everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Iehowa Zebaot eto eyiṅ ake̱ eewo hewõ anumnyam fẽ he mūdši, ni eehã šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ anumnyam gbomei fẽ he guo̱ agbo.

english_verse: People of Tyre, your harbor is destroyed! You will have to become farmers just like the Egyptians. Tyre Will Be Forgotten
translation_verse: Bo Taršiš biyō, yi ošikpoṅ le̱ no̱ to̱ tamo̱ Nilo; *mlifĩnõ ko be̱ ohe doṅṅ! *Hiob

english_verse: The Lord's hand has reached across the sea, upsetting the nations. He has given a command to destroy fortresses in the land of Canaan.
translation_verse: Ekpã enine mli ye̱ ṅšo̱ le̱ no̱, ehoso maṅtše̱yelihei le̱: Iehowa ewo kitã ye̱ Kanaan hewo̱ ako̱ afite ame̱mõdši le̱;

english_verse: The Lord has said to the people of Sidon, “Your celebrating is over— you are crushed. Even if you escape to Cyprus, you won't find peace.”
translation_verse: ni ekē̱ ake̱: Omli akaflio doṅṅ, bo oblayō ni atoö kabonā, *Zidon biyō! Te ši ni ofoṅ ke̱-ya Kitimbii le̱ aṅõ! ši dše̱i hũ onáṅ hedšo̱le̱. *Ezek.

english_verse: Look what the Assyrians have done to Babylonia! They have attacked, destroying every palace in the land. Now wild animals live among the ruins.
translation_verse: Na, Kaldeabii ašikpoṅ le̱: ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱, ame̱dšee maṅ ko doṅṅ, Ašurbii eṅõ-hã ṅãno̱ koloi, ame̱mämo̱ ame̱-dientše̱ ame̱mõdši ní kwŏ̱lo̱ le̱, ni ame̱-kũmo̱ emõdši le̱, ame̱fele̱ koikoi!

english_verse: Not a fortress will be left standing, so tell all the seagoing ships to mourn.
translation_verse: Nye Taršiš le̱dši, nyewo̱a lele; edšako̱ akpãtã nyemō̃ le̱ hĩe!

english_verse: You're gone and forgotten, you evil woman! So strut through the town, singing and playing your favorite tune to be remembered again.
translation_verse: Ko̱ saṅkũ ni oyakpa mã le̱ṅ, bo adſamaṅ ní hĩe ekpa ono̱! Tſa saṅkũ le̱ dšogbāṅ, ni ola lalai pī, beni afe ní akaio ekoṅ!

english_verse: but none of what is earned will be kept in the city. That money will belong to the Lord, and it will be used to buy more than enough food and good clothes for those who worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Ši edšrayelinii ke̱ epābō̱nii le̱ aatšṍ kroṅkroṅ ahã Iehowa; atĩaṅ ni ake̱-bo̱ṅ dſetri, ši epābō̱nii le̱ aatšṍ mei ní hĩo̱ ši ye̱ Iehowa hĩe le̱ anõ, ní ame̱ye nii amè̱tŏ̱ro̱, ni ame̱bu mama kpakpa.

english_verse: The earth wilts away; its mighty leaders melt to nothing.
translation_verse: Šikpoṅ le̱ mīye ṅko̱mo̱ ni ēṅãlã; dše le̱ṅ yi mītã ni ēṅãlã; šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ gbomei agboi le̱ mītã!

english_verse: No one plays tambourines or stringed instruments; all noisy celebrating has come to an end.
translation_verse: Mĩdši anyã́mo̱ le̱ edšo̱, mliflilo̱i le̱ ablo̱mo̱ le̱ se̱ efo, saṅkũi anyã́mo̱ le edšo̱. Ier.

english_verse: They no longer sing as they drink their wine, and it tastes sour.
translation_verse: Anuu wein afataa lala he, dā̃ ní wa hũ edšō ehã mei ní nuo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Happy times have disappeared from the earth, and people shout in the streets, “We're out of wine!”
translation_verse: Āblo̱ ye̱ blohũi le̱ amli ye̱ wein hewo̱, ni mīše̱ fẽ enyõ ši kwrā, šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ nyã́mo̱ le̱ ete šoṅṅ.

english_verse: Cities are destroyed; their gates are torn down.
translation_verse: Maṅ le̱ noni eſe̱ pe̱ dši amaṅfõ, akũmo̱ agbói le̱ dukuduku.

english_verse: Nations will be stripped bare, like olive trees or vineyards after the harvest season. Praise the God of Justice
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo̱ni baha ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ke̱ mãdšimãdši le̱ ateṅ ne̱, tamo̱ ahosoo̱ mũtšo, lo ayeo̱ weinyibii akpe̱kpe̱o, beni atše weinyibii le̱ etã le̱.

english_verse: And so, everyone in the east and those on the islands should praise the Lord, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyewoa Iehowa hĩe nyam ye̱ bokã le̱, ni ṅšo̱kpo̱i le̱ ano̱ hũ, nyewóa Iehowa, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, gbe̱i le̱ no̱!

english_verse: From all over the world songs of praise are heard for the God of justice. But I feel awful, terribly miserable. Can anyone be trusted? So many are treacherous! There's No Escape
translation_verse: Wo̱nu lalai ke̱-dše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbẽ-hei le̱ ake̱: Dšalo̱ le̱ hĩe aaba nyam! Ši mi le̱ mikē̱: Mītã lō, mĩtã lō! kpóo hãmil kũtũmpo̱foi miye kũtũmpo̱o, kũtũmpo̱foi miye kũtũmpo̱o pi!

english_verse: Terror, traps, and pits are waiting for everyone.
translation_verse: Gbeyei ke̱ bu ke̱ tšõne kã ši hão, bo moni oyo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ ne̱ le̱.

english_verse: He will put them in a pit and keep them prisoner. Then later on, he will punish them.
translation_verse: ni aawoame̱ tšũṅ, tamo̱ awoo̱ gbokle̱foi atšũṅ ye̱ bu mli, aaṅã́ ame̱yi awo gbokle̱foi atšũṅ, ni gbĩĩ babaō ee̱ dãni aawoame̱ nyõmo̱.

english_verse: Now strong and cruel nations will fear and honor you.
translation_verse: Hewo̱ le̱ maṅ ko ni he wa aawo ohĩe nyam, dšeṅmãdši yiwalo̱i le̱ amaṅ le̱ aašeo gbeyei.

english_verse: You have been a place of safety for the poor and needy in times of trouble. Brutal enemies pounded us like a heavy rain or the heat of the sun at noon, but you were our shelter.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ otšṍ mõ ohã nõnalo̱, otšṍ mō̃ ohã ohĩafo ye̱ efĩmo̱ mli, *abobāhe ye̱ ahum mli, ke̱ hō̃ṅ ye̱ latšā mli, be mli ní yiwalo̱i le̱ amumo̱ tamo̱ ahum ke̱ nyoṅmo̱ne̱mo̱ ní yio̱ gbogbo le̱.

english_verse: Those wild foreigners struck like scorching desert heat. But you were like a cloud, protecting us from the sun. You kept our enemies from singing songs of victory. The Lord Has Saved Us
translation_verse: Bo̱ni latšā feo̱ ye̱ ṅă kpatā no̱ le̱, nakai oba maṅse̱bìi ahōfemo̱ le̱ ši; bo̱ni atatu hō̃ṅ mli latšā yo̱ le̱, nakai oba yiwalo̱i le̱ alala le̱ ši.

english_verse: On this mountain the Lord All-Powerful will prepare for all nations a feast of the finest foods. Choice wines and the best meats will be served.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa Zebaot aaṅmẽ okplõ ye̱ goṅ ne̱ no̱ ahă mãdšimãdši fẽ: *fo̱nii ke̱ wein kpakpa, fo̱nii ke̱ wuiaṅfo̱, wein kpakpa ni atšere no. *Lal.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will destroy the power of death and wipe away all tears. No longer will his people be insulted everywhere. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: Eemĩ *gbĕle ke̱-ate nāno̱; ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa †aatšumo̱ hĩeaṅ fẽ yāfónui, ni eedšie emaṅ le̱ hĩegbĕle le̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ mū le̱ fẽ no̱; edša-ke̱ Iehowa ekē̱. *

english_verse: At that time, people will say, “The Lord has saved us! Let's celebrate. We waited and hoped— now our God is here.”
translation_verse: Ni aakē̱ ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ ake̱: Na, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ní wo̱hĩe kã eno̱, ake̱ eehere wo̱yiwala le̱ ne̱! Mone̱ dši Iehowa ní wo̱hĩe kã eno̱ le̱! Nyehãa wo̱nyã́a ni wo̱mli afliawo̱ ye̱ eyiwalaheremo̱ le̱ hewo̱! Lal.

english_verse: The powerful arm of the Lord will protect this mountain. The Moabites will be put down and trampled on like straw in a pit of manure.
translation_verse: Ši Iehowa ke̱ enine aaṅmẽ ne̱ke̱ goṅ ne̱ no̱, ni aanānā Moab no̱ ye̱ heni eyo̱ le̱, tamo̱ anāa dſe̱i no̱ ye̱ tumu no̱ nu mli le̱.

english_verse: They will struggle to get out, but God will humiliate them no matter how hard they try.
translation_verse: Ni eekpã enidši amli ye̱ ame̱teṅ, tamo̱ sĕrelo̱ kpãa enidšĩ amli ní eke̱-sẽreo̱ le̱; ni eehã ehewō le̱ ke̱ eninenā ṅā le̱ aba ši;

english_verse: The walls of their fortresses will be knocked down and scattered in the dirt.
translation_verse: ni ogbogboi ní wa ní ame̱kwŏ̱lo̱ le̱, eekūmo̱ nĩ eehã aba ši, ní eke̱ šikpoṅ sũ aye egbo.

english_verse: The Lord gives perfect peace to those whose faith is firm.
translation_verse: Dſẽṅmo̱ ní mã ši šiṅṅ le̱, oohã ená hedšo̱le̱, hedšo̱le̱; edšake̱ ono̱ eṅõo̱ ehĩe efõo̱.

english_verse: Now the poor and abused trample all over that city.” The Lord Can Be Trusted
translation_verse: ake̱ nane aanā no̱; hē̃, nõnalo̱i anãdši ke̱ ohĩafoi ananefãmo̱i hũ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and you make the path smooth for those who obey you.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱ gbe̱ le̱ dša tromō̃; bo odšadšeo̱ dšalo̱ tempõṅ le̱ pe̱pē̱pe̱.

english_verse: You are the one we trust to bring about justice; above all else we want your name to be honored.
translation_verse: Iehowa, wo̱mīkwe̱o gbe̱ ye̱ okodšomo̱i agbe̱ le̱ no̱ hũ; *wo̱susuma mīſe ogbe̱i ke̱ okaimo̱ le̱! *Lal.

english_verse: Throughout the night, my heart searches for you, because your decisions show everyone on this earth how to live right.
translation_verse: Misusuma ſeo̱o nyōṅ, mimumo̱ hũ ní yo̱ mimli le̱ taoo̱ bo mrã; edšake̱ kē̱ okodšomo̱i le̱ ba šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱, dše le̱ṅ bii le̱ kaseo̱ dšale̱.

english_verse: Your hand is raised and ready to punish them, but they don't see it. Put them to shame! Show how much you care for us and throw them into the fire intended for your enemies.
translation_verse: Iehowa, owó onine no̱, ši kẽle̱ ame̱naa; ši ame̱ana dšōmo̱ ní odšōo̱ ye̱ omaṅ le̱ he le̱, ni ame̱hĩe aagboi; la aašã ohenye̱lo̱i le̱.

english_verse: Others have ruled over us besides you, our Lord God, but we obey only you.
translation_verse: Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱, nuṅtšo̱mei krokomei ebaye wo̱no̱, ni dšee bo ke̱ke̱; ši bo okome ogbe̱i le̱ atã wo̱o̱tšĩ!

english_verse: When you punished our people, they turned and prayed to you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Iehowa, kē̱ efĩ le̱, no ame̱hĩe tšṍo̱o; ké̱ otšo̱semo̱ le̱ kã ame̱no̱ le̱, ame̱fo̱seo̱ faikpamo̱ ame̱ſieo̱ ši.

english_verse: Because of what you did to us, we suffered like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Tamo̱ *yō ní hĩe mũsũ ni eše̱ efo̱mo̱be kẽmoo̱ ni eblo̱ö̱ yo̱ ekō̃mo̱ le̱ mli le̱, nakai wo̱ hũ wo̱yo̱ ye̱ ohĩe ne̱, Iehowa. *Ioh.

english_verse: But instead of having a child, our terrible pain produced only wind. We have won no victories, and we have no descendants to take over the earth.
translation_verse: Wo̱ hũ *wo̱hĩe mũsũ, wo̱mīkẽmo̱; etamo̱ ake̱ wo̱fo̱ kō̱yo̱. Wo̱nyẽẽ šikpoṅ le̱ yiwala wo̱here, ni dše le̱ṅ bii le̱ hũ wo̱fo̱koame̱. *Mika

english_verse: Your people will rise to life! Tell them to leave their graves and celebrate with shouts. You refresh the earth like morning dew; you give life to the dead.
translation_verse: Omei ní *egboi le̱ ahĩe aakãmo̱, migbohĩĩ le̱ aate ši. Nyehĩe atšẽa, nyelaä yidšiemo̱ lalai, nye mei ní nyeyo̱ sũ mli le̱! Ši obó̱ le̱, la bó̱ ni, ni šikpoṅ le̱ aadšie sisai le̱ aſie. *Ezek.

english_verse: Go inside and lock the doors, my people. Hide there for a little while, until the Lord is no longer angry. The Earth and the Sea Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Ya, mimaṅ, ni oyabote opia le̱ mli, ni oṅã́ ošĩnā le̱ owo oyi; tēmo̱ ohe hĩṅme̱itſā-ō ko *ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní mlifũ le̱ aaho! *Lal.

english_verse: The Lord will come out to punish everyone on earth for their sins. And when he does, those who did violent crimes will be known and punished.
translation_verse: Ši na, Iehowa mīdše kpo ke̱-mīdše̱ ehĩle̱he le̱ ni eyawo šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ bii anyõmo̱ ye̱ ame̱nišaianii le̱ ahewo̱; ni šikpoṅ le̱ aadšie elá le̱ kpo ni ehaṅ mei ni agbe ye̱ eno̱ le̱ ano̱ doṅṅ.

english_verse: At that time you must sing about a fruitful vineyard.
translation_verse: Nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ nyelaã ye̱ *weintrom fe̱fe̱o le̱ he ake̱: *

english_verse: I am no longer angry. But if it produces thorns, I will go to war against it and burn it to the ground.
translation_verse: Mlifũ ko be̱ mimli. Miná ni kũle̱ kpitikpitii ke̱ ṅmeiĩ ke̱mi mīwu, kũle̱ mafã ke̱-yaninaame̱ ni mašã blublu tſēm!

english_verse: Yet if the vineyard depends on me for protection, it will become my friend and be at peace with me.
translation_verse: Dša ebabami abo, ni eke̱mi kpãtã; hē̃, hã eke̱mi akpãtã!

english_verse: Someday Israel will take root like a vine. It will blossom and bear fruit that covers the earth.
translation_verse: Gbĩĩ ni baba le̱ amli le̱ Iakob aatšẽrẽ fãi, ni Israel hũ aagba afofro ni eefro̱ke, ni ame̱ke̱ yibii aawo dše le̱ṅ obõ to̱.

english_verse: I carefully measured out Israel's punishment and sent the scorching heat to chase them far away.
translation_verse: Beni oſiele̱ le̱, *susumo̱ nā oke̱le̱ ye ye̱; †gbĩ ní bokã kō̱yo̱ le̱ tſaä le̱ oke̱ kō̱yo̱ ní nä wa le̱ lōle̱ ke̱-te. *Ier.

english_verse: There's only one way that Israel's sin and guilt can be completely forgiven: They must crush the stones of every pagan altar and place of worship. The Lord Will Bring His People Together
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ ene̱ ake̱-tšumo̱ Iakob nõša le, ni yibii fẽ ní ehe eša le̱ dšiemo̱ le̱ wo ne̱, beni efe efo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ be te̱i le̱ fẽ tamo̱ kālote̱i ní efuflu le̱, ni *wo̱ṅkōi le̱ ke̱ †hũlũ amãgãi le̱ mãmo̱ṅ ši doṅṅ. *

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will shake the land between the Euphrates River and the border of Egypt, and one by one he will bring all of his people together.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ ake̱ Iehowa aagbẽ eṅmā̃ le̱ ke̱-adše̱ Eufrate fā le̱ nā ke̱-yaši Mizraim fā le̱ nā, ni nye, Israelbii le̱, aako̱lo̱nye ekomekome.

english_verse: A loud trumpet will be heard. Then the people of Israel who were dragged away to Assyria and Egypt will return to worship the Lord on his holy mountain in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ ake̱ aakpã te̱tre̱mantre̱ wulu, ni mei ni elādše ye̱ Ašur šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ ke̱ mei ni aše̱re̱ame̱ aſie Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ aaba, ni ame̱abadšá Iehowa ye̱ goṅ kroṅkroṅ le̱ no̱ ye̱ Ierusalem.

english_verse: Every drunkard in Ephraim takes pride in Samaria, but it will be crushed.
translation_verse: Ni Efraim dā̃to̱lo̱i ahewō akekre le̱ ake̱ nãdši aanānā no̱;

english_verse: Samaria above a fertile valley will quickly lose its glory. It will be gobbled up like the first ripe fig at harvest season.

translation_verse: Ni *ete̱sā le̱ aaho aya ye̱ gbeyei nā, ni elumei le̱ ahe aakpokpo ye̱ aflaṅā le̱ hewo̱. Nakai Iehowa, moni ela yo̱ Zion ni eflõnõ yo̱ Ierusalem le̱, kē̱. *

english_verse: They will be a place of safety from stormy winds, a stream in the desert, and a rock that gives shade from the heat of the sun.
translation_verse: ni mofẽmo aatšṍ tamo̱ abobāhe ye̱ kŏ̱yo̱ nā ke̱ tēmo̱he ye̱ nyoṅmo̱ne̱mo̱ nā, tamo̱ fāi ye̱ ṅã kpatā no̱ lo te̱sā kple ko ní hãa hō̃ṅ ye̱ šikpoṅ gbĩṅ no̱.

english_verse: Fools will no longer be highly respected, and crooks won't be given positions of honor.
translation_verse: Atšé̱ṅ kwašia ake̱ ablade doṅṅ, ni šišiulo̱ hũ abuṅle̱ odše doṅṅ.

english_verse: Fools talk foolishness. They always make plans to do sinful things, to lie about the Lord, to let the hungry starve, and to keep water from those who are thirsty.
translation_verse: Ši kwašia wieo̱ kwašiai awiemo̱, ni etšui hũ tšuo̱ nišaianii, ni ayeo̱ kũtũmpo̱o sane, ni ewieo̱ sakasaka ešio̱ Iehowa, ni ehãa moni hõmo̱ yeo̱le̱ le̱ susuma kãa eflo, ni moni kũmai yeo̱le̱ le̱ ehãã ená nu enu.

english_verse: Cruel people tell lies— they do evil things, and make cruel plans to destroy the poor and needy, even when they beg for justice.
translation_verse: Šišiulo̱ ṅă le̱, efõṅ ni; etoo̱ efõṅ he ṅā, koni eke̱ amale wiemo̱i akpãtã mei ní nii yo̱ mo̱bo̱ le̱ ahĩe, ké̱ ohĩafoi miwie noni dša tete le̱.

english_verse: But helpful people can always be trusted to make helpful plans. Punishment for the Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ši ablade le̱ abladei anii ahe edſẽṅo̱, ni abladei anii ahe hũ ekãa.

english_verse: Listen to what I say, you women who are carefree and careless!
translation_verse: Nye yei ní nyehe edšo̱nye le̱, nyetea ši nyeboa migbē toi! Nye biyei hũ, ní nyeyitšei kãmo̱ nyeyise̱ le̱, nyefea toi nyehãa miwiemo̱ le̱!

english_verse: You may not have worries now, but in about a year, the grape harvest will fail, and you will tremble.
translation_verse: Wó̱se̱ afi ko le̱ nyehe aakpokpo, nye yei ní nyeyitšei kãmo̱ nyeyi se̱ ne̱; edšake̱ weinyibii atšemo̱ se̱ aafo, tšei ayibii anābuamo̱ baṅ doṅṅ.

english_verse: Shake and shudder, you women without a care! Strip off your clothes— put on sackcloth.
translation_verse: Nye yei ní nyehe edšo̱nye le̱, nyehe adšoa, ni nye mei ní nyeyitšei kãmo̱ nyeyise̱ le̱, nyehe akpokpoa! Nyekplo̱a nyetadei ni nyehe akã ni nyeke̱ kpekpe aṅmõlõa nyehe̱i!

english_verse: Slap your breasts in sorrow because of what happened to the fruitful fields and vineyards,
translation_verse: Nyeašimo̱ nyetšitšii ye̱ ṅmõdši ní yo̱ fe̱o le̱ ahewo̱, ye̱ weintšei ní woo̱ yibii pī le̱ ahewo̱.

english_verse: and to the happy homes in Jerusalem. The land of my people is covered with thorns.
translation_verse: Nmeii ke̱ kpitikpitii aakwẽ ye̱ mimaṅ le̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, hē̃, ye̱ nyã́mo̱ maṅ le̱ mli mīše̱námo̱ tšũi le̱ fẽ ayiteaṅ!

english_verse: The palace will be deserted, the crowded city empty. Fortresses and towers will forever become playgrounds for wild donkeys and pastures for sheep. God's Spirit Makes the Difference
translation_verse: Edšake̱ aakwa mõdši le̱, ni aašĩ maṅ ní mli yo̱ so̱ko̱so̱ko̱ le̱ afõ ši, goṅkpo̱ le̱ ke̱ būmō̃ le̱ aatšṍmo̱ koloi abui ke̱-ate nāno̱, ke̱ ṅãṅ tedšii amīše̱nõ ke̱ kolokui alẽ̱̀he;

english_verse: When the Spirit is given to us from heaven, deserts will become orchards thick as fertile forests.
translation_verse: ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní aafo̱se *Mumo̱ ke̱-adše̱ ṅwei aſie wo̱no̱, ni †ṅãno̱ aatšṍ abō̱, ni aabu abō̱ hũ ake kō. *

english_verse: You, the Lord's people, will live in peace, calm and secure,
translation_verse: ni mimaṅ le̱ aabi ši ye̱ hedšo̱le̱ šĩa, ke̱ šihĩle̱he ni yo̱ ſeſēſe, ke̱ hedšō̱mo̱he ní yo̱ kpō.

english_verse: You will have God's blessing, as you plant your crops beside streams, while your donkeys and cattle roam freely about.
translation_verse: Adšō̱ nye mei ní nyedũo̱ nii ye̱ fāi fẽ nā, ni nyeṅmẽo̱ tšina ke̱ tedši nane gbe̱ le̱.

english_verse: you are the foundation on which we stand today. You always save us and give true wisdom and knowledge. Nothing means more to us than obeying you. The Lord Will Do Something
translation_verse: Ni šifĩmo̱ aaba ye̱ oyino̱ le̱, ke̱ yiwalaheremo̱ ke̱ ṅā ke̱ nilē babaō; Iehowa gbeyeišemo̱ dši edſetri.

english_verse: Fields are dry and barren; Mount Lebanon wilts with shame. Sharon Valley is a desert; the forests of Bashan and Carmel have lost their leaves.
translation_verse: Šikpoṅ lo̱ miye ṅko̱mo̱ ni eṅălã; Lebanon hĩe egbo ni egbĩ kwrā; Šaron etšṍ tamo̱ ṅã ole̱ṅle̱, Bašan ke̱ Karmel hũ ekpla ame̱bāi eſie ši.

english_verse: But the Lord says, “Now I will do something and be greatly praised.
translation_verse: Iehowa kē̱: Agbe̱ne̱ mate ši, agbe̱ne̱ mawó miyi no̱, agbe̱ne̱ mawó mihe no̱!

english_verse: Your deeds are straw that will be set on fire by your very own breath.
translation_verse: Nyehĩe dſe̱i mũsũ, nyebafo gbetšelii; nyemnmo̱ ní nyemũo̱ lo̱ dši la ni bašãnye!

english_verse: Everyone, both far and near, come look at what I have done. See my mighty power!” Punishment and Rewards
translation_verse: Nye mei ní nyeyo̱ šoṅṅ le̱, nyenua nii ní mife le̱! ni nye mei ní nyebe̱ṅke̱ le̱, nyeyoa mihewale̱ le̱!

english_verse: Those terrible sinners on Mount Zion tremble as they ask in fear, “How can we possibly live where a raging fire never stops burning?”
translation_verse: Ešafelo̱i ní yo̱ Zion le̱ ahe mīkpokpo, ni ṅmiṅmi emõmo̱ osatofoi le̱ [ame̱-kē̱o̱ ake̱]: Wo̱teṅ namo aahĩ la ní šãa nii mase̱i? ni wo̱teṅ namo aahĩ la ni etšẽ ke̱-yaã nāno̱ le̱ mase̱i?

english_verse: They will live in a fortress high on a rocky cliff, where they will have food and plenty of water. The Lord Is Our King
translation_verse: le̱ le̱ eebi ṅwei šoṅṅ, te̱sāi amli mõdši aatšṍmo̱ ebobāhe; aaṅõ eniyenii ahãle̱, enu hũ emĩṅ.

english_verse: With your own eyes you will see the glorious King; you will see his kingdom reaching far and wide.
translation_verse: Ohĩṅme̱ii aana *maṅtše̱ le̱ ye̱ ehe-fe̱o le mli, ame̱ana šikpoṅ ní lẽ te̱trē̱. *

english_verse: Then you will ask yourself, “Where are those officials who terrified us and forced us to pay such heavy taxes?”
translation_verse: Otšui aadſẽṅ ṅmiṅmi le̱ he: nẽgbe̱ moni kaneo̱ šika le̱ yo̱? nẽgbe̱ moni ṅmẽo̱ le̱ yo̱? nẽgbe̱ moni kanee̱ mõdši le̱ yo̱?

english_verse: You will never again have to see the proud people who spoke a strange and foreign language you could not understand.
translation_verse: Ši onaṅ maṅ ní sane wa le̱, maṅ ní *ewiemo̱ wa ní anuu, ní wieo̱ ke̱ momohā lile̱i ni anaa šiši le̱. *

english_verse: Look to Mount Zion where we celebrate our religious festivals. You will see Jerusalem, secure as a tent with pegs that cannot be pulled up and fastened with ropes that can never be broken.
translation_verse: Kwe̱mo̱ Zion, ni dši wo̱gbĩdšŭrõyeli maṅ le̱, ni ohĩṅme̱ii aana Ierusalem, šĩa ní yo̱ ſeſēſe, bū ni atšii, ní afãmo̱o̱ ehe šiṅmlitšei le̱ gbĩkogbĩko, ní ehe tãṅkpēi le̱ eko eko tšee le̱.

english_verse: Our wonderful Lord will be with us! There will be deep rivers and wide streams safe from enemy ships. The Lord Is Our Judge
translation_verse: Ši Iehowa ni dši anumnyamtše̱ le̱ aahĩ ši ye̱ dše̱i ahãwo̱, tamo̱ noni fãi ke̱ nsutẽṅi ní lē̱ ebo̱lewo̱, ni ahiṅke̱se ke̱ emli tablõi nyẽṅ dše̱i aya, ni le̱le̱ wulu ko nyẽẽ afo.

english_verse: The Lord is our judge and our ruler; the Lord is our king and will keep us safe.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa dši wo̱kodšolo̱, Iehowa dši wo̱tatše̱, Iehowa dši wo̱maṅtše̱, le̱ noṅṅ eehere wo̱yiwala.

english_verse: But your nation is a ship with its rigging loose, its mast shaky, and its sail not spread. Someday even you that are lame will take everything you want from your enemies.
translation_verse: Otãṅkpēi le̱ amli egbo̱dšo̱, ame̱nyẽẽ le̱le̱ṅtšo le̱ ame̱hĩe, ame̱nyẽẽ aabalã le̱ ame̱ši! No le̱ aadša nomṅõnii ni aha babaō le̱ mli, obubuafoi tete aaha nii.

english_verse: The Lord will forgive your sins, and none of you will say, “I feel sick.”
translation_verse: Ni maṅbii le̱ ateṅ moko ekē̱ṅ ake̱: *Migbo̱dšo̱! Edšake̱ mei ní yo̱ mli le̱, aaṅõ ame̱nišaianii le̱ afa-ame̱. *Zak.

english_verse: After the sword of the Lord has done what it wants to the skies above, it will come down on Edom, the nation that the Lord has doomed for destruction.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ miklante le̱ eto dā̃ ye̱ ṅwei; na, ebayi *Edom no̱, ebaba maṅ ni mifele̱ musu le̱ no̱ ebakodšo. *Ier.
