english_verse: Edom's leaders are wild oxen. They are powerful bulls, but they will die with the others. Their country will be soaked with their own blood, and its soil made fertile with their own fat.
translation_verse: Ni wuoi ke̱ame̱ aanyõnyõi, ke̱ tšinahĩĩ ke̱ tšina osaii hũ, ni ame̱šikpoṅ le̱ aato̱ ke̱ lá, ni ame̱sũ le̱ aafe ṅĕlẽṅṅ ke̱ fo̱ so̱ṅṅ.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen the year and the day, when he will take revenge and come to Zion's defense.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa *oweletō̱ gbĩ ni, ke̱ nãdšiaṅtō afi ní eke̱-baye Zion sane ehã le̱. *

english_verse: Edom's streams will turn into tar and its soil into sulfur— then the whole country will go up in flames.
translation_verse: Ni emli fāi le̱ aatšṍmo̱ amã, ni dše̱i sũ hũ aatšṍ swō̱, ni ešikpoṅ le̱ aatšṍ amã ní tšoo̱;

english_verse: It will burn night and day and never stop smoking. Edom will be a desert, generation after generation; no one will ever travel through that land.
translation_verse: egboṅ nyōṅ ke̱ ſane fẽ, *elasũ aate ši ke̱-ate nāno̱, ni eetšṍ amaṅfõ ye̱ yino̱i fẽ no̱, ni mokomoko tšṍṅ dše̱i ke̱-ate nāno̱; *Kpods.

english_verse: Owls, hawks, and wild animals will make it their home. God will leave it in ruins, merely a pile of rocks. The End of Edom
translation_verse: ši kpokukpoku ke̱ ko̱to̱ko̱i aaṅõ dše̱i afe ame̱nō, ni patui ke̱ kwãkwãlabitei aahĩ dše̱i; ni eeṅmẽ ole̱ṅle̱ kpã ye̱ no̱, ni eke̱ amaṅfõ kŭlomŭlo aato he;

english_verse: Edom will be called “Kingdom of Nothing.” Its rulers will also be nothing.
translation_verse: ni ame̱bladei le̱ hũ, moko be̱ ní aašie̱ maṅtše̱yeli le̱; ame̱lumei le̱ fẽ le̱, ame̱dšee noko doṅṅ.

english_verse: Wildcats and hyenas will hunt together, demons will scream to demons, and creatures of the night will live among the ruins.
translation_verse: Ni ṅãṅ koloi ke̱ klãdši aabakpe ye̱ dše̱i, ni sasabonsami hũ anā aakpe ši; nyōṅ-sisa aahĩ dše̱i, ni eená hedšō̱mo̱he ye̱ dše̱i. Kpods.

english_verse: Owls will nest there to raise their young among its shadows, while families of vultures circle around.
translation_verse: Ahurutia aafe etšũ ye̱ dše̱i ni eeṅmẽ ni eebu no̱ ni eefo̱ ye̱ ehō̃ṅ le̱ṅ, ni akromãi aabua ame̱he nā, mone̱ ke̱ mone̱, ye̱ dše̱i.

english_verse: In The Book of the Lord you can search and find where it is written, “The Lord brought together all of his creatures by the power of his Spirit. Not one is missing.”
translation_verse: Nyetaoa ye̱ Iehowa wolo le̱ṅ ni nyekanea: nii ne̱ ateṅ ekomeflo eſe̱ṅ, eko eko hefatalo̱ ebo̱ṅle̱; edšake̱ minābu efã́, ni emumo̱ le̱ dši moni buaä nā.

english_verse: The Lord has decided where they each should live; they will be there forever, generation after generation.
translation_verse: Ni le̱ noṅṅ efō ošiki ehãame̱, ni enine dša mli hãame̱ ye̱ susumo̱ kpã nā: eetšṍ ame̱nõ ke̱-ate nāno̱, ni ame̱ahĩ dše̱i ye̱ yino̱i fẽ no̱.

english_verse: Deserts will bloom everywhere and sing joyful songs. They will be as majestic as Mount Lebanon, as glorious as Mount Carmel or Sharon Valley. Everyone will see the wonderful splendor of the Lord our God. God Changes Everything *
translation_verse: Eegba afofro babaō ni emli aaflile̱, ni emli aaflile̱ ke̱ mīše̱ ke̱ nyã́mo̱ so̱ṅṅ; aaṅõ Lebanon anumnyam le̱ ahãle̱, ke̱ Karmel ke̱ Šaron wulamo̱ le̱ hũ. Ame̱-ana Iehowa anumnyam le̱, ke̱ wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ wulamo̱ le̱ hũ.

english_verse: Here is a message for all who are weak, trembling, and worried:
translation_verse: Nyewadšea nidši ni mli edše wui le̱, nyewoa nakutšei ní egbo̱dšo̱ le̱ hewale̱! Heb.

english_verse: The blind will see, and the ears of the deaf will be healed.
translation_verse: No mli le̱ aagble ſilafoi ahĩṅme̱ii, ni aagble toimũlo̱i atoii.

english_verse: Scorching sand will turn into a lake, and thirsty ground will flow with fountains. Grass will grow in deserts, where packs of wild dogs once made their home. God's Sacred Highway
translation_verse: Šia-ṅã ní no̱ edo̱ aatšṍ kpākpo, ni šikpoṅ ní nu be̱ no̱ aatšṍ nui ní baä so̱ṅṅ; ni ṅãṅgbēi ašihĩle̱he, heni ame̱bumoo̱ le̱, dſe̱i ke̱ gãlãi ke̱ ntō aakwẽ ye̱ dše̱i.

english_verse: A good road will be there, and it will be named “God's Sacred Highway.” It will be for God's people; no one unfit to worship God will walk on that road. And no fools can travel on that highway.
translation_verse: Ni aadše *gbe̱dšegbe̱ ye̱ dše̱i ke̱ gbe̱ ko ní aatšé̱le̱ gbe̱ kroṅkroṅ le̱; moko ní he tšee enyieṅ no̱; edšake̱ ame̱ adše ahã, ni mei ní nyieo̱ no̱ le̱, kē̱ kwašiai tete ni le̱, ame̱dũṅ gbe̱. *

english_verse: No lions or other wild animals will come near that road; only those the Lord has saved will travel there.
translation_verse: Dšata ko dšata ko ehĩṅ dše̱i, ni kolo awuyelo̱ ko enyieṅ no̱, anaṅame̱ yo̱ dše̱i kwră; mei ni adšieame̱ le̱ aanyie no̱.

english_verse: The people the Lord has rescued will come back singing as they enter Zion. Happiness will be a crown everyone will always wear. They will celebrate and shout because all sorrows and worries will be gone far away.
translation_verse: Mei ni Iehowa ekpõame̱ le̱ aakũ ame̱se̱ ke̱-aba ekoṅ, ni ame̱-aba Zion ke̱ nyã́mo̱ lala; nāno̱ mīše̱ aahĩ ame̱yiteaṅ, ame̱nine aaše̱ mliflimo̱ ke̱ mīše̱ ne̱, ni aw̌ere̱hō ke̱ ntšo̱idõmo aadšo foi.

english_verse: Hezekiah claims the Lord will save you. But don't be fooled by him. Were any other gods able to defend their land against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Nyekahãa Hezekia mīlakaãnye ake̱: Iehowa bahere wo̱yiwala! Ani *dšeṅmãdši le̱ anyoṅmo̱i le̱ eko ehere ešikpoṅ yiwala ke̱-dše̱ Ašur maṅtše le̱ deṅ pẽṅ? *

english_verse: Then, in a voice loud enough for everyone to hear, he shouted out in Hebrew: Listen to what the great king of Assyria says!
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Rabšake ho damo̱ ši ni ebo ke̱ gbē wāle̱ ye̱ Iuda wiemo̱ le̱ mli ni ekē̱: Nyeboa *maṅtše̱ kpeteṅkple le̱ ni dši Ašur maṅtše̱ le̱ gbẽ toi! *K.

english_verse: What happened to the gods of Hamath, Arpad, and Sepharvaim? Were the gods of Samaria able to protect their land against the Assyrian forces?
translation_verse: Nẽgbe̱ Hamat ke̱ Arpad nyoṅmo̱i le̱ yo̱? Nẽgbe̱ Sefarvaim nyoṅmo̱i le̱ yo̱? ani ame̱here Samaria yiwala ke̱-dše̱ mideṅ?

english_verse: Don't be fooled by Hezekiah. He can't save you.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni maṅtše̱ le̱ kē̱ ne̱: Nyekahãa Hezekia mīlakaänye; edšake̱ enyẽṅnye edšie.

english_verse: Three of the king's highest officials came out of Jerusalem to meet him. One of them was Hilkiah's son Eliakim, who was the prime minister. The other two were Shebna, assistant to the prime minister, and Joah son of Asaph, keeper of the government records.
translation_verse: Ni Hilkia bi *Eliakim ni kwe̱o̱ maṅtše̱ šīa le̱, ke̱ Šebna, woloṅmãlo̱ le̱, ke̱ Ioa, Asaf bi ni dši sãdšiaṅmãlo̱ le̱, dše kpo te eṅõ. *

english_verse: Is he depending on Egypt and its king? That's the same as leaning on a broken stick, and it will go right through his hand.
translation_verse: Na, ohĩe kã ne̱ke̱ gălã ní amla ní dši Mizraim ne̱ no̱, noni ke̱dši moko kpasa ní egbuo̱ edẽ ke̱-dšeo̱ kpo le̱. Nakai Farao, Mizraim maṅtše̱ le̱, feo̱ mei fẽ ní ṅõo̱ ame̱hĩe ame̱fõo̱ eno̱ le̱.

english_verse: Is Hezekiah now depending on the Lord, your God? Didn't Hezekiah tear down all except one of the Lord's altars and places of worship? Didn't he tell the people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship at that one place?
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši ookē̱mi ake̱: Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, no̱ moṅ wo̱hĩe kã le̱! ani dšee le̱ ehei groṅṅi ke̱ efo̱lešãlate̱i Hezekia dšie ni ekē̱ Iuda ke̱ Ierusalem ake̱: Ne̱ke̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ ne̱ hĩe nyedšáa ye̱! le̱?

english_verse: The king of Assyria wants to make a bet with you people! He will give you
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ agbe̱ne̱ oke̱ minuṅtšo̱, Ašur maṅtše̱ le̱, ata abasa ko, ni madšie okpo̱ṅo̱i akpei-enyo̱ mahão, ake̱ ooná bodientše̱ omei otrá ame̱no̱ lo?

english_verse: How could you even defeat our lowest ranking officer, when you have to depend on Egypt for chariots and cavalry?
translation_verse: Ni té oofe tẽṅ ni oonyẽ ohã minuṅtšo̱ tšũdšĩ bibii le̱ ateṅ asafoiatše̱ kome etšṍ ese̱ ahão hũ? Ni ohĩe kã Mizraim no̱ ye̱ ſīlii ke̱ okpo̱ṅo̱iatše̱mei ahewe̱, be̱?

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said, “Sir, we don't want the people listening from the city wall to understand what you are saying. So please speak to us in Aramaic instead of Hebrew.”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Eliakim ke̱ šebna ke̱ Ioa kē̱ Rabšake ake̱: Ofai ne̱, oke̱ otšũdši awie Aram wiemo̱, edšake̱ wo̱nuo̱; ši oke̱wo̱ akawie Iuda wiemo̱ ye̱ maṅ ní dſere gbogbo le̱ no̱ le̱ atoiiaṅ.

english_verse: Don't trust him when he tells you that the Lord will protect you from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ nyekahãa Hezekia mīhã nyeke̱ nyehĩe mīfõ Iehowa no̱ ake̱: Iehowa bahere wo̱yiwala kẽ, ni atuṅ maṅ ne̱ awoṅ Ašur maṅtše̱ le̱ deṅ!

english_verse: Stop listening to Hezekiah. Pay attention to my king. Surrender to him. He will let you keep your own vineyards, fig trees, and cisterns
translation_verse: Nyekaboa Hezekia toi! Edšake̱ bo̱ni Ašur maṅtše̱ le̱ kē̱ ne̱: Nyeke̱mi aba-kpãtãa ni nyedšea kpo nyebaä miṅõ, koni nyeteṅ *mofẽmo aye eweintšo ke̱ egbãmitšo yibii, ni nyeteṅ mofẽmo anu enubu mli nu, *

english_verse: for a while. Then he will come and take you away to a country just like yours, where you can plant vineyards and raise your own grain.
translation_verse: ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní maba ni mabalōnye ke̱-ya šikpoṅ ní tamo̱ nyedientše̱ nyešikpoṅ le̱ no̱, able ke̱ wein šikpoṅ, abolo ke̱ weintromi ašikpoṅ ni.

english_verse: None of those gods kept their people safe from the king of Assyria. Do you think the Lord, your God, can do any better?
translation_verse: Ne̱ke̱ šikpõdši ne̱ anyoṅmo̱i le̱ fẽ ateṅ namei ehere ame̱šikpoṅ yiwala ke̱-dše̱ mideṅ, hewo̱ ni Iehowa le̱, le̱ le̱ eehere Ierusalem yiwala ke̱-adše̱ mideṅ le̱?

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah had been warned by King Hezekiah not to answer the Assyrian commander. So they tore their clothes in sorrow and reported to Hezekiah everything the commander had said.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Eliakim, Hilkia bi le̱, ni kwe̱o̱ maṅtše̱ šīa le̱, ke̱ Šebna, woloṅmãlo̱ le̱, ke̱ Ioa, Asaf bi le̱, ní dši sãdšiaṅmãlo̱ le̱, ba Hezekia ṅõ ke̱ ametadei ní ame̱gbla, ni ame̱bagbale̱ Rabšake wiemo̱i le̱.

english_verse: The kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah have all disappeared. Hezekiah Prays (
translation_verse: Nẽgbe̱ Hamat maṅtše̱ le̱ ke̱ Arpad maṅtše̱ le̱ ke̱ Sefarvaim maṅ le̱ ke̱ Hena ke̱ Iva maṅtše̱ le̱ yo̱?

english_verse: Isaiah, these are difficult and disgraceful times. Our nation is like a woman too weak to give birth, when it's time for her baby to be born.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱yakē̱le̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Hezekia kē̱ ne̱: Haomo̱ ke̱ dše̱mo̱ ke̱ heguo̱gbē gbĩ dši ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱; edšake̱ bii le̱ eše̱ asosodſã he, ši hewale̱ be̱ ní ake̱-fo̱ö̱.

english_verse: Please pray for those of us who are left alive. The king of Assyria sent his army commander to insult the living God. Perhaps the Lord heard what he said and will do something, if you will pray.
translation_verse: Ekole̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, enu Rabšake, moni enuṅtšo̱, Ašur maṅtše̱ le̱, tšũ le̱ ní ebasopa Nyoṅmo̱ hĩekãlo̱ le̱, wiemo̱i le̱, ni ebakã ehĩe ye̱ wiemo̱i ni Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, enu le̱ ahewo̱: nohewo̱ le̱ wó ofaikpamo̱ le̱ no̱ ohã mei ní eſe̱ ní yo̱ le̱!

english_verse: I will upset him with rumors about what's happening in his own country. He will go back, and there I will make him die a violent death.
translation_verse: Na, mike̱ mumo̱ ko bawo emli, ni eenu adafitſā ko, ni eekũ ese̱ ke̱-ate ešikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni mahã enyõ ye̱ klante nā ye̱ le̱dientše̱ ešikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: About this same time, the king of Assyria learned that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was on his way to attack him. Then the king of Assyria sent some messengers with this note for Hezekiah:
translation_verse: Ni enu Kuš maṅtše̱ Tirhaka he ake̱: Efã ke̱-mība ni eke̱o abawu. Ni beni enu le̱, etšũ bo̱foi ke̱-ba Hezekia ṅõ ake̱:

english_verse: Don't trust your God or be fooled by his promise to defend Jerusalem against me.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni nyeyakē̱ Iuda maṅtše̱ Hezekia ne̱: Kāhã o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ni ohĩe kã eno̱ le̱ mīlakao ake̱: Ake̱ Ierusalem woṅ Ašur maṅtše̱ le̱ deṅ!

english_verse: You have heard how we Assyrian kings have completely wiped out other nations. What makes you feel so safe?
translation_verse: Na, bodientše̱ onu nii ní Ašur maṅtše̱mei le̱ fe šikpõdši le̱ fẽ ní ame̱feame̱ musu le̱, ni bo ni abahere oyiwala lo?

english_verse: The Assyrian kings before me destroyed the towns of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and everyone from Eden who lived in Telassar. What good did their gods do them?
translation_verse: Dšeṅmãdši le̱ ní mitše̱mei le̱ kpãtã ame̱hĩe le̱, ani ame̱nyoṅmo̱i le̱ here ame̱yiwala lo? tamo̱ Gozan ke̱ Haran ke̱ Rezef ke̱ Edenbii le̱ ní yo̱ Telasar le̱?

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful of Israel, your throne is above the winged creatures. You created the heavens and the earth, and you alone rule the kingdoms of this world.
translation_verse: Iehowa Zebaot, Israel Nyoṅmo̱, bo ní ohĩo̱ kerubim ano̱, bo okometō dši Nyoṅmo̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ maṅtše̱yelii le̱ fẽ no̱; bo ofe ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ!

english_verse: It is true, our Lord, that Assyrian kings have turned nations into deserts.
translation_verse: Iehowa, eye̱ mli le̱le̱ṅ ake̱ Ašur maṅtše̱mei le̱ efite dšeṅmãdši le̱ fẽ ke̱ ame̱šikpõdši le̱ hũ,

english_verse: As surely as I am the Lord, he will return by the way he came and will never enter Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Gbe̱ no̱ ni etšṍ ke̱-ba le̱, no noṅṅ no̱ eetšṍ ke̱-ate ekoṅ; ši eboteṅ ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱ mli, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: I went to Hezekiah and told him that the Lord God of Israel had said: Hezekiah, you prayed to me about King Sennacherib of Assyria. Now this is what I say to that king: The people of Jerusalem hate and make fun of you; they laugh behind your back.
translation_verse: Wiemo̱ ni Iehowa wie yo̱ ehe ne̱: Zion biyō oblayō fro le̱ mīgbe ohe guo̱, ni ēye ohe fe̱o, Ierusalem biyō le̱ mihoso eyitšo ye̱ ose̱.

english_verse: You let your officials insult me, the Lord. And here is what you have said about yourself, “I led my chariots to the highest heights of Lebanon's mountains. I went deep into its forest, cutting down the best cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: Otšũdši le̱ ano̱ otšṍ obaho̱ Nuṅtšo̱ lo̱ ahora ni okē̱: Mike̱ miſīlii babaō le̱ ekwo̱ ke̱-te gõdši ayiteaṅ, ke̱-te Lebanon se̱ tō̃, ni maflo̱ emli *tšenedrui ní kwŏ̱lo̱ le̱ ke̱ emli se̱se̱oi ní hĩ le̱ maſie ši, ni maše̱ eyiteṅ šõšō̃šõ le̱ ke̱ etšei atrom kō le̱ mli. *

english_verse: I dried up every stream in the land of Egypt, and I drank water from wells I had dug.”
translation_verse: Mitšatšā bui ni mina ame̱mli nu, ni mike̱ minaneši aahã Mizraim fāi fẽ-tſẽm atã!

english_verse: Sennacherib, now listen to me, the Lord. I planned all of this long ago. And you don't even know that I alone am the one who decided that you would do these things. I let you make ruins of fortified cities.
translation_verse: Ani onuko ake̱ nakai mifeo̱ ke̱-dše̱ blema bēbe, ni nakai mito ke̱-dše̱ blema gbĩĩ le̱ amli? Agbe̱ne̱ le̱ mihã eba mli, koni akpãtã mãdši ní atſa gbogboi awo he le̱ ahĩe, ní ame̱tšṍmo̱ amaṅfõ kuikui,

english_verse: I know all about you, even how fiercely angry you are with me.
translation_verse: Mile ošitámo̱ ke̱ oya ke̱ obā fẽ ke̱ ogrimo̱ ní ogri owomi le̱ hũ!

english_verse: I have seen your pride and the tremendous hatred you have for me. Now I will put a hook in your nose, a bit in your mouth, then I will send you back to where you came from.
translation_verse: Ake̱-ni ogri owomi ni *oſā̃ le̱ ekwo̱ ke̱-baše̱ mitoiiaṅ hewo̱ le̱, mike̱ mikpoṅ aawo ogugõṅ, ni mike̱ mimanyofle̱ le̱ aawo odāṅ, ni makpaleo ke̱-kũ se̱ ke̱-tšṍ gbe̱ ní otšṍ no̱ ke̱-ba le̱ no̱! *

english_verse: Hezekiah, I will tell you what's going to happen. This year you will eat crops that grow on their own, and the next year you will eat whatever springs up where those crops grew. But the third year, you will plant grain and vineyards, and you will eat what you harvest.
translation_verse: Ši ene̱ aafe okadi ahăo: Afi ne̱ mli le̱ nyeaye nii ni ame̱dientše̱ ame̱kwẽ, ni afi ní dši enyo̱ le̱ mli hũ nyeaye nii ni kwẽ ye̱ nomei ase̱ le̱; ši afi ni dši etẽ le̱ mli le̱ nyedũa nii ni nyekpaä, ni nyefea weintromi hũ ni nyeyea emli yibii.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will see to it that some who live in Jerusalem will survive.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ſē̱nõ ko kẽ aadše̱ Ierusalem aba, ni mei ní edše mli hũ aadše̱ Zion goṅ le̱ no̱ aba; Iehowa Zebaot hĩedō̱ le̱ bafe ene̱!

english_verse: I promise that the king of Assyria won't get into Jerusalem, or shoot an arrow into the city, or even surround it and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ye̱ Ašur maṅtše̱ le̱ he ne̱: Ebaṅ mā ne̱ṅ ni etšẽṅ gãi ko ke̱-baṅ mli, ni eke̱ tše̱ṅ ko baṅ dše̱i, ni asaṅ etſaṅ kpoku ko ewoṅ he!

english_verse: After this, King Sennacherib went back to Assyria and lived in the city of Nineveh.
translation_verse: Ni Ašur maṅtše̱ Sanherib fã ye̱ dše̱i ni eyiṅ ete, ni ekũ ese̱ eyahĩ Ninive.

english_verse: The Lord sent an angel to the camp of the Assyrians, and he killed
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iehowa bo̱fo le̱ dše kpo ke̱-te Ašur nsra le̱ṅ ni eyagbe mei akpei-oha-ke̱-nyoṅmai-kpānyo̱-ke̱-enumo̱; ni beni ame̱te ši lebi mā̃ṅkpa le̱, na, ame̱fẽ-tſẽm ame̱tsṍmo̱ gbohĩĩ so̱ṅṅ.

english_verse: One day he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, when his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords. They escaped to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon became king.
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱, beni edšáa ye̱ enyoṅmo̱ Nisrok we le̱, Adramelek ke̱ Šarezer, ní dši ebii le̱, ke̱ klante gbele̱, ni ame̱dšo foi ke̱-te Ararat šikpoṅ le̱ no̱; ni ebi Esar-Hadon baye maṅtše̱ ye̱ ese̱.

english_verse: You, Lord, will save me, and every day that we live we will sing in your temple to the music of stringed instruments. Isaiah's Advice to Hezekiah
translation_verse: Iehowa here miyiwala, nohewo̱ le̱ wo̱wala gbĩĩ fẽ mli le̱ wo̱ke̱ saṅkũ aala milalai le̱ ye̱ Iehowa we le̱!

english_verse: I thought I would never again see you, my Lord, or any of the people who live on this earth.
translation_verse: Mikē̱: Minaṅ Iehowa doṅṅ, minaṅ Iehowa ye̱ *hĩekãlo̱i ašikpoṅ le̱ no̱; mikwe̱ṅ gbomei hũ doṅṅ ye̱ mei ní yo̱ yaka dše le̱ṅ le̱ ateṅ. *Lal.

english_verse: Then the Lord sent me
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iehowa wiemo̱ ba Iesaia ṅõ ake̱:

english_verse: with this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord God, who was worshiped by your ancestor David. I heard you pray, and I saw you cry. I will let you live
translation_verse: Ya ni oyakē̱ Hezekia ake̱: Bo̱ni Iehowa, otše̱ David Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kē̱ ne̱: Minu ofaikpamo̱ le̱, ni mina oyāfónui le̱; na, maṅõ afii nyoṅma ke̱ enumo̱ mafata ogbĩĩ le̱ ahe;

english_verse: There's nothing I can say in answer to you, since you are the one who has done this to me. My life has turned sour; I will limp until I die.
translation_verse: Té makē̱ tēṅ? Ewomi ši, ni efe hũ! Miwala afii le̱ fẽ mli le̱ manyie so̱kē ye̱ misusuma aw̌ere̱hō le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: Do you see the shadow made by the setting sun on the stairway built for King Ahaz? I will make the shadow go back ten steps. Then the shadow went back ten steps. King Hezekiah's Song of Praise
translation_verse: Na, mahã hũlũ ṅmle̱ le̱ no̱ susuma, ní hũlũ ehã enyie ye̱ Ahaz hũlũ ṅmle̱ le̱ no̱ le̱, akũ ese̱ mlidšãi nyoṅma. Ni hũlũ kũ ese̱ mlidšāi nyoṅma ni enyie momo le̱ ye̱ hũlũ ṅmle̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: This is what Hezekiah wrote after he got well:
translation_verse: Iuda maṅtše̱ Hezekia nii ní eṅmã, beni ehe ye ni ehe wale̱ ke̱-dše̱ ehela le̱ṅ le̱, ne̱:

english_verse: My life was taken from me like the tent that a shepherd pulls up and moves. You cut me off like thread from a weaver's loom; you make a wreck of me day and night.
translation_verse: Akpa mibū le̱ ni awó ke̱-dše mihe ke̱-te tamo̱ tōkwe̱lo̱ bū ko; mikota miwala tamo̱ mamalòlo̱ feo̱ le̱; ētšemi ke̱-dše̱ kpã le̱ nā: ōgbe nā ohãmi gbĩ kome dsenamo̱! Hiob

english_verse: Until morning came, I thought you would crush my bones just like a hungry lion; both night and day you make a wreck of me.
translation_verse: Mimla mihĩe ke̱-yaši dšetše̱remo̱; ekũmo̱ miwui fẽ *tamo̱ dšata; ōgbe nā ohãmi gbĩ kome dšenamo̱! *Hiob

english_verse: I cry like a swallow; I mourn like a dove. My eyes are red from looking to you, Lord. I am in terrible trouble. Please come and help me.
translation_verse: Midõmo̱ ntšo̱i tamo̱ nyoṅmo̱bite̱te lo kpokukpoku, miye ṅko̱mo̱ tamo̱ okpo; mihĩṅme̱ii šiu ke̱ ṅwei so̱ṅṅ ni mikwe̱o̱ ake̱: Iehowa! efĩmi, damo̱ mli ohãmi!

english_verse: Your words and your deeds bring life to everyone, including me. Please make me healthy and strong again.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱, ene̱mei ano̱ mei tšṍo̱ ni ame̱yi náa wala, ni ene̱mei fẽ mli mimumo̱ wala yo̱; edšake̱ otšámi, ni ohã miyi ená wala!

english_verse: It was for my own good that I had such hard times. But your love protected me from doom in the deep pit, and you turned your eyes away from my sins.
translation_verse: Na, mihedso̱le̱-námo̱ hewo̱ mina dšōmo̱ babaō! ši suomo̱ ní osumoo̱ misusuma hewo̱ le̱, odšiele̱ ke̱-dše̱ fitemo̱ bu le̱ mli; edšake̱ *oše̱re̱ mihe ešai le fẽ oſie ose̱! *Lal.

english_verse: No one in the world of the dead can thank you or praise you; none of those in the deep pit can hope for you to show them how faithful you are.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ gbohĩĩadše edšieṅ oyi, ni gbĕle hũ kafoṅ bo; mei hũ ní kplekeo̱ ši ke̱-yaä bu le̱ mli le̱ ame̱ṅõṅ ame̱hĩe ame̱fōṅ ono̱kwale le̱ no̱; Lal.

english_verse: Only the living can thank you, as I am doing today. Each generation tells the next about your faithfulness.
translation_verse: hĩekãlo̱, hĩekãlo̱ moṅ dšieo̱ oyi, tamo̱ bo̱ni mifeo̱ ṅme̱ne̱ ne̱; tše̱ hãa bii leo̱ ono̱kwale le̱.

english_verse: I had told King Hezekiah's servants to put some mashed figs on the king's open sore, and he would get well.
translation_verse: Ši Iesaia ekē̱ ake̱ aṅō agbãmi-tatale ko ato asãne le̱ no̱, ni ehe aawale̱.

english_verse: Then Hezekiah asked for proof that he would again worship in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Ni Hezekia hũ kē̱: Mẽ dši okadi ake̱ mate Iehowa we le̱?

english_verse: Hezekiah welcomed the messengers and showed them all the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fine oils that were in his storehouse. He even showed them where he kept his weapons. Nothing in his palace or in his entire kingdom was kept hidden from them.
translation_verse: Ni Hezekia ná ame̱he tšuidšŭrõ, ni eṅõ ešĩa heni enibii ní dšra wa le̱ yo̱ le̱ etšõame̱, dſie̱te̱i ke̱ šika, ke̱ tšofãi-ke̱-ṅmai ke̱ mũ ní dšra wa, ke̱ etawūnii atšũ le̱ fẽ ke̱ nibii fẽ ni anaä ye̱ enitōhei le̱; nokonoko be̱ ewe le̱ lo eno̱yelihe le̱ ní Hezekia ke̱-tšõõame̱.

english_verse: Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, was now king of Babylonia. And when he learned that Hezekiah was well, he sent messengers with letters and a gift for him.
translation_verse: Nakai be le̱ mli le̱ Merodak-Baladan, Baladan bi le̱, ní dši Babel maṅtše̱ le̱, tšũ ake̱ wodši ke̱ nikēnii bahã Hezekia; edšake̱ enu ake̱ ehe ye, ni ehe ewale̱.

english_verse: I asked Hezekiah, “Where did these men come from? What did they want?” “They came all the way from Babylonia,” Hezekiah answered.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni gbalo̱ Iesaia ba maṅtše̱ Hezekia ṅõ ni ebabile̱ ake̱: Meni ne̱ke̱ gbomei ne̱ kē̱, ni nẽgbe̱ ame̱dše̱ ame̱ba oṅõ ne̱? Ni Hezekia kē̱: Ame̱dše̱ šoṅṅ heko ame̱ba miṅõ, ame̱dše̱ Babel.

english_verse: “What did you show them?” I asked. Hezekiah answered, “I showed them everything in my kingdom.”
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱: Meni ame̱na ye̱ owe le̱? Ni Hezekia kē̱: Nibii fẽ ní yo̱ miwe le̱ ame̱na; nokonoko be̱ minitõhei le̱ ní mike̱-tšõkoame̱.

english_verse: Then I told Hezekiah: I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iesaia kē̱ Hezekia ake̱: Bo Iehowa Zebaot wiemo̱ toi!

english_verse: One day everything you and your ancestors have stored up will be taken to Babylonia. The Lord has promised that nothing will be left.
translation_verse: Na, gbĩĩ mība ní aabalō nibii fẽ ní yo̱ owe le̱ ke̱ nii ni otše̱mei le̱ ebua nā eto ke̱-baši ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ no̱ le̱ ke̱-ate Babel; ašĩṅ nokonoko, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: Some of your own sons will be taken to Babylonia, where they will be disgraced and made to serve in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ obii ní aadše̱ omli ní oofo̱ le̱, aaṅõ ame̱teṅ meikomei ke̱-ate, ni ame̱-atšṍmo̱ piafoi ye̱ Babel maṅtše̱ le̱ mō̃ le̱ṅ.

english_verse: Hezekiah thought, “At least our nation will be at peace for a while.” So he told me, “The message you brought from the Lord is good.”
translation_verse: Ni Hezekia kē̱ Iesaia ake̱: Iehowa wiemo̱ ni owie le̱ hĩ! Ni esā ekē̱: Ši hedšo̱le̱ ke̱ ano̱kwale aahĩ migbĩĩ le̱ amli!

english_verse: At the Lord's command, flowers and grass disappear, and so do we.
translation_verse: dſe̱i gbĩo̱, fo̱fo̱i hũ ṅălãa; edšake̱ Iehowa mumo̱ ní emũo̱ le̱ tſaä ke̱-tšṍo̱ no̱. Le̱le̱ṅ, dſe̱i dši maṅ le̱!

english_verse: Flowers and grass fade away, but what our God has said will never change. Your God Is Here!
translation_verse: Dſe̱i gbĩo̱, ni fo̱fo̱i hũ ṅălãa: ši wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ *wiemo̱ le̱ aadamo̱ ši ke̱-ate nāno̱! *Lal.

english_verse: Did the Lord ask anyone to teach him wisdom and justice? Who gave him knowledge and understanding?
translation_verse: Namo eke̱-too̱ adšina, ni etšõo̱le̱ nii, ni etšõo̱le̱ kodšomo̱ gbe̱, ni etšõo̱le̱ nilē, ni ehãa eleo̱ sanese̱ko̱mo̱ gbe̱?

english_verse: To the Lord, all nations are merely a drop in a bucket or dust on balance scales; all of the islands are but a handful of sand.
translation_verse: Na, dšeṅmãdši le̱ tamo̱ nukuli ye̱ blagē he, ni abuo̱ame̱ tamo̱ mlukuli ní kpe̱te̱ nsẽni he; na, eholeo̱ ṅšo̱kpo̱i le̱ ano̱ tamo̱ mlu!

english_verse: Is an idol at all like God? It is made of bronze with a thin layer of gold, and decorated with silver.
translation_verse: Amãgã le̱, ṅālo̱ ſieo̱, ni šikaṅālo̱ haä he šika, ni eke̱ dſie̱te̱i kõsõṅkõsõi woo̱le̱.

english_verse: Or special wood may be chosen because it doesn't rot— then skilled hands take care to make an idol that won't fall on its face. God Rules the Whole Earth
translation_verse: Moni be̱ nakai kēnii le̱ eko le̱, ehalaä tšo ko ní kpo̱to̱o̱; etaoo ṅālo̱ ko ni le ṅā ehãa ehe, ni egbo̱ö̱ amãgã ní hosoo!

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? Hasn't it been clear since the time of creation?
translation_verse: Ani nyelee ni nyenuko hũ? ani agbakonye ke̱-dše̱ šišidšē? ani nyenako šikpoṅ le̱ šišitōi le̱ anā?

english_verse: God is the one who rules the whole earth, and we that live here are merely insects. He spread out the heavens like a curtain or an open tent.
translation_verse: Le̱ etá šikpoṅ le̱ yiteṅ ati le̱ no̱, ni eno̱ bii le̱ tamo̱ agāi; le̱ *elē̱o̱ ṅwei mli tamo̱ muhō̱, ni ešiole̱ tamo̱ bū ní ahĩo̱ mli; *Lal.

english_verse: God brings down rulers and turns them into nothing.
translation_verse: le̱ ehãa lume̱i feo̱ ſe̱m, ni ehãa šikpoṅ no̱ kodšolo̱i hũ tšṍo̱ yakayakanoko.

english_verse: They are like flowers freshly sprung up and starting to grow. But when God blows on them, they wilt and are carried off like straw in a storm.
translation_verse: Amrō pe̱ ní ate̱oame̱ le̱, amrõ pe̱ ni adũame̱ le̱, amrõ pe̱ ní ame̱tšo le̱ tšẽ fã ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱: etſaä ke̱-tšṍo̱ ame̱no̱ ni ame̱ṅălãa, ni lasũogbĕle lōo̱ame̱ ke̱-yaã tamo̱ tutū.

english_verse: The holy God asks, “Who compares with me? Is anyone my equal?”
translation_verse: Bĕle̱ namo he nyeke̱mi aato, ni eke̱mi aaye egbo̱? Mokroṅkroṅ lo̱ kē̱.

english_verse: Look at the evening sky! Who created the stars? Who gave them each a name? Who leads them like an army? The Lord is so powerful that none of the stars are ever missing. The Lord Gives Strength
translation_verse: Nyeholea nyehĩṅme̱ii ano̱ ke̱-yaä ṅwei, ni nyekwe̱a: Namo bo̱ ene̱mei? Le̱ moni edšieo̱ ame̱safo le̱ kpo ye̱ yibo̱ nā, ni etše̱o̱ ame̱fẽ *ke̱ ame̱gbe̱ii; enyẽmo̱ ní fá ke̱ ehewale̱ kple le̱ hewo̱ le̱ ame̱teṅ ekomeflo po eſe̱e̱. *Lal.

english_verse: You people of Israel say, “God pays no attention to us! He doesn't care if we are treated unjustly.” But how can you say that?
translation_verse: Bĕle̱ bo Iakob, mẽba okē̱o̱, ni bo Israel, owieo̱ ake̱: Aṅõ migbe̱ le̱ atē Iehowa, ni mikodšomo̱ eho mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ hĩe le̱?

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? The Lord is the eternal God, Creator of the earth. He never gets weary or tired; his wisdom cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Ani olee, ani onuko? nāno̱ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, Iehowa *ní bo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbēhei le̱, egbo̱dšo̱o̱ ni asaṅ eto̱o̱le̱, ni †edſẽṅmo̱ le̱ anyẽẽ mli atao. *

english_verse: The Lord gives strength to those who are weary.
translation_verse: Le̱ ehãa moni egbo̱dšo̱ lo̱ hewale̱, ni moni be̱ nyẽmo̱ le̱ ehãa ehewale̱ fáa.

english_verse: Even young people get tired, then stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Oblahĩĩ ní edše no̱ le̱, ame̱gbo̱dšo̱ö̱ ni eto̱ö̱ame̱, ni mei ní eše̱ oblahĩĩ tete le̱, ame̱gbēgbēo̱ ši;

english_verse: But those who trust the Lord will find new strength. They will be strong like eagles soaring upward on wings; they will walk and run without getting tired.
translation_verse: ši mei ní hĩe kã Iehowa no̱ le̱ náa hewale̱ hē, ame̱holeo̱ ame̱fĩdši ano̱ tamo̱ *okropoṅi, ame̱dšoo̱ foi, ni eto̱o̱amo̱, ame̱nyieo̱ hũ, nĩ ame̱gbo̱dšo̱o̱. *Lal.

english_verse: Worshipers of idols comfort each other, saying, “Don't worry!”
translation_verse: Mofēmo ye bua enanyo, ni ekē̱ enyemi ake̱: Ná tšui!

english_verse: Don't be afraid. I am with you. Don't tremble with fear. I am your God. I will make you strong, as I protect you with my arm and give you victories.
translation_verse: Kāše gbeyei, ši mi, mike̱o yo̱! Kākwe̱kwē̱ ohe, ši midsi o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱! Mawadšeo, ni maye mabuao; ni mahĩe omli ke̱ midšale̱ ninedšŭrõ le̱.

english_verse: Everyone who hates you will be terribly disgraced; those who attack will vanish into thin air.
translation_verse: Na, mei fẽ ni ame̱mli ewoö la le̱ ahĩe aagboi ni ame̱hĩe aaſie ši; mei ní ke̱o béo̱ le̱ aafe ſe̱m, ni ame̱hĩe aakpãtã.

english_verse: You will look around for those brutal enemies, but you won't find them— they will be gone.
translation_verse: Mei ní ke̱o ená le̱, ootaoame̱, ši onaṅame̱, mei ní ke̱o wuo̱ le̱ aafe ſe̱m, ni ame̱atã.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I am holding your hand, so don't be afraid. I am here to help you.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mi, Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, mihĩe oninedšŭrõ mli, ni mīkē̱o ake̱: Kāše gbeyei! maye mabuao!

english_verse: People of Israel, don't worry, though others may say, “Israel is only a worm!” I am the holy God of Israel, who saves and protects you.
translation_verse: Kāšegbeyei, bo gõgõmi Iakob, nye Israelbii ni nyeyi fáá! *maye mabuao, Iehowa kē̱, ni okpõlo̱ dši Israel Mokroṅkroṅ le̱. *

english_verse: I will let you be like a log covered with sharp spikes. You will grind and crush every mountain and hill until they turn to dust.
translation_verse: Na, mīṅõo mife ṅmā̃gbēmo̱tšõne hē ko ní nā ba ke̱ enā nyãnyõdši, ni oogbē gõdši le̱ ni oošiame̱ bo̱do̱bo̱do̱, ni oofe ṅmeṅmei le̱ hũ tamo̱ tutū.

english_verse: A strong wind will scatter them in all directions. Then you will celebrate and praise me, your Lord, the holy God of Israel. The Lord Helps the Poor
translation_verse: Ooša ame̱mli, ni kō̱yo̱ aalōame̱ ke̱-ate, ni lasũogbĕle aagbe̱ame̱ aſã; ši bo le̱, omli aaflio ye̱ Iehowa mli, ni ooſā ofõ Israel Mokroṅkroṅ le no̱.

english_verse: When the poor and needy are dying of thirst and cannot find water, I, the Lord God of Israel, will come to their rescue. I won't forget them.
translation_verse: Mei ní nii yo̱ mo̱bo̱ ke̱ ohĩafoi le̱, ame̱mītao nu, ši eko be̱, ame̱lile̱ii ano̱ egbi ke̱ kũmai; ši mi, Iehowa, mahereame̱ no̱ kẽ, mi, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, mikwaṅame̱.

english_verse: I will make rivers flow on mountain peaks. I will send streams to fill the valleys. Dry and barren land will flow with springs and become a lake.
translation_verse: Magble fāi anā ye̱ gõdši kpatāi ano̱, ni madše nubui hũ ye̱ dšō̱i ateṅ; mahã ṅãno̱ atšṍ nu kpākpo, ni šikpoṅ gbĩṅ hũ atšṍ nui ní baä.

english_verse: I will fill the desert with all kinds of trees— cedars, acacias, and myrtles; olive and cypress trees; fir trees and pines.
translation_verse: Mahã tšenedrutšei akwẽ ye̱ ṅãno̱, ke̱ yō̱itšei, mirtotšei ke̱ mũtšei; mate̱o se̱se̱o ke̱ papao, ke̱ tšei ní nyẽo̱ dšale̱ ye̱ ṅã kpatã no̱,

english_verse: Everyone will see this and know that I, the holy Lord God of Israel, created it all. Idols Are Useless
translation_verse: koni ame̱fẽ-tſẽm ame̱na ni ame̱le ni ame̱ke̱-to ame̱tšuiṅ ni ame̱dſẽṅ he, ake̱ Iehowa nine fe ene̱, ni Israel Mokroṅkroṅ le̱ bo̱.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the King of Israel! Come argue your case with me. Present your evidence.
translation_verse: Nyeke̱ nyesane le̱ abaä! Iehowa kē̱; nyeke̱ nyesane nātšõmo̱i le̱ abe̱ṅke̱a! Iakob maṅtše̱ le̱ kē̱.

english_verse: Come near me, you idols. Tell us about the past, and we will think about it. Tell us about the future, so we will know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Hã ame̱ke̱-ba ni ame̱badšadše noni baba ame̱tsõwo̱! Nii ni ye̱ tšutsu le̱, nyetšõa nii ní dši, ni wo̱ke̱-to wo̱tšoiiaṅ ni wolo amenāgbē; alo nyetšõawo̱ nii ni baba.

english_verse: You idols are nothing, and you are powerless. To worship you would be disgusting.
translation_verse: Na, nyedšee nokonoko, ni nyenitšumo̱ le̱ hũ dšee fē̱ifē̱i, moni halaänye le̱, āhĩle̱.

english_verse: I, the Lord, appointed a ruler in the north; now he comes from the east to honor my name. He tramples kings like mud, as potters trample clay.
translation_verse: Mitē moko ši ke̱-dše̱ kōyigbe̱ ni ēba, ni eetšé̱ migbei ke̱-adše̱ hũlũ šitẽhe, ni eenā no̱yelo̱i tamo̱ anāa sũ, lo tamo̱ nišõlo̱ kpo̱to̱ö̱ sũ!

english_verse: Did any of you idols predict what would happen? Did any of you get it right? None of you told about this or even spoke a word.
translation_verse: Namo dšadše ke̱-dše̱ šišidšē, koni wo̱le? lo namo dšadše dãni eba mli ni wo̱kē̱ ake̱: Enõ dša! Mokomoko be̱ ní dšadšeo̱, mokomoko be̱ ní hãa anuo̱, ni mokomoko be̱ ni nuo̱ nyewiemo̱i le̱!

english_verse: I was the first to tell the people of Jerusalem, “Look, it's happening!” I was the one who announced this good news to Zion.
translation_verse: Mi tšutšu mikē̱ Zion ake̱: Na, ame̱ ne̱! ni Ierusalem hũ, *mihãle̱ sanekpakpadšadšelo̱ ko! *Mat.

english_verse: None of these idols are able to give advice or answer questions.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ mikwe̱ le̱, mokomoko be̱, ni ṅāwolo̱ ko be̱ ame̱teṅ, ní ké̱ mibiame̱ ni ame̱ahãmi hetō.

english_verse: They are nothing, and they can do nothing— they are merely a passing breeze.
translation_verse: Na, ame̱fẽ le̱ yakayakanii dšiame̱, ni ame̱nitšumo̱i le̱ hũ dšee fē̱ifē̱i, *ame̱mãgãi le̱ hũ kō̱yo ke̱ nibii fodši ni! *Lal.

english_verse: He won't quit or give up until he brings justice everywhere on earth, and people in foreign nations long for his teaching.
translation_verse: Esane nā edšo̱ṅ, ni enidšiaṅ edšeṅ wui ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní eke̱ kodšomo̱ aamã ši ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni ṅšo̱kpo̱i le̱ aakwe̱ emla le̱ gbe̱.

english_verse: You will give sight to the blind; you will set prisoners free from dark dungeons.
translation_verse: koni ogble ſilafoi ahĩṅme̱ii, ni odšie mei ni awoame̱ tšũṅ ke̱ mei ní trá duṅ mli le̱ hũ ke̱-dše̱ gbokle̱foiatšũ le̱ṅ.

english_verse: Tell the whole world to sing a new song to the Lord! Tell those who sail the ocean and those who live far away to join in the praise.
translation_verse: Nyelaä lala hē nyehãa Iehowa, nyelaä nyedšiea eyi ke̱-dše̱a šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbēhe le̱! Nye mei ni nyenyieo̱ ṅšo̱ hĩe, ke̱ nibii fẽ ní yo̱ emli le̱, ṅšo̱kpo̱i le̱, ke̱ mei ni hĩo̱ no̱ le̱!

english_verse: Let them announce his praises everywhere.
translation_verse: Ame̱ke̱ anumnyam ahã Iehowa, ni ame̱dšadše eyidšiemo̱ le̱ ye̱ ṅšo̱kpo̱i le̱ ano̱!

english_verse: The Lord is marching out like an angry soldier, shouting with all his might while attacking his enemies. The Lord Will Help His People
translation_verse: Iehowa aafã tamo̱ kãkãlo̱ ko, eetē hĩedō̱ ši tamo̱ tabilo̱; eeblo̱ ni eebo̱ oše; eke̱ ehenye̱lo̱i le̱ aaye dẽṅdẽṅ!

english_verse: For a long time, I, the Lord, have held my temper; now I will cry out and groan like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Mibu minā āhũ, mife diō, mimĩa mihĩe: ši mablo̱ tamo̱ yō ní kõmoo̱, makẽmo̱ ni mamũ hē̱hē̱.

english_verse: I will destroy the mountains and what grows on them; I will dry up rivers and ponds.
translation_verse: Makpãtã gõdši ke̱ goṅkpo̱i ahĩe, ni mahã ame̱no̱ dſe̱i fẽ agbĩ, ni mahã fāi atšṍmo̱ fākpo̱i, ni mahã kpākpoi hũ amī̃!

english_verse: I will lead the blind on roads they have never known; I will guide them on paths they have never traveled. Their road is dark and rough, but I will give light to keep them from stumbling. This is my solemn promise.
translation_verse: Ni mike̱ ſilafoi aatšṍ gbe̱ ko ní ame̱lee no̱, ni mahã ame̱nyie tempõṅ ko ní ame̱lee no̱; maṅõ duṅ mafe la ye̱ ame̱hĩe, ni heni yo̱ dokoidokoi le̱ mahã afe tre̱nē̱. Nii ne̱ mafe mahãame̱ ni miṅmē̃ṅ he.

english_verse: Everyone who worships idols as though they were gods will be terribly ashamed. God's People Won't Obey
translation_verse: Ši mei ní ke̱ ame̱hĩe fōo̱ amãgãi ano̱, ni ame̱kē̱o̱ amãgãi ní aſie ake̱. Nyedši wo̱nyoṅmo̱i le̱! ame̱akũ ame̱se̱, ni ame̱hĩe aagboi.

english_verse: You people are deaf and blind, but the Lord commands you to listen and to see.
translation_verse: Nye toimũlo̱i, nyeboa toi; nye ſilafoĩ, nyekwe̱a ní nyenaä nii!

english_verse: who sees and hears so much, but pays no attention.
translation_verse: Ona nibii babaō, ši oyoo; etoii anā kã, ši enuu nii.

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and so he wanted his Law to be greatly praised.
translation_verse: Esa Iehowa hĩe ye̱ edšale̱ le̱ hewo̱, ake̱ eehã mla le̱ ada ni eewo ehĩe nyam.

english_verse: But his people were trapped and imprisoned in holes with no one to rescue them. All they owned had been taken, and no one was willing to give it back.
translation_verse: Ši le̱ le̱, maṅ ní atſale̱ odšo ní ahale̱ ni; adũame̱ fẽ ye̱ bui amli, aṅõ-ame̱ atē gbokle̱foiatšũiaṅ; amõmo̱ame̱, ni dšielo̱ ko be̱; ahaame̱, ni moko be̱ ni kē̱o̱ ake̱: Oke̱-kũ se̱ ohã!

english_verse: Why won't his people ever learn to listen?
translation_verse: Nyeteṅ namo aabo ene̱ toi? ni eka etoi ní enu nii ní baba le̱?

english_verse: Israel sinned and refused to obey the Lord or follow his instructions. So the Lord let us be robbed of everything we owned.
translation_verse: Namo ke̱ Iakob hã ní ahale̱, ni eke̱ Israel hã odsotſalo̱i? Ani dšee Iehowa ní wo̱fe eša wo̱šile̱ le̱ ni, moni ame̱kplẽẽ egbè̱i le̱ ano̱ nyiemo̱, ni ame̱boo emla le̱ toi le̱?

english_verse: He was furious with us and punished our nation with the fires of war. Still we paid no attention. We didn't even care when we were surrounded and scorched by flames.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ efo̱se mlifũ ní nā wa ke̱ ta ní mli wa hũ eſie ame̱no̱; ni eše̱re la ewo ame̱he ke̱-kpe, ši ame̱lee; ešãame̱, ši ame̱ke̱-woo ame̱tšui mli.

english_verse: To me, you are very dear, and I love you. That's why I gave up nations and people to rescue you.
translation_verse: Ake̱-ni odšra wa ye̱ mihĩe ni ohĩe eba nyam, ni mi le̱, misumoo̱ osane hewo̱ le̱, mike̱ gbomei aahã ye̱ onãdšiaṅ, ke̱ mãdšimãdšĩ hũ ye̱ owala hewo̱.

english_verse: They are my people— I created each of them to bring honor to me.” The Lord Alone Is God The Lord said:
translation_verse: mofēmo ní aṅõ *migbe̱ĩ awole̱, moni mibo̱le̱ mihã minumnyam, moni mišõle̱ ni miſele̱ le̱! *Ier.

english_verse: I promised to save you, and I kept my promise. You are my witnesses that no other god did this. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mi noṅṅ midšadše, ni mihere mei ayiwala, ni mihã anu hũ, ni mokpõṅ ko be̱ nyeteṅ; nohewo̱ le̱ *nyedši midasefoi, Iehowa kē̱, ni mi, midši Mawu le̱! *K.

english_verse: I am God now and forever. No one can snatch you from me or stand in my way. The Lord Will Prepare the Way
translation_verse: Dãni gbĩ ko aaba dšeṅ le̱ mi noṅṅ ni, ni moko be̱ ni aadšie mo ye̱ mideṅ; ké̱ mife noko le̱, namo aakũ nā?

english_verse: I am the one who cut a path through the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa, — moni *dše gbe̱ ye̱ ṅšo̱ le̱ mli, ke̱ tempõṅ hũ ye̱ nui ní nā wa le̱ amli le̱, *

english_verse: I sent an army to chase you with chariots and horses; now they lie dead, unable to move. They are like an oil lamp with the flame snuffed out. Forget the Past The Lord said:
translation_verse: moni dšie ſīlii ke̱ okpo̱ṅo̱i ke̱ ta ke̱ hewale̱ kpo, ni ame̱fẽ-tſẽm ame̱kãmo̱ ši ni ame̱tee ši doṅṅ, ni ame̱tã, ni ame̱gboi tamo̱ kane mli odonti le̱, — kē̱ ne̱:

english_verse: I am creating something new. There it is! Do you see it? I have put roads in deserts, streams in thirsty lands.
translation_verse: Na, mibafe noko hē, ebapue amrõ ne̱: aso nyenáṅ nyele? Hē̃, madše gbe̱ ye̱ ṅā le̱ no̱, ke̱ *fāi hũ ye̱ ṅã ole̱ṅle̱ le̱ no̱. *

english_verse: Every wild animal honors me, even jackals and owls. I provide water in deserts— streams in thirsty lands for my chosen people.
translation_verse: Ṅãṅ koloi tete aawo mihĩe nyam, ṅãṅgbēi ke̱ dugumai fẽ; edšake̱ mahã nu aba ṅã le̱ no̱, ke̱ fāi hũ ye̱ ṅã ole̱ṅle̱ le̱ no̱, ni mahã mimaṅ le̱, mei ní mihala le̱, anu.

english_verse: I made them my own nation, so they would praise me.
translation_verse: Maṅ ní mišõ mihã mihe, koni ame̱gba miyidšiemo̱ le̱.

english_verse: You have not honored me by sacrificing sheep or other animals. And I have not burdened you with demands for sacrifices or sweet-smelling incense.
translation_verse: Oke̱ ošā̃-afo̱le tōi le̱ ebahããmi, ni asaṅ oke̱ ofo̱lei le̱ woo mihĩe nyam; mi-ke̱ niyenii-afo̱lei gbaa onā, ni mihãã ato̱o ke̱ kro̱be̱o;

english_verse: You have not brought delicious spices for me or given me the best part of your sacrificed animals. Instead, you burden me down with your terrible sins.
translation_verse: oke̱ odſie̱te̱i hee kalamo ohããmi, ni ohãã mato̱ ke̱ ofo̱lei afo̱ le̱; moṅ, oke̱ ohe ešai le̱ haomi, ni ohã etomi ke̱ onišaianii le̱!

english_verse: But I wipe away your sins because of who I am. And so, I will forget the wrongs you have done.
translation_verse: Mi noṅṅ midši moni gbeo̱ ono̱-tõmo̱i le̱ ye̱ midientše̱ mihewo̱, ni ohe ešai le̱ hũ mikaiṅ doṅṅ.

english_verse: Meet me in court! State your case and prove that you are right.
translation_verse: Kaimo̱mi, ní wo̱kodšo; dšadšemo̱ osane le̱, koni abuo bem!

english_verse: Your earliest ancestor and all your leaders rebelled against me.
translation_verse: Okleṅkleṅ tše̱ le̱ fe eša, ni mei ní damoo̱ mli hãao le̱ tõ mino̱: Dan.

english_verse: That's why I don't allow your priests to serve me; I let Israel be destroyed and your people disgraced.
translation_verse: hewo̱ le̱ mibule hekroṅkroṅ le̱ lume̱i le̱, ni mife Iakob musu, ni mike̱ Israel hã heguo̱gbē.

english_verse: Can anyone compare with me? If so, let them speak up and tell me now. Let them say what has happened since I made my nation long ago, and let them tell what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Ni namo tamo̱mi, ke̱-dše̱ beyino̱ ní mito blema maṅ le̱? Hã edše kpo ni ebadšadše ni eke̱-mãmo̱ mihĩe; *ni ame̱-dšadše wó̱se̱ sãdši ke̱ sãdši ni baba le̱ ame̱tšõ!

english_verse: Don't tremble with fear! Didn't I tell you long ago? Didn't you hear me? I alone am God— no one else is a mighty rock. Idols Can't Do a Thing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nyehe akakpokpoa ni nyekašea gbeyei! Ani dšee blema bēbe midse̱ midšadše mitšõnye ni mihã nyenu? Ni nyedši midasefoi! Ani mise̱ le̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ko ye̱? Ni te̱sã ko hũ be̱: milee eko!

english_verse: Some of the wood is used to make a fire for heating or for cooking. One piece is made into an idol, then the woodcarver bows down and worships it.
translation_verse: ni etšṍo̱ lai ehãa gbomo: eṅõo̱ eko ew̌ereo̱, eše̱reo̱ eko ni eṅõ-šãa abolo; ni eṅõo̱ no noṅṅ eko efeo̱ nyoṅmo̱, ni edšáa! eke̱ eko feo̱ amãgã, ni akotoo̱le̱!

english_verse: He enjoys the warm fire and the meat that was roasted over the burning coals.
translation_verse: Ešăa fã ye̱ la mli; eyeo̱ lō hũ ye̱ fã no̱; eflo̱oo̱ lō ye̱ no̱ ni eyeo̱ eto̱ö̱; ew̌ereo̱ ni ekē̱o̱ ake̱: Yie̱! mihe edo̱, mina la!

english_verse: They don't have enough sense to say to themselves, “I made a fire with half of the wood and cooked my bread and meat on it. Then I made something worthless with the other half. Why worship a block of wood?”
translation_verse: Ni mokomoko dſẽṅmo̱ baa no̱, asaṅ nilē lo sanese̱ko̱mo̱ ko be̱, ni aakē̱ ake̱: Mišã fã ye̱ laṅ, ni mišã abolo hũ ye̱ eṅãi le̱ no̱, ni miflo̱o lō ye̱ no̱ miye; aso maṅõ noni eſe̱ le̱ mafe nihĩnii? aso makoto ši mahã tšokuku lo?

english_verse: How can anyone be stupid enough to trust something that can be burned to ashes? No one can save themselves like that. Don't they realize that the idols they hold in their hands are not really gods? The Lord Won't Forget His People
translation_verse: Moni nyieo̱ lamlu se̱ le̱, tšui ní ašišiu mīhã ēdū gbe̱, ni enyẽṅ esusuma edšie, ni ekē̱ṅ ake̱: Aso dšee apasa yo̱ mininedšŭrõ ne̱?

english_verse: Turn back to me! I have rescued you and swept away your sins as though they were clouds. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: *Migbe onõfõṅfemo̱i le̱ tamo̱ atatu ko, ke̱ ohe ešai le̱ hũ tamo̱ afua ko: Kpalemo̱ ke̱-ba miṅõ, ši mikpõo! *

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to start singing! Tell the mountains and every tree in the forest to join in the song! The Lord has rescued his people; now they will worship him. The Lord Created Everything
translation_verse: Nyelaä nyã́mo̱ lala, nye ṅweii, edšake̱ Iehowa efe! Nyeboa oše, nye šikpoṅ le̱ šišigbe̱i le̱! Nyewóa nyã́mo̱ lala no̱, nye gõdši, kō ke̱ emli tšei le̱ fiä; *edšake̱ Iehowa ekpõ Iakob, ni ehĩe eba nyam ye̱ Israel mli!

english_verse: Israel, I am your Lord, the source of your life, and I have rescued you. I created everything from the sky above to the earth below.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa, okpõlo̱ le̱, ke̱ moni šõo ke̱-dše̱ onye mũsũṅ le̱, kē̱ ne̱: Mi, Iehowa, dši moni feo̱ nibii fẽ, moni eko-metō egbleo̱ ṅwei mli, ni elē̱o̱ šikpoṅ le̱ mli, ni moko fataa ehe le̱;

english_verse: I make liars of false prophets and fools of fortunetellers. I take human wisdom and turn it into nonsense.
translation_verse: moni hãa amale gbalo̱i akadii feo̱ yaka, ni ehãa klamo̱i yeo̱ se̱ke̱; moni kũo̱ nilelo̱i anā, ni ehãa ame̱nilē le̱ tšṍo̱ kwašiafemo̱;

english_verse: I will make the message of my prophets come true. They are saying, “Jerusalem will be filled with people, and the Lord will rebuild the towns of Judah.”
translation_verse: moni mãa etšũlo̱ wiemo̱ no̱ mĩ́, ni ehãa ebo̱foi agbale̱ baä mli; moni kē̱o̱ ye̱ Ierusalem he ake̱: Mei aahĩ emli! ke̱ Iuda mãdši le̱ ake̱: Aamãmo̱ame̱, ni matē emaṅfõ le̱ ši mamã ši! le̱;

english_verse: I am the one who commands the sea and its streams to run dry.
translation_verse: moni kē̱o̱ bu kwo̱ṅkwo̱ṅ le̱ ake̱: Omli agbī! ni mahã ofāi le̱ hũ amī̃ le̱!

english_verse: I am also the one who says, “Cyrus will lead my people and obey my orders. Jerusalem and the temple will be rebuilt.”
translation_verse: Moni kē̱o̱ ye̱ *Koreš he ake̱: Mitōkwe̱lo̱ dšile̱! ni eehã nii ni sa mihĩe le̱ fẽ aba mli, ni eekē̱ ye̱ Ierusalem he ake̱: Aamãle̱! ke̱ so̱lemo̱we le̱ hũ ake̱: Aato šiši! le̱. *

english_verse: Cyrus, you don't even know me! But I have called you by name and highly honored you because of Israel, my chosen servant.
translation_verse: *Mitšũlo̱ Iakob ke̱ Israel ní mihala le̱ hewo̱ ni mitšé̱o ke̱ ogbe̱i, ni miwoö gbe̱i, dãni olemi po. *

english_verse: I create light and darkness, happiness and sorrow. I, the Lord, do all this.
translation_verse: Mišõo̱ la, ni mibo̱ö̱ duṅ hũ; mi mihãa hedšo̱le̱ baä, ni *mibo̱ö̱ efõṅ; mi, Iehowa, le̱ noṅṅ mifeo̱ ene̱mei fẽ! *Amos

english_verse: Tell the heavens to send down justice like showers of rain. Prepare the earth for my saving power to sprout and produce justice that I, the Lord, create. The Lord's Mighty Power The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nye ṅweii, nyetšerea ke̱-dše̱a yiteṅgbe̱ nyeſiea ši, ni atatui le̱ afo̱se dšale̱ aſie ši! Šikpoṅ le̱ hũ agble enā ni yiwalaheremo̱ aba, ni eke̱ dšale̱ akwẽ šikōme: mi, Iehowa, mibo̱ ene̱! Lal.

english_verse: I created the world and covered it with people; I stretched out the sky and filled it with stars.
translation_verse: Mi mife šikpoṅ le̱, ni mibo gbomei mito no̱; mi minidši gble ṅwei mli, ni mifã́ ame̱safo le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: I have done the right thing by placing Cyrus in power, and I will make the roads easy for him to follow. I am the Lord All-Powerful! Cyrus will rebuild my city and set my people free without being paid a thing. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Alone Can Save
translation_verse: Mi noṅṅ mitēle̱ ši ye̱ dšale̱ nā, ni madšadše egbè̱i le̱ fẽ: le̱ noṅṅ eesā eto mimaṅ le̱ ni eeṅmē̃ minomi le̱ ahe, dšee yinii anā, ni dšee nyōṅnii anā: bo̱ni Iehowa Zebaot kē̱ dši no. K.

english_verse: People of Israel, your God is a mystery, though he alone can save.
translation_verse: Asono̱kwa, bo dši Mawu ní etē ehe, Israel Nyoṅmo̱, yiwalaherelo̱! Rom.

english_verse: Anyone who makes idols will be confused and terribly disgraced.
translation_verse: Ame̱hĩe aagboi, ni ame̱fẽ ame̱hĩe aaſie ši, mei ní feo̱ amãgãi le̱, ame̱fẽ ame̱anyie ke̱ hĩešiſiemo̱.

english_verse: But Israel, I, the Lord, will always keep you safe and free from shame. Everyone Is Invited
translation_verse: Ši Iehowa aahere Israel yiwala ke̱ nāno̱ yiwalaheremo̱: nyehĩe gboiṅ ni asaṅ nyehĩe eſieṅ ši gbĩkogbĩko ke̱-yaši nāno̱.

english_verse: The Lord alone is God! He created the heavens and made a world where people can live, instead of creating an empty desert. The Lord alone is God; there are no others.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa, moni bo̱ ṅwei le̱, Nyoṅmo̱, mo̱ni šõ šikpoṅ le̱ ni efe ni eke̱-mã ši, ni ebo̱o̱le̱ eflo, ši ešõle̱ ní ahĩ no̱ le̱, kē̱ ne̱: Midsi Iehowa, ni moko be̱ se̱ doṅṅ!

english_verse: The Lord did not speak in a dark secret place or command Jacob's descendants to search for him in vain. The Lord speaks the truth, and this is what he says
translation_verse: Dšee tēmo̱he ko miwie ye̱, dšee šikpoṅ ni ewo duṅ le̱ no̱ heko; mikē̱ko Iakob sešibii le̱ ake̱: Nyetaoami yakatſā! Midsi Iehowa ní wieo̱ dšale̱ le̱, ní dšadšeo̱ nii ní dša le̱!

english_verse: to every survivor from every nation: “Gather around me! Learn how senseless it is to worship wooden idols or pray to helpless gods.
translation_verse: Nyebuaä nyehe nā ke̱-baä, nyefẽ-tſẽm nyebahe̱ṅke̱a, nye mei ní nyedše mli ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ amli le̱: mei ní tĕreo̱ ame̱mãgã tšo, ni ame̱kpaä nyoṅmo̱ ko ni nyẽẽ mo yiwala ahere fai le̱, ame̱ lee noko.

english_verse: “Why don't you get together and meet me in court? Didn't I tell you long ago what would happen? I am the only God! There are no others. I bring about justice, and have the power to save.
translation_verse: Nyedšadšea ni nyeke̱-baä, hẽ, nyefẽ nyeyaä adšina! Namo hã anu ene̱ ke̱-dše̱ tetēte? namo dšadše ene̱ ke̱-dše̱ blema bēbe? Aso dšeemi, Iehowa ni? ni *mise̱ le̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ko be̱ doṅṅ; Mawu dšalo̱ ke̱ yiwalaherelo̱, ni mise̱ le̱ mokomoko be̱ doṅṅ! *K.

english_verse: “I invite the whole world to turn to me and be saved. I alone am God! No others are real.
translation_verse: Nyetšṍmo̱a nyehe ke̱-baä miṅõ, ko-ni ahere nyeyiwala, nye šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbēhei le̱ fẽ, edšake̱ midši Mawu, ni moko be̱ doṅṅ!

english_verse: They will admit that I alone can bring about justice. Everyone who is angry with me will be terribly ashamed and will turn to me.
translation_verse: Iehowa mli ke̱ke̱ *dšale̱ ke̱ hewale̱ yo̱; eṅõ mei aaba, ni mei fẽ ni mli ewole̱ la le̱ ahĩe aagboi. *Ier.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will give victory and great honor to the people of Israel.”
translation_verse: Iehowa mli Israel seši fẽ aaye bem ye̱, *eno̱ ame̱aſã ame̱afõ. *

english_verse: The gods Bel and Nebo are down on their knees, as wooden images of them are carried away on weary animals.
translation_verse: Bel eba ši, Nebo ekoto ši; ame̱mãgãi le̱ ake̱-hã gbe̱ſā̃ koloi ke̱ dšatšutẽremo̱ koloi: nii ni nyetĕreo̱ ke̱-foo̱ ši le̱ etšṍ dšatšu ke̱ tšĩmo̱ ní hãa to̱ö̱ame̱. Ier.

english_verse: You survivors in Israel, listen to me, the Lord. Since the day you were born, I have carried you along.
translation_verse: Nyeboami toi, nye Iakob we, mei fẽ ní eſe̱ ye̱ Israel we le̱, nye mei ní mihĩenye ke̱-dše̱ mũsũṅ bēbe, ní mitĕre-nye ke̱-dše̱ fo̱mo̱he le̱;

english_verse: I will still be the same when you are old and gray, and I will take care of you. I created you. I will carry you and always keep you safe.
translation_verse: nĩ ke̱-yaši *gbo̱le̱ mli le̱, mi noṅṅ ni, ni ke̱-yaši waṅdšē mli hũ mi noṅṅ matĕre: mi mife, ni mi noṅṅ mahĩe, mi noṅṅ matĕre, ni madšie. *Lal.

english_verse: Can anyone compare with me? Is anyone my equal?
translation_verse: Namo he nyeke̱mi aato, ni eke̱mi aaye egbo̱? Namo nyeke̱mi aasusu ni eke̱mi aafe pe̱?

english_verse: They carry the idol on their shoulders, then put it on a stand, but it cannot move. They call out to the idol when they are in trouble, but it doesn't answer, and it cannot help.
translation_verse: Ame̱ṅõo̱le̱ ame̱tſaä ame̱kõṅ, ame̱tĕreo̱le̱ ni ame̱ke̱le̱ yamãa emā̃he, ni emãa ši, etšĩi ehe ke̱-dše̱e̱ emā̃he le̱: eblo̱ö̱ atšé̱o̱le̱, ši eheree no̱; enyẽẽ mo yiwala ehere ke̱-dše̱ haomo̱ mli.

english_verse: Now keep this in mind, you sinful people. And don't ever forget it. The Lord Alone Is God
translation_verse: Nyekaia ene̱, ni nyefĩa ši; nyeke̱woa nyetšuiiaṅ, nye no̱tõlo̱i!

english_verse: From the very beginning, I told what would happen long before it took place. I kept my word
translation_verse: mi ní midše̱o̱ šišidšē le̱ midšadšeo̱ nāgbēnii le̱, ni midše̱o̱ blema bēbe midšadšeo̱ nii ní anáko afe le̱; mikē̱o̱ ake̱: Miyiṅtō le̱ aaba mli, ni nibii fẽ ní sa mihĩe le̱ mafe!

english_verse: and brought someone from a distant land to do what I wanted. He attacked from the east, like a hawk swooping down. Now I will keep my promise and do what I planned.
translation_verse: Mītšé̱ okropoṅ ko ke̱-mīdše̱ bokã, ke̱ miyiṅtō nā nū le̱ ke̱-mīdše̱ maṅse̱ šoṅṅ. Mi miwie, ni mi noṅṅ mahã aba mli; mito miyiṅ, ni mafe hũ!

english_verse: You people are stubborn and far from being safe, so listen to me.
translation_verse: Nyeboami toi, nye tšuisalo̱i, ní nyeke̱ dšale̱ teṅ edšeke̱ le̱!

english_verse: I will soon come to save you. I am not far away and will waste no time; I take pride in Israel and will save Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mike̱ midšale̱ le̱ ebe̱ṅke̱, ebe̱ šoṅṅ, ni miyiwalaheremo̱ le̱ hũ etše̱ṅ. Ni mike̱ yiwalaheremo̱ aahã ye̱ Zion, ni mike̱ minumnyam le̱ aahã Israel.

english_verse: You will suffer the shame of going naked, because I will take revenge, and no one can escape.
translation_verse: Aadšie *oyayaiaṅ kpo, aana ohĩegbĕle le̱! Mato̱ owele, ni gbomo ko etšīṅ minā! *Nah.

english_verse: Babylon, be silent! Sit in the dark. No longer will nations accept you as their queen.
translation_verse: Tá ši diō ni obote duṅ mli, bo Kaldeabii abiyō! Ši akãṅ he atšé̱ṅo ake̱ maṅtše̱yelii le̱ awura doṅṅ!

english_verse: I was angry with my people. So I let you take their land and bring disgrace on them. You showed them no mercy, but were especially cruel to those who were old.
translation_verse: Mimli wo mimaṅ le̱ la, mibule mino̱yelinõ le̱, ni mike̱ame̱ wo odeṅ: omũsũṅ etšõõo ye ame̱he, ohã opã le̱ tšī ye̱ nūmo po no̱;

english_verse: You think that you alone are all-powerful, that you won't be a widow or lose your children. All you care about is pleasure, but listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ agbe̱ne̱ bo ene̱ toi, bo ni osumoo̱ dšeṅṅõmo̱ yeli, ní otá ši ni ohe edšo̱o, ni *okē̱o̱ ye̱ otšui mli ake̱: Mi dši mi, ni mise̱ le̱ moko be̱ doṅṅ, mitáṅ ši ake̱ yō okũlafo, ni mileṅ bo̱ni akpakpāa mo bii yo̱ ehe. *Kpods.

english_verse: Your magic powers and charms will suddenly fail, then you will be a widow and lose your children.
translation_verse: Ši nibii enyo̱ no̱ aaba ono̱ trukã ye̱ gbĩ kome no̱, aakpakpã obii ye̱ ohe ni ootšṍ okũlafo hũ; ene̱mei fẽ aaba ono̱ ye̱ okũnyāyelii ní fá le̱ ke̱ okable̱fĩmo̱i babaō le̱ mli.

english_verse: You hid behind evil like a shield and said, “No one can see me!” You were fooled by your wisdom and your knowledge; you felt sure that you alone were in full control.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ oke̱ ohĩe fõo̱ onifõdšianii le̱ ano̱, okē̱o̱ ake̱: Moko enaami! Oṅā ke̱ onilē lo̱ ehã odũ gbe̱, ni okē̱o̱ ye̱ otšui mli ake̱: Mi dši mi, ni mise̱ le̱ moko be̱ doṅṅ!

english_verse: But without warning, disaster will strike— and your magic charms won't help at all.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ lo̱ efōṅ aaba ono̱, oleṅ bo̱ni oofe okpa ye̱ ono̱; ni ošrã aašrão, ni onyẽṅ okpãtã; ni hĩekpãtãmo̱ aaba eno̱ trukā ní olee be.

english_verse: Keep using your magic powers and your charms as you have always done. Maybe—just maybe— you will frighten somebody!
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ te ši odamo̱ ši ke̱ okable̱fĩmo̱i, ke̱ *okūnyāyeliĩ babaō ní ogbo he deṅme ke̱-dše̱ ogbekẽbiiaši le̱: ake̱ aleenõ oonyẽ oke̱-fe noko, ake̱ aleenõ ohe aafe gbeyei lo! *Dan.

english_verse: You have worn yourself out, asking for advice from those who study the stars and tell the future month after month. Go ask them how to be saved from what will happen.
translation_verse: Oṅāwō pī le̱ ehã eto̱o: hã mei ní le ṅwei nii le̱ ke̱ ṅulamiiaṅkwe̱lo̱i le̱ ni ké̱ nyõṅ dše ni ame̱tšõo̱ nii ní baba ono̱ le̱ ate ši, ni ame̱here oyiwala!

english_verse: People who trust the stars are as helpless as straw in a flaming fire. No one can even keep warm, sitting by a fire that feeds only on straw.
translation_verse: Na, ame̱tamo̱ gbetšelĩĩ, la aašãame̱: ame̱nyẽṅ ame̱he ame̱dšie ke̱-dše̱ lalilei le̱ deṅ; edšee ṅãi-ke̱-la ní aw̌ereo̱, lo la ko ni atráa he.

english_verse: These are the fortunetellers you have done business with all of your life. But they don't know where they are going, and they can't save you.
translation_verse: Mei ní ogbo ame̱he deṅme le̱, bo̱ni ame̱batšṍmo̱ ame̱hão ne̱, mei ní ke̱o ye dšra ke̱-dše̱ ogbekẽbiiaši le̱ ateṅ mofẽmo aadũ gbe̱ ke̱-ate enõ mli; mokomoko be̱ ni aahere oyiwala.

english_verse: Today I am doing something new, something you cannot say you have heard before.
translation_verse: Kpāko abo̱, ni ebe̱ sá; onuko dã, dša ṅme̱ne̱, koni okakē̱ ake̱: Na, mile!

english_verse: I, the Lord, am true to myself; I will be praised for not punishing and destroying you.
translation_verse: Migbe̱i le̱ hewo̱ le̱ matši mlifũ le̱ mato, ni miyidšiemo̱ le̱ hewo̱ le̱ mato mitsui ši mahão, koni mikakpãtã ohĩe.

english_verse: Israel, my chosen people, listen to me. I alone am the Lord, the first and the last.
translation_verse: Bomi toi ko, Iakob, ke̱ Israel ní mitšé̱o: Mi ni, *midši kleṅkleṅmo, ni mi noṅṅ dši se̱kpēmo! *

english_verse: With my own hand I created the earth and stretched out the sky. They obey my every command. The Lord Speaks to the Nations
translation_verse: Minine to šikpoṅ le̱ šiši, ni mininedšŭrõ le̱ ṅwei mli; mi mitšé̱ame̱, ni ame̱fẽ ame̱badamo̱ ši!

english_verse: Gather around me, all of you! Listen to what I say. Did any of your idols predict this would happen? Did they say that my friend would do what I want done to Babylonia?
translation_verse: Nyefẽ nyebuaä nyehe nā ní nyebaboa toi: Ame̱teṅ namo dšadše ene̱ tšō? Moni Iehowa *sumoo̱ le̱: eefe noni sa ehĩe ye̱ Babel he, ni enine aakã Kaldeabii le̱ ano̱. *

english_verse: I was the one who chose him. I have brought him this far, and he will be successful.
translation_verse: Mi, mi noṅṅ miwie, ni mitšé̱le̱, ni miṅõle̱ ke̱-ba, ni egbe̱ le̱ aadša.

english_verse: Come closer and listen! I have never kept secret the things I have said, and I was here before time began. It Is Best To Obey the Lord By the power of his Spirit the Lord God has sent me
translation_verse: Nyetšia nyebe̱ṅke̱ami, nyebaboa ene̱ toi: ke̱-dše̱ šišidšē le̱ *dšee dudšiaṅ miwie ye̱; ke̱-dše̱ beyino̱ ní eyo̱ le̱ miye̱ dše̱i! Ni agbe̱ne̱ Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa etšũmi, ke̱ Emumo̱ le̱! *

english_verse: Your nation would be blessed with more people than there are grains of sand along the seashore. And I would never have let your country be destroyed.
translation_verse: ni oseši aafá tamo̱ šia, ni omũsũṅbii hũ aatamo̱ šia kulibii: afoṅ egbe̱i aše̱ṅ afõṅ ni afiteṅle̱ ye̱ mihĩe!

english_verse: Now leave Babylon! Celebrate as you go. Be happy and shout for everyone to hear, “The Lord has rescued his servant Israel!
translation_verse: *Nyedšea Babel, nyedšoa foi ke̱-dše̱a Kaldeabii ateṅ ke̱ nyã́mo̱ gbẽ! Nyedšadšea ene̱ nyetaoa, nyegbaä, nyehãa edšidšea ke̱-yaä šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbēhe! Nyekē̱a ake̱: Iehowa ekpo etšũlo̱ Iakob! *

english_verse: But the Lord has promised that none who are evil will live in peace.”
translation_verse: Hedšo̱le̱ be̱ hã meifõdši le̱! Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: This is what the Lord says: I will answer your prayers because I have set a time when I will help by coming to save you. I have chosen you to take my promise of hope to other nations. You will rebuild the country from its ruins, then people will come and settle there.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: *Be ní sa mli miboõ toi ye̱, ni yiwalaheremo̱ gbĩ no̱ hũ miye mibuao ye̱: ni mibā oyi, ni mihã otšṍ maṅ le̱ †kpãṅmo̱, koni otō šikpoṅ le̱ ši omã ši, ni oke̱ gbošinii ni efe amaṅfõ le̱ ahãame̱; *Lal.

english_verse: They won't go hungry or get thirsty; they won't be bothered by the scorching sun or hot desert winds. I will be merciful while leading them along to streams of water.
translation_verse: Hõmo̱ yeṅame̱, ni kũmai hũ yeṅame̱, ni šia-ṅã ní no̱ edo̱ lo hũlũ esaṅ ame̱he; edšake̱ moni mũsũṅ tšõo̱le̱ ye̱ ame̱he le̱ aawaame̱, ni eetšõame̱ gbe̱ ke̱-ate nubui ahe. Kpods.

english_verse: I will level the mountains and make roads.
translation_verse: Ni mafe migõdši le̱ fẽ gbe̱, ni aahole migbe̱dšegbe̱i ano̱.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to celebrate and sing; command every mountain to join in the song. The Lord's people have suffered, but he has shown mercy and given them comfort.
translation_verse: Nyelaä, nye ṅweii, ni šikpoṅ, nyã́; ni nye gõdši le̱ hũ, nyelaä nyã́mo̱ lala! edšake̱ Iehowa eše̱dše emaṅ le̱ṅ mī, ni emei ní nii yo̱ mo̱bo̱ le̱, emũsũṅ etšõle̱ ye̱ ame̱he!

english_verse: The people of Zion said, “The Lord has turned away and forgotten us.”
translation_verse: Ši Zion kē̱ ake̱: Iehowa ešĩmi, ni Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ hĩe ekpa mino̱!

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Could a mother forget a child who nurses at her breast? Could she fail to love an infant who came from her own body? Even if a mother could forget, I will never forget you.
translation_verse: Aso yō ble aakpa *ebi fufo̱ō no̱, alo emũsũṅ etšõṅle̱ ye̱ emũsũṅbi hewo̱? Ni ké̱ mene̱mei ahĩe aakpa no̱ tete le̱, mi le̱ mihĩe kpaṅ ono̱! *

english_verse: Look around! You will see your people coming home. As surely as I live, I, the Lord, promise that your city with its people will be as lovely as a bride wearing her jewelry.” Jerusalem's Bright Future
translation_verse: *Holemo̱ ohĩṅme̱ii ano̱ ni okwe̱ ohe ke̱-kpe! Mene̱mei fẽ mībua ame̱he nā ke̱-mība oṅõ! Gbĩĩabo̱ ní mihĩe kã ne̱! Iehowa kē̱, le̱le̱ṅ ake̱ oowo ame̱fẽ tamo̱ awoo̱ wulamo̱nii, ni oke̱ame̱ aafĩmo̱ omli, tamo̱ ayemforo feo̱ le̱. *

english_verse: Jerusalem is now in ruins! Nothing is left of the city. But it will be rebuilt and soon overcrowded; its cruel enemies will be gone far away.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ohei ni efe ole̱ṅle̱ le̱ ke̱ omaṅfõi ke̱ ošikpoṅ ni afite le̱, le̱le̱ṅ, agbe̱ne̱ obafe fintō̃ tšṍ ohã mei ní hĩeo̱ mli le̱, ni mei ní mī̃o le̱ aate šoṅṅ.

english_verse: Jerusalem is a woman whose children were born while she was in deep sorrow over the loss of her husband. Now those children will come and seek room in the crowded city,
translation_verse: Asaṅ obii ni akpakpā ye̱ ohe le̱ aakē̱ ye̱ otoiiaṅ ake̱: Bie̱ ne̱ ye̱ fintō̃ tšṍ hãmi, tši ohe ke̱-ya se̱, koni maná hĩle̱he!

english_verse: and Jerusalem will ask, “Am I really their mother? How could I have given birth when I was still mourning in a foreign land? Who raised these children? Where have they come from?”
translation_verse: No le̱ ookē̱ ye̱ otšui mli ake̱: Namo fe̱ mene̱mei hãmi, mi ni akpakpā mibii ye̱ mihe ni mitšṍ kene, aṅōmi nom, ni aſiemi le̱? ši mene̱mei ne̱, namo lē̱ame̱? Na, mi le̱, ašĩ mikōme; ši mene̱mei ne̱ nẽgbe̱ ame̱dše̱?

english_verse: The kings and queens of those nations where they were raised will come and bow down. They will take care of you just like a slave taking care of a child. Then you will know that I am the Lord. You won't be disappointed if you trust me.” The Lord Is on Our Side
translation_verse: Ni *maṅtše̱mei aatšṍmo̱ okwe̱lo̱i, ni ame̱maṅnyemei lo̱ aatšṍmo̱ ofufo̱hãlo̱i; †ame̱akotoö ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱hĩe aabumo̱ ši, ni ame̱ale̱mo̱ onādšiaši mlu, ni ooná ole ake̱ mi, midši Iehowa, ni mei ní hĩe kā mino̱ le̱ ahĩe gboiṅ! *

english_verse: Is it possible to rescue victims from someone strong and cruel?
translation_verse: Ani ašõo̱ ekãlo̱ hānii ye̱ edeṅ? alo moni he wa le̱ nomi le̱ aadše mli?

english_verse: But the Lord has promised to fight on our side and to rescue our children from those strong and violent enemies.
translation_verse: Ši bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: *Aašõ ekãlo̱ nomi le̱, ni moni he ye̱ gbeyei le̱ hānii le̱ aadše mli, edšake̱ moni ke̱o béo̱ le̱, mike̱le̱ aabé, ni mahere obii le̱ ayiwala. *Mat.

english_verse: He will make those cruel people dine on their own flesh and get drunk from drinking their own blood. Then everyone will know that the Lord is our Savior; the powerful God of Israel has rescued his people.
translation_verse: Ni mahã ohaolo̱i le̱ aye ame̱dientše̱ ame̱helo, ni ame̱dientše̱ ame̱lá aatō̱ro̱ame̱ tamo̱ dā̃ do̱ko̱do̱ko̱; ni helo fẽ aaná ale ake̱ mi, Iehowa, dši oyiwalaherelo̱ le̱, ni okpõlo̱ dši Iakob hewalo̱ le̱.

english_verse: The Lord God gives me the right words to encourage the weary. Each morning he awakens me eager to learn his teaching;
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa ehãmi *nikaselo̱i alile̱i, koni male bo̱ni mike̱ moni eto̱le̱ le̱ aawie ye̱ he ni sa mli; etšĩeo̱mi dā lebi, etšĩeo̱ mitoi, ní mike̱-nu nii tamo̱ nikaseloi. *Mat.

english_verse: he made me willing to listen and not rebel or run away.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa egble *mitoi, ni mitšee atũa, ni asaṅ mikũũ mise̱. *Lal.

english_verse: I let them beat my back and pull out my beard. I didn't turn aside when they insulted me and spit in my face.
translation_verse: Mitšṍ mikotose̱ mihã yilo̱i, ke̱ midabii hũ mihã mei ni fāmoo̱ tšo̱i; mike̱ mihĩe hũ etēē ke̱-dše̱e̱ hĩegbĕle ke̱ ladšõ he. Mat.

english_verse: But the Lord God keeps me from being disgraced. So I refuse to give up, because I know God will never let me down.
translation_verse: Ši Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa yeo̱ buaämi, be-wo̱ le̱ mihĩe eſieko ši; nohewo̱ hũ le̱ mife mihĩe tamo̱ tſre̱bo, ni mile ake̱ mihĩe gboṅ.

english_verse: The Lord God will help me and prove I am innocent. My accusers will wear out like moth-eaten clothes.
translation_verse: Na, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa yeo̱ buaämi: namo dši moni aabumi fo̱? Na, ame̱fẽ ame̱asū tamo̱ atade, omlẽgẽ aayeame̱!

english_verse: None of you respect the Lord or obey his servant. You walk in the dark instead of the light; you don't trust the name of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Nyeteṅ namo šeo̱ Iehowa gbeyei, ni eboo etšule̱ le̱ gbē toi? Ké̱ enyie duṅ mli po ni la etšoo hããle̱ le̱, hã eke̱ ehĩe afõ Iehowa gbe̱i le̱ no̱, ni eke̱ ehe ekpasa e-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱!

english_verse: Go ahead and walk in the light of the fires you have set. But with his own hand, the Lord will punish you and make you suffer.
translation_verse: Na, nyefẽ ní nyeše̱reo̱ la, ní nyeke̱ gãimlibii ni tšoo̱ bo̱leo̱ nyehe le̱, nyeyaä nyelalile̱i ke̱ gãimlibii ni tšoo̱ ní nyeše̱re le̱ amli! Mideṅ nyeaná ene̱ ke̱-adše̱, aw̌ere̱hō mli nyeakãmo̱ ši ye̱!

english_verse: Though Zion is in ruins, the Lord will bring comfort, and the city will be as lovely as the garden of Eden that he provided. Then Zion will celebrate; it will be thankful and sing joyful songs. The Lord's Victory Will Last
translation_verse: Ši Iehowa eše̱dše Zion mī, eše̱dše emaṅfõi le̱ fẽ amī, ni ehã eṅã le̱ no̱ etšṍ tamo̱ Eden, ni eṅã ole̱ṅle̱ le̱ no̱ etšṍ tamo̱ Iehowa trom. Mliflimo̱ ke̱ mīše̱ aana ye̱ mli, ke̱ šidā hũ ke̱ yidšiemo̱ lala gbē.

english_verse: The Lord says: You are my people and nation! So pay attention to me. My teaching will cause justice to shine like a light for every nation.
translation_verse: Mimaṅbii, nyefea toi nyehãami, ni mimaṅ, nyeboami toi! ši mla aadše̱ miṅõ adše kpo, ni mike̱ mikodšomo̱ le̱ aamã ši ake̱ mãdšimãdši le̱ ala.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the one who encourages you. Why are you afraid of mere humans? They dry up and die like grass.
translation_verse: Mi, midsi nyemīše̱dšelo̱. Namo dšio ni ošeo̱ *ádesã ní bagbo, alo gbomo bi ní †tamo̱ dſe̱i le̱ gbeyei? *Lal.

english_verse: I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. But you have forgotten me, your Lord and Creator. All day long you were afraid of those who were angry and hoped to oppress you. Where are they now?
translation_verse: ni ohĩe kpaä Iehowa moni feo le̱, moni lē̱ ṅwei mli ni eto šikpoṅ le̱ šiši le̱ no̱? ni ohe kpokpoo̱ dā dšenamo̱ ye̱ haolo̱ le̱ grimo̱ le̱ hewo̱, kē̱ ēsä ehe ní ebafite le̱? Ši nẽgbe̱ haolo̱ le̱ grimo̱ le̱ ye̱ po?

english_verse: Everyone crying out in pain will be quickly set free; they will be rescued from the power of death and never go hungry.
translation_verse: Aafẽne gbokle̱fonyo le̱ oyá, ni egboṅ ni eete bu le̱ mli, ni ebolo hũ ebo̱ṅle̱.

english_verse: I have told you what to say, and I will keep you safe in the palm of my hand. I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. Now I say, “Jerusalem, your people are mine.” A Warning to Jerusalem
translation_verse: ni mike̱ miwiemo̱i le̱ ewo odāṅ, ni *mike̱ minine hō̃ṅ le̱ eha ono̱, koni mate̱o ṅwei, ni mato šikpoṅ lo̱ šiši, ni makē̱ Zion ake̱: Mimaṅ dšio! *

english_verse: Not one of your many children is there to guide you or to offer a helping hand.
translation_verse: Ebihĩĩ fẽ ní efo̱ le ateṅ mokomoko be̱ ní aatšõle̱ gbe̱, ebihĩĩ fẽ ni elè̱ le̱ ateṅ mokomoko be̱ ni aamõ enine mli.

english_verse: The Lord your God is angry, and on every street corner your children lie helpless, like deer trapped in nets.
translation_verse: Obii le̱ eto̱ *biti; ame̱kãmo̱kãmo̱ ši ye̱ blohũi le̱ fẽ akodši ano̱ tamo̱ bāyelo̱ ní adūle̱ ye̱ tšõne mli, ni ame̱yimo̱ obõbõ ke̱ Iehowa mlila ke̱ o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ kāmo̱ le̱. *Yāfó

english_verse: You are in trouble and drunk, but not from wine. So pay close attention
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo ni onii yo̱ mo̱bo̱, bo ni oto̱, ši dšee ke̱ wein, bo ene̱ toi!

english_verse: to the Lord your God, who defends you and says, “I have taken from your hands the cup filled with my anger that made you drunk. You will never be forced to drink it again.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni o-Nuṅtšo̱, Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱, moni yeo̱ emaṅ le̱ sane le̱, kē̱ ne̱: Na, mihe *didãmo̱ kpulu le̱ ye̱ odeṅ ke̱ mimlila kpulu le̱ hũ, ni onuṅ doṅṅ; *K.

english_verse: Instead I will give it to your brutal enemies, who treated you like dirt and walked all over you.”
translation_verse: ši mike̱-awo mei ní haoo̱ bo le̱ adeṅ, mei ni kē̱o̱ osusuma ake̱: *Kotomo̱ ši, koni wo̱tšṍ ono̱! ni oke̱ okotose̱ ſõ ši tamo̱ šikpoṅ lo tamo̱ gbe̱dšegbe̱ ní anyieo̱ no̱ le̱! *Lal.

english_verse: Long ago you went to Egypt where you lived as foreigners. Then Assyria was cruel to you,
translation_verse: Ši bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Tšutšu le̱ mimaṅ le̱ yiṅ ke̱-te Mizraim ní eyato gbo̱ ye̱ dše̱i; ni Ašur hũ wale̱ yi yakatſā.

english_verse: and now another nation has taken you prisoner for no reason at all. Your leaders groan with pain, and day after day my own name is cursed.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ agbe̱ne̱, meni mifeo̱ ye̱ bie̱? Iehowa kē̱, beni aṅõ mimaṅ le̱ ke̱-te yakatſā le̱; eno̱yelo̱i le̱ mīblo̱ so̱ṅṅ, Iehowa kē̱, ni dā dšetše̱remo̱ lo̱ *awieo̱ musubō̱ wiemo̱ ašio̱ wigbe̱i lo̱. *Ezek.

english_verse: What a beautiful sight! On the mountains a messenger announces to Jerusalem, “Good news! You're saved. There will be peace. Your God is now King.”
translation_verse: Kwe̱ bo̱ni *sanekpakpadšadšelo̱ ní šie̱o̱ hedšo̱le̱ le̱, sanekpakpadšadšelo̱ ní sie̱o̱ yiwalaheremo̱ le̱ nãdši yo̱ fe̱o ye̱ gõdši le̱ ano̱, moni kē̱o̱ Zion ake̱: †O-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ yeo̱ maṅtše̱ le! *Nah.

english_verse: Everyone on guard duty, sing and celebrate! Look! You can see the Lord returning to Zion.
translation_verse: *Obulo̱i le̱ agbẽ ne̱: Ame̱fẽ-tſẽm ame̱ahole ame̱gbēi ano̱ ame̱ala; edšake̱ hĩe ke̱ hĩe ame̱ana bo̱ni Iehowa aakpale Zion ke̱-aba ekoṅ le̱. *

english_verse: Jerusalem, rise from the ruins! Join in the singing. The Lord has given comfort to his people; he comes to your rescue.
translation_verse: Nyefẽ-tfẽm nyewoa nyã́mo̱ lala, nye Ierusalem tšũkói, edšake̱ Iehowa eše̱dše emaṅ le̱ mī, ekpõ Ierusalem!

english_verse: The Lord has shown all nations his mighty strength; now everyone will see the saving power of our God. A Command To Leave Babylon
translation_verse: Iehowa *edšie enine kroṅkroṅ le̱ he ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ fẽ ahĩe, koni šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbēhei le̱ fẽ ana wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ yiwalaheremo̱ le̱. *

english_verse: The Lord says: My servant will succeed! He will be given great praise and the highest honors.
translation_verse: Na, *mitšũlo̱ le̱ aafe enii nilē mli: aawó eno̱, ni eekwo̱ godšō, ni aawo ehĩe nyam babaō! *

english_verse: Many were horrified at what happened to him. But everyone who saw him was even more horrified because he suffered until he no longer looked human.
translation_verse: Take̱ bo̱ni mei pī ahe dšõ ame̱he ye̱ ohewo̱ le̱, — edšake̱ ehĩe efite ni etamo̱o̱ gbomo nõ, ni esubãṅ tamo̱o̱ gbomeiabii anõ, —

english_verse: All of us were like sheep that had wandered off. We had each gone our own way, but the Lord gave him the punishment we deserved.
translation_verse: Wo̱fẽ-tſẽm *wo̱dũ gbe̱ tamo̱ toi, mofẽmo eko̱ le̱dientše̱ egbe̱; ši Iehowa hã †wo̱fẽ wo̱nõša le̱ bakã eno̱. *

english_verse: He was painfully abused, but he did not complain. He was silent like a lamb being led to the butcher, as quiet as a sheep having its wool cut off.
translation_verse: Afele̱ niseniianii, ši kẽle̱ eba ehe ši, ni egblee edăṅ, tamo̱ tōgwanteṅbi ni ake̱le̱ yaä ayagbele̱, lo tamo̱ tōgwanteṅ feo̱ diē ye̱ ehetšo̱ikulo̱i ahĩe, ni egblee edāṅ. Ioh.

english_verse: He was condemned to death without a fair trial. Who could have imagined what would happen to him? His life was taken away because of the sinful things my people had done.
translation_verse: Haomo̱ ke̱ kodšomo̱ mli aṅõle̱ ke̱-dše̱ ke̱-te; ši eyino̱bii le̱ ateṅ namo dſẽṅo̱ he ake̱ ašale̱ ke̱-dše̱ hĩekãlo̱i ašikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ke̱-te? Mimaṅ le̱ no̱tõmo̱i le̱ ahewo̱ apĩle̱!

english_verse: He wasn't dishonest or violent, but he was buried in a tomb among cruel, rich people.
translation_verse: Ni ahãle̱ egbonyobu ye̱ efõṅfelo̱i ateṅ, ši egbĕle se̱ le̱ niiatše̱ eke̱-hĩ ši, edšake̱ *ewako moko yi, ni apasa ko be̱ edāṅ. *

english_verse: By suffering, the servant will learn the true meaning of obeying the Lord. Although he is innocent, he will take the punishment for the sins of others, so that many of them will no longer be guilty.
translation_verse: Esusuma haomo̱ le̱ hewo̱ le̱ eena nii ní aahã etšui anyõ emli; enilē nā le̱ mitšũlo̱ dšalo̱ le̱ aaná *dšale̱ ahã mei pī, ni †eetĕre ame̱nišaianii le̱. *Rom.

english_verse: The Lord will reward him with honor and power for sacrificing his life. Others thought he was a sinner, but he suffered for our sins and asked God to forgive us.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ mahãle̱ egbe̱fãṅnõ ye̱ mei agboi ateṅ, ni eke̱ hewalo̱i aadša hānii; edšake̱ eṅõ esusuma ewo gbĕle mli, ni *abule̱ aši no̱tõlo̱i ano̱, ni etĕre mei babaō ahe eša, ni †edamo̱ mli ehã no̱tõlo̱i. *Mar.

english_verse: You and your descendants will take over the land of other nations. You will settle in towns that are now in ruins.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ oolē̱ omli ke̱-ate ninedšŭrõ ke̱ abe̱ku, ni oseši le̱ aaye dšeṅmãdši le̱ ano̱, ni ame̱ahe ši ye̱ amaṅfõi le̱ amli.

english_verse: Don't be afraid or ashamed and don't be discouraged. You won't be disappointed. Forget how sinful you were when you were young; stop feeling ashamed for being left a widow.
translation_verse: Kāše gbeyei, ši ohĩe gboṅ, ni kāhã ohĩe mīſie ši, ši agbeṅ ohĩe doṅṅ; ši ohĩe aakpa oblayeiaṅ hĩegbële le̱ no̱, ni *okũlafemo̱ mli heguo̱gbē le̱ okaiṅ doṅṅ! *Ier.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the Holy God of Israel, rules all the earth. He is your Creator and husband, and he will rescue you.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *owù dši ofelo̱ le̱: Iehowa Zebaot dši egbe̱i; ni okpõlo̱ dši Israel Mokroṅkroṅ le̱: aatšé̱le̱ šikpoṅ le̱ fẽ Nyoṅmo̱! *Hos.

english_verse: I rejected you for a while, but with love and tenderness I will embrace you again.
translation_verse: Hĩṅmeitſā ke̱ke̱ mikwao, ši mũsũṅtšõle̱i kplei mike̱-abua onā. Lal.

english_verse: Every mountain and hill may disappear. But I will always be kind and merciful to you; I won't break my agreement to give your nation peace. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ši gõdši le̱ aatši aya, ni goṅkpo̱i le̱ hũ aagbēgbē ši, ši mimlihĩle̱ le̱ tšiṅ ke̱-dšeṅ ono̱, ni *mihedšo̱le̱ kpãṅmo̱ le̱ hũ egbẽṅ ši, Iehowa, moni mũsũṅ tšōo̱le̱ ye̱ ohe le̱, kē̱. *Ezek.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are sad and discouraged, tossed around in a storm. But I, the Lord, will rebuild your city with precious stones; for your foundation I will use blue sapphires.
translation_verse: Bo ní onii yo̱ mo̱bo̱ ní ahum tſaäo ni aše̱dšee omī! Na, mi le̱, ma-tſa ote̱i le̱ ke̱ wulamo̱, ni mato ošiši ke̱ safiro-te̱i;

english_verse: Your fortresses will be built of rubies, your gates of jewels, and your walls of gems.
translation_verse: ni maṅõ rubi-te̱i mafe ogbogboi le̱ ayiteaṅ, ni ogboi le̱ mike̱ karfuṅkle-te̱i aafe, ni ohũsũi le̱ ano̱ fẽ le̱ te̱i fe̱fe̱dši so̱ṅṅ; Kpods.

english_verse: I will teach your children and make them successful.
translation_verse: ni obii le̱ fẽ aafe *Iehowa kaselo̱i, ni mahã obii le̱ hedšo̱le̱ babaō. *Ioh.

english_verse: You will be built on fairness with no fears of injustice; every one of your worries will be taken far from you.
translation_verse: Aaṅõo amã ši ye̱ dšale̱ mli: oke̱ yiwale̱ teṅ aadšeke̱, ni ošeṅ gbeyei, oke̱ hekpokpomo̱ hũ teṅ aadšeke̱, ni ebe̱ṅke̱ṅo.

english_verse: I will never send anyone to attack your city, and you will make prisoners of those who do attack.
translation_verse: Na, ké̱ ame̱ke̱o bé le̱, dšee mi edše̱, mofẽmo ní ke̱o aabé le̱, aagbe ši! Rom.

english_verse: Don't forget that I created metalworkers who make weapons over burning coals. I also created armies that can bring destruction.
translation_verse: Na, mi mibo̱ sõlo̱ ni hūo̱ ṅãi-ke̱-la, ni esõo̱ tawūnii ye̱ enitšumo̱ le̱ mli le̱; ni mi noṅṅ mibo̱ fitelo̱ hũ, koni ekpãtã hĩe.

english_verse: Weapons made to attack you won't be successful; words spoken against you won't hurt at all. My servants, Jerusalem is yours! I, the Lord, promise to bless you with victory.
translation_verse: Tawūnii ní asõo̱ ašio̱o le̱ eko eko nyẽṅ noko afe, ni lile̱i-fē-lile̱i ní aate ši ni eke̱o akodšo le̱, oobule̱ fo̱. Ene̱ dši Iehowa tšũdši le̱ agbošinii, ke̱ ame̱-dšale̱ ní dše̱ mideṅ, Iehowa kē̱!

english_verse: If you are thirsty, come and drink water! If you don't have any money, come, eat what you want! Drink wine and milk without paying a cent.
translation_verse: Hūi! nye mei fẽ ní kũmai yeo̱nye le̱, nyebaä nu he! ni mei ní be̱ šika hũ, nyebaä nyebahea ní nyeyea! Nyebaä nyebahea wein ke̱ fufo̱, ši dšee šika alo yinii anā! Ioh.

english_verse: Why waste your money on what really isn't food? Why work hard for something that doesn't satisfy? Listen carefully to me, and you will enjoy the very best foods.
translation_verse: Mẽba nyekaneo̱ šika nyeheo̱ noni dšee abolo, ni nyeke̱ nyenitšumo̱nii le̱ heo̱ noni eto̱o̱ mo? Nyeboami toi moṅ, ní nyeye nii kpakpai, ni nyesusuma mī aše̱ ye̱ fo̱nii ahe!
