english_verse: You will call out to nations you have never known. And they have never known you, but they will come running because I am the Lord, the holy God of Israel, and I have honored you. God's Words Are Powerful
translation_verse: Na, ootšé̱ dšeṅmaṅ ní olee ke̱-aba, ni dšeṅmaṅ ní leeo hũ aadšo foi ke̱-aba oṅõ, ye̱ Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ke̱ Israel Mokroṅkroṅ le̱ hewo̱, edšake̱ ewo ohĩe nyam!

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and your evil thoughts. Return to the Lord our God. He will be merciful and forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Hã ní *mofõṅ akwa egbè̱i le̱, ni nõšafelo̱ akwa edſẽṅmo̱i le̱, ni ekũ ese̱ ke̱-ba Iehowa ṅõ, ni emũsũṅ aatšõle̱ ye̱ ehewo̱, ke̱ wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ṅõ, ši †eke̱-afale̱ āhũ! *Ezek.

english_verse: Just as the heavens are higher than the earth, my thoughts and my ways are higher than yours.
translation_verse: ši bo̱ni ṅwei kwo̱ fè šikpoṅ le̱, nakai migbè̱i le̱ kwo̱ fē nyegbè̱i le̱, ni *midſẽṅmo̱i le̱ hũ kwo̱ fē nyedſẽṅmo̱i le̱! *Lal.

english_verse: “Rain and snow fall from the sky. But they don't return without watering the earth that produces seeds to plant and grain to eat.
translation_verse: Ši tamo̱ bo̱ni nyoṅmo̱ne̱mo̱ ke̱ snō dše̱o̱ ṅwei ſieo̱ ši, ni ekũũ ese̱ ke̱-yaa dše̱i doṅṅ, ake̱ dša ehã šikpoṅ le̱ nu, ni ehã eba nii ni ewo yibii, ni eke̱ dũmo̱nii ehã nidũlo̱ ni eke̱ niyenii hũ ehã moni yeo̱ le̱:

english_verse: That's how it is with my words. They don't return to me without doing everything I send them to do.” God's People Will Celebrate
translation_verse: nakai miwiemo̱ ni dše̱o̱ midāṅ le̱ hũ aafe: ekũṅ ese ke̱-baṅ miṅõ eflo, ši moṅ eefe noni sa mihĩe le̱, ni eehã noni mitšũle̱ ye̱ hewo̱ le̱ aya no̱! Mat.

english_verse: When you are set free, you will celebrate and travel home in peace. Mountains and hills will sing as you pass by, and trees will clap.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nyeadše kpo ke̱ nyã́mo̱, ni aakplanye ke̱-adše kpo ye̱ hedšo̱le̱ mli. *Gõdši le̱ ke̱ ṅmeṅmei le̱ aawó nyã́mo̱ lala no̱ ye̱ nyehĩe, ni ṅãno̱ tšei le̱ fẽ aatſa ame̱dẽ. *

english_verse: Cypress and myrtle trees will grow in fields once covered by thorns. And then those trees will stand as a lasting witness to the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Se̱se̱o aakwẽ ye̱ ṅmeitšo nãdšiaṅ, ni mirtotšo hũ aakwẽ ye̱ aklati nãdšiaṅ; ni eetšṍ gbe̱i ehã Iehowa ke̱ nāno̱ okadi hũ ní afiteṅ.

english_verse: Foreigners who worship me must not say, “The Lord won't let us be part of his people.” Men who are unable to become fathers must no longer say, “We are dried-up trees.”
translation_verse: Ni *gbo̱ ní ke̱ ehe ebakpe̱te̱ Iehowa le̱ akakē̱ ake̱: Iehowa badšiemi ke̱-dše̱ emaṅ le̱ mli; ni †osai hũ akakē̱ ake̱: Na, mi le̱, tšo gbĩṅ dšimi! *

english_verse: To them, I, the Lord, say: Respect the Sabbath, obey me completely, and keep our agreement.
translation_verse: Ši bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Osaii ni yeo̱ mihedšō̱mo̱gbĩĩ le̱, ní ame̱halaä nii ní sa mihĩe le̱, ní ame̱mõe̱ mikpãṅmo̱ le̱ mli le̱:

english_verse: Then you will be like monuments in my temple with your names written on them. This will be much better than having children, because these monuments will stand there forever.
translation_verse: mahãame̱ kaimo̱nõ ke̱ gbe̱i ní hĩ fè bihĩĩ ke̱ biyei ye̱ miwe le̱ ke̱ migbo-gboi le̱ amli; mahãame̱ nāno̱ gbe̱i ní fiteṅ!

english_verse: I will bring them to my holy mountain, where they will celebrate in my house of worship. Their sacrifices and offerings will always be welcome on my altar. Then my house will be known as a house of worship for all nations.
translation_verse: ame̱ hũ mike̱ame̱ aaba migoṅ kroṅkroṅ le̱ no̱, ni mahã amenyã́ ye̱ miso̱lemo̱we le̱: ame̱šã-afo̱lei ke̱ ame̱gbē-afo̱lei le̱ aasa mihĩe ye̱ mifo̱lešālate̱ le̱ no̱; edšake̱ *miwe le̱, aatšé̱le̱ so̱lemo̱ we ahã mãdšimãdši fẽ. *Mar.

english_verse: You leaders of Israel should be watchdogs, protecting my people. But you can't see a thing, and you never warn them. Dozing and daydreaming are all you ever do.
translation_verse: *Ebulo̱i le̱, ſilafoi dšiame̱, ame̱fẽ-tſẽm ame̱lee nokonoko; ame̱fẽ le̱, gbēi mumuii dšiame̱, amenyẽẽ ame̱blo̱; wo mli wielo̱i ni, ame̱kãmoo̱ ši, ni ame̱sumoo̱ wo̱dōiwo̱. *

english_verse: You stupid leaders are a pack of hungry and greedy dogs that never get enough. You are shepherds who mistreat your own sheep for selfish gain.
translation_verse: Ni gbēi le̱ fulo̱i ni, ame̱lee mito̱! Ni mene̱mei hũ tōkwe̱lo̱i ni, ši ame̱be̱ dſẽṅmo̱; ame̱fẽ ame̱kŏ̱lo̱ ame̱gbē̱i, *mofẽmo mitao ese̱námo̱ ye̱ hefẽhe. *Ier.

english_verse: You say to each other, “Let's drink till we're drunk! Tomorrow we'll do it again. We'll really enjoy ourselves.”
translation_verse: Ame̱kē̱o̱ ake̱: “Nyebaä, miyawó wein ke̱-ba, ní wo̱nu dā̃ babaō, ni wó̱ hũ aafe tamo̱ ṅme̱ne̱ noṅṅ, gbĩ wulu ní da *ke̱-teke ne̱!” *Abe̱i

english_verse: You people are unfaithful! You go to fortunetellers, and you worship idols. Now pay close attention!
translation_verse: Ši nye le̱, nyetšia nyebaä bie̱, nye klamo̱foi abii, *gblãfltelo̱ ke̱ yō adſamaṅ sešibii! *Mat.

english_verse: Who are you making fun of? Who are you sneering at? Look how your sins have made fools of you.
translation_verse: Namo he fe̱o nyeyeo̱ ne̱? namo nyegbe̱ nyedāṅ hatō nyewo, ni nyekpã nyelile̱ii amli ne̱? Ani dšee no̱tõmo̱-ſĩei ke̱ amale-sešibii dšinye?

english_verse: You have chosen to worship idols made of stone; you have given them offerings of wine and grain. Should I be pleased?
translation_verse: Fāi anā fo̱bite̱i amli ogbe̱nā yo̱, nomei dši ogbe̱fãṅnõ; nomei noṅṅ ofo̱seo̱ dā̃-afo̱le ni ošãa niyenii-afo̱le ohãa. Aso mitšui aanyõ mimli ye̱ ene̱mei ahe?

english_verse: You have spread out your beds on the tops of high mountains, where you sacrifice to idols.
translation_verse: Goṅ groṅṅ ní kwo̱ no̱ oyaṅmẽ osā ye̱, dše̱i noṅṅ okwo̱ö̱ ke̱-yaä eyašãa afole.

english_verse: Even in your homes you have placed pagan symbols all around your huge beds. Yes, you have rejected me, sold yourselves to your lovers, and gone to bed with them.
translation_verse: Oke̱ okaime̱-okadii le̱ eto šĩnāi ke̱ šĩnātšei ase̱; ši odše mise̱ ogble, ni okwo̱, ni olē̱ osā le̱ mli, ni oke̱ame̱ ye nā; osumo̱ ame̱sā le̱ ni okwe̱.

english_verse: Did you forget about me and become unfaithful because you were more afraid of someone else? Have I been silent so long that you no longer fear me?
translation_verse: Ni namo hewo̱ otšui fãa lo ošeo̱ gbeyei, hewo̱ ni omaleo̱ ne̱? ni mi le̱ okaiimi ni oke̱-woo otšui mli? Aso dšee *diṅṅ mife ke̱-dše̱ tetēte po? ši mi le̱, ošeemi gbeyei! *Lal.

english_verse: You think you're so good, but I'll point out the truth.
translation_verse: Mi mibadšadše odšale̱ le̱ matšõ, ni onifemo̱nii le̱ hũ, onáṅ se̱ ko ye̱ mli.

english_verse: The Lord says, “Clear the road! Get it ready for my people.”
translation_verse: Ni eekē̱ ake̱: Nyedšea, nyedšea, nyedšadšea gbe̱ le̱, nyedšiea pampii le̱ ye̱ mimaṅ le̱ gbe̱ le̱ no̱!

english_verse: Our holy God lives forever in the highest heavens, and this is what he says: Though I live high above in the holy place, I am here to help those who are humble and depend only on me.
translation_verse: Ši *bo̱ni moni kwo̱ ní awó eno̱, ní eyo̱ dā, ní gbe̱i dši Mokroṅkroṅ le̱ kē̱ ne̱: Ṅwei šoṅṅ ke̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱ mihĩo̱; asaṅ †mike̱ moni tſiaä ši ke̱ do̱le̱ ni ebaä ehe ši ye̱ emumo̱ mli le̱ hĩo̱ ši, koni mahã hešibalo̱i amumo̱ aná wala hẽ, ní mei ní tſiaã ši ke̱ do̱le̱ le̱ atšui aná wala hẽ! *Lal.

english_verse: My people, I won't stay angry and keep on accusing you. After all, I am your Creator. I don't want you to give up in complete despair.
translation_verse: Ši *mibéṅ ke̱-yaṅ nāno̱, ni dšee dā mimli aawo la; edšake̱ kũle̱ mumo̱i ke̱ susumai ní mife le̱ aato̱ biti ye̱ mihĩe. *Lal.

english_verse: I know what you are like! But I will heal you, lead you, and give you comfort, until those who are mourning
translation_verse: Mina egbè̱i le̱ ni matšále̱, ni mawale̱, ni maše̱dše le̱ ke̱ eko̱mo̱yelo̱i le̱ amĩ ekoṅ.

english_verse: start singing my praises. No matter where you are, I, the Lord, will heal you and give you peace.
translation_verse: Mabo̱ nābui ayibii: Hedšo̱le̱, hedšo̱le̱ ahã moni yo̱ šoṅṅ ke̱ moni yo̱ kpakpa le̱, Iehowa kē̱, ni matšále̱! Ef.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, have promised that none who are evil will live in peace.
translation_verse: Hedšo̱le̱ ko be̱ hã meifõdši le̱, mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ kē̱.

english_verse: Shout the message! Don't hold back. Say to my people Israel: You've sinned! You've turned against the Lord.
translation_verse: Blo̱mo̱ wā: kāhã onā mība ši! Wó ogbē no̱ tamo̱ te̱tre̱mantre̱, ni odšadše *mimaṅ le̱ no̱tõmo̱i le̱ otšõame̱, ni otšõ Iakob we le ame̱he ešai le̱! *Mika

english_verse: You wonder why the Lord pays no attention when you go without eating and act humble. But on those same days that you give up eating, you think only of yourselves and abuse your workers.
translation_verse: [Ame̱kē̱o̱ ake̱:] “Mẽba wo̱hĩo̱ ṅmā̃, ni onaa le̱, ni wo̱waä wohe yi, ni olee le̱?” Na, nyeṅmā̃hĩle̱ gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ nyetšuo̱ nii, ni nyehaoo̱ nyenitšulo̱i fẽ!

english_verse: Share your food with everyone who is hungry; share your home with the poor and homeless. Give clothes to those in need; don't turn away your relatives.
translation_verse: Ani dšee no dši ake̱ oke̱ obolo akũma moni hõmo̱ yeo̱le̱, ni oṅõ ohĩafoi ní be̱ šihĩle̱he le̱ ke̱-ba owe, ni ké̱ ona moko ní nyie yayai le̱, ohale̱ mama, ni oke̱ ohe akatē bodientše̱ ohelo? Mat.

english_verse: Then your light will shine like the dawning sun, and you will quickly be healed. Your honesty will protect you as you advance, and the glory of the Lord will defend you from behind.
translation_verse: No le̱ *ola le̱ aadšidše take̱ dšetše̱remo̱, ni otšámo̱ le̱ hũ aafe oyá, ni odšale̱ le̱ aanyie ohĩe, Iehowa anumnyam le̱ aanyie ose̱. *K.

english_verse: When you beg the Lord for help, he will answer, “Here I am!” Don't mistreat others or falsely accuse them or say something cruel.
translation_verse: No le̱ *ootšé̱, ni Iehowa aahere no̱, ooblo̱, ni eekē̱ ake̱: Nami! Ke̱dši odšie gbokle̱ le̱ ke̱ wao ní ake̱-tšõo̱ mo ke̱ wiemo̱ fõṅ ke̱-dše̱ oteṅ, *

english_verse: Give your food to the hungry and care for the homeless. Then your light will shine in the dark; your darkest hour will be like the noonday sun.
translation_verse: ni oṅõ noni osusuma taoo̱ le̱ ohã moni hõmo̱ yeo̱le̱, ni ohã susuma ní nii yo̱ mo̱bo̱ le̱ hũ to̱ le̱: no le̱ ola le̱ aadšidše ye̱ duṅ mli, ni oduṅ kpī le̱ aatšṍ tamo̱ ſane.

english_verse: The Lord will always guide you and provide good things to eat when you are in the desert. He will make you healthy. You will be like a garden that has plenty of water or like a stream that never runs dry.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa aawao dāne̱, ní eehã osusuma ato ye̱ hei gbīdši, ni eehã owuiaṅ awa, ni ootšṍ *tamo̱ trom ní nu hoo̱ ye̱ mli, lo tamo̱ nuhĩṅme̱i ní nu kpaa ye̱ mli. *Ier.

english_verse: You will rebuild those houses left in ruins for years; you will be known as a builder and repairer of city walls and streets.
translation_verse: Ni omei le̱ aatſá blema tšũkói le̱, ni ootē blema yino̱i le̱ ašišitōi le̱ aši omãmo̱ ši; ni aatšé̱o afãbaṅsãlo̱, ke̱ moni dšeo̱ gbè̱i ní mei ahĩ dše̱i!

english_verse: But first, you must start respecting the Sabbath as a joyful day of worship. You must stop doing and saying whatever you please on this special day.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši otšĩ onane nā ye̱ *hedšō̱mo̱gbĩ le̱ no̱, ni okatšu otšuinānii ye̱ migbĩ kroṅkroṅ le̱ no̱, ni otšé̱ hedsō̱mo̱gbĩ le̱ ake̱ otsuihenõ, ke̱ Iehowa gbĩ kroṅkroṅ le̱ ake̱ onumnyam noko, ni owo ehĩe nyam, ni efee bodientše̱ ogbè̱i ano̱ nii, ni otšuu nii, ni owiee yaka wiemo̱i le̱: *

english_verse: Then you will truly enjoy knowing the Lord. He will let you rule from the highest mountains and bless you with the land of your ancestor Jacob. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: no le̱ omī aaše̱ ye̱ Iehowa he, ni mahã oye šikpoṅ no̱ hei groṅṅi le̱ ano̱, ni mahã oye otše̱ Iakob gbošinii le̱; edšake̱ Iehowa nābu ekē̱!

english_verse: Your sins are the roadblock between you and your God. That's why he doesn't answer your prayers or let you see his face.
translation_verse: Ši moṅ nyenišaianii le̱ dši nii ní gblaä nyeke̱ nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ teṅ, ni nyehe ešai le̱ dši nii ní etšĩ ehĩe ke̱-dše̱ nyehe, ni eboonye toi le̱.

english_verse: You falsely accuse others and tell lies in court; sin and trouble are the names of your children.
translation_verse: Moko be̱ ní wieo̱ ye̱ dšale̱ nā, ni moko be̱ hũ ní yeo̱ sane ye̱ ano̱kwale nā: aṅõo̱ hĩe afõo̱ yakayakanii ano̱, ni amaleo̱; ahĩeo̱ haomo̱ mũsũ ni afo̱ö̱ nõša!

english_verse: but you can't make clothes with those webs or hide behind them. You're sinful and brutal.
translation_verse: Ame̱kpãi le̱ ake̱-lòṅ atade, ni ame̱-nitšumo̱nii ehĩĩ ní moko ke̱-aha ebe; ame̱nitšumo̱i, nišai anitšumo̱i ni, ni niseniianifemo̱ ye̱ ame̱deṅ.

english_verse: You hurry off to do wrong or murder innocent victims. All you think about is sin; you leave ruin and destruction wherever you go.
translation_verse: Amenãdši šaä foi ke̱-yaä efõṅfemo̱, ni ame̱yeo̱ oyai ke̱ lá ní eye bem le̱ šiſiemo̱: ame̱dſẽṅmo̱i le̱, nõša dſẽṅmo̱i ni, fitemo̱ ke̱ hĩekpãtãmo̱ yo̱ ame̱tempõṅi le̱ ano̱. Rom.

english_verse: You don't know how to live in peace or to be fair with others. The roads you make are crooked; your followers cannot find peace. The People Confess Their Sins
translation_verse: Hedšo̱le̱ gbe̱ le ame̱lee, ni dšale̱ saneyeli be amenyiemo̱i amli, ame̱kõdõ ame̱gbè̱i le̱: mofẽmo ní nyieo̱ no̱ le̱ elee hedšo̱le̱.

english_verse: We feel our way along, as if we were blind; we stumble at noon, as if it were night. We can see no better than someone dead.
translation_verse: Wo̱gbugbūo̱ ši ye̱ gbogbo he tamo̱ ſilafoi, ni wo̱gbugbūo̱ ši tamo̱ mei ní be̱ hĩṅme̱ii; wo̱tĕ̱re̱o̱ ſane fintĩṅṅ, tamo̱ noni hĩe ebu; wo̱tamo̱ gbohĩĩ ye̱ hewalo̱i ateṅ.

english_verse: How often have we sinned and turned against you, the Lord God? Our sins condemn us! We have done wrong.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ wo̱no̱tõmo̱i le̱ fá tšõ ye̱ ohĩe, ni wo̱he ešai le̱ yeo̱ odase šio̱wo̱; edšake̱ wo̱no̱tõmo̱i le̱ dſere wo̱hĩe, ni wo̱nišaianii le̱ hũ wo̱le:

english_verse: We have rebelled and refused to follow you. Our hearts were deceitful, and so we lied; we planned to abuse others and turn our backs on you.
translation_verse: Wo̱tõ Iehowa no̱ ni wo̱kwale̱, ni wo̱kpale ye̱ wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ se̱; yiwale̱ ke̱ atũatšemo̱ wiemo̱i wo̱wieo̱, wo̱ná amale mũsũ ye̱ wo̱tšuiiaṅ ni wo̱dšiele̱ kpo.

english_verse: Injustice is everywhere; justice seems far away. Truth is chased out of court; honesty is shoved aside.
translation_verse: Ni akpale kodšomo̱ ke̱-te, ni dšale̱ hũ eyadamo̱ se̱ fle̱ṅṅ; edšake̱ ano̱kwale egbē ši ye̱ blohũ le̱ṅ, ni noni dša nyẽẽ mli abote;

english_verse: Everyone tells lies; those who turn from crime end up ruined. The Lord Will Rescue His People When the Lord noticed that justice had disappeared, he became very displeased.
translation_verse: ni ano̱kwale elādše, ni moni tšio̱ ehe ke̱-dše̱o̱ efõṅ he le̱, ahaäle̱. Ni Iehowa na, ni esaa ehĩe ake̱ kodšomo̱ be̱ le̱.

english_verse: It disgusted him even more to learn that no one would do a thing about it. So with his own powerful arm, he won victories for truth.
translation_verse: Ni ena ake̱ nū ko nū ko be̱, ni enā kpe̱ ehe ake̱ mlidamo̱lo̱ ko be̱ le̱: hewo̱ le̱ eke̱ le̱dientše̱ enine here eyiwala, ni edšale̱ le̱ ye buale̱

english_verse: Justice was the Lord's armor; saving power was his helmet; anger and revenge were his clothes.
translation_verse: Ni ewo dšale̱ ake̱ dama, ni ebu yiwalaheremo̱ dadefai ye̱ eyitšo, ni ewo oweletō̱-atade ake̱ hehānõ, ni eha hĩedō̱ ake̱ mama.

english_verse: Now the Lord will get furious and do to his enemies, both near and far, what they did to his people.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni ame̱fe le̱, nakai pe̱ ebafe eto nãdšiaṅ: emli aawo la awo mei ní ke̱le̱ ená le̱, eewo ehenye̱lo̱i le̱ anyõmo̱; ṅšo̱kpo̱i le̱, eewoame̱ nyõmo̱ eto nãdšiaṅ.

english_verse: He will attack like a flood in a mighty windstorm. Nations in the west and the east will then honor and praise his wonderful name.
translation_verse: Ni aaše Iehowa gbe̱i le̱ gbeyei ye̱ hũlũ šinyō̃he, ke̱ enumnyam le̱ hũ ye̱ hũlũ šitēhe; edšake̱ eeba tamo̱ fā ní atšĩ nā, ši Iehowa mumo̱ ní emũo̱ le̱ etši eyise̱.

english_verse: The Lord has promised to rescue the city of Zion and Jacob's descendants who turn from sin.
translation_verse: Ni eeba ake̱ kpõlo̱ ehã Zion ke̱ mei ní ekpale ke̱-dše̱ ne̱tõmo̱ he ye Iakob mli le, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: The Lord says: “My people, I promise to give you my Spirit and my message. These will be my gifts to you and your families forever. I, the Lord, have spoken.”
translation_verse: Ni mi le̱, ene̱ dši mike̱ame̱ kpãṅmo̱ le̱, Iehowa kē̱: Mimumo̱ ní yo̱ ono̱ le̱, ke̱ *miwiemo̱i le̱ ní mike̱-wo onā le̱, edšeṅ odāṅ ke̱ osešibii adāṅ ke̱ osešibii asešibii adāṅ, Iehowa kē̱, ke̱-dše̱ be ne̱ mli ke̱-yaši nāno̱! *Ier.

english_verse: Nations and kings will come to the light of your dawning day. Crowds Are Coming to Jerusalem The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ni dšeṅmãdši aanyie ke̱-aba *ola le̱ he, ni maṅtše̱mei aaba kpe̱mo̱ ní kpe̱o̱ ye̱ ono̱ le̱ he. *Kpods.

english_verse: Open your eyes! Look around! Crowds are coming. Your sons are on their way from distant lands; your daughters are being carried like little children.
translation_verse: Holemo̱ ohĩṅme̱ii ane̱ ní okwe̱ ohe ke̱-kpe: Ame̱fẽ ame̱bua ame̱he nā ke̱-mī-ba oṅõ! Obihĩĩ le̱ aadše̱ maṅse̱ šoṅṅ aba, ni obiyei le̱ hũ, aahĩeame̱ ye̱ ṅmãwuiaṅ ke̱-aba.

english_verse: When you see this, your faces will glow; your hearts will pound and swell with pride. Treasures from across the sea and the wealth of nations will be brought to you.
translation_verse: No le̱ oona, ni ohĩe aakpe̱ ke̱ mīše̱, otšui aakpokpo ni emli hũ aale; edšake̱ mei babaō aadše̱ ṅšo̱ṅ aba oṅõ, dšeṅmãdši le̱ ahewale̱ le̱ aaba oṅõ.

english_verse: Your country will be covered with caravans of young camels from Midian and Ephah. The people of Sheba will bring gold and spices in praise of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Yomai asafo yū aabua ohe kutū, ke̱ Midian ke̱ Efa yomai oblahĩĩ; ame̱-fẽ ame̱adše̱ *Šeba ame̱aba: ame̱ahĩe šika ke̱ kro̱bo̱o ke̱-aba, ni ame̱agba Iehowa yidšiemo̱ le̱. *Lal.

english_verse: On those distant islands your people are waiting for me, the Lord. Seagoing ships lead the way to bring them home with their silver and gold. I, the holy Lord God of Israel, do this to honor your people, so they will honor me. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt The Lord said:
translation_verse: Le̱le̱ṅ, ṅšo̱kpo̱i aakwe̱mi gbe̱, ni Taršiš le̱dši le̱ aatšṍ hĩe aba, koni ame̱-ke̱ obihĩĩ le̱ ke̱ ame̱dſie̱te̱i ke̱ ame̱šika adše̱ šoṅṅ aba, abahã Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, gbe̱i le̱, ke̱ Israel Mokroṅkroṅ le̱, edšake̱ ewo ohĩe nyam.

english_verse: Jerusalem, your city walls will be rebuilt by foreigners; their rulers will become your slaves. I punished you in my anger; now I will be kind and treat you with mercy.
translation_verse: Ni gbo̱iabii aatſa ogbogboi le̱, ni ame̱maṅtše̱mei le̱ aasúmo̱o; edšake̱ *mimliſũ mli miyio ye̱, ši mimlihĩle̱ nā le̱ mimũsũṅ etsōmi ye ohe. *

english_verse: Your gates will be open day and night to let the rulers of nations lead their people to you with all their treasures.
translation_verse: Ni ogbói le̱ anā aakãmo̱ befẽbe, ſane ke̱ nyōṅ fẽ le̱ aṅã́mo̱ṅ, koni ake̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ahewale̱ le̱ aba oṅõ, ni ekpla ame̱maṅtše̱mei le̱ ke̱-ba. Kpods.

english_verse: Any nation or kingdom that refuses to serve you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Ši dšeṅmaṅ alo maṅtše̱yeli ní súmo̱o̱o le̱ hĩe aakpãtã, ni nakai dšeṅmãdši le̱, fitemo̱ aafiteame̱.

english_verse: Wood from Lebanon's best trees will be brought to you— the pines, the firs, and the cypress trees. It will be used in my temple to make beautiful the place where I rest my feet.
translation_verse: Lebanon anumnyam le̱ aaba oṅõ; se̱se̱o ke̱ odum ke̱ tšei ní nyẽo̱ dšale̱ le̱ fẽ, koni awula mihekroṅkroṅ le̱, ni mawo minãdšianāmo̱he le̱ hĩe nyam.

english_verse: You were hated and deserted, rejected by everyone. But I will make you beautiful, a city to be proud of for all time to come.
translation_verse: Ye̱ kwa ní akwao ni anye̱o ni mokomoko tšṍṍ omli le̱ nãdšiaṅ le̱, mike̱o aafe nāno̱ anumnyam ke̱ yino̱i pī anyã́mo̱.

english_verse: You will drain the wealth of kings and foreign nations. You will know that I, the mighty Lord God of Israel, have saved and rescued you.
translation_verse: Ni oonu dšeṅmãdši afufo̱, ni ooye *maṅtše̱mei akpokuai, ni oole ake̱ mi, Iehowa, dši oyiwalaherelo̱, ni okpõlo̱ dši Iakob hewalo̱ le̱. *

english_verse: I will bring bronze and iron in place of wood and stone; in place of bronze and iron, I will bring gold and silver. I will appoint peace and justice as your rulers and leaders.
translation_verse: Akō̱ble nãdšiaṅ le̱ mike̱ šika aaba, ni dade nãdšiaṅ le̱ mike̱ dſie̱te̱i aaba, ni tšei anãdšiaṅ le̱ akō̱ble, ni te̱i anãdšiaṅ le̱ dade; ni maṅõ *hedšo̱le̱ mafe ono̱yelo̱i, ni maṅõ dšale̱ mafe onukpai. *

english_verse: Violence, destruction, and ruin will never again be heard of within your borders. “Victory” will be the name you give to your walls; “Praise” will be the name you give to your gates.
translation_verse: Anuṅ yiwale̱ he doṅṅ ye̱ ošikpoṅ le̱ no̱, anuṅ fitemo̱ lo hĩekpãtãmo̱ he doṅṅ ye̱ ohũsũi le̱ amli, ši ootšē̱ yiwalaheremo̱ ake̱ *ogbogboi, ni ootšé̱ yidšiemo̱ ake̱ ogbói. *

english_verse: You won't need the light of the sun or the moon. I, the Lord your God, will be your eternal light and bring you honor.
translation_verse: Dšee *hũlũ batšṍ ola ſane doṅṅ, ni asaṅ dšee nyoṅtšĕre bakpe̱ ní dšeṅ atše ahão; ši moṅ Iehowa aatšṍ ola ke̱-ate nāno̱, ni o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ aatšṍ onumnyam. *

english_verse: Your sun will never set or your moon go down. I, the Lord, will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will come to an end.
translation_verse: Ohũlũ le̱ enyõṅ ši doṅṅ, ni onyoṅtšĕre le̱ hũ gboṅ; edšake̱ Iehowa aatšṍ ola ke̱-ate nāno̱, ni oko̱mo̱yeli gbĩĩ le̱ hũ se̱ aafo.

english_verse: Your people will live right and always own the land; they are the trees I planted to bring praise to me.
translation_verse: Ni omaṅ mū le̱ fẽ aatšṍmo̱ dšalo̱i so̱ṅṅ; ame̱aye šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ke̱-ate nāno̱, ame̱dši miṅmõ le̱ mli tšonine ni fro̱keo̱ ke̱ mininenã nĩtšumo̱ ni ake̱-awo mihĩe nyam.

english_verse: Even the smallest family will be a powerful nation. I am the Lord, and when the time comes, I will quickly do all this.
translation_verse: Mo bibiō ko aatšṍ mei akpe, ni mo fio hũ aatšṍ maṅ ní wa: Ké̱ še̱ ebe le̱, mi, Iehowa, mahã afe oyá!

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord God has taken control of me! The Lord has chosen and sent me to tell the oppressed the good news, to heal the brokenhearted, and to announce freedom for prisoners and captives.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa Mumo̱ le̱ ye̱ mino̱, edšake̱ Iehowa efo̱mi mũ, koni mišie̱ sanekpakpa le̱ mitšõ ohĩafoi; etšũmi koni mibatšá mei ni ame̱-tšuii ekumo̱ le̱, ní midšadse heyeli mitšõ nomi le̱, ni midšadše gblemo̱ mitšõ mei ni awoame̱ tšũṅ le̱; Mat.

english_verse: Then they will rebuild cities that have been in ruins for many generations.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱atſa blema tšũkói le̱, ni ame̱asā tšutšubii le̱ amaṅfõi le̱, ni ame̱ato mãdši ní efite le̱ ehē ekoṅ, ní dši yino̱i pī ano̱ amaṅfõi le̱.

english_verse: They will hire foreigners to take care of their sheep and their vineyards.
translation_verse: Ni maṅse̱bii aadamo̱ ši ni ame̱alè̱ nyetōi le̱, ni meikpõdši aatšṍmo̱ nyehũlo̱i ke̱ nyeweintromsălo̱i.

english_verse: But they themselves will be priests and servants of the Lord our God. The treasures of the nations will belong to them, and they will be famous.
translation_verse: Ši nye le̱, aatšenye Iehowa *oso̱foi, ni aakē̱nye ake̱: Wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ súolo̱i dšinye; nyeaye dšeṅmãdši le̱ anii, ni ame̱numnyam le̱ aatšṍ nyenõ. *

english_verse: They were terribly insulted and horribly mistreated; now they will be greatly blessed and joyful forever. The Lord Loves Justice
translation_verse: Nyehĩegbĕle le̱ nãdšiaṅ le̱ aakũ abo̱ he toi enyo̱ ahãnye, ni hĩešiſiemo̱ le̱ nãdšiaṅ le̱ ame̱ala nyã́mo̱ lala ye̱ ame̱gbe̱fãṅnõ le̱ hewo̱; nohewo̱ le̱ ame̱ana *toi enyo̱ ye̱ ame̱šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni nãno̱ mīše̱ aaṅõ-hàame̱. *

english_verse: I, the Lord, love justice! But I hate robbery and injustice. My people, I solemnly promise to reward you with an eternal agreement.
translation_verse: Ši mi, Iehowa le̱, misumoo̱ dšale̱ saneyeli, minye̱o̱ odšotſā ke̱ nõšafemo̱, ni mawoame̱ nyõmo̱ ye̱ ano̱kwale mli, ni mike̱ame̱ aakpãṅ *nāno̱ kpãṅmo̱. *

english_verse: Your descendants will be known in every nation. All who see them will realize that they have been blessed, by me, the Lord. Celebrate and Shout
translation_verse: Ni aale ame̱sešibii le̱ ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ ke̱ ame̱ſĩeii hũ ye̱ mãdšimãdsi le̱ ateṅ; mei fẽ ní aanaame̱ le̱ aayoame̱ ake̱ ame̱dši seši ni Iehowa edšō̱.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because of my Lord God. His saving power and justice are the very clothes I wear. They are more beautiful than the jewelry worn by a bride or groom.
translation_verse: Manyã́ ye̱ Iehowa mli, ni misusuma mli aaflile̱ ye̱ mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ mli; edšake̱ ewomi *yiwalaheremo̱ atadei, ni eke̱ dšale̱ mama ehami, tamo̱ bo̱ni ayemforowu wulaä ehe ke̱ oso̱fo fai, lo bo̱ni ayemforo woo̱ dſinei le̱. *Mat.

english_verse: The Lord will bring about justice and praise in every nation on earth, like flowers blooming in a garden.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ take̱ bo̱ni šikpoṅ le̱ baä enii ní kwẽo̱ le̱, ni trom hãa nii ní adũ ye̱ mli le̱ kwẽo̱ le̱: nakai Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa aahã dšale̱ ke̱ yidšĩemo̱ akwẽ ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ fẽ ahĩe.

english_verse: Jerusalem, I will speak up for your good. I will never be silent till you are safe and secure, sparkling like a flame.
translation_verse: Zion hewo̱ le̱ mimũaṅ minā, ni Ierusalem hewo̱ le̱ mĩdšō̱ṅ mihe, ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní edšale̱ le̱ aadše kpo tamo̱ dsetše̱remo̱ kpe̱mo̱, ni eyiwalaheremo̱ aatšo tamo̱ ko̱ti.

english_verse: Your name will no longer be “Deserted and Childless,” but “Happily Married.” You will please the Lord; your country will be his bride.
translation_verse: Atšé̱ṅo *“moni akwale̱” doṅṅ, ni ošikpoṅ le̱ hũ, atšé̱ṅle̱ “amaṅfõ” doṅṅ, ši moṅ aatšé̱o ake̱ †“mitšuihe gbomo”, ke̱ ošikpoṅ le̱ hŭ ake̱ “kpēmo̱yō”; edšake̱ Iehowa ená ohe tšuidšŭrõ, ni ošikpoṅ le̱ hũ, aakpēle̱. *

english_verse: Your people will take the land, just as a young man takes a bride. The Lord will be pleased because of you, just as a husband is pleased with his bride.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ take̱ bo̱ni oblanyo kpēo̱ oblayō le̱, nakai noṅṅ obii le̱ aakpẽo; ni tamo̱ bo̱ni ayemforowu nyã́a eyemforo he le̱, nakai o-Nyoṅmo le aanyã́ ohe. Zef.

english_verse: Jerusalem, on your walls I have stationed guards, whose duty it is to speak out day and night, without resting. They must remind the Lord
translation_verse: Mito *bulo̱i ye̱ ogbogboi le̱ ano̱, Ierusalem; ſane ke̱ nyōṅ fẽ le̱ ame̱mũaṅ ame̱nā; nye mei ní nyekaio̱ Iehowa le̱, nyekadšō̱a nyehe! *

english_verse: and not let him rest till he makes Jerusalem strong and famous everywhere.
translation_verse: ni nyekahãale̱ hedšō̱mo̱, ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní eeṅõ Ierusalem emã ši, ni eehã etšṍ yidšiemo̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱!

english_verse: The Lord has given his word and made this promise: “Never again will I give to your enemies the grain and grapes for which you struggled.
translation_verse: Iehowa ekã eninedšŭrõ ke̱ ehewale̱ nine le̱ kitã ake̱: Le̱le̱ṅ ake̱ mike̱ oble le̱ hãṅ ohenye̱lo̱i yeṅ doṅṅ, ni maṅse̱bii enuṅ owein ní ogbo he deṅme le̱ doṅṅ!

english_verse: Here is what the Lord has said for all the earth to hear: “Soon I will come to save the city of Zion and to reward you.
translation_verse: Na, Iehowa ehã ašie̱ ke̱-te šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbēhe le̱ ake̱: *Nyekē̱a Zion biyō le̱ ake̱: Na, oyiwalaheremo̱ le̱ miba! na, ehĩe †enyõmo̱wo ke̱-mība, ni enãdšiaṅtō le̱ nyie ehĩe! *Zak.

english_verse: Then you will be called, ‘The Lord's Own People, The Ones He Rescued!’ Your city will be known as a good place to live and a city full of people.”
translation_verse: Ni aatšé̱ame̱ ake̱ “maṅ kroṅkroṅ”, *“mei ní Iehowa ekpõame̱”; ni bo hũ aatšē̱o “moni ataoo̱ ese̱gbe̱”, “maṅ ní akwaṅle̱ doṅṅ”. *

english_verse: “I alone trampled the grapes! None of the nations helped. I trampled nations in my anger and stained my clothes with their blood.
translation_verse: “Weinṅãnõ le̱, mikomelõ minã no̱, ni mãdšimãdši ano̱ bii le̱ eko fataa mihe; minānā ame̱no̱ ye̱ mimlifũ le̱ṅ, ni mišimo̱ ame̱no̱ hũ ye̱ mimlila le̱ṅ, ni ame̱mlinu le̱ etšẽṅe ewo mitadei le̱ amli, ni ewú mitade le̱ mli fẽ. Kpods.

english_verse: I did this because I wanted to take revenge— the time had come to rescue my people.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ oweletō̱ gbĩ ko ye̱ mitšuiṅ, ni mikpõmo̱ afi le̱ eše̱.

english_verse: I will tell about the kind deeds the Lord has done. They deserve praise! The Lord has shown mercy to the people of Israel; he has been kind and good.
translation_verse: Matšī Iehowa mlihĩle̱ le̱ ke̱ Iehowa yidšiemo̱ le̱ tã matšõ, ye̱ nibii fẽ ni Iehowa efe ehãwo̱ le̱ ke̱ edšŭrõ pī ní efe Israel we le̱ ye̱ emũsũṅtšõle̱ ke̱ emlihĩle̱ ni fá le̱ nā le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: The Lord rescued his people, and said, “They are mine. They won't betray me.”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ekē̱ ake̱: Mimaṅ dšiame̱, ke̱ *bii ni pasaṅ! ni etšṍ ame̱yiwalaherelo̱. *

english_verse: It troubled the Lord to see them in trouble, and his angel saved them. The Lord was truly merciful, so he rescued his people. He took them in his arms and carried them all those years.
translation_verse: Ame̱haomo̱i le̱ fẽ mli le̱, le̱ hũ ehao; ni ehĩe *bo̱fo le̱ here ame̱yiwala: ekpõame̱ ye̱ esuomo̱ ke̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ hewo̱, ni eholeame̱ ni ehĩeame̱ ye̱ blemagbĩĩ le̱ fẽ mli. *

english_verse: Then the Lord's people turned against him and made his Holy Spirit sad. So he became their enemy and attacked them.
translation_verse: Ši ame̱ le̱, ame̱tše atũa, ni amefe Emumo̱ kroṅkroṅ le̱ nidō̱nĩi, hewo̱ le̱ etšṍ ame̱henye̱lo̱, ni le̱dientše̱ eke̱ame̱ wu.

english_verse: But his people remembered what had happened during the time of Moses. Didn't the Lord bring them and their leaders safely through the sea? Didn't he give them his Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni emaṅ le̱ kai Mose blema gbĩĩ le̱, ni ame̱kē̱: Nẽgbe̱ moni *dšieame̱ ke̱-dše̱ ṅšo̱ le̱ṅ ke̱ etōiku le̱ kwe̱lo̱ le̱ yo̱? Nẽgbe̱ moni ke̱ Emumo̱ kroṅkroṅ le̱ to ame̱teṅ le̱ yo̱? *

english_verse: The glorious power of the Lord marched beside Moses. The Lord will be praised forever for dividing the sea.
translation_verse: moni hã enumnyam nine le̱ nyie Mose ninedšŭrõ no̱ le̱? moni gba nui le̱ amli ye̱ ame̱hĩe ni eke̱-ná nāno̱ gbe̱i ehã ehe le̱?

english_verse: He led his people across like horses running wild without stumbling.
translation_verse: moni kplaame̱ ke̱-tšṍ bui ní mli kwŏ̱lo̱ le̱ amli tamo̱ okpo̱ṅo̱ ye̱ ṅãno̱, ní ame̱tĕ̱re̱e̱ le̱?

english_verse: His Spirit gave them rest, just as cattle find rest when led into a valley. The name of the Lord was praised for doing these things. A Prayer for Mercy and Help
translation_verse: Iehowa Mumo̱ le̱ hã ame̱dšō̱ amehe, tamo̱ koloi ní kplekeo ši ke̱-yaä dšō̱ mli: nakai okpla omaṅ le̱, ni oke̱-ná anumnyam gbe̱i ohã ohe!

english_verse: Please, Lord, look down from your holy and glorious home in the heavens and see what's going on. Have you lost interest? Where is your power? Show that you care about us and have mercy!
translation_verse: Mã oyi ši ke̱-dše̱ ṅwei ni odše̱ ohekroṅkroṅ ke̱ onumnyam šihĩle̱he le̱ okwe̱! Nẽgbe̱ ohĩedō̱ ke̱ ohewale̱ nitšumo̱i le̱ yo̱? otšuiṅšãle̱ ke̱ omũsũṅtšõle̱ babaō le̱, atšĩ nā ke̱-dše̱ mihe.

english_verse: Our ancestors Abraham and Jacob have both rejected us. But you are still our Father; you have been our protector since ancient times.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo kẽ dši wo̱tše̱: ši Abraham leewo̱, ni Israel hũ yoowo̱; bo, Iehowa, bo noṅṅ *dši wo̱-tše̱, wo̱kpõlo̱ dši ogbe̱i ke̱-dše̱ blema bēbe. *

english_verse: Why did you make us turn away from you, our Lord? Why did you make us want to disobey you? Please change your mind! We are your servants, your very own people.
translation_verse: Iehowa, mẽba ohãa wo̱dũo̱ gbe̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ ogbè̱i le̱ ano̱, ni owadšeo̱ wo̱tšui ní wo̱kašeo gbeyei le̱? Otšũdši le̱ ke̱ ono̱yelinõ le̱ akutšei le̱ ahewo̱ le̱, kũ ose̱!

english_verse: For a little while, your temple belonged to us; and now our enemies have torn it down.
translation_verse: Be fiō ke̱ke̱ omaṅ kroṅkroṅ le̱ ye no̱; — wo̱henye̱lo̱i le̱ enānā ohekroṅkroṅ le̱ no̱. Lal.

english_verse: We act as though you had never ruled us or called us your people.
translation_verse: Wo̱tšṍme̱ tamo̱ mei ní oyeko ame̱no̱ pẽṅ, ke̱ mei ni ake̱ ogbe̱i tšé̱koame̱!

english_verse: When you see these things, how can you just sit there and make us suffer more?
translation_verse: ] Iehowa, aso ene̱mei fẽ se̱ le̱ oosu ohe lo? oofe diṅṅ, ni oowawo̱ yi tũtu?

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will give food and drink to my servants, and they will celebrate. But all of you sinners will go hungry and thirsty, overcome with disgrace.
translation_verse: Hewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Na, mitšũdši le̱ aaye nii, ši nye le̱ hõmo̱ aayenye; na, mitšũdši le̱ *aanu nii, ši nye le̱, kũmai aayenye; na, mitšũdši le̱ aanyã́, ši nye le̱, nyehĩe aagboi; *

english_verse: My servants will laugh and sing, but you will be sad and cry out in pain.
translation_verse: na, mitšũdši le̱ aala ke̱ tšuidšŭrõ, ši nye le̱ nyeablo̱ ke̱ tšuiṅdo̱le̱, ni nyeke̱ mumo̱ ni ekũmo̱ aafo yõ̀!

english_verse: I, the Lord God, promise to see that you are killed and that my chosen servants use your names as curse words. But I will give new names to my servants.
translation_verse: Ni nyeašĩ nyegbe̱i nyehã mei ní mihala le̱ ní ame̱ke̱-lomo̱; ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa aagbeo, ni *eewo etšŭdši le̱ gbe̱i kroko: *

english_verse: I am creating new heavens and a new earth; everything of the past will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ na, mībo̱ ṅwei hē ke̱ šikpoṅ hē, ni akaiṅ tšutšunii le̱ doṅṅ, ni asaṅ ebaṅ dſẽṅmo̱ mli doṅṅ;

english_verse: No child will die in infancy; everyone will live a very long life. Anyone a hundred years old will be considered young, and to die younger than that will be considered a curse.
translation_verse: Fufo̱ō ko be̱ dše̱i ní aaye gbĩĩ fio ke̱ke̱, lo nūmo ko ní egbĩĩ še̱e̱; ši oblanyo aaye afii oha ni eegbo, ni ešafelo̱ ní ye afii oha pe̱ le̱, alomo̱le̱. Zak.

english_verse: My people will live in the houses they build; they will enjoy grapes from their own vineyards.
translation_verse: Ši ame̱mãmo̱ tšŭi, ni ame̱ahĩ mli, ni ame̱afe weintromi, ni ame̱aye mli yibii!

english_verse: No one will take away their homes or vineyards. My chosen people will live to be as old as trees, and they will enjoy what they have earned.
translation_verse: *Ame̱mãmo̱ṅ tšŭi, ní mokroko ahĩ mli, ni ame̱hũṅ hũ, ní mokroko aye; edšake̱ mimaṅ le̱ gbĩĩ aatamo̱ tšei agbĩĩ, ni mei ní mihala le̱ aaye ameninenā nitšumo̱ le̱ mli nii āhũ po. *

english_verse: Their work won't be wasted, and their children won't die of dreadful diseases. I will bless their children and their grandchildren.
translation_verse: Ame̱gboṅ deṅme yakatſā, ni ame̱fo̱ṅ ame̱hãṅ ošrã; edšake̱ mei ní Iehowa edšō̱ame̱ le̱ asešibii dšiame̱, ni ame̱ſĩei ke̱ame̱ aahĩ ši.

english_verse: I will answer their prayers before they finish praying.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱, dãni ame̱atšé̱mi le̱, mihere no̱; ni beni ame̱wieo̱ lolo le̱, mabo toi!

english_verse: Wolves and lambs will graze together; lions and oxen will feed on straw. Snakes will eat only dirt! They won't bite or harm anyone on my holy mountain. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: *Klaṅ ke̱ tōgwanteṅbi aaye nii ye̱ hekome, ni dšata aaye dſe̱i tamo̱ tšina; ni onũfũ le̱, sũ aafe eniyenii: ayeṅ awui ni akpãtãṅ hĩe doṅṅ ye̱ migoṅ kroṅkroṅ le̱ no̱ fẽ, Iehowa kē̱. *

english_verse: I have made everything; that's how it all came to be. I, the Lord, have spoken. The people I treasure most are the humble— they depend only on me and tremble when I speak.
translation_verse: Ši ene̱mei fẽ le̱, minine fe, ni nakai afe nii ne̱ fẽ, Iehowa ke̱. Ši moni *makwe̱ ne̱: moni nii yo̱ mo̱bo̱ ni emumo̱ tſiaä ši ke̱ do̱le̱, ni ehe kpokpoo̱ ye̱ miwiemo̱ le̱ nā le̱. *

english_verse: If you love Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! If you were in sorrow because of the city, you can now be glad.
translation_verse: Nyeke̱ Ierusalem anyã́a, ni nyemli aflianye ye̱ ehewo̱, nye mei fẽ ní nyesumoo̱le̱ le̱; nyeke̱le̱ anáa mīše̱, nye mei fē ní nyeyeo̱le̱ ṅko̱mo̱ le̱: Lal.

english_verse: The Lord has promised: “I will flood Jerusalem with the wealth of nations and make the city prosper. Zion will nurse you at her breast, carry you in her arms, and hold you in her lap.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Na, mado̱ hedšo̱le̱ yi ke̱-aba eno̱ tamo̱ fā, ke̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ anumnyam le̱ hũ tamo̱ nsutẽṅ ní eyi ke̱-teke no̱, ni nyeanu; ṅmãwuiaṅ aahĩenye ye̱, ni aahĩenye do̱dō̱do̱ ye̱ nakutšei ano̱.

english_verse: I will comfort you there like a mother comforting her child.”
translation_verse: Take̱ bo̱ni mo nye se̱dšeo̱ emī le̱, nakai noṅṅ mi hũ maše̱dše nyemī, ni nyemī aaše̱ nyehe ye̱ Ierusalem.

english_verse: When you see this happen, you will celebrate; your strength will return faster than grass can sprout. Then everyone will know that the Lord provides help for his servants, but he is angry with his enemies.
translation_verse: Ni nyeana, ni nyetšui aanyō nyemli, ni nyewui le̱ aafro̱ke tamo̱ dſe̱fo̱; ni aale Iehowa nine ní kã etšũdši ahe le̱, ke̱ emlifũ ní kã ehenye̱lo̱i ano̱ le̱.

english_verse: The Lord's fiery sword will bring justice everywhere on this earth and execute many people. A Threat and a Promise
translation_verse: Edšake̱ la Iehowa ke̱-bakodšo, ni eke̱ eklante hũ aakodšo helo fẽ, ni mei ní Iehowa aagbe le̱ ayi aafá babaō.

english_verse: I know everything you do and think! The time has now come to bring together the people of every language and nation and to show them my glory
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mile ame̱nitšumo̱i ke̱ ame̱dſẽṅmo̱i le̱. Ni be aaba ní mabua dšeṅmãdši ke̱ lile̱ii fẽ anā, ni ame̱aba ame̱bana minumnyam le̱.

english_verse: They will bring your relatives from the nations as an offering to me, the Lord. They will come to Jerusalem, my holy mountain, on horses, chariots, wagons, mules, and camels. It will be like the people of Israel bringing the right offering to my temple.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ke̱ nyenyemimei le̱ fẽ ni dše̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ amli le̱ aaba abake Iehowa, ye̱ okpo̱ṅo̱i ano̱ ke̱ ſīlii amli ke̱ akpãkãii amli ke̱ tedšiokpo̱ṅo̱i ke̱ yomai ano̱, ye̱ Ierusalem, migoṅ kroṅkroṅ le̱ no̱, Iehowa kē̱, take̱ bo̱ni Israelbii le̱ hĩeo̱ ame̱nikēnii ye̱ nibii ní mli tše mli, ke̱-baä Iehowa we le̱,

english_verse: I promise that some of them will be priests and others will be helpers in my temple. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ni maṅõ ame̱teṅ meikomei hũ mafe *oso̱foi ke̱ Levibii, Iehowa kē̱. *

english_verse: I also promise that you will always have descendants and will never be forgotten, just as the new heavens and the new earth that I create will last forever.
translation_verse: Ši tamo̱ bo̱ni *ṅwei hē ke̱ šikpoṅ hē ni mibafe le̱ aadamo̱ ši ye̱ mihĩe le̱, Iehowa kē̱, nakai nyeseši ke̱ nyegbe̱i le̱ aadamo̱ ši. *

english_verse: On the first day of each month and on each Sabbath, everyone will worship me. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱ nyõṅ hē-fẽ-nyõṅ hẽ ke̱ hedšō̱mo̱gbĩ-fẽ-hedšō̱mo̱gbī no̱ le̱ helo fẽ aaba abadšá ye̱ mihĩe, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: My people will go out and look at the dead bodies of those who turned against me. The worms there never die, the fire never stops burning, and the sight of those bodies will be disgusting to everyone.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱adše kpo ame̱yakwe̱ mei ní etõ mino̱ le̱ agbohĩĩ le̱; edšake̱ *ame̱gõgõmi le̱ gboṅ, ni ame̱la le̱ hũ agbeṅ, ni ame̱he aafe helo fẽ nyãṅemo̱. *Mar.

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa wiemo̱ ba miṅõ ake:

english_verse: The Lord showed me something in a vision. Then he asked, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” I answered, “A branch of almonds that ripen early.”
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa wiemo̱ sā ba miṅõ ake̱: Meni onaä, Ieremia? Ni mikē̱: Ṅme̱tšo ko minaä ne̱.

english_verse: “That's right,” the Lord replied, “and I always rise early to keep a promise.”
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱mi ake̱; Ona dšogbāṅ; edšake̱ *mīši kpe ye̱ miwiemo̱ le̱ he ní mafe! *

english_verse: Then the Lord showed me something else and asked, “What do you see now?” I answered, “I see a pot of boiling water in the north, and it's about to spill out toward us.”
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa wiemo̱ ba miṅõ noni dši šii enyo̱ ake̱: Meni onaä? Ni mikē̱: Mina kukwe̱i ko ni tſaä, ni ehĩe dše̱ kōyigbe̱.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will pour out destruction all over the land.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱mi ake̱: Kōyigbe̱ nõfõṅ badše̱ adſa aſie šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ bii fẽkwa no̱.

english_verse: I will punish my people, because they are guilty of turning from me to worship idols.
translation_verse: Ni makodšoame̱ ye̱ ame̱nifõdšianii le̱ fẽ hewo, ake̱-ni ame̱kwami, ni ame̱yašã tšofãi-ke̱-ṅmai ame̱hã nyoṅmo̱i krokomei, ni ame̱dšá ame̱dientše̱ ame̱ninenā nitšumo̱i le̱.

english_verse: Jeremiah, get ready! Go and tell the people what I command you to say. Don't be frightened by them, or I will make you terrified while they watch.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo le̱, mĩamo̱, ni ote ši ni okē̱ame̱ nofẽno ní mafã́o! Otšui akafã ye̱ ame̱hĩe, ké̱ dšee nakai le̱ mahã otšui afã ye̱ ame̱hĩe!

english_verse: My power will make you strong like a fortress or a column of iron or a wall of bronze. You will oppose all of Judah, including its kings and leaders, its priests and people.
translation_verse: Edšake̱, na, ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ miṅõo mife maṅ ni atſa gbogbo awo he, ke̱ dade akulašĩṅ, ke̱ akō̱ble gbogboi miši šikpoṅ le̱ fẽ ke̱ Iuda maṅtše̱mei ke̱ elumei ke̱ eso̱foi ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no bii le̱;

english_verse: They will fight back, but they won't win. I, the Lord, give my word— I won't let them harm you.
translation_verse: ni ame̱ke̱o aawu, ši ame̱nyẽṅo; edšake̱ mike̱o ye̱, ní madšieo, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: to go to Jerusalem and tell everyone that he had said: When you were my young bride, you loved me and followed me through the barren desert.
translation_verse: Ya ni oyašie̱ owo Ierusalem toiiaṅ ake̱: Bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Mikai oblayeiaṅ mlihĩle̱ le̱ mihão ke̱ oyemforo be le̱ mli suomo̱ le̱ hũ, bo̱ni onyie mise̱ ke̱-te ṅã le̱ no̱, ye̱ šikpoṅ ní adũko nii ye̱ no̱ le̱ no̱ le̱.

english_verse: I brought you here to my land, where food is abundant, but you made my land filthy with your sins.
translation_verse: Ni mike̱nye ba šikpoṅ ní baä nii no̱, koni nyeye eno̱ yibii ke̱ eno̱ nii kpakpai; ši beni nyeba le̱, nyebabule mišikpoṅ le̱, ni nyefe mino̱yelinõ le̱ noni anyãṅeo̱.

english_verse: The priests who teach my laws don't care to know me. Your leaders rebel against me; your prophets give messages from Baal and worship false gods. The Lord Accuses His People
translation_verse: Oso̱foi le̱ ekē̱ē̱ ake̱: Nẽgbe̱ Iehowa yo̱? ni mlatšõlo̱i le̱ leemi, ni no̱kwe̱lo̱i le̱ tõ mino̱, ni gbalo̱i le̱, Baal no̱ ame̱tšṍo̱ ame̱gbaä, ni nii ni he be̱ se̱námo̱ le̱ ase̱ ame̱nyieo̱.

english_verse: Enemies roared like lions and destroyed your land; towns lie burned and empty.
translation_verse: Dšatabii hū̃o̱, ni ame̱blo̱ö̱ ame̱woo̱le̱, ni ame̱fe ešikpoṅ le̱ amaṅfõ; ašã emãdši le̱, ní moko ehĩĩ mli doṅṅ.

english_verse: Soldiers from the Egyptian towns of Memphis and Tahpanhes have cracked your skulls.
translation_verse: *Nof ke̱ Takpanes bii le̱ hũ efẽ̀ oyiteṅ pampam. *

english_verse: It's all your own fault! You stopped following me, the Lord your God,
translation_verse: Ani dšee bodientše̱ otao ene̱ ohã ohe, ake̱-ní okwa Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, beni ekplaäo ke̱-tšṍ gbe̱ le̱ no̱ le̱? Hos.

english_verse: Your own sins will punish you, because it was a bitter mistake for you to reject me without fear of punishment. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken.
translation_verse: Bodientše̱ onifõdšianii aagbla otoi, ni ose̱se̱yā le̱ hũ aakã ohĩe; hewo̱ le̱ ná ole ni oyo ake̱ kwa ni okwa Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ke̱ migbeyeišemo̱ ní be̱ omli le̱ edši nõfõṅ ke̱ noni dšōo̱, Nuṅtšo̱, Iehowa Zebaot, kē̱!

english_verse: Long ago you left me and broke all ties between us, refusing to be my servant. Now you worship other gods by having sex on hilltops or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ blema bēbe odše̱ okũ opã le̱, ni otšere̱ okpãi le̱, ni okē̱ ake̱: Misúmo̱o̱ moko! edšake̱ *goṅkpo̱-fẽ-goṅkpo̱ ní kwo̱ no̱ ke̱ tšo-fẽ-tšo ni ebu kusū šiši oyakãa ši obo̱ō̱ adſamaṅ ye̱. *

english_verse: You were a choice grapevine, but you have become a wild, useless vine. Israel Is Stained with Guilt
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, mite̱o bo ake̱ weintšo kpakpa ní dše̱ noni hĩ kwrā mli: té fe tēṅ ní otšake otšṍ kōṅ weintšo ní ehĩĩ obãmi ne̱? Ies.

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Israel, you are stained with guilt, and no soap or bleach can wash it away.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ké̱ odšu ke̱ adi po, ni ohã sãmlã fá babaō tete, otõmo̱ le̱ ṅmã ši ye̱ mihĩe kẽ! Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: You deny your sins and say, “We aren't unclean. We haven't worshiped Baal.” But think about what you do in Hinnom Valley. You run back and forth like young camels, as you rush to worship one idol after another.
translation_verse: Té tēṅ ní okē̱o̱ ake̱: Mibuleko mi-he, ni miyanyieko Baalim se̱ le̱? Kwe̱mo̱ ogbe̱ le̱ ye̱ dšō̱ le̱ mli, ni oná ole noni ofe! yoma oblayō ni he yo̱ oyá ní kpaä ši;

english_verse: You are a female donkey sniffing the desert air, wanting to mate with just anyone. You are an easy catch!
translation_verse: ṅãṅ tedšiyō ní ele ṅãno̱ hĩle̱, ní fũo̱ kō̱yo̱ ye̱ esusuma se̱di le̱ mli, — ehĩedō̱ le̱ṅ le̱, namo aatšĩ enā? mei fẽ ni taoo̱le̱ le̱, eto̱ṅame̱; enyõṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ ame̱anale̱.

english_verse: Your shoes are worn out, and your throat is parched from running here and there to worship foreign gods. “Stop!” I shouted, but you replied, “No! I love those gods too much.”
translation_verse: Kwe̱mo̱ onane dšogbāṅ, ní ehe aka-kã, ke̱ osẽ hũ, ní kũmai akayeo! Ši okē̱ ake̱: Ehĩĩ fõmo̱! dabi! edšake̱ misumoo̱ meikpõdši, ni ame̱se̱ manyie!

english_verse: worship stone idols and sacred poles as if they had created you and had given you life. You have rejected me, but when you're in trouble, you cry to me for help.
translation_verse: mei ni kē̱o̱ tšo ake̱: Mitše̱ dšio! ke̱ te̱ ake̱: Bo ofo̱mi! le̱; edšake̱ ame̱tšṍmo̱ ame̱se̱ ame̱hãmi, ši dšee ame̱hĩeaṅ; ši ame̱fĩmo̱ be mli le̱ ame̱kēo ake: Te ši ní ohere wo̱yiwala!

english_verse: Go cry to the gods you made! There should be enough of them to save you, because Judah has as many gods as it has towns. Israel Rebels against the Lord
translation_verse: Ši *nẽgbe̱ onyoṅmo̱i ní ofe ohã ohe le̱ yo̱? hã ní ame̱te ši, ake̱ ame̱anyẽ oyiwala ame̱here ye̱ ofĩmo̱ be le̱ mli lo? Edšake̱ †bo̱ni omãdši le̱ fá le̱, nakai noṅṅ onyoṅmo̱i le̱ fá, Iuda! *Kodš.

english_verse: The Lord said to Israel: You accuse me of not saving you, but I say you have rebelled.
translation_verse: Mẽba nyeke̱mi béo̱ mo̱? Nyefẽ-tſẽm nyetō mino̱, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: I tried punishing you, but you refused to come back to me, and like fierce lions you killed my prophets.
translation_verse: Yakatſā po mitſia nyebii le̱ anii; *ame̱kplẽẽ tšo̱semo̱. Nyedientše̱ nyeklante yeo̱ nyegbalo̱i le̱, take̱ dšata hĩekpãtãlo̱! *Ies.

english_verse: Now listen to what I say! Did I abandon you in the desert or surround you with darkness? You are my people, yet you have told me, “We'll do what we want, and we refuse to worship you!”
translation_verse: Nye ne̱ke̱ yino̱bii! nyekwe̱a Iehowa wiemo̱ le̱! Ani mitšṍ ṅãno̱ mihā Israel alo šikpoṅ ní eno̱ ewo duṅ kpī? Mẽhewo̱ mo̱ ni mimaṅ le̱ kē̱o̱ ake̱: Wo̱ye wo̱he! ni wo̱baa oṅõ doṅṅ ne̱?

english_verse: A bride could not forget to wear her jewelry to her wedding, but you have forgotten me day after day.
translation_verse: Ani oblayō hĩe aakpa ewulamo̱nii ano̱, alo ayemforo hĩe aakpa emlifĩnii ano̱? ši mimaṅ le̱ hĩe ekpa mino̱ gbĩĩ ní anyẽṅ akane.

english_verse: You are so clever at finding lovers that you could give lessons to a prostitute.
translation_verse: Kwe̱ bo̱ni osā ogbe̱ le̱ fe̱fe̱o, ní oke̱-tao suomo̱! Nohewo̱ hũ le̱ ohã nifõdšianii eka ogbè̱i le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: You killed innocent people for no reason at all. And even though their blood can be seen on your clothes,
translation_verse: Anaä ohĩafoi ní efeko noko le̱ asusumai le̱ alá ye̱ otade nāmūi le̱ amli; dšee nifĩfĩaṅ mina ene̱ ye̱, ši moṅ hefẽhe.

english_verse: you claim to be innocent, and you want me to stop being angry with you. So I'll take you to court, and we'll see who is right.
translation_verse: Kẽle̱ okē̱o̱ ake̱: Mifeko noko: nto emlifũ le̱ edše mino̱! Na, *mike̱o bakodšo ye̱ kē̱mo̱ ní okē̱ ake̱: Mifeko eša ko! le̱ hewo̱. *Ies.

english_verse: When Assyria let you down, you quickly ran to Egypt, but you'll find no help there,
translation_verse: Mẽba olilaä ši babaō ne̱ke̱, ni otšake ogbe̱ le̱? Ohĩe bagbo ye̱ Mizraim he, tamo̱ bo̱ni ohĩe gbo ye̱ Ašur he le̱.

english_verse: and you will leave in great sadness. I won't let you find help from those you trust.
translation_verse: Oodše̱ dše̱i hũ odše kpo, ni onidši aadſere oyiteṅ; edšake̱ Iehowa ekwa mei ní ohĩe kã ame̱no̱ le̱, ni emli ehĩṅ bāṅo ye̱ ame̱ṅõ.

english_verse: So I, the Lord, refused to let the spring rains fall. But just like a prostitute, you still have no shame for what you have done.
translation_verse: Nohewo le̱ atšĩ nyoṅmo̱ne̱mo̱ nā, ni gbo nyoṅmo̱ ene̱e̱; ši ohĩe yō adſamaṅ hĩeṅtšo, ni ohĩe gboo nõ.

english_verse: And worst of all, the people of Judah pretended to come back to me.
translation_verse: Ši fẽ le̱, enyemiyō Iuda, kũtũmpo̱fo le̱, ekũũ ese̱ ke̱-baa miṅõ ke̱ etsui mū le̱ fẽ, ši moṅ, apasa mli ke̱ke̱, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: Jeremiah, shout toward the north: Israel, I am your Lord— come back to me! You were unfaithful and made me furious, but I am merciful, and so I will forgive you.
translation_verse: Ya ni oyašie̱ ne̱ke̱ wiemo̱i ne̱ ke̱-ya kōyigbe̱ ni okē̱: Kũ ose̱, se̱se̱yalo̱ Israel! Iehowa kē̱; mitũṅ mihĩe miwoṅ-nye doṅṅ; edšake̱ *mo̱bo̱nalo̱ dšimi, Iehowa kē̱; mibè̱ṅnye miwoṅ mimli ke̱-yaṅ nāno̱! *Lal.

english_verse: You are unfaithful children, but you belong to me. Come home! I'll take one or two of you from each town and clan and bring you to Zion.
translation_verse: Nyekũa nyese̱, nye bii se̱se̱yalo̱i! Iehowa kē̱; edšake̱ *midsi nyewù, ni maṅõnye, †mokome ke̱-adše̱ maṅ kome mli, mei enyo̱ hũ ke̱-adše̱ weku kome mli, ni mike̱nye aaba Zion ekoṅ. *Hos.

english_verse: Then I'll appoint wise rulers who will obey me, and they will care for you like shepherds.
translation_verse: Ni mahãnye no̱kwe̱lo̱i ye̱ mitšui nā, ni emealè̱nye ke̱ nilē ke̱ dſẽṅmo̱.

english_verse: You will increase in numbers, and there will be no need to remember the sacred chest or to make a new one.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱, beni nyeyi aafá ni nyeafo̱ pī ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ye̱ nakai gbĩĩ le̱ amli le̱, — Iehowa kē̱, — akē̱ṅ doṅṅ ake̱: Iehowa kpãṅmo̱ adeka le̱! ní ebaṅ dſẽṅmo̱ mli, ni akaiṅ, ni ataoṅ, asaṅ afeṅ eko doṅṅ.

english_verse: The whole city of Jerusalem will be my throne. All nations will come here to worship me, and they will no longer follow their stubborn, evil hearts.
translation_verse: Nakai be le̱ mli le̱ aatsé̱ Ierusalem ake̱ Iehowa maṅtše̱sẽi; ni *dšeṅmãdši fẽ aabua amehe nā ke̱-aba dše̱i ye̱ Iehowa gbe̱i ní yo̱ Ierusalem le̱ hewo̱, ni ame̱-nyieṅ †ametšui fõṅ le̱ wale̱ se̱ doṅṅ. *Ies.

english_verse: Then, in countries to the north, you people of Judah and Israel will be reunited, and you will return to the land I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Nakai gbĩĩ le̱ amli le̱ Iuda we le̱ aate Israel we le̱ ṅõ, ni ame̱yi enyo̱ le̱ fẽ ame̱adše̱ kōyigbe̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ke̱-aba šikpoṅ ni miṅõ-hã ame̱tše̱mei le̱ ake̱ ame̱gbe̱fāṅnõ le̱ no̱. Ies.

english_verse: I have always wanted to treat you as my children and give you the best land, the most beautiful on earth. I wanted you to call me “Father” and not turn from me.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱ mikē̱: Kwe̱ boni mike̱o bato bii ateṅ, ni mike̱ šikpoṅ fe̱fe̱o ni dši dšeṅmãdši le̱ asafoi le̱ agbošinii ni yo̱ fe̱o fè fẽ le̱ bahão! Ni mikē̱: Nye-atšé̱mi ake̱: *Mitše̱l ni nyekpaleṅ ye̱ mise̱ doṅṅ. *K.

english_verse: But instead, you are like a wife who broke her wedding vows. You have been unfaithful to me. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People Confess Their Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ši take̱ bo̱ni yō yeo̱ ewù he kũtũmpo̱o le̱, nakai nye hũ nyeye mihe kũtũmpo̱o, nye Israel we, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: Listen to the noise on the hilltops! It's the people of Israel, weeping and begging me to answer their prayers. They forgot about me and chose the wrong path.
translation_verse: Anuo̱ gbē ko ye̱ gõdši kpatāi le̱ ano̱: Israelbii le̱ ayāfó ke̱ faikpamo̱i, edšake̱ ame̱kõdõ ame̱gbe̱ le̱, ni ame̱hĩe ekpa Iehowa, ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, no̱.

english_verse: I will tell them, “Come back, and I will cure you of your unfaithfulness.” They will answer, “We will come back, because you are the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Nyekũa nyese̱, nye bii se̱se̱yalo̱i, matšá nyese̱se̱yā le̱! *Na, wo̱mība oṅõ, edšake bo dši Iehowa, wo-Nyoṅmo le̱. *Hos.

english_verse: On hilltops, we worshiped idols and made loud noises, but it was all for nothing— only you can save us.
translation_verse: Le̱le̱ṅ, goṅkpo̱i ke̱ gõdši le̱ ano̱ hōſemo̱ le̱, yakatſā ni! Le̱le̱ṅ, Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, mli Israel yiwalaheremo̱ yo̱!

english_verse: Since the days of our ancestors when our nation was young, that shameful god Baal has taken our crops and livestock, our sons and daughters.
translation_verse: Ši hĩegbĕle eye nii ní wo̱tše̱mei le̱ gbo he deṅme le̱ ke̱-dše̱ wo̱gbekẽbii-aši: ame̱tōi ke̱ ame̱tšinai ke̱ ame̱bihĩĩ ke̱ ame̱biyei fẽ!

english_verse: Make promises only in my name, and do what you promise! Then all nations will praise me, and I will bless them.
translation_verse: ni *ookã kitã ye̱ ano̱kwale ke̱ kodšomo̱ ke̱ dšale̱ mli ake̱: Gbĩĩabo̱ ní Iehowa hĩe kã ne̱! ni no le̱ dšeṅmãdši aadšō̱dšō̱ ame̱he ye̱ emli, ni le noṅṅ eno̱ ame̱aſã ame̱fõ. *

english_verse: With all your hearts, keep the agreement I made with you. But if you are stubborn and keep on sinning, my anger will burn like a fire that cannot be put out. Disaster Is Coming The Lord said: *
translation_verse: *Nyeflo̱a nyehe ketia nyehãa Iehowa, ni nyedšiea nyetšui mli fō le̱, nye Iudahĩĩ ke̱ Ierusalembii, ké̱ dšee nakai le̱, mimlila le̱ adše kpo tamo̱ la, ni eešã ní moko nyẽṅ agbe, ye̱ nyenifemo̱nii fõdši le̱ ahewo! *

english_verse: An army will come out, like a lion from its den. It will destroy nations and leave your towns empty and in ruins.”
translation_verse: Dšata ko edše kpo ke̱-dše̱ ekō ku-sū le̱ṅ ke̱-mība, dšeṅmãdši le̱ afitelo̱ le̱ efã ke̱-dše̱ ehĩle̱he le̱ ke̱-mība, ni ebafe ošikpoṅ le̱ amaṅfõ, ni ekpãtã omãdši le̱ ahĩe, ni moko ehĩṅ mli doṅṅ.

english_verse: Then I told the people of Israel, “Put on sackcloth! Mourn and cry out, ‘The Lord is still angry with us.’ ”
translation_verse: Ene̱ hewo le̱ nyemĩaä kpekpe, nyewoa yāra ni nyeblo̱a lelēle; edšake̱ Iehowa mlifũ ní nā wa le̱ edšeko wo̱no̱!

english_verse: When disaster comes, the Lord will tell you people of Jerusalem, “I am sending a windstorm from the desert— not a welcome breeze. And it will sweep you away as punishment for your sins.
translation_verse: Kō̱yo̱ ní nā wa tšṍ hã ene̱ aaba ahãmi, no koni mi hũ mawie kodšomo̱ wiemoi mašiame̱!

english_verse: Look! The enemy army swoops down like an eagle; their cavalry and chariots race faster than storm clouds blown by the wind.” Then you will answer, “We are doomed!”
translation_verse: Na, efã ke̱-mība tamo̱ atatui, ni eſīlii le̱ tamo̱ lasũogbĕle; ekpo̱ṅo̱i le̱ ahe ye̱ oyá fè okropoṅi: Kpóo hãwo̱! wo̱hĩe ekpãtã!

english_verse: But Jerusalem, there is still time for you to be saved. Wash the evil from your hearts and stop making sinful plans,
translation_verse: *Fo̱ otšui he ke̱-dše̱ efõṅ mli, Ierusalem, beni afe ní ahere oyiwala! Mẽ beyino noṅṅ po odſẽṅmo̱i fõdši le̱ aahĩ omli ke̱-yaši! *Ies.

english_verse: I can't stand the pain! My heart pounds, as I twist and turn in agony. I hear the signal trumpet and the battle cry of the enemy, and I cannot be silent.
translation_verse: Mimũsũṅ! ō, mimũsũṅ! mitsui mli dientše̱ miwa mihe! mitšui kãã mimli! minyẽẽ diõ mafe! edšake̱ misusuma enu te̱tre̱mantre̱ gbē̱mo̱ ke̱ ta mli ošebō̱. Ies

english_verse: I see the enemy defeating us time after time, leaving everything in ruins. Even my own home is destroyed in a moment.
translation_verse: Āblo̱ ake̱: Hĩekpãtãmo̱ nyie hĩekpãtãmo̱ se̱! edšake̱ afite šikpoṅ le̱ fẽ; afite mibūi le̱ trukā, ke̱ mibūi ahe mamai le̱ hũ hĩṅme̱itfā mli.

english_verse: How long will I see enemy flags and hear their trumpets?
translation_verse: Mẽ beyino noṅṅ po mana aflaṅä, ni manu te̱tre̱mantre̱ gbē̱mo̱ ke̱-yaši?

english_verse: I heard the Lord say, “My people ignore me. They are foolish children who do not understand that they will be punished. All they know is how to sin.”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mimaṅ le̱ eye se̱ke̱; ame̱-leemi; bii kwašiai dšiame̱, ni ame̱be̱ dſẽṅ-mo. Nilelo̱i dšiame̱ ye̱ efõṅfemo̱ gbe̱faṅ, ši ekpakpafemo̱ le̱ ame̱lee.

english_verse: After this, I looked around. The earth was barren, with no form of life. The sun, moon, and stars had disappeared.
translation_verse: Mikwe̱ šikpoṅ le̱, ni na, eye̱ ole̱ṅle̱ ni efe flóṅṅ! ni mikwe̱ ṅwei hũ, ši la be̱!

english_verse: no people could be seen, and all the birds had flown away.
translation_verse: Mikwe̱, ni na, gbomo komeflo be̱, ni ṅwei lofõdši fẽ efliki ke̱-te.

english_verse: Farmland had become a desert, and towns were in ruins. The Lord's fierce anger had done all of this. The Death of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Mikwe̱, ni na, abō̱i le̱ etšṍmo̱ ṅã, ni eno̱ mãdši le̱ fẽ edſăra ye̱ Iehowa ke̱ emlifũ ní nā wa le̱ hĩe!

english_verse: The Lord said: I have made my decision, and I won't change my mind. This land will be destroyed, although not completely. The sky will turn dark, and the earth will mourn.
translation_verse: Ene̱ hewo̱ le̱ šikpoṅ le̱ aaye ṅko̱mo̱, ni ṅwei aadĩ tū̃ ye̱ yiteṅ; edšake̱ miwie, mito miyiṅ, ni miſaṅ mihe, ni mikpaleṅ ke̱-dšeṅ he.

english_verse: Enemy cavalry and archers shout their battle cry. People run for their lives and try to find safety among trees and rocks. Every town is empty.

english_verse: Jerusalem, your land has been wiped out. But you act like a prostitute and try to win back your lovers, who now hate you. You can put on a red dress, gold jewelry, and eye shadow, but it's no use— your lovers are out to kill you!
translation_verse: Ni bo le̱, ké̱ akpatã ohĩe le̱, té obafe teṅ? Tše̱ obu mama tšuru, tše̱ owula ke̱ šika wulamo̱nii, tše̱ oke adibri ediki ohĩṅme̱ii ase̱, ši yakatſā ofeo̱ ohe fe̱fe̱o: osuolo̱i le̱ aagbe ohe guo̱; ame̱atao bo ame̱gbe.

english_verse: I heard groaning and crying. Was it a woman giving birth to her first child? No, it was Jerusalem, gasping for breath and begging for help. “I'm dying!” she said. “They have murdered me.”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ minu gbē ko tamo̱ yō ní kõmoo̱ gbē, kē̃mo̱ ní tamo̱ yō ní bafo̱ ekromo̱bi nõ: Zion biyō ní tšui suo̱ le̱ gbē ni, egbe̱o̱ enidšĩaṅ ake̱: Kpóo hãmi! edšake̱ misusuma eto̱ biti ye̱ awuyelo̱i le̱ adeṅ!

english_verse: So I'll go and talk to the leaders. They know what God demands.” But even they had decided not to obey the Lord.

english_verse: People of Judah, how can I forgive you? I gave you everything, but you abandoned me and worshiped idols. You men go to prostitutes and are unfaithful to your wives.

translation_verse: Ame̱kpaã ye̱ Iehowa se̱, ame̱kē̱o̱ ake̱: “Dšee le̱ ni! ni nõfõṅ ko baṅ wo̱no̱, ni asaṅ wo̱naṅ klante ke̱ hõmo̱;

english_verse: They tell these lies in my name, so now they will be killed in war or starve to death.
translation_verse: ni gbaloi le̱ aatšṍmo̱ kō̱yo̱, ni Nyoṅmo̱ wiemo le̱ be̱ ame̱mli: bo̱ni aafeame̱ ne̱!”

english_verse: People of Israel, I have made my decision. An army from a distant country will attack you. I've chosen an ancient nation, and you won't understand their language.
translation_verse: Na, mahã dšeṅmaṅ ko ní dše̱ šoṅṅ aba ono̱, bo, Israel we, — Iehowa kē̱, — *dšeṅmaṅ ko ní he wa, dšeṅmaṅ ní dše̱ blema bēbe, dšeṅmaṅ ko ní olee ewiemo̱, ni onuu noni ekē̱o̱ le̱. *

english_verse: All of them are warriors, and their arrows bring death.
translation_verse: Ame̱gãimlibii akotoku le̱ tamo̱ gbonyobu ní agble nā, ame̱fẽ le̱, kãkãlo̱i so̱ṅṅ ni.

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, the enemy army won't kill everyone in Judah.
translation_verse: Kẽle̱ nakai gbĩĩ le̱ amli hũ, — Iehowa kē̱, — miplenēṅnye ke̱-mõṅ ši.

english_verse: And the people who survive will ask, “Why did the Lord our God do such terrible things to us?” Then tell them: I am the Lord, but you abandoned me and worshiped other gods in your own land. Now you will be slaves in a foreign country.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱, kē̱ nyekē̱ ake̱: Mẽhewo̱ ni Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, fewo̱ ene̱mei fẽ? le̱, okē̱ame̱ ake̱: Take̱ bo̱ni nyekwami ni nyesúmo̱ maṅse̱ nyoṅmo̱i ye̱ nyešikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱, nakai noṅṅ kẽ nyeasúmo̱ maṅse̱bii ye̱ šikpoṅ ko ní dšee nyeno no̱!

english_verse: Tell these things to each other, you people of Judah, you descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: Nyegbaã ene̱ ye̱ Iakob we le̱, ni nyehea anua ye̱ Iuda, ake̱:

english_verse: You fools! Why don't you listen when I speak? Why can't you understand
translation_verse: *Nyeboa ene̱ toi ko, maṅ kwašiai ni be̱ dſẽṅmo̱, ní ame̱yo̱ hĩṅme̱ii, ši ame̱naa nii, ní ame̱yo̱ toii hũ, ši ame̱nuu nii! *Ies.

english_verse: You refuse to say, “Let's worship the Lord! He's the one who sends rain in spring and autumn and gives us a good harvest.”
translation_verse: ni ame̱kē̱ē̱ ye̱ ame̱tšuii amli ake̱: Nyehãa wo̱sea Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, gbeyei, ši le̱ *ehãa nyoṅmo̱ ne̱o̱ gbo ke̱ agbie̱nā ye̱ ebe mli, le̱ ebāa nikpamo̱ otšii ní ato le̱ ayi ehãawo̱! *Bo̱f.

english_verse: That's why I cannot bless you! *
translation_verse: Nyenišaianii le̱ etšake ene̱mei, ni *nyehe ešai le̱ ehã nõkpakpa ebo̱nye. *Ies.

english_verse: A hunter traps birds and puts them in a cage, but some of you trap humans and make them your slaves.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ana meifõdši ye̱ mimā leṅ, ame̱woo̱ ká, tamo̱ loflõdũlo̱i woo̱ ante̱o, ame̱tšṍo̱ tšṍnei ame̱dũo̱ gbomei.

english_verse: You are evil, and you lie and cheat to make yourselves rich. You are powerful
translation_verse: Bo̱ni loflõtšũ mli eyi obõ ke̱ lofõdši le̱, nakai ame̱šĩai eyimo̱ obõbõ ke̱ šišiume̱: nohewo le̱ ame̱tsṍmo̱ gbomei agboi, ni ame̱ná nii;

english_verse: Look at the terrible things going on in this country. I am shocked!
translation_verse: Nākpe̱nii ke̱ gbeyei nibii afeo̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱:

translation_verse: gbalo̱i le̱ gbaä apasa gbale̱, ni oso̱foi le̱ hũ fataä ame̱he ke̱-feo̱, ni mimaṅ le̱ hũ mīsumo̱ nakai. Enāgbẽ mli le̱, ti nyebafe tẽṅ?

english_verse: Kings will tell their troops, “If we reach Jerusalem in the morning, we'll attack at noon. But if we arrive later,
translation_verse: Nyefea ta le̱ kroṅkroṅ nyešiale̱t Nyetea ši ni wo̱fãa ke̱-yaã ſane! Kpóo bãwo̱! edšake̱ dše mina, ni gbe̱ke̱ hō̃ṅ le̱ elē̱ ši ke̱-te šoṅṅ!

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I will command these armies to chop down trees and build a ramp up to the walls of Jerusalem. People of Jerusalem, I must punish you for your injustice.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo̱ni Iehowa Zebaot kē̱ ne̱: Nyetoa tšei nyeſiea ši, ni nyetſaä kpoku nyewoa Ierusalem he! Maṅ ní abawole̱ nyõmo̱ le̱ ne̱: *amimyeli so̱ṅṅ yo̱ mli. *

english_verse: Evil pours from your city like water from a spring. Sounds of injustice and violence echo within your walls; victims are everywhere, wounded and dying.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni nubu ko baä nu le̱, nakai enifõdšianii le̱ baä: anuo̱ yiwale̱ ke̱ haomo̱ he ye̱ mli, fadši ke̱ nitſiamo̱ so̱ṅṅ yo̱ mihĩe dā!

english_verse: I will tell your enemies to leave your nation bare like a vine stripped of grapes. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah's Anger
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa Zebaot kē̱ ne̱: Ame̱aye Israel mei ní eſe̱ le̱ kpe̱kpe̱o, tamo̱ ayeo weintšo kpe̱kpe̱o, ní weinyibii atšelo̱ kpaa enine mli ke̱-yaä tšo le̱ no̱ no̱tono̱to le̱.

english_verse: Everyone is greedy and dishonest, whether poor or rich. Even the prophets and priests cannot be trusted.

english_verse: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.
