translation_verse: Kādše kpo ke̱-mīya ṅã le̱ no̱, ni kānyie gbe̱ le̱ no̱ hũ! edšake̱ henye̱lo̱ le̱ hĩe klante, ni hefẽhe efe gbeyei!

english_verse: and attacks without warning. So mourn, my people, as though your only child had died. Wear clothes made of sackcloth and roll in the ash pile.” The Lord's People Must Be Tested The Lord said:
translation_verse: Mimaṅ biyō, mĩamo̱ kpekpe, ni okoklo ši ye̱ lamlu mli; ye ṅko̱mo̱ tamo̱ *ayeo̱ bi kome he ṅko̱mo̱, ni owo yăra ní mli wa; edšake̱ hĩekpãtãlo̱ le̱ baba wo̱no̱ trukā! *Amos

english_verse: Jeremiah, test my people as though they were metal.
translation_verse: Mike̱o efe šikakalo̱ mihã mimaṅ le̱, koni oná ole, ni oka ame̱gbe̱ le̱ okwe̱.

english_verse: And you'll find they are hard like bronze and iron. They are stubborn rebels, always spreading lies. *
translation_verse: Ame̱fẽ le̱ kaniṅkadšelo̱i amli kaniṅkadšelo̱i ni, ame̱kpaä ši ame̱nyieo̱ mei ašiši, *akō̱ble ke̱ dade so̱ṅṅ dšiame̱; ame̱fẽ le̱ fitelo̱i dšiame̱. *Ezek.

english_verse: But you have ignored me and become even more stubborn and sinful than your ancestors ever were! Slaughter Valley The Lord said:
translation_verse: ši kẽle̱ ame̱boomi toi, ni asaṅ ame̱hãã ame̱toi aba no̱ hũ, ši moṅ amefe ame̱he kue̱ṅtilo̱i, ni ame̱fe efõṅ fè ame̱tše̱mei le̱.

english_verse: While you have been sinning, I have been trying to talk to you, but you refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱ le̱, ake̱-ni nyetšu ne̱ke̱ nitšumo̱i ne̱ fẽ, Iehowa kē̱, ni *miwieo̱ mitšõo̱nye, miteo ši lebi mā̃ṅkpa miwieo̱ dā, ni nyeboo toi, ni misā mitšé̱o̱nye, ni nyeheree no̱ *Abe̱i

english_verse: And now, I, the Lord All-Powerful, will flood Judah with my fiery anger until nothing is left—no people or animals, no trees or crops. It Is Useless To Offer Sacrifices
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Na, aafo̱se mimlifũ ke̱ mimlila aſie ne̱ke̱ šihĩle̱he ne̱ no̱, gbomei ke̱ koloi ano̱, ṅãno̱ tšei ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ nibānii le̱ ano̱, ni eetšo ní anyẽṅ agbe.

english_verse: But your ancestors refused to listen. They were stubborn, and whenever I wanted them to go one way, they always went the other.
translation_verse: Ši ame̱boo toi, ni ame̱hãã ame̱toi aba no̱ hũ, ši moṅ ame̱dientše̱ ame̱ṅāwōi ke̱ ame̱tšui fõṅ le̱ wale̱ se̱ amenyie, ni ame̱tšṍ ame̱se̱ ame̱hãmi, ni dšee ame̱hĩe,

english_verse: Ever since your ancestors left Egypt, I have been sending my servants the prophets to speak for me.
translation_verse: Ke̱-dše̱ gbĩ no̱ ni nyetše̱mei le̱ dše Mizraim āhũ ke̱-baši ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ no̱ le̱, mitšũo̱ mitšũdši ní dši gbalo̱i le̱ fẽ ke̱-baä nyeṅõ, miteo̱ ši le̱bi mā̃ṅkpa mitšũo̱ame̱ dā:

english_verse: Jeremiah, no matter what you do, the people won't listen.
translation_verse: Ni ké̱ owie ne̱ke̱ wiemo̱i ne̱ fẽ otšõame̱ le̱, ame̱boṅo toi, ni ké̱ otšé̱ame̱ hũ, ame̱hereṅo no̱.

english_verse: So you must say to them: People of Judah, I am the Lord your God, but you have refused to obey me, and you didn't change when I punished you. And now, you no longer even pretend to be faithful to me.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ kē̱mo̱ame̱ ake̱: Dšeṅmaṅ ní boo Iehowa, ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, gbē toi, ni ame̱kplẽẽ tšo̱semo̱ ne̱; *ano̱kwale elādše ni etã ye̱ ame̱dāṅ! *

english_verse: Shave your head bald and throw away the hair. Sing a funeral song on top of a barren hill. You people have made me angry, and I have abandoned you.
translation_verse: Ku oyitšo̱i le̱ oſie, ni owo yăra ye̱ gõdši kpatãi le̱ ano̱; edšako̱ Iehowa ekwa yino̱bii ni emli efũamo̱ le̱, ni ešĩ-ame̱!

english_verse: You have disobeyed me by putting your disgusting idols in my temple, and now the temple itself is disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iudabii le̱ efe efõṅ ye̱ mihĩe, Iehowa kē̱. Ame̱ke̱ ame̱nihīnii le̱ eto šĩa ní aṅõ migbei awole̱ le̱, ní ame̱-ke̱-bulele̱;

english_verse: At Topheth in Hinnom Valley you have built altars where you kill your children and burn them as sacrifices to other gods. I would never think of telling you to do this.
translation_verse: ni ame̱mãmo̱ *Tofet hei groṅṅi le̱ ní yo̱ Hinom bi le̱ dšō̱ le̱ṅ le̱, koni †ame̱šã ame̱bihĩĩ ke̱ ame̱biyei ye̱ la mli, noni miwoko he kitã, ni esā ebako miyiṅ le̱. *

english_verse: So watch out! Someday that place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley, because you will bury your dead there until you run out of room,
translation_verse: Hewo̱ le̱ na, gbĩĩ mība, Iehowa kē̱, ní atšē̱ṅ dše̱i ake̱ Tofet alo Hinom bi le̱ dšō̱ doṅṅ, ši moṅ aatšē̱le̱ awuyeli dšō̱, ni aafũ mei ye̱ Tofet, edšake̱ gbe̱ be̱ hekoheko doṅṅ;

english_verse: and then bodies will lie scattered on the ground. Birds and wild animals will come and eat, and no one will be around to scare them off.
translation_verse: ni ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱ gbohĩĩ le̱ aatšṍmo̱ ṅwei lofõdši ke̱ šikpoṅ no̱ koloi aniyenii, ni mokomoko eſieṅame̱.

english_verse: When I am finished with your land, there will be deathly silence in the empty ruins of Jerusalem and the towns of Judah—no happy voices, no sounds of parties or wedding celebrations.
translation_verse: Ni mahã nyã́mo̱ ke̱ mīše̱ gbē ke̱ ayemforowu ke̱ ayemforo gbē se̱ afo ye̱ Iuda mãdši le̱ ke̱ Ierusalem blohũi le̱ amli; edšake̱ šikpoṅ le̱ batšṍ kpatā.

english_verse: who loved and worshiped the sun, moon, and stars. These bones will be scattered and left lying on the ground like trash, where the sun and moon and stars can shine on them.
translation_verse: ni aagbe mli aka hũlũ ke̱ nyoṅtšĕre ke̱ ṅwei asafo le̱ fẽ, nii ni *ame̱sumo̱ ni ame̱úṅmo̱ hũ, ni amenyie ame̱se̱ ni ame̱tao ame̱se̱gbe̱, ni ame̱dšáame̱ le̱: abuaṅ ame̱nā, †asaṅ afũṅame̱; ni ame̱atšṍ tumu ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱. *

english_verse: Some of you people of Judah will be left alive, but I will force you to go to foreign countries, and you will wish you were dead. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken. The People Took the Wrong Road
translation_verse: Ni ne̱ke̱ weku fõṅ ne̱ mli mei fẽ ni aaſe̱ ye̱ hei fẽ ní miſieame̱ ke̱-te le̱, aasumo̱ gbĕle moṅ fè wala, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱.

english_verse: So why do you refuse to come back to me? Why do you hold so tightly to your false gods?
translation_verse: Mēhewo̱ mo̱ ni ne̱ke̱ maṅ Ierusalem ne̱ ekpale ni ame̱ka mli kwrā ne̱? ame̱hĩe šišiumo̱ mli gbãgbā̃gbã, ame̱kplẽẽ se̱kū̃.

english_verse: Storks, doves, swallows, and thrushes all know when it's time to fly away for the winter and when to come back. But you, my people, don't know what I demand.
translation_verse: Klitšo tete ni nyie ṅwei le̱, ele ebe, kose̱-okpo hũ ke̱ nyoṅmo̱bite̱te ke̱ kpokukpoku sraä ame̱bā-be; ši mimaṅ le̱ lee Iehowa gbe̱nānii le̱! Ies.

english_verse: You say, “We are wise because we have the teachings and laws of the Lord.” But I say that your teachers have turned my words into lies!
translation_verse: Té tēṅ ni nyekē̱o̱ ake̱: Nilelo̱i dšiwo̱, ni Iehowa mla le̱ ye̱ we̱deṅ le̱? Ši na, woloṅmãlo̱i le̱ amale-pen le̱ etšṍle̱ amale!

english_verse: They should be ashamed of the way they live, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else.
translation_verse: Kē̱ ame̱fe nihĩnii le̱, agbeo̱ ame̱hĩe: ši ame̱hĩe gboii komeflo, ni ame̱lee noni dši hĩegbĕle; hewo̱ le̱ ame̱anyõnyõi ye̱ mei ní enyōnyõi le̱ ateṅ: be mli ni mabasraame̱ le̱ ame̱agbēgbē ši, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: I will wipe them out. They are vines without grapes; fig trees without figs or leaves. They have not done a thing that I told them! I, the Lord, have spoken. The People and Their Punishment
translation_verse: Matšere̱ame̱ ni malōame̱ ke̱-ate, Iehowa kē̱, ní weinyibii akaſe̱ ye̱ weintšo le̱ no̱, ní agbãmii akaſe̱ ye̱ agbãmitšo le̱ no̱, ní bāi le̱ tete aṅălã; ni nii ní mihãame̱ le̱, aadše ame̱deṅ.

english_verse: We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Wo̱kwe̱ *hedšo̱le̱ gbe̱, ši nõkpakpa ko baa, ke̱ tšámo̱-be hũ, ši na, gbeyei so̱ṅṅ! *

english_verse: Our enemies have reached the town of Dan in the north, and the snorting of their horses makes us tremble with fear. The enemy will destroy Jerusalem and our entire nation. No one will survive.”
translation_verse: Anuo̱ ekpo̱ṅo̱i le̱ atšinemo̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ Dan, ekpo̱ṅo̱hĩĩ le̱ ablo̱mo̱ le̱ gbē̱mo̱ hãa šikpoṅ mū le̱ fẽ hosoo̱; edšake̱ ame̱mība ní ame̱baye šikpoṅ le̱ ke̱ eno̱ nii fẽ, maṅ lo̱ ke̱ mei ní yo̱ mli le̱ hũ.

english_verse: “Watch out!” the Lord says. “I'm sending poisonous snakes to attack you, and no one can stop them.” Jeremiah Mourns for His People
translation_verse: Edšake̱ na, matšũ onũfũi ke̱ blesaṅai ni *ṅkũnyāyeli ko nyẽẽame̱ ke̱-aba nyeteṅ, ní ame̱bakõmo̱nye, Iehowa kē̱. *Dšadš.

english_verse: I'm burdened with sorrow and feel like giving up.
translation_verse: Miná ní kũle̱ manyẽ mihe mī maše̱dše ye̱ miw̌ere̱hō le̱ mli! mitšui egbo̱dšo̱ ye̱ mimli!

english_verse: In a foreign land my people are crying. Listen! You'll hear them say, “Has the Lord deserted Zion? Is he no longer its king?” I hear the Lord reply, “Why did you make me angry by worshiping useless idols?”
translation_verse: Na, mimaṅ le̱ biyō le̱ blo̱mo̱ gbē le̱ dše̱ maṅse̱ šoṅṅ: “Aso Iehowa be̱ Zion? alo emaṅtše̱ le̱ be̱ emli doṅṅ?” “Mẽba mo̱ ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱mãgãi ke̱ maṅse̱ yakayakanii le̱ woo̱ mimli la ne̱?”

english_verse: The people complain, “Spring and summer have come and gone, but still the Lord hasn't rescued us.”
translation_verse: “Nikpamo̱be le̱ eho, ni yibii atšemo̱be efo mli, ši ahereko wo̱yiwala!”

english_verse: My people are crushed, and so is my heart. I am horrified and mourn.
translation_verse: Mimaṅ le̱ biyō le̱ hedšramo̱ le̱ hewo̱ lo̱ mi hũ mihe mīdšrami; mīye ṅko̱mo̱, mihe edšõ mihe.

english_verse: If medicine and doctors may be found in Gilead, why aren't my people healed?
translation_verse: Ani *tšofã be̱ Gilead, alo tšofãtše̱ ko be̱ dše̱i? mẽhewo̱ mo̱ ni atšáko mimaṅ le̱ biyō le̱? *

english_verse: They say they want peace, but this lie is deadly, like an arrow that strikes when you least expect it.
translation_verse: Gãimlibi ní gbeo̱ mo dši ame̱lile̱i, šišiumo̱ wiemo̱i ewieo; mo ke̱ enanyo wieo̱ ke̱ nādšo̱le̱, ši ewoo̱le̱ ká ye̱ etšui mli.

english_verse: I heard the Lord reply, “When I am finished, Jerusalem and the towns of Judah will be piles of ruins where only jackals live.” Why the Land Was Destroyed
translation_verse: Ni mafe Ierusalem kóikói, ṅãṅgbēi ašihĩle̱he, ni mafe Iuda mãdši le̱ amaṅ-fõ ni moko ehĩĩ mli.

english_verse: I said to the Lord, “None of us can understand why the land has become like an uncrossable desert. Won't you explain why?”
translation_verse: Namo dši *nilelo̱ ní aayo ene̱ se̱? ni namo dši moni Iehowa nābu ke̱le̱ ewie ní egba nõ hewo̱ ní akpãtã šikpoṅ le̱ hĩe ni ašãle̱ tamo̱ ṅãno̱ ní mokomoko tšṍṍ no̱ le̱? *

english_verse: The Lord said: I destroyed the land because the people disobeyed me and rejected my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱: Edšake̱ ame̱kwa mimla ní miṅõ-to ame̱hĩe le̱, ni ame̱boo mi-gbẽ toi, ni ame̱nyiee ye̱ mli,

english_verse: They were stubborn and worshiped Baal, just as their ancestors did.
translation_verse: ši moṅ *ame̱dientše̱ ame̱tšui wale̱ se̱ ame̱nyieo̱, ke̱ Baalim ní ame̱tše̱mei le̱ tšõame̱ le̱, *

english_verse: I'll scatter them in foreign countries that they and their ancestors have never even heard of. Finally, I will send enemy soldiers to kill every last one of them. The Women Who Are Paid To Weep
translation_verse: ni magbe̱ame̱ maſã dšeṅmãdši ní ame̱ke̱ ame̱tše̱mei fẽ lee le̱ ateṅ, ni mahã klante anyie ame̱se̱ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní maplenēame̱ kwrā.

english_verse: The people answered, “Let them come quickly and cry for us, until our own eyes are flooded with tears.
translation_verse: ni ame̱he afe oyá ní ame̱wo yăra ye̱ wo̱hewo̱, ní wo̱hĩṅme̱iiaṅ afo̱se yāfónui aſie ši, ni wo̱hĩṅme̱inātšo̱i atšere nui!

english_verse: “We ask you women to pay attention to what the Lord says. We will teach you a funeral song that you can teach your daughters and friends:
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱, nye yei le̱, nyeboa Iehowa wiemo̱ le̱ toi, ni nyehãa edāṅ wiemo le̱ abotea nyetoiiaṅ, ni nyetšṍ nyebiyei le̱ yărawō, ni nyeteṅ mofẽmo atšõ enanyo yāfó lala!

english_verse: ‘We were in our fortress, but death sneaked in through our windows. It even struck down children at play and our strongest young men.’
translation_verse: Edšake̱ gbĕle ekwo̱ ke̱-tšṍ wo̱samfe̱dši amli, ni ebabote wo̱mõdši le̱ amli, ni ebaplenē gbekẽbii ye̱ agbói anã, ke̱ oblahĩĩ hũ ye̱ blohũi amli.

english_verse: “The Lord has told us the ground will be covered with dead bodies, like ungathered stalks of grain or manure in a field.” What the Lord Likes Best
translation_verse: Kē̱mo̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Gbomei *agbohĩĩ aaſie ši tamo̱ ṅmõ mli tumu, lo tamo̱ ṅmā̃ nyaṅkũi ye̱ ṅmā̃kpalo̱i ase̱, ni mokomoko be̱ ní aabua nā! *

english_verse: The Lord says: Don't brag about your wisdom or strength or wealth.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Nilelo̱ akaſã mīfõ enilē no̱, hewalo̱ hũ akaſã mīfõ ehewale̱ no̱, ni niiatše̱ akaſã mīfõ enii ano̱;,

english_verse: If you feel you must brag, then have enough sense to brag about worshiping me, the Lord. What I like best is showing kindness, justice, and mercy to everyone on earth.
translation_verse: ši moni ſãa le̱, *ene̱ moṅ no̱ eſã efõ, ake̱ eyo ni asaṅ elemi, ake̱ midši Iehowa, moni yeo̱ mlihĩle̱ ke̱ kodšomo̱ ke̱ dšale̱ sane ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱; edšake̱ ene̱ sa mihĩe, Iehowa kē̱. *

english_verse: Someday I will punish the nations of Egypt, Edom, Ammon, and Moab, and the tribes of the desert. The men of these nations are circumcised, but they don't worship me. And it's the same with you people of Judah. Your bodies are circumcised, but your hearts are unchanged.
translation_verse: Mizraim ke̱ Iuda ke̱ Edom ke̱ Amonbii le̱ hũ ke̱ Moab fẽ ke̱ mei ní *eše̱šē̱ ame̱yi afãfãi ni hĩo̱ ṅã le̱ no̱ le̱ fẽ: edšake̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ fẽ le̱, fōlo̱i ni, ni Israel we le̱ fẽ le̱, †tšuiṅ fōloi ni, *

english_verse: Their religion is worthless! They chop down a tree, carve the wood into an idol,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mãdšimãdši le̱ akusumi le̱, yakayakanii ni: edšake̱ *ame̱yafoo̱ tšo ye̱ kō mli, ni ṅālo̱ ke̱ lema tšuo̱ he nii; *Ies.

english_verse: cover it with silver and gold, and then nail it down so it won't fall over.
translation_verse: ake̱ dſie̱te̱i ke̱ šika wulaäle̱, ake̱ ple̱kobii ke̱ hamle kălaä, ní ekakpo̱.

english_verse: Idols are worthless, and anyone who worships them is a fool!
translation_verse: Ame̱fē le̱ bului ke̱ kwašiai so̱ṅṅ ni: yakayakanii atšo̱semo̱, tšo ni!

english_verse: You, Lord, are the only true and living God. You will rule for all time. When you are angry the earth shakes, and nations are destroyed.
translation_verse: Ši Iehowa dši ano̱kwa Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, Nyoṅmo̱ hĩekãlo̱ ke̱ nāno̱ maṅtše̱ ni; emlifũ hãa šikpoṅ le̱ hosoo̱, ni dšeṅmãdši le̱ nyẽẽ emlila le̱ nā adamo̱.

english_verse: The waters in the heavens roar at your command. You make clouds appear— you send the winds from your storehouse and make lightning flash in the rain.
translation_verse: Kē̱ ewo egbē le̱, nu pī baä ṅwei, ni ehãa afuai tetēo̱ ši ke̱-dše̱o̱ šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbēhei le̱; efeo̱ srawai efataä nyoṅmo̱ne̱mo̱ he, ni efãa kō̱yo̱ kpo ke̱-dše̱o̱ enitōhei le̱. Lal.

english_verse: People who make idols are so stupid! They will be disappointed, because their false gods are not alive.
translation_verse: Koloi dši gbomei fẽ, ni ame̱lee nii; šikaṅālo̱-fẽ-šikaṅālo̱ hĩe egbo ye̱ emãgã hewo̱; edšake̱ emãgã ni eſie le̱, apasa ni, ni mumo̱ ni amũo̱ be̱ ame̱mli.

english_verse: Idols are merely a joke, and when the time is right, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Yakayakanii ni, hefe̱oyeli nitšumo̱ ni; ame̱sramo̱-be le̱ṅ le̱ ame̱hĩe aakpãtã.

english_verse: I said to the people of Judah, “Gather your things; you are surrounded.
translation_verse: Buamo̱ onibii le̱ anā ke̱-dše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, bo moni ohĩo̱ maṅ ní abo̱ nsra awo he le̱ mli le̱!

english_verse: The Lord said these troubles will lead to your capture, and he will throw you from this land like a rock from a sling.”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Na, agbe̱ne̱ mibafõ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ bii le̱ tamo̱ afõo̱ akromia, ni mahaoame̱, koni amenu he!

english_verse: The people answered, “We are wounded and doomed to die. Why did we say we could stand the pain?
translation_verse: Kpóo hãmi ye̱ mihedšramo̱ le̱ hewo̱! mipilamo̱ le̱ mīwa mihe; šĩ mi le̱ mikē: Mihela ni, ni *mamõ mli! *Lal.

english_verse: Our homes are destroyed; our children are dead. No one is left to help us find shelter.”
translation_verse: Mibū le̱ efite, ni mitãṅkpēi le̱ fẽ etšere̱; mibii le̱ edše mihe ete, ni ame̱be̱: mokomoko be̱ ni aaši mibū le̱ doṅṅ, lo ni eewo mibū le̱ he mamai le̱!

english_verse: But I told them, “Our leaders were stupid failures, because they refused to listen to the Lord. And so we've been scattered like sheep.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ tōkwe̱lo̱i le̱ etšṍmo̱ koloi, ni ame̱bii Iehowa ši, nohewo̱ le̱ ehĩĩ hããame̱, ni ame̱tōikui le̱ fẽ egbe eſã.

english_verse: “Sounds of destruction rumble from the north like distant thunder. Soon our towns will be ruins where only jackals live.” Jeremiah Prays
translation_verse: Ānu gbē ko, na, ēba, ke̱ hofemo̱ babaō ní dše̱ kōyigbe̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ko-ni abafe Iuda mãdši le̱ amaṅfõ ke̱ ṅãṅgbēi ašihĩle̱he!

english_verse: I know, Lord, that we humans are not in control of our own lives.
translation_verse: Iehowa, mile ake̱ gbomo gbe̱ be̱ le̱dientše̱ edeṅ, ni adesã ní nyie ne̱, bo̱-ni eetšṍ edsadše enãdšifãmo̱i ehã le̱, ebe̱ edeṅ. Abe̱i

english_verse: Correct me, as I deserve, but not in your anger, or I will be dead.
translation_verse: Iehowa, kãmi, ši bo̱ni sa ke̱ke̱, dšee ye̱ omliſũ mli, koni okaplenēmi!

english_verse: Our enemies refuse to admit that you are God or to worship you. They have wiped out our people and left our nation lying in ruins. So get angry and sweep them away!
translation_verse: *Fo̱semo̱ omlila oſie dšeṅmãdši ní leeo le̱ ke̱ wekui ni tšé̱é̱ ogbe̱i le̱ ano̱; edšake̱ ame̱tšere̱ Iakob, ni ame̱yele̱ amegbe nā kwrā, ni ame̱fe ešihĩle̱he le̱ amaṅfõ. *Lal.

english_verse: My commands haven't changed since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, a nation that seemed like a blazing furnace where iron ore is melted. I told your ancestors that if they obeyed my commands, I would be their God, and they would be my people.
translation_verse: noni miwo nyetše̱mei le̱ akitã ye̱ he, gbĩ ni midšieame̱ ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ke̱-dše̱ dade flõnõ le̱ mli le̱, ake: Nyeboa migbē toi, ni nyeyea no̱ tamo̱ bo̱ni miwonye kitã le̱ pe̱pē̱pe̱, ní nyetšṍ mimaṅ, ni matšṍ nye-Nyoṅmo̱;

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to everyone on the streets of Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah: Pay attention to the commands in my agreement with you.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱mi ake̱: Šie̱mo̱ ne̱ke̱ wiemo̱i ne̱ fẽ ye̱ Iuda mãdši le̱ ke̱ Ierusalem blohũi le̱ amli ake̱: Nyeboa ne̱ke̱ kpãṅmo̱ ne̱ wiemo̱i le̱ atoi, ni nyeyea no̱!

english_verse: have always been stubborn. You have refused to listen, and instead you have done whatever your sinful hearts have desired. You have not kept the agreement we made, so I will make you suffer every curse that goes with it.
translation_verse: Ši ame̱boo toi ni asaṅ ame̱hãã ame̱toi aba no̱ hũ, ši mofẽmo nyie etsui fõṅ le̱ wale̱ se̱. Nohewo̱ le̱ mike̱ ne̱ke̱ kpãṅmo̱ ne̱ wiemo̱i fẽ ní miwoame̱ kitã ake̱ ame̱ye no̱, ni ame̱yee no̱ le̱, eba ame̱no̱,

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Jeremiah, the people of Judah and Jerusalem are plotting against me.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱mi ake̱: Ana ake̱ Iudahĩĩ le̱ ke̱ Ierusalembii le̱ ete apãm.

english_verse: Then they will offer sacrifices to their other gods and ask them for help. After all, the people of Judah have more gods than towns, and more shameful altars for Baal than there are streets in Jerusalem. But those gods won't be able to rescue the people of Judah from disaster.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo̱ni omãdši le̱ fá le̱, nakai noṅṅ onyoṅmo̱i le̱ fá, Iuda; ni bo̱ni Ierusalem blohũi le̱ fá le̱, nakai ṅyemãmo̱ afo̱lešãlate̱i nyehã hĩegbedšianii, afo̱lešãlate̱i ni ašãa tšofã-ke̱-ṅma ahãa Baal ye̱ no̱!

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: You are my chosen people, but you have no right to be here in my temple, doing such evil things. The sacrifices you offer me won't protect you from disaster, so stop celebrating.
translation_verse: Mẽba misuole̱ le̱ tšuo̱ nihĩnii ye̱ miwe le̱? Ani siwōi ke̱ lō kroṅkroṅ aadšíe onifõdšianii le̱ ye̱ ohe, alo ootšṍ ene̱mei ano̱ odše mli? ké̱ nakai ni le̱, no le̱ omī aše̱ ohe!

english_verse: Once you were like an olive tree covered with fruit. But soon I will send a noisy mob to break off your branches and set you on fire.
translation_verse: Iehowa woö gbe̱i ake̱ mũtšo ní ebu kusū fe̱fe̱o ní woo yibii kpakpai; ši agbe̱ne̱ eke̱ hōfemo̱ gbē̱mo̱ wulu eše̱re la ewo ehe ni enidši le̱ ekũmo̱.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful. You people of Judah were like a tree that I had planted, but you have made me angry by offering sacrifices to Baal, just as the northern kingdom did. And now I'm going to pull you up by the roots. The Plot To Kill Jeremiah *
translation_verse: Ši Iehowa Zebaot ní te̱o bo le̱ ewie efõṅ ye̱ ohe, ye̱ Israel we le̱ ke̱ Iuda we le̱ efõṅ ní ame̱fe ame̱dientše̱ ame̱he, ake̱ ame̱šã tšofā-ke̱-ṅma ame̱hã Baal ni ame̱ke̱-wo mimli la le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: Some people plotted to kill me. And like a lamb being led to the butcher, I knew nothing about their plans.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa hã mile, ni miná mile hũ: no mli ohã mina ame̱nifemo̱nii le̱.

english_verse: But then the Lord told me that they had planned to chop me down like a tree— fruit and all— so that no one would ever remember me again.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱ mitamo̱ *gwanteṅbi ní he dšo̱ ni akplaäle̱ ke̱-yaä ni eyagbele̱, ni milee ake̱ ame̱to mihe ṅā fõṅ ake̱: Nyehãa wo̱fitea tšo le̱ ke̱ eno̱ yibii le̱, ni wo̱fole̱ ke̱-dše̱ hĩekãlo̱i ašikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ní akakai egbe̱i le̱ kwrakwra doṅṅ! *Ies.

english_verse: I prayed, “Lord All-Powerful, you always do what is right, and you know every thought. So I trust you to help me and to take revenge.”
translation_verse: Ši bo, Iehowa Zebaot, ní okodšoo̱ dšale̱ nā, ni okaä *sabai ke̱ tšuii okwe̱o̱, hã mana owele ní obato̱ ye̱ ame̱no̱ le̱; edšake̱ bo odeṅ mitu misane le̱ miwo! *Lal.

english_verse: Then the Lord said: Jeremiah, some men from Anathoth say they will kill you, if you keep on speaking for me.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ ne̱ke̱ Iehowa kē̱ ye̱ *Anatot hĩĩ le̱ ní taoo̱ bo amegbe ni ame̱kē̱o̱ ake̱: Kāgba ye̱ Iehowa gbe̱i le̱ ano̱, koni okatšṍ wo̱nine no̱ ogbo! le̱ ahewo̱. *

english_verse: But I will punish them. Their young men will die in battle, and their children will starve to death.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni Iehowa Zebaot kē̱ ne̱: Na, mibawoame̱ nyõmo̱ kẽ: oblahīĩ le̱ aagboi ye̱ klante nā, ame̱bihĩĩ ke̱ ame̱biyei le̱ aagboi ke̱ hõmo̱,

english_verse: And when I am finished, no one from their families will be left alive.
translation_verse: ni ašĩṅ ſē̱nõ ko ahãṅame̱; edšake̱ mike̱ efõṅ aaba Anatot hĩĩ le̱ ano̱ ye̱ ame̱sramo̱ afi le̱ mli,

english_verse: Whenever I complain to you, Lord, you are always fair. But now I have questions about your justice. Why is life easy for sinners? Why are they successful?
translation_verse: Iehowa, kē̱ mike̱o kodšo le̱, onõ dša; kẽle̱ mike̱o aatao sane nā: *Mẽhewo̱ ni meifõdšĩ agbe̱ dsaä hãaame̱ ni kùtũmpo̱foi ahe dšo̱ö̱ame̱ le̱? *Hiob

english_verse: Even your own family has turned against you. They act friendly, but don't trust them. They're out to get you, and so is everyone else. The Lord Is Furious with His People
translation_verse: Edšake̱ onyemimei le̱ ke̱ otše̱ we le̱, ame̱ tete ame̱yeo̱ ohe kũtũmpo̱o, ame̱ tete ame̱blo̱ō̱ wā ke̱-nyieo̱ ose̱; kē̱ ame̱-do̱ko̱ ame̱nā ame̱hão tete le̱, kāheame̱ oye!

english_verse: My people are like a hawk surrounded and attacked by other hawks. Tell the wild animals to come and eat their fill.
translation_verse: Ani migbe̱fãṅnõ le̱ etšṍ lōflo lōyelo̱ ke̱ ehe ṅwãtãṅwãtã ehãmi? ani lofõdši lōyelo̱i ebo̱lele̱ ke̱-kpe? nyeyaä nyeyabuaä ṅãṅ koloi fẽ nā ke̱-baä ní ame̱baye nii!

english_verse: My beautiful land is ruined like a field or a vineyard trampled by shepherds and stripped bare by their flocks.
translation_verse: Kolokwe̱lo̱i babaō efite miweintrom le̱, ame̱nānā migbe̱fãṅnõ le̱ no̱, ame̱tšṍ migbe̱fãṅnõ fe̱fe̱o le̱ ṅã kpatā.

english_verse: Every field I see lies barren, and no one cares.
translation_verse: Ame̱kpãtã ehĩe butū; eyeo̱ mihe ṅko̱mo̱, ehĩe ekpãtã, ni akpãtã šikpoṅ le̱ fẽ-kwa hĩe; ši mokomoko be̱ ní ṅõ-woo̱ etšuiṅ!

english_verse: A destroying army marches along desert roads and attacks everywhere. They are my deadly sword; no one is safe from them.
translation_verse: Hĩekpãtãlo̱i eba ṅã le̱ no̱ gõdši kpatāi le̱ fẽ no̱; edšake̱ Iehowa klante le̱ miye nii ke̱-mīdše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbēhe ke̱-yaši šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbēhe kroko le̱; helo ko helo ko be̱ hedšo̱le̱.

english_verse: My people, you planted wheat, but because I was furious, I let only weeds grow. You wore yourselves out and gained only shame! The Lord Will Have Pity on Other Nations
translation_verse: Ame̱dũ ṅmā̃, ši ame̱kpa ṅmei; ame̱gbo deṅme, ši ame̱náá se̱ ye̱ he; ni nyehĩe aagboi ye̱ nyenibānii le̱ ahewo̱ ye̱ Iehowa mlifũ ní nā wa le hewo̱.

english_verse: The Lord said: I gave this land to my people Israel, but enemies around it have attacked and robbed it. So I will uproot them from their own countries just as I will uproot Judah from its land.
translation_verse: Ne̱ke̱ Iehowa kē̱ ye̱ mihegbomei fõdsi fẽ ní taä gbe̱fãṅnõ ní mike̱-hã mimaṅ Israel ake̱ ame̱ye le̱ he le̱ ahewo̱: Na, mafãame̱ ke̱-adše̱ ame̱sikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni mafã Iuda we le̱ hũ ke̱-adše̱ ame̱teṅ!

english_verse: But later, I will have pity on these nations and bring them back to their own lands.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱, beni mifãame̱ se̱ le̱, makũ se̱ mahã mimũsũṅ atšõmi ye̱ ame̱he, ni mike̱ame̱ aakũ se̱ ke̱-aba, mo-fẽmo aaba egbe̱fãṅnõ ke̱ ešikpoṅ ne̱.

english_verse: They once taught my people to worship Baal. But if they admit I am the only true God, and if they let my people teach them how to worship me, these nations will also become my people.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱, ke̱dši ame̱akase mimaṅ le̱ gbè̱i le̱ dšogbāṅ, ni *ame̱ke̱ migbe̱i aakã kitã ake̱: Gbĩĩabo̱ ní Iehowa hĩe kã ne̱! tamo̱ bo̱ni ame̱tšõ mimaṅ le̱ Baal kitãkãmo̱ le̱, no le̱ aaṅõame̱ amãmo̱ mimaṅ le̱ teṅ. *

english_verse: However, if they don't listen to me, I will uproot them from their lands and completely destroy them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši ame̱boṅ toi le̱, no le̱ mafã nakai dšeṅmaṅ le̱ maſie, mafãame̱ ni mafiteame̱, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: “Take off the shorts. Go to Parah and hide the shorts in a crack between some large rocks.”
translation_verse: Ko̱ he̱fĩnõ ní ohe ní fĩ ohe̱ le̱, ni ote ši oya Eufrate fā le̱ nā, ni oke̱-yatē te̱sā flo̱ ko mli ye̱ dše̱i.

english_verse: I went back and dug the shorts out of their hiding place, but the cloth had rotted, and the shorts were ruined.
translation_verse: Ni miyiṅ mite Eufrate nā, ni mi-yatša ši, ni miko̱ he̱fĩnõ le̱ ke̱-dše̱ heni miṅõ-tē le̱; ni na, he̱fĩnõ le̱ efite, ehĩĩ hãã nokonoko doṅṅ.

english_verse: The people of Judah are evil and stubborn. So instead of listening to me, they do whatever they want and even worship other gods. When I am finished with these people, they will be good for nothing, just like this pair of shorts.
translation_verse: Ne̱ke̱ maṅ fõṅ ne̱ ní ekplẽẽ miwiemo̱i le̱ atoibō, ní ame̱nyieo̱ *ame̱tšui wale̱ se̱, ni ame̱nyieo̱ nyoṅmo̱i krokomei ase̱, ni ame̱súmoo̱ame̱ ni ame̱dšáaame̱ le̱, ame̱atšṍmo̱ tamo̱ ne̱ke̱ he̱fĩnõ ní ehĩĩ hãã nokonoko doṅṅ ne̱ pe̱! *

english_verse: These shorts were tight around your waist, and that's how tightly I held onto the kingdoms of Israel and Judah. I wanted them to be my people. I wanted to make them famous, so that other nations would praise and honor me, but they refused to obey me. Wine Jars The Lord said:
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo̱ni he̱fĩnõ kpe̱te̱o̱ mo he̱ le̱, nakai mihã Israel we le̱ fẽ ke̱ Iuda we le̱ fẽ kpe̱te̱ mihe, Iehowa kē̱, koni ame̱tšṍ mimaṅ ke̱ gbe̱i ke̱ yidšiemo̱ ke̱ anumnyam; ši kẽle̱ ame̱boo toi!

english_verse: Jeremiah, tell the people of Judah, “The Lord God of Israel orders you to fill your wine jars with wine.” They will answer, “Of course we fill our wine jars with wine! Why are you telling us something we already know?”
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ kē̱mo̱ame̱ ne̱ke̱ wiemo̱ ne̱: Bo̱ni Iehowa, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kē̱ ne̱: To̱-fẽ-to̱ bayi obõ ke̱ wein! Ni ame̱-akē̱o ake̱: Aso wo̱lee ake̱ to̱-fẽ-to̱ bayi obõ ke̱ wein?

english_verse: Then say to them: I am the Lord, and what I'm going to do will make everyone in Judah and Jerusalem appear to be full of wine. And the worst ones will be the kings of David's family and the priests and the prophets.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱ okē̱ame̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Na, mibahã šikpoṅ ne̱ no̱ bii le̱ fẽ ke̱ maṅtše̱mei, ní trá David sẽi le̱ no̱ le̱, ke̱ oso̱foi le̱ ke̱ gbaloi le̱ ke̱ Ierusalembii le̱ fẽ, *tŏ̱ro̱ dā̃ kpotō̱. *

english_verse: Then I will smash them against each other like jars. I will have no pity on the young or the old, and they will all be destroyed. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Will Be Taken Away
translation_verse: Ni mamõmo̱ame̱ matſiatſia ame̱he, tše̱mei ke̱ bii fẽ, Iehowa kē̱; minaṅ mo̱bo̱, ni mikõṅ mifliṅ, ni mimũsũṅ etšõṅmi ye̱ ame̱fitemo̱ le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: People of Judah, don't be too proud to listen to what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Nyeboa toi, ni nyehãa nyetoi abaä no̱! nyekawoa nyehe, edšake̱ Iehowa ewie!

english_verse: If you are too proud to listen, I will weep alone. Tears will stream from my eyes when the Lord's people are taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ nyeboo toi le̱, misusuma aafó ye̱ tēmo̱ mli ye̱ nyehewō le̱ hewo̱, ni *mihĩṅme̱i aafó āhũ, ni emli aaho nu; edšake̱ aṅõ Iehowa tōiku le̱ nom. *

english_verse: The Lord told me to tell you that your king and his mother must surrender their thrones and remove their crowns.
translation_verse: Kē̱mo̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ ke̱ maṅnye le̱ ake̱: Nyebaä nyehe ši, nyetráa ši; edšake̱ nyenumnyam *akekre le̱ edše nyeyiteṅ egbē ši! *Yāfó

english_verse: The cities in the Southern Desert are surrounded; no one can get in or out. Everyone in Judah will be taken away.
translation_verse: Aṅã́mo̱ wuoyigbe̱ mãdši le̱ anā, ni mokomoko be̱ ni aagble; aṅõ Iuda fẽ nom, aṅõ ame̱fẽ nom ke̱-te!

english_verse: You once trusted them to help, but now I'll let them rule you. What do you say about that? You will be in pain like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Ké̱ ewo mei, ní bodientše̱ otšo̱se-ame̱ ake̱ onanemei le̱, onukpai ye̱ ono̱ le̱, té obakē̱ tēṅ? Ani kō̃mo̱ etaṅ ohe tamo̱ yō ní bafo?

english_verse: Can you ever change and do what's right? Can people change the color of their skin, or can a leopard remove its spots? If so, then maybe you can change and learn to do right.
translation_verse: Ani modiṅ aanyẽ ehewolo atšake, alo kōtše̱ aanyẽ ehe ṅwãtãṅwãtã le̱ atšake? no le̱ nye hũ *nyeanyẽ ekpakpa nyefe, nye mei ní efõṅfemo̱ eka nyeno̱ le̱! *Lal.

english_verse: I will scatter you, just as the desert wind blows husks from grain tossed in the air.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ magbe̱ame̱ maſã tamo̱ tutū ní ṅãno̱ kō̱yo̱ lōo̱ ke̱-yaä!

english_verse: I won't change my mind. I, the Lord, have spoken. You rejected me and worshiped false gods. *
translation_verse: Ene̱ dši ogbe̱nā ní obaná, ogbefãṅnõ ní misusu mihão, Iehowa kē̱; edšake̱ ohĩe ekpa mino̱, ni oṅõ ohĩe ofõ amale no̱!

english_verse: You were married to me, but you were unfaithful. You even became a prostitute by worshiping disgusting gods on hilltops and in fields.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ mi hũ mawó otade nāmūi le̱ ano̱ ye̱ ohĩe, koni ana ohĩegbĕle le̱! K.

english_verse: So I'll rip off your clothes and leave you naked and ashamed for everyone to see. You are doomed! Will you ever be worthy to worship me again?
translation_verse: Mina onihĩnii ke̱ ogblãfitemo̱ ke̱ onyenyeṅtſibō̱ ke̱ odſamaṅbō̱ ní yo̱ nyãṅemo̱ le̱, ye̱ ṅãno̱ goṅkpo̱i le̱ ano̱. Kpóo hao, Ierusalem! atšūṅ ohe; mẽ beyino noṅṅ ebakã he ke̱-yaši?

english_verse: Rulers send their servants to the storage pits for water. But there's none to be found; they return in despair with their jars still empty.
translation_verse: Ame̱teṅ abladei le̱ etšũ ame̱šišibii ke̱-te nuyē̱; ame̱te nubui le̱ anā, ame̱naa nu: ame̱ke̱ ame̱gbé̱i fodši le̱ kũ ame̱se̱, ame̱hĩe egboi, ame̱hĩe eſie ši, ni ame̱ha ame̱yitšei ahe.

english_verse: My people, you love to wander away; you don't even try to stay close to me. So now I will reject you and punish you for your sins. I, the Lord, have spoken. Lying Prophets
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱o̱ ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱ ne̱: Nakai ame̱sumoo̱ šikpā, ame̱tšĩĩ ame̱nã-dši anā; nohewo̱ le̱ Iehowa náá ame̱he tšui: agbe̱ne̱ eekai ame̱nišaianii le̱, ni eewo ame̱he ešai le̱ ahe nyõmo̱.

english_verse: They may even go without eating and offer sacrifices to please me and to give thanks. But when they cry out for my help, I won't listen, and I won't accept their sacrifices. Instead, I'll send war, starvation, and disease to wipe them out.”
translation_verse: Ke̱dši ame̱hĩ ṅmā̃ le̱, miboṅ ame̱-blo̱mo̱ toi; ni ke̱dši ame̱šã šā̃-afo̱le ke̱ niyenii-afo̱le hũ, minaṅ ame̱he tšui: ši moṅ klante ke̱ hõmo̱ ke̱ gbĕle-hela mike̱-aplenēame̱ kwrā! Ies.

english_verse: I replied, “The other prophets keep telling everyone that you won't send starvation or war, and that you're going to give us peace.”
translation_verse: Ni mikē̱: Ei, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa! na, gbaloi le̱ kē̱o̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyenaṅ klante, ni hõmo̱ hũ yeṅnye, ši moṅ mahãnye hedšo̱le̱ le̱le̱ṅ ye̱ bie̱ ne̱!

english_verse: And everyone who listens to them will be killed, just as they deserve. Their dead bodies will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem, because their families will also be dead, and no one will be left to bury them.
translation_verse: Ni maṅ ní ame̱gbaä ame̱hãa-ame̱ le̱, aaše̱re̱ame̱ aſie Ierusalem blohũiaṅ ye̱ hõmo̱ ke̱ klante le̱ noṅṅ hewo̱, ni amenáṅ mokomoko *afũame̱, ame̱ ke̱ ame̱ṅãmei ke̱ ame̱bihĩĩ ke̱ ame̱biyei fẽ; ni mafo̱se ame̱nifõdšianii le̱ maſie ame̱no̱! *

english_verse: Jeremiah, go and tell the people how you feel about all this. So I told them: “Tears will flood my eyes both day and night, because my nation suffers from a deadly wound.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ kē̱mo̱ame̱ ne̱ke̱ wĩemo̱ ne̱: Hã *mihĩṅme̱iiaṅ afo̱se yāfónui aſie ši nyõṅ ke̱ ſane ni ekafõ; edšake̱ adſăra mimaṅ le̱ biyō oblayō le̱ dſăramo̱ kpeteṅkple, apilale̱ ni ehĩĩ. *

english_verse: In the fields I see the bodies of those killed in battle. And in the towns I see crowds dying of hunger. But the prophets and priests go about their business, without understanding what has happened.” Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: Ke̱dši miyiṅ mite ṅã le̱ no̱ le̱, na, mei ní enyõnyõi ye̱ klante nā ne̱! ni ke̱dši misā miba mã le̱ṅ le̱, na, mei ni hõmo̱ egbeame̱ ne̱! edšake̱ gbalo̱ ke̱ oso̱fo fẽ-tſẽm kpaä ši ye̱ šikpoṅ ní ame̱-lee no̱.

english_verse: Have you rejected Judah, Lord? Do you hate Jerusalem? Why did you strike down Judah with a fatal wound? We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Aso oše̱ Iuda ofõ kwrā, alo osusuma enyãṅe Zion? mẽhewo̱ mo̱ ni otſia-wo̱ nii ni wo̱náá tšámo̱ ne̱? *Wo̱kwe̱ hedšo̱le̱ gbe̱, ši nõkpakpa ko baa, ke̱ tšámo̱-be hũ, ši na, gbeyei so̱ṅṅ! *

english_verse: We and our ancestors are guilty of rebelling against you.
translation_verse: Iehowa, wo̱le wo̱nifõdšianii le̱ ke̱ wo̱tše̱mei le̱ anišaianii le̱; edšake̱ wo̱fe eša wo̱šio! K.

english_verse: If you save us, it will show how great you are. Don't let our enemies disgrace your temple, your beautiful throne. Don't forget that you promised to rescue us.
translation_verse: Ogbe̱i le̱ hewo̱ le̱ kākwawo̱; kāhã onumnyam sẽi le̱ he guo mīgbo; kaimo̱, ni okakũ oke̱wo̱ teṅ kpãṅmo̱ le̱ mli!

english_verse: Idols can't send rain, and showers don't fall by themselves. Only you control the rain, so we put our trust in you, the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Ani wo̱ṅdsálo̱i le̱ ayakayakawo̱dši le̱ eko ye̱ ni nyẽo̱ hãa nyoṅmo̱ ne̱o̱? alo ṅwei aanyẽ ahã nu atue? ani dšee bo, Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, noṅṅ ni? nohewo̱ le̱ bo gbe̱ wo̱kwe̱o̱; edšake̱ bo oféo̱ ene̱mei fẽ!

english_verse: This punishment will happen because of the horrible things your King Manasseh did. And you will be disgusting to all nations on earth.
translation_verse: Ni mahã agbe̱ame̱ aſã šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ maṅtše̱yelihei le̱ fẽ *ye̱ Manase, Hezekia bi, ní dši Iuda maṅtše̱ le̱, ke̱ nibii ní efe ye̱ Ierusalem le̱ ahewo̱. *

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, who will feel sorry for you? Will anyone bother to ask if you are well?
translation_verse: Edšake̱ namo aanao mo̱bo̱, Ierusalem? ni namo aayeo ṅko̱mo̱? ni namo aagba ababi ohedšo̱le̱ ši?

english_verse: My people, you abandoned me and walked away. I am tired of showing mercy; that's why I'll destroy you
translation_verse: Oše̱mi ofo, Iehowa kē̱, okũ ose̱ ke̱-te se̱se̱: nohewo̱ le̱ mikpã minine mli ye̱ ono̱, ni mafiteo; etomi ke̱ mũsũṅtšõle̱.

english_verse: by scattering you like straw blown by the wind. I will punish you with sorrow and death, because you refuse to change your ways.
translation_verse: Ni mike̱ *šātšene aaša ame̱mli ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ agbói le̱ anā; makpakpā ame̱-bii ye̱ ame̱he, mafite mimaṅ le̱, edšake̱ ame̱kũũ ame̱se̱ ke̱-dše̱e̱ ame̱gbè̱i le̱ ano̱! *Mat.

english_verse: I wish I had never been born! I'm always in trouble with everyone in Judah. I never lend or borrow money, but everyone curses me just the same.
translation_verse: Kpóo hãmi, *minye, ake̱ ofo̱mi, mi ní šikpoṅ mū le̱ fẽ ke̱mi béo̱ ni ame̱ke̱mi tāa nā! Mifeko moko noko, ni asaṅ moko hũ efakomi noko; kẽle̱ mei fẽ-kwa lomoo̱mi! *

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “I promise to protect you, and when disaster comes, even your enemies will beg you for help.” The Enemy Cannot Be Defeated The Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Iehowa kē̱: Mawoö hewale̱ ni abi ahão, le̱le̱ṅ ake̱ mahã henye̱lo̱ tete akpao fai ye̱ nõfõṅ be ke̱ fĩmo̱ be mli!

english_verse: I will give them everything you own, because you have sinned everywhere in your country.
translation_verse: Nyenii ke̱ nyedſetrii le̱, mahã aha ní awoo nyõmo̱, ye̱ nyehe ešai fẽ ní nyefe ye̱ nyekpokpai fẽ no̱ le̱ hewo̱;

english_verse: My anger is a fire that cannot be put out, so I will make you slaves of your enemies in a foreign land. Jeremiah Complains Again
translation_verse: ni mahã osúmo̱ ohenye̱lo̱i le̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ ko ni olee no̱; edšake̱ mimliſũ le̱ tamo̱ la ni aše̱re ni eetšo ye̱ nyeno̱. —

english_verse: You can see how I suffer insult after insult, all because of you, Lord. Don't be so patient with my enemies; take revenge on them before they kill me.
translation_verse: Bo, Iehowa, ole! kaimo̱mi ni osrami, ni oto̱ mihe owele ye̱ mei ní waä-mi yi le̱ ano̱; oke̱ otšui ši ni oṅmẽo̱ ohãa-ame̱ le̱ akaṅõmi ke̱-mīya; ná ole ake̱ ohewo̱ mináa ahorabō̱!

english_verse: When you spoke to me, I was glad to obey, because I belong to you, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ké̱ mina owiemo̱i le̱ *miyeo̱; owiemo̱i le̱ dši mimīše̱ ke̱ mitšui mliflimo̱; edšake̱ aṅõ ogbe̱i awomi, Iehowa, Zebaot Nyoṅmo̱. *Ezek.

english_verse: I don't go to parties and have a good time. Instead, I keep to myself, because you have filled me with your anger.
translation_verse: Mitáá fe̱oyelo̱i agwabō̱ mli mimli efliimi; onine hewo̱ le̱ mikometō mitáa ši; edšake̱ owomi obõ ke̱ mlila.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Stop talking like a fool! If you turn back to me and speak my message, I will let you be my prophet once again. I hope the people of Judah will accept what you say. But you can ignore their threats, *
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ lo̱ bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Ke̱dši okũ ose̱ le̱, no le̱ maṅõo ke̱-aba ekoṅ ní obadamo̱ mihĩe; ni ke̱dši odšie nii kro̱ṅṅi ni mũdši be̱ mli le̱, no le̱ ootamo̱ minābu! Ame̱ ame̱akũ ame̱se̱ ke̱-aba oṅõ, ši bo le̱ okũṅ ose̱ ke̱-yaṅ ame̱ṅõ.

english_verse: because I am making you strong, like a bronze wall. They are evil and violent, but when they attack,
translation_verse: Ni *maṅõo mafe akō̱ble gbogbo ní wa mahã ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱, ni ame̱ke̱o aawu, ši ame̱nyẽṅo; edšake̱ mike̱o ye̱ ni mahere oyiwala, ni madšieo, Iehowa kē̱. *

english_verse: I will be there to rescue you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ni madšieo ke̱-adše̱ meifõdši adeṅ, ni makpõo ke̱-adše̱ yiwalo̱i adeṅ.

english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa wiemo̱ le̱ ba miṅõ ake:

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't get married and have children—Judah is no place to raise a family.
translation_verse: Kākpē yō ní oná bihĩĩ lo biyei ye̱ bie̱ ne̱!

english_verse: They will die of horrible diseases and of war and starvation. No one will give them a funeral or bury them, and their bodies will be food for the birds and wild animals. And what's left will lie on the ground like manure.
translation_verse: Gbĕle-hela ní pīo̱ mo aagbeame̱, afeṅ ame̱yăra ni afũṅame̱ hũ: ame̱atšṍ tumu ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni ame̱aplenē ye̱ klante ke̱ hōmo̱ nā, ni ame̱gbohĩĩ le̱ aatšṍmo̱ ṅwei lofõdši ke̱ šikpoṅ no̱ koloi aniyenii.

english_verse: When someone dies, don't visit the family or show any sorrow. I will no longer love or bless or have any pity on the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Kā-bote yāfó šĩa le̱, ni kãya yăra no̱, ni asaṅ kāyeame̱ ṅko̱mo̱; edšake̱ midšie mihedšo̱le̱ le̱ ke̱ mlihĩle̱ ke̱ mũsũṅtšõle̱ le̱ ke̱-dše̱ ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱ no̱, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: Rich and poor alike will die and be left unburied. No one will mourn and show their sorrow by cutting themselves or shaving their heads.
translation_verse: Ni mei wudši ke̱ mei bibii fẽ aagboi ye̱ šikpoṅ ne̱ no̱: afũṅame̱, ni afeṅ ame̱-yăra, ni moko bãmo̱ṅ ehe, ni asaṅ moko kpo̱ṅ eyi hãṅame̱;

english_verse: Warn the people of Judah that I, the Lord All-Powerful, will put an end to all their parties and wedding celebrations.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo̱ni Iehowa Zebaot, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kē̱ ne̱: Na, *mahã nyã́mo̱ ke̱ mīše̱ gbē ke̱ ayemforowu ke̱ ayemforo gbē se̱ afo ye̱ bie̱ ne̱, ye̱ nyehĩe ke̱ nyeyino̱ ne̱. *

english_verse: They will ask, “Why has the Lord our God threatened us with so many disasters? Have we done something wrong or sinned against him?”
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱, ké̱ odšadše wiemo̱i ne̱ fẽ otšõ ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱ ni ame̱bio ake̱: Mẽhewo̱ po ni Iehowa wie ne̱ke̱ efõṅ kpeteṅkple ne̱ fẽ ye̱ wo̱he, alo meni dši wo̱nõša, ni meni dši wo̱he eša ní wo̱fe wo̱ši Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱?

english_verse: Then tell them I have said: People of Judah, your ancestors turned away from me; they rejected my laws and teachings and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: no le̱ kē̱me̱ame̱ ake̱: Edšake̱ nyetše̱mei le̱ kwami, Iehowa kē̱, ni ame̱ya-nyie nyoṅmo̱i krokomei ase̱, ni ame̱súmo̱ame̱, ni ame̱dšáame̱, ši mi le̱ ame̱kwami, ni mimla le̱ hũ ame̱yee no̱,

english_verse: And you have done even worse! You are stubborn, and instead of obeying me, you do whatever evil comes to your mind.
translation_verse: ni nye le̱, nyefe efõṅ fè nyetše̱mei le̱; edšake̱ na, nyeteṅ mofẽmo nyiee̱ etšui fõṅ le̱ wale̱ se̱, ni nyeboomi toi: —

english_verse: So I will throw you into a land that you and your ancestors know nothing about, a place where you will have to worship other gods both day and night. And I won't feel the least bit sorry for you.
translation_verse: nohewo̱ le̱ maše̱re̱nye ke̱-adše̱ šikpoṅ ne̱ no̱ maſie šikpoṅ ko ní nye ke̱ nyetše̱mei le̱ lee no̱, ni nyeasúmo̱ nyoṅmo̱i krokomei ſane ke̱ nyōṅ ye̱ dše̱i, edšake̱ minaṅnye mo̱bo̱.

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living Lord who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ na, gbĩĩ mība, Iehowa kē̱, ní akē̱ṅ doṅṅ ake̱: Gbĩĩabo̱ kẽ ní Iehowa ní dšie Israelbii le̱ ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ke̱-ba le̱ hĩe kã ne̱!

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living Lord who rescued you from that country in the north and from the other countries where I had forced you to go. Someday I will bring you back to this land that I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: ši moṅ: Gbĩĩabo̱ kẽ ní Iehowa ní dšie Israelbii le̱ ke̱-dše̱ kōyigbe̱ šikpoṅ le̱ ne̱ ke̱ šikpõdši fẽ ní eſieame̱ ke̱-te no̱ le̱ ano̱ ke̱-ba ekoṅ le̱ hĩe kã ne̱! Ni mayaṅõame̱ ke̱-aba ame̱sikpoṅ ní miṅõ-hā ame̱tše̱mei le̱ no̱ ekoṅ.

english_verse: But for now, I am sending enemies who will catch you like fish and hunt you down like wild animals in the hills and the caves.
translation_verse: Na, matšũ wole̱i pī ke̱-ba, Iehowa kē̱, ní ame̱bahe̱ame̱; ni no se̱ le̱ matšũ gbo̱bilo̱i pī ke̱-ba ní ame̱bagbo̱biame̱ ye̱ goṅ-fẽ-goṅ no̱ ke̱ goṅkpo̱-fẽ-goṅkpo̱ no̱ ke̱ te̱sā-fo̱dši amli.

english_verse: I can see everything you are doing, even if you try to hide your sins from me.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mihĩṅme̱ii dſere ame̱gbè̱i fẽ no̱: aṅōkoame̱ atēko ke̱-dše̱ko mihĩe, ni atšĩmo̱ko ame̱nišaianii le̱ ano̱ ye̱ mihĩe.

english_verse: I will punish you double for your sins, because you have polluted my own land. You have filled it with lifeless idols that remind me of dead bodies. The Lord Gives Strength I prayed to the Lord:
translation_verse: Ši tšutšu le̱ mawo ame̱nišaianii ke̱ ame̱he esa le̱ he nyõmo̱ toi enyo̱; edšake̱ ame̱ke̱ ame̱tãṅtãṅnii le̱ agbohĩï le̱ ebule mišikpoṅ le̱, ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱nihĩnii le̱ ewo migbe̱fãṅnõ le̱ obõ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the one who gives me strength and protects me like a fortress when I am in trouble. People will come to you from distant nations and say, “Our ancestors worshiped false and useless gods,
translation_verse: Iehowa, mihewale̱ ke̱ mō̃ ní wa ke̱ mibobāhe ye̱ fĩmo̱ gbĩ no̱! bo noṅṅ oṅõ dšeṅmãdši le̱ aadše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbēhei aba abakē̱ ake̱: Wo̱tše̱mei le̱ agbošinii ní ame̱ná le̱, amale ke̱ke̱ ni, ke̱ yakayakanii ní se̱námo̱ ko be̱ṅ!

english_verse: worthless idols made by human hands.”
translation_verse: Aso gbomo aafe nyoṅmo̱i ni dšee nyoṅmo̱i ahã ehe?

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “That's why I will teach them about my power, and they will know that I truly am the Lord.”
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, na, mahã ame̱ná ame̱-le, šikome ne̱, mahã ame̱ná ame̱le minine ke̱ mihewale̱ le̱, koni ame̱ná ame̱le ake̱ migbe̱i dši Iehowa!

english_verse: You will lose the land that I gave you, and I will make you slaves in a foreign country, because you have made my anger blaze up like a fire that won't stop burning. Trust the Lord
translation_verse: Ni bodientše̱ ooṅmē̃, ono̱yelinõ ní miṅõhão le̱ he ofõ ši, ni mahã osúmo̱ ohenye̱lo̱i ye̱ šikpoṅ ko ní olee no̱; edšake̱ nyeše̱re *la ye̱ mimlifũ le̱ mli, ni eetšo ke̱-ate nāno̱! *

english_verse: You people of Judah are so deceitful that you even fool yourselves, and you can't change.
translation_verse: Tšui yo̱ ne̱, eyi to̱ ke̱ kũtũmpo̱o fè nii fẽ, ni esane ehĩĩ kwrā; namo aanyẽ ale?

english_verse: Our Lord, your temple is a glorious throne that has stood on a mountain from the beginning.
translation_verse: Bo anumnyam maṅtše̱sẽi ní mã ši godšō ke̱-dše̱ tetēte, wo̱hekroṅkroṅ le̱ mā̃he:

english_verse: You, Lord, are the one I praise. So heal me and rescue me! Then I will be completely well and perfectly safe.
translation_verse: Tšámi, Iehowa, ni mihe aatã; heremo̱ miyiwala, ni miyi aaná wala; ši bo dši miyidšiemo̱!

english_verse: The people of Judah say to me, “Jeremiah, you claimed to tell us what the Lord has said. So why hasn't it come true?”
translation_verse: Na, ame̱kē̱o̱mi ake̱: Nẽgbe̱ Iehowa wĩemo̱ le̱ yo̱? hā ní eba ko! Ies.

english_verse: Our Lord, you chose me to care for your people, and that's what I have done. You know everything I have said, and I have never once asked you to punish them.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, midšieko mihe ye̱ tōkwe̱-mo̱ nitšumo̱ ní mitšuo̱ ke̱-nyieo̱ ose̱ le̱ mli, ni musu gbĩ le̱ hũ miſee, bodientše̱ ole! noni dšee̱ minā le̱, edſere ohĩe!

english_verse: I trust you for protection in times of trouble, so don't frighten me.
translation_verse: Kātšṍ hegbeyeiwōnõ ohāmi, bo dši mibobāhe ye̱ gbĩ fõṅ no̱!

english_verse: Keep me from failure and disgrace, but make my enemies fail and be disgraced. Send destruction to make their worst fears come true. Resting on the Sabbath
translation_verse: Hã mei ní waämi yi le̱ ahĩe agboi, ši mi le̱, kāhã mihĩe mīgbo kwrā; hã ame̱tšui afã, ši mi le̱ kāhã mitsui mīfã: oke̱ gbĩ fõṅ le̱ aba ame̱no̱, oke̱ hĩekpãtãmo̱ toi enyo̱ akpãtã ame̱hĩe!

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, stand at each city gate in Jerusalem, including the one the king uses, and speak to him and everyone else. Tell them I have said: I am the Lord, so pay attention.
translation_verse: ni okē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyeboa Iehowa wiemo̱ toi, nye Iuda maṅtše̱mei ke̱ Iuda fẽ ke̱ Ierusalembii le̱ fẽ ní tšṍo̱ ne̱ke agbói ne̱ amli ke̱-baä mli le̱!

english_verse: If you value your lives, don't do any work on the Sabbath. Don't carry anything through the city gates or through the door of your house, or anywhere else. Keep the Sabbath day sacred! I gave this command to your ancestors, but they were stubborn and refused to obey or to be corrected. But if you obey,
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake, ke̱dši nyebomi toi le̱le̱ṅ, Iehowa kē̱, ní nyeke̱ dšatšu ko dšatšu ko tsṍṍ mã ne̱ṅ agbó le̱ṅ ke̱-baa mli ye̱ hedšō̱mo̱gbĩ lo̱ no̱, ši moṅ nyefe hedšō̱mo̱gbĩ le̱ kroṅkroṅ ni nyetšun nitšumo̱ ko nitšumo̱ ko yo̱ no̱ le̱:

english_verse: then Judah and Jerusalem will always be ruled by kings from David's family. The king and his officials will ride through these gates on horses or in chariots, and the people of Judah and Jerusalem will be with them. There will always be people living in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: no le̱ maṅtše̱mei ke̱ lume̱i ní trá David maṅtše̱sẽi le̱ no̱ le̱ aatrá ſīlii amli ke̱ okpo̱ṅo̱i ano̱ ke̱-atšṍ mã ne̱ṅ agbói le̱ amli ke̱-aba mli, ame̱ ke̱ ame̱lumei ke̱ Iudahĩĩ ke̱ Ierusalembii le̱, ni maṅ ne̱ ahĩ ši ke̱-ate nāno̱.

english_verse: and others will come here from the nearby villages, from the towns of Judah and Benjamin, from the hill country and the foothills to the west, and from the Southern Desert. They will bring sacrifices to please me and to give me thanks, as well as offerings of grain and incense.
translation_verse: Ni aadše̱ Iuda mãdši le̱ amli ke̱ hei ní bole Ierusalem le̱ ke̱ Benyamin šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ke̱ ṅãno̱ ke̱ gõdši le̱ ano̱ ke̱ wuoyigbe̱ le̱, ni aahĩe šā̃-afo̱lei ke̱ gbē-afo̱lei ke̱ niyenii-afo̱lei ke̱ kro̱bo̱o ke̱-aba, ni ake̱ yidšiemo̱-afo̱lei aaba Iehowa we le̱.

english_verse: But if you keep on carrying things through the city gates on the Sabbath and keep treating it as any other day, I will set fire to these gates and burn down the whole city, including the fortresses.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši nyeboṅmi toi, ní nyeafe hedšō̱mo̱gbĩ le̱ kroṅkroṅ, ni nyekatĕre dšatšu ko dšatšu ko ke̱-mītšṍ Ierusalem agbói le̱ amli ye̱ hedšō̱mo̱gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱: no le̱ maše̱re la ye̱ egbói le̱ amli, ni eešã Ierusalem mõdši le̱, ni anyẽṅ agbe.

english_verse: And whenever the clay would not take the shape he wanted, he would change his mind and form it into some other shape.
translation_verse: Ni beni šō̃nõ ní gbe̱šõlo̱ le̱ ke̱ sũ le̱ feo̱ le̱ fite ye̱ edeṅ le̱, esā eṅõ-fe nõ kroko, bo̱ni sa gbe̱šõlo̱ le̱ hĩe ake̱ eefe.

english_verse: but its people start disobeying me and doing evil, then I will change my mind and not help them at all.
translation_verse: ke̱dši efe efõṅ ye̱ mihĩe ni eboo migbē toi le̱, no le̱ maſa mihe ye̱ nõkpakpa ní mikē̱ mike̱-afeame̱ edšŭrõ le̱ he!

english_verse: So listen to me, people of Judah and Jerusalem! I have decided to strike you with disaster, and I won't change my mind unless you stop sinning and start living right.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ agbe̱ne̱ kē̱mo̱ Iudahĩĩ le̱ ke̱ Ierusalembii le̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Na, misusu efõṅ ye̱ nyehe, ni mito miyiṅ efõṅ ye̱ nyehe! nohewo̱ lo̱ *nyeteṅ mofẽmo akũ ese̱ ke̱-dše̱ egbe̱ fõṅ le̱ no̱, ni nyesāa nyegbè̱i ke̱ nyeni-femo̱nii le̱! *

english_verse: But I know you won't listen. You might as well answer, “We don't care what you say. We have made plans to sin, and we are going to be stubborn and do as we please!”
translation_verse: Ši ame̱kē̱o̱ ake̱: *Dabida! ši moṅ wo̱o̱nyie wo̱dientše̱ wo̱yiṅtōi le̱ ase̱, ni wo̱teṅ mofẽmo aafe †etšui fõṅ le̱ wale̱ nā nii! *

english_verse: So I, the Lord, command you to ask the nations, and find out if they have ever heard of such a horrible sin as what you have done.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Nyebia ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ, namo enu ene̱ eko dã? Gbeyei nibii Israel oblayō le̱ feo̱ ne̱!

english_verse: Your land will be ruined, and every passerby will look at it with horror and make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: koni afe ame̱šikpoṅ le̱ amaṅfõ ke̱ noni aahã abo tšia dā; mofẽmo ní aaho ye̱ dše̱i le̱, ehe aadšõ ehe, ni eehoso eyitšo.

english_verse: When your enemies attack, I will scatter you like dust blown by an eastern wind. Then, on that day of disaster, I will turn my back on you. The Plot against Jeremiah
translation_verse: Magbe̱ame̱ maſã tamo̱ bokã kō̱yo̱ ye̱ ame̱henye̱lo̱i le̱ ahĩe; ame̱manehũlũ gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ *mise̱ moṅ matšṍ mahãame̱ ši dšee mihĩe. *

english_verse: Some of the people said, “Let's get rid of Jeremiah! We will always have priests to teach us God's laws, as well as wise people to give us advice, and prophets to speak the Lord's messages. So, instead of listening to Jeremiah any longer, let's accuse him of a crime.” Jeremiah Prays about His Enemies
translation_verse: Ši ame̱kē̱o̱ ake̱: Nyebaä ni wo̱yaä Ieremia yi no̱ adšina; edšake̱ mla ebo̱ṅ oso̱ſo, ni ṅāwō ebo̱ṅ nilelo̱, ni wiemo̱ ebo̱ṅ gbalo̱! Nyebaä ni nyehãa wo̱tſaä-le̱ lile̱i, ni nyekahãa wo̱dia ewiemo̱i le̱ ekomeflo se̱!

english_verse: Please, Lord, answer my prayer. Make my enemies stop accusing me of evil.
translation_verse: Di mise̱, Iehowa, ni obo mei ní ke̱mi béo̱ le̱ agbē toi!

english_verse: I tried to help them, but they are paying me back by digging a pit to trap me. I even begged you not to punish them.
translation_verse: Aso aṅõo̱ efõṅ atoo̱ ekpakpa nãdšiaṅ? edšake̱ *ame̱tsa bu ame̱hã misusuma. Kaimo̱ ake̱ midamo̱ ohĩe ní mawie ekpakpa mahãame̱, ní makpale omlila le̱ ke̱-dše̱ ame̱no̱! *Lal.

english_verse: But now I am asking you to let their children starve or be killed in war. Let women lose their husbands and sons to disease and violence.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ dšiemo̱ ame̱bii le̱ ohã hõmo̱, ni otuame̱ owo klante deṅ, ni akpakpā ame̱ṅãmei le̱ abii ye̱ ame̱he, ni ame̱tšṍmo̱ okũlafoi, ni gbĕle agbe ame̱wùmei le̱, ni ame̱blahĩĩ le̱, abãmo̱ame̱ klante ye̱ ta mli!

english_verse: These people have dug pits and set traps for me, Lord. Make them scream in fear when you send enemy troops to attack their homes.
translation_verse: Hã anu blo̱mo̱ ye̱ ame̱šĩai, beni oke̱ ta aaba ame̱no̱ trukā lo̱: edšake̱ ame̱tša bu ni ame̱ke̱-dũmi, ni ame̱tšõ̀ minãdši tšõnei ame̱ṅõ-tē.

english_verse: So watch out! Someday this place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley!
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ na, gbĩĩ mība, Iehowa kē̱, ni atšé̱ṅ bie̱ ne̱ Tofet lo Hinom bi le̱ dšō̱ doṅṅ, ši moṅ aatšé̱le̱ awuyeli dšō̱.

english_verse: I will turn Jerusalem into a pile of rubble, and every passerby will be shocked and horrified and will make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: ni mahã maṅ ne̱ atšṍ amaṅfõ ke̱ noni hãa aboo̱ tšia: *mofẽmo ní aaho ye̱ dše̱i le̱ ehe aadšõ ehe ni eebo tšia ye̱ ame̱manehũlũ le̱ so̱ṅṅ hewo̱. *

english_verse: And while your enemies are trying to break through your city walls to kill you, the food supply will run out. You will become so hungry that you will eat the flesh of your friends and even of your own children.
translation_verse: Ni mahã *ame̱ye ame̱bihĩĩ alō ke̱ ame̱biyei alō, ni ame̱teṅ mofẽmo aaye enanyo lō, ye̱ yisamo̱ ke̱ fĩmo̱ ní ame̱henye̱lo̱i le̱ ke̱ mei ní taoo̱ ame̱susuma se̱gbe̱ le̱ bahã afĩame̱ le̱ mli! *

english_verse: Jeremiah, as soon as you have said this, smash the jar while the people are watching.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni odſa kpulu le̱ ye̱ hĩĩ le̱ ni ke̱o yaä le̱ ahĩe,

english_verse: Then tell them that I have also said: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I warn you that I will shatter Judah and Jerusalem just like this jar that is broken beyond repair. You will bury your dead here in Topheth, but so many of you will die that there won't be enough room.
translation_verse: ni okē̱ame̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Iehowa Zebaot kē̱ ne̱: *Ne̱ke̱ noṅṅ madſa ne̱ke̱ maṅbii ne̱ ke̱ ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱, take̱ bo̱ni adſaä gbe̱šõlo̱ gbé̱ ní ehĩĩ tšăramo̱ doṅṅ le̱; ni aafũame̱ ye̱ †Tofet, edšake̱ gbe̱ be̱ hekoheko doṅṅ. *Ies.

english_verse: I will make Jerusalem as unclean as Topheth, by filling the city with your dead bodies. I will do this because you and your kings have gone up to the roofs of your houses and burned incense to the stars in the sky, as though they were gods. And you have given sacrifices of wine to foreign gods. Jeremiah Speaks in the Temple Courtyard
translation_verse: Ni Ierusalem šĩai le̱ ke̱ Iuda maṅtše̱mei le̱ ašĩai le̱ aabuleame̱ tamo̱ heni Tofet yo̱ le̱, šĩai le̱ fẽ ni ame̱šãšā̃ tšofã-ke̱-ṅma ye̱ *ame̱yiteaṅ ame̱bã ṅwei asafo le̱ fẽ, ni ame̱ye ṅkpai ye̱ mli ame̱hã nyoṅmo̱i krokomei le̱.

english_verse: I went to Topheth, where I told the people what the Lord had said. Then I went to the temple courtyard and shouted to the people,
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni beni Ieremia dše̱ Tofet, heni Iehowa tšũle̱ ake̱ eyagba le̱, eba ni ebadamo̱ Iehowa we le̱ kpo le̱ no̱, ni ekē̱ maṅ mū le̱ fẽ ake̱:

english_verse: “Listen, everyone! Some time ago, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, warned you that he would bring disaster on Jerusalem and all nearby villages. But you were stubborn and refused to listen. Now the Lord is going to bring the disaster he promised.”
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa Zebaot, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kē̱ ne̱: Na, mike̱ efõṅ fẽ ní miwie ye̱ ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱ ke̱ ehe mãdšimãdši le̱ fẽ he le̱ baba ame̱no̱, edšake̱ ame̱fe ame̱he kue̱ṅtilo̱i, koni ame̱kabo miwiemo̱i le̱ atoi.

english_verse: and so he hit me. Then he had me arrested and put in chains at the Benjamin Gate in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Pašhur yi gbalo̱ Ieremia, ni ebo̱le apã ye̱ yiteṅgbe̱ Benyamin agbó ní yo̱ Iehowa we le̱ he le̱ mli.

english_verse: Pashhur, you are guilty of telling lies and claiming they were messages from me. That's why I will let the Babylonians take you, your family, and your friends as prisoners to Babylonia, where you will all die and be buried. Jeremiah Complains to the Lord
translation_verse: Ni bo, Pašhur, ke̱ ošĩabii fẽ aate nomṅō̃ mli, ni oote Babel, ni dše̱i oogbo ye̱, ni dše̱i noṅṅ aafũo ye̱, bo ke̱ onanemei le̱ fẽ ní ogba amale gbale̱ otšõame̱ le̱!

english_verse: Sometimes I tell myself not to think about you, Lord, or even mention your name. But your message burns in my heart and bones, and I cannot keep silent.
translation_verse: Ni ké̱ mikē̱ ake̱: Mitšĩṅ etã, ni miwieṅ ye̱ egbe̱i ano̱ doṅṅ le̱, etšṍ tamo̱ la ní tšoo̱ ye̱ mitšui mli, ni aṅã́ yi awo miwui amli; enātšī̃ etomi, ni minyẽẽ.

english_verse: Lord All-Powerful, you test those who do right, and you know every heart and mind. I have told you my complaints, so let me watch you take revenge on my enemies.
translation_verse: Ši bo, Iehowa Zebaot, ní okaä dšalo̱ okwe̱o̱, ni onaä sabai ke̱ tšui amli nii: hã mana owele ni obato̱ ye̱ ame̱no̱; edšake̱ bo odeṅ mitu misane le̱ miwo.

english_verse: I sing praises to you, Lord. You rescue the oppressed from the wicked.
translation_verse: Nyelaä nyehãa Iehowa, nyedšiea Iehowa yi! edšake̱ edšie ohĩafo susuma ke̱-dše̱ efõṅfelo̱i adeṅ!

english_verse: Put a curse on the day I was born! Don't bless that day.
translation_verse: Alomo̱ gbĩ ní afo̱mi ye̱ no̱ le̱; akadšō̱ gbĩ ni minye fo̱mi ye̱ no̱ le̱!

english_verse: Put a curse on the man who told my father, “Good news! You have a son.”
translation_verse: Alomo̱ nū ní hĩe sane kpakpa ke̱-bahã mitše̱ ake̱: Afo̱ binū ahão! ni ehã ená mīše̱ naakpa le̱!

english_verse: May that man be like the towns you destroyed without pity. Let him hear shouts of alarm in the morning and battle cries at noon.
translation_verse: Hã ní nakai nū le̱ etšṍ *tamo̱ mãdši ní Iehowa ebutuame̱ ní eſaa ehe le̱; hã enu blomo̱ lebi ke̱ ošebō̱ hū ſane! *

english_verse: He deserves to die for not killing me before I was born. Then my mother's body would have been my grave.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ egbeemi ye̱ mũsũṅ, ní kũ-le̱ minye atšṍ migbonyobu, ni mũsũ le̱ ahĩ ehe ke̱-ya nāno̱!

english_verse: Why did I have to be born? Was it just to suffer and die in shame?
translation_verse: Mẽhewo̱ po ni midše̱ mũsũṅ midše kpo, ní mibana deṅmegbomo̱ ke̱ aw̌ere̱-hō, ní migbĩĩ atã kwrā ke̱ hĩegbẽle ne̱?

english_verse: King Zedekiah of Judah sent for Pashhur son of Malchiah and for a priest named Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. Then he told them, “Talk with Jeremiah for me.” So they came to me and said,
translation_verse: Wiemo̱ ní dše̱ Iehowa ṅõ ba Ieremia ṅõ ne̱, beni maṅtše̱ Zedekia tšũ Pašhur, Malkia bi le̱, ke̱ oso̱fo *Zefania, Maaseia bi le̱, ke̱-ba eṅõ amebakē̱ ake̱: *

english_verse: Then I told them that the Lord had said: People of Jerusalem, I, the Lord, give you the choice of life or death.
translation_verse: Ni ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱ hũ okē̱ame̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: *Na, mihĩe wala gbe̱ ke̱ gbĕle gbe̱ mīſie nyehĩe! *

english_verse: The Babylonian army has surrounded Jerusalem, so if you want to live, you must go out and surrender to them. But if you want to die because of hunger, disease, or war, then stay here in the city.
translation_verse: Moni aahĩ mã ne̱ṅ le̱, eegbo ye̱ klante ke̱ hõmo̱ ke̱ gbĕle-hela nā; šĩ mo moṅ ní aadše kpo, ní eyagbē Kaldeabii ní ebo̱ nsra ewo nyehe le̱ adeṅ le̱, eyi aaná wala, ni esusuma aatšṍ hānõ ahãle.

english_verse: I have decided not to rescue Jerusalem. Instead, I am going to let the king of Babylonia burn it to the ground. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Warns the King of Judah *
translation_verse: Edšake̱ midšie mihĩe mika maṅ ne̱ ye̱ efõṅ gbe̱ ni dšee ekpakpa gbe̱, Iehowa kē̱; aatule̱ awo Babel maṅtše̱ le̱ deṅ, ni eke̱ la aašãle̱.

english_verse: Pay attention, you that belong to the royal family.
translation_verse: Ni Iuda maṅtše̱ le̱ we le̱, kē̱mo̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyeboa Iehowa wiemo̱ le̱ toi!

english_verse: Each new day, make sure that justice is done, and rescue those who are being robbed. Or else my anger will flame up like a fire that never goes out.
translation_verse: David we, bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Nyekodšoa dšale̱ nā dā lebi, ni *nyedšiea moni ahaäle̱ le̱ ke̱-dše̱a amimyelo̱ le̱ deṅ, koni †mimlila le̱ akadše kpo tamo̱ la, ní etšo ní moko nyẽẽ agbe, ye̱ nyenifemo̱nii fõdši le̱ ahewo̱! *

english_verse: Jerusalem, from your mountaintop you look out over the valleys and think you are safe. But I, the Lord, am angry,
translation_verse: Na, mike̱o ená, bo moni ohĩo̱ dšō̱ le̱ṅ ke̱ ṅã kplanā le̱ no̱ te̱sā le̱ no̱, Iehowa kē̱; nye mei ní nyekē̱o̱ ake̱: Namo aabatuawo̱? ni namo aabote wo̱šihĩle̱hei le̱?

english_verse: and I will punish you as you deserve. I'll set your palace on fire, and everything around you will go up in smoke.
translation_verse: ni mawonye nyõmo̱ ye̱ nyenifemo̱nii le̱ ayibii le̱ anā, Iehowa kē̱, ni maše̱re la ye̱ ekō le̱ mli, ni eešã nibii fẽ ní ebo̱lele̱ ke̱-kpe le̱!

translation_verse: Edšake̱ midšie mihĩe mika maṅ ne̱ ye̱ efõṅ gbe̱ ni dšee ekpakpa gbe̱, Iehowa kē̱; aatule̱ awo Babel maṅtše̱ le̱ deṅ, ni eke̱ la aašãle̱.

english_verse: Pay attention, you that belong to the royal family.
translation_verse: Ni Iuda maṅtše̱ le̱ we le̱, kē̱mo̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyeboa Iehowa wiemo̱ le̱ toi!

english_verse: Each new day, make sure that justice is done, and rescue those who are being robbed. Or else my anger will flame up like a fire that never goes out.
translation_verse: David we, bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Nyekodšoa dšale̱ nā dā lebi, ni *nyedšiea moni ahaäle̱ le̱ ke̱-dše̱a amimyelo̱ le̱ deṅ, koni †mimlila le̱ akadše kpo tamo̱ la, ní etšo ní moko nyẽẽ agbe, ye̱ nyenifemo̱nii fõdši le̱ ahewo̱! *

english_verse: Jerusalem, from your mountaintop you look out over the valleys and think you are safe. But I, the Lord, am angry,
translation_verse: Na, mike̱o ená, bo moni ohĩo̱ dšō̱ le̱ṅ ke̱ ṅã kplanā le̱ no̱ te̱sā le̱ no̱, Iehowa kē̱; nye mei ní nyekē̱o̱ ake̱: Namo aabatuawo̱? ni namo aabote wo̱šihĩle̱hei le̱?

english_verse: and I will punish you as you deserve. I'll set your palace on fire, and everything around you will go up in smoke.
translation_verse: ni mawonye nyõmo̱ ye̱ nyenifemo̱nii le̱ ayibii le̱ anā, Iehowa kē̱, ni maše̱re la ye̱ ekō le̱ mli, ni eešã nibii fẽ ní ebo̱lele̱ ke̱-kpe le̱!

english_verse: Listen to what I think about it: The palace of Judah's king is as glorious as Gilead or Lebanon's highest peaks. But it will be as empty as a ghost-town when I'm through with it.
translation_verse: Ši bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ye̱ Iuda maṅtše̱ le̱ we le̱ he ne̱: Gilead dšio hãmi, ke̱ Lebanon yitšo moṅ! ši kẽle̱ mahã otšṍ ṅãno̱ ke̱ mãdši ní moko be̱ mli kẽ!

english_verse: I'll send troops to tear it apart, and its beautiful cedar beams will be used for firewood.
translation_verse: Ni madšie fitelo̱i mawoö, mofẽmo aahĩe etawūnii, ni ame̱atō otšenedrui fe̱fe̱dši le̱ ame̱ſie ši, ni ame̱aše̱re̱ame̱ ame̱ſie la mli.

english_verse: People from different nations will pass by and ask, “Why did the Lord do this to such a great city as Jerusalem?”
translation_verse: Ni dšeṅmãdši pī aabatšṍ maṅ ne̱ he ke̱-ho, ni ame̱teṅ mofẽmo aake enanyo ake̱: Mẽhewo̱ ni Iehowa fe maṅ kple ne̱ ne̱ke̱?

english_verse: That's what it means to truly know me. So he lived a comfortable life and always had enough to eat and drink.
translation_verse: Eye nõnalo̱ ke̱ ohĩafo sane ehãle̱, ni ehĩ ehãle̱! Ani dšee ene̱ dši lē ní aleo̱mi le̱? Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: But all you think about is how to cheat or abuse or murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Ši bo le̱ ohĩṅme̱ii ke̱ otšui kãã nokonoko no̱, ake̱ ose̱námo̱ ke̱ moni efeko noko le̱ lá šiſiemo̱ ke̱ amimyeli ke̱ yiwale̱ no̱ pe̱ ekã.

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, the nations you trusted have been crushed. Go to Lebanon and weep; cry in the land of Bashan and in Moab.
translation_verse: Kwo̱ ke̱-ya Lebanon ní oyablo̱, ni owó ogbē no̱ ye̱ Bašan, ni oblo̱ ke̱-dše̱ Abarim; edšake̱ akpãtã osuolo̱i le̱ fẽ ahĩe!

english_verse: Now you will be disgraced because of your sins. Your leaders will be swept away by the wind, and the nations you trusted will be captured and dragged to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Kō̱yo̱ aalè̱ otōkwe̱lo̱i le̱ fẽ, ni osuolo̱i le̱ aate nomṅō̃ mlĩ: ni *ohĩe aagbo ni ohĩe aaſie ši ye̱ onifõdšianii le̱ fẽ hewo̱. *

english_verse: Those who live in the palace paneled with cedar will groan with pain like women giving birth.
translation_verse: Bo moni ohĩo̱ Lebanon, ní ofe otšũ ye̱ tšenedrui ateṅ, ké̱ kō̃mo̱ ke̱ hedšramo̱ ni tamo̱ yō ní bafo̱ nõ le̱ ba ono̱ le̱, onii aafe mo̱bo̱ pi!

english_verse: I would hand you over to the enemy you fear, to King Nebuchadnezzar and his army, who want to kill you.
translation_verse: ni matao mawo mei ni taoo̱ osusuma se̱gbe̱ le̱ ke̱ mei ní ošeo̱ame̱ gbeyei ko̱kō̱ko̱ le̱ adeṅ, ke̱ Nebukadnezar, Babel maṅtše̱ le̱, ke̱ Kaldeabii le̱ adeṅ!

english_verse: You and your mother were born in Judah, but I will throw both of you into a foreign country, where you will die,
translation_verse: Ni *maše̱o ke̱ onye ní fo̱o le̱ mafõ šikpoṅ kroko no̱ heni dšee dše̱i afo̱nye ye̱, ni dšei noṅṅ nyeagboi ye̱: *

english_verse: Jehoiachin, you are unwanted like a broken clay pot. So you and your children will be thrown into a country you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Ani šō̃nõ ní abuu ní edſa dši ne̱ke̱ nū Konia ne̱? alo šō̃nõ ko ní asumo̱o̱ dšile̱? Mẽhewo̱ mo̱ ni aſieo̱ame̱, le̱ ke̱ eseši le̱, ni aše̱re̱o̱ame̱ aſieo̱ šikpoṅ ko ní ame̱lee le̱ no̱ ne̱?

english_verse: Land of Judah, I am the Lord. Now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Ō šikpoṅ, šikpoṅ, šikpoṅ, bo Iehowa wiemo̱ toi!

english_verse: Erase the names of Jehoiachin's children from the royal records. He is a complete failure, and so none of them will ever be king. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Nyeṅmãa ye̱ ne̱ke̱ nū ne̱ gbe̱i anā ake̱ ebe̱ bi, nū ko ní ſereṅ ye̱ egbĩĩ fẽ mli; edšake̱ esešinyo ko esešinyo ko ſereṅ, ní eetá David maṅtše̱sẽi le̱ no̱, ní esā eeye Iuda no̱ hũ doṅṅ!

english_verse: You were supposed to take care of my people, but instead you chased them away. So now I'll punish you severely and make you pay for your crimes!
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni Iehowa, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kē̱ ye̱ kwe̱lo̱i ni lè̱o̱ mimaṅ le̱ hewo̱ ne̱: Nyegbe mitōi le̱ nyeſã, ni nyeſieame ke̱-te, ni nyeyataooame̱: na, mibawonye nyeniſemo̱nii fõdši le̱ ahe nyõmo̱! Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living God who rescued you from the land in the north and from all the other countries where I had forced you to go. And you will once again live in your own land. Jeremiah Thinks about Unfaithful Prophets
translation_verse: ši moṅ: Gbĩĩabo̱ kẽ ní Iehowa, ní dšie Israel we le̱ seši le̱ ke̱-dše̱ kōyigbe̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ke̱ šikpõdši fẽ ní miſieame̱ ke̱-te no̱ le̱ no̱ ke̱-ba ni ame̱bahĩ ame̱dientše̱ ame̱šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱, hĩe kã ne̱!

english_verse: Don't listen to the lies of these false prophets, you people of Judah! The message they preach is something they imagined; it did not come from me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa Zebaot kē̱ ne̱: Nyekaboa gbalo̱i ní gbaā tšõo̱nye le̱ awie-mo̱i le̱ atoi! edšake̱ *ame̱hãa nyedũo̱ gbe̱ ke̱-yaä yakayakanii ahe; ame̱tšuiiaṅ ninā ame̱wieo̱, dšee noni dše̱ Iehowa dāṅ. *

english_verse: These prophets go to people who refuse to respect me and who are stubborn and do whatever they please. The prophets tell them, “The Lord has promised everything will be fine.”
translation_verse: Dāne̱ ame̱kē̱o̱ mei ní gbeo̱ mihe guo̱ le̱ ake̱: Iehowa kē̱ ake̱: Nyeaná hedšo̱le̱! Ni mofẽmo ni *nyieo̱ le̱dientše̱ etsui wale̱ se̱ le̱, ame̱kē̱o̱le̱ ake: Nõfõṅ komeflo baṅ nyeno! *

english_verse: But I, the Lord, tell you that these prophets have never attended a meeting of my council in heaven or heard me speak.
translation_verse: Ši namo damo̱ Iehowa adšina le̱ṅ, ni ena ni enu ewiemo̱ le̱? Namo bo miwiemo̱ le̱ toi ni enu? Ies.

english_verse: They are evil! So in my anger I will strike them like a violent storm.
translation_verse: Na, Iehowa lasũogbĕle le̱ ní dši emlifũ le̱ edše kpo, lasũogbĕle ní tšõ̀moo̱ ni, ni eebo̱le meifõdši ayitsei ahe.

english_verse: If they had been in a meeting of my council in heaven, they would have told you people of Judah to give up your sins and come back to me.
translation_verse: Ši edši ame̱damo̱ midšina le̱ṅ kũle̱, ame̱ahã mimaṅ le̱ anu miwiemo̱i le̱, ni ame̱akpaleame̱ ke̱-adše̱ ame̱gbe̱ fõṅ le̱ ke̱ amenifemo̱nii fõdši le̱ ahe!

english_verse: in heaven and on earth. There are no secret places where you can hide from me.
translation_verse: Ani moko aanyẽ atē ehe ye̱ tēmo̱hei komei, ní minaṅle̱ lo? Iehowa kē̱. Ani miyii ṅwei ke̱ ši-kpoṅ fẽ obõ lo? Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim that I have given them a dream or a vision, and then they tell lies in my name.
translation_verse: Minu noni gbaloi ní gbaä amale gbale̱ ye̱ migbe̱i amli le̱ kē̱o̱ ake̱: Mila lamõ ko, mila lamõ ko! le̱.

english_verse: But everything they say comes from their own twisted minds. How long can this go on?
translation_verse: Mẽ beyino̱ noṅṅ po ni ene̱ aahĩ gbaloi le̱ atšuiṅ ni ame̱agba amale gbale̱, ni ame̱agba ame̱tšuiṅ šišiumo̱ ke̱-yaši?

english_verse: They tell each other their dreams and try to get my people to reject me, just as their ancestors left me and worshiped Baal.
translation_verse: Ame̱taoo̱ ní ame̱ke̱ ame̱lamõi ní ame̱teṅ mofẽmo gbaä enanyo le̱ ahã mimaṅ le̱ hĩe akpa migbe̱i le̱ ano̱, take̱ bo̱ni ame̱tše̱mei le̱ ahĩe kpa migbe̱i le̱ ane̱ ye̱ Baal hewo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Their dreams and my truth are as different as straw and wheat. But when prophets speak for me, they must say only what I have told them.
translation_verse: Gbalo̱ ní ela lamõ ko le̱, hã ní egba lamõ le̱, ni moni hĩe miwiemo̱ le̱, hĩ ní ewie miwiemo̱ le̱ ano̱kwale mli! Mẽ bō̱ yo̱ gbetšeli ke̱ able teṅ? Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: My words are a powerful fire; they are a hammer that shatters rocks.
translation_verse: Ani miwiemo̱ le̱ etamo̱o̱ la? Iehowa kē̱, ni etamo̱o̱ hamle ní dſăraä te̱sā wo̱tšo̱wo̱tšo̱? Heb.

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim I give them their dreams, but it isn't true. I didn't choose them to be my prophets, and yet they babble on and on, speaking in my name, while stealing words from each other. And when my people hear these liars, they are led astray instead of being helped. So I warn you that I am now the enemy of these prophets. I, the Lord, have spoken. News and Nuisance The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Na, mike̱ gbalo̱i ní gbaä amale lamõi le̱ ená, Iehowa kē̱, mei ní dšadšeo̱ ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱male ke̱ ame̱yakaſā̃i hãa mimaṅ le̱ dũo̱ gbe̱ le̱; ši mitšũko-ame̱ ni miwokoame̱ kitã ko, hewo le̱ ame̱he be̱ se̱námo̱ kwrā hã ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱l Iehowa kē̱. K.

english_verse: Jeremiah, when a prophet or a priest or anyone else comes to you and asks, “Does the Lord have news for us?” tell them, “You people are a nuisance to the Lord, and he will get rid of you.”
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱ lo gbalo̱ le̱ alo oso̱fo ko bio ake̱: Mẽ dši Iehowa dšatšu le̱? no le̱ kē̱mo̱ame̱ ake̱: Nye noṅṅ nyedši dšatšu le̱, ni maše̱nye ma-fõ! Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: If any of you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” I will punish you and your families, even if you are a prophet or a priest.
translation_verse: Ni gbalo̱ le̱ ke̱ oso̱fo le̱ ke̱ maṅ le̱ ní kē̱o̱ ake̱: Iehowa dšatšu le̱! mawo nakai gbomo le̱ ke̱ ewe le̱ nyõmo̱.

english_verse: Instead, you must ask your friends and relatives, “What answer did the Lord give?” or “What has the Lord said?”
translation_verse: Bo̱ni nyeteṅ mofẽmo akē̱ enanyo, ni nyeteṅ mofẽmo akē̱ enyemi ne̱: “Mẽ hetō Iehowa hã, ni té Iehowa kē̱ tēṅ?”

english_verse: It seems that you each have your own news! So if you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” you are twisting my words into a lie. Remember that I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ši Iehowa dšatšu le̱, nyekatšĩa tã doṅṅ; edšake̱ mofẽmo wiemo̱ aatšṍ dšatšu ahãle̱, edšake̱ nyetšake Nyoṅmo̱ hĩekãlo̱, Iehowa Zebaot, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, wiemo̱i le̱ ahĩe!

english_verse: If you go to a prophet, it's all right to ask, “What answer did the Lord give to my question?” or “What has the Lord said?”
translation_verse: Bo̱ni okē̱ gbalo̱ le̱ ne̱: Mẽ hetō Iehowa hão, ni té Iehowa kē̱ tēṅ?

english_verse: I will pick you up and throw you far away. And I will abandon this city of Jerusalem that I gave to your ancestors.
translation_verse: nohewo̱ le̱, na, mawó nyeno̱ ni maše̱re̱nye ke̱ maṅ le̱ ní miṅõ-hãnye ke̱ nyetše̱mei le̱ maſie ke̱-adše̱ mihĩe;

english_verse: You will never be free from your shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: ni mike̱ *nāno̱ ahorabō̱ ke̱ nāno̱ hĩegbĕle ní hĩe edšeṅ no̱ gbĩkogbĩko aaṅmẽ nyeno̱!

english_verse: One basket was full of very good figs that ripened early, and the other was full of rotten figs that were not fit to eat.
translation_verse: Kafũ kome le̱ agbāmii kpakpai dientše̱, ni tamo̱ agbãmii ni tšu kleṅkleṅ, yo̱ mli; ši kafũ kroko le̱ agbãmii gbohĩĩ dientše̱, ní hĩ ní ame̱hĩĩ so̱ṅṅ nā le̱ ame̱hĩĩ yeli, yo̱ mli.

english_verse: “Jeremiah,” the Lord asked, “what do you see?” “Figs,” I said. “Some are very good, but the others are too rotten to eat.”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iehowa kē̱mi ake̱: *Meni onaä ne̱, Ieremia? Ni mikē̱: Agbãmii; agbãmii kpakpai le̱, ame̱hĩ naakpa dientše̱, ši gbohĩĩ le̱, ame̱hĩĩ kwrā, ni hĩ ní ame̱hĩĩ so̱ṅṅ nā le̱ ame̱hĩĩ yeli. *

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iehowa wiemo̱ ba miṅõ ake̱:

english_verse: People of Judah, the good figs stand for those of you I sent away as exiles to Babylonia,
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kē̱ ne̱: Bo̱ni agbãmii kpakpai ne̱ yo̱ le̱, nakai makwe̱ Iuda nomi le̱ ní midšie-ame̱ ke̱-dše̱ bie̱ ke̱-te Kaldeabii le̱ ašikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ni mafeame̱ ekpakpa;

english_verse: where I am watching over them. Then someday I will bring them back to this land. I will plant them, instead of uprooting them, and I will build them up, rather than tearing them down.
translation_verse: ni mahã mihĩṅme̱ii akã ame̱he ni mafeame̱ ekpakpa, ni mike̱ame̱ aakũ se̱ ke̱-aba ne̱ke̱ šikpoṅ ne̱ no̱, ni *mamã-mo̱ame̱ ni mikũmo̱ṅame̱, ni mate̱oame̱ ni mifãino̱ṅame̱; *

english_verse: I will give them a desire to know me and to be my people. They will want me to be their God, and they will turn back to me with all their heart.
translation_verse: ni mahãame̱ tšui ní ame̱ke̱-lemi, ake̱ midši Iehowa! Ni ame̱atšṍ mimaṅ ni mi hũ matsṍ ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱; edšake̱ ame̱ke̱ ame̱tšui mū le̱ fẽ aakũ ame̱se̱ ke̱-aba miṅõ.

english_verse: The rotten figs stand for King Zedekiah of Judah, his officials, and all the others who were not taken away to Babylonia, whether they stayed here in Judah or went to live in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ši *bo̱ni agbãmii gbohĩĩ ne̱, ni ehĩĩ yeli ye̱ hĩ ní ame̱hĩĩ so̱ṅṅ nā le̱, yo̱ le̱, le̱le̱ṅ, bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱, nakai mafe Zedekia, Iuda maṅtše̱ le̱, ke̱ elumei le̱ ke̱ Ierusalem mei ní eſe̱, ní yo̱ ne̱ke̱ šikpoṅ ne̱ no̱ le̱, ke̱ mei ní hĩo̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱. *

english_verse: I will punish them with a terrible disaster, and everyone on earth will tremble when they hear about it. I will force the people of Judah to go to foreign countries, where they will be cursed and insulted.
translation_verse: Ni maṅõame̱ mahã ní agbe̱ame̱ aſã ake̱ nõfõṅ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ maṅtše̱yeli-hei le̱ fẽ, ní ame̱tsṍmo̱ *ahorabō̱ ke̱ abe̱-bunõ, kpã-lamo̱nõ ke̱ lōmo̱ ye̱ hefẽhe ní maſieame̱ ke̱-ate le̱. *

english_verse: War and hunger and disease will strike them, until they finally disappear from the land that I gave them and their ancestors.
translation_verse: Ni mahã klante ke̱ hõmo̱ ke̱ gbĕle-hela abote ame̱teṅ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní ame̱atã kwrā ye̱ šikpoṅ ní miṅõ-hãame̱ ke̱ ame̱tše̱mei le̱ no̱.

english_verse: They told you that the Lord had said: Change your ways! If you stop doing evil, I will let you stay forever in this land that I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: ekē̱o̱ ake̱: Agbe̱ne̱ nyeteṅ mofẽmo *akũ ese̱ ke̱-dše̱ egbe̱ fõṅ le̱ no̱ ke̱ nyenifemo̱nii fõdši le̱ ahe, ní nyehĩ šikpoṅ ní Iehowa ṅõ-hãnye ke̱ nyetše̱mei le̱ ke̱-dše̱ nāno̱ āhũ ke̱-yaši nāno̱ le̱ no̱! *

english_verse: My servant Jeremiah has told you what I said I will do to Babylonia and to the other nations, and he wrote it all down in this book. I will do everything I threatened.
translation_verse: Ni mahã miwiemo̱i fẽ ni miwie ye̱ šikpoṅ ne̱ he le̱ aba eno̱, nii fẽ ni aṅmã ye̱ wolo ne̱ mli ní Ieremia gba ye̱ dšeṅmãdší le̱ ahe le̱:

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel showed me a vision in which he said, “Jeremiah, here is a cup filled with the wine of my anger. Take it and make every nation drink some.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo̱ni Iehowa, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kē̱mi ne̱: Hemo̱ ne̱ke̱ *mlifũ wein kpulu ne̱ ye̱ midẽ, ni †ohã dšeṅmãdši fẽ ní mitšũo̱o ame̱ṅõ le̱ anu, *

english_verse: I started with Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, and the king and his officials were removed from power in disgrace. Everyone still makes insulting jokes about them and uses their names as curse words.
translation_verse: ame̱dši Ierusalem ke̱ Iuda mãdši le̱ ke̱ emaṅtše̱mei le̱ ke̱ elumei le̱, koni ahã ame̱tšṍmo̱ ole̱ṅle̱ ke̱ amaṅfõ ke̱ noni hãa aboo̱ tšia ke̱ lōmo̱, take̱ bo̱ni eyo̱ ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱;
