translation_verse: ni Iuda mei ní eſe̱ ní ete Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ eyato gbo̱ ye̱ dše̱i le̱ ateṅ mokomoko edšeṅ mli lo eſe̱ṅ, ní ame̱akũ ame̱se̱ ke̱-aba Iuda šikpoṅ le̱ ní ame̱ſeo̱ ake̱ ame̱akũ ame̱se̱ ame̱bahĩ dše̱i le̱ no̱; edšake ame̱kũṅ ame̱se̱, ake̱ dša mei ní aadše mli komei ke̱ke̱!

english_verse: A large number of Jews from both northern and southern Egypt listened to me as I told them what the Lord had said. Most of the men in the crowd knew that their wives often burned incense to other gods. So they and their wives shouted:
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni hĩĩ fẽ ní le ake̱ ame̱ṅãmei šãa tšofã-ke̱-ṅma ame̱hãa nyoṅmo̱i krokomei le̱, ke̱ yei fẽ nī damo̱ dše̱i le̱, asafo babaō dientše̱, ke̱ maṅ mū le̱ fẽ ní yo̱ *Patros ye̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ lo̱ to he ame̱hã Ieremia ake̱: *Ies.

english_verse: Jeremiah, what do we care if you speak in the Lord's name? We refuse to listen!
translation_verse: Wiemo̱ ní owie otšõwo̱ ye̱ Iehowa gbe̱i ano̱ ne̱, wo̱boo bo toi;

english_verse: But since the time we stopped burning incense and offering wine sacrifices to her, we have been dying from war and hunger.
translation_verse: ši ke̱-dše̱ beyino̱ ní wo̱fō tšofã-ke̱-ṅma šã ke̱ ṅkpaiyeli ke̱ ṅwei maṅnye le̱ hãmo̱ ne̱, nofẽno hĩaäwo̱, ni wo̱mītã ye̱ klante ke̱ hõmo̱ nā.

english_verse: Then the women said, “When we lived in Judah, we worshiped the Queen of Heaven and offered sacrifices of wine and special loaves of bread shaped like her. Our husbands knew what we were doing, and they approved of it.”
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ ke̱dši wo̱mīšã tšofä-ke̱-ṅma wo̱mīhã ṅwei maṅnye le̱ ni wo̱mīye ṅkpai wo̱mīhãle̱ le̱, ani wo̱wùmei le̱ lee mli ni wo̱kwe̱o̱ esubãṅ no̱ wo̱šĩo̱ tatalei ni wo̱yeo̱ ṅkpai wo̱hāale̱ le̱ lo?

english_verse: Don't you think the Lord knew that you and your ancestors, your leaders and kings, and the rest of the people were burning incense to other gods in Jerusalem and everywhere else in Judah?
translation_verse: Nto tšofã-ke̱-ṅma ní nye ke̱ nyetše̱mei ke̱ nyemaṅtše̱mei ke̱ nyelumei ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ bii le̱ šãšãi ye̱ Iuda mãdši le̱ amli ke̱ Ierusalem blohũi le̱ amli le̱, nomei Iehowa ekai ni eba edſẽṅmo̱ mli ne̱!

english_verse: And when he could no longer put up with your disgusting sins, he placed a curse on your land and turned it into a desert, as it is today.
translation_verse: Iehowa nyẽẽ nyenifemo̱nii fõdši ke̱ nihĩnii ní nyefe le̱ doṅṅ le̱, nohewo̱ nyešikpoṅ le̱ etšṍ amaṅfõ ke̱ nākpe̱nõ ke̱ lōmo̱, ni mokomoko be̱ dše̱i, tamo̱ bo̱ni yo̱ ṅme̱ne̱ ne̱!

english_verse: This disaster happened because you worshiped other gods and rebelled against the Lord by refusing to obey him or follow his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Ake̱-ní nyešãšā̃ tšofã-ke̱-ṅma ni nyefe eša nyeši Iehowa, ni nyeboo Iehowa gbē toi, ni nyenyiee emla ke̱ egbe̱nāi ke̱ edasei le̱ amli le̱, nohewo̱ ošrã ne̱ ebašrãnye, tamo̱ bo̱ni yo̱ ṅme̱ne̱ ne̱!

english_verse: Then I told the men and their wives, that the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, had said: Here in Egypt you still keep your promises to burn incense and offer sacrifices of wine to the so-called Queen of Heaven.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa Zebaot, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kē̱ ne̱: Nye ke̱ nyeṅãmei le̱ nyeke̱ nyenābu ewie, ni nyeke̱ nyenidši ehã eba mli ake̱: Wo̱ši ní wo̱wowoi ake̱ wo̱o̱šã tšofã-ke̱-ṅma wo̱hã ṅwei maṅnye le̱ ni wo̱o̱ye ṅkpai wo̱hãle̱ le̱, dša wo̱ye no̱! Bĕle̱ nyeyea nyešiwōi le̱ ano̱, ni nyefea bo̱ni nyewo ši le! K.

english_verse: Keep these promises! But let me tell you what will happen. As surely as I am the Lord God, I swear that I will never again accept any promises you make in my name.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyeboa Iehowa wiemo̱ toi, nye Iuda fẽ ní yo̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱! Na, mikã migbe̱i wulu le̱ kitã, Iehowa kē̱, ake̱ Iudanyo ko Iudanyo ko ke̱ enābu etšĩṅ migbe̱i atã ake̱: “Gbĩĩabo̱ ní Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa hĩe kã ne̱!” ye̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ mū le̱ fẽ no̱ doṅṅ!

english_verse: Instead of watching over you, I will watch for chances to harm you. Some of you will die in war, and others will starve to death.
translation_verse: Na, mīši ame̱he kpe ye̱ efõṅ gbe̱ ni dšee ekpakpa gbe̱, ni Iudafoi fẽ ni yo̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ aaplenē ye̱ klante ke̱ hõmo̱ nā ke̱-yaši beyino ní ame̱atāãkwrā!

english_verse: Only a few will escape and return to Judah. Then everyone who went to live in Egypt will know that when I say something will happen, it will—no matter what you say.
translation_verse: Ni mei fiō ke̱ke̱ dši mei ní aadše klante le̱ nā *akū ame̱se̱ ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ke̱-ba Iuda šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni Iuda mei ní eſe̱ le̱ fẽ ni ete Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ eyato gbo̱ ye̱ dše̱i le̱ aaná ale mo wiemo̱ ní aamã ši šiṅṅ, minõ dšio, ame̱nõ dšio! *Ies.

english_verse: And here is how you will know that I will keep my threats to punish you in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ni ene̱ aafe okadi ahãnye, Iehowa kē̱, ake mawonye nyõmo̱ ye̱ bie̱ ne̱, beni afe ni nyená nyele ake̱ miwiemo̱i le̱ aaba mli ahãnye ye̱ efõṅ gbe̱:

english_verse: I will hand over King Hophra of Egypt to those who want to kill him, just as I handed Zedekiah over to Nebuchadnezzar, who wanted to kill him.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Na, maṅõ Farao Hofra, Mizraim maṅtše̱ le̱, mawo ehenye̱lo̱i ke̱ mei ní taoo̱ esusuma se̱gbe̱ le̱ adeṅ, take̱ bo̱ni miṅõ Zedekia, Iuda maṅtše̱ le̱, miwo *Nebukadnezar, Babel maṅtše̱ le̱, ni dši ehenye̱lo̱ ke̱ moni taoo̱ esusuma se̱gbe̱ le̱, deṅ le̱! *

english_verse: Then later, the Lord God of Israel told me to say to Baruch:
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kē̱ ye̱ bo, Baruk, ohe ne̱:

english_verse: You are moaning and blaming me, the Lord, for your troubles and sorrow, and for being so tired that you can't even rest.
translation_verse: Okē̱ ake̱: Mīhã mihe kpóo, edšake̱ Iehowa eṅõ aw̌ere̱hō efata minõnä le̱ he! Eto̱mi ke̱ ntšo̱idõmo̱, ni mináá hedšō̱mo̱!

english_verse: But all over the earth I am tearing down what I built and pulling up what I planted.
translation_verse: Kē̱mo̱le̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Na, noni mimã le̱, mi noṅṅ mikũmoo̱ ne̱, ni noni mite̱o le̱, mi noṅṅ mifãmoo̱ ne̱, ni nakai dši šikpoṅ mū le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: I am bringing disaster everywhere, so don't even think about making any big plans for yourself. However, I promise that wherever you go, I will at least protect you from death. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ni bo le̱ nii wudši otaoo̱ ohã ohe? Kātao! Edšake̱ na, mike̱ efõṅ aaba helo fiā no̱, Iehowa kē̱; ši maṅõ *osusuma mahão ake̱ hānõ ye̱ hefẽhe ní ootšṍ. *

english_verse: The Lord often told me what to say about the different nations of the world. What the Lord Says about Egypt
translation_verse: Iehowa wiemo̱ ní ba gbalo̱ Ieremia ṅõ ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ahewo̱ ne̱:

english_verse: It's time to go into battle! So grab your shields,
translation_verse: Nyesāa tše̱ṅi bibii ke̱ tše̱ṅi wudši, ni nyefãa ta!

english_verse: saddle your horses, and polish your spears. Put on your helmets and armor, then take your positions.
translation_verse: Nyewoa okpo̱ṅo̱i le̱ anii ni nyetráa no̱, nye okpo̱ṅo̱iatše̱mei! Nyebumo̱a nyedadefai ke̱-damo̱a ši, nyetšumo̱a akplo̱i le̱ ahe kãṅkãṅ, ni nyewoa nyedamai le̱!

english_verse: You are strong and run fast, but you can't escape. You fall in battle near the Euphrates River.
translation_verse: Heoyátše̱ náṅ gbe̱ adšo foi, ni kãkãlo̱ hũ edšeṅ mli: ame̱tĕ̱re̱tĕ̱re̱i ni ame̱nyõnyõi ye̱ kōyigbe̱ ye̱ Eufrate fã le̱ nā!

english_verse: What nation is this, that rises like the Nile River overflowing its banks?
translation_verse: Namo dši moni efã ke̱-baã tamo̱ Nilo, ni emli nui le̱ tšõ̀mo̱ö̱ tamo̱ fāi ne̱?

english_verse: Go ahead, Egypt. Tell your chariots and cavalry to attack and fight hard. Order your troops to march out, with Ethiopians and Libyans carrying shields, and the Lydians armed with bows and arrows.
translation_verse: Nye okpo̱ṅo̱i, nyefãa ke̱-ba ni nye ſīlii, nyewoa foi ke̱-baä, ni nyehãa kãkãlo̱i le̱ adšea kpo, Kušbii ke̱ Putbii ní hĩeo̱ tše̱ṅi, ke̱ Ludbii ní hĩeo̱ gãii ní ame̱dŏ̱ro̱ö̱ le̱!

english_verse: When King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia was on his way to attack Egypt, the Lord sent me with a warning for every Egyptian town, but especially for Migdol, Memphis, and Tahpanhes. He said to tell them: Prepare to defend yourselves! Everywhere in your nation, people are dying in war.
translation_verse: Nyedšadšea ye̱ Mizraim, ni nyešie̱a ye̱ Migdol, ni nyešie̱a ye̱ Nof ke̱ Takpanes nyekē̱a: Damo̱ ši ní awa, ni ofĩ ši šiṅṅ; ši klante miye nii ke̱-mībo̱leo!

english_verse: I have struck down your mighty god Apis and chased him away.
translation_verse: Té aye tẽṅ ní atšire̱ ohewalo̱i le̱ atſia ši ne̱? Ame̱damo̱o̱ ši, edšake̱ Iehowa etšire̱ame̱ etſia ši.

english_verse: Your soldiers stumble over each other and say, “Get up! The enemy will kill us, unless we can escape to our own land.”
translation_verse: Ehã mei pī etĕ̱re̱tĕ̱re̱i, moko egbē moko no̱, ni ame̱kē̱: Te ši ní wo̱kũ wo̱se̱ ke̱-ya wo̱maṅbii aṅõ ke̱ šikpoṅ heni afo̱wo̱ ye̱ le̱ no̱ ye̱ yiwale̱ klante le̱ hewo̱!

english_verse: Give the king of Egypt this new name, “Talks-Big-Does-Nothing.”
translation_verse: Ame̱blo̱ ye̱ dše̱i ake̱: Farao, Mizraim maṅtše̱ le̱, elādše; ehã ebe ní sa le̱ eho!

english_verse: Egypt, I am the true king, the Lord All-Powerful, and as surely as I live, those enemies who attack will tower over you like Mount Tabor among the hills or Mount Carmel by the sea.
translation_verse: Gbĩĩabo̱ ni mihĩe kã ne̱, — maṅtše̱ le̱, mo gbe̱i ní dši Iehowa Zebaot le̱, kē̱, — take̱ bo̱ni Tabor yo̱ ye̱ gõdši ateṅ, ke̱ bo̱ni Karmel yo̱ ye̱ ṅšo̱nā le̱, nakai ebaba!

english_verse: You will be led away captive, so pack a few things to bring with you. Your capital, Memphis, will lie empty and in ruins.
translation_verse: Sāmo̱ ohe ohã gbe̱fā̃, bo Mizraim biyō ni oyo̱ dše̱i; edšake̱ Nof batšṍ amaṅfõ, ni abašãle̱, ní moko ehĩṅ mli doṅṅ!

english_verse: An enemy from the north will attack you, beautiful Egypt, like a fly biting a cow.
translation_verse: Tšinabiyō ní he yo̱ fe̱o naakpa dši Mizraim; ši ofo̱i dše̱ kōyigbe̱ miba, ēba!

english_verse: The foreign soldiers you hired will turn and run. But they are doomed, like well-fed calves being led to the butcher. *
translation_verse: Epāfoi ní yo̱ eteṅ le̱ tamo̱ tšinabii ní ewo fo̱; ši ame̱ hũ ame̱tšṍ ame̱he ame̱dšo foi ke̱-te tſẽm, ame̱damo̱o̱ ši; edšako̱ ame̱plenēmo̱ gbĩ le̱ ke̱ ame̱sramo̱-be le̱ eninaame̱.

english_verse: The enemy army will go forward like a swarm of locusts. Your troops will feel helpless, like a snake in a forest
translation_verse: Egbē̱mo̱ tamo̱ onũfũ ní nyieo̱; edšake̱ ame̱ke̱ ta nyie ke̱-mība, ni ame̱ke̱ lemai mība eno̱, tamo̱ tšotōlo̱i.

english_verse: when men with axes start chopping down trees. It can only hiss and try to escape.
translation_verse: Ame̱agba ekō le̱, Iehowa kē̱, edšake̱ hĩṅme̱i kplee ame̱no̱; edšake̱ ame̱yi fá fè bālabii ní alee ame̱yibo̱.

english_verse: Your people will be disgraced and captured by the enemy from the north.
translation_verse: Awo Mizraim biyō le̱ hĩegbĕle po; atule̱ awo kōyigbe̱ maṅ le̱ deṅ!

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. Soon I will punish the god Amon of Thebes and the other Egyptian gods, the Egyptian kings, the people of Egypt, and everyone who trusts in the Egyptian power.
translation_verse: Iehowa Zebaot, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kē̱: Na, mibawo Amon ní dše̱ No le̱ nyõmo̱, ke̱ Farao ke̱ Mizraim ke̱ *enyoṅmo̱i le̱ ke̱ emaṅtše̱mei le̱, ke̱ Farao ke̱ mei ní hĩe kã eno̱ le̱, *

english_verse: I will hand them over to King Nebuchadnezzar and his army. But I also promise that Egypt will someday have people living here again, just as it had before. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Will Bring Israel Home The Lord said:
translation_verse: ni maṅõame̱ mawo mei ní taoo̱ ame̱susuma le̱ adeṅ, ke̱ Nebukadnezar, Babel maṅtše̱ le̱, ke̱ etšũdši le̱ adeṅ; ši kẽ́ fe se̱ le̱ eehĩ ši tamo̱ blema le̱, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: Israel, don't be afraid. Someday I will bring you home from foreign lands. You and your descendants will live in peace and safety, with nothing to fear.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, kāše gbeyei, *mitšũlo̱ Iakob, ní otšui akafã, Israel! Ši na, mahere oyiwala ke̱-adše̱ šoṅṅ, ke̱ oseši hũ ke̱-adše̱ ame̱nomṅō̃ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni Iakob aakũ ese̱ ke̱-aba ekoṅ, ni eebi ši kpō ni ehe aadšo̱le̱, ni moko woṅ ehe gbeyei. *

english_verse: So don't be afraid, even though now you deserve to be punished and have been scattered among other nations. But when I destroy them, I will protect you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Kāše gbeyei, mitšũlo̱ Iakob, Iehowa kē̱; edšake̱ mike̱o ye̱. Edšake̱ mafite dšeṅmãdši ni migbe̱o miſã ame̱teṅ le̱ fẽ ke̱-mõ ši, ši bo le̱ mifiteṅo ke̱-mõṅ ši; ši moṅ magbla otoi bo̱ni sa ke̱ke̱, ni mihäṅ oṅõ ohe oye kwrā.

english_verse: When you hear the thunder of horses and chariots, your courage will vanish, and parents will even abandon their own children.
translation_verse: Ekpo̱ṅo̱i hewalo̱i le̱ akoklotoi ašišīmo̱ gbē̱mo̱ le̱ ke̱ eſīlii le̱ agbē̱mo̱ le̱ ke̱ eſīlii anādsi le̱ ahōfemo̱ le̱ hewo̱ le̱, tše̱mei tete tšṍmo̱ṅ ame̱he kwe̱ṅ ame̱bii, ame̱nidšiaṅ edše wui,

english_verse: You ask how long will I continue to attack you with my sword, then you tell me to put it away and leave you alone.
translation_verse: Ao, Iehowa klante, mẽ beyino̱ noṅṅ ohe aadšo̱? Kũ ose̱ oyaho̱ ohebo le̱ mli! Dšō̱mo̱ ohe ni ofe kpō!

english_verse: But how can my sword rest, when I have commanded it to attack Ashkelon and the seacoast?
translation_verse: Ní Iehowa efã́o ewo Aškelon ke̱ ṅšo̱ le̱ nā he ne̱, té aafe tēṅ ní ohe aadšo̱ṅ? dše̱i noṅṅ eto ehãle̱!

english_verse: No one honors you, Moab. In Heshbon, enemies make plans to end your life. My sword will leave only silence in your town named “Quiet.”
translation_verse: Moab yidšiemo̱ le̱ be̱ doṅṅ; ame̱to ehe ṅā fõṅ ye̱ Hešbon ake̱: “Nyebaä ní wo̱plenēale̱ ní ekafe dšeṅmaṅ doṅṅ!” Bo Madmen hũ, aakpãtã ohĩe; klante aanyie ose̱!

english_verse: The people of Horonaim will cry for help, as their town is attacked and destroyed.
translation_verse: Blo̱mo̱ gbē dše̱ Horonaim, fitemo̱ ke̱ hĩekpãtãmo̱ kpeteṅkple!

english_verse: I want you to kill the Moabites, and if you let them escape, I will put a curse on you.”
translation_verse: Alomo̱ moni tšuo̱ Iehowa nitšumo̱ dšabedšabe, ni alomo̱ moni tšĩo̱ eklante le̱ nā ke̱-dse̱o̱ lá he!

english_verse: But now, I will send enemies to pour out the wine and smash the jars!
translation_verse: Hewo le̱, na, gbĩĩ mība, Iehowa kē̱, ni matšũ fo̱selo̱i ke̱-aba eno̱, ni ame̱afo̱sele̱ ni ame̱atšṍmo̱ enibii le̱ amli nii, ni ame̱adſăradſărā eto̱i le̱ hũ.

english_verse: Then you will be ashamed, because your god Chemosh cannot save you, just as Bethel could not help the Israelites.
translation_verse: Ni Moab hĩe aagbo ye̱ Kemoš he, take̱ bo̱ni Israel we le̱ hĩe gbo ye̱ Betel, ame̱hĩeno̱kãmo̱ le̱, he le̱.

english_verse: You claim that your soldiers are strong and brave.
translation_verse: Mẽba nyekē̱o̱ ake: Hĩĩ kãkãlo̱i ke̱ tabiloi ní sa tawū dši wo̱ le̱?

english_verse: They will answer, “Moab has been defeated! Weep with us in shame. Tell everyone at the Arnon River that Moab is destroyed.”
translation_verse: Ahã Moab hĩe eſie ši, edšake̱ akũmo̱le̱: wo̱ lele ni oblo̱! Nyegbaä ye̱ Arnon ake̱ akpãtã Moab hĩe!

english_verse: Kiriathaim, Beth-Gamul, Beth-Meon,
translation_verse: ke̱ Kiriataim ke̱ Bet-Gamul ke̱ Bet-Meon

english_verse: People of Moab, you claim to be stronger than I am. Now I will tell other nations to make you drunk and to laugh while you collapse in your own vomit.
translation_verse: Nyehãa *eto̱a dā̃, edšake̱ ewó ehe no̱ eši Iehowa, ni Moab aakoklo ši ye̱ eſē mli, ni le̱ hũ eetšṍ ṅmlõnõ! *

english_verse: You made fun of my people and treated them like criminals caught in the act.
translation_verse: Nto Israel tšṍ ṅmlõnõ hão! Ani dšulo̱i ateṅ aanale̱ ye̱? edšake̱ befẽbe ní owieo̱ ehe le̱, ohosoo̱ oyitšo.

english_verse: But I also know bragging will never save you.
translation_verse: Mile emlifũ ke̱ eſā̃ ní esaa le̱, Iehowa kē̱; nii ní esaa ame̱fe.

english_verse: So I will cry and mourn for Moab and its town of Kir-Heres.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ mawo lele ye̱ Moab hewo̱, ni mablo̱ ye̱ Moab fē hewo̱: aaye ṅko̱mo̱ ye̱ Kir-Heres hĩĩ le̱ ahewo̱!

english_verse: People of Sibmah, you were like a vineyard heavy with grapes, and with branches reaching north to the town of Jazer and west to the Dead Sea. But you have been destroyed, and so I will weep for you, as the people of Jazer weep for the vineyards.
translation_verse: Yāfó ní fè Iazer nõ le̱ mafó mahão, bo Sibma weintšo; onidši le̱ eteke ṅšo̱ le̱ tete, ame̱yaše̱ Iazer ṅšo̱ le̱ nā tō̃: hĩekpãtãlo̱ ebaſie otšeiayibii ke̱ oweinyibii le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: Harvest celebrations are gone from the orchards and farms of Moab. I have silenced the shouts of people making wine.
translation_verse: Ni nyã́mo̱ ke̱ mliflimo̱ se̱ efo ye̱ ṅmõdšiaṅ ke̱ Moab šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni mi-hã wein bũ se̱ efo ye̱ weinbui le̱aṅ: aṅã̀ṅ wein ke̱ lala, lala le̱ dšee lala doṅṅ!

english_verse: Weeping from Heshbon can be heard as far as Elealeh and Jahaz; cries from Zoar are heard in Horonaim and Eglath-Shelishiyah. And Nimrim Creek has run dry.
translation_verse: Ke̱-dše̱ Hešbon blo̱mo̱ le̱ no̱ le̱ ame̱wóo̱ amegbē ke̱-yašío̱ Eleale ke̱ Iahaz tō̃, ke̱-dše̱ Zoar ke̱-yaši Horonaim, ní dši tšinayō ní eye afii etẽ le̱; edšake̱ Nimrim nui le̱ tete aatšṍmo̱ ole̱ṅle̱.

english_verse: I will get rid of anyone who burns incense to the gods of Moab or offers sacrifices at their shrines. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ni mahã moni šãa šā̃-afo̱le ye̱ he groṅṅ ke̱ moni šãa tšofã-ke̱-ṅma ehãa enyoṅmo̱i le̱ se̱ afo ye̱ Moab, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: In my heart I moan for Moab, like a funeral song played on a flute. I mourn for the people of the town of Kir-Heres, because their wealth is gone. *
translation_verse: Hewo̱ le̱ mitsui mli hū̃o̱ tamo̱ be̱dši ye̱ Moab hewo̱, ni mitsui mli hū̃o̱ tamo̱ be̱dši ye̱ Kir-Heres hĩĩ le̱ ahewo̱; edšake̱ enii babaō ní ená le̱ elādše.

english_verse: Moab lies broken! Listen to its people cry as they turn away in shame. Other nations are horrified at what happened, but still they mock her.
translation_verse: Kwe̱ bo̱ni ekũmo̱! Nyewo̱a lele! Kwe̱ bo̱ni Moab etšṍ ekue̱! Eye̱ hĩegbĕle! Ni Moab aatšṍ ṅmlõnõ ko̱ tšuifā̃ fẽ ehã mei fẽ ní ebo̱lele̱ ke̱-kpe le̱.

english_verse: Moab, an enemy swoops down like an eagle spreading its wings over your land.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Na, eefliki ke̱-aba tamo̱ okropoṅ, ni eegbe̱ efidšiaṅ ewo Moab.

english_verse: Your cities and fortresses will be captured, and your warriors as fearful as women giving birth.
translation_verse: Aṅõ mãdši ní wa le̱, atua mõdši le̱, ni nakai gbĩ le̱ Moab hĩĩ kãkãlo̱i le̱ etšui aatšṍ tamo̱ yō ní kõmoo̱ tšui.

english_verse: You are finished as a nation, because you dared oppose me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni aakpãtã Moab hĩe ní ekafe maṅ doṅṅ, edšake̱ ewó ehe no̱ eši Iehowa.

english_verse: Terror, pits, and traps are waiting for you.
translation_verse: Gbeyei ke̱ bu ke̱ tšõne kã ši hão, bo moni oyo̱ Moab, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: If you are terrified and run, you will fall into a pit; and if you crawl out of the pit, you'll get caught in a trap. The time has come for you to be punished. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Moni aadšo gbeyei le̱ nā foi le̱, eeyagbē bu le̱ mli, ni moni aate ši ke̱-dše̱ bu le̱ mli le̱, eeyadũ tšõne le̱; edšake̱ mike̱ ame̱sramo̱ afi le̱ aaba le̱ Moab eno̱, Iehowa kē̱. Ies.

english_verse: Near the city of Heshbon, where Sihon once ruled, tired refugees stand in shadows cast by the flames of their burning city. Soon, the towns on other hilltops, where those warlike people live, will also go up in smoke.
translation_verse: Hešbon hō̃ le̱ṅ foidšelo̱i ní be̱ hewale̱ le̱ badamo̱; edšake̱ *la aadše̱ Hešbon aba, ni lalilei aadše̱ Sihon teṅ aba, ni ebašã Moab kóṅ le̱ ke̱ mei ní feo̱ hō le̱ ayiteṅ pampam. *

english_verse: People of Moab, you worshiped Chemosh, your god, but now you are done for, and your children are prisoners in a foreign country.
translation_verse: Kpóo hão, Moab! Olādše, Kemoš maṅ! edšake̱ aṅõ obihĩĩ le̱ nom, ni obiyei le̱ ete nomṅō̃ mli.

english_verse: Yet someday, I will bring your people back home. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ši makpale Moab nomṅō̃ le̱ ke̱-aba ekoṅ ye̱ nāgbē gbĩĩ le̱ amli, Iehowa kē̱. Heni Moab kodšomo̱ le̱ ebaše̱ ne̱.

english_verse: Someday I will send an army to attack you in Rabbah, your capital city. It will be left in ruins, and the surrounding villages will lie in ashes. You took some of Israel's land, but on that day Israel will take yours!
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, na, gbĩĩ mība, Iehowa kē̱, ní mahã Amonbii le̱ a-Raba le̱ anu ta he, ni eetšṍ goṅkpo̱ ní moko be̱ no̱, ni ebiyei le̱, aašãame̱ ke̱ la, ni Israel aaye eno̱yelo̱i le̱ ano̱! Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: You rebellious Ammonites trust your wealth and ask, “Who could attack us?” But I warn you not to boast when your strength is fading.
translation_verse: Mẽba oſãa ofõo̱ odšō̱i ní dši dšō̱i ní hoo̱ le̱ ano̱? bo biyō ní okpale ke̱-te se̱, bo ní ohĩe kã odſetrii ano̱, ni okē̱o̱ ake̱: Namo aaba mino̱? le̱.

english_verse: Yet someday, I will bring your people back home. I, the Lord, have spoken. What the Lord Says about Edom
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ fe se̱ le̱ aakpale Amonbii le̱ anomṅō̃ le̱ ke̱-kũ se̱ ke̱-ba ekoṅ, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says about Edom: Wisdom and common sense have vanished from Teman.
translation_verse: *Edom nõ. Bo̱ni Iehowa Zebaot kē̱ ne̱: Aso nilē be̱ Teman doṅṅ? alo ṅāwō elādše ye̱ hĩetẽloi le aṅõ, ni afo̱se amenilē le̱ aſie? *Ies.

english_verse: I have sent a messenger to command the nations to prepare for war against you people of Edom.
translation_verse: Minu sane ko ke̱-dše̱ Iehowa ṅõ, ni atšũ bo̱fo ke̱-te dšeṅmãdši le̱ aṅõ, ake̱: Nyebuaä nyehe nā ke̱-kpea ni nyebaä eno̱, ni nyetea ši nyeyaä ta!

english_verse: Your nation will be small, yet hated by other nations.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ na, mifeo bibiō ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ, ni ohe guo̱ egbo ye̱ gbomei ateṅ!

english_verse: as bad as the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah and towns nearby. The towns of Edom will be empty.
translation_verse: Tamo̱ bo̱ni abutu Sodom ke̱ Gomora ke̱ ame̱hewo̱ mãdši le̱, Iehowa kē̱, mokomoko ehĩṅ dše̱i ni asaṅ gbomobi ko ebatoṅ gbo̱ ye̱ dše̱i. Ies.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will attack you like a lion from the forest, attacking sheep in a meadow along the Jordan. In a moment the flock runs, and the land is empty. Who will I choose to attack you? I will do it myself! No one can force me to fight or chase me away.
translation_verse: Na, efã tamo̱ dšata ke̱-dše̱ Iordan he kō-hayīi le̱ amli ke̱-mība koloianiyelihe ní hĩo̱ ši dā le̱; ši mahã edšo foi ke̱-dše̱ eno̱ hĩṅme̱itſā, ni moni aahalale̱ le̱, le̱ maṅõ-to eno̱. Edšake̱ namo po tamo̱mi? ni namo ke̱mi aakpe? ni namo dši tōkwe̱lo̱ ní anyē mihĩe adamo̱ le̱?

english_verse: Listen to my plans for you, people of Edom. Your children will be dragged off and your country destroyed.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyeboa Iehowa yiṅ ní eſie ye̱ Edom he ke̱ eyiṅ ní eto ye̱ Temanbii le̱ ahe le̱ toi: Šãtãmo̱ kẽ aašãtã tōiku le̱ mli bibii le̱ ke̱-ate, ni ame̱niyelihe le̱ nā aakpe̱ ehe ye̱ amehe!

english_verse: An enemy will swoop down to attack you, like an eagle spreading its wings and circling over Bozrah. Your warriors will be as fearful as women giving birth. What the Lord Says about Damascus
translation_verse: Na, eefã ke̱-aba, ni *eefliki tamo̱ okropoṅ, ni eegbe̱ efĩdšiaṅ ewo Bozra, ni nakai gbĩ le̱ Edomhĩĩ kãkãlo̱i le̱ atšui aatšṍ tamo̱ yō ní kõmoo̱ tšui. *

english_verse: You people of Damascus have lost your courage, and in panic you turn to run, gripped by fear and pain.
translation_verse: Damasko egbo̱dšo̱, etšṍ ehe ní ebadšo foi, ṅmiṅmi emõle̱; hedšramo̱ ke̱ kō̃-mo̱ eta ehe tamo̱ yō ní bafo̱.

english_verse: Soon, even your best soldiers will lie dead in your streets. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ eblahĩĩ le̱ aanyõnyõi ye̱ eblohũi le̱aṅ, ni aaplenē hĩĩ tawulo̱i le̱ fẽ ye̱ no gbĩ le̱ no̱, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱;

english_verse: I will set fire to your city walls and burn down the fortresses King Benhadad built. Nebuchadnezzar and the People of the Desert
translation_verse: ni maše̱re la ye̱ Damasko gbogbo le̱ṅ, ni eešã Benhadad mõdši wudši le̱.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord says about the Kedar tribe and the desert villages that were conquered by King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia: Listen, you people of Kedar and the other tribes of the eastern desert. I have told Nebuchadnezzar to attack and destroy you.
translation_verse: *Kedar ke̱ †Hazor maṅtše̱yelii ní Nebukadnezar, Babel maṅtše̱ le̱, tſĩa-ame̱ nii le̱ anõ. Bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Nyetea ši, nye-fãa ke̱-yaä Kedar, ni nyeyakpãtãa bokãgbe̱ bii le̱ ahĩe! *Ies.

english_verse: His fearsome army will surround you, taking your tents and possessions, your sheep and camels.
translation_verse: Ame̱būi le̱ ke̱ ame̱tōiku le̱ ame̱aṅõ ke̱-ate; ame̱bū he mamai le̱ ke̱ ame̱nibii le̱ fẽ ke̱ ame̱yomai le̱ ame̱alō ame̱hã ame̱he, ni ame̱ablo̱ ame̱woame̱ ake̱: Hefẽhe efe gbeyei!

english_verse: Run and hide, you people of the desert who live in villages! Nebuchadnezzar has big plans for you.
translation_verse: Nyešaä foi, nyedšoa foi ní awáa, nyetšaä bui ní mli kwŏ̱lo̱ nyehĩa mli, nye Hazorbii! Iehowa kē̱; edšake̱ Ne-bukadnezar, Babel maṅtše̱ le̱, ete nyeyi no̱ adšina, ni eto eyiṅ ye̱ nyehe. K.

english_verse: You have no city walls and no neighbors to help, yet you think you're safe— so I told him to attack.
translation_verse: Nyetea ši nyefãa ke̱-yaä maṅ ni he edšo̱ame̱, ní ame̱hĩo̱ ši ſeſēſe le̱ no̱, Iehowa kē̱; mei ní be̱ agbói alo agbói ase̱-adabãṅi, ní ame̱ko̱krō̱ ame̱hĩo̱ ši.

english_verse: Then your camels and large herds will be yours no longer. People of the Arabian Desert, disaster will strike you from every side, and you will be scattered everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱yomai le̱ aatšṍmo̱ odšonii, ni ame̱koloikui babaō le̱ aatšṍmo̱ hānii; ni magbe *mei ní eše̱šē̱ ame̱yii afãfãi lo̱ maſã kō̱yo̱i fiā mli; ni mike̱ ame̱manehũlũ le̱ aadše ame̱hewo̱ hefẽhe ke̱-aba, Iehowa kē̱. *

english_verse: Only jackals will live where your villages once stood. I, the Lord, have spoken. What the Lord Says about Elam
translation_verse: Ni Hazor aatšṍ ṅãṅgbēi ašihĩle̱he ke̱ amaṅfõ ke̱-ate nāno̱, ni mokomoko ehĩṅ dše̱i, ni asaṅ gbomobi ko ebatoṅ gbo̱ ye̱ dše̱i.

english_verse: Not long after Zedekiah became king of Judah, the Lord told me to say: People of Elam, I, the Lord All-Powerful, will kill the archers who make your army strong.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa Zebaot kē̱ ne̱: Na, makũ Elam gãi le̱ ní dši ame̱hewale̱nõ titri le̱;

english_verse: Your king and his officials will die, and I will rule in their place. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ni mike̱ mimaṅtše̱sẽi le̱ aamã Elam, ni makpãtã maṅtše̱ ke̱ lume̱i le̱ ahĩe ye̱ dše̱i, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: But I promise that someday I will bring your people back to their land.
translation_verse: Ši aaba mli ye̱ nāgbē gbĩĩ le̱ ano̱ ake̱ makpale Elam nomṅō̃ le̱ ke̱-aba ekoṅ, Iehowa kē̱. K.

english_verse: Raise the signal flags; shout so all nations can hear— Babylon will be captured! Marduk, Babylon's god, will be ashamed and terrified, and his idols broken.
translation_verse: Nyedšadšea ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ, nyešie̱a, ni nyešia aflaṅã! Nyešie̱a, ni nyekašiua no̱! Nyekē̱a ake̱: Aṅõ Babel; ahã Bel hĩe eſie ši, adſăra Merodak hũ; ahã emãgãi le̱ ahĩe eſie ši, adſăra ewo̱dšĩ le̱! Ies.

english_verse: The attack on the Babylonians will come from the north; they and their animals will run, leaving the land empty. Israel and Judah Will Return to Their Land
translation_verse: Ši dšeṅmaṅ ko edše̱ kōyigbe̱ efã ke̱-mība eno̱, ni eefe ešikpoṅ le̱ amaṅfõ, ni mokomoko ehĩṅ ši ye̱ no̱, gbomo ke̱ koloi fẽ aadšo foi ame̱ate.

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Israel and Judah, when these things happen you will weep, and together you will return to your land and worship me, the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Nakai gbĩĩ le̱ amli le̱ ke̱ nakai be le̱ mli le̱, Iehowa kē̱, Israelbii le̱ aaba, ame̱ ke̱ Iudabii le̱ fẽ-tſẽm; *ame̱abafó ke̱-nyie, ni ame̱abatao Iehowa, ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, se̱gbe̱. *

english_verse: People of Babylonia, you were glad to rob my people. You had a good time, making more noise than horses and jumping around like calves threshing grain.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nyeminyã́, edšake̱ nyemli eflinye, nye mei ní nyehaä mino̱yelinõ le̱, edšake̱ nyehoo̱ la tamo̱ tšinabi oblayō ni gble̱o̱ able, ni nyeblo̱ö̱ tamo̱ okpo̱ṅo̱hĩĩ hewalo̱i.

english_verse: The city of Babylon was like a mother to you. But it will be disgraced and become nothing but a barren desert.
translation_verse: Nyenye hĩe egbo naakpa dientše̱; moni fo̱nye le̱ hũ hĩe eſie ši: Na, etšṍ dšeṅmãdši ase̱kpelo̱, ṅã kpatā ke̱ šikpoṅ ni egbĩ ke̱ ole̱ṅle̱!

english_verse: My anger will destroy Babylon, and no one will live there. Everyone who passes by will be shocked to see what has happened.
translation_verse: Iehowa mlifũ le̱ hewo̱ le̱ ahĩṅ dše̱i, ši moṅ eetšṍ amaṅfõ kwrā: mofēmo ní aatšṍ Babel he ke̱-aho le̱, enā aakpe̱ ehe, ni eebo tšia ye̱ enii ní atſiale̱ le̱ fẽ hewo̱.

english_verse: Babylon has rebelled against me. Archers, take your places. Shoot all your arrows at Babylon.
translation_verse: Nyegbaä ta nyewoa Babel he ke̱-kpea, nye mei flā ní nyedŏ̱ro̱ö̱ gãii amli! Nyetšẽrẽale̱ nyekabäa gãimlibii ayi! edšake̱ efe eša eši Iehowa!

english_verse: There is no one in Babylonia to plant or harvest crops. Even foreigners who lived there have left for their homelands, afraid of the enemy armies.
translation_verse: Nyefoa moni dũo̱ nii ke̱ moni mõo̱ nikpamo̱-kakla mli ye̱ nikpamo̱be le̱ṅ le̱ ke̱-dše̱a Babel! Yiwale̱ klante le̱ hewo̱ le̱, ame̱teṅ mofẽmo aakũ ese̱ ke̱-ate emaṅbii le̱ aṅõ, ni mofẽmo aadšo foi ke̱-ate ešikpoṅ no̱!

english_verse: Israel is a flock of sheep scattered by hungry lions. The king of Assyria first gobbled Israel up. Then Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylonia, crunched on Israel's bones.
translation_verse: Tōi ní egbe̱ eſã dši Israel; dšatai le̱ eſiele̱ ke̱-te: tšutšu le̱ Ašur maṅtše̱ le̱ yele̱, ni se̱kpē ne̱ Nebukadnezar, Babel maṅtše̱ le̱, ekpe ewui.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, punished the king of Assyria, and I will also punish the king of Babylonia.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni Iehowa Zebaot, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kē̱ ne̱: Na, mibawo Babel maṅtše̱ le̱ ke̱ ešikpoṅ le̱ nyõmo̱, tamo̱ bo̱ni miwo Ašur maṅtše̱ le̱ nyõmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Sounds of war and the noise of destruction can be heard.
translation_verse: Ta ke̱ hĩekpãtãmo̱ kpeteṅkple ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱!

english_verse: Come from far away, you enemies of Babylon! Pile up the grain from its storehouses, and destroy it completely, along with everything else.
translation_verse: Nyedše̱a nāgbēhei le̱ fẽ nyebaä! Nyegblea eboṅoi le̱ anā! Nyelōale̱ nye-buaã ši tamo̱ ṅmā̃ kuikui, nyefeale̱ musu tſẽm! Nyekahãa enokonoko mīſe̱a!

english_verse: Kill the soldiers of Babylonia, because the time has come for them to be punished.
translation_verse: Nyegbea etšinahĩĩ le̱ fẽ-tſẽm, nyehãa ame̱kplekea ši ke̱-yaä gbē! Kpóo hãame̱! edšake̱ ame̱gbĩ ní dši ame̱sramo̱-be le̱ eše̱!

english_verse: The Babylonian army destroyed my temple, but soon I will take revenge. Then refugees from Babylon will tell about it in Zion.
translation_verse: Anuo̱ mei ní dšo foi ni ame̱dše mli ke̱-dše̱ Babel šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ agbē, ni ame̱mīdšadše Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ lo̱, oweletō̱, eso̱lemo̱we le̱ he oweletō̱ le̱ ye̱ Zion!

english_verse: Attack Babylon, enemy archers; set up camp around the city, and don't let anyone escape. It challenged me, the holy God, so do to it what it did to other cities. Proud Babylon Will Fall
translation_verse: Nyetšé̱a gãitšẽlo̱i le̱ nyewoa Babel be, mei ni dŏ̱ro̱ö̱ gãi le̱ fẽ! Nyeboa nsra nyewoa ehe ke̱-kpea! Nyekahãa mokomoko mīdšea mli! *Nyewoale̱ nyõmo̱ ye̱ enitsumo̱ le̱ nā! Bo̱fẽbo̱ ní efe le̱, nyefeale̱ nakai noṅṅ; edšake̱ ewó ehe ye̱ Iehowa no̱, ye̱ Israel Mokroṅkroṅ le̱ no̱! *K.

english_verse: Babylon, you should be named, “The Proud One.” But the time has come when I, the Lord All-Powerful, will punish you.
translation_verse: Na, mike̱o ená, bo hewolo̱, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa Zebaot kē̱; edšake̱ ogbĩ ní dši osramo̱be le̱ eše̱!

english_verse: You are proud, but you will stumble and fall, and no one will help you up. I will set your villages on fire, and everything around you will go up in flames.
translation_verse: Ni hewolo̱ le̱ aate̱ ni eegbē ši, ni mokomoko be̱ ní aawó eno̱; ni maše̱re la ye̱ emãdši mãdši le̱ amli, ni eešã mei fiā ní bo̱lele̱ ke̱-kpe le̱.

english_verse: You Babylonians were cruel to Israel and Judah. You took them captive, and now you refuse to let them go.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa Zebaot kē̱ ne̱: Amla Israelbii le̱ ke̱ Iudabii le̱ fẽ-tfẽm, ni ame̱nomṅõlo̱i le̱ fẽ hĩe ame̱mli kpẽṅṅ, ame̱kplẽẽ ní ame̱ṅmē̃ ame̱he le̱.

english_verse: But I, the Lord All-Powerful, will rescue and protect them. I will bring peace to their land and trouble to yours.
translation_verse: Ame̱kpõlo̱ le̱ he wa, Iehowa Zebaot dši egbe̱i: ye kẽ ebaye ame̱sane le̱ ehãame̱, beni afe ní ehã šikpoṅ le̱ adšō̱ ehe, ni ehã Babelbii le̱ ehao.

english_verse: I have declared war on you, your officials, and advisors.
translation_verse: Klante aaba Kaldeabii le̱ ano̱, Iehowa kē̱, ke̱ Babelbii le̱ ano̱ ke̱ elumei le̱ ano̱ ke̱ enilelo̱i le̱ ano̱!

english_verse: This war will prove that your prophets are liars and fools. And it will frighten your warriors.
translation_verse: Klante aaba nāfūtše̱mei le̱ ano̱, ní ame̱tšṍmo̱ kwašiai! Klante aaba ehĩĩ kãkãlo̱i le̱ ano̱, ní ame̱tšui afã!

english_verse: Then your chariot horses and the foreigners in your army will refuse to go into battle, and the enemy will carry away everything you treasure.
translation_verse: Klante aaba ekpo̱ṅo̱i ke̱ eſīlii le̱ ano̱ ke̱ futufutugbomei le̱ fẽ ní yo̱ eteṅ le̱ ano̱, ní *ame̱tšṍmo̱ yei! Klante aaba edſetrii le̱ ano̱, ní aha! *

english_verse: Your rivers and canals will dry up. All of this will happen, because your land is full of idols, and they have made fools of you.
translation_verse: Klante aaba enui le̱ ano̱, ni ame̱amī̃! edšake̱ amãgãi ašikpoṅ ni, ni gbeyei wo̱dši ahe se̱ke̱ ame̱yeo̱!

english_verse: Never again will people live in your land— only desert animals, jackals, and unclean birds.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ ṅãṅ koloi ke̱ klãdši aahĩ dše̱i, ni dugumai aahĩ dše̱i; ni ahĩṅ dše̱i doṅṅ ke̱-ate nāno̱, ni asaṅ ake̱ dše̱i efeṅ šihĩle̱he ye̱ yino̱ ko yino̱ ko no̱.

english_verse: I destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns, and I will destroy Babylon just as completely. No one will live there again. Babylonia Is Invaded The Lord said:
translation_verse: Tamo̱ bo̱ni Nyoṅmo̱ butu *Sodom ke̱ Gomora ke̱ ame̱hewo̱ mãdši le̱, Iehowa kē̱, mokomoko ehĩṅ dše̱i, ni asaṅ gbomobi ko ebatoṅ gbo̱ yo̱ dšei. *

english_verse: Far to the north, a nation and its allies have been awakened. They are powerful and ready for war.
translation_verse: Na, *maṅ ko aadše̱ kōyigbe̱ aba, ni dšeṅmaṅ wulu ko ke̱ maṅtše̱mei babaō aate ši ke-adše šikpoṅ le nāgbē tō̃. *K.

english_verse: Bows and arrows and swords are in their hands. The soldiers are cruel and show no pity. The hoofbeats of their horses echo like ocean waves crashing against the shore. The army has lined up for battle and is coming to attack you, people of Babylonia!
translation_verse: Ame̱hĩe gãi ke̱ akplo̱; ame̱yi wa, ni ame̱mũsũṅ etšõõame̱; ame̱gbē *tamo̱ ṅšo̱ hū̃mo̱, ni ame̱trá okpo̱ṅo̱i ano̱ ke̱-mība, awoame̱ nii tamo̱ tabiloi, ní ame̱-ke̱ bo, Babel biyō le̱, abawu! *

english_verse: Ever since your king heard about this army, he has been weak with fear; he twists and turns in pain like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Babel maṅtše̱ le̱ nu ame̱he pe̱, ni enidšiaṅ dše wui; etšui fã, ekõmo̱ tamo̱ yō ni bafo̱.

english_verse: Babylonia, I will attack you like a lion from the forest, attacking sheep in a meadow along the Jordan. In a moment the flock runs, and the land is empty. Who will I choose to attack you? I will do it myself! No one can force me to fight or chase me away.
translation_verse: Na, efã tamo̱ dšata ke̱-dše̱ Iordan he kō-hayīi le̱ amli ke̱-mība koloianiyelihe ní hĩo̱ ši dā le̱: ši mahã edšo foi ke̱-dše̱ ame̱no̱ hĩṅme̱itſā, ni moni aahalale̱ le̱, le̱ maṅõ-to eno̱ Edšake̱ namo po tamo̱mi? ni namo ke̱mi aakpe? ni namo dši tōkwe̱lo̱ ní anyẽ mihĩe adamo̱?

english_verse: The sounds of your destruction will be heard among the nations, and the earth will shake.
translation_verse: Gbē ní kē̱o̱ ake̱: Aṅõ Babel! le̱ gbē̱mo̱ nā le̱ šikpoṅ aahoso, ni aanu eblo̱mo̱ le̱ ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ.

english_verse: Babylon was my golden cup, filled with the wine of my anger. The nations of the world got drunk on this wine and went insane.
translation_verse: Šika kpulu dši Babel ye̱ Iehowa deṅ, ni ehã *šikpoṅ mū le̱ fẽ etŏ̱ro̱ dā̃: dšeṅmãdši le̱ ena ewein le̱ eko, hewo̱ le̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ eye se̱ke̱. *

english_verse: But suddenly, Babylon will fall and be destroyed. I, the Lord, told the foreigners who lived there, “Weep for the city! Get medicine for its wounds; maybe they will heal.”
translation_verse: *Babel egbē ši trukā, ni akũmo̱le̱: nyewoa lele nyehãale̱! Nyeṅõa tšofã nyetoa epĩme̱ le̱ he, ake̱ aleenõ eehĩ tšámo̱ lo! *Kpods.

english_verse: The foreigners answered, “We have already tried to treat Babylon's wounds, but they would not heal. Come on, let's all go home to our own countries. Nothing is left in Babylonia; everything is destroyed.”
translation_verse: “Wo̱mītšá Babel, ši ehĩĩ tšámo̱; nyešĩale̱, ní wo̱teṅ mofẽmo aya le̱dientše̱ ešikpoṅ no̱! Edšake̱ ekodšome̱ le̱ eše̱ ṅwei tō̃, ni awó no̱ ke̱-yaši atatuiaṅ!

english_verse: I, the Lord, want Babylon destroyed, because its army destroyed my temple. So, you kings of Media, sharpen your arrows and pick up your shields.
translation_verse: Nyešaä gãimlibii le̱ ahe kãṅkãṅ! nyekŏ̱lo̱a tše̱ṅi nyewoa! Iehowa etšĩe *Mediabii amaṅtše̱mei le̱ amumo̱ hĩe; edšake̱ eto eyiṅ ye̱ Babel he, ake̱ eekpãtã ehĩe. Edšake̱ Iehowa †oweletō̱ ni, eso̱lemo̱we le̱ he oweletō̱ ni. *Ies.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, swear by my own life that enemy soldiers will fill your streets like a swarm of locusts. They will shout and celebrate their victory. A Hymn of Praise (Jeremiah
translation_verse: Iehowa Zebaot ekã le̱dientše̱ ehe kitã ake̱: Mawoö obõ to̱ ke̱ gbomei tamo̱ agãi, ni ame̱abo̱ oše ame̱awoö! (K.

english_verse: The waters in the heavens roar at his command. He makes clouds appear; he sends the wind from his storehouse and makes lightning flash in the rain.
translation_verse: Ké̱ ewó egbē le̱, nu pī baä ṅwei, ni ehãa afuai tetēo̱ ši ke̱-dše̱o̱ šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbēhei le̱; efeo̱ srawai efataä nyoṅmo̱ne̱mo̱ he, ni efãa kō̱yo̱ kpo ke̱-dše̱o̱ enitōhei le̱.

english_verse: God used his wisdom and power to create the earth and spread out the heavens.
translation_verse: Le̱ efe šikpoṅ le̱ ye̱ ehewale̱ nā, le̱ noṅṅ eṅō dše le̱ emã ši ye̱ eṅã nā, ni elē̱ ṅwei mli ye̱ enilē nā.

english_verse: People who make idols are stupid! They will be disappointed, because their false gods cannot breathe.
translation_verse: Koloi dši gbomei fẽ, ni ame̱lee nii; šikaṅālo̱-fẽ-šikaṅālo̱ hĩe egbo ye̱ emãgã hewo̱; edšake̱ emãgã ní eſie le̱, apasa ni, ni mumo̱ ní amũo̱ be̱ ame̱mli.

english_verse: But the Lord, Israel's God, is all-powerful. He created everything, and he chose Israel to be his very own. God's Hammer The Lord said:
translation_verse: Moni dši Iakob gbe̱fãṅnõ le̱ tamo̱o̱ ene̱mei; edšake̱ nii fẽ-kwa ke̱ egbe̱fāṅ akutšo le̱ hũ šõlo̱ dšile̱, Iehowa Zebaot dši egbe̱i.

english_verse: as well as men and women, young and old,
translation_verse: bo noṅṅ mike̱-dſăraä nū ke̱ yō, ni bo mike̱-dſăraä onukpa ke̱ gbekẽ, ni bo mike̱-dſăraä oblanyo ke̱ oblayō;

english_verse: shepherds and their flocks, farmers and their oxen, and governors and leaders.
translation_verse: ni bo mike̱-dſăraä tōkwe̱lo̱ ke̱ etōiku, ni bo mike̱-dſăraä hũlo̱ ke̱ etšinai nta, ni bo mike̱-dſăraä amraloi ke̱ lume̱i.

english_verse: But now, my people will watch, while I repay you for what you did to Zion.
translation_verse: Ni *mawo Babel ke̱ Kaldeabii le̱ fẽ amenifõdši fẽ ní ame̱fe Zion le̱ he nyõmo̱ ye̱ nyehĩṅme̱iiaṅ! Iehowa kē̱, *

english_verse: Signal the nations to get ready to attack. Raise a flag and blow a trumpet. Send for the armies of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz. Choose a commander; let the cavalry attack like a swarm of locusts.
translation_verse: Nyešia aflaṅã ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱! Nyekpãa te̱tre̱mantre̱ ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ! *Nyefea dšeṅmãdši le̱ kroṅkroṅ nyewoale̱! Nyekpēa Ararat, Mini ke̱ †Aškenaz maṅtše̱yelii le̱ nyewoa ehe! Nyetoa tatše̱ nyewoale̱! Nyehãa okpo̱ṅo̱i le̱ abaã tamo̱ agãi ke̱ ame̱he sakasaka! *Ies.

english_verse: Tell the kings and governors, the leaders and the people of the kingdoms of the Medes to prepare for war!
translation_verse: Nyefea dšeṅmãdši le̱ kroṅkroṅ nyewoale̱, Media maṅtše̱mei le̱, emraloi ke̱ elumei le̱ fẽ ke̱ emaṅtše̱yeli šikpoṅ mū le̱ fẽ!

english_verse: The earth twists and turns in torment, because I have decided to make Babylonia a desert where no one can live, and I won't change my mind.
translation_verse: Ni šikpoṅ lo̱ mihoso, ni edšidšā; edšake̱ Iehowa yiṅ ní etotoi ye̱ Babel he le̱ damo̱ ši ake̱ eefe Babel šikpoṅ le̱ amaṅfõ, ní mokomoko akahĩ mli doṅṅ.

english_verse: The Babylonian soldiers have lost their strength and courage. They stay in their fortresses, unable to fight, while the enemy breaks through the city gates, then sets their homes on fire.
translation_verse: Babel hĩĩ kãkãlo̱i le̱ efõ tawū, ame̱trá ame̱mõdši le̱ amli; ame̱-ekā̃ le̱ etã, ame̱tšṍmo̱ yei: ašãšā̃ ame̱šihĩle̱hei le̱, akũmo̱ ame̱-adabãṅi le̱.

english_verse: One messenger after another announces to the king, “Babylon has been captured!
translation_verse: Foišalo̱ šaä foi ke̱ foišalo̱ yakpeo̱, bo̱fo hũ ke̱ bo̱fo yakpeo̱, koni ame̱yatſa Babel maṅtše̱ le̱ adafi ake̱ aṅõ emaṅ le̱ ye̱ ehefẽhe,

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I make this promise— “Soon Babylon will be leveled and packed down like a threshing place at harvest time.” Babylonia Will Pay!
translation_verse: Ši bo̱ni Iehowa Zebaot, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kē̱ ne̱: Babel biyō le̱ tamo̱ ṅmā̃-gbẽmo̱he be mli ní anānāa no̱ le̱; eſe̱ fiō ke̱ke̱ ní nikpamo̱be le̱ aaše̱ ahãle̱!

english_verse: The people of Jerusalem say, “King Nebuchadnezzar made us panic. That monster stuffed himself with us and our treasures, leaving us empty— he gobbled up what he wanted and spit out the rest.
translation_verse: Nebukadnezar, Babel maṅtše̱ le̱, eyewo̱, ekpãtã wo̱hĩe; eṅõwo̱ emã ši tamo̱ nõ flo, emī̃wo̱ hũ tamo̱ dšeṅ; ewo emũsũ obõ ke̱ mido̱ko̱do̱ko̱nii le̱; eše̱re̱wo̱ eſie.

english_verse: Babylon will be a pile of rubble where only jackals live, and everyone will be afraid to walk among the ruins.
translation_verse: Ni Babel aatšṍmo̱ kóikói ke̱ ṅãṅ-gbēi ahĩle̱he, nākpe̱nõ ke̱ noni hãa aboo̱ tšia, ni mokomoko ehĩṅ dše̱i doṅṅ.

english_verse: The Babylonians roar and growl like young lions.
translation_verse: Ame̱fẽ-kwa ame̱ahū̃ tamo̱ dšatai oblahĩĩ, ni ame̱ablo̱ tamo̱ dšatabii.

english_verse: I will lead them away to die, like sheep, lambs, and goats being led to the butcher.
translation_verse: Makplaame̱ ke̱-kpleke ši tamo̱ tōhii ní ayagbeame̱, tamo̱ tōagboi ke̱ tōkpakpoi!

english_verse: All nations now praise Babylon, but when it is captured, those same nations will be horrified.
translation_verse: Té aye tēṅ ní aṅõ *Šešak, ni ahe šikpoṅ le̱ fẽ yidšiemo̱ le̱ ne̱? Té aye tēṅ ní Babel etšṍ nākpe̱nõ ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ ne̱? *

english_verse: Babylon's enemies will rise like ocean waves and flood the city.
translation_verse: Ṅšo̱ le̱ ete ši ewo Babel, eṅšo̱kei ní gbē̱o̱ le̱ eha eno̱.

english_verse: Horrible destruction will strike the nearby towns. The land will become a barren desert, where no one can live or even travel.
translation_verse: Emãdši le̱ etšṍmo̱ amaṅfõi ke̱ šikpoṅ ní egbi keketē ke̱ ole̱ṅle̱, šikpoṅ ní mokomoko ehĩĩ no̱, ni gbomobi ko tšṍṍ no̱.

english_verse: I will punish Marduk, the god of Babylon, and make him vomit out everything he gobbled up. Then nations will no longer bring him gifts, and Babylon's walls will crumble. The Lord Offers Hope to His People
translation_verse: Ši mayasra Bel ye̱ Babel, ni madšie noni emĩ le̱ ye̱ edāṅ, ni dšeṅmãdši le̱ hoṅ ke̱-yaṅ eṅõ doṅṅ; Babel gbogbo le̱ tete aagbē ši!

english_verse: Get out of Babylon, my people, and run for your lives, before I strike the city in my anger!
translation_verse: Mimaṅ, nyedšea kpo ke̱-dše̱a eteṅ, ni nyeteṅ mofẽmo ahere eyiwala ke̱-dše̱ Iehowa mliſũ ní nā wa le̱ mli! K.

english_verse: Don't be afraid or lose hope, though year after year there are rumors of leaders fighting for control in the city of Babylon.
translation_verse: Nyetšui akafãa, ni nyekasea gbeyei ye̱ adafi ni aanu ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ hewo̱, ši adafi aaba ye̱ afi ko no̱, ni no se̱ afi le̱ adafi aaba ekoṅ, ake̱ yiwale̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, no̱yelo̱ aate ši awo no̱yelo̱!

english_verse: The time will come when I will punish Babylon's false gods. Everyone there will die, and the whole nation will be disgraced,
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ na, gbĩĩ mība, ní mayasra Babel amãgãi le̱, ni ešikpoṅ le̱ fẽ hĩe aagbo, ni emei ni agbe le̱ fẽ aanyõnyõi ye̱ eteṅ.

english_verse: when an army attacks from the north and brings destruction. Then the earth and the heavens and everything in them will celebrate.
translation_verse: Ni *ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ ke̱ ame̱mli nii fẽ aala nyã́mo̱ lala ye̱ Babel hewo̱; edšake̱ hĩekpãtãlo̱i aadše̱ kōyigbe̱ aba eno̱, Iehowa kē̱. *Kpods.

english_verse: Babylon must be overthrown, because it slaughtered the people of Israel and of many other nations.
translation_verse: Babel hũ bagbē ši, nye Israel mei ní enyõnyõi, tamo̱ bo̱ni Babel hã šikpoṅ le̱ fẽ no̱ mei ní enyõnyõi le̱ gbēgbē ši le̱.

english_verse: My people, you escaped death when Jerusalem fell. Now you live far from home, but you should trust me and think about Jerusalem. Leave Babylon! Don't stay!
translation_verse: Nye mei ni nyedše klante nā, nyeyaä, nyekadamo̱a ši! Nyekaia Iehowa ke̱-dše̱a šoṅṅ, ni *nyehĩe abaä Ierusalem no̱! *Lal.

english_verse: You feel ashamed and disgraced, because foreigners have entered my sacred temple.
translation_verse: “Wo̱hĩe egboi, edšake̱ wo̱nu ahorabō̱; hĩešiſiemo̱ eha wo̱hĩe, edšake̱ meikpõdši eba Iehowa we le̱ hei kroṅkroṅi le̱!”

english_verse: Soon I will send a war to punish Babylon's idols and leave its wounded people moaning everywhere.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, na, gbĩĩ miba, Iehowa kē̱, ní mayasra emãgãi le̱, ni ešikpoṅ le̱ fẽ no̱ le̱ pilafoi le̱ aakẽmo̱!

english_verse: Although Babylon's walls reach to the sky, the army I send will destroy that city. I, the Lord, have spoken. Babylon Will Be Destroyed The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ké̱ Babel kwo̱ ke̱-te ṅwei po, ni ehã emõdši le̱ kwŏ̱lo̱ bo̱ni moko nyẽẽ abe̱ṅke̱ po le̱, mi noṅṅ kẽ miṅõ ehĩekpãtãlo̱i aadše̱ aba eno̱! Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: Listen to the cries for help coming from Babylon. Everywhere in the country the sounds of destruction can be heard.
translation_verse: Anuo̱ blo̱mo̱ ko ke̱-dše̱o̱ Babel, ke̱ hĩekpãtãmo̱ kpeteṅkple ke̱-dse̱o̱ Kaldeabii le̱ ašikpoṅ le̱ no̱!

english_verse: The shouts of the enemy, like crashing ocean waves, will drown out Babylon's cries as I level the city.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iehowa mīkpãtã Babel hĩe, ni ēhã hōfemo̱ se̱ mifo ye̱ mli; ni ame̱ṅšo̱kei le̱ hū̃o̱ tamo̱ nui babaō, ni ame̱gbē le̱ gbē̱mo̱ nā wa.

english_verse: An enemy will attack and destroy Babylon. Its soldiers will be captured and their weapons broken, because I am a God who takes revenge against nations for what they do.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ hĩekpãtãlo̱ eba eno̱, eba Babel no̱, ni amõmo̱ emli hĩĩ kãkãlo̱i le̱, akũmo̱kũmō̱ ame̱gãii le̱ amli; edšake̱ *nādšiaṅtō Mawu dši Iehowa, ewoo̱ nyõmo̱ pe̱pē̱pe̱. *

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, the true King, promise that the officials and advisors, the governors and leaders, and the soldiers of Babylon will get drunk, fall asleep, and never wake up.
translation_verse: Ni mahã ame̱lumei ke̱ ame̱nilelo̱i ke̱ ame̱mraloi ke̱ ame̱bladei ke̱ ame̱kãkãlo̱i le̱ *atŏ̱ro̱ dā̃, ni ame̱awo̱ nāno̱ wo̱, ni ame̱hĩe etšẽṅ doṅṅ! maṅtše̱, mo gbe̱i ní dši Iehowa Zebaot le̱ kē̱. *K.

english_verse: The thick walls of that city will be torn down, and its huge gates burned. Everything that nation worked so hard to gain will go up in smoke. Jeremiah Gives Seraiah a Scroll
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa Zebaot kē̱ ne̱: Babel gbogboi ní hĩe lē̱ le̱, aawuleame̱ kwrā, ni egbói ní kwŏ̱lo̱ le̱, aašãame̱ ke̱ la; ni mãdšimãdši amo̱deṅbō̱ le̱ aafe yaka, ni dšeṅmãdši le̱, la po ame̱gbo deṅme ame̱hã! Hab.

english_verse: During Zedekiah's fourth year as king of Judah, he went to Babylon. And Baruch's brother Seraiah went along as the officer in charge of arranging for places to stay overnight.
translation_verse: Wiemo̱ ní gbalo̱ Ieremia ke̱-hã Seraia, Maeseia bi *Neria bi le̱, beni eke̱ Iuda maṅtše̱ Zedekia te Babel ye̱ eyino̱ afi ní dši edſe̱ le̱ no̱ le̱ ne̱. Ni Seraia dši piafonyo-nukpa. *

english_verse: Before they left, I wrote on a scroll all the terrible things that would happen to Babylon.
translation_verse: Ni Ieremia ṅmã efõṅ fẽ ní baba Babel no̱ le̱ ewo wolo kome mli, no dši wiemo̱i ne̱ fẽ ní aṅmã ye̱ Babel he le̱.

english_verse: I gave the scroll to Seraiah and said: When you get to Babylon, read this scroll aloud,
translation_verse: Ni Ieremia kē̱ Seraia ake̱: Ké̱ oše̱ Babel le̱, kwe̱mo̱ ni okane ne̱ke̱ wiemo̱i ne̱ fẽ,

english_verse: then pray, “Our Lord, you promised to destroy this place and make it into a desert where no people or animals will ever live.”
translation_verse: ni okē̱: Iehowa! bo owie ye̱ bie̱ ne̱ he, ake̱ ooplenēle̱, ní mokomoko aka-hĩ mli doṅṅ, gbomo dšio, šĩa kolo dšio, ši moṅ etšṍ nāno̱ amaṅfõ!

english_verse: When you finish praying, tie the scroll to a rock and throw it in the Euphrates River. Then say,
translation_verse: Ni aba ake̱ ké̱ okane wolo ne̱ ogbe nā le̱, ofĩ te̱ okpe̱te̱ he, ni oše̱ ofo Eufrate teṅ, Kpods.

english_verse: “This is how Babylon will sink when the Lord destroys it. Everyone in the city will die, and it won't have the strength to rise again.” The End of Jeremiah's Writing Jeremiah's writing ends here.
translation_verse: ni okē̱: Ne̱ke̱ Babel bašiu, ni eteṅ ši doṅṅ, ye̱ efõṅ fẽ ní mike̱-aba eno̱ le̱ hewo̱, ni ame̱atã! Heni Ieremia wiemo̱i le̱ bawa ne̱.

english_verse: After a year and a half, all the food in Jerusalem was gone. Then on the ninth day of the fourth month,
translation_verse: Ni nyõṅ ní dši edſe̱ le̱ no̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ ne̱hũ le̱ no̱ le̱ hõmo̱ le̱ nā bawa ye̱ mã le̱ṅ, ni šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ bii le̱ náá nii aye.

english_verse: Zedekiah was taken to Riblah in the land of Hamath, where Nebuchadnezzar put him on trial and found him guilty.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ame̱mō maṅtše̱ le̱ ni ame̱ke̱le̱ bahã Babel maṅtše̱ le̱ ye̱ Ribla ye̱ Hamat šikpoṅ le̱ no̱; ni ekodšole̱.

english_verse: Zedekiah's sons and the officials of Judah were killed while he watched,
translation_verse: Ni Babel maṅtše̱ le̱ gbe Zedekia bihĩĩ le̱ ye̱ ehĩe; ni asaṅ egbe Iuda lume̱i le̱ fẽ ye̱ Ribla.

english_verse: Jerusalem was captured during Nebuchadnezzar's nineteenth year as king of Babylonia. About a month later, Nebuchadnezzar's officer in charge of the guards arrived in Jerusalem. His name was Nebuzaradan,
translation_verse: Ni nyõṅ ní dši enumo̱ le̱ no̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ nyoṅma le̱ no̱ ye̱ maṅtše̱ Nebukadnezar, Babel maṅtše̱ le̱, yino̱ afi ní dši nyoṅma ke̱ ne̱hũ le̱ no̱ lo̱, Nebuzaradan, oblafoi atše̱ ní damoo̱ Babel maṅtše̱ le̱ hĩe le̱, ba Ierusalem;

english_verse: and he burned down the Lord's temple, the king's palace, and every important building in the city, as well as all the houses.
translation_verse: ni ebašã Iehowa we le̱ ke̱ maṅtše̱ we le̱ ke̱ Ierusalem šĩai le̱ fẽ ni šĩa wulu-fẽ-šĩa wulu le̱ eke̱ la šã.

english_verse: Then he ordered the Babylonian soldiers to break down the walls around Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ni Kaldeabii le̱ ata fẽ ní fata oblafoi atše̱ le̱ he le̱ kũmo̱ Ierusalem gbogboi le̱ fẽ hũ ke̱-kpe.

english_verse: Evil Merodach was kind to Jehoiachin and honored him more than any of the other kings held prisoner there.
translation_verse: ni eke̱le̱ wie wiemo̱ kpakpa, ni eṅõ esẽi le̱ eto maṅtše̱mei ní ke̱le̱ yo̱ Babel le̱ asẽi le̱ ano̱;

english_verse: Jehoiachin was allowed to wear regular clothes instead of a prison uniform, and he even ate at the king's table every day.
translation_verse: ni etšake etšũṅwō atadei le̱, ni eke̱le̱ yeo̱ nii dāne̱ ewala gbĩĩ abo̱ fẽ.

english_verse: As long as Jehoiachin lived, he was paid a daily allowance to buy whatever he needed.
translation_verse: Ni noni ato ní ahãale̱ le̱, Babel maṅtše̱ le̱ ṅõ adše̱o̱ ahãale̱ dā, gbĩ-fẽ-gbĩ ke̱ enõ, ewala gbĩĩ abo̱ fẽ ke̱-yaši egbĕle gbĩ.

english_verse: Each night, bitter tears flood her cheeks. None of her former lovers are there to offer comfort; her friends have betrayed her and are now her enemies.
translation_verse: Fó so̱ṅṅ efóo̱ nyōṅ, yāfónui dſere ehĩe; *mokomoko be̱ esuolo̱i le̱ fẽ ateṅ ni še̱dšeo emĩ, enanemei fiā eyele̱ kũtũmpo̱o, ame̱tšṍmo̱ ehenye̱lo̱i. *Lal.

english_verse: Zion's glory has disappeared. Her leaders are like deer that cannot find pasture; they are hunted down till their strength is gone.
translation_verse: Zion biyō le̱ hefe̱o le̱ fẽ edše ehe ete. Elumei le̱ tamo̱ ofrotei ní náá lẽ̱̀he ko, ame̱nyie tiulo̱i le̱ ahĩe ni ame̱be̱ hewale̱.

english_verse: Her people recall the good life that once was theirs; now they suffer and are scattered. No one was there to protect them from their enemies who sneered when their city was taken.
translation_verse: Ierusalem amanehũlũ ke̱ haomo̱ gbĩĩ le̱ amli le̱ ekaio̱ enu fe̱fe̱dši ní eyo̱ ke̱-dše̱ blema bēbe le̱; beni emaṅ le̱ gbē haolo̱ le̱ deṅ, ní ebe̱ bualo̱ ko le̱ ehaolo̱i le̱ nale̱, ni ame̱ṅmõ ehĩekpãtãmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Zion's treasures were stolen. Jerusalem saw foreigners enter her place of worship, though the Lord had forbidden them to belong to his people.
translation_verse: Henye̱lo̱ le̱ ekpã enine mli ye̱ enii fe̱fe̱dši le̱ fẽ no̱; ena ake̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ebote ehekroṅkroṅ le̱, *mei ní owo ame̱he kitã ake̱ ame̱kabote osafo le̱ mli le̱. *

english_verse: No passerby even cares. Why doesn't someone notice my terrible sufferings? You were fiercely angry, Lord, and you punished me worst of all.
translation_verse: Nye mei fẽ ni nyetšṍo̱ gbe̱ le̱ no̱ ke̱-hoo le̱! Ani dšee nyehe sane ko lo? Nyekwe̱a ní nyena ake̱ aw̌ere̱hō ko ye̱ ní tamo̱ miw̌ere̱hō ní ekãmi, ni Iehowa ke̱-hã mina nõ ye̱ emlifũ ní nā wa gbĩ le̱ no̱ ne̱ lo! K.

english_verse: From heaven you sent a fire that burned in my bones; you set a trap for my feet and made me turn back. All day long you leave me in shock from constant pain.
translation_verse: Etšu la ke̱-dše̱ ṅwei ke̱-ba miwui amli, ni eye ame̱no̱; etšṍ minãdši tšõne, ehã mikpale; ehã mife pasā, ehãa mifeo̱ vī dā dšenamo̱.

english_verse: You have tied my sins around my neck, and they weigh so heavily that my strength is gone. You have put me in the power of enemies too strong for me.
translation_verse: Eke̱ enine efĩ mino̱tõmo̱i apã le̱; atſẽtſẽame̱ afõ mikue̱, ehã mihewale̱ etä. Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ etumi ewo mei ní minyẽẽ ame̱hĩe madamo̱ le̱ adeṅ.

english_verse: You, Lord, have turned back my warriors and crushed my young heroes. Judah was a woman untouched, but you let her be trampled like grapes in a wine pit.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ ese̱re̱ mihĩĩ kãkãlo̱i ní yo̱ mimli le̱ fẽ eſie; etšé̱ kpē ewo mihe, ní ame̱kpãtã miblahĩĩ le̱ ahĩe. Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ enānā Iuda biyō oblayō le̱ *weinṅãtšõne le̱ no̱. *Ies.

english_verse: Zion reaches out her hands, but no one offers comfort. The Lord has turned the neighboring nations against Jacob's descendants. Jerusalem is merely a filthy rag to her neighbors. Jerusalem Speaks:
translation_verse: Zion egbe̱ enidšiaṅ, bi mīše̱dšelo̱ ko be̱ hãle̱. Iehowa efã́ Iakob henye̱lo̱i le̱ ní ame̱bo̱lele̱ ke̱-kpe; Ierusalem etšṍ tamo̱ *nyãṅemo̱ noko ye̱ ame̱teṅ. *K.

english_verse: The Lord was right, but I refused to obey him. Now I ask all of you to look at my sufferings— even my young people have been dragged away.
translation_verse: Dšalo̱ dši Iehowa; edšake̱ *mitše ekitā le̱ hĩe atũa. Nye mãdšimãdši fẽ, nyeboa toi ni nyekwe̱a miw̌ere̱hō le̱! Miblayei le̱ ke̱ miblahĩĩ le̱ ete nomṅō̃ mli. *

english_verse: I called out to my lovers, but they betrayed me. My priests and my leaders died while searching the city for scraps of food.
translation_verse: Mitšé̱ misuolo̱i le̱, ši ame̱šišiumi. Miso̱foi ke̱ minukpai le̱ eto̱ biti ye̱ mã le̱ṅ, beni *ame̱taoo̱ niyenii ame̱hã amehe ní ame̱ke̱-hã ame̱susumai ahĩe atšere̱-ame̱ le̱. *K.

english_verse: Won't you look and see how upset I am, our Lord? My stomach is in knots, and my heart is broken because I betrayed you. In the streets and at home, my people are slaughtered.
translation_verse: Iehowa, kwe̱ boni efĩmi! mimlinii mītšômo̱, mitšui etšṍ ye̱ mimli, edšake̱ mitše atŭa. Klante mīšò mibii ye̱ agbó nā, šĩa hũ gbēle ye̱.

english_verse: Don't let their evil deeds escape your sight. Punish them as much as you have punished me because of my sins. I never stop groaning— I've lost all hope!
translation_verse: Hā amenifõdšianii le̱ fẽ aba ohĩe, ni ofeame̱ tamo̱ bo̱ni ofemi ye̱ mino̱tõmo̱i le̱ fẽ hewo̱ le̱! edšake̱ mitšo̱idõmo̱ le̱ fá tšṍ, ni mitšui efe vī.

english_verse: The Lord had no mercy! He destroyed the homes of Jacob's descendants. In his anger he tore down every walled city in Judah; he toppled the nation together with its leaders, leaving them in shame.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ eplenē Iakob šihĩle̱hei le̱ fẽ, enaa mo̱bo̱; ekũme Iuda biyō le mõdši le̱ ye̱ emlifũ le̱ṅ, etšire̱ame̱ etſie šikpoṅ; ebule maṅtše̱yeli le̱ ke̱ emli lume̱i le̱.

english_verse: He attacked like an enemy with a bow and arrows, killing our loved ones. He has burned to the ground the homes on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: *Edo̱ egãi mli tamo̱ henye̱lo̱; edamo̱ ši ke̱ eninedšũrõ tamo̱ haolo̱, ní ekpãtã nii fẽ ni feo̱ hĩṅme̱i ako̱no̱ le̱ hĩe; efo̱se emlifũ le̱ tamo̱ la ye̱ Zion biyō le̱ bū le̱ mli. *Lal.

english_verse: He shattered his temple like a hut in a garden; he completely wiped out his meeting place, and did away with festivals and Sabbaths in the city of Zion. In his fierce anger he rejected our king and priests.
translation_verse: Efe esese le̱ butū tamo̱ ahũo̱ trom mli, efite egwabō̱he le̱. Iehowa ehã hĩe ekpa gbidšũrõ ke̱ hedšō̱mo̱gbĩ le̱ no̱ ye̱ Zion, ní emlifũ hĩedō̱ le̱ mli le̱ enyāṅe maṅtše̱ ke̱ oso̱fo fẽ.

english_verse: The Lord had decided to tear down the walls of Zion stone by stone. So he started destroying and did not stop until walls and fortresses mourned and trembled.
translation_verse: Iehowa eto eyiṅ ake̱ eekpätä Zion biyō le̱ gbogbo le̱ hĩe; eṅmẽ kpã ke̱, esuko enine ewoko mli ní efõle̱ plenēmo̱; ehã kpoku ke̱ gbogbo fẽ miye ṅko̱mo̱, ame̱fẽ ame̱gbo̱dšo̱,

english_verse: Zion's leaders are silent. They just sit on the ground, tossing dirt on their heads and wearing sackcloth. Her young women can do nothing but stare at the ground.
translation_verse: Zion biyō le̱ onukpai le̱ trá šikpoṅ, ame̱fe diṅṅ; ame̱lō mlu ame̱ſie ame̱yiteaṅ, ame̱mīa kpekpei; Ierusalem oblayei le̱ emāmo̱ ame̱yii aši.

english_verse: A child begs its mother for food and drink, then blacks out like a wounded soldier lying in the street. The child slowly dies in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: Ame̱kē̱o̱ ame̱nyemei ake̱: Nẽgbe̱ able ke̱ wein yo̱? beni ame̱to̱tō̱ biti tamo̱ pilafoi ye̱ mã le̱ṅ blohũi le̱ amli, ní ame̱fo̱seo̱ ame̱susuma ame̱ſieo̱ ame̱nyemei amīnā le̱.

english_verse: Zion, how can I comfort you? How great is your pain? Lovely city of Jerusalem, how can I heal your wounds, gaping as wide as the sea?
translation_verse: Mẽ odase maye mahão, meni he maṅõo mato, Ierusalem biyō? Meni mike̱-ato ohe, ni mike̱-še̱dše omī, Zion biyō oblayō? Edšake̱ opilamo̱ le̱ da tamo̱ ṅšo̱; namo aanyẽo atšá?

english_verse: Zion, your enemies curse you and snarl like wild animals, while shouting, “This is the day we've waited for! At last, we've got you!”
translation_verse: Ohenye̱lo̱i le̱ fẽ egbe̱ ame̱dāṅ ewoö, ame̱boo̱ tšia, ni *ame̱kpeo̱ ame̱nyãnyõdši ašiši, ame̱kē̱o̱ ake̱: “Wo̱plenēle̱ pe̱! Gbĩ ni †wo̱kwe̱o̱ gbe̱ le̱ ne̱; eše̱ wo̱deṅ ni wo̱na!” *Hiob

english_verse: The Lord has done everything that he had planned and threatened long ago. He destroyed you without mercy and let your enemies boast about their powerful forces.
translation_verse: Iehowa yiṅ ní eto le̱ efe; ehã ewiemo̱ ní ewo he kitã ke̱-dse̱ blema bēbe le̱ eba mli; etšire̱ etſia ši ni enaa mo̱bo̱; ebo henye̱lo̱ le̱ eyeo yō̱; ewo haolo̱i le̱ aklonto le̱ no̱!

english_verse: Zion, deep in your heart you cried out to the Lord. Now let your tears overflow your walls day and night. Don't ever lose hope or let your tears stop.
translation_verse: Ame̱tšui blo̱ tšé̱ Iehowa; Zion biyō le̱ gbogbo, hã *yēfónui aho tamo̱ fā ſane ke̱ nyōṅ; kākpa, kãhā ohĩṅme̱i mli adša-ṅmalāte̱ le̱ midšō̱ ehe! *K.

english_verse: Get up and pray for help all through the night. Pour out your feelings to the Lord, as you would pour water out of a jug. Beg him to save your people, who are starving to death at every street crossing. Jerusalem Speaks:
translation_verse: Te ši ni obo yāfó nyōṅ, ye̱ būbei le̱ ašišidšē mli; fo̱seme̱ otšui oſie ši tamo̱ nu ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ hĩe; holemo̱ onidši ano̱ otšõle̱ ye̱ obii abifabii le̱ asusuma hewo̱, edšake̱ ame̱mīto̱ biti ke̱ hōmo̱ ye̱ blohũ-fẽ-blobũ kóṅ!

english_verse: Think about it, Lord! Have you ever been this cruel to anyone before? Is it right for mothers to eat their children, or for priests and prophets to be killed in your temple?
translation_verse: Iehowa, kwe̱mo̱ ní ona moni ofe le̱ ene̱ ne̱! Aso yei aye *ame̱mũsũṅbii, abifabii ni ahĩe ye̱ dẽ le̱? Aso agbe oso̱fo ke̱ gbalo̱ fẽ ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱? *

english_verse: My people, both young and old, lie dead in the streets. Because you were angry, my young men and women were brutally slaughtered.
translation_verse: Gbekẽbii ke̱ onukpai kãmo̱ šikpoṅ ye̱ blohũi amli; miblayei ke̱ miblahĩĩ le̱ enyõnyõi ye̱ klante nā. Oye awui ye̱ omlifū gbĩ le̱ no̱; ogbe kpo̱tō̱, onaa mo̱bo̱.

english_verse: When you were angry, Lord, you invited my enemies like guests for a party. No one survived that day; enemies killed my children, my own little ones.
translation_verse: Otšé̱ migbeyei le̱ owo hefẽhe ke̱-kpe tamo̱ *kpē gbĩ, ni Iehowa mlifũ gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ moni edše mli ke̱ moni eſe̱ be̱; mei ní mihole ke̱ mei ni milè̱ le̱, mihenye̱lo̱ eplenēame̱. *K.

english_verse: God caused my skin and flesh to waste away, and he crushed my bones.
translation_verse: Mihelo ke̱ mihewolo he edšo̱; ekũmo̱ miwui.

english_verse: God has turned my life sour.
translation_verse: Ewomi obõ ke̱ dšõmo̱, ehã tatšo eto̱mi dā̃.

english_verse: I cannot find peace or remember happiness.
translation_verse: Otši misusuma ke̱-dše̱ hedšo̱le̱ he; mihĩe edše edšũrõyeli no̱,

english_verse: I tell myself, “I am finished! I can't count on the Lord to do anything for me.”
translation_verse: ni mikē̱ ake̱; Mihewale̱ ke̱ noni mihĩe kã no̱ ke̱-dše̱ Iehowa ṅõ le̱ hĩe ekpãtã.

english_verse: Just thinking of my troubles and my lonely wandering makes me miserable.
translation_verse: Kaimo̱ mimanehũlũ ke̱ mihaomo̱, tatšo ke̱ ko̱liko̱ le̱!

english_verse: That's all I ever think about, and I am depressed.
translation_verse: Misusuma kaio̱ pe̱pē̱pe̱ ni edo̱ ko̱mō̱ ye̱ mimli.

english_verse: Then I remember something that fills me with hope.
translation_verse: Mike̱ ene̱ eto mitšuiṅ, nohewo̱ le̱ miye̱ hĩeno̱kãmo̱ kẽ.

english_verse: The Lord's kindness never fails! If he had not been merciful, we would have been destroyed.
translation_verse: Iehowa mo̱bo̱nale̱ nā ni wo̱plenēko ne̱, edšake̱ emũsũṅtšõle̱i le̱ etãã; Neh.

english_verse: The Lord can always be trusted to show mercy each morning.
translation_verse: ame̱tšṍo̱ ehēi dã lebi, ono̱kwayeli le̱ da kple!

english_verse: Deep in my heart I say, “The Lord is all I need; I can depend on him!”
translation_verse: Misusuma kē̱o̱ ake̱: Iehowa dši *migbe̱fãṅnõ, hewo̱ le̱ mihĩe kã eno̱. *Lal.

english_verse: The Lord is kind to everyone who trusts and obeys him.
translation_verse: Iehowa mli hĩ hã mei ni kwe̱o̱le̱ gbe̱ le̱, ke̱ susuma ni taoo̱ ese̱gbe̱ le̱.

english_verse: It is good to wait patiently for the Lord to save us.
translation_verse: Ehĩ ake̱ afe diõ amẽ Iehowa yiwalaheremo̱. Rom.

english_verse: When we are young, it is good to struggle hard
translation_verse: Ehĩ hã nū ake̱ etĕreo̱ ekõṅtšo ye̱ eblohĩĩaṅ.

english_verse: and to sit silently alone, if this is what the Lord intends.
translation_verse: Ké̱ ake̱-fõ eno̱ le̱, hã ekome etá šĩ ni efe diõ;

english_verse: Being rubbed in the dirt can teach us a lesson;
translation_verse: hã eke̱ enābu ebu sũ mli, ake̱ aleenõ hieno̱kãmo̱ ko ye̱ lo;

english_verse: we can also learn from insults and hard knocks.
translation_verse: hã eke̱ edā he ahã moni gbaäle̱ mã le̱; hã awole̱ obõ ke̱ ahorabō̱.

english_verse: He causes a lot of suffering, but he also has pity because of his great love.
translation_verse: edšake̱ ke̱dši efe mo nidō̱nii po le̱, kẽle̱ emũsũṅ tšõo̱le̱ ye̱ emo̱bo̱nale̱ fále̱ le̱ nā; Ies.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't enjoy sending grief or pain.
translation_verse: edšake̱ dšee etsui nā ehãa mo naã amanehũlũ, lo efeo̱ gbomei abii anidō̱nii.

english_verse: Don't trample prisoners under your feet
translation_verse: Ké̱ moko ſiſia šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ gbokle̱foi le̱ fẽ ye̱ enãdšĩaši,

english_verse: or cheat anyone out of what is rightfully theirs. God Most High sees everything,
translation_verse: ké̱ moko kẽdõ gbomo kodšomo̱ ye̱ Ṅweinyo le̱ hĩe,

english_verse: and he knows when you refuse to give someone a fair trial.
translation_verse: ké̱ moko tšṍ gbomo sane hĩe bu ši le̱, ani Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ enaa?

english_verse: No one can do anything without the Lord's approval.
translation_verse: Namo dši moni aakē̱ *noko ni eeba mli, kedši Nuṅtšo le fã́ko le? *Ies.

english_verse: Good and bad each happen at the command of God Most High.
translation_verse: Ani efõṅ ke̱ ekpakpa fẽ le̱ dšee Ṅweinyo le̱ dāṅ dše̱o̱ lo?

english_verse: We're still alive! We shouldn't complain when we are being punished for our sins.
translation_verse: Mẽhewo̱ gbomo wieo̱ hũhū̃hũ ye̱ ewala mli? Hã mofẽmo awie hũhū̃hũ ye̱ ehe ešai le̱ ahewo̱ moṅ!

english_verse: Instead, we should think about the way we are living, and turn back to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyehãa wo̱taoo̱ wo̱gbé̱i le̱ amli ni wo̱kaä wo̱kwe̱a, ni wo̱kpalea ke̱ baä Iehowa ṅõ ekoṅl

english_verse: When we lift our hands in prayer to God in heaven, we should offer him our hearts and say,
translation_verse: Nyehãa wo̱holea wo̱tšuii ke̱ wo̱nidši ano̱ wo̱hãa Nyoṅmo̱ ye̱ ṅwei!

english_verse: “We've sinned! We've rebelled against you, and you haven't forgiven us!
translation_verse: Wo̱ le̱ *wo̱tõ ni wo̱tše atũa; bo le̱ oṅō-fako. *Lal.

english_verse: Anger is written all over you, as you pursue and slaughter us without showing pity.
translation_verse: Oke̱ mlifũ eha ohe ni onyie wo̱se̱ ke̱ yiwale̱, ogbewo̱, onako mo̱bo̱

english_verse: You are behind a wall of clouds that blocks out our prayers.
translation_verse: Oke atatu eha ohe, koni faikpamo̱ akatšṍ mli ke̱-mīho.

english_verse: You allowed nations to treat us like garbage;
translation_verse: Oke̱wo̱ efe bē̱mo̱nii ke̱ nyãṅemo̱nii ye̱ mãdšimãdši le̱ ateṅ.

english_verse: our enemies curse us.
translation_verse: Wo̱henye̱lo̱i le̱ fẽ egbe̱gbē̱ amedāṅ ame̱wowo̱.

english_verse: We are terrified and trapped, caught and crushed.”
translation_verse: Gbeyei ke̱ bu ke̱ fitemo̱ ke̱ hĩekpãtãmo̱ ebakã wo̱no̱.

english_verse: My people are destroyed! Tears flood my eyes,
translation_verse: Mihĩṅme̱i mli ſo̱seo̱ mu fãi ſieo̱ ši ye̱ mimaṅ le̱ biyō le̱ hĩekpãtãmo̱ le̱ hewo̱. Ier.

english_verse: and they won't stop
translation_verse: Mihĩṅme̱i mli hoo̱ nu dāne̱, ni efõõ,

english_verse: until the Lord looks down from heaven and helps.
translation_verse: ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní Iehowa aamã eyi ši ni edše̱ ṅwei ekwe̱.

english_verse: I am horrified when I see what enemies have done to the young women of our city.
translation_verse: Mihĩṅme̱i ehao misusuma ye̱ mimaṅ biyei le̱ fẽ ahewo̱.

english_verse: No one had reason to hate me, but I was hunted down like a bird.
translation_verse: Mei ní nye̱o̱mi yakatſā le̱ mīgbo̱bimi tamo̱ loflõ;

english_verse: Then they tried to kill me by tossing me into a pit and throwing stones at me.
translation_verse: ame̱plenē miwala ye̱ bu le̱ mli, ni ame̱ke̱ te̱i eſie mino̱.

english_verse: Water covered my head— I thought I was gone.
translation_verse: Nui le̱ ho ye̱ miyiteṅ; miké̱ ake̱: Milādše!

english_verse: From the bottom of the pit, I prayed to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Iehowa, bu le̱ šiši tō̃ midše̱ mitšé̱ ogbe̱i. Lal.

english_verse: I begged you to listen. “Help!” I shouted. “Save me!” You answered my prayer
translation_verse: Onu migbē: Kātšĩmo̱ otoi ye̱ mihū̃mo̱ ke̱ miblo̱mo̱ le̱ no!

english_verse: and came when I was in need. You told me, “Don't worry!”
translation_verse: Gbĩ ni mitšé̱o le̱ otši obe̱ṅke̱, oké̱ ake̱: Kāše gbeyei!

english_verse: You rescued me and saved my life.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱, oye misusuma sane le̱ ohãmi, okpõ miwala!

english_verse: You saw them abuse me, Lord, so make things right.
translation_verse: Iehowa, ona yi ní awaämi le̱; ye misane le̱ ohãmi!

english_verse: You know every plot they have made against me.
translation_verse: Ona ame̱weletō̱ le̱ fẽ ke̱ ame̱yiṅ ní ame̱to ye̱ mihe le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: Yes, you know their insults and their evil plans.
translation_verse: Iehowa, onu ame̱hora ní ame̱bo̱ö̱ te ke̱ ame̱yiṅ ní ame̱too̱ ye̱ mihe le̱ fẽ,

english_verse: All day long they attack with words and whispers.
translation_verse: mei ní teo̱ ši woo̱mi le̱ ana wiemo̱ ke̱ ame̱dſēṅmo̱ ní ame̱dſēṅo̱ ye̱ mihe dā dšenamo̱ le̱.

english_verse: No matter what they are doing, they keep on mocking me.
translation_verse: Kwe̱mo̱, ši ame̱trá dšio, ši ame̱te dšio, mi noṅṅ dši *ame̱dăṅ lala! *K.

english_verse: Pay them back for everything they have done, Lord!
translation_verse: Iehowa, toame̱ nãdšíaṅ ye̱ ame̱nidši anã nitšumo̱i le̱ anã!

english_verse: Put your curse on them and make them suffer.
translation_verse: Ṅo̱ tšuino̱hānõ ko ohãame̱, ni olōmo̱ le̱ akã ame̱no̱!

english_verse: Get angry and go after them until not a trace is left under the heavens.
translation_verse: Tiumo̱ame̱ ye̱ mlifũ mli, ni okpãtã ame̱hĩe ke̱-dše̱ Iehowa ṅwei šišĩ ne̱!

english_verse: Even jackals nurse their young, but my people are like ostriches that abandon their own.
translation_verse: Ṅãṅgbēi tete gblaä ame̱fufo̱ amehãa ame̱bii yeo̱; mimaṅ le̱ biyō le̱ etšṍ yiwalo̱ tamo̱ dugumai ní yo̱ ṅãno̱.

english_verse: Babies are so thirsty that their tongues are stuck to the roof of the mouth. Children go begging for food, but no one gives them any.
translation_verse: Gbekẽ fufo̱õ lile̱i kpe̱te̱o̱ edā yiteṅ ye kũmai ni yeo̱le̱ hewo̱; abifabii bio̱ abolo ši, ši mokomoko be̱ ní kũo̱ hāa-ame̱.

english_verse: Life in the city is so bad that loving mothers have boiled and eaten their own children.
translation_verse: Yei ni mũšũṅ tšõo̱ame̱ le̱ anidši hõo̱ ame̱dientše̱ ame̱mũsũṅbii; ame̱tšṍmo̱ ame̱niyenii ye̱ mimaṅ ke̱ biyō le̱ hĩekpãtãmo̱ le̱ mli.

english_verse: Jerusalem was punished because her prophets and her priests had sinned and caused the death of innocent victims.
translation_verse: Egbalo̱i le̱ ahe ešai le̱ ke̱ eso̱foi le̱ ni ſie dšalo̱i le̱ alá ši ye̱ eteṅ le̱ anišaianii le̱ ahewo̱ dše̱.

english_verse: Yes, her prophets and priests were covered with blood; no one would come near them, as they wandered from street to street.
translation_verse: Ame̱lilaä ši tamo̱ ſilafoi ye̱ blohũi le̱ amli, ame̱bule ame̱he ke̱ lá, ní anyẽẽ ame̱tadei ke̱ ahe ata.

english_verse: The Lord is the one who sent them scattering, and he has forgotten them. No respect or kindness will be shown to the priests or leaders.
translation_verse: Iehowa hĩetũmo̱ efãame̱ eſie, ekwe̱e̱ame̱ doṅṅ; abuṅ oso̱foi le̱, *onukpai le̱ ahĩe baṅ nyam doṅṅ. *

english_verse: Our eyes became weary, hopelessly looking for help from a nation that could not save us.
translation_verse: Wo̱hĩṅme̱ii ešiu ke̱ kwe̱ ní wo̱kwe̱o̱ wo̱yaka yeli-ke̱-buamo̱ ke̱ gbe̱; wo̱sramo̱ le̱ mli le̱ wo̱kwe̱ dseṅmaṅ ko ni nyẽṅ yiwala ahere gbe̱.

english_verse: Enemies hunted us down on every public street. Our time was up; our doom was near.
translation_verse: Agbo̱bio̱ wonãdšifãmoi, ni wo̱nyẽẽ wo̱nyie ye̱ wo̱blohũi le̱ amli. Wonāgbë le̱ ebe̱ṅke̱, wogbĩĩ le̱ eše̱ pe̱; edšake̱ wo̱nāgbē le̱ eše̱!

english_verse: They swooped down faster than eagles from the sky. They hunted for us in the hills and set traps to catch us out in the desert.
translation_verse: Wo̱tiulo̱i ke̱ ahe ye̱ oyá fè ṅwei okropoṅi; amenyie wo̱se̱ ye̱ gõdši ke̱ ano̱, ni ame̱wowo̱ ka ye̱ ṅã le̱ no̱.

english_verse: The Lord's chosen leader was our hope for survival! We thought he would keep us safe somewhere among the nations, but even he was caught in one of their traps.
translation_verse: Wo̱wala mumo̱ ní dši moni Iehowa efo̱le̱ mũ le̱, amòle̱ ye̱ ame̱bui le̱ amli, moni wo̱kē̱ ye̱ ehe ake̱: Ebō̃ṅ le̱ šiši wo̱yi aaná wala ye̱ ye̱ dšeṅmàdši le̱ ateṅ le̱! Ier

english_verse: The people of Zion have paid for their sins, and the Lord will soon let them return home. But, people of Edom, you will be punished, and your sins exposed.
translation_verse: Zion biyō, *agbe onišaianii ke̱ ahe nyõmo̱wo ke̱ nā; eṅõṅo ke̱-yaṅ nom mli doṅṅ *lo Edom biyo̱; eebasra onišaianii ke̱, eedšie ohe ešai le̱ akpo! *Ies.

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget how we have suffered and been disgraced.
translation_verse: Iehowa, kaimo̱ noni eba wo̱no̱ le̱; kwe̱mo̱ ní ona wo̱hora ní abo̱ö̱wo̱ le̱!

english_verse: We are like children whose mothers are widows.
translation_verse: Wo̱tšṍmo̱ awusăi, wo̱be̱ tše̱mei; wo̱nyemei tamo̱ yei okũlafoi.

english_verse: The water we drink and the wood we burn cost far too much.
translation_verse: Wo̱nu le̱ wo̱nuo̱ ye̱ šika nā; wo̱lai le̱, hō̃mo̱ ahõo̱ ahãawo̱.

english_verse: We had to surrender to Egypt and Assyria because we were hungry.
translation_verse: Wo̱ke̱ wo̱he hã Mizraim ke̱ Ašur, koni wo̱ná nii wo̱ye ni wo̱tŏ̱ro̱.

english_verse: Our ancestors sinned, but they are dead, and we are left to pay for their sins.
translation_verse: Wo̱tše̱mei le̱ efe eša, ni ame̱be̱, ni wo̱ moṅ wo̱tĕre amenišaianii le̱.

english_verse: Slaves are now our rulers, and there is no one to set us free.
translation_verse: Tšũdši yeo̱ wo̱no̱; moko be̱ ní aadšiewo̱ ye̱ ame̱deṅ.

english_verse: We are in danger from brutal desert tribes; we must risk our lives just to bring in our crops.
translation_verse: Ṅãno̱ klante le̱ hewo̱ le̱ wo̱ke̱ wo̱wala tšĕrẽo̱ tšei anā dãni wo̱náa niyenii.

english_verse: Our skin is scorched from fever and hunger.
translation_verse: Hõmo̱ ní mli edo̱ la le̱ hewo̱ le̱ wo̱hewolo ešã tū̃ tamo̱ flõnõ.

english_verse: On Zion and everywhere in Judah our wives and daughters are being raped.
translation_verse: Ame̱to yei le̱ kabonā ye̱ Zion, ke̱ oblayei le̱ hũ ye̱ Iuda mãdši ke̱ amli.

english_verse: Our rulers are strung up by their arms, and our nation's advisors are treated shamefully.
translation_verse: Ame̱ke̱ ame̱nidši se̱ṅo̱ lume̱i, ame̱hĩe eſiee onukpai le̱ ahĩeiṅ.

english_verse: Our leaders are not allowed to decide cases in court, and young people no longer play music.
translation_verse: Onukpai le̱ efõ koi le̱ ši yā, oblahĩĩ le̱ hũ efõ ame̱saṅkũtſā le̱.

english_verse: Our hearts are sad; instead of dancing, we mourn.
translation_verse: Wo̱tsuiṅ mīše̱ le̱ se̱ efo; wo̱dšò le̱ etšṍ ṅko̱mo̱yeli.

english_verse: Zion's glory has disappeared! And we are doomed because of our sins.
translation_verse: Wo̱yiteṅ *akekre le̱ edše egbē ši. Kpóo hawo̱, ake̱ wo̱fe eša! *Ier.

english_verse: We feel sick all over and can't even see straight;
translation_verse: Ene̱ hewo̱ ke̱ wo̱tšui egbo̱dšo̱, ene̱mei ahewo̱ le̱ wo̱hĩṅme̱ii ano̱ efe tūtū,

english_verse: our city is in ruins, overrun by wild dogs.
translation_verse: ye̱ Zion goṅ ní efe amaṅfõ, ní oso̱i po nyieo̱ no̱ le̱ hewo̱!

english_verse: You will rule forever, Lord! You are King for all time.
translation_verse: Bo Iehowa ohĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaã nāno̱, osẽi ke̱ ye̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ yino̱ ke̱-yaä yino̱.

english_verse: Why have you forgotten us for so long?
translation_verse: Mẽba *ohĩe aakpa wo̱no̱ ke̱-ya nāno̱, ni ookwawo̱ wo̱wala gbĩĩ abo̱ fẽ? *Lal.

english_verse: Bring us back to you! Give us a fresh start.
translation_verse: Kpalemo̱wo̱ ke̱-ba oṅõ, Iehowa, ni wo̱o̱kpale; femo̱ wo̱gbĩĩ le̱ ehē tamo̱ blema le̱!

english_verse: Or do you despise us so much that you don't want us?
translation_verse: Kākā efe ake̱ okwawo̱ kwrakwra ni omli efũwo̱ tūtu!

english_verse: and in that center I saw what looked like four living creatures. They were somewhat like humans,
translation_verse: Ni hĩekãlo̱i edſe̱ subãṅ dšeo̱ kpo ye̱ eteṅ; ni bo̱ni ame̱su yo̱ ne̱: ame̱hĩe gbomo subãṅ;

english_verse: except that each one had four faces and four wings.
translation_verse: ni mofẽmo ye̱ hĩei edſe̱, ni ame̱teṅ mofẽmo ye̱ fĩdši edſe̱;

english_verse: Their legs were straight, but their feet looked like the hoofs of calves and sparkled like bronze.
translation_verse: ni ameãādši le̱ nãdši trõmō̃i ni, ni ame̱nãdši ašiši tamo̱ tšina nanešiši, ni ame̱-he kple̱o̱ tamo̱ akō̱ble ní aša he kãṅkãṅ;

english_verse: The four creatures were standing back to back with the tips of their wings touching. They moved together in every direction, without turning their bodies.
translation_verse: ame̱fĩdši le̱ eko ke̱ eko tša; ké̱ ame̱mīnyie le̱, ame̱tšṍmo̱o̱ ame̱he: ame̱teṅ mofẽmo nyieo̱ ke̱-yaã ehĩe tē̃.

english_verse: Two wings of each creature were spread out and touched the wings of the creatures on either side. The other two wings of each creature were folded against its body.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱hĩei ke̱ ame̱fīdši le̱ adšadšā mli ye̱ yiteṅgbe̱; mofẽmo fĩdši enyo̱ tša, ni enyo̱ hũ ame̱ke̱-hahā ame̱gbomo-tšei le̱ ahe.

english_verse: The creatures were glowing like hot coals, and I saw something like a flaming torch moving back and forth among them. Lightning flashed from the torch every time its flame blazed up.
translation_verse: Ni hĩekãlo̱i le̱ ateṅ le̱ noko dšeo̱ kpo tamo̱ ṅãi la ní tšoo̱ tamo̱ ko̱tii, ni enyienyieo̱ ye̱ hĩekãlo̱i le̱ ateṅ; ni la le̱ kpe̱o̱, ni srawa dše̱o̱ la le̱ mli.

english_verse: The creatures themselves moved as quickly as sparks jumping from a fire.
translation_verse: Ni hĩekãlo̱i le̱ šaä foi ke̱-yaä ke̱-baä tamo̱ srawa gbaä.

english_verse: I then noticed that on the ground beside each of the four living creatures was a wheel,
translation_verse: Ni beni mikwe̱ hĩekãlo̱i le̱, na kokrolonto komekome mãmo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ ye̱ hĩekãlo̱i le̱ amase̱i ye̱ ame̱hĩei edſe̱ le̱.

english_verse: shining like chrysolite. Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it,
translation_verse: Kokrolontoi le̱ asu ke̱ ame̱femo̱ tamo̱ Taršiš-te̱ su, ni ame̱yi edſe̱ le̱ ame̱hĩe subãṅ kome, ni ame̱su ke̱ ame̱femo̱ tamo̱ noni kokrolonto ho̱ kokrolonto teṅ.

english_verse: so that they could move in any direction without turning.
translation_verse: Ké̱ ame̱mīnyie le̱, ame̱nyieo̱ ame̱-kodši edſe̱ le̱ no̱, ni ké̱ ame̱mīnyie le̱, ame̱tšṍmo̱o̱ ame̱he.

english_verse: The rims of the wheels were large and frightening, and they had eyes all the way around them.
translation_verse: Ame̱gai le̱ kwŏ̱lo̱ ni ame̱he ye̱ gbeyei; ni ame̱gai le̱ ahe eyimo̱ to̱ ke̱ hĩṅme̱ii ke̱-bo̱le ame̱yi edſe̱ le̱ fẽ ke̱-kpe.
