english_verse: The creatures controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the four creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels were beside them.
translation_verse: Ké̱ nomei mīnyie le̱, bĕle̱ ene̱mei hũ mīnyie; ni ké̱ nomei wa damo̱ ši le̱, bĕle̱ ene̱mei hũ ewa edamo̱ ši; ni ké̱ nomei hole ame̱he no̱ ke̱-dše̱ šikpoṅ le̱, bĕ̱le̱ kokrolontoi le̱ hũ ke̱ame̱ ehole ame̱he no̱ šikōme; edšake̱ hĩekãlo̱i le̱ amumo̱ ye̱ kokrolontoi le̱ amli.

english_verse: Whenever the creatures flew, their wings roared like an ocean or a large army or even the voice of God All-Powerful. And whenever the creatures stopped, they folded their wings against their bodies.
translation_verse: Ké̱ ame̱mīnyie le̱, minuo̱ ame̱fĩdšiaṅ gbē̱mo̱ tamo̱ nu babaō gbē̱mo̱, tamo̱ Ofe le̱ gbē, hōfemo̱ gbē ní tamo̱ ta gbē,; ši ké̱ ame̱wa ame̱damo̱ ši le̱, bĕle̱ ame̱ṅmē̃ ame̱fĩdši le̱ ahe ame̱ſie ši.

english_verse: When the creatures stopped flapping their wings, I heard a sound coming from above the dome.
translation_verse: Ni ké̱ ame̱wa ame̱damo̱ ši ni ame̱ṅmē̃ ame̱fĩdši ahe ame̱ſie ši le̱, gbē dše̱o̱ atatu ní yo̱ ame̱yiteṅ le̱ mli.

english_verse: I then saw what looked like a throne made of sapphire, and sitting on the throne was a figure in the shape of a human.
translation_verse: Ni noko ní tamo maṅtše̱sẽi ní esu tamo̱ safiro-te̱ dšeo̱ kpo ye̱ atatu ní yo̱ ame̱yiteṅ le̱ no̱, ni ké̱ akwe̱ le̱, noko ní tamo̱ gbomo ye̱ noko ní tamo maṅtše̱sẽi le̱ no̱ ye̱ yiteṅgbe̱. K.

english_verse: From the waist up, it was glowing like metal in a hot furnace, and from the waist down it looked like the flames of a fire. The figure was surrounded by a bright light,
translation_verse: Ni mina ake̱ edšidše tamo̱ šika ní kpe̱o̱; ni ke̱-dše̱ ehe su le̱ no̱ ke̱-yaä ṅwei-gbe̱ le̱ la ebo̱lele̱ ke̱-kpe, ni asaṅ ke̱-dše̱ ehe̱ su le̱ no̱ ke̱-kplekeo̱ ši le̱ mina ake̱ etamo̱ la, ní kpe̱mo̱ ebo̱lele̱ ke̱-kpe.

english_verse: as colorful as a rainbow that appears after a storm. I realized I was seeing the brightness of the Lord's glory! So I bowed with my face to the ground, and just then I heard a voice speaking to me.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni kwābue̱te̱ ní yo̱ atatu mli ye̱ nyoṅmo̱ne̱mo̱ gbĩ no̱ le̱ su yo̱ le̱, nakai kpe̱mo̱ ní bo̱lele̱ ke̱-kpe le̱ yo̱. Ene̱ dši Iehowa anumnyam le̱ kpe̱mo̱ le̱ kpodšiemo̱. Ni beni mina le̱, miho migbē ši ni mike̱ mihĩe bu ši, ni minu moko ní wieo̱ gbē. Kpods.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, I want you to stand up and listen.”
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱mĩ ake̱: Gbomobi, te ši odamo̱ onãdši ano̱, ní mike̱o awie!

english_verse: After he said this, his Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Ni beni eke̱mi wieo̱ le̱, mumo̱ le̱ bote mimli ni etēmi ši edamo̱ minãdší ano̱, ni mibo moni ke̱mi wieo̱ le̱ toi.

english_verse: They are stubborn and hardheaded. But I, the Lord God, have chosen you to tell them what I say.
translation_verse: Ni bii ní hĩe wa ni ame̱wadše ame̱tšui le̱ aṅõ mitšũo̱o, ní oyakē̱ame̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱!

english_verse: Those rebels may not even listen, but at least they will know that a prophet has come to them.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ le̱, *ame̱bo toi dšio, ame̱boo toi dšio, ake̱-ní weku toigbolo̱i dšiame̱ hewo le̱, ame̱ná ame̱le kẽ ake̱ gbalo̱ ko ye̱ ame̱teṅ. *

english_verse: Don't be afraid of them or of anything they say. You may think you're in the middle of a thorn patch or a bunch of scorpions. But be brave
translation_verse: Ši bo, gbomobi, kāšeame̱ gbeyei, ni kāše ame̱wiemo̱i le̱ hũ gbeyei: tše̱ ṅmei ke̱ kpitikpitii ke̱o yo̱, ni nyoṅmo̱ṅkrakroi ateṅ ohĩo̱, kẽle̱ kāše ame̱wiemo̱i le̱ agbeyei, ni otšui akafã ye̱ ame̱hĩe hũ; tše̱ weku toigbolo̱i dšiame̱.

english_verse: and preach my message to them, whether they choose to listen or not.
translation_verse: Kẽle̱ ame̱ bo toi dšio, ame̱boo toi dšio, wiemo̱ miwiemo̱i le̱ otšõame̱, edšake̱ toigbolo̱i dšiame̱.

english_verse: Just then, I saw a hand stretched out toward me. And in it was a scroll.
translation_verse: Ni mikwe̱, ni na, akpā nine mli ahãmi; ni na, wolokpo ye̱ mli. Kpods.

english_verse: The hand opened the scroll, and both sides of it were filled with words of sadness, mourning, and grief.
translation_verse: Ni eṅõ lē̱ ši ye̱ mihĩe, ni aṅmã hĩe ke̱ se̱, ni aṅmã yāfói ke̱ ntšo̱idõme̱ ke̱ yărafemo̱ ye̱ mli.

english_verse: They are Israelites, not some strangers who speak a foreign language you can't understand. If I were to send you to foreign nations, they would listen to you.
translation_verse: dšee mãdšimãdši babaō ní wieo̱ maṅse̱ wiemo̱ ní ame̱wiemo̱ wa ni onuu ame̱wiemo̱ ni. Le̱le̱ṅ, ké̱ ame̱ṅõ mitšũo̱o ne̱ kũle̱, ame̱aboö toi!

english_verse: Listen carefully to everything I say and then think about it.
translation_verse: Ni esā ekē̱mi ake̱: Gbomobi, miwiemoi fẽ ni mike̱o aawie le̱, hemo̱ owo otšuiṅ, ni onu ke̱ otoii,

english_verse: The Spirit lifted me up, and as the glory of the Lord started to leave, I heard a loud, thundering noise behind me.
translation_verse: Ni *mumo̱ le̱ wómi, ní minu hosomo̱ kpeteṅkple gbē ye̱ mise̱ ní kē̱ ke̱-dše̱ egbe̱he le̱ ake̱: Aadšie Iehowa anumnyam le̱ yi! *

english_verse: Then the Spirit carried me away. The Lord's power had taken complete control of me, and I was both annoyed and angry.
translation_verse: Ni mumo̱ le̱ womi, ni eke̱mi te, ni mite ye̱ mimumo̱ mlila ní nā wa le̱ mli, ni Iehowa nine le̱ mli wa ye̱ mino̱.

english_verse: When I was back with the others living at Abib Hill near the Chebar River, I sat among them for seven days, shocked at what had happened to me. The Lord Appoints Ezekiel To Stand Watch (Ezekiel
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni miba nomi ní yo̱ Tel-Abib, mei ní yo̱ Kebar fā le̱ nā le̱ ke̱ mei ní hĩo̱ dše̱i le̱ aṅõ; ni mitá ši ye̱ ame̱teṅ ye̱ dše̱i gbĩĩ kpawo so̱ṅṅ, ni mitſaa misẽṅ.

english_verse: Seven days after I had seen the brightness of the Lord's glory, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱ gbĩĩ kpawo le̱ se̱ le̱, Iehowa wiemo̱ ba miṅõ ake:

english_verse: However, if you do warn them, and they keep on sinning, they will die because of their sins, and you will be innocent.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši obo̱ efõṅfelo̱ le̱ ko̱ko̱, ni ekpalee ke̱-dše̱e̱ enõfõṅfemo̱ le̱ṅ ke̱ egbe̱ fõṅ le̱ no̱ le̱, eegbo ye̱ enišaianii le̱ ahewo̱, ši bo le̱ ohere osusuma yiwala.

english_verse: Now suppose faithful people start sinning, and I decide to put stumbling blocks in their paths to make them fall. They deserve to die because of their sins. So if you refuse to warn them, I will forget about the times they were faithful, and I will hold you responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ ke̱dši *dšalo̱ kpale ke̱-dše̱ edšale̱ le̱ṅ ni efe nii ní edšaa le̱, mike̱ pāmpi aato ehĩe ni eegbo: ke̱dši obo̱o̱le̱ ko̱ko̱ le̱, eegbo ye̱ ehe eša le̱ hewo̱, ni akaiṅ edšale̱nii ní efe le̱; ši elá le̱, odeṅ mabi ši ke̱-adše̱. *

english_verse: But if you do warn them, and they listen to you and stop sinning, I will let them live. And you will be innocent. Ezekiel Cannot Talk
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši obo̱ dšalo̱ le̱ ko̱ko̱, beni afe ní dšalo̱ le̱ akafe eša, ni efee eša le̱, no le̱ eyi aaná wala, edšake̱ ekplẽ ko̱ko̱bō̱; ni bo hũ odšie osusuma.

english_verse: The Lord took control of me and said, “Stand up! Go into the valley, and I will talk with you there.”
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa nine ba mino̱ *ye̱ dše̱i, ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Te ši ní oya dšō̱ le̱ṅ, ní mike̱o ayawie ye̱ dše̱i. *

english_verse: I immediately went to the valley, where I saw the brightness of the Lord's glory, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River, and I bowed with my face to the ground.
translation_verse: Ni mite ši mite dšō̱ le̱ṅ, ni na, Iehowa anumnyam le̱ damo̱ dše̱i, tamo̱ anumnyam ní mina ye̱ *Kebar fā le̱ nā le̱; ni mike̱ mihĩe bu ši. *

english_verse: His Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said: Go back and lock yourself in your house!
translation_verse: Ni *mumo̱ le̱ babote mimli, ní etēmi ši edamo̱ minãdši ano̱; ni eke̱mi wie ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Yaṅã́ oyi owo owe le̱. *

english_verse: You will be tied up to keep you inside,
translation_verse: Ni bo, gbomobi, na, ame̱ke̱ kpãi aaſie ono̱ ni ame̱ke̱-afĩo, ni odseṅ kpo ye̱ ame̱teṅ.

english_verse: and I will make you unable to talk or to warn those who have rebelled against me.
translation_verse: Ni mahã olile̱i akpe̱te̱ odā yiteṅ, ni ooto̱ mṹ, ni otšṍṅ kãlo̱ ohãṅame̱; edšake̱ weku *toigbolo̱i dšiame̱. *

english_verse: But the time will come, when I will tell you what to say, and you will again be able to speak my message. Some of them will listen; others will be stubborn and refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši mike̱o bawie le̱, magble odāṅ, ni ookē̱ame̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱! Moni nuo̱ le̱, hã ní enu, ni moni nuu le̱, ekanu; edšake̱ weku toigbolo̱i dšiame̱. K.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, find a brick and sketch a picture of Jerusalem on it.
translation_verse: Ši bo, gbomobi, ko̱ ntayā, ni oṅō-fõ ohĩe, ni otẽṅ maṅ ní dšĩ Ierusalem le̱ ye̱ no̱.

english_verse: Then prepare to attack the brick as if it were a real city. Build a dirt mound and a ramp up to the top and surround the brick with enemy camps. On every side put large wooden poles as though you were going to break down the gate to the city.
translation_verse: Ni otſa káwō gbogbo owo he, ni omãmo̱ mõdši owo he, ni otſa kpoku owo he, ni oke̱ nsrai abo̱lele̱ ke̱-kpe, ni oṅõ gbogbokū̃mo̱nii omãmo̱ he ke̱-kpe.

english_verse: Set up an iron pan like a wall between you and the brick. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ni oṅõ dade ṅe̱sũ, ni onõ-fe dade gbogbo ye̱ oke̱ maṅ le̱ teṅ; ni odšie ohĩe okale̱, ni atſa káwō gbogbo awo ehe, ni owole̱ ká! Okadi dši no hã Israel we le̱.

english_verse: The brick stands for Jerusalem, so attack it! Stare at it and shout angry warnings.
translation_verse: Ni odšie ohĩe oka Ierusalem he káwō gbogbo le̱ ke̱ onine he eflo, ni ogba ošile̱.

english_verse: I will tie you up, so you can't leave until your attack has ended.
translation_verse: Ni na, mike̱ kpãi aaſie ono̱, ni otšṍṅ ohe ke̱-dše̱ṅ oṅmãwu no̱ ke̱-yaṅ oṅmãwu no̱ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní oogbe okáwō gbĩĩ le̱ anā dã.

english_verse: Get a large bowl. Then mix together wheat, barley, beans, lentils, and millet, and make some bread. This is what you will eat for the
translation_verse: Ši bo le̱, ṅõ ṅmã ke̱ akoko ke̱ akpatramo̱ ke̱ yō̱ ke̱ blo̱ſo-akoko ke̱ able, ni oṅõ-wo nõ kome mli, ni oṅõ-fe abolo ohã ohe, ní oye gbĩĩ abo̱ ní ookã oṅmãwu no̱ ni dši *gbĩĩ ohai-etẽ ke̱ nyoṅmai-ne̱hũ le̱; *K.

english_verse: and drink only two large cups of water.
translation_verse: Ni nu hũ susumo̱ ní onu, hin mlidšāi ekpa mli ekome, ni oflo̱ mli bei onu.

english_verse: Use dried human waste to start a fire, then bake the bread on the coals where everyone can watch you.
translation_verse: Ni oyele̱ tamo̱ akoko tatalei, ni oke̱ se̱bo ní dše̱ gbomo mli ašã ye̱ ame̱hĩe.

english_verse: The Lord replied, “Instead of human waste, I will let you bake your bread on a fire made from cow manure.
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Kwe̱, miṅõ tšina fei mihão ye̱ gbomo se̱bo nãdšiaṅ, ni oṅõ-šã obolo le̱.

english_verse: Ezekiel, the people of Jerusalem will starve. They will have so little food and water that they will be afraid and hopeless.
translation_verse: Ni esā ekē̱mi ake̱: Gbomobi, na, *mibakũ abolo-tšo le̱ ye̱ Ierusalem, ni ame̱aṅmē abolo ame̱ye ke̱ tšuiyeli, ni ame̱asusu nu ame̱nu ke̱ hedšõmo̱, *

english_verse: Everyone will be shocked at what is happening, and, because of their sins, they will die a slow death.”
translation_verse: koni abolo, ke̱ nu ahĩaame̱, ni mo ke̱ enyemi nā aakpe amehe, ni ame̱tărã lō ye̱ ame̱nišaianii le̱ ahewo̱.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, get a sharp sword and use it to cut off your hair and beard. Weigh the hair and divide it into three equal piles.
translation_verse: Ni bo, gbomobi, ko̱ klante ní nā ba ohã ohe, ni oke̱-fe yiše̱lo̱i asōyi ohã ohe, ni ohã atšṍ oyiteṅ ke̱ otšẽṅ mli; koni oko̱ nsẽni ni oke̱-ṅmẽ tšo̱i le̱ ni odša mli.

english_verse: Keep a few of the hairs and wrap them in the hem of your clothes.
translation_verse: Ni oṅõ ene̱ mli fiō ko ye̱ yibo̱ nā, ni oke̱-ṅmõ otade le̱ nā.

english_verse: So tell the people of Jerusalem: I am the Lord God! You have refused to obey my laws and teachings, and instead you have obeyed the laws of the surrounding nations. You have become more rebellious than any of them!
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Ake̱-ní nyetoi egbo fè dšeṅmãdši ní ebo̱lenye le̱, ni nyenyiee ye̱ mikpo̱i le̱ anā, ni nyeyee mimlai le̱ ano̱, ni dšeṅmãdši ní bo̱lenye le̱ amlai le̱ hũ, nyeyee no̱

english_verse: Your sins have disgusted me and made my temple unfit as a place to worship me. So I swear by my own life that I will cut you down and show you no pity.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ lo̱ gbĩĩabo̱ ní mihĩe kã ne̱, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱, ake̱-ní oke̱ otãṅtãṅnii le̱ fẽ ke̱ onihĩnii le̱ fẽ *ebule mihekroṅkroṅ le̱ hewo̱ le̱, mi hũ matã oyi, ni mihĩṅme̱i enaṅo mo̱bo̱, ni asaṅ mibāṅ oyi. *

english_verse: A third of you will die here in Jerusalem from disease or starvation. Another third will be killed in war. And I will scatter the last third of you in every direction, then track you down and kill you.
translation_verse: Omlidšãi etẽ mli ekome aagboi ke̱ gbĕle-hela, ame̱aaplenē ke̱ hõmo̱ ye̱ oteṅ, ni mlidšãi etẽ mli ekome aanyõnyõi ye̱ klante nā ke̱-abo̱leo ke̱-akpe, ni magbe̱ mlidšāi etẽ mli ekome hũ maſã kō̱yo̱i fẽ amli, ni magbla klante ke̱-nyie amese̱. K.

english_verse: You will feel my fierce anger until I have finished taking revenge. Then you will know that I, the Lord, was furious because of your disobedience.
translation_verse: Ni maṅmẽ mimlifũ le̱ gbe̱, ni ma-hã mimlila le̱ awula ame̱no̱, ni *mato̱ mihe owele; ni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ mi, Iehowa, miwie ye̱ mihĩedō̱ le̱ mli, beni miṅmẽ mimlila le̱ gbe̱ ke̱-ba ameno̱ le̱. *

english_verse: will insult you and make fun of you, but they will also be shocked and terrified at what I did in my anger.
translation_verse: Ni eetšṍ *ahorabō̱ ke̱ heguo̱gbē ke̱ ko̱ko̱bō̱ ke̱ nākpe̱nõ ehã dšeṅmãdši ní ebo̱le ohe ke̱-kpe le̱, beni makodšoö ye̱ mliſũ ke̱ mlila ke̱ mlila hĩekãmo̱i ámli le̱. Mi, Iehowa, miwie ene̱. *Ier.

english_verse: Starvation and wild animals will kill your children. I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and your enemies will strike you down with their swords. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: ni matšũ hõmo̱ ke̱ koloi fõdši ke̱-aba nyeno̱, ni ame̱akpakpā obii le̱ ye̱ ohe; ni gbĕle-hela ke̱ lá aatšṍ omli ke̱-aho, ni mike̱ klante hũ aaba ono̱. Mi, Iehowa, miwie ene̱.

english_verse: Every altar will be smashed, and in front of the idols I will put to death the people who worship them.
translation_verse: koni afite nyefo̱lešãlate̱i le̱, ni akũmo̱ *nyehũlũ amãgãi le̱, ni maše̱re̱ nyemei ní enyõnyõi le̱ maſie nyewo̱dši le̱ ahĩe; *

english_verse: I will let some of the people live through this punishment, but I will scatter them among the nations,
translation_verse: Ši kẽle̱ maſe̱ ſē̱nõ ko, ni nyeaná mei komei ní edše klante nā ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ, beni aagbe̱nye aſã šikpõdšĩ le̱ ano̱ le̱; Ies.

english_verse: where they will be prisoners. And when they think of me, they will realize that they disgraced me by rebelling and by worshiping idols. They will hate themselves for the evil things they did,
translation_verse: ni nyeteṅ mei ni aadše mli le̱ aakaimi ye̱ dšeṅmãdši ní aṅõame̱ nom ke̱-te mli le̱ ateṅ, beni mikũmo̱ ame̱dſamaṅbō̱ tšui ní etše ehe ke̱-dše mihe le̱ mli, ke̱ ame̱hĩṅme̱ii ní eyabo̱ adſamaṅ ke̱-nyie ame̱wo̱dšĩ le̱ ase̱ le̱; ni ame̱anyãṅe ame̱dĩentše̱ ame̱he ye̱ nifõdšianii ní amefe ye̱ ame̱nihĩnii le̱ fẽ mli le̱ ahewo̱.

english_verse: and they will know that I am the Lord and that my warnings must be taken seriously.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱, dšee yakatſā miwie ake̱ mafeame̱ ne̱ke̱ efõṅ ne̱ le̱.

english_verse: The Lord God then said: Ezekiel, beat your fists together and stomp your feet in despair! Moan in sorrow, because the people of Israel have done disgusting things and now will be killed by enemy troops, or they will die from starvation and disease.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Tſa odẽ ni oke̱ onane ašimo̱ ši ni okē̱ ake̱: Kpóo hã Israel we le̱ nihĩnii fõdši le̱ fẽ, edšake̱ ame̱anyõnyõi ye̱ klante ke̱ hõmo̱ ke̱ gbĕle-hela nā!

english_verse: Those who live far away will be struck with deadly diseases. Those who live nearby will be killed in war. And the ones who are left will starve to death. I will let loose my anger on them!
translation_verse: Moni yo̱ se̱ šoṅṅ le̱ aagbo ye̱ gbĕle-hela nā, ni moni be̱ṅke̱ hũ aanyõ ye̱ klante nā, ni moni eſe̱ ní abā eyi le̱ aagbo ye̱ hõmo̱ nā, ni maṅmẽ mimlifũ le̱ gbe̱ ke̱-aba ame̱no̱.

english_verse: These people used to offer incense to idols at altars built on hills and mountaintops and in the shade of large oak trees. But when they see dead bodies lying around those altars, they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni nyeaná nyele ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱, beni nye mei ní enyõnyõi le̱ aakãmo̱ nyewo̱dši le̱ ateṅ ke̱-abo̱le nyefo̱lešãlate̱i le̱ kpula, ye̱ goṅkpo̱-fẽ-goṅkpo̱ ní kwo̱ no̱ ke̱ *gõdši le̱ ayiteaṅ fẽ hũ ke̱ tšo-fẽ-tšo ní ebu šiši ke̱ blo̱foyō̱itšo kusū-fẽ-blo̱foyō̱itšo kusū šiši, heni ame̱šãa tšofã-ke̱-ṅma ame̱hãa ame̱wo̱dšĩ le̱ fẽ ye̱ le̱. *

english_verse: I will make their country a barren wasteland, from the Southern Desert to the town of Diblah in the north. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Ši makpã minine mli ye̱ ame̱no̱, ni mafe šikpoṅ le̱ amaṅfõ ke̱ ole̱ṅle̱ ke̱-dše̱ ṅã le̱ no̱ ke̱-yaši Dibla, ye̱ ame̱šihĩle̱hei le̱ fiā-kwa; ni *ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱. *K.

english_verse: And when it comes, your life will be over.
translation_verse: Nāgbē miba, nāgbē le̱ mība, ehĩe etšẽ ewoö; na, ēba!

english_verse: You people of Israel are doomed! Soon there will be panic on the mountaintops instead of celebration.
translation_verse: Bo šikpoṅ le̱ no̱hĩlo̱, noni ato ahão le̱ mība ono̱; be le̱ eše̱, *haomo̱ gbĩ le̱ ebe̱ṅke̱, ni dšee gõdši ano̱ nyã́mo̱ ošebō̱ ni! *Ioel

english_verse: I will let loose my anger and punish you for the evil things you've done. You'll get what you deserve.
translation_verse: Agbene etše̱ṅ ni mafo̱se mimlila le̱ maſie ono̱, ni maṅmẽ mimlifũ le̱ gbe̱ ke̱-aba ono̱, ni makodšoö ye̱ ogbè̱i le̱ anā, ni mike̱ onihĩnii le̱ fiā aaba ono̱.

english_verse: Your sins are so terrible, that you'll get no mercy from me. Then you will know that I, the Lord, have punished you.
translation_verse: Ni mihĩṅme̱i enaṅ mo̱bo̱, ni mibāṅ yi; bo̱ni ogbè̱i le̱ yo̱ le̱, nakai mike̱-aba ono̱, ni onihĩnii le̱ aahĩ oteṅ; ni nyeaná nyele ake̱ mi, Iehowa, mitſiaä nii le̱.

english_verse: The time is coming when everyone will be ruined. Buying and selling will stop,
translation_verse: Be le̱ eše̱, gbĩ le̱ ebe̱ṅke̱; nihelo̱ akanyã́, ni nihõlo̱ akaye ṅko̱me̱; edšake̱ mlifũ miba esafo le̱ fẽ no̱.

english_verse: and people who sell property will never get it back, because all of you must be punished for your sins. And I won't change my mind!
translation_verse: Ši nihõlo̱ le̱, ké̱ ehĩe kã lolo po le̱, ekŭṅ ese̱ ke̱-yaṅ *noni ehõ le̱ he; edšake̱ gbale̱ ní agba aši esafo mū le̱ fẽ le̱, ahãṅ ekpale, ni mokomoko ke̱ enišai-anifemo̱ woṅ ewala hewale̱. *

english_verse: Anyone who survives will escape into the hills, like doves who leave the valleys to find safety. All of you will moan because of your sins.
translation_verse: Ši ame̱teṅ mei ní edše mli le̱ aadše mli, ni ame̱ayahĩ gõdši le̱ ano̱ tamo̱ dšō̱iaṅ okpoi, ame̱fẽ-tſẽm ame̱aye ṅko̱mo̱, mofẽmo ye̱ enõša hewo̱.

english_verse: Your hands will tremble, and your knees go limp.
translation_verse: Nidšiaṅ fẽ-tſẽm aadše wui, ni nakutšei fẽ-tſẽm aasĕre tamo̱ nu;

english_verse: Your silver and gold will be thrown into the streets like garbage, because those are the two things that led you into sin, and now they cannot save you from my anger. They are not even worth enough to buy food.
translation_verse: Ame̱dſie̱te̱i le̱ ame̱aše̱re̱ ame̱ſie blohũi le̱ amli, ni ame̱abu ame̱šika le̱ ake̱ noko ní anyãṅeo̱; *ame̱dſie̱te̱i ke̱ ame̱šika le̱ nyẽṅ ame̱yiwala ahere ye̱ Iehowa mlifũ gbĩ le̱ no̱; ehãṅ ame̱susumai atŏ̱ro̱, ni eyiṅ ame̱mlinii obõbõ; edšake̱ ame̱nõša le̱ he pāmpi ni. *Abe̱i

english_verse: You took great pride in using your beautiful jewelry to make disgusting idols of foreign gods. So I will make your jewelry worthless.
translation_verse: Ewulamo̱nii ni yo̱ fe̱o le̱ ame̱ke̱-fe hewõnii, ni ame̱ke̱-fe ame̱nihĩnii amãgãi le̱ ke̱ ame̱tãṅtãṅnii le̱; nohewo̱ le̱ mihã etšṍ noko ní anyãṅeo̱ ehãame̱ le̱.

english_verse: They will break into my temple and leave it unfit as a place to worship me, but I will look away and let it happen.
translation_verse: Ni matšṍ mihĩe hũ ke̱-adše̱ ame̱he, ni ame̱abule midſetri le̱, ni odšotſalo̱i aabote mli, ni ame̱abulele̱.

english_verse: Your whole country is in confusion! Murder and violence are everywhere in Israel,
translation_verse: Femo̱ kõsõṅkõsõ; edšake̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ eyi to̱ ke̱ lá he fo̱yeli, ni mã le̱ṅ eyi to̱ ke̱ yiwale̱.

english_verse: so I will tell the most wicked nations to come and take over your homes. They will put an end to the pride you have in your strong army, and they will make your places of worship unfit to use.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ mahã wo̱ṅdšálo̱i le̱ ateṅ meifõdši fè fẽ aha ni ame̱abaṅõ ame̱šĩai le̱ amefe ame̱nii; ni mahã hewalo̱i le̱ ahewõ le̱ se̱ afo, ni aabule ame̱hei kraṅkroṅi le̱.

english_verse: You will be terrified and will desperately look for peace—but there will be no peace.
translation_verse: Hĩekpãtãmo̱ miba; ni ame̱atao hedšo̱le̱, ši eko be̱.

english_verse: One tragedy will follow another, and you'll hear only bad news. People will beg prophets to give them a message from me. Priests will stop teaching my Law, and wise leaders won't be able to give advice.
translation_verse: Ošrã aanyie ošrã se̱, adafitſā hũ aanyie adafitſā se̱; ni ame̱ayatao ninā ye̱ gbalo̱ ṅõ; ši mla aalādše oso̱fo, ni ṅā-wō hũ aalādše onukpai.

english_verse: Even your king and his officials will lose hope and cry in despair. Your hands will tremble with fear. I will punish you for your sins and treat you the same way you have treated others. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Maṅtše̱ le̱ aaye nko̱mo̱, ni lumo̱ le̱ hũ aaha hedšõmo̱, ni šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ maṅ le̱ nidšiaṅ aadše wui. Bo̱ni ame̱gbe̱ le̱ yo̱ le̱, nakai mafeame̱, ni bo̱ni ame̱kodšomo̱i le̱ yo̱ le̱, nakai makodšoame̱, ni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ midsi Iehowa le̱.

english_verse: God said to me, “Ezekiel, son of man, look north.” And when I did, I saw that repulsive idol by the altar near the gate.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Gbomobi, holemo̱ ohĩṅme̱ii ano̱ ke̱-ya kōyigbe̱! Ni mihole mihĩṅme̱ii ano̱ ke̱-te kōyigbe̱ le̱, ni na, afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ he agbó le̱ kōyigbe̱ le̱ nakai awuṅãyeli amãgã le̱ mã ši ye̱ agbó le̱ nā.

english_verse: God said, “Make this hole bigger.” And when I did, I realized it was a doorway.
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Gbomobi, gbu gbogbo le̱ mli! Ni beni migbu gbogbo le̱ mli le̱, na šĩnā ko.

english_verse: Inside, I saw that the walls were covered with pictures of reptiles and disgusting, unclean animals, as well as with idols that the Israelites were worshiping.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mibote mli ni mikwe̱, ni na, *wāmo̱nibii ke̱ koloi ní ahio̱ sro̱toi abo, ke̱ Israel we le̱ wo̱dši le̱ fẽ amfonirii ní atẽṅame̱ ye̱ gbogbo le̱ he ke̱-bo̱le ke̱-kpe. *Rom.

english_verse: Seventy Israelite leaders were standing there, including Jaazaniah son of Shaphan. Each of these leaders was holding an incense burner, and the smell of incense filled the room.
translation_verse: Ni Israel we le̱ onukpai le̱ ateṅ hĩĩ nyoṅmai-kpawo damo̱ ame̱hĩe, ni Iaazania, Šafan bi le̱, damo̱ ame̱teṅ, ni mofẽmo hĩe etšofã-ke̱-ṅma ṅe̱sũ ye̱ edeṅ, ni tšoſā-ke̱-ṅma atatu le̱ ṅma mīte ši ke̱-mīya ṅwei.

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, do you see what horrible things Israel's leaders are doing in secret? They have filled their rooms with idols. And they say I can't see them, because they think I have already deserted Israel.
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Gbomobi, ōna noni Israel we le̱ onukpai le̱ feo̱ ye̱ dũdšiaṅ, mofẽmo ye̱ emãgã piai le̱ amli lo? Edšake̱ *ame̱kē̱o̱ ake̱: Iehowa enaawo̱, Iehowa ešĩ šikpoṅ le̱! *

english_verse: But I will show you something even worse than this.”
translation_verse: Ni esā ekē̱mi ake̱: Osā oona nihĩnii wudši krokomei hũ ní ame̱feo̱!

english_verse: He took me to the north gate of the temple, where I saw women mourning for the god Tammuz.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni eke̱mi ba Iehowa we le̱ agbó le̱ šĩnā ní kā ke̱-yaä kōyigbe̱ le̱ nā, ni na, yei le̱ trá dše̱i, ame̱mīfó Tamuz.

english_verse: God asked me, “Can you believe what these women are doing? But now I want to show you something even worse.”
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Gbomobi, ōna ene̱? Osā oona nihĩnii wudši ní fè ene̱mei.

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, it's bad enough that the people of Judah are doing these disgusting things. But they have also spread violence and injustice everywhere in Israel and have made me very angry. They have disgraced and insulted me in the worst possible way.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Gbomobi, ōna ene̱? Ani efáá hãã Iuda we le̱ ake̱ ame̱feo̱ nibĩnii ní ame̱feo̱ ye̱ bie̱ ne̱ le̱? edšake̱ ame̱ke̱ yiwale̱ so̱ṅṅ ewo šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ obõ to̱, ni ame̱kũ ame̱se̱ amebawo mimli la ekoṅ? Ni na, ame̱ke̱ tšonine oo̱ ame̱gugõ nā!

english_verse: So in my fierce anger, I will punish them without mercy and refuse to help them when they cry out to me.”
translation_verse: Nohewo le̱ mi hũ maye sane ye̱ mlifũ ní nā wa mli: mihĩṅme̱i enaṅ mo̱bo̱, ni mibāṅ yi, ni *ame̱ablo̱ ame̱awo mitoiiaṅ ke̱ gbẽ ni wa moṅ, ši miboṅame̱ toi. *Ies.

english_verse: He turned to the other six men and said, “Follow him and put to death everyone who doesn't have a mark on their forehead. Show no mercy or pity! Kill men and women, parents and children. Begin here at my temple, but be sure not to harm those who are marked.” The men immediately killed the leaders who were standing there.
translation_verse: Onukpai ke̱ oblahĩĩ ke̱ oblayei ke̱ gbekẽbii ke̱ yei le̱, nyegbeaame̱ butubutu; ši mofẽmo ní okadi le̱ yo̱ ehe le̱ nyekataä ehe; ni *nyebõia ke̱-dše̱a mi-hekroṅkroṅ le̱! Ke̱ke̱ ni ame̱bõi ke̱-dše̱ onukpai le̱ ní yo̱ šīa le̱ hĩe le̱ ano̱. *

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Pollute the temple by piling the dead bodies in the courtyards. Now get busy!” They left and started killing the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ni esā ekē̱ame̱ ake: Nyebulea šĩa le̱, ni nyewoa kpoi le̱ ano̱ obõbõ ke̱ mei ní enyõnyõi! Nyedšea kpo! Ni ame̱dše kpo ni ame̱yatſia maṅ le̱ nii.

english_verse: The Lord answered, “The people of Israel and Judah have done horrible things. Their country is filled with murderers, and Jerusalem itself is filled with violence. They think that I have deserted them, and that I can't see what they are doing.
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Israel ke̱ Iuda we le̱ nõša le̱ da kple naakpa dientše̱, ni šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ eyi obõ ke̱ lá, ni maṅ le̱ hũ eyi to̱ ke̱ sanehĩetšṍmo̱; edšake̱ *ame̱-kē̱: Iehowa ešĩ šikpoṅ le̱, ni Iehowa enaa! *

english_verse: And so I will not have pity on them or forgive them. They will be punished for what they have done.”
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ mi hũ mihĩṅme̱i enaṅ mo̱bo̱, ni mibāṅ yi, ši mahã ame̱gbe̱ le̱ abua ame̱yiteaṅ!

english_verse: Just then, the man in the linen robe returned and said, “I have done what you commanded.”
translation_verse: Ni na, nū ní wo klala ní woloṅmãto̱ ṅmõ ehe̱ le̱ ke̱ wiemo̱ kũ ese̱ ke̱-ba ebakē̱: Mife take̱ bo̱ni ofámi le̱.

english_verse: The winged creatures were standing south of the temple when the man walked among them. A cloud filled the inner courtyard,
translation_verse: Ši beni nū le̱ bote mli le̱, kerubim le̱ damo̱ šĩa le̱ ninedšŭrõgbe̱ le̱, ni atatu le̱ yo̱ mligbe̱ kpo le̱ no̱ obõ.

english_verse: The sound of the creatures' wings was as loud as the voice of God All-Powerful and could even be heard in the outer courtyard.
translation_verse: Ni anu kerubim le̱ afĩdšiaṅ gbē̱mo̱ āhũ ke̱-yaſie agbónã kpo le̱ no̱, tamo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ Ofe le̱ gbē, ké̱ ēwie le̱.

english_verse: One of the four creatures reached its hand into the fire among them and gave him some of the hot coals. The man took the coals and left.
translation_verse: Ni kerub le̱ kpa enine mli ke̱-dše̱ kerubim le̱ ateṅ ke̱-te la ní yo̱ kerubim le̱ ateṅ le̱ he, ni ekpĩtĩ eko eṅõ-wo moni wo klala le̱ ko̱ko̱iaṅ, ni ehe ni edše kpo.

english_verse: I noticed again that each of the four winged creatures had what looked like human hands under their wings,
translation_verse: Ni ana noko ní tamo̱ gbomo nine ye̱ kerubim le̱ ahe ye̱ ame̱fĩdši ašiši.

english_verse: and I saw the four wheels near the creatures. These wheels were shining like chrysolite.
translation_verse: Ni mikwe̱, ni na, kokrolontoi edſe̱ ye̱ kerubim le̱ amase̱i, kokrolonto kome ye̱ kerub kome mase̱i, kokrolonto kome ye̱ kerub kome mase̱i; ni kokrolontoi le̱ asu tamo̱ Taršĩš-te̱ su.

english_verse: Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it,
translation_verse: Ni ké̱ akwe̱ le̱, ame̱yi edſe̱ le̱ fẽ ame̱hĩe su kome, tamo̱ noni kokrolonto ho̱ kokrolonto teṅ.

english_verse: so that they could move in any direction without turning. The wheels moved together whenever the creatures moved.
translation_verse: Ké̱ ame̱mīnyie le̱, ame̱nyieo̱ ame̱kódši edſe̱ le̱ no̱, ni ké̱ ame̱mīnyie le̱, ame̱tšṍmo̱o̱ ame̱he, ši moṅ hégbe̱ ní yitšo le̱ yaä le̱, dše̱i ame̱nyieo̱ ese̱ ke̱-yaä; ni kē̱ ame̱mīnyie le̱, ame̱tšṍmo̱o̱ ame̱he.

english_verse: I also noticed that the wheels and the creatures' bodies, including their backs, their hands, and their wings, were covered with eyes.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱gbomotšo mū le̱ fẽ ke̱ ame̱kotose̱ ke̱ ame̱nidši ke̱ ame̱fĩdši le̱ ke̱ kokrolontoi le̱ hũ ahe eyimo̱ to̱ ke̱ hĩṅme̱ii ke̱-bo̱le kpula ye̱ ame̱kokrolontoi edſe̱ le̱ fẽ he.

english_verse: And I heard a voice calling these “the wheels that spin.”
translation_verse: Kokrolontoi le̱, afã́ame̱ ye̱ mitoiiaṅ ake̱ ame̱tšṍmo̱.

english_verse: Each of the winged creatures had four faces: the face of a bull, the face of a human, the face of a lion, and the face of an eagle.
translation_verse: Ni mofẽmo ye̱ hĩei edſe̱; kleṅkleṅ hĩe le̱ kerub hĩe ni, ni hĩe ní dši enyo̱ le̱ gbomo hĩe ni, ni noni dši etẽ le̱ dšata hĩe ni, ni noni dši edſe̱ le̱ okropoṅ hĩe ni.

english_verse: These were the same creatures I had seen near the Chebar River. They controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels stayed beside them.
translation_verse: Ké̱ ame̱wa ame̱damo̱ ši le̱, bĕle̱ mene̱mei hũ ewa edamo̱ ši; ni ké̱ ame̱hole ame̱he no̱ le̱, bĕle̱ mene̱mei hũ ehole ame̱he no̱; edšake̱ hĩekãlo̱i le̱ amumo̱ ye̱ ame̱mli.

english_verse: Then I watched the brightness of the Lord's glory move from the entrance of the temple and stop above the winged creatures.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa anumnyam le̱ dše šĩa le̱ kpoku le̱ yiteṅ ni eyadamo̱ kerubim le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: They spread their wings and flew into the air with the wheels at their side. They stopped at the east gate of the temple, and the Lord's glory was above them.
translation_verse: Ni kerubim le̱ hole ame̱fĩdši ano̱, ni beni ame̱dše kpo le̱, ame̱te ši ke̱-dše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ye̱ mihĩe, ni kokrolontoi le̱ ke̱ame̱ te ši; ni ame̱yadamo̱ Iehowa we le̱ bokãgbe̱ agbó le̱ šĩnā le̱ ši, ni Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ anumnyam le̱ ye̱ ame̱no̱ ye̱ *yiteṅgbe̱. *K.

english_verse: I knew for sure that these were the same creatures I had seen beneath the Lord's glory near the Chebar River.
translation_verse: Hĩekãlo̱ ní mina ye̱ Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ šiši ye̱ Kebar fā le̱ nā le̱ ne̱. Ni miyo ake̱ kerubim ni.

english_verse: They had four wings with hands beneath them, and they had the same four faces as those near the River. Each creature moved straight ahead without turning.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱hĩe su tamo̱ nii ní mina ye̱ Kebar fā le̱ nā le̱, bo̱ni ame̱pueo̱ ke̱ bo̱ni ame̱yo̱ fẽ; ame̱teṅ mofẽmo nyĩeo̱ ke̱-yaä ehĩe tē̃.

english_verse: and I told them everything the Lord had shown me.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni midšadše nii ní Iehowa hã mina le̱ fẽ mitšō nomi le̱.

english_verse: You leaders claim to be meat in a cooking pot, but you won't be protected by this city. No, you will die at the border of Israel.
translation_verse: Maṅ ne̱ efeṅ kukwe̱i ehãṅnye, ni nye hũ nyefeṅ emli lō; Israel kpokpai le̱ ano̱ noṅṅ makodšonye ye̱.

english_verse: Before I finished speaking, Pelatiah dropped dead. I bowed down and cried out, “Please, Lord God, don't kill everyone left in Israel.” A Promise of Hope
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱, beni migbaä le̱, Pelatia, Benaia bi le̱, gbo. Ke̱ke̱ ni *mike̱ mihĩe bu ši ni miblo̱ ke̱ gbē ni wa mikē̱: Ao, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa! aso oogbe Israel ſē̱nõ le̱ nā kwrakwra? *

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people living in Jerusalem claim that you and the other Israelites who were taken to Babylonia are too far away to worship me. They also claim that the land of Israel now belongs only to them.
translation_verse: Gbomobi, onyemimei le̱, onyemimei ní dši odšakubii le̱ ke̱ Israel we mū le̱ fẽ dši mei ní Ierusalembii le̱ ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyetšia nyehe ke̱-dšea Iehowa he ke̱-yaä se̱ šoṅṅ; wo̱ aṅõ ne̱ke̱ šikpoṅ ne̱ ahã ní etšṍ wo̱nõ.

english_verse: But here is what I want you to tell the Israelites in Babylonia: It's true that I, the Lord God, have forced you out of your own country and made you live among foreign nations. But for now, I will be with you wherever you are, so that you can worship me.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ kē̱mo̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Ké̱ *mike̱ame̱ te šoṅṅ ye̱ dšeṅmãdši ateṅ, ni migbe̱ame̱ miſã šikpõdši le̱ ano̱ dšiṅṅ, matšṍ hekroṅkroṅ mahãame̱ kẽ be fiō ko ye̱ šikpõdši ní ame̱ate no̱ le̱ ano̱. *

english_verse: And someday, I will gather you from the nations where you are scattered and let you live in Israel again.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ kē̱mo̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Mabua nyenõ ke̱-adše̱ mãdšimãdši le̱ amli, ni mahã nyenā abatĩ ke̱-adše̱ šikpõdši ní agbe̱nye aſã no̱ le̱ ano̱, ni mike̱ Israel šikpoṅ le̱ aahãnye. Ier

english_verse: When that happens, I want you to clear the land of all those idols I hate so much.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱aba dše̱i, ni ame̱abadšie emli tãṅtãṅnii le̱ fẽ ke̱ nihĩnii le̱ fẽ ke̱-adše̱ mli ke̱-ate.

english_verse: Then I will take away your stubbornness and make you eager to be completely faithful to me. You will want to obey me
translation_verse: Ni mahãame̱ tšui kroko, ni mike̱ mumo̱ hē aawo nyemli, ni madšie *te̱-tšui le̱ ke̱-adše̱ ame̱helo mli, ni mahãame̱ lō-tšui,

english_verse: and all my laws and teachings. You will be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: beni afe ní ame̱nyie ye̱ mikpo̱i le̱ anā, ni ame̱ye mimlai le̱ ano̱ ni ame̱fe, ni ame̱tšṍ mimaṅ, ni mi hũ matšṍ ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱. Ier.

english_verse: But those who worship idols will be punished and get what they deserve. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Lord's Glory Leaves Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ši mei ní ame̱tšui nyieo̱ ame̱tãṅtãṅnii ke̱ ame̱nihĩnii atšui le̱ se̱ le̱, mahã ame̱gbe̱ le̱ abua ame̱yiteṅ! Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: After the Lord had finished speaking, the winged creatures spread their wings and flew into the air, and the wheels were beside them. The brightness of the Lord's glory above them
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni kerubim le̱ hole ame̱fĩdši ano̱, ni kokrolontoi le̱ ke̱ame̱ hole ame̱he no̱, ni Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ anumnyam le̱ ye̱ ame̱no̱ ye̱ yiteṅgbe̱.

english_verse: left Jerusalem and stopped at a hill east of the city.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa anumnyam le̱ wó ehe no̱ ke̱-dše̱ maṅ le̱ teṅ, ni eyadamo̱ goṅ le̱ ní yo̱ maṅ le̱ bokãgbe̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Then in my vision, the Lord's Spirit lifted me up and carried me back to the other exiles in Babylonia. The vision faded away,
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni *mumo̱ le̱ wómi ni eke̱mi te Kaldea ye̱ nomi le̱ aṅõ ye̱ ninā mli ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ Mumo̱ le̱ nā. Ni ninā ní mina le̱ dše mino̱. *

english_verse: Dig through the wall of your house and crawl out, carrying the bag with you. Make sure everyone is watching.
translation_verse: Gbu gbogbo le̱ mli ye̱ ame̱hĩe, ni oke̱-tšṍ dše̱i ke̱-dše kpo.

english_verse: reminded me that those rebellious people didn't even ask what I was doing.
translation_verse: Gbomobi, ani Israel we le̱ ní dši weku toigbolo̱i le̱ bikoö ake̱: Meni ofeo̱ ne̱ lo?

english_verse: So he sent me back to tell them: The Lord God has a message for the leader of Jerusalem and everyone living there!
translation_verse: Kē̱mo̱ame̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Ne̱ke̱ kodšomo̱ he gbale̱ ne̱, lumo̱ ní yo̱ Ierusalem le̱ ke̱ Israel we le̱ fẽ ní yo̱ dše̱i le̱ nõ ni.

english_verse: I have done these things to show them what will happen when they are taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Kē̱mo̱ ake̱: *Midši okadi hãnye; bo̱ni mife le̱, nakai aafeame̱: ame̱afã gbe̱, ame̱ate nomṅō̃ mli. *K.

english_verse: The leader of Jerusalem will lift his own bag to his shoulders at sunset and leave through a hole that the others have dug in the wall of his house. He will cover his face, so he can't see the land he is leaving.
translation_verse: Ni lumo̱ ní yo̱ ame̱teṅ le̱, ké̱ hĩe bu le̱, eke̱ dšatšu aatſa ekõṅ, ni eedše kpo; ame̱agbu gbogbo le̱ mli ní ame̱ke̱-tšṍ dše̱i ke̱-dše kpo, eeha ehĩe ní eke̱ ehĩṅme̱i akana šikpoṅ. Ier.

english_verse: The Lord will spread out a net and trap him as he leaves Jerusalem. He will then be led away to the city of Babylon, but will never see that place, even though he will die there.
translation_verse: Ni maṅõ *miyā le̱ malē̱ eno̱, ni eedũ mitšõne le̱; ni mike̱le̱ aate Babel ye̱ Kaldeabii le̱ ašikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ši no tete le̱ enaṅ, ni dše̱i noṅṅ eegbo ye.

english_verse: His own officials and troops will scatter in every direction, and the Lord will track them down and put them to death.
translation_verse: Ni mei fẽ ni ebo̱lele̱ ke̱-kpe koni ame̱ye ame̱buale̱ le̱, ke̱ etai le̱ fẽ le̱, magbe̱ame̱ maſã kō̱yo̱-fẽ-kō̱yo̱ mli, ni magbla klante ke̱-anyie ame̱se̱.

english_verse: The Lord will force the rest of the people in Jerusalem to live in foreign nations, where they will realize that he has done all these things.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱, beni matšire̱ ame̱yi se̱ ke̱-ate dšeṅmãdši le̱ amli, ni magbeame̱ maſã šikpõdši le̱ ano̱ le̱.

english_verse: Some of them will survive the war, the starvation, and the deadly diseases. That way, they will be able to tell foreigners how disgusting their sins were, and that it was the Lord who punished them in this way. A Sign of Fear
translation_verse: Ši *maſe̱ ame̱teṅ mei fiō ko, ní ame̱dše klante ke̱ hõmo̱ ke̱ gbĕle-hela le̱ mli, beni afe ní ame̱gba ame̱nihĩnii le̱ fẽ ye̱ dšeṅmãdši ní ame̱yaä mli le̱ ateṅ, ni ameaná ame̱le ake midši Iehowa le. *

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, shake with fear when you eat, and tremble when you drink.
translation_verse: Gbomobi, ye obolo le̱ ke̱ hekpokpomo̱, ni onu onu le̱ ke̱ hehosomo̱ ke̱ tšuiyeli;

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that I, the Lord, say that someday everyone in Jerusalem will shake when they eat and tremble when they drink. Their country will be destroyed and left empty, because they have been cruel and violent.
translation_verse: ni okē̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ maṅ le̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ye̱ Ierusalembii ní yo̱ Iuda šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ ahe ne̱: Ame̱bolo le̱, tšuiyeli ame̱ke̱-aye, ni ame̱nu le̱ hũ, hedšõmo̱ ame̱ke̱-anu; edšake̱ ešikpoṅ le̱ etšṍ amaṅfõ ni eno̱ nii fẽ etã ye̱ eno̱ bii le̱ fẽ ayiwale̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: Every town will lie in ruins, and the land will be a barren desert. Then they will know that I am the Lord. The Words of the Lord Will Come True
translation_verse: Ni mãdši ní mei yo̱ mli le̱ aafite, ni šikpoṅ le̱ aatšṍ amaṅfõ, ni nyeaná nyele ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱!

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, you've heard people in Israel use the saying, “Time passes, and prophets are proved wrong.”
translation_verse: Gbomobi, mẽ dši abe̱ ní nyebuo̱ ye̱ Israel šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ake̱: Gbĩĩ le̱ mītše̱, ni ninā-fẽ-ninā milãdše le̱?

english_verse: Now tell the people that I, the Lord, am going to prove that saying wrong. No one will ever be able to use it again in Israel, because very soon everything I have said will come true!
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ kē̱mo̱ame̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Mahã ne̱ke̱ abe̱ ne̱ se̱ afo, ni abuṅ doṅṅ ye̱ Israel; ši moṅ kē̱mo̱ame̱ ake̱: Gbĩĩ le̱ ke̱ ninā-fẽ-ninā mli sane le̱ ebe̱ṅke̱. Hab.

english_verse: The people will hear no more useless warnings and false messages.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ yaka ninā ko lo lakamo̱ klamo̱ ko ehĩṅ ši doṅṅ ye̱ Israel we le̱.

english_verse: I will give them my message, and what I say will certainly happen. Warn those rebels that the time has come for them to be punished. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ midši Iehowa le̱, mibawie, ni wiemo̱ ní mibawie le̱ aaba mli. Atšiṅ ke̱-yaṅ se̱ doṅṅ; ši moṅ nyeyino̱ noṅṅ mibawie wiemo̱ le̱ ní mibafe hũ, nye weku toigbolo̱i! Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: Ezekiel, the people of Israel are also saying that your visions and messages are only about things in the future.
translation_verse: Gbomobi, na, Israel we le̱ kē̱o̱ ake̱: Ninā ni enaä le̱ yeo̱ gbĩĩ pī dãni ebaä mli, ni bei ní yo̱ se̱ šoṅṅ le̱ ahe egbaä ye̱!

english_verse: So tell them that my words will soon come true, just as I have warned. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ kē̱mo̱ame̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Atšiṅ miwiemo̱i le̱ eko eko ke̱-yaṅ se̱ doṅṅ; ši moṅ wiemo̱ ní mibawie le̱ aaba mli! Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa wiemo̱ ba miṅõ ake̱:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the prophets of Israel who say they speak in my name, but who preach messages that come from their own imagination. Tell them it's time to hear my message.
translation_verse: Gbomobi, gba oši Israel gbaloi le̱ ní gbaä le̱, ni okē̱ mei ní dše̱o̱ ame̱dientše̱ ame̱tšuiiaṅ gbaä le̱ ake̱: Nyeboa Iehowa wiemo̱ toi!

english_verse: Israel's prophets are no better than jackals that hunt for food among the ruins of a city.
translation_verse: Israel, ogbalo̱i le̱ etšṍmo̱ tamo̱ oso̱i ní yo̱ amaṅfĩi amli!

english_verse: They say they're preaching my messages, but they are full of lies—I did not speak to them!
translation_verse: Aso dšee yaka ninā nyenaä, ni amale klamo̱ nyeklaä, ní nyekē̱o̱ ake̱: Iehowa kē̱! tšè̱ miwieko le̱?

english_verse: So I am going to punish those lying prophets for deceiving the people of Israel with false messages.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Ake̱-ní nyewieo̱ yakanii ni nyenaä amale nii hewo̱ le̱, na, mike̱nye ená! Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people. They will not be allowed to call themselves Israelites or even to set foot in Israel. Then they will realize that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Ni minine aakã gbalo̱i le̱ ní naä yakanii ní ame̱klaä amalei le̱ ano̱: *ame̱hĩṅ mimaṅ le̱ gwabō̱ le̱ mli, ni asaṅ aṅmãṅ ame̱gbe̱i ye̱ Israel we le̱ wolo le̱ mli, ni ame̱baṅ Israel šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ hũ, ni nyeaná nyele ake̱ midši Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa le̱, *

english_verse: But when I send rainstorms, hailstones, and strong winds, the wall will surely collapse.
translation_verse: Kē̱mo̱ mei ní ke̱ yaka kālō mãa he le̱, ake̱ ebagbē ši! nyoṅmo̱ne̱mo̱ ní lōo̱ nibii ke̱-yaä baba, ni mahã nyoṅmo̱ṅte̱i wudši aſie ši, ni ahum batſa.

english_verse: People will then ask the workers why the paint didn't hold it up.
translation_verse: Ni na, gbogbo le̱ bagbe ši. Aso ake̱ṅnye ake̱: Nẽgbe̱ noni nyeke̱-mā he le̱ yo̱?

english_verse: That wall is the city of Jerusalem. And I, the Lord God, am so angry that I will send strong winds, rainstorms, and hailstones to destroy it.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Mahã ahum atſa ye̱ mimlila le̱ṅ, ni nyoṅmo̱ne̱mo̱ ní lōo̱ nibii ke̱-yaä aaba ye̱ mimlifũ le̱ṅ, ni nyoṅmo̱ṅte̱i wudši aaba ye̱ mlila le̱ mli ni ebakpãtã hĩe.

english_verse: because they promised my people peace, when there was no peace. I, the Lord God, have spoken. Women Who Wear Magic Charms The Lord said:
translation_verse: mei ní dši Israel gbalo̱i ní gbaä ye̱ Ierusalem hewo̱, ní ame̱naä *omanye nināi ame̱hãale̱, ni omanye ko be̱ le̱! Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱. *K.

english_verse: Tell them they're doomed! They wear magic charms on their wrists and scarves on their heads, then trick others into believing they can predict the future. They won't get away with telling those lies.
translation_verse: ni okē̱: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Kpóo hã yei nī kpe̱o̱ fī̃mo̱-mamai ame̱hãa nikutšei fẽ, ni ame̱feo̱ yiteṅhā-mamai ame̱hãa yitšo-fẽ-yitšo dale̱, ní ake̱-dũ susumai le̱! Nyemīdũ mimaṅ le̱ susumai, ši nyedientše̱ nyesusumai le̱ nyemīhere ame̱yi wala;

english_verse: They charge my people a few handfuls of barley and a couple pieces of bread, and then give messages that are insulting to me. They use lies to sentence the innocent to death and to help the guilty go free. And my people believe them!
translation_verse: ni nyebuleo̱mi ye̱ mimaṅ le̱ teṅ ye̱ akoko ko̱ko̱i obõbõ ke̱ abolo atromai ahe-wo̱, ni *nyeke̱-gbeo̱ susumai ni esaa gbĕle, ní nyeke̱hereo̱ susumai ní esaa yiwalaheremo̱ le̱ ayiwala, ye̱ nyemalemo̱ ní nyemaleo̱ nyetšõo̱ mimaṅ le̱ ní boo̱ amale toi le̱ ahewo̱? *Ies.

english_verse: I hate the magic charms they use to trick people into believing their lies. I will rip those charms from their wrists and set free the people they have trapped like birds.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Na, mike̱ nyefī̃mo̱-mamai ní nyeke̱-dũo̱ susumai tamo̱ lofõdši le̱ ena, ni matšere̱ame̱ ke̱-adše̱ nyenidši, ni maṅmē̃ susumai le̱ ahe, susumai ní nyedũo̱ tamo̱ lofõdši le̱.

english_verse: I will tear the scarves from their heads and rescue my people from their power once and for all. Then they will know that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Ni matšere̱ nyeyiteṅhā-mamai le̱ hũ, ni madšie mimaṅ le̱ ye̱ nyedeṅ, ni ame̱hĩṅ nyedeṅ ake̱ gbo̱bimo̱nõ doṅṅ, ni nyeaná nyele ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱.

english_verse: They do things I would never do. They lie to good people and encourage them to do wrong, and they convince the wicked to ruin their own lives by not turning from sin.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nyeke̱ amale hãa dšalo̱, ní mi le̱ mihako ew̌ere̱ aho ehe le̱, tšui yeo, ni *nyewadšeo̱ mofõṅ moṅ nidšiaṅ, beni afe ní ekakpale ke̱-mīdše̱ egbe fõṅ le̱ no̱, ní ahere eyiwala. *Ier.

english_verse: I will no longer let these women give false messages and use magic, and I will free my people from their control. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyenaṅ yakanii doṅṅ, ni klamo̱ hũ nyeklaṅ doṅṅ; ši madšie mimaṅ le̱ ye̱ nyedeṅ, ni nyeaná nyele ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱.

english_verse: While they were there, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa wiemo̱ ba miṅõ ake:

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that if they sin by worshiping idols and then go to a prophet to find out what I say, I will give them the answer their sins deserve.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ oke̱ame̱ awie ni okē̱-ame̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Mofẽmo ní dše̱ Israel we le̱ ní ṅōo̱ ewo̱dši le̱ etoo̱ etšuiṅ, ni eṅõo̱ enõša le̱ pãmpi le̱ etoo̱ ehĩe, ni ebaä gbalo̱ le̱ ṅõ le̱, mi Iehowa dientše̱ mahãle̱ hetö ye̱ ewo̱dši le̱ afále̱ le̱ nā,

english_verse: Suppose one of you Israelites or a foreigner living in Israel rejects me and starts worshiping idols. If you then go to a prophet to find out what I say, I will answer
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mofẽmo ní dše̱ Israel we le̱ lo gbo̱i ní batoo̱ gbo̱ ye̱ Israel le̱ eko, ní tšeo̱ ehe ke̱-dše̱o̱ mihe, ni eṅõo̱ ewo̱dši le̱ ewoo̱ etšui mli, ni eṅõo̱ enõša le̱ pãmpi le̱ etoo̱ ehĩe, ni ebaã gbalo̱ le̱ ṅõ koni ebimi nii ehãle̱ le̱: mi Iehowa dientše̱ mahãle̱ hetō;

english_verse: If a prophet gives a false message, I am the one who caused that prophet to lie. But I will still reject him and cut him off from my people,
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši elaka gbalo̱ le̱ ni ewie wiemo̱ ko le̱, bĕle̱ mi Iehowa milaka nakai gbalo̱ le̱, ni makpā minine mli ye̱ eno̱, ni makpãtã ehĩe ke̱-adše̱ mimaṅ Israel teṅ.

english_verse: and anyone who goes to that prophet for a message will be punished in the same way.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱atĕre ame̱nõša le̱: gbalo̱ le̱ nõša le̱ aatamo̱ nibilo̱ le̱ nõša le̱ noṅṅ pe̱,

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa wiemo̱ sā ba miṅõ ake̱:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, suppose an entire nation sins against me, and I punish it by destroying the crops and letting its people and livestock starve to death.
translation_verse: Gbomobi, kē̱ šikpoṅ ko tõ ni eke̱fe eša ešimi, ni mikpã minine mli ye̱ eno̱, ni mikũ *ebolo-tšo le̱ ni mihã hõmo̱ ba no̱, ni mikpãtã gbomo ke̱ kolo hĩe ye̱ no̱ le̱: *

english_verse: Even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were living in that nation, their faithfulness would not save anyone but themselves.
translation_verse: ké̱ *ne̱ke̱ hĩĩ etẽ ne̱, ní dši Noa, Daniel ke̱ Hiob ye̱ dše̱i tete le̱, ame̱-dientše̱ ame̱susumai ke̱ke̱ ame̱ke̱ ame̱-dšale̱ le̱ aadšie, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱. *Ier.

english_verse: Or suppose I send an enemy to attack a sinful nation and kill its people and livestock.
translation_verse: Lo ke̱dši mike̱ klante ba nakai šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ni mikē̱: Klante, yakpa šikpoṅ le̱ no̱! ni mikpãtã gbomo ke̱ kolo fẽ hĩe ye̱ no̱ le̱:

english_verse: If these three men were in that nation when I punished it, not even their children would be spared. Only the three men would live.
translation_verse: ké̱ ne̱ke̱ hĩĩ etẽ ne̱ ye̱ dše̱i tete le̱, gbĩĩabo̱ ní mihĩe kã ne̱, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱, ame̱dšieṅ bihĩĩ lo biyei; ši moṅ ame̱ ke̱ke̱ aadšie.

english_verse: And suppose I am so angry that I send a deadly disease to wipe out the people and livestock of a sinful nation.
translation_verse: Lo kē̱ mihã gbĕle-hela ba nakai šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni mifo̱se mimlila le̱ miſie no̱ ye̱ lá mli, koni akpãtã gbomo ke̱ kolo hĩe ye̱ no̱ le̱:

english_verse: Again, even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were living there, I, the Lord, promise that the children of these faithful men would also die. Only the three of them would be spared.

english_verse: He made a promise in my name and swore to honor the treaty. And now that he has broken that promise, my name is disgraced. He must pay for what he's done.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Gbĩĩabo̱ ní mihĩe kã ne̱, mikitã le̱ ní egbe he guo̱ ke̱ mikpãṅmo̱ le̱ ní ekũ mli le̱, eyiteṅ kẽ maṅõ-bua;

english_verse: Someday, I, the Lord, will cut a tender twig from the top of a cedar tree, then plant it on the peak of Israel's tallest mountain,
translation_verse: Be̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Mi hũ makpo̱ tšenedru ní kwo̱ le̱ yiteṅ, ni mayate̱o; makũ *enidši fo̱bii le̱ ayiteṅ fo̱flo̱ō, ni mayate̱o ye̱ goṅ ní kwo̱ groṅṅ ko no̱; *Ies.

english_verse: where it will grow strong branches and produce large fruit. All kinds of birds will find shelter under the tree, and they will rest in the shade of its branches.
translation_verse: Israel *goṅ ní kwo̱ le̱ no̱ mate̱o ye̱, ni eegbla nidši, ni eewo yibii, ni eetšṍ tšenedru fe̱fe̱o, ni †lofõdši sro̱toi fẽ aabahĩ ešiši; ame̱ahī efīdši ašiši hō̃ṅ le̱ mli. *

english_verse: Every tree in the forest will know that I, the Lord, can bring down tall trees and help short ones grow. I dry up green trees and make dry ones green. I, the Lord, have spoken, and I will keep my word.
translation_verse: Ni ṅãno̱ tšei le̱ fẽ aaná ale ake̱ mi, Iehowa, mihã *tšo ní kwo̱ le̱ eba ši, miwó tšo te̱ṅē̱ le̱ no̱ ke̱-te ṅwei, mi-hã tšo ṅmõṅ le̱ egbĩ, ni mihã tšo gbĩṅ le efeo. Mi, Iehowa, miwie ni mife. *

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa wiemo̱ ba miṅõ ake̱:

english_verse: He refuses to eat meat sacrificed to foreign gods at local shrines or to worship Israel's idols. He doesn't have sex with someone else's wife or with a woman having her monthly period.
translation_verse: ni eyee nii ye̱ gõdši le̱ ano̱, ni eholeo ehĩṅme̱ii ano̱ ekwe̱e̱ Israel we le̱ wo̱dši le̱, ni *ebulee enanyo ṅã, ni ebe̱ṅ-ke̱e̱ yō ni ete tšũi ase̱, *

english_verse: and doesn't charge interest when lending money. He refuses to do anything evil; he is fair to everyone
translation_verse: *efaa nii ehee hekpa ní fè nine, ni ehee hebō̱, ni edšieo̱ enine ye̱ nõša-femo̱ he, ekodšoo̱ ano̱kwa kodšomo̱ ye̱ mo ke̱ mo teṅ, *

english_verse: and faithfully obeys my laws and teachings. This man is good, and I promise he will live.
translation_verse: enyieo̱ ye̱ mikpo̱i le̱ anā, ni eyeo̱ mimlai le̱ ano̱, ni eyeo̱ ano̱kwa le̱; le̱ le̱ dšalo̱ dšile̱, eyi aaná wala kẽ, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: But suppose this good man has an evil son who is violent and commits sins
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši efo̱ bi yiwalo̱ ko ni ſieo̱ lá ši, ni efeo ne̱ke̱ nibii ne̱ ateṅ eko,

english_verse: cheats the poor, and robs people. He keeps what is given to him as security for a loan. He worships idols, does disgusting things,
translation_verse: ewaã ohĩafo ke̱ moni efĩle̱ yi, ehaä nii, ekpalee awabatōnii ehãã, eholeo ehĩṅme̱ii ano̱ ekwe̱o̱ wo̱dši, esā efeo̱ nihĩnii,

english_verse: and charges high interest when lending money. An evil man like that will certainly not live. He is the one who has done these horrible sins, so it's his own fault that he will be put to death.
translation_verse: efaä nii eheo̱ hekpa ni fè nine, ni eheo̱ hebō̱ le̱: aso eyi aaná wala? Eyi náṅ wala! Ní efeo̱ ne̱ke̱ nihĩnii ne̱ fẽ hewo̱ le̱, gbo eegbo; elá le̱ aabua eyiteṅ!

english_verse: But suppose this evil man has a son who sees his father do these things and refuses to act like him.
translation_verse: Ši na, ke̱dši efo̱ bi ko, ni le̱ le̱ ena etše̱ he ešai le̱ ní efe le̱ fẽ, ni eše gbeyei, ni efee nakai noko,

english_verse: He doesn't eat meat at local shrines or worship Israel's idols, and he doesn't have sex with someone else's wife.
translation_verse: eyee nii ye̱ gõdši le̱ ano̱, ni eholee ehĩṅme̱ii ano̱ ekwe̱e̱ Israel we le̱ wo̱dši le̱, ebulee enanyo ṅã hũ,

english_verse: He never cheats or robs anyone and doesn't even demand security for a loan. He gives food and clothes to the poor
translation_verse: ni ewaa mokomoko yi, ehee awabatōnii, ehaa nii, ši moṅ eṅõo̱ ebolo ehãa moni hõmo̱ yeo̱le̱, ni asaṅ heyayaiatše̱ le̱, ebuo̱le̱ mama,

english_verse: It is his father who will die for cheating and robbing and doing evil.
translation_verse: Etše̱ le̱, ake̱-ní ewaä yi, ni ehaä enyemi, ni efeo̱ noni ehĩĩ ye̱ emaṅ le̱ teṅ hewo̱ le̱, na, eegbo ye̱ enišaianii le̱ ahewo̱!

english_verse: You may wonder why a son isn't punished for the sins of his father. It is because the son does what is right and obeys my laws.
translation_verse: Kẽle̱ nyekē̱o̱ ake̱: Mẽhewo̱ bi tĕree etše̱ nišaianii le̱? Ké̱ bi le̱ yeo̱ dšale̱ sane ni efeo̱ noni dša, ni eyeo mikpoi le̱ fẽ no̱ ni efeo̱ le̱, eyi aaná wala kẽ.

english_verse: Suppose wicked people stop sinning and start obeying my laws and doing right. They won't be put to death.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši mofõṅ le̱ kpale ke̱-dše̱ ehe ešai ní efe le̱ fẽ mli, ni eye mikpo̱i le̱ fẽ no̱, ni eye dšale̱ sane, ni efe noni dša le̱, eyi aaná wala kẽ, egboṅ!

english_verse: But when good people start sinning and doing disgusting things, will they live? No! All their good deeds will be forgotten, and they will be put to death because of their sins.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ dšalo̱ kpale ke̱-dše̱ edšale̱ le̱ mli ni efe nišaianii, ni efe nihĩnii fẽ ní mofõṅ feo̱ le̱: aso eyi aaná wala? Edšale̱nii fẽ ní efe le̱ akaiṅ eko eko; etõmo̱ ní etõ le̱ ke̱ ehe ešai ní efe le̱, eegbo ye̱ nomei ahewo̱!

english_verse: You people of Israel accuse me of being unfair! But listen—I'm not unfair; you are!
translation_verse: Ni kẽle̱ nyekē̱o̱ ake̱: *Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ gbe̱ le̱ yee egbo̱! Nyeboa toi ko, nye Israel we: Ani migbe̱ le̱ yee egbo̱? ani dšee nye moṅ nyegbè̱i le̱ yee egbo? *

english_verse: And if wicked people start doing right, they will save themselves from punishment.
translation_verse: Asaṅ ké̱ efõṅfelo̱ kpale ke̱-dše̱ enõfõṅ ní efe le̱ mli ni eye dšale̱ sane ni efe noni dša le̱: le̱ le̱ ehere esusuma yiwala.

english_verse: They will think about what they've done and stop sinning, and so they won't be put to death.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ eko̱ eyiṅ, ni ekpale ke̱-dše̱ etõmo̱i ní etõ le̱ fẽ mli: eyi aaná wala kẽ, egboṅ.

english_verse: But you still say that I am unfair. You are the ones who have done wrong and are unfair!
translation_verse: Kẽle̱ Israel we le̱ kē̱o̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ gbe̱ le̱ yee egbo̱! Ani migbè̱i le̱ yee egbo̱, Israel we? ani dšee nye nyegbè̱i le̱ yee egbo̱?

english_verse: I will judge each of you for what you've done. So stop sinning, or else you will certainly be punished.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ makodšonye, Israel we, mofẽmo ye̱ egbe̱i anā! Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱. *Nyekpalea ni nyetšṍmo̱a nyehe ke̱-dše̱a nyeno̱tõmo̱i le̱ fẽ mli, koni nišai-anii akafenye pãmpi! *

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and start thinking pure thoughts. And be faithful to me! Do you really want to be put to death for your sins?
translation_verse: Nyeše̱re̱a nyeno̱tõmo̱i le̱ fẽ ní nyeke̱-tõ le̱ nyeſiea ke̱-dše̱a nyehe, ni nyefea *tšui hẽ ke̱ mumo̱ hē nyehãa nyehe! ši mẽba nyeagboi, Israel we? *

english_verse: I, the Lord God, don't want to see that happen to anyone. So stop sinning and live!
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *mináá moni gboo̱ le̱ gbĕle he mīše̱, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱. Nohewo̱ le̱ nyekpalea, ní nyeyi aná wala! *K.

english_verse: Ezekiel, sing a funeral song for two of Israel's leaders:
translation_verse: Ni bo le̱, wó yāfó lala no̱ ohã Israel lume̱i le̱,

english_verse: She taught one of them to hunt, and he learned to eat people.
translation_verse: Ni etšo̱se ebii le̱ ateṅ ekome; etšṍ dšata oblanyo ní ekase lōmõmo̱, eyeo̱ gbomei tete.

english_verse: His mother waited for him to return. But soon she lost all hope and raised another cub, who also became fierce.
translation_verse: Ni beni enye le̱ na ake̱ emẽ āhũ ni ehĩeno̱kãmo̱ elādše le̱, esā eṅõ ebii le̱ ateṅ ekroko efe dšata oblanyo.

english_verse: Nations plotted to kill him, and people came from all over to spread out a net and catch him in a trap.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni dšeṅmãdši ní dše̱ šikpõdši le̱ ano̱ le̱ bagba wole̱ ke̱-kpe, ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱yā le̱ lē̱ eno̱, ni adũle̱ ye̱ ame̱bu le̱ṅ.

english_verse: They put him in a cage and took him to Babylonia. The lion was locked away, so that his mighty roar would never again be heard on Israel's hills.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ke̱ kpodši gblale̱ ame̱wo koloi adeka mli, ni *ame̱ke̱le̱ yahã Babel maṅtše̱ le̱; ni ake̱le̱ to mõdši le̱ amli, beni afe ní akanu egbē ye̱ Israel gõdši le̱ ano̱ doṅṅ. *

english_verse: Your mother was a vine like you, growing near a stream. There was plenty of water, so she was filled with branches and with lots of fruit.
translation_verse: Onye tamo̱ weintšo ye̱ olá le̱ṅ, ní ate̱ole̱ ye̱ nu he; ewo yibii ní egbla ni-dši ye̱ nu babaō le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: Her strong branches became symbols of authority, and she was taller than all other trees— everyone could see how strong and healthy she was.
translation_verse: Ni ená tšei ní wa ní hĩ hã no̱yelo̱i amaṅtše̱tšei, ni awó ekwo̱le̱ le̱ no̱ ye̱ nidši kusukusui le̱ ateṅ, ni anale̱ ye̱ ekwo̱le̱ ke̱ enidši ní fá le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: But in anger, I pulled her up by the roots and threw her to the ground, where the scorching desert wind dried out her fruit. Her strong branches wilted and burned up.
translation_verse: Ši afãle̱ ye̱ mlila nā aše̱le̱ afõ šikpoṅ, ni bokă kō̱yo̱ le̱ gbĩ eyibii le̱; akũmo̱ etšei ní wa le̱ ni *ame̱gbīgblĩ la sãame̱. *

english_verse: Then she was planted in a hot, dry desert,
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱ le̱ ayate̱ole̱ ye̱ ṅãno̱, ye̱ šikpoṅ gbĩṅ ní nu be̱ no̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: where her stem caught fire, and flames burned her branches and fruit. Not one strong branch is left; she is stripped bare. This funeral song must be sung with sorrow.
translation_verse: Ni la dše̱ enidši le̱ amli tšei le̱ ateṅ, ni ešã eyibii le̱, ni tšo ní wa ní hĩ hã no̱yelo̱ maṅtše̱tšo be̱ no̱ doṅṅ. Yāfó lala dši ene̱, ni eetšṍ yāfó lala hũ.

english_verse: I told them to get rid of their disgusting idols and not to sin by worshiping the gods of Egypt. I reminded them that I was the Lord their God,
translation_verse: Ni mikē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyeteṅ *mofẽmo aše̱re̱ ehĩṅme̱ii anihĩnii le̱ aſie, ni nyeke̱ Mizraim wo̱dši le̱ akabulea nyehe! Midši Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱! *Ios.

english_verse: but they still rebelled against me. They refused to listen and kept on worshiping their idols and foreign gods. In my anger, I decided to punish the Israelites in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ši ame̱tše mihĩe atũa, ni e̱me̱kplẽẽ-mi toibõ; ame̱teṅ mokomoko še̱re̱e̱ ehĩṅme̱ii anihĩnii le̱ eſiee̱, ni Mizraim wo̱dši le̱ hũ ame̱šĩĩ. Ke̱ke̱ ni mikē̱: Mafo̱se mimlila le̱ maſie ame̱no̱, ni maṅmẽ mimlifũ le̱ gbe̱ ke̱-ba ame̱no̱ ye̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ teṅ.

english_verse: So I brought them out and led them into the desert.
translation_verse: Ni midšieame̱ ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni mike̱ame̱ ba ṅã le̱ no̱;

english_verse: I gave them my laws and teachings, so they would know how to live right.
translation_verse: ni mike̱ mikpo̱i le̱ hãame̱, ni mi-hã ame̱le mimlai le̱, ni *ké̱ gbomo ye no̱ ní eyi aaná wala ye̱ mli le̱. *

english_verse: But the Israelites rebelled against me in the desert. They refused to obey my laws and teachings, and they treated the Sabbath like any other day. Then in my anger, I decided to destroy the Israelites in the desert once and for all.
translation_verse: Ši Israel we le̱ tše mihĩe atũa ye̱ ṅã le̱ no̱; ame̱nyiee ye̱ mikpo̱i le̱ anã, ni amegbe mimlai le̱ ahe guo̱, nii ní ké̱ gbomo ye no̱ ni eyi aaná wala ye̱ mli le̱, ni ame̱bule mihedšō̱mo̱gbĩĩ le̱ pī. Ke̱ke̱ ni mikē̱: Mafo̱se mimlila maſie ame̱-no̱ ye̱ ṅã le̱ no̱, ní maplenēame̱.

english_verse: Instead, I told them in the desert that I would not lead them into the beautiful, fertile land I had promised.
translation_verse: Asaṅ *miwó minine no̱ mitšõame̱ ye̱ ṅã le̱ no̱, ako̱ mike̱ame̱ eyaa šikpoṅ ní miṅõ-hãame̱ ní fufo̱ ke̱ wò hoo̱ ye̱ no̱ ní dši šikpõdši le̱ ateṅ noni yo̱ fe̱o fè fẽ le̱ no̱; *

english_verse: So I warned the children not to act like their parents or follow their evil ways or worship their idols.
translation_verse: Ši mikē̱ ame̱bii le̱ ye̱ ṅã le̱ no̱ ake̱: Nyekanyiea ye̱ nyetše̱mei le̱ akpo̱i le̱ anā, ni nyekayea ame̱mlai le̱ ano̱, ni nyeke̱ ame̱wo̱dši le̱ akabulea nyehe!

english_verse: I reminded them that I was the Lord their God and that they should obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Midši Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱; nyenyiea ye̱ mikpo̱i le̱ moṅ anā, ni nyeyea mimlai le̱ ano̱ ni nyefea!

english_verse: I told them to respect my Sabbath to show that they were my people and that I was the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Ni nyeyea mihedšō̱mo̱gbĩĩ le̱ kroṅkroṅ, ní ame̱tšṍmo̱ okadi ye̱ mike̱nye teṅ, koni nyená nyele ake̱ midsi Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱. K.

english_verse: But the children also rebelled against me. They refused to obey my laws and teachings, and they treated the Sabbath as any other day. I became angry and decided to punish them in the desert.
translation_verse: Ši bii le̱ hũ tše mihĩe atũa: ame̱nyiee ye̱ mikpo̱i le̱ anā, ni asaṅ ame̱yee mimlai le̱ ano̱ ni ame̱fe, nii ní ké̱ gbomo ye no̱ ní eyi aaná wala ye̱ mli le̱; ame̱bule mihedšō̱mo̱gbĩĩ le̱ hũ. Ke̱ke̱ ni mikē̱: Mafo̱se mimlila le̱ maſie ame̱no̱, ni maṅmẽ mimlifũ le̱ gbe̱ ke̱-ba ame̱no̱ ye̱ ṅã le̱ no̱.

english_verse: because they had disobeyed my laws and ignored my teachings; they had disgraced my Sabbath and worshiped the idols their ancestors had made.
translation_verse: edšake̱ ame̱yee mimlai le̱ ano̱, ši ame̱gbe mikpo̱i le̱ ahe guo̱, ni ame̱bule mihedšō̱mo̱gbĩĩ le̱, ni ame̱hĩe nyie ame̱tše̱mei awo̱dši le̱ ase̱.

english_verse: I gave them laws that bring punishment instead of life,
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ mi hũ mĩhãame̱ akpo̱i ní ehĩĩ ke̱ mlai ní ame̱yi náṅ wala ye̱ mli,

english_verse: by offering sacrifices, incense, and wine to gods on every hill and under every large tree. I was very angry, because they did these things in the land I had given them!
translation_verse: Edšake̱ beni mike̱ame̱ ba šikpoṅ ní miwó minine no̱ ake̱ maṅõ-hãame̱ le̱ no̱ le̱, goṅkpo̱-fẽ-goṅkpo̱ ní kwo̱ lo tšo kusũ-fẽ-tšo kusū ní ame̱ana le̱, ame̱yašãa ame̱gbē-afo̱lei le̱ ye̱ dše̱i, ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱mlilawō nikēnii le̱ yakeo̱ ye̱ dše̱i; dše̱i noṅṅ ame̱hãa ame̱tšofãi le̱ dšeo̱ ṅma ye̱, ni ame̱yeo̱ ame̱ṅkpai ye̱ dše̱i.

english_verse: I asked them where they went to worship those gods, and they answered, “At the local shrines.” And those places of worship are still called shrines.
translation_verse: Ni mikē̱ame̱ ake̱: He groṅṅ le̱ ní nyeyaä le̱, té ešišiṅ? Ši atšé̱o̱ dše̱i ake̱ he groṅṅ ke̱-baši ṅme̱ne̱.

english_verse: Then ask the Israelites why they are following the example of their wicked ancestors
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ kē̱mo̱ Israel we le̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ no̱: Aso nyeabule nyehe bo̱ni nyetše̱mei le̱ fe le̱, ni nyeabo adſamaṅ ke̱-nyie ame̱nihĩnii le̱ ase̱?

english_verse: As surely as I am the living Lord God, I will rule over you with my powerful arm. You will feel my fierce anger
translation_verse: Gbĩĩabo̱ ní mihĩe kã ne̱, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱, ninešiwale̱ ke̱ nine ní akpa mli ke̱ mlila ní afo̱se aſie ši mike̱-aye nyeno̱ maṅtše̱.

english_verse: and lead you into a desert surrounded by nations. I will meet you there face to face. Then I will pass judgment on you
translation_verse: ni mike̱nye aaba mãdšimãdši le̱ *aṅã le̱ no̱, ni mike̱nye aabakodšo ye̱ dše̱i hĩe ke̱ hĩe. *Hos.

english_verse: I will force each of you to obey the regulations of our solemn agreement.
translation_verse: Ni mahã nyetšṍ tšo le̱ šiši, ni mike̱nye aawo kpãṅmo̱ le̱ kpã le̱ mli.

english_verse: I will separate the sinful rebels from the rest of you, and even though I will bring them from the nations where they live in exile, they won't be allowed to return to Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni madšie atũatšelo̱i le̱ ke̱ mei ní etõ mino̱ lo̱ ke̱-adše̱ nyeteṅ; madšieame̱ ke̱-adše̱ ame̱gbo̱tō šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ moṅ, ši ame̱baṅ Israel šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni nyeaná nyele ake midši Iehowa le̱.

english_verse: Go ahead and worship your idols for now, you Israelites, because soon I will no longer let you dishonor me by offering gifts to them. You will have no choice but to obey me!
translation_verse: Ši nye, Israel we, bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Nyeyaä ní nyeteṅ mofẽmo ayasúmo̱ ewo̱dši le̱; ši ké̱ fe se̱ le̱, nyeabomi toi kẽ, ni nyeke̱ nyenikē-nii ke̱ nyewo̱dši le̱ buleṅ migbe̱i kroṅkroṅ le̱ doṅṅ.

english_verse: When that day comes, everyone in Israel will worship me on Mount Zion, my holy mountain in Jerusalem. I will once again call you my own, and I will accept your sacred offerings and sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ši migoṅ kroṅkroṅ le̱ *ní dši Israel goṅ ní kwo̱ le̱ no̱ le̱, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱, dše̱i Israel we le̱ fẽ, ame̱fẽ-kwa ní ame̱-yo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱, ame̱abasúmo̱mi ye̱: maná ame̱he tšui ye̱ dše̱i, ni dše̱i noṅṅ mabi nyeno̱wómo̱-nikēnii ke̱ nyenikēnii le̱ amli kleṅkleṅnii le̱ ke̱ nyenii kroṅkroṅi le̱ fẽ ši ye̱. *

english_verse: When I bring you home from the places where you are now scattered, I will be pleased with you, just as I am pleased with the smell of the smoke from your sacrifices. Every nation on earth will see that I am holy,
translation_verse: Maná nyehe tšui tamo̱ noko ní dšeo̱ ṅma dšogbāṅ, beni midšienye ke̱-dše̱ mãdšimãdši le̱ amli, ni mibua nye-nā ke̱-dše̱ šikpõdši ní agbe̱nye aſā no̱ le̱ ano̱ le̱, ni mihã afemi kroṅkroṅ ye̱ nyemli ye̱ dšeṅmãdšimãdši le̱ ahĩe le̱.

english_verse: and you will know that I, the Lord, am the one who brought you back to Israel, the land I promised your ancestors.

english_verse: But you must drink every drop! Then smash the cup and chew on its broken pieces. Use them to cut your breasts in sorrow. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ni oonu ni ooſo̱ mli, ni ookpe ekói le̱ tete, ni oke̱-aše̱te ofufo̱i ahe; edšake̱ mi, miwie, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: You have completely rejected me, and so I promise that you will be punished for the disgusting things you did as a prostitute. The Two Sisters Are Condemned
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Ake̱-ní ohĩe kpa mino̱, ni oše̱mi ofo okotose̱ hewo̱ le̱, bo hũ, tĕremo̱ onyenyeṅtſibō̱ ke̱ odſamaṅbō̱i le̱!

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, it's time for you to tell Oholah and Oholibah that they are guilty. Remind them of their evil ways!
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa sā kē̱mi ake̱: Gbomobi, ani ookodšo Ohola ke̱ Oholiba? bĕle̱ dšadšemo̱ ame̱nihĩnii le̱ otšõame̱!

english_verse: They have been unfaithful by worshiping idols, and they have committed murder by sacrificing my own children as offerings to idols.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ame̱fite gblã, ni lá ye̱ ame̱dẽ; ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱wo̱dši le̱ efite gblã, ni ame̱hã *ame̱bii ní ame̱fo̱ ame̱hãmi le̱ etšṍmo̱ la mli ehãame̱ ame̱ye! *Ier.

english_verse: They came into my temple that same day, and that made it unfit as a place to worship me. They have even stopped respecting the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ beni ame̱gbe ame̱bii le̱ ame̱hã ame̱wo̱dši le̱, ame̱ba mihekroṅkroṅ le̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ noṅṅ ni ame̱babulele̱; ni na, nakai noṅṅ amefe ye̱ mišĩa le̱ teṅ!

english_verse: They sent messengers to attract men from far away. When those men arrived, the two sisters bathed themselves and put on eye shadow and jewelry.
translation_verse: Asaṅ tete po le̱ ame̱tšũ ayaṅõ hĩĩ ní dše̱ šoṅṅ ba, ame̱tšũ bo̱fo ke̱-te ame̱ṅõ, ni na, ame̱ba; ni odšu ohe ohãame̱, ni oke̱ adibri diki ohĩṅme̱ii, ni oke̱ wulamo̱nibii wula ohe;

english_verse: They sat on a fancy couch, and in front of them was a table for the olive oil and incense that had belonged to me.
translation_verse: ni otá sā fe̱fe̱o no̱, ni okplõ ní aṅmẽ mã hĩe, ni oke̱ mitšofã-ke̱-ṅma ke̱ mimũ le̱ emãmo̱ no̱;

english_verse: Their room was always filled with a noisy crowd of drunkards brought in from the desert. These men gave the women bracelets and beautiful crowns,
translation_verse: ni anu nyã́mo̱ gbẽ kpeteṅkple ye̱ dše̱i, ni ayaṅõ dā̃to̱lo̱i ke̱-dše̱ ṅã le̱ no̱ ebafata mei babaō le̱ he; ni ame̱ke̱ ninešĩgai wo yei le̱ anidši, ni ame̱ke̱ akekrei fe̱fe̱dši fĩmo̱ ame̱yitsei.

english_verse: and I noticed that the men were eager to have sex with these women, though they were exhausted from being prostitutes.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mikē̱ ake̱: Aso moni egbo̱ ne̱ aafite gblã lolo? kpāko moṅ ake̱le̱ babo̱ adſamaṅ.

english_verse: In fact, the men had sex over and over with Oholah and Oholibah, the two sinful sisters.
translation_verse: Ni ayaä eṅõ tamo̱ ayaä yō adſamaṅ ko ṅõ; nakai ame̱yaä Ohola ke̱ Oholiba ní dši yei nyenyeṅtſii le̱ aṅõ.

english_verse: But honest judges will someday accuse those two of murder and of being unfaithful, because they are certainly guilty.
translation_verse: Ši hĩĩ ní dši *dšalo̱i le̱, ame̱ke̱ yei gblãfitelo̱i akodšomo̱ ke̱ yei lášiſielo̱i akodšomo̱ aakodšoame̱; edšake̱ gblãfitelo̱i dšiame̱, ni lá ye̱ ame̱dẽ. *

english_verse: So I, the Lord God, now say to these sisters: I will call together an angry mob that will abuse and rob you.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Mahã asafo yū afã ke̱-ba ame̱no̱, ni maṅõame̱ mahã ní atſiaame̱ ši ni ahaame̱.

english_verse: They will stone you to death and cut you to pieces; they will kill your children and burn down your houses.
translation_verse: Ni asafo le̱ aatſiaame̱ te̱i, ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱klantei le̱ aabãmo̱ame̱; ame̱bihĩĩ ke̱ ame̱biyei le̱, ame̱agbeame̱, ni ame̱šĩai le̱ hũ ame̱ke̱ la aašã.

english_verse: I will get rid of sinful prostitution in this country, so that women everywhere will be warned not to act as you have.
translation_verse: Ni mahã nyenyeṅtſibō̱ se̱ afo ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ní aṅõ-bo̱ yei fẽ-kwa ko̱ko̱, koni ame̱kafe nyenyenyeṅtſiianii ne̱ eko.

english_verse: You will be punished for becoming prostitutes and for worshiping idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Ni maṅõ nyenyenyeṅtſibō̱ le̱ mafõ nyeno̱, ni nyeatĕre ešai ní nyeke̱ nyewo̱dši le̱ fe le̱, ni nyeaná nyele ake̱ midši Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa le̱.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, write down today's date, because the king of Babylonia has just begun attacking the city of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Gbomobi, ṅmã ne̱ke̱ gbĩ ne̱ ní dši ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ gbe̱i! Babel maṅtše̱ le̱ ewo Ierusalem he ká ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ noṅṅ.

english_verse: Throw in the legs and shoulders of your finest sheep and put in the juicy bones.
translation_verse: ṅõ lō ní asā le̱ fẽ owo mli, hei ní hĩ le̱ fẽ, ſuo̱ ke̱ nine, ke̱ wui ní hĩ fè fẽ le̱ oke̱-wo mli.

english_verse: These words mean that Jerusalem is doomed! The city is filled with murderers and is like an old, rusty pot. The meat is taken out piece by piece, and no one cares what happens to it.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: *Kpóo hã lášiſiemo̱ maṅ le̱! kukwe̱i ní mli edo̱ ṅkanale ní emli ṅkanale le̱ edšee le̱! Kŏ̱lo̱mo̱ emli nii le̱ ekomekome, akafõ no̱ ošiki! *K.

english_verse: The people of Jerusalem murdered innocent people in the city and didn't even try to cover up the blood that flowed out on the hard ground.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ elá le̱ ye̱ eteṅ; te̱sā kpatā no̱ eke̱-ſie, dšee šikpoṅ eke̱-ſie ní ake̱ sũ aaha no̱.

english_verse: But I have seen that blood, and it cries out for me to take revenge.
translation_verse: Beni afe ní ehã mlila ate ši, ni ebato̱ owele hewo̱ ni mihã eke̱ elá le̱ fĩe te̱sā kpatā no̱ ní akaha no̱ le̱.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will punish that city of violence! I will make a huge pile of firewood,
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Kpóo hã *lášiſiemo̱ maṅ le̱! Mi hũ mahã ešiši laike le̱ ada! *Nah.

english_verse: so bring more wood and light it. Cook the meat and boil away the broth to let the bones scorch.
translation_verse: Hã lai le̱ afá, hã la le̱ atšo! Ha lō le̱ abe dšogbāṅ, hã wonu le̱ afĩ, ni wui le̱ tete aṅălã!

english_verse: That time will certainly come! And when it does, I won't show the people of Jerusalem any pity or change my mind. They must be punished for the evil they have done. I, the Lord God, have spoken. Ezekiel's Wife Dies
translation_verse: Mi, Iehowa, miwie; eeba mli, ni mafe hũ: mifõṅ, ni minaṅ mo̱bo̱ ni miſaṅ mihe hũ. Bo̱ni ogbè̱i le̱ yo̱ ke̱ bo̱ni onifemo̱nii le̱ yo̱ le̱, nakai ame̱akodšoö, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: The Lord said,
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa wiemo̱ ba miṅõ ake̱:

english_verse: “Ezekiel, son of man, I will suddenly take the life of the person you love most. But I don't want you to complain or cry.
translation_verse: Gbomobi, na, mike̱ gbĕle-hela baṅõ *ohĩṅme̱ii atšuihenõ le̱ ke̱-dše̱ ohe; ši kāwo yăra ni kāfó hũ ni kāhã ohĩeyāfónui mīdše. *K.

english_verse: Mourn in silence and don't show that you are grieving. Don't remove your turban or take off your sandals; don't cover your face to show your sorrow, or eat the food that mourners eat.”
translation_verse: Dõmo̱ ntšo̱i diō, kāfe gbohĩĩ ahe yăra ko; oke̱ oyitšofĩnii le̱ afĩ oyitšo, ni oke̱ tokotai le̱ awo onãdši, ni kāha onābu no̱, nĩ kāye yăra no̱ niyenii hũ!

english_verse: One morning, I was talking with the people as usual, and by sunset my wife was dead. The next day I did what the Lord had told me,
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mike̱ maṅ le̱ wie lebi, ni gbe̱ke̱ le̱ miṅã le̱ gbo; ni lebi le̱ mife bo̱ni awomi kitã le̱.

english_verse: and when people saw me, they asked, “Why aren't you mourning for your wife?”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni maṅ le̱ bimi ake̱: Ani otšōṅwo̱ noni dši nii ní ofeo̱ ne̱ ašiši hãwo̱?

english_verse: I answered: The Lord God says
translation_verse: Ni mikē̱ame̱ ake̱: Iehowa wiemo̱ ba miṅõ ake̱:

english_verse: Then you will do the same things I have done. You will leave your face uncovered and refuse to eat the food that mourners usually eat.
translation_verse: Ni nyeafe tamo̱ bo̱ni mife ne̱: nyehaṅ nyenābui ano̱, ni nyeyeṅ yăra no̱ niyenii hũ,

english_verse: You won't take off your turbans and your sandals. You won't cry or mourn, but all day long you will go around groaning because of your sins.
translation_verse: ni nyeyitšofĩnii le̱ aafĩmo̱ nyeyitšei, ni nyetokotai le̱ aahĩ nyenãdši; nyewoṅ yăra ni asaṅ nyefóṅ, ši nyeatără lō ye̱ nyenišaianii le̱ ahewo̱, ni nyeakẽmo̱ nyetšõtšō̃ nyehe.

english_verse: I am a warning sign—everything I have done, you will also do. And then you will know the Lord God has made these things happen.
translation_verse: Ni Ezekiel aatšṍ *okadi ahãnye; bo̱ni efe le̱, nakai pe̱ nyeafe, ké̱ eba mli le̱; ni nyeaná nyele ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱. *K.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, I will soon destroy the temple that makes everyone feel proud and safe, and I will take away their children as well.
translation_verse: Ni bo, gbomobi, le̱le̱ṅ ake̱ gbĩ ní mašõ ame̱hewale̱ le̱, ame̱numnyam le̱ he nyã́mo̱ le̱, ame̱hĩṅme̱ii atšuihenõ le̱ ke̱ ame̱susumai ataomo̱nii le̱, ame̱bihĩĩ ke̱ ame̱biyei le̱, ke̱-adše̱ ame̱deṅ le̱,

english_verse: On that same day, someone will escape from the city and come to tell you what has happened.
translation_verse: nakai gbĩ le̱ noṅṅ *moko ní edše mli aaba oṅõ, ní ebawó otoi no̱. *

english_verse: Then you will be able to speak again, and the two of you will talk. You will be a warning sign to the people, and they will know that I am the Lord.”
translation_verse: Nakai gbĩ le̱ noṅṅ oke̱ moni edše mli le̱ fẽ nābu aagble, ni oowie ni oto̱ṅ mṹ doṅṅ; ni ootšṍ okadi ohãame̱, koni ame̱ná ame̱le ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱.

english_verse: and tell them: You celebrated when my temple was destroyed, when Israel was defeated, and when my people were taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: ni okē̱ Amonbii le̱ ake̱: Nyeboa Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa wiemo toi! Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Ake̱ nõ kẽ ní nyebo: *Yie̱! ye̱ mihekroṅkroṅ le̱ he, edšake̱ abulele̱, ke̱ Israel šikpoṅ le̱ he, edšake̱ afele̱ amaṅfõ, ke̱ Iuda we le̱ he, edšake̱ ame̱te nomṅō̃ mli: *

english_verse: Now I am going to let you be conquered by tribes from the eastern desert. They will set up their camps in your land and eat your fruit and drink your milk.
translation_verse: hewo̱ le̱ na, maṅõo mahã bokãgbe̱bii le̱ ní otšṍ ame̱nõ, ni ame̱abo̱ ame̱nsrai ye̱ omli, ni ame̱amãmo̱ ame̱šihĩle̱hei ye̱ omli; ame̱aye oyibii le̱, ni ame̱anu ofufo̱ le̱.

english_verse: The Lord God said, “The people of Moab thought Judah was no different from any other nation.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Ake̱-ni *Moab ke̱ Seir kē̱ ake̱: Na, Iuda we le̱ etšṍ tamo̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ fẽ! *Ies.

english_verse: So I will let Moab's fortress towns along its border be attacked, including Beth-Jeshimoth, Baal-Meon, and Kiriathaim.
translation_verse: hewo̱ le̱, na, magbu Moab ṅmãwuiaṅ ní dši mãdši le̱, emãdši le̱ ní dši šikpõdši le̱ ateṅ noni yo̱ fe̱o fè fẽ le̱, mawo mli ye̱ hefẽhe: Bet-Iešimot, Baal-Meon, ke̱-yaši Kiriataim tō̃.

english_verse: The same eastern desert tribes that invade Ammon will invade Moab, and just as Ammon will be forgotten forever,
translation_verse: Ni mike̱ame̱ aaši Amonbii le̱ ano̱ mahã bokãgbe̱bii le̱, ní etšṍ ame̱nõ, beni afe ní akakai Amonbii le̱ doṅṅ ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ.

english_verse: Moab will be punished. Then the people there will know that I am the Lord.” Judgment on Edom
