translation_verse: Ni makodšo Moab; ni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱.

english_verse: The Lord God then said, “The people of Edom are guilty of taking revenge on Judah.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Ake̱-ní Edom ke̱ Iuda we le̱ ye oweletō̱ sane, ni etõ babaō ye̱ oweletō̱ le̱ mli Ier.

english_verse: So I will punish Edom by killing all its people and livestock. It will be an empty wasteland all the way from Teman to Dedan.
translation_verse: hewo̱ le̱, bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Makpã minine mli ye̱ Edom no̱, ni mafo emli gbomo ke̱ šĩa kolo fẽ maše̱ mafõ, ni mafele̱ amaṅfõ ke̱-adše̱ Teman; ni ame̱anyõnyõi ye̱ klante nā āhũ ke̱-yaši Dedan tō̃.

english_verse: The Lord God said, “The cruel Philistines have taken revenge on their enemies over and over and have tried to destroy them.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Ake̱-ní *Filistibii le̱ ye oweletō̱ sane, ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱tšui mli heguo̱gbē to̱ ame̱he owele, koni ame̱kpãtã ame̱hĩe ye̱ nāno̱ nyē̱ nā *Ies.

english_verse: Now it's my turn to treat the Philistines as my enemies and to kill everyone living in their towns along the seacoast.
translation_verse: hewo̱ le̱, bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Na, makpã minine mli ye̱ Filistibii le̱ ano̱, ni maflo̱ *Keretibii le̱ maše̱re̱ maſie, ni makpãtã ṅšo le̱ nā ſē̱nõ le̱ hĩe. *

english_verse: In my fierce anger, I will take revenge on them. And when I punish them, they will know that I am the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ni mike̱ mlila kãmo̱i aato̱ owele kple ye̱ ame̱no̱, ni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ midsi Iehowa le̱, beni mito̱ mihe owele ye̱ ame̱no̱ le̱.

english_verse: Eleven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the first day of the month. He said:
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱ afi ni dši nyoṅma ke̱ ekome le̱ no̱, nyõṅ le̱ no̱ kleṅkleṅ gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ Iehowa wiemo̱ ba miṅõ ake̱:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people of the city of Tyre have celebrated Jerusalem's defeat by singing, “Jerusalem has fallen! It used to be powerful, a center of trade. Now the city is shattered, and we will take its place.”
translation_verse: Gbomobi, ake̱-ní Tiro kē̱ ye̱ Ierusalem he ake̱: *Yie̱! akũmo̱ mãdšimãdši le̱ agbó le̱; atšṍ ahãmi; ni etšṍ amaṅfõ ne̱ mibayi obõ! *

english_verse: They will tear down your city walls and defense towers. I will sweep away the ruins until all that's left of you is a bare rock,
translation_verse: Ni ame̱afite Tiro gbogboi le̱, ni ame̱-akũmo̱ emõdši ní kwŏ̱lo̱ le̱; ni mabē̱ eno̱ sũ tete ke̱-adše̱ eno̱, ni mafele̱ te̱sā kpatā.

english_verse: where fishermen can dry their nets along the coast. I promise that you will be robbed
translation_verse: Eetšṍ yāi akamo̱he ye̱ ṅšo̱ le̱ teṅ; edšake̱ mi miwie, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱; ni eetšṍ hānõ ehã dšeṅmãdši le̱.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia is the world's most powerful king, and I will send him to attack you. He will march from the north with a powerful army, including horses and chariots and cavalry troops.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Na, mahã Nebukadnezar, Babel maṅtše̱ le̱ ní dši *maṅtše̱mei amaṅtše̱ le̱, adše̱ kōyigbe̱ aba Tiro no̱ ke̱ okpo̱ṅo̱i ke̱ ſīlii ke̱ okpo̱ṅo̱iatše̱mei ke̱ asafo ke̱ ta babaō. *Dan.

english_verse: First, he will attack your towns along the coast and kill the people who live there. Then he will build dirt ramps up to the top of your city walls and set up rows of shields around you.
translation_verse: Ohe mãdši *ní kãmo̱ ṅã le̱ no̱ le̱, eke̱ klante aagbeame̱, ni eemã mō̃ ewo ohe, ni eetſa kpoku ewo ohe, ni eewó tše̱ṅ no̱ ešio. *K.

english_verse: He will command some of his troops to use large wooden poles to beat down your walls, while others use iron rods to knock down your watchtowers.
translation_verse: Ni eke̱ egbogbokū̃mo̱nii lo̱ aašimo̱ ogbogboi le̱, ni eke̱ edadei le̱ aakũmo̱ omõdši ní kwŏ̱lo̱ le̱.

english_verse: He will have so many horses that the dust they stir up will seem like a thick fog. And as his chariots and cavalry approach, even the walls will shake, especially when he proudly enters your ruined city.
translation_verse: Ekpo̱ṅo̱i ayifále̱ so̱ṅṅ nā le̱ ame̱he mlu aaha ohe; ekpo̱ṅo̱i ke̱ enigblamo̱-ſīlii ke̱ eta-ſīlii le̱ agbē̱mo̱ so̱ṅṅ aahã ogbogboi le̱ ahoso, beni eetšṍ ogbói le̱aṅ ke̱-abote mli, tamo̱ aboteo̱ maṅ ko ni agbu awoṅ mli lo̱.

english_verse: The troops will steal your valuable possessions; they will break down your walls, and crush your expensive houses. Then the stones and wood and all the remains will be dumped into the sea.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ašõ onii ní oná le̱, ni ame̱-aha oguo̱nii le̱, ni ame̱akũmo̱ ogbogboi lo̱, ni ame̱afite ošĩai fe̱fe̱dši le̱, ni ame̱-ke̱ ote̱i ke̱ otšei ke̱ osũ le̱ aawo nu mli.

english_verse: You will have no reason to sing or play music on harps,
translation_verse: Ni mahã olalai le̱ agbē̱mo̱ se̱ afo, ni *anuṅ osaṅkũi le̱ agbē doṅṅ. *Ies.

english_verse: because I will turn you into a bare rock where fishermen can dry their nets. And you will never rebuild your city. I, the Lord God, make this promise.
translation_verse: Ni mafeo te̱sā kpatā; ootšṍ yei akamo̱he; asāṅo doṅṅ; edšake̱ mi, Iehowa, miwie, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: The people of the nations up and down the coast will shudder when they hear your screams and moans of death.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ Tiro ne̱: Le̱le̱ṅ ake̱ ṅšo̱kpo̱i le̱ aahoso ye̱ ošigbēmo̱ le̱ gbē̱mo̱ nā, beni pilafoi kẽmoo̱ ní agbeo̱ mei ye̱ oteṅ kpo̱tō̱ le̱.

english_verse: The kings will step down from their thrones, then take off their royal robes and fancy clothes, and sit on the ground, trembling. They will be so shocked at the news of your defeat that they will shake in fear
translation_verse: Ni ṅšo̱ le̱ no̱ lume̱i le̱ fẽ aadše̱ ame̱sẽii le̱ ano̱ akpleke ši, ni ame̱adšie ame̱heboi le̱, ni ame̱akplo̱ ame̱tadei ni alò mli le̱; ame̱abu hekpokpomo̱, ni ame̱-atrá šikpoṅ, ni ame̱he aakpokpo hĩṅme̱i-tſā-fẽ-hĩṅme̱itſā, ni ame̱he aadšõ ame̱he ye̱ ohewo̱.

english_verse: and sing this funeral song: “The great city beside the sea is destroyed! Its people once ruled the coast and terrified everyone there.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱awo yāfó lala ye̱ ohe ni ame̱akē̱o ake̱: Kwe̱ bo̱ni ohĩe ekpãtã, bo ní ṅšo̱hĩenyielo̱i hĩo̱ omli, bo maṅ ní adšieo̱ oyi, ní ohe wa ye̱ ṅšo̱ hĩe, bo ke̱ omli bii, ní hã ame̱he ṅmiṅmi mõmo̱ mei fẽ ní bo̱leame̱ le̱!

english_verse: But now Tyre is in ruins, and the people on the coast stare at it in horror and tremble in fear.”
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ ṅšo̱kpo̱i le̱ ahe aakpokpo ye̱ ošigbēmo̱ gbĩ le̱ no̱, ni ṅšo̱kpo̱i ní yo̱ ṅšo̱ le̱ mli le̱ atšui aafã ye̱ odšeṅdšē le̱ hewo̱!

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will turn you into a ghost-town. The ocean depths will rise over you
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Beni mafeo maṅ amaṅfõ, tamo̱ mãdši ni ahĩĩ mli doṅṅ le̱, beni mahã ṅšo̱ ayi abaninao, ni nu babaō abaha ono̱ le̱:

english_verse: and carry you down to the world of the dead, where you will join people of ancient times and towns ruined long ago. You will stay there and never again be a city filled with people.
translation_verse: mahã oke̱ mei ní ekpleke ši ke̱-te lādšemo̱ bu le̱ mli le̱ akpleke ši ke̱-ya blema bēbe maṅ le̱ ṅõ, ni mahã oke̱ mei ní ekpleke ši ke̱-te lādšemo̱ bu le̱ mli le̱ ahĩ ši ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ šiši, ye̱ hei ní dši amaṅfõi ke̱-dše̱ blema bēbe le̱, beni afe ni akahĩ omli doṅṅ, ni asaṅ okatšõ ohe ye̱ hĩekãlo̱i ašikpoṅ le̱ no̱ doṅṅ!

english_verse: You will die a horrible death! People will come looking for your city, but it will never be found. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Maṅõo mafe gbeyeinõ, ni ohĩṅ ši doṅṅ; ni ké̱ abi oši le̱, anaṅo doṅṅ ke̱-ate nāno̱ fẽ, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: Oak trees from Bashan were shaped into oars; pine trees from Cyprus were cut for your deck, which was then decorated with strips of ivory.
translation_verse: Tšei wudši ní dše̱ Bašan ame̱ke̱-gbo̱ otablõi le̱; omāṅōi le̱ ſuo̱wu ní akpe̱ awo tšei ní nyẽo̱ dšale̱ ní dše̱ Kitim ṅšo̱kpo̱i le̱ ano̱ le̱ amli ame̱ke̱-fe.

english_verse: The builders used fancy linen from Egypt for your sails, so everyone could see you. Blue and purple cloth from Cyprus was used to shade your deck.
translation_verse: Klala ní alò mli ní dše̱ Mizraim le̱ dši obalā, koni esā etšṍ oflaṅā hũ; mama blū ke̱ afaseo ní dše̱ *Eliša ṅšo̱kpo̱i le̱ ane̱ dši ono̱hābū le̱. *

english_verse: Men from Sidon and Arvad did the rowing, and your own skilled workers were the captains.
translation_verse: Zidonbii ke̱ Arwadbii dši ow̌irilo̱i; Tiro, oṅālelo̱i ní yo̱ omli le̱, ame̱dši okudō̱tše̱mei.

english_verse: Experienced men from Byblos repaired any damages. Sailors from all over shopped at the stores in your port.
translation_verse: *Gebal onukpai le̱ ke̱ emli ṅālelo̱i le̱ hũ ye̱ omli, ame̱ ame̱tšĩmoo̱ ofo̱dši le̱; ṅšo̱ no̱ le̱dši fẽ ke̱ ame̱le̱dšiaṅbii ye̱ omli; ame̱yeo̱ dšra ame̱hãao. *

english_verse: Brave soldiers from Persia, Lydia, and Libya served in your navy, protecting you with shields and helmets, and making you famous.
translation_verse: Persia ke̱ Lud ke̱ Put ye̱ ota le̱ mli, otabilo̱i ni; ame̱ke̱ tše̱ṅ ke̱ dadefai tšotšŏroo̱ omli, ame̱ ame̱hãa ohĩe baã nyam.

english_verse: Your guards came from Arvad and Cilicia, and men from Gamad stood watch in your towers. With their weapons hung on your walls, your beauty was complete.
translation_verse: Arwadbii le̱ ke̱ ota le̱ yo̱ ogbogboi lo̱ ano̱ ke̱-kpe, ni hĩĩ kãkãlo̱i yo̱ omõdši ní kwŏ̱lo̱ le̱ amli; ame̱ke̱ ame̱tše̱ṅi le̱ tšo-tšŏ̱roo̱ ogbogboi le̱ ahe ke̱-kpeo̱; ame̱ ame̱hãa ohe feo̱ fe̱o ke̱-wulaä ši.

english_verse: Merchants from southern Spain traded silver, iron, tin, and lead for your products.
translation_verse: Taršiš ke̱o yeo̱ dšra ye̱ onifále̱ so̱ṅṅ hewo̱; dſie̱te̱i ke̱ dade ke̱ sãnyã ke̱ sumui ame̱ke̱-batšakeo̱ oguo̱nii le̱.

english_verse: and those from Beth-Togarmah traded work horses, war horses, and mules.
translation_verse: Mei ní dše̱ Togarma we le̱ ke̱ okpo̱ṅo̱i ke̱ tawū-okpo̱ṅo̱i ke̱ tedšiokpo̱ṅo̱i ame̱ke̱-batšakeo̱ oguo̱nii le̱.

english_verse: You also did business with people from Rhodes, and people from nations along the coast gave you ivory and ebony in exchange for your goods.
translation_verse: Dedanbii ke̱o yeo̱ dšra; ake̱ onine-nānii yeo̱ dšra ye̱ ṅšo̱kpo̱i babaō no̱; ſuo̱wu ke̱ no̱ko̱tšei ame̱ke̱-bawoo̱o nyõmo̱.

english_verse: Judah and Israel gave you their finest wheat, fancy figs, honey, olive oil, and spices in exchange for your merchandise.
translation_verse: Iuda ke̱ Israel šikpoṅ le̱ ke̱o yeo̱ dšra; ṅmā̃ ní dše̱ Minit ke̱ akpãnō ke̱ wò ke̱ mū ke̱ ohe̱ ní dšeo̱ ṅma ame̱ke̱-batšakeo̱ odšrayelinii le̱.

english_verse: The people of Damascus saw what you had to offer and brought you wine from Helbon and wool from Zahar.
translation_verse: Damasko hũ ke̱o yeo̱ dšra ye̱ oninenā nitšumo̱i le̱ afále̱ ke̱ onifále̱ so̱ṅṅ hewo̱, ke̱ wein ní dše̱ Helbon ke̱ tõhetšo̱i ní ye̱o̱ futā.

english_verse: The people of Dedan supplied you with saddle blankets,
translation_verse: Dedan hũ ke̱o yeo̱ okpo̱ṅo̱ no̱ mama ní atáa no̱ dšra.

english_verse: while people from Arabia and the rulers of Kedar traded lambs, sheep, and goats.
translation_verse: Arabia ke̱ *Kedar lume̱i le̱ fẽ ke̱ oninenānii yeo̱ dšra, ke̱ tōgwanteṅbii ke̱ tōagboi ke̱ tōkpakpoi: nomei adšra ame̱-ke̱o yeo̱. *

english_verse: Merchants from Sheba and Raamah gave you excellent spices, precious stones, and gold in exchange for your products.
translation_verse: Šeba ke̱ Raama dšrayelo̱i le̱ ame̱ hũ ame̱ke̱o yeo̱ dšra; tšofãi-ke̱-ṅmai fẽ mli ekpakpai ke̱ te̱i ní dšra wa fẽ ke̱ šika ame̱ke̱-batšakeo̱ oguo̱nii le̱.

english_verse: You also did business with merchants from the cities of Haran, Canneh, Eden, Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad,
translation_verse: Haran ke̱ Kanē ke̱ Eden ke̱ Šeba dšrayelo̱i le̱, Ašur ke̱ Kilmad ke̱o yeo dšra.

english_verse: and they gave you expensive clothing, purple and embroidered cloth, brightly colored rugs, and strong rope.
translation_verse: Mene̱mei ke̱o yeo̱ mamai fe̱fe̱dši adšra, ke̱ mama afaseo ke̱ mama ní alò mli atadei, ke̱ kéntei ke̱ tãṅkpēi ní agbo̱ ke̱ tãṅkpēi ní atšṍ.

english_verse: Large, seagoing ships carried your goods wherever they needed to go. You were like a ship loaded with heavy cargo
translation_verse: Taršiš le̱dši le̱ woo̱ odšrayelinii le̱, ni oyi to̱ ni ohĩe ba nyam ye̱ ṅšo̱ teṅ.

english_verse: and sailing across the sea, but you were wrecked by strong eastern winds.
translation_verse: Ow̌irilo̱i le̱ ke̱o te nui wudši ano̱; ši bokã kō̱yo̱ edſărao ye̱ ṅšo̱ teṅ.

english_verse: Every ship is deserted; rowers and sailors and captains all stand on shore,
translation_verse: Ni mei ní hĩe tablõi le̱ fẽ, le̱dšiaṅbii ke̱ ṅšo̱ hĩe kudō̱tše̱mei le̱ fẽ aadše ame̱le̱dši le̱ amli abadamo̱ šikpoṅ,

english_verse: mourning for you. They show their sorrow by putting dust on their heads and rolling in ashes;
translation_verse: ni ame̱awó ame̱gbē no̱ ye̱ ohewo̱, ni ame̱ablo̱ wā, ni ame̱alō mlu ame̱ſie ame̱yiteṅ, ame̱akoklo lamlu mli,

english_verse: they shave their heads and dress in sackcloth as they cry in despair.
translation_verse: ni ame̱akpo̱ ame̱yi ye̱ ohewo̱, ni ame̱amĩa kpekpe, ni ame̱afó ame̱hão ke̱ susuma aw̌ere̱hō ke̱ yărafemo̱ ní mli wa,

english_verse: In their grief they sing a funeral song for you: “Tyre, you were greater than all other cities. But now you lie in silence at the bottom of the sea.
translation_verse: ni ame̱awo yāfó lala ye̱ ohewo̱ ye̱ ame̱lelewo̱mo̱ le̱ mli, ni ame̱afó ye̱ ohewo̱ ake̱: Namo tamo̱ Tiro, tamo̱ moni efe diṅṅ ye̱ ṅšo̱ teṅ le̱?

english_verse: “Nations that received your merchandise were always pleased; kings everywhere got rich from your costly goods.
translation_verse: Beni oguo̱nii le̱ dše̱o̱ ṅšo̱i fẽ mli baä le̱, ohã mãdšimãdši pī tŏ̱ro̱; onii ke̱ odšrayelinii le̱ afále̱ le̱ oke̱-hã šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ maṅtše̱mei ná nii.

english_verse: But now you are wrecked in the deep sea, with your cargo and crew scattered everywhere.
translation_verse: Agbene ní adſărao ke̱-dše̱ ṅšo̱i ahĩe ye̱ nui ní mli kwŏ̱lo̱ le̱ amli ne̱, odšrayelinii ke̱ osafo fẽ ní yo̱ omli le̱ ešiu.

english_verse: People living along the coast are shocked at the news. Their rulers are horrified, and terror is written across their faces.
translation_verse: Mei fẽ ní hīo̱ ṅšo̱kpo̱i le̱ ano̱ le̱ ahe aadšõ ame̱he ye̱ ohewo̱, ni ame̱maṅtše̱mei le̱, ṅmiṅmi aamõmo̱ame̱, ame̱hĩe hũ aafeame̱ yā.

english_verse: The merchants of the world can't believe what happened. Your death was gruesome, and you are gone forever.”
translation_verse: Mãdšimãdši le̱ amli dšrayelo̱i le̱ aaboö tšia; *oplenēmo̱ le̱ ye̱ gbeyei, ni olãdše ke̱-mīya nāno̱! *

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa wiemo̱ sā ba miṅõ ake̱:

english_verse: You think you're wiser than Daniel and know everything.
translation_verse: na, bo le̱ ole nii fè *Daniel, tēmo̱sane ko tēmo̱sane ko be̱ ní aanyẽ aṅõ-tēo. *

english_verse: Your wisdom has certainly made you rich, because you have storehouses filled with gold and silver.
translation_verse: Onilē ke̱ osanese̱ko̱mo̱ nā le̱ oná nii ohã ohe, ni oná šika ke̱ dſie̱te̱i owo odſetrii le̱ amli.

english_verse: You're a clever businessman and are extremely wealthy, but your wealth has led to arrogance!
translation_verse: Onilē le̱ fále̱ ke̱ odšrayeli le̱ nā le̱ oha onii le̱ efá, ni otšui ewó ehe no̱ ye̱ onii le̱ ahewo̱: —

english_verse: You compared yourself to a god, so now I, the Lord God,
translation_verse: hewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Ake̱-ní ofe otšui tamo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ tšui

english_verse: will make you the victim of cruel enemies. They will destroy all the possessions you've worked so hard to get.
translation_verse: hewo̱ le̱, na, mahã gbo̱i ní dši dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ yiwalo̱i aba ono̱, ni ame̱-abagbla ame̱klantei ame̱wo onilē le̱ hefe̱o le̱, ni ame̱abule okpe̱mo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Your enemies will brutally kill you, and the sea will be your only grave.
translation_verse: Ame̱ahã okpleke ši ke̱-ya lādšemo̱ bu le̱ṅ, ni oogbo mei ní nyõnyõo̱ le̱ agbĕle ye̱ ṅšo̱ teṅ.

english_verse: When you face your enemies, will you still claim to be a god? They will attack, and you will suffer like any other human.
translation_verse: Ani ookē̱ ye̱ moni gbeo̱o le̱ hĩe ake̱: *“Nyoṅmo̱ dšimi!” lo? ši gbomo dšio ye̱ moni yeo̱o awui le̱ deṅ, ni dšee Mawu. *K.

english_verse: You were truly good from the time of your birth, but later you started doing wicked things.
translation_verse: Oye emū ye̱ ogbè̱i le̱ amli ke̱-dše̱ gbĩ no̱ ní abo̱o le̱ āhũ ke̱-yaši beyino ní ana noni edšaa ye̱ omli le̱.

english_verse: You traded with other nations and became more and more cruel and evil. So I forced you to leave my mountain, and the creature that had been your protector now chased you away from the jewels.
translation_verse: Oguo̱yeli ní fá le̱ nā le̱ ame̱ke̱ amimyeli ewo omli obõ, ni ofe eša; nohewo̱ le̱ mabuleo maſieo ke̱-adše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ goṅ le̱ no̱, ni makpãtã ohĩe ke̱-adše̱ la te̱i le̱ ateṅ, bo kerub ní keteo̱ no̱.

english_verse: It was your good looks that made you arrogant, and you were so famous that you started acting like a fool. That's why I threw you to the ground and let other kings sneer at you.
translation_verse: Otšui ewó ehe no̱ ye̱ ohefe̱o le̱ hewo̱; ofite onilē le̱ ye̱ okpe̱mo̱ le̱ hewo̱. Maṅōo matſa šikpoṅ, maṅõo mafõ maṅtše̱mei ahĩe, koni ame̱kwe̱o.

english_verse: and the people of other nations are shocked. Your punishment was horrible, and you are gone forever. Judgment on Sidon and Peace for Israel
translation_verse: Mei fẽ ní leo ye̱ mãdšimãdši le̱ ateṅ le̱ ahe aadšõ ame̱he ye̱ ohe, *oplenēmo̱ le̱ ye̱ gbeyei, ni olādše ke̱-mĩya nāno̱! *

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the city of Sidon
translation_verse: Gbomobi, tšṍ ohĩe ohã *Zidon, ni ogba osile̱, *Ies.

english_verse: and tell its people: I, the Lord God, am your enemy! People will praise me when I punish you, and they will see that I am holy.
translation_verse: ni okē̱: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Na, mike̱o ená, Zidon, ni *aawo mihĩe nyam ye̱ omli, ni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ mi-dši Iehowa le̱, beni makodšole̱ ni mafe mihe kroṅkroṅ ye̱ emli le̱. *

english_verse: I will send deadly diseases to wipe you out, and I will send enemies to invade and surround you. Your people will be killed, and you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ši matšũ gbĕle-hela ke̱-aba eno̱ ke̱ lá hũ ke̱-aba eblohũi le̱ amli, ni pilafoi le aanyõnyõi ye̱ eteṅ ye̱ klante ní dše̱ hefẽhe ke̱-ba eno̱ ke̱-kpe le̱ nā, ni ame̱-aná ame̱le ake̱ midsi Iehowa le̱.

english_verse: When that happens, the people of Israel will no longer have cruel neighbors that abuse them and make them feel as though they are in a field of thorns and briers. And the Israelites will know that I, the Lord God, have done these things. A Blessing for Israel
translation_verse: Ni ṅmei ko ní tšuo̱ mo lo aklati ko ní nā dšraä ehĩṅ ši hãṅ Israel we le̱ doṅṅ ye̱ mei fẽ ní ebo̱leame̱ ke̱-kpe, ní gbeo̱ ame̱he gno̱ le̱ ateṅ, ni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱.

english_verse: The Lord God said: Someday I will gather the people of Israel from the nations where they are now scattered, and every nation will see that I am holy. The Israelites will once again live in the land I gave to my servant Jacob.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Beni mabua Israel we le̱ nā ke̱-adše̱ mãdšimãdši le̱ ní agbe̱ame̱ aſã ame̱teṅ le̱ amli, ni mihe aafe kroṅkroṅ ye̱ ame̱mli ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ahĩe le̱, no le̱ ame̱ahĩ ame̱dientše̱ ame̱šikpoṅ le̱ ní miṅõ-hã mitšũlo̱ Iakob le̱ no̱.

english_verse: They will be safe and will build houses and plant vineyards. They will no longer be in danger, because I will punish their hateful neighbors. Israel will know that I am the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ahĩ no̱ ſeſẽſe, ni ame̱amãmo̱ tšũi, ni ame̱afe weintromi, ni ame̱ahĩ ši ſeſēſe, heni makodšo mei fẽ ní gbeo̱ ame̱he guo̱ ní ebo̱leame̱ ke̱-kpe le̱, ni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ midsi Iehowa, ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Ten years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the twelfth day of the tenth month. He said:
translation_verse: Afi ní dši nyoṅma le̱ no̱ nyõṅ ní dši nyoṅma le̱ no̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱ le̱ no̱ le̱ Iehowa wiemo̱ ba miṅõ ake̱:

english_verse: that I am saying: King of Egypt, you were like a giant crocodile lying in a river. You acted as though you owned the Nile and made it for yourself. But now I, the Lord God, am your enemy!
translation_verse: Wiemo̱ ni okē̱: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Na, mike̱o ená, Farao, Mizraim maṅtše̱, *bã́ wulu kple ní kã efāi ateṅ ní kē̱o̱ ake̱: Mifā le̱ minõṅ, midientše̱ mife mihã mihe! *

english_verse: Then everyone in Egypt will know that I am the Lord. You and your nation refused to help the people of Israel and were nothing more than a broken stick.
translation_verse: Ni Mizraimbii fẽ aaná ale ake̱ mi dši Iehowa le̱. Edšake̱ ame̱tšṍmo̱ *gălã ame̱hã Israel we le̱, *

english_verse: When they reached out to you for support, you broke in half, cutting their arms and making them fall.
translation_verse: beni ame̱ke̱ amenine mõ omli le̱, oboda, ni ogbla ame̱kõdši ano̱ fẽ; ni beni ame̱kpasa bo le̱, okũ, ni ohã ame̱he̱i fẽ kpokpo.

english_verse: So I, the Lord God, will send troops to attack you, king of Egypt. They will kill your people and livestock,
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Na, mike̱ klante aaba ono̱, ni mafo gbomo ke̱ kolo fẽ ye̱ omli maše̱ mafõ.

english_verse: until your land is a barren desert. Then you will know that I have done these things. You claimed that you made the Nile River and control it.
translation_verse: Ni Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ aatšṍ amaṅfõ ke̱ ole̱ṅle̱, ni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱. Edšake̱ ekē̱ ake̱: “Fā le̱ minõṅ, ni mi mife!”

english_verse: No human or animal will even dare travel through Egypt, because no sign of life will be found there for
translation_verse: Gbomo nane tšṍṅ no̱, ni kolo nane hũ tšṍṅ no̱, ni asaṅ ahĩṅ no̱ afii nyoṅmai-edſe̱ so̱ṅṅ.

english_verse: They will once again live in their homeland in southern Egypt. But they will be a weak kingdom
translation_verse: ni makpale Mizraim nomṅō̃ le̱ ke̱-aba ekoṅ, ni mike̱ame̱ aaba Patros šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ke̱-ba šikpoṅ ni ame̱dše no̱ le̱ no̱, ni ame̱atšṍ maṅtše̱yeli ní eba ši ye̱ dše̱i.

english_verse: and won't ever be strong enough to rule nations, as they did in the past.
translation_verse: Eetšṍ maṅtše̱yelii le̱ amli noni ba ši fè fẽ, ni esă ewóṅ ehe no̱ doṅṅ ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ano̱; ši mahã ame̱no̱ agbo̱, ni ame̱kaye dšeṅmãdši le̱ ano̱ doṅṅ.

english_verse: My own people Israel will never again depend on your nation. In fact, when the Israelites remember what happened to you Egyptians, they will realize how wrong they were to turn to you for help. Then the Israelites will know that I, the Lord God, did these things. King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia Will Conquer Egypt
translation_verse: Ni efeṅ noni Israel we le̱ ke̱ ame̱hĩe fõo̱ no̱ doṅṅ, ni eehã akai ame̱nišaianii le̱, ni ame̱atšṍ ame̱he ke̱-yanyie ame̱se̱, ni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱.

english_verse: Twenty-seven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the first day of the first month. He said:
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱ afi ní dši nyoṅmai-enyo̱ ke̱ kpawo le̱ no̱ kleṅkleṅ nyõṅ le̱ no̱ kleṅkleṅ gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ Iehowa wiemo̱ ba miṅõ ake̱:

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked the city of Tyre. He forced his soldiers to carry so many heavy loads that their heads were rubbed bald, and their shoulders were red and sore. Nebuchadnezzar and his army still could not capture the city.
translation_verse: Gbomobi, Nebukadnezar, Babel maṅtše̱ le̱, hã eta le̱ súmo̱ súomo̱ kple ye̱ Tiro hewo̱: yiteṅ-fẽ-yiteṅ kpa, ni kõṅ-fẽ-kõṅ no̱ kpo̱; ši kẽle̱ le̱ ke̱ eta le̱ náá nyõmo̱wo ko ye̱ Tiro he ye̱ súomo̱ ní esùmo̱ ye̱ ehe le̱ mli.

english_verse: So now I will hand over the nation of Egypt to him. He will take Egypt's valuable treasures and give them to his own troops.
translation_verse: Nohewo le̱ bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Mike̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ aahã Nebukadnezar, Babel maṅtše̱ le̱, ni eeṅõ enii babaō le̱ nom, ni eeha ehānii le̱, ni eešõ edšotſānii le̱, ni no aatšṍ eta le̱ nyõmo̱wo.

english_verse: Egypt will be his reward, because he and his army have been following my orders. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Maṅõ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ mahãle̱ ake̱ súomo̱ ní esúmo̱ le̱ he nyõmo̱wo, edšake̱ *mi ame̱tšu ame̱hã, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱. *

english_verse: Ezekiel, when Egypt is defeated, I will make the people of Israel strong, and I will give you the power to speak to them. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ mahã aklonto ko akwẽ ahã Israel we le̱, ni bo le̱ magble onābu ye̱ ame̱teṅ, ni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱.

english_verse: Soldiers hired from Ethiopia, Libya, Lydia, Arabia, Kub, as well as from Israel, will die in that battle.
translation_verse: Kuš ke̱ Put ke̱ Lud ke̱ futufutu-gbomei le̱ fẽ ke̱ Kub ke̱ kpãṅmo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ bii le̱ ke̱ame̱ aanyõnyõi ye̱ klante nā.

english_verse: All of your allies will be killed, and your proud strength will crumble. People will die from Migdol in the north to Aswan in the south. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Boni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Mei ní hĩe Mizraim le̱ hũ aanyõnyõi, ni ehewale̱ hewo le̱ nā aaba ši; ame̱anyõnyõi ye̱ klante nā ye̱ mli ke̱-dše̱ Migdol ke̱-yaši Sewene, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: Your nation of Egypt will be the most deserted place on earth, and its cities will lie in complete ruin.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱atšṍmo̱ amaṅfõi ye̱ šikpõdši ní etšṍmo̱ amaṅfõi le̱ ateṅ, ni emãdši le̱ hũ aahĩ mãdši ní etšṍmo̱ ole̱ṅle̱i le̱ ateṅ.

english_verse: I will set fire to your land, and anyone who defended your nation will die. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱, beni miwo la ye̱ Mizraim, ni akpãtã ebualo̱i le̱ fẽ hĩe le̱.

english_verse: On the same day I destroy Egypt, I will send messengers to the Ethiopians to announce their coming destruction. They think they are safe, but they will be terrified.
translation_verse: Nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ bo̱foi aadše̱ mihĩe adše kpo ye̱ le̱dši amli, ní ame̱yawo *Kušbii ní hĩe be̱ ame̱he no̱ le̱ ahe gbeyei, ni ṅmiṅmi aamõmo̱ame̱, tamo̱ bo̱ni ba mli ye̱ Mizraim gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱; edšake̱ na, ẽba! *Ies.

english_verse: Your Egyptian army is very strong, but I will send King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to completely defeat that army.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Asaṅ matšṍ Nebukadnezar, Babel maṅtše̱ le̱, nine no̱ mahã Mizraim asafo yū le̱ atã.

english_verse: He and his cruel troops will invade and destroy your land and leave your dead bodies piled everywhere.
translation_verse: Le̱ ke̱ emaṅ ní fata ehe ní dši dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ yiwalo̱i le̱, ake̱ame̱ aaba ni ame̱bakpãtã šíkpoṅ le̱ hĩe, ni ame̱agbla ame̱klantei ame̱awo Mizraim, ni ame̱ke̱ gbohĩĩ aawo šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ obõ to̱.

english_verse: I will dry up the Nile River, then sell the land to evil buyers. I will send foreigners to turn your entire nation into a barren desert. I, the Lord, have spoken. Egypt's Proud Cities Will Lie in Ruins The Lord said to the people of Egypt:
translation_verse: Ni mahã efāi le̱ amī̃, ni mahõ šikpoṅ le̱ mawo meifõdši adeṅ, ni matšṍ gbo̱i anine no̱ mafe šikpoṅ le̱ ke̱ emli nii fẽ pasă. Mi, Iehowa, miwie!

english_verse: All the idols and images you Egyptians worship in the city of Memphis will be smashed. No one will be left to rule your nation, and terror will fill the land.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Asaṅ makpãtã wo̱dši le̱ ahĩe, ni mahã amãgãi le̱ atã ye̱ Nof, ni lumo̱ dše̱ṅ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ doṅṅ; ni mahã gbeyei aba Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: The city of Pathros will be left in ruins, and Zoan will be burned to the ground. Thebes, your capital city, will also be destroyed!
translation_verse: Ni mafe Patros hũ pasā ni mawo la ye̱ Zoan, ni makodšo Nō.

english_verse: The fortress city of Pelusium will feel my fierce anger, and all the troops stationed at Thebes will be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Ni mafo̱se mimlila le̱ maſie Sin, ní dši Mizraim mō̃ ní wa le̱ no̱, ni mafo Nõ asafo yū le̱ maše̱ mafo.

english_verse: I will set fire to your nation of Egypt! The city of Pelusium will be in anguish. Thebes will fall, and the people of Memphis will live in constant fear.
translation_verse: Ni mawo la ye̱ Mizraim, ni Sin aakẽmo̱, ni aagbu Nō awo mli, ni Nof aaná haolo̱i ſane fintĩṅṅ.

english_verse: The young soldiers in the cities of Heliopolis and Bubastis will die in battle, and the rest of the people will be taken prisoner.
translation_verse: Awen ke̱ Pi-Be̱se̱t oblahĩĩ le̱ aanyõnyõi ye̱ klante nā, ni ame̱mli bii le̱ aate nomṅō̃ mli.

english_verse: You were so proud of your nation's power, but when I crush that power and kill that pride, darkness will fall over the city of Tahpanhes. A dark, gloomy cloud will cover the land as you are being led away into captivity.
translation_verse: Duṅ aawo ſane ye̱ Tehafnehes, beni makũmo̱ Mizraim kõṅtšei le̱ amli ye̱ dše̱i, ni ehe wale hewo le̱ se̱ aafo ye̱ emli le̱; le̱dientše̱ le̱, atatu aaha eno̱, ni ebiyei le̱ hũ aate nomṅō̃ mli.

english_verse: When I'm through punishing Egypt, you will know that I am the Lord. Egypt's King Is Powerless
translation_verse: Ni makodšo Mizraim, ni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I, the Lord, have defeated the king of Egypt! I broke his arm, and no one has wrapped it or put it in a sling, so that it could heal and get strong enough to hold a sword.
translation_verse: Gbomobi, mikũ Farao, Mizraim maṅtše̱ le̱, nine, ni na, afĩṅ ní ake̱ tšo-fã aato he, lo ní ake̱ flafī̃mama aafĩ no̱ ní emli awa, bo̱ni eenyẽ klante mli emõ.

english_verse: So tell him that I am now his worst enemy. I will break both his arms—the good one and the broken one! His sword will drop from his hand forever,
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ boni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Na, mike̱ Farao, Mizraim maṅtše̱ le̱, ená ni makũmo̱ enidši le̱, noni mli wa le̱ ke̱ noni akũ le̱ fẽ, ni mahã klante le̱ adše edẽ anyõ ši.

english_verse: and I will scatter the Egyptians all over the world.
translation_verse: Ni matšire̱ Mizraimbii ayise̱ ke̱-ate dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ, ni magbeame̱ maſã šĩkpõdšĩ le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: I will strengthen the power of Babylonia's king and give him my sword to use against Egypt. I will also make the wounded king of Egypt powerless, and he will moan in pain and die in front of the Babylonian king. Then everyone on earth will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ši mawadše Babel maṅtše̱ le̱ nidšiaṅ, ni Farao nidši aakplo̱ aſie ši, ni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱, beni mike̱ miklante le̱ aawo Babel maṅtše̱ le̱ deṅ, ni eewó ne̱ ye̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱.

english_verse: I will force the Egyptians to live as prisoners in foreign nations, and they will know that I, the Lord, have punished them.
translation_verse: Ni matšire̱ Mizraimbii ayise̱ ke̱-ate dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ, ni magbe̱ame̱ maſã šikpõdši le̱ ano̱, ni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ midsi Iehowa le̱.

english_verse: Eleven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the first day of the third month. He said:
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱ afi ní dši nyoṅma ke̱ ekome le̱ ne̱ nyõṅ ní dši etẽ le̱ no̱ kleṅkleṅ gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ Iehowa wiemo̱ ba miṅõ ake̱:

english_verse: There was once a cedar tree in Lebanon with large, strong branches reaching to the sky.
translation_verse: Na, Ašur le̱, Lebanon no̱ tšenedru ni ke̱ enidši fe̱fe̱dši kusukusū ní hãa hō̃ṅ, ni ekwo̱ groṅṅ, ni eyiteṅ ye̱ atatuiaṅ. Dan.

english_verse: This tree had plenty of water to help it grow tall, and nearby streams watered the other trees in the forest.
translation_verse: Nui le̱ lè̱le̱, bu kwo̱ṅkwo̱ṅ le̱ hã eda; efāi le̱ ho ke̱-bo̱le eṅmõ le̱, ni egbla enudšō̱i le̱ ke̱-te ṅãno̱ tšei le̱ fẽ he.

english_verse: But this tree towered over those other trees, and its branches grew long and thick.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ ekwo̱ fè ṅãno̱ tšei le̱ fẽ, ni enidši wudši le̱ fá babaō, ni enidši bibii ní egblá le̱ kĕ̱le̱ kakadãdši ye̱ nu le̱ fále̱ so̱ṅṅ nā.

english_verse: Birds built nests in its branches, and animals were born beneath it. People from all nations lived in the shade of this strong tree.
translation_verse: Ṅwei lofõdši fẽ fe ame̱tšũi ye̱ enidši wudši le̱ amli, ni ṅãṅ koloi fẽ yafo̱ ame̱bii ye̱ enidši bibii le̱ ašiši, ni dšeṅmãdši wudši le̱ fẽ yahĩ ešiši hō̃ṅ le̱ mli.

english_verse: It had beautiful, long branches, and its roots found water deep in the soil.
translation_verse: Ni ehe fe fe̱o ye̱ edale̱ le̱ mli, ye̱ enidši bibii le̱ akĕ̱le̱mo̱ le̱ mli, edšake̱ ešišifãi le̱ ye̱ nui wudši ahe.

english_verse: None of the cedar trees in my garden of Eden were as beautiful as this tree; no tree of any kind had such long branches.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱ trom le̱ mli tšenedrui le̱ nyẽẽ eno̱ aye, se̱se̱oi le̱ hũ ke̱ enidši wudši le̱ yee egbo̱, ni papaoi ke̱ enidši bibii le̱ yee egbo̱, ni asaṅ tšo ko tšo ko be̱ Nyoṅmo̱ trom le̱ṅ ní ke̱le̱ ye egbo̱ ke̱ hefe̱o,

english_verse: I, the Lord, gave this tree its beauty, and I helped the branches grow strong. All other trees in Eden wanted to be just like it.
translation_verse: Mifele̱ fe̱fe̱o ye̱ enidši bibii le̱ afále̱ nā, āhũ ní Eden tšei fẽ ní yo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ trom le̱ṅ le̱ ahĩe kõ eno̱.

english_verse: So I, the Lord God, will reject the tree and hand it over to a foreign ruler, who will punish it for its wickedness.
translation_verse: hewo̱ le̱, matule̱ mawo dšeṅmãdši le̱ amli hewalo̱ le̱ deṅ, eke̱le̱ baye; enifõdšĩanii le̱ ahewo̱ miſiele̱.

english_verse: Cruel foreigners will chop it down and leave it wherever it falls. Branches and broken limbs will be scattered over the mountains and in the valleys. The people living in the shade of those branches will go somewhere else.
translation_verse: Ni gbo̱i ní dši dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ yiwalo̱i le̱ etōle̱ efõ ši, ni enidši bibii le̱ eſie gõdši le̱ ano̱ ke̱ dšō̱i le̱ fẽ mli, ni enidši wudši le̱ ekũmo̱ eſie šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ bui fë mli, ni šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ mãdši-mãdši le̱ fẽ edše ehõ le̱ṅ ete, ni ame̱šĩle̱.

english_verse: Birds will then nest on the stump of the fallen tree, and wild animals will trample its branches.
translation_verse: Ekuku ní egbē ši le̱ no̱ ṅwei lofõdši le̱ fẽ sõmoo̱, ni enidši bibii le̱ ano̱ ṅãno̱ koloi fẽ bumoo̱,

english_verse: On the day this tree dies and goes to the world below, I, the Lord God, will command rivers and streams to mourn its death. Every underground spring of water and every river will stop flowing. The mountains in Lebanon will be covered with darkness as a sign of their sorrow, and all the trees in the forest will wither.
translation_verse: Boni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Gbĩ ní ekpleke ši ke̱-te gbohĩĩadše le̱, mihã bu kwo̱ṅkwo̱ṅ le̱ wo yăra ye̱ ehewo̱, ni mitšĩ efāi le̱ anā, ni asa nui babaō le̱ ayi, ni mihã Lebanon wo nidiṅ ye̱ ehewo̱, ni ṅãno̱ tšei le̱ fẽ to̱ biti ye̱ ehewo̱.

english_verse: This tree will crash to the ground, and I will send it to the world below. Then the nations of the earth will tremble. The trees from Eden and the choice trees from Lebanon are now in the world of the dead, and they will be comforted when this tree falls.
translation_verse: Mihã dšeṅmãdši le̱ hoso ye̱ ešigbēmo̱ le̱ gbē̱mo̱ nā, beni mitšile̱ miwo gbohĩĩadše mifata mei ní kplekeo̱ ši ke̱-yaä bu le̱ mli le̱ ahe le̱; ni Eden tšei le̱ fẽ, Lebanon nii ní ahala ní hĩ fè fẽ le̱, nu nulo̱i le̱ fẽ amī še̱ amehe ye̱ šikpoṅ šiši. K.

english_verse: Those people who found protection in its shade will also be sent to the world below, where they will join the dead.
translation_verse: Ame̱ hũ ame̱ke̱le̱ kpleke ši ke̱-te gbohĩĩadše, ke̱-te mei ní enyõnyõi ye̱ klante nā le̱ aṅõ, mei ní dši enine ní hĩo̱ ešišihō̃ le̱ṅ ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ le̱.

english_verse: King of Egypt, all these things will happen to you and your people! You were like this tree at one time—taller and stronger than anyone on earth. But now you will be chopped down, just as every tree in the garden of Eden must die. You will be sent down to the world of the dead, where you will join the godless and the other victims of violent death. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Bĕle̱ namo po otamo̱ ye̱ anumnyam ke̱ dale̱ nā, ye̱ Eden tšei le̱ ateṅ? Ši atšio ke̱ Eden tšei le̱ awo šikpoṅ šiši tõ; ookã fõlo̱i ateṅ, oke̱ mei ní enyõnyõi ye̱ klante nā le̱: Farao ke̱ esafo yū le̱ fẽ ne̱! Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱,

english_verse: Twelve years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the first day of the twelfth month. He said:
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱ afi ní dši nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱ le̱ no̱ nyõṅ ní dši nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱ le̱ no̱, nyõṅ le̱ no̱ kleṅkleṅ gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ Iehowa wiemo̱ ba miṅõ ake̱:

english_verse: King of Egypt, listen to me. I, the Lord God, will catch you in my net and let a crowd of foreigners drag you to shore.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Maṅõ miyā le̱ malē̱ ono̱ ye̱ mãdšimãdši babaō asafo mlì, ni ame̱ke̱ mitšā̃ni le̱ aagblao ke̱-aba,

english_verse: I will throw you into an open field, where birds and animals will come to feed on your flesh.
translation_verse: ni maše̱o mafõ šikpoṅ, ni matšio maſie ṅã kpatā le̱ no̱, ni mahã ṅwei lofõdši fè abasõmo̱ ono̱, ni mahã šikpoṅ mū le̱ fẽ no̱ koloi ayeo atŏ̱ro̱.

english_verse: I will spread your rotting flesh over the mountains and in the valleys,
translation_verse: Ni mike̱ ohelo le̱ aafõ gõdši le̱ ano̱, ni mike̱ ogbohĩĩ le̱ aawo dšō̱i le̱ obõbõ.

english_verse: I will cover the whole sky and every star with thick clouds, so that the sun and moon will stop shining.
translation_verse: Ni ké̱ migbeo tamo̱ agbeo kane le̱, *maha ṅwei hĩe, ni mahã ame̱ṅulamii le̱ awo duṅ; mike̱ oblo̱tu aaha hũlũ hĩe, ni nyoṅtšĕre hũ kpe̱ṅ. *Ies.

english_verse: The heavens will become black, leaving your country in total darkness. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mahã ṅwei lai ní kple̱o̱ le̱ fẽ awo duṅ ye̱ ono̱, ni mahã duṅ awo ye̱ ošikpoṅ le̱ no̱, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: I will slaughter your cattle that graze by the river, and no people or livestock will be left to muddy its water.
translation_verse: Ni maplenē emli šīa koloi fẽ ke̱-adše̱ nui babaō le̱ ahe, ni gbomo nane ko etaṅ mli doṅṅ, ni asaṅ šĩa koloi akoklotoi hũ etaṅ mli.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, mourn for the Egyptians and condemn them to the world of the dead, where they will be buried alongside the people of other powerful nations.
translation_verse: Gbomobi, fó ohã Mizraim asafo yū le̱, ni otšire̱ame̱ ke̱ dšeṅmãdši ní hĩe yo̱ nyam le̱ abiyei le̱ otſia ši ke̱-ya šikpoṅ le̱ šiši tō̃ ofata *mei ní kplekeo̱ ši ke̱-yaä bu le̱ṅ le̱ ahe. *

english_verse: You cannot escape! The enemy's sword is ready to slaughter every one of you.
translation_verse: Ame̱anyõnyõi ye̱ mei ní ake̱ klante aagbegbēame̱ le̱ ateṅ; aṅõle̱ ahã *klante: nyegblaäle̱ ke̱ esafo yū le̱ fẽ ke̱-yaä! *

english_verse: The graves of soldiers from Meshech and Tubal are there. These godless soldiers who terrified people were all killed in battle.
translation_verse: *Mešek, Tubal ke̱ esafo yū le̱ fẽ ye̱ dše̱i, egbohĩĩabui le̱ bo̱lele̱ ke̱-kpe: ame̱fẽ le̱, fōlo̱i dšiame̱, ni agbegbēame̱ ye̱ klante nā; edšake̱ ame̱hã ame̱he ṅmiṅmi mõmo̱ mei ye̱ hĩekãlo̱i ašikpoṅ le̱ no̱. *

english_verse: They were not given a proper burial like the heroes of long ago, who were buried with their swords under their heads and with their shields over their bodies. These were the heroes who made their enemies panic.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱kãmo̱ṅ ekãlo̱i ní enyõnyõi ye̱ fōlo̱i le̱ ateṅ le̱ amase̱i, mei ní ekpleke ši ke̱-te gbohĩĩadše ke̱ ame̱tawūnii le̱, ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱klantei le̱ eho̱lo̱ ame̱yitšei ašiši, ni ame̱nišaianii le̱ eba ame̱-wui ano̱; edšake̱ ekãlo̱i le̱ ahe ṅmiṅmi mõmo̱ mei ye̱ hĩekãlo̱i ašikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: The graves of kings and leaders from Edom are there. They were powerful at one time. Now they are buried in the world of the dead with other godless soldiers killed in battle.
translation_verse: *Edom ke̱ emaṅtše̱mei ke̱ elumei le̱ fẽ ye̱ dše̱i, ni aṅõame̱ ye̱ ame̱hewale̱ le̱ mli ato mei ní agbegbēame̱ ye̱ klante nā le̱ amase̱i; ame̱ hũ ame̱ke̱ fōlo̱i ke̱ mei ní ekpleke ši ke̱-te bu le̱ṅ le̱ kã-mo̱ ši. *

english_verse: The graves of the rulers of the north are there, as well as those of the Sidonians. Their powerful armies once terrified enemies. Now they lie buried in the world of the dead, where they are disgraced like other soldiers killed in battle.
translation_verse: *Kōyigbe̱ lume̱i le̱ fẽ-tſẽm ye̱ dše̱i, ke̱ †Zidonbii le̱ fẽ ní ke̱ mei ní agbeame̱ le̱ kpleke ši ke̱-te ke̱ ame̱he ṅmiṅmi le̱, ame̱hĩe gboi ye̱ ame̱hewale̱ le̱ hewo̱, ni ame̱ ke̱ mei ní ake̱ klante egbegbēame̱ le̱ kāmo̱ ši ní ame̱flo̱ko ketia, ni ame̱ ke̱ mei ní kplekeo̱ ši ke̱-yaä bu le̱ mli le̱ tĕre ame̱hĩegbĕle le̱. *

english_verse: The Lord God says: When your king of Egypt sees all of these graves, he and his soldiers will be glad they are not the only ones suffering.
translation_verse: Farao aanaame̱, ni *emī aaše̱ ehe ye̱ esafo yū le̱ fẽ hewo̱; Farao ke̱ eta le̱ fẽ dši mei ní agbegbēame̱ ye̱ klante nā le̱, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱. *Ies.

english_verse: I sent him to terrify people all over the earth. But he and his army will be killed and buried alongside other godless soldiers in the world of the dead. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mike̱ ehe ṅmiṅmi eba hĩekãlo̱i ašikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni ake̱ Farao ke̱ esafo yū le̱ fẽ eṅmẽ fōlo̱i ke̱ mei ní agbegbēame̱ ye̱ klante nā le̱ ateṅ, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: Their past sins will be forgiven, and they will live because they have done right.
translation_verse: Ehe ešai ní efe le̱ fẽ akaiṅ eko eko ahãṅle̱: eye dšale̱ sane ni efe noni dša, eyi aaná wala kẽ!

english_verse: Twelve years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, a refugee who had escaped from Jerusalem came to me on the fifth day of the tenth month. He told me that the city had fallen.
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱ wo̱nomṅō̃ afi ní dši nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱ le̱ no̱ nyõṅ ní dši nyoṅma le̱ no̱, ye̱ nyõṅ le̱ no̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ enumo̱ le̱ no̱ le̱, *moko ní edše mli dše̱ Ierusalem ba miṅõ bakē̱ ake̱: Atſia maṅ le̱ nii! *

english_verse: But suppose the person watching fails to sound the warning signal. The enemy will attack and kill some of the sinful people in that country, and I, the Lord, will hold that person responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši bulo̱ le̱ na klante le̱ mība, ni ekpãã te̱tre̱mantre̱ le̱, ni etſaa maṅ le̱ adafi, ni klante le̱ ba ni ebaṅõ ame̱teṅ moko ke̱-te le̱: le̱ le̱, aṅõle̱ ke̱-te ye̱ enišaianii le̱ ahewo̱ moṅ, ši mabi elá ši ye̱ bulo̱ le̱ deṅ.

english_verse: If you do warn them, and they keep sinning, they will die because of their sins, and you will be innocent. The Lord Is Always Fair (Ezekiel
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši obo̱ efõṅfelo̱ le̱ ko̱ko̱ ní ekpale ke̱-dše̱ egbe̱ le̱ no̱, ni kẽle̱ ekpalee ke̱-dše̱e̱ egbe̱ le̱ no̱ le̱: le̱ le̱, eegbo ye̱ enišaianii le̱ ahewo̱, ši bo le̱ ohere osusuma yiwala.

english_verse: If good people start doing evil, they will be put to death, because they have sinned.
translation_verse: Ké̱ dšalo̱ kpale ke̱-dše̱ edšale̱ le̱ mli ni efe nišaianii le̱, nomei ahewo̱ noṅṅ eegbo ye̱.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people with you in Babylonia talk about you when they meet by the city walls or in the doorways of their houses. They say, “Let's ask Ezekiel what the Lord has said today.”
translation_verse: Ni bo, gbomobi, omaṅbii le̱ wieo̱ ohe ye̱ gbogboi ahe ke̱ šĩai ašĩnāi aši, ni moko ke̱ moko wieo̱, ni mo ke̱ enyemi hũ wieo̱ ake̱: Nyebaä ní nyebaboa nõ wiemo̱ ní dše̱ Iehowa ṅõ toi!

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, the people of Israel are complaining that the punishment for their sins is more than they can stand. They have lost all hope for survival, and they blame me.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo, gbomobi, kē̱mo̱ Israel we le̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni nyekē̱o̱ ne̱: Wo̱no̱tõmo̱i le̱ ke̱ wohe ešai le̱ bua wo̱no̱, ni wo̱mītărã lō ye̱ hewo̱: té aafe tẽṅ mo̱ ní woyi aaná walaṅ?

english_verse: Tell them that as surely as I am the living Lord God, I don't like to see wicked people die. I enjoy seeing them turn from their sins and live. So if the Israelites want to live, they must stop sinning and turn back to me.
translation_verse: Kē̱mo̱ame̱ ake̱: Gbĩĩabo̱ ní mihĩe kã ne̱, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱: *mináá efõṅfelo̱ gbĕle he mīše̱, ši moṅ ake̱ efõṅfelo̱ akpale ke̱-dše̱ egbe̱ le̱ no̱, ni eyi aná wala! †Nyekpalea, nyekpalea ke̱-dše̱a nyegbè̱i fõdši le̱ ano̱! Ši mẽba ni nyeagboi, Israel we? *

english_verse: Tell them that when good people start sinning, all the good they did in the past cannot save them from being punished. And remind them that when wicked people stop sinning, their past sins will be completely forgiven, and they won't be punished.
translation_verse: Ši asaṅ bo, gbomobi, kē̱mo̱ omaṅbii le̱ ake̱: *Dšalo̱ le̱, edšale̱ le̱ edšieṅle̱ gbĩ ní eetõ le̱; ni efõṅfelo̱ hũ, enõfõṅfemo̱ le̱ hãṅ egbē ši gbĩ ní eekpale ke̱-adše̱ enõfõṅfemo̱ le̱ mli le̱; ni dšalo̱ hũ nyẽṅ eke̱-here eyiwala gbĩ ní eefe eša le̱. *

english_verse: Suppose I promise good people that they will live, then later they start sinning and believe they will be saved by the good they did in the past. These people will certainly be put to death because of their sins. Their good deeds will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Ké̱ mikē̱ dšalo̱ ake̱ eyi aaná wala, ni eṅõ ehĩe efõ edšale̱ le̱ no̱ ni efe nišaianii le̱: edšale̱nii fẽ ní efe le̱, akaiṅ eko eko, ši enišaianii ní efe le̱, nomei noṅṅ ahewo̱ eegbo ye̱!

english_verse: Suppose I warn wicked people that they will die because of their sins, and they stop sinning and start doing right.
translation_verse: Ši asaṅ ké̱ mikē̱ efõṅfelo̱ ake̱: Gbo oogbo! ni ekpale ke̱-dše̱ ehe eša le̱ mli ni eye dšale̱ sane ni efe noni dša:

english_verse: Ezekiel, your people accuse me of being unfair. But they are the ones who are unfair.
translation_verse: Kẽle̱ omaṅbii le̱ kē̱o̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ gbe̱ le̱ yee egbo̱! tše̱ ame̱ moṅ ame̱gbe̱ le̱ yee egbo̱!

english_verse: And if wicked people stop sinning and start doing right, they will save themselves from punishment.
translation_verse: Ni ké̱ efõṅfele̱ kpale ke̱-dše̱ enõfõṅfemo̱ le̱ mli ni eye dšale̱ sane ni efe noni dša le̱, nomei ahewo̱ noṅṅ eyi aaná wala ye̱.

english_verse: But the Israelites still think I am unfair. So warn them that they will be punished for what they have done. The News of Jerusalem's Fall
translation_verse: Ni kẽle̱ nyekē̱o̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ gbe̱ le̱ yee egbo! Boni mofẽmo gbè̱i yo̱ hãa le̱, nakai makodšonye, Israel we!

english_verse: Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iehowa wiemo̱ ba miṅõ ake̱:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people living in the ruined cities of Israel are saying, “Abraham was just one man, and the Lord gave him this whole land of Israel. There are many of us, and so this land must be ours.”
translation_verse: Gbomobi, Israel šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ amaṅfõi le̱ amli bii le̱ kē̱e̱ ake̱: Abraham, le̱ *ekometō ni, beni aṅõ šikpoṅ le̱ ahãle̱ le̱; ši wo̱ le̱ woyi fá: ake̱ šikpoṅ le̱ ehãwo̱ ake̱ wo̱ṅõ wo̱ye! *Ies.

english_verse: So, Ezekiel, tell them I am saying: How can you think the land is still yours? You eat meat with blood in it and worship idols. You commit murder
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ kē̱mo̱ame̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Nyeyee̱ nii ke̱ lá, ni nyeholeo̱ nyehĩṅme̱ii ano̱ nyekwe̱o̱ nyewo̱dši le̱, ni nyeſieo̱ lá ši: aso šikpoṅ le̱ aatšṍ nyenõ kẽ?

english_verse: and spread violence throughout the land. Everything you do is wicked; you are even unfaithful in marriage. And you claim the land is yours!
translation_verse: Nyedamoo̱ nyeklantei le̱ ano̱, nyetšuo̱ nihĩnii, ni nyeteṅ mofẽmo buleo̱ enanyo ṅã: aso šikpoṅ le̱ aatšṍ nyenõ kẽ?

english_verse: As surely as I am the living Lord God, you people in the ruined cities will be killed in battle. Those of you living in the countryside will be eaten by wild animals, and those hiding in caves and on rocky cliffs will die from deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Kē̱mo̱ame̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Gbĩĩabo̱ ní mihĩe kã ne̱: le̱le̱ṅ ake̱ mei ní yo̱ amaṅfõi le̱ amli le̱, ame̱anyõnyõi ye̱ klante nā; ni mei ni yo̱ ṅã le̱ no̱ le̱ hũ, maṅõame̱ mahã ṅãṅ koloi ní ame̱yeame̱; ni mei ní yo̱ mõdši ke̱ te̱kpodši le̱ amli le̱, gbĕle-hela aagbeame̱.

english_verse: I will make the whole country an empty wasteland and crush the power in which you take such pride. Even the mountains will be bare, and no one will try to cross them.
translation_verse: Ni mafe šikpoṅ le̱ amaṅfõ ke̱ hedšõmo̱nõ, ni ehewale̱ hewō le̱ se̱ aafo, ni Israel gõdši le̱ aatšṍmo̱ amaṅfõ, ni mokomoko tšṍṅ no̱ ke̱-hoṅ doṅṅ.

english_verse: I will punish you because of your sins, and I will turn your nation into a barren desert. Then you will know that I am the Lord. The People Listen, but Don't Change The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱, beni mafe šikpoṅ le̱ amaṅfõ ke̱ hedšõmo̱nõ ye̱ ame̱nihĩnii fẽ ní ame̱fe le̱ hewo̱ le̱.

english_verse: So they all come and listen to you, but they refuse to do what you tell them. They claim to be faithful, but they are forever trying to cheat others out of their money.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱baã oṅõ tamo̱ maṅ baã, ni ame̱batráa ši ye̱ ohĩe tamo̱ mimaṅ, ni ame̱boo̱ owiemo̱i le̱ atoi, ši *ame̱yee no̱; edšake̱ ame̱ke̱ ame̱nābu wieo̱ do̱ko̱bī, ši ame̱tšui nyieo̱ ame̱se̱námo̱ se̱. *Ies.

english_verse: They treat you as though you were merely singing love songs or playing music. They listen, but don't do anything you say.
translation_verse: Ni na, bo le̱ otamo̱ lala ke̱ ṅõmo̱ ke̱ moko ní gbē ṅõ ni ele saṅkũtſā dšogbāṅ ohãame̱; edšake̱ ame̱boo̱ owiemo̱i lo̱ atoi moṅ, ši ame̱yee no̱.

english_verse: Soon they will be punished, just as you warned, and they will know that a prophet has been among them.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ eba mli le̱, — na, ebaba! — no dãni ame̱aná ame̱le *ake̱ gbalo̱ ehĩ ame̱teṅ pẽṅ. *

english_verse: So my sheep were scattered across the earth. They roamed on hills and mountains, without anyone even bothering to look for them.
translation_verse: Mitōi le̱ tšomloo̱ ke̱nyieo̱ gõdši fẽ no̱ ke̱ goṅkpo̱-fẽ-goṅkpo̱ ní kwo̱ no̱, ni mitōi le̱ egbe̱ eſã šikpoṅ le̱ hĩe fẽ, ni moko be̱ ní dio̱ ame̱se̱ lo etaoo̱ame̱.

english_verse: Now listen to what I, the living Lord God, am saying to you shepherds. My sheep have been attacked and eaten by wild animals, because you refused to watch them. You never went looking for the lost ones, and you fed yourselves without feeding my sheep.
translation_verse: Gbĩĩabo̱ ní mihĩe kã ne̱, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱: Ake̱-ní mitōi le̱ etšṍmo̱ hānii, ni mitōi le̱ etšṍmo̱ ṅãṅ koloi fẽ aniyenii, edšake̱ tōkwe̱lo̱ ko be̱, ni mitōkwe̱lo̱i le̱ edii mitōi le̱ ase̱, ši moṅ tōkwe̱lo̱i le̱, *ame̱dientše̱ ame̱he ke̱ke̱ ame̱lè̱o̱, ni ame̱lèè mitōi le̱: *K.

english_verse: and bring them back from the foreign nations where they now live. I will be their shepherd and will let them graze on Israel's mountains and in the valleys and fertile fields.
translation_verse: Ni makplaame̱ ke̱-adše̱ mãdšimãdši le̱ amli, ni mabua ame̱nā ke̱-adše̱ šikpõdši le̱ ano̱, ni mahã ame̱ba ame̱dientše̱ ame̱šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni malè̱ame̱ ye̱ Israel gõdši le̱ ano̱, ye̱ dšō̱i le̱ amli ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ šihĩle̱hei le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: I promise to take care of them and keep them safe,
translation_verse: Midientše̱ malè̱ mitōi le̱, ni mahã ame̱bumo̱ ši, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: to look for those that are lost and bring back the ones that wander off, to bandage those that are hurt and protect the ones that are weak. I will also slaughter those that are fat and strong, because I always do right. Judgment on the Strong Sheep
translation_verse: Noni elādše le̱, matao; ni noni edũ gbe̱ le̱, mayakplale̱; ni noni epila le̱, mafĩ mahãle̱; belatše̱ le̱, mawadšele̱; ši noni ewo fo̱ ke̱ noni yo̱ hewale̱ le̱, makpãtã ame̱hĩe; malè̱ame̱ bo̱ni dša!

english_verse: The Lord God said to his sheep, the people of Israel: I will carefully watch each one of you to decide which ones are the strong sheep and which ones are weak.
translation_verse: Ni nye, mitōi, bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Na, *makodšo tõ ke̱ tõ teṅ, tōagboi ke̱ tōkpakpoi ateṅ! *Mat.

english_verse: That means my other sheep have nothing fit to eat or drink.
translation_verse: Ni mitōi le̱, ame̱ le̱ ame̱yeo̱ noni nyeke̱ nyenãdši enānā no̱ le̱, ni ame̱nuo̱ noni nyeke̱ nyenãdši ekpo̱to̱ le̱!

english_verse: You strong ones have used your powerful horns to chase off those that are weak,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nyeke̱ nyeṅmãwuiaṅ ke̱ nyekõṅ šimoo̱, ni nyeke̱ nyekodši hĕ̱le̱o̱ helatše̱mei le̱ fẽ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní nyeſieo̱-ame̱ ke̱-dšeo̱ kpo.

english_verse: but I will rescue them and no longer let them be mistreated. I will separate the good from the bad.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ mahere mitōi le̱ ayiwala, ni ame̱tšṍmo̱ṅ hānii doṅṅ, ni makodšo tō ke̱ tō teṅ.

english_verse: After that, I will give you a shepherd from the family of my servant King David. All of you, both strong and weak, will have the same shepherd, and he will take good care of you.
translation_verse: Ni maṅõ *tōkwe̱lo̱ kome mato ame̱no̱, ni eelè̱ame̱, le̱ dši †mitšũlo̱ David; le̱ eelè̱ame̱, ni le̱ eetšṍ tōkwelo ehãame. *

english_verse: He will be your leader, and I will be your God. I, the Lord, have spoken. A Bright Future for the Lord's Sheep The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Ni mi, Iehowa, matšṍ ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱, ni mitšũlo̱ David aafe lumo̱ ye̱ ame̱teṅ; mi, Iehowa, miwie!

english_verse: The people of Israel are my sheep, and I solemnly promise that they will live in peace. I will chase away every wild animal from the desert and the forest, so my sheep will not be afraid.
translation_verse: Ni mike̱ame̱ aakpãṅ *hedšo̱le̱ kpãṅmo̱, ni mahã koloi fõdši atã ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni ame̱ahĩ ši ſeſēſe ye̱ ṅã le̱ no̱, ni ame̱awo̱wo̱i ye̱ kōi le̱ amli. *

english_verse: They will live around my holy mountain, and I will bless them by sending more than enough rain
translation_verse: Ni mahã ame̱ ke̱ hei ní bo̱le migoṅkpo̱ le̱ he le̱ atšṍ dšō̱mo̱, ni mahã nyoṅmo̱ ane̱ ye̱ be ní sa mli; eetšṍ dšō̱mo̱ nyoṅmo̱ne̱mo̱!

english_verse: to make their trees produce fruit and their crops to grow. I will set them free from slavery and let them live safely in their own land. Then they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni ṅãno̱ tšo aawo eyibii, ni šikpoṅ le̱ aaba enii, ni ame̱ahĩ ši ſeſēſe ye̱ ame̱šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱, beni mikũmo̱ ame̱kõṅtšei le̱, ni midšieame̱ ke̱-dše̱ mei ní yeo̱ame̱ nyṍṅ le̱ adeṅ le̱.

english_verse: Foreign nations will never again rob them, and wild animals will no longer kill and eat them. They will have nothing to fear.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱tšṍmo̱ṅ hānii ame̱hãṅ wo̱ṅdšálo̱i le̱ doṅṅ, ni šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ koloi le̱ yeṅame̱ doṅṅ, ni ame̱ahĩ ši ſeſēſe, ni mokomoko woṅ ame̱he gbeyei.

english_verse: I will make their fields produce large amounts of crops, so they will never again go hungry or be laughed at by foreigners.
translation_verse: Ni matē ṅmõ ní gbe̱i ehehe ši mahãame̱, ni hõmo̱ plenēṅame̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ doṅṅ, ni ame̱tĕreṅ wo̱ṅdšálo̱i aheguo̱gbē le̱ doṅṅ.

english_verse: Then everyone will know that I protect my people Israel. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ mi, Iehowa, *ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, mike̱ame̱ ye̱, ni ame̱, Israel we le̱, ame̱dši mimaṅ, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱. *

english_verse: They are my sheep; I am their God, and I take care of them.
translation_verse: Ni nye, mitōi ní dši *milẽ̱̀he tōi le̱, gbomei dšinye, ni midši nye-Nyoṅmo̱! Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱. *Lal.

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa wiemo̱ ba miṅõ ake̱:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the people of Edom
translation_verse: Gbomobi, tšṍ ohĩe ohã Seir *goṅ le̱, ni ogba ošíle̱, *

english_verse: leaving your towns in ruins. Your land will be a desert, and then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mahã omãdši le̱ adſere ši eflo, ni bodientše̱ hũ ootšṍ amaṅfõ, ni ooná ole ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱!

english_verse: and your land will lie in ruins forever. No one will live in your towns ever again. You will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mafeo nāno̱ amaṅfõi, ni moko ehĩṅ omãdši le̱ amli, ni nyeaná nyele ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱.

english_verse: You thought the nations of Judah and Israel belonged to you, and that you could take over their territory. But I am their God,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ okē̱ ake̱: Ne̱ke̱ dšeṅmãdši enyo̱ ne̱ ke̱ ne̱ke̱ šikpõdši enyo̱ ne̱ aatšṍmo̱ minii ni wo̱o̱ṅõame̱ wo̱ye! tše̱bele̱ Iehowa ye̱ dše̱i:

english_verse: and as surely as I live, I will punish you for treating my people with anger and hatred. Then they will know that I, the Lord, am punishing you!
translation_verse: nohewo̱ le̱ gbĩĩabo̱ ní mihĩe kã ne̱, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱, mi hũ mafeo ye̱ omlifũ ke̱ owuṅã ní oye ye̱ onyē̱ ní onye̱ame̱ le̱ mli le̱ nā, ni mahã alemi ye̱ ame̱teṅ, bo̱ni makodšoö le̱.

english_verse: And you will finally realize that I heard you laugh at their destruction and say their land was yours to take.
translation_verse: Ni ooná ole ake̱ mi, Iehowa, mina omusubō̱ wiemoi le̱ fẽ ní owie oši Israel gõdši le̱ ake̱: Afeame̱ amaṅfõi; ake̱ame̱ ehãwo̱ ní we̱yeame̱! le̱.

english_verse: You even insulted me, but I heard it all.
translation_verse: Ni nyeke̱ nyenābu wó nyehe no̱ nyešimi, ni nyehã nyewiemo̱i ní nyewie nyešimi le̱ fá; midientše̱ minu!

english_verse: Everyone on earth will celebrate when I destroy you,
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Mafeo amaṅfõ, koni šikpoṅ mū le̱ fẽ anyã́!

english_verse: just as you celebrated when Israel was destroyed. Your nation of Edom will be nothing but a wasteland. Then everyone will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni *onyã́ ye̱ Israel we le̱ gbošinii le̱ hewo̱, ake̱ etšṍ amaṅfõ le̱, nakai noṅṅ mafeo: amaṅfõ noṅṅ Seir goṅ le̱ aatšṍ ke̱ Edom fẽ-tſẽm hũ, ni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱! *

english_verse: So all you mountains and hills, streams and valleys, listen to what I will do. Your towns may now lie in ruins, and nations may laugh and insult you.
translation_verse: hewo̱ le̱, nye Israel gõdši, nyeboa Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa wiemo̱ toi! Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱o̱ gõdši ke̱ goṅkpo̱i le̱ ke̱ nudšō̱i ke̱ dšō̱i le̱ ke̱ amaṅfõi ní kãmo̱ efodši ke̱ mãdši ní ašĩ aſie ši ni ame̱tšṍmo̱ hānii ke̱ hefe̱oyeli ame̱hã dšeṅmãdši ní eſe̱ ní bo̱leame̱ ke̱-kpe le̱ ne̱: —

english_verse: Trees will grow on you mountains of Israel and produce fruit for my people, because they will soon come home.
translation_verse: Ši nye, Israel gõdši, nyeagblá nyenidši le̱, ni nyeawo nyeyibii le̱ nyehã mimaṅ Israel; edšake̱ ame̱bā-be eše̱ etã!

english_verse: But I, the Lord, promise that you won't hear other nations laugh and sneer at you ever again. From now on, you will always produce plenty of food for your people. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Lord Will Be Honored
translation_verse: Ni mihãṅ anu wo̱ṅdšálo̱i aheguo̱gbẽ le̱ he ye̱ ono̱ doṅṅ, ni otĕreṅ mãdšimãdši le̱ ahorabō̱ le̱ doṅṅ, ni okpakpāṅ omaṅ le̱ bii ye̱ ame̱he doṅṅ, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: They committed murders and worshiped idols, which made the land even worse. So in my anger, I punished my people
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ mifo̱se mimlila miſie ame̱no̱ ye̱ lá ni ame̱fo̱se ame̱ſie ši ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ ke̱ ame̱wo̱dši ní ame̱ke̱-bulele̱ le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: and to show foreign nations that I am holy. Then they will know that I am the Lord God. I have spoken.
translation_verse: Ni mafe migbe̱i kpeteṅkple le̱ ní abule ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ, ní nyebulele̱ ye̱ ame̱teṅ le̱, kroṅkroṅ, ni *dšeṅmãdši le̱ aaná ale ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱, beni mife mihe kroṅkroṅ ye̱ nyemli ye̱ nyehĩṅme̱iiaṅ le̱. *

english_verse: I will sprinkle you with clean water, and you will be clean and acceptable to me. I will wash away everything that makes you unclean, and I will remove your disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Ni maṅõ *nu ní mli tše maſã nyeno̱ ní nyehe atše, ni matsū nyehe ke̱-adše̱ nyehe mũdši le̱ fẽ ke̱ nyewo̱dši le̱ fẽ mli. *Zak.

english_verse: I will take away your stubborn heart and give you a new heart and a desire to be faithful. You will have only pure thoughts,
translation_verse: Ni maṅõ *tšui he mahãnye, ni maṅõ mumo̱ hẽ hũ mawo nyemli, ni madšie te̱-tšui le̱ ye̱ nyehelo mli, ni maṅõ lō-tšui mahãnye;

english_verse: because I will put my Spirit in you and make you eager to obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: ni maṅõ Mimumo̱ le̱ mawo nyemli, ni mahã nyenyie mikpo̱i le̱ amli, ni nyeato mimlai le̱ ní nyeye no̱.

english_verse: You will once again live in the land I gave your ancestors; you will be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: Ni nyeahĩ šikpoṅ le̱ ní miṅõ-hã nyetše̱mei le̱ no̱, ni *nyeatšṍ mimaṅ, ni mi hũ matšṍ nye-Nyoṅmo̱. *

english_verse: I will protect you from anything that makes you unclean. Your fields will overflow with grain, and no one will starve.
translation_verse: Ni mahere nyeyiwala ke̱-adše̱ nyehe mũdši le̱ fẽ mli, ni matšé̱ ṅmā̃, ni mahã efa, ni mike̱ hõmo̱ eṅmẽṅ nyeno̱.

english_verse: Your trees will be filled with fruit, and crops will grow in your fields, so that you will never again feel ashamed for not having enough food.
translation_verse: Ni maha tšeiayibii ke̱ ṅmõdšiaṅ nibanii afá pī, ni nyenáṅ hõmo̱ he ahorabō̱ ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ doṅṅ. Ioel

english_verse: You will remember your evil ways and hate yourselves for what you've done.
translation_verse: No koni nyeakai nyegbè̱i fõdši le̱ ke̱ nyenifemo̱nii ní ehĩĩ le̱, ni nyedientše̱ nyehe aafenye nyãṅemo̱ ye̱ nyenišaianii ke̱ nyenihĩnii le̱ ahewo̱.

english_verse: People of Israel, I'm not doing these things for your sake. You sinned against me, and you must suffer shame and disgrace for what you have done. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Nyenáa nyelea ake *dšee nyehewo̱ mifeo, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱! Nyehĩe agboia ni nyehĩe aſiea ši ye̱ nyegbè̱i le̱ ahewo̱, Israel we! *K.

english_verse: After I have made you clean, I will let you rebuild your ruined towns and let you live in them.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Gbĩ ni matsŭ nyehe ke̱-adše̱ nyenišaianii le̱ fẽ mli le̱, mahã mei ahĩ mãdši le̱ amli, ni aasa tšũkói le̱.

english_verse: Your land will be plowed again, and nobody will be able to see that it was once barren.
translation_verse: Ni aahũ šikpoṅ ní kã ši eflo le̱, ye̱ ši ni ekã eflo ye̱ mei fẽ ni hoo̱ le̱ ahĩe le̱ nãdšiaṅ.

english_verse: Instead, they will say that it looks as beautiful as the garden of Eden. They won't see towns lying in ruins, but they will see your strong cities filled with people.
translation_verse: Ni aakē̱ ake̱: Šikpoṅ ne̱ ní kã ši eflo le̱, no etšṍ tamo̱ Eden trom ne̱! ni mãdši ní tšṍmo̱ amaṅfõi ní kãmo̱ efodši le̱, nomei ahe atſa gbogboi awo ni ahĩo̱ mli ne̱!

english_verse: Then the nearby nations that survive will know that I am the one who rebuilt the ruined places and replanted the barren fields. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: No dãni dšeṅmãdši ní eſe̱ ní bo̱lenye ke̱-kpe le̱ aaná ale ake̱ mi, Iehowa, misãa tšũkói le̱, ni mite̱oo̱ nii ye̱ heni kã ši eflo le̱. *Mi, Iehowa, miwie ni mafe! *

english_verse: I will once again answer your prayers, and I will let your nation grow until you are like a large flock of sheep.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Ene̱ hũ mahã Israel we le̱ abimi, ní mafe mahãame̱: Mahã ame̱yi afá ke̱ gbomei tamo̱ *tōiku. *Mika

english_verse: The towns that now lie in ruins will be filled with people, just as Jerusalem was once filled with sheep to be offered as sacrifices during a festival. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Tamo̱ tōiku kroṅkroṅ, tamo̱ bo̱ni Ierusalem tōiku le̱ yo̱ ye̱ egbĩĩ dšudši le̱ ano̱ le̱, nakai mãdši kóikói le̱ aayimo̱ obõbõ ke̱ gbomei kuikui, ni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ midsi Iehowa le̱.

english_verse: “I, the Lord God, will put breath in you, and once again you will live.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱o̱ wui ne̱ ne̱: Na, maha *mumo̱ abote nyemli, ni nyeyi aaná wala! *Lal.

english_verse: I will wrap you with muscles and skin and breathe life into you. Then you will know that I am the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ni mike̱ fãi aaſie nyeno̱, ni mahã lō aba nyehe, ni mike̱ hewolo aaha nyehe, ni mike̱ mumo̱ aawo nyemli, ni nyeyi aaná wala, ni nyeaná nyele ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱. Ies.

english_verse: I did what the Lord said, but before I finished speaking, I heard a rattling noise. The bones were coming together!
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni *migba, take̱ bo̱ni afã́mi le̱; ni beni migba le̱, gbē̱mo̱ ko ba, ni na, hetšire̱mo̱ ko ba, ni wui le̱ bakpe, wu bakpe̱te̱ ewu he. *K.

english_verse: I saw muscles and skin cover the bones, but they had no life in them.
translation_verse: Ni mikwe̱, ni na, fãi ba ame̱no̱, ni lō kwẽ ha ame̱he, ni hewolo baha amehe ke̱-to no̱; ši mumo̱ be̱ ame̱mli.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, now say to the wind, “The Lord God commands you to blow from every direction and to breathe life into these dead bodies, so they can live again.”
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Gba otšõ mumo̱ le̱; gba, gbomobi, ni okē̱ mumo̱ le̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Dše̱ kō̱yo̱i edſe̱ le̱ no̱ oba, mumo̱, ni obamũ oſie ne̱ke̱ mei ní agbe ne̱ ano̱, ní ame̱yi aná wala!

english_verse: My Spirit will give you breath, and you will live again. I will bring you home, and you will know that I have kept my promise. I, the Lord, have spoken.” Judah and Israel Together Again
translation_verse: Ni mike̱ Mimumo̱ le̱ aawo nyemli, ni nyeyi aaná wala, ni mike̱nye aato nyedientše̱ nyešikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni nyeaná nyele ake̱ mi, Iehowa, miwie ni mife, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, get a stick and write on it, “The kingdom of Judah.” Then get another stick and write on it, “The kingdom of Israel.”
translation_verse: Ni bo, gbomobi, ko̱ tšo kome ohã ohe, ni oṅmã ye̱ no̱ ake̱: “Iuda ke̱ Israelbii ní fata ehe le̱ anõ;” asaṅ oko̱ tšo kroko hũ ni oṅmã ye̱ no̱ ake̱: “Iosef nõ, Efraim ke̱ Israel we le̱ fẽ ní fata ehe le̱ tšo.”

english_verse: Hold these two sticks end to end, so they look like one stick.
translation_verse: Ni oṅõ eko obo̱ eko he ofeame̱ tšo kome ohã ohe, ni ame̱tšṍ ekome ye̱ odeṅ.

english_verse: tell them that I, the Lord, will join together the stick of Israel and the stick of Judah. I will hold them in my hand, and they will become one.
translation_verse: kē̱mo̱ame̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Na, mibaṅõ Iosef tšo le̱ ní yo̱ Efraim dẽ le̱, ke̱ Israel akutšei le̱ ní fata ehe le̱, ni maṅõame̱ mafata Iuda tšo le̱ he, ni mafeame̱ tšo kome, ni ame̱afe ekome ye̱ mideṅ.

english_verse: Hold these two sticks where they can be seen by everyone
translation_verse: Ni tšei le̱ ní oṅmã nii ye̱ no̱ le̱ ahĩ odẽ ye̱ ame̱hĩe,

english_verse: and then say: I, the Lord God, will gather the people of Israel and bring them home from the foreign nations where they now live.
translation_verse: ni okē̱ame̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Na, *mayaṅõ Israelbii le̱ ke̱-adše̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ heni ame̱te le̱, ni mabua ame̱nā ke̱-adše̱ hefẽhe ke-bakpe, ni mike̱ame̱ aate ame̱dientše̱ ame̱šikpoṅ le̱ no̱; *

english_verse: I will make them into one nation and let them once again live in the land of Israel. Only one king will rule them, and they will never again be divided into two nations.
translation_verse: ni mafeame̱ *dšeṅmaṅ kome ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ye̱ Israel gõdši le̱ ano̱, ni maṅtše̱ kome aaye ame̱fẽ ame̱no̱ maṅtše̱, ni ame̱feṅ dšeṅmãdši enyo̱ doṅṅ, ni asaṅ adšaṅ ame̱mli maṅtše̱yelii enyo̱ hũ kwrā doṅṅ; *Ies.

english_verse: Their king will always come from the family of my servant King David and will care for them like a shepherd. The people of Israel will faithfully obey my laws. They and their descendants will live in the land I gave my servant Jacob, just as their ancestors did.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ahĩ šikpoṅ ní miṅõ-hã mitšũlo̱ Iakob, ní nyetše̱mei le̱ hĩ ne̱ le̱ no̱, ni ame̱ahĩ ne̱, ame̱ ke̱ ame̱bii ke̱ ame̱bii abii ke̱-ate nāno̱; ni mitšũlo̱ David aaye ame̱no̱ lumo̱ ke̱-ate nāno̱.

english_verse: and I will live among my people and be their God.
translation_verse: Ni mišihĩle̱he aahĩ ame̱no̱, ni matšṍ ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱, ni ame̱ hũ ame̱atšṍ mimaṅ.

english_verse: Every nation on earth will know that my temple is in Israel and that I have chosen the Israelites to be my people.
translation_verse: Ni *dšeṅmãdši le̱ aaná ale ake̱ midši Iehowa, moni feo̱ Israel kroṅkroṅ le̱, beni mihekroṅkroṅ le̱ aamã ame̱teṅ ke̱-ate nāno̱ le̱. *

english_verse: When that day comes, I know that you will have an evil plan
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Aaba mli ake̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ sãdši komei aaba otšuiṅ, ni osā oodſẽṅ dſẽṅmo̱ fõṅ,

english_verse: to take advantage of Israel, that weak and peaceful country where people live safely inside towns that have no walls or gates or locks.
translation_verse: ni ookē̱: “Mafã ke̱-ate šikpoṅ ní nā kã le̱ no̱, mayatua mei ní yo̱ kpō, ní ame̱hĩo̱ ši ſeſēſe, ní ame̱fẽ ame̱hĩo̱ ši ní *ame̱be̱ gbogbo, ní ame̱be̱ agbóse̱-adabãṅĩ lo agbói hũ le̱!” *Zak.

english_verse: The people of Sheba and Dedan, along with merchants from villages in southern Spain, will be your allies. They will want some of the silver and gold, as well as the livestock and property that your army takes from Israel.
translation_verse: Šeba ke̱ Dedan ke̱ Taršiš dšrayelo̱i le̱ ke̱ ame̱dšatabii le̱ fẽ aakē̱o ake̱: Nihā oba ne̱? Odšotſā hewo̱ obua osafo le̱ nā ke̱-kpe, ní olō dſie̱te̱i ke̱ šika, ní oṅõ koloi ke̱ nibii pī, ní oha nii babaō be̱?

english_verse: I, the Lord God, know that when you see my people Israel living in peace,
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ gba, gbomobi, ni okē̱ Gog ake̱: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Ani gbĩ ní mimaṅ Israel aahĩ ši ſeſēſe le̱, oteṅ ši,

english_verse: You will attack my people like a storm-cloud that covers their land. I will let you invade my country Israel, so that every nation on earth will know that I, the Lord, am holy. Judgment on Gog
translation_verse: Ni oofă ke̱-aba mimaṅ Israel no̱, tamo̱ atatu ní baha šikpoṅ le̱ no̱. Nāgbē gbĩĩ le̱ amli le̱ eeba mli ake̱ mahã obatua mišikpoṅ le̱, koni dšeṅmãdši le̱ aná alemi, beni aafemi kroṅkroṅ ye̱ omli ye̱ ame̱hĩe le̱, ō Gog!

english_verse: The Lord said to Gog: Long ago, I ordered my prophets to warn the people of Israel that someday I would send an enemy to attack them. You, Gog, are that enemy, and that day is coming.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Ani bo ohe miwie ye̱ blemagbĩĩ le̱ amli, beni mitšṍ mitšũdši, ní dši Israel gbalo̱i le̱ ní gba afii pī ye̱ nakai gbĩĩ le̱ amli le̱, ane̱ mikē̱ ake̱ maba obatuaame̱ le̱? Ies.

english_verse: and in my anger I will send a terrible earthquake to shake Israel.
translation_verse: edšake̱ miwie ye̱ miwuṅãyeli ke̱ mimlifŭ la le̱ṅ ake̱: Le̱le̱ṅ ake̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ hosomo̱ kpeteṅkple aaba Israel šikpoṅ le̱ no̱:

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make the mountains of Israel turn against you. Your troops will be so terrified that they will attack each other.
translation_verse: Ni matšé̱ klante ke̱-aba eno̱ ye̱ migõdši le̱ fẽ no̱, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱: mofẽmo klante aakã enyemi no̱.

english_verse: I will strike you with diseases and punish you with death. You and your army will be pounded with rainstorms, hailstones, and burning sulfur.
translation_verse: Ni matšṍ gbĕle-hela ke̱ lá ne̱ mike̱le̱ aakodšo, ni mahã nyoṅmo̱ne̱me̱ ní lōo̱ nibii ke̱-yaä ke̱ nyoṅmo̱ṅte̱i ke̱ la ke̱ swō̱ *ane̱ aſie le̱ ke̱ etai le̱ ke̱ mãdšimãdši babaō ní fata ehe le̱ ano̱. *Kpods.

english_verse: I will do these things to show the world that I, the Lord, am holy.
translation_verse: Ni mafe mihe agbo, ni mafe mihe kroṅkroṅ, ni mahã alemi ye̱ dšeṅmãdši pī ahĩe, ni *ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱. *

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn Gog and tell him: You are the ruler of Meshech and Tubal, but I, the Lord, am your enemy!
translation_verse: Ši bo, gbomobi, gba oši *Gog, ni oke ake̱: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Na, mike̱o ená, bo Gog ní dši Roš, Mešek ke̱ Tubal lumo̱ le̱! *

english_verse: I will turn you around and drag you from the north until you reach the mountains of Israel.
translation_verse: ni malakao, ni makplao, ni mahã odše̱ kōyigbe̱ tō̃ ofã ke̱-ba, ni mahã oba Israel gõdši le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: and you and your army will die on those mountains. Then birds and wild animals will eat the flesh
translation_verse: Oonyõ ye̱ Israel gõdši le̱ ano̱, bo ke̱ otai le̱ fiā ke̱ mãdšimãdši ní fata ohe le̱; *maṅõo mahã lofõdši lōyelo̱i sro̱toi fẽ ke̱ ṅãno̱ koloi le̱ ní ame̱yeo. *K.

english_verse: of your dead bodies left lying in open fields. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ṅã kplenē le̱ no̱ noṅṅ oonyõ ye̱; edšake̱ mi miwie, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: I will set fire to the land of Magog and to those nations along the seacoast that think they are so secure, and they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni matšũ la ke̱-ate Magog ke̱ ṅšo̱kpo̱i ano̱ bii ní hĩo̱ ši ſeſēſe le̱ ateṅ, ni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ midši Iehowa le̱!

english_verse: My people Israel will know me, and they will no longer disgrace my holy name. Everyone on earth will know that I am the holy Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ni mahã ale migbe̱i kroṅkroṅ le̱ ye̱ mimaṅ Israel teṅ, ni mihãṅ abule migbe̱i kroṅkroṅ le̱ doṅṅ, ni dšeṅmãdši le̱ aaná ale ake̱ midši Iehowa, Mokroṅkroṅ ní yo̱ Israel le̱.

english_verse: When that day comes, the people in the towns of Israel will collect the weapons of their dead enemies. They will use these shields, bows and arrows, spears, and clubs as firewood, and there will be enough to last for seven years.
translation_verse: Ni Israel mãdši le̱ amli bii le̱ aadše kpo ni ame̱ayamã tawūnii le̱ anā la ame̱šã, tše̱ṅi bibii ke̱ tše̱ṅi wudši le̱ fẽ ke̱ gãitšei ke̱ gāimlibii le̱ ke̱ kpotii ke̱ akplo̱i le̱, ni ame̱ke̱-afe lai amešã afii kpawo; Lal.

english_verse: They will burn these weapons instead of gathering sticks or chopping down trees. That's how the Israelites will take revenge on those who robbed and abused them. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Burial of Gog The Lord said:
translation_verse: ni ame̱yale̱ṅ lai ke̱-dše̱ṅ ṅã le̱ no̱, ni asaṅ ame̱yaflo̱ṅ eko ke̱-dše̱ṅ koi le̱ amli, edšake̱ ame̱ke̱ tawūnii aafe lai ame̱ašã; ni ame̱aha mei ní haame̱ le̱, ni ame̱atſa mei ni tſaame̱ odšo le̱ odšo, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: After Gog has been destroyed, I will bury him and his army in Israel, in Travelers' Valley, east of the Dead Sea. That graveyard will be so large that it will block the way of anyone who tries to walk through the valley, which will then be known as “The Valley of Gog's Army.”
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ mahã Gog fū̃he ye̱ Israel, gbe̱nyielo̱i le̱ adšō̱ ní yo̱ ṅšo̱ le̱ bokāgbe̱ le̱, ni eetšĩ gbe̱nyielo̱i le̱ agbe̱; ni dše̱i aafũ Gog ke̱ esafo yū le̱ fẽ ye̱, ni aatšé̱ dše̱i ake̱: Gog asafo yū le̱ dšō̱.

english_verse: The Israelites will spend seven months burying dead bodies and cleaning up their land.
translation_verse: Ni Israel we le̱ aafũame̱ nyõdši kpawo so̱ṅṅ, ní ame̱ke̱-tšū šikpoṅ le̱ he.

english_verse: Everyone will help with the burial, and they will be honored for this on the day the brightness of my glory is seen.
translation_verse: Ni šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ maṅ mū le̱ fẽ aafũame̱, ni eetšṍ gbe̱ihehemo̱ ehãame̱ gbĩ ní aawo mihĩe nyam le̱, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: After those seven months, the people will appoint a group of men to look for any dead bodies left unburied. This must be done for seven months to make sure that the land is no longer unclean.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱afãmo̱ mei ní ame̱tšu nii dā, ní ame̱kpa šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni beni ame̱kpaä ši le̱, ame̱fũ mei ní eſe̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱, koni ake̱-tšū he; nyõdši kpawo se̱ le̱ ame̱atao fitšofitšo.

english_verse: Whenever they find a human bone, they will set up a marker next to it. Then the gravediggers will bury it in “The Valley of Gog's Army”
translation_verse: Ni mei ní kpaä šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱, kē̱ ame̱teṅ moko na gbomo wú ko le̱, eto okadi ye̱ he ke̱-yaši beyino ní fũlo̱i le̱ aaba abafũle̱ ye̱ Gog asafo yū le̱ dšō̱ le̱ mli.

english_verse: will feast on the bodies of warriors and foreign rulers that I will sacrifice like sheep, goats, and bulls.
translation_verse: Kãkãlo̱i alō nyeaye, ni šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ lume̱i le̱ alá nyeanu: tōagboi ke̱ tōgwanteṅbii ke̱ tōkpakpoi ke̱ tšinahĩĩ, Bašan koloi ní ewo fo̱ so̱ṅṅ ni!

english_verse: I want the birds and animals to eat until they are full and drink until they are drunk.
translation_verse: Ni nyeaye fo̱ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní nyeatŏ̱ro̱, ni nyeanu lá ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní nyeatŏ̱ro̱ dā̃, ke̱ migbē-afo̱le ní migbeo̱ mahãnye le̱.

english_verse: They will come to my table and stuff themselves with the flesh of horses and warriors of every kind. I, the Lord God, have spoken. Israel Will Be Restored The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ni nyeatŏ̱ro̱ ye̱ mikplõ le̱ he ke̱ okpo̱ṅo̱i ke̱ ſīlii ke̱ hĩĩ kãkãlo̱i ke̱ tabilo̱i so̱ṅṅ, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: When I punish the nations of the earth, they will see the brightness of my glory.
translation_verse: Ni mike̱ minumnyam le̱ aato dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ, ni dšeṅmãdši le̱ fẽ aana mikodšomo̱ ní mikodšo le̱ ke̱ minine ní mike̱-ṅmẽ ame̱no̱ le̱.

english_verse: The people of Israel will know from then on that I am the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱-dše̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ ke̱-yaä ne̱ Israel we le̱ aaná ale ake̱ mi, Iehowa, dši ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Foreign nations will realize that the Israelites were forced to leave their own land because they sinned against me. I turned my back on my people and let enemies attack and kill them.
translation_verse: Ni dšeṅmãdši le̱ hũ aaná ale ake̱ Israel we le̱, ame̱nišaianii ahewo̱ ame̱te nomṅō̃ mli le̱; edšake̱ ame̱tõ mino̱ hewo̱ le̱ miṅõ *mihĩe mitēame̱, ni mituame̱ miwo ame̱haolo̱i adeṅ, ni ame̱fẽ-tſẽm ame̱nyõnyõi ye̱ klante nā. *Ies.

english_verse: Their lives were wicked and corrupt, and they deserved to be punished.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni ame̱mũdšinii ke̱ ame̱no̱tõmo̱i le̱ yo̱ le̱, nakai mifeame̱, ni miṅõ mihĩe mitēame̱.

english_verse: Now I will show mercy to the people of Israel and bring them back from the nations where they are living. They are Jacob's descendants, so I will bless them and show that I am holy.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Agbe̱ne̱ makpale Iakob nomṅō̃ le̱ ke̱-aba ekoṅ, ni mimũsũṅ aatšõmi ye̱ Israel we mū le̱ fẽ hewo̱, ni maye migbe̱i kroṅkroṅ le̱ he awuṅã.

english_verse: My people will realize that I, the Lord their God, sent them away as prisoners and now will bring them back to their own land.
translation_verse: no dãni ame̱aná ame̱le ake̱ mi, Iehowa, dši ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ake̱-ní mihã aṅõame̱ nom ke̱-te dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ, ni misā miyabua ame̱nã ke̱-ba ame̱šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ekoṅ, ni mišĩĩ ame̱teṅ mokomoko ye̱ dše̱i doṅṅ le̱.

english_verse: Never again will I turn my back on the people of Israel, and my Spirit will live in them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ miṅõṅ mihĩe mitẽṅame̱ doṅṅ; edšake̱ *mifo̱se Mimumo̱ le̱ miſie Israel we le̱ no, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱. *

english_verse: Twenty-five years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, and
