translation_verse: eṅõmi ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ he nināi le̱ amli ke̱-ba Israel šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni eke̱mi yadamo̱ goṅ groṅṅ ko no̱, ni eno̱ tamo̱ noni ato maṅ ye̱ no̱ ye̱ wuoyigbe̱.

english_verse: He measured the entrance room at the far end of the passageway, and it was ten meters wide.
translation_verse: Ni efe šimãmo̱nii ninetalo̱i nyoṅmai-ekpa, ni šimãmo̱nii le̱ ahe ye̱ kpo ní hole agbó le̱ he ke̱-kpe.

english_verse: The man said, “Ezekiel, son of man, pay close attention to everything I'm going to show you—that's why you've been brought here. Listen carefully, because you must tell the people of Israel what you see.” The East Gate
translation_verse: Ni nū le̱ kē̱mi ake̱: Gbomobi, oke̱ ohĩṅme̱ii *akwe̱, ni oke̱ otoii anu, ni oke̱ odſẽṅmo̱ afõ nibii fẽ ní mibahã ona le̱ ano̱; edšake̱ ake̱o ba bie̱, beni afe ni mahã ona. Dšadšemo̱ nibii ní onaä ne̱ fẽ otšõ Israel we le̱! *

english_verse: at the end of the passageway. The man measured this room: It was four meters from the doorway to the opposite wall, and the distance from the doorway to the wall on either side was one meter.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni esusu agbó le̱ koi le̱, ninetalo̱i kpānyo̱, ke̱ ehe šimãmo̱nii le̱ hũ ninetalo̱i enyo̱; ni agbó le̱ koi le̱ ye mligbe̱.

english_verse: The three guardrooms on each side of the passageway were the same size, and the walls that separated them were the same thickness.
translation_verse: Ni agbó le̱ ní nā kã bokãgbe̱ le̱ he tšũi le̱ etẽ ye̱ bie̱, ni etẽ hũ ye̱ bie̱, ni etẽ le̱ fẽ hĩe susumo̱ kome, ni šimãmo̱nii ní yo̱ bie̱ ke̱ bie̱ le̱ fẽ hĩe susumo̱ kome.

english_verse: Next, the man measured the width of the passageway, and it was six and a half meters, but the two doors of the gate were only five meters wide.
translation_verse: Ni esusu agbó le̱ lē̱mo̱, ninetalo̱i nyoṅma, ke̱ agbó le̱ ke̱le̱, ninetalo̱i nyoṅma ke̱ etẽ.

english_verse: The three walls in the guardrooms had small windows in them, just like the ones in the entrance room. The walls along the passageway were decorated with carvings of palm trees. The Outer Courtyard
translation_verse: Ni samfe̱dši ní aflo̱flo̱ mli ye̱ tšũi le̱ ke̱ ame̱he šimãmo̱nii le̱ ahe ye̱ agbó le̱ mligbe̱ ke̱-bo̱le ši ke̱-kpe, ke̱ koii le̱ hũ ahe; ni samfe̱dši bo̱le ši ke̱-kpe ye̱ mligbe̱, ni šimãmo̱nõ-fẽ-šimãmo̱nõ le̱ tẽṅi ye̱ he.

english_verse: The man then led me through the passageway and into the outer courtyard of the temple, where I saw
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni eṅõmi ke̱-te agbónāgbe̱ kpo le̱ no̱, ni na, piai ye̱ dše̱i, ni aka kpo le̱ no̱ te̱ ke̱-kpe; piai nyoṅmai-etẽ yo̱ heni aka dše̱i te̱ le̱.

english_verse: Next, the man measured the north gate that led to the outer courtyard.
translation_verse: Ni esusu agbónāgbe̱ kpo le̱ no̱ agbó ní hĩe kwe̱o̱ kōyigbo̱ le̱ hũ ke̱le̱ ke̱ elē̱mo̱;

english_verse: and the windows, the entrance room, and the carvings of palm trees were just like those in the east gate. The entrance room also faced the courtyard of the temple and had seven steps leading up to it.
translation_verse: Ni esamfe̱dši le̱ ke̱ ekoi le̱ ke̱ etẽṅi le̱ asusumo̱ tamo̱ agbó ní hīe kwe̱o̱ bokãgbe̱ le̱ nõ le̱; ni akwo̱ö̱ atrakpoi kpawo ke̱-yaã he; ni ekoi le̱ kã mligbe̱.

english_verse: Directly across the outer courtyard was a gate that led to the inner courtyard, just as there was for the east gate. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gate, and it was
translation_verse: Ni mligbe̱ kpo le̱ no̱ agbó le̱ ye agbó ní hĩe kwe̱o̱ kōyigbe̱ le̱ ṅe̱le̱no̱, ni eko ye agbó ní hĩe kwe̱o̱ bokãgbe̱ le̱ ṅe̱le̱no̱; ni esusu ke̱-dše̱ agbó kome he ke̱-yaši agbó kroko le̱ he, ninetalo̱i oha.

english_verse: The man then took me to the south gate. He measured the walls and the entrance room of this gate, and the measurements were exactly the same as those of the other two gates.
translation_verse: No se̱ le̱ eke̱mi te wuoyigbe̱, ni na, agbó ye̱ wuoyigbe̱ le̱ hũ; ni esusu ešimãmo̱nii ke̱ ekoi le̱ tamo̱ kleṅkleṅ susumo̱i le̱ noṅṅ.

english_verse: Seven steps led up to the gate; the entrance room was at the far end of the passageway and faced the courtyard of the temple. Carvings of palm trees decorated the walls along the passageway.
translation_verse: Ni atrakpoi kpawo akwo̱ö̱ ke̱-yaä he, ni ekoi le̱ kã mligbe̱; ni tẽṅi ye̱ ešimãmo̱nii le̱ ahe, ekome ye̱ bie̱ ni ekome hũ ye̱ bie̱.

english_verse: And directly across the outer courtyard was a gate on the south side of the inner courtyard. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gate, and it was also
translation_verse: Ni agbó ye̱ mligbe̱ kpo le̱ he ye̱ wuoyigbe̱, ni esusu ke̱-dše̱ agbó kome he ke̱-yaši agbó kroko le̱ he ye̱ wuoyigbe̱, ninetalo̱i oha.

english_verse: We then went into the inner courtyard, through the gate on the south side of the temple. The man measured the gate, and it was the same size as the gates in the outer wall.
translation_verse: Ni eke̱mi tšṍ wuoyigbe̱ agbó le̱ ke̱-te mligbe̱ kpo le̱ no̱, ni esusu wuoyigbe̱ agbó le̱ tamo̱ kleṅkleṅ susumo̱i le̱ noṅṅ,

english_verse: The entrance room of this gate faced the outer courtyard, and carvings of palm trees decorated the walls of the passageway. Eight steps led up to this gate.
translation_verse: Ni ekoi le̱ kwe̱o̱ agbónāgbe̱ kpo le no̱ gbe̱, ni tẽṅi ye̱ ešimãmo̱nii le̱ ahe, ni atrakpoi kpānyo̱ akwo̱ö̱ ke̱-yaä he.

english_verse: Next, we went through the east gate to the inner courtyard. The man measured this gate, and it was the same size as the others.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni eke̱mi te mligbe̱ kpo le̱ no̱ ye̱ bokãgbe̱, ni esusu agbó le̱ tamo̱ kleṅkleṅ susumo̱i le̱ noṅṅ;

english_verse: The guardrooms, the walls separating them, and its entrance room had the same measurements as the other gates. The guardrooms and the entrance room had windows, and the gate was
translation_verse: ni etšũi le̱ ke̱ ešimãmo̱nii le̱ ke̱ ekoi le̱ tamo̱ kleṅkleṅ susumo̱i le̱ noṅṅ, ni samfe̱dši ye̱ he ke̱ ekoi le̱ he ke̱-kpe; eke̱le̱ dši ninetalo̱i nyoṅmai-enumo̱, ni elē̱mo̱ dši ninetalo̱i nyoṅmai-enyo̱ ke̱ enume̱.

english_verse: Then the man took me to the north gate. He measured it, and it was the same size as the others,
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni eke̱mi te kōyigbe̱ agbó le̱ nā, ni esusu tamo̱ kleṅkleṅ susumo̱i le̱ noṅṅ:

english_verse: including the guardrooms, the walls separating them, and the entrance room. There were also windows in this gate. It was
translation_verse: etšŭi le̱, ešimãmo̱nii le̱ ke̱ ekoi le̱; ni samfe̱dši ye̱ he ke̱-bo̱lele̱ ke̱-kpe; eke̱le̱ dši ninetalo̱i nyoṅmai-enumo̱, ni elē̱mo̱ dši ninetalo̱i nyoṅmai-enyo̱ ke̱ enumo̱.

english_verse: and like the other inner gates, its entrance room faced the outer courtyard, and its walls were decorated with carvings of palm trees. Eight steps also led up to this gate. The Rooms for Sacrificing Animals
translation_verse: Ni ešimãmo̱nii le̱ kwe̱o̱ agbónāgbe̱ kpo le̱ no̱ gbe̱, ni tẽṅi ye̱ ešimãmo̱nii le̱ ahe bie̱ ke̱ bie̱; ni atrakpoi kpānyo̱ akwo̱ö̱ ke̱-yaä he.

english_verse: Four more tables were in the outer courtyard, two on each side of the steps leading into the entrance room.
translation_verse: Ni gbogbo le̱ mase̱i ní ye agbónā-gbe̱, ké̱ ōkwo̱ ke̱-mīya kōyigbe̱ agbó le̱ nā gbe̱ le̱, okplõi enyo̱ ye̱ dše̱i, ni emase̱i kroko le̱ ní yo̱ agbó le̱ koi le̱ ši le̱ hũ, okplõi enyo̱ ye̱ dše̱i.

english_verse: So there was a total of eight tables, four inside and four outside, where the animals were killed,
translation_verse: Okplõi edſe̱ ye fã kome ne̱, ni okplõi edſe̱ hũ ye fã kome ne̱, ye̱ agbó le̱ mase̱i: okplõi kpānyo̱ ní agbeo̱ koloi ye̱ no̱.

english_verse: He said, “The building beside the north gate belongs to the priests who serve in the temple,
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Ne̱ke̱ tšũ ne̱ ní hĩe kwe̱o̱ wuoyigbe̱ ne̱ oso̱foi ní tšuo̱ šĩa le̱ nii le̱ anõ ni.

english_verse: and the building beside the south gate belongs to those who serve at the altar. All of them are descendants of Zadok and are the only Levites allowed to serve as the Lord's priests.” The Inner Courtyard and the Temple
translation_verse: Ši tšũ le̱ ní hĩe kwe̱o̱ kōyigbe̱ le̱ oso̱foi ní tšuo̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ he nii le̱ anõ ni. Mene̱mei dši *Zadok bii ní dše̱ Levibii le̱ ateṅ ní ame̱be̱ṅke̱o̱ Iehowa ame̱basúmoo̱le̱ le̱. *

english_verse: We walked to the porch of the temple, and the man measured the doorway of the porch: It was seven meters long, two and a half meters wide, and the distance from the doorway to the wall on either side was one and a half meters.
translation_verse: Ni eke̱mi ba šĩa le̱ *koi le̱ ši, ni esusu koi le̱ šimãmo̱nii le̱, ninetalo̱i enumo̱ ye̱ bie̱ ke̱ ninetalo̱i enumo̱ ye̱ bie̱ hũ, ke̱ agbó le̱ lē̱mo̱, ninetalo̱i etẽ ye̱ bie̱ ke̱ ninetalo̱i etẽ ye̱ bie̱. *

english_verse: The porch itself was ten meters by six meters, with steps leading up to it. There was a column on each side of these steps.
translation_verse: Koi le̱ ke̱le̱ dši ninetalo̱i nyoṅmai-enyo̱, ni elē̱mo̱ dši ninetalo̱i nyoṅma ke̱ ekome; ni atrakpoi [nyoṅma] akwo̱ö̱ ke̱-yaä he. Ni *akulašĩṅi mãmo̱ simãmo̱nii le̱ amase̱i, ekome ye̱ bie̱, ṅi ekome hũ ye̱ bie̱. *

english_verse: Then the man walked to the far end of the temple's main room and said, “Beyond this doorway is the most holy place.” He first measured the doorway: It was one meter wide,
translation_verse: Ni esusu eke̱le̱, ninetalo̱i nyoṅmai-enyo̱, ke̱ elē̱mo̱, ninetalo̱i nyoṅmai-enyo̱, ye̱ so̱lemo̱tšũ le̱ hĩe; ni ekē̱mi ake̱: *Bie̱ dši hekroṅkroṅ fè fẽ le̱. *

english_verse: The walls of the temple were thicker at the bottom than at the top, which meant that the storage rooms on the top level were wider than those on the bottom level. Steps led from the bottom level, through the middle level, and into the top level.
translation_verse: Ni piaipiai le̱ hĩe lē̱mo̱ beni ame̱ho̱leo̱ šĩa le̱ ke̱-yaä ṅweigbe̱ le̱; edšake̱ šĩa le̱ bo̱lemo̱ le̱ hĩe ṅwei-yā āhũ ke̱-bo̱le šĩa le̱ ke̱-kpe, nohewo̱ le̱ šĩa le̱ lē̱mo̱ le̱ yafá ye̱ ṅweigbe̱, ni adše̱o̱ šišigbe̱ nõ le̱ mli ke̱-tšṍo̱ teṅgbe̱ nõ le̱ mli ke̱-yaä ṅweigbe̱ nõ le̱ mli.

english_verse: The temple rested on a stone base three meters high, which also served as the foundation for the storage rooms.
translation_verse: Ni mina ake̱ šĩa le̱ ye̱ kpoku ní bo̱lele̱ ke̱-kpe, ni piaipiai le̱ ašišitōĩ le̱ feo̱ susumo̱tšo kome ni hĩe ninetalo̱i ekpa šišiši.

english_verse: The outside walls of the storage rooms were two and a half meters thick; there was nothing between these walls
translation_verse: Asaṅ piaipiai le̱ agbogbo le̱ ní yo̱ kpono̱gbe̱ le̱ tile̱ dši ninetalo̱i enumo̱; ni noni ašĩ ye̱ šĩa le̱ he piaipiai le̱ ahe le̱ hũ, nakai noṅṅ.

english_verse: One door led into the storage rooms on the north side of the temple, and another door led to those on the south side. The stone base extended two and a half meters beyond the outside wall of the storage rooms. The West Building and the Measurements of the Temple
translation_verse: Ni piaipiai le̱ anā šĩnāi le̱ mikwe̱ gbe̱ ní aši le̱: šĩnā kome na kã kōyigbe̱, ni šĩnā kroko hũ nā kã wuoyigbe̱, ni gbe̱ ní aši le̱ lē̱mo̱ hĩe ninetalo̱i enumo̱ ke̱-bo̱le ke̱-kpe.

english_verse: The man measured the length of the temple, and it was
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni esusu šĩa le̱ ke̱le̱, ninetalo̱i oha, ke̱ mõse̱ le̱ ke̱ tšũ le̱ ke̱ egbogboi le̱ ake̱le̱, ninetalo̱i oha.

english_verse: The distance across the front of the temple, including the open space on either side, was also
translation_verse: Asaṅ šĩa le̱ ke̱ mõse̱ le̱ ní kwe̱o̱ bokãgbe̱ le̱ hĩelē̱mo̱ dši ninetalo̱i oha.

english_verse: Finally, the man measured the length of the west building, including the side rooms on each end, and it was also
translation_verse: Ni esusu tšũ ní ye mõse̱ le̱ se̱gbe̱ le̱ hĩegbe̱ ke̱ ehe ablanāi le̱ ní yo̱ bie̱ ke̱ bie̱ le̱ ake̱le̱, ninetalo̱i oha; ke̱ so̱lemo̱tšũ le̱ ní yo̱ mligbe̱ le̱ ke̱ kpo le̱ no̱ koii le̱ hũ;

english_verse: were paneled with wood all the way from the floor to the windows, while the doorways, the small windows, and the three side rooms were trimmed in wood.
translation_verse: kpokui le̱ ke̱ samfe̱dši ní aflo̱flo̱ mli le̱ ke̱ ablanāi ní bo̱le ši ke̱-kpe ye̱ amensō̱doi etẽ le̱ ano̱ ye̱ kpoku le̱ ṅe̱le̱no̱, le̱ ake̱ ṅmoṅmlo eka ke̱-bo̱le ši ke̱-kpe, ni asaṅ ke̱-dše̱ šikpoṅ ke̱-yaši samfe̱dši le̱ ahe, ni samfe̱dši le̱ hũ aha-hā he,

english_verse: The doorframe to the temple's main room was in the shape of a rectangle. The Wooden Altar In front of the doorway to the most holy place was something that looked like
translation_verse: Ni so̱lemo̱tšũ le̱ gbogbo le̱ he šĩnātšei le̱ afeame̱ kodši edſe̱dſe̱, ni hekroṅkroṅ le̱ hĩe le̱ noko ye̱ dše̱i ní esu tamo̱ afo̱lešãlate̱.

english_verse: a wooden altar. It was one and a half meters high and one meter square, and its corners, its base, and its sides were made of wood. The man said, “This is a reminder that the Lord is constantly watching over his temple.” The Doors in the Temple
translation_verse: *Tšo ake̱-fe, ekwo̱le̱ dši ninetalo̱i etẽ, ni eke̱le̱ dši ninetalo̱i enyo̱; ni ehe ye̱ kodši, ni enãdši ke̱ ehewo̱hewo̱i le̱ tšo ake̱-fe; ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Okplõ ní mã Iehowa hĩe le̱ ne̱. *

english_verse: The doors to the main room were decorated with carvings of winged creatures and palm trees just like those on the walls, and there was a wooden covering over the porch just outside these doors.
translation_verse: Ni ayeyē kerubim ke̱ tẽṅi asãmãi ye̱ so̱lemo̱tšũ le̱ nā šĩnāi le̱ ahe, tamo̱ nii ní afe ye̱ gbogboi le̱ ahe le̱; ni ake̱ tšo fe kpoku ye̱ koi le̱ hĩe ye̱ kpono̱gbe̱.

english_verse: The walls on each side of this porch had small windows and were also decorated with carvings of palm trees.
translation_verse: Ni samfe̱dši ní aflo̱flo̱ mli ke̱ tẽṅi ye̱ koi le̱ mase̱i bie̱ ke̱ bie̱, ke̱ šĩa le̱ piaipiai le̱ ke̱ kpokui le̱ ahe.

english_verse: and at the east end of this wall was the door leading from the courtyard to these rooms. There was also a set of rooms on the south side of the west building.
translation_verse: Ni kpo le̱ he gbogbo le̱ lē̱mo̱ no̱ ke̱-yaä bokãgbe̱ ye̱ mõse̱ le̱ ke̱ tšũi le̱ ahĩe le̱, piai ye̱ dše̱i hũ.

english_verse: with doors that opened toward the north, and in front of them was a walkway five meters wide and
translation_verse: Ni piai le̱ ahĩe le̱ nyiemo̱he ní hĩe ninetalo̱i nyoṅma lē̱mo̱ ye̱ dše̱i ye̱ mligbe̱, eke̱le̱ dši ninetalo̱i oha; ni ame̱šĩnāi le̱ anā kãmo̱ kōyigbe̱.

english_verse: The rooms on the top level were narrower than those on the middle level, and the rooms on the middle level were narrower than those on the bottom level.
translation_verse: Ni ṅweigbe̱ tšũi le̱ kĕ̱le̱e̱; edšake̱ ablanāi le̱ ehe ame̱gbe̱ le̱ fè šĩšinii le̱ ke̱ teṅnii le̱ anõ le̱.

english_verse: The rooms on the bottom level supported those on the two upper levels, and so these rooms did not have columns like other buildings in the courtyard.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ame̱hĩe nsō̱doi etẽ, ši ame̱be̱ akulašĩṅi tamo̱ kpoi le̱ ane̱ akulasĩṅi le̱; nohewo̱ le̱ adše̱ šiši abe̱ ṅwei nii le̱ amli fè šišinii le̱ ke̱ teṅnii le̱.

english_verse: These rooms were exactly like those on the north side, and they also had a walkway in front of them.
translation_verse: Ni gbe̱ kã ame̱hĩe, take̱ bo̱ni anaa ye̱ tšũi ní yo̱ kōyigbe̱ le̱ ahĩe le̱; ame̱ke̱le̱ ke̱ ame̱lē̱mo̱ tamo̱ ekrokomei le̱ noṅṅ, ni ame̱nāgbe̱i ke̱ ame̱gbe̱dšiano̱tōi tamo̱ ekrokomei le̱ noṅṅ.

english_verse: The door to these rooms was at the east end of the wall that stood in front of them.
translation_verse: Nakai noṅṅ tšũi ni kãmo̱ wuoyigbe̱ le̱ ašĩnāi le̱ yo̱; asaṅ šĩnā ko ye̱ gbe̱ le̱ šišidšē, gbe̱ ni kã gbogbo le̱ hĩe tū̃ntũ ke̱-yaä bokãgbe̱, ké̱ ōbote mli le̱.

english_verse: The man then said to me: These rooms on the north and south sides of the temple are the sacred rooms where the Lord's priests will eat the most holy offerings. These offerings include the grain sacrifices, the sacrifices for sin, and the sacrifices to make things right.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Tšũi ní kãmo̱ kōyigbe̱ le̱ ke̱ tšũi le̱ ní kãmo̱ wuoyigbe̱ ye̱ mõse̱ le̱ hĩe le̱ dši tšũi kroṅkroṅi le̱, heni oso̱foi ní be̱ṅke̱o Iehowa le̱ aaye nii kroṅkroṅi fè fẽ le̱ ye̱; dše̱i ame̱ke̱ nii kroṅkroṅi fè fẽ le̱ ke̱ niyenii-afo̱le le̱ ke̱ eša-afo̱le le̱ ke̱ sō-afo̱le le̱ aato; edšake̱ dše̱i ye̱ kroṅkroṅ.

english_verse: When the priests are ready to leave the temple, they must go through these rooms before they return to the outer courtyard. They must leave their sacred clothes in these rooms and put on regular clothes before going anywhere near other people. The Size of the Temple Area
translation_verse: Ké̱ oso̱foi le̱ bote mli le̱, ame̱kadše hekroṅkroṅ le̱ ame̱mīdše kpo ke̱-mīya agbónāgbe̱ kpo le̱ no̱, ši moṅ ame̱ke̱ ame̱tadei le̱ ní ame̱ke̱súmoo̱ le̱ aſie dše̱i, edšake̱ ame̱ye̱ kroṅkroṅ; ame̱wo atadei krokomei, dãni ame̱be̱ṅke̱ heni maṅ le̱ yo̱ le̱.

english_verse: After the man had finished measuring the buildings inside the temple area, he took me back through the east gate and measured the wall around this area.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ beni esusu mligbe̱ šĩa le̱ egbe nā le̱, eke̱mi dše kpo ke̱-tšṍ agbó ní hĩe kwe̱o̱ bokãgbe̱ le̱ nā gbe̱, ni esusu fẽ ke̱-kpe.

english_verse: He used his measuring stick to measure the east side of this wall; it was
translation_verse: Eke̱ susumo̱tšo le̱ susu bokãgbe̱ le̱, tšei ohai-enumo̱ ye̱ susumo̱tšo le̱ nā ke̱-kpe.

english_verse: Then he measured the north side, the south side, and the west side of the wall, and they were each
translation_verse: Esã etšṍ ehe ke̱-ba anaigbe̱ le̱, ni esusu tšei ohai-enumo̱ ye̱ susumo̱tšo le̱ nā.

english_verse: and so the temple area was a perfect square. The wall around this area separated what was sacred from what was ordinary.
translation_verse: Esusu ehei edſe̱ le̱ fẽ. Gbogbo bo̱lele̱ ke̱-kpe: eke̱le̱ dši tšei ohai-enumo̱, ni elē̱mo̱ hũ tšei ohai-enumo̱, koni ake̱-fo hekroṅkroṅ ke̱ heni dši mei fẽ anõ le̱ teṅ.

english_verse: This vision was like the one I had seen when God came to destroy Jerusalem and like the one I had seen near the Chebar River. I immediately bowed with my face to the ground,
translation_verse: Ni etamo̱ ninā ní mina le̱ su, tamo̱ ninā ní mina *beni miba mibafite maṅ le̱, ni nināi le̱ tamo̱ ninā ní mina †ye̱ Kebar fā le̱ nā le̱. Ke̱ke̱ ni miṅõ mihĩe mibu ši. *Y.

english_verse: and the Lord's glory came through the east gate and into the temple.
translation_verse: Ni *Iehowa anumnyam le̱ tšṍ †agbó ní hĩe kwe̱o bokãgbe̱ le̱ ke̱-ba šĩa le̱. *

english_verse: The Lord's Spirit lifted me to my feet and carried me to the inner courtyard, where I saw that the Lord's glory had filled the temple.
translation_verse: Ni mumo̱ le̱ wómi ni eke̱mi ba mligbe̱ kpo le̱ no̱, ni na, *Iehowa anumnyam le̱ yi šĩa le̱ obõ to̱. *

english_verse: But if the people and their kings stop worshiping other gods and tear down those memorials, I will live among them forever.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ le̱ ame̱adšie ame̱dſamaṅbō̱ le̱ ke̱ ame̱maṅtše̱mei le̱ agbohĩĩ le̱ ke̱-adše̱ mimase̱i ke̱-ate flōflo, ni mahĩ ame̱ teṅ ke̱-ate nāno̱.

english_verse: The people of Israel must suffer shame for sinning against me, so tell them about my holy temple. Let them think about it,
translation_verse: Bo gbomobi, ṅō šĩa le̱ otšõ Israel we le̱, koni *ame̱hĩe aſie ši ye̱ ame̱nišaianii le̱ ahe, ni ame̱susu noni asusule̱ pe̱pē̱pe̱ le̱. *

english_verse: then if they are truly sorry, describe for them the design and shape of the temple, the gates, the measurements, and how the buildings are arranged. Explain the regulations about worshiping there, then write down these things, so they can study and obey them.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši ame̱hĩe ſie ši ye̱ nibii fẽ ní ame̱fe le̱ he le̱, no le̱ oṅõ šĩa le̱ su ke̱ egbe̱dšiano̱tō le̱ ke̱ ekpodšēhei ke̱ emlibāhei le̱ ke̱ esu le̱ fẽ ke̱ egbe̱nānii le̱ fẽ ke̱ esui le̱ fẽ ke̱ ehe mlai le̱ fẽ otšōame̱, ni oṅmã ye̱ ame̱hĩe, koni ame̱ ye esu mũ le̱ fe ke̱ egbe̱nānii le̱ fẽ no̱, ní ame̱fe.

english_verse: The temple area on my holy mountain must be kept sacred! This is the most important law about the temple. The Altar
translation_verse: Ene̱ dši šĩa le̱ he mla le̱: Goṅ le̱ yiteṅ le̱, ehũsũ mū le̱ fẽ ní bo̱lele̱ ke̱-kpe le̱ afe hekroṅkroṅ fè fẽ; na, ene̱ dši šĩa le̱ he mla le̱.

english_verse: According to the official standards, the altar in the temple had the following measurements: Around the bottom of the altar was a gutter
translation_verse: Ni *afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ susumo̱i ye̱ ninetalo̱i amli ne̱: Ešiši le̱ aafe ninetalo̱ kome ke̱ elē̱mo̱ hũ ninetalo̱ kome: ni etoi ní dši enābu ní bo̱lele̱ ke̱-kpe le̱ klakate kome. Ni afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ kwo̱le̱ ne̱: *

english_verse: Each day for the next seven days, you must offer a goat and a bull and a ram as sacrifices for sin. These animals must have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Oke̱ tōkpakpo aba nī ake̱-fe eša-afo̱le dā gbĩ ke̱-yaši gbĩĩ kpawo; asaṅ ake̱ tšina oblanyo ke̱ tōagbo ní kpa ko be̱ ame̱he aba.

english_verse: The Lord God said: Ezekiel, son of man, after the altar is built, it must be dedicated by offering sacrifices on it and by splattering it with blood. Here is what you must do:
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Gbomobi, bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Gbĩ ní aafe afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ ní aašã šā̃-afo̱le ye̱ no̱ ní aaṅõ lá aſã no̱ le̱, ehe gbe̱nānii ne̱.

english_verse: The priests of the Levi tribe from the family of Zadok the priest are the only ones who may serve in my temple—this is my law. So give them a young bull to slaughter as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Oso̱foi Levibii ní dše̱ *Zadok seši mli ní babe̱ṅke̱o̱mi, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱, koni ame̱súmo̱mi le̱, hãame̱ tšina oblanyo ní ake̱-fe eša-afo̱le.

english_verse: Take some of the animal's blood and smear it on the four corners of the altar, some on the corners of the middle section, and some more on the rim around its edge. That will purify the altar and make it fit for offering sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Ni oṅõ elá le̱ eko ni oke̱-diki ehe aklontoi edſe̱ le̱ ke̱ esẽi le̱ kodši edſe̱ le̱ ke̱ etoi le̱ ke̱-kpe kpula, ní oke̱-dšie ehe eša, ni okpãtã ohãle̱.

english_verse: Then take the body of the bull outside the temple area and burn it at the special place.
translation_verse: Ni oṅõ eša-afo̱le tšinanū le̱ hũ, ni ošãle̱ ye̱ šĩa le̱ he ní ato ye̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱ kpono̱gbe̱ le̱.

english_verse: The next day, a goat that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice for sin. Purify the altar with its blood, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
translation_verse: Ni gbĩ ní dši gbĩ enyo̱ le̱ no̱ le̱ oṅõ tōkpakpo ní kpa ko be̱ ehe ke̱-ba ní ake̱-fe eša-afo̱le, ni ake̱-dšie afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ he eša, take̱ bo̱ni ake̱ tšinanū le̱ dšie le̱.

english_verse: Then choose a young bull and a young ram that have nothing wrong with them,
translation_verse: Ké̱ odšie eša le̱ ogbe nā le̱, osā oṅõ tšina oblanyo ní kpa ko be̱ ehe ke̱ tōagbo ní kpa ko be̱ ehe ke̱-dše̱ tōi le̱ ateṅ ke̱-ba,

english_verse: and bring them to my temple. The priests will sprinkle salt on them and offer them as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: ni oke̱ame̱ aba Iehowa hĩe, ni oso̱foi le̱ aṅõ ṅō aſie ame̱no̱, ni ame̱ṅõame̱ ame̱šã šā̃-afo̱le ame̱hã Iehowa.

english_verse: The priests will purify the altar during those days, so that it will be acceptable to me and ready to use.
translation_verse: Akpãtã ahã afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ gbĩĩ kpawo, ni atšū he, ni adšō̱ no̱ ahã afo̱lešā̃.

english_verse: From then on, the priests will use this altar to offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices to ask my blessing. Then I will be pleased with the people of Israel. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ni ké̱ agbe ne̱ke̱ gbĩĩ ne̱ anā le̱, aba mli ake̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ kpānyo̱ le̱ no̱ āhũ ke̱-yaä ne̱ oso̱foi le̱ ašã nyešā̃-afo̱lei ke̱ nyešidā-afo̱lei le̱ ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱, ni maná nyehe tšui, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: The Lord said: I, the Lord God of Israel, came through this gate, so it must remain closed forever! No one must ever use it.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱mi ake̱: Ne̱ke̱ agbó ne̱ aṅã́ dā, akagble, ni moko akatšṍ dše̱i ke̱-bote mli; edšake̱ Iehowa, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, etšṍ nā ke̱-bote mli, hewo le̱ aṅã dā.

english_verse: Tell those rebellious people of Israel: I, the Lord God, command you to stop your evil ways!
translation_verse: Ni okē̱ toigbolo̱i le̱, ní dši Israel we le̱, ake̱: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Nye Israel we, nyenihĩnii fẽ ní nyefe le̱ efá,

english_verse: But because these Levites served the people of Israel when they worshiped idols, I, the Lord God, promise that the Levites will be punished. They did not stop the Israelites from sinning,
translation_verse: Ake̱-ní ame̱súmo̱ame̱ ye̱ ame̱wo̱dši le̱ ahĩe, ni ame̱tšṍmo̱ nõša pãmpi ame̱hã Israel we le̱ hewo̱ le̱, miwó minine no̱ ye̱ ame̱no̱, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱, ni ame̱-atĕre ame̱nišaianii le̱.

english_verse: The priests of the Levi tribe who are descendants of Zadok the priest were faithful to me, even when the rest of the Israelites turned away. And so, these priests will continue to serve as my priests and to offer the fat and the blood of sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ši oso̱foi Levibii ní dši *Zadok bii le̱ ní tšu mihekroṅkroṅ le̱ he nitšumo̱ le̱, beni Israelbii dše mihe ame̱yadũ gbe̱ le̱, ame̱ ame̱be̱ṅke̱mi, koni ame̱súmo̱mi ni ame̱damo̱ mihĩe, koni ame̱ke̱ fo̱ ke̱ lá abahāmi, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱. *

english_verse: When they come to the inner courtyard, they must wear their linen priestly clothes. My priests must never wear anything made of wool when they are on duty in this courtyard or in the temple.
translation_verse: Ni aba mli ake̱, ké̱ ame̱mībote mli-gbe̱ kpo le̱ no̱ agbói le̱ amli le̱, ame̱wo *klala atadei, ni kũntũ noko akahĩ amehe, beni ame̱súmoo̱ ye̱ mligbe̱ kpo le̱ no̱ agbói le̱ anã lo šĩa le̱. *

english_verse: Priests must teach my people the difference between what is sacred and what is ordinary, and between what is clean and what is unclean.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱tšõ mimaṅ le̱ *sro̱to ní yo̱ nõkroṅkroṅ ke̱ noni abule teṅ, ni ame̱hã ame̱le sro̱to ní yo̱ nii ní he tšee ke̱ nii ní he tše le̱ ateṅ. *

english_verse: They will make decisions in difficult legal cases, according to my own laws. They must also observe the religious festivals my Law requires and must always respect the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Ni béisane mli hũ ame̱ noṅṅ ame̱damo̱ ši ní ame̱kodšo; mĩkodšomo̱i le̱ anā ame̱kodšo ye̱, ni ame̱ye mimlai ke̱ mikpo̱i le̱ ano̱ ye̱ migbĩĩ dšudši le̱ fẽ no̱, ni ame̱fe mihedšō̱mo̱gbĩĩ le̱ kroṅkroṅ.

english_verse: Touching a dead body will make a person unclean. So a priest must not go near a dead body, unless it is one of his parents or children, or his brother or unmarried sister.
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ ame̱kaya gbonyo ko he ní ame̱ke̱-bule ame̱he; dša tše̱ lo nye lo, binū lo biyō lo nyeminū lo nyemiyō ni egbãko he ame̱bule ame̱he ye̱.

english_verse: he must go to the inner courtyard of the temple and offer a sacrifice for sin. After that, he may once again serve as my priest. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ni gbĩ ní eboteo̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱ ye̱ mligbe̱ kpo le̱ no̱, ní eyasúmo̱ ye̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱, eke̱ ehe eša-afo̱le aba, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: I myself will provide for my priests, and so they won't receive any land of their own.
translation_verse: Ni gbošinii ní ame̱aná le̱, midši ame̱gbošinii! nohewo̱ le̱ nyekahãa-ame̱ gbe̱-fãṅnõ ko ye̱ Israel; *midši ame̱gbe̱fãṅnõ! *

english_verse: Instead, they will receive part of the grain sacrifices, as well as part of the sacrifices for sin and sacrifices to make things right. They will also be given everything in Israel that has been completely dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Ame̱ye niyenii-afo̱le le̱ ke̱ eša-afo̱le le̱ ke̱ sõ-afo̱le le̱, ni nofẽno ní adšō̱ no̱ ake ye̱ Israel le̱ atšṍ ame̱nõ.

english_verse: The first part of every harvest will belong to the priests. They will also receive part of all special gifts and offerings the Israelites bring to me. And whenever any of my people bake bread, they will give their first loaf as an offering to the priests, and I will bless the homes of the people when they do this.
translation_verse: Ni nibii fẽ mli kleṅkleṅ yibii le̱ fẽ ateṅ noni hĩ fè fẽ le̱ ke̱ nibii fẽ mli no̱wómo̱-afo̱lei ní nyewóo̱ no̱ le̱ fẽ atšṍ oso̱foi le̱ anõ; ni nyekleṅkleṅ mã le̱ hũ nyeṅõ-hãa oso̱fo le̱, koni ehã dšō̱mo̱ ahĩ owe le̱.

english_verse: Priests must not eat any bird or animal that dies a natural death or that has been killed by a wild animal.
translation_verse: *Noko ní le̱dientše̱ egbo lo atšere̱ emli, loflõ dšio, kolo dšio, oso̱foi akaye. *

english_verse: So from now on, you must use honest weights and measures.
translation_verse: Nyehĩea *nsẽnii ní dša ke̱ efa ní dša ke̱ bat ní dša. *

english_verse: The Festival of Shelters will begin on the fifteenth day of the seventh month and will continue for seven days. On each day of this festival, the ruler will provide the same number of animals that he did each day during Passover, as well as the same amount of grain and olive oil for the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Nyõṅ ní dši kpawo le̱ no̱ *gbĩ ní dši nyoṅma ke̱ enumo̱ le̱ no̱, ye̱ gbĩdšŭrõ le̱ no̱ le̱, efe nakai noṅṅ gbĩĩ kpawo le̱ fẽ: tamo̱ eša-afo̱le ke̱ šā̃-afo̱le ke̱ niyenii-afo̱le ke̱ mũ le̱ noṅṅ. *

english_verse: The ephah will be the standard dry measure, and the bath will be the standard liquid measure. Their size will be based on the homer, which will equal ten ephahs or ten baths.
translation_verse: Efa ke̱ bat aye egbo̱, koni bat le̱ aye homer mlidšāi nyoṅma mli ekome, ke̱ efa le̱ hũ homer mlidšāi nyoṅma mli ekome; ake̱ homer asusu.

english_verse: The same ceremony must also be done on the seventh day of the month, so that anyone who sins accidentally or without knowing it will be forgiven, and so that my temple will remain holy.
translation_verse: Ni nakai noṅṅ kẽ ofe ye̱ nyõṅ le̱ no̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ kpawo le̱ no̱ hũ ohã moni *dšee kwa ekwa etõ ke̱ moni lee ni efe le̱, ní nyeke̱-kpãtã nyehã šĩa le̱. *

english_verse: Leaders of Israel, the people must bring you one sixtieth of their grain harvests as offerings to me.
translation_verse: No̱wómo̱-nikēnii ní nyeke̱-hã ne̱: Ṅmā̃ homer kome le̱, efa mlidšāi ekpa mli ekome; ni akoko homer le̱, efa mli-dšāi ekpa mli ekome.

english_verse: They will also bring one percent of their olive oil. These things will be measured according to the bath, and ten baths is the same as one homer or one cor.
translation_verse: Ni mũ he akpo̱ ne̱: Mũ bat mli-dšāi nyoṅma mli ekome ye̱ kor ní dši homer ní hĩe bati nyoṅma le̱ mli; edšake̱ bati nyoṅma feo̱ homer;

english_verse: The people of Israel will bring you these offerings.
translation_verse: Šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ maṅ mū le̱ fẽ aṅõ ne̱ke̱ no̱wómo̱-nikēnii ne̱ ahã lumo̱ ní yo̱ Israel le̱.

english_verse: The Lord God said: On the first day of the first month, a young bull that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice to purify the temple.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Kleṅkleṅ nyõṅ le̱ no̱ kleṅkleṅ gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ ṅõ tšina oblanyo ní kpa ko be̱ ehe, ni oke̱-dšie hekroṅkroṅ le̱ he eša.

english_verse: Beginning on the fourteenth day of the first month, and continuing for seven days, everyone will celebrate Passover and eat bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Asaṅ kleṅkleṅ nyõṅ le̱ no̱ gbĩ ní dši *gbĩ nyoṅma ke̱ edſe̱ le̱ nyeyea Hehō, ní dši gbĩĩ kpawo gbĩdšŭrõ le̱; aye abolo akpĩtĩ so̱ṅṅ. *

english_verse: He will also provide nine kilograms of grain and three liters of olive oil to be offered with each bull and each ram.
translation_verse: Ni ehã niyenii-afo̱lei hũ: tšinanū kome le̱, efa kome; ni tōagbo kome le̱, efa kome; ni mũ hin kome afata efa kome he.

english_verse: The Lord said: The east gate of the inner courtyard must remain closed during the six working days of each week. But on the Sabbath and on the first day of the month, this gate will be opened.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Mligbe̱ kpo le no̱ agbó le̱ ní kwe̱o̱ bokāgbe̱ le̱ aṅã́ dā nitšumo̱gbĩĩ ekpa le̱; ši hedšō̱mo̱gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ agble, ni nyõṅ hē gbĩ le̱ no̱ hũ agble.

english_verse: Israel's ruler will go from the outer courtyard into the entrance room of this gate and stand in the doorway while the priest offers sacrifices to ask my blessing and sacrifices to please me. The ruler will bow with his face to the ground to show that he has worshiped me. Then he will leave, and the gate will remain open until evening.
translation_verse: Ni *lumo̱ le̱ atšṍ nakai agbó le̱ koi le̱ ši gbe̱ le̱ no̱ ye̱ kpono̱gbe̱ le̱ ke̱-bote mli, ni ebadamo̱ agbó le̱ šĩnātšo le̱ he. Ni oso̱foi le̱ asã ešā̃-afo̱le ke̱ ešidā-afo̱lei le̱; ni edšá ye̱ agbó le̱ kpoku le̱ no̱, ni edše kpo, ši agbó le̱ akaṅã́ ke̱-yaši gbe̱ke̱. *

english_verse: With the ram, he is to offer nine kilograms of grain, and with each of the lambs, he can offer as much as he wants. He must also offer three liters of olive oil with every nine kilograms of grain.
translation_verse: ke̱ niyenii-afo̱le le̱: tōagbo kome le̱, efa kome, ke̱ tōgwanteṅbii ahe niyenii-afo̱le: bo̱ni eenyẽ ehã, ke̱ mū hin kome ní afata efa le̱ he.

english_verse: The ruler is to bring six lambs, a bull, and a ram to be offered as sacrifices at the New Moon Festival. There must be nothing wrong with any of these animals.
translation_verse: Ni nyõṅ hē gbĩ le̱ no̱ nõ dši tšina oblanyo kome ní kpa ko be̱ ehe ke̱ tōgwanteṅbii ekpa ke̱ tōagbo kome ní kpa ko be̱ ame̱he,

english_verse: At all other festivals and celebrations, nine kilograms of grain will be offered with a bull, and nine kilograms will be offered with a ram. The worshipers can offer as much grain as they want with each lamb. Three liters of olive oil must be offered with every nine kilograms of grain.
translation_verse: Ni gbĩdšŭrõ-fẽ-gbĩdšŭrõ no̱ niyenii-afo̱lei le̱, *tšinanū kome nõ dši efa kome, ke̱ tōagbo hũ nõ efa kome, ke̱ tōgwanteṅbii le̱ anõ bo̱ni eenyẽ ehã, ke̱ mũ hin kome ní afata efa le̱ he. *K.

english_verse: If the ruler voluntarily offers a sacrifice to please me or to ask my blessing, the east gate of the inner courtyard will be opened for him. He will offer his sacrifices just as he does on each Sabbath; then he will leave, and the gate will be closed.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši lumo̱ le̱ ké̱ tšuidšŭrōnā šā̃-afo̱le lo tšuidšũrõnã šidā-afo̱le ko ba-hã Iehowa le̱, agble agbó le̱ ní kwe̱o̱ bokãgbe̱ le̱ ahãle̱, ni eke̱ ešā̃-afo̱le ke̱ ešidā-afo̱lei le̱ ahã tamo̱ bo̱ni efeo̱ ye̱ hedšō̱mo̱gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱: ke̱ke̱ ni edše kpo; ni ekpodšē le̱ se̱ le̱ aṅã́ agbó le̱.

english_verse: Each morning a year-old lamb that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Ši oke̱ tōgwanteṅbi ní eye afi ní kpa ko be̱ ehe ašã šā̃-afo̱le *dā gbĩ ohã Iehowa; dā lebi ošã. *

english_verse: Along with it, two kilograms of fine flour mixed with a liter of olive oil must be offered as a grain sacrifice. This law will never change—
translation_verse: Ni oke̱ niyenii-afo̱le afata he dā lebi: efa mlidšāi ekpa mli ekome, ke̱ mũ hin mlidšāi etẽ mli ekome ní ake̱-kpo̱to̱ ṅmā̃ mãmũ le̱, ní efe niyenii-afo̱le ehã Iehowa; akpo̱ ní kã ši dā dšĩ no.

english_verse: The Lord God said: If the ruler of Israel gives some of his land to one of his children, it will belong to the ruler's child as part of the family property.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Ke̱-dši lumo̱ le̱ ṅõ egbe̱făṅnõ le̱ eko eke ebihĩĩ le̱ eko le̱, etšṍ ebihĩĩ anõ; ame̱-gbošinii ní ame̱ná dši no.

english_verse: But if the ruler gives some of his land to one of his servants, the land will belong to the servant until the Year of Celebration, when it will be returned to the ruler. Only the ruler's children can keep what is given to them.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši eṅõ egbe̱fãṅnõ le̱ eko eke etšũdši le̱ ateṅ moko le̱, no le̱ ahĩ edeṅ ke̱-yaši *heyeli afi le̱ no̱; ke̱ke̱ ni ake̱-kũ se̱ ahã lumo̱ le̱ ekoṅ; ši ebihĩĩ le̱ agbošinii ní ame̱aná le̱ ke̱ke̱ atšṍ ame̱nõ. *

english_verse: The ruler must never abuse my people by taking land from them. Any land he gives his children must already belong to him. The Sacred Kitchens
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ lumo̱ le̱ akašõ maṅbii le̱ agbošinii le̱ eko ní eſieame̱ ke̱-dše̱ ame̱-gbe̱fãṅnõ le̱ no̱; le̱dientše̱ egbe̱fãṅnõ le̱ eko eṅõ-hã ebihĩĩ le̱ ní etšṍ ame̱nõ, beni afe ní akagbe mimaṅbii le̱ aſã, mofẽmo ke̱-dše̱ egbe̱fãṅnõ no̱.

english_verse: The man who was showing me the temple then took me back to the inner courtyard. We walked to the south side of the courtyard and stopped at the door to the sacred rooms that belonged to the priests. He showed me more rooms at the western edge of the courtyard
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni eke̱mi tšṍ nāgbe̱ le̱ ní yo̱ agbó le̱ mase̱i le̱ ke̱-te hekroṅkroṅ tšũi ní dši oso̱foi le̱ anii ní kwe̱o̱ kōyigbe̱ le̱ anā, ni na, gbe̱he ko ye̱ dše̱i, ye̱ se̱gbe̱ ke̱-yaä anaigbe̱.

english_verse: Around the inside of these smaller courtyards was a low wall of stones, and against the wall were places to build fires.
translation_verse: Ni gbogbo bo̱le edſe̱ le̱ fẽ ke̱-kpe, ni afe late̱i ye̱ gbogboi le̱ ašiši ke̱-kpe.

english_verse: The man said, “These are the kitchens where the temple workers will boil the meat that worshipers offer as sacrifices.”
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Kpatai ní šĩa le̱ súolo̱i le̱ hōo̱ maṅ le̱ gbē-afo̱le le̱ ye̱ mli ne̱.

english_verse: The man said, “Ezekiel, son of man, pay attention to what you've seen.” We walked to the riverbank,
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Gbomobi, ona lo? Ni eke̱mi nyie ke̱-kũ se̱ ke̱-ba fā le̱ nā ekoṅ.

english_verse: where I saw dozens of trees on each side.
translation_verse: Ni beni mikũ mise̱ miba le̱, na, tšei babaō dientše̱ mãmo̱ fā le̱ toi bie̱ ke̱ bie̱.

english_verse: The man said: This water flows eastward to the Jordan River valley and empties into the Dead Sea, where it turns the salt water into fresh water.
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Ne̱ke̱ nu ne̱ hoo̱ ke̱-yaã bokãgbe̱ niiaṅ, ni emãa eyi ši ke̱-yaä ṅã kplanā le̱ no̱, ni eke̱ enā ya-woo̱ *ṅšo̱ le̱ mli, ni ké̱ ete ṅšo̱ le̱ mli le̱, ke̱ke̱ le̱ atšá nu le̱. *

english_verse: Wherever this water flows, there will be all kinds of animals and fish, because it will bring life and fresh water to the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱ nofẽno ní hĩe kã ní tšio̱ ehe ye̱ hefẽhe ní ne̱ke̱ fāi ne̱ aaba le̱ yi aaná wala, ni emli lōi aafá babaō dientše̱; edšake̱ ne̱ke̱ nu ne̱ aaba dše̱i, ni aatšá nofẽno ye̱ heni ne̱ke̱ fā ne̱ aaba le̱, ni eyi aaná wala.

english_verse: From En-Gedi to Eneglaim, people will fish in the sea and dry their nets along the coast. There will be as many kinds of fish in the Dead Sea as there are in the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱ wole̱i le̱ aadamo̱damō̱ nā, ke̱-dše̱ En-Gedi āhũ ke̱-yaši En-Eglaim tō̃ aatšṍmo̱ yāiakamo̱hei; emli lōi le̱ aafe sro̱toisro̱toi, tamo̱ ṅšo̱ wulu le̱ṅ lōi, babaō dientše̱.

english_verse: But the marshes along the shore will remain salty, so that people can use the salt from them.
translation_verse: Ši ehe ṅmiamo̱i ke̱ ṅmo̱to̱i le̱ atšáṅ; aahã ame̱nyṍ ṅō.

english_verse: The northern border will begin at the Mediterranean Sea, then continue eastward to Hethlon, to Lebo-Hamath, then across to Zedad,
translation_verse: Ni šikpoṅ le̱ hũsũ ne̱: Kōyigbe̱ le̱, ke̱-dše̱ ṅšo̱ wulu le̱ nā ke̱-tšṍ Hetlon gbe̱ ke̱-yamõ Zedad,

english_verse: Berothah, and Sibraim, which is on the border between the two kingdoms of Damascus and Hamath. The border will end at Hazer-Hatticon, which is on the border of Hauran.
translation_verse: Hamat, Berota, Sibraim ní kã Damasko ke̱ Hamat hũsũ le̱ teṅ, Teṅ-Hazer ní yo̱ Hauran hũsũ le̱ nā le̱.

english_verse: So the northern border will run between the Mediterranean Sea and Hazar-Enon, which is on the border between Damascus and Hamath.
translation_verse: Ni hũsũ ní kā ke̱-dše̱ ṅšo̱ le̱ nā dši: Hazar-Enon ní kã Damasko hũsũ le̱ nā le̱, ni eteke no̱ ke̱-te kōyigbe̱ ke̱-yamõ Hamat hũsũ le̱; no dši kōyigbe̱ hũsũ le̱.

english_verse: The eastern border will begin on the border between the two kingdoms of Hauran and Damascus. It will run south along the Jordan River, which separates the territories of Gilead and Israel, and it will end at the Dead Sea near the town of Tamar.
translation_verse: Ni bokãgbe̱ hũsũ le̱ adše̱ Hauran ke̱ Damasko teṅ ke̱ Gilead ke̱ Israel šikpoṅ le̱ teṅ ye̱ Iordan fā le̱ he, ni nyesusu ke̱-dše̱ nakai hũsũ le̱ ne̱ ke̱-yaši bokãgbe̱ ṅšo̱ le̱ nā; ni ene̱ dši bokãgbe̱ hũsũ le̱.

english_verse: The southern border will begin at Tamar, then run southwest to the springs near Meribath-Kadesh. It will continue along the Egyptian Gorge and will end at the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱-yaä wuoyigbe̱ le̱: wuoyigbe̱ hũsũ dši ke̱-dše̱ Tamar ke̱-tšṍ *Meribot-Kadeš nui le̱ ahe ke̱-yamõ Mizraim †fā le̱ ke̱ ṅšo̱ wulu le̱; ni ene̱ dši wuoyigbe̱ hũsũ le̱ ye̱ wuoyigbe̱. *

english_verse: The western border will run north along the Mediterranean Sea to a point just west of Lebo-Hamath.
translation_verse: Ni anaigbe̱ hũsũ dši ṅšo̱ wulu le̱, ke̱-dše̱ nakai hũsũ le̱ no̱ āhũ ke̱-yaši Hamat ṅe̱le̱no̱; no dši anaigbe̱ hũsũ le̱.

english_verse: a share of the land given to the tribe where they live. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ni aba mli ake̱ akutšo ní mo le̱ yato gbo̱ ye̱ mli le̱, dše̱i noṅṅ nyehãle̱ egbošinii ye̱, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will give half of my sacred land to the priests. Their share will be twelve and a half kilometers long and five kilometers wide, and my temple will be right in the middle.
translation_verse: Ni mei anõ ní no̱wómo̱-nõkēnõ kroṅkroṅ le̱ atšṍ ne̱: Oso̱foi anõ, kõyigbe̱ le̱ susumo̱tšei akpei-nyoṅmai-enyo̱-ke-enumo̱, ni anaigbe̱ le̱, elē̱mo̱ susumo̱tšei akpei-nyoṅma, ni bokã gbe̱ le̱, elē̱mo̱ susumo̱-tšei akpei-nyoṅma, ni wuoyigbe̱ le̱, eke̱le̱ susumo̱tšei akpei-nyoṅmai-enyo̱-ke̱-enumo̱. Ni Iehowa hekroṅkroṅ le̱ akã teṅ.

english_verse: Only priests who are descendants of Zadok will receive a share of this sacred land, because they remained faithful to me when the Levites and the rest of the Israelites started sinning.
translation_verse: Oso̱foi ní afeame̱ kroṅkroṅ ní dše̱ Zadok bihĩĩ le̱ ateṅ, ní *ame̱tšuo̱ minitšumo̱ le̱, ní beni Israelbii le̱ dũ gbe̱ ní ame̱ le̱ ame̱dũũ gbe̱ tamo̱ bo̱ni Levibii le̱ dũ gbe̱ le̱, ame̱nõ ni. *

english_verse: and they must never sell or trade any of this land—it is the best land and belongs to me.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱kahõ eko, ni ame̱katšake, ni ame̱kaṅõ šikpoṅ le̱ heni hĩ fè fẽ le̱ ame̱hã moko; edšake̱ kroṅkroṅ ni hã Iehowa.

english_verse: South of my sacred land will be a section twelve and a half kilometers long and three kilometers wide. It will not be sacred, but will belong to the people of Israel and will include the city of Jerusalem, together with its houses and pastureland.
translation_verse: Ši susumo̱tšei akpei-enumo̱ ní ſe̱ yo̱ lē̱mo̱ no̱ ye̱ akpei-nyoṅmai-enyo̱-ke̱-enumo̱ le̱ mli le̱ atšṍ kwāsafo šikpoṅ ahã maṅ le̱, ní ake̱-fe šihĩle̱hei ke̱ maṅ he šikpoṅ, ni maṅ le̱ akã teṅ.

english_verse: The land on the east and west sides of the city limits will be farmland for the people of Jerusalem; both sections will be five kilometers long and three kilometers wide.
translation_verse: Ni noni eſe̱ ye̱ ke̱le̱ no̱ ye̱ no̱wómo̱-nõkēnõ kroṅkroṅ le̱ ṅe̱le̱no̱ le̱, akpei-nyoṅma ye̱ bokãgbe̱ le̱ ke̱ akpei-nyoṅma ye̱ anaigbe̱ le̱, ni ekã no̱wómo̱-nõkēnõ kroṅkroṅ le̱ ṅe̱le̱no̱, eno̱ nibānii le̱ afe mã le̱ṅ nitšulo̱i le̱ aniyenii.

english_verse: And so the center of this special section of land will be for my sacred land, as well as for the city and its property. The land will be a square, twelve and a half kilometers on each side.
translation_verse: No̱wómo̱-nõkēnõ le̱ fẽ afe akpei-nyoṅmai-enyo̱-ke̱-enumo̱ ke̱le̱ ke̱ akpei-nyoṅmai-enyo̱-ke̱-enumo̱ lē̱mo̱, kodši edſe̱; no dši no̱wómo̱-nõkēnõ kroṅkroṅ le̱ ke̱ maṅ le̱ gbe̱fãṅnõ le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: together with the share belonging to the Levites and the city of Jerusalem. The northern border of the ruler's property will be the land that belongs to Judah, and the southern border will be the land that belongs to Benjamin. The Division of Land among Tribes in the South The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Ni ke̱-dše̱ Levibii le̱ agbe̱fãṅnõ le̱ ke̱ maṅ le̱ gbe̱fãṅnõ le̱ ní kã lumo̱ le̱ nõ le̱ teṅ le̱ he ye̱ Iuda hũsũ le̱ ke̱ Benyamin hũsũ le̱ teṅ le̱, lumo̱ le̱ nõ ni.

english_verse: Gad's southern border is also the southern border of Israel. It will begin at the town of Tamar, then run southwest to the springs near Meribath-Kadesh. It will continue along the Egyptian Gorge and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Ni Gad hũsũ le̱ mase̱i, ye̱ wuoyigbe̱ hũsũ le̱ no̱ ye̱ wuoyigbe̱ le̱, hũsũ le̱ adše̱ *Tamar ke̱-yaši Meribot-Kadeš nui le̱ ke̱ Mizraim fã le̱ nā ke̱-yaši ṅšo̱ wulu le̱ nā. *

english_verse: That's how the land of Israel will be divided among the twelve tribes. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Gates of Jerusalem The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ene̱ dši šikpoṅ le̱ ní nyebafõ ošiki nyeke̱-dša mli nyehã Israel akutšei le̱ ni etšṍ ame̱gbošinii le̱, ni ene̱mei dši ame̱gbe̱fãṅnii le̱, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: and so the total length of the wall will be ten kilometers. The new name of the city will be “The-Lord-Is-Here!”
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ efeo̱ susumo̱tšei akpei-nyoṅma-ke̱-kpānyo̱ ke̱-bo̱lele̱ ke̱-kpe. Ni ke̱-dše̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ maṅ le̱ gbe̱i dši: Iehowa *ye̱ dšei! *

english_verse: The king said, “They must be healthy, handsome, smart, wise, educated, and fit to serve in the royal palace. Teach them how to speak and write our language
translation_verse: gbekẽbii ní kpa ko be̱ ame̱he, ní ame̱he yo̱ fe̱o ní ame̱anyi ṅā-fẽ-ṅā ame̱-kase, ní ame̱le nii, ní ame̱yo̱ dſẽṅmo̱, ni ame̱anyẽ maṅtše̱ le̱ mō̃ le̱ṅ ame̱damo̱, koni atšõame̱ Kaldeamei awoloṅ ke̱ wiemo̱.

english_verse: and give them the same food and wine that I am served. Train them for three years, and then they can become court officials.”
translation_verse: Ni maṅtše̱ le̱ to ake̱ ahãame̱ ame̱dāṅmā̃ ke̱-dše̱ le̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ dientše̱ eniyenii ke̱ ewein ní enuo̱ le̱ mli; ni alè̱ame̱ afii etẽ, ní no se̱ ní ame̱badamo̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ hĩe.

english_verse: Four of the young Jews chosen were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, all from the tribe of Judah.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱teṅ mei ni dše̱ Iudabii le̱ ateṅ dši Daniel, Hanania, Mišael ke̱ Azaria.

english_verse: But the king's chief official gave them Babylonian names: Daniel became Belteshazzar, Hananiah became Shadrach, Mishael became Meshach, and Azariah became Abednego.
translation_verse: Ni piafoi le̱ anukpa le̱ woame̱ gbe̱i, ni ewo Daniel Beltešazar, ni Hanania le̱, ewole̱ Šadrak, ni Mišael le̱, ewole̱ Mešak, ni Azaria le̱, ewole̱ Abednego.

english_verse: Daniel made up his mind to eat and drink only what God had approved for his people to eat. And he asked the king's chief official for permission not to eat the food and wine served in the royal palace.
translation_verse: Ni Daniel kpe̱ mli ye̱ etšui mli ake̱ eke̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ niyenii ke̱ ewein ní enuo̱ le̱ buleṅ ehe, ni ekpa piafoi le̱ anukpa le̱ fai, koni ekabule ehe.

english_verse: God had made the official friendly and kind to Daniel.
translation_verse: Ni Nyoṅmo̱ hã Daniel hĩe banyam ye̱ piafoi le̱ anukpa le̱ hĩe, ni emũsũṅ tšõle̱ ye̱ ehewo̱.

english_verse: But the man still told him, “The king has decided what you must eat and drink. And I am afraid he will kill me, if you eat something else and end up looking worse than the other young men.”
translation_verse: Ni piafoi le̱ anukpa le̱ kē̱ Daniel ake̱: Mīše minuṅtšo̱ maṅtše̱ ní eto nyeniyenii ke̱ nyedā̃ ehãnye le̱ gbeyei, ake̱ aleenõ eena nyehĩe mo̱bo̱mo̱bo̱ fè gbekẽbiihĩĩ nyetipẽṅfoi le̱ ahĩe, ni nyeahã miyiwala atõ ye̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ hĩe.

english_verse: The king's official had put a guard in charge of Daniel and his three friends. So Daniel said to the guard,
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱ Daniel ke̱ niyenii ano̱kwe̱lo̱ ní piafoi le̱ anukpa le̱ edšie eto Daniel, Hanania, Mišael ke̱ Azaria no̱ le̱ ake̱:

english_verse: “For the next ten days, let us have only vegetables and water at mealtime.
translation_verse: Ka otšũdši okwe̱ gbĩĩ nyoṅma, ni ahãwo̱ ſie ní wo̱ye ke̱ nu ní wo̱nu;

english_verse: When the ten days are up, compare how we look with the other young men, and decide what to do with us.”
translation_verse: ni akwe̱ wo̱hĩeaṅ ke̱ gbekẽbii ní yeo̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ niyenii le̱ ahĩeaṅ ye̱ ohĩe, ni bo̱fẽbo̱ ní oona le̱, ní oke̱ otšũdši aye̱.

english_verse: The guard agreed to do what Daniel had asked.
translation_verse: Ni eboame̱ toi ye̱ ne̱ke̱ sanee ne̱ mli, ni ekaame̱ ekwe̱ gbĩ nyoṅma.

english_verse: Ten days later, Daniel and his friends looked healthier and better than the young men who had been served food from the royal palace.
translation_verse: Ni gbĩĩ nyoṅma le̱ se̱ le̱ anaa ake̱ ame̱hĩeãa efe fe̱o, ni ame̱ſiſī fè gbekẽbii fẽ ni yeo̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ niyenii le̱.

english_verse: After this, the guard let them eat vegetables instead of the rich food and wine.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ niyenii ano̱kwe̱lo̱ le̱ dšieo̱ ame̱niyenii le̱ ke̱ wein ní ahãa ame̱ ní ame̱nu le̱, ni ahãa-ame̱ ſie.

english_verse: God made the four young men smart and wise. They read a lot of books and became well educated. Daniel could also tell the meaning of dreams and visions.
translation_verse: Ši ne̱ke̱ gbekẽbiihĩĩ edſe̱ ne̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hã ame̱le nii, ni ame̱nyẽ ame̱kase wolo-fẽ-wolo ke̱ nilē-fẽ-nilē; ni Daniel le̱, ehã ena ninā-fẽ-ninā ke̱ lamõi ašiši. Ezek.

english_verse: At the end of the three-year period set by King Nebuchadnezzar, his chief palace official brought all the young men to him.
translation_verse: Ni beni gbĩĩ ní maṅtše̱ le̱ eto ake̱ ake̱ame̱ aba ee̱ še̱ le̱, piafoi le̱ anukpa le̱ ke̱ame̱ ba Nebukadnezar hĩe.

english_verse: The king interviewed them and discovered that none of the others were as outstanding as Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. So they were given positions in the royal court.
translation_verse: Ni maṅtše̱ le̱ ke̱ame̱ wie, ni ame̱fẽ le̱ anaa ame̱teṅ mokomoko ní tamo̱ Daniel, Hanania, Mišael ke̱ Azaria; nohewo̱ le̱ ame̱badamo̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ hĩe.

english_verse: From then on, whenever the king asked for advice, he found their wisdom was ten times better than that of any of his other advisors and magicians.
translation_verse: Ni ṅā ke̱ nilē sãdši fẽ ni maṅtše̱ le̱ biame̱ le̱ ena ye̱ mli ake̱ ame̱fē woloṅlelo̱i ke̱ okõmfoi fẽ ní yo̱ emaṅtše̱yelihei le̱ fẽ le̱ šii nyoṅma.

english_verse: Daniel served there until the first year of King Cyrus.
translation_verse: Ni Daniel hĩ dšeṅ ke̱-yaši maṅtše̱ *Koreš kleṅkleṅ afi le̱ no̱. *Ezra

english_verse: But the king replied, “No! I have made up my mind. If you don't tell me both the dream and its meaning, you will be chopped to pieces and your houses will be torn down.
translation_verse: Maṅtše̱ le̱ to he ni ekē̱ Kaldeamei le̱ ake̱: Mihĩe ekpa no̱. Ši na, ke̱dši nyetšõõmi lamõ le̱ ke̱ ešiši le̱, aaflo̱ nyenṅi dukuduku, ni aahã nyešĩai le̱ atšṍmo̱ tumu.

english_verse: His advisors explained, “Your Majesty, you are demanding the impossible! No king, not even the most famous and powerful, has ever ordered his advisors, magicians, or wise men to do such a thing.
translation_verse: Kaldeamei le̱ to he hã maṅtše̱ le̱, ni ame̱kē̱: Mokomoko be̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ni aanyẽ maṅtše̱ sane ne̱ atšõ, nohewo̱ le̱, maṅtše̱ ko hũ be̱, ni ké̱ edši agbo ke̱ hewalo̱ tete le̱, ní eebi ne̱ke̱ sane ye̱ woloṅlelo̱ lo okõmfo le Kaldeanyo ko deṅ;

english_verse: This made the king so angry that he gave orders for every wise man in Babylonia to be put to death, including Daniel and his three friends. God Tells Nebuchadnezzar's Dream to Daniel
translation_verse: Ni akpo̱ le̱ dšekpo, ake̱ agbe nilelo̱i le̱, ni ātao Daniel ke̱ enanemei le̱ hũ, ní agbeame̱.

english_verse: Then he said, “Pray that the God who rules from heaven will be merciful and explain this mystery, so that we and the others won't be put to death.”
translation_verse: koni ame̱kpa ṅwei Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ fai, ní emũsũṅ atšõle̱ ye̱ ame̱hewo̱ ye̱ ne̱ke̱ tēmo̱sane ne̱ hewo̱, koni akakpãtã Daniel ke̱ enanemei le̱ able afata Babel nilelo̱i krokomei le̱ ahe.

english_verse: In a vision one night, Daniel was shown the dream and its meaning. Then he praised the God who rules from heaven:
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni *adšie ne̱ke̱ tēmo̱sane ne̱ ši atšõ Daniel nyōṅ ye̱ ninā mli; nohewo̱ le̱ Daniel dšie ṅwei Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ yi. *K.

english_verse: “Our God, your name will be praised forever and forever. You are all-powerful, and you know everything.
translation_verse: Ni Daniel wó enā no̱ ekē̱: Adsĩe Nyoṅmo̱ gbe̱i le̱ yi ke̱-dše̱ nāno̱ ke̱-yaši nāno̱, edšake̱ enõ dši nilē ke̱ hewale̱ fẽ!

english_verse: You control human events— you give rulers their power and take it away, and you are the source of wisdom and knowledge.
translation_verse: Le̱ dši moni tšakeo̱ be ke̱ yino̱, le̱ *ekpaä maṅtše̱mei, ni esā ewoo̱ maṅtše̱mei, le̱ ehãa ṅālelo̱i leo̱ ṅā, ni nilelo̱i hũ leo̱ nii. *

english_verse: You are the God who was worshiped by my ancestors. Now I thank you and praise you for making me wise and telling me the king's dream, together with its meaning.” Daniel Interprets the Dream
translation_verse: Bo, mitše̱mei a-Nyoṅmo̱, mīdao ši, ni mīdšie oyi, ake̱ ohãmi nilē ke̱ hewale̱, ní agbe̱ne̱ otšõmi noni wo̱kpao he fai le̱; edšake̱ otšòwo̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ sane le̱.

english_verse: Arioch rushed Daniel to the king and announced, “Your Majesty, I have found out that one of the men brought here from Judah can explain your dream.”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Ariok he fe oyá ni eke̱ Daniel te maṅtše̱ le̱ ṅõ, ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Mina nū ko ye̱ Iuda nomṅō̃bii le̱ ateṅ, ni anyẽ atšõ maṅtše̱ šiši.

english_verse: However, you must realize that these mysteries weren't explained to me because I am smarter than everyone else. Instead, it was done so that you would understand what you have seen.
translation_verse: Ši mi le, *dšee minii ní mile tšṍ fè hĩekãlo̱i fẽ hewo̱ ni adšie ne̱ke̱ tēmo̱sane ne̱ ši atšõmi, ši moṅ beni afe ní atšõ maṅtše̱ šiši; ni ole otšuiṅ dſẽṅmo̱i le̱ hewo̱ṅ. *

english_verse: Your Majesty, what you saw standing in front of you was a huge and terrifying statue, shining brightly.
translation_verse: Bo maṅtše̱ ōkwe̱, ni na, amãgã kpeteṅkple ko ne̱, ni ne̱ke̱ amãgã ne̱ da, ni ekpe̱o̱ ake̱ noko, ni edamo̱ ohĩe, ni ehe ye̱ gbeyei.

english_verse: Its head was made of gold, its chest and arms were silver, and from its waist down to its knees, it was bronze.
translation_verse: Ne̱ke̱ amãgã ne̱ yitšo le̱ šika kpakpa ni, etšitši ke̱ enidši le̱ dſie̱te̱i ni, emũsũ ke̱ ehe̱ le̱ akō̱ble ni,

english_verse: From there to its ankles it was iron, and its feet were a mixture of iron and clay.
translation_verse: eſŭo̱dši le̱ dade ni, enãdši le̱ fã dade, ni fã hũ sũ.

english_verse: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver, and the gold were crushed and blown away without a trace, like husks of wheat at threshing time. But the stone became a tremendous mountain that covered the entire earth.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni dade le̱ ke̱ sũ le̱ ke̱ akō̱ble le̱ ke̱ dſie̱te̱i le̱ ke̱ šika le̱ fẽ-tſẽm dſăra wo̱tšo̱wo̱tšo̱, ni ame̱tšṍmo̱ tamo̱ ablenāšadsi nī dſere gbo ablešāhe, ni kō̱yo̱ lōame̱ ke̱-te ni anaa-ame̱ ye̱ hekoheko doṅṅ; ši te̱ le̱ ní tſa amãgã le̱ tšṍ goṅ kpeteṅkple, ni ekpĕle šikpoṅ mū le̱ fẽ no̱.

english_verse: That was the dream, and now I'll tell you what it means.
translation_verse: Lamõ le̱ ne̱; ni wo̱o̱tšõ ešiši hũ ye̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ hĩe.

english_verse: Your Majesty, you are the greatest of kings, and God has highly honored you with power
translation_verse: Bo maṅtše̱ dši *maṅtše̱mei amaṅtše̱, ni ṅwei Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ eṅõ maṅtše̱yeli ke̱ hewale̱ ke̱ no̱yeli ke̱ anumnyam ehão; *Ezek.

english_verse: After you are gone, another kingdom will rule, but it won't be as strong. Then it will be followed by a kingdom of bronze that will rule the whole world.
translation_verse: Ni ose̱ le̱ maṅtše̱yeli kroko aate ši ní ke̱o yee egbo̱, ke̱ maṅtše̱yeli kroko ni dši etẽ ní dši akō̱ble nõ, ni eeye šikpoṅ le̱ fẽ no̱.

english_verse: This fourth kingdom will be divided—it will be both strong and brittle, just as you saw that the feet and toes were a mixture of iron and clay.
translation_verse: Ni bo̱ni enanewābii le̱ fã dade ni fã hũ sũ le̱, nakai noṅṅ maṅtše̱yeli le̱ fã mli aawa, ni fã hũ aadſa.

english_verse: This kingdom will be the result of a marriage between kingdoms, but it will crumble, just as iron and clay don't stick together.
translation_verse: Ni beni ona dade ni sũ ni akpo̱to̱ futu mli le̱, nakai ame̱ke̱ gbomei asešibii aafutu ame̱mli moṅ, ši ame̱kpe̱te̱ṅ, take̱ beni dade ke̱ sũ futuu le̱.

english_verse: During the time of those kings, the God who rules from heaven will set up an eternal kingdom that will never fall. It will be like the stone that was cut from the mountain, but not by human hands—the stone that crushed the iron, bronze, clay, silver, and gold. Your Majesty, in your dream the great God has told you what is going to happen, and you can trust this interpretation. Daniel Is Promoted
translation_verse: take̱ bo̱ni ona ake̱ *te̱ le̱ tše ke̱-dše̱ goṅ le̱ no̱ bagbẽ ši ni dšee nine sa he, ni edſăra dade le̱ ke̱ akō̱ble le̱ ke̱ sũ le̱ ke̱ dſie̱te̱i le̱ ke̱ šika le̱. — Nyoṅmo̱ agbo le̱ edšie noni baba wó̱se̱ etšõ maṅtše̱, ni lamõ le̱ ye̱ mli, ni ešišitšõmo̱ le̱ hũ mã ši šiṅṅ. *K.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar bowed low to the ground and worshiped Daniel. Then he gave orders for incense to be burned and a sacrifice of grain to be offered in honor of Daniel.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni maṅtše̱ Nebukadnezar ke̱ ehĩe bu ši, ni edšá Daniel, ni efã́ ake̱ ašã afo̱le ke̱ tšofăi-ke̱-ṅmai ahāle̱.

english_verse: The king said, “Now I know that your God is above all other gods and kings, because he gave you the power to explain this mystery.”
translation_verse: Maṅtše̱ le̱ here Daniel no̱ ni ekē̱: Le̱le̱ṅ ake̱ nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ *dši nyoṅmo̱i a-Nyoṅmo̱ ke̱ maṅtše̱mei anuṅtšo̱ ke̱ tēmo̱sãdši akpodšielo̱, ake̱ noni onyẽ odšie ne̱ke̱ tēmosane ne̱ kpo ne̱. *

english_verse: The king then presented Daniel with a lot of gifts; he promoted him to governor of Babylon Province and put him in charge of the other wise men.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni maṅtše̱ le̱ fe Daniel gbomo agbo, *ni ekele̱ nii wudši babaō, ni ewole̱ no̱yelo̱ ye̱ Babel šikpoṅ le̱ fẽ no̱, ke̱ Babel nilelo̱i le̱ fẽ no̱ onukpa. *K.

english_verse: At Daniel's request, the king appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego to high positions in Babylon Province, and he let Daniel stay on as a palace official.
translation_verse: Ni Daniel bi maṅtše̱ le̱, ni *eṅō Šadrak, Mešak ke̱ Abednego eto Babel šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ nitšumo̱i le̱ ano̱, ši Daniel le̱, ehĩ maṅtše̱ we le̱. *

english_verse: and the king's high officials, governors, and advisors all crowded around them. The men were not burned, their hair wasn't scorched, and their clothes didn't even smell like smoke.
translation_verse: Ni maṅtše̱ le̱ amraloi le̱ ke̱ lume̱i le̱ ke̱ akutšei anukpai le̱ ke̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ adšinafoi le̱ bua ame̱he nā ni ame̱bakwe̱ ne̱ke̱ gbomei ne̱, ni ame̱na ake̱ la le̱ náá hewale̱ ko ye̱ ame̱gbomotšei ano̱, ni ame̱yiteṅ tšo̱i ṅălãã, ni ame̱tadei le̱ tšakee, asaṅ lasũ tete edšee fũ ye̱ ame̱he. Heb.

english_verse: Then an official stood up and announced: People of every nation and race, now listen to the king's command!
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni šie̱lo̱ le̱ bo wā ake̱: Nye mãdši ke̱ asafoi ke̱ wiemo̱i! ākē̱nye ake̱:

english_verse: Some Babylonians used this as a chance to accuse the Jews to King Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ amrõ le̱ noṅṅ le̱ Kaldeamei komei ba ni ame̱baflo̱ Iudafoi le̱ anā,

english_verse: They said, “Your Majesty, we hope you live forever!
translation_verse: ame̱wó ame̱nā no̱ ni ame̱kē̱ maṅtše̱ Nebukadnezar ake̱: Maṅtše̱, oyi aná wala ke̱-ya nāno̱!

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar was furious. So he sent for the three young men and said,
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ní Nebukadnezar ke̱ mlifũ ke̱ mlila fã́ ake̱ ayaṅõ Šadrak, Mešak ke̱ Abednego ke̱-ba. Ni ayaṅõ ne̱ke̱ gbomei ne̱ ke̱-ba maṅtše̱ le̱ hĩe.

english_verse: “I hear that you refuse to worship my gods and the gold statue I have set up.
translation_verse: Ni Nebukadnezar wó enā no̱ ni ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Šadrak, Mešak ke̱ Abednego, ani nyehĩe kã he ni nyesúmo̱o̱ mi-nyoṅmo̱i te, ni nyedšáá šika amãgã le̱ ni mike̱-mã ši le̱?

english_verse: Now I am going to give you one more chance. If you bow down and worship the statue when you hear the music, everything will be all right. But if you don't, you will at once be thrown into a flaming furnace. No god can save you from me.”
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ ke̱dši nyesā nyehe nyeto le̱, no le̱ befẽbe ní nyeanu kōfẽṅ le̱ ke̱ ble̱ le̱ ke̱ saṅkũ le̱ ke̱ kete le̱ ke̱ obentá le̱ ke̱ obónu le̱ ke̱ dšõ̀i sro̱toi le̱ fẽ agbē̱mo̱ le̱, nyekũlaä ši; ni nyedšáa amãgã ni mife le̱; ši ke̱dši nyedšáá le̱, nakai nmle̱tſā le̱ no̱ noṅṅ le̱ aaše̱re̱nye aſie la ke̱ flõnõ ní tšoo̱ grigri le̱ mli! Ni *namo dši Nyoṅmo̱ ní aadšienye ye̱ mideṅ le̱? *

english_verse: The three men replied, “Your Majesty, we don't need to defend ourselves.
translation_verse: Šadrak, Mešak ke̱ Abednego here no̱ ni ame̱kē̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ ake̱: Nebukadnezar, ehĩaawo̱ ake̱ wo̱hão hetō ye̱ ne̱ke̱ sane ne̱ mli.

english_verse: The God we worship can save us from you and your flaming furnace.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši nakai le̱, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ní wo̱súmoo̱ le̱ aanyẽ adšiewo̱ ye̱ *la de̱ flõnõ ní tšoo̱ grigri le̱ mli, ni eedsiewo̱ ye̱ odeṅ, maṅtše̱. *Lal.

english_verse: But even if he doesn't, we still won't worship your gods and the gold statue you have set up.”
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ dšee nakai hũ le̱, maṅtše̱, ná ole ake̱ wo̱súmo̱ṅ onyoṅmo̱i le̱, ni wo̱dšáṅ šika amãgã ní oke̱-mã ši le̱.

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar's face twisted with anger at the three men. And he ordered the furnace to be heated seven times hotter than usual.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Nebukadnezar mli wo la naakpa, ni ehĩe tšake sro̱to ko ewo Šadrak, Mešak ke̱ Abednego, ni efã́ ake̱ ame̱hã flõnõ le̱ ado̱ toi kpawo fè be̱ni ahãa edo̱ö̱ dā le̱.

english_verse: Next, he commanded some of his strongest soldiers to tie up the men and throw them into the flaming furnace.
translation_verse: No efã́ eta le̱ mli hĩi hewalo̱i komei ake̱ ame̱fĩmo̱ Šadrak, Mešak ke̱ Abednego, ni ame̱yaše̱re̱ame̱ ame̱ſie la ke̱ flõnõ ní tšoo̱ grigri le̱ mli.

english_verse: Suddenly the king jumped up and shouted, “Weren't only three men tied up and thrown into the fire?” “Yes, Your Majesty,” his officers answered.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni maṅtše̱ Nebukadnezar nā kpe̱ ehe, ni ete ši oyá, ni ekē̱ edšinafoi le̱ ake̱: Ani dšee mei etẽ wo̱fĩmo̱ wo̱wo la le̱ mli le̱? Ame̱here no̱ ni ame̱kē̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ ake̱: Eye̱ṅ, maṅtše̱!

english_verse: “But I see four men walking around in the fire,” the king replied. “None of them is tied up or harmed, and the fourth one looks like a god.”
translation_verse: Ehere no̱ ni ekē̱: Na, mi le̱ mina mli edſe̱ ni afẽneame̱ ní *amenyie la le̱ mli, ni nokonoko efekoame̱, ni moni gbe yi fe edſe̱ le̱ bu tamo̱ †nyoṅmoi le̱ abi! *Ies.

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar went closer to the flaming furnace and said to the three young men, “You servants of the Most High God, come out at once!” They came out,
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Nebukadnezar tši be̱ṅke̱ la ke̱ flõnõ ni tšoo̱ grigri le̱ nā, ni ewó enā no̱ ekē̱: Šadrak ke̱ Mešak ke̱ Abednego, nye Nyoṅmo̱ moni yo̱ ṅwei šoṅṅ le̱ tšũdši, nyedšea kpo ni nyebaä! Ke̱ke̱ ni Šadrak ke̱ Mešak ke̱ Abednego dše kpo ye̱ la le̱ mli.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar said: Praise their God for sending an angel to rescue his servants! They trusted their God and refused to obey my commands. Yes, they chose to die rather than to worship or serve any god except their own.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Nebukadnezar wó enā no̱ ni ekē̱: Adšie Šadrak, Mešak ke̱ Abednego Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ yi ake̱ *etšũ ebo̱fo, ni ebadšie etšũdši ni ṅõ ame̱hĩe ame̱fõ eno̱, ni ame̱tšake maṅtše̱ le̱ wiemo̱ le̱ hĩe, ni ame̱ṅò ame̱gbomotšei ame̱hã koni ame̱kasúmo̱ nyoṅmo̱ ko nyoṅmo̱ ko ní ame̱dšá-le̱, ake̱ dša ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ke̱ke̱ le̱!

english_verse: And I won't allow people of any nation or race to say anything against their God. Anyone who does will be chopped up and their houses will be torn down, because no other god has such great power to save.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ miwo akpo̱ ake̱: Maṅ-lẽ-maṅ ke̱ asafo-fẽ-asafo ke̱ wiemo̱-fẽ-wiemo̱ ní aawie Šadrak ke̱ Mešak ke̱ Abednego Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ he efõṅ ko le̱, aaflo̱ ame̱mli dukuduku, ni aahã ame̱šĩai atšṍ-mo̱ tumu; edšake̱ *Nyoṅmo̱ ko Nyoṅmo̱ ko be̱ ní aanyẽ mo adšie ne̱ke̱. *

english_verse: After this happened, the king appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego to even higher positions in Babylon Province.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni maṅtše̱ le̱ wó Šadrak, Mešak ke̱ Abednego no̱ ye̱ Babel šikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: I was enjoying a time of peace and prosperity,
translation_verse: Mi Nebukadnezar miye̱ hedšo̱le̱ ye̱ miwe ne̱, m mīſere ye̱ mimō̃ ne̱ mli;

english_verse: Then I commanded every wise man in Babylonia to appear in my court, so they could explain the meaning of my dream.
translation_verse: Ni miwo akpo̱, ake̱ ayaṅõ Babel nilelo̱i le̱ fẽ ke̱-ba mihĩe, koni ame̱batšõmi lamõ le̱ šiši.

english_verse: Finally, a young man named Daniel came in, and I told him the dream. The holy gods had given him special powers, and I had renamed him Belteshazzar after my own god.
translation_verse: Ši beni yi yawula ši le̱, Daniel, moni atšé̱o̱le̱ Beltešazar, take̱ bo̱ni atšé̱o̱ minyoṅmo̱ le̱ gbe̱i le̱, moni *nyoṅmo̱i kroṅkroṅi le̱ amumo̱ yo̱ emli le̱, ba mihĩe, ni migba lamõ le̱ ye̱ ehĩe mikē̱: *

english_verse: I said, “Belteshazzar, not only are you the wisest of all advisors and counselors, but the holy gods have given you special powers to solve the most difficult mysteries. So listen to what I dreamed and tell me what it means:
translation_verse: Beltešezar, woloṅlelo̱i le̱ anukpa, ake̱-ní mile ake̱ nyoṅmo̱i kroṅkroṅi le̱ amumo̱ ye̱ omli ni *tēmo̱sane ko tēmo̱sane ko waa hãão hewo̱ le̱, gbami milamõ mli nināi ní mina le̱ ke̱ ešiši. *Ezek.

translation_verse: ešiši ne̱, maṅtše̱, ni moni yo̱ ṅwei šoṅṅ le̱ adšina ní baä minuṅtšo̱ maṅtše̱ no̱ ne̱:

translation_verse: Nohewo̱ te, maṅtše̱, hã miṅāwō le̱ asa ohĩe, ni oke̱ dšale̱ akũmo̱ ohe ešai le̱ aſie, ni oke̱ *ohĩafoi amo̱bo̱nale̱ akũmo̱ onišaianii le̱, ake̱ aleenõ no aahã ohedšole̱ le̱ se̱ atše̱ ahão lo. Abe̱i

english_verse: This was no sooner said than done—I was forced to live like a wild animal; I ate grass and was unprotected from the dew. As time went by, my hair grew longer than eagle feathers, and my fingernails looked like the claws of a bird.

english_verse: Finally, I prayed to God in heaven, and my mind was healed. Then I said: “I praise and honor God Most High. God lives forever, and his kingdom will never end.
translation_verse: Ni gbĩĩ le̱ ase̱ le̱ mi, Nebukadnezar, mihole mihĩeṅme̱ii ano̱ mikwe̱ ṅwei, ni midſẽṅmo̱ kũ se̱ ba mimli ekoṅ, ni midšie moni yo̱ ṅwei šoṅṅ te yi, ni mikafo ni miwo moni hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yašio̱ nāno̱ le̱ hĩe nyam; edšake̱ *eno̱yeli le̱ nāno̱ no̱yeli ni, ni emaṅtše̱yeli le̱ ye̱ ke̱-dše̱ yino̱ ke̱-yaä yino̱. *K.

english_verse: To him the nations are far less than nothing; God controls the stars in the sky and everyone on this earth. When God does something, we cannot change it or even ask why.”

english_verse: At that time my mind was healed, and once again I became the ruler of my glorious kingdom. My advisors and officials returned to me, and I had greater power than ever before.
translation_verse: Nakai be te mli noṅṅ te midſẽṅmo̱ kũ se̱ ba mimli ekoṅ, ni beni afe ni mimaṅtše̱yeli le̱ hĩe aba nyam ekoṅ he-wo̱ le̱, miwō ke̱ mihĩentšo ne̱ kpe̱mo̱ le̱ kũ se̱ ba miṅõ ekoṅ, ni midšinafoi ke̱ minukpai le̱ taomi, ni aṅõmi ato mimaṅtše̱yeli le̱ no̱ ekoṅ, ni aṅõ hewale̱ ni fè tšutšu nõ te afata he ahãmi.

english_verse: That's why I say: “Praise and honor the King who rules from heaven! Everything he does is honest and fair, and he can shatter the power of those who are proud.”
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ agbe̱ne̱ mi, Nebukadnezar, mīdšie ṅwei maṅtše̱ le̱ yi, ni mīwó eno̱, ni mīwo ehĩe nyam; edšake̱ enitšumo̱i fẽ le̱ ano̱kwale ni, ni egbe̱i hũ dša, ni *mei ní yo̱ hewō dšeṅ le̱ enyẽo̱ame̱ ši ebaä. *

english_verse: Suddenly a human hand was seen writing on the plaster wall of the palace. The hand was just behind the lampstand, and the king could see it writing.
translation_verse: Nakai ṅmle̱tſā le̱ ne̱ noṅṅ te gbomo nine wābii dše kpo, ni ebaṅmã nii ye̱ kanetšo te ṅe̱le̱no̱ ye̱ maṅtše̱ mō̃ leṅ gbogbo ní aša he kālō le̱ he; ni maṅtše̱ le̱ na nine ní ṅmãa nii le̱.

english_verse: and they were completely puzzled. Now the king was more afraid than ever before, and his face turned white as a ghost.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni maṅtše̱ Belšazar hao naakpa, ni ehĩe tšake, ni enukpai le̱ hũ fe yā.

english_verse: When the queen heard the king and his officials talking, she came in and said: Your Majesty, I hope you live forever! Don't be afraid or look so pale.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ ke̱ enukpai le̱ awiemo̱i ahewo̱ le̱ maṅnye le̱ ba okplõṅmẽ asa le̱ no̱, ni ewó enā no̱ ekē̱: Maṅtše̱, oyi ana wala ke̱-ya nāno̱! Kāhã odſẽṅmo̱i mĩhaoö, ni kāhã ohĩe mītšake!

english_verse: In your kingdom there is a man who has been given special powers by the holy gods. When your father Nebuchadnezzar was king, this man was known to be as smart, intelligent, and wise as the gods themselves. Your father put him in charge of all who claimed they could talk with the spirits or understand the meanings in the stars or tell about the future.
translation_verse: Nū ko ye̱ omaṅtše̱yeli le̱ mli, ni *nyoṅmo̱i kroṅkroṅi le̱ amumo̱ yo̱ emli, ni otše̱ yino̱ le̱ ana hĩetē̃ ke̱ dſẽṅmo̱ ke̱ nilē ni tamo̱ nyoṅmo̱i le̱ anilē ye̱ emli, ni maṅtše̱ Nebukadnezar, otše̱ le̱, wole̱ woloṅlelo̱i ke̱ okõmfoi ke̱ Kaldeamei ke̱ ṅulamiiaṅkwe̱lo̱i le̱ anukpa, bo̱ni otše̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ fe ne̱, *

english_verse: When Daniel was brought in, the king said: So you are Daniel, one of the captives my father brought back from Judah!
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ayaṅõ Daniel ke̱-ba maṅtše̱ le̱ hĩe. Ni maṅtše̱ le̱ wó enā no̱ ni ekē̱ Daniel ake̱: Ani bo dši Daniel le̱ ní dše̱ Iuda nomṅō̃ gbomei ni mitše̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ yaṅō ke̱-dše̱ Iudea ke̱-ba le̱ ateṅ le̱ lo?

english_verse: I was told that the gods have given you special powers and that you are intelligent and very wise.
translation_verse: Ši minu ohe ake̱ nyoṅmo̱i le̱ amumo̱ ye̱ omli, ni anaä hĩetē̃ ke̱ dſẽṅmo̱ ke̱ nilē ní teke no̱ ye̱ omli.

english_verse: Neither my advisors nor the men who talk with the spirits of the dead could read this writing or tell me what it means.
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱ ake̱ nilelo̱i ke̱ okõmfoi ne̱ ba mihĩe, koni ame̱bakane ne̱ke̱ ṅmãle̱ ne̱, ni ame̱tšõmi šiši, ši ame̱nyẽẽ wiemo̱ le̱ šiši ame̱tšõ.

english_verse: But I have been told that you understand everything and that you can solve difficult problems. translation_verse: Ni minu ohe, ake̱ onyẽo̱ nibii ašiši otšõo̱, ni ofẽneo̱ kpoi hũ; agbe̱ne̱ ke̱dši oonyẽ ṅmãle̱ le̱ okane, ni otšõmi šiši le̱, aawoö atade afaseo, ni aawo okue̱ šika kõšõṅkõšõ, ni ootšṍ no̱yelo̱ moni ši etẽ ye̱ maṅtše̱yeli le̱ mli!

english_verse: Daniel answered: Your Majesty, I will read the writing and tell you what it means. But you may keep your gifts or give them to someone else.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Daniel here no̱, ni ekē̱ ye̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ hĩe ake̱: Hã onikēnii le̱ ahĩ ši ahão, ni oṅõ onyõmo̱wo le̱ hũ ohã mokroko; ši kẽle̱ makane ṅmãle̱ le̱ matšõ maṅtše̱, ni matšõle̱ šiši hũ.

english_verse: Sir, the Most High God made your father a great and powerful man and brought him much honor and glory.

translation_verse: .] ni mene̱mei hũ, eṅõ onukpai etẽ eto ame̱no̱, ní Daniel dši ame̱teṅ mokome, koni amraloi ne̱ ababu akontā atšõame̱, ní maṅtše̱ le̱ noko hĩe akakpãtã.

english_verse: They all went to the king and said: “Your Majesty, we hope you live forever!

translation_verse: .] Ke̱ke̱ ni miṅtše̱ le̱ yiṅ ke̱-te emō̃ le̱ mli, ni ehĩ ṅmā̃ nyō le̱ṅ fẽ, ni ehãã ake̱ hemo ko aba eṅõ, ni ewo̱ tšere̱ ye̱ ehĩe.

english_verse: He was anxious and shouted, “Daniel, you were faithful and served your God. Was he able to save you from the lions?”

english_verse: My God knew that I was innocent, and he sent an angel to keep the lions from eating me. Your Majesty, I have never done anything to hurt you.”
translation_verse: .] Mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ etšũ *ebo̱fo, ni ehaṅã́mo̱ †dšatai le̱ anābui, ni ame̱yekomi awui ko, edšake̱ ehĩe le̱ ana ake̱ miye bem, ni bo maṅtše̱ hũ ohĩe le̱ mifeko efõṅ ko. *

english_verse: The king was relieved to hear Daniel's voice, and he gave orders for him to be taken out of the pit. Daniel's faith in his God had kept him from being harmed.
translation_verse: .] Ke̱ke̱ ni maṅtše̱ le̱ ná mīše̱ naakpa, ni efã́ ake̱ adšie Daniel ye̱ bu le̱ mli. Ni adšie Daniel ye̱ bu le̱ mli, ni anaa awui ko ni ayele̱, edšake̱ *eke̱ ehĩe fõ e-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ no̱. *Lal.

english_verse: And the king ordered the men who had brought charges against Daniel to be thrown into the pit, together with their wives and children. But before they even reached the bottom, the lions ripped them to pieces.
translation_verse: .] Ni maṅtše̱ le̱ fã́, ni ake̱ nakai gbomei le̱ ni baflo̱ Daniel nā le̱ ba, ni aše̱re̱ame̱ aſie dšatai abu le̱ mli, ame̱ ke̱ ame̱bii ke̱ ame̱ṅãmei, ni ame̱še̱e̱ bu le̱ šiši tete, ni dšatai le̱ mo̱mo̱ame̱, ni ame̱dſăra ame̱wui fẽ.

english_verse: King Darius then sent this message to all people of every nation and race in the world: “Greetings to all of you!
translation_verse: .] Ke̱ke̱ ni maṅtše̱ Dario ṅmã wolo eyahã mãdšimădsi ke̱ asafoi ke̱ wiemo̱i fẽ ní yo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ fẽ le̱ ake̱: Hedšo̱le̱ afá ahãnye!

english_verse: I command everyone in my kingdom to worship and honor the God of Daniel. He is the living God, the one who lives forever. His power and his kingdom will never end.
translation_verse: .] Miwo kitã ake̱, mimaṅtše̱geli le̱ mli no̱yelihe-fẽ-no̱yelihe le̱ mei ahe akpokpo ni ame̱še gbeyei ye̱ Daniel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ hĩe. Edšake̱ le̱ dši Nyoṅmo̱ hĩekãlo̱ le̱, ni ehĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä nāno̱, ni emaṅtše̱yeli le̱ hĩe kpătăṅ, ni eno̱yeli lo̱ aahĩ ši ke̱-ate nāgbā.

english_verse: He rescues people and sets them free by working great miracles. Daniel's God has rescued him from the power of the lions.”
translation_verse: .] Dšielo̱ ke̱ herelo̱ dšile̱, efeo̱ okadii ke̱ nākpe̱nii ye̱ ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱; edšake̱ edšie Daniel ye̱ dšatai le̱ adeṅ.

english_verse: All went well for Daniel while Darius was king, and even when Cyrus the Persian ruled.
translation_verse: .] Ni ne̱ke̱ Daniel no̱ awó eno̱ ye̱ Dario maṅtše̱yelibe le̱ ke̱ *Koreš, Persianyo le̱, maṅtše̱yelibe le̱ mli. *

english_verse: The third beast was like a leopard—except that it had four wings and four heads. It was given authority to rule.
translation_verse: Ene̱ se̱ le̱ mihĩe kwe̱mo̱, ni na, ekroko hũ tamo̱ kōtše̱ ni hĩe loflõ fĩdši edſe̱ ye̱ ekotose̱, ni ne̱ke̱ kolo ne̱ ye̱ yitšei hũ edſe̱, ni aṅõ no̱yeli ahãle̱.

english_verse: Just as I was thinking about these horns, a smaller horn appeared, and three of the other horns were pulled up by the roots to make room for it. This horn had the eyes of a human and a mouth that spoke with great arrogance. Judgment Daniel wrote:
translation_verse: Mihĩe aklontoi le̱ akwe̱mo̱, ni na, aklonto kroko ní dši bibiō badše kpo ye̱ ame̱teṅ, ni kleṅkleṅ aklontoi le̱ ateṅ etẽ fãmo̱ ye̱ ehĩe, ni na ne̱ke̱ aklonto ne̱, hĩṅme̱ii ye̱ he tamo̱ gbomo hĩṅme̱ii ke̱ nābu *ní wieo̱ nibii wudši. *

english_verse: Thrones were set up while I was watching, and the Eternal God took his place. His clothing and his hair were white as snow. His throne was a blazing fire with fiery wheels,
translation_verse: Mihĩe kwe̱mo̱ āhũ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní ake̱ maṅtše̱sẽii bamãmo ši, ni *moni eye gbĩĩ pī le̱ ho-tá ši, ni etade ye̱o̱ tamo̱ snō, ni eyiteṅ tšoi tamo̱ tōhetšo̱i ṅmīṅmi, emaṅtše̱sẽi le̱ lalileii so̱ṅṅ ni, ehe kokrolontoī le̱, la ní tšoo̱ grigri ni. *Lal.

english_verse: I watched closely to see what would happen to this smaller horn because of the arrogant things it was saying. Then before my very eyes, the fourth beast was killed and its body destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ mihĩe kwe̱mo̱ ye̱ wiemo̱i wudši ní aklonto le̱ wieo̱ le̱ gbē le̱ hewo̱; mihĩe kwe̱mo̱ āhũ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní agbe kolo le̱, ni afite egbonyo le̱, ni aše̱ afõ la mli ni ašã. Kpods.

english_verse: He was crowned king and given power and glory, so that all people of every nation and race would serve him. He will rule forever, and his kingdom is eternal, never to be destroyed. The Meaning of Daniel's Vision
translation_verse: ni ahãle̱ no̱yeli ke̱ anumnyam ke̱ maṅtše̱yeli, koni mãdšimãdši ke̱ asafoi ke̱ wiemo̱i te fẽ asúmo̱le̱, ono̱yeli le̱ nāno̱ no̱yeli ní hoṅ eyaṅ ni, ni emaṅtše̱yeli te noni fiteṅ ni.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I was terrified by these visions, and I didn't know what to think.
translation_verse: Mi, Daniel, mimumo̱ hao ye̱ migbomotšo mli, ni miyitšoṅ nināi te wo mihe gbeyei.

english_verse: But God Most High will give his kingdom to his chosen ones, and it will be theirs forever and ever.”
translation_verse: Ši moni yo̱ ṅwei šoṅṅ le̱ *mei kroṅkroṅi le̱ enine aaše̱ maṅtše̱yeli le̱ no̱, ni ame̱aye maṅtše̱yeli le̱ no̱ ke̱-ya nāno̱, ke̱-ya nāno̱i anāno̱. *K.

english_verse: I wanted to know more about the fourth beast, because it was so different and much more terrifying than the others. What was the meaning of its iron teeth and bronze claws and of its feet that smashed what the teeth and claws had not ground and crushed?
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mitao ní male *kolo ní dši edſe̱ le̱ ní sŏrole̱ sŏro ekrokomei le̱ fẽ, ní ohe yo̱ gbeyei naakpa, ni eyo̱ dade nyãnyõdši ke̱ akō̱ble wābii, ni eye nii, ni ekũmo̱ mli dukuduku, ni nii ní ſe̱ le̱ eke̱ enãdši nānā no̱ le̱, sane le̱ mli ano̱kwale, *K.

english_verse: I also wanted to know more about all ten of those horns on its head. I especially wanted to know more about the one that took the place of three of the others—the horn that had eyes and spoke with arrogance and seemed greater than the others.
translation_verse: ke̱ aklontoi nyoṅma le̱ ní yo̱ eyiteṅ le̱, ke̱ ekroko le̱ ní dše ní etẽ kplo̱ ye ehĩe, ní ne̱ke̱ aklonto ne̱ he yo̱ hĩṅme̱ii ke̱ nābu ní wieo̱ nibii, wudši, ní ké̱ okwe̱le̱ le̱, edše agbo fè enanemei le̱ anõ le̱ hũ.

english_verse: While I was looking, this horn attacked God's chosen ones and was winning the battle.
translation_verse: Mihĩe kwe̱mo̱ noṅṅ, ni *nakai aklonto le̱ noṅṅ ke̱ mei kroṅkroṅi le̱ wu, ni oye ame̱no̱, *Kpods.

english_verse: Then God Most High, the Eternal God, came and judged in favor of his chosen ones, because the time had arrived for them to be given the kingdom.
translation_verse: ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni moni eye gbĩĩ pī le̱ ba, ni aṅõ kodšomo̱ ahã moni yo̱ ṅwei šoṅṅ le̱ mei kroṅkroṅi le̱, ni be baše̱ ní mei kroṅkroṅi le̱ ye maṅtše̱yeli le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Then I was told by the one standing there: “The fourth beast will be a fourth kingdom to appear on earth. It will be different from all the others— it will trample the earth and crush it to pieces.
translation_verse: Ni bo̱ni ekē̱ ne̱: Kolo ní dši odſe̱ le̱ dši šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ maṅtše̱yeli ni dši edſe̱ ni aasŏrole̱ ye̱ moṅtše̱yelii fẽ ateṅ, ni eeye šilkpoṅ mū le̱ fẽ, ni eenānā no̱ ni eekūmo̱le̱ dukuduku.

english_verse: All ten of those horns are kings who will come from this kingdom, and one more will follow. This horn will be different from the others, and it will conquer three other kings.
translation_verse: Ni *aklontoi nyoṅma le̱, maṅtše̱mei nyoṅma aate ši ke̱-adše̱ ne̱ke̱ maṅtše̱yeli ne̱ mli; ni mokroko aate ši ye̱ ame̱se̱, ni aasŏrole̱ ke̱ kleṅkleṅbii le̱, ni eeba maṅtše̱mei ole ši. *Kpods.

english_verse: “This king will speak evil of God Most High, and he will be cruel to God's chosen ones. He will try to change God's Law and the sacred seasons. And he will be able to do this for a time, two times, and half a time.
