translation_verse: Ni eewie wiemo̱i *eši moni yo̱ ṅwei šoṅṅ le̱, ni eehao moni yo̱ ṅwei šoṅṅ le̱ mei kroṅkroṅi le̱, ni eeto eyiṅ ake̱ eetšake bei le̱ ke̱ mla le̱, ni aatuame̱ awo edeṅ ke̱-yaši †be ke̱ bei he̱ be mlidšā. *Kpods.

english_verse: But he will finally be judged, and his kingdom completely destroyed.
translation_verse: Ši kodšolo̱i le̱ aatrá ši, ní aašõ no̱yeli le̱ ye̱ edeṅ, ni aafitele̱ ni aakpãtã ehĩe ke̱-yaši nāgbẽ.

english_verse: “Then the greatest kingdom of all will be given to the chosen ones of God Most High. His kingdom will be eternal, and all others will serve and obey him.”
translation_verse: Ši maṅtše̱yeli le̱ ke̱ no̱yeli le̱ he̱ maṅtše̱yelii ní yo̱ ṅwei mū le̱ fẽ šiši le̱ amli hewale̱ le̱ aaṅō-hã moni yo̱ ṅwei šoṅṅ le̱ mei kroṅkroṅi le̱ amaṅ le̱. Emaṅtše̱yeli le̱ nāno̱ maṅtše̱yeli ni, ni no̱yelii le̱ fẽ aasúmo̱le̱, ni ame̱abõle̱ toi.

english_verse: That was what I saw and heard. I turned pale with fear and kept it all to myself.
translation_verse: Sane le̱ nāgbē ne̱. Ši mi, Daniel, le̱, midſēṅmo̱i haomi naakpa, ni mihĩe tšake, ni miṅõ oona le̱ mito mitsuiṅ.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: In the third year of King Belshazzar of Babylonia, I had a second vision
translation_verse: Maṅtše̱ Belšazar montše̱yeli afi ni dši etẽ le̱ no̱ le̱, ninā ko badšie ehe kpo etšõ mi, Daniel, ye kleṅkleṅnõ ní badšie ehe kpo etšõmi le̱ se̱.

english_verse: and with tremendous anger the goat started toward the ram that I had seen beside the river.
translation_verse: ni eba tōagbo le̱ ní dši aklontoi enyo̱ tše ní mina ake̱ edamo̱ fā le̱ nā le̱ ṅõ, ni eša foi ke̱-ba eno̱ ye̱ ehewale̱ hĩedō̱ le̱ mli.

english_verse: Then one of the holy angels asked another, “When will the daily sacrifices be offered again? What about this horrible rebellion? When will the temple and heaven's army no longer be trampled in the dust?”
translation_verse: Ni minu ni mei kroṅkroṅi le̱ ateṅ moko mīwie, ni mei kroṅkroṅi le̱ ateṅ mokroko hũ kē̱ mokome le̱ ní wieo̱ le̱ ake̱: Mẽ beyino̱ noṅṅ dā gbĩ afo̱le le̱ ke̱ amaṅfõfemo̱ mlatõmo̱ le̱ he ninā le̱ aakă no̱ ke̱-yašã, ní aṅõ hekroṅkroṅ le̱ ke̱ asafo le̱ ahã ni anānā no̱?

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I was trying to figure out the meaning of the vision, when someone suddenly appeared there beside me.
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱, beni mi, Daniel, mina ne̱ke̱ ninā ne̱, ni mitaoo̱ šiši mana le̱, ke̱ke̱ le̱, na, moko badamo̱ mihĩe tamo̱ gbomo.

english_verse: And from beside the Ulai River, a voice like that of a human said, “Gabriel, help him understand the vision.”
translation_verse: Ni minu gbomo gbē ye̱ Ulai teṅ, ni ebo ni ekē̱: *Gabriel, tšõmo̱ mone̱ ninā le̱ šiši! *

english_verse: Gabriel came over, and I fell to the ground in fear. Then he said, “You are merely a human, but you need to understand that this vision is about the end of time.”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni etšī eba heni mīdamo̱ le̱, ni beni eba le̱, miše gbeyei, ni *mike̱ mihĩe bu ší ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Tēdšemo̱ ohĩe okwe̱, gbomobi; edšake̱ nāgbē be le̱ he ninā ne̱! *

english_verse: While he was speaking, I fell facedown in a deep sleep. But he lifted me to my feet
translation_verse: Ni beni eke̱mi wieo̱ le̱, mibĩe dĩmi ni migbē ši, ni mike̱ mihĩe bu šikpoṅ; ši eta mihe, ni ewó mino̱ edame̱ ši ye̱ mišidamo̱he le̱.

english_verse: and said: Listen, and I will tell you what will happen at the end of time, when God has chosen to show his anger.
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Na, mibatšõo noni baba ye̱ mlifũ le̱ nāgbē be le̱ mli; edšake̱ nāgbē be ní ato le̱ nõ ni.

english_verse: The two horns of the ram are the kings of Media and Persia,
translation_verse: Tōagbo le̱ ní ona ní dši aklontoi enyo̱ tše̱ le̱, dši Media ke̱ Persia maṅtše̱mii le̱.

english_verse: After this horn is broken, four other kingdoms will appear, but they won't be as strong.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ le̱ bo̱ni no kũ ni edſe̱ te ši damo̱ ši ye̱ enãdšiaṅ le̱, maṅtše̱yeli edſe̱ aadše̱ dšeṅmaṅ le̱ mli ate ši, ši ame̱náṅ hewale̱ tamo̱le̱.

english_verse: When these rulers have become as evil as possible, their power will end, and then a king who is dangerous and cannot be trusted will appear.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱maṅtše̱yeli le̱ nãgbē mli, beni mlatõlo̱i le̱ amlatõmo̱ le̱ eyi le̱, maṅtše̱ ko ní hĩe wa ní ele ṅā fõṅ hũ aate ši.

english_verse: He will gain strength, but not on his own, and he will cause terrible destruction. He will wipe out powerful leaders and God's people as well.
translation_verse: Ni ehewale̱ le̱ mli aawa, ši dšee le̱dientše̱ ehewale̱ nă; ni eokpãtã hĩe ni ye̱ nākpe̱, ni eeſere, ni eefe, ni eekpãtã hewalo̱i le̱ ke̱ mei kroṅkroṅi le̱ amaṅ le̱ hĩe.

english_verse: His deceitful lies will make him so successful, that he will think he is really great. Suddenly he will kill many people, and he will even attack God, the Supreme Ruler. But God will crush him!
translation_verse: Ni eṅālē so̱ṅṅ hewo̱ le̱ eehã šišiumo̱ aſere ye̱ edeṅ, ni eefe ehe agbo ye̱ etšui mli, ni eekpãtã mei pī ahĩe ní ame̱lee be; ni eete ši ewo lume̱i alumo̱ le̱ tete; ši aakũmo̱le̱, ni dšee ke̱ nine tete.

english_verse: This vision about the evenings and mornings is true, but these things won't happen for a long time, so don't tell it to others.
translation_verse: Ni dšenamo̱i ke̱ dšetše̱remo̱i aninā le̱ ní agba le̱ ano̱kwale ni; ši bo le̱ *tšīmo̱ ninā le̱ no̱, edšake̱ eeye gbĩĩ pī dāni eeba mli. *

english_verse: After this, I was so worn out and weak that it was several days before I could get out of bed and go about my duties for the king. I was disturbed by this vision that made no sense to me.
translation_verse: Ši mi, Daniel, mife vī̃, ni mihe ye gbĩĩ komei; fe se̱ le̱ mite ši, ni mitšu maṅtše̱ le̱ nitsumo̱ le̱, ni mihe dšō mihe ye̱ ninā le̱ hewo̱, ši mokomoko enaa šiši.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: Some years later, Darius the Mede, who was the son of Xerxes, had become king of Babylonia. And during his first year as king, I found out from studying the writings of the prophets that the Lord had said to Jeremiah, “Jerusalem will lie in ruins for
translation_verse: emaṅtše̱yeli le̱ mli kleṅkleṅ afi le̱ no̱ le̱ mi, Daniel, midwe̱ wodši le̱ amli, ní mina ake̱ afii le̱ ni Iehowa wiemo̱ ba gbalo̱ Ieremia ṅō ye̱ hewo̱, ake̱ eegbe Ierusalem amaṅfõ le̱ nā le̱, dši afii *nyoṅmai-kpawo. *Ier.

english_verse: We have ignored the message your servants the prophets spoke to our kings, our leaders, our ancestors, and everyone else.
translation_verse: ni wo̱boo otšũdši, gbalo̱i le̱, ni wie ye̱ ogbe̱i ano̱ tšõ wo̱maṅtše̱mei le̱ ke̱ wo̱lumei le̱ ke̱ wo̱tše̱mei le̱ ke̱ maṅ mū le̱ fẽ ní yo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ atoi.

english_verse: and even our kings, our officials, and our ancestors.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱, wo̱sa hĩeghĕle, wo̱ke̱ wo̱maṅtše̱mei le̱ ke̱ wo̱lumei le̱ ke̱ *wo̱tše̱mei le̱, edšake̱ wo̱fe eša wo̱šio. *Ies.

english_verse: and rejected your teachings that came to us from your servants the prophets.
translation_verse: ni wo̱boo Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, gbẽ toi, koni wo̱nyie emlai le̱ ni etšṍ etšũdši, gbalo̱i le̱, anine no̱ eṅõ-ſie wo̱hĩe le̱ amli,

english_verse: We have not escaped any of the terrible curses written by Moses, and yet we have refused to beg you for mercy and to remind ourselves of how faithful you have always been.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni aṅmã ye̱ Mose mla le̱ mli le̱, nakai ne̱ke̱ efõṅ ne̱ fẽ eba wo̱no̱ ne̱; ši kẽle̱ wo̱kpaa Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, fai, koni wo̱kpale ke̱-dše̱ wo̱nišaianii le̱ ahe, ni wo̱dſẽṅ ano̱kwale le̱ he.

english_verse: In the past, you treated us with such kindness, that we now beg you to stop being so terribly angry with Jerusalem. After all, it is your chosen city built on your holy mountain, even though it has suffered public disgrace because of our sins and those of our ancestors.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱, ye̱ odšale̱ nitšumo̱i le̱ fẽ nā le̱, mīkpao fai ní ohã omlifũ ke̱ omlila le̱ adše omaṅ Ierusalem, ogoṅ kroṅkroṅ le̱ no̱! Edšake̱ wo̱he ešai le̱ ke̱ wo̱tše̱mei le̱ anišaianii le̱ ahewo̱ le̱ Ierusalem ke̱ omaṅ le̱ etšṍ ahorabō̱nõ ehã mei fẽ ni bo̱lewo̱ le̱.

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord God, and I beg you to answer my prayers and bring honor to yourself by having pity on your temple that lies in ruins.
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱, wo-Nyoṅmo̱ ko otšũlo̱ so̱lemo̱ ke̱ efaikpamo̱ le̱ toi, ni ohã ohĩe akpe̱ ye̱ ohekroṅkroṅ ní efe amaṅfõ le̱ no̱, ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ hewo̱!

english_verse: Forgive us! Hurry and do something, not only for your city and your chosen people, but to bring honor to yourself. The Seventy Weeks Daniel wrote:
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱, bo toi! Nuṅtšo̱, ṅõ-fa! Nuṅtšo̱, ka toi, ní ofe, kātše̱ kwrā, ye̱ bodientše̱ ohewo̱, mi-Nyoṅmo̱;, edšake̱ ake̱ *ogbe̱i ewo omaṅ ke̱ omaṅbii le̱! Ier.

english_verse: I was still confessing my sins and those of all Israel to the Lord my God, and I was praying for the good of his holy mountain,
translation_verse: Ni beni miwieo̱ lolo, ni miso̱leo̱, ni midšadšeo̱ mihe ešai le̱ ke̱ mimaṅ Israel he ešai le̱, ni mike̱ mifaikpamo̱ le̱ ſieo̱ Iehowa; mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, hĩe mihãa mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ goṅ kroṅkroṅ le̱, —

english_verse: and he explained: Daniel, I am here to help you understand the vision.
translation_verse: Ni etšõmi šiši ni eke̱mi wie ni ekē̱: Daniel, agbe̱ne̱ midše kpo miba ní mibatšõo šiši.

english_verse: God thinks highly of you, and at the very moment you started praying, I was sent to give you the answer.
translation_verse: Beni odše oſaikpamo̱ le̱ šisi le̱, wiemo̱ dše kpo, ni mi miba mibatšõo; edšake̱ āsumo̱ osane naakpa. Nohewo̱ le̱ agbe̱ne̱ dſẽṅmo̱ sane le̱ he, ni otẽdše ohĩi okwe̱ ninā le̱.

english_verse: For one week this foreigner will make a firm agreement with many people, and halfway through this week, he will end all sacrifices and offerings. Then the “Horrible Thing” that causes destruction will be put there. And it will stay there until the time God has decided to destroy this one who destroys.
translation_verse: Ni eewadše kpãṅmo̱ ehã mei pī otši kome; ni otši le̱ teṅ le̱ eehã afo̱le ke̱ niyenii-afo̱le te̱ afo; ni fĩne no̱ amaṅfõ *nihīnii te aahī, ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní aafo̱se nyõmo̱wo ta kodšomo̱ aſie fitelo̱ le no. *

english_verse: I ate no fancy food or meat, I drank no wine, and I put no olive oil on my face or hair.
translation_verse: miyee niyenii ko ní ṅõ, ni lō lo wein eyaa midāṅ, ni mikpaa mũ hũ kwrā ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni otšii etẽ le̱ fẽ še̱.

english_verse: Then, on the twenty-fourth day of the first month, I was standing on the banks of the great Tigris River,
translation_verse: Ni kleṅkleṅ nyõṅ le̱ no̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ nyoṅmai-enyo̱ ke̱ edſe̱ le̱ no̱ le̱ miye̱ Hidekel fā wulu le̱ nā,

english_verse: when I looked up and saw someone dressed in linen and wearing a solid gold belt.
translation_verse: ni mihole mihĩṅme̱ii ano̱, ni mikwe̱, ni na, *nū ko ní wo klala ni Ufaz šika fĩ ehe̱ ne̱. *Ezek.

english_verse: He raised me to my hands and knees
translation_verse: Ni na, nine ko bata mihe, ni etšimi ni mike̱ minakutšei ke̱ minidši nyẽmo̱ ši;

english_verse: and then said, “Daniel, your God thinks highly of you, and he has sent me. So stand up and pay close attention.” I stood trembling, while the angel said:
translation_verse: ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Daniel, bo nū ni asumoo̱ osane naakpa na wiemo̱i ni mike̱o wieo̱ te anã, ni odamo̱ odamo̱he le̱; edšake̱ oṅõ atšũni ne̱. Ni beni eke̱mi wie ne̱ke̱ wiemo̱ ne̱, mite ši midamo̱ ši ke̱ hekpokpomo̱.

english_verse: Daniel, don't be afraid! God has listened to your prayers since the first day you humbly asked for understanding, and he has sent me here.
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Kāše gbeyei, Daniel; edšake̱ ke̱-dše̱ gbĩ kleṅkleṅ ní otao bo̱ni oofe ní onu šiši, ní oba ohe ši ye̱ o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ hĩe le̱, anu owiemo̱i le̱, ni owiemo̱i le̱ ahewo̱ miba ne̱.

english_verse: I will tell you what is written in The Book of Truth. But first, you must realize that no one except Michael, the guardian angel of Israel, is on my side.
translation_verse: Ši mibatšõo noni aṅmã ye̱ ano̱kwale wolo le̱ mli; ni mokomoko be̱ ní aafata mihe aši mene̱mei, ake̱ dša nyelumo̱ Mikael le̱.

english_verse: Now I have come here to give you another vision about what will happen to your people in the future.
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱ miba ní *mibatšõo noni baba omaṅ le̱ no̱ ye̱ nāgbē gbĩĩ le̱ amli; edšake̱ gbĩĩ ní baba le̱ ahe ninā kroko ye̱ lolo. *

english_verse: While this angel was speaking to me, I stared at the ground, speechless.
translation_verse: Ni beni eke̱mi wie ne̱ke̱ wiemo̱i ne̱; mimã mihĩe ši, ni mito̱ mṹ.

english_verse: Then he appeared in human form and touched my lips. I said, “Sir, this vision has brought me great pain and has drained my strength.
translation_verse: Ni na, moko ní esu tamo̱ gbomei abii asu *bata minābu he, ni migble midāṅ ni miwie, ta mikē̱ moni damo̱ mihĩe le̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, ninā le̱ hewo̱ le̱ miw̌ere̱hō le̱ ekũ se̱ eba mino̱, ni mibe̱ hewale̱ ko doṅṅ; *Ies.

english_verse: The angel touched me a second time and said, “Don't be frightened! God thinks highly of you, and he intends this for your good, so be brave and strong.” At this, I regained my strength and replied, “Please speak! You have already made me feel much better.”
translation_verse: ni ekē̱: *Kāše gbeyei, bo nū ni asumoo̱ osane naakpa! hedšo̱le̱ ahão! ohe awa, hē̃, ohe awa! Ni beni eke̱mi wie le̱, miná hewale̱, ni mikē̱: Wiemo̱, minuṅtšo̱, edšake̱ owomi hewale̱! *Kpods.

english_verse: Then the angel said: Now do you understand why I have come? Soon I must leave to fight against the guardian angel of Persia. Then after I have defeated him, the guardian angel of Greece will attack me.
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱: Ole nõ hewo̱ ní miba oṅõ ne̱? Ni agbe̱ne̱ mibakũ mise̱ ní mike̱ *Persia lumo̱ le̱ ayawu; ni ké̱ mite pe̱ le̱, na, Hela lumo̱ le̱ baba. *K.

english_verse: The sons of the king of the north will gather a huge army that will sweep down like a roaring flood, reaching all the way to the fortress of the southern kingdom.
translation_verse: Ši ebii le̱ aafe ta, ni ame̱abua tai wudši asafo babaō na, ši eeba, ni eebaho tamo̱ nu babaō, ni eetšṍ no̱ ke̱-aho; ni eekũ ese̱, ni aame̱awu la ke̱-yaši emō̃ ni wa le̱ he.

english_verse: The king who invaded from the north will do as he pleases, and he will even capture and destroy the holy land.
translation_verse: Ši moni baä eno̱ le̱ aafe bo̱ni esumoo̱, ni moko be̱ ní aadamo̱ ehĩe, ni eẽdamo̱ *šikpoṅ fe̱fe̱o le̱ no̱, ni hĩekpãtãmo̱ aahĩ edẽ. *

english_verse: In fact, he will decide to invade the south with his entire army. Then he will attempt to make peace by giving the king of the south a bride from the northern kingdom, but this won't be successful.
translation_verse: Ni eeto eyiṅ ake̱ eke̱ emaṅtše̱yeli mū le̱ fẽ hewale̱ aaba, ni eke̱le̱ aakpāṅ, ni eeṅõ yei le̱ abiyō le̱ ehãle̱ gblã, ni efitele̱; ši edamo̱ṅ ši, ni etšṍṅ enõ.

english_verse: Afterwards, this proud king of the north will invade and conquer many of the nations along the coast, but a military leader will defeat him and make him lose his pride.
translation_verse: Ni eetšṍ ehĩe ehã ṅšo̱kpo̱i le̱, ni eeṅõ pī; ši asafoiatše̱ ko aahã efõ aho-rabō̱, ni dšee no ke̱ke̱, ši eehã ahorabō̱ le̱ akũ se̱ abua eyiteṅ.

english_verse: He will retreat to his fortresses in his own country, but on the way he will be defeated and never again be seen.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni eetšṍ ehĩe ehã le̱dientše̱ ešikpoṅ no̱ mõdši ní wa le̱, ni eete̱ ni eegbē ši, ni anaṅle̱ doṅṅ.

english_verse: The next king of the north will try to collect taxes for the glory of his kingdom. However, he will come to a sudden end in some mysterious way, instead of in battle or because of someone's anger. Part Two: The Evil King from the North
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni moko aate ši ye̱ enădšiaṅ, moni anhã onĩatšũlo̱ ko abatsṍ maṅtše̱yeli le̱ anumnyam le̱ mli ke̱-ho ni gbĩĩ fiõ še̱ le̱ aakũmo̱le̱, ši dšee mlifũ lo ta nā.

english_verse: The successor of this king of the north will be a worthless nobody, who doesn't even come from a royal family. He will suddenly appear and gain control of the kingdom by treachery.
translation_verse: Ni moko ni ebuu aate ši ye̱ enãdšiaṅ, ni kũle̱ ame̱ke̱ maṅtše̱yeli anumnyam le̱ hăṅle̱: ši eeba beni ame̱lee ame̱he be, ni eke̱ nādo̱ko̱mo̱ aašõ maṅtše̱yeli le̱.

english_verse: He will make a treaty, but he will be deceitful and break it, even though he has only a few followers.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ eke̱le̱ kpãṅ se̱ le̱, eeye kũtũmpo̱o, ni eedše kpo ke̱ asafo bibiõ, ni eeye kũnim.

english_verse: by members of the royal court. He will be ruined, and most of his army will be slaughtered.
translation_verse: ni mei ni yeo̱ eṅmā̃ le̱ tete aakpãtã ehĩe, ni eta le̱ aaho tamo̱ nu babaō, ni mei pī aanyõnyõi.

english_verse: Then the king of the north will return to his country with great treasures. But on the way, he will attack the religion of God's people and do whatever else he pleases.
translation_verse: Ni eekũ ese̱ ke̱-ate ešikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ke̱ nii babaō, ni etšui aate ši awo kpãṅmo̱ kroṅkroṅ le̱, ni eefe; ni eekũ ese̱ ke̱-ate ešikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: At the time God has decided, the king of the north will invade the southern kingdom again, but this time, things will be different.
translation_verse: Be ni ato le̱ mli le̱ eekũ ese̱ ke̱-aba wuoyigbe̱ ekoṅ, ši se̱kpē nõ le̱ tamo̱ṅ tšutšunõ le̱.

english_verse: Ships from the west will come to attack him, and he will be discouraged. Then he will start back to his own country and take out his anger on the religion of God's faithful people, while showing kindness to those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Kitim le̱dši aabatuale̱, ni etšui aafã, ni eekũ ese̱, ni emli aawo la ye̱ kpãṅmo̱ kroṅkroṅ le̱ hewo̱; ni eefe; ni eekũ ese̱ ni eetao mei ní kwaä kpãṅmo̱ kroṅkroṅ le̱ ase̱gbe̱.

english_verse: He will send troops to pollute the temple and the fortress, and he will stop the daily sacrifices. Then he will set up that “Horrible Thing” that causes destruction.
translation_verse: Ni toi aadše̱ eṅō adamo̱ ši, ni ame̱abule mō̃ ni dši hekroṅkroṅ le̱, ni ame̱e̱dšie dā gbĩ afo̱le le̱, ni ame̱ke̱ amaṅfõfemo̱ *nihĩnii le̱ aamã ši. *

english_verse: The king will use deceit to win followers from those who are unfaithful to God, but those who remain faithful will do everything possible to oppose him.
translation_verse: Ni mei ni feo̱ efõṅ ame̱šio̱ kpãṅmo̱ le̱, eke̱ nādo̱ko̱mo̱ aahã ame̱ya se̱se̱; ši maṅ ni le ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ame̱he aawa, ni ame̱afe.

english_verse: Wise leaders will instruct many of the people. But for a while, some of these leaders will either be killed with swords or burned alive, or else robbed of their possessions and thrown into prison.
translation_verse: Ni *mei ní le nii ye̱ mã le̱ṅ le̱ aatšõ mei pī anii; ši ame̱anyōnyõi ye̱ klante ke̱ lalile̱i ke̱ nomṅō̃ ke̱ nihã nā gbĩĩ abo̱. *

english_verse: They will receive only a little help in their time of trouble, and many of their followers will be treacherous.
translation_verse: Ni beni ame̱anyõnyõi le̱, aaye abuaame̱ fiõ, ni mei pī ke̱ ame̱he aakpe̱te̱ ame̱he ke̱ nādo̱ko̱mo̱.

english_verse: Some of those who are wise will suffer, so that God will make them pure and acceptable until the end, which will still come at the time he has decided.
translation_verse: Ni mei ní le̱ nii le̱ ateṅ meikomei hũ aanyõnyõi, koni ake̱-kaame̱ akwe̱ ni ake̱-tšū ame̱he, ní ahă ame̱ye̱ futafuta ke̱-yaši nāgbē be le̱ mli; edšake̱ dša be ni ato to eše̱ dãni eeba mli.

english_verse: This king will do as he pleases. He will proudly claim to be greater than any god and will insult the only true God. Indeed, he will be successful until God is no longer angry with his people.
translation_verse: Ni maṅtše̱ le̱ aafe noni esumoo̱, ni *eewó ehe no̱, ni eefe ehe agbo fē nyoṅmo̱-fẽ-nyoṅmo̱, ni †eewie hepupūmo̱ wiemo̱i eši nyoṅmo̱i a-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ni eeſere ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní mlila le̱ aayi; ši noni amã no̱ mĩ́ le̱, aafe. *

english_verse: This king will reject the gods his ancestors worshiped and the god preferred by women. In fact, he will put himself above all gods
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ ebuṅ etše̱mei anyoṅmo̱i le̱, ni ebuṅ *yei ase̱dī to nyoṅmo̱ ko nyoṅmo̱ ko, ni eewó ehe no ye̱ mei fẽ no̱. *

english_verse: and worship only the so-called god of fortresses, who was unknown to his ancestors. And he will honor it with gold, silver, precious stones, and other costly gifts.
translation_verse: Ni eewo mõdši anyoṅmo̱ to hĩe nyam ye̱ enãdšiaṅ, ni eke̱ šika ke̱ dſie̱te̱i ke̱ te̱i ni dšra wa ke̱ fe̱onibii aawo nyoṅmo̱ ko ní etše̱mei le̱ lee hĩe nyam.

english_verse: With the help of this foreign god, he will capture the strongest fortresses. Everyone who worships this god will be put in a position of power and rewarded with wealth and land. Part Three: The Time of the End
translation_verse: Ni eke̱ mõdši ni wa fè fẽ le̱ aaye ye̱ maṅse̱ nyoṅmo̱ ko yeli-ke̱-buamo̱ nā; mofẽmo ní buo̱le̱ le̱, eehã enumnyam afá, ni eehã eye mei pī ano̱, ni eedša šipoṅ le̱ mli eke̱-wo nyõmo̱.

english_verse: At the time of the end, the king of the south will attack the kingdom of the north. But its king will rush out like a storm with war chariots, cavalry, and many ships. Indeed, his forces will flood one country after another,
translation_verse: Ni nāgbē be le̱ mli le̱ wuoyigbe̱ maṅtše̱ to ke̱le̱ aaši; ni kōyigbe̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ aafã ke̱-aba eno̱ ke̱ ſīlii ke̱ okpo̱ṅo̱i-atše̱mei ke̱ le̱dši babaō, tamo̱ ahum, ni eeba šikpõdši le̱ ano̱, ni eeho tamo̱ nu babaō, ni eetšṍ no̱ ke̱-aho.

english_verse: and when they reach the holy land, tens of thousands will be killed. But the countries of Edom and Moab and the ruler of Ammon will escape.
translation_verse: Ni eela *šikpoṅ fe̱fe̱o le̱ no̱, ni mei pī aanyõnyõi; ši mei ni aadše edeṅ ne̱; Edom ke̱ Moab ke̱ Amonbii le̱ ateṅ abladei le̱. *K.

english_verse: The king of the north will invade many countries, including Egypt,
translation_verse: Ni eekpã enine mli ye̱ šikpõdši le̱ ano̱ ni Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ edšeṅ mli;

english_verse: and he will take its rich treasures of gold and silver. He will also conquer Libya and Ethiopia.
translation_verse: ši eeye šika ke̱ dſie̱te̱i dſetrii ke̱ Mizraim ſe̱onibii le̱ fẽ no̱, ni Lubbii ke̱ Kušbii aanyie ese̱.

english_verse: But he will be alarmed by news from the east and the north, and he will become furious and cause great destruction.
translation_verse: Ši sãdši ní dše̱ bokăgbe̱ ke̱ kõyigbe̱ te aahaole; nohewo̱ te eke̱ mlila babaō aadše kpo, ní eyafite mei pī ni efeame̱ musu.

english_verse: After this, he will set up camp between the Mediterranean Sea and Mount Zion. Then he will be destroyed, and no one will be able to save him.
translation_verse: Ni eeši emō̃ le̱ṅ bui le̱ ye̱ ṅšo̱i le̱ ke̱ gõṅ kroṅkroṅ ní yo̱ fe̱o te teṅ; ni eeše̱ enãgbē, ni moko be̱ ní aaye abuale̱.

english_verse: Many of those who lie dead in the ground will rise from death. Some of them will be given eternal life, and others will receive nothing but eternal shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Ni mei ní wo̱ö̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ sũ mli le̱ ateṅ mei pī hĩe aatsẽ; *meikomei aate nāno̱ wala mli, ši meikomei hũ aate nāno̱ hĩegbĕle ke̱ nāno̱ nyãṅemo̱ mli. *Ioh.

english_verse: Everyone who has been wise will shine as bright as the sky above, and everyone who has led others to please God will shine forever like the stars.
translation_verse: Ni mei ní te nii te *aakpe̱ tamo̱ atatu kpe̱mo̱, ni mei ní etšõ mei pī agbe̱ ke̱-te dšale̱ mli le̱ aakpe̱ tamo̱ ṅulamii ke̱-ate nāno̱. *Mat.

english_verse: Daniel, I now command you to keep the message of this book secret until the end of time, even though many people will go everywhere, searching for the knowledge to be found in it. The End of Time
translation_verse: Ši bo, Daniel le̱, tšĩmo̱ wiemo̱i ne̱ ano̱, ni *oso̱o wolo ne̱ nā ke̱-yaši nāgbē be le̱; mei pī aakane fitšofitšo, ni nilē aafá. *K.

english_verse: I heard what the angel said, but I didn't understand. So I asked, “Sir, how will it all end?” The angel in my vision then replied:
translation_verse: Ni minu, ši minaa šiši, ni mikē̱: Minuṅtšo̱, té ene̱mei anā aayakpa tēṅ?

english_verse: Daniel, go about your business, because the meaning of this message will remain secret until the end of time.
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱: Ya, Daniel! edšake̱ atšīmo̱ wiemo̱i le̱ ano̱, ni aso̱o nā ke̱-yaši nāgbē be le̱.

english_verse: Many people will have their hearts and lives made pure and clean, but those who are evil will keep on being evil and never understand. Only the wise will understand.
translation_verse: Aatšũ mei pī ahe ni aahã ame̱ye̱ futafuta, ni aakaame̱ akwe̱; ši mei fõdši le̱ aafe efõṅ, ni mei fõdši le̱ ateṅ mokomoko enaṅ šiši; ši mei ní le nii le̱ aana šiši.

english_verse: So, Daniel, be faithful until the end! You will rest, and at the end of time, you will rise from death to receive your reward.
translation_verse: Ši bo le̱, ya ke̱-yaši nãgbē le̱ aaše̱, ni oodšō̱ ohe, ni oote ši oyaná ogbe̱fãṅnò ye̱ gbĩĩ te anãgbē le̱ mli.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Hosea, name your son Jezreel, because I will soon punish the descendants of King Jehu of Israel for the murders he committed in Jezreel Valley. I will destroy his kingdom,
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱le̱ ake̱: Tšé̱ egbe̱i Iezreel; edšake̱ eſe̱ fiō ke̱ke̱ ní mibato̱ Iee̱reel lášiſiemo̱ le̱ he owele ye̱ *Iehu we le̱ no̱, ni mahã Israel we le̱ maṅtše̱yeli le̱ se̱ afo. *

english_verse: Later, Gomer had a daughter, and the Lord said, “Name her Lo-Ruhamah, because I will no longer have mercy and forgive Israel.
translation_verse: Ni ená mũsũ ekoṅ, ni efo̱ biyō. Ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Tšé̱ egbe̱i ake̱ Lo-Ruhama; edšake̱ mikāṅ he̱ *mimũsũṅ etšōṅmi ye̱ Israel we le̱ he, ni maṅõ-faame̱ doṅṅ. *

english_verse: But I am the Lord God of Judah, and I will have mercy and save Judah by my own power—not by wars and arrows or swords and cavalry.”
translation_verse: Ši mimũsũṅ aatšõmi ye̱ Iuda we le̱ he, ni matšṍ Iehowa, ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, no̱ mahere ame̱yiwala; ši dšee gãi lo klante lo ta lo okpo̱ṅo̱i lo okpo̱ṅo̱i-atše̱mei mike̱-ahere ame̱yiwala.

english_verse: After Gomer had stopped nursing Lo-Ruhamah, she had another son.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ beni etše Lo-Ruhama fufo̱ le̱, esā ená mũsũ ni efo̱ binū.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Name him Lo-Ammi, because these people are not mine, and I am not their God.” Hope for Israel
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱: Tšé̱ egbe̱i ake̱ Lo-Ami; edšake̱ *dšee mimaṅ dšinye, ni mi hũ dšee nyenõ dšimi. *

english_verse: Your mother was unfaithful. She was disgraceful and said, “I'll run after my lovers. Everything comes from them— my food and drink, my linen and wool, my olive oil and wine.”
translation_verse: .] Edšake̱ ame̱nye ebo̱ adſamaṅ, moni náame̱ mũsũ le̱ efe hĩegbedšianii; edšake̱ ekē̱: *Manyie misuolo̱i le̱ ase̱, ame̱ ame̱hãami mibolo ke̱ minu le̱, mi-tōheišoi ke̱ midonti le̱, mimũ ke̱ midā̃i le̱. *Ier.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will build a fence of thorns to block her path.
translation_verse: .] Nohewo̱ le̱ na, mike̱ ṅmeii aafo afābaṅ matšĩ ogbe̱ le̱, ni matſa gbogbo ye̱ no̱, koni ekana etempõṅĩ le̱.

english_verse: She didn't know that her grain, wine, and olive oil were gifts from me, as were the gold and silver she used in worshiping Baal.
translation_verse: .] Ši le̱ le̱ ele̱e ake̱ mi mihãle̱ able ke̱ wein ke̱ mũ le̱, ni mihã edſie̱tei ke̱ ešika ni ame̱fiteo̱ ame̱hãa Baal le̱ fá hãle̱ le̱!

english_verse: I'll stop Israel's celebrations— no more New Moon Festivals, Sabbaths, or other feasts.
translation_verse: .] Ni mahã emliflimo̱ le̱ fẽ se̱ afo, egbĩĩ dšudši, enyõdšĩ hēi ke̱ ehe-dšō̱mo̱gbīĩ ie̱ ke̱ egbĩdšũrõyelii le̱ fẽ-kwa.

english_verse: She said, “My lovers gave me vineyards and fig trees as payment for sex.” Now I, the Lord, will ruin her vineyards and fig trees; they will become clumps of weeds eaten by wild animals.
translation_verse: .] Ni mafite eweintšei ke̱ egbã-mitšei le̱ ní ekē̱o̱ ye̱ he ake̱: “Minikē-nii ní misuolo̱i le̱ ke̱mi ne̱!” le̱, ni maṅõame̱ mafe kō, ni ṅãṅ koloi aaye.

english_verse: I'll punish her for the days she worshiped Baal and burned incense to him. I'll punish her for the times she forgot about me and wore jewelry and rings to attract her lovers. I, the Lord, have spoken! The Lord Will Help Israel
translation_verse: .] Ni mawole̱ Baalim gbĩĩ le̱ ahe nyõmo̱, no mli ní ešã tšofã-ke̱-ṅma ebäame̱, ni ewula ehe ke̱ egugõṅgai ke̱ edſinei, ni enyie esuoloi le̱ ase̱, ni mi le̱ ehĩe kpa mino̱ le̱, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, will lure you into the desert and speak gently to you.
translation_verse: .] Nohewo̱ le̱, na, malakale̱, ni maṅõle ke̱-ate *ṅã le̱ no̱, ni †mahãle̱ tšui. *Ezek.

english_verse: I promise from that day on, you will call me your husband instead of your master.
translation_verse: .] Ni aaba mli ake̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱, Iehowa kē̱, ootsē̱mi ake̱ “Mi-wù”, ni otšé̱ṅmi ake̱ “mi-Baal” doṅṅ.

english_verse: I will no longer even let you mention the names of those pagan gods that you called “Master.”
translation_verse: .] Edšake̱ madšie Baalim gbe̱i ye̱ edāṅ, ni atšĩṅ ame̱gbe̱i atã doṅṅ.

english_verse: And I will agree to let you live in peace—you will no longer be attacked by wild animals and birds or by weapons of war.
translation_verse: .] Ni nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ mike̱ ṅãṅõ koloi ke̱ ṅwei lofõdši ke̱ šikpoṅ sũ le̱ no̱ wāmo̱nibii aakpãṅ kpãṅmo̱ ko ahãame̱, ni makũmo̱ gãi ke̱ klante ke̱ ta mli ke-adše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni mahã ame̱kãmo̱ ši ſeſẽſe. Ezek

english_verse: and faithfulness. Then you will truly know who I am.
translation_verse: .] ni matšè̱ ohe bā mahã mihe ye̱ *ano̱kwayeli mli, ni †ooná ole Iehowa! *Lal.

english_verse: and it will produce grain, grapes, and olives in Jezreel Valley.
translation_verse: .] ni šikpoṅ le̱ aabo able ke̱ wein ke̱ mũ toi, ni ame̱ le̱ ame̱abo Iezreel toi.

english_verse: I will scatter the seeds and show mercy to Lo-Ruhamah. I will say to Lo-Ammi, “You are my people,” and they will answer, “You are our God.”
translation_verse: .] Ni madũame̱ mahã mihe ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni mimũsũṅ aatšõmi ye̱ *“moni mimũsũṅ etšõkomi ye̱ ehe le̱” Ie, ni makē̱ moni †“dšee mimaṅ le̱” ake̱: Mimaṅ dšio! ni le̱ hũ eekē̱mi ake̱: mi-Nyoṅmo̱ dšio! *

english_verse: It will also be a long time before Israel has a king or before sacrifices are offered at the temple or before there is any way to get guidance from God.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *Israelbii le̱ aahĩ ši gbĩĩ pī ni ame̱be̱ maṅtše̱, ni ame̱be̱ asafoi-atše̱, ní ame̱be̱ afo̱le, ni ame̱be̱ amãgã, ni ame̱be̱ efodlo terafim. *

english_verse: But later, Israel will turn back to the Lord their God and to David their king. At that time they will come to the Lord with fear and trembling, and he will be good to them.
translation_verse: Ké̱ fe se̱ le̱ Israelbii le̱ aakũ ame̱se̱, ni ame̱abatao Iehowa, ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ke̱ *ame̱maṅtše̱ David le̱; ni ame̱ke̱ hekpokpomo̱ aaba Iehowa ke̱ enõkpakpafemo̱ le̱ ṅõ ye̱ nāgbē gbĩĩ le̱ amli. *Ier.

english_verse: Israel, listen as the Lord accuses everyone in the land! No one is faithful or loyal or truly cares about God.
translation_verse: Nyeboa Iehowa wiemo̱ le̱ toí, nye Israelbii! Ši Iehowa ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ bii le̱ ená, edšake̱ ano̱kwale ke̱ mobonale̱ ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱ he nilē be̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no.

english_verse: Cursing, dishonesty, murder, robbery, unfaithfulness— these happen all the time. Violence is everywhere.
translation_verse: Noni eſe̱ame̱ pe̱ dši kitãkãmo̱ ke̱ kũtũmpo̱oyeli ke̱ gbomogbē ke̱ dšū ke̱ gblãfitemo̱; ame̱gbulo̱ö̱ šĩai ame̱woo̱ mli, ni lášiſiemo̱ tša lášiſiemo̱ no̱.

english_verse: By adding more of you priests, you multiply the number of people who sin. Now I'll change your pride into shame.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni ame̱yi fá le̱, nakai ame̱fe eša ame̱šimi; mahã *ame̱numnyam le̱ atšṍ hĩegbĕle. *Fil.

english_verse: You encourage others to sin, so you can stuff yourselves on their sin offerings.
translation_verse: Mimaṅ le̱ he eša le̱ ame̱ke̱-lè̱o̱ ame̱he, ni ame̱ſeo̱ ame̱nišaianii le̱.

english_verse: That's why I will punish the people for their deeds, just as I will punish you priests.
translation_verse: Oso̱fo le̱ etšṍ tamo̱ maṅbii le̱ noṅṅ, ni mawoame̱ nyõmo̱ ye̱ ame̱gbè̱i le̱ ahewo̱, ni mahã ame̱nifemo̱nii le̱ akũ se̱ abua ame̱yiteṅ.

english_verse: You expect wooden idols and other objects of wood to give you advice. Lusting for sex at pagan shrines has made you unfaithful to me, your God.
translation_verse: Mimaṅ le̱, *ame̱tšo ṅõ ame̱bio̱ nii ye̱, ni ame̱dēhĩemo̱tšo le̱ dšadšeo̱ sãdši tšõo̱ame̱; edšake̱ †adſamaṅbō̱ mumo̱ le̱ ehã ame̱dũ gbe̱, ni ame̱dše ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ se̱ ame̱yabo̱ adſamaṅ. *Ier.

english_verse: But I won't punish them. You men are to blame, because you go to prostitutes and offer sacrifices with them at pagan shrines. Your own foolishness will lead to your ruin.
translation_verse: Miwoṅ nyebiyii le̱ anyõmo̱, ké̱ ame̱bo̱ adſamaṅ le̱, lo nyebihĩĩ aṅämei le̱, ké̱ ame̱fite gblã le̱; edšake̱ ame̱dientše̱ le̱ ame̱ke̱ adſamaṅi gbáa afã, ni ame̱ke̱ yei ní efe ame̱he adſamaṅbo̱lo̱i šãa afo̱le, ši maṅ ni enaa nii ašiši le̱, aabutuame̱!

english_verse: Israel, you are unfaithful, but don't lead Judah to sin. Stop worshiping at Gilgal or at sinful Bethel. And quit making promises in my name—the name of the living Lord.
translation_verse: Ké̱ io, Israel, obo̱ adſamaṅ dšiṅṅ, kãhã Iuda hũ mītõ! Ni nyekabaā Gilgal, ni nyekayaä *Bet-Awen, ni nyekakãmo̱a kitã ake̱: Gbĩĩabo̱ ni Iehowa hĩe kã ne̱! *

english_verse: You are nothing more than a stubborn cow— so stubborn that I, the Lord, cannot feed you like lambs in an open pasture.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Israel toi wa tamo̱ tšinayō ní toi wa; agbe̱ne̱ Iehowa aalè̱ame̱ tame̱ alè̱o̱ tōhi ye̱ he ní lē̱.

english_verse: You people of Israel are charmed by idols. Leave those people alone!
translation_verse: Efraim ke̱ ehe eyabo̱ wo̱dši ahe; nyeṅmẽale̱ gbe̱!

english_verse: You get drunk, then sleep with prostitutes; you would rather be vulgar than lead a decent life.
translation_verse: Ame̱dā̃numo̱ le̱ tede no̱, ni ame̱mībo̱ adſamaṅ; eno̱yelo̱i le̱ sumoo̱ hĩegbĕle.

english_verse: And so you will be swept away in a whirlwind for sacrificing to idols.
translation_verse: Kō̱yo̱ ekotale̱ ewo efĩdšiaṅ, ni ame̱hĩe aagboi ye̱ ame̱fo̱lešā̃i le̱ ahewo̱!

english_verse: Israel, I know all about you, and because of your unfaithfulness, I find you unacceptable.
translation_verse: Mile Efraim, ni Israel hũ aṅõkole̱ atēkomi; ši agbe̱ne̱ obo̱ö̱ adſamaṅ, Efraim, ni Israel ebule ehe.

english_verse: Israel, your pride testifies to your guilt; it makes you stumble, and Judah stumbles too.
translation_verse: Ni Israel hewō le̱ mīye odase ye̱ ehĩe, ni Israel ke̱ Efraim aagbē ši ye̱ ame̱nišai-anii le̱ amli; Iuda hũ ke̱ame̱ aagbē ši.

english_verse: Give a warning on the trumpet! Let it be heard in Gibeah, Ramah, and sinful Bethel. Benjamin, watch out!
translation_verse: Nyekpãa te̱tre̱mantre̱ ye̱ Gibea, nye-kpãa kōfẽṅ ye̱ Rama! Nyebo̱a oše ye̱ *Bet-Awen, — ke̱-nyie ose̱, Benyamin! *

english_verse: I, the Lord, will punish and wipe out Israel. This is my solemn promise to every tribe of Israel.
translation_verse: Efraim aatšṍ amaṅfõ ye̱ kãmo̱ gbĩ le̱ no̱. Mihã ale ano̱kwale le̱ ye̱ Israel akutšei le̱ amli!

english_verse: Now I, the Lord, will fill Israel with maggots and make Judah rot.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ mĩtšṍ tamo̱ omlẽgẽ mi-hã Efraim, ke̱ šramo̱ hũ mihã Iuda we le̱.

english_verse: So I'll become a fierce lion attacking Israel and Judah. I'll snatch and carry off what I want, and no one can stop me.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mitšṍ *tamo̱ kōtše̱ mihã Efraim, mitšṍ tamo̱ dšata mihã Iuda we le̱; mi noṅṅ †matšere̱ mli ni mate, ma-wó ke̱-ate, ni dšielo̱ ko be̱. *

english_verse: Then I'll return to my temple until they confess their guilt and worship me, until they are desperate and beg for my help.
translation_verse: Makũ mise̱ ke̱-ate migbe̱he le̱, ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní ame̱akalẽ ame̱tõmo̱ le̱ ni ameabatao mihĩegbe̱; *ké̱ efĩame̱ le̱, ame̱-ataomi mrã. *Ies.

english_verse: In two or three days he will heal us and restore our strength that we may live with him.
translation_verse: *Eehã wo̱yi aná wala ye̱ gbĩĩ enyo̱ se̱, gbĩ ní dši gbĩ etẽ le̱ eetēwo̱ ši, koni wo̱yi aná wala ye̱ ehĩe. *

english_verse: At a place named Adam, you betrayed me by breaking our agreement.
translation_verse: Ši ame̱ le̱ ame̱tõ kpãṅmo̱ le̱ *tamo̱ Adam, dše̱i ame̱yemi kũtũmpo̱o ye̱. *

english_verse: Everyone in Gilead is evil; your hands are stained with the blood of victims.
translation_verse: Gilead le̱, mei ní tšuo̱ nišaianii amaṅ ni, lá ewú mli!

english_verse: You priests are like a gang of robbers in ambush. On the road to Shechem you murder and commit other horrible crimes.
translation_verse: Ni bo̱ni odšotſalo̱i asafo woo̱ mo ká le̱, nakai oso̱foi asafoku le̱ yeo̱ awui ye̱ Šekem gbe̱teṅ, ni ame̱tšuo̱ nišaianii!

english_verse: I have seen a terrible thing in Israel— you are unfaithful and unfit to worship me.
translation_verse: Israel we le̱, mina gbeyeinõ ko ye̱ dše̱i: dše̱i Efraim *bo̱ adſamaṅ ye̱, Israel ebule ehe. *

english_verse: People of Judah, your time is coming too. The Lord Wants To Help Israel I, the Lord, would like to make my nation prosper again
translation_verse: Iuda, bo hū ato *nikpamo̱be ahão, beni †makpale mimaṅ le̱ nomṅō̃ le̱ ke̱-aba ekoṅ le̱. *Ioel

english_verse: and to heal its wounds. But then I see the crimes in Israel and Samaria. Everyone is deceitful; robbers roam the streets.
translation_verse: Beni mikē̱ mibatšá Israel le̱, ke̱ke̱ ni Efrata nišaianii le̱ ke̱ Samaria nifõdšianii le̱ dše kpo; edšake̱ ame̱tšuo̱ amalenii, ni dšulo̱ boteo̱ mli, odšotſalo̱i asafo haä nii ye̱ agbó nā.

english_verse: The king and his officials take great pleasure in their sin and deceit.
translation_verse: Ame̱ke̱ ame̱nifõdšianii le̱ hãa maṅtše̱ le̱ mī še̱o̱, ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱pasa wiemo̱i le̱ hãa lume̱i le̱ hũ amī še̱o̱.

english_verse: Their anger is a fire that smolders all night, then flares up at dawn.
translation_verse: Ame̱ke̱ dſẽṅmo̱i fõdši ewo ame̱tšui mli tamo̱ awoo̱ ta ye̱ flõnõ mli; amabološãlo̱ le̱ wo̱ö̱ nyō le̱ṅ fẽ, lebi le̱ ehãa etšoo̱ plamplam.

english_verse: They are flames destroying their leaders. And their kings are powerless; none of them trust me.
translation_verse: Ame̱fẽ-tſẽm ame̱mli edo̱ la tamo̱ flõnõ, ni ame̱šãa ame̱kodšolo̱i le̱; ame̱maṅtše̱mei le̱ fẽ nyõnyõo̱, ni mokomoko be̱ ame̱teṅ ni tšé̱o̱mi!

english_verse: The people of Israel have mixed with foreigners; they are a thin piece of bread scorched on one side.
translation_verse: Ake̱ Efraim efutu mãdšimãdši le̱; Efraim etšṍ kaka ní atšṍko.

english_verse: They don't seem to realize how weak and feeble they are; their hair has turned gray, while foreigners rule.
translation_verse: Gbo̱i eye ehewale̱, ši elee; wadši eſã eyiteṅ, ši elee.

english_verse: I am the Lord, their God, but in all of their troubles their pride keeps them from returning to me. No Help from Foreign Nations The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ni Israel hewō le̱ mīye odase ye̱ ehĩe, kẽle̱ ame̱kũũ ame̱se̱ ame̱baa Iehowa, ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ṅõ, ni ame̱taoole̱ ye̱ ene̱ fẽ mli hũ.

english_verse: Israel is a senseless bird, fluttering back and forth between Egypt and Assyria.
translation_verse: Ši Efraim etšṍ tamo̱ okpo kwašia ni be̱ yitšoṅ: Mizraim ame̱tšē̱o̱, Ašur ame̱yaä.

english_verse: But I will catch them in a net as hunters trap birds; I threatened to punish them, and indeed I will.
translation_verse: Ké̱ ame̱mīya le̱, magble miyā le̱ṅ malē̱ ame̱no̱; madšieame̱ mayimo̱ ši tamo̱ ṅwei lofõdši; magbla ame̱toi, take̱ bo̱ni ame̱safo le̱ enu le̱.

english_verse: Trouble and destruction will be their reward for rejecting me. I would have rescued them, but they told me lies.
translation_verse: Kpóo hãame̱! edšake̱ ame̱bo̱ kó ke̱-dše̱ miṅõ; hĩekpãtãmo̱ dši ame̱nõ! edšake̱ ame̱tõ mino̱; ši *mi le̱ mītao makpõame̱ moṅ, ši ame̱ le̱ ame̱malemaleo mihe. *Lal.

english_verse: They don't really pray to me; they just howl in their beds. They have rejected me for Baal and slashed themselves, in the hope that Baal will bless their crops.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱blo̱o̱ ame̱tšé̱é̱mi ye̱ ame̱tšuiiaṅ, ši amahū̃o̱ ye̱ ame̱sāi ano̱. Ame̱buabuaä ame̱he nā ye̱ ṅmā̃ ke̱ wein moṅ hewo̱; ame̱tšeo̱ mihĩe atũa.

english_verse: I taught them what they know, and I made them strong. Now they plot against me
translation_verse: Mitšo̱ne ame̱nidši ni miwoame̱ hewale̱; ši kẽle̱ ame̱dſẽṅo̱ mihe efõṅ.

english_verse: and refuse to obey. They are more useless than a crooked arrow. Their leaders will die in war for saying foolish things. Egyptians will laugh at them.
translation_verse: Ame̱kūo̱ ame̱se̱, ši dšee ṅweigbe̱; *ame̱tamo̱ gãitšo gbonyo. Ame̱lumei le̱ aanyõnyõi ye̱ klante nā, ye̱ ame̱lile̱i grimo̱ le̱ hewo̱; ene̱ aatšṍ noni ake̱-yeo̱ amehe fe̱o ye̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no. *Lal.

english_verse: You chose kings and leaders without consulting me; you made silver and gold idols that led to your downfall.
translation_verse: *Ame̱too̱ maṅtše̱mei, ši dšee mideṅ edše̱; ame̱woo̱ lume̱i hũ, ši milee mli. Ame̱ke̱ amadſie̱tei ke̱ ame̱šika le̱ feo̱ amãgãi, beni afe ní aflo̱ame̱ aſie! *

english_verse: Someone from Israel built that idol for you, but only I am God. And so it will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Ši Israel deṅ ene̱ dše̱, ṅālo̱ fe, ni dšee Nyoṅmo̱ ni; ši *aakũmo̱ Samaria tšinabi le̱ dukuduku! *

english_verse: Israel, you are ruined, and now the nations consider you worthless.
translation_verse: Aye Israel; agbe̱ne̱ ame̱ye̱ dšeṅmãdšie ateṅ tamo̱ *šō̃nõ ko ni asumo̱o̱! *Ier.

english_verse: You can bargain with nations, but I'll catch you anyway. Soon you will suffer abuse by kings and rulers.
translation_verse: Asaṅ ké̱ ame̱bo̱ apā ye̱ dšeṅmãdši ateṅ tete le̱, agbe̱ne̱ mabua ame̱nã ke̱-akpe; ni ame̱no̱ aabõi gbo̱mo̱ ye̱ lume̱i amaṅtše̱ le̱ onĩa hewo̱.

english_verse: My instructions for sacrifices were written in detail, but you ignored them.
translation_verse: Ké̱ miṅmã mimlai babaō mihãle̱ tete le̱, abuo̱ame̱ tamo̱ mokpõṅ ko nõ.

english_verse: You sacrifice your best animals and eat the sacrificial meals, but I, the Lord, refuse your offerings. I will remember your sins and punish you. Then you will return to Egypt.
translation_verse: Ame̱gbeo̱ *mifo̱lei le̱ tamo̱ lō ke̱-ke̱ ni ame̱yeo̱; Iehowa náá ame̱he tšui. Agbe̱ne̱ eekaĩ ame̱nišaianii le̱, ni eewo amehe ešai le̱ ahe nyõmo̱; †ame̱akũ ame̱-se ke̱-ate Mizraim. *Ies.

english_verse: Israel, I created you, but you forgot me. You and Judah built palaces and many strong cities. Now I will send fire to destroy your towns and fortresses.
translation_verse: Israel hĩe ekpa efelo̱ le̱ no̱, ni emãmo̱ mõdši, ni Iuda hũ ehã mãdši ni atſa gbogboi awo he le̱ efá pī; ši matšũ *la ke̱-aba emãdši le̱ amli, ni eešã emõdši fe̱fe̱dši le̱. *Ier.

english_verse: But you will run short of grain and wine,
translation_verse: Ṅmā̃gbẽmo̱he ke̱ weinbu akalè̱ame̱, ni wein hē hũ atã ye̱ emli.

english_verse: Even if you escape alive, you will end up in Egypt and be buried in Memphis. Your silver treasures will be lost among weeds; thorns will sprout in your tents.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ na, ame̱dše hĩekpãtãmo̱ mli ame̱te; Mizraim aababua ame̱nã, Memfis aabafũame̱. Ame̱dſie̱te̱i nibii fe̱fe̱dši le̱, *sãnsrõi aaṅõ, ni ṅmeitšei aamãmo̱ ame̱bũi le̱ amli. *

english_verse: Israel, the time has come. You will get what you deserve, and you will know it. “Prophets are fools,” you say. “And God's messengers are crazy.” Your terrible guilt has filled you with hatred.
translation_verse: Sramo̱ gbĩĩ le̱ eše̱, nădšiaṅtō gbĩĩ le̱ hũ eše̱, Israel aaná ale, — gbalo̱ le̱ būlu ni, mumo̱ṅ gbomo le̱ hũ se̱ke̱yelo̱ ni, ye̱ onišaianii le̱ afále̱ ke̱ nyē̱ ní fá pī le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord sent me to look after you. But you trap his prophets and flood his temple with your hatred.
translation_verse: Efraim le̱, sralo̱ dšile̱ ye̱ mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ mase̱i. Gbalo̱ le̱, *loflõdũlo̱ tšõne ye̱ egbe̱i fẽ no̱, nyē̱ ye̱ e-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ we le̱. *

english_verse: You are brutal and corrupt, as were the men of Gibeah. But God remembers your sin, and you will be punished. Sin's Terrible Results
translation_verse: Ame̱bote fitemo̱ mli vī̃, take̱ boni afe *ye̱ Gibea gbĩĩ le̱ amli le̱; eekai ame̱nišaianii le̱, eewo amehe ešai le̱ ahe nyõmo̱! *Kodš.

english_verse: And so, Israel, your glory will fly away like birds— your women will no longer be able to give birth.
translation_verse: Efraim hũ, enyam le̱ aafliki tamo̱ loflõ, afo̱ṅ, ahĩeṅ mũsũ, anáṅ mũsũ hũ.

english_verse: Even if you do have children, I will take them all and leave you to mourn. I will turn away, and you will sink down in deep trouble.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ ame̱lè̱ ame̱bii le̱ tete le̱, makpakpāame̱, ni eſe̱ṅ moko; ši ame̱ le̱, ke̱dši midše amehe le̱, kpóo hãame̱!

english_verse: Israel, when I first met you, I thought of you as palm trees growing in fertile ground. Now you lead your people out, only to be slaughtered. Hosea's Advice
translation_verse: Ké̱ mikwe̱ ke̱-yaä Tiro gbe̱ le̱, mi-naä Efraim ake̱ ate̱ole̱ ye̱ he ní *hĩ; ši Efraim aadšie ebii ahã awuyelo̱. *Ezek.

english_verse: Israel, I first began to hate you because you did evil at Gilgal. Now I will chase you out of my house. No longer will I love you; your leaders betrayed me.
translation_verse: Ame̱nifõdšianii le̱ yi obõ ye̱ Gilgal; edšake̱ dše̱i minye̱ame̱ ye̱, ye̱ ame̱nifemo̱nü fõdši ie̱ ahewo̱; maſieame̱ ke̱-adše̱ miwe le̱. Mikãṅ he misumo̱ṅame̱ doṅṅ! Ame̱lumeĩ le̱ fẽ le̱, atūatšelo̱i so̱ṅṅ ni.

english_verse: Israel, you are a vine with dried-up roots and fruitless branches. Even if you had more children and loved them dearly, I would slaughter them all. Hosea Warns Israel
translation_verse: Atſia Efraim nii; ame̱šišifã le̱ egbĩ; ame̱woṅ yibii! Asaṅ ke̱dši ame̱fo̱ kẽ le̱, magbe ame̱mũsũṅbii ní ame̱sumoo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Israel, you disobeyed my God. Now he will force you to roam from nation to nation.
translation_verse: Mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ekwaame̱; edšake̱ ame̱boole̱ toi: ni ame̱atšṍmo̱ tšomloloi ye̱ dšeṅmădšĩ le̱ ateṅ!

english_verse: You were a healthy vine covered with grapes. But the more grapes you grew, the more altars you built; the better off you became, the better shrines you set up for pagan gods.
translation_verse: *Weintšo kusū ní woo̱ yibii dši Israel. Bo̱ni eyibii le̱ fá le̱, nakai ehã afo̱lešãlatei le̱ hũ fá; bo̱ni ešikpoṅ le̱ hĩ le̱, nakai efe amãgãi ní hĩ. *Ier.

english_verse: You are deceitful and disloyal. So you will pay for your sins, because the Lord will destroy your altars and images.
translation_verse: Adša ame̱tšui mli; agbe̱ne̱ ame̱ana he nõ. Eewule ame̱fo̱lešãlate̱ĩ le̱ eſie ši, ni esā eekpãtã ame̱mãgãi le̱ ahĩe.

english_verse: All who live in Samaria tremble with concern for the idols at sinful Bethel. The idol there was the pride of the priests, but it has been put to shame; now everyone will cry.
translation_verse: *Bet-Awen tšinabii le̱ ahewo̱ le̱ Samariabii le̱ atšui aaye, edšake̱ emaṅ le̱ aaye ṅko̱mo̱ ye̱ ehewo̱, ni ewulo̱mei le̱ ahe aakpokpo ye̱ ehewo̱, ye̱ anumnyam le̱ hewo̱, edšake̱ edše ehe ete. *K.

english_verse: Like a twig in a stream, the king of Samaria will be swept away.
translation_verse: Samaria ke̱ e̱maṅtše̱ le̱ elādše tamo̱ nu hĩe afũi.

english_verse: Your sins have doubled, and you are rebellious. Now I have decided to send nations to attack and put you in chains.
translation_verse: Magbla ame̱toi bo̱ni misumoo̱, ni aabua mãdšimãdši anā awoame̱, beni aafĩmo̱ame̱ akpe̱te̱ ame̱mlatõmo̱i enyo̱ le̱ ahe le̱.

english_verse: Once you were obedient like a calf that loved to thresh grain. But I will put a harness on your beautiful neck; you and Judah must plow and cultivate the ground.
translation_verse: Ši Efraim le̱, tšina oblayō ni atšõ-le̱ nii ni, ni esumoo̱ ṅmā̃gbēmo̱. Ši mitšṍ ekue̱ fe̱fe̱o le̱ no̱ ke̱-ho; mahã Efraim agbla nii; Iuda hũ ke̱ tšinakō̱i aahũ; Iakob aaninẽ ahãle̱!

english_verse: Plow your fields, scatter seeds of justice, and harvest faithfulness. Worship me, the Lord, and I will send my saving power down like rain.
translation_verse: Nyedũa nii nyehãa nyehe ye̱ dšale̱ mli, nyekpaä nii ye̱ mo̱bo̱nale̱ nā! *Nyehũa hayī hũ nyehãa nyehe; edšake̱ †eše̱ be ní aké̱-taoo̱ Iehowa se̱gbe̱ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní eeba ebane̱ dšale̱ ehãnye. *Ier.

english_verse: You have planted evil, harvested injustice, and eaten the fruit of your lies. You trusted your own strength and your powerful forces.
translation_verse: *Nyehũ nõfõṅfemo̱, nyekpa nõša, nyeye apasa yibii, edšake̱ oṅõ ohĩe ofõ ogbe̱ le̱ ke̱ ohĩĩ kãkãlo̱i le̱ ayifále le no̱. *Hiob

english_verse: So war will break out, and your fortresses will be destroyed. Your enemies will do to you what Shalman did to the people of Beth-Arbel— mothers and their children will be beaten to death against rocks.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ blo̱mo̱ hō aate ši ye̱ omãdšĩmãdši le̱ amli, ni aakpãtã omõdši le̱ fē hĩe, take̱ bo̱ni Šalman kpãtã Bet-Arbel hĩe ye̱ ta-gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱; atšere̱ nye le̱ mli aſie ebii le̱ ano̱!

english_verse: Bethel, this will be your fate because of your evil. Israel, at dawn your king will be killed.
translation_verse: Nakai noṅṅ Betel aafenye ye̱ nyenõfõṅfemo̱ kpeteṅkple le̱ hewo̱; beni dše aatše̱re le̱, aafo Israel maṅtše̱ le̱ eše̱ afõ!

english_verse: My people are determined to reject me for a god they think is stronger, but he can't help.
translation_verse: Ši mimaṅ le̱ fo̱ö̱ se̱se̱yā; ni ké̱ ātšé̱ame̱ ke̱-ya ṅwei le̱, ame̱teṅ mokomoko wóó ehe no̱.

english_verse: Israel, I can't let you go. I can't give you up. How could I possibly destroy you as I did the towns of Admah and Zeboiim? I just can't do it. My feelings for you are much too strong.
translation_verse: Té mafe tẽṅ maṅmē̃ oheṅ, Efraim? Té mafe tẽṅ madšieo mahãṅ, Israel? Té mafe tẽṅ mafeo tamo̱ *Adăma, ni maṅõo mamã ši tamo̱ Zeboim hũṅ? †Mitšui etšṍ ye̱ mimli, mimo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱ ehe mi-mli fẽ! *

english_verse: Israel, I won't lose my temper and destroy you again. I am the Holy God— not merely some human, and I won't stay angry.
translation_verse: Mifeṅ ye̱ mimlifũ ní nā wa le̱ ta; mikũṅ mise̱ mĩtafiteṅ Efraim; edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ dšimĩ, ši dšee gbomo, mokroṅkroṅ ní yo̱ oteṅ le̱, ni mibaṅ ke̱ mlila. Yãfó

english_verse: I, the Lord, will roar like a lion, and my children will return, trembling from the west.
translation_verse: Ame̱anyie Iehowa se̱; *eehū̃ tamo̱ dšata; edšake̱ eehū̃, ni †bii le̱ ke̱ hekpokpomo̱ aadše̱ anaigbe̱ aba. *Ies.

english_verse: They will come back, fluttering like birds from Egypt or like doves from Assyria. Then I will bring them back to their homes. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel and Judah Compared
translation_verse: Ame̱ke̱ hekpokpomo̱ aadše Mizraim aba tamo̱ loflõ, ni ame̱adše̱ Ašur šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ame̱aba tamo̱ okpo; ni mahã ame̱-bahī ame̱wei le̱! Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: The Lord also brings charges against the people of Judah, the descendants of Jacob. He will punish them for what they have done.
translation_verse: Efraim hakuo̱ kō̱yo̱, ni enyieo̱ bo-kã kō̱yo̱ se̱; dāne̱ ehãa amale ke̱ hĩekpãtãmo̱ fáa, ni ame̱ke̱ *Ašur kpãṅo̱, ni atĕreo̱ mũ ke̱-yaä Mizraim. *

english_verse: So return to your God. Patiently trust him, and show love and justice.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa dši Zebaot Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, Iehowa dši *egbe̱i ní ake̱-kaio̱le. *Lal.

english_verse: Israel, you enjoy cheating and taking advantage of others.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ lē̱ kpalemo̱ ke̱-ya o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ṅõ; hĩemo̱ mo̱bo̱nale̱ ke̱ kodšomo̱ mli, ni okwe̱ o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ gbe̱ dāne̱!

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, am still your God, just as I have been since the time you were in Egypt. Now I will force you to live in tents once again, as you did in the desert.
translation_verse: Ši Efraim kē̱: Kẽle̱ *mitšṍ niiatše̱, miná nii babaō mihã mihe! Mideṅme-gbomo̱ mli nii le̱ fẽ mli ie̱ anaa tõmo̱ ko ní dši eša ye̱ mihe! *Kpods.

english_verse: Gilead is terribly sinful and will end up ruined. Bulls are sacrificed in Gilgal on altars made of stones, but those stones will be scattered in every field.
translation_verse: Ni mike̱ gbalo̱i le̱ wie, ni mihã nināi fá pī, ni mitšṍ gbalo̱i le̱ ano̱ mibubū abe̱i.

english_verse: Jacob escaped to Syria where he tended sheep to earn himself a wife.
translation_verse: Ké̱ Gilead dši efõṅ le̱, ame̱fẽ ame̱hĩe aakpãtã; Gilgal ame̱šãa tšinai afo̱le ye̱: ame̱fo̱lešãlate̱i le̱ hũ tamo̱ te̱i kuikui ye̱ ṅmõši akofii le̱ ateṅ.

english_verse: I sent the prophet Moses to lead Israel from Egypt and to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Ši Iakob *dšo foi ke̱-te Aram ṅã le̱ no̱, ni †Israel súmo̱ ye̱ ṅã hewo̱, ekwe̱ tōi ye̱ ṅã hewo̱. *

english_verse: Israel, I will make you pay for your violent crimes and for insulting me.
translation_verse: Ni gbalo̱ no̱ Iehowa tšṍ *edšie Israel ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim ke̱-ba, ni gbalo̱ no̱ etšṍ ekwe̱ame̱. *

english_verse: I fed you till you were satisfied, then you became proud and forgot about me.
translation_verse: *Bo̱ni ame̱lẽ̱̀he le̱ yo̱ le̱, nakai ame̱tŏ̱ro̱. Ame̱tŏ̱ro̱ ni ame̱tšui wó ehe no̱; nohewo̱ le̱ ame̱hĩe ekpa mino̱. *

english_verse: Now I will attack like a lion, ambush you like a leopard,
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ mitšṍ *tamo̱ dšata mihãame̱, miwoame̱ ká ye̱ gbe̱ toi tamo̱ kõtše̱; *

english_verse: In my anger, I gave you a king; in my fury, I took him away. Israel's Terrible Fate The Lord said:
translation_verse: Mihão maṅtše̱ ye̱ mimlifũ le̱ṅ, ni misā miṅõle̱ ke̱-te ye̱ mimlila le̱ṅ!

english_verse: Israel, your terrible sins are written down and stored away.
translation_verse: Afĩ Efraim nišaianii le̱; aṅõ ehe eša le̱ ato.

english_verse: You are like a senseless child who refuses to be born at the proper time.
translation_verse: *Yōfo̱yō kō̃mo̱i aaba eno̱. Bi ní lee nii dšile̱; edšake̱ †ké̱ še̱ be le̱, ebaa aso-sodſāhe. *Mika

english_verse: No matter if you prosper more than the other tribes, I, the Lord, will wipe you out, just as a scorching desert wind dries up streams of water. I will take away your precious treasures.
translation_verse: Tše̱ *ewoo̱ yibii ye̱ enyemimei le̱ ateṅ moṅ, kẽle̱ †bokã ahum aafã, Iehowa kō̱yo̱ aadše̱ ṅã le̱ no̱ atſa, ni enubu le̱ṅ aagbĩ, ni enuhĩṅme̱i le̱ se̱ aafo; eelō dſetri le̱ mli nibii ni dšra wa le̱ fẽ ke̱-ate. *

english_verse: Return to the Lord and say, “Please forgive our sins. Accept our good sacrifices of praise instead of bulls.
translation_verse: Israel, *kpalemo̱ oba Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ṅõ! Edšake̱ onišaianii le̱ ahewo̱ le̱ ogbē ši. *

english_verse: Assyria can't save us, and chariots can't help. So we will no longer worship the idols we have made. Our Lord, you show mercy to orphans.” The Lord Promises To Forgive
translation_verse: Nyeṅõa wiemo̱i nyehĩea nyedẽ, ni nyekũa nyese̱ nyeyaä Iehowa ṅõ! Nyeyakē̱ale̱ ake̱: “Ṅõ nišaianii fë ofa, ni omli ahĩ ahãwo̱, ni *wo̱o̱ṅō wo̱nābui wo̱fe tšinahĩĩ wohão. *Heb.

english_verse: Israel, you have rejected me, but my anger is gone; I will heal you and love you without limit.
translation_verse: Ašur nyẽṅ wo̱yiwala ahere, wo̱tráṅ okpo̱ṅo̱i ano̱ hũ, ni asaṅ wo̱tšé̱ṅ wo̱ni-dši anā nitšumo̱i le̱ ake̱: Wo̱nyoṅmo̱i! doṅṅ; edšake̱ bo le̱ omũsũṅ tšõo̱o ye̱ awusãi ahe!”

english_verse: I will be like the dew— then you will blossom like lilies and have roots like a tree.
translation_verse: Matšá ame̱se̱se̱yā le̱, masumo̱ame̱ ye̱ tšuidšũrõ nā; edšake̱ mimlifũ le̱ edše eno̱.

english_verse: Your branches will spread with the beauty of an olive tree and with the aroma of Lebanon Forest.
translation_verse: Matšṍ tamo̱ bó̱ mahã Israel: eegba afofro tamo̱ oflo̱-fo̱fo̱i, ni eetšẽrẽ fãi tamo̱ Lebanon.

english_verse: You will rest in my shade, and your grain will grow. You will blossom like a vineyard and be famous as the wine from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Enidši aalē̱ ši, ni ehefe̱o le̱ aatamo̱ mũtšo nõ, ni eedše ṅma hũ tamo̱ Lebanon.

english_verse: Israel, give up your idols! I will answer your prayers and take care of you. I am that glorious tree, the source of your fruit.
translation_verse: Mei ní yo̱ ehō̃ṅ le̱ šiši le̱ aakũ ame̱se̱, ame̱ahã ṅmā̃ le̱ yi aná wala, ni ame̱afro̱ke tamo̱ weintšo; egbe̱i aahehe tamo̱ Lebanon wein.

english_verse: If you are wise, you will know and understand what I mean. I am the Lord, and I lead you along the right path. If you obey me, we will walk together, but if you are wicked, you will stumble.
translation_verse: Mẽ sane Efraim ke̱ wo̱dši yo̱ doṅṅ? Mi le̱ maherele̱ no̱ ni makwe̱le̱; mitamo̱ se̱se̱o ṅmõṅ; mino̱ aaná oyibii ke̱-adše̱!

english_verse: Our grapevines and fig trees are stripped bare; only naked branches remain.
translation_verse: Ame̱kpātã miweintšo le̱ hĩe, ni ame̱kũmo̱ migbãmitšo le̱; ame̱kplo̱ ehetotoi le̱ ame̱ſie, ni enidši le̱ abe eye̱ futafuta.

english_verse: Grieve like a young woman mourning for the man she was to marry.
translation_verse: Wo yăra tamo̱ oblayō ni emīa kpekpe ehã eblayeiaṅ wù le̱!

english_verse: Barren fields mourn; grain, grapes, and olives are scorched and shriveled.
translation_verse: Akpātã ṅmõdši le̱ ahĩe, šikpoṅ le̱ mīye ṅko̱mo̱; edšake̱ akpãtã ṅmā̃ le̱ hĩe, wein hē le̱ egbĩ, mũ le̱ hũ eṅãlã.

english_verse: Tell the leaders and people to come together at the temple. Order them to go without eating and to pray sincerely.
translation_verse: Nyetoa ṅmā̃hĩle̱ kroṅkroṅ; nyetšé̱a kpē hũ! Nyebuaä onukpai le̱ ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ bii le̱ fẽ nā ke̱-baä Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, we le̱, ni nyeblo̱a nyetšé̱a Iehowa!

english_verse: We are in for trouble! Soon the Lord All-Powerful will bring disaster.
translation_verse: Ao, nakai gbĩ le̱! edšake̱ Iehowa *gbĩ le̱ ebe̱ṅke̱, ni eeba tamo̱ hĩekpãtãmo̱ ke̱-adše̱ Ofe le̱ ṅò. *

english_verse: Seeds dry up in the ground; no harvest is possible. Our barns are in bad shape, with no grain to store in them.
translation_verse: Dūmo̱nii le̱ egbĩ ye̱ ame̱sũkukulii le̱ ašiši, aboṅoi le̱ ekãmo̱ efodši, abletōhei le̱ ekũmo̱; edšake̱ ṅmā̃ le̱ eṅãlã.

english_verse: Our cattle wander aimlessly, moaning for lack of pasture, and sheep are suffering.
translation_verse: Kwe̱ bo̱ni šĩa koloi kẽmoo̱! Tšinaikui le̱ mīhao, edšake̱ ame̱be̱ niyelihe, ni tōikui le̱ bũ mīna nõ!

english_verse: I cry out to you, Lord. Grasslands and forests are eaten by the scorching heat.
translation_verse: Bo, Iehowa, miblo̱ö̱ mitšé̱o̱ ne̱! edšake̱ la ekpãtã ṅãno̱ dſe̱fo̱i le̱ ahĩe, ni *lalile̱i ešã ṅã le̱ no̱ tšei le̱ fẽ. *

english_verse: Wild animals have no water because of you; rivers and streams are dry, and pastures are parched.
translation_verse: *Ṅãṅ koloi le̱ tete mīſeo, edšake̱ fāi le̱ etã, ni la ekpātã ṅãno̱ dſe̱fo̱i le̱ ahĩe! *Lal.

english_verse: They climb over walls like warriors; they march in columns and never turn aside.
translation_verse: Ame̱šaä foi tamo̱ kãkãlo̱i, ame̱kwo̱ö̱ gbogbo tamo̱ tabilo̱i, ni mofēmo nyieo̱ egbe̱ no̱, ni ame̱dšee ame̱pašale no̱.

english_verse: The Lord said: It isn't too late. You can still return to me with all your heart. Start crying and mourning! Go without eating.
translation_verse: Kẽle̱ agbe̱ne̱ hũ Iehowa kē̱: *Nyekpalea ke̱-baä miṅõ ke̱ nyetšui mū le̱ fẽ, ye̱ ṅmā̃hĩle̱ ke̱ yāfó ke̱ ṅko̱mo̱yeli mli! *Ezek.

english_verse: Don't rip your clothes to show your sorrow. Instead, turn back to me with broken hearts. I am merciful, kind, and caring. I don't easily lose my temper, and I don't like to punish.
translation_verse: Ni nyetšere̱a nyetšui, ši dšee nyetadei, ni nyekpalea ke̱-baä Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ṅõ! ši *drolo̱ ke̱ mlitšõlo̱ dšile̱, emli fūũ mrã, ni emo̱bo̱nale̱ ſá, ni eſaä ehe ye̱ nõfõṅ hewo̱. *

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion! Call the people together. Show your sorrow by going without food.
translation_verse: Nyekpãa te̱tre̱mantre̱ ye̱ Zion! nyetoa ṅmā̃bĩle̱ kroṅkroṅ, nyetšé̱a kpē!

english_verse: Make sure that everyone is fit to worship me. Bring adults, children, babies, and even bring newlyweds from their festivities.
translation_verse: Nyebuaä maṅ le̱ nā, nyefea asafo le̱ kroṅkroṅ, nyekpēa onukpai ke̱-bakpea, nyebuaä gbekẽbii ke̱ mei ni yeo̱ fufo̱ le̱ anā! ayemforowu adše kpo ke̱-dše̱ ese̱tšũṅ, ni ayemforo hũ adše̱ epiaṅ adše kpo!

english_verse: Tell my servants, the priests, to cry inside the temple and to offer this prayer near the altar: “Save your people, Lord God! Don't let foreign nations make jokes about us. Don't let them laugh and ask, ‘Where is your God?’ ” The Lord Will Bless the Land
translation_verse: Hã ni oso̱foi, ni dši Iehowa súolo̱i le̱, afó ye̱ koi le̱ ke̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ teṅ, ni ame̱kē̱: Iehowa, na omaṅ le̱ mo̱bo̱, ni kãṅõ ogbe̱fãṅnõ le̱ ohã ahorabō̱, ni dšeṅmādši le̱ ke̱ame̱ mīfe ame̱dāṅ lala! *Mẽba aakē̱ ye̱ mãdšimãdši le̱ ateṅ ake̱: Nẽgbe̱ ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ yo̱? *Lal.

english_verse: The Lord was deeply concerned about his land and had pity on his people.
translation_verse: No le̱ Iehowa aaye ešikpoṅ le̱ he awuṅã, ni eena emaṅ le̱ mo̱bo̱.

english_verse: In answer to their prayers he said, “I will give you enough grain, wine, and olive oil to satisfy your needs. No longer will I let you be insulted by the nations.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa aahere no̱ akē̱ emaṅ le̱ ake̱: Na, mamãdšenye ṅmā̃ ke̱ wein hē ke̱ mũ, ní nyetŏ̱ro̱, ni *mihãṅ abo̱nye ahora ye̱ dšeṅmädši le̱ ateṅ doṅṅ. *K.

english_verse: An army attacked from the north, but I will chase it into a scorching desert. There it will rot and stink from the Dead Sea to the Mediterranean.” The Lord works wonders
translation_verse: Ni *kōyigbe̱nyo le̱, matšile̱ ke̱-adše̱ nyehe ke̱-ate šoṅṅ, ni maſiele̱ ke̱-ate šikpoṅ gbĩṅ ke̱ amaṅfõ le̱ no̱, ehĩe-ta le̱ aate bokãgbe̱ ṅšo̱ le̱ mli, ni ese̱-ta le̱ aate anaigbe̱ ṅšo̱ le̱ mli, ni esãdšã le̱ aate ši, hē̃, efũdšē le̱ aate ši; edšake̱ efe nibii wudši! *

english_verse: and does great things. So tell the soil to celebrate
translation_verse: Kãše gbeyei, šikpoṅ! omli aflio ni onyã́; edšake̱ Iehowa efe nibii wudši!

english_verse: and wild animals to stop being afraid. Grasslands are green again; fruit trees and fig trees are loaded with fruit. Grapevines are covered with grapes.
translation_verse: Nyekašea gbeyei, nye ṅãṅ koloi! ši ṅãno̱ dſe̱fo̱ le̱ mīfro̱ke, ši tšei mīwo ame̱yibii, ni agbãmitšo ke̱ weintšo hũ mīdšie ame̱mli hewale̱ le̱ mīhã!

english_verse: People of Zion, celebrate in honor of the Lord your God! He is generous and has sent the autumn and spring rains in the proper seasons.
translation_verse: Ni nye, Zionbii, nyemli aflianye ni nyenyã́a ye̱ Iehowa, nye-Nãnyoṅmo̱ le̱, mli! edšake̱ ehãnye tšõlo̱ ni ke̱nye yaã dšale̱ mli, ni *ehã gbo ke̱ agbie̱nā ene̱ ehãnye ye̱ kleṅkleṅ nyõṅ le̱ no̱. *Ier.

english_verse: Grain will cover your threshing places; jars will overflow with wine and olive oil. The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: Ni ṅmā̃gbẽmo̱hei le̱ aayimo̱ obõbõ ke̱ ṅmā̃, ni bui le̱ aaho ke̱ wein ke̱ mũ.

english_verse: I, the Lord your God, will make up for the losses caused by those swarms and swarms of locusts I sent to attack you.
translation_verse: Ni matonye afii le̱ amli nii ni *bālabii ke̱ otnkpe̱i ke̱ ligõligõi ke̱ agãi, ni dši mita babaō le̱ ni mitšũ ke̱-ba nyeteṅ le̱, eye le̱ anādšiaṅ. *

english_verse: My people, you will eat until you are satisfied. Then you will praise me for the wonderful things I have done. Never again will you be put to shame.
translation_verse: Ni nyeaye nii pī ni nyeatŏ̱ro̱, ni *nyeadšie Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, gbe̱i le̱ yi, edšake̱ eke̱nye eye ye̱ nākpe̱ gbe̱ no̱; ni mimaṅ le̱ hle gbōṅ gbĩkogbĩko. *

english_verse: Israel, you will know that I stand at your side. I am the Lord your God— there are no other gods. Never again will you be put to shame. The Lord Will Work Wonders The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ni nyeanã́ nyele ake̱ miye̱ Israel teṅ, ni midši Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ni mise̱ le̱ moko be̱, ni mimaṅ le̱ hĩe gboṅ gbĩkogbĩko!

english_verse: and gambled to see who would get my people; they sold boys and girls to pay for prostitutes and wine.
translation_verse: Ni mahã ana nākpe̱nii ye̱ ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱: lá ke̱ la ke̱ lasũ kutū.

english_verse: You people of Tyre and Sidon and you Philistines, why are you doing this? Are you trying to get even with me? I'll strike back before you know what's happened.
translation_verse: Hũlũ aatšṍ duṅ, ni nyoṅtšĕre aatšṍ lá, dãni Iehowa gbĩ wulu ni he yo̱ gbeyei le̱ aaba.

english_verse: Now I will burn down the palaces and fortresses of King Hazael and of King Benhadad.
translation_verse: Ši mamã Hazael we le̱ nā la, ni eešã Ben-Hadad mõdši fe̱ſe̱dši le̱.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Philistia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Boni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: *Gaza mlatõmo̱i etẽ ke̱ edſe̱ le̱ hewo̱ le̱ mitšakeṅ miyiṅtō le̱; edšake̱ ame̱ṅõ maṅ mū le̱ fẽ nom ke̱-te ame̱yatuame̱ ame̱wo Edom deṅ. *

english_verse: That's why I will burn down the walls and fortresses of the city of Gaza.
translation_verse: Ši mamã Gaza gbogbo le̱ nā la, ni eešã emli mõdši fe̱fe̱dši le̱.

english_verse: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the ruler of Ashkelon. I will strike down Ekron, and that will be the end of the Philistines. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Phoenicia
translation_verse: Ni maplenẽ Ašdod mli bii le̱, ke̱ maṅtše̱tšotše̱ le̱ ke̱-adše̱ Aškelon, ni matšṍ minine mawo Ekron, ni Filistibii le̱ ateṅ mei ní eſe̱ le̱ hĩe aakpãtã, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Phoenicia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They broke their treaty and dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: *Tiro mlatõmo̱i etẽ ke̱ edſe̱ le̱ hewo̱ le̱ mitšakeṅ miyiṅtō le̱; edšake̱ ame̱tu maṅ mū le̱ fẽ ame̱wo Edom deṅ, ni ame̱kaii nyemimei †akpãṅmo̱ le̱. *Ies.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Edom for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They killed their own relatives and were so terribly furious that they showed no mercy.
translation_verse: Boni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: *Edom mlatõmo̱i etẽ ke̱ edſe̱ le̱ hewo̱ le̱ mitšakeṅ miyiṅtō le̱; edšake̱ eke̱ klante tiu †enyemi le̱, ni eše̱ mũsūṅtšōle̱ fẽ efõ, ni emlifũ tšere̱o̱ mei amli dāne̱, ni etoo̱ emlila le̱ ke̱-yaä nāgbē. *Ier.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to wipe out the fortresses of Teman and Bozrah. Judgment on Ammon
translation_verse: Ši mamã Teman nā la, ni eešã Bozra mõdši fe̱fe̱dši le̱.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Ammon for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. In Gilead they ripped open pregnant women, just to take the land.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: *Amonbii le̱ amlatõmo̱i etẽ ke̱ edſe̱ le̱ hewo̱ le̱ mitšakeṅ miyiṅtō le̱; edšake̱ ame̱gblagbla Gilead yeiho̱lo̱i le̱ amli, beni afe ní ame̱lē̱ ame̱hūsũi le̱ amli. *Ier.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to destroy the walls and fortresses of Rabbah. Enemies will shout and attack like a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Ši maše̱re la mawo Raba gbogbo le̱ he, ni eešã emli mõdši fe̱fe̱dši le̱, ke̱ ošebō̱ ye̱ ta gbĩ le̱ no̱, ke̱ ahum ye̱ lasũogbĕle gbĩ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: Ammon's king and leaders will be dragged away. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ni aaṅõ ame̱maṅtše̱ le̱ ke̱ elumei le̱ fẽ-tſẽm nom, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Moab for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They made lime from the bones of the king of Edom.
translation_verse: Boni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: *Moab mlatõmo̱i etẽ ke̱ edſe̱ le̱ hewo̱ le̱ mitšakeṅ miyiṅtō le̱; edšake̱ eṅõ Edom maṅtše̱ le̱ wui le̱ ešã kālō. Ies.

english_verse: with its king and leaders. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: ni maplenē emli kodšolo̱ le̱, ni magbe emli lume̱i le̱ fẽ mafata ehe, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: Now I will send fire on Judah and destroy the fortresses of Jerusalem. Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: Ši mamã Iuda nā la, ni eešã Ierusalem mõdši fe̱fe̱dši le̱.

english_verse: They lie down beside altars on clothes taken as security for loans. And they drink wine in my temple, wine bought with the money they received from fines.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱kãmoo̱ *awaba atadei ano̱ ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱-fẽ-afo̱lešãlate̱ mase̱i, ni mei ní abuame̱ fo̱ le̱ awein amenuo̱ ye̱ ame̱-nyoṅmo̱i le̱ awe le̱!

english_verse: Israel, the Amorites were there when you entered Canaan. They were tall as cedars and strong as oaks. But I wiped them out— I destroyed their branches and their roots.
translation_verse: Ši mi mikpãtã *Amornyo le̱ hĩe ye̱ ame̱hĩe, moni edale̱ le̱ tamo̱ tšenedrui adāramo̱, ni ehe wa hũ tamo̱ odumi le̱; kẽle̱ mikpātā eyibii ní yo̱ yiteṅ le̱ ke̱ ešišifãi ní yo̱ šiši le̱ ahĩe. *

english_verse: I had rescued you from Egypt, and for forty years I had led you through the desert. Then I gave you the land of the Amorites.
translation_verse: Ni nii midšienye ke̱-dše̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni mike̱nye nyie ye̱ ṅã le̱ no̱ afii nyoṅmai-edſe̱ so̱ṅṅ, koni nyebaṅõ Amornyo le̱ šikpoṅ le̱.

english_verse: But you commanded the prophets not to speak their message, and you pressured the Nazirites into drinking wine.
translation_verse: Ši nyehã Nazirmei le̱ wein ame̱nu, ni nyewo gbalo̱i le̱ akitã ake̱: *Nyeka-gbaä! *

english_verse: And so I will crush you, just as a wagon full of grain crushes the ground.
translation_verse: Na, mi le̱ mamĩanye ke̱-ya šiši, take̱ bo̱ni ſīli ní eyi obõ ke̱ ṅmā̃ mĩaä nii le̱.

english_verse: No matter how fast you run, you won't escape. No matter how strong you are, you will lose your strength and your life.
translation_verse: Ni foidšē aalădše heoyátše̱, ni hewalo̱ ewadšeṅ ehewodšiaṅ, ni ekā̃lo̱ hũ hereṅ eyiwala;

english_verse: Even if you are an expert with a bow and arrow, you will retreat. And you won't get away alive, not even if you run fast or ride a horse.
translation_verse: asaṅ moni hĩe gãi damo̱ṅ ši, ni moni nãdši yo̱ oyá hũ edšeṅ mli, ni moni tá okpo̱ṅo̱ no̱ hereṅ eyiwala;

english_verse: You may be brave and strong, but you will run away, stripped naked. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: ni moni dši tšuisalo̱ ye̱ ekā̃lo̱i ateṅ le̱, ehe yayai po eke̱-adšo foi ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱! Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: Of all nations on earth, you are the only one I have chosen. That's why I will punish you because of your sins. The Work of a Prophet
translation_verse: Nye ke̱ke̱ mile *ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ wekui le̱ ateṅ; nohewo̱ le̱ mibawonye nyenišaianii le̱ fẽ he nyõmo̱! *

english_verse: How can anyone catch a bird without using a net? Does a trap spring shut unless something is caught?
translation_verse: Ani loflõ dũo̱ tšõne ye̱ šikpoṅ, ké̱ atšõ̀dole̱ tšõne ye̱ dše̱i le̱? Ani tšõne fe̱o̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ, ní edũũ noko?

english_verse: Whatever the Lord God plans to do, he tells his servants, the prophets.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa efeṅ noko, ake̱ dša edšie eyiṅtõ le̱ kpo etšõ etšũ-dši, gbalo̱i le̱, dã.

english_verse: Everyone is terrified when a lion roars— and ordinary people become prophets when the Lord God speaks. Samaria Is Doomed
translation_verse: Dšata mīhū̃, namo šeṅ gbeyei? Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa mīwie, namo egbaṅ?

english_verse: The Lord has said that they don't even know how to do right. They have become rich from violence and robbery.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mei ní buaä yiwale̱ ke̱ hĩekpãtãmo̱ nā ye̱ ame̱mõdši le̱ amli le̱, ame̱lee noni dša gbe̱ femo̱, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: And so the Lord God has sworn that they will be surrounded. Enemies will break through their defenses and steal their treasures.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa le ne̱: Henye̱lo̱i aabo̱le šikpoṅ le̱ ke̱-akpe, ni ame̱ahã ohewale̱ le̱ aba ši, ni aaha omõdši fe̱fe̱dši le̱.

english_verse: The Lord has promised that only a few from Samaria will escape with their lives and with some broken pieces of their beds and couches. It will be like when a shepherd rescues two leg bones and part of a sheep's ear from the jaws of a lion. The Altars at Bethel
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Take̱ bo̱ni tōkwe̱lo̱ šõo̱ ſŭo̱dši enyo̱ lo toi kuku ko ke̱-dše̱o̱ dšata dāṅ le̱, nakai aadšie Israelbii le̱ ní trá sā kóṅ no̱ ke̱ kampē no̱ mama ní dšra wa no̱ ye̱ Samaria le̱.

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful told me to speak this message against Jacob's descendants:
translation_verse: Nyeboa toi ni nyeyea odase nyetšõa Iakob we le̱, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa, Zebaot Nyoṅmo̱ le̱; kē̱:

english_verse: When I, the Lord, punish Israel for their sins, I will destroy the altars at Bethel. Even the corners of the altar will be left in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ake̱ gbĩ ní mawo Israel emlatõmo̱i le̱ ahe nyõmo̱ le̱, mawo Betel afo̱lešãlate̱i le̱ anyõmo̱, ni aaflo̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ he aklontoi le̱ aſie, ni ame̱agbēgbē šikpoṅ.

english_verse: I will tear down winter homes and summer homes. Houses decorated with ivory and all other mansions will be gone forever. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ni matſa fẽibe šĩa le̱ ke̱ latšābe šĩa le̱ nõ šĩkome, ni *ſuo̱wu šĩai le̱ hũ ahĩe aakpãtã; ni šĩai babaō aalādše kwrā, Iehowa kē̱. *

english_verse: Bring offerings to show me how thankful you are. Gladly bring more offerings than I have demanded. You really love to do this. I, the Lord God, have spoken! How the Lord Warned Israel
translation_verse: Ni nyeṅõa *măša nyešāa šidā-afo̱lei; ni nyešie̱a tšuidšũrõnā-nikē ní anua! edšake̱ nakai nyesumoo̱, nye Israelbii! Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱. *

english_verse: I, the Lord, took away the food from every town and village, but still you rejected me.
translation_verse: Ni mi hũ mihãnye nyãnyõdši ano̱ tšemo̱ ye̱ nyemãdši fiā-kwa mli, ke̱ abolo hõmo̱ ye̱ nyehĩle̱hei le̱ fẽ; ni kẽle̱ nyekpaleko ke̱-bako miṅõ! Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: Three months before harvest, I kept back the rain. Sometimes I would let it fall on one town or field but not on another, and pastures dried up.
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ, beni eſe̱ nyõdši etẽ ni akpaä nii le̱, *mihãã nyoṅmo̱ ane̱nye, ni mihã nyoṅmo̱ ne̱ maṅ kome no̱, ši mihãã ene̱ maṅ kroko le̱ no̱: ene̱ ṅmõ kome no̱, ni ṅmõ ní ene̱e̱ no̱ le̱ mli nii ṅălã. *

english_verse: I dried up your grain fields; your gardens and vineyards turned brown. Locusts ate your fig trees and olive orchards, but even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Asaṅ mihã *latšā ke̱ nibii aṅālãmo̱ ba nyeno̱; nyebō̱i ke̱ nyeweintromi ke̱ nyigbãmitšei ke̱ nyemũtšeii babaō le, †agãi eye; ni kẽle̱ nyekpaleko ke̱-bako miṅõ! Iehowa kē̱. *Hag.

english_verse: I did terrible things to you, just as I did to Egypt— I killed your young men in war; I let your horses be stolen, and I made your camp stink with dead bodies. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Mitšu gbĕle-hela ni tamo̱ *Mizraim nõ le̱ ke̱-ba nyeteṅ, ni mike̱ klante gbegbē nyeblahĩĩ le̱; ni mihã aṅõ nyekpo̱ṅo̱i le̱ anom, ni mihã nyensrai le̱ amli fũdšē le̱ te ši ke̱-babote nyegugõdši amli tete; ni kẽle̱ nyekpaleko ke̱-bako miṅõ! Iehowa kē̱. *

english_verse: I destroyed many of you, just as I did the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. You were a burning stick I rescued from the fire. But even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Asaṅ mibutunye, tamo̱ bo̱ni *Nyoṅmo̱ butu Sodom ke̱ Gomora le̱; ni nyetamo̱ †latšo ní afã ye̱ la nā; ni kẽle̱ nyekpaleko ke̱-bako miṅõ! Iehowa kē̱. *

english_verse: Now, Israel, I myself will deal with you. Get ready to face your God!
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni mibafeo ne̱, Israel: ni ake̱-ni mibafeo nakai hewo̱ le̱, sāmo̱ ohe ni oke̱ o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ akpe, Israel!

english_verse: I created the mountains and the wind. I let humans know what I am thinking. I bring darkness at dawn and step over hills. I am the Lord God All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Edšake̱ na, moni šõ gõdši ni ebo̱ kō̱yo̱, ni egbaä gbomo noni yo̱ edſẽṅmo̱ mli le̱, moni hãa dšetše̱remo̱ tšṍo̱ duṅ, ni enyieo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ *hei groṅṅi le̱ ano̱ le̱, Iehowa, Zebaot Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, dši egbe̱i! *Mika

english_verse: But the Lord created the stars and put them in place. He turns darkness to dawn and daylight to darkness; he scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth.
translation_verse: Ši le̱ *efe wuuo̱-ke̱-ebii ke̱ oṅwẽ, ni ehãa gbĕlehō̃ṅ tšṍo̱ lebi la, ni ehãa ſane woo̱ duṅ tamo̱ nyōṅ; le̱ †etšé̱o̱ ṅšo̱ le̱ṅ nu le̱ hũ ni efo̱seo̱ eſieo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ hĩe, Iehowa dši egbe̱i! *Hiob

english_verse: God destroys mighty soldiers and strong fortresses. Choose Good Instead of Evil! The Lord said:
translation_verse: Le̱ ehãa hĩekpātămo̱ gbaä yio̱ hewalo̱ no̱, ni hĩekpãtãmo̱ baä mō̃ ní wa no̱!

english_verse: Times are so evil that anyone with good sense will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ moni dši hĩetẽlo̱ le̱, nakai be le̱ mli le̱ efeo̱ diṅṅ; edšake̱ be fõṅ ni.

english_verse: If you really want to live, you must stop doing wrong and start doing right. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, will then be on your side, just as you claim I am.
translation_verse: Nyetaoa nõkpakpa ni dšee nõfõṅ, beni afe ni nyeyi aná wala, ni no le̱ Iehowa, Zebaot Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kenye aahĩ ši, take̱ bo̱ni nyekē̱o̱ le̱.

english_verse: This is what the Lord has sworn: Noisy crying will be heard in every town and street. Even farmers will be told to mourn for the dead, together with those who are paid to mourn.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ boni Iehowa, Zebaot Nuṅtšo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kē̱ ne̱: Blohũiaṅ fẽ le̱ yāfó so̱ṅṅ yo̱, ni gbe̱dšegbe̱i ano̱ fẽ le̱ ame̱kē̱o̱ ake̱: Ao! ao! ni atšé̱o̱ okwāfonyo ni ebaye ṅko̱mo̱, ke̱ mei ni le yāfó dšogbāṅ ní ame̱bafó.

english_verse: Your vineyards will be filled with crying and weeping, because I will punish you. I, the Lord, have spoken! When the Lord Judges
translation_verse: Ni yāfó ye̱ weintromi fẽ mli; edšake̱ mitšṍ omli ke̱-ho, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: You look forward to the day when the Lord comes to judge. But you are in for trouble! It won't be a time of sunshine; all will be darkness.
translation_verse: Kpóo hã nye, mei ní nyeſeo̱ Iehowa gbĩ le̱! Meni Iehowa gbĩ le̱ bafe ahãnye? *Duṅ gbĩ ni, ši dšee la! *Ioel

english_verse: You will run from a lion, only to meet a bear. You will escape to your house, rest your hand on the wall, and be bitten by a snake.
translation_verse: Tamo̱ boni ké̱ moko dšo dšata nā foi, ni ošišibriši ke̱le̱ kpeo̱, ni ké̱ eba šīa ni eke̱ enine kpasa gbogbo, ní onũfũ kõo̱le̱ le̱.

english_verse: The day when the Lord judges will be dark, very dark, without a ray of light. What the Lord Demands
translation_verse: Ani dšee duṅ Iehowa gbĩ le̱ aawo, ni dšee la; duṅ kpī ni kpe̱mo̱ be̱ mli?

english_verse: I, the Lord, hate and despise your religious celebrations and your times of worship.
translation_verse: *Mĩnye̱ nyegbĩĩ dšudši le̱, migbe he guo̱, nyegwabō̱i le̱ tete edše mitšine. *Ies.

english_verse: No more of your noisy songs! I won't listen when you play your harps.
translation_verse: Dšiemo̱ olalai le̱ agbē̱mo̱ ke̱-dše mino̱, ni osaṅkũi atſā le̱ hū̃ mitaoo toi mabo!

english_verse: But let justice and fairness flow like a river that never runs dry.
translation_verse: Ni ohã dšale̱ saneyeli akū̃mo̱ ke̱-ba tamo̱ nu, ni dšale̱ hũ aba tamo̱ fā ni hoo̱ dā!

english_verse: Israel, for forty years you wandered in the desert, without bringing offerings or sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Ani *nyeke̱ gbē-afo̱le ke̱ niyenii-afo̱le bahãmi ye̱ ṅã le̱ no̱ afii nyoṅmai-edſe̱ le̱, Israel we? *Bo̱f.

english_verse: I will force you to march as captives beyond Damascus. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: ni mahã aṅõnye nom ke̱-ya Damasko se̱! Iehowa, mo gbe̱i ni dši Zebaot Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kē̱.

english_verse: Look what happened to the cities of Calneh, powerful Hamath, and Gath in Philistia. Are you greater than any of those kingdoms?
translation_verse: Nyehoa ke̱-yaä *Kalne ni nyeyakwe̱a, ni nyedše̱a dše̱i nyeyaä Hamat wulu ke̱, ni nyekplekea ši ke̱-yaä Filistibii a-Gat le̱: ani ame̱hĩ fè maṅtše̱yelii ne̱, alo ame̱hũsũi le̱ amli lē̱ fé nyehũsũi le̱? *

english_verse: You rich people lounge around on beds with ivory posts, while dining on the meat of your lambs and calves.
translation_verse: Mei ni kãmoo̱ *ſuo̱wu sātšei ano̱, ni ame̱kpãa ame̱mli ye̱ ame̱kampēi ano̱, ni ame̱yeo̱ tōiku le̱ṅ gwanteṅbii ke̱ tšinai alẽ̱̀he le̱ mli tšinabii. *
