english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful has sworn by his own name: “You descendants of Jacob make me angry by your pride, and I hate your fortresses. And so I will surrender your city and possessions to your enemies.”
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa ekã le̱dientše̱ ehe kitã, Iehowa, Zebaot Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kē̱: Mi le̱ mīnyãṅe Iakob hewō le̱, ni emõdši fe̱fe̱dši le̱ mīnye̱, nohewo̱ le̱ maṅõ maṅ le̱ ke̱ emli nii le̱ fẽ mahã!

english_verse: If only ten of you survive by hiding in a house you will still die.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱, ké̱ ſe̱ hĩĩ nyoṅma ye̱ šĩa kome tete le̱, ame̱agboi kẽ.

english_verse: As you carry out a corpse to prepare it for burial, your relative in the house will ask, “Are there others?” You will answer, “No!” Then your relative will reply, “Be quiet! Don't dare mention the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ni ké̱ moko tše̱kwẽ ni dši moni fũo̱le̱ bawóle̱ ke̱-te̱, koni edšĩe gbohĩĩawui le̱ ke̱-aba šĩa le̱, ni eekē̱ moni yo̱ šĩa le̱ teṅ le̱ ake̱: Ani eſe̱ moko fata ohe lolo lo? ni mo le̱ akē̱ ake̱: Mokomoko be̱ doṅṅ! le̱, no le̱ mone̱ aakē̱: *Femo̱ diṅṅ! edšake̱ atšĩĩ Iehowa gbe̱i atã! *

english_verse: At the Lord's command, houses great and small will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Ši na, Iehowa efã́ ake̱ adſa šĩa wulu le̱, ní akũmo̱ šĩa bibiō le̱.

english_verse: Horses can't gallop on rocks; oceans can't be plowed. But you have turned justice and fairness into bitter poison.
translation_verse: Ani okpo̱ṅo̱i dšoo̱ foi ye̱ te̱sā no̱, alo ake̱ tšinai hũo̱ dše̱i hewo̱ ni *nyetšake dšale̱ saneyeli nyefe ebō̱, ni nyeṅõ dšale̱ yibii nyefe tatšo? *

english_verse: You celebrate the defeat of Lo-Debar and Karnaim, and you boast by saying, “We did it on our own.”
translation_verse: Nye mei ni nyemī še̱o̱ ye̱ noni dšee noko he, ni nyekē̱o̱ ake̱: Ani dšee wo̱hewale nā wodše aklontoi le̱?

english_verse: But the Lord God All-Powerful will send a nation to attack you people of Israel. They will capture Lebo-Hamath in the north, Arabah Creek in the south, and everything in between.
translation_verse: Ši na, mibatẽ dšeṅmaṅ ko ši mawonye, Israel we, Iehowa, Zebaot Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kē̱, ni ame̱ahaonye ke̱-adše̱ Hamat klotia ke̱-yaši ṅã kplenē le̱ no̱ nudšō̱ le̱ nā

english_verse: Then the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of Fire
translation_verse: Iehowa ſa ehe ye̱ ene̱ he: Ebaṅ mli! Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: Then I said, “Won't you please stop? How can our weak nation survive?”
translation_verse: Ni mikē̱: Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa, mīkpao fai ní ofõ! Té Iakob aafe tēṅ adamo̱ šiṅ? edšake̱ bibiõ ke̱ke̱ dšile̱!

english_verse: Again the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of a Measuring Line
translation_verse: Iehowa ſa ehe ye̱ ene̱ hũ he: Ene̱ hũ baṅ mli! Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: Amaziah the priest at Bethel sent this message to King Jeroboam of Israel, “Amos is plotting against you in the very heart of Israel. Our nation cannot put up with his message for very long.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Amazia, Betel oso̱fo le̱, tšũ ke̱-te Ierobeam, Israel maṅtše̱ le̱, ṅō ake̱: Amos ete oyi no̱ apãm ye̱ Israel we le̱ teṅ; šikpoṅ le̱ nyẽṅ ewiemo̱i le̱ fẽ nā adamo̱. Ier.

english_verse: Here is what he is saying: ‘Jeroboam will be put to death, and the people will be taken to a foreign country.’ ”
translation_verse: Sĩ bo̱ni Amos kē̱ ne̱: Ierobeam aagbo ye̱ klante nā, ni Israel le̱, nom kẽ aaṅōle̱ ke̱-adše̱ ešikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ke̱-ate!

english_verse: I answered: I'm not a prophet! And I wasn't trained to be a prophet. I am a shepherd, and I take care of fig trees.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Amos here no̱ ni ekē̱ Amazia ake̱: Dšee gbalo̱ dšimi, ni asaṅ hũ dšee gbalo̱ bi dšimi; ši moṅ *tšina-kwe̱lo̱ dšimi ke̱ moni sāa sikamoretšei ahe.

english_verse: But the Lord told me to leave my herds and preach to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa yakplami ke̱-dše̱ tōì le̱ ase̱, ni Iehowa le̱ noṅṅ kē̱mi ake̱: Ya ni oyagba otšõ mimaṅ Israel!

english_verse: Now, listen to what the Lord says about you: Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, your sons and daughters will be killed in war, and your land will be divided among others. You will die in a country of foreigners, and the people of Israel will be dragged from their homeland.
translation_verse: Hewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Oṅã aatšṍ adſamaṅ ye̱ mã le̱ṅ, ni obihĩĩ ke̱ obiyei le̱ aanyõlyõi ye̱ klante nā, ni ošikpoṅ le̱, ake̱ susumo̱kpã aadša mli, ni bodientše̱ le̱, ooyagbo ye̱ šikpoṅ ko ní he tšee no̱, ni Israel le̱, nom kẽ aaṅōame̱ ke̱-adše̱ ame̱šikpoṅ le no̱ ke̱-ate!

english_verse: The Lord God showed me a basket of ripe fruit
translation_verse: Noni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa hă mina ne̱: Ni na kafũ ke̱ tšeiayibii ní etšu.

english_verse: You people crush those in need and wipe out the poor.
translation_verse: Nyeboa ene̱ toi, *nye mei ni nyeheo̱ ohĩafoi nyemĩ, koni nyehã šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ nõnalo̱i le̱ ase̱ afo, *

english_verse: Your country will tremble, and you will mourn. It will be like the Nile River that rises and overflows, then sinks back down.
translation_verse: Aso šikpoṅ hosoṅ ye̱ ene̱ hewo̱, ni mofẽmo ní yo̱ no̱ le̱ tšui eſāṅ? *Eeyi tamo̱ Nilo, ni eefe hãmãhãmã ni eekpõṅ tamo̱ Mizraim fā le̱. *

english_verse: Your festivals and joyful singing will turn into sorrow. You will wear sackcloth and shave your heads, as you would at the death of your only son. It will be a horrible day.
translation_verse: Ni mahã nyegbĩĩ dšudši le̱ atšṍ ṅko̱mo̱yeli, ni nyelalai fẽ atšṍmo̱ yāfó lalai, ni mike̱ kpekpe aaṅmõ he̱-fē-he̱, ni mahã mofẽmo yiteṅ akpa, ni mahã atšṍ *tamo̱ hi kome he ṅko̱mo̱yeli, ni enāgbē hũ aatamo̱ aw̌ere̱hō gbĩ. *Ier.

english_verse: I, the Lord, also promise you a terrible shortage, but not of food and water. You will hunger and thirst to hear my message.
translation_verse: Na, gbĩĩ mība, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa kē̱, ní mahã hõmo̱ aba šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, dšee abolo hõmo̱ lo nu kũmai ni, ši Iehowa wiemo̱i le̱ atoibō nõ ni!

english_verse: You will search everywhere— from north to south, from east to west. You will go all over the earth, seeking a message from me, the Lord. But you won't find one.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ato̱ ntitãṅ ke̱-adše̱ ṅšo̱ nā ke̱-ya ṅšo̱ nā, ni ame̱atšomlo ke̱-adše̱ kōyigbe̱ ke̱-ya bokãgbe̱, ame̱yatao Iehowa wiemo̱ le̱, *ni ame̱naṅ! *Mika

english_verse: Your beautiful young women and your young men will faint from thirst.
translation_verse: Nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ oblayei ní he yo̱ fe̱o ke̱ obahĩĩ aato̱ biti ke̱ kũmai so̱ṅṅ,

english_verse: You made promises to the goddess Ashimah at Samaria; you made vows to other gods at the shrines of Dan and Beersheba. So now you will fall and never get up.
translation_verse: mei ni ke̱ Samaria eša le̱ kãa kitã ni ame̱kē̱o̱ ake̱: “Gbĩĩabo̱ ní bo, Dan, onyoṅmo̱ le̱ hĩe kā ne̱!” ke̱ “gbĩĩabo̱ ní Beeršeba gbe̱ le̱ hĩe kã ne̱!” le̱, ame̱ le̱ ame̱anyõnyõi, ni ame̱teṅ ší doṅṅ!

english_verse: I saw a vision of the Lord standing by the temple altar, and he said, “Shake the columns until the tops fall loose, and the doorposts crumble. Then make the pieces fall on the people below. I will take a sword and kill anyone who escapes.
translation_verse: Mina Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ damo̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ he, ni ekē̱ ake̱: Tſa akulašĩṅ le̱ yiteṅkpo̱ le̱ no̱, koni kpoku le̱ ahoso, ni owule oſie ame̱fẽ ame̱yiteṅ! Ni mike̱ klante aagbe ame̱teṅ se̱kpelo̱i le̱; ame̱teṅ mokomoko edšoṅ foi, ni ame̱teṅ mokomoko edšeṅ mli.

english_verse: “If they dig deep into the earth or climb to the sky, I'll reach out and get them.
translation_verse: Ké̱ ame̱tša ši ke̱-te gbohĩĩadše tete le̱, minine aaṅõame̱ ke̱-adše̱ dše̱i; ni ké̱ ame̱kwo̱ ke̱-te ṅwei tete le̱, mike̱ame̱ aakpleke ši ke̱-adše̱ dše̱i; Lal.

english_verse: My eyes have seen what a sinful nation you are, and I'll wipe you out. But I will leave a few of Jacob's descendants. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Na, Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa edšĩe ehĩe eka maṅtše̱yeli ní feo̱ eša le̱, ni makpãtã ehĩe ke̱-adše̱ sikpoṅ le̱ no̱; kẽle̱ mikpãtäṅ Iakob we le̱ hĩe kwrakwra, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: At my command, all of you will be sifted like grain. Israelites who remain faithful will be scattered among the nations. And the others will be trapped like trash in a sifter.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ na, mafã́ ni maša Israel we le̱ mli ye̱ dšeṅmãdšimãdši fẽ ateṅ, tamo̱ ašaä nii amli ye̱ šānõ mli, ni kuli egbēṅ šikpoṅ!

english_verse: Some of you are evil, and you deny that you will ever get caught. But you will be killed. The Lord's Promise to Israel
translation_verse: Mimã le̱ṅ ešafelo̱i le̱ fẽ ni *kē̱o̱ ake̱: “Eše̱ṅ wo̱no̱, ni asaṅ eninaṅwo̱!” ke̱, aagboi ye̱ klante nā. *

english_verse: In the future, I will rebuild David's fallen kingdom. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again, just as it used to be.
translation_verse: Nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ *matē David bū ní egbē ši le̱ ši mamã ši, ni matšĩmo̱ emli fodši le̱, ni matē etšũkói le̱ aši mamãmo̱ ši, ni matſale̱ take̱ bo̱ni eyo̱ ye̱ blema gbĩĩ le̱ amli le̱; *Bo̱f.

english_verse: Then you will capture Edom and the other nations that are mine. I, the Lord, have spoken, and my words will come true.
translation_verse: beni afe ni ame̱ṅõ Edom ſē̱nõ le̱ ke̱ dšeṅmădšĩ fẽ ni ake̱ migbe̱i ewoame̱ le̱ ame̱ye, Iehowa, moni feo̱ ene̱ le̱, kē̱.

english_verse: You will have such a harvest that you won't be able to bring in all of your wheat before plowing time. You will have grapes left over from season to season; your fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains.
translation_verse: Na, gbĩĩ mība, Iehowa kē̱, ni *hũlo̱ aayanina nikpalo̱, ni weinyibii aṅã̀lo̱ hũ aayanina nidũlo̱, ni †gõdši le̱ amli aatšere wein do̱ko̱do̱ko̱, ni eehã goṅkpo̱i le̱ fẽ asẽre. *

english_verse: I'll make Israel prosper again. You will rebuild your towns and live in them. You will drink wine from your own vineyards and eat the fruit you grow.
translation_verse: Ni *makpale mimaṅ Israel nomṅō̃ le̱ ke̱-aba ekoṅ, ni ame̱abamãmo̱ mädši kóikói le̱ ame̱ahĩ mli, ni ame̱afe †weintromi, ni ame̱anu ame̱mli wein, ni ame̱afe tromi, ni ame̱aye ame̱mli yibii. *

english_verse: I'll plant your roots deep in the land I have given you, and you won't ever be uprooted again. I, the Lord God, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ni mate̱oame̱ ye̱ ame̱šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni afãṅame̱ ke̱-dše̱ṅ ame̱šikpoṅ ni miṅõ-hãame̱ le̱ no̱ doṅṅ; Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kē̱.

english_verse: The Lord said to Edom: I will make you the weakest and most despised nation.
translation_verse: Na, mifeo bibiō ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ, ohe guo̱ egbo babaō!

english_verse: You live in a mountain fortress, because your pride makes you feel safe from attack, but you are mistaken.
translation_verse: Otšuiṅ hewõ le̱ ešišiuo, bo moni *ohĩo̱ te̱kpodši amli, ni ošihĩle̱he yo̱ ṅwei šoṅṅ; okē̱o̱ ye̱ otšui mli ake̱: Namo aa-nyẽmi adšie ke̱-kpleke ši ke̱-ba šikpoṅ? *

english_verse: If thieves break in at night, they steal only what they want. And people who harvest grapes always leave some unpicked. But, Edom, you are doomed!
translation_verse: Ke̱dši dšulo̱i ba ono̱, ké̱ odšotſalo̱i ba nyõṅ le̱, kwe̱ bo̱ni akpãtã ohĩe! ani ame̱dšuṅ bo̱ni aaše̱ ame̱nā? ké̱ weinyibii kpaloi ba ono le, ani amešĩṅ kpe̱kpe̱-bii?

english_verse: Warriors from the city of Teman will be terrified, and you descendants of Esau will be wiped out. The Lord Condemns Edom's Cruelty
translation_verse: Ni ṅmiṅmi aamõmo̱ ohĩĩ kãkãlo̱i le̱, Teman! beni afe ni ake̱ awuyeli akpãtã mofẽmo hĩe ke̱-dše̱ Esau goṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: You were cruel to your relatives, the descendants of Jacob. Now you will be destroyed, disgraced forever.
translation_verse: Yi ni owa *onyemi Iakob hewo̱ le̱ hĩegbẽle aaha ohe, ni aakpãtã ohĩe ke̱-ate nāno̱. *Ioel

english_verse: You stood there and watched as foreigners entered Jerusalem and took what they wanted. In fact, you were no better than those foreigners.
translation_verse: Gbĩ ni odamo afã, gbĩ ni gbo̱i ṅõ eta le̱ nom ke̱-te ni meikpõdši bote egbói le̱ amli ni ame̱fõ Ierusalem no̱ ošiki le̱, bo hũ otamo̱ ame̱teṅ mo-kome.

english_verse: They are my people, and you were cruel to them. You went through their towns, sneering and stealing whatever was left.
translation_verse: Kābote mimaṅ le̱ agbó le̱ mli ye̱ ame̱gbĩ ſõṅ le̱ no̱, kākwe̱ ame̱nõnā le̱ ye̱ ame̱gbĩ ſõṅ le̱ no̱, ni kākpã onine mli ota ame̱nii le̱ ahe ye̱ ame̱gbĩ ſõṅ le̱ no̱!

english_verse: In their time of torment, you ambushed refugees and handed them over to their attackers. The Lord Will Judge the Nations
translation_verse: Ni kāyadamo̱ gbe̱nta ni okpãtã emei ni dšoo̱ foi le̱ ahĩe, ni kādšie emei ni eſe̱ le̱ ohã ye̱ efĩmo̱ gbĩ le̱ no̱!

english_verse: I forced the people of Judah to drink the wine of my anger on my sacred mountain. Soon the neighboring nations must drink their fill— then vanish without a trace. Victory for Israel
translation_verse: Edšake̱ take̱ bo̱ni nyenunū dãi ye̱ migoṅ kroṅkroṅ le̱ no̱ le̱, nakai noṅṅ dšeṅmãdši le̱ fẽ *aanunū dãi dāne̱; ni ame̱anu ni ame̱amĩ, ni ame̱atšṍmo̱ tamo̱ mei ni be̱ po. *Ier.

english_verse: Israel will be a fire, and Edom will be straw going up in flames. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: Ni Iakob we le̱ aatšṍ *la, ni Iosef we le̱ aatšṍ lalile̱i, ni Esau we le̱ aatšṍ gbetšelii, ni ame̱ahere ye̱ ame̱teṅ, ni ame̱ašãame̱, ni mokomoko eſe̱ṅ hãṅ Esau we le̱; edšake̱ Iehowa kē̱. *Zak.

english_verse: The people of Israel who live in the Southern Desert will take the land of Edom. Those who live in the hills will capture Philistia, Ephraim, and Samaria. And the tribe of Benjamin will conquer Gilead.
translation_verse: Ni wuoyigbe̱bii le̱ aaṅõ Edom goṅ le̱, ni ṅãno̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ bii le̱ aaṅõ Filistibii ašikpoṅ le̱, ni ame̱aṅõ Efraim ṅã le̱ ke̱ Samaria ṅã le̱, ni Benyamin aaṅõ Gilead.

english_verse: Those who return from captivity will control Phoenicia as far as Zarephath. Captives from Jerusalem who were taken to Sepharad will capture the towns of the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Ni ne̱ke̱ ta ne̱, ni dši Israelbii ni aṅõame̱ nom le̱, aaṅõ Kanaanbii le̱ ke̱-yaši Zarefad, ni Ierusalem nomi ni yo̱ Sefarad le̱ aaṅõ wuoyigbe̱ mãdši le̱.

english_verse: Those the Lord has saved will live on Mount Zion and rule over Edom. Then the kingdom will belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni yiwalaherelo̱i aakwo̱ ke̱-ba Zion goṅ le̱ no̱, koni ame̱bakodšo Esau goṅ le̱, ni maṅtše̱yeli le̱ aatšṍ Iehowa nõ.

english_verse: to go to the great city of Nineveh and say to the people, “The Lord has seen your terrible sins. You are doomed!”
translation_verse: Te ši ni oya Ninive maṅ kpeteṅ-kple le̱ṅ, ni oyašie̱ ošile̱, edšake̱ ame̱nifõdšianii le̱ ehaše̱ mihĩe!

english_verse: Instead, Jonah ran from the Lord. He went to the seaport of Joppa and found a ship that was going to Spain. So he paid his fare, then got on the ship and sailed away to escape.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iona te ši, koni edšo foi ke̱-dše̱ Iehowa hĩe ke̱-ya Taršiš; ni eyiṅ ke̱-te Iopa, ni eyana le̱le̱ ko ní yaä Taršiš, ni ewole̱ nyõmo̱, ni ebote mli, koni eke̱ame̱ aya Taršiš ni *edše Iehowa hĩe. *Lal.

english_verse: But the Lord made a strong wind blow, and such a bad storm came up that the ship was about to be broken to pieces.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa hã kō̱yo̱ ni nā wa te ši ye̱ ṅšo̱ le̱ hĩe, ni ahum ni nā wa tſa ye̱ ṅšo̱ le̱ hĩe, ni le̱le̱ le̱ fe tamo̱ noni ebadſa.

english_verse: The sailors were frightened, and they all started praying to their gods. They even threw the ship's cargo overboard to make the ship lighter. All this time, Jonah was down below deck, sound asleep.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni amlākui le̱ še gbeyei, ni mofẽmo blo̱ tšé̱ enyoṅmo̱, ni ame̱dšie le̱le̱ le̱ mli nii ame̱wo ṅšo̱ṅ, koni efe fle̱fle̱ ehãame̱. Ši Iona le̱, ekpleke ši ke̱-te le̱le̱ le̱ šiši tõ, ni ekã ši ewo̱ naakpa.

english_verse: The ship's captain went to him and said, “How can you sleep at a time like this? Get up and pray to your God! Maybe he will have pity on us and keep us from drowning.”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni le̱le̱tše̱ le̱ ba eṅõ ni eba-kē̱le̱ ake̱: Meni feo̱o ni owo̱ö̱ ne̱ke̱? Te ši ni oblo̱ otšé̱ o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ake̱ aleenõ Nyoṅmo̱ aadſēṅ wo̱he ni wo̱hĩe aka-kpãtã lo!

english_verse: Finally, the sailors got together and said, “Let's ask our gods to show us who caused all this trouble.” It turned out to be Jonah.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱kē̱kē̱ ame̱he ake̱: Nyebaä ni wo̱fõa ošiki, ni wo̱ke̱-le mo hewo̱ ni ne̱ke̱ efõṅ ne̱ eba wo̱no̱ ne̱! Ni ame̱fõ ošiki, ni ošiki le̱ *gbē Iona no̱. *Abe̱i

english_verse: They started asking him, “Are you the one who brought all this trouble on us? What business are you in? Where do you come from? What is your country? Who are your people?”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Agbe̱ne̱ tšõmo̱wo̱ mo hewo̱ ni ne̱ke̱ efõṅ ne̱ eba wo̱no̱ ne̱? Meni dši onitšumo̱, ni nẽgbe̱ odše̱? Nẽ dši ošikpoṅ le̱, ni namei dši omaṅbii?

english_verse: When the sailors heard this, they were frightened, because Jonah had already told them he was running from the Lord. Then they said, “Do you know what you have done?”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni gbomei le̱ še gbeyei naakpa dientše̱, ni ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Meni ofe ne̱? Edšake̱ ame̱le ake̱ Iehowa hĩe edšoo̱ foi ke̱-dše̱; edšake̱ ekē̱ame̱.

english_verse: The storm kept getting worse, until finally the sailors asked him, “What should we do with you to make the sea calm down?”
translation_verse: Ni ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Meni wo̱feo, koni ṅšo̱ le̱ aṅmẽ ahãwo̱? edšake̱ ṅšo̱ le̱ mīya no̱ mife hãmãhãmã.

english_verse: Jonah told them, “Throw me into the sea, and it will calm down. I'm the cause of this terrible storm.”
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyewóami, ni nyeše̱ami nyefõa ṅšo̱ le̱ mli, ni ṅšo̱ le̱ aaṅmẽ ahãnye; edšake̱ mile ake̱ mihewo̱ ni ne̱ke̱ ahum kpeteṅkple ne̱ tſaänye ne̱!

english_verse: The sailors tried their best to row to the shore. But they could not do it, and the storm kept getting worse every minute.
translation_verse: Ni mei le̱ mīw̌iri naakpa, koni ame̱kũ ame̱se̱ ke̱-ba šikpoṅ; ši ame̱nyẽẽ, edšake̱ ṅšo̱ mĩya no̱ mīfe hāmãhãmã ke̱-mī-kpeame̱.

english_verse: So they prayed to the Lord, “Please don't let us drown for taking this man's life. Don't hold us guilty for killing an innocent man. All of this happened because you wanted it to.”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ame̱blo̱ ame̱tšé̱ Iehowa ake̱: Ao, Iehowa, wo̱mīkpao fai, kãhã wo̱hĩe mīkpãtã ye̱ nū ne̱ susuma hewo̱, ni oke̱ moni eye bem lá akafõ wo̱no̱! edšake̱ bo, Iehowa, ofeo̱ bo̱ni sa ohĩe!

english_verse: Then they threw Jonah overboard, and the sea calmed down.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ame̱wó Iona, ni ame̱še̱le̱ ame̱fõ ṅšo̱ le̱ṅ; ni ṅšo̱ le̱ fõ ehãmãhãmãfemo̱ le̱.

english_verse: The sailors were so terrified that they offered a sacrifice to the Lord and made all kinds of promises.
translation_verse: Ni gbomei le̱ še Iehowa gbeyei naakpa, ni ame̱šã afo̱le ame̱hã Iehowa, ni ame̱wowō šii.

english_verse: You threw me down to the bottom of the sea. The water was churning all around; I was completely covered by your mighty waves.
translation_verse: ni ekē̱: *Miblo̱ mitšé̱ Iehowa ye̱ mifĩmo̱ le̱ mli, ni eto he ehãmi; mihlo̱ ke̱-dše̱ gbohĩĩadše mūsũṅ, ni ebo migbē toi. *Lal.

english_verse: I was almost drowned by the swirling waters that surrounded me. Seaweed had wrapped around my head.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱ *mikē̱: Aše̱mi afõ ke̱-dše̱ ohĩe! kẽle̱ masā makwe̱ oso̱lemo̱we kroṅkroṅ le̱! *Lal.

english_verse: I had sunk down deep below the mountains beneath the sea. I knew that forever, I would be a prisoner there. But, you, Lord God, rescued me from that pit.
translation_verse: Nu le̱ ebo̱lemi ke̱-yaše̱ misusuma he tõ; hu kwo̱ṅkwo̱ṅ le̱ esa miyi; wosumai ebla miyitšo be. Lal.

english_verse: All who worship worthless idols turn from the God who offers them mercy.
translation_verse: Beni *misusuma to̱ hiti ye̱ mimli le̱, mikai Iehowa, ni miso̱lemo̱ še̱ oṅõ, ye̱ oso̱lemo̱we kroṅkroṅ le̱. *Lal.

english_verse: The Lord commanded the fish to vomit up Jonah on the shore. And it did.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, mike̱ šidā ghē aašã afo̱le ahão; maye mišiwō le̱ no̱. Yiwalaheremo̱ le̱ Iehowa nõ ni! Lal.

english_verse: Jonah obeyed the Lord and went to Nineveh. The city was so big that it took three days just to walk through it.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iona te ši, ni eyiṅ ete Ninive ye̱ Iehowa wiemo̱ le̱ nā. Ši Ninive le̱, *maṅ kpeteṅkple ni ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hīe, efeo̱ gbīĩ etẽ gbe̱nyiemo̱. *

english_verse: After walking for a day, Jonah warned the people, “Forty days from now, Nineveh will be destroyed!”
translation_verse: Ni Iona bõi maṅ le̱ mli botemo̱ gbĩ kome gbe̱nyiemo̱, ni ešie̱ ni ekē̱: Bie̱ gbĩĩ nyoṅmai-edſe̱ se̱ le̱ ababutu Ninive!

english_verse: They believed God's message and set a time when they would go without eating to show their sorrow. Then everyone in the city, no matter who they were, dressed in sackcloth.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Ninivebii le̱ he Nyoṅmo̱ ame̱ye, ni ame̱šie̱ ni ahĩ ṅmã, ni ame̱bumo̱ kpekpei ke̱-dše̱ ame̱teṅ mo wulu no̱ ke̱-baši ame̱teṅ mo bibiõ no̱. Mat.

english_verse: When the king of Nineveh heard what was happening, he also dressed in sackcloth; he left the royal palace and sat in dust.
translation_verse: Ni beni wiemo̱ le̱ še̱ Ninive maṅtše̱ le̱ ṅõ le̱, ete ši ke̱-dše̱ esẽi le̱ no̱, ni edšie ehebo fe̱fe̱o le̱ ye̱ ehe efõ ši, ni ebu kpekpe, ni eho etá lamlu mli.

english_verse: When God saw that the people had stopped doing evil things, he had pity and did not destroy them as he had planned.
translation_verse: Ni Nyoṅmo̱ na ame̱nifemo̱nii le̱, ake̱ ame̱kpale ke̱-dše̱ ame̱gbe̱ fõṅ le̱ no̱, ni Nyoṅmo̱ *ſa ehe ye̱ efõṅ ni ekē̱ ebafeame̱ le̱ hewo̱, ni efee. *Ier.

english_verse: Jonah then left through the east gate of the city and made a shelter to protect himself from the sun. He sat under the shelter, waiting to see what would happen to Nineveh.
translation_verse: Ši Iona dše kpo ke̱-dše̱ mã le̱ṅ, ni eyatá maṅ le̱ bokãghe̱, ni efe asese ye̱ dše̱i ehã ehe, ni eho etá šiši ye̱ hõṅ le̱ mli, ke̱-yaši heyine̱ ní eena noni aafe maṅ le̱.

english_verse: The Lord made a vine grow up to shade Jonah's head and protect him from the sun. Jonah was very happy to have the vine,
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iehowa sã adedeṅkrũma ko, ni ekwẽ eha Iona yiteṅ, koni eyiteṅ aná hõṅ, ni eke̱-dšiele̱ ke̱-dše̱ ehaomo̱ le̱ mli. Ke̱ke̱ ni Iona nyã́ adedeṅkrũma le̱ he naakpa.

english_verse: but early the next morning the Lord sent a worm to chew on the vine, and the vine dried up.
translation_verse: Ši dšetše̱reno̱ lehi le̱, Nyoṅmo̱ sã gõgõmi ko, ni eye adedeṅkrũma le̱, ni eṅãlã.

english_verse: During the day the Lord sent a scorching wind, and the sun beat down on Jonah's head, making him feel faint. Jonah was ready to die, and he shouted, “I wish I were dead!”
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱, heni hũlū te ši le̱, Nyoṅmo̱ sã bokà kō̱yo̱ ni mli edo̱ la, ni hũlũ le̱ šã Iona yiteṅ, ni eto̱ biti; ni etao gbĕle ehã ehe, ni ekē̱: Fãṅ noni migho moṅ fè noni mihĩe kã ne̱!

english_verse: But the Lord asked, “Jonah, do you have the right to be angry about the vine?” “Yes, I do,” he answered, “and I'm angry enough to die.”
translation_verse: Ni Nyoṅmo̱ kē̱ Iona ake̱: *Kole̱ omli ni ewo la ye̱ adedeṅkrũma ne̱ hewo̱ ne̱ edša, be̱? Ni ekē̱: Edša ake̱ mi-mli awo la ke-yaši gbĕle mli tete! *K.

english_verse: But the Lord said: You are concerned about a vine that you did not plant or take care of, a vine that grew up in one night and died the next.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱: Bo le̱, adedeṅkrũma ne̱ ni ogboko he deṅme ko, ni dšee ho ohã ekwẽ, ni nyõṅ kome mli eba, ni nyõṅ kome mli noṅṅ ehĩe kpãtã le̱, esane mīdo̱o;

english_verse: Mountains will melt beneath his feet like wax beside a fire. Valleys will vanish like water rushing down a ravine.
translation_verse: Ni gõdši le̱ aasĕre ye̱ ešiši, ni dšō̱i le̱ amli aagblagblai, tamo̱ wò-agbaku sĕreo̱ ye la hĩe, tamo̱ nu ní hoo̱ ſimſim ye heko ni emã enā ši.

english_verse: This will happen because of the terrible sins of Israel, the descendants of Jacob. Samaria has led Israel to sin, and pagan altars at Jerusalem have made Judah sin.
translation_verse: Iakob mlatõmo̱ le̱ ke̱ Israel we le̱ he ešai le̱ ahewo̱ ni ene̱mei fẽ baä ne̱. Mẽ dši Iakob mlatõmo̱ le̱? *ani dšee Samaria ni? ni mẽ dši Iuda hei groṅṅi le̱? ani dšee Ierusalem ni? *Ier.

english_verse: So the Lord will leave Samaria in ruins— merely an empty field where vineyards are planted. He will scatter its stones and destroy its foundations.
translation_verse: Ni mafe Samaria kóikói ye̱ ṅã le̱ no̱, ke̱ weintromi amli te̱omo̱nii, ni mafo̱se emli te̱i le̱ maſie dšō̱ le̱ mli, ni madšie ešišĩtōi le̱ akpo.

english_verse: Because of this tragedy, I go barefoot and naked. My crying and weeping sound like howling wolves or ostriches.
translation_verse: Ene̱ hewo̱ le̱ mawo yăra ni mawo̱ lele, manyie pasā ke̱ yayai; mawo yăra tamo̱ ṅãṅgbēi, ni maye ṅko̱mo̱ tamo̱ dugumai.

english_verse: The nation is fatally wounded. Judah is doomed. Jerusalem will fall.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ epilamo̱i le̱ ehĩĩ tsámo̱; edšake̱ ehe Iuda tõ, eše̱ mimaṅ le̱ agbó le̱ nā, eše̱ Ierusalem!

english_verse: Don't tell it in Gath! Don't even cry. Instead, roll in the dust at Beth-Leaphrah.
translation_verse: *Nyekayagbaä ye̱ Gat! nyekayafóa ye̱ Ako! makoklo lamlu mii ye̱ Bet-Afra! *

english_verse: Depart naked and ashamed, you people of Shaphir. The town of Bethezel mourns because no one from Zaanan went out to help.
translation_verse: Nyehoa ke̱-yaä ke̱ hĩegbĕle ke̱ he-yayai, nye Safirbii! Zaanabii le̱ edšee kpo doṅṅ; Bet-Ezel yărafemo̱ le̱ ehã edāmo̱ ni ebadamo̱ nyemase̱i le̱ ebo̱nye!

english_verse: Everyone in Maroth hoped for the best, but the Lord sent disaster down on Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Marotbii le̱ mīkwe̱ nõkpakpa gbe̱; edšake̱ nõfõṅ dše̱ Iehowa ṅõ kpleke ši ke̱-ba Ierusalem agbó le̱ nā.

english_verse: Get the war chariots ready, you people of Lachish. You led Jerusalem into sin, just as Israel did.
translation_verse: Nyefĩa ſīli nyekpe̱te̱a okpo̱ṅo̱ ní he yo̱ oyá le̱, nye Lakišbii! le̱ dši eša šišidšē hã Zion biyō le̱; edšake̱ bo omli ana Israel mlatõmo̱i le̱ ye̱!

english_verse: Now you will have to give a going-away gift to Moresheth. Israel's kings will discover that they cannot trust the town of Achzib.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ oohã Morešet-Gat mligblamo̱wolo. Akzib šĩai le̱ aatšṍmo̱ šišiumo̱-fā ahã Israel maṅtše̱mei le̱.

english_verse: People of Mareshah, the Lord will send someone to capture your town. Then Israel's glorious king will be forced to hide in Adullam Cave.
translation_verse: Kẽle̱ mike̱ no̱yelo̱ aaba nyeno̱, Marešabii le̱; Israel hĩenānobii le̱ aaše̱ Adulam tō̃.

english_verse: Judah, shave your head as bald as a vulture and start mourning. Your precious children will be dragged off to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Kpo̱ oyi ní oše̱ otšẽṅ ye̱ obii ni onyã́a ame̱he le̱ ahewo̱; hã oyiteṅ kpatā le̱ alē̱ tamo̱ akpaṅa nõ! edšake̱ ame̱dše ohe ame̱te nomṅō̃ mli!

english_verse: Doomed! You're doomed! At night you lie in bed, making evil plans. And when morning comes, you do what you've planned because you have the power.
translation_verse: Kpóo hã mei ní dſẽṅo̱ nišaianii ni ame̱too̱ nifõdšianii ahe ṅāi *ye̱ ame̱sāi ano̱ le̱! ké̱ dše tše̱re le̱, ame̱feo̱, edšake̱ eye̱ ame̱dẽ hewale̱ mli. *Lal.

english_verse: You grab any field or house that you want; you cheat families out of homes and land.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱hĩe kõo̱ abō̱i ano̱, ni ame̱šõo̱, ke̱ šĩai, ni ame̱ṅõo̱; ni ame̱yeo̱ mo ke̱ ewe ke̱ mo ke̱ egbošinii amim.

english_verse: But here is what the Lord says: “I am planning trouble for you. Your necks will be caught in a noose, and you will be disgraced in this time of disaster.”
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Na, mīdſēṅ efõṅ ye̱ ne̱ke̱ weku ne̱ le, ni nyenyẽṅ nyikue̱i nyedšie ye̱ mli, ni asaṅ nyenyieṅ ye̱ hewõ mii doṅṅ; edšake̱ ne̱ke̱ be ne̱, *be fõṅ ni. *Amos

english_verse: When that happens, this sorrowful song will be sung about you: “Ruined! Completely ruined! The Lord has taken our land and given it to traitors.”
translation_verse: Nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ aabu nyehe abe̱, ni aala yāfo lala ake̱: Eba mli, afitewo̱ kwrakwra! etšake mimaṅ le̱ gbe̱fāṅnõ le̱; kwe̱ boni etšile̱ ke̱-dše̱ mihe! eke̱ wo̱ṅmõdsi le̱ ehã henye̱lo̱!

english_verse: And so you will never again own property among the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ onáṅ moko ni aaṅmẽ kpã ye̱ ošikifõ nā ye̱ Iehowa asafo le̱ mli.

english_verse: “Enough of your preaching!” That's what you tell me. “We won't be disgraced, so stop preaching!”
translation_verse: *Ame̱šie̱o̱ ake̱: Nyekašie̱a! Ani esaa ake̱ ašie̱ ene̱mei, ani esaa ake̱ hĩegbĕle le̱ se̱ afo? *Amos

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, is it right for you to claim that the Lord did what he did because he was angry? Doesn't he always bless those who do right?
translation_verse: Bo ni atšé̱o̱o Iakob we, ani Iehowa etoo etšui ši? alo enitšumo̱i dši ene̱mei? ani dšee hĩ miwiemo̱i le̱ hĩ hã moni nyieo̱ dšale̱ nā le̱?

english_verse: My people, you have turned against one another! You have even stolen clothes right off the backs of innocent neighbors who pass by in peace.
translation_verse: Ši dšeeṅmõ bēbe mimaṅ le̱ te ši tamo̱ henye̱lo̱; nyekplo̱ö̱ atade no̱ſiemo̱nõ ye̱ mei ní hoo̱ kpō ní ame̱sumo̱o̱ ta le̱ ahe.

english_verse: You take over lovely homes that belong to the women of my nation. Then you cheat their children out of the inheritance that comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Mimã le̱ṅ yei le̱; nyeſieame̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ ame̱sĩai ní ame̱nyã́a he le̱; ame̱bii fufo̱bii le̱, nyešõo̱ minumnyam le̱ ye̱ ame̱deṅ ke̱-yaä nāno̱.

english_verse: Get out of here, you crooks! You'll find no rest here. You're not fit to belong to the Lord's people, and you will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nyetea ši ní nyeyaā! edšake̱ dšee nyehedšō̱mo̱be ne̱, ye̱ mũdšinii ní ke̱ hĩekpãtãmo̱ ní nā wa baä le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: The only prophet you want is a liar who will say, “Drink and get drunk!” A Promise of Hope
translation_verse: Ekole̱ nū ni nyieo̱ kō̱yo̱ se̱ ni eyeo̱ kũtũmpo̱o ni emaleo̱ ake̱: Mašie̱ wein ke̱ dā̃ ní wa he šie̱mo̱ le̱ ehaišṍ šielo̱ ehã ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱!

english_verse: I will break down the gate and lead them out— then I will be their king.
translation_verse: Dſãralo̱ aafã ke̱-atšṍ ame̱hĩe; ame̱adſāra ni ame̱atšṍ agbó le̱ mli, ni ame̱sā ame̱adše kpo ekoṅ, ni ame̱maṅtše̱ ie̱ aatšṍ ame̱hĩe, ni *Iehowa aafe ame̱safokaṅ. *Ies.

english_verse: You lying prophets promise security for anyone who gives you food, but disaster for anyone who refuses to feed you. Here is what the Lord says to you prophets:
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ye̱ gbaloi le̱, ni hãa mimaṅ ie̱ dũo̱ gbe̱ le̱, mei ní ké̱ ame̱ná noko ame̱ke̱ ame̱nyãnyõdši mīkpe ni ame̱blo̱ö̱ ake̱: Omanye! ši moni woo ame̱dāṅ noko le̱, ame̱feo̱ ta ame̱šio̱le̱ le̱, ahe ne̱:

english_verse: “You will live in the dark, far from the sight of the sun, with no message from me.
translation_verse: Ene̱ hewo̱ le̱ dše aananye, koni nyekana ninā ko, ni buṅ aawonye, ko-ni nyekakla, ni hũlũ aanyõ ši ye̱ gbalo̱i le̱ ano̱, ni ſane aatšṍ duṅ kpī ye̱ ame̱no̱.

english_verse: But the Lord has filled me with power and his Spirit. I have been given the courage to speak about justice and to tell you people of Israel that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, miyi obõ ke̱ hewale̱ ke̱ Iehowa Mumo̱ le̱ ke̱ kodšomo̱ ke̱ ekā̃ so̱ṅṅ, ní maṅõ-dšadše Iakob mlatõmo̱ le̱ ke̱ Israel he ešai le̱ matšõame̱. Ies.

english_verse: You make cruelty and murder a way of life in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: nye mei ní nyeke̱ *lá mãa Zion, ni nyeke̱ kõdõṅnii māa Ierusalem le! Hab.

english_verse: And so, because of you, Jerusalem will be plowed under and left in ruins. Thorns will cover the mountain where the temple now stands.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyehewo̱ le̱ *aahũ Zion tamo̱ ahũo̱ ṅmõ, ni Ierusalem aatšṍ kóikói, ni šĩa le̱ goṅ le̱ aatšṍ kōṅ he groṅṅ ko! Ier.

english_verse: People of many nations will come and say, “Let's go up to the mountain of the Lord God of Jacob and worship in his temple.” The Lord will teach us his Law from Jerusalem, and we will obey him.
translation_verse: ni dšeṅmãdši pī aate ayakē̱ ake̱: Nyebaä ní wo̱yakwo̱a Iehowa goṅ le̱, ke̱-yaä Iakob Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ we le̱, koni etsõwo̱ egbè̱i le̱, ní wo̱nyie etempõṅi le̱ ano̱! Edšake̱ mla le̱, Zion ebadše̱, ní Iehowa wiemo̱ le̱, *Ierusalem ebadše̱. *Luk.

english_verse: Everyone will find rest beneath their own fig trees or grape vines, and they will live in peace. This is a solemn promise of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ni mofẽmo aitá *eweintšo ke̱ egbãmitšo šiši, ni moko woṅ ame̱he gbeyei; edšake̱ Iehowa Zebaot nābu wie. *

english_verse: Others may follow their gods, but we will always follow the Lord our God. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mãdšimãdši le̱ fẽ ateṅ mofẽmo nyieo̱ ye̱ enyoṅmo̱ gbe̱i amli; ši wo̱ le̱ wo̱o̱nyie ye̱ Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, gbe̱i amli ke̱-ate nāno̱i anāno̱!

english_verse: The Lord said: At that time I will gather my people— the lame and the outcasts, and all others into whose lives I have brought sorrow.
translation_verse: Nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱, Iehowa kē̱, mabua mei ni tšo̱ö̱ le̱ anā, ni makpla mei ní aſieame̱ le̱ ke̱ mei ní mihao le̱ fẽ ke̱-aba. Ier.

english_verse: Then the lame and the outcasts will belong to my people and become a strong nation. I, the Lord, will rule them from Mount Zion forever.
translation_verse: Ni maṅõ mei ni tšo̱ö̱ le̱ maſe mei ní eſe̱, ni maṅõ mei ní aše̱re̱ame̱ aſie soṅn le̱ mafe dšeṅmaṅ agbo; ni Iehowa aaye ame̱no̱ maṅtše̱ ye̱ Zion goṅ le̱ no̱ ke̱-adše̱ ṅme̱ne̱ ke̱-ate nāno̱ fẽ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, why are you crying? Don't you have a king? Have your advisors gone? Are you suffering like a woman in childbirth?
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ mĕba oblo̱ö̱ wā? *Ani maṅtše̱ be̱ omli, alo onāwolo̱ le̱ elādše, edšake̱ kō̃mo̱ eta ohe tamo̱ yō ní bafo̱? *Ier.

english_verse: Keep on groaning with pain, you people of Jerusalem! If you escape from your city to the countryside, you will still be taken as prisoners to Babylonia. But later I will rescue you from your enemies.
translation_verse: Zion biyō kẽmo̱ ke̱ke̱, ní okõmo̱ tamo̱ yō ní bafo̱! Edšake̱ agbe̱ne̱ oodše kpo ke̱-adše̱ mã le̱ṅ, ní oyahĩ ṅã le̱ no̱, ní ooše̱ Babel tō̃; dše̱i aadšieo ye̱; dše̱i Iehowa akpõo ye̱ ke̱-adše̱ obenye̱lo̱i le̱ adeṅ.

english_verse: Zion, because of your sins you are surrounded by many nations who say, “We can hardly wait to see you disgraced.”
translation_verse: Ši agbe̱ne̱ dšeṅmãdši pī anā ekpe ewo ohe, ni ame̱kē̱o̱ ake̱: Abulele̱, koni wo̱hĩṅme̱ii akwe̱ Zion!

english_verse: But they don't know that I, the Lord, have gathered them here to grind them like grain.
translation_verse: Ši ame̱ le̱ ame̱lee Iehowa dſẽṅmo̱i le̱, ni ame̱yoo eyiṅtō le̱ se̱, ake̱ ebua ame̱nā tamo̱ ṅmā̃kei ye̱ ṅmā̃gbẽmo̱he.

english_verse: Smash them to pieces, Zion! I'll let you be like a bull with iron horns and bronze hoofs. Crush those nations and bring their wealth to me, the Lord of the earth.
translation_verse: Te ši ni ogbẽ ṅmā̃, Zion biyō! Edšake̱ mafe oklontoi le̱ dade ke̱ okoklotoi le̱ hũ akō̱ble, ni oke̱-ašimo̱ mãdši pī dukuduku, ni oodšō̱ ame̱hānii le̱ no̱ oke Iehowa, ni oke̱ ame̱nĩfále̱ le̱ aahā šikpoṅ le̱ fẽ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Like a shepherd taking care of his sheep, this ruler will lead and care for his people by the power and glorious name of the Lord his God. His people will live securely, and the whole earth will know his true greatness,
translation_verse: Ni mone̱ aatšṍ *hedšo̱le̱. Ké̱ Ašur mītao aba wo̱šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ní ebabote wo̱mõdši fe̱fe̱dši le̱ amli le̱, no le̱ wo̱o̱tē no̱kwe̱lo̱i kpawo ke̱ lume̱i kpānyo̱ ši wo̱-wole̱. *Ies.

english_verse: because he will bring peace. Assyria Will Be Defeated Let Assyria attack our country and our palaces. We will counterattack, led by a number of rulers
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ke̱ klante aalè̱ Ašur šikpoṅ le̱ ke̱ Nimrod šikpoṅ le̱ ye̱ egbói le̱ anā; ni eeherewo̱ ke̱-dše̱ Ašur deṅ, ké̱ eba wo̱šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni ebanānā wo̱hūsũi le̱ ano̱ le̱.

english_verse: The Lord said: At that time I will wipe out your cavalry and chariots,
translation_verse: ni maplenē ošikpoṅ le̱ no̱ mãdši le̱, ni makũmo̱ omõdši le̱ fiā;

english_verse: as well as your cities and your fortresses.
translation_verse: ni maplenẽ ṅkũnyāyelii ke̱-adše̱ odeṅ, ní onáṅ okõmfoi doṅṅ;

english_verse: I will stop you from telling fortunes and practicing witchcraft.
translation_verse: ni maplenē omāgãi ke̱ owo̱ṅte̱i le̱ ke̱-adše̱ omli, ni odšáṅ onidši anā nitšumo̱ le̱ doṅṅ; Zak.

english_verse: You will no longer worship the idols or stone images you have made— I will destroy them,
translation_verse: ni mafãmo̱ okrabatšai le̱ ke̱-adše̱ omli, ni makpãtã omãdši le̱ ahĩe;

english_verse: together with the sacred poles and even your towns.
translation_verse: ni mike̱ mlifũ ke̱ mlila aato̱ owele ye̱ dšeṅmādši ní boo toi le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: My people, have I wronged you in any way at all? Please tell me.
translation_verse: Mimaṅ, meni mifeo, ni meni mli hũ mihã eto̱o ye̱? Ye odase ošimi! Ier.

english_verse: What offering should I bring when I bow down to worship the Lord God Most High? Should I try to please him by sacrificing calves a year old?
translation_verse: “Meni mike̱-aba Iehowa hĩe, ni makoto ši ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ní yo̱ ṅwei šoṅṅ le̱ hĩe? Ani mike̱ *šā̃-afo̱lei ke̱ tšinabii ni eye afifi aba ehĩe? Ies.

english_verse: Will thousands of sheep or rivers of olive oil make God satisfied with me? Should I sacrifice to the Lord my first-born child as payment for my terrible sins?
translation_verse: Ani Iehowa aaná tõagboi akpei abo̱ lo mũ fãi akpei-nyoṅmai abo̱ he tšui? Aso míṅõ mikromo̱bi míhã ye̱ mimlatõmo̱ le̱ hewo̱, alo mike̱ mimũsũṅbi ahã ye̱ misusuma he eša le̱ hewo̱?”

english_verse: I am the Lord, and you are wise to respect my power to punish. So listen to my message for the city of Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Iehowa gbē le̱ mĩbo mĩtšé̱ maṅ le, ni ehĩ ake̱ aše egbe̱i le̱ gbeyei; nyeboa tšo le̱ ke̱ moni tole̱ le̱ toi!

english_verse: You store up stolen treasures and use dishonest scales.
translation_verse: Ani nõfõṅfemo̱ dſetrii ke̱ *e̱fa ni še̱e̱ ní ahĩo̱ le̱ ye̱ mofõṅ we le̱ lolo? *Amos

english_verse: But I, the Lord, will punish you for cheating with weights and with measures.
translation_verse: Ani mihe aatše, ké̱ mihĩe nsẽnii fõdši ke̱ fotro le̱ emli šišiumo̱ nsẽnite̱i le̱?

english_verse: Because of your sins, I will wound you and leave you ruined and defenseless.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ mi hũ matſiao nii dšogbāṅ, ni makpãtã ohĩe ye̱ ohe ešai le̱ ahewo̱.

english_verse: You will eat, but still be hungry; you will store up goods, but lose everything— I, the Lord, will let it all be captured in war.
translation_verse: Ooye nii, ši oto̱ṅ, ši ohõmo̱ le̱ aahĩ omli kẽ; oodšienii; ši oke̱-yaṅ; ni noni oke̱-ate le̱, maṅõ-hã klante;

english_verse: You won't harvest what you plant or use the oil from your olive trees or drink the wine from grapes you grow.
translation_verse: oodũ nii; ši okpaṅ; ooṅã̀ mũtšoyibii; ši okpaṅ mũ, ke̱ wein hē hũ, ši onuṅ wein.

english_verse: Sons refuse to respect their own fathers, daughters rebel against their own mothers, and daughters-in-law despise their mothers-in-law. Your family is now your enemy.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *binū ebuu etše̱, biyō hũ teo̱ ši woo̱ enye, šāyō teo̱ ši woo̱ ešāyō; ni modientše̱ šĩateṅbii dši ehenye̱lo̱i! *Ier.

english_verse: Towns of Judah, the day is coming when your walls will be rebuilt, and your boundaries enlarged.
translation_verse: Gbĩ ko aaba ní aatſa ogbogboi le̱; nakai gbĩ le̱ aatši ohũsũ le̱ ke̱-ate šoṅṅ.

english_verse: Lead your people, Lord! Come and be our shepherd. Grasslands surround us, but we live in a forest. So lead us to Bashan and Gilead, and let us find pasture as we did long ago.
translation_verse: Oke̱ otšo le̱ *alè̱ omaṅ le̱, ní dši ogbe̱fãṅnõ le̱ tōiku le̱, ní †ekometō ehĩe̱ ši; ye̱ kōṅ ye̱ Karmel yiteṅ le̱; hã ní alè̱ame̱ ye̱ Bašan ke̱ Gilgal, tamo̱ blema gbĩĩ le̱ amli. *

english_verse: because of their fear of me, your Lord and God. Then they will come trembling, crawling out of their fortresses like insects or snakes, lapping up the dust. No One Is Like God The people said:
translation_verse: Ame̱alemo̱ *sũ tamo̱ onũfũ, tamo̱ šikpoṅ no̱ wāmo̱nibii, ame̱adše̱ ame̱kpokplobii le̱ amli ame̱aba ke̱ hekpokpomo̱; Iehowa, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, be ṅmiṅmi aamõmo̱ame̱, ni ame̱ašeo gbeyei. *Ies.

english_verse: and pleased to be merciful. You will trample on our sins and throw them in the sea.
translation_verse: Eekũ ese̱ ni emũsũṅ aatšõle̱ ye̱ wo̱-he, eke̱ enane aaſiſia wo̱nišaianii le̱ ano̱; ni ooše̱re̱ wohe ešai le̱ oſie ṅšo̱ṅ bu kwo̱ṅkwo̱ṅ le̱ mli.

english_verse: You will keep your word and be faithful to Jacob and to Abraham, as you promised our ancestors many years ago.
translation_verse: Dšiemo̱ ano̱kwayeli kpo otšõ Iakob, ni odšie mo̱bo̱nale̱ kpo otšõ Abraham, bo̱ni *okã wo̱tše̱mei le̱ akitã ke̱-dše̱ blema gbĩĩ le̱ amli bẽbe le̱! *

english_verse: The Lord is powerful, yet patient; he makes sure that the guilty are always punished. He can be seen in storms and in whirlwinds; clouds are the dust from his feet.
translation_verse: Iehowa mli fũũ mrā, ni ehewale̱ le̱ da kple, ni *ehãã no̱tõlo̱ aṅõ ehe aye. Iehowa le̱, ahum ke̱ lasũogbĕle mli egbe̱ le̱ kã, ni atatu le̱, enaneši mlu ni. *

english_verse: The Lord is good. He protects those who trust him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Iehowa *hĩ, mō̃ ní wa dšile̱ ye̱ fĩmo̱ gbĩ no̱; ni †ele mei ni baäle̱ abo le̱. *

english_verse: But like a roaring flood, the Lord chases his enemies into dark places and destroys them.
translation_verse: Ši eke̱ nu babaō ni hoo̱ aahã emā̃he le̱ alādše, ni ehenye̱lo̱i le̱, eke̱ duṅ tiuo̱ame̱!

english_verse: So don't plot against the Lord! He wipes out his enemies, and they never revive.
translation_verse: Meni nyedſẽṅo̱ nyešio̱ Iehowa? Ebafo se̱! ni fĩmo̱ eteṅ ši noni dši ši enyo̱.

english_verse: They are like drunkards overcome by wine, or like twisted thornbushes burning in a fire.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ ame̱tõtõ tamo̱ ṅmei, ni ame̱fo̱ tšō ke̱ ame̱dā̃ le̱, aašãame̱ kwrakwra tamo̱ gbetšelii gbĩdši pe̱.

english_verse: Assyria, one of your rulers has made evil plans against the Lord.
translation_verse: Moko edše̱ omli ni dſẽṅo̱ Iehowa he efõṅ, ni etoo̱ eyiṅ efõṅ.

english_verse: But the Lord says, “Assyria, no matter how strong you are, you will be cut down! My people Judah, I have troubled you before, but I won't do it again.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: Kē̱ ame̱dše mli šišiši, ni ame̱yi fá po le̱, aaflo̱ame̱ aſie kẽ, ni eeho eya. Ni ké̱ mibao ši dšiṅṅ, mibaṅo ši doṅṅ.

english_verse: I'll snap your chains and set you free from the Assyrians.”
translation_verse: Ši agbe̱ne̱ makũmo̱ epã le̱ mli ke̱-adše̱ ohe, ni matšĕre̱ okpãi le̱.

english_verse: Assyria, this is what else the Lord says to you: “Your name will be forgotten. I will destroy every idol in your temple, and I will send you to the grave, because you are worthless.”
translation_verse: Ši Iehowa ewo kitã ye̱ ohe ake̱: ogbe̱i le̱ náṅ seši doṅṅ! Maflo̱ amãgã ke̱ wo̱ṅ ke̱-adše̱ onyoṅmo̱ le̱ we le̱, masā ogbonyobu mato, edšake̱ oye̱ fle̱fle̱ tšṍ!

english_verse: Judah and Israel are like trees with branches broken by their enemies. But the Lord is going to restore their power and glory. *
translation_verse: Hĩekpãtãlo̱ le̱ efã ebatuao! Bu gbogboi le̱ ahe, sramo̱ gbe̱ le̱, mĩamo̱ ohe̱, wadšemo̱ ohewale̱ le̱ ni awa!

english_verse: Nineveh, on this day of attack, your enemies' shields are red; their uniforms are crimson.
translation_verse: Ši Iehowa mĩkpale Iakob agbodšē le̱ ke̱-mība, tamo̱ Israel agbodšē le̱; odšake̱ halo̱i le̱ ehaame̱, ni ame̱fite ame̱-weintšei anidši le̱.

english_verse: Their horses prance, and their armored chariots dart around like lightning or flaming torches.
translation_verse: Ekãkãlo̱i le̱ atše̱ṅi le̱ tšuo̱, tabilo̱i le̱ hũ wo munẽle, eſīlii ahe dadei le̱ kple̱o̱ ye̱ ehesāmo̱ gbĩ le̱ no̱, ni ahosoo̱ akplo̱i le̱.

english_verse: An officer gives a command. But his soldiers stumble, as they hasten to build a shelter to protect themselves against rocks thrown down from the city wall.
translation_verse: Fīlii le̱ flo̱ö̱ ši ke̱ hĩedō̱ ye̱ blobũi le̱ amli, ame̱he̱mo̱he̱moo̱ ame̱he ye̱ dšadši le̱ ano̱, kē̱ okwe̱ame̱ le̱, ame̱tamo̱ ko̱tii, ni ame̱šaä foi tamo̱ srawai.

english_verse: Enemy soldiers shout, “The city is full of treasure and all kinds of wealth. Steal her silver! Grab her gold!”
translation_verse: Ši Ninive tamo̱ kpākpo ke̱-dše̱ blema bēbe; ši ame̱adšo foi. Nyedamo̱a ši, nyedamo̱a ši! ši mokomoko tšṍṅ ehe.

english_verse: Nineveh is doomed! Destroyed! Her people tremble with fear; their faces turn pale.
translation_verse: Nyehaä dſie̱te̱i, nyekaä šika! edšake̱ nii ni abua nā ato ke̱ fe̱onibii sro̱toi babaō le̱ fẽ be̱ nāgbẽ.

english_verse: What happened to this city? They were safer there than powerful lions in a den, with no one to disturb them.
translation_verse: Aſe̱le̱ eflo, ekã ši eflo ke̱ amaṅfõ, ni *tšui mīfã, ni nakutšei mīhoso; ame̱-he̱iaṅ fẽ mīkpokpo, ame̱fẽ ame̱bĩeaṅ ešale. Ies.

english_verse: These are the same lions that ferociously attacked their victims, then dragged away the flesh to feed their young.
translation_verse: Nẽgbe̱ dšatai ahĩle̱he le̱ ke̱ dšata oblahĩĩ aniyelihe le̱ yo̱, beni dšatanū ke̱ dšatayō ke̱ dšatabi nyieo̱, ni moko woo ame̱he gbeyei le̱?

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is against you, Nineveh. God will burn your chariots and send an army to kill those young lions of yours. You will never again make victims of others or send messengers to threaten everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Dšata le̱ tšere̱o̱ mli bo̱ni aaše̱ ebii le̱ anā, ni ešõtōo̱ ehãa edšatayei le̱, ni eke̱ lō ni emõ woo̱ ebui le̱ amli obõbõ, ni eke̱ nii ni etšere̱ mli le̱ woo̱ ešihĩle̱hei le̱ obõbõ.

english_verse: here is your fate— cracking whips, churning wheels; galloping horses, roaring chariots;
translation_verse: Okpo̱ṅo̱ kpã mīgbē̱, ni ſīlinãdši mĩ-gbē̱; okpo̱ṅo̱i mĩša foi, ni ſīlii mīhe̱mo̱ ši;

english_verse: But I, the Lord All-Powerful, am now your enemy. I will pull up your skirt and let nations and kingdoms stare at your nakedness.
translation_verse: Na, mike̱o ená, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱, ni *mawó otade nāmūi le̱ ano̱ ye̱ ohĩe, ni mahã dšeṅmãdši le̱ ana oyayaiaṅ, ni maṅtše̱yelii le̱ hũ ana ohĩegbĕle le̱. *Ies.

english_verse: I will cover you with garbage, treat you like trash, and rub you in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ni maše̱re̱ nyãṅemo̱nii maſíe ono̱ ni mabuleo, ni maṅõo mafe kwe̱mo̱nõ.

english_verse: Everyone who sees you will turn away and shout, “Nineveh is done for! Is anyone willing to mourn or to give her comfort?” Nineveh's Fate Is Sealed
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱ mofēmo ní aanao le̱ aadšo onā foi, ni eekē̱ ake̱: Ninive etšṍ amaṅfõ! namo aayelē̱ ṅko̱mo̱? nẽgbe̱ matao mīše̱dšelo̱i mahão kē̱-adše̱?

english_verse: Nineveh, do you feel safer than the city of Thebes? The Nile River was its wall of defense.
translation_verse: Ani obĩ fè *No-Amon ní kã fāi ateṅ, ni nu ebo̱lelē̱ ke̱-kpe, ni ṅšo̱ dši ehe kpoku, ní ṅšo̱ noṅṅ dši ebe gbogbo le̱ lo? *Ier.

english_verse: Thebes trusted the mighty power of Ethiopia and Egypt; the nations of Put and Libya were her allies.
translation_verse: Kuš ke̱ Mizraim ni be̱ nãgbẽ le̱ dši ehewale̱; Putbii ke̱ Lubbii ye̱ ebualo̱i le̱ ateṅ.

english_verse: But she was captured and taken to a foreign country. Her children were murdered at every street corner. The members of her royal family were auctioned off, and her high officials were bound in chains.
translation_verse: Le̱ hũ ete nomṅõ mli ni etšṍ nom; ebii abifabii le̱, ake̱ame̱ tſia ši ye̱ blohũ-fẽ-blohũ kódši ano̱; emei ni hĩe yo̱ nyam le̱, *afõ ame̱no̱ ošiki, ni egbomei agboi le̱ fẽ le̱, awoame̱ gbokle̱i. *Ioel

english_verse: Nineveh, now it's your turn! You will get drunk and try to hide from your enemy.
translation_verse: Bo hũ *ooto̱ dā̃ ni ohĩe aaha; bo bũ ootao abobāhe ye̱ henye̱lo̱ le̱ hewo̱! *Ier.

english_verse: Your fortresses are fig trees with ripe figs. Merely shake the trees, and fruit will fall into every open mouth.
translation_verse: Omõdši ni wa le̱ fẽ aatšṍmo̱ tamo̱ agbãmitšei ke̱ ame̱kleṅkleṅ agbãmii: ké̱ ahosoame̱ pe̱ le̱, ame̱gbēo̱ yelo̱ le̱ dāṅ.

english_verse: Your army is weak. Fire has destroyed the crossbars on your city gates; now they stand wide open to your enemy.
translation_verse: Na, omaṅ ni yo̱ omli le̱ yei so̱ṅṅ ni; aagble ošikpoṅ le̱ no̱ agbói le̱ ahã ohenye̱lo̱i le̱, la aašã ogbói le̱ ase̱ adabãṅi le̱!

english_verse: Your city is under attack. Haul in extra water! Strengthen your defenses! Start making bricks! Stir the mortar!
translation_verse: Yé̱ nu oto obã ohe ye̱ káwō lé̱ hewo̱, wadšemo̱ omõdši ni wa le̱! botemo̱ sũ le̱ mli ní onā sũ le̱, mõ ntayāfemo̱ adeka le̱ mli!

english_verse: You will still go up in flames and be cut down by swords that will wipe you out like a field attacked by grasshoppers. So, go ahead and increase like a swarm of locusts!
translation_verse: Dše̱i noṅṅ la aašão ye̱, klante aaplenẽo; eeyeo tamo̱ otukpe̱i yeo̱ nii, óle-beni oyi afá tamo̱ otukpe̱i, óle-beni oyi afá tamo̱ bālabii. Ioel

english_verse: More merchants are in your city than there are stars in the sky— but they are like locusts that eat everything, then fly away.
translation_verse: Ohã odšrayelo̱i le̱ ayi efá fè ṅwei ṅulamii; otukpe̱i le̱ egbe̱ ame̱fĩdãiaṅ, ni ame̱fliki ke̱-te.

english_verse: Your guards and your officials are swarms of locusts. On a chilly day they settle on a fence, but when the sun comes out, they take off to who-knows-where.
translation_verse: Olumei le̱ tamo̱ bālabii, ni otatše̱mei le̱ tamo̱ bālabii asafoi ni bua afãbaṅi ahe ye̱ fẽigbĩ no̱; ké̱ hũlũ te ši le̱, ame̱-flikio̱ ke̱-yaä, ni alee beni ame̱yo̱.

english_verse: King of Assyria, your officials and leaders are sound asleep, while your people are scattered in the mountains. Yes, your people are sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Otōkwe̱lo̱i le̱ etšṍ mli ewo̱wo̱i, Ašur maṅtše̱, ohĩenāno̱bii le̱ kãmo̱ ši; agbe̱ omaṅ le̱ aſã gõdši le̱ ano̱, ni mokomoko be̱ ni buaä ame̱nā!

english_verse: You're fatally wounded. There's no hope for you. But everyone claps when they hear this news, because your constant cruelty has caused them pain.
translation_verse: Ofla le̱ ehĩĩ tšámo̱, opilamo̱ le̱ wa! Mofẽmo ní aanu ohe le̱, eetſa edẽ ye̱ ohewe̱; edšake̱ namo no̱ po ni onifõdšianii le̱ tšṍko āhū dã?

english_verse: Our Lord, how long must I beg for your help before you listen? How long before you save us from all this violence?
translation_verse: Iehowa, mẽ beyino̱ noṅṅ mablo̱ ke̱-yaši, ni oboṅ toi? ni mabo matšé̱o ye̱ yiwale̱ hewo̱, ni ohereṅ miyiwala?

english_verse: Laws cannot be enforced; justice is always the loser; criminals crowd out honest people and twist the laws around. The Lord Answers Habakkuk
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ mla mli egbo̱dšo̱, ni dšale̱ saneyeli edšee kpo; edšake̱ meifõdši bo̱leo̱ dšalo̱ ke̱-kpeo̱, nohewo̱ le̱ kodšomo̱i kõdõdši dšeo̱ kpo.

english_verse: Look and be amazed at what's happening among the nations! Even if you were told, you would never believe what's taking place now.
translation_verse: Nyekwe̱a dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ, ni nyenaä, ni nyehe adšõa nyehe dšoghāṅ! Edšake̱ mĩtšu nitšumo̱ ko ye̱ nyeyino̱ ne̱, ni ké̱ agbanye le̱, nyeheṅ nyeyeṅ! Bo̱f.

english_verse: I am sending the Babylonians. They are fierce and cruel— marching across the land, conquering cities and towns.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ na, mitẽ Kaldeabii aši, dšeṅmaṅ ko ní yi wa ní he yo̱ oyá hũ, ní ſãa nyiemo̱ ke̱-kpaä šikpoṅ le̱ lē̱mo̱ no̱, beni afe ní ame̱yaṅõ šihĩle̱hei ní dšee ame̱nõ le̱.

english_verse: How fearsome and frightening. Their only laws and rules are the ones they make up.
translation_verse: Ame̱he ye̱ ṅmiṅmi ke̱ gbeyei; ame̱mla ke̱ ame̱gbodšē dše̱ ame̱dientše̱ ame̱mli.

english_verse: Their cavalry troops are faster than leopards, more ferocious than wolves hunting at sunset, and swifter than hungry eagles suddenly swooping down.
translation_verse: Ame̱kpo̱ṅo̱i le̱ ahe ye̱ oyá fè kōtše̱i, ni ame̱ye̱ krãmãkrãmã fè *gbe̱ke̱ klādši, ni ame̱kpo̱ṅo̱iatše̱mei le̱ šaä foi ke̱-baä, ni ame̱kpo̱ṅo̱iatše̱mei le̱ dše̱o̱ šoṅṅ baä; ame̱flikio̱ †amo̱ fokropoṅ ní yeo̱ oyái ayaye nii! *Zef.

english_verse: They are eager to destroy, and they gather captives like handfuls of sand.
translation_verse: Ame̱fẽ-kwa yiwale̱ hewo̱ ame̱baä, ame̱safo mū le̱ ke̱ hĩedō̱ kwe̱o̱ ame̱hĩe tē̃, ni ame̱buaä nomi anā tamo̱ šia.

english_verse: Then suddenly they disappear like a gust of wind— those sinful people who worship their own strength. Habakkuk Complains Again
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱ ame̱aho ſiā tamo̱ kō̱yo̱, ni ame̱aſo mli ke̱-ate; ši mei ni ke̱ ame̱hewale̱ feo̱ ame̱nyoṅmo̱ le̱ aaye fo̱.

english_verse: Holy Lord God, mighty rock, you are eternal, and we are safe from death. You are using those Babylonians to judge and punish others.
translation_verse: Iehowa, aui dšee nāno̱ odše̱, mi-Nyoṅmo̱, mi-Mokroṅkroṅ? *Wo̱gboiṅ; Iehowa, otole̱ ohã kodšomo̱, ni bo, te̱sã, oke̱le̱ emã ši ohā kãmo̱. *Ier.

english_verse: But you can't stand sin or wrong. So don't sit by in silence while they gobble up people who are better than they are.
translation_verse: Ohĩṅme̱ii ye̱ kro̱ṅṅ tšṍ, bo̱ni oke̱akwe̱ nõfõṅ, ni onyẽṅ okwe̱ haomo̱; mẽ-hewo̱ mo̱ ni okwe̱o̱ kũtũmpo̱oyelo̱i, ofeo̱ diō ni efõṅfelo̱ mĩo̱ moni dša fèle̱?

english_verse: The people you put on this earth are like fish or reptiles without a leader.
translation_verse: Ni ofeo̱ gbomei tamo̱ ṅšo̱ṅlōi po, tamo̱ wāmo̱nibii ní be̱ no̱yelo̱ ko le̱.

english_verse: Then an enemy comes along and takes them captive with hooks and nets. It makes him so happy
translation_verse: Eke̱ kpoṅ šaä ame̱fẽ, eke̱ eyā le̱ ghlaäame̱ ni ebuaä ame̱nā ye̱ etšā̃ni le̱ṅ; nohewo̱ le̱ enyã́a, ni emli flio̱le̱;

english_verse: that he offers sacrifices to his fishing nets, because they make him rich and provide choice foods.
translation_verse: nohewo̱ le̱ ešãa afo̱le ehãa eyã le̱, ni ešãa tšofã-ke̱-ṅma hũ ehãa etšā̃ni le̱; edšake̱ nomei hãa egbe̱fãṅnõ le̱ woo̱ fo̱, ni eniyenii he hĩo̱ fo̱.

english_verse: Will he keep hauling in his nets and destroying nations without showing mercy?
translation_verse: Aso nobewo̱ le̱ eedšie eyā le̱ mli nii le̱, ni dā eegbe dšeṅmãdši, ni enaṅ mo̱bo̱?

english_verse: Wine is treacherous, and arrogant people are never satisfied. They are no less greedy than death itself— they open their mouths as wide as the world of the dead and swallow everyone.
translation_verse: Asaṅ wein le̱ šišiulo̱ ni, ni nū hewolo̱ le̱ enyẽẽ ši etá diṅṅ; moni gbe̱o̱ edāṅ tamo̱ gbohĩĩadše, ni etamo̱ gbĕle, eto̱o̱, ši ebuaä dšeṅmãdši fẽ nā ke̱-baä eṅṍ, ni etĩaä mãdšimãdši fẽ nā ye̱ eṅõ!

english_verse: But they will be mocked with these words: You're doomed! You stored up stolen goods and cheated others of what belonged to them.
translation_verse: Aso mene̱mei fẽ ebuṅ abe̱ šiṅle̱, ni ame̱yeṅ ehe fe̱o ni ame̱toṅ ehe ablṍṅ ake̱: Kpóo hã moni hāa nii ni dšee enõ le̱ fáa! — mẽ beyino̱ noṅṅ ni? — ke̱ moni lōo̱ awabatōnii eſieo̱ eno̱!

english_verse: But without warning, those you owe will demand payment. Then you will become a frightened victim.
translation_verse: Aso dšee trukā ni mei ni bayeo w̌ei le̱ aate ši, ni mei ni bahao bo le̱ ahĩe aatšẽ? ni ootšṍ hānii ohãame̱!

english_verse: You're doomed! You built a city on crime and violence.
translation_verse: Kpóo hã *moni ke̱ lášiſiemo̱ too̱ maṅ, ni eke̱ nišaianii mãa mō̃! *Ier.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful sends up in flames what nations and people work so hard to gain.
translation_verse: Na, aso dšee Iehowa Zebaot ṅõ edše̱, ni mãdšimãdši le̱ tšuo̱ nii hãa la, ni dšeṅmãdši le̱ gboo̱ deṅme ye̱ yakayakanoko he ne̱? Ier.

english_verse: Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *šikpoṅ le̱ ne̱ aayi to ke̱ Iehowa anumnyam le̱ lē, tamo̱ nu ha ṅšo̱ šiši le̱. *Ies.

english_verse: Now you will be disgraced instead of praised. The Lord will make you drunk, and when others see you naked, you will lose their respect.
translation_verse: Ye̱ hĩenyam nãdšiaṅ le̱ oyi to̱ ke̱ hĩegbĕle: ho hũ nu, ni odšie oyayaiaṅ ofẽ ši; Iehowa ninedšũrõ kpulu le̱ *aatšṍ ke̱-ba ono̱, ni hĩegbĕle ni wa aaba ohĩenyam le̱ no̱! *Ier.

english_verse: What is an idol worth? It's merely a false god. Why trust a speechless image made from wood or metal by human hands?
translation_verse: Mẽ se̱námo̱ yo̱ amãgã he, hewo̱ ni ṅālo̱ gbo̱ö̱le̱ le̱, lo amãgã ni aſie ní tšõo amale le̱ he, hewo̱ ni ṅālo̱ le̱ ke̱ ehĩe fõo̱ enii ni efe lo̱ no̱, ni efeo̱ wo̱dši mumuii le̱? Ies.

english_verse: What can you learn from idols covered with silver or gold? They can't even breathe. Pity anyone who says to an idol of wood or stone, “Get up and do something!”
translation_verse: Kpóo hã moni kē̱o̱ tšo akē̱: Ohĩe atšẽ! kē̱ te̱ mumui hũ ake̱: Te ši! Aso ene̱ aatšõ mo nii lo? — Na, *ake̱ šika ke̱ dſie̱te̱i eha he, ši mumo̱ ko mumo̱ ko he̱ emli kwrã! *Lal.

english_verse: Let all the world be silent— the Lord is present in his holy temple.
translation_verse: Ši *Iehowa ye̱ eso̱lemo̱we kroṅkroṅ le̱; šikpoṅ mū le̱ fẽ †afe diṅṅ ye̱ ehĩe! *Lal.

english_verse: This is my prayer:
translation_verse: Gbalo̱ Habakuk faikpamo̱ ni eke̱ lala gbē la.

english_verse: You are the same Holy God who came from Teman and Paran to help us. The brightness of your glory covered the heavens, and your praises were heard everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Nānyoṅmo̱ dše̱ Teman mība, ni Mokroṅkroṅ le̱ dše̱ Paran goṅ le̱ no̱. Enumnyam le̱ eha ṅwei, ni eyidšiemo̱ eyi šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ to̱.

english_verse: Your glory shone like the sun, and light flashed from your hands, hiding your mighty power.
translation_verse: Ni ekpe̱mo̱ le̱ tamo̱ la, egblaä hāi ye̱ emase̱i, ni dše̱i dši ehewale̱ le̱ tēmo̱he.

english_verse: Dreadful diseases and plagues marched in front and followed behind.
translation_verse: Tšēṅemo̱-hela nyie ehĩe, ni he-ladō̱ dše̱o̱ enãdšiaši.

english_verse: When you stopped, the earth shook; when you stared, nations trembled; when you walked along your ancient paths, eternal mountains and hills crumbled and collapsed.
translation_verse: Ewá edamo̱ ši, ni šikpoṅ hoso; ekwe̱, ni dšeṅmãdši ahe kpokpo, ni agbe̱ nāno̱ gõdši le̱ afã, nāno̱ goṅkpo̱i le̱ hũ ba ši; enyiemo̱i le̱ tamo̱ blema nõ. Lal.

english_verse: The tents of desert tribes in Cushan and Midian were ripped apart.
translation_verse: Mina Kušan būi le̱ ye̱ haomo̱ mli, ni Midian šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ muhō̱i le̱ kpokpo.

english_verse: Your arrows were ready and obeyed your commands. You split the earth apart with rivers and streams;
translation_verse: Ogãi le̱ he ekã kwrā; owiemo̱ le̱ ekã toigblamo̱ he kitā. Oke̱ fāi egbla šikpoṅ le̱ mli.

english_verse: The sun and moon stood still, while your arrows and spears flashed like lightning.
translation_verse: *Hũlũ ke̱ nyoṅtšẽre damo̱ ši ye̱ ame̱šihĩle̱he le̱, ye̱ ogãimlibii ni nyieo̱ le̱ ala le̱ ke̱ okplo̱i ní kple̱o̱ le̱ akpe̱mo̱ hewo̱. *Ios.

english_verse: In your furious anger, you trampled on nations
translation_verse: Oke̱ mlila fã ke̱-tšṍ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, oke̱ mlifũ šimo̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ dukuduku.

english_verse: to rescue your people and save your chosen one. You crushed a nation's ruler and stripped his evil kingdom of its power.
translation_verse: Odše kpo obahere omaṅ le̱ ke̱ moni ofo̱le̱ mũ le̱ yiwala; odſãra mofõṅ le̱ we le̱ yitšo, odšie šišitō le̱ kpo ke̱-yatá kue̱. Lal.

english_verse: His troops had come like a storm, hoping to scatter us and glad to gobble us up. To them we were refugees in hiding— but you smashed their heads with their own weapons.
translation_verse: Oke̱ ekplo̱i le̱ gbulo̱ elumei le̱ ayitšo le̱, amefã hū tamo̱ lasũogbĕle ni ame̱bagbe̱mi ame̱ſã; ame̱nyã́mo̱ le̱ tamo̱ noni ame̱bamĩ nõnalo̱ ye̱ tẽmo̱ mli.

english_verse: Then your chariots churned the waters of the sea. Habakkuk's Response to God's Message
translation_verse: Oke̱ o-kpo̱ṅo̱i le̱ nānā ṅšo̱ le̱ ní dši nu babaō ní nā wa le̱ no̱.

english_verse: When I heard this message, I felt weak from fear, and my lips quivered. My bones seemed to melt, and I stumbled around. But I will patiently wait. Someday those vicious enemies will be struck by disaster. Trust in a Time of Trouble
translation_verse: Minu, ni mimũsũ kpokpo, minãbui dšo bliblibli ye̱ gbẽ le̱ hewo̱; šramo̱ bote miwui amli, ni mihe kpokpo ye̱ heni midamo̱ le̱, ake̱ matá ši diṅṅ ke̱-yaši haomo̱gbĩ le̱, beni moni ke̱ maṅ le̱ bawu le̱ aafã ke̱-aba le̱.

english_verse: Fig trees may no longer bloom, or vineyards produce grapes; olive trees may be fruitless, and harvest time a failure; sheep pens may be empty, and cattle stalls vacant—
translation_verse: Edšake̱ agbãmitšo le̱ gbaṅ afofro, ni yibii hũ ehĩṅ weintšei le̱ ano̱; mũtšo yibiiwō aafe yaka, ni abō̱i le̱ baṅ niyenii; aahã tōi atã ye̱ tōiatšũ le̱ mli, ni anaṅ tšinai ye̱ ame̱tšũi le̱ amli.

english_verse: The Lord gives me strength. He makes my feet as sure as those of a deer, and he helps me stand on the mountains. To the music director: Use stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa dši mihewale̱, ni eehã *minãdši atamo̱ ofrotei anii, ni eehã manyie mihei groṅṅi le̱! *Lal.

english_verse: people and animals, birds and fish. Everyone who is evil will crash to the ground, and I will wipe out the entire human race.
translation_verse: Makpãtã gbomo ke̱ kolo hĩe; makpãtã ṅwei lofõdši ke̱ ṅšo̱ṅlōi ahĩe, ke̱ *pãmpii ke̱ meifõdši fẽ, ni maplenẽ gbomei ke̱-adše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱! Iehowa kē̱. *Mat.

english_verse: I will reach out to punish Judah and Jerusalem— nothing will remain of the god Baal; nothing will be remembered of his pagan priests.
translation_verse: Ni makpã minine mli ye̱ Iuda ke̱ Ierusalembii le̱ fẽ no̱, ni maplenẽ Baal noni eſe̱ le̱, ke̱ *wulo̱mei ke̱ oso̱foi le̱ fẽ agbe̱i ke̱-adše̱ bie̱, *

english_verse: On that day I will punish national leaders and sons of the king, along with all who follow foreign customs.
translation_verse: Ni aaha mli ake̱ Iehowa gbē-afo̱le le̱ gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ mawo lume̱i le̱ ke̱ maṅtše̱bii le̱ ke̱ mei ſẽ ni woo̱ maṅse̱ atade le̱ anyõmo̱.

english_verse: I will punish worshipers of pagan gods and cruel palace officials who abuse their power.
translation_verse: Ni nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ mawo mei fẽ ní huruo̱ tekeo̱ kpoku ni ame̱ke̱ yiwale̱ ke̱ šišiumo̱ woo̱ ame̱nuṅtšo̱mei awei obõbõ le̱ anyõmo̱.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise that on that day noisy crying will be heard from Fish Gate, New Town, and Upper Hills.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱, Iehowa kē̱, blo̱mo̱ gbē aadšē̱ lõi agbó lē̱ nā, ni lelewo̱mo̱ hũ aadšē̱ maṅ le̱ mlidšā ni dši enyo̱ le̱ mli, ni gbē̱mo̱ wulu kple aadše̱ goṅkpo̱i le̱ ano̱.

english_verse: I'll search Jerusalem with lamps and punish those people who sit there unworried while thinking, “The Lord won't do anything, good or bad.”
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱ nakai be le̱ mli le̱ mike̱ kanei aakpa Ierusalem, ni mawo gbomei ní dſere ame̱šiši atutru le̱ hĩe le̱ anyõmo̱, mei ní kē̱o̱ ye̱ ame̱tšui mli ake̱: “Iehowa efeṅ ekpakpa, ni esā efeṅ efõṅ hũ!” le̱.

english_verse: Their possessions will be taken, their homes left in ruins. They won't get to live in the houses they build, or drink wine from the grapes in their own vineyards. A Terrible Day
translation_verse: Ni ame̱nii le̱ aatšṍmo̱ hānii, ni ame̱-wei le̱ hũ aatšṍmo̱ amaṅfõ; *ame̱amãmo̱ tšũi, ši ame̱hĩṅ mli, ni ame̱afe †weintromi, ši ame̱nuṅ mli wein le̱ eko. *Amos

english_verse: The great day of the Lord is coming soon, very soon. On that terrible day, fearsome shouts of warriors will be heard everywhere.
translation_verse: *Iehowa gbĩ wulu le̱ ebe̱ṅke̱, ebe̱ṅke̱, ni ēye oyái naakpa. Anuo̱ Iehowa gbĩ le̱ gbẽ! No mli le̱ nū kãkãlo̱ aablo̱ wā. *Ioel

english_verse: It will be a time of anger— of trouble and torment, of disaster and destruction, of darkness and despair, of storm clouds and shadows,
translation_verse: Mlifũ gbĩ dši *nakai gbĩ le̱, fĩmo̱ ke̱ amanehũlũ gbĩ ni, amaṅfõ ke̱ amaṅfõ-femo̱ gbĩ ni, duṅ ke̱ dšeṅ tūtūfemo̱ gbĩ ni, atatu ke̱ oblotu kpī gbĩ hũ ni, *Ier.

english_verse: of trumpet calls and battle cries against fortified cities and mighty fortresses.
translation_verse: te̱tre̱mantre̱ ke̱ ošebō̱ gbĩ ni baä mãdši ni atſa gbogboi awo ame̱he le̱ ke̱ mõdši ni kwŏ̱lo̱ le̱ ano̱ ni.

english_verse: The Lord warns everyone who has sinned against him, “I'll strike you blind! Then your blood and your insides will gush out like vomit.
translation_verse: Ni mahao gbomei le̱, ni ame̱anyie tamo̱ ſilafoi, edšake̱ ame̱fe eša ame̱ši Iehowa; ni aafo̱se ame̱lá aſĩe ši tamo̱ mlu, ke̱ ame̱helo hũ tamo̱ se̱bo.

english_verse: Not even your silver or gold can save you on that day when I, the Lord, am angry. My anger will flare up like a furious fire scorching the earth and everyone on it.”
translation_verse: Asaṅ *ame̱dſie̱te̱i ke̱ ame̱šika fẽ nyẽṅame̱ adšie ye̱ Iehowa mlifũ gbĩ le̱ ne̱, ši ewuṅãyeli la le̱ aašã šikpoṅ mū le̱ fẽ; edšake̱ eke̱ plenēmo̱ ni baä trukā aaplenē šikpoṅ le̱ no bii le̱ fẽ. *Ezek.

english_verse: before it's too late. The Lord has set a time when his fierce anger will strike like a storm and sweep you away.
translation_verse: dãni akpo̱ le̱ afo̱, ni gbĩ le̱ aho tamo̱ tutū; dãni Iehowa mlifũ ni nā wa le̱ aba nyeno̱, dãni Iehowa mlifũ gbĩ le̱ aba nyeno̱!

english_verse: Gaza and Ashkelon will be deserted and left in ruins. Ashdod will be emptied in broad daylight, and Ekron uprooted.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Gaza le̱, aašĩle̱ afõ ši, ni Aškelon aatšṍ amaṅfõ; Ašdod le̱, aaſiele̱ ſane fintĩṅṅ, ni Ekron hũ, aafãle̱ ke̱ ešiši.

english_verse: To you people of Philistia who live along the coast, the Lord has this to say: “I am now your enemy, and I'll wipe you out!”
translation_verse: Kpóo hã ṅšo̱nābii le̱, *Keretibii adšeṅmaṅ le̱! Iehowa wiemo̱ le̱ kã nyeno̱, Kanaan, †Filistibii ašikpoṅ le̱! makpãtã ohĩe, ni mokomoko ehĩṅ omli doṅṅ! *

english_verse: Your seacoast will be changed into pastureland and sheep pens.
translation_verse: Ni ṅšo̱ le̱ nā niiaṅ aatšṍ koloi alḕ̱he ke̱ tōkwe̱lo̱i asesei ke̱ tōi atšũi.

english_verse: The Lord God hasn't forgotten those survivors in Judah, and he will help them— his people will take your land to use for pasture. And when evening comes, they will rest in houses at Ashkelon. Judgment on Moab and Ammon *
translation_verse: Ni ṅšo̱ le̱ nā niiaṅ aatšṍ Iuda we le̱ mei ni eſe̱ le̱ anõ: dše̱i noṅṅ ame̱alē̱ ame̱koloi le̱ ye̱; gbe̱ke̱ le̱ ame̱abumo̱ ši ye̱ Aškelon šĩai le̱; edšake̱ Iehowa, ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, aabasraame̱, ni eekpale *ame̱nomṅō̃ le̱ ke̱-aba ekoṅ! *

english_verse: This is how Moab and Ammon will at last be repaid for their pride— and for sneering at the nation that belongs to me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ene̱ ame̱aná ye̱ ame̱hewō le̱ hewo̱, edšake̱ ame̱bo̱ Iehowa Zebaot maṅ le̱ ohora, ni ame̱wó ame̱he no̱ ye̱ ame̱no̱.

english_verse: People of Ethiopia, the sword of the Lord will slaughter you! Judgment on Assyria
translation_verse: Nye *Kušbii hũ, nyeanyõnyõi ye̱ miklante nā! *Ezek.

english_verse: Herds of wild animals will live in its rubble; all kinds of desert owls will perch on its stones and hoot in the windows. Noisy ravens will be heard inside its buildings, stripped bare of cedar.
translation_verse: ni koloikui *aabumo̱ eteṅ, koloi sro̱toi fẽ; †kpokukpoku ke̱ koto̱ko̱ fẽ aabawo̱ ekulašĩṅi ayiteaṅkpo̱i le̱ ano̱; aanu lofõdši alala ye̱ samfe̱dši le̱ amli; gbogbo kukudši aadſere kpokui le̱ ano̱; edšake̱ adšie tšenedrui le̱. *Ies.

english_verse: This is the glorious city that felt secure and said, “I am the only one!” Now it's merely ruins, a home for wild animals. Every passerby simply sneers and makes vulgar signs.
translation_verse: Maṅ ní mli fliole̱, ní hĩo̱ ši ſeſēſe, ni kē̱o̱ ye̱ etšui mli ake̱: *Mi ni, ni mokomoko be̱ mise̱! le̱ ne̱: té tēṅ ni etšṍ amaṅfõ, koloi ašibumo̱he ne̱! mo-fēmo ni aabatšṍ he ke̱-ho le̱, eebo tšia, ni eefõ enine. *Ies.

english_verse: Too bad for that disgusting, corrupt, and lawless city!
translation_verse: Kpṍo hã maṅ ni tšeo̱ atũa ni abule-le̱, maṅ ní yi wa le̱!

english_verse: Its officials are roaring lions, its judges are wolves; in the evening they attack, by morning nothing is left.
translation_verse: Elumei ni yo̱ emli le̱, dšatai ni hũo̱ ni; ekodšolo̱i le̱ hũ, gbe̱ke̱ klãdši ni; ame̱ſe̱e̱ nokonoko ni dše atše̱re no̱. Ezek.

english_verse: From across the rivers of Ethiopia, my scattered people, my true worshipers, will bring offerings to me.
translation_verse: *Kuš fāi le̱ ase̱ tō̃ midšálo̱i le̱ ni dši mimei ni egbe̱ eſã le̱ asafo le̱ ke̱ ni-kēnii aadše̱ abahãmi. *Lal.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't rebel against me and be put to shame. I'll do away with those who are proud and arrogant. Never will any of them strut around on my holy mountain.
translation_verse: Nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ ohĩe gboṅ ye̱ onifemo̱nii fẽ ní oke̱-tõ mino̱ le̱ hewo̱ doṅṅ; edšake̱ no mli le̱ madšie mei ni mli flio̱ame̱ ke̱ hewō le̱ ke̱-adše̱ oteṅ, ni owóṅ ohe no̱ ye̱ migoṅ kroṅkroṅ le̱ ṅo̱ doṅṅ.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, won't destroy any of your people who are truly humble and turn to me for safety.
translation_verse: Ni *maſe̱ maṅ ni dši nõnalo̱i ke̱ ohĩafoi ye̱ oteṅ, ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱hĩe aafō Iehowa gbe̱i le̱ no̱. *Ezek.

english_verse: The people of Israel who survive will live right and refuse to tell lies. They will eat and rest with nothing to fear. A Song of Celebration
translation_verse: Israel ſē̱nõ le̱ efeṅ nišaianii, ni ame̱maleṅ doṅṅ, ni asaṅ anaṅ šišinmo̱ lile̱i ye̱ ame̱dāṅ; edšake̱ ame̱aye nii ni ame̱abumo̱ ši, ni mokomoko woṅ ame̱he gbeyei.

english_verse: Zion, your punishment is over. The Lord has forced your enemies to turn and retreat. Your Lord is King of Israel and stands at your side; you don't have to worry about any more troubles.
translation_verse: Iehowa edšie okodšomo̱i le̱ ke̱-te, eſie ohenye̱lo̱ le̱ ke̱-dše̱ ohe; Israel maṅ-tše̱ Iehowa le̱ ye̱ oteṅ: ošeṅ nõfõṅ ko gbeyei doṅṅ!

english_verse: Jerusalem, the time is coming, when it will be said to you: “Don't be discouraged or grow weak from fear!
translation_verse: Nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ aakē̱ Ierusalem akē̱: Kāše gbeyei! Zion, kāhã onidšiaṅ mīgbo̱dšo̱!

english_verse: The Lord your God wins victory after victory and is always with you. He celebrates and sings because of you, and he will refresh your life with his love.” The Lord's Promise to His People
translation_verse: Iehowa, o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ye̱ oteṅ, nū ekãlo̱ ní aanyẽ oyiwala ahere ni; *eenyã́ ohe ke̱ mīše̱, eefe diō ye̱ esuomo̱ le̱ mli, emli aaflile̱ ye̱ ohe ke̱ nyã́mo̱ lala. *Ies.

english_verse: I will punish those who mistreat you. I will bring together the lame and the outcasts, then they will be praised, instead of despised, in every country on earth.
translation_verse: Na, mike̱ ohaolo̱i le̱ fẽ aaye ye̱ nakai be le̱ mli, ni mahere *mei ni tšo̱ö̱ le̱ ayiwala, ni mabua mei ní aſieame̱ le̱ anā, ni maṅõame̱ mafe yidšiemo̱ ke̱ gbe̱i ye̱ šikpõdši fẽ ni agbeame̱ be guo̱ ye̱ no̱ le̱ ano̱. *Mika

english_verse: I will lead you home, and with your own eyes you will see me bless you with all you once owned. Then you will be famous everywhere on this earth. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Nakai be le̱ mli le̱ maṅõnye ke̱-aba ekoṅ, ni nakai be le̱ mli le̱ mabua nyenã; edšake̱ maṅõnye mafe gbe̱i ke̱ yidšiemo̱ ye̱ sikpoṅ le̱ no̱ mãdšimãdši fẽ mli, beni *makpale nyenomṅō̃ le̱ ke̱-aba ekoṅ ye̱ nyehĩṅmeiiaṅ le, Iehowa kē̱. *Ier.

english_verse: You harvest less than you plant, you never have enough to eat or drink, your clothes don't keep you warm, and your wages are stored in bags full of holes.
translation_verse: *Nyedũo̱ nii pī, ši fiō pe̱ baä; nyeyeo̱ nii, ši nyetō̱ro̱o̱; nyenuo̱ dā̃i, ši nyetōro̱o̱ dā̃; nyebumoo̱ mamai, ši mokomoko he efee kulō̱; ni moni yeo̱ apā ni awoo̱le̱ nyõmo̱ le̱, eke̱-woo̱ kotoku ni agbulo̱ he mli. *

english_verse: But first, go to the hills and get wood for my temple, so I can take pride in it and be worshiped there.
translation_verse: Nyekwo̱a kē̱-yaä goṅ le̱ no̱, ni nyeyaṅõa tšei ke̱-baä, ni nyeke̱-bamãa šĩa le̱; ni maná he tšui, ni aawo mihĩe nyam! Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: That's also why the dew doesn't fall and your harvest fails.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ ṅwei ní yo̱ nyeyiteṅ le̱ etšĩ *bó nā, ni šikpoṅ le̱ hũ etšī eni-bānii le̱ anā; *

english_verse: And so, at my command everything will become barren—your farmland and pastures, your vineyards and olive trees, your animals and you yourselves. All your hard work will be for nothing.
translation_verse: ni mitšē̱ *nuhõmo̱ kē̱-ba šikpoṅ lē̱ no̱ kē̱ gõdši le̱ ano̱, ke̱ able ke̱ wein ke̱ mũ ke̱ nofẽno ni šikpoṅ le̱ baä le̱ no̱, ke̱ gbomei ano̱, ke̱ šĩa koloi ano̱, ke̱ ninenā nitšumo̱i fẽ no̱. *

english_verse: Zerubbabel and Joshua, together with the others who had returned from exile in Babylonia, obeyed the Lord's message spoken by his prophet Haggai, and they started showing proper respect for the Lord.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Zerubabel, Šealtiel bi le̱, ke̱ Iošua, Iehozadak bi ni dši oso̱fonukpa le̱, ke̱ maṅ le̱ mli mei ni eſe̱ le̱ fẽ bo Iehowa, ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, gbē ke̱ gbalo̱ Hagai wiemoi le̱ atoi, bo̱ni Iehowa, ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, tšũle̱ le̱; ni maṅ le̱ še gbeyei ye̱ Iehowa hĩe.

english_verse: Haggai then told them that the Lord had promised to be with them.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Hagai, Iehowa *bo̱fo le̱, kē̱ maṅ le̱ ye̱ tšũmo̱ ni Iehowa tšũle̱ le̱ nā ake̱: Mike̱nye ye̱! Iehowa kē̱. *Mal.

english_verse: All silver and gold belong to me,
translation_verse: Minõ dši dſie̱te̱i le̱, ni minõ dši šika le̱, Iehowa Zebaot kō̱.

english_verse: and I promise that this new temple will be more glorious than the first one. I will also bless this city with peace. The Past and the Future
translation_verse: Šĩa ne̱ se̱kpē anumnyam le̱ aada fè tšutšunõ le̱, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱; ni biē̱ nē̱ mahã hedšo̱le̱ ye̱, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱.

english_verse: Suppose meat ready to be sacrificed to God is being carried in the folds of someone's clothing, and the clothing rubs against some bread or stew or wine or olive oil or any other food. Would those foods that were touched then become acceptable for sacrifice? “Of course not,” the priests answered.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši moko hĩe lō kroṅkroṅ ye̱ etade nāmū le̱ṅ, ni eke̱ nāmū le̱ yasa abolo lo nii ni abõ lo wein lo mũ lo niyenii-fẽ-niyenii he le̱: ani etšṍ kroṅkroṅ lo? — Ni oso̱foi le̱ to he ni ame̱kē̱ ake̱: Dabi!

english_verse: Then Haggai said, “Suppose someone has touched a dead body and is considered unacceptable to worship God. If that person touches these foods, would they become unclean?” “Of course they would,” the priests answered.
translation_verse: Kē̱kē̱ ni Hagai kē̱: Ké̱ moni ke̱ *gbonyo ebule ehe ta ene̱mei eko he le̱, ani abule no lo? Ni oso̱foi le̱ here no̱ ni ame̱kē̱: Abule no! *

english_verse: So the Lord told Haggai to say: That's how it is with this entire nation. Everything you do and every sacrifice you offer is unacceptable to me.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Hagai here no̱ ni ekē̱: Nakai pe̱ dši maṅ ne̱, ni nakai pe̱ dši dšeṅmaṅ ne̱ ye̱ mihĩe, Iehowa ke̱, ni nakai pe̱ dši ame̱ninenā nitšumo̱-fẽ-nitšumo̱, ni noni ame̱ke̱-bahãa ye̱ dše̱i le̱ hũ, abule no.

english_verse: But from now on, things will get better. Before you started laying the foundation for the temple,
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱ nyedſẽṅa he ke̱-dšea ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ no̱ ke̱-yaä se̱, beyino̱ ni anáko aṅõ te̱ afõ te̱ no̱ ye̱ Iehowa so̱lemo̱we le̱:

english_verse: I made all of your hard work useless by sending mildew, mold, and hail—but you still did not return to me, your Lord.
translation_verse: *Mike̱ ṅmā̃ šā̃ ke̱ ṅălãmo̱ ke̱ nyoṅmo̱ṅte̱ tſianye ye̱ nyeninenā nitšumo̱i fẽ mli; kẽle̱ nyekpalee ke̱-baa miṅõ! Iehowa ke̱. *

english_verse: Although you have not yet harvested any grain, grapes, figs, pomegranates, or olives, I will richly bless you in the days ahead. God's Promise to Zerubbabel
translation_verse: Ani dũmo̱nii ko ye̱ aboṅo le̱ṅ lolo? ni asaṅ weintšo le̱ ke̱ agbãmitšo le̱ ke̱ akututšo le̱ ke̱ mūtšo le̱ woko; ke̱-dše̱ ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ no̱ le̱ madšō̱nye!

english_verse: Tell Governor Zerubbabel of Judah that I am going to shake the heavens and the earth
translation_verse: Kē̱mo̱ Zerubabel, Iuda amralo le̱, ake̱: *Mibahoso ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱, *K.

english_verse: and wipe out kings and their kingdoms. I will overturn war chariots, and then cavalry troops will start slaughtering each other.
translation_verse: ni mabutu maṅtše̱yelii asẽi le̱, ni makpãtã dšeṅmãdši le̱ amaṅtše̱yelii le̱ ahewale̱ hĩe, ni mabutu ſīlii ke̱ ame̱mlitrálo̱i, ni okpo̱ṅo̱i ke̱ ame̱no̱trálo̱i le̱ aanyõnyõi, mofēmo ye̱ enyemi klante nā.

english_verse: But tell my servant Zerubbabel that I, the Lord All-Powerful, have chosen him, and he will rule in my name.
translation_verse: Nakai gbĩ ie̱ no̱ le̱, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱, maṅõ bo, Zerubabel, Šealtiel bi, ni dši mitšũlo̱ le̱, Iehowa kē̱, ni maṅõo mafe tamo̱ wolonāso̱omo̱nõ; edšake̱ bo le̱ mihalao, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱. Zak.

english_verse: Don't be stubborn like your ancestors. They were warned by the earlier prophets to give up their evil and turn back to me, but they paid no attention.
translation_verse: Nyekafea tamo̱ nyetše̱mei le̱, mei ní kleṅkleṅ gbalo̱i le̱ šie̱ tšõame̱ ake̱: Boni Iehowa Zebaot le̱ ne̱: *Nyekpalea ke̱-dše̱a nyegbè̱i fõdši le̱ ano̱ ke̱ nyenifemo̱nii fõdši le̱ ahe! ni ame̱nuu ni ame̱sā ame̱boomi toi le̱, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: At once, the man standing among the myrtle trees said, “These are the ones the Lord has sent to find out what's happening on earth.”
translation_verse: Ni nū le̱ ní damo̱ mirtotšei le̱ ateṅ le̱ here no̱ ni ekē̱: Mene̱mai dši mei ní Iehowa tšũ, ní ame̱yakpa šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱.

english_verse: For a while I was angry at the nations, but now I am furious, because they have made things worse for Jerusalem and are not the least bit concerned.
translation_verse: ši mimli efũ dsenmādsi ní he edšo̱ame̱ le̱ naakpa; edšake̱ beni mimli fũ fiō ke̱ke̱ le̱, ame̱ le̱ ame̱ye ame̱bua nõfõṅ le̱. Ies.

english_verse: And so, I will have pity on Jerusalem. The city will be completely rebuilt, and my temple will stand again.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ ṅo̱ni Iehowa kē̱ ne̱: *Mike̱ mũsũṅtšõle̱i ekũ se̱ eba Ierusalem, aamã mišĩa le̱ ye̱ mli, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱, ni aaṅmẽ kpã ye̱ Ierusalem no̱. *

english_verse: I also promise that my towns will prosper—Jerusalem will once again be my chosen city, and I will comfort the people of Zion. Second Vision: Animal Horns
translation_verse: Asaṅ šie̱mo̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni Iehowa Zebaot kē̱ ne̱: Nikpakpai aayi mimãdši le̱ amli ke̱-teke no̱, ni Iehowa *aaše̱dše Zion mĩ ekoṅ, ní †eehala Ierusalem ekoṅ. *Ies.

english_verse: The angel who had spoken to me came toward me, when another angel came up to him
translation_verse: .] Ni na, bo̱fo le̱ ni ke̱mi wieo̱ le̱ dše kpo, ni bo̱fo kroko dše kpo le eke̱le̱ yakpe,

english_verse: and said, “Hurry! Tell that man with the measuring line that Jerusalem won't have any boundaries. It will be too full of people and animals even to have a wall.
translation_verse: .] ni eke̱le̱ ake̱: Ša foi ní oya-kē̱ ne̱ke̱ oblanyo ne̱ ake̱: Ierusalem he *bakã eflo ye̱ gbomei ke̱ koloi ní yo̱ mli le̱ ayifále̱ hewo̱; *Ezek.

english_verse: The Lord says to his people, “Run! Escape from the land in the north, where I scattered you to the four winds.
translation_verse: .] Hēi! hēi! nyedšoa foi ke̱-dše̱a kōyigbe̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱! Iehowa kē̱; edšake̱ migbe̱nye miſã tamo̱ ṅwei kō̱yo̱i edſe̱ le̱, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: Leave Babylonia and hurry back to Zion.”
translation_verse: .] Hēi, Zion, heremo̱ oyiwala, bo moni oke Babel biyō le̱ yo̱ le̱!

english_verse: Then the glorious Lord All-Powerful ordered me to say to the nations that had raided and robbed Zion: Zion is as precious to the Lord as are his eyes. Whatever you do to Zion, you do to him.
