translation_verse: .] Edšake̱ boni Iehowa Zebaot kē̱ ne̱: Anumnyam le̱ se̱ le̱ etšũmi dšeṅ-mãdši ní hahãnye le̱ aṅõ: edšake̱ moni taä nyehe le̱ ēta *ehīṅme̱iṅ adšaṅmalāte̱ he. *

english_verse: And so, he will put you in the power of your slaves, and they will raid and rob you. Then you will know that I am a prophet of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: .] Ni na, mahoso minine mawoame̱, ní ame̱atšṍmo̱ hãnii ame̱hã amatšũdši le̱; ni nyeaná nyele ake̱ Iehowa Zebaot tšũmi.

english_verse: Then Judah will be his part of the holy land, and Jerusalem will again be his chosen city.
translation_verse: .] Ni Iehowa aaṅõ Iuda ake̱ egbe̱fãṅnõ ye̱ šikpoṅ kroṅkroṅ le̱ no̱, ni *eehala Ierusalem ekoṅ. *

english_verse: Everyone, be silent! The Lord is present and moving about in his holy place.
translation_verse: .] Helo fẽ afe diṅṅ ye̱ Iehowa hĩe! edšake̱ ete ši ke̱-dše̱ ešihĩle̱he kroṅkroṅ le̱. Hab.

english_verse: If you truly obey me, I will put you in charge of my temple, including the courtyard around it, and you will be allowed to speak at any time with the angels standing beside me.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa Zebaot kē̱ ne̱: Kedši oonyie migbè̱i ano̱ ni ooye migbe̱nānii le̱ ano̱ le̱, no le̱ bo hũ ookodšo miwe le̱, ni asaṅ oobu mikpoi le̱ ahe; ni mahão hegbe̱ ní onyie mei ní damo̱ bie̱ ne̱ ateṅ. *Lal.

english_verse: Joshua, I have placed in front of you a stone with seven sides. I will engrave something on that stone, and in a single day I will forgive this guilty country.
translation_verse: Ši na, te̱ le̱ ní miṅõ-fõ Iošua hĩe le̱, *hĩṅme̱ii kpawo mīkwe̱ te̱ kome le̱; na, makpe̱ eno̱kpe̱mo̱nii le̱, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱, ni magbe nakai šikpoṅ le̱ nišaianii le̱ gbĩ kōme. *

english_verse: Then each of you will live at peace and entertain your friends in your own vineyard and under your own fig trees.
translation_verse: Nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱, nyeteṅ *mofẽmo aatšé̱ enanyo ke̱-aba weintšo šiši ke̱ agbãmitšo šiši. *

english_verse: Zerubbabel, that mountain in front of you will be leveled to the ground. Then you will bring out the temple's most important stone and shout, “God has been very kind.”
translation_verse: Namo dšio ye̱ Zerubabel hĩe, bo goṅ kpeteṅkple? ootšṍ ṅã kplanā! ni eke̱ yi-teṅ te̱ le̱ aadše kpo ke̱-aba ke̱ *oše̱bō̱i ake̱: Dromo̱, dromo̱ ahãle̱! *Lal.

english_verse: Zerubbabel laid the foundation for the temple, and he will complete it. Then everyone will know that you were sent by me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: *Zerubabel nidši to šĩa ne̱ šiši, ni enidši noṅṅ bagbe nā; ni †ooná ole ake̱ Iehowa Zebaot tšũmi nyeṅõ le̱. *Ezra

english_verse: Those who have made fun of this day of small beginnings will celebrate when they see Zerubbabel holding this important stone. Those seven lamps represent my eyes—the eyes of the Lord—and they see everything on this earth.
translation_verse: Ši namo gbeo̱ *nibii bibii agbĩ le̱ he guo̱? Edšake̱ †kpawo ne̱, ní dši Iehowa hĩṅme̱ii ní kpaä šikpoṅ mū le fẽ no̱ le̱, aana kũlomŭlo le̱ ye̱ Zerubabel deṅ, ni ame̱anyã́. *Hag.

english_verse: And what is the meaning of the two branches from which golden olive oil flows through the two gold pipes?”
translation_verse: Ni misā mihere no̱ ni mikē̱le̱ ake̱: Meni dši ne̱ke̱ mũtšei aniṅšl enyo̱ ne̱ ní yo̱ šika be̱dši enyo̱ le̱ ní fo̱seo̱ šika mũ le̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ ame̱mli le̱ amase̱i ne̱?

english_verse: “Don't you know?” he asked. “No sir, I don't,” was my answer.
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Aso olee noṅi dši ene̱mei lo? Ni mikē̱: Dabi, minuṅtšo̱!

english_verse: Then he told me, “These branches are the two chosen leaders who stand beside the Lord of all the earth.”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ekē̱: Ene̱mei dši mũbihĩĩ enyo̱ ní damo̱ šikpoṅ mū le̱ fẽ nuṅtšo̱ le̱ mase̱i le̱. Kpods.

english_verse: Then he told me: This scroll puts a curse on everyone in the land who steals or tells lies. The writing on one side tells about the destruction of those who steal, while the writing on the other side tells about the destruction of those who lie.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Ene̱ dši lō-mo̱ ní dšeo̱ kpo yaä šikpoṅ mū le̱ fẽ no̱ le̱; edšake̱ dšulo̱-fẽ-dšulo̱ le̱, aabē̱le̱ ke̱-adše̱ bie̱ ke̱-ate tamo̱ no noṅṅ, ni kitãkãlo̱-fẽ-kitãkãlo̱ hũ, aabē̱le̱ ke̱-adše̱ bie̱ ke̱-ate tamo̱ no noṅṅ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has said, “I am sending this scroll into the house of everyone who is a robber or tells lies in my name, and it will remain there until every piece of wood and stone in that house crumbles.” Seventh Vision: A Woman in a Basket
translation_verse: Mihã edše kpo, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱, koni eyabote dšulo̱ le̱ we ke̱ moni ke̱ migbe̱i kãa amale kitã le̱ we, ni eehĩ ši ye̱ ewe le̱, ni eekpãtã ehĩe ke̱ emli tšei ke̱ emli te̱i fẽ.

english_verse: Now the angel who was there to explain the visions came over and said, “Look up and tell me what you see coming.”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni bo̱fa le̱ ní ke̱mi wieo̱ le̱ dše kpo, ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Holemo̱ ohĩṅme̱ii ano̱ ní okwe̱! Meni dšeo̱ kpo ne̱?

english_verse: The lead cover of the basket was opened, and in the basket was a woman.
translation_verse: Ni na, awó sumui kutruku ko no̱; ni agbe̱ne̱ yō kome tá efa le̱ teṅ.

english_verse: “This woman represents evil,” the angel explained. Then he threw her back into the basket and slammed the heavy cover down tight.
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱: nõfõṅ ne̱. Ni eše̱le̱ efõ efa le̱ teṅ, ni eše̱ sumuite̱ le̱ efõ enābu.

english_verse: Right after this I saw two women coming through the sky with wings outstretched like a stork in the wind. Suddenly they lifted the basket into the air,
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mihole mihĩṅme̱ii ano̱ ni mikwe̱, ni na, yei enyo̱ dše kpo ba, ni kō̱yo̱ ye̱ ame̱fīdšĩaṅ, ni ame̱ye̱ fĩdši tamo̱ klitšo fĩdši; ni ame̱bawó efa le̱ no̱ ke̱-te šikpoṅ ke̱ ṅwe̱i teṅ.

english_verse: and I asked the angel, “Where are they taking the basket?”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mikē̱ bo̱fo le̱ ní ke̱mi wieo̱ le̱ ake̱: Nẽgbe̱ mene̱mei hĩe efa le̱ ke̱-yaä ne̱?

english_verse: The first chariot was pulled by red horses, and the second by black horses;
translation_verse: Kleṅkleṅ ſīli le̱ okpo̱ṅo̱i tšudši yo̱ he, ni ſīli ní dši enyo̱ le̱ akpo̱ṅo̱i didši yo̱ he,

english_verse: Then he explained, “These are the four winds of heaven, and now they are going out, after presenting themselves to the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Ni bo̱fo le̱ here no̱ ni eke̱mi ake̱: Ene̱me̱i dšĩ ṅwei kō̱yo̱i edſe̱ le̱ ni ke̱ ame̱he yatšõo̱ *šikpoṅ mū le̱ fẽ nuṅtšo̱ le̱ ni ame̱dšeo̱ kpo le̱. *

english_verse: The chariot with black horses goes toward the north, the chariot with white horses goes toward the west, and the one with spotted horses goes toward the south.”
translation_verse: Noni okpo̱ṅo̱i didši yo̱ he le̱ dšeo̱ kpo ke̱-yaä kōyigbe̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni eye̱dši le̱ dšeo̱ kpo nyieo̱ ame̱se̱, ni truntrãi le̱ dšeo̱ kpo ke̱-yaã wuoyigbe̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: The horses came out eager to patrol the earth, and the angel told them, “Start patrolling the earth.” When they had gone on their way,
translation_verse: Ši etšudši le̱ dše kpo ni ame̱mītao ame̱yakpa ši ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱. Ni ekē̱: Nyeyaä ni *nyeyakpaä ši ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱! Ni ame̱yakpa ši ye šikpoṅ le̱ no̱. *

english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa wiemo̱ să ba miṅõ ake̱:

english_verse: Tell him that I, the Lord All-Powerful, say, “Someone will reach out from here like a branch and build a temple for me. I will name him ‘Branch,’ and he will rule with royal honors. A priest will stand beside his throne, and the two of them will be good friends.
translation_verse: Le̱ ebamã Iehowa so̱lemo̱we le̱, ni eená anumnyam, ni eetá esẽi le̱ no ni eeye lumo̱, ni eeye *oso̱fo hũ ye̱ esẽi le̱ no̱, ni hedšo̱le̱ adšinatō aihĩ ame̱yi enyo̱ le̱ ame̱teṅ. *Lal.

english_verse: This crown will be kept in my temple as a reminder and will be taken care of by Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Josiah.”
translation_verse: Ni akekre le̱ aatšṍ kaimo̱nõ ni ake̱-kaio̱ Helem ke̱ Tobia ke̱ Iedaia ke̱ Zefania bi le̱ mlihĩle̱ ye̱ Iehowa so̱lemo̱we le̱.

english_verse: When people from distant lands come and help build the temple of the Lord All-Powerful, you will know that the Lord is the one who sent me. And this will happen, if you truly obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ni mei ní yo̱ šoṅṅ le̱ aaba ní ame̱-abamã Iehowa so̱lemo̱we le̱ eko, ni nyeaná nyele ake̱ Iehowa Zebaot tšũmi nyeṅõ le̱, ni ene̱ aaba mli, ke̱dši nyeabo Iehowa, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, gbē toi le̱le̱ṅ le̱.

english_verse: On the fourth day of Chislev, the ninth month of the fourth year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord again spoke to me.
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱ maṅtše̱ Dario yino̱ afi ní dši edſe̱ le̱ no̱ le̱ Iehowa wiemo̱ ba Zakaria ṅõ ye̱ nyõṅ ní dši ne̱hũ ní dši Kislev le̱ no̱ gbĩ ní dši gbĩ edſe̱ le̱ no̱;

english_verse: It happened after the people of Bethel had sent Sharezer with Regem-Melech and his men to ask the priests in the Lord's temple and the prophets to pray for them. So they prayed, “Should we mourn and go without eating during the fifth month, as we have done for many years?”
translation_verse: ni ame̱babi oso̱foi le̱ ní yo̱ Iehowa Zebaot we le̱, ke̱ gbalo̱i le̱ ake̱: Ani mifó ye̱ nyõṅ ní dši *enumo̱ le̱ hũ no̱, ni mitšĩ mihe nā, take̱ bo̱ni mife afii abo̱ lo? le̱. *

english_verse: My message today is the same one I commanded the earlier prophets to speak to Jerusalem and its villages when they were prosperous, and when all of Judah, including the Southern Desert and the hill country, was filled with people.
translation_verse: Ani esaa moṅ ake̱ nyeyeo̱ Iehowa wiemo̱i le̱ ano̱ noni etšṍ ekle̱ṅkle̱ṅ gbalo̱i le̱ ano̱ ešie̱, heni mei yo̱ Ierusalem ni eke̱ emãdši ni bo̱le ehe ke̱-kpe le̱ ſereo̱, ni mei yo̱ wuoyigbe̱ ke̱ ṅãno̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ lo?

english_verse: So once again, I, the Lord All-Powerful, tell you, “See that justice is done and be kind and merciful to one another!
translation_verse: Noni Iehowa Zebaot kē̱ ne̱: *Nyekodšoa ano̱kwa kodšomo̱, ni mofẽmo adšie mobo̱nale ke̱ mũsũṅtšõla kpo atšõ enyemi! *Mika

english_verse: Don't mistreat widows or orphans or foreigners or anyone who is poor, and stop making plans to hurt each other.”
translation_verse: Ni *nyekawaä okũlafo lo awusã, gbo̱ ko ohĩafo yi, ni mokomoko akasusu enyemi he efõṅ ye̱ etšuiṅ! *

english_verse: But everyone who heard those prophets, stubbornly refused to obey. Instead, they turned their backs on everything my Spirit had commanded the earlier prophets to preach. So I, the Lord, became angry
translation_verse: ni ame̱fe ame̱tšui *tamo̱ diamentete̱, koni ame̱kanu mla le̱ ke̱ wiemo̱i ke̱ ni Iehowa Zebaot tšṍ Emumo̱ le̱ no̱ eke̱tšũ kleṅkleṅ gbalo̱i le̱; nohewo̱ ni mlifũ kpeteṅkple dše̱ Iehowa Zebaot ṅõ be ke̱. *Ies.

english_verse: and said, “You people paid no attention when I called out to you, and now I'll pay no attention when you call out to me.”
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱, bo̱ni eblo̱ ni ame̱-boo toi le̱, nakai ame̱blo̱, ni mi hũ miboo toi, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱.

english_verse: That's why I came with a whirlwind and scattered them among foreign nations, leaving their lovely country empty of people and in ruins.
translation_verse: Ši mike̱ lasũogbĕle gbe̱ame̱ ſã dšeṅmãdši fẽ ní ame̱lee le̱ mli, ni šikpoṅ le̱ tšṍ amaṅfõ ye̱ ame̱se̱, ni mokomoko tšṍṍ no̱ ke̱-hoo lo ní eekũ ese̱; ni ame̱hā šikpoṅ fe̱fe̱o le̱ tšṍ amaṅfõ.

english_verse: and I will bring them to live in Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, faithful to bring about justice.
translation_verse: ni mĩke̱ame̱ aaba, ní ame̱bahĩ Ierusalem teṅ, ni *ame̱atšṍ mimaṅ, ni mi hũ matšṍ ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ ye̱ ano̱kwale mli ke̱ dšale̱ mli! *Ier.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful! So don't give up. Think about the message my prophets spoke when the foundation of my temple was laid.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa Zebaot kē̱ ne̱: *Nyewadšea nynidšiaṅ, nye mei ni ne̱ke̱ gbĩī ne̱ amli ní nyenuo̱ ne̱ke̱ wiemo̱i ne̱ ye̱ gbalo̱i, ní yo̱ gbĩ ní ato Iehowa Zebaot we ke̱ ní dši so̱lemo̱we ke̱ šiši, koni amã le̱, anā ke̱! *Ies.

english_verse: My people, only a few of you are left, and I promise not to punish you as I did before.
translation_verse: Ši agbe̱ne̱ mitamo̱ṅ boni miyo̱ ye̱ kleṅkleṅ gbĩĩ ke̱ amli ke̱ mihãṅ ne̱ke̱ maṅ ne̱ mli mei ni eſe̱ ke̱; Iehowa Zebaot kē̱;

english_verse: People of Judah and Israel, you have been a curse to the nations, but I will save you and make you a blessing to them. So don't be afraid or lose courage.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱, bo̱ni nyetšṍ lōmo̱ ye dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ ke̱, Iuda we ke̱ Israel we, nakai noṅṅ mahere nyeyiwala, ni nyeatsṍ *dšō̱mo̱. Nyekašea gbeyei; nyewadšea nyenidšiaṅ ke̱ke̱! *

english_verse: When your ancestors made me angry, I decided to punish you with disasters, and I didn't hold back.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo̱ni Iehowa Zebaot kē̱ ne̱: Take̱ bo̱ni midſẽṅ ake̱ mibafenye efõṅ, beni nyetše̱mei le̱ wo mimli la le̱, ni miſaa mihe le̱, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱,

english_verse: Now you no longer need to be afraid. I have decided to treat Jerusalem and Judah with kindness.
translation_verse: nakai noṅṅ midſëṅ ye̱ ne̱ke̱ gbĩī ne̱ amli, ake̱ mafe Ierusalem ke̱ Iuda we ke̱ edšũrõ. Nyekašea gbeyei!

english_verse: But you must be truthful with each other, and in court you must give fair decisions that lead to peace.
translation_verse: Nibii ní nyefe ne̱: Nyeteṅ mofẽmo ke̱ enanyo *awie ano̱kwale, asaṅ nyekodšoa ano̱kwale ke̱ hedšo̱le̱ kodšomo̱ ye̱ nyegbói ke̱ o̱mli! *Ef.

english_verse: Don't ever plan evil things against others or tell lies under oath. I, the Lord, hate such things. A Time of Celebration
translation_verse: Ni nyeteṅ mokomoko *akadſẽṅ enanyo he efõṅ ye̱ etšui mli, ni nyekasumo̱a amale kitãkãmo̱! edšake̱ ene̱mei fẽ dši nibii ní minye̱o̱, Iehowa kē̱. *

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful told me to say:
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa Zebaot wiemo̱ sā ba miṅõ ake̱:

english_verse: People of Judah, I, the Lord, demand that whenever you go without food as a way of worshiping me, it should become a time of celebration. No matter if it's the fourth month, the fifth month, the seventh month, or the tenth month, you should have a joyful festival. So love truth and live at peace.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni Iehowa Zebaot kē̱ ne̱: Nyõṅ ni dši edſe̱ le̱ no̱ ṅmā̃hile̱ le̱ ke̱ noni dši enumo̱ le̱ no̱ nmā̃hile̱ le̱ ke̱ noni dši kpawo le̱ no̱ ṅmā̃hĩle̱ le̱ ke̱ noni dši nyoṅma le̱ no̱ ṅmā̃hile̱ ke̱ aatšṍ nyã́mo̱ ke̱ miše̱ ke̱ mliflimo̱ gbĩĩ dšudši ahã Iuda we le̱; ši nyesumo̱a ano̱kwale ke̱ ho̱dšo̱le̱!

english_verse: I tell you that people will come here from cities everywhere.
translation_verse: Noni Iehowa Zebaot kē̱ ne̱: Aakã he aba mli ake̱ mãdšimãdši ke̱ mãdši pī amli bii aaba,

english_verse: Those of one town will go to another and say, “We're going to ask the Lord All-Powerful to treat us with kindness. Come and join us.”
translation_verse: ni maṅ kome mli bii aate maṅ kroko mli ayakē̱ ake̱: Nyehãa wo̱yaä wo̱yakpaä Iehowa fai, ni wo̱yatao Iehowa Zebaot se̱gbe̱! Mi hũ mate!

english_verse: Many people from strong nations will come to Jerusalem to worship me and to ask me to treat them with kindness.
translation_verse: Ni mãdšimãdši pī ke̱ dšeṅmãdši ni he wa aaba abatao Iehowa Zebaot se̱gbe̱ ye̱ Ierusalem, ni ame̱akpa Iehowa fai.

english_verse: When this happens, ten people from nations with different languages will grab a Jew by his clothes and say, “Let us go with you. We've heard that God is on your side.” I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Beni Iehowa Zebaot kē̱ ne̱: Nakai gbĩī le̱ amli ke̱ aaba mli ake̱ boo nyoṅma no dše̱ dšeṅmãdši ano̱ wiemo̱i sro̱toi fẽ mli aamõ Iudanyo kome atade nāmū mli, ame̱akē̱: Wo̱ke̱nye aate; edšake̱ wo̱nu ake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ kenye ye̱!

english_verse: Now the Lord will punish Tyre with poverty; he will sink its ships and send it up in flames.
translation_verse: Na, Nuṅtšo̱ ke̱ aaṅõle̱, ni eetſa ehewale̱ le̱ nõ ye̱ ṅšo̱ mli, ni le̱dientše̱ le̱, aašãle̱ ke̱ la.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will take away war chariots and horses from Israel and Jerusalem. Bows that were made for battle will be broken. I will bring peace to nations, and your king will rule from sea to sea. His kingdom will reach from the Euphrates River across the earth. The Lord Promises To Rescue Captives
translation_verse: Ni makpãtã ſīlii ahĩe ke̱-adše̱ Efraim ke̱ okpo̱ṅo̱i hũ ke̱-adše̱ Ierusalem, ni aakpãtã tawū gãi le̱ hũ hĩe; ni eewie hedšo̱le̱ wiemo̱ etšõ dseṅmãdši le̱, ni eno̱yeli le̱ aadše̱ ṅšo̱ nā ke̱-yaši ṅšo̱ nā, ni eedše̱ fā le̱ nā ke̱-yaši šikpoṅ, nāgbēhei le̱ tō̃. Mika

english_verse: When I made a sacred agreement with you, my people, we sealed it with blood. Now some of you are captives in waterless pits, but I will come to your rescue
translation_verse: Bo hũ okpăṅmo̱ *lá le̱ hewo̱ le̱ madšie ogbokle̱foi le̱ ke̱-adše̱ bu ní nu be̱ṅ le̱ mli. *

english_verse: and offer you hope. Return to your fortress, because today I will reward you with twice what you had.
translation_verse: Nyekũa nyese̱ ke̱-baä mō̃ ni wa le̱ṅ, nye gbokle̱foi ni nyeyo̱ hĩeno̱kãmo̱! Ṅme̱ne̱ gbĩ ne̱ hũ mīdšadše mītšõ ake̱: Matoö nãdšiaṅ *toi enyo̱! *Ies.

english_verse: I will use Judah as my bow and Israel as my arrow. I will take the people of Zion as my sword and attack the Greeks. The Lord Will Protect His People
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mido̱ Iuda tamo̱ gãitšo mihã mihe, ni mike̱ Efraim ewo mli, ni matē bo, Zion, obihĩĩ le̱ aši mawo bo, *Hela, obihĩĩ le̱, ni maṅõo mafe tamo̱ nū kãkãlo̱ klante. *Dan.

english_verse: Like a cloud, the Lord God will appear over his people, and his arrows will flash like lightning. God will sound his trumpet and attack in a whirlwind from the south.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa aadšie ehe kpo ye̱ ame̱yiteṅ, ni egãimlibi le̱ aafã kpo tamo̱ srawa; ni Nuṅtšo̱ Iehowa aakpã te̱tre̱mantre̱, ni eke̱ wuoyigbe̱ lasũogbĕlei le̱ aanyie.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will protect his people, and they will trample down the sharpshooters and their slingshots. They will drink and get rowdy; they will be as full as a bowl at the time of sacrifice.
translation_verse: Iehowa Zebaot aabu ame̱he, ni ame̱aye nii, ni ame̱anānā akromia te̱i le̱ ano̱, ni ame̱anu noko, ni ame̱afe hō tamo̱ noni amenu wein, ni ame̱ayimo̱ obõbõ tamo̱ kà ko lo tamo̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ kódši le̱.

english_verse: The Lord God will save them on that day, because they are his people, and they will shine on his land like jewels in a crown.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa, ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, aahere ame̱yiwala ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ tamo̱ emaṅ le̱ tōiku le̱; edsake̱ ame̱atamo̱ akekre he te̱i ni kple̱o̱ ye̱ ešikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: How lovely they will be. Young people will grow there like grain in a field or grapes in a vineyard.
translation_verse: Ši kwe̱ bo̱ni edale̱ ke̱ bo̱ni ehefe̱o le̱ fá hã! ṅmā̃ aahã oblahĩĩ afro̱ke, ni wein hẽ hũ aahã oblayei afro̱ke.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am the one who sends storm clouds and showers of rain to make fields produce. So when the crops need rain, you should pray to me.
translation_verse: Nyebia Iehowa ní ehã nyoṅmo̱ ane̱ ye̱ gbo be le̱ṅ! Iehowa dši moni hãa srawai gblaä, ni eehã nyoṅmo̱ atue babaō ahãame̱, ahã ṅãno̱ bāi fẽ.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am fiercely angry with you leaders, and I will punish you. I care for my people, the nation of Judah, and I will change this flock of sheep into charging war horses.
translation_verse: Mimli ewo *tōkwe̱lo̱i le̱ la, ni mawo tōkpakpoi le̱ anyõmo̱; edšake̱ Iehowa Zebaot ebasra etōiku le̱ ní dši Iuda we le̱, ni eeṅõame̱ efe tamo̱ ekpo̱ṅo̱ ní he yo̱ fe̱o ye̱ ta mli. *

english_verse: From this flock will come leaders who will be strong like cornerstones and tent pegs and weapons of war.
translation_verse: Emli koṅte̱ ke̱ šiṅmlitšo aadše̱ aba, ni emli tawū gãi aadše̱ aba, emli noṅṅ no̱yelo̱-fẽ-no̱yelo̱ aadše̱ aba. Ier.

english_verse: They will join in the fighting, and together they will trample their enemies like mud. They will fight, because I, the Lord, will be on their side. And they will crush the enemy cavalry.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱atamo̱ kãkãlo̱i ní nānāa blohũiaṅ ṅmiamo̱ no̱ ye̱ ta le̱ṅ, ni ame̱awu ta; edšake̱ Iehowa ke̱ame̱ ye̱, ni mei ní trá okpo̱ṅo̱i ano̱ le̱ ahĩe aaſie ši.

english_verse: I will strengthen the kingdoms of Judah and Israel. And I will show mercy because I am the Lord, their God. I will answer their prayers and bring them home. Then it will seem as though I had never rejected them.
translation_verse: Ni mawo Iuda we le̱ hewale̱, ni mahere Iosef we le̱ yiwala, ni mike̱ame̱ aakũ se̱ ke̱-aba ekoṅ; edšake̱ mimũsũṅ etšõmi ye̱ ame̱he, ni ame̱afe tamo̱ mei ní miſiekoame̱; edšake̱ midši Iehowa, ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ni mato he mahãame̱.

english_verse: Israel will be like a tribe of warriors celebrating with wine. When their children see this, they will also be happy because of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni Efraim aatamo̱ kãkãlo̱, ni ame̱tšui aanyõ ame̱mli tamo̱ noni ame̱nu wein; ni ame̱bii hũ aana, ni ame̱mī aaše̱, ni ame̱mli aafliame̱ ye̱ Iehowa mli.

english_verse: I will give a signal for them to come together because I have rescued them. And there will be as many as ever before.
translation_verse: Makpā ble̱ matšé̱ame̱, ni mabua ame̱nā; edšake̱ mikpõame̱, ni ame̱aſere, tamo̱ bo̱ni ame̱ſere sá le̱.

english_verse: Although I scattered my people in distant countries, they won't forget me. Once their children are raised, they will return—
translation_verse: Ni magbe̱ame̱ maſã mãdšimãdši ateṅ, ni ameakaimi ye̱ sikpõdši ní yo̱ soṅṅ le̱ ano̱, ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱bii ayi aaná wala, ni ame̱akpale ke̱-aba ekoṅ. Ies.

english_verse: I will bring them home from Egypt and Assyria, then let them settle as far as Gilead and Lebanon, until the land overflows with them.
translation_verse: Masā mayaṅõame̱ ekoṅ ke̱-adše̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ke̱-aba, ni mayabua ame̱nā ke̱-adše̱ Ašur, ni mike̱ame̱ aaba Gilead ke̱ Lebanon šikpoṅ ne̱ no̱, ni anáṅ gbe̱ ahãame̱ tete.

english_verse: I'll strengthen my people because of who I am, and they will follow me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ni mawoame̱ hewale̱ ye̱ Iehowa mli, ni egbe̱i le̱ṅ ame̱anyie ye̱, Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: Lebanon, open your gates! Let the fire come in to destroy your cedar trees.
translation_verse: Lebanon, gblemo̱ osĩnāi le̱, ní la ašã otšenedrui le̱.

english_verse: Listen! Shepherds are crying. Their glorious pastures have been ruined. Listen! Lions are roaring. The forests of the Jordan Valley are no more to be found. Worthless Shepherds
translation_verse: Tōkwe̱loi alelewo̱mo̱ gbē le̱ mīdšidše, edšake̱ ame̱numuyam le̱ hĩe ekpãtã; dšatabii ahū̃mo̱ gbē le̱ mīdšidše, edšake̱ Iordan hewõ le̱ hĩe ekpãtã.

english_verse: The Lord my God said to me: Tend those sheep doomed for slaughter!
translation_verse: Boni Iehowa, mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, kē̱ ne̱: Lẽ̱̀ tōiku ní abagbe le̱,

english_verse: The people who buy and butcher them go unpunished, while everyone who sells them says, “Praise the Lord! I'm rich.” Not even their shepherds have pity on them.
translation_verse: nii ní mei ní heoame le̱ gbeo̱ame̱, ni ame̱yee fo̱, ni mei ní hõo̱ame̱ le̱ kē̱o̱ ake̱: Yidšiemo̱ ahã Iehowa, edšake̱ miná nii! ni ame̱kwe̱lo̱i le̱ hũ ebãã ame̱yí le̱. Ier.

english_verse: Tend those sheep because I, the Lord, will no longer have pity on the people of this earth. I'll turn neighbor against neighbor and make them slaves of a king. They will bring disaster on the earth, and I'll do nothing to rescue any of them.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mibāṅ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ bii le̱ ayi doṅṅ, Iehowa kē̱; ši na, madšie gbomei ke̱ ateṅ mofẽmo mawo enanyo deṅ ke̱ emaṅtše̱ deṅ, ni ame̱atſia šikpoṅ le̱ nii, ni midšieṅ moko ye̱ ame̱deṅ.

english_verse: In less than a month, I became impatient with three shepherds who didn't like me, and I got rid of them.
translation_verse: Ni miplenē tōkwe̱lo̱i etẽ le̱ ye̱ nyōṅ kome mli; edšake̱ ame̱sane edše misusuma tsine, ni ame̱ hũ ame̱susuma enyãṅemi.

english_verse: The sheep dealers who saw me knew at once that this was a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni akũ mli ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱, ni tōiku le̱ mli nii *ní nii yo̱ mo̱bo̱ ní buo̱mi le̱ ná le ake̱ Iehowa wiemo̱ ni. *K.

english_verse: I told them, “Pay me my wages, if you think you should; otherwise, forget it.” So they handed me my wages, a measly
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa kē̱mi ake̱: Še̱re̱mo̱ miyi dšra kpakpa ní ame̱wo le̱ oſie nitōhe le̱! Ni *mikŏ̱lo̱ dſie̱te̱i kukudši nyoṅmai-etẽ le̱ ni miyaše̱re̱ miſie Iehowa we le̱ nitōhe le̱. *Mat.

english_verse: Then I broke the stick named “Unity” and canceled the ties between Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mikũ mitšo kroko ní dši Kpãṅmo̱ le̱ mli, beni ale ní akũ *nyemifemo̱ ní yo̱ Iuda ke̱ Israel teṅ le̱ mli. *Ezek

english_verse: Next, the Lord said to me, “Act like a shepherd again—this time a worthless shepherd.
translation_verse: Ni Iehowa sā kē̱mi ake̱: Kŏ̱lo̱mo̱ tōkwe̱lo̱ kwašia nitsumo̱nii ohã ohe ekoṅ!

english_verse: Once more I am going to let a worthless nobody rule the land—one who won't care for the strays or search for the young or heal the sick or feed the healthy. He will just dine on the fattest sheep, leaving nothing but a few bones.”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ na, matē tōkwe̱lo̱ ko ši ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, moni ediṅ nii ní lādšeo̱ le̱ ase̱, ni etaoṅ nii ní egbe̱ eſã le̱, ni etšáṅ nii ní ekũmo̱ le̱, ni elè̱ṅ noni yo̱ hewale̱ le̱; ši eeye nii ní ewo fo̱ le̱ alō, ni eegbla ame̱koklotoi amli.

english_verse: You worthless shepherd, deserting the sheep! I hope a sword will cripple your arm and blind your right eye.
translation_verse: Kpóo hā tōkwe̱lo̱ gbonyo ní šĩo̱ tōiku le̱! Klante aakã enine ke̱ ehĩṅme̱i dsũrõ no̱! Enine aagbo kwrā, ni ehĩṅmei dsũrõ aaſila kwrā!

english_verse: I will blind every horse and make them panic, and every rider will be confused. But at the same time, I will watch over Judah.
translation_verse: Nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱, Iehowa kē̱, mahã okpo̱ṅo̱-fẽ-okpo̱ṅo̱ agri, ni eno̱tálo̱ hũ aaye se̱ke̱; ni magble mihĩṅme̱ii ye̱ Iuda we le̱ no̱, ši mãdši le̱ akpo̱ṅo̱i le̱ mahã ame̱ſila.

english_verse: Then every clan in Judah will realize that I, the Lord All-Powerful, am their God, and that I am the source of their strength.
translation_verse: Ni Iuda asifoiatše̱mei le̱ aakē̱ ye̱ ame̱tšuiṅ ake̱: Ierusalembii le̱ dši mi-hewale̱ ye̱ Iehowa Zebaot, ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, mli!

english_verse: At that time I will let the clans of Judah be like a ball of fire in a wood pile or a fiery torch in a hay stack. Then Judah will send the surrounding nations up in smoke. And once again the city of Jerusalem will be filled with people.
translation_verse: Nakai le̱ no̱ le̱ miṅõ Iuda asafoiatše̱mei le̱ mafe tamo̱ la ke̱ ṅe̱sũ ye̱ laii ateṅ, lo tamo̱ ko̱ti ní asu ye̱ *ṅmā̃kei ateṅ, ni ame̱ašã mãdšimãdši fẽ ní bo̱leame̱ le̱ ye̱ ninedšũrõ ke̱ abe̱ku, ni Ierusalem aahĩ egbe̱he, ní dši Ierusalem le̱ noṅṅ. *Obad.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will protect Jerusalem. Even the weakest person there will be as strong as David, and David's kingdom will rule as though my very own angel were its leader.
translation_verse: Nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ Iehowa aabu moni hĩo̱ Ierusalem le̱ he, ni moni *egbo̱-dšo̱ ye̱ ame̱teṅ le̱ aatamo̱ David, ni David we le̱ hũ aatamo̱ Nyoṅmo̱, tamo̱ Iehowa bo̱fo ní nyie ame̱hĩe. *Ies.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make the descendants of David and the people of Jerusalem feel deep sorrow and pray when they see the one they pierced with a spear. They will mourn and weep for him, as parents weep over the death of their only child or their first-born.
translation_verse: Ni *mafo̱se dromo̱ ke̱ faikpamo̱ mumo̱ le̱ maſie David we le̱ ke̱ Ierusalembii le̱ ano̱, ni †ame̱akwe̱ moni ame̱tsule̱ nõ le̱, ni ame̱awo ehe yăra tamo̱ mo woo̱ ebi kome he yăra, ni ame̱w̌ere̱ aaho ame̱he ye̱ ehewo̱ tamo̱ mo w̌ere̱ hoo̱ ehe ye̱ ekromo̱bi hewo̱. *Ioel

english_verse: On that day the people of Jerusalem will mourn as much as everyone did for Hadad Rimmon on the flatlands near Megiddo.
translation_verse: Nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ yărafemo̱ kpeteṅkple aaba Ierusalem tamo̱ Hadad-Rimon yărafemo̱ ní afe ye̱ *Megido dšō̱ le̱ṅ le̱. *

english_verse: Everyone of each family in the land will mourn, and the men will mourn separately from the women. This includes those from the family of David, and the families of Nathan,
translation_verse: Ni šikpoṅ le̱ aawo yăra wekuiaṅ-wokuiaṅ: David we le̱ weku le̱ nõ ekro, ke̱ ame̱ṅāmei anõ ekro; Natan we le̱ weku le̱ nõ ekro, ke̱ ame̱ṅãmei anõ ekro;

english_verse: If any such prophets ever appear again, their own parents must warn them that they will die for telling lies in my name—the name of the Lord. If those prophets don't stop speaking, their parents must then kill them with a sword.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱, ke̱dši moko aakã he agba le̱, no le̱ etše̱ ke̱ enye ní fo̱le̱ le̱ aakē̱le̱ ake̱: *Oyi náṅ wala, edšake̱ omale ye̱ Iehowa gbe̱i amli! ni ké̱ ēgba le̱, etše̱ ke̱ enye ní fo̱le̱ le̱ aatšule̱ nõ. *

english_verse: Those prophets will be ashamed of their so-called visions, and they won't deceive anyone by dressing like a true prophet.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ gbalo̱i le̱ ateṅ mofẽmo hĩe aagbo ye̱ eninā te hewo̱, ké̱ ēgba le̱, ni asaṅ ame̱woṅ *atade ní ake̱ tšo̱i lò ni ame̱ke̱-ašišiu mei doṅṅ. *

english_verse: Instead, they will say, “I'm no prophet. I've been a farmer all my life.”
translation_verse: Ši eekē̱ ake̱: Dšee gbalo̱ dšimi, šikpoṅ-hũlo̱ dšimi; edšake̱ moko hemi ke̱-dše̱ migbekẽbiiaši.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: My sword, wake up! Attack my shepherd and friend. Strike down the shepherd! Scatter the little sheep, and I will destroy them.
translation_verse: Klante, ohĩe atšẽ owo mitōkwe̱lo̱ te ke̱ nū ni dši minanyo le̱! Iehowa Zebaot kē̱. *Tſa tōkwe̱lo̱ le̱ nõ, ni tōi le̱ aagbe̱ aſã, ni matšṍ minine ke̱-aba bibii le̱ ano̱! *Mat.

english_verse: Then I will purify them and put them to the test, just as gold and silver are purified and tested. They will pray in my name, and I will answer them. I will say, “You are my people,” and they will reply, “You, Lord, are our God!”
translation_verse: Ni mike̱ mlidšā ni dši etẽ le̱ awo la mli, ni matšū amehe, tamo̱ atšūo̱ dſie̱te̱i he, ni makaame̱ makwe̱, tamo̱ akaä šika akwe̱o̱. Ame̱atšé̱ migbei, ni mahereame̱ no̱; makē̱ ake̱: *Mimaṅ dšiame̱! ni ame̱ hũ ame̱akē̱ ake̱: Iehowa dši mi-Nyoṅmo̱! *Hos.

english_verse: He will take his stand on the Mount of Olives east of Jerusalem, and the mountain will split in half, forming a wide valley that runs from east to west.
translation_verse: Ni nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ enãdši aadamo̱ Mũgoṅ le̱ ni mã Ierusalem hĩe ye̱ bokãgbe̱ le̱ no̱, ni Mũgoṅ le̱ mli aagbá enyo̱ ye̱ eteṅ ke̱-ate bokãgbe̱ ke̱ anaigbe̱, ni dšō̱ kpeteṅkple dientše̱ aaba, ni goṅ le̱ fã aafã ke̱-ate kōyigbe̱, ni fã hũ aate wuoyigbe̱.

english_verse: Then you people will escape from the Lord's mountain, through this valley, which reaches to Azal. You will run in all directions, just as everyone did when the earthquake struck in the time of King Uzziah of Judah. Afterwards, the Lord my God will appear with his holy angels.
translation_verse: Ni nyeadšo foi ke̱-ate migõdsi le̱ adšō̱ le̱ṅ; edšake̱ gõdši le̱ adšō̱ le̱ aaše̱ Azal tō̃, ni nyeadšo foi take̱ bo̱ni nyedšo *šikpoṅ hosomo̱ le̱ nā foi ye̱ Iuda maṅtše̱ Uzia gbĩĩ le̱ amli le̱; ni Iehowa, mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, aaba, ni meikroṅkroṅi le̱ fẽ aafata ohe. *Amos

english_verse: It will be a bright day that won't turn cloudy or cold.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ la le̱ kpe̱ṅ, nii ní kple̱o̱ le̱ ahĩe aaha.

english_verse: And the Lord has decided when it will happen—this time of unending day.
translation_verse: Ši gbĩ ko aaba ní *Iehowa pe̱ le: dšee ſane le̱, dšee nyōṅ hũ ni; ši aaba mli ake̱ gbe̱ke̱ le̱ dseṅ aatše. *Mar.

english_verse: In both summer and winter, life-giving streams will flow from Jerusalem, half of them to the Dead Sea in the east and half to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ walanui atue ke̱-adše̱ Ierusalem: emli fã aate bokãgbe̱ nšo̱ le̱ mli, ni emli fã hũ aate anaigbe̱ ṅso le̱ mli; eeba ye̱ latšābe ke̱ fẽibe fẽ mli. Ezek.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord will do to those who attack Jerusalem: While they are standing there, he will make their flesh rot and their eyes fall from their sockets and their tongues drop out.
translation_verse: Ni ene̱ dši haomo̱ ní Iehowa ke̱-ahao mãdšimãdši fiā ni efã ta eši Ierusalem le̱: ame̱helo aakpo̱to̱ beni ame̱damo̱ ame̱nãdši anā lolo le̱, ni ame̱hĩṅme̱ii aakpo̱to̱ ye̱ amefo̱dši le̱ amli, ni ame̱lile̱i hũ aakpo̱to̱ ye̱ ame̱dāṅ.

english_verse: until even the people of Judah turn against those in Jerusalem. This same terrible disaster will also strike every animal nearby, including horses, mules, camels, and donkeys. Finally, everything of value in the surrounding nations will be collected and brought to Jerusalem—gold, silver, and piles of clothing.
translation_verse: Ni okpo̱ṅo̱ ke̱ tedšiokpo̱ṅo̱ ke̱ yoma ke̱ tedši ke̱ koloi fẽ ní yo̱ ne̱ke̱ nsrai ne̱ amli le̱ ahaomo̱ le̱ aatamo̱ ne̱ke̱ haomo̱ ne̱ noṅṅ.

english_verse: Afterwards, the survivors from those nations that attacked Jerusalem will go there each year to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful, and to celebrate the Festival of Shelters.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱ dšeṅmãdši fẽ ní te ši wo Ierusalem le̱ ateṅ mei ní eſe̱ le̱ fẽ aaba dā afi, ní ame̱badšá *maṅtše̱ Iehowa Zebaot, ní ame̱baye asesei agbĩdšũrõ le̱ hũ. *K.

english_verse: No rain will fall on the land of anyone in any country who refuses to go to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ wekui le̱ fẽ mli mei ní baa Ierusalem, ní ame̱badšá maṅtše̱ Iehowa Zebaot le̱, nyoṅmo̱ ene̱ṅ hãṅame̱.

english_verse: This horrible disaster will strike the Egyptians and everyone else who refuses to go there for the celebration.
translation_verse: Ene̱ dši Mizraim eša he nyōmo̱wo, ke̱ dšeṅmãdši fiā ní baa ame̱bayee asesei agbĩdšũrõ le̱ eša he nyōmo̱wo.

english_verse: At that time the words “Dedicated to the Lord” will be engraved on the bells worn by horses. In fact, every ordinary cooking pot in Jerusalem will be just as sacred to the Lord All-Powerful as the bowls used at the altar. Any one of them will be acceptable for boiling the meat of sacrificed animals, and there will no longer be a need to sell special pots and bowls.
translation_verse: Ni kukwe̱i-fẽ-kukwe̱i ní yo̱ Ierusalem ke̱ Iuda le̱ aafe kroṅkroṅ ahã Iehowa Zebaot, ni mei fẽ ní šãa afo̱le le̱ aaba abakŏ̱lo̱ ekomei ayahõ lō ye̱ mli; ni nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ Kanaannyo ko *ehĩṅ Iehowa Zebaot we le̱ doṅṅ. *Kpods.

english_verse: Esau's descendants may say, “Although our nation Edom is in ruins, we will rebuild it.” But I, the Lord All-Powerful, promise to tear down whatever they build. Then everyone will know that I will never stop being angry with them as long as they are so sinful.
translation_verse: Ké̱ Edom kē̱ ake̱: Adſărawo̱ moṅ, ši wo̱o̱kũ wo̱se̱ ke̱-ya ní wo̱yamãmo̱ kói-kói le̱! no le̱ bo̱ni Iehowa Zebaot bõ ne̱: Ame̱amãmo̱ moṅ, ši mi le̱ mawule maſie ši! ni aatšē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nõfõṅfemò̱ kpokpai, ke̱ Maṅ ni Iehowa mli ewoame̱ la ke̱-yaä nāno̱.

english_verse: Israel, when you see this, you will shout, “The Lord's great reputation reaches beyond our borders.” Judgment against Priests
translation_verse: Ni ayehĩṅme̱ii aana, ni nyedientše̱ nyeakē̱ ake̱: Iehowa da ke̱-teke Israel kpokpai le̱!

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something to say to you priests. Children respect their fathers, and servants respect their masters. I am your father and your master, so why don't you respect me? You priests have insulted me, and now you ask, “How did we insult you?”
translation_verse: *Bi woo̱ etše̱, ni tšũlo̱ hũ woo̱ enuṅtšo̱; kole̱ ke̱dši tše dšimi le̱, nẽgbe̱ miwō le̱ yo̱? ni ke̱dši nuṅtšo̱ hũ dšimi le̱, nẽgbe̱ migbeyeišemo̱ le̱ yo̱? Iehowa Zebaot mīkē̱ nye, oso̱foi, ní nyegbeo̱ migbe̱i le̱ he guo̱ le̱; ši nyekē̱o̱ ake̱: Meni mli wo̱gbeo̱ ogbe̱i le̱ he guo̱ ye̱? *

english_verse: But isn't it wrong to offer animals that are blind, lame, or sick? Just try giving those animals to your governor. That certainly wouldn't please him or make him want to help you.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši nyeke̱ kolo *ſilafo bahã ní ake̱-ša afo̱le le̱, edšee nõfõṅ ko! ni ke̱dši nyoke̱ akpake lo helatše̱ bahã le̱, edšee nõfõṅ! Oke̱-yahã omralo le̱: ani eená ohe tšui, alo eekwe̱ ehĩe? Iehowa Zebaot kē̱.

english_verse: I am the Lord God All-Powerful, and you had better try to please me. You have sinned. Now see if I will have mercy on any of you.
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne, nyekpaä Mawu fai, koni edrowo̱! Nyedeṅ ene̱ dše̱; ani eekwe̱ nyeteṅ moko hĩe? Iehowa Zebaot kē̱.

english_verse: I wish someone would lock the doors of my temple, so you would stop wasting time building fires on my altar. I am not pleased with you priests, and I refuse to accept any more of your offerings.
translation_verse: Minã ni kũle̱ nyeteṅ moko ṅã́mo̱ šĩnãi le̱, koni nyekaše̱re la ye̱ mifo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ yakatſā doṅṅ! Mináá nyehe tšui, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱, ni nyedeṅ *ni-kēnii hũ mináá he mīše̱, *

english_verse: From dawn until dusk my name is praised by every nation on this earth, as they burn incense and offer the proper sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ka-dše̱ hũlũ šitē mli ke̱-yaši ešinyō mli le̱ migbe̱i le̱ da ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ, ni ašãa tšofã-he̱-ṅma ahãa migbe̱i le̱ ye̱ hefẽhe, ni ake̱ nikēnii ní he tše hũ baä; edšake̱ migbe̱i le̱ da ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱. Ies.

english_verse: You get so disgusted that you even make vulgar signs at me. And for an offering, you bring stolen animals or those that are lame or sick. Should I accept these?
translation_verse: Ni nyekē̱o̱ ake̱: Na, mẽ haomo̱ ne̱! ni nyegbeo̱ he guo̱, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱, ni nyeke̱ dšūnii ke̱ akpake ke̱ helatše̱ baä, ni nyeko-bohãa ake nikēnii: aso mahe ene̱ ke̱ mīše̱ ye̱ nyedeṅ lo? Iehowa kē̱.

english_verse: Instead of offering the acceptable animals you have promised, you bring me those that are unhealthy. I will punish you for this, because I am the great King, the Lord All-Powerful, and I am worshiped by nations everywhere.
translation_verse: Ši alomo̱ šišiulo̱ ni yo̱ *tōnū ye̱ etōiku mli ni ké̱ ewo ši ni eke̱ noni kpa yo̱ he yašãa afo̱le ehãa Nuṅtšo̱ le̱! Edšake̱ maṅtše̱ kpeteṅkple dšimi, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱, ni migbe̱i le̱ he ye̱ gbeyei ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ! *Mose

english_verse: I am telling you this, so I can continue to keep my agreement with your ancestor Levi.
translation_verse: Ni nyeaná nyele ake̱ mi mitšũ ne̱ke̱ kitã ne̱ ke̱-ba nyeṅõ, ní etšṍ mike̱ Levi kpãṅmo̱, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱.

english_verse: You priests should be eager to spread knowledge, and everyone should come to you for instruction, because you speak for me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ esa ake̱ *oso̱fo le̱ nā-bu too̱ nilē, ni le̱ edãṅ sa ake̱ atao mla ke̱-dše̱, edšake̱ Iehowa Zebaot †bo̱fo dšile̱. *

english_verse: But you have turned your backs on me. Your teachings have led others to do sinful things, and you have broken the agreement I made with your ancestor Levi.
translation_verse: Ši nye nyebá afã ke̱-dše̱ gbe̱ le̱ no̱, nyehã mei babaō etĕ̱re̱ mla le̱; nyefite Levi kpãṅmo̱ le̱, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱.

english_verse: You people in Judah and Jerusalem have been unfaithful to the Lord. You have disgraced the temple that he loves, and you have committed the disgusting sin of marrying the worshipers of other gods.
translation_verse: Iuda eye kũtũmpo̱o, ni afe nihīnii ye̱ Israel ke̱ Ierusalem; edšake̱ Iuda ebule Iehowa hekroṅkroṅ ni esumoo̱ le̱, ni eyaw̌e̱ *maṅse̱ nyoṅmo̱ biyō. *Ezra

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful of Israel hates anyone who is cruel enough to divorce his wife. So take care never to be unfaithful!
translation_verse: Mīnye̱ *ṅãſiemo̱, Iehowa, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ṅē̱, ke̱ moni ṅõo̱ yiwale̱ ehaä e̱tade no̱ le̱, Ie̱howa Zebaot kē̱; nohe̱wo̱ le̱ nyekwe̱a nyehe ní ahĩa ye̱ nye̱mumo̱ le̱ hewo̱, ní nyekaye kũtũmpo̱o! *Mose

english_verse: You have worn out the Lord with your words. And yet, you ask, “How did we do that?” You did it by saying, “The Lord is pleased with evil and doesn't care about justice.”
translation_verse: Nyehã e̱to̱ Iehowa ke̱ *nyewiemo̱i le̱. Ši nyekē̱o̱ ake̱: Meni mli wo̱hã eto̱le̱ ye̱? Ni nyekē̱o̱ ake̱: Mofẽmo ní feo̱ efõṅ le̱ ehĩ ye̱ Iehowa hĩe, ni enáa ame̱he tšui le̱, alo: Nẽgbe̱ kodšomo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ yo̱? le̱. *

english_verse: On the day the Lord comes, he will be like a furnace that purifies silver or like strong soap in a washbasin. No one will be able to stand up to him.
translation_verse: .] Ši nye mei ní nyešeo̱ mi-gbe̱i le̱ gbeyei le̱, *dšale̱ hũlũ le̱ aate ši ahãnye ke̱ tšámo̱ ye̱ efĩdši amli, ni nyeadše kpo ni nyeahuru tamo̱ tšiṅabii ní agble ameyi. *Luk.

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I never change. That's why you haven't been wiped out,
translation_verse: .] Ni *eedŏ̱ro̱ tše̱mei atšuii ke̱-ba e̱me̱bii ahe, ke̱ bii hũ atšuii ke̱-ba ame̱tše̱mei ahe, koni mikaba ní mibahã šikpoṅ le̱ ye musu. *Luk.

english_verse: even though you have ignored and disobeyed my laws ever since the time of your ancestors. But if you return to me, I will return to you. And yet you ask, “How can we return?”
translation_verse: Ke̱-dše̱ nyetše̱mei ayino̱ bēbe nye-gbá afã ke̱-dše mikpo̱i le̱ ahe ni nyeyee no̱. *Nyekpalea ke̱-baä miṅõ! ni makpale ke̱-ba nyeṅõ, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱. Ši nye-kē̱o̱ ake̱: Meni mli wó̱kpale ye̱? *Zak.

english_verse: You people are robbing me, your God. And, here you are, asking, “How are we robbing you?” You are robbing me of the offerings and of the ten percent that belongs to me.
translation_verse: Aso gbo̱mo̱ ko šišiuo̱ Nyoṅmo̱? ši nye le̱ nyešišiuo̱mi. Ši nythē̱o̱ abe̱: Meni mli wo̱šišiuo̱o ye̱? ye̱ mlidšāi nyoṅma mli ekomekome le̱ ke̱ no̱wómo̱-afo̱lei le̱ amli!

english_verse: That's why your whole nation is under a curse.
translation_verse: Lōmo̱ *kã nyeno̱, edšake̱ nye maṅ mū le̱ fẽ nyešišiuo̱mi! *Hag.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I challenge you to put me to the test. Bring the entire ten percent into the storehouse, so there will be food in my house. Then I will open the windows of heaven and flood you with blessing after blessing.
translation_verse: Nyeke̱ mlidšāi nyoṅma mli ekomekome le̱ fẽ abaä fiase le̱, koni niyenii ahĩ miwe le̱! ni nyeke̱-kaämi nyekwe̱a, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱, ake̱ migbleṅ ṅwei samfe̱dši le̱ mihãṅnye, ni mifo̱seṅ dšō̱mo̱ mihãṅnye ni ateke no̱ lo?

english_verse: Everyone of every nation will talk about how I have blessed you and about your wonderful land. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ni dšeṅmãdši ṅe̱ aabunye mei ni adšō̱, edšake̱ nyetšṍ šikpoṅ ní ayo̱ be̱ tšui, Iehowa Zebaot kē̱.

english_verse: See how happy those arrogant people are. Everyone who does wrong is successful, and when they put God to the test, they always get away with it.” Faithfulness Is Rewarded
translation_verse: Ši agbe̱ne̱ wo̱buo̱ hewolo̱i ake̱ mei ní adšō̱ame̱; mei ni feo̱ nifõdšianii le̱, amãa-ame̱; ame̱baä Nyoṅmo̱, ni adšieo̱-ame̱ kẽ.

english_verse: All those who truly respected the Lord and honored his name started discussing these things, and when God saw what was happening, he had their names written as a reminder in his book.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mei ni šeo̱ Iehowa gbeyei le̱ ke̱ ame̱he wie, ni Iehowa bo toi, ni enu, ní aṅmä kaimo̱-wolo ye̱ ehĩe ahã mei ní šeo̱ Iehowa gbeyei le̱, ke̱ mei ni dſẽṅo̱ egbe̱i le̱ he le̱.

english_verse: Then everyone will once again see the difference between those who obey me by doing right and those who reject me by doing wrong.
translation_verse: No dãni nyeakũ se̱ nyena sro̱to ní yo̱ dšalo̱ ke̱ efōṅfelo̱ ieṅ, ke̱ moni súmoo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ke̱ moni súmo̱o̱le̱ teṅ.

english_verse: “A virgin will have a baby boy, and he will be called Immanuel,” which means “God is with us.”
translation_verse: “Na, oblayō fro le̱ aaná mũsũ, ni eefo binū, ni ame̱wole̱ gbei ake̱ Imanuel,” ešiši dši: Nyoṅmo̱ ke̱wo̱ ye̱.

english_verse: Joseph was a good man and did not want to embarrass Mary in front of everyone. So he decided to quietly call off the wedding.
translation_verse: Ši Iosef, ewù le̱, ake̱-ní dšalo̱ dšile̱ ni etaoo ake̱ ebo̱le̱ ahora le̱, esusu ake̱ eeṅmē̃ ehe kpō.

english_verse: While Joseph was thinking about this, an angel from the Lord appeared to him in a dream. The angel said, “Joseph, the baby that Mary will have is from the Holy Spirit. Go ahead and marry her.
translation_verse: Ši beni edſẽṅo̱ nii ne̱ ahe le̱, na, Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ bo̱fo dšie ehe kpo etšõle̱ ye̱ lamõ mli, ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Iosef, David bi, kāše oṅã Maria le̱ ṅō̃ gbeyei, ši *ho̱ ní ehĩe ne̱ edše̱ Mumo̱ kroṅkroṅ le̱ṅ; *K.

english_verse: So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said,
translation_verse: Ši afe ene̱ fẽ, koni noni Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ wie ye *gbalo̱ le̱ nā le̱ aba mli ake̱: *Ies.

english_verse: After Joseph woke up, he and Mary were soon married, just as the Lord's angel had told him to do.
translation_verse: Ši beni Iosef te ši ke̱-dše̱ wo̱ le̱ mli le̱, efe bo̱ni Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ bo̱fo le̱ kē̱le̱ le̱, ni eṅõ eṅã le̱;

english_verse: But they did not sleep together before her baby was born. Then Joseph named him Jesus.
translation_verse: ni eleele̱ āhũ ke̱-yaši beyino ní efo̱ *ekromo̱binū le̱, ni ewole̱ gbe̱i ake̱ Iesu. *Luk.

english_verse: When King Herod heard about this, he was worried, and so was everyone else in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ši beni maṅtše̱ Herode nu ene̱ le̱, eke̱ Ierusalem fẽ yoyoro;

english_verse: Herod secretly called in the wise men and asked them when they had first seen the star.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Herode tšé̱ nilelo̱i le̱ nĩgī̃, ni ebiame̱ fitšofitšo beyino̱ ní ṅulamile̱ pue.

english_verse: He told them, “Go to Bethlehem and search carefully for the child. As soon as you find him, let me know. I also want to go and worship him.”
translation_verse: Ni ehã ame̱te Betlehem ni ekē̱; Nyeyaä ni nyeyataoa abifao le̱ fitšofitšo; ši ké̱ nyenale̱ le̱, nyebakē̱ami, koni mi hũ maba ní mabadšále̱.

english_verse: The wise men listened to what the king said and then left. And the star they had seen in the east went on ahead of them until it stopped over the place where the child was.
translation_verse: Ši beni ame̱nu maṅtše̱ le̱ wiemo̱ le̱, ame̱yiṅ ame̱te. Ni na, ṅulami le̱ ní ame̱na ye̱ bokã le̱ nyie ame̱hĩe āhũ, ke̱-yaši ebadamo̱ heni abifao le̱ yo̱ le̱ ṅwei.

english_verse: Later they were warned in a dream not to return to Herod, and they went back home by another road. The Escape to Egypt
translation_verse: Ni ake̱-ní adšie atšõame̱ ye̱ wo̱lamõ mli ake̱ ame̱kaya Herode ṅõ doṅṅ le̱, ame̱tšṍ gbe̱ kroko no̱ ke̱-te ame̱šikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: That night, Joseph got up and took his wife and the child to Egypt,
translation_verse: Ni ete ši eṅõ abifao le̱ ke̱ enye le̱ nyōṅ, ni eyiṅ ete Mizraim.

english_verse: When Herod found out that the wise men from the east had tricked him, he was very angry. He gave orders for his men to kill all the boys who lived in or near Bethlehem and were two years old and younger. This was based on what he had learned from the wise men.
translation_verse: Agbene beni Herode na ake̱ nilelo̱i le̱ eye ehe fe̱o le̱, emli fũ babaō, ni etšũ ayagbe gbekẽbiihĩĩ fẽ ní yo̱ Betlehem ke̱ dše̱i niiaṅ fẽ, mei ní eye afii enyo̱ ke̱ mei ní yeko nakai le̱, ye̱ be ni ebi nilelo̱i le̱ fitšofitšo le̱ nā.

english_verse: So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet Jeremiah had said,
translation_verse: Ne̱ke̱ noni *gbalo̱ Ieremia kē̱ le̱ ba mli ake̱: *Ier.

english_verse: “In Ramah a voice was heard crying and weeping loudly. Rachel was mourning for her children, and she refused to be comforted, because they were dead.” The Return from Egypt
translation_verse: “Anu gbe ye̱ Rama, ṅko̱mo̱yeli ke̱ yāfó ke̱ yărafemo̱ babaō: *Rahel mīfó ebii, ni ekplẽẽ kpãtãmo̱; edšake̱ ame̱be̱.” *

english_verse: After King Herod died, an angel from the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph while he was still in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ši beni Herode egbo le̱, na, Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ bo̱fo dšie ehe kpo etšõ Iosef ye̱ lamõ mli ye̱ Mizraim,

english_verse: The angel said, “Get up and take the child and his mother back to Israel. The people who wanted to kill him are now dead.”
translation_verse: ni ekē̱: Te ši, ní oṅõ abifao le̱ ke̱ enye le̱, ní oya Israel šikpoṅ le̱ no̱; *ši mei ní taoo̱ abifao le̱ susuma le̱ egboi. *

english_verse: Joseph got up and left with them for Israel.
translation_verse: Ni ete ši, ni eṅõ abifao le̱ ke̱ enye le̱, ni eba Israel šikpoṅ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: But when he heard that Herod's son Archelaus was now ruler of Judea, he was afraid to go there. Then in a dream he was told to go to Galilee,
translation_verse: Ši beni enu ake̱ Arkelao mīye maṅtše̱ ye̱ Iudea ye̱ etše̱ Herode se̱ le̱, eše dše̱i-yā gbeyei; ni ake̱-ni adšie atšõle̱ ye̱ lamõ mli le̱, edo̱ eyi ke̱-te Galilea niiaṅ.

english_verse: and they went to live there in the town of Nazareth. So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said, “He will be called a Nazarene.”
translation_verse: Ni eba ebahĩ maṅ ko ni atšé̱o̱le̱ *Nazaret le̱ mli; koni noni gbalo̱ le̱ wie le̱ aba mli ake̱: “Aatšé̱le̱ Nazarenyo.” *Luk.

english_verse: They told how sorry they were for their sins, and he baptized them in the river.
translation_verse: ni ebaptisiame̱ ye̱ Iordan mli, beni ame̱dšadšeo̱ ame̱he ešai le̱.

english_verse: An ax is ready to cut the trees down at their roots. Any tree that doesn't produce good fruit will be chopped down and thrown into a fire.
translation_verse: Ši lema le̱ kā tšei le̱ ašišifã le̱ no̱ momo, koni tšo-fẽ-tšo ní woo yibii kpakpai le̱, atole̱ agbē ši, ni ašé̱ afõ la mli. Luk.

english_verse: His threshing fork is in his hand, and he is ready to separate the wheat from the husks. He will store the wheat in a barn and burn the husks in a fire that never goes out. The Baptism of Jesus (Mark
translation_verse: Moni hĩe ešātšeneye̱ edeṅ, ni ebabē̱ ešikpoṅ le̱ fitšofitšo, ni ebuá eṅmā̃ le̱ nā eto eboṅo mli; ši tutū le̱, eke̱ la ni gboo bašã.

english_verse: Jesus left Galilee and went to the Jordan River to be baptized by John.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iesu dše̱ Galilea eba Iohane ṅõ ye̱ Iordan nā, koni no abaptisile̱.

english_verse: But John kept objecting and said, “I ought to be baptized by you. Why have you come to me?”
translation_verse: Ši Iohane tšĩle̱ gbe ekē̱: Mi moṅ ní ehĩami ake̱ bo obaptisio̱mi le̱, ni bo obaä miṅõ ne̱?

english_verse: Jesus answered, “For now this is how it should be, because we must do all God wants us to do.” Then John agreed.
translation_verse: Ši Iesu here no̱ ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Kplẽmo̱ ke̱ke̱, ši ne̱ke̱ sa ake̱ wo̱gbeo̱ dšale̱ fẽ nā. Ke̱ke̱ ni ekplẽle̱.

english_verse: So Jesus was baptized. And as soon as he came out of the water, the sky opened, and he saw the Spirit of God coming down on him like a dove.
translation_verse: Ni beni abaptisi Iesu le̱, edše̱ nu le̱ mli amrō edše kpo; ni na, agble ṅwei nā ahãle̱, ni ena Nyoṅmo̱ Mumo̱ le̱ mīkpleke ši tamo̱ okpo ke̱-mība eno.

english_verse: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he went to Galilee.
translation_verse: Ši beni Iesu nu ake̱ *amõ Iohane le̱, eyiṅ ete Galilea; *

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet Isaiah had said,
translation_verse: koni gbalo̱ *Iesaia wiemo le̱ aba mli ake̱: *Ies.

english_verse: Right then the two brothers dropped their nets and went with him.
translation_verse: Ni amrõ le̱ ame̱šĩ ame̱yāi le̱, ni ame̱banyie ese̱.

english_verse: While Jesus was walking along the shore of Lake Galilee, he saw two brothers. One was Simon, also known as Peter, and the other was Andrew. They were fishermen, and they were casting their net into the lake.
translation_verse: Ši beni Iesu kpaä ši ye̱ Galilea ṅšo̱ le̱ nā le̱, ena nyemimei enyo̱, Simon ni atšé̱o̱le̱ Petro, ke̱ enyemi Andrea, ake̱ ame̱mīhe̱ ye̱ ṅšo̱ le̱ mli, edšake̱ wole̱i dšiame̱.

english_verse: Jesus walked on until he saw James and John, the sons of Zebedee. They were in a boat with their father, mending their nets. Jesus asked them to come with him.
translation_verse: Ni beni edše dše̱i eyaã le̱, ena nyemimei krokomei enye̱, Zebedeo bi Iakobo ke̱ enyemi Iohane ke̱ ame̱tše̱ Zebedeo ye̱ le̱le̱ mli mīkpe̱ ame̱yāi le̱; ni etšé̱ame̱,

english_verse: At once they left the boat and their father and went with Jesus. Jesus Teaches, Preaches, and Heals (Luke
translation_verse: Ni amrõ le̱ ame̱ hũ ame̱šì le̱le̱ le̱ ke̱ ame̱tše̱ le̱ ame̱banyie ese̱.

english_verse: Jesus went all over Galilee, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the good news about God's kingdom. He also healed every kind of disease and sickness.
translation_verse: Ni *Iesu kpa Galilea mū le̱ fẽ, etšõo̱ nii ye̱ ame̱kpēhei le̱, ni ešie̱o̱ maṅtše̱yeli le̱ he sanekpakpa le̱ etšõo̱, ni etšáa hela-fẽ-hela ke̱ hedšramo̱-fẽ-hedšramo̱ ye̱ mā le̱ṅ. *Mar.

english_verse: News about him spread all over Syria, and people with every kind of sickness or disease were brought to him. Some of them had a lot of demons in them, others were thought to be crazy, and still others could not walk. But Jesus healed them all.
translation_verse: Ni ehe sane dšidše ye̱ Siria fẽ, ni *ame̱ke̱ mei ni be̱ dšogbāṅ ní helai ke̱ pīmo̱i sro̱toi hĩeame̱ ke̱ mei ni daimonioi yo̱ ame̱mli ke̱ mei ní yeo̱ gbligbli ke̱ mei ní egbo̱dšo̱ ba eṅõ, ni etšáame̱. *Mar.

english_verse: Large crowds followed Jesus from Galilee and the region around the ten cities known as Decapolis. They also came from Jerusalem, Judea, and from across the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Ni *mei pī dše̱ Galilea ke̱ Dekapoli ke̱ Ierusalem ke̱ Iudea ke̱ Iordan se̱ nyie ese̱. *Mar.

english_verse: The earth is God's footstool, so don't swear by the earth. Jerusalem is the city of the great king, so don't swear by it.
translation_verse: alo šikpoṅ, ši enãdšiaši māṅō ni; alo Ierusalem, ši *maṅtše̱ agbo le maṅ ni. *Lal.

english_verse: Before you are dragged into court, make friends with the person who has accused you of doing wrong. If you don't, you will be handed over to the judge and then to the officer who will put you in jail.
translation_verse: Oke̱ obelo̱ le̱ atšá mrã, beni oke̱le̱ nyie gbe le̱; koni aleenõ obelo̱ le̱ akaṅõo ehã kodšolo̱ le̱ gbĩko, ni kodšolo̱ le̱ ṅõo ehã tšũlo̱ le̱, ni aṅõo awo tšũṅ.

english_verse: I promise you will not get out until you have paid the last cent you owe. Marriage
translation_verse: Le̱le̱ṅ, mīkē̱o ake̱: Odšeṅ dše̱i odšeṅ kpo ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní oowo nāgbē hĩeo le̱.

english_verse: You have been taught that a man who divorces his wife must write out divorce papers for her.
translation_verse: Asaṅ akē̱ ake̱: “Mofẽmo ní aaſie eṅã le̱ ehāle̱ ſiemo̱-wolo.”

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Don't use the Lord's name to make a promise unless you are going to keep it.”
translation_verse: Asaṅ nyenu ake̱, akē̱ blemabii le̱ ake̱: “Kākã amale kitã, ši ye okitãi le̱ ano̱ ohã Nuṅtšo̱ le̱.”

english_verse: When you make a promise, say only “Yes” or “No.” Anything else comes from the devil. Revenge (Luke
translation_verse: Ši nyehãa nyewiemo̱ afea: Hē̃, hē̃! dabi, dabi! ši nofẽno ní fè ene̱mei le̱ edše̱ mofõṅ le̱ṅ,

english_verse: You know you have been taught, “An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.”
translation_verse: Nyenu ake̱ akē̱: “Ake̱ hĩṅme̱i ato hĩṅme̱i nãdšiaṅ, nĩ ake̱ nyãnyõṅ ato nyãnyõṅ nãdšiaṅ.”

english_verse: But I tell you not to try to get even with a person who has done something to you. When someone slaps your right cheek, turn and let that person slap your other cheek.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, mīkē̱nye ake̱: Nyekakũa efõṅ le̱ nā; ši moṅ mofẽmo ní aagba oninedšŭrõ toiṅ le̱, tšṍ eko le̱ hũ ohãle. Ioh.

english_verse: If someone sues you for your shirt, give up your coat as well.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši moko tao ake̱ eke̱o aye sane ní ešõ oflaka le̱, hã eṅõ ohebo le̱ hũ.

english_verse: If a soldier forces you to carry his pack one kilometer, carry it two kilometers.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši moko aanyẽ ono̱ ake̱ oke̱le̱ anyie ṅmle̱tſā kome le̱, oke̱le̱ aya enyo̱.

english_verse: When people ask you for something, give it to them. When they want to borrow money, lend it to them. Love (Luke
translation_verse: Hã moni baäo le̱, ni moni taoo̱ ake̱ ofàle̱ le̱, kãtšṍ ohe ke̱-dše̱ eṅõ.

english_verse: You have heard people say, “Love your neighbors and hate your enemies.”
translation_verse: Nyenu ake̱, akē̱ ake̱: “Suomo̱ onanyo,” ni onye̱ ohenye̱lo̱.

english_verse: But I tell you to love your enemies and pray for anyone who mistreats you.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, mīkē̱nye ake̱: Nyesumo̱a *nyehenye̱lo̱i, nyedšō̱a mei ni lomoo̱nye, nyefea mei ní nye̱o̱nye le̱ ekpakpa, ni †nyeso̱lea nyehãa mei ní haoo̱nye ní ame̱waänye yi le̱; *

english_verse: Then you will be acting like your Father in heaven. He makes the sun rise on both good and bad people. And he sends rain for the ones who do right and for the ones who do wrong.
translation_verse: koni *nyetšṍmo̱ nyetše̱ ní yo̱ ṅwei le̱ bii; ši ehãa ehũlũ teo̱ ši ye̱ meifõdši ke̱ meikpakpai ano̱, ni ehãa nyoṅmo̱ ne̱o̱ ye̱ dšalo̱i ke̱ mei ní be dšale̱ le̱ ano̱. *Ef.

english_verse: If you love only those people who love you, will God reward you for this? Even tax collectors love their friends.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši nyesnmoo̱ mei ni sumoo̱nye le̱, mẽ nyõmo̱wo nyeyo̱? Ani ntōhelo̱i le̱ tete efee nakai noṅṅ?

english_verse: If you greet only your friends, what's so great about this? Don't even unbelievers do that?
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši nyeṅãa nyenyemimei ke̱ke̱ le̱, enyie noṅṅ nyefeo̱? Ani wo̱ṅdšálo̱i le̱ tete efee nakai noṅṅ?

english_verse: But you must always act like your Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ *nyehĩa ke̱-wulaä ši, tamo̱ bo̱ni nyetše̱ ni yo̱ ṅwei le̱ hĩ ke̱-wula ši le̱. *

english_verse: Don't be like them. Your Father knows what you need even before you ask.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyekatamo̱aame̱; ši *nyetše̱ le̱ le nii ní hĩaänye dãni nyebio̱le̱. *K.

english_verse: But if you don't forgive others, your Father will not forgive your sins. Worshiping God by Going without Eating
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši nyeke̱ mei atõmo̱i efaa-ame̱ le̱, nyetše̱ le̱ hũ ke̱ nyetõmo̱i le̱ efaṅnye. Mar.

english_verse: But more than anything else, put God's work first and do what he wants. Then the other things will be yours as well.
translation_verse: Ši nyetaoa *Nyoṅmo̱ maṅtše̱yeli le̱ ke̱ edšale̱ le̱ tšutšu, †ni ake̱ nii ne̱ fẽ aafata he ahãnye. *Rom.

english_verse: Don't worry about tomorrow. It will take care of itself. You have enough to worry about today.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyekahaoa nyehe nyetoa wó̱; edšake̱ wó̱ dientše̱ aahao ye̱ enii ahe. Gbĩ-fẽ-gbĩ no̱ efõṅ le̱ fá hãle̱. K.

english_verse: Instead, store up your treasures in heaven, where moths and rust cannot destroy them, and thieves cannot break in and steal them.
translation_verse: Ši nyeboa dſetrii nyehãa nyehe ye̱ ṅwei, heni omlẽgẽ ke̱ ṅkanale fitee nii ní dšulo̱i gbáá ame̱yadšuu ye̱ le.

english_verse: Your heart will always be where your treasure is. Light (Luke
translation_verse: Ši heni nyedſetri yo̱ le̱, dše̱ĩ nyetšuĩ aahĩ.

english_verse: But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark. If the light inside you is dark, you surely are in the dark. Money (Luke
translation_verse: ši ke̱dši ohĩṅme̱i no̱ tšee le̱, ogbomotšo mū le̱ aawo duṅ. Nohewo le̱, ke̱-dši la ni yo̱ omli le̱ dši duṅ le̱, té no duṅ le̱ aafá aha tēṅ!

english_verse: You cannot be the slave of two masters! You will like one more than the other or be more loyal to one than the other. You cannot serve both God and money. Worry (Luke
translation_verse: Moko nyẽṅ nuṅtšo̱mei enyo̱ asúmo̱; edšake̱ ekole̱ eenye̱ mokome ni eesumo̱ mokroko le̱; alo eekpe̱te̱ mokome he, ni eegbe mokroko le̱ he guo. Nyenyẽṅ Nyoṅmo̱ ke̱ mamona [niifále̱] nyesúmo̱. Luk.

english_verse: Don't worry and ask yourselves, “Will we have anything to eat? Will we have anything to drink? Will we have any clothes to wear?”
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyekahaoa nyehe nyekē̱a ake̱: Meni wo̱o̱ye, alo meni wo̱o̱nu, meni hũ wo̱o̱ṅõ-ha wo̱he?

english_verse: Look at the birds in the sky! They don't plant or harvest. They don't even store grain in barns. Yet your Father in heaven takes care of them. Aren't you worth much more than birds?
translation_verse: Nyekwe̱a ṅwei lofõdši le̱: ame̱dũũ nii, asaṅ ame̱kũũ, asaṅ ame̱buaa nā ame̱woo aboṅoi amli; ši nyetše̱ ní yo̱ ṅwei le̱ lè̱o̱ame̱ kẽ. Ani nyehũ āhũ fèame̱?

english_verse: Can worry make you live longer?
translation_verse: Ši nyeteṅ namo ke̱ yeyēyefemo̱ aanyẽ atšá eke̱le̱ nā ninetalo̱ kome?

english_verse: Why worry about clothes? Look how the wild flowers grow. They don't work hard to make their clothes.
translation_verse: Ni mẽhewo̱ nyefeo̱ yeyēye ye̱ atade hewo? Nyedſẽṅa ṅãno̱ fo̱fo̱ii le̱ ahe, bo̱ni ame̱kwẽo̱: ame̱tšun nii, asaṅ ame̱tšẽẽ kpā̃.

english_verse: But I tell you that Solomon with all his wealth wasn't as well clothed as one of them.
translation_verse: Ši mīkē̱nye ake̱, *Salomo ke̱ enumnyam le̱ fẽ tete, ewulaa tamo̱ ene̱mei ateṅ ekome. *

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. God will surely do even more for you! Why do you have such little faith?
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši ṅãno̱ dſe̱i ni ṅme̱ne̱ eye̱ ní wó̱ ni aṅõ-wo flõnõ mli le̱ ni Nyoṅmo̱ wulaä ne̱ke̱ le̱, efeṅ noni fè ene̱ ehãṅnye ni nyehemo̱-ke̱-yeli fáá le̱ lo?

english_verse: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father in heaven knows you need all of these.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nii ne̱ fẽ se̱ dšeṅmãdšiaṅbii le̱ dio̱. Ši nyetše̱ le̱ ni yo̱ ṅwei le̱ le ake̱ nii ne̱ fẽ he mīhĩanye.

english_verse: Would any of you give your hungry child a stone, if the child asked for some bread?
translation_verse: Alo nyeteṅ namo ni, ke̱dši ebi bile̱ abolo, ni eehãle̱ te̱?

english_verse: Anyone who hears and obeys these teachings of mine is like a wise person who built a house on solid rock.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, mofẽmo ni nuo̱ miwiemoi ne̱ ni eyeo̱ no̱ le̱, maṅõle̱ mato ṅālelo̱ ní mă étšũ ye̱ te̱sā no̱ le̱ he. K.

english_verse: You can tell what they are by what they do. No one picks grapes or figs from thornbushes.
translation_verse: Ame̱yibii le̱ nyeke̱-aleame̱. Ani atšeo̱ weinyibii ye̱ ṅmeitšei ano̱, alo atšeo̱ agbãmii ye̱ aklatii ano̱? Gal.

english_verse: A good tree produces good fruit, and a bad tree produces bad fruit.
translation_verse: Nakai noṅṅ tšo-fẽ-tšo ní dši ekpakpa le̱ woo̱ yibii kpakpai; ši tšo fõṅ woo̱ yibii fõdši.

english_verse: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot produce good fruit.
translation_verse: Tšo kpakpa nyẽẽ awo yibii fõdši, ni asaṅ tšo fõṅ nyẽẽ awo yibii kpakpai.

english_verse: Anyone who hears my teachings and doesn't obey them is like a foolish person who built a house on sand.
translation_verse: Ni mofẽmo ni nuo̱ miwiemo̱i ne̱ ni eyee no̱ le̱, aaṅõle̱ ato nū kwašia ní mã etšũ ye̱ šia no̱ le̱ he.

english_verse: Rain poured down, rivers flooded, and the winds blew and beat against that house. Finally, it fell with a crash.
translation_verse: Ni nyoṅmo̱ tue, ni fāi ba, ni kō̱yo̱ tſa, ni ame̱šimo̱ tšũ le̱, ni ewule, ni ewulemo̱ le̱ da. Ezek.

english_verse: But I will tell them, “I will have nothing to do with you! Get out of my sight, you evil people!” Two Builders (Luke
translation_verse: Ni no le̱ magba mli makē̱ame̱ ake̱: Mileenye kwrā, nyedšea mino̱ nyeyaä, nye mei ní nyetšuo nibii ní edšaa gbe̱!

english_verse: Rain poured down, rivers flooded, and winds beat against that house. But it was built on solid rock, and so it did not fall.
translation_verse: Ni nyoṅmo̱ tue, ni fāi ba, ni kō̱yo̱ tſa, ni ame̱šimo̱ tšũ le̱, ši ewulee; edšake̱ ato šiši ye̱ te̱sā no̱.

english_verse: When Jesus finished speaking, the crowds were surprised at his teaching.
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱, beni Iesu egbe wiemo̱i ne̱ ana le̱, *mei le̱ ahe dšõ amo̱he ye̱ eniitšõmo̱ le̱ hewo̱; *Mar.

english_verse: He taught them like someone with authority, and not like their teachers of the Law of Moses.

translation_verse: Ši ekaselo̱i le̱ ateṅ mokroko hũ kē̱-le̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, ṅmẽmi gbe̱ ní mayafũ mitše̱ dã.

english_verse: After Jesus had crossed the lake, he came to shore near the town of Gadara and started down the road. Two men with demons in them came to him from the tombs. They were so fierce that no one could travel that way.
translation_verse: Ni beni eba se̱ le̱ gbe̱ ye̱ Gergesibii ašikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱, mei enyo̱ ni daimonioi yo̱ ame̱mli ke̱le̱ bakpe, ame̱dše̱ gbohĩĩ afũhe le̱, ni ame̱hĩe ewo la tšṍ, bo̱ni moko nyẽẽ nakai gbe̱ le̱ no̱ atšṍ.

english_verse: While Jesus was still speaking, an official came and knelt in front of him. The man said, “My daughter has just now died! Please come and place your hand on her. Then she will live again.”
translation_verse: Beni ewieo̱ wiemo̱i ne̱ etšõo̱ame̱ le̱, na, onukpa ko ba bakotole̱ ekē̱: Mibiyō édše mli amrõ ne̱; ši ba ní obaṅõ onine oṅmẽ eno̱, ni ehĩe atsẽ.

english_verse: Jesus turned. He saw the woman and said, “Don't worry! You are now healed because of your faith.” At that moment she was healed.
translation_verse: Ši Iesu tšṍ ehe, ni beni enale̱ le̱ ekē̱: Biyō, hã otšui anyõ omli, ohemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ éhere oyiwala! Ni yō le̱ he wale ye̱ no ṅmle̱tſā le̱ no̱ noṅṅ.

english_verse: After Jesus had forced the demon out, the man started talking. The crowds were so amazed they began saying, “Nothing like this has ever happened in Israel!”
translation_verse: Ni beni efa daimonio le̱, mumui le̱ wie. Ni mei le̱ anā kpe̱ ame̱he ame̱kē̱: Anako ne̱ke̱ noko pẽṅ ye̱ Israel!

english_verse: Jesus answered: The friends of a bridegroom aren't sad while he is still with them. But the time will come when he will be taken from them. Then they will go without eating.
translation_verse: Ni Iesu kē̱ame̱ ake̱: Ani yōkpēmo̱ le̱ he bialo̱i le̱ aanyẽ aye ṅko̱mo̱ gbĩĩ abo̱ ni ayemforowu le̱ ke̱ame̱ yo̱ le̱? Ši gbĩĩ aaba momo, ní aaṅõ *ayemforowu le̱ ke̱-adše ame̱teṅ ke̱-ate, ni no dãni ame̱ahĩ ṅmä. *Ioh.

english_verse: No one uses a new piece of cloth to patch old clothes. The patch would shrink and tear a bigger hole.
translation_verse: Ši moko eṅõõ mamanā hē etáá atade momo; edšake̱ noni aṅõ-tá ní kũle̱ aṅõ-tšĩ flo̱ le̱, yeo̱ atade le̱, ni flo̱ le̱ lē̱o̱ moṅ fè tšutšu le̱. Ioh.

english_verse: She had said to herself, “If I can just touch his clothes, I will be healed.”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ekē̱ ye̱ emli ake̱: Ke̱dši miná *etade le̱ he mita ke̱ke̱ le̱, mihe aawami. *

translation_verse: Ni Iesu te ši ni eke̱ ekaselo̱i le̱ nyie ese̱.

english_verse: A woman who had been bleeding for twelve years came up behind Jesus and barely touched his clothes.
translation_verse: Ni na, yō ko nī he yeo̱ ko̱ láfo̱semo̱ afii nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱ le̱ badše ese̱gbe̱ eta etade nāmū le̱ he.

english_verse: But after the crowd had been sent out of the house, Jesus went to the girl's bedside. He took her by the hand and helped her up.
translation_verse: Ši beni aſie mei le̱, ete tšũ le̱ṅ, ni emo no nine ši, ni oblayō le̱ te ši.

english_verse: After Jesus had gone indoors, the two blind men came up to him. He asked them, “Do you believe I can make you well?” “Yes, Lord,” they answered.
translation_verse: Ši beni ebote šĩa le̱, ſilafoi le̱ ba eṅõ; ni Iesu biame̱ ake: Nyeheo̱ nyeyeo̱ ake̱ manyẽ ene̱ mafe lo? Ame̱kē̱le̱ ake: Hẽ, Nuṅtšo̱!

english_verse: Jesus touched their eyes and said, “Because of your faith, you will be healed.”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni etra ame̱hĩṅme̱ii le̱ ahe ni ekē̱: *Bo̱ni nyeheo̱ nyeyeo̱ le̱, áfe nakai ahãnye. *

english_verse: They were able to see, and Jesus strictly warned them not to tell anyone about him.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱hĩṅme̱ii le̱ gble. Ni Iesu bo̱ame̱ ko̱ko̱ ake: Nyekakwe̱a ní moko mile!

english_verse: But they left and talked about him to everyone in that part of the country. Jesus Heals a Man Who Could Not Talk

translation_verse: Moni bāa esusuma yi le̱, eelādšele̱; ni moni lādšeo̱ esusuma ye̱ mihewo̱ le̱, enine aaše̱ no̱. Luk.

translation_verse: Gbomobi le̱ ba, ní *eyeo̱ nii ni esā enuo̱ noko le̱, ame̱kē̱ ake̱: Na, nū fulo̱ ke̱ dā̃nulo̱, ntōhelo̱i ke̱ ešafelo̱i ašientše̱ ne̱! Ni abu nilē le̱ bem ye̱ ebii le̱ anā.

english_verse: When Jesus found out what was happening, he left there and large crowds followed him. He healed all of their sick,
