translation_verse: Ši yakatſā ame̱dšáami le̱, edšake̱ ame̱tšõo̱ tšõmo̱i ní dši gbomei akitãi.”

english_verse: Jesus did not say a word. But the woman kept following along and shouting, so his disciples came up and asked him to send her away.
translation_verse: Ši efoo edāṅ. Ni ekaselo̱i le̱ ba bakpale̱ fai, ni ame̱kē̱ ake̱: Wole̱ gbe̱ ní eya, ši ēblo̱ ke̱-mīnyie wo̱se̱!

english_verse: The food you put into your mouth doesn't make you unclean and unfit to worship God. The bad words that come out of your mouth are what make you unclean.”
translation_verse: Dšee noni *boteo̱ mo dāṅ le̱ buleo̱ gbomo; ši moṅ noni †dšeo̱ mo dāṅ le̱, no buleo̱ gbomo. *

english_verse: Then his disciples came over to him and asked, “Do you know you insulted the Pharisees by what you said?”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ekaselo̱i le̱ ba eṅõ ame̱bakē̱le̱ ake̱: Ole ake̱, beni Farisifoi le̱ nu ne̱ke̱ wiemo̱i ne̱, efeame̱ tāṅ?

english_verse: Peter replied, “What did you mean when you talked about the things that make people unclean?”
translation_verse: Ni Petro here no̱ ekē̱le̱ ake: Tšõmo̱wo̱ abe̱ ne̱ šiši!

english_verse: Jesus then said: Don't any of you know by now what I am talking about?
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱: Ani nye hũ nyeleko nii lolo?

english_verse: Don't you know that the food you put into your mouth goes into your stomach and then out of your body?
translation_verse: Ani nyekpako ši ake̱, nofẽno ní boteo̱ mo dāṅ le̱, mũsũṅ eyaä ni adšieo̱ awoo tiafi mli?

english_verse: But the words that come out of your mouth come from your heart. And they are what make you unfit to worship God.
translation_verse: Ši nii ní dše̱o̱ dāṅ dšeo̱ kpo le̱ tšui mli dše̱o̱, ni nomei buleo̱ mo le̱.

english_verse: Out of your heart come evil thoughts, murder, unfaithfulness in marriage, vulgar deeds, stealing, telling lies, and insulting others.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *tšui mli ni susumo̱i fõdši, gbomogbē, gblãfitemo̱i, adſamaṅbō̱i, dšūi, amale odaseyelii ke̱ musubō̱i dše̱o. *

english_verse: These are what make you unclean. Eating without washing your hands will not make you unfit to worship God. A Woman's Faith (Mark
translation_verse: Ene̱mei dši nii ní buleo̱ gbomo; ši dẽ ni afo̱o̱ dãni ayeo̱ nii le̱, no bulee mo. (

english_verse: Jesus said, “I was sent only to the people of Israel! They are like a flock of lost sheep.”
translation_verse: Ši ehere no̱ ekē̱: *Israel we tōi ní elādše le̱ aṅõ ke̱ke̱ atšũmi. *

english_verse: Large crowds came and brought many people who were paralyzed or blind or lame or unable to talk. They placed them, and many others, in front of Jesus, and he healed them all.
translation_verse: Ni asafoi pī ba eṅõ ame̱hĩe obubuafoi ke̱ ſilafoi ke̱ mumuii ke̱ kpadšelo̱i ke̱ meikrokomei pī; ni ame̱ke̱ame̱ baſie Iesu nādši anā; ni etšáame̱.

english_verse: Jesus left and went to the territory near the towns of Tyre and Sidon.
translation_verse: Ni Iesu dše dše̱i eyiṅ ete Tiro ke̱ Zidon niiaṅ.

english_verse: Suddenly a Canaanite woman from there came out shouting, “Lord and Son of David, have pity on me! My daughter is full of demons.”
translation_verse: Ni na, Kanaanyō ko ní dše̱ dše̱i niiaṅ noṅṅ bablo̱le̱ ekē̱: Nami mo̱bo̱, Nuṅtšo̱, David bi; mibiyō mina nõ ke̱ daimonio.

english_verse: The woman came closer. Then she knelt down and begged, “Please help me, Lord!”
translation_verse: Ši yō le̱ ba bakũla ši ye̱ ehĩe ekē̱: Nuṅtšo̱, femo̱ he eko ohãmi!

english_verse: Jesus replied, “It isn't right to take food away from children and feed it to dogs.”
translation_verse: Ši ehere no̱ ekē̱: Edšaa ake̱ aṅõo̱ bii abolo le̱ aše̱re̱o̱ aſieo̱ šifõdši abii.

english_verse: “Lord, this is true,” the woman said, “but even puppies get the crumbs that fall from their owner's table.”
translation_verse: Ši ekē̱: Nuṅtšo̱, eye̱ mli moṅ; ši be̱ šifõdšĩ abii le̱ hũ yeo̱ fufudšì ni ſieo̱ ame̱nuṅtšo̱mei akplõi le̱ ašisi le̱ eko!

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Dear woman, you really do have a lot of faith, and you will be given what you want.” At that moment her daughter was healed. Jesus Heals Many People
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱ Iesu here no̱ ekē̱le̱ ake̱: O yō, *ohemo̱-ke̱-yeli da! Afe ahão tamo̱ bo̱ni otaoo̱ le̱! Ni atšá ebiyō le̱ ye̱ no ṅmle̱tſā le̱ no̱ noṅṅ. *

english_verse: From there, Jesus went along Lake Galilee. Then he climbed a hill and sat down.
translation_verse: Ni *Iesu dše dše̱i eba Galilea ṅšo̱ le̱ nā. Ni ekwo̱ ete goṅ le̱ no̱ ni eyatá ši ye̱ dše̱i. *Mar.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed at what they saw and heard. People who had never spoken could now speak. The lame were healed, the paralyzed could walk, and the blind were able to see. Everyone was praising the God of Israel. Jesus Feeds Four Thousand (Mark
translation_verse: Ni asafoi le anā kpe̱ ame̱he, beni ame̱na ake̱ mumuii miwie ni kpadšelo̱i eye emū ni obubuafoi minyie ni ſilafoi mīna nii le̱; ni ame̱wo Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ hĩe nyam. Mar.

english_verse: Jesus called his disciples together and told them, “I feel sorry for these people. They have been with me for three days, and they don't have anything to eat. I don't want to send them away hungry. They might faint on their way home.”
translation_verse: Ši Iesu tšé̱ ekaselo̱i le̱ ke̱-ba ni ekē̱: *Mimũsũṅ mītšõmi ye̱ asafoi le̱ ahewo̱, ake̱ ṅmene̱ dši gbĩĩ ete ní ame̱ke̱mĩ ehĩi ši, ni ame̱be̱ noko ní ame̱yeo̱; ni misumo̱o̱ ake̱ miwoo̱ame̱ gbe̱ ke̱ hõmo̱, ni ekole̱ ame̱yato̱ö̱ biti ye̱ gbe̱ le̱ no̱. *

english_verse: His disciples said, “This place is like a desert. Where can we find enough food to feed such a crowd?”
translation_verse: Ni ekaselo̱i le̱ kē̱le̱ ake̱: Nẽgbe̱ wo̱baná aboloi ní pá pī ye̱ ṅã ne̱ no̱, bo̱ni aaše̱ asafo babaō ne̱ nā?

english_verse: Jesus asked them how much food they had. They replied, “Seven small loaves of bread and a few little fish.”
translation_verse: Ni Iesu biame̱ ake̱: Aboloi enyie nyeyo̱? Ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Kpawo, ke̱ lōi bibii fio ko.

english_verse: After Jesus had told the people to sit down,
translation_verse: Ni efã́ asafoi le̱ ake̱ ame̱trá ši ye̱ šikpoṅ.

english_verse: he took the seven loaves of bread and the fish and gave thanks. He then broke them and handed them to his disciples, who passed them around to the crowds.
translation_verse: Ni ekŏ̱lo̱ aboloi kpawo le̱ ke̱ lōi le̱, ni eda ši, ni ekũmo̱ mli ni eṅõ-hã ekaselo̱i le̱, ni ekaselo̱i le̱ ṅõ-hã asafoi le̱.

english_verse: Everyone ate all they wanted, and the leftovers filled seven large baskets.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱fẽ ame̱ye ni ame̱tŏ̱ro̱; ni ame̱kŏ̱lo̱ fufudši ní ſe̱ le̱ flo̱to̱i kpawo obõbõ.

english_verse: After Jesus had sent the crowds away, he got into a boat and sailed across the lake. He came to shore near the town of Magadan.
translation_verse: Ni ewo asafoi le̱ agbe̱, ni ebote le̱le̱ mlĩ, nĩ eba Magdala niiaṅ.

english_verse: Don't you know by now that I am not talking to you about bread? Watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees!
translation_verse: Té tēṅ ní nyenaa nā ake̱ dšee abolo hewo̱ ní mikē̱nye ake nyehĩe ahĩ nyehe no̱ ye̱ Farisifoi ke̱ Sadukifoi le̱ amãša le̱ hewo̱ le̱?

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples were near the town of Caesarea Philippi, he asked them, “What do people say about the Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Ši beni Iesu ba Kaisaria Filipi niiaṅ le̱, ebi ekaselo̱i le̱ ake̱: Namo mei kē̱o̱ ake̱ gbomobi le̱ dši?

english_verse: But if the sky is red and gloomy in the morning, you say it is going to rain. You can tell what the weather will be like by looking at the sky. But you don't understand what is happening now.
translation_verse: Ni lebi le̱ nyekē̱o̱ ake̱: Nme̱ne̱ nyoṅmo̱ bane̱; edšake̱ ṅwei etšu ni ehĩe eha. Osatofoi, nyele ṅwei hĩenibii amlibū, ši yino̱i le̱ ahe *okadii le̱ nyenyẽẽ nyebu lo?

english_verse: From then on, Jesus began telling his disciples what would happen to him. He said, “I must go to Jerusalem. There the nation's leaders, the chief priests, and the teachers of the Law of Moses will make me suffer terribly. I will be killed, but three days later I will rise to life.”
translation_verse: Ke̱-dše̱ no be le̱ no̱ noṅṅ ni Iesu bõi ekaselo̱i le̱ tšõmo̱ ake̱ dša ete Ierusalem ni eyana amanehũlũ pī ye̱ onukpai le̱ ke̱ oso̱fonukpai ke̱ woloṅmãlo̱i le̱ adeṅ, ni agbele̱, ní gbĩ ní dši gbĩ etẽ le̱ eete ši ekoṅ.

english_verse: The disciples talked this over and said to each other, “He must be saying this because we didn't bring along any bread.”
translation_verse: Ši ame̱wiewie he ye̱ ame̱teṅ ame̱kē̱: Abolo ní wo̱hĩee le̱ hewo̱ṅ!

english_verse: The Son of Man will soon come in the glory of his Father and with his angels to reward all people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ gbomobi le̱ baba ye̱ etše̱ anumnyam le̱ mli ke̱ ebo̱foi le̱; ni no mli le̱ *eewo mofẽmo nyõmo̱ ye̱ enitšumo̱ nā. *Rom.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples not to tell anyone he was the Messiah. Jesus Speaks about His Suffering and Death (Mark
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni etſa ekaselo̱i le̱ ana mã ake ame̱kakē̱ moko ake̱ le̱ dši Iesu, Kristo le̱.

english_verse: Peter took Jesus aside and told him to stop talking like that. He said, “God would never let this happen to you, Lord!”
translation_verse: Ni Petro tšé̱le̱ ke̱-te afã ebõile̱ ko̱-ko̱bō̱ ekē̱: Na ohe mo̱bo̱, Nuṅtšo̱, ene̱ akagbaleo fō̃ṅfõ!

english_verse: Jesus turned to Peter and said, “Satan, get away from me! You're in my way because you think like everyone else and not like God.”
translation_verse: Ši etšṍ ehe ekē̱ Petro ake̱: Ho mise̱, satan! õtõtõ minane: edšake̱ odſẽṅṅ Nyoṅmo̱ nii ahe, ši gbomei anii ahe moṅ odſẽṅo̱.

english_verse: Then Jesus said to his disciples: If any of you want to be my followers, you must forget about yourself. You must take up your cross and follow me.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iesu kē̱ ekaselo̱i le̱ ake̱: Ke̱dši moko mīsumo̱ ake̱ enyieo̱ mise̱ le̱, hã ní ekwa ehe ní ewó ese̱ṅmo̱tšo le̱ ní enyie mise̱.

english_verse: What will you gain, if you own the whole world but destroy yourself? What would you give to get back your soul?
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mẽ se̱ gbomo náa, ke̱dši enine še̱ dšeṅ mū le̱ fẽ no̱, ši elādše esusuma le̱? Alo meni gbomo aaṅō-hã ní eke̱kpõ esusuma le̱?

english_verse: I promise you some of those standing here will not die before they see the Son of Man coming with his kingdom.
translation_verse: Le̱le̱ṅ, mīkē̱nye ake̱: Meikomei ye̱ mei ní damo̱ bie̱ ne̱ ateṅ ní ame̱saṅ ame̱nā gbĕle ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní ame̱ana gbomobi le̱ miba ye̱ emaṅtše̱yeli le̱ mli.

english_verse: So Peter said to him, “Lord, it is good for us to be here! Let us make three shelters, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
translation_verse: Ni yadše Petro nā le̱, ekē̱ Iesu ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, ehĩ hãwo̱ ake̱ wo̱o̱hĩ bie̱; ke̱dši ōsumo̱ le̱, hã ní wo̱fe būi etẽ ye̱ bie̱, onõ ekome, ke̱ Mose nõ ekome, ke̱ Elia nõ ekome.

english_verse: But Jesus came over and touched them. He said, “Get up and don't be afraid!”
translation_verse: Ni Iesu ba ni ebatra amehe ekē̱: Nyetea ši, nyekašea gbeyei!

english_verse: When they opened their eyes, they saw only Jesus.
translation_verse: Ši beni ame̱hole ame̱hĩṅme̱ii ano̱ le̱, ame̱naa moko ake̱ dša Iesu kome pe̱.

english_verse: Jesus told them, “Elijah certainly will come and get everything ready.
translation_verse: Ši Iesu here no̱ ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Elia mība le̱le̱ṅ, ní ebato nibii fẽ gbe̱dšiano̱ ekoṅ.

english_verse: In fact, he has already come. But the people did not recognize him and treated him just as they wanted to. They will soon make the Son of Man suffer in the same way.”
translation_verse: Ši mīkē̱nye ake̱, Elia eba momo, ni ame̱yoole̱, ši moṅ *ame̱fele̱ nofẽno ní ame̱sumoo̱. Nakai noṅṅ gbomobi le̱ hũ bana amane ye̱ ame̱deṅ. *

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples returned to the crowd. A man knelt in front of him
translation_verse: Ni beni ame̱še̱ asafo le̱ ṅõ le̱, nū ko ba eṅõ, ni ebakũla ši ye̱ ehĩe,

english_verse: and said, “Lord, have pity on my son! He has a bad case of epilepsy and often falls into a fire or into water.
translation_verse: ni ekē̱: Nuṅtšo̱, na mibi le̱ mo̱bo̱, ši ēye gbligbli ni ēna nõ ní ehĩĩ; edšake̱ biane̱biane̱ eyagbe la mli, ni biane̱biane̱ eyagbe nu mli,

english_verse: Then Jesus spoke sternly to the demon. It went out of the boy, and right then he was healed.
translation_verse: Ni Iesu fã́ eyi, ni daimonio le̱ dše̱ emli dše kpo, ni gbekẽ le̱ he wale̱ ye̱ no ṅmle̱tſā le̱ no̱ noṅṅ.

english_verse: Later the disciples went to Jesus in private and asked him, “Why couldn't we force out the demon?”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iesu kaselo̱i le̱ ba eṅõ ye̱ afã, ni ame̱kē̱: Mẽba wo̱ le̱ wo̱nyẽẽle̱ wo̱fã le̱?

english_verse: While Jesus and his disciples were going from place to place in Galilee, he told them, “The Son of Man will be handed over to people
translation_verse: Ši beni ame̱kpaä Galilea le̱, Iesu kē̱ame̱ ake̱: Abaṅõ gbomobi le̱ awo gbomei adeṅ,

english_verse: who will kill him. But three days later he will rise to life.” All of this made the disciples very sad. Paying the Temple Tax
translation_verse: ni ame̱agbele̱, ni gbĩ ní dši gbĩ etẽ le̱ aatēle̱ ši ekoṅ. Ni edo̱ame̱ tšṍ.

english_verse: When Jesus and the others arrived in Capernaum, the collectors for the temple tax came to Peter and asked, “Does your teacher pay the temple tax?”
translation_verse: Ši beni ame̱ba Kapernaum le̱, oniatšũlo̱i le̱ ba Petro ṅõ ni ame̱babile̱ ake̱: Ani nyetšõlo̱ le̱ hãã *afi-onĩa le̱? *

english_verse: “Yes, he does,” Peter answered. After they had returned home, Jesus went up to Peter and asked him, “Simon, what do you think? Do the kings of this earth collect taxes and fees from their own people or from foreigners?”
translation_verse: Ekē̱: Ehãa. Ni beni eha šĩa le̱, Iesu tšṍ hĩe ekē̱: Té osusuo̱ tēṅ, Simon? šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ maṅtše̱mei le̱, namei adeṅ ame̱heo̱ ntō lo onĩa ye̱? ye̱ ame̱dientše̱ ame̱bii adeṅ alo meikpõdšĩ adeṅ?

english_verse: Peter answered, “From foreigners.” Jesus replied, “Then their own people don't have to pay.
translation_verse: Petro kē̱le̱ ake̱: Ye̱ meikpõdši adeṅ. Iesu kē̱le̱ ake̱: Bĕle̱ bii le̱ yeo̱ ame̱he mo̱.

english_verse: But we don't want to cause trouble. So go cast a line into the lake and pull out the first fish you hook. Open its mouth, and you will find a coin. Use it to pay your taxes and mine.”
translation_verse: Ši beni afe ní wo̱katšṍ ame̱nā le̱, ya ṅšo̱ le̱ nā oyafõ kpoṅ, ni lō kleṅkleṅ ní aabako̱ kpoṅ le̱, šale̱, ni ké̱ ogbe̱ edāṅ le̱, oona šika ni nā šio̱, yii enyo̱; ko̱ ni oṅõ-hãame̱, ohāmi ke̱o fẽ.

english_verse: Don't you think you should show pity to someone else, as I did to you?”
translation_verse: ani kũle̱ dšee ho hũ ogbe̱nā dši ake̱ ona onanyo-tšũlo̱ le̱ mo̱bo̱, bo̱ni mi hũ minao mo̱bo̱ le̱?

english_verse: I promise you God in heaven will allow whatever you allow on earth, but God will not allow anything you don't allow.
translation_verse: Le̱le̱ṅ, mīkē̱nye ake̱: Nofẽno ní nyeafĩ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱, aafĩ ye̱ ṅwei; ni nofẽno ní nyeafẽne ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱, aafẽne ye̱ ṅwei.

english_verse: I promise that when any two of you on earth agree about something you are praying for, my Father in heaven will do it for you.
translation_verse: Asaṅ mīkē̱nye ake̱, ke̱dši nyeteṅ mei enyo̱ kpã gbē ye̱ šikpoṅ ne̱ no̱ ye̱ sane-fẽ-sane ní ame̱bio̱ le̱ he le̱, mitše̱ ní yo̱ ṅwei le̱ aafe ahãame̱. Mar.

english_verse: Peter came up to the Lord and asked, “How many times should I forgive someone who does something wrong to me? Is seven times enough?”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Petro ba eṅõ ni ebakē̱: Nuṅtšo̱, šii enyie minyemi atõ mino̱ ní miṅõ-fale̱? ke̱-yaši šii kpawo lo?

english_verse: As he was doing this, one official was brought in who owed him
translation_verse: Ni beni ebõi bū le̱, ake̱ moko ní hĩele̱ nyõmo̱ talentai akpei-nyoṅma ba eṅõ.

english_verse: But he didn't have any money to pay what he owed. The king ordered him to be sold, along with his wife and children and all he owned, in order to pay the debt.
translation_verse: Ši ake̱-ní ebe̱ noko ní eke̱-awole̱ le̱, enuṅtšo̱ le̱ fã́ ake̱ ahõle̱ ke̱ eṅã ke̱ ebii ke̱ nii fẽ ní eyo̱, ní aṅõ-wo nyõmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: The king felt sorry for him and let him go free. He even told the official that he did not have to pay back the money.
translation_verse: Ni tšũlo̱ ne̱ nuṅtšo̱ le̱ mũsũṅ tsõle̱ ni eṅmē̃ ehe, ni eke̱ nyõmo̱ le̱ kele̱.

english_verse: But as this official was leaving, he happened to meet another official, who owed him
translation_verse: Ši nakai tšũlo̱ le̱ dše kpo eyana enanemei tšũdši le̱ ateṅ mokome ní hĩele̱ nyõmo̱ denarioi oha; nĩ emõle̱ emĩa esẽ, ni ekē̱: Womi nyõmo̱ ní ohĩemi le̱!

english_verse: The man got down on his knees and began begging, “Have pity on me, and I will pay you back.”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni enanyotšũlo̱ le̱ ho kũla ši ekpale fai ekē̱: To otšui ši ohãmi, ni mawoö nyõmo̱ le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: But the first official refused to have pity. Instead, he went and had the other official put in jail until he could pay what he owed.
translation_verse: Ši le̱ le̱ ekplẽẽ; ši moṅ eyawule̱ tšũṅ ke̱-yaši beyino ní eewole̱ nyõmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: When some other officials found out what had happened, they felt sorry for the man who had been put in jail. Then they told the king what had happened.
translation_verse: Ši beni enanemei-tšũdši le̱ na noni afe le̱, edo̱ame̱ tšṍ ni ame̱bagba ame̱nuṅtšo̱ le̱ noni afe le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: The king called the first official back in and said, “You're an evil man! When you begged for mercy, I said you did not have to pay back a cent.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni enuṅtšo̱ le̱ hã ayatšé̱le̱ ke̱-ba ni ekē̱le̱ ake: Tšũlo̱ fõṅ! ake̱-ní okpami fai hewo̱ le̱ miṅõ ne̱ke̱ nyõmo̱ ne̱ fẽ mikeo;

english_verse: The king was so angry that he ordered the official to be tortured until he could pay back everything he owed.
translation_verse: Ni enuṅtšo̱ le̱ mli fũ, ni ehã apĩle̱ *ke-yaši beyino ní eebawole nyõmo le fẽ.

english_verse: That is how my Father in heaven will treat you, if you don't forgive each of my followers with all your heart.
translation_verse: Nakai noṅṅ mitše̱ ní yo̱ ṅwei le̱ hũ aaṅõ-fenye, ke̱dši nyeteṅ mofẽmo eṅõõ enyemi notõmo̱ ekeele̱ ke̱-dše̱e̱ etšuĩṅ le̱.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Don't you know in the beginning the Creator made a man and a woman?
translation_verse: Ni ehere no̱ ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Ani nyekaneko ake̱, moni bo̱ gbomo ye̱ šišidšē le̱ṅ le̱, “nū ke̱ yō ebo̱ame̱”?

english_verse: Jesus replied, “You are so heartless! That's why Moses allowed you to divorce your wife. But from the beginning God did not intend it to be that way.

translation_verse: Ni beni asafoi le̱ nu ene̱ le̱, amehe dšõ ame̱he ye̱ etšõmo̱ le̱ hewo̱. (

english_verse: After Jesus had made the Sadducees look foolish, the Pharisees heard about it and got together.
translation_verse: Ši beni Farisifoi le̱ nu ake̱ ekũ Sadukifoi le̱ anā le̱, ame̱babua ame̱he nā ye̱ hekome;

english_verse: “Teacher, what is the most important commandment in the Law?”
translation_verse: Tšõlo̱, té noni dši mla le̱ mli kitã wuluṅ?

english_verse: This is the first and most important commandment.
translation_verse: Kitãi le̱ amli otu ke̱ ewulu ne̱.

english_verse: The second most important commandment is like this one. And it is, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Ni noni nyie se̱ le̱ tamo̱ no, ake̱: *“Suomo̱ onanyo tamo̱ bo̱ni osumoo̱ bodientše̱ ohe,” *

english_verse: While the Pharisees were still there, Jesus asked them,
translation_verse: Ni beni Farisifoi le̱ anā ekpe ši le̱, Iesu biame̱ ake̱:

english_verse: ‘The Lord said to my Lord: Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.’
translation_verse: *“Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ kē̱ mi-Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ ake̱: Tá mininedšŭrõ no̱ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní ma-ṅõ ohenye̱lo̱i le̱ mafe onãdšiaši mãṅō?” Lal.

english_verse: “What do you think about the Messiah? Whose family will he come from?” They answered, “He will be a son of King David.”
translation_verse: Té nyesusuo̱ ye̱ Kristo le̱ hewo̱ tēṅ? Namo bi dšile̱? Ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: David biṅ.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “How then could the Spirit lead David to call the Messiah his Lord? David said,
translation_verse: Ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Mẽba mo̱ ni David ye̱ Mumo̱ nā le̱ etšé̱o̱le̱ Nuṅtšo̱ ni ekē̱o̱ ake̱:

english_verse: If David called the Messiah his Lord, how can the Messiah be a son of King David?”
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ ke̱ dši David tšé̱le̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱, té tēṅ ni edši ebi moṅ?

english_verse: No one was able to give Jesus an answer, and from that day on, no one dared ask him any more questions.
translation_verse: Ni moko nyẽẽle̱ hetõ ko ahã, ni asaṅ ke̱-dše̱ no gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ moko ekaale̱ noko bimo̱ doṅṅ.

english_verse: If you put yourself above others, you will be put down. But if you humble yourself, you will be honored.
translation_verse: Ní mofẽmo ní aawo ebe no̱ le̱, aabale̱ ši; ni mofẽmo ní aaba ehe ši le̱, aawó eno̱. Abe̱i

english_verse: And now your temple will be deserted.
translation_verse: Na, aašĩ nyewe le̱ amaṅfõ ahãnye!

english_verse: Whoever is the greatest should be the servant of the others.
translation_verse: Ši moni dši agbo ye̱ nyeteṅ le̱, etšṍ nyetšũlo̱.

english_verse: Jerusalem, Jerusalem! Your people have killed the prophets and have stoned the messengers who were sent to you. I have often wanted to gather your people, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings. But you wouldn't let me.
translation_verse: *Ierusalem, Ierusalem, bo moni ogbeo̱ gbalo̱i le̱ ní otſiaä mei ní atšũo̱ame̱ oṅõ le̱ ate̱i: šii enyie mitao ake̱ kũle̱ mibuaä obii anā tamo̱ boni wuo̱ buaä ebii anā ewoo efĩdši ašiši le̱, ni nyekplẽẽ! *Luk.

english_verse: None of you should be called the leader. The Messiah is your only leader.
translation_verse: Asaṅ akatšé̱nye nuṅtšo̱mei hũ; edšake̱ mokome dši nyenuṅtšo̱, le̱ dši Kristo.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You are supposed to lead others, but you are blind. You teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the temple. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gold in the temple.
translation_verse: Kpóo hã *nye, gbe̱tšõlo̱i ſilafoi! nye mei ní nyekē̱o̱ ake̱: “Moni aakã so̱lemo̱tšũ le̱ kitã le̱, no dšee noko; ši moni aakã so̱lemo̱tšũ le̱ be šika le̱ kitã le̱, etẽresõ.” *

english_verse: You blind fools! Which is greater, the gold or the temple that makes the gold sacred?
translation_verse: Kwašiai ke̱ ſilafoi! té noni fèṅ, šika le̱, alo so̱lemo̱tšũ le̱ ní hãa šika le̱ feo̱ kroṅkroṅ le̱?

english_verse: Are you blind? Which is more important, the gift or the altar that makes the gift sacred?
translation_verse: Kwašiai ke̱ ſilafoi! té noni fèṅ, afo̱le le̱, alo afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ ni hãa afo̱le le̱ feo̱ kroṅkroṅ le̱?

english_verse: To swear by heaven is the same as swearing by God's throne and by the one who sits on that throne.
translation_verse: Ni moni kãa ṅwei kitã le̱, ekã Nyoṅmo̱ sẽi le̱ ke̱ moni tá no̱ le̱ hũ kitã.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You wash the outside of your cups and dishes, while inside there is nothing but greed and selfishness.
translation_verse: Kpṍo hã nye, woloṅmãlo̱i ke̱ Farisifoi, osatofoi! ake̱-ní nyetšumoo̱ kpulu he ke̱ kã se̱; ši ame̱mligbe̱ eyimo̱ obõbõ ke̱ odšotſā ke̱ adufudeyeli. Mar.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You're like tombs that have been whitewashed. On the outside they are beautiful, but inside they are full of bones and filth.
translation_verse: Kpóo hã nye, woloṅmãlo̱i ke̱ Farisifoi, osatofoi! ake̱-ní nyetamo̱ *gbohĩĩ asãṅi ní aša he ni ame̱hewo̱ efe fe̱o moṅ, ši ame̱mligbe̱ le̱ eyimo̱ obõbõ ke̱ gbohĩĩawui ke̱ mũdši sro̱toi fẽ. *Bo̱f.

english_verse: That's what you are like. Outside you look good, but inside you are evil and only pretend to be good.
translation_verse: Nakai noṅṅ anaä nye hũ ye̱ gbomei ahĩe tamo̱ dšalo̱i, ši osato ke̱ mlatõmo̱ eyi nyemli obõ.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are nothing but show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You build monuments for the prophets and decorate the tombs of good people.
translation_verse: Kpóo hã nye, woloṅmãlo̱i ke̱ Farisifoi, osatofoi! nyemãmoo̱ gbaloi le̱ agbohĩĩabui ni nyewulaä dšalo̱i le̱ asãṅi le̱,

english_verse: And you claim you would not have taken part with your ancestors in killing the prophets.
translation_verse: ni nyekē̱o̱ ake̱: Edši wo̱tše̱mei ayino̱ le̱ wo̱ye̱ dšeṅ kũle̱, wo̱fataṅ ame̱he ní aſie gbaloi le̱ alá ši.

english_verse: But you prove you really are the relatives of the ones who killed the prophets.
translation_verse: Bĕle̱ nyedientše̱ nyemīye nyehe odase ake̱ mei ní gbe gbalo̱i le̱ abii dšinye. Bo̱f.

english_verse: So keep on doing everything they did.
translation_verse: Nye hũ nyewoa nyetše̱mei le̱ atšenesa le̱ obõ mo̱!

english_verse: You are nothing but snakes and the children of snakes! How can you escape going to hell?
translation_verse: *Onũfũi, šikpãi aſīei! Té nyeafe tēṅ nyedšo gehena fo̱bũ le̱ nā foiṅ? *

english_verse: You won't see me again until you say, “Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mīkē̱nye ake̱: Ke̱-dše̱ be ne̱ no̱ ke̱-yaä ne̱ nyenaṅmi doṅṅ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní nyeakē̱ ake̱: *Adšō̱ moni baä ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ gbe̱i ano̱ le̱! *

english_verse: And pray that you won't have to escape in winter or on a Sabbath.
translation_verse: Ši nyeso̱lea, koni nyefoĩdšē le̱ akaba ye̱ fẽibe le̱ mli alo ye̱ *hedšō̱mo̱gbī le̱ no̱. *Bo̱f.

english_verse: If God doesn't make the time shorter, no one will be left alive. But because of God's chosen ones, he will make the time shorter.
translation_verse: Ni ké̱ afoo no gbĩĩ le̱ ano̱ kpitiō le̱, kũle̱ ahereṅ helo ko helo ko yiwala; ši mei ni ahala le̱ ahewo̱ le̱ aafo no gbĩĩ le̱ ano̱ kpitiō.

english_verse: So when you see all these things happening, you will know the time has almost come.
translation_verse: Nakai noṅṅ nye hũ, beni nyeana nii ne̱ fẽ le̱, nyelea ake̱ eše̱ agbói le̱ anā etã.

english_verse: When the Son of Man appears, things will be just as they were when Noah lived.
translation_verse: Ši bo̱ni Noa gbĩĩ le̱ fe le̱, nakai gbomobi le̱ bā le̱ hũ batamo̱.

english_verse: People were eating, drinking, and getting married right up to the day the flood came and Noah went into the big boat.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo̱ni yo̱ ye̱ gbĩĩ ní nyie nuafua le̱ hīe le̱ amli, ni mei le̱ hīe niyeli ke̱ ninumo̱ ke̱ yōw̌ē̱ ke̱ gblãhãmo̱ mli āhũ ke̱-yaši gbĩ ní Noa yabote adeka le̱ mli,

english_verse: Two men will be in the same field, but only one will be taken. The other will be left.
translation_verse: No mli le̱ mei enyo̱ aahĩ ṅmõšĩ, aaṅõ mokome, ni aasĩ mokroko le̱. Luk

english_verse: Two women will be together grinding grain, but only one will be taken. The other will be left.
translation_verse: Mei enyo̱ aaw̌ie̱ ye̱ w̌ie̱ se̱; aaṅõ mokome, ni aašĩ mokroko le̱.

english_verse: So be on your guard! You don't know when your Lord will come.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyesraä, edšake̱ nyelee nõ ṅmle̱tſā no̱ ní nyenuṅtšo̱ le̱ baä.

english_verse: Homeowners never know when a thief is coming, and they are always on guard to keep one from breaking in.
translation_verse: Ši nyenáa nyelea ake̱, *ké̱ šĩatše̱ ko le nõ ṅmle̱tſā no̱ ní dšulo̱ baä le̱, kũle̱ eesra ni eṅmẽṅ gbe̱ ní agbu ewe le̱ awoṅ. *Luk.

english_verse: Always be ready! You don't know when the Son of Man will come. Faithful and Unfaithful Servants (Luke
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nye hũ nyesãa nyehe nyetoa, edšake̱ nõ ṅmle̱tſā ní nyesusuu le̱ no̱ gbomobi le̱ baä. Kpods.

english_verse: But suppose one of the servants thinks the master won't return until late.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši nakai tšũlo̱ fõṅ le̱ aake ye̱ etšui mli ake̱: Minuṅtšo̱ le̱ mītši ebabe le̱ ēto; Dsads.

english_verse: Who are faithful and wise servants? Who are the ones the master will put in charge of giving the other servants their food supplies at the proper time?
translation_verse: Bĕle̱ namo dši tšũlo̱ ano̱kwafo ke̱ nilele̱ mo̱ ní enuṅtšo̱ ṅõle̱ eto ewebii le̱ ano̱, koni ehãame̱ ame̱ṅmā̃ ye̱ be ní sa no̱ le̱?

english_verse: Servants are fortunate if their master comes and finds them doing their job.
translation_verse: Adšō̱ nakai tšũlo̱ le̱, moni beni enuṅtšo̱ baä le̱, ní eebaninale̱ ake̱ ēfe nakai le̱.

english_verse: Suppose this evil servant starts beating the other servants and eats and drinks with people who are drunk.
translation_verse: ni eebõi enanemei-tšũdši le̱ yī, ni eke̱ dā̃to̱lo̱i le̱ aaye ni eke̱ame̱ aanu le̱:

english_verse: If that happens, the master will surely come on a day and at a time when the servant least expects him.
translation_verse: nakai tšũlo̱ le̱ nuṅtšo̱ le̱ aaba ye̱ gbĩ no̱ ni ekwe̱e̱le̱ gbe̱ ke̱ ṅmle̱tſā no̱ ní elee,

english_verse: This servant will then be punished and thrown out with the ones who only pretended to serve their master. There they will cry and grit their teeth in pain.
translation_verse: ni eetsere̱ emli ni eehãle̱ egbe̱fãṅnõ ye̱ osatofoi le̱ ateṅ. *Dše̱i yāfó ke̱ nyãnyõdši ašišikpemo̱ aahĩ. *

english_verse: The ones who were wise took along extra oil for their lamps.
translation_verse: Ši nilelo̱i le̱ ṅõ mũ wo ame̱to̱i amli ame̱fata ame̱kanei le̱ ahe.

english_verse: Those who were wise answered, “There's not enough oil for all of us! Go and buy some for yourselves.”
translation_verse: Ši nilelo̱i le̱ here no̱ ame̱kē̱: Ekole̱ ebaše̱ṅ wo̱ke̱nye fẽ; ši moṅ nyeyaä mei ní hõo̱ le̱ aṅõ nyeyahea eko nyehãa nyehe.

english_verse: “Wonderful!” his master replied. “You are a good and faithful servant. I left you in charge of only a little, but now I will put you in charge of much more. Come and share in my happiness!”
translation_verse: Enuṅtšo̱ le̱ kē̱le̱ ake̱: *Ahekō, tšũlo̱ kpakpa ke̱ ano̱kwafo, oye ano̱kwa ye̱ nii fio he, mahã oye nii pī atše̱: botemo̱ onuṅtšo̱ mīše̱ le̱ mli. *K.

english_verse: I was frightened and went out and hid your money in the ground. Here is every single coin!”
translation_verse: ni no hã miše gbeyei, ni mite mike̱ otalenta le̱ yatē šikpoṅ; na onii.

english_verse: The master of the servant told him, “You are lazy and good-for-nothing! You know I harvest what I don't plant and gather crops where I haven't scattered seed.
translation_verse: Ši enuṅtšo̱ le̱ here no̱ ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Tšũlo̱ fõṅ ke̱ anihaolo̱l ní ole ake̱ mikpaä nii ye̱ heni midũko noko ye̱ ni mibuaä nii anã ye̱ heni miſãko noko ye̱ le̱,

english_verse: You are a worthless servant, and you will be thrown out into the dark where people will cry and grit their teeth in pain.” The Final Judgment
translation_verse: Ni tšũlo̱ ni he be̱ se̱námo̱ ko ne̱, *nyetšiale̱ nyewoa gbe̱se̱ duṅ le̱ mli; dše̱i yāfó ke̱ nyãnyõdši ašišikpemo̱ aahĩ! *

english_verse: When the Son of Man comes in his glory with all his angels, he will sit on his royal throne.
translation_verse: Ši beni gbomobi le̱ aaba ye̱ enumnyam le̱ mli, ni bo̱foi kroṅkroṅi le̱ fẽ aafata ehe le̱, no mli le̱ eetá enumnyam sẽĩ le̱ no̱;

english_verse: The people of all nations will be brought before him, and he will separate them, as shepherds separate their sheep from their goats.
translation_verse: ni *aabua dšeṅmãdši le̱ fẽ nā ye̱ ehĩe, ni eegbla ame̱mli, take̱ bo̱ni tōkwe̱lo̱ gblaã gwanteṅi ke̱ abotiai amli le. *Rom.

english_verse: He will place the sheep on his right and the goats on his left.
translation_verse: Ni eeṅõ gwanteṅi le̱ edamo eninedšŭrõ no̱, ši abotiai le̱, eeṅõame̱ edamo ebe̱ku no̱. Ezek.

english_verse: Then the king will say to those on his right, “My father has blessed you! Come and receive the kingdom that was prepared for you before the world was created.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱ maṅtše̱ le̱ aakē̱ mei ní yo̱ eninedšŭrõ no̱ le̱ ake̱: Nyebaä, nye mei ní mitše̱ edšō̱nye, nyebaṅõa maṅtše̱yeli le̱ nĩ asa atonye ke̱-dše̱ dšeṅ šĩšĩdšē le̱!

english_verse: When I was hungry, you gave me something to eat, and when I was thirsty, you gave me something to drink. When I was a stranger, you welcomed me,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ hõmo̱ yemi, ni nyehãmi nii miye; kũmai yemi, ni nyehãmi nu minu; gbo̱ dšimi, ni nyehã mibato nyeṅõ; Ies.

english_verse: Then the ones who pleased the Lord will ask, “When did we give you something to eat or drink?
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱ dšalo̱i le̱ aaherele̱ no̱ ame̱akē̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, té gbĩ ní wo̱nao ake̱ hõmo̱ mīyeo, ni wo̱hão nii oyeṅ? alo ake̱ kũmai mīyeo, ni wo̱hão noko onuṅ?

english_verse: When did we welcome you as a stranger or give you clothes to wear
translation_verse: Ni té gbĩ ní wo̱nao ake̱ gbo̱ dsio, ni wo̱hã obato wo̱ṅõ? alo ake̱ onyie yayai ni wo̱woö atadeṅ?

english_verse: or visit you while you were sick or in jail?”
translation_verse: Asaṅ té gbĩ ní wo̱nao ake̱ ohe miye alo awoõ tšũṅ, ni wo̱ba oṅõṅ?

english_verse: The king will answer, “Whenever you did it for any of my people, no matter how unimportant they seemed, you did it for me.”
translation_verse: Ni maṅtše̱ le̱ aahere no̱ ekē̱ame̱ ake: Le̱le̱ṅ, mīkē̱nye ake̱: Gbĩĩabo̱ kẽ ní nyefe nyehã minyemimei ne̱ ateṅ bibiō kome le̱, mi noṅṅ nyefe nyehã le̱. Abe̱i

english_verse: Then the king will say to those on his left, “Get away from me! You are under God's curse. Go into the everlasting fire prepared for the devil and his angels!
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱ eekē̱ mei ní yo̱ ebe̱ku no̱ le̱ hũ ake̱: Nyedšea mino̱, nye mei ní alomo̱nye, nyeyaä nāno̱ la le̱ ni asā ato abonsam ke̱ ebo̱foi le̱ mli!

english_verse: I was hungry, but you did not give me anything to eat, and I was thirsty, but you did not give me anything to drink.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ hõmo̱ yemi, ni nyehããmi nii maye; kũmai yemi, ni nyehããmi nu manu;

english_verse: I was a stranger, but you did not welcome me, and I was naked, but you did not give me any clothes to wear. I was sick and in jail, but you did not take care of me.”
translation_verse: gbo̱ dšimi, ni nyehãã mabato nyeṅõ; minyie yayai, ni nyewoomi atade; mihe ye ni asaṅ awomi tšũṅ, ni nyebasraami.

english_verse: Then the people will ask, “Lord, when did we fail to help you when you were hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in jail?”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱ ame̱ hũ ame̱aherele̱ no̱ ame̱-akē̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, té gbĩ ní wo̱nao ake̱ hõmo̱ mīyeo alo kũmai mīyeo alo gbo̱ dsio alo onyie yayai alo ohe miye alo awoö tšũṅ, ni wo̱basúmo̱o̱oṅ?

english_verse: The king will say to them, “Whenever you failed to help any of my people, no matter how unimportant they seemed, you failed to do it for me.”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱ eehereame̱ no̱ eekē̱ ake̱: Le̱le̱ṅ, mīkē̱nye ake̱: Gbĩĩabo̱ kẽ ní nyefee nyehãã mei bibii kwrā ne̱ ateṅ mokome le̱, nyefee nyehããmi hũ!

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “Those people will be punished forever. But the ones who pleased God will have eternal life.”
translation_verse: Ni mene̱mei le̱, ame̱ate nāno̱ hedšramo̱ mli; ši dšalo̱i le̱ aate nāno̱ wala mli. Ioh.

english_verse: Finally, Jesus returned to his disciples and said, “Are you still sleeping and resting? The time has come for the Son of Man to be handed over to sinners.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni eba ekasele̱i le̱ aṅõ, ni ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nye le̱ nyehe edšo̱nye ni nyewoo ne̱? na, ṅmle̱tſā le̱ eše̱ etã, ni aaṅõ gbomobi le̱ awo ešafelo̱i adeṅ.

english_verse: During the meal Jesus took some bread in his hands. He blessed the bread and broke it. Then he gave it to his disciples and said, “Take this and eat it. This is my body.”
translation_verse: Ši beni ame̱yeo̱ nii le̱, Iesu ko̱ abolo, ni edšō̱ no̱ ni ekũmo̱ mli, ni eṅõ-hã ekaselo̱i le̱, ni ekē̱: Nyehea, nyeyea! ene̱ dši migbomotšo le̱.

english_verse: From now on I am not going to drink any wine, until I drink new wine with you in my Father's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Ši mīkē̱nye ake̱: Ke̱-dše̱ ene̱ no̱ ke̱-yaä ne̱ minuṅ weintšo yibii ne̱ eko doṅṅ, ke̱-yaši gbĩ no̱ ní mike̱nye aanule̱ ehē ye̱ mitše̱ maṅtše̱yeli le̱ mli le̱.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I promise you before a rooster crows tonight, you will say three times that you don't know me.”
translation_verse: Iesu kē̱le̱ ake̱: Le̱le̱ṅ, mīkē̱o ake̱: Nyō ne̱ṅ noṅṅ, dãni wuo̱ aagbe̱ le̱, ookpá ye̱ mise̱ šii etẽ. Ioh.

english_verse: Jesus went with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane. When they got there, he told them, “Sit here while I go over there and pray.”
translation_verse: Agbene̱ Iesu ke̱ame̱ ba heko ní atšé̱o̱ dše̱i Getsemane; ni ekē̱ ekaselo̱i le̱ ake̱: Nyetráa ši ye̱ bie̱, koni maya mayaso̱le ye̱ dše̱i.

translation_verse: Ni eyahe klala, ni ebadšiele̱ ke̱-kpleke ši, ni eṅõ klala le̱ eha ehe, ni eṅõle̱ eyaṅmẽ gbonyobu ní akpe̱ ye̱ te̱sā mli le̱ṅ, ni ekoklo te̱ eke̱-ṅã́ bu le̱ nā.

english_verse: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joseph were watching and saw where the body was placed.
translation_verse: Ni Maria Magdalēna ke̱ Maria, Iose nye le̱, yakwe̱ heni akele yaṅmẽ le̱.

english_verse: Later, Jesus appeared in another form to two disciples, as they were on their way out of the city.
translation_verse: Nii ne̱ ase̱ le̱ edšie ehe kpo ye̱ su kroko mli etšõ ame̱teṅ mei enyo̱, beni ame̱yaä šišĕramo̱ ye̱ ṅãno̱ le̱. Luk.

english_verse: Then the disciples left and preached everywhere. The Lord was with them, and the miracles they worked proved that their message was true. ANOTHER OLD ENDING TO MARK'S GOSPEL
translation_verse: Ši ame̱ le̱ ame̱dše kpo ni ame̱yašie̱ ye̱ hefẽhe, ni Nuṅtšo̱ lo̱ ke̱ame̱ *mītšu nii ni ewo wiemo̱ le̱ hewale̱ ke̱ okadii ni nyie ee̱ le̱. *Heb.

english_verse: They will handle snakes and will drink poison and not be hurt. They will also heal sick people by placing their hands on them. Jesus Returns to Heaven (Luke
translation_verse: *ame̱ahole onũfũi; ni ke̱dši ame̱nu noko ní gbeo̱ mo le̱, efeṅame̱ efõṅ ko; †ame̱aṅõ ame̱nidši ame̱ſie helatše̱mei ano̱, ni ame̱he aawaame̱. *Luk.

english_verse: But when these disciples told what had happened, the others would not believe either. What Jesus' Followers Must Do (Matthew
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ hũ ame̱yiṅ ame̱te ame̱yakē̱ mei ni eſe̱ le̱, ši ame̱hee nomei hũ tete ame̱yee. (

english_verse: After the Lord Jesus had said these things to the disciples, he was taken back up to heaven where he sat down at the right side of God.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱ beni Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu ke̱ame̱ ewie se̱ le̱, aṅõle̱ ke̱-te ṅwei, ni *eyatá Nyoṅmo̱ ninedšŭrõ no̱. *Lal.

english_verse: Everyone who believes me will be able to do wonderful things. By using my name they will force out demons, and they will speak new languages.
translation_verse: Ši okadii ní aanyie mei ní heo̱ yeo̱ le̱ ase̱ ne̱: Migbe̱i ano̱ le̱ *ame̱afãmo̱ daimonioi; †ame̱awie wiemoi hēi; *Bo̱f.

english_verse: Your son will be a great servant of the Lord. He must never drink wine or beer, and the power of the Holy Spirit will be with him from the time he is born.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ eetšõ agbo ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ hĩe; ni enuṅ wein lo dā̃ ní wa ko, ni Mumo̱ kroṅkroṅ aayi emli obõ ke̱-adše̱ enye mũsũṅ bēbe. Kods.

english_verse: The angel answered, “I am Gabriel, God's servant, and I was sent to tell you this good news.
translation_verse: Ni bo̱fo le̱ to he ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Midsi *Gabriel ní damoo̱ †Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe le̱, ni atšũmi ake̱ mike̱o abawie ní migbao sanekpakpa ne̱. *Dan.

english_verse: Mary was confused by the angel's words and wondered what they meant.
translation_verse: Ši beni enale̱ le̱, etšui fã ye̱ ewiemo̱ le̱ he, ni edſẽṅ nõ ṅãmo̱ ní dši ene̱.

english_verse: Then the angel told Mary, “Don't be afraid! God is pleased with you,
translation_verse: Ni bo̱fo le̱ kē̱le̱ ake̱: Kāše gbeyei, Maria; edšake̱ ohĩe eba nyam ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe.

english_verse: He will be great and will be called the Son of God Most High. The Lord God will make him king, as his ancestor David was.
translation_verse: Eetšṍ agbo, ni aatšé̱le̱ Ṅweinyo le̱ bi, ni Nuṅtšo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ aaṅõ *etše̱ David maṅtše̱sẽi le̱ ahãle̱. *

english_verse: He will rule the people of Israel forever, and his kingdom will never end.”
translation_verse: Ni eeye Iakob we le̱ no̱ maṅtše̱ ke̱-ate nāno̱, ni emaṅtše̱yeli le̱ se̱ efoṅ.

english_verse: The angel answered, “The Holy Spirit will come down to you, and God's power will come over you. So your child will be called the holy Son of God.
translation_verse: Ni bo̱fo le̱ to he ekē̱le̱ ake̱: *Mumo̱ kroṅkroṅ aaba ono̱, ni Ṅweinyo le̱ hewale̱ aabaha ono̱, nohewo̱ le̱ nakai bi kroṅkroṅ le̱ hũ ní oofo̱ le̱, aatšé̱le̱ Nyoṅmo̱ bi. *Mat.

english_verse: Your relative Elizabeth is also going to have a son, even though she is old. No one thought she could ever have a baby, but in three months she will have a son.
translation_verse: Ši na, owekunyo Elisabet le̱ hũ, ená binū mũsũ ye̱ egbo̱le̱ mli, ni moni atšé̱o̱le̱ kene le̱ ená nyõdši ekpa.

english_verse: Nothing is impossible for God!”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nokonoko be̱ ní Nyoṅmo̱ nyẽṅ afe.

english_verse: Mary said, “I am the Lord's servant! Let it happen as you have said.” And the angel left her. Mary Visits Elizabeth
translation_verse: Ni Maria kē̱: Na, Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ weyō dšimi; ába mli ahãmi ye̱ owieme̱ le̱ nā! Ni bo̱fo le̱ šĩle̱ ete.

english_verse: A short time later Mary hurried to a town in the hill country of Judea.
translation_verse: Ni Maria te ši yiṅ ye̱ nakai gbĩĩ le̱ amli oyá ke̱-te Iuda maṅ ko mli ye̱ gōdši le̱ ano̱,

english_verse: She went into Zechariah's home, where she greeted Elizabeth.
translation_verse: ni eyabote Zakaria we le̱ ni eṅã Elisabet.

english_verse: When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, her baby moved within her. The Holy Spirit came upon Elizabeth.
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱, beni Elisabet nu Maria ṅãmo̱ le̱, abifao le̱ tũ *ye̱ emũsũṅ; ni Mumo̱ kroṅkroṅ yi Elisabet mli obõ; *K.

english_verse: Why should the mother of my Lord come to me?
translation_verse: Ni nẽgbe̱ ene̱ dše̱ bahãmi ní mi-Nuṅtšo̱ nye baä miṅõ ne̱?

english_verse: As soon as I heard your greeting, my baby became happy and moved within me.
translation_verse: Ši na, amrõ pe̱ ní oṅãmo̱ gbē le̱ gbe̱ ye̱ mitoiṅ le̱, abifao le̱ ke̱ mliflimo̱ tũmo̱ ye̱ mimũsũṅ.

english_verse: The Lord has blessed you because you believed that he will keep his promise. Mary's Song of Praise
translation_verse: Ni *adsō̱o, bo moni ohe oye ake̱ wiemo̱i ní adše̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ ṅõ abakē̱o̱le̱ aaba mli le̱. *

english_verse: Mary said: With all my heart I praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Ni Maria kē̱: Misusuma mīkafo Nuṅtšo̱ le̱,

english_verse: and I am glad because of God my Savior.
translation_verse: ni mimumo̱ mli mīflile̱ ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱, miwalaherelo̱ le̱, hewo̱,

english_verse: God cares for me, his humble servant. From now on, all people will say God has blessed me.
translation_verse: ake̱ *ebakwe̱ eweyō hũmi ni dši le̱ le̱. Edšake̱ na, ke̱-dše̱ ṅme̱ne̱-gbī-ne̱ no̱ le̱ yino̱i le̱ fẽ †aadšō̱mi: *Lal.

english_verse: God All-Powerful has done great things for me, and his name is holy.
translation_verse: edšake̱ Ofe le̱ éfe nii wudši éhãmi; ni kroṅkroṅ dši egbe̱i le̱,

english_verse: He always shows mercy to everyone who worships him.
translation_verse: ni emo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱ ye̱ mei ní šeo̱le̱ gbeyei le̱ ane̱ ke̱-yaši yino̱i ayino̱i. Lal.

english_verse: The Lord has used his powerful arm to scatter those who are proud.
translation_verse: Eke̱ enine etšu hewale̱-nitšumo̱; mei ní woo̱ amehe ye̱ ame̱tšuiṅ dſẽṅmo̱ mli le̱ egbe̱ame̱ eſã.

english_verse: God drags strong rulers from their thrones and puts humble people in places of power.
translation_verse: Ekpa odšei ke̱-dše ame̱sẽii ano̱, ni ewó mei ní dši hũmii le̱ ano̱. Lal.

english_verse: God gives the hungry good things to eat, and sends the rich away with nothing.
translation_verse: Ehā hõmo̱wo̱lo̱i etŏ̱ro̱ ke̱ nii kpakpai, ni henálo̱i le̱, eſieame̱ eflo. Lal.

english_verse: God helps his servant Israel and is always merciful to his people.
translation_verse: Eye ebaa ewenū Israel, koni ekai emo̱bo̱nale̱i le̱,

english_verse: The Lord made this promise to our ancestors, to Abraham and his family forever!
translation_verse: take̱ bo̱ni ekē̱ wo̱tše̱mei le̱, ehã Abraham ke̱ esešibii le̱ ke̱-ya nāno̱.

english_verse: Mary stayed with Elizabeth about three months. Then she went back home. The Birth of John the Baptist
translation_verse: Ni Maria ke̱le̱ hī ši aafe nyõdši etẽ, ni ekũ ese̱ ete emaṅ.

english_verse: When Elizabeth's son was born,
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ Elisabet fo̱mo̱be se̱, ni efo̱ binū.

english_verse: her neighbors and relatives heard how kind the Lord had been to her, and they too were glad.
translation_verse: Ni ekū le̱ṅ bii ke̱ ewekumei le̱ nu ake̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ énale̱ mo̱bo̱ babaō, ni ame̱ke̱le̱ nyã́.

english_verse: Eight days later they did for the child what the Law of Moses commands. They were going to name him Zechariah, after his father.
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱, gbĩ ní dši gbĩ *kpānyo̱ le̱ ameba gbekẽ le̱ ketiafō, ni ame̱ṅõ etše̱ gbe̱i Zakaria le̱ ame̱wole̱. *

english_verse: The people argued, “No one in your family has ever been named John.”
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ke̱le̱ ake̱: Moko be̱ oweku le̱ mli ní atšé̱o̱le̱ nakai!

english_verse: So they motioned to Zechariah to find out what he wanted to name his son.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ke̱ amenine fe okadi bi etše̱ boni esumoo̱ ake̱ atšé̱le̱.

english_verse: Zechariah asked for a writing tablet. Then he wrote, “His name is John.” Everyone was amazed.
translation_verse: Ni ebi tāo fiō ko, ni eṅmã ake̱: Iohane dši egbe̱i. Ni efe ame̱fẽ nākpe̱.

english_verse: At once, Zechariah started speaking and praising God.
translation_verse: Ni amrō le̱ noṅṅ le̱ enabu gble ni elile̱i fẽne, ni ewie edšie Nyoṅmo̱ yi.

english_verse: All the neighbors were frightened because of what had happened, and everywhere in the hill country people kept talking about these things.
translation_verse: Ni gbeyei mõmo̱ ame̱kū le̱ṅ bii le̱ fẽ, ni agba sãdši ne̱ fẽ ye̱ Iudea gõdši le̱ fẽ no̱.

english_verse: Everyone who heard about this wondered what this child would grow up to be. They knew the Lord was with him. Zechariah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Ni mei fẽ ní nu le̱ ṅõ-to ame̱tšuiṅ ame̱kē̱: Meni po gbekẽ ne̱ batšṍ? Edšake̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ nine kã ehe.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit came upon Zechariah, and he began to speak:
translation_verse: Ni etše̱ Zakaria mli yi obõ ke̱ Mumo̱ kroṅkroṅ, ni egba ekē̱:

english_verse: Praise the Lord, the God of Israel! He has come to save his people.
translation_verse: Adšō̱ Nuṅtšo̱, Israel Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, ake̱ *ebasra emaṅ le̱, ni etšu kpõmo̱nii ehãame̱. *

english_verse: Our God has given us a mighty Savior from the family of David his servant.
translation_verse: ni etē walaheremo̱ aklonto ši ehãwo̱ ye̱ ewenū David we le̱, Lal.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord promised by the words of his holy prophets
translation_verse: take̱ bo̱ni ewie ye̱ egbalo̱i kroṅkroṅi ní yo̱ ke̱-dše̱ blema bēbe le̱ anā le̱;

english_verse: to save us from our enemies and from everyone who hates us.
translation_verse: ake̱ eehere wo̱yiwala ke̱-adše̱ wo̱henye̱lo̱i ke̱ mei fẽ ní he tšẽo̱wo̱ le̱ adeṅ;

english_verse: God said he would be kind to our people and keep his sacred promise.
translation_verse: ni ena wo̱tše̱mei le̱ amo̱bo̱, ní ekai ekpãṅmo̱ kroṅkroṅ le̱,

english_verse: He told our ancestor Abraham
translation_verse: kitã ní ekã wo̱tše̱ Abraham le̱,

english_verse: that he would rescue us from our enemies. Then we could serve him without fear,
translation_verse: ake̱ eeba adšiewo̱ ye̱ wo̱henye̱lo̱i adeṅ ni wo̱súmo̱le̱ ni gbeyeišeme̱ ko be̱ mli Tit.

english_verse: by being holy and good as long as we live.
translation_verse: ye̱ hetšemo̱ ke̱ dšale̱ mli ye̱ ehĩe wo̱gbĩĩ abo̱ fẽ.

english_verse: You, my son, will be called the prophet of God Most High. You will go ahead of the Lord to get everything ready for him.
translation_verse: Ni bo, gbekẽ ne̱, aatšé̱o Ṅweifloflonyo le̱ gbalo̱; edšake̱ obatšṍ *Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ hĩe ní oyasā egbe̱i le̱ oto, Mat.

english_verse: You will tell his people that they can be saved when their sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: koni oṅõ walaheremo̱ he nilē ohã emaṅ le̱ ye̱ amehe ešai fā mli, Ier.

english_verse: God's love and kindness will shine upon us like the sun that rises in the sky.
translation_verse: ye̱ wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ mo̱bo̱nale̱ ní hãa emũsũṅ tšõo̱le̱ le̱ nā noni hã dšetše̱remo̱ ní dše̱ ṅwei le̱ ebasrawo̱ ne̱,

english_verse: On us who live in the dark shadow of death this light will shine to guide us into a life of peace.
translation_verse: koni dšeṅ atše ahã mei ní trá duṅ ke̱ gbĕle hō̃ṅ mli le̱, ni atšṍmo̱ wo̱nãdši ke̱-ya hedšo̱le̱ gbe̱ le̱ no̱. Ies.

english_verse: As John grew up, God's Spirit gave him great power. John lived in the desert until the time he was sent to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ni gbekẽ le̱ bada, ni ehe wa ye̱ mumo̱ mli, ni ehī *ṅã le̱ no̱ ke̱-yaši gbĩ no̱ ní aṅõle̱ atšõ Israel. *Mat.

english_verse: At this time a man named Simeon was living in Jerusalem. Simeon was a good man. He loved God and was waiting for him to save the people of Israel. God's Spirit came to him
translation_verse: Ni na, nū ko ye̱ Ierusalem ní atšé̱o̱le̱ ake̱ Simeon, ni nakai nū le̱ dšalo̱ dšile̱ ni ešeo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ gbeyei, ēkwe̱ *Israel mīše̱dšemo̱ le̱ gbe̱, ni Mumo̱ kroṅkroṅ ye̱ eno. *Ies

english_verse: This very day in King David's hometown a Savior was born for you. He is Christ the Lord.
translation_verse: ake̱ ṅme̱ne̱ áfo̱ walaherelo̱ ní dši Kristo, Nuṅtšo̱ le̱, ahãnye, ye̱ David mã le̱ṅ.

english_verse: After the angels had left and gone back to heaven, the shepherds said to each other, “Let's go to Bethlehem and see what the Lord has told us about.”
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake, beni bo̱foi le̱ édše ame̱ṅõ ete ṅwei le̱, tōkwe̱lo̱i le̱ hũ kē̱kē̱ ame̱he ake̱: Nyehãa wo̱yaä Betlehem ko, ni wo̱yakwe̱a sane ní eba ní Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ édšie ētšõwo̱ ne̱.

english_verse: As the shepherds returned to their sheep, they were praising God and saying wonderful things about him. Everything they had seen and heard was just as the angel had said.
translation_verse: Ni tōkwe̱lo̱i le̱ kũ ame̱se̱, ni ame̱wo Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe nyam, ni ame̱dšie eyi ye̱ nibii fẽ-kwa ní amenu ni ame̱na le̱ hewo̱, tamo̱ boni agbaame̱ le̱.

english_verse: The time came for Mary and Joseph to do what the Law of Moses says a mother is supposed to do after her baby is born. They took Jesus to the temple in Jerusalem and presented him to the Lord,
translation_verse: Ni beni agbe ame̱hetšūmo̱-gbĩĩ le̱ anā ye̱ *Mose mla le̱ nā le̱, ame̱ke̱le̱ te Ierusalem, koni ake̱le̱ ayatšõ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱, *

english_verse: The Law of the Lord also says parents have to offer a sacrifice, giving at least a pair of doves or two young pigeons. So that is what Mary and Joseph did.
translation_verse: ni ame̱yašã afo̱le, tamo bo̱ni akē̱ ye̱ *Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ mla le̱ mli ake̱: “Kose̱-okpoi enyo̱ alo šia-okpoi bibii enyo̱”. *

english_verse: When Mary and Joseph brought Jesus to the temple to do what the Law of Moses says should be done for a new baby, the Spirit told Simeon to go into the temple.
translation_verse: Ni Mumo̱ le̱ nā le̱ eba so̱lemo̱we le̱. Ni beni gbekẽ Iesu le̱ fo̱lo̱i le̱ ke̱le̱ ba koni ame̱bafe bo̱ni dši mla le̱ gbe̱nā le̱ ame̱hãle̱ le̱,

english_verse: Simeon took the baby Jesus in his arms and praised God,
translation_verse: ke̱ke̱ ni ehele̱ efõ ekpo̱ko̱iaṅ, ni edšō̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ni ekē̱:

english_verse: “Lord, I am your servant, and now I can die in peace, because you have kept your promise to me.
translation_verse: Agbene hã otšũlo̱ aya, Owura, ye̱ owiemo̱ le̱ nā, ye̱ hedšo̱le̱ mli;

english_verse: and foreign nations will also see this.
translation_verse: noni osā omã mãdši fẽ ahĩe le̱,

english_verse: Your mighty power is a light for all nations, and it will bring honor to your people Israel.”
translation_verse: la ní aatẽdše dšeṅmãdši le̱ ahĩe ni eewo omaṅ Israel hĩe nyam le̱, Ies.

english_verse: Jesus' parents were surprised at what Simeon had said.
translation_verse: Ni etše̱ ke̱ enye nā kpe̱ ame̱he ye̱ nii ní awie ye̱ ehewo̱ le̱ ahe.

english_verse: Then he blessed them and told Mary, “This child of yours will cause many people in Israel to fall and others to stand. The child will be like a warning sign. Many people will reject him,
translation_verse: Ni Simeon dsō̱ame̱ ni ekē̱ enye Maria ake̱: Na, ake̱ mone̱ edamo̱ ši ehã mei pī *ašigbẽmo̱ ke̱ šitē ye̱ Israel, ke̱ okadi ní awieo̱ ašio̱; *Ies.

english_verse: The prophet Anna was also there in the temple. She was the daughter of Phanuel from the tribe of Asher, and she was very old. In her youth she had been married for seven years, but her husband died.
translation_verse: Ni gbalo̱yō ko ni atšé̱o̱le̱ Hana ye̱, ní dši Fanuel biyō ní dše̱ Ašer akutšo le̱ṅ, ni egbo̱ naakpa, ni eke̱ ewù ehĩ ši afii kpawo ke̱-dše̱ eblayeiaṅ,

english_verse: At this time Anna came in and praised God. She spoke about the child Jesus to everyone who hoped for Jerusalem to be set free. The Return to Nazareth
translation_verse: Le̱ hũ eba ye̱ nakai ṅmle̱tſā le̱ mli noṅṅ, ni ebadšie Nyoṅmo̱ yi, ni ewie ye̱ ehewo̱ etšõ mei fẽ ní kwe̱o̱ Ierusalem *kpõmo̱ le̱ gbe̱ le̱. *Ies.

english_verse: After Joseph and Mary had done everything that the Law of the Lord commands, they returned home to Nazareth in Galilee.
translation_verse: Ni beni ame̱gbe nii le̱ fẽ nā ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ mla le̱ nā le̱, ame̱kũ ame̱se̱ ke̱-te Nazaret, ame̱dientše̱ ame̱mã le̱ṅ ye̱ Galilea.

english_verse: The child Jesus grew. He became strong and wise, and God blessed him. The Boy Jesus in the Temple
translation_verse: Ni gbekẽ le̱ bada, ni ehe wa ye̱ mumo̱ mli, ni eyi obõ ke̱ nilē, ni Nyoṅmo̱ dromo̱ ye̱ eno. K.

english_verse: Every year Jesus' parents went to Jerusalem for Passover.
translation_verse: Ši dā afi le̱ efo̱lo̱i le̱ *yaä Ierusalem, ame̱yayeo̱ Hehō gbīdšŭrõ. *

english_verse: And when Jesus was twelve years old, they all went there as usual for the celebration.
translation_verse: Ni beni eye afii nyonma ke̱ enyo le̱, ame̱te Ierusalem take̱ bo̱ni gbĩdšŭrõyeli le̱ gbe̱nā yo̱ le̱.

english_verse: After Passover his parents left, but they did not know that Jesus had stayed on in the city.
translation_verse: Ni beni ame̱gbe *gbĩĩ le̱ anā ní ame̱kũo̱ ame̱se̱ ekoṅ le̱, gbekẽ Iesu le̱ kpe se̱ ye̱ Ierusalem, ni efo̱lo̱i le̱ lee. *

english_verse: They thought he was traveling with some other people, and they went a whole day before they started looking for him.
translation_verse: Ši ame̱susuo̱ ake̱ efutu asafo le̱ ke̱-te, ni amenyie gbĩ kome gbe̱ ame̱taole̱ ye̱ ame̱wekumei ke̱ ame̱nanemei le̱ ateṅ.

english_verse: Three days later they found Jesus sitting in the temple, listening to the teachers and asking them questions.
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱ gbĩĩ etẽ se̱ le̱ ame̱yanale̱ ye̱ so̱lemo̱we le̱, ní etá ši ye̱ tšõlo̱i le̱ ateṅ ēboame̱ toi ni ēbibīame̱ nii.

english_verse: Everyone who heard him was surprised at how much he knew and at the answers he gave.
translation_verse: Ni mei fẽ ní boo̱le̱ toi le̱ nā kpe̱ ame̱he ye̱ enilē ke̱ ehetōi ni ehāa le̱ ahewo̱.

english_verse: When his parents found him, they were amazed. His mother said, “Son, why have you done this to us? Your father and I have been very worried, and we have been searching for you!”
translation_verse: Ni beni ame̱nale̱ le̱, ame̱he dšõ ame̱he, ni enye kē̱le̱ ake̱: Mibi, mẽba ofewe̱ ke̱ke̱? Na, mike̱ otše̱ etaoö ke̱ aw̌ere̱hō.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Why did you have to look for me? Didn't you know that I would be in my Father's house?”
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Mẽba ni nyetaoo̱mi? Ani nyelee ake̱ esami ake̱ mihĩo̱ ši ye̱ nii ní dši *mitše̱ nõ le̱ mli? *Ioh.

english_verse: But they did not understand what he meant.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱nuu wiemo̱ ní eke̱ame̱ wie le̱ šiši.

english_verse: Jesus went back to Nazareth with his parents and obeyed them. His mother kept on thinking about all that had happened.
translation_verse: Ni eke̱ame̱ yiṅ ke̱-te Nazaret, ni eba ehe ši ehãame̱. Ni enye *ṅō ne̱ke̱ wiemoi ne̱ fẽ eto etšui mli. *K.

english_verse: Jesus became wise, and he grew strong. God was pleased with him and so were the people.
translation_verse: Ni Iesu te ehĩe ye̱ nilē ke̱ dale̱ ke̱ dromo̱ mli ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ke̱ gbomei ahĩe.

english_verse: When tax collectors came to be baptized, they asked John, “Teacher, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Ni ntōhelo̱i hũ ba ní abaptisiame̱, ni ame̱kē̱le̱ ake: Tšŏlo̱, meni wo̱fe?

english_verse: But to Herod the ruler, he said, “It was wrong for you to take Herodias, your brother's wife.” John also said Herod had done many other bad things.
translation_verse: Ši tetrarke Herode le̱, ake̱-ni Iohane kãle̱ ye̱ enyemi Filipo ṅã Herodia le̱ hewo̱, ke̱ nifõdšianii fẽ ní le̱ Herode le̱ efe le̱ hewo̱ le̱, Mat.

english_verse: Melchi, Addi, Cosam, Elmadam, Er,
translation_verse: Melki bi, Adi bi, Kosam bi, Elmadam bi, Er bi,

english_verse: Crowds of people came out to be baptized, but John said to them, “You bunch of snakes! Who warned you to run from the coming judgment?
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ekē̱ asafoi le̱ ní ba eṅõ ní ebaptisiame̱ le̱ ake̱: *Šikpãi aſĩei, namo wie tšõnye ake̱ nyédšo mlifũ ní baä le̱ nā foi? *Mat.

english_verse: John said, “I am just baptizing with water. But someone more powerful is going to come, and I am not good enough even to untie his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
translation_verse: Iohane here no̱ ni ekē̱ mei le̱ fẽ ake̱: Mi le̱ nu mike̱-baptisio̱nye; ši moko ní he wa fèmi mība, ni mīsaa moni fẽneo̱ etokotai anā kpã, le̱ eke̱ Mumo̱ kroṅkroṅ ke̱ la aabaptisinye;

english_verse: Finally, Herod put John in jail, and this was the worst thing he had done. The Baptism of Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: esā efe ene̱ eši no̱, ake̱ emõ Iohane ewo tšūṅ. (

english_verse: Enosh, and Seth. The family of Jesus went all the way back to Adam and then to God.
translation_verse: Enos bi, Set bi, Adam bi, ní dši Nyoṅmo̱ nõ le̱.

english_verse: After the sun had set, people with all kinds of diseases were brought to Jesus. He put his hands on each one of them and healed them.
translation_verse: Ni beni hũlũ nyo ši le̱, mei fẽ ní yo̱ mei ní helai sro̱toi hĩeame̱ le̱ ke̱ame̱ ba eṅõ; ni eṅõ enidši eſie ame̱fẽ ame̱no̱ ekomekome ni etšáame̱.

english_verse: He taught in the Jewish synagogues, and everyone praised him. The People of Nazareth Turn against Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Ni etšõ nii ye̱ ame̱kpēhei le̱, ni mei le̱ fẽ wo ehīe nyam. (

english_verse: Jesus went back to Nazareth, where he had been brought up, and as usual he went to the synagogue on the Sabbath. When he stood up to read from the Scriptures,
translation_verse: Ni eba Nazaret, heni alè̱le̱ ye̱ le̱, ni take̱ bo̱ni efo̱ö̱ femo̱ le̱, ete kpēhe le̱ ye̱ hedšō̱mo̱gbĩ le̱ no̱, ni ete ši koni ekane wolo.

english_verse: Jesus closed the book, then handed it back to the man in charge and sat down. Everyone in the synagogue looked straight at Jesus.
translation_verse: Ni ekota wolo le̱ eṅõ-hã súolo̱ le̱, ni eho etá ši, ni mei fẽ ní yo̱ kpēhe le̱ tšũ ame̱hĩṅme̱ii ame̱ſie eno̱.

english_verse: All the people started talking about Jesus and were amazed at the wonderful things he said. They kept on asking, “Isn't he Joseph's son?”
translation_verse: Ni mei fẽ yele̱ odase, ní ame̱hĩe feame̱ yā ye̱ dromo̱-wiemo̱i ní dše̱ enā le̱ hewo̱, ni ame̱kē̱: *Ani dšee Iosef bi le̱ ne̱? *Ioh.

english_verse: Jesus answered: You will certainly want to tell me this saying, “Doctor, first make yourself well.” You will tell me to do the same things here in my own hometown that you heard I did in Capernaum.
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Befiābe ní fe le̱ nyeaṅõ ne̱ke̱ abe̱ ne̱ nyebumi ake̱: “Tšofãtše̱, tšá bodientše̱ ohe!” Nii abo̱ ní wo̱nu ake̱ ofe ye̱ *Kapernaum le̱, femo̱ ye̱ bie̱ ní dši omaṅ le̱ hũ. *Mat.

english_verse: But you can be sure that no prophets are liked by the people of their own hometown.
translation_verse: Ši ekē̱: Le̱le̱ṅ, mīkē̱nye ake̱: *Gbalo̱ ko sane eṅõõ ye̱ le̱dientše̱ emaṅ. *Ioh.

english_verse: Once during the time of Elijah there was no rain for three and a half years, and people everywhere were starving. There were many widows in Israel,
translation_verse: Ši mīkē̱nye ano̱kwale ake̱: Okũlafoi pī ye̱ Israel ye̱ *Elia yino̱ le̱, be mli ní aṅã ṅwei nā afii etẽ ke̱ nyõdši ekpa soṅṅ ni hõmo kple ba šikpoṅ le̱ fẽ no̱ le̱; *

english_verse: but Elijah was sent only to a widow in the town of Zarephath near the city of Sidon.
translation_verse: ši atšũũ Elia ke̱-yaa ame̱teṅ mokomoko ṅõ, ake̱ dša yō okũlafo ko ní yo̱ Zarefat ye̱ Zidon šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱.

english_verse: During the time of the prophet Elisha, many men in Israel had leprosy. But no one was healed, except Naaman who lived in Syria.
translation_verse: Ni kpitiyelo̱i pī ye̱ Israel ye̱ gbalo̱ Eliša yino̱ le̱, ni atšáá ame̱teṅ mokomoko, ake̱ dša *Naeman, Sirianyo le̱. *

english_verse: But Jesus slipped through the crowd and got away. A Man with an Evil Spirit (Mark
translation_verse: Ši etšṍ ame̱teṅ ke̱-ho, ni eyiṅ ete. (

english_verse: Jesus went to the town of Capernaum in Galilee and taught the people on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Ni eba *Kapernaum, Galilea maṅ le̱ mli, ni etšõame̱ nii ye̱ hedšō̱mo̱gbĩĩ le̱ ano̱, *Mat.

english_verse: His teaching amazed them because he spoke with power.
translation_verse: ni *ame̱nā kpe̱ ame̱he ye̱ enitšõmo̱ le̱ hewo̱; edšake̱ ewiemo̱ le̱ mli ye̱ hewale̱. *Mat.

english_verse: There in the synagogue was a man with an evil spirit. He yelled out,
translation_verse: Ni nū ko ye̱ kpēhe le̱, ní daimonio ní he tšee mumo̱ yo̱ emli, ni ebo ko̱ gbē wale

english_verse: Jesus ordered the evil spirit to be quiet and come out. The demon threw the man to the ground in front of everyone and left without harming him.
translation_verse: Ni Iesu fã́ eyi ni ekē̱: Bú ona ni odše emli! Ni daimonio le̱ še̱le̱ efõ teṅ ni edše emli, ni eyeele̱ awui ko.

english_verse: They all were amazed and kept saying to each other, “What kind of teaching is this? He has power to order evil spirits out of people!”
translation_verse: Ni ame̱fẽ ame̱he dšõ ame̱he, ni ame̱kē̱kē̱ ame̱he ake̱: Më wiemo̱ ne̱! edšake̱ hegbe̱ ke̱ hewale̱ eke̱-fã́a mumo̱i fõdši le̱, ni ame̱dšeo̱ kpo!

english_verse: News about Jesus spread all over that part of the country. Jesus Heals Many People (Matthew
translation_verse: Ni eyidšiemo̱ dšidše ye̱ dše̱i niiaṅ fẽ. (

english_verse: Jesus left the synagogue and went to Simon's home. When Jesus got there, he was told that Simon's mother-in-law was sick with a high fever.
translation_verse: Ni ete ši ye̱ kpēhe le̱ ni eyabote Simon we le̱. Ši fulu ní wa emõ Simon šāyō le̱, ni ame̱kpale̱ fai ame̱hãle̱.

english_verse: So Jesus went over to her and ordered the fever to go away. Right then she was able to get up and serve them a meal.
translation_verse: Ni eyadamo̱ eyiteṅgbe̱, ni efã́ fulu le̱ yi, ni fulu le̱ tše ye̱ eno. Ni amrõ le̱ ete ši ni esúmo̱ame̱.

english_verse: Demons went out of many people and shouted, “You are the Son of God!” But Jesus ordered the demons not to speak because they knew he was the Messiah.
translation_verse: Ni daimonioi hũ dše mei pī amli, ni ame̱blo̱ ame̱kē̱: Bo dši Kristo, Nyoṅmo̱ bi le̱! Ni efã́mo̱ ame̱yi ni eṅmẽẽame̱ gbe̱ ní ame̱wie ake̱ ame̱le ake̱ le̱ dši Kristo le̱. Mat.

english_verse: The next morning Jesus went out to a place where he could be alone, and crowds came looking for him. When they found him, they tried to stop him from leaving.
translation_verse: Ni beni dše tše̱re le̱, eyiṅ ke̱-te ṅãne̱ heko; ni asafoi le̱ taole̱ ni ame̱ba eṅõ, ni ame̱tšĩ enā, koni ekadše ame̱nõ.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “People in other towns must hear the good news about God's kingdom. This is why I was sent.”
translation_verse: Ši ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Esa ake̱ miyadšadšeo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ maṅtše̱yeli le̱ he sanekpakpa le̱ mitaoo mãdši krokomei hũ, edšake̱ no hewo̱ atšũmi.

english_verse: So he kept on preaching in the synagogues in Judea.
translation_verse: Ni ešie̱ etšõ mei ye Galilea kpēheĩ le̱. Mat.

english_verse: When Jesus saw how much faith they had, he said to the man, “My friend, your sins are forgiven.”
translation_verse: Ni beni ena ame̱hemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱, ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Nū, aṅõ ohe ešai le̱ áfao.

english_verse: “Master,” Simon answered, “we have worked hard all night long and have not caught a thing. But if you tell me to, I will let the nets down.”
translation_verse: Ni Simon here no̱ ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Onukpa, nyō ne̱ṅ fẽ wo̱tšu nii dendēndeṅ ni wo̱náá noko; ši kẽle̱ owiemo̱ nā le̱ mafõ yā le̱.

english_verse: They did this and caught so many fish that their nets began ripping apart.
translation_verse: Ni beni ame̱fe nakai le̱, ame̱gbe lōi babaō ni ame̱yā le̱ mīgbla.

english_verse: Then they signaled for their partners in the other boat to come and help them. The men came, and together they filled the two boats so full that they both began to sink.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱fõ ame̱nanemei ní yo̱ le̱le̱ kroko le̱ mli le̱ nine ake̱ amé̱ba ní ame̱bawaame̱. Ni ame̱ba ni ame̱wo le̱dši enyo̱ le̱ fẽ obõbõ ní ame̱mīhe ame̱šiu.

english_verse: His partners James and John, the sons of Zebedee, were surprised too. Jesus told Simon, “Don't be afraid! From now on you will bring in people instead of fish.”
translation_verse: ni nakai noṅṅ fe Iakobo ke̱ Iohane, Zebedeo bii le̱, ni dši Simon hefatalo̱i le̱. Ni Iesu kē̱ Simon ake̱: Kāše gbeyei! ke-dše be ne̱ no ke-yaä ne̱ *ooša gbomei. *Mat.

english_verse: The men pulled their boats up on the shore. Then they left everything and went with Jesus. Jesus Heals a Man (Matthew
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱le̱dši le̱ bakpleke, ni *ame̱šī fẽ ni amenyie ese̱. *Mat.

english_verse: But because of the crowd, they could not get him to Jesus. So they went up on the roof, where they removed some tiles and let the mat down in the middle of the room.
translation_verse: Ni heni ame̱naa bo̱ni ame̱afe ní ame̱ke̱le̱ aba ye̱ asafo le̱ hewo̱ le̱, ame̱kwo̱ ame̱te tšũ le̱ yiteṅ, ni ame̱šile̱ ke̱ esā le̱ ke̱-tšṍ ntayāi le̱ amli ke̱-yaṅmẽ teṅ ye̱ Iesu hĩe.

english_verse: The Pharisees and the experts began arguing, “Jesus must think he is God! Only God can forgive sins.”
translation_verse: Ni woloṅmãlo̱i le̱ ke̱ Farisifoi le̱ bõi susumo̱ ame̱kē̱: Namo dši mone̱ ní wieo̱ musubō̱ wiemo ne̱? Namo aanyẽ aṅõ ešai afa ake̱ dša Nyoṅmo̱ ke̱ke̱? Ies.

english_verse: Is it easier for me to tell this man that his sins are forgiven or to tell him to get up and walk?
translation_verse: Té noni kē̱mo̱ dšraaṅ? noni aakē̱: “Aṅõ ohe ešai afao” le̱? alo noni aakē̱: “Te ši ni onyie” le̱?

english_verse: At once the man stood up in front of everyone. He picked up his mat and went home, giving thanks to God.
translation_verse: Ni amrō le̱ ete ši ye̱ ame̱hĩe, ni ewó noni ekã no̱ le̱, ni eyiṅ ke̱-te le̱dientše̱ ewe, ni ehĩe Nyoṅmo̱ hĩenyamwō.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed and praised God. What they saw surprised them, and they said, “We have seen a great miracle today!” Jesus Chooses Levi (Matthew
translation_verse: Ni ame̱fẽ ame̱nā kpe̱ amehe, ni ame̱wo Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe nyam, ni ame̱še gbeyēi naakpa ní ame̱kē̱: Wo̱na nākpe̱nii ṅme̱ne̱! (

english_verse: Later, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the place for paying taxes. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”
translation_verse: Ni nii ne̱ ase̱ le̱ edše kpo, ni eyana ntōhelo̱ ko ni atšé̱o̱le̱ Levi ní etá ntōhemo̱he le̱, ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Nyiemo̱ mìse̱!

english_verse: Levi left everything and went with Jesus.
translation_verse: Ni eši fẽ ni ete ši ebanyie ese̱.

english_verse: In his home Levi gave a big dinner for Jesus. Many tax collectors and other guests were also there.
translation_verse: Ni Levi ṅmẽle̱ okplõ kpeteṅkple ye̱ ewe le̱, ni ntōhelo̱i ke̱ meikrokomei pī ke̱ame̱ baye nii.

english_verse: The Pharisees and some of their teachers of the Law of Moses grumbled to Jesus' disciples, “Why do you eat and drink with these tax collectors and other sinners?”
translation_verse: Ni Farisifoi le̱ ke̱ ame̱woloṅmãlo̱i le̱ wie hũhũhũ wo ekaselo̱i le̱ ame̱kē̱: Menihewo̱ nyeke̱ ntōhelo̱i ke̱ ešafelo̱i yeo̱ nii ni nyeke̱ame̱ nuo̱ ne̱?

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Healthy people don't need a doctor, but sick people do.
translation_verse: Ni Iesu to he ni ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Mei ní yo̱ kpintiṅkpliṅ le̱ ehĩaa-ame̱ tšofãtše̱, ši mei ní he yeo̱ le̱ moṅ ehĩa.

english_verse: Some people said to Jesus, “John's followers often pray and go without eating, and so do the followers of the Pharisees. But your disciples never go without eating or drinking.”
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ke̱le̱ ake̱: Mẽhewo̱ Iohane kaselo̱i le̱ fo̱ö̱ ṅmā̃hĩle̱ ke̱ so̱lemo̱, ni Farisifoi akaselo̱i le̱ hũ feo̱ nakai noṅṅ, ni bo le̱ okaselo̱i le̱ yeo̱ nii ni ame̱nuo̱ le̱?

english_verse: Jesus told them, “The friends of a bridegroom don't go without eating while he is still with them.
translation_verse: Ši ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Ani nyeanyẽ nyehã yōkpēmo̱ he bialo̱i le̱ ahĩ ṅmā̃, beni ayemforowu le̱ ke̱ame̱ yo̱ lolo le̱?

english_verse: But the time will come when he will be taken from them. Then they will go without eating.”
translation_verse: Ši gbĩĩ aaba ni aaṅõ ayemforowu le̱ ke̱-adše ame̱ṅõ, ni nakai gbĩĩ le̱ amli dãni ame̱ahĩ ṅmā̃.

english_verse: Jesus then told them these sayings: No one uses a new piece of cloth to patch old clothes. The patch would shrink and make the hole even bigger.
translation_verse: Ši ebuame̱ abe̱ hũ ekē̱: Moko gbaa mama hẽ nā eṅõ-táá atade momo; ši ké̱ afe nakai le̱, egblaä ehē le̱, ni mama nā ní adšie ye̱ ehē le̱ nā le̱ ke̱ emomo le̱ eyayee.

english_verse: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. The new wine would swell and burst the old skins. Then the wine would be lost, and the skins would be ruined.
translation_verse: Ni moko eṅõõ wein hē ewoo woloto̱i memedši amli; ši ké̱ afe nakai le̱, wein hē le̱ aafle̱ woloto̱i le̱ ni eeſie ši, ni woloto̱i le̱ hũ aafite;

english_verse: New wine must be put only into new wineskins.
translation_verse: ši wein hē le̱, woloto̱i hēi amli ake̱-woo̱, bĕle̱ enyo̱ le̱ fẽ yi éná wala.

english_verse: No one wants new wine after drinking old wine. They say, “The old wine is better.”
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ moko enuu wein momo ni amrõ noṅṅ ni etao ehē, edšake̱ ekē̱o̱ ake̱: Emomo le̱ hĩ fè no.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he told the man to stand up where everyone could see him. And the man stood up.
translation_verse: Ši le̱ le̱, ní ele ame̱susumo̱i le̱, ekē̱ nū ní nine egbo le̱ ake̱: Te ši obadamo̱ teṅ! Ni ete ši edamo̱ ši.

english_verse: Long ago your own people did these same things to the prophets. So when this happens to you, be happy and jump for joy! You will have a great reward in heaven.
translation_verse: Nyenyã́a ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ ni nyetũmo̱a; edšake̱ na, nyenyõmo̱wo fá ye̱ ṅwei; edšake̱ nakai noṅṅ ame̱tše̱mei le̱ fe gbaloi le̱.

english_verse: Ask God to bless anyone who curses you, and pray for everyone who is cruel to you.
translation_verse: nyedšō̱a mei ní lomoo̱nye; nyeso̱lea nyehãa mei ni feo̱nye niseniianii.

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “On the Sabbath should we do good deeds or evil deeds? Should we save someone's life or destroy it?”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iesu kē̱ame̱ ake̱: Mibabinye noko: Ani edša gbe̱ ye̱ hedšō̱mo̱gbĩĩ le̱ ano̱ ake̱ afeo̱ ekpakpa lo efõṅ? ake̱ ahereo̱ susuma yiwala lo akpãtãa ehĩe?

english_verse: Everyone was trying to touch Jesus, because power was going out from him and healing them all. Blessings and Troubles (Matthew
translation_verse: Ni asafo mũ le̱ fẽ mītao ehe ata edšake̱ hewale̱ dše emli ni etšáame̱ fẽ. (

english_verse: Jude, who was the son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who later betrayed Jesus. Jesus Teaches, Preaches, and Heals (Matthew
translation_verse: Iuda, Iakobo nyemi le̱, ke̱ Iuda Iskariot, moni tšṍ se̱gbe̱tšõlo̱ le̱. (

english_verse: God will bless you hungry people. You will have plenty to eat! God will bless you people who are now crying. You will laugh!
translation_verse: Adšō̱nye mei ní hõmo̱ yeo̱nye agbene ne̱; edšake̱ aahã nyetŏ̱ro̱. Adšō̱nye mei ní nyefóo̱ agbe̱ne̱ ne̱: edšake̱ nyeaṅmõ. Kpods.

english_verse: You are in for trouble when everyone says good things about you. That is what your own people said about those prophets who told lies. Love for Enemies (Matthew
