translation_verse: Ni nakai noṅṅ Levinyo ko hũ, beni eše̱ dše̱i ni enale̱ le̱, egbá afã ke̱-ho.

english_verse: and went over to him. He treated his wounds with olive oil and wine and bandaged them. Then he put him on his own donkey and took him to an inn, where he took care of him.
translation_verse: ni ete eṅõ eyafĩmo̱ epilamo̱i le̱ ano̱, ni efo̱se mũ ke̱ wein eſie no̱, ni esā ewóle̱ etá le̱dientše̱ ekolo le̱ no̱, ni eke̱le̱ te gbo̱iatōhe ni eyakwe̱le̱.

english_verse: The next morning he gave the innkeeper two silver coins and said, “Please take care of the man. If you spend more than this on him, I will pay you when I return.”
translation_verse: Ni dšetše̱reno̱ beni eyaä le̱, edšie denarioi enyo̱ ehã gbo̱iatōhetše̱ le̱, ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Kwe̱mo̱le̱ dšogbāṅ, ni nofẽno ni oosā ofite le̱, ké̱ mikũ mise̱ miba le̱, mawoö nyõmo̱.

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “Which one of these three people was a real neighbor to the man who was beaten up by robbers?”
translation_verse: Agbene̱ le̱, mei etẽ ne̱ ateṅ namo osusuo̱ ake̱ etšṍ moni gbé odšotſalo̱i ateṅ ne̱ nanyo?

english_verse: The expert in the Law of Moses answered, “The one who showed pity.” Jesus said, “Go and do the same!” Martha and Mary
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱: Moni nale̱ mo̱bo̱ le̱ṅ. Ke̱ke̱ ni Iesu kē̱le̱ ake̱: Bo hũ ya ni oyafe nakai noṅṅ.

english_verse: The Lord and his disciples were traveling along and came to a village. When they got there, a woman named Martha welcomed him into her home.
translation_verse: Ši eba mli ake̱, beni ame̱yaä le̱, eyabote akrowa ko mli. Ni *yō ko ni atšé̱o̱le̱ Marta le̱ ṅõle̱ ke̱-te ewe. *Ioh

english_verse: She had a sister named Mary, who sat down in front of the Lord and was listening to what he said.
translation_verse: Ni eye̱ nyemiyō ko ní atšé̱o̱le̱ Maria, ni le̱ hũ ebatá Iesu nãdši anā ni ebo ewiemo̱ le̱ toi.

english_verse: Martha was worried about all that had to be done. Finally, she went to Jesus and said, “Lord, doesn't it bother you that my sister has left me to do all the work by myself? Tell her to come and help me!”
translation_verse: Ši Marta gba ehe nā tūtu ye̱ súomo̱ pī hewo, ni eba eṅõ ebakē̱: Nuṅtšo̱, okwe̱e̱ ake̱ minyemi le̱ ešĩmi ni mikome misúmoo̱ ne̱? nohewo̱ le̱ kē̱mo̱le̱, ni le̱ hũ ebafata mihe.

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Martha, Martha! You are worried and upset about so many things,
translation_verse: Ši Iesu to he ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Marta, Marta! ōgba ohe nā ni ōhao ohe ye̱ nibii pī ahewo̱;

english_verse: but only one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen what is best, and it will not be taken away from her.”
translation_verse: ši nõkome ehĩa. Noni hĩ le̱, Maria eko̱ le̱, ni no le̱ ašõṅ ye̱ edeṅ. Mat.

english_verse: As bad as you are, you still know how to give good gifts to your children. But your heavenly Father is even more ready to give the Holy Spirit to anyone who asks. Jesus and the Ruler of Demons (Matthew
translation_verse: Bĕle̱ ke̱dši nye ní nyedši meifõdši le̱ nyele bo̱ni nyefeo̱ ní nyeke̱ nikēnĩi kpakpai keo̱ nyebii le̱, enyie noṅṅ nyetše̱ ní yo̱ ṅwei le̱ eṅõṅ Mumo̱ kroṅkroṅ ehãṅ mei ní bio̱le̱ le̱? (

english_verse: Forgive our sins, as we forgive everyone who has done wrong to us. And keep us from being tempted.’ ”
translation_verse: ni oke̱ wohe ešai afawo̱, edšake̱ wo̱ hũ wo̱ke̱-faã mofẽmo ni tōo̱ wo̱no̱; ni oke̱wo̱ akaya kā mli; ši moṅ dsiemo̱wo̱ ye̱ mofõṅ le̱ deṅ.

english_verse: Just as Jonah was a sign to the people of Nineveh, the Son of Man will be a sign to the people of today.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo̱ni Iona tšṍ okadi hã Ninivebii le̱, nakai noṅṅ kẽ gbomobi le̱ aatšṍ ahã ne̱ke̱ yino̱bii ne̱.

english_verse: While Jesus was still talking, a woman in the crowd spoke up, “The woman who gave birth to you and nursed you is blessed!”
translation_verse: Ni eba mli ake̱, beni ewieo̱ nii ne̱ le̱, yō ko ní yo̱ asafo le̱ mli le̱ wó egbē no̱ ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: *Adšō̱ mũsũ ní hĩeo ke̱ fufo̱ ní oye le̱! *

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he said: A kingdom where people fight each other will end up in ruin. And a family that fights will break up.
translation_verse: Ši le̱ le̱, ake̱-ní ele ame̱dſẽṅmo̱i le̱, ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Maṅ-fẽ-maṅ ní gbaa woo̱ le̱dientše̱ ehe le̱, edſaä; ni tšũ kũmoo̱ ſieo̱ tšũ no̱.

english_verse: If Satan fights against himself, how can his kingdom last? Yet you say that I force out demons by the power of Beelzebul.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši satan hũ gbáa woo̱ le̱dientše̱ ehe le̱, té aafe tēṅ ní emaṅtše̱yeli le̱ aadamo̱ šiṅ? edšake̱ nyekē̱ ake̱ Beelzebul hewale̱ nā mifãa daimonioi le̱.

english_verse: You Pharisees are in for trouble! You love the front seats in the synagogues, and you like to be greeted with honor in the market.
translation_verse: Kpóo hã nye, Farisifoi, ake̱ nyesumoo̱ onukpai-asitrámo̱hei ye̱ kpēhei le̱ ke̱ ṅãmo̱i ye̱ dšadši ano̱!

english_verse: A teacher of the Law of Moses spoke up, “Teacher, you said cruel things about us.”
translation_verse: Ni mlatšõlo̱i le̱ ateṅ mokome here no̱ ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Tšõlo̱, nii ní okē̱o̱ ne̱ oke̱mībo̱ wo̱ hũ ahora.

english_verse: When an evil spirit leaves a person, it travels through the desert, looking for a place to rest. But when it doesn't find a place, it says, “I will go back to the home I left.”
translation_verse: Ké̱ mumo̱ fõṅ le̱ dše gbomo mli le̱, eyanyieo̱ hei ní nu be̱ etaoo bedšō̱mo̱, ni ké̱ enáá eko le̱, ekē̱o ake̱: Makũ mise̱ mate miwe heni midše̱ le̱.

english_verse: When it gets there and finds the place clean and fixed up,
translation_verse: Ni ké̱ eba le̱, ebanaä ake̱ ábē̱ mli ni áwula mli.

english_verse: it goes off and finds seven other evil spirits even worse than itself. They all come and make their home there, and that person ends up in worse shape than before. Being Really Blessed
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱ eyaä ni eyaṅõo̱ mumo̱i krokomei kpawo ní dši mumo̱i fõdši fèle̱ efataä ehe, ni ame̱yaboteo̱ emli, ni ame̱hĩo̱ dše̱i, ni nakai gbomo le̱ *se̱kpẽ šihĩle̱ le̱ tšṍo̱ efṍṅ fè tšutšu nõ le̱, *Ioh.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “That's true, but the people who are really blessed are the ones who hear and obey God's message!” A Sign from God (Matthew
translation_verse: Ši ehere no̱ ake̱: Eye̱ mli moṅ, ši adšō̱ mei ní nuo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ wiemo̱ le̱ ni ame̱yeo̱ no̱ le̱!

english_verse: The Pharisee was surprised that he did not wash his hands before eating.
translation_verse: Ši beni Farisifonyo le̱ na ake̱ efo̱flo̱ko ehe dāni ebaye nii le̱, eble fele̱ yā. Mat.

english_verse: You Pharisees are in for trouble! You give God a tenth of the spices from your gardens, such as mint and rue. But you cheat people, and you don't love God. You should be fair and kind to others and still give a tenth to God.
translation_verse: Ši kpóo hã nye, Farisifoi, ake̱ nyehãa kowe̱ ke̱ ſie ke̱ bāi sro̱toi fẽ mlidšā nyoṅmanyoṅma, ní nyešĩo̱ dšale̱saneyeli ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱ suomo̱ le̱! Kũle̱ edša ake̱ nyefeo̱ ene̱mei, ni nyekašĩ eko le̱ hũ.

english_verse: As crowds were gathering around Jesus, he said: You people of today are evil! You keep looking for a sign from God. But what happened to Jonah is the only sign you will be given.
translation_verse: Ši beni asafoi le̱ ebabua ame̱he nā pī le̱, ebõi kē̱mo̱ ake̱: Yino̱bii ne̱ yino̱bii fõdši ni, ame̱mītao okadi, ni ahãṅame̱ okadi ko, ake̱ dša gbalo̱ Iona okadi le̱.

english_verse: When the judgment comes, the Queen of the South will stand there with you and condemn you. She traveled a long way to hear Solomon's wisdom, and yet here is something far greater than Solomon.
translation_verse: Wuoyigbe̱ maṅnye le̱ ke̱ yino̱bii ne̱ aate ši ye̱ kodšomo̱ le̱ mli, ni eebuame̱ fo̱, edšake̱ edše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ nāgbēhe ebabo Salomo nilē toi; ni na, moni fè Salomo ye̱ bie̱!

english_verse: The people of Nineveh will also stand there with you and condemn you. They turned to God when Jonah preached, and yet here is something far greater than Jonah. Light (Matthew
translation_verse: Ninivebii le̱ ke̱ ne̱ke̱ yino̱bii ne̱ aate ši ye̱ kodšomo̱ le̱ mli ni ame̱abuame̱ fo̱, edšake̱ ame̱tšake ame̱tšui ye̱ Iona šie̱mo̱ le̱ nā; ni na, moni fè Iona ye̱ bie̱. Iona

english_verse: No one lights a lamp and then hides it or puts it under a clay pot. A lamp is put on a lampstand, so everyone who comes into the house can see the light.
translation_verse: Moko esuu kane emãã kpokplobiiaṅ alo tšese šiši, ši moṅ kanetšo no̱ eke̱-mãa, koni mei ní baä mli le̱ ana ekpe̱mo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Your eyes are the lamp for your body. When your eyes are good, you have all the light you need. But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark.
translation_verse: Gbomotšo le̱ kane dši ohĩṅme̱i le̱. Ke̱dši ohĩṅme̱i no̱ tše le̱, ogbomotšo mū le̱ hũ mli tšeo̱; ši ke̱dši ohĩṅme̱i ehĩĩ le̱, ogbomotšo le̱ hũ woo̱ duṅ.

english_verse: So be sure your light isn't darkness.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ kwe̱ ní ahĩ, koni la ní yo̱ omli le̱ akatšṍ duṅ.

english_verse: You fools! Didn't God make both the outside and the inside?
translation_verse: Kwašiai! ani moni fe se̱ le̱, dšee le̱ noṅṅ efe mli le̱ hũ?

english_verse: Yes, you are really in for trouble. You build monuments to honor the prophets your own people murdered long ago.
translation_verse: Kpóo hã nye! ake̱ nyemãmoo̱ gbaloi le̱ afũhei le̱; ši nyetše̱mei gbeame̱;

english_verse: When Jesus finished speaking, a Pharisee invited him home for a meal. Jesus went and sat down to eat.
translation_verse: Ni beni ewieo̱ le̱, Farisifonyo ko bakpēle̱ ake̱ éba ni eke̱le̱ abaye nii; ni ete šĩa le, ni eyatá niyenii le̱ ahe.

english_verse: So the Lord said to him: You Pharisees clean the outside of cups and dishes, but on the inside you are greedy and evil.
translation_verse: Ni Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ kē̱le̱ ake̱: Nme̱ne̱ ṅme̱ne̱ nye Farisifoi le̱ nyetšumoo̱ kpulu he ke̱ kã se̱, ši nyemli éyi obõ ke̱ dšū ke̱ fō.

english_verse: If you would only give what you have to the poor, everything you do would please God.
translation_verse: Moṅ le̱, nyeṅõa nibii ní yo̱ mli le̱ nyefea edšŭrõ, ni na, nibii fẽ he aatše ahãnye.

english_verse: But you are in for trouble! You are like unmarked graves that people walk on without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Kpóo hã nye, woloṅmãlo̱i ke̱ Farisifoi, osatofoi, ake̱ nyetamo̱ gbohĩĩafũhei ní edšee ši, ni mei ní nyieo̱ no̱ le̱ lee!

english_verse: Jesus replied: You teachers are also in for trouble! You load people down with heavy burdens, but you won't lift a finger to help them carry the loads.
translation_verse: Ši ekē̱: Nye mlatšõlo̱i le̱ hũ, kpóo hã nye! ake̱ nyeke̱ dšatšui ní tēremo̱ dšraä tĕreo̱ mei, ni nyedientše̱ le̱, nyeke̱ nyewao kome etaa dšatšui le̱ ahe.

english_verse: You must think that was the right thing for your people to do, or else you would not have built monuments for the prophets they murdered.
translation_verse: bĕle̱ nyemīye nyetše̱mei le̱ anitšumo̱i le̱ ahe odase ni eṅõ nyenā; edšake̱ ame̱ ame̱gbeame̱ moṅ, ši nye nyemāmoo̱ ame̱fũhei le̱.

english_verse: Because of your evil deeds, the Wisdom of God said, “I will send prophets and apostles to you. But you will murder some and mistreat others.”
translation_verse: Ene̱hewo̱ noṅṅ ni Nyoṅmo̱ nilē le̱ kē̱: Mibatšũ gbaloi ke̱ bo̱foi ke̱-ya ame̱ṅõ, ni ame̱agbe ame̱teṅ meikomei ni ame̱awa ame̱teṅ meikomei ayi,

english_verse: You people living today will be punished for all the prophets who have been murdered since the beginning of the world.
translation_verse: koni gbalo̱i le̱ fẽ alá ní afo̱se aſie ši ke̱-dše̱ dseṅšišitō mli le̱ abi ši ye̱ yino̱bii ne̱ adeṅ;

english_verse: This includes every prophet from the time of Abel to the time of Zechariah, who was murdered between the altar and the temple. You people will certainly be punished for all of this.
translation_verse: ke̱-dše̱ Habel lá le̱ no̱ ke̱-yaši Zakaria, moni agbele̱ ye̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ ke̱ so̱lemo̱tšũ le̱ te le̱ṅ le̱ lá le̱ no̱. Hē̃, mīkē̱nye ake, aabi ši ye̱ ne̱ke̱ yino̱bii ne̱ adeṅ!

english_verse: You teachers of the Law of Moses are really in for trouble! You carry the keys to the door of knowledge about God. But you never go in, and you keep others from going in.
translation_verse: Kpóo hã nye, mlatšõlo̱i, edšake̱ nyeko̱ nilē le̱ nā samfe! Nyedíentše̱ le̱ nyebotee mli, ni mei ní taoo̱ mli abote le̱ hũ, nyetšĩo̱ame̱ gbe̱.

english_verse: Jesus was about to leave, but the teachers and the Pharisees wanted to get even with him. They tried to make him say what he thought about other things,
translation_verse: Ni beni edše dše̱i ete le̱, woloṅmãlo̱i le̱ ke̱ Farisifoi le̱ dšie ame̱hĩe ame̱kale̱ ni ame̱bõi enā sãdši ble̱mo̱ babaō,

english_verse: so they could catch him saying something wrong.
translation_verse: ni ame̱wole̱ ká, ni ame̱mītao enā enyo̱ṅ ame̱mõ, koni ame̱yaflo̱ enā.

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. Won't he do even more for you? You have such little faith!
translation_verse: Agbene̱ ke̱dši dſe̱i ní ṅme̱ne̱ le̱ eye̱ ṅāno̱ ní wó̱ ni aṅõ-wo flõnõ mli le̱ Nyoṅmo̱ wulaä ne̱ke̱ le̱, ani ewulaṅnye āhũ fèame̱? nye ní nyehemo̱-ke̱-yeli fáá!

english_verse: But put God's work first, and these things will be yours as well. Treasures in Heaven (Matthew
translation_verse: Moṅ nyetaoa Nyoṅmo̱ maṅtše̱yeli le̱ se̱gbe̱, ni aaṅõ nii ne̱ fẽ afata he ahãnye.

english_verse: Even the hairs on your head are counted. So don't be afraid! You are worth much more than many sparrows. Telling Others about Christ (Matthew
translation_verse: Ši *nyeyiteṅ tšo̱i tete akane fẽ. Nohewo̱ le̱ nyekašea gbeyei; nyedšra wa fè aflimatai babaō. *

english_verse: My little group of disciples, don't be afraid! Your Father wants to give you the kingdom.
translation_verse: Kāše gbeyei, asafoku bibiō; edšake̱ nyetše̱ le̱ ye̱ he tšuidšŭrõ ake̱ eeṅõ maṅtše̱yeli le̱ ehãnye.

english_verse: Sell what you have and give the money to the poor. Make yourselves moneybags that never wear out. Make sure your treasure is safe in heaven, where thieves cannot steal it and moths cannot destroy it.
translation_verse: Nyehõa nii ní nyeyo̱ le̱ ní nyeke̱fea edšŭrõ; nyefea fotroi ní tšṍmo̱o̱ ememedši, nyetoa dſetri ní etãã ye̱ ṅwei, heni dšulo̱ ko be̱ṅke̱e̱ ni omlẽgẽ kpee nii ye̱ le̱.

english_verse: Then he said to the crowd, “Don't be greedy! Owning a lot of things won't make your life safe.”
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyehĩe ahĩa nyehe no̱ dšogbāṅ ye̱ hĩedšōmo̱ hewo; edšake̱ dšee gbomo nii ni ená ni eteke no̱ le̱ mli ewala yo̱.

english_verse: Life is more than food or clothing.
translation_verse: Susuma le̱ fè ṅmā̃, ni gbomotšo le̱ hũ fè atade.

english_verse: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father knows what you need.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ne̱ke̱ nibii ne̱ fẽ se̱ dše ne̱ṅ mãdši ano̱ bii dio̱; ši nyetše̱ le̱ le ake̱ nii ne̱ ahe mīhĩanye.

english_verse: But suppose one of the servants thinks that the master won't return until late. Suppose that servant starts beating all the other servants and eats and drinks and gets drunk.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši nakai tšŭlo̱ le̱ kē̱ ye̱ etšui mli ake̱: Minuṅtšo̱ le̱ mītši ebabe le̱ eto, ni eebõi wehĩĩ ke̱ weyei le̱ yī ke̱ niyeli ke̱ numo̱ ke̱ dā̃tō̱ le̱:

english_verse: Do you think that I came to bring peace to earth? No indeed! I came to make people choose sides.
translation_verse: Ani nyesusu? ake̱ hedšo̱le̱ hãmo̱ miba ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱? Mīkē̱nye ake̱: Dabida, ši mligblamo̱ moṅ.

english_verse: Be ready and keep your lamps burning
translation_verse: Nyefĩmo̱a *nyemliteaṅ, ni nyehãa †nyekanei le̱ atšoa; *

english_verse: Servants are fortunate if their master finds them awake and ready when he comes! I promise you he will get ready and let his servants sit down so he can serve them.
translation_verse: Adšō̱ nakai tšũdši le̱ ni beni nuṅtšo̱ le̱ aaba le̱ ní eebaninaame̱ ake̱ ame̱mīši kpe le̱! Le̱le̱ṅ, mīkē̱nye ake̱ eemĩa ni eehã ame̱trá niyenii abe, ni eeba ebasúmo̱ame̱.

english_verse: You would surely not let a thief break into your home, if you knew when the thief was coming.
translation_verse: Ši nyenaa nyelea ene̱ ake̱, *ke̱dši šĩatše̱ le nõ ṅmle̱tſā no̱ ni dšulo̱ le̱ baä le̱, kũle̱ eebu ni eṅmẽṅ gbe̱ ní agbu ešĩa le̱ awoṅ. *

english_verse: So always be ready! You don't know when the Son of Man will come.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nye hũ nyesāa nyehe nyetoa, edšake̱ ṅmle̱tſā ni nyehĩe kãã no̱ le̱ no̱ gbomobi le̱ baba.

english_verse: Peter asked Jesus, “Did you say this just for us or for everyone?”
translation_verse: Ši Petro kē̱le̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, wo̱ obuo̱ ne̱ke̱ abe̱ ne̱, alo mei le̱ fẽ hũ ye̱ṅ?

english_verse: The Lord answered: Who are faithful and wise servants? Who are the ones the master will put in charge of giving the other servants their food supplies at the proper time?
translation_verse: Ni Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ kē̱: Ši namo mo̱ dši tšũlo̱nukpa ano̱kwafo ke̱ nilelo̱, ní nuṅtšo̱ le̱ aawole̱ onukpa ye̱ ewebii ano̱, koni ehãame̱ ame̱niyenii ye̱ be ní sa mli le̱?

english_verse: Servants are fortunate if their master comes and finds them doing their job.
translation_verse: Adšō̱ nakai tšŭlo̱ le̱, moni ké̱ enuṅtšo̱ le̱ ba ní eebaninale̱ ake̱ ẽfe nakai le̱.

english_verse: A servant who is always faithful will surely be put in charge of everything the master owns.
translation_verse: Mīkē̱nye ano̱kwale mli ake̱ eewole̱ onukpa ye̱ enibii fẽ no̱. Mat.

english_verse: If that happens, the master will come on a day and at a time when the servant least expects him. That servant will then be punished and thrown out with the servants who cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: nakai tšũlo̱ le̱ nuṅtšo̱ le̱ aaba ye̱ gbĩ no̱ ní ekwe̱e̱le̱ gbe̱ ke̱ ṅmle̱tſā no̱ ní elee, ni eeflo̱ emli, ni eehãle̱ egbe̱fãṅnõ ke̱ ko̱ko̱nsafoi le̱.

english_verse: If servants are not ready or willing to do what their master wants them to do, they will be beaten hard.
translation_verse: Ši nakai tšũlo̱ le̱ ní le enuṅtšo̱ suomo̱nānii ni esāā ehe etoo ni esā efee esuomonānii le̱, aayile kpãi pī; Iak.

english_verse: But servants who don't know what their master wants them to do will not be beaten so hard for doing wrong. If God has been generous with you, he will expect you to serve him well. But if he has been more than generous, he will expect you to serve him even better. Not Peace, but Trouble (Matthew
translation_verse: ši moni lee ni eyafe yīnii le̱, aayile̱ fiō. Ši mofẽmo ní aṅõ pī ahã le̱, pī aatao ye̱ edeṅ; ni moni atu pī awo edeṅ le̱, aabi noni teke no̱ ši ye̱ edeṅ.

english_verse: I came to set fire to the earth, and I wish it were already on fire!

english_verse: Nathanael said, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God and the King of Israel!”
translation_verse: Natanael here no̱ ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Rabi, bo dši Nyoṅmo̱ bi le̱, bo dši Israel maṅtše̱ le̱.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Did you believe me just because I said that I saw you under the fig tree? You will see something even greater.
translation_verse: Iesu here no̱ ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Ni mikē̱o ake̱ minao ye̱ agbãmitšo le̱ šiši le̱ hewo̱ oheo̱ oyeo̱ ne̱. Oona nii wudši ni fè ene̱.

english_verse: I tell you for certain you will see heaven open and God's angels going up and coming down on the Son of Man.”
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Le̱le̱ṅ, le̱le̱ṅ, mīkē̱nye ake̱: Ke̱-dše̱ be ne̱ no̱ le̱ nyeana ake̱ ṅwei nā kã ni *Nyoṅmo̱ bo̱foi le̱ mīkwo̱ mīkpleke ye̱ gbomobi le̱ no̱. *

english_verse: Mary then said to the servants, “Do whatever Jesus tells you to do.”
translation_verse: Enye kē̱ tšũdši le̱ ake̱: Nofẽno ní eekē̱nye le̱, nyefea.

english_verse: and the man in charge drank some of the water that had now turned into wine. He did not know where the wine had come from, but the servants did. He called the bridegroom over
translation_verse: Ši beni piafonyo le̱ sa ena nu ní étšṍ wein, ni elee beni dše̱, ši tšũdši le̱ ni ye̱ nu le̱ ke̱ke̱ le le̱, piafonyo le̱ tšé̱ ayemforowu le̱,

english_verse: But Jesus was talking about his body as a temple.
translation_verse: Ši le̱ le̱, egbomotšo so̱lemo̱tšũ le̱ he ewieo̱ le̱.

english_verse: So he took some rope and made a whip. Then he chased everyone out of the temple, together with their sheep and cattle. He turned over the tables of the moneychangers and scattered their coins.
translation_verse: Ni eṅõ tãṅkpēi bibii efe kplebii eṅõ-ſie amefẽ ke̱-dše so̱lemo̱we le̱, ke̱ tōi ke̱ tšinai le̱, ni efo̱se šíka-tšakelo̱i le̱ ašika le̱ eſie ši, ni etšire̱ okplõi le̱ etſia ši;

english_verse: The disciples then remembered that the Scriptures say, “My love for your house burns in me like a fire.”
translation_verse: Ši ekaselo̱i le̱ kai ake̱ aṅmã ake̱: *“Owe le̱ he hĩedō̱ le̱ eyemi.” *Lal.

english_verse: There he found people selling cattle, sheep, and doves in the temple. He also saw moneychangers sitting at their tables.
translation_verse: Ni eyanina mei ni hõo̱ tšinai ke̱ tōi ke̱ okpoi ke̱ mei ni tšakeo̱ šika hũ trá ši ye̱ so̱lemo̱we le̱.

english_verse: Jesus said to the people who had been selling doves, “Get those doves out of here! Don't make my Father's house a marketplace.”
translation_verse: ni ekē̱ mei ni hõo̱ okpoi le̱ ake̱: Nyedšiea nii ne̱ ke̱-dšea bie̱, nyekaṅõa mitše̱ we le̱ nyefea dšāno̱.

english_verse: The Jewish leaders asked Jesus, “What miracle will you work to show us why you have done this?”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iudafoi le̱ here no̱ ni ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Mẽ okadi oke̱-tšõo̱wo̱ hewo ni ofeo̱ ene̱mei ne̱? Mat.

english_verse: And when he was raised from death, his disciples remembered what he had told them. Then they believed the Scriptures and the words of Jesus. Jesus Knows What People Are Like
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ beni ete ši ke̱-dše̱ gbohĩĩ ateṅ le̱, ekaselo̱i le̱ kai ake̱ ekē̱ ene̱, ni ame̱há ṅmãle̱ le̱ ke̱ wiemo̱ ní Iesu wie le̱ ame̱ye.

english_verse: In Jerusalem during Passover many people put their faith in Jesus, because they saw him work miracles.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱, beni eyo̱ Ierusalem ye̱ Hehō gbĩĩ dšudši le̱ amli le̱, mei pī na okadii ni efe le̱, ni ame̱hé egbe̱i le̱ no̱ ame̱ye.

english_verse: But Jesus knew what was in their hearts, and he would not let them have power over him.
translation_verse: Ši Iesu dientše̱ le̱ edšiee ehe ši ehããame̱, edšake̱ ele ame̱fẽ,

english_verse: No one had to tell him what people were like. He already knew.
translation_verse: ni ehĩaale̱ ake̱ moko aye gbomo he odase, edšake̱ le̱dientše̱ ele noni yo̱ gbomo mli. Mar.

english_verse: Jesus replied: How can you be a teacher of Israel and not know these things?
translation_verse: Iesu here no̱ ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Té Israel tšõlo̱ dšio ni olee ene̱mei ne̱?

english_verse: Then everyone who has faith in the Son of Man will have eternal life.
translation_verse: Koni mofẽmo ni heo̱ eno̱ yeo̱ le̱ hĩe akakpãtã, ši moṅ ená nāno̱ wala.

english_verse: God loved the people of this world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who has faith in him will have eternal life and never really die.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ne̱ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱ sumo̱ dše le̱, ake̱ eṅõ ebi kōme le̱ ehã, koni mofẽmo ní heo̱ eno̱ yeo̱ le̱ hĩe akakpãtã, ši moṅ ená nāno̱ wala. Rom.

english_verse: God did not send his Son into the world to condemn its people. He sent him to save them!
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ tšũũ ebi le̱ ke̱-baa dše le̱ mli koni ebakodšo dše le̱, ši moṅ koni atšṍ eno̱ ahere dše le̱ yiwala.

english_verse: No one who has faith in God's Son will be condemned. But everyone who doesn't have faith in him has already been condemned for not having faith in God's only Son.
translation_verse: Moni heo̱ eno̱ yeo̱ le̱, akodšoole̱; ši moni hee yee le̱, ákodšole̱ momo, edšake̱ eheko Nyoṅmo̱ bi kōme le̱ gbe̱i le̱ no̱ eyeko. K.

english_verse: The light has come into the world, and people who do evil things are judged guilty because they love the dark more than the light.
translation_verse: Ši kodšomo̱ le̱ ne̱, ake̱ la le̱ éba dše le̱ mli, ni gbomei sumoo̱ duṅ le̱ moṅ fè la le̱, edšake̱ ame̱nitšumo̱i le̱ efõdši ni.

english_verse: But everyone who lives by the truth will come to the light, because they want others to know that God is really the one doing what they do. Jesus and John the Baptist
translation_verse: Ši moni feo̱ ano̱kwalenii le̱ baä la le̱ he, koni enitšumo̱i le̱ adše kpo, edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ mli atšuame̱ ye̱.

english_verse: John's followers got into an argument with a Jewish man about a ceremony of washing.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ ṅwanedšē bate ši ye̱ Iohane kaselo̱i le̱ ke̱ Iudafonyo ko teṅ ye̱ hetšūmo̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: You surely remember how I told you that I am not the Messiah. I am only the one sent ahead of him.
translation_verse: Nyedientše̱ nyemīyemi odase ake̱ mĩkē̱ ake̱: *Dšee midsi Kristo le̱, ši moṅ ake̱ atšũmi ke̱-tšṍ ehĩe. *

english_verse: At a wedding the groom is the one who gets married. The best man is glad just to be there and to hear the groom's voice. That's why I am so glad.
translation_verse: Moni hĩe eyemforo le̱, le̱ dši *ayemforowu; ši ayemforowu le̱ šientše̱ ni damo̱ ši boo̱le̱ toi le̱, nyã́ enyã́a ye̱ ayemforowu le̱ gbē hewo̱. Nohewo̱ le̱ ne̱ke̱ minyã́mo̱ ne̱ éba mli. *Mat.

english_verse: Jesus must become more important, while I become less important. The One Who Comes from Heaven
translation_verse: Le̱ le̱, dša eſere, ni mi le̱, mino̱ gbo̱.

english_verse: God's Son comes from heaven and is above all others. Everyone who comes from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks about earthly things. The one who comes from heaven is above all others.
translation_verse: Moni *dše̱ ṅwei ba le̱, efè mei fẽ. Moni dše̱ šikpoṅ no̱ le̱, šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ edše̱, ni šikpoṅ le̱ he ewieo̱. Moni dše̱ ṅwei ba le̱, efè mei fẽ, *

english_verse: He speaks about what he has seen and heard, and yet no one believes him.
translation_verse: ni noni ena ni enu le̱, no he odase eyeo̱; ni mokomoko hee edase le̱ yee. K.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has given him everything.
translation_verse: *Tše̱ le̱ mīsumo̱ bi le̱, ni etu †nibii fẽ éwo edeṅ. *

english_verse: Everyone who has faith in the Son has eternal life. But no one who rejects him will ever share in that life, and God will be angry with them forever.
translation_verse: Moni heo̱ bi le̱ no̱ yeo̱ le̱, eye nāno̱ wala; ši moni boo bi le̱ toi le̱, ēnaṅ wala, ši moṅ Nyoṅmo̱ mlifũ hĩo̱ eno̱. K.

english_verse: But no one who drinks the water I give will ever be thirsty again. The water I give will become in that person a flowing fountain that gives eternal life.”
translation_verse: ši moni nuo̱ nu ni mi mahãle̱ le̱ eko le̱, kũmai yeṅle̱ doṅṅ ke̱-ate nāno̱; ši moṅ, nu ní mahãle̱ le̱, aatšṍ nu hĩṅme̱i nĩ baä ke̱-yaä nāno̱ wala mli ye̱ emli.

english_verse: The woman replied, “Sir, please give me a drink of that water! Then I won't get thirsty and have to come to this well again.”
translation_verse: Yō le̱ kē̱le̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, hami nu ne̱ eko, koni kũmai akayemi, ní miba bie̱ mibaye̱ nu doṅṅ.

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Go and bring your husband.”
translation_verse: Iesu kē̱le̱ ake̱: Ya ni oyatšé̱ owù, ni oke̱le̱ aba bie̱.

english_verse: The woman said, “Sir, I can see that you are a prophet.
translation_verse: Yō le̱ kē̱le̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, mina ake̱ gbalo̱ dsio.

english_verse: My ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say Jerusalem is the only place to worship.”
translation_verse: Goṅ ne̱ no̱, wo̱tše̱mei le̱ so̱le ye̱, ni nye le̱ nyekē̱ ake̱ *Ierusalem dši he ní sa ake̱ aso̱le ye. *

english_verse: Jesus said to her: Believe me, the time is coming when you won't worship the Father either on this mountain or in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Iesu kē̱le̱ ake̱: Awó, hemi oye ake̱ ṅmle̱tſā le̱ mība ní dšee goṅ ne̱ no̱ ni asaṅ dšee Ierusalem ni nyeadšá tše̱ le̱ ye̱.

english_verse: The woman said, “I know that the Messiah will come. He is the one we call Christ. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”
translation_verse: Yō le̱ kē̱le̱ ake̱: Mile ake̱ *Mesia ni atšé̱o̱le̱ Kristo le̱ mība; ké̱ éba le̱, eegbawo̱ nii fẽ. *

english_verse: “I am that one,” Jesus told her, “and I am speaking to you now.”
translation_verse: Iesu kē̱le̱ ake̱: Mi ní mike̱o wieo̱ ne̱, mi ni.

english_verse: The disciples returned about this time and were surprised to find Jesus talking with a woman. But none of them asked him what he wanted or why he was talking with her.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ekaselo̱i le̱ ba, ni ame̱hĩe feame̱ yā ake̱ eke̱ yō mīwie; ši kẽle̱ moko biile̱ ake̱: Meni obio̱le̱? alo: meni wiemo̱ oke̱le̱ wieo̱?

english_verse: The woman left her water jar and ran back into town, where she said to the people,
translation_verse: Agbene yō le̱ šī enugbé̱ le̱, ni eyiṅ ete mã le̱ṅ, ni eyakē̱ mei le̱ ake̱:

english_verse: “Come and see a man who told me everything I have ever done! Could he be the Messiah?”
translation_verse: Nyebaä nyebakwe̱a nū ko ni edšadše nii fẽ ni mife etšõmi; ake̱ dšee Kristo le̱ ne̱ lo?

english_verse: Everyone in town went out to see Jesus.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le amedše mã leṅ ameba eṅõ.

english_verse: While this was happening, Jesus' disciples were saying to him, “Teacher, please eat something.”
translation_verse: Ši no mli le̱ ekaselo̱i le̱ kpale̱ fai ame̱ke̱: Rabi, ye noko.

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I have food you don't know anything about.”
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Miye̱ *ṅmā̃ ni miyeo̱, ní nyelee. *K.

english_verse: His disciples started asking each other, “Has someone brought him something to eat?”
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ ekaselo̱i le̱ kē̱kē̱ amehe ake̱: Ani moko ébahãle̱ noko eye?

english_verse: Jesus said: My food is to do what God wants! He is the one who sent me, and I must finish the work that he gave me to do.
translation_verse: Iesu kē̱ame̱ ake̱: Miṅmā̃ dši ake̱ mafe moni tšũmi le̱ suomo̱nānii, ni magbe enitšumo̱ le̱ nā.

english_verse: You may say there are still four months until harvest time. But I tell you to look, and you will see that the fields are ripe and ready to harvest.
translation_verse: Ani nyekē̱ē̱ ake̱: Eſe̱ nyõdši edſe̱ ní ablekpamo̱be le̱ še̱o̱? Na, mīkē̱nye ake̱: Nyeholea nyehĩṅme̱ii ano̱ ni nyekwe̱a ṅmõdši le̱ boni amē̱gba *futā momo ni sa kpamo̱. *Mat.

english_verse: Even now the harvest workers are receiving their reward by gathering a harvest that brings eternal life. Then everyone who planted the seed and everyone who harvests the crop will celebrate together.
translation_verse: Ni moni kpaā le̱ náa enyōmo̱wo, ni ebuaä yibii anā etoo nāno̱ wala, koni moni dũo̱ le̱ ke̱ moni kpaā le̱ fẽ anyã́ šikome.

english_verse: So the saying proves true, “Some plant the seed, and others harvest the crop.”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ene̱ mli ni wiemo̱ ni awie ake: Moko dũo̱ ni moko kpaä le̱ baä mli ye̱.

english_verse: I am sending you to harvest crops in fields where others have done all the hard work.
translation_verse: Mi le̱ mitšũnye koni nyeyakpa noni dšee nye nyetšu he noko; meikrokomei étšu nii le̱, ni nyeba ame̱ni-tšumo̱ le̱ mli.

english_verse: A lot of Samaritans in that town put their faith in Jesus because the woman had said, “This man told me everything I have ever done.”
translation_verse: Ni Samariabii le̱ ni dše̱ nakai mã le̱ṅ le̱ ateṅ mei pī hé eno̱ ye ye̱ yō le̱ wiemo̱ le̱ ni eṅõ-ye odase ake̱: Ekē̱mi nii fẽ ní mife pẽṅ le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: They came and asked him to stay in their town, and he stayed on for two days.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ beni Samariabii le̱ ba eṅõ le̱, ame̱kpale̱ fai ake̱ eke̱ame̱ ahī ši; ni ehì dše̱i gbĩĩ enyo̱.

english_verse: Many more Samaritans put their faith in Jesus because of what they heard him say.
translation_verse: Ni mei pī ní fè tšutšubii le̱ sa hē ye ye̱ le̱dientše̱ ewiemo̱ le̱ hewo̱;

english_verse: They told the woman, “We no longer have faith in Jesus just because of what you told us. We have heard him ourselves, and we are certain that he is the Savior of the world!” Jesus Heals an Official's Son (Matthew
translation_verse: ni ame̱kē̱ yō le̱ ake̱: Agbe̱ne̱ wo̱mīhe wo̱mīye, dšee bo owiemo̱ le̱ hewo̱ṅ doṅṅ; edšake̱ wo̱dientše̱ wó̱nu, ni wo̱ná wo̱le ake̱, ano̱kwale, mone̱ dši dše le̱ walaherelo̱ ní dši Kristo le̱.

english_verse: Jesus had said, “Prophets are honored everywhere, except in their own country.” Then two days later he left
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Iesu dientše̱ ye odase ake̱ gbalo̱ ko hĩe be̱ nyam ye̱ le̱dientše̱ emaṅ. Mat

english_verse: and went to Galilee. The people there welcomed him, because they had gone to the festival in Jerusalem and had seen everything he had done.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱, beni eba Galilea le̱, Galileabii le̱ ní na nii fẽ ní efe ye̱ Ierusalem ye̱ gbĩdšŭrõ le̱ no̱ le̱ herele̱, edšake̱ ame̱ hũ ame̱te gbĩdšŭrõ le̱.

english_verse: While Jesus was in Galilee, he returned to the village of Cana, where he had turned the water into wine. There was an official in Capernaum whose son was sick.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iesu ba Kana ye̱ Galilea, heni ehã nu tšṍ wein ye̱ le̱, ekoṅ. Ni maṅtše̱wenū ko ye̱ Kapernaum ni ebi he mīye.

english_verse: And when the man heard that Jesus had come from Judea, he went and begged him to keep his son from dying.
translation_verse: Ni beni enu ake̱ Iesu édše̱ Iudea éba Galilea le̱, ete eṅõ ni eyatuto̱le̱ ake̱ eba ni ebatšá ebi le̱, edšake̱ ēhe égbo.

english_verse: Jesus told the official, “You won't have faith unless you see miracles and wonders!”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iesu kē̱le̱ ake̱: Ké̱ nyenaa okadii ke̱ nākpe̱nii le̱ nyehee nyeyee.

english_verse: The man replied, “Lord, please come before my son dies!”
translation_verse: Maṅtše̱wenū le̱ kē̱le̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, bá dãni mibi le̱ agbo.

english_verse: Jesus then said, “Your son will live. Go on home to him.” The man believed Jesus and started back home.
translation_verse: Iesu kē̱le̱ ake̱: Ya, obi le̱ yi ēná wala. Ni nū le̱ hé wiemo̱ ní Iesu kē̱le̱ le̱ eye, ni eyiṅ ete.

english_verse: Some of the official's servants met him along the road and told him, “Your son is better!”
translation_verse: Ši beni eyaä le̱, etšũdšĩ ke̱le̱ bakpe, ni ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Obinū le̱ he ewale̱.

english_verse: He asked them when the boy got better, and they answered, “The fever left him yesterday at one o'clock.”
translation_verse: Ni ebiame̱ nõ ṅmle̱tſā no̱ ní ehe bõile̱ wā; ni ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Nye ſane ṅmle̱ kome mli ni fulu le̱ tše ye̱ eno̱.

english_verse: The boy's father realized that at one o'clock the day before, Jesus had told him, “Your son will live!” So the man and everyone in his family put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni tše̱ le̱ ke̱-na ake̱ nakai ṅmle̱tſā le̱ no̱ noṅṅ ní Iesu kē̱le̱ ake̱: Obi le̱ he ewale̱ le̱; ni eke̱ ewe le̱ fẽ hé ye.

english_verse: This was the second miracle that Jesus worked after he left Judea and went to Galilee.
translation_verse: Asaṅ ene̱ dši okadi noni dši enyo̱ ni Iesu fe, beni edše̱ Iudea eba Galilea le̱.

english_verse: You have not believed his message, because you refused to have faith in the one he sent.
translation_verse: ni ewiemo̱ le̱ mõõ ši ye̱ nyemli; edšake̱ nyehee moni étšũle̱ le̱ nyeyee.

english_verse: Jesus told the people: I tell you for certain the Son cannot do anything on his own. He can do only what he sees the Father doing, and he does exactly what he sees the Father do.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ Iesu here no̱ ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Le̱le̱ṅ, le̱le̱ṅ, mīkē̱nye ake̱: Bi le̱ dientše̱ nyẽṅ eto eyiṅ efe noko, dša noni *enaä ake̱ tše̱ le̱ feo̱ le̱; edšake̱ nibii fẽ ní no feo le̱, nomei noṅṅ ni bi le̱ hũ feo̱. *

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has shown him everything he does. The Father will show him even greater things, and you will be amazed.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *tše̱ le̱ sumoo̱ bi le̱, ni etšõo̱le̱ nibii fiā ni le̱dientše̱ efeo̱ le̱, ni eetšõle̱ nitšumo̱i wudši ní fè ene̱mei tete, ni nyenā aakpe nyehe. *

english_verse: Just as the Father raises the dead and gives life, so the Son gives life to anyone he wants to.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo̱ni tše̱ le̱ tēo̱ gbohĩĩ aši ni ehãaame̱ wala le̱, nakai noṅṅ bi le̱ hũ hãa mei ní esumoo̱ le̱ wala.

english_verse: I tell you for certain the time will come, and it is already here, when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God. And those who listen to it will live!
translation_verse: Le̱le̱ṅ, le̱le̱ṅ, mīkē̱nye ake̱: Ṅmle̱tſā le̱ mība ni *éše̱ etã, ní gbohĩĩ le̱ aanu Nyoṅmo̱ bi le̱ gbē, ni mei ni nuo̱lē̱ ahĩe aatšẽ. *Ef.

english_verse: Don't be surprised! The time will come when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of Man,
translation_verse: Ene̱ akafenye nãkpe̱; edšake̱ ṅmle̱tſā le̱ mība, nõ mli ní mei fẽ ní yo̱ gbohĩĩabui le̱ amli le̱ aanu egbẽ,

english_verse: and they will come out of their graves. Everyone who has done good things will rise to life, but everyone who has done evil things will rise and be condemned.
translation_verse: ni ame̱adše kpo, mei ní efe ekpakpa le̱ aate ši ke̱-ate wala mli, ni mei ní ētšu nišāníi le̱ aate ši ke̱-ate kodšomo̱ le̱ mli.

english_verse: I cannot do anything on my own. The Father sent me, and he is the one who told me how to judge. I judge with fairness, because I obey him, and I don't just try to please myself. Witnesses to Jesus
translation_verse: Midientše̱ minyẽṅ miyiṅ mato mafe noko; boni minuo̱ le̱, nakai mikodšoo̱, ni mikodšomo̱ le̱ dšale̱ kodšomo̱ ni, edšake̱ mitaoo noni midientše̱ misumoo̱, ši moṅ noni tše̱ le̱ ní tšũmi le̱ sumoo̱. K.

english_verse: But there is someone else who speaks for me, and I know what he says is true.
translation_verse: Mokroko ye̱ ní yeo̱ mihe odase, ni mile ako̱ odase ní eyeo̱ ye̱ mihe le̱ ano̱kwaleṅ. K.

english_verse: I don't depend on what people say about me, but I tell you these things so that you may be saved.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, mitaoo gbomo ko odase; ši beni afe ní ahere nyeyiwala hewo̱ miwieo̱ ene̱mei ne̱.

english_verse: John was a lamp that gave a lot of light, and you were glad to enjoy his light for a while.
translation_verse: Le̱ dši kane ní tšoo̱ ni dšidšeo̱ le̱, ši nye le̱, nyesumo̱ ake̱ nyemli aflinye be kukuō ke̱ke̱ ye̱ ela le̱ mli.

english_verse: But something more important than John speaks for me. I mean the things that the Father has given me to do! All of these speak for me and prove that the Father sent me.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, miye̱ odase ní fè Iohane nõ le̱; edšake̱ nitšumo̱i le̱ ni tše̱ le̱ ehãmi ake̱ migbe nā le̱, nakai nitšumo̱i ni mitšuo̱ le̱ noṅṅ yeo̱ mihe odase ake̱ tše̱ le̱ tšũmi.

english_verse: The Father who sent me also speaks for me, but you have never heard his voice or seen him face to face.
translation_verse: Ni tše̱ le̱ ni tšũmi le̱, le̱dientše̱ éye mihe odase. Nyenuko egbē dã le̱, asaṅ nyenako esubãṅ dã; Mat.

english_verse: You search the Scriptures, because you think you will find eternal life in them. The Scriptures tell about me,
translation_verse: Nyetaoa ṅmãle̱i le̱ amli, edšake̱ nyedientše̱ nyesusuo̱ ake̱ nomei amli nyenáa nāno̱ wala ye̱, ni nomei noṅṅ dši nii ni yeo̱ mihe odase le̱. Luk

english_verse: but you refuse to come to me for eternal life.
translation_verse: Ni nyesumo̱o̱ ake̱ nyebaä miṅõ ni nyená wala.

english_verse: I don't care about human praise,
translation_verse: Mitaoo gbomei ahĩenyam.

english_verse: but I do know that none of you love God.
translation_verse: Ši moṅ mikpanye ši ake̱ nyebe̱ Nyoṅmo̱ suomo̱ yo̱ nyemli.

english_verse: How could you possibly believe? You like to have your friends praise you, and you don't care about praise that the only God can give!
translation_verse: Nye ni nyehaä nyeteṅ anumnyam he, ši *anumnyam ní dše̱o̱ Nyoṅmo̱ kome le̱ ṅõ le̱ nyedii se̱, té aafe tēṅ ní nyeanyẽ nyehé nyeyeṅ? *

english_verse: Don't think that I will be the one to accuse you to the Father. You have put your hope in Moses, yet he is the very one who will accuse you.
translation_verse: Nyekasusua ake̱ mibaflo̱ nyenā mahã tše̱ le̱; moko ye̱ ni mīflo̱ nyenā, le̱ dši *Mose, mo noṅṅ no̱ ní nyeṅōo̱ nyehĩe nyefõo̱ le̱. *

english_verse: Moses wrote about me, and if you had believed Moses, you would have believed me.
translation_verse: Ši edši nyehé Mose nyeye kũle̱, mi hū nyeahemi nyeye; ši mihe sane eṅmã le̱.

english_verse: But if you don't believe what Moses wrote, how can you believe what I say?
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši nyehee eṅmãle̱i le̱ nyeyee le̱, té afe tēṅ ní nyeahe miwiemo̱i le̱ nyeyeṅ? Luk

english_verse: The disciples wanted to take him into the boat, but suddenly the boat reached the shore where they were headed. The Bread That Gives Life
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ ame̱sumo̱ ake̱ ame̱ṅõle̱ ke̱-ba le̱le̱ le̱ mli, ni amrõ le̱ le̱le̱ le̱ yakpleke he ní ame̱yaä le̱.

english_verse: They replied, “What miracle will you work, so that we can have faith in you? What will you do?
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Bĕle̱ mẽ okadi ofeo̱, ni wó̱na koni wó̱heo wo̱ye? Meni otšuo̱?

english_verse: “There is a boy here who has five small loaves of barley bread and two fish. But what good is that with all these people?”
translation_verse: Gbekẽnū ko ye̱ bie̱ ni yo̱ barle-aboloi enumo̱ ke̱ lōi bibii enyo̱; ši mei pī ne̱, ame̱nẽgbe̱ ene̱ še̱o̱?

english_verse: Jesus realized that they would try to force him to be their king. So he went up on a mountain, where he could be alone. Jesus Walks on the Water (Matthew
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱, beni Iesu yo ake̱ ame̱baba ni ame̱bamõle̱ ní ame̱yawole̱ maṅtše̱ le̱, ekometō egbla ehe ši ke̱-te goṅ le̱ no̱ ekoṅ.

english_verse: One of the prophets wrote, “God will teach all of them.” And so everyone who listens to the Father and learns from him will come to me.
translation_verse: Aṅmā ye̱ *gbalo̱i le̱ amli ake̱: “Ame̱fẽ ame̱afe Nyoṅmo̱ kaselo̱i.” Mofẽmo ni enu ye̱ tše̱ le̱ nā ni ekase hũ le̱, ebaã miṅõ. *Ies.

english_verse: They started arguing with each other and asked, “How can he give us his flesh to eat?”
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ Iudafoi le̱ tātā nā ye̱ ame̱teṅ ame̱kē̱: Té mone̱ bafe tēṅ ní enyẽ eṅõ ehelo ehãwo̱ ní wo̱yeṅ?

english_verse: When the disciples had rowed for five or six kilometers, they saw Jesus walking on the water. He kept coming closer to the boat, and they were terrified.
translation_verse: Ni heni amé̱w̌iri aafe stadioi nyoṅmai-enyo̱ ke̱ enumo̱ lo nyoṅmai-etẽ le̱, ame̱na Iesu nyie ṅšo̱ le̱ hĩe ni ēbe̱ṅke̱ le̱le̱ le̱, ni ame̱še gbeyei.

english_verse: But he said, “I am Jesus! Don't be afraid!”
translation_verse: Ši ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Miṅ, nyekašea gbeyei.

english_verse: some boats from Tiberias sailed near the place where the crowd had eaten the bread for which the Lord had given thanks.
translation_verse: tše̱bele̱ le̱dši krokomei dše̱ Tiberia ba heni Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ *da ši ní ame̱ye abolo le̱ ye̱ le̱ mase̱i; *K.

english_verse: They found him on the west side of the lake and asked, “Rabbi, when did you get here?”
translation_verse: Ni heni ame̱banale̱ ye̱ ṅšo̱ le̱ se̱ le̱, ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Rabi, té be ni oba bie̱ṅ?

english_verse: I have told you already that you have seen me and still do not have faith in me.
translation_verse: Ši *mikē̱nye ake̱ nyénami, ni kẽle̱ nyehee nyeyee. *K.

english_verse: Everything and everyone that the Father has given me will come to me, and I won't turn any of them away.
translation_verse: Mei fẽ ní tše̱ le̱ ṅõ-hãami le̱ aaba miṅõ, ni moni baä miṅõ le̱, *miſieṅle̱ ko̱kō̱ko̱. *

english_verse: I didn't come from heaven to do what I want! I came to do what the Father wants me to do. He sent me,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ dšee midĩentše̱ misuomo̱nānii femo̱ hewo̱ midše̱ ṅwei miba, ši moṅ moni tšũmi le̱ suomo̱nānii femo̱.

english_verse: and he wants to make certain that none of the ones he has given me will be lost. Instead, he wants me to raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Ši ene̱ dši tše̱ ní tšũmi le̱ suomo̱nānii le̱, ake̱ mei fẽ ní éṅõ-hãmi le̱, mikahã ame̱teṅ moko mīlādše, ši moṅ mitẽle̱ ši ekoṅ ye̱ nāgbēgbĩ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: My Father wants everyone who sees the Son to have faith in him and to have eternal life. Then I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ene̱ dši mitše̱ suomo̱nānii le̱, ake̱ mofẽmo ní kwe̱o̱ bi le̱ ni eheo̱ eno̱ eyeo̱ le̱ aná nāno̱ wala, ni mi le̱ *mitēle̱ ši ekoṅ ye̱ nāgbēgbĩ le̱ no. *

english_verse: The people started grumbling because Jesus had said he was the bread that had come down from heaven.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iudafoi le̱ wie ehe hũhũhũ, ake̱ ekē̱ ake̱: Midši abolo nĩ dše̱ ṅwei le̱;

english_verse: They were asking each other, “Isn't he Jesus, the son of Joseph? Don't we know his father and mother? How can he say that he has come down from heaven?”
translation_verse: ni ame̱kē̱: Ani dšee Iosef bi Iesu le̱ ní wo̱le etše̱ ke̱ enye le̱ ne̱? Té tēṅ mo̱ ní ekē̱o̱ ake̱: Midše̱ ṅwei le̱? Luk.

english_verse: The only one who has seen the Father is the one who has come from him. No one else has ever seen the Father.
translation_verse: Dšee ake̱ moko éna tše̱ le̱ pẽṅ, dša moni dše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ṅō le̱, le̱ ēna tše̱ le̱.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who has faith in me has eternal life.
translation_verse: Le̱le̱ṅ, le̱le̱ṅ, mīkē̱nye ake: Moni heo̱ míno̱ yeo̱ le̱ eye̱ nāno̱ wala.

english_verse: I am the bread that gives life!
translation_verse: Midši wala abolo le̱. K.

english_verse: But the bread from heaven has come down, so that no one who eats it will ever die.
translation_verse: Ene̱ dši abolo ní dše̱o̱ ṅwei baã le̱, koni gbomo aye ní ekagbo.

english_verse: I am that bread from heaven! Everyone who eats it will live forever. My flesh is the life-giving bread I give to the people of this world.
translation_verse: Midsi abolo ní hĩe kã ní dše̱ ṅwei ba le̱; ke̱dši moko ye abolo ne̱ eko le̱, ehĩe aakã ke̱-ate nāno̱. Ši abolo ní mĩke̱-bahã le̱, dši mihelo ni mike̱-bahã *ye̱ dše le̱ wala hewo le̱. *Heb.

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that you won't live unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iesu kē̱ame̱ ake̱: Le̱le̱ṅ, le̱le̱ṅ, mīkē̱nye ake̱: Ke̱dši nyeyee gbomobi le̱ helo ni nyenuu elá le̱, nyebe̱ wala ye̱ nyemli.

english_verse: But if you do eat my flesh and drink my blood, you will have eternal life, and I will raise you to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Moni yeo̱ mihelo ni enuo̱ mila le̱, eye̱ nãno̱ wala, ni mi le̱ matēle̱ ši ye̱ nāgbēgbĩ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: My flesh is the true food, and my blood is the true drink.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mihelo le̱ ano̱kwa ṅmā̃ ni, ni milá le̱ ano̱kwa numo̱nõ ni.

english_verse: If you eat my flesh and drink my blood, you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Moni yeo̱ mihelo ni enuo̱ milá le̱, *ehĩo̱ mimli, ni mi hũ mihĩo̱ emli. *

english_verse: The living Father sent me, and I have life because of him. Now everyone who eats my flesh will live because of me.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni tše̱, hĩekālo̱ le̱, tšũmi, ni tše̱ le̱ hewo̱ mihĩe kā le̱, nakai noṅṅ moni yeo̱mi le̱ hũ hĩe aakã ye̱ mihewo̱.

english_verse: The bread that comes down from heaven isn't like what your ancestors ate. They died, but whoever eats this bread will live forever.
translation_verse: Abolo ní dše̱ ṅwei ba ne̱, tamo̱o̱ mána ní nyetše̱mei le̱ ye ni ame̱gboi le̱; moni yeo̱ abolo ne̱, ehĩe aakã ke̱-ate nāno̱.

english_verse: Jesus was teaching in a synagogue in Capernaum when he said these things. The Words of Eternal Life
translation_verse: Ewie nii ne̱, beni etšōo̱ nii ye̱ kpēhe ko ye̱ Kapernaum le̱.

english_verse: Many of Jesus' disciples heard him and said, “This is too hard for anyone to understand.”
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, beni ekaselo̱i le̱ ateṅ mei pī nu ene̱ le̱, ame̱kē̱: Wiemo̱ ni wa ne̱; namo aanyẽ toi abo?

english_verse: Jesus knew that his disciples were grumbling. So he asked, “Does this bother you?
translation_verse: Ši beni Iesu yo ake̱ ekaselo̱i le̱ mīhũhū̃ ye̱ ene̱ hewo̱ le̱, ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Ani ene̱ tōtõo̱ nyenane ne̱?

english_verse: What if you should see the Son of Man go up to heaven where he came from?
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši nyena gbomobi le̱ miya ṅwei heni eyo̱ sá le̱, no hũ?

english_verse: But some of you refuse to have faith in me.” Jesus said this, because from the beginning he knew who would have faith in him. He also knew which one would betray him.
translation_verse: Ši nyeteṅ meikomei ye̱ ni hee yee. Edšake̱ Iesu le ke̱-dše̱ šišidšē le̱ mei ní hee yee le̱ ke̱ *mo hũ ní batšõ ese̱gbe̱ le̱. *

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “You cannot come to me, unless the Father makes you want to come. That is why I have told these things to all of you.”
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱: Ene̱hewo̱ mikē̱nye ake̱: Moko nyẽṅ miṅõ aba, dša tše̱ le̱ éhãle̱ hegbe̱ le̱. K.

english_verse: Because of what Jesus said, many of his disciples turned their backs on him and stopped following him.
translation_verse: Dše̱ no no̱ le̱ ekaselo̱i le̱ ateṅ mei pī kũ ame̱se̱ ni ame̱ke̱le̱ enyiee doṅṅ.

english_verse: Jesus then asked his twelve disciples if they also were going to leave him.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iesu kē̱ mei nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱ lo̱ ake̱: Ani nye hũ nyemīsumo̱ ake̱ nyeate?

english_verse: Simon Peter answered, “Lord, there is no one else that we can go to! Your words give eternal life.
translation_verse: Simon Petro herele̱ no̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, namo ṅõ wo̱o̱te? Bo oyo̱ *nāno̱ wala wiemoi le̱; *K.

english_verse: We have faith in you, and we are sure that you are God's Holy One.”
translation_verse: ni wo̱ le̱ wó̱he wó̱ye ni asaṅ wo̱ná wo̱le ake̱ *bo dši Kristo, Nyoṅmo hĩekãlo̱ le bi le̱! *

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “I chose all twelve of you, but one of you is a demon!”
translation_verse: Iesu hereame̱ no̱ ake̱: Ani dšee nyeyi nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱ mihala? ši nyeteṅ mokome le̱ abonsam ni.

english_verse: Jesus was talking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. He would later betray Jesus, even though he was one of the twelve disciples.
translation_verse: Ši Iuda Iskariot, Simon bi le̱, he ewieo le̱; edšake̱ le̱ dši mei nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱ le̱ ateṅ mokome ní batšõ ese̱gbe̱ le̱.

english_verse: Don't judge by appearances. Judge by what is right.
translation_verse: Nyekakwe̱a hīeaṅ nyekodšoa, ši moṅ nyekodšoa dšale̱ kodšomo̱.

english_verse: Some of the people from Jerusalem were saying, “Isn't this the man they want to kill?
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱ Ierusalembii le̱ ateṅ meikomei kē̱: Ani dšee moni ame̱taoo̱le̱ ame̱gbe le̱ ne̱? K.

english_verse: Yet here he is, speaking for everyone to hear. And no one is arguing with him. Do you suppose the authorities know he is the Messiah?
translation_verse: Ni na, faṅṅ ewieo ye̱ ne̱, ni ame̱kē̱ē̱le̱ noko. Ekole̱ bene̱ onukpai le̱ ená ele ake̱ Kristo le̱ dši mone̱ le̱le̱ṅ?

english_verse: A lot of people in the crowd put their faith in him and said, “When the Messiah comes, he surely won't perform more miracles than this man has done!” Officers Sent To Arrest Jesus
translation_verse: Ši asafoi le̱ ateṅ *mei pī hé eno̱ ame̱ye, ni ame̱kē̱ ake̱: Beni Kristo aaba le̱, ani eefe okadii pī fè nii ní mone̱ feo̱ ne̱? *

english_verse: When the Pharisees heard the crowd arguing about Jesus, they got together with the chief priests and sent some temple police to arrest him.
translation_verse: Farisifoi le̱ nu ake̱ asafo le̱ mīwiewie nii ne̱ ye̱ ehewo̱; ni Farisifoi le̱ ke̱ oso̱fonukpai le̱ tšũ tšũdši, koni ame̱yamõle̱.

english_verse: You will look for me, but you won't find me. You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Nyeataomi ni nyenaṅmi, ni heni miyo̱ le̱, nyenyẽṅ dše̱i nyeba.

english_verse: The people asked each other, “Where can he go to keep us from finding him? Is he going to some foreign country where our people live? Is he going there to teach the Greeks?
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ Iudafoi le̱ kē̱kē̱ amehe ake̱: Nẽgbe̱ mone̱ baya ní wo̱naṅle̱? Ani mei ni éſã Helafoi le̱ ateṅ le̱ aṅõ ebaya, ní eyatšõ Helafoi le̱ anii?

english_verse: On the last and most important day of the festival, Jesus stood up and shouted, “If you are thirsty, come to me and drink!
translation_verse: Ši *nāgbēgbĩ ní dši gbĩĩ dšudši le̱ ateṅ gbĩ wulu le̱ no̱ le̱, Iesu yadamo̱ ši ni ebo ekē̱: Ke̱dši †kũmai miye moko le̱, hã mo le̱ aba miṅõ ni ebanu, *

english_verse: Have faith in me, and you will have life-giving water flowing from deep inside you, just as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: moni heo̱ mino̱ eyeo̱ le̱, — *bo̱ni ṅmãle̱ le̱ kē̱o̱ le̱, walanu fāi adše̱ emũsũ mli aho. *Ies.

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the Holy Spirit, who would be given to everyone that had faith in him. The Spirit had not yet been given to anyone, since Jesus had not yet been given his full glory. The People Take Sides
translation_verse: Ši Mumo̱ le̱ ní mei ní heo̱ eno̱ yeo̱ le̱ baná le̱ hewo̱ ewie ne̱; ši Mumo̱ kroṅkroṅ le̱ náko aba, edšake̱ anáko awo Iesu hĩe nyam.

english_verse: When the crowd heard Jesus say this, some of them said, “He must be the Prophet!”
translation_verse: Beni asafoi le̱ ateṅ mei pī nu wiemo̱ ne̱ le̱, ame̱kē̱: *Gbalo̱ le̱ ne̱ le̱le̱ṅ. *

english_verse: The people started taking sides against each other because of Jesus.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mligblamo̱ ba asafo le̱ teṅ ye̱ ehewo̱.

english_verse: Some of them wanted to arrest him, but no one laid a hand on him. The Leaders Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus
translation_verse: Ši kũle̱ ame̱teṅ meikomei mītao ake̱ amemõole̱, ši kẽle moko nyẽẽ ehe ata. K.

english_verse: When the temple police returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, they were asked, “Why didn't you bring Jesus here?”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni tšũdši le̱ kpale ke̱-te oso̱fonukpai le̱ ke̱ Farisifoi le̱ aṅõ, ni nomei biame̱ ake̱: Mẽba ni nyeke̱le̱ baa?

english_verse: They answered, “No one has ever spoken like this man!”
translation_verse: Tšũdši le̱ here no̱ ake̱: Bo̱ni gbomo ne̱ wieo̱ le, moko ewieko nakai dã. Mat.

english_verse: The Pharisees said to them, “Have you also been fooled?
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le Farisifoi le̱ hereame̱ no̱ ake̱: Ani nye hũ alakanye?

english_verse: Not one of the chief priests or the Pharisees has faith in him.
translation_verse: Ani onukpai le̱ lo Farisifoi le̱ ateṅ moko éhe eno̱ éye?

english_verse: And these people who don't know the Law are under God's curse anyway.”
translation_verse: Ši asafo ní lee mla ne̱, alomo̱ame̱.

english_verse: “Our Law doesn't let us condemn people before we hear what they have to say. We cannot judge them before we know what they have done.”
translation_verse: Ké̱ anuko moko dāṅ gbē ní ale noni efe le̱, *wo̱mla le̱ buole̱ fo̱ lo? *

english_verse: Then they said, “Nicodemus, you must be from Galilee! Read the Scriptures, and you will find that no prophet is to come from Galilee.” A Woman Caught in Sin
translation_verse: Ame̱here no̱ ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Ani bo hũ Galilea odše̱? Taomo̱ mli okwe̱, ši gbalo̱ ko eteko ši ke̱-dšeko Galilea pẽṅ. K.

english_verse: Everyone else went home,
translation_verse: Ni ame̱teṅ mofẽmo te ewe.

english_verse: “No sir,” the woman answered. Then Jesus told her, “I am not going to accuse you either. You may go now, but don't sin anymore.” Jesus Is the Light for the World
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱: Moko ebukomi fo̱, Nuṅtšo̱. Ni Iesu kē̱le̱ ake̱: Bĕle̱ mi hũ mibuuo fo̱; ši ya ni *okafe eša doṅṅ. *

english_verse: Your Law requires two witnesses to prove that something is true.
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ nyemla le̱ mli hũ aṅmā ake̱: Mei enyo̱ odase le̱ ano̱kwaṅ.

english_verse: “Where is your Father?” they asked. “You don't know me or my Father!” Jesus answered. “If you knew me, you would know my Father.”
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Nẽgbe̱ otše̱ le̱ yo̱? Iesu here no̱ ake̱: Nyeleemi ni nyesã nyelee mitše̱; nyelemi dšikũle̱, nyeale mitše̱ hũ. —

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You are from below, but I am from above. You belong to this world, but I don't.
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nye le̱ nyedše̱ šiši ne̱, mi le̱ midše̱ ṅwei; nye le̱ nyedše̱ dše ne̱ mli, mi le̱ midše̱e̱ dše ne̱ mli.

english_verse: This is why I said you will die with your sins unforgiven. If you don't have faith in me for who I am, you will die, and your sins will not be forgiven.”
translation_verse: Nohewo ni mikē̱nye ake̱ nyeagboi ye̱ nyehe ešai le̱ amli le̱; edšake̱ ké̱ nyehee nyeyee ake̱ mi ne̱ dšile̱ le̱, nyebagboi ye̱ nyehe ešai le̱ amli.

english_verse: “Who are you?” they asked Jesus. Jesus answered, “I am exactly who I told you at the beginning.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Namo dšio? Ni Iesu kē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nõ noṅṅ ní mikē̱o̱-nye ke̱-dše̱ šišidšē le̱.

english_verse: There is a lot more I could say to condemn you. But the one who sent me is truthful, and I tell the people of this world only what I have heard from him.”
translation_verse: Miye̱ nyehe sãdši pī ní mawie ni mike̱-akodšonye; ši kẽle̱ moni tšũmi le̱ ano̱kwafoṅ, ni mi le̱, nii ní minu ye̱ enā le̱, ne̱ke̱ nii ne̱ noṅṅ miwieo̱ mitšõo̱ dše le̱.

english_verse: No one understood that Jesus was talking to them about the Father.
translation_verse: Ame̱lee ake̱ tše̱ le̱ hewo̱ eke̱ame̱ wieo̱ le̱.

english_verse: The one who sent me is with me. I always do what pleases him, and he will never leave me.”
translation_verse: Ni moni tšũmi le̱ ke̱mi ye̱, tše̱ le̱ *šĩko mikome, edšake̱ mi le̱, noni sa ehīe mifeo dã. *K.

english_verse: After Jesus said this, many of the people put their faith in him. The Truth Will Set You Free
translation_verse: Beni ewieo̱ nii ne̱ le̱, mei pī he eno̱ ye.

english_verse: You will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
translation_verse: ni nyeale ano̱kwale le̱, ni ano̱kwale le̱ aahã nyeye nyehe.

english_verse: They answered, “We are Abraham's children! We have never been anyone's slaves. How can you say we will be set free?”
translation_verse: Ame̱herele̱ no̱ ake̱: Abraham sešibii dšiwo̱, ni wo̱tšṍmo̱ko moko nyṍdši pēṅ; té tēṅ ní bo okē̱o ake̱: Nyeaye nyeheṅ? Mat

english_verse: Jesus replied: I tell you for certain that anyone who sins is a slave of sin!
translation_verse: Iesu hereame̱ no̱ ake̱: Le̱le̱ṅ, le̱le̱ṅ, mīkē̱nye ake̱: Mofẽmo ní feo̱ eša le̱, eša le̱ nyṍṅ dšile̱. Rom.

english_verse: And slaves don't stay in the family forever, though the Son will always remain in the family.
translation_verse: Nyṍṅ ehĩĩ šĩa ke̱-yaa nāno̱; ši bi hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä nāno̱.

english_verse: If the Son gives you freedom, you are free!
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, ke̱dši bi le̱ hã nyeye nyehe le̱, no nyeaye nyehe le̱le̱ṅ. Rom.

english_verse: I am telling you what my Father has shown me, just as you are doing what your father has taught you. Your Father Is the Devil
translation_verse: Mi le̱, nii ní mina ye̱ mitše̱ be le̱, no miwieo̱; ni nye hũ, nii ní nyenu ye̱ nyetše̱ na le̱, no nyefeo̱.

english_verse: The people said to Jesus, “Abraham is our father!” Jesus replied, “If you were Abraham's children, you would do what Abraham did.
translation_verse: Ame̱here no̱ ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Wo̱tše̱ dši Abraham. Iesu kē̱ame̱ ake̱: Abraham bii dšinye dšikũle̱, nyeatšu Abraham nitšumo̱i.

english_verse: Jesus answered: If God were your Father, you would love me, because I came from God and now I am here. He sent me. I did not come on my own.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱ Iesu kē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyoṅmo̱ dši nyetše̱ kũle̱, nyeasumo̱mi; edšake̱ mi le̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ṅõ midše̱ miba; ni asaṅ mitoo midientše̱ miyi mibaa, ši moṅ le̱ etšũmi.

english_verse: Why can't you understand what I am talking about? Can't you stand to hear what I am saying?
translation_verse: Ši mẽhewo̱ nyenaa miwiemo̱ nā le̱? Edše̱ miwiemo̱ toi ni nyeboo le̱.

english_verse: Your father is the devil, and you do exactly what he wants. He has always been a murderer and a liar. There is nothing truthful about him. He speaks on his own, and everything he says is a lie. Not only is he a liar himself, but he is also the father of all lies.
translation_verse: Nye le̱ *nyetše̱ ní nyedše̱ emli dši abonsam, ni nyetše̱ le̱ tšinebānii nyesumoo̱ ake̱ nyefe. Le̱ le̱ †gbomogbelo̱ dšile̱ ke̱-dše̱ tetēte, ni **edamo̱o̱ ano̱kwale le̱ mli, edšake̱ ano̱kwale be̱ emli. Ké̱ ēmale le̱, le̱dientše̱ enii ahe ewieo̱, edšake̱ amalelo̱ ke̱ malemo̱tše̱ dšile̱. *

english_verse: Everything I have told you is true, and you still refuse to have faith in me.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, ake̱-ní miwieo̱ ano̱kwale hewo̱ le̱, nyeheemi nyeyee.

english_verse: Can any of you accuse me of sin? If you cannot, why won't you have faith in me? After all, I am telling you the truth.
translation_verse: *Nyeteṅ namo kãami ye̱ eša ko hewo̱? Ši ke̱dši miwie ano̱kwale le̱, mẽhewo̱ ni nyeheemi nyeyee le̱? *

english_verse: The people told Jesus, “We were right to say that you are a Samaritan and that you have a demon in you!”
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ Iudafoi le̱ here no̱ ni ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Ani dšee egbe̱nā wo̱kē̱o̱ ake̱ Samarianyo dšio, ni *daimonio hũ ye̱ omli? *

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I don't have a demon in me. I honor my Father, and you refuse to honor me.
translation_verse: Iesu here no̱ ake: Daimonio be̱ mimli, ši miwo mitše̱, ni nye le̱ nyemīgbe mihe guo̱ moṅ.

english_verse: years old!” they said. “How could you have seen Abraham?”
translation_verse: Mitaoo midientše̱ minumnyam; ši moko ye̱ ni taoo̱ ni ekodšoo̱.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you obey my words, you will never die.”
translation_verse: Le̱le̱ṅ, le̱le̱ṅ, mīkē̱nye ake̱: Ke̱dši moko ye miwiemo̱ le̱ no̱ le̱, enaṅ gbẽle ke̱-ate nāno̱.

english_verse: Then the people said, “Now we are sure that you have a demon. Abraham is dead, and so are the prophets. How can you say that no one who obeys your words will ever die?
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱ Iudafoi le̱ kē̱le̱ ake̱: Kpāko wo̱ná wo̱le ake̱ daimonio ye̱ omli. Abraham gbo, ni gbaloi le̱ hũ gboi, ni bo le̱ okē̱o̱ ake̱: Ke̱dši moko ye miwiemo̱ le̱ no̱ le̱, esaṅ enā gbĕle kwrā ke̱-ate nāno̱.

english_verse: Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are?”
translation_verse: Ani ofè wo̱tše̱ Abraham ní gbo le̱? ni gbalo̱i le̱ hũ gboi. Té otšé̱o̱ ohe tēṅ ne̱?

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If I honored myself, it would mean nothing. My Father is the one who honors me. You claim that he is your God,
translation_verse: Iesu here no̱ ake̱: Ke̱dši miwo midientše̱ mihĩe nyam le̱, minumnyam le̱ dšee noko; mitše̱ dši moni woo̱ mihĩe nyam, moni nyekē̱o̱ ake̱ nye-Nyoṅmo̱ dšile̱ le̱,

english_verse: even though you don't really know him. If I said I didn't know him, I would be a liar, just like all of you. But I know him, and I do what he says.
translation_verse: ni *nyeyokole̱, ši mi le̱ milele̱; ni ke̱dši mikē̱ ake̱ mileele̱ le̱, matšṍ amalelo̱ tamo̱nye; ši milele̱, ni miyeo̱ ewiemo̱ no̱. *

english_verse: Your father Abraham was really glad to see me.”
translation_verse: Nyetše̱ Abraham mli flile̱ ake̱ eena migbĩ le̱, ni ena ni emī še̱.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that even before Abraham was, I was, and I am.”
translation_verse: Iesu kē̱ame̱ ake̱: Le̱le̱ṅ, le̱le̱ṅ, mīkē̱nye ake̱: Miye̱ dãni Abraham yo̱.

english_verse: The people picked up stones to kill Jesus, but he hid and left the temple.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni *ame̱kŏ̱lo̱ tei ní ame̱batſiale̱; ši Iesu tē ehe, ni edše so̱lemo̱we le̱ ete. *

english_verse: “No, it wasn't!” Jesus answered. “But because of his blindness, you will see God work a miracle for him.
translation_verse: Iesu here no̱ ekē̱: Dšee mone̱ lo eſo̱lo̱i ni fe eša, ši moṅ beni afe ní *Nyoṅmo̱ nitšumo̱ĩ le̱ aná adše kpo ye̱ emli. *

english_verse: After Jesus said this, he spit on the ground. He made some mud and smeared it on the man's eyes.
translation_verse: Beni ekē̱ ene̱ le̱, etšẽ ladšõ efo ši, ni eke̱ ladšõ le̱ kpo̱to̱ sũ, ni eṅõ sũ le̱ ekpá ſilafo le̱ hĩṅme̱ii ano̱, Mar.

english_verse: The man's neighbors and the people who had seen him begging wondered if he really could be the same man.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱ ekūṅbii ke̱ mei ní nale̱ sá ake sisẽlo̱ dšile̱ le̱ kē̱: Ani dšee moni kũle̱ etaa ši ni esisẽo̱ le̱ ne̱?

english_verse: “Then how can you see?” they asked.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Té fe tēṅ ní ohĩṅme̱ii le̱ gbleṅ?

english_verse: The day when Jesus made the mud and healed the man was a Sabbath. So the people took the man to the Pharisees.
translation_verse: Ši gbĩ ni Iesu kpo̱to̱ sũ ní egble ehĩṅme̱ii le̱ hedšō̱mo̱gbĩ ni.

english_verse: they asked the man, “What do you say about this one who healed your eyes?” “He is a prophet!” the man told them.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ame̱kē̱ ſilafo le̱ ekoṅ ake̱: Bo hũ, té okē̱o̱ ye̱ ehe tēṅ, ake̱-ní egble ohĩṅme̱ii le̱? Ni ekē̱: Gbalo̱ dšile̱.

english_verse: But the Jewish leaders would not believe that the man had once been blind. They sent for his parents
translation_verse: Ši Iudafoi le̱ hee yee ake̱ ſilafo dšile̱ sá dãni enaä nii ne̱, ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni ame̱yatšé̱ moni ena nii le̱ fo̱lo̱i,

english_verse: The man's parents answered, “We are certain that he is our son, and we know that he was born blind.
translation_verse: Efo̱lo̱i le̱ hereame̱ no̱ ame̱kē̱: Wo̱le ake̱ wo̱bi le̱ ne̱, ni we̱le ake̱ afó̱le ſilafo;

english_verse: But we don't know how he got his sight or who gave it to him. Ask him! He is old enough to speak for himself.”
translation_verse: ši bo̱ni fe ní enaä nii agbe̱ne̱ ne̱, wolee, asaṅ moni gble ehĩṅme̱ii le̱ hũ wo̱lee; éda, nyebiale̱, le̱dientše̱ eewie ehã ehe.

english_verse: The leaders called the man back and said, “Swear by God to tell the truth! We know that Jesus is a sinner.”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ame̱tšé̱ nū ní sá ni edši ſilafo le̱, noni dši ši enyo̱, ni ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Ṅõ anumnyam *ohã Nyoṅmo̱; ši wo̱ le̱ wo̱le ake̱ gbomo ne̱ ešafelo dšile̱. *Ios.

english_verse: The man replied, “I don't know if he is a sinner or not. All I know is that I used to be blind, but now I can see!”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ehere no̱ ekē̱: Ešafelo̱ dšile̱ dšĩṅ, milee; nokome mile, ake̱ kũle̱ ſilafo dšimi, ši agbe̱ne̱ mina nii.

english_verse: The man answered, “I have already told you once, and you refused to listen. Why do you want me to tell you again? Do you also want to become his disciples?”
translation_verse: Ehereame̱ no̱ ake̱: Mikē̱nye momo, ni nyenuu; mẽhewo̱ nyetaoo̱ toi nyebo ekoṅ? Ani nye hũ nyemīsumo̱ ake̱ nyeatšṍmo̱ ekaselo̱i?

english_verse: The leaders insulted the man and said, “You are his follower! We are followers of Moses.
translation_verse: Ame̱dšé̱le̱ ame̱kē̱: Bo odši ekaselo̱, ši wo̱ le̱, Mose kaselo̱i dši wo̱.

english_verse: “How strange!” the man replied. “He healed my eyes, and yet you don't know where he comes from.
translation_verse: Nū le̱ here no̱ ni ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Ei, ene̱ dši noni yo̱ nākpe̱, ake̱ nyelee heni edše̱, ni kẽle̱ égble mihĩṅme̱ii le̱!

english_verse: We know that God listens only to people who love and obey him. God doesn't listen to sinners.
translation_verse: Wo̱le ake̱ *Nyoṅmo̱ boo ešafelo̱i atoi; ši moṅ ke̱dši mo dšáa Nyoṅmo̱ ni efeo̱ esuomo̱nānii le̱, le̱ toi eboo̱. *Ies.

english_verse: And this is the first time in history anyone has ever given sight to someone born blind.
translation_verse: Ke̱-dše̱ ní abo̱ ade ne̱ anuko ake̱ moko égble moni afó̱le̱ ſilafo hĩṅme̱ii dã.

english_verse: Jesus could not do anything unless he came from God.”
translation_verse: Ke̱dši mone̱ dše̱e̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ṅõ kũle̱, enyẽṅ noko efe. K.

english_verse: The leaders told the man, “You have been a sinner since the day you were born! Do you think you can teach us anything?” Then they said, “You can never come back into any of our synagogues!”
translation_verse: Ame̱here no̱ ni ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Bo le̱, *afó̱o ye̱ eša mli kwrā, ni bo moṅ otšõo̱we̱ nii ne̱? Ni ame̱ſiele̱. *K.

english_verse: When Jesus heard what had happened, he went and found the man. Then Jesus asked, “Do you have faith in the Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Iesu nu ake̱ ame̱ſiele̱; ni beni enale̱ le̱, ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Ōhe Nyoṅmo̱ bi le̱ no̱ ōye lo?

english_verse: He replied, “Sir, if you will tell me who he is, I will put my faith in him.”
translation_verse: Ehere no̱ ekē̱: Namo dšile̱, Nuṅtšo̱, koni mahe eno̱ maye?

english_verse: “You have already seen him,” Jesus answered, “and right now he is talking with you.”
translation_verse: Ši Iesu kē̱le̱ ake̱: Onale̱ momo, ni asaṅ moni ke̱o wieo̱ le̱, le̱ noṅṅ ni.

english_verse: The man said, “Lord, I put my faith in you!” Then he worshiped Jesus.
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱: Mīhe mīye, Nuṅtšo̱; ni edšale̱.

english_verse: Jesus told him, “I came to judge the people of this world. I am here to give sight to the blind and to make blind everyone who can see.”
translation_verse: Ni Iesu kē̱: Kodšomo̱ hewo̱ miba dše ne̱ṅ, koni mei ní enaa nii le̱ ána, ni mei ní naä le̱ atšṍmo ſilafoi. Mat

english_verse: When the Pharisees heard Jesus say this, they asked, “Are we blind?”
translation_verse: Ni Farisifoi le̱ ateṅ meikomei ní yo̱ dše̱i le̱ nu ene̱, ni ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Ani wo̱ hũ wo̱ſila?

english_verse: Jesus answered, “If you were blind, you would not be guilty. But now that you claim to see, you will keep on being guilty.”
translation_verse: Iesu kē̱ame̱ ake̱: Edši nyéſila moṅ kũle̱, nyehe be̱ eša; ši agbe̱ne̱ nyekē̱o̱ ake̱: Wo̱mīna nii; nohewo̱ le̱ nyehe eša le̱ éka nyehe. Abe̱i

english_verse: A thief comes only to rob, kill, and destroy. I came so everyone would have life, and have it fully.
translation_verse: Dšulo̱ baa yaka, ši dšū ke̱ gbē ke̱ hĩekpãtãmo̱ hewo̱ ebaä; mi le̱ miba beni afe ní ame̱ná wala ni ame̱ná ni ateke no̱. Lal.

english_verse: Hired workers are not like the shepherd. They don't own the sheep, and when they see a wolf coming, they run off and leave the sheep. Then the wolf attacks and scatters the flock.
translation_verse: Ši moni dši apāfonyo ni edšee tōi le̱ akwe̱lo̱, moni tōi le̱ dšee enõ le̱, naä ake̱ klaṅ mība, ni ešĩo̱ tōi le̱ edšoo̱ foi, ni klaṅ le̱ bamõmoo̱ame̱ ni egbe̱o̱ tōi le̱ amli eſãa.

english_verse: Hired workers run away because they don't care about the sheep.
translation_verse: Ši apāfonyo le̱ edšoo̱ foi, edšake̱ apāfonyo dšile̱, ni tōi le̱ ahe edo̱o̱le̱.

english_verse: I am the good shepherd. I know my sheep, and they know me.
translation_verse: Midši tōkwe̱lo̱ kpakpa le̱, ni *mile mei ní dši mimei, ni mimei le̱ hũ lemi, *

english_verse: Just as the Father knows me, I know the Father, and I give up my life for my sheep.
translation_verse: take̱ bo̱ni *tše̱ le̱ lemi, ni mi hũ mile tše̱ le̱; ni miṅõo̱ miwala miṅmẽo̱ ši ye̱ tōi le̱ anãdšiaṅ le̱. *Mat.

english_verse: The people took sides because of what Jesus had told them.
translation_verse: Wiemoi ne̱ ahewo̱ le̱ mligblamo̱ sā ba Iudafoi le̱ ateṅ ekoṅ.

english_verse: But others said, “How could anyone with a demon in him say these things? No one like this could give sight to a blind person!” Jesus Is Rejected
translation_verse: Meikomei hũ kē̱: Moni daimonio yo̱ emli wiemo̱i ne̱? ani daimonio aanyẽ ſilafo hĩṅmeii agble?

english_verse: That winter, Jesus was in Jerusalem for the Temple Festival.
translation_verse: Ši aye šo̱lemo̱tšũnāgblemo̱-kaimo̱-gbīdšŭrõ ye̱ Ierusalem, ni fẽibe ni.

english_verse: One day he was walking in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch,
translation_verse: Ni Iesu mīšĕra ši ye̱ so̱lemo̱we le̱ ye̱ *Salomo ablanā le̱ no̱. *Bo̱f.

english_verse: and the people gathered all around him. They said, “How long are you going to keep us guessing? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly!”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iudafoi le̱ babo̱le ehe, ni ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Mẽ beyino noṅṅ oohã wo̱yiṅ afewo̱ ko̱šiko̱ši ke̱-yaši? Ké̱ bo dši Kristo le̱, kē̱mo̱wo̱ faṅṅ.

english_verse: Jesus answered: I have told you, and you refused to believe me. The things I do by my Father's authority show who I am.
translation_verse: Iesu hereame̱ no̱ ake̱: Mikē̱nye, ni nyehee nyeyee. *Nitšumo̱i ní mitšuo̱ ye̱ mitše̱ gbe̱i ano̱ le̱, nomei mīye mihe odase; *

english_verse: My sheep know my voice, and I know them. They follow me,
translation_verse: Mitōi le̱ nuo̱ migbē, ni mile-ame̱, ni ame̱nyieo̱ mise̱, K.

english_verse: My Father gave them to me, and he is greater than all others. No one can snatch them from his hands,
translation_verse: Mitše̱ ní ṅõame̱ ehãmi le̱ fè mei fẽ, ni moko nyẽṅ ašõame̱ ye̱ mitše̱ deṅ.

english_verse: Once again the people picked up stones in order to kill Jesus.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iudafoi le̱ *kŏ̱lo̱ te̱i ekoṅ ake̱ ame̱batſĩale̱. *

english_verse: They answered, “We are not stoning you because of any good thing you did. We are stoning you because you did a terrible thing. You are just a man, and here you are claiming to be God!”
translation_verse: Iudafoi le̱ herele̱ no̱ ni āme̱kē̱: Dšee nitšumo̱ kpakpa ko hewo̱ wo̱batſiao te̱i le̱, ši moṅ musubō̱ hewo̱ṅ, edšako̱ bo ní gbomo dšio le̱ otšé̱o̱ ohe ake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ dšio.

english_verse: Jesus replied: In your Scriptures doesn't God say, “You are gods”?
translation_verse: Iesu hereame̱ no̱ ake̱: Ani *aṅmãko ye̱ nyemla le̱ mlĩ ake̱: “Mĩkē̱, nyoṅmo̱i dšinye?” *Lal.

english_verse: You can't argue with the Scriptures, and God spoke to those people and called them gods.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši mei aṅõ ní Nyoṅmo̱ wiemo̱ le̱ ba le̱ tete le̱ etšé̱ame̱ nyoṅmo̱i, ni anyēṅ ṅmãle̱ le̱ mli akũ le̱, —

english_verse: So why do you accuse me of a terrible sin for saying that I am the Son of God? After all, it is the Father who prepared me for this work. He is also the one who sent me into the world.
translation_verse: nyemīkē̱ ye̱ moni tše̱ le̱ efele̱ kroṅkroṅ ní etšũle̱ ke̱-ba dše le̱ mli le̱ hewo̱ ake̱: Obo̱ musu, ake̱-ní mĩkē̱ ake̱: Nyoṅmo̱ bi dšimi le̱?

english_verse: If I don't do as my Father does, you should not believe me.
translation_verse: Ké̱ mitšuu mitše̱ nitšumo̱i le̱, no le̱ nyekaheami nyeyea;

english_verse: But if I do what my Father does, you should believe because of that, even if you don't have faith in me. Then you will know for certain that the Father is one with me, and I am one with the Father.
translation_verse: ši ke̱dši mitšuo̱, ni kẽle̱ nyeheemi nyeyee le̱, nyehea nitšumo̱i le̱ nyeyea mo̱, koni nyele ni nyehe nyeye ake̱ tše̱ le̱ ye̱ mimli, ni mi hũ miye̱ tše̱ le̱ mli.

english_verse: Again they wanted to arrest Jesus. But he escaped
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ ame̱mĩtao ekoṅ ake̱ ame̱mõle̱, ni edše ame̱deṅ.

english_verse: and crossed the Jordan to the place where John had earlier been baptizing. While Jesus was there,
translation_verse: Ni eyiṅ ete Iordan se̱ ekoṅ, heni *Iohane baptisi ye̱ tšutšu le̱, ni eyahĩ dše̱i. *

english_verse: many people came to him. They were saying, “John didn't work any miracles, but everything he said about Jesus is true.”
translation_verse: Ni mei pī ba eṅō ni ame̱kē̱: Iohane efee okadi ko moṅ, ši nii fiā ní Iohane wie ye̱ nū ne̱ he le̱, ano̱kwaṅ.

english_verse: A lot of those people also put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Ni mei pī he ene̱ ye ye̱ dše̱i.

english_verse: Then he said to his disciples, “Now we will go back to Judea.”
translation_verse: Ni no se̱ le̱ ekē̱ ekaselo̱i le̱ ake̱: Nyehăa wo̱yaä Iudea ekoṅ.

english_verse: Then he told them, “Our friend Lazarus is asleep, and I am going there to wake him up.”
translation_verse: Ewie nii ne̱, ni no se̱ le̱ ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Wo̱šientše̱ Lazaro *ewo̱; ši mīya ni mayatšĩele̱ ye̱ wo̱ le̱ mli. *Mat.

english_verse: I am glad I wasn't there, because now you will have a chance to put your faith in me. Let's go to him.”
translation_verse: ni nyehewo̱ le̱ eṅõ minā ake̱ mibe̱ dše̱i le̱, beni afe ní nyehe nyeye; ši nyehãa wo̱yaä eṅõ.

english_verse: Martha answered, “I know he will be raised to life on the last day, when all the dead are raised.”
translation_verse: Marta kē̱le̱ ake̱: Mile ake̱ *ebate ši ye̱ ghohĩĩašitē le̱ mli ye nāgbēgbĩ le̱ no̱. *

english_verse: As soon as Mary heard this, she got up and went out to Jesus.
translation_verse: Le̱ le̱, beni enu le̱, ete ši oyá ni eba eṅõ.

english_verse: Many people had come to comfort Mary, and when they saw her quickly leave the house, they thought she was going out to the tomb to cry. So they followed her.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱, beni Iudafoi le̱ ni ke̱le̱ yo̱ šīa le̱ ni ame̱yeo̱le̱ ṅko̱mo̱ le̱ na ake̱ Maria eša ehe ke̱-dše kpo le̱, ame̱tiule̱, amesusu ake̱, bene̱ ēya fū̃he le̱ eyafó ye̱ dše̱i.

english_verse: Mary went to where Jesus was. Then as soon as she saw him, she knelt at his feet and said, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.”
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱, beni Maria ba heni Iesu yo̱ le̱ ni enale̱ le̱, eho egbē enãdši anā, ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, edši oye̱ bie̱ kũle̱, minyemi le̱ náá agbo.

english_verse: When Jesus saw that Mary and the people with her were crying, he was terribly upset
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱, beni Iesu nale̱ ake̱ ēfó, ke̱ Iudafoi le̱ hũ ní ke̱le̱ ba le̱, ake̱ ame̱ hũ ame̱mīfó le̱, ehũṅ ye̱ emumo̱ mli ni *ekpokpo; *

english_verse: and asked, “Where have you put his body?” They replied, “Lord, come and you will see.”
translation_verse: ni ekē̱: Nẽgbe̱ nyetole̱ ye̱? Ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, ba ní obakwe̱.

english_verse: Jesus started crying,
translation_verse: Ni Iesu fó. Luk.

english_verse: and the people said, “See how much he loved Lazarus.”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱ Iudafoi le̱ kē̱: Kwe̱, bo̱ni edo̱ö̱ ehe!

english_verse: Some of them said, “He gives sight to the blind. Why couldn't he have kept Lazarus from dying?”
translation_verse: Ši ame̱teṅ meikomei kē̱: Nū ne̱ ní gble ſilafo le̱ hĩṅme̱ii le̱, aso enyẽṅ efe ní kũle̱ nū ne̱ akagbo?

english_verse: Jesus was still terribly upset. So he went to the tomb, which was a cave with a stone rolled against the entrance.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iesu sā hũṅ ye̱ emli ekoṅ, ni ete fū̃he le̱; ši te̱-kplo ni, ni *te̱ bu nā. *Mat.

english_verse: Then he told the people to roll the stone away. But Martha said, “Lord, you know that Lazarus has been dead four days, and there will be a bad smell.”
translation_verse: Iesu kē̱: Nyedšiea te̱ le̱. Marta, moni egbo le̱ nyemiyō le̱, kē̱le̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, be ne̱ mli le̱ eša, edšake̱ éye gbĩĩ edſe̱.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Didn't I tell you that if you had faith, you would see the glory of God?”
translation_verse: Iesu kē̱le̱ ake̱: Ani mikē̱ē̱o ake̱: Ke̱dši ohe oye le̱, oona *Nyoṅmo̱ anumnyam le̱? *K.

english_verse: After the stone had been rolled aside, Jesus looked up toward heaven and prayed, “Father, I thank you for answering my prayer.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ame̱dšie te̱ le̱ ye̱ heni gbonyo le̱ kã le̱. Ni Iesu hole ehĩṅme̱ii ano̱ ke̱-te ṅwei ni ekē̱: Atā, mīdao ši ake̱ obomi toi le̱.

english_verse: I know that you always answer my prayers. But I said this, so the people here would believe you sent me.”
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, mile ake̱ dā oboo̱mi toi; ši *asafo le̱ ní damo̱ ši le̱ hewo̱ mikē̱o̱, koni amehe ame̱ye ake̱ bo otšũmi. *

english_verse: When Jesus had finished praying, he shouted, “Lazarus, come out!”
translation_verse: Ni beni éwie ne̱ke̱ le̱, ebo ke̱ gbē wā ake̱: Lazaro ē, dše kpo!

english_verse: The man who had been dead came out. His hands and feet were wrapped with strips of burial cloth, and a cloth covered his face. Jesus then told the people, “Untie him and let him go.” The Plot To Kill Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Ni gbonyo le̱ dše kpo, fū̃-mamai le̱ fĩmo̱ enãdši ke̱ enidši, ni duku fĩ ehĩe. Iesu kē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyefẽneale̱, ní nyehãa eyaä.

english_verse: Many of the people who had come to visit Mary saw the things Jesus did, and they put their faith in him.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ Iudafoi le̱ ní ba Maria ṅõ le̱ ateṅ mei pī he eno̱ ye, beni ame̱na nii ni Iesu fe le̱.

english_verse: Others went to the Pharisees and told what Jesus had done.
translation_verse: Ši ame̱teṅ meikomei yiṅ te Farisifoi le̱ aṅõ, ni ame̱yagbaame̱ nii ní Iesu fe le̱.

english_verse: Then the chief priests and the Pharisees called the council together and said, “What should we do? This man is working a lot of miracles.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ oso̱fonukpai le̱ ke̱ Farisifoi le̱ tšé̱ kpē, ni ame̱kē̱: Té wo̱feo̱ tēṅ? ši nūu ne̱ mīfe okadii sro̱toi pī.

english_verse: If we don't stop him now, everyone will put their faith in him. Then the Romans will come and destroy our temple and our nation.”
translation_verse: Ke̱dši wo̱ṅmẽle̱ gbe ne̱ke̱ le̱, mei fẽ aahe eno̱ aye; ni Romabii le̱ aaba ni ame̱abašõ wo̱maṅ ke̱ wo̱sikpoṅ le̱ fẽ.
