english_verse: One of the council members was Caiaphas, who was also high priest that year. He spoke up and said, “You people don't have any sense at all!
translation_verse: Ši ame̱teṅ mokome, Kaiafa ní yeo̱ oso̱fonukpa ye̱ nakai afi le̱ mli le̱, kē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nye le̱ nyelee noko kwrā,

english_verse: Don't you know it is better for one person to die for the people than for the whole nation to be destroyed?”
translation_verse: ni nyesa nyedſẽṅṅ hũ ake̱ ehĩ hãwo̱ ake̱ mokome agbo ye̱ maṅ le̱ nãdšĩaṅ, fè noni maṅbii le̱ fẽ hĩe aakpãtã le̱.

english_verse: Caiaphas did not say this on his own. As high priest that year, he was prophesying that Jesus would die for the nation.
translation_verse: Ši ene̱ le̱, dšee le̱dientše̱ eto eyi ewie; ši moṅ, edšake̱ oso̱fonukpa dšile̱ ye̱ nakai afi le̱ no̱ hewo̱ le̱, *gba egba ake Iesu bagbo ye̱ maṅ le̱ nãdšĩaṅ; *

english_verse: Yet Jesus would not die just for the Jewish nation. He would die to bring together all of God's scattered people.
translation_verse: ni dšee ye̱ maṅ le̱ ke̱ke̱ nãdsiaṅ hewo̱ṅ, ši beni afe ní ebua Nyoṅmo̱ bii ni egbe̱ eſã le hũ nā *efe ekome. *

english_verse: From that day on, the council started making plans to put Jesus to death.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱-dše̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ ame̱kpe̱ ame̱yiṅ ake̱ ame̱bagbele̱.

english_verse: Because of this plot against him, Jesus stopped going around in public. He went to the town of Ephraim, which was near the desert, and he stayed there with his disciples.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ Iesu edšee faṅṅ enyiee ye̱ Iudafoi le̱ ateṅ doṅṅ, ši edše dše̱i ete šikpoṅ ko ni kã ṅã le̱ nā le̱ no̱, ye̱ maṅ ko ní atšé̱o̱ Efraim le mli, ni eke̱ ekaselo̱i le̱ yahĩ dše̱i.

english_verse: It was almost time for Passover. Many of the Jewish people who lived out in the country had come to Jerusalem to get themselves ready for the festival.
translation_verse: Agbene Iudafoi le̱ a-Hehō le̱ éše̱ étã. Ni mei babaō dše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ fẽ no̱ ame̱te Ierusalem, dãni Hehō le̱ aše̱, *koni ame̱yatšū ame̱he. *

english_verse: They looked around for Jesus. Then when they were in the temple, they asked each other, “You don't think he will come here for Passover, do you?”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ame̱bõi Iesu taomo̱, ni beni ame̱damo̱damo̱ ši ye̱ so̱lemo̱we le̱, ame̱kē̱kē̱ ame̱he ake̱: Té nyesusuo̱ tēṅ, ani ebaṅ gbĩdšŭrõ le̱?

english_verse: The chief priests and the Pharisees told the people to let them know if any of them saw Jesus. This is how they hoped to arrest him.
translation_verse: Ši oso̱fonukpai le̱ ke̱ Farisifoi le̱ éwo kitã ake̱, ké̱ moko le heni eyo̱ le̱, étſa he adafi, koni ayamõle̱.

english_verse: A meal had been prepared for Jesus. Martha was doing the serving, and Lazarus himself was there.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ame̱ṅmēle̱ okplõ ye̱ dše̱i, ni Marta súmo̱, ši Lazaro dši mei ní ke̱le̱ trá okplõ le̱ he le̱ ateṅ mokome.

english_verse: Philip from Bethsaida in Galilee was there too. So they went to him and said, “Sir, we would like to meet Jesus.”
translation_verse: mene̱mei ba Filipo *ni dše̱ Betsaida ye̱ Galilea le̱ ṅõ, ni ame̱babile̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, wo̱mītao ake̱ wo̱na Iesu. *

english_verse: But the Pharisees said to each other, “There is nothing we can do! Everyone in the world is following Jesus.” Some Greeks Want To Meet Jesus
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ Farisifoi le̱ kē̱ ye̱ ame̱teṅ ake̱: Té nyena ake̱ nyenyẽẽ fē̱i nyefe; na, *dše le̱ efã ke̱-nyie ese le̱.

english_verse: Some Greeks had gone to Jerusalem to worship during Passover.
translation_verse: Ši Helabii komei ye̱ mei ni ba koni ame̱badšá Nyoṅmo̱ ye̱ gbĩdšŭrõ le̱ no̱ le̱ ateṅ;

english_verse: Jesus said: The time has come for the Son of Man to be given his glory.
translation_verse: Ni Iesu hereame̱ no̱ ekē̱: Ṅmletſā ní ake̱-bawo gbomobi le̱ hĩe nyam le̱ eše̱.

english_verse: If you love your life, you will lose it. If you give it up in this world, you will be given eternal life.
translation_verse: Moni do̱ö̱ ewala he le̱, elādšeo̱le̱, ši moni nye̱o̱ ewala ye̱ dše ne̱ mli le̱, eetole̱ ke̱-ate nāno̱ wala mli. Mat.

english_verse: Now I am deeply troubled, and I don't know what to say. But I must not ask my Father to keep me from this time of suffering. In fact, I came into the world to suffer.
translation_verse: Agbene *misusuma mihao, ni meni makē̱? Atā, heremo̱mi ye̱ ṅmle̱tſā ne̱ mli? Tše̱bele̱ ene̱ hewo̱ noṅṅ miba ye̱ ṅmle̱tſā ne̱ mli. *Mat.

english_verse: When the crowd heard the voice, some of them thought it was thunder. Others thought an angel had spoken to Jesus.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni mei ní damo̱ dše̱i ní nu le̱ kē̱ ake̱: Nyoṅmo̱ éši; meikomei hũ kē̱: Ṅweibo̱fo ko ke̱le̱ éwie.

english_verse: This world's people are now being judged, and the ruler of this world is already being thrown out!
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ dše ne̱ṅ kodšomo̱ le̱ eše: kpāko abafã dše ne̱ṅ lumo̱ le̱ aše̱ afõ;

english_verse: If I am lifted up above the earth, I will make everyone want to come to me.”
translation_verse: ni mi le̱, ke̱dši *awó mino̱ ke̱-dše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱, magbla mei fẽ ke̱-aba miṅõ. *

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the way he would be put to death.
translation_verse: Ši ene̱ le̱ ekē̱ eke̱-tšõ nõ gbĕle ní ebagbo le̱.

english_verse: The crowd said to Jesus, “The Scriptures teach that the Messiah will live forever. How can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Asafo le̱ herele̱ no̱ ake̱: Wo̱ le̱ wonu ye̱ mla le̱ mli ake̱ Kristo le̱ *hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä nāno̱; ni té tēṅ ní bo le̱ okē̱o̱ ake̱: Dša awó gbomobi le̱ no̱ṅ? Namo dši ne̱ke̱ gbomobi ne̱? *Lal.

english_verse: Have faith in the light while it is with you, and you will be children of the light.” The People Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus After Jesus had said these things, he left and went into hiding.
translation_verse: Gbĩĩ abo̱ ní nyeyo̱ la le̱ ne̱, nyehea la le̱ no̱ nyeyea, koni *nyetšṍmo̱ la-bii. Iesu wie nii ne̱, ni eyiṅ ete ni eyatē ehe ye̱ ame̱hĩe. Ef.

english_verse: He had worked a lot of miracles among the people, but they were still not willing to have faith in him.
translation_verse: Tše̱bele̱ éfe okadii wudši ye̱ ame̱hĩe, ši kẽle̱ ame̱hee eno̱ ame̱yee;

english_verse: This happened so that what the prophet Isaiah had said would come true, “Lord, who has believed our message? And who has seen your mighty strength?”
translation_verse: koni gbalo̱ Iesaia wiemo̱ ni ewie le̱ ana aba mli ake̱: *“Nuṅtšo̱, namo ehe wo̱sane le̱ eye, ni namo adšie Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ nine le̱ kpo atsõ?” *Ies.

english_verse: The people could not have faith in Jesus, because Isaiah had also said,
translation_verse: Ene̱hewo̱ ni ame̱nyẽẽ ame̱he ame̱ye le̱, edšake̱ Iesaia sã kē̱ ekoṅ ake̱: Ies.

english_verse: Isaiah said this, because he saw the glory of Jesus and spoke about him.
translation_verse: Nii ne̱ Iesaia kē̱, edšake̱ ena *enumnyam le̱, ni ewie ehe. *Ies.

english_verse: Even then, many of the leaders put their faith in Jesus, but they did not tell anyone about it. The Pharisees had already given orders for the people not to have anything to do with anyone who had faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Tše̱bele̱ onukpai le̱ tete ateṅ mei pī he eno̱ ye, ši kẽle̱ Farisifoi le̱ ahewo̱ le̱ ame̱dšadšee faṅṅ, koni *akaſieame̱ ke̱-dše̱ kpēhe le̱; *

english_verse: In a loud voice Jesus said: Everyone who has faith in me also has faith in the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Ši Iesu bo ekē̱ ake̱: Moni heo̱ mino̱ eyeo̱ le̱, dšee mi mino̱ eheo̱ eyeo̱ le̱, ši moṅ moni tšũmi le̱;

english_verse: And everyone who has seen me has seen the one who sent me.
translation_verse: ni *moni naämi le̱ naä moni tšũmi le̱. *

english_verse: I am the light that has come into the world. No one who has faith in me will stay in the dark.
translation_verse: Mi le̱ miba dše le̱ mli ake̱ la, koni mofẽmo ní heo̱ mino̱ yeo̱ le̱ akahī duṅ le̱ mli. K.

english_verse: I am not the one who will judge those who refuse to obey my teachings. I came to save the people of this world, not to be their judge.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši moko nu miwiemo̱i le̱ ni eyee no̱ le̱, mi le̱, mikodšoole̱; edšake̱ mibaa koni mibakodšo dše le̱, ši moṅ miba koni mibahere dše le̱ yiwala.

english_verse: But everyone who rejects me and my teachings will be judged on the last day by what I have said.
translation_verse: Moni kwaämi ni emõõ miwiemo̱i le̱ amli le̱, eye̱ moko ní kodšoo̱le̱; wiemo̱ ní míwie le̱, no noṅṅ aakodšole̱ ye̱ nāgbēgbĩ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: I don't speak on my own. I say only what the Father who sent me has told me to say.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mi le̱ mitoo midientše̱ miyi miwiee; ši tše̱ ní tšũmi le̱, le̱ moṅ ewomi kitã, noni mikē̱ ke̱ noni míwie.

english_verse: I know that his commands will bring eternal life. This is why I tell you exactly what the Father has told me.
translation_verse: Ni mile ake̱ ekitã le̱ nāno̱ wala ni; nohewo̱ le nofẽno ní miwieo̱ le̱, bo̱ni tše̱ le̱ ékē̱mi le̱, nakai miwieo̱.

english_verse: So during the meal Jesus got up, removed his outer garment, and wrapped a towel around his waist.
translation_verse: ete ši ye̱ niyenii le̱ aši, ni edšie etadei le̱ eſie ši, ni eko̱ papaṅ ni eṅõ-ṅmõ ehe.

english_verse: Peter said, “Lord, don't wash just my feet. Wash my hands and my head.”
translation_verse: Simon Petro kē̱le̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, dšee minãdši ahe ke̱ke̱, ši moṅ minidši ke̱ miyitšo hũ.

english_verse: Jesus knew who would betray him. That is why he said, “except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ele moni batšõ ese̱gbe̱ le̱; nohewo̱ ni ekē̱ ako̱: Dšee nyefẽ nyehe edše le̱.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that servants are not greater than their master, and messengers are not greater than the one who sent them.
translation_verse: Le̱le̱ṅ, le̱le̱ṅ, mīkē̱nye ake̱: Nyṍṅ efèè enuṅtšo̱, ni asaṅ bo̱fo efèè moni tšũle̱ le̱. Mat.

english_verse: So the disciple leaned toward Jesus and asked, “Lord, which one of us are you talking about?”
translation_verse: Ši le̱ le̱ eho egbē Iesu tšitši no̱ ni ebile̱ ake̱: Nuntše̱, namo ni?

english_verse: and Simon motioned for this disciple to find out which one Jesus meant.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ Simon Petro be̱le̱ hĩṅme̱i ake̱ ébile̱ mo he ní ewieo̱ le̱.

english_verse: No one at the meal understood what Jesus meant.
translation_verse: Ši mei ní trá okplõ le̱ be le̱ ateṅ mokomoko lee nõhewo̱ ní ekē̱le̱ nakai le̱.

english_verse: Judas took the piece of bread and went out. It was already night. The New Command
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱, beni ehé atrõma le̱ noṅṅ le̱, edše kpo. Ši dše éna.

english_verse: Then, after God is given glory because of him, God will bring glory to him, and God will do it very soon.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši áwo Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe nyam ye̱ emli le̱, *Nyoṅmo̱ hũ aawo ehĩe nyam ye̱ le̱dientše̱ emli, ni eewo ehĩe nyam oyá. *

english_verse: Simon Peter asked, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “You can't go with me now, but later on you will.”
translation_verse: Simon Petro kē̱le̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, nẽgbe̱ oyaã? Iesu herele̱ no̱ ekē̱: Heni *miyaã le̱, onyẽṅ mise̱ onyie amrõ ne̱, ši oonyie mise̱ †wó̱se̱ ko. *

english_verse: Peter asked, “Lord, why can't I go with you now? I would die for you!”
translation_verse: Petro kē̱le̱ ake̱: Nuntše̱, mẽhewo̱ minyẽṅ ose̱ manyie amrõ ne̱? Miwala tete maṅõ-ṅmẽ ši ye̱ ohewo̱.

english_verse: “Would you really die for me?” Jesus asked. “I tell you for certain before a rooster crows, you will say three times that you don't even know me.”
translation_verse: Iesu herele̱ no̱ ake̱: Ooṅõ owala oṅmẽ ši ye̱ mihewo? Le̱le̱ṅ, le̱le̱ṅ, mīkē̱o ake̱: Wuo̱ náṅ agbe̱ ni ookpá ye̱ mise̱ šii etẽ.

english_verse: Jesus replied: Philip, I have been with you for a long time. Don't you know who I am? If you have seen me, you have seen the Father. How can you ask me to show you the Father?
translation_verse: Iesu kē̱le̱ ake̱: Dšeeṅmõ ni mike̱nye yo̱ ne̱, olekomi lolo, Filipo? Moni enami le̱, ena tše̱ le̱, ni té tēṅ ní okē̱o̱ ake̱: Tšõme̱wo̱ tše̱ le̱?

english_verse: I will do whatever you ask me to do. The Holy Spirit Is Promised
translation_verse: Ke̱dši nyekpa noko he fai *ye̱ migbei ano̱ le̱, mafe. *

english_verse: In a little while the people of this world won't be able to see me, but you will see me. And because I live, you will live.
translation_verse: Eſe̱ fiõ ke̱ke̱ ni dše le̱ enaṅmi doṅṅ; ši nye le̱ nyemīnami; edšake̱ mihĩe kã, ni nye hũ nyehĩe aakã.

english_verse: Then you will know I am one with the Father. You will know you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ nyedientše̱ nyeale ake̱ miye̱ mitše̱ mli ni nye hũ nyeye̱ mimli ni mi hũ miye̱ nyemli.

english_verse: The other Judas, not Judas Iscariot, then spoke up and asked, “Lord, what do you mean by saying that you will show us what you are like, but you will not show the people of this world?”
translation_verse: Iuda, dšee Iskariot le̱, kē̱le̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, meni éba hewo̱ ni wo̱ ke̱ke̱ obadšie ohe ši otšõ, ni odšieṅ otšõṅ dše le̱?

english_verse: Jesus replied: If anyone loves me, they will obey me. Then my Father will love them, and we will come to them and live in them.
translation_verse: Iesu here no̱ ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Ke̱dši moko mīsumo̱mi le̱, eeye miwiemo̱ le̱ no̱, ni mitše̱ aasumo̱le̱, ni wo̱o̱ba eṅõ, ni wo̱ke̱ eṅõ aafe wo̱šihĩle̱he. K.

english_verse: But anyone who doesn't love me, won't obey me. What they have heard me say doesn't really come from me, but from the Father who sent me.
translation_verse: Moni sumo̱o̱mi le̱ eyee miwiemo̱i le̱ ano̱; *ni wiemo̱ ní nyenuo̱ le̱ dšee minõṅ, ši moṅ tše̱ ní tšũmi le nõṅ. *

english_verse: I have told you these things while I am still with you.
translation_verse: Be mli ní mike̱nye yo̱ ne̱, mikē̱nye nii ne̱.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come and help you, because the Father will send the Spirit to take my place. The Spirit will teach you everything and will remind you of what I said while I was with you.
translation_verse: Ši hefatalo̱ le̱, ni dši Mumo̱ kroṅkroṅ le̱, moni tše̱ le̱ batšũ ye̱ migbe̱i ano̱ le̱, le̱ eetšõnye nii fẽ, ni eekainye nii fẽ ní mikē̱nye le̱. K.

english_verse: I give you peace, the kind of peace only I can give. It isn't like the peace this world can give. So don't be worried or afraid.
translation_verse: *Hedšo̱le̱ mišīo̱ mahãnye, hedšo̱le̱ ní dši minõ le̱ miṅõhãanye, dšee bo̱ni dše le̱ hãa le̱, mihãanye ne̱. Nyetšui akayea, ni asaṅ ekafãa. *

english_verse: You have already heard me say I am going and I will also come back to you. If you really love me, you should be glad I am going back to the Father, because he is greater than I am.
translation_verse: Nyénu ake̱ *mikē̱nye ake̱: Mīya ni mība nyeṅõ. Nyemīsumo̱mi kũle̱, nyeaná mīše̱ †ake̱ mīya tše̱ le̱ ṅõ, edšake̱ mitše̱ da fèmi. *K.

english_verse: I am telling you this before I leave, so when it does happen, you will have faith in me.
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱ mikē̱nye dãni eba mli, koni ké̱ eba mli le̱, ní nyehe nyeye.

english_verse: I cannot speak with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. But he has no power over me.
translation_verse: Mike̱nye ewieṅ nibii pī doṅṅ, edšake̱ *dše le̱ṅ lumo̱ le̱ mība, ni ebe noko ye̱ mimli; *

english_verse: I obey my Father, so everyone in the world might know that I love him. It is time for us to go now.
translation_verse: ši beni afe ní dše le̱ aná ale ake̱ mīsumo̱ tše̱ le̱ ni *bo̱ni tše̱ le̱ womi kitã le̱ nakai mifeo̱ hewo̱ le̱: Nyetea ši, nyehãa wo̱dšea bie̱. *

english_verse: If you don't stay joined to me, you will be thrown away. You will be like dry branches that are gathered up and burned in a fire.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši moko ehĩĩ mimli le̱, atše̱o̱le̱ afõo̱ tamo tšonine, ni egbĩo̱, ni abuaä nā awoo̱ la mli, ni ašãa.

english_verse: I have loved you, just as my Father has loved me. So remain faithful to my love for you.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni tše̱ le̱ sumo̱mi le̱, nakai mi hũ misumo̱nye; nyehĩa ši ye̱ misuomo̱ le̱ mli.

english_verse: Now I tell you to love each other, as I have loved you.
translation_verse: Ene̱ dši mikitã, ake̱ nyesumo̱ nyehe tamo̱ bo̱ni misumo̱nye le̱.

english_verse: Servants don't know what their master is doing, and so I don't speak to you as my servants. I speak to you as my friends, and I have told you everything my Father has told me.
translation_verse: Mĩtšé̱é̱nye nyṍdši doṅṅ, edšake̱ nyṍṅ lee noni enuṅtšo̱ feo̱; ši moṅ šĩentše̱mei mítšé̱nye, edšake̱ nii fẽ ní minu ye̱ mitše̱ nā le̱, mitšĩ tã mikē̱nye.

english_verse: If the people of this world hate you, just remember that they hated me first.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši dše le̱ mīnye̱nye le̱, nyenáa nyelea ake̱ mi tšutšu enye̱.

english_verse: If you belonged to the world, its people would love you. But you don't belong to the world. I have chosen you to leave the world behind, and this is why its people hate you.
translation_verse: Edši dše le̱ṅ nyedše̱ kũle̱, dše le̱ aasumo̱ le̱dientše̱ emei, ši ake̱-ní nye-dše̱e̱ dše le̱ṅ, ši mi moṅ mihalanye ke̱-dše̱ dše le̱ṅ le̱, nohewo̱ dše le̱ nye̱o̱nyele̱.

english_verse: Remember how I told you that servants are not greater than their master. So if people mistreat me, they will mistreat you. If they do what I say, they will do what you say.
translation_verse: Nyehĩe ahĩa wiemo̱ ní mi noṅṅ mikē̱nye lo̱ no̱, ake̱: *Nyṍṅ efèè enuṅtšo̱. Ké̱ ame̱wami yi le̱, ame̱awa nye hũ yi; ké̱ ame̱ye miwiemo̱ no̱ le̱, ame̱aye nye hũ nyenõ no̱. *

english_verse: People will do to you exactly what they did to me. They will do it because you belong to me, and they don't know the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Ši ame̱aṅõ ene̱mei fẽ ame̱fenye ye̱ migbe̱i le̱ hewo̱; edšake̱ *ame̱lee moni tšũmi le̱. *

english_verse: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
translation_verse: Mibaa mike̱ame̱ ebawiee dšikule̱, ame̱he be̱ eša ko; ši ene̱ le̱ ame̱be̱ ame̱he eša le̱ he lakpatō ko.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me also hates my Father.
translation_verse: Moni nye̱o̱mi le̱ ẽnye̱ mitše̱ hũ.

english_verse: This is why the Scriptures are true when they say, “People hated me for no reason.”
translation_verse: Ši beni afe ni wiemo̱ le̱ ní aṅmã ye̱ ame̱mla le̱ mli ake̱: “Ame̱nye̱mi yakatſā” le̱ aná aba mli. Lal.

english_verse: Then you will also tell others about me, because you have been with me from the beginning.
translation_verse: ni nye hũ nyeaye odase, edšake̱ nyeke̱mi yo̱ ke̱-dše̱ šišidšē. Bo̱f.

english_verse: You are very sad from hearing all of this.
translation_verse: Ši ní mitšĩ nii ne̱ atã mikē̱nye hewo̱ le̱, ṅko̱mo̱yeli éyi nyetšuiaṅ.

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but right now it would be more than you could understand.
translation_verse: Miye̱ nii pī lolo ní makenye; ši nyenyẽṅ mli nyemõ amrõ ne̱;

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “For a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.”
translation_verse: Eſe̱ fiō, ni nyenaṅmi, ni asaṅ eſe̱ fiō, ninyebanami; edšake̱ miya tše̱ le̱ ṅõ.

english_verse: What is this ‘little while’ that he is talking about? We don't know what he means.”
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ lo̱ ame̱kē̱: Meni dši noni ekē̱o̱ ne̱: Eſe̱ fiō? Wo̱lee noni ekē̱o̱ ne̱.

english_verse: Jesus knew they had some questions, so he said: You are wondering what I meant when I said that for a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ Iesu na ake̱ ame̱mītao ake̱ ame̱bio̱le̱, ni ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Ní mĩkē̱: Eſe̱ flō ní nyenaṅmi, ni asaṅ eſe̱ fiō ní nyebanami le̱, no nyebibīo̱ nyehe ne̱?

english_verse: You are now very sad. But later I will see you, and you will be so happy that no one will be able to change the way you feel.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nye hũ, agbe̱ne̱ nyemīye ṅko̱mo̱ moṅ; ši mibananye ekoṅ, ni nyetšui aanyõ nyemli, ni nyemīše̱ le̱ moko šõṅ ye̱ nyedeṅ;

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't have to ask me about anything. I tell you for certain the Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: ni *no gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱ nyebiṅmi nokonoko. Le̱le̱ṅ, le̱le̱ṅ, mīkē̱nye ake̱: Nofẽno he †fai ní nyeakpa tše̱ le̱ ye̱ migbe̱i ano̱ le̱, eehãnye. *

english_verse: You have not asked for anything in this way before, but now you must ask in my name. Then it will be given to you, so you will be completely happy.
translation_verse: Ke̱-baši be ne̱ le̱ nyekpako noko he fai ye̱ migbe̱i ano̱; nyekpaä fai, ni nyeana, koni *nyemīšo̱ le̱ ayi. *

english_verse: I came from the Father into the world, but I am leaving the world and returning to the Father.
translation_verse: Tše̱ le̱ ṅõ midše̱ miba dše le̱ mli, asaṅ mīdše dše le̱ṅ maya tše̱ le̱ ṅõ.

english_verse: At last we know that you understand everything, and we don't have any more questions. Now we believe you truly have come from God.”
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ wo̱yo ake̱ ole nii fẽ ni ehĩaa ake̱ moko bio̱o sane ko; ene̱ wo̱ke̱heo̱ wo̱yeo̱, ake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ṅõ odše̱.

english_verse: The time will come and is already here when all of you will be scattered. Each of you will go back home and leave me by myself. But the Father will be with me, and I won't be alone.
translation_verse: Na, ṅmle̱tſā le̱ mība ni eše̱ po, ní *nyebagbe̱ nyeſā ni mofẽmo aako̱ egbe̱, ni nyeašĩ mikome; ši dšee †mikome ni, edšake tše̱ le̱ ke̱mi ye. *Zak.

english_verse: I have told you this, so that you might have peace in your hearts because of me. While you are in the world, you will have to suffer. But cheer up! I have defeated the world.
translation_verse: Mikē̱nye nii ne̱, koni *nyewonyetšui ye̱ mimli. Dše le̱ṅ le̱, hedšramo̱ nyenáa, ši kẽle̱ nyetšui anyõa nyemli: miye dše le̱ no̱ †kũnim.

english_verse: Now, Father, give me back the glory I had with you before the world was created.
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱, Atā, ṅõ anumnyam ní miyo̱ ye̱ oṅõ dãni dše le̱ yo̱ le̱ owo mihĩe nyam. K.

english_verse: They know that you gave me everything I have.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ ame̱le ake̱, nii flã ní oṅõ-hãmi le̱, oṅõ edše̱,

english_verse: I am praying for them, but not for those who belong to this world. My followers belong to you, and I am praying for them.
translation_verse: Mi le̱, ame̱ mibio̱ mahã; dšee dše le̱ mibio̱ mahã, ši moṅ mei ni *oṅõ-hãmi le̱, edšake̱ onii dšiame̱; *

english_verse: I am on my way to you. But I say these things while I am still in the world, so my followers will have the same complete joy that I do.
translation_verse: Ši agbe̱ne̱ le̱, mība oṅõ, ni mīwie nii ne̱ ye̱ dše le̱ mlĩ, koni ame̱ná mimīše̱ le̱ ní eye mū ye̱ ame̱mli.

english_verse: I have told them your message. But the people of this world hate them, because they don't belong to this world, just as I don't.
translation_verse: Miṅõ owiemo̱ le̱ mihãame̱, ni dše le̱ mīnye̱ame̱, edšake̱ ame̱dše̱e̱ dše le̱ mli, take̱ bo̱ni mi hũ midše̱e̱ dše le̱ mli le̱.

english_verse: Father, I don't ask you to take my followers out of the world, but keep them safe from the evil one.
translation_verse: Mibii ake̱ odšieame̱ ke̱-dše̱ dše le̱ mli, ši moṅ ake̱ *obu ame̱he ye̱ efõṅ le̱ mli. *

english_verse: They don't belong to this world, and neither do I.
translation_verse: Ame̱dše̱e̱ dše le̱ mli, take̱ bo̱ni mi hũ midše̱e̱ dše le̱ mli le̱.

english_verse: I am sending them into the world, just as you sent me.
translation_verse: Take̱ bo̱ni otšũmi dše le̱ mli le̱, nakai noṅṅ mi hũ mitšũo̱ame̱ dše le mli.

english_verse: I have given myself completely for their sake, so they may belong completely to the truth.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱hewo̱ midientše̱ mifeo̱ mihe kroṅkroṅ le̱, koni ame̱ hũ afeame̱ kroṅkroṅ ye̱ ano̱kwale mli. Heb.

english_verse: I am not praying just for these followers. I am also praying for everyone else who will have faith because of what my followers will say about me.
translation_verse: Ši dšee mene̱mei ahewo̱ ke̱ke̱ mibio̱ le̱, ši mei ní bahe mino̱ aye ye̱ ame̱wiemo̱ nā le̱ hũ ahewo̱ṅ;

english_verse: I want all of them to be one with each other, just as I am one with you and you are one with me. I also want them to be one with us. Then the people of this world will believe that you sent me.
translation_verse: koni ame̱fẽ *amefe ekome, take̱ bo̱ni bo, Atā, oyo̱ mimli ni mi hũ miyo̱ omli le̱, koni ame̱ hũ ame̱fe ekome ye̱ wo̱mli, koni dše le̱ ahe aye ake bo otšũmi. *Gal.

english_verse: I have honored my followers in the same way you honored me, in order that they may be one with each other, just as we are one.
translation_verse: Ni anumnyam ní oṅõ-hãmì le̱, miṅõ-hãame̱, koni *ame̱fe ekome, take̱ bo̱ni wo̱ hũ wo̱yo̱ ekome le̱; *Bo̱f.

english_verse: I am one with them, and you are one with me, so they may become completely one. Then this world's people will know that you sent me. They will know that you love my followers as much as you love me.
translation_verse: miye̱ *ame̱mli, ni bo hũ oye̱ mimli, koni ame̱fe ekome ke̱-wula ši, ni dše le̱ ale ake̱ bo otšũmi ni osumoo̱ame̱ tamo̱ bo̱ni osumoo̱mi le̱. *

english_verse: Father, I want everyone you have given me to be with me, wherever I am. Then they will see the glory you have given me, because you loved me before the world was created.
translation_verse: Atā, mei ní oṅõ-hãmi le̱, mīsumo̱ ake̱ *heni miyo̱ le̱ ame̱ hũ ame̱ke̱mi abahĩ dše̱i, koni ame̱na minumnyam ní oṅõ-hãmi le̱, edšake̱ ōsumo̱mi dãni ato dše le̱ šiši. *

english_verse: Good Father, the people of this world don't know you. But I know you, and my followers know that you sent me.
translation_verse: Atā dšalo̱, dše le̱ leeo, ši mi le̱ mileo, ni mene̱mei le ake̱ bo otšũmi;

english_verse: I told them what you are like, and I will tell them even more. Then the love you have for me will become part of them, and I will be one with them.
translation_verse: ni midšie ogbe̱i le̱ kpo mitšõame̱, ni masa madšĩele̱ kpo matšõ, koni suomo̱ ni oke̱-sumo̱mi le̱ ahĩ ame̱mli, ni mi hũ mahĩ ame̱mli.

english_verse: One of the high priest's servants was there. He was a relative of the servant whose ear Peter had cut off, and he asked, “Didn't I see you in the garden with that man?”
translation_verse: Oso̱fonukpa le̱ nyṍdši le̱ ateṅ mokome, ní dši moni Petro fo etoi le̱ wekunyo, kē̱: Ani minaao ke̱le̱ ye̱ trom le̱ mli?

english_verse: This time Jesus replied, “I have already told you that I am Jesus. If I am the one you are looking for, let these others go.
translation_verse: Iesu here no̱ ake̱: Mikē̱nye ake̱ miṅ; nohewo̱ le̱, ke̱dši mi nyetaoo̱ le̱, nyehãa mene̱mei ayaä.

english_verse: Then everything will happen, just as I said, ‘I did not lose anyone you gave me.’ ”
translation_verse: Koni *wiemo̱ ni ewie ake̱: Mei ní oṅõ-hãmi le̱, mihãko ame̱teṅ moko alādše le̱, aba mli. *

english_verse: Simon Peter had brought along a sword. He pulled it out and struck at Malchus, the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱ Simon Petro hĩe klante, ni egbla ni eṅõ-bã oso̱fonukpa le̱ nyṍṅ le̱ ni efo eninedšŭrõ toi; ši nyṍṅ le̱ gbe̱i dši Malko.

english_verse: Peter stayed outside near the gate. But the other disciple came back out and spoke to the girl at the gate. She let Peter go in,
translation_verse: ši Petro damo̱ agbó le̱ se̱. Nohewo̱ le̱ nakai kaselo̱ kroko le̱ ní oso̱fonukpa le̱ lele̱ le̱ dše kpo, ni eyakē̱ yō ní bno̱ šĩnā le̱ nā le̱, ni eṅõ Petro ke̱-ba šĩa le̱.

english_verse: but asked him, “Aren't you one of that man's followers?” “No, I am not!” Peter answered.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱ oblayō le̱ ni buo̱ šĩnā le̱ nā le̱ kē̱ Petro ake̱: Té bo hũ nū ne̱ kaselo̱i le̱ eko dšio? Ekē̱: Dabi.

english_verse: It was cold, and the servants and temple police had made a charcoal fire. They were warming themselves around it, when Peter went over and stood near the fire to warm himself. Jesus Is Questioned by the High Priest (Matthew
translation_verse: Ši nyõdši le̱ ke̱ tšũdši le̱ damo̱ dše̱i, ame̱ke̱ ṅãi eše̱re la, edšake̱ fẽi ye̱, ni ame̱mīw̌ere; ni Petro hũ ke̱ame̱ damo̱ ši ēw̌ere eko.

english_verse: Why are you questioning me? Why don't you ask the people who heard me? They know what I have said.”
translation_verse: Mẽba obio̱mi moṅ? Bi mei ní baboo̱mi toi le̱ noni mikē̱o̱ame̱; na, mene̱mei le nii ní mikē̱o̱ le̱.

english_verse: Jesus was still tied up, and Annas sent him to Caiaphas the high priest. Peter Again Denies that He Knows Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Ni Hana hã akele te oso̱fonukpa Kaiafa ṅõ ye̱ kpã mli.

english_verse: It was early in the morning when Jesus was taken from Caiaphas to the building where the Roman governor stayed. But the crowd waited outside. Any of them who had gone inside would have become unclean and would not be allowed to eat the Passover meal.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ame̱kpla Iesu ke̱-dše̱ Kaiafa ṅõ ke̱-te kodšomo̱he le̱. Ni eše mãṅkẽ. Ni ame̱dientše̱ le̱ ame̱botee kodšomohe le̱, koni ame̱kabule ame̱he, beni afe ní ame̱wo Hehō le̱ yeli.

english_verse: Pilate came out and asked, “What charges are you bringing against this man?”
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ Pilato dše kpo ba ame̱ṅõ ni ekē̱: Mẽ nāflo̱mo̱ nyeke̱-ba ye̱ nū ne̱ he?

english_verse: They answered, “He is a criminal! That's why we brought him to you.”
translation_verse: Ame̱here no̱ ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Dšee efõṅfelo̱ dšile̱ dšikũle̱, wo̱ke̱le̱ ebahãão.

english_verse: Pilate then went back inside. He called Jesus over and asked, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱ Pilato sā bote kodšomo̱he le̱ ekoṅ, ni etšé̱ Iesu, ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Ani bo dši Iudafoi amaṅtše̱ le̱?

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Are you asking this on your own or did someone tell you about me?”
translation_verse: Iesu herele̱ no̱ áke̱: Bodientše̱ oyi oto owieo̱ ene̱ ne̱, alo meikomei gbao nakai ye̱ mihe?

english_verse: “You know I'm not a Jew!” Pilate said. “Your own people and the chief priests brought you to me. What have you done?”
translation_verse: Pilato here no̱ ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Ani Iudanyo dšimi? Bodientše̱ omaṅbii ke̱ oso̱fonukpai le̱ ṅõo hami. Meni ofe?

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My kingdom doesn't belong to this world. If it did, my followers would have fought to keep me from being handed over to our leaders. No, my kingdom doesn't belong to this world.”
translation_verse: Iesu here no̱ ake̱: Mimaṅtše̱yeli le̱ dše̱e̱ dše ne̱ṅ; mimaṅtše̱yeli le̱ dše̱ dše ne̱ mli dšikũle̱, misúolo̱i le̱ aaple he, koni akaṅõmi ahã Iudafoi le̱; ši ene̱ le̱, mimaṅtše̱yeli le̱ dše̱e̱ bie̱.

english_verse: “So you are a king,” Pilate replied. “You are saying that I am a king,” Jesus told him. “I was born into this world to tell about the truth. And everyone who belongs to the truth knows my voice.”
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ Pilato kē̱le̱ ake̱: Bĕle̱ maṅtše̱ dšio kẽ? Iesu here no̱ ake̱: Oke; edšake̱ maṅtše̱ dšimi. Mi le̱, ene̱hewo̱ afo̱mi ni ene̱hewo̱ noṅṅ miba dše le̱ mli, koni mibaye ano̱kwale le̱ he odase. Mofẽmo ní dše̱ ano̱kwale le̱ mli le̱ nuo̱ migbē.

english_verse: And since I usually set a prisoner free for you at Passover, would you like for me to set free the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Ši nyeye gbe̱nā ko ake̱ miṅmē̃o̱ mokome he mihãanye ye̱ Hehō gbĩdšŭrõ le̱ no̱; nohewo̱ le̱, nyemīsumo̱ ake̱ miṅmẽ Iudafoi le̱ amaṅtše̱ le̱ he mihānye lo?

english_verse: They shouted, “No, not him! We want Barabbas.” Now Barabbas was a terrorist.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱ ame̱fẽ ame̱blo̱ ekoṅ ame̱kē̱: Dšee mone̱ṅ, ši Baraba moṅ! Tše̱ Baraba le̱, odšotſalo̱ṅ.

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he was terrified.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, beni Pilato nu ne̱ke̱ wiemo̱ ne̱, eše gbeyei fè tšutšu le̱;

english_verse: He went back inside and asked Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus did not answer.
translation_verse: ni ebote kodšomo̱he le̱ ekoṅ, ni ekē̱ Iesu ake̱: Nẽgbe̱ odše̱? Ši Iesu efoo edāṅ.

english_verse: It was about noon on the day before Passover, and Pilate said to the crowd, “Look at your king!”
translation_verse: Ši Hehō le̱ sāmo̱-ke̱-tō-gbĩ ni, ni aafe ſane ṅmle̱ nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱ mli. Ni ekē̱ Iudafoi le̱ ake̱: Na, nyemaṅtše̱ le̱!

english_verse: The soldiers first broke the legs of the other two men who were nailed there.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ asrafoi le̱ te ni ame̱ya-kũmo̱ mei ni ase̱ṅ afata ehe le̱ anãdši, kleṅkleṅmo le̱ ke̱ moni dši enyo̱ le̱ fẽ.

english_verse: When Jesus saw his mother and his favorite disciple with her, he said to his mother, “This man is now your son.”
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, beni Iesu na enye ke̱ kaselo̱ *ní esumoo̱ le̱ damo̱ ši le̱, ekē̱ enye ake̱: Awó, obi ne̱! *

english_verse: and he carried his cross to a place known as “The Skull.” In Aramaic this place is called “Golgotha.”
translation_verse: Ni le̱dientše̱ etẽre ese̱ṅmo̱tšo le̱ ke̱-te heni atšé̱o̱ yitšoṅoṅohe, ni Hebri mli le̱ atšé̱o̱le̱ Golgota le̱;

english_verse: The words were written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek. The place where Jesus was taken wasn't far from the city, and many of the people read the charge against him.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ ne̱ke̱ wolo ne̱ Iudafoi le̱ ateṅ mei pī kane, edšake̱ heni ase̱ṅ Iesu ye̱ le̱ be̱ṅke̱ maṅ le̱; ni aṅmã ye̱ Hebri ke̱ Hela ke̱ Roma wiemo̱ mli.

english_verse: The soldiers said to each other, “Let's not rip it apart. We will gamble to see who gets it.” This happened so the Scriptures would come true, which say, “They divided up my clothes and gambled for my garments.” The soldiers then did what they had decided.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ ame̱kē̱ ye̱ ame̱teṅ ake̱: Nyekahãa wo̱gblaã no mli, ši nyehãa wo̱fõa no̱ ošiki, ní wo̱na mo nõ ni aatšṍ. Koni ṅmãlo̱ ní kē̱ ake̱: *“Ame̱dša mitadei le̱ amli ame̱hã ame̱he, ni mihebo le̱ ame̱fõ no̱ ošiki” le̱ aba mli. Nohewo̱ asrafoi le̱ fe nakai le̱. *Lal.

english_verse: Jesus' mother stood beside his cross with her sister and Mary the wife of Clopas. Mary Magdalene was standing there too.
translation_verse: Ši Iesu nye ke̱ enye nyemiyō, Maria, Klopa ṅã le̱, ke̱ Maria Magdalēna damo̱ Iesu se̱ṅmo̱tšo le̱ mase̱i.

english_verse: But when they came to Jesus, they saw he was already dead, and they did not break his legs.
translation_verse: Ši beni ame̱še̱ Iesu no̱ ni ame̱na ake̱ égbo momo le̱, le̱ le̱ ame̱kŭmo̱o̱ enãdši;

english_verse: In the place where Jesus had been nailed to a cross, there was a garden with a tomb that had never been used.
translation_verse: Ši heni ase̱ṅle̱ ye̱ le̱, trom ko ye̱ dše̱i, ni sāṅ hē ko ye̱ trom le̱ mli ní atoko moko ye̱ mli pẽṅ;

english_verse: A jar of cheap wine was there. Someone then soaked a sponge with the wine and held it up to Jesus' mouth on the stem of a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ nõ mã dše̱i ke̱ emli ašiṅ obõ; ni ame̱ṅõ ṅšo̱ṅkotša ame̱tšo̱ *ašiṅ le̱ mli, ni ame̱ṅõ-mã hisopotšo nā, ni ame̱ṅō-to enā. *Lal.

english_verse: kilograms of spices made from myrrh and aloes. This was the same Nicodemus who had visited Jesus one night.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ beni Iesu he ašiṅ le̱, ekē̱: Agbe nā! ni emã eyi ši, ni eṅõ emumo̱ le̱ ehã.

english_verse: The next day would be both a Sabbath and the Passover. It was a special day for the Jewish people, and they did not want the bodies to stay on the crosses during this day. So they asked Pilate to break the men's legs and take their bodies down.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Iudafoi le̱ yakpa Pilato fai ake̱ akũmo̱ ame̱nãdši ni adšĩeame̱, beni afe ní ame̱gbohĩī le̱ akahĩ se̱ṅmo̱tšo le̱ no̱ ye̱ hedšō̱mo̱gbĩ le̱ no̱, edšake̱ hesāmo̱-ke̱-tō-gbĩ ni, ni nakai hedšō̱mo̱gbĩ le̱ gbĩ wulu ni.

english_verse: One of the soldiers stuck his spear into Jesus' side, and blood and water came out.
translation_verse: ši moṅ asrafoi le̱ ateṅ mokome ke̱ akplo̱ tšu eṅmãwuaṅ, ni amrõ le̱ lá ke̱ nu dše̱ mli ho.

english_verse: We know this is true, because it was told by someone who saw it happen. Now you can have faith too.
translation_verse: Ni moni na le̱, le̱ eye he odase ne̱, ni edase le̱ ano̱kwaṅ, ni ele ake̱ ano̱kwale ewieo̱, koni nye hũ nyehé nyeye.

english_verse: All this happened so that the Scriptures would come true, which say, “No bone of his body will be broken”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ afe nii ne̱, koni noni *aṅmã ake̱: “Akũṅ ewú ko” le̱ aba mli. *

english_verse: and “They will see the one in whose side they stuck a spear.” Jesus Is Buried (Matthew
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ *ṅmãle̱ kroko kē̱: “Ame̱-akwe̱ moni ame̱tšule̱ nõ le̱.” *Zak.

english_verse: The tomb was nearby, and since it was the time to prepare for the Sabbath, they were in a hurry to put Jesus' body there.
translation_verse: nohewo̱ le̱ ame̱yato Iesu ye̱ dše̱i ye̱ Iudafoi le̱ ahesāmo̱-ke̱-tō-gbĩ le̱ hewo̱, edšake̱ sāṅ le̱ be̱ṅke̱.

english_verse: Joseph from Arimathea was one of Jesus' disciples. He had kept it secret though, because he was afraid of the Jewish leaders. But now he asked Pilate to let him have Jesus' body. Pilate gave him permission, and Joseph took it down from the cross.
translation_verse: Ni nii ne̱ ase̱ le̱ Iosef ní dše̱ Arimatia ní dši Iesu kaselo̱, ši Iudafoi le̱ ašemo̱ hewo̱ le̱ edšiee ehe ši le̱, eyabi Pilato, koni ehã eyadšie Iesu gbonyo le̱; ni Pilato hãle̱ hegbe̱. Nohewo̱ le̱ ete ni eyadšie Iesu gbonyo le̱ ke̱-te.

english_verse: The two men wrapped the body in a linen cloth, together with the spices, which was how the Jewish people buried their dead.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ame̱ṅõ Iesu gbonyo le̱, ni ame̱ke̱ klalai le̱ ke̱ tšofãi le̱ fĩmo̱le̱, tamo bo̱ni Iudafoi feo̱ fũo̱ mo le̱.

english_verse: Thomas replied, “You are my Lord and my God!”
translation_verse: Toma here no̱ ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Mi-Nuṅtšo̱ ke̱ *mi-Nyoṅmo̱! *

english_verse: Although Thomas the Twin was one of the twelve disciples, he wasn't with the others when Jesus appeared to them.
translation_verse: Ši *Toma, mei nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱ le̱ ateṅ mokome ní atšē̱o̱le̱ Didimo le̱, be̱ ame̱teṅ ni Iesu ba le̱. *

english_verse: Peter and the other disciple started for the tomb.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ Petro ke̱ nakai kaselo̱ kome le̱ dše kpo, ni ame̱yiṅ ke̱-mīya sāṅ le̱ he.

english_verse: When Simon Peter got there, he went into the tomb and saw the strips of cloth.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni Simon nyie ese̱ ke̱-ba, ni ebabote bu le̱ mli, ni ena klalai le̱ dſere ši;

english_verse: He also saw the piece of cloth that had been used to cover Jesus' face. It was rolled up and in a place by itself.
translation_verse: ši *duku ní ake̱-fĩ eyĩtšo le̱ kãã klalai le̱ amase̱i, ši moṅ akũmo̱ mli ni ekã hekroko bãnē. *

english_verse: The angels asked Mary, “Why are you crying?” She answered, “They have taken away my Lord's body! I don't know where they have put him.”
translation_verse: Ni ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Awó, mẽba ofóo̱? Ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Edšake̱ ame̱wó mi-Nnntšo̱ le̱ ke̱-te, ni milee heni ame̱ke̱le̱ eyaṅmẽ.

english_verse: Jesus asked her, “Why are you crying? Who are you looking for?” She thought he was the gardener and said, “Sir, if you have taken his body away, please tell me, so I can go and get him.”
translation_verse: Iesu kē̱le̱ ake̱: Awó, mẽba ofóo̱? Le̱ le̱ esusu ake̱ bene̱ tromsālo̱ le̱ ni, ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, ké̱ bo owóle̱ ke̱-dše bie̱ le̱, tšõmo̱mi heni oke̱le̱ eyaṅmẽ, koni mayawóle̱.

english_verse: and showed them his hands and his side. When the disciples saw the Lord, they became very happy.
translation_verse: Ni beni ekē̱ nakai le̱, *eṅõ edii le̱ ke̱ eṅmāwuaṅ le̱ etšõame̱. Ke̱ke̱ ni kaselo̱i le̱ ná mīše̱ ake̱ ame̱na Nuṅtšo̱ le̱.

english_verse: After Jesus had greeted them again, he said, “I am sending you, just as the Father has sent me.”
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ Iesu sā kē̱ame̱ ekoṅ ake̱: Hedšo̱le̱ ahãnye! Bo̱ni tše̱ le̱ *tšũmi le̱, nakai mi hũ mitšũo̱nye ne̱. *

english_verse: Then he breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ni beni ekē̱ nakai le̱, emū eſie ame̱no̱, ni ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyehea Mumo̱ kroṅkroṅ le̱!

english_verse: If you forgive anyone's sins, they will be forgiven. But if you don't forgive their sins, they will not be forgiven.” Jesus and Thomas
translation_verse: *Mei ahe ešai ní nyeaṅõ-faame̱ le̱, aṅõ-faame̱; ni mei ahe ešai ni nyeke̱-ato le̱, aṅõ-to. *Mat.

english_verse: So they told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But Thomas said, “First, I must see the nail scars in his hands and touch them with my finger. I must put my hand where the spear went into his side. I won't believe unless I do this!”
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ kaselo̱i krokomei le̱ kē̱le̱ ake̱: Wó̱na Nuṅtšo̱ le̱. Ši ekē̱ame̱ aké̱: Dša mina edeṅ ple̱kobĩi le̱ anãdšiaṅ, ni mike̱ miwao eta ple̱kobii le̱ anãdšiaṅ, ni mike̱ minine eho̱ *eṅmãwuaṅ le̱, dãni mahe maye. *

english_verse: A week later the disciples were together again. This time, Thomas was with them. Jesus came in while the doors were still locked and stood in the middle of the group. He greeted his disciples
translation_verse: Ni gbĩĩ kpānyo̱ se̱ ekoṅ le̱ ekaselo̱i le̱ ye̱ tšũ mli, ni Toma hũ ye̱ mli. Ni *aṅãmo̱ šĩnāi le̱ ni Iesu ba, ni ebadamo̱ ame̱teṅ ni ekē̱: Hedšo̱le̱ ahãnye! *K.

english_verse: and said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at my hands! Put your hand into my side. Stop doubting and have faith!”
translation_verse: No se̱ le̱ ekē̱ Toma ake̱: Oke̱ owao aba bie̱ ní obakwe̱ midẽ le̱, ni oke̱ onine abaho miṅmãwuaṅ le̱, ni okadše ṅwane, šĩ moṅ ohe oye.

english_verse: Jesus said, “Thomas, do you have faith because you have seen me? The people who have faith in me without seeing me are the ones who are really blessed!” Why John Wrote His Book
translation_verse: Iesu kē̱le̱ ake̱: Toma, ní onami hewo̱ le̱, ohe oye; adšō̱ *mei ní enaa ni kẽle̱ ame̱he ame̱ye le̱. *

english_verse: Jesus worked many other miracles for his disciples, and not all of them are written in this book.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ okadii krokomei pī hũ ye̱ ní Iesu fe ye̱ ekaselo̱i le̱ ahĩe, ní aṅmãã ye̱ wolo ne̱ mli;

english_verse: But these are written so that you will put your faith in Jesus as the Messiah and the Son of God. If you have faith in him, you will have true life.
translation_verse: ši ene̱mei le̱ aṅmã, koni nyehé nyeye ake̱ Iesu dši Kristo, Nyoṅmo̱ bi le̱, ni ké̱ *nyeheo̱ nyeyeo̱ le̱, ní nyená wala ye̱ egbe̱i le̱ mli, *

english_verse: Simon Peter said, “I'm going fishing!” The others said, “We will go with you.” They went out in their boat. But they didn't catch a thing that night.
translation_verse: Simon Petro kē̱ame̱ ake̱: Mīya wuo. Ame̱kē̱le̱ ake̱: Wo̱ hũ wo̱ke̱o mīya. Ame̱yiṅ ni ame̱yabote le̱le̱ mli, ni nakai nyō le̱ṅ le̱ ame̱gbee noko.

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple told Peter, “It's the Lord!” When Simon heard it was the Lord, he put on the clothes he had taken off while he was working. Then he jumped into the water.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ kaselo̱ ni Iesu *sumoo̱ le̱ kē̱ Petro ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ ni. Agbe̱ne̱, beni Simon Petro nu ake̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ ni le̱, eke̱ etade le̱ ṅmõ ehe̱, edšake̱ etá ši yayai, ni etũ egbē ṅšo̱ le̱ mli. *

english_verse: When the disciples got out of the boat, they saw some bread and a charcoal fire with fish on it.
translation_verse: Ši beni ame̱kpleke le̱, ame̱bana ṅãi ke̱ la ye̱ dše̱i, ni lō dſere no̱, ke̱ abolo.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “Bring some of the fish you just caught.”
translation_verse: Iesu kē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyeke̱ lōi ní nyegbe biane̱ le̱ eko abaä.

english_verse: Jesus said, “Come and eat!” But none of the disciples dared ask who he was. They knew he was the Lord.
translation_verse: Iesu kē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyebakpaä nyenā noko. Ni kaselo̱i le̱ ateṅ moko ekaale̱ bimo̱ ake̱: Namo dšio? edšake̱ ame̱le ake̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ ni.

english_verse: This was the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from death. Jesus and Peter
translation_verse: Šii etẽ ne̱ ní Iesu dšie ehe kpo etšõ ekaselo̱i le̱, beni ete ši ke̱-dše̱ gbohĩĩ ateṅ le̱.

english_verse: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter was hurt because Jesus had asked him three times if he loved him. So he told Jesus, “Lord, you know everything. You know I love you.” Jesus replied, “Feed my sheep.
translation_verse: Ekē̱le̱ noni dši *ši etẽ ake̱: Simon, Iona bi, ōdo̱ mihe lo? Edo̱ Petro ake̱ ekē̱le̱ šii etẽ so̱ṅṅ ake̱: ōdo̱ mihe lo? le̱; ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, †ole nii fiā, ole ake̱ mīdo̱ ohe. Iesu kē̱le̱ ake̱: Lè̱ mitōi le̱! *

english_verse: I tell you for certain that when you were a young man, you dressed yourself and went wherever you wanted to go. But when you are old, you will hold out your hands. Then others will wrap your belt around you and lead you where you don't want to go.”
translation_verse: Le̱le̱ṅ, le̱le̱ṅ, mīkē̱o ake̱: Beni odši oblanyo le̱, bodientše̱ omĩaä ni onyieo̱ heni osumoo̱; ši ké̱ ogbo̱ le̱, ookpã onidši amli, ni mokroko aamĩao, ni eke̱o aate heni osumo̱o̱.

english_verse: Jesus said this to tell how Peter would die and bring honor to God. Then he said to Peter, “Follow me!” Jesus and His Favorite Disciple
translation_verse: Ši ekē̱ ene̱ eke̱-tšõ nõ gbĕle ní eke̱-bawo Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe nyam. Ni beni ekē̱ ene̱ le̱, ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Nyiemo̱ mise̱!

english_verse: Peter turned and saw Jesus' favorite disciple following them. He was the same one who had sat next to Jesus at the meal and had asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”
translation_verse: Ši beni Petro tšṍ ehe le̱, ena kaselo̱ ní Iesu *sumoo̱ le̱ nyie se̱, le̱ dši moni kpasa Iesu tšitši ye̱ niyenii le̱ aši ni ekē̱le̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, namo batšõ ose̱gbe̱ le̱? *

english_verse: When Peter saw this disciple, he asked Jesus, “Lord, what about him?”
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, beni Petro na le̱ le̱, ekē̱ Iesu ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, ši mone̱ hũ?

english_verse: Jesus answered, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return? You must follow me.”
translation_verse: Iesu kē̱le̱ ake̱: Ke̱dši mīsumo̱ ake̱ ehī ši ke̱-yaši mibābe le̱, ohe sane meni dši no? Bo le̱ nyiemo̱ mise̱!

english_verse: So the rumor spread among the other disciples that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say he would not die. He simply said, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return?”
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱ wiemo̱ ne̱ gbe̱ ſã ye̱ nyemimei le̱ ateṅ, ake̱ nakai kaselo̱ le̱ gboṅ. Tše̱ Iesu ekē̱ē̱le̱ ake̱ egboṅ, ši moṅ ekē̱: Ke̱dši mīsumo̱ ake̱ ehĩ ši ke̱-yaši mibābe le̱, ohe sane meni dši no?

english_verse: This disciple is the one who told all of this. He wrote it, and we know he is telling the truth.
translation_verse: Mone̱ dši kaselo̱ ni yeo̱ nii ne̱ ahe odase le̱, ni le̱ eṅmã nii ne̱, ni wo̱le ake̱ edase le̱ ano̱kwaleṅ.

english_verse: Jesus did many other things. If they were all written in books, I don't suppose there would be room enough in the whole world for all the books.
translation_verse: Ši nii krokomei pī hũ ye̱ ní Iesu fe, nĩ ke̱dši akē̱ aaṅmã fẽ ekomekome le̱, misusuo̱ ake̱ dše le̱ dientše̱ nyẽṅ wodši ni kũle̱ aaṅmã le̱ ato. [Amen.]

english_verse: While the apostles were still with Jesus, they asked him, “Lord, are you now going to give Israel its own king again?”
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ mei ní nā ebakpe ši le̱ bile̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, ani ne̱ke̱ be ne̱ mli *obatē maṅtše̱yeli le̱ ši omã ši ohã Israel le̱? *Luk.

english_verse: After Jesus had said this and while they were watching, he was taken up into a cloud. They could not see him,
translation_verse: Ni beni ewie nii ne̱, ame̱mīkwe̱le̱ noṅṅ, ni awóle̱, ni atatu ko ṅõle̱ ke̱-dše ame̱hĩe ke̱-te. Mar.

english_verse: They said, “Why are you men from Galilee standing here and looking up into the sky? Jesus has been taken to heaven. But he will come back in the same way you have seen him go.” Someone To Take the Place of Judas
translation_verse: mei ní kē̱ ũi ake: Nye Galileahīĩ, mẽba nyedamo̱ ši nyekwe̱o̱ ṅwei ne̱ke̱? Ne̱ke̱ Iesu ne̱ ní aṅõle̱ ke̱-dše nyeṅō ke̱-te ṅwei ne̱, *ebaba nakai noṅṅ, tamo̱ boni nyena ake̱ eyaä ṅwei ne̱. *Luk.

english_verse: The apostles often met together and prayed with a single purpose in mind. The women and Mary the mother of Jesus would meet with them, and so would his brothers.
translation_verse: Mene̱mei fẽ, ke̱ yei le̱ ke̱ Iesu nye Maria ke̱ *enyemimeĩhĩĩ le̱, ke̱ †dſẽṅmo̱ kome hĩe so̱lemo̱ ke̱ faikpamo mli wā. *Ioh.

english_verse: Then Judas bought some land with the money he was given for doing that evil thing. He fell headfirst into the field. His body burst open, and all his insides came out.
translation_verse: Ši ne̱ke̱ nū ne̱ ṅõ enõša ní efe le̱ mli nyõmo̱wo le̱ ehé abō̱, ni eyamã eyi ši, ni emli gbá enyo̱ ni emlinii fẽ tue ſie ši; Mat.

english_verse: When the people of Jerusalem found out about this, they called the place Akeldama, which in the local language means “Field of Blood.”
translation_verse: ni mei fẽ ni yo̱ Ierusalem le̱ ná-le ene̱, nohewo le̱ atšé̱o̱ nakai abō̱ le̱ ye̱ ame̱dientše̱ ame̱wiemo̱ mli ake̱ Akeldama, ešiši dši “lá-abō̱.”

english_verse: In the book of Psalms it says, “Leave his house empty, and don't let anyone live there.” It also says, “Let someone else have his job.”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ aṅmã ye̱ *Lalai awolo le̱ mli ake̱: “Ha ešihĩle̱he le̱ atšṍ amaṅfõ ní mokomoko akahĩ mli,” “ni eno̱kwe̱mo̱nitšumo le hã mokroko ako.” *Lal.

english_verse: Two men were suggested: One of them was Joseph Barsabbas, known as Justus, and the other was Matthias.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱fãmo̱ mei enyo̱, Iosef ni atšé̱o̱le̱ Barsaba ní awole̱ Iusto hũ le̱, ke̱ Matia, ame̱damo̱ ši.

english_verse: Then they all prayed, “Lord, you know what everyone is like! Show us the one you have chosen
translation_verse: Ni ame̱so̱le ame̱kē̱: Bo, Nuṅtšo̱, ní ole gbomei fẽ atšuiiaṅ, tšõmo̱ mei enyo̱ ne̱ ateṅ moni ohala,

english_verse: to be an apostle and to serve in place of Judas, who got what he deserved.”
translation_verse: koni eṅõ ne̱ke̱ súomo̱ ke̱ bo̱fonitšumo̱ ní Iuda edše mli eko̱ le̱dientše̱ egbe̱ le̱.

english_verse: They drew names, and Matthias was chosen to join the group of the eleven apostles.
translation_verse: Ni *ame̱fõ ame̱no̱ ošikii, ni ošiki le̱ yagbe Matia no̱, ni abule̱ aši bo̱foi nyonma ke̱ ekome le̱ no̱. *Abe̱i

english_verse: And when they heard this noise, a crowd gathered. But they were surprised, because they were hearing everything in their own languages.
translation_verse: Ni beni anu ne̱ke̱ gbē̱mo̱ ne̱, mei babaō babua ame̱he nā, ni ame̱he dšõ amehe, edšake̱ mofẽmo nu ake̱ ame̱mīwie le̱dientše̱ emaṅ wiemo.

english_verse: Some of us are from Parthia, Media, and Elam. Others are from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,
translation_verse: Partiabii ke̱ Mediabii ke̱ Elambii, ke̱ mei ní yo̱ Mesopotamia ke̱ Iudea ke̱ Kapadokia, Ponto ke̱ Asia,

english_verse: In those days I will give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women, and they will prophesy.
translation_verse: ni asaṅ mitšŭdšihĩĩ ke̱ mitšũdšiyei le̱ ano̱ hũ mafo̱se mi-Mumo̱ le̱ eko maſie ye̱ nakai gbĩĩ le̱ ano̱, ni ame̱agba.

english_verse: Now, listen to what I have to say about Jesus from Nazareth. God proved he sent Jesus to you by having him work miracles, wonders, and signs. All of you know this.
translation_verse: Atāmei Israelbii, nyeboa ne̱ke̱ wiemoi ne̱ atoi: Iesu Nazarenyo le̱, nū ni Nyoṅmo̱ ke̱ hewale̱nitšumo̱i ke̱ nākpe̱nii ke̱ okadii ni etšṍ enine no̱ efe ye̱ nyeteṅ le̱ ye ehe odase etšõnye, tamo̱ bo̱ni nyedientše̱ nyele le̱,

english_verse: God had already planned and decided that Jesus would be handed over to you. So you took him and had evil men put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: le̱ ní *adšiele̱ ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ yiṅtō ke̱ enii ní ele eto le̱ nā ahã le̱, nyetšṍ mei ní be̱ mla le̱ anine no̱ nyese̱ṅle̱ ni nyegbele̱; *

english_verse: What David said are really the words of Jesus, “I always see the Lord near me, and I will not be afraid with him at my right side.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *David wie ye̱ ehe ekē̱: “Minaä Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ ye̱ mihĩe dā, edšake̱ eye̱ mininedšŭrõ no̱, koni mikadĩdã. *Lal.

english_verse: Because of this, my heart will be glad, my words will be joyful, and I will live in hope.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ mitšui enyõ mimli ni milile̱i mīnyã́, ni asaṅ mihelo hũ aadšō̱ ehe ye̱ hĩeno̱kāmo̱ mli;

english_verse: The Lord won't leave me in the grave. I am his holy one, and he won't let my body decay.
translation_verse: edšake̱ ošīṅ misusuma ye̱ gbohĩĩadše, ni ohãṅ omokroṅkroṅ le̱ ana fitemo̱.

english_verse: He has shown me the path to life, and he makes me glad by being near me.”
translation_verse: Ohã mile wala gbe̱i le̱, ni oohã mitšui anyõ mimli fā ye̱ ohĩe.”

english_verse: My friends, it is right for me to speak to you about our ancestor David. He died and was buried, and his tomb is still here.
translation_verse: Atāmei ke̱ anyemimei, nyehāa mawiea faṅṅ matšõanye ye̱ blematše̱ David le̱ hewo̱, ake̱ egbo ni afũle̱, ni esãṅ ye̱ wo̱teṅ ke̱-baši ṅme̱ne̱.

english_verse: Jesus was taken up to sit at the right side of God, and he was given the Holy Spirit, just as the Father had promised. Jesus is also the one who has given the Spirit to us, and this is what you are now seeing and hearing.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ ake̱ noni awo eno̱ ke̱-te Nyoṅmo̱ ninedšŭrõ no̱ ni ená Mumo̱ kroṅkroṅ le̱ he šiwō le̱ ke̱-dše̱ tše̱ le̱ dẽ hewo̱ le̱, efo̱se noni nyenaä ní nyenuo̱ ne̱ eſie šĩ.

english_verse: David didn't go up to heaven. So he wasn't talking about himself when he said, “The Lord told my Lord to sit at his right side,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ David eyaa ṅwei, *ši le̱ noṅṅ ekē̱: “Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ kē̱ minuṅtšo̱ le̱ ake̱: Tá mininedšũrõ no̱, *Lal.

english_verse: until he made my Lord's enemies into a footstool for him.”
translation_verse: ke̱-yaši beyino ní maṅõ ohenye̱lo̱i le̱ mafe onãdšiaši māṅō.”

english_verse: Everyone in Israel should then know for certain that God has made Jesus both Lord and Christ, even though you put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ hã ní Israel we le̱ fẽ ale kre̱dē̱ ake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ eṅõ ne̱ke̱ Iesu ni nyese̱ṅle̱ ne̱ efe Nuṅtšo̱ ke̱ Kristo fẽ.

english_verse: When the people heard this, they were very upset. They asked Peter and the other apostles, “Friends, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Ši beni ame̱nu ene̱ le̱, etšuro̱ ame̱tšuiiaṅ, ni ame̱kē̱ Petro ke̱ bo̱foi ní eſe̱ le̱ ake̱: Atāmei ke̱ anyemĩmei, *té wo̱o̱fe tēṅ? *

english_verse: Peter said to them, “Turn to God and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ni Petro kē̱ame̱ ake̱: *Nyetšakea nyetšuii amli ní nyeteṅ mofẽmo ahã abaptisile̱ awo Iesu Kristo gbe̱i amli, koni aṅõ nyehe ešai le̱ afanye, ni nyeaná Mumo̱ kroṅkroṅ nõkēnõ le̱. *

english_verse: This promise is for you and your children. It is for everyone our Lord God will choose, no matter where they live.”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ šiwō le̱, nye ke̱ nyebii ke̱ mei fẽ ní yo̱ se̱ šoṅṅ, *mei abo̱ ni Nuṅtšo̱, wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, aatšé̱ ke̱-aba le̱ anõ ni. *Ioel

english_verse: Peter told them many other things as well. Then he said, “I beg you to save yourselves from what will happen to all these evil people.”
translation_verse: Ni ewie wiemo̱i krokomei pī eke̱-ye odase ni eke̱-woame̱ ṅā ake̱: Nyehãa aherea nyeyiwala ke̱-dše̱a *yíne̱ kõdõṅ ne̱ mli. *

english_verse: Everyone was amazed by the many miracles and wonders that the apostles worked.
translation_verse: Ni gbeyei mõ mofẽmo, ni bo̱foi le̱ fe nākpenii ke̱ okadii pī.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers often met together, and they shared everything they had.
translation_verse: Ni mei ní heo̱ yeo̱ le̱ fẽ ye̱ hekome, ni amefe ame̱nii fẽ ekome;

english_verse: They would sell their property and possessions and give the money to whoever was in need.
translation_verse: ni ame̱šikpõdši ke̱ ame̱henii le̱ ame̱hõhõi, ni ame̱dša mli ame̱hã mei le̱ fẽ boni he hīaä mofẽmo.

english_verse: Day after day they met together in the temple. They broke bread together in different homes and shared their food happily and freely,
translation_verse: Ni dā gbĩ le̱ ame̱ke̱ dſẽṅmo̱ kome yaä so̱lemo̱we le̱, ni ame̱kũmo̱kũmoo̱ abolo ye̱ šīai, ni ame̱ke̱ mīše̱ ke̱ tšui kro̱ṅṅ yeo̱ nii, K.

english_verse: while praising God. Everyone liked them, and each day the Lord added to their group others who were being saved.
translation_verse: ni ame̱dšieo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ yi, ni ame̱hĩe ba nyam ye̱ maṅ mū le̱ fẽ hĩe. Ni Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ *ṅõo̱ mei ní ahere ame̱yiwala le̱ efataä asafo le̱ he gbĩ-fẽ-gbĩ. *

english_verse: The man saw Peter and John entering the temple, and he asked them for money.
translation_verse: Ni beni ena Petro ke̱ Iohane boteo̱ so̱lemo̱we le̱, eba-ame̱ noko.

english_verse: But Peter said, “I don't have any silver or gold! But I will give you what I do have. In the name of Jesus Christ from Nazareth, get up and start walking.”
translation_verse: Ši Petro kē̱: Dſie̱te̱i ke̱ šika le̱ mĩbe̱ eko; ši noni miyo̱ le̱, no miṅō-hãao ne̱: Iesu Kristo, Nazarenyo le̱, gbe̱i amli le̱, te ši ní onyie! K.

english_verse: Peter then took him by the right hand and helped him up. At once the man's feet and ankles became strong,
translation_verse: Ni emō eninedšŭrõ mli ni ewó eno̱ edamo̱ ši; ni amrõ le̱ noṅṅ le̱ enãdši ke̱ etalo̱i le̱ amli wale̱;

english_verse: and he jumped up and started walking. He went with Peter and John into the temple, walking and jumping and praising God.
translation_verse: ni ehuru edamo̱ ši ni ebõĩ nyiemo̱, ni eke̱ame̱ bote so̱lemo̱we le̱ ke̱ nyiemo̱ ke̱ tũmo̱ ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱ yidšiemo̱.

english_verse: Everyone saw him walking around and praising God.
translation_verse: Ni maṅ mū le̱ fẽ nale̱ ní enyie ẽdšĩe Nyoṅmo̱ yi;

english_verse: Peter saw that a crowd had gathered, and he said: Friends, why are you surprised at what has happened? Why are you staring at us? Do you think we have some power of our own? Do you think we were able to make this man walk because we are so religious?
translation_verse: Ši beni Petro na ene̱ le̱, ekē̱ maṅ le̱ ake̱: Nye Israelhĩĩ, mẽba nyehĩe feo̱nye yā ye̱ ene̱ hewo̱? alo mẽba nyekwe̱o̱wo̱ gā̃ ne̱ke̱, tamo̱ noni wo̱dientše̱ wo̱hewale̱ lo Nyoṅmo̱-dšámo̱ wo̱ke̱-hã mone̱ nyieo̱ ne̱?

english_verse: You rejected Jesus, who was holy and good. You asked for a murderer to be set free,
translation_verse: Ši nye le̱, nyekwa mokroṅkroṅ ke̱ dšalo̱ le̱, ni *nyekpa fai ake̱ aṅõ gbomo awuyelo̱ moṅ akenye, *Mat

english_verse: You see this man, and you know him. He put his faith in the name of Jesus and was made strong. Faith in Jesus made this man completely well while everyone was watching.
translation_verse: Ni egbe̱i le̱ ano̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli nā ni egbe̱i le̱ tšá mone̱ ní nyenaä ní nyele le̱; ni eno̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ ehã efe kpintiṅ-kpliṅṅ ye̱ nyefẽ nyehĩe ne̱.

english_verse: My friends, I am sure you and your leaders didn't know what you were doing.
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱, enyemimei, mile ake̱, lē ní nyelee hewo̱ ní nyefe, tamo̱ nyenukpai le̱ noṅṅ; Luk.

english_verse: Then the time will come when the Lord will give you fresh strength. He will send you Jesus, his chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: beni afe ní hedšō̱mo̱ yino̱ adše̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ hĩe aba, ní etšũ Iesu Kristo moni edšie etonye momo le̱;

english_verse: But Jesus must stay in heaven until God makes all things new, just as his holy prophets promised long ago.
translation_verse: moni sa ake̱ eyahĩ ṅwei ke̱-yaši nibii fẽ agbe̱dšiano̱tō be le̱ ní Nyoṅmo̱ ewie he ye̱ egbalo̱i kroṅkroṅi le̱ anā ke̱-dše̱ tetēte le̱.

english_verse: No one who disobeys this prophet will be one of God's people any longer.”
translation_verse: Ni aaba mli ake̱, mofẽmo ní boṅ nakai gbalo̱ le̱ toi le̱, aakpãtã ehĩe kwrā ke̱-adše̱ maṅ le̱ mli.”

english_verse: Samuel and all the other prophets who came later also spoke about what is now happening.
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ gbaloi fẽ ní wie ke̱-dše̱ Samuel ke̱ mei ní nyie ese̱ le̱ no̱ le̱, ame̱tšĩ ne̱ke̱ gbĩĩ ne̱ hũ atã ame̱to.

english_verse: You are really the ones God told his prophets to speak to. And you were given the promise God made to your ancestors. He said to Abraham, “All nations on earth will be blessed because of someone from your family.”
translation_verse: Nyedši gbaloi le̱ ke̱ kpãṅmo̱ le̱ bii, kpãṅmo̱ ni Nyoṅmo̱ ke̱ wo̱tše̱mei le̱ kpãṅ, beni ekē̱ Abraham ake̱: *“Ni oseši mli aadšō̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ wekui fẽ ye̱” le̱. *

english_verse: God sent his chosen Son to you first, because God wanted to bless you and make each one of you turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Ni Nyoṅmo̱ tē etšũlo̱ Iesu le̱ ši le̱, *nye tšutšu nyeṅõ etšũle̱ ní ebadšō̱nye ni ekpale nyeteṅ mofẽmo ke̱-dše̱ enĩfõdšianii le̱ amli. *

english_verse: But a lot of people who had heard the message believed it. So by now there were about
translation_verse: Ši mei ní nu wiemo̱ le̱ ateṅ mei pī hé ye, ni hĩĩ le̱ ayibo̱ aafe akpei-enumo̱.

english_verse: They brought in Peter and John and made them stand in the middle while they questioned them. They asked, “By what power and in whose name have you done this?”
translation_verse: ni ame̱yaṅõame̱ ameba damo̱ teṅ, ni ame̱biame̱ ake̱: Mē hewale̱ nā alo mẽ gbe̱i amli nyefe ene̱ ye̱? Mat.

english_verse: But there is something we must tell you and everyone else in Israel. This man is standing here completely well because of the power of Jesus Christ from Nazareth. You put Jesus to death on a cross, but God raised him to life.
translation_verse: no le̱ nyefẽ ke̱ Israel maṅ mū le̱ fẽ aná ale ake̱, Iesu Kristo, Nazarenyo le̱, ní nyese̱ṅ, ní Nyoṅmo̱ tēle̱ ši ke̱-dše̱ gbohĩĩ ateṅ le̱, le̱ noṅṅ egbe̱i amli mone̱ damo̱ nyehĩe ni ehe étã ne̱.

english_verse: The officials were amazed to see how brave Peter and John were, and they knew that these two apostles were only ordinary men and not well educated. The officials were certain these men had been with Jesus.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ beni ame̱na Petro ke̱ Iohane ekã le̱ ni ame̱yo ake̱ dšee woloṅlelo̱i ke̱ nilelo̱i komei dšiame̱ le̱, efe ame̱hĩe yā, ni ame̱ko̱ se̱ ake̱ ame̱ke̱ Iesu hĩ ši.

english_verse: But they could not deny what had happened. The man who had been healed was standing there with the apostles.
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ ake̱-ní ame̱na gbomo ní *atšále̱ le̱ ke̱ame̱ damo̱ ši hewo̱ le̱, ame̱náá noko ame̱kē̱. *

english_verse: “What can we do with these men? Everyone in Jerusalem knows about this miracle, and we cannot say it didn't happen.
translation_verse: ame̱kē̱: Té wo̱o̱fe gbomei ne̱ tēṅ? edšake̱ okadi wulu ní amefe le̱ ye̱ faṅṅ ye̱ mei fẽ ní yo̱ Ierusalem le̱ ahĩe, ni wo̱nyẽṅ wo̱tšo. Ioh.

english_verse: But to keep this thing from spreading, we will warn them never again to speak to anyone about the name of Jesus.”
translation_verse: Ši kẽle̱, beni afe ní ekahehe tūtu ko doṅṅ ye̱ maṅ le̱ mli hewo̱ le̱, *nyehāa wo̱woa ame̱he gbeyei, koni ame̱kawie ye̱ ne̱ke̱ gbe̱i ne̱ amli ame̱mītšõ mokomoko doṅṅ. *

english_verse: So they called the two apostles back in and told them they must never, for any reason, teach anything about the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱tšé̱ame̱ ke̱-ba, ni ame̱woame̱ kitã ake̱ ame̱katšĩ tã ni ame̱katšõ nii ye̱ Iesu gbe̱i amli kwrā doṅṅ.

english_verse: We cannot keep quiet about what we have seen and heard.”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ wo̱ le̱ wo̱nyẽṅ ake̱ dša wo̱wie nii ní wo̱na ke̱ nii ní wonu le̱.

english_verse: And by the Holy Spirit you spoke to our ancestor David. He was your servant, and you told him to say: “Why are all the Gentiles so furious? Why do people make foolish plans?
translation_verse: bo moni otšṍ wo̱tše̱ David, otšũlo̱ le̱, nā *okē̱: “Mẽba dšeṅmădši le̱ feo̱ hō, ni mãdši le hū dſẽṅo yakanii? *Lal.

english_verse: The kings of earth prepare for war, and the rulers join together against the Lord and his Messiah.”
translation_verse: Šikpoṅ no̱ maṅtše̱mei le̱ ete ši edamo̱ ši, ni lume̱i le̱ hũ anā ebakpe ši ewo Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ ke̱ moni efo̱le̱ mũ le̱”:

english_verse: Here in Jerusalem, Herod and Pontius Pilate got together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel. Then they turned against your holy Servant Jesus, your chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Le̱le̱ṅ, *Herode ke̱ Pontio Pilato ke̱ dšeṅmădši le̱ ke̱ Israel mãdši le̱ hũ ebabua ame̱he nā ye̱ mă ne̱ṅ ame̱wo otšũlo̱ kroṅkroṅ Iesu, moni ofo̱le̱ mũ le̱, *Luk.

english_verse: They did what you in your power and wisdom had already decided would happen.
translation_verse: koni amefe nii fẽ ni onine ke̱ oyintō le̱ eto efõ ši ake̱ afe le̱.

english_verse: Lord, listen to their threats! We are your servants. So make us brave enough to speak your message.
translation_verse: Ni agbene hũ, Nuṅtšo̱, kwe̱mo̱ ame̱he gbeyei ní ame̱woo̱ le̱, ni ohã otšũdši le̱ ke̱ ekã pī adšadše owiemo̱ le̱, Ef.

english_verse: Show your mighty power, as we heal people and work miracles and wonders in the name of your holy Servant Jesus.
translation_verse: ní okpã onine mli ni ohă atšátšā mei, ní atšṍ otšũlo̱ kroṅkroṅ Iesu le̱ gbe̱i ano̱ afe okadii ke̱ nākpe̱nii.

english_verse: After they had prayed, the meeting place shook. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and bravely spoke God's message. Sharing Possessions
translation_verse: Ni beni ame̱so̱le le̱, heni ame̱nā ebakpe ši ye̱ le hoso, ni Mumo̱ kroṅkroṅ yimo̱ ame̱fẽ ame̱mli obõbõ, ni ame̱ke̱ ekã dšadše Nyoṅmo̱ wiemo le.

english_verse: The group of followers all felt the same way about everything. None of them claimed that their possessions were their own, and they shared everything they had with each other.
translation_verse: Ši mei babaō le̱ ní heo̱ yeo̱ le̱ fẽ hĩe tšui kome ke̱ susuma kome, ní ame̱teṅ mokomoko tšé̱é̱ enii ni eyo̱ le̱ amli eko ake̱ le̱dientše̱ enõ, ši moṅ ame̱ṅõ fẽ amefe ekome.

english_verse: In a powerful way the apostles told everyone that the Lord Jesus was now alive. God greatly blessed his followers,
translation_verse: Ni hewale̱ kpeteṅkple bo̱foi le̱ ke̱-ye Nnntšo̱ Iesu sitē le̱ he odase, ni *dromo̱ kpeteṅkple ye̱ ame̱fẽ ame̱no̱. *

english_verse: and no one went in need of anything. Everyone who owned land or houses would sell them and bring the money
translation_verse: Ni mokomoko be̱ ame̱teṅ ni efĩo̱le̱; edšake̱ mei abo̱ ní yo̱ šikpõdši alo šĩai le̱ hõhõi, ni ame̱ke̱ nii ní ahõ le̱ ayinii le̱ ba,

english_verse: to the apostles. Then they would give the money to anyone in need.
translation_verse: ame̱ke̱-baſie bo̱foi le̱ anădši ana, ni adšäă ahãa mofẽmo bo̱ni he hīaäle̱ le̱.

english_verse: Peter asked her, “Tell me, did you sell the property for this amount?” “Yes,” she answered, “that's the amount.”
translation_verse: Ni Petro bile̱ ake̱: Kē̱mo̱mi, ani bo̱ni nyehõ šikpoṅ le̱ nyehé ne̱? Ni ekē̱: Hẽ, ne̱ke̱ṅ.

english_verse: Many men and women started having faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ ake̱ mei ní heo̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ no̱ yeo̱, hĩĩ ke̱ yei babaō, bafata ame̱he,

english_verse: A lot of people living in the towns near Jerusalem brought those who were sick or troubled by evil spirits, and they were all healed. Trouble for the Apostles
translation_verse: Ni mei pī dše̱ mãdši ní dſere Ierusalem hewo̱ le̱ amli babua ame̱he nā, ni ame̱hĩe helatše̱mei ke̱ mei ní mumo̱i fõdši haoo̱ame̱ ke̱-ba, ni atšáame̱ fẽ.

english_verse: The high priest and all the other Sadducees who were with him became jealous.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni *oso̱fonukpa le̱ te ši ke̱ mei fẽ ní ke̱le̱ yo̱ ní dši Sadukifoi le̱ akū le̱, ni ame̱hĩe edo̱ dientše̱, *

english_verse: “Go to the temple and tell the people everything about this new life.”
translation_verse: Nyeyaä so̱lemo̱we le̱ nyeyadamo̱a ši nyedšadšea ne̱ke̱ wala ne̱ wiemo̱i le̱ fẽ nyetšõa maṅ le̱!

english_verse: So they went into the temple before sunrise and started teaching. The high priest and his men called together their council, which included all of Israel's leaders. Then they ordered the apostles to be brought to them from the jail.
translation_verse: Ni beni amenu le̱, ame̱yiṅ lebi mā̃ṅkpa ame̱te so̱lemo̱we le̱ ame̱yatšõ nii. Agbe̱ne̱ oso̱fonukpa le̱ ke̱ mei ni ke̱le̱ yo̱ le̱ ba ni ame̱batšé̱ akuašoṅ le̱ ke̱ Israelbii le̱ anukpai le̱ fẽ ke̱-kpe, ni ame̱tšū ke̱-te tšũ le̱ṅ koni ayadšieame̱ ke̱-ba.

english_verse: “We found the jail locked tight and the guards standing at the doors. But when we opened the doors and went in, we didn't find anyone there.”
translation_verse: ake̱: Tšũ le̱ wo̱na ake̱ aṅã́ nā kpẽṅṅ, ni bulo̱i le̱ hũ damo̱ šĩnāi le̱ anā; ši beni wo̱gble le̱, wo̱naa moko ye̱ mli.

english_verse: “We told you plainly not to teach in the name of Jesus. But look what you have done! You have been teaching all over Jerusalem, and you are trying to blame us for his death.”
translation_verse: ake̱: *Ani dšee kitã wo̱wonye dikadika ake̱ nyekatšõ nii ye̱ ne̱ke̱ gbei ne̱ ano̱ le̱? ni na, nyehã Ierusalem eyi obõ ke̱ nyetšõmo̱ le̱, ni nyemītao ake̱ nyeke̱ ne̱ke̱ nū ne̱ †lá le baä wo̱no̱. *

english_verse: Peter and the apostles replied: We don't obey people. We obey God.
translation_verse: Ši Petro ke̱ bo̱foi le̱ here no̱ ni ame̱kē̱: Esa ake̱ aboo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ moṅ toi fē gbomei.

english_verse: You killed Jesus by nailing him to a cross. But the God our ancestors worshiped raised him to life
translation_verse: Iesu ní nyese̱ṅle̱ ye̱ tšo no̱ ní nyegbele̱ le̱, wo̱tše̱mei a-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ tēle̱ ši;

english_verse: and made him our Leader and Savior. Then God gave him a place at his right side, so that the people of Israel would turn back to him and be forgiven.
translation_verse: le̱ eno̱ Nyoṅmo̱ *wó ke̱-te eninedšŭrõ no̱, ni ewole̱ lumo̱ ke̱ walaherelo̱, koni eṅõ tšuitšakemo̱ ke̱ ešaifā ehã Israel. *

english_verse: We are here to tell you about all this, and so is the Holy Spirit, who is God's gift to everyone who obeys God.
translation_verse: Ni *wo̱dši ne̱ke̱ sãdši ne̱ ahe odasefoi, nakai noṅṅ dši Mumo̱ kroṅkroṅ le̱ hũ ni Nyoṅmo̱ ṅõ-hã mei ní boo̱le̱ toi le̱. *Luk.

english_verse: When the council members heard this, they became so angry they wanted to kill the apostles.
translation_verse: Ši beni amenu le̱, eflo̱ ame̱tšuiaṅ, ni ame̱to ame̱yiṅ ake̱ ame̱agbeame̱.

english_verse: But one of the members was the Pharisee Gamaliel, a highly respected teacher. He ordered the apostles to be taken out of the room for a little while.
translation_verse: Ši Farisifonyo ko ní atšé̱o̱le̱ *Gamaliel, mlatšõlo̱ ni maṅ le̱ fẽ buo̱le̱ le̱, te ši damo̱ ši ye̱ akuašoṅ le̱ teṅ, ni efã́ ake̱ ake̱ bo̱foi le̱ adše kpo fiō, *

english_verse: Then he said to the council: Men of Israel, be careful what you do with these men.
translation_verse: ni eke̱ame̱ ake̱: Atāmei Israelbii, nyehũmia ši ye̱ ne̱ke̱ gbomei ne̱ ahewo̱, bo̱ni nyeke̱ame̱ aaye ahã.

english_verse: Later, when the people of our nation were being counted, Judas from Galilee showed up. A lot of people followed him, but he was killed, and all his followers were scattered.
translation_verse: Mone̱ se̱ le̱ Iuda, Galileanyo le̱, te ši ye̱ mei-akanemo̱ gbĩĩ le̱ amli, ní egbla asafo babaō eſie ese̱; le̱ hũ ehĩe kpãtã, ni mei ní bole̱ toi le̱ fẽ hũ gbe̱ ſã.

english_verse: So I advise you to stay away from these men. Leave them alone. If what they are planning is something of their own doing, it will fail.
translation_verse: Nohewo le̱ mīkē̱nye ake̱: Nyeṅmē̃a ne̱ke̱ gbomei ne̱ ahe ni nyekadia ame̱se̱; edšake̱ *ké̱ gbomei adeṅ ne̱ke̱ yiṅtō ne̱ lo ne̱ke̱ nitšumo̱ ne̱ dše̱ le̱, ebafite; *Mat.

english_verse: But if God is behind it, you cannot stop it anyway, unless you want to fight against God. The council members agreed with what he said,
translation_verse: ši ké̱ Nyoṅmo̱ deṅ edše̱ le̱, nyenyẽṅ nyefite; koni nyekabafe nyehe tamo̱ mei ni ke̱ *Nyoṅmo̱ wuo̱. *

english_verse: and they called the apostles back in. They had them beaten with a whip and warned them not to speak in the name of Jesus. Then they let them go.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱bole̱ toi; ni ame̱tsé̱ bo̱foi le̱ ke̱-ba, ni *ame̱yiame̱, ni ame̱woame̱ kitã ake̱ ame̱kawie ye̱ Iesu gbe̱i le̱ ano̱, ni ame̱ṅmē̃ ame̱he.

english_verse: The apostles left the council and were happy, because God had considered them worthy to suffer for the sake of Jesus.
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ ni ame̱dše akuašoṅ le̱ hĩe ame̱te *ke̱ mīše̱, ake̱ egbe̱i le̱ ahewo le̱ abuame mei ní sa ake abo̱ame̱ ahora. *Mat.

english_verse: The twelve apostles called the whole group of followers together and said, “We should not give up preaching God's message in order to serve at tables.
translation_verse: Ši mei nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱ le̱ tšé̱ kaselo̱i asafo le̱ ke̱-ba, ni ame̱kē̱: Esaa ake̱ wo̱šĩo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ wiemo̱ le̱ ní wo̱yasúmoo̱ ye̱ okplõi ahe.

english_verse: We can spend our time praying and serving God by preaching.”
translation_verse: ši wo̱ le̱ wo̱o̱hĩe so̱lemo̱ ke̱ wiemo̱ le̱ he súomo̱ le̱ mli.

english_verse: These men were brought to the apostles. Then the apostles prayed and placed their hands on the men to show they had been chosen to do this work.
translation_verse: ni ame̱ke̱ mene̱mei badamo̱ bo̱foi le̱ ahĩe; ni *ame̱so̱le ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱nidši ſie ame̱no̱. *

english_verse: God's message spread, and many more people in Jerusalem became followers. Even a large number of priests put their faith in the Lord. Stephen Is Arrested
translation_verse: Ni *Nyoṅmo̱ wiemo̱ le̱ ſere, ni kaselo̱i le̱ ayi bafá babaō dientše̱ ye̱ Ierusalem; ní oso̱foi le̱ tete ateṅ mei pī boo̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ toi. *

english_verse: God gave Stephen the power to work great miracles and wonders among the people.
translation_verse: Ni Stefano, moni hemo̱-ke̱-yeli ke̱ hewale̱ eyile̱ obõ le̱, fe nākpe̱nii ke̱ okadii wudši ye̱ maṅ le̱ mli.

english_verse: But some men from Cyrene and Alexandria were members of a group who called themselves “Free Men.” They started arguing with Stephen. Some others from Cilicia and Asia also argued with him.
translation_verse: Ši meikomei ní dše̱ kpēhe ní atšé̱o̱ ake̱ Libertinomei ke̱ Kirẽnemei ke̱ Aleksandriamei akpēhe le̱ ke̱ mei ní dše̱ Kilikia ke̱ Asia le̱ ateṅ meikomei te ši ni ame̱ke̱ Stefano tā nā;

english_verse: But they were no match for Stephen, who spoke with the great wisdom that the Spirit gave him.
translation_verse: ši ame̱nyẽẽ nilē ke̱ mumo̱ ní eke̱-wieo̱ le̱ nā ame̱damo̱. Luk.

english_verse: They turned the people and their leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses against Stephen. Then they all grabbed him and dragged him in front of the council.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱wo maṅbii le̱ ke̱ maṅ onukpái le̱ ke̱ woloṅmãlo̱i le̱ ayiṅ, ni ame̱te ši ke̱-ba eno̱ ame̱bamõle̱, ni ame̱kplale̱ ke̱-te akuašoṅ le̱ hĩe.

english_verse: Some men agreed to tell lies about Stephen, and they said, “This man keeps on saying terrible things about this holy temple and the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ke̱ amale-odasefoi badamo̱ ši, ni ame̱kē̱ ake̱: Ne̱ke̱ gbomo ne̱ efõko *hekroṅkroṅ le̱ ke̱ mla le̱ he wiemo pẽṅ; *Ier.

english_verse: We have heard him claim that Jesus from Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses gave us.”
translation_verse: edšake̱ wonu ake̱ ekē̱ ake̱: Iesu, Nazarenyo le̱, aafite bie̱, ní eetšake gbe̱nāi ni Mose ṅõ-hāwo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Then all the council members stared at Stephen. They saw that his face looked like the face of an angel.
translation_verse: Ni mei le̱ ní trá akuašoṅ le̱ mli le̱ fẽ tšũ ame̱hīṅme̱ii ame̱ſie eno̱, ni ame̱na ehĩe tamo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ bo̱fo ko hĩe.

english_verse: But when Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors there for the first time.
translation_verse: Ni beni Iakob nu ake̱ able ye̱ Mizraim le̱, kleṅkleṅ le̱ etšũ wo̱tše̱mei le̱ ke̱-te.

english_verse: Finally, the time came for God to do what he had promised Abraham. By then the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.
translation_verse: Ši beni šiwō le̱ ní Nyoṅmo̱ kã Abraham he kitã le̱ be le̱ še̱ le̱, maṅ le̱ bada, ni ame̱yi fá ye̱ Mizraim šikpoṅ le̱ no̱,

english_verse: One day he saw an Egyptian mistreating one of them. So he rescued the man and killed the Egyptian.
translation_verse: Ni beni ena ake̱ āfe ame̱teṅ moko efõṅ le̱, efã́ ehe, ni eto̱ moni afeo̱le̱ efõṅ le̱ he owele ni egbe Mizraimnyo le̱.

english_verse: Are you going to kill me, just as you killed that Egyptian yesterday?”
translation_verse: Ani otao ake̱ ogbemi, tamo̱ bo̱ni ogbe Mizraimnyo le̱?

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he ran away to live in the country of Midian. His two sons were born there.
translation_verse: Ni wiemo ne̱ hewo̱ le̱ Mose dšo foi, ni eyato gbo̱ ye̱ Midian šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni efo̱ bihĩĩ enyo̱ ye̱ dše̱i.

english_verse: Forty years later, an angel appeared to Moses from a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Ši beni še̱ afii nyoṅmai-edſe̱ le̱, Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ bo̱fo ko badšĩe ehe kpo etšõle̱ ye̱ Sinai goṅ le̱ he ṅã le̱ no̱ ye lalilei mli ye̱ kō ko mli.

english_verse: This was the same Moses that the people rejected by saying, “Who made you our leader and judge?” God's angel had spoken to Moses from the bush. And God had even sent the angel to help Moses rescue the people and be their leader.
translation_verse: Nakai Mose le̱ noṅṅ ní *ame̱kwa ame̱kē̱: Namo woö wo̱no̱ lumo̱ ke̱ kodšolo̱ le̱, le̱ noṅṅ Nyoṅmo̱ tšṍ bo̱fo le̱ ní dšie ehe kpo etšõle̱ ye̱ kō le̱ṅ le̱ nine no̱ etšũle̱ ake̱ lumo̱ ke̱ kpõlo̱. *

english_verse: Moses is the one who told the people of Israel, “God will choose one of your people to be a prophet, just as he chose me.”
translation_verse: Le̱ dši nakai Mose le̱ ni kē̱ Israelbii le̱ ake̱: Nuṅtšo̱, nye-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, aatẽ gbalo̱ ko ní tamo̱mĩ ši ke̱-adše̱ nyenyemimei le̱ ateṅ ahãnye; nyeboale̱ toi le̱.

english_verse: Moses brought our people together in the desert, and the angel spoke to him on Mount Sinai. There he was given these life-giving words to pass on to us.
translation_verse: Mose dši moni ke̱ asafo le̱ hĩ ṅã le̱ no̱, ni edamo̱ bo̱fo le̱ ní ke̱le̱ wie ye̱ Sinai goṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ ke̱ wo̱tše̱mei le̱ ateṅ, ni ehé wala wiemo̱i le̱ eba-hãwo le̱,

english_verse: But our ancestors refused to obey Moses. They rejected him and wanted to go back to Egypt.
translation_verse: ni wo̱tše̱mei le̱ ekplẽẽ ní ame̱bole̱ toi, ši moṅ ame̱fele̱ sōisōi, ni ame̱tšuii kpale ke̱-te Mizraim ekoṅ;

english_verse: God turned his back on his people and left them. Then they worshiped the stars in the sky, just as it says in the Book of the Prophets, “People of Israel, you didn't offer sacrifices and offerings to me during those
translation_verse: Ši Nyoṅmo̱ tšṍ ehe ni eṅmē̃ ame̱he ake̱ amé̱dšá ṅwei nii, take̱ boni aṅmã ye̱ *gbalo̱i le̱ awolo le̱ mli ake̱: “Nye Israel we, ani mi nyešã koloi ke̱ niyenii afo̱le nyehã ye̱ ṅã le̱ no̱ afii nyoṅmaĩ-edſe̱ le̱? Amos

english_verse: Instead, you carried the tent where the god Molech is worshiped, and you took along the star of your god Rephan. You made those idols and worshiped them. So now I will have you carried off beyond Babylonia.”
translation_verse: Molok bū le̱ moṅ nyewó nyetĕre ke̱ nyenyoṅmo̱ Remfan le̱ ṅulami le̱ ní dši amãgãi ní nyešõ ní nyedšáame̱ le̱; ni Babilon se̱ malōnye ke̱-ate.”

english_verse: The tent where our ancestors worshiped God was with them in the desert. This was the same tent that God had commanded Moses to make. And it was made like the model that Moses had seen.
translation_verse: Odase bū le̱ hĩ wo̱tše̱mei le̱ ateṅ ye̱ ṅã le̱ no̱, tamo̱ bo̱ni moni ke̱ Mose wie le̱ tšõ ake̱ eyafele̱ tamo̱ noni ena le̱;

english_verse: Later it was given to our ancestors, and they took it with them when they went with Joshua. They carried the tent along as they took over the land from those people that God had chased out for them. Our ancestors used this tent until the time of King David.
translation_verse: no hũ, beni we̱tše̱mei le̱ anine se̱ no̱ le̱, ame̱ke̱ Iošua hĩe ke̱-ba dšeṅmãdši ni Nyoṅmo̱ ſieame̱ ye̱ wo̱tše̱mei le̱ ahīe le̱ ašikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ke̱-baši David gbĩĩ le̱ ano̱; Ios.

english_verse: But the Most High God doesn't live in houses made by humans. It is just as the prophet said, when he spoke for the Lord,
translation_verse: Tše̱bele̱ Ṅweinyo le̱, ehĩĩ tšũi ní ake̱ nidsi fe le̱ amli, take̱ bo̱ni *gbalo̱ le̱ hũ kē̱ le̱ ake̱: *Ies.

english_verse: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: “Ṅwei le̱, misẽi ni, ni šikpoṅ le̱, minaneši māṅō ni: Mẽ tšũ nyeamã nyehãmi mo̱, asaṅ nẽgbe̱ dši mihedšō̱mo̱he le̱? Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ kē̱;

english_verse: I have made everything.”
translation_verse: aso dšee minine fe nihii ne̱ fẽ?”

english_verse: You stubborn and hardheaded people! You are always fighting against the Holy Spirit, just as your ancestors did.
