english_verse: If God says his chosen ones are acceptable to him, can anyone bring charges against them?
translation_verse: Namo aaflo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ halamo̱bii le̱ anā? Nyoṅmo̱ dši moni buo̱ bem.

english_verse: Or can anyone condemn them? No indeed! Christ died and was raised to life, and now he is at God's right side, speaking to him for us.
translation_verse: Namo dši *moni buo̱ fo̱ le̱? Kristo dši moni gbo, ši noni fè no le̱, moni atēle̱ ši hũ, ní eyo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ninedšŭrõ no̱, ni esā †edamoo̱ mli ehãawo̱ le̱. *K.

english_verse: Can anything separate us from the love of Christ? Can trouble, suffering, and hard times, or hunger and nakedness, or danger and death?
translation_verse: Namo aagbla wo̱ke̱ Kristo suomo̱ le̱ mli? Amanehũlũ alo tšuifā̃ alo yiwale̱ alo hõmo̱ alo yayainyieme̱ alo hegbeyeiwō alo klante?

english_verse: It is exactly as the Scriptures say, “For you we face death all day long. We are like sheep on their way to be butchered.”
translation_verse: Take̱ bo̱ni *aṅmã ake̱: “Ohewo̱ le̱ agbeo̱wo̱ āhũ dšenamo̱ tū; abnwo̱ ake̱ tōi ní ayagbeame̱.” *Lal.

english_verse: In everything we have won more than a victory because of Christ who loves us.
translation_verse: Ši kẽle̱ ene̱mei fiā mli le̱ wo̱tšṍo̱ moni sumo̱wo̱ le̱ ne̱ wo̱yeo̱ kũnim āhũ.

english_verse: I am sure that nothing can separate us from God's love—not life or death, not angels or spirits, not the present or the future,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ miye̱ hewale̱ ye̱ no̱, ake̱ gbĕle dšio wala dšio, ṅweibo̱foi dšio no̱yelo̱i dšio hewale̱i dšio, nii ní yo̱ ne̱ dšio, nii ni baba le̱ dšio,

english_verse: and not powers above or powers below. Nothing in all creation can separate us from God's love for us in Christ Jesus our Lord!
translation_verse: ṅwei dšio šiši dšio, alo nii ní abo̱ le̱ amli nõkroko dšio, ame̱nyẽṅ ame̱gbla wo̱ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱ suomo̱ ní yo̱ Kristo Iesu, wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ le̱, mli le̱ mli.

english_verse: It cannot be said that God broke his promise. After all, not all of the people of Israel are the true people of God.
translation_verse: Ši dšee ake̱ *Nyoṅmo̱ wiemo̱ le̱ efe yaka. Edšake̱ †dšee mei ní dše̱ Israel mli le̱ fẽ dši Israel; *

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say that the Lord liked Jacob more than Esau.
translation_verse: Take̱ bo̱ni aṅmã ake̱: “Iakob le̱, misumole̱, ši Esau le̱, minye̱le̱” le̱. Mal.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses that he has pity and mercy on anyone he wants to.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *akē̱ Mose ake̱: “Moni minaäle̱ mo̱bo̱ le̱, le̱ noṅṅ mo̱be̱ mibana, ni moni mimũsũṅ tšṍo̱mi hãale̱ le̱, le̱ noṅṅ mimũsũṅ aatšṍmi ahã.” *

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says to the king of Egypt, “I let you become king, so that I could show you my power and be praised by all people on earth.”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ṅmãle̱ le̱ *kē̱ Farao ake̱: “Ene̱ noṅṅ hewo̱ miteo ši, koni madšie mihewale̱ kpo matšõ ye̱ ono̱, koni atšĩ migbe̱i tã ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ fẽ no̱.” *

english_verse: Everything depends on what God decides to do, and he can either have pity on people or make them stubborn. God's Anger and Mercy
translation_verse: Bĕle̱ nohewo̱ le̱ moni esumoo̱ le̱, enaäle̱ mo̱bo̱; ni moni esumoo̱ hũ, *ewadšeo̱ etšui. *

english_verse: Someone may ask, “How can God blame us, if he makes us behave in the way he wants us to?”
translation_verse: Ši agbe̱ne̱ obakē̱mi ake̱: Bĕle̱ mẽba eſaä mo mo̱? Edšake̱ namo aanyẽ eyiṅtō nā akũ?

english_verse: “Once they were told, ‘You are not my people.’ But in that very place they will be called children of the living God.”
translation_verse: *“Ni aaba mli ake̱, heni akē̱ame̱ ye̱ ake̱: Dšee mimaṅ dšinye le̱, dše̱i noṅṅ aatšé̱ame̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩekãlo̱ le̱ bii ye̱.” *Hos.

english_verse: And this is what the prophet Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “The people of Israel are as many as the grains of sand along the beach. But only a few who are left will be saved.
translation_verse: Ši Iesaia bo ye̱ Israel hewo̱ ake̱: *“Ké̱ Israelbii le̱ ayibo̱ tamo̱ ṅšo̱nā šia le̱, mei ní †eſe̱ le̱ yiwala aahere. *Ies.

english_verse: Isaiah also said, “If the Lord All-Powerful had not spared some of our descendants, we would have been destroyed like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah.” Israel and the Good News
translation_verse: Ni take̱ bo̱ni *Iesaia ekē̱ eto momo le̱ ake̱: “Efe ake̱ tai a-Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ eſe̱e̱ seši ko ehããwo̱ kũle̱, wo̱tamo̱ Sodoma, ni wo̱tšṍmo̱ tamo̱ Gomora pe̱.” *Ies

english_verse: What does all of this mean? It means that the Gentiles were not trying to be acceptable to God, but they found that he would accept them if they had faith.
translation_verse: Bĕle̱ té wo̱o̱kē̱ tẽṅ? Ake̱ *dšeṅmãdšiaṅbii ni edii dšale̱ se̱ le̱ ená dšale̱, ni dši dšale̱ ní dše̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli mli le̱; *

english_verse: just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a stone to make people stumble and fall. But those who have faith in that one will never be disappointed.”
translation_verse: take̱ bo̱ni *aṅmã ake̱: “Na, mike̱ te̱mo̱te̱ ke̱ nanetõtõmo̱-te̱sā ko mīmã ši ye̱ Zion, ni mofẽmo ní heo̱ eno̱ yeo̱ le̱ eble gboṅ.” *Ies.

english_verse: But people whose faith makes them acceptable to God will never ask, “Who will go up to heaven to bring Christ down?”
translation_verse: Ši bo̱ni dšale̱ ní dše̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli mli le̱ kē̱o̱ ne̱: *“Kākē̱ ye̱ otšui mli ake̱: Namo aakwo̱ ke̱-ate ṅwei?” no dši, koni eyaṅõ Kristo ke̱-kpleke ši; *

english_verse: All who are acceptable because of their faith simply say, “The message is as near as your mouth or your heart.” And this is the same message we preach about faith.
translation_verse: Ši moṅ té ekē̱o̱ tēṅ? *“Be̱ṅke̱mo̱ wiemo̱ le̱ ebe̱ṅke̱o ye̱ odā mli ke̱ otšui mli fẽ;” no noṅṅ dši hemo̱-ke̱-yeli wiemo̱ le̱ ni wo̱šie̱o̱ le̱. *

english_verse: The Scriptures say no one who has faith will be disappointed,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ṅmãle̱ le̱ kē̱o̱ ake̱: *“Mofẽmo ní heo̱ eno̱ yeo̱ le̱, ehĩe gboṅ.” *Ies

english_verse: no matter if that person is a Jew or a Gentile. There is only one Lord, and he is generous to everyone who asks for his help.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *sro̱to ko be̱ Iudanyo ke̱ Helanyo teṅ: edšake̱ Nuṅtšo̱ kome ame̱fẽ ame̱yo̱, ni niiatše̱ bũ dšile̱ hã mei fẽ ní boo̱ tšé̱o̱le̱ le̱. *Bo̱f.

english_verse: All who call out to the Lord will be saved.
translation_verse: Edšako̱ *“mofẽmo ní aabo atšé̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ gbe̱i le̱, aahere eyiwala.” *Ioel

english_verse: How can people have faith in the Lord and ask him to save them, if they have never heard about him? And how can they hear, unless someone tells them?
translation_verse: Ši té aafe tẽṅ ní ame̱abo ame̱tšé̱ moni ame̱hekole̱ ame̱yeko le̱? ni té aafe tēṅ ni ame̱ahe moni ame̱nuko ehe sane le̱ ame̱yeṅ? ni asaṅ tē aafe tēṅ ni ame̱-anu ké̱ šie̱lo̱ ko be̱ le̱?

english_verse: And how can anyone tell them without being sent by the Lord? The Scriptures say it is a beautiful sight to see even the feet of someone coming to preach the good news.
translation_verse: Ni té aafe tēṅ ní ame̱ašie̱, ké̱ atšũkoame̱ le̱? take̱ bo̱ni *aṅmã ake̱: “Kwe̱ bo̱ni hedšo̱le̱ he sanekpakpa-šie̱lo̱i ní šie̱o̱ nikpakpai le̱ anãdši yo̱ fe̱o hã!” *Ies.

english_verse: Yet not everyone has believed the message. For example, the prophet Isaiah asked, “Lord, has anyone believed what we said?”
translation_verse: Ši kẽle̱ dšee meifẽbo sanekpakpa le̱ toi. Edšake̱ Iesaia *kē̱o̱ ake̱: “Nuṅtšo̱, namo ehé wo̱sane le̱ eye?” *Ies.

english_verse: But am I saying that the people of Israel did not hear? No, I am not! The Scriptures say, “The message was told everywhere on earth. It was announced all over the world.”
translation_verse: Ši mīkē̱ ake̱: Aso nu ame̱nuu? Le̱le̱ṅ ake̱ *ame̱gbē edšidše ke̱-te šikpoṅ mū le̱ fẽ no̱, ni ame̱wiemo̱i le̱ eše̱ dšeṅ nāgbēhei le̱. *Lal.

english_verse: Did the people of Israel understand or not? Moses answered this question when he told that the Lord had said, “I will make Israel jealous of people who are a nation of nobodies. I will make them angry with people who don't understand a thing.”
translation_verse: Ši mīkē̱ ake̱: Aso le Israel lee? Mose etšṍ hĩe ekē̱ ake̱: *“Mahã nyeye maṅ ni dšee maṅ ko he awuṅã; ni mike̱ maṅ ko ní lee noko aawonye mlila.” *

english_verse: Isaiah was fearless enough to tell that the Lord had said, “I was found by people who were not looking for me. I appeared to the ones who were not asking about me.”
translation_verse: Ni Iesaia ke̱ ekã *kē̱: “Mihã mei ní taoomi le̱ nami, ni midšie mihe kpo mitšõ mei ní biko miši le̱.” *Ies.

english_verse: And Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “All day long the Lord has reached out to people who are stubborn and refuse to obey.”
translation_verse: Ši Israel le̱, *ekē̱ame̱ ake̱: “Dā dšenamo̱ migbe̱o̱ minidšiaṅ mihăa maṅ toigbolo̱i ke̱ sanenādšielo̱i le̱.” *Ies.

english_verse: You Gentiles are like branches of a wild olive tree made to be part of a cultivated olive tree. You have taken the place of some branches that were cut away from it. And because of this, you enjoy the blessings that come from being part of that cultivated tree.
translation_verse: Šĩ ke̱dši akũmo̱ tšonidši le̱ ekomei, ni abate̱o bo ní odši *ṅãṅmũtšo le̱ ye̱ ame̱nãdšiaṅ, ni oná mũtšo le̱ šišifã le̱ ke̱ emlinu le̱ eko le̱, *Ef.

english_verse: Maybe you think those branches were cut away, so you could be put in their place.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ ekole̱ ookē̱ ake̱: Kū̃mo̱ akũmo̱ nidši le̱, beni afe ní ate̱omi awo tšo le̱ mli.

english_verse: My friends, I don't want you Gentiles to be too proud of yourselves. So I will explain the mystery of what has happened to the people of Israel. Some of them have become stubborn, and they will stay like that until the complete number of you Gentiles has come in.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ misumo̱o̱ ake̱ mašiunye ne̱ke̱ tēmo̱sane ne̱ no̱, anyemimei, koni nyekabu nyehe olētei, ake̱: wadšemo̱ awadše Israel fã-ke̱-fã *ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni dšeṅmãdši le̱ ayifále̱ le̱ aaba mli, *Luk.

english_verse: In this way all of Israel will be saved, as the Scriptures say, “From Zion someone will come to rescue us. Then Jacob's descendants will stop being evil.
translation_verse: ni no dãni *aahere Israel fẽ yiwala, take̱ bo̱ni aṅmã le̱ ake̱: †“Dšielo̱ le̱ aadše̱ Zion aba ni eebadšie Iakob he nõšafemo̱ le eše efõ; *Mat.

english_verse: This is what the Lord has promised to do when he forgives their sins.”
translation_verse: ni *ene̱ dši mike̱ame̱ teṅ kpãṅmo̱ le̱, ake̱ madšie ame̱he ešai le̱ ke̱-ate.” *Ier.

english_verse: God doesn't take back the gifts he has given or disown the people he has chosen.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ſaa ehe ye̱ edromo̱nii le̱ ke̱ etšé̱mo̱ le̱ he.

english_verse: At one time you Gentiles rejected God. But now Israel has rejected God, and you have been shown mercy.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ take̱ bo̱ni sá le̱ nye hũ nyeboo Nyoṅmo̱ toi, ši agbe̱ne̱ ananyo mo̱bo̱ ye̱ ame̱toigbĕle le̱ hewo̱ le̱,

english_verse: And because of the mercy shown to you, they will also be shown mercy.
translation_verse: nakai noṅṅ kẽ ame̱ hũ ame̱toi gbo, koni, bo̱ni ananyo mo̱bo̱ le̱, ame̱ hũ anaame̱ mo̱bo̱.

english_verse: All people have disobeyed God, and that's why he treats them as prisoners. But he does this, so that he can have mercy on all of them.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *Nyoṅmo̱ eṅã́mo̱ mei fẽ ayi ewo toigbĕle mli, beni afe ni ena †ame̱fẽ mo̱bo. *Gai.

english_verse: Who can measure the wealth and wisdom and knowledge of God? Who can understand his decisions or explain what he does?
translation_verse: Ō, bo̱ni Nyoṅmo̱ *nifále̱ ke̱ ṅā ke̱ nilē mli kwo̱ hã ne̱! Ekodšomo̱i le̱ anyẽẽ šiši ana, ni egbe̱i le̱ hũ anyẽẽ se̱ mò adša! *

english_verse: “Has anyone known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *namo le Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ dſẽṅmo le̱, alo namo ewole̱ ṅā pẽṅ? *Ies.

english_verse: Has anyone loaned something to the Lord that must be repaid?”
translation_verse: Alo namo etšṍ hĩe ehãle̱ noko, ni kũle̱ aatole̱ nãdšiaṅ?

english_verse: Everything comes from the Lord. All things were made because of him and will return to him. Praise the Lord forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ edeṅ nii fẽ dše̱, ni eno̱ ame̱tšṍ ke̱-ba, ni le̱ noṅṅ ame̱yo̱ ame̱hã. Aaṅõ anumnyam ahãle̱ ke̱-ya nāno̱! Amen.

english_verse: Love each other as brothers and sisters and honor others more than you do yourself.
translation_verse: nyeke̱ *nyemimei asuomo̱ asumo̱sumo̱a nyehe; moſẽmo ke̱ †wō ahã enanyo tšutšu. *

english_verse: Never give up. Eagerly follow the Holy Spirit and serve the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyemo̱deṅbō̱ lā nā akabaä ši; nyemumo̱ le̱ he *ado̱a la; nyesúmo̱a Nuṅtšo̱ le̱. *Kpods.

english_verse: Be friendly with everyone. Don't be proud and feel that you know more than others. Make friends with ordinary people.
translation_verse: Nyedſẽṅa nyehewo̱ *dſẽṅmo̱ kome; nyekadſẽṅa nii wudši, ši moṅ nyeke̱ hešibalo̱i le̱ abaä nyehe ši. †Nyekabua nyehe ake̱ nilelo̱i. *

english_verse: Don't mistreat someone who has mistreated you. But try to earn the respect of others,
translation_verse: *Nyekaṅõa efõṅ nyetoa mokomoko efõṅ nãdšiaṅ; nyedſẽṅa noni yo̱ fe̱o no̱ nyetoa ye̱ gbomei fẽ hĩe. *

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink. This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads.”
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, ke̱dši *hõmo̱ mīye ohenye̱le̱ le̱, hãle̱ nii eye; ke̱dši kũmai mīyele̱ le̱, hāle̱ nu enu; edšake̱ ké̱ ofe nakai le̱, oobua ṅãi ke̱ la nā oſie eyiteṅ. *Abe̱i

english_verse: Don't let evil defeat you, but defeat evil with good.
translation_verse: Kāhã efõṅ mīye ono̱ kūnim, ši moṅ oke̱ ekpakpafemo̱ aye efõṅ no̱ kũnim.

english_verse: You must also pay your taxes. The authorities are God's servants, and it is their duty to take care of these matters.
translation_verse: Ene̱hewo̱ ni nyetšũo̱ onĩa hũ le̱; edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ tšũdši dšiame̱, ni ne̱ke̱ súomo̱ ne̱ noṅṅ he ame̱yo̱.

english_verse: In the Law there are many commands, such as, “Be faithful in marriage. Do not murder. Do not steal. Do not want what belongs to others.” But all of these are summed up in the command that says, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: edšake̱ noni *akē̱ ake̱: “Kābo̱ adſamaṅ! kāgbe gbomo! kādšu! kāye amale odase! ohĩe akakõ noko no̱!” ni ké̱ kitã kroko hũ ye̱ le̱, fẽ ho̱ ne̱ke̱ wiemo̱ ne̱ ni dši: †“Suomo̱ onanyo take̱ bo̱ni osumoo̱ bodientše̱ ohe” le̱ mli. *

english_verse: No one who loves others will harm them. So love is all that the Law demands. The Day When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Suomo̱ *efee enanyo efõṅ ko, hewo̱ le̱ †suomo̱ pe̱ dši mla le̱ no̱yeli.

english_verse: Night is almost over, and day will soon appear. We must stop behaving as people do in the dark and be ready to live in the light.
translation_verse: Nyōṅ le̱ eho etã, *ni dšetše̱remo̱ ebe̱ṅke̱: nohewo̱ le̱ †nyehãa wo̱dšiea duṅ mli nitšumo̱i le̱ woſiea, ni wo̱wo la tawūnii le̱. *

english_verse: Let the Lord Jesus Christ be as near to you as the clothes you wear. Then you won't try to satisfy your selfish desires.
translation_verse: ši moṅ *nyewoa Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo, ni nyekahãa helo le̱ no̱dſẽṅmo̱ le̱ mītšṍ helo le̱ se̱dī. *Gal.

english_verse: But you should not criticize others for eating or for not eating. After all, God welcomes everyone.
translation_verse: Moni yeo̱ lo̱ akagbe moni yee le̱, he guo̱, ni moni yee le̱ akakodšo moni yeo̱ le̱; edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ eṅōle̱, Kol.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for God, rather than for ourselves.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ wo̱teṅ moko hĩe kãã hãã le̱dientše̱ ehe, ni moko gboo hũ ehãã le̱dientše̱ ehe.

english_verse: This is because Christ died and rose to life, so that he would be the Lord of the dead and of the living.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ene̱hewo̱ Kristo gbo ni ete ši ni ehĩe kã, beni afe ní etšṍ gbohĩĩ ke̱ hĩekãloi fẽ a-Nuṅtšo̱.

english_verse: Don't let your right to eat bring shame to Christ.
translation_verse: Nohewe̱ le̱ nyekahãa awiea nyenõkpakpa le̱ he efõṅ. Tit.

english_verse: We should try to live at peace and help each other have a strong faith.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ agbe̱ne̱ nyehãa wo̱tina hedšo̱le̱ nibii ke̱ nibii ní wo̱ke̱-ahã wo̱nanemei anane amõ šĩ moṅ.

english_verse: Don't let your appetite destroy what God has done. All foods are fit to eat, but it is wrong to cause problems for others by what you eat.
translation_verse: Kāfite Nyoṅmo̱ nitšumo̱ le̱ ye̱ niyenii ko hewo̱. *Nibii fẽ he tše moṅ ne̱, ši kẽle̱ edši efõṅ hã gbomo ní yeo̱ eke̱-too̱ pãmpi le̱. *K.

english_verse: It is best not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else that causes problems for other followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ehĩ ake̱ oyee lō ni asaṅ onuu wein lo noko ni aato onyemi pãmpi lo aahã enane atõtõ alo enidšiaṅ aadše wui ye̱ mli.

english_verse: What you believe about these things should be kept between you and God. You are fortunate, if your actions don't make you have doubts.
translation_verse: Bo le̱ oye̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yelĩ? oke̱-to ohã bodientše̱ ohe ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe; adšō̱ moni ekodšoo le̱dientše̱ ehe ye̱ noni ebuo̱ ake̱ ehĩ le̱ mli le̱.

english_verse: But if you do have doubts about what you eat, you are going against your beliefs. And you know that is wrong, because anything you do against your beliefs is sin.
translation_verse: Ši moni yiṅ etẽẽle̱ le̱, ke̱dši eye le̱, eye fo̱, edšake̱ edše̱e̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli mli; ni nofẽno ní dše̱e̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli mlĩ le̱, eša ni. Tit.

english_verse: Honor God by accepting each other, as Christ has accepted you.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyehereherea nyehe, take̱ bo̱ni Kristo eherenye ke̱-ba Nyoṅmo̱ anumnyam le̱ mli le̱.

english_verse: My friends, I am sure that you are very good and that you have all the knowledge you need to teach each other.
translation_verse: Ši midientše̱ hũ miye̱ hewale̱ ye̱ no̱ ye̱ nyehewo̱, ake̱ nyedientše̱ tete nyeyimo̱ obõbō̃bõ ke̱ mlihĩle̱; ni nilē fẽ eyimo̱nye tó̱, ni nyenyẽo̱ nyewieo̱ nyetšõo̱ nyehe hũ.

english_verse: Now there is nothing left for me to do in this part of the world, and for years I have wanted to visit you.
translation_verse: Ši agbene̱ noni mibe̱ gbe̱ ye̱ bie̱ niiaṅ doṅṅ, ni misā midše afii pī *mītao ake̱ mibaä nyeṅõ hewo̱ le̱, *

english_verse: So I plan to stop off on my way to Spain. Then after a short, but refreshing, visit with you, I hope you will quickly send me on.
translation_verse: befẽbe ní mafã gbe̱ ke̱-ate Spania le̱, maba nyeṅõ; edšake̱ mihĩe kã no̱, ake̱, ké̱ matao dše̱igbe̱ le̱, mabakwe̱ nyehĩe, koni, ke̱dši miná mīše̱ fiō ye̱ nyeno tſem le̱, *nyeyadšiemi gbe̱ ke̱-ya dše̱i. *

english_verse: I am now on my way to Jerusalem to deliver the money that the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia collected for God's needy people.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Makedonia ke̱ Akaia fẽ ke̱ tšuidšŭrō etšũ onĩa ko ame̱yahã kroṅkroṅbii ní yo̱ Ierusalem le̱ ateṅ ohĩafoi le̱.

english_verse: After I have safely delivered this money, I will visit you and then go on to Spain.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, ké̱ miná migbe ene̱ nā ni miso̱o ne̱ke̱ yibii ne̱ anā mihãame̱ le̱, mabatšṍ nyeṅõ ke̱-ya Spania.

english_verse: And when I do arrive in Rome, I know it will be with the full blessings of Christ.
translation_verse: Ni mile ake̱, ké̱ miba nyeṅõ le̱, Kristo sanekpakpa le̱ dšō̱mo̱ fále̱ le̱ mli maba ye̱.

english_verse: My friends, by the power of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the love that comes from the Holy Spirit, I beg you to pray sincerely with me and for me.
translation_verse: Ši mīkpanye fai, anyemimei, ye̱ wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo hewo̱ ke̱ mumo̱ le̱ suomo̱ le̱ hewo̱, *ake̱ nyefata mihe ke̱-ple ye̱ nyeso̱lemo̱i ni nyeso̱leo̱ nyehãami ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe le̱ amli, *

english_verse: Pray that God will protect me from the unbelievers in Judea, and that his people in Jerusalem will be pleased with what I am doing.
translation_verse: koni adšiemi ye̱ toigbolo̱i ní yo̱ Iudea le̱ adeṅ, ní misúomo̱ ní miyasúmo̱ ye̱ Ierusalem le̱ asa meikroṅkroṅi le̱ ahĩe dšogbāṅ;

english_verse: Ask God to let me come to you and have a pleasant and refreshing visit.
translation_verse: koni, ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ suomo̱ nā le̱, mike̱ mīše̱ aba nyeṅõ, ni mabawo mitšui ye̱ nyeṅõ.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will be with all of you. Amen.
translation_verse: Hedšo̱le̱ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ke̱ nyefẽ ahĩ ši! Amen.

english_verse: Greet Mary, who has worked so hard for you.
translation_verse: Nyeṅãa Maria ní gba ehe nā pī ye̱ wo̱hewo̱ le̱.

english_verse: Greet Herodion, who is a relative of mine. Greet Narcissus and the others in his family, who have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyeṅãa miwekunyo Herodion le̱. Nyeṅãa mei ní dše̱ Narkiso šĩabii le̱ ateṅ ní ame̱yo̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ mli le̱.

english_verse: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work hard for the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis. She also works hard for the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyeṅãa Trifaina ke̱ Trifosa ní bo̱ö̱ mo̱deṅ ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ mli le̱. Nyeṅãa Persi moni asumoo̱ ní etšu nii pī ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ mli le̱.

english_verse: Timothy, who works with me, sends his greetings, and so do my relatives, Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.
translation_verse: Minanyo-nitšulo̱ *Timoteo ke̱ miwekumei Lukio ke̱ Iason ke̱ Sosipatre mībinye. *Bo̱f.

english_verse: but now at last it has been told. The eternal God commanded his prophets to write about the good news, so that all nations would obey and have faith.
translation_verse: noni agbe̱ne̱ *adšie atšõ faṅṅ ye̱ nāno̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ kită nā, ni atšṍ gbalo̱i le̱ aṅmãle̱i le̱ ano̱ atšĩ tă atšṍ dšeṅmădši le̱ fẽ koni †ame̱bo hemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ toi: *

english_verse: And now, because of Jesus Christ, we can praise the only wise God forever! Amen.
translation_verse: le̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ní dši *nilelo̱ kometō le̱, aṅõ anumnyam ahãle̱ ye̱ Iesu Kristo mli ke̱-yaši nāno̱! Amen. *

english_verse: My dear friends, as a follower of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg you to get along with each other. Don't take sides. Always try to agree in what you think.
translation_verse: Ši, anyemimei, mikpanye fai ye̱ wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo gbe̱i amli, ake̱ nyenābu afe ekome ní mligblamo̱i akaba nyeteṅ, ši moṅ nyefẽ *nyeyitšoṅ ke̱ nyedſẽṅmo̱ afe ekome. *Fil.

english_verse: Has Christ been divided up? Was I nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptized in my name?
translation_verse: Ani agbla Kristo mli? Ani Paulo ase̱ṅ ahãnye le̱? alo Paulo gbe̱i amli abaptisinye awo le̱?

english_verse: What happened to those wise people? What happened to those experts in the Scriptures? What happened to the ones who think they have all the answers? Didn't God show that the wisdom of this world is foolish?
translation_verse: Nẽgbe̱ nilelo̱ yo̱? nẽgbe̱ woloṅmālo̱ yo̱? nẽgbe̱ dše ne̱ṅ nãtalo̱ yo̱? Ani Nyoṅmo̱ ehãko dše le̱ṅ nilē le̱ etšṍ kwašiaiasane? Hiob

english_verse: Jews ask for miracles, and Greeks want something that sounds wise.
translation_verse: edšake̱ *Iudafoi le̱, okadii aši ame̱bio̱, ni †Helabii hũ taoo nilē, *Mat

english_verse: What the world thinks is worthless, useless, and nothing at all is what God has used to destroy what the world considers important.
translation_verse: ni dše ne̱ṅ nii ní abuu ke̱ nii ní agbe be guo̱ le̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hala, ke̱ nibii ni dšee nokonoko le̱ tete, koni ehã nibii ní dši noko le̱ afe yaka;

english_verse: God did all this to keep anyone from bragging to him.
translation_verse: beni afe ní helo ko helo ko akaſã ye̱ ehĩe. Rom.

english_verse: You are God's children. He sent Christ Jesus to save us and to make us wise, acceptable, and holy.
translation_verse: Ši le̱ dše̱ ni nyeyo̱ Kristo Iesu mli, moni tšṍ nilē ni dše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ṅõ ke̱ *dšale̱ ke̱ †hetšūmo̱ ke̱ kpõmo̱ ehãwo̱ le̱; *Ier.

english_verse: So if you want to brag, do what the Scriptures say and brag about the Lord.
translation_verse: koni “moni ſãa le̱, eſã efõ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ ne̱,” tamo̱ boni *aṅmã le̱. *Ier.

english_verse: At first, I was weak and trembling with fear.
translation_verse: Ni mike̱nye hĩ ši ye̱ gbo̱dšo̱mo̱ ke̱ gbeyeišemo̱ ke̱ hekpokpomo̱ pī mli; Bo̱f.

english_verse: We do use wisdom when speaking to people who are mature in their faith. But it isn't the wisdom of this world or of its rulers, who will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Ši kẽle̱ wo̱wieo̱ nilē wiemo̱ ye̱ mei ní eye emū le̱ ateṅ, ši dšee dše ne̱ṅ nilē alo dše ne̱ṅ onukpai ní hoo̱ yaä le̱ anõ ni;

english_verse: We speak of God's hidden and mysterious wisdom that God decided to use for our glory long before the world began.
translation_verse: ši moṅ Nyoṅmo̱ nilē ni *aṅõ-tē ye̱ tēmo̱sane mli le̱ wo̱wieo̱, noni Nyoṅmo̱ sā eto hã wo̱numnyam dãni adše dšeṅ šiši, *Rom.

english_verse: But it is just as the Scriptures say, “What God has planned for people who love him is more than eyes have seen or ears have heard. It has never even entered our minds!”
translation_verse: ši moṅ take̱ boni *aṅmã le̱, “nii ni hĩṅme̱i enako ní toi hũ nuko ní ebako gbomo ko tšuiṅ dã dši nii ní Nyoṅmo̱ esã eto mei ní sumoo̱le̱ le̱.” *Ies.

english_verse: God's Spirit has shown you everything. His Spirit finds out everything, even what is deep in the mind of God.
translation_verse: Ši *wo̱ le̱, Nyoṅmo̱ etšṍ Emumo̱ le̱ no̱ edšie kpo etšõwo̱; edšake̱ Mumo̱ le̱ taoo nibii fẽ mli, Nyoṅmo̱ nibii nī mli kwŏ̱lo̱ tete. *Mat

english_verse: But God has given us his Spirit. This is why we don't think the same way that the people of this world think. This is also why we can recognize the blessings God has given us.
translation_verse: Ši wo̱ le̱, dšee dše ne̱ṅ mumo̱ le̱ wo̱ná, ši moṅ Mumo̱ ní dše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ mli le̱, koni wo̱le nii ní Nyoṅmo̱ eṅõ-drowo̱ le̱;

english_verse: This is why only someone who has God's Spirit can understand spiritual blessings. Anyone who doesn't have God's Spirit thinks these blessings are foolish.
translation_verse: Ši gbomo su nī ake̱-fo̱le̱ le̱ hee Nyoṅmo̱ Mumo̱ le̱ nii le̱; edšake̱ efeo̱le̱ ake̱ *kwašiaiasane ni, ni enyẽẽ nā ena, edšake̱ mumo̱ ake̱-taoo̱ nā. *

english_verse: People who are guided by the Spirit can make all kinds of judgments, but they cannot be judged by others.
translation_verse: Ši *mumo̱ṅ-gbomo le̱ kodšoo̱ nii fiā, ši le̱ le̱, mokomoko ekodšoole̱. *

english_verse: The Scriptures ask, “Has anyone ever known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?” But we understand what Christ is thinking.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *namo le Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ dſẽṅmo̱, ní eetšõle̱ nii? Ši wo̱ le̱ wo̱hĩe Kristo dſẽṅmo̱. *Rom.

english_verse: What matters isn't those who planted or watered, but God who made the plants grow.
translation_verse: Bĕle̱ agbe̱ne̱ dšee moni te̱o le̱ dši noko, ni dšee moni ſie no̱ nu le̱ hũ, ši moṅ moni hã eſere, ní dši Nyoṅmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: We will be rewarded if our building is left standing.
translation_verse: Ké̱ moko nitšumo̱ ní etſa emã no̱ le̱ aadamo̱ ši le̱, eená nyõmo̱wo;

english_verse: But if it is destroyed by the fire, we will lose everything. Yet we ourselves will be saved, like someone escaping from flames.
translation_verse: ši ké̱ moko nitšumo̱ aašã le̱, enine banye ši; ši le̱dientše̱ le̱, aahere eyiwala, ši kẽle̱ tamo̱ moko ní tšṍ la mli.

english_verse: This is because God considers the wisdom of this world to be foolish. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God catches the wise when they try to outsmart him.”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ dše ne̱ṅ nilē le̱ dši kwašiaiasane ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe. Edšake̱ aṅmã ake̱: *“Emōo̱ nilelo̱i le̱ ye̱ ame̱dientše̱ ame̱hĩetẽ le̱ mli.” *Hiob

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “The Lord knows that the plans made by wise people are useless.”
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ: *“Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ le nilelo̱i adſẽṅmo̱i le̱, ake̱ yakanii ni.” *Lal.

english_verse: So stop bragging about what anyone has done. Paul and Apollos and Peter all belong to you. In fact, everything is yours, including the world, life, death, the present, and the future. Everything belongs to you,
translation_verse: Paulo dšio, Apolo dšio, Kefa dšio, dše le̱ dšio, wala dšio, gbĕle dšio, nii ní yo̱ ne̱ dšio, nii ní baba le̱ dšio: fẽ le̱, nyenõṅ;

english_verse: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
translation_verse: ši nye le̱, Kristo nii dšinye; ši Kristo le̱, Nyoṅmo̱ nõṅ.

english_verse: So don't judge anyone until the Lord returns. He will show what is hidden in the dark and what is in everyone's heart. Then God will be the one who praises each of us.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyekakodšoa noko dãni še̱ be le̱, ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ aaba, moni ke̱ dũdšiaṅnibii nī aṅõ-tē le̱ tete aaba la hĩe, ni eedšie tšuiiaṅ-adšinai le̱ aši le̱; ni no mli le̱ *mofẽmo aaná eyidšiemo̱ ke̱-adše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ deṅ. *

english_verse: What is so special about you? What do you have that you were not given? And if it was given to you, how can you brag?
translation_verse: Ši namo hã esŏro bo? Ni asaṅ *meni oyo̱ ní dšee hã ahão? Ši ke̱dši hã ahão le̱, mẽba oſãa tamo̱ noni dšee hã ahão le̱? *Rom.

english_verse: Because of Christ we are thought of as fools, but Christ has made you wise. We are weak and hated, but you are powerful and respected.
translation_verse: Wo̱ le̱, *kwašiai dšiwo̱ ye̱ Kristo hewo̱, ši nye le̱, nilelo̱i dšinye ye̱ Kristo mli; wo̱ le̱, gbo̱dšo̱lo̱i dšiwo̱, ši nye le̱, hewalo̱i dšinye; nye, nyehĩe yo̱ nyam, ši wo̱ le̱, wo̱hĩe be̱ nyam. *

english_verse: I am not writing to embarrass you. I want to help you, just as parents help their own dear children.
translation_verse: Miṅmãã ene̱mei ni mike̱-wonye hĩegbĕle, ši moṅ mīwie mītšõnye tamo̱ mibii ni misumoo̱.

english_verse: and I want you to be like me.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ mīkpanye fai ní nyekasemi.

english_verse: But if the Lord lets me come, I will soon be there. Then I will find out if the ones who are doing all this bragging really have any power.
translation_verse: ši, *ké̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ mīsumo̱le̱, etše̱ṅ ni maba nyeṅõ, ni mabana mei ní wóo̱ ame̱he no̱ le̱ ahewale̱, ši dšee amewiemo̱. *Bo̱f.

english_verse: What do you want me to do when I arrive? Do you want me to be hard on you or to be kind and gentle?
translation_verse: Té nyetaoo̱ le̱ tẽṅ? mihĩe tšo ke̱-ba nyeṅõ, alo miba ye̱ suomo̱ ke̱ mlidšo̱le̱ mumo̱ mli?

english_verse: So don't celebrate the festival by being evil and sinful, which is like serving bread made with yeast. Be pure and truthful and celebrate by using bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyehãa wo̱yea Hehō gbĩdšũrõ le̱, dšee ke̱ mãša momo, ni asaṅ dšee ke̱ efõṅ lo nõšafemo̱ mãša, ši moṅ ke̱ ano̱kwale akpĩtĩ ṅmĩṅmi.

english_verse: In my other letter I told you not to have anything to do with immoral people.
translation_verse: Miṅmãnye ye̱ wolo le̱ mli ake̱ nyeke̱ adſamaṅbo̱lo̱i *akabo̱; *Mat.

english_verse: Why should I judge outsiders? Aren't we supposed to judge only church members?
translation_verse: Ši mei ní *yo̱ se̱ le̱, mẽ ame̱kodšomo̱ hũ miná? Ani dšee mei ní yo̱ mli le̱, nyekodšoo̱, *Mar.

english_verse: Why should one of you take another to be tried by unbelievers?
translation_verse: ši moṅ mo ke̱ enyemi yaä kodšomo̱ ye̱ mei ní hee yee le̱ aṅõ po?

english_verse: But instead, you cheat and rob other followers.
translation_verse: Ši nye moṅ nyeyeo̱ amim ni nyešišiuo̱ mei ní dši nyemimei tete.

english_verse: Don't you know that evil people won't have a share in the blessings of God's kingdom? Don't fool yourselves! No one who is immoral or worships idols or is unfaithful in marriage or is a pervert or behaves like a homosexual
translation_verse: Ani nyelee ake̱ amimyelo̱i anine še̱ṅ Nyoṅmo̱ maṅtše̱yeli le̱ no̱? Nyekabia alakaänye! Adſamaṅbo̱lo̱i lo wo̱ṅdšálo̱i lo gblãṅkũolo̱i lo mei ní ke̱ ame̱dientše̱ ame̱helo feo yakayakanii lo hĩĩ ni ke̱ hĩĩ feo yakayakanii,

english_verse: Some of you used to be like that. But now the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and the power of God's Spirit have washed you and made you holy and acceptable to God. Honor God with Your Body
translation_verse: Ni ne̱ke̱ nyeteṅ meikomei yo̱ sá; ši agbe̱ne̱ adšu nyehe, ni asaṅ atšū nyehe, ni abunye bem hũ ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu gbe̱i ke̱ wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ Mumo̱ mli. Tit.

english_verse: You also say, “Food is meant for our bodies, and our bodies are meant for food.” But I tell you that God will destroy them both. We are not supposed to do indecent things with our bodies. We are to use them for the Lord who is in charge of our bodies.
translation_verse: Ṅmā̃ ye̱ hã mũsũ, ni mũsũ hũ ye̱ hã ṅmā̃; ši Nyoṅmo̱ bahã enyo le̱ fẽ se̱ afo; ši *gbomotšo le̱, dšee adſamaṅbō̱ hewo̱ eyo̱, ši moṅ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ hewo̱ eyo̱, ni Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ hũ ye̱ hã gbomotšo le̱; *

english_verse: Don't you know that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? Is it right for me to join part of the body of Christ to a prostitute? No, it isn't!
translation_verse: Ani nyelee ake̱ nyegbomotšei le̱, Kristo henii dšĩame̱? bĕle̱ miṅõ Kristo henii le̱ mife adſamaṅ henii lo? Dabida!

english_verse: My advice for the unmarried and for widows is that it is acceptable for them to remain single, just as I am.
translation_verse: Ši ošidšafoi ke̱ okũlafoi le̱ mīkē̱ame̱ ake̱: Ehī hãame̱ ke̱dši ame̱hĩ ši take̱ bo̱ni mi hũ miyo̱ ne̱ le̱.

english_verse: But if you don't have enough self-control, then go ahead and get married. After all, it is better to marry than to burn with desire.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ ame̱nyẽẽ ame̱he no̱ ame̱ye le̱, hā ame̱bote gblãšihĩle̱ mli; edšake̱ gblãšihīle̱ hĩ fè noni ako̱no̱ aahaoö.

english_verse: If you are already circumcised, don't try to change it. If you are not circumcised, don't get circumcised.
translation_verse: Ké̱ afo moko ketia ní atšé̱le̱ le̱, ekatšṍ ehe fōlo̱; fō mli átšé̱ moko ye̱ hũ, ekafo ehe ketia.

english_verse: Being circumcised or uncircumcised isn't really what matters. The important thing is to obey God's commands.
translation_verse: Ketiafō dšee noko, ní fõ hũ dšee noko, ši Nyoṅmo̱ kitãi le̱ ano̱yeli moṅ dši noko. Gal.

english_verse: Are you a slave? Don't let that bother you. But if you can win your freedom, you should.
translation_verse: Ké̱ tšũlo̱ dšio ni atšé̱o dšiṅṅ, kābã mīdo̱o; ši ké̱ oonyẽ ohe oye le̱, bo̱ he mo̱deṅ.

english_verse: When the Lord chooses slaves, they become his free people. And when he chooses free people, they become slaves of Christ.
translation_verse: Ši moni atšé̱le̱ ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ mli ni edši tšũlo̱ le̱, Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ odehe ni; nakai noṅṅ kẽ moni atšé̱le̱ ní edši odehe le̱, Kristo tšũlo̱ ni. Ef.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So don't become slaves of anyone else.
translation_verse: Dšra ní wa ake̱-hénye; nyekatšṍmo̱a gbomei atšũdši.

english_verse: Stay what you were when God chose you. Unmarried People
translation_verse: Anyemimei, mofẽmo le̱, nõ mli ní atšé̱le̱ ye̱ le̱, no mli noṅṅ éhĩ ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ṅõ. K.

english_verse: If you are married, stay married. If you are not married, don't try to get married.
translation_verse: Ké̱ afĩo akpe̱te̱ yō he dšiṅṅ, kātao fẽnemo̱; afẽneo ye̱ yō he hũ dšiṅṅ, kā-tao ṅã.

english_verse: It isn't wrong to marry, even if you have never been married before. But those who marry will have a lot of trouble, and I want to protect you from this.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši ow̌e̱ yō hũ dšiṅṅ, ofeko eša; ni ke̱dši oblayō hũ gbā dšiṅṅ, efeko eša; ši helo gbe̱fāṅ amanehũlũ mene̱mei baná; ši mi le̱, nyehe mifóo̱.

english_verse: It will be all the same if you are crying or laughing, or if you are buying or are completely broke.
translation_verse: ni mei ní nyã́a hũ afe tamo̱ mei ni nyã́ã́; ni mei ní heo̱ le̱ atamo̱ mei ní dšee nõtše̱mei;

english_verse: It won't make any difference how much good you are getting from this world or how much you like it. This world as we know it is now passing away.
translation_verse: ni mei ni tšuo̱ dše ne̱ be nii le̱ afe tamo̱ mei ní tšuu he nii: *edšake̱ dše ne̱ṅ subāṅ le̱ hoo̱ yaä. *

english_verse: I want all of you to be free from worry. An unmarried man worries about how to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Ši mīsumo̱ ake̱ nyekaná haomo̱. Moni ew̌e̱e̱ yō le̱, ehaoo̱ ehe ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ nii ahewo, bo̱ni eefe ni esane asa Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ hĩe;

english_verse: But a married man has more worries. He must worry about the things of this world, because he wants to please his wife.
translation_verse: ši moni ew̌e̱ yō le̱, ehaoo̱ ehe ye̱ *dše ne̱ṅ nii ahewo̱, bo̱ni eefe ní esane asa †eṅã hĩe. *Luk.

english_verse: So he is pulled in two directions. Unmarried women and women who have never been married worry only about pleasing the Lord, and they keep their bodies and minds pure. But a married woman worries about the things of this world, because she wants to please her husband.
translation_verse: Esŏro yōgbãyō, ni asaṅ esŏro oblayō fro. Moni egbãko le̱ haoo̱ ehe ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ nii ahewo̱, koni efe kroṅkroṅ ye̱ gbomotšo ke̱ mumo̱ fẽ gbe̱fāṅ; ši moni egbã le̱ haoo̱ ehe ye̱ dše ne̱ṅ nii ahewo̱, bo̱ni eefe ní esane asa ewù hĩe.

english_verse: What I am saying is for your own good—it isn't to limit your freedom. I want to help you to live right and to love the Lord above all else.
translation_verse: Ši ene̱ le̱, nye-ekpakpa hewo̱ mikē̱o̱, dšee nyekue̱ kpã miwoo, ši moṅ beni afe ní afe fe̱o, koni nyesúmo̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱, ní nokonoko akawonye ahuntō.

english_verse: But suppose you are engaged to someone old enough to be married, and you want her so much that all you can think about is getting married. Then go ahead and marry. There is nothing wrong with that.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši moko susuo̱ ake̱, ke̱ ebi oblayō fro aale gblã le̱, ebe̱ fe̱o ši dša egbã le̱, efe bo̱ni esumoo̱, efee eša; hã ame̱gbã.

english_verse: It is perfectly all right to marry, but it is better not to get married at all.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ moni ṅõo̱le̱ hãa gblã le̱, efe dšogbāṅ; ši moni ke̱le̱ hãã gblã le̱, efe dšogbāṅ fè no.

english_verse: A wife should stay married to her husband until he dies. Then she is free to marry again, but only to a man who is a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: *Yō le̱, gbĩĩ abo̱ ni ewù hĩe kã ne̱, ake̱ mla efĩle̱; ši ke̱dši ewù le̱ gbo le̱, eye̱ hegbe̱ ake̱ eegba moni esumoo̱, ši dša afe ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ mli. *Rom.

english_verse: However, I think I am obeying God's Spirit when I say she would be happier to stay single.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši ehĩ ši bo̱ni eyo̱ le̱, midſẽṅmo̱ nā le̱ eyo̱ hedšo̱le̱ āhũ; ši efeo̱mi ake̱ mi hũ miye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ Mumo̱. K.

english_verse: In fact, people who think they know so much don't know anything at all.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ *moko susuo̱ ake̱ ele noko le̱, eleko noko bo̱ni sa ake̱ ale; Gal.

english_verse: But God has no doubts about who loves him.
translation_verse: ši ké̱ moko mīsumo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, le̱ *Nyoṅmo̱ le. *Gal.

english_verse: Even though food is offered to idols, we know that none of the idols in this world are alive. After all, there is only one God.
translation_verse: Agbene ye̱ wo̱dši-afo̱lešãnii ayeli hewo̱ le̱, wo̱le ake̱ wo̱ṅ-ko-wo̱ṅ-ko be̱ dše ne̱ṅ, ni asaṅ nyoṅmo̱-ko-nyoṅmo̱-ko be̱, ake̱ dša mokome ke̱ke̱.

english_verse: Not everyone knows these things. In fact, many people have grown up with the belief that idols have life in them. So when they eat meat offered to idols, they are bothered by a weak conscience.
translation_verse: Ši kẽle̱ dšee mei fẽ mli ne̱ke̱ nilē ne̱ yo̱; ši meikomei yo̱ ke̱-baši ṅme̱ne̱-ṅme̱ne̱ ni ame̱ke̱ wo̱dši ano̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli yeo̱ ake̱ wo̱dši-afo̱lešãnii, ni ake̱ noni ame̱henilẽ egbede hewo̱ le̱, abuleo̱le.

english_verse: But food doesn't bring us any closer to God. We are no worse off if we don't eat, and we are no better off if we do.
translation_verse: Ši ṅmā̃ efee noko ehããwo̱ ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe; ké̱ wo̱yeo̱ le̱ ehãã wo̱hĩ fè nine, ni asaṅ ké̱ wo̱yee hũ le̱ ehãã wo̱te̱ no̱ atše. Rom.

english_verse: Don't cause problems for someone with a weak conscience, just because you have the right to eat anything.
translation_verse: Ši nyekwe̱a ní ahĩa koni nyehegbe̱ ne̱ akabatšṍ pãmpi mīhã gbe̱delo̱i le̱. Gal.

english_verse: You know all this, and so it doesn't bother you to eat in the temple of an idol. But suppose a person with a weak conscience sees you and decides to eat food that has been offered to idols.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ke̱dši moko na bo ní odši nilelo̱ le̱ ake̱ otá wo̱ṅtšũ mli ōye nii le̱, ani dšee hewale̱ owoo̱ moni egbede le̱ henilē koni eyaye wo̱dši-afo̱lešãnii le̱?

english_verse: Then what you know has destroyed someone Christ died for.
translation_verse: no le̱ edše̱ onilē le̱ hewo̱ le̱ nyemi gbedelo̱ ní Kristo bagbo ye̱ le̱ hũ ehewo̱ le̱ hĩe bakpãtã. Rom.

english_verse: When you sin by hurting a follower with a weak conscience, you sin against Christ.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši nyefeo̱ nyemimei le̱ eša ne̱ke̱ ni nyeke̱-pilaä ame̱henilẽ ní waa le̱, no le̱ Kristo nyefeo̱ eša nyešio̱.

english_verse: So if I hurt one of the Lord's followers by what I eat, I will never eat meat as long as I live.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, ke̱dši ṅmā̃ ahã minyemi nane atõtõ le̱, no le̱ miyeṅ lō gbĩkogbĩko doṅṅ, koni mikahã minyemi nane mītõtõ. Rom.

english_verse: Are we the only ones who have to support ourselves by working at another job?
translation_verse: Alo mike̱ Barnaba ke̱ke̱ be̱ hegbe̱ ake̱ wo̱fõ nitšumo̱?

english_verse: If others have the right to do this, we have an even greater right. But we haven't used this right of ours. We are willing to put up with anything to keep from causing trouble for the message about Christ.
translation_verse: Asaṅ ké̱ meikrokomei ye̱ ne̱ke̱ hegbe̱ ye̱ nyeno̱ le̱, ani dšee wo̱ moṅ wo̱yo̱ fèame̱ po? Ši kẽle̱ wo̱fee ne̱ke̱ hegbe̱ ne̱ he noko, ši moṅ wo̱mĩo̱ ṅō̃ ye̱ nii fẽ mli, koni wo̱katšī Kristo sanekpakpa le̱ gbe̱. Bo̱f.

english_verse: But I have never used these privileges of mine, and I am not writing this because I want to start now. I would rather die than have someone rob me of the right to take pride in this.
translation_verse: ši *mi le̱, mifeko ne̱ke̱ nii ne̱ ekomeflo he noko. Ni miṅmãã ene̱ koni áfe nakai ahãmi; edšake̱ ké̱ ka noni moko aahã miſã le̱ afe yaka le̱, fäṅ noni migbo moṅ. *Bof.

english_verse: If I preach because I want to, I will be paid. But even if I don't want to, it is still something God has sent me to do.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ké̱ midientše̱ misuomo̱ nā mitšu ene̱ le̱, miye̱ nyõmo̱wo, ši ké̱ dšee suomo̱ nā tete le̱, atu tšũlo̱nukpayeli awo mideṅ kẽ.

english_verse: What pay am I given? It is the chance to preach the good news free of charge and not to use the privileges that are mine because I am a preacher.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ meni dši minyõmo̱wo mo̱? No dši ake̱, ké̱ midšadše sanekpakpa le̱, madšadšele̱ yaka, ní mihee noko ye̱ Kristo sanekpakpa le̱ hewo̱, beni afe ní mikafe *mihegbe̱ ní miyo̱ ye̱ sanekpakpa le̱ mli le̱ he noko tūtu ko. *

english_verse: I am not anyone's slave. But I have become a slave to everyone, so I can win as many people as possible.
translation_verse: Tše̱bele̱ mihĩe mihe ni midšee mokomoko nõ, kẽle̱ mĩke̱ mihe éfe mei fẽ atšũlo̱, beni afe ní minine aše̱ mei babaō no̱. Mat.

english_verse: And when I am with people who are not ruled by the Law, I forget about the Law to win them. Of course, I never really forget about the law of God. In fact, I am ruled by the law of Christ.
translation_verse: mei ni be̱ mla le̱, *mitšṍ tamo̱ moko ni be̱ mla mihãame̱, tše̱ midšee moko ní be̱ Nyoṅmo̱ mla, ši moṅ miye̱ Kristo mla šiši, beni afe ní minine aše̱ mei ní be̱ mla le̱ ano̱. *Gal.

english_verse: When I am with people whose faith is weak, I live as they do to win them. I do everything I can to win everyone I possibly can.
translation_verse: Mitšṍ tamo̱ *gbedelo̱ mihã gbedelo̱i le̱, beni afe ní minine aše̱ gbedelo̱i le̱ ano̱; mitšṍ mihe nofẽno mihã mei fẽ, koni befẽbe ní aafe le̱ †mike̱-here meikomei ayiwala. *

english_verse: I do all this for the good news, because I want to share in its blessings. A Race and a Fight
translation_verse: Ši sanekpakpa le̱ hewo̱ mifeo ene̱mei fẽ, beni afe ní mi hũ maná emlinii le̱ eko.

english_verse: You know that many runners enter a race, and only one of them wins the prize. So run to win!
translation_verse: Ani nyelee ake̱ mei ni dáa foi le̱, ame̱fẽ ame̱dáa moṅ, ši mokome ke̱ke̱ náa emli dšŭromo̱nõ le̱? Nyedáa foi le̱ nakai, koni nyenine aše̱ no̱.

english_verse: Athletes work hard to win a crown that cannot last, but we do it for a crown that will last forever.
translation_verse: Ši *mofẽmo hũ ní šio̱ akaṅ ke̱ nõmo̱ le̱, ehĩe kãa ši ye̱ nibii fẽ mli. Agbe̱ne̱ ame̱ le̱ ame̱feo̱ nakai, koni ame̱ná akekre ní fiteo̱, ši wo̱ le̱, koni wo̱ná nõ †ni fitee.

english_verse: I don't run without a goal. And I don't box by beating my fists in the air.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ foi ní midáa ne̱, mi-dáále̱ butubutu; nõmo̱ ni mĩnõo̱ ne̱, dšee kō̱yo̱ mike̱-nõo̱;

english_verse: I keep my body under control and make it my slave, so I won't lose out after telling the good news to others.
translation_verse: ši moṅ *migblaã midientše̱ migbomotšo le̱ mãi ni miyeo̱le̱ nyṍṅ, koni mi ní mišie̱o̱ mitšõo̱ meikrokomei le̱, midientše̱ le̱ akaše̱mi afõ. *Rom.

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do whatever we want to!” But I tell you not everything may be good or helpful.
translation_verse: Wo̱ye̱ nibii fẽ hegbe̱, ši dšee nibii fẽ hĩ; wo̱ye̱ nibii fẽ hegbe̱, ši dšee nibii fẽ hāa mo nane mõo̱ ši.

english_verse: These things happened to them as a warning to us. All this was written in the Scriptures to teach us who live in these last days.
translation_verse: Ši afeame̱ ene̱mei fẽ ní ake̱-to okadi ahãwo̱, ni aṅmã ní aṅõ-bo̱wo̱ ko̱ko̱, wo̱ mei ní dše le̱ nāgbẽi le̱ eninawo̱ le̱;

english_verse: Aren't the people of Israel sharing in the worship when they gather around the altar and eat the sacrifices offered there?
translation_verse: Nyekwe̱a helo gbe̱fãṅ Israel le̱: ani mei ní *yeo̱ afo̱lešãnii le̱, dšee nanyo ame̱ke̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ bo̱ō̱ le̱? *

english_verse: Am I saying that either the idols or the food sacrificed to them is anything at all?
translation_verse: Bĕle̱ meni mikē̱o̱ mo̱? Ake̱ amãgã dši noko, alo ake̱ amãgā-afo̱le dši noko?

english_verse: You cannot drink from the cup of demons and still drink from the Lord's cup. You cannot eat at the table of demons and still eat at the Lord's table.
translation_verse: Nyenyẽṅ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ kpulu le̱ ke̱ daimonioi akpulu le̱ nyenu šikome; nyenyẽṅ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ okplõ le̱ no̱ nii ke̱ daimonioi anõ le̱ no̱ nii nyeye šikome.

english_verse: However, when you buy meat in the market, go ahead and eat it. Keep your conscience clear by not asking where the meat came from.
translation_verse: Nofẽno ní ahõo̱ ye̱ lō-dšã no̱ le̱, nyeyea; ši henilē le̱ hewo̱ le̱, nyekabia mli; Rom.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.”
translation_verse: edšake̱ “šikpoṅ le̱ ke̱ emlinii le̱ fẽ le̱, Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ nõ ni.” Lal.

english_verse: If an unbeliever invites you to dinner, and you want to go, then go. Eat whatever you are served. Don't cause a problem for someone's conscience by asking where the food came from.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ mei ní hee yee le̱ ateṅ moko kpēnye okplõ he ni nyemīsumo̱ ake̱ nyeate le̱, nofẽno ní ake̱-amã nyehīe le̱, nyeyea ni nyekabia mli, ye̱ henilẽ hewo̱.

english_verse: But if you are told it has been sacrificed to idols, don't cause a problem by eating it. I don't mean a problem for yourself, but for the one who told you. Why should my freedom be limited by someone else's conscience?
translation_verse: Ši henilē ní mikē̱o̱ ne̱, dšee bodientše̱ onõ le̱, ši moṅ mokroko nõ le̱; edšake̱ mẽhewo̱ mokroko henilē aakodso mihehĩemo̱ le̱?

english_verse: If I give thanks for what I eat, why should anyone accuse me of doing wrong?
translation_verse: Ké̱ šidã mike̱-ye le̱, mẽba awieo̱ mihe efõṅ ye̱ nii ní mida ši ye̱ he le̱ hewo̱?

english_verse: When you eat or drink or do anything else, always do it to honor God.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, ké̱ nii nyeyee dsio, nii nyenuo̱ dšio, alo nokroko ni nyefeo̱ dšio, nyefea fẽ nyeke̱-woa Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe nyam. Kol.

english_verse: Don't cause problems for Jews or Greeks or anyone else who belongs to God's church.
translation_verse: Nyekatšõmo̱a pāmpii nyebaa Iudafoi ke̱ Helabii ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱ asafo le̱ fẽ; Rom.

english_verse: I always try to please others instead of myself, in the hope that many of them will be saved.
translation_verse: take̱ bo̱ noṅṅ ní mi hũ misumoo̱ ake̱ nibii fē mli le̱ masa mei fẽ hĩe, ní mitaoo noni hĩ hã midientše̱, ši moṅ noni hĩ hã mei pī, koni ahere ame̱yiwala.

english_verse: Men were created to be like God and to bring honor to God. This means a man should not wear anything on his head. Women were created to bring honor to men.
translation_verse: Ši nū le̱, esaa ake̱ ehaä eyitšo he, edšake̱ *Nyoṅmo̱ subāṅ ke̱ anumnyam dšile̱; ši yō le̱, nū anumnyam dšile̱. *

english_verse: It was the woman who was made from a man, and not the man who was made from a woman.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nū dše̱e̱ yō mli, ši yō moṅ dše̱ nū mli.

english_verse: He wasn't created for her. She was created for him.
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ abo̱o̱ nū ye̱ yō hewo̱; ši yō moṅ abo̱ ye̱ nū hewo̱,

english_verse: As far as the Lord is concerned, men and women need each other.
translation_verse: Tše̱bele̱ nū akaši yō, ni yō hũ akaši nū, ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ mli;

english_verse: This is how things are done in all of God's churches, and this is why none of you should argue about what I have said. Rules for the Lord's Supper
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši moko mīsumo̱ ake̱ eefe ehe helo̱ le̱, wo̱ le̱ wo̱fee nakai, ni Nyoṅmo̱ asafoi le̱ hũ efee nakai.

english_verse: Your worship services do you more harm than good. I am certainly not going to praise you for this.
translation_verse: Ši kítã ní miwoo̱nye ne̱, dšee nyeyi mike̱-dšieo̱ le̱, edšake̱ ké̱ nyekpe le̱, dšee ekpakpa dše̱o̱ mli, ši moṅ efõṅ dšeo̱ mli. K.

english_verse: I am told you can't get along with each other when you worship, and I am sure that some of what I have heard is true.
translation_verse: Ši kleṅkleṅ le̱ minuo̱ ake̱, ké̱ nyeyabua nyehe nā ye̱ asafo le̱ mli le̱, mligblamo̱i ye̱ nyeteṅ, ni miheo̱ miyeo̱ fã-ke̱-fã;

english_verse: You even start eating before everyone gets to the meeting, and some of you go hungry, while others get drunk.
translation_verse: edšake̱ ne̱ke̱ nyeniyeli ne̱ mli le̱, mofẽmo ṅõo̱ le̱dientše̱ eniyenii ni eyeo̱, ni beni hõmo̱ yeo̱ moko le̱, bĕle̱ moko eto̱ dā̃.

english_verse: If you fail to understand that you are the body of the Lord, you will condemn yourselves by the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: edšake̱ moni yeo̱ ni enuo̱ bo̱ni esaa le̱, kodšomo̱ moṅ eyeo̱ ni enuo̱ ehãa ehe, edšake̱ ebuu Nuṅtšo̱ lo̱ gbomotšo le̱.

english_verse: I have already told you what the Lord Jesus did on the night he was betrayed. And it came from the Lord himself. He took some bread in his hands.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ midientše̱ miná ke̱-dse̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ deṅ, ni no noṅṅ miṅõ-hãnye, *ake̱ Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu le̱, nakai nyō le̱ṅ noṅṅ ni atšõ ese̱-gbe̱ le̱, eko abolo, *Mat

english_verse: Then after he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body, which is given for you. Eat this and remember me.”
translation_verse: ni eda ši, ni ekũmo̱ mli, ni ekē̱: Nyehea, nyeyea: ene̱ dši migbomotšo ní akũmo̱ ye̱ nyehewo̱; nyefea ene̱ ní nyeṅõ-kaimi.

english_verse: But if you eat the bread and drink the wine in a way that isn't worthy of the Lord, you sin against his body and blood.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, mofẽmo ní yeo̱ ne̱ke̱ abolo ne̱ ni enuo̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ kpulu le̱ bo̱ni esaa le̱, ētõ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ gbomotšo le̱ ke̱ elá le̱ no̱. Heb.

english_verse: This is why you must examine the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Ši gbomo *áka le̱dientše̱ ehe dãni eye abolo ne̱ eko ni enu kpulu ne̱ eko; *Mat.

english_verse: This is why many of you are sick and weak and why a lot of others have died.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ hũ ni nyeteṅ mei pī he yeo̱ ni ame̱he waaame̱, ni mei babaō hũ *ewo ne̱. *

english_verse: If we carefully judge ourselves, we won't be punished.
translation_verse: Ši edši wo̱kaã wo̱dientše̱ wo̱he wo̱kwe̱o̱ kũle̱, akodšoowo̱.

english_verse: But when the Lord judges and punishes us, he does it to keep us from being condemned with the rest of the world.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ akodšoo̱wo̱ le̱, Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ tšo̱semo̱ ni, beni afe ní akabuwo̱ ke̱ dše le̱ fẽ fo̱. Heb.

english_verse: My dear friends, you should wait until everyone gets there before you start eating.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, minyemimei, ké̱ nyenä bakpe ši nyebaye nii le̱, nyemēmēa nyehe;

english_verse: If you really are hungry, you can eat at home. Then you won't condemn yourselves when you meet together. After I arrive, I will instruct you about the other matters.
translation_verse: ši ké̱ hõmo̱ mīye moko le̱, hã ní eye nii ye̱ šĩa dã, beni afe ní nyekpē le̱ akatšé̱ kodšomo̱ mihãnye. Ši nii ní eſe̱ le̱, ké̱ miba le̱, matoame̱ gbe̱dšiano̱.

english_verse: and we can each do different things. Yet the same God works in all of us and helps us in everything we do.
translation_verse: ni nitšumo̱i sro̱toi hũ ye̱, ši Nyoṅmo̱ kome le̱ noṅṅ dši moni tšuo̱ fẽ ye̱ mei fẽ mli.

english_verse: Some of us can speak with wisdom, while others can speak with knowledge, but these gifts come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Ši moko le̱, atšṍ Mumo̱ le̱ no̱ ahãle̱ nilē-wiemo̱; ni mokroko hũ ahãle̱ niiašiši-namo̱-wiemo̱ ye̱ nakai Mumo̱ le̱ noṅṅ nā;

english_verse: To others the Spirit has given great faith or the power to heal the sick
translation_verse: moko le̱, ahãle̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli ye̱ nakai Mumo̱ le̱ noṅṅ mli; ni mokroko hũ ahãle̱ tšámo̱ dromo̱kēnii ye̱ nakai Mumo̱ le̱ noṅṅ mli;

english_verse: Some of us are Jews, and others are Gentiles. Some of us are slaves, and others are free. But God's Spirit baptized each of us and made us part of the body of Christ. Now we each drink from that same Spirit.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *Iudafoi dšiwo̱ dšio, Helabii dšiwo̱ dšio, nyṍdši dšio, hehĩelo̱i dšio, wo̱ fẽ le̱ Mumo̱ kome mli atšṍ abaptisiwo̱ awo gbomotšo kome mli; ni wo̱ fẽ, Mumo̱ kome ake̱-hãwo̱ ni wo̱nu. *Gai.

english_verse: Suppose a foot says, “I'm not a hand, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the foot still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Ke̱dši nane aakē̱ ake̱: Ake̱-ní mi-dšee nine hewo̱ le̱, midšee gbomotšo le̱ henii le̱ eko le̱; ani ene̱hewo̱ le̱ edšee gbomotšo le̱ henii le̱ eko?

english_verse: Or suppose an ear says, “I'm not an eye, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the ear still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši toi hũ aakē̱ ake̱: Ake̱ noni midšee hĩṅme̱i hewo̱ le̱, midšee gbomotšo le̱ henii le̱ eko le̱; ani ene̱hewo̱ le̱ edšee gbomotšo le̱ henii le̱ eko?

english_verse: If our bodies were only an eye, we couldn't hear a thing. And if they were only an ear, we couldn't smell a thing.
translation_verse: Ké̱ gbomotšo mū le̱ fẽ le̱ hīṅme̱i ni le̱, nẽgbe̱ ninumo̱ yo̱? Ké̱ ninumo̱ so̱ṅṅ ni le̱, nẽgbe̱ nifũ le̱ yo̱?

english_verse: But God has put all parts of our body together in the way that he decided is best.
translation_verse: Ši agbe̱ne̱ Nyoṅmo̱ to henii le̱, ame̱teṅ nofẽno ekro ye̱ gbomotšo le̱ he, bo̱ni esumoo̱.

english_verse: A body isn't really a body, unless there is more than one part.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ ame̱fẽ ame̱dši henõ kome le̱, nēgbe̱ gbomotšo le̱ yo̱?

english_verse: It takes many parts to make a single body.
translation_verse: Ši agbe̱ne̱ le̱ henii pī ni moṅ, ši gbomotšo komeṅ. K.

english_verse: That's why the eyes cannot say they don't need the hands. That's also why the head cannot say it doesn't need the feet.
translation_verse: Ši hĩṅme̱i nyẽṅ ekē̱ nine ake̱: Mibe̱ ohe nitšumo̱; ni asaṅ yitšo nyẽṅ ekē̱ nãdši ake̱: Mibe̱ nyehe nĩtšumo̱.

english_verse: In fact, we cannot get along without the parts of the body that seem to be the weakest.
translation_verse: Ši gbomotšo le̱ henii ní efeo̱wo̱ ake̱ ame̱he waa kwrā le̱, ame̱ moṅ ame̱he hĩaäwe̱ titri;

english_verse: We take special care to dress up some parts of our bodies. We are modest about our personal parts,
translation_verse: ni nii ní efeo̱wo̱ ako̱ ame̱dši gbomotšo henii ní hĩe be̱ nyam kwrā le̱, nomei titri ahĩe nyam wo̱woo̱, ni wo̱henii ni be̱ fe̱o moṅ le̱, nomei yo̱ fe̱o titri;

english_verse: but we don't have to be modest about other parts. God put our bodies together in such a way that even the parts that seem the least important are valuable.
translation_verse: ši wo̱henii ni yo̱ fe̱o momo le̱ ehĩaa no. Ši Nyoṅmo̱ to gbomotšo le̱ gbe̱dšiano̱ etšăra, ni noni ſe̱o̱le̱ noko le̱, no titri eke̱ wō hã;

english_verse: He did this to make all parts of the body work together smoothly, with each part caring about the others.
translation_verse: koni mligblamo̱ akaba gbomotšo le̱ mli, ši moṅ henii le̱ abābā ame̱he yi pe̱pe̱pe̱.

english_verse: If one part of our body hurts, we hurt all over. If one part of our body is honored, the whole body will be happy.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši henõ kome mīna nõ le̱, henii le̱ fẽ ke̱le̱ naä nõ; ni ke̱dši henõ kome hĩe ba nyam hũ, henii fẽ le̱ ke̱le̱ náa miše̱.

english_verse: Together you are the body of Christ. Each one of you is part of his body.
translation_verse: Ši nye le̱, Kristo gbomotšo dšinye, ke̱ ehenii ye̱ mokomekome gbe̱fãṅ. Rom.

english_verse: First, God chose some people to be apostles and prophets and teachers for the church. But he also chose some to work miracles or heal the sick or help others or be leaders or speak different kinds of languages.
translation_verse: Ni kleṅkleṅ le̱ Nyoṅmo̱ wo meikomei bo̱foi ye̱ asafo le̱ mli, noni dši enyo̱ le̱, gbalo̱i, noni dši etẽ le̱, tšōlo̱i, no se̱ le̱, hewale̱i, no se̱ le̱, helai-atšámo̱ dromo̱kēnii, yeli-ke̱-buamo̱, no̱yelii, wiemo̱i sro̱toi awiemo̱. Ef.

english_verse: Not everyone is an apostle. Not everyone is a prophet. Not everyone is a teacher. Not everyone can work miracles.
translation_verse: Ani mei fẽ dši bo̱foi? ani mei fẽ dši gbalo̱i? ani mei fẽ dši tšõlo̱i? ani mei fẽ dši hewale̱-nitšulo̱i?

english_verse: Not everyone can heal the sick. Not everyone can speak different kinds of languages. Not everyone can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: ani mei fẽ yo̱ helai-atšámo̱ dromo̱kēnii? ani mei fẽ wieo̱ wiemo̱i sro̱toi? ani mei fẽ tšõo̱ wiemo̱i ašiši?

english_verse: I want you to desire the best gifts. So I will show you a much better way.
translation_verse: Ši nyehīe ado̱a dromo̱kēnii ní hĩ titri le̱ ahe. Ni masā matšõnye gbe̱ ní hĩ fè fẽ.

english_verse: What if I gave away all that I owned and let myself be burned alive? I would gain nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši miṅõ minii fẽ mikũma mei, ni ke̱dši miṅõ migbomotšo mihã ni ašãmi, ši mibe̱ suomo̱ le̱, dšikũle̱ mináá se̱ ko. Mat.

english_verse: Love rejoices in the truth, but not in evil.
translation_verse: enyã́ã́ nõša he, ši enyã́a ano̱kwale he; Rom.

english_verse: Love never fails! Everyone who prophesies will stop, and unknown languages will no longer be spoken. All that we know will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Suomo̱ se̱ efoo gbĩkogbĩko. Ši ke̱-dši gbale̱i ni le̱, ame̱se̱ bafo; ke̱dši wiemo̱i ni le̱, abafõ; ke̱dši nilē ni le̱, ese̱ bafo.

english_verse: We don't know everything, and our prophecies are not complete.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ wo̱nii ní wo̱le le̱, fã-ke̱-fã ni, ni wo̱gbale̱ hũ fã-ke̱-fã ni,

english_verse: But what is perfect will someday appear, and what isn't perfect will then disappear.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ noni eye emū le̱ ba le̱, no le̱ noni dši fã-ke̱-fã le̱ se̱ aafo.

english_verse: When we were children, we thought and reasoned as children do. But when we grew up, we quit our childish ways.
translation_verse: Beni midsi abifao le̱, miwieo̱ tamo̱ abifao, midſẽṅo̱ nii ahe tamo̱ abifao, misusuo̱ tamo̱ abifao; ši beni mitšṍ ṅũ nukpa le̱, miše̱re̱ abiſabiianii le̱ miſie se̱.

english_verse: Now all we can see of God is like a cloudy picture in a mirror. Later we will see him face to face. We don't know everything, but then we will, just as God completely understands us.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ṅme̱ne̱ṅme̱ne̱ le̱ aſiſe̱ mli wo̱tšṍo̱ wo̱naä nii tūtū, ši no mli le̱, hĩe ke̱ hĩe; ṅme̱ne̱ṅme̱ne̱ le̱ mile nii fã-ke̱-fã, ši no mli le̱, male nii ke̱-yiši tamo̱ bo̱ni alemi ke̱-yiši le̱.

english_verse: If all musical instruments sounded alike, how would you know the difference between a flute and a harp?
translation_verse: Take̱ bo̱ni nii ni be̱ wala le̱ gbē̱o̱ le̱, ble̱ dsio, saṅkũ dšio, ke̱dši egbē̱ē̱ ke̱ gbēi sro̱toisro̱toi le̱, té aafe tēṅ ní aale noni akpāa lo noni atſaä le̱ṅ?

english_verse: This is how it is when you speak unknown languages. If no one can understand what you are talking about, you will only be talking to the wind.
translation_verse: Nakai noṅṅ kẽ dši nye̱ hũ ye̱ lile̱i gbe̱fāṅ: ke̱dši nyewiee wiemo̱ ní šiši yo̱ faṅṅ le̱, té aafe tẽṅ ní aale noni akē̱o̱ le̱? Edšake̱ nyetamo̱ mei ní wieo̱ tšõo̱ kō̱yo̱.

english_verse: When we speak languages that others don't know, we should pray for the power to explain what we mean.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ moni wieo̱ ke̱ lile̱i sro̱to ko le̱, hā ní eso̱le koni etšõ šiši, hũ.

english_verse: But words that make sense can help the church. This is why in church I would rather speak five words that make sense than to speak
translation_verse: ši kẽle̱, asafo le̱ mli le̱, mīsumo̱ ake̱ mike̱ midſẽṅmo̱ awie wiemo̱i komekomei enumo̱, koni maṅõ-tšõ meikrokomei anii moṅ, fè noni mawie wiemo̱i komekomei akpei-nyoṅma ye̱ lile̱i sro̱to mli.

english_verse: Suppose everyone in your worship service started speaking unknown languages, and some outsiders or some unbelievers come in. Won't they think you are crazy?
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ agbe̱ne̱ ke̱dši asafo mū le̱ fẽ nā bakpe ši ye̱ hekome, ni mei le̱ fẽ ke̱ lile̱ii sro̱toi mīwie, ni mei ní lee mli eko alo mei ní hee yee le̱ ateṅ meikomei hũ ba dše̱i le̱, ani ame̱kē̱ṅ ake̱ nyemīye se̱ke̱?

english_verse: But suppose all of you are prophesying when those unbelievers and outsiders come in. They will realize that they are sinners, and they will want to change their ways because of what you are saying.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši mei le̱ fẽ mīgba, ni moko ní hee yee alo elee mli eko ba dše̱i le̱, mei le̱ fẽ aakãle̱, mei le̱ fẽ aakodšole̱,

english_verse: They will tell what is hidden in their hearts. Then they will kneel down and say to God, “We are certain that you are with these people.” Worship Must Be Orderly
translation_verse: aadšie etšuiṅ tēmo̱nii akpo faṅṅ, ni no aahã eke̱ ehĩe abu ši edšá Nyoṅmo̱, ni eedšadše ake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ye̱ nyeteṅ le̱le̱ṅ. Ioh.

english_verse: My friends, when you meet to worship, you must do everything for the good of everyone there. That's how it should be when someone sings or teaches or tells what God has said or speaks an unknown language or explains what the language means.
translation_verse: Bĕle̱ meniṅ mo̱, anyemimei? Ké̱ *nyenā bakpe ši, ni nyeteṅ moko ye̱ lala ko, moko hũ †ye̱ tšõmo̱ ko, moko ye̱ lile̱i sro̱to ko, moko ye̱ kpodšiemo̱ ko, moko ye̱ šišitšõmo̱ ko le̱: nyehãa afea fẽ **bo̱ni mei anane aamõ ši. *

english_verse: No more than two or three of you should speak unknown languages during the meeting. You must take turns, and someone should always be there to explain what you mean.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši aawie lile̱i sro̱to le̱, dāne̱, mei enyo̱ lo, ké̱ efá āhũ le̱, mei etẽ pe̱ áwĩe, mokomekome, ni mokome hũ átšõ šiši;

english_verse: If no one can explain, you must keep silent in church and speak only to yourself and to God.
translation_verse: ši ke̱dši šĩšitšõlo̱ ko be̱ le̱, hã ní efe diō ye̱ asafo le̱ mli, ši ewie ehã le̱dientše̱ ehe ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱.

english_verse: Two or three persons may prophesy, and everyone else must listen carefully.
translation_verse: Ši gbaloi le̱, mei enyo̱ lo mei etẽ awie, ni mei ní eſe̱ le̱ *akodšo. *

english_verse: If someone sitting there receives a message from God, the speaker must stop and let the other person speak.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši adšie noko kpo atšõ moko ni tá ši le̱, tšutšumo le̱ afe diō.

english_verse: Let only one person speak at a time, then all of you will learn something and be encouraged.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ké̱ afe mokomekome le̱, nyefẽ nyeanyẽ nyegba, koni mei fẽ akase nii ni awie atšõ mei fẽ.

english_verse: A prophet should be willing to stop and let someone else speak.
translation_verse: Ši gbalo̱i amumo̱i le̱ baã ame̱he ši ame̱hãa gbaloi le̱;

english_verse: God wants everything to be done peacefully and in order. When God's people meet in church,
translation_verse: edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, edšee sakasa-kafemo̱ Nyoṅmo̱, ši moṅ hedšo̱le̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ni; take̱ bo̱ni eyo̱ ye̱ hetšelo̱i asafoi le̱ fẽ mli le̱.

english_verse: the women must not be allowed to speak. They must keep quiet and listen, as the Law of Moses teaches.
translation_verse: Nyehãa *yei le̱ afea diō ye̱ asafoi le̱ amli, edšake̱ aṅmẽẽame̱ gbe̱ ní ame̱wie, ši moṅ †ame̱ba ame̱he ši, take̱ bo̱ni mla le̱ hũ kē̱o le̱. *

english_verse: If there is something they want to know, they can ask their husbands when they get home. It is disgraceful for women to speak in church.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ ame̱mīsumo̱ ake̱ ame̱kase noko le̱, ame̱bi ame̱dientše̱ ame̱wùmei ye̱ šĩa. Edšake̱ eye̱ hīegbĕle hã yei ake̱ ame̱awie ye̱ asafo mli.

english_verse: God's message did not start with you people, and you are not the only ones it has reached.
translation_verse: Alo nyeṅõ Nyoṅmo̱ wiemo̱ le̱ dše̱? Alo nye ke̱ke̱ nyeṅõ eba?

english_verse: If you think of yourself as a prophet or a spiritual person, you will know I am writing only what the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Ké̱ efeo̱ moko ake̱ gbalo̱ alo mumo̱ṅgbomo dšile̱ le̱, sa ake̱ ele ake̱ noni miṅmãnye ne̱, Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ kitãi ni;

english_verse: So don't pay attention to anyone who ignores what I am writing.
translation_verse: ši ké̱ moko lee noko le̱, ekale.

english_verse: My friends, be eager to prophesy and don't stop anyone from speaking languages that others don't know.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, anyemimei, nyehĩe ado̱a ye̱ gbalo̱ hewo̱, ni lile̱ii sro̱toi ke̱ wiemo̱ le̱ hũ nyekatšĩa nā.

english_verse: But do everything properly and in order.
translation_verse: Afe nii fẽ bo̱ni yo̱ fe̱o ke̱ gbe̱nā-gbe̱nā. Kol.

english_verse: I am the least important of all the apostles. In fact, I caused so much trouble for God's church that I don't even deserve to be called an apostle.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mi le̱ midši *bibiō fè fẽ ye̱ bo̱foi le̱ ateṅ, ni misaa tete ake̱ atšé̱o̱mi bo̱fo hũ, edšake̱ miwa Nyoṅmo asafo le yi. *Ef.

english_verse: If our hope in Christ is good only for this life, we are worse off than anyone else.
translation_verse: Ké̱ wala ne̱ mli ke̱ke̱ wo̱hĩe kã Kristo no̱ yo̱ le̱, wo̱nii ye̱ mo̱bo̱ fè gbomei fẽ.

english_verse: But we must each wait our turn. Christ was the first to be raised to life, and his people will be raised to life when he returns.
translation_verse: Ši mofẽmo ye̱ le̱dientše̱ egbe̱dšiano̱: *kleṅkleṅmo dši Kristo, †no se̱ le̱ mei ni dši Kristo nii le̱, ye̱ ebā le̱ mli; *K.

english_verse: When the Scriptures say he will put everything under his power, they don't include God. It was God who put everything under the power of Christ.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *eṅõ nibii fẽ-kwa eto enãdšiaši. Ši ké̱ ekē̱ ake̱ aṅõ nibii fẽ ato ešiši le̱, bĕle̱ eye̱ faṅṅ ake̱ moni ṅõ nibii fẽ to ešiši le̱ be̱ mli. *Lal.

english_verse: After everything is under the power of God's Son, he will put himself under the power of God, who put everything under his Son's power. Then God will mean everything to everyone.
translation_verse: Ši beni aṅõ nii fẽ ato bi le̱ šiši le̱, no le̱ le̱dientše̱ hũ eeṅõ ehe eto moni ṅõ nii fẽ to ešiši le̱ šiši, koni Nyoṅmo̱ afe nibii fẽ ayitšo.

english_verse: If the dead are not going to be raised to life, what will people do who are being baptized for them? Why are they being baptized for those dead people?
translation_verse: Edšake̱, mei ní hãa abaptisio̱ame̱ ye̱ gbohĩĩ anãdšiaṅ le̱, tē ame̱bafe tēṅ? Ké̱ gbohĩĩ eteṅ ši kwrā le̱, mẽba mo̱ ni ame̱hãa abaptisio̱ame̱ ye̱ gbohĩĩ anãdšiaṅ le̱?

english_verse: And why do we always risk our lives
translation_verse: Mẽba wo̱ hũ wo̱naã amane ṅmle̱tſā-fẽ-ṅmle̱tſā le̱? Rom.

english_verse: What do you think I gained by fighting wild animals in Ephesus? If the dead are not raised to life, “Let's eat and drink. Tomorrow we die.”
translation_verse: Ké̱ gbomo gbe̱fãṅ ni mike̱ koloi awuyelo̱i wu ye̱, ye̱ Efeso le̱, kũle̱ mẽ se̱námo̱ miyo̱? Ké̱ gbohĩĩ etee ši le̱: *“Nyehãa wo̱yea nii ni wo̱nua dā̃i, edšake̱ wó̱ le̱, wo̱bagboi!” *Ies.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves. Bad friends will destroy you.
translation_verse: Nyekahša ašišinanye. Nanyobō̱ fõṅ fiteo̱ dšeṅba kpakpa.

english_verse: Be sensible and stop sinning. You should be embarrassed that some people still don't know about God. What Our Bodies Will Be Like
translation_verse: *Nyehãa nyehĩe atše̱re̱anye dšogbāṅ, ni nyekafea eša; edšake̱ nyeteṅ meikomei †lee nokonoko ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hewo̱. **Mīkē̱ ene̱ mike̱-wonye hĩegbĕle. *Rom.

english_verse: Some of you have asked, “How will the dead be raised to life? What kind of bodies will they have?”
translation_verse: Ši ekole̱ moko aabi ake̱: Té gbohĩĩ aafe tẽṅ ate šiṅ? ni asaṅ mẽ gbomotšo ame̱ke̱-aba?

english_verse: Don't be foolish. A seed must die before it can sprout from the ground.
translation_verse: Kwašia! Noni bo̱dientše̱ odũo̱ le̱, *dša egbo fẽdã ni eyi náa wala, *Ioh.

english_verse: Wheat seeds and all other seeds look different from the sprouts that come up.
translation_verse: ni asaṅ noni odũo̱ le̱, dšee tšo ní babale̱ odũo̱ lé̱, ši moṅ dũmo̱wú kuli ko ke̱ke̱, ké̱ ṅmã ni dšio, nii ni eſe̱ le̱ eko ni dšio;

english_verse: This is because God gives everything the kind of body he wants it to have.
translation_verse: ši Nyoṅmo̱ hãale̱ tšo bo̱ni esumoo̱, ni wú-fẽ-wú le̱, ehãale̱ le̱dientše̱ etšo.

english_verse: People, animals, birds, and fish are each made of flesh, but none of them are alike.
translation_verse: Dšee helo ſẽ dši helo kome, ši moṅ esõro gbomei ahelo, ni esõro koloi ahelo, esõro nuṅloi anõ, ni esõro lofõdši anõ hũ.

english_verse: Everything in the heavens has a body, and so does everything on earth. But each one is very different from all the others.
translation_verse: Ni ṅwei gbomotšei ye̱, ni šikpoṅ no̱ gbomotšei hũ ye̱; ši kẽle̱ esõro ṅwei nii anumnyam, ni esõro šikpoṅ no̱ nii le̱ hũ anõ.

english_verse: The sun isn't like the moon, the moon isn't like the stars, and each star is different.
translation_verse: Esŏro hũlũ anumnyam, ni esõro nyoṅtšẽre hũ anumnyam, ni esŏro ṅulamii anumnyam; edšake̱ ṅulami kome fè ṅulami kroko anumnyam.

english_verse: That's how it will be when our bodies are raised to life. These bodies will die, but the bodies that are raised will live forever.
translation_verse: Nakai noṅṅ dši gbohĩĩašitē le̱ hũ. Adũo̱le̱ ye̱ fitemo̱ mli, atēo̱le̱ ši ye̱ noni fitee mli;

english_verse: As surely as there are physical bodies, there are spiritual bodies. And our physical bodies will be changed into spiritual bodies.
translation_verse: aduo̱ susuma gbomotšo, atēo̱ mumo̱ gbomotšo ši. Ké̱ Susuma gbomotšo ye̱ le̱, mumo̱ gbomotšo hũ ye̱.

english_verse: The first man was named Adam, and the Scriptures tell us that he was a living person. But Jesus, who may be called the last Adam, is a life-giving spirit.
translation_verse: Nakai *aṅmā hũ ake̱: “Adam ni dši kleṅkleṅ gbomo le̱ tšṍ misusu ní hĩe kã,” nāgbē Adam le̱ tšṍ †mumo̱ ní hãa mo yi náa wala. *

english_verse: We see that the one with a spiritual body did not come first. He came after the one who had a physical body.
translation_verse: Ši dšee mumo̱nõ le̱ dši kleṅkleṅnõ, ši moṅ susumanõ le̱, no se̱ le̱ mumo̱nõ le̱.

english_verse: The first man was made from the dust of the earth, but the second man came from heaven.
translation_verse: Kleṅkleṅ gbomo le̱ ní dše̱ šikpoṅ no̱ le̱, šikpoṅno̱nyo ni; gbomo ní dši enyo̱ le̱, dši Nuṅtšo̱ ní dše̱ ṅwei le̱.

english_verse: Everyone on earth has a body like the body of the one who was made from the dust of the earth. And everyone in heaven has a body like the body of the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni šikpoṅno̱nyo le̱ yo̱ le̱, nakai šikpoṅno̱bii le̱ hũ yo̱; ni bo̱ni ṅweinyo le̱ yo̱ le̱, nakai ṅweibii le̱ hũ yo̱;

english_verse: Just as we are like the one who was made out of earth, we will be like the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: ni tamo̱ bo̱ni wo̱hĩe šikpoṅno̱nyo le̱ *subãṅ le̱, nakai noṅṅ wo̱bahĩe ṅweinyo le̱ hũ subãṅ.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that our bodies of flesh and blood will decay. This means they cannot share in God's kingdom, which lasts forever.
translation_verse: Anyemimei, noni mikē̱o̱ dši ake̱, helo ke̱ lá nine še̱ṅ Nyoṅmo̱ maṅtše̱yeli le̱ no̱, ni asaṅ fitemo̱ hũ nine še̱ṅ noni fitee le̱ no̱.

english_verse: I will explain a mystery to you. Not every one of us will die, but we will all be changed.
translation_verse: Na, tēmo̱sane miṅõ-kē̱o̱nye ne̱: *Dšee wo̱fẽ wo̱bawo̱ le̱, ši abatšake wo̱fẽ, *

english_verse: It will happen suddenly, quicker than the blink of an eye. At the sound of the last trumpet the dead will be raised. We will all be changed, so we will never die again.
translation_verse: trukă, hĩṅme̱itſā mli, beni aakpã́ nāgbē *te̱tre̱mantre̱ le̱; edšake̱ abakpã́ te̱tre̱mantre̱, ni aatē gbohĩĩ aši ni ame̱fiteṅ doṅṅ, ni wo̱ le̱, abatšakewo̱. *Mat

english_verse: Our dead and decaying bodies will be changed into bodies that won't die or decay.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ dša ne̱ke̱ fitemo̱nō ne̱ wo noni fitee le̱, ni ne̱ke̱ gbĕlenō ne̱ wo noni gboo le̱.

english_verse: The bodies we now have are weak and can die. But they will be changed into bodies that are eternal. Then the Scriptures will come true, “Death has lost the battle!
translation_verse: Ši beni ne̱ke̱ fitemo̱nõ ne̱ ewo nom fitee le̱, ni ne̱ke̱ gbĕlenõ ne̱ ewo noni gboo le̱, no le̱ wiemo̱ ní aṅmã le̱ aaba mli ake̱:

english_verse: Sin is what gives death its sting, and the Law is the power behind sin.
translation_verse: Ši gbĕle gãi dši eša; ni *eša hewale̱ dši mla le̱. *Rom.

english_verse: But thank God for letting our Lord Jesus Christ give us the victory!
translation_verse: Ši šidā ahã Nyoṅmo̱, moni tšṍ wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo no̱ ni ehã wo̱ye kũnim le̱.

english_verse: My dear friends, stand firm and don't be shaken. Always keep busy working for the Lord. You know that everything you do for him is worthwhile.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, minyemimei ni misumoo̱, nyefĩa ši ní nyekagbugbãa, ni nyetekea no̱ ye̱ Nuntše̱ le̱ nitšumo̱ le̱ mli dāne̱, edšake̱ nyele *ake̱ nyemo̱deṅbō̱ le̱ efee yaka ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ mli. *

english_verse: If the Lord lets me, I would rather come later for a longer visit than to stop off now for only a short visit.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ agbe̱ne̱ misumo̱o̱ ake̱ minaänya ye̱ gbe̱teṅ ke̱ke̱, ši mihĩe kã no̱ ake̱, *ké̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ aaṅmẽmi gbe̱ le̱, †matše̱ fiō ye̱ nyeṅõ. *Bo̱f.

english_verse: Don't let anyone mistreat him. I am looking for him to return to me together with the other followers. So when he leaves, send him off with your blessings.
translation_verse: Hewo̱ le̱ moko *akagbe ehe guo̱; †ši nyedšieale̱ gbe̱ ye̱ hedšo̱le̱ mli koni eba miṅõ; ši mihĩe kã no̱ ake̱ eke̱ nyemimei le̱ aaba. *

english_verse: You know that Stephanas and his family were the first in Achaia to have faith in the Lord. They have done all they can for God's people. My friends, I ask you
translation_verse: Ši mīkpanye fai, anyemimei, nyele *Stefana šĩabii le̱, ake̱ ame̱dši Akaia †kleṅkleṅyibii, ni ame̱ko̱ meikroṅkroṅi le̱ asúomo̱ ame̱fõ ame̱no̱: *

english_verse: Greetings from the churches in Asia. Aquila and Priscilla, together with the church that meets in their house, send greetings in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Asia asafoi le̱ mībinye. *Akwila ke̱ Priskila ke̱ asafo ní yo̱ ame̱we le̱ mībinye dšogbāṅ ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ mli. *Bo̱f.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers send their greetings. Give each other a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Nyemimei le̱ fẽ mībinye. *Nyeṅãṅãa nyehe ke̱ nāſo̱mo̱ kroṅkroṅ. *Rom.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL.
translation_verse: Mi, Paulo dientše̱, minine nā bimo̱ ne̱. Kol.

english_verse: I pray that God will put a curse on everyone who doesn't love the Lord. And may the Lord come soon.
translation_verse: Ké̱ moko sumo̱o̱ Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo sane le̱, *hã mo le̱ atšṍ musumo! Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ miba ! *Gal.

english_verse: I pray the Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo dromo̱ le̱ kenye ahĩ ši!

english_verse: I love everyone who belongs to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Misuomo̱ le̱ kenye fẽ ahĩ ši ye̱ Kristo Iesu mli! Amen.

english_verse: You never disappoint us. You suffered as much as we did, and we know that you will be comforted as we were.
translation_verse: Ni wo̱hĩe ní kã nyeno̱ le̱ gbugbãã, edšake̱ wo̱le ake̱, boni nyenaä amanehũlũi le̱ eko le̱, nakai noṅṅ kẽ nyenaa mīše̱dšemo̱ le̱ hũ eko.

english_verse: God saved us from the threat of death, and we are sure that he will do it again and again.
translation_verse: mo hũ ni dšiewo̱ ke̱-dše̱ gbĕle ní tamo̱ ne̱ke̱ ne̱ mli, ni edšieo̱wo̱ lolo, ni wo̱hĩe kã eno̱ ake̱ esā eedšiewo̱ kwrā,

english_verse: I was so sure of your pride in us that I had planned to visit you first of all. In this way you would have the blessing of two visits from me—
translation_verse: Ni ne̱ke̱ hĩe-ke̱-no̱fõ ne̱ hewo̱ mito miyiṅ ake̱ maba nyeṅõ tšutšu le̱, koni nyená dromo̱ ni dši enyo̱,

english_verse: Do you think I couldn't make up my mind about what to do? Or do I seem like someone who says “Yes” or “No” simply to please others?
translation_verse: Bĕle̱ ní mito miyiṅ nakai le̱, yiṅ-fle̱fle̱ mike̱-fe? Alo miyiṅ ní mito le̱, helo nā mito ye̱? Dabi! ši mi-hē̃ le̱ hē̃ ni, ni mi-dabi le̱ dabi ni.

english_verse: God can be trusted, and so can I, when I say our answer to you has always been “Yes” and never “No.”
translation_verse: Ši ano̱kwafo dši Nyoṅmo̱, ake̱ wo̱-wiemo̱ ní wo̱ke̱nye wie le̱ edšee hē̃ ke̱ dabi šikome.

english_verse: This is because Jesus Christ the Son of God is always “Yes” and never “No.” And he is the one Silas, Timothy, and I told you about.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ bi Iesu Kristo, moni mike̱ Silvano ke̱ Timoteo šie̱ ehe sane ye̱ nyeteṅ le̱, edšee hē̃ ke̱ dabi šikome, ši moṅ emli hē̃ yo̱.

english_verse: Christ says “Yes” to all God's promises. This is why we have Christ to say “Amen” for us to the glory of God.
translation_verse: Ši Nyoṅmo̱ šiwōi abo̱ ní yo̱ ne̱, emli hē̃ le̱ yo̱ ni emli noṅṅ *amen le̱ yo̱, koni etšṍ wo̱no̱ awo Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe nyam. *Kpods

english_verse: And so God makes it possible for you and us to stand firmly together with Christ. God is also the one who chose us
translation_verse: Ši Nyoṅmo̱ dši moni hãa wo̱ ke̱ nye-fẽ fĩo̱ ši ye̱ Kristo mli ni *efo̱wo̱ mũ, *

english_verse: and put his Spirit in our hearts to show that we belong only to him.
translation_verse: le̱ noṅṅ ni eso̱o wo̱nā, ni eke̱ Mumo̱ le̱ yibāfonõ ehãwo̱ ye̱ wo̱tšuii amli hũ.

english_verse: God is my witness that I stayed away from Corinth, just to keep from being hard on you.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, mītšé̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ní *ebaye misusuma odase, ake̱ nyeyibāmo̱ hewo̱ ni mináko maba Korinto le̱, *

english_verse: We are not bosses who tell you what to believe. We are working with you to make you glad, because your faith is strong.
translation_verse: Dšee ake̱ nyehemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ *nyṍṅ wo̱yeo̱, ši moṅ nyemīše̱ le̱ he nitšume̱ hefatalo̱i dšiwo̱, edšake̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli mli nyedamo̱ ši ye̱. *

english_verse: At the time I wrote, I was suffering terribly. My eyes were full of tears, and my heart was broken. But I didn't want to make you feel bad. I only wanted to let you know how much I cared for you. Forgiveness
translation_verse: Ši mitšuĩṅ amanehũlũ ke̱ fĩmo̱ babaō mli miṅmãnye ye̱, ke̱-tšṍ yāfónui babaō hũ mli, dšee ní nyew̌ere̱ aho nyehe hewo̱ṅ, ši moṅ ni nyena no suomo̱ babaō ní misumoo̱nye.

english_verse: You should make them sure of your love for them.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ mīkpanye fai ní nyehã nyesuomo̱ le̱ mli awa ye̱ ene̱;

english_verse: But I was worried when I didn't find my friend Titus there. So I left the other followers and went on to Macedonia.
