translation_verse: mináá hedšo̱le̱ ye̱ mimumo̱ mli, edšake̱ minaa minyemi Tito; hewo̱ le̱ miše̱ame̱ ni miyiṅ ke̱-ba Makedonia. Bo̱f.

english_verse: I am grateful that God always makes it possible for Christ to lead us to victory. God also helps us spread the knowledge about Christ everywhere, and this knowledge is like the smell of perfume.
translation_verse: Ši šidā ahã Nyoṅmo̱, moni hãa wo̱-yeo̱ kũnim dā ye̱ Kristo mli, ni ehãa ehe nilē ṅmadšē le̱ tšṍo̱ wo̱no̱ dšeo̱ kpo ye̱ hefẽhe le̱.

english_verse: A lot of people try to get rich from preaching God's message. But we are God's sincere messengers, and by the power of Christ we speak our message with God as our witness.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ wo̱fee tamo̱ mei pī ni futuo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ wiemo̱ le̱, ši moṅ wo̱wieo̱le̱ ṅmīṅmi bo̱ni edše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ mli le̱ ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe, ye̱ Kristo mli.

english_verse: We are sure about all this. Christ makes us sure in the very presence of God.
translation_verse: Ši Kristo hewo̱ wo̱yo̱ ne̱ke̱ hĩe-ke̱-nofõ ne̱ ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ gbe̱fãṅ:

english_verse: The Law of Moses brought only the promise of death, even though it was carved on stones and given in a wonderful way. Still the Law made Moses' face shine so brightly the people of Israel could not look at it, even though it was a fading glory.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ gbĕle súomo̱ ni aṅõ ṅmãle̱-okadii akadi ye̱ te̱i ano̱ le̱ hĩe ba nyam bo̱ni Israelbii le̱ *nyẽẽ Mose hĩe ame̱kwe̱ ye̱ ehĩe nyam ní se̱ foo̱ le̱ hewo̱ po le̱: *

english_verse: So won't the agreement the Spirit brings to us be even more wonderful?
translation_verse: ani mumo̱ súomo̱ le̱ hĩe baṅ nyam āhũ fè no? Gal.

english_verse: If something that brings the death sentence is glorious, won't something that makes us acceptable to God be even more glorious?
translation_verse: Edšake̱, ke̱ *fo̱bū súomo̱ le̱ hĩe ba nyam le̱, ani †dšale̱ súomo̱ le̱ hĩe baṅ nyam ke̱-tekeṅ no? *

english_verse: In fact, the new agreement is so wonderful that the Law is no longer glorious at all.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ anumnyam le̱ ní fá babaō tšṍ le̱ hewo̱ le̱, noni awo ehĩe nyam tete le̱, hĩe be̱ nyam ye̱ ene̱ gbe̱fãṅ.

english_verse: This wonderful hope makes us feel like speaking freely.
translation_verse: Agbene ake-ní wo̱yo̱ ne̱ke̱ hĩeno̱-kãmo̱ ne̱ hewo̱ le̱ wo̱feo̱ ekã babaō,

english_verse: We are not like Moses. His face was shining, but he covered it to keep the people of Israel from seeing the brightness fade away.
translation_verse: ni wo̱fee tamo̱ Mose ní ke̱ hĩehānõ ha ehĩe, koni Israelbii le̱ akakwe̱ noni se̱ foo̱ le̱ nāgbē le̱.

english_verse: The people were stubborn, and something still keeps them from seeing the truth when the Law is read. Only Christ can take away the covering that keeps them from seeing.
translation_verse: Ši moṅ awadše ame̱dſẽṅmo̱i le̱. Edšake̱ ke̱-baši ṅme̱ne̱-gbĩ-ne̱ no̱ le̱ nakai hĩehānõ le̱ noṅṅ ha kpãṅmo̱ momo le̱ kanemo̱ le̱ no̱; adšieko ši ake̱ Kristo mli ese̱ foo̱ ye̱. Rom.

english_verse: When the Law of Moses is read, they have their minds covered over
translation_verse: Ši ke̱-baši ṅme̱ne̱-gbĩ-ne̱ no̱ le̱, befẽbe ní akaneo̱ Mose wolo le̱, hĩehānõ ha ame̱tšui no̱;

english_verse: with a covering that is removed only for those who turn to the Lord.
translation_verse: ši *ké̱ ame̱kũ ame̱se̱ ke̱-ba Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ ṅõ le̱, aadšie hĩehānõ le̱. *Rom.

english_verse: The Lord and the Spirit are one and the same, and the Lord's Spirit sets us free.
translation_verse: Ši Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ dši Mumo̱ le̱; ši heni Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ Mumo̱ le̱ yo̱ le̱, dše̱i heyeli yo̱.

english_verse: So our faces are not covered. They show the bright glory of the Lord, as the Lord's Spirit makes us more and more like our glorious Lord.
translation_verse: Ši wo̱fẽ ní wo̱ke̱ hĩe kpetekplē kwe̱o̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ anumnyam le̱ tamo̱ akwe̱o̱ aſiſe̱ mli le̱, wo̱mīltšake wo̱mītšṍmo̱ nakai subãṅ le̱ noṅṅ ke̱-mīdše̱ anumnyam mli ke̱-mīya anumnyam mli, take̱ bo̱ni edše̱o̱ Nuṅtšo̱ ní dši Mumo̱ le̱ ṅõ le̱.

english_verse: The god who rules this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers. They cannot see the light, which is the good news about our glorious Christ, who shows what God is like.
translation_verse: mei amli ní dše ne̱ṅ nyoṅmo̱ le̱ eſila mei ní hee yee le̱ adſẽṅmo̱i le̱ ye̱, koni Kristo, ní dši *Nyoṅmo̱ subãṅ le̱, anumnyam sanekpakpa le̱ la ní tšoo̱ le̱ akakpé̱ mīhãame̱. *Heb.

english_verse: In times of trouble, God is with us, and when we are knocked down, we get up again.
translation_verse: awaäwo̱ yi, ši kẽle̱ akwakowo̱; atſiaäwo̱ ši, ši kẽle̱ wo̱plenēko;

english_verse: This means that death is working in us, but life is working in you.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ agbe̱ne̱ gbĕle tsuo̱ nii ye̱ wo̱mli, ši nye le̱, wala tšuo̱ nii ye̱ nyemli.

english_verse: In the Scriptures it says, “I spoke because I had faith.” We have this same kind of faith. So we speak
translation_verse: Ši ake̱ noni wo̱yo̱ nakai hemo̱-ke̱-yeli mumo̱ le̱ noṅṅ, take̱ bo̱ni *aṅmã ake̱: “Mihe miye hewo̱ ni miwie le̱,” hewo̱ le̱ wo̱ hũ wo̱heo̱ wo̱yeo̱, nohewo le̱ wo̱wieo̱ hũ; *Lal.

english_verse: All of this has been done for you, so more and more people will know how kind God is and will praise and honor him. Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nyehewo̱ afeo fẽ, koni dromo̱ ní fá babaō le̱ atšṍ mei pī ašidā no̱ ateke no̱ ahã Nyoṅmo̱ anumnyam.

english_verse: Things that are seen don't last forever, but things that are not seen are eternal. This is why we keep our minds on the things that cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Wo̱ ní wo̱dšee mei ní kwo̱o̱ nii ni anaä le̱, ši moṅ *nii ni anaa le̱ wo̱kwe̱o̱; edšake̱ nii ní anaä le̱ hĩo̱ ši be fio̱ ke̱ke̱, ši nii ní anaa le̱ hĩo ši ke̱-yašio̱ nāno. *Heb.

english_verse: We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are.
translation_verse: Nohewo le̱, ake̱-ní wo̱le Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ he ni yo̱ gbeyei hewo̱ le̱, wo̱wieo̱ wo̱tšõo̱ gbomei, ši wo̱ye̱ faṅṅ ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe; ni mihĩe kã no̱ ake̱ wo̱ye̱ faṅṅ ye̱ nyehenilē mli hũ.

english_verse: We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ dšee *wo̱dientše̱ wo̱he yi wo̱dšieo̱ wo̱hãanye ekoṅ, ši moṅ wo̱ke̱mīhãnye gbe̱ ní nyeṅõ-fã nyefõ wo̱no̱, koni nyená eko nyekē̱ mei ni ſãa ye̱ hĩeaṅ ši dšee tšui mli le̱. *

english_verse: We are careful not to judge people by what they seem to be, though we once judged Christ in this way.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, ke̱-dše̱o̱ ṅme̱ne̱ no̱ ke̱-yaä ne̱, wo̱lee mokomoko doṅṅ ye̱ helo mli; ni ké̱ helo mli wo̱le Kristo ye̱ tete le̱, kẽle̱ agbe̱ne̱ le̱ wo̱leele̱ nakai doṅṅ.

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to Christ is a new person. The past is forgotten, and everything is new.
translation_verse: Hewo̱ le̱, *ke̱ moko ye̱ Kristo mli le̱, †bō̱nõ hi dšile̱; blemanii le̱ ého; **na, nibii fẽ étšṍmo ehẽ. *Rom.

english_verse: God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.
translation_verse: Ši nibii ne̱ fã dše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ deṅ, *moni tšṍ Iesu Kristo no̱ ekpãtã le̱dientše̱ eke̱wo̱ teṅ, ni eke̱ kpãtãmo̱-súomo̱ le̱ hãwo̱ le̱; *Rom.

english_verse: We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God.
translation_verse: Nohewe̱ le̱ wo̱dši *bo̱foi ye̱ Kristo, nãdšiaṅ, tamo̱ ake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ etšṍ wo̱no̱ eke̱ mei mīwie: wo̱damoo̱ Kristo nãdšiaṅ wo̱kpaänye fai ake̱: nyehãa akpãtãa nye ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱ teṅ! *Ies.

english_verse: Christ never sinned! But God treated him as a sinner, so Christ could make us acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *moni lee eša le̱, wo̱hewo̱ le̱ ehã etšṍ †eša, koni wo̱ le̱ wo̱tšṍmo̱ **Nyoṅmo̱ dšale̱ ye̱ emli. *Heb.

english_verse: But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real.
translation_verse: ye̱ *hetšemo̱ mli, ye̱ nilē mli, ye̱ dſẽṅmo̱ ní se̱ tše̱o̱ mli, ye̱ mlihĩle̱ mli, ye̱ Mumo̱ kroṅkroṅ mli, ye̱ suomo̱ ní pasaa mli, *

english_verse: We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.
translation_verse: ye̱ ano̱kwale wiemo̱ mli, ye̱ *Nyoṅmo̱ hewale̱ mli, ke̱-tšṍ dšale̱ tawūnii ni dši ninedšŭrõ nõ ke̱ nineabe̱ku nõ le̱ amli, *

english_verse: Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not.
translation_verse: ke̱-tšṍ anumnyam ke̱ heguo̱gbē mli, ke̱-tšṍ hewiemo̱ fõṅ ke̱ hewiemo̱ kpakpa mli; tamo̱ šišiulo̱i, kẽle̱ ano̱kwafoi dšiwo̱;

english_verse: and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.
translation_verse: tamo̱ ṅko̱mo̱yelilo̱i, ši wo̱mī še̱o̱ dā; tamo̱ ohĩafoi, ši wo̱tšakeo̱ mei pī wo̱feo̱ame̱ niiatše̱mei; tamo̱ mei ní be̱ noko, ni kẽle̱ wo̱ye̱ nii fiā. Fil.

english_verse: I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us. The Temple of the Living God
translation_verse: Ni nye hã nyehãa nyemli alē̱a nakai noṅṅ, ní nyeke̱-towo̱ nãdšiaṅ . *

english_verse: Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same?
translation_verse: Nyeke̱ mei ni hee yee le̱ akagblaä kõṅtšo kome ní yee egbo̱! Edšake̱ *mẽ bō̱ dšale̱ ke̱ mlatõmo̱ yo̱? alo mẽ yeli la ke̱ duṅ yo̱? *Ef.

english_verse: Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says, “I will live with these people and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ mẽ ekomefemo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ so̱lemo̱we ke̱ amãgãi yo̱? Edšake̱ *Nyoṅmo̱ hĩekãlo̱ le̱ so̱lemo̱tšũ dšinye, take̱ bo̱ni Nyoṅmo̱ †kē̱ ake̱: “Mahĩ ame̱mli, ni manyie ye̱ ame̱teṅ, ni matšṍ ame̱-Nyoṅmo̱, ni ame̱ hũ ame̱atšṍ mimaṅ.” *

english_verse: The Lord also says, “Leave them and stay away! Don't touch anything that isn't clean. Then I will welcome you
translation_verse: *Nohewo̱ le̱ Iehowa kē̱, nyedšea ame̱teṅ, ni nyetšea nyehe, ni nyekataä mũdši noko he, ni maherenye atū, *Ies.

english_verse: and be your Father. You will be my sons and my daughters, as surely as I am God, the All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: ni matšṍ nyetše̱, ni nye hũ nyeatšṍmo̱ mibihĩĩ ke̱ mibiyei, bo̱ni Iehowa, Ofe le̱, kē̱ ne̱. Ier.

english_verse: But God cheers up people in need, and this is what he did when he sent Titus to us.
translation_verse: Ši Nyoṅmo̱, moni *še̱dšeo̱ mei ní baä ame̱he ši le̱ amī le̱, eke̱ †Tito bā le̱ še̱dše womi; *

english_verse: Of course, we were glad to see Titus, but what really made us glad is the way you cheered him up. He told how sorry you were and how concerned you were about me. And this made me even happier.
translation_verse: ši dšee ebā le̱ ke̱ke̱, ši moṅ emīše̱dšemo̱ ní aṅõ-še̱dše emī ye̱ nyehewo̱ le̱ hũ, edšake̱ egbawo̱ nyeſẽ le̱ ke̱ nyeṅko̱mo̱yeli le̱ ke̱ mihe mo̱deṅ ní nyebo̱ö̱ le̱, bo̱ni fe ní miná mīše̱ babaō fè tšutšu le̱ ne̱.

english_verse: I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while.
translation_verse: Tše̱ mike̱ miwolo le̱ ehã edo̱nye moṅ, ši kẽle̱ miſaa mihe. Tše̱ edo̱mi kẽ, edšake̱ mina ake̱ nakai wolo le̱ edo̱nye moṅ, ši be kukuō ke̱ke̱ edo̱nye,

english_verse: When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ do̱le̱ ní sa Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe le̱ tše̱o̱ heſamo̱ ní ke̱ mo yaä walaheremo̱ mli noni moko ſaa ehe ye̱ hewo̱ le̱; ši *dše ne̱ṅ do̱le̱ le̱ tše̱o̱ gbĕle. *Mat.

english_verse: Just look what God has done by making you feel sorry! You sincerely want to prove you are innocent. You are angry. You are shocked. You are eager to see that justice is done. You have proved that you were completely right in this matter.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ na, ne̱ke̱ do̱le̱ ní edo̱nye bo̱ni sa Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe ne̱ noṅṅ le̱, nyekwe̱a nõ mo̱deṅbō̱, nõ henãdšiemo̱, nõ tšuilawō, nõ gbeyeišemo̱, nõ ſẽ, nõ hĩedō̱, nõ oweletō̱ tete ní etše̱ ewo nyemli! nofẽno mli nyeke̱ nyehe tšõwo̱ ye̱, ake̱ nyehe tše ye̱ ne̱ke̱ sane ne̱ mli.

english_verse: When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ kē̱ miṅmãnye tete le̱, dšee moni tõ le̱, asaṅ hũ dšee moni atõ eno̱ le̱ hewo̱ṅ, ši moṅ beni afe ní wo̱he mo̱deṅ ní nyebo̱ö̱ le̱ apue faṅṅ ahãnye, ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe.

english_verse: And we were greatly encouraged. Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ wo̱mī eše̱. Ši wo̱mīše̱-dšemo̱ le̱ teke no̱ babaō ke̱ mīše̱ ní wo̱ná ye̱ Tito mīše̱ le̱ hewo̱ le̱, edšake̱ nyefẽ nyehã emumo̱ le̱ tšui nyõ emli,

english_verse: We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true.
translation_verse: edšake̱, ké̱ miſãnye mitšõle̱ ye̱ noko mli le̱, nyewoomi hĩegbĕle; ši tamo̱ bo̱ni wo̱wie nibii fē ano̱kwale mli wo̱tšõnye le̱, nakai noṅṅ kẽ wo̱ſā̃ hũ ní wo̱ſã wo̱tšõ Tito le̱ efe ano̱kwale,

english_verse: Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him.
translation_verse: ni eye nyehe tšui babaō fè tšutšu le̱, edšake̱ ekaio̱ nyefẽ *nyetoibō le̱, bo̱ni nyeke̱ gbeyeišemo̱ ke̱ hekpokpomo̱ herele̱ hĩemẽ le̱. *

english_verse: It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.
translation_verse: Miná mīše̱ ake̱ miye̱ nyehe tšui ye̱ nofẽno mli.

english_verse: They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people.
translation_verse: ni ame̱ke̱ tuto̱mo̱ babaō kpawo̱ fai ake̱ wo̱ke̱ ne̱ke̱ dromo̱ ne̱ ke̱ nanyobō̱ ní yo̱ súomo̱ le̱ mli le̱ ayahã kroṅkroṅ-bii le̱,

english_verse: Titus was the one who got you started doing this good thing, so we begged him to help you finish what you had begun.
translation_verse: no hã wo̱kpa Tito fai, koni bo̱ni ebõi momo sá le̱, nakai noṅṅ egbe ne̱ke̱ dromo̱ ne̱ nā hū ye̱ nyeteù.

english_verse: You know our Lord Jesus Christ treated us with undeserved grace by giving up all his riches, so you could become rich.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nyele wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo dromo̱ le̱, ake̱ le̱ ní dši niiatše̱ le̱ *etšṍ ohĩafo ye̱ nyehewo̱, koni nyetšṍ ehĩa le̱ no̱ nyetšṍmo̱ niiatše̱mei. *Mat.

english_verse: I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving.
translation_verse: ni agbe̱ne̱ nyegbeo̱ femo̱ le̱ hũ nā, koni take̱ bo̱ni nyená suomo̱ le̱ he tšui le̱, nakai noṅṅ nyedše̱ nii ní nyeyo̱ le̱ mli nyegbe nā.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “Those who gathered too much had nothing left. Those who gathered only a little had all they needed.” Titus and His Friends
translation_verse: tamo̱ bo̱ni *aṅmã le̱ ake̱: “Moni bua pī nā le̱, enáá eko ye̱ se̱, ni moni bua fiō nā hũ le̱, eſe̱e̱le̱ eko.” *

english_verse: When we begged Titus to visit you, he said he would. He wanted to because he cared so much for you.
translation_verse: ši ebo wo̱fai ní wo̱kpale̱ le̱ toi moṅ, ši ake̱ noni le̱dientše̱ le̱ mo̱deṅbo̱lo̱ dšile̱ hewo̱ le̱, eba nyeṅō ye̱ le̱dientše̱ esuomo̱ nā.

english_verse: The churches chose this follower to travel with us while we carry this gift that will bring praise to the Lord and show how much we hope to help.
translation_verse: ši dšee ene̱ ke̱ke̱, ši asafoi le̱ fãle̱ to hũ, ni ske̱wo̱ anyie ni ehĩe ne̱ke̱ dromo̱ ni *wo̱súmoo̱ ye̱ he ne̱, ke̱-yahã Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ dientše̱ anumnyam, ní ake̱-tšõ he tšui ni wo̱yo̱: *Gal.

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with the way we handle your generous gift.
translation_verse: edšake̱ wo̱mītao ene̱ nā wo̱tšī, ní moko akawie wo̱he efõṅ ye̱ ne̱ke̱ nifále̱ ní wo̱súmoo̱ ye̱ he ne̱ hewo̱;

english_verse: But we want to do what pleases the Lord and what people think is right.
translation_verse: edšake̱ wo̱dſẽṅo̱ nii ni yo̱ fe̱o le̱ ano̱ wo̱too̱, dšee ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ hĩe ke̱ke̱, ši moṅ ye̱ gbomei ahĩe hũ.

english_verse: We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much.
translation_verse: Ši wo̱tšũ wo̱nyemi le̱ hũ wo̱fata ame̱he, moni wo̱kale̱ kpitiokpitio ye̱ nibii pī amli, ni wo̱na ake̱ ebo̱ō̱ mo̱deṅ, ši agbe̱ne̱ ēbo̱ mo̱deṅ fè tšutšu le̱, ye̱ ehĩe ni eke̱-fõo̱ nyeno̱ pī le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Ye̱ *Tito hewo̱ le̱, mihefatalo̱ ke̱ nanyonitšulo̱ dšile̱ hãnye, ni wo̱nyemimei le̱ hũ, asafoi le̱ †abo̱foi ke̱ Kristo anumnyam dšiame̱. *

english_verse: Treat them in such a way that the churches will see your love and will know why we bragged about you.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyedšiea nyesuomo̱ ke̱ *ſā̃ ni wo̱ſãa wo̱fõo̱ nyeno̱ le̱ nyetšõaame̱ ye̱ asafoi le̱ ahĩe. *

english_verse: I know how eager you are to give. And I have proudly told the Lord's followers in Macedonia that you people in Achaia have been ready for a whole year. Now your desire to give has made them want to give.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mile *bo̱ni nyená he tšui ní miſã mifõ nyeno̱ ye̱ he mitšõ Makedoniabii le̱, ake̱ Akaiabii ésā ame̱he éto nyese̱ afi le̱ bēbe; ni nyemo̱deṅbō̱ le̱ ewo mei pī ahĩedō̱. *

english_verse: So I have decided to ask Titus and the others to spend some time with you before I arrive. This way they can arrange to collect the money you have promised. Then you will have the chance to give because you want to, and not because you feel forced to.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ midſẽṅ ake̱ ehĩa ake̱ makpa nyemimei le̱ afai ní ame̱tšṍ mihĩe ke̱-ba nyeṅõ ni ame̱basā ne̱ke̱ nyedšō̱mo̱ ní awo ši momo ne̱ ame̱to, koni efe klalo ake̱ dšō̱mo̱ noko ši dšee hĩedšōmo̱ noko.

english_verse: Remember this saying, “A few seeds make a small harvest, but a lot of seeds make a big harvest.”
translation_verse: Ši ene̱ mikē̱o̱ ake̱, moni le̱teo̱ nii ahe dũo̱ le̱, eke̱ hele̱temo̱ hũ aakpa; ni moni dũo̱ ye̱ dšō̱mo̱ mli le̱, dšō̱mo̱ mli noṅṅ eekpa ye̱. Abe̱i

english_verse: Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give.
translation_verse: Mofẽmo ahã bo̱ni ekpe̱ mli momo ye̱ etšui mli, ní ekadše̱ ṅko̱mo̱yeli alo fĩmo̱ mli: edšake̱ *tšuidšŭrõnā-hãlo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ sumoo̱. *Rom.

english_verse: What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God.
translation_verse: edšake̱ ne̱ke̱ yeli-ke̱-buamo̱ ne̱ he súomo̱ le̱, dšee kroṅkroṅhii le̱ *afĩmo̱ le̱ ke̱ke̱ efẽneo̱, ši moṅ ehãa adaä Nyoṅmo̱ ši babaō ke̱-teke no̱ hũ. *

english_verse: The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ne̱ke̱ súomo̱ ne̱ sale̱ le̱ hewo̱ le̱ ame̱woo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe nyam ye̱ nyetoibō ní nyeke̱-dšadšeo̱ Kristo sanekpakpa le̱ ke̱ nyenanyobō̱ kro̱ṅṅ ní nye-ke̱ame̱ ke̱ mei fẽ bo̱ö̱ le̱ hewo̱,

english_verse: Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much.
translation_verse: ni ame̱ hũ ame̱ke̱ faikpamo̱-ke̱-nyehãmo̱ ſeo̱nye ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ dromo̱ ní yo̱ nyeno̱ ke̱-teke no̱ le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: Thank God for his gift that is too wonderful for words!
translation_verse: Ši šidā aha Nyoṅmo̱ ye̱ enikēnii ní anyẽṅ agba le̱ hewo̱!

english_verse: You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do.
translation_verse: Ani nii ní yo̱ nyehĩe le̱ nyekwe̱o̱? Ké̱ moko ṅõo̱ ehĩe efõo le̱dientše̱ ehe no̱ ake̱ Kristo nõ dšile̱ le̱, hã ní esā edše̱ le̱dientše̱ noṅṅ emli esusu ake̱, take̱ bo̱ni le̱dientše̱ edši Kristo nõ le̱, nakai noṅṅ kẽ wo̱ hũ wo̱dši Kristo nii.

english_verse: Those people had better understand that when I am with you, I will do exactly what I say in my letters.
translation_verse: Hã nakai gbomo le̱ asusu ake̱, bo̱ni wo̱wiemo̱ yo̱ ye̱ wodši amli ké̱ wo̱be̱ le̱, nakai noṅṅ kẽ, ké̱ wo̱ye̱ le̱, wo̱nifemo̱nii hũ yo̱.

english_verse: We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work.
translation_verse: Ši wo̱ le̱, *wo̱ſãṅ fè nine, ši moṅ ye̱ susumo̱kpã ni Nyoṅmo̱ esusu ehãwo̱, ni wo̱ke̱-še̱ nye hũ nyeṅõ le̱ nā. *Rom.

english_verse: We are not bragging more than we should. After all, we did bring the message about Christ to you.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ wo̱kpãã wo̱mli tšṍ tamo̱ mei ní še̱e̱ nyeṅõ, — edšake̱ wo̱ke̱ Kristo sanekpakpa le̱ še̱ nyeṅõ hũ;

english_verse: Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done.
translation_verse: koni wo̱yadšadše sanekpakpa le̱ ye̱ nyese̱gbe̱ niiaṅ, ni wo̱kaſã wo̱fõ hei ní meikrokomei etšu nii ye̱ momo le̱ ano̱. Bo̱f.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you want to brag, then brag about the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ši moni ſãa le̱, Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ no̱ eſã éfõ! Ier.

english_verse: You may brag about yourself, but the only approval that counts is the Lord's approval.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ dšee moni dšieo̱ ehe yi le̱, dši moni sa, ši moṅ moni Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ dšiee̱ eyi le̱.

english_verse: Was it wrong for me to lower myself and honor you by preaching God's message free of charge?
translation_verse: Alo bĕle̱, ní miba mihe ši koni awó nyeno, ní midšadše Nyoṅmo̱ sanekpakpa le̱ mitšõnye *yaka le̱, mife eša? *

english_verse: I robbed other churches by taking money from them to serve you.
translation_verse: Miha asafoi krokomei ni mihe nyõmo̱wo ye̱ ame̱deṅ, koni rnike̱-basúmo̱nye. Fil.

english_verse: Anyway, they are no more than false apostles and dishonest workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ne̱ke̱ mei ne̱ dši amalebo̱foi, nitšulo̱i šišiulo̱i ní tšakeo̱ ame̱he feo̱ Kristo bo̱foi.

english_verse: When I do all this bragging, I do it as a fool and not for the Lord.
translation_verse: Noni miwieo̱ ne̱, miwiee ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ nā, ši moṅ tamo̱ kwašia wieo̱, ye̱ ne̱ke̱ ſā̃ no̱hĩekãmo̱ ne̱ mli.

english_verse: During my many travels, I have been in danger from rivers, robbers, my own people, and foreigners. My life has been in danger in cities, in deserts, at sea, and with people who only pretended to be the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: mifã gbe̱ kpitiokpitio, mina nõ ye̱ fāi ahĩe, mina nõ ye̱ odšotſalo̱i adeṅ, mina nõ ye̱ midšakubii adeṅ, mina nõ ye̱ dšeṅmãdšiaṅbii adeṅ, mina nõ ye̱ maṅ, mina nõ ye̱ ṅãno̱, mina nõ ye̱ ṅšo̱ hĩe, mina nõ ye̱ amale-nyemimei le̱ ateṅ;

english_verse: I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm.
translation_verse: ye̱ nitšumo̱ ke̱ to̱le̱ mli, ye̱ kpešii amli kpitiokpitio, ye̱ hõmo̱ ke̱ kũmai mli, ye̱ buadayelii amli kpitiokpitio, ye̱ fẽi ke̱ yayainyiemo̱ mli;

english_verse: Besides everything else, each day I am burdened down, worrying about all the churches.
translation_verse: sõro nibii ní yo̱ se̱; ni asaṅ mihaomo̱ ní mináa dā ke̱ asafoi le̱ fẽ *ahe susumo̱. *Bo̱f.

english_verse: When others are weak, I am weak too. When others are tricked into sin, I get angry.
translation_verse: *Namo gbedeo̱, ni mi le̱ migbedee? Namo nane atõtõo̱, ni mimli ešããmi hããle̱? *

english_verse: If I have to brag, I will brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Ké̱ ehĩa ake̱ maſã kẽ le̱, maſã mafõ migbedemo̱ nii ano̱.

english_verse: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever!
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱ ke̱ wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo tše̱, moni adšō̱o̱le̱ ke̱-yašio̱ nāno̱ le̱, *le ake̱ mimalee. *

english_verse: The governor of Damascus at the time of King Aretas had the city gates guarded, so he could capture me.
translation_verse: Damasko le̱, lumo̱ ní yo̱ maṅtše̱ Areta šiši le̱ bu ye̱ Damaskobii amã le̱ṅ ētaomi emõ,

english_verse: But I escaped by being let down in a basket through a window in the city wall.
translation_verse: ni ake̱mi tšṍ samfle̱ mli ye̱ akpãkãi mli ke̱-kpleke ši ye̱ gbogbo le̱ no̱, ni midšo foi ye̱ edeṅ. Bo̱f.

english_verse: I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children.
translation_verse: Na, ene̱ dši *šii etẽ ní misaä mihe ake̱ mība nyeṅõ, ši mike̱ mihe ebafõṅ nyeno̱; edšake̱ dšee nyenii le̱ mitaoo̱, ši moṅ nyedientše̱. Edšake̱ esaa ake̱ bii tĩaä nii too̱ ame̱fo̱lo̱i, ši moṅ fo̱lo̱i ni tĩaä nii too̱ ame̱bii. *

english_verse: As I said, only God really knows if this man was in his body at the time.
translation_verse: Ni mile ne̱ke̱ gbomo ne̱, — eye̱ gbomotšo mli dšio, ebe̱ gbomotšo mli dšio, milee; Nyoṅmo̱ le, —

english_verse: Of course, I am now referring to the wonderful things I saw. One of Satan's angels was sent to make me suffer terribly, so that I would not feel too proud.
translation_verse: Ši beni afe ní mikawó mihe no̱ tūtu ko ye̱ kpodšiemo̱i ní dăra naakpa le̱ ahewo̱ le̱, ahãmi ṅmei ko ye̱ mihelo mli, ní dši *satan bo̱fo, koni egblami mãi, ní mikawó mihe no̱ tūtu ko. *Hiob

english_verse: So I will gladly give all I have and all I am. Will you love me less for loving you too much?
translation_verse: Ši mīsumo̱ babaō ake̱ mafite nii ni asaṅ *afitemi kwrā ahã nyesusumai le̱, tše̱bele̱ babaō ni misumoo̱nye le̱, babaō ní nyesumo̱o̱mi dši no. *Fil.

english_verse: Were you cheated by any of those I sent to you?
translation_verse: Ani mitšṍ mei ní mitšũo̱ nyeṅõ le̱ eko no̱ miyenye amim lo?

english_verse: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
translation_verse: Asaṅ nyesusuo̱ ake̱ wo̱he nā so̱ṅṅ wo̱dšieo̱ wo̱tšõo̱nye ne̱ lo? Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe wo̱wieo̱ ye̱, ye̱ Kristo mli, ši, suomo̱mei, nii ne̱ fẽ le̱, nyenanešimõmo̱ hewo̱ wo̱wieo̱.

english_verse: I am afraid when I come, we won't be pleased with each other. I fear that some of you may be arguing or jealous or angry or selfish or gossiping or insulting each other. I even fear that you may be proud and acting like a mob.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mīše gbeyei ake̱ aleenõ, ké̱ *miba le̱, mibanaṅnye bo̱ni misumoo̱, ni nye hŭ nyenaṅmi bo̱ni nyesumoo̱; ake̱ ekole̱ béi, awuṅãyelii, mlilai, blo̱mo̱i, hewiemo̱i, hũhū̃hũwiemo̱i, †hefũmo̱i, sakasakafemo̱i ye̱ nyeteṅ; *

english_verse: I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
translation_verse: *ni ké̱ miba le̱, mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ aabami ši ekoṅ ye̱ nyehewo̱, ni maye ṅko̱mo̱ mahã †mei ní efe eša sá ni ame̱tšakee ame̱tšui le̱ ateṅ mei pī, ye̱ ame̱mũdšinii ke̱ adſamaṅbō̱ ke̱ nyenyeṅtſĩbō̱ le̱ hewo̱. *

english_verse: This should prove to you that I am speaking for Christ. When he corrects you, he won't be weak. He will be powerful!
translation_verse: ake̱-ní nyetaoo̱ okadi ko ni nyeke̱-ana ake̱ Kristo wieo̱ ye̱ mimli, moni gbedee ye̱ nyemli, ši moṅ ebe waä ye̱ nyemli le̱.

english_verse: Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed.
translation_verse: Nyekaä nyedientše̱ nyehe nyekwe̱a ake̱ nyeye̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli mli lo; *nye-kwe̱a nyedientše̱ nyehe ní ahĩa. Alo nyelee nyedientše̱ nyehe ake̱ Iesu Kristo ye̱ nyemli? ké̱ dšee nakai le̱ mei ní esaa kwrā dšinye. *

english_verse: I hope you will discover we have not failed.
translation_verse: Ši mihĩe kã no̱ ake̱ nyeale ake̱, wo̱ le̱ wo̱dšee mei ní esaa.

english_verse: We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
translation_verse: Ši mīkpa Nyoṅmo̱ fai, koni nyekafe noko fõṅ ko kwrā, dšee koni wo̱ le̱ wo̱fe tamo̱ mei ní sa hewo̱ṅ, ši moṅ koni nye le̱ nyefe ekpakpa, ni wo̱ le̱ wo̱fe tamo̱ mei ní esaa.

english_verse: Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ wo̱náa mīše̱, ké̱ wo̱fe gbedē, ni nye moṅ nyeye̱ hewale̱ le̱; ši ene̱ he fai hũ wo̱kpaä, no dši nye-emūyeli le̱.

english_verse: Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other. Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you.
translation_verse: Noni eſe̱ le̱, anyemimei, *nyemī aše̱a, nyeyea emū, nyehãa aše̱dšea nyemi, nyedſẽṅmo̱ afea ekome, nyehĩa ši ye̱ hedšo̱le̱ mli, ni suomo̱ ke̱ †hedšo̱le̱ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ke̱nye aahĩ ši. *Fil.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. All God's people send their greetings.
translation_verse: Nyeṅãṅãa nyehe ke̱ nāſo̱mo̱ kroṅkroṅ. Meikroṅkroṅi le̱ fẽ mībinye.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will bless you and be kind to you! May God bless you with his love, and may the Holy Spirit join all your hearts together.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo dromo̱ le̱ ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱ suomo̱ le̱ ke̱ Mumo̱ kroṅkroṅ nanyobō̱ le̱ ke̱ nyefẽ áhĩ ši! Amen.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Dromo̱ ke̱ hedšo̱le̱ ni dše̱ tše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ke̱ wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo deṅ ahãnye; Rom.

english_verse: I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message,
translation_verse: Efe míhĩe yā ake̱ amrõ ne̱ noṅṅ le̱ nyemītši nyehe ke̱-dše̱ moni tšē̱nye ye̱ Kristo dromo̱ mli le̱ ṅõ ke̱-ya sane-kpakpa kroko he;

english_verse: I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši wo̱ po, alo bo̱fo ni dše̱ ṅweí tete, badšadše sanekpakpa kroko tšõnye, ye̱ noni wo̱dšadše wo̱tšõnye ne̱ se̱ le̱, *hã éye musu! *

english_verse: I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ. How Paul Became an Apostle
translation_verse: Edšake̱ be ne̱ le̱, *gbomei ahīe gbe̱ mitaoo̱ alo Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe gbe̱? alo mĩtao gbomei ahīe masa? Edšake̱, ké̱ mikã he mĩsa gbomei ahĩe lolo le̱, dšee Kristo tšũlo̱ dšimi. *

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach.
translation_verse: Ši mĩhã nyele, anyemimei, ake̱ sane-kpakpa ni midšadše le̱, edše̱e̱ gbomo nā;

english_verse: It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
translation_verse: edšake̱ dšee gbomo ko deṅ miná ke̱-dše̱, ni dšee tšõmo̱ hũ atšõmi, ši moṅ Iesu Kristo kpodšiemo̱ nā miná ye̱.

english_verse: I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us.
translation_verse: ni mifé mitipẽṅfoi pĩ ye̱ Iudafoi adšámo̱ le̱ mli ye̱ midšakubii ateṅ, ni mihĩe do̱ naakpa ye̱ wo̱tše̱mei ablema-sãdši ní aṅõ-hãwo̱ le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
translation_verse: ni misã miyaa Ierusalem hũ ye̱ mei ni dši bo̱foi dãni mi hũ mitšõ bo̱fo le̱ aṅõ, ši moṅ miyiṅ ke̱-te Arabia, ni misã mikũ mise̱ ke̱-ba Damasko ekoṅ.

english_verse: Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for
translation_verse: Ke̱ke̱ le̱ no se̱ afii etẽ le̱, mite Ierusalem ni mike̱ Petro yagba sane, ni mihĩ eṅõ gbĩī nyoṅma ke̱ enumo̱; Bof.

english_verse: The only other apostle I saw was James, the Lord's brother.
translation_verse: ši minaa bo̱foi le̱ ateṅ mokroko, ake̱ dša *Iakobo, Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ nyemi le̱. *Mat,

english_verse: And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: Ši nii ni miṅmãanye ne̱, na, Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe mikē̱o̱ ye̱, ake̱ši mimalee.

english_verse: Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
translation_verse: No se̱ le̱ miba Siria ke̱ Kilikia niiaṅ. Bof.

english_verse: But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person.
translation_verse: Ši miyo̱ ne̱, alee mihĩe ye̱ Iudea asafoi ní yo̱ Kristo mli le̱ ateṅ;

english_verse: They had only heard that the one who had been cruel to them was now preaching the message that he had once tried to destroy.
translation_verse: ši moṅ ame̱nuo̱ ke̱ke̱ ake̱, moni wawo̱ yi sã le̱, agbe̱ne̱ édšadše hemo̱-ke̱-yeli ni sá ni ekpãtã hĩe le̱ he sane-kpakpa le̱ ẽtšõ;

english_verse: And because of me, they praised God.
translation_verse: ni ame̱wo Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe nyam ye̱ mihewo̱.

english_verse: James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews.
translation_verse: ni beni ame̱yo dromo̱ ni aṅõ-hãmi le̱, Iakobo ke̱ *Kefa ke̱ Iohane ni abuo̱-ame̱ ake̱ akulašĩṅi le̱, ame̱ke̱ nanyobō̱ ninedšũrõ le̱ ta mi ke̱ Barnaba dĕ, koni wo̱ le̱ wo̱ya dšeṅmãdši le̱ aṅõ, ši ame̱ le̱ ame̱ya ketiafolo̱i le̱ ateṅ; *Ioh.

english_verse: He used to eat with Gentile followers of the Lord, until James sent some Jewish followers. Peter was afraid of the Jews and soon stopped eating with Gentiles.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ dãni meikomei aadše̱ Iakobo ṅõ aba le̱, eke̱ dšeṅmãdšiaṅbii le̱ yeo̱ nii; ši beni ame̱ba le̱, egbla ehe ši ni etše ehe, edšake̱ ĕše mei ni dše̱ ketiafolo̱i le̱ ateṅ le̱ gbeyei. Bof.

english_verse: He and the others hid their true feelings so well that even Barnabas was fooled.
translation_verse: Ni Iudafoi ni eſe̱ le̱ hũ ke̱le̱ fe nakai osato le̱, ni ame̱gbla Barnaba tete ame̱wo ame̱satofemo̱ le̱ mli,

english_verse: But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said: Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
translation_verse: Ši beni mina ake̱ ame̱nyiee trõmõ ye̱ sanekpakpa le̱ ano̱kwale le̱ nā le̱, mikē̱ Petro ye̱ ame̱fẽ ame̱hĩe ake̱: Ké̱ bo ni odši Iudanyo le̱ ofeo̱ onii tamo̱ dšeṅmãdšiaṅnyo ni dšee tamo̱ Iudanyo le̱, mẽba onyẽo̱ dšeṅmãdšiaṅbii le̱ ano̱ ake̱ ame̱fe ame̱nii tamo̱ Iudafoi?

english_verse: But we know that God accepts only those who have faith in Jesus Christ. No one can please God by simply obeying the Law. So we put our faith in Christ Jesus, and God accepted us because of our faith.
translation_verse: kẽle̱ wo̱le ake̱ abuu gbomo bem ke̱-dše̱e̱ mla nitšumo̱i amli, ake̱ dša atšõ Iesu Kristo no̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ no̱ ke̱ke̱: bewo̱ le̱ wo̱ hũ wo̱hé Kristo Iesu no̱ wo̱ye, koni abuwo̱ bem ke̱-dše̱ Kristo hemo̱-ke̱-yeli mli, ni dšee mla nitšumo̱i amli; edšake̱ abuṅ helo-ko-helo-ko bem ke̱-dše̱ṅ mla nitšumo̱i amli. Bo̱f.

english_verse: But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ké̱ nii ni mikũmo̱ le̱ noṅṅ mimāa ekoṅ le̱, bĕle̱ mitšõo̱ midientše̱ mihe ake̱ no̱tõlo̱ dšimi,

english_verse: It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God. I have been nailed to the cross with Christ.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mi le̱ mitšó̱ mla le̱ no̱ migbo mihã mla le̱, *koni mibĩe akā ahā Nyoṅmo̱. *Rom.

english_verse: I have died, but Christ lives in me. And I now live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave his life for me.
translation_verse: Ase̱ṅmi ke̱ Kristo; hewo̱ le̱ dšee mi mihĩe kā doṅṅ, ši *Kristo ni hĩe kā ye̱ mimli; ši mihĩe nĩ kā ye̱ helo mli agbe̱ne̱ ne̱, Nyoṅmo̱ bi le̱, ni sumo̱mi ni †eṅõ ehe ehā ye̱ mihewo̱ le̱, hemo̱-ke̱-yeli mli mihĩe kā ye̱. *Ioh

english_verse: I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
translation_verse: Mikwaa Nyoṅmo̱ dromo̱ le̱; edšake̱, kē̱ mla no̱ dšale̱ tšõo̱ ke̱-baā le̱, bĕle̱ Kristo le̱, yakatſā egbo le̱,

english_verse: My friends, I will use an everyday example to explain what I mean. Once someone agrees to something, no one else can change or cancel the agreement.
translation_verse: Anyemimei, mīwiele̱ gbomeiaṅ: Gbomo šamaṅšeo tete, ke̱dši awadšele̱ le̱, moko kwaa, ni asaṅ moko fataa he noko.

english_verse: That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ.
translation_verse: Ši Abraham le̱, awie šiwō wiemo̱i le̱ ahãle̱ ke̱ eseši le̱, *Ekē̱ē̱ ake̱: “ke̱ esešibii le̱,” take̱ mei pī anõ, ši moṅ take̱ mokome nõ, ake̱ “ke̱ oseši le̱,” moni dši Kristo le̱, *

english_verse: If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ gbošinii le̱ dše̱ mla le̱ mli le̱, no le̱ dšee šiwõ le̱ mli edše̱ doṅṅ; ši Abraham le̱, šiwō no̱ Nyoṅmo̱ tšó̱ eṅõ-kele̱.

english_verse: There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him. Slaves and Children
translation_verse: ši mlidamo̱lo̱ ie̱, edšee mokome nõ, ši Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, mokome dšile̱.

english_verse: Does the Law disagree with God's promises? No, it doesn't! If any law could give life to us, we could become acceptable to God by obeying that law.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ mla le̱ kũo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ šiwōi le̱ anā lo? Dabida! Edšake̱ awo mla ko ni aanyẽ *wala ahã, kũle̱ eye̱ mli le̱le̱ṅ ake̱ mla mli dšale̱ le̱ dše̱. *Rom.

english_verse: But the Scriptures say that sin controls everyone, so that God's promises will be for anyone who has faith in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ši moṅ *ṅmãle̱ le̱ eṅõ nibii fẽ eto eša šiši, koni atšõ Iesu Kristo no̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli no̱ ake̱ šiwõ le̱ ahã mei ni heo̱ yeo̱ le̱. *Rom.

english_verse: The Law controlled us and kept us under its power until the time came when we would have faith.
translation_verse: Ši dãni hemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ ba le̱, ake̱wo̱ eto mla šiši, ni aṅá wo̱yi ato hemo̱-ke̱-yeli ni abadšie kpo le̱.

english_verse: In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ mla le̱ etšõ wo̱tšo̱-selo̱ ke̱-mĩya Kristo ṅõ, koni hemo̱-ke̱-yeli mli abuwo̱ bem ye̱.

english_verse: But once a person has learned to have faith, there is no more need to have the Law as a teacher.
translation_verse: Ši ni hemo̱-ke̱-yeli ba ne̱, wo̱be̱ tšo̱selo̱ le̱ šiši doṅṅ, Rom

english_verse: All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nyefẽ le̱ Nyoṅmo̱ bii dšinye ye̱ Kristo Iesu mli ke̱-tšõ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ no̱; Ioh

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes.
translation_verse: edšake̱ nye mei aho̱ ni *abaptisinye awo †Kristo mli le̱, nyewo Kristo, *Rom.

english_verse: Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman.
translation_verse: Iudanyo be̱ le̱, Helanyo hũ be̱ doṅṅ; nyõṅ be̱ le̱, odehe hũ be̱ doṅṅ; nō be̱ le̱, yō hũ be̱ doṅṅ: edšake̱ nyefẽ, mokome dšinye ye̱ Kristo Iesu mli, Rom.

english_verse: So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ Kristo nii dšinye le̱, bẽle̱ Abraham sešibii dšinye, ke̱ gbošiniyelo̱i hũ ye̱ šiwō le̱ nā, K.

english_verse: I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
translation_verse: Mīše gbeyei mīhãnye, ake̱ aleenõ yakatſā migba mihe nā ye̱ nyehewo̱ le̱.

english_verse: when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick.
translation_verse: ši nyele ake̱ *helo gbedemo̱ mli midšadše sanekpakpa le̱ ye̱ †mitšõnye kleṅkleṅ le̱, *

english_verse: My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself.
translation_verse: ni noni dši nãtšõnõ hãnye ye̱ mihelo mli le̱, nyegbee he guo̱ ni asaṅ nye-nyāṅee; ši moṅ nyeheremi tamo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ bo̱fo, tamo̱ Kristo Iesu dientše̱.

english_verse: Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention.
translation_verse: Dšee nyehe mo̱deṅ kpakpa ko ame̱bo̱ō̱ ne̱; ši moṅ wo̱ṅõgbe̱ ame̱taoo̱ ni ame̱tšĩnye, ni nyebo̱ ame̱ moṅ ame̱he mo̱deṅ.

english_verse: It is always good to give your attention to something worthwhile, even when I am not with you.
translation_verse: Ši sa ake̱ nyebo̱ mo̱deṅ ye̱ noni yo̱ fe̱o he dā, ni dšee beni mike̱nye yo̱ le̱ ke̱ke̱.

english_verse: My children, I am in terrible pain until Christ may be seen living in you.
translation_verse: Mibii bibii ni mikõmoo̱ ke̱ nyefo̱mo̱ ekoṅ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni aašõ Kristo subãṅ ye̱ nyemli:

english_verse: I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled. Hagar and Sarah
translation_verse: minã ni kũle̱ miye̱ nyemase̱i amrõ ne̱ ni matšake migbẽ, edšake̱ miyiṅ feo̱mi ko̱šiko̱ši ye̱ nyehewo̱!

english_verse: All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave.
translation_verse: Ne̱ke̱ nii ne̱ aṅõ-buo̱ abe̱. Ene̱mei dši kpãṅmo̱i enyo̱ le̱: ekome le̱ dše̱ Sinai goṅ le̱ no̱, ni *nyõṅyeli mli efo̱ō̱ ewoo̱: no dši Hagar; *

english_verse: Hagar also stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and for the present city of Jerusalem. She and her children are slaves.
translation_verse: edšake̱ Hagar dši Sinai goṅ le̱ ye̱ Arabia; ši eke̱ ṅme̱ne̱me̱ Ierusalem le̱ tšáa no̱, edšake̱ eke̱ ebii le̱ dši nyodši;

english_verse: But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave.
translation_verse: ši ṅwei Ierusalem le̱ dši odehe le̱, mo noṅṅ ni dši wonye le̱. Heb.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about her, “You have never had children, but now you can be glad. You have never given birth, but now you can shout. Once you had no children, but now you will have more children than a woman who has been married for a long time.”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *aṅmã ake̱: “La nyamo̱lala, bo kene ni ofo̱o̱; tſa nyamo̱lala ni oblo̱ ke̱ mĩše̱, bo ni okõmo̱o̱; edšake̱ moni be̱ moko le̱ moṅ bii fã fẽ moni yo̱ wù le̱ po!” *Ies.

english_verse: My friends, you were born because of this promise, just as Isaac was.
translation_verse: Ši, anyemimei, wo̱ le̱, šiwõ le̱ bii dšiwo̱ tamo̱ Isak. K.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.”
translation_verse: Ši *té ṅmãle̱ le̱ kē̱ tẽṅ? “ſiemo̱ tšũlo̱yō le̱ ke̱ ebi le̱; edšake̱ nyõṅyo le̱ bi le̱ esaa ake̱ eke̱ odehe le̱ bi le̱ aye gbošinii le̱.” *

english_verse: My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, anyemimei, wo̱dšee tšulo̱yō le̱ bii, ši moṅ odehe le̱ bii dšiwe̱.

english_verse: My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, anyemimei, ké̱ ketiafõ le̱ mišie̱o̱ lolo le̱, mēba mo̱ ni awaämi yi lolo? no kũle̱ se̱ṅmo̱tšo le̱ he *nãtšõ le̱ se̱ efo. *

english_verse: My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ odeheyeli mli atšé̱nye ke̱-ba, anyemimei; ši nyedeheyeli le̱ ke̱ke̱ ni nyekahãa etšó̱a hegbe̱ ebã helo le̱; ši moṅ nyetšõa suomo̱ mli nyesúmo̱súmo̱a nyehe.

english_verse: All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mla mũ le̱ fẽ no̱yeli ye̱ wiemo̱ kome *ne̱ mli ake̱: “Suomo̱ onanyo take̱ bo̱ni esumoo̱ bodientše̱ ohe” le̱. *

english_verse: The Spirit and your desires are enemies of each other. They are always fighting each other and keeping you from doing what you feel you should.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ helo le̱ dio̱ nii ase̱ ešio̱ mumo̱ le̱, ni mumo̱ le̱ hũ dio̱ nii ase̱ ešio̱ helo le̱; ši ene̱mei ke̱ ame̱he yee, koni nyekafe nii moṅ ni nyesumoo̱ le̱. Rom.

english_verse: But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱ mumo̱ le̱ kplaānye le̱, nyebe̱ mla šiši.

english_verse: People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds.
translation_verse: Ši helo le̱ nitšumo̱i le̱ dšeo̱ kpo faṅṅ, nomei dši gblãfitemo̱, adſamaṅbō̱, mũdšinitšumo̱, nye-nyeṅtſibō̱,

english_verse: envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
translation_verse: dā̃to̱i, ſe̱mo̱ fõṅ ke̱ nii ni tamo̱ ene̱mei le̱, nii ni mīkē̱nye mĩto, take̱ boni mikē̱nye momo le̱, ake̱ mei ni feo̱ ne̱ke̱ nii ne̱ le̱, ame̱nine še̱ṅ *Nyoṅmo̱ maṅtše̱yeli le̱ no̱. *Ef.

english_verse: God's Spirit makes us loving, happy, peaceful, patient, kind, good, faithful,
translation_verse: Ši mumo̱ le̱ yibii dši suomo̱, mĩše̱, hedšo̱le̱, tšuišitõ, mlihīle̱, edšũrẽfemo̱, hemo̱-ke̱-yeli, mli-dšo̱le̱, hĩešikãmo̱; Ef.

english_verse: And because we belong to Christ Jesus, we have killed our selfish feelings and desires.
translation_verse: Ši mei ni dši Kristo Iesu nii le̱, ame̱se̱ṅ helo le̱ ke̱ ehĩedo̱nii ke̱ eke̱no̱i le̱ fẽ. Rom.

english_verse: God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit.
translation_verse: Ké̱ wo̱hīe kã ye̱ mumo̱ le̱ mli le̱, nyehãa wo̱nyiea ye̱ *mumo̱ le̱ mli hũ. *K.

english_verse: But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
translation_verse: Wo̱hĩe akakõ yakayaka anumnyam no̱ ni wo̱wowo wo̱he mlila ni wo̱he mĩtšẽtšẽ wo̱he! Fil.

english_verse: Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up.
translation_verse: Ši nyekahãa ekpakpafemo̱ mĩto̱awo̱, edšake̱ ké̱ we̱nidšiaṅ edšee wui le̱, wo̱-bakpa hũ ye̱ be ni sa mli.

english_verse: Those people who are telling you to get circumcised are only trying to show how important they are. And they don't want to get into trouble for preaching about the cross of Christ.
translation_verse: Mei ni taoo̱ ake̱ ame̱hĩe aba nyam ye̱ helo mli le̱, ame̱ ame̱nyẽo̱ nyeno̱ ni aflo̱nye ketia, beni afe ke̱ke̱ ni *aka-waame̱ yi ye̱ Kristo se̱ṅmotšo le hewo̱. *

english_verse: They are circumcised, but they don't obey the Law of Moses. All they want is to brag about having you circumcised.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mei ni aflo̱ame̱ ketia le̱ dientše̱ tete yee mla le̱ ne̱; ši moṅ ame̱-mĩtao ake̱ aflo̱nye ketia, koni ame̱ſã ame̱fõ nyehelo le̱ no̱.

english_verse: But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
translation_verse: Ši mi le̱, akagbalemi fõṅfõ ake̱ maſã mafõ noko no̱ ake̱ dša wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo se̱ṅmotšo le̱ no̱, no noṅṅ no̱ atšõ ase̱ṅ dše le̱ ahami, ni mi hũ ase̱ṅmi ahã dše le̱.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Kristo Iesu mli le̱, ketiafõ dšee noko, ni asaṅ fō hũ dšee noko, ši moṅ bō̱ hē ke̱ke̱ dši noko.

english_verse: If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
translation_verse: Ni mei abo̱ ni aanyie ye̱ ne̱ke̱ susumo̱kpã ne̱ nā le̱, hedšo̱le̱ ke̱ mo̱bo̱nale̱ ahãame̱ ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱ *Israel le̱! *Lal.

english_verse: On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ moko akagba minã doṅṅ; edšake̱ *mihĩe Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu pilamo̱-okadii ye̱ migbomotšo le̱ he. *

english_verse: My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
translation_verse: Wo-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo dromo̱ le̱ ke̱ nyemumo̱ le̱ ahĩ ši, anyemimei! Amen. Efeso.)

english_verse: God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
translation_verse: koni aṅõ-dšie edrome̱ anumnyam le̱ yi, noni eṅõ-drowo̱ ye̱ moni *asumoo̱le̱ le̱ mli le̱, *Mat.

english_verse: God always does what he plans, and this is why he appointed Christ to choose us.
translation_verse: le̱ emli noṅṅ wo̱ná *gbošinii le̱ bũ ye̱, wo̱ mei ni adšiewo̱ ato ye̱ moni tšuo̱ nibii fiã le̱ †yiṅtō nā, bo̱ni sa le̱-dientše̱ esuomo̱ ṅãwõ le̱ hĩe le̱, *Kol.

english_verse: Christ also brought you the truth, which is the good news about how you can be saved. You put your faith in Christ and were given the promised Holy Spirit to show you belong to God.
translation_verse: le̱ noṅṅ eno̱ nye hũ nyeke̱ nyehĩe fõ, beni nyenu ano̱kwale le̱ wiemo̱ le̱ ni dši nyeyiwalaheremo̱ le̱ sanekpakpa le̱; le̱ noṅṅ emli ake̱ šiwõ le̱ Mumo̱ kroṅkroṅ le̱ *so̱o nyenã ye̱, beni nyehe nyeye le̱, *

english_verse: The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised. Paul's Prayer
translation_verse: moni dši we̱gbošinii le̱ *ayibāfonõ le̱, koni aṅõ-kpõ emei ni dši le̱dientše̱ enii le̱, ni ake̱-dšie enumnyam le̱ yi. *

english_verse: So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers.
translation_verse: mifõõ nyehe šidã, ši mikaio̱nye ye̱ miso̱lemo̱i amli,

english_verse: I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God.
translation_verse: koni wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo Nyoṅmo̱ ni dši anumnyam tše̱ Ie̱ ahãnye nilẽ ke̱ kpodšiemo̱ mumo̱ ye̱ lē ni nyealele̱ dšogbãṅ le̱ mli,

english_verse: I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used
translation_verse: ke̱ noni dši ehewale̱ le̱ dale̱ ni tekeo̱ no̱ babao hãawo̱ mei ni wo̱heo̱ wo̱yeo̱ le̱ ye̱ enyẽmo̱ le̱ hewale̱ nitšumo̱ le̱ nā,

english_verse: when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven.
translation_verse: noni etšu ye̱ Kristo mli, beni etẽle̱ ši ke̱-dše̱ gbobĩĩ ateṅ, ni eke̱le̱ *tá enine-dšurõ no̱ ye̱ ṅweiniiaṅ, *Lal.

english_verse: There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well.
translation_verse: ye̱ onukpayeli ke̱ hegbe̱ ke̱ hewale̱ ke̱ no̱yeli fẽ ke̱ gbe̱i-fẽ-gbe̱i ni awo dšee bene̱be ne̱ mli ke̱ke̱, ši be ni baba le̱ mli hũ le̱ ano̱, Kol.

english_verse: God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything.
translation_verse: ni eṅõ *nibii fiā eto enãdšiaši, ni eṅõle̱ efe nibii fē †yitšo ehã asafo le̱ *Lal.

english_verse: The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.
translation_verse: ni dši *egbomotšo le̱ ke̱ le̱ †moni ewoo̱ mei fẽ obõ ye̱ nii fẽ mli le̱ obõyimo le̱, *Rom.

english_verse: Don't forget that you are Gentiles. In fact, you used to be called “uncircumcised” by those who take pride in being circumcised.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyekaia ake̱ nye ni *sá ni nyedši wo̱ṅdšálo̱i ye̱ helo gbefãṅ ni mei ni atšé̱o̱ame̱ ketiafolo̱i ni ake̱ nidši fe ye̱ helo mli le̱ tšé̱o̱nye fõlo̱i le̱, *

english_verse: and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
translation_verse: Ši agbe̱ne̱, Kristo Iesu mli le̱, nye ni sá ni nyeyo̱ šoṅṅ le̱, nyetšõ Kristo lá le̱ no̱ nyebe̱ṅke̱.

english_verse: to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace.
translation_verse: ni eke̱ le̱dientše̱ ehelo le̱ gu kitãi *amla le̱ ni yo̱ akpo̱i amli le̱, koni eke̱ mei enyo̱ le̱ fẽ abo̱ †gbomo hē kome ye̱ le̱dientše̱ emli ni ehã hedšo̱le̱ eba, *Kol.

english_verse: Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God.
translation_verse: Ni eba ebadšadše hedšo̱le̱ sanekpakpa le̱ etšõ nye ni nyeyo̱ šoṅṅ le̱ ke̱ mei ni be̱ṅke̱ le̱ hũ, Ies.

english_verse: You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ agbe̱ne̱ nyedšee gbo̱i ke̱ meikpõdši doṅṅ, ši moṅ nyedši meikroṅkroṅi le̱ ananemeimaṅbii ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱ webii,

english_verse: You are like a building with the apostles and prophets as the foundation and with Christ as the most important stone.
translation_verse: ni atſanye amã bo̱foi le̱ ke̱ gbalo̱i le̱ *ašišitō le̱, ni †ekoṅte̱ dši Iesu Kristo le no̱, *Mat.

english_verse: Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord.
translation_verse: mo no̱ ni atšo atšẽ tšũ mũ le̱ fẽ awoṅ afe ekome, ni ēda ēfe so̱lemo̱tšũ kroṅkroṅ ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ mli,

english_verse: And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.
translation_verse: mo mli ni atſanye hũ awo afe Nyoṅmo̱ šihĩle̱he ye̱ Mumo̱ mli le̱.

english_verse: In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways.
translation_verse: ake̱ kpodšiemo̱ no̱ etšõ ehã mile *tẽmo̱sane le̱, take̱ beni miṅmãnye fiõ mo̱mo le̱, *

english_verse: I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured.
translation_verse: mi ni midši *bibiõ fẽ hetšelo̱i le̱ fẽ le̱, aṅõ ne̱ke̱ dromo̱ ne̱ ahãmi, ake̱ midšadše Kristo †nifále̱ ni anyẽẽ šiši ana ke̱-gbe nā le̱ he sanekpakpa le̱ mitšõ **dšeṅmãdši le̱, *

english_verse: God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind.
translation_verse: ni mihã mei fẽ ahĩe atšere̱ame̱ ni ame̱le noni dši *tẽmo̱sane ni aṅõ-tē ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ moni ke̱ Iesu Kristo †bo̱ nii fẽ le̱ mli le̱ gbe̱dšiano̱tõ le̱, *Rom.

english_verse: Christ now gives us courage and confidence, so we can come to God by faith.
translation_verse: *mo hũ ni ene̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli mli wo̱tšõ wo̱ná †ekã ke̱ gbe̱ṅmĕ ye̱ hĩe-ke̱-no̱fõ mli le̱. *Ioh.

english_verse: This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you. Christ's Love for Us
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ mīkpa fai, koni nyetšui akafã ye̱ mimanehũlũi ni minaā ye̱ *nyehewo̱ le̱ ahewo̱, edšake̱ nyenum-nyam ni. *Kol.

english_verse: All beings in heaven and on earth receive their life from him.
translation_verse: ni dši mei fẽ ni atšé̱ame̱ ake̱ bii ye̱ ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ atše̱ kro̱ṅṅ le̱,

english_verse: God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers
translation_verse: koni ye̱ enumnyam *fále̱ nā le̱ ehã nyetšõ Emumo̱ le̱ no̱ †nyehe awa kpintiṅṅ ye̱ nyemligbomo le̱ gbe̱fãṅ, *

english_verse: and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love.
translation_verse: ni atšó̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli no̱ ni *Kristo ahĩ ši ye̱ nyetšuii amli, ni †nyešišifãi amõmo̱ ši ni nye-māmo̱ ši šiṅṅ ye̱ suome̱ mli, *loh.

english_verse: I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep.
translation_verse: koni nyená hewale̱, ni nyeke̱ mei-kroṅkroṅi le̱ fẽ ayo noni dši lē̱mo̱ ke̱ ke̱le̱ ke̱ miikwo̱le̱ ke̱ no̱kwo̱le̱ le̱,

english_verse: I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
translation_verse: ni nyele Kristo suomo̱ ni tá nilẽ fẽ no̱ le̱, koni Nyoṅmo̱ obõyimo̱ le̱ ayimo̱ nyefẽ obõ.

english_verse: I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.
translation_verse: le̱ aṅõ anumnyam ahã ye̱ asafo ni ye̱ Kristo Iesu mli ye̱ yino̱i fẽ no̱ ke̱-yaši nãno̱i anãno̱! Amen.

english_verse: Christ has generously divided out his gifts to us.
translation_verse: Ši wo̱teṅ mofẽmo̱ le̱, aṅõ dromo̱ le̱ ahãle̱ ye̱ Kristo nikenii asusumo̱ le̱ nā. Rom.

english_verse: Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head
translation_verse: ši moṅ wo̱fe ano̱kwafoi ye̱ suomo̱ mli, ni wo̱dāra ye̱ nibii fẽ gbe̱fãṅ ye̱ le̱ *Kristo le noṅṅ ni dši yitšo le̱ he; *

english_verse: But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him.
translation_verse: ke̱dši eye̱ mli ake̱ nyenu ehe, ni atšõnye ye̱ emli hũ, take̱ bo̱ni dši ano̱-kwale ye̱ Iesu mli le̱,

english_verse: Let the Spirit change your way of thinking
translation_verse: ni nyetšõmo̱ mei hẽi ye̱ nyedſẽṅmo̱ mumo̱ le̱ mli, Rom.

english_verse: and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy. Rules for the New Life
translation_verse: ni nyewo gbomo hẽ *ni abo̱ ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ subãṅ no̱ ye̱ ano̱kwa dšale̱ ke̱ hetšemo̱ mli le̱, *

english_verse: We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le nyešé̱a amale nyefõa ni nyeteṅ mofẽmo ke̱ ananyo *awie ano̱kwale, edšake̱ gbomotšo kome henii dšiwo̱, *Zak.

english_verse: Don't get so angry that you sin. Don't go to bed angry
translation_verse: Nyemli afũa, ši nyekafea eša; hũlũ akanyõ ši ye̱ nyemlila le̱ no̱, Lal.

english_verse: and don't give the devil a chance.
translation_verse: ni asaṅ nyeke̱ nyehe akafõa ši nyehãa abonsam,

english_verse: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
translation_verse: Dšulo̱ le̱ ekadšu doṅṅ, ši moṅ ebo̱ mo̱deṅ ni eke̱ enidši *atšu nitšumo̱ kpakpa, koni ená noko ni eke̱-hã moni ehīale̱ le̱, *

english_verse: Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.
translation_verse: *Wiemo̱-ša-ko-wiemo̱-ša-ko akadše nyenã kwrã; ši moṅ †wiemo̱ ni hī ni ehīa, koni ehã mo nane amõ ši, ni ake̱-dro mei ni nuo̱ le̱. *

english_verse: Don't make God's Spirit sad. The Spirit makes you sure that someday you will be free from your sins.
translation_verse: Ni *nyekafea Nyoṅmo̱ Mumo̱ kroṅkroṅ le̱ nidō̱nii, mo mli ni †aso̱onye nā ye̱ ato kpõmo̱ gbī le̱. *Ies.

english_verse: Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude.
translation_verse: Nyehãa mlidšõmo̱ ke̱ mlila ke̱ mlifũ ke̱ blo̱mo̱ ke̱ musubō̱ fẽ se̱ afoa ye̱ nyeteṅ, ke̱ efõṅ-fẽ-efõṅ. Kol.

english_verse: Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ.
translation_verse: Ši nyemli ahīa ahãa nyehe, nye-mũsũṅ atšõanye ye̱ nyehe, nyeṅõ-fafaä nyehe, take̱ bo̱ noṅṅ ni Nyoṅmo̱ ṅõ-fanye ye̱ Kristo mli le̱. Mat.

english_verse: So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
translation_verse: Hewo̱ le̱ nyeke̱ nyehe akabo̱a ame̱he.

english_verse: and make your light shine. Be good and honest and truthful,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ la le̱ yibii dši mlihĩle̱ ke̱ dšale̱ ke̱ ano̱kwale fẽ.

english_verse: It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nii ni ame̱dšue̱ ši ame̱feo̱ le̱ ye̱ hĩegbĕle ake̱ atšĩo̱ tã tete. Rom.

english_verse: Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyekafea nyehe mei ni be̱ yitšeiaṅ, ši moṅ nyeyoa nii ni dši Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ suomo̱nānii le̱. K.

english_verse: Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything. Wives and Husbands
translation_verse: nyedaä Nyoṅmo̱ ke̱ tše̱ le̱ ši dā ye̱ nii fiã hewo̱ ye̱ wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo gbe̱i amli,

english_verse: Honor Christ and put others first.
translation_verse: ni nyebabaä nyehe ši nyehãa nyehe ye̱ Kristo gbeyeišemo̱ mli,

english_verse: A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord.
translation_verse: Nye yeigbãyei le̱, nyebaä nyehe ši nyehãa nyedientše̱ nyewùmei le̱, ta-mo boni nyefeo nyehãa Nuṅtšo̱ le̱,

english_verse: A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it.
translation_verse: Nye wùmei le, nyesumo̱a nyedientše̱ nyeṅãmei, take̱ boni Kristo hũ sumo̱ asafo le̱ ni eṅõ le̱dientše̱ ehe ehã ye̱ ehewo̱, Kol.

english_verse: He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water.
translation_verse: koni eke̱ *nu hedšũ le̱ atšū ehe ye̱ wiemo̱ mli ni ehã efe kroṅkroṅ, *Tĩt.

english_verse: Christ did this, so he would have a glorious and holy church, without faults or spots or wrinkles or any other flaws.
translation_verse: koni eṅõle̱ edamo̱ ši ehã le̱dientše̱ ehe ake̱ anumnyam asafo ni he be̱ kpa ko alo hĩekũamo̱ ko alo nakai noko, ši móṅ efe kroṅkroṅ ni ſãmo̱ ko akahĩ ehe. Lal.

english_verse: In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself.
translation_verse: Nakai sa ake̱ wúmei hũ asumo̱ ame̱dientše̱ ame̱ṅãmei, tamo̱ ame̱dientše̱ ame̱gbomotšei. Moni sumoo̱ eṅã le̱, le̱-dientše̱ ehe esumoo̱.

english_verse: None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ moko enye̱ko le̱dientše̱ ehelo dã, ši moṅ elè̱o̱le̱ ni ehĩeo̱le̱ do̱dō̱do̱, take̱ boni Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ hĩeo̱ asafo le̱;

english_verse: because we are each part of his body.
translation_verse: edšake̱ egbomotšo *henii ni dše̱ †ehelo ke̱ ewúi amli dšiwo̱. *

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.”
translation_verse: “Ene̱hewo̱ le̱ nū aašĩ etše̱ ke̱ enye, ni eekpe̱te̱ eṅã he, ni ame̱yi enyo̱ le̱ fẽ ame̱atšõmo̱ helo kome,”

english_verse: This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church.
translation_verse: Ne̱ke̱ tĕmo̱sane ne̱ mli tšī! ši mi le̱ miwieo̱ ke̱-too̱ Kristo ke̱ asafo le̱ he,

english_verse: So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
translation_verse: Ša ake̱ nye hũ nyeteṅ mofẽmo a-sumo̱ le̱dientše̱ eṅã nakai, tamo̱ le̱dientše̱ ehe; koni ṅã le̱ hũ aše ewù.

english_verse: Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: dšee ke̱ hĩeaṅ súomo̱ tamo̱ mei ni taoo̱ gbomei ahĩenyam, ši tamo̱ Kristo tšũdši ni dšieo̱ ame̱mũsũṅ ame̱feo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ suomo̱nãnii,

english_verse: Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks.
translation_verse: Nyewoa Nyoṅmo̱ tawũnii le̱ fẽ, koni nyenyẽ abonsam ṅãtšõi le̱ anã nye-damo̱.

english_verse: Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyedamo̱a ši, ni nyeke̱ ano̱kwale *afĩa nyehe̱, ni †nyewoa dšale̱ dama le̱, *Luk.

english_verse: Your desire to tell the good news about peace should be like shoes on your feet.
translation_verse: ni nyeke̱ hedšo̱le̱ sanekpakpa le̱ he sãmo̱-ke̱-tō awoa nyenãdši;

english_verse: Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
translation_verse: fẽ se̱ le̱ nyehĩea *hemo̱-ke̱-yeli tše̱ṅ le̱ mli, nõ ni nyeke̱-anyẽ mo-fõṅ le̱ gãimlibii ni tšoo̱ le̱ fẽ nyegbe le̱; *

english_verse: Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.
translation_verse: ni *walaheremo̱ dadefai le̱ hũ nyebua, ke̱ mumo̱ṅ klante ni dši Nyoṅmo̱ wiemo̱ le̱; *

english_verse: Never stop praying, especially for others. Always pray by the power of the Spirit. Stay alert and keep praying for God's people.
translation_verse: ni nyeke̱ so̱lemo̱ ke̱ faikpamo̱ fẽ aso̱lea dā ye̱ mumo̱ mli, ni ene̱ noṅṅ hewo̱ le̱ nyesraä, ni nyekãa be dā nye-kpaä fai nyehãa kroṅkroṅbii le̱ fĕ Mat.

english_verse: Pray that I will be given the message to speak and that I may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news.
translation_verse: *ke̱ mi hũ, koni, ké̱ migble minā le̱, aṅõ wiemo̱ awo mina, ni mike̱ †ekā̃ adšadše sanekpakpa le̱ṅ tĕmo̱sane le, *Kol.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower!
translation_verse: Hedšo̱le̱ ahã nyemimei le̱, ke̱ suomo̱ ke̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli ni dše̱ tše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ke̱ Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo deṅ!

english_verse: May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Dromo̱ ke̱ mei fẽ ni sumoo̱ wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo ke̱-wulaä ši le̱ ahĩ ši! Amen.

english_verse: Every time I think of you, I thank my God.
translation_verse: Midaä mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ši befẽbe ni mikaio̱nye, Rom.

english_verse: Now most of the Lord's followers have become brave and are fearlessly telling the message.
translation_verse: ni nyemimei ni yo̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ mli le̱ ateṅ mei babaõ etšo mikpãi le̱ ano̱ ená ekā̃ babaõ fè tšutšu le̱ ke̱-mīdšadše Nyoṅmo̱ wiemo̱ le̱ ni ame̱šee gbeyei.

english_verse: Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help.
translation_verse: Meikomei le̱, hetšẽmo̱ ke̱ meianã-béi-taomo̱ hewo̱ ame̱šie̱o̱ Kristo le̱; ši meikomei hũ ke̱ dſẽṅmo̱ kpakpa šie̱o̱.

english_verse: If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mi le̱, Kristo dši *miwala, ni gbĕle le̱ mise̱námo ni. *Gal,

english_verse: It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better.
translation_verse: ši mĩhao ye̱ nibii enyo̱ ne̱ teṅ: *mīſe ni madše mli ni mike̱ Kristo ayahĩ ši, adšake̱ no hī āhũ; *

english_verse: But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith.
translation_verse: Ni ake̱ noni miṅõ mihīe mifõ éne̱ no̱ hewo̱ le̱, mile ake̱ mahĩ ši, ni mi-ke̱nye fẽ aahĩ ši, koni nyehemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ aſere, ni nyenã mĩše̱ ye̱ mli;

english_verse: Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
translation_verse: koni nyemliflimo̱ le̱ ateke no̱ ye̱ Kristo Iesu mli, ye̱ mihewo̱, ye̱ kpe ni mike̱nye bakpe ekoṅ le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
translation_verse: Bẽle̱ nyemaṅsane gbe̱fãṅ le̱ nyebaä nyedšeṅ *bo̱ni sa Kristo sanekpakpa le̱ ke̱ke̱, koni, ké̱ miba mibananye dšio, mike̱nye be̱ dšio, manu nyehe ake̱ nye-damo̱ ši ye̱ mumo̱ kome mli, ni nyeke̱ dſẽṅmo̱ kome mĩple sanekpakpa le̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ he, *Kol.

english_verse: Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen,
translation_verse: ni nyekahãa henye̱lo̱i le̱ mīwoa nyeha gbeyei ye̱ nokonoko mli, no noṅṅ dši hīekpãtãmo̱ okadi hãame̱, ši nye le, edši walaheremo̱ okadi hãnye, ni ene̱ dše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ deṅ,

english_verse: and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him.
translation_verse: edšake̱ nye le̱ adronye ye̱ Kristo hewo̱, dšee eno̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli ke̱ke̱, ši moṅ ake̱ nyena nõ ye̱ ehewo̱ hũ:

english_verse: You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.
translation_verse: ni nakai ta kome le̱ noṅṅ ni nyena ye̱ *mihe ni agbe̱ne̱ nyenuo̱ ye̱ mihe hũ le̱ mli nyeyo̱ ne̱. *Bof.

english_verse: Instead he gave up everything and became a slave, when he became like one of us.
translation_verse: ši moṅ edšie ye̱ ehe efõ ši, eṅõ *tšulo̱ su efõ eno̱, etšõ tamo̱ gbomo, ni ešihĩle̱ ghe̱fãṅ hũ anale̱ take̱ gbomo; *Ies.

english_verse: My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, nye mei ni misumoo̱, take̱ bo̱ni nyeboo̱ toi dãne̱, dšee beni mike̱nye yo̱ le̱ ke̱ke̱, ši moṅ titri le̱ agbe̱ne̱ ni mibe̱ nyeṅõ ne̱ hũ le̱: nyeke̱ *gbeyeišemo̱ ke̱ hekpokpomo̱ atšua nyedientše̱ nyeyiwalaheremo̱ le̱ he nii; *

english_verse: God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
translation_verse: edšake̱ suomo̱ ni aasumo̱ dšio, femo̱ ni aafe dšio, Nyoṅmo̱ dši moni tšuo̱ fẽ ye̱ nyemli ye̱ emlihile̱ nā. Ioh.

english_verse: Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world,
translation_verse: koni nyehe akahĩ ſamo̱, ni nyefe mei *kro̱ṅi, Nyoṅmo̱ bii ni he be̱ kpa ko ye̱ yino̱ kõdõṅ ni be̱ eṅe̱le̱no̱ ne̱ teṅ, mei ateṅ ni †nyetšoo̱ tamo̱ kanei ye̱ dše ne̱ṅ; *

english_verse: Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši *afo̱se milá aſie nyehemo̱-ke̱-yeli afo̱le ke̱ dšámo̱ le̱ no̱ tete le̱, miye̱ he tšuidšũrõ ni mike̱nye fẽ aaná tšuidšũrõ; *

english_verse: I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you.
translation_verse: Ši mihĩe kã no̱ ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu mli, ake̱ etše̱ṅ ni matšu Timoteo nyeṅõ, koni ke̱dši minu bo̱ni nyeyo̱ le̱, ni mi hũ mitšui anyõ mimli.

english_verse: I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mibe̱ moko ni *edſĕṅmo̱ ke̱ midſẽṅmo̱ yeo̱ egbo̱ ni nyehe sane do̱ö̱le̱ kro̱ṅṅ tamo̱le̱; *

english_verse: The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: edšake̱ mei le̱ fẽ le, ame̱dientše̱ ame̱nii ame̱pleo̱, ši dšee Kristo Iesu nii.

english_verse: But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Ši nyele ete̱ nā, ake̱ eke̱mi sumoo̱ ye̱ sanekpakpa le̱ hewo̱ tamo̱ bi ke̱ etše̱.

english_verse: I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me.
translation_verse: Nohewe̱ le̱ mihĩe kã eno̱, ake̱ amrõ ni mana misane le̱ nā le̱, matšũle̱ nyeṅõ.

english_verse: And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
translation_verse: Ši mihĩe kã Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ no̱, ake̱ midientše̱ hũ, etše̱ṅ ni maba.

english_verse: I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me,
translation_verse: Kẽle̱ midſẽṅo̱ ake̱ ehĩa ake̱ matšũ wo̱nyemi *Epafrodito, ni dši minanyonitšulo̱ ke̱ tabilo̱ ke̱ nyebo̱fo ke̱ mihĩa le̱ he suolo̱ hũ le̱, nyeṅõ, *

english_verse: but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick.
translation_verse: edšake̱ ēſe nyefē, ni ake̱-ni nyenu ake̱ ehe mĩye hewo̱ le̱ ẽhao.

english_verse: In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
translation_verse: Ši ehe ye le̱le̱ṅ ni ebe̱ṅke̱ gbĕle tã, ši kẽle̱ Nyoṅmo̱ enale̱ mo̱bo̱, ni dšee le̱ ke̱ke̱, ši moṅ mi hũ, koni mikaye ṅko̱mo̱ mito ṅko̱mo̱ no̱.

english_verse: Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ titri mibo̱ mo̱deṅ mitšũle̱ le̱, koni, ké̱ nyenale̱ ekoṅ le̱, ni nyená mīše̱ ni mi hũ mikaye ṅko̱mo̱ tũtu,

english_verse: Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyehereale̱ atu ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ mli, ke̱ mĩše̱ so̱ṅṅ, ni nyebua ne̱ke̱ gbomei ake̱ mei ni sa wō;

english_verse: He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.
translation_verse: edšake̱ Kristo nitšumo̱ le̱ hewo̱ le̱ ebe̱ṅke̱ gbẽle kwrä, ni ešē̱ ewala efõ, koni eke̱-gbe noni ſe̱o̱nye ye̱ suomo̱ ni nyeke̱-asúmo̱mi le̱ mli le̱ nā.

english_verse: although I could. Others may brag about themselves, but I have more reason to brag than anyone else.
translation_verse: tše̱bele̱ mi hũ miye̱ noko ye̱ helo gbe̱fãṅ ni kũle̱ mike̱ mihĩe aafõ no̱. Ké̱ efeo̱ moko ake̱ eye̱ noko ni eṅõo̱ ehĩe efõo̱ no̱ ye̱ helo gbe̱fãṅ le̱, minõ fè:

english_verse: But Christ has shown me that what I once thought was valuable is worthless.
translation_verse: Ši kẽle̱ nii ni dši *se̱námo̱ hãmi sá le̱, mibu nomei lãdšemo̱nii ye̱ Kristo hewo̱. *Mat.

english_verse: All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him to life. I want to suffer and die as he did,
translation_verse: ni malele̱ ke̱ *ešitē le̱ hewale̱ le̱ ke̱ †emanehũlũi le̱ amli nanyobō̱ le̱, ni matamole̱ ye̱ egbĕle le̱ gbe̱fãṅ; *Rom.

english_verse: My friends, I don't feel I have already arrived. But I forget what is behind, and I struggle for what is ahead.
translation_verse: Anyemimei, mibuu mihe ake̱ minine eše̱ no̱, ši nokome ke̱ke̱: nii ni yo̱ se̱gbe̱ le̱ mĩdšie mihĩe ye̱ no̱, ši nii ni yo̱ hĩegbe̱ le̱ ahe moṅ mi-pleo̱,

english_verse: I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: ni mītiu oti le̱ ke̱-yaše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ tšé̱mo̱ ni dše̱ ṅwei ye̱ Kristo Iesu mli le̱ he dšũromo̱nõ le̱ he.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you.
translation_verse: Anyemimei, nyefea minanemei-kaselo̱i, ni mei ni nyieo̱ bo̱ni we̱too̱nye okadi le̱, nyekwe̱aame̱.

english_verse: that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
translation_verse: ame̱ le̱ ame̱nãgbē dši híekpãtãmo̱, ni *ame̱mũsũ dši ame̱nyoṅmo̱, ni ame̱-hĩegbedšianii amli ame̱numnyam yo̱, ši-kpoṅno̱nii ahe ke̱ke̱ ame̱dſẽṅo̱. *Rom.

english_verse: But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ
translation_verse: Ši *wo̱le̱ wo̱maṅ le̱ ṅwei eyo̱, heni wo̱kwe̱o̱ walaherelo̱ ni dši Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo le̱ gbe̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ le̱, *Ef.

english_verse: has power over everything, and he will make these poor bodies of ours like his own glorious body.
translation_verse: moni batšake wo̱gbomotšo ni hīe be̱ nyam le̱, koni etamo̱ enumnyam-gbomotšo le̱ su, ye̱ ehe-wale̱-nitšumo̱ ni eke̱-nyẽo̱ eṅõo̱ nibii fẽ etoo̱ ešiši hũ le̱ nā le̱.

english_verse: Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad.
translation_verse: Nyemĩ aše̱a ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ mli dā! misā mĩkē̱: Nyemī ašea!

english_verse: Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
translation_verse: ni Nyoṅmo̱ hedšo̱le̱ ni fẽ dſẽṅmo̱i fẽ le̱ aato nyetšuii ke̱ nye-dſẽṅmoi le̱ ye̱ Kristo Iesu mli! Ioh.

english_verse: Finally, my friends, keep your minds on whatever is true, pure, right, holy, friendly, and proper. Don't ever stop thinking about what is truly worthwhile and worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Noni eſe̱ le̱, anyemimei, nii abo̱ ni dši ano̱kwa, *nii ni sa wō, nii ni dša, nii ni be tše, nii ni ado̱ö̱ he, nii ni yo̱ gbe̱i kpakpa le̱ fẽ, ké̱ dšeṅba kpakpa ko ye̱, ké̱ yidšiemo̱ ko hũ ye̱ le̱, ene̱mei ano̱ nyedſẽṅa! *Rom.

english_verse: Christ gives me the strength to face anything.
translation_verse: Minyẽo̱ nii fẽ mifeo̱ ye̱ moni wadšeo̱mi ni dši Kristo le̱ mli.

english_verse: It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time.
translation_verse: Ši kẽle̱ nyefe dšogbāṅ, ake̱ nye-baye nyebuami ye̱ mimanehũlũ le̱ mli le̱.

english_verse: My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return.
translation_verse: Ši nye Filipibii dientše̱ hũ nyele ake̱, sanekpakpa le̱ šišidšē le̱ṅ, beni miyiṅ ke̱-dše̱ Makedonia le̱, *asafo ko he̱ ni ke̱mi bo̱ö̱ nanyo ye̱ hãmo̱ ke̱ hemo̱ gbe̱fãṅ, ake̱ dša nye ke̱ke̱; *

english_verse: Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once.
translation_verse: edšake̱ beni miyo̱ Tesalonika le̱ hũ nyemãdšemi nii ni hĩaämi le̱ šikome ke̱ šii enyo̱ fẽ.

english_verse: I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
translation_verse: Dšee ake̱ nikẽnii mitaoo̱; ši moṅ mītao yibii ni aahã nyekontā le̱ afá ahãnye,

english_verse: I have been paid back everything, and with interest. I am completely satisfied with the gifts you sent with Epaphroditus. They are like a sweet-smelling offering or like the right kind of sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Ši miná nii fẽ ke̱-teke no̱: mito̱ ke̱ nii ni nyeke̱-mãdše *Epafrodito ke̱-bahãmi le, ni dši ṅmadšē kpakpa ke̱ afo̱le ke̱ ṅõmo̱ ni sa Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe le. *

english_verse: I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus!
translation_verse: Mi-Nyoṅmo̱ le ahãnye nii ni hĩaänye le̱ fē ye̱ enumnyam fále̱ le̱ nā, ye̱ Kristo Iesu mli.

english_verse: May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Ši anumnyam ahã wo̱tše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ke̱-yaši nāno̱i anāno̱ le̱ l Amen.
