english_verse: Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus. The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Nyeṅāa hetšelo̱-fẽ-hetšelo̱ ye̱ Kristo Iesu mli. Nyemimei ni ke̱mi yo̱ le̱ mī-binye.

english_verse: All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
translation_verse: Hetšelo̱i le̱ fẽ, ši titri le̱ mei ni dše̱ Kaisare we le̱, mībinye.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless your life!
translation_verse: Wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo dromo̱ le̱ ke̱ nyemumo̱ le̱ ahĩ ši! Amen.

english_verse: The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness
translation_verse: noni eše̱ nyeṅõ take̱ bo̱ noṅṅ ni eyo̱ ye̱ dšeṅ mū le̱ fẽ mli, ní ewoo̱ yibii ni eſereo̱, take̱ bo̱ni efeo̱ ye̱ nye hũ nyeteṅ ke̱-dše̱ gbĩ no̱ ni nyenu ni nyená nyele Nyoṅmo̱ dromo̱ le̱ ye̱ ano̱kwale mli le̱;

english_verse: Christ is exactly like God, who cannot be seen. He is the first-born Son, superior to all creation.
translation_verse: mo noṅṅ ni dši Nyoṅmo̱ ni anaa le̱ subāṅ, bō̱nii fẽ ateṅ kromo̱bi le̱. Heb

english_verse: God's Son was before all else, and by him everything is held together.
translation_verse: Ni le̱ noṅṅ eyo̱ dãni nii fiã yo̱, ni nii fiã le̱, emli noṅṅ emãmo̱ ši ye̱, Abe̱i

english_verse: God himself was pleased to live fully in his Son.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ esa hĩe ake̱ obõyimo̱ le̱ fẽ ahĩ amli;

english_verse: And God was pleased for him to make peace by sacrificing his blood on the cross, so that all beings in heaven and on earth would be brought back to God.
translation_verse: ni etšõ le̱ noṅṅ eno̱ ekpãtã eke̱ nibii fẽ teṅ kwrā, nii ni yo̱ šikpoṅ no̱ ke̱ nii ni yo̱ ṅwei le̱, ake̱-ni le̱dientše̱ etšō eseṅmotšo lá le̱ no̱ ehã hedšole ba le̱. Ef.

english_verse: You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things.
translation_verse: Ni nye ni sá ni nyedši *meikpõdši ke̱ †henye̱lo̱i ye̱ nyedſẽṅmo̱ ke̱ nitšumo̱i fõdši le̱ amli le̱, *Ef

english_verse: But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message. Paul's Service to the Church
translation_verse: ke̱dši nyehĩe heme̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ mli ni nyedamo̱ ši šiṅṅ, ni nyetšĩṅ nyehe ke̱-dše̱ṅ sanekpakpa le̱ ni nyenu ni ašie̱o̱ atšõo̱ bō̱nii fẽ ni yo̱ ṅwei šiši le̱, ni mi Paulo misúmoo̱ ye̱ he le̱, no̱hĩekãmo̱ le̱ he le̱.

english_verse: I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ mimī še̱o̱ ye̱ mimanehũlũi ni minaä ye̱ nyehewe̱ le̱ amli, ni mihãa nii ni ſe̱ ye̱ Kristo amanehũlũi le̱ amli le̱ yio̱ obõ ye̱ mihelo le̱ mli hã egbomotšo ni dši asafo le̱, Ef.

english_verse: God did this because he wanted you Gentiles to understand his wonderful and glorious mystery. And the mystery is that Christ lives in you, and he is your hope of sharing in God's glory.
translation_verse: mei ni Nyoṅmo̱ *sumoo̱ ake̱ ahã ame̱le noni dši ne̱ke̱ tēmo̱sane ne̱ anumnyam fále̱ le̱ ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ateṅ, ni dši Kristo ye̱ nyemli, anumnyam le̱ *no̱hĩekãmo̱ le̱; *

english_verse: We announce the message about Christ, and we use all our wisdom to warn and teach everyone, so all of Christ's followers will grow and become mature.
translation_verse: mo he sane ni wo̱dšadšeo̱, ni wo̱woo̱ gbomo-fē-gbomo ṅā, ni wo̱tšõo̱ gbomo-fē-gbomo nii ye̱ nilē-fē-nilē mli, koni wo̱ke̱ gbomo-fẽ-gbomo adamo̱ ši ake̱ moni *eye emũ ye̱ Kristo Iesu mli, *K.

english_verse: This is why I work so hard and use the mighty power he gives me.
translation_verse: no he deṅme migboo̱ ni mipleo̱ ye̱ nitšumo̱ ni ake̱ hewale̱ tšuo̱ ye̱ mimli le̱ nā.

english_verse: Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
translation_verse: ni *nyešišifāi amõmo̱ ši, ni †amãmo̱nye ye̱ eno̱, ni nyefī ši ye̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ mli, take̱ bo̱ noṅṅ ni atšõnye le̱, ni nyeteke no̱ ke̱ šidā, *Ef.

english_verse: Christ has also taken away your selfish desires, just as circumcision removes flesh from the body.
translation_verse: mo mli ni aflo̱nye ketia hũ ye̱, ke̱ ketiafō ni dšee nidši aṅõfe, ši moṅ *noni yo̱ helo ešai agbomotšo le̱ dšiemo̱ le̱ mli, ye̱ Kristo ketiafō le̱ mli le̱; *

english_verse: These things are only a shadow of what was to come. But Christ is real!
translation_verse: edšake̱ nii ni baba le̱ ahe susuma ke̱ke̱ ni, ši gbomotšo le̱ dši Kristo nõ le̱. Heb

english_verse: Don't be cheated by people who make a show of acting humble and who worship angels. They brag about seeing visions. But it is all nonsense, because their minds are filled with selfish desires.
translation_verse: Nyekahãa moko mīšõa nyedšuromo̱nii le̱ ye̱ nyedeṅ ye̱ le̱dientše̱ etaome̱ nā *hešibãdſẽṅmo̱ ke̱ ṅweibo̱foi adšámo̱ mli, nõ mli ni eke̱ ehe woo̱ nii ni enako le̱ amli, ni ebelodſẽṅmo̱ le̱ hãa ewōo̱ ehe no̱ yakatſā, *K.

english_verse: They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God. Christ Brings New Life
translation_verse: ni ehĩee yitšo le̱ mli, nõ mli noṅṅ ni gbomotšo le̱ fẽ tšoo̱ talo̱i ke̱ fāi le̱ ano̱ enáa nii ni hĩaäle̱, ni etšratšraä ehe ke̱-daä Nyoṅmo̱ dale̱ le̱. Ef.

english_verse: You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as,
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, ké̱ nyeke̱ Kristo egbo ehã dše ne̱ṅ šišidšēnii le̱, mẽba mo̱ ni nyetamo̱ mei ni hĩe kãmo̱ ye̱ dšeṅ, ni *nyehãa awoo̱nye akpo̱i lolo, ake̱: *Gal.

english_verse: “Don't handle this. Don't taste that. Don't touch this.”?
translation_verse: “Kāmõ mli, ni kāsa onã, ni kāta he tete!” le̱?

english_verse: Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
translation_verse: ni ame̱dši nii ni hĩe nilē wiemo̱ ye̱ ame̱dientše̱ ame̱suomo̱-nā-dšámo̱ ke̱ hešibãdſẽṅmo̱ ke̱ *gbomotšo yiwã mli moṅ, ši edšee wō ko ni kũo̱ helo le̱ gbe̱ṅmē̃ nā. *Rom.

english_verse: Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
translation_verse: ši ene̱mei fẽ se̱ le̱ nyewoa suomo̱ ni dši emūyeli kpã le̱. Rom.

english_verse: Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Ni nyehãa Nyoṅmo̱ *hedšo̱le̱ le̱ ayea lumo̱ ye̱ nyetšuii amli, nõ he hũ ni atšé̱nye ke̱-ba ye̱ †gbomotšo kome mli le̱, ni nyelea šidā. *Fil

english_verse: Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
translation_verse: Nyehãa Kristo wiemo̱ le̱ ahĩa nyemli babaō ye̱ nilē-fē-nilē mli; ni nyetšõa nyehe nii ni nyewiea nyetšõa nyehe ye̱ *saṅkũtſãi ke̱ yidšiemo̱lalai ke̱ mumo̱ṅ-lalai amli, ni nyeke̱ šidã alaā ye̱ nyetšuii amli nyehãa Nyoṅmo̱; *Ef.

english_verse: Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him. Some Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: ni nofẽno ni nyefeo̱ ye̱ wiemo̱ lo nitšumo̱ gbe̱fãṅ le, nyefea fẽ ye̱ Iesu Kristo gbe̱i amli, ni nyetšōa eno̱ nyedaä Nyoṅmo̱ ke̱ tše̱ le̱ ši,

english_verse: A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nye yeigbãyei le, nyebaä nyehe ši nyehãa nyewũmei, take̱ bo̱ni sa ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le mli le̱.

english_verse: A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
translation_verse: Nye wùmei le̱, nyesumo̱a nyeṅãmei, ni nyemli akadšoa ye̱ ame̱no̱.

english_verse: Children must always obey their parents. This pleases the Lord.
translation_verse: Nye bii le̱, nyeboa nyefo̱lo̱i atoi ye̱ nibii fẽ gbe̱fãṅ; edšake̱ no sa Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ hīe dšogbāṅ.

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
translation_verse: Nye tše̱mei le̱, nyekawoa nyebii amli la, koni ame̱tšui ãkafã.

english_verse: Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart.
translation_verse: Nye tšũdši le̱, nyeboa nyehelo gbe̱fãṅ nuṅtšo̱mei le̱ atoi ye̱ nibii fẽ mli, dšee ke̱ hĩeaṅsúomo̱, tamo̱ mei ni taoo̱ gbomei ahĩenyam, ši moṅ ye̱ tšui kro̱ṅṅ mli ake̱ mei ni šeo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ gbeyei.

english_verse: Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master.
translation_verse: Ni nofẽno ni nyefeo̱ le̱, nyedšiea nyemũsũṅ nyetšua, take̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ nyetšuo̱ nyehã ni dšee gbomei,

english_verse: In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you.
translation_verse: ni nyele ake̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ deṅ nyenine baše̱ gbošinii le̱ ano̱ ye̱ ake̱ nyenyõmo̱wo; edšake̱ Nuṅtšo̱ Kristo nyesúmoo̱.

english_verse: But Christ has no favorites! He will punish evil people, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Ši moni feo̱ nii ni edšaa gbe̱ le̱ aaná nii ni edšaa gbe̱ le̱ he nyõmo̱wo, ni hĩeiaṅkwe̱mo̱ ko be̱ṅ, Rom.

english_verse: I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along.
translation_verse: mo hũ ni mitšũ nyeṅõ ye̱ ene̱ noṅṅ hewo̱, koni male nyehe sãdši le̱, ni etšé̱ nyetšui eṅmẽ nyemli, Ef.

english_verse: Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
translation_verse: ni miṅõ *Onesimo ni dši ano̱kwa ke̱ suomo̱ nyemi ni dše̱ nyeteṅ le̱ mifata ehe; āme̱agbanye bie̱ sãdši fē. *Filem.

english_verse: Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely.
translation_verse: *Epafra ni dše̱ nyeteṅ ní dši Kristo tšũlo̱ ni dāne̱ epleo̱ nyehe ye̱ eso̱lemo̱i amli, koni nyedamo̱ ši ni nyeye emũ ni nyeyimo̱ obõbõ ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ suomo̱nãnii fẽ mli le̱, mĩbinye. *

english_verse: I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mĩye ehe odase, ake̱ ebo̱ō̱ mo̱deṅ naakpa ye̱ nye ke̱ mei ni yo̱ Laodikea ke̱ mei ni yo̱ Hierapoli le̱ ahewo̱.

english_verse: Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
translation_verse: Luka, tšofãtše̱ ni asumoo̱ le̱, ke̱ Dema mībinye.

english_verse: Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
translation_verse: Wo̱mībi nyemimei ni yo̱ Laodikea le̱, ke̱ Nimfa ke̱ asafo ni yo̱ ewe le̱.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL. Don't forget that I am in jail. I pray that God will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Mi Paulo dientše̱ *minine nā bimo̱ ni miṅmã ne̱. Nyekaia mikpāi le̱! Dromo̱ le̱ ke̱nye ahī ši! Amen. *

english_verse: we tell God our Father about your faith and loving work and about your firm hope in our Lord Jesus Christ. The Thessalonians' Faith and Example
translation_verse: ni wo̱kaio̱ nyehemo̱-ke̱-yeli nitšumo̱ le̱ ke̱ nyesuomo̱ mo̱deṅbō̱ le̱ ke̱ wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo he hĩeno̱kãmo̱ mli tšuišitõ le̱ ye̱ Nyoṅmo ke̱ wotše le̱ hĩe,

english_verse: So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
translation_verse: Ni nye le̱, nyetšõmo̱ wo̱ke̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ *kaselo̱i, ake̱-ni nyeke̱ Mumo̱, kroṅ-kroṅ mli mīše̱ mõ wiemo̱ ie̱ mii ye̱ amane-hũlũ babaō mli le̱; *

english_verse: You became an example for all the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia.
translation_verse: ni ehã nyetšõmo̱ okadii nyehã mei fẽ ni he ye ye̱ *Makedonia ke̱ Akaia le̱. *

english_verse: Everyone is talking about how you welcomed us and how you turned away from idols to serve the true and living God.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ame̱dientše̱ ame̱gbaä bo̱ni wo̱ná nyeteṅgbe̱ wo̱hã ke̱ bo̱ni *nye-kpale ke̱-dše̱ amãgãi ahe ke̱-ba Nyoṅmo̱ ṅõ, ni nyebasumo̱ ano̱kwa Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe-kãlo̱ le̱, *Bof.

english_verse: They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
translation_verse: ni nyemĩkwe̱ ebi le̱ ni etēle̱ ši ke̱-dše̱ gbohĩĩ ateṅ le̱ gbe̱ ke̱-dše̱ ṅwei, Iesu, ni dšiewo̱ ke̱-dše̱ mlifũ ni baba le̱ mli le̱, Tit.

english_verse: We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ wo̱wiemo̱-ke̱-tšõmo̱ le̱, dšee šišiumo̱ lo nyãṅemo̱-nitšumo̱ lo kũtũmpo̱o mli edše̱;

english_verse: We were not trying to get you or anyone else to praise us.
translation_verse: asaṅ wo̱taoo gbomei ahĩenyam, ye̱ nyeṅõ dšio, meikrokomei aṅõ dšio, Ioh.

english_verse: We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
translation_verse: Ni ake̱-ni wo̱sumoo̱nye dšogbãṅ ne̱ke̱ hewo̱ le̱, wo̱ye̱ he tšui ake̱ dšee Nyoṅmo̱ sanekpakpa le̱ ke̱ke̱ wo̱ke̱-ahãnye, ši moṅ wo̱dientše̱ wo̱wala tete, edšake̱ wo̱-mĩsumo̱nye naakpa.

english_verse: My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone.
translation_verse: Edšake̱, anyemimei, nyehĩe ye̱ wo̱-to̱le̱ ke̱ wo̱deṅmegbomo̱ le̱ no̱, ake̱ beni afe ni wo̱katšõ dšatšu wo̱mĩhã nyeteṅ moko hewo̱ le̱ nyõṅ ke̱ ſane fẽ wo̱mĩtšu nii, ni wo̱sã wo̱mīdšadše Nyoṅmo̱ sane-kpakpa le̱ wo̱mĩtšõnye.

english_verse: Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyedientše̱ ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱ dši odasefoi ake̱ wo̱dšeṅ ni wo̱ba ye̱ nye mei ni nyeheo̱ nyeyeo̱ le̱ ateṅ le̱ eye̱ kro̱ṅṅ, edša, ni kpatō ko be̱ he,

english_verse: We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
translation_verse: ni wo̱mã no̱ mī wo̱hãnye ake̱ nyenyie bo̱ni *sa Nyoṅmo̱ ni tšē̱nye ke̱-ba le̱-dientše̱ emaṅtše̱yeli ke̱ enumnyam le̱ mli le̱ hĩe le̱. *Ef.

english_verse: My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nye le̱, anyemimei, nye-tšomo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ asafoi ni yo̱ Iudea le̱ akaselo̱i ye̱ Kristo Iesu mli, edšake̱ amanei ni nyena ye̱ nyedientše̱ nyemaṅbii le̱ adeṅ le̱, no noṅṅ ame̱ hũ ame̱na ye̱ Iudafoi le̱ adeṅ,

english_verse: Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else.
translation_verse: mei ni gbe Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu ke̱ ame̱-dientše̱ ame̱gbalo̱i le̱ hũ, ni ame̱waä wo̱ hũ yi, ni ame̱saa Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe, ni ame̱ke̱ gbomei fẽ yee, Bof.

english_verse: My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person.
translation_verse: Ši wo̱ le̱, anyemimei, ake̱-ni wo̱ke̱nye mli egbla be kukuõ ko ye̱ hīeaṅ ši dšee tšui mli hewo̱ le̱, wo̱ke̱ ſẽ pĩ bo̱ mo̱deṅ babaõ, koni wo̱na nyehĩe ekoṅ. Rom.

english_verse: We really wanted to come. I myself tried several times, but Satan always stopped us.
translation_verse: Hewo̱ le̱ wo̱tao ake̱ wo̱ba nyeṅõ, mi Paulo le̱, šikome ke̱ šii enyo̱ fẽ; ši satan tšīwo̱ gbe̱.

english_verse: After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us?
translation_verse: Edšake̱ namo dši wo̱hĩeno̱kãme̱ lo wo̱mĩše̱ lo wo̱fã akekre le̱ ye̱ wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo hīe, ye̱ ebābe le̱ mli le̱? ani dšee nye noṅṅ ni? Fil,

english_verse: You alone are our glory and joy!
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nye nyedši wo̱numnyam ke̱ wo̱mĩše̱.

english_verse: because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know.
translation_verse: edšake̱ beni wo̱ke̱nye yo̱ le̱, wo̱ke̱nye woto ake̱ wo̱bana amanehũlũ, tamo̱ bo̱ noṅṅ ni eba mli ni nyele le.

english_verse: Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
translation_verse: Ši agbe̱ne̱ ni *Timoteo dše̱ nyeṅõ ba wo̱ṅõ, ni ebagbawo̱ nyehemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ ke̱ nyesuomo̱ le̱ ke̱ kaimo̱ kpakpa ni nyeke̱-kaio̱wo̱ dā le̱ ke̱ nyeſẽ ni nyeſeo̱ ake̱ nyeanawo̱ take̱ bo̱ni wo̱ hũ wo̱ſeo̱nye le̱ he sane le̱, *Bo̱f.

english_verse: My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you.
translation_verse: ene̱hewo̱ le̱, anyemimei, wo̱manehũlũ ke̱ wo̱hedšramo̱ le̱ fẽ mli le̱, nyehemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ ehã wo̱mĩ eše̱ ye̱ nyehewo̱;

english_verse: Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life.
translation_verse: agbe̱ne̱ wo̱he ewawo̱, ake̱-ni nye-damo̱ ši ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ mli le̱.

english_verse: How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us?
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mẽ šidã po wo̱o̱nyẽ wo̱ke̱-da Nyoṅmo̱ ye̱ nyehewo̱ ye̱ mĩše̱ fẽ ni wo̱ná ye̱ nyehe ye̱ wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ hīe le̱ hewo̱?

english_verse: We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you.
translation_verse: Ši Nyoṅmo̱ ke̱ wo̱tše̱ le̱ dientše̱ ke̱ wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo le̱ aahã wo̱gbe̱ le adša ke-ba nyeṅõ.

english_verse: May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown.
translation_verse: Ši nye le̱, Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ awonye obõ-bõ, ni ehã nyeteke no̱ ke̱ suomo̱ ni nyeke̱-sumoo̱ nyehe ke̱ mei fẽ, take̱ bo̱ni wo̱ hũ wo̱sumoo̱nye le̱;

english_verse: And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
translation_verse: beni afe ni ehã nyetšuii afĩ ši ye̱ kroṅkroṅfemo̱ mli ni *ſamo̱ ko akahī nyehe, ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ke̱ wo̱tše̱ le̱ hĩe, ye̱ wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo ke̱ emeikroṅkroṅi le̱ fẽ abābe le̱ mli. *Fil.

english_verse: You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things.
translation_verse: koni moko akaye enyemi amim ni ešišiule̱ ye̱ sane ko mli, edšake̱ ene̱mei fẽ ahe oweleto̱lo̱ dši Nuṅtšo̱ le̱, take̱ bo̱ni wo̱kē̱nye wo̱to ni wo̱ye be odase le̱.

english_verse: God didn't choose you to be filthy, but to be pure.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ tšé̱é̱wo̱ ehãã nyã-ṅemo̱-nitšumo̱, ši moṅ hetšemo̱.

english_verse: and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more.
translation_verse: edšake̱ nyefeo̱ nakai hũ nyehãa nyemimei fẽ ni yo̱ Makedonia mū le̱ fẽ le̱, ši wo̱mĩkpanye fai, anyemimei, ake̱ nyeteke no̱ fẽ tšutšu le̱;

english_verse: Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do.
translation_verse: ni nyebo̱ mo̱deṅ ni nyehĩ ši diō ni nyehĩe nyedientše̱ nyenitšumo̱ mli ni nyeke̱ nyenidši atšu nii, bo̱ni wo̱wonye kitã le̱, Ef.

english_verse: My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope.
translation_verse: Ši, anyemimei, wo̱mīsumo̱ ake̱ nyele mei ni *ewo̱ le̱ ahe sane, koni nyekaye ṅko̱mo̱ tamo̱ mei ni eſe̱ le̱, mei ni be̱ †no̱hĩekãmo̱ ko le̱. *

english_verse: With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life.
translation_verse: edšake̱ le̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ dientše̱ ke̱ ošebō̱ ke̱ ṅweibo̱fonukpa gbē ke̱ Nyo-ṅmo̱ te̱tre̱mantre̱ aadše̱ ṅwei akpleke ši, ni gbohĩĩ ni yo̱ Kristo mii le̱ tšutšu bate ši,

english_verse: Encourage each other with these words.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyeke̱ ne̱ke̱ wiemo̱i ne̱ atšé̱a nyetšui aṅmĕa nyemli

english_verse: People sleep during the night, and some even get drunk.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mei ni wo̱ö̱ le̱, nyōṅ ame̱-wo̱ö̱, ni mei ni tro̱ö̱ dã le̱, nyõṅ ame̱-tro̱ö̱;

english_verse: Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes.
translation_verse: moni gbo wo̱yi gbĕle, koni *wo̱hĩe kãmo̱ dšio, wo̱wo̱ dšio, †wo̱ke̱le̱ ahī ši, *Rom.

english_verse: This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing. Final Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Hewo̱ le̱ nyetšé̱a nyetšui nyeṅmẽa nyemli, ni *mo ahã enanyo nane amõ ši, take̱ bo̱ noṅṅ ni nyefeo̱ le̱. *Iud.

english_verse: Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other.
translation_verse: ni nyebuaame̱ naakpa dientše̱ ye̱ suomo̱ mli, ye̱ ame̱nitšumo̱ le̱ hewo̱. Nyehĩa ši ye̱ hedšo̱le̱ mli ye̱ nyeteṅ.

english_verse: Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
translation_verse: Nyekwe̱a ni ahīa koni moko akaṅõ efõṅ mĩto efõṅ nãdšiaṅ, ši moṅ dãne̱ nyenyiea ekpakpafemo̱ se̱ nyehãa nyeba ke̱ mei fẽ. Abei.

english_verse: and never stop praying.
translation_verse: nyesolea ni nyekafōa, Luk.

english_verse: Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: nyedaä ši ye̱ nofẽno mli: edšake̱ no dši Nyoṅmo̱ suomo̱nãnii ye̱ Kristo Iesu mli ye̱ nyegbe̱fãṅ. Ef.

english_verse: Don't turn away God's Spirit
translation_verse: Nyekagbea Mumo̱ le̱,

english_verse: Put everything to the test. Accept what is good
translation_verse: Ši nyekaä nii fiã nyekwe̱a, ni noni hī le̱ nyemõa mli.

english_verse: and don't have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Nyetšia nyeba ke̱-dšea nofẽno ni hīe efõṅ su le̱ he.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Ši hedšo̱le̱ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ dientše̱ atšũ nyehe kwrã ke̱-mõ ši, ni eto nyemumo̱ ke̱ nyesusuma ke̱ nye-gbomotšo mũ le̱ fẽ ni ſamo̱ ko akahī he ye̱ wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo bãbe le̱ṅ.

english_verse: The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.
translation_verse: Anó̱kwafo dši moni tšé̱o̱nye le̱, ni le̱ noṅṅ eefe hũ.

english_verse: Friends, please pray for us.
translation_verse: Anyemimei, nyeso̱lea nyehãawo̱.

english_verse: Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Nyeṅãa nyemimei le̱ fẽ ke̱ nãſo̱mo̱ kroṅkroṅ.

english_verse: In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
translation_verse: Mĩkãnye Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ kitã ake̱ nyehãa akanea ne̱ke̱ wolo ne̱ ahãa nyemimei kroṅkroṅi ie̱ fẽ!

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo dromo̱ le̱ ke̱nye ahĩ ši! Amen.

english_verse: All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering.
translation_verse: nii ni dši Nyoṅmo̱ *kodšomo̱ ní dša gbe̱ le̱ he okadi ni anaä faṅṅ, koni †abunye ake̱ nyesa Nyoṅmo̱ maṅtše̱yeli ni nyenaä hewo̱ nõ le̱, *Fil.

english_verse: but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels
translation_verse: ni nye mei ni ahaoo̱nye le, eehã nyeke̱wo̱ fẽ hedšō̱mo̱, beni aadšie Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu kpo ke̱-adše̱ ṅwei *ke̱ ehewale̱ bo̱foi le, *Mat,

english_verse: Their punishment will be eternal destruction, and they will be kept far from the presence of our Lord and his glorious strength.
translation_verse: mei ni aaná nyomo̱wo ni dši nãno̱ hĩekpãtãmo̱ ke̱-adše̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le hĩe ke̱ *ehewale̱ le̱ anumnyam le̱ he, *Ies.

english_verse: This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.
translation_verse: beni *eeba ni aawo ehĩe nyam ye̱ emeikroṅkroṅi le̱ amli, ni aana enãkpe̱nii ye̱ eheyelilo̱i le̱ fẽ mli ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱, edšake̱ ahé wo̱dase ni wo̱ye wo̱-tšõnye le̱ aye. *Kol.

english_verse: God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do.
translation_verse: Ene̱hewo̱ hũ ni wo̱so̱leo̱ dā wo̱-hãanye, koni wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ahã nyesa tšé̱mo̱ le, ni ehã emlihĩle̱ taomo̱nii le̱ fẽ ke̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli nitšumo̱ le̱ ayi obõ ye̱ hewale̱ mli,

english_verse: Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: beni afe ni awo wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo gbe̱i le̱ hĩe nyam ye̱ nyemli, ni nye hũ nyehĩe aba nyam ye̱ emli, ye̱ wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ke̱ Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo dromo̱ le̱ nā.

english_verse: Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
translation_verse: Nyekaii ake̱, heni mike̱nye yo̱ le̱, mikē̱nye ne̱ke̱ nii ne̱ lo?

english_verse: His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way.
translation_verse: *Edšake̱ mlakwamo̱ tēmo̱sane le̱ mĩtšu nii momo; ši dša adšie moni kã he tšĩo̱ gbe̱ le̱ ke̱-dše̱ teṅ dã. *Bof.

english_verse: Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.
translation_verse: Ni no dãni aadšie mlakwalo̱ le̱ kpo, moni Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu ke̱ edāṅ-mumo̱ le̱ aagbe, ni eke̱ ebā le̱ puemo̱ le̱ aakpātã ehĩe le̱; Ies.

english_verse: When the wicked one appears, Satan will pretend to work all kinds of miracles, wonders, and signs.
translation_verse: mo hũ ni ebā le̱ mli le̱ eeba ke̱ satan nitšumo̱ ni mli wa ye̱ amale be-wale̱ ke̱ okadii ke̱ nākpe̱nii fẽ mli, Mat.

english_verse: Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it.
translation_verse: ke̱ nii ni edšaa gbe̱ fẽ ni ake̱-ši-šiuo̱ mei ni *lādšeo̱ le̱, edšake̱ ame̱mõõ ano̱kwale suomo̱ le̱ mli ni ake̱-here ame̱yiwala. *

english_verse: So God will make sure they are fooled into believing a lie.
translation_verse: Ni ene̱hewo̱ le̱ Nyoṅmo̱ aatšu šišiu-mo̱ ní mli wa ke̱-aba ame̱ṅõ, ni ame̱he amale ame̱ye, Rom.

english_verse: All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth. Be Faithful
translation_verse: koni akodšo mei fẽ ni hee ano̱-kwale le̱ ame̱yee, ši ame̱náa nii ni edšaa gbe̱ le̱ moṅ ahe tšui le̱.

english_verse: My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth.
translation_verse: Ši wo̱ le̱, *sa ake̱ wo̱daā Nyoṅmo̱ ši dā ye̱ nyehewo̱, anyemimei ni Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ sumoo̱, edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ †ehalanye ke̱-dše̱ šišidšē ehã walaheremo̱ ye̱ mumo̱ le̱ kroṅkroṅfemo̱ ke̱ ano̱kwale le̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli mli, *

english_verse: God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: no̱ mli etšõ wo̱sanekpakpa le̱ no̱ etšé̱nye ke̱-ba, koni nyená wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo anumnyam le̱.

english_verse: My friends, this is why you must remain faithful and follow closely what we taught you in person and by our letters.
translation_verse: Bẽle̱ nohewo̱ le̱, anyemimei, nye-damo̱a ši, ni nyehĩea nii ni wo̱tšõnye ye̱ wiemo̱ mli lo wolo mli le̱ amli.

english_verse: God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father
translation_verse: Ši le̱ wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo le̱ dientše̱ ke̱ wo̱tše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ni sumo̱wo̱ ni eke̱ nāno̱ mĩše̱dšemo̱ ke̱ no̱hĩekāmo̱ kpakpa hāwo̱ ye̱ dro̱mo̱ nā le̱,

english_verse: will encourage you and help you always to do and say the right thing.
translation_verse: le̱ noṅṅ eetšē̱ nyetšuii eṅmẽ nyemli, ni eewadšenye ye̱ wiemo̱ kpakpa ke̱ nitšumo̱ kpakpa fẽ mli.

english_verse: But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Ši ano̱kwafo dši Nuṅtšo̱ le̱, moni aawadšenye, ni eebu nyehe ke̱-adše̱ mo-fõṅ le̱ deṅ le̱.

english_verse: You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nyedientše̱ nyele ake̱ esa ake̱ *nyekaseo̱wo̱; edšake̱ wo̱fee wo̱he sakasaka ye̱ nyeteṅ, *

english_verse: and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
translation_verse: ni asaṅ wo̱yee moko ṅmã yaka, ši moṅ wo̱ke̱ mo̱deṅbō̱ ke̱ to̱le̱ tšuo̱ nii nyōṅ ke̱ ſane, beni afe ni wo̱kafe dšatšu wo̱-mĩhã nyeteṅ moko;

english_verse: We also gave you this rule: If you don't work, you don't eat.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ beni wo̱ke̱nye yo̱ le̱ hũ, wo̱wonye kitã ake̱, ké̱ moko sumo̱o̱ ake̱ *etšuo̱ nii le̱, bẽle̱ ekaye nii hũ.

english_verse: So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living.
translation_verse: Ne̱ke̱ mei ne̱ wo̱mīwoame̱ kitã ni wo̱mĩwoame̱ ṅã ye̱ wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo mli ake̱ ame̱tšu nii *diõ ni ame̱ye ame̱-dientše̱ ame̱deṅ ṅmã. *

english_verse: Dear friends, you must never become tired of doing right.
translation_verse: Ši nye le̱, anyemimei, nyekahãa edšũrõfemo̱ mīto̱anye. Gal.

english_verse: Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ moko boo wo̱wiemo̱ ni yo̱ wolo le̱ mli le̱ toi le̱, nyekadiale̱, ni nyeke̱le̱ *akabo̱a, koni ehĩe agbo; *K.

english_verse: Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower. Final Prayer
translation_verse: ni nyekabuale̱ ake̱ henye̱lo̱, ši moṅ nyewiea nyetšõale̱ take̱ nyemi,

english_verse: I always sign my letters as I am now doing: PAUL.
translation_verse: Mi Paulo dientše̱ minine nā bimo̱ ni dši okadi ye̱ miwolo-fẽ-wolo mli ne̱: bo̱ni miṅmãa ne̱.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo dromo̱ le̱ ke̱ nyefẽ ahĩ ši! Amen.

english_verse: We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way.
translation_verse: Ši wo̱le ake̱ mla le̱ hĩ hā moni tšuo̱ he nii bo̱ni sa mla le̱, Rom

english_verse: of the good news the glorious and wonderful God has given me. Being Thankful for God's Kindness
translation_verse: ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ní *adšō̱le̱ le̱ anumnyam sanekpakpa ní atu awo mideṅ le̱ nā. *

english_verse: I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him.
translation_verse: mi ní tšutšu le̱ midši musubo̱lo̱ ke̱ yiwalo̱ ke̱ mei aniseniianifelo̱; ši kẽle̱ anami mo̱bo̱, edšake̱ milee ni mife, ye̱ hé ní mihee miyee mli.

english_verse: Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
translation_verse: Ši wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ dromo̱ le̱ fá āhũ ke̱-teke no̱ ke̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli ke̱ suomo̱ ní yo̱ Kristo Iesu mli le̱.

english_verse: “Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all!
translation_verse: Edši ano̱kwa wiemo ni sa ake̱ amõ mli kwrā, ake̱ Kristo Iesu bá dše ne̱ṅ eba ešafelo̱i ayiwalaheremo̱, mei ateṅ ní mi midši otu le̱; Luk.

english_verse: Timothy, my son, the instructions I am giving you are based on what some prophets once said about you. If you follow these instructions, you will fight like a good soldier.
translation_verse: Kitã ní miwoo̱o ne̱, mibi Timoteo, ye̱ gbale̱i ní agba sá ye̱ ohe le̱ anā, koni oke̱-wu ta kpakpa le̱,

english_verse: You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences.
translation_verse: ni ohĩe *emo̱-ke̱-yeli ke̱ henilē kpakpa, noni meikomei še̱re̱ ſie ni ame̱ke̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ †yaša ši le̱:

english_verse: Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
translation_verse: ame̱teṅ meikomei dši *Himeneo ke̱ Aleksandro, mei ní mitu miwo †satan deṅ, koni agbla ame̱toi ní ame̱kawie musubō̱-wiemo̱i doṅṅ le̱. *

english_verse: I want everyone everywhere to lift innocent hands toward heaven and pray, without being angry or arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ mitao ake̱ hĩĩ aso̱le ye̱ hefẽhe ní ame̱hole nidši ní he tše no̱ ní mlifũ lo ṅwanedšē akaba mli.

english_verse: I would like for women to wear modest and sensible clothes. They should not have fancy hairdos, or wear expensive clothes, or put on jewelry made of gold or pearls.
translation_verse: Nakai noṅṅ yei hū, ame̱ke̱ atade ní sa ke̱ hĩe ní gboo̱ nõ ke̱ dſẽṅmo̱ ni sa awula amehe, dšee ke̱ yigbō̱ lo šika lo adiagbai lo atade ní dšra wa,

english_verse: They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do.
translation_verse: ši mĩhãã *yō hegbe̱ ake̱ etšõ nii alo †eye nū no̱, ši moṅ efe diō. *

english_verse: After all, Adam was created before Eve,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Adam tšutšu abo̱, no se̱ le̱ Hawa.

english_verse: and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned.
translation_verse: Ni dšee Adam alaka le̱, ši yō le̱ alaka, ni ebote no̱tõmo mli.

english_verse: But women will be saved by having children, if they stay faithful, loving, holy, and modest.
translation_verse: Ši aahere eyiwala ke̱-atšṍ biiafo̱mo̱ no̱, ke̱dši ame̱hĩ ši ye̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli ke̱ suomo̱ ke̱ hetšemo̱ ke̱ dſẽṅmo̱ hũ ní sa mli le̱.

english_verse: Finally, they must be well-respected by people who are not followers. Then they won't be trapped and disgraced by the devil. Church Officers
translation_verse: Ši sa ake̱ *mei ní yo̱ se̱ le̱ hũ †aye ehe odase kpakpa, koni ekagbē dše̱mo̱ ke̱ abonsam tšõne mli. *

english_verse: Church officers should be serious. They must not be liars, heavy drinkers, or greedy for money.
translation_verse: Asafo mli *súolo̱i le̱ hũ esa ake̱ amefe gbomei ní hĩe tšī, dšee lile̱i-nta-tše̱mei, dšee dā̃to̱lo̱i, dšee hĩedšōloi, Fil.

english_verse: And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith.
translation_verse: ši mei ní hĩeo̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ tēmo̱sane le̱ ye̱ henilē ni he tše mli.

english_verse: Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
translation_verse: Yei le̱ hũ nakai noṅṅ; amefe mei ni hĩe tšī, *dšee meiahewielo̱i, ši ame̱hĩe akä ši, ame̱ye anokwa ye̱ nii fẽ mli. *Tit.

english_verse: Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home.
translation_verse: Asafo mli súolo̱i le̱ amefe *ṅã komekome tše̱mei, mei ní yeo̱ ame̱bii ke̱ ame̱dientše̱ ame̱mei ano̱ dšogbāṅ. *K.

english_verse: Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus. The Mystery of Our Religion
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mei ní súmoo̱ dšogbāṅ le̱, ame̱náa se̱tšo kpakpa ame̱hãa ame̱he, ke̱ eká babaō ye̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli ní yo̱ Kristo Iesu mli le̱ṅ.

english_verse: I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions,
translation_verse: Mīṅmão ene̱mei, ni mihĩe kã no̱ ake̱ etše̱ṅ ni maba oṅõ;

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious.
translation_verse: *Ši yeimedši ayakayaka adesãi le̱ gu. Ni obo̱ Nyoṅmo̱-dšámo̱ moṅ he mo̱deṅ. *

english_verse: We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
translation_verse: Ene̱hewo̱ wo̱gboo̱ deṅme ni wo̱hãa adšé̱o̱wo̱ le̱, edšake̱ wo̱ṅõ wo̱hĩe wo̱fõ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩekãlo̱ le̱ no̱, moni dši gbomei fe *ayiwalaherelo̱, titri le̱ mei ní heo̱ yeo̱ le̱. *

english_verse: Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.
translation_verse: Kāhã *moko mīgbe ohe guo̱ ye̱ oblanyo ní odši le̱ hewo̱, ši moṅ oke̱ ohe ato okadi ohã mei ní heo̱ yeo̱ le̱, ye̱ wiemo̱ mli, ye̱ dšeṅba mli, ye̱ suomo̱ mli, ye̱ mumo̱ mli, ye hemo̱-ke̱-yeli mli, ye̱ hetšemo̱ mli. *Tit.

english_verse: Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Hĩ wolo kanemo̱ ke̱ ṅāwō ke̱ nitšõmo̱ he ke̱-yaši beyino ní maba.

english_verse: Remember these things and think about them, so everyone can see how well you are doing.
translation_verse: Bo̱ nii ne̱ ahe mo̱deṅ, oke̱ ohe awo mli kwrā, koni mei fẽ ana oſeremo̱ faṅṅ.

english_verse: Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
translation_verse: Ohĩe ahĩ ohe no̱ ke̱ tšõmo̱ lo̱ no̱, hĩ ši ye̱ nii ne̱ amli; edšake̱ ke̱dši ofe ene̱ le̱, *oohere bodientše̱ ke̱ mei ní boo̱o toi le̱ fẽ yiwala. *Rom.

english_verse: Take care of any widow who is really in need.
translation_verse: Yei okũlafoi ní dši okũlafoi le̱le̱ṅ le̱ woame̱. K.

english_verse: A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
translation_verse: Ši moni bo̱ö̱ ahoſi le̱, ehĩe kã moṅ ši egbo.

english_verse: Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ
translation_verse: Ši yei okũlafoi ní drako le̱, kaṅō-ame̱; edšake̱ ké̱ lahō yi ame̱hĩe le̱, ame̱-dšeo̱ Kristo se̱ ame̱taoo̱ gblã,

english_verse: If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need. Church Leaders
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ nū lo yō ní heo̱ yeo̱ ye̱ yei okũlafoi le̱, ekwe̱ame̱, ní akawa mīhã asafo le̱, koni akwe̱ okũlafoi ní dši okũlafoi le̱le̱ṅ le̱.

english_verse: Church leaders who do their job well deserve to be paid twice as much, especially if they work hard at preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Onukpai ni yeo̱ no̱ *dšogbāṅ le̱, esa ake̱ aṅõ wō toi enyo̱ awoame̱, titri le̱ mei ní bo̱ö̱ wiemo̱ ke̱ tšõmo̱ he mo̱deṅ le̱. *Rom.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *ṅmãle̱ le̱ kē̱o̱ ake̱: “Kā-wo tšina ní gble̱o̱ able nābu kotoku”; ke̱: †“Nitšulo̱ le̱, enyõmo̱wo sale̱.” *

english_verse: But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
translation_verse: Mei ní feo̱ eša le̱, okãame̱ ye̱ mei fẽ hĩe, koni mei ní eſe̱ le̱ hũ aše gbeyei. Gal.

english_verse: In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.
translation_verse: Mīwoö kitã ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ke̱ Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo ke̱ ebo̱foi ní ehala le̱ ahĩe, ake̱ oye nii ne̱ ano̱ ni okašá ohe okodšo, ni asaṅ okafe noko ye̱ niiaṅkpamo̱ nā.

english_verse: Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them. Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
translation_verse: Kāṅõ *onidši oſie moko no̱ oyá, ni asaṅ kāṅõ ohe ofutu meikrokomei ahe ešai amli. To ohe kroṅṅ.

english_verse: Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
translation_verse: Kānu nu so̱ṅṅ, ši nu wein fio ye̱ omũsũ ke̱ ohelai ní yeo̱o kpitiokpitio le̱ ahewo̱.

english_verse: Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later.
translation_verse: Meikomei ahe ešai dšeo̱ kpo tšutšu ni ame̱nyieo̱ ame̱hĩe ke̱ame̱ yaä kodšomo̱ mli, ši meikomei anõ hũ nyieo̱ ame̱se̱.

english_verse: It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.
translation_verse: Nakai noṅṅ kẽ nitšumo̱i kpakpai hũ dšeo̱ kpo tšutšu, ni nii ní sōroame̱ le̱ hũ anyẽṅ ake̱-tē.

english_verse: Anyone who teaches something different disagrees with the correct and godly teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ké̱ moko tšõo̱ tšõmo̱ *kroko ni ekplẽẽ wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo wiemoi †ní tšáa mo le̱ ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱-dšámo̱ nā tšõmo̱ le̱, *Gal.

english_verse: Now I ask you to make a promise. Make it in the presence of God, who gives life to all, and in the presence of Christ Jesus, who openly told Pontius Pilate about his faith.
translation_verse: Mīwoö kitã ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ní hãa nibii fiā wala le̱ ke̱ Kristo Iesu ní ye dšadšemo̱ fe̱fe̱o le̱ he odase *ye̱ Pontio Pilato yino̱ le̱ hĩe, *Ioh.

english_verse: The glorious God is the only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords. At the time that God has already decided, he will send Jesus Christ back again.
translation_verse: noni hewale̱-no̱yelo̱ kome ni *adšō̱le̱, †maṅtše̱mei amaṅtše̱ ke̱ **nuṅtšo̱mei anuṅtšo̱ le̱ aatšõ ye̱ le̱dientše̱ ebe mli le̱, *

english_verse: Only God lives forever! And he lives in light that no one can come near. No human has ever seen God or ever can see him. God will be honored, and his power will last forever. Amen.
translation_verse: mo hũ ni le̱ ekome eyo̱ nāno̱šihĩle̱ ni gbĕle be̱ mli, ni ehīo̱ la ní anyẽṅ abe̱ṅke̱ mli le̱, moni gbomo-ko-gbomo-ko enakole̱ dã, ni *enyẽṅle̱ ena hũ le̱, mo nõ ní dši nāno̱wō ke̱ hewale̱ le̱. Amen. *

english_verse: Warn the rich people of this world not to be proud or to trust in wealth that is easily lost. Tell them to have faith in God, who is rich and blesses us with everything we need to enjoy life.
translation_verse: Niiatše̱mei ní yo̱ dše ne̱ṅ le̱, wo-ame̱ kitã ní ame̱kadſẽṅ nii wudši, ni *ame̱kaṅõ ame̱hĩe hũ ame̱fõ nifále̱ ní be̱ ſeſēſe le̱ no̱, ši moṅ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩekãlo̱ le̱ no̱, mo hũ ní ṅõo̱ nibii fẽ ehãawo̱ babaō, ake̱ wo̱ye mli ṅõmo̱ le̱, *Lal.

english_verse: Instruct them to do as many good deeds as they can and to help everyone. Remind the rich to be generous and share what they have.
translation_verse: ní amefe edšŭrõ, ni ame̱tšṍmo̱ niiatše̱mei ye̱ edšŭrõfemo̱i agbe̱fãṅ, ame̱sumo̱ nihãmo̱, amenine akpo,

english_verse: This will lay a solid foundation for the future, so they will know what true life is like.
translation_verse: ame̱bo̱ dſetri amehã ame̱he, ní efe šišitō kpakpa ehã be ní baba le̱, koni ame̱mõ ano̱kwa wala le̱ mli. Mat.

english_verse: Timothy, guard what God has placed in your care! Don't pay any attention to godless and stupid talk that sounds smart but really isn't.
translation_verse: Ō Timoteo! *nii ní atu awo odeṅ le̱ bāmo̱ yi, ni †okwa yakayakasane-gbā ní buleo̱ mo ke̱ ṅwanedšēwiemo̱ ní dše̱ apasa-nilē mli le̱, *

english_verse: Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: noni meikomei tšõo̱ ake̱ ame̱yo̱ ni *ame̱dũ gbe̱ ke̱-dše̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ he le̱. Dromo̱ le̱ ke̱o ahĩ ši! Amen.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ *ohĩe akagbo ye̱ wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ he odaseyeli le̱ he alo ye̱ mi ni midši egbokle̱fonyo le̱ he, ši moṅ oke̱ sanekpakpa le̱ ahĩe amanehũlũ mli ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hewale̱ nā; *Rom.

english_verse: God saved us and chose us to be his holy people. We did nothing to deserve this, but God planned it because he is so kind. Even before time began God planned for Christ Jesus to show kindness to us.
translation_verse: mo hũ ni ehere wo̱yiwala ni eke̱ tšē̱mo̱ kroṅkroṅ tšē̱wo̱, dšee wo̱nitšumo̱i anā, ši moṅ ye̱ le̱dientše̱ eyiṅtõ ke̱ edromo̱ nā, noni eṅõ-hãwo̱ ye̱ Kristo Iesu mli, dãni abo̱ dše ne̱ṅ be le̱, Tit

english_verse: Now Christ Jesus has come to offer us God's gift of undeserved grace. Christ our Savior defeated death and brought us the good news. It shines like a light and offers life that never ends.
translation_verse: ni agbe̱ne̱ atšó wo̱yiwalaherelo̱ Iesu Kristo puemo̱ le̱ no̱ *adšiele̱ ši faṅṅ le̱; le̱ efo †gbĕle se̱ ni edšie wala ke̱ nã-nošihĩle kpo etšõwo̱ ye̱ sanekpakpa le̱ṅ, *Rom.

english_verse: My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
translation_verse: nõ he ni awomi šie̱lo̱ ke̱ bo̱fo ke̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ atšõlo̱ le̱.

english_verse: This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ noṅṅ minaã amanehũlũi ne̱, ši kẽle̱ mihĩe gboo; edšake̱ mile moni mihe miye le̱, ni miye̱ hewale̱ ye̱ no̱ ake̱ eenyẽ nii ni eto ehãmi le̱ ahe ebu ke̱-yaši nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱,

english_verse: Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model.
translation_verse: Hĩemo̱ tšámo̱-wiemo̱i ni onu ye̱ minã le̱ akadi le̱ mli ye̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli ke̱ suomo̱ ni yo̱ Kristo Iesu mli le̱ mli;

english_verse: You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.
translation_verse: nikpakpai ni atu awo odeṅ le̱ bu he ye̱ Mumo̱ kroṅkroṅ ni hĩo̱ wo̱mli le̱ hewale̱ nā!

english_verse: You know that everyone in Asia has turned against me, especially Phygelus and Hermogenes.
translation_verse: Ole ene̱ ake̱ mei ni yo̱ Asia le̱ fẽ ekpa ye̱ mise̱, ame̱teṅ meikomei dši Figelo ke̱ Hermogene.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ ana Onesiforo we le̱ mo̱be̱, edšake̱ kpitiokpitio ebahãami tšui, ni ehĩe gboo mikõsõṅkõsõ le̱ he;

english_verse: Then after he arrived in Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.
translation_verse: ši beni eba Roma le̱, ebo̱ mo̱deṅ etaomi ni enami.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ ahã ená Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ deṅ me̱bo̱nale̱ ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱. Ni bo̱ni etšṍ esũmo̱mi ehã ye̱ Efeso le̱, ole pe̱-pē̱pe̱.

english_verse: No one wins an athletic contest without obeying the rules.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši moko mīši mple hũ le̱, afĩṅle̱ kũnimyeli-akekre, ake̱ dša ešile̱ mla nā.

english_verse: If we don't give up, we will rule with him. If we deny that we know him, he will deny that he knows us.
translation_verse: ke̱ wo̱mia we̱hĩe ye̱ amanehũlũ mli le̱, wo̱ke̱le̱ aaye maṅtše̱ hũ; ké̱ *wo̱kpa ye̱ ese̱ le̱, le̱ hũ eekpa ye̱ wo̱se; *Mat.

english_verse: If we are not faithful, he will still be faithful. Christ cannot deny who he is.” An Approved Worker
translation_verse: ké̱ wo̱fee wo̱he ano̱kwafoi le̱, le̱ le̱ eehĩ ši ane̱kwafo, enyẽṅ ekpa ye̱ le̱dientše̱ ehe se̱, Rom.

english_verse: Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.
translation_verse: Bo̱ mo̱deṅ ni oke̱ ohe adamo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe, ake̱ *moko ni sa, nitšulo̱ ni hĩe gboo, ni dšaä ano̱kwale wiemo̱ le̱ mli pe̱pē̱pe̱. *

english_verse: Keep away from worthless and useless talk. It only leads people farther away from God.
translation_verse: Ši yakayakasanegbā ni buleo̱ mo le̱, tši ohe ke̱-dše̱ he; edšake̱ ame̱ate hĩe pĩ ye̱ nõšafemo̱ mli,

english_verse: That sort of talk is like a sore that won't heal. And Hymenaeus and Philetus have been talking this way
translation_verse: ni ame̱wiemo̱ le̱ aatšẽṅe tamo̱ hela fõṅ ko ke̱-akpe: *ame̱teṅ meikomei dši Himeneo ke̱ Fileto, *

english_verse: by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.
translation_verse: mei ni edũ gbe̱ ke̱-dše̱ ano̱kwale le̱ he, ni ame̱kē̱o̱ ake̱ šitẽ le̱ eho momo, ni ame̱butuo̱ meikomei ahemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱.

english_verse: But the foundation God has laid is solid. On it is written, “The Lord knows who his people are. So everyone who worships the Lord must turn away from evil.”
translation_verse: Ši Nyoṅmo̱ šišitõ-te̱ ni wa le̱ mã ši šiṅṅ, ni ehĩe ne̱ke̱ nãso̱omo̱nõ ne̱: *Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ le le̱dientše̱ emei le̱, ke̱: Hā ni mofẽmo ni tšĩo̱ Kristo gbe̱i le̱ atã le̱ atši ehe ke̱-dše̱ nii ni edšaa gbe̱ le̱ ahe. *Ioh

english_verse: In a large house some dishes are made of gold or silver, while others are made of wood or clay. Some of these are special, and others are not.
translation_verse: Ši šīa wolo ko mli le̱, dšee ši-kanii ke̱ dſie̱te̱inii ke̱ke̱ yo̱ dše̱i, ši moṅ tšonii ke̱ sũnii hũ ye̱ mli, ni ekomei le̱ abuo̱ame̱, ši ekomei hũ abuu.

english_verse: This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ ke̱dši moko tšũ ehe ke̱dše̱ ne̱ke̱ nii ne̱ amli le̱, etšõ nõ ni abuo̱, ni atšū ehe kro̱ṅṅ, ni ehĩ hã šĩatše̱ le̱ dšogbãṅ, ni asāle̱ ahã nitšumo̱ kpakpa-fẽ-nitšumo̱ kpakpa.

english_verse: Run from temptations that capture young people. Always do the right thing. Be faithful, loving, and easy to get along with. Worship with people whose hearts are pure.
translation_verse: Ši oblahĩaṅ se̱dii le̱ hũ, dšo nā foi: ši moṅ oke̱ mei ni tšé̱o̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ tšui ni mli tše mli le̱ atiu dšale̱, hemo̱-ke̱-yeli, suomo̱ ke̱ hedšo̱le̱.

english_verse: Stay away from stupid and senseless arguments. These only lead to trouble,
translation_verse: Ši kwašiai aṅwanedšēi ni aṅõ-kasee noko le̱ gũ, edšake̱ ole ake̱ ame̱ke̱ béi baā;

english_verse: and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.
translation_verse: ši Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ tšũlo̱ le̱, esaa ake̱ ebéo̱, ši moṅ emli adšo̱ ahã mei fē, moni le nitšōmo, moni too̱ etšui ši ehãa efõṅ, Tit.

english_verse: Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth.
translation_verse: moni ke̱ mlidšo̱le̱ wieo̱ tšõo̱ mei ni kũo̱ enā, ake̱ aleenõ Nyoṅmo̱ aahãame̱ tšuitšakemo̱ ni ame̱le ano̱kwale,

english_verse: They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.
translation_verse: ni ame̱hĩe aatšere̱ame̱ ke̱-dše̱ abonsam tšõne le̱ṅ; edšake̱ eke̱-dũame̱ ni ame̱fe esuomo̱nānii.

english_verse: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people are enemies of the truth. Their minds are sick, and their faith isn't real.
translation_verse: Ši take̱ bo̱ni Iane ke̱ Iambre kũ *Mose nā le̱, nakai noṅṅ kẽ ne̱ke̱ mei ne̱ kũo̱ ano̱kwale le nā; gbomei ni yitšo efite, mei ni dšee meikomei ye̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ gbe̱fãṅ ni. *

english_verse: But they won't get very far with their foolishness. Soon everyone will know the truth about them, just as Jannes and Jambres were found out. Paul's Last Instructions to Timothy
translation_verse: Ši ame̱yaṅ ame̱hĩe tūtu ko; edšake̱ ame̱kwašiafeme̱ le aadše kpo faṅṅ ye̱ mei fẽ hĩe, take̱ bo̱ni nomei anõ le hũ dše kpo le̱,

english_verse: In fact, anyone who belongs to Christ Jesus and wants to live right will have trouble from others.
translation_verse: Ši mei fẽ hũ ni taoo̱ ake̱ ame̱-ahi ši ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱-dšámo̱ nā ye̱ Kristo Iesu mli le̱, aawaame̱ yi. Mat.

english_verse: But evil people who pretend to be what they are not will become worse than ever, as they fool others and are fooled themselves.
translation_verse: Ši gbomei fõdši ke̱ šišiulo̱i aawo wu ye̱ efõṅ mli; ame̱lakaā mei ni ame̱ hũ alakaäame̱.

english_verse: Keep on being faithful to what you were taught and to what you believed. After all, you know who taught you these things.
translation_verse: Ši bo le̱, hĩ ši *ye̱ nii ni okase ni oyo̱ hewale̱ ye̱ no̱ le̱ amli, edšake̱ ole mo nā ni okase ye̱, *

english_verse: Since childhood, you have known the Holy Scriptures that are able to make you wise enough to have faith in Christ Jesus and be saved.
translation_verse: ni ogbekẽbiiaši odše̱ ole ṅmãle̱i kroṅkroṅi le̱, ni aanyẽ abã ole nii ni atšo Kristo Iesu no̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli no̱ ke̱-ya yiwalaheremo̱ mli le̱. Ioh.

english_verse: Everything in the Scriptures is God's Word. All of it is useful for teaching and helping people and for correcting them and showing them how to live.
translation_verse: *Nmāle̱-fẽ-ṅmãle̱ ni dše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ Mumo̱ le̱ṅ le̱ ehĩ hã nitšõmo̱ ke̱ hĩekãmo̱ ke̱ mo-sāmo̱ ke̱ tšo̱se-mo̱ ni yo̱ dšale̱ mli le̱, *

english_verse: The Scriptures train God's servants to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: koni *Nyoṅmo̱ gbomo le̱ aye emū, ni asāle̱ pe̱pē̱pe̱ ahã nitšumo̱ kpakpa-fẽ-nitšumo̱ kpakpa. *

english_verse: So a crown will be given to me for pleasing the Lord. He judges fairly, and on the day of judgment he will give a crown to me and to everyone else who wants him to appear with power. Personal Instructions
translation_verse: noni eſe̱ ni kã ši hãmi dši dšale̱ *akekre le̱, ni Nuṅtšo̱ ni dši dšale̱ kodšolo̱ le̱ bahãmi ye̱ nakai gbĩ le̱ no̱ le̱, ni dšee mikome eba-hã, ši moṅ mei blũblu ni sumoo̱ epuemo̱ le̱ hũ. *

english_verse: Come to see me as soon as you can.
translation_verse: Bo̱ mo̱deṅ ni oba miṅõ oyá, K.

english_verse: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
translation_verse: Tihiko le̱, mitšũle̱ Efeso. Bof.

english_verse: When you come, bring the coat I left at Troas with Carpus. Don't forget to bring the scrolls, especially the ones made of leather.
translation_verse: Kotoku le̱ ni mišĩ ye̱ Troia ye̱ Karpo ṅõ le̱, oke̱-ba, ke̱ wodši le̱ hũ, ši titri le̱ koloi-ahe wodši ni aṅmãa nii ye̱ no̱ le̱,

english_verse: Alexander, the metalworker, has hurt me in many ways. But the Lord will pay him back for what he has done.
translation_verse: *Aleksandro, sõlo̱ le̱, femi efõṅ naakpa: †Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ atole̱ nãdšiaṅ ye̱ enitšumo̱i le̱ anā, *

english_verse: But the Lord stood beside me. He gave me the strength to tell his full message, so that all Gentiles would hear it. And I was kept safe from hungry lions.
translation_verse: Ši Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ *fĩ mise̱ ni ewomi hewale̱, koni atšṍ mino̱ amã šie̱me̱ le̱ no̱ mi, ni dšeṅmãdši le̱ fẽ anu; ni adšiemi ye̱ dšata le̱ dáṅ, *Bof.

english_verse: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do the rest of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Bo̱ mo̱deṅ ni oba dãni fẽibe le̱ aše̱, Eubulo ke̱ Pude ke̱ Lino ke̱ Klaudia ke̱ nyemimei le̱ fẽ mībio,

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless your life and will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo ke̱ omumo̱ le̱ ahĩ ši! Dromo̱ ke̱nye ahĩ ši! Amen.

english_verse: Instead, they must be friendly to strangers and enjoy doing good things. They must also be sensible, fair, pure, and self-controlled.
translation_verse: ši moṅ gbo̱felo̱, moni sumoo̱ ekpakpa, moni dſẽṅmo̱ kā ši, dšalo̱, moni he tše, moni hìe kā ši,

english_verse: They must stick to the true message they were taught, so their good teaching can help others and correct everyone who opposes it.
translation_verse: moni hīeo̱ tšõmo̱ le̱ nā ano̱kwa wiemo̱ le̱ mli, koni enyẽ ewie etšõ mei ye̱ nitšõmo̱ ni tšáa mo le̱ mli, ni mei ni kũo̱ wiemo̱ nā le̱ hũ, ekā ame̱hìe.

english_verse: There are many who don't respect authority, and they fool others by talking nonsense. This is especially true of some Jewish followers.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mei pī ye̱ ni dši yakayakawielo̱i ke̱ šišiulo̱i ni baa ame̱he ši ame̱hāā moko, titri le̱ mei ni dše̱ ketiafolo̱i le̱ ateṅ le̱;

english_verse: It is like one of their own prophets once said, “The people of Crete always tell lies. They are greedy and lazy like wild animals.”
translation_verse: Ame̱teṅ moko ni dši ame̱dientše̱ ame̱gbalo̱ le̱ kē̱ ake̱: Kretabii maleo̱ dā; koloi fõdši ni, mũsũtše̱mei hedšõlo̱i ni.

english_verse: This surely is a true saying. And you should be hard on such people, so you can help them grow stronger in their faith.
translation_verse: Ne̱ke̱ odase ne̱ ano̱kwale ni. Nohewo̱ le̱ *kā ame̱hìe vevēve, koni ame̱he awa ye̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ mli, *

english_verse: Such people claim to know God, but their actions prove they really don't. They are disgusting. They won't obey God, and they are too worthless to do anything good.
translation_verse: Ame̱kē̱ ake̱ ame̱le Nyoṅmo̱, ši ame̱ke̱ ame̱nitšumo̱i kwaäle̱, ni ame̱dši gbomei ni ahĩo̱, ke̱ toigbolo̱i, mei ni ehĩĩ hãã nitšumo̱ kpakpa ko kwrā.

english_verse: Use clean language that no one can criticize. Do this, and your enemies will be too ashamed to say anything against you.
translation_verse: wiemo̱ kpakpa ni anáṅ he sane ko atã, beni afe ni moni ke̱wo̱ yee le hīe agbo, edšake̱ ebe̱ wo̱he nõša ko kē̱mo̱.

english_verse: Tell slaves always to please their owners by obeying them in everything. Slaves must not talk back to their owners
translation_verse: Tšũdši le̱, ake̱ ame̱ba ame̱he ši ame̱hã ame̱nuṅtšo̱mei le̱, ame̱sa ame̱hīe ye̱ nibii fẽ mli, ame̱kadšie sane nā, Ef.

english_verse: God has shown us undeserved grace by coming to save all people.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ dromo̱ ni ake̱hereo̱ gbomei fẽ yiwala le̱ epue,

english_verse: We are filled with hope, as we wait for the glorious return of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: ni *we̱kwe̱ Nyoṅme̱ kpeteṅkple le̱ ke̱ wo̱yiwalaherelo̱ Iesu Kristo dšō̱mo̱-no̱hĩekāmo̱ le̱ ke̱ enumnyam le puemo̱ le̱ gbe̱; *

english_verse: He gave himself to rescue us from everything evil and to make our hearts pure. He wanted us to be his own people and to be eager to do right.
translation_verse: moni ṅō *le̱dientše̱ ehe ehã ye̱ wo̱nãdšiaṅ, koni ekpõwo̱ ke̱dše̱ no̱tōmo̱ fẽ mli, ni etšū wo̱he efe le̱dientše̱ emaṅ kro̱ṅṅ ni hīe do̱ö̱ ye †nitšumo̱i kpakpai ahe le̱. *Gal.

english_verse: Teach these things, as you use your full authority to encourage and correct people. Make sure you earn everyone's respect.
translation_verse: Nii ne̱ owie, ni owoame̱ ṅā ye̱ he, ni okã ame̱hīe ye̱ he ke̱ hewale̱ fẽ. *Kāhã moko mīgbe ohe guo̱. *

english_verse: This message is certainly true. These teachings are useful and helpful for everyone. I want you to insist that the people follow them, so that all who have faith in God will be sure to do good deeds.
translation_verse: Ano̱kwa wiemo̱ ne̱; ni ne̱ke̱ nii ne̱ ano̱ mī mitaoo̱ ake̱ omã, koni mei ni ehe Nyoṅmo̱ no̱ eye le̱ adſẽṅ no̱, ni *ame̱bo̱ nitšumo̱i kpakpai ahe mo̱deṅ. Ene̱mei dši nii ni yo̱ fe̱o ni hī hã gbomei. *K.

english_verse: But don't have anything to do with stupid arguments about ancestors. And stay away from disagreements and quarrels about the Law of Moses. Such arguments are useless and senseless.
translation_verse: Ši kwašiai-aṅwanedšēi ke̱ weku-šišitšõmo̱i ke̱ bēi ke̱ mla he nõmo̱i le, tši ohe ke̱-dše̱ he, edšake̱ ehe be̱ se̱-námo̱ ni edšee fē̱i hũ.

english_verse: You know their minds are twisted, and their own sins show how guilty they are. Personal Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: edšake̱ ole ake̱ moko ni yo̱ nakai le̱, edše eṅe̱le̱no̱ ni efeo̱ eša, ni eke̱-abu le̱dientše̱ ehe fo̱.

english_verse: When Zenas the lawyer and Apollos get ready to leave, help them as much as you can, so they won't have need of anything.
translation_verse: Bo̱ mo̱deṅ owo Zena, mlatšõlo̱ le̱, ke̱ *Apolo gbe̱ dšogbãṅ ni nokonoko akaſe̱ame̱. *Bo̱f.

english_verse: Greetings to you from everyone here. Greet all of our friends who share in our faith. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Mei ni ke̱mi yo̱ le̱ fẽ mībio. Wo̱mībi mei ni snmoo̱we̱ ye̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli mli le̱. Dromo̱ le̱ ke̱ nyefẽ ahĩ ši! Amen.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Philemon's Love and Faith
translation_verse: Dromo̱ ke̱ hedšo̱le̱ ní dše̱ wo̱tše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ke̱ Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo le̱ deṅ ahānye! Rom.

english_verse: I hear about your faith in our Lord Jesus and about your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: ake̱-ni minuo̱ osuomo̱ ke̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli ni ohīe ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu ke̱ mei-kroṅkroṅi le̱ fē agbe̱fãṅ le̱ he le̱;

english_verse: Christ gives me the courage to tell you what to do.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, tše̱ miye̱ ekā̃ pī ye̱ Kristo mli ni mike̱-awoö kitã ye̱ noni sa hewo̱,

english_verse: Before this, he was useless to you, but now he is useful both to you and to me.
translation_verse: moni sá le̱ ehe be̱ se̱námo̱ ko hão, ši agbe̱ne̱ le̱ ehe ye̱ se̱námo̱ ba mike̱o fẽ dšogbāṅ, ni mihã ekpale ke̱-baä oṅõ ne̱.

english_verse: I would like to keep him here with me, where he could take your place in helping me while I am here in prison for preaching the good news.
translation_verse: moni kũle̱ mĩsumo̱ ake̱ eke̱mi ahī ši, *koni esúmo̱mi ye̱ onãdšiaṅ ye̱ sanekpakpa le̱ kpãi le amli; *Fil

english_verse: Perhaps Onesimus was taken from you for a little while so you could have him back for good,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ene̱ hewo̱ ni ekole̱ ãgbla nyemli fiō, koni agbe̱ne̱ onále̱ dā,

english_verse: but not as a slave. Onesimus is much more than a slave. To me he is a dear friend, but to you he is even more, both as a person and as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: dšee ake̱ tšũlo̱ doṅṅ, ši moṅ moni fé tšũlo̱ tete, moni dši suomo̱nyemi, ni dši minõ titri, ši bo moṅ onõṅ āhũ ye̱ helo ke̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ gbe̱fãṅ fẽ,

english_verse: If you consider me a friend because of Christ, then welcome Onesimus as you would welcome me.
translation_verse: Hewo̱ le̱ agbe̱ne̱, ké̱ obuo̱mi ake̱ onanyo le̱, heremo̱le̱ tamo̱ midientše̱.

english_verse: If he has cheated you or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
translation_verse: Ši ke̱dši eyeo sane fõṅ ko alo ehĩeo nyōmo̱ ko le̱, no le̱ bū nakai akontā le ohãmi.

english_verse: With my own hand I write: I, PAUL, WILL PAY YOU BACK. But don't forget you owe me your life.
translation_verse: Mi, Paulo, miṅmã ke̱ midientše̱ minine ake̱, mawo; koni mikakē̱o ake̱ ohĩemi bodientše̱ oyi nyõmo̱ tete.

english_verse: My dear friend and follower of Christ our Lord, please cheer me up by doing this for me.
translation_verse: Hē, anyemi, hā maná ohe se̱ ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ mli; *hã mitšui anyõ mimli ye̱ Kristo mli. *K.

english_verse: I am sure you will do all I have asked, and even more.
translation_verse: Ake̱-ni mihĩe kã ono̱ ake̱ oobomi toi hewo̱ miṅmão ne̱, edšake̱ mile ake̱ oofe fẽ beni mikē̱o̱ ne̱ tete.

english_verse: Please get a room ready for me. I hope your prayers will be answered, and I can visit you.
translation_verse: Ši asaṅ sāmo̱ heko otomi; edšake̱ mihĩe kã no̱ ake̱ aatšõ nyeso̱lemo̱i le̱ ano̱ ake̱mi *aakenye. *Fil

english_verse: Epaphras is also here in jail for being a follower of Christ Jesus. He sends his greetings,
translation_verse: *Epafra, moni dši minanyo gbokle̱fonyo ye̱ Kristo Iesu mli le̱, mībio, *Kol.

english_verse: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, who work together with me.
translation_verse: ke̱ Marko hũ ke̱ Aristarko ke̱ Dema ke̱ Luka, mei ni dši minanemei nitšulo̱i le̱. Kol.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo dromo̱ le̱ ke̱ nyemumo̱ le̱ ahĩ ši! Amen

english_verse: God's Son has all the brightness of God's own glory and is like him in every way. By his own mighty word, he holds the universe together. After the Son had washed away our sins, he sat down at the right side of the glorious God in heaven.
translation_verse: mo noṅṅ ní dši enumnyam le̱ kpe̱mo̱ ke̱ esu le̱ *heno̱ le̱ ni eke̱ le̱dientše̱ ehewale wiemo le̱ hĩeo̱ nibii fẽ le̱, beni eṅõ le̱dientše̱ ehe efe wohe ešai le̱ †ahetšūmo̱ le̱, ete **eyatá ši ye̱ anumnyamtše̱ agbo le̱ ninedšŭrõ no ye̱ ṅwei, *

english_verse: God has never said to any of the angels, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!” Neither has God said to any of them, “I will be his Father, and he will be my Son!”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ bo̱foi le̱ ateṅ namo ni ekē̱le̱ pēn ake̱: *“Mibi dšio: nme̱ne̱ mifo̱o”? ni asaṅ: †“Matšṍ etše, ni le̱ hũ eetšṍ mibi”? *Lal.

english_verse: When God brings his first-born Son into the world, he commands all of his angels to worship him.
translation_verse: Ni beni eke̱ *kromo̱bi le̱ aaba dše ne̱ mli ekoṅ le̱, eke̱: †“Hà Nyoṅmo̱ bo̱foi fè adšále̱.” *Rom

english_verse: You loved justice and hated evil, and so I, your God, have chosen you. I appointed you and made you happier than any of your friends.”
translation_verse: osumoo̱ dšale̱ ni onye̱o̱ efõṅ-femo̱; hewo le̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ní dši o-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ke̱ mliflimo̱ mũ le̱ efo̱o fè onanemei le̱.”

english_verse: You will roll them up like a robe and change them like a garment. But you are always the same, and you will live forever.”
translation_verse: ni ookotaame̱ tamo̱ mama, ni ame̱atšake; ši bo le̱, oye bo̱ni oyo̱ le̱ noṅṅ, ni ofii le̱ etãã.”

english_verse: God never said to any of the angels, “Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you!”
translation_verse: Ši ṅweibo̱foi le̱ ateṅ namo po ni eke ye̱ ehewo̱ pẽṅ ake̱: *“Tá mininedšŭrõ no̱ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní maṅõ ohenye̱lo̱i le̱ mafe onãdšiaši-mãṅō?” *Lal

english_verse: Angels are merely spirits sent to serve people who are going to be saved.
translation_verse: Ani amefẽ le̱, dšee mumo̱i ni *súmoo̱ dsiame̱, ní mei ni batšṍmo̱ yiwalaheremo̱ le̱ yelo̱i le̱ †asúomo̱ hewo̱ atšũo̱ame̱? *Dan.

english_verse: Somewhere in the Scriptures someone says to God, “What makes you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for weaklings such as we?
translation_verse: Ši moko ye odase faṅṅ ye̱ *heko ake: “Meni dši gbomo ádesã ni okaio̱le̱? alo gbomo bi hũ, ni ohĩe kãa ehe ne̱? *Lal

english_verse: Jesus and the people he makes holy all belong to the same family. This is why he isn't ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ moni tšūo̱ mei ahe le̱ ke̱ mei ní atšūo̱ amehe le̱ fẽ dše̱ mokome mli, no hewo̱ dše̱ ni ehĩe gboo ake eetšé̱ame̱ *nyemimei le̱, *Mar

english_verse: He also said, “I will trust God.” Then he said, “Here I am with the children God has given me.”
translation_verse: Ni asaṅ: *“Maṅõ mihĩe mafõ eno̱.” Ni asaṅ: †“Nami, ke̱ bii ni Nyoṅmo̱ eṅõ-hãmi le̱.” *Ies.

english_verse: We are people of flesh and blood. This is why Jesus became one of us. He died to destroy the devil, who had power over death.
translation_verse: Nohewo le̱ ake̱-ní bii le̱ hĩe helo ke̱ lá hewo̱ le̱, le̱ hũ eṅõ no noṅṅ eko *tamo̱ame̱, koni etšṍ gbĕle no̱ ekpãtã moni yo̱ gbĕle no̱ †hewale̱ ní dši abonsam le̱ hĩe, *K.

english_verse: Jesus clearly did not come to help angels, but he did come to help Abraham's descendants.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ le̱le̱ṅ, dšee ṅweibo̱foi eyeo ebuaä, ši moṅ Abraham sešibii eyeo̱ ebuaä;

english_verse: He had to be one of us, so he could serve God as our merciful and faithful high priest and sacrifice himself for the forgiveness of our sins.
translation_verse: nohewo̱ le̱ nibii fẽ gbe̱fãṅ le̱ esa ake̱ *etamo̱ enyemimei le̱, koni etšṍ mo̱bo̱nalo̱ ke̱ ano̱kwa oso̱fonukpa ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe, koni ekpa maṅ le̱ yi musu. *Fil.

english_verse: And now that Jesus has suffered and was tempted, he can help anyone else who is tempted.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ake̱-ní le̱dientše̱ le̱ ena amanehũlũ ni akale̱ hewo̱ le̱, enyẽo̱ eyeo̱ ebuaä mei ní akaäarne̱ le̱.

english_verse: But Jesus deserves more honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house deserves more honor than the house.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ tamo̱ bo̱ni moni mã šĩa ko le̱ wō fá fè šĩa le̱ nõ le̱, nakai noṅṅ le̱ hũ ehĩe yo̱ nyam fè Mose.

english_verse: don't be stubborn! Don't rebel like those people who were tested in the desert. *
translation_verse: nyekawadšea nyetšuii, take̱ bo̱ni afe ye̱ mlilawō le̱ mli, ye̱ nātšõgbĩ le̱ no̱, ye̱ ṅã le̱ ṅo̱ le̱,

english_verse: For forty years your ancestors tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: heni nyetše̱mei le̱ tšõ̀ minā, ní ame̱kami, ni ame̱na minitšumo̱i le̱ afii nyoṅmai-edſe̱ so̱ṅṅ ye̱ le̱.

english_verse: My friends, watch out! Don't let evil thoughts or doubts make any of you turn from the living God.
translation_verse: Nyekwe̱a ní ahĩa, anyemimei, koni nyeteṅ moko akahĩ tšui fõṅ ní hee yee ni ekpale ke̱-dše̱ Nyoṅmo̱, hĩekãlo̱ le̱, he;

english_verse: You must encourage one another each day. And you must keep on while there is still a time that can be called “today.” If you don't, then sin may fool some of you and make you stubborn.
translation_verse: ši moṅ *nyewiea nyetšõtšõa nyehe gbĩ-fẽ-gbĩ ní atšé̱ole̱ ṅme̱ne̱ le̱, koni ake̱ esa šišiumo̱ le̱ akawadše nyeteṅ moko. *

english_verse: We were sure about Christ when we first became his people. So let's hold tightly to our faith until the end.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Kristo hefatalo̱i wo̱tšṍmo̱, ke̱dši wo̱hĩe wo̱he ní wo̱ṅõ-fõo̱ eno̱ ke̱-dše̱ šišidšē le̱ mli *kpẽṅṅ ke̱-yaši nāgbē le̱. *

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn like those who rebelled.”
translation_verse: Ni akē̱ ake̱: *“Nme̱ne̱, ke̱dši nyenu egbē le̱, nyekawadšea nyetšui, take̱ bo̱ni afe ye̱ mlilawō le̱ mli” le̱; *K.

english_verse: Who were those people that heard God's voice and rebelled? Weren't they the same ones that came out of Egypt with Moses?
translation_verse: bĕle̱ mei ní nu le̱ ateṅ namei wo emli la le̱? ani dšee mei ní ke̱ Mose dše Mizraim le̱ fẽ ni?

english_verse: And who did God say would never enter his place of rest? Weren't they the ones that disobeyed him?
translation_verse: Ni namei ano̱ *ekã kitã efõ ake̱ ame̱boteṅ ehedšō̱mo̱ le̱ mli le̱? ani, dšee mei ní toi gbo le̱? *K.

english_verse: We see that those people did not enter the place of rest because they did not have faith.
translation_verse: Ni wo̱naā ake̱ hé ní ame̱hee ame̱yee le̱ hewo̱ ame̱nyẽẽ mli ame̱bote le̱.

english_verse: On that day God's people will rest from their work, just as God rested from his work.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ moni ebote ehedšō̱mo̱ le̱ mli le̱, le̱dientše̱ hũ *edšō̱ ehe ke̱-dše̱ enitšumo̱i le̱ amli, take̱ bo̱ni Nyoṅmo̱ dšō̱ ehe ke̱-dše̱ enõ le̱ mli le̱. *Kpods.

english_verse: God's word is alive and powerful! It is sharper than any double-edged sword. His word can cut through our spirits and souls and through our joints and marrow, until it discovers the desires and thoughts of our hearts.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ wiemo̱ hĩe kã ni eye hewale̱ ni enā ba fè klante ke̱ enā nta fẽ, ni egbuo̱ ke̱-boteo̱ mli ke̱-yaši beyino ní egblaä susuma ke̱ mumo̱ le̱ ke̱ talo̱i ke̱ wuiaṅfo̱i le̱ amli, ni edši tšuiiaṅ susumo̱i ke̱ dſẽṅmo̱i le̱ akodšolo̱: Ier.

english_verse: Nothing is hidden from God! He sees through everything, and we will have to tell him the truth. Jesus Is the Great High Priest
translation_verse: ni atēē bō̱nõ ko ye̱ ehĩe, ši nibii fẽ ye̱ faṅṅ ni agble no ye̱ le̱ moni wo̱-ke̱-yo̱ sane le̱ hĩṅme̱iiaṅ.

english_verse: We have a great high priest, who has gone into heaven, and he is Jesus the Son of God. This is why we must hold on to what we have said about him.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱, ake̱ noni *wo̱yo̱ oso̱fonukpa kpeteṅkple, ni efoṅ ke̱-tšṍ ṅweiiaṅ, ní dši Iesu, Nyoṅmo̱ bi le̱ ne̱, nyehãa womõa dšadšemo̱ le̱ mli ní awaä. *

english_verse: Jesus understands every weakness of ours, because he was tempted in every way that we are. But he did not sin!
translation_verse: Edšake̱ wo̱so̱fonukpa ni wo̱yo̱ le̱ edšee moni *nyẽẽ anu wo̱gbede-mo̱i le̱ ahe ahãwo̱, ši edši moko ní akale̱ ye̱ nibii fẽ gbe̱fäṅ tamo̱wo̱ ní kẽle̱ eša-ko-eša-ko be̱ ehe. *

english_verse: So whenever we are in need, we should come bravely before the throne of our merciful God. There we will be treated with undeserved grace, and we will find help.
translation_verse: Hewo le̱ nyehãa *wo̱ke̱ ekã atšia abe̱ṅke̱a †dromo̱ sẽi le̱, koni wo̱nine aše̱ mo̱bo̱nale̱ no̱ ni wo̱ná dromo̱ ní aaye abuawo̱ ye̱ be ní sa mli. *

english_verse: In another place, God says, “You are a priest forever just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Take̱ bo̱ noṅṅ ní ekē̱ ye̱ hekroko hũ ake̱: *“Oso̱fo dšio ke̱-mīya nāno̱ ye̱ Melkizedek gbe̱dšiano le nā.” *Lal.

english_verse: God had the power to save Jesus from death. And while Jesus was on earth, he begged God with loud crying and tears to save him. He truly worshiped God, and God listened to his prayers.
translation_verse: Mo hũ ní ehelo gbĩĩ le̱ amli le̱ eṅõ so̱lemo̱i ke̱ faikpamo̱i ní blo̱mo̱ ní nā wa ke̱ yāfónui fata he *ešā afole ehã moni yo̱ hewale̱ ní eke̱-aherele̱ ke̱-adše̱ gbĕle mli le̱, ni abole̱ toi hũ, edšake̱ ebuo̱ Nyoṅmo̱; *Mat.

english_verse: Suffering made Jesus perfect, and now he can save forever all who obey him.
translation_verse: ni ake̱-ní *ehĩ ke̱-wula ši hewo le̱, etšṍ mo mli ní nāno̱ yiwalaheremo̱ dše̱o̱ eha mei fẽ ni boo̱le̱ toi le, *Ioh.

english_verse: Much more could be said about this subject. But it is hard to explain, and all of you are slow to understand.
translation_verse: Wo̱ye̱ wiemo̱i pī ni wo̱o̱wie ye̱ nohewo, ni ešĩšitšõmo̱ hũ wa, edšake̱ nyetoii esa;

english_verse: By now you should have been teachers, but once again you need to be taught the simplest things about what God has said. You need milk instead of solid food.
translation_verse: edšake̱ nye ní kũle̱ esa ake̱ nyetšṍmo̱ tšõlo̱i moṅ ye̱ be le̱ nā le̱, ehĩa ake̱ atšõnye Nyoṅmo̱ wiemo̱i le̱ amli šišidšē nibii le̱ ekoṅ, ni nyetšṍmo̱ mei ni *fufo̱ ehĩaame̱, ni dšee niyenii kpakpa. *

english_verse: People who live on milk are like babies who don't really know what is right.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mofẽmo ní yeo̱ fufo̱ le̱, ekpako dšale̱ wiemo̱ le̱ ši; edšake̱ *fufo̱ō dšile̱. Ef.

english_verse: Solid food is for mature people who have been trained to know right from wrong.
translation_verse: Ši mei ní edăra le̱ anõ dši niyenii kpakpa, mei ní fo̱ ni ame̱fo̱ö̱ femo̱ le̱ ehã ame̱henumo̱nii le̱ *ele ekpakpa ke̱ efōṅ mlikpamo̱. *Fil.

english_verse: A field is useful to farmers, if there is enough rain to make good crops grow. In fact, God will bless such a field.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ šikpoṅ ní mĩo̱ nu ní ne̱o̱ fieo̱ eno kpitiokpitio ni ebaä nii ní hĩ hã mei ní hũo̱ no̱ le̱, enáa Nyoṅmo̱ dšō̱mo̱ le̱ eko;

english_verse: But land that produces only thornbushes is worthless. It is likely to fall under God's curse, and in the end it will be set on fire.
translation_verse: ši ké̱ ṅmeii ke̱ aṅle̱ṅle̱ ekwẽo̱ le̱, akwáale̱, ni ebe̱ṅke̱ lōmo̱, ni enāgbē dši šã.

english_verse: My friends, we are talking this way. But we are sure that you are doing those really good things people do when they are being saved.
translation_verse: Ši wo̱suomo̱mei, tše̱ wo̱mīkē̱ ne̱ke̱ moṅ, ši kẽle̱ wo̱hĩe kã nyeno ake̱ nyesãdši hĩ fè nakai, ni yiwalaheremo̱ aanyie se̱.

english_verse: Then you would never be lazy. You would be following the example of those who had faith and were patient until God kept his promise to them. God's Promise Is Sure
translation_verse: koni nyekafe kpo̱kē, ši moṅ nyeko̱ mei ni tšṍo̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli ke̱ tšuišitō no̱ náa šiwōi le̱ anane.

english_verse: No one is greater than God. So he made a promise in his own name when he said to Abraham,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ beni Nyoṅmo̱ wo Abraham ši le̱, ake̱-ní ebe̱ moko ní fè le̱dientše̱ ní eekãle̱ kitã hewo̱ le̱, *ekã le̱dientše̱ ehe kitã, *

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will bless you with many descendants!”
translation_verse: ekē̱: “Le̱le̱ṅ, dsō̱mo̱ madšō̱o ni fá hũ mahã oseši afá.”

english_verse: Then after Abraham had been very patient, he was given what God had promised.
translation_verse: Ni ake̱-ní eto etšui ši hewo̱ le, enine še̱ šiwō le̱ no̱.

english_verse: When anyone wants to settle an argument, they make a vow by using the name of someone or something greater than themselves.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ gbomei yo̱ ne̱, moni fèame̱ le̱, le̱ kitã ame̱kãa, ni ame̱ṅwanedšē fẽ nāgbē dši *kitãkãmo̱ ní ake̱-mãa sane no̱ aduatšo̱ le̱. *

english_verse: So when God wanted to prove for certain his promise to his people could not be broken, he made a vow.
translation_verse: No hewo̱ hũ ni, beni Nyoṅmo̱ tao ake̱ etšṍ šiwō le̱ yelo̱i le̱ ake̱ eyiṅtō le̱ tšakee kwrā le̱, eke̱ kitã damo mli;

english_verse: God cannot tell lies! And so his promises and vows are two things that can never be changed. We have run to God for safety. Now his promises should greatly encourage us to take hold of the hope that is right in front of us.
translation_verse: koni wo̱tšṍ sãdši enyo̱ ní tšakee ní Nyoṅmo̱ nyẽṅ emale ye̱ mli le̱ ano̱, wo̱ná mīše̱dšemo̱ ní wa, ní wo̱ mei ní wo̱yaba abo le̱ wo̱ke̱-mõ no̱hĩekãmo̱ ní kã wo̱hïe le̱ mli;

english_verse: This hope is like a firm and steady anchor for our souls. In fact, hope reaches behind the curtain and into the most holy place.
translation_verse: noni wo̱hĩe tamo̱ wo̱susuma se̱ke̱ ni tšee ni efĩ ši šiṅṅ ní ebote mli ke̱-te muhō̱ le̱ se̱ tō̃,

english_verse: Jesus has gone there ahead of us, and he is our high priest forever, just like Melchizedek.
translation_verse: heni hĩenyielo̱ le̱ ní dši Iesu, moni tšṍ *nāno̱-oso̱fonukpa ye̱ Melkizedek gbe̱dšiano̱ le̱ nā le̱, bote hãwo̱ le̱, *

english_verse: Everyone agrees a person who gives a blessing is greater than the one who receives the blessing.
translation_verse: Ši ebe̱ ṅwanedšē ko kwrā ake̱, moni da fè mo le̱, le̱ edšō̱o̱ moni edaa le̱.

english_verse: The person we are talking about is our Lord, who came from a tribe that had never had anyone to serve as a priest at the altar.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ mo he ní ekē̱ nii ne̱ ye̱ le̱, edši akutšo-kroko-mlinyo, nõ mli ní moko dše̱ko ebatšuko afo̱lešālate̱ le̱ he nii pẽṅ;

english_verse: The Scriptures say about him, “You are a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ eye odase ake̱: *“Oso̱fo dšio ke̱-mīya nāno̱ ye̱ Melkizedek gbe̱dšiano̱ le̱ nā.” *Lal.

english_verse: In this way a weak and useless command was put aside,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ kitã ní tšṍ hĩe le̱, ake̱-ní ebe̱ hewale̱ ni ehe be̱ se̱námo̱ ko hewo̱ le̱ agu,

english_verse: because the Law cannot make anything perfect. At the same time, we are given a much better hope, and it can bring us close to God.
translation_verse: edšake̱ mla le̱ *hãã nokonoko aye emū, ši ake̱ no̱hĩekãmo̱ ní hĩ fè no ní wo̱ke̱-be̱ṅke̱o̱ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ba dšeṅ. *

english_verse: God himself made a promise when this priest was appointed. But he did not make a promise like this when the other priests were appointed. The promise he made is, “I, the Lord, promise that you will be a priest forever! And I will never change my mind!”
translation_verse: ši mone̱ le̱, kitãkãmo̱ ake̱-wole̱, ye̱ moni kē̱le̱ ake̱: *“Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ ekã kitã ni eſaṅ ehe, ake̱: Oso̱fo dšio ke̱-mīya nāno̱ ye̱ Melkizedek gbe̱dšiano̱ le̱ nā,” le̱ hewo̱: *Lal.
