english_verse: This means that Jesus guarantees us a better agreement with God.
translation_verse: — babaō ní kpãṅmo̱ ní Iesu damo mli le̱ hi fẽ no dši no.

english_verse: There have been a lot of other priests, and all of them have died.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ le̱, ake̱-ní gbĕle hãã ame̱wo šihĩle̱ hewo̱ le̱, ame̱yi pī ame̱ye oso̱foi;

english_verse: But Jesus will never die, and so he will be a priest forever!
translation_verse: ši mone̱ le̱, ake̱ noni ehĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä nāno̱ hewo̱ le̱, eso̱foyeli le̱ se̱ efoo.

english_verse: He is forever able to save the people he leads to God, because he always lives to speak to God for them.
translation_verse: Nohewo hũ le̱ enyẽo̱ mei ní tšṍo̱ eno̱ ke̱-baä Nyoṅmo̱ ṅõ le̱ ayiwala ehereo̱ kwrā, edšake̱ eye dā koni edamo̱ mli ehãame̱. Rom.

english_verse: Jesus is the high priest we need. He is holy and innocent and faultless, and not at all like us sinners. Jesus is honored above all beings in heaven,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ oso̱fonukpa ní sawo̱ pe̱ ne̱: moni he tše, ní efõṅ ko be̱ ehe, ni ehé be̱ kpa ko, ní etše ehe ke̱-dše̱ ešafelo̱i ahe, ní awo eno̱ ahā ekwo̱ fè ṅweii; *

english_verse: and he is better than any other high priest. Jesus doesn't need to offer sacrifices each day for his own sins and then for the sins of the people. He offered a sacrifice once for all, when he gave himself.
translation_verse: moni ehĩaale̱, *tamo̱ nakai oso̱fonukpai le̱, ake̱ gbĩ-fē-gbĩ le̱ ešã le̱dientše̱ ehe ešai ahe afo̱le tšutšu, dāni ešã maṅ le̱ hũ nõ; edšake̱ efe ene̱ ši kome nyoṅlo, beni eṅō le̱dientše̱ ehe ešã afo̱le le̱. *

english_verse: The Law appoints priests who have weaknesses. But God's promise, which came later than the Law, appoints his Son. And he is the perfect high priest forever.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *mla le̱, gbomei gbedelo̱i eṅõ-woo̱ oso̱fonukpai le̱, ši kitã ní akã ye̱ mla le̱ se̱ le̱ he wiemo̱ le̱ ewo bi ni eye emū ke̱-yaä nāno̱ le [oso̱fonukpa]. *

english_verse: If the first agreement with God had been all right, there would not have been any need for another one.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ edši tšutšunõ le̱ hĩ ke̱-wula ši kũle̱, ataoo gbe̱ ahãã noni dši enyo̱ le̱.

english_verse: But the Lord found fault with it and said, “I tell you the time will come, when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ eſaame̱ ekē̱: *“Na, gbĩĩ miba, Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ kē̱, ní mike̱ Israel we le̱ ke̱ Iuda we le̱ aakpãṅ kpãṅmo hē ko, *Ier.

english_verse: It won't be like the agreement that I made with their ancestors, when I took them by the hand and led them out of Egypt. They broke their agreement with me, and I stopped caring about them!
translation_verse: dšee tamo̱ kpãṅmo̱ ní *mike̱ ame̱ tše̱mei le̱ kpãṅ gbĩ no̱ ni mimõ ame̱nine mli ni mike̱ame̱ dše Mizraim Sikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱, — edšake̱ ame̱yee mikpãṅmo̱ le̱ no̱, ni mi hũ midſẽṅṅ ame̱no̱, Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ kē̱. *

english_verse: Not one of them will have to teach another to know me, their Lord.’ “All of them will know me, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱teṅ moko etšõṅ emaṅnyo alo enyemi doṅṅ ake̱: Le Nuṅtšo̱ le̱. Edšake̱ ame̱fẽ ame̱alemi, ke̱-adše̱ ame̱teṅ mo-bibiō no̱ ke̱-yaši mo-wulu no̱.

english_verse: I will treat them with kindness, even though they are wicked. I will forget their sins.”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ manaame̱ mo̱bo̱ ye̱ ame̱no̱tõmoi le̱ agbe̱fãṅ, ni amehe ešai le̱ hũ mikaii doṅṅ.”

english_verse: When the Lord talks about a new agreement, he means that the first one is out of date. And anything that is old and useless will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Noni ekē̱ ake̱ “ehē” ne̱, eke̱-fe kleṅkleṅnõ le̱ emomo. Ši noni etšṍ emomo ke̱ noni egbo̱ le̱, etše̱ṅ ni eelādše. Rom.

english_verse: According to the Law of Moses, those people who become unclean are not fit to worship God. Yet they will be considered clean, if they are sprinkled with the blood of goats and bulls and with the ashes of a sacrificed calf.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ké̱ *tšinai ke̱ tōkpakpoi alá ke̱ tšinayō †lamlu ní atšo̱ö̱ aſãa mei ní ebule ame̱he le̱ ano̱ le̱ tšūo̱ ame̱he ni ame̱he tšeo̱ ye̱ helo gbe̱fãṅ le̱: *

english_verse: Blood was also used to put the first agreement into effect.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ ni kleṅkleṅnõ le̱ hũ, ašii lá awoo le̱.

english_verse: He told the people, “With this blood God makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: ekē̱: *“Na, kpãṅmo̱ le̱ ni Nyoṅmo̱ wonye he kitã le̱ lá le̱ ne̱.” *

english_verse: Moses also sprinkled blood on the tent and on everything else used in worship.
translation_verse: Ni bū le̱ hũ ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱-dšámo̱ he nii le fẽ le, eke̱ *lá le̱ ſãa no nakai noṅṅ. *

english_verse: The Law says that almost everything must be sprinkled with blood, and no sins can be forgiven unless blood is offered. Christ's Great Sacrifice
translation_verse: Ni *ſe̱ fiō ni lá aṅõ-tšūo̱ nii fẽ he ye̱ mla le nā; ni †ké̱ aſiee lá ši le̱, aṅõ-faa. *

english_verse: These things are only copies of what is in heaven, and so they had to be made holy by these ceremonies. But the real things in heaven must be made holy by something better.
translation_verse: Bĕle̱ ehĩa ake̱, nii ni dši ṅweinii le̱ *aheno̱i ne̱, ake̱ ene̱mei atšū he; ši ṅweinii le̱ dientše̱ le̱, afo̱lei ni hĩ fè nomei ake̱tšūo̱ he. *

english_verse: This is why Christ did not go into a tent made by humans and was only a copy of the real one. Instead, he went into heaven and is now there with God to help us.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ *dšee hekroṅkroṅ ni ake̱ nidši fe ní dši nii le̱ dientše̱ le̱ aheno̱ ke̱ke̱ le̱ mli Kristo yabote le̱; ši moṅ ṅwei dientše̱ eyabote, koni agbe̱ne̱ †eyapue ye Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe ehãwo. *K.

english_verse: Christ did not have to offer himself many times. He wasn't like a high priest who goes into the most holy place each year to offer the blood of an animal.
translation_verse: Asaṅ eyabotee dše̱i koni eṅõ ehe ehã dādā, tamo̱ bo̱ni oso̱fonukpa le̱ ya-boteo̱ hekroṅkroṅ le̱ dā afi ke̱ lá ní dšee le̱dientše̱ enõ le̱;

english_verse: If he had offered himself every year, he would have suffered many times since the creation of the world. But instead, near the end of time he offered himself once and for all, so he could be a sacrifice that does away with sin.
translation_verse: edšake̱ ke̱dši nakai le̱, kũle̱ sa ake̱ ena amanehũlũ kpitiokpitio ke̱-dše̱ dšeṅ šišidšē bēbe; ši agbe̱ne̱ le̱, *šĩkome ke̱ke̱ adšiele̱ kpo †ye̱ dšeṅbei le̱ anāgbē le̱ mli, koni eke̱ le̱dientše̱ ehe ni eke̱-šā afo̱le le̱ adšie eša le. *K.

english_verse: We die only once, and then we are judged.
translation_verse: Ni *gbĩĩ abo̱ ní ekã ši ehã gbomei ake̱ šikome ame̱gboio̱, ši no se̱ le̱ abakodšoame̱ le̱: *

english_verse: So Christ died only once to take away the sins of many people. But when he comes again, it will not be to take away sin. He will come to save everyone who is waiting for him.
translation_verse: nakai noṅṅ *Kristo hũ, noni aṅõle̱ ahã šikome, koni etĕre mei pī ahe ešai ke̱-ya le̱, noni dši ši enyo̱ le̱ eeši eša ebapue ehã mei ní kwe̱e̱le̱ gbe̱ le̱ ayiwalaheremo̱. *

english_verse: Then Christ said, “And so, my God, I have come to do what you want, as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: No ni mikē̱: Na, miba, aṅmã mihe sane ye̱ wolokpo le̱ mli, ní mibafe bo, Nyoṅmo̱, osuomo̱nānii le̱.”

english_verse: The priests do their work each day, and they keep on offering sacrifices that can never take away sins.
translation_verse: Ni oso̱fo-fē-oso̱fo le̱, *gbĩ-fẽ-gbĩ le̱ edamoo̱ ši esúmoo̱, ni ešãa nakai afo̱lei le̱ noṅṅ kpitiokpitio, nii ni †nyẽẽ ešai adšie gbĩkogbĩko le̱; *

english_verse: When sins are forgiven, there is no more need to offer sacrifices. Encouragement and Warning
translation_verse: Ni heni ake̱ ene̱mei efa ye̱ le̱, ešai ahe afo̱le-šā̃ ko be̱ doṅṅ.

english_verse: So let's come near God with pure hearts and a confidence that comes from having faith. Let's keep our hearts pure, our consciences free from evil, and our bodies washed with clean water.
translation_verse: *nyehāa wo̱ke̱ ano̱kwa tšui ababe̱ṅke̱a ye̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli ni wo̱-yo̱ hewale̱ ye̱ no̱ le̱ mli, ke̱ tšui hũ ní atšū he ní ebe̱ henilē fõṅ ko doṅṅ, ke̱ gbomotšo ní †ake̱ nu ní mli tše edšu he, *

english_verse: We must hold tightly to the hope we say is ours. After all, we can trust the one who made the agreement with us.
translation_verse: ni nyehãa *wo̱mõa wo̱hĩeno̱kãmo̱ dšadšemo̱ le̱ mli ní awaä ní ekagbugbã, edšake̱ moni wo ši le̱ ano̱kwafo ni, *

english_verse: We should keep on encouraging each other to be thoughtful and to do helpful things.
translation_verse: ni nyehãa wo̱yo̱seyo̱sea wo̱he, koni wo̱hĩe ado̱ suomo̱ ke̱ nitšumo̱i kpakpai ahe,

english_verse: Some people have given up the habit of meeting for worship, but we must not do that. We should keep on encouraging each other, especially since you know that the day of the Lord's coming is getting closer.
translation_verse: ni wo̱kakwa wo̱he nābuamo̱, take̱ bo̱ni meikomei fo̱ö̱ femo̱ le̱, ši moṅ *wo̱-wowō wo̱he ṅā, ni titri le̱ ake̱-ní †nyenaä ake̱ gbĩ le̱ mībe̱ṅke̱ ne̱. *

english_verse: No sacrifices can be made for people who decide to sin after they find out about the truth.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ke̱ kwa wo̱kwaä wo̱feo̱ eša, beni wo̱ná ano̱kwale he nilē le̱ se̱ le̱, bĕle̱ ešai ahe afo̱le ko be̱ doṅṅ;

english_verse: They are God's enemies, and all they can look forward to is a terrible judgment and a furious fire.
translation_verse: ši kodšomo̱ gbe̱kwe̱mo̱ ní yo̱ gbeyei ke̱ke̱, ke̱ la grigri ní bašã henye̱lo̱i le̱.

english_verse: If two or more witnesses accused someone of breaking the Law of Moses, that person could be put to death.
translation_verse: Ké̱ moko kwa Mose mla le̱, anaale̱ mo̱bo̱, ši mei enyo̱ lo etẽ odaseyeli nä le̱ agbeo̱le̱;

english_verse: We know that God has said he will punish and take revenge. We also know that the Scriptures say the Lord will judge his people.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ wo̱le moni kē̱ ake̱: *“Minõ dši oweletō̱, mi mawo he nyõmo̱”. Ni asaṅ: “Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ aakodso le̱dientše̱ emaṅ le̱.” *

english_verse: It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living God!
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱ hĩekãlo̱ le̱ deṅ gbēmo̱ ye̱ gbeyei pam.

english_verse: Don't forget all the hard times you went through when you first received the light.
translation_verse: Ši nyekaia kleṅkleṅ gbĩĩ le̱, *beni la tšo ye̱ nyeno̱ le̱, bo̱ni nyemĩa nyehĩe ye̱ amanehũlũi ata babaō mli. *

english_verse: Sometimes you were abused and mistreated in public, and at other times you shared in the sufferings of others.
translation_verse: ni eko mli le̱ ake̱ dšé̱mo̱ ke̱ amanehũlũi so̱ṅṅ hã nyetšṍmo̱ *kwe̱mo̱nii, ni eko hũ nyetšṍmo̱ mei ni afeame̱ nakai le̱ ananemei; *

english_verse: You were kind to people in jail. And you gladly let your possessions be taken away, because you knew you had something better, something that would last forever.
translation_verse: edšake̱ nyemũsũṅ šãnye ye̱ mei ní awoame̱ gbokle̱i le̱ ahewo̱, ni nyenii ni aha le̱ hũ nyeke̱ mīše̱ kplẽ, ake̱-ni *nyele ake̱ nyeye̱ dſetri ní hĩ fè no āhũ ní hĩo̱ ši dā ye̱ ṅwei le̱. *Mat.

english_verse: Keep on being brave! It will bring you great rewards.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nyekaše̱a nyemli eka le nyefoa, edšake̱ eye̱ nyõmo̱wo kpeteṅkple.

english_verse: Learn to be patient, so you will please God and be given what he has promised.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ tšuisitō ehĩanye, koni, beni nyefe Nyoṅmo̱ suomo̱nānii le̱, nyenine aše̱ šiwō le̱ no̱. Luk.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “God is coming soon! It won't be very long.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ “fiō ke̱ke̱ eſe̱ ní moni baä le̱ aaba, ni etše̱ṅ kwrā; Hab

english_verse: The people God accepts will live because of their faith. But he isn't pleased with anyone who turns back.”
translation_verse: ši *dšalo̱ ni dše̱ hemo-ke̱-yeli mli le̱ yi aana wala; ni ké̱ ekpa ye̱ mise̱ le̱, misusuma náṅ ehe tšuidšŭrõ.” *Hab.

english_verse: We are not like those people who turn back and get destroyed. We will keep on having faith until we are saved.
translation_verse: Ši wo̱ le̱, dšee mei ní kpaleo̱ ke̱-yaä hīekpãtãmo̱ mli le̱ ateṅ meikomei dšiwo̱, ši moṅ wo̱dsi mei ní ke̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli náa ame̱susuma yiwalaheremo̱ le̱ ateṅ meikomei.

english_verse: Abraham had faith and obeyed God. He was told to go to the land that God had said would be his, and he left for a country he had never seen.
translation_verse: Hemo̱-ke̱-yeli Abraham ke̱-bo toi, beni atšé̱le̱ le̱, ní eyiṅ ete heni batsṍ eno̱yelinõ le̱, ni eyiṅ ete, tše̱ elee heni eyaa.

english_verse: because he was sure that God could raise people to life. This was just like getting Isaac back from death.
translation_verse: edšake̱ ebu ake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ye̱ hewale̱ ni eke̱-atele̱ ši ke̱-adše̱ gbohĩĩ ateṅ tete, ni le̱le̱ṅ, enine še̱ eno nakai ekoṅ. Rom.

english_verse: Moses knew that the treasures of Egypt were not as wonderful as what he would receive from suffering for the Messiah, and he looked forward to his reward.
translation_verse: ebuo̱ Kristo hewo̱ *ahorabō̱ le̱ ake̱ nii babaō fè Mizraim dſetrii le̱, edšake̱ †nyomo̱wo le̱ ekwe̱o̱. *

english_verse: Because of their faith, the people walked through the Red Sea on dry land. But when the Egyptians tried to do it, they were drowned.
translation_verse: Hemo̱-ke̱-yeli ame̱ke̱-fo Ṅšo̱-tšuru le̱ tamo̱ šikpoṅ gbĩṅ, noni Mizraimbii le̱ hũ ka femo̱, ni emī̃ame̱ le̱.

english_verse: God's people had faith, and when they had walked around the city of Jericho for seven days, its walls fell down.
translation_verse: Hemo̱-ke̱-yeli nā Ieriko gbogboi le̱ kũmo̱ gbē ši, beni abo̱lele̱ gbĩĩ kpawo le̱. Ios.

english_verse: Rahab had been a prostitute, but she had faith and welcomed the spies. So she wasn't killed with the people who disobeyed.
translation_verse: Hemo̱-ke̱-yeli hewo̱ Rahab, adſamaṅ le̱, plenēē efataa mei ní hee yee le̱ ahe le̱, edšake̱ ehere sralo̱i le̱ hedšo̱le̱ nā. Ios.

english_verse: What else can I say? There isn't enough time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets.
translation_verse: Ni meni makē̱ doṅṅ? Edšake̱ mináṅ mihe dekã bo̱ni mike̱-agba Gideon ke̱ Barak, Samson ke̱ Iefta, David ke̱ Samuel hũ, ke̱ gbalo̱i le̱ ahe sane: Kods.

english_verse: Their faith helped them conquer kingdoms, and because they did right, God made promises to them. They closed the jaws of lions
translation_verse: mei ní tšṍ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli no̱ ame̱ye maṅtše̱yelii ano̱ kũnim, ame̱tšu dšalenii, amenine še̱ šiwōi ano̱, *ame̱tšĩmo̱ dšatai anā, *Kods.

english_verse: and put out raging fires and escaped from the swords of their enemies. Although they were weak, they were given the strength and power to chase foreign armies away.
translation_verse: *ame̱gbe la hewale̱, ame̱dše klantei amli, ame̱ná hewale̱ ke̱-dše̱ gbedemo̱ mli, ame̱he wa ye̱ ta mli, ame̱wo meikpõdši ata le̱ foi. *Dan.

english_verse: Some women received their loved ones back from death. Many of these people were tortured, but they refused to be released. They were sure they would get a better reward when the dead are raised to life.
translation_verse: *Yei anine še̱ ame̱mei ní egboi le̱ ano̱ ekoṅ ke̱-tsṍ šitē no̱. Ši meikrokomei hũ, ake̱ pĩmo̱ gbeame̱, ni ame̱kplẽẽ kpõmo̱, koni amenine aše̱ šitē ni hĩ fè no le̱ no̱. *

english_verse: Others were made fun of and beaten with whips, and some were chained in jail.
translation_verse: Meikomei hũ aye ame̱he fe̱o ni ayiame̱ kplebii ni awoame̱ gbokle̱i ni awoame̱ tšũṅ; Ier.

english_verse: Still others were stoned to death or sawed in two or killed with swords. Some had nothing but sheep skins or goat skins to wear. They were poor, mistreated, and tortured.
translation_verse: *atſiaame̱ tei, ake̱ akplala gbla ame̱mli, akaame̱, ake̱ klante gbeame̱; ahã ame̱wo tōgwanteṅi ke̱ tōabotiai awodši ke̱-nyie, ohĩa hĩaame̱, awaame̱ yi, afeame̱ niseniianii; *

english_verse: The world did not deserve these good people, who had to wander in deserts and on mountains and had to live in caves and holes in the ground.
translation_verse: mei ní dše ne̱ṅ esaaame̱ le̱, ame̱-tšomlo ye̱ ṅãĩ ano̱ ke̱ gõdši ano̱ ke̱ te̱-kploi ke̱ šikpoṅ fo̱dši amli.

english_verse: All of them pleased God because of their faith! But still they died without being given what had been promised.
translation_verse: Ni mene̱mei fẽ le̱, aye ame̱he odase kpakpa ye̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ hewo̱ moṅ, ši amenine še̱e̱ šiwō nii le̱ ano̱,

english_verse: Be patient when you are being corrected! This is how God treats his children. Don't all parents correct their children?
translation_verse: Ké̱ nyemĩaä nyehĩe ye tšo̱semo̱ mli le̱, no le̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩeo̱nye tamo̱ ebii; edšake̱ mẽ bi yo̱ ni etše̱ tšo̱seele̱?

english_verse: God corrects all his children, and if he doesn't correct you, then you don't really belong to him.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ nyenáá tšo̱semo̱ ní mei fẽ náa le̱ eko le̱, no le̱ adſamaṅbii dšinye, ši dšee bii kpakpai. Lal.

english_verse: You know how he later wanted it back. But there was nothing he could do to change things, even though he begged his father and cried.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nyele ake̱, beni *fe se̱ ní etao ake̱ ená dšō̱mo̱ le̱, akwale̱; edšake̱ enaá tšuitšakemo̱ he gbe̱, tše̱ eke̱ yā-fónui tao se̱gbe̱. *

english_verse: You have now come to Mount Zion and to the heavenly Jerusalem. This is the city of the living God, where thousands and thousands of angels have come to celebrate.
translation_verse: Ši moṅ, *Zion goṅ le̱ he nyeba, ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩekãlo̱ le̱ maṅ ni †dši ṅwei Ierusalem le̱, ke̱ **ṅweibo̱foi akpei-akpei abo, *Kpods.

english_verse: Here you will find all of God's dearest children, whose names are written in heaven. And you will find God himself, who judges everyone. Here also are the spirits of those good people who have been made perfect.
translation_verse: ke̱ kromo̱bii ní *aṅmã ame̱gbe̱ii ye̱ ṅwei le̱ anābuamo̱ ke̱ asafo le̱, ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ni dši mei fẽ akodšolo̱ le̱, ke̱ dšaloi ni ehĩ ke̱-wula ši le̱ amumo̱i le̱, *Luk.

english_verse: Make sure you obey the one who speaks to you. The people did not escape, when they refused to obey the one who spoke to them at Mount Sinai. Do you think you can possibly escape, if you refuse to obey the one who speaks to you from heaven?
translation_verse: Nyekwe̱a ni ahĩa, koni nyekakwa moni wieo̱ le̱; edšake̱, ké̱ *mei ní kwa moni wie tšõame̱ ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ ahe edšee mli le̱, bĕle̱ ke̱dši wo̱kpale ke̱-dše̱ moni dše̱o̱ ṅwei wieo̱ le̱ he le̱, wo̱ moṅ wo̱he edšeṅ mli ko̱kō̱ko̱; *

english_verse: When God spoke the first time, his voice shook only the earth. This time he has promised to shake the earth once again, and heaven too.
translation_verse: mo gbē ní hoso šikpoṅ le̱ ye̱ no be le̱ mli le̱, ši agbe̱ne̱ ewo ši *ekē̱: “Eſe̱ šikome ní mahoso, dšee šikpoṅ le̱ ke̱ke̱, ši ṅwei hũ” le̱. *Hag.

english_verse: The words “once again” mean that these created things will someday be shaken and removed. Then what cannot be shaken will last.
translation_verse: Ši noni ekē̱: “eſe̱ šikome” le̱, eke̱-tšõo̱ faṅṅ ake̱, nii ní ahosoo̱ le̱ aatšake, edšake̱ nii ní afe ni, koni nii ní hosoṅ le̱ ahĩ ši.

english_verse: We should be grateful we were given a kingdom that cannot be shaken. And in this kingdom we please God by worshiping him and by showing him great honor and respect.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, ake̱ noni wo̱ná maṅtše̱yeli ni anyẽṅ ahoso le̱, nyehãa wo̱daä ši, ní wo̱ke̱-súmo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ bo̱ni sa ehĩe ke̱ wō ke̱ gbeyeišemo̱!

english_verse: Our God is like a destructive fire!
translation_verse: Edšake̱ wo̱-Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, la ní fiteo̱ mo hũ dšile̱.

english_verse: Don't forget about your leaders who taught you God's message. Remember what kind of lives they lived and try to have faith like theirs.
translation_verse: Nyekaia *nyetšõlo̱i, mei ní wie Nyoṅmo̱ wiemo̱ le̱ tšõnye le̱; nyekwe̱a ame̱dšeṅba le̱ nāgbē, ni †nyekasea ame̱-hemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱. *K

english_verse: This is why we should go outside the camp to Jesus and share in his disgrace.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ agbene, nyehãa wo̱dšea kpo ke̱-yaä eṅõ ye̱ nsra le̱ se̱ ni wo̱tẽre *ehorabō̱ le̱. *

english_verse: Our sacrifice is to keep offering praise to God in the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Bĕle̱ nyehãa wo̱tšṍa eno̱ ní wo̱ke̱ yidšĩemo̱ afo̱le abahãa Nyoṅmo̱ dā; no dši nābui ní dšadšeo̱ egbe̱i le̱ ayibii le̱. Lal

english_verse: But don't forget to help others and to share your possessions with them. This too is like offering a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Ši edšũrõfemo̱ ke̱ nikē le̱, nyehĩe akakpaä no̱; edšake̱ *nakai afo̱lei saä Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe dšogbāṅ. *Fil.

english_verse: Obey your leaders and do what they say. They are watching over you, and they must answer to God. So don't make them sad as they do their work. Make them happy. Otherwise, they won't be able to help you at all.
translation_verse: *Nyeboa nyetšõlo̱i le̱ atoi ni nyebaä nyehe ši nyehãäame̱; edšake̱ ame̱ ame̱buo̱ nyesusumai le̱ ahe ake̱ mei ni †babu he akontā, koni ame̱ke̱ mīše̱ afe nii ne̱, ši dšee ntšo̱idõmo̱; edšake̱ no ehĩĩ hããnye.

english_verse: Pray for us. Our consciences are clear, and we always try to live right.
translation_verse: Nyeso̱lea nyehãawo̱; edšake̱ *wo̱hĩe kã no̱ ake̱ wo̱ye̱ henilē kpakpa, ni wo̱mītao ake̱ wo̱ba wo̱dšeṅ fe̱fe̱o ye̱ nii fẽ mli. *

english_verse: I especially want you to pray that I can visit you again soon. Final Prayers and Greetings
translation_verse: Ni mikpanye fai babaō ake̱ nyefe nakai, koni akpalemi ahãnye oyá.

english_verse: God gives peace, and he raised our Lord Jesus Christ from death. Now Jesus is like a Great Shepherd whose blood was used to make God's eternal agreement with his flock.
translation_verse: Ši hedšo̱le̱ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, moni dšie tōi le̱ *akwe̱lo̱ kpeteṅkple ní dši wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu ke̱-dše̱ gbohĩĩ ateṅ ye̱ nāno̱ kpãṅmo̱ le̱ lá le̱ mli le̱, *Ioh.

english_verse: I pray God will make you ready to obey him and that you will always be eager to do right. May Jesus help you do what pleases God. To Jesus Christ be glory forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: le̱ ésānye ehã nitšumo̱ kpakpa-fẽ-nitšumo̱ kpakpa, ní nyefe esuomo̱nānii, ní etšṍ Iesu Kristo no̱ efe noni sa le̱dientše̱ ehĩe ye̱ nyemli; le̱ aṅõ anumnyam ahã ke̱-yaši nāno̱i anāno̱ le̱! Amen.

english_verse: My friends, I have written only a short letter to encourage you, and I beg you to pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Ši, anyemimei, mikpanye fai ní nyemõ wiemo̱-ke̱-tšõmo̱ ne̱ mli, edšake̱ wiemo̱ kukuō miṅmã mimãdšenye ne̱.

english_verse: Please give my greetings to your leaders and to the rest of the Lord's people. His followers from Italy send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Wo̱mībi nyetšõlo̱i le̱ fẽ ke̱ meikroṅkroṅi le̱ fẽ-tſẽm. Mei ní dše̱ Italia le̱ mībinye.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Dromo̱ le̱ ke̱ nyefẽ ahĩ ši! Amen.

english_verse: scorched by the burning heat of the sun. The flowers lose their blossoms, and their beauty is destroyed. This is how the rich will disappear, as they go about their business. Trials and Temptations
translation_verse: Edšake̱ hũlũ teo̱ ši ke̱ latšã ni egbĩo̱ dſe̱i le̱, ni *efo̱fo̱i le̱ kpãlaä ſieo̱ ši ni efe̱o le̱ fiteo̱: nakai noṅṅ niiatše̱ le hũ hĩe bakpãtã ye̱ egbe̱i le̱ ano̱. *Ies,

english_verse: Our desires make us sin, and when sin is finished with us, it leaves us dead.
translation_verse: No se̱ le̱ ako̱no̱ le̱, kē̱ éṅõ ho̱ le̱, efo̱ō̱ eša, ni eša le̱ hũ, ké̱ afe agbe nā le̱ efo̱ō̱ *gbēle. *Rom.

english_verse: Don't be fooled, my dear friends.
translation_verse: Nyekadũa gbe̱, minyemimei ni misumoo̱.

english_verse: He wanted us to be his own special people, and so he sent the true message to give us new birth. Hearing and Obeying
translation_verse: Le̱dientše̱ esuomo̱ nā eke̱ ano̱kwale wieme̱ le̱ fo̱wo̱, koni wo̱fe enibó̱nii le̱ amli kleṅkleṅ yibii, Ioh

english_verse: My dear friends, you should be quick to listen and slow to speak or to get angry.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, minyemimei ni misumoo, mofẽmo he afe oyá ke̱ ninumo̱, ehũmi ši ke̱ wiemo̱, *ehũmi ši ke̱ mlifũ. *Dsads.

english_verse: You must stop doing anything immoral or evil. Instead be humble and accept the message planted in you to save you.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ *nyeše̱re̱a nyãṅemo̱-nitšumo̱ ke̱ efõṅ ne̱tekemo̱ fẽ nyeſiea, ni nyeke̱ mlidšo̱le̱ aherea wiemo̱ le̱ ni ate̱o ye̱ nyemli ni yo̱ hewale̱ ni eke̱-ahere nyesusumai ayiwala le̱, *Kol.

english_verse: Obey God's message! Don't fool yourselves by just listening to it.
translation_verse: Ši nyetšōmo̱a wiemo̱ le̱ no̱yelo̱i, ni dšee wiemo̱ le̱ nulo̱i ke̱ke̱, ni nyeke̱mīšišiu nyedientše̱ nyehe. Mat.

english_verse: If you hear the message and don't obey it, you are like people who stare at themselves in a mirror
translation_verse: Edšake̱, ké̱ moko dši wiemo̱ le̱ nulo̱ ke̱ke̱ ši edšee eno̱yelo̱ hũ le̱, ne̱ke̱ gbomo ne̱ tamo̱ nū ko ni kwe̱o̱ ehĩe su le̱ ye̱ aſiſe̱ mli;

english_verse: and forget what they look like as soon as they leave.
translation_verse: edšake̱ ekwe̱o̱ ehe, ni eyaā, ni amrõ-mrõ noṅṅ le̱ ehīe kpaä bo̱ ni eyo̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: But you must never stop looking at the perfect law that sets you free. God will bless you in everything you do, if you listen and obey, and don't just hear and forget.
translation_verse: Ši moni mãa eyi ši ekwe̱o̱ *heyeli mla ni hĩ ke̱-wula ši le̱ mli, ni ekãa he, ni edšee moni nuo̱ ni ehĩe kpaā no̱, ši moṅ edši no̱yelo̱ ni tšuo̱ he nii le̱, nakai mo le̱ †aadšō̱le̱ ye̱ eno̱yeli le̱ mli, *

english_verse: If you think you are being religious, but can't control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is useless.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ efeo̱ nyeteṅ moko ake̱ Nyoṅmo̱-dšálo̱ dšile̱ ni *ewoo elile̱i manyofle̱ ši moṅ ešišiuo̱ etšui le̱, ne̱ke̱ gbomo ne̱ dšámo̱ le̱ yaka ni. *Lal.

english_verse: Religion that pleases God the Father must be pure and spotless. You must help needy orphans and widows and not let this world make you evil.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱ dšãmo̱ ni he tše ni ehe be̱ mũdši ko ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ke̱ tše̱ le hīe dši ene̱, ake̱ mo asra awusãi ke̱ okũlafoi ye̱ ame̱manehũlũ le mli, ni eto ehe ke̱-dše̱ dše ne̱ṅ koni ekawo ehe mũdši.

english_verse: Do this, because on the day of judgment there will be no pity for those who have not had pity on others. But even in judgment, God is merciful! Faith and Works
translation_verse: Edšake̱ kodšomo̱ mli le̱, moni enaa mo̱bo̱ le̱ anaṅle̱ me̱bo̱: fã me̱be̱nale̱ ſãa ešio̱ kodšomo̱. Mat.

english_verse: My friends, what good is it to say you have faith, when you don't do anything to show you really do have faith? Can this kind of faith save you?
translation_verse: Minyemimei, ke̱dši moko kē̱, eye̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli, ši ebe̱ nitšumo̱i le̱, mẽ se̱-námo̱ yo̱ mli? Ani hemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ aanyẽ eyiwala ahere? Mat.

english_verse: you shouldn't just say, “I hope all goes well for you. I hope you will be warm and have plenty to eat.” What good is it to say this, unless you do something to help?
translation_verse: ni nyeteṅ moko yakē̱ame̱ ake̱: Nyeyaä ye̱ hedšo̱le̱ mli: nyeyawerea la, ni nyeyayea nii nyetō̱ro̱a; ši ehããame̱ nii ni hĩaä gbomotšo le: mē se̱námo̱ yo̱ mli

english_verse: Suppose someone disagrees and says, “It is possible to have faith without doing kind deeds.” I would answer, “Prove that you have faith without doing kind deeds, and I will prove that I have faith by doing them.”
translation_verse: Ši moko aakē̱: Bo le̱, oye̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli, ni mi le̱, nitšumo̱i miyo̱; tšõmo̱mi ohemo̱ke̱yeli ni nitšumo̱i be̱ he le̱, ni mi hũ madše̱ minitšumo̱i le̱ amli matšõo *mihemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱. *Gal.

english_verse: You surely believe there is only one God. That's fine. Even demons believe this, and it makes them shake with fear.
translation_verse: Bo le̱ oheo̱ oyeo̱ ake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ mokome ni? ofe dšogbāṅ; daimonioi hũ heo̱ yeo̱, ni ãme̱he dšoo̱.

english_verse: Does some stupid person want proof that faith without deeds is useless?
translation_verse: Ō yaka gbomo, ōtão ole ake̱ he-mo̱-ke̱-yeli ni nitšumo̱i be̱ he le̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli gbonyo ni lo?

english_verse: Well, our ancestor Abraham pleased God by putting his son Isaac on the altar to sacrifice him.
translation_verse: Wo̱tše̱ Abraham le̱, ani dšee ni-tšumo̱i amli adše̱ abule̱ bem, beni eke̱ ebi Isak yaṅmẽ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ le̱?

english_verse: Now you see how Abraham's faith and deeds worked together. He proved his faith was real by what he did.
translation_verse: Ōna ake̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli ke̱ enitšumo̱i le̱ nyie, ni nitšumo̱i le̱ amli edše̱ ni ehemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ ye emū le̱;

english_verse: This is what the Scriptures mean by saying, “Abraham had faith in God, and God accepted him.” That's how Abraham became God's friend.
translation_verse: ni ṅmãle̱ le̱ ni *kē̱o̱ ake̱; “Ši Abraham he Nyoṅme̱ eye, ni abu ene̱ dšale̱ ahãle̱ le̱”, ba mli, ni atšē̱le̱ ake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ †šieutše̱. *

english_verse: You can now see that we please God by what we do and not only by what we believe.
translation_verse: Nyemīna ake̱ nitšumo̱i amli adše̱o̱ abuo̱ gbomo bem, ši dšee hemo̱-ke̱-yeli ke̱ke̱ mli.

english_verse: For example, Rahab had been a prostitute. But she pleased God when she welcomed the spies and sent them home by another way.
translation_verse: Nakai noṅṅ *Rahab, adſamaṅ le̱ hũ, ani dšee nitšumo̱i amli adše̱ abule̱ bem, beni ehere †bo̱foi le̱ atū ni edšie-ame gbe̱ ke̱-tšó̱ gbe̱ kroko no̱ le̱? Heb.

english_verse: Anyone who doesn't breathe is dead, and faith that doesn't do anything is just as dead!
translation_verse: Edšake̱ take̱ bo̱ni gbomotšo ni mu-mo̱ be̱ mli le̱ dši gbonyo le̱, nakai noṅṅ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli ni nitšumo̱i be̱ he le̱ dši *hemo̱-ke̱-yeli gbonyo, K,

english_verse: By putting a bit into the mouth of a horse, we can turn the horse in different directions.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ wo̱ke̱ okpo̱ṅo̱i amanyofle̱i wo ame̱dāṅ ni ame̱bowo̱ toi le̱, wo̱ke̱kplaä ame̱gbomotšo mū le̱ fē.

english_verse: The tongue is like a spark. It is an evil power that dirties the rest of the body and sets a person's entire life on fire with flames that come from hell itself.
translation_verse: Ni lile̱i le̱ hũ, la ni; wo̱henii le̱ ateṅ le̱ lile̱i dši nišaianii adšeṅ ni *buleo̱ gbomotšo mū le̱ fẽ ni emēa fo̱-mo̱ṅ kokrolonto le̱ nā la, ni gehena adše̱o̱ aše̱reo̱ la le̱. *Mat.

english_verse: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and sea creatures can be tamed and have been tamed.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ koloi ke̱ lofõdši ke̱ nii ni wamoo̱ ke̱ nii ni yo̱ ṅšo̱ mli le̱ asu-fẽ-su le̱, adšo̱ō̱ he, ni gbomei ke̱ ame̱su édšo̱ ame̱he;

english_verse: But our tongues get out of control. They are restless and evil, and always spreading deadly poison.
translation_verse: ši lile̱i le̱, gbomo-ko-gbomo-ko nyẽẽ ehe adšo̱; nõfõṅ ni eflegedše ni eyi obō ke̱ *ebō̱ ni gbeo̱ mo ni. *Lal.

english_verse: Can clean water and dirty water both flow from the same spring?
translation_verse: Aso nubu yo̱ ne̱, ebaä nu ṅma ke̱ nu ni dšōo̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ hĩṅme̱i kome le̱ noṅṅ mli?

english_verse: Can a fig tree produce olives or a grapevine produce figs? Does fresh water come from a well full of salt water? Wisdom from Above
translation_verse: Minyemimei, aso agbãmitšo aanyẽ mũtšo-yibii awo, alo weintšo aawo agbã-mi? Nakai noṅṅ kẽ ṅōbu ko nyĕṅ nu ṅma aba.

english_verse: Are any of you wise or sensible? Then show it by living right and by being humble and wise in everything you do.
translation_verse: Namo dši nilelo̱ ke̱ sanese̱ko̱lo̱ ye̱ nyeteṅ? Hã ni eke̱ dšeṅba kpakpa atšõ le̱dientše̱ *enitšumo̱i le̱ ye̱ nilē kpōfeme̱ mli. *

english_verse: But if your heart is full of bitter jealousy and selfishness, don't brag or lie to cover up the truth.
translation_verse: Ši ké̱ *awuṅãyeli fõṅ ke̱ béi ye̱ nyetšui mli le̱, nyekaſãa ni nyemalea nyešia ano̱kwale le̱. *Ef.

english_verse: This kind of wisdom doesn't come from above. It is earthly and selfish and comes from the devil himself.
translation_verse: Ne̱ke̱ nilē ne̱, *dšee ṅwei edše̱, ši moṅ šikpoṅ no̱ nõ ni, helo nā nõ ni, daimonioi anõ ni. *

english_verse: Whenever people are jealous or selfish, they cause trouble and do all sorts of cruel things.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ heni awuṅãyeli ke̱ béi yo̱ le̱, dše̱i sakasakafemo̱ ke̱ nišaianii fẽ yo̱.

english_verse: When peacemakers plant seeds of peace, they will harvest justice.
translation_verse: Ši *dšale̱ yibii le̱, hedšo̱le̱ mli adũo̱ ye̱ †ahãa mei ni feo̱ hedšo̱le̱nii le̱. *Ies.

english_verse: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Clean up your lives, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you people who can't make up your mind.
translation_verse: *Nyetšia nyebe̱ṅke̱a Nyoṅmo̱, ni eetši eebe̱ṅke̱nye. †Nyetšũa nyenidši ahe, nye ešafelo̱i, ni nyehãa nyetšuii ahe atšea, nye dſẽṅmo̱i enyo̱nyo̱tše̱mei. *Zak

english_verse: Be sad and sorry and weep. Stop laughing and start crying. Be gloomy instead of glad.
translation_verse: Nyew̌ere̱ ahoa nyehe ni nyeyea ṅko̱mo̱ ni nyefōa; nyeṅmlõ le̱ atšõ ṅko̱mo̱yeli, ni nyemīše̱ hũ atšō hĩešiſiemo̱.

english_verse: Be humble in the Lord's presence, and he will honor you. Saying Cruel Things about Others
translation_verse: Nyebaä nyehe ši ye̱ Nuntše̱ le̱ hīe, ni eewō nyeno̱.

english_verse: My friends, don't say cruel things about others! If you do, or if you condemn others, you are condemning God's Law. And if you condemn the Law, you put yourself above the Law and refuse to obey either it
translation_verse: Nyekawiewiea nyenanemei ahe, anyemimei. Moni wieo̱ enyemi, he alo ekodšoo̱ enyemi le̱, mla le ewieo̱ ešio̱ ni mla le̱ ekodšoo̱ le̱; ši ké̱ ōkodšo mla le̱, dšee mla le̱ no̱yelo̱ dšio, ši mla le̱ kodšolo̱ moṅ dšio.

english_verse: You should know better than to say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to the city. We will do business there for a year and make a lot of money!”
translation_verse: Bĕle̱ agbe̱ne̱ nye hũ, nye mei ni nyekē̱o̱ ake̱: Nme̱ne̱ lo wó̱ le̱ wo̱o̱te ne̱ke̱ lo ne̱ke̱ mã ne̱ṅ, ni wo̱yaye afl kome ye̱ dše̱i, ni wo̱o̱ye dšra, ni wo̱o̱nã se̱. Abe̱i

english_verse: What do you know about tomorrow? How can you be so sure about your life? It is nothing more than mist that appears for only a little while before it disappears.
translation_verse: Tšē̱ nyelee wó̱ sane. Edšake̱ meni dši nyewala le̱? Edši lamo̱ ni pueo̱ fiō ko, ni ké̱ fe se̱ le̱ elādšeo̱. Luk.

english_verse: You should say, “If the Lord lets us live, we will do these things.”
translation_verse: Hewo̱ le̱ sa moṅ ake̱ nyekē̱o̱ ake̱: Ke̱dši Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ mīsumo̱ ni wo̱yi ná wala le̱, no le̱ wo̱o̱fe ene̱ lo ene̱. Bof.

english_verse: Yet you are stupid enough to brag, and it is wrong to be so proud.
translation_verse: Ši agbe̱ne̱ le̱ nyeſāa ye̱ nyebewōi le̱ amli; ne̱ke̱ ſã ne̱ fẽ le̱, efõṅ ni.

english_verse: If you don't do what you know is right, you have sinned.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ moni le ekpakpafemo̱ ni efee le̱, eša dši no hãle̱. Luk.

english_verse: Your treasures have already rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
translation_verse: *Nyenii babao le̱ ešãra, ni nyetadei le̱ hũ, omlegẽi éye. *Mat.

english_verse: My friends, be patient until the Lord returns. Think of farmers who wait patiently for the autumn and spring rains to make their valuable crops grow.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, *nyeṅmẽa nyetšui ši, anyemimei, ke̱yašia Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ bābe le̱. Na, hũlo̱ le̱ mẽo̱ šikpo̱ṅ no̱ nibãnii ni dšra wa le̱, ni eṅmẽo̱ etšui ši ye̱ he ke̱-yašio̱ beyino̱ ni enáa agbie̱nā ke̱ gbo nune̱mo̱ le̱; *Luk

english_verse: Don't grumble about each other or you will be judged, and the judge is right outside the door.
translation_verse: Nyekadõmo̱a ntšo̱i nyewoa nyehe, anyemimei, koni akakodšonye; na, kodšolo̱ le̱ damo̱ šĩnãi le̱ ase̱.

english_verse: In fact, we praise the ones who endured the most. You remember how patient Job was and how the Lord finally helped him. The Lord did this because he is so merciful and kind.
translation_verse: Na, wo̱dšō̱o̱ mei ni ṅmẽo̱ ame̱tšui ši le̱, Nyenu *Hiob tšuišiṅmĕ le̱ he, ni nyena Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ nãgbē le̱; ake̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ mli tšõole̱ babaō, ni amli dšo̱ hũ. *Hiob

english_verse: If you are sick, ask the church leaders to come and pray for you. Ask them to put olive oil on you in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ké̱ nyeteṅ moko he waale̱ le̱, étšé̱ asafo le̱ mli onukpai le̱ ke̱-ba eṅõ, ni *amé̱kpale̱ mũ ye̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ gbe̱i amli ni ame̱so̱le ame̱hãle̱, *Mar.

english_verse: If you have sinned, you should tell each other what you have done. Then you can pray for one another and be healed. The prayer of an innocent person is powerful, and it can help a lot.
translation_verse: Nyedšadšea nyeno̱tõmo̱i nyetšõa nyehe, ni nyeso̱lea nyehãa nyehe, ni nyehe atã, Dšalo̱ so̱lemo̱ ni mli wa le̱ nyẽo̱ nii babaō etšuo̱.

english_verse: My friends, if any followers have wandered away from the truth, you should try to lead them back.
translation_verse: Anyemimei, ke̱dši nyeteṅ moko dũ gbe̱ ke̱-dše̱ ano̱kwale le̱ mli ni *moko mĩkpalele̱ ekoṅ le̱, *Gal

english_verse: If you turn sinners from the wrong way, you will save them from death, and many of their sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: hã ní ele ake̱, moni kpaleo̱ *ešafelo̱ ke̱-dše̱o̱ egbe̱dũ mli le̱, ẽhere susuma yiwala ke-dše gbĕle mli, ni †eeha ešai pī ano̱ *Lal

english_verse: Always live as God's holy people should, because God is the one who chose you, and he is holy.
translation_verse: ši moṅ, bo̱ni moni tšé̱nye le̱ yo̱ kroṅkroṅ le̱, nye hũ nyefea kroṅkroṅ ye̱ nyedšeṅba fẽ mli;

english_verse: You say that God is your Father, but God doesn't have favorites! He judges all people by what they do. So you must honor God while you live as strangers here on earth.
translation_verse: Ni ké̱ nyetšé̱o̱ moni *kwe̱e̱ mei ahĩeaṅ ši ekodšoo̱ ye̱ mofẽmo nitšumo̱ nā le̱ ake̱ nyetše̱ le̱, nyeke̱ gbeyeišemo̱ abaä nyedšeṅ ye̱ nyegbo̱tō be le̱ mli, *Rom.

english_verse: You were rescued by the precious blood of Christ, that spotless and innocent lamb.
translation_verse: ši moṅ, ke̱ Kristo moni tamo̱ tōbi ní he be̱ kpa lo ṅmãmo̱nõ ko le̱ lá ní dšra wa le̱; Ies

english_verse: Christ was chosen even before the world was created, but because of you, he did not come until these last days.
translation_verse: moni alele̱ momosa dãni ato dšeṅ šiši, ši adšiele̱ kpo ye̱ bei le̱ anāgbē mli ye̱ nyehewo̱, Rom.

english_verse: And when he did come, it was to lead you to have faith in God, who raised him from death and honored him in a glorious way. This is why you have put your faith and hope in God.
translation_verse: nye mei ni *nyetšṍ eno̱ nyeheo̱ Nyoṅmo̱, moni tēle̱ ši ke̱-dše̱ gbohĩĩ ateṅ ni ewo ehĩe nyam le̱ no̱ nyeyeo̱ le̱, beni afe ní nyehemo̱-ke̱-yeli ke̱ nyehĩeno̱kãmo̱ ahĩ Nyoṅmo̱ no̱. Ioh.

english_verse: You obeyed the truth, and your souls were made pure. Now you sincerely love each other. But you must keep on loving with all your heart.
translation_verse: Ni ake̱ noni nyetšṍ mumo̱ le̱ no̱ nyetšū nyesusumai ahe ye̱ ano̱kwale le̱ toibō mli nyehã nyemimei ahedō̱ ní apasa be̱ mli hewo̱ le̱, nyeke̱ tšui kro̱ṅṅ asumo̱a nyehe dšogbāṅ,

english_verse: Do this because God has given you new birth by his message that lives on forever.
translation_verse: edšake̱ afo̱nye ehē, ni dšee wúi ní fiteo̱, ši moṅ noni fitee mli adše̱ afo̱nye ke̱-tšṍ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩekãlo̱ ke̱ dāšihĩlo̱ le̱ wiemo le̱ no̱. Ioh.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Humans wither like grass, and their glory fades like wild flowers. Grass dries up, and flowers fall to the ground.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ “helo fẽ tamo̱ dſe̱i, ni enumnyam le̱ fẽ tamo̱ dſe̱iaṅ fo̱fo̱i. Dſe̱i gbĩo̱ ni emli fo̱fo̱i le̱ kplaä; Ies.

english_verse: But what the Lord has said will stand forever.” Our good news to you is what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: ši *Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ wiemo le̱ hĩo̱ ši ke̱-yaä nāno̱.” Ene̱ dši wiemo ní adšadše atšõnye ake̱ sanekpakpa le̱. *Ies.

english_verse: God wants you to silence stupid and ignorant people by doing right.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nakai dši Nyoṅmo̱ suomo̱-nānii le̱, *ake̱ ekpakpafemo̱ nyeke̱-atšĩmo̱ gbomei ní be̱ yitšoṅ le akwašiafemo le̱ nā, *

english_verse: Servants, you must obey your masters and always show respect to them. Do this, not only to those who are kind and thoughtful, but also to those who are cruel.
translation_verse: *Webii, nyeke̱ gbeyeišemo̱ fẽ abaä nyehe ši ahãa nyenuṅtšo̱mei, dšee meikpakpai ke̱ mlihīlo̱i ke̱ke, ši moṅ meifõdši hũ. *Ef.

english_verse: God will bless you, even if others treat you unfairly for being loyal to him.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ eno dši dromo̱, ké̱ Nyoṅmo̱ he nilē hewo̱ ni moko hĩeo̱ nidō̱nii amli, ni enaä amanehũlù ní edšaa gbe̱ le̱.

english_verse: You don't gain anything by being punished for some wrong you have done. But God will bless you, if you have to suffer for doing something good.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ké̱ tõ nyetõ ni ayinye ni nyeto nyetšui ši ye̱ mli le̱, mẽ anumnyam yo̱ mli? Ši ké̱ *ekpakpa nyefe ni nyena he amanehũlũ ni nyeto nyetšui ši ye̱ mli le̱, no dši dromo̱ ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe. *

english_verse: Christ did not sin or ever tell a lie.
translation_verse: le̱ moni efee eša, ni asaṅ anaa apasa ye̱ edāṅ le̱, Ies.

english_verse: Although he was abused, he never tried to get even. And when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he had faith in God, who judges fairly.
translation_verse: moni, beni adše̱o̱le̱ le̱, edše̱e̱ moko etoo nãdšiaṅ, beni enaä amanehũlũ le̱, elomo̱o̱ moko, ši moṅ etu esane ewo moni kodšoo̱ dšale̱ nā le̱ deṅ;

english_verse: Christ carried the burden of our sins. He was nailed to the cross, so we would stop sinning and start living right. By his cuts and bruises you are healed.
translation_verse: moni le̱dientše̱ etĕre *wo̱he ešai le̱ ye̱ egbomotšo le̱ mli ke̱-te tšo le̱ no̱, koni †wo̱gboi wo̱hã eša ní wo̱hĩe akãmo̱ aha dšale̱, mo he fadši ní aṅõ-tšánye le̱. *

english_verse: You had wandered away like sheep. Now you have returned to the one who is your shepherd and protector.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ kũle̱ *nyetamo̱ tōi ní elādše, ši agbe̱ne̱ le̱ nyekũ nyese̱ ke̱-ba nyesusumai †alè̱lo̱ ke̱ no̱kwe̱lo̱ le̱ ṅõ. *Ies.

english_verse: Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: nyeke̱ efõṅ akatoa efõṅ nãdšiaṅ alo dše̱mo̱ ye̱ dše̱mo̱ nãdšiaṅ, ši moṅ nyedšō̱a, edšake̱ nyele ake̱ ene̱ hewo̱ atšé̱nye, koni nyenine aše̱ dšō̱mo̱ le̱ no̱.

english_verse: “Do you really love life? Do you want to be happy? Then stop saying cruel things and quit telling lies.
translation_verse: *Ši moni taoo ake̱ etše̱ ye̱ dšeṅ ní ena gbĩĩ kpakpai le̱, †hã emõ elile̱i mli ke̱-dše̱ efõṅ he, ke̱ enabu hũ, koni ekawie apasa wiemo̱; *Lal.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and do right, as you find and follow the road to peace.
translation_verse: ew̌i eſõṅ ni efe ekpakpa, etao hedšo̱le̱ ni enyie no se̱.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who obeys him, and he listens to their prayers. But he opposes everyone who does evil.”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ hĩṅme̱ii kã dšalo̱i ahe, ni eboo̱ ame̱faikpamo̱ toi; ši mei ní feo̱ niſõdšianii le̱, Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ edšie ehĩe ekaame̱.

english_verse: Honor Christ and let him be the Lord of your life. Always be ready to give an answer when someone asks you about your hope.
translation_verse: ši Nuṅtšo̱, Kristo le̱, *nyebuale̱ kroṅkroṅ ye̱ nyetšuii amli; ni dāne̱ nyesaä nyehe nyetoa, koni nyená hetō nyehã mofẽmo ní bio̱nye hĩeno̱kãmo̱ ní yo̱ nyemli le̱ šiši le̱, ke̱ mlidšo̱le̱ ke̱ gbeyeišemo̱. *Ies.

english_verse: Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ.
translation_verse: ni nyehĩe henilē kpakpa, koni nõ mli ní ame̱wie nyehe ake̱ efõṅfelo̱i ye̱ le̱, mei ni gbe nyedšeṅba kpakpa ní yo̱ Kristo mli le̱ he guo̱ le̱ ahĩe agboi.

english_verse: Christ then preached to the spirits that were being kept in prison.
translation_verse: emli noṅṅ etšṍ ke̱-te *mumo̱i ní awoame̱ tšũṅ le̱ aṅõ, eyašie̱ etšõame̱, *

english_verse: Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.
translation_verse: moni yo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ *ninedšŭrõ no̱, ake̱-ní ete ṅwei, ni aṅõ ṅwei bo̱foi ke̱ hegbe̱i ke̱ hewale̱i awo ešiši le̱. *Ef.

english_verse: Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well.
translation_verse: Bo̱ni mofẽmo éná dromo̱kēnii le̱, nyeke̱-súmo̱súmo̱a nyehe, tamo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ dromo̱nii sro̱toi le̱ ano̱kwe̱lo̱i kpakpai.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't be surprised or shocked that you are going through testing that is like walking through fire.
translation_verse: Suomo̱meĩ, nyekahãa *amanehũlũ la ní aṅõ-kaänye le̱ mīfenye sane sro̱to ko, tamo̱ ake̱ noko sro̱to ko feo̱nye le̱, *

english_verse: Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.
translation_verse: ši moṅ babaō ni *nyenaä Kristo amanehũlũi le̱ eko le̱, †nyemi aše̱a, koni enumnyam kpodšiemo̱ le̱ mli hũ nyemī aše̱ ni nyemli aflinye. *Rom.

english_verse: Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you.
translation_verse: Ké̱ Kristo gbe̱i ahewo̱ adšé̱o̱nye le̱, *adšō̱nye, edšake̱ anumnyam mumo̱ ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱ Mumo̱ le̱ dšo̱ō̱ ehe ye̱ nyeno̱. [Ame̱ le̱ ame̱wieo̱ ehe efõṅ, ši nye le̱ nyewoo̱ eble nyam.] *

english_verse: But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody.
translation_verse: Ši nyeteṅ mokomoko akana amanehũlũ ake̱ awuyelo̱ lo dšalo̱ lo efõṅfelo̱ alo moko ní ke̱ ehe woo̱ meikrokomei asãdši amli;

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to suffer for being a Christian. Praise God that you belong to him.
translation_verse: ši ké̱ moko naä amanehũlũ ake̱ Kristofonyo le̱, ehĩe akagbo, ši moṅ *éwo Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe nyam ye̱ ne̱ke̱ gbe̱i ne̱ mli. *Fil.

english_verse: God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Edšake̱ be ni abadše kodšomo̱ šiši ke̱-dše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ *we le̱ eše̱ etã; ši ke̱ wo̱no̱ tšutšu edše̱ le̱, mei ní boo Nyoṅmo̱ sanekpakpa le̱ toi le̱, té ame̱nāgbē aafe tēṅ? *Ezek.

english_verse: “If good people barely escape, what will happen to sinners and to others who don't respect God?”
translation_verse: ni ké̱ ekpakpa aafe dãni aahere dšalo̱ yiwala le̱, moni šee Nyoṅmo̱ gbeyei ke̱ ašafelo̱ le̱, nēgbe̱ ame̱badamo̱? Abe̱i

english_verse: If you suffer for obeying God, you must have complete faith in your faithful Creator and keep on doing right.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ mei ni naä amanehũlũ ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ suomo̱ le̱ nā le̱ hũ *atu ame̱susumai awo bo̱lo̱ ano̱kwafo le̱ deṅ ye̱ ekpakpafemo̱ mli. *Lal.

english_verse: God cares for you, so turn all your worries over to him.
translation_verse: Nyeṅõa nyehaomo̱ fẽ nyefõa eno̱, edšake̱ le̱ edſẽṅo̱ nyeno̱. Lal.

english_verse: Be on your guard and stay awake. Your enemy, the devil, is like a roaring lion, sneaking around to find someone to attack.
translation_verse: *Nyehĩe akãa ši, nyesraä; edšake̱ nyehenye̱lo̱, abonsam le̱, nyie tamo̱ dšata ní hũo̱ ētao moni eemĩ; *

english_verse: But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are.
translation_verse: nyedamo̱a ši šiṅṅ ye̱ hemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ mli nyetšĩale̱ gbe, edšake̱ nyele ake̱ nakai amanehũlũi le̱ nonṅ nyenyemimei ní yo̱ dše le̱ṅ le̱ hũ naä. Ef.

english_verse: But God shows undeserved kindness to everyone. That's why he appointed Christ Jesus to choose you to share in his eternal glory. You will suffer for a while, but God will make you complete, steady, strong, and firm.
translation_verse: Ši dromo̱ fë Nyoṅmo̱ ní tšé̱nye ke̱-ba enāno̱-anumnyam le̱ mli ye̱ Kristo Iesu mli le̱, ké̱ nyena amanehũlũ *fiō ne̱ etã le̱, le̱dientše̱ eesānye pe̱ ni eewa-dšenye ni eewonye hewale̱ ni eehã nyefĩ ši šiṅṅ;

english_verse: Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones. Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.
translation_verse: ní ahala ye̱ Babilon afata wo̱he le̱ ke̱ mibi *Marko hũ mībinye. *Bo̱f.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. I pray that God will give peace to everyone who belongs to Christ.
translation_verse: Nyeṅãṅãa nyehe ke̱ suomo̱ *nāſo̱mo̱. Hedšo̱le̱ ahãnye fẽ ní nyeyo̱ Kristo Iesu mli le̱! Amen. *

english_verse: God made great and marvelous promises, so his nature would become part of us. Then we could escape our evil desires and the corrupt influences of this world.
translation_verse: nii ni atšõ no̱ hũ ni aṅõ šiwōi kpleikplei ni dšra wa le̱ akewo̱, koni nyetšõ ne̱ke̱ nii ne̱ ano̱ nyená Nyoṅmo̱ fo̱mo̱su le̱ eko ni nyedšo dše ne̱ṅ fitemo̱ ni yo̱ ako̱no̱ mli le̱ nā foi:

english_verse: If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ke̱dši ne̱ke̱ nii ne̱ ye̱ nyemli ni efá le̱, ehãṅ nyefe hedšõlo̱i alo mei ni woo yibii ye̱ wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo he nilē le̱ gbe̱fãṅ.

english_verse: My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, anyemimei, nyebo̱a mo̱deṅ ni nyewadšea nyetšé̱mo̱ ke̱ ha-lamo̱ le̱; edšake̱, ké̱ nyefe ene̱ le, nyetē̱re̱ṅ gbĩkogbĩko.

english_verse: Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ nakai ni aaṅmẽnye wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ ke̱ yiwalaherelo̱ Iesu Kristo nāno̱-maṅtše̱yeli le̱ mli gbe̱ āhũ.

english_verse: You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le dãne̱ mike̱ mihe efõṅ ši ni makainye ye̱ ne̱ke̱ nii ne̱ ahewo̱, tše̱ nyele momo ni nyenane emõ ši ye̱ ano̱kwale ni yo̱ le̱ mli.

english_verse: In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body.
translation_verse: Ši gbĩĩabo̱ ni miyo̱ ne̱ke̱ *bū ne̱ mii ne̱, mibuo̱ ake̱ edša, ake̱ mike̱ kaimo̱ atšĩe nyehĩe; *

english_verse: And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind.
translation_verse: edšake̱ mile ake̱ miba le̱ kpamo̱ le̱ bafe oyá, take̱ bo̱ni wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo hũ edšie kpo etšõmi le. Ioh

english_verse: We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.
translation_verse: Ni ne̱ke̱ gbē ne̱ wo̱dientše̱ wo̱nu ake̱ ṅwei edše̱, beni wo̱ke̱le̱ yo̱ goṅ kroṅkroṅ le̱ no̱ le̱.

english_verse: All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts.
translation_verse: Ni amã gbale̱ wiemo̱ le̱ no̱ mi ahãwo̱ fé tšutšu le̱, noni ke̱dši nyeṅõ nyehĩe nyeto no̱ ake̱ la ni tšoo̱ ye̱ heko ni woo̱ duṅ, ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni dše aatše̱re ni tolō le̱ aate ši ye̱ nyetšuii amli le̱, no̱ le̱ nyemĩfe dšogbãṅ.

english_verse: But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Ni nyele ene̱ tšutšu ake̱ ṅmãle̱ le̱ṅ gbale̱-fẽ-gbale̱ le̱ edše̱e̱ gbomo ko šišitšõmo̱ mli.

english_verse: The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ gbale̱ ko bako ye̱ gbomo suomo̱ nā pẽṅ, ši moṅ Mumo̱ kroṅkroṅ le̱ tšire̱o̱ Nyoṅmo̱ gbomei kroṅkroṅi le̱ ni ame̱wieo̱.

english_verse: And during Noah's time, God did not have pity on the ungodly people of the world. He destroyed them with a flood, though he did save eight people, including Noah, who preached the truth.
translation_verse: ni asaṅ eṅõõ blema dše le̱ he ekeele̱, ši moṅ Noa ni dši dšale̱ šie̱le̱ le̱, moni gbe yi fe mei kpānyo̱ le̱ ke̱ke̱ yi ebā, ni eke̱ nu afua le̱ ba mei ni kwa Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ adše le̱ no̱, —

english_verse: God punished the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and this is a warning to anyone else who wants to sin.
translation_verse: ni Sodoma ke̱ Gomora mãdši le̱ hũ ešã ni ehã ame̱tšō lamlu, ni eke̱ butumo̱ kodšoame̱ eke̱-to mei ni bakwa Nyoṅmo̱ ie̱ okadi,

english_verse: This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
translation_verse: bẽle̱ Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ le bo̱ni efeo̱ edšieo̱ dšalo̱i ye̱ *kā mli, ke̱ bo̱ni efeo̱ etoo̱ meifõdši ye̱ pĩmo̱ mli ke̱-yaši kodšomo̱gbĩ le̱ no̱;

english_verse: The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven.
translation_verse: ši titri le̱ mei ni nyieo̱ helo se̱ ye̱ hebulemo̱ ake̱no̱ mli, ni ame̱gbeo̱ no̱yeli he guo̱ le̱. Tšuisalo̱i ke̱ yibulo̱i ni ke̱ ame̱mĩwie gbomei agboi ahe efõṅ ni ame̱he kpokpoo:

english_verse: They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil. They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on.
translation_verse: ni ake̱-awoame̱ nii ni edšaa gbe le̱ ahe nyõmo̱. Ame̱buo̱ dã ahoſibō̱ ake̱ nii ni ṅõ; mũdšiatše̱mei ni he yo̱ tãṅ ni; ame̱bo̱ō̱ ahoſi ye̱ ame̱gbe̱dũi le̱ amli, beni ame̱ke̱nye yeo̱ nii le̱;

english_verse: They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook.
translation_verse: Ame̱dše gbe̱ ni dša le̱ no̱, ni ame̱dũ gbe̱ ke̱-yanyie Bosor bi *Bileam, moni sumo̱ nõšafemo̱ mli nyõmo̱wo le̱, gbe̱ le̱ no̱; *

english_verse: But a donkey corrected him for this evil deed. It spoke to him with a human voice and made him stop his foolishness.
translation_verse: ši le̱ le̱ akã ehĩe ye̱ le̱dientše̱ emlatõmo̱ le̱ hewo̱: tedši ni lee wiemo̱ le̱ ke̱ gbomo gbē wie, ni etšĩ gbalo̱ le̱ kwašiafemo̱ le̱ nā.

english_verse: These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them.
translation_verse: Mene̱mei dši nubui ni nu be̱ mli, atatui ni ahum lōo̱ ke̱-yaã, mei ni ake̱ duṅ kpĩ le̱ eto ehãame̱ ke̱-yaã nāno̱ le̱.

english_verse: They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ake̱-ni nãfū-wiemo̱i wudši dšeo̱ ame̱nã hewo̱ le̱, ame̱tšõo̱ helo ako̱no̱i ano̱ ame̱ke̱ nyenyeṅtſibō̱ lakaā mei ni dše mei ni baã ame̱dšeṅ ye̱ šišiumo̱ mli le̱ adeṅ etše̱ko le̱;

english_verse: They promise freedom to everyone. But they are merely slaves of filthy living, because people are slaves of whatever controls them.
translation_verse: ame̱woo̱ame̱ ši ake̱ ame̱aye ame̱he, tše̱ ame̱dientše̱ le̱ fitemo̱ nyõdši dšiame̱; edšake̱ moni eye moko no̱ le̱, *le̱ noṅṅ enyõṅ dšile̱. *Ioh.

english_verse: When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ ké̱ ame̱tšõ Nuṅtšo̱ ke̱ yiwalaherelo̱ Iesu Kristo he nilē le̱ no̱ ame̱dšo dše ne̱ṅ mũdšinii le̱ anā foi, ni nomei amli noṅṅ asá adũame̱ ye̱ ni aye ame̱no̱ ekoṅ le̱, *ame̱nãgbẽšihĩle̱ étšõ efõṅ fè tšutšunii le̱. *Mat.

english_verse: They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ fãṅ noni ame̱nãã ame̱le dšale̱ gbe̱ le̱, fè noni ame̱le ni kẽle̱ ame̱kpale ke̱-dše̱ kitã kroṅkroṅ ni atu awo ame̱deṅ le̱ he le̱. Luk.

english_verse: What happened to them is just like the true saying, “A dog will come back to lick up its own vomit. A pig that has been washed will roll in the mud.”
translation_verse: Ši ano̱kwa abe̱ le̱ eba mli ye̱ ame̱he ake̱: *“Gbé kũo̱ ese̱ ke̱-yaã le̱dientše̱ eſẽ he, ni kploko ni adšu ehe le̱ yakokloo̱ ṅmo̱to̱ mli,” *Abe̱i

english_verse: Later it was destroyed by the waters of a mighty flood.
translation_verse: nomei noṅṅ no̱ etšṍ ni nu ṅõ no be le̱ṅ dše le̱ ni ehĩe kpãtã le̱.

english_verse: The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
translation_verse: Ši *Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ gbĩ le̱ baba tamo̱ dšulo̱ baã nyõṅ, ni no mli le̱ †ṅwei le̱ aaho aya ke̱ gbē̱mo̱, ni dše ne̱ṅ šišidšēnii le̱ aasĕre ye̱ la mli, ni šikpoṅ ke̱ emli nitšumo̱i le aašã, *

english_verse: Everything will be destroyed. So you should serve and honor God by the way you live.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱, ake̱-ni ne̱ke̱ nibii ne̱ fẽ bafite hewo̱ le̱, mẽ gbomei sa ake̱ nye-tšõmo̱ ye̱ dšeṅbai kroṅkroṅi ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱-dšámo̱i amli?

english_verse: You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat.
translation_verse: mei ni kwe̱o̱ gbe̱ ni ame̱ſeo̱ Nyo̱ṅmo̱ gbĩ le̱ bã le̱, no mli ni ṅwei aahere ke̱ la ni eešã, ni dšeṅšišidšēnii hũ aasĕre ye̱ lã mli,

english_verse: My friends, while you are waiting, you should make certain the Lord finds you pure, spotless, and living at peace.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le, suomo̱mei, ake̱-ni nye-kwe̱o̱ nii ne̱ agbe̱ ne̱, nye̱bo̱a mo̱deṅ, koni ananye ni mũdši lo kpa ko be̱ nyehe ye̱ ehĩe, ye̱ hedšo̱le̱ mli;

english_verse: Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him.
translation_verse: ni nyebua wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ *tšuišitō le̱ ake̱ yiwalaheremo̱ ni, take̱ bo̱ noṅṅ ni wo̱suomo̱-nyemi Paulo le̱ hũ ṅmãnye, ye̱ nilē ni aṅõ-hãle̱ le̱ nā le̱, *Rom.

english_verse: Paul talks about these same things in all his letters, but part of what he says is hard to understand. Some ignorant and unsteady people even destroy themselves by twisting what he said. They do the same thing with other Scriptures too.
translation_verse: tamo̱ bo̱ni ewieo̱ ene̱mei ahe ye̱ ewodši le̱ fẽ mli le̱; nomei amli nibii komei ašišinamo̱ mĩdšra, nii ni mei ni ekaseko noko le̱ ke̱ mei ni nane mõko ši le̱ tšõo̱ šiši ekroko, tamo̱ bo̱ni ame̱feo̱ ṅmãle̱i ni eſe̱ le̱ hũ, ke̱-kpãtãa ame̱-dientše̱ ame̱hĩe le̱.

english_verse: My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance.
translation_verse: Agbe̱ne̱ nye le̱, suomo̱mei, ake̱-ni nyele momosá hewo̱ le̱ *nyesraā, koni ake̱ gbomei fõdši alakamo̱-sane le̱ aka-šãtãnye hũ, ni nyedše̱ nyedientše̱ nye-šifĩmo̱ le̱ mli nyegbē ši; *Mar,

english_verse: Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
translation_verse: ši nyeſerea ye̱ wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ ke̱ yi-walaherelo̱ Iesu Kristo dromo̱ ke̱ nilẽ le̱ mli. Le̱ noṅṅ aṅõ anumnyam ahã agbene̱ ke̱ dā! Amen.

english_verse: If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši wo̱kē̱ ake̱ wo̱ke̱le̱ mībo̱ nanyo ni wo̱nyieo̱ duṅ le̱ mli le̱, wo̱mĩmale ni wo̱yee ano̱kwa;

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši wo̱kē̱ ake̱ eša ko be̱ wo̱he le̱, wo̱dientše̱ wo̱he wo̱šišiuo̱, ni ano̱kwale le̱ be̱ wo̱mli.

english_verse: But if we confess our sins to God, he can always be trusted to forgive us and take our sins away.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši wo̱dšadše *wo̱he ešai le̱, ano̱kwafo ke̱ dšalo̱ dšile̱, koni eke̱ wo̱he ešai le̱ afawo̱ ni etšumo̱ wo̱he ke̱-dše̱ nii ni edšaa ghe̱ fiã mli. *Abe̱i

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši wo̱kē̱ ake̱ wo̱feko eša le̱, bĕle̱ wo̱mītšōle̱ amalelo̱, ni ewiemo̱ le̱ be̱ wo̱mli.

english_verse: Christ is the sacrifice that takes away our sins and the sins of all the world's people.
translation_verse: ni le̱ dši wo̱he ešai le̱ ahe kpãtãmo̱nõ; ši dšee wo̱nõ le̱ ke̱ke̱ he, ši moṅ dšeṅ mū le̱ fẽ nō le̱ hũ he. Kol.

english_verse: But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
translation_verse: Asaṅ kitã bē miṅmãanye, noni dši ano̱kwa ye̱ emli ke̱ nye hũ nyemli le̱, edšake̱ *duṅ le̱ eho, ni ano̱kwa la le̱ mītšo agbe̱ne̱. *Rom.

english_verse: If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark.
translation_verse: Moni kē̱o̱ ake̱ eye̱ la le̱ mli ni *enye̱o̱ le̱dientše̱ enyemi le̱, duṅ le̱ mli eyo̱ ke̱-baši biane̱. *

english_verse: If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
translation_verse: ši moni nye̱o̱ enyemi le̱, duṅ le̱ mli eyo̱, ni duṅ le̱ mli enyieo̱, ni elee heni eyaä, edšake̱ duṅ le̱ eſila ehīṅme̱ii.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because your sins have been forgiven in the name of Christ.
translation_verse: Mīṅmãnye, bii bibii, edšake̱ aṅō nyehe ešai le̱ afanye ye̱ egbe̱i le̱ hewo̱.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because you have known the Father. Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you are strong. God's message is firm in your hearts, and you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: Miṅmãnye, atāmei, edšake̱ nyele moni yo̱ ke̱-dše̱ šišidšē le̱. Miṅmãnye, oblahīī, edšake̱ *nyehe wa, ni Nyoṅmo̱ wiemo̱ le̱ hĩo̱ nyemli, ni nyeye mofõṅ le̱ ne̱ kũnim. — *Ef

english_verse: Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here.
translation_verse: Gbekēbii, nāgbē ṅmle̱tſā le̱ ne̱; ni bo̱ni nyenu ake̱ *antikristo le̱ mība, ni agbe̱ne̱ antikristoi pĩ éba, hewo̱ le̱ wo̱le ake̱ nāgbē ṅmle̱tſã le̱ ne̱. *Mat.

english_verse: These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
translation_verse: Wo̱teṅ *ame̱dše̱ ame̱te, ši kẽle̱ ame̱dšee wo̱teṅ meikomei, edšake̱ wo̱teṅ meikomei dšiame̱ kũle̱ ame̱ke̱wo̱ hĩ ši; ši ame̱te beni afe ni ame̱dšie ame̱he ši ake̱ dšee ame̱fẽ ame̱dši wo̱teṅ meikomei. *Bo̱f.

english_verse: I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth.
translation_verse: Dšee ake̱ nyelee ano̱kwale le̱ hewo̱ miṅmãanye ne̱, ši moṅ edšake̱ nyele, ni nyele ake̱ amale komeflo dše̱e̱ ano̱kwale le̱ mli.

english_verse: And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son.
translation_verse: Namo dši amalelo̱, ké̱ dšee moni kwaä ake̱ Iesu dši Kristo le̱? Moni kwaä tše̱ le̱ ke̱ bi le̱, le̱ dši antikristo le̱.

english_verse: Keep thinking about the message you first heard, and you will always be one in your heart with the Son and with the Father.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ nye le̱, noni *nyenu ke̱-dše̱ šišidšē le̱, nyehãa no ahĩa nyemli. Ke̱dši noni nyenu ke̱-dše̱ šišidšē le̱ hī nyemli le̱, no le̱ nye hũ nyeahĩ bi le̱ ke̱ tše̱ le̱ mli. *K.

english_verse: The Son has promised us eternal life.
translation_verse: Ni ene̱ dši ši ni ewowo̱ le̱, nāno̱ wala le̱.

english_verse: I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you.
translation_verse: Mei ni šišiuo̱nye le̱ ahewo̱ miṅmānye nii ne̱.

english_verse: But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do. Children of God
translation_verse: Ni nye le̱, mũfō̱ ni nyená ye̱ eṅõ le̱ hĩo̱ nyemli, ni ehĩaanye ake̱ moko atšõnye nii, ši moũ bo̱ni emufō̱ le̱ tšõo̱nye nii fiā, ni edši ano̱kwale ni edšee amale, hewo̱ le̱ bo̱ni etšõnye le̱, nyehĩa emli. K.

english_verse: Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame.
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱, bii bibii, nyehīa emli, koni beni eebapue le̱, ni wo̱ná *ekā̃ ní wo̱hīe akagboi ye̱ ehīe ye̱ ebã le̱ mli. *

english_verse: You know Christ always does right and everyone who does right is a child of God.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši nyele ake̱ dšalo̱ dšile̱ le̱, nyenáa nyelea ake̱ mofẽmo ni *tšuo̱ dšale̱nii le̱ áfó̱le̱ ke̱-dše̱ emli. *

english_verse: This hope makes us keep ourselves holy, just as Christ is holy.
translation_verse: Ni mofẽmo ni yo̱ ne̱ke̱ no̱hìekàmo̱ ne̱ ye̱ eno̱ le̱, etšũo̱ le̱dientše̱ ehe, take̱ bo̱ni le ehe tše le̱.

english_verse: You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other. Love Each Other
translation_verse: Ene̱ mli Nyoṅmo̱ bii le̱ ke̱ abonsam bli le̱ dšie̱o̱ ame̱he ši faṅṅ ye̱, Mofẽmo ni tšuu dšale̱nii le̱, edše̱e̱ Nyoṅmo̱ mli, ke̱ moni sumo̱o̱ enyemi hũ.

english_verse: Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil.
translation_verse: dšee tamo̱ bo̱ni Kain dše̱ mofōṅ le̱ mli ni egbe enyemi le̱; ni mẽhewo̱ egbele̱ le̱? edšake̱ le̱die̱ntše̱ enitšumo̱i le̱ efõdši ni, ši enyemi le̱ nõ le̱ dša.

english_verse: Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.
translation_verse: Wo̱le *ake̱ wo̱foṅ ke̱-dše̱ gbẽle mli ke̱-te wala mli, edšake̱ wo̱sumoo̱ wo̱nyemimei; †moni sumo̱o̱ le̱, ehĩo̱ gbẽle mli, *Ioh

english_verse: Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.
translation_verse: Bii bibii, nyekahãa wo̱sumo̱a mei ye̱ wie̱mo̱ mli lo lile̱i no̱ ke̱ke̱, ši moṅ ye̱ nitšumo̱ ke ano̱kwale̱ mli. Iak.

english_verse: When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Ni no̱ wo̱ke̱-ale̱, ake̱ ano̱kwale̱ le̱ mli wo̱dše̱, ni wo̱o̱tšé̱ wo̱tšuii wo̱ṅmẽ wo̱mli ye̱ ehīe,

english_verse: But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.
translation_verse: ake̱, ke̱dši wo̱tšuii buo̱wo̱ fo̱ le̱, Nyoṅmo̱ da fē wo̱tšui, ni ele nii fiā.

english_verse: Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him.
translation_verse: Suomo̱mei, ke̱dši wo̱tšui ebuuwo̱ fo̱ le̱, wo̱ye̱ ekā̃ ye̱ Nyoṅmo hĩe, Rom.

english_verse: He will give us whatever we ask, because we obey him and do what pleases him.
translation_verse: ni nofẽno ni wo̱baä le̱, wo̱náa ye̱ edeṅ, edšake̱ ekitãi le̱ wo̱yeo̱ no̱, ni wo̱feo̱ nii ni Sa ehĩe, Mar.

english_verse: God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do.
translation_verse: Ni ene̱ dši ekitã le̱, *ake̱ wó̱he ebi Iesu Kristo gbe̱i le̱ no̱ wó̱ye, ni wó̱sumo̱sumó̱ wo̱he, take̱ bo̱ni ewowo̱ kitã le̱. *Ioh

english_verse: If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
translation_verse: Ni moni yeo̱ ekitãi le̱ ano̱ le̱ hĩo̱ emli, ni le̱ hũ ehĩo̱ emli; ni noni wo̱ke̱le̱ ake̱ ehĩo̱ wo̱mli, dši *mumo̱ ni eṅõhãwo̱ le̱. *

english_verse: Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world.
translation_verse: Bii bibii, nye le̱ nyedše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ mli, ni nyéye ame̱no̱ kũnim; edšake̱ moni yo̱ nyemli le̱ da fẽ moni yo̱ dše le̱ṅ le̱,

english_verse: We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
translation_verse: Wo̱ le̱, Nyoṅmo̱ mli wo̱dše̱; *moni le̱ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, eboo̱wo̱ toi; moni dše̱e̱ Nyoṅmo̱ mli le̱, eboowo̱ toi. No wo̱ke̱yoo̱ ano̱kwale̱ mumo̱ le ke̱ šišiumo̱ mumo̱ le̱. *Ioh,

english_verse: My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him.
translation_verse: Suomo̱mei, nyehãa wo̱sumo̱sumo̱a wo̱he; edšake̱ suomo̱ le̱ Nyoṅmo̱ mli edše̱, ni mofẽmo ni sumoo̱ mo le̱, Nyoṅmo̱ mli ádše̱ áfó̱le̱ ni ele Nyoṅmo̱.

english_verse: God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life.
translation_verse: Ene̱ mli Nyoṅmo̱ suomo̱ ni eke̱sumoo̱wo̱ le̱ dše kpo ye̱, ake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ tšũ le̱die̱ntše̱ ebi kōme le̱ ke̱ba dše le̱ṅ, koni wo̱tšõ ene̱ wo̱ná wala. Ioh

english_verse: Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Ene̱ mli suomo̱ le̱ yo̱: dšee ake̱ wo̱ ni we̱sumo̱ Nyoṅmo̱, ši moṅ ake̱ le̱ ni esnmo̱wo̱, ni etšũ ebi le̱ ake̱ ebafe wo̱he ešai le̱ ahe *kpãtãmo̱nõ. *

english_verse: Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
translation_verse: Suomo̱mei, ké̱ Nyoṅmo̱ sumo̱wo̱ ne̱ke̱ le̱, esa ake̱ wo̱ hũ wo̱sumo̱sumō̱ wo̱he. Mat.

english_verse: God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us.
translation_verse: Ene̱ wo̱ke̱-leo̱ ake̱ wo̱hīo̱ emli ni le̱ hũ ehīo̱ wo̱mli, edšake̱ eṅõ le̱die̱ntše̱ e-Mumo̱ le̱ eko ehãwo̱.

english_verse: God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him.
translation_verse: Ni wo̱ le̱ wó̱na ni wo̱mīye odase ake̱ tše̱ le̱ étšũ ebi le̱ ake̱ dše le̱ yiwala-herelo̱. Ioh

english_verse: God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God
translation_verse: Mofēmo ni dšadšeo̱ faṅṅ ake̱ Iesu dši Nyoṅmo̱ bi le̱, Nyoṅmo̱ hĩo̱ emli, ni le̱ hũ ehĩo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ mli.

english_verse: and are sure God loves us. God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us.
translation_verse: Ni wo̱ le̱ wo̱le ni wo̱hé suomo̱ ni Nyoṅmo̱ sumoo̱wo̱ le̱ wo̱ye. Nyoṅmo̱ le̱, *suomo̱ dšile̱, ni moni hīo̱ suomo̱ mli le̱, ehīo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ mli, ni Nyoṅmo̱ hũ hĩo̱ emli. *K.

english_verse: If we truly love others and live as Christ did in this world, we won't be worried about the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Ene̱ mli suomo̱ le̱ éye emū ye̱ ye̱ wo̱mli, koni wo̱ná *ekā̃ ye̱ kodšomo̱ gbĩ le̱ no̱; edšake̱ bo̱ni eyo̱ le̱, nakai wo̱ hũ wo̱yo̱ ye̱ dše ne̱ṅ. *

english_verse: A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
translation_verse: Gbeyeišemo̱ be̱ suomo̱ mli, ši moṅ suomo̱ ni eye emũ le̱ ſie̱o̱ gbeyeišemo̱, edšake̱ gbeyeišemo̱ mli ye̱ pĩmo̱; ši moni šeo̱ gbeyei le̱, enako eye emũ ye̱ suomo̱ mli.

english_verse: We love because God loved us first.
translation_verse: Wo̱sumoo̱le̱, edšake̱ le̱ tšutšu esumo̱wo̱.

english_verse: But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see?
translation_verse: Ke̱dši moko kē̱ ake̱: Mīsumo̱ Nyo-ṅmo̱, ni enye̱o̱ le̱die̱ntše̱ enyemi le̱, amalelo̱ dšile̱. Edšake̱ moni sumo̱o̱ le̱-die̱ntše̱ enyemi ni enaäle̱ le̱, Nyoṅmo̱ ni enaale̱ le̱, té aafe tẽṅ ni eenyẽle̱ esu-mo̱ṅ?

english_verse: The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
translation_verse: Ni ne̱ke̱ kitã ne̱ wó̱ná ke̱-dše̱ eṅõ, koni moni sumoo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ asumo̱ le̱-die̱ntše̱ enyemi hũ. Mar.

english_verse: If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children.
translation_verse: Ene̱ wo̱ke̱-leo̱ ake̱ wo̱sumoo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ bii le̱, ke̱dši wo̱sumoo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ni wo̱yeo̱ ekitãi le̱ ano̱ le̱.

english_verse: God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son.
translation_verse: Ni ene̱ dši odase le̱, ake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ éṅõ nāno̱ wala éhãwo̱, ni ne̱ke̱ wala nē ye̱ ebi le̱ mli.

english_verse: And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱dši wo̱le ake̱ nofēno ni wo̱baäle̱ le̱ eboo̱wo̱ toi le̱, bĕle̱ wo̱le ake̱ nii ni wo̱bale̱ le̱, wo̱nine eše̱ no̱.

english_verse: Suppose you see one of our people commit a sin that isn't a deadly sin. You can pray, and this person will be given eternal life. But the sin must not be one that is deadly.
translation_verse: Ke̱dši moko na enyemi mīfe eša ni dšee gbĕle̱ eša le̱, ebi, ni eehãle̱ wala, mei ni feo̱ eša ni dšee gbẽle̱ eša le̱ṅ. *Gbĕle eša ko ye̱; dšee ene̱ hewe̱ mikē̱o̱ ake̱ ébi le̱. *Mat

english_verse: We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
translation_verse: *Wo̱le ake̱ mofẽmo ni adše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ mli afó̱le̱ le̱, efee eša; ši moṅ moni adše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ mli afó̱le̱ le̱, etoo̱ ehe, ni mofõṅ le̱ etaa ehe. *

english_verse: We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Wo̱le ake̱ wo̱dše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ mli, ni *dšeṅ mũ le̱ fẽ kã mofõṅ le mli; *Gal.

english_verse: We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
translation_verse: ši wo̱le ake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ bi le̱ éba, ni ébahãwo̱ dſēṅmo̱ koni wo̱le ano̱kwafo le̱; ni wo̱ye̱ ano̱kwafo le̱ mli, ye̱ ebi Iesu Kristo le̱ mli; mone̱ dši *ano̱kwa Nyoṅmo̱ le̱ ke̱ nāno̱ wala le̱. *Ioh.

english_verse: Children, you must stay away from idols.
translation_verse: Bii bibii, nyekwe̱a nyehe ni ahía ye̱ wo̱dši ahewo̱. [Amen.]

english_verse: Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do.
translation_verse: Ni agbe̱ne̱ mīkpao fai, Awurã, dšee ake̱ bĕle̱ mīṅmão kitã hē ko, ši moṅ no̱ni wo̱yo̱ ke̱-dše̱ šišidšē le̱: ake̱ wó̱sumo̱ wo̱he,

english_verse: Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ šišiulo̱i pī eba dše le̱ mli, mei ní edšadšee ake̱ Iesu Kristo éba ye̱ helo̱ mli; mone̱ dši šišiulo̱ le̱ ke̱ antikristo le̱.

english_verse: So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward.
translation_verse: Nyekwe̱a nyehe dšogbāṅ, koni wo̱kalādše nii ní wo̱ke̱ nitšumo̱ ená le̱, ši moṅ wo̱ná nyõmo̱wo mū. Gal.

english_verse: Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you.
translation_verse: Mofẽmo ní tõo̱ ní ehĩĩ Kristo tšõmo̱ le̱ mli le̱, ebe̱ Nyoṅmo̱; moni hĩo̱ Kristo tšõmo̱ le̱ mli le̱, le̱ eyo̱ tše̱ le̱ ke̱ bi le̱.

english_verse: If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them.
translation_verse: Ké̱ moko ba nyeṅõ ní ehĩee ne̱ke̱ tšõmo̱ ne̱ le̱, nyekahereale̱ ke̱-baä nyewe, ni nyekaflaäle̱ tete;

english_verse: Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds. Final Greetings
translation_verse: edšake̱ moni flaäle̱ le̱, eke̱le̱ feo̱ ekome ye̱ enitšumo̱i fõdši le̱ amli.

english_verse: I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
translation_verse: Miye̱ nibii pī ní maṅmãnye moṅ, ši *misumo̱o̱ ake̱ mike̱ wolo ke̱ ble̱gi ṅmãa, ši moṅ mihĩe kã no̱ ake̱ maba nyeṅõ ní mike̱nye abawie nābu ke̱ nābu, koni wo̱mīše̱ le̱ ayi. — *

english_verse: Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
translation_verse: Onyemiyō ní ahala le̱ bii le̱ mībio.

english_verse: Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth. Working Together
translation_verse: Mibe̱ mīše̱ ni fá fè ene̱ ake̱ manu ake̱ mibii le̱ nyieo̱ ano̱kwale mli le̱.

english_verse: Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before.
translation_verse: Suolo̱, noni otšuo̱ ohãa nyemimei ni dši gbo̱i le, ano̱kwale mli ofeo̱ ye̱.

english_verse: When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ egbe̱i le̱ ahewo̱ ame̱dše kpo ke̱-te, ni *ame̱hee noko ye̱ dšeṅmãdšiaṅbii le̱ adeṅ. *Bof.

english_verse: We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱ esa ake̱ wo̱hereo̱ ne̱ke̱ gbomei ne̱ atū, koni wo̱tšōmo̱ ano̱kwale le̱ he nanemei-nitšulo̱i. Heb.

english_verse: So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
translation_verse: Nohewo̱ le̱, ké̱ miba dšiṅṅ, makai enitšumo̱i ni etšuo̱ le̱, bo̱ni ewieo̱ wo̱he wiemo̱i fōdši le̱, ni ene̱mei tete hũ fáá hããle̱, ši moṅ le̱dientše̱ eheree nyemimei le̱, ni asaṅ mei ní sumoo̱ ake̱ ame̱afe nakai le̱ etšīo̱ame̱ gbe̱, ni eſieo̱ame̱ ke̱dše̱o̱ asafo le̱ mli.

english_verse: Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
translation_verse: Suolo̱, kākase noni dši efōṅ, ši kasemo̱ noni dši ekpakpa moṅ. Moni feo̱ ekpakpa le̱, edše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ mli; moni feo̱ efõṅ le̱, enako Nyoṅmo̱.

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink.
translation_verse: Miye̱ nibii pī ní maṅmã, ši misumoo ake̱ mike̱ ble̱gi ke̱ pen ṅmãao;

english_verse: I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
translation_verse: ši mihīe kã no̱ ake̱ eſe̱ fiō ke̱ke̱ ni manao, ni wo̱o̱wie nābu ke̱ nābu.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless you with peace! Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.
translation_verse: Hedšo̱le̱ ahão! Wo̱šientše̱mei le̱ mībio. Tšī wo̱šientše̱mei le̱ agbe̱i atã ekomekome oṅãame̱.

english_verse: You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment.
translation_verse: Ni *ṅweibo̱foi hũ ni ehīee ame̱dientše̱ ame̱nukpayeli le̱ mli, ši moṅ ame̱ši ame̱dientše̱ ame̱šihīle̱ le̱, eke̱ nāno̱ kpāi efīmo̱ame̱ eto duṅ kpī mli ehã gbī wulu le̱ no̱ kodšomo̱ le̱. *Ioh

english_verse: Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
translation_verse: Ši *bo̱fonukpa Mikael le̱, beni eke̱ abonsam kodšoo̱ ni eke̱le̱ tāa nā ye̱ Mose gbonyo le̱ hewo̱ le̱, ekaa lōmo̱ kodšomo̱ ko ke̱ eno̱fõ, ši moṅ ekē̱: †Kā, Nuṅtšo̱ le̱ aakã obīe! *Dan.
