english_verse: These people are filthy minded, and by their shameful and selfish actions they spoil the meals you eat together. They are like clouds blown along by the wind, but never bringing any rain. They are like leafless trees, uprooted and dead, and unable to produce fruit.
translation_verse: Mene̱mei dši mei ni woo̱ nyesuomo̱ niyenii le̱ abe mũdši, edšake̱ ame̱ke̱nye yeo̱ nii ni ame̱šee gbeyei, ame̱mīlè̱ ame̱dientše̱ ame̱he, atātui ni nu be̱ ame̱mli ni kō̱yo̱i kplaäame̱ ke̱-bo̱leo̱ ši dšiame̱, tšei ni yibāi ekpla ni ame̱woo yibii, ši ame̱gboi šii enyo̱ ni afãmo̱ame̱ ke̱ ame̱šišifãi,

english_verse: Their shameful deeds show up like foam on wild ocean waves. They are like wandering stars forever doomed to the darkest pits of hell.
translation_verse: ṅšo̱kei hũ ni yo̱ hãmãhãmã *ni fẽo̱ ame̱dientše̱ ame̱hīegbedšianii ame̱ſieo̱, ṅulamii dūdūlo̱i, mei ni asā duṅ kpī le̱ atoame̱ ke̱-mīya nãno̱ le̱. *Ies

english_verse: to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
translation_verse: ni *ebakodšo mei fẽ, ni eekã nõšafelo̱i le̱ ye̱ ame̱nišai-anitšumo̱i fẽ ni ame̱tšu le̱ ke̱ wiemo̱i wawāi fẽ ni ešafelo̱i Nyoṅmo̱ kwalo̱i ewie ye̱ ehe le̱ hewo̱.” *Mat.

english_verse: They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God.
translation_verse: ake̱ ame̱ké̱uye ake̱ *nāgbē be le̱ mli le̱ hefe̱oyelo̱i ni nyieo̱ ye̱ ame̱dientše̱ ame̱ko̱no̱i fõdši le̱ anã le̱ aaba. *

english_verse: And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life.
translation_verse: ni nyetoa nyehe ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ suomo̱ le̱ mli, ni nyekwe̱a wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo mo̱bo̱nale̱ le̱ gbe̱, koni nyená nāno̱ wala,

english_verse: Be helpful to all who may have doubts.
translation_verse: Ni nyefea sro̱to ye̱ mli: meikomei le̱, nyenaäame̱ mo̱bo̱,

english_verse: Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
translation_verse: Nyoṅmo̱ ni dši nilelo̱ kōme ke̱ wo̱yiwalaherelo̱ ye̱ Iesu Kristo, wo̱-Nuṅtšo̱ le̱, hewo̱ le̱, le̱ aṅó̱ anumnyam ke̱ agbodšē, no̱yeli ke̱ hegbe̱ fẽ ahã agbe̱ne̱ ke̱ dã! Amen. Rom.

english_verse: The voice said, “Write in a book what you see. Then send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
translation_verse: ní kē̱ ake̱: *[Midši Alfa le̱ ke̱ Omega le̱, kleṅkleṅmo le̱ ke̱ nāgbēmo le̱.] Noni onaä le̱, ṅmã owo wolo mli, ni oṅõ-mãdše asafoi kpawo ní yo̱ Asia le̱, ní ake̱-ya Efeso, ke̱ Smirna, ke̱ Pergamo, ke̱ Tiatira, ke̱ Sarde, ke̱ Filadelfia, ke̱ Laodikea. *K.

english_verse: His head and his hair were white as wool or snow, and his eyes looked like flames of fire.
translation_verse: ni eyitšo ke̱ eyitšo̱i *yé̱o̱ tamo̱ tōhetšo̱i ye̱ṅ, tamo snō, ni †ehĩṅme̱ii tamo̱ lalile̱i, *Dan.

english_verse: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said: Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last,
translation_verse: Ni beni minale̱ le̱, migbē ši ye̱ enädši anā *tamo̱ gbonyo; ní eke̱ eninedšŭrõ ṅmẽ mino̱, ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Kāše gbeyēi; midsi kleṅkleṅmo le̱ ke̱ nāgbēmo le̱ *Dan.

english_verse: and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead.
translation_verse: ke̱ hĩekãlo̱ le̱; ni migbo, ni na, mihĩe kā ke̱-mīya nāno̱i anāno̱, ni mihĩe gbohĩĩadše ke̱ gbĕle nā samfei le̱.

english_verse: Write what you have seen and what is and what will happen after these things.
translation_verse: Nohewo le̱ ṅmã nii ní ona le̱ ke̱ nii ni yo̱ ke̱ nii ní baba ye̱ nii ne̱ ase̱ le̱:

english_verse: I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.
translation_verse: ṅulamii kpawo ni ona ye̱ mininedšŭrõ no̱ le̱ hetēmo̱sane le̱, ke̱ šika kanetšei kpawo le̱. Ṅulamii kpawo le̱ dši asafoi kpawo le̱ *abo̱foi, ni kanetšei kpawo ni ona le dši asafoi kpawo le̱. *Mal.

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Ni Tiatira asafo le̱ bo̱fo le̱, ṅmã oyahãle̱ ake̱: Nii ní Nyoṅmo̱ bi le̱ ní *ehĩṅme̱ii tamo̱ lalilei ni enãdši tamo̱ ayawa ní kpe̱o̱ nyeramnyeram le̱ kē̱ ne̱: *

english_verse: I know everything about you, including your love, your faith, your service, and how you have endured. I know you are doing more now than you have ever done before.
translation_verse: Mile onitšumo̱i le̱ ke̱ osuomo̱ le̱ ke̱ osúomo̱ le̱ ke̱ ohemo̱-ke̱-yeli le̱ ke̱ otšuišinmē̃ le̱, ni mile onitšumo̱i le̱ ake̱ se̱kpēnii le̱ fè tsutšunii le̱ tete.

english_verse: But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols.
translation_verse: Ši kẽle̱ *mike̱o ye̱ sane ko, ake̱ oṅmẽ yō †Isabel ni tsé̱o̱ ehe gbalo̱yō le̱ gbe, ní etšõ mitšũdši le̱ anii ní elakaame̱, ní ame̱bo̱ adſamaṅ ní ame̱ye wo̱dši afo̱lešãnii. *K.

english_verse: I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.
translation_verse: Ni mihãle̱ be, koni eke̱-tšake etsui, ši esumo̱o̱ ake̱ etšake ke̱-dše̱ edſamaṅbō̱ le̱ mli.

english_verse: I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.
translation_verse: Ni ebii le̱, gbe magbeame̱; ni asafoi le̱ fẽ aana ale ake̱ midsi moni taoo̱ *sabai ke̱ tsuii amli, ní mahã nyeteṅ mofẽmo boni nyenitšumo̱i le̱ yo̱ le̱. *Lal.

english_verse: Some of you in Thyatira don't follow Jezebel's teaching. You don't know anything about what her followers call the “deep secrets of Satan.” So I won't burden you down with any other commands.
translation_verse: Ši mīkē̱nye, nye mei ni nyefe̱ ye̱ Tiatira le̱, mei abo̱ ní ehĩee tsõmo̱ ne̱ mli, ni ame̱lee satan bui ní mli kwo̱ le̱ , ake̱: Mike̱ dšatsu kroko eṅmẽṅ nyeno̱;

english_verse: But until I come, you must hold firmly to the teaching you have.
translation_verse: ši *noni nyeyo̱ le, nyehĩea mli ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní maba. *

english_verse: I will give power over the nations to everyone who wins the victory and keeps on obeying me until the end.
translation_verse: Ni kũnimyelo̱ le̱ ke̱ moni too̱ minitšumo̱i le̱ ke̱-yašio̱ nāgbē le̱, mahãle̱ hegbe̱ ye̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ ano̱,

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: Moni yo̱ toi le̱, hã ní enu noni Mumo̱ le̱ kē̱o̱ asafoi le̱.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Laodicea
translation_verse: Moni yo̱ toi le̱, hã ni enu noni Mumo̱ le̱ kē̱o̱ asafoi le̱.

english_verse: You claim to be rich and successful and to have everything you need. But you don't know how bad off you really are. You are pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ okē̱o̱ ake̱: Niiatše̱ dšimi ni miye̱ nii ni nokonoko ehĩaami, ni olee ake̱ oye̱ amane mli ni onii hũ ye̱ mo̱bo̱ ni ohĩafo ke̱ ſilafo ke̱ heyayaiatše̱ dsio,

english_verse: Buy your gold from me. It has been refined in a fire, and it will make you rich. Buy white clothes from me. Wear them and you can cover up your shameful nakedness. Buy medicine for your eyes, so you will be able to see.
translation_verse: mīwoö ṅā ake̱ *ohé †šika ní atšũ he ye̱ la mli ye̱ miṅõ, koni oná nii, ke̱ atadei ye̱dši, koni owo ní **oyayaiaṅ hĩegbĕle le̱ akakã ši, ke̱ hĩṅme̱i-tšofã ní oke̱-fo ohĩṅme̱ii, koni ona nii. *Ies.

english_verse: Listen! I am standing and knocking at your door. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and we will eat together.
translation_verse: Na, *midamo̱ šĩnā le̱ nā ni mīši; ke̱dši moko nu migbē ni egble šĩnā le̱, †maba eṅõ ni mike̱le̱ aabaye nii ni le̱ hũ eke̱mi aaye. *Luk.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat with my Father on his throne.
translation_verse: Kũnimyelo̱ le̱, mahãle̱ gbe̱ ní eke̱mi atá mimaṅtše̱sẽi le̱ no̱, take̱ bo̱ noṅṅ ni mi hũ miye kũnim, ni mike̱ mitše̱ tá emaṅtše̱sẽi le̱ no̱ le̱. Mat.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: Moni yo̱ toi le̱, hã ni enu noni Mumo̱ le̱ kē̱o̱ asafoi le̱.

english_verse: The first creature was like a lion, the second one was like a bull, the third one had the face of a human, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
translation_verse: Ni kleṅkleṅ hĩekãlo̱ le̱ tamo̱ *dšata, ni hĩekãlo̱ ní dši enyo̱ le̱ tamo̱ tšina, ni hĩekãlo̱ ni dši etẽ le̱ hĩe tamo̱ gbomo, ni hĩekãlo̱ ní dši edſe̱ le̱ tamo̱ okropoṅ ní flikio̱. *Ezek.

english_verse: Each of the four living creatures had six wings, and their bodies were covered with eyes. Day and night they never stopped singing, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord, the all-powerful God, who was and is and is coming!”
translation_verse: Ni hĩekãlo̱i edſe̱ le̱ ateṅ mofẽmo ye̱ fĩdši ekpa-ekpa, ni ame̱hewo̱ ke̱ ame̱-mli eyimo̱ obõbõ ke̱ hĩṅme̱ii so̱ṅṅ, ni ame̱dšo̱o̱ ame̱he nyōṅ ke̱ ſane ni ame̱kē̱o̱ ake̱: *Kroṅkroṅ, kroṅkroṅ, kroṅkroṅ dši Nuṅtšo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ Ofe le̱, moni ye̱ le̱ ke̱ moni yo̱ le̱ ke̱ moni baba le. *Ies.

english_verse: The living creatures kept praising, honoring, and thanking the one who sits on the throne and who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ni beni hĩekãlo̱i le̱ ṅõo̱ anumnyam ke̱ agbodšē ke̱ šidā ame̱hãa moni tá maṅtše̱sẽi le̱ no̱ ní ehĩe kã ke̱-dše̱ nāno̱ ke̱-yaä nāno̱ le̱,

english_verse: “Our Lord and God, you are worthy to receive glory, honor, and power. You created all things, and by your decision they are and were created.”
translation_verse: Nuṅtšo̱, bo dši moni sa ake̱ oṅõ anumnyam ke̱ agbodšē ke̱ hewale̱ le̱, edšake̱ bo obo̱ nii fẽ, ni osuomo̱ nā ame̱-yo̱ ni abo̱ame̱.

english_verse: and they were saying in a loud voice, “The Lamb who was killed is worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise.”
translation_verse: ni ame̱ke̱ gbē wulu kē̱ ake̱: Tōbi ní agbe le̱ sa ake̱ eṅõ *hewale̱ ke̱ nifále̱ ke̱ nilē ke̱ nyẽmo̱ ke̱ agbodšē ke̱ anumnyam ke̱ dšō̱mo̱. *

english_verse: Then I heard all beings in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and in the sea offer praise. Together, all of them were saying, “Praise, honor, glory, and strength forever and ever to the one who sits on the throne and to the Lamb!”
translation_verse: Ni minu ake̱ bō̱nii fẽ ni yo̱ ṅwei ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ šiši ke̱ ṅšo̱ hīe ke̱ nii fẽ ní yo̱ ame̱mli le̱ kē̱ ake̱: Aṅõ dšō̱mo̱ ke̱ agbodšē ke̱ anumnyam ke̱ no̱yeli le̱ áhã moni tá maṅtše̱sẽi le̱ no̱ le̱ ke̱ tōbi le̱ ke̱-dše̱ nāno̱ ke̱-ya nāno̱!

english_verse: The four living creatures said “Amen,” while the elders knelt down and worshiped.
translation_verse: Ni hĩekãlo̱i edſe̱ le̱ kē̱: Amen. Ni onukpai nyoṅmai-enyo̱ ke̱ edſe̱ le̱ ho gbē ši, ni ame̱dšá moni hĩe kã ke̱-dše̱ nãno̱ ke̱-yaä nãno̱ le̱.

english_verse: I heard what sounded like a voice from somewhere among the four living creatures. It said, “A liter of wheat will cost you a whole day's wages! Three liters of barley will cost you a day's wages too. But don't ruin the olive oil or the wine.”
translation_verse: Ni minu gbē ko ye̱ hĩekãlo̱i edſe̱ le̱ ateṅ mīke̱: Ṅmā̃ susumo̱nõ kome denario, ni able susumo̱nii etẽ denario; ni mũ ke̱ wein le̱ kãta he!

english_verse: Then each of those who had been killed was given a white robe and told to rest for a little while. They had to wait until the complete number of the Lord's other servants and followers would be killed.
translation_verse: Ni aṅõ atade yū ni *ye̱o̱ ahã ame̱teṅ mofẽmo, ni akē̱ame̱ ake̱ amē̱dšō̱ ame̱he be fiō ko lolo, ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ní ame̱nanemei-tšũdši le̱ ke̱ ame̱nyemimei le̱ hũ ni abagbeame̱ take̱ bo̱ni agbe amedientše hũ le̱ ayikule le̱ aase̱. *

english_verse: When I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, I looked and saw a great earthquake. The sun turned as dark as sackcloth, and the moon became red as blood.
translation_verse: Ni mina beni etše nāso̱omo̱ ní dši ekpa le̱, ni na, šikpoṅ hoso babaō, ni *hũlũ tšṍ ediṅ tamo̱ tšo̱i-kotoku, ni nyoṅtšere mŭ le̱ tšṍ tamo lá; *Ies.

english_verse: The stars in the sky fell to earth, just like figs shaken loose by a windstorm.
translation_verse: ni ṅwei ṅulamii le̱ tšere̱ ſie šikpoṅ, *tamo bo̱ni agbãmitšo yi agbãmii ṅmlikitii ſieo̱ ši, beni kō̱yo̱ kpeteṅkple hosoo̱le̱ le̱; *Ies.

english_verse: Then the sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all mountains and islands were moved from their places.
translation_verse: ni ṅwei tši ehe ke̱-te tamo̱ akotaä wolo; ni atšire̱ goṅ-fẽ-goṅ ke̱ ṅšo̱kpo̱-fẽ-ṅšo̱kpo̱ ke̱-dše̱ ame̱gbe̱hei.

english_verse: The kings of the earth, its famous people, and its military leaders hid in caves or behind rocks on the mountains. They hid there together with the rich and the powerful and with all the slaves and free people.
translation_verse: Ni šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ maṅtše̱mei le̱ ke̱ mei agboi le̱ ke̱ asafoiatše̱mei le̱ ke̱ niiatše̱inei le̱ ke̱ hewalo̱i le̱, ke̱ nyṍṅ-fẽ-nyṍṅ ke̱ odehe-fẽ-odehe *yatētē ame̱he ye̱ bui amli ke̱ gõdši ate̱sāi amli, *Ies.

english_verse: Then they shouted to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us! Hide us from the one who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb.
translation_verse: ni *ame̱kē̱ gõdši le̱ ke̱ te̱sāi le̱ ake̱: Nyegbea wo̱ne̱, ni nyetēawo̱ ke̱-dše̱a moni tá maṅtše̱sẽi le̱ no̱ le̱ hĩe ke̱ tōbi le̱ mlifŭ le̱ nā. Luk.

english_verse: That terrible day has come! God and the Lamb will show their anger, and who can face it?”
translation_verse: Edšake̱ emlifũ gbĩ wulu le̱ eše̱, ni namo aanyẽ ši adamo̱? Rom.

english_verse: One of the elders asked me, “Do you know who these people are that are dressed in white robes? Do you know where they come from?”
translation_verse: Ni onukpai le̱ ateṅ mokome here no̱ ekē̱mi ake̱: Mei ní wo atadei ye̱dši ne̱, namei ni, ni nẽgbe̱ ame̱dše̱?

english_verse: They will never hunger or thirst again, and they won't be troubled by the sun or any scorching heat.
translation_verse: Hõmo̱ yeṅame̱ doṅṅ, ni kũmai hũ yeṅame̱ doṅṅ, ni asaṅ hũlũ lo latšã ko esaṅ amehe doṅṅ; Ies.

english_verse: “The Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. He will lead them to streams of life-giving water, and God will wipe all tears from their eyes.”
translation_verse: edšake̱ *tōbi le̱ ni yo̱ maṅtše̱sẽi le̱ teṅ le̱ aalè̱ame̱, ni †eetšõame̱ gbe̱ ke̱-ate wala nubui ahe, ni **Nyoṅmo̱ aatšumo̱ ame̱hĩeaṅ yāfónui fẽ. *

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
translation_verse: Ni heni etše nāso̱omo̱ ni dši kpawo le̱, afe *diṅṅ ye̱ ṅwei aafe ṅmletſā fã. *Zak.

english_verse: Another angel, who had a gold container for incense, came and stood at the altar. This one was given a lot of incense to offer with the prayers of God's people on the gold altar in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Ni bo̱fo kroko ba ni ebadamo̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ he, ni ehĩe *šika tšofã-ke̱-ṅma šānõ, ni aṅõ tšofã-ke̱-ṅma babaō ahãle̱, koni eṅõ-fata kroṅkroṅbii le̱ fe aso̱lemo̱i le̱ ahe ye̱ šika afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ ni mã maṅtše̱sẽi le̱ hĩe le̱ no̱. *

english_verse: Then the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God's people, went up to God from the hand of the angel.
translation_verse: Ni tšofā-ke̱-ṅma le̱ lasũ le̱ *te ši ke̱-dše̱ bo̱fo lo̱ deṅ ke̱-yafata kroṅkroṅbii le̱ aso̱lemo̱i le̱ ahe ke̱-te Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe. *Lal.

english_verse: After this, the angel filled the incense container with fire from the altar and threw it on the earth. Thunder roared, lightning flashed, and the earth shook. The Trumpets
translation_verse: Ni bo̱fo le̱ ko̱ tšofā-ke̱-ṅma šãnõ le̱, ni edše afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ no̱ la le̱ eko ewole̱ obo, ni *etši eſie šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni gbẽi ke̱ nyoṅmo̱šĩmo̱i ke̱ srawai ke̱ šikpoṅhosomo̱ ba. *Ezek.

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a lone eagle flying across the sky. It was shouting, “Trouble, trouble, trouble to everyone who lives on earth! The other three angels are now going to blow their trumpets.”
translation_verse: Ni mina, ni minu *okropoṅ ko mīfliki ye̱ ṅwei teṅ, ni eke̱ gbē wā kē̱: †Kpóo, kpóo, kpóo hã mei ni hĩo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ ye̱ bo̱foi etẽ ní bakpã́ le̱ ate̱tre̱mantre̱i agbēi ní eſe̱ le̱ ahewo! *

english_verse: The locusts were allowed to make them suffer for five months, but not to kill them. The suffering they caused was like the sting of a scorpion.
translation_verse: Ni ahāame̱ hegbe̱ ake̱ ame̱ka-gbeame̱, ši moṅ ame̱pĩame̱ nyõdši enumo̱. Ni ame̱nã dšramo̱ le̱ tamo̱ nyoṅmo̱ṅkrakro dšramo̱, kē̱ etšẽ mo le̱.

english_verse: In those days people will want to die, but they will not be able to. They will hope for death, but it will escape from them.
translation_verse: Ni nakai gbĩĩ le̱ amli le̱ gbomei *aafe gbĕle, ši ame̱náṅ, ni ame̱asumo̱ ake ame̱agboi, ši gbĕle aadšo amenā foi. *Luk.

english_verse: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice speak from the four corners of the gold altar that stands in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Ni bo̱fo ní dši ekpa le̱ kpã́, ni minu gbē ko dše̱ *šika afo̱lesãlate ni mã Nyoṅmo hĩe le̱ aklontoi edſe̱ le̱ mli *

english_verse: The voice spoke to this angel and said, “Release the four angels who are tied up beside the great Euphrates River.”
translation_verse: kē̱ bo̱fo ní dši ekpa le̱ ní hĩe te̱tre̱mantre̱ le̱ ake̱: Fẽnemo̱ bo̱foi edſe̱ le̱ ní afĩmo̱ ye̱ *Eufrate fā kpeteṅkple le̱ nā le̱! *

english_verse: The four angels had been prepared for this very hour and day and month and year. Now they were set free to kill a third of all people.
translation_verse: Ni afẽne bo̱foi edſe̱ le̱ ní asā ato ṅmle̱tſā le̱ ke̱ gbĩ le̱ ke̱ nyõn le̱ ke̱ afi le̱, koni ame̱gbe gbomei amlidšāi *etẽ mli ekome. *

english_verse: In my vision their riders wore fiery-red, dark-blue, and yellow armor on their chests. The heads of the horses looked like lions, with fire and smoke and sulfur coming out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Ni bo̱ni mina okpo̱ṅo̱i le̱ ke̱ ame̱no̱trálo̱i le̱ ye̱ ninā le̱ mli ne̱: ni ame̱damai ní ame̱wo le̱ asu tamo̱ la ke̱ afaseo diṅ ke̱ swō̱ damai; ni okpo̱ṅo̱i le̱ ayitsei tamo̱ dšatai ayitsei, ni la ke̱ lasũ ke̱ swō̱ fãa ke̱-dse̱o̱ ame̱dãṅ.

english_verse: One third of all people were killed by the three terrible troubles caused by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur.
translation_verse: Ne̱ke̱ haomo̱i etẽ, ni dši la ke̱ lasũ ke̱ swō̱ ní fãa ke̱-dse̱o̱ ame̱dãṅ ne̱, ake̱-gbe gbomei amlidšāi etẽ mli ekome.

english_verse: The horses had powerful mouths, and their tails were like poisonous snakes that bite and hurt.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ okpo̱ṅo̱i le̱ ahewale̱i ye̱ ame̱dãṅ ke̱ ame̱leii amli, edšake̱ ame̱leii le̱ tamo̱ onũfũi, ni yitšei ye̱ he, ni nomei ame̱ke̱-feo̱ efõṅ.

english_verse: No one stopped murdering or practicing witchcraft or being immoral or stealing.
translation_verse: ni asaṅ ame̱tšakee ame̱tšui ke̱-dše̱e̱ ame̱wuyelii ke̱ ame̱sũi ke̱ ame̱dſamaṅbō̱ ke̱ ame̱dšūi le̱ amli.

english_verse: The angel I had seen standing on the sea and the land then held his right hand up toward heaven.
translation_verse: Ni bo̱fo le̱ ní mina ake̱ edamo ṅšo̱ le̱ no̱ ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ wó eninedšŭrõ no̱ ke̱-te ṅwei,

english_verse: God told his secret plans to his servants the prophets, and it will all happen by the time the seventh angel sounds his trumpet.”
translation_verse: ši moṅ *bo̱fo ní dši kpawo le̱ gbē le̱ gbĩĩ le̱ amli, beni eheo̱ ekpã́ le̱, no le̱ †agbe Nyoṅmo̱ tēmo̱sane le̱ hũ nā, bo̱ni edšadše sanekpakpa le̱ etšõ le̱dientše̱ etšũdši ní dši gbaloi le. *

english_verse: Once again the voice from heaven spoke to me. It said, “Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel standing on the sea and the land.”
translation_verse: Ni gbē ni minu ke̱-dše̱ ṅwei le̱ *ke̱mi wie ekoṅ, ni eke: Ya ní oyahe †wolo le̱ ní agble nā le̱ ye̱ bo̱fo ní damo ṅšo le̱ no ke̱ šikpoṅ le no̱ le̱ deṅ. *K.

english_verse: When I went over to ask the angel for the little scroll, the angel said, “Take the scroll and eat it! Your stomach will turn sour, but the taste in your mouth will be sweet as honey.”
translation_verse: Ni mite bo̱fo le̱ ṅõ ni miyakē̱le̱ ake̱: Ṅõ wolo bibiō le̱ obãmi. Ni ekē̱mi ake̱: *Hemo̱ ni oye, ni eedšō ye̱ omũsũṅ, ši odāṅ moṅ le̱ eeṅõ do̱ko̱do̱ko̱ tamo̱ wò, *Ezek.

english_verse: I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. The taste was sweet as honey, but my stomach turned sour.
translation_verse: Ni mihe wolo bibiō le̱ ye̱ bo̱fo le̱ deṅ ni miye, ni eṅõ do̱ko̱do̱ko̱ ye̱ midāṅ tamo̱ wò, ni beni miye le̱, edšō ye̱ mimũsũ mli.

english_verse: Then some voices said, “Keep on telling what will happen to the people of many nations, races, and languages, and also to kings.”
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱mi ake̱: Esa ake̱ ogba ekoṅ ye̱ mãdši ke̱ dšeṅmãdši ke̱ mãdšiano̱wiemoi ke̱ maṅtše̱mei pī ahe.

english_verse: They have the power to lock up the sky and to keep rain from falling while they are prophesying. And whenever they want to, they can turn water to blood and cause all kinds of terrible troubles on earth.
translation_verse: Mene̱mei ye̱ hegbe̱ ake̱ *ame̱ṅã́a ṅwei nā, koni nu akane ye̱ ame̱gbale̱ gbĩĩ le̱ amli; ni ame̱ye̱ †hegbe̱ hũ ye̱ nui le̱ ano̱ ake̱ ame̱hāa etšṍo̱ lá, ni ame̱-ke̱ haomo̱ haoo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ šii abo̱ ní ame̱sumoo̱. *

english_verse: At that same moment there was a terrible earthquake that destroyed a tenth of the city. Seven thousand people were killed, and the rest were frightened and praised the God who rules in heaven.
translation_verse: Ni nakai ṅmle̱tſā le̱ no̱ noṅṅ le̱ šikpoṅ hoso wā, ni maṅ le̱ mlidšãi nyoṅma mli ekome wule; ní šikpoṅhosomo̱ le̱ mli le̱ agbe gbomei akpei-kpawo, ni mei ni ſe̱ le̱ še gbeyei, ni ame̱ṅõ anumnyam ame̱hã ṅwei Nyoṅmo̱ le̱.

english_verse: They said, “Lord God All-Powerful, you are and you were, and we thank you. You used your great power and started ruling.
translation_verse: ame̱kē̱: Wo̱mīdao ši, bo *Nuṅtšo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ Ofe le̱, bo moni oyo ni oye̱ ní obaba le̱, ake̱ oṅõ ohewale̱ kpeteṅkple le̱ ni oye maṅtše̱, *

english_verse: When the nations got angry, you became angry too! Now the time has come for the dead to be judged. It is time for you to reward your servants the prophets and all your people who honor your name, no matter who they are. It is time to destroy everyone who has destroyed the earth.”
translation_verse: ni dšeṅmãdši le̱ amli efũ, ni *omlifũ ešẽ ke̱ be ní abakodšo gbohĩĩ le̱ ni abawo otšũdši ní dši gbaloi le̱ ke̱ kroṅkroṅbii le̱ ke̱ mei ní šeo̱ ogbe̱i le̱ gbeyei, mei bibii ke̱ mei wudši le̱, anyõmo̱, ni abafite mei ní fiteo̱ šikpoṅ le̱. *

english_verse: The door to God's temple in heaven was then opened, and the sacred chest could be seen inside the temple. I saw lightning and heard roars of thunder. The earth trembled and huge hailstones fell to the ground.
translation_verse: Ni agble Nyoṅmo̱ *so̱lemo̱tšũ le̱ nā ye̱ ṅwei, ni ana ekpãṅmo̱ adeka le̱ ye̱ eso̱lemo̱tšũ le̱ṅ, ni †srawai ke̱ gbēi ke̱ nyoṅmo̱šimo̱i ke̱ šikpoṅhosomo̱ ke̱ nyoṅmo̱ṅte̱i babaō ba. *

english_verse: With its tail, it dragged a third of the stars from the sky and threw them down to the earth. Then the dragon turned toward the woman, because it wanted to eat her child as soon as it was born.
translation_verse: Ni elei mīgbla ṅwei *ṅulamii amlidšāi etẽ mli ekome, ni etšire̱ame̱ eſie šikpoṅ le̱ no̱. Ni drako le̱ badamo̱ yō le̱ ní bafo le̱ hĩe, koni, ké̱ efo̱ le̱, ní emĩ ebi le̱. *Dan.

english_verse: and were thrown down to the earth. Yes, that old snake and his angels were thrown out of heaven! That snake, who fools everyone on earth, is known as the devil and Satan.
translation_verse: Ni *ašé̱ drako kpeteṅkple le̱ afõ, moni dši †blema onũfũ le̱ ní atšé̱o̱le̱ diabolo le̱ ke̱ satan le̱ ní šišiuo̱ dšeṅ mū le̱ fẽ le̱, ašé̱le̱ afõ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni aše̱re̱ ebo̱foi le̱ hũ aſie afata ehe. *Luk

english_verse: “Our people defeated Satan because of the blood of the Lamb and the message of God. They were willing to give up their lives.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱ le̱, *tōbi le̱ lá le̱ ke̱ ame̱dientše̱ †ame̱daseyeli wiemo le̱ **ame̱ke̱-ye eno̱ kũnim, ni ame̱do̱o̱ ame̱dientše̱ ame̱wala he ke̱-yaši gbĕle mli tete. *

english_verse: When the dragon realized it had been thrown down to the earth, it tried to make trouble for the woman who had given birth to a son.
translation_verse: Ni beni drako le̱ na ake̱ ašé̱le̱ afõ šikpoṅ le̱, etiu yō le̱ ní fo̱ nū le̱.

english_verse: The snake then spewed out water like a river to sweep the woman away.
translation_verse: Ni onũfũ le̱ fẽ̀ nu ní tamo̱ fā ko ke̱-dše̱ edāṅ eſie yō le̱ se̱, koni nu le̱ ášále̱ ke̱-ya.

english_verse: But the earth helped her and swallowed the water that had come from the dragon's mouth.
translation_verse: Ni šikpoṅ le̱ ye bua yō le̱; ni šikpoṅ le̱ gble edāṅ ní emĩ fā le̱ ní drako le̱ fẽ̀ ke̱-dše̱ edāṅ eſie le̱.

english_verse: This made the dragon terribly angry with the woman. So it started a war against the rest of her children. They are the people who obey God and are faithful to what Jesus did and taught.
translation_verse: Ni drako le̱ mli fũ yō le̱, ni eyiṅ ete ní eke̱ yō le̱ sešibii ní eſe̱ ni *yeo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ kitãi le̱ ano̱ ni ame̱hĩe †Iesu Kristo odase le̱ ayawu. *

english_verse: The dragon stood on the beach beside the sea.
translation_verse: Ni eyadamo̱ ṅšo̱ nā šia le̱ no̱.

english_verse: The beast cursed God, and it cursed the name of God. It even cursed the place where God lives, as well as everyone who lives in heaven with God.
translation_verse: Ni egble enabu ewie musubō̱-wiemo̱i eši Nyoṅmo̱, ni ewie egbe̱i le̱ ke̱ ebū le̱ ke̱ mei ní hĩo̱ ṅwei le̱ ahe musu-bō̱-wiemo̱i.

english_verse: I now saw another beast. This one came out of the ground. It had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
translation_verse: Ni mina kolo *kroko mīdše kpo ke̱-mīdše̱ šikpoṅ le̱ mli, ni eye aklontoi enyo̱ †tamo̱ tōbi ni ewieo tamo̱ drako.

english_verse: It worked for the beast whose fatal wound had been healed. And it used all its authority to force the earth and its people to worship that beast.
translation_verse: Ni etšuo̱ kleṅkleṅ kolo le̱ *hegbe̱ le̱ fẽ he nii ye̱ ehĩe, ni ehãa šikpoṅ le̱ ke̱ mei ni yo̱ eno̱ le̱ dšáa kleṅkleṅ kolo le̱ ni atšá egbĕle-pilamo̱ le̱. *K.

english_verse: This second beast fooled people on earth by working miracles for the first one. Then it talked them into making an idol in the form of the beast that did not die after being wounded by a sword.
translation_verse: ni *eke̱ okadii ni ená hegbe̱ ake̱ efe ye̱ kolo le̱ hĩe le̱ ešišiuo̱ mei ni yo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱, ni ekē̱o̱ mei ní yo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ ake̱ amé̱fe amãgã ame̱hã kolo le̱ ní yo̱ klante nā pilamo̱ ní ehĩe kã le̱. *

english_verse: All people were forced to put a mark on their right hand or forehead. Whether they were powerful or weak, rich or poor, free people or slaves,
translation_verse: Ni ehãa mei fe, mei bibii ke̱ mei wudšĩ, niiatše̱meĩ ke̱ ohĩafoi, odehei ke̱ nyõdši kplẽo̱ ni *akadio̱ame̱ ye̱ amenine dsŭrõ alo ame̱hĩeṅtšei ano̱; *

english_verse: You need wisdom to understand the number of the beast! But if you are smart enough, you can figure this out. Its number is
translation_verse: Bie̱ *nilē le̱ yo̱. Moni yo̱ dſẽṅmo̱ le̱ abu kolo le̱ †yibo̱ le̱ he akontā; edšake̱ gbomo yibo̱ ni; ni eyibo̱ le̱ dši ohai-ekpa ke̱ nyoṅmai-ekpa ke̱ ekpa. *

english_verse: They never tell lies, and they are innocent. The Messages of the Three Angels
translation_verse: ni anaa amale ko ye̱ ame̱dāṅ, edšake̱ kpa ko be̱ ame̱he [ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ maṅtše̱sẽi le̱ hĩe].

english_verse: I saw another angel. This one was flying across the sky and had the eternal good news to announce to the people of every race, tribe, language, and nation on earth.
translation_verse: Ni mina *bo̱fo kroko mīfliki ye̱ ṅwei teṅ, ni ehĩe nāno̱ sanekpakpa ní eyadšadse etšõ mei ní yo̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ ke̱ dšeṅmaṅ-fẽ-dšeṅmaṅ ke̱ akutšo-fẽ-akutšo ke̱ mãdšiano̱wiemo̱i fẽ ke̱ maṅ-fẽ-maṅ, ni eke̱ gbē wulu kē̱: *

english_verse: Finally, a third angel came and shouted: Here is what will happen if you worship the beast and the idol and have the mark of the beast on your hand or forehead.
translation_verse: Ni bo̱fo kroko ni dši etẽ nyie ame̱se̱, ni eke̱ gbē wulu kē̱: Ké̱ moko dšá kolo le̱ ke̱ emãgã le̱, ni ehé ekadi le̱ ye̱ ehĩeṅtšo no̱ lo *enine no̱ le̱: *

english_verse: If you worship the beast and the idol and accept the mark of its name, you will be tortured day and night. The smoke from your torture will go up forever and ever, and you will never be able to rest.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱pĩmo̱ le̱ *lasũ le̱ teo̱ ši ke̱-yaä nāno̱i anāno̱; ni mei ní dšáa kolo le̱ ke̱ emãgã le̱, ke̱ mofẽmo ní ehé egbe̱i okadi le̱, náá hedšomo nyōṅ ke̱ ſane. *

english_verse: I looked and saw a bright cloud, and someone who seemed to be the Son of Man was sitting on the cloud. He wore a gold crown on his head and held a sharp sickle in his hand.
translation_verse: Ni mikwe̱, ni na, *atatu ye̱ṅ, ni moko tá atatu le̱ no̱ tamo̱ gbomobi le̱, ni šika akekre fĩ eyitšo, ni ehĩe †nikpamo-kakla ni nā ba ye̱ edeṅ. *Dan.

english_verse: The one on the cloud swung his sickle and harvested the crops.
translation_verse: Ni moni tá atatu le̱ no̱ le̱ še̱ enikpamo̱-kakla le̱ efõ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱, ni akpa šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ nii le̱.

english_verse: Another angel with a sharp sickle then came out of the temple in heaven.
translation_verse: Ni bo̱fo kroko dše kpo ke̱-dše̱ so̱lemo̱tšũ le̱ ní yo̱ ṅwei le̱ mli, ni le̱ hũ ehĩe kakla ní nā ba.

english_verse: After this, an angel with power over fire came from the altar and shouted to the angel who had the sickle. He said, “All grapes on earth are ripe! Harvest them with your sharp sickle.”
translation_verse: Ni be̱fo kroko dše kpo ke̱-dše̱ afo̱lešãlate̱ le̱ mli, ní yo̱ la no̱ hewale̱, ni ebo etšé̱ moni hĩe kakla ní nā ba le̱ ke̱ blo̱mo̱ ní nā wa ake̱: *Oke̱ okakla ní nā ba le̱ awo mli, ni obua šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ weinyibii šabii le̱ anā, edšake̱ eweinyibii le̱ étšu! *K.

english_verse: The pit was outside the city, and when the grapes were mashed, blood flowed out. The blood turned into a river that was about
translation_verse: Ni anānā *weinṅã̀nõ le̱ no̱ ye̱ maṅ le̱ ṅmaṅmaša le̱, ní lá dše̱ weinṅã̀nõ le̱ mli ke̱-yaše̱ okpo̱ṅo̱i le̱ adãṅnii le̱ ahe ye̱ stadioi akpe ke̱ ohai-ekpa dšeke̱mo̱ mli. *Ies.

english_verse: and they were singing the song his servant Moses and the Lamb had sung. They were singing, “Lord God All-Powerful, you have done great and marvelous things. You are the ruler of all nations, and you do what is right and fair.
translation_verse: Ni ame̱la Nyoṅmo̱ tšũlo̱ *Mose lala le̱ ke̱ †tōbi le̱ lala le̱ ame̱kē̱: **Onitšumo̱i le̱ dăra ni ame̱ye̱ nākpe̱, Nuṅtšo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ Ofe; ogbe̱i le̱ dša ni ano̱kwa dšiame̱, bo dšeṅmãdši le̱ amaṅtše̱. *

english_verse: After this, I noticed something else in heaven. The sacred tent used for a temple was open.
translation_verse: Ni nii ne̱ ase̱ le̱ mikwe̱, ni na, *agble odase bū le̱ so̱lemo̱tšŭ le̱ nā ye̱ ṅwei, *

english_verse: One of the four living creatures gave each of the seven angels a bowl made of gold. These bowls were filled with the anger of God who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ni *hĩekãlo̱i edſe̱ le̱ ateṅ mokome ṅõ šika toi kpawo ní †eyimo̱ obõbõ ke̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ni hīe kã ke̱-yaä nāno̱i anāno̱ le̱ mlila le̱ ehã bo̱foi kpawo le̱. *

english_verse: The second angel emptied his bowl on the sea. At once the sea turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
translation_verse: Ni bo̱fo ní dši enyo̱ le̱ fo̱se eto̱ le̱ mli nii le̱ ewo ṅšo̱ṅ; ni etšṍ lá tamo̱ gbonyo nõ, ni nofẽno ní hĩe kã ye̱ ṅšo̱ le̱ mli le̱ gbo.

english_verse: After this, I heard the altar shout, “Yes, Lord God All-Powerful, your judgments are honest and fair.”
translation_verse: Ni minu *afo̱lesãlate̱ le̱ mīkē̱: Hē̃, Nuṅtšo̱ Nyoṅmo̱ Ofe, †ano̱kwa ke̱ dšale̱ dši okodšomoi le̱. *

english_verse: Remember Christ says, “When I come, it will surprise you like a thief! But God will bless you, if you are awake and ready. Then you won't have to walk around naked and be ashamed.”
translation_verse: Na, *mība take̱ dšulo̱. Adšō̱ moni sraã ni etoo̱ etadei le̱, koni ekanyie †yayai ní ana ehĩegbĕle le. *

english_verse: Those armies came together in a place that in Hebrew is called Armagedon.
translation_verse: Ni ebua ame̱nā ke̱-te heko ní atšé̱o̱ dše̱i ye̱ Hebri wiemo mli ake̱ *Harmagedon le̱. *Kods.

english_verse: As soon as the seventh angel emptied his bowl in the air, a loud voice from the throne in the temple shouted, “It's done!”
translation_verse: Ni bo̱fo ní dši kpawo le̱ fo̱se eto̱ le̱ mli nii le̱ ewo kō̱yo̱ mli; ni gbē kpeteṅkple ko dše̱ ṅwei so̱lemo̱tšũ le̱ṅ ke̱-dše̱ maṅtše̱sẽi le̱ṅ kē̱ ake̱: Agbe nā!

english_verse: The great city of Babylon split into three parts, and the cities of other nations fell. So God made Babylon drink from the wine cup filled with his anger.
translation_verse: Ni *maṅ kpeteṅkple le̱ mli gbla etẽ, ni dšeṅmãdši le̱ amãdši le̱ wule, ni akai Babilon kpeteṅkple le̱ ye̱ Nyoṅmo̱ hĩe, koni aṅõ emlifũ ní nā wa le̱ †kpulu le̱ mli dā̃ le̱ ahãle̱. *

english_verse: I could tell that the woman was drunk on the blood of God's people who had given their lives for Jesus. This surprising sight amazed me,
translation_verse: Ni mina yō le̱ ake̱ kroṅkroṅbii le̱ alá le̱ ke̱ Iesu he odasefoi le̱ alá le̱ ēto̱le̱ dā̃; ni beni minale̱ le̱, mināa kpe̱ mihe naakpa.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom can figure this out. The seven heads that the woman is sitting on stand for seven hills. These heads are also seven kings.
translation_verse: Bie̱ *dſẽṅmo̱ ní nilē yo̱ mli le̱ yo̱. †Yitšei kpawo le̱ dši gõdši kpawo ní yō le̱ tá no̱ le̱, ni maṅtše̱mei kpawo ni. *

english_verse: You also saw a beast that used to be and no longer is. That beast is one of the seven kings who will return as the eighth king, but only to be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ni kolo le̱ ní yo̱ ní ebe̱ le̱, le̱ dši moni dši kpānyo, ni edše̱ mei kpawo le amli, ni ēya *hĩekpãtãmo̱ mli. *K.

english_verse: The oceans you saw the prostitute sitting on are crowds of people from all races and languages.
translation_verse: Ni ekē̱mi ake̱: *Nui le̱ ni ona ni yō adſamaṅ le̱ tá no̱ le̱ dši †mãdši ke̱ asafoi ke̱ dšeṅmãdši ke̱ mãdšianowiemoi. *K.

english_verse: The ten horns and the beast will start hating the shameless woman. They will strip off her clothes and leave her naked. Then they will eat her flesh and throw the rest of her body into a fire.
translation_verse: Ni *aklontoi nyoṅma ní ona le̱, ke̱ kolo le̱, ame̱anye̱ adſamaṅ le̱, ni ame̱afele̱ amaṅfõ, ni ame̱aṅmẽle̱ yayai, ni ame̱aye ehelo, ni †ame̱ke̱ la aašãle̱. *K.

english_verse: God is the one who made these kings all think alike and decide to give their power to the beast. And they will do this until what God has said comes true.
translation_verse: Edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ke̱-wo ame̱tšuiiaṅ koni ame̱fe eyiṅtōnii le̱, ni ame̱hĩe dſēṅmo̱ kome, ni ame̱ke̱ ame̱maṅtše̱yeli le̱ ahã kolo le̱ ke̱-yaši beyino̱ ni *aagbe nii ní Nyoṅmo̱ ekē̱ le̱ anā. *

english_verse: Every merchant on earth will mourn, because there is no one to buy their goods.
translation_verse: Ni šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ dšrayelo̱i le̱ aafóle̱ ni ame̱ayele̱ ṅko̱mo̱, edšake̱ mokomoko hee ame̱dšrayelinibii le̱ doṅṅ: Ezek

english_verse: The merchants had become rich because of her. But when they saw her sufferings, they were terrified. They stood at a distance, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Ne̱ke̱ nibii ne̱ aguo̱yelo̱i ní etšṍmo̱ niiatše̱mei ye̱ mli le̱ aadamo̱ se̱ fle̱ṅṅ ye̱ epĩmo̱ le̱ gbeyeišemo̱ le̱ hewo̱, ni ame̱-afó ni ame̱aye ṅko̱mo̱

english_verse: When they saw the smoke from her fire, they shouted, “This was the greatest city ever!”
translation_verse: ni beni ame̱na ešā̃ le̱ *lasũ le̱, ame̱blo̱ ame̱kē̱: Mẽ maṅ tamo̱ maṅ kpeteṅkple ne̱? *Ies.

english_verse: The heavens should be happy with God's people and apostles and prophets. God has punished her for them.”
translation_verse: Bo ṅwei, ke̱ nye kroṅkroṅbii ke̱ bo̱foi ke̱ gbalo̱i, *nyenyie ye̱ ehewo̱, edšake̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ekodšole̱ ehãnye. *Ies.

english_verse: A powerful angel then picked up a huge stone and threw it into the sea. The angel said, “This is how the great city of Babylon will be thrown down, never to rise again.
translation_verse: Ni bo̱fo ko ni he wa wó *te̱ ko ni tamo̱ w̌ie̱ wulu, ni ešé̱ efo ṅšo̱ṅ ekē̱: Ne̱ke̱ aašé̱ Babilon maṅ kpeteṅkple le̱ afo trukā, ni anaṅle̱ kwrā doṅṅ. *Ier

english_verse: The music of harps and singers and of flutes and trumpets will no longer be heard. No workers will ever set up shop in that city, and the sound of grinding grain will be silenced forever.
translation_verse: Ni *anuṅ saṅkũtſalo̱i ke̱ lalatše̱mei ke̱ ble̱kpãlo̱i ke̱ te̱tre̱mantre̱kpãlo̱i le̱ agbē kwrā doṅṅ ye̱ omli, ni anaṅ ṅālo̱-ko-ṅālo̱ ko ní le ṅã ko kwrā doṅṅ ye̱ omli, ni anuṅ w̌ie̱ gbē̱mo̱ he hũ kwrā doṅṅ ye̱ omli, *Ies.

english_verse: On the streets of Babylon is found the blood of God's people and of his prophets, and everyone else.”
translation_verse: ni emli *ana gbalo̱i ke̱ kroṅkroṅ-bii ke̱ mei fẽ ni agbe ye̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ le̱ alá le̱ ye̱. *

english_verse: You can eat the flesh of kings, rulers, leaders, horses, riders, free people, slaves, important people, and everyone else.”
translation_verse: koni nyebaye maṅtše̱mei alo ke̱ asafoiatše̱mei alo ke̱ hewalo̱i alo ke̱ okpo̱ṅo̱i alo ke̱ mei ní trá ame̱no̱ le̱ alō ke̱ odehei ke̱ nyõdsi ke̱ mei bibii ke̱ mei wudši fẽ alō.

english_verse: I also saw the beast and all kings of the earth come together. They fought against the rider on the white horse and against his army.
translation_verse: Ni mina *kolo le̱ ke̱ šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ maṅtše̱mei le̱ ke̱ ame̱tai ní †abua nā le̱, ni ame̱ke̱ moni tá okpo̱ṅo̱ le̱ no̱ le̱ ke̱ eta le̱ yawu. *

english_verse: But the rest of their army was killed by the sword that came from the mouth of the rider on the horse. Then birds stuffed themselves on the dead bodies.
translation_verse: Ni mei ní fe̱ le̱, ake moni tá okpo̱ṅo̱ le̱ no̱ le̱ tši ní dseo̱ edãṅ le̱ gbeame̱, ni lofõdši fẽ tŏ̱ro̱ ke̱ ame̱lōi le̱.

english_verse: He will fool the countries of Gog and Magog, which are at the far ends of the earth, and their people will follow him into battle. They will have as many followers as there are grains of sand along the beach,
translation_verse: ni eedše kpo, ni eyašisiu dšeṅmãdši le̱ ní yo̱ šikpoṅ kodši edſe̱ le̱ mli le̱, *Gog le̱ ke̱ Magog le̱, koni ebua ame̱nā ke̱-kpe ni ameya ta; mei ayibo̱ ni †tamo̱ ṅšo̱ nā šia le̱. *Ezek.

english_verse: I saw a great white throne with someone sitting on it. Earth and heaven tried to run away, but there was no place for them to go.
translation_verse: Ni mina *maṅtše̱sẽi ye̱ṅ ko ní da, ke̱ moni tá no̱ le̱, ní šikpoṅ ke̱ ṅwei †dšo foi ye̱ ehĩe, ni anáá gbe ahãame̱. *Mat

english_verse: I also saw all the dead people standing in front of that throne. Every one of them was there, no matter who they had once been. Several books were opened, and then the book of life was opened. The dead were judged by what those books said they had done.
translation_verse: Ni mina gbohĩĩ le̱, mei bibii ke̱ mei wudši, damo̱ maṅtše̱sẽi le̱ hĩe, ni *agble wodši anā; ni agble †wolo kroko ni dši wala-wolo le̱ hũ nā. Ni akodšo gbohĩĩ le̱ ye̱ nibii ní aṅmã ye̱ wodši le̱ amli le̱ anā, **bo̱ni sa ame̱nitšumo̱i le̱. *Dan

english_verse: The sea gave up the dead people who were in it, and death and its kingdom also gave up their dead. Then everyone was judged by what they had done.
translation_verse: Ni ṅšo̱ dšie gbohĩĩ ní yo̱ emli le̱ ehā, ni gbĕle ke̱ gbohĩĩadše dšie gbohĩĩ ni yo̱ ame̱mli le̱ ame̱hã; ni akodšoame̱, mofẽmo bo̱ni sa enitšumo̱i le̱. Ioh.

english_verse: Afterwards, death and its kingdom were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
translation_verse: Ni *gbĕle ke̱ gbohĩĩadše le̱, aše̱re̱-ame̱ aſie la kpākpo le̱ mli. Ene̱ dši gbĕle ní dši enyo̱ le̱, la kpākpo le̱ ne̱. *

english_verse: Anyone whose name wasn't written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
translation_verse: Ni ke̱ moko ye̱ ní anaa ake aṅmã egbe̱i ye̱ wala-wolo le̱ mli le̱, ašé̱o̱le̱ afõo̱ *la kpākpo le̱ mli. *

english_verse: I saw one of the seven angels who had the bowls filled with the seven last terrible troubles. The angel came to me and said, “Come on! I will show you the one who will be the bride and wife of the Lamb.”
translation_verse: Ni *bo̱foi kpawo ní hīe te̱i kpawo ní eyimo̱ obõbõ ke̱ nāgbē haomo̱i kpāwo le̱ ateṅ mokome ba miṅõ ni eke̱mi bawie ekē̱: Ba, ní matšõo †ayemforo le̱ ní dši tōbi le̱ ṅã le̱. *

english_verse: Then with the help of the Spirit, he took me to the top of a very high mountain. There he showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down from God in heaven.
translation_verse: Ni eṅõmi ye̱ mumo̱ mli ke̱-te *goṅ kple ko ni kwo̱ no̱, ni etšõmi maṅ kpeteṅkple le̱ ni dši Ierusalem kroṅkroṅ le̱ ní edše̱ Nyoṅmo̱ ṅõ ye̱ ṅwei ẽkpleke ši, *Ezek.

english_verse: Three of these gates were on the east, three were on the north, three more were on the south, and the other three were on the west.
translation_verse: Agbói etẽ ye̱ bokãgbe̱, ni agbói etẽ ye̱ kōyigbe̱, ni agbói etẽ ye̱ wuoyi-gbe̱, ni agbói etẽ ye̱ anaigbe̱.

english_verse: Then the angel measured the wall, and by our measurements it was about
translation_verse: Ni esusu egbogbo le̱, efe ninetalo̱i oha ke̱ nyoṅmai-edſe̱ ke̱ edſe̱ ye̱ gbomo susumo̱nõ ní bo̱fo le̱ hĩe le̱ nā.

english_verse: The wall was built of jasper, and the city was made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: Ni noni ake̱-tſa egbogbo le̱ dši yaspi-te̱, ni maṅ le̱ šika kro̱ṅṅ ni tamo̱ aſiſe̱ kro̱ṅṅ ni.

english_verse: Each of the twelve gates was a solid pearl. The streets of the city were made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: Ni agbói nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱ le̱ adiagbai nyoṅma ke̱ enyo̱ ni, agbó kome le̱ adiagba kome ake̱-fe. Ni maṅ le̱ *blohũ le̱ šika kro̱ṅṅ ni, ni emli tše tamo aſiſe̱.

english_verse: Nations will walk by the light of that city, and kings will bring their riches there.
translation_verse: Ni dšeṅmădši [ní ahere ame̱yiwala] le̱ aanyie ye̱ ela le̱ mlĩ, ni šikpoṅ le̱ no̱ maṅtše̱mei le̱ aaṅõ ame̱numnyam le̱ ke̱-ba mli. Ies.

english_verse: Its gates are always open during the day, and night never comes.
translation_verse: Ni *egbói le̱ aṅã́mo̱ṅ kwrā ſane; edšake̱ †nyōṅ be̱ dše̱i; *Ies.

english_verse: The glorious treasures of nations will be brought into the city.
translation_verse: ni ame̱ke̱ dšeṅmãdši le̱ anumnyam le̱ ke̱ ame̱wō le̱ aaba mli.

english_verse: But nothing unworthy will be allowed to enter. No one who is dirty-minded or who tells lies will be there. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of life will be in the city.
translation_verse: Ni noko ní he tšee ke̱ moni feo̱ nihĩnii ke̱ moni maleo̱ boteṅ mli kwrā, ake̱ dša mei ní aṅmã ame̱gbe̱i ye̱ tōbi le̱ wala-wolo le̱ mlĩ le̱.

english_verse: Then I was told: I am coming soon! And when I come, I will reward everyone for what they have done.
translation_verse: *Na, mība oyá, ni †mihĩe minyõmo̱wo le̱ ke̱-mība, ní **mawo mofẽmo nyõmo̱ ye̱ enitšumo le̱ nā. *K.

english_verse: God will bless all who have washed their robes. They will each have the right to eat fruit from the tree that gives life, and they can enter the gates of the city.
translation_verse: Adšō̱ mei ní fo̱ö̱ ametadei le̱ ahe le̱, koni ame̱ná hegbe̱ ye̱ walatšo le̱ no̱, ni ame̱tšṍ agbói le̱ amli ke̱-bote maṅ le̱ mli.

english_verse: I am Jesus! And I am the one who sent my angel to tell all of you these things for the churches. I am David's Great Descendant, and I am also the bright morning star.
translation_verse: *Mi, Iesu, mitšũ mibote le̱ koni †ebaye nii ne̱ ahe odase etšõnye ye̱ asafoi le̱ amli. Midši David **šišifã le̱ ke̱ esešinyo le̱, ††tolō ní kpe̱o̱ le̱. *

english_verse: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Everyone who hears this should say, “Come!” If you are thirsty, come! If you want life-giving water, come and take it. It's free!
translation_verse: Ni *Mumo̱ le̱ ke̱ ayemforo le̱ kē̱o̱ ake̱: Ba! Ni moni nuo̱ le̱, hã ni eke: Ba! Ni moni †kũmai yeo̱le̱ le̱, hã ni eba, ni moni sumoo̱ le̱, hã ni ebaye wala-nu le̱ yaka. *Rom.

english_verse: Here is my warning for everyone who hears the prophecies in this book: If you add anything to them, God will make you suffer all the terrible troubles written in this book.
translation_verse: Mi mīye odase mīhã mofẽmo ní nuo̱ ne̱ke̱ wolo ne̱ mli gbale̱ wiemo̱i le̱ ake̱: Ke̱dši moko ke̱ noko fata nii ne̱ ahe le̱, Nyoṅmo̱ aaṅõ haomo̱i *ni aṅmã ye̱ ne̱ke̱ wolo ne̱ mli le̱ afata he abale; *

english_verse: If you take anything away from these prophecies, God will not let you have part in the life-giving tree and in the holy city described in this book.
translation_verse: ni ke̱dši *moko dšie noko ke̱-dše̱ ne̱ke̱ gbale̱ wolo ne̱ mli wiemo̱i le̱ amli le̱, Nyoṅmo̱ aadšie egbemi ke̱-adše̱ wala-wolo le̱ ke̱ maṅ kroṅkroṅ le̱ ke̱ nii ni aṅmã ye̱ ne̱ke̱ wolo ne̱ mli le̱ amli. *

english_verse: The one who has spoken these things says, “I am coming soon!” So, Lord Jesus, please come soon!
translation_verse: Moni yeo̱ ne̱ke̱ nii ne̱ he odase le̱ mīkē̱ ake̱: Hē̃, miba oyá. Amen. Hē̃, ba, Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu!

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Wo̱ Nuṅtšo̱ Iesu Kristo dromo̱ le̱ ke̱ nyefe ahĩ ši! Amen.

english_verse: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
translation_verse: Shishijee mli lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ.

english_verse: The earth was barren, with no form of life; it was under a roaring ocean covered with darkness. But the Spirit of God was moving over the water. The First Day
translation_verse: Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ olɛŋlɛ, ni efee flóŋŋ, ni duŋ ha nu babaoo ni ha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hiɛ; ni Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ ha nu lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: God said, “I command light to shine!” And light started shining.
translation_verse: Ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã akɛ, “La aba.” Kɛkɛ ni la ba.

english_verse: God looked at the light and saw that it was good. He separated light from darkness
translation_verse: Ni Nyɔŋmɔ na akɛ la lɛ hi. Ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbala la lɛ kɛ duŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: and named the light “Day” and the darkness “Night.” Evening came, then morning—that was the first day. The Second Day
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ la lɛ shwane, ni duŋ lɛ etsɛ lɛ nyɔɔŋ. Je na, ni je tsɛre, ni no ji klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ.

english_verse: God said, “I command a dome to separate the water above it from the water below it.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã akɛ, “Atatu aba koni eja nu lɛ mli enyɔ.”

english_verse: and named it “Sky.” Evening came, then morning—that was the second day. The Third Day
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ he ni atatu lɛ yɔɔ lɛ akɛ ŋwɛi. Je na, ni je tsɛre; no ji gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ.

english_verse: God said, “I command the water under the sky to come together in one place, so there will be dry ground.” And that's what happened.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã akɛ, “Nu ni yɔɔ ŋwɛishishi lɛ abua ehe naa yɛ he kome, koni ana shikpɔŋ gbiŋ lɛ!” Ni eba mli nakai.

english_verse: God named the dry ground “Land,” and he named the water “Ocean.” God looked at what he had done and saw that it was good.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ he ni egbi lɛ akɛ shikpɔŋ, ni nu ni ebua ehe naa lɛ etsɛ lɛ ŋshɔ; ni Nyɔŋmɔ na akɛ ehi.

english_verse: Evening came, then morning—that was the third day. The Fourth Day
translation_verse: Ni je na, ni je tsɛre; ni no fee gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ.

english_verse: God said, “I command lights to appear in the sky and to separate day from night and to show the time for seasons, special days, and years.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã akɛ, “Kanei aba ŋwɛi atatu lɛ mli koni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ teŋ srɔto ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ okadii kɛ bei kɛ gbii kɛ afii,

english_verse: I command them to shine on the earth.” And that's what happened.
translation_verse: ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ kanei yɛ ŋwɛi atatuiaŋ ni amɛtso yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Ni eba mli nakai.

english_verse: God made two powerful lights, the brighter one to rule the day and the other to rule the night. He also made the stars.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ kanei wuji enyɔ lɛ koni ewulu lɛ aye shwane nɔ ni bibioo lɛ aye nyɔɔŋ nɔ, ni ebɔ ŋulamii lɛ hu.

english_verse: Then God put these lights in the sky to shine on the earth,
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ amɛ wo ŋwɛi atatu lɛ mli koni amɛtso yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,

english_verse: to rule day and night, and to separate light from darkness. God looked at what he had done, and it was good.
translation_verse: koni amɛye shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ nɔ, ni amɛgbala la lɛ kɛ duŋ lɛ mli. Nyɔŋmɔ na akɛ ehi.

english_verse: Evening came, then morning—that was the fourth day. The Fifth Day
translation_verse: Ni je na ni je tsɛre ni no fee gbi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ.

english_verse: God said, “I command the ocean to be full of living creatures, and I command birds to fly above the earth.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã akɛ, “Nu lɛ awo loi nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ, ni loofɔji afliki yɛ ŋwɛi kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli!”

english_verse: So God made the giant sea monsters and all the living creatures that swim in the ocean. He also made every kind of bird. God looked at what he had done, and it was good.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ ŋshɔŋ loi wuji lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã ni tsiɔ ehe ni nu lɛ ewo nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ lɛ. Asaŋ ebɔ loofɔji fɛɛ yɛ amɛhenɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ na akɛ ehi.

english_verse: Then he gave the living creatures his blessing—he told the ocean creatures to increase and live everywhere in the ocean and the birds to increase everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ amɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛfɔa koni nyɛyi afaa ni nyɛyimɔa fai kɛ ŋshɔ mli obɔ̃bɔ̃, ni loofɔji afa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ!”

english_verse: Evening came, then morning—that was the fifth day. The Sixth Day
translation_verse: Ni je na ni je tsɛre, ni efee gbi ni ji enumɔ lɛ.

english_verse: God said, “I command the earth to give life to all kinds of tame animals, wild animals, and reptiles.” And that's what happened.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã akɛ, “Shikpɔŋ lɛ awo bɔɔnii ni hiɛ kã yɛ amɛhenɔ: shĩa kooloi kɛ kooloi ni wamɔɔ kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi yɛ amɛhenɔ!” Ni eba mli nakai.

english_verse: God made every one of them. Then he looked at what he had done, and it was good.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ ŋaŋ kooloi yɛ amɛhenɔ kɛ shĩaŋ kooloi yɛ amɛhenɔ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni wamɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ yɛ amɛhenɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ na akɛ ehi.

english_verse: God said, “Now we will make humans, and they will be like us. We will let them rule the fish, the birds, and all other living creatures.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔbɔa gbɔmɔ adesa yɛ wɔsu nɔ, tamɔ wɔhenɔ, koni eye ŋshɔŋ loi kɛ loofɔji kɛ shĩaŋ kooloi kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wamɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ!”

english_verse: So God created humans to be like himself; he made men and women.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ gbɔmɔ adesa yɛ esu nɔ, Nyɔŋmɔ su lɛ nɔ ebɔ lɛ yɛ, ebɔ nuu, ni ebɔ yoo.

english_verse: God gave them his blessing and said: Have a lot of children! Fill the earth with people and bring it under your control. Rule over the fish in the ocean, the birds in the sky, and every animal on the earth.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ amɛ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfɔa ni nyɛyi afa. Nyɛyea ŋshɔŋ loi kɛ ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã ni tsiɔ ehe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ anɔ.”

english_verse: And I have given the green plants as food for everything else that breathes, including animals, both wild and tame, and birds. And so it was.
translation_verse: “Kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ kɔɔyɔŋ loofɔlɔ fɛɛ loofɔlɔ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wamɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni wala mumɔ yɔɔ emli lɛ, mikɛ baa fɔ fɛɛ baa fɔ ehã lɛ koni eye!” Ni eba mli nakai.

english_verse: God looked at what he had done. All of it was very good! Evening came, then morning—that was the sixth day.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kwɛ nibii ni efee lɛ fɛɛ, ni naa, ehi naakpa. Ni je na ni je tsɛre; ni no fee gbi ni ji ekpaa.

english_verse: So the heavens and the earth and everything else were created. The Seventh Day
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni agbe ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ amɛsafoi lɛ fɛɛ bɔɔ naa ahã.

english_verse: God blessed the seventh day and made it special, because on that day he rested from his work.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ ni efee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ no nɔ ejɔɔ ehe yɛ, be ni egbe ebɔɔ nitsumɔ ni etsu lɛ fɛɛ naa lɛ.

english_verse: That's how God created the heavens and the earth. The Garden of Eden When the Lord God made the heavens and the earth,
translation_verse: Ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋbɔɔ he saji nɛ. Eden Trom lɛ Be ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ je lɛ,

english_verse: no grass or plants were growing anywhere. God had not yet sent any rain, and there was no one to work the land.
translation_verse: ŋa nɔ baa ko bɛ ni ŋa nɔ jwɛi ko nako akwɛ̃ ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hãko nu anɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni gbɔmɔ ko bɛ ni huɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: But streams came up from the ground and watered the earth.
translation_verse: Shi afua teɔ shi kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ bɔ, ni eshwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ nu.

english_verse: The Lord God took some soil from the ground and made a man. God breathed life into the man, and the man started breathing.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ sũ shɔ̃ gbɔmɔ, ni emu wala mumɔ ewo egugɔ mli, ni gbɔmɔ tsɔ bɔɔnɔ ni hiɛ kã.

english_verse: The Lord made a garden in a place called Eden, which was in the east, and he put the man there.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ fee trom yɛ Eden yɛ bokãgbɛ, ni ekɛ gbɔmɔ ni eshɔ̃ lɛ to jɛi.

english_verse: The Lord God filled the garden with all kinds of beautiful trees and fruit trees. Two other trees were in the middle of the garden. One of these gave life—the other gave the wisdom to know the difference between right and wrong.
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hã tsei fɛɛ ni kɛ akwɛ ni aaaba mɔ tsine ni amɛhi hã yeli hu kwɛ̃ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ sũ lɛ mli. Ehã wala tso kɛ ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋlee tso hu kwɛ̃ yɛ trom lɛ teŋ.

english_verse: From Eden a river flowed out to water the garden, then it divided into four rivers.
translation_verse: Ni faa ko hoɔ yɛ Eden mli ni hãa trom lɛ nu. Egbalaa niji ejwɛ kɛjɛɔ jɛi.

english_verse: The first one is the Pishon River that flows through the land of Havilah,
translation_verse: Klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Pishon. Ehoɔ kɛbɔleɔ Hawila shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ, he ni shika yɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: where pure gold, rare perfumes, and precious stones are found.
translation_verse: Nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shika lɛ hi naakpa; ni bedola ojeŋma kɛ onike tɛ hu yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: The second is the Gihon River that winds through Ethiopia.
translation_verse: Faa ni ji enyɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Gihon. Ehoɔ kɛbɔleɔ Kush shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: The Tigris River that flows east of Assyria is the third, and the fourth is the Euphrates River.
translation_verse: Faa ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ gbɛi ji Tigris. Ehoɔ yɛ Asiria bokãgbɛ. Faa ni ji ejwɛ lɛ gbɛi ji Eufrate.

english_verse: The Lord God put the man in the Garden of Eden to take care of it and to look after it.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ni ekɛ lɛ bato Eden trom lɛ mli koni ehu mli ni ebu he.

english_verse: But the Lord told him, “You may eat fruit from any tree in the garden,
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ akɛ, “Trom lɛ mli tsei lɛ fɛɛ nɔ yibii lɛ ye bɔ ni osumɔɔ;

english_verse: except the one that has the power to let you know the difference between right and wrong. If you eat any fruit from that tree, you will die before the day is over!”
translation_verse: shi ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋlee tso lɛ yibii lɛ kaaye ejaakɛ gbi nɔ ni oooye eko lɛ, gbo ooogbo!”

english_verse: The Lord God said, “It isn't good for the man to live alone. I will make a suitable partner for him.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, “Ehiii akɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ koome hiɔ shi, mafee hefatalɔ ko ni sa lɛ mahã lɛ.”

english_verse: So the Lord God made him fall into a deep sleep, and he took out one of the man's ribs. Then after closing the man's side,
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hã wɔ ni tsii nyɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ nɔ ni ewɔ. Be ni ewɔ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jie eŋmawu wui lɛ ekome, ni ekɛ loo tsi wui lɛ anajiaŋ.

english_verse: the Lord made a woman out of the rib. The Lord God brought her to the man,
translation_verse: Ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ŋmawu wu ni ejie yɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ fee yoo, ni ekɛ lɛ ba gbɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.

english_verse: and the man exclaimed, “Here is someone like me! She is part of my body, my own flesh and bones. She came from me, a man. So I will name her Woman!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni gbɔmɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Mihe nɔ nɛ! Wu ni jɛ miwui amli, kɛ loo ni jɛ miheloo mli nɛ. Mɔ nɛ lɛ aaatsɛ lɛ yoo ejaakɛ nuu mli ajie lɛ kɛjɛ.”

english_verse: That's why a man will leave his own father and mother. He marries a woman, and the two of them become like one person.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nuu aaashi etsɛ kɛ enyɛ, ni eeekpɛtɛ eŋa he, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ kome.

english_verse: Although the man and his wife were both naked, they were not ashamed.
translation_verse: Amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ, nuu lɛ kɛ eŋa lɛ, nyiɛ yayai, shi amɛhiɛ gbooo he.

english_verse: The snake was sneakier than any of the other wild animals that the Lord God had made. One day it came to the woman and asked, “Did God tell you not to eat fruit from any tree in the garden?”
translation_verse: Onufu ji kooloo ko ni le ŋaa fe kooloi fɛɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ lɛ. Ebi yoo lɛ akɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ trom lɛ mli tsei ayibii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ nyɛkaye lɛ?”

english_verse: The woman answered, “God said we could eat fruit from any tree in the garden,
translation_verse: Ni yoo lɛ kɛɛ onufu lɛ akɛ, “Trom lɛ mli tsei ayibii lɛ wɔyeɔ,

english_verse: except the one in the middle. He told us not to eat fruit from that tree or even to touch it. If we do, we will die.”
translation_verse: shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ tso ni yɔɔ trom lɛ teŋ lɛ nɔ yibii lɛ, ‘Nyɛkayea, ni nyɛkataa he tete, kɛjeee nakai lɛ nyɛbaagboi.’ ”

english_verse: “No, you won't!” the snake replied.
translation_verse: Onufu lɛ kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Jeee gboimɔ nyɛaagboi;

english_verse: “God understands what will happen on the day you eat fruit from that tree. You will see what you have done, and you will know the difference between right and wrong, just as God does.”
translation_verse: shi moŋ le Nyɔŋmɔ le akɛ gbi nɔ ni nyɛaaye eko lɛ, nyɛhiŋmɛi aaagbele, ni nyɛaatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ lɛ, ni nyɛaale ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋ.”

english_verse: The woman stared at the fruit. It looked beautiful and tasty. She wanted the wisdom that it would give her, and she ate some of the fruit. Her husband was there with her, so she gave some to him, and he ate it too.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ be ni yoo lɛ na akɛ tso lɛ hi hã yeli ni efeɔ hiŋmɛi akɔnɔ ni tso lɛ baa mɔ tsine ni ehãa mɔ leɔ nii lɛ, etse enɔ yibii lɛ eko ni eye ni ehã ewu lɛ ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ hu eko ni eye.

english_verse: At once they saw what they had done, and they realized they were naked. Then they sewed fig leaves together to cover themselves.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛhiŋmɛi gbele ni amɛna akɛ amɛnyiɛ yayai. Amɛkpɛ agbãmi baa amɛkɛfee mama amɛkɛha amɛhe.

english_verse: Late in the afternoon, when the breeze began to blow, the man and woman heard the Lord God walking in the garden. So they hid behind some trees. Sin Brings a Curse
translation_verse: Amɛnu Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ he ni enyiɛ trom lɛ mli be ni gbɛkɛnaashi kɔɔyɔɔ shwie lɛ; ni Adam kɛ eŋa lɛ tee amɛhe yɛ trom lɛ mli tsei lɛ ateŋ koni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ akana amɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God called out to the man and asked, “Where are you?”
translation_verse: Shi Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ Adam ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ oyɔɔ?”

english_verse: The man answered, “I was naked, and when I heard you walking through the garden, I was frightened and hid!”
translation_verse: Ni Adam kɛɛ, “Minu ohe yɛ trom lɛ mli, ni mishe gbeyei ejaakɛ minyiɛ yayai ni miyatee mihe.”

english_verse: “How did you know you were naked?” God asked. “Did you eat any fruit from that tree in the middle of the garden?”
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ bi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ kɛɛ bo akɛ onyiɛ yayai? Te tso lɛ ni miwo bo he kitã akɛ okaye eyibii lɛ eko lɛ, no oye nɛɛ?”

english_verse: “It was the woman you put here with me,” the man said. “She gave me some of the fruit, and I ate it.”
translation_verse: Ni Adam kɛɛ akɛ, “Yoo lɛ ni okɛfata mihe lɛ, lɛ ehã mi tso lɛ yibii lɛ eko ni miye.”

english_verse: The Lord God then asked the woman, “What have you done?” “The snake tricked me,” she answered, “and I ate some of that fruit.”
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni ofee nɛɛ?” Ni yoo lɛ kɛɛ, “Onufu lɛ ni laka mi ni miye.” Nyɔŋmɔ kojomɔ

english_verse: So the Lord God said to the snake: “Because of what you have done, you will be the only animal to suffer this curse— For as long as you live, you will crawl on your stomach and eat dirt.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ onufu lɛ akɛ, “Enɛ ni ofee hewɔ lɛ, alomɔ bo yɛ shĩaŋ kooloi kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ ateŋ. Omusu nɔ ooonyiɛ, ni sũ oooye owala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: You and this woman will hate each other; your descendants and hers will always be enemies. One of hers will strike you on the head, and you will strike him on the heel.”
translation_verse: Mikɛ nyɛɛ aaaŋmɛ bo kɛ yoo lɛ teŋ, kɛ oshwiei kɛ eshwiei ateŋ. Eshwiei aaatswa oyitso nɔ, ni bo hu oshwiei aaakɔ̃ enane tsitsi.”

english_verse: Then the Lord God said to the woman, “You will suffer terribly when you give birth. But you will still desire your husband, and he will rule over you.”
translation_verse: Yoo lɛ, lɛ lɛ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hã mahã ohe ajara bo, yɛ omusuhiɛmɔ mli. Hejaramɔ mli ooofɔ bii yɛ; owu lɛ sɛɛgbɛ oootao, ni lɛ eeeye onɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to the man, “You listened to your wife and ate the fruit I told you not to eat. And so, the ground will be under a curse because of what you did. As long as you live, you will have to struggle to grow enough food.
translation_verse: Ni Adam lɛ, ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Akɛni obo oŋa lɛ toi ni oye tso lɛ ni miwo bo he kitã akɛ okaye eyibii lɛ eko lɛ hewɔ lɛ, alomɔ shikpɔŋ sũ yɛ ohewɔ. Hejaramɔ okɛaana enɔ nii oye owala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Your food will be plants, but the ground will produce thorns and thistles.
translation_verse: Ŋmei kɛ aŋɛ̃ŋlɛ̃ eeewo ehã bo, ni ŋa nɔ baa oooye.

english_verse: You will sweat all your life to earn a living; you were made out of soil, and you will once again turn into soil.”
translation_verse: Ohiɛ latsaa mli oooye nii yɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni oooku osɛɛ kɛaatee shikpɔŋ sũ mli; ejaakɛ emli ajie bo kɛjɛ; sũ ji bo, ni sũ mli nɔŋŋ oooku osɛɛ kɛaatee.”

english_verse: The man Adam named his wife Eve because she would become the mother of all who live.
translation_verse: Adam wo eŋa lɛ gbɛi akɛ Hawa ejaakɛ lɛ ji adesai fɛɛ anyɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord God made clothes out of animal skins for the man and his wife.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ kooloo hewolo fee atadei ehã Adam kɛ eŋa lɛ, ni ekɛwo amɛ. Ashwie Adam kɛ Hawa kɛje Trom lɛ mli

english_verse: The Lord said, “They now know the difference between right and wrong, just as we do. But they must not be allowed to eat fruit from the tree that lets them live forever.”
translation_verse: Ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, “Naa, gbɔmɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ tamɔ wɔteŋ mɔ kome, ni ele ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋ. Agbɛnɛ, eko lɛ eeekpã enine mli ni etse wala tso lɛ yibii lɛ eko ni eye koni ehiɛ akã kɛya naanɔ.”

english_verse: So the Lord God sent them out of the Garden of Eden, where they would have to work the ground from which the man had been made.
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shwie lɛ kɛje Eden trom lɛ mli koni eyahu shikpɔŋ, nɔ mli ni ajie lɛ kɛjɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Then God put winged creatures at the entrance to the garden and a flaming, flashing sword to guard the way to the life-giving tree.
translation_verse: Ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shwie Adam, ni ekɛ kerubim kɛ klante ni miifo ehe ni kpɛlɛɔ tamɔ la to Eden trom lɛ hiɛ yɛ bokãgbɛ koni ebu gbɛ ni yaa wala tso lɛ he lɛ he.

english_verse: Adam and Eve had a son. Then Eve said, “I'll name him Cain because I got him with the help of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Adam kɛ eŋa Hawa na bɔlɛ. Hawa na musu ni efɔ Kain, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mina binuu yɛ Yehowa yelikɛbuamɔ naa”.

english_verse: Later she had another son and named him Abel. Abel became a sheep farmer, but Cain farmed the land.
translation_verse: Kain sɛɛ lɛ efɔ enyɛmi Habel. Habel tsɔ̃ tookwɛlɔ, ni Kain tsɔ̃ okwaafonyo.

english_verse: One day, Cain gave part of his harvest to the Lord,
translation_verse: Yɛ mli aahu lɛ Kain kɛ eŋmɔshi nii lɛ eko yashã afɔle ehã Yehowa.

english_verse: and Abel also gave an offering to the Lord. He killed the first-born lamb from one of his sheep and gave the Lord the best parts of it. The Lord was pleased with Abel and his offering,
translation_verse: Habel hu kɛ etoi lɛ akromɔbii ni ewo fɔ ba ekɛbashã afɔle. Yehowa hiɛ sɔ Habel kɛ efɔle lɛ;

english_verse: but not with Cain and his offering. This made Cain so angry that he could not hide his feelings.
translation_verse: shi ehiɛ esɔɔɔ Kain kɛ efɔle lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, Kain mli wo la naakpa, ni etũ ehiɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Cain: What's wrong with you? Why do you look so angry?
translation_verse: Yehowa bi Kain akɛ, “Mɛɛba omli ewo la, ni mɛɛba otũ ohiɛ nɛkɛ?

english_verse: If you had done the right thing, you would be smiling. But you did the wrong thing, and now sin is waiting to attack you like a lion. Sin wants to destroy you, but don't let it!
translation_verse: Aso kɛji ofee ekpakpa lɛ, ohiɛ baŋ nyam? Kɛji ofeee ekpakpa lɛ, esha bu oshinaa lɛ shi, ni bo osɛɛgbɛ etaoɔ lɛ; shi bo lɛ ye enɔ kunim.”

english_verse: Cain said to his brother Abel, “Let's go for a walk.” And when they were out in a field, Cain attacked and killed him.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Kain kɛɛ enyɛmi Habel akɛ, “Hã ni wɔya ŋa lɛ nɔ wɔba.” Be ni amɛyɔɔ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, Kain te shi wo enyɛmi Habel ni egbe lɛ.

english_verse: Afterwards the Lord asked Cain, “Where is Abel?” “How should I know?” he answered. “Am I supposed to look after my brother?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bi Kain akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ onyɛmi Habel yɔɔ?” Kain to he akɛ, “Mileee; ani minyɛmi lɛ, enɔkwɛlɔ ji mi lo?”

english_verse: Then the Lord said: Why have you done this terrible thing? You killed your own brother, and his blood flowed onto the ground. Now his blood is calling out for me to punish you.
translation_verse: Ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni ofee nɛɛ? Onyɛmi lɛ la miibolɔ kɛmiijɛ shikpɔŋ sũ mli eetsɛ mi.

english_verse: And so, I'll put you under a curse. Because you killed Abel and made his blood run out on the ground, you will never be able to farm it again.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ alomɔ bo yɛ shikpɔŋ ni gbɛ edaaŋ ekɛmi onyɛmi lɛ la lɛ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: When you try to farm the land, it won't produce anything for you. From now on, you'll be without a home, and you'll spend the rest of your life wandering from place to place.
translation_verse: Kɛji ohu shikpɔŋ lɛ ebaŋ nii ehaŋ bo yɛ ehewalɛ naa dɔŋŋ. Kobɔlɔ kɛ shikpalɔ oootsɔ̃ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ!”

english_verse: “You're making me leave my home and live far from you. I will have to wander about without a home, and just anyone could kill me.”
translation_verse: Naa, oshwie mi ŋmɛnɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni matee mihe yɛ ohiɛ. Mitsɔ̃ kobɔlɔ kɛ shikpalɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaana mi lɛ, eeegbe mi.”

english_verse: “No!” the Lord answered. “Anyone who kills you will be punished seven times worse than I am punishing you.” So the Lord put a mark on Cain to warn everyone not to kill him.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Kain akɛ, “Dabida! Kɛji mɔ ko gbe Kain lɛ, aaatɔ Kain he owele shii kpawo.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa to okadi yɛ Kain he koni kɛji mɔ ko na lɛ lɛ, ekagbe lɛ.

english_verse: But Cain had to go far from the Lord and live in the Land of Wandering, which is east of Eden. More and More People
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Kain je Yehowa hiɛ etee, ni eyahi shi yɛ Nod shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Eden bokãgbɛ. Kain Shwiei

english_verse: Later, Cain and his wife had a son named Enoch. At the time Cain was building a town, and so he named it Enoch after his son.
translation_verse: Kain kɛ eŋa lɛ na bɔlɛ, ni ena musu ni efɔ Henok. Kain to maŋ ni ekɛ ebi Henok gbɛi wo maŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then Enoch had a son named Irad, who had a son named Mehujael, who had a son named Methushael, who had a son named Lamech.
translation_verse: Henok fɔ Irad; Irad fɔ Mehuyael; Mehuyael fɔ Metushael; ni Metushael fɔ Lamek.

english_verse: Lamech and Zillah had a son named Tubal Cain who made tools out of bronze and iron. They also had a daughter, whose name was Naamah.
translation_verse: Zila hu fɔ Tubalkain, ni ji ayawa nibii kɛ dade nibii fɛɛ sɔ̃lɔ lɛ; ni Tubalkain nyɛmi yoo gbɛi ji Naama.

english_verse: One day, Lamech said to his two wives, “A young man wounded me, and I killed him.
translation_verse: Lamek kɛɛ eŋãmɛi lɛ akɛ, “Ada kɛ Zila, nyɛboa migbee toi, Migbe oblanyo ko: ejaakɛ epila mi.

english_verse: Anyone who tries to get even with me will be punished ten times more than anyone who tries to get even with Cain.”
translation_verse: Kɛji aaatɔ Kain he owele shii kpawo lɛ, asonɔkwa Lamek lɛ, aaatɔ ehe owele shii nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ kpawo!” Set kɛ Enosh

english_verse: Adam and his wife had another son. They named him Seth, because they said, “God has given us a son to take the place of Abel, who was killed by his brother Cain.”
translation_verse: Adam kɛ eŋa Hawa na bɔlɛ ekoŋŋ, ni Hawa fɔ binuu, ni Hawa wo lɛ Set, ejaakɛ ekɛɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ bi kroko eto mibi Habel ni Kain gbe lɛ lɛ najiaŋ.”

english_verse: Later, Seth had a son and named him Enosh. About this time people started worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Set hu fɔ binuu, ni ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Enosh. Nakai be lɛ mli gbɔmɛi bɔi Yehowa gbɛi tsɛmɔ kɛ lɛ jamɔ.

english_verse: God created men and women to be like himself. He gave them his blessing and called them human beings. The following is a list of the descendants of Adam, the first man:
translation_verse: Ebɔ nuu ni ebɔ yoo ni ejɔɔ amɛ ni ewo amɛ gbɛi akɛ “Gbɔmɔ adesa” gbi nɔ ni ebɔ amɛ lɛ.

english_verse: and during the next
translation_verse: ni efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.

english_verse: Lamech said, “I'll name him Noah because he will give us comfort, as we struggle hard to make a living on this land that the Lord has put under a curse.”
translation_verse: Ewo lɛ Noa, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mɔ nɛ baashɛje wɔmii yɛ wɔninenaa nitsumɔ kɛ tɔlɛ ni etɔɔ wɔ yɛ loomɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ lomɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ hewɔ.”

english_verse: More and more people were born, until finally they spread all over the earth. Some of their daughters were so beautiful that supernatural beings came down and married the ones they wanted.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɛi lɛ yana akɛ gbɔmɛi abiyei lɛ ahe yɛ fɛo, ni amɛŋɔŋɔɔ amɛteŋ yei fɛɛ ni amɛsumɔɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “I won't let my life-giving breath remain in anyone forever. No one will live for more than
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mimumɔ lɛ nyɛŋ ahi gbɔmɔ mli kɛya naanɔ, ejaakɛ heloo ji gbɔmɔ ni ebaagbo ni afii abɔ ni ebaaye ji afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ.”

english_verse: The children of the supernatural beings who had married these women became famous heroes and warriors. They were called Nephilim and lived on the earth at that time and even later.
translation_verse: Nakai bei lɛ amli kɛ no sɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔbii lɛ kɛ gbɔmɛi abiyei lɛ fɔfɔɔ asaabui yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Bii nɛɛ tsɔmɔ gbɔmɛi kãkãlɔi ni agbɛii hehee kɛjɛ blema bei lɛ amli tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord saw how bad the people on earth were and that everything they thought and planned was evil.
translation_verse: Be ni Yehowa na akɛ gbɔmɛi anɔfɔŋfeemɔ lɛ efa tsɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nibii ni amɛsusuɔ yɛ amɛyiŋ daa nɛɛ lɛ efɔŋ sɔŋŋ ni lɛ,

english_verse: He was sorry that he had made them,
translation_verse: edɔ lɛ naakpa akɛ ebɔ gbɔmɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Ni Yehowa shwa ehe.

english_verse: and he said, “I'm going to destroy every person on earth! I'll even wipe out animals, birds, and reptiles. I'm sorry I ever made them.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Makpãtã gbɔmɔ ni mibɔ lɛ lɛ hiɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ gbɔmɔ nɔ aahu kɛyashi kooloi kɛ nii ni wamɔɔ kɛ loofɔji anɔ ejaakɛ shi edɔ mi akɛ mibɔ amɛ.”

english_verse: But the Lord was pleased with Noah,
translation_verse: Shi Yehowa na Noa he miishɛɛ. Noa

english_verse: and this is the story about him. Noah was the only person who lived right and obeyed God.
translation_verse: Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Noa shwiei lɛ. Noa ji jalɔ ni eye emuu yɛ eyinɔbii lɛ ateŋ; ni efeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii.

english_verse: He had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
translation_verse: Noa fɔ bihii etɛ̃. Shem kɛ Ham kɛ Yafet.

english_verse: God knew that everyone was terribly cruel and violent.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ na akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ efite ejaakɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ efite amɛjeŋba yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Get some good lumber and build a boat. Put rooms in it and cover it with tar inside and out.
translation_verse: Ŋɔɔ timba ni okɛkpɛ adeka ohã ohe. Feemɔ tsui yɛ mli ni okɛ amã akpa emli kɛ ehewɔ fɛɛ kɛtsimɔ ehe fɔji lɛ.

english_verse: Noah did everything God told him to do.
translation_verse: Noa fee nakai; bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã lɛ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ efee.

english_verse: But I solemnly promise that you, your wife, your sons, and your daughters-in-law will be kept safe in the boat.
translation_verse: Shi bo lɛ mi kɛ bo aaakpãŋ kpãŋmɔ, ni ooobote adeka lɛ mli, bo kɛ obihii lɛ kɛ oŋa kɛ obihii lɛ aŋamɛi lɛ.

english_verse: Take into the boat with you a male and a female of every kind of animal and bird, as well as a male and a female of every reptile. I don't want them to be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ŋɔɔ loofɔji yɛ amɛhenɔ, kɛ kooloi yɛ amɛhenɔ, kɛ nii ni wamɔɔ yɛ amɛhenɔ, srɔtoi fɛɛ lɛ, enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ, kɛba oŋɔɔ yɛ adeka lɛ mli koni ahere amɛyiwala.

english_verse: The Lord told Noah: Take your whole family with you into the boat, because you are the only one on this earth who pleases me.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Noa akɛ, “Bo kɛ owe lɛ fɛɛ nyɛbotea adeka lɛ mli ejaakɛ bo ji mɔ ni mina akɛ jalɔ yɛ mihiɛ yɛ yinɔ nɛɛ mli.

english_verse: Take seven pairs of every kind of animal that can be used for sacrifice and one pair of all others.
translation_verse: Ŋɔɔ kooloi ni he tse lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ kpawokpawo, nuu kɛ yoo, kɛ kooloi ni he tseee lɛ enyɔɔnyɔɔnyɔ, nuu kɛ yoo,

english_verse: Also take seven pairs of every kind of bird with you. Do this so there will always be animals and birds on the earth.
translation_verse: kɛ loofɔji hu kpawokpawo, nuu kɛ yoo, ofata ohe koni akɛhere amɛshwiei fɛɛ ayiwala yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: He obeyed God and took a male and a female of each kind of animal and bird into the boat with him.
translation_verse: enyɔɔnyɔɔnyɔ, nuu kɛ yoo, kɛ Noa tee adeka lɛ mli tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã lɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Seven days later a flood began to cover the earth.
translation_verse: Gbii kpawo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, nu afua lɛ ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The water under the earth started gushing out everywhere, the sky opened like windows, and rain poured down for
translation_verse: ni nu tue ni enɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.

english_verse: On that day Noah and his wife went into the boat with their three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth, and their wives.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ Noa kɛ ebii lɛ, Shem kɛ Ham kɛ Yafet, kɛ Noa ŋa lɛ kɛ ebihii etɛ̃ lɛ aŋamɛi etɛ̃ lɛ, bote adeka lɛ mli,

english_verse: Noah took a male and a female of every living creature with him,
translation_verse: Bɔɔnii fɛɛ ni wala yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ ateŋ enyɔɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛ Noa tee adeka lɛ mli.

english_verse: just as God had told him to do. And when they were all in the boat, the Lord closed the door.
translation_verse: Heloo fɛɛ heloo ni hiɛ kã, nuu kɛ yoo, tee adeka lɛ mli taakɛ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efã lɛ lɛ. Ni Yehowa ŋa Noa yi.

english_verse: Finally, the mighty flood was so deep that even the highest mountain peaks were about seven meters below the surface of the water.
translation_verse: Nu lɛ kwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi ni esu gɔji lɛ ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ.

english_verse: Not a bird, animal, reptile, or human was left alive anywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Bɔɔnii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, loofɔji kɛ shĩa kooloi kɛ ŋa nɔ kooloi kɛ waamɔ nii kɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ plene.

english_verse: A hundred fifty days later, the water started going down.
translation_verse: Nu lɛ damɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.

english_verse: God did not forget about Noah and the animals with him in the boat. So God made a wind blow, and the water started going down.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kai Noa kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi lɛ kɛ shĩa kooloi lɛ fɛɛ ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ adeka lɛ mli lɛ; ni Nyɔŋmɔ hã kɔɔyɔɔ ko batswa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nu lɛ bɔ̃i kpɔ̃ŋmɔ.

english_verse: God stopped up the places where the water had been gushing out from under the earth. He also closed up the sky, and the rain stopped.
translation_verse: Aŋamɔ nu ni tueɔ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ ŋwɛi samfɛji lɛ anaa; ni nu ni tueɔ kɛjɛɔ ŋwɛi lɛ kpa.

english_verse: Then on the seventeenth day of the seventh month of the year, the boat came to rest somewhere in the Ararat mountains.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, adeka lɛ yama shi yɛ Ararat gɔji lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: The water kept going down, and the mountain tops could be seen on the first day of the tenth month.
translation_verse: Nu lɛ hiɛ kpɔ̃ŋmɔ aahu kɛyashi nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ. Nakai nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ana gɔji lɛ ayiteiaŋ.

english_verse: Forty days later Noah opened a window to send out a raven, but it kept flying around until the water had dried up.
translation_verse: ni etsu kwãakwãalabite ko. Kwãakwãalabite lɛ hiɛ yaa kɛ baa kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nu lɛ mii yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Noah wanted to find out if the water had gone down, so he sent out a dove.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Noa tsu okpo ko koni ekɛna kɛji nu lɛ emii yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lo.

english_verse: Deep water was still everywhere, and when the dove could not find a place to land, it flew back to the boat. Then Noah held out his hand and helped it back in.
translation_verse: Shi be ni okpo lɛ tee lɛ enaaa he ko esɔ̃ ejaakɛ nu lɛ ha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ lolo. Hewɔ lɛ eku esɛɛ kɛba Noa ŋɔɔ yɛ adeka lɛ mli.

english_verse: Seven days later Noah sent the dove out again.
translation_verse: Noa mɛ gbii kpawo kroko, ni esaa etsu okpo lɛ ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: It returned in the evening, holding in its beak a green leaf from an olive tree. Noah knew the water was finally going down.
translation_verse: Okpo lɛ ku esɛɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ gbɛkɛnaashi, ni naa, mutso baa fɔ kɔ̃ enaa. Enɛ hã Noa na le akɛ nu lɛ emii yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: He waited seven more days before sending the dove out again, and this time it did not return.
translation_verse: Esaa emɛ gbii kpawo kroko hu, ni etsu okpo lɛ ekoŋŋ, shi okpo lɛ ekuuu esɛɛ ebaaa eŋɔɔ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: By the twenty-seventh day of the second month, the earth was completely dry.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi kwraa.

english_verse: God said to Noah,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Noa wie ni ekɛɛ,

english_verse: “You, your wife, your sons, and your daughters-in-law may now leave the boat.
translation_verse: “Jee adeka lɛ mli, bo kɛ oŋa kɛ obii kɛ obii aŋamɛi ni fata ohe lɛ.

english_verse: After Noah and his family had left the boat,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Noa kɛ ebii lɛ kɛ eŋa kɛ ebii lɛ aŋamɛi ni fata ehe lɛ je kpo;
