english_verse: Noah built an altar where he could offer sacrifices to the Lord. Then he offered on the altar one of each kind of animal and bird that could be used for a sacrifice.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Noa ma afɔleshãa latɛ ehã Yehowa. Eŋɔ shĩaŋ kooloi ni he tse lɛ fɛɛ mli eko kɛ loofɔji ni he tse lɛ fɛɛ mli eko, ni ekɛshã shãa afɔle yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The smell of the burning offering pleased the Lord, and he said: Never again will I punish the earth for the sinful things its people do. All of them have evil thoughts from the time they are young, but I will never destroy everything that breathes, as I did this time.
translation_verse: Be ni Yehowa here afɔle lɛ ŋma jurɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ ehe akɛ, “Milomɔŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ gbɔmɔ hewɔ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ nii ni gbɔmɔ jwɛŋɔ yɛ eyiŋ lɛ efɔŋ ni kɛjɛ egbekɛbiiashi; ni asaŋ mikpãtãŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã hiɛ dɔŋŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni mifee nɛɛ.

english_verse: As long as the earth remains, there will be planting and harvest, cold and heat; winter and summer, day and night.
translation_verse: Gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ yɔɔ nɛɛ lɛ, nidumɔ kɛ nikpamɔ, latsaabe kɛ fɛ̃ibe, Agbiɛnaa kɛ Aharabata, shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ sɛɛ efoŋ.”

english_verse: God said to Noah and his sons: I am giving you my blessing. Have a lot of children and grandchildren, so people will live everywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ Noa kɛ ebii lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfɔa ni nyɛyi afa, ni nyɛyia shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ̃ tɔ.

english_verse: All animals, birds, reptiles, and fish will be afraid of you. I have placed them under your control,
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi fɛɛ kɛ loofɔji kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wamɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ ŋshɔŋ loi fɛɛ ashe nyɛ gbeyei ni nyɛheŋmiŋmi amɔ amɛ, nyɛdɛŋ atu amɛ awo.

english_verse: and I have given them to you for food. From now on, you may eat them, as well as the green plants that you have always eaten.
translation_verse: Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni tsiɔ ehe ni ehiɛ kã lɛ atsɔ̃ nyɛniyenii, ni tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛ shwie ŋmɔŋ ehã nyɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mikɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ehã nyɛ.

english_verse: But life is in the blood, and you must not eat any meat that still has blood in it.
translation_verse: Shi loo ni lá ni ji ewala yɔɔ mli lɛ nyɛkayea.

english_verse: I created humans to be like me, and I will punish any animal or person that takes a human life. If an animal kills someone, that animal must die. And if a person takes the life of another, that person must be put to death.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni shwieɔ gbɔmɔ lá shi lɛ, gbɔmɔ nɔŋŋ aaashwie lɛ hu elá shi kɛ̃ ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ su nɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ gbɔmɔ yɛ.

english_verse: I want you and your descendants to have many children, so people will live everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: “Ni nyɛ lɛ, nyɛfɔa ni nyɛyi afa; nyɛwoa shwiei babaoo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛyi afa yɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: Again, God said to Noah and his sons:
translation_verse: Asaŋ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Noa kɛ ebii ni fata ehe lɛ akɛ,

english_verse: I am going to make a solemn promise to you and to everyone who will live after you.
translation_verse: “Naa, mikɛ mikpãŋmɔ miima shi mahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei ni aaaba yɛ nyɛsɛɛ lɛ,

english_verse: I promise every living creature that the earth and those living on it will never again be destroyed by a flood.
translation_verse: Mahã mikpãŋmɔ ni mikɛ nyɛ ekpãŋ lɛ ama shi, ni nu afua lɛ ebapleneŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã dɔŋŋ, ni asaŋ nu afua ko ebakpãtãŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ gbi ko gbi ko dɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: The rainbow that I have put in the sky will be my sign to you and to every living creature on earth. It will remind you that I will keep this promise forever.
translation_verse: Mikɛ mikwaabuɛtɛ miito atatui lɛ amli, ni efee kpãŋmɔ ni yɔɔ mi kɛ je lɛ teŋ he okadi.

english_verse: When I send clouds over the earth, and a rainbow appears in the sky,
translation_verse: Kɛji mihã atatui wo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ana kwaabuɛtɛ lɛ yɛ atatui lɛ amli lɛ,

english_verse: I will remember my promise to you and to all other living creatures. Never again will I let floodwaters destroy all life.
translation_verse: makai kpãŋmɔ lɛ ni mikɛ nyɛ kɛ nibii srɔtoi srɔtoi fɛɛ ni hiɛ kã lɛ ekpãŋ lɛ, ni nu tsɔŋ afua ni eeekpãtã nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã hiɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: When I see the rainbow in the sky, I will always remember the promise that I have made to every living creature.
translation_verse: Kɛji kwaabuɛtɛ lɛ fo yɛ atatui lɛ amli lɛ, mana ni makai minaanɔ kpãŋmɔ lɛ ni kã mi kɛ nibii srɔtoi fɛɛ ni hiɛ kã ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ teŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Noah and his sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth, left the boat. Ham later had a son named Canaan.
translation_verse: Noa bii lɛ ni jɛ adeka lɛ mli lɛ ji Shem kɛ Ham kɛ Yafet. Ham ji Kanaan tsɛ.

english_verse: All people on earth are descendants of Noah's three sons.
translation_verse: Mɛi etɛ̃ nɛɛ ji Noa bihii lɛ; amɛmli gbɔmɛi fɛɛ jɛ gbɛ shwã shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Noah farmed the land and was the first to plant a vineyard.
translation_verse: Noa nitsumɔ ji humɔ; lɛ ji mɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ni fee waintrom.

english_verse: One day he got drunk and was lying naked in his tent.
translation_verse: Enu wain ni etɔ, ni ekã ebuu lɛ mli kɛ ehe yayai.

english_verse: Ham entered the tent and saw him naked, then went back outside and told his brothers.
translation_verse: Ham, Kanaan tsɛ lɛ, yana etsɛ yayaiaŋ ni eyakɛɛ enyɛmimɛi enyɔ lɛ yɛ agbo lɛ naa.

english_verse: Shem and Japheth put a robe over their shoulders and walked backwards into the tent. Without looking at their father, they placed it over his body.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Shem kɛ Yafet kɔ mama ni amɛkɛfɔ̃ amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛkɔ̃ji anɔ ni amɛnyiɛ sɛɛsɛɛ ni amɛtee amɛkɛyaha amɛtsɛ yayaiaŋ, amɛtsɔ̃mɔ amɛhiɛ amɛhã sɛɛgbɛ, ni amɛnaaa amɛtsɛ yayaiaŋ.

english_verse: When Noah sobered up and learned what his youngest son had done,
translation_verse: Shi be ni dãa lɛ tserɛ yɛ Noa hiɛ ni ena ele nɔ ni ebi gbekɛ lɛ efee lɛ lɛ,

english_verse: he said, “I now put a curse on Canaan! He will be the lowest slave of his brothers.
translation_verse: ekɛɛ akɛ, “Alomɔ Kanaan; nyɔji amli nyɔŋ eeetsɔ̃ ehã enyɛmimɛi lɛ.”

english_verse: I ask the Lord my God to bless Shem and make Canaan his slave.
translation_verse: Asaŋ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa, Shem Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni Kanaan atsɔ̃ Shem nyɔŋ.”

english_verse: I pray God will give Japheth more and more land and let him take over the territory of Shem. May Canaan be his slave.”
translation_verse: “Nyɔŋmɔ ahã Yafet shwiei ashwere. Ehi Shem bui lɛ amli ni Kanaan atsɔ̃ Yafet nyɔŋ.”

english_verse: After the flood Shem, Ham, and Japheth had many descendants. The Descendants of Japheth
translation_verse: Noa bihii ni ji Shem kɛ Ham kɛ Yafet ashwiei nɛ; amɛfɔ bihii yɛ nu afua lɛ sɛɛ.

english_verse: Japheth's descendants had their own languages, tribes, and land. They were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras. Gomer was the ancestor of Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah. Javan was the ancestor of Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim, who settled along the coast. The Descendants of Ham
translation_verse: Mɛnɛɛmɛi amli mɛi jɛ amɛgbɛ amɛshwã ŋshɔnaa shikpɔji kɛ ŋshɔkpɔi lɛ anɔ. Yafet shwiei nɛɛ hi amɛshikpɔji anɔ yɛ amɛwekui amli yɛ amɛmaji amli, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ emaŋ wiemɔ.

english_verse: This completes the list of Noah's descendants. After the flood their descendants became nations and spread all over the world.
translation_verse: Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Noa shwiei lɛ yɛ amɛwekukpãa naa. Amɛhi amɛmajiaŋ yɛ amɛshikpɔji anɔ. Amɛmli jeŋ maji lɛ jɛ gbɛ shwã jeŋ fɛɛ yɛ nu afua lɛ sɛɛ.

english_verse: but after some of them moved from the east and settled in Babylonia,
translation_verse: Ni eba mli akɛ be ni amɛfã gbɛ kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ, amɛyana ŋa kplenee ko yɛ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛhi jɛi.

english_verse: they said: Let's build a city with a tower that reaches to the sky! We'll use hard bricks and tar instead of stone and mortar. We'll become famous, and we won't be scattered all over the world.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ nyɛhãa wɔtoa maŋ wɔhãa wɔhe, ni emli mɔɔ yiteŋ ayashi ŋwɛi, ni wɔkɛhe gbɛi koni wɔkagbɛ wɔshwã shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: But when the Lord came down to look at the city and the tower,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kpeleke shi kɛba ni ebakwɛ maŋ kɛ mɔɔ ni gbɔmɛi adesai ema lɛ.

english_verse: he said: These people are working together because they all speak the same language. This is just the beginning. Soon they will be able to do anything they want.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Kwɛ, gbɔmɛi kome ni, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛwieɔ wiemɔ kome, ni nɔ ni amɛaafee wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ, eshishijee kɛkɛ po nɛ, etsɛŋ kwraa ni amɛaafee nɔ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsumɔɔ.

english_verse: Let's go down and confuse them! We'll make them speak different languages, and they won't be able to understand each other.
translation_verse: Nyɛhãa wɔkpelekea shi ni wɔyatsakea amɛwiemɔ lɛ ni wɔfee lɛ wiemɔi srɔtoisrɔtoi, koni mɔ ko akanu enaanyo wiemɔ dɔŋŋ!”

english_verse: So the people had to stop building the city, because the Lord confused their language and scattered them all over the earth. That's how the city of Babel got its name. The Descendants of Shem
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Babilon, ejaakɛ jɛi Yehowa tsake shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ awiemɔ yɛ, ni jɛi Yehowa jɛ egbɛ amɛ eshwã shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Shem Shwiei lɛ (

english_verse: Arpachshad had more children and died at the age of
translation_verse: Be ni Arpakshad fɔ Shela sɛɛ lɛ, eye afii ohai ejwɛ kɛ etɛ̃ eshwie nɔ; efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.

english_verse: Shelah had more children and died at the age of
translation_verse: Be ni Shela fɔ Eber sɛɛ lɛ, eye afii ohai ejwɛ kɛ etɛ̃ eshwie nɔ; efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.

english_verse: Eber had more children and died at the age of
translation_verse: Be ni efɔ Peleg sɛɛ lɛ, eye afii ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ eshwie nɔ, efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.

english_verse: Peleg had more children and died at the age of
translation_verse: Be ni efɔ Reu sɛɛ lɛ eye afii ohai enyɔ kɛ nɛɛhu eshwie nɔ; efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.

english_verse: Reu had more children and died at the age of
translation_verse: Be ni Reu fɔ Serug sɛɛ lɛ, eye afii ohai enyɔ kɛ kpawo eshwie nɔ; efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.

english_verse: Serug had more children and died at the age of
translation_verse: Be ni Serug fɔ Nahor sɛɛ lɛ, eye afii ohai enyɔ eshwie nɔ; efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.

english_verse: Terah decided to move from Ur to the land of Canaan. He took along Abram and Sarai and his grandson Lot, the son of Haran. But when they came to the city of Haran, they settled there instead.
translation_verse: Tera ŋɔ ebi Abram kɛ Haran bi Lot ni ji enabi lɛ kɛ eshaayoo Sarai, ni ji ebi Abram ŋa lɛ, ni ekɛ amɛje Ur yɛ Babilon koni amɛya Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; shi be ni amɛbashɛ Haran lɛ, amɛhi jɛi.

english_verse: The Lord said to Abram: Leave your country, your family, and your relatives and go to the land that I will show you.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Abram akɛ, “Jee oshikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ kɛ ojakumɛi ateŋ kɛ otsɛ we lɛ kɛya shikpɔŋ ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: I will bless you and make your descendants into a great nation. You will become famous and be a blessing to others.
translation_verse: Mahã otsɔ̃ maŋ kpeteŋkple, ni majɔɔ bo, ni mahã ogbɛi ahehee, ni oootsɔ̃ jɔɔmɔ!

english_verse: I will bless those who bless you, but I will put a curse on anyone who puts a curse on you. Everyone on earth will be blessed because of you.
translation_verse: Majɔɔ mɛi ni jɔɔ bo, ni mɔ ni lomɔɔ bo lɛ, malomɔ lɛ; kɛtsɔ̃ onɔ lɛ aaajɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wekui fɛɛ.”

english_verse: Abram went as far as the sacred tree of Moreh in a place called Shechem. The Canaanites were still living in the land at that time,
translation_verse: Abram tee ehiɛ tɛ̃ɛ kɛyashi eyashɛ Shekem; etseŋ kɛtee tso krɔŋkrɔŋ ko ni yɔɔ More ŋa lɛ mli lɛ he. Nakai be mli lɛ, Kanaanbii lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: but the Lord appeared to Abram and promised, “I will give this land to your family forever.” Abram then built an altar there for the Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Abram ni ekɛɛ, “Oshwiei mikɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ baahã.” No hewɔ lɛ, Abram mã afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi ehã Yehowa, mɔ ni jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Abram traveled to the hill country east of Bethel and camped between Bethel and Ai, where he built another altar and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Abram fã yɛ jɛi kɛtee gɔŋ ko ni yɔɔ Betel bokãgbɛ lɛ he, ni eshi ebuu yɛ jɛi; Betel ye anaigbɛ, ni Ai ye bokãgbɛ. Jɛi hu ema afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ ehã Yehowa, ni eja Yehowa yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: Later, Abram started out toward the Southern Desert. Abram in Egypt
translation_verse: Abram tsa egbɛnyiɛmɔ lɛ nɔ kɛmiiya wuoyi gbɛ lolo. Abram kɛ Sarai yɛ Ijipt

english_verse: The crops failed, and there was no food anywhere in Canaan. So Abram and his wife Sarai went to live in Egypt for a while. But just before they got there, Abram said, “Sarai, you are really beautiful!
translation_verse: Be ni eshwɛ fioo ni ebaashɛ Ijipt lɛ, ekɛɛ eŋa Sarai akɛ, “Mile akɛ yoo ni he yɔɔ fɛo ji bo, ni kɛ ana bo lɛ, ohe yɛ fɛo;

english_verse: When the Egyptians see you, they will murder me because I am your husband. But they won't kill you.
translation_verse: ni eeeba mli akɛ kɛ Ijiptbii lɛ na bo lɛ, amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Eŋa ni.’ Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaagbe mi, shi bo lɛ amɛaahere oyiwala.

english_verse: As soon as Abram and Sarai arrived in Egypt, the Egyptians noticed how beautiful she was.
translation_verse: Be ni Abram bashɛ Ijipt lɛ, Ijiptbii lɛ na yoo lɛ akɛ ehe yɛ fɛo naakpa.

english_verse: The king's officials told him about her, and she was taken to his house.
translation_verse: Farao lumɛi lɛ hu na lɛ, ni amɛyajie eyi amɛhã Farao, ni abaŋɔ yoo lɛ kɛtee Farao we lɛ.

english_verse: The king was good to Abram because of Sarai, and Abram was given sheep, cattle, donkeys, slaves, and camels.
translation_verse: Sarai hewɔ lɛ Farao hiɛ Abram jogbaŋŋ. Ni no hewɔ lɛ, Abram na toi kɛ tsinai kɛ tejihii kɛ webii kɛ weyei kɛ tejiyei kɛ yoomai.

english_verse: Because of Sarai, the Lord struck the king and everyone in his palace with terrible diseases.
translation_verse: Shi Abram ŋa Sarai hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa hã Farao kɛ ewe lɛ na amanehulu ni naa wa.

english_verse: Finally, the king sent for Abram and said to him, “What have you done to me? Why didn't you tell me Sarai was your wife?
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Farao tsɛ Abram ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni ofee mi nɛɛ? Mɛɛba okɛɛɛ mi akɛ yoo lɛ oŋa ni lɛ?

english_verse: Why did you make me believe she was your sister? Now I've married her. Take her and go! She's your wife.”
translation_verse: Mɛɛba okɛɛ akɛ onyɛmi yoo ji lɛ, ni ohã miŋɔ lɛ mifee miŋa lɛ? Agbɛnɛ naa oŋa, ŋɔɔ lɛ ni oya!”

english_verse: So the king told his men to let Abram and Sarai take their possessions and leave.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Farao famɔ hii komɛi eto ehe akɛ amɛyajie lɛ kɛ eŋa kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ gbɛ.

english_verse: Abram and Sarai took everything they owned and went to the Southern Desert. Lot went with them.
translation_verse: Abram kɛ eŋa kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ je Ijipt, ni Lot fata ehe; amɛtee wuoyigbɛ.

english_verse: Abram was very rich. He owned many cattle, sheep, and goats, and had a lot of silver and gold.
translation_verse: No mli lɛ Abram ena nii babaoo: shĩaŋ kooloi kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika tsuru.

english_verse: Abram moved from place to place in the Southern Desert. And finally, he went north and set up his tents between Bethel and Ai,
translation_verse: Etsa egbɛfãa lɛ nɔ fiofio kɛjɛ wuoyigbɛ aahu kɛtee Betel. Eyashɛ he ko yɛ Betel kɛ Ai teŋ, he ni eshi ebuu lɛ yɛ ni ema afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ tsutsu ko lɛ.

english_verse: Lot, who was traveling with him, also had sheep, goats, and cattle, as well as his own family and slaves.
translation_verse: Lot ni kɛ Abram nyiɛ lɛ hu yɛ toi kɛ tsinai kɛ bui,

english_verse: At this time the Canaanites and the Perizzites were still living in the same area, and so there wasn't enough pastureland left for Abram and Lot with all of their animals. Besides this, the men who took care of Abram's animals and the ones who took care of Lot's animals started quarreling.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni bei ba Abram koolookwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ Lot koolookwɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ. Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Perizbii lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Abram said to Lot, “We are close relatives. We shouldn't argue, and our men shouldn't be fighting one another.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Abram kɛɛ Lot akɛ, “Kaahã bei miiba mi kɛ bo teŋ kɛ mikoolookwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ okoolookwɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ, ejaakɛ nyɛmimɛi ji wɔ.

english_verse: There is plenty of land for you to choose from. Let's separate. If you go north, I'll go south; if you go south, I'll go north.”
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kã ohiɛ nɛɛ. Tse ohe yɛ mihe. Kɛji okɔ abɛkugbɛ lɛ, no lɛ makɔ ninejurɔgbɛ; ni kɛji okɔ ninejurɔgbɛ lɛ, no lɛ makɔ abɛkugbɛ.”

english_verse: This happened before the Lord had destroyed the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. And when Lot looked around, he saw there was plenty of water in the Jordan Valley. All the way to Zoar the valley was as green as the garden of the Lord or the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Lot wo ehiɛ nɔ ni ekwɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛkpe, ni ena akɛ Yordan jɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ frɔ̃frɔ̃ aahu kɛtee Zoar tɔ̃ɔ. Etamɔ Yehowa trom lɛ aloo Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ. Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ, Yehowa kpãtãko Sodom kɛ Gomora hiɛ.

english_verse: So Lot chose the whole Jordan Valley for himself, and as he started out toward the east, he and Abram separated.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Lot kɔ Yordan jɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ, ni efã kɛtee bokãgbɛ. Bɔ ni fee ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ amɛgbala mli nɛ.

english_verse: Abram stayed in the land of Canaan. But Lot settled near the cities of the valley and put up his tents not far from Sodom,
translation_verse: Abram hi Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Lot hi maji ni yɔɔ Yordan jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ amli. Lot shi ebuu lɛ shii abɔ kɛyashi be ni eyashɛ Sodom.

english_verse: where the people were evil and sinned terribly against the Lord. Abram Moves to Hebron
translation_verse: Shi Sodombii lɛ yiwalɔi ji amɛ, ni amɛfeɔ esha amɛshiɔ Yehowa. Abram fã kɛtee Hebron

english_verse: After Abram and Lot had gone their separate ways, the Lord said to Abram: Look around to the north, south, east, and west.
translation_verse: Be ni Lot kɛ Abram egbala mli sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Abram akɛ, “Wo ohiɛ nɔ, ni ojɛ he ni oyɔɔ lɛ okwɛ kooyigbɛ kɛ wuoyigbɛ kɛ bokãgbɛ kɛ anaigbɛ shikpɔŋ ni onaa nɛɛ,

english_verse: I will give you more descendants than there are specks of dust on the earth, and someday it will be easier to count those specks of dust than to count your descendants.
translation_verse: Mahã oshwiei afa tamɔ shikpɔŋ mlu, ni kɛji mɔ ko aaanyɛ shikpɔŋ mlu akane lɛ, belɛ aaanyɛ oshwiei lɛ hu akane.

english_verse: Now walk back and forth across the land, because I am going to give it to you.
translation_verse: Tee shi, nyiɛmɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛtsɔ̃ ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ nɔ, shi bo mikɛbaahã”.

english_verse: Abram took down his tents and went to live near the sacred trees of Mamre at Hebron, where he built an altar in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Abram fã ebuu lɛ, ni eba ebahi Mamre tsei krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ni yɔɔ Hebron lɛ amasɛi, ni ema afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi ehã Yehowa.

english_verse: About this time, King Amraphel of Babylonia, King Arioch of Ellasar, King Chedorlaomer of Elam, and King Tidal of Goiim
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛmɛi ejwɛ, Babilon maŋtsɛ Amrafel kɛ Elasar maŋtsɛ Ariok kɛ Elam maŋtsɛ Kedorlaomer kɛ Goiim maŋtsɛ Tidal abei amli lɛ,

english_verse: attacked King Bera of Sodom, King Birsha of Gomorrah, King Shinab of Admah, King Shemeber of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, a city also known as Zoar.
translation_verse: maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ fã ta amɛshi Sodom maŋtsɛ Bera kɛ Gomora maŋtsɛ Birsha kɛ Adma maŋtsɛ Shinab kɛ Zeboim maŋtsɛ Shemeber kɛ Bela ni ji Zoar maŋtsɛ lɛ.

english_verse: King Chedorlaomer and his allies had ruled these last five kings for twelve years, but in the thirteenth year the kings rebelled and joined forces in Siddim Valley, which is now covered by the southern part of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ sɔmɔ Kedorlaomer afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, shi afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛtse atua.

english_verse: A year later King Chedorlaomer and his allies attacked and defeated the Rephaites in Ashteroth-Karnaim, the Zuzites in Ham, and the Emites in Shaveh-Kiriathaim.
translation_verse: Afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Kedorlaomer kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ni fata ehe lɛ ba ni amɛbaye Refabii anɔ kunim yɛ Ashterot-Karnaim. Amɛye Zuzbii anɔ yɛ Ham, ni amɛye Embii anɔ yɛ Kiriataim ŋa lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: They also defeated the Horites in the hill country of Edom, as far as El-Paran, near the desert.
translation_verse: Amɛye Horbii hu anɔ yɛ amɛgɔŋ Edom lɛ nɔ, ni amɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛyashi El-Paran ni kã shiaŋa kplanaa lɛ naa lɛ.

english_verse: They went back to the city of Enmishpat, better known as Kadesh. Then they captured all the land that belonged to the Amalekites, and they defeated the Amorites who were living in Hazazon-Tamar.
translation_verse: Amɛku amɛsɛɛ ni amɛba En-mishpat, ni amɛye Amalekbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, kɛ Amorbii ni yɔɔ Hazazon-Tamar lɛ hu anɔ.

english_verse: At Siddim Valley, the armies of the kings of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboiim, and Bela fought the armies of King Chedorlaomer of Elam, King Tidal of Goiim, King Amraphel of Babylonia, and King Arioch of Ellasar. The valley
translation_verse: ni amɛkɛ Elam maŋtsɛ Kedorlaomer kɛ Goiim maŋtsɛ Tidal kɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ Amrafel kɛ Elasar maŋtsɛ Ariok bawu; maŋtsɛmɛi ejwɛ kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi enumɔ wu.

english_verse: was full of tar pits, and when the troops from Sodom and Gomorrah started running away, some of them fell into the pits. Others escaped to the hill country.
translation_verse: Shi Sidim jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, amãtɛ bui sɔŋŋ yɔɔ jɛi. Awo Sodom kɛ Gomora maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ afoi, ni amɛnyɔnyɔi bui lɛ amli, shi maŋtsɛmɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ jo foi kɛtee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Their enemies took everything of value from Sodom and Gomorrah, including their food supplies.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi ejwɛ lɛ ŋɔ Sodom kɛ Gomora nii fɛɛ kɛ niyenii fɛɛ, ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee.

english_verse: They also captured Abram's nephew Lot, who lived in Sodom. They took him and his possessions and then left.
translation_verse: Amɛŋɔ Abram nyɛmibi Lot ni yɔɔ Sodom lɛ hu kɛ enibii kɛtee.

english_verse: At this time Abram the Hebrew was living near the oaks that belonged to Mamre the Amorite. Mamre and his brothers Eshcol and Aner were Abram's friends. Someone who had escaped from the battle told Abram
translation_verse: Shi nuu ko ni jo foi kɛjɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ ba ni ebagba Abram, Hebrinyo lɛ ni ehe shi yɛ he ni Mamre, Amornyo lɛ, wɔŋ koo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ. Shi Eshkol kɛ Aner nyɛmi ji Mamre; ni amɛkɛ Abram ekpãŋ.

english_verse: that his nephew Lot had been taken away. Three hundred and eighteen of Abram's servants were fighting men, so he took them and followed the enemy as far north as the city of Dan.
translation_verse: Be ni Abram nu akɛ aŋɔ enyɛmibi lɛ nom lɛ, ekɛ etsuji ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ ni le ta he nii, ni afɔ amɛ yɛ ewe lɛ, fã ta, ni etiu maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛtee Dan.

english_verse: That night, Abram divided up his troops, attacked from all sides, and won a great victory. But some of the enemy escaped to the town of Hobah north of Damascus,
translation_verse: Ekɛ etsuji lɛ gba ta wo amɛhe nyɔɔŋ, ni enine tsɔ̃ amɛnɔ, ni etiu amɛ kɛtee Hoba ni yɔɔ Damasko kooyigbɛ lɛ.

english_verse: and Abram went after them. He brought back his nephew Lot, together with Lot's possessions and the women and everyone else who had been captured. Abram Is Blessed by Melchizedek
translation_verse: Eŋɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ enyɛmibi Lot lɛ hu kɛ enibii lɛ, kɛ yei lɛ hu kɛ maŋbii lɛ kɛku sɛɛ kɛba. Melkizedek jɔɔ Abram

english_verse: Abram returned after he had defeated King Chedorlaomer and the other kings. Then the king of Sodom went to meet Abram in Shaveh Valley, which is also known as King's Valley.
translation_verse: Be ni Abram eye Kedorlaomer kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ni fata ehe lɛ anɔ kunim ni eku esɛɛ eba lɛ, Sodom maŋtsɛ lɛ tee eyakpee lɛ yɛ Shaveh Jɔɔ ni atsɛɔ jɛi Maŋtsɛ Jɔɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: King Melchizedek of Salem was a priest of God Most High. He brought out some bread and wine
translation_verse: Ni Salem maŋtsɛ Melkizedek kɛ aboloo kɛ wain ba. Ŋwɛi Flooflo Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ osɔfo ji lɛ.

english_verse: and said to Abram: “I bless you in the name of God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Ejɔɔ Abram ni ekɛɛ, “Ŋwɛi Flooflo Nyɔŋmɔ, ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ bɔlɔ lɛ ajɔɔ Abram;

english_verse: All praise belongs to God Most High for helping you defeat your enemies.” Then Abram gave Melchizedek a tenth of everything.
translation_verse: ni ajie Ŋwɛi Flooflo Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni hã oye ohenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kunim lɛ yi.” Ni Abram hã Melkizedek nii lɛ fɛɛ mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome.

english_verse: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “All I want are my people. You can keep everything else.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ Sodom maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Abram akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ migbɔmɛi lɛ ohã mi, shi haa nibii lɛ ŋɔɔ ohã ohe.”

english_verse: Abram answered: The Lord God Most High made the heavens and the earth. And I have promised him
translation_verse: Shi Abram kɛɛ Sodom maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mina Ŋwɛi Flooflo Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ bɔlɔ lɛ

english_verse: that I won't keep anything of yours, not even a sandal strap or a piece of thread. Then you can never say that you are the one who made me rich.
translation_verse: akɛ kɛjɛ kpãa nɔ aahu kɛyashi tokota naa kpãa nɔ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ji onɔ lɛ, kɛji mikɔ eko fii! Koni okakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mi, mifee Abram niiatsɛ.’

english_verse: Let my share be the food that my men have eaten. But Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre went with me, so give them their share of what we brought back.
translation_verse: Miŋɔɔɔ nɔ ko nɔ ko akɛ ja nɔ ni oblahii lɛ eye kɛkɛ, kɛ hii ni kɛ mi tee lɛ, Aner kɛ Eshkol kɛ Mamre; amɛ lɛ hã ni amɛŋɔ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: Later the Lord spoke to Abram in a vision, “Abram, don't be afraid! I will protect you and reward you greatly.”
translation_verse: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛ Abram wie yɛ ninaa mli akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei, Abram, mabu ohe, ni mabaa oyi.”

english_verse: But Abram answered, “Lord All-Powerful, you have given me everything I could ask for, except children. And when I die, Eliezer of Damascus will get all I own.
translation_verse: Shi Abram kɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛni obaahã mi, mi ni minyiɛ ni mibɛ bi ni mɔ ni baaye migboshinii lɛ ji Eliezer, Damaskonyo nɛɛ?”

english_verse: You have not given me any children, and this servant of mine will inherit everything.”
translation_verse: Abram tee nɔ ekɛɛ, “Naa, mi lɛ, ohãko mi shwie ko, ni nyɔŋ ni afɔ lɛ yɛ miwe lɛ baaye minii.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “No, he won't! You will have a son of your own, and everything you have will be his.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Abram akɛ, “Mɔ nɛ yeŋ onii; shi moŋ bi ni aaajɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ omusuŋ lɛ, lɛ ebaaye onii.”

english_verse: Then the Lord took Abram outside and said, “Look at the sky and see if you can count the stars. That's how many descendants you will have.”
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Abram je kpo ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kwɛmɔ ŋwɛi koo, ni okane ŋulamii lɛ akɛ ooonyɛ amɛ okane lo.” Ekɛɛ Abram akɛ, “Bɔ ni oshwiei aaatamɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Abram believed the Lord, so the Lord was pleased with him and accepted him. The Lord Makes Another Promise to Abram
translation_verse: Abram kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa na ehe tsuijurɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Abram, “I brought you here from Ur in Chaldea, and I gave you this land.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Abram akɛ, “Mi ji Yehowa mɔ ni jie bo kɛjɛ Ur yɛ Babilonbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni maŋɔ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ mahã bo akɛ onɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: Abram asked, “Lord God, how can I know the land will be mine?”
translation_verse: Shi Abram bi akɛ, “Ao Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛni mikɛaale akɛ eeetsɔ̃ minɔ?”

english_verse: Then the Lord told him, “Bring me a three-year-old cow, a three-year-old female goat, a three-year-old ram, a dove, and a young pigeon.”
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛ tsinayoo ni eye afii etɛ̃ kɛ too abotiayoo ni eye afii etɛ̃ kɛ ojwɛni ni eye afii etɛ̃ kɛ kosɛɛ okpo kɛ shĩa okpo aba.”

english_verse: Abram obeyed the Lord. Then he cut the animals in half and laid the two halves of each animal opposite each other on the ground. But he did not cut the doves and pigeons in half.
translation_verse: Abram kɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ba. Abram folɔ amɛmli enyɔɔnyɔɔnyɔ, ni eto fãfãi lɛ eshwie biɛ kɛ biɛ, eko yɛ eko ŋlɛnɔ; shi loofɔji lɛ efolɔɔɔ amɛmli.

english_verse: And when birds came down to eat the animals, Abram chased them away.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni loofɔji ni yeɔ loo kpeleke shi basɔmɔ kooloi agbohii lɛ anɔ, shi Abram shwie amɛ.

english_verse: As the sun was setting, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and everything became dark and frightening.
translation_verse: Be ni hulu yaa eyanyɔ shi lɛ, wɔ ni tsii nyɔ Abram nɔ, ni duŋ kpii kɛ gbeyei ni naa wa mɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Four generations later, your descendants will return here and take this land, because only then will the people who live here be so sinful that they deserve to be punished.
translation_verse: Shi yinɔ ni ji ejwɛ sɛɛ lɛ oshwiei lɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaaba biɛ ekoŋŋ; ejaakɛ eshai ni Amorbii feɔ lɛ shɛko he ni kɛ eshɛ ni abaagbala amɛtoi.”

english_verse: Sometime after sunset, when it was very dark, a smoking cooking pot and a flaming fire passed between the two halves of each animal.
translation_verse: Ni be ni hulu enyɔ shi ni hiɛ ebu lɛ, naa, kukwɛi kɛ emli la ni miifã lasu kɛ kɔti ni miitso gboŋaa batsɔ̃ loi fãfãafãi lɛ ateŋ kɛho.

english_verse: At that time the Lord made an agreement with Abram and told him: I will give your descendants the land east of the Shihor River on the border of Egypt as far as the Euphrates River.
translation_verse: Ni nakai gbi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Abram kpãŋ ni ekɛɛ, “Oshwiei lɛ mikɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ baahã, kɛjɛ Ijipt faa lɛ naa kɛyashi faa kpeteŋkple ni ji Eufrate Faa lɛ naa.

english_verse: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaites,
translation_verse: kɛ Hitbii kɛ Perizbii kɛ Refabii

english_verse: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.
translation_verse: kɛ Amorbii kɛ Kanaanbii kɛ Girgashbii kɛ Yebusbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Abram's wife Sarai had not been able to have any children. But she owned a young Egyptian slave woman named Hagar,
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ Sarai, Abram ŋa lɛ fɔɔɔ; shi eyɛ weyoo Ijiptyoo ko ni egbɛi ji Hagar.

english_verse: and Sarai said to Abram, “The Lord has not given me any children. Sleep with my slave, and if she has a child, it will be mine.” Abram agreed,
translation_verse: Ni Sarai kɛɛ Abram akɛ, “Naa, Yehowa etsi mifɔmɔ naa. Okɛ minyɔŋyoo lɛ ayawɔ; eko lɛ mana bii kɛaatsɔ̃ enɔ.” Ni Abram bo Sarai toi.

english_verse: and Sarai gave him Hagar to be his wife. This happened after Abram had lived in the land of Canaan for ten years.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Sarai ŋɔ Ijiptyoo Hagar, eweyoo lɛ, ehã ewu Abram gbãlã, be ni Abram eye afii nyɔŋma yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Later, when Hagar knew she was going to have a baby, she became proud and treated Sarai hatefully.
translation_verse: Abram kɛ Hagar na musu; shi be ni Hagar na akɛ ehiɛ musu lɛ, ewula lɛ heguɔ gbo yɛ ehiɛ.

english_verse: Then Sarai said to Abram, “It's all your fault! I gave you my slave woman, but she has been hateful to me ever since she found out she was pregnant. You have done me wrong, and you will have to answer to the Lord for this.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Sarai kɛɛ Abram akɛ, “Sane ni eŋɔɔɔ ni akɛyeɔ mi nɛɛ, sɔ̃ lɛ atere bo! Mikɛ miweyoo lɛ hã bo; shi kɛjɛ be ni ena akɛ ena musu lɛ, mihiɛ eshwiei shi yɛ ehiɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ aaakojo mi kɛ bo teŋ sane nɛɛ.”

english_verse: Abram said, “All right! She's your slave—do whatever you want with her.” Then Sarai began treating Hagar so harshly that she finally ran away.
translation_verse: Shi Abram kɛɛ Sarai akɛ, “Naa, oweyoo lɛ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ; feemɔ lɛ bɔ ni osumɔɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Sarai nyɛ Hagar hiɛ, ni Hagar jo foi kɛje eŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Hagar stopped to rest at a spring in the desert on the road to Shur. While she was there, the angel of the Lord came to her
translation_verse: Yehowa bɔfo lɛ na Hagar yɛ nubu ko he yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, yɛ Shur gbɛ lɛ nɔ nubu lɛ he.

english_verse: and asked, “Hagar, where have you come from, and where are you going?” She answered, “I'm running away from Sarai, my owner.”
translation_verse: Bɔfo lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Hagar! Sarai weyoo, nɛgbɛ ojɛ? Ni nɛgbɛ hu oyaa?” Hagar to he ekɛɛ, “Miijo foi kɛjɛ miwula Sarai ŋɔɔ.”

english_verse: The angel said, “Go back to Sarai and be her slave.
translation_verse: Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kuu osɛɛ kɛya owula lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni oba ohe shi ohã lɛ.”

english_verse: I will give you a son, who will be called Ishmael, because I have heard your cry for help. And someday I will give you so many descendants that no one will be able to count them all.
translation_verse: Yehowa bɔfo lɛ tee nɔ ekɛɛ Hagar akɛ, “Naa, ohiɛ musu ni obaafɔ binuu ni gbɛi ni ooowo lɛ ji Ishmael, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ena bɔ ni onaa nɔ ni oyoyro lɛ,

english_verse: But your son will live far from his relatives; he will be like a wild donkey, fighting everyone, and everyone fighting him.”
translation_verse: shi gbekɛ lɛ aaafee enii tamɔ ŋaŋ teji, ekɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaana, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hu kɛ lɛ aaana, ni ekɛ ewekumɛi efeŋ nɔ ko.”

english_verse: Hagar thought, “Have I really seen God and lived to tell about it?” So from then on she called him, “The God Who Sees Me.”
translation_verse: Hagar bi ehe akɛ, “Ani mina Nyɔŋmɔ lɛɛlɛŋ ni fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ mihiɛ kã lolo nɛɛ?” No hewɔ lɛ, etsɛ Yehowa mɔ ni kɛ lɛ wie lɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ ni naa mi.”

english_verse: That's why people call the well between Kadesh and Bered, “The Well of the Living One Who Sees Me.”
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, atsɛ nɛkɛ bu nɛɛ akɛ, “Beer-lahai-roi”, eshishi ji, “Mɔ ni hiɛ kã ni enaa mi” lɛ nubu. Nubu nɛɛ yɛ Kadesh kɛ Bered teŋ.

english_verse: I will keep my solemn promise to you and give you more descendants than can be counted.”
translation_verse: Mikɛ mikpãŋmɔ lɛ baaŋmɛ mi kɛ bo teŋ, ni mahã oshwiei afa babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.”

english_verse: Abram bowed with his face to the ground, and God said:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Abram ŋɔ ehiɛ ebu shi, ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ,

english_verse: I promise that you will be the father of many nations. So now I'm changing your name from Abram to Abraham.
translation_verse: Atsɛŋ bo Abram dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ aaatsɛ bo Abraham, ejaakɛ mahã ofee maji pii atsɛ.

english_verse: I will give you a lot of descendants, and they will become great nations. Some of them will even be kings.
translation_verse: Mahã owo shwiei babaoo diɛŋtsɛ, ni mahã majimaji ajɛ omli ni maŋtsɛmɛi aaajɛ omli.

english_verse: I will always keep the promise I have made to you and your descendants, because I am your God and their God.
translation_verse: “Mahã mikpãŋmɔ ni kã mi kɛ bo teŋ lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ, ni eeetsɔ̃ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ ehã oshwiei ni aaaba yɛ osɛɛ lɛ yɛ amɛyinɔi fɛɛ mli; matsɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ mahã bo kɛ oshwiei ni aaaba yɛ osɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: I will give you and them the land in which you are now a foreigner. I will give the whole land of Canaan to your family forever, and I will be their God.
translation_verse: Mikɛ shikpɔŋ ni obato gbɔ yɛ nɔ nɛɛ baahã bo kɛ oshwiei ni aaaba yɛ osɛɛ lɛ. Kanaan shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ oshwiei anɔ kɛya naanɔ, ni matsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ.”

english_verse: Abraham, you and all future members of your family must promise to obey me.
translation_verse: Asaŋ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Abraham akɛ, “Yɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋ lɛ, bo kɛ oshwiei ni aaaba yɛ osɛɛ lɛ, nyɛyea mikpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ yɛ amɛyinɔi lɛ fɛɛ mli.

english_verse: As the sign that you are keeping this promise, you must circumcise every man and boy in your family.
translation_verse: Afolɔ nyɛ ketia, ni no atsɔ̃ kpãŋmɔ ni yɔɔ mi kɛ nyɛ teŋ lɛ he okadi.

english_verse: Any man who isn't circumcised hasn't kept his part of the promise and cannot be one of my people.
translation_verse: Nuu foolɔ ko ni afoko lɛ ketia lɛ akabu lɛ ashi mimɛi lɛ anɔ; eku mikpãŋmɔ lɛ mli.”

english_verse: Abraham, from now on your wife's name will be Sarah instead of Sarai.
translation_verse: Asaŋ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Abraham akɛ, “Oŋa Sarai lɛ, kaatsɛ egbɛi akɛ Sarai dɔŋŋ, shi abaatsɛ lɛ Sara.

english_verse: I will bless her, and you will have a son by her. She will become the mother of nations, and some of her descendants will even be kings.
translation_verse: Majɔɔ lɛ ni asaŋ mahã okɛ lɛ afɔ binuu. Majɔɔ lɛ, ni eeetsɔ̃ maji anyɛ, ni maji anɔ maŋtsɛmɛi aaajɛ emli.”

english_verse: Then he asked God, “Why not let Ishmael inherit what you have promised me?”
translation_verse: Abraham kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “Ao, mina ni kulɛ Ishmael yi na wala yɛ ohiɛ.”

translation_verse: Enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi lɛ biyoo nukpa lɛ kɛɛ enyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, nyɛ nyɔɔŋ lɛ mikɛ mitsɛ yawɔ; hã ni wɔhã lɛ wain enu gbɛkɛ nɛɛ hu koni bo hu oya okɛ lɛ ayawɔ koni wɔkɛ wɔtsɛ afɔ bii.”

english_verse: That night they got their father drunk, and this time the younger sister slept with him. But once again he was too drunk even to know she was there.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, amɛhã amɛtsɛ wain enu nakai gbɛkɛ lɛ hu; ni gbekɛ lɛ hu yiŋ etee, ni ekɛ lɛ yawɔ; ni Lot leee be ni ebi lɛ bakã shi kɛ be ni ete shi.

english_verse: That's how Lot's two daughters had children.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni fee ni Lot biyei enyɔ lɛ kɛ amɛtsɛ na musu nɛ.

english_verse: The older daughter named her son Moab, and he is the ancestor of the Moabites.
translation_verse: Kromɔbi lɛ fɔ binuu, ni ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Moab; lɛ eshwiei ji Moabbii lɛ.

english_verse: The younger daughter named her son Benammi, and he is the ancestor of the Ammonites.
translation_verse: Ni gbekɛ lɛ hu fɔ binuu, ni ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Ben-Ami; eshwiei lɛ ji Amonbii lɛ.

english_verse: he told everyone that his wife Sarah was his sister. So King Abimelech of Gerar had Sarah brought to him.
translation_verse: Abraham kɛɛ yɛ eŋa hewɔ akɛ, “Minyɛmi yoo ji lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Abimelek, Gerar maŋtsɛ lɛ, tsu ayaŋɔ Sara abahã lɛ.

english_verse: But God came to Abimelech in a dream and said, “You have taken a married woman into your home, and for this you will die!”
translation_verse: Shi Nyɔŋmɔ ba Abimelek ŋɔɔ nyɔɔŋ yɛ lamɔ mli, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, obaagbo yɛ yoo lɛ ni oyaŋɔ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ mɔ ko ŋa ni.”

english_verse: Abimelech said to the Lord, “Don't kill me! I haven't slept with Sarah. Didn't they say they were brother and sister? I am completely innocent.”
translation_verse: Ani jeee Abraham diɛŋtsɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Minyɛmi yoo ji lɛ’ lɛ? Ni yoo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Minyɛmi nuu ji lɛ’ lɛ? Mihe nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ mi lɛ miye, ni nɔ ni mifee nɛɛ lɛ, mijɛ tsui ni tse mli mikɛfee, ni midɛŋ hu diii.”

english_verse: Then God continued: I know you are innocent. That's why I kept you from sleeping with Sarah and doing anything wrong.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Abimelek yɛ lamɔ lɛ mli akɛ, “Hɛɛ, mi hu mile akɛ onɔkwale fɛɛ okɛfee enɛ. Asaŋ, mi ni mitsi onaa koni okafee esha oshi mi, no hewɔ ni mihãaa bo hegbɛ akɛ ota ehe lɛ.

english_verse: Her husband is a prophet. Let her go back to him, and his prayers will save you from death. But if you don't return her, you and all your people will die.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ kɛ nuu lɛ ŋa lɛ aku sɛɛ oyahã lɛ ejaakɛ gbalɔ ji lɛ, ni eeesɔle ekpa fai ehã bo, ni oyi aaana wala. Shi kɛji okɛ lɛ hãaa lɛ lɛ, no lɛ na ole akɛ gbo ooogbo, bo kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni ji onɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: Early the next morning Abimelech sent for his officials, and when he told them what had happened, they were frightened.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Abimelek te shi leebi maŋkpa, ni etsɛ etsuji lɛ fɛɛ, ni ebɔ amɛ nɔ ni ba lɛ fɛɛ; ni hii lɛ she gbeyei naakpa.

english_verse: Abimelech then called in Abraham and said: Look what you've done to us! What have I ever done to you? Why did you make me and my nation guilty of such a terrible sin?
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Abimelek tsɛ Abraham ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni ofee wɔ nɛɛ? Mɛni esha mifee bo hewɔ ni otsi mi kɛ mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ owo esha kpeteŋkple tamɔ nɛkɛ mli nɛɛ? Nɔ ni afeee ofee mi nɛɛ.”

english_verse: What were you thinking when you did this?
translation_verse: Asaŋ Abimelek bi Abraham akɛ, “Mɛni osusu hewɔ ofee enɛ?”

english_verse: Abraham answered: I did it because I didn't think any of you respected God, and I was sure that someone would kill me to get my wife.
translation_verse: Abraham to he akɛ, “Miyasusu akɛ ekolɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ biɛ nɛɛ lɛ sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni amɛbaagbe mi yɛ miŋa lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Besides, she is my half sister. We have the same father, but different mothers.
translation_verse: Ni asaŋ eyɛ mli lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ minyɛmi yoo ni, ejaakɛ mitsɛbi ni, shi jeee minyɛbi ni, ni etsɔ miŋa.

english_verse: When God made us leave my father's home and start wandering, I told her, “If you really love me, then tell everyone that I am your brother.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Nyɔŋmɔ hã mije mitsɛ we lɛ ni miyatsomlo lɛ, mikɛɛ miŋa lɛ akɛ, ‘Enɛ ji ejurɔ ni mitaoɔ ni ofee mi: He fɛɛ he ni wɔɔshɛ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ yɛ mihe akɛ minyɛmi nuu ni.’ ”

english_verse: After Abimelech had given Abraham some sheep, cattle, and slaves, he sent Sarah back
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Abimelek ŋɔ toi kɛ tsinai kɛ wehii kɛ weyei eyahã Abraham, ni ekɛ eŋa Sara lɛ ku sɛɛ ehã lɛ.

english_verse: and told Abraham he could settle anywhere in his country.
translation_verse: Abimelek kɛɛ Abraham akɛ, “Mishikpɔŋ lɛ kã ohiɛ nɛɛ; hii he ni osumɔɔ.”

english_verse: Meanwhile, God had kept Abimelech's wife and slaves from having children. But Abraham prayed, and God let them start having children again.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ kulɛ Yehowa eŋa yei fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Abimelek we lɛ amusu naa yɛ Abraham ŋa Sara sane lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: The Lord was good to Sarah and kept his promise.
translation_verse: Yehowa baduro Sara tamɔ bɔ ni ewo shi lɛ ni Yehowa fee nɔ ni ewo shi eto lɛ ehã lɛ.

english_verse: Although Abraham was very old, Sarah had a son exactly at the time God had said.
translation_verse: Be ni Nyɔŋmɔ to hã Sara lɛ shɛ, ni Sara na musu ni ekɛ Abraham fɔ binuu yɛ egbɔlɛ mli.

english_verse: and when the boy was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him, just as God had commanded.
translation_verse: Ni Abraham fo ebi Isak ketia be ni gbekɛ lɛ ena gbii kpaanyɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ewo lɛ kitã lɛ.

english_verse: and Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. And now everyone will laugh with me.
translation_verse: Ni Sara kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ ewo minaaŋmɔlɔ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaanu he lɛ aaaŋmɔ eko.”

english_verse: Who would have dared to tell Abraham that someday I would have a child? But in his old age, I have given him a son.”
translation_verse: Asaŋ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Kulɛ namɔ aaagba Abraham akɛ Sara aaahã ebii afufɔ? Shi mikɛ lɛ efɔ bi yɛ egbɔlɛ mli.”

english_verse: The time came when Sarah no longer had to nurse Isaac, and on that day Abraham gave a big feast. Hagar and Ishmael Are Sent Away
translation_verse: Gbekɛ lɛ bada, ni atse lɛ fufɔ; ni Abraham ŋmɛ okplɔ̃ kpeteŋkple gbi nɔ ni atse lɛ fufɔ lɛ. Awo Hagar kɛ Ishmael gbɛ

english_verse: One day, Sarah noticed Hagar's son Ishmael playing, and she said to Abraham, “Get rid of that Egyptian slave woman and her son! I don't want him to inherit anything. It should all go to my son.”
translation_verse: Ni Sara kɛɛ Abraham akɛ, “Shwiemɔ tsulɔyoo nɛɛ kɛ ebi lɛ ni amɛya koni tsulɔyoo nɛɛ binuu lɛ kɛ mibi Isak akaja gboshinii lɛ.

english_verse: Abraham was worried about Ishmael.
translation_verse: Wiemɔ nɛɛ eŋɔɔɔ Abraham naa kwraa yɛ ebi Ishmael hewɔ.

english_verse: But God said, “Abraham, don't worry about your slave woman and the boy. Just do what Sarah tells you. Isaac will inherit your family name,
translation_verse: Shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Abraham akɛ, ‘Kaahã oblanyo lɛ kɛ otsulɔyoo lɛ sane lɛ miidɔ bo. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Sara aaakɛɛ bo lɛ, bo egbee toi ni ofee ejaakɛ Isak gbɛi mli aaatsɛ oshwiei agbɛi yɛ.

english_verse: but the son of the slave woman is also your son, and I will make his descendants into a great nation.”
translation_verse: Tsulɔyoo lɛ binuu lɛ hu, mahã etsɔ̃ maŋ kpele ejaakɛ oshwie ji lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Early the next morning Abraham gave Hagar an animal skin full of water and some bread. Then he put the boy on her shoulder and sent them away. They wandered around in the desert near Beersheba,
translation_verse: Abraham te shi leebi maŋkpa. Ekɔ aboloo ni ewo nu kɛ tɔ ekɛtswa Hagar kɔŋ. Ekɛ gbekɛ lɛ hu hã Hagar, kɛkɛ ni ewo lɛ gbɛ. Hagar yi mli ni eyatsomlo yɛ Beersheba ŋa lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: and after they had run out of water, Hagar put her son under a bush.
translation_verse: Be ni nu lɛ tã yɛ wolo tɔ lɛ mli lɛ, Hagar ŋmɛɛ gbekɛ lɛ he efɔ̃ koowie ko mli.

english_verse: Then she sat down a long way off, because she could not bear to watch him die. And she cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Ni etee eyata sɛɛ flɛŋŋ aaafee tɛfɔ̃ɔ jɛkɛmɔ yɛ gbekɛ lɛ ŋlɛnɔ; ejaakɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Minyɛŋ makwɛ gbekɛ lɛ gbele.” Eho eta shi yɛ gbekɛ lɛ ŋlɛnɔ ni gbekɛ lɛ jwa yaafo.

english_verse: When God heard the boy crying, the angel of God called out to Hagar from heaven and said, “Hagar, why are you worried? Don't be afraid. I have heard your son crying.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ nu oblanyo lɛ gbee, ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo jɛ ŋwɛi etsɛ Hagar, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni gbaa onaa Hagar? Kaashe gbeyei, shi Nyɔŋmɔ enu gbekɛ lɛ gbee yɛ he ni gbekɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Help him up and hold his hand, because I will make him the father of a great nation.”
translation_verse: Tee shi ni owo gbekɛ lɛ nɔ, hiɛmɔ lɛ jogbaŋŋ, ejaakɛ mahã etsɔ maŋ kpeteŋkple.”

english_verse: Then God let her see a well. So she went to the well and filled the skin with water, then gave some to her son.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbele Hagar hiŋmɛii, ni ena nubu ko. Eyiŋ etee, ni eyayɛ nu ewo wolo tɔ lɛ mli obɔ̃, ni ehã gbekɛ nuu lɛ eko enu.

english_verse: God blessed Ishmael, and as the boy grew older, he became an expert at hunting with his bow and arrows. He lived in the Paran Desert, and his mother chose an Egyptian woman for him to marry. A Peace Treaty
translation_verse: Ehi shi yɛ Paran ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni enyɛ yaŋɔ yoo kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ebahã lɛ. Abraham kɛ Abimelek kpãŋ

english_verse: About this time Abimelech and his army commander Phicol said to Abraham, “God blesses everything you do!
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ, Abimelek kɛ etatsɛ Fikol bakɛɛ Abraham akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ bo yɛ, yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni ofeɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: Now I want you to promise in the name of God that you will always be loyal to me and my descendants, just as I have always been loyal to you in this land where you have lived as a foreigner.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akã mi kitã yɛ biɛ nɛɛ akɛ oyeŋ mi loo mibii loo mihɔi kutumpɔo; shi bɔ ni miyeɔ bo anɔkwa lɛ, nakai obaafee mi kɛ shikpɔŋ ni obato gbɔ yɛ nɔ nɛɛ.”

english_verse: And so, Abraham promised he would.
translation_verse: Ni Abraham kɛɛ akɛ, “Makã kitã lɛ.”

english_verse: One day, Abraham told Abimelech, “Some of your servants have taken over one of my wells.”
translation_verse: Shi Abraham kɛ Abimelek wie kɛ dɔlɛ yɛ nubu ko ni Abimelek tsuji lɛ eshɔ̃ ekãa naa yɛ edɛ lɛ he.

english_verse: “This is the first I've heard about it,” Abimelech replied. “Why haven't you said something before? I don't have any idea who did it.”
translation_verse: Ni Abimelek kɛɛ akɛ, “Mileee mɔ ni ye nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ, ni bo hu otsiii tã okɛɛɛ mi lɛ, asaŋ minuko da hu, akɛ ja ŋmɛnɛ.”

english_verse: Abraham gave Abimelech some sheep and cattle, then the two men made a peace treaty.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Abraham kɛ toi kɛ tsinai hã Abimelek ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛkpãŋ.

english_verse: Abraham separated seven female lambs from his flock of sheep,
translation_verse: Abraham jie toi lɛ amli gwantɛŋ biyei kpawo eto afã.

english_verse: and Abimelech asked, “Why have you done this?”
translation_verse: Abimelek bi Abraham akɛ, “Nɛkɛ gwantɛŋ biyei kpawo ni ojie oto afã nɛɛ, te eshishiŋ?”

english_verse: Abraham replied, “I want you to accept these seven lambs as proof that I dug this well.”
translation_verse: Ni Abraham kɛɛ, “Gwantɛŋ biyei kpawo nɛɛ, ŋɔɔ yɛ midɛŋ koni okɛye odase ohã mi akɛ mi mije nɛkɛ nubu nɛɛ.”

english_verse: So they called the place Beersheba, because they made a treaty there.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Abraham tsɛ jɛi Beersheba, ejaakɛ jɛi amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛkãmɔ kitã yɛ.

english_verse: When the treaty was completed, Abimelech and his army commander Phicol went back to the land of the Philistines.
translation_verse: Amɛkpãŋ yɛ Beersheba. Kɛkɛ ni Abimelek kɛ etatsɛ Fikol te shi, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Filistibii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba and worshiped the eternal Lord God.
translation_verse: Abraham tɛo tso ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ akɛ tamariske tso lɛ yɛ Beersheba, ni eja Yehowa, Naanɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: Then Abraham lived a long time as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines.
translation_verse: Abraham to gbɔ yɛ Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ be kplaŋŋ.

english_verse: Some years later God decided to test Abraham, so he spoke to him. Abraham answered, “Here I am, Lord.”
translation_verse: Saji nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ eba mli akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ka Abraham ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Abraham!” Ni Abraham kɛɛ, “Naa mi!”

english_verse: The Lord said, “Go get Isaac, your only son, the one you dearly love! Take him to the land of Moriah, and I will show you a mountain where you must sacrifice him to me on the fires of an altar.”
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ obi Isak ni ji obi koome ni odɔɔ ehe lɛ, ni oyiŋ oya Moria Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni okɛ lɛ ayashã afɔle yɛ jɛi, yɛ gɔji lɛ ateŋ ekome ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: So Abraham got up early the next morning and chopped wood for the fire. He put a saddle on his donkey and set out with Isaac and two servants for the place where God had told him to go.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Abraham te shi leebi maŋkpa, ni ewo eteji nɔ nii, ni eŋɔ eblahii lɛ enyɔ kɛ ebi Isak lɛ efata ehe. Egba lai ni ekɛyaashã shãa afɔle lɛ; ni eyiŋ eeya he ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Three days later Abraham looked off in the distance and saw the place.
translation_verse: Gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Abraham wo ehiɛ nɔ, ni ena jɛi yɛ shɔŋŋ.

english_verse: He told his servants, “Stay here with the donkey, while my son and I go over there to worship. We will come back.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Abraham kɛɛ eblahii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ teji lɛ ahĩa biɛ; mi kɛ oblanyo lɛ miiya he ni jeɔ lɛ wɔyaja Nyɔŋmɔ ni wɔku wɔsɛɛ wɔba nyɛŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ.”

english_verse: Abraham put the wood on Isaac's shoulder, but he carried the hot coals and the knife. As the two of them walked along,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Abraham kɛ afɔleshãa lai lɛ tere ebi Isak, ni eŋɔ la lɛ kɛ kakla lɛ ehiɛ edɛ; ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ pɛ amɛyi mli amɛtee.

english_verse: Isaac said, “Father, we have the coals and the wood, but where is the lamb for the sacrifice?” “My son,” Abraham answered, “God will provide the lamb.” The two of them walked on, and
translation_verse: Abraham to he akɛ, “Mibi, Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ aaahã too gwantɛŋ ni akɛshã shãa afɔle lɛ!” Kɛkɛ ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛshwie nɔ kɛtee.

english_verse: when they reached the place that God had told him about, Abraham built an altar and placed the wood on it. Next, he tied up his son and put him on the wood.
translation_verse: Be ni amɛshɛ he ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, Abraham ma afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi. Eto lai lɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni efi ebi Isak lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ ŋmɛ lai lɛ nɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: He then took the knife and got ready to kill his son.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Abraham kpã enine mli ekɔ kakla lɛ koni ekɛgbe ebi lɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord's angel shouted from heaven, “Abraham! Abraham!” “Here I am!” he answered.
translation_verse: Shi Yehowa bɔfo lɛ jɛ ŋwɛi etsɛ Abraham ekɛɛ, “Abraham, Abraham!” Abraham here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Naa mi!”

english_verse: “Don't hurt the boy or harm him in any way!” the angel said. “Now I know that you truly obey God, because you were willing to offer him your only son.”
translation_verse: Bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaahã onine miisa oblanyo lɛ he, ni asaŋ kaafee lɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko! Shi mina mile agbɛnɛ akɛ osheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, akɛni okamaaa lɛ obi koome nɛɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: Abraham looked up and saw a ram caught by its horns in the bushes. So he took the ram and sacrificed it instead of his son.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Abraham wo ehiɛ nɔ; eyaakwɛ ehe lɛ, naa ojwɛni ko yɛ esɛɛgbɛ ni eklontoi elalaa koo. Abraham tee eyamɔ ojwɛni lɛ, ni eŋɔ lɛ eshã shãa afɔle lɛ yɛ ebi lɛ najiaŋ.

english_verse: Abraham named that place “The Lord Will Provide.” And even now people say, “On the mountain of the Lord it will be provided.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Abraham wo jɛi gbɛi akɛ “Yehowa aaakwɛ.” No hewɔ akɛɔ kɛ ŋmɛnɛ akɛ, “Yehowa Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ aaakwɛ yɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord's angel called out from heaven a second time:
translation_verse: Ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ jɛ ŋwɛi etsɛ Abraham nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ,

english_verse: You were willing to offer your only son to the Lord, and so he makes you this solemn promise,
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Mikã mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe kitã akɛ, akɛni ofee enɛ ni okamaaa mi obi lɛ ni ji obi kome too lɛ

english_verse: You have obeyed me, and so you and your descendants will be a blessing to all nations on earth.”
translation_verse: Ni oshwiei lɛ amli aaajɛ ajɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji fɛɛ, ejaakɛ obo mi toi.’ ”

english_verse: Abraham and Isaac went back to the servants who had come with him, and they returned to Abraham's home in Beersheba. The Children of Nahor
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Abraham ku esɛɛ kɛba eblahii lɛ aŋɔɔ. Amɛte shi, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛŋɔ shwie nɔ kɛba Beersheba. Abraham hi shi yɛ Beersheba.

english_verse: Nahor also had another wife. Her name was Reumah, and she had four sons: Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
translation_verse: Nahor hemɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Reuma lɛ hu kɛ Nahor fɔ Teba kɛ Gaham kɛ Tahash kɛ Maaka.

english_verse: “I live as a foreigner in your land, and I don't own any property where I can bury my wife. Please let me buy a piece of land.”
translation_verse: “Mɔkpɔŋ ji mi, ni mibato gbɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ. Nyɛhãa mi he ko mahe koni mikɛfee fuuhe ni mato miŋa gbonyo ni kã mihiɛ nɛɛ yɛ jɛi.”

english_verse: “Sir,” they answered, “you are an important man. Choose the best place to bury your wife. None of us would refuse you a resting place for your dead.”
translation_verse: “Nuŋtsɔ, bo wɔ toi; wɔbuɔ bo akɛ lumɔ kpele yɛ wɔteŋ. Wɔfuuhei lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ, fuu ogbonyo lɛ yɛ mli; wɔteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko etsiŋ bo gbɛ akɛ okafu ogbonyo lɛ yɛ fuuhe lɛ.”

english_verse: and replied, “If you are willing to let me bury my wife here, please ask Zohar's son Ephron
translation_verse: ni ekɛ amɛ wie ekɛɛ; “Kɛji nyɛyɛ he tsui akɛ mifu migbonyo ni kã mihiɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛboa mi toi, ni nyɛkpaa Zohar bi Efron lɛ fai nyɛhãa mi

english_verse: to sell me Machpelah Cave at the end of his field. I'll pay what it's worth, and all of you can be witnesses.”
translation_verse: koni ekɛ etɛkplo ni ji Makpela tɛkplo lɛ ni yɔɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ naagbee he lɛ ahã mi. Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni ji tɛkplo lɛ naa lɛ, eŋɔ ehã mi yɛ nyɛhiɛ, ni mahe mikɛfee mifuuhe lɛ.”

english_verse: Ephron was sitting there near the city gate, when Abraham made this request, and he answered,
translation_verse: Efron, Hitnyo lɛ, ta Hitbii lɛ ateŋ, ni ehere Abraham nɔ bɔ ni Hitbii lɛ fɛɛ nu yɛ amɛtoiŋ yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni boteɔ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ mli lɛ hiɛ akɛ,

english_verse: “Sir, the whole field, including the cave, is yours. With my own people as witnesses, I freely give it to you as a burial place for your dead.”
translation_verse: “Dabida, minuŋtsɔ, bo mi toi! Shikpɔŋ lɛ mikɛmiihã bo, ni tɛkplo ni yɔɔ mli lɛ hu mikɛmiihã bo, mimaŋbii lɛ ahiɛ mikɛhãa bo yɛ nɛɛ, fuu oŋa lɛ gbonyo lɛ yɛ jɛi.”

english_verse: and said to Ephron, “In front of these witnesses, I offer you the full price, so I can bury my wife. Please accept my offer.”
translation_verse: akɛ, “Miikpa bo fai, bo mi toi. Masumɔ matse shika mikɛhe shikpɔŋ lɛ; hemɔ shika lɛ yɛ midɛŋ koni mafu migbonyo lɛ yɛ jɛi.”

english_verse: So Abraham buried his wife Sarah in Machpelah Cave that was in the field
translation_verse: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Abraham fu eŋa Sara yɛ nakai tɛkplo lɛ ni yɔɔ Makpela abɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ mli, yɛ Mamre bokãgbɛ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Abraham was now a very old man. The Lord had made him rich, and he was successful in everything he did.
translation_verse: Abraham egbɔ, ni eye afii pii; ni Yehowa ejɔɔ Abraham yɛ nibii fɛɛ amli.

english_verse: One day, Abraham called in his most trusted servant and said to him, “Solemnly promise me
translation_verse: Abraham kɛɛ etsulɔ ni ji ewe lɛ mli onukpa ni lɛ ekwɛɔ nii fɛɛ ni Abraham yɔɔ lɛ anɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ba ni okɛ onine abahɔ mishuɔ shishi

english_verse: in the name of the Lord, who rules heaven and earth, that you won't choose a wife for my son Isaac from the people here in the land of Canaan.
translation_verse: koni mahã okã Yehowa, ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitã akɛ oŋɔŋ Kanaanbii ni miyɔɔ amɛteŋ nɛɛ abiyei lɛ eko akɛ ŋa ohaŋ mibi Isak;

english_verse: Instead, go back to the land where I was born and find a wife for him from among my relatives.”
translation_verse: shi moŋ oootee mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ miweku lɛ mli ni oyaŋɔ yoo obahã lɛ.”

english_verse: But the servant asked, “What if the young woman I choose refuses to leave home and come here with me? Should I send Isaac there to look for a wife?”
translation_verse: Ni tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ Abraham akɛ, “Ekolɛ, yoo lɛ ebakpɛlɛŋ ni enyiɛ misɛɛ kɛba shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ. Kɛ eba lɛ nakai lɛ, ani mikɛ obi lɛ aku sɛɛ aya shikpɔŋ nɔ he ni ojɛ kɛba lɛ lo?”

english_verse: “No!” Abraham answered. “Don't ever do that, no matter what.
translation_verse: Abraham kɛɛ tsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Kwɛmɔ ni ahi koni okɛ mibi lɛ akaku sɛɛ kɛmiiya jɛi.

english_verse: The Lord who rules heaven brought me here from the land where I was born and promised that he would give this land to my descendants forever. When you go back there, the Lord will send his angel ahead of you to help you find a wife for my son.
translation_verse: Yehowa, ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni ŋɔ mi kɛjɛ mitsɛ we lɛ kɛ miwekumɛi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛ mi wie ni ekã mi kitã akɛ, ‘Oshwiei maŋɔ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ mahã lɛ,’ lɛ eeetsu ebɔfo kɛnyiɛ ohiɛ ni oyaŋɔ yoo kɛjɛ jɛi obahã mibi lɛ.

english_verse: If the woman refuses to come along, you don't have to keep this promise. But don't ever take my son back there.”
translation_verse: Kɛji yoo lɛ sumɔɔɔ akɛ eeenyiɛ osɛɛ kɛba lɛ, no lɛ, ohe eje mikitã nɛɛ mli; mibi lɛ kɛkɛ ni okɛ lɛ akaku sɛɛ kɛmiiya jɛi.”

english_verse: So the servant gave Abraham his word that he would do everything he had been told to do.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni tsulɔ lɛ kɛ enine hɔ enuŋtsɔ Abraham shuɔ shishi ni ekã lɛ kitã yɛ sane nɛɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Soon after that, the servant loaded ten of Abraham's camels with valuable gifts. Then he set out for the city in northern Syria, where Abraham's brother Nahor lived.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni tsulɔ lɛ ŋɔ enuŋtsɔ yoomai lɛ ateŋ nyɔŋma, ni eŋɔ enuŋtsɔ lɛ nikeenii kpakpai srɔtoi ehiɛ edɛ̃ŋ, ni eyiŋ kɛtee maŋ he ni Nahor hi yɛ Mesopotamia kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: When he got there, he let the camels rest near the well outside the city. It was late afternoon, the time when the women came out for water.
translation_verse: Tsulɔ lɛ hã yoomai lɛ bumɔ shi yɛ maŋ lɛ ŋmaŋmasha lɛ, yɛ nubu ko he, gbɛkɛnaashi be mli ni yei jeɔ kpo baa nuyɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The servant prayed: You, Lord, are the God my master Abraham worships. Please keep your promise to him and let me find a wife for Isaac today.
translation_verse: Esɔle ekɛɛ “Ao, Yehowa, minuŋtsɔ Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ! Miikpa bo fai ni ohã mihe aba nii ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, ni ojie osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kpo otsɔ̃ɔ minuŋtsɔ Abraham.

english_verse: The young women of the city will soon come to this well for water,
translation_verse: Naa, midamɔ nubu nɛɛ he, ni maŋ lɛ mli bii abiyei miije kpo miiba nuyɛɛ.

english_verse: and I'll ask one of them for a drink. If she gives me a drink and then offers to get some water for my camels, I'll know she is the one you have chosen and that you have kept your promise to my master.
translation_verse: Hã aba mli akɛ oblayoo mɔ ni makɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Miikpa bo fai, too ogbɛ lɛ kɛba shi ni manu nu lɛ eko,’ ni eeekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nuu, ni mahã oyomai lɛ hu eko amɛnu’ lɛ, lɛ efee mɔ krɛdɛɛ ni ojie ohã otsulɔ Isak. Enɛ mikɛaale akɛ ojie osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kpo otsɔ̃ɔ minuŋtsɔ.”

english_verse: While he was still praying, a beautiful unmarried young woman came by with a water jar on her shoulder. She was Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel, the son of Abraham's brother Nahor and his wife Milcah. Rebekah walked past Abraham's servant, then went over to the well, and filled her water jar. When she started back,
translation_verse: Oblayoo nɛɛ ehe yɛ fɛo naakpa; oblayoo foro ni, ni nuu ko etako ehe dã. Ekpeleke shi kɛtee bu lɛ mli ni eyawo egbɛ lɛ obɔ̃, kɛkɛ ni eje kpo kɛba.

english_verse: Abraham's servant ran to her and said, “Please let me have a drink of water.”
translation_verse: Abraham tsulɔ lɛ sha foi ekɛ lɛ yakpe ni ekɛɛ, “Miikpa bo fai ni ohã manu ogbɛ lɛ mli nu lɛ fioo.”

english_verse: “I'll be glad to,” she answered. Then she quickly took the jar from her shoulder and held it while he drank.
translation_verse: Oblayoo lɛ kɛɛ, “Nuu, minuŋtsɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni ehe fee oya ni eto gbɛ lɛ ehiɛ edɛ̃ŋ ni ehã lɛ nu enu.

english_verse: After he had finished, she said, “Now I'll give your camels all the water they want.” She quickly poured out water for them, and she kept going back for more, until his camels had drunk all they wanted.
translation_verse: Ehe fee oya ni etsɔ̃ egbɛ lɛ mli nu lɛ ewo nunumɔ nɔ lɛ mli. Kɛkɛ ni esha foi etee bu lɛ mli ekoŋŋ eyayɛ nu lɛ ni eyɛ ehã yoomai lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Abraham's servant did not say a word, but he watched everything Rebekah did, because he wanted to know for certain if this was the woman the Lord had chosen.
translation_verse: Tsulɔ lɛ fee diŋŋ ni ekwɛ oblayoo lɛ too koni ekɛle akɛ Yehowa ehã egbɛfãa lɛ efee omanye lo.

english_verse: The servant had brought along an expensive gold ring and two large gold bracelets. When Rebekah had finished bringing the water, he gave her the ring for her nose and the bracelets for her arms.
translation_verse: Be ni yoomai lɛ enu nu lɛ egbe naa lɛ, tsulɔ lɛ ŋɔ shika ŋmiiŋmi ga ni jara wa ekɛwo oblayoo lɛ gugɔŋ, ni eŋɔ shika ŋmiiŋmi nineshi gai agboi enyɔ hu ekɛwo oblayoo lɛ niji.

english_verse: Then he said, “Please tell me who your father is. Does he have room in his house for me and my men to spend the night?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ biyoo ji bo? Kɛɛmɔ mi koo! Ani wɔɔna gbɛ yɛ otsɛ we lɛ koni wɔyato jɛi?”

english_verse: She answered, “My father is Bethuel, the son of Nahor and Milcah.
translation_verse: Oblayoo lɛ hã hetoo akɛ, “Nahor kɛ eŋa Milka bi Betuel lɛ biyoo ji mi.”

english_verse: We have a place where you and your men can stay, and we also have enough straw and feed for your camels.”
translation_verse: Asaŋ oblayoo lɛ kɛɛ tsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔyɛ jwɛi kɛ kooloi aniyenii pii, ni gbɛ hu yɛ bɔ ni aaanyɛ ato jɛi.”

english_verse: Then the servant bowed his head and prayed,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni tsulɔ lɛ ma eyi shi, ni eja Yehowa ni ekɛɛ,

english_verse: “I thank you, Lord God of my master Abraham! You have led me to his relatives and kept your promise to him.”
translation_verse: “Aaajie Yehowa, minuŋtsɔ Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi akɛ ehãko esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛ enɔkwayeli lɛ sɛɛ afo yɛ minuŋtsɔ nɔ; ni mi hu Yehowa ebatsɔ̃ɔ mi minuŋtsɔ wekumɛi awe gbɛ!”

english_verse: Rebekah ran straight home and told her family everything.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni oblayoo lɛ sha foi kɛtee eyagba mɛi ni yɔɔ enyɛ we lɛ nɛkɛ saji nɛɛ.

english_verse: Her brother Laban heard her tell what the servant had said, and he saw the ring and the bracelets she was wearing. So Laban ran out to Abraham's servant, who was standing by his camels at the well.
translation_verse: Be ni Laban na ga lɛ kɛ nineshi gai lɛ yɛ enyɛmi yoo lɛ niji, ni asaŋ enu wiemɔi ni Rebeka kɛɛ nuu lɛ kɛ lɛ wie lɛ, eba nuu lɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ he ni edamɔ yɛ yoomai lɛ amasɛi yɛ bu lɛ he lɛ,

english_verse: Then Laban said, “The Lord has brought you safely here. Come home with me. There's no need for you to keep on standing outside. I have a room ready for you in our house, and there's also a place for your camels.”
translation_verse: ni Laban kɛɛ nuu lɛ akɛ, “Ba shĩa, bo mɔ ni Yehowa ejɔɔ bo! Mɛɛ hewɔ odamɔ ŋmaŋmasha? Shi misaa shĩa lɛ mihã bo, kɛ gbɛ hu mihã yoomai lɛ.”

english_verse: Abraham's servant went home with Laban, where Laban's servants unloaded his camels and gave them straw and feed. Then they brought water into the house, so Abraham's servant and his men could wash their feet.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nuu lɛ ba shĩa lɛ, ni Laban jie yoomai lɛ anɔ nii lɛ. Ehã nuu lɛ jwɛi kɛ niyenii ni akɛhã yoomai lɛ. Asaŋ ehã tsulɔ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni ekɛnyiɛ lɛ nu ni amɛkɛfɔ amɛnaji ahe.

english_verse: After that, they brought in food. But the servant said, “Before I eat, I must tell you why I have come.” “Go ahead and tell us,” Laban answered.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni akɛ niyenii bama tsulɔ lɛ hiɛ koni eye. Shi tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Miyeŋ nii ja mibɔ mimaniɛ ni mihiɛ kɛba lɛ dã.” Ni Laban kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wiemɔ!”

english_verse: The servant explained: I am Abraham's servant.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Abraham tsulɔ ji mi.

english_verse: The Lord has been good to my master and has made him very rich. He has given him many sheep, goats, cattle, camels, and donkeys, as well as a lot of silver and gold, and many slaves.
translation_verse: Yehowa ejɔɔ minuŋtsɔ naakpa, ni etsɔ̃ niiatsɛ wulu. Yehowa ehã lɛ toi kɛ tsinai kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika kɛ webii kɛ weyei kɛ yoomai kɛ tejii.

english_verse: Sarah, my master's wife, didn't have any children until she was very old. Then she had a son, and my master has given him everything.
translation_verse: Minuŋtsɔ ŋa Sara kɛ minuŋtsɔ fɔ binuu be ni Sara egbɔ sɛɛ, ni minuŋtsɔ Abraham eŋɔ enii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ ehã ebinuu nɛɛ.

english_verse: I solemnly promised my master that I would do what he said. And he told me, “Don't choose a wife for my son from the women in this land of Canaan.
translation_verse: Minuŋtsɔ hã mikã kitã akɛ, ‘Kaaŋɔ Kanaanbii, mɛi ashikpɔŋ nɔ ni miyɔɔ lɛ abiyei lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko akɛ ŋa ohã mibinuu lɛ;

english_verse: Instead, go back to the land where I was born and find a wife for my son from among my relatives.”
translation_verse: shi moŋ yaa mitsɛ we lɛ kɛ wekumɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ koni oyaŋɔ ŋa obahã mibinuu lɛ.’

english_verse: I asked my master, “What if the young woman refuses to come with me?”
translation_verse: Ni mikɛɛ minuŋtsɔ akɛ, ‘Eko lɛ yoo lɛ ebanyiɛŋ misɛɛ kɛbaŋ.’

english_verse: My master answered, “I have always obeyed the Lord, and he will send his angel to help you find my son a wife from among my own relatives.
translation_verse: Shi ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Yehowa, mɔ toi ni miboɔ daa nɛɛ lɛ, aaatsu ebɔfo afata ohe, ni eeehã oye omanye, ni obaaya oyaŋɔ ŋa yɛ mijaku kɛ mitsɛ we lɛ obahã mibinuu lɛ.

english_verse: But if they refuse to let her come back with you, then you are freed from your promise.”
translation_verse: Ja nakai dani ohe aaaje mikitã nɛɛ mli. Kɛji otee mijakubii aŋɔɔ ni amɛkɛ yoo lɛ hãaa bo lɛ, no lɛ ohe eje mikitã lɛ mli.’

english_verse: When I came to the well today, I silently prayed, “You, Lord, are the God my master Abraham worships, so please lead me to a wife for his son
translation_verse: “Be ni mibashɛ nubu lɛ he ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, misɔle mikɛɛ, ‘Yehowa, minuŋtsɔ Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ, kɛji ooohã migbɛ ni minyiɛ nɛɛ afee omanye lɛ,

english_verse: while I am here at the well. When a young woman comes out to get water, I'll ask her to give me a drink.
translation_verse: no lɛ naa miidamɔ nubu nɛɛ he, ni hã aba mli akɛ oblayoo ni aaaje kpo aba nuyɛɛ ni makɛɛ lɛ akɛ miikpa bo fai ni ohã mi ogbɛ lɛ mli nu lɛ fioo manu,

english_verse: If she gives me a drink and offers to get some water for my camels, I'll know she is the one you have chosen.”
translation_verse: ni eeekɛɛ mi akɛ, nuu, ni masaa mayɛ eko mahã oyomai lɛ hu lɛ, hã lɛ efee yoo krɛdɛɛ ni Yehowa ejie ehã minuŋtsɔ bi lɛ.’

english_verse: Even before I had finished praying, Rebekah came by with a water jar on her shoulder. When she had filled the jar, I asked her for a drink.
translation_verse: Be ni mikɛɛ miwieɔ migbeɔ naa yɛ miyitsoŋ pɛ lɛ, naa, Rebeka epue ni egbɛ tswa ekɔŋ kɛmiiba. Ekpeleke shi kɛtee bu lɛ mli eyayɛ nu. Mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Ofainɛ ni ohã mi nu lɛ fioo.’

english_verse: She quickly lowered the jar from her shoulder and said, “Have a drink. Then I'll get water for your camels.” So I drank, and after that she got some water for my camels.
translation_verse: “Ehe fee oya, ni eto egbɛ lɛ ehiɛ edɛ̃ŋ ni ekɛɛ, ‘Nuu ni mahã oyomai lɛ hu eko amɛnu!’ No hewɔ lɛ, minu, ni ehã yoomai lɛ hu eko amɛnu.

english_verse: I asked her who her father was, and she answered, “My father is Bethuel the son of Nahor and Milcah.” At once I put the ring in her nose and the bracelets on her arms.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mibi lɛ akɛ, ‘Namɔ bi ji bo?’ Ni ekɛɛ, ‘Nahor kɛ eŋa Milka binuu Betuel lɛ bi ji mi’. No hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ ga lɛ wo egugɔŋ, ni mikɛ nineshi gai lɛ wo eniji.

english_verse: Then I bowed my head and gave thanks to the God my master Abraham worships. The Lord had led me straight to my master's relatives, and I had found a wife for his son.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mima miyi shi, ni mija Yehowa, ni mijie Yehowa, minuŋtsɔ Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ mi gbɛ jurɔ koni mikɛbaŋɔ minuŋtsɔ wekunyo biyoo mahã ebinuu lɛ.

english_verse: Now please tell me if you are willing to do the right thing for my master. Will you treat him fairly, or do I have to look for another young woman?
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ kɛji nyɛkɛ minuŋtsɔ aaaye yɛ mlihilɛ kɛ anɔkwayeli naa lɛ, no lɛ nyɛkɛa mi ni kɛjeee nakai hu, nyɛkɛa mi, koni male bɔ ni mafee.”

english_verse: Laban and Bethuel answered, “The Lord has done this. We have no choice in the matter.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Laban kɛ Betuel here nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yehowa ŋɔɔ sane nɛɛ jɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, wɔbɛ nɔ ko ni wɔbaakɛɛ.

english_verse: Take Rebekah with you; she can marry your master's son, just as the Lord has said.”
translation_verse: Naa, Rebeka lɛ nɛ, ŋɔɔ lɛ ni okɛ lɛ aya ni eyatsɔ onuŋtsɔ binuu lɛ ŋa, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: Abraham's servant bowed down and thanked the Lord.
translation_verse: Be ni Abraham tsulɔ lɛ nu amɛnaa wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, eho ebu shi ni eja Yehowa.

english_verse: Then he gave clothing, as well as silver and gold jewelry, to Rebekah. He also gave expensive gifts to her brother and her mother.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ tsulɔ lɛ jie jwiɛtɛi nibii kɛ shika nibii kɛ mamai kɛba, ni ekɛhã Rebeka. Asaŋ ehã Rebeka nyɛmi nuu lɛ kɛ enyɛ hu nibii ni jara wa.

english_verse: Abraham's servant and the men with him ate and drank, then spent the night there. The next morning they got up, and the servant told Rebekah's mother and brother, “I would like to go back to my master now.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni agbɛnɛ tsulɔ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ ye nii, ni amɛnu nɔ ko. Amɛwɔ jɛi nakai gbi lɛ. Be ni amɛte shi leebi lɛ, Abraham tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛwoa mi gbɛ koni maya minuŋtsɔ ŋɔɔ.”

english_verse: “Let Rebekah stay with us for a week or ten days,” they answered. “Then she may go.”
translation_verse: Shi Rebeka nyɛmi nuu lɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Hã oblayoo lɛ kɛ wɔ ahi shi gbii fioo, akɛ gbii nyɔŋma nɛkɛ, koni no sɛɛ ni okɛ lɛ aya.”

english_verse: But he said, “Don't make me stay any longer. The Lord has already helped me find a wife for my master's son. Now let us return.”
translation_verse: Shi tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkatsia minaa, ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã migbɛfãa lɛ eye omanye; nyɛwoa mi gbɛ ni maya minuŋtsɔ ŋɔɔ!”

english_verse: They answered, “Let's ask Rebekah what she wants to do.”
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔbaatsɛ oblayoo lɛ koni wɔbi edaaŋ gbee.”

english_verse: They called her and asked, “Are you willing to leave with this man at once?” “Yes,” she answered.
translation_verse: Amɛtsɛ lɛ ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ nuu nɛɛ aaatee lo?” Ni Rebeka kɛɛ akɛ, “Matee.”

english_verse: So they agreed to let Rebekah and an old family servant woman leave immediately with Abraham's servant and his men.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amɛwo amɛnyɛmi yoo Rebeka kɛ tsulɔyoo nukpa kɛ Abraham tsulɔ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni fata ehe kɛba lɛ gbɛ.

english_verse: They gave Rebekah their blessing and said, “We pray that God will give you many children and grandchildren and that he will help them defeat their enemies.”
translation_verse: Amɛjɔɔ Rebeka amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔnyɛmi yoo, tsɔ mɛi akpei huhaa anyɛ, ni oshwiei aye amɛhenyɛlɔi amaji anɔ kunim.”

english_verse: Afterwards, Rebekah and the young women who were to travel with her prepared to leave. Then they got on camels and left with Abraham's servant and his men.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Rebeka kɛ eblayei lɛ te shi, ni amɛho amɛtara yoomai lɛ anɔ koni amɛya; kɛkɛ ni Abraham tsulɔ lɛ ŋɔ Rebeka, ni amɛŋɔ shwie nɔ.

english_verse: At that time Isaac was living in the southern part of Canaan near a place called “The Well of the Living One Who Sees Me.”
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ, Isak ejɛ nubu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ, “Mɔ ni hiɛ kã ni enaa nii lɛ nubu” lɛ kpokpai anɔ eba. Nubu nɛɛ yɛ Kanaan wuoyigbɛ.

english_verse: One evening he was walking out in the fields, when suddenly he saw a group of people approaching on camels. So he started toward them. Rebekah saw him coming; she got down from her camel, and asked, “Who is that man?” “He is my master Isaac,” the servant answered. Then Rebekah covered her face with her veil.
translation_verse: Ebi Abraham tsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ni nyiɛ ŋa lɛ mli kɛbaa ni ekɛ wɔ abakpe nɛɛ, namɔ ni?” Ni tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ lɛ ni.” Kɛkɛ ni Rebeka kɔ ehiɛhaa nɔ lɛ ni ekɛha ehiɛ.

english_verse: The servant told Isaac everything that had happened.
translation_verse: Tsulɔ lɛ gba Isak nii fɛɛ ni eyatsu lɛ.

english_verse: Isaac took Rebekah into the tent where his mother had lived before she died, and Rebekah became his wife. He loved her and was comforted over the loss of his mother.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Isak kɛ Rebeka ba buu ni enyɛ Sara hi mli lɛ mli. Isak ŋɔ Rebeka ni ebatsɔ eŋa ni esumɔ lɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, Rebeka shɛje Isak mii yɛ enyɛ gbele lɛ sɛɛ.

english_verse: and they had six sons: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
translation_verse: Abraham kɛ Ketura fɔ Zimran kɛ Yokshan kɛ Medan kɛ Midian kɛ Ishbak kɛ Shua.

english_verse: Later, Jokshan became the father of Sheba and Dedan, and when Dedan grew up, he had three sons: Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.
translation_verse: Yokshan fɔ Sheba kɛ Dedan. Dedan bii ji Ashurbii kɛ Letushbii kɛ Leumbii;

english_verse: Midian also had five sons: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah.
translation_verse: Midian bii ji Efa kɛ Efer kɛ Hanok kɛ Abida kɛ Eldaa. Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ Ketura shwiei ni.

english_verse: While Abraham was still alive, he gave gifts to the sons of Hagar and Keturah. He also sent their sons to live in the east far from his son Isaac, and when Abraham died, he left everything to Isaac. The Death of Abraham
translation_verse: Shi ehemɛi lɛ abii lɛ, Abraham hã amɛ nikeenii be mli ni ehiɛ kã beebe, ni ewo amɛ gbɛ kɛje ebi Isak he kɛtee bokãgbɛ yɛ bokãgbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Abraham gbele kɛ efuu

english_verse: Abraham died at the ripe old age of
translation_verse: Ni Abraham gbo yɛ gbɔlɛ kpakpa mli, nuumo ni, ni egbɔ kotokoto.

english_verse: God blessed Isaac after this, and Isaac moved to a place called “The Well of the Living One Who Sees Me.” Ishmael's Descendants
translation_verse: Abraham gbele sɛɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ ebinuu Isak. Ehi shi yɛ “Mɔ ni hiɛ kã ni naa mi” lɛ nubu lɛ he. Ishmael Shwiei (

english_verse: Ishmael was the son of Abraham and Hagar, the slave woman of Sarah.
translation_verse: Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Abraham bi Ishmael ni Ijiptyoo Hagar ni ji Sara weyoo lɛ kɛ Abraham fɔ lɛ shwiei.

english_verse: Ishmael had twelve sons, in this order: Nebaioth, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
translation_verse: Yɛ fɔmɔ naa lɛ, Ishmael bihii lɛ agbɛii nɛ: Nebaiot, lɛ ji kromɔ, kɛ Kedar kɛ Abdeel kɛ Mibsam

english_verse: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
translation_verse: kɛ Mishma kɛ Duma kɛ Masa

english_verse: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
translation_verse: kɛ Hadad kɛ Tema kɛ Yetur kɛ Nafish kɛ Kedema.

english_verse: Each of Ishmael's sons was a tribal chief, and a village was named after each of them.
translation_verse: Ishmael bihii lɛ, amɛ ji akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ablematsɛmɛi, ni akɛ amɛgbɛii wo amɛkrowai kɛ amɛshitoohei lɛ.

english_verse: Ishmael had settled in the land east of his brothers, and his sons settled everywhere from Havilah to Shur, east of Egypt on the way to Asshur. Ishmael was
translation_verse: Ishmael shwiei nɛɛ he shi kɛjɛ Hawila kɛyashi Shur. Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ Ijipt ŋlɛnɔ kɛyaa Asiria gbɛ. Amɛtse amɛhe kɛje Abraham shwiei krokomɛi lɛ ahe. Esau kɛ Yakob fɔmɔ

english_verse: Isaac was the son of Abraham,
translation_verse: Abraham bi Isak shwiei nɛ: Abraham fɔ Isak.

english_verse: Rebekah still had no children. So Isaac asked the Lord to let her have a child, and the Lord answered his prayer.
translation_verse: Isak kpa Yehowa fai ehã eŋa lɛ ejaakɛ efee kene. Yehowa bo efaikpamɔ lɛ toi ni eŋa Rebeka na musu.

english_verse: Before Rebekah gave birth, she knew she was going to have twins, because she could feel them inside her, fighting each other. She thought, “Why is this happening to me?” Finally, she asked the Lord why her twins were fighting,
translation_verse: Bii lɛ shimɔshimɔɔ amɛhe yɛ musu lɛ mli. Ni Rebeka kɛɛ, “Mɛɛba sa akɛ nɛkɛ nɔ ko afee mi?” No hewɔ lɛ, etee eyabi Yehowa.

english_verse: and he told her: “Your two sons will become two separate nations. The younger of the two will be stronger, and the older son will be his servant.”
translation_verse: Ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Jeŋmaji enyɔ yɛ omusuŋ, ni maŋ kome he aaawa fe ekome, ni onukpa lɛ aaasɔmɔ gbekɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: the first baby was covered with red hair, so he was named Esau.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni ba klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ etsuɔ fɔɔ kɛ ehe tsɔi sulaŋŋ tamɔ ofo; awo lɛ Esau.

english_verse: The second baby grabbed on to his brother's heel, so they named him Jacob. Isaac was
translation_verse: No sɛɛ lɛ, enyɛmi lɛ hu ba ni enine hiɛ Esau nanetsitsi mli, ni awo lɛ Yakob. Be ni afɔ amɛ lɛ, Isak eye afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa. Esau hɔɔ ekromɔbi gbɛnaa

english_verse: As Jacob and Esau grew older, Esau liked the outdoors and became a good hunter, while Jacob lived the quiet life of a shepherd.
translation_verse: Gbekɛbii lɛ badara. Esau le gbɔbimɔ jogbaŋŋ, no hewɔ lɛ, efɔɔ ŋa mli yaa; shi Yakob lɛ gbɔmɔ kpoo ni, ni ehiɔ shĩa.

english_verse: One day, when Jacob was cooking some stew, Esau came home hungry
translation_verse: Gbi ko lɛ Yakob miihoo nii, ni Esau jɛ ŋa lɛ mli eba ni hɔmɔ miiye lɛ.

english_verse: and said, “I'm starving to death! Here and now give me some of that red stew!” That's how Esau got the name “Edom.”
translation_verse: Esau kɛɛ Yakob akɛ, “Miikpa bo fai, hã mi nɛkɛ niyenii tsuru nɛɛ eko maye, shi hɔmɔ miiye mi.” No hewɔ lɛ, awo Esau gbɛi akɛ Edom.

english_verse: Jacob replied, “Sell me your rights as the first-born son.”
translation_verse: Shi Yakob kɛɛ Esau akɛ, “Hɔɔmɔ okromɔbi gbɛnaa lɛ ohã mi dã!”

english_verse: “I'm about to die,” Esau answered. “What good will those rights do me?”
translation_verse: Ni Esau kɛɛ akɛ, “Miigbo kɛ hɔmɔ, ni mɛni kromɔbi gbɛnaa nɛɛ baafee ehã mi?”

english_verse: But Jacob said, “Promise me your birthrights, here and now!” And that's what Esau did.
