english_verse: Moses said to them, “You obeyed the Lord and did what was right, and so you will serve as his priests for the people of Israel. It was hard for you to kill your own sons and brothers, but the Lord has blessed you and made you his priests today.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Levibii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛjɔɔ nyɛhe nɔ ŋmɛnɛ nyɛhã Yehowa sɔ̃ɔmɔ, ejaakɛ akɛni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ te shi ewo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebi kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enyɛmi lɛ, Yehowa ejɔɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ.”

english_verse: After the people saw that Moses had been on the mountain for a long time, they went to Aaron and said, “Make us an image of a god who will lead and protect us. Moses brought us out of Egypt, but nobody knows what has happened to him.”
translation_verse: Be ni Israelbii lɛ na akɛ Mose eyatsɛ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ekpelekeee shi lɛ, amɛbua amɛhe naa, ni amɛtee Aaron ŋɔɔ amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi ni ofee nyɔŋmɔ kroko ohã wɔ koni enyiɛ wɔhiɛ kɛya, shi nɛkɛ Mose nɛɛ, ni ji nuu ni yajie wɔ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba biɛ nɛɛ lɛ, wɔleee nɔ koome ni efee lɛ.”

english_verse: Aaron told them, “Bring me the gold earrings that your wives and sons and daughters are wearing.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Aaron kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkpɔlɔa shika toiiaŋnii ni yɔɔ nyɛŋamɛi kɛ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei lɛ atoiiaŋ lɛ nyɛbahãa mi.”

english_verse: then he melted them and made an idol in the shape of a young bull. All the people said to one another, “This is the god who brought us out of Egypt!”
translation_verse: Aaron he toiiaŋnii lɛ yɛ amɛdɛ̃, ni esere fɛɛ, ni ekɛ ŋaayeli dade tsu he nii, ni eshwie lɛ tsina. Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ kɛɛ, “Israel, naa wɔnyɔŋmɔ ni jie wɔ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ei!”

english_verse: When Aaron saw what was happening, he built an altar in front of the idol and said, “Tomorrow we will celebrate in honor of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Be ni Aaron na enɛ lɛ, ema afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ tsina lɛ hiɛ; kɛkɛ ni eshiɛ, ni ekɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ, aye gbijurɔ ahã Yehowa.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: Hurry back down! Those people you led out of Egypt are acting like fools.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kpelekemɔ shi oya ni oya, shi omaŋbii lɛ ni okɛjɛ Ijipt kɛba lɛ ewo amɛhe muji.

english_verse: They have already stopped obeying me and have made themselves an idol in the shape of a young bull. They have bowed down to it, offered sacrifices, and said that it is the god who brought them out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ amɛje gbɛ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ nɔ. Amɛkɛ shika efee tsinabi, ni amɛja lɛ, ni amɛshã afɔlei hu amɛhã lɛ, ni nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ yɛ ehe ji, ‘Israel, naa wɔnyɔŋmɔ ni jie wɔ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ei!’ ”

english_verse: and I'm angry enough to destroy them, so don't try to stop me. But I will make your descendants into a great nation.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, hã mimli awo la awo amɛ koni maplenee amɛ; shi bo lɛ mahã otsɔ̃ maŋ kpeteŋkple.”

english_verse: Moses tried to get the Lord God to change his mind: Our Lord, you used your mighty power to bring these people out of Egypt. Now don't become angry and destroy them.
translation_verse: Mose kpa Yehowa, eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fai ekɛɛ, “Yehowa, mɛɛba ni omli woɔ la woɔ omaŋ ni okɛ hewalɛ kpele kɛ nineshiwalɛ eyakpɔ̃ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba lɛ?

english_verse: If you do, the Egyptians will say that you brought your people out here into the mountains just to get rid of them. Please don't be angry with your people. Don't destroy them!
translation_verse: Mɛɛ hewɔ hu ni ooohã Ijiptbii ana hegbɛ amɛwie akɛ, ‘Moaŋ yiŋ fɔŋ ni eto hewɔ eyajie amɛ kɛtee lɛ, koni eyagbe amɛ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ ni eplenee amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.’ Na tsui ohã amɛ, ni efɔŋ ni oto oyiŋ akɛ obaafee amɛ lɛ, okɛfa amɛ.

english_verse: Remember the solemn promise you made to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. You promised that someday they would have as many descendants as there are stars in the sky and that you would give them land.
translation_verse: Kaimɔ otsuji Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob, mɛi ni bo diɛŋtsɛ okã amɛ kitã, ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Mahã nyɛshwiei afa tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋulamii lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ nɛɛ fɛɛ ni miwo nyɛ shi yɛ he lɛ mikɛbaahã amɛ akɛ amɛgboshinii kɛya naanɔ.’ ”

english_verse: So even though the Lord had threatened to destroy the people, he changed his mind and let them live.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ efɔŋ ni kulɛ eto akɛ ebaafee Israelbii lɛ fa amɛ.

english_verse: Moses went back down the mountain with the two flat stones on which God had written all of his laws with his own hand, using both sides of the stones.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ ninenaa nitsumɔ ji tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ, ni nii ni aŋma yɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ anɔ lɛ hu Nyɔŋmɔ ni ŋma.

english_verse: When Joshua heard the noisy shouts of the people, he said to Moses, “A battle must be going on down in the camp.”
translation_verse: Be ni Yoshua nu akɛ aabɔ oshe hoo yɛ maŋ lɛŋ lɛ, ekɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Aabolɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli tamɔ ta mli blɔmɔ.”

english_verse: But Moses replied, “It doesn't sound like they are shouting because they have won or lost a battle. It sounds more like a wild party!”
translation_verse: Shi Mose here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Nɔ he ni minuɔ lɛ, ejeee mɛi komɛi kunimyeli he oshebɔɔ, ni ejeee yaafo ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nine etsɔ̃ mɛi komɛi anɔ hu, shi moŋ lala ni aahere nɔ ni.”

english_verse: As Moses got closer to the camp, he saw the idol, and he also saw the people dancing around. This made him so angry that he threw down the stones and broke them to pieces at the foot of the mountain.
translation_verse: Ni amrɔ pɛ ni Mose bɛŋkɛ shitoohe lɛ ni ena tsina lɛ kɛ joo ni maŋ lɛ joɔ lɛ, kɛkɛ ni emli wo la, ni ekɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ tswia shi.

english_verse: He melted the idol the people had made, and he ground it into powder. He scattered it in their water and made them drink it.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Mose wo tsina lɛ ni maŋbii lɛ efee lɛ, ni ekɛwo la mli ni eshã, ni egbɛlɛ lɛ mlumlu, ni ekɛshwã nu hiɛ, ni ehã Israelbii lɛ nu.

english_verse: Moses asked Aaron, “What did these people do to harm you? Why did you make them sin in this terrible way?”
translation_verse: Ni Mose bi Aaron akɛ, “Mɛni po maŋbii nɛɛ fee bo hewɔ ni ohã amɛfee esha kpele nɛkɛ?”

english_verse: Aaron answered: Don't be angry with me. You know as well as I do that they are determined to do evil.
translation_verse: Aaron jie enaa ekɛɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ mli akawo mi la. Bo diɛŋtsɛ ole akɛ maŋ nɛɛ sumɔɔ efɔŋ feemɔ.”

english_verse: They even told me, “That man Moses led us out of Egypt, but now we don't know what has happened to him. Make us a god to lead us.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ mi akɛ, “Feemɔ nyɔŋmɔ kroko ohã wɔ ni enyiɛ wɔhiɛ kɛya, shi nɛkɛ Mose nɛɛ, ni ji nuu ni yajie wɔ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba biɛ nɛɛ lɛ, wɔleee nɔ koome ni efee lɛ.”

english_verse: Then I asked them to bring me their gold earrings. They took them off and gave them to me. I threw the gold into a fire, and out came this bull.
translation_verse: Ni mito he mihã amɛ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ shika nii lɛ ekpɔlɔ kɛba, ni amɛkpɔlɔ kɛba, ni mikɛwo la mli, ni etsɔ̃ tsina nɛɛ.”

english_verse: So Moses stood at the gate of the camp and shouted, “Everyone who is on the Lord's side come over here!” Then the men of the Levi tribe gathered around Moses,
translation_verse: eyadamɔ shitoohe lɛ agbo lɛ naa, ni ebo etsɛ ekɛɛ, “Namɔ yɔɔ Yehowa gbɛfaŋ? Mɔ lɛ aba miŋɔɔ!” Kɛkɛ ni Levibii lɛ fɛɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛba Mose ŋɔɔ.

english_verse: and he said to them, “The Lord God of Israel commands you to strap on your swords and go through the camp, killing your relatives, your friends, and your neighbors.”
translation_verse: Ni Mose kɛɛ Levibii lɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Nuu fɛɛ nuu akɔ eklante eŋmɔ, ni nyɛnyiɛa maŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ, kɛjɛ agbonaa kɛya agbonaa, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ agbe enyɛmi, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ agbe enaanyo, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ agbe ehe gbɔmɔ.’ ”

english_verse: The men of the Levi tribe followed his orders, and that day they killed about
translation_verse: Levibii lɛ fee bɔ ni Mose fã amɛ lɛ, ni maŋ lɛ mli hii aaafee akpei etɛ̃ nyɔnyɔɔ nakai gbi lɛ.

english_verse: The next day Moses told the people, “This is a terrible thing you have done. But I will go back to the Lord to see if I can do something to keep this sin from being held against you.”
translation_verse: Enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi lɛ Mose kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfee esha kpeteŋkple. No hewɔ lɛ, makwɔ gɔŋ lɛ kɛya Yehowa ŋɔɔ. Eko lɛ eeebo mifaikpamɔ toi, ni eeeŋɔ nyɛhe esha lɛ efa nyɛ.”

english_verse: Moses returned to the Lord and said, “The people have committed a terrible sin. They have made a gold idol to be their god.
translation_verse: Ni Mose ku esɛɛ etee Yehowa ŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Ao, maŋ nɛɛ efee esha kpeteŋkple diɛŋtsɛ akɛ amɛfee shika amãgã amɛhã amɛhe.

english_verse: But I beg you to forgive them. If you don't, please wipe my name out of your book.”
translation_verse: Ofainɛ, okɛ amɛhe esha lɛ afa amɛ; shi kɛji ehiii nakai feemɔ lɛ no lɛ gbee mi moŋ migbɛi yɛ wolo ni oŋma omɛi agbɛii yɛ mli lɛ mli.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “I will wipe out of my book the name of everyone who has sinned against me.
translation_verse: Shi Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mɔ ni efee esha eshi mi lɛ, lɛ egbɛi magbe yɛ miwolo lɛ mli.

english_verse: Now take my people to the place I told you about, and my angel will lead you. But when the time comes, I will punish them for this sin.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, yaa ni oyakpala maŋ lɛ kɛya he ni mi kɛ bo ewie he eto lɛ. Naa, mibɔfo lɛ aaanyiɛ ohiɛ, shi moŋ kɛji gbi lɛ shɛ lɛ, mibagbala amɛtoi yɛ esha ni amɛfee lɛ hewɔ.”

english_verse: So the Lord punished the people of Israel with a terrible disease for talking Aaron into making the gold idol.
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa hã gbele hela bote Israelbii lɛ ateŋ, ejaakɛ amɛ amɛfee, ni Aaron fee shika tsina lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: You led the people of Israel out of Egypt. Now get ready to lead them to the land I promised their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Yi mli ni oje biɛ, bo kɛ maŋ ni oyajie kɛjɛ Ijipt kɛba lɛ, kɛya shikpɔŋ ni mikã Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob ehe kitã akɛ, ‘Oshwiei mikɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ baahã’ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: It is a land rich with milk and honey, and I will send an angel to force out those people who live there—the Canaanites, the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. But I will not go with my people. They are so rebellious that I would destroy them before they get there.
translation_verse: Nyɛmiiya shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ ni baa nii nɔ, shi mikɛ nyɛ enyiɛŋ kɛyaŋ, ejaakɛ maŋ ni kuɛŋ ti ji nyɛ, koni moŋ mikayaplene nyɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: Even before the Lord said these harsh things, he had told Moses, “These people really are rebellious, and I would kill them at once, if I went with them. But tell them to take off their fancy jewelry, then I'll decide what to do with them.” So the people started mourning,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Maŋ ni kuɛŋ ti ji nyɛ, ni kɛji mibaye hiŋmɛitswaa kome kɛkɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ mibaplene nyɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkpɔlɔa jwinei lɛ yɛ nyɛhe koni makwɛ nɔ ni mafee yɛ nyɛhe.’ ”

english_verse: and after leaving Mount Sinai, they stopped wearing fancy jewelry. The Lord Is with His People
translation_verse: No hewɔ ni Israelbii lɛ jie amɛhe jwinei fɛɛ, ni amɛkpa woo kɛjɛ be ni amɛshi Horeb, ni ji Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ. Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ

english_verse: Moses used to set up a tent far from camp. He called it the “meeting tent,” and whoever needed some message from the Lord would go there.
translation_verse: Kɛji Israelbii lɛ to shi lɛ Mose kɛ Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yaa ni eyashiɔ yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ. Ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Kpee Buu, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni miitao Yehowa nii ebi lɛ, ejeɔ kpo kɛyaa Kpee Buu lɛ mli yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.

english_verse: Each time Moses went out to this tent, everyone would stand at the entrance to their own tents and watch him enter.
translation_verse: Be fɛɛ be ni Mose aaaje kpo kɛmiiya Buu lɛ he lɛ, maŋbii teteɔ shi, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ badamɔɔ ebuu shinaa shi, ni amɛhiɛɔ Mose yisɛɛ kwɛmɔ aahu kɛyashiɔ eboteɔ Buu lɛ mli.

english_verse: Then they would bow down because a thick cloud would come down in front of the tent, and the Lord would speak to Moses face to face, just like a friend. Afterwards, Moses would return to camp, but his young assistant Joshua would stay at the tent. The Lord Promises To Be with His People
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ Mose wieɔ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ tamɔ mɔ kɛ enaanyo wieɔ. Kɛji Mose ku esɛɛ eba shitoohe lɛ mli lɛ, etsulɔ Yoshua, Nun binuu oblanyo lɛ, lɛ lɛ eshiii Buu lɛ mli. Yehowa wo shi akɛ ebaahi ewebii ateŋ

english_verse: Moses said to the Lord, “I know that you have told me to lead these people to the land you promised them. But you have not said who will go along to help me. You have said that you are my friend and that you are pleased with me.
translation_verse: Ni Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Naa, bo diɛŋtsɛ okɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Yaaŋɔ maŋ nɛɛ kɛya’ shi moŋ ohãko male mɔ ni obaatsu ni ekɛ mi aya. Kɛ̃lɛ bo nɔŋŋ okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mile bo jogbaŋŋ, ni miyɛ ohe miishɛɛ’.

english_verse: If this is true, let me know what your plans are, then I can obey and continue to please you. And don't forget that you have chosen this nation to be your own.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ miikpa bo fai, kɛji ona he miishɛɛ lɛ, hã male oyiŋtoo bɔ ni afee ni male bo, koni masa ohiɛ. Kaimɔ hu akɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ omaŋ ni.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “I will go with you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mikɛ nyɛ aaatee ni mahã oye kunim.”

english_verse: Then Moses replied, “If you aren't going with us, please don't make us leave this place.
translation_verse: Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Kɛ bo okɛ wɔ eyaaa lɛ, no lɛ kaaloo wɔ kɛmiijɛ biɛ kɛmiiya,

english_verse: But if you do go with us, everyone will know that you are pleased with your people and with me. That way, we will be different from the rest of the people on earth.”
translation_verse: ejaakɛ mɛni aaatsɔ̃ɔ akɛ oyɛ mi kɛ omaŋ nɛɛ he miishɛɛ akɛ ja tee ni okɛ wɔ aaatee lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni ana akɛ soro wɔ, ni ji mi kɛ omaŋ lɛ, yɛ maji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ.”

english_verse: So the Lord told him, “I will do what you have asked, because I am your friend and I am pleased with you.”
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Nɔ ni okɛɛ nɛɛ hu mafee, ejaakɛ miyɛ ohe miishɛɛ, ni mile bo jogbaŋŋ.”

english_verse: Then Moses said, “I pray that you will let me see you in all of your glory.”
translation_verse: Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Kɛ nakai ni lɛ hã mana onunyam lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord answered: All right. I am the Lord, and I show mercy and kindness to anyone I choose. I will let you see my glory and hear my holy name,
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mibahã minunyam lɛ abaho yɛ ohiɛ, ni mibatsɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ migbɛi, Yehowa lɛ, yɛ ohiɛ. Mibaduro mɔ ni mibaduro, ni mɔ ni mimusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ mi yɛ ehe lɛ, lɛ ehe mimusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ mi yɛ.

english_verse: but I won't let you see my face, because anyone who sees my face will die.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ, onyɛŋ mihiɛ ona, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko enaŋ mihiɛ ni eyi aaana wala.”

english_verse: There is a rock not far from me. Stand beside it,
translation_verse: Yehowa tee nɔ ekɛɛ, “Naa, tɛsaa ko yɛ mimasɛi yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, daamɔ jɛi.

english_verse: and before I pass by in all of my shining glory, I will put you in a large crack in the rock. I will cover your eyes with my hand until I have passed by.
translation_verse: Shi be mli ni minunyam lɛ hoɔ lɛ maŋɔ bo mawo tɛsaa lɛ tɛkplo lɛ mli, ni mi kɛ minine aaatsi onɔ kɛyashi mibaho dã.

english_verse: Then I will take my hand away, and you will see my back. You will not see my face.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ majie minine lɛ, ni ooona mikotosɛɛ gbɛ, shi mihiɛ lɛ no lɛ anaaa.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I promise to perform miracles for you that have never been seen anywhere on earth. Neighboring nations will stand in fear and know that I was the one who did these marvelous things.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Naa, mi kɛ nyɛ baakpãŋ. Mibafee naakpɛɛ nii yɛ omaŋ lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ, ni ji nii ni eko bako dã yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, loo yɛ maŋ ko maŋ ko nɔ, ni mɛi ateŋ ni oyɔɔ lɛ kɛaana Yehowa nitsumɔ, ejaakɛ mi kɛ bo baatsu nii ni yɔɔ gbeyei.

english_verse: Be ready tomorrow morning to come up Mount Sinai and meet me at the top.
translation_verse: Wɔ lɛ osaa ohe, ni oba Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ okɛ ohe abatsɔ̃ɔ mi yɛ jɛi yɛ gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ.

english_verse: No one is to come with you or to be on the mountain at all. Don't even let the sheep and cattle graze at the foot of the mountain.”
translation_verse: Mɔ ko mɔ ko akafata ohe kɛmiiba lɛ, akana mɔ ko mɔ ko yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ko he ko, ni akana toi loo tsinai miiba abaye nii yɛ gɔŋ lɛ he.”

english_verse: So Moses cut two flat stones like the first ones, and early the next morning he carried them to the top of Mount Sinai, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Mose ko tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ tamɔ klɛŋklɛŋnii lɛ, ni ete shi leebi maŋkpa, ni ekwɔ kɛtee Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa efã lɛ lɛ, ni ehiɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Then he passed in front of Moses and called out, “I am the Lord God. I am merciful and very patient with my people. I show great love, and I can be trusted.
translation_verse: Yehowa batsɔ̃ Mose hiɛ kɛho, ni etsɛ ehe ekɛɛ, “Yehowa, Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ musuŋtsɔlɔ kɛ durolɔ lɛ, mɔ ni toɔ etsui shi, ni emli eyi kɛ suɔmɔ kɛ anɔkwale babaoo lɛ,

english_verse: Moses quickly bowed down to the ground and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni Mose he fee oya, ni ekoto shi, ni eja Yehowa,

translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, agbɛnɛ kɛji ona mihe miishɛɛ lɛ, miikpa bo fai akɛ Nuŋtsɔ ahi wɔteŋ kɛya, tsɛbelɛ gbɔmɛi ni kuɛŋ ti ji maŋ nɛɛ. Okɛ wɔtɔ̃mɔi kɛ wɔhe esha afa wɔ koni okɛ wɔ afee onɔ.” Yehowa kɛ Israelbii kpãŋ ekoŋŋ (Ɛksodɔs

english_verse: Your men must come to worship me three times a year, because I am the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: “Daa afi lɛ nyɛteŋ hii lɛ fɛɛ abapue yɛ Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ji Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ shii etɛ̃.

english_verse: I demand your complete loyalty—you must not worship any other god!
translation_verse: “Nyɛkajaa nyɔŋmɔ kroko ejaakɛ Yehowa, ni egbɛi ji ‘Awuŋã’ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ni yeɔ awuŋã ni.

english_verse: The first-born males of your families and of your flocks and herds belong to me.
translation_verse: “Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ji nuu ni gbeleɔ musu naa lɛ minɔ ni, tsina ni jio, too ni jio.

english_verse: Don't make metal images of gods.
translation_verse: “Kaafee dade amãgã ko ohã ohe.

english_verse: I will force out the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, but you must do what I command you today.
translation_verse: Ye mlai ni miwoɔ bo ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ anɔ. Naa, mibahã Amorbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Hitbii lɛ kɛ Perizbii lɛ kɛ Hivbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii lɛ ajo nyɛnaa foi.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with any of those people. If you do, it will be like falling into a trap.
translation_verse: Kwɛmɔ ohe ni ahi koni okɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ ni nyɛyaa lɛ nɔ bii lɛ akakpãŋ koni no batsɔ̃ tsɔne ehã nyɛ.

english_verse: Instead, you must destroy their altars and tear down the sacred poles they use in the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ nyɛkumɔa amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ kɛ amɛmãgãi lɛ, ni nyɛfitea amɛkrabatsai lɛ, ni nyɛfolɔa amɛ-Ashera lɛ wɔŋ koo lɛ nyɛshwiea.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with the people there, or you will soon find yourselves worshiping their gods and taking part in their sacrificial meals.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛkɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ akakpãŋa kpãŋmɔ ko, ejaakɛ kɛji amɛmiija amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ, ni amɛshã amɛfɔle lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ ko aaatsɛ nyɛ, ni nyɛaayaye amɛfɔleshãa niyenii lɛ eko.

english_verse: Don't fail to observe the Festival of Thin Bread in the month of Abib. Obey me and eat bread without yeast for seven days during Abib, because that is the month you left Egypt.
translation_verse: “Nyɛyea Akpiti Gbijurɔ lɛ. Bɔ ni miwo nyɛ ehe kitã lɛ; nyɛyea aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã. Nyɛyea lɛ gbii kpawo, yɛ be ni ato ni ji Abib nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ Abib nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɛshi Ijipt.

english_verse: You can save the life of a first-born donkey by sacrificing a lamb; if you don't, you must break the donkey's neck. You must save every first-born son. Bring an offering every time you come to worship.
translation_verse: Shi teji kromɔbi lɛ akɛ toobi akpɔ̃ lɛ, shi kɛji asumɔŋ ni akpɔ̃ lɛ lɛ no lɛ aku ekuɛŋ. Okpɔ̃ bihii ateŋ kromɔbii fɛɛ. “Mɔ ko mɔ ko akapue kɛ edɛ̃ folo yɛ mihiɛ.

english_verse: Work for six days and rest on the seventh day, even during the seasons for plowing and harvesting.
translation_verse: “Atsu nii gbii ekpaa, shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ ajɔɔ he, humɔ be mli jio, nikpamɔ be mli jio, ajɔɔ he.

english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: “Asaŋ nyɛyea Otsii Agbijurɔ lɛ, be mli ni akuɔ ŋmaa kpokploku lɛ, kɛ Ŋmaa naabuamɔkɛtoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ afi lɛ naagbee mli.

english_verse: As you advance, I will force the nations out of your land and enlarge your borders. Then no one will try to take your property when you come to worship me these three times each year.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mibashwie majimaji yɛ nyɛhiɛ, ni malɛɛ nyɛhusui lɛ amli kɛya shɔŋŋ, ni daa afi shii etɛ̃, be mli ni nyɛba Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko hiɛ ekɔŋ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni eeeta he.

english_verse: When you sacrifice an animal on the altar, don't offer bread made with yeast. And don't save any part of the Passover meal for the next day.
translation_verse: “Akɛ masha aboloo akafata kooloo he akɛshã afɔle ahã mi; ni je hu akatsɛre Hehoo Gbijurɔ afɔle lɛ eko nɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must bring the first part of your harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk.
translation_verse: “Klɛŋklɛŋ ŋmɔshi nii lɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ yibii ni nyɛbaakpa lɛ, nyɛkɛbaa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, we lɛ. “Akahoo toobi kɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ enyɛ fufɔ mli nu.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to put these laws in writing, as part of his agreement with Israel.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Ŋmaa wiemɔi nɛɛ, ejaakɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ anaa mi kɛ bo kɛ Israel ekpãŋ yɛ.”

english_verse: Moses came down from Mount Sinai, carrying the Ten Commandments. His face was shining brightly because the Lord had been speaking to him. But Moses did not know at first that his face was shining.
translation_verse: Be ni Mose jɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekpeleke shi, ni tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ lɛ hiɛ edɛ̃ lɛ, eleee kwraa akɛ wiemɔi ni ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yawie hiɛ kɛ hiɛ lɛ ehã ehiɛ miikpɛ.

english_verse: When Aaron and the others looked at Moses, they saw this, and they were afraid to go near him.
translation_verse: Be ni Aaron kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ na Mose lɛ ehiɛ miikpɛ, ni amɛshe gbeyei akɛ amɛaabɛŋkɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Moses called out for Aaron and the leaders to come to him, and he spoke with them.
translation_verse: Shi Mose tsɛ amɛ, ni Aaron kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni Mose kɛ amɛ wie.

english_verse: Then the rest of the people of Israel gathered around Moses, and he gave them the laws that the Lord had given him on Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Fee sɛɛ lɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ Mose, ni ewo amɛ kitãi lɛ fɛɛ ni Yehowa kɛhã lɛ yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The face of Moses kept shining, and after he had spoken with the people, he covered his face with a veil.
translation_verse: Be ni Mose kɛ maŋ lɛ wie egbe naa lɛ, ekɛ mama ko ha ehiɛ.

english_verse: Moses would always remove the veil when he went into the sacred tent to speak with the Lord. And when he came out, he would tell the people everything the Lord had told him to say.
translation_verse: Kɛji Mose tee Yehowa hiɛ ekɛ lɛ yaawie lɛ, ekpaa mama nɛɛ yɛ hiɛ kɛyashiɔ ejeɔ kpo, ni ebakɛɔ Israelbii lɛ nɔ ni Yehowa efã lɛ ni ekɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: They could see that his face was still shining. So after he had spoken with them, he would put the veil back on and leave it on until the next time he went to speak with the Lord.
translation_verse: Israelbii lɛ naa Mose hiɛ akɛ eekpɛ, ni Mose saa ekɛ mama lɛ haa ehiɛ kɛyashiɔ beyinɔ ni eeetee ekoŋŋ ekɛ Yehowa ayawie.

english_verse: You have six days in which to do your work. But the seventh day must be dedicated to me, your Lord, as a day of rest. Whoever works on the Sabbath will be put to death.
translation_verse: Aŋɔ gbii ekpaa akɛtsu nii, shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ atsɔ̃ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã nyɛ, Yehowa hejɔɔmɔ gbi krɔŋŋ ni. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsu nii yɛ nɔ lɛ aaagbe lɛ.

translation_verse: Eduro amɛ nilee koni amɛkɛŋa ŋai srɔtoi fɛɛ, tamɔ samayeli loo niloo kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ kɛ klala kpakpa mliwoo nɛkɛ, kɛ mamaloo diɛŋtsɛ hu. No ji amɛle nitsumɔ fɛɛ nitsumɔ ni ŋaalɔ tsuɔ lɛ tsumɔ.”

english_verse: If you have any skills, you should use them to help make what I have commanded:

translation_verse: Ni amɛkɛ mama bluu fimɔ tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ he gai lɛ amɛkpɛtɛ efod lɛ he gai lɛ, koni tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ akã efod lɛ mlifiinii fɛɛfɛo lɛ nɔ koni akɛje nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ. Osɔfoi ahewulamɔ nibii krokomɛi lɛ feemɔ (Ɛksodɔs

translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amɛfĩ kɛkpɛtɛ kuŋtu bluu nɔ, ni akɛta osɔfonukpa fai lɛ hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ. Nitsumɔ lɛ naagbee (Ɛksodɔs

translation_verse: Ajie kuɛ awo atade lɛ he, ni akɛ mama baŋ kuɛ lɛ naa kɛkpe koni ekagba.

english_verse: Along the hem of the robe were woven pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool with a bell of pure gold between each of them. This robe was to be worn by Aaron when he performed his duties.
translation_verse: shika ŋmɛlɛ kome kɛkɛ lɛ kpɔ kokroo kome, shika ŋmɛlɛ kome kɛkɛ lɛ kpɔ kokroo kome aahu kɛbɔle atade yuu lɛ ni abaawo kɛsɔ̃mɔ lɛ naamuu lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm kɛkpe tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.

english_verse: Everything that Aaron and his sons wore was made of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, including their robes and turbans, their fancy caps and underwear, and even their sashes that were embroidered with needlework.
translation_verse: Ni amɛkɛ klala kpakpa kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ fee mlifii nɔ lɛ, ni alo nii awo mli tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.

english_verse: the sacred chest with its carrying poles and the place of mercy;
translation_verse: Asaŋ amɛkɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ enaanɔ lɛ kɛ ehe tsei lɛ

english_verse: So the people of Israel finished making everything the Lord had told Moses to make.
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni afee agbe Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ naa ahã. Israelbii lɛ fee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.

english_verse: Then they brought it all to Moses: the sacred tent and its equipment, including the hooks, the framework and crossbars, and its posts and stands;
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ batsɔ̃ɔ Mose, no ji Buu lɛ kɛ ehe tsɛnsii srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ ekpoji lɛ kɛ eplaŋi lɛ kɛ amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ, kɛ akulashiŋi lɛ kɛ nibii ni amɛmamɔɔ nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: the table with all that goes on it, including the sacred bread;
translation_verse: kɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ kɛ ehe tsɛnsii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ aboloo ni akɛmaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ hu ba.

english_verse: the gold-covered incense altar; the ordination oil and the sweet-smelling incense; the curtain for the entrance to the tent;
translation_verse: kɛ shika afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, kɛ mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ kɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa mama lɛ.

english_verse: the bronze altar for sacrifices with its bronze grating, its carrying poles, and its equipment; the large bronze bowl with its stand;
translation_verse: Ekrokomɛi ji akɔɔble afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ ehe akɔɔble ntaŋ ni kãa latɛ lɛ mli lɛ, kɛ latɛ lɛ he tsei bloblobii lɛ kɛ ehenii lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ okpolu lɛ kɛ eshishitamɔ nii lɛ.

english_verse: the curtain with its posts and cords, and its pegs and stands that go around the courtyard; everything needed for the sacred tent;
translation_verse: Ekrokomɛi hu ji kpo lɛ muhɔi lɛ kɛ ekulashiŋi lɛ kɛ nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ naa mama lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ he taŋkpei lɛ kɛ nibii srɔtoi fɛɛ ni akɛbaasɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ,

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: Set up my tent on the first day of the year
translation_verse: “Klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, shii Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and put the chest with the Ten Commandments behind the inside curtain.
translation_verse: Okɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ama mli, ni okɛ muhɔɔ lɛ atsĩ hiɛ.

english_verse: Bring in the table and set on it those things that are made for it. Also bring in the lampstand and attach the lamps to it.
translation_verse: Okɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ aya Buu lɛ mli, ni oto nibii ni sa akɛ amãmɔ nɔ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ omamɔ nɔ, ni okɛ kanetso lɛ aya mli, ni okɛ ehe kanei lɛ amãmɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Then place the gold altar of incense in front of the sacred chest and hang a curtain at the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Okɛ shika latɛ ni akɛbaashã tsofakɛŋma lɛ ama Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ, ni okɛ shinaa lɛ naa mama lɛ aha Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ naa.

english_verse: Set the altar for burning sacrifices in front of the entrance to my tent.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ okɛ shãa afɔle latɛ lɛ ama Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ hiɛgbɛ.

english_verse: Put the large bronze bowl between the tent and the altar and fill the bowl with water.
translation_verse: Okɛ okpolu lɛ ama Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ, ni okɛ nu awo mli.

english_verse: Surround the tent and the altar with the wall of curtains and hang the curtain that was made for the entrance.
translation_verse: No sɛɛ lɛ, owo kpo lɛ oma shi kɛbɔle Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he fɛɛ tswɛm, ni okɛ kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ naa mama lɛ aha naa.

english_verse: Do the same thing with the altar for offering sacrifices and its equipment
translation_verse: Ofɔ shãa afɔle latɛ lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ mu ni okɛfee latɛ lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ koni etsɔ̃ afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ.

english_verse: and with the bowl and its stand.
translation_verse: Ofɔ okpolu lɛ kɛ eshishitamɔ nii lɛ hu mu ni okɛfee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: “Agbɛnɛ okɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, ni okɛ nu aju amɛhe.

english_verse: Dress Aaron in the priestly clothes, then use the sacred olive oil to ordain him and dedicate him to me as my priest.
translation_verse: No sɛɛ lɛ, okɛ hewulamɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ awula Aaron, ni ofɔ lɛ mu okɛfee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ koni eye osɔfo ehã mi.

english_verse: Put the priestly robes on Aaron's sons
translation_verse: Okɛ Aaron bihii lɛ hu aba ni okɛ flakai lɛ awo amɛ,

english_verse: Moses followed the Lord's instructions.
translation_verse: Mose fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: And on the first day of the first month of the second year, the sacred tent was set up.
translation_verse: Be ni Israelbii lɛ shi Ijipt lɛ enɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ ashi Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ama shi.

english_verse: The stones with the Ten Commandments written on them were stored in the sacred chest, the place of mercy was put on top of it, and the carrying poles were attached.
translation_verse: Ni Mose kɛ tɛi ni aŋmala kitãi lɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ wo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ mli, ni ekɛ tsei bloblobii lɛ hɔlɔ Adeka lɛ he, ni ekɛ naanɔ lɛ bu Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ naa.

english_verse: The chest was brought into the tent and set behind the curtain in the most holy place. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Mose wo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛtee Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, ni eshi muhɔɔ lɛ ekɛtsi Adeka lɛ hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The table for the sacred bread was put along the north wall of the holy place,
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ Mose wo okplɔ̃ lɛ ekɛyama Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli he ni ye kooyigbɛ lɛ, yɛ muhɔɔ lɛ kponɔgbɛ,

english_verse: then the lamps were attached to it there in the presence of the Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ ehe kanei lɛ mamɔ nɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The gold incense altar was set up in front of the curtain,
translation_verse: Ekɛ shika tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ ma Kpee Buu lɛ mli yɛ muhɔɔ lɛ kponɔgbɛ,

english_verse: and sweet-smelling incense was burned on it. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: ni eshã tsofakɛŋma yɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The curtain was hung at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ mama lɛ ha Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.

english_verse: Then the altar for offering sacrifices was put in front of the tent, and animal sacrifices and gifts of grain were offered there.
translation_verse: Ekɛ shãa afɔle latɛ lɛ ma Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa, ni eshã shãa afɔle kɛ niyenii afɔle yɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The large bronze bowl was placed between the altar and the entrance to the tent. It was filled with water,
translation_verse: Ewo okpolu lɛ ema Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ, ni ekɛ nu wo mli,

english_verse: then Moses and Aaron, together with Aaron's sons, washed their hands and feet.
translation_verse: ni no sɛɛ lɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Aaron bihii lɛ kɛfɔflɔ amɛniji kɛ amɛnaji ahe.

english_verse: In fact, they washed each time before entering the tent or offering sacrifices at the altar. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Kɛji amɛbaaya Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ni kɛji amɛbaabɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ amɛfɔfɔlɔɔ amɛhe tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.

english_verse: Suddenly the sacred tent was covered by a thick cloud and filled with the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni atatu baha Kpee Buu lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa anunyam lɛ yi He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ obɔ̃.

english_verse: Whenever the cloud moved from the tent, the people would break camp and follow;
translation_verse: Israelbii lɛ agbɛfãa lɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ, kɛji atatu lɛ wo ehe nɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛfãa kɛyaa amɛhiɛ;

english_verse: then they would set up camp and stay there, until it moved again.
translation_verse: shi kɛji atatu lɛ wooo ehe nɔ lɛ, belɛ amɛfãaa kɛyaashi gbi nɔ ni eeewo ehe nɔ.

english_verse: No matter where the people traveled, the Lord was with them. Each day his cloud was over the tent, and each night a fire could be seen in the cloud.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ amɛgbɛfãa lɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ Yehowa atatu lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ shwane, ni nyɔɔŋ lɛ atatu lɛ kpɛɔ la ni Israelbii lɛ naa gbɛ.

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head, and I will accept the animal as a sacrifice for taking away your sins.
translation_verse: Ekɛ enine aŋmɛ afɔleshãa kooloo lɛ yiteŋ, ni abaaŋɔ kooloo lɛ akɛshã afɔle ni akɛkpãtã ehe esha lɛ ahã lɛ.

english_verse: After the bull is killed in my presence, some priests from Aaron's family will offer its blood to me by splattering it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ egbe tsinanuu lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni Aaron bihii osɔfoi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ aba ni amɛkɛbashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni ma Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa koji ejwɛ lɛ he lɛ kɛkpe.

english_verse: Skin the bull and cut it up,
translation_verse: Mɔ lɛ akpɔ kooloo lɛ hewolo lɛ koni esaa loo lɛ.

english_verse: while the priests pile wood on the altar fire to make it start blazing.
translation_verse: Aaron bihii lɛ ato lai amɛshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; ni amɛshɛre la lɛ.

english_verse: Wash the bull's insides and hind legs, so the priests can lay them on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. A priest will then send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Nuu lɛ kɛ nu afɔ kooloo lɛ mlinii lɛ kɛ enaji lɛ ahe; ni osɔfo lɛ ashã kooloo muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; shãa afɔle ni, afɔle ni akɛ la shãa kooloo lɛ fɛɛ ni. Afɔle nɛɛ jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa.

english_verse: If you sacrifice a ram or a goat, it must not have anything wrong with it.
translation_verse: “Shi kɛji too gwantɛŋ loo abotia mɔ lɛ kɛbaa ebashã shãa afɔle lɛ, ehiɛ gwantɛŋ nuu loo abotia nuu ni kpa ko bɛ ehe kɛba.

english_verse: Lead the animal to the north side of the altar, where it is to be killed in my presence. Then some of the priests will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Egbe kooloo lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ masɛi yɛ ekooyigbɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. Aaron bihii osɔfoi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ aba ni amɛkɛbashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe.

english_verse: Cut up the animal and wash its insides and hind legs. A priest will put these parts on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. Then he will send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ lɛ kɛ nu afɔ kooloo lɛ mlinii lɛ kɛ enaji lɛ ahe. No sɛɛ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ ni tsuɔ nii nakai gbi lɛ kɛ nomɛi hu baashi nɔ, ni eshã kooloo muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Shãa afɔle ni: afɔle ni ashãa fɛɛ ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa ni.

english_verse: If you offer a bird for this kind of sacrifice, it must be a dove or a pigeon.
translation_verse: “Shi kɛji loofɔlɔ mɔ lɛ kɛbaa ebashã shãa afɔle ehã Yehowa lɛ, no lɛ ehiɛ kosɛɛ okpo loo shĩa okpo pɛmpɛoo.

english_verse: A priest will take the bird to the bronze altar, where he will wring its neck and put its head on the fire. Then he will drain out its blood on one side of the altar,
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ kɛ loofɔlɔ lɛ abaŋmɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; etsɔ̃mɔ ni etse loofɔlɔ lɛ yitso, ni eshã loofɔlɔ lɛ loo lɛ, shi loofɔlɔ lɛ lá lɛ atsere kɛnyiɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he.

english_verse: remove the bird's craw with what is in it, and throw them on the ash heap at the east side of the altar.
translation_verse: Ejie loofɔlɔ lɛ kpɔŋɔshi kɛ emlinii lɛ koni eshɛrɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ masɛi yɛ ebokãgbɛ he ni atsiɔ lamlu ashwieɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Finally, he will take the bird by its wings, tear it partially open, and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Emɔ loofɔlɔ lɛ fiji lɛ amli koni egba loofɔlɔ lɛ mli, shi ekakpɔlɔ efiji lɛ. Osɔfo lɛ ashã loofɔlɔ lɛ yɛ lai lɛ nɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Shãa afɔle ni: afɔle ni ashãa fɛɛ ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa ni.”

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to give thanks to me, you must use only your finest flour. Put it in a dish, sprinkle olive oil and incense on the flour,
translation_verse: “Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ ŋmãa miiba abashã afɔle ahã Yehowa lɛ, egbɛlɛ ŋmãa lɛ mã. Ekɛ mu ashwie mamu lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ tsofakɛŋma hu afata he;

english_verse: and take it to the priests from Aaron's family. One of them will scoop up the incense together with a handful of the flour and oil. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay this part on the bronze altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: koni ekɛbahã Aaron bihii osɔfoi lɛ. Osɔfo ni yɔɔ nitsumɔ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ akpiti mã lɛ kɛ mu lɛ ekɔkɔ obɔ̃ kɛ tsofakɛŋma lɛ fɛɛ koni ashã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ afɔle muu ni akɛbahã Yehowa he odaseyeli nɔ. Eji shãa afɔle, ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Niyenii afɔle lɛ mli nɔ ni shwɛɔ yɛ nɔ ni ashãa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ anɔ ni; eji nɔ ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, ejaakɛ afɔle ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa lɛ eko ni.

english_verse: If you bake bread in an oven for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour, but without any yeast. You may make the flour into a loaf mixed with olive oil, or you may make it into thin wafers and brush them with oil.
translation_verse: “Kɛji afɔle lɛ yafee ŋmãa nii ni ashã yɛ flɔnɔɔ mli lɛ, nɔ lɛ efee mã akpiti keeki ni akɛ mu wo mli ashã, loo mã akpiti akpãanɔɔ ni akɛ mu ekpa hiɛ.

english_verse: If you cook bread in a shallow pan for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour. Mix it with olive oil, but do not use any yeast.
translation_verse: “Kɛji afɔle lɛ yafee nii ni ashãa yɛ looshãa dade nɔ lɛ, no lɛ efee nii ni akɛ mã akpiti ni awo mli mu fee niyenii.

english_verse: Then break the bread into small pieces and sprinkle them with oil.
translation_verse: Akumɔ afɔle lɛ mli dukuduku, ni afɔse mu ashwie nɔ. Niyenii afɔle ni.

english_verse: If you cook your bread in a pan with a lid on it, you must also use the finest flour mixed with oil.
translation_verse: “Kɛji afɔle lɛ yafee niyenii ni ashĩ yɛ ŋɛsu mli hu lɛ, afɔle lɛ afee niyenii ni akɛ mã akpiti kɛ mu fee.

english_verse: You may prepare sacrifices to give thanks in any of these three ways. Bring your sacrifice to a priest, and he will take it to the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Akɛ niyenii afɔle ni akɛ nibii nɛɛ fee lɛ aba akɛ Yehowa nikeenii, ni akɛbahã osɔfo lɛ, ni ekɛya afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he.

english_verse: Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay part of it on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ ajie niyenii afɔle lɛ mli eko, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ shãa afɔle muu lɛ ni akɛbahã Yehowa he odaseyeli nɔ.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Niyenii afɔle lɛ mli nɔ ni shwɛɔ yɛ nɔ ni ashã lɛ sɛɛ lɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ anɔ ni. Eji nɔ ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, ejaakɛ afɔlei ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa mli eko ni.

english_verse: Yeast and honey must never be burned on the altar, so don't ever mix either of these in a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: “Nyɛkɛ niyenii afɔle ko niyenii afɔle ko ni akɛ mã sha fee akabahãa Yehowa, ni nyɛkashãa nɔ ko ni mã sha loo wo yɔɔ mli akɛ shãa afɔle nyɛhãa Yehowa.

english_verse: You may offer either of them separately, when you present the first part of your harvest to me, but they must never be burned on the altar.
translation_verse: Nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛŋɔ nibii nɛɛ amli klɛŋklɛŋ nii lɛ eko nyɛbahã Yehowa. Shi moŋ akashã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ nii ni jeɔ ŋma.

english_verse: Freshly cut grain, either roasted or coarsely ground, must be used when you offer the first part of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: Kɛji niyenii afɔle ni akɛbaahã Yehowa fee ŋmɔshi klɛŋklɛŋ nibaanii lɛ mli eko lɛ, no lɛ afɔle lɛ afee abele kpokploku ni ashĩ mamu.

english_verse: You must mix in some olive oil and put incense on top, because this is a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: Akɛ mu ashwie nɔ, ni akɛ tsofakɛŋma afɔ̃ nɔ. Niyenii afɔle ni.

english_verse: A priest will sprinkle all of the incense and some of the grain and oil on the altar and send them up in smoke to show that the whole offering belongs to me.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ ashã mamu lɛ he ni mu lɛ yɔɔ lɛ kɛ mu lɛ kɛ tsofakɛŋma ni fata he lɛ hu fɛɛ akɛ afɔle ni akɛbahã lɛ he odaseyeli nɔ. Eji afɔle ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa.”

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to ask my blessing, you may offer either a bull or a cow, but there must be nothing wrong with the animal.
translation_verse: “Kɛji mɔ ko miiba ebashã toiŋjɔlɛ naanyobɔɔ afɔle ehã Yehowa lɛ, ekɛ etsinai lɛ ateŋ eko, tsina lɛ nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, efee kooloo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe.

english_verse: Lead it to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay your hand on its head, and have it killed there. A priest from Aaron's family will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Mɔ lɛ kɛ enine aŋmɛ tsina lɛ yitso nɔ, ni egbe kooloo lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa, ni Aaron bihii osɔfoi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ abashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: kɛ esabai enyɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ ni yɔɔ amɛhe lɛ, kɛ loo ni tsa mlɛbo lɛ. Ajie loo nɛɛ akɛfata sabai lɛ ahe.

english_verse: Some of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me, together with the sacrifice that is offered to please me.
translation_verse: Osɔfoi lɛ kɛshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ koni ashã: shãa afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa ni.

english_verse: Instead of a bull or a cow, you may offer any sheep or goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: “Kɛji mɔ lɛ miiba ebashã naanyobɔɔ afɔle ehã Yehowa kɛ gwantɛŋi loo abotiai lɛ ateŋ eko lɛ, kooloo lɛ nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, efee kooloo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe.

english_verse: If you offer a sheep, you must present it to me at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ lɛ hiɛ gwantɛŋ kɛba afɔleshãa lɛ, no lɛ ekɛba Yehowa hiɛ,

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: ni ekɛ enine aŋmɛ kooloo lɛ yitso nɔ, ni egbe lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ hiɛ. Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ ashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koji lɛ ahe kɛkpe.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: kɛ esabai enyɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ hu ni yɔɔ amɛhe, kɛ loo ni tsa mlɛbo lɛ nɔ lɛ. Ajie loo nɛɛ akɛfata sabai lɛ ahe.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering for me.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ni yɔɔ nitsumɔ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ ashã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ niyenii afɔle ni aashã akɛhã Yehowa.

english_verse: If you offer a goat, you must also present it to me
translation_verse: “Kɛji mɔ lɛ kɛ abotia ba afɔleshãa lɛ, no lɛ ekɛbahã yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: at the entrance to the sacred tent. Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ekɛ enine aŋmɛ kooloo lɛ yitso nɔ, ni egbe lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ. Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ ashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: kɛ esabai enyɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ hu ni ha amɛhe, kɛ loo ni tsa mlɛbo lɛ nɔ lɛ. Ajie loo nɛɛ akɛfata sabai lɛ ahe.

english_verse: One of the priests will put these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering with a smell that pleases me. All fat belongs to me.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ ashã fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ niyenii afɔle ni ashãa kɛŋma akɛhã Yehowa. Fɔ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ Yehowa nɔ ni.

english_verse: So you and your descendants must never eat any fat or any blood, not even in the privacy of your own homes. This law will never change.
translation_verse: Israelbii akaye kooloo fɔ loo lá. Enɛ atsɔ̃ akpɔ ni akã shi ahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei fɛɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he ni nyɛaahi.”

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: ni ekɛ ewao atsɔ lá lɛ mli, koni ekɛ la lɛ eko ashwã shii kpawo yɛ Muhɔɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: This is a sacrifice for sin. So he will lay his hand on the animal's head, before having it killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ekɛ enine aŋmɛ too kpakpo lɛ yiteŋ, ni egbe too lɛ yɛ he ni agbeɔ shãa afɔle kooloi lɛ yɛ lɛ, yɛ Yehowa hiɛ lɛ. Esha afɔle ni.

english_verse: Then a priest will dip a finger in the blood; he will smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ kɛ ewao atsɔ too lɛ lá lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lá lɛ adiki shãa afɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji lɛ ahe. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsi lá ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Offer a sacrifice to ask forgiveness when you sin by accidentally doing something I have told you not to do. When the High Priest Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ kɛji mɔ ko tɔ̃ akpɔi kɛ kitãi ni Yehowa ewo lɛ eko nɔ, ni efee nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ akafee lɛ eko be mli ni mɔ lɛ hiɛ kãaa he lɛ, nɔ ni afee nɛ:

english_verse: When the high priest sins, he makes everyone else guilty too. And so, he must sacrifice a young bull that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Kɛji Osɔfonukpa lɛ ni tɔ̃ lɛ, ni no ehã maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ etɔ̃ lɛ, ekɛ tsina oblanyo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe abashã ehe esha lɛ he afɔle ehã Yehowa.

english_verse: The priest will lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay his hand on its head, and kill it there.
translation_verse: Ekɛ tsinanuu lɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; ekɛ enine afɔ̃ tsinanuu lɛ yiteŋ ni egbe lɛ.

english_verse: He will take a bowl of the blood inside the tent,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ Osɔfonukpa lɛ aŋɔ tsinanuu lɛ lá lɛ eko kɛbote Kpee Buu lɛ mli,

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he will smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Osɔfonukpa lɛ kɛ lá lɛ eko adiki tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ ni yɔɔ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ koji lɛ ahe. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsi tsinanuu lɛ lá ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ shishi.

english_verse: The skin and flesh of the bull, together with its legs, insides, and the food still in its stomach, are to be taken outside the camp and burned on a wood fire near the ash heap. When the Whole Nation Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: Osɔfonukpa lɛ awo tsinanuu muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛje kpo kɛya he ko ni tse yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ, he ni atsiɔ lamlu ashwieɔ lɛ he ko, koni eyashã yɛ lai nɔ yɛ jɛi. He ni atsiɔ lamlu ashwieɔ lɛ, jɛi ashã afɔle nɛɛ yɛ.

english_verse: Once you realize what has happened, you must sacrifice a young bull to ask my forgiveness. Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: kɛji ana ale esha tɔ̃mɔ ni atɔ̃ lɛ, maŋ muu lɛ kɛ tsina oblanyo ashã esha afɔle. Akɛ tsina oblanyo lɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: where your tribal leaders will lay their hands on its head, before having it killed in my presence.
translation_verse: Maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ amɛniji ashwie tsina lɛ yiteŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni agbe tsina lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: The priest will take a bowl of the animal's blood inside the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Osɔfonukpa lɛ aŋɔ tsinanuu lɛ lá lɛ eko kɛbote Kpee Buu lɛ mli,

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: ni ekɛ ewao atsɔ lá lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lá lɛ eko ashwã shii kpawo yɛ Muhɔɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he must smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Ekɛ lá lɛ eko adiki tsofakɛŋma afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ Yehowa hiɛ, yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli, lɛ koji lɛ ahe. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsi tsinanuu lɛ lá ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ eshwie shãa afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ shishi.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove the fat from the bull and send it up in smoke on the altar. Finally, he will burn its remains outside the camp, just as he did with the other bull. By this sacrifice the sin of the whole nation will be forgiven. When a Tribal Leader Sins The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Ewo tsinanuu lɛ loo lɛ kɛje kpo kɛya shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ, ni eshã tamɔ bɔ ni eshã lɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ he esha tsina afɔle loo lɛ. Maŋ lɛ he esha afɔle ni.

english_verse: As soon as the leader realizes what has happened, he must sacrifice a goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: kɛji ahã ele tɔ̃mɔ ni etɔ̃ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, ekɛ too kpakpo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe aba ekɛbashã afɔle.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ osɔfo lɛ kɛ ewao atsɔ esha afɔle too lɛ lá lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lá lɛ adiki shãa afɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji lɛ ahe. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsi la ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ eshwie shãa afɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi.

english_verse: Then he must send all of the fat up in smoke, just as he does when a sacrifice is offered to ask my blessing. By this sacrifice the leader's sin will be forgiven. When Ordinary People Sin The Lord said:
translation_verse: Eshã too kpakpo lɛ mli fɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni eshã naanyobɔɔ afɔlei akooloi lɛ amli fɔ lɛ koni kɛtsɔ nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ lɛ osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ yɛ etɔ̃mɔ lɛ hewɔ, ni akɛbaafa lɛ.

english_verse: As soon as you realize what you have done, you must sacrifice a female goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: kɛji ahã ele tɔ̃mɔ ni etɔ̃ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, ekɛ abotia yoo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe aba ni ekɛbashã afɔle yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Lead the goat to the north side of the bronze altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: Ekɛ enine aŋmɛ esha afɔle too lɛ yiteŋ, ni egbe too lɛ yɛ he ni agbeɔ shãa afɔle kooloi lɛ yɛ lɛ.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove all of the fat, just as he does when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. The priest will then send the fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. This animal is sacrificed so that I will forgive you ordinary people when you sin.
translation_verse: Ejie too lɛ mli fɔ lɛ fɛɛ tamɔ ajieɔ shidaa afɔlei akooloi amli fɔ lɛ, ni eshã fɔ lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ koni eje ŋma ewo Yehowa, koni osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ehã lɛ, ni akɛ etɔ̃mɔ lɛ baafa lɛ.

english_verse: If you offer a lamb instead of a goat as a sacrifice for sin, it must be a female that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ gwantɛŋ miiba abashã esha afɔle lɛ, ekɛ gwantɛŋyoo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe aba.

english_verse: Lead the lamb to the altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: Ekɛ enine aŋmɛ esha afɔle kooloo lɛ yitso nɔ, ni egbe lɛ koni akɛshã esha afɔle yɛ he ni agbeɔ shãa afɔle kooloi lɛ yɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ kɛ ewao atsɔ esha afɔle kooloo lɛ lá lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lá lɛ adiki shãa afɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji lɛ ahe. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsi lá ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi.

english_verse: After this, all of the fat must be removed, just as when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. Then the priest will send it up in smoke to me, together with a food offering, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ejie too lɛ mli fɔ lɛ fɛɛ tamɔ ajieɔ naanyobɔɔ afɔle gwantɛŋ lɛ mli fɔ lɛ koni eshã no kɛ niyenii afɔlei yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ ehã Yehowa. Ni osɔfo lɛ baakpãtã ahã lɛ, ni akɛ ehe esha lɛ baafa lɛ.

english_verse: You are guilty if you find out that you have accidentally touched anything unclean that comes from a human body.
translation_verse: Aloo kɛji eta nɔ ko ni he tseee yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ kɛkɛ ni he tseee ni buleɔ gbɔmɔ he, ni eleee, shi kɛ fee sɛɛ ni ebale lɛ, eye sɔ̃.

english_verse: You are guilty the moment you realize that you have made a hasty promise to do something good or bad.
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ko eyakwɛɛɛ jogbaŋŋ ni ekã kitã akɛ eeefee efɔŋ loo ekpakpa ko tamɔ bɔ ni mɛi kãa kitã ni amɛjwɛŋŋ he lɛ, kɛ fee sɛɛ ni ebale lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ji lɛ eyeɔ sɔ̃ yɛ mli.

english_verse: As soon as you discover that you have committed any of these sins, you must confess what you have done.
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ko ye sɔ̃ yɛ nii nɛɛ eko he lɛ, no lɛ ejaje esha ni efee lɛ

english_verse: Then you must bring a female sheep or goat to me as the price for your sin. A priest will sacrifice the animal, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: ni ekɛ esɔ̃ afɔle abahã Yehowa yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ. Ekɛ gwantɛŋ loo too abotia yoo aba, koni osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Give both birds to the priest, who will offer one as a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness. He will wring its neck without tearing off its head,
translation_verse: Ekɛ afɔlei enyɔ lɛ aba osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ. Ekɛ nɔ ni ji esha afɔle lɛ aba tsutsu. Etsɔ̃mɔ loofɔlɔ lɛ yitso yɛ ekuɛ nɔ, shi ekatse kɛje nɔ.

english_verse: splatter some of its blood on one side of the bronze altar, and drain out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Etsɔ esha afɔle lɛ lá lɛ eko eshwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he. Lá ni baashwɛ lɛ etsi eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi. Afɔle ni akɛjieɔ esha kɛyaa ji no.

english_verse: If you are so poor that you cannot afford doves or pigeons, you may bring one kilogram of your finest flour. This is a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness, so don't sprinkle olive oil or sweet-smelling incense on it.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji enyɛɛɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo okpobii enyɔ ehã lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ mã kilo kome aba akɛ esha afɔle yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ. Ekɛ mu akawo mli, ni ekɛ ohɛ hu akafɔ̃ nɔ, ejaakɛ esha afɔle ni.

english_verse: Give the flour to a priest, who will scoop up a handful and send it up in smoke together with the other offerings. This is a reminder that all of the flour belongs to me.
translation_verse: Ekɛba osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ. Osɔfo lɛ atĩ ekɔkɔ obɔ̃ ekɛfee afɔle lɛ mli eko ni akɛkaiɔ Yehowa yɛ afɔle muu lɛ fɛɛ he, koni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ ni ashãa ŋmãa afɔlei yɛ nɔ ahãa Yehowa lɛ nɔ. Esha afɔle ni.

english_verse: By offering this sacrifice, the priest pays the price for any of these sins you may have committed. The priest gets to keep the rest of the flour, just as he does with grain sacrifices. Sacrifices To Make Things Right (Leviticus
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ afee nɛkɛ koni ekɛkpãtã ehã mɔ ni efee esha lɛ, ni akɛ esha ni efee yɛ enɛɛmɛi eko gbɛfaŋ lɛ aaafa lɛ. Afɔle lɛ nɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ nɔ ni, tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ ŋmãa afɔle gbɛfaŋ lɛ. Afɔlei ni akɛtoɔ mlai krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ anajiaŋ

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do to make things right when they find out they have cheated the Lord without meaning to: If this happens, you must either sacrifice a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay the price of a ram with the official money used by the priests.
translation_verse: “Kɛji oniai krɔŋkrɔŋi ni atsuɔ ahãa Yehowa lɛ mɔ ko hãaa egbɛfaŋnɔ, ni no ehã eye sɔ̃ ni eleee lɛ, no lɛ esɔ̃ afɔle ni ekɛbaahã Yehowa nɛ: etoi lɛ ateŋ too ojwɛni ni he bɛ kpa ko. Too lɛ jara adamɔ he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shika jara nɔ, ni akɛfee sɔ̃ afɔle.

english_verse: and pay the owner a fine of
translation_verse: loo nɔ ko ni ekã he amale kitã lɛ, najiaŋ.

english_verse: The next morning you will dress in your priestly clothes, including your linen underwear. Then clean away the ashes left by the sacrifices and pile them beside the altar.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ awo eklala flaka kɛ eklala tswakotoi lɛ koni eloo lamlu lɛ; shi la lɛ ni akɛshã shãa afɔle lɛ, eshi yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ masɛi he ko.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do when they commit other sins against the Lord: You have sinned if you rob or cheat someone, if you keep back money or valuables left in your care, or if you find something and claim not to have it.
translation_verse: aloo ena nɔ ko ni elaaje ni ekã amale kitã akɛ enako lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaafee nibii nɛɛ ateŋ eko ni gbɔmɛi fɔɔ feemɔ lɛ, efee esha.

english_verse: and told him what sacrifices the priests must offer on the morning and evening of the day they are ordained: It is the same as the regular morning and evening sacrifices—half a kilogram of flour
translation_verse: “Gbi nɔ ni afɔɔ Aaron loo eshwie ko mu akɛ osɔfo lɛ, ekɛ ŋmãa mamu kilo kome aba abahã Yehowa tamɔ daa ŋmãa afɔle lɛ nɔŋŋ. Akɛ fã aba leebi, ni akɛfã hu aba gbɛkɛ.

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy, and only the priests may have any part of it.
translation_verse: Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni jɛ osɔfoi ateŋ aye loo lɛ eko; eji nɔ ko ni he tse krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa.

english_verse: If the meat was cooked in a clay pot, the pot must be destroyed, but if it was cooked in a bronze pot, the pot must be scrubbed and rinsed with water.
translation_verse: Sũ gbɛ ni ahoo loo lɛ eko yɛ mli lɛ, ajwara; shi kɛ akɔɔble loo dadesɛŋ mli ahoo yɛ lɛ, asha mli ni akɛ nu ajale mli.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to tell Aaron and his sons how to offer the daily sacrifices that are sent up in smoke to please the Lord: You must put the animal for the sacrifice on the altar in the evening and let it stay there all night. But make sure the fire keeps burning.
translation_verse: “Fã Aaron kɛ ebii lɛ akɛ shãa afɔle he mla nɛ. Shãa afɔle lɛ ahi afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ, ni la ahi shishi kɛyashi leebi.

english_verse: Change into your everyday clothes, take the ashes outside the camp, and pile them in the special place.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ ajie etadei lɛ koni ewo ekroko. Ekɛ lamlu lɛ aje kpo kɛya nsra lɛ sɛɛ ni ekɛyashwie he ko ni tse.

english_verse: The fire must never go out, so put wood on it each morning. After this, you are to lay an animal on the altar next to the fat that you sacrifice to ask my blessing. Then send it all up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: La lɛ ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ akã he atso daa; akahã egbo gbi ko gbi ko. Daa leebi lɛ osɔfo lɛ kɛ lai ashwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Eto shãa afɔle lɛ gbɛjianɔ eshwie nɔ ni eshã toiŋjɔlɛ afɔlei ahe fɔi lɛ yɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The altar fire must always be kept burning—it must never go out. Sacrifices To Give Thanks to the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: La atso daa yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; akahã egbo gbi ko gbi ko.” Ŋmãa afɔlei

english_verse: When someone offers a sacrifice to give thanks to me, the priests from Aaron's family must bring it to the front of the bronze altar,
translation_verse: Ŋmãa afɔle lɛ he mla nɛ: “Aaron bihii osɔfoi lɛ kɛ ŋmãa afɔle lɛ aba abahã Yehowa yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: where one of them will scoop up a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the incense on it. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, he will lay all of this on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛteŋ mɔ kome aŋɔ mã lɛ kɛ emli mu lɛ kɛ ohɛ ni yɔɔ ŋmãa afɔle lɛ nɔ lɛ ekɔkɔ kome ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Eji okadi kɛkɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ akɛ ŋmãa afɔle lɛ fɛɛ ehã Yehowa. Afɔle nɛɛ ŋma lɛ sa Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: The rest of it is to be baked without yeast and eaten by the priests in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent. This bread is very holy, just like the sacrifices for sin or the sacrifices for making things right, and I have given this part to the priests from what is offered to me on the altar.
translation_verse: Aboloo akpiti nɛɛ ji osɔfoi lɛ agbɛfaŋnɔ ni mihã amɛ yɛ ŋmãa afɔlei ni ashãa ahãa mi lɛ mli. Nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa ni, tamɔ esha afɔle kɛ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ.

english_verse: Only the men in Aaron's family are allowed to eat this bread, and they must go through a ceremony to be made holy before touching it. This law will never change. When Priests Are Ordained
translation_verse: Bei fɛɛ, yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ ni baaba lɛ mli lɛ, nuu fɛɛ nuu ni jɛ Aaron shwiei lɛ ateŋ lɛ aye akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ ŋmãa afɔlei ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa lɛ mli. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa he lɛ aaatsɔ̃ krɔŋkrɔŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ,

english_verse: mixed with olive oil and cooked in a shallow pan. The bread must then be crumbled into small pieces and sent up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Akɛ mu ashi yɛ ŋɛsu mli. Kɛ ebe lɛ, akumɔ mli dukuduku ni akɛba akɛ ŋmãa afɔle ni eŋma sa Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa fã Mose

english_verse: how the priests from Aaron's family were to offer the sacrifice for sin: This sacrifice is very sacred, and the animal must be killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: koni ekɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebii lɛ bɔ ni ashã esha afɔlei lɛ ahã. He ni agbeɔ kooloi ni akɛshãa shãa afɔlei lɛ yɛ lɛ, jɛi nɔŋŋ agbe kooloo ni akɛshãa esha afɔle lɛ yɛ ahã Yehowa. Eji afɔle ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa.

english_verse: The priest who offers this sacrifice must eat it in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Osɔfo ni gbeɔ kooloo lɛ kɛshãa esha afɔle lɛ aye loo lɛ. Eye yɛ he ni tse krɔŋkrɔŋ; no ji yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ kpo lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: and anyone or anything that touches the meat will be holy. If any of the animal's blood is splattered on the clothes of the priest, they must be washed in a holy place.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni taa loo lɛ he lɛ aaatsɔ̃ krɔŋkrɔŋ. Kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ eko tsɛ̃ŋe shwie atade he lɛ, afɔ atade loo nɔ lɛ ni lá lɛ tsɛ̃ŋe shwie he lɛ he yɛ he ni tse krɔŋkrɔŋ.

english_verse: None of the meat may be eaten from the sacrifices for sin that require blood to be brought into the sacred tent. These sacrifices must be completely burned.
translation_verse: Shi esha afɔle fɛɛ esha afɔle ni akɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ eko aaaba Kpe Buu lɛ mli ni akɛaakpãtã yɛ he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ esha ko hewɔ lɛ, akaye; ashã kɛ la.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ ashã fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ ahã Yehowa akɛ niyenii afɔle ni akɛ la shãa. Sɔ̃ afɔle ni.

english_verse: Give me one loaf or wafer from each of these four kinds of bread, after which they will belong to the priest who splattered the blood against the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Nii ni ekɛba lɛ, ejie fɛɛ mli ekomekome ehã, ni akɛfee nɔwomɔ afɔle ahã Yehowa; Osɔfo lɛ ni tsiɔ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ eshwieɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he lɛ nɔ ni.

english_verse: Don't eat any of the meat that has touched something unclean. Instead, burn it. The rest of the meat may be eaten by anyone who is clean and acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Loo ni nɔ ko ni he tseee aaasa he lɛ, akaye, ashã. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni he tse lɛ aye loo lɛ eko.

english_verse: The sacrifice to make things right is very sacred.
translation_verse: Sɔ̃ afɔle he mla nɛ. Eji afɔle ni he tse krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ.

english_verse: The animal must be killed in the same place where the sacrifice to please me is killed, and the animal's blood must be splattered against the four sides of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Kooloo ni akɛbaashã sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ agbe lɛ yɛ he ni agbeɔ kooloo ni akɛshãa shãa afɔle lɛ yɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ. Kooloo lɛ lá lɛ afɔse ashwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ he.

english_verse: Offer all of the animal's fat, including the fat on its tail and on its insides,
translation_verse: Ajie efɔ lɛ fɛɛ, elei ni ewo fɔ lɛ, fɔ ni ha emlinii lɛ ahe lɛ kɛ

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: sabai enyɔ ni yɔɔ hɛ mli lɛ, kɛ fɔ ni ha amɛhe lɛ kɛ loo ni tsa mlɛbo lɛ kɛ sabai lɛ, koni akɛshã afɔle.

english_verse: This sacrifice for making things right is very holy. Only the priests may eat it, and they must eat it in a holy place.
translation_verse: Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni jɛ osɔfoi ateŋ aye eko; eye yɛ he ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ; afɔle ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa ni.

english_verse: The ceremony for this sacrifice and the one for sin are the same, and the meat may be eaten only by the priest who performs this ceremony of forgiveness.
translation_verse: Esha afɔle lɛ etamɔ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ; mla kome nɔŋŋ kã shi hã enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ: osɔfo ni shãa afɔle lɛ kɛkpãtãa lɛ, enɔ ji loo lɛ.

english_verse: In fact, the priest who offers a sacrifice to please me may keep the skin of the animal,
translation_verse: Kooloo ni akɛshãa shãa afɔle lɛ hewolo lɛ, osɔfo ni shãa afɔle lɛ nɔ ni.

english_verse: All other grain sacrifices—with or without olive oil in them—are to be divided equally among the priests of Aaron's family. Sacrifices To Ask the Lord's Blessing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Shi niyenii afɔle fɛɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ, awo mli mu jio, afee lɛ egbiŋ jio, Aaron shwiei osɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ ni; aja lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ana tamɔ bɔ ni enyɛmi na lɛ pɛ. Naanyobɔɔ afɔlei

english_verse: Here are the instructions for offering a sacrifice to ask my blessing:
translation_verse: Bɔ ni sa akɛ ashã naanyobɔɔ afɔlei ahã Yehowa nɛ.

english_verse: If you offer it to give thanks, you must offer some bread together with it. Use the finest flour to make three kinds of bread without yeast—two in the form of loaves mixed with olive oil and one in the form of thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: Kɛ afɔle lɛ shidaa afɔle ni lɛ, nibii ni akɛfata he ji keeki ni akɛ mã akpiti ni awo mli mu shã kɛ akpãanɔɔ ni akɛ mã akpiti ni akpa hiɛ mu shã kɛ keeki ni akɛ mã ni mu enumɔ mli shã.

english_verse: You must also make some bread with yeast.
translation_verse: Kɛshi naanyobɔɔ shidaa afɔlei nɛɛ anɔ lɛ ekɛ keeki ni akɛ mãsha shã hu abashã afɔle.

english_verse: When you offer an animal to ask a blessing from me or to thank me, the meat belongs to you, but it must be eaten the same day.
translation_verse: Kooloo ni akɛshãa shidaa afɔle lɛ loo lɛ, aye gbi nɔ ni agbe kooloo lɛ nɔŋŋ; akashwɛ eko ni je tsɛre nɔ.

english_verse: It is different with the sacrifices you offer when you make me a promise or voluntarily give me something. The meat from those sacrifices may be kept and eaten the next day,
translation_verse: Kɛji afɔle ni mɔ ko kɛba lɛ shiwoo afɔle ni, loo afɔle ni ekɛba yɛ tsuijurɔ naa ni lɛ, no lɛ ebɛ akɛ aye loo lɛ fɛɛ gbi nɔ ni agbe kooloo lɛ nɔŋŋ; shi kɛ loo lɛ eko shwɛ lɛ, aye enɔ jetsɛremɔ.

english_verse: but any that is left over must be destroyed. If you eat any of it after the second day, your sacrifice will be useless and unacceptable, and you will be both disgusting and guilty.
translation_verse: Kɛji gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ mɔ ko ye loo lɛ eko lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hereŋ mɔ ni kɛ afɔle lɛ ba lɛ. Enaŋ he nyɔmɔwoo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. Nihii nii ji loo lɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaye eko lɛ, eloo musu.

english_verse: But don't eat any of this meat if you have become unclean by touching something unclean from a human or an animal or from any other creature. If you do, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Asaŋ kɛ mɔ ko aaaye naanyobɔɔ afɔle nɛɛ eko, be mli ni eta nɔ ko ni he tseee he, gbɔmɔ ni he tseee he eta jio, kooloo ni he tseee he eta jio, nɔ kroko ni jio, aaatswa enane shi tu kɛaaje emɛi ateŋ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ,

english_verse: to say to the people: Don't eat the fat of cattle, sheep, or goats.
translation_verse: “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, nyɛkayea fɔ ko fɔ ko; tsina fɔ jio, gwantɛŋ fɔ jio, too abotia fɔ jio, nyɛkayea.

english_verse: If you eat the fat of an animal that can be used as a sacrifice to me, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaye kooloo ni akɛshã niyenii afɔle ahã Yehowa lɛ eko lɛ aaatswa enane shi tu kɛaaje emɛi ateŋ.

english_verse: And no matter where you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal,
translation_verse: He fɛɛ he ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ nyɛkayea lá ko lá ko, loofɔlɔ lá jio, kooloo naji ejwɛ tsɛ jio.

english_verse: or you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaku mla nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, aaatswa enaneshi tu kɛaaje emɛi ateŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If you want to offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, you must bring the part to be burned and lay it on the bronze altar. But you must first lift up the choice ribs with their fat to show that the offering is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Ehiɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ kɛba akɛ niyenii afɔle. Akɛ kooloo lɛ fɔ lɛ kɛ etsitsi lɛ fɛɛ aba ni ekɛbahã Yehowa akɛ nikeenii titri ko hã Yehowa.

english_verse: A priest from Aaron's family will then send the fat up in smoke, but the ribs belong to the priests.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ ashã fɔ lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, shi tsitsi lɛ Aaron kɛ ebii osɔfoi lɛ anɔ ni.

english_verse: The upper joint of the right hind leg is for the priest who offers the blood and the fat of the animal.
translation_verse: osɔfo ni shãa naanyobɔɔ afɔle lɛ lá lɛ kɛ fɔ lɛ ehãa Yehowa lɛ. Akɛhã osɔfo lɛ akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ titri ko.

english_verse: I have decided that the people of Israel must always give the choice ribs and the upper joint of the right hind leg to Aaron's descendants
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kooloo lɛ tsitsi lɛ kɛ sɛɛgbɛ nanejurɔ lɛ mihe yɛ Israelbii lɛ adɛŋ mihã osɔfoi ni ji Aaron kɛ eshwiei lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛnaanɔ ni kã shi hã amɛ daa.

english_verse: These are the ceremonies for sacrifices to please the Lord, to give him thanks, and to ask for his blessing or his forgiveness, as well as the ceremonies for those sacrifices that demand a payment and for the sacrifices that are offered when priests are ordained.
translation_verse: Enɛ ji mla ni kã shi hã shãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ ŋmãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ esha afɔlei kɛ sɔ̃ afɔlei lɛ kɛ osɔfowoo afɔlei lɛ kɛ naanyobɔɔ afɔlei lɛ.

english_verse: While Moses and the people of Israel were in the desert at Mount Sinai, the Lord commanded them to start offering these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Enɛ he Yehowa wo Mose kitã yɛ gbi nɔ ni ewo Israelbii lɛ kitã akɛ amɛkɛ amɛfɔlei lɛ aba abahã Yehowa yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ ni yɔɔ Sinai ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Moses lifted up the choice ribs of the ram to show that they were dedicated to the Lord. This was the part that the Lord had said Moses could have.
translation_verse: Mose kɔ osɔfowoo too ojwɛni lɛ tsitsi lɛ, ni ekɛshã afɔle ehã Yehowa akɛ nɔkee nɔ titri ko. Mose ŋɔ osɔfowoo too ojwɛni tsitsi lɛ akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo lɛ kitã lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: Send for Aaron and his sons, as well as their priestly clothes, the oil for ordination, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams, and a basket of bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: “Ŋɔɔ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ ofata ohe, ni oŋɔ atadei lɛ kɛ mɔ mufɔɔ mu lɛ kɛ tsinanuu ni akɛshãa esha afɔle lɛ kɛ too ojwɛnii enyɔ lɛ kɛ mã akpiti kafu lɛ koni okɛ amɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ naa.

english_verse: Then bring the whole community of Israel together at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ni obua asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ naa.”

english_verse: he said, “We are here to follow the Lord's instructions.”
translation_verse: Mose kɛɛ asafo lɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni Yehowa fã akɛ mifee lɛ, no mibafee nɛɛ.”

english_verse: After Moses told Aaron and his sons to step forward, he told them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Mose hã Aaron kɛ ebii lɛ ba hiɛ, ni ekɛ nu ju amɛhe.

english_verse: He put the priestly shirt and robe on Aaron and wrapped the sash around his waist. Then he put the sacred vest on Aaron and fastened it with the finely woven belt.
translation_verse: Ekɛ flaka lɛ wo Aaron, ni ekɛ mlifii nɔ lɛ fĩ emliteŋ. Ekɛ atade yuu lɛ wo Aaron. Ekɛ efod lɛ hu wo lɛ, ni ekɛ efod lɛ mlifii nɔ lɛ fĩ efod lɛ ekpɛtɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Next, he put on Aaron the sacred breastpiece that was used in finding out what the Lord wanted his people to do.
translation_verse: Ekɛ tsitsinɔnii lɛ to nɔ, ni ekɛ Urim kɛ Tumim lɛ wo tsitsinɔnii lɛ kotoku lɛ mli.

english_verse: He placed the turban on Aaron's head, and on the front of the turban was the narrow strip of thin gold as a sign of his dedication to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ekɛ yitsofii nɔ lɛ fĩ Aaron yitso, ni Mose kɛ shika fɛtɛfɛtɛ ni ji hiɛnaanii krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ta yitsofii nɔ lɛ hiɛnaa. Amɛfee enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ.

english_verse: Moses then dedicated the sacred tent and everything in it to the Lord by sprinkling them with some of the oil for ordination.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ Mose wo mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ. Efɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ mu koni efee fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.

english_verse: He sprinkled the bronze altar seven times, and he sprinkled its equipment, as well as the large bronze bowl and its base.
translation_verse: Ekɛ mu lɛ eko shwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ shii kpawo ekɛfɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ nibii ni akɛtsuɔ nii yɛ he lɛ kɛ lalakã lɛ kɛ nɔ ni ema nɔ lɛ mu, koni efee amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ehã Yehowa.

english_verse: He also poured some of the oil on Aaron's head to dedicate him to the Lord.
translation_verse: Mose fɔse mufɔɔ mu lɛ eko eshwie Aaron yiteŋ, ni ekɛfɔ lɛ mu koni efee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.

english_verse: Next, Moses dressed Aaron's sons in their shirts, then tied sashes around them and put special caps on them, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ Mose hã Aaron bii lɛ ba hiɛ. Ewo amɛ flakai; ekɛ amɛmlifĩinii lɛ fimɔ amɛmliteŋ, ni ekɛ amɛfaii lɛ bumɔ amɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo lɛ kitã lɛ.

english_verse: Moses led out the bull that was to be sacrificed for sin, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ tsinanuu ni akɛshãa esha afɔle lɛ ba. Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛniji shwie esha afɔle tsinanuu lɛ yiteŋ.

english_verse: After it was killed, Moses dipped a finger in the blood and smeared some of it on each of the four corners of the bronze altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the altar. This purified the altar and made it a fit place for offering the sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Mose gbe tsinanuu lɛ. Ekɛ ewao tsɔ lá lɛ eko, ni ekɛkpa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji lɛ ahe kɛkpe, koni ekɛtsuu he. Mose tsi lá ni eshwɛ lɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi. Efee enɛ ekɛtsuu afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he, ni ejɔɔ nɔ ehã Yehowa.

english_verse: Moses then took the fat on the bull's insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and sent them up in smoke on the altar fire.
translation_verse: Mose jie fɔ lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mlinii lɛ ahe lɛ kɛ loo ni tsotsoro mlɛbo lɛ he lɛ kɛ sabai enyɔ lɛ kɛ amɛhe fɔ lɛ, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Finally, he took the skin and the flesh of the bull, together with the food still in its stomach, and burned them outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Shi tsinanuu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ hewolo lɛ kɛ eloo lɛ kɛ ewamɔ lɛ Mose kɛtee shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ eyashã, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo lɛ kitã lɛ.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the sacrifice to please the Lord. After Aaron and his sons had laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ Mose kɛ too ojwɛni ni akɛshãa shãa afɔle ba. Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛniji shwie too ojwɛni lɛ yiteŋ,

english_verse: Moses killed the ram and splattered its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: ni Mose gbe lɛ. Etsi lá lɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ kɛbɔle.

english_verse: Moses had the animal cut up, and he washed its insides and hind legs. Then he laid the head, the fat, and the rest of the ram on the altar and sent them up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. All this was done just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Esaa too ojwɛni lɛ, ni ekɛ nu fɔ mlinii lɛ kɛ naji lɛ ahe. Kɛkɛ ni eshã yitso lɛ kɛ fɔ lɛ kɛ too muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo lɛ kitã lɛ. Shãa afɔle nɛɛ niyenii afɔle ni; eŋma lɛ sa Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the ceremony of ordination. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ Mose kɛ too ojwɛni ni ji enyɔ ni agbeɔ akɛ afɔle kɛji aawo osɔfo lɛ ba. Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛniji shwie too ojwɛni lɛ yiteŋ,

english_verse: and it was killed. Moses smeared some of its blood on Aaron's right earlobe, some on his right thumb, and some on the big toe of his right foot.
translation_verse: ni Mose gbe lɛ. Etsɔ lá lɛ eko esa Aaron ninejurɔ toi naa kɛ eninejurɔ gɔnti naa kɛ enanejurɔ gɔnti naa.
