english_verse: Moses did the same thing for Aaron's sons, before splattering the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Mose hã Aaron bihii lɛ hu ba. Etsɔ lá lɛ eko esa amɛninejurɔ toi naa kɛ amɛninejurɔ gɔnti naa kɛ amɛnane gɔnti naa. Kɛkɛ ni efɔse lá ni eshwɛ lɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe.

english_verse: He took the animal's fat tail, the fat on its insides, and the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and the right hind leg.
translation_verse: Mose ŋɔ fɔ kɛ lei lɛ ni ewo fɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ fɛɛ ni ha mlinii kɛ mlɛbo lɛ ahe lɛ kɛ sabai enyɔ lɛ kɛ amɛhe fɔ lɛ kɛ sɛɛ nanejurɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Then he took from a basket some of each of the three kinds of bread that had been made without yeast and had been dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni ekɔ aboloo kome yɛ mã akpiti kafu ni akɛmaa Yehowa hiɛ lɛ mli, kɛ aboloo kome ni mu yɔɔ mli kɛ akpãanɔɔ kome, ni ekɛshwie fɔ lɛ kɛ shuɔ jurɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Moses placed the bread on top of the meat and gave it all to Aaron and his sons, who lifted it up to show that it was dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Mose kɛ niyenii nɛɛ fɛɛ wo Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ adɛŋ; ni efɔ̃ kɛtee kɛba akɛ afɔle ni afɔ̃ɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: After this, Moses placed it on the fires of the altar and sent it up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. This was part of the ordination ceremony.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Mose saa he niyenii lɛ yɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ adɛŋ, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ eshi shãa afɔlei ni ashãa fɛɛ emuu lɛ anɔ. Eji osɔfowoo afɔle ni akɛ la shãa ahãa Yehowa, ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Finally, Moses sprinkled the priestly clothes of Aaron and his sons with some of the oil for ordination and with some of the blood from the altar. So Aaron and his sons, together with their priestly clothes, were dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Mose ŋɔ mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ eko kɛ lá ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ eko, ni ekɛshwã Aaron kɛ etadei lɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛtadei lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Ekɛ enɛ fee Aaron kɛ etadei lɛ kɛ Aaron bihii lɛ kɛ amɛtadei lɛ fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ehã Yehowa.

english_verse: Moses said to Aaron and his sons: The Lord told me that you must boil this meat at the entrance to the sacred tent and eat it there with the bread.
translation_verse: Mose kɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ loo lɛ ayaa Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa koni nyɛyahoa. Nyɛyea loo lɛ kɛ aboloo ni yɔ kafu ni akɛ osɔfowoo afɔlei toɔ mli lɛ mli lɛ yɛ jɛi nɔŋŋ. Nyɛyea tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo kitã akɛ, ‘Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ aye lɛ.’

english_verse: Burn what is left over
translation_verse: Loo kɛ aboloo ni aaashwɛ yɛ sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛshãa.

english_verse: and stay near the entrance to the sacred tent until the ordination ceremony ends seven days from now.
translation_verse: Nyɛkajea Kpee Buu lɛ mli kɛyashi gbii kpawo ni akɛfeɔ nyɛ osɔfowoo kusum lɛ aaaho; ejaakɛ gbii kpawo akɛfeɔ osɔfowoo kusum lɛ.

english_verse: We have obeyed the Lord in everything that has been done today, so that your sins may be forgiven.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni afee ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ afee koni akɛjie nyɛhe esha kɛya.

english_verse: The Lord has told me that you must stay near the entrance to the tent for seven days and nights, or else you will die.
translation_verse: Nyɛhia Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane gbii kpawo koni nyɛkɛfee nɔ ni Yehowa efã akɛ afee lɛ. Kɛji nyɛfeee nakai lɛ, nyɛbaagboi. Nakai ji bɔ ni Yehowa wo mi kitã.”

english_verse: Aaron and his sons obeyed everything that the Lord had told Moses they must do.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ fee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yehowa wo Mose he kitã lɛ.

english_verse: Eight days later Moses called together Aaron, his sons, and Israel's leaders.
translation_verse: Gbi ni agbe osɔfowoo kusumi lɛ anaa lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, Mose tsɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ Israel onukpai lɛ.

english_verse: Then he said to Aaron: Find a young bull and a ram that have nothing wrong with them. Offer the bull to the Lord as a sacrifice for sin and the ram as a sacrifice to please him.
translation_verse: Mose kɛɛ Aaron akɛ: “Ŋɔɔ tsinanuu fioo kome ni kpa ko bɛ ehe kɛ too ojwɛni kome hu ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ni okɛshã afɔle, ohã Yehowa. Okɛ tsinanuu lɛ ashã esha afɔle ni okɛ too ojwɛni lɛ ashã shãa afɔle.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that they must offer sacrifices as well. They must offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to please the Lord. The bull and the ram must be a year old and have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ okɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛŋɔ too ojwɛni amɛkɛshã esha afɔle; amɛkɛ tsinabi ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe kɛ too gwantɛŋbi ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ashã shãa afɔle;

english_verse: Then the people must offer a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing and also a grain sacrifice mixed with oil. Do this, because the Lord will appear to you today.
translation_verse: ni amɛkɛ tsinanuu kɛ too ojwɛni kɛ ŋmãa afɔle ni awo mli mu ashã naanyobɔɔ afɔle. Amɛshã afɔle amɛhã Yehowa, ejaakɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ Yehowa baajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.”

english_verse: After the animals and the grain had been brought to the front of the sacred tent, and the people were standing there in the presence of the Lord,
translation_verse: Amɛkɛ nii ni Mose fã amɛ akɛ amɛkɛba lɛ ba Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ, ni asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ bua amɛhe naa yɛ jɛi koni amɛja Yehowa.

english_verse: Moses said: The Lord has ordered you to do this, so that he may appear to you in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Mose kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Yehowa fã akɛ nyɛfee enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni enunyam ni kpɛ kaŋkaŋ lɛ ajie ehe kpo atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.”

english_verse: Aaron, step up to the altar and offer the sacrifice to please the Lord, then offer the sacrifices for the forgiveness of your sins and for the sins of the people, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, “Tsi obɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni oshã esha afɔle kɛ shãa afɔle ohã ohe koni okɛfɔ ohe esha kɛ maŋ lɛ he esha. Oshã afɔle nɛɛ koni okɛfɔ maŋ lɛ he eshai, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo kitã lɛ.”

english_verse: Aaron stepped up to the altar and killed the bull that was to be the sacrifice for his sins.
translation_verse: Aaron tsi kɛtee afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he, ni egbe tsinanuu fioo lɛ ekɛshã esha afɔle ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe.

english_verse: His sons brought him the blood. He dipped a finger in it, smeared some on the four corners of the bronze altar, and poured out the rest at its foot.
translation_verse: Ebihii lɛ kɛ lá lɛ ba. Aaron kɛ ewao tsɔ mli, ni ekɛdiki koji ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he lɛ. Ni lá ni shwɛ lɛ etsi eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi.

english_verse: But he sent up in smoke the fat, the kidneys, and the lower part of the liver, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni eshã fɔ lɛ kɛ sabai lɛ kɛ mlɛbo lɛ he loo ni tsotsoro shi lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo Mose kitã lɛ.

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the skin and the flesh outside the camp.
translation_verse: Shi kooloo lɛ kɛ hewolo lɛ eshã yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.

english_verse: After Aaron had killed the ram that was sacrificed to please the Lord, Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Mose gbe kooloo ni akɛbaashã shãa afɔle lɛ hu. Ebihii lɛ kɛ lá lɛ bahã lɛ, ni ekɛshwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe.

english_verse: They brought him each piece of the animal, including the head, and he burned them all on the altar.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛ shãa afɔle lɛ hu bahã lɛ, loo ni ashãa lɛ kɛ yitso lɛ fɛɛ hu lɛ, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: He washed the insides and the hind legs and also sent them up in smoke.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni efɔ mlinii lɛ kɛ naji lɛ ahe, ni ekɛshwie shãa afɔle ni jwere afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ, ni eshã fɛɛ.

english_verse: Next, Aaron sacrificed the goat for the sins of the people, as he had done with the sacrifice for his own sins.
translation_verse: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ maŋ lɛ afɔlei lɛ ba. Eŋɔ too kpakpo ni akɛbaashã maŋ lɛ he esha afɔle lɛ; egbe lɛ ni ekɛshã afɔle, tamɔ bɔ ni efee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe esha afɔle lɛ.

english_verse: And so, he burned this sacrifice on the altar in the proper way.
translation_verse: Eŋɔ kooloo ni akɛshãa shãa afɔle lɛ hu kɛba, ni ekɛshã afɔle tamɔ bɔ ni gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: He also presented the grain sacrifice and burned a handful of the flour on the altar as part of the morning sacrifice.
translation_verse: Ekɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ ba; ni ekpiti emli eko ekɔkɔ obɔ̃ ni ekɛfata shãa afɔle ni ashãa daa leebi lɛ he, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Finally, he killed the bull and the ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing on the people. Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni egbe tsinanuu lɛ kɛ too ojwɛni lɛ ekɛshã naanyobɔɔ afɔle ehã maŋ lɛ; ebihii lɛ kɛ lá lɛ bahã lɛ, ni ekɛshwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe.

english_verse: His sons placed all the fat, as well as the kidneys and the lower part of the liver
translation_verse: Tsinanuu lɛ kɛ too ojwɛni lɛ fɔi lɛ kɛ lei ni ewo fɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ ni ha mlinii lɛ ahe lɛ kɛ sabai lɛ kɛ loo ni tsotsoro mlɛbo lɛ he lɛ,

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the fat on the altar and lifted up the ribs and the right hind leg to show that these were dedicated to the Lord. This was done just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
translation_verse: Ekɛ tsitsii lɛ kɛ sɛɛ ninejurɔ shuɔ naji lɛ hã Yehowa akɛ nikeenii titri ko, tamɔ bɔ ni Mose ewo kitã lɛ.

english_verse: Aaron held out his hand and gave the people his blessing, before coming down from the bronze altar where he had offered the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Be ni Aaron eshã esha afɔle kɛ naanyobɔɔ afɔle lɛ egbe naa lɛ, ehole eniji anɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi ni ejɔɔ maŋ lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni ekpeleke shi.

english_verse: He and Moses went into the sacred tent, and when they came out, they gave the people their blessing. Then the Lord appeared to the people in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ Mose kɛ Aaron bote Kpee Buu lɛ mli. Be ni amɛje kpo ekoŋŋ lɛ, amɛjɔɔ maŋ lɛ. Ni Yehowa anunyam ni kpɛɔ kaŋkaŋ lɛ jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: The Lord sent fiery flames that burned up everything on the altar, and when everyone saw this, they shouted and fell to their knees to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Trukaa lɛ Yehowa hã la ba ni ebashã shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ fɔi lɛ ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ. Be ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ na lɛ, amɛbolɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi.

english_verse: Nadab and Abihu were two of Aaron's sons, but they disobeyed the Lord by burning incense to him on a fire pan, when they were not supposed to.
translation_verse: Shi Aaron bihii ni ji Nadab kɛ Abihu lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ wo elajee ŋɛsu, ni amɛkɛ la wo mli. Amɛkɛ tsofakɛŋma shwie nɔ, ni amɛshã amɛhã Yehowa; shi la ni amɛkɛshã lɛ bɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ jeee no he kitã Yehowa wo lɛ.

english_verse: Suddenly the Lord sent fiery flames and burned them to death.
translation_verse: Yehowa hã la ba ebashã amɛ, ni amɛgboi yɛ ehiɛ.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron that this was exactly what the Lord had meant when he said: “I demand respect from my priests, and I will be praised by everyone!” Aaron was speechless.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, “Enɛ ji nɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ɔ be ni ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛi fɛɛ ni sɔ̃mɔɔ mi lɛ esa akɛ abu mi akɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ; majie minunyam lɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ.’ ” Shi Aaron mua enaa.

english_verse: Moses sent for Mishael and Elzaphan, the two sons of Aaron's uncle Uzziel. Then he told them, “Take these two dead relatives of yours outside the camp far from the entrance to the sacred tent.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsɛ Mishael kɛ Elzafan, Aaron tsɛkwɛ Uziel bii lɛ kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ: “Nyɛbaa nyɛbaholea nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ agbohii lɛ kɛjea He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛyaa shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.”

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron and his other two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: Don't show your sorrow by messing up your hair and tearing your priestly clothes, or the Lord will get angry. He will kill the three of you and punish everyone else. It's all right for your relatives, the people of Israel, to mourn for those he destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: Mose kɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii ni ji Eleazar kɛ Itamar akɛ, “Nyɛkahãa nyɛyiteŋ fea tsaŋtsaŋ aloo nyɛgbalaa nyɛtadei kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nyɛmiiye ŋkɔmɔ. Kɛ nyɛfee nakai lɛ, nyɛbaagboi, ni Yehowa mli baawo maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ la. Nyɛhãa nyɛwekumɛi, Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ, afoa shãa ni Yehowa ehã la eshã nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ni amɛgboi nɛɛ.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's chosen priests, and you must not leave the sacred tent, or you will die. Aaron and his two sons obeyed Moses.
translation_verse: Nyɛkajea Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa hu ni nyɛbagboi, ejaakɛ akɛ Yehowa mufɔɔ mu lɛ efɔ nyɛ mu.” Amɛfee bɔ ni Mose kɛɛ amɛ lɛ. Mlai ni awo Osɔfoi

english_verse: The Lord said to Aaron:
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Aaron akɛ,

english_verse: When you or your sons enter the sacred tent, you must never drink beer or wine. If you do, you will die right there! This law will never change.
translation_verse: “Bo kɛ obihii lɛ, nyɛkanua wain loo dãa ni wa ko be mli ni nyɛyaa Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ. Kɛ nyɛnu dãa lɛ, nyɛbaagboi. Oshwiei fɛɛ aye akpɔ nɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: You must learn the difference between what is holy and what isn't holy and between the clean and the unclean.
translation_verse: Esa akɛ nyɛle srɔto ni kã nɔ ni he tse krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ nɔ ni buleɔ mɔ teŋ; ni esa akɛ nyɛle srɔto ni yɔɔ nɔ ni he tse kɛ nɔ ni he tseee teŋ.

english_verse: You must also teach the people of Israel everything that I commanded Moses to say to them.
translation_verse: Nyɛtsɔ̃a Israelbii lɛ akpɔi fɛɛ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ekɛ amɛ wie he lɛ.”

english_verse: Moses told Aaron and his two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: The grain sacrifice that was offered to give thanks to the Lord is very holy. So make bread without yeast from the part that wasn't sent up in smoke and eat it beside the altar.
translation_verse: Mose kɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii ni eshwɛ ni ji Eleazar kɛ Itamar lɛ akɛ, “Niyenii afɔlei ni shwɛɔ yɛ afɔlei ni ashã ahã Yehowa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛshãa mã akpiti aboloo ni nyɛyea yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he ejaakɛ afɔle nɛɛ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni fe fɛɛ ni.

english_verse: The Lord has said that this belongs to you and your sons, and that it must be eaten in a holy place.
translation_verse: Nyɛyea yɛ he ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ bo kɛ obihii lɛ, nyɛgbɛnaanii ji niyenii afɔlei nɛɛ ni shwɛɔ yɛ shãa afɔlei ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa lɛ asɛɛ lɛ. Ejaakɛ enɛ ji Yehowa kitã ni ewo mi.

english_verse: But the choice ribs and the hind leg that were lifted up may be eaten by your entire family, as long as you do so in an acceptable place. These parts are yours from the sacrifices that the people offer to ask the Lord's blessing. This is what the Lord has commanded, and it will never change.
translation_verse: Akɛ tsitsi lɛ kɛ sɛɛ shuɔ lɛ afata fɔi lɛ ahe kɛba, be mli ni ashãa fɔi lɛ akɛ afɔle ahãa Yehowa akɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ. Tsitsi lɛ kɛ shuɔ lɛ, bo kɛ obihii lɛ agbɛnaanii ni akɛhã nyɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ ni. Nakai ji bɔ ni Yehowa fã akɛ afee.”

english_verse: When Moses asked around and learned that the ram for the sin sacrifice had already been burned on the altar, he became angry with Eleazar and Ithamar and said,
translation_verse: Mose tao too ojwɛni ni akɛshãa esha afɔle lɛ aahu kɛyashi ena ele akɛ ashã momo. Mose mli wo Eleazar kɛ Itamar Aaron bihii ni eshwɛ lɛ la ni ekɛɛ,

english_verse: “Why didn't you eat the meat from this sacrifice in an acceptable place? It is very holy, and the Lord has given you this sacrifice to remove Israel's sin and guilt.
translation_verse: “Mɛɛba nyɛyeee esha afɔle lɛ yɛ he ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ? Nɔ ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa ji afɔle lɛ ni Yehowa kɛhã nyɛ koni nyɛkɛ kpãtã yɛ Yehowa hiɛ koni nyɛjie maŋ lɛ he esha lɛ kɛya lɛ.

english_verse: Whenever an animal's blood isn't brought into the sacred tent, I commanded you to eat its meat in an acceptable place, but you burned it instead.”
translation_verse: Akɛni akɛ too ojwɛni lɛ lá lɛ baaa Kpee Buu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli hewɔ lɛ, kulɛ esa akɛ nyɛye afɔle lɛ yɛ jɛi tamɔ bɔ ni mifã lɛ.”

english_verse: Their father Aaron replied, “Today two of my sons offered the sacrifice for sin and the sacrifice to please the Lord, and look what has happened to me! Would the Lord have approved if I had eaten the sacrifice for sin?”
translation_verse: Aaron to he ehã Mose akɛ, “Maŋbii lɛ shã amɛhe esha afɔle kɛ amɛshãa afɔle lɛ ŋmɛnɛ; ni kɛ̃lɛ oshara ebasharã mi nɛɛ. Eji miye esha afɔle ŋmɛnɛ kulɛ ehi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ?”

english_verse: Moses was satisfied with Aaron's reply.
translation_verse: Be ni Mose nu wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, ena akɛ eja.

english_verse: any animal that has divided hoofs and chews the cud.
translation_verse: nii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ koklotoi ni agbala mli aloo aja mli, ni asaŋ amɛgɔiɔ amɛniyenii ni amɛtaa.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You may eat
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Kooloi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ nii ni nyɛye ji:

english_verse: The only winged insects you may eat are locusts, grasshoppers, and crickets. All other winged insects that crawl are too disgusting for you to eat.
translation_verse: filikilɔi krokomɛi fɛɛ ni eshwɛ ni wamɔɔ ni amɛyɔɔ naji ejwɛɛjwɛ lɛ nyɛkayea, ejaakɛ amɛhe tseee.

english_verse: Don't even touch the dead bodies of animals that have divided hoofs but don't chew the cud. And don't touch the dead bodies of animals that have paws. If you do, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni aaawo kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ eko gbonyo lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe; shi ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. Nyɛbua kooloi nɛɛ akɛ kooloi ni ahe tseee.

english_verse: Moles, rats, mice, and all kinds of lizards are unclean.
translation_verse: kɛ mampam kɛ odiŋmɔlɔ kɛ tsunyɛ kɛ kɔ̃dɔ̃ kɛ obosumaketeo.

english_verse: Anyone who touches their dead bodies or anything touched by their dead bodies becomes unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Nyɛbua enɛɛmɛi akɛ nii ni he tseee yɛ kooloi ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ lɛ ateŋ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa eko ni egbo he lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.

english_verse: If any of these animals is found dead in a clay pot, the pot must be broken to pieces, and everything in it becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ sũ fee ni kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ eko aaagbee mli lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ he tseee. Ajwa sũnɔ ni nii lɛ yɔɔ mli lɛ.

english_verse: If you pour water from this pot on any food, that food becomes unclean, and anything drinkable in the pot becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Niyenii fɛɛ ni ayeɔ ni aaatsɔ̃ nu ni jɛ sũnɔ nɛɛ mli aaashwie nɔ lɛ, ehe tseee; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni anuɔ ni yɔɔ nɛkɛ sũnɔ nɛɛ mli lɛ, ehe tseee.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals touches anything else, including ovens and stoves, that thing becomes unclean and must be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ eko gbonyo aaagbee nɔ lɛ, ehe tseee. Kɛ flɔnɔɔ loo latɛ nɔ egbee lɛ, akumɔ, ejaakɛ ehe tseee, ni nyɛbua lɛ akɛ nɔ ni he tseee.

english_verse: A spring or a cistern where one of these dead animals is found is still clean, but anyone who touches the animal becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ nu hiŋmɛi loo dudɔ ni akɛ nu toɔ mli ni lɛ, no lɛ ehe tse; shi kɛ eko he aaasa kooloo gbonyo he lɛ, ehe tseee.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals is found lying on seeds that have been set aside for planting, the seeds remain clean.
translation_verse: Kɛji kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ eko gbonyo gbee wu ni abaadu nɔ lɛ, wu lɛ he tse lolo.

english_verse: But seeds that are soaking in water become unclean, if the dead animal is found in the water.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ aafɔ dumɔnii lɛ yɛ nu mli, ni gbonyo lɛ gbee nɔ lɛ, wu lɛ he tseee.

english_verse: If an animal that may be eaten happens to die, and you touch it, you become unclean until evening.
translation_verse: “Kɛ kooloi ni ayeɔ lɛ eko gbo lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa egbonyo lɛ he lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.

english_verse: If you eat any of its meat or carry its body away, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ kooloo ni egbo lɛ loo lɛ eko lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. Mɔ ni woɔ kooloo lɛ gbonyo lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.

english_verse: Don't eat any of those disgusting little creatures that crawl or walk close to the ground.
translation_verse: Kooloi fɛɛ ni wamɔɔ yɛ amɛmusu nɔ aloo amɛnyiɛɔ yɛ amɛnaji ejwɛ nɔ, aloo amɛyɔɔ naji piipii, kooloi bibii fɛɛ ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ lɛ, nyɛkayea, ejaakɛ amɛbuleɔ mɔ.

english_verse: If you eat any of them, you will become just as disgusting and unclean as they are.
translation_verse: Nyɛkayea koni nyɛkɛ no bule nyɛhe ni nyɛkɛwo nyɛhe muji.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must dedicate yourselves to me and be holy, just as I am holy. Don't become disgusting by eating any of these unclean creatures.
translation_verse: Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛfea nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ; nyɛtoa nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji mi. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ nibii ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ̃ lɛ eko eko akabulea nyɛhe.

english_verse: I brought you out of Egypt so that I could be your God. Now you must become holy, because I am holy!
translation_verse: Mi ji Yehowa mɔ ni jie nyɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, koni matsɔ̃ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛfea nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji mi.

english_verse: I have given these laws so that you will know what animals, birds, and fish are clean and may be eaten, and which ones are unclean and may not be eaten.
translation_verse: Awo mla lɛ koni akɛna srɔto ni yɔɔ kooloi ni he tse kɛ nii ni he tseee teŋ, kɛ kooloi ni ayeɔ kɛ nii ni ayeee teŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ Mose wie

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If a woman gives birth to a son, she is unclean for seven days, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: koni ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji yoo ko na musu, ni efɔ binuu lɛ, ehe tseee gbii kpawo, tamɔ bɔ ni ehe tseee yɛ eyei aniifeemɔ be mli lɛ.

english_verse: Her son must be circumcised on the eighth day,
translation_verse: Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, afo gbekɛ lɛ ketia.

english_verse: Any woman who gives birth to a daughter is unclean for two weeks, just as she is during her period. And she won't be completely clean for another
translation_verse: “Kɛ yoo ko fɔ biyoo lɛ, ehe tseee otsii enyɔ, tamɔ be ni efee yeianii lɛ. Eŋɔ gbii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ekpaa sɔŋŋ ni ekɛtsuu ehe, ni ekɛjie ehe lá muji lɛ.

english_verse: When the mother has completed her time of cleansing, she must come to the front of the sacred tent and bring to the priest a year-old lamb as a sacrifice to please me and a dove or a pigeon as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: “Kɛji gbii ni ekɛtsuɔ ehe lɛ, yɛ binuu loo biyoo hewɔ lɛ ho lɛ, ekɛ too gwantɛŋ bi ni eye afi aba abahã ni akɛshã shãa afɔle, kɛ shĩa okpo loo kosɛɛ okpo ni akɛshã esha afɔle. Ekɛba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa ekɛbahã osɔfo lɛ.

english_verse: After the priest offers the sacrifices to me, the mother will become completely clean from her loss of blood, whether her child is a boy or a girl.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ kɛ afɔle lɛ aba Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ni ekpãtã ehã yoo lɛ, koni ehe atse yɛ lá ni hoɔ lɛ lɛ gbɛfaŋ. Enɛ ji mla ni kã shi hã yoo ni fɔɔ nuu loo yoo lɛ.

english_verse: If she cannot afford a lamb, she can offer two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice to please me and the other as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: “Shi kɛji yoo lɛ naaa too gwantɛŋbi yinii lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo shĩa okpoi enyɔ aba. Akɛ ekome ashã shãa afɔle, koni akɛ ekome hu ashã esha afɔle. Osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ, ni ehe aaatse yɛ lá ni hoɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ mlai nɛɛ hã Mose kɛ Aaron.

english_verse: If sores or boils or a skin rash should break out and start spreading on your body, you must be brought to Aaron or to one of the other priests.
translation_verse: “Kɛji nɔ ko fũu yɛ mɔ ko hewolo nɔ loo fala ko loo gbɛ̃ ko, ni fee sɛɛ lɛ elɛɛ shi, ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ kpiti hela lɛ, akɛ mɔ lɛ aba Osɔfo Aaron loo ebihii osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ŋɔɔ.

english_verse: If the priest discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ he ni hela lɛ yɔɔ lɛ. Kɛ ekwɛ ni tsɔi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ etsɔ̃ eyɛŋ, ni jɛi enyɔ mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle he ni hela lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, belɛ kpiti ni; ni be ni osɔfo lɛ ekwɛ helatsɛ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tseee.

english_verse: But if the infected area is white and only skin deep, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, the priest will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji hewolo nɔ he ni akwɛ lɛ yɛ eyɛŋ ni enyɔko mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle he lɛ, ni emli tsɔi lɛ hu tsɔ̃ko eyɛŋ lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ aŋa helatsɛ lɛ yi gbii kpawo.

english_verse: If the disease hasn't spread by that time, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ osɔfo lɛ akwɛ, ni kɛ hela lɛ yɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ yɛ heloo lɛ hiɛ, ni elɛɛko yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ asaa aŋa eyi gbii kpawo ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: Then if the disease hasn't become any worse or spread, the priest will say, “You are clean. It is only a sore. After you wash your clothes, you may go home.”
translation_verse: Kɛji gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ osɔfo lɛ kwɛ ekoŋŋ, ni kɛ hela lɛ elaaje, ni elɛɛko yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ aŋɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ akɛ mɔ ko ni he tse; hela lɛ gbɛ̃i ni. Helatsɛ lɛ afɔ etadei ahe, koni ehe atse.

english_verse: If it is discovered that the disease has started spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Kɛ osɔfo lɛ kwɛ, ni gbɛ̃i lɛ miilɛɛ yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ mɔ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ kpiti ni.

english_verse: Any of you with a skin disease must be brought to a priest.
translation_verse: “Kɛji kpiti shwie mɔ ko he lɛ, akɛ lɛ aba osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ.

english_verse: If he discovers that the sore spot is white with pus and that the hair around it has also turned white,
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ lɛ. Kɛ nɔ ko yɛŋ ewo yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ, ni ehã jɛi tsɔi lɛ etsɔ̃ eyɛŋ, ni loo ŋmɔŋ tɔ̃ɔ yɛ nɔ ni efuu lɛ mli lɛ,

english_verse: he will say, “This is leprosy. You are unclean and must stay away from everyone else.”
translation_verse: belɛ kpiti momo yɔɔ ehewolo lɛ mli lɛ. Osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ nɔ ko ni he tseee ni. Osɔfo lɛ akaŋa eyi, ejaakɛ ekã shi faŋŋ akɛ ehe tseee.

english_verse: But if the disease has run its course and only the scars remain, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: osɔfo lɛ akwɛ helatsɛ lɛ; ni kɛ ena akɛ hela lɛ eha ehewolo nɔ fɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tse. Ni kɛ helatsɛ lɛ he fɛɛ eyɛ futaa lɛ, ehe tse.

english_verse: If the sores come back and turn white again, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ helatsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ; ni kɛ ena lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ kpiti ni.

english_verse: However, if the sores heal and only white spots remain, the priest will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ. Kɛ ena akɛ loo ŋmɔŋ lɛ etsɔ̃ eyɛŋ lɛ, helatsɛ lɛ he tse; ni osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ ehe tse.

english_verse: If you have a sore that either swells or turns reddish-white after it has healed, then you must show it to a priest.
translation_verse: ni fee sɛɛ lɛ nɔ ko yɛŋ bawo yɛ he ni asane lɛ tsɛ̃ lɛ yɛ lɛ, aloo nɔ ko yɛŋ ni tsuɔo ba jɛi lɛ, no lɛ mɔ lɛ aya osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ.

english_verse: If he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ lɛ. Kɛji he ni hela lɛ yɔɔ lɛ enyɔ mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle jɛi lɛ, ni emli tsɔi lɛ etsɔ̃ eyɛŋ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ ehe tseee; kpiti ebote asane lɛ mli.

english_verse: But if the white area is only on the surface of the skin and hasn't become any worse, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji osɔfo lɛ kwɛ, ni ena akɛ tsɔi yɛŋ bɛ mli, ni jɛi enyɔko mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, ni enaa miilaaje lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ aŋa helatsɛ lɛ yi gbii kpawo.

english_verse: If the sore begins spreading during this time, the priest will say, “You are unclean because you have a disease.”
translation_verse: Kɛji hela lɛ miilɛɛ shi fe bɔ ni kulɛ eyɔɔ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ kpiti ni.

english_verse: But if it doesn't spread, and only a scar remains, he will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: Shi kɛji nɔ ko yɛŋ lɛ elɛɛɛ shi, ni eyɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ fladoku ni; asane lɛ shishi ni. Osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tse.

english_verse: If you have a burn that gets infected and turns red or reddish-white,
translation_verse: “Kɛji la shã mɔ ko, ni la fala lɛ fee nɔ ko yɛŋ aloo nɔ ko yɛŋ ni etsuru fioo futu mli lɛ,

english_verse: a priest must examine it. Then if he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “The burn has turned into leprosy, and you are unclean.”
translation_verse: osɔfo lɛ akwɛ mɔ lɛ. Kɛji tsɔi ni yɔɔ la fala lɛ mli etsɔ̃ eyɛŋ, ni jɛi enyɔ mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, belɛ kpiti ebote la fala lɛ mli. Osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ kpiti ni.

english_verse: But if the priest finds that the hair in the infected area hasn't turned white and that the sore is only skin deep and it is healing, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ osɔfo lɛ kwɛ lɛ, ni ena akɛ tsɔi yɛŋ bɛ fala lɛ mli ni jɛi enyɔko mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ aŋa helatsɛ lɛ yi gbii kpawo.

english_verse: On the seventh day the priest will examine you again, and if the infection is spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ helatsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ. Kɛji fala lɛ elɛɛ yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ fe bɔ ni kulɛ eyɔɔ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ mɔ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ kpiti ni.

english_verse: However, if the infection hasn't spread and has begun to heal, and if only a scar remains, he will say, “Only a scar remains from the burn, and you are clean.”
translation_verse: Shi kɛji he ni hela lɛ yɔɔ lɛ yɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni elɛɛko shi efatako he, shi moŋ enaa miilaaje lɛ, belɛ la fala lɛ kɛkɛ ni ehã jɛi efuu lɛ. Osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tse, ejaakɛ fala doku kɛkɛ ni.

english_verse: If you have a sore on your head or chin,
translation_verse: “Kɛji fala fee nuu loo yoo ko yiteŋ loo etsɛŋ mli lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akwɛ.

english_verse: it must be examined by a priest. If the infection seems more than skin deep, and the hair in it has thinned out and lost its color, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Kɛji he ni fala lɛ yɔɔ lɛ enyɔ mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle jɛi lɛ, ni tsɔi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ yɛ hwiaahwiaa ni ehiɛ wuɔfɔ su lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ mɔ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ fafale ni; efeɔ yiteŋ loo tsɛŋ mli.

english_verse: On the other hand, if he discovers that the itchy spot is only skin deep, but that the hair still isn't healthy, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Kɛji be ni osɔfo lɛ kwɛ helatsɛ lɛ ena akɛ he ni fafale lɛ yɔɔ lɛ enyɔko mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ tsɔi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ bɛ ediŋ lɛ, eŋa helatsɛ lɛ yi ewo tsuŋ gbii kpawo.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread, if the hair seems healthy, and if the itch is only skin deep,
translation_verse: Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ osɔfo lɛ asaa akwɛ fafale lɛ ekoŋŋ. Kɛji fafale lɛ elɛko, ni tsɔi ni hiɛ wuɔfɔ su ekwɛ̃ko yɛ mli, ni fala lɛ enyɔko hewolo lɛ mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ,

english_verse: you must shave off the hair around the infection, but not those on it. Then the priest will tell you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: ahã mɔ lɛ ashɛ ehe tsɔi fɛɛ fe he ni fafale lɛ yɔɔ pɛ eshi. Osɔfo lɛ aŋa mɔ lɛ yi awo tsuŋ gbii krokomɛi kpawo.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread and seems no more than skin deep, he will say, “You are clean; now you must wash your clothes.”
translation_verse: Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akwɛ fafale lɛ ekoŋŋ. Kɛji elɛɛko ni enyɔko mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ mɔ lɛ he tse. Mɔ lɛ afɔ etadei ahe koni ehe atse.

english_verse: Later, if the itch starts spreading, even though the hair is still healthy, the priest will say, “You are unclean.”
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ helatsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ. Kɛji fafale lɛ esaa elɛɛ lɛ, ehe ehiaaa akɛ osɔfo lɛ akwɛ akɛ eeena tsɔi ni hiɛ wuɔfɔ su lo; nɔ ni kã shi faŋŋ kɛkɛ ji mɔ lɛ he tseee.

english_verse: If white spots break out on your skin,
translation_verse: “Kɛji nii yɛji hãlãhãlã komɛi ba nuu loo yoo ko hewolo nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: but the priest discovers that it is only a rash, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: osɔfo lɛ akwɛ. Kɛji nibii yɛji hãlãhãlã nɛɛ ejeee shi jogbaŋŋ yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ lɛ, belɛ aflimata eshwie mɔ lɛ hewolo nɔ lɛ; mɔ lɛ he tse.

english_verse: If you become bald on any part of your head, you are still clean.
translation_verse: Kɛji ehiɛnaa gbɛ kɛkɛ eyi lɛ kpa yɛ lɛ, hiɛnaa kpataa tsɛ ji lɛ, shi ehe tse.

english_verse: But if a priest discovers that a reddish-white sore has broken out on the bald spot and looks like leprosy, he will say,
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ mɔ lɛ. Kɛji osɔfo lɛ na fafale yɛŋ ni tsuɔ oo yɛ eyisɛɛ loo ehiɛnaa he ni ekpa lɛ, ni etamɔ kpiti yɛ hewolo nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: If you ever have leprosy, you must tear your clothes, leave your hair uncombed, cover the lower part of your face, and go around shouting, “I'm unclean! I'm unclean!”
translation_verse: “Mɔ ni yeɔ kpiti lɛ egbala etadei, ni ehiɛ eyitso efolo. Eha enaabu nɔ, ni ebolɔ akɛ, ‘Mihe tseee, mihe tseee!’

english_verse: As long as you have the disease, you are unclean and must live alone outside the camp.
translation_verse: Gbii abɔ ni hela lɛ yɔɔ ehe lɛ, ehe tseee kwraa. Ekome too ehi shi, ni eshihilɛhe lɛ ahi shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.

english_verse: If a greenish or reddish spot appears anywhere on any of your clothing or on anything made of leather, you must let the priest examine the clothing or the leather. He will put it aside for seven days,
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ nɔ ni ekadi mli lɛ, ni ekɛ nɔ ni mli ni ekadi lɛ ato gbii kpawo.

english_verse: he will tell you to wash the clothing or leather and put it aside for another seven days,
translation_verse: no lɛ osɔfo lɛ afã akɛ afɔ nɔ ni kpiti lɛ ekadi mli lɛ he, ni esaa eŋa eyi gbii kpawo ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: after which he will examine it again. If the spot hasn't spread, but is still greenish or reddish, the clothing or leather is unclean and must be burned.
translation_verse: Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ osɔfo lɛ akwɛ; ni kɛ ena akɛ kadimɔ lɛ su tsakeko be ni afɔ he sɛɛ, ni elɛko hu efatako he lɛ, belɛ nɔ ni kpiti lɛ ekadi mli lɛ he tseee. Akɛ la ashã; hiɛgbɛ ekadi jio, sɛɛgbɛ jio, no kɔɔɔ he eko.

english_verse: Even if the spot completely disappears after being washed, it must be washed again before it is clean.
translation_verse: Atade lɛ loo kpãi ni akɛlo lɛ loo kooloo wolo nɔ lɛ ni afɔ he lɛ, kɛ nɔ ni ekadi mli lɛ je mli lɛ, afɔ he ekoŋŋ koni ehe atse.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛ mlai ni abaatsi tã nɛɛ hã lɛ.

english_verse: he will order someone to bring out two live birds that are acceptable for sacrifice, together with a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: osɔfo lɛ afã mɔ ni abaatsuu ehe lɛ koni ekɛ loofɔji hiɛkãalɔi enyɔ ni he tse kɛ tsenedru tso kɛ kpãa tsuru kɛ hisopo aba.

english_verse: The priest will order someone to kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ afã ni agbe loofɔji lɛ ateŋ ekome yɛ kã ni nu ŋmɔŋ yɔɔ mli nɔ.

english_verse: Then he will dip the other bird, the cedar, the red yarn, and the hyssop in the blood of the dead bird.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ amɔ loofɔlɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ. Ekɛ tsenedru tso lɛ kɛ kpãa tsuru lɛ kɛ hisopo lɛ afata he ni ekɛ fɛɛ atsɔ loofɔlɔ ni agbe lɛ yɛ kã ni nu yɔɔ mli lɛ lá lɛ mli.

english_verse: Next, he will sprinkle you seven times with the blood and say, “You are now clean.” Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away.
translation_verse: Etsɔ la lɛ eshwã kpitiyelɔ ni abaatsuu ehe lɛ nɔ shii kpawo koni ekɛtsuu ehe. Eŋmɛɛ loofɔlɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ he ni eya ŋa lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: After this you must wash your clothes, shave your entire body, and take a bath before you are completely clean. You may move back into camp, but you must not enter your tent for seven days.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni atsuɔ ehe lɛ afɔ etadei lɛ ahe. Eshɛ eyiteŋ tsɔi fɛɛ, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe koni ehe atse. No sɛɛ lɛ, eba shitoohe lɛ mli, shi ekabote ebuu lɛ mli gbii kpawo.

english_verse: Then you must once again shave your head, face, and eyebrows, as well as the hair on the rest of your body. Finally, wash your clothes and take a bath, and you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ esaa eshɛ eyiteŋ tsɔi ekoŋŋ kɛ etsɛŋ kɛ ehiŋmɛi sɛɛ tsɔi kɛ ehe tsɔi fɛɛ. Efɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; kɛkɛ lɛ ehe baatse.

english_verse: On the eighth day you must bring to the priest two rams and a year-old female lamb that have nothing wrong with them; also bring
translation_verse: Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ mɔ ni atsuɔ ehe lɛ kɛ gwantɛŋbii enyɔ ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe kɛ gwantɛŋ yoo kome ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe kɛ ŋmãa mamu kiloi etɛ̃ ni akɛ mu ewo mli kɛ mu lita mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome aba.

english_verse: Then the priest will present you and your offerings to me at the entrance to my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Osɔfo ni tsuuɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ he lɛ aŋɔ lɛ kɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ kɛba Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu shinaa lɛ naa.

english_verse: There he will offer one of the rams, together with the oil, as a sacrifice to make things right. He will also lift them up to show that they are dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Emɔ gwantɛŋbii lɛ ateŋ ekome ekɛbahã akɛ sɔ̃ afɔle kɛ mu lita mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ hu, koni ekɛba Yehowa hiɛ akɛ keenii titri ko.

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy. It belongs to the priest and must be killed in the same place where animals are killed as sacrifices for sins and as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Egbe gwantɛŋbi lɛ yɛ he ni agbeɔ esha afɔle kɛ shãa afɔle lɛ yɛ lɛ, yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ jio, esha afɔle lɛ jio, fɛɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ nɔ ni; eji nɔ ko krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa.

english_verse: The priest will smear some of the blood from this sacrifice on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ osɔfo lɛ kɛ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ lá lɛ eko asa mɔ ni atsuɔ ehe lɛ ninejurɔ toi naa kɛ eninejurɔ gɔnti naa, kɛ enanejurɔ gɔnti naa.

english_verse: He will then pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ awo mu lɛ ni efo eko ewo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enine abɛku kɔkɔ mli.

english_verse: dip a finger of his right hand into the oil, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ekɛ eninejurɔ wao atsɔ mu ni yɔɔ ebɛku lɛ mli lɛ eko eshwã shii kpawo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: Next, the priest will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot,
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ kɛ mu ni eshwɛ yɛ edɛŋ lɛ eko asa mɔ ni atsuɔ ehe lɛ ninejurɔ toi naa kɛ eninejurɔ gɔnti naa kɛ enanejurɔ gɔnti naa he ni akɛ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ lá lɛ sa lɛ.

english_verse: and he will pour the rest of the oil from his palm on your head. Then he will offer the other two animals—one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, together with a grain sacrifice. After this you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: no sɛɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ ashã shãa afɔle kɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, koni ekɛtsuu mɔ lɛ he; kɛkɛ lɛ ehe baatse.

english_verse: If you are poor and cannot afford to offer this much, you may offer a ram as a sacrifice to make things right, together with
translation_verse: Shi kɛ eji ohiafo ni enaaa enɛɛmɛi lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ gwantɛŋbi kome aba akɛ sɔ̃ afɔle, keenii titri ko ni akɛkpãtã ahã lɛ ni. Ekɛ ŋmãa mamu kilo kome ni awo mli mu hu aba akɛ niyenii afɔle, kɛ mu lita mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome.

english_verse: Depending on what you can afford, you must also offer either two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Asaŋ ekɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo shĩa okpoi bibii enyɔ aba; emli eko fɛɛ eko ni enine aaashɛ nɔ. Akɛ ekome afee esha afɔle, ni akɛ ekome hu afee shãa afɔle.

english_verse: The priest will offer these to me in front of the sacred tent on the eighth day.
translation_verse: Ehetsuumɔ gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ekɛ nibii nɛɛ aba abahã osɔfo lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: The priest will kill this ram for the sacrifice to make things right, and he will lift it up with the olive oil in dedication to me. Then he will smear some of the blood on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ agbe gwantɛŋbi ni akɛshãa sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ. Ekɛ toobi lɛ lá lɛ eko asa mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ ninejurɔ toi naa kɛ eninejurɔ gɔnti naa kɛ enanejurɔ gɔnti naa.

english_verse: The priest will pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ afo mu lɛ eko awo enine abɛku kɔkɔ mli.

english_verse: then dip a finger of his right hand in the oil and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ekɛ eninejurɔ wao atsɔ mu ni yɔɔ ebɛku lɛ eko eshwã shii kpawo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: He will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot, just as he did with the blood of the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ kɛ mu ni yɔɔ edɛŋ lɛ eko asa mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ ninejurɔ toi naa, kɛ eninejurɔ gɔnti naa, kɛ enanejurɔ gɔnti naa, eko fɛɛ eko lɛ akɛsa he ni lá ni akɛshã sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: And he will pour the rest of the oil from his palm on your head. Then, depending on what you can afford, he will offer either the doves or the pigeons together with the grain sacrifice. One of the birds is the sacrifice for sin, and the other is the sacrifice to please me. After this you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: osɔfo lɛ kɛ ekome afee esha afɔle, ni ekɛ ekome hu afee shãa afɔle efata niyenii afɔle lɛ he. Efee enɛ ni ekɛkpãtã ehã mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you have leprosy and cannot afford the usual sacrifices to make you clean. When There Is Mildew in a House
translation_verse: Enɛ ji mla ni kã shi hã mɔ ni yeɔ kpiti ni enine shɛɛɛ nii ni akɛbaatsuu ehe lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ. Kpiti yɛ shĩai amli

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ mlai ni abaatsi tã nɛɛ hã Mose kɛ Aaron.

english_verse: After I have given you the land of Canaan as your permanent possession, here is what you must do, if I ever put mildew on the walls of any of your homes.
translation_verse: Kɛ nyɛshɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mi diɛŋtsɛ mikɛhã nyɛ ni nyɛye nɔ lɛ nɔ, ni mihã kpiti shwie shĩa ko he yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: First, you must say to a priest, “I think there is mildew on the wall of my house.”
translation_verse: no lɛ nakai shĩa lɛ tsɛ lɛ aya ni eyakɛɛ osɔfo lɛ akɛ etamɔ nɔ ni nɔ ko tamɔ kpiti eshwie eshĩa lɛ he.

english_verse: If the priest discovers greenish or reddish spots that go deeper than the surface of the walls,
translation_verse: Kɛ osɔfo lɛ yakwɛ, ni ena akɛ nɔ ni eshwie shĩa lɛ gbogboi lɛ ahe lɛ, fɔji ŋɔlii kɛ etsuji ni, ni amɛmiikpe kɛmiibote gbogboi lɛ amli lɛ,

english_verse: he will have the house closed for seven days.
translation_verse: no lɛ eje kpo ni eŋmɛ agbo lɛ mli kɛyashi gbii kpawo.

english_verse: Then he will return and check to see if the mildew has spread.
translation_verse: Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ osɔfo lɛ aba ekoŋŋ. Kɛji ekwɛ, ni ena akɛ fɔji lɛ elɛɛlɛɛ yɛ gbogboi lɛ ahe lɛ,

english_verse: If so, he will order someone to scrape the plaster from the walls, remove the stones covered with mildew, then haul everything off and dump it in an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: No sɛɛ lɛ, aŋmala shĩa lɛ mligbɛ gbogboi lɛ fɛɛ he kɛ kpe, ni akɛ su ni aŋmala lɛ ayashwie maŋ lɛ sɛɛ yɛ he ko ni tseee.

english_verse: Afterwards the wall must be repaired with new stones and fresh plaster.
translation_verse: Akɛ tɛi krokomɛi ahɔlɔ tɛi ni afamɔ lɛ anajiaŋ, ni akɛ su hee ama gbogboi lɛ ahe.

english_verse: Then he will have the house torn down and every bit of wood, stone, and plaster hauled off to an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: Akumɔ shĩa lɛ ashwie shi, etɛi lɛ kɛ mplaŋi lɛ kɛ shĩa lɛ sũ lɛ fɛɛ, ni aloo kɛje maŋ lɛ mli kɛyashwie he ko ni tseee.

english_verse: Meanwhile, if any of you entered the house while it was closed, you will be unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni boteɔ shĩa lɛ mli be mli ni ala agbo lɛ mli lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ;

english_verse: And if you either slept or ate in the house, you must wash your clothes.
translation_verse: ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaawɔ shĩa lɛ afɔ etadei ahe; ni mɔ ni aaaye nii yɛ shĩa lɛ afɔ etadei ahe.

english_verse: On the other hand, if the priest discovers that mildew hasn't reappeared after the house was newly plastered, he will say, “This house is clean—the mildew has gone.”
translation_verse: Shi kɛji osɔfo lɛ ba shĩa lɛ ni ebakwɛ, ni ena akɛ nɔ ni shwie he lɛ ekuko esɛɛ eshwieko shĩa lɛ he kɛjɛ be ni ama shĩa lɛ he ekoŋŋ nɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, shĩa lɛ he tse, ejaakɛ nɔ ni shwie he lɛ etã kwraa.

english_verse: Then, to show that the house is now clean, he will get two birds, a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant and bring them to the house.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ kɛ loofɔji enyɔ kɛ tsenedru tso kɛ kpãa tsuru kɛ hisopo ashã esha afɔle kɛjwira shĩa lɛ.

english_verse: He will kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water
translation_verse: Egbe loofɔji lɛ ateŋ ekome yɛ kã ni nuhiŋmɛi ni hoɔ mli nu yɔɔ mli lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: and let its blood drain into the pot. Then he will dip the cedar, the hyssop, the yarn, and the other bird into the mixture of blood and water. Next, he will sprinkle the house seven times with the mixture, then the house will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Kɛ efee nɛkɛ lɛ, belɛ ekɛ loofɔlɔ lɛ lá lɛ kɛ nuhiŋmɛi ni hoɔ lɛ mli nu lɛ kɛ loofɔlɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ kɛ tsenedru tso lɛ kɛ hisopo lɛ kɛ kpãa tsuru lɛ ejwra shĩa lɛ.

english_verse: Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away, ending the ceremony for purifying the house.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ eŋmɛɛ loofɔlɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ he, yɛ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa, koni efiliki kɛya ŋa lɛ nɔ. Gbɛ nɔ ni osɔfo lɛ atsɔ kɛkpãtã ehã shĩa lɛ nɛ, koni shĩa lɛ he atse.

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you discover that you are unclean because of an itch or a sore, or that your clothing or house is unclean because of mildew.
translation_verse: Eji mla ni akɛnaa nɔ ni he tseee kɛ nɔ ni he tse; hela ni tamɔ kpiti kɛ ehenɔi ahe mla nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ mlai ni abaatsi tã nɛɛ hã Mose kɛ Aaron

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Any man with an infected penis is unclean,
translation_verse: ni amɛkɛhã Israelbii lɛ. Kɛji nu miiho yɛ nuu ko nuutso mli lɛ, nu ni hoɔ lɛ he tseee.

english_verse: and if you touch either these or him, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni taa mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ he lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.

english_verse: If you are spit on by the man, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ tsɛ̃ lajɔ̃ eshwie mɔ ni he tse he lɛ, mɔ ni atsɛ̃ lajɔ̃ ashwie ehe lɛ afɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.

english_verse: Any saddle or seat on which the man sits is unclean. And if you touch or carry either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa nɔ ko ni mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ eta nɔ lɛ he lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni woɔ nɔ ko ni tamɔ nakai lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.

english_verse: If the man touches you without first washing his hands, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mɔ ni he hoɔ nu ni efɔko edɛ aaata ehe lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.

english_verse: Any clay pot that he touches must be destroyed, and any wooden bowl that he touches must be washed.
translation_verse: Sũ nii ni mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ aaata he lɛ, ajwa; ni tso nii fɛɛ tso nii ni eeeta he lɛ, akɛ nu afɔ mli.

english_verse: Seven days after the man gets well, he will be considered clean, if he washes his clothes and takes a bath in spring water.
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ hela lɛ tã lɛ, emɛ gbii kpawo. Efɔ etadei ahe ni ekɛ nuhiŋmɛi ni hoɔ mli nu aju ehe; kɛkɛ lɛ ehe baatse.

english_verse: On the eighth day he must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ ekɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo shĩa okpoi enyɔ aya Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa ni ekɛyahã osɔfo lɛ.

english_verse: The priest will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, then I will consider the man completely clean.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ kɛ ekome afee esha afɔle ni ekɛ ekome hu afee shãa afɔle, koni ekpãtã ehã lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ nu ni hoɔ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Any man who has a flow of semen must take a bath, but he still remains unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Kɛji nuu ko shwie ehe shi lɛ, ekɛ nu aju ehe fɛɛ; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.

english_verse: If the semen touches anything made of cloth or leather, these must be washed, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Mama fɛɛ mama kɛ kooloo wolo fɛɛ kooloo wolo ni nu nɛɛ eko aaatee mli lɛ akɛ nu afɔ he; ni ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.

english_verse: After having sex, both the man and the woman must take a bath, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Kɛji nuu ko kɛ yoo ko wɔ, ni nuu lɛ henu je emli lɛ, amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛ nu aju amɛhe; amɛhe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.

english_verse: When a woman has her monthly period, she remains unclean for seven days, and if you touch her, you must take a bath, but you remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Kɛji yoo ko fee yeianii ni ehe miiho lá lɛ, ehe tseee gbii kpawo. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa ehe lɛ he tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on is also unclean, and if you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ko ta nɔ ko ni yɔɔ yoo lɛ saa nɔ loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eta nɔ lɛ he lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.

english_verse: Any man who has sex with her during this time becomes unclean for seven days, and anything he rests on is also unclean.
translation_verse: Kɛji nuu ko kɛ yoo lɛ na bɔlɛ ni lá ni hoɔ yɛ yoo lɛ he lɛ eko tee ehe lɛ, no lɛ ehe tseee gbii kpawo, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ekã nɔ lɛ he tseee.

english_verse: Any woman who has a flow of blood outside her regular monthly period is unclean until it stops, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: Kɛji yoo ko he ho lá gbii pii be ni eshɛko etsuiasɛɛyaa be lɛ, aloo ehe ho lá yɛ etsuiasɛɛyaa be lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni ehe hoɔ la lɛ ehe tseee, tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ etsuiasɛɛyaa gbii lɛ amli lɛ pɛ.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on during this time is also unclean, just as it would be during her period.
translation_verse: Saa fɛɛ saa ni ekã nɔ gbii abɔ ni ehe hoɔ lá lɛ tamɔ etsuiasɛɛyaa saa lɛ pɛ. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eta nɔ lɛ he tseee tamɔ bɔ ni ehe tseee yɛ etsuiasɛɛyaa be lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: If you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa nibii nɛɛ eko he lɛ, ehe tseee. Efɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.

english_verse: Seven days after the woman gets well, she will be considered clean.
translation_verse: Kɛji lá ni hoɔ yɛ yoo lɛ he lɛ sɛɛ fo lɛ, ekane gbii kpawo ehã ehe; no sɛɛ lɛ ehe aaatse.

english_verse: On the eighth day, she must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ ekɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo shĩa okpoi bibii enyɔ aba abahã osɔfo lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me; then I will consider the woman completely clean.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ kɛ okpoi lɛ ateŋ ekome afee esha afɔle, ni ekɛ ekome hu afee shãa afɔle ni ekɛkpãtã ehã lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ ni ehe aaatse.

english_verse: When any of you are unclean, you must stay away from the rest of the community of Israel. Otherwise, my sacred tent will become unclean, and the whole nation will die.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose koni ebɔ Israelbii lɛ kɔkɔ yɛ amɛhe ni tseee lɛ hewɔ koni amɛkabule miKpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ ni amɛbagboi.

english_verse: Two of Aaron's sons had already lost their lives for disobeying the Lord, so the Lord told Moses to say to Aaron: I, the Lord, appear in a cloud over the place of mercy on the sacred chest, which is behind the inside curtain of the sacred tent. And I warn you not to go there except at the proper time. Otherwise, you will die!
translation_verse: “Okɛ onyɛmi Aaron awie koni ekabote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli kɛmiiya muhɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ, yɛ mɔbɔnalɛ sɛi ni bu Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ nɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, be fɛɛ be kɛkɛ, koni ekagbo, ejaakɛ mapue yɛ atatu mli yɛ naanɔ ni bu Adeka lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Before entering this most holy place, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for your sins and a ram as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Nii ni Aaron kɛbote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɛ: tsinanuu oblanyo ni akɛfee esha afɔle kɛ ojwɛni ni akɛfee shãa afɔle.

english_verse: You will take a bath and put on the sacred linen clothes, including the underwear, the robe, the sash, and the turban.
translation_verse: “Aaron kɛ nu aju ehe, ni ewo klala flaka krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ klala tswakotoi lɛ. Ekɛ klala mlifiinii lɛ afi emli, ni ekɛ klala tɔɔbaŋ afi eyitso. Atadei ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Then the community of Israel will bring you a ram and two goats, both of them males. The goats are to be used as sacrifices for sin, and the ram is to be used as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Israel asafo ku lɛ ahã Aaron too kpakpoi enyɔ ni akɛbaashã esha afɔle, kɛ ojwɛni kome ni akɛbaafee eshãa afɔle.

english_verse: Aaron, you must offer the bull as a sacrifice of forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: Aaron kɛ tsinanuu ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ lɛ abashã esha afɔle kɛjie lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe eshai kɛ ewe lɛ he eshai.

english_verse: Then you will lead the two goats into my presence at the front of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ ekɛ too kpakpoi enyɔ lɛ abadamɔ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.

english_verse: After you offer the first goat as a sacrifice for sin,
translation_verse: Aaron kɛ too kpakpo ni Yehowa oshiki lɛ gbee enɔ lɛ aba ni ekɛbashã esha afɔle.

english_verse: the other one must be presented to me alive, before you send it into the desert to take away the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Shi too kpakpo ni Azazel oshiki lɛ gbee enɔ lɛ, ekɛ lɛ abadamɔ Yehowa hiɛ ni kooloo lɛ hiɛ kã. Eŋmɛɛ kooloo lɛ he ehã Azazel yɛ ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ koni ewo maŋ lɛ he eshai lɛ kɛya.

english_verse: You must offer the bull as a sacrifice to ask forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: “Aaron kɛ etsinanuu lɛ aba akɛ esha afɔle ahã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kɛ ewe lɛ, ni egbe.

english_verse: Then you will take a fire pan of live coals from the bronze altar, together with two handfuls of finely ground incense, into the most holy place.
translation_verse: Eloo ŋai kɛ la ŋɛsu obɔ̃ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, kɛ tsofakɛŋma ni ashi bɔdɔbɔdɔ ekɔkɔi obɔbɔi enyɔ, ni ekɛbote muhɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ.

english_verse: There you will present them to me by placing the incense on the coals, so that the place of mercy will be covered with a cloud of smoke. Do this, or you will die right there!
translation_verse: Ekɛ ohɛ lɛ ashwie la lɛ nɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ jɛi, ni ohɛ lɛ he lasu kumɔŋŋ lɛ baaha mɔbɔnalɛ sɛi lɛ ni bu Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ nɔ lɛ he, koni Aaron akana ni egbo.

english_verse: Next, use a finger to sprinkle some of the blood on the place of mercy, which is on the lid of the sacred chest; then sprinkle blood seven times in front of the chest.
translation_verse: Ekɛ ewao atsɔ tsinanuu lɛ lá lɛ eko koni ekɛshwã mɔbɔnalɛ sɛi lɛ hiɛgbɛ; ni ekɛ ewao atsɔ lá lɛ eko hu ni ekɛshwã Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ shii kpawo.

english_verse: Aaron, you must next sacrifice the goat for the sins of the people, and you must sprinkle its blood inside the most holy place, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
translation_verse: “No sɛɛ lɛ, egbe too kpakpo ni ji maŋ lɛ nɔ ni akɛbaashã esha afɔle lɛ. Ekɛ lá lɛ abote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ lɛ mli, ni etsɔ eko eshwã mɔbɔnalɛ sɛi lɛ hiɛgbɛ kɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛgbɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛ tsina lá lɛ fee lɛ.

english_verse: By doing this, you will take away the sins that make both the most holy place and the people of Israel unclean. Do the same for the sacred tent, which is here among the people.
translation_verse: Ni akɛjwira He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe ni tseee kɛ amɛtũatsemɔi kɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ. Aaron afee nakai nɔŋŋ ehã Kpee Buu lɛ ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ; efee yɛ amɛmuji nii lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: After leaving the tent, you will purify the bronze altar by smearing each of its four corners with some of the blood from the bull and from the goat.
translation_verse: No sɛɛ lɛ, eje kpo kɛya afɔleshãa latɛ ni ma Yehowa hiɛ lɛ he, ni etsuu he. Ekɛ tsinanuu lɛ lá lɛ eko kɛ too kpakpo lɛ lá lɛ eko asra koji ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he lɛ ahe kɛkpe.

english_verse: Use a finger to sprinkle the altar seven times with the blood, and it will be completely clean from the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Ekɛ ewao atsɔ lá lɛ eko eshwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ shii kpawo koni ekɛtsuu he efee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe eshai lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: After you have purified the most holy place, the sacred tent, and the bronze altar, you must bring the live goat to the front of the tent.
translation_verse: “Kɛ Aaron egbe He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ jwiramɔ lɛ naa lɛ, ekɛ too kpakpo ni hiɛ kã lɛ aba.

english_verse: There you will lay your hands on its head, while confessing every sin the people have committed, and you will appoint someone to lead the goat into the desert, so that it can take away their sins.
translation_verse: Ekɛ eniji enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ ashwie too kpakpo ni hiɛ kã lɛ yiteŋ, ni ejaje Israelbii lɛ atɔ̃mɔi kɛ amɛmla tɔ̃mɔi ni ji amɛhe eshai lɛ fɛɛ eshwie too kpakpo lɛ yiteŋ. Etu lɛ ewo nuu ko ni mɛɔ yɛ jɛi lɛ dɛŋ koni eyaŋmɛɛ ehe ni eya ŋa lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Finally, this goat that carries the heavy burden of Israel's sins must be released deep in the desert.
translation_verse: Too kpakpo lɛ baatere amɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛya ŋa nɔ he ko kplanaa ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ, ni jɛi nuu lɛ aŋmɛɛ ehe yɛ.

english_verse: Aaron, after this you must go inside the sacred tent, take a bath, put on your regular priestly clothes, and leave there the clothes you put on before entering the most holy place. Then you will come out and offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices for your sins and for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Eju ehe kɛ nu yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni ekɔlɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etadei lɛ. Eje kpo ni eyashã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshãa afɔle lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ shãa afɔle kooloo lɛ koni ekɛkpãtã ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kɛ maŋ lɛ hu.

english_verse: The fat from these sacrifices for sin must be sent up in smoke on the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Eshã fɔ ni yɔɔ esha afɔle lɛ he lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The one who led the goat into the desert and sent it off to the demon Azazel must take a bath and wash his clothes before coming back into camp.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ mɔ ni kɛ too kpakpo lɛ tee eya ŋmɛɛ ehe ehã Azazel lɛ afɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe dani eba nsra lɛ mli.

english_verse: The remains of the bull and the goat whose blood was taken into the most holy place must be taken outside the camp and burned.
translation_verse: Akɛ tsinanuu lɛ kɛ too kpakpo lɛ ni akɛshã esha afɔle lɛ ni akɛ amɛlá lɛ tee He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli ni akɛyakpãtã lɛ, aje nsra lɛ mli ni akɛ la ayashã. Ashã amɛloo kɛ amɛhewoji kɛ amɛwamɔ lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: And whoever does this must take a bath and change clothes before coming back into camp. The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yashã lɛ afɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; no sɛɛ fɛɛ dani eba shitoohe lɛ mli.” Kpãtãmɔ gbi wulu lɛ

english_verse: On the tenth day of the seventh month of each year, you must go without eating to show sorrow for your sins, and no one, including foreigners who live among you, is allowed to work.
translation_verse: “Enɛ afee akpɔ ahã nyɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ. Nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛgbea nyɛhe hɔmɔ. Nyɛkatsua nitsumɔ ko, nyɛmaŋ lɛ mli bii jio, gbɔ ni ebato nyɛ jio.

english_verse: This is the day on which the sacrifice for the forgiveness of your sins will be made in my presence,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nakai gbi lɛ abaakpãtã ahã nyɛ koni akɛtsuu nyɛhe ni akɛhã nyɛhe atse yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: and from now on, it must be celebrated each year. Go without eating and make this a day of complete rest just like the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Hejɔɔmɔ gbi wulu ni hã nyɛ. Nyɛgbea nyɛhe hɔmɔ. Akpɔ ni yɔɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The high priest must offer the sacrifices for cleansing from sin, while wearing the sacred linen clothes.
translation_verse: Kusum ni abaafee kɛkpãtã lɛ, mɔ ni afɔ lɛ mu ni awo lɛ osɔfo koni eye etsɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ewo klala atadei ni ji atadei ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni efee.

english_verse: He will offer these sacrifices for the most holy place, the sacred tent, the bronze altar, all the priests, and for the whole community.
translation_verse: Ejwra He Krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ lɛ kɛ Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ni ekpãtã ehã osɔfoi lɛ kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: You must celebrate this day each year—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness for all the sins of the people of Israel. Moses did exactly as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Enɛ atsɔ̃ akpɔ ni kã shi hã nyɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ, koni akɛkpãtã ahã Israelbii lɛ daa afi shi kome yɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ fɛɛ hewɔ.” Mose fee bɔ ni Yehowa wo lɛ kitã lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa fã Mose,

english_verse: to tell Aaron, his sons, and everyone else in Israel:
translation_verse: koni ekɛ mlai ni abaatsi tã nɛɛ ahã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Whenever you kill any of your cattle, sheep, or goats as sacrifices to me, you must do it at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you don't, you will be guilty of pouring out blood, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: ni ekɛbaaa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa koni akɛshã afɔle ahã Yehowa yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, eye lá yi sɔ̃. Lá efɔse eshwie shi lɛ, ni abuŋ lɛ ashiŋ Yehowa bii anɔ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: And so, when you sacrifice an animal to ask my blessing, it must not be done out in a field,
translation_verse: Mla nɛɛ oti ji akɛ kooloi ni Israelbii lɛ gbeɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ amɛkɛba ni amɛkɛbahã osɔfo lɛ yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa koni amɛgbe amɛkɛshã naanyobɔɔ afɔlei amɛhã Yehowa.

english_verse: but in front of the sacred tent. Then a priest can splatter its blood against the bronze altar and send its fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ atsi lá lɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he, yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, ni eshã fɔ lɛ koni eje ŋma ni Yehowa sumɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Remember! No one in Israel, including foreigners, is to offer a sacrifice anywhere
translation_verse: “Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo loo gbɔ ni ebato Israelbii lɛ ni shãa shãa afɔle loo

english_verse: except at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you do, you will no longer belong to my people. Do Not Eat Blood The Lord said:
translation_verse: afɔle kroko ehãa Yehowa yɛ he kroko ni ekɛbaaa Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ, abuŋ lɛ ashiŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋbii lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: I will turn against any of my people who eat blood. This also includes any foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo loo gbɔ ni ebato Israelbii akaye loo lɛ mli lá, no lɛ majie mihiɛ maka nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ, ni mi kɛ lɛ baafo takoŋ.

english_verse: Even if you should hunt and kill a bird or an animal, you must drain out the blood and cover it with soil.
translation_verse: “Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ebato gbɔ yɛ Israel lɛ, kɛji eyagbɔbi ni egbe kooloo loo loofɔlɔ ni ayeɔ lɛ, efɔse elá lɛ eshwie shi, ni ekɛ sũ atsi nɔ,

english_verse: The life of every living creature is in its blood. That's why I have forbidden you to eat blood and why I have warned you that anyone who does will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ bɔɔ nii fɛɛ ni hiɛ kã lɛ, amɛlá lɛ mli amɛwala yɔɔ; ni no hewɔ ni mikɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛkaye loo ko loo ko lá lɛ. Bɔɔnɔ fɛɛ bɔɔnɔ lɛ elá mli ewala yɔɔ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ lá lɛ abuŋ lɛ ashiŋ Nyɔŋmɔ webii anɔ.

english_verse: If you happen to find a dead animal and eat it, you must take a bath and wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ kooloo ni egbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ gbele aloo kooloo ni kooloo awuyelɔ ko tserɛ emli lɛ, Israelnyo ji lɛ jio, gbɔ ni ebato Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ji lɛ jio, efɔ etadei ahe ni ekɛnu aju ehe; ebaahi shi kɛyashi gbɛkɛ dani ehe baatse.

english_verse: If you don't take a bath, you will suffer for what you did wrong.
translation_verse: Kɛji efɔɔɔ etadei ahe, ni ejuuu ehe lɛ, no lɛ esɔ̃ akã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ,

english_verse: So don't follow the customs of Egypt where you used to live or those of Canaan where I am bringing you.
translation_verse: Nyɛkabaa nyɛjeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni abaa jeŋ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ni nyɛhi tsutsu lɛ. Asaŋ nyɛkabaa nyɛjeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni abaa jeŋ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ ni mikɛ nyɛ yaa nɔ nɛɛ lɛ. Amɛkusum lɛ nyɛkafea.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must obey my teachings.
translation_verse: Nyɛyea mimlai kɛ migbɛjianɔtoi lɛ anɔ be fɛɛ be. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Obey them and you will live. I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛyea migbɛjianɔtoi kɛ mimlai lɛ anɔ; nɔ ni kɛji gbɔmɔ ye nɔ ni enaa wala lɛ. Mi ji Yehowa.

english_verse: Don't have sex with any of your close relatives,
translation_verse: Nuu ko nuu ko akabɛŋkɛ ewekunyo ni ekɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ. Mi ji Yehowa.

english_verse: especially your own mother. This would disgrace your father.
translation_verse: Okɛ onyɛ akawɔ ni okɛshwie otsɛ hiɛ shi; onyɛ ni, kaahã ehiɛ miishwie shi.

english_verse: And don't disgrace him by having sex with any of his other wives.
translation_verse: Okɛ otsɛ ŋa akawɔ; obaashwie otsɛ hiɛ shi.

english_verse: Don't have sex with your sister or stepsister, whether you grew up together or not.
translation_verse: Okɛ onyɛmi yoo ni ji otsɛ loo onyɛ bi akawɔ; alɛ lɛ yɛ nyɛshĩa lɛ mli jio, shĩa kroko mli jio, okɛ lɛ akawɔ.

english_verse: Don't disgrace yourself by having sex with your granddaughter
translation_verse: Okɛ obinuu biyoo loo obiyoo biyoo akawɔ. Eji nɔ ko ni baashwie bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiɛ shi.

english_verse: or a sister of your father or mother.
translation_verse: Okɛ onyɛ nyɛmi yoo akawɔ: onyɛ lá ji lɛ.

english_verse: Don't disgrace your uncle by having sex with his wife.
translation_verse: Kaabɛŋkɛ otsɛ nyɛmi nuu ŋa ni okɛshwie otsɛ hiɛ shi: onyɛkwɛ ni.

english_verse: Don't have sex with your daughter-in-law
translation_verse: Okɛ onyɛmi nuu ŋa akawɔ: ebaahã onyɛmi nuu lɛ hiɛ ashwie shi.

english_verse: And don't have sex with the daughter or granddaughter of any woman that you have earlier had sex with. You will be having sex with her closest relatives, and that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Okɛ yoo kɛ ebiyoo fɛɛ akawɔ, ni asaŋ okaŋɔ obinuu biyoo loo ebiyoo lɛ biyoo ni okɛ lɛ yawɔ. Yoo lɛ lá ji amɛ, ni jeŋba ni tamɔ nakai bɛ fɛo.

english_verse: As long as your wife is alive, don't cause trouble for her by taking one of her sisters as a second wife.
translation_verse: Kaaŋɔ oŋa nyɛmi yoo ofee oŋa bienyɛ; ni okɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ be mli ni oŋa hiɛ kã lolo.

english_verse: When a woman is having her monthly period, she is unclean, so don't have sex with her.
translation_verse: “Kaaya yoo ŋɔɔ ni okɛ lɛ ayawɔ be mli ni etee tsuiasɛɛ, ejaakɛ ehe tseee.

english_verse: Don't have sex with another man's wife—that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Okɛ onaanyo ŋa akawɔ ni okɛwo ohe muji.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice your children on the altar fires to the god Molech. I am the Lord your God, and that would disgrace me.
translation_verse: Kaaŋmɛɛ obii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko he ohã ni akɛ lɛ ja Molek ni akɛ no wo oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi he muji. Mi ji Yehowa.

english_verse: It is disgusting for a man to have sex with another man.
translation_verse: Okɛ nuu akawɔ tamɔ okɛ yoo wɔɔ lɛ; aahi.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves unclean by any of these disgusting practices of those nations that I am forcing out of the land for you. They made themselves
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ nii nɛɛ ateŋ eko eko akawoa nyɛhe muji; ejaakɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ jeŋmaji ni mibashwie mahã nyɛ lɛ kɛwoɔ amɛhe muji lɛ.

english_verse: and the land so unclean, that I punished the land because of their sins, and I made it vomit them up.
translation_verse: Gbɛ nɔ ni tsɔ̃ ni shikpɔŋ fee shikpɔŋ ni he tseee nɛ. Mibagbala etoii yɛ enishaianii lɛ hewɔ, ni ebaafɛ̃ mɛi ni yɔɔ enɔ lɛ eshwie.

english_verse: Then the land won't become sick of you and vomit you up, just as it did them.
translation_verse: koni shikpɔŋ lɛ akafɛ̃ nyɛ hu eshwie tamɔ bɔ ni efɛ̃ jeŋmaŋ ni tsɔ nyɛhiɛ lɛ eshwie lɛ.

english_verse: If any of you do these vulgar, disgusting things, you will be unclean and no longer belong to my people. I am the Lord your God, and I forbid you to follow their sickening way of life.
translation_verse: “No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyea nii ni mifã akɛ nyɛfee lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛkafea kusumi ni ahiɔ ni afeɔ dani nyɛba lɛ, koni nyɛkɛkawo nyɛhe muji. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I am the Lord your God. I am holy, and you must be holy too!
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfea nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji mi.

english_verse: Respect your father and your mother, honor the Sabbath, and don't make idols or images. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: “Nyɛkayanyiɛa yakayaka wɔji asɛɛ, ni nyɛkafea dade wɔji hu ni ashwie nyɛhã nyɛhe; mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, be sure to follow my instructions.
translation_verse: “Kɛji nyɛgbe kooloo nyɛkɛmiishã naanyobɔɔ afɔle lɛ, nyɛfea lɛ yɛ mlai ni awo yɛ he lɛ naa koni esa mihiɛ ni mahere.

english_verse: You may eat the meat either on the day of the sacrifice or on the next day, but you must burn anything left over on the third day.
translation_verse: Aye loo lɛ gbi ni ashã afɔle lɛ nɔŋŋ, kɛ enɔ jetsɛremɔ; shi nɔ ni baashwɛ kɛyaashi gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, akɛ la ashã, ejaakɛ ehe tseee;

english_verse: If you eat any of it on the third day, the sacrifice will be disgusting to me, and I will reject it.
translation_verse: ni kɛ aye gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ loo lɛ eko lɛ, minaŋ afɔle lɛ he tsui.

english_verse: In fact, you will be punished for not respecting what I say is holy, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ, etere musu, ejaakɛ ewo keenɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛmiihã Yehowa he muji, ni abuŋ lɛ ashiŋ mimɛi lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing along the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground.
translation_verse: “Kɛji nyɛmiikpa nyɛŋmɔshinii lɛ, nyɛkakpaa nii ni yɔɔ nyɛŋmɔji lɛ anaanaa lɛ kɛmɔ shi kwraa.

english_verse: Don't strip your grapevines clean or gather the grapes that fall off the vines. Leave them for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛkakpaa wain tsei lɛ ayibii hu fɛɛ kɛmɔɔ shi; ni wain yibii ni aaashwie shi lɛ hu nyɛkakɔlɔa. Nyɛshĩa nyɛhãa ohiafoi kɛ gbɔi lɛ koni amɛbaye lɛ kpɛkpɛo. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Do not steal or tell lies or cheat others.
translation_verse: “Kaaju; kaashishiu onaanyo gbɔmɔ, kaalaka lɛ.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name by making promises you don't intend to keep. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Kaakã kitã yɛ migbɛi mli ni okɛshishiu mɔ ko ni okɛwo oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi he muji. Mi ji Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Do not steal anything or cheat anyone, and don't fail to pay your workers at the end of each day.
translation_verse: “Kaaye onaanyo gbɔmɔ amim, ni kaatswa lɛ ojo. Kaahã je miitsɛre apaafonyo nyɔmɔwoo nɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I command you not to make fun of the deaf or to cause a blind person to stumble.
translation_verse: Kaalomɔ toimulɔ, ni okɛ pampi akama shwilafo gbɛ nɔ ni eyatɛ; shi she oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbeyei. Mi ji Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Be fair, no matter who is on trial—don't favor either the poor or the rich.
translation_verse: “Kaatsɔ̃ jalɛ sane hiɛ obu shi ni oye ohã ohiafo aloo ohiɛ shwie gbɔmɔ wulu hiɛ. Kojomɔ onaanyo gbɔmɔ yɛ jalɛ naa.

english_verse: Don't be a gossip, but never hesitate to speak up in court, especially if your testimony can save someone's life.
translation_verse: Kaanyiɛ kɛmiiya kɛmiiba ni ooye osheku yɛ omaŋ lɛ mli; ni kaate shi oshi onaanyo gbɔmɔ ni okɛ gbɔmɔgbee sane fɔ̃ enɔ; mi ji Yehowa.

english_verse: Don't hold grudges. On the other hand, it's wrong not to correct someone who needs correcting.
translation_verse: “Kaanyɛ onyɛmi gbɔmɔ yɛ otsui mli; shi kã lɛ blɛoo yɛ etɔ̃mɔ he koni okatere sɔ̃ ko bo diɛŋtsɛ hu.

english_verse: Don't be angry or try to take revenge. I am the Lord, and I command you to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Kaatɔ ohe owele, ni kaabɛ omaŋbii lɛ eko owo omli, shi suɔmɔ onaanyo gbɔmɔ tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe lɛ. Mi ji Yehowa.

english_verse: Breed your livestock animals only with animals of the same kind, and don't plant two kinds of seed in the same field or wear clothes made of different kinds of material.
translation_verse: “Nyɛyea mikpɔi lɛ anɔ. Kaahã oshĩa kooloi srɔtoi miifutu amɛmiikwɔ. Oŋmɔ mli hu kaafutu wui srɔtoi odu. Ni kaawo atade ni akɛ klala kɛ kuŋtu futu lo.

english_verse: If a man has sex with a slave woman who is promised in marriage to someone else, he must pay a fine, but they are not to be put to death. After all, she was still a slave at the time.
translation_verse: “Kɛji nuu ko kɛ nyɔŋyoo ko wɔ, ni nyɔŋyoo lɛ atsɛ ehe baa ahã nuu kroko, shi nuu nɛɛ woko eyi nyɔmɔ koni yoo lɛ aye ehe lɛ, no lɛ abote sane lɛ mli. Agbala yoo lɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ toi, shi akagbe amɛ, ejaakɛ ahãko yoo lɛ aye ehe.

english_verse: The man must bring a ram to the entrance of the sacred tent and give it to a priest, who will then offer it as a sacrifice to me, so the man's sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ kɛ ojwɛni ni ji sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ akpãtã ahã nuu lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ, ni akɛaafa lɛ.

english_verse: After you enter the land, you will plant fruit trees, but you are not to eat any fruit from them for the first three years.
translation_verse: “Kɛji nyɛyashɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, yeli tso fɛɛ yeli tso ni nyɛaatɛo ni ayeɔ lɛ, nyɛbua eyibii lɛ akɛ nɔ ko ni ehe tseee kɛyashi afii etɛ̃; akaye eyibii lɛ.

english_verse: In the fourth year the fruit must be set apart, as an expression of thanks
translation_verse: Shi afi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ afee tso yibii lɛ fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ akɛ afɔle ni aashã ahã mi, Yehowa, kɛda mi shi.

english_verse: to me, the Lord God. Do this, and in the fifth year, those trees will produce an abundant harvest of fruit for you to eat.
translation_verse: Shi afi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛyea yibii lɛ, koni nibaa nii afa babaoo ahã nyɛ. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't eat the blood of any animal. Don't practice any kind of witchcraft.
translation_verse: “Nyɛkayea loo ni lá yɔɔ mli. Nyɛkaklaa, ni nyɛkayea ŋkunyaa.

english_verse: I forbid you to shave any part of your head or beard or to cut and tattoo yourself as a way of worshiping the dead.
translation_verse: Nyɛkabamɔa nyɛhewolo nɔ gbɛ̃i kɛyea gbonyo ko he ŋkɔmɔ; ni nyɛkayea sãmãi yɛ nyɛhewolo nɔ. Mi ji Yehowa.

english_verse: Don't let your daughters serve as temple prostitutes—this would bring disgrace both to them and the land.
translation_verse: “Okɛ obiyoo akawɔ ni ohã etsɔ̃ yoo ajwamãŋ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bayi tɔ kɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ.

english_verse: I command you to respect the Sabbath and the place where I am worshiped.
translation_verse: Nyɛyea mihejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ, ni nyɛshea he ni ajaa mi yɛ lɛ gbeyei; mi ji Yehowa.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves disgusting to me by going to people who claim they can talk to the dead.
translation_verse: “Nyɛkanyiɛa okɔmfoi kɛ mɛi ni tsɛɔ sisai anɔ, koni nyɛkawo nyɛhe muji. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I command you to show respect for older people and to obey me with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: “Ohiɛ asɔ mɛi ni egbɔlɔ, ni owo amɛ. She Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei. Mi ji Yehowa.

english_verse: Don't mistreat any foreigners who live in your land.
translation_verse: “Kɛ gbɔ ko bato gbɔ yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkawaa lɛ yi.

english_verse: Instead, treat them as well as you treat your own people and love them as much as you love yourself. Remember, you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Nyɛhiɛa lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛbaahiɛ nyɛnyɛmi Israelnyo nɔŋŋ, ni nyɛsumɔa lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛsumɔɔ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe lɛ; ejaakɛ nyɛ hu nyɛyato gbɔ pɛŋ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Use honest scales and don't cheat when you weigh or measure anything. I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt,
