translation_verse: Nyɛhiɛa nsɛnii kpakpai kɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛi kpakpai kɛ nisusumɔ nii kpakpai. Mi ji Yehowa ni jie nyɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ Mose wie,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Death by stoning is the penalty for any citizens or foreigners in the country who sacrifice their children to the god Molech.
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ji Israelnyo loo gbɔ ni ebato gbɔ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛ ebii lɛ eko aaahã ni akɛja Molek lɛ, agbe lɛ; shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ atswia lɛ tɛ.

english_verse: They have disgraced both the place where I am worshiped and my holy name, and so I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people.
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ ebii ateŋ mɔ ko hã Molek, ni ekɛwo He Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni ajaa mi yɛŋ lɛ he muji, ni eshwie migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ shi lɛ, mi lɛ majie mihiɛ maka lɛ, ni mibuŋ lɛ mishiŋ miwebii lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Some of you may let them get away with human sacrifice,
translation_verse: Shi kɛji mɛi ateŋ ni eyɔɔ lɛ ku amɛhiɛ amɛfɔ̃ nɔ ni efee lɛ nɔ, ni amɛgbeee lɛ lɛ,

english_verse: but not me. If any of you worship Molech, I will turn against you and your entire family, and I will no longer let you belong to my people.
translation_verse: mi lɛ majie mihiɛ maka lɛ kɛ eweku fɛɛ, kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyiɛ esɛɛ ni amɛyeee mi anɔkwa, shi amɛjaa Molek lɛ. Mibuŋ amɛ mishiŋ miwebii anɔ.

english_verse: I will be your enemy if you go to someone who claims to speak with the dead, and I will destroy you from among my people.
translation_verse: “Kɛji mɔ ko yabi nii yɛ mɛi ni tsɛɔ sisai aŋɔɔ lɛ, mate shi mawo lɛ, ni mibuŋ lɛ mishiŋ miwebii lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Dedicate yourselves to me and be holy because I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Nyɛhiɛa nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I have chosen you as my people, and I expect you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: Nyɛhiɛ akãa mimlai lɛ ahe ni nyɛyea nɔ; mi ji Yehowa ni feɔ nyɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: If you curse your father or mother, you will be put to death, and it will be your own fault.
translation_verse: “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni lomɔɔ etsɛ loo enyɛ lɛ, agbe lɛ. Etsɛ kɛ enyɛ elomɔ lɛ; esɔ̃ atere lɛ.

english_verse: If any of you men have sex with another man's wife, both you and the woman will be put to death.
translation_verse: “Kɛji nuu ko kɛ nuu kroko ŋa ku gbãlã mli lɛ, agbe nuu gbãlãŋkulɔ kɛ yoo gbãlãŋkulɔ lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Having sex with one of your father's wives disgraces him. So both you and the woman will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Nuu ni kɛ etsɛ ŋa wɔɔ lɛ eshwie etsɛ hiɛ shi. Gbe agbe lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ fɛɛ; ni amɛsɔ̃ atere amɛ.

english_verse: It isn't natural to have sex with your daughter-in-law, and both of you will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Kɛji nuu ko kɛ eshaayoo ni ji ebinuu ŋa wɔ lɛ, agbe lɛ kɛ eshaayoo lɛ fɛɛ; hiɛgbejianii amɛfee lɛ; amɛsɔ̃ atere amɛ.

english_verse: It's disgusting for men to have sex with one another, and those who do will be put to death, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Kɛji nuu ko kɛ nuu kroko wɔ tamɔ bɔ ni akɛ yoo wɔɔ lɛ, amɛfee nɔ ni ahiɔ; agbe amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ; ni amɛsɔ̃ atere amɛ.

english_verse: It isn't natural for a man to marry both a woman and her daughter, and so all three of them will be burned to death.
translation_verse: Kɛji nuu ko ŋɔ yoo ko kɛ enyɛ fɛɛ efee eŋãmɛi lɛ, ashã amɛyi etɛ̃ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ musu ni amɛbɔ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: If any of you have sex with an animal, both you and the animal will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Kɛji yoo ko bɛŋkɛ kooloo ko, ni ekãa shi ehãa lɛ, ni ekɛ kooloo lɛ wɔ lɛ, agbe yoo lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ fɛɛ; amɛmusu atere amɛ.

english_verse: If you marry one of your sisters, you will be punished, and the two of you will be disgraced by being openly forced out of the community.
translation_verse: “Kɛji nuu ko kɛ enyɛmi yoo ni ji etsɛbi loo enyɛbi wɔ lɛ, amɛfee hiɛgbejianii. Atswa amɛnaneshi tu kɛje amɛwekumɛi ateŋ. Nuu lɛ ni kɛ enyɛmi yoo ewɔ lɛ, esɔ̃ atere lɛ.

english_verse: If you have sex with a woman during her monthly period, both you and the woman will be cut off from the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Kɛji nuu ko kɛ yoo ko ni etee tsuiasɛɛ wɔ lɛ, atswa amɛnaneshi tu kɛje amɛwekumɛi ateŋ.

english_verse: The sisters of your father and mother are your own relatives, and you will be punished for having sex with any of them.
translation_verse: “Kɛji nuu ko kɛ etsɛ nyɛmi yoo loo enyɛ nyɛmi yoo wɔ lɛ, eshwie mɔ ni ekɛ lɛ hiɛ heloo kome hiɛ shi; amɛsɔ̃ atere amɛ.

english_verse: If you have sex with your uncle's wife, neither you nor she will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Kɛji nuu ko kɛ etsɛkwɛ̃ ŋa wɔ lɛ, eshwie etsɛkwɛ̃ lɛ hiɛ shi; ekɛ yoo lɛ fɛɛ, amɛsɔ̃ atere amɛ; amɛteŋ mɔ ko naŋ bi, ni ebaagbo.

english_verse: And if you marry your sister-in-law, neither of you will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Kɛji nuu ko kɛ enyɛmi nuu ŋa wɔ lɛ, amɛbaagboi ni amɛbɛ bi. Nuu lɛ etsu hiɛgbejianii, ni eshwie enyɛmi lɛ hiɛ shi.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings. Or else the land I am giving you will become sick of you and throw you out.
translation_verse: “Nyɛyea mimlai lɛ kɛ mikpɔi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, koni shikpɔŋ ni mikɛ nyɛ yaa ni nyɛyahi nɔ lɛ akafɛ̃ nyɛ eshwie.

english_verse: The nations I am chasing out did these disgusting things, and I hated them for it, so don't follow their example.
translation_verse: Nyɛkakasea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ akusumi ni amɛfeɔ lɛ. Miishwie nɛkɛ wɔŋjalɔi nɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni nyɛnyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɛya. Amɛkɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ ehã minyaŋe amɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have promised you their land that is rich with milk and honey. I have chosen you to be different from other people.
translation_verse: Shi miwo nyɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii nɛɛ he shi, ni mikɛbaahã nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Mijie nyɛ yɛ maji krokomɛi lɛ ateŋ mito afã.

english_verse: That's why you must make a difference between animals and birds that I have said are clean and unclean—this will keep you from becoming disgusting to me.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛfea srɔto yɛ kooloi kɛ loofɔji ni he tse kɛ nii ni he tseee ateŋ. Nyɛkayea kooloi loo loofɔji ni he tseee. Mihã nyɛle akɛ amɛhe tseee; ni kɛ nyɛye lɛ nyɛhe baawo muji.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the holy God. You have been chosen to be my people, and so you must be holy too.
translation_verse: Nyɛhiɛa nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ nyɛhãa mi pɛ, ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, mihe tse. Mijie nyɛ yɛ maji krokomɛi lɛ ateŋ mito afã koni nyɛfee mi pɛ minɔ.

english_verse: If you claim to receive messages from the dead, you will be put to death by stoning, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: “Nyɛteŋ nuu loo yoo ni aaayabi nii yɛ sisa ŋɔɔ lɛ, atswia lɛ tɛ ni egbo. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ enɛ lɛ egbele sɔ̃ atere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses these instructions for Aaron's sons, the priests: Touching a dead body will make you unclean. So don't go near a dead relative,
translation_verse: Yehowa fã Mose ni ekɛɛ osɔfoi ni ji Aaron bihii lɛ akɛ, “Osɔfo ko akaya wekunyo ko kɛkɛ ni egbo yara nɔ ni ekɛwo ehe muji,

english_verse: except your mother, father, son, daughter, brother,
translation_verse: belɛ ja enyɛ loo etsɛ loo ebinuu loo ebiyoo loo enyɛmi nuu

english_verse: or an unmarried sister, who has no husband to take care of her.
translation_verse: loo enyɛmi yoo, ni ji oblayoo foro ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, koni ekɛbule ehe.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by attending the funeral of someone related to you by marriage.
translation_verse: Ekaya mɔ ko ni gbãlã hewɔ efeɔ ewekunyo yara nɔ koni ekɛwo ehe muji.

english_verse: Don't shave any part of your head or trim your beard or cut yourself to show that you are mourning.
translation_verse: “Osɔfo ko akakpɔ eyi, ni ekaku etsɛŋ nɔ, ni asaŋ ekabãmɔ ehewolo nɔ gbɛ̃i kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ eeye ŋkɔmɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have chosen you alone to offer sacrifices of food to me on the altar. That's why you must keep yourselves holy.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ afee ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã mi, ni ekawo migbɛi lɛ he muji, ejaakɛ Yehowa afɔlei ni akɛ la shãa, ni ji eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aboloo lɛ, lɛ ekɛbahãa. No hewɔ lɛ, efee ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ.

english_verse: Don't marry a divorced woman or a woman who has served as a temple prostitute. You are holy,
translation_verse: Osɔfo ko akaŋɔ yoo ajwamãŋ ko loo yoo ni le nuu, loo yoo ni ewu eshwie lɛ, ejaakɛ miniyenii afɔle lɛ, osɔfo lɛ kɛbahãa mi; Osɔfo lɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.

english_verse: because I am holy. And so, you must be treated with proper respect, since you offer food sacrifices to me, the God of holiness.
translation_verse: Nyɛbua osɔfo lɛ akɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, ji mɔ ni mifeɔ osɔfoi lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: If any of you priests has a daughter who disgraces you by serving as a temple prostitute, she must be burned to death.
translation_verse: Kɛji osɔfo ko biyoo fee ehe ajwamãŋ lɛ, ewo etsɛ he muji; ashã lɛ ni egbo.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must not mess up your hair or tear your clothes in order to mourn for the dead.
translation_verse: “Osɔfonukpa lɛ, mɔ ni afɔse mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ ashwie eyiteŋ ni awo lɛ osɔfo, ni ewo osɔfo atadei lɛ, lɛ lɛ ekahiɛ eyitso folo, ni ekagbala etadei hu kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ eeye ŋkɔmɔ.

english_verse: If you leave the sacred place to attend a funeral, both you and the sacred place become unclean, because you are the high priest.
translation_verse: Afɔ lɛ mu ni ajɔɔ enɔ ahã mi; no hewɔ lɛ, ekawo mishihilɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he muji; ni ekashi jɛi etee eyabote shĩa ko ni gbonyo ko kɛkɛ loo etsɛ loo enyɛ tete gbonyo kã mli.

english_verse: from your own tribe. Don't marry a divorced woman or any other woman who has already had sex, including a temple prostitute.
translation_verse: Ekaŋɔ yoo okulafo loo mɔ ni ewu eshwie lɛ loo mɔ ni le nuu loo yoo ajwamãŋ; shi moŋ eŋɔ oblayoo foro kɛjɛ etsɛ weku lɛ mli.

english_verse: In this way, your descendants will be qualified to serve me. Remember—I am the Lord, and I have chosen you.
translation_verse: Efee enɛ, kɛjeee nakai lɛ eshwiei ni sa akɛ amɛfee krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ahe baawo muji. Mi ji Yehowa, ni mijɔɔ enɔ mifee lɛ osɔfonukpa.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa fã Mose,

english_verse: to say to Aaron: No descendant of yours can ever serve as my priest if he is blind or lame, if his face is disfigured, if one leg is shorter than the other,
translation_verse: Mɔ ko ni kpa yɔɔ egbɔmɔtso he kɛ afɔle lɛ akaba; mɔ ni eshwila aloo etsɔ̃ɔ, loo eji gbɔmɔ akotia loo gbɔmɔ asaabu,

english_verse: if either a foot or a hand is paralyzed,
translation_verse: loo mɔ ni enane loo enine eje kpa

english_verse: if he is a hunchback or a dwarf, if an eye or his skin is diseased, or if his testicles have been damaged.
translation_verse: loo afutsɛ, loo mɔ ni tɛ kã ehiŋmɛi nɔ, loo mɔ ni he edɔ kpla loo mɔ ni egbɛi mli wui ejwra.

english_verse: These men may not serve as my priests and burn sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni kpa ko yɔɔ ehe yɛ osɔfo Aaron bihii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, ekatsi ebɛŋkɛ ni ekɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ bahã mi.

english_verse: but they may not enter the sacred place or serve me at the altar. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: shi muhɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he kɛkɛ ni ekaba, ni ekatsi ebɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ kpa yɛ ehe. No hewɔ lɛ, ekawo minii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ahe muji, ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa ni feɔ amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Moses told all of this to Aaron, his sons, and the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Belɛ enɛ ji nɔ ni Mose kɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa fã Mose,

english_verse: to say to Aaron and his sons: I am the Lord God, and I demand that you honor my holy name by showing proper respect for the offerings brought to me by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ akɛ: “Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ yɛ nikeenii krɔŋkrɔŋi ni Israelbii lɛ tsuɔ he ni amɛjɔɔ nɔ amɛhãa mi lɛ he, koni migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he guɔ akagbo. Mi ji Yehowa.

english_verse: If any of you are unclean when you accept an offering for me, I will no longer let you serve as a priest.
translation_verse: Kɛji oshwiei lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ni he tseee tsi bɛŋkɛ afɔlei ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni Israelbii lɛ etsuu he amɛjɔɔ nɔ amɛhã mi lɛ, abuŋ lɛ ashiŋ miwebii lɛ anɔ. Mla nɛɛ kã shi hã yinɔi fɛɛ.

english_verse: None of you may take part in the sacred meals while you have a skin disease or an infected penis, or after you have been near a dead body or have had a flow of semen,
translation_verse: “Aaron shwiei lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni miiye hewolo nɔ hela gbeyeigbeyei aloo ehe miiho nu akaye niyenii krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko kɛyashi beyinɔ ni ehe aaatse.

english_verse: Once you are unclean, you must take a bath, but you still cannot eat any of the sacred food until evening.
translation_verse: Kɛ hulu enyɔ shi ni ehe tse lɛ, no sɛɛ dani eye nii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ eko, ejaakɛ nomɛi ji eŋmãa.

english_verse: I command you not to eat anything that is killed by a wild animal or dies a natural death. This would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Ekaye kooloo ni egbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ gbele loo kooloi etserɛ lɛ. Kɛji eye lɛ ebaatsɔ̃ mɔ ni he tseee; mi ji Yehowa.

english_verse: Obey me, or you will die on duty for disgracing the place of worship. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: “Osɔfoi fɛɛ aye mlai ni miwo nɛɛ anɔ; kɛjeee nakai lɛ amɛaatere sɔ̃, ni amɛaagboi yɛ mimlai krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ anɔtɔ̃mɔ hewɔ; mi mifeɔ osɔfoi lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.

english_verse: Only you priests and your families may eat the food offerings; these are too sacred for any of your servants.
translation_verse: “Mɔkpɔŋ ko mɔkpɔŋ ko akaye nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko; nakai nɔŋŋ ji gbɔ loo apaafonyo ni ebato osɔfo gbɔ.

english_verse: However, any slave that you own, including those born into your household, may eat this food.
translation_verse: Shi nyɔŋ ni osɔfo lɛ he kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshika, aye nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko; ni nyɔji ni afɔ amɛ yɛ osɔfo lɛ we lɛ kɛ lɛ aye eniyenii lɛ eko.

english_verse: If your daughter marries someone who isn't a priest, she can no longer have any of this food.
translation_verse: Kɛ osɔfo ko biyoo yagbã mɔ ko kɛkɛ lɛ, ekaye nii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ amli nɔ ni aje gbɛ ajie ato afã lɛ.

english_verse: But if she returns to your home, either widowed or divorced, and has no children, she may join in the meal. Only members of a priestly family can eat this food,
translation_verse: Shi kɛji osɔfo biyoo lɛ tsɔ̃ okulafo aloo ewu shwie lɛ, ni ebɛ bi, ni eku esɛɛ kɛba etsɛ we lɛ, tamɔ eyɔɔ yɛ egbekɛbiiashi lɛ, no lɛ eye etsɛ nii lɛ eko. Mɔkpɔŋ ko mɔkpɔŋ ko kɛkɛ akaye eko.

english_verse: and anyone else who accidentally does so, must pay for the food plus a fine of
translation_verse: “Kɛji mɔ ko ni jɛɛɛ osɔfoi aweku mli leee ehe be ni eyaye nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko lɛ, eto najiaŋ ni ekɛ mlijai enumɔ mli ekome ashi nɔ.

english_verse: must have nothing wrong with them, or else I won't accept them. Bulls or rams or goats are the animals to be used for these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Kɛ nyɛkɛ kooloo ni kpa yɔɔ ehe ba lɛ, esaŋ Yehowa hiɛ, ni eheŋ.

english_verse: I warn you not to treat lightly the offerings that are brought by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Osɔfoi lɛ akaŋmɛ mɔ ko kɛkɛ gbɛ ni eye niyenii krɔŋkrɔŋ ni Israelbii lɛ kɛbahãa Yehowa lɛ eko.

english_verse: Don't let them become guilty of eating this sacred food. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes these offerings holy. Acceptable Sacrifices
translation_verse: Kɛji amɛŋmɛ gbɛ lɛ amɛbaawo niyenii krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he muji, ni amɛaatere tɔ̃mɔ lɛ yi sɔ̃, ni aaagbala amɛtoi, ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa ni feɔ amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa fã Mose

english_verse: to tell Aaron and his sons and everyone else the rules for offering sacrifices. He said: The animals that are to be completely burned on the altar
translation_verse: koni ekɛ mlai nɛɛ ahã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ, “Kɛji Israelnyo ko loo mɔ ko ni ebato gbɔ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ shãa afɔle miiba abahã Yehowa, shiwoo ni jio, tsuijurɔ naa nii jio, kooloo lɛ afee kooloo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, there must be nothing wrong with the animal. This is true, whether the sacrifice is part of a promise or something you do voluntarily.
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ naanyobɔɔ afɔle tamɔ akɛ tsina loo too, loo afɔle ni ewo he shi eto, loo afɔle ni eeshã yɛ tsuijurɔ naa lɛ, miiba abahã Yehowa lɛ, esaaa akɛ kpa ko ahi kooloo lɛ he; esa akɛ efee kooloo ni eye emuu koni esa Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: If one of your cattle or lambs has a leg that is longer or shorter than the others, you may offer it voluntarily, but not as part of a promise.
translation_verse: Kɛji afɔle ni nyɛkɛba lɛ tsuijurɔ naa nyɛkɛba lɛ, no lɛ nyɛaanyɛ nyɛkɛ kooloo ni enine loo enane bɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ashã afɔle lɛ. Shi kɛ afɔle ni nyɛwo he shi nyɛto nyɛshãa lɛ, no lɛ kooloo lɛ esaŋ Yehowa hiɛ ni eheŋ.

english_verse: As long as you live in this land, don't offer an animal with injured testicles.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ kooloo ni ajwara aloo ashimɔ aloo atserɛ aloo afolɔ egbɛi akashã afɔle nyɛhã Yehowa. Ni nyɛkafea nakai yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: And don't bring me animals you bought from a foreigner. I won't accept them, because they are no better than one that has something wrong with it.
translation_verse: “Nyɛkahea kooloi nɛɛ eko yɛ maŋsɛɛnyo dɛŋ ni nyɛkɛbahã Yehowa akɛ niyenii afɔle, ejaakɛ adebɔɔ mli kpa ko yɛ maŋsɛɛ kooloi nɛɛ ahe. Eji kpa ni eka amɛhe, ni amɛsaŋ Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: Newborn cattle, sheep, or goats must remain with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day, you may send them up in smoke to me, and I will accept the offering.
translation_verse: “Kɛji afɔ tsina loo gwantɛŋ loo abotiabi lɛ, akajie lɛ yɛ enyɛ he kɛyashi gbii kpawo. Kɛjɛ gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ kɛyaa lɛ, esa hã niyenii afɔle shãa hã Yehowa.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice a newborn animal and its mother on the same day.
translation_verse: Nyɛkagbea tsina loo gwantɛŋ loo abotia kɛ ebi fɛɛ gbi kome.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to give thanks to me, you must do it in a way that is acceptable.
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛmiishã shidaa afɔle nyɛhã Yehowa lɛ, nyɛyea ehe mlai lɛ anɔ, koni afɔle lɛ asa ehiɛ.

english_verse: Eat all of the meat that same day and don't save any for the next day. I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Nyɛyea loo lɛ fɛɛ gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ; nyɛkashwɛa eko ni je tsɛre nɔ.”

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings—I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Nyɛhiɛ ahiãa mikpɔi lɛ anɔ ni nyɛyea nɔ; mi ji Yehowa.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I have chosen certain times for you to come together and worship me.
translation_verse: “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ gbii juji ni, mi, Yehowa, mito akɛ akpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛja yɛ amɛnɔ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work, but the seventh day of each week is holy because it belongs to me. No matter where you live, you must rest on the Sabbath and come together for worship. This law will never change. Passover and the Festival of Thin Bread (Numbers
translation_verse: Atsu nii gbii ekpaa; shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ, hejɔɔmɔ gbi ni; akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ yɛ hei fɛɛ ni nyɛaahi; akpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛja

english_verse: No one is to work on that day—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness, when sacrifices will be offered to me, so that I will forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko yɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ kpãtãmɔ gbi ni, koni akpãtã yɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ ahã nyɛ.

english_verse: Passover is another time when you must come together to worship me, and it must be celebrated on the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month of each year.
translation_verse: “Klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ ji Yehowa Hehoo gbi lɛ.

english_verse: Each day of this festival you must offer sacrifices. Then on the final day you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship. Offering the First Part of the Harvest
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ niyenii afɔle abahãa Yehowa gbii kpawo. Ni gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛjaa; shi akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land I am giving you, the first bundle of wheat from each crop must be given to me. So bring it to a priest
translation_verse: “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛkpa enɔ ŋmɔshi nii lɛ, nyɛkɛ nikpamɔnii lɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ abele tso kɛ eyinii lɛ abahãa osɔfo lɛ.

english_verse: and two kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil. Then he will place these on the bronze altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. Together with these, you must bring a liter of wine as a drink offering.
translation_verse: Ni niyenii afɔle ni afata kooloo lɛ he ji ŋmãa mamu ni akɛ fɔ ekpɔtɔ, kiloi enyɔ, koni ashã ahã Yehowa koni eje ŋma ewo lɛ; ni dãa afɔle ni akɛfata he ji wain lita kome.

english_verse: I am your God, and I forbid you to eat any new grain or anything made from it until you have brought these offerings. This law will never change. The Harvest Festival (Numbers
translation_verse: Ni kɛyaashi gbi nɔ ni nyɛkɛ nyɛfɔle lɛ aaabahã nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aboloo loo abele ni ashã loo abele fɔ ko akaya nyɛdaaŋ. Akpɔ nɛɛ kã shi hã nyɛshwiei yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ anɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛyɔɔ. Ŋmãakpamɔ gbijurɔ lɛ (Numeri

english_verse: The Lord God said to Moses:
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: None of my people are ever to do any work on that day—not now or in the future. And I will wipe out those who do!
translation_verse: Nyɛkatsua nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko yɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ. Naanɔ akpɔ nɛ hã nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛyɔɔ.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you offer this bundle of grain, each family must bring another offering of new grain.
translation_verse: “Nyɛkanea otsii kpawo kɛjɛ Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ ni ji gbi ni nyɛkɛ ŋmãa ni nyɛku lɛ baahã Yehowa lɛ.

english_verse: Bring two loaves of bread to be lifted up in dedication to me. Each loaf is to be made with yeast and with two kilograms of the finest flour from the first part of your harvest.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ aboloo akwaabɔi enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ ni akɛŋmãa mamu kiloi enyɔ ni awo mli yiisi shã ajɛa nyɛshĩai amli kɛbaa akɛ nyɛŋmɔshi klɛŋklɛŋ nikpamɔnii ni nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa.

english_verse: At this same time, the entire community of Israel must bring seven lambs that are a year old, a young bull, and two rams. These animals must have nothing wrong with them, and they must be offered as a sacrifice to please me. You must also offer the proper grain and wine sacrifices with each animal.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ gwantɛŋbii kpawo ni amɛye afifii, ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe kɛ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛnii enyɔ afata aboloi lɛ ahe. Akɛ kooloi lɛ kɛ amɛhe niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ dãa lɛ fɛɛ baafee shãa afɔle akɛhã Yehowa. Afɔle ni ashãa ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa ni.

english_verse: Offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and two rams a year old as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Asaŋ nyɛkɛ too kpakpo kome afea esha he faikpamɔ afɔle, koni nyɛkɛ gwantɛŋbii enyɔ ni amɛye afifii lɛ afea shidaa afɔle.

english_verse: The priest will lift up the rams together with the bread in dedication to me. These offerings are holy and are my gift to the priest.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ baaŋɔ aboloo lɛ kɛ gwantɛŋbii lɛ ehã koni afɔ̃ akɛ fɔ̃ɔ afɔle yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. Nibii nɛɛ etsɔ̃mɔ Yehowa nii krɔŋkrɔŋ. Aŋɔ hã osɔfo lɛ akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ.

english_verse: This is a day of celebration and worship, a time of rest from your work. You and your descendants must obey this law.
translation_verse: Ashiɛ koni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ nyɛkpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛja, ni akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ. Naanɔ akpɔ nɛ hã nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛyɔɔ.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing around the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground. Leave it for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God! The Festival of Trumpets (Numbers
translation_verse: “Ni kɛji nyɛmiikpa nyɛŋmɔshi nii lɛ, nyɛkakpaa ŋmɔ lɛ naanaanii lɛ kɛmɔ shi kwraa; nakai nɔŋŋ hu onikpamɔnii lɛ amli kpɛkpɛbii lɛ hu kaakpɛte; shi moŋ ashi ahã ohiafo kɛ gbɔ koni amɛkɛbaye kpɛkpɛo. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.” Afi hee gbijurɔ (Numeri

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. It is a solemn day of worship; everyone must go without eating to show sorrow for their sins, and sacrifices must be burned.
translation_verse: “Nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo nɛɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ ji esha kpãtãmɔ gbi lɛ. Gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛwaa nyɛhe yi kɛ hɔmɔ; asaŋ nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛjaa, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛdɛŋ niyenii afɔle ni ashãa abaa abahãa Yehowa.

english_verse: This is a time of complete rest just like the Sabbath, and everyone must go without eating from the evening of the ninth to the evening of the tenth. The Festival of Shelters (Numbers
translation_verse: Hejɔɔmɔ gbi wulu nɛ hã nyɛ. Nyɛwaa nyɛhe yi kɛ hɔmɔ kɛjɛ nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ gbɛkɛnaashi aahu kɛyaashi enɔ jetsɛremɔ gbɛkɛnaashi ekoŋŋ. Nyɛyea Hejɔɔmɔ gbi krɛdɛɛ nɛɛ.” Asesei agbijurɔ lɛ (Numeri

english_verse: Pick the best fruit from your trees and cut leafy branches to use during the time of this joyous celebration in my honor.
translation_verse: Gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛhiɛa nyɛtsei anɔ aduawai kpakpai fɛɛfɛji kɛ tɛŋ bɛlɛo kɛ tsei flofloi aniji kɛ faa naa ŋɔi kɛbaa koni nyɛbanyaa yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ gbii kpawo.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.
translation_verse: “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo ni kã nɔ nɛɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ ji Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ; aye gbijurɔ lɛ gbii kpawo ahã Yehowa.

english_verse: No one is to do any work on the first day of the festival—it is a time when everyone must come together for worship.
translation_verse: Gbi ni ji klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ akpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛja; akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ.

english_verse: For seven days, sacrifices must be offered on the altar. The eighth day is also to be a day of complete rest, as well as a time of offering sacrifices on the altar and of coming together for worship.
translation_verse: Gbii kpawo lɛ mli gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ, nyɛhiɛa nyɛdɛŋ niyenii afɔle ni ashãa nyɛkɛbahãa Yehowa. Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛjaa ekoŋŋ, ni nyɛkɛ niyenii afɔle ni ashãa abaa abahãa Yehowa. Kpee wulu diɛŋtsɛ gbi ni. Akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ.

english_verse: I have chosen these festivals as times when my people must come together for worship and when animals, grain, and wine are to be offered on the proper days.
translation_verse: “Enɛɛmɛi ji gbii juji ni Yehowa eto lɛ; ni kɛji eko shɛ lɛ nyɛshiɛa koni maŋ lɛ akpe kpei krɔŋkrɔŋi kɛja, asaŋ koni ashã niyenii afɔlei kɛ shãa afɔlei kɛ ŋmãa afɔlei kɛ dãa afɔlei akɛhã Yehowa, eko fɛɛ eko yɛ egbi nɔ.

english_verse: These festivals must be celebrated in addition to the Sabbaths and the times when you offer special gifts or sacrifices to keep a promise or as a voluntary offering.
translation_verse: Esoro Yehowa Hejɔɔmɔgbii lɛ, dani esoro nyɛdaadaa nikeenii lɛ, ni esoro nyɛshiwoo afɔlei lɛ kɛ nyɛtsuijurɔ naa afɔlei lɛ fɛɛ hu ni nyɛkɛbahãa Yehowa.

english_verse: Remember to begin the Festival of Shelters on the fifteenth day of the seventh month after you have harvested your crops. Celebrate this festival for seven days in honor of me and don't do any work on the first day or on the day following the festival.
translation_verse: “Nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ, be ni nyɛkpa ŋmɔshinii nyɛgbe naa lɛ, nyɛjea shishi nyɛyea Yehowa gbijurɔ lɛ kɛyashia gbii kpawo. Gbi ni ji klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi krɛdɛɛ ni.

english_verse: I command you and all of your descendants to celebrate this festival during the seventh month of each year.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ gbii kpawo ayea gbijurɔ nɛɛ daa afi nyɛhãa Yehowa yɛ nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ. Eji naanɔ akpɔ hã nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ.

english_verse: For seven days every Israelite must live in a shelter,
translation_verse: Nyɛhia asesei amli gbii kpawo. Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo ahi asese mli,

english_verse: so future generations will know that I made their ancestors live in shelters when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: koni nyɛshwiei kɛna amɛle akɛ be ni miyakpala Israel kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, asesei amli mihã amɛhi. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: This is how Moses instructed the people of Israel to celebrate the Lord's festivals.
translation_verse: Belɛ bɔ ni Mose tsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii lɛ gbii juji ni Yehowa eto ehã amɛ akɛ amɛye lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: It's possible to pay the owner for an animal that has been killed, but death is the penalty for murder.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni aaagbe mɔ ko kooloo ko lɛ, eto mɔ lɛ kooloo lɛ najiaŋ; shi mɔ ni aaagbe gbɔmɔ lɛ gbe agbe lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You must supply the purest olive oil for the lamps in the sacred tent, so they will keep burning.
translation_verse: “Fã Israelbii akɛ amɛbahã bo mutso mu krɔŋŋ ni akɛ mutso ni ashimɔ fee koni akɛ mu lɛ asu Kpee Buu lɛ mli kane lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni ahã kane lɛ ama nɔ be fɛɛ be.

english_verse: Aaron will set up the gold lampstand in the holy place of the sacred tent. Then he will light the seven lamps that must be kept burning there in my presence, every night from now on. This law will never change. The Sacred Bread The Lord said:
translation_verse: Aaron baakura kanei lɛ yɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi kanetsei lɛ anɔ, ni ebaakwɛ koni amɛtso yɛ Yehowa hiɛ be fɛɛ be. Aboloo ni akɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ

english_verse: Use your finest flour to bake twelve loaves of bread about two kilograms each,
translation_verse: “Okɛ ŋmãa mamu ashã aboloo akwaabɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, aboloo akwaabɔ kome aye ŋmãa mamu kilo kome.

english_verse: then take them into the sacred tent and lay them on the gold table in two rows of six loaves.
translation_verse: Too aboloo lɛ srɛnɛɛ kui enyɔ yɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ. Aboloo ekpaa aye afã biɛ, ni aboloo ekpaa hu aye biɛ.

english_verse: Alongside each row put some pure incense that will be sent up by fire in place of the bread as an offering to me.
translation_verse: Okɛ krɔbɔo krɔŋŋ afata aboloo ku kome fɛɛ ku kome he, koni no afee kaimɔ nɔ ni akɛbahã akɛ afɔle ni ashã ahã Yehowa.

english_verse: Aaron must lay fresh loaves on the table each Sabbath, and priests in all generations must continue this practice as part of Israel's agreement with me.
translation_verse: Daa Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ, Aaron ato aboloo nɛɛ eshwie okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ, bɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. Naanɔ kpãŋmɔ ni kã shi hã Israelbii nɛ.

english_verse: This bread will always belong to Aaron and his family; it is very holy because it was offered to me, and it must be eaten in a holy place. Punishment for Cursing the Lord
translation_verse: Aboloi lɛ atsɔ̃ Aaron kɛ eshwiei agbɛfaŋnɔ; ni amɛye nii nɛɛ yɛ he ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ejaakɛ niyenii afɔle ni abashã akɛhã Yehowa mli nii ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ ni.” Toigbalamɔ ni ja gbɛ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ

english_verse: Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri from the tribe of Dan, had married an Egyptian, and they had a son. One day their son got into a fight with an Israelite man in camp and cursed the name of the Lord. So the young man was dragged off to Moses,
translation_verse: Israelyoo nɛɛ gbɛi ji Shelomit, ni etsɛ ji Dibri ni jɛ Dan akutso lɛ mli lɛ. Bei lɛ mli lɛ oblanyo lɛ bɔ musu elomɔ Nyɔŋmɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, amɔ lɛ kɛbahã Mose.

english_verse: who had him guarded while everyone waited for the Lord to tell them what to do.
translation_verse: Atsi oblanyo lɛ naa kɛyashi Yehowa aaatsɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni afee lɛ.

english_verse: Finally, the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Fee sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: This man has cursed me! Take him outside the camp and tell the witnesses to lay their hands on his head. Then command the whole community of Israel to stone him to death.
translation_verse: “Mɔ mɔ ni lomɔ lɛ kɛje shitoohe lɛ mli kɛya esɛɛ. Mɛi fɛɛ ni nu akɛ elomɔ lɛ kɛ amɛniji abashwie eyiteŋ, koni no sɛɛ lɛ maŋtso muu lɛ atswia lɛ tɛ ni egbo.

english_verse: And warn the others that everyone else who curses me will die in the same way, whether they are Israelites by birth or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: mɔ ni baalomɔ Yehowa lɛ, gbe kɛ̃ aaagbe lɛ. Gbɔ ni jio, maŋnyo ni jio, kɛji ena elomɔ Yehowa lɛ, maŋtso muu lɛ fɛɛ atswia lɛ tɛ ni egbo.’

english_verse: Death is also the penalty for murder,
translation_verse: “Mɔ ni aaagbe gbɔmɔ lɛ, lɛ hu agbe lɛ;

english_verse: but the killing of an animal that belongs to someone else requires only that the animal be replaced.
translation_verse: ni mɔ ni aaagbe mɔ kroko kooloo lɛ, eto kooloo lɛ najiaŋ kɛ kooloo nɔŋŋ; akɛ kooloo ato kooloo najiaŋ.

english_verse: Personal injuries to others must be dealt with in keeping with the crime—
translation_verse: “Kɛji mɔ ko pila enaanyo gbɔmɔ lɛ, lɛ hu apila lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ bɔ ni epila enaanyo lɛ koni akɛtse.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I demand equal justice both for you Israelites and for those foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Mla koome nɛɛ akã shi ahã nyɛ fɛɛ, gbɔ kɛ maŋnyo fɛɛ, ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: When Moses finished speaking, the people did what the Lord had told Moses, and they stoned to death the man who had cursed the Lord.
translation_verse: Be ni Mose kɛ Israelbii lɛ ewie egbe naa lɛ, maŋbii lɛ mɔ oblanyo lɛ ni lomɔ lɛ kɛje amɛshitoohe lɛ mli kɛtee esɛɛ, ni ayatswia lɛ tɛ yɛ jɛi ni egbo. Belɛ kɛtsɔ̃ nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ fee nɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ afee lɛ.

english_verse: So when you buy or sell farmland, the price is to be determined by the number of crops it can produce before the next Year of Celebration. Don't try to cheat.
translation_verse: Adamɔ afii abɔ ni abaanyɛ ahu shikpɔŋ lɛ ni akpa enɔ nibaanii lɛ dani wɔsɛɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ ashɛ nɔ awo shikpɔŋ lɛ he jara.

english_verse: When Moses was on Mount Sinai, the Lord told him
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ

english_verse: This is a year of complete celebration, so don't plant any seed or harvest what your fields or vineyards produce.
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɛɛ atsɔ nyamɔ afi ahã nyɛ. Nyɛkadua nii yɛ enɔ; ni nyɛkakpaa niyenii ni shikpɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baaba ahã nyɛ lɛ nyɛtoa; asaŋ nyɛkakpaa nyɛwaintsei ni akpɔlɔɔɔ amɛhe lɛ anɔ yibii lɛ hu.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land that I am giving you, it must be allowed to rest one year out of every seven.
translation_verse: ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa shikpɔŋ lɛ akãa shi efolo afi koni ekɛjɔɔ ehe akɛ woo kɛhã Yehowa.

english_verse: but the seventh year you must let your fields and vineyards rest in honor of me, your Lord.
translation_verse: shi afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, aŋmɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ he koni ejɔɔ ehe kpoo, akɛ woo kɛhã Yehowa. Akadu nii yɛ ŋmɔshi, ni akakpɔlɔ waintsei ahe hu.

english_verse: This is to be a time of complete rest for your fields and vineyards, so don't harvest anything they produce.
translation_verse: Ŋmɔshinii ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eeekwɛ̃ lɛ, akakpa ato; ni yibii ni waintsei ni akpɔlɔko amɛhe lɛ aaawo lɛ hu, akakpa ato. Nakai afi lɛ eji hejɔɔmɔ afi hã shikpɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: However, you and your slaves and your hired workers, as well as any domestic or wild animals, may eat whatever grows on its own. The Year of Celebration The Lord said to his people:
translation_verse: kɛ nyɛshĩa kooloi kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yeli aahu. Niyenii fɛɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baaba lɛ aye.” Nikpɔ̃mɔ afi lɛ

english_verse: or uncle or cousin, or some other family member. In fact, if you ever get enough money, you may buy your own freedom
translation_verse: loo etsɛkwɛ̃ loo etsɛ loo enyɛ nyɛmibi loo ewekunyo ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ kpaakpa aya ayakpɔ̃ lɛ, loo kɛji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ena nɔ ko lɛ, ekpɔ̃ ehe.

english_verse: on the tenth day of the seventh month, which is also the Great Day of Forgiveness, trumpets are to be blown everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Afi nɛɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ, no ji Nikpɔ̃mɔ Gbi lɛ. Akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ kɛfo shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ yɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Gbi nɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: In this time of sacred celebration you may eat only what grows on its own.
translation_verse: Nyamɔ afi ni, ni nyɛyea lɛ akɛ afi krɔŋkrɔŋ. Nibaanii ni shikpɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baaba ahã nyɛ lɛ, no nyɛyea.

english_verse: During this year, all property must go back to its original owner.
translation_verse: “Nɛkɛ nyamɔ afi nɛɛ mli lɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kulɛ ehɔ̃ɔ lɛ, eya ni eyaŋɔ enii ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: If it is a long time before the next Year of Celebration, the price will be higher, because what is really being sold are the crops that the land can produce.
translation_verse: Kɛji afii lɛ fa lɛ, no lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ jara lɛ awa; ni kɛji afii lɛ faaa lɛ, no lɛ ejara lɛ aba shi, ejaakɛ afii lɛ amli nibaanii ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baawo lɛ ji nɔ ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ.

english_verse: If you obey my laws and teachings, you will live safely in the land and enjoy its abundant crops.
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ lɛ aaaba eniyenii, ni nyɛaaye nyɛtɔrɔ; ni nyɛaahi nɔ shweshweeshwe.

english_verse: Don't ever worry about what you will eat during the seventh year when you are forbidden to plant or harvest.
translation_verse: “Eko lɛ nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛji wɔduŋ nii, ni wɔkpãŋ ŋmɔshinii wɔtoŋ yɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ mɛni wɔɔye mɔ?’

english_verse: I will see to it that you harvest enough in the sixth year to last for three years.
translation_verse: Naa, mibajɔɔ afi ni ji ekpaa lɛ bɔ ni ebaaba afii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ niyenii shi kome.

english_verse: In the eighth year you will live on what you harvested in the sixth year, but in the ninth year you will eat what you plant and harvest in the eighth year.
translation_verse: Belɛ afi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ be mli ni nyɛdu nii lɛ, nyɛbaaye blema niyenii ni nyɛkpa nyɛto lɛ kɛyaashi afi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛaakpa enɔ nii ni nyɛdu lɛ. Nikpɔ̃mɔ lɛ

english_verse: No land may be permanently bought or sold. It all belongs to me—it isn't your land, and you only live there for a little while.
translation_verse: “Akafo shikpɔŋ yibaa ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ owura kosɛɛ, ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mi minɔ ni; ni nyɛ lɛ miwe kɛ mishĩa mli gbɔi kɛkɛ ji nyɛ.

english_verse: When property is being sold, the original owner must be given the first chance to buy it.
translation_verse: “Nyɛŋmɛa shikpɔŋ kpɔ̃mɔ hegbɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu ni nyɛyaaŋɔ lɛ nɔ he fɛɛ he.

english_verse: If any of you Israelites become so poor that you are forced to sell your property, your closest relative must buy it back,
translation_verse: Kɛji efi onyɛmi Israelnyo, ni no hewɔ lɛ, eehɔ̃ɔ egboshinii ko lɛ, ewekunyo ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ kpaakpa lɛ yɛ hegbɛ akɛ ebakpɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni enyɛmi lɛ hɔ̃ɔ lɛ.

english_verse: you must pay enough to make up for what the present owner will lose on it before the next Year of Celebration, when the property would become yours again.
translation_verse: no lɛ akane afii abɔ ni nii lɛ eye, kɛjɛ be ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ naa, koni mɔ ni hɔ̃ɔ nii lɛ awo afii abɔ ni eshwɛ dani wɔsɛɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ shɛɔ lɛ nyɔmɔ; kɛkɛ lɛ eku sɛɛ eŋɔ enii lɛ.

english_verse: But if you don't have the money to pay the present owner a fair price, you will have to wait until the Year of Celebration, when the property will once again become yours.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji mɔ ni hɔ̃ɔ nii lɛ nyɛɛɛ eyakpɔ̃ nii lɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, no lɛ nɔ ni ehɔ̃ɔ lɛ ahi mɔ ni he nii lɛ dɛŋ kɛyashi Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ, ni Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ mli lɛ nihelɔ lɛ aŋmɛɛ nii lɛ he, koni nɔtsɛ lɛ aŋɔ enii lɛ ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: If you sell a house in a walled city, you have only one year in which to buy it back.
translation_verse: “Kɛji mɔ ko hɔ̃ɔ eshĩa ni yɔɔ maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he mli lɛ, eyɛ hegbɛ kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni ehɔ̃ɔ shĩa lɛ kɛyashi enɔ afi naakplɔ ni ekpɔ̃ɔ shĩa lɛ.

english_verse: If you don't buy it back before that year is up, it becomes the permanent property of the one who bought it, and it will not be returned to you in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji akpɔ̃ɔɔ shĩa nɛɛ kɛyashi afi muu ho lɛ, no lɛ shĩa nɛɛ ni yɔɔ maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he lɛ etsɔ̃ mɔ ni he shĩa lɛ kɛ eshwiei agboshinii kɛmiiya naanɔ. Kɛji shɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ tete lɛ, ekaŋmɛɛ he ehã mɔ ni hɔ̃ɔ lɛ.

english_verse: But a house out in a village may be bought back at any time just like a field. And it must be returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Shi tsui ni yɔɔ akrowai ni atswako gbogbo awoko amɛhe amli lɛ, abu amɛ tamɔ ŋmɔji ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. Abaanyɛ akpɔ̃ amɛ be fɛɛ be; ni Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ lɛ aŋmɛɛ amɛhe ahã tsutsu nɔtsɛmɛi lɛ.

english_verse: If any Levites own houses inside a walled city, they will always have the right to buy them back.
translation_verse: Shi yɛ Levibii amaji ni ahã amɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ amli shĩai lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, Levibii lɛ yɛ hegbɛ akɛ amɛkpɔ̃ɔ eko fɛɛ eko ni ahɔ̃ɔ be fɛɛ be.

english_verse: And any houses that they do not buy back will be returned to them in the Year of Celebration, because these homes are their permanent property among the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Kɛji Levinyo ko kpɔ̃ɔɔ shĩa ko ni ehɔ̃ɔ kɛyashi Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ aŋmɛɛ shĩa ni ahɔ̃ɔ yɛ Levibii amaŋ lɛ mli lɛ he ahã lɛ, ejaakɛ shĩai ni yɔɔ Levibii amaji lɛ amli lɛ, nomɛi ji Levibii lɛ agbɛfaŋnii ni amɛyɔɔ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ.

english_verse: No pastureland owned by the Levi tribe can ever be sold; it is their permanent possession. Help for the Poor The Lord said:
translation_verse: Shi amɛmaji lɛ ahe shikpɔji lɛ akahɔ̃ɔ eko kɔkɔɔkɔ, ejaakɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ ni kɛmiiya naanɔ.” Shika ni akɛfaa ohiafoi

english_verse: If any of your people become poor and unable to support themselves, you must help them, just as you are supposed to help foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: “Kɛji onyɛmi Israelnyo ni yɔɔ omasɛi ye ohia bɔ ni enyɛɛɛ ehe ekwɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, omɔ mli ohã lɛ ni okwɛ lɛ; okɛ lɛ ahi shi akɛ gbɔ ni ebadɔmɔ bo.

english_verse: Don't take advantage of them by charging any kind of interest or selling them food for profit. Instead, honor me by letting them stay where they now live.
translation_verse: Kaahe lɛ oshika ni okɛfa lɛ lɛ he kpa; ni oniyenii ni ohãa lɛ lɛ hu kaaŋmɛ ejara nɔ.

english_verse: Remember—I am the Lord your God! I rescued you from Egypt and gave you the land of Canaan, so that I would be your God.
translation_verse: Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie nyɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni maŋɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ mahã nyɛ, ni matsɔ̃ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.” Nyɔji aheyeli

english_verse: Suppose some of your people become so poor that they have to sell themselves and become your slaves.
translation_verse: “Kɛji onyɛmi Israelnyo ni yɔɔ omasɛi ye ohia bɔ ni no hã ehɔ̃ɔ ehe ehã bo lɛ, okaye lɛ nyɔŋ,

english_verse: Then you must treat them as servants, rather than as slaves. And in the Year of Celebration they are to be set free,
translation_verse: shi moŋ etsɔ̃ tamɔ apaafonyo loo gbɔ ni ebadɔmɔ bo. Esɔmɔ bo kɛyashi Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: so they and their children may return home to their families and property.
translation_verse: Kɛji eshɛ nakai afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, lɛ kɛ ebii kɛ hɔi fɛɛ ashi oŋɔɔ, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛya amɛwekumɛi ateŋ kɛ eseshibii anɔ mli ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: I brought them out of Egypt to be my servants, not to be sold as slaves.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ mitsuji ni mijie amɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ji amɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, ebɛ akɛ ahɔ̃ɔ amɛteŋ mɔ ko akɛ nyɔŋ.

english_verse: So obey me, and don't be cruel to the poor.
translation_verse: Okaye amɛnɔ kɛ yiwalɛ; shi oshe oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbeyei.

english_verse: or from the foreigners who live in your own country, and make them your property.
translation_verse: Nyɛbaanyɛ hu ni nyɛhe nyɔji kɛjɛ gbɔi ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ abii ni afɔ yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ koni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ nyɛgboshinii;

english_verse: You can own them, and even leave them to your children when you die, but do not make slaves of your own people or be cruel to them.
translation_verse: ni nyɛaanyɛ nyɛshi amɛ nyɛhã nyɛbii akɛ amɛgboshinii. Amɛ lɛ nyɛaanyɛ nyɛye amɛ nyɔŋ, shi nyɛnyɛmimɛi Israel fɔmɔbii lɛ, amɛ lɛ, akaye amɛteŋ mɔ ko nɔ kɛ yiwalɛ.

english_verse: Even if some of you Israelites become so much in debt that you must sell yourselves to foreigners in your country,
translation_verse: “Kɛji gbɔ ko loo mɔkpɔŋ ko ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ tsɔ̃ niiatsɛ; shi onyɛmi Israelnyo ni yɔɔ emasɛi lɛ ye ohia bɔ ni no hã ehɔ̃ɔ ehe ehã gbɔ loo mɔkpɔŋ lɛ loo gbɔ lɛ wekunyo ko lɛ,

english_verse: you still have the right to be set free by a relative, such as a brother
translation_verse: gbɔmɔ nɛɛ hehɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, hegbɛ yɛ lolo akɛ akpɔ̃ɔ lɛ. Esa akɛ enyɛmi nuu ko,

english_verse: And even while you are the slaves of foreigners in your own country, your people must make sure that you are not mistreated.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni he lɛ lɛ abu lɛ tamɔ apaafonyo ni miitsu afi nii yɛ ekɛ lɛ shihilɛ mli. Enuŋtsɔ lɛ akaye enɔ kɛ yiwalɛ.

english_verse: If you cannot gain your freedom in any of these ways, both you and your children will still be set free in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Kɛji gbɔmɔ nɛɛ naaa mɔ ko atsɔ̃ gbɛi nɛɛ eko nɔ ni ebakpɔ̃ lɛ lɛ, no lɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ lɛ aŋmɛɛ ehe ni eye ehe, lɛ kɛ ebii ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: People of Israel, I am the Lord your God, and I brought you out of Egypt to be my own servants.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ mitsuji ni; amɛ ji mitsuji ni mijie yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: Respect the Sabbath and honor the place where I am worshiped, because I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛyea gbii juji ni mito lɛ, ni nyɛhiɛ asɔa he ni ajaa mi yɛ lɛ. Mi ji Yehowa.

english_verse: and I will send rain to make your crops grow and your trees produce fruit.
translation_verse: mahã nu anɛ ahã nyɛ yɛ be ni sa mli, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baaba nii babaoo ahã nyɛ, ni ŋmɔshi tsei hu baawo yibii.

english_verse: I will bless your country with peace, and you will rest without fear. I will wipe out the dangerous animals and protect you from enemy attacks.
translation_verse: “Mahã jeŋ ajɔ yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni nyɛaakamɔ shi nyɛwɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko woŋ nyɛhe gbeyei. Mahã kooloi fɔ̃ji atã yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni awuŋ ta yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: You will chase and destroy your enemies,
translation_verse: Nyɛaawo nyɛhenyɛlɔi foi, ni amɛaanyɔnyɔi yɛ nyɛhiɛ yɛ klante naa.

english_verse: I will treat you with such kindness that your nation will grow strong, and I will also keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Madro nyɛ, ni mahã nyɛwo shwiei ni nyɛyi afa; ni maye mi kɛ nyɛ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: I will live among you and never again look on you with disgust.
translation_verse: Mahi nyɛteŋ yɛ miBuu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, ni minyaŋeŋ nyɛ.

english_verse: I will walk with you—I will be your God, and you will be my people.
translation_verse: Manyiɛ nyɛteŋ, ni matsɔ̃ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ, ni nyɛ hu nyɛaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I rescued you from Egypt, so that you would never again be slaves. I have set you free; now walk with your heads held high. Punishment for Disobeying the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie nyɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni nyɛkahi shi akɛ amɛnyɔji dɔŋŋ lɛ. Mikumɔ tsei ni akɛwo nyɛ apã lɛ, ni mihã nyɛnyiɛ ni apã kãaa nyɛkuɛ.” Toigbele he toigbalamɔ (Deuteronomio

english_verse: If you disobey me and my laws, and if you break our agreement,
translation_verse: ni kɛji nyɛkwa mikpɔi lɛ, ni nyɛnyaŋe mimlai lɛ, ni nyɛyeee mikitãi lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛku mi kɛ nyɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ,

english_verse: I will punish you terribly, and you will be ruined. You will be struck with incurable diseases and with fever that leads to blindness and depression. Your enemies will eat the crops you plant,
translation_verse: mi hu nɔ ni mibafee nyɛ nɛ: Mibahã tsuifãa saji abahɛŋ nyɛ trukaa, ni wɔlɔmɔ kɛ atridii ni hãa hiŋmɛi fiteɔ, ni etãa gbɔmɔtso loo baaye nyɛ. Nyɛbaagbo deŋme yaka nyɛdu nii ejaakɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi moŋ baaba abaye.

english_verse: and I will turn from you and let you be destroyed by your attackers. You will even run at the very rumor of attack.
translation_verse: Majie mihiɛ maka nyɛ, ni nyɛhenyɛlɔi baaye nyɛnɔ, ni mɛi ni hetsɛ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ aaaye nyɛnɔ bɔ sɔŋŋ, ni nyɛbaawo foi be mli ni mɔ ko mɔ ko enyiɛɛɛ nyɛsɛɛ.

english_verse: Then, if you still refuse to obey me, I will punish you seven times for each of your sins,
translation_verse: “Ni kɛji enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, nyɛbooo mi toi lolo lɛ, no lɛ mibagbala nyɛtoi ekoŋŋ shii kpawo yɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ahewɔ,

english_verse: until your pride is completely crushed. I will hold back the rain, so the sky above you will be like iron, and the ground beneath your feet will be like copper.
translation_verse: ni maku nyɛhe ni nyɛwoɔ kɛ kuɛŋtilɛ lɛ naa, ni mahã ŋwɛi agbi tamɔ dade, ni nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ hu nɔ aaagbi tamɔ akɔɔble,

english_verse: All of your hard work will be for nothing—and there will be no harvest of grain or fruit.
translation_verse: ni nyɛaagbo yaka deŋme ejaakɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ baŋ niyenii, ni enɔ tsei lɛ hu woŋ yibii.

english_verse: If you keep rebelling against me, I'll punish you seven times worse, just as your sins deserve!
translation_verse: “Kɛji nyɛfeee nɔ ni mi mitaoɔ, ni nyɛtee nɔ nyɛbooo mi toi lɛ, mayanɔ magbala nyɛtoi shii kpawo fe tsutsu lɛ yɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ anaa.

english_verse: I'll send wild animals to attack you, and they will gobble up your children and livestock. So few of you will be left that your roads will be deserted.
translation_verse: Maŋmɛɛ ŋaŋ kooloi ahe mawo nyɛteŋ, ni amɛbaagbegbee nyɛbii, ni amɛbaakpãtã nyɛshĩa kooloi ahiɛ, ni amɛbaahã nyɛ nɔ agbɔ, bɔ ni nane baaje nyɛgbɛjegbɛi anɔ.

english_verse: War will break out because you broke our agreement, and if you escape to your walled cities, I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and you will be captured by your enemies.
translation_verse: Mahã ta abanina nyɛ koni atsɔ̃ no nɔ kɛgbala nyɛtoi, kɛtɔ mi kɛ nyɛ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mlikuu he owele. Kɛji nyɛbua nyɛhe naa yɛ nyɛmaji wuji amli, yɛ shweshweeshwefeemɔ hewɔ hu lɛ, mibahã gbele hela abote nyɛteŋ, ni nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anine aaashɛ nyɛnɔ.

english_verse: You will have such a shortage of bread, that ten women will be able to bake their bread in the same oven. Each of you will get only a few crumbs, and you will go hungry.
translation_verse: Mafo nyɛŋmãa ni nyɛnaa nyɛyeɔ sɛɛ lɛ; ni no baahã yei nyɔŋma ashã aboloo fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ shãa lɛ yɛ flɔnɔɔ kome pɛ mli. Aboloo lɛ hu abaaŋmɛ kɛ nsɛni ahã nyɛ nyɛye; ni nyɛaaye nɛ shi nyɛtɔrɔŋ.

english_verse: I'll really get furious and punish you terribly for your sins!
translation_verse: no lɛ mi hu mate shi mawo nyɛ kɛ mlila, ni magbala nyɛtoi shii kpawo fe tsutsu lɛ yɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: In fact, you will be so desperate for food that you will eat your own children.
translation_verse: “Hɔmɔ naa lɛ nyɛbaagbe nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei, nyɛye.

english_verse: I'll destroy your shrines and tear down your incense altars, leaving your dead bodies piled on top of your idols. And you will be disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Mibafite hei ni nyɛjaa yɛ, yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, kɛ ohɛ afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ; ni mibashɛrɛ nyɛgbohii lɛ mashwie nyɛmãgãi ni akumɔ ashwie shi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: I'll wipe out your towns and your places of worship and will no longer be pleased with the smell of your sacrifices.
translation_verse: Mahã nyɛmaji lɛ atsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃i, ni mafite nyɛjamɔhei lɛ hu; ni mihereŋ nyɛtsofakɛŋma lɛ ŋma dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Your land will become so desolate that even your enemies who settle there will be shocked when they see it.
translation_verse: Makpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ bɔ ni nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ni aaabahi nɔ lɛ tete ahiɛ aaafee amɛ yaa.

english_verse: After I destroy your towns and ruin your land with war, I'll scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ mahã ta abanina nyɛ, ni magbɛ nyɛ mashwã majimaji ni yɔɔ jeŋ lɛ anɔ. Gbɔmɛi baatã yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛmaji lɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃i.

english_verse: While you are prisoners in foreign lands, your own land will enjoy years of rest and refreshment, as it should have done each seventh year when you lived there.
translation_verse: Gbii abɔ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ kã shi efolo ni ahuuu nɔ lɛ, belɛ ehejɔɔmɔ ni nyɛhã ŋmɛɛ lɛ be ni nyɛyɔɔ enɔ lɛ, no eyeɔ lɛ.

english_verse: In the land of your enemies, you will tremble at the rustle of a leaf, as though it were a sword. And you will become so weak that you will stumble and fall over each other, even when no one is chasing you.
translation_verse: Ni amɛaagbeegbee shi, mɔ ko kã mɔ ko nɔ tamɔ mɛi ni miijo klante naa foi gbeɔ shi, tsɛbelɛ mɔ ko woko amɛ foi; ni nyɛnyɛŋ nyɛhenyɛlɔi ahiɛ nyɛdamɔ.

english_verse: and others of you will waste away in sorrow as the result of your sins and the sins of your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛteŋ mɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ, mligbigblimɔ sɔŋŋ baagbegbee nyɛ yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ anɔ yɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ahewɔ. Nakai nɔŋŋ hu nyɛaagbigbli nyɛmli tamɔ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛyaashi nyɛaagboi tamɔ amɛ.

english_verse: Then suppose you realize that I turned against you and brought you to the land of your enemies because both you and your ancestors had stubbornly sinned against me. If you humbly confess what you have done and start living right,
translation_verse: ni no hewɔ hu mi hu mite shi miwo amɛ, ni mihã amɛyaje amɛhenyɛlɔi shikpɔŋ nɔ lɛ, kɛji amɛtsui ni ekpiliŋ lɛ he jɔ, ni amɛba amɛhe shi, ni amɛkpɛlɛ̃ amɛnifɔɔji lɛ ahe nyɔmɔwoo lɛ nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: I'll keep the promise I made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will bless your land
translation_verse: no lɛ mibakai mi kɛ Yakob teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ mi kɛ Isak teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ hu, kɛ mi kɛ Abraham teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ hu, ni mibakai amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and let it rest during the time that you are in a foreign country, paying for your rebellion against me and my laws.
translation_verse: Shi ja amɛhã shikpɔŋ lɛ kã shi efolo ni ahuuu nɔ, koni shikpɔŋ lɛ ana aye ehejɔɔmɔ be lɛ. No sɛɛ lɛ, ja agbala amɛtoi kɛwo amɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ ahe nyɔmɔ, ejaakɛ amɛkwa mimlai lɛ, ni amɛnyaŋe mikpɔi lɛ.

english_verse: No matter what you have done, I am still the Lord your God, and I will never completely reject you or become absolutely disgusted with you there in the land of your enemies.
translation_verse: Enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, be mli ni amɛyɔɔ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tete lɛ, mikwaŋ amɛ, ni minyaŋeŋ amɛ bɔ ni no baahã makpãtã amɛhiɛ kwraa kɛku mi kɛ amɛteŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: While nations watched, I rescued your ancestors from Egypt so that I would be their God. Yes, I am your Lord, and I will never forget our agreement.
translation_verse: Shi amɛhewɔ lɛ, mibakai mi kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ, amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ni mijie yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ majimaji lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, koni matsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Mi ji Yehowa.”

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws and teachings for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Akpɔi kɛ kitãi kɛ mlai ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ewo yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni ekã lɛ, Yehowa, kɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ ji enɛɛmɛi.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If you ever want to free someone who has been promised to me,
translation_verse: ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko je gbɛ, ni ewo shi krɛdɛɛ, ni ejɔɔ gbɔmɛi komɛi anɔ ekɛke Yehowa koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ jamɔhe lɛ, jara ni abaawo yɛ amɛyi kɛkpɔ̃ amɛ nɛ:

english_verse: you may do so by paying the following amounts, weighed according to the official standards:
translation_verse: Ni mɛi ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛyaa lɛ, nuu yi jara ji jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ, yoo hu yi jara ji jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋma.

english_verse: Ten percent of everything you harvest is holy and belongs to me, whether it grows in your fields or on your fruit trees.
translation_verse: “Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii fɛɛ lɛ, ŋmãa ni jio, aduawai ni jio, amɛmlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ Yehowa nɔ ni; nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.

english_verse: If you have promised to give someone to me and can't afford to pay the full amount for that person's release, you will be taken to a priest, and he will decide how much you can afford.
translation_verse: “Kɛji mɔ ni wo shi lɛ ohiafo ni, ni enyɛɛɛ jara ni afo lɛ ewo lɛ, no lɛ ekpala gbɔmɔ ni ejɔɔ enɔ eke Yehowa lɛ kɛya osɔfo lɛ hiɛ koni osɔfo lɛ awo egbɔmɔ lɛ yi jara. Osɔfo lɛ adamɔ bɔ ni mɔ ni wo shi lɛ aaana ahã nɔ kɛwo jara lɛ.

english_verse: If you promise to sacrifice an animal to me, it becomes holy, and there is no way you can set it free.
translation_verse: “Shi kɛji shĩa kooloo ji nɔ ni awo ehe shi ajɔɔ enɔ akɛhã Yehowa lɛ, no lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛhãa Yehowa lɛ, etsɔ̃ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ.

english_verse: Donkeys are unfit for sacrifice, so if you promise me a donkey, you must bring it to the priest,
translation_verse: Shi kɛji kooloo lɛ yafee kooloo ni he tseee, ni no hewɔ lɛ, akɛshãaa afɔle ahãaa Yehowa lɛ eko ni lɛ, no lɛ mɔ ni wo shi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ aya osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ.

english_verse: If you promise a house to me, a priest will set the price, whatever the condition of the house.
translation_verse: “Kɛji mɔ ko jɔɔ eshĩa nɔ eke Yehowa lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akwɛ nibii ni hi kɛ nibii ni ehiii fɛɛ yɛ shĩa lɛ he koni ewo ejara; ni jara ni osɔfo lɛ baawo lɛ aŋɔ nɔ nakai.

english_verse: If you promise part of your family's land to me, its value must be determined by the amount of seed needed to plant the land, and the rate will be ten pieces of silver for every
translation_verse: “Kɛji mɔ ko jɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni ji egboshinii nɔ ekɛke Yehowa lɛ, akwɛ dumɔ wui ni shikpɔŋ lɛ yeɔ falɛ kɛwo shikpɔŋ lɛ jara. Tɛ nɔ ni adamɔ kɛwo jara lɛ ji akoko kiloi nyɔŋmai enyɔ akɛhe jwiɛtɛi shekel nyɔŋma.

english_verse: If this promise is made in the Year of Celebration, the land will be valued at the full price.
translation_verse: Kɛji Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afiyeli lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ ni ejɔɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eke lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ jara lɛ adamɔ jara bɔ ni awo lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: But any time after that, the price will be figured according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Kɛji afiyeli lɛ sɛɛ dani ejɔɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eke lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ abu afii abɔ ni eshwɛ dani eshɛɔ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi ekoŋŋ yɛ shika mli koni akɛtse jara ni awo lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: When the Year of Celebration comes, the land becomes holy because it belongs to me, and it will be given to the priests.
translation_verse: Ni kɛji eshɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ, ni aŋmɛɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ he tete lɛ, ebaahi shi akɛ Yehowa nɔ, nɔ ko ni ajɔɔ nɔ owura kosɛɛ ake Yehowa; ebaatsɔ̃ osɔfo lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: If you promise me a field that you have bought,
translation_verse: “Kɛji mɔ ko jɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni jeee gbo agbo ashi ahã lɛ, shi etse shika ekɛhe, nɔ ehã Yehowa lɛ,

english_verse: its value will be decided by a priest, according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration, and the money you pay will be mine.
translation_verse: no lɛ osɔfo lɛ abu shikpɔŋ lɛ jara lɛ naa kɛyashi Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ ehã mɔ lɛ, ni mɔ lɛ awo shika nɛɛ yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ akɛ shika lɛ ahã Yehowa akɛ enii yinii.

english_verse: However, on the next Year of Celebration, the land will go back to the family of its original owner.
translation_verse: Ni Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ lɛ akpale shikpɔŋ lɛ ahã mɔ dɛŋ ni ahe yɛ lɛ koni etsɔ̃ enɔ ekoŋŋ akɛ shikpɔŋ ni ji egboshinii.

english_verse: Every price will be set by the official standards. Various Offerings The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Tɛ nɔ ni adamɔ kɛwo jara fɛɛ jara afee He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ jwiɛtɛi tɛ lɛ naa; no ji akɛ gerai nyɔŋmai enyɔ afee shekel kome.

english_verse: All first-born animals of your flocks and herds are already mine, and so you cannot promise any of them to me.
translation_verse: “Shi kooloi fɛɛ akromɔbii ni ji Yehowa nii momo lɛ, mɔ ko akajɔɔ eko nɔ ekɛmiike Yehowa: tsina ni jio, too ni jio, Yehowa nɔ ni momo.

english_verse: Anything that you completely dedicate to me must be completely destroyed. It cannot be bought back or sold. Every person, animal, and piece of property that you dedicate completely is only for me.
translation_verse: “Shi moŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mɔ ko yɔɔ, gbɔmɔ ni jio, kooloo ni jio, shikpɔŋ ni agbo ashi ahã lɛ ni jio, ni ejɔɔ nɔ tswaa ekɛke Yehowa lɛ, akahɔ̃ɔ, ni akakpɔ̃ kɔkɔɔkɔ, ejaakɛ nɔ lɛ eji Yehowa nii kɛmiiya naanɔ.

english_verse: In fact, any humans who have been promised to me in this way must be put to death.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ adesa tete ni akɛ lɛ eke koni akpãtã ehiɛ kɛje gbɔmɛi ateŋ lɛ, akakpɔ̃ lɛ; ana agbe lɛ kɛ̃.

english_verse: If you want to buy back this part of your harvest, you may do so by paying what it is worth plus an additional
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ko sumɔ akɛ ekpɔ̃ egbɛfaŋ nibii lɛ mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ eko lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome agbe yi kɛwo nyɔmɔ.

english_verse: When you count your flocks and herds, one out of ten of every newborn animal is holy and belongs to me,
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ ji tsinai kɛ toi: no ji kooloi fɛɛ ni akpalaa amɛ lɛ amɛyikulɛ nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ eji Yehowa nɔ.

english_verse: no matter how good or bad it is. If you substitute one animal for another, both of them become holy, and neither can be bought back.
translation_verse: Akakpa mli akwɛ akɛ kooloo lɛ ehi aloo ehiii; ni akatsake hu. Kɛji mɔ ko aaatsake eko kɛ̃ lɛ, no lɛ no kɛ lɛ kooloo hee ni akɛbaatsake emomo lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm baatsɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ; akakpɔ̃ kooloo lɛ.”

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Enɛɛmɛi ji kitãi ni Yehowa fã Mose yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ ewo Israelbii lɛ.

english_verse: The people of Israel had left Egypt and were living in the Sinai Desert. Then on the first day of the second month of the second year, when Moses was in the sacred tent the Lord said:
translation_verse: Israelbii lɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shimɔ sɛɛ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ mli nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Mose wie yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli yɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,

english_verse: I want you and Aaron to find out how many people are in each of Israel's clans and families. And make a list of all the men
translation_verse: kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa, ni ji mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa. Bo kɛ Aaron akane mɛi lɛ yɛ amɛsafoi anaa.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with these twelve tribal leaders,
translation_verse: Mose kɛ Aaron ŋɔ hii ni atsi amɛgbɛii atã nɛɛ amɛfata amɛhe,

english_verse: called together the people that same day. They were counted according to their clans and families. Then Moses and the others listed the names of the men twenty years and older,
translation_verse: ni amɛbua Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ, ni amɛŋmala maŋbii lɛ agbɛii yɛ amɛwekui lɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa. Hii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa lɛ aŋmala amɛgbɛii ni akane amɛyibɔ.

english_verse: The people of Israel did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Israelbii lɛ fee lɛ.

english_verse: But the Levites will camp around the sacred tent to make sure that no one goes near it and makes me furious with the Israelites.
translation_verse: Shi Levibii lɛ ashishii amɛbui lɛ kɛbɔle miKpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ; amɛbu he bɔ ni afee ni mɔ folo ko akabɛŋkɛ Buu lɛ ni no yatsɛ mimlifu bahã Israelbii lɛ.”

english_verse: But those from the Levi tribe were not included
translation_verse: Shi Levibii lɛ akaneee amɛ ashiii akutsei krokomɛi lɛ anɔ,

english_verse: because the Lord had said to Moses:
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: When you count the Israelites, do not include those from the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: “Kɛji okane Israelbii lɛ ayikulɛ lɛ, okakane Levibii lɛ oshi nɔ.

english_verse: Instead, give them the job of caring for the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the objects used for worship. They will camp around the tent, and whenever you move, they will take it down, carry it to the new camp, and set it up again. Anyone else who tries to go near it must be put to death.
translation_verse: Kɛji maŋ lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, Levibii lɛ afã Buu lɛ, ni kɛji shɛ be ni abaashi Buu lɛ, Levibii lɛ nɔŋŋ ashi. Mɔ folo fɛɛ mɔ folo ni aaabɛŋkɛ Buu lɛ agbe lɛ.

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites will camp in their own groups and under their own banners.
translation_verse: Kɛji ashɛ shitoohe ko lɛ, Israelbii fɛɛ ashi amɛbuui yɛ amɛsafo kuikui lɛ anaa. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ buu ahi esafo shitoohe mli, ni asaŋ yɛ etsɛmɛi awe aflaŋaa shishi.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ,

english_verse: how the Israelites should arrange their camp: Each tribe must set up camp under its own banner and under the flags of its ancestral families. These camps will be arranged around the sacred tent, but not close to it.
translation_verse: “Kɛji ashɛ shitoohe ko lɛ, Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ashi ebuu yɛ esafo shitoohe, yɛ etsɛmɛi awe aflaŋaa lɛ shishi. Amãmɔ bui fɛɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ ŋlɛnɔ kɛbɔle lɛ kpula kɛkpe.

english_verse: Judah and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the east side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The
translation_verse: Ta ni yɔɔ eshishi lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai ekpaa.

english_verse: On one side of Judah will be the tribe of Issachar, with Nethanel son of Zuar as the leader of its
translation_verse: ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai ejwɛ lɛ.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Zebulun, with Eliab son of Helon as the leader of its
translation_verse: Eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ kpawo kɛ ohai ejwɛ.

english_verse: Reuben and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the south side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The
translation_verse: ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekpaa kɛ ohai enumɔ.

english_verse: On one side of Reuben will be the tribe of Simeon, with Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai as the leader of its
translation_verse: ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ nɛɛhu kɛ ohai etɛ̃.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Gad, with Eliasaph son of Deuel as the leader of its
translation_verse: ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ kɛ ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.

english_verse: Marching behind Reuben will be the Levites, arranged in groups, just as they are camped. They will carry the sacred tent and their own banners.
translation_verse: “Kɛkɛ lɛ Levibii lɛ kɛ Kpee Buu lɛ hu baafã kɛnyiɛ klɛŋklɛŋ asafoi wuji enyɔ lɛ kɛ naagbee asafoi wuji enyɔ lɛ ateŋ. Bɔ ni ato naa abato shi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ abaato naa kɛfã nyiɛmɔ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ anyiɛ egbɛhe yɛ aflaŋaa shishi.

english_verse: Ephraim and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the west side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The
translation_verse: ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ohai enumɔ.

english_verse: On one side of Ephraim will be the tribe of Manasseh, with Gamaliel son of Pedahzur as the leader of its
translation_verse: ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai enyɔ.

english_verse: So all the Israelites in the camp were counted according to their ancestral families. The troops were arranged by divisions and totaled
translation_verse: Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ni akane yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ kɛ amɛsafoi lɛ anaa yɛ amɛshitoohei lɛ amli naa shiɔ mɛi akpei ohai ekpaa kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ ohai enumɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Benjamin, with Abidan son of Gideoni as the leader of its
translation_verse: ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enumɔ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.

english_verse: Dan and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the north side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The
translation_verse: ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai kpawo.

english_verse: On one side of Dan will be the tribe of Asher, with Pagiel son of Ochran as the leader of its
translation_verse: ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekome kɛ ohai enumɔ.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Naphtali with Ahira son of Enan as the leader of its
translation_verse: Eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.

english_verse: The only Israelites not included were the Levites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Shi akaneee Levibii lɛ ashiii Israelbii krokomɛi lɛ anɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ efee lɛ.

english_verse: Israel did everything the Lord had told Moses. They arranged their camp according to clans and families, with each tribe under its own banner. And that was the order by which they marched into battle.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fee bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ afee lɛ. Kɛji ashɛ shitoohe lɛ, amɛtoɔ shi yɛ amɛflaŋaai lɛ ashishi; ni kɛji amɛfã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, amɛnyiɛɔ yɛ tsɛmɛiawei lɛ anaa.

english_verse: Aaron's four sons, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar,
translation_verse: Aaron bihii lɛ ji Nadab, ekromɔbi lɛ, kɛ Abihu kɛ Eleazar kɛ Itamar.

english_verse: were the ones to be ordained as priests.
translation_verse: Aaron fɔ ebihii nɛɛ mu, ni ewo amɛ osɔfo koni amɛtsu osɔfoyeli nitsumɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord killed Nadab and Abihu in the Sinai Desert when they used fire that was unacceptable in their offering to the Lord. And because Nadab and Abihu had no sons, only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests with their father Aaron. The Duties of the Levites
translation_verse: Shi Nadab kɛ Abihu gboi be ni amɛhiɛ la ko ni he tseee kɛtee Yehowa hiɛ be ni ayɔɔ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ. Amɛshiii bii. Eleazar kɛ Itamar pɛ sɔ̃mɔ akɛ osɔfoi yɛ amɛtsɛ Aaron walabeiaŋ. Ato Levibii lɛ akɛ osɔfoi lɛ awalɔi

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: who have been appointed to be priests. Anyone else who tries to perform the duties of a priest must be put to death.
translation_verse: Ojɔɔ osɔfoyeli lɛ nɔ ohã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ pɛ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaajɛ sɛɛ efee ehe osɔfo lɛ agbe lɛ.”

english_verse: Moses, I have chosen these Levites from all Israel, and they will belong to me in a special way. When I killed the first-born sons of the Egyptians, I decided that the first-born sons in every Israelite family and the first-born males of their flocks and herds would be mine. But now I accept these Levites in place of the first-born sons of the Israelites. The Levites Are Counted
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ gbi ni migbe Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kromɔbii fɛɛ lɛ, mijɔɔ Israelbii akromɔbii fɛɛ anɔ mihã mihe, kɛjɛ gbɔmɔ kromɔbi nɔ kɛyashi shĩa kooloo kromɔbi nɔ. Minii ji amɛ fɛɛ. Mi ji Yehowa.” Levibii lɛ akanemɔ

english_verse: In the Sinai Desert the Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ Mose wie yɛ Sinai shiaŋa lɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,

english_verse: “Now I want you to count the men and boys in the Levi tribe by families and by clans. Include every one at least a month old.”
translation_verse: “Kanemɔ Levi we lɛ hii fɛɛ kɛjɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu ni eye nyɔŋ kome nɔ kɛyaa, yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ kɛ amɛwekui anaa.”

english_verse: So Moses obeyed and counted them.
translation_verse: Mose kane amɛ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Levi's three sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, had become the heads of their own clans.
translation_verse: Levi fɔ bihii etɛ̃, ni amɛgbɛii ji Gershon kɛ Kohat kɛ Merari.

english_verse: Gershon's sons were Libni and Shimei.
translation_verse: Gershon bihii lɛ agbɛii yɛ amɛwekui anaa ji Libni kɛ Shimei.

english_verse: And Merari's sons were Mahli and Mushi. These were the sons and grandsons of Levi, and they had become the leaders of the Levite clans.
translation_verse: ni Merari bihii enyɔ lɛ agbɛii yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa ji Maheli kɛ Mushi. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Levibii lɛ awekui lɛ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa.

english_verse: The two Gershon clans were the Libnites and Shimeites,
translation_verse: Gershon shwiei lɛ ji Libnibii lɛ kɛ Shimeibii lɛ.

english_verse: The Gershonites, under the leadership of Eliasaph son of Lael, were to camp on the west side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Amɛwekui lɛ fɛɛ amli wekunukpa lɛ ji Eliasaf, Lael bi lɛ.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the tent itself, along with its outer covering, the curtain for the entrance,
translation_verse: Amɛ amɛdɛŋ atu nibii nɛɛ anɔkwɛmɔ kɛ kuramɔ awo: Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, kɛ buu lɛ yiteŋ nɔhaanɔ lɛ, kɛ eshinaa lɛ naa mama lɛ,

english_verse: the curtains hanging inside the courtyard around the tent, as well as the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard and its altar. The Gershonites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: kɛ kpo ni bɔle Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ fɛɛ kpula lɛ he mamai lɛ, kɛ mamai lɛ ahe taŋkpei lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ agbo lɛ naa mama lɛ hu. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kɔɔ nibii nɛɛ ahe lɛ amɛnitsumɔ ni.

english_verse: The four Kohath clans were the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites, and the Uzzielites,
translation_verse: Kohat shwiei lɛ ji Amrambii lɛ kɛ Izeharbii lɛ kɛ Hebronbii lɛ kɛ Uzielbii lɛ. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Kohatbii lɛ.

english_verse: The Kohathites, under the leadership of Elizaphan son of Uzziel, were to camp on the south side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Amɛwekui lɛ fɛɛ amli onukpa lɛ ji Elizafan, Uziel bi lɛ.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the sacred chest, the table for the sacred bread, the lampstand, the altars, the objects used for worship, and the curtain in front of the most holy place. The Kohathites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: Nibii ni atu awo amɛdɛŋ ji Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, kɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ, kɛ kanetso lɛ, kɛ afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ, kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni osɔfoi lɛ kɛ sɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ muhɔɔ lɛŋ lɛ. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kɔɔ nibii nɛɛ ahe lɛ amɛnitsumɔ ni.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron was the head of the Levite leaders, and he made sure that the work at the sacred tent was done.
translation_verse: Levibii lɛ anukpa fe fɛɛ ji Eleazar, Osɔfo Aaron bi lɛ; ni lɛ ekwɛɔ mɛi ni tsuɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ nitsumɔi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: The two Merari clans were the Mahlites and the Mushites,
translation_verse: Merari shwiei lɛ ji Mahelibii lɛ kɛ Mushibii lɛ. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Meraribii lɛ.

english_verse: The Merarites, under the leadership of Zuriel son of Abihail, were to camp on the north side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Meraribii nɛɛ awekui lɛ fɛɛ awekunukpa lɛ ji Zuriel, Abihail bi lɛ. Ahã Meraribii nɛɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ koŋ nɔ kɛyaa kooyigbɛ akɛ amɛshihilɛhe koni amɛmãmɔ amɛbui lɛ yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and his sons were to camp in front of the sacred tent, on the east side, and to make sure that the Israelites worshiped in the proper way. Anyone else who tried to do the work of Moses and Aaron was to be put to death.
translation_verse: Shi mɛi ni baamãmɔ amɛbui yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ bokãgbɛ ni amɛkɛ jɛi afee amɛshihilɛhe ji Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ. He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli sɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ kusumi fɛɛ ni sa akɛ atsu ahã Israel maŋbii lɛ, amɛ esa akɛ amɛtsu. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaajɛ sɛɛ ni ekɛ ehe aaawo amɛnitsumɔ lɛ mli lɛ agbe lɛ.

english_verse: So Moses and Aaron obeyed the Lord and counted the Levites by their clans. The total number of Levites at least one month old was
translation_verse: Levibii hii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ nyɔŋ kome kɛyaa ni Mose kɛ Aaron kane yɛ amɛwekui anaa yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa lɛ ayikulɛ shɛɔ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ. Levibii lɛ ye kromɔ bihii anajiaŋ

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Make a list and count the first-born sons at least one month old in each of the Israelite families.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Ŋmaa Israelbii akromɔbihii fɛɛ; kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye nyɔŋ kome nɔ kɛyaa, agbɛii koni okane amɛyikulɛ,

english_verse: They belong to me, but I will accept the Levites as substitutes for them, and I will accept the Levites' livestock as substitutes for the Israelites' first-born livestock.”
translation_verse: ni otse Levibii lɛ ohã mi, Yehowa, koni okɛ amɛ ato Israelbii kromɔ bihii lɛ fɛɛ anajiaŋ. Nakai nɔŋŋ oŋɔ̃ Levibii ashĩa kooloi ohã mi koni okɛto Israelbii fɛɛ ashĩa kooloi akromɔ bihii fɛɛ anajiaŋ.”

english_verse: Moses obeyed the Lord and counted the first-born sons;
translation_verse: Mose kane Israelbii akromɔbihii fɛɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said,
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: “The Levites will belong to me and will take the place of the first-born sons; their livestock will take the place of the Israelites' first-born livestock.
translation_verse: “Jɔɔmɔ Levibii lɛ anɔ ohã mi yɛ Israelbii akromɔbihii fɛɛ anajiaŋ, ni ojɔɔ Levibii ashĩa kooloi anɔ ohã mi yɛ Israelbii fɛɛ ashĩa kooloi akromɔbihii anajiaŋ. Levibii lɛ minii ji amɛ. Mi, mi ji Yehowa.

english_verse: But since there are more first-born sons than Levites, the extra
translation_verse: Israelbii akromɔbihii ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ etɛ̃ ni edɛŋ Levibii lɛ ayikulɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, akpɔ̃ amɛ.

english_verse: For each one, you are to collect five pieces of silver, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: Hemɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa jwiɛtɛi shekeli enumɔ yɛ mɔ kome yi, shekel kome feɔ garai nyɔŋmai enyɔ.

english_verse: This money must then be given to Aaron and his sons.”
translation_verse: Ni shika ni akɛbaakpɔ̃ mɛi ni edɛŋ nɔ nɛɛ lɛ okɛhã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ.”

english_verse: Then he gave it to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: ni Mose kɛ mɛi ni akpɔ̃ lɛ shika lɛ hã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ bɔ ni Yehowa fã akɛ efee lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron:
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: The Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects used in worship at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kohatbii lɛ anitsumɔ ni amɛbaatsu yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ he lɛ kɔɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi fe fɛɛ lɛ ahe.

english_verse: When the Israelites are ready to move their camp, Aaron and his sons will enter the tent and take down the curtain that separates the sacred chest from the rest of the tent. They will cover the chest with this curtain,
translation_verse: “Kɛji maŋ lɛ baafã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ aya Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ni amɛyajie muhɔɔ ni tsiɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ lɛ koni amɛkɛ muhɔɔ nɛɛ aha Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ he.
