english_verse: and then with a piece of fine leather, and cover it all with a solid blue cloth. After this they will put the carrying poles in place.
translation_verse: No sɛɛ lɛ, amɛkɛ abotia hewolo aha muhɔɔ ni akɛha Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ he lɛ nɔ; ni yɛ no hu sɛɛ lɛ amɛkɛ mama bluu krɔŋŋ alɛɛ Adeka lɛ nɔ. Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ amɛkɛ tsei bloblobii ni akɛwoɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ahɔlɔ amɛfɔji lɛ amli.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will use another blue cloth to cover the table for the sacred bread. On the cloth they will place the dishes, the bowls for incense, the cups, the jugs for wine, as well as the bread itself.
translation_verse: “Amɛkɛ mama bluu aha okplɔ̃ ni akɛ Yehowa aboloo lɛ mãa nɔ lɛ nɔ, koni amɛkɛ plɛtei lɛ, kɛ tsɛnsii ni akɛ tsofakɛŋma woɔ mli lɛ, kɛ okpolui lɛ kɛ kpuji ni akɛ afɔleshãa dãa woɔ mli lɛ amãmɔ nɔ. Be fɛɛ be lɛ aboloo amã okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: With another blue cloth they will cover the lampstand, along with the lamps, the lamp snuffers, the fire pans, and the jars of oil for the lamps.
translation_verse: “Amɛkɔ mama bluu, ni amɛkɛha kanetso lɛ kɛ ehe kanei lɛ, kɛ lagbeenii lɛ, kɛ tsɛnsii tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ, kɛ nibii ni akɛ mu ni akɛsuɔ kanei lɛ woɔ mli lɛ fɛɛ ahe.

english_verse: All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather and placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: No sɛɛ lɛ, amɛfi nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ amɛwo abotia wolo mli koni amɛkɛwo tso adeka ni akɛtereɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: The gold incense altar is to be covered with a blue cloth, and then with a piece of fine leather, before its carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: “Shika afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, amɛlɛɛ mama bluu lɛ mli amɛkɛha nɔ, koni amɛkɛ abotia wolo aha mama bluu lɛ hu nɔ; ni no sɛɛ lɛ akɛ tsei bloblobii ni akɛwoɔ latɛ lɛ ahɔlɔ amɛfɔji lɛ amli.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will take blue cloth and wrap all the objects used in worship at the sacred tent. These will need to be covered with a piece of fine leather, then placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: Amɛfi tsɛnsii fɛɛ ni akɛsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ amɛwo mama bluu mli; ni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛfi nii lɛ ekoŋŋ amɛwo abotia hewolo mli. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ amɛkɛma nɔ ni akɛtereɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: They are to remove the ashes from the bronze altar and cover it with a purple cloth.
translation_verse: Amɛloo lamlu fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛ mama afaseo aha latɛ lɛ nɔ;

english_verse: On that cloth will be placed the utensils used at the altar, including the fire pans, the meat forks, the shovels, and the sprinkling bowls. All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather, before the carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: ni amɛkɛ nibii fɛɛ ni akɛsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he lɛ ashwie latɛ lɛ nɔ. Nibii nɛɛ ji lajee tsɛnsii lɛ, kɛ fakai lɛ kɛ sofii lɛ kɛ tsɛnsii lɛ kɛ nibii krokomɛi fɛɛ. Akɛ abotia hewolo aha nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ anɔ; ni no sɛɛ lɛ akɛ tsei bloblobii ni akɛwoɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ahɔlɔ amɛfɔji lɛ amli.

english_verse: When the camp is ready to be moved, the Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects and the furnishings of the sacred tent. But Aaron and his sons must have already covered those things so the Kohathites won't touch them and die.
translation_verse: Kɛji Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ eha Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ Buu lɛ mli nibii lɛ hu fɛɛ ahe amɛgbe naa, ni maŋ lɛ baafã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, no mli dani Kohatbii lɛ abahole nibii lɛ, shi moŋ amɛkɛ amɛnine akata nibii lɛ eko he koni amɛkagboi. Enɛɛmɛi ji Kpee Buu lɛ he nibii ni Kohatbii lɛ baatere lɛ.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest will be in charge of the oil for the lamps, the sweet-smelling incense, the grain for the sacrifices, and the olive oil used for dedications and ordinations. Eleazar is responsible for seeing that the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the sacred objects are taken care of.
translation_verse: “Nibii ni atu awo Osɔfo Eleazar, Aaron bi lɛ, dɛŋ koni ekwɛ nɔ ji mu ni akɛsuɔ kane lɛ, kɛ mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ kɛ daa niyenii afɔle lɛ, kɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ, kɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hu kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: The Gershonites will be responsible
translation_verse: Jatsui ni Gershonbii lɛ atere ji:

english_verse: for carrying the curtains of the sacred tent, its two outer coverings, the curtain for the entrance to the tent,
translation_verse: Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mamai lɛ, kɛ mama ni haa Buu lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ abotia hewolo ni haa Buu lɛ yiteŋ lɛ, kɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa mama lɛ.

english_verse: the curtains hanging around the courtyard of the tent, and the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard. The Gershonites are to do whatever needs to be done to take care of these things,
translation_verse: Amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛtere kpo lɛ ni bɔle Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ fɛɛ kpula lɛ mamai lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ agbo lɛ naa mamai lɛ, kɛ mamai nɛɛ ahe taŋkpei lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ he nibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kɔɔ nibii nɛɛ ahe lɛ amɛnitsumɔ ni.

english_verse: These are the duties of the Gershonites at the sacred tent, and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work. The Duties of the Merarite Clans
translation_verse: Enɛɛmɛi ji nitsumɔi ni Gershonbii lɛ awekui lɛ baatsu yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ he; ni mɔ ni baakwɛ amɛnɔ ji Osɔfo Aaron bi Itamar.” Meraribii, Levibii lɛ, agbɛfaŋ nitsumɔi

english_verse: The Merarites will be responsible for carrying the frames of the tent and its other pieces, including the bars, the posts, and the stands,
translation_verse: Ni jatsui ni amɛbaatere kɛ amɛnitsumɔ fɛɛ ni amɛbaatsu yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ gbɛfaŋ ji Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mplaŋi lɛ, kɛ mlibɛlɛmɔnii lɛ, kɛ ekulashiŋi lɛ, kɛ nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ̃ɔ nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: as well as the posts that support the courtyard, together with their stands, tent pegs, and ropes. The Merarites are to be told exactly what objects they are to carry,
translation_verse: kɛ kpo lɛ he akulashiŋi lɛ kɛ amɛhe nibii ni amɛmamɔ̃ɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ shiŋmlitsei lɛ kɛ taŋkpei lɛ kɛ amɛhe nibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ hu. Ni nyɛtsɔ̃a mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ejatsu ni ebaatere lɛ gbɛi.

english_verse: and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work. The Levites Are Counted Again
translation_verse: Enɛɛmɛi ji nitsumɔi ni Meraribii lɛ awekui lɛ baatsu yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he; ni mɔ ni baakwɛ amɛnɔ ji Osɔfo Aaron bi Itamar.” Levibii lɛ ayikulɛ kanemɔ

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelite leaders obeyed the Lord and counted the Levi tribe by families and clans, to find out how many men there were between the ages of
translation_verse: Mose nine nɔ atsɔ̃ akane Levibii nɛɛ yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ naa, ni Yehowa wiemɔ nɔ nɔŋŋ adamɔ ni ahã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ enitsumɔ kɛ ejatsu.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you commit a crime against someone, you have sinned against me.
translation_verse: “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ kɛji nuu ko loo yoo ko booo Yehowa toi, ni efee enaanyo esha, ni ekɛkwa Yehowa ni nakai mɔ lɛ ye fɔ lɛ,

english_verse: You must confess your guilt and pay the victim in full for whatever damage has been done, plus a fine of
translation_verse: no lɛ ejaje esha ni efee lɛ, ni eto mɔ ni efee lɛ esha lɛ najiaŋ; asaŋ ekɛ nii ni ekɛtoɔ mɔ lɛ najiaŋ lɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome afata he ehã mɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: If the victim has no relative who can accept this money, it belongs to me and will be paid to the priest. In addition to that payment, you must take a ram for the priest to sacrifice so your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji mɔ nɔ ni atɔ̃ lɛ egbo, ni anaaa ewekunyo ko ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ koni akɛ najiaŋtoo nii lɛ ahã mɔ lɛ lɛ, no lɛ najiaŋtoo nii lɛ atsɔ Yehowa nɔ, ni akɛhã osɔfo lɛ; esoro ojwɛni ni tɔ̃lɔ lɛ baahã koni akɛshã afɔle ekɛdãi efɔŋ ni efee lɛ.

english_verse: When you make a donation to the sacred tent, that money belongs only to the priest, and each priest will keep what is given to him. A Suspicious Husband
translation_verse: Osɔfo fɛɛ osɔfo lɛ, nii ni akɛaabahã lɛ lɛ, enɔ ni.” Kɛji nuu kɛɛ eŋa eje esɛɛ

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: Suppose a man becomes jealous and suspects that his wife has been unfaithful, but he has no proof.
translation_verse: loo kɛji awuŋayeli te shi yɛ nuu ko mli, ni eye eŋa he awuŋã lɛ, yoo lɛ ebule ehe jio, ebuleko ehe jio,

english_verse: He must take his wife to the priest, together with one kilogram of ground barley as an offering to find out if she is guilty. No olive oil or incense is to be put on that offering.
translation_verse: nuu lɛ kɛ eŋa lɛ aba osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ. Nuu lɛ ahiɛ akoko mamu kilo kome hu kɛba. Ekɛ mu akashwie mamu lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ krɔbɔo hu akafɔ̃ nɔ, ejaakɛ eji awuŋayeli he niyenii afɔle ni akɛmiitao anɔkwale lɛ ale.’

english_verse: The priest will lead the woman to my altar and make her stand there.
translation_verse: “Osɔfo lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ aba, ni ehã ebadamɔ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: He will then pour sacred water into a clay jar and stir in some dust from the floor of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ kɛ nu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko awo su kpulu mli, ni ekpiti shikpɔŋ su yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli ewo nu lɛ mli.

english_verse: The priest will write these curses on special paper and wash them off into the bitter water,
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ aŋmã loomɔi nɛɛ yɛ nɔ ko nɔ; no sɛɛ lɛ, efɔ niŋmaa lɛ ewo nu ni joɔ lɛ mli,

english_verse: so that when the woman drinks this water, the curses will enter her body.
translation_verse: ni ehã yoo lɛ anu nu ni joɔ ni gbalaa loomɔ kɛbaa lɛ, koni kɛji nu lɛ bote yoo lɛ mli lɛ epiŋ lɛ waa.

english_verse: He will take the barley offering from her and lift it up in dedication to me, the Lord. Then he will place it on my altar
translation_verse: Dani yoo lɛ baanu nu lɛ, osɔfo lɛ ahe mamu ni ji niyenii afɔle lɛ ni akɛjieɔ mɔ shi lɛ yɛ yoo lɛ dɛŋ, ni ewo afɔle lɛ nɔ kɛya kɛba yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; ni no sɛɛ lɛ ekɛma afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: and burn part of it as a sacrifice. After that, the woman must drink the bitter water.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ akpiti niyenii afɔle lɛ edɛ̃ kɔkɔ obɔ̃ kome, akɛ nɔ ni ekɛmiiye he odase, koni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; ni no sɛɛ lɛ ehã yoo lɛ anu nu lɛ.

english_verse: If the woman has been unfaithful, the water will immediately make her unable to have children, and she will be a curse among her people.
translation_verse: Kɛji yoo lɛ eje ewu lɛ sɛɛ ekɛwo ehe muji lɛ, kɛji enu nu ni joɔ lɛ ni ebote emli lɛ, nu lɛ baahã epiŋ waa diɛŋtsɛ, ni emusu baafũu, ni eyoohe baabɛ, ni lɛ yoo lɛ ebaatsɔ̃ musumɔ yɛ emaŋbii ateŋ.

english_verse: But if she is innocent, her body will not be harmed, and she will still be able to have children.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji yoo lɛ ejeko ewu lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ ehe baaje loomɔ lɛ mli, ni ebaawo shwiei.

english_verse: This is the ceremony that must take place at my altar when a husband suspects that his wife has been unfaithful. The priest must tell the woman to stand in my presence and carefully follow these instructions.
translation_verse: aloo nuu ye eŋa he awuŋã akɛ eje esɛɛ lɛ, nuu lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ aba koni yoo lɛ abadamɔ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ koni osɔfo lɛ atsu yoo lɛ he nii yɛ nɛkɛ mla nɛɛ naa pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: If the husband is wrong, he will not be punished; but if his wife is guilty, she will be punished.
translation_verse: Nuu lɛ yeŋ sɔ̃ ko kwraa; shi yoo lɛ kɛji etɔ̃ lɛ no lɛ eyi sɔ̃ lɛ aaatere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If any of you want to dedicate yourself to me by vowing to become a Nazirite,
translation_verse: “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘nuu fɛɛ nuu loo yoo fɛɛ yoo ni eje gbɛ ewo shi akɛ eeefee ehe Nazirnyo, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ejɔɔ ehe nɔ kwraa ehã Yehowa lɛ,

english_verse: you must no longer drink any wine or beer or use any kind of vinegar. Don't drink grape juice or eat grapes or raisins—
translation_verse: ekanu wain loo dãa ni wa; ekanu vinega ni akɛ wainyibii loo dãa ni wa fee. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ wainyibii fee lɛ ekanu; ni wainyibii ŋmɔŋ jio, nɔ ni aka lɛ egbiŋ jio, ekaye.

english_verse: The hair of a Nazirite is sacred to me, and as long as you are a Nazirite, you must never cut your hair.
translation_verse: “Kɛyaashi eeeye ebe ni ewo shi akɛ ejɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa etã lɛ, ekaku eyi, ni yishɛɛ kakla naa akasa eyiteŋ. Shiwoo lɛ fĩɔ lɛ bei abɔ fɛɛ ni ejɔɔ ehe nɔ kwraa ehã Yehowa lɛ. Mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji lɛ; ni eŋmɛ eyi kusuu.

english_verse: During the time that you are a Nazirite, you must never go close to a dead body,
translation_verse: Gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni ejɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa lɛ, ekaya gbonyo ko masɛi

english_verse: If someone suddenly dies near you, your hair is no longer sacred, and you must shave it seven days later during the ceremony to make you clean.
translation_verse: “Kɛji mɔ ko tswa shi egbo trukaa yɛ emasɛi, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ebule eyiteŋ tsɔi lɛ ni ejɔɔ nɔ lɛ, eshɛ eyi lɛ yɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ ni ekɛtsuu ehe.

english_verse: Then on the next day, bring two doves or two pigeons to the priest at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ ehiɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo okpoi bibii enyɔ ekɛbahã osɔfo lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me. You will then be forgiven for being too near a dead body, and your hair will again become sacred.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ aŋɔ okpoi lɛ ekome koni ekɛshã esha he afɔle, ni ekɛ ekome lɛ hu ashã shãa afɔle koni ekɛkpãtã ehã lɛ; ejaakɛ gbonyo lɛ ewo ehe muji. Nakai gbi lɛ, mɔ lɛ aku sɛɛ ejɔɔ eyiteŋ tsɔi lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ ehã Yehowa.

english_verse: But the dead body made you unacceptable, so you must make another vow to become a Nazirite and be dedicated once more. Finally, a year-old ram must be offered as the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: Esaa ejɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa ekoŋŋ ejaakɛ be ni ewo shi tsuutsu lɛ eho. Ekɛ too gwantɛŋ binuu ni eye afi aba ekɛbashã fɔyeli he afɔle, ejaakɛ ebule ehe nɔ ni ejɔɔ lɛ, ni ekɛhã be ni eye momo lɛ efee yaka.

english_verse: When you have completed your promised time of being a Nazirite, go to the sacred tent
translation_verse: “Kɛji Nazirnyo eye be ni ewo shi akɛ ejɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa egbe naa lɛ, nɔ ni afee nɛ: akɛ lɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi.

english_verse: and offer three animals that have nothing wrong with them: a year-old ram as a sacrifice to please me, a year-old female lamb as a sacrifice for sin, and a full-grown ram as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Ehiɛ edɛŋ toi etɛ̃ ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ni akɛshã afɔle akɛhã Yehowa nɛkɛ: ekɛ gwantɛŋ binuu ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ashã shãa afɔle, ni ekɛ gwantɛŋ yoo kome ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ashã esha he afɔle, ni ekɛ too ojwɛni kome ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ashã shidaa afɔle.

english_verse: Wine offerings and grain sacrifices must also be brought with these animals. Finally, you are to bring a basket of bread made with your finest flour and olive oil, but without yeast. Also bring some thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: Ehiɛ nibii nɛɛ hu efata kooloi lɛ ahe: aboloo ni akɛŋmãa mã akpiti ni awo mli fɔ shã kɛntɛŋ kome, kɛ akpãanɔɔ ni akɛ mamu muɛmuɛ fɛɛfɛo ni awo mli fɔ shã kɛ mã akpiti aboloo kekeree ni akpa hiɛ fɔ. Ekɛ abele kɛ dãa afɔlei lɛ hu ashi nɔ.

english_verse: The priest will take these gifts to my altar and offer them, so that I will be pleased and will forgive you.
translation_verse: “Osɔfo lɛ aŋɔ̃ nibii lɛ fɛɛ kɛba Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ koni ekɛshã esha he afɔle lɛ kɛ shãa afɔle lɛ ehã Nazirnyo lɛ.

english_verse: After that, you will stand at the entrance to the sacred tent, shave your head, and put the hair in the fire where the priest has offered the sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Nazirnyo lɛ ashɛ eyiteŋ tsɔi ni eto kɛjɛ be ni ejɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi lɛ, koni eloo eyitsɔi lɛ ewo la ni yɔɔ toiŋjɔlɛ afɔle lɛ shishi lɛ mli.

english_verse: Once the meat from the ram's shoulder has been boiled, the priest will take it, along with one loaf of bread and one wafer brushed with oil, and give them to you.
translation_verse: “Kɛji loo lɛ be lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɔ ojwɛni lɛ nine kome, ni ekɛfata kɛntɛŋ lɛ mli mã akpiti aboloo lɛ akwaabɔ kome kɛ akpiti akpãanɔɔ hu kome he koni ekɛwo Nazirnyo lɛ dɛŋ be ni eshɛ eyiteŋ tsɔi lɛ sɛɛ.

english_verse: You will hand them back to the priest, who will lift them up in dedication to me. Then he can eat the meat from the ram's shoulder, its choice ribs, and its hind leg, because this is his share of the sacrifice. After this, you will no longer be a Nazirite, and you will be free to drink wine.
translation_verse: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ ahe afɔle lɛ ni efɔ̃ kɛya kɛba yɛ Yehowa hiɛ akɛ afɔle krɔŋkrɔŋ. Nii nɛɛ ji nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛhãa osɔfo lɛ kɛfataa too lɛ tsitsinaa lɛ kɛ eshuɔ lɛ he. Agbɛnɛ Nazirnyo lɛ baanyɛ enu wain kɛjɛ enɛ sɛɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses,
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: “When Aaron and his sons bless the people of Israel, they must say:
translation_verse: “Kɛɛmɔ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ akɛ kɛji amɛmiijɔɔ Israelbii lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ,

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless and protect you,
translation_verse: ‘Yehowa ajɔɔ bo, ni eto bo!

english_verse: and that he will show you mercy and kindness.
translation_verse: Yehowa atse ehiɛ ehã bo, ni eduro bo.

english_verse: May the Lord be good to you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: Yehowa ana bo mɔbɔ, ni ehã bo hejɔlɛ!’

english_verse: When Moses had finished setting up the sacred tent, he dedicated it to the Lord, together with its furnishings, the altar, and its equipment.
translation_verse: Gbi ni Mose gbe Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ efɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ mu ekɛtsuu amɛhe, ni asaŋ efɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ hu mu nakai nɔŋŋ ekɛfee fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.

english_verse: Then the twelve tribal leaders of Israel, the same men who had been in charge of counting the people, came to the tent
translation_verse: Maŋbii lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔi ni ji Israelbii lɛ atsɛmɛi awei lɛ anɔ onukpai, ni ji akutsei lɛ atsɛmɛi, mɛi nɔŋŋ hu ni kwɛ maŋbii lɛ kanemɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: with gifts for the Lord. They brought six strong carts and twelve oxen—one ox from each leader and a cart from every two.
translation_verse: hiɛ amɛdɛŋ nikeenii kɛba amɛkɛbahã Yehowa. Nibii nɛɛ ji shwiilii ekpaa ni awo amɛ nibii obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ tsinai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; shwiilii lɛ, onukpai enyɔ anɔ ekome, ni tsinai lɛ mɔ kome nɔ ekome. Amɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ ba Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: “Accept these gifts, so the Levites can use them here at the sacred tent for carrying the sacred things.”
translation_verse: “Hemɔ nibii ni amɛkɛba lɛ koni akɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii. Ojara ohã Levibii lɛ yɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nitsumɔ naa.”

english_verse: Then Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites,
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Mose kɛ shwiilii kɛ nibii lɛ kɛ tsinai lɛ hã Levibii lɛ.

english_verse: who were under the leadership of Ithamar son of Aaron. Moses gave two carts and four oxen to the Gershonites for their work, and four carts and eight oxen to the Merarites for their work.
translation_verse: ni ehã Meraribii lɛ shwiilii ejwɛ kɛ tsinai hu kpaanyɔ. Ekɛ nibii lɛ wo Osɔfo Aaron bi Itamar dɛŋ, ejaakɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni kwɛɔ kui nɛɛ anɔ yɛ amɛnitsumɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: But Moses did not give any to the Kohathites, because they were in charge of the sacred objects that had to be carried on their shoulders.
translation_verse: Shi Kohatbii lɛ shwiili jio, tsina jio, Mose hãaa amɛ eko ejaakɛ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi ni amɛkwɛɔ nɔ lɛ, kɔ̃ŋ nɔ atereɔ yɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Each day one leader is to give his offering for the dedication.”
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Onukpai lɛ aba mɔ kome mɔ kome amɛkɛ amɛnikeenii lɛ abahã, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ gbi ni ato ahã lɛ lɛ nɔ koni akɛjɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ kɛgbele naa.”

english_verse: kilograms, according to the official standards;
translation_verse: kɛ too kpakpo kome ni akɛ lɛ baashã esha he afɔle

english_verse: Whenever Moses needed to talk with the Lord, he went into the sacred tent, where he heard the Lord's voice coming from between the two winged creatures above the lid of the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Be ni Mose bote Kpee Buu lɛ mli koni ekɛ Yehowa ayawie lɛ, enu Yehowa gbee ni ekɛ lɛ, Mose lɛ, miiwie kɛjɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ naanɔ lɛ nɔ gbɛ yɛ kerubim enyɔ lɛ ateŋ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: “Tell Aaron to put the seven lamps on the lampstand so they shine toward the front.”
translation_verse: “Kɛɛmɔ Aaron akɛ kɛji ekɛ kanei lɛ miimamɔ kanetsei kpawo lɛ anɔ lɛ, ekɛ amɛ amãmɔ shi bɔ ni amɛbaakpɛ kɛya kanetso lɛ hiɛgbɛ.”

english_verse: The lampstand was made of hammered gold from its base to the decorative flowers on top, exactly like the pattern the Lord had described to Moses. Instructions for Ordaining the Levites
translation_verse: Bɔ ni kanetso lɛ yɔɔ ji akɛ atswia lɛ shika sɔŋŋ nii kɛjɛ eshitamɔnɔ lɛ nɔ, kɛmɔ ehe fɔfɔii lɛ aahu kɛyagbe naa emuu. Bɔ ni nɔkwɛmɔnɔ lɛ ni Yehowa kɛtsɔ̃ɔ Mose lɛ yɔɔ lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ afee kanetso lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: and sprinkle them with the water that washes away their sins. Then have them shave their entire bodies and wash their clothes.
translation_verse: Ni bɔ ni ofee amɛ ni otsuu amɛhe nɛ. Okɛ nu ni akɛtsuɔ mɔ he lɛ ashwã amɛnɔ; amɛshɛ amɛhe tsɔi fɛɛ kɛ kakla, ni amɛfɔ amɛtadei ahe koni amɛhe atse.

english_verse: They are to bring a bull and its proper grain sacrifice of flour mixed with olive oil. And they must bring a second bull as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ ohã amɛŋɔ tsina oblanyo, ni akɛ niyenii afɔle ni ji ŋmãa mamu ni awo mli mu afata he; ni bo diɛŋtsɛ hu oŋɔ̃ tsina oblanyo kroko ni okɛshã esha he afɔle.

english_verse: Then you, Moses, will call together all the people of Israel and send the Levites to my sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ohã Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ababɔ gwa; ni ohã Levibii lɛ adamɔ Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: Aaron will present the Levites to me as a gift from the people, so that the Levites will do my work.
translation_verse: No sɛɛ lɛ, Aaron ajɔɔ Levibii lɛ anɔ ahã mi, Yehowa, akɛ afɔle krɛdɛɛ ni jɛ Israelbii lɛ adɛŋ koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ mi.

english_verse: After this, the Levites are to place their hands on the heads of the bulls. Sacrifice one of the bulls for the forgiveness of sin, and the other to make sure that I am pleased. Then the Levites will be acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Levibii lɛ kɛ amɛniji ashwie tsinahii lɛ ayiteŋ; ni okɛ ekome ashã esha he afɔle, ni okɛ ekome hu ashã shãa afɔle okɛhã Yehowa koni okɛkpãtã ohã Levibii lɛ.

english_verse: They will stand at my altar in front of Aaron and his sons, who will dedicate the Levites to me.
translation_verse: “Jɔɔmɔ Levibii lɛ anɔ ohã mi koni amɛwa Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛsɔ̃mɔ,

english_verse: This ceremony will show that the Levites are different from the other Israelites and belong to me in a special way.
translation_verse: koni ojie Levibii lɛ yɛ Israelbii krokomɛi lɛ ateŋ oto afã akɛ minɔ.

english_verse: After they have been made acceptable and have been dedicated, they will be allowed to work at my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Otsuu amɛhe koni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛba Kpee Buu lɛ mli amɛbasɔ̃mɔ yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: They are mine and will take the place of the first-born Israelite sons.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ miiŋɔ amɛ kwraa yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ miihã mihe; mikɛ amɛ eto nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni gbeleɔ musu naa ni ji Israelbii akromɔbii lɛ anajiaŋ.

english_verse: When I killed the oldest sons of the Egyptians, I decided that the first-born sons in each Israelite family would be mine, as well as every first-born male from their flocks and herds.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ gbi nɔ ni mitswia kromɔbii fɛɛ anii yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, mijɔɔ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ kromɔbi fɛɛ kromɔbi kɛ shĩa kooloo kromɔbi fɛɛ kromɔbi hu nɔ mihã mihe, ni mifee lɛ minɔ.

english_verse: But now I have chosen these Levites as substitutes for the first-born sons,
translation_verse: Levibii lɛ mikɛto Israelbii lɛ akromɔbii fɛɛ anajiaŋ

english_verse: and I have given them as gifts to Aaron and his sons to serve at the sacred tent. I will hold them responsible for what happens to anyone who gets too close to the sacred tent. The Levites Are Dedicated to the Lord
translation_verse: ni mikɛ Levibii lɛ miihã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kwraa akɛ Israelbii lɛ adɛŋ nikeenii koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli yɛ Israelbii lɛ anajiaŋ bɔ ni afee ni amɛkpãtã efɔŋ ni baaba maŋbii anɔ kɛji amɛbɛŋkɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: The Levites sprinkled themselves with the water of forgiveness and washed their clothes. Then Aaron brought them to the altar and offered sacrifices to forgive their sins and make them acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Levibii lɛ tsu kusum kɛfɔ amɛhe eshai; amɛfɔfɔɔ amɛtadei ahe, ni Aaron jɔɔ amɛnɔ ehã akɛ keenii krɛdɛɛ hã Yehowa. Asaŋ etsuu amɛhe hu.

english_verse: After this, the Levites worked at the sacred tent as assistants to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: No sɛɛ lɛ, Levibii lɛ tee Buu lɛ mli, ni amɛyasɔ̃mɔ yɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ ashishi. Bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ efee yɛ Levibii lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, nakai efee amɛ.

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses,
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: They may help the other Levites in their duties, but they must no longer be responsible for any work themselves. Remember this when you assign their duties.”
translation_verse: Be nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛaanyɛ amɛwa amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli; shi moŋ nitsumɔ ko akakã amɛnɔ. Gbɛjianɔ ni oto ohã Levibii lɛ yɛ amɛgbɛnaa nitsumɔi lɛ agbɛfaŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: During the first month of Israel's second year in the Sinai Desert, the Lord had told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ Mose wie yɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ Israelbii lɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shimɔ sɛɛ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,

english_verse: to say to the people, “Celebrate Passover
translation_verse: “Hã ni Israelbii lɛ aye Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ ebe ni ato lɛ mli.

english_verse: in the evening of the fourteenth day of this month and do it by following all the regulations.”
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ nyɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ gbi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ, nyɛyea gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ ebe ni ato lɛ mli; nyɛyea lɛ yɛ ehe akpɔi kɛ gbɛjianɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ anaa pɛpɛɛpɛ.”

english_verse: Moses told the people what the Lord had said, and they celebrated Passover there in the desert in the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: ni amɛye Hehoo lɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ gbɛkɛnaashi, yɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ. Bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Israelbii lɛ fee.

english_verse: Some people in Israel's camp had touched a dead body and had become unfit to worship the Lord, and they could not celebrate Passover. But they asked Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Shi hii komɛi yata gbonyo he, ni amɛbule amɛhe; ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛnyɛɛɛ Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ amɛye yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ. Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, hii nɛɛ ba Mose kɛ Aaron ŋɔɔ yɛ Hehoo gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: “Even though we have touched a dead body, why can't we celebrate Passover and offer sacrifices to the Lord at the same time as everyone else?”
translation_verse: Amɛbakɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ wɔyabule wɔhe kɛ gbonyo ko he ni wɔyata lɛ. Mɛni hewɔ ni atsiɔ wɔ gbɛ akɛ wɔkɛ wɔnikeenii akabahã Yehowa yɛ ebe ni eto lɛ mli tamɔ Israelbii krokomɛi lɛ?”

english_verse: Moses said, “Wait here while I go into the sacred tent and find out what the Lord says about this.”
translation_verse: Mose kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛmɛa kɛyashi Yehowa aaakɛɛ mi nɔ ni afee yɛ nyɛhewɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord then told Moses
translation_verse: Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you or your descendants touch a dead body and become unfit to worship me, or if you are away on a long journey, you may still celebrate Passover.
translation_verse: “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛji nyɛteŋ mɔ ko loo nyɛshwiei lɛ eko yata gbonyo he ni ekɛbule ehe, aloo edom etee maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ he ko tete lɛ, ebaanyɛ eye Hehoo lɛ ehã Yehowa kɛ̃.

english_verse: But it must be done in the second month, in the evening of the fourteenth day. Eat the Passover lamb with thin bread and bitter herbs,
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi lɛ amɛye Hehoo lɛ yɛ nyɔŋ ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ gbɛkɛnaashi. Amɛkɛ mã akpiti kɛ shwie ni joɔ aye;

english_verse: and don't leave any of it until morning or break any of the animal's bones. Be sure to follow these regulations.
translation_verse: amɛkashwɛ eko ni je tsɛre nɔ, ni asaŋ amɛkajwa kooloo ni agbe akɛye lɛ wui lɛ eko. Amɛye Hehoo lɛ yɛ ehe akpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa.

english_verse: But if any of you are fit to worship me, and yet refuse to celebrate Passover when you are not away on a journey, you will no longer belong to my people. You will be punished because you did not offer sacrifices to me at the proper time.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni he tse, ni asaŋ edomko, shi kɛ̃lɛ ekwa Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yeli lɛ, nakai mɔ lɛ ehiɛ aaakpãtã yɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ, ejaakɛ ekɛ Yehowa nikeenii lɛ baaa ebahãaa yɛ be ni ato lɛ mli. Nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ yi sɔ̃ atere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ.’

english_verse: whether it was only one night, a few days, a month, or even a year. As long as the cloud remained over the tent, the Israelites stayed where they were. But when the cloud moved, so did the Israelites.
translation_verse: Ni kɛ gbii enyɔ atatu lɛ ye yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ jio, nyɔŋ kome jio, be kakadaŋŋ jio, gbii abɔ ni eyɔɔ Buu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ efãaa. Shi kɛji ewo ehe nɔ pɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛfã.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: Have someone make two trumpets out of hammered silver. These will be used to call the people together and to give the signal for moving your camp.
translation_verse: “Okɛ jwiɛtɛi ni atswia afee tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi enyɔ koni akɛtsɛ asafo lɛ kɛkpe, ni asaŋ okɛhã amɛfã kɛshi shitoohe lɛ.

english_verse: If both trumpets are blown, everyone is to meet with you at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kɛji akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ shikome ni gbɛɛmɔ lɛ sɛɛ tsɛ naakpa lɛ, maŋbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa abakpe shi yɛ oŋɔɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.

english_verse: But if just one is blown, only the twelve tribal leaders need to come together.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ kome kɛkɛ akpã lɛ, no lɛ Israelbii lɛ atsɛmɛi awei lɛ amli onukpai lɛ sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ababua amɛhe naa yɛ oŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Give a signal on a trumpet when it is time to break camp. The first blast will be the signal for the tribes camped on the east side, and the second blast will be the signal for those on the south.
translation_verse: Kɛ akpã kɛbɔ oshe nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ lɛ asafoi ni jwere wuoyigbɛ lɛ anɔ ni, amɛ amɛfã. Belɛ kɛji aatao akɛ maŋ lɛ afã kɛshi shitoohe lɛ, akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ kɛbɔ oshe.

english_verse: But when you want everyone to come together, sound a different signal on the trumpet.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji aatsɛ maŋ lɛ koni amɛnaa abakpe shi lɛ, akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ, ni egbɛɛmɔ lɛ sɛɛ atsɛ, shi akɛkabɔ oshe.

english_verse: The priests of Aaron's family will be the ones to blow the trumpets, and this law will never change.
translation_verse: Aaron bihii ni ji osɔfoi lɛ ji mɛi ni akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ. “Gbɛjianɔtoo kɛ akpɔ ni akã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi nɛɛ akpãmɔ he ahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei fɛɛ nɛ:

english_verse: Whenever you go into battle against an enemy attacking your land, give a warning signal on the trumpets. Then I, the Lord, will hear it and rescue you.
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛkɛ henyɛlɔ ko ni gbaa nyɛnaa miiwu yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi lɛ kɛbɔa oshe; ni mi, Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mibaye mabua nyɛ, ni mibahere nyɛyiwala yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ.

english_verse: During the celebration of the New Moon Festival and other religious festivals, sound the trumpets while you offer sacrifices. This will be a reminder that I am the Lord your God. The Israelites Begin Their Journey
translation_verse: Asaŋ nyɛkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi lɛ yɛ gbii ni nyɛmiinya hu anɔ, kɛ gbii juji ni ato lɛ kɛ nyɔŋ hee shishijee gbi lɛ hu nɔ be mli ni nyɛshãa afɔlei kɛ shidaa afɔlei lɛ yɛ mihiɛ lɛ, ni maye mabua nyɛ. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.” Israelbii lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ

english_verse: On the twentieth day of the second month of that same year, the cloud over the sacred tent moved on.
translation_verse: Israelbii lɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shimɔ sɛɛ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, atatu lɛ wo ehe nɔ yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: So the Israelites broke camp and left the Sinai Desert. And some time later, the cloud stopped in the Paran Desert.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii asafo lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ, ni amɛyiŋ kɛjɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ. Atatu lɛ yawa yɛ Paran ŋa lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: This was the first time the Lord had told Moses to command the people of Israel to move on.
translation_verse: Enɛ ji Israelbii lɛ aklɛŋklɛŋ fãa ni amɛfã nyiɛmɔ yɛ fãmɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ efã amɛ lɛ naa.

english_verse: Judah and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out first, carrying their banner. Nahshon son of Amminadab was the leader of the Judah tribe,
translation_verse: Yudabii akutso lɛ aflaŋaa lɛ tsutsu fã, asafo nyiɛ asafo sɛɛ; ni amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Nahashon, Aminadab bi lɛ.

english_verse: Nethanel son of Zuar was the leader of the Issachar tribe,
translation_verse: Mɔ ni ji Isakar akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Netanel, Zuar bi lɛ,

english_verse: and Eliab son of Helon was the leader of the Zebulun tribe.
translation_verse: ni mɔ ni ji Zebulon akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Eliab, Helon bi lɛ.

english_verse: The sacred tent had been taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites carried it, marching behind the Judah camp.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni afã Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ; ni Gershonbii lɛ kɛ Meraribii lɛ, ni amɛ amɛtereɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hu fã nyiɛmɔ.

english_verse: Reuben and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out second, carrying their banner. Elizur son of Shedeur was the leader of the Reuben tribe,
translation_verse: Amɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ Ruben akutso lɛ aflaŋaa lɛ fã, asafo nyiɛ asafo sɛɛ, ni mɔ ni ji amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Elizur, Shedeur bi lɛ.

english_verse: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was the leader of the Simeon tribe,
translation_verse: Mɔ ni ji Simeon akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Shelumiel, Zurishadai bi lɛ;

english_verse: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was the leader of the Gad tribe.
translation_verse: ni mɔ ni ji Gad akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Eliasaf, Deuel bi lɛ.

english_verse: Next were the Kohathites, carrying the objects for the sacred tent, which was to be set up before they arrived at the new camp.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Levibii lɛ ateŋ Kohatbii lɛ ni tereɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli nibii lɛ fã. Ashiɔ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ amãa shi dani asafo lɛ yashɛɔ he ni ayaato shi yɛ ehee lɛ.

english_verse: Ephraim and the tribes that camped alongside it marched next, carrying their banner. Elishama son of Ammihud was the leader of the Ephraim tribe,
translation_verse: Amɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ Efraim akutso lɛ aflaŋaa lɛ fã, asafo nyiɛ asafo sɛɛ; ni mɔ ni ji amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Elishama, Amihud bi lɛ.

english_verse: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was the leader of the Manasseh tribe,
translation_verse: Mɔ ni ji Manase akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Gamaliel, Pedazur bi lɛ;

english_verse: and Abidan son of Gideoni was the leader of the Benjamin tribe.
translation_verse: ni mɔ ni ji Benyamin akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Abidan, Gideon bi lɛ.

english_verse: Dan and the tribes that camped alongside it were to protect the Israelites against an attack from behind, and so they marched last, carrying their banner. Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was the leader of the tribe of Dan,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Dan akutso lɛ aflaŋaa lɛ ni nyiɛɔ Israelbii asafoi lɛ fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ fã, asafo nyiɛ asafo sɛɛ; ni mɔ ni ji amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Ahiezer, Amishadai bi lɛ.

english_verse: Pagiel son of Ochran was the leader of the Asher tribe,
translation_verse: Mɔ ni ji Asher akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Pagiel, Okran bi lɛ;

english_verse: and Ahira son of Enan was the leader of the Naphtali tribe.
translation_verse: ni mɔ ni ji Naftali akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Ahira, Enan bi lɛ.

english_verse: This was the order in which the Israelites marched each time they moved their camp.
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni Israelbii lɛ toɔ naa fãa, asaŋ ni amɛnyiɛɔ yɛ asafoi lɛ anaa kɛji amɛshi shitoohe ko lɛ.

english_verse: Hobab the Midianite, the father-in-law of Moses, was there. And Moses said to him, “We're leaving for the place the Lord has promised us. He has said that all will go well for us. So come along, and we will make sure that all goes well for you.”
translation_verse: Be ni Israel asafoi lɛ baafã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, Mose kɛɛ eŋa nyɛmi nuu Hobab, ni ji eshaanuu Yetro, Midiannyo lɛ, binuu lɛ akɛ, “Wɔmiifã kɛya he ni Yehowa wo wɔ shi yɛ he akɛ ekɛbaahã wɔ lɛ. Fatamɔ wɔhe ni wɔtee. Yehowa ewo shi akɛ ebaahã Israel aye ejurɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, wɔ hu wɔɔfee bo ejurɔ.”

english_verse: “No, I won't go,” Hobab answered. “I'm returning home to be with my own people.”
translation_verse: Shi Hobab here Mose nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ehiŋ mi yaa; shi moŋ matee mi diɛŋtsɛ mijaku shikpɔŋ nɔ kɛ mimaŋbii aŋɔɔ.”

english_verse: “Please go with us!” Moses said. “You can be our guide because you know the places to camp in the desert.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Hobab akɛ, “Ofainɛ, kaashi wɔ. Gbii abɔ ni bo ole hei ni sa akɛ wɔtotoo shi yɛ, yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyiɛmɔ wɔhiɛ.

english_verse: Besides that, if you go, we will give you a share of the good things the Lord gives us.”
translation_verse: Kɛji okɛ wɔ nyiɛ lɛ, ejurɔ fɛɛ ni Yehowa aaafee wɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ wɔ hu wɔkɛaafee bo.” Israelbii lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ

english_verse: The people of Israel began their journey from Mount Sinai. They traveled three days, and the Levites who carried the sacred chest led the way, so the Lord could show them where to camp.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ kɛjɛ Sinai, ni ji Yehowa Gɔŋ lɛ he; ni amɛnyiɛ gbii etɛ̃; ni Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ nyiɛ amɛhiɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ koni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ amɛshitoohe.

english_verse: Each day as the Israelites began their journey, Moses would pray, “Our Lord, defeat your enemies and make them run!”
translation_verse: Kɛji eshɛ be ni Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ baafã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, Mose kɛɔ akɛ, “Wo ohe nɔ, Yehowa, koni ohenyɛlɔi lɛ agbɛ ashwã, koni mɛi ni teɔ shi woɔ bo lɛ ajo foi yɛ ohiɛ.”

english_verse: And when they stopped to set up camp, he would pray, “Our Lord, stay close to Israel's thousands and thousands of people.”
translation_verse: Ni kɛji Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ miito shi lɛ, Mose kɛɔ akɛ, “Kuu osɛɛ, Yehowa, kɛba Israelbii akpeiakpei abɔ lɛ aŋɔ̃ɔ.”

english_verse: One day the Israelites started complaining about their troubles. The Lord heard them and became so angry that he destroyed the outer edges of their camp with fire.
translation_verse: Yehowa toi gbe huhuuhu ni maŋbii lɛ wie tamɔ gbɔmɛi komɛi ni miina nɔ. Be ni Yehowa nu lɛ, emli wo la ni ehã la here yɛ amɛshitoohe lɛ mli ni ekpãtã nibii ahiɛ yɛ shitoohe lɛ afãgbɛ.

english_verse: When the people begged Moses to help, he prayed, and the fire went out.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ bolɔ amɛtsɛ Mose, ni Mose kpa Yehowa fai, ni la lɛ gbo.

english_verse: They named the place “Burning,” because in his anger the Lord had set their camp on fire. The People Grumble about Being Hungry
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, awo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Tabera, ejaakɛ Yehowa la shã nii yɛ amɛteŋ. Mose hala onukpai nyɔŋmai kpawo

english_verse: One day some foreigners among the Israelites became greedy for food, and even the Israelites themselves began moaning, “We don't have any meat!
translation_verse: Maŋsɛɛbii komɛi ni futu Israelbii lɛ, amɛsuɔmɔnaanii kwraa ji loo; ni no hewɔ lɛ, loo bɔ̃i amɛtsine baa; ni asaŋ, Israelbii lɛ hu bɔ̃i amɛmli gbigblimɔ ekoŋŋ, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ po wɔɔna loo yɛ wɔye.

english_verse: In Egypt we could eat all the fish we wanted, and there were cucumbers, melons, all kinds of onions, and garlic.
translation_verse: Loo ni jara waaa enyiɛ po wɔnaaa wɔye yɛ Ijipt? Wɔkaiɔ kokumba kɛ waatrɛ kɛ shwie kɛ sabolai!

english_verse: But we're starving out here, and the only food we have is this manna.”
translation_verse: Shi naa wɔ ŋmɛnɛ ni wɔtɔ biti, ni wɔnaaa nɔ ko nɔ ko kwraa wɔye akɛ ja nɛkɛ mana nɛɛ pɛ.”

english_verse: The manna was like small whitish seeds
translation_verse: Mana nɛɛ tamɔ dumɔ wui bibiibii kɛ esu wuɔfɔ oo ko.

english_verse: He prayed: I am your servant, Lord, so why are you doing this to me? What have I done to deserve this? You've made me responsible for all these people,
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Mɛɛba ni okɛ mi, otsulɔ, yeɔ kɛ joomɔ nɛɛ, ni oná mi mlifu? Mɛɛba ni okɛ nɛkɛ maŋbii nɛɛ fɛɛ yi sɔ̃ etere mi nɛɛ?

english_verse: but they're not my children. You told me to nurse them along and to carry them to the land you promised their ancestors.
translation_verse: Ani mi, mibɔ maŋ muu nɛɛ, aloo mi, mifɔ amɛ, hewɔ ni okɛɛ mi akɛ mihiɛ amɛ yɛ mikpɔkɔiaŋ tamɔ bɔ ni bihiɛlɔ hiɛɔ bi abifao kɛya shikpɔŋ lɛ ni owo amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ashi yɛ he lɛ nɔ lɛ?

english_verse: They keep whining for meat, but where can I get meat for them?
translation_verse: Nɛgbɛ maná loo yɛ mahã nɛkɛ maŋ muu nɛɛ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛmiifo amɛmiiwo mi akɛ mihã amɛ loo amɛye?

english_verse: This job is too much for me. How can I take care of all these people by myself?
translation_verse: Mi kome too minyɛŋ maŋ muu nɛɛ fɛɛ makura. Nitsumɔ nɛɛ da fe mi.

english_verse: If this is the way you're going to treat me, just kill me now and end my miserable life! Seventy Leaders Are Chosen To Help Moses
translation_verse: Kɛji nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni okɛ mi baaye lɛ, no lɛ, naa mi mɔbɔ koni ogbe mi moŋ nyɔŋlo koni mikana mihiɛnaanɔnii.”

english_verse: While I am talking with you there, I will give them some of your authority, so they can share responsibility for my people. You will no longer have to care for them by yourself.
translation_verse: Mibakpeleke shi mikɛ bo abawie yɛ jɛi, ni maŋɔ mumɔ ni mikɛhã bo lɛ eko mahã amɛ hu koni amɛwa bo kɛtere maŋ lɛ jatsu lɛ bɔ ni afee ni okome okatere.

english_verse: As for the Israelites, I have heard them complaining about not having meat and about being better off in Egypt. So tell them to make themselves acceptable to me, because tomorrow they will have meat.
translation_verse: Ni okɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, Nyɛfea nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ nyɛtoa wɔ; shi nyɛbaana loo nyɛye. Yehowa enu yaafo ni nyɛfo akɛ, ‘Namɔ aaahã wɔ loo ni wɔye, ejaakɛ be mli ni wɔyɔɔ Ijipt lɛ ehi moŋ ehã wɔ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ Yehowa baahã nyɛ loo ni nyɛye.’

english_verse: . They turned against me and wanted to go back to Egypt. Now they will eat meat until they get sick of it.
translation_verse: shi moŋ nyɔŋ kome muu sɔŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni loo lɛ baaje fu ewo nyɛ, ni ebaaje nyɛtsine. Ejaakɛ nyɛgbe Yehowa ni kɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ he guɔ, ni nyɛfo nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Wɔyɛ Ijipt moŋ kulɛ ehi.’ ”

english_verse: Even if we butchered all our sheep and cattle, or caught every fish in the sea, we wouldn't have enough to feed them.”
translation_verse: Ani toi kɛ tsinai aaagbe ahã amɛ, ni eeeshɛ amɛnaa aloo ŋshɔŋ loo fɛɛ abaaya ayahɛ abahã amɛ, ni eeeshɛ amɛnaa?”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “I can do anything! Watch and you'll see my words come true.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Ani Yehowa bɛ hewalɛ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ nɔ lo? Miwiemɔ lɛ aaaba mli jio, ebaŋ mli jio, obaana ŋmɛnɛ!”

english_verse: Eldad and Medad were two leaders who had not gone to the tent. But when the Spirit took control of them, they began shouting like prophets right there in camp.
translation_verse: Maŋ onukpai ni Mose hala lɛ ateŋ hii enyɔ komɛi, mɔ kome gbɛi ji Eldad, ni mɔ kome hu gbɛi ji Medad, naaa afata maŋ onukpai lɛ ahe kɛya Kpee Buu lɛ he. Kɛ̃lɛ mumɔ lɛ yi amɛ hu amɛnɔ, ni amɛgba yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli.

english_verse: A boy ran to Moses and told him about Eldad and Medad.
translation_verse: Ni oblanyo ko jo foi ni ebatsĩ tã etsɔ̃ɔ Mose akɛ Eldad kɛ Medad miigba yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli.

english_verse: Joshua was there helping Moses, as he had done since he was young. And he said to Moses, “Sir, you must stop them!”
translation_verse: Enɛ hã Nun bi Yoshua ni ji Mose sɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛjɛ eblahiaŋ lɛ here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, tsii amɛ gbɛ!”

english_verse: But Moses replied, “Are you concerned what this might do to me? I wish the Lord would give his Spirit to all his people so everyone could be a prophet.”
translation_verse: Shi Mose kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, “Mi oyeɔ awuŋã ohã nɛɛ? Miná ni kulɛ Yehowa maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃mɔ gbalɔi, ni Yehowa fɔse emumɔ lɛ eshwie amɛnɔ.”

english_verse: Some time later the Lord sent a strong wind that blew quails in from the sea until Israel's camp was completely surrounded with birds, piled up about a meter high for many kilometers in every direction.
translation_verse: Yehowa hã kɔɔyɔɔ ko tswa, ni eloo trakɔkɔi babaoo kɛjɛ ŋshɔ lɛ naa kɛba ni ekɛ amɛ bashwie shitoohe lɛ mli kɛ ehewɔ fɛɛ kɛbɔle kpula bɔ ni amɛkɛ shikpɔŋ jekɛmɔ aaafee ninetalɔi enyɔ.

english_verse: The people picked up quails for two days—each person filled at least ten large baskets. Then they spread them out to dry.
translation_verse: Ni nakai gbi muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ enyɔɔŋ lɛ mli kɛmɔ enɔ jetsɛremɔ fɛɛ lɛ maŋbii lɛ mɔmɔ trakɔkɔi lɛ. Mɔ ni naaa kwraa lɛ ena loo ni tsiimɔ fee kiloi akpe. Amɛgbɛ loo lɛ mli amɛka kɛbɔle shitoohe lɛ he kpula.

english_verse: But before the meat could be eaten, the Lord became angry and sent a deadly disease through the camp.
translation_verse: Ayeko loo nɛɛ atãko, ni Yehowa mli fu Israelbii lɛ, ni ehã hela ko babote amɛteŋ ni ekpãtã amɛhiɛ naakpa.

english_verse: After they had buried the people who had been so greedy for meat, they called the place “Graves for the Greedy.”
translation_verse: Sane nɛɛ hã awo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Kibrot Hataava , ejaakɛ jɛi ji he ni afu mɛi ni nii ba amɛtsine lɛ yɛ.

english_verse: Israel then broke camp and traveled to Hazeroth.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ fã yɛ Kibrot Hataava kɛtee Hazerot, ni amɛto shi yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: and told Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to come to the entrance of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni trukaa lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Miriam akɛ, “Nyɛyi etɛ̃ lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛjea kpo ni nyɛbaa Kpee Buu lɛ he.” Ni amɛyi etɛ̃ lɛ fɛɛ amɛtee.

english_verse: There the Lord appeared in a cloud and told Aaron and Miriam to come closer.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kpeleke shi yɛ atatu kutuu lɛ mli, ni ebadamɔ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, ni etsɛ Aaron kɛ Miriam. Amɛyi enyɔ lɛ amɛtsi amɛbɛŋkɛ;

english_verse: Then after commanding them to listen carefully, he said: “I, the Lord, speak to prophets in visions and dreams.
translation_verse: ni Yehowa kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛboa mi toi! Kɛji gbalɔ ko yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, mitsɔ̃ɔ ninaa nɔ mihãa eleɔ mi, ni wɔlamɔ mli mitsɔ̃ɔ mikɛ lɛ wieɔ.

english_verse: But my servant Moses is the leader of my people.
translation_verse: Shi mitsulɔ Mose nɔ bɛ nakai. Lɛ edɛŋ mitu mimaŋ Israel fɛɛ kuramɔ miwo.

english_verse: He sees me face to face, and everything I say to him is perfectly clear. You have no right to criticize my servant Moses.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, lɛ lɛ, mikɛ lɛ wieɔ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ faŋŋ; shi jeee yɛ abɛbuai amli; ni enaa mi, Yehowa, misu. Mɛɛba nyɛsheee gbeyei, ni nyɛwie nyɛshi mitsulɔ Mose lɛ?”

english_verse: The Lord became angry with Aaron and Miriam. And after the Lord left
translation_verse: Yehowa mli fu Aaron kɛ Miriam; ni eyiŋ etee.

english_verse: and the cloud disappeared from over the sacred tent, Miriam's skin turned white with leprosy. When Aaron saw what had happened to her,
translation_verse: Shi be ni atatu kutuu lɛ jeɔ Buu lɛ nɔ lɛ, naa Miriam ni hela gbonyo eshwie ehe fɛɛ futaa oookɛɛ kpiti. Aaron yaakwɛ Miriam lɛ, hewolo nɔ hela gbonyo eshwie ehe fɛɛ oookɛɛ kpiti.

english_verse: he said to Moses, “Sir, please don't punish us for doing such a foolish thing.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Aaron kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, ofainɛ, kaahã agbala wɔtoi yɛ kwashiaianii kɛ esha ni wɔfee nɛɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Don't let Miriam's flesh rot away like a child born dead!”
translation_verse: Kaahã obiyoo tsɔ̃ tamɔ gbɔmɔ ni be mli ni enyɛ fɔɔ lɛ beebe lɛ egbo, ni eheloo fã ekpɔtɔ momo.”

english_verse: But the Lord replied, “Miriam would be disgraced for seven days if her father had punished her by spitting in her face. So make her stay outside the camp for seven days, before coming back.”
translation_verse: Yehowa here Mose nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji Miriam tsɛ fɛ̃ lajɔ̃ shwie Miriam hiɛ lɛ, ani ashwieko Miriam hiɛ shi kɛyashi gbii kpawo lo? Ashwie Miriam kɛya shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ gbii kpawo; no sɛɛ dani ahã eba shitoohe lɛ mli.”

english_verse: The people of Israel did not move their camp until Miriam returned seven days later.
translation_verse: Ashwie Miriam yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli kɛyashi gbii kpawo, ni no hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ nyɛɛɛ afã nyiɛmɔ kɛyashi aŋɔ Miriam kɛba shitoohe lɛ mli ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: Then they left Hazeroth and set up camp in the Paran Desert.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni maŋ lɛ fã yɛ Hazerot kɛtee, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Paran.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ Mose wie, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,

english_verse: In fact, we saw the Nephilim who are the ancestors of the Anakim. They were so big that we felt as small as grasshoppers.”
translation_verse: ni wɔna Anakbii ashwiei, gbɔmɛi oblaŋi gojogojoo lɛ ateŋ ekomɛi hu yɛ jɛi. Kɛji wɔkɛ wɔhe to amɛhe lɛ, wɔtamɔ agãi; ni nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ amɛ hu amɛnaa wɔ.”

english_verse: “Choose a leader from each tribe and send them into Canaan to explore the land I am giving you.”
translation_verse: “Tsu hii koni amɛyasara Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii, shikpɔŋ ni mikɛbaahã Israelbii lɛ. Akutso fɛɛ akutso mli lɛ tsu mɔ kome ni eji onukpa yɛ amɛteŋ.”

english_verse: So Moses sent twelve tribal leaders from Israel's camp in the Paran Desert
translation_verse: Mose ye Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni etsu Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii onukpai akɛ saralɔi kɛjɛ Paran ŋa lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Before Moses sent them into Canaan, he said: After you go through the Southern Desert of Canaan, continue north into the hill country
translation_verse: Mose tsu bɔfoi nɛɛ koni amɛyasara Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsɔ̃a kooyigbɛ nɛɛ kɛyaa Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ; ni kɛjɛ jɛi lɛ nyɛkwɔa gɔji lɛ,

english_verse: and find out what those regions are like. Be sure to remember how many people live there, how strong they are,
translation_verse: ni nyɛyasaraa shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii bɔ ni eyɔɔ kɛ gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ nɔ, akɛ amɛhe wa aloo amɛhe waaa, akɛ amɛyi fa aloo amɛyi faaa.

english_verse: and if they live in open towns or walled cities. See if the land is good for growing crops and find out what kinds of trees grow there. It's time for grapes to ripen, so try to bring back some of the fruit that grows there.
translation_verse: Nyɛkwɛa bɔ ni amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ yɔɔ, akɛ ebaa nii aloo ebaaa nii jogbaŋŋ, akɛ tsei yɛ nɔ aloo tsei bɛ nɔ. Ni nyɛbɔa mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛtserɛa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tsei ayibii lɛ eko kɛbaa.” Nakai be mli lɛ eshɛ klɛŋklɛŋ wain yibii atsulɛ be.

english_verse: The twelve men left to explore Canaan from the Zin Desert in the south all the way to the town of Rehob near Lebo-Hamath in the north.
translation_verse: Bɔfoi lɛ yiŋ amɛtee, ni amɛyasara Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii kɛjɛ Zin ŋa lɛ nɔ, yɛ wuoyigbɛ, aahu kɛyashi Rehob, he ni atsɔ̃ɔ kɛyaa Hamat lɛ, yɛ kooyigbɛ.

english_verse: As they went through the Southern Desert, they came to the town of Hebron, which was seven years older than the Egyptian town of Zoan. In Hebron, they saw the three Anakim clans of Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai.
translation_verse: Bɔfoi nɛɛ tsɔ̃ wuoyigbɛ lɛ kɛyashɛ Hebron he ni Ahimanbii lɛ kɛ Sheshaibii lɛ kɛ Talmaibii lɛ yɔɔ lɛ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ lɛ, gbɔmɛi gojogojoo ni, ni mɛi ni atsɛɔ amɛ akɛ Anakbii lɛ ashwiei ni. Ato Hebron maŋ lɛ afii kpawo dani ato Zoan maŋ ni yɔɔ Ijipt lɛ.

english_verse: the twelve men returned to Kadesh in the Paran Desert and told Moses, Aaron, and the people what they had seen. They showed them the fruit
translation_verse: Amɛba Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ŋɔ̃ɔ yɛ Kadesh yɛ Paran ŋa lɛ nɔ. Amɛbagba amɛ bɔ ni amɛyana nibii amɛhã, ni amɛkɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tsei ayibii lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.

english_verse: and said: Look at this fruit! The land we explored is rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Amɛbɔ Mose amaniɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔtee shikpɔŋ ni otsu wɔ nɔ lɛ nɔ; ni anɔkwale ji akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ewo fɔ ni ebaa nii hu, ni enɔ tsei ayibii po nɛ.

english_verse: But the people who live there are strong, and their cities are large and walled. We even saw the three Anakim clans.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛhe wa; ni amɛmaji lɛ atswatswaa gbogboi awo amɛhe akɛwaje amɛ, ni maji lɛ dara naakpa hu; asaŋ wɔna Anakbii oblaŋi lɛ hu yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: Besides that, the Amalekites live in the Southern Desert; the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites are in the hill country; and the Canaanites live along the Mediterranean Sea and the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Amalekbii lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ, ni Hitbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni Kanaanbii lɛ kã ŋshɔ lɛ naa kɛ Yordan Faa lɛ hu naa.”

english_verse: Caleb calmed down the crowd and said, “Let's go and take the land. I know we can do it!”
translation_verse: Shi Kaleb tswa bɔfoi lɛ anaa mã yɛ Mose hiɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔyaa kɛ̃ koni wɔyaŋɔa shikpɔŋ lɛ ejaakɛ wɔbaanyɛ amɛnɔ kunim wɔye aahu.”

english_verse: But the other men replied, “Those people are much too strong for us.”
translation_verse: Shi hii lɛ ni kɛ Kaleb tee amɛyasara shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔnyɛŋ gbɔmɛi lɛ ahiɛ wɔdamɔ, ejaakɛ amɛhe wa fe wɔ.”

english_verse: and complained to Moses and Aaron, “We wish we had died in Egypt or somewhere out here in the desert!
translation_verse: ni amɛwie huhuuhu amɛshi Mose kɛ Aaron, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔgboi moŋ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, loo yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ po kulɛ bɛ ehi?

english_verse: Is the Lord leading us into Canaan, just to have us killed and our women and children captured? We'd be better off in Egypt.”
translation_verse: Mɛɛba Yehowa ekpala wɔ kɛba shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ koni wɔbanyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa koni aŋɔ wɔŋamɛi kɛ wɔbifabii anom nɛɛ? Ani ehiii moŋ akɛ wɔkpale kɛya Ijipt ekoŋŋ?”

english_verse: Then they said to one another, “Let's choose our own leader and go back.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔwoa wɔteŋ mɔ ko onukpa koni enyiɛ wɔhiɛ, ni wɔku wɔsɛɛ kɛya Ijipt.”

english_verse: Moses and Aaron bowed down to pray in front of the crowd.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi yɛ Israelbii asafo ni ebabɔ gwa lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: and said: We saw the land ourselves, and it's very good.
translation_verse: ni amɛkɛɛ Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Shikpɔŋ lɛ ni wɔyakpa nɔ wɔsara wɔkwɛ lɛ, shikpɔŋ kpakpa jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ ni.

english_verse: If we obey the Lord, he will surely give us that land rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Kɛji Yehowa yɛ wɔhe tsui lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ wɔ aaayashɛ jɛi, ni eeeŋɔ nakai shikpɔŋ ni hi ni baa nii lɛ ehã wɔ.

english_verse: So don't rebel. We have no reason to be afraid of the people who live there. The Lord is on our side, and they won't stand a chance against us!
translation_verse: Shi moŋ Yehowa hiɛ atua kɛkɛ ni nyɛkatsea; ni asaŋ nyɛkashea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ amɛshɛŋ wɔwaosɛɛkpelɔ tete; amɛkɔlɔ eje amɛnɔ momo; shi wɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ wɔ yɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkashea gbeyei.”

english_verse: The crowd threatened to stone Moses and Aaron to death. But just then, the Lord appeared in a cloud at the sacred tent. Moses Prays for the People
translation_verse: Asafo lɛ fɛɛ to amɛyiŋ akɛ amɛbaatswia amɛ tɛ pɛ kɛkɛ ni Yehowa anunyam la lɛ pue yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ nɔ yɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ. Mose sɔle yɛ Maŋbii lɛ ahewɔ

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “I have done great things for these people, and they still reject me by refusing to believe in my power.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ maŋ nɛɛ aaakwa mi kɛyashi? Mɛni shwɛɔ dɔŋŋ dani amɛaahe minɔ amɛye yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni mifee mikɛto amɛ okadii lɛ asɛɛ?

english_verse: So they will no longer be my people. I will destroy them, but I will make you the ancestor of a nation even stronger than theirs.”
translation_verse: Mibahã gbele hela ababote amɛteŋ koni mikɛkpãtã amɛhiɛ; shi mahã oshwiei atsɔ̃ maŋ kpeteŋkple ni he wa fe maŋ nɛɛ.”

english_verse: that you love to show mercy and kindness. And you said that you are very patient, but that you will punish everyone guilty of doing wrong—not only them but their children and grandchildren as well.
translation_verse: ‘Mi, Yehowa, mimli fuuu mra, ni mimɔbɔnalɛ hu fa; ni mikɛ tɔ̃mɔ kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ faa; shi kɛ̃lɛ mihãaa tɔ̃lɔ aŋɔ ehe aye, ni miwoɔ bii anyɔmɔ yɛ tsɛmɛi atɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ kɛyashiɔ yinɔ ni ji etɛ̃ kɛ yinɔ ni ji ejwɛ tete nɔ.’

english_verse: You are merciful, and you treat people better than they deserve. So please forgive these people, just as you have forgiven them ever since they left Egypt.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, okɛ maŋ nɛɛ tɔ̃mɔ afa amɛ yɛ osuɔmɔ kpeteŋkple lɛ naa tamɔ bɔ ni okɛfa nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt aahu kɛbashi bianɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: I swear that not one of these Israelites will enter the land I promised to give their ancestors. These people have seen my power in Egypt and in the desert, but they will never see Canaan. They have disobeyed and tested me too many times.
translation_verse: amɛteŋ mɔ kome nɛkɛ shɛŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni miwo ehe shi mito akɛ mikɛbaahã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ. Mɛi fɛɛ ni kwa mi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome nɛkɛ shɛŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: But my servant Caleb isn't like the others. So because he has faith in me, I will allow him to cross into Canaan, and his descendants will settle there.
translation_verse: Shi akɛni soro mumɔ ni mitsulɔ Kaleb hiɛ, ni asaŋ eye mi anɔkwa kɛwula shi hewɔ lɛ, lɛ lɛ, mikɛ lɛ baaya ayashɛ shikpɔŋ ni etee ayasara lɛ nɔ, ni jɛi aaatsɔ̃ eshwiei anɔ.

english_verse: Now listen, Moses! The Amalekites and the Canaanites live in the valleys of Canaan. And tomorrow, you'll need to turn around and head back into the desert toward the Red Sea. The Israelites Are Punished for Complaining
translation_verse: Amalekbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ yɛ jɔɔ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ amrɔ nɛɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, wɔ lɛ, nyɛdɔa nyɛyi koni nyɛtsɔ̃a Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ he gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛyajea ŋa lɛ nɔ.” Yehowa gbala maŋ lɛ toi

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ,

english_verse: to give this message to the people of Israel: You sinful people have complained against me too many times! Now I swear by my own life that I will give you exactly what you wanted.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ, ‘Gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ, bɔ ni nyɛwie nyɛwo mitoiŋ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ mibafee nyɛ.

english_verse: You will die right here in the desert, and your dead bodies will cover the ground. You have insulted me, and none of you men who are over
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ shiaŋa nɛɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ nyɛbaagboi yɛ. Nyɛteŋ mɛi fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa, ni wie huhuuhu shi mi lɛ,

english_verse: will enter the land that I solemnly promised to give you as your own—only Caleb and Joshua will go in.
translation_verse: amɛteŋ mɔ kome nɛkɛ shɛŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni miwo shi yɛ he akɛ mikɛbaahã nyɛ koni nyɛhi nɔ lɛ nɔ, akɛ ja Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ, kɛ Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ.

english_verse: You were worried that your own children would be captured. But I, the Lord, will let them enter the land you have rejected.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛbii bibii lɛ ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ aaaŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ, mibakpala amɛ kɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni nyɛkpoo lɛ nɔ, ni amɛaale jɛi.

english_verse: You will die here in the desert!
translation_verse: Nyɛ lɛ shiaŋa nɛɛ nɔ nyɛbaagboi yɛ.

english_verse: So they got up early the next morning and got ready to head toward the hill country of Canaan. They said, “We were wrong to complain about the Lord. Let's go into the land that he promised us.”
translation_verse: Enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi maŋkpa lɛ, Israelbii lɛ kwɔ kɛtee gɔji ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ̃; ni amɛkɛɛ, “Naa wɔ, wɔbaaya he ni Yehowa ewo shi yɛ he lɛ kɛ̃; ejaakɛ wɔfee esha!”

english_verse: You sinful people who ganged up against me will die here in the desert.
translation_verse: Mi, Yehowa, minã miwie; ni anɔkwa, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ mafee nɛkɛ asafo fɔŋ ni fee ekome wo mi nɛɛ. Nɛkɛ shiaŋa nɛɛ nɔ nyɛaagboi ni nyɛyi aaatã yɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Ten of the men sent to explore the land had brought back bad news and had made the people complain against the Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni hii lɛ ni Mose tsu yasara shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛba ni amɛbatã shikpɔŋ lɛ he sane fɔŋ amɛkɛhã maŋ lɛ wie huhuuhu amɛshi Yehowa lɛ,

english_verse: So he sent a deadly disease that killed those men,
translation_verse: gbele hela fɔŋ ko bashi amɛnɔ, ni amɛtswia shi amɛgboi yɛ amɛnajiaŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: But Moses replied, “You're disobeying the Lord! Your plan won't work,
translation_verse: Shi Mose here amɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛtaoɔ akɛ nyɛkuɔ Yehowa wiemɔ nɔ nɛɛ? Nyɛyeŋ omanye.

english_verse: The Amalekites and the Canaanites came down from the hill country, defeated the Israelites, and chased them as far as the town of Hormah.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Amalekbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ ni yɔɔ gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ kpeleke shi, ni amɛbaye Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛshwie amɛ aahu kɛtee Horma tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: The people of Israel were very sad after Moses gave them the Lord's message.
translation_verse: Be ni Mose jaje wiemɔi ni Yehowa kɛ lɛ wie lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ ye ŋkɔmɔ babaoo.

english_verse: so don't even try it. The Lord refuses to help you, because you turned your backs on him. The Amalekites and the Canaanites are your enemies, and they will attack and defeat you.”
translation_verse: Amalekbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ yɛ jɛi, ni amɛkɛ nyɛ baakpe, ni amɛbaagbegbee nyɛ, ejaakɛ gbii abɔ ni nyɛkpale yɛ Yehowa sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa hu fiŋ nyɛsɛɛ.”

english_verse: But the Israelites ignored Moses and marched toward the hill country, even though the sacred chest and Moses did not go with them.
translation_verse: Shi maŋbii lɛ shi amɛtsitsi, ni amɛkã akɛ amɛaakwɔ gɔŋ lɛ kɛya eyiteŋ, tsɛbelɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ Mose fɛɛ shiii shitoohe lɛ mli kɛyaaa.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: to give the Israelites the following laws about offering sacrifices:
translation_verse: “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikɛhãa nyɛ ni nyɛhi nɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: Bulls or rams or goats are the animals that you may burn on the altar as sacrifices to please me. You may also offer sacrifices voluntarily or because you made a promise, or because they are part of your regular religious ceremonies. The smell of the smoke from these sacrifices is pleasing to me.
translation_verse: kɛji nyɛkɛ tsina loo too baashã afɔle nyɛkɛhã mi, Yehowa, lɛ, shãa afɔle ni jio, gbee afɔle ni jio, afɔle ni akɛmiiye shiwoo ko nɔ ni jio, tsuijurɔ naa afɔle ni jio, nyɛgbii juji ni ato lɛ eko nɔ afɔle ni jio, afɔle lɛ ŋma asa mi, Yehowa, mihiɛ.

english_verse: If you sacrifice a young ram or goat, you must also offer a kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of olive oil as a grain sacrifice. A liter of wine must also be poured on the altar.
translation_verse: kɛ wain hu lita kome. Akɛ nibii nɛɛ afata toobi kome ni akɛbaashã shãa afɔle loo gbee afɔle lɛ he.

english_verse: If a bull is offered as a sacrifice to please me or to ask my blessing,
translation_verse: Shi kɛji akɛ tsina oblanyo baashã shãa afɔle loo gbee afɔle akɛ akɛmiiye shiwoo ko nɔ loo akɛ shidaa afɔle akɛhã mi, Yehowa, lɛ,

english_verse: you must offer three kilograms of flour mixed with two liters of olive oil.
translation_verse: no lɛ niyenii afɔle ni akɛfata tsina oblanyo lɛ he lɛ afee ŋmãa mamu kiloi etɛ̃ ni akɛ mu litai enyɔ efutu mli;

english_verse: Two liters of wine must also be poured on the altar. The smell of this smoke is pleasing to me.
translation_verse: ni akɛ wain litai enyɔ hu afata he. Afɔle ni akɛ la shãa hãa mi Yehowa, ni misumɔɔ eŋma ji enɛ.’

english_verse: If you are a native Israelite, you must obey these rules each time you offer a bull, a ram, or a goat as a sacrifice.
translation_verse: Israel fɔmɔbi fɛɛ fɔmɔbi afee enɛ kɛji eba ebaashã niyenii afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ mi, Yehowa.

english_verse: This law will never change. I am the Lord, and I consider all people the same, whether they are Israelites or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mla kome kɛ gbɛjianɔtoo kome baahi shi ahã nyɛ Israel fɔmɔbii kɛ gbɔ ni ebato nyɛ lɛ fɛɛ.”

english_verse: When you eat food in the land that I am giving you, remember to set aside some of it as an offering to me.
translation_verse: shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii ni nyɛaana nyɛye lɛ, nyɛkɛ eko ashãa afɔle nyɛhãa mi, Yehowa.

english_verse: From the first batch of bread dough that you make after each new grain harvest, make a loaf of bread and offer it to me, just as you offer grain.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ nyɛkpokploku mã lɛ eko ashãa aboloo nyɛhãa mi akɛ nɔwomɔ afɔle. Bɔ ni nyɛshãa ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ he afɔle lɛ, nakai nyɛshã enɛ hu.

english_verse: All your descendants must follow this law and offer part of the first batch of bread dough.
translation_verse: Nyɛbaashã kpokploku mã aboloo afɔle nɛɛ nyɛkɛhã Yehowa yɛ nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ mli.

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses to tell the people what must be done if they ever disobey his laws:
translation_verse: kitãi fɛɛ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ewo nyɛ, kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni Yehowa wo nakai mlai lɛ, kɛyashi nyɛyinɔi ayinɔi blublu anɔ lɛ,

english_verse: If all of you disobey one of my laws without knowing it, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice to please me, together with a grain sacrifice, a wine offering, and a goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: ni atɔ̃ tɔ̃mɔ ko, yɛ leee ni asafo lɛ leee hewɔ lɛ, no lɛ asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ amɛdɛŋ tsina oblanyo kome koni amɛkɛshã shãa afɔle amɛkɛhã mi, akɛ afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ mi, Yehowa. Akɛ niyenii kɛ dãa afɔle hu bɔ ni afo akɛ kusum lɛ afata he. Too kpakpo kome hu afata he koni akɛshã esha lɛ hefaikpamɔ afɔle.

english_verse: Then the priest will pray and ask me to forgive you. And since you did not mean to do wrong, and you offered sacrifices,
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni akɛ tɔ̃mɔ lɛ aaafa amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛhiɛ kãaa he, ni asaŋ, tɔ̃mɔ lɛ hewɔ ni amɛhiɛ amɛdɛŋ shãa afɔle kɛ niyenii afɔle ni akɛhãa Yehowa lɛ.

english_verse: But if one of you does wrong without knowing it, you must sacrifice a year-old female goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: “Kɛji mɔ ko fee esha ni ehiɛ kãaa he lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ abotiayoo ni eye afi aba koni akɛshã esha lɛ hefaikpamɔ afɔle.

english_verse: The priest will then ask me to forgive you, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Osɔfo lɛ akpãtã yɛ Yehowa hiɛ ehã mɔ ni efee esha lɛ ni akɛaafa lɛ.

english_verse: The law will be the same for anyone who does wrong without meaning to, whether an Israelite or a foreigner living among you.
translation_verse: Mla kome akã shi ahã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jeee kwa ekwa efee esha lɛ, Israel fɔmɔbi ni jio, mɔkpɔŋ ni ebato gbɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ ni jio.

english_verse: But if one of you does wrong on purpose, whether Israelite or foreigner, you have sinned against me by disobeying my laws. You will no longer belong to my people. A Man Put to Death for Gathering Firewood on the Sabbath
translation_verse: ejaakɛ ebuuu Yehowa wiemɔ, ni etɔ̃ ekitã nɔ. Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ agbe lɛ koni emusu atere lɛ.” Nuu ko tɔ̃ hejɔɔmɔ gbi mla nɔ

english_verse: Once, while the Israelites were traveling through the desert, a man was caught gathering firewood on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Be ko be mli ni Israelbii lɛ yɔɔ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lolo lɛ, ayana nuu ko ni etee eelɛ lai yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: He was taken to Moses, Aaron, and the rest of the community.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni yana nuu lɛ kpala lɛ kɛba Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: But no one knew what to do with him, so he was not allowed to leave.
translation_verse: Awo nuu lɛ tsuŋ ejaakɛ nakai be mli lɛ anako nɔ pɔtɛɛ ni sa akɛ afee lɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Tell the people to take that man outside the camp and stone him to death!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Agbe nuu lɛ. Akɛ lɛ aje kpo kɛya shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ koni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ atswia lɛ tɛi ni agbe lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel, “Sew tassels onto the bottom edge of your clothes and tie a blue string to each tassel.
translation_verse: “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛfee ahwanyai amɛwo amɛtadei akoji anaa, ni akɛ kpãa bluu amɔ̃mɔ̃ amɛ. Yinɔi fɛɛ anɔ bii afee nakai.

english_verse: These will remind you that you must obey my laws and teachings. And when you do, you will be dedicated to me and won't follow your own sinful desires.
translation_verse: Ahwanyai lɛ baakai nyɛ mikitãi lɛ koni nyɛye nɔ, koni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi nyɛhã mi, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God who led you out of Egypt.”
translation_verse: Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni matsɔ̃ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: Korah son of Izhar was a Levite from the Kohathite clan. One day he called together Dathan, Abiram, and On from the Reuben tribe, and the four of them decided to rebel against Moses. So they asked
translation_verse: Amɛte shi amɛwo Mose. Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni ji asafo lɛ mli onukpai kɛ hiɛnaanɔbii ni yɔɔ gbɛi komɛi hu fata amɛhe.

english_verse: and Aaron and said, “Why do you think you're so much better than everyone else? We're part of the Lord's holy people, and he's with all of us. What makes you think you're the only ones in charge?”
translation_verse: Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kpe amɛwo Mose kɛ Aaron he, ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛmiitsɛ nyɛhe tsɔ̃. Ejaakɛ asafo muu lɛ mli mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, Yehowa nɔ ni; ni Yehowa kɛ wɔ fɛɛ yɛ. Mɛɛba ni nyɛwoɔ nyɛhe nɔ yɛ Yehowa asafo lɛ nɔ mɔ?”

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he knelt down to pray.
translation_verse: Be ni Mose nu wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi ni esɔle.

english_verse: Then he said to Korah and his followers: Tomorrow morning the Lord will show us the person he has chosen to be his priest, and that man will faithfully serve him.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Kora kɛ asafo lɛ ni ekɛba lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔ ni ji wɔ leebi lɛ Yehowa baahã ale mɔ ni ji enɔ; mɔ ni ji mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, lɛ ebaahã ebɛŋkɛ lɛ. Mɔ ni Yehowa aaaŋɔ̃ lɛ, lɛ ebaahã ebɛŋkɛ lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he.

english_verse: Korah, here is what you and your followers must do: Get some fire pans, fill them with coals and incense, and place them near the sacred tent. And the man the Lord chooses will be his priest. Korah, this time you Levites have gone too far!
translation_verse: nyɛjea la nyɛwoa amɛmli kɛbaa wɔ, koni nyɛkɛ tsofakɛŋma abashwiea nɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. Jɛi wɔbaana yɛ mɔ ni Yehowa aaaŋɔ̃ lɛ akɛ lɛ ji mɔ̃ krɔŋkrɔŋ. Nyɛmiitsɛ nyɛhe tsɔ̃, nyɛ Levibii.”

english_verse: You know that the God of Israel has chosen you Levites from all Israel to serve him by being in charge of the sacred tent and by helping the community to worship in the proper way. What more do you want?
translation_verse: Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ etse nyɛ yɛ Israel asafo lɛ he, ni ehãa nyɛ hegbɛ ni nyɛbɛŋkɛɔ lɛ, ni nyɛtsuɔ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli nii; ni asaŋ nyɛdamɔɔ asafo lɛ hiɛ nyɛsɔ̃mɔɔ amɛ, aso no faaa hãaa nyɛ lo?

english_verse: The Lord has given you a special responsibility, and now, Korah, you think you should also be his priest.
translation_verse: Yehowa ehã bo kɛ onyɛmimɛi Levibii lɛ fɛɛ bɛŋkɛɔ lɛ; ni fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ nyɛmiitao osɔfoyeli lɛ hu nyɛfata he?

english_verse: Then Moses sent for Dathan and Abiram, but they sent back this message: “We won't come!
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsu koni ayatsɛ Datan kɛ Abiram, Eliabbii lɛ, kɛba. Shi amɛhã hetoo akɛ, “Wɔbaaa he ko he ko!

english_verse: It's bad enough that you took us from our rich farmland in Egypt to let us die here in the desert. Now you also want to boss us around!
translation_verse: Kɛji obakpala wɔ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni ewo fɔ nɔ, ni obaagbegbee wɔ yɛ ŋa nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, no kɛkɛ faaa hãaa bo; shi no sɛɛ hu lɛ ootao akɛ oyeɔ lumɔ yɛ wɔnɔ lo?

english_verse: Moses was very angry and said to the Lord, “Don't listen to these men! I haven't done anything wrong to them. I haven't taken as much as a donkey.”
translation_verse: Sane lɛ wo Mose mli la naakpa; ni ekɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Kaahe amɛfɔlei lɛ. Mishɔ̃ko amɛteŋ mɔ ko teji yɛ edɛŋ lɛ, miyeko amɛteŋ mɔ ko sane fɔŋ ko!”

english_verse: Then he said to Korah, “Tomorrow you and your followers must go with Aaron to the Lord's sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Kora akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ, bo kɛ osafo lɛ fɛɛ aba Yehowa hiɛ. Bo kɛ amɛ kɛ Aaron fɛɛ.

english_verse: Each of you take along your fire pan with incense in it and offer the incense to the Lord.”
translation_verse: Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ, bo kɛ osafoŋbii ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ, kɛ Aaron hu, akɔ elajee tsɛnsi, ni ekɛ tsofakɛŋma awo mli koni nyɛkɛba Yehowa hiɛ.”

english_verse: The next day the men placed incense and coals in their fire pans and stood with Moses and Aaron at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɔ elajee tsɛnsi, ni eje la ewo mli; ni ekɛ tsofakɛŋma shwie nɔ, ni amɛkɛba amɛbadamɔ shi yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, amɛ kɛ Mose kɛ Aaron fɛɛ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, Korah had convinced the rest of the Israelites to rebel against their two leaders. When that happened, the Lord appeared in all his glory
translation_verse: Kora bua maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ naa ewo Mose kɛ Aaron; amɛbabɔ gwa yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi ni amɛmiikwɛ Mose. Yehowa anunyam la lɛ pue trukaa yɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: and said to Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ,

english_verse: “Get away from the rest of the Israelites so I can kill them at once!”
translation_verse: “Nyɛtsia nyɛhe yɛ nɛkɛ asafo nɛɛ he koni makpãtã amɛhiɛ hiŋmɛitswaa mli.”

english_verse: But the two men bowed down and prayed, “Our God, you gave these people life. Why would you punish everyone here when only one man has sinned?”
translation_verse: Shi Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi, ni amɛsɔle amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, Nyɔŋmɔ, heloo fɛɛ awala jɛɛhe! Aso mɔ kome aaafee esha, ni okɛ ehe nu aaaju maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ he lo?”

english_verse: The Lord answered Moses,
translation_verse: Yehowa hã Mose hetoo akɛ,

english_verse: “Tell the people to stay away from the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.”
translation_verse: “Kɛɛmɔ maŋ muu lɛ akɛ, ‘Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ashi Kora kɛ Datan kɛ Abiram shihilɛhei lɛ ahe kɛya sɛɛ flɛŋŋ.’ ”

english_verse: Moses walked over to Dathan and Abiram, and the other leaders of Israel followed.
translation_verse: Mose te shi, ni eyiŋ kɛtee Datan kɛ Abiram ŋɔ̃ɔ, ni Israel maŋ onukpai lɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ kɛtee.

english_verse: Then Moses warned the people, “Get away from the tents of these sinful men! Don't touch anything that belongs to them or you'll be wiped out.”
translation_verse: Mose kɛɛ asafo lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsia nyɛhe oya kɛjea nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji nɛɛ abui lɛ ahe kɛyaa sɛɛ flɛŋŋ, ni nyɛkataa amɛnɔ ko nɔ ko he koni akakpãtã nyɛ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ hiɛ yɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ.”

english_verse: Moses said to the crowd, “The Lord has chosen me and told me to do these things—it wasn't my idea. And here's how you will know:
translation_verse: Mose kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Enɛ nyɛkɛaale akɛ Yehowa ji mɔ ni tsu mi akɛ mibatsu nibii fɛɛ ni nyɛnaa ni mifeɔ lɛ, shi jeee mi diɛŋtsɛ mito miyiŋ ni mifeɔ.

english_verse: But suppose the Lord does something that has never been done before. For example, what if a huge crack appears in the ground, and these men and their families fall into it and are buried alive, together with everything they own? Then you will know they have turned their backs on the Lord!”
translation_verse: Shi kɛji Yehowa fee nɔ ko ni bako dã, ni shikpɔŋ gba ni emĩ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ, ni amɛkpeleke shi kɛtee gbohiiaje hiɛkãalɔi lɛ, no nyɛkɛaale akɛ nɛkɛ hii nɛɛ ebuuu Yehowa.”

english_verse: As soon as Moses said this, the ground under the men opened up
translation_verse: Mose naa ni nyɔ shi nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni shikpɔŋ gba yɛ Datan kɛ Abiram shishi,

english_verse: and swallowed them alive, together with their families and everything they owned. Then the ground closed back up, and they were gone.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtee gbohiiaje hiɛkãalɔi kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ. Shikpɔŋ ni gba lɛ bashi hiɛ ni etsa ekoŋŋ, ni emii amɛ, kɛkɛ ni amɛhiɛkpãtã kwrakwra yɛ amɛjakumɛi lɛ ateŋ.

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites heard their screams, so they ran off, shouting, “We don't want that to happen to us!”
translation_verse: Bolɔmɔ ni amɛbolɔ lɛ hã Israelbii fɛɛ ni ewo shi yɛ jɛi kɛkpe lɛ jojoo foi, ni amɛ hu amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Akakwɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ bamii wɔ hu.”

english_verse: Then the Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: “Tell Aaron's son Eleazar to take the fire pans from the smoldering fire and scatter the coals. The pans are now sacred,
translation_verse: “Kɛɛmɔ Eleazar, Osɔfo Aaron binuu lɛ, akɛ ehole lajee tsɛnsii lɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi lɛ ni eshã lɛ ateŋ, ni egbɛ amɛmli la lɛ eshwã kɛya sɛɛ shɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ tsɛnsii lɛ etsɔ̃mɔ nii ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ,

english_verse: because they were used for offering incense to me. Have them hammered into a thin layer of bronze as a covering for the altar. Those men died because of their sin, and now their fire pans will become a warning for the rest of the community.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, atswia hii nɛɛ, mɛi ni kɛ amɛwala wo esha lɛ he nyɔmɔ lɛ, atsɛnsii lɛ tɛtɛrɛbii, ni akɛha afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koni etsɔ̃ okadi ehã Israelbii fɛɛ.”

english_verse: Eleazar collected the pans and had them hammered into a thin layer of bronze as a covering for the altar,
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Osɔfo Eleazar kɔlɔ akɔɔble lajee tsɛnsii lɛ ni hii lɛ ni la lɛ shã lɛ kɛba lɛ, ni atswia akɛfee afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hehaanii,

english_verse: just as the Lord had told Moses. The pans were a warning to the Israelites that only Aaron's descendants would be allowed to offer incense to the Lord. Anyone else who tried to would be punished like Korah and his followers. The Israelites Rebel and Are Punished
translation_verse: koni etsɔ̃ kaimɔnɔ ehã Israelbii lɛ bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ni jeee Aaron shwie ko akatsi ebɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ akɛ ebaashã tsofakɛŋma ekɛhã Yehowa, koni ekabatsɔ̃ tamɔ Kora kɛ esafo lɛ. Eleazar fee bɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Aaron here maŋbii lɛ ayiwala

english_verse: The next day the people of Israel again complained against Moses and Aaron, “The two of you killed some of the Lord's people!”
translation_verse: Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ saa wie huhuuhu amɛshi Mose kɛ Aaron ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛgbe Yehowa webii.”
