translation_verse: Mose kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar he shika tsuru nibii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ tabilɔi lɛ adɛŋ.

english_verse: This did not include the things that the soldiers had kept for themselves.
translation_verse: Shi tabilɔ fɛɛ tabilɔ ha nii hã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hu.

english_verse: So Moses and Eleazar placed the gold in the Lord's sacred tent to remind Israel of what had happened.
translation_verse: Mose kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar he shika lɛ yɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ adɛŋ, ni amɛkɛtee Kpee Buu lɛ mli koni etsɔ̃ kaimɔnɔ ehã Israelbii lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: except Caleb and Joshua. They remained faithful to the Lord,
translation_verse: ja Keniznyo Yefune binuu Kaleb lɛ kɛ Nun binuu Yoshua lɛ. Amɛ lɛ amɛye mi anɔkwa kɛwula shi.’

english_verse: then after the Lord helps Israel capture the land, you can return to your own land. You will no longer have to stay with the others.
translation_verse: ni eeeŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ. No sɛɛ dani nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ kɛba, ni nyɛaaye bem yɛ Yehowa kɛ Israel fɛɛ hiɛ, ni Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ nyɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben and Gad owned a lot of cattle and sheep, and they saw that the regions of Jazer and Gilead had good pastureland.
translation_verse: Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ yɛ kooloi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, be ni amɛna akɛ Yazer kɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ hi hã kooloolɛɛ lɛ,

english_verse: So they went to Moses, Eleazar, and the other leaders of Israel and said,
translation_verse: amɛbakɛɛ Mose kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar kɛ maŋ lumɛi lɛ akɛ,

english_verse: “The Lord has helped us capture the land around the towns of Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon. That's good pastureland, and since we own cattle and sheep,
translation_verse: ni ji shikpɔji ni Yehowa hã Israelbii ye amɛnɔ bii lɛ anɔ kunim lɛ hi hã kooloolɛɛ, ni wɔyɛ kooloi babaoo.

english_verse: would you let us stay here east of the Jordan River and have this land as our own?”
translation_verse: Nyɛfai nɛ, nyɛkɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ahãa wɔ akɛ wɔgbɛfaŋnɔ. Nyɛkɛ wɔ akafoa Yordan lɛ kɛmiiya esɛɛ akɛ wɔyahi jɛi.”

english_verse: Moses answered: You mean you'd stay here while the rest of the Israelites go into battle?
translation_verse: Mose here Gad hii lɛ kɛ Rubenbii lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Aso nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ aya ni amɛyawu ta be mli ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛtara shi yɛ biɛ lo?

english_verse: If you did that, it would discourage the others from crossing over into the land the Lord promised them.
translation_verse: Mɛɛba nyɛfãa Israelbii lɛ atsui koni amɛkafo Yordan lɛ kɛtee shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa kɛhãa amɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ?

english_verse: This is exactly what happened when I sent your ancestors from Kadesh-Barnea to explore the land.
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ji bɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi fee be ni mitsu amɛ kɛjɛ Kadesh Barnea akɛ amɛyasara shikpɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: They went as far as Eshcol Valley, then returned and told the people that we should not enter it.
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛbashɛ Eshkol Jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛna jɛi shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛba lɛ, amɛbafã Israelbii lɛ atsui koni amɛkaya shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa kɛhãa amɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord became very angry.
translation_verse: Yehowa mli wo la nakai gbi lɛ, ekã kitã ekɛɛ,

english_verse: Moses said: You promised that you would be ready to fight for the Lord.
translation_verse: Mose kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛaafee nɔ ni nyɛkɛɛ nɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛsaa nyɛhe yɛ Yehowa hiɛ kɛyaa ta.

english_verse: but he was so angry with the others that he forced them to wander around in the desert for
translation_verse: Yehowa mli fu Israelbii lɛ, ni ehã amɛtsomlo yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛyashi yinɔbii ni gbo Yehowa nɔ toi lɛ fɛɛ gboi.

english_verse: So Moses gave the Machirites the region of Gilead, and they settled there.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Mose jɔɔ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eha Manase bi Makir shwiei lɛ, ni amɛhi jɛi.

english_verse: Now you people of Reuben and Gad are doing the same thing and making the Lord even angrier.
translation_verse: Amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛ nyɛbaye nyɛtsɛmɛi hii toigbolɔi lɛ anajiaŋ, ni nyɛmiitao akɛ Yehowa mlifu ni naa wa lɛ aba Israel nɔ fe tsutsu lɛ?

english_verse: If you reject the Lord, he will once again abandon his people and leave them here in the desert. And you will be to blame!
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛkwa Yehowa lɛ, lɛ hu eeekwa maŋ lɛ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni belɛ nyɛaakpãtã Israel maŋ muu nɛɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.”

english_verse: The men from Reuben and Gad replied: Let us build places to keep our sheep and goats, and towns for our wives and children,
translation_verse: Gad hii lɛ kɛ Ruben hii lɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ Mose, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔmiitao akɛ wɔmãmɔ kooloi atsui kɛkɛ wɔhã wɔkooloi lɛ, ni wɔto maji hu wɔhã wɔbii abifabii lɛ.

english_verse: We will stay with them until they have settled in their own tribal lands.
translation_verse: Wɔkuŋ wɔsɛɛ kɛbaŋ wɔshĩai amli kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Israel akutsei krokomɛi lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko aaana egbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ.

english_verse: The land on this side of the Jordan River will be ours, so we won't expect to receive any on the other side.
translation_verse: Wɔkɛ amɛ epeleŋ shikpɔŋ ko he yɛ Yordan lɛ sɛɛgbɛ kɛyaa fɛɛ, ejaakɛ wɔ wɔgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ ebaje Yordan lɛ biɛgbɛ yɛ bokãgbɛ nɛɛ.”

english_verse: You also agreed to cross the Jordan and stay with the rest of the Israelites, until the Lord forces our enemies out of the land. If you do these things,
translation_verse: Nyɛteŋ tabilɔ fɛɛ tabilɔ afo Yordan Faa lɛ koni ekɛ Yehowa henyɛlɔi lɛ ayawu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Yehowa aaaye ehenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ,

english_verse: But if you don't keep your promise, you will sin against the Lord and be punished.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji nyɛyeee nyɛshiwoo lɛ nɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛtɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ, ni bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ nyɛbaana nyɛtɔ̃mɔ lɛ he toigbalamɔ.

english_verse: Go ahead and build towns for your wives and children, and places for your sheep and goats. Just be sure to do what you have promised.
translation_verse: Nyɛmãmɔa tsui nyɛhãa nyɛbii lɛ, ni nyɛmãmɔa kooloi atsui nyɛhãa nyɛkooloi lɛ; ni shi ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnaa ewo lɛ lɛ nyɛyea nɔ.”

english_verse: The men from Reuben and Gad answered: Sir, we will do just what you have said.
translation_verse: Gad hii lɛ kɛ Ruben hii lɛ here nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Wɔnuŋtsɔ, bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ wɔbaafee nakai.

english_verse: Our wives and children and sheep and cattle will stay here in the towns in Gilead.
translation_verse: Wɔbii abifabii lɛ kɛ wɔŋamɛi lɛ kɛ wɔkooloi lɛ fɛɛ baahi Gilead maji lɛ amli;

english_verse: But those of us who are prepared for battle will cross the Jordan and fight for the Lord.
translation_verse: shi wɔ, hii lɛ, wɔsaa wɔhe, ni wɔbaanyiɛ Yehowa sɛɛ kɛyawu ta lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.”

english_verse: “Make sure that the tribes of Gad and Reuben prepare for battle and cross the Jordan River with you. If they do, then after the land is in your control, give them the region of Gilead as their tribal land.
translation_verse: “Kɛji Gad hii lɛ kɛ Ruben hii lɛ kɛ nyɛ aaafo Yordan lɛ, ni amɛteŋ hii fɛɛ aaawa nyɛ kɛwu ta lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni nyɛaaye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ ahãa amɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.

english_verse: But if they break their promise, they will receive land on the other side of the Jordan, like the rest of the tribes.”
translation_verse: Shi kɛji amɛhii lɛ emiaaa koni amɛ kɛ nyɛ afo Yordan lɛ kɛyawu ta lɛ, no lɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛaana yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ eko kɛkɛ nyɛhãa amɛ.”

english_verse: The tribes of Gad and Reuben replied, “We are your servants and will do whatever the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Gad hii lɛ kɛ Ruben hii lɛ here Mose nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ lɛ nakai otsuji baafee.

english_verse: We will cross the Jordan River, ready to fight for the Lord in Canaan. But the land we will inherit as our own will be on this side of the river.”
translation_verse: Wɔbaamia kɛfo Yordan lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ kɛya Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bɔ ni afee ni wɔgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ni wɔna yɛ biɛ nɛɛ, yɛ Yordan lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ, ahi shi ahã wɔ.”

english_verse: So Moses gave the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and half of Manasseh the territory and towns that King Sihon the Amorite had ruled, as well as the territory and towns that King Og of Bashan had ruled.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Mose kɛ shikpɔji kɛ maji ni yɔɔ Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon kɛ Bashan maŋtsɛ Og hu shishi lɛ fɛɛ hã Gadbii lɛ kɛ Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Yosef bi Manase shwiei akutso lɛ fã lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.

english_verse: The tribe of Gad rebuilt the towns of Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
translation_verse: Gadbii lɛ saa maji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe kɛwaje amɛ lɛ amli tsui lɛ. Dibon kɛ Atarot kɛ Aroer,

english_verse: Atroth-Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
translation_verse: kɛ Atrot-Shofan kɛ Yazer kɛ Yogbeha,

english_verse: Beth-Nimrah, and Beth-Haran. They built walls around them and also built places to keep their sheep and goats.
translation_verse: kɛ Bet-Nimra kɛ Bet-Haran. Amɛmãmɔ kooloi atsui hu yɛ amɛmli.

english_verse: The tribe of Reuben rebuilt Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
translation_verse: Rubenbii lɛ saa tsui ni yɔɔ maji nɛɛ amli lɛ amɛmãmɔ: Heshbon kɛ Eleale kɛ Kiriataim,

english_verse: Sibmah, as well as the towns that used to be known as Nebo and Baal-Meon. They renamed all those places.
translation_verse: kɛ Nebo kɛ Baal-Meon, maŋ ni amɛtsake egbɛi lɛ, kɛ Shibma. Amɛwowoo maji ni amɛsaa nɛɛ fɛɛ gbɛii hei.

english_verse: The clan of Machir from the tribe of East Manasseh went to the region of Gilead, captured its towns, and forced out the Amorites.
translation_verse: Manase binuu Makir shwiei lɛ fã ta kɛtee, ni amɛyatua Gilead, ni amɛshɔ̃ jɛi shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛshwie Amorbii lɛ ni yɔɔ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Jair from the Manasseh tribe captured villages and renamed them “Villages of Jair.”
translation_verse: Manase binuu Yair hu tee ni eyatua Amorbii akrowai komɛi, ni eshɔ̃, ni ewo jɛi akɛ, “Yair Akrowai.”

english_verse: Nobah captured the town of Kenath with its villages and renamed it Nobah.
translation_verse: Noba hu tee eyatua Kenat maŋ lɛ kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ, ni eshɔ̃ fɛɛ, ni ekɛ egbɛi “Noba” lɛ wo maŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Moses kept a list of the places they camped, just as the Lord had instructed. Here is the record of their journey:
translation_verse: Mose ŋmã he fɛɛ he ni yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa lɛ ayiɔ mli yɛ lɛ, kɛ he fɛɛ he ni atoɔ shi yɛ lɛ hu gbɛi; ni nomɛi baa nɛɛ.

english_verse: Israel left the Egyptian city of Rameses on the fifteenth day of the first month. This was the day after the Lord had punished Egypt's gods by killing the first-born sons in every Egyptian family. So while the Egyptians were burying the bodies, they watched the Israelites proudly leave their country.
translation_verse: No mli lɛ Ijiptbii lɛ miifufuu amɛkromɔbii fɛɛ ni Yehowa egbe lɛ agbohii lɛ. Yehowa kɛ nɛkɛ gbele nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ eyɛ hewalɛ fe Ijiptbii awɔji lɛ.

english_verse: After the Israelites left Rameses, they camped at Succoth,
translation_verse: Israelbii lɛ yiŋ kɛjɛ Rameses, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Sukot.

english_verse: and from there, they moved their camp to Etham on the edge of the desert.
translation_verse: Amɛfã kɛjɛ Sukot ni amɛyato shi yɛ Etam yɛ shiaŋa lɛ naa.

english_verse: Then they turned back toward Pi-Hahiroth, east of Baal-Zephon, and camped near Migdol.
translation_verse: Amɛfã yɛ Etam, ni amɛdɔ amɛyi kɛtee Pi-Hahirot ni yɔɔ Baal-Zefon bokãgbɛ lɛ, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Migdol masɛi.

english_verse: They left Pi-Hahiroth, crossed the Red Sea, then walked three days into the Etham Desert and camped at Marah.
translation_verse: Amɛshi Pi-Hahirot ni amɛfo Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ kɛyashɛ Shur Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ; ni be ni amɛnyiɛ gbii etɛ̃ gbɛ lɛ amɛto shi yɛ Mara.

english_verse: They left Elim and camped near the Red Sea,
translation_verse: Amɛfã nyiɛmɔ kɛjɛ Elim ni amɛyato shi yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa.

english_verse: then turned east and camped along the western edge of the Sinai Desert.
translation_verse: Ni amɛshi Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa lɛ, amɛyato shi yɛ Sin Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ;

english_verse: From there they went to Dophkah, Alush, and Rephidim, where they had no water.
translation_verse: be ni amɛjɛ Alush lɛ, amɛyawa yɛ Refidim; amɛnaaa nu amɛnu yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: When they left Kadesh, they came to Mount Hor, on the border of Edom.
translation_verse: kɛkɛ lɛ Hor Gɔŋ lɛ he yɛ Edombii ashikpɔŋ lɛ husu lɛ naa.

english_verse: That's where the Lord commanded Aaron the priest to go to the top of the mountain. Aaron died there on the first day of the fifth month,
translation_verse: Yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa lɛ Osɔfo Aaron kwɔ kɛtee Hor Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eyagbo yɛ jɛi yɛ Israelbii lɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shimɔ sɛɛ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ mli nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: It was then that the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Southern Desert of Canaan, heard that Israel was headed that way.
translation_verse: Arad maŋtsɛ ni yɔɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ nu akɛ Israelbii lɛ miiba.

english_verse: and finally in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amɛfã yɛ Abarim Gɔŋ lɛ he ni amɛyato shi yɛ Moab ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ yɛ Yeriko ŋlɛnɔ.

english_verse: While Israel was camped in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho, the Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose yɛ Moab ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ sɛɛ yɛ Yeriko ŋlɛnɔ akɛ,

english_verse: to give the people of Israel this message: When you cross the Jordan River and enter Canaan,
translation_verse: “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛfo Yordan lɛ kɛtee Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: Then settle in the land—I have given it to you as your own.
translation_verse: Nyɛŋɔa shikpɔŋ lɛ koni nyɛhia nɔ, ejaakɛ mijɔɔ nɔ mihã nyɛ koni etsɔ̃ nyɛnɔ.

english_verse: I will show you how to divide the land among the tribes, according to the number of clans in each one, so that the larger tribes will have more land than the smaller ones.
translation_verse: Nyɛfɔa oshiki koni nyɛkɛja shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛhã nyɛkutsei lɛ. Akutso ni yi fa lɛ, ena shikpɔŋ agbo; ni akutso ni yi faaa lɛ ena shikpɔŋ fioo. Bɔ ni oshiki lɛ baagbee shi ehã lɛ, nakai naa aja shikpɔŋ lɛ ahã akutso fɛɛ akutso.

english_verse: If you don't force out all the people there, they will be like splinters in your eyes and thorns in your back. They will always be trouble for you,
translation_verse: Shi naa, kɛji nyɛshwieee shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ kɛjeee nyɛteŋ lɛ, no lɛ amɛteŋ mɛi ni nyɛbaashi lɛ baagba nyɛnaa tamɔ aklatii ni miitsulɔ nyɛhiŋmɛiiaŋ kɛ ŋmei yɛ nyɛŋmawuiaŋ; ni amɛbaahao nyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyɔɔ nɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: and I will treat you as severely as I planned on treating them.
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛshwieee amɛ lɛ, no lɛ bɔ ni mito ni mibakpãtã amɛhiɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mibafee nyɛ hu.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: The southern border will be the Zin Desert and the northwest part of Edom. This border will begin at the south end of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ baakã shi kɛjɛ Zin ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni ebaanyiɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ husu lɛ nɔ. Nyɛwuoyigbɛ husu lɛ baajɛ Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ bokãgbɛ naagbee gbɛ,

english_verse: It will go west from there, but will turn southward to include Scorpion Pass, the village of Zin, and the town of Kadesh-Barnea. From there, the border will continue to Hazar-Addar and on to Azmon.
translation_verse: ni ebaadɔ eyi kɛya wuoyigbɛ Akrabim Jɔɔ lɛ mli. Kɛkɛ lɛ efo mli kɛtsɔ Zin kɛtee wuoyigbɛ aahu kɛyashɛ Kadesh Barnea. Kɛjɛ jɛi lɛ husu lɛ baadɔ eyi eŋmɛ kooyi anaigbɛ kɛtsɔ Hazar Adar kɛya Azmon.

english_verse: It will run along the Egyptian Gorge and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Husu lɛ baadɔ eyi yɛ Azmon kɛyanina Ijipt husu lɛ naa jɔɔ lɛ, ni enaa baaya eyatã yɛ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ naa.

english_verse: The western border will be the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Nyɛnaigbɛ husu lɛ ji Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ kɛ enaa shikpɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The northern border will begin at the Mediterranean, then continue eastward to Mount Hor.
translation_verse: “Nyɛkooyigbɛ husu lɛ nyɛbaajie kɛjɛ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ naa kɛyamɔ Hor Gɔŋ lɛ;

english_verse: After that, it will run to Lebo-Hamath and across to Zedad, which is the northern edge of your land.
translation_verse: ni ebaajɛ jɛi hu kɛyamɔ Hamat, koni etsa nɔ kɛya Zedad,

english_verse: From Zedad, the border will continue east to Ziphron and end at Hazar-Enan.
translation_verse: kɛyashɛ Zifron; ni ebaanyiɛ nɔ koni enaa ayatã yɛ Hazar Enan. Enɛ baafee nyɛkooyigbɛ husu.

english_verse: The eastern border will begin at Hazar-Enan in the north, then run south to Shepham,
translation_verse: “Nyɛbaakadi nyɛbokãgbɛ husu lɛ kɛjɛ Hazar Enan kɛyamɔ Shefam;

english_verse: and on down to Riblah on the east side of Ain. From there, it will go south to the eastern hills of Lake Galilee,
translation_verse: ni husu lɛ baatsa nɔ kɛjɛ Shefam koni ekpeleke shi kɛya Harbel yɛ Ain bokãgbɛ. Kɛjɛ jɛi lɛ enyiɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ kɛyanina Galilea Kpaakpo lɛ yɛ ebokãgbɛ;

english_verse: then follow the Jordan River down to the north end of the Dead Sea. The land within those four borders will belong to you.
translation_verse: etsa nɔ kɛyamɔ Yordan Faa lɛ koni enaa ayatã yɛ Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ naa. Nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ ehe husui ni bɔle lɛ kpula lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: Then Moses told the people, “You will receive the land inside these borders. It will be yours, but the Lord has commanded you to divide it among the nine and a half tribes.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Shikpɔŋ ni nyɛbaafɔ̃ oshiki kɛja nyɛhã nyɛhe lɛ nɛ, ni ji shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa wo he shi akɛ ekɛbaahã akutsei nɛɛhu kɛ fã lɛ.

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh have already been given their land

translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: They will be places of protection for anyone who lives in Israel and accidentally kills someone. Laws about Murder and Accidental Killing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ maji ekpaa nɛɛ atsɔ̃ abobaa maji ahã nyɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛ gbɔi ni ebato nyɛ kɛ mɛi ni ebadɔmɔ nyɛ kwraa hu fɛɛ, koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaagbe mɔ ko be mli ni jeee gbɛ eje lɛ ajo foi kɛya jɛi eyaba abo.

english_verse: Suppose you hit someone with a piece of iron or a large stone or a dangerous wooden tool. If that person dies, then you are a murderer and must be put to death
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛji mɔ ko hiɛ tso ni aaanyɛ gbɔmɔ agbe, ni ekɛtswa mɔ ko, ni mɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ mli egbo lɛ, mɔ ni tswa mɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ egbe gbɔmɔ, ni esa akɛ lɛ hu agbe lɛ.

english_verse: Or suppose you get angry and kill someone by pushing or hitting or by throwing something. You are a murderer and must be put to death by one of the victim's relatives.
translation_verse: aloo egba mɔ lɛ ma, ni mɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ mli egbo lɛ, gbɔmɔ ni gba mɔ lɛ ma lɛ egbe gbɔmɔ, ni esa akɛ lɛ hu agbe lɛ. Mɔ ni agbe lɛ wekunyo yɛ hegbɛ ni etɔɔ enyɛmi lɛ lá lɛ he owele. He fɛɛ he ni ekɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ aaakpe yɛ lɛ, eyɛ hegbɛ akɛ egbeɔ lɛ.

english_verse: But if you are not angry and accidentally kill someone in any of these ways, the townspeople must hold a trial and decide if you are guilty.
translation_verse: no lɛ yɛ mlai nɛɛ anaa lɛ asafo lɛ akojo mɔ ni tswa mɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ lá he oweletɔlɔ lɛ teŋ.

english_verse: If they decide that you are innocent, you will be protected from the victim's relative and sent to stay in one of the Safe Towns until the high priest dies.
translation_verse: Asafo lɛ ahere gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ yiwala yɛ lá oweletɔlɔ lɛ dɛŋ koni ahã gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ ahi shi yɛ maŋ he ni ejo foi kɛtee eyaba abo yɛ lɛ mli, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni mɔ ni afɔ lɛ mu akɛ osɔfonukpa ni yɔɔ be mli ni eyaba abo lɛ aaagbo.

english_verse: The community of Israel must always obey these laws.
translation_verse: Mlai nɛɛ akã shi ahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei ayinɔi fɛɛ yɛ hei fɛɛ ni nyɛaayahi.

english_verse: Death is the penalty for murder. But no one accused of murder can be put to death unless there are at least two witnesses to the crime.
translation_verse: “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni akɛ sane eshi lɛ akɛ egbe gbɔmɔ lɛ, adamɔ odasefoi kɛjɛ mɛi enyɔ loo nɔ nɔ kɛyaa anaa wiemɔ nɔ akɛbu lɛ gbele fɔ. Akadamɔ odasefonyo kome too naa wiemɔ nɔ akɛbu mɔ ko gbele fɔ.

translation_verse: Asaŋ akahe shika ko yɛ mɔgbelɔ ni ejo foi eyaba abo yɛ abobaa maŋ lɛ dɛŋ akɛ ehekpɔ̃mɔ nii, bɔ ni afee ni ekanyɛ eku esɛɛ etee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ beyinɔ ni osɔfonukpa mɔ yinɔ ni eyaba abo lɛ nako agbo,

translation_verse: Yosef bi Manase bi Makir bi Gilead shwiei lɛ atsɛmɛi ashĩai lɛ amli onukpai lɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ Mose kɛ Israelbii lɛ akutseiaŋ onukpai lɛ,

english_verse: and said, “Sir, the Lord has said that he will show what land each tribe will receive as their own. And the Lord has commanded you to give the daughters of our relative Zelophehad the land that he would have received.
translation_verse: ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Yehowa fã nyɛ akɛ nyɛfɔ̃ oshiki koni nyɛkɛja shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛhã Israelbii lɛ. Asaŋ efã hu akɛ nyɛkɛ wɔnyɛmi Zelofehad gbɛfaŋ nɔ lɛ ahã ebiyei lɛ.

english_verse: But if they marry men from other tribes of Israel, the land they receive will become part of that tribe's inheritance and will no longer belong to us.
translation_verse: Belɛ kɛji biyei nɛɛ kɛ Israel hii ni jɛ akutsei krokomɛi amli yabote gbãlãshihilɛ mli lɛ, abaajie amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ yɛ nɔ ni abaahã wɔ lɛ mli koni akɛfata amɛwumɛi lɛ atsɛmɛi agbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ he; enɛ baahã wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ agbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɔ agbɔ.

english_verse: God has even promised to bless us a thousand times more, and I pray that he will.
translation_verse: Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ahã nyɛyi afa bɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ toi akpei abɔ; ni ejɔɔ nyɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ewo nyɛ shi lɛ.

english_verse: But I cannot take care of all your problems and settle all your arguments alone.
translation_verse: Te mafee tɛŋŋ ni mi koome manyɛ nyɛhaomɔi kɛ nyɛteŋ saji fɛɛ makura hu?

english_verse: Then I took these men, who were already wise and respected leaders, and I appointed them as your official leaders. Some of them became military officers in charge of groups of
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni miŋɔ nyɛkutsei lɛ amli hii ni le nii, ni yɔɔ gbɛi hu ni nyɛfamɔ lɛ, ni miwo amɛ onukpai mihã nyɛ, mɛi akpeakpe kui kɛ mɛi ohaoha kui kɛ mɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔenumɔ kui kɛ mɛi nyɔŋmanyɔŋma kui anɔkwɛlɔi kɛ nyɛkutsei lɛ anɔkwɛlɔi hu.

translation_verse: “Miwo nyɛkojolɔi lɛ kitã nakai be lɛ mli, ni mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkuraa saji ni aaaba nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ ni nyɛkojoa mɔ kɛ enyɛmi teŋ loo maŋnyo kɛ gbɔ teŋ sane yɛ jalɛ naa.

english_verse: And it doesn't matter if one is helpless and the other is powerful. Don't be afraid of anyone! No matter who shows up in your court, God will help you make a fair decision. If any case is too hard for you, bring the people to me, and I will make the decision.
translation_verse: Nyɛkakwɛa hiɛiaŋ nyɛkɛkojoa; nyɛboa mɔ bibioo kɛ mɔ wulu fɛɛ toi pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni nyɛkashea gbɔmɔ hiɛ sanekɛɛmɔ gbeyei, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni baakudɔ nyɛ kɛkojo. Shi sane ni mli wa tsɔ̃ hã nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛbahãa mi koni maye.’

translation_verse: “Wɔfã kɛjɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he, ni tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, efã wɔ lɛ, wɔtsɔ̃ shiaŋa ni nɔ yɔɔ gbeyei, tamɔ nyɛna lɛ, nɔ yɛ gbɛ ni yaa Amorbii agɔji ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ, ni wɔbashɛ Kadesh Barnea.

english_verse: and I told you, “We have reached the hill country. It belongs to the Amorites now, but the Lord our God is giving it to us. He is the same God our ancestors worshiped, and he has told us to go in and take this land, so don't hesitate and be afraid.”

translation_verse: “Wiemɔ lɛ sa mihiɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, miŋɔ nyɛteŋ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, akutso fɛɛ akutso mli lɛ mɔ kome, ni mitsu amɛ.

translation_verse: Amɛyi mli, ni amɛkwɔ kɛtee gɔji ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛtee aahu kɛyashɛ Eshkol Jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛyasara jɛi.

english_verse: and even brought back some of the fruit. They said, “The Lord our God is giving us good land.” Israel Refused To Obey the Lord (Numbers
translation_verse: Amɛtserɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aduawai lɛ eko amɛhiɛ amɛdɛ̃, ni amɛkɛkpeleke shi kɛba, ni amɛbagba wɔ akɛ, ‘Shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa wɔ lɛ, ehi.’

english_verse: Then you came back to the place of worship at Kadesh-Barnea and wept, but the Lord would not listen to your prayers. Israel Spent Years in the Desert Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ni nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ nyɛba, ni nyɛbafo nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa shi Yehowa kwɛɛɛ nyɛ lɛ, efooo nyɛdaaŋ hu.” Afii ni aye yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ

english_verse: You did not want to go into the land, and you refused to obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: “Shi nyɛtse Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ atua, ni nyɛyayeee ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛkwa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yaa.

english_verse: We are afraid, because the men who explored the land told us that the cities are large, with walls that reach to the sky. The people who live there are taller and stronger than we are, and some of them are Anakim. We have nowhere to go.”
translation_verse: Nɛgbɛ wɔɔtsɔ̃ kɛya?’ Wɔnyɛmimɛi lɛ ehã wɔtsui efã, ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ, ‘Gbɔmɛi lɛ dara ni amɛkwɔlɔ fe wɔ; amɛmaji lɛ hu dara, ni atswa gbogboi ni kwɔlɔ kɛyashi ŋwɛi awowoo amɛhe; ni wɔna Anakbii tete yɛ jɛi.’

english_verse: The Lord our God will lead the way. He will fight on our side, just as he did when we saw him do all those things to the Egyptians.
translation_verse: Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni nyiɛ nyɛhiɛ lɛ, baawu ehã nyɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni efee ehã nyɛ yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhiŋmɛiaŋ, yɛ Ijipt,

english_verse: And you know that the Lord has taken care of us the whole time we've been in the desert, just as you might carry one of your children.”
translation_verse: kɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ. Ni nyɛna bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ nyɛmli kɛyashi nyɛbashɛ biɛ nɛɛ tamɔ bɔ ni nuu hiɛɔ ebi yɛ ekpɔkɔiaŋ lɛ.’

english_verse: But you still would not trust the Lord,
translation_verse: Shi nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛyaheee Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nyɛyeee,

english_verse: You had made the Lord angry, and he said:
translation_verse: “Yehowa nu wiemɔi ni nyɛwiewie lɛ, ni ewo lɛ mlifu, ni ekã kitã ekɛɛ akɛ,

english_verse: You people of this generation are evil, and I refuse to let you go into the good land that I promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: ‘Nɛkɛ yinɔ fɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ bii nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko enaŋ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni mikã he kitã akɛ mikɛbaahã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh is the only one of your generation that I will allow to go in. He obeyed me completely, so I will give him and his descendants the land he explored.
translation_verse: Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ, pɛ ni aaana jɛi, ni lɛ kɛ eshwiei nɔŋŋ mikɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni eyasara lɛ baahã, ejaakɛ eye mi anɔkwa kɛmɔ shi.’

english_verse: The Lord was even angry with me because of you people, and he said, “Moses, I won't let you go into the land either.
translation_verse: Mi hu, nyɛhewɔ lɛ Yehowa mli fu mi, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Bo Mose, bo hu oshɛŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Instead, I will let Joshua your assistant lead Israel to conquer the land. So encourage him.”
translation_verse: Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, mɔ ni waa bo lɛ ji mɔ ni baaya ayashɛ jɛi. Wo lɛ hewalɛ ejaakɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni baanyiɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ kɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ akɛ amɛnɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord spoke to you again: People of Israel, you said that your innocent young children would be taken prisoner in the battle for the land. But someday I will let them go into the land, and with my help they will conquer it and live there.
translation_verse: Asaŋ nyɛbifabii ni ji nyɛbii ni nako ale ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋ lɛ, mɛi ni nyɛkɛɛ abaaŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ, amɛ amɛbaayashɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ, ni amɛ mikɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ baahã, ni amɛbaaŋɔ akɛ amɛnɔ.

english_verse: Then you told me, “We disobeyed the Lord our God, but now we want to obey him. We will go into the hill country and fight, just as he told us to do.” So you picked up your weapons, thinking it would be easy to take over the hill country.
translation_verse: “Kɛkɛ ni nyɛhere nɔ, ni nyɛkɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Wɔgbo Yehowa nɔ toi; wɔɔtee koni wɔyawu tamɔ bɔ pɛ ni Yehowa fã akɛ wɔfee lɛ.’ Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ mia kɛ etawuu nii, ejaakɛ efee nyɛ akɛ gɔŋ nɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ tuamɔ lɛ shwɛmɔ nɔ ko ni.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Moses, warn them not to go into the hill country. I won't help them fight, and their enemies will defeat them.”
translation_verse: “Shi Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Bɔɔ amɛ kɔkɔ akɛ nyɛkayaa ni nyɛyawua, koni nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ akaye nyɛnɔ ejaakɛ mi kɛ nyɛ eyaŋ.’

english_verse: I told you what the Lord had said, but you paid no attention. You disobeyed him and went into the hill country anyway. You thought you were so great!
translation_verse: Ni mikɛɛ nyɛ hu, shi nyɛbooo mi toi, ni nyɛtse Yehowa hiɛ atua, ni nyɛfee ntɛŋ kɛkwɔ kɛtee gɔŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: But when the Amorites in the hill country attacked from their towns, you ran from them as you would run from a swarm of bees. The Amorites chased your troops into Seir as far as Hormah, killing them as they went.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Amorbii lɛ ni yɔɔ nakai gɔji ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ je kpo, ni amɛ kɛ nyɛ bakpe, ni amɛshwie nyɛ, tamɔ wobii shwieɔ mɔ lɛ, ni amɛtswia nyɛ nii kɛjɛ Edom aahu kɛyashi Horma.

english_verse: After we had been in Kadesh for a few months, we obeyed the Lord and headed back into the desert by way of Red Sea Road.
translation_verse: “No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛye gbii babaoo yɛ Kadesh bɔ ni nyɛle momo lɛ.

english_verse: until the Lord said: Moses,
translation_verse: “Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ,

english_verse: Israel has wandered in these hills long enough. Turn and go north.
translation_verse: ‘Bɔ ni nyɛbɔle shi yɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ he lɛ efa; nyɛtsɔ̃a nyɛhiɛ nyɛhãa kooyigbɛ agbɛnɛ.

english_verse: And give the people these orders: “Be very careful, because you will soon go through the land that belongs to your relatives, the descendants of Esau. They are afraid of you,
translation_verse: Ni obɔ maŋ lɛ kɔkɔ ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ nyɛyaatsɔ̃ nyɛnyɛmimɛi, Esau shwiei, ni yɔɔ Edom lɛ akpokpai lɛ anɔ. Amɛbaashe nyɛ gbeyei;

english_verse: but don't start a war with them. I have given them the hill country of Seir, so I won't give any of it to you, not even enough to set a foot on.
translation_verse: shi moŋ nyɛkwɛa ni ahia, ni nyɛkɛ amɛ akawua ejaakɛ mikɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ he ko he ko haŋ nyɛ. Mihaŋ nyɛ shikpɔŋ nanemaahe kome tete nɛkɛ yɛ jɛi, ejaakɛ mikɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ ehã Esau akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ.

english_verse: And as you go through their land, you will have to buy food and water from them.”
translation_verse: Nyɛkɔa shika nyɛkɛhea niyenii tete yɛ amɛdɛ̃ dani nyɛyea, ni nu ni nyɛbaanu hu nyɛkɔa shika nyɛkɛhea yɛ amɛdɛ̃.’

english_verse: We went past the territory that belonged to our relatives, the descendants of Esau. We followed Arabah Road that starts in the south at Elath and Ezion-Geber, then we turned onto the desert road that leads to Moab.
translation_verse: ‘Wɔtsa wɔ nyiɛmɔ lɛ nɔ; shi wɔshi gbɛ ni jɛ Elat kɛ Eziongeber kɛyaa Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ he lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni wɔtswa wɔnyɛmimɛi Esau shwiei ni yɔɔ Edom lɛ hu wɔfɔ̃; ni wɔtsɔ̃ wɔhiɛ wɔhã Moab ŋa lɛ nɔ.’

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Don't try to start a war with Moab. Leave them alone, because I gave the land of Ar to them, and I will not let you have any of it.” Tribes That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Nyɛkagbaa Moabbii lɛ anaa, ejaakɛ mikɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ he ko kwraa haŋ nyɛ, ejaakɛ mikɛhã Ar, Lot shwiei lɛ, akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Before the Lord gave the Moabites their land, a large and powerful tribe lived there. They were the Emim, and they were as tall as the Anakim.
translation_verse: (Emimbii ji mɛi ni hi shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ sa; gbɔmɛi kakabãŋi ni, ni amɛyi fa, ni amɛkwɔlɔ tamɔ Anakbii lɛ.

english_verse: The Moabites called them Emim, though others sometimes used the name Rephaim for both the Anakim and the Emim.
translation_verse: Tamɔ Anakbii lɛ, atsɛɔ amɛ akɛ Refaim hu, shi Moabbii lɛ tsɛɔ amɛ Emimbii.

english_verse: The Horites used to live in Seir, but the Edomites took over that region. They killed many of the Horites and forced the rest of them to leave, just as Israel did to the people in the land that the Lord gave them. Israel Crossed the Zered Gorge Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Sa lɛ mɛi ni hi Edom ji Horbii lɛ; shi Esau shwiei lɛ bashwie amɛ yɛ jɛi, ni amɛplene amɛ, ni amɛŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ amɛhi nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Israelbii lɛ shwie mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa kɛhã amɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ.)

english_verse: When we came to the Zered Gorge along the southern border of Moab, the Lord told us to cross the gorge into Moab, and we did.
translation_verse: “Shi moŋ nyɛtea shi ni nyɛfoa Zered Faa lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, wɔyafo Zered Faa lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord kept getting rid of them until finally none of them were left.
translation_verse: “Be ni tsutsu tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ gboi lɛ,

english_verse: Then the Lord told me,
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ,

english_verse: “Moses, now go past the town of Ar and cross Moab's northern border
translation_verse: ‘Ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, nyɛbaatsɔ̃ Moabbii lɛ akpokpai lɛ anɔ kɛho yɛ Ar maŋ lɛ masɛi.

english_verse: into Ammon. But don't start a war with the Ammonites. I gave them their land, and I won't give any of it to Israel.” More Nations That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛyashɛ Amonbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ husu lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkagbaa Amonbii lɛ anaa, ni nyɛkɛ amɛ akawua ta ko hu, ejaakɛ mikɛ Amonbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ he ko kwraa haŋ nyɛ, ejaakɛ mikɛhã Lot shwiei lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Before the Ammonites conquered the land that the Lord had given them, some of the Rephaim used to live there, although the Ammonites called them Zamzummim.
translation_verse: (Atsɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ akɛ Refaim hu ejaakɛ Refaimbii ji mɛi ni hi jɛi sa, shi Amonbii lɛ tsɛɔ amɛ akɛ Zamzumbii.

english_verse: The Lord helped them as he had helped the Edomites, who killed many of the Horites in Seir and forced the rest to leave before settling there themselves.
translation_verse: tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fee ehã Esau shwiei ni yɔɔ Edom lɛ, be ni eshwie Horbii lɛ ni ehã Esau shwiei lɛ shɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ Horbii lɛ adɛŋ, ni amɛbahi nɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: A group called the Avvim used to live in villages as far south as Gaza, but the Philistines killed them and settled on their land. Israel Crossed the Arnon Gorge Moses said:
translation_verse: Avimbii lɛ, sa lɛ amɛhi shi kɛjɛ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ naa kɛyashi Gaza. Kretabii fã kɛjɛ Kreta ŋshɔkpɔ lɛ nɔ kɛba, ni amɛbashwie Avimbii lɛ, ni amɛshɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ, ni amɛhi nɔ.)

english_verse: After we went through Ammon, the Lord told us: Israel, pack up your possessions, take down your tents, and cross the Arnon River gorge. The territory of the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon lies on the other side of the river, but I now give you his land. So attack and take it!
translation_verse: “Nyɛtea shi ni nyɛyia mli, ni nyɛyafoa Arnon Faa lɛ. Naa, mijɔɔ Heshbon maŋtsɛ Sihon, Amornyo lɛ, kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ hu fɛɛ nɔ mihã nyɛ. Nyɛyatuaa lɛ koni nyɛbɔi shikpɔŋ lɛ shɔ̃mɔ.

english_verse: Today I will start making all other nations afraid of you. They will tremble with fear when anyone mentions you, and they will be terrified when you show up. The Defeat of King Sihon of Heshbon (Numbers
translation_verse: Kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, mahã nyɛhe ŋmiŋmi kɛ gbeyei amɔmɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ jeŋ fɛɛ; amɛaanu nyɛhe, amɛtsui aaafã, ni amɛhe aaakpokpo kɛji atsi nyɛtã. Israel ye Maŋtsɛ Sihon nɔ kunim (Numeri

english_verse: Please let Israel go across your country. We will walk straight through, without turning off the road.
translation_verse: ‘Ŋmɛɛ wɔ gbɛ koni wɔtsɔ̃ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛho. Gbɛjegbɛ lɛ kɛkɛ nɔ wɔbaanyiɛ tɛ̃ɛ; wɔgbaŋ ninejurɔgbɛ lɛ, wɔgbaŋ abɛku hu.

english_verse: You can even sell us food and water, and we will pay with silver. We need to reach the Jordan River and cross it, because the Lord our God is giving us the land on the west side. The Edomites and Moabites have already let us cross their land. Please let us cross your land as well.
translation_verse: kɛyashi wɔɔfo Yordan Faa lɛ kɛbote shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛaahã wɔ lɛ mli. Nakai ji bɔ ni Esau shwiei ni yɔɔ Edom lɛ kɛ Moabbii ni yɔɔ Ar lɛ hu fee amɛhã wɔ.’

english_verse: But Sihon refused to let us go across his country, because the Lord made him stubborn and eager to fight us. The Lord told me, “I am going to help you defeat Sihon and take his land, so attack him!”
translation_verse: “Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Naa, mibɔ̃i Maŋtsɛ Sihon kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔjɔɔmɔ kɛ bo hãmɔ; bɔ̃imɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ shɔ̃mɔ koni nyɛhi nɔ.’

english_verse: We met Sihon and his army in battle at Jahaz,
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ Sihon kɛ etabilɔi fɛɛ fã kɛba koni amɛ kɛ wɔ abawu yɛ Yahaz maŋ lɛ masɛi.

english_verse: and the Lord our God helped us defeat them. We killed Sihon, his sons, and everyone else in his army.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, jɔɔ Maŋtsɛ Sihon nɔ ehã wɔ, ni wɔgbe lɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ etabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: but keeping the livestock and everything else of value.
translation_verse: Wɔloo kooloi lɛ wɔhã wɔhe akɛ haanii kɛ maji ni wɔŋɔŋɔɔ lɛ amli nibii hu.

english_verse: The Lord helped us capture every town from the Arnon River gorge north to the boundary of Gilead, including the town of Aroer on the edge of the gorge and the town in the middle of the gorge.
translation_verse: Kɛjɛ Aroer maŋ lɛ ni kã Arnon Faa lɛ jɔɔ lɛ toi, kɛ maŋ lɛ ni yɔɔ jɔɔ lɛ teŋ kɛyashi Gilead maŋ lɛ mli tɔ̃ɔ lɛ, maŋ ko maŋ ko bɛ ni wɔyeee enɔ kunim. Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, jɔɔ eko fɛɛ eko nɔ ehã wɔ.

english_verse: However, we stayed away from all the Ammonite towns, both in the hill country and near the Jabbok River, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Amonbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ pɛ he wɔyataaa, no ji Yabok Faa lɛ hewɔhewɔ shikpɔji lɛ, kɛ gɔji ashikpɔji lɛ anɔ maji lɛ, kɛ he fɛɛ he ni Yehowa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, bɔ wɔ kɔkɔ akɛ wɔkata he lɛ.”

english_verse: But the Lord told me, “Moses, don't be afraid of King Og. I am going to help you defeat him and his army and take over his land. Destroy him and his people, just as you did with the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon.”
translation_verse: Shi Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Nyɛkashea Og gbeyei, ejaakɛ mijɔɔ lɛ kɛ etabilɔi lɛ kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ mihã nyɛ koni nyɛfee amɛ tamɔ nyɛfee Sihon, Amorbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ ni hi Heshbon lɛ.’

english_verse: The Lord our God helped us destroy Og and his army and conquer his entire kingdom of Bashan, including the Argob region. His kingdom had lots of villages and
translation_verse: Bɔ ni wɔkɛ Heshbon Maŋtsɛ Sihon ye lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔkpãtã maŋ fɛɛ maŋ kɛ emli hii kɛ yei kɛ gbekɛbii fɛɛ ahiɛ yɛ Bashan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: but keeping the livestock and everything else of value.
translation_verse: Wɔmɔmɔ kooloi fɛɛ, ni wɔha maŋbii lɛ anibii wɔhã wɔhe.

english_verse: Sihon and Og had ruled Amorite kingdoms east of the Jordan River. Their land stretched from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, and we captured it all.
translation_verse: “Belɛ wɔshɔ̃ nakai be lɛ mli shikpɔji ni yɔɔ Amorbii amaŋtsɛmɛi enyɔ nɛɛ ashishi, yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ, yɛ amɛdɛŋ. Wɔshɔ̃ kɛjɛ Arnon Faa lɛ naa aahu kɛyashi Hermon Gɔŋ lɛ he.

english_verse: We captured all the towns in the highlands, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as Salecah and Edrei, two of the towns that Og had ruled. Og's Coffin
translation_verse: Wɔshɔ̃ Bashan Maŋtsɛ Og nɔyelihei lɛ fɛɛ: maji fɛɛ ni jwere gɔji ayiteŋ shikpɔŋ kplanaa lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ nii ni yɔɔ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, kɛ Bashan shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛtee bokãgbɛ aahu kɛyanina maji ni ji Salka kɛ Edrei lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord will let them defeat the enemy nations on the west side of the Jordan and take their land. Afterwards, you can come back here to the land I gave you.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ baaya kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni Yehowa aaahã nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ aaajɔɔ amɛhe tamɔ nyɛ nɔŋŋ, ni amɛ hu amɛnine aaashɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa amɛ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ anaigbɛ lɛ nɔ. No sɛɛ dani nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baanyɛ eku esɛɛ kɛba egbɛfaŋnɔ ni mikɛhã lɛ lɛ nɔ.’

english_verse: At that time I prayed and begged,
translation_verse: “Mikpa Yehowa fai nakai be lɛ mli akɛ,

english_verse: “Our Lord, it seems that you have just begun to show me your great power. No other god in the sky or on earth is able to do the mighty things that you do.
translation_verse: ‘Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, ogbojee kɛ ohewalɛ lɛ eshishi kɛkɛ oje ojieɔ otsɔ̃ɔ otsulɔ nɛɛ; ejaakɛ mɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɔɔ dɔŋŋ, yɛ ŋwɛi jio, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jio, ni aaanyɛ hewalɛ naa nibii wuji ni otsu nɛɛ etsu?

english_verse: The land west of the Jordan is such good land. Please let me cross the Jordan and see the hills and the Lebanon Mountains.”
translation_verse: Ofainɛ, hã mi hu mafo mli kɛya mayana shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii ni yɔɔ Yordan anaigbɛ lɛ, nakai gɔji ashikpɔŋ kpakpa lɛ kɛ Lebanon hu.’

english_verse: But the Lord was angry with me because of you people, and he refused to listen. “That's enough!” he said. “I don't want to hear any more.
translation_verse: “Nyɛhewɔ lɛ Yehowa mli fu mi, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ebooo mi toi. Shi moŋ ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Efa; okɛ mi akawie nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ he dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Climb to the top of Mount Pisgah and look north, south, east, and west. Take a good look, but you are not going to cross the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Kwɔɔ Pisga Gɔŋ lɛ kɛya eyiteŋ, koni owo ohiɛ nɔ okwɛ anaigbɛ kɛ kooyigbɛ kɛ wuoyigbɛ kɛ bokãgbɛ, ni obaana shikpɔŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ ofoŋ nɛkɛ Yordan Faa nɛɛ.

english_verse: Joshua will lead Israel across the Jordan to take the land, so help him be strong and brave and tell him what he must do.”
translation_verse: Wo Yoshua kitã; ni owo lɛ ekãa kɛ hewalɛ fɛɛ ejaakɛ lɛ ebaanyiɛ maŋbii lɛ ahiɛ kɛya kɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni obaana lɛ.’

english_verse: After this we stayed in the valley at Beth-Peor.
translation_verse: “No hewɔ lɛ, wɔhi shi yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli yɛ Betpeor maŋ lɛ ŋlɛnɔ.”

english_verse: Israel, listen to these laws and teachings! If you obey them, you will live, and you will go in and take the land that the Lord is giving you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped,
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ Mose kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyea akpɔi kɛ mlai ni mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ anɔ koni nyɛyi ana wala koni nyɛya nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ.

english_verse: and now he is your God. I am telling you everything he has commanded, so don't add anything or take anything away.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ nɔ ko akafataa mlai ni miwoɔ nyɛ nɛɛ ahe, ni asaŋ nyɛkajiea nɔ ko yɛ mli hu. Nyɛyea Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mlai ni miwoɔ nyɛ nɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: But all of you that were faithful to the Lord your God are still alive today.
translation_verse: shi nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛye Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, anɔkwa lɛ, nyɛ fɛɛ tswɛm nyɛyi ena wala kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.

english_verse: You must be very careful not to forget the things you have seen God do for you. Keep reminding yourselves, and tell your children and grandchildren as well.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ, nyɛkwɛa ni ahia kɛkɛ koni nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ jogbaŋŋ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛhiɛ akaje nibii ni nyɛna kɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhiŋmɛii nɛɛ anɔ nyɛwala gbii abɔ fɛɛ. Ni nyɛgbaa nyɛbii kɛ nyɛnabii lɛ,

english_verse: Do you remember the day you stood in the Lord's presence at Mount Sinai? The Lord said, “Moses, bring the people of Israel here. I want to speak to them so they will obey me as long as they live, and so they will teach their children to obey me too.”
translation_verse: titri lɛ, sane ni ba gbi ni nyɛdamɔ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ, be ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Buamɔ maŋ lɛ naa ohã mi, shi miitao akɛ mahã amɛnu nɔ ni makɛɛ koni amɛkɛkase mi gbeyeishemɔ gbii abɔ ni amɛyɔɔ jeŋ lɛ, asaŋ koni amɛgba amɛbii hu.’

english_verse: Mount Sinai was surrounded by deep dark clouds, and fire went up to the sky. You came to the foot of the mountain,
translation_verse: “Nyɛgbaa nyɛbii lɛ bɔ ni nyɛtsi nyɛbɛŋkɛ, ni nyɛbadamɔ gɔŋ lɛ shishi, kɛ bɔ ni gɔŋ lɛ here kɛ la kɛtee ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ, ni atatu kpii ko ha gɔŋ lɛ he fɛɛ kpula.

english_verse: and the Lord spoke to you from the fire. You could hear him and understand what he was saying, but you couldn't see him.
translation_verse: Nyɛgbaa amɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛ nyɛ wie kɛjɛ la lɛ mli; bɔ ni nyɛnu wiemɔi lɛ shi nyɛnaaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kwraa, fe akɛ egbee lɛ kɛkɛ nyɛnu;

english_verse: The Lord said he was making an agreement with you, and he told you that your part of the agreement is to obey the Ten Commandments. Then the Lord wrote these Commandments on two flat stones.
translation_verse: bɔ ni egbala ekpãŋmɔ lɛ mli etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, ni efã akɛ nyɛye nɔ, no ji kitãi nyɔŋma lɛ ni eŋmala ewo tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ anɔ lɛ.

english_verse: That's when the Lord commanded me to give you the laws and teachings you must obey in the land that you will conquer west of the Jordan River. Don't Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Yehowa wo mi kitã yɛ nakai be lɛ mli akɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akpɔi lɛ kɛ mlai lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛye nɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛfoɔ mli kɛya ni nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ. Abɔ kɔkɔ akɛ akakwa Nyɔŋmɔ

english_verse: not to commit the sin of worshiping idols. Don't make idols to be worshiped, whether they are shaped like men, women,
translation_verse: no lɛ nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ koni nyɛkafee amãgã ko ni tamɔ nuu loo yoo henɔ nyɛhã nyɛhe, koni nyɛtɔ̃.

english_verse: And when you see the sun or moon or stars, don't be tempted to bow down and worship them. The Lord put them there for all the other nations to worship.
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛwo nyɛhiɛ nɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi ni nyɛkwɛ hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii lɛ ni ji ŋwɛiniiaŋ nibii lɛ, nyɛkahãa amɛgbalaa nyɛ ni nyɛjaa amɛ, ni nyɛsɔmɔa amɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, saa nomɛi eto ehã maji krokomɛi lɛ koni amɛ, amɛja nomɛi.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's people, because he rescued you from Egypt, that fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛ lɛ, Yehowa yakpɔ̃ nyɛ yɛ Ijipt, kɛje dade flɔnɔɔ lɛ mli, koni nyɛbatsɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewebii tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with me because of what you said, and he told me that he would not let me cross the Jordan River into the good land that he is giving you.
translation_verse: Nyɛhewɔ lɛ Yehowa na mi mlifu, ni ewo shi akɛ mifoŋ Yordan Faa lɛ, ni miyaŋ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii, ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: So I must stay here and die on this side of the Jordan, but you will cross the river and take the land.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mi lɛ, mibagbo yɛ biɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ, ni mifoŋ Yordan lɛ; shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛbaafo faa lɛ koni nyɛyaŋɔ nakai shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii lɛ.

english_verse: Always remember the agreement that the Lord your God made with you, and don't make an idol in any shape or form.
translation_verse: Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhenɔ ni ahia koni nyɛhiɛ akaje kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ kpãŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛyafee nɔ ko henɔ amãgã tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, egu nyɛ lɛ;

english_verse: The Lord will be angry if you worship other gods, and he can be like a fire destroying everything in its path.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, etamɔ la grigri ni shãa nii wɛɛ; ni Nyɔŋmɔ ni yeɔ awuŋã ni.

english_verse: Only a few of you will survive, and the Lord will force you to leave the land and will scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Yehowa aaagbɛ nyɛ ashwã maji krokomɛi anɔ, ni nyɛyi fioo kɛkɛ aaashwɛ yɛ maji ni Yehowa aaagbɛ nyɛ ashwã kɛaatee lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: There you will have to worship gods made of wood and stone, and these are nothing but idols that can't see or hear or eat or smell.
translation_verse: “Nyɛbaaya nyɛyaja nyɔŋmɔi ni ji tsei kɛ tɛi ni gbɔmɔ kɛ enine fee; amɛnaaa nii lɛ, amɛnuuu nii hu, amɛyeee nii, ni amɛnuuu nii fu hu.

english_verse: In all of your troubles, you may finally decide that you want to worship only the Lord. And if you turn back to him and obey him completely, he will again be your God.
translation_verse: “Kɛji enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ eba nyɛnɔ, ni nyɛyɛ nɔnaa mli lɛ, nakai gbii lɛ amli nyɛaakpale kɛba Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ, ni nyɛaabo lɛ toi,

english_verse: The Lord your God will have mercy—he won't destroy you or desert you. The Lord will remember his promise, and he will keep the agreement he made with your ancestors.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, musuŋtsɔlɔ ji lɛ; ekwaŋ nyɛ, ni asaŋ ekpãtãŋ nyɛhiɛ; ni ehiɛ kpaŋ kpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ lɛ nɔ, nɔ ni ekã he kitã ehã amɛ lɛ.

english_verse: When the Lord your God brought you out of Egypt, you saw how he fought for you and showed his great power by performing terrifying miracles. You became his people, and at Mount Sinai you heard him talking to you out of fiery flames. And yet you are still alive! Has anything like this ever happened since the time God created humans? No matter where you go or who you ask, you will get the same answer. No one has ever heard of another god even trying to do such things as the Lord your God has done for you.
translation_verse: Aloo nyɛnu nyɔŋmɔ ko eka dã akɛ eeeya maŋ ko nɔ, ni eyakpɔ̃ mɛi komɛi kɛje nakai maŋ lɛ mli ni ebafee mɛi lɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, tsɔ̃ kai kɛ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛ nii, kɛ ta kɛ nineshiwalɛ kɛ hewalɛ kpeteŋkple nɔ efee ehã nyɛ yɛ Ijipt, yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhiŋmɛiiaŋ lɛ?

english_verse: The Lord wants you to know he is the only true God, and he wants you to obey him. That's why he let you see his mighty miracles and his fierce fire on earth, and why you heard his voice from that fire and from the sky.
translation_verse: Ŋwɛi tɔ̃ɔ ehã nyɛnu egbee kɛjɛ koni ekɛtsɔse nyɛ; ni ehã nyɛna ela kpeteŋkple lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛnu ewiemɔ kɛjɛ la mli.

english_verse: The Lord loved your ancestors and decided that you would be his people. So the Lord used his great power to bring you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Ni akɛni esumɔ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, eŋɔ amɛshwiei ni ba yɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ yakpɔ̃ nyɛ yɛ Ijipt.

english_verse: Now you face other nations more powerful than you are, but the Lord has already started forcing them out of their land and giving it to you.
translation_verse: Eshwie maji wuji ni ahe wa kwraa fe nyɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ, bɔ ni afee ni ekɛ nyɛ aba ni eŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ ehã nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ tamɔ bɔ ni eba mli ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: So remember that the Lord is the only true God, whether in the sky above or on the earth below.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea ŋmɛnɛ, ni nyɛkɛtoa nyɛyiŋ, akɛ Yehowa ji ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ; lɛ esɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Today I am explaining his laws and teachings. And if you always obey them, you and your descendants will live long and be successful in the land the Lord is giving you. Safe Towns
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyea Yehowa akpɔi kɛ kitãi ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ, koni ahi ahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛbii ni baa yɛ nyɛsɛɛ lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛtsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ.” Abobaa maji ni yɔɔ Yordan bokãgbɛ lɛ

english_verse: The Israelites had come from Egypt and were camped east of the Jordan River near Beth-Peor, when Moses gave these laws and teachings. The land around their camp had once belonged to King Sihon of Heshbon. But Moses and the Israelites defeated him
translation_verse: ni amɛbashɛ jɔɔ ni kã Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ mli, yɛ Betpeor maŋ lɛ ŋlɛnɔ lɛ. Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ, Israelbii lɛ yɛ Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon ni hi Heshbon, mɔ ni Mose kɛ Israelbii lɛ ye enɔ kunim, be ni amɛnyiɛ gbɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt amɛbaa lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: and King Og of Bashan, and took their lands. These two Amorite kings had ruled the territory east of the Jordan River
translation_verse: Israelbii lɛ shɔ̃ Maŋtsɛ Sihon shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛshɔ̃ Bashan maŋtsɛ Og ni ji Amorbii amaŋtsɛ kroko ni yɔɔ Yordan bokãgbɛ lɛ hu shikpɔŋ lɛ,

english_verse: from the town of Aroer on the edge of the Arnon River gorge, north to Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: kɛjɛ Aroer maŋ lɛ ni kã Arnon Faa lɛ jɔɔ lɛ toi kɛtee kooyigbɛ aahu kɛyashi Sirion ni ji Hermon Gɔŋ lɛ he.

english_verse: Their land included the eastern side of the Jordan River valley, as far south as the Dead Sea below the slopes of Mount Pisgah.
translation_verse: Ŋa kplenee lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yordan lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ kɛtee wuoyigbɛ kɛyanina Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ, kɛtee bokãgbɛ kɛyashi Pisga Gɔŋ lɛ shishi fɛɛ fata shikpɔŋ nɛɛ he.

english_verse: Moses called together the people of Israel and said: Today I am telling you the laws and teachings that you must follow, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: Mose tsɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ kɛbakpe, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Israelbii, nyɛboa akpɔi kɛ mlai ni mibajaje mawo nyɛtoiiaŋ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ toi; nyɛkasea ni nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ jogbaŋŋ ni nyɛye nɔ.

english_verse: Do not murder.
translation_verse: “Kaagbe gbɔmɔ.

english_verse: The Lord our God made an agreement with our nation at Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ wɔ kpãŋ yɛ Sinai.

english_verse: That agreement wasn't only with our ancestors but with us, who are here today.
translation_verse: Jeee wɔblematsɛmɛi lɛ kɛkɛ Yehowa kɛkpãŋ nɛkɛ kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ lɛ; shi moŋ wɔ fɛɛ ni wɔyɔɔ wala mli ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ, wɔ ekɛkpãŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord himself spoke to you out of the fire,
translation_verse: Yehowa jɛ la lɛ teŋ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛ nyɛ wie hiɛ kɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: but you were afraid of the fire and refused to go up the mountain. So I spoke with the Lord for you, then I told you that he had said:
translation_verse: Mi lɛ, nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, midamɔ Yehowa kɛ nyɛ teŋ koni majaje Yehowa wiemɔi lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, ejaakɛ la lɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛshe gbeyei, ni nyɛkwɔɔɔ gɔŋ lɛ. “Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ,

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt where you were slaves.
translation_verse: ‘Mi ji Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mi mijie bo yɛ nyɔŋyeli mli kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Do not worship any god except me.
translation_verse: “‘Kaana nyɔŋmɔ kroko ko yɛ misɛɛ.

english_verse: Do not make idols that look like anything in the sky or on earth or in the ocean under the earth.
translation_verse: “‘Kaafee amãgã ko ni ji nɔ ko ni tamɔ nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi loo nii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, loo nii ni yɔɔ nu mli yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi henɔ ohã ohe.

english_verse: Don't bow down and worship idols. I am the Lord your God, and I demand all your love. If you reject me and worship idols, I will punish your families for three or four generations.
translation_verse: Kaaja nibii nɛɛ, ni kaasɔ̃mɔ amɛ hu, ejaakɛ mi Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ni yeɔ awuŋã ji mi; ni miwoɔ tsɛmɛi kɛ bii nyɔmɔ yɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ atɔ̃mɔi lɛ ahewɔ, kɛyashiɔ yinɔ ni ji etɛ̃ kɛ yinɔ ni ji ejwɛ tete ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: But if you love me and obey my laws, I will be kind to your families for thousands of generations.
translation_verse: Shi mɛi akpei abɔ fɛɛ ni sumɔɔ mi, ni amɛyeɔ mikitãi anɔ lɛ, misumɔɔ amɛ kɛ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee, ni minaa amɛ mɔbɔ hu.’

english_verse: Do not misuse my name. I am the Lord your God, and I will punish anyone who misuses my name.
translation_verse: “Kaahiɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi mli yakayaka; ejaakɛ Yehowa ebuŋ mɔ ni hiɛɔ egbɛi mli yakayaka lɛ bem.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work,
translation_verse: Otsu nii gbii ekpaa, ni ofee onii fɛɛ,

english_verse: but the seventh day of the week belongs to me, your God. No one is to work on that day—not you, your children, your oxen or donkeys or any other animal, not even those foreigners who live in your towns. And don't make your slaves do any work.
translation_verse: shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi ni hã Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. No nɔ lɛ okatsu nɔ ko, bo jio, obinuu jio, obiyoo jio, owenuu jio, oweyoo jio, otsinanuu jio, oteji jio, oshĩa kooloo kroko jio, loo gbɔ ni yɔɔ ogboi lɛ amli; bɔ ni afee ni bo kɛ otsuji hii kɛ otsuji yei ajɔɔ amɛhe tamɔ bo nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: This special day of rest will remind you that I reached out my mighty arm and rescued you from slavery in Egypt.
translation_verse: Nyɛkaia akɛ nyɛ hu nyɔji ji nyɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nineshiwalɛ yakpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛje jɛi yɛ ehewalɛ naa. No hewɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, wo nyɛ kitã akɛ nyɛye hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ akɛ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Respect your father and mother, and you will live a long and successful life in the land I am giving you.
translation_verse: “Wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ewo bo kitã lɛ, koni owala sɛɛ atsɛ; asaŋ koni ahi ahã bo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ, kɛhãa bo lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: When we were gathered at the mountain, the Lord spoke to us in a loud voice from the dark fiery cloud. The Lord gave us these commands, and only these. Then he wrote them on two flat stones and gave them to me. The People Were Afraid (Exodus
translation_verse: “Nɛkɛ kitãi nɛɛ Yehowa kɛ gbee ni wa jɛ la lɛ kɛ atatu kpii lɛ mli ewo nyɛsafo muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni ekɛ nɔ ko fataaa he. Kɛkɛ ni eŋma ewo tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ nɔ, ni ekɛhã mi.” Maŋbii lɛ she gbeyei (Ɛksodɔs

english_verse: When fire blazed from the mountain, and you heard the voice coming from the darkness, your tribal leaders came to me
translation_verse: “Be ni nyɛnu gbee lɛ kɛjɛ duŋ kpii lɛ mli, be mli ni gɔŋ lɛ tsoɔ kɛ la lɛ, nyɛtsi nyɛbɛŋkɛ mi, nyɛ kɛ akutseiatsɛmɛi kɛ nyɛmaŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ,

english_verse: and said: Today the Lord our God has shown us how powerful and glorious he is. He spoke to us from the fire, and we learned that people can live, even though God speaks to them.
translation_verse: ni nyɛkɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Naa, Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã wɔna enunyam kɛ egbojee, ni ehã wɔnu egbee hu kɛjɛ la lɛ mli. Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, wɔna wɔle akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ gbɔmɔ adesa wieɔ, ni mɔ lɛ yi naa wala kɛ̃.

english_verse: But we don't want to take a chance on being killed by that terrible fire, and if we keep on hearing the Lord's voice, we will die.
translation_verse: Belɛ agbɛnɛ mɛni hewɔ wɔɔgboi? Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ la kpeteŋkple nɛɛ aaaŋala wɔ wɛɛ. Wɔbaagboi kɛji wɔnu Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbee ekoŋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Has anyone else ever heard the only true God speaking from fire, as we have? And even if they have, would they live to tell about it?
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛɛ gbɔmɔ adesa enu Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ gbee ni miiwie kɛjɛ la teŋ tamɔ wɔnu nɛɛ, ni eyi ena wala dã?

english_verse: Moses, go up close and listen to the Lord. Then come back and tell us, and we will do everything he says.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, bo tsi obɛŋkɛ Yehowa koni obo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaakɛɛ lɛ toi ni obakɛɛ wɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ bo aaawie. Wɔbaabo toi, ni wɔbaafee hu.’

english_verse: The Lord heard you and said: Moses, I heard what the people said to you, and I approve.
translation_verse: “Be ni nyɛkɛ mi wie nɛkɛ lɛ, Yehowa nu wiemɔi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Minu wiemɔi ni maŋbii lɛ kɛ bo wie lɛ; amɛgbee lɛ ja.

english_verse: I wish they would always worship me with fear and trembling and be this willing to obey me! Then they and their children would always enjoy a successful life.
translation_verse: Mina ni kulɛ amɛyɛ nɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ daa koni amɛkɛye mikitãi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, bɔ ni afee ni ehi ehã amɛ kɛ amɛshwiei kɛya naanɔ.

english_verse: Now, tell them to return to their tents,
translation_verse: Yaa ni oyakɛɛ amɛ koni amɛkpale kɛya amɛbui lɛ amli.

english_verse: but you come back here to me. After I tell you my laws and teachings, you will repeat them to the people, so they can obey these laws in the land I am giving them. Moses said:
translation_verse: Shi bo lɛ, daamɔ biɛ yɛ mimasɛi, ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo kitãi lɛ kɛ akpɔi lɛ kɛ mlai lɛ fɛɛ, koni oyatsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ akɛ amɛye nɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhãa amɛ akɛ amɛnɔ lɛ nɔ.’

english_verse: Follow them, because they make a path that will lead to a long successful life in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
translation_verse: Nyɛbaa nyɛjeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, koni nyɛna wala yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord told me to give you these laws and teachings, so you can obey them in the land he is giving you. Soon you will cross the Jordan River and take that land.
translation_verse: “Agbɛnɛ kitãi lɛ kɛ akpɔi lɛ kɛ mlai lɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fã akɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ nɛ, koni nyɛyaye nɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaa ni nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: And if you and your descendants want to live a long time, you must always worship the Lord and obey his laws.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei awala gbii abɔ fɛɛ mli lɛ, esa akɛ nyɛshe Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyei ni nyɛye akpɔi kɛ kitãi ni miwoɔ nyɛ nɛɛ fɛɛ nɔ, koni nyɛwala sɛɛ atsɛ.

english_verse: Pay attention, Israel! Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he promised to give us this land that is rich with milk and honey. Be careful to obey him, and you will become a successful and powerful nation.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii, nyɛboa toi, ni nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ, ni nyɛyea nɔ koni ahi ahã nyɛ, koni nyɛshwere yɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii lɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ewo nyɛ shi lɛ.

english_verse: Listen, Israel! The Lord our God is the only true God!
translation_verse: “Bo toi, Israel! Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ ekoome ji Yehowa.

english_verse: So love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and strength.
translation_verse: Suɔmɔ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ otsui fɛɛ kɛ omumɔ fɛɛ kɛ onyɛmɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: and tell them to your children over and over again. Talk about them all the time, whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: ni otsɔ̃ɔ obii fitsofitso. Owie he be mli ni ota shi yɛ oshĩaŋ; owie he be mli ni onyiɛ gbɛteŋ; owie he be mli ni ojɔɔ ohe kɛ be mli ni otsuɔ nii.

english_verse: Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Asaŋ okɛfi onineshi kɛ ohiɛŋtso nɔ hu akɛ hekaimɔ okadi,

english_verse: Write these laws on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates. Worship Only the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Oŋma yɛ oshĩa lɛ shinaatsei lɛ kɛ agboi lɛ ahe hu.” Toigbele he kɔkɔbɔɔ

english_verse: The Lord promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that he would give you this land. Now he will take you there and give you large towns, with good buildings that you didn't build,
translation_verse: “Kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ yashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi, Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob, he shi akɛ ekɛbaahã nyɛ lɛ nɔ, shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ maji wuji fɛɛfɛji ni jeee nyɛ nyɛto;

english_verse: and houses full of good things that you didn't put there. The Lord will give you wells that you didn't have to dig, and vineyards and olive orchards that you didn't have to plant. But when you have eaten so much that you can't eat any more,
translation_verse: shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ shĩai ni amɛmli eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ nibii kpakpai ni jeee nyɛ nyɛtsu nyɛwo amɛmli; shikpɔŋ kɛ nubui ni jeee nyɛ nyɛtsatsaai, kɛ wain tromi kɛ mutsei ni jeee nyɛ nyɛtɛo, kɛji nyɛye ni nyɛtɔrɔ lɛ,

english_verse: don't forget it was the Lord who set you free from slavery and brought you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe nɔ ni ahĩa koni nyɛhiɛ akajea Yehowa, mɔ ni jie nyɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ni aye nyɛ nyɔŋ yɛ lɛ, nɔ.

english_verse: Worship and obey the Lord your God with fear and trembling, and promise that you will be loyal to him.
translation_verse: Nyɛshea Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyei; lɛ ekoome nyɛjaa, ni lɛ pɛ egbɛi nyɛkɛkãa kitã.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with gods that are worshiped by the nations around you.
translation_verse: Nyɛkayasɔmɔa nɔ kroko yɛ lɛ esɛɛ, ni ji majimaji ni jwere nyɛmasɛi lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ;

english_verse: If you worship other gods, the Lord will be furious and wipe you off the face of the earth. The Lord your God is with you,
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ, eyeɔ awuŋã, koni emli akawo nyɛ la, ni ekpãtã nyɛhiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: so don't try to make him prove that he can help you, as you did at Massah.
translation_verse: “Nyɛkakaa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛka lɛ yɛ Masa lɛ;

english_verse: Always obey the laws that the Lord has given you
translation_verse: shi moŋ nyɛyea ehe saji lɛ kɛ ekitãi lɛ kɛ ekpɔi lɛ ni ewoɔ nyɛ lɛ anɔ;

english_verse: and live in a way that pleases him. Then you will be able to go in and take this good land from your enemies, just as he promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: kɛtsɔ̃ shwiemɔ ni nyɛbaashwie nyɛhenyɛlɔi fɛɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ lɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ewo shi lɛ.

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why did the Lord give us these laws and teachings?”
translation_verse: “Kɛji nyɛbii aaabi nyɛ wɔ ko loo wɔsɛɛ ko akɛ, ‘Te odaseyeli saji kɛ akpɔi kɛ mlai ni Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, wo nyɛ lɛ shishi hu lɛ’,

english_verse: Then you will answer: We were slaves of the king of Egypt, but the Lord used his great power and set us free.
translation_verse: no lɛ nyɛkɛa nyɛbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Sa ko lɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ ye wɔ nyɔŋ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa kɛ nineshiwalɛ bajie wɔ kɛje Ijipt.

english_verse: We saw him perform miracles and make horrible things happen to the king, his officials, and everyone else.
translation_verse: Yehowa fee okadii kɛ naakpɛɛ nii ni yɔɔ gbeyei eshi Ijipt kɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ ewebii fɛɛ yɛ wɔhiɛ,

english_verse: The Lord rescued us from Egypt, so he could bring us into this land, as he had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: ni ejie wɔ kɛje nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, koni ekɛ wɔ aba ni ekɛ shikpɔŋ ni ewo wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ashi yɛ he lɛ abahã wɔ.

english_verse: That's why the Lord our God demands that we obey his laws and worship him with fear and trembling. And if we do, he will protect us and help us be successful.
translation_verse: Kɛji wɔjwɛŋ nɔ, ni wɔye nɛkɛ kitãi nɛɛ fɛɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, efã wɔ lɛ no aaahã wɔsa ehiɛ.’

english_verse: So be sure to obey his laws and teachings I am giving you today. The Lord Will Bless You if You Obey (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, kitãi kɛ akpɔi kɛ mlai ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ koni nyɛyea nɔ.” Toiboo sɛɛ jɔɔmɔi (Deuteronomio

english_verse: When the Lord helps you defeat your enemies, you must destroy them without pity! And don't get trapped into worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Maji fɛɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaatu awo nyɛdɛŋ lɛ, nyɛkpãtãa amɛhiɛ ni mɔbɔnalɛ bɛ mli; ni nyɛkajaa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ, ejaakɛ no baahã nyɛdu tsɔne.

english_verse: the Lord will force them out of the land. Then you must destroy them without mercy. Don't make any peace treaties with them,
translation_verse: Kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ amɛwo nyɛdɛŋ nɛkɛ lɛ, nyɛkpãtãa amɛhiɛ kwraa. Nyɛ kɛ amɛ akakpãŋa kpãŋmɔ ko, ni asaŋ nyɛkanaa amɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: If you do, those people will lead your descendants to worship other gods and to turn their backs on the Lord. That will make him very angry, and he will quickly destroy Israel.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ amɛbiyei lɛ aaahã nyɛbihii lɛ akpale yɛ misɛɛ ni amɛyasɔmɔ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi. Enɛ baahã Yehowa mli awo nyɛ la, ni eeekpãtã nyɛhiɛ.

english_verse: So when you conquer these nations, tear down the altars where they worship their gods. Break up their sacred stones, cut down the poles that they use in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and throw their idols in the fire. The Lord's Chosen People Moses said:
translation_verse: Bɔ ni nyɛkɛ amɛ aye ahã moŋ nɛ: amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ nyɛkumɔa, ni amɛshiui ni amɛmamɔ lɛ nyɛjwaraa, ni amɛwɔŋkoi lɛ nyɛgbaa nyɛshwiea shi, ni amɛmãgãi lɛ nyɛmamɔa amɛnaa la nyɛshãa.

english_verse: Israel, you are the chosen people of the Lord your God. There are many nations on this earth, but he chose only Israel to be his very own.
translation_verse: “Nyɛfea nakai ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ nyɛ ehã ehe akɛ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ. Eje gbɛ ni eŋɔ nyɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni nyɛtsɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewebii krɛdɛɛ.

english_verse: but the Lord chose you because he loves you and because he had made a promise to your ancestors. Then with his mighty arm, he rescued you from the king of Egypt, who had made you his slaves.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ suɔmɔ ni esumɔɔ nyɛ hewɔ, shi bɔ ni afee ni eye shi ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ, no hewɔ ni Yehowa kɛ nineshiwalɛ jie nyɛ, ni ekpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛje nyɔŋ ni Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ yeɔ nyɛ lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: You know that the Lord your God is the only true God. So love him and obey his commands, and he will faithfully keep his agreement with you and your descendants for a thousand generations.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ koome lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwafo, mɔ ni yeɔ shi ni ewo nɔ, asaŋ ni esuɔmɔ tsakeee yɛ mɛi ni esumɔɔ ni amɛyeɔ ekitãi anɔ kɛyashiɔ amɛshwiei ni ji akpe lɛ ayinɔ tɔ̃ɔ lɛ.

english_verse: God will bless you more than any other nation—your families will grow and your livestock increase.
translation_verse: Aaajɔɔ nyɛ fe jeŋ maji fɛɛ; nyɛteŋ nuu ko loo yoo ko ehiŋ shi ni efɔŋ; nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛkooloo ko hu ehiŋ shi ni efɔŋ.

english_verse: so destroy it. If you bring it home with you, both you and your house will be destroyed. Stay away from those disgusting idols!
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ musu nii ko akayaa nyɛshĩai amli ni no hã nyɛloo musu tamɔ nii lɛ nɔŋŋ. Nyaŋemɔ nyɛnyaŋea, ni hi nyɛhia amɛ, ejaakɛ alomɔ amɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will love you and bless you by giving you many children and plenty of food, wine, and olive oil. Your herds of cattle will have many calves, and your flocks of sheep will have many lambs.
translation_verse: Ebaasumɔ nyɛ, ni ebaajɔɔ nyɛ, ni ebaahã nyɛyi afa. Ebaajɔɔ nyɛmusuŋbii hu kɛ nyɛŋmɔshi nibaanii bɔ ni nyɛbele kɛ nyɛwaintsei kɛ mu kɛ nyɛtsinai kɛ nyɛtoi baashwere yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi yɛ he akɛ ekɛbaahã nyɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: If you completely obey these laws, the Lord your God will be loyal and keep the agreement he made with you, just as he promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: “Kɛji nyɛbo nɛkɛ mlai nɛɛ toi, ni nyɛye nɔ lɛ, no lɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baaye kpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ nyɛ ekpãŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ebaasumɔ nyɛ kɛ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee tamɔ bɔ ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi eto lɛ.

english_verse: You will no longer suffer with the same horrible diseases that you sometimes had in Egypt. You will be healthy, but the Lord will make your enemies suffer from those diseases. Destroy the Nations and Their Gods Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ni Yehowa baajie helai fɛɛ kɛje nyɛteŋ; ehaŋ Ijipt helai fɔ̃ji lɛ eko kwraa aye nyɛ; shi moŋ ebaahã helai nɛɛ aye nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: You may be thinking, “How can we destroy these nations? They are more powerful than we are.”
translation_verse: “Nyɛkakɛa nyɛhe akɛ, ‘Maji nɛɛ ayi fa fe wɔ; te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ ni wɔnyɛ amɛ wɔshwie lɛ?’

english_verse: But stop worrying! Just remember what the Lord your God did to Egypt and its king.
translation_verse: Nyɛkashea amɛ gbeyei, shi moŋ nyɛkaia nɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fee Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: You saw how the Lord used his tremendous power to work great miracles and bring you out of Egypt. And he will again work miracles for you when you face these enemies you fear so much.
translation_verse: Nyɛkaia helai wuji kɛ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii ni nyɛna kɛ nyɛhiŋmɛii lɛ kɛ nineshiwalɛ kɛ hewalɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛkpɔ̃ nyɛ lɛ. Nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baafee maji fɛɛ ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛsheɔ amɛ gbeyei lɛ.

english_verse: Some of them may try to survive by hiding from you, but the Lord will make them panic, and soon they will be dead.
translation_verse: Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baahã sosomootii ababote amɛteŋ kɛbahao amɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni amɛteiaŋ mɛi ni baajo nyɛnaa foi amɛyatee amɛhe lɛ tete ahiɛ aaakpãtã.

english_verse: So don't be frightened when you meet them in battle. The Lord your God is great and fearsome, and he will fight at your side.
translation_verse: Nyɛtsui akafãa yɛ amɛhewɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ kpeteŋkple ni he yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ, ji mɔ ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ.

english_verse: As you attack these nations, the Lord will force them out little by little. He won't let you get rid of them all at once—if he did, there wouldn't be enough people living in the land to keep down the number of wild animals.
translation_verse: Shi fiofio ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baashwie maji nɛɛ kɛje nyɛhiɛ. Nyɛnyɛŋ nyɛkpãtã amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ shi kome, no lɛ ŋa nɔ kooloi lɛ ayi baafa fe nine awo nyɛ.

english_verse: But when you attack your enemies, the Lord will make them panic, and you will easily destroy them. You will defeat their kings one after another until they are gone, and no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Ebaatu maji lɛ amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ewo nyɛdɛŋ; ni nyɛaagbe amɛ, ni amɛgbɛii baalaaje yɛ jeŋ. Amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ nyɛhiɛ adamɔ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaakpãtã amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: After you conquer a nation, burn their idols. Don't get trapped into wanting the silver or gold on an idol. Even the metal on an idol is disgusting to the Lord,
translation_verse: Nyɛmamɔa amɛnyɔŋmɔi ni ji amãgãi lɛ anaa la nyɛshãa. Nyɛhiɛ akakɔ̃a jwiɛtɛi loo shika ni yɔɔ nibii nɛɛ ahe lɛ anɔ ni nyɛŋɔ eko nyɛhã nyɛhe, koni no akafee kaa miihã nyɛ, ejaakɛ musu nii ni hã Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Israel, do you want to go into the land the Lord promised your ancestors? Do you want to capture it, live there, and become a powerful nation? Then be sure to obey every command I am giving you.
translation_verse: “Kitãi fɛɛ ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ, ni nyɛyea nɔ koni nyɛyi ana wala, ni nyɛshwere, ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔa shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, wo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi yɛ he lɛ.

english_verse: so he made you go hungry. Then he gave you manna, a kind of food that you and your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was teaching you that people need more than food to live—they need every word that the Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Ehã hɔmɔ ye nyɛ, ni ehã nyɛhumi shi; ni ehã nyɛ mana ni nyɛye, niyenii ko ni nyɛleee, ni nyɛtsɛmɛi hu tete leee nɔ ni ji lɛ, koni nyɛkɛna nyɛle akɛ jeee aboloo pɛ hãa gbɔmɔ yi naa wala, shi moŋ wiemɔ fɛɛ wiemɔ ni jɛɔ Yehowa daaŋ lɛ hãa gbɔmɔ yi naa wala.

english_verse: So keep in mind that the Lord has been correcting you, just as parents correct their children.
translation_verse: Belɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, miitsɔse nyɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mɔ tsɔseɔ ebi.

english_verse: Obey the commands the Lord your God has given you and worship him with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyea Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitãi lɛ anɔ; nyɛbaa nyɛjeŋ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, ni nyɛshea lɛ gbeyei.

english_verse: The Lord your God is bringing you into a good land with streams that flow from springs in the valleys and hills.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ miiya shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ, shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ fai kɛ kpaakpoi kɛ shikpɔŋ nu ni tueɔ kɛjɛɔ jɔi kɛ gɔji amli;

english_verse: You can dig for copper in those hills, and the stones are made of iron ore. And you won't go hungry. Wheat and barley fields are everywhere, and so are vineyards and orchards full of fig, pomegranate, and olive trees, and there is plenty of honey. Don't Forget the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Daaŋŋmãa ni nyɛaaye he esɛŋ, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko he ehiaŋ nyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ. Dade yɛ emli tɛi lɛ amli; ni nyɛaana akɔɔble hu nyɛtsa yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ gɔji lɛ amli.

english_verse: After you eat and are full, give praise to the Lord your God for the good land he gave you.
translation_verse: Nyɛbaaye nii nyɛtɔrɔ, ni nyɛbaajie Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi yɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni ehã nyɛ lɛ hewɔ. Hiɛ akakpa Yehowa nɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ

english_verse: Make sure that you never forget the Lord or disobey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. If you always obey them,
translation_verse: “Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe ni ahia koni nyɛhiɛ akakpa Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni no hã nyɛyeee ekitãi kɛ emlai kɛ ekpɔi ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: you will have plenty to eat, and you will build good houses to live in.
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛna nii nyɛye nyɛtɔrɔ, ni nyɛmamɔ shĩai fɛɛfɛji nyɛhi mli,

english_verse: You will get more and more cattle, sheep, silver, gold, and other possessions.
translation_verse: ni nyɛtoi kɛ tsinai kɛ nyɛjwiɛtɛi kɛ nyɛshika kɛ nyɛnibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ shwere lɛ,

english_verse: But when all this happens, don't be proud! Don't forget that you were once slaves in Egypt and that it was the Lord who set you free.
translation_verse: nyɛkwɛa ni ahia koni nyɛkawo nyɛhe nɔ ni nyɛhiɛ miikpa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ. Lɛ mɔ ni ejie nyɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ni aye nyɛ nyɔŋ yɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Remember how he led you in that huge and frightening desert where poisonous snakes and scorpions live. There was no water, but the Lord split open a rock, and water poured out so you could drink.
translation_verse: Lɛ ji mɔ ni kpala nyɛ kɛtsɔ̃ shiaŋa kpeteŋkple ni nɔ yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ nɔ lɛ, he ni onufui ni naa jaraa kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋkrakroi kɛ nu hɔmɔ yɔɔ lɛ. Lɛ ehã nu tue kɛjɛ tswɛrɛbo tɛsaa mli hã nyɛ, ni nyɛna nyɛnu;

english_verse: He also gave you manna, a kind of food your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was testing you to make you trust him, so that later on he could be good to you.
translation_verse: ni ekɛ mana ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tete leee lɛ, lɛ nyɛ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ koni ehã nyɛhumi shi, ni asaŋ koni ekɛka nyɛ ekwɛ, koni naagbee mli lɛ efee nyɛ ejurɔ.

english_verse: When you become successful, don't say, “I'm rich, and I've earned it all myself.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni ahia koni nyɛkakɛɛ yɛ nyɛtsuiŋ yɛ he akɛ, ‘Wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhewalɛ kɛ nyɛmɔ naa hã wɔshwere nɛkɛ nɛɛ.’

english_verse: Instead, remember that the Lord your God gives you the strength to make a living. That's how he keeps the promise he made to your ancestors.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ nyɛkaia akɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni duro nyɛ hewalɛ ni nyɛkɛna nii ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ, koni ehã ekpãŋmɔ ni ekã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kitã yɛ he lɛ ama shi, tamɔ nyɛnaa ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: But I'm warning you—if you forget the Lord your God and worship other gods, the Lord will destroy you, just as he destroyed the nations you fought.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa baahã maji ni nyɛkɛaakpe lɛ ahiɛ akpãtã lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu nyɛhiɛ aaakpãtã kɛji nyɛbooo Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ wiemɔ toi lɛ.”

english_verse: Israel, listen to me! You will soon cross the Jordan River and go into the land to force out the nations that live there. They are more powerful than you are, and the walls around their cities reach to the sky.
translation_verse: “Nyɛboa toi, Israelbii! Nyɛbaafo Yordan Faa lɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ koni nyɛya nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔji yɛ maji ni dara, ni asaŋ amɛhe wa hu fe nyɛ adɛŋ, shikpɔji kɛ amɛnɔ maji wuji kɛ amɛhe gbogboi ni atswa kɛtee ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ akɛwaje amɛ.

english_verse: Some of these nations are descendants of the Anakim. You know how tall and strong they are, and you've heard that no one can defeat them in battle.
translation_verse: Shikpɔji nɛɛ anɔ gbɔmɛi lɛ dara ni amɛkwɔlɔ hu. Anakbii lɛ ashwiei ji amɛ, ni tamɔ nyɛle momo lɛ, nyɛnuɔ akɛ akɛɔ yɛ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Namɔ baanyɛ Anakbii lɛ ahiɛ adamɔ?’

english_verse: But the Lord your God has promised to go ahead of you, like a raging fire burning everything in its path. So when you attack your enemies, it will be easy for you to destroy them and take their land.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ nyɛnaa nyɛlea ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ akɛ mɔ ni nyiɛ nyɛhiɛ kɛyaa lɛ etamɔ la grigri ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ. Lɛ ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Ebaaye amɛnɔ, ni ebaajɔɔ amɛhe yɛ nyɛhiɛ koni nyɛshwie amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛkpãtã amɛhiɛ oya tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ Yehowa ewo nyɛ shi eto momo lɛ.

english_verse: Don't ever forget how you kept rebelling and making the Lord angry the whole time you were in the desert. You rebelled from the day you left Egypt until the day you arrived here.
