translation_verse: “Nyɛkaia, ni nyɛhiɛ akakpaa nɔ, bɔ ni nyɛtsɔ̃ nyɛwo Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mlifu nyɛhã be mli ni nyɛyɔɔ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ. Kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni nyɛshi Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aahu kɛbashi nyɛbashɛ biɛ nɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa hiɛ atua sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ nyɛtseɔ.

english_verse: At Mount Sinai you made the Lord so angry that he was going to destroy you.
translation_verse: Nyɛwo Yehowa mli la yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he hu, ni emli fu nyɛ, ni kulɛ eehe nyɛhiɛ ekpãtã.

english_verse: he said: Moses, hurry down the mountain to those people you led out of Egypt. They have already disobeyed me and committed the terrible sin of making an idol.
translation_verse: “Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Kpelekemɔ shi oya ni oya, ejaakɛ omaŋbii lɛ ni okpala kɛjɛ Ijipt lɛ eye sane fɔŋ. Yeee be ko kwraa nɛɛ lɛ, amɛkwa bɔ ni miwo amɛ kitã akɛ amɛhi shi amɛhã lɛ, ni amɛshwie amãgã amɛhã amɛhe.’

english_verse: I've been watching the Israelites, and I've seen how stubborn and rebellious they are.
translation_verse: “Yehowa kɛɛ hu akɛ, ‘Mikwɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ aahu, ni mina akɛ amɛkuɛŋ ti.

english_verse: So don't try to stop me! I am going to wipe them out, and no one on earth will remember they ever lived. Then I will let your descendants become an even bigger and more powerful nation than Israel. Moses said:
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ koni makpãtã amɛhiɛ, ni mabule amɛshishi kwraa yɛ je lɛ mli. No sɛɛ lɛ, mahã oshwiei ashwere ni efɛo ni etsɔ̃ jaku ni da, ni yɛ hewalɛ fe amɛ.’

english_verse: Fire was raging on the mountaintop as I went back down, carrying the two stones with the commandments on them.
translation_verse: “No hewɔ lɛ, mitsɔ̃ mihe, ni mikpeleke gɔŋ lɛ, ni mihiɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ lɛ ni aŋma kpãŋmɔ lɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ miniji enyɔ. Nakai be mli fɛɛ lɛ gɔŋ lɛ miitso kɛ la.

english_verse: I saw how quickly you had sinned and disobeyed the Lord your God. There you were, worshiping the metal idol you had made in the shape of a calf.
translation_verse: Ni mikwɛ, ni naa nyɛfee Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shishi esha; nyɛfee tsina ni ashwie; amrɔ nɛɛ nyɛkpale kɛjɛ gbɛ ni Yehowa ewo nyɛ he kitã lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: So I threw down the two stones and smashed them before your very eyes.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mikɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ lɛ ni mihiɛ kɛ miniji enyɔ lɛ tswia shi, ni mijwara amɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ.

english_verse: I bowed down at the place of worship and prayed to the Lord, without eating or drinking for
translation_verse: Yehowa mli fu Aaron hu jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, bɔ ni he eheɔ lɛ egbe nɛɛ. Shi mikpa fai mihã Aaron hu.

english_verse: It was a sin for you to make that idol, so I threw it into the fire to melt it down. Then I took the lump of gold, ground it into powder, and threw the powder into the stream flowing down the mountain.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni miwo tsina amãgã ni nyɛshwie lɛ, nɔ ni nyɛkɛtɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ lɛ, ni mishã, ni fee sɛɛ lɛ mishimɔ, ni miwiɛ lɛ kɛyashi efee munyɔmunyɔ tamɔ mlu, ni mitsi mlu nɛɛ mishwie faa ni jɛɔ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ hoɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: You also made the Lord angry when you were staying at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-Hattaavah.
translation_verse: Nyɛku sɛɛ nyɛwo Yehowa mlifu yɛ Tabera kɛ Masa kɛ Kibrot Hataava fɛɛ.

english_verse: Then at Kadesh-Barnea the Lord said, “I am giving you the land, so go ahead and take it!” But since you didn't trust the Lord, you rebelled and disobeyed his command.
translation_verse: Ni be ni Yehowa wo nyɛ gbɛ yɛ Kadesh Barnea akɛ nyɛya koni nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ ni ekɛhãa nyɛ akɛ nyɛŋɔ lɛ, no mli hu nyɛtse Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ atua, ni nyɛheee lɛ nyɛyeee, ni nyɛbooo lɛ toi hu.

english_verse: In fact, you've rebelled against the Lord for as long as he has known you.
translation_verse: Yehowa hiɛ atua sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ nyɛtseɔ kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni mile nyɛ lɛ.

english_verse: After you had made the idol in the shape of a calf, the Lord said he was going to destroy you. So I lay face down in front of the Lord for
translation_verse: “Miho mikã shi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa ekɛɛ akɛ ebaakpãtã nyɛhiɛ.

english_verse: and prayed: Our Lord, please don't wipe out your people. You used your great power to rescue them from Egypt and to make them your very own.
translation_verse: Mikpa Yehowa fai mikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, kaakpãtã bo diɛŋtsɛ omɛi lɛ, ni ji gbɔmɛi ni oyakpɔ̃ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ nineshiwalɛ kɛ ohewalɛ lɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: Israel's ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob obeyed you faithfully. Think about them, and not about Israel's stubbornness, evil, and sin.
translation_verse: Kwɛmɔ otsuji Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob ahewɔ; kaadi gbɔmɛi nɛɛ akuɛŋtilɛ loo amɛnifɔɔjianii kɛ nishaianii lɛ asɛɛ,’

english_verse: If you destroy your people, the Egyptians will say, “The Lord promised to give Israel land, but he wasn't powerful enough to keep his promise. In fact, he hated them so much that he took them into the desert and killed them.”
translation_verse: koni shikpɔŋ ni oyakpɔ̃ wɔ kɛje nɔ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ akakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛ ni Yehowa nyɛɛɛ ekɛ amɛ ayashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni ewo amɛ shi yɛ he lɛ nɔ, kɛ agbɛnɛ hu nyɛ ni enyɛɔ amɛ moŋ hewɔ ni eyakpala amɛ kɛtee lɛ, koni eyagbe amɛ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: But you, our Lord, chose the people of Israel to be your own, and with your mighty power you rescued them from Egypt.
translation_verse: Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ omɛi ni oje gbɛ oŋɔ ji amɛ, ni oyakpɔ̃ amɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ nineshiwalɛ yɛ ohewalɛ lɛ naa.’

english_verse: The Lord told me to chisel out two flat stones, just like the ones he had given me earlier. He also commanded me to make a wooden chest, then come up the mountain and meet with him.
translation_verse: “Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Ko tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ ni tamɔ klɛŋklɛŋ tɛi lɛ; asaŋ okɛ tso akpɛ adeka. Kɔlɔmɔ tɛi lɛ kɛba miŋɔɔ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: He told me that he would write on the new stones the same words he had written on the ones I broke, and that I could put these stones in this sacred chest.
translation_verse: Mibasaa maŋma wiemɔi ni yɔɔ tsutsu tɛi lɛ ni ojwara lɛ anɔ lɛ mawo tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii nɛɛ anɔ ni okɛ tɛi lɛ ato adeka lɛ mli.’

english_verse: So I made a chest out of acacia wood, and I chiseled two flat stones like the ones I broke. Then I carried the stones up the mountain,
translation_verse: “No hewɔ lɛ, mikpɛ tso adeka ko, ni miko tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ tamɔ tsutsu tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni mihole tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ mihiɛ kɛkwɔ gɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: where the Lord wrote the Ten Commandments on them, just as he had done the first time. The commandments were exactly what he had announced from the fire, when you were gathered at the mountain. After the Lord returned the stones to me,
translation_verse: Ni tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fee klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, eŋma kitãi Nyɔŋma lɛ ewo tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ anɔ. Kitãi nɛɛ ji wiemɔ ni Yehowa jɛ la lɛ teŋ ekɛ nyɛ wie kɛjɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, gbi nɔ ni maŋ lɛ kpe kpee wulu lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ hã mi,

english_verse: I took them down the mountainside and put them in the chest, just as he had commanded. And they are still there. Aaron Died (Numbers
translation_verse: ni mitsɔ̃ mihe, ni mikpeleke shi kɛjɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba. Ni tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã akɛ mifee lɛ, mikɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ bawo adeka lɛ ni mikpɛ lɛ mli, ni amɛyɛ mli kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.”

english_verse: Respect the Lord your God, be faithful, and serve only him, making promises in his name.
translation_verse: Nyɛshea Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyei; nyɛsɔmɔa lɛ; nyɛkpɛtɛa ehe, ni lɛ egbɛi lɛ pɛ nyɛkɛkã kitã.

english_verse: Later we set up camp at the wells belonging to the descendants of Jaakan. Then we moved on and camped at Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried, and his son Eleazar became the priest.
translation_verse: (Israelbii lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ kɛjɛ Yaakanbii lɛ anubui lɛ ahe kɛtee Mosera. Jɛi Aaron gbo yɛ, ni jɛi nɔŋŋ afu lɛ yɛ. Kɛkɛ ni ebinuu Eleazar baye esɛɛ akɛ osɔfo.

english_verse: Next, we camped at Gudgodah and then at Jotbathah, where there are flowing streams. The Levites Were Appointed To Carry the Chest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Kɛjɛ Mosera lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fã kɛtee Gudgoda; ni kɛjɛ Gudgoda lɛ amɛtee Yotbata, ni ji shikpɔŋ ko ni fai yɔɔ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: After I put the two stones in the sacred chest, the Lord chose the tribe of Levi, not only to carry the chest, but also to serve as his priests at the place of worship and to bless the other tribes in his name. And they still do these things.
translation_verse: Be ni ayɔɔ gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ, Yehowa ŋɔ Levi akutso lɛ akɛ amɛ amɛtere Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ. Asaŋ amɛ amɛdamɔ ehiɛ amɛsɔmɔ lɛ, ni amɛ pɛ amɛkɛ egbɛi ajɔɔ mɛi. Nitsumɔi nɛɛ amli amɛhiɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ.

english_verse: Instead, he told me, “Moses, get ready to lead the people into the land that I promised their ancestors.” What the Lord Wants Moses said:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Yaa ni oyanyiɛ maŋ lɛ hiɛ koni amɛya ni amɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni miwo amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi yɛ he akɛ mikɛbaahã amɛ lɛ.’ ” Nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ taoɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ dɛŋ

english_verse: People of Israel, what does the Lord your God want from you? The Lord wants you to respect and follow him, to love and serve him with all your heart and soul,
translation_verse: “No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ Israel, mɛni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, taoɔ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ dɔŋŋ fe akɛ nyɛshe Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyei, ni nyɛba nyɛjeŋ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, ni nyɛsumɔ lɛ ni nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsui fɛɛ kɛ nyɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ hu asɔmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: and to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. Do this, and all will go well for you.
translation_verse: Nyɛyea Yehowa kitãi lɛ kɛ ekpɔi ni miwo nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ nɔ koni ahi ahã nyɛ.

english_verse: Everything belongs to the Lord your God, not only the earth and everything on it, but also the sky and the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Naa, Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋwɛi kɛ ŋwɛi amli ŋwɛi lɛ enɔ ni; ni shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ emli nii lɛ fɛɛ hu enɔ ni.

english_verse: Yet the Lord loved your ancestors and wanted them to belong to him. So he chose them and their descendants rather than any other nation, and today you are still his people.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ Yehowa na suɔmɔ krɛdɛɛ hã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ni eŋɔ nyɛ, ni ji amɛshwiei lɛ, yɛ maji fɛɛ ateŋ; ni nakai ekɛ nyɛ yɔɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.

english_verse: Remember your agreement with the Lord and stop being so stubborn.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui ni nyɛkpliŋ lɛ, ni nyɛkafea nyɛhe kuɛŋtilɔi dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: The Lord your God is more powerful than all other gods and lords, and his tremendous power is to be feared. His decisions are always fair, and you cannot bribe him to change his mind.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ ji nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ aNyɔŋmɔ kɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi anuŋtsɔ; lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe ni je agbo, ni he yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ; mɔ ni kwɛɛɛ hiɛiaŋ, ni asaŋ eheee nyɔɔŋnii lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord defends the rights of orphans and widows. He cares for foreigners and gives them food and clothing.
translation_verse: Eyeɔ awusã kɛ okulafo sane ehãa amɛ, ni edɔɔ gbɔ he, ni ehãa amɛ nɔ ni amɛaaye kɛ nɔ ni amɛkɛaahã amɛhe.

english_verse: And you should also care for them, because you were foreigners in Egypt.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛdɔa gbɔ he ejaakɛ nyɛ hu nyɛyato gbɔ pɛŋ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Offer your praises to him, because you have seen him work such terrifying miracles for you.
translation_verse: Nyɛjiea eyi ejaakɛ lɛ ji nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ; ni asaŋ nyɛna kɛ nyɛhiŋmɛi nibii wuji ni yɔɔ gbeyei ni etsu ehã nyɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is your God, so you must always love him and obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: “No hewɔ lɛ, esa akɛ nyɛsumɔ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛye egbei kɛ ekpɔi lɛ kɛ emlai lɛ kɛ ekitãi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ daa nɛɛ.

english_verse: Remember, he corrected you and not your children. You are the ones who saw the Lord use his great power
translation_verse: Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nyɛkaia tsɔsemɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, etsɔse nyɛ lɛ, kɛ egbojee lɛ kɛ enineshiwalɛ lɛ kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ hu. Ejaakɛ jeee nyɛbii ni amɛnako aloo amɛleko nibii nɛɛ ji mɛi ni mikɛ wieɔ nɛɛ.

english_verse: when he worked miracles in Egypt, making terrible things happen to the king and all his people.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛle okadii ni efee kɛ nibii ni efee Ijipt Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ eshikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Ijipt lɛ.

english_verse: And when the Egyptian army chased you in their chariots, you saw the Lord drown them and their horses in the Red Sea. Egypt still suffers from that defeat!
translation_verse: Nyɛna nɔ ni Yehowa fee Ijiptbii ata lɛ kɛ amɛkpɔŋɔi lɛ kɛ amɛtayaa shwiilii lɛ; bɔ ni ehã Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ baha amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ, ni amɛhiɛ kpãtã be mli ni amɛtiuɔ nyɛ lɛ.

english_verse: You saw what the Lord did for you while you were in the desert, right up to the time you arrived here.
translation_verse: Nyɛle nibii ni Yehowa tsu ehã nyɛ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ aahu kɛbashi beyinɔ ni nyɛbashɛ biɛ nɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: And you saw how the Lord made the ground open up in the middle of our camp underneath the tents of Dathan and Abiram, who were swallowed up along with their families, their animals, and their tents.
translation_verse: Nyɛkaiɔ nɔ ni efee Datan kɛ Abiram ni ji Ruben bi Eliab bii lɛ. Nyɛ Israel fɛɛ, nyɛhiɛ ni shikpɔŋ gba, ni emi amɛ kɛ amɛshiaŋbii kɛ amɛbii kɛ amɛtsuji kɛ amɛkooloi fɛɛ hu.

english_verse: With your own eyes, you saw the Lord's mighty power do all these things.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛhiŋmɛi na nibii wuji nɛɛ fɛɛ ni Yehowa tsu lɛ.” Shiwoo Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jɔɔmɔi

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River, and if you obey the laws and teachings I'm giving you today, you will be strong enough to conquer the land
translation_verse: “No hewɔ lɛ, kitãi fɛɛ ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ nyɛyea nɔ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛhe awa koni nyɛnyɛ nyɛya nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛfoɔ mli kɛya nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ;

english_verse: that the Lord promised your ancestors and their descendants. It's rich with milk and honey, and you will live there and enjoy it for a long time.
translation_verse: asaŋ koni nyɛwala sɛɛ atsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii ni Yehowa wo nyɛtsɛmɛi shi akɛ ekɛbaahã amɛ kɛ amɛshwiei lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: But the hills and valleys in the promised land are watered by rain from heaven,
translation_verse: Shi moŋ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaa ni nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ, gɔji kɛ jɔi ashikpɔŋ ni; ni nu nɛɔ nɔ;

english_verse: because the Lord your God keeps his eye on this land and takes care of it all year long.
translation_verse: eji shikpɔŋ ko ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baa yi, ni ehiŋmɛi yɛ he afi muu lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: The Lord your God commands you to love him and to serve him with all your heart and soul. If you obey him,
translation_verse: “Kɛji nyɛye kitãi ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ akɛ nyɛsumɔ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛtsui kɛ nyɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ hu asɔmɔ lɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: But watch out! You will be tempted to turn your backs on the Lord. And if you worship other gods,
translation_verse: Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe ni ahia, bɔ ni afee ni nɔ ko akalaka nyɛ ni nyɛkpale yɛ Yehowa sɛɛ nyɛyasɔmɔ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni nyɛja amɛ.

english_verse: the Lord will become angry and keep the rain from falling. Nothing will grow in your fields, and you will die and disappear from the good land that the Lord is giving you.
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛfee nɛkɛ nɔ ko lɛ, Yehowa mli baafu nyɛ, ni ebaatsi nu naa, ni nu enɛŋ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baŋ nii, ni nyɛhiɛ baakpãtã oya yɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni Yehowa kɛhã nyɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Memorize these laws and think about them. Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and your foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: “No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ miwiemɔi lɛ atoa nyɛtsuiiaŋ kɛ nyɛmumɔ mli; nyɛkɛfimɔa nyɛnijiashi kɛ nyɛhiɛŋtsei anɔ akɛ hekaimɔ nii.

english_verse: Teach them to your children. Talk about them all the time—whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Nyɛtsɔ̃a nyɛbii; nyɛwiea he be ni nyɛtara shi yɛ shĩateŋ kɛ be ni nyɛnyiɛ gbɛ, kɛ be ni nyɛjɔɔ nyɛhe kɛ be ni nyɛtsuɔ nii fɛɛ.

english_verse: Write them on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates.
translation_verse: Nyɛŋmaa yɛ nyɛshĩai lɛ ashinaatsei lɛ kɛ nyɛmaji lɛ agboi lɛ hu ahe,

english_verse: Then you and your descendants will live a long time in the land that the Lord promised your ancestors. Your families will live there as long as the sky is above the earth.
translation_verse: koni nyɛwala kɛ nyɛbii lɛ hu awala sɛɛ atsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa wo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi akɛ ekɛbaahã amɛ lɛ nɔ gbii abɔ ni ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ yɔɔ nɛɛ.

english_verse: Love the Lord your God faithfully and obey all the laws and teachings I'm giving you today. If you live the way the Lord wants,
translation_verse: “Kɛji nyɛjwɛŋ nɛkɛ kitãi nɛɛ ni miwoɔ nyɛ nɛɛ nɔ, ni nyɛye nɔ, ni nyɛsumɔ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛhi shi pɛpɛɛpɛ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, ni nyɛkpɛtɛ ehe lɛ,

english_verse: he will help you take the land. And even though the nations there are more powerful than you, the Lord will force them to leave when you attack.
translation_verse: no lɛ Yehowa baashwie maji nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ, ni nyɛbaashɔ̃shɔ̃ɔ maji ni dara ni amɛhe wa fe nyɛ ashikpɔji yɛ amɛdɛŋ, ni nyɛbaaŋɔ akɛ nyɛnɔ.

english_verse: You will capture the land everywhere you go, from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains, and from the Euphrates River west to the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: He fɛɛ he ni nyɛnane aaasa lɛ jɛi aaatsɔ̃ nyɛnɔ. Nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ baajɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ wuoyigbɛ, kɛyanina Lebanon gɔji lɛ yɛ kooyigbɛ; ni ebaajɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa yɛ bokãgbɛ kɛyamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ yɛ anaigbɛ.

english_verse: No one will be able to stand up to you. The Lord will make everyone terrified of you, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baahã nyɛhe ŋmiŋmi kɛ nyɛhe gbeyei amɔmɔ shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛaayashɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ bii, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ nyɛhiɛ adamɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ewo nyɛ shi lɛ.

english_verse: Today I am giving you his laws, and if you obey him, he will bless you.
translation_verse: Ebaafee jɔɔmɔ ehã nyɛ kɛji nyɛye Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitãi lɛ ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ nɔ;

english_verse: But if you disobey him and worship those gods that have never done anything for you, the Lord will put a curse on you.
translation_verse: shi eeefee loomɔ ehã nyɛ kɛji nyɛyeee Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitãi lɛ anɔ; kɛji nyɛyahiii shi bɔ ni miwoɔ nyɛ kitã ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ akɛ nyɛhi shi lɛ, ni nyɛyaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni nyɛleee sa lɛ.

english_verse: After the Lord your God helps you take the land, you must have a ceremony where you announce his blessings from Mount Gerizim and his curses from Mount Ebal.
translation_verse: Kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ yashɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, daamɔ Gerizim Gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ koni ojaje nɔ ni ji jɔɔmɔ lɛ otsɔ̃ɔ; ni loomɔ lɛ odamɔ Ebal Gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ ojaje otsɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River to conquer the land that the Lord your God is giving you. And when you have settled there,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɛbaafo Yordan lɛ koni nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ. Kɛji nyɛtee nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ, ni nyɛhi nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: be careful to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ koni nyɛye akpɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ mlai lɛ hu fɛɛ ni mikɛshwieɔ nyɛhiɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Now I'll tell you the laws and teachings that you have to obey as long as you live. Your ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he is giving you this land.
translation_verse: “Akpɔi kɛ mlai ni nyɛjwɛŋ nɔ nyɛye nɔ gbii abɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: But the nations that live there worship other gods. So after you capture the land, you must completely destroy their places of worship—on mountains and hills or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Fitemɔ nyɛfitea hei fɛɛ ni maji ni nyɛyaashwie lɛ jaa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ yɛ, yɛ gɔji grɔŋŋi lɛ anɔ jio gɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ jio, tsei kusukusuu lɛ fɛɛ ashishi jio.

english_verse: Wherever these nations worship their gods, you must tear down their altars, break their sacred stones, burn the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and smash their idols to pieces. Destroy these places of worship so completely that no one will remember they were ever there.
translation_verse: Nyɛkumɔa amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ kɛ shiui ni amɛkɛ tɛi emamɔ lɛ nyɛshwiea; ni amɛ, Ashera, wɔŋ koi lɛ nyɛshãa; amɛtso amãgãi lɛ nyɛfolɔa mli nyɛshwiea shi, koni akaja amɛ yɛ hei nɛɛ dɔŋŋ kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ.

english_verse: Don't worship the Lord your God in the way those nations worship their gods.
translation_verse: “Shi bɔ ni amɛjaa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ jeee nakai nyɛbaaja Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yɛ he fɛɛ he kɛkɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has promised that later on he will give Israel more land, and some of you may not be able to travel all the way from your homes to the place of worship each time you are hungry for meat. But the Lord will give you cattle, sheep, and goats, and you can butcher any of those animals at home and eat as much as you want.
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛmaji lɛ kɛ he koome ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ akɛ aja lɛ yɛ jɛi lɛ teŋ jɛkɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛgbea nyɛtoi kɛ nyɛtsinai lɛ ni Yehowa kɛduro nyɛ lɛ, yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ amli, koni nyɛye bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni nyɛaanyɛ tamɔ bɔ ni miwo nyɛ ehe kitã lɛ.

english_verse: Do you want the Lord to make you successful? Do you want your children to be successful even after you are gone? Then do what pleases the Lord and don't eat blood.
translation_verse: Nyɛkayea la lɛ bɔ ni afee ni kɛji nyɛfee nɔ ni ja yɛ Yehowa hiɛ lɛ, ahi ahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei fɛɛ.

english_verse: All sacrifices and offerings to the Lord must be taken to the place where he chooses to be worshiped. If you offer a sacrifice to please the Lord, all of its meat must be burned on the altar. You can eat the meat from certain kinds of sacrifices, but you must always pour out the animal's blood on the altar.
translation_verse: koni kooloo afɔle ni ashãa lɛ loo lɛ kɛ lá lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛshã yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Shi afɔlei krokomɛi lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, nyɛtsia lá lɛ nyɛshwiea afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; shi loo lɛ nyɛyea.

english_verse: If you obey these laws, you will be doing what the Lord your God says is right and good. Then he will help you and your descendants be successful. Worship the Lord in the Right Way Moses said:
translation_verse: Nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ, ni nyɛyea nibii fɛɛ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ nɔ, ni ebaahi ehã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei fɛɛ kɛya naanɔ, kɛ nyɛfee nɔ ni hi kɛ nɔ ni ja yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ lɛ. Amãgãjamɔ he kɔkɔbɔɔ

english_verse: Israel, as you go into the land and attack the nations that are there, the Lord will get rid of them, and you can have their land.
translation_verse: “Kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kpãtã maji ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ amɛshikpɔji lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ ahiɛ, ni nyɛŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛhi nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: But that's when you must be especially careful not to ask, “How did those nations worship their gods? Shouldn't we worship the Lord in the same way?”
translation_verse: nyɛkwɛa ni ahia koni be ni akpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ni nyɛkanyiɛ amɛsɛɛ, ni nyɛyadu tsɔne, ni nyɛkabia amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ ahe sane ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Te amɛjaa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ amɛhãa tɛŋŋ,’ ni nyɛ hu nyɛfee nakai.

english_verse: No, you should not! The Lord hates the disgusting way those nations worship their gods, because they even burn their sons and daughters as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Nyɛkajaa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, tamɔ amɛjaa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ, ejaakɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa hiɔ lɛ, nomɛi moŋ amɛfeɔ amɛkɛjaa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ. Amɛgbeɔ amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei tete amɛkɛshãa afɔle amɛhãa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ.

english_verse: Obey all the laws and teachings I am giving you. Don't add any, and don't take any away.
translation_verse: “Nyɛyea nibii fɛɛ ni miwo nyɛ he kitã lɛ anɔ; nyɛkɛ nɔ ko akafataa he, ni nyɛkajiea nɔ ko hu yɛ mli.

english_verse: Someday a prophet may come along who is able to perform miracles or tell what will happen in the future. Then the prophet may say, “Let's start worshiping some new gods—some gods that we know nothing about.”
translation_verse: ni okadi lɛ loo naakpɛɛ nɔ lɛ na ba mli anɔkwaleŋ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɔ nɛɛ kɛɛ ‘Nyɛhãa wɔyaa ni wɔyajaa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni nyɛleee koni nyɛsɔmɔ amɛ lɛ,

english_verse: If the prophet says this, don't listen! The Lord your God will be watching to find out whether or not you love him with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: nyɛkaboa nakai gbalɔ lɛ loo lamɔ shishitsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ toi; ejaakɛ kaa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛkaa nyɛ lɛ. Eetao ena akɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛtsui fɛɛ kɛ nyɛmumɔ fɛɛ miisumɔ lɛ Yehowa lɛ lo.

english_verse: You must be completely faithful to the Lord. Worship and obey only the Lord and do this with fear and trembling,
translation_verse: Nyɛjaa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛshea lɛ gbeyei; nyɛyea ekitãi lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛboa lɛ toi; nyɛsɔmɔa lɛ, ni lɛ ehe nyɛkɛ nyɛhe akpɛtɛa.

english_verse: because he rescued you from slavery in Egypt. If a prophet tells you to disobey the Lord your God and to stop worshiping him, then that prophet is evil and must be put to death.
translation_verse: Shi nakai gbalɔ lɛ loo mɔ ni laa lamɔi lɛ agbe lɛ. Ejaakɛ eetsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ nyɛtse Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie nyɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ekpɔ̃ nyɛ yɛ nyɔŋyeli mli lɛ, hiɛ̃ atua. Eetao akɛ nyɛkahi shi bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ewo nyɛ kitã akɛ nyɛfee lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, esa akɛ nyɛgbe lɛ koni nyɛjie nakai su fɔŋ lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.’

english_verse: And when the rest of Israel hears about it, they will be afraid, and no one else will ever do such an evil thing again.
translation_verse: No baahã Israel muu fɛɛ anu nɔ ni eba lɛ, ni amɛbaashe gbeyei koni akaye nɛkɛ sane fɔŋ nɛɛ eko yɛ nyɛteŋ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives you towns to live in, you may hear a rumor about one of the towns.
translation_verse: “Kɛji nyɛaanu yɛ maji ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ ni nyɛhi amɛmli lɛ eko he akɛ

english_verse: You may hear that some worthless people have talked everyone there into worshiping other gods, even though these gods had never done anything for them.
translation_verse: nyɛteŋ hii yakagbɔmɛi komɛi ete shi yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛlaka maŋ lɛ mli bii, ni amɛmiija nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni nyɛleee lɛ,

english_verse: You must carefully find out if the rumor is true. Then if the people of that town have actually done such a disgusting thing in your own country,
translation_verse: nyɛtaoa sane nɛɛ mli fitsofitso. Kɛji sane lɛ yɛ mli anɔkwale akɛ abɔ nɛkɛ musu yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ,

english_verse: you must take your swords and kill every one of them, and their livestock too.
translation_verse: no lɛ nyɛfãa klante yɛ nakai maŋ lɛ mli bii lɛ anɔ; nyɛgbea gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi fɛɛ.

english_verse: Gather all the possessions of the people who lived there, and pile them up in the marketplace, without keeping anything for yourself. Set the pile and the whole town on fire, and don't ever rebuild the town. The whole town will be a sacrifice to the Lord your God. Then he won't be angry anymore, and he will have mercy on you and make your nation stronger, just as he promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: Nyɛkaŋɔa musunii lɛ eko kwraa nyɛtoa nyɛhãa nyɛhe bɔ ni afee ni Yehowa afo emlifu ni naa wa lɛ sɛɛ. Eeena nyɛ mɔbɔ, ni emusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ nyɛhe, ni eeehã nyɛyi afa tamɔ bɔ ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi lɛ,

english_verse: That's why you must do what the Lord your God says is right. I am giving you his laws and teachings today, and you must obey them.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ nyɛbo Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi, ni nyɛye ekitãi ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛfee nɔ ni ja yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ.”

english_verse: Out of all the nations on this earth, the Lord your God chose you to be his own. You belong to the Lord, so don't behave like those who worship other gods. Animals That Can Be Eaten (Leviticus
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa je gbɛ eŋɔ nyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji fɛɛ ateŋ ehã ehe akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ. Kooloi ni aye kɛ nii akaye (Levitiko

english_verse: You can eat any clean bird.
translation_verse: “Loofɔji fɛɛ ni he tse lɛ nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛye.

english_verse: You may eat the meat of cattle, sheep, and goats; wild sheep and goats; and gazelles, antelopes, and all kinds of deer.
translation_verse: kɛ ofrote kɛ baayelɔ kɛ odabɔ kɛ soŋai kɛ duŋ kɛ wuo kɛ otrɔ̃ŋ.

english_verse: It is all right to eat meat from any animals that have divided hoofs and also chew the cud.
translation_verse: Kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni agba enane kokloto mli enyɔ, ni asaŋ egɔiɔ eniyenii, ni esaa etaa ni emiɔ ekoŋŋ lɛ, nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛye.

english_verse: But don't eat camels, rabbits, and rock badgers. These animals chew the cud but do not have divided hoofs. You must treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛkayea kooloo ko kooloo ko ja eyɛ kokloto ni agba mli, ni asaŋ egɔiɔ eniyenii, ni esaa etaa ni emiɔ ekoŋŋ. Kooloi tamɔ yooma kɛ kpɛŋkplɛ kɛ afutuɔkɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, tsɛbelɛ amɛgɔiɔ amɛniyenii ni amɛsaa amɛtaa amɛmiɔ ekoŋŋ moŋ nɛ, shi agbalako amɛkoklotoi amli lɛ, amɛhe tseee hãaa nyɛ.

english_verse: And don't eat pork, since pigs have divided hoofs, but they do not chew their cud. Don't even touch a dead pig!
translation_verse: Nyɛkayea kplotoo hu ejaakɛ agba enane kokloto mli enyɔ moŋ nɛ, shi egɔiii eniyenii etaaa. Nyɛkayea kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ ekoeko loo; ni kɛji agbe eko lɛ ehe tete po nyɛkataa.

english_verse: You can eat any fish that has fins and scales. But there are other creatures that live in the water,
translation_verse: “Nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛye nu mli loo fɛɛ loo ni yɔɔ fiji ni eyɛ totoi hu yɛ ehe.

english_verse: and if they do not have fins and scales, you must not eat them. Treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: Shi nɔ ni bɛ fiji ni totoi hu bɛ ehe lɛ nyɛkayea; ehe tseee hã nyɛ.

english_verse: Swarming insects are unclean, so don't eat them.
translation_verse: “Kooloi nyɛ́ŋɛ́nyɛ́ŋɛ́ ni filikiɔ fɛɛ lɛ, amɛhe tseee, nyɛkayea.

english_verse: However, you are allowed to eat certain kinds of winged insects.
translation_verse: Kooloi ni filikiɔ ni he tse fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛyea.

english_verse: You belong to the Lord your God, so if you happen to find a dead animal, don't eat its meat. You may give it to foreigners who live in your town or sell it to foreigners who are visiting your town. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. Give the Lord Ten Percent of Your Harvest Moses said:
translation_verse: “Nyɛkayea kooloo ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbo. Aaanyɛ akɛ kooloo lɛ ahã gbɔ ni nyɛkɛyɔɔ nyɛmaŋ lɛ mli koni eye, aloo ahɔ̃ɔ ahã gbɔ kroko ko, ejaakɛ nyɛ lɛ, Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ji nyɛ. “Nyɛkahoa toobi kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ enyɛ fufɔ mli nu.” Mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ he mla

english_verse: People of Israel, every year you must set aside ten percent of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: “Nyɛjiea nyɛŋmɔshi nii mli mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome daa afi;

english_verse: Also set aside ten percent of your wine and olive oil, and the first-born of every cow, sheep, and goat. Take these to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped, and eat them there. This will teach you to always respect the Lord your God.
translation_verse: ni nyɛkɛyaa he koome ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ. Nyɛyayea nyɛtoi kɛ nyɛtsinai akromɔbii kɛ nyɛbele kɛ nyɛmu ni nyɛnu nyɛwain mli mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekomei lɛ yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ, koni nyɛkɛkase Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyeishemɔ nyɛwala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: But suppose you can't carry that ten percent of your harvest to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. If you live too far away, or if the Lord gives you a big harvest,
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ oshihilɛhe kɛ he ni Yehowa eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ teŋ jɛkɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni owoŋ oŋmɔshi nii lɛ mli mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ teremɔ kɛ jɛiyaa lɛ,

english_verse: When you and your family arrive, spend the money on food for a big celebration. Buy cattle, sheep, goats, wine, beer, and if there are any other kinds of food that you want, buy those too.
translation_verse: Okɛ shika nɛɛ ahe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni baa otsine, too loo jio, tsina loo jio, wain jio, dãa ni wa jio, koni bo kɛ owe lɛ fɛɛ aye yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ yɛ jɛi ni nyɛmii ashɛ nyɛhe.

english_verse: And since people of the Levi tribe won't own any land for growing crops, remember to ask the Levites to celebrate with you.
translation_verse: “Nyɛkashĩa Levibii ni nyɛkɛyɔɔ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ asɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛ lɛ ahãaa amɛ amɛ kɔkrɔɔ amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ loo gboshinii ko.

english_verse: Every third year, instead of using the ten percent of your harvest for a big celebration, bring it into town and put it in a community storehouse.
translation_verse: Daa afii etɛ̃ naagbee lɛ, nyɛbuaa nyɛŋmɔshi nii lɛ amli mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekomei lɛ fɛɛ anaa nyɛtoa yɛ nyɛmaji amli.

english_verse: The Levites have no land of their own, so you must give them food from the storehouse. You must also give food to the poor who live in your town, including orphans, widows, and foreigners. If they have enough to eat, then the Lord your God will be pleased and make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ niyenii nɛɛ eko ahãa Levibii lɛ ni ahãaa amɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ ko lɛ, kɛ gbɔi kɛ awusai kɛ okulafoi hu ni yɔɔ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ koni amɛna nii amɛye ni amɛtɔrɔ; ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaajɔɔ nyɛninenaa nitsumɔi fɛɛ.”

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives land to each of you, there may be poor Israelites in the town where you live. If there are, then don't be mean and selfish with your money.
translation_verse: “Kɛji nyɛnyɛmi Israelnyo ko miiye ohia yɛ maŋ ko mli yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, akawa lɛ yi, musuŋ akajoo yɛ nyɛmi ohiafo lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Every seven years you must announce, “The Lord says loans do not need to be paid back.” Then if you have loaned money to another Israelite, you can no longer ask for payment.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni afee yɛ afi lɛ nɔ nɛ: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni efa enyɛmi Israelnyo nɔ ko lɛ, ekɛ nɔ lɛ ake mɔ lɛ; ekabi nɔ lɛ shi yɛ enaanyo loo enyɛmi lɛ dɛŋ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ Yehowa efã akɛ ahã mɛi fɛɛ aye amɛhe.

english_verse: This law applies only to loans you have made to other Israelites. Foreigners will still have to pay back what you have loaned them.
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔkpɔŋ ji mɔ ni hiɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ, no lɛ ahe yɛ edɛŋ, shi kɛji onyɛmi Israelnyo ni lɛ, no lɛ onɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ edɛŋ lɛ okɛke lɛ.

english_verse: No one in Israel should ever be poor. The Lord your God is giving you this land, and he has promised to make you very successful, if you obey his laws and teachings that I'm giving you today. You will lend money to many nations, but you won't have to borrow. You will rule many nations, but they won't rule you.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baajɔɔ nyɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ewo shi eto lɛ. Nyɛbaafala maji babaoo nii, shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛfaŋ nɔ ko yɛ maŋ ko dɛŋ; nyɛaaye maji babaoo anɔ, shi nyɛ lɛ maŋ ko yeŋ nyɛnɔ.

english_verse: Be careful! Don't say to yourself, “Soon it will be the seventh year, and then I won't be able to get my money back.” It would be horrible for you to think that way and to be so selfish that you refuse to help the poor. They are your relatives, and if you don't help them, they may ask the Lord to decide whether you have done wrong. And he will say that you are guilty.
translation_verse: Kwɛmɔ koni jwɛŋmɔ gbonyo akaba oyiŋ ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Afi ni ji kpawo ni ji heyeli afi lɛ eshɛ etã’ hewɔ lɛ, otũ ohiɛ owo onyɛmi ohiafo lɛ, ni ohãaa lɛ nɔ ni ebaa ebafa lɛ. Kɛji nyɛmi ohiafo nɛɛ fo etsɛ Yehowa lɛ, eeebu bo fɔ.

english_verse: You should be happy to give the poor what they need, because then the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ hã lɛ nii lɛ yɛ tsuijurɔ naa, ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaajɔɔ onitsumɔi fɛɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni okɛ onine aaata he lɛ.

english_verse: But if the animal is lame or blind or has something else wrong with it, you must not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji kpa ko yɛ kooloo ko he lɛ, akpake ni jio, shwilamɔ ni jio, kpa fɛɛ kpa ni eji lɛ, nyɛkɛ no akashãa afɔle nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: If any of you buy Israelites as slaves, you must set them free after six years.
translation_verse: “Kɛji ahɔ̃ɔ onyɛmi Hebrinyo ahã bo lɛ, nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, esɔmɔ bo afii ekpaa; afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, oŋmɛɛ ehe koni eye ehe tswaa.

english_verse: And don't just tell them they are free to leave—
translation_verse: Shi kɛji oŋmɛɛ nyɔŋ lɛ he koni eye ehe tswaa lɛ, kaahã eeya kɛ edɛ̃ folo.

english_verse: give them sheep and goats and a good supply of grain and wine. The more the Lord has given you, the more you should give them.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ okɛ otoi lɛ kɛ obele lɛ kɛ owain lɛ eko awo lɛ gbɛ. Okwɛ jɔɔmɔ ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛjɔɔ bo lɛ nɔ koni ohã lɛ nii lɛ bɔ ni sa ni okɛwo lɛ gbɛ.

english_verse: But one of your slaves may say, “I love you and your family, and I would be better off staying with you, so please don't make me leave.”
translation_verse: Shi kɛji nyɔŋ lɛ aaakɛɛ bo akɛ esumɔɔɔ akɛ eshi bo, akɛni esumɔɔ bo kɛ owe lɛ ejaakɛ eyɛ jogbaŋŋ yɛ oŋɔɔ lɛ,

english_verse: Take the slave to the door of your house and push a sharp metal rod through one earlobe and into the door. Such slaves will belong to you for life, whether they are men or women.
translation_verse: no lɛ ŋɔɔ nyɔŋ lɛ kɛba shinaa lɛ naa, ni akɔ fitii ni akɛgbu nyɔŋ lɛ toi. Enɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ etsɔ̃ onyɔŋ kɛmiiya naanɔ. Nakai nɔŋŋ afee yoo nyɔŋ hu.

english_verse: If the first-born animal of a cow or sheep or goat is a male, it must be given to the Lord. Don't put first-born cattle to work or cut wool from first-born sheep.
translation_verse: “Nyɛjɔa nyɛtoi lɛ kɛ nyɛtsinai lɛ hu akromɔbii hii fɛɛ ni aaafɔ lɛ anɔ nyɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Nyɛkɛ tsinai akromɔbii lɛ akatsua nɔ ko nɔ ko; ni nyɛtoi akromɔbii lɛ hu nyɛkakua amɛhe tsɔi.

english_verse: Instead, each year you must take the first-born of these animals to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped. You and your family will sacrifice them to the Lord and then eat them as part of a sacred meal.
translation_verse: Nyɛ kɛ nyɛwekui kɛ nyɛwebii baaya he ni Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ daa afi koni nyɛyagbe kooloi nɛɛ yɛ jɛi, ni nyɛye yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: You can butcher it where you live, and eat it just like the meat of a deer or gazelle that you kill while hunting. Even those people who are unclean and unfit for worship can have some.
translation_verse: Nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛye nakai kooloo lɛ yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ amli tamɔ nyɛyeɔ soŋai loo ofrote nɛkɛ lɛ. Mɔ ni he tseee kɛ mɔ ni he tse fɛɛ aaanyɛ aye eko.

english_verse: But you must never eat the blood of an animal—let it drain out on the ground.
translation_verse: Kooloo lɛ mli lá lɛ moŋ kɛkɛ nyɛkaye; nyɛtsia lá lɛ nyɛshwiea tamɔ atsiɔ nu ashwieɔ shi.”

english_verse: People of Israel, you must celebrate Passover in the month of Abib, because one night in that month years ago, the Lord your God rescued you from Egypt.
translation_verse: “Nyɛhiɛ ahia Abib nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni nyɛye Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ nɔ nyɛhã Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Ejaakɛ Abib nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɔɔŋteŋ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you want to enjoy a long and successful life, make sure that everyone is treated with justice in the land the Lord is giving you. Don't Set Up Sacred Poles or Stones Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Naa, nyɛyea jalɛ sane pɛ kɛkɛ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛyi ana wala, ni nyɛhi shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Eat thin bread for the next six days. Then on the seventh day, don't do any work. Instead, come together and worship the Lord. The Harvest Festival (Exodus
translation_verse: Nyɛyea ma akpiti aboloo lɛ gbii ekpaa, ni gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, akpe kpee wulu akɛja Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ.” Nikpamɔ Gbijurɔyeli (Ɛksodɔs

english_verse: The Passover sacrifice must be a cow, a sheep, or a goat, and you must offer it at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyaa he ni Yehowa eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ, ni nyɛgbea too kɛ tsina akɛ Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ afɔle nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa.

english_verse: Don't offer the Passover sacrifice in just any town where you happen to live.
translation_verse: “Nyɛkayea Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ nyɛmaji ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ eko eko mli,

english_verse: It must be offered at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. Kill the sacrifice at sunset, the time of day when you left Egypt.
translation_verse: akɛ ja yɛ he ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ. Jɛi nyɛgbe Hehoo afɔle kooloo lɛ yɛ, gbɛkɛnaashi mli be ni hulu yaanyɔ shi lɛ, ejaakɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa mli nyɛshi Ijipt.

english_verse: Then cook it and eat it there at the place of worship, returning to your tents the next morning.
translation_verse: Nyɛhoa kooloo lɛ, ni nyɛyea yɛ he ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ; ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ kɛyaa nyɛshĩaiaŋ.

english_verse: And don't set up a sacred stone! The Lord hates these things.
translation_verse: Asaŋ nyɛkamaa shiu ko shiu ko ni ji nii ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɔ lɛ nyɛhãa nyɛhe.”

english_verse: When you build the altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God, don't set up a sacred pole for the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: “Kaatɛo tsei ni okɛfee wɔŋ koo ofata Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, afɔleshãa latɛ ni nyɛbaama lɛ he.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you start your grain harvest,
translation_verse: “Nyɛkanea otsii kpawo kɛjɛ be mli ni abɔiɔ abelekuu lɛ,

english_verse: go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped and celebrate the Harvest Festival in honor of the Lord your God. Bring him an offering as large as you can afford, depending on how big a harvest he has given you. Be sure to take along your sons and daughters and all your servants. Also invite the poor, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: Nyɛmii ashɛa nyɛhe yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ, nyɛ kɛ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei kɛ nyɛwehii kɛ nyɛweyei kɛ Levibii ni yɔɔ nyɛmaji lɛ amli kɛ maŋsɛɛ gbɔi kɛ awusãi kɛ okulafoi hu ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ. Nyɛyea gbijurɔ nɛɛ yɛ he ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The bigger the harvest the Lord gives you, the bigger your gift should be. Treat Everyone with Justice Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahã bɔ ni eeenyɛ. Ekwɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ejɔɔ lɛ ehã koni ehã nikee bɔ ni eeenyɛ.

english_verse: Each year there are three festivals when all Israelite men must go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. These are the Festival of Thin Bread, the Harvest Festival, and the Festival of Shelters. And don't forget to take along a gift for the Lord.
translation_verse: “Afi fɛɛ afi mli lɛ nyɛteŋ hii fɛɛ abapuea yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ shii etɛ̃, yɛ he ni Yehowa eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ. Bei nɛɛ ji Ma Akpiti Gbijurɔ be lɛ kɛ Nikpamɔ Gbijurɔ be lɛ kɛ Asesei Agbijurɔ be lɛ. Mɔ ko mɔ ko akabapue yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ kɛ edɛ̃ folo;

english_verse: If an ox or a sheep has something wrong with it, don't offer it as a sacrifice to the Lord your God—he will be disgusted! Put To Death People Who Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Nyɛkaŋɔa tsina loo too ni kpa ko yɔɔ ehe nyɛkɛshãa afɔle nyɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ eehi nakai kooloo.

english_verse: So when you hear that someone in your town is committing this disgusting sin, you must carefully find out if that person really is guilty.
translation_verse: ni abatswa nyɛ adafi lɛ, nyɛtaoa sane lɛ mli fitsofitso. Kɛji nyɛna akɛ eyɛ mli anɔkwale akɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ efee nɛkɛ musubɔɔnii nɛɛ yɛ Israel lɛ,

english_verse: But you will need two or three witnesses—one witness isn't enough to prove a person guilty. Get rid of those who are guilty of such evil. Take them outside your town gates and everyone must stone them to death. But the witnesses must be the first to throw stones. Difficult Cases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Odasefoi lɛ tsuutsu atswa gbɔmɔ nɛɛ tɛ; ni no sɛɛ dani maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ atswia lɛ tɛi ni egbo. Kɛtsɔ̃ nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛbaajie nɔ fɔŋ lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.

english_verse: When other Israelites hear about it, they will be afraid and obey the decisions of the court. The King Moses said:
translation_verse: Kɛ afee nakai lɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ baanu he, ni amɛbaashe gbeyei, ni mɔ ko ekaŋ asa akɛ eeeye etsui naa sane nakai dɔŋŋ. Maŋtsɛyeli he Akpɔi

english_verse: People of Israel, after you capture the land the Lord your God is giving you, and after you settle on it, you will say, “We want a king, just like the nations around us.”
translation_verse: “Kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛfee nyɛnɔ, ni nyɛhe shi yɛ nɔ lɛ, eeeba nyɛsusumɔ mli akɛ nyɛwo maŋtsɛ nyɛhã nyɛhe tamɔ bɔ ni majimaji ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ efee lɛ.

english_verse: Go ahead and appoint a king, but make sure that he is an Israelite and that he is the one the Lord has chosen.
translation_verse: Nyɛaanyɛ nyɛwo maŋtsɛ lɛ; shi efee mɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ ni jie lɛ ehã nyɛ. Mɔ lɛ afee nyɛnyɛmi Israelnyo. Nyɛkawoa gbɔ ni ejeee Israelnyo nyɛmaŋtsɛ.

english_verse: The king should not have many horses, especially those from Egypt. The Lord has said never to go back there again.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ maŋtsɛ lɛ akahi okpɔŋɔi pii; asaŋ ekawo maŋbii lɛ gbɛ ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛyahe okpɔŋɔi, ejaakɛ Yehowa ewo nyɛ shi akɛ nyɛkaku nyɛsɛɛ kɛtee Ijipt kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: And the king must not have a lot of wives—they might tempt him to be unfaithful to the Lord. Finally, the king must not try to get huge amounts of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ hu maŋtsɛ lɛ akaŋɔ yei pii; ni ekadi shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi sɛɛ tuutu hu koni ekaje Yehowa sɛɛ.

english_verse: The official copy of God's laws will be kept by the priests of the Levi tribe. So, as soon as anyone becomes king, he must go to the priests and write out a copy of these laws while they watch.
translation_verse: “Kɛji maŋtsɛ nɛɛ bata maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ekwɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlai nɛɛ anɔ wolo lɛ ni yɔɔ Levibii osɔfoi lɛ adɛŋ lɛ nɔ, koni eŋma nakai wolo lɛ henɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kome ehã ehe.

english_verse: Each day the king must read and obey these laws, so that he will learn to worship the Lord with fear and trembling
translation_verse: Wolo lɛ ahi eŋɔɔ, ni ekane ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ, bɔ ni afee ni ekase Yehowa, eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyeishemɔ; ni asaŋ eye mlai kɛ akpɔi nɛɛ anɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: and not think that he's better than everyone else. If the king completely obeys the Lord's commands, he and his descendants will rule Israel for many years.
translation_verse: No ji nɔ ni baahã maŋtsɛ nɛɛ akawo ehe nɔ yɛ enyɛmimɛi Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ni no hã ekwa kitãi lɛ eko ni egba kɛtee ninejurɔ loo abɛku. Enɛ baahã lɛ kɛ eshwiei hu amaŋtsɛyeli sɛɛ atsɛ yɛ Israel.”

english_verse: So when I want to speak to them, I will choose one of them to be a prophet like you. I will give my message to that prophet, who will tell the people exactly what I have said.
translation_verse: Mibatee gbalɔ ko shi tamɔ bo mahã amɛ, yɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ, ni ebaakɛɛ emaŋbii lɛ nɔ ni mikɛhã lɛ akɛ ekɛɛ amɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Some Levites may have money from selling family possessions, and others may not. But all Levites serving at the place of worship will receive the same amount of food from the sacrifices and gifts brought by the people. Don't Do Disgusting Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ekɛ enyɛmimɛi osɔfoi krokomɛi lɛ ana afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ naa niyenii lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ; shi nii ni eeena kɛjɛ etsɛmɛiawe lɛ ekome enɔ ni. Wɔŋjamɔ he kɔkɔbɔɔ

english_verse: The people of the Levi tribe, including the priests, will not receive any land. Instead, they will receive part of the sacrifices that are offered to the Lord,
translation_verse: “Levibii ni ji osɔfoi akutso lɛ, akahã amɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ eko yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ; amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ ji afɔlei ni ashãa ahãa mi, Yehowa, akɛ migbɛnaanii lɛ. Mijɔɔ no nɔ mihã amɛ koni amɛye.

english_verse: When you sacrifice a bull or sheep, the priests will be given the shoulder, the jaws, and the stomach.
translation_verse: “Kɛji akɛ tsina loo too bashã afɔle lɛ, akɛ kooloo lɛ nine lɛ kɛ kadaa lɛ kɛ musuŋ kotoku lɛ ahã osɔfoi lɛ akɛ osɔfoi agbɛnaanɔ ni yɔɔ afɔle lɛ mli.

english_verse: In addition, they will receive the first part of your grain harvest and part of your first batches of wine and olive oil. You must also give them the first wool that is cut from your sheep each year.
translation_verse: Klɛŋklɛŋ obele ni obaaku kɛ owain kɛ omu klɛŋklɛŋ ni oooŋa kɛ otoi ahetsɔi ni oooku lɛ okɛhã osɔfoi lɛ tsuutsu.

english_verse: Give these gifts to the priests, because the Lord has chosen them and their descendants out of all the tribes of Israel to be his special servants at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ Levi kɛjɛ nyɛkutsei lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ koni lɛ kɛ eshwiei lɛ asɔmɔ yɛ ehiɛ akɛ osɔfoi kɛya naanɔ.

english_verse: Any Levite can leave his hometown, and go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: “Levinyo ni miisumɔ baanyɛ eshi Israel maŋ fɛɛ maŋ ni eyɔɔ mli lɛ koni eya he ni Yehowa eto akɛ aja lɛ yɛ lɛ. Kɛji eba lɛ nakai lɛ,

english_verse: and then be a special servant of the Lord there, just like all the other Levites.
translation_verse: esɔmɔ Yehowa, eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, akɛ osɔfo tamɔ enyɛmimɛi Levibii ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land that the Lord your God is giving you. The nations that live there do things that are disgusting to the Lord, and you must not follow their example.
translation_verse: “Kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛhãa nyɛ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkakasea jɛibii lɛ amusubɔɔ nii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with anyone who does these things, and that's why he will help you destroy the nations that are in the land.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa miihi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ nii nɛɛ ateŋ eko lɛ; ni no hewɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, shwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Never be guilty of doing any of these disgusting things! A Prophet like Moses Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, akana tɔ̃mɔ ko yɛ nyɛhe. Awo Gbalɔ he shi

english_verse: You will go in and take the land from nations that practice magic and witchcraft. But the Lord your God won't allow you to do those things.
translation_verse: “Maji anɔ bii ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ nɛɛ lɛ, amɛboɔ klamɔfoi kɛ ŋkunyaayelɔi atoi; shi nyɛ lɛ, Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋmɛɛɛ nyɛ gbɛ ni nyɛfee nakai nɔ ko.

english_verse: Instead, he will choose one of your own people to be a prophet just like me, and you must do what that prophet says.
translation_verse: “Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baatee gbalɔ ko ni tamɔ mi shi yɛ nyɛ nyɛteŋ, ni lɛ toi esa akɛ nyɛbo.

english_verse: You were asking for a prophet the day you were gathered at Mount Sinai and said to the Lord, “Please don't let us hear your voice or see this terrible fire again—if we do, we will die!”
translation_verse: “Gbi ni akpe yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ, nyɛkpa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fai nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Wɔnyɛŋ wɔnu Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ gbee aloo wɔna enunyam ni kpɛlɛɔ nyramnyram lɛ dɔŋŋ koni wɔkagboi.’

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Moses, they have said the right thing.
translation_verse: Ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Amɛwiemɔ lɛ ja naakpa.

english_verse: Since the message comes from me, anyone who doesn't obey the message will have to answer to me.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni booo wiemɔi ni ebaawie yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ toi lɛ, mibagbala mɔ lɛ toi yɛ no hewɔ.

english_verse: But if I haven't spoken, and a prophet claims to have a message from me, you must kill that prophet, and you must also kill any prophet who claims to have a message from another god. Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Shi gbalɔ ni aaato lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiŋ ni ewie wiemɔ ko yɛ migbɛi mli, be mli ni jeee mi mifã lɛ akɛ ewie nakai wiemɔ lɛ, ja agbe lɛ; nakai nɔŋŋ gbalɔ ko ni aaawie yɛ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi agbɛi amli hu agbe lɛ.’

english_verse: You may be asking yourselves, “How can we tell if a prophet's message really comes from the Lord?”
translation_verse: “Nyɛaabi nyɛhe akɛ, ‘Te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ ni wɔle gbalɛ ni jeee Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛ hu?’

english_verse: You will know, because if the Lord says something will happen, it will happen. And if it doesn't, you will know that the prophet was falsely claiming to speak for the Lord. Don't be afraid of any prophet whose message doesn't come from the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ kɛji gbalɔ ko wie yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli, ni gbalɛ lɛ baaa mli loo ebɛ mli lɛ, no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ jeee Yehowa dɛŋ nakai wiemɔ lɛ jɛ. Gbalɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ni to eyiŋ ni ewie, ni no hewɔ lɛ, kaashe nakai gbalɔ lɛ gbeyei.”

english_verse: Israel, the Lord your God has promised that if you obey his laws and teachings I'm giving you, and if you always love him, then he will give you the land he promised your ancestors. When that happens, you must name three more Safe Towns in the new territory.
translation_verse: “Nyɛhalaa maji etɛ̃ krokomɛi hu nyɛkɛfataa abobaa maji etɛ lɛ ahe kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛɛ nyɛhusui lɛ amli ehã nyɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi akɛ ebaafee lɛ, ni ekɛ shikpɔŋ ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi yɛ he akɛ ekɛbaahã amɛ lɛ fɛɛ hã nyɛ lɛ. Kɛji nyɛye nɛkɛ kitãi nɛɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni nyɛfee nɔ ni kitãi lɛ kɛɔ lɛ, ni nyɛsumɔ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛba nyɛjeŋ bɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ, eeeŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ ehã nyɛ.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land and attack the nations. The Lord your God will destroy them and give you their lands, towns, and homes. Then after you are settled,
translation_verse: “Kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kpãtã maji anɔ bii lɛ ni eŋɔɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ ehã nyɛ lɛ ahiɛ, ni nyɛŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ amɛmaji lɛ kɛ amɛshĩai lɛ ni nyɛhi mli lɛ,

english_verse: you must choose three of your towns to be Safe Towns. Divide the land into three regions with one Safe Town near the middle of each, so that a Safe Town can be easily reached from anywhere in your land. Then, if one of you accidentally kills someone, you can run to a Safe Town and find protection from being put to death. But you must not have been angry with the person you killed.
translation_verse: “Mla ni yɔɔ gbɔmɔgbelɔ ni aaajo foi kɛya abobaa maŋ ko mli koni ehere eyiwala lɛ nɛ: Mɔ ni nine aaayakpa yɛ enaanyo nɔ, be mli ni jeee akɛ ebɛ mɔ lɛ ewo emli momo sa lɛ, ejo foi kɛya abobaa maji lɛ eko mli, koni efee shweshweeshwe.

english_verse: For example, suppose you and a friend go into the forest to cut wood. You are chopping down a tree with an ax, when the ax head slips off the handle, hits your friend, and kills him. You can run to one of the Safe Towns and save your life.
translation_verse: Wɔŋɔ lɛ akɛ nyɛyi enyɔ nyɛtee koo ko mli nyɛyaafo tso, ni be ni nyɛ teŋ mɔ kome wo elema lɛ nɔ koni efo tso lɛ, lema lɛ fã yɛ etso lɛ he, ni eyatswa mɔ kome ni egbe lɛ lɛ, gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ aaanyɛ ajo foi kɛya maŋ nɛɛ eko mli, ni eyi aaana wala.

english_verse: You don't deserve to die, since you did not mean to harm your friend. But he did get killed, and his relatives might be very angry. They might even choose one of the men from their family to track you down and kill you. If it is too far to one of the Safe Towns, the victim's relative might be able to catch you and kill you.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛji abobaa maŋ kome too ayɔɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ mli baajekɛ, ni mɔ ni agbe lɛ lɛ wekunyo ni baatɔ mɔ ni egbo lɛ lá lɛ he owele lɛ, baatiu gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ, be mli ni etsui he ejɔko, ni kɛji eyanina lɛ lɛ, eeetswa lɛ nɔ egbe lɛ; tsɛbelɛ esaaa akɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ agbo, ejaakɛ enyɛko mɔ ni egbe lɛ lɛ etoko.

english_verse: That's why I said there must be three Safe Towns.
translation_verse: No hewɔ ni mifãa nyɛ akɛ nyɛhala maji etɛ̃ nyɛto lɛ.

english_verse: You will need them, so innocent people won't be killed on your land while they are trying to reach a Safe Town that is too far away. You will be guilty of murder, if innocent people lose their lives because you didn't name enough Safe Towns in the land the Lord your God will give you.
translation_verse: Nyɛfea enɛ koni akashwie mɔ ni efeko nɔ fɔŋ ko lá shi yakatswaa yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛbaye lá yi sɔ̃.

english_verse: But what if you really do commit murder? Suppose one of you hates a neighbor. So you wait in a deserted place, kill the neighbor, and run to a Safe Town.
translation_verse: “Shi kɛji mɔ ko miinyɛ enyɛmi, ni no hewɔ lɛ, eyawo enyɛmi lɛ ka, ni etua lɛ, ni etswa lɛ nɔ, ni epila lɛ ablaŋ, ni mɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ mli egbo, ni gbɔmɔgbelɔ nɛɛ jo foi kɛtee nɛkɛ abobaa maji nɛɛ ateŋ eko mli lɛ,

english_verse: If that happens, the leaders of your town must send messengers to bring you back from the Safe Town. They will hand you over to one of the victim's relatives, who will put you to death.
translation_verse: gbɔmɔgbelɔ nɛɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ atsu koni ayaŋɔ gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ yɛ abobaa maŋ lɛ mli kɛba. Kɛji akɛ lɛ ba lɛ onukpai lɛ atu lɛ awo mɔ ni esa akɛ etɔ lá he owele lɛ dɛŋ koni egbe gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Israel, for the good of the whole country, you must kill anyone who murders an innocent person. Never show mercy to a murderer! Property Lines Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Akana lɛ mɔbɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ. Ajie mɔ ni eye bem lɛ lá yi sɔ̃ kɛje Israel nɔ, koni ahi ahã nyɛ. Blema husui lɛ

english_verse: In the land the Lord is giving you, there are already stones set up to mark the property lines between fields. So don't move those stones. Witnesses Must Tell the Truth Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Kaajie onaanyo kɛ bo teŋ husu nɔ okadi ni blemabii lɛ eto jeeŋmɔ lɛ kɛtee sɛɛ, yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa kɛhãa nyɛ koni etsɔ̃ nyɛnɔ lɛ nɔ. Odaseyeli he akpɔi

english_verse: Before you are convicted of a crime, at least two witnesses must be able to testify that you did it.
translation_verse: “Akadamɔ odasefonyo kome naa wiemɔ nɔ abu mɔ ko fɔ. Esa akɛ ana odasefoi enyɔ loo etɛ̃ anaa wiemɔ dani adamɔ no nɔ kɛbu fɔ yɛ sane fɛɛ sane mli.

english_verse: If you accuse someone of a crime, but seem to be lying,
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ko to yiŋ sha yɛ enaanyo he, ni ekata sane efɔ̃ enaanyo lɛ nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: then both you and the accused must be taken to the court at the place where the Lord is worshiped. There the priests and judges will find out if you are lying or telling the truth. If you are lying and the accused is innocent,
translation_verse: Kojolɔi lɛ atao sane lɛ mli fitsofitso. Kɛji ana akɛ sanetsɛ lɛ je gbɛ ekata sane efɔ̃ enyɛmi lɛ nɔ yaka, ni eye amale odase eshi enyɛmi lɛ,

english_verse: If you have to go to war, you may find yourselves facing an enemy army that is bigger than yours and that has horses and chariots. But don't be afraid! The Lord your God rescued you from Egypt, and he will help you fight.
translation_verse: “Kɛji nyɛmiiya nyɛkɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi ayawu ta, ni nyɛna amɛkpɔŋɔi kɛ tawuu shwiilii kɛ tabilɔi babaoo ni ayi fa fe nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkashea gbeyei, ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni yakpɔ̃ nyɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ yɛ.

english_verse: Before you march into battle, a priest will go to the front of the army
translation_verse: Kɛji be lɛ shɛ ni nyɛbaabɔ̃i ta lɛ wuumɔ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ aje kpo kɛba koni ekɛ tabilɔi lɛ abawie,

english_verse: and say, “Soldiers of Israel, listen to me! Today when you go into battle, don't be afraid of the enemy, and when you see them, don't panic.
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Hiiabii Israelbii, nyɛboa toi! Ta ebanina nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi yaakpe. Nyɛtsui akafãa; nyɛkashea gbeyei, ni nyɛhe akakpokpoa; nyɛkahãa ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔa nyɛ yɛ amɛhiɛ,

english_verse: The Lord your God will fight alongside you and help you win the battle.”
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ yaa ta lɛ koni ekɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ayawu ahã nyɛ koni nyɛye kunim.’

english_verse: Then the tribal officials will say to the troops: If any of you have built a new house, but haven't yet moved in, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to live in your new house.
translation_verse: “Osɔfo lɛ wiemɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ akɛɛ tabilɔi lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛteŋ mɔ ni ema tsu hee ni egbeleko naa lɛ, eku esɛɛ kɛya ewe, ejaakɛ kɛji eeeyanyɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ, mɔ kroko moŋ ni baagbele tsu lɛ naa.

english_verse: If any of you have planted a vineyard but haven't had your first grape harvest, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to enjoy your grapes.
translation_verse: Mɔ hu ni efee waintrom hee, shi ebɔiko emli yibii yeli lɛ, eku esɛɛ kɛya ewe, ejaakɛ kɛji eeeyanyɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ, mɔ kroko moŋ ni baaye trom lɛ mli nii lɛ.

english_verse: If any of you are engaged to be married, you may go back home and get married. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to marry the woman you are engaged to.
translation_verse: Ni mɔ hu ni etsɛ yoo he baa, shi eyaŋɔko yoo lɛ, lɛ hu eku esɛɛ kɛya ewe, ejaakɛ kɛji eeeyanyɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ, mɔ kroko moŋ ni baaŋɔ yoo lɛ.’

english_verse: Finally, if any of you are afraid, you may go home. We don't want you to discourage the other soldiers.
translation_verse: “Asaŋ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ akɛɛ tabilɔi lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛteŋ mɔ ni miishe gbeyei, ni etsui efã lɛ, eku esɛɛ kɛya ewe koni ekahã enyɛmimɛi tabilɔi krokomɛi lɛ atsui miifã tamɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.’

english_verse: When the officials are finished giving these orders, they will appoint officers to be in command of the army.
translation_verse: Kɛji asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ tabilɔi lɛ wie gbe naa lɛ, afãmɔ tatsɛmɛi ni amɛnyiɛ asafoiasafoi lɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: Whenever you capture towns in the land the Lord your God is giving you, be sure to kill all the people and animals.
translation_verse: “Shi nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ ehã nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ, nyɛgbea amɛmaji lɛ amli gbɔmɛi fɛɛ.

english_verse: He has commanded you to completely wipe out the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
translation_verse: Nyɛbulea amɛshishi wɛɛ, ni ji Hitbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Perizbii lɛ kɛ Hivbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, efã nyɛ ni nyɛfee lɛ.

english_verse: If you allow them to live, they will persuade you to worship their disgusting gods, and you will be unfaithful to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛgbea amɛ bɔ ni afee ni amɛkatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ musubɔɔ nibii ni amɛfeɔ amɛkɛjaa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ koni nyɛkafee esha nyɛshi Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ, lɛ.

english_verse: When you are attacking a town, don't chop down its fruit trees, not even if you have had the town surrounded for a long time. Fruit trees aren't your enemies, and they produce food that you can eat, so don't cut them down.
translation_verse: “Kɛji nyɛkɛ maŋ ko miiwu ni nyɛsa maŋ lɛ yi, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛŋɔ lɛ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni maŋ lɛ yisamɔ lɛ sɛɛ etsɛ ehã lɛ, nyɛkafolɔa maŋ lɛ yeli tsei nyɛshwiea, ejaakɛ tsei nɛɛ ayibii lɛ eko nɔŋŋ nyɛbaana nyɛye. Ani tsei lɛ ji gbɔmɛi ni nyɛkɛna ta lɛ lo?

english_verse: You may need wood to make ladders and towers to help you get over the walls and capture the town. But use only trees that you know are not fruit trees.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛfolɔ tsei ni ayeee amɛyibii lɛ koni nyɛkɛfee tawuu nibii koni nyɛkɛsa maŋ lɛ yi kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaaye maŋ lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: Suppose the body of a murder victim is found in a field in the land the Lord your God is giving you, and no one knows who the murderer is.
translation_verse: “Kɛji ana mɔ ko ni agbe lɛ afɔ̃ ŋa nɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ, ni aleee mɔ ni gbe lɛ lɛ,

english_verse: The judges and other leaders from the towns around there must find out what town is the closest to where the body was found.
translation_verse: nyɛmaŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ kojolɔi lɛ aya, ni amɛyasusu he ni agbe gbɔmɔ lɛ afɔ̃ lɛ kɛ maji ni yɔɔ jɛiniiaŋ lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko jekɛmɔ.

english_verse: The leaders from that town will go to their cattle herds and choose a young cow that has never been put to work.
translation_verse: Maŋ ni kɛ gbonyo lɛ bɛŋkɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ amɔ tsina oblayoo ni akɛtsuko nii dã.

english_verse: and say, “We had no part in this murder, and we don't know who did it.
translation_verse: Nakai be mli lɛ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Jeee wɔ ni wɔshwie lá nɛɛ shi, ni asaŋ wɔleee mɔ hu ni gbe lɛ.

english_verse: But since an innocent person was murdered, we beg you, our Lord, to accept this sacrifice and forgive Israel. We are your people, and you rescued us. Please don't hold this crime against us.” If you obey the Lord and do these things, he will forgive Israel. Marrying a Woman Taken Prisoner in War Moses said to Israel:

english_verse: If a man and a woman have been married less than one year, he must not be sent off to war or sent away to do forced labor. He must be allowed to stay home for a year and be happy with his wife. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Kɛji nuu ko kpee yoo hee lɛ, ekaya ta; ni akɛ nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko akafɔ̃ enɔ akɛ etsu. Ahã eye ehe afi naakplɔ yɛ eshĩa teŋ koni ehã eŋa ni ekpee lɛ mii ashɛ ehe.

english_verse: If you are guilty of kidnapping Israelites and forcing them into slavery, you will be put to death to remove this evil from the community. Skin Diseases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Kɛji ana mɔ ko ni eju enyɛmi Israelnyo, ni eeye lɛ nyɔŋ aloo eyahɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ, agbe nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ koni akɛgu nɛkɛ nɔ fɔŋ nɛɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.

english_verse: And remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam after you left Egypt. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nyɛkaia nɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fee Miriam yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, be ni nyɛjɛ Ijipt nyɛbaa lɛ.

english_verse: When you lend money to people, you are allowed to keep something of theirs as a guarantee that the money will be paid back. But you must not go into their house to get it.
translation_verse: “Kɛji ofa onaanyo ko nɔ ko lɛ, kaatiu lɛ kɛtee eshĩa mli koni oyahe nɔ ni ekɛbaato bo awaba lɛ;

english_verse: Wait outside, and they will bring out the item you have agreed on.
translation_verse: shi moŋ daamɔ agbo naa, ni mɔ ni okɛ nii lɛ efa lɛ lɛ kɛ nɔ ni ekɛtoɔ awaba lɛ baaje kpo ekɛbahã bo.

english_verse: Suppose someone is so poor that a coat is the only thing that can be offered as a guarantee on a loan. Don't keep the coat overnight.
translation_verse: Kɛji ohiafo ji lɛ lɛ kaahã ehebo lɛ hi oŋɔɔ ni obu kɛwɔ ni je tsɛre nɔ.

english_verse: Instead, give it back before sunset, so the owner can keep warm and sleep and ask the Lord to bless you. Then the Lord your God will notice that you have done the right thing. Poor People's Wages Moses said:
translation_verse: Kpalemɔ ohã lɛ kɛji hulu yaanyɔ shi, bɔ ni afee ni ohiafo lɛ ana ehebo lɛ ebu kɛwɔ koni eda bo shi; ni osane baasa Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: If you hire poor people to work for you, don't hold back their pay, whether they are Israelites or foreigners who live in your town.
translation_verse: “Kaawa apaafonyo ohiafo ni efĩ lɛ yi. Nyɛnyɛmi Israelnyo ni jio, gbɔi ni yɔɔ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ ateŋ eko ni jio, akawa lɛ yi.

english_verse: Pay them their wages at the end of each day, because they live in poverty and need the money to survive. If you don't pay them on time, they will complain about you to the Lord, and he will punish you. The Death Penalty Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Wo lɛ gbi lɛ nɔ apaa ni obɔ lɛ lɛ he nyɔmɔ dani hulu anyɔ shi , koni ekafo etsɛ Yehowa ewo bo, ni no tsɔ̃ esha ehã bo.

english_verse: Parents must not be put to death for crimes committed by their children, and children must not be put to death for crimes committed by their parents. Don't put anyone to death for someone else's crime. Don't Mistreat the Powerless Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Tsɛmɛi akagbo bii ayi gbele, ni bii hu akagbo tsɛmɛi ayi gbele; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ agbo yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ efɔŋ ni efee hewɔ.

english_verse: You were slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws. Leave Some of Your Harvest for the Poor Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Shi nyɛkaia akɛ aye nyɛ nyɔŋ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛje jɛi; no hewɔ ni miwoɔ nyɛ kitã nɛɛ koni nyɛye nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: If you forget to bring in a stack of harvested grain, don't go back in the field to get it. Leave it for the poor, including foreigners, orphans, and widows, and the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: “Kɛji okpa oŋmɔshinii, ni ohiɛ kpa ke kome nɔ yɛ ŋmɔ lɛŋ lɛ, kaaku osɛɛ oyawo; shi moŋ oshi ohã gbɔ kɛ awusã kɛ okulafo bɔ ni afee ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ajɔɔ oninenaa nitsumɔi fɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: When you harvest your olives, don't try to get them all for yourself, but leave some for the poor.
translation_verse: Kɛji otse omutso yibii sɛɛ lɛ, kaaku osɛɛ okpa niji lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ otserɛ nɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ; shi nomɛi ohã gbɔ kɛ awusã kɛ okulafo.

english_verse: And when you pick your grapes, go over the vines only once, then let the poor have what is left.
translation_verse: Kɛji otse owaintrom mli yibii sɛɛ lɛ, kaaye kpɛkpɛo yɛ trom lɛ mli dɔŋŋ; shi yibii ni eshwɛ kpɛkpɛo lɛ ohã gbɔ kɛ awusã kɛ okulafo.

english_verse: You lived in poverty as slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws.
translation_verse: Nyɛkaia akɛ nyɔji ji nyɛ yɛ Ijipt, ni no hewɔ ni miwoɔ nyɛ kitãi akɛ nyɛfee nɛkɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: Suppose you and someone else each accuse the other of doing something wrong, and you go to court, where the judges decide you are guilty. If your punishment is to be beaten with a whip, one of the judges will order you to lie down, and you will receive the number of lashes you deserve.
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ni eye fɔ lɛ sa yii lɛ, kojolɔ lɛ ahã abu lɛ shi koni ayi lɛ kpãa, yɛ lɛ kojolɔ lɛ ehiɛ, yɛ efɔŋ ni efee lɛ naa.

english_verse: Forty lashes is the most that you can be given, because more than that might make other Israelites think you are worthless. Don't Muzzle an Ox Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Kɛji efa aahu lɛ atswa lɛ kpãa nyɔŋmai ejwɛ; akateke nɔ, no lɛ ashwie onyɛmi Israelnyo lɛ hiɛ shi yɛ ohiɛ.

english_verse: Don't muzzle an ox while it is threshing grain. A Son for a Dead Brother Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Tsina ni gbɛlɛɔ abele lɛ akawo enaabu kotoku. Nɔ ni afee ahã nyɛmi ni egbo

english_verse: Suppose two brothers are living on the same property, when one of them dies without having a son to carry on his name. If this happens, his widow must not marry anyone outside the family. Instead, she must marry her late husband's brother, and their first son will be the legal son of the dead man.
translation_verse: Kromɔ binuu ni yoo nɛɛ aaafɔ lɛ, atsɔ̃ nuu ni egbo lɛ bi kɛ niyelɔ, bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ni egbo lɛ gbɛi akalaaje yɛ Israelbii ateŋ.

english_verse: But suppose the brother refuses to marry the widow. She must go to a meeting of the town leaders at the town gate and say, “My husband died without having a son to carry on his name. And my husband's brother refuses to marry me so I can have a son.”
translation_verse: Shi kɛji mɔ ni egbo lɛ nyɛminuu lɛ sumɔɔɔ akɛ eŋɔɔ enyɛmi lɛ ŋa lɛ, no lɛ enyɛminuu lɛ ŋa lɛ aya maŋ onukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ maŋ koi lɛ shi, ni eyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Miwu nyɛmi nuu lɛ sumɔɔɔ akɛ ekɛ mi awo shwie ahã enyɛmi nuu lɛ koni enyɛmi lɛ gbɛi akalaaje yɛ Israel; esumɔɔɔ akɛ etsuɔ wu nyɛminuu gbɛnaanii ehãa mi.’

english_verse: The leaders will call the living brother to the town gate and try to persuade him to marry the widow. But if he doesn't change his mind and marry her,
translation_verse: Kɛji eba lɛ nakai lɛ, maŋ onukpai lɛ atsɛ mɔ ni egbo lɛ nyɛmi nuu lɛ, koni amɛ kɛ lɛ awie he. Kɛji gbɔmɔ nɛɛ ma nɔ mi ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Misumɔɔɔ akɛ maŋɔ lɛ akɛ ŋa lɛ’,

english_verse: she must go over to him while the town leaders watch. She will pull off one of his sandals and spit in his face, while saying, “That's what happens to a man who won't help provide descendants for his dead brother.”
translation_verse: no lɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ nyɛmi nuu lɛ okulafo lɛ atsi abɛŋkɛ ewu lɛ nyɛminuu lɛ yɛ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ, koni ejie nuu lɛ tokota nane kome yɛ ehe, ni efɛ̃ lajɔ̃ eshwie nuu lɛ hiɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni sa nuu ni sumɔɔɔ akɛ esaa enyɛminuu we nɛ.’

english_verse: From then on, that man's family will be known as “the family of the man whose sandal was pulled off.” When Two Men Fight Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ni nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ abaatsɛ ewe yɛ Israel akɛ, ‘Mɔ ni ajie etokota we’. Mlai krokomɛi

english_verse: If two men are fighting, and the wife of one man tries to rescue her husband by grabbing the other man's private parts,
translation_verse: “Kɛji hii miinɔ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ kome ŋa tsi ebɛŋkɛ koni ebahere ewu lɛ yɛ enaanyo ni enine etsɔ̃ ewu lɛ nɔ dɛŋ, ni yoo nɛɛ kpã enine mli ekɛmɔ nuu kome lɛ nuutso lɛ,

english_verse: you must cut off her hand. Don't have any mercy. Be Honest in Business Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: afo yoo nɛɛ nine lɛ; akana yoo lɛ mɔbɔ ko kwraa.

english_verse: Don't try to cheat people by having two sets of weights or measures, one to get more when you are buying, and the other to give less when you are selling.
translation_verse: ni kaato susumɔ nii hu srɔtoi enyɔ yɛ shĩa, nɔ ni da kɛ nɔ ni edaaa.

english_verse: If you weigh and measure things honestly, the Lord your God will let you enjoy a long life in the land he is giving you.
translation_verse: Nyɛhãa nsɛnitɛ kɛ susumɔ nii lɛ ashɛa shishiishi koni nyɛwala sɛɛ atsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ;

english_verse: But the Lord is disgusted with anyone who cheats or is dishonest. Wipe Out Amalek Moses said:
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, miihi mɛi fɛɛ ni shishiuɔ mɔ.

english_verse: People of Israel, do you remember what the Amalekites did to you after you came out of Egypt?
translation_verse: “Nyɛkaia nɔ ni Amalekbii lɛ fee nyɛ yɛ gbɛteŋ be ni nyɛjɛ Ijipt nyɛbaa lɛ,

english_verse: You were tired, and they followed along behind, attacking those who could not keep up with the others. This showed that the Amalekites have no respect for God.
translation_verse: bɔ ni amɛyasheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛjɛ nyɛsɛɛgbɛ ni amɛtua nyɛ, be ni etɔ nyɛ ni nyɛtɔ biti lɛ, ni amɛgbegbee nyɛsɛɛbii fɛɛ ni egbɔjɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord your God will help you capture the land, and he will give you peace. But when that day comes, you must wipe out Amalek so completely that no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã nyɛhe ejɔ nyɛ yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi fɛɛ ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ adɛŋ lɛ, nyɛbulea Amalekbii lɛ ashishi kwraa koni akakai amɛ dɔŋŋ yɛ jeŋ. Nyɛhiɛ akakpaa nɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord is giving you the land, and soon you will conquer it, settle down,
translation_verse: “Kɛji oyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa kɛhãa bo akɛ onɔ lɛ nɔ, ni oŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni ohi nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: and plant crops. And when you begin harvesting each of your crops, the very first things you pick must be put in a basket. Take them to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: okɛ klɛŋklɛŋnii ni obaakpa, yɛ oŋmɔ mli yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa eŋɔ ehã bo lɛ nɔ lɛ, eko awo kɛntɛŋ mli koni okɛya he koome ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ.

english_verse: and tell the priest, “Long ago the Lord our God promised our ancestors that he would give us this land. And today, I thank him for keeping his promise and giving me a share of the land.”
translation_verse: Yaa osɔfo ni tsuɔ jɛi nii nakai be mli lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni oyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Miikɛɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, yɛ Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ akɛ mibashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wo wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ehe shi akɛ ekɛbaahã wɔ lɛ nɔ.’

english_verse: The priest will take the basket and set it in front of the Lord's altar.
translation_verse: “Kɛkɛ lɛ Osɔfo lɛ baahe kɛntɛŋ lɛ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ, koni ekɛma Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: Then, standing there in front of the place of worship, you must pray: My ancestor was homeless, an Aramean who went to live in Egypt. There were only a few in his family then, but they became great and powerful, a nation of many people.
translation_verse: No sɛɛ lɛ, okɛɛ, yɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ akɛ, ‘Aramnyo ni ebɔ ko ji mitsɛ; ekɛ mɛi fioo ko tee Ijipt, ni eyato gbɔ yɛ jɛi. Shi eshwiei ayi bafa, ni etsɔ̃ maŋ kpeteŋkple ni he wa yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: The Egyptians were cruel and had no pity on us. They mistreated our people and forced us into slavery.
translation_verse: Shi Ijiptbii lɛ hiɛ wɔ soisoi, ni amɛwa wɔ yi, ni amɛye wɔ nyɔŋ.

english_verse: We called out for help to you, the Lord God of our ancestors. You heard our cries; you knew we were in trouble and abused.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni wɔbolɔ wɔtsɛ Yehowa, wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ebo wɔ toi, ni ena bɔ ni ahaoɔ wɔ lɛ kɛ deŋme ni wɔgboɔ lɛ kɛ nyɔŋ ni ayeɔ wɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Then you terrified the Egyptians with your mighty miracles and rescued us from Egypt.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bakpɔ̃ wɔ yɛ Ijipt yɛ ehewalɛ kɛ enineshiwalɛ naa. Ehã naakpɛɛ kɛ gbeyei nibii ba, ni ekɛto okadi.

english_verse: You brought us here and gave us this land rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Ni ekɛ wɔ eba biɛ nɛɛ, ni ekɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ hã wɔ, shikpɔŋ ni ewo fɔ ni baa nii babaoo lɛ.

english_verse: Now, Lord, I bring to you the best of the crops that you have given me. After you say these things, place the basket in front of the Lord's altar and bow down to worship him.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, naa, mikɛ shikpɔŋ ni bo, Yehowa, okɛhã mi lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ŋmɔshi nii ni mikpa lɛ eko eba.’ “Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ okɛ kɛntɛŋ lɛ ama Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ, ni oja yɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ, lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: Then you and your family must celebrate by eating a meal at the place of worship to thank the Lord your God for giving you such a good harvest. And remember to invite the Levites and the foreigners who live in your town. Ten Percent of the Harvest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Onya nibii kpakpai fɛɛ ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eduro bo lɛ he, bo kɛ owe lɛ mli bii kɛ Levibii kɛ gbɔi ni kɛ bo yɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Every year you are to give ten percent of your harvest to the Lord. But every third year, this ten percent must be given to the poor who live in your town, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows. That way, they will have enough to eat.
translation_verse: “Afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ, ni ji mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekomekome hãmɔ afi lɛ, kɛji okɛ oŋmɔshi nii mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ ehã Levibii lɛ kɛ gbɔi lɛ kɛ awusãi lɛ kɛ okulafoi lɛ ogbe naa, koni amɛna nii amɛye yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ,

english_verse: Then you must pray: Our Lord and our God, you have said that ten percent of my harvest is sacred. I have obeyed your command and given this to the poor, including the Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: yaakɛɛ yɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ akɛ, ‘Mijie nii krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ minii mli yɛ miwe lɛ, ni mikɛhã Levibii kɛ gbɔi kɛ awusãi kɛ okulafoi bɔ ni owo mi shi akɛ mifee lɛ. Mitɔ̃ko okitãi lɛ eko nɔ, ni mihiɛ hu kpako kitã ko nɔ.

english_verse: I have not eaten any of this sacred food while I was in mourning; in fact, I never touched it when I was unclean. And none of it has been offered as a sacrifice to the spirits of the dead. I have done everything exactly as you commanded.
translation_verse: Miyeko nii nɛɛ ni mijie lɛ eko yɛ mikɔmɔyeli beiaŋ lɛ, mifiteko nii lɛ eko be ni mibule mihe lɛ, mikɛ eko hu eshãko afɔle mihãko gbonyo ko. Miye Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbee nɔ, ni mifee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni owo mi shi akɛ mifee lɛ.
