english_verse: Our Lord, look down from your temple in heaven and bless us and our land. You promised our ancestors that you would give us this land rich with milk and honey, and you have kept your promise. The Lord Is Your God, and You Are His People Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Jɛɛ oshihilɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ, ni okwɛ koni ojɔɔ omaŋ Israel kɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii ni okɛhã wɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni okã wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kitã lɛ.’ Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ webii

english_verse: Today the Lord your God has commanded you to obey these laws and teachings with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: “Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, miiwo bo kitã akɛ oye ekpɔi kɛ emlai lɛ anɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, kwɛmɔ jogbaŋŋ koni okɛ otsui kɛ onyɛmɔ fɛɛ aye nɔ.

english_verse: In response, you have agreed that the Lord will be your God, that you will obey all his laws and teachings, and that you will listen when he speaks to you.
translation_verse: Ogba mli kpoo ŋmɛnɛ okɛɛ Yehowa akɛ lɛ ji oNyɔŋmɔ, ni obaaba ojeŋ bɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ, ni obaaye ekpɔi lɛ kɛ ekitãi lɛ kɛ emlai lɛ anɔ, ni obaabo lɛ toi.

english_verse: Since you have agreed to obey the Lord, he has agreed that you will be his people and that you will belong to him, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Yehowa hu egba mli kpoo ekɛɛ bo, ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ ji bo tamɔ bɔ ni ewo bo shi lɛ, ni eebi bo koni oye ekitãi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ,

english_verse: The Lord created all nations, but he will make you more famous than any of them, and you will receive more praise and honor. You will belong only to the Lord your God, just as he promised.
translation_verse: koni yɛ yijiemɔ kɛ gbɛi kɛ anunyam gbɛfaŋ lɛ, Israel agbojee akwɔ fe maji fɛɛ agbojee yɛ je lɛ mli. Oootsɔ̃ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ bɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: Moses stood together with the leaders and told the people of Israel: Obey all the laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ Mose kpã ewo maŋbii lɛ atoiŋ, yɛ Israel maŋ onukpai lɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyea kitãi fɛɛ ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: At this same place, build an altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God. But don't use stones that have been cut with iron tools.
translation_verse: Nyɛmaa afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi nyɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ tɛi ni akɛ dade naa esako amɛhe dã,

english_verse: Look for stones that can be used without being cut. Then offer sacrifices to please the Lord, burning them completely on the altar.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ afɔleshãa latɛ fɛɛ afɔleshãa latɛ ni amaa akɛhã Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, akɛ tɛi ni dade naa esako he ama. Nyɛshãa shãa afɔlei yɛ nɔ nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Next, offer sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing, and serve the meat at a sacred meal where you will celebrate in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛshãa shidaa afɔlei lɛ hu yɛ jɛi, ni nyɛyea nii yɛ jɛi koni nyɛnyaa yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ.

english_verse: Moses stood together with the priests and said, “Israel, be quiet and listen to me! Today you have become the people of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ, yɛ osɔfoi ni ji Levibii lɛ ahiɛ, akɛ, “Israelbii, nyɛfea diŋŋ ni nyɛboa toi. Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ nyɛtsɔ̃ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ maŋ;

english_verse: So you must obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you.”
translation_verse: no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛboa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi, ni nyɛyea ekitãi kɛ ekpɔi ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ nɔ.” Toigbele he Loomɔi

english_verse: That same day, Moses gave them the following instructions:
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ Mose fã Israelbii lɛ akɛ,

english_verse: Today I am giving you the laws and teachings of the Lord your God. Always obey them, and the Lord will make Israel the most famous and important nation on earth, and he will bless you in many ways.
translation_verse: Obaana Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, dɛŋ jɔɔmɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ, ni jɔɔmɔi nɛɛ aaanina bo yɛ he fɛɛ he kɛji ooobo Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbee toi.

english_verse: The Lord will make your businesses and your farms successful.
translation_verse: “Aaajɔɔ bo yɛ maŋ, ni aaajɔɔ bo yɛ ŋmɔshi hu.

english_verse: You will have many children. You will harvest large crops, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats will produce many young.
translation_verse: “Aaajɔɔ omusuŋ bii kɛ oŋmɔshi nibaanii kɛ oshĩaŋ kooloi abii kɛ otoi kɛ otsinai abii fɛɛ.

english_verse: You will have plenty of bread to eat.
translation_verse: “Aaajɔɔ okɛntɛŋ ni okɛyakpaa nii lɛ kɛ otsese hu.

english_verse: The Lord will make you successful in your daily work.
translation_verse: “Aaajɔɔ oyaa kɛ obaa mli fɛɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will help you defeat your enemies and make them scatter in all directions.
translation_verse: “Yehowa aaahã oplene ohenyɛlɔi ni aaabatua bo. Amɛaanyiɛ gbɛ kome nɔ kɛaabatua bo, shi amɛaatsɔ̃ gbɛi kpawo nɔ amɛaajo foi kɛaaje ohiɛ.

english_verse: The Lord your God is giving you the land, and he will make sure you are successful in everything you do. Your harvests will be so large that your storehouses will be full.
translation_verse: “Yehowa aaajɔɔ onitsumɔ, ni eeehã oboŋoi ayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni okɛ onine taa he aaashwere; ni eeejɔɔ bo yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛhãa bo lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: If you follow and obey the Lord, he will make you his own special people, just as he promised.
translation_verse: “Yehowa aaaŋɔ bo, Israel, akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ tamɔ bɔ ni ekã bo kitã lɛ, kɛji oye Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitãi lɛ anɔ, ni oba ojeŋ bɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will know that you belong to the Lord, and they will be afraid of you.
translation_verse: No lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ fɛɛ aaana akɛ Yehowa kɛ egbɛi ewo bo akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ, ni amɛbaashe bo gbeyei.

english_verse: The Lord will give you a lot of children and make sure that your animals give birth to many young. The Lord promised your ancestors that this land would be yours, and he will make it produce large crops for you.
translation_verse: Yehowa baahã oshwere babaoo. Omusuŋ bii kɛ okooloi abii kɛ oŋmɔshi nibaanii fɛɛ aaashwere yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni ewo otsɛmɛi lɛ he shi akɛ ekɛbaahã bo lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will open the storehouses of the skies where he keeps the rain, and he will send rain on your land at just the right times. He will make you successful in everything you do. You will have plenty of money to lend to other nations, but you won't need to borrow any yourself.
translation_verse: Yehowa aaagbele eŋwɛi niikpakpai anaa ehã bo; eeehã nu anɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ be ni sa mli; eeejɔɔ onine naa nitsumɔi fɛɛ nɔ; ooona nii, ni ooofala maji pii nii, shi bo lɛ ofaŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ maŋ ko dɛŋ.

english_verse: and no one will disturb the birds and wild animals while they eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Ogbonyo aaatsɔ̃ niyenii ahã ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi, ni onaŋ mɔ ko po ashwie amɛ kɛje ohe.

english_verse: Israel, today I am giving you the laws and teachings of the Lord your God. And if you don't obey them all, he will put many curses on you.
translation_verse: “Shi kɛji aaaba mli akɛ obooo Yehowa toi ni ojwɛŋŋ nɔ ni oye ekitãi kɛ ekpɔi fɛɛ ni miwoɔ bo ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ nɛkɛ loomɔi nɛɛ miimɛ bo:

english_verse: Your businesses and farms will fail.
translation_verse: “Aaalomɔ bo yɛ maŋ, ni aaalomɔ bo yɛ ŋmɔshi hu.

english_verse: You won't have enough bread to eat.
translation_verse: “Aaalomɔ okɛntɛŋ kɛ otsese hu.

english_verse: The Lord will make you fail in everything you do.
translation_verse: “Aaalomɔ bo yɛ oyaa mli, ni aaalomɔ bo yɛ obaa mli hu.

english_verse: No matter what you try to accomplish, the Lord will confuse you, and you will feel his anger. You won't last long, and you may even meet with disaster, all because you rejected the Lord.
translation_verse: “Yehowa aaalomɔ bo, ni eeehã ojijaa, ni onijiaŋ aaaje wui yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooofee mli kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni aaafite bo, ni ohiɛ aaakpãtã oya mli yɛ nibii fɔ̃ji ni ofee lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ okwa Yehowa.

english_verse: He will send dust and sandstorms instead of rain, and you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Yehowa aaahã shia kɛ mlu atsɔ̃ onu ni aaanɛ ahã bo; amɛaajɛ ŋwɛi amɛbayi bo yɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ohiɛ aaakpãtã.

english_verse: The Lord will let you be defeated by your enemies, and you will scatter in all directions. You will be a horrible sight for the other nations to see,
translation_verse: “Yehowa aaahã henyɛlɔi aye onɔ. Ooonyiɛ gbɛ kome nɔ kɛyatua amɛ; shi gbɛi kpawo nɔ oootsɔ̃ ojo foi kɛje amɛhiɛ. Osane lɛ baahã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɔyelihei fɛɛ atsui afã.

english_verse: The Lord will make you suffer with diseases that will cause oozing sores or crusty itchy patches on your skin or boils like the ones that are common in Egypt. And there will be no cure for you!
translation_verse: Yehowa aaahã asanei ni ye Ijiptbii lɛ eko kɛ fala kɛ abuasha kɛ kpla ni ehiii tsamɔ aye bo.

english_verse: You will become insane and go blind. The Lord will make you so confused,
translation_verse: Yehowa aaahã oye sɛkɛ, ni oooshwila, ni oyiŋ baakã bo.

english_verse: that even in bright sunshine you will have to feel your way around like a blind person, who cannot tell day from night. For the rest of your life, people will beat and rob you, and no one will be able to stop them.
translation_verse: Ooogbugbuu shi shwane fintiŋŋ tamɔ shwilafo ni yɔɔ duŋ mli be fɛɛ be. Obaatsɔ ogbutsɛ, ni onɔ ko nɔ ko kwraa shwereŋ, ni aaahi bo nyɔŋyeli kɛ ojotswaa sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ daa nɛɛ, ni onaŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko ni aaahere bo.

english_verse: Your cattle will be killed while you watch, but you won't get to eat any of the meat. Your donkeys and sheep will be stolen from you, and no one will be around to force your enemies to give them back.
translation_verse: Ookwɛ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni aaamɔ otsina agbe, shi onaŋ eloo lɛ eko oye, ni ookwɛ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni aaamɔ oteji akranaŋ naa kɛya, ni akpaleŋ lɛ abahaŋ bo dɔŋŋ. Abaahã ohenyɛlɔi abamɔmɔ otoi kɛya, ni onaŋ mɔ ko abahere bo.

english_verse: Your sons and daughters will be dragged off to a foreign country, while you stand there helpless. And even if you watch for them until you go blind, you will never see them again.
translation_verse: Abaaŋɔ obihii kɛ obiyei akɛ nomii ahã mɛi kpɔ̃ji be mli ni oona kɛ ohiŋmɛi nɔŋŋ, ni obaakwɛ amɛsɛɛkuu gbɛ kɛ tɔlɛ daa gbi; shi onyɛŋ he nɔ ko ofee.

english_verse: You will work hard on your farms, but everything you harvest will be eaten by foreigners, who will mistreat you and abuse you for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Maŋsɛɛ maŋ ko ni oleee kwrakwra aaaba ebaloo oŋmɔshi nibaanii kɛ nii ni otsu oto fɛɛ kɛya eyaye. Yi sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ aaawa bo, ni shi sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ aaashwishwia bo daa nɛɛ,

english_verse: What you see will be so horrible that you will go insane,
translation_verse: ni ohiɛnaanɔ nii ni ooona lɛ aaaye bo sɛkɛ.

english_verse: and the Lord will punish you from head to toe with boils that never heal.
translation_verse: Yehowa aaahã asanei ni anaa jaraa ni ehiii tsamɔ atsɛ̃rɛ onakutsei anaa kɛ oshuɔji ahe; ebaatsɛ̃rɛ kɛjɛ oyiteŋ aahu kɛyashi onaneshi.

english_verse: The Lord will let you and your king be taken captive to a country that you and your ancestors have never even heard of, and there you will have to worship idols made of wood and stone.
translation_verse: “Yehowa aaakpala bo kɛ omaŋtsɛ ni oto ohã ohe lɛ fɛɛ kɛaatee maŋsɛɛ maŋ ko ni bo loo otsɛmɛi leee mli; jɛi oooyaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni akɛ tso kɛ tɛ fee yɛ.

english_verse: People of nearby countries will shudder when they see your terrible troubles, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: Oootsɔ̃ gbeyei nɔ kɛ naakpɛɛ nɔ ni akɛbaabu abɛ yɛ maji amli he ni Yehowa kɛ bo aaatee lɛ.

english_verse: You will plant a lot of seed, but gather a small harvest, because locusts will eat your crops.
translation_verse: “Okɛ dumɔ wui babaoo baaya oyadu yɛ ŋmɔ mli, shi nii fioo pɛ obaana okpa kɛba, ejaakɛ baalabii aaaye tsiimɔ.

english_verse: You will plant vineyards and work hard at taking care of them, but you won't gather any grapes, much less get any wine, because the vines themselves will be eaten by worms.
translation_verse: Ooofee waintromi, ni obaakura amɛ, shi onaŋ amɛmli wain lɛ eko onu lɛ, onaŋ amɛmli yibii lɛ eko hu oye, ejaakɛ gɔgɔmii aaaye.

english_verse: Even if your olive trees grow everywhere in your country, the olives will fall off before they are ready, and there won't be enough olive oil for combing your hair.
translation_verse: Obaahi mutsei yɛ okpokpai lɛ fɛɛ anɔ nɛ, shi onaŋ mutso mu okpa, ejaakɛ omutsei lɛ ayibii lɛ aaakpala be mli ni amɛsrako.

english_verse: Even your children will be taken as prisoners of war.
translation_verse: Ooofɔ bihii kɛ biyei nɛ, shi ohiŋ bi, ejaakɛ aaaŋɔ amɛ fɛɛ nom.

english_verse: Locusts will eat your crops and strip your trees of leaves and fruit.
translation_verse: Otsei lɛ kɛ oŋmɔshi nibaanii lɛ baalabii aaaye fɛɛ.

english_verse: Foreigners in your towns will become wealthy and powerful, while you become poor and powerless.
translation_verse: “Gbɔ ni kɛ bo yɔɔ lɛ agbojee aaakwɔ fe ogbojee, shi bo lɛ ogbojee lɛ aaaba shi daa.

english_verse: You will be so short of money that you will have to borrow from those foreigners. They will be the leaders in the community, and you will be the followers. More Curses for Disobedience Moses said:
translation_verse: Lɛ lɛ ebaana nii efa bo, shi bo lɛ onaŋ nɔ ko ofa lɛ; eeetsɔ̃ yitso, ni bo lɛ oootsɔ̃ lei.

english_verse: Israel, if you don't obey the laws and teachings that the Lord your God is giving you, he will send these curses to chase, attack, and destroy you.
translation_verse: “Naa, nɛkɛ loomɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ aaaba onɔ, ni amɛaanyiɛ osɛɛ, ni amɛaanina bo yɛ hei fɛɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ohiɛ aaakpãtã, ejaakɛ obooo Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbee toi, ni oyeee ekitãi ni ewo bo lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: If the Lord makes you wealthy, but you don't joyfully worship and honor him,
translation_verse: “Ejaakɛ yɛ nii ni Yehowa jɔɔmɔ hã ona babaoo lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, okɛ miishɛɛ kɛ tsuijurɔ jaaa Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: he will send enemies to attack you and make you their slaves. Then you will live in poverty with nothing to eat, drink, or wear, and your owners will work you to death.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, okɛ hɔmɔ kɛ kumai kɛ yayai kɛ hiamɔ yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli aaasɔmɔ ohenyɛlɔi ni Yehowa baahã abatua bo lɛ. Henyɛlɔi nɛɛ kɛ dade apã aaawo okuɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeekpãtã ohiɛ.

english_verse: Foreigners who speak a strange language will be sent to attack you without warning, just like an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ maŋ ko aaajɛ shɔŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, kɛaajɛ je lɛ naagbeehe, abatua bo trukaa, shwim tamɔ okropɔŋ filikiɔ, maŋ ko ni onuuu amɛwiemɔ,

english_verse: They won't show any mercy, and they will have no respect for old people or pity for children.
translation_verse: maŋ ni hiɛ yɔɔ kramakrama; amɛhiɛ eshwieee onukpa hiɛiaŋ lɛ, amɛnaaa gbekɛ mɔbɔ hu.

english_verse: They will take your cattle, sheep, goats, grain, wine, and olive oil, then leave you to starve.
translation_verse: Amɛbaaye otsinai abii kɛ oŋmɔshi nibaanii kɛyaashi aaakpãtã ohiɛ; amɛshiŋ abele loo wain loo mu loo otsinabii loo otoobii lɛ eko amɛhaŋ bo kɛyaashi amɛaakpãtã ohiɛ.

english_verse: All over the land that the Lord your God gave you, the enemy army will surround your towns. You may feel safe inside your town walls, but the enemy will tear them down,
translation_verse: Amɛaasa oyi amɛwo omaji lɛ fɛɛ amli kɛyashi omaji lɛ ahe gbogboi grɔŋŋi ni awaje, ni okɛ ohiɛ efɔ̃ nɔ lɛ, amɛaakumɔ ogbogboi lɛ amɛshwie shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa bo lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: while you wait in horror. Finally, you will get so hungry that you will eat the sons and daughters that the Lord gave you.
translation_verse: “Hiamɔ ni ohenyɛlɔi aaahã ahia bo, be mli ni asa oyi lɛ hewɔ lɛ oooye bo diɛŋtsɛ omusuŋbii, obihii kɛ obiyei, ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã bo lɛ aloo.

english_verse: Because of hunger, a man who had been gentle and kind will eat his own children and refuse to share the meal with his brother or wife or with his other children.
translation_verse: bɔ sɔŋŋ ni ehaŋ amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko abi lɛ loo ni eyeɔ lɛ eko, ejaakɛ oyi ni asa kɛ fimɔ ni ohenyɛlɔ ehã efi bo yɛ omaji fɛɛ amli hewɔ lɛ, obɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: A woman may have grown up in such luxury that she never had to put a foot on the ground. But times will be so bad that she will secretly eat both her newborn baby and the afterbirth, without sharing any with her husband or her other children. Disobedience Brings Destruction Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ebaaye lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebi ni efɔ eŋmɔŋ sɛɛnii kɛ emusuŋ bii nigii, ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ he esɛ̃ yɛ omaji lɛ ayi ni ohenyɛlɔ esa kɛ fimɔ ni efi bo lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: You must obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Because if you don't respect the Lord,
translation_verse: “Kɛji okwɛɛɛ ni ahi koni oye nɛkɛ mlai ni aŋma yɛ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ anɔ, ni oooshe Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛi ni yɔɔ nyam kɛ gbeyei fɛɛ lɛ gbeyei lɛ,

english_verse: he will punish you and your descendants with incurable diseases,
translation_verse: no lɛ Yehowa aaahã helai ni anaa wa abaye bo kɛ oshwiei, helai ni anaa wa, asaŋ ni amɛsɛɛ efooo.

english_verse: Remember! If the Lord decides to destroy your nation, he can use any disease or disaster, not just the ones written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: Hela fɛɛ hela kɛ haomɔ fɛɛ haomɔ hu ni atsĩko tã yɛ nɛkɛ Mla Wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ, Yehowa aaahã eko aye bo kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ohiɛ aaakpãtã.

english_verse: There are as many of you now as the stars in the sky, but if you disobey the Lord your God, only a few of you will be left.
translation_verse: Tsɛbelɛ sa lɛ nyɛyi fa tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋulamii, shi nyɛyi fioo kɛkɛ aaashwɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛbooo Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi.

english_verse: The Lord is happy to make you successful and to help your nation grow while you conquer the land. But if you disobey him, he will be just as happy to pull you up by your roots.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa nya he akɛ efee nyɛ ejurɔ koni ehã nyɛyi afa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ eeenya he akɛ ekpãtã nyɛhiɛ koni efite nyɛ, ni aaashwie nyɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Those of you that survive will be scattered to every nation on earth, and you will have to worship stone and wood idols that never helped you or your ancestors.
translation_verse: “Ni Yehowa aaagbɛ nyɛ ashwã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ, kɛjɛ je lɛ naagbeehe kome kɛyashi naagbeehe kome hu, ni nyɛbaaya nyɛyaja tso kɛ tɛ nyɔŋmɔi ni nyɛ loo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ leee.

english_verse: You will be restless—always longing for home, but never able to return.
translation_verse: Onaŋ hejɔlɛ, ni asaŋ onaŋ nanemaahe hu yɛ maji nɛɛ ateŋ; aaahã otsui afã, ni ooofee yeyeeye kɛ tsuiyeli yɛ jɛi;

english_verse: Each morning you will wake up to such terrible sights that you will say, “I wish it were night!” But at night you will be terrified and say, “I wish it were day!”
translation_verse: Leebi lɛ obaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mina ni je ena’, ni gbɛkɛ lɛ obaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mina ni je etsɛre’. Obaakɛɛ nɛkɛ yɛ ŋmiŋmi ni emɔ bo kɛ ohiɛnaanɔ nii ni onaa lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: I told you never to go back to Egypt. But now the Lord himself will load you on ships and send you back. Then you will even try to sell yourselves as slaves, but no one will be interested.
translation_verse: Ni Yehowa kɛ nyɛ aaawo lɛji amli kɛaaya Ijipt ekoŋŋ, tsɛbelɛ eji gbɛ ko ni ewo nyɛ he shi akɛ nyɛfaŋ dɔŋŋ; ni nyɛaahɔ̃hɔ̃ɔ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe nyɛhã nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ akɛ nyɔji hii kɛ nyɔji yei, shi mɔ ko mɔ ko heŋ nyɛ tete.”

english_verse: So Moses finished telling the Israelites what they had to do in order to keep the agreement the Lord was making with them in Moab, which was in addition to the one the Lord had made with them at Mount Sinai. The Third Speech: Israel Must Keep Its Agreement with the Lord The Lord Is Your God
translation_verse: Kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ ekɛ Israelbii lɛ akpãŋ yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli wiemɔi nɛ; esoro kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Israelbii kpãŋ yɛ Horeb Gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ.

english_verse: When we first camped here, King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan attacked, but we defeated them.
translation_verse: Ni be ni nyɛbashɛ biɛ lɛ, Heshbon Maŋtsɛ Sihon kɛ Bashan Maŋtsɛ Og fã ta kɛba amɛkɛ wɔ bawu; shi wɔye amɛnɔ kunim,

english_verse: Then we captured their land and divided it among the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh. Keep the Agreement Moses said:
translation_verse: ni wɔŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni wɔjara shikpɔŋ lɛ wɔhã Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Manasebii akutso lɛ fã kome akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord has made an agreement with you, and if you keep your part, you will be successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛjwɛŋa kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ anɔ koni nyɛye nɔ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛshwere yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: When we lived in Egypt, you saw the Egyptians worship disgusting idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold. Then as we traveled through other nations, you saw those people worship other disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Nyɛna maji nɛɛ amusubɔɔ nibii ni ji amɛmãgãi ni akɛ tso kɛ tɛ kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika fee ni amɛyɔɔ yɛ amɛteŋ lɛ.

english_verse: So make sure that everyone in your tribe remains faithful to the Lord and never starts worshiping gods of other nations. If even one of you worships idols, you will be like the root of a plant that produces bitter, poisonous fruit.
translation_verse: Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ koni nyɛteŋ nuu ko loo yoo ko loo weku ko loo akutso ko yiŋ akatsɔ̃ ŋmɛnɛ ni ekpale yɛ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ, ni etee eyaja nakai maji lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ; no lɛ nakai mɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ tso shishifã ni woɔ tsoyibii ni joɔ kɛ emli ebɔɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ.

english_verse: You may be an Israelite and know all about the Lord's agreement with us, but he won't bless you if you rebel against him. You may think you can get away with it, but you will cause the rest of Israel to be punished along with you.
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ baahã ehe tsui kɛji enu kitã ni ji kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ, ni ebaakɛɛ ehe akɛ, ‘Mikpliŋ mitsui kɛmiifee nɔ ni mi misumɔɔ moŋ nɛ, kɛ̃lɛ mibaye mihe.’ Enɛ baahã mɔ kpakpa kɛ mɔ fɔŋ hu fɛɛ hiɛ akpãtã.

english_verse: The Lord will be furious, and instead of forgiving you, he will separate you from the other tribes. Then he will destroy you, by piling on you all the curses in The Book of God's Law, and you will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ ehiɛ aaaka lɛ dikadika yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ amli, yɛ nɛkɛ kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ mli loomɔi ni yɔɔ Mla Wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ anaa.

english_verse: The Lord will strike your country with diseases and disasters. Your descendants and foreigners from distant countries will see that your land
translation_verse: “Wɔsɛɛ yinɔbii, ni ji nyɛshwiei ni aaaba yɛ nyɛsɛɛ lɛ, kɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji ni aaajɛ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ aaawie he kɛji amɛna haomɔi kɛ helai ni Yehowa ehã eba nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: has become a scorching desert of salt and sulfur, where nothing is planted, nothing sprouts, and nothing grows. It will be as lifeless as the land around the cities of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, after the Lord became angry and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Amɛaana bɔ ni swɔɔ kɛ ŋoo egbe shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ, ni ehiii enɔ nidumɔ, ni ebaaa nii, ni jwɛi tete ekwɛ̃ɛɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ. Amɛaana akɛ efite tamɔ Sodom kɛ Gomora kɛ Adama kɛ Zeboim maji lɛ ni Yehowa kpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ emlifu kɛ emlila naa lɛ.

english_verse: People from other nations will ask, “Why did the Lord destroy this country? Why was he so furious?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ majimaji fɛɛ aaabi akɛ, ‘Mɛni ba ni Yehowa fee shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɛkɛ nɛɛ? Mɛni kɛ mlifu ni naa wa nɛkɛ ba?’

english_verse: And they will be given this answer: Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, but after he brought them out of Egypt and made an agreement with them, they rejected the agreement
translation_verse: Hetoo ni mɛi aaahã ji akɛ, ‘Ejɛ kwamɔ ni amɛkwa kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa, amɛtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ amɛ kpãŋ be mli ni eyakpɔ̃ amɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: and decided to worship gods that had never helped them. The Lord had forbidden Israel to worship these gods,
translation_verse: Amɛtee ni amɛyajajaa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi moŋ, ni amɛsɔmɔ amɛ, nyɔŋmɔi ni amɛleee, asaŋ ni Yehowa ewo amɛ kitã akɛ amɛkaja amɛ lɛ.

english_verse: and so he became furious and punished the land with all the curses in The Book of God's Law. Then he pulled up Israel by the roots and tossed them into a foreign country, where they still are today.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa gri, ni efã amɛ yɛ emlifu kɛ emlila lɛ naa, ni eshɛrɛ amɛ eshwie maŋsɛɛ shikpɔŋ ko nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ.’

english_verse: The Lord our God hasn't explained the present or the future, but he has commanded us to obey the laws he gave to us and our descendants.
translation_verse: “Teemɔŋ nibii lɛ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, koome nɔ ni; shi kɛji ajie nɔ ko kpo atsɔ̃ɔ pɛ, nɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ wɔ kɛ wɔbii anɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ, bɔ ni afee ni wɔye mla nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ kwa nɔ.”

english_verse: I have told you everything the Lord your God will do for you, and I've also told you the curses he will put on you if you reject him. He will scatter you in faraway countries, but when you realize that he is punishing you,
translation_verse: “Mikɛ saji nɛɛ ni ji jɔɔmɔ kɛ loomɔ miishwie nyɛhiɛ; kɛ ena eba nyɛnɔ beiaŋ ni nyɛyɔɔ maji anɔ fɛɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eshwie nyɛ kɛtee lɛ, ni nyɛaakai nɔ ni mikɛɛ nyɛfee lɛ,

english_verse: return to him with all your heart and soul and start obeying the commands I have given to you today.
translation_verse: ni nyɛ kɛ nyɛbii nyɛaakpale kɛba Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛtsuii kɛ nyɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ aaaye egbee nɔ, bɔ ni miwo nyɛ kitã ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ akɛ nyɛfee lɛ,

english_verse: Then he will stop punishing you and treat you with kindness. He may have scattered you to the farthest countries on earth, but he will bring you back
translation_verse: Nyɛteŋ mɛi ni eeeshɛrɛ amɛ ashwie je lɛ mli naagbeehei tete po lɛ, Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaabaŋɔ amɛ kɛaaje jɛi kɛaaba.

english_verse: to the land that had belonged to your ancestors and make you even more successful and powerful than they ever were.
translation_verse: Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ aaaba nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni nyɛbaŋɔ. Yehowa aaahã nyɛshwere, ni nyɛyi aaafa hu fe nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ.

english_verse: You and your descendants are stubborn, but the Lord will make you willing to obey him and love him with all your heart and soul, and you will enjoy a long life.
translation_verse: Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei hu atsake nyɛtsui bɔ ni afee ni nyɛkɛ nyɛtsui kɛ nyɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ asumɔ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, koni nyɛyi ana wala.

english_verse: Then the Lord your God will remove the curses from you and put them on those enemies who hate and attack you.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaahã nɛkɛ loomɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ abashwie nyɛhenyɛlɔi kɛ nyɛhetsɛ̃lɔi ni waa nyɛ yi lɛ anɔ;

english_verse: You will again obey the laws and teachings of the Lord,
translation_verse: ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛaaku sɛɛ nyɛbo Yehowa toi, ni nyɛaaye ekitãi fɛɛ ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: and he will bless you with many children, large herds and flocks, and abundant crops. The Lord will be happy to do good things for you, just as he did for your ancestors.
translation_verse: Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaahã nyɛnine naa nitsumɔi fɛɛ ashwere, ni nyɛmusuŋ bii kɛ nyɛtsinai abii kɛ nyɛŋmɔshi nibaanii fɛɛ hu ashwere babaoo ahã nyɛ; ejaakɛ Yehowa aaana nyɛhe miishɛɛ ni eeehã nyɛshwere ekoŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni ena nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ahe tsuijurɔ lɛ.

english_verse: But you must decide once and for all to worship him with all your heart and soul and to obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Choose Life, Not Death Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ebaafee nakai kɛji nyɛaabo Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi, ni nyɛaaye ekitãi lɛ kɛ ekpɔi lɛ ni aŋma yɛ nɛkɛ Mla Wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛaakpale kɛ nyɛtsui kɛ nyɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ kɛaaba Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You know God's laws, and it isn't impossible to obey them.
translation_verse: “Kitã ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ, ejeee nɔ ko ni wa tsɔ̃ hã nyɛ, ni ebɛ shɔŋŋ hu.

english_verse: His commands aren't in heaven, so you can't excuse yourselves by saying, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are in heaven, and no one can go up to get them, then bring them down and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Jeee ŋwɛi eyɔɔ ni no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘namɔ aaakwɔ kɛya ŋwɛi ahã wɔ koni eyaŋɔ ekɛbahã wɔ, ni wɔnu ni wɔye nɔ?’

english_verse: And you can't say, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are across the sea, and someone must go across, then bring them back and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Ni jeee ŋshɔ sɛɛ hu eyɔɔ ni nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘namɔ aaafo ŋshɔ koni eyaŋɔ ekɛbahã wɔ, ni wɔnu ni wɔye nɔ?’

english_verse: No, these commands are nearby and you know them by heart. All you have to do is obey!
translation_verse: Dabida, wiemɔ lɛ bɛŋkɛ nyɛ kpaakpa; eyɛ nyɛdaaŋ ni eyɛ nyɛtsuii amli hu, no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛaanyɛ nɔ nyɛye aahu.

english_verse: Today I am giving you a choice. You can choose life and success or death and disaster.
translation_verse: “Naa, ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ, mikɛ wala kɛ gbele kɛ ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋ fɛɛ miishwie nyɛhiɛ.

english_verse: Now I call the sky and the earth to be witnesses that I am offering you this choice. Will you choose for the Lord to make you prosperous and give you a long life? Or will he put you under a curse and kill you? Choose life!
translation_verse: Miitsɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ koni amɛbaye he odase akɛ mikɛ wala kɛ gbele, kɛ jɔɔmɔ kɛ loomɔ hu eshwie nyɛhiɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɔa wala bɔ ni afee ni nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei fɛɛ ayi ana wala.

english_verse: Be completely faithful to the Lord your God, love him, and do whatever he tells you. The Lord is the only one who can give life, and he will let you live a long time in the land that he promised to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Nyɛsumɔa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛboa lɛ toi, ni nyɛkpɛtɛa lɛ. Ejaakɛ no aaahã nyɛyi ana wala ni nyɛtsɛ yɛ jeŋ koni nyɛhi shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa kã nyɛtsɛmɛi Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob he kitã akɛ ekɛaahã amɛ lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: Moses again spoke to the whole nation of Israel:
translation_verse: Mose tee nɔ ekɛ Israelbii lɛ wie,

english_verse: Be brave and strong! Don't be afraid of the nations on the other side of the Jordan. The Lord your God will always be at your side, and he will never abandon you.
translation_verse: Nyɛhe awaa, ni nyɛfea ekãa; nyɛkashea gbeyei lɛ, nyɛtsui akafãa hu yɛ amɛhewɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ji mɔ ni kɛ nyɛ nyiɛ kɛyaa lɛ; eshiŋ nyɛ, ni ekwaŋ nyɛ hu.”

english_verse: Then Moses called Joshua up in front of the crowd and said: Joshua, be brave and strong as you lead these people into their land. The Lord made a promise long ago to Israel's ancestors that this land would someday belong to Israel. That time has now come, and you must divide up the land among the people.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsɛ Yoshua kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ yɛ Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ akɛ, “Ohe awa, ni ofee ekãa, ejaakɛ bo okɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ baaya shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa ewo amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ he shi akɛ ekɛbaahã amɛ lɛ nɔ, ni bo nɔŋŋ oooja shikpɔŋ lɛ ohã amɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will lead you into the land. He will always be with you and help you, so don't ever be afraid of your enemies. Read These Laws
translation_verse: Yehowa ji mɔ ni aaanyiɛ ohiɛ kɛya; ni ekɛ bo aaahi shi; ehaŋ onine anyɛ shi lɛ, eshiŋ bo hu. Kaashe gbeyei, ni otsui akafã hu.” Akane Mla Wolo lɛ shi kome daa afii kpawo

english_verse: Moses wrote down all of these laws and teachings and gave them to the priests and the leaders of Israel. The priests were from the Levi tribe, and they carried the sacred chest that belonged to the Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Mose ŋma mla lɛ ewo wolo mli, ni ekɛhã osɔfoi lɛ, ni ji Levi shwiei, mɛi ni tereɔ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, kɛ Israelbii lɛ amaŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Moses told these priests and leaders: Each year the Israelites must come together to celebrate the Festival of Shelters at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. You must read these laws and teachings to the people at the festival every seventh year, the year when loans do not need to be repaid.
translation_verse: be ni Israel maŋtso muu fɛɛ ebapue yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ yɛ he ni lɛ eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ, akane nɛkɛ mlai nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ Israel fɛɛ hiɛ awo amɛtoiiaŋ.

english_verse: Everyone must come—men, women, children, and even the foreigners who live in your towns. And each new generation will listen and learn to worship the Lord their God with fear and trembling and to do exactly what is said in God's Law. Israel Will Reject the Lord
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛbii hu ni leee mlai nɛɛ amɛto lɛ akase ni amɛshe Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyei bei abɔ fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaafo Yordan Faa lɛ ni nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ.” Naagbee fãmɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose

english_verse: The Lord told Moses, “You will soon die, so bring Joshua to the sacred tent, and I will appoint him the leader of Israel.” Moses and Joshua went to the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Naa, ogbele be eshɛ etã. Tsɛ Yoshua kɛba koni bo, okɛ lɛ fɛɛ nyɛbadamɔ Kpee Buu lɛ mli koni matu nitsumɔ lɛ mawo edɛŋ.” Mose kɛ Yoshua tee, ni amɛyadamɔ Kpee Buu lɛ mli.

english_verse: and the Lord appeared in a thick cloud right over the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Yehowa bapue yɛ Buu lɛ mli yɛ atatu kutuu mli, ni atatu lɛ badamɔ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi.

english_verse: The Lord said: Moses, you will soon die. But Israel is going into a land where other gods are worshiped, and Israel will reject me and start worshiping these gods. The people will break the agreement I made with them,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Naa, eshwɛ fioo ni obaagbo, ni ogbele sɛɛ lɛ maŋ nɛɛ baakwa mi, ni amɛbaaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni amɛyaanina yɛ shikpɔŋ ni amɛyaa nɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ. Amɛbaakwa mi, ni amɛaaku kpãŋmɔ ni mi kɛ amɛ ekpãŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: and I will be so furious that I will abandon them and ignore their prayers. I will send disasters and suffering that will nearly wipe them out. Finally, they will realize that the disasters happened because I abandoned them.
translation_verse: Kɛji eba mli nakai lɛ mimli aaawo amɛ la yɛ nakai be lɛ mli; ni mibakwa amɛ, ni mifeŋ amɛ ejurɔ, ni aaaye amɛnɔ. Saji fɔ̃ji babaoo kɛ haomɔi baaba amɛnɔ, ni ebaahã amɛbi yɛ nakai be lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Kwɛɛ jeee Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni bɛ wɔteŋ dɔŋŋ lɛ hewɔ ni nɛkɛ nifɔɔjianii nɛɛ eba wɔnɔ nɛɛ?’

english_verse: They will pray to me, but I will ignore them because they were evil and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Anɔkwa, nakai be lɛŋ lɛ mifeŋ amɛ ejurɔ yɛ nifɔɔjianii fɛɛ ni amɛfee lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ amɛtee amɛmiija nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi.

english_verse: I am bringing them into the land that I promised their ancestors. It is a land rich with milk and honey, and the Israelites will have more than enough food to eat. But they will get fat and turn their backs on me and start worshiping other gods. The Israelites will reject me and break the agreement that I made with them.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛji mikɛ amɛ yashɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii lɛ nɔ, nɔ ni mikã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kitã yɛ he akɛ mikɛbaahã amɛ lɛ, ni amɛna nii amɛye ni amɛtɔrɔ, ni amɛshwishwii lɛ, amɛbaakpale kɛyanyiɛ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi asɛɛ, ni amɛaaya amɛyasɔmɔ amɛ, ni amɛaagbe mihe guɔ moŋ, ni amɛaaku mi kɛ amɛteŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: When I punish the Israelites and their descendants with suffering and disasters, I will remind them that they know the words to this song, so they have no excuse for not obeying me. I will give them the land that I promised, but I know the way they are going to live later on.
translation_verse: Kɛji saji fɔ̃ji kɛ hejaramɔ babaoo eba amɛnɔ lɛ, lala nɛɛ aaaye mi kɛ amɛteŋ odase, ejaakɛ amɛshwiei ahiɛ kpaŋ lala nɛɛ nɔ, ni lala lɛ aaahi amɛdaaŋ daa. Amrɔmrɔ nɛɛ po, dani mikɛ amɛ aaaya ayashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikã he kitã akɛ mikɛbaahã amɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, mile yiŋ ni amɛtoɔ momo.”

english_verse: Moses at once wrote down the words to the song, and he taught it to the Israelites.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Mose ŋma nɛkɛ lala nɛɛ yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ ni etsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Be brave and strong! I will help you lead the people of Israel into the land that I have promised them.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa tu nitsumɔ lɛ ewo Yoshua, Nun binuu lɛ, dɛŋ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ohe awa, ni ofee ekãa, ejaakɛ bo ji mɔ ni okɛ Israelbii lɛ baaya shikpɔŋ lɛ ni miwo he shi akɛ mikɛbaahã amɛ lɛ nɔ; mikɛ bo baahi shi.”

english_verse: Moses wrote down all these laws and teachings in a book,
translation_verse: Be ni Mose eŋma mla nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ ewo wolo mli egbe naa owura kosɛɛ lɛ,

english_verse: then he went to the Levites who carried the sacred chest and said:
translation_verse: Mose fã Levibii osɔfoi ni tereɔ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ,

english_verse: This is The Book of God's Law. Keep it beside the sacred chest that holds the agreement the Lord your God made with Israel. This book is proof that you know what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: “Nyɛŋɔa nɛkɛ Mla Wolo nɛɛ ni nyɛkɛŋmɛa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ masɛi koni eye nyɛhe odase yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: I know how stubborn and rebellious you and the rest of the Israelites are. You have rebelled against the Lord while I have been alive, and it will only get worse after I am gone.
translation_verse: Mile bɔ ni nyɛtseɔ atua kɛ bɔ ni nyɛkuɛŋ ti hã hu. Nyɛmiitse Yehowa hiɛ atua amrɔ nɛɛ po ni mihiɛ kã ni mi kɛ nyɛ yɔɔ nɛɛ, shi migbele sɛɛ lɛ te aaatamɔ tɛŋŋ mɔ?

english_verse: So call together the leaders and officials of the tribes of Israel. I will bring this book and read every word of it to you, and I will call the sky and the earth as witnesses that all of you know what you are supposed to do.
translation_verse: Nyɛtsɛa nyɛkutseiatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ nyɛmaŋ nitsulɔi onukpai lɛ hu kɛbaa miŋɔɔ bɔ ni afee ni mawie nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ mawo amɛtoii amli koni matsɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ koni amɛbaye mi kɛ amɛteŋ odase.

english_verse: I am going to die soon, and I know that in the future you will stop caring about what is right and what is wrong, and so you will disobey the Lord and stop living the way I told you to live. The Lord will be angry, and terrible things will happen to you. The Song of Moses
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mile faŋŋ akɛ migbele sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛbaafite kwraa, ni nyɛbaŋ nyɛjeŋ bɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, wɔsɛɛ aahu lɛ, efɔŋ ji nɔ ni baaba nyɛnɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛbaafee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnifeemɔnii baawo emli la.” Mose Lala lɛ

english_verse: Moses called a meeting of all the people of Israel, so he could teach them the words to the song that the Lord had given him. And here are the words:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Mose wie nɛkɛ lala ni baa nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ ewo Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ toiiaŋ kɛyashi egbe naa.

english_verse: Earth and Sky, listen to what I say!
translation_verse: “Ŋwɛi, bo mi toi, shi mibawie; ni Shikpɔŋ, bo minaa wiemɔi nɛɛ toi.

english_verse: Israel, I will teach you. My words will be like gentle rain on tender young plants, or like dew on the grass.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ̃ɔmɔ aaashwie shi tamɔ nu ni miinɛ, ni eeenyɔ tamɔ bɔ, tamɔ futufuli ni miishwã jwɛfɔ nɔ, tamɔ nu kulibii yɛ bai anɔ.

english_verse: Join with me in praising the wonderful name of the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Mibajie Yehowa gbɛi yi! Nyɛwoa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam!

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty rock, and he never does wrong. God can always be trusted to bring justice.
translation_verse: “Tɛsaa ji lɛ, enitsumɔ hi pɛpɛɛpɛ, ejaakɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efeɔ lɛ ja. Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwafo ji lɛ; nɔ sha ko bɛ ehe; jalɔ kɛ anɔkwafo ji lɛ.

english_verse: But you lie and cheat and are unfaithful to him. You have disgraced yourselves and are no longer worthy to be his children.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛyeee lɛ anɔkwa; no hewɔ lɛ, jeee ebii ji nyɛ dɔŋŋ, yɛ nyɛhe kpa hewɔ; yinɔ kɔɔdɔŋ ni eje eŋɛlɛnɔ ji nyɛ.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord is your Father, the one who created you, but you repaid him by being foolish.
translation_verse: Aso Yehowa shidaa moŋ nɛ, kwashiai ni bɛ yitseiaŋ? Aso jeee lɛ ji nyɛtsɛ, mɔ ni bɔ nyɛ, mɔ ni fee nyɛ mɛi komɛi, ni ehã nyɛnane mɔ shi lɛ?

english_verse: Think about past generations. Ask your parents or any of your elders. They will tell you
translation_verse: “Nyɛkaia blema jeeŋmɔ ko lɛ, nyɛjwɛŋa yinɔi ni eho lɛ ahe; nyɛbia nyɛtsɛmɛi, ni amɛaagba nyɛ, kɛ nyɛnukpai lɛ hu, ni amɛaakɛɛ nyɛ.

english_verse: that God Most High gave land to every nation. He assigned a guardian angel to each of them,
translation_verse: Be ni Ŋwɛinyo lɛ ja shikpɔŋ lɛ ekɛhã jeŋ majimaji lɛ, ni egbala adesai abii amli lɛ, ejie maji lɛ ahusui eshwie shi faŋŋ, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ ayibɔ naa.

english_verse: but the Lord himself takes care of Israel.
translation_verse: Yehowa ŋɔ Yakob akɛ gboshinii ni ena; ejaakɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ ji emaŋbii lɛ.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord discovered you in a barren desert filled with howling winds. God became your fortress, protecting you as though you were his own eyes.
translation_verse: “Ena lɛ yɛ shiaŋa shikpɔŋ ko nɔ, yɛ ŋa olɛŋɛlɛ shwaŋŋ ko nɔ. Ebu ehe, ni ekura lɛ hu; ebaa eyi tamɔ ehiŋmɛi mli ajaŋmalaatɛ.

english_verse: The Lord was like an eagle teaching its young to fly, always ready to swoop down and catch them on its back.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni okropɔŋ tsɔ̃ɔ ebii filikimɔ, ni egbɛɔ efijiaŋ ekɛsɔoɔ amɛ, ni ehiɛɔ amɛ koni amɛkagbee shi lɛ,

english_verse: Israel, the Lord led you, and without the aid of a foreign god,
translation_verse: nakai Yehowa koome nyiɛ ewebii ahiɛ, ni maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko fataaa ehe.

english_verse: he helped you capture the land. Your fields were rich with grain. Olive trees grew in your stony soil, and honey was found among the rocks.
translation_verse: “Ehã Israel ye gɔji anɔ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ; Israel ye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii lɛ. Ena wo kɛjɛ tɛsai amli, ni emutsei shwere yɛ tɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ.

english_verse: Your flocks and herds produced milk and yogurt, and you got choice meat from your sheep and goats that grazed in Bashan. Your wheat was the finest, and you drank the best wine.
translation_verse: Tsinai kɛ gwantɛŋi hã fufɔ ni efĩ; egwaŋtɛŋ yei kɛ gwantɛŋ hii shwishwii kɛ fɔ tamɔ Bashan tsinai kɛ abotiai; ni enu wain kpakpa.

english_verse: Israel, you grew fat and rebelled against God, your Creator you rejected the Mighty Rock, your only place of safety.
translation_verse: “Yehowa webii lɛ shwere, shi amɛtse atua; amɛshwishwii, ni amɛhe wa, ni amɛhe shamɔ hu. Kɛkɛ ni amɛkwa Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni bɔ amɛ lɛ moŋ, ni amɛbuuu Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji yiwalaheremɔ Tɛsaa lɛ.

english_verse: You made God jealous and angry by worshiping disgusting idols and foreign gods.
translation_verse: Amɛtee Yehowa awuŋayeli shi kɛ maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔi ni amɛja lɛ, ni esha ni amɛfee hewɔ lɛ amɛwo lɛ mlifu.

english_verse: You offered sacrifices to demons, those useless gods that never helped you, new gods that your ancestors never worshiped.
translation_verse: Amɛshã afɔlei amɛhã nyɔŋmɔi ni jeee nɔ ko nɔ ko, nyɔŋmɔi ni amɛleee, kɛ nyɔŋmɔi hei ni akɛba etsɛko, nii ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ sheko amɛ gbeyei dã.

english_verse: You turned away from God, your Creator; you forgot the Mighty Rock, the source of your life.
translation_verse: Nyɛbuuu Tɛsaa ni babɔ nyɛ ade lɛ, ni nyɛhiɛ kpa Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni bɔ nyɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: You were the Lord's children, but you made him angry. Then he rejected you
translation_verse: “Be ni Yehowa na enɛ lɛ, enyaŋe ebihii kɛ ebiyei lɛ, yɛ emli la ni amɛwo lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: and said, “You are unfaithful and can't be trusted. So I won't answer your prayers; I'll just watch and see what happens to you.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mifeŋ amɛ ejurɔ ko dɔŋŋ.’ Makwɛ bɔ ni amɛnaagbee baatamɔ ahã, ejaakɛ yinɔbii toigbolɔi ji amɛ, bii ni yeee anɔkwa.

english_verse: You worshiped worthless idols, and made me jealous and angry! Now I will send a cruel and worthless nation to make you jealous and angry.
translation_verse: Amɛhã miye nɔ ni jeee nyɔŋmɔ he awuŋã yakatswaa; amɛwo mimli la kɛ amɛmãgãi lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, mi hu mahã amɛye maŋ ko ni bɛ nɔ ko mli he awuŋã. Mahã amɛmli awo la yɛ kwashiai amaŋ ko hewɔ.

english_verse: “My people, I will breathe out fire that sends you down to the world of the dead. It will scorch your farmlands and burn deep down under the mountains.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mimlifu ehã la ko ehere, ni eetso kɛmiiya gbohiiaje tɔ̃ɔ; ebaashã je lɛ kɛ enɔ nibii, ni ebaashã gɔji lɛ ashishitoi diɛŋtsɛ.

english_verse: I'll send disaster after disaster to strike you like arrows.
translation_verse: “Maloo haomɔi mabua amɛyiteŋ, matserɛ̃ amɛ gãii ni miyɔɔ.

english_verse: You'll be struck by starvation and deadly diseases, by the fangs of wild animals and poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Hɔmɔ baahã amɛtã loo, ni jeŋ dɔlɛ kɛ hela baagbe amɛ. Mawo kooloi kakawuai agbɛ koni amɛbatua amɛ, kɛ onufui kɛ amɛnaa ebɔɔ hu gbɛ koni amɛbakɔ̃mɔ amɛ.

english_verse: Young and old alike will be killed in the streets and terrified at home.
translation_verse: Klante aaanu lá yɛ blohui amli, ni piai amli baafee gbeyei. Ebaakpãtã oblanyo kɛ oblayoo kɛ bi fufɔoo kɛ wajiatsɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: “I wanted to scatter you, so no one would remember that you had ever lived.
translation_verse: Kulɛ makɛɛ akɛ, ‘Magbɛ amɛ mashwã kɛya shɔŋŋ, ni mahã hiɛ akpa amɛnɔ yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ.’

english_verse: But I dreaded the sound of your enemies saying, ‘We defeated Israel with no help from the Lord.’ ”
translation_verse: Shi mishe gbeyei akɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi aaashwã ni amɛaaŋɔ nɔ ni eba lɛ ekroko ni amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Wɔ ni wɔye amɛnɔ kunim lɛ, jeee Yehowa ni fee amɛ enɛ.’

english_verse: If you did, you could see where you are headed.
translation_verse: Eji amɛle nii kulɛ amɛaanu nɔ ni ba lɛ shishi, ni amɛaayoo bɔ ni amɛnaagbee mli aaabatamɔ.

english_verse: How could one enemy soldier chase a thousand of Israel's troops? Or how could two of theirs pursue ten thousand of ours? It can only happen if the Lord stops protecting Israel and lets the enemy win.
translation_verse: Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni gbɔmɔ kome kɛkɛ woɔ mɛi akpe foiŋ, ni gbɔmɛi enyɔ kɛkɛ hu woɔ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma foiŋ? Nɔ ni kɛba ji amɛTɛsaa lɛ ekwa amɛ, ni Yehowa eŋmɛɛ amɛhe ehã.

english_verse: Even our enemies know that only our God is a Mighty Rock.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ yeɔ enɛ he odase akɛ amɛtɛsaa, amɛnyɔŋmɔ lɛ, tamɔɔɔ wɔTɛsaa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Our enemies are grapevines rooted in the fields of Sodom and Gomorrah. The grapes they produce are full of bitter poison;
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ jeŋ ni amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ba lɛ tamɔ Sodom kɛ Gomora jeŋba lɛ; amɛjeŋba fɛɛ etsɔ̃ ebɔɔ, ni amɛyibii miijoo pam;

english_verse: their wine is more deadly than cobra venom.
translation_verse: amɛwain lɛ shikpãi ebɔɔ ni, tamɔ blikã naa ebɔɔ pɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord has written a list of their sins and locked it in his vault.
translation_verse: “Mikɛ amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ eto; mikɛŋmɛ shi, ni eemɛ amɛ.

english_verse: Soon our enemies will get what they deserve— suddenly they will slip, and total disaster will quickly follow.
translation_verse: Oweletɔɔ kɛ toigbalamɔ lɛ, mi minɔ ni; amɛhiɛkpãtãmɔ be lɛ ebɛŋkɛ, nɔ ni baaba amɛnɔ lɛ miiba shwiaa.

english_verse: When only a few of the Lord's people remain, when their strength is gone, and some of them are slaves, the Lord will feel sorry for them and give them justice.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa baafã ewebii ahe; ebaana amɛ mɔbɔ kɛji ena akɛ amɛhewalɛ fɛɛ etã, ni eshwɛko mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa, mɔ ni hiɛ ehe jio, nyɔŋ jio.

english_verse: But first the Lord will say, “You ran for safety to other gods— couldn't they help you?
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ Yehowa baabi akɛ, ‘Nɛgbɛ tɛsaa, amɛnyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ nɔ lɛ yɔɔ;

english_verse: You offered them wine and your best sacrifices. Can't those gods help you now or give you protection?
translation_verse: nibii ni amɛkɛ kooloi ni amɛkɛmiishã afɔle lɛ amli fɔi lɛ hã, ni amɛfɔse wain amɛshwie shi amɛhã amɛ akɛ amɛnu lɛ? Amɛba amɛbaye amɛbua amɛ, amɛbafã amɛhe koo!

english_verse: Don't you understand? I am the only God; there are no others. I am the one who takes life and gives it again. I punished you with suffering. But now I will heal you, and nothing can stop me!
translation_verse: “‘Te nyɛna akɛ Mi nɔŋŋ ji Mi, ni misɛɛ lɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ? Migbeɔ, ni mihãa wala, mipilaa mɔ, ni mitsaa mɔ, ejaakɛ mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ nɔ ko ashɔ̃ yɛ mi midɛŋ.

english_verse: “I make this solemn promise: Just as I live forever,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ miiwo minine nɔ kɛya ŋwɛi, ni miikɛɛ akɛ, miyɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ,

english_verse: I will take revenge on my hateful enemies. I will sharpen my sword and let it flash like lightning.
translation_verse: kɛji mijɔ miklante lɛ naa, ni ekpɛ kaŋkaŋ ni miwo jalɛ saneyeli nɔ lɛ, mibatɔ mihe owele yɛ mihenyɛlɔi anɔ, ni mibagbala mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ toi.

english_verse: My arrows will get drunk on enemy blood; my sword will taste the flesh and the blood of the enemy. It will kill prisoners, and cut off the heads of their leaders.”
translation_verse: Lá baawu migãimlibii ahe, ni miklante lɛ baaye loo. Lá baatsere yɛ migãimlibii anaa, ni miklante baagbe mɔ ni teɔ shi ewoɔ mi lɛ. Minaŋ mɔ ni egba ewo mi mɔbɔ, pilafo lɛ kɛ nomi fɛɛ yeŋ amɛhe.’

english_verse: Tell the heavens to celebrate and all gods to bow down to the Lord, because he will take revenge on those hateful enemies who killed his people. He will forgive the sins of Israel and purify their land.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ majimaji, nyɛkɛ Yehowa webii lɛ anyaa, ejaakɛ etɔ etsuji alá he owele, ni etɔ ehe owele yɛ ehenyɛlɔi anɔ, ni ekɛ ewebii atɔ̃mɔi efa amɛ.”

english_verse: Moses spoke the words of the song so that all the Israelites could hear, and Joshua helped him. When Moses had finished,
translation_verse: Be ni Mose kɛ Israelbii lɛ ewie wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ egbe naa lɛ,

english_verse: he said, “Always remember this song I have taught you today. And let it be a warning that you must teach your children to obey everything written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wiemɔi fɛɛ ni mikɛshwie nyɛhiɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ akãa nyɛtsui nɔ; ni nyɛkpãa nyɛwoa nyɛbii atoiiaŋ koni amɛjwɛŋ nɛkɛ mla nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni amɛye nɔ;

english_verse: The Law isn't empty words. It can give you a long life in the land that you are going to take.” Moses Will See the Land
translation_verse: ejaakɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ jeee wiemɔi foji hã nyɛ, shi moŋ nyɛwala diɛŋtsɛ ni; ni no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛwala sɛɛ aaatsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛfoɔ Yordan Faa lɛ kɛyaa ni nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: Later that day the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

english_verse: Go up into the Abarim Mountain range here in Moab across the Jordan River valley from Jericho. And when you reach the top of Mount Nebo, you will be able to see the land of Canaan, which I am giving to Israel.
translation_verse: “Kwɔɔ Abarim gɔŋ nɛɛ, ni ji Nebo Gɔŋ ni yɔɔ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ekwɛɔ Yeriko maŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, koni okwɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhãa Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Then you will die and be buried on the mountaintop, just as your brother Aaron died and was buried on Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Obaagbo yɛ nakai gɔŋ ni obaakwɔ lɛ nɔ koni oyanina omɛi lɛ tamɔ onyɛmi Aaron gbo yɛ Hor Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eyanina emɛi lɛ,

english_verse: Both of you were unfaithful to me at Meribah Spring near Kadesh in the Zin Desert. I am God, but there in front of the Israelites, you did not treat me with the honor and respect I deserve.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ, bo kɛ lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛkwa mi yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ yɛ Meriba nu lɛ he yɛ Kadesh, yɛ Zin ŋa lɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ nyɛwooo mihiɛ nyam akɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: So I will give the land to the people of Israel, but you will only get to see it from a distance.
translation_verse: Obaana shikpɔŋ lɛ kã ohiɛ moŋ nɛ; shi ya ni oyaŋ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ni mikɛhãa Israelbii lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: Moses was a prophet, and before he died, he blessed the tribes of Israel by saying:
translation_verse: Jɔɔmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ Mose kɛjɔɔ Israelbii lɛ dani egbo lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord came from Mount Sinai. From Edom, he gave light to his people, and his glory was shining from Mount Paran. Thousands of his warriors were with him, and fire was at his right hand.
translation_verse: Ekɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa jɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekpɛ kɛjɛ Edom eshwie wɔnɔ; ekpɛ kɛjɛ Paran Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ejɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi akpei nyɔŋma lɛ aŋɔɔ kɛ la plamplam ni ma eninejurɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord loves the tribes of Israel, and he protects his people. They listen to his words and worship at his feet. *
translation_verse: “Anɔkwa, edɔɔ emɛi ahe, ehiɛ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ yɛ edɛŋ, no hewɔ lɛ, wɔkula enaji anaa ni wɔmiibo egbɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ toi.

english_verse: I called a meeting of the tribes of Israel and gave you God's Law.
translation_verse: Wɔyeɔ Mla lɛ ni Mose kɛhã wɔ lɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ no ji Yakob shwiei agboshinii.

english_verse: Tribe of Reuben, you will live, even though your tribe will always be small.
translation_verse: Mose kɛɛ yɛ Ruben akutso lɛ he akɛ, ‘Ruben yi ana wala, eshishi akabule; emli hii anɔ akagbɔ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord will listen to you, tribe of Judah, as you beg to come safely home. You fought your enemies alone; now the Lord will help you.
translation_verse: Ekɛɛ yɛ Yuda akutso lɛ he akɛ, “Yehowa, bo Yuda toi; kplamɔ lɛ kɛbafata akutsei krokomɛi lɛ ahe. Nuŋtsɔ, bo diɛŋtsɛ wuu ohã Yuda koni oye obua lɛ ni enyɛ ehenyɛlɔi ekɛwu.”

english_verse: At Massah and Meribah Spring, the Lord tested you, tribe of Levi. You were faithful, and so the priesthood belongs to the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Ekɛɛ yɛ Levi akutso lɛ he akɛ, “Bo Yehowa, hã Urim kɛ Tumim ajie osuɔmɔnaa nii kpo atsɔ̃ɔ omaŋ lɛ, kɛtsɔ̃ omɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni ji Levibii lɛ anɔ. Oka amɛ okwɛ yɛ Masa, ni okɛ amɛ taa naa yɛ Meriba nu lɛ he.

english_verse: Protecting Israel's agreement with the Lord was more important to you than the life of your father or mother, or brothers or sisters, or your own children.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɛ yɛ amɛtsɛ kɛ amɛnyɛ he akɛ, ‘Wɔbuuu amɛ, ni amɛkwa amɛnyɛmimɛi, ni amɛshi amɛmusuŋbii asɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛmɔ owiemɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛye okpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: You teach God's laws to Israel, and at the place of worship you offer sacrifices and burn incense.
translation_verse: Amɛ amɛbaatsɔ̃ɔ Yakob shwiei okpɔi lɛ, kɛ Israel omla lɛ. Amɛ amɛbaashã tsofakɛŋma yɛ ohiɛ kɛ shãa afɔle muu yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.’

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless everything you do, and make you strong enough to crush your enemies.
translation_verse: Ao! Yehowa, jɔɔmɔ Levi shwiei lɛ, ni amɛninenaa nitsumɔ asa ohiɛ; tswiamɔ amɛhenyɛlɔi kɛ mɛi ni nyɛɔ amɛ lɛ nii, koni amɛkanyɛ shi amɛte dɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord Most High loves you, tribe of Benjamin. He will live among your hills and protect you.
translation_verse: Mose kɛɛ yɛ Benyamin akutso lɛ he akɛ, “Mɔ ni Yehowa sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ, ehiɔ Yehowa masɛi shweshweeshwe. Ebuɔ ehe gbi muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni ekpɔkɔiaŋ ji ekamɔhe.”

english_verse: Descendants of Joseph, the Lord will bless you with precious water from deep wells and with dew from the sky.
translation_verse: Mose kɛɛ yɛ Yosef akutso lɛ he akɛ, “Yehowa ajɔɔ oshikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ bɔ, ŋwɛi nikeenii ni jara wa fe fɛɛ lɛ, kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi nu hu.

english_verse: Month by month, your fruit will ripen in the sunshine.
translation_verse: Yehowa ajɔɔ Yosef kɛ tsoyibii kpakpai diɛŋtsɛ ejɔɔ lɛ kɛ ŋmɔshinii kpakpai babaoo ni baa yɛ be ni sa mli.

english_verse: You will have a rich harvest from the slopes of the ancient hills.
translation_verse: Ehã ŋmɔshinii kpakpai akwɛ̃ yɛ eblema gɔji lɛ anɔ; ni naanɔ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ hu aba nii babaoo.

english_verse: The Lord who appeared in the burning bush wants to give you the best the land can produce, and it will be a princely crown on Joseph's head.
translation_verse: Yehowa ajɔɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ koni eba nii babaoo, bɔ ni shikpɔŋ nyɛɔ ebaa nii. Mɔ ni hi ŋmeitso lɛ mli lɛ ana Yosef akutso lɛ he miishɛɛ. Akɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ aduro Yosef; jɔɔmɔ aba ekekre ni fi eyitso lɛ nɔ, Lɛ mɔ ni ji lumɔ yɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The armies of Ephraim and Manasseh are majestic and fierce like a bull or a wild ox. They will run their spears through faraway nations.
translation_verse: Yosef kromɔbi lɛ je agbo tamɔ tsinanuu; ni ekoji ni ji ehewalɛ lɛ tamɔ ŋaŋ tsinanuu nɔ; nomɛi ji Efraim mɛi akpei nyɔŋma, kɛ Manase akpei nyɔŋma ni amɛkɛbaashimɔ maji lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛaatsirɛ amɛ kɛaatee jeŋ naagbeehei lɛ.”

english_verse: Be happy, Zebulun, as your boats set sail; be happy, Issachar, in your tents.
translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ yɛ Zebulon akutso lɛ he akɛ: “Zebulon, nya yɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ jarayeli hewɔ; ni bo Isakar hu, nya onii ni ona yɛ shĩa lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: The sea will make you wealthy, and from the sandy beach you will get treasure. So invite the other tribes to celebrate with you and offer sacrifices to God.
translation_verse: Amɛaatsɛ mɛi kɛaaya amɛgɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ: jɛi amɛaashã afɔlei ni sa yɛ, ejaakɛ amɛna nii kɛjɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ, ni amɛna shĩa mli jwetri ni akɛtee lɛ hu.”

english_verse: Tribe of Gad, the Lord will bless you with more land. So shout his praises! Your tribe is like a lion ripping up its victim.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni Mose kɛɛ yɛ Gad akutso lɛ he nɛ: “Akafo Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni lɛɔ Gad husui lɛ amli lɛ. Gad bu shi tamɔ jata ni miiwɔ, ni etserɛɔ mɛi aniji, ni ekpɔɔ yitso heloo.

english_verse: Tribe of Dan, you are like a lion cub, startled by a snake.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni Mose kɛɛ yɛ Dan akutso lɛ he nɛ: “Dan lɛ jatabi ni tumɔɔ kɛjɛ Bashan ni.”

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with you, people of Naphtali. He will bless you and give you the land to the west and the south.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni Mose kɛɛ yɛ Naftali akutso lɛ he nɛ: “Naftali, bo lɛ aduro bo naakpa, Yehowa ejɔɔ bo jogbaŋŋ; ŋɔɔ wuoyigbɛ kɛ Galilea Kpaakpo lɛ ofee onɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord's greatest blessing is for you, tribe of Asher. You will be the favorite of all the other tribes. You will be rich with olive oil
translation_verse: Nɔ ni Mose kɛɛ yɛ Asher akutso lɛ he nɛ: “Ajɔɔ Asher fe fɛɛ yɛ bii ateŋ, ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ aaasumɔ esane; ni eshikpɔŋ lɛ aaashwere kɛ mu tso.

english_verse: and have strong town gates with bronze and iron bolts. Your people will be powerful for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Akɛ dade kɛ akɔɔble adabãi aaalalaa omaŋ agboi asɛɛ; ni bɔ ni ogbii falɛ yɔɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ohewalɛ aaahi.

english_verse: Israel, no other god is like ours— the clouds are his chariot as he rides across the skies to come and help us.
translation_verse: Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni tamɔ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni taa okpɔŋɔ nɔ kɛnyiɛɔ ŋwɛi, ni ekɛ agbojee tsɔ̃ɔ atatuiaŋ kɛbayeɔ ebuaa bo lɛ.

english_verse: The eternal God is our hiding place; he carries us in his arms. When God tells you to destroy your enemies, he will make them run.
translation_verse: Naanɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji obobaahe, ni enaanɔ niji lɛ hiɛ omli. Eshwie henyɛlɔi lɛ kɛje ohiɛ, ni ekɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Kpãtãmɔ amɛhiɛ’.

english_verse: Israel, you will live in safety; your enemies will be gone. The dew will fall from the sky, and you will have plenty of grain and wine.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ, aaahi shi shweshweeshwe. Yakob nubu lɛ aaahi shikpɔŋ ni abele kɛ wain pii baa yɛ nɔ, ni ŋwɛi bɔ nyɔɔ kɛjɛɔ ŋwɛi shwieɔ nɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has rescued you and given you more blessings than any other nation. He protects you like a shield and is your majestic sword. Your enemies will bow in fear, and you will trample on their backs.
translation_verse: Israel, omii ashɛ ohe! Namɔ tamɔ bo, maŋ ni Yehowa ehere oyiwala? Mɔ ni ji oyelikɛbuamɔ tsɛŋ kɛ okunimyeli klante lɛ? Ohenyɛlɔi aaashwie amɛnaa shi amɛhã bo, ni obaanaanaa amɛhei grɔŋŋi lɛ anɔ.”

english_verse: Sometime later, Moses left the lowlands of Moab. He went up Mount Pisgah to the peak of Mount Nebo, which is across the Jordan River from Jericho. The Lord showed him all the land as far north as Gilead and the town of Dan.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Mose jɛ Moab ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni ekwɔ Nebo Gɔŋ lɛ kɛtee Pisga Gɔŋ lɛ ni kwɛɔ Yeriko maŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ yiteŋ. Yehowa kɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ kɛjɛ Gilead kɛyashi Dan,

english_verse: He let Moses see the territories that would soon belong to the tribes of Naphtali, Ephraim, Manasseh, and Judah, as far west as the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: kɛ Naftali fɛɛ, kɛ Efraim kɛ Manase shikpɔŋ lɛ, kɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ kɛyashwie Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ anaigbɛ.

english_verse: The Lord also showed him the land in the south, from the valley near the town of Jericho, known as The City of Palm Trees, down to the town of Zoar.
translation_verse: Ekɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ, kɛ Yeriko ni ji tɛŋmaŋ jɔɔ lɛ mli ŋa kplenee lɛ kɛyashi Zoar tɔ̃ɔ?

english_verse: The Lord said, “Moses, this is the land I was talking about when I solemnly promised Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that I would give land to their descendants. I have let you see it, but you will not cross the Jordan and go in.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Shikpɔŋ lɛ ni miwo Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob shi yɛ he akɛ, ‘Mikɛbaahã nyɛshwiei’ lɛ, no nɛ. Mihã ona kɛ ohiŋmɛitsei enyɔ, shi jɛi ni oyaŋ.”

english_verse: And so, Moses the Lord's servant died there in Moab, just as the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Yehowa tsulɔ Mose gbo yɛ jɛi yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa;

english_verse: The Lord buried him in a valley near the town of Beth-Peor, but even today no one knows exactly where.
translation_verse: ni Yehowa fu Mose yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ Betpeor ŋlɛnɔ; shi mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa leee Mose saŋ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.

english_verse: The people of Israel stayed in the lowlands of Moab, where they mourned and grieved
translation_verse: Israelbii lɛ fo Mose gbii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ yɛ Moab ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ, dani amɛkɛgbe Mose yarafeemɔ kɛ lɛ fomɔ lɛ naa.

english_verse: Before Moses died, he had placed his hands on Joshua, and the Lord had given Joshua wisdom. The Israelites paid attention to what Joshua said and obeyed the commands that the Lord had given Moses. Moses Was a Great Prophet
translation_verse: Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, eyi obɔ̃ kɛ nilee mumɔ, ejaakɛ Mose kɛ eniji eshwie enɔ ejɔɔ enɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ bo Yoshua toi, ni amɛfee tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa efã Mose lɛ.

english_verse: There has never again been a prophet in Israel like Moses. The Lord spoke face to face with him
translation_verse: Gbalɔ ko eteko shi dɔŋŋ yɛ Israel tamɔ Mose mɔ ni Yehowa kɛ lɛ wie hiɛ kɛ hiɛ lɛ.

english_verse: and sent him to perform powerful miracles in the presence of the king of Egypt and his entire nation.
translation_verse: Gbalɔ ko hu efeko okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii tamɔ nii fɛɛ ni Yehowa tsu Mose ni eyafee yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ etsɔ̃ɔ Ijipt maŋtsɛ kɛ etsuji lɛ kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: No one else has ever had the power to do such great things as Moses did for everyone to see.
translation_verse: Gbalɔ ko hu bako ni eyɛ hewalɛ kpele, ni efee naakpɛɛnii kɛ gbeyeinii tamɔ Mose fee yɛ Israelbii ahiɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Moses, the Lord's servant, was dead. So the Lord spoke to Joshua son of Nun, who had been the assistant of Moses. The Lord said:
translation_verse: Yehowa tsulɔ Mose gbele sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, ni lɛ ji Mose sɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ akɛ,

english_verse: My servant Moses is dead. Now you must lead Israel across the Jordan River into the land I'm giving to all of you.
translation_verse: “Mitsulɔ Mose egbo, no hewɔ lɛ, saamɔ ohe koni bo kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ afo Yordan Faa nɛɛ kɛya shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikɛhãa amɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Wherever you go, I'll give you that land, as I promised Moses.
translation_verse: He fɛɛ he ni nyɛnane shi aaasa lɛ mikɛhã nyɛ tamɔ bɔ ni miwo minaa shi mihã Mose lɛ.

english_verse: It will reach from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains in the north, and to the northeast as far as the great Euphrates River. It will include the land of the Hittites, and the land from here at the Jordan River to the Mediterranean Sea on the west.
translation_verse: “Nyɛhusu ji kɛjɛ ŋã lɛ nɔ kɛ nɛkɛ Lebanon gɔji nɛɛ ahe kɛyashi faa wulu ni ji Eufrate Faa lɛ naa, kɛtsɔ̃ Hitbii ashikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ mli kɛyashi Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ naa yɛ anaigbɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Joshua, I will always be with you and help you as I helped Moses, and no one will ever be able to defeat you.
translation_verse: Mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ ohiɛ adamɔ owalagbii abɔ fɛɛ. Bɔ ni mikɛ Mose hi shi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mikɛ bo aaahi shi; mishiŋ bo, ni mikwaŋ bo hu.

english_verse: Long ago I promised the ancestors of Israel that I would give this land to their descendants. So be strong and brave! Be careful to do everything my servant Moses taught you. Never stop reading The Book of the Law he gave you. Day and night you must think about what it says. If you obey it completely, you and Israel will be able to take this land.
translation_verse: Kaahã nɛkɛ Mla Wolo nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ miikpa yɛ odaaŋ; shi jwɛŋmɔ he be fɛɛ be, nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane, ni ojwɛŋ nɔ bɔ ni afee ni ohiɛ ahi ohe nɔ, ni ofee bɔ ni aŋma yɛ mli lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ejaakɛ no baahã oshwere.

english_verse: I've commanded you to be strong and brave. Don't ever be afraid or discouraged! I am the Lord your God, and I will be there to help you wherever you go. The Eastern Tribes Promise To Help
translation_verse: Ani jeee mi mifã bo? Wajemɔ ohe ni ofee ekãa. Kaahã ŋmiŋmi miimɔ bo, ni asaŋ otsui akafã ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mifĩ osɛɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he ni oyaa.” Yoshua tsɔ̃ɔ maŋbii lɛ nɔ ni afee

english_verse: Joshua ordered the tribal leaders
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua fã maŋ lɛ nɔkwɛlɔi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ,

english_verse: to go through the camp and tell everyone: In a few days we will cross the Jordan River to take the land that the Lord our God is giving us. So prepare as much food as you'll need for the march into the land.
translation_verse: “Nyɛkpaa maŋ lɛŋ koni nyɛwoa maŋbii lɛ shi. Nyɛkɛa amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛtaoa gbɛ nɔ niyenii nyɛtoa, ejaakɛ biɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ, nyɛbaafo Yordan Faa nɛɛ koni nyɛya nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Joshua told the men of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh:
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ Yoshua kɛɛ Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Manasebii akutso lɛ fã lɛ akɛ,

english_verse: conquer the land that the Lord is giving them. The Lord will give peace to them as he has given peace to you, and then you can come back and settle here in the land that Moses promised you.
translation_verse: kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Yehowa aaahã nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ hu ana he ko ni amɛjɔɔ amɛhe yɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni ehã nyɛjɔɔ nyɛhe lɛ, be mli ni amɛ hu shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa amɛ lɛ aaashɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ. No sɛɛ dani nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ kɛba nyɛshikpɔŋ ni Yehowa tsulɔ Mose kɛhã nyɛ yɛ Yordan Faa nɛɛ sɛɛ yɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛbahi nɔ.”

english_verse: The men answered: We'll cross the Jordan River and help our relatives. We'll fight anywhere you send us.
translation_verse: Maŋbii lɛ to he amɛhã Yoshua amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni owo wɔ ehe kitã lɛ wɔɔfee, ni he fɛɛ he ni oootsu wɔ lɛ wɔɔtee.

english_verse: If the Lord our God will help you as he helped Moses, and if you are strong and brave, we will obey you as we obeyed Moses. We'll even put to death anyone who rebels against you or refuses to obey you.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatse ohiɛ atua, ni efeee nɔ ni ofã akɛ efee lɛ, aaagbe lɛ. Bo lɛ wajemɔ ohe ni ofee ekãa jogbaŋŋ kɛkɛ.”

english_verse: Joshua chose two men as spies and sent them from their camp at Acacia with these instructions: “Go across the river and find out as much as you can about the whole region, especially about the town of Jericho.” The two spies left the Israelite camp at Acacia and went to Jericho, where they decided to spend the night at the house of a prostitute named Rahab.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, tsu hii enyɔ nigii kɛjɛ Shitim koni amɛyasara shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa nyɛyasaraa shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛbaa, shi titri lɛ Yeriko.” Kɛkɛ ni hii lɛ yi mli amɛtee, ni amɛyato yoo ajwamãŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Rahab lɛ we.

english_verse: But someone found out about them and told the king of Jericho, “Some Israelite men came here tonight, and they are spies.”
translation_verse: Ni atee ayakɛɛ Yeriko maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii komɛi eba biɛ nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ koni amɛbasara shikpɔŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Rahab went back up to her roof. The spies were still awake, so she told them:
translation_verse: Rahab gbɔi enyɔ lɛ nako amɛkamɔ shi, ni etee amɛŋɔ̃ɔ yɛ tsu lɛ yiteŋ,

english_verse: I know that the Lord has given Israel this land. Everyone shakes with fear because of you.
translation_verse: ni eyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mile akɛ Yehowa kɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ehã nyɛ, ni nyɛhe ŋmiŋmi emɔmɔ wɔmaŋbii fɛɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ ejijaa yɛ nyɛhewɔ;

english_verse: We heard how the Lord dried up the Red Sea so you could leave Egypt. And we heard how you destroyed Sihon and Og, those two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ wɔnu bɔ ni Yehowa hã Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ mli nu lɛ gbi yɛ nyɛhiɛ be ni nyɛshi Ijipt lɛ. Asaŋ wɔnu bɔ ni nyɛfee Amorbii amaŋtsɛmɛi enyɔ, ni ji Sihon kɛ Og, ni yɔɔ Yordan bokãgbɛ lɛ musumusu nyɛhã lɛ.

english_verse: We know that the Lord your God rules heaven and earth, and we've lost our courage and our will to fight.
translation_verse: Amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni wɔnu saji nɛɛ lɛ, wɔtsui fã, ni shi ofɔ̃ shi nuu fɛɛ nuu nɔ yɛ nyɛhewɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ ji ŋwɛi ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shishi lɛ nɔ Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: Please promise me in the Lord's name that you will be as kind to my family as I have been to you. Do something to show
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, miikpa nyɛ fai, nyɛkɛ Yehowa akãa mi kitã akɛ gbii abɔ ni mifee nyɛ ejurɔ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛbaafee mitsɛ we lɛ ejurɔ nakai nɔŋŋ; ni nyɛbaato mi okadi krɛdɛɛ ko,

english_verse: that you won't let your people kill my father and mother and my brothers and sisters and their families.
translation_verse: ni nyɛbaahere mitsɛ kɛ minyɛ kɛ minyɛmimɛi hii kɛ minyɛmimɛi yei kɛ nii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ ayiwala koni nyɛjie wɔ kɛje gbele mli.”

english_verse: “Rahab,” the spies answered, “if you keep quiet about what we're doing, we promise to be kind to you when the Lord gives us this land. We pray that the Lord will kill us if we don't keep our promise!”
translation_verse: Hii lɛ wo Rahab shi amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔwala lɛ owala ni. Kɛji nyɛjieee wɔ shi lɛ, no lɛ kɛji Yehowa kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ hã wɔ lɛ, wɔkɛ bo aaaye yɛ mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ anɔkwale naa.”

english_verse: Rahab's house was built into the town wall, and one of the windows in her house faced outside the wall. She gave the spies a rope, showed them the window, and said, “Use this rope to let yourselves down to the ground outside the wall.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Rahab shiu hii lɛ kɛ taŋkpee kɛtsɔ̃ samflɛ mli kɛyimɔ shi, ejaakɛ Rahab shĩa lɛ ama akpɛtɛ maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ, ni jɛi Rahab yɔɔ.

english_verse: Then hide in the hills. The men who are looking for you won't be able to find you there. They'll give up and come back after a few days, and you can be on your way.”
translation_verse: Rahab kɛɛ hii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa gɔji lɛ anɔ koni mɛi ni atsu akɛ amɛyatao nyɛ lɛ kɛ nyɛ akakpe. Nyɛtea nyɛhe yɛ jɛi gbii etɛ̃ kɛyashi mɛi ni etiu nyɛ lɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaaba; no sɛɛ dani nyɛyi gbɛ nyɛya.”

english_verse: “I'll do exactly what you said,” Rahab promised. Then she sent them on their way and tied the red rope to the window.
translation_verse: Rahab kɛɛ hii lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni nyɛkɛɛ nɛɛ aba mli nakai.” Kɛkɛ ni ewo hii lɛ gbɛ, ni amɛtee; ni Rahab fĩ kpãa tsuru lɛ etsotsoro samflɛ lɛ he.

english_verse: The spies hid in the hills for three days while the king's soldiers looked for them along the roads. As soon as the soldiers gave up and returned to Jericho,
translation_verse: Hii lɛ shwie nɔ kɛtee gɔji lɛ anɔ; ni amɛhi jɛi gbii etɛ̃ kɛyashi mɛi ni atsu akɛ amɛtiu amɛ lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛba. Mɛi ni tiu hii lɛ tao Israelbii ni atsu lɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, shi amɛnaaa amɛhe okadi ko kwraa.

english_verse: the two spies went down into the Jordan valley and crossed the river. They reported to Joshua and told him everything that had happened.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii abɔfoi enyɔ lɛ kpeleke gɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛfo Yordan lɛ kɛba Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbagba lɛ saji ni ba amɛnɔ lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: “We're sure the Lord has given us the whole country,” they said. “The people there shake with fear every time they think of us.”
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, “Yehowa etu shikpɔŋ lɛ ewo wɔdɛŋ lɛɛlɛŋ. Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ejijaa yɛ wɔhewɔ.”

english_verse: Early the next morning, Joshua and the Israelites packed up and left Acacia. They went to the Jordan River and camped there that night.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua te shi leebi maŋkpa, ni lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛ̃ɛ fã kɛjɛ Akasia shitoohe lɛ, ni amɛba Yordan Faa lɛ naa. Amɛwɔ yɛ jɛi dani amɛfo faa lɛ.

english_verse: Two days later their leaders went through the camp,
translation_verse: Gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ maŋnɔkwɛlɔi lɛ kpa shitoohe lɛ mli,

english_verse: Joshua told the people, “Make yourselves acceptable to worship the Lord, because he is going to do some amazing things for us.”
translation_verse: Yoshua kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsua nyɛhe ejaakɛ wɔ lɛ Yehowa baafee naakpɛɛ nii yɛ nyɛteŋ.”

english_verse: Then Joshua turned to the priests and said, “Take the chest and cross the Jordan River ahead of us.” So the priests picked up the chest by its carrying poles and went on ahead.
translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ osɔfoi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛwoa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ koni nyɛkɛnyiɛa maŋ lɛ hiɛ.” Osɔfoi lɛ wo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, ni amɛkɛnyiɛ maŋ lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Beginning today I will show the people that you are their leader, and they will know that I am helping you as I helped Moses.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, “Mibabɔ̃i ohiɛ nyamwoo kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ matsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ koni amɛkɛna amɛle akɛ bɔ ni mikɛ Mose hi shi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mikɛ bo hu baahi shi.

english_verse: Now, tell the priests who are carrying the chest to go a little way into the river and stand there.”
translation_verse: Wo osɔfoi ni tere Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kitã akɛ, ‘Kɛji nyɛyanina Yordan Faa lɛ, nyɛwaa nyɛdamɔa faa lɛ mli.’ ”

english_verse: Joshua spoke to the people: Come here and listen to what the Lord our God said he will do!
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua tsɛ maŋbii lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsia nyɛbaa biɛ koni nyɛbaboa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi.”

english_verse: The Canaanites, the Hittites, the Hivites, the Perizzites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, and the Jebusites control the land on the other side of the river. But the living God will be with you and will force them out of the land when you attack. And now, God is going to prove that he's powerful enough to force them out.
translation_verse: Be ni maŋbii lɛ tsi ba lɛ, Yoshua kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Enɛ nyɛkɛaale akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ, ni akɛ shwiemɔ eeeshwie Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Hitbii lɛ kɛ Hivbii lɛ kɛ Perizbii lɛ kɛ Girgashbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii lɛ kɛaaje nyɛhiɛ.

english_verse: Just watch the sacred chest that belongs to the Lord, the ruler of the whole earth. As soon as the priests carrying the chest step into the Jordan, the water will stop flowing and pile up as if someone had built a dam across the river. The Lord has also said that each of the twelve tribes should choose one man to represent it.
translation_verse: Ni naa, amrɔ pɛ ni osɔfoi ni tere Yehowa, ni ji shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, Adeka lɛ anaji aaasa Yordan mli nu lɛ mli lɛ, nu lɛ aaakpa hoo, ni nu ni jɛɔ yiteŋgbɛ baa lɛ baawa, ni eeema shi tamɔ gbogbo.”

english_verse: The Israelites packed up and left camp. The priests carrying the chest walked in front,
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛŋ be ni maŋbii lɛ famɔ amɛbui lɛ koni amɛyafo Yordan lɛ, ni osɔfoi tere Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛnyiɛ amɛhiɛ,

english_verse: until they came to the Jordan River. The water in the river had risen over its banks, as it often does in springtime. But as soon as the feet of the priests touched the water,
translation_verse: ni mɛi ni tere Adeka lɛ bashɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa, ni osɔfoi lɛ ni tere Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ anaji na sa nu lɛ mli pɛ ,

english_verse: the river stopped flowing, and the water started piling up at the town of Adam near Zarethan. No water flowed toward the Dead Sea, and the priests stood in the middle of the dry riverbed near Jericho while everyone else crossed over.
translation_verse: Be ni Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ nyiɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ kɛfoɔ faa lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ ni tere Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ wa damɔ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ yɛ Yordan teŋ tuuŋtu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ fo faa lɛ tã.

english_verse: After Israel had crossed the Jordan, the Lord said to Joshua:
translation_verse: Be ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ efo Yordan Faa lɛ etã lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ,

english_verse: Tell one man from each of the twelve tribes to pick up a large rock from where the priests are standing. Then tell the men to set up those rocks as a monument at the place where you camp tonight.
translation_verse: koni ofã amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛholea tɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ yɛ Yordan teŋ he ni osɔfoi lɛ anaji mãmɔ lɛ koni nyɛtere kɛfo mli kɛya he ni nyɛyaato ŋmɛnɛ gbɛkɛ nɛɛ, nyɛkɛyamãmɔ shi yɛ jɛi.’ ”

english_verse: and said: Go to the middle of the riverbed where the sacred chest is, and pick up a large rock. Carry it on your shoulder to our camp. There are twelve of you, so there will be one rock for each tribe.
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsɔ̃a Yehowa Adeka lɛ hiɛ kɛyaa Yordan teŋ, ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ awo tɛ kome atswa ekɔŋ yɛ Israelbii akutsei lɛ ayibɔ naa.

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why are these rocks here?” Then you can tell them how the water stopped flowing when the chest was being carried across the river. These rocks will always remind our people of what happened here today.
translation_verse: nyɛjie naa nyɛhã amɛ akɛ, ‘Yordan Faa lɛŋ nu lɛ sɛɛ fo yɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ be ni akɛfo Yordan lɛ.’ No hewɔ lɛ, tɛi nɛɛ baatsɔ̃ kaimɔ nɔ ahã Israelbii kɛya naanɔ.”

english_verse: The men followed the instructions that the Lord had given Joshua. They picked up twelve rocks, one for each tribe, and carried them to the camp, where they put them down.
translation_verse: Israelbii lɛ fee bɔ ni Yoshua fã amɛ lɛ: amɛhole tɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ teŋ yɛ Israelbii lɛ akutsei lɛ ayibɔ naa tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua lɛ. Amɛtere tɛi nɛɛ kɛba he ni Israelbii lɛ to shi yɛ gbi lɛ, ni amɛkɛ tɛi lɛ bamãmɔ shi yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: Joshua set up a monument next to the place where the priests were standing. This monument was also made of twelve large rocks, and it is still there in the middle of the river. The People of Israel Set Up Camp at Gilgal
translation_verse: Yoshua diɛŋtsɛ hu hole tɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ komɛi emãmɔ shi yɛ Yordan teŋ he ni osɔfoi ni tere Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ anaji mãmɔ lɛ. Tɛi nɛɛ yɛ jɛi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.

english_verse: It was the tenth day of the first month of the year when Israel crossed the Jordan River. They set up camp at Gilgal, which was east of the land controlled by Jericho.
translation_verse: Israelbii lɛ fo Yordan lɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Gilgal yɛ Yeriko bokãgbɛ husu lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The men who had carried the twelve rocks from the Jordan brought them to Joshua, and they made them into a monument.
translation_verse: Yoshua kɛ tɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni ahole yɛ Yordan lɛ mli lɛ mãmɔ shi yɛ Gilgal nɛɛ,
