translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni etsu ayakɛɛ Yehoshafat, Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ etse mihiɛ atua; ani ooofata mihe ni mikɛ Moabbii lɛ ayawu lo?” Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat hã hetoo akɛ, “Matee; mi nɔŋŋ ji bo, mimaŋ lɛ omaŋ ni, ni mikpɔŋɔi lɛ okpɔŋɔi ni.”

english_verse: But which way should we go?” “We will march through Edom Desert,” Joram replied.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehoshafat bi akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ wɔɔɔtsɔ̃ kɛtua amɛ lɛ?” Yehoram hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Wɔbaatsɔ̃ Edom ŋa lɛ nɔ gbɛ tɔ̃ɔ.”

english_verse: So Joram, Jehoshaphat, and the king of Edom led their troops out. But seven days later, there was no drinking water left for them or their animals.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoram kɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat kɛ Edom maŋtsɛ lɛ yiŋ amɛtee. Amɛkpa shi gbii kpawo, ni anaaa nu ahã tabilɔi lɛ kɛ kooloi ni amɛkɛnyiɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Joram cried out, “This is terrible! The Lord must have led us out here to be captured by Moab's army.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoram kɛɛ akɛ, “Ao! Yehowa etsɛ wɔ maŋtsɛmɛi etɛ̃ nɛɛ, koni etu wɔ ewo Moabbii adɛŋ!”

english_verse: Jehoshaphat said, “Which of the Lord's prophets is with us? We can find out from him what the Lord wants us to do.” One of Joram's officers answered, “Elisha son of Shaphat is here. He was one of Elijah's closest followers.”
translation_verse: Shi Yehoshafat bi akɛ, “Ani Yehowa gbalɔ ko bɛ biɛ nɛɛ ni wɔɔtee wɔyabi Yehowa nii yɛ eŋɔɔ?” Kɛkɛ ni Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ tsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Elisha, Shafat bi lɛ ni fɔse nu shwie Elia niji anɔ lɛ, yɛ biɛ.”

english_verse: Jehoshaphat replied, “He can give us the Lord's message.” The three kings went over to Elisha,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehoshafat kɛɛ akɛ “Yehowa gbalɔ ji lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat lɛ kɛ Edom maŋtsɛ lɛ tee Elisha ŋɔɔ.

english_verse: and he asked Joram, “Why did you come to me? Go talk to the prophets of the foreign gods your parents worshiped.” “No,” Joram answered. “It was the Lord who led us out here, so that Moab's army could capture us.”
translation_verse: Ni Elisha kɛɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ sane mikɛ bo yɔɔ? Yaa koni oyabi otsɛ gbalɔi kɛ onyɛ gbalɔi lɛ anii.” Shi Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat here nɔ akɛ, “Dabida, ejaakɛ Yehowa ji mɔ ni etsɛ wɔ maŋtsɛmɛi etɛ̃ nɛɛ kɛbakpe koni etu wɔ ewo Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ.”

english_verse: Elisha said to him, “I serve the Lord All-Powerful, and as surely as he lives, I swear I wouldn't even look at you if I didn't respect King Jehoshaphat.”
translation_verse: Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bei abɔ ni Yehowa, tai aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni misɔmɔɔ lɛ hiɛ kã nɛɛ, eji jeee Yehoshafat, Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛaŋ mihiɛ shwieɔ kulɛ, mikwɛŋ bo hiŋmɛileishi po, aahu ni makwɛ ohiɛ.

english_verse: Then Elisha said, “Send for someone who can play the harp.” The harpist began playing, and the Lord gave Elisha this message for Joram:
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ nyɛyaŋɔa saŋkutswalɔ ko nyɛbahãa mi”. Agbɛnɛ be ni saŋkutswalɔ lɛ tswaa esaŋku lɛ, Yehowa hewalɛ bayi Elisha nɔ;

english_verse: The Lord says that this dry riverbed will be filled with water.
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Nyɛtsaa bui yɛ nɛkɛ jɔɔ nɛɛ mli fɛɛ.

english_verse: You won't feel any wind or see any rain, but there will be plenty of water for you and your animals.
translation_verse: Nyɛnaŋ ahum, ni asaŋ nyɛnaŋ nunɛmɔ; shi kɛ̃lɛ nɛkɛ jɔɔ nɛɛ baayi tɔ kɛ nu, koni nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsinai lɛ kɛ nyɛlɛɛ kooloi lɛ fɛɛ anu.’ ”

english_verse: That simple thing isn't all the Lord is going to do. He will also help you defeat Moab's army.
translation_verse: Elisha tee nɔ akɛ, “Shi enɛ tete lɛ ejeee nɔ ko ni wa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; asaŋ ebaatu Moabbii lɛ hu ewo nyɛdɛŋ;

english_verse: You will capture all their walled cities and important towns. You will chop down every good tree and stop up every spring of water, then ruin their fertile fields by covering them with rocks.
translation_verse: ni nyɛaaye maŋ wulu fɛɛ maŋ wulu ni atswa gbogbo awo he, kɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ ni yɔɔ fɛo nɔ, ni nyɛaatoo tso kpakpa fɛɛ tso kpakpa, ni nyɛaatsimɔ nubu fɛɛ nubu, ni nyɛkɛ tɛi aaafite amɛshikpɔŋ kpakpai lɛ fɛɛ.”

english_verse: The next morning, while the sacrifice was being offered, water suddenly started flowing from the direction of Edom, and it flooded the land.
translation_verse: Enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi afɔle shãa be mli lɛ, naa nu jɛ Edom gbɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yi tɔ kɛ nu.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the people of Moab had heard that the three kings were coming to attack them. They had called together all of their fighting men, from the youngest to the oldest, and these troops were now standing at their border, ready for battle.
translation_verse: Be ni Moabbii lɛ fɛɛ nu akɛ maŋtsɛmɛi etɛ̃ lɛ efã kɛmiiba ni amɛkɛ amɛ abawu lɛ, ayabua mɛi fɛɛ ni eshɛ tayaa, kɛjɛ oblahii anɔ kɛyashi onukpai anɔ, anaa kɛba, ni akɛ amɛ badamɔ husu lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: When they got up that morning, the sun was shining across the water, making it look red. The Moabite troops took one look
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛte shi leebi maŋkpa, ni hulu miikpɛ yɛ nui lɛ anɔ lɛ, Moabbii lɛ na nu lɛ ni yɔɔ amɛhiɛ lɛ akɛ eetsu faa tamɔ lá.

english_verse: and shouted, “Look at that blood! The armies of those kings must have fought and killed each other. Come on, let's go take what's left in their camp.”
translation_verse: Ni Moabbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Lá nɛ; maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe ewuwui, agbɛnɛ nyɛhãa wɔyahaa amɛshitoohe lɛ mli nii.”

english_verse: But when they arrived at Israel's camp, the Israelite soldiers came out and attacked them, until they turned and ran away. Israel's army chased them all the way back to Moab, and even there they kept up the attack.
translation_verse: Shi be ni Moabbii lɛ shɛ Israelbii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ he lɛ, Israelbii lɛ te shi, ni amɛtua Moabbii lɛ, ni amɛtswia amɛ nii; ni Moabbii lɛ jo foi kɛje Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ, ni Israelbii lɛ bote Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛgbegbee Moabbii lɛ.

english_verse: The Israelites destroyed the Moabite towns. They chopped down the good trees and stopped up the springs of water, then covered the fertile fields with rocks. Finally, the only city left standing was Kir-Hareseth, but soldiers armed with slings surrounded and attacked it.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amɛbutu maji wuji lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ kpakpa fɛɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ ni amɛaatsɔ̃ lɛ, Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo shɛ etɛ efɔ̃ nɔ kɛyashi shikpɔji lɛ anɔ yi obɔ̃ tɔ kɛ tɛ. Amɛtsimɔ nubui fɛɛ; ni amɛtoo tsei kpakpai lɛ fɛɛ. Naagbee lɛ, maŋ wulu ni ashi pɛ ji Kir-Heres; kɛkɛ ni akromiafɔ̃lɔi lɛ yabɔle maŋ lɛ ni amɛŋɔ.

english_verse: He then grabbed his oldest son who was to be the next king and sacrificed him as an offering on the city wall. The Israelite troops were so horrified that they left the city and went back home.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni eŋɔ ebi nuu ni ji ekromɔbi, ni kulɛ ebaaye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ shã shãa afɔle yɛ gbogbo lɛ nɔ, ehã Moabbii anyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Enɛ wo Israelbii lɛ ahe gbeyei ni amɛgbala amɛhe shi kɛje maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: One day the widow of one of the Lord's prophets said to Elisha, “You know that before my husband died, he was a follower of yours and a worshiper of the Lord. But he owed a man some money, and now that man is on his way to take my two sons as his slaves.”
translation_verse: Gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ŋa okulafo tee Elisha ŋɔɔ, ni eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ataa, naa, otsulɔ ni ji miwu lɛ egbo, ni ole akɛ esheɔ Yehowa gbeyei. Shi amrɔ nɛɛ mɔ ko ni miwu lɛ hiɛ lɛ nyɔmɔ ebamɔmɔ mibihii lɛ kɛtee eyafee amɛ enyɔji.”

english_verse: “Maybe there's something I can do to help,” Elisha said. “What do you have in your house?” “Sir, I have nothing but a small bottle of olive oil.”
translation_verse: Elisha bi yoo lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni mifee mihã bo? Kɛɛmɔ mi. Mɛni oyɔɔ yɛ shĩa?” Yoo lɛ hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Otsulɔ yoo bɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ shĩa, akɛ ja mu tɔ kometoo pɛ kɛkɛ.”

english_verse: Elisha told her, “Ask your neighbors for their empty jars. And after you've borrowed as many as you can,
translation_verse: Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa akutso lɛ mli bii fɛɛ aŋɔɔ ni oyamala gbɛi foji babaoo, bɔ ni ooonyɛ.

english_verse: go home and shut the door behind you and your sons. Then begin filling the jars with oil and set each one aside as you fill it.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ yaa shĩa lɛ mli koni oŋa shinaa lɛ owo bo kɛ obii lɛ ayi; koni obɔ̃i mu lɛ fɔsemɔ kɛwo gbɛi lɛ fɛɛ amli; kɛji eko yi obɔ̃ lɛ, wo oma sɛɛ flɛŋŋ.”

english_verse: The woman left. Later, when she and her sons were back inside their house, the two sons brought her the jars, and she began filling them.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni yoo okulafo lɛ shi gbalɔ Elisha, ni etee eyaŋa shinaa lɛ ewo ekɛ ebihii lɛ ayi. Ni be ni amɛholeɔ gbɛi lɛ kɛbaa lɛ, belɛ eefɔse mu lɛ eewowoo amɛmli.

english_verse: At last, she said to one of her sons, “Bring me another jar.” “We don't have any more,” he answered, and the oil stopped flowing from the small bottle.
translation_verse: Be ni gbɛi lɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ lɛ, ekɛɛ ebi nuu lɛ akɛ, “Wo gbɛ kroko hu kɛba!” Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Gbɛ lɛ eko bɛ dɔŋŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni mu lɛ sɛɛ fo.

english_verse: After she told Elisha what had happened, he said, “Sell the oil and use part of the money to pay what you owe the man. You and your sons can live on what is left.” Elisha Brings a Rich Woman's Son Back to Life
translation_verse: Yoo okulafo lɛ tee Elisha, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ ni eyabɔ lɛ amaniɛ. Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa ni oyahɔ̃ɔ mu lɛ koni okɛwo onyɔmɔ lɛ; ni nɔ ni aaashwɛ lɛ, okɛ obihii lɛ, nyɛkɛkwɛa nyɛhe.” Elisha kɛ Shunem yoo niiatsɛ lɛ

english_verse: Once, while Elisha was in the town of Shunem, he met a rich woman who invited him to her home for dinner. After that, whenever he was in Shunem, he would have a meal there with her and her husband.
translation_verse: Gbi ko lɛ Elisha tee Shunem; yoo niiatsɛ ko yɛ jɛi. Yoo nɛɛ kpee Elisha kɛtee ewe lɛ koni ebaye nii. No hewɔ lɛ, be fɛɛ be ni Elisha tsɔ̃ɔ jɛi kɛhoɔ lɛ, egbaleɔ jɛi eyayeɔ nii.

english_verse: Some time later the woman said to her husband, “I'm sure the man who comes here so often is a prophet of God.
translation_verse: Yoo nɛɛ kɛɛ ewu akɛ, “Naa, agbɛnɛ, miyoo akɛ nuu nɛɛ ni batsɔ̃ɔ wɔŋɔɔ daa nɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.

english_verse: Why don't we build him a small room on the flat roof of our house? We can put a bed, a table and chair, and an oil lamp in it. Then whenever he comes, he can stay with us.”
translation_verse: Hã wɔma gbogbo tsu fioo ko, ni wɔkɛ saatso kɛ okplɔ̃ kɛ sɛi kɛ kane amãmɔ mli ahã lɛ, koni be fɛɛ be kɛji eba wɔŋɔɔ lɛ ebahi jɛi.”

english_verse: The next time Elisha was in Shunem, he stopped at their house and went up to his room to rest.
translation_verse: Gbi ko lɛ Elisha ku esɛɛ kɛba Shunem, ni etee tsu lɛ mli, ni eyajɔɔ ehe yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: He said to his servant Gehazi, “This woman has been very helpful. Have her come up here to the roof for a moment.” She came, and Elisha told Gehazi to say to her, “You've gone to a lot of trouble for us, and we want to help you. Is there something we can request the king or army commander to do?” The woman answered, “With my relatives nearby, I have everything I need.”
translation_verse: Elisha kɛɛ Gehazi akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ yoo lɛ akɛ, ‘Kwɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni ogba ohe naa yɛ wɔhewɔ; mɛni ooosumɔ akɛ mifee mihã bo? Ani oyɛ sane ko ni ooosumɔ akɛ ayakɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ loo asraafoiatsɛ lɛ lo?’ ” Yoo lɛ hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Mi diɛŋtsɛ mimaŋbii ateŋ miyɔɔ lɛ, ni nɔ ko he ehiaaa mi.”

english_verse: “Then what can we do for her?” Elisha asked Gehazi. Gehazi replied, “I do know that her husband is old, and that she doesn't have a son.”
translation_verse: Elisha bi Gehazi akɛ, “Belɛ mɛni afee ahã lɛ mɔ?” Gehazi to he akɛ, “Ebɛ binuu, ni ewu hu egbɔ.”

english_verse: “Ask her to come here again,” Elisha told his servant. He called for her, and she came and stood in the doorway of Elisha's room.
translation_verse: Elisha kɛɛ Gehazi akɛ, “Tsɛ yoo lɛ kɛba.” Ni etsɛ lɛ, ni ebadamɔ shinaa lɛ shi.

english_verse: Elisha said to her, “Next year at this time, you'll be holding your own baby son in your arms.” “You're a man of God,” the woman replied. “Please don't lie to me.”
translation_verse: Elisha kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Wɔsɛɛ afi naakplɔ benɛ lɛ, ooohiɛ binuu yɛ okpɔkɔiaŋ.” Yoo lɛ kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Dabida minuŋtsɔ, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ji bo, kaalaka mi.”

english_verse: But a few months later, the woman got pregnant. She gave birth to a son, just as Elisha had promised.
translation_verse: Be ni shɛ afi naakplɔ lɛ, yoo lɛ na musu, ni efɔ binuu tamɔ bɔ ni Elisha ekɛɛ lɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: One day while the boy was still young, he was out in the fields with his father, where the workers were harvesting the crops.
translation_verse: Be ni gbekɛ lɛ bada lɛ, gbi ko lɛ etee etsɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ ŋmãakulɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Suddenly he shouted, “My head hurts. It hurts a lot!” “Carry him back to his mother,” the father said to his servant.
translation_verse: Trukaa lɛ, gbekɛ lɛ bolɔ ekɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, “Miyitso miigba mi, miyitso miigba mi.” Etsɛ kɛɛ tsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Wo lɛ oyahã enyɛ!”

english_verse: loaves of bread made from the first barley that was harvested. Elisha said, “Give it to the people so they can eat.”
translation_verse: Ni ewo lɛ eyahã enyɛ. Gbekɛ lɛ ta enyɛ shuɔ nɔ kɛyashi shwane, ni egbo.

english_verse: She carried him upstairs to Elisha's room and laid him across the bed. Then she walked out and shut the door behind her.
translation_verse: Ni ewo gbonyo lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ kwɔ kɛtee eyafɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ saa lɛ nɔ, ni eŋa shinaa ewo eyi, ni eje kpo.

english_verse: The woman called to her husband, “I need to see the prophet. Let me use one of the donkeys. Send a servant along with me, and let me leave now, so I can get back quickly.”
translation_verse: Ebo etsɛ ewu lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ hã mi oblahii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛ teji yei lɛ ateŋ ekome koni masha mihe maya Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ maba!

english_verse: “Why do you need to see him today?” her husband asked. “It's not the Sabbath or time for the New Moon Festival.” “That's all right,” she answered.
translation_verse: Ewu lɛ bi lɛ akɛ “Mɛni hewɔ otaoɔ ni oya eŋɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ?” Ŋmɛnɛ jeee nyɔŋ hee, asaŋ ejeee hejɔɔmɔ gbi. Yoo lɛ here nɔ akɛ, “Kaaye otsui.”

english_verse: She saddled the donkey and said to her servant, “Let's go. And don't slow down unless I tell you to.”
translation_verse: Ehã awo teji yoo lɛ nɔ nii ahã lɛ; kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Wo teji lɛ foi ni wɔtee; kaagbɔjɔ foijee lɛ mli yɛ mihewɔ, ja mikɛɛ bo akɛ ogbɔjɔ mli.”

english_verse: She left at once for Mount Carmel to talk with Elisha. When Elisha saw her coming, he said, “Gehazi, look! It's the woman from Shunem.
translation_verse: Ni eyi mli etee Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Ni eba mli akɛ be ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ na lɛ yɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ, ekɛɛ etsulɔ Gehazi akɛ: “Naa, Shunamyoo lɛ baa lɛ.

english_verse: Run and meet her. And ask her if everything is all right with her and her family.” “Everything is fine,” she answered Gehazi.
translation_verse: “Sha foi amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ koni okɛ lɛ ayakpe, ni obi lɛ akɛ: ‘Te oyɔɔ tɛŋŋ? Te owu hu yɔɔ tɛŋŋ? Te gbekɛ lɛ hu yɔɔ tɛŋŋ?’ ” Yoo lɛ here nɔ akɛ, “Wɔyɛ jogbaŋŋ!”

english_verse: But as soon as she got to the top of the mountain, she went over and grabbed Elisha by the feet. Gehazi started toward her to push her away, when Elisha said, “Leave her alone! Don't you see how sad she is? But the Lord hasn't told me why.”
translation_verse: Be ni Shunamyoo lɛ shɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ebamɔmɔ enaji amli. Kɛkɛ ni Gehazi tsi bɛŋkɛ koni etsi lɛ kɛya sɛɛ. Shi Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Ŋmɛɛ lɛ gbɛ ni emɔ mimli, ejaakɛ esusuma ehao naakpa yɛ emli; ni Yehowa kɛtee mi, ni ejieko etsɔ̃ko mi.”

english_verse: The woman said, “Sir, I begged you not to get my hopes up, and I didn't even ask you for a son.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Shunamyoo lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Ani mibaba bi nuu ko yɛ minuŋtsɔ dɛŋ? Ani mikɛɛɛ bo akɛ okalaka mi?”

english_verse: “Gehazi, get ready and go to her house,” Elisha said. “Take along my walking stick, and when you get there, lay it on the boy's face. Don't stop to talk to anyone, even if they try to talk to you.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Elisha kɛɛ Gehazi akɛ, “Miamɔ, ni okɔ midɛŋhiɛmɔtso lɛ ohiɛ odɛ̃, ni oya. Kɛji okɛ mɔ ko kpe yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kaaŋa lɛ; ni kɛji mɔ ko ŋa bo lɛ, kaahere lɛ nɔ, ni oya ni okɛ mitso lɛ ayafɔ gbekɛ lɛ hiɛŋtso nɔ.”

english_verse: But the boy's mother said to Elisha, “I swear by the living Lord and by your own life that I won't leave without you.” So Elisha got up and went with them.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni gbekɛ lɛ nyɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Bei abɔ ni Yehowa hiɛkãalɔ lɛ yɔɔ, ni bo hu oyɔɔ nɛɛ lɛ, mishiŋ bo miyaŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛyi mli amɛtee.

english_verse: Gehazi ran on ahead and laid Elisha's walking stick on the boy's face, but the boy didn't move or make a sound. Gehazi ran back to Elisha and said, “The boy didn't wake up.”
translation_verse: Gehazi tsɔ̃ amɛhiɛ kɛtee, ni ekɛ tso lɛ yafɔ̃ gbekɛ lɛ hiɛŋtso nɔ. Shi gbekɛ lɛ ewieee, ni nɔ ko etsɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ wala yɛ emli. Hewɔ lɛ Gehazi ku esɛɛ ni ekɛ Elisha yakpe, ni ekɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Gbekɛ lɛ hiɛ etsɛ̃ko.”

english_verse: Elisha arrived at the woman's house and went straight to his room, where he saw the boy's body on his bed.
translation_verse: Be ni Elisha bote shĩa lɛ mli lɛ, ena gbekɛ lɛ ni egbo lɛ kã esaa lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: He walked in, shut the door, and prayed to the Lord.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, ebote tsu lɛ mli, ni eŋa shinaa lɛ ewo amɛyi enyɔ lɛ amɛyi, ni esɔle ekpa Yehowa fai.

english_verse: Then he got on the bed and stretched out over the dead body, with his mouth on the boy's mouth, his eyes on his eyes, and his hand on his hands. As he lay there, the boy's body became warm.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni ekwɔ saatso lɛ ni eyabu gbekɛ lɛ nɔ; ni ekɛ enaabu bu enaabu nɔ; ni ekɛ ehiŋmɛii bumɔ ehiŋmɛii anɔ, ni ekɛ eniji hu shwie eniji anɔ, ni ekpã emli ebu gbekɛ lɛ nɔ. Ni gbekɛ lɛ he dɔ la.

english_verse: Elisha got up and walked back and forth in the room, then he went back and leaned over the boy's body. The boy sneezed seven times and opened his eyes.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ, Elisha te shi, ni eshara shi kɛtee kɛba shi kome yɛ tsu lɛ mli, ni esaa eyakpã emli ebu gbekɛ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ. Gbekɛ lɛ tsine shii kpawo, kɛkɛ ni egbele ehiŋmɛi.

english_verse: Elisha called out to Gehazi, “Ask the boy's mother to come here.” Gehazi did, and when she was at the door, Elisha said, “You can take your son.”
translation_verse: Elisha tsɛ Gehazi kɛba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Tsɛ Shunam yoo lɛ kɛba.” Ni etee eyatsɛ lɛ kɛba. Be ni yoo lɛ ba lɛ, Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wo obi lɛ.”

english_verse: She came in and bowed down at Elisha's feet. Then she picked up her son and left. Elisha Makes Some Stew Taste Better
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni eba, ni ebaho egbee Elisha najianaa, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi; no sɛɛ lɛ ewo ebi lɛ kɛje kpo. Naakpɛɛ nibii enyɔ komɛi hu ni Elisha fee

english_verse: Later, Elisha went back to Gilgal, where there was almost nothing to eat, because the crops had failed. One day while the prophets who lived there were meeting with Elisha, he said to his servant, “Prepare a big pot of stew for these prophets.”
translation_verse: Be ni Elisha ku esɛɛ eba Gilgal ekoŋŋ lɛ, no mli lɛ hɔmɔ eba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Gbi ko be mli ni gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii tara shi lɛ, ekɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ kukwɛi wulu lɛ oma la nɔ, ni ohoo nii ohã gbalɔi nɛɛ.”

english_verse: One of them went out into the woods to gather some herbs. He found a wild vine and picked as much of its fruit as he could carry, but he didn't know that the fruit was very sour. When he got back, he cut up the fruit and put it in the stew.
translation_verse: Gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome je kpo etee ŋa nɔ koni eyatse shwie. Eyana ŋa nɔ baa ko ni haa shi; ni etserɛ baa nɛɛ eko ewo emama naa obɔ̃; ebafolɔ mli ewo kukwɛi ni ma la lɛ nɔ lɛ mli; tsɛbelɛ amɛleee nɔ baa ni ji.

english_verse: The stew was served, and when the prophets started eating it, they shouted, “Elisha, this stew tastes terrible! We can't eat it.”
translation_verse: Amɛtsɔ niyenii lɛ amɛhã mɛi lɛ ni amɛye. Be ni amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Ao, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, ebɔɔ yɛ niyenii lɛ mli.” Ni amɛnyɛɛɛ niyenii lɛ amɛye.

english_verse: “Bring me some flour,” Elisha said. He sprinkled the flour in the stew and said, “Now serve it to them.” And the stew tasted fine. Elisha Feeds One Hundred People
translation_verse: Elisha kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ mamu abaa!” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ mamu lɛ wo kukwɛi lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛtsɔa nyɛhãa mɛi lɛ ni amɛyea.” Ni nɔ ko fɔŋ ko efeee amɛ.

english_verse: So the servant served the bread and grain to the people. They ate and still had some left over, just as the Lord had promised.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, tsulɔ lɛ ŋɔ niyenii lɛ ema amɛhiɛ, ni amɛye, ni eko shwɛ, yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa.

english_verse: Naaman was the commander of the Syrian army. The Lord had helped him and his troops defeat their enemies, so the king of Syria respected Naaman very much. Naaman was a brave soldier, but he had leprosy.
translation_verse: Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ asafoiatsɛnukpa ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Naaman; gbɔmɔ wulu ji lɛ, ni enuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ buɔ lɛ ejaakɛ lɛ enɔ Yehowa tsɔ̃ ehã Siriabii lɛ ye kunim. Eyɛŋ akɛ eji asraafonyo kãkãlɔ kpanaa nɛ, shi eeye kpiti.

english_verse: One day while the Syrian troops were raiding Israel, they captured a girl, and she became a servant of Naaman's wife.
translation_verse: Be ko lɛ, Siriabii lɛ yatua Israelbii lɛ, ni amɛŋɔ gbekɛ oblayoo fioo ko nom ni eyasɔ̃mɔ Naaman ŋa lɛ.

english_verse: the king replied, “Go ahead! I will give you a letter to take to the king of Israel.” Naaman left and took along
translation_verse: Ni Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Yaa mɔ! Maŋma wolo mahã bo kɛyahã Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Naaman ŋɔ jwiɛtɛi talentai nyɔŋma kɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi shekel akpei ekpaa kɛ hewulamɔ atadei srɔtoi nyɔŋma kɛtee.

english_verse: He also carried the letter to the king of Israel. It said, “I am sending my servant Naaman to you. Would you cure him of his leprosy?”
translation_verse: Ni ekɛ wolo lɛ yahã Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni aŋmã yɛ wolo lɛ mli akɛ, “Mikɛ wolo nɛɛ miihã ole akɛ mi ji mɔ ni miwo Naaman gbɛ kɛba oŋɔɔ nɛɛ. Eba koni otsa ekpiti lɛ ohã lɛ.”

english_verse: Elisha sent someone outside to say to him, “Go wash seven times in the Jordan River. Then you'll be completely cured.”
translation_verse: Elisha tsu bɔfo ko kɛtee eŋɔɔ akɛ, “Yaa ni oyaju ohe shii kpawo yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ mli ni aaatsa ohela lɛ ahã bo kwraa.”

english_verse: When the king of Israel read the letter, he tore his clothes in fear and shouted, “That Syrian king believes I can cure this man of leprosy! Does he think I'm God with power over life and death? He must be trying to pick a fight with me.”
translation_verse: Be ni Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ kane wolo lɛ, egbala ehe atadei ni ekɛɛ, “Aso Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi ni migbeɔ mɔ, ni mihãa mɔ yi naa wala, hewɔ ni mɔnɛ tsuɔ miŋɔɔ akɛ mitsa mɔ ko kpiti mihã lɛ nɛɛ? Nyɛjwɛŋa he nyɛkwɛa ni nyɛaana akɛ minaa bei kɛkɛ etaoɔ nɛɛ.”

english_verse: As soon as Elisha the prophet heard what had happened, he sent the Israelite king this message: “Why are you so afraid? Send the man to me, so that he will know there is a prophet in Israel.”
translation_verse: Shi be ni Elisha, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ, nu akɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ egbala ehe atadei lɛ, etsu atee maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ni ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba ogbala ohe atadei lɛ? Hã eba miŋɔɔ, ni eeena ele akɛ gbalɔ ko yɛ Israel.”

english_verse: Naaman left with his horses and chariots and stopped at the door of Elisha's house.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Naaman kɛ ekpɔŋɔ kɛ eshwiilii lɛ ba ni amɛbadamɔ Elisha we lɛ agbo lɛ naa.

english_verse: But Naaman stormed off, grumbling, “Why couldn't he come out and talk to me? I thought for sure he would stand in front of me and pray to the Lord his God, then wave his hand over my skin and cure me.
translation_verse: Shi Naaman mli fu ni eyiŋ kɛmiiya, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, miyiŋ fɛɛ lɛ eeeje kpo kɛba miŋɔɔ ebadamɔ shi, ni eeetsɛ Yehowa eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi, ni ekɛ enine aaahuu jɛi koni etsa kpiti lɛ.

english_verse: What about the Abana River or the Pharpar River? Those rivers in Damascus are just as good as any river in Israel. I could have washed in them and been cured.”
translation_verse: Ani Abana Faa kɛ Farpar Faa ni yɔɔ Damasko lɛ, amɛhiii fe Israel fai lɛ fɛɛ lo? Kɛji nakai ni lɛ, kulɛ mɛɛba mijuuu mihe yɛ nomɛi amli ni mihe tã mɔ?” Ni etsɔ̃ ehe ni eyi mli ni kulɛ eeya kɛ mlifu.

english_verse: His servants went over to him and said, “Sir, if the prophet had told you to do something difficult, you would have done it. So why don't you do what he said? Go wash and be cured.”
translation_verse: Shi etsuji lɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ lɛ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ wie akɛ, “Ataa, ani nɔ ko wulu ko gbalɔ lɛ kɛɛ ofee kulɛ, ofeŋ lo? Aahuu moŋ ni ekɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Yaaju ohe kɛkɛ ni ohe atã lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Naaman walked down to the Jordan; he waded out into the water and stooped down in it seven times, just as Elisha had told him. At once, he was cured, and his skin became as smooth as a child's.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Naaman kpeleke shi, ni ekɛ ehe yatsɔ Yordan Faa lɛ mli shii kpawo tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ wie lɛ, ni ehe tã, ni ehewolo nɔ bafee trotro ekoŋŋ tamɔ gbekɛ fioo hewolo.

english_verse: Naaman and his officials went back to Elisha. Naaman stood in front of him and announced, “Now I know that the God of Israel is the only God in the whole world. Sir, would you please accept a gift from me?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Naaman ku esɛɛ eba Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, lɛ kɛ emɛi ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ fɛɛ. Eba ni ebadamɔ shi yɛ Elisha hiɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, kpaako mina mile akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɔŋmɔ ko nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ ni tamɔ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, ofainɛ ni ohe otsulɔ dɛŋ nikeenii ko.”

english_verse: “I am a servant of the living Lord,” Elisha answered, “and I swear that I will not take anything from you.” Naaman kept begging, but Elisha kept refusing.
translation_verse: Elisha hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Gbii abɔ ni Yehowa, mɔ ni misɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ, hiɛ kã nɛɛ, miheee nɔ ko.” Ni enyɛ enɔ doo akɛ ehe kɛ̃, shi Elisha ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ.

english_verse: Finally Naaman said, “If you won't accept a gift, then please let me take home as much soil as two mules can pull in a wagon. Sir, from now on I will offer sacrifices only to the Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Naaman kɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛji oheee midɛŋ nikee lɛ, belɛ ofainɛ ni ohã ni ahã mi sũ, bɔ ni teji okpɔŋɔi enyɔ aaatere; ejaakɛ kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ, mi otsulɔ, mishaŋ shãa afɔle loo afɔle kroko mihaŋ nyɔŋmɔ ko nyɔŋmɔ ko dɔŋŋ, akɛ ja Yehowa kɛkɛ.

english_verse: But I pray that the Lord will forgive me when I go into the temple of the god Rimmon and bow down there with the king of Syria.”
translation_verse: Kɛji minuŋtsɔ tee Rimmon, Siria nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, we lɛ ni eyaaja lɛ, ekpasaa minine. Kɛji maŋtsɛ lɛ koto shi eeja lɛ, esa akɛ mikɛ lɛ akoto shi eko yɛ Rimmon we lɛ. Kɛji eeeba lɛ nakai lɛ, Yehowa aŋɔfa mi, otsulɔ.”

english_verse: “Go on home, and don't worry about that,” Elisha replied. Then Naaman left. Elisha Places a Curse on Gehazi After Naaman had gone only a short distance,
translation_verse: Ni Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa yɛ hejɔlɛ mli.” Kɛkɛ ni Naaman yi gbɛ etee.

english_verse: Gehazi said to himself, “Elisha let that Syrian off too easy. He should have taken Naaman's gift. I swear by the living Lord that I will talk to Naaman myself and get something from him.”
translation_verse: Naaman shɛko he ko shɔŋŋ ko kɛkɛ ni Gehazi, Elisha Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ ehe akɛ, “Naa, minuŋtsɔ eŋɔ Naaman, Sirianyo nɛɛ, he eke lɛ, ni eheee nɔ ni ekɛba lɛ yɛ edɛŋ. Akɛni Yehowa hiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, masha foi kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ koni mayahe nɔ ko yɛ edɛŋ.”

english_verse: So he hurried after Naaman. When Naaman saw Gehazi running after him, he got out of his chariot to meet him. Naaman asked, “Is everything all right?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Gehazi ŋɔ shwie Naaman sɛɛ. Shi be ni Naaman na akɛ mɔ ko hiɛ foi kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ eyi shi kɛjɛ eshwiili lɛ mli koni ekɛ lɛ ayakpe. Naaman bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni eba?”

english_verse: “Yes,” Gehazi answered. “But my master has sent me to tell you about two young prophets from the hills of Ephraim. They came asking for help, and now Elisha wants to know if you would give them
translation_verse: Ni Gehazi hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Nɔ ko bako. Minuŋtsɔ tsu mi koni mibakɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ ejɛ Efraim gɔŋ lɛ nɔ eba miŋɔɔ; ofainɛ ni ohã amɛ jwiɛtɛi talenta kome kɛ hewulamɔ atadei enyɔ.’ ”

english_verse: “Sure,” Naaman replied. “But why don't you take twice that amount of silver?” He convinced Gehazi to take it all, then put the silver in two bags. He handed the bags and the clothes to his two servants, and they carried them for Gehazi.
translation_verse: Naaman kɛɛ akɛ, “Hã ni mahã bo jwiɛtɛi talentai enyɔ koni okɛya!” Ni enyɛ enɔ, ni efimɔ jwiɛtɛi talentai enyɔ lɛ ewo kotokui enyɔ amli, kɛ hewulamɔ atadei fɛɛfɛji srɔtoi enyɔ lɛ. Ni eŋɔ tere etsuji enyɔ kɛnyiɛ Gehazi hiɛ.

english_verse: When they reached the hill where Gehazi lived, he took the bags from the servants and placed them in his house, then sent the men away. After they had gone,
translation_verse: Shi be ni amɛshɛ gɔŋ ni Elisha yɔɔ nɔ lɛ he lɛ, Gehazi he kotokui lɛ yɛ Naaman tsuji lɛ adɛŋ, ni ekɛyato shĩa lɛ mli, ni ewo Naaman tsuji lɛ agbɛ, ni amɛtee.

english_verse: Gehazi went in and stood in front of Elisha, who asked, “Gehazi, where have you been?” “Nowhere, sir,” Gehazi answered.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni etee eyadamɔ enuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ. Elisha bi lɛ akɛ, “Gehazi, nɛgbɛ ojɛ?” Ni ehã hetoo akɛ, “Otsulɔ eyako he ko he ko.”

english_verse: Elisha asked, “Don't you know that my spirit was there when Naaman got out of his chariot to talk with you? Gehazi, you have no right to accept money or clothes, olive orchards or vineyards, sheep or cattle, or servants.
translation_verse: Shi Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo lɛ oleee akɛ yɛ mumɔ mli lɛ miyɛ jɛi, be mli ni nuu lɛ yi shi kɛjɛ eshwiili lɛ mli ni ekɛ bo bakpe lɛ? Ani be ni aŋɔɔ shika kɛ atadei kɛ mutsei kɛ waintromi kɛ too gwantɛŋi kɛ toi kɛ tsinai kɛ wehii kɛ weyei yɛ mɔ dɛŋ nɛ?

english_verse: Because of what you've done, Naaman's leprosy will now be on you and your descendants forever!” Suddenly, Gehazi's skin became white with leprosy, and he left.
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Naaman kpiti lɛ aaatsɛŋe bo kɛ oshwiei fɛɛ kɛaatee naanɔ.” Ni eje ehiɛ eje kpo kɛ ehe kpiti sakoo tamɔ ayilɔ.

english_verse: One day the prophets said to Elisha, “The place where we meet with you is too small.
translation_verse: Gbi ko lɛ gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Naa, he ni wɔ owebii nɛɛ wɔyɔɔ lɛ, yɛ kplokotoo tsɔ̃ hã wɔ.

english_verse: Why don't we build a new meeting place near the Jordan River? Each of us could get some wood, then we could build it.” “That's a good idea,” Elisha replied, “get started.”
translation_verse: Hewɔ lɛ ŋmɛɛ wɔ gbɛ ní wɔya Yordan Faa lɛ naa wɔyafolɔ tsei ni wɔkɛbafee shihilɛhei wɔhã wɔhe yɛ jɛi.” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa.”

english_verse: “Aren't you going with us?” one of the prophets asked. “Yes, I'll go,” Elisha answered,
translation_verse: Shi amɛteŋ mɔ kome kɛɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, ni okɛ wɔ otsuji aya.” Ni ekpɛlɛ̃ nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mi kɛ nyɛ baaya.”

english_verse: and he left with them. They went to the Jordan River and began chopping down trees.
translation_verse: Hewɔ lɛ ekɛ amɛ tee. Ni be ni amɛshɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa lɛ amɛtootoo tsei lɛ.

english_verse: “Where did it fall in?” Elisha asked. The prophet pointed to the place, and Elisha cut a stick and threw it into the water at that spot. The ax head floated to the top of the water.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Elisha bi akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ eyagbee lɛ?” Be ni atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ jɛi lɛ, Elisha fo tso kuku ko ni eshɛ efɔ̃ jɛi, kɛkɛ ni amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni dade lɛ batɛo nu lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: “Now get it,” Elisha told him. And the prophet reached in and grabbed it. Elisha Stops an Invasion of the Syrian Army
translation_verse: Ni efã akɛ, “Yaakɔ!” Kɛkɛ ni nuu lɛ kpã enine mli ni ekɔ. Aye Siria ta nɔ kunim

english_verse: Time after time, when the king of Syria was at war against the Israelites, he met with his officers and announced, “I've decided where we will set up camp.”
translation_verse: Be ko lɛ ta te shi yɛ Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ. Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ etatsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋɔ, ni amɛkɔɔ he ni amɛkɛbaafee amɛshitoohe.

english_verse: Each time, Elisha would send this warning to the king of Israel: “Don't go near there. That's where the Syrian troops have set up camp.”
translation_verse: Shi Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ Elisha lɛ leɔ enɛ, ni etswaa Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ adafi akɛ, “Kwɛmɔ ni ahi koni okatsɔ̃ jɛi kɛmiiho ejaakɛ Siriabii lɛ miiya jɛi.”

english_verse: So the king would warn the Israelite troops in that place to be on guard.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ etsu kɛtee he ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ etswa lɛ he adafi lɛ. Enɛ tee nɔ shii abɔ.

english_verse: The king of Syria was furious when he found out what was happening. He called in his officers and asked, “Which one of you has been telling the king of Israel our plans?”
translation_verse: Enɛ ye Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ tsui naakpa; no hewɔ lɛ, etsɛ etsuji lɛ, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Aso nyɛtsɔ̃ŋ mi wɔteŋ mɔ ni yɔɔ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ gbɛfaŋ lo?”

english_verse: “None of us, Your Majesty,” one of them answered. “It's an Israelite named Elisha. He's a prophet, so he can tell his king everything—even what you say in your own room.”
translation_verse: Ni etsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Jeee wɔteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko ni, minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ; shi moŋ, Elisha, gbalɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ Israel lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni gbaa Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ wiemɔi ni owieɔ yɛ osɛɛtsu lɛ mli tete lɛ.”

english_verse: “Find out where he is!” the king ordered. “I'll send soldiers to bring him here.” They learned that Elisha was in the town of Dothan and reported it to the king.
translation_verse: Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ fã akɛ, “Nyɛyaa nyɛyataoa he ni eyɔɔ, ni matsu ni ayamɔ lɛ kɛba.” Kɛkɛ ni akɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, eyɛ Dotan.”

english_verse: He ordered his best troops to go there with horses and chariots. They marched out during the night and surrounded the town.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, etsu ta kpele kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ tayaa shwiilii kɛtee jɛi. Amɛshɛ jɛi nyɔɔŋ, ni amɛgba amɛbɔle maŋ lɛ.

english_verse: When Elisha's servant got up the next morning, he saw that Syrian troops had the town surrounded. “Sir, what are we going to do?” he asked.
translation_verse: Leebi maŋkpa lɛ, Elisha Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ tsulɔ lɛ te shi, ni eje kpo, ni ena Siria tabilɔi kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ shwiilii ni amɛbɔle maŋ lɛ. Tsulɔ lɛ ku esɛɛ etee Elisha ŋɔɔ ni eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ao minuŋtsɔ, te wɔbaafee tɛŋŋ?”

english_verse: “Don't be afraid,” Elisha answered. “There are more troops on our side than on theirs.”
translation_verse: Elisha here nɔ akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei ejaakɛ mɛi ni kɛ wɔ yɔɔ lɛ fa fe mɛi ni kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: Then he prayed, “Lord, please help him to see.” And the Lord let the servant see that the hill was covered with fiery horses and flaming chariots all around Elisha.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Elisha sɔle akɛ, “Ao Yehowa, miikpa bo fai, gbelemɔ ehiŋmɛii ni ena nii!” No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa gbele oblanyo lɛ hiŋmɛii ni ena nii; ni naa, gɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ la shwiilii kɛbɔle Elisha he kɛkpe.

english_verse: As the Syrian army came closer, Elisha prayed, “Lord, make those soldiers blind!” And the Lord blinded them with a bright light.
translation_verse: Be ni Siriabii lɛ kpeleke shi kɛba Elisha mɔmɔ lɛ, Elisha kpa Yehowa fai akɛ, “Ofainɛ, hã gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ashwi la!” Ni amɛshwi la yɛ Elisha sɔlemɔ lɛ naa.

english_verse: Elisha told the enemy troops, “You've taken the wrong road and are in the wrong town. Follow me. I'll lead you to the man you're looking for.” Elisha led them straight to the capital city of Samaria.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Elisha tee amɛŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Jeee gbɛ lɛ nɛ, ni jeee maŋ ni nyɛtaoɔ lɛ hu nɛ. Nyɛnyiɛa misɛɛ, ni mikɛ nyɛ baaya nuu lɛ ni nyɛtaoɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.” Ni ekɛ amɛ tee Samaria tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: When all the soldiers were inside the city, Elisha prayed, “Lord, now let them see again.” The Lord let them see that they were standing in the middle of Samaria.
translation_verse: Amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni amɛshɛ Samaria lɛ Elisha sɔle akɛ, “Ao Yehowa, gbelemɔ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahiŋmɛii koni amɛna nii.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa gbele amɛhiŋmɛii ni amɛna nii; ni naa, amɛna akɛ amɛyɛ Samaria.

english_verse: The king of Israel saw them and asked Elisha, “Should I kill them, sir?”
translation_verse: Be ni Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ na amɛ lɛ, ebi Elisha akɛ, “Mitsɛ, ani mitswia amɛ nii? Ani migbe amɛ lo?”

english_verse: “No!” Elisha answered. “You didn't capture these troops in battle, so you have no right to kill them. Instead, give them something to eat and drink and let them return to their leader.”
translation_verse: Elisha hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Dabida, kaatswia amɛ nii ni ogbe amɛ. Ani mɛi po ni okɛ oklante kɛ ogãi yaŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ, ogbeɔ amɛ? Ŋmɛɛ amɛ okplɔ̃ koni amɛye nii, ni amɛnu nii koni ohã amɛya amɛnuŋtsɔ ŋɔɔ.”

english_verse: The king ordered a huge meal to be prepared for Syria's army, and when they finished eating, he let them go. For a while, the Syrian troops stopped invading Israel's territory. King Benhadad of Syria Attacks Samaria
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋmɛ amɛ okplɔ̃ kpele ko, ni be ni amɛye nii ni amɛnu nii, lɛ, ewo amɛ gbɛ, ni amɛtee amɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ. Kɛjɛ no sɛɛ lɛ Siriabii lɛ baaa Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛbayeee ofɔ̃ dɔŋŋ! Asa Samaria Yi

english_verse: Some time later, King Benhadad of Syria called his entire army together, then they marched to Samaria and attacked.
translation_verse: Be kplaŋŋ ko sɛɛ lɛ Siria Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad bua eta lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe, ni amɛfã kɛtee amɛyasa Samaria maŋ lɛ yi.

english_verse: They kept up the attack until there was nothing to eat in the city. In fact, a donkey's head cost
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, hɔmɔ ni naa wa ba Samaria, aahu po ní ahɔ̃ɔ teji yitso jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ, ni ahɔ̃ɔ okpo wamɔ okpolu mlijaa ejwɛ mli ekome jwiɛtɛi shekeli enumɔ. Afɔɔ ŋaŋ sabolai tsɛmɔ ŋaŋ “okpo fee.”

english_verse: One day as the king of Israel was walking along the top of the city wall, a woman shouted to him, “Please, Your Majesty, help me!”
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ eba lɛ akɛ be ni Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ sheraa shi yɛ maŋ lɛ mli gbogbo lɛ nɔ lɛ, yoo ko bolɔ kɛtsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, ofainɛ, ye obua mi.”

english_verse: “Let the Lord help you!” the king said. “Do you think I have grain or wine to give you?”
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ lɛ here lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Dabi, hã ni Yehowa aye abua bo, te mafee tɛŋŋ maye mabua bo hu? Ani mijɛ miŋmãagbeemɔhe loo mijɛ miwainbu mli?”

english_verse: Then he asked, “What's the matter anyway?” The woman answered, “Another woman and I were so hungry that we agreed to eat our sons. She said if we ate my son one day, we could eat hers the next day.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ lɛ biyoo lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni gbaa onaa?” Yoo lɛ hã hetoo akɛ, “Nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Kɛ obinuu lɛ aba ni wɔye lɛ ŋmɛnɛ, koni wɔ lɛ, wɔye mi hu mibinuu lɛ.’

english_verse: So yesterday we cooked my son and ate him. But today when I went to her house to eat her son, she had hidden him.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni wɔhoo mibi lɛ, ni wɔye. Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛ obinuu lɛ aba ni wɔye lɛ’; shi lɛ lɛ eŋɔ ebi lɛ etee.”

english_verse: The king tore off his clothes in sorrow, and since he was on top of the city wall, the people saw that he was wearing sackcloth underneath.
translation_verse: Be ni Maŋtsɛ lɛ nu yoo lɛ wiemɔi lɛ, egbala etadei lɛ yɛ ehe; ni maŋbii ni bɛŋkɛ gbogbo lɛ he lɛ na akɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ wo kpekpe atade yɛ etadei ni ewo lɛ ashishi.

english_verse: He said, “I pray that God will punish me terribly, if Elisha's head is still on his shoulders by this time tomorrow.”
translation_verse: Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ agbe mi, ni esaa egbe mi ekoŋŋ, kɛji Elisha, Shafat bi lɛ, yitso tsa eyitso nɔ ŋmɛnɛ!”

english_verse: Then he sent a messenger to Elisha. Elisha was home at the time, and the important leaders of Israel were meeting with him. Even before the king's messenger arrived, Elisha told the leaders, “That murderer is sending someone to cut off my head. When you see him coming, shut the door and don't let him in. I'm sure the king himself will be right behind him.”
translation_verse: Ni etsu tsulɔ koni eyamɔ Elisha. Shi no mli lɛ Elisha ta shi yɛ eshĩa lɛ ni onukpai komɛi ni ba lɛ saramɔ lɛ tara emasɛi. Shi dani tsulɔ lɛ shɛɔ Elisha ŋɔɔ lɛ, Elisha kɛɛ onukpai lɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛle akɛ nakai nuu mɔgbelɔ lɛ ewo mɔ gbɛ ni abafo miyitso lo? Naa, kɛji tsulɔ lɛ ba lɛ, nyɛŋaa shinaa lɛ nyɛwoa eyi kpɛŋŋ ni ekaba mli. Enuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ kɛmiiba.”

english_verse: Before Elisha finished talking, the messenger came up and said, “The Lord has made all these terrible things happen to us. Why should I think he will help us now?”
translation_verse: Be ni Elisha kɛ enukpai lɛ wieɔ lolo lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ bashɛ eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nɛkɛ efɔŋ nɛɛ, Yehowa ŋɔɔ ejɛ. Mɛni mimɛɔ dɔŋŋ? Mɛni feemɔ shwɛɔ mi dɔŋŋ?”

english_verse: Elisha answered, “I have a message for you. The Lord promises that tomorrow here in Samaria, you will be able to buy a large sack of flour or two large sacks of barley for almost nothing.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Elisha hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, Wɔ be nɛ mli lɛ akɛ talenta kome baahe ŋmãa mamu kiloi etɛ̃ aloo ashikishaŋ kiloi ekpaa yɛ Samaria.”

english_verse: The chief officer there with the king replied, “I don't believe it! Even if the Lord sent a rainstorm, it couldn't produce that much grain by tomorrow.” “You will see it happen, but you won't eat any of the food,” Elisha warned him. The Syrian Army Stops Its Attack
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni asafoiatsɛ lɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kpasaa enine lɛ here Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Naa, kɛji Yehowa aaagbele samfɛji yɛ ŋwɛi po ni ŋmãa aaanɛ kɛaajɛ ŋwɛi ashwie shi lɛ, ani wiemɔ nɛɛ aaaba mli lo?” Ni Elisha kɛɛ, “Na ooona kɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛi, shi oyeŋ eko kɔkɔɔkɔ.” Siria tabilɔi lɛ jo foi

english_verse: About the same time, four men with leprosy were just outside the gate of Samaria. They said to each other, “Why should we sit here, waiting to die?
translation_verse: Hii kpitiyelɔi ejwɛ komɛi yɛ Samaria maŋ agbo lɛ naa. Amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ: “Mɛni hewɔ ni wɔɔɔtara biɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni wɔɔɔgboi?”

english_verse: There's nothing to eat in the city, so we would starve if we went inside. But if we stay out here, we will die for sure. Let's sneak over to the Syrian army camp and surrender. They might kill us, but they might not.”
translation_verse: Kɛji wɔkɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔbotea maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, hɔmɔ lɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli; ni wɔɔɔgboi yɛ jɛi. Ni kɛji wɔtara biɛ hu gboimɔ nɔŋŋ wɔbaagboi. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛbaa; nyɛhãa wɔyagbea Siriabii lɛ ata lɛ mli moŋ; kɛji amɛhere wɔyi wala lɛ, wɔyi aaana wala; ni kɛji amɛgbe wɔ lɛ belɛ wɔɔgboi kɛkɛ.”

english_verse: They said to each other, “This isn't right. Today is a day to celebrate, and we haven't told anyone else what has happened. If we wait until morning, we will be punished. Let's go to the king's palace at once and tell the good news.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Nɔ ni wɔfeɔ nɛɛ ejaaa. Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, omanye gbi ni. Shi moŋ kɛji wɔfee diŋŋ ni wɔmɛ kɛyashi jetsɛre leebi lɛ, wɔɔye sɔ̃. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔyaa ni wɔyabɔa amaniɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ.”

english_verse: They went back to Samaria and shouted up to the guards at the gate, “We've just come from the Syrian army camp, and all the soldiers are gone! The tents are empty, and the horses and donkeys are still tied up. We didn't see or hear anybody.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amɛshi Siriabii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ kɛtee Samaria. Kɛkɛ ni kpitiyelɔi lɛ bo amɛtsɛ maŋ lɛ agbonaabulɔi lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Wɔtee Siriabii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ; ni naa, anaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko lɛ, anuuu mɔ ko mɔ ko he hu akɛ ja okpɔŋɔi ni afimɔ amɛ aŋmɔlɔ̃ shi; ni tejii lɛ hu ŋmɔlɔ shi; ni bui lɛ hu mamɔ shi bɔ ni eyɔɔ ni Siriabii lɛ shi amɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: The guards reported the news to the king's palace.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni agbonaabulɔi lɛ tswa adafi, kɛkɛ ni sane lɛ yashɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ.

english_verse: The king got out of bed and said to his officers, “I know what those Syrians are doing. They know we're starving, so they're hiding in the fields, hoping we will go out to look for food. When we do, they can capture us and take over our city.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ te shi nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, “Matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ yiŋtoo ni Siriabii nɛɛ kɛfee enɛ nɛɛ. Amɛle akɛ hɔmɔ miiye wɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, amɛje shitoohe lɛ mli amɛtee amɛyateetee amɛhe yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ. Amɛsusuɔ akɛ wɔbaaje maŋ lɛ mli wɔyatao niyenii, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaamɔmɔ wɔ hiɛkãalɔi koni amɛbote wɔmaŋ lɛ mli ni amɛŋɔ maŋ lɛ hu.”

english_verse: One of his officers replied, “We have a few horses left—why don't we let some men take five of them and go to the Syrian camp and see what's happening? We're going to die anyway like those who have already died.”
translation_verse: Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛi ni yɔɔ maŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ, amɛtamɔ mɛi ni egboi momo lɛ nɔŋŋ. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔtsua hii komɛi; amɛŋɔ okpɔŋɔi ni eshwɛ lɛ ateŋ enumɔ kɛya jɛi koni amɛyakwɛ nɔ ni eba lɛ.”

english_verse: They found two chariots, and the king commanded the men to find out what had happened to the Syrian troops.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amɛfamɔ mɛi enyɔ, ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu amɛ kɛ okpɔŋɔ shwiilii kɛtee Siria ta lɛ mli. Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa nyɛyakwɛa.”

english_verse: The men rode as far as the Jordan River. All along the way they saw clothes and equipment that the Syrians had thrown away as they escaped. Then they went back to the king and told him what they had seen.
translation_verse: Ni amɛtiu amɛ kɛyashɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa tɔ̃ɔ; ni naa, gbɛ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ eyi tɔ kɛ atadei kɛ nibiinibii ni Siria tabilɔi lɛ eshɛrɛ eshwie yɛ amɛoyaiyeli lɛ mli. Bɔfoi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛba, ni amɛbabɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ amaniɛ.

english_verse: At once the people went to the Syrian camp and carried off what was left. They took so much that a large sack of flour and two large sacks of barley sold for almost nothing, just as the Lord had promised.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Samariabii lɛ je kpo kɛtee, ni amɛyaha Siriabii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ. Ni yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ, akɛ talenta kome he ŋmãa mamu kiloi etɛ̃ aloo ashikishaŋ kiloi ekpaa yɛ Samaria.

english_verse: The king of Israel had put his chief officer in charge of the gate, but he died when the people trampled him as they rushed out of the city.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ eba mli akɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔ asafoiatsɛ, mɔ ni ekpasaa enine lɛ, eto maŋ wulu lɛ agbo lɛ naa akɛ agbonaakwɛlɔ nukpa. Maŋbii lɛ naanaa enɔ yɛ agbo lɛ naa, taakɛ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, Elisha, kɛɛ be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kpeleke shi kɛba eŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Earlier, when the king was at Elisha's house, Elisha had told him that flour or barley would sell for almost nothing.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ be ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ kɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔ benɛ beiaŋ lɛ akɛ talenta kome baahe ŋmãa mamu kiloi etɛ̃ aloo ashikishaŋ kiloi ekpaa, yɛ Samaria, yɛ nakai agbo lɛ naa lɛ,”

english_verse: But the officer refused to believe that even the Lord could do that. So Elisha warned him that he would see it happen, but would not eat any of the food.
translation_verse: nakai asafoiatsɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni here Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Kɛji Yehowa aaagbele samfɛji yɛ ŋwɛi po, ni ŋmãa aaanɛ kɛaajɛ ŋwɛi ashwie shi lɛ, ani wiemɔ nɛɛ aaaba mli lo?” lɛ. Ni Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, bo diɛŋtsɛ ooona kɛ ohiŋmɛii, shi oyeŋ eko kɔkɔɔkɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: And that's exactly what happened—the officer was trampled to death.
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ eba enɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ maŋbii lɛ naanaa enɔ yɛ agbo lɛ naa, ni egbo.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the king was asking Gehazi the servant of Elisha about the amazing things Elisha had been doing.
translation_verse: Yoo lɛ yanina maŋtsɛ lɛ ni ekɛ Gehazi, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ tsulɔ lɛ, miiwie akɛ, “Gbaa mi nibii wuji fɛɛ ni Elisha efee lɛ.”

english_verse: While Gehazi was telling him that Elisha had brought a dead boy back to life, the woman and her son arrived. “Here's the boy, Your Majesty,” Gehazi said. “And this is his mother.”
translation_verse: Gehazi miigba maŋtsɛ lɛ bɔ ni Elisha tsɔ̃ etsĩɛ gbonyo hiɛ nɔŋŋ, kɛkɛ lɛ naa yoo lɛ ni etsĩɛ ebi hiɛ lɛ. Ebafo ewo maŋtsɛ lɛ nijiaŋ yɛ eshĩa lɛ kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ hewɔ. Kɛkɛ ni Gehazi kɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, yoo lɛ nɛ, ni ebi lɛ ni Elisha tsĩɛ ehiɛ lɛ hu nɛ.”

english_verse: Some time later Elisha went to the capital city of Damascus to visit King Benhadad of Syria, who was sick. And when Benhadad was told he was there,
translation_verse: Ni Elisha tee Damasko be mli ni Siria Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad lɛ he miiye. Be ni ayagba maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ eba biɛ nɛɛ lɛ,”

english_verse: Hazael left with forty camel loads of the best things made in Damascus as a gift for Elisha. He found the prophet and said, “Your servant, King Benhadad, wants to know if he will get well.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Hazael tee Elisha ŋɔɔ. Eŋɔ nikeenii ni ji Damasko nibii kpakpai lɛ fɛɛ eko ehiɛ edɛ̃, yoomai nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yiteremɔ. Be ni Hazael kɛ Elisha kpe lɛ, Hazael kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Otsulɔ Ben-Hadad tsu mi oŋɔɔ koni mibabi bo akɛ ehe ni yeɔ nɛɛ lɛ eeena hewalɛ kɛ̃ lo?”

english_verse: “Tell him he will,” Elisha said to Hazael. “But the Lord has already told me that Benhadad will definitely die.”
translation_verse: Ni Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa ni oyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Ohe baawa bo!’ Tsɛbelɛ, Yehowa ejie etsɔ̃ɔ mi akɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ ebaagbo.”

english_verse: “Sir, why are you crying?” Hazael asked. Elisha answered, “Because I know the terrible things you will do to the people of Israel. You will burn down their walled cities and slaughter their young men. You will even crush the heads of their babies and rip open their pregnant women.”
translation_verse: Hazael bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ minuŋtsɔ foɔ nɛɛ?” Elisha hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Ejaakɛ mile nɔ efɔŋ ni bo obaafee Israelbii: amɛmɔji ni he wa lɛ obaamamɔ naa la, ni amɛblahii lɛ okɛ klante baagbe amɛ, ni amɛbii fufɔbii lɛ obaaŋɔ amɛ otswia shi, ni amɛyeihɔlɔi lɛ obaagbalagbalaa amɛmli.”

english_verse: “How could I ever do anything like that?” Hazael replied. “I'm only a servant and don't have that kind of power.” “Hazael, the Lord has told me that you will be the next king of Syria.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Hazael kɛɛ akɛ, “Mi, otsulɔ ni tamɔ gbee nɛɛ, namɔ ji lɛ ni eeetsu nɔ ko wulu ni tamɔ nɛkɛ?” Elisha hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Yehowa ejie etsɔ̃ɔ mi akɛ bo obaaye maŋtsɛ yɛ Siria.”

english_verse: But the very next day, Hazael got a thick blanket; he soaked it in water and held it over Benhadad's face until he died. Hazael then became king. King Jehoram of Judah (
translation_verse: Shi enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ Hazael kɔ saanɔbo, ni ekɛtsɔ nu mli, ni eŋɔ hã maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ, ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsui su aahu kɛyashi egbo. Kɛkɛ ni Hazael baye Ben-Hadad sɛɛ akɛ Siria maŋtsɛ. Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoram (

english_verse: So Jehoram and his cavalry marched to Zair, where the Edomite army surrounded him and his commanders. During the night he attacked the Edomites, but he was defeated, and his troops escaped to their homes.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehoram kɛ eta shwiilii lɛ fɛɛ foŋ kɛtee Zair. Edombii lɛ gba kɛbɔle amɛ kɛkpe yɛ jɛi. Shi Yehoram kɛ eshwiilii nɔtalɔi lɛ te shi nyɔɔŋ, ni amɛgba kɛtsɔ̃ Edombii ata lɛ mli, ni amɛjo foi, ni etabilɔi lɛ gbɛ shwã, ni amɛtee amɛshĩaiaŋ.

english_verse: While Jehoram was king, the people of Edom rebelled and chose their own king.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ Yehoram yinɔ lɛ, Edom tse Yuda hiɛ atua, ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwo maŋtsɛ amɛhã amɛhe.

english_verse: Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat became king of Judah in Joram's fifth year as king of Israel, while Jehoshaphat was still king of Judah.
translation_verse: Yoram, Ahab bi lɛ ni ji Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ, yinɔ afi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehoshafat bi Yehoram babɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Yuda.

english_verse: Jehoram disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong. He married Ahab's daughter and was as sinful as Ahab's family and the kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Eba ejeŋ gbonyogbonyo tamɔ Israel maŋtsɛmɛi krokomɛi lɛ; eba ejeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni Ahab we lɛ fee lɛ, ejaakɛ Ahab biyoo ji eŋa, ni efee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord refused to destroy Judah, because he had promised his servant David that someone from his family would always rule in Judah.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ Yehowa sumɔɔɔ akɛ ekpãtãa Yuda hiɛ yɛ etsulɔ David hewɔ; ejaakɛ ewo lɛ shi akɛ eeehã lɛ kɛ eshwiei atsɔ̃ kane ni baakudɔ Yuda kɛaatee naanɔ.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoram did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Shi Yehoram he saji kɛ nibii ni efee fɛɛ lɛ aŋma yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Lɛ Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.

english_verse: Jehoram died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Ahaziah then became king. King Ahaziah of Judah (
translation_verse: Ni Yehoram gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ David maŋ lɛ mli; ni ebi Ahazia baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ. Yuda Maŋtsɛ Ahazia (

english_verse: Ahaziah son of Jehoram became king of Judah in the twelfth year of Joram's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Ahab bi Yoram, ni ji Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ, yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Ahazia Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoram bi lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yuda.

english_verse: Since Ahaziah was related to Ahab's family, he acted just like them and disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Eba ejeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni Ahab we lɛ fee lɛ, ni efee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ Ahab we lɛ fee lɛ nɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ Ahab we lɛ bii lɛ ashaanuu ji lɛ.

english_verse: Ahaziah went with King Joram of Israel to attack King Hazael and the Syrian troops at Ramoth in Gilead. Joram was wounded in that battle,
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ Ahazia yafata Ahab bi Yoram he, ni amɛkɛ Siria Maŋtsɛ Hazael yawu yɛ Ramot-Gilead; ni Siriabii lɛ pila Yoram.

english_verse: One day, Elisha called for one of the other prophets and said: Take this bottle of olive oil and get ready to go to the town of Ramoth in Gilead.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ Elisha tsɛ gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mĩamɔ, wo nɛkɛ mu kɛ tɔ nɛɛ ohiɛ odɛ̃ oya Ramot-Gilead.

english_verse: When you get there, find Jehu son of Jehoshaphat and grandson of Nimshi. Take him to a place where the two of you can be alone,
translation_verse: Ni kɛji oshɛ jɛi lɛ taomɔ Yehu, Yehoshafat bi lɛ, ni ji Nimshi nabi lɛ. Ohã ete shi yɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ, koni okɛ lɛ abote sɛɛtsu mli.

english_verse: then pour olive oil on his head to show that he is the new king. Say to him, “The Lord has chosen you to be king of Israel.” Then leave quickly—don't wait around for anything!
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ wo mu kɛ tɔ lɛ koni ofɔse oshwie eyiteŋ, ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, miiwo bo Israel maŋtsɛ!’ Kɛkɛ lɛ gbelemɔ shinaa lɛ ni ojo foi; kaashashao shi.”

english_verse: The young prophet left for Ramoth.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni oblanyo lɛ ni ji gbalɔ lɛ, yiŋ etee Ramot-Gilead.

english_verse: When he arrived, the army officers were meeting together. “Sir, I have a message for you,” he said. “For which one of us?” Jehu asked. “You, sir,” the prophet answered.
translation_verse: Be ni eshɛ jɛi lɛ, naa ta lɛ mli asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ tara shi amɛkpe; ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Asafoiatsɛ, mihiɛ sane ko mihã bo!” Ni Yehu bi akɛ, “Wɔteŋ namɔ okɛwieɔ lɛ?” Ni ehã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Bo, asafoiatsɛ Yehu tuuŋtu ni!”

english_verse: So Jehu got up and went inside. The prophet poured olive oil on Jehu's head and told him: The Lord God of Israel has this message for you: “I am the Lord, and I have chosen you to be king of my people Israel.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yehu te shi ni amɛbote shĩa lɛ mli, ni oblanyo lɛ fɔse mu lɛ eshwie Yehu yiteŋ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Mifɔ bo mu kɛwo bo Yehowa maŋbii ni ji Israel maŋtsɛ.

english_verse: I want you to wipe out the family of Ahab, so Jezebel will be punished for killing the prophets and my other servants.
translation_verse: Ni obaabutu onuŋtsɔ Ahab we lɛ, koni mikɛtɔ Yezebel kɛ mitsuji gbalɔi lɛ alá, kɛ Yehowa tsuji lɛ fɛɛ alá he owele.

english_verse: Every man and boy in Ahab's family must die, whether slave or free.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Ahab we lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ baakpãtã; ni maplene nuu fɛɛ nuu ni yɔɔ Ahab we lɛ, nyɔŋ kɛ mɔ ni eye ehe fɛɛ, yɛ Israel.

english_verse: His whole family must be destroyed, just like the families of Jeroboam son of Nebat and Baasha son of Ahijah.
translation_verse: Ni mafee Ahab we lɛ tamɔ mifee Israel maŋtsɛ Yeroboam, Nebat bi lɛ, we lɛ, kɛ Baasha, Ahia bi lɛ we lɛ.

english_verse: As for Jezebel, her body will be eaten by dogs in the town of Jezreel. There won't be enough left of her to bury.” Then the young prophet opened the door and ran out.
translation_verse: Ni gbei baaye Yezebel loo yɛ Yezreel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko efuŋ lɛ.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ lɛ gbele shinaa lɛ, ni ejo foi.

english_verse: Jehu went back to his officers, and one of them asked, “What did that crazy prophet want? Is everything all right?” “You know him and how he talks,” Jehu answered.
translation_verse: Be ni Yehu ku esɛɛ kɛba enuŋtsɔ tsuji, asafoiatsɛmɛi, lɛ aŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Ani hejɔlɛ sane ni lo? Mɛni hewɔ ni mɔnɛ sɛkɛyelɔ nɛɛ ba oŋɔɔ nɛɛ?” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle gbɔmɔ lɛ kɛ bɔ ni ewiemɔ yɔɔ.”

english_verse: “No, we don't. What did he say?” they asked. “He had a message from the Lord,” Jehu replied. “He said that the Lord has chosen me to be the next king of Israel.”
translation_verse: Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ “Oolaka wɔ, gbaa wɔ nɔ ni ekɛɛ moŋ.” Ni Yehu kɛɛ, “Bɔ ni ekɛɛ mi nɛ; ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ. Mifɔ bo mu, miwo bo Israel maŋtsɛ.’ ”

english_verse: They quickly grabbed their coats and spread them out on the steps where Jehu was standing. Someone blew a trumpet, and everyone shouted, “Jehu is king!” Jehu Kills Joram and Ahaziah
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amɛhe fee oya, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ jie etade, ni eŋɔ ha shi yɛ atrakpoi lɛ anɔ, ni amɛkpãkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi amɛkɛɛ, “Yehu eye maŋtsɛ!” Agbe Israel Maŋtsɛ Yoram

english_verse: When the guard in the watchtower at Jezreel saw Jehu and his men riding up, he shouted to the king, “I see a large group of men coming this way.” Joram ordered, “Send someone out to ask them if this is a friendly visit.”
translation_verse: Bulɔ ko damɔ mɔɔ lɛ yiteŋ yɛ Yezreel; ena Yehu kɛ esafo ku lɛ ni amɛmiiba, ni ekɛɛ, “Miina asafo ku ko.” Kɛkɛ ni Yoram kɛɛ akɛ, “Tsɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔ ko ni otsu lɛ koni ekɛ amɛ ayakpe, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, ‘Hejɔlɛ sane nyɛkɛbaa lo?’ ”

english_verse: One of the soldiers rode out and said to Jehu, “King Joram wants to know if this is a friendly visit.” “What's it to you?” Jehu asked. “Just stay behind me with the rest of my troops!” About the same time the guard in the watchtower said, “Your Majesty, the rider got there, but he isn't coming back.”
translation_verse: Okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔ ko tee ni ekɛ Yehu yakpe, ni ekɛɛ, “Bɔ ni maŋtsɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Hejɔlɛ sane nyɛkɛbaa lo?’ ” Yehu to he akɛ, “Mɛni hejɔlɛ sane kɔɔ yɛ ohe? Bo lɛ baanyiɛ misɛɛ ni wɔtee.” Bulɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ tsulɔ lɛ eyashɛ amɛŋɔɔ, shi ekuuu esɛɛ ebaaa dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: So Joram sent out another rider, who rode up to Jehu and said, “The king wants to know if this is a friendly visit.” “What's it to you?” Jehu asked. “Just get behind me with the rest of my troops!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni etsu okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔ ni ji enyɔ kɛtee. Be ni eyashɛ amɛŋɔɔ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Bɔ ni maŋtsɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Hejɔlɛ sane nyɛkɛbaa lo?’ ” Ni Yehu to he akɛ, “Mɛni hejɔlɛ sane kɔɔ yɛ ohe? Bo lɛ baanyiɛ misɛɛ ni wɔtee.”

english_verse: The guard in the watchtower said, “Your Majesty, the rider got there, but he isn't coming back either. Wait a minute! That one man is a reckless chariot driver—it must be Jehu!”
translation_verse: Bulɔ lɛ kɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ tsulɔ lɛ eyashɛ amɛŋɔɔ, shi ekuuu esɛɛ ebaaa dɔŋŋ. Ni bulɔ lɛ kɛfata he akɛ, “Shwiili lɛ foiwoo tamɔ Yehu Nimshi nabi lɛ shwiili foiwoo, ejaakɛ ewoɔ shwiili foi tamɔ sɛkɛyelɔ”.

english_verse: Joram commanded, “Get my chariot ready.” Then he and Ahaziah got in their chariots and rode out to meet Jehu. They all met on the land that had belonged to Naboth.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yoram kɛɛ, “Nyɛfea mishwiili lɛ kralo.” Ni amɛfee eshwiili lɛ kralo. Ni Yoram, Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, kɛ Ahazia, Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ, je kpo, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ta eshwiili mli; ni amɛ kɛ Yehu yakpe. Amɛyanina lɛ yɛ Nabot, Yezreelnyo lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Joram asked, “Jehu, is this a peaceful visit?” “How can there be peace?” Jehu asked. “Your mother Jezebel has caused everyone to worship idols and practice witchcraft.”
translation_verse: Be ni Yoram na Yehu lɛ, ebi lɛ akɛ “Yehu, hejɔlɛ sane okɛbaa lo?” Yehu here nɔ akɛ, “Te baafee tɛŋŋ ni hejɔlɛ aba hu, bei abɔ ni ŋkunyaayeli kɛ wɔŋjamɔ ni onyɛ Yezebel bato shishi lɛ yɔɔ lolo lɛ?”

english_verse: “Ahaziah, let's get out of here!” Joram yelled. “It's a trap!” As Joram tried to escape,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yoram tsɔ̃ ehe, ni ejo foi; ni be ni ejoɔ foi lɛ, ekɛɛ Ahazia akɛ, “Ahazia, atsɔ̃ wɔ akpa!”

english_verse: Jehu shot an arrow. It hit Joram between his shoulders, then it went through his heart and came out his chest. He fell over dead in his chariot.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehu kɔ egãi lɛ ni eŋɔ tsɛ̃ Yoram kɔ̃ji ateŋ, ni gãi lɛ tsɔ̃ Yoram tsui mli kɛje kpo, ni egbee eshwiili lɛ mli.

english_verse: Jehu commanded his assistant Bidkar, “Get Joram's body and throw it in the field that Naboth once owned. Do you remember when you and I used to ride side by side behind Joram's father Ahab? It was then that the Lord swore to Ahab that he would be punished in the same field where he had killed Naboth and his sons. So throw Joram's body there, just as the Lord said.”
translation_verse: ‘Nabot lá ni afɔse ashwie shi kɛ ebii lɛ hu alá ni afɔse ashwie shi, ni mina nyɛ, lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mikã mihe kitã akɛ mawo he nyɔmɔ yɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ.’ Yehowa kɛɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ wo lɛ oshɛ ofɔ̃ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa.” Agbe Yuda Maŋtsɛ Ahazia

english_verse: Ahaziah saw all of this happen and tried to escape to the town of Beth-Haggan, but Jehu caught up with him and shouted, “Kill him too!” So his troops shot Ahaziah with an arrow while he was on the road to Gur near Ibleam. He went as far as Megiddo, where he died.
translation_verse: Be ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Ahazia na nɔ ni eba lɛ, ejo foi kɛtsɔ̃ Bet-Hagan gbɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Yehu tiu lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Lɛ hu nyɛtsɛ̃a lɛ gãi.” Ni atsɛ̃ lɛ gãi yɛ eshwiili lɛ mli yɛ Gur ŋmeŋme lɛ ni yɔɔ Ibleam masɛi lɛ he. Kɛkɛ ni ejo foi kɛtee Megido, ni eyagbo yɛ jɛi, ni

english_verse: Ahaziah's officers put his body in a chariot and took it back to Jerusalem, where they buried him beside his ancestors.
translation_verse: etsuji lɛ wo egbonyo lɛ amɛwo shwiili lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛ lɛ ba Yerusalɛm, ni amɛbafu lɛ yɛ efuuhe lɛ yɛ etsɛmɛi lɛ amasɛi yɛ David maŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: Ahaziah had become king of Judah in the eleventh year of the rule of Ahab's son Joram. Jehu Kills Jezebel
translation_verse: Ahazia bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Yuda yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Yoram, Ahab bi lɛ, maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ. Agbe Maŋnyɛ Yezebel

english_verse: Jehu headed toward Jezreel, and when Jezebel heard he was coming, she put on eye shadow and brushed her hair. Then she stood at the window, waiting for him to arrive.
translation_verse: Yehu ba Yezreel. Be ni Yezebel nu he lɛ, ediki ehiŋmɛii asɛɛ, ni ehɔ eyi fɛɛfɛo, ni eyabu samflɛ naa, ni eekwɛ gbɛjegbɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: As he walked through the city gate, she shouted down to him, “Why did you come here, you murderer? To kill the king? You're no better than Zimri!”
translation_verse: Be ni Yehu bote maŋtsɛ we lɛ agbo lɛ mli lɛ, Yezebel bi akɛ, “Zimri ni ogbe onuŋtsɔ, hejɔlɛ sane okɛbaa lo?”

english_verse: He looked up toward the window and asked, “Is anyone up there on my side?” A few palace workers stuck their heads out of a window,
translation_verse: Yehu wo ehiɛ nɔ ekwɛ samflɛ lɛ naa, ni ekɛɛ, “Namɔ yɔɔ migbɛfaŋ?” Namɔ? Ni piafoi enyɔ loo piafoi etɛ̃ ko gbo amɛyi naa shi amɛkwɛ lɛ.

english_verse: and Jehu shouted, “Throw her out the window!” They threw her down, and her blood splattered on the walls and on the horses that trampled her body.
translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛwoa lɛ nyɛshɛa nyɛfɔ̃a shikpɔŋ!” Kɛkɛ ni amɛwo lɛ amɛtswa shi; ni elá lɛ eko tsɛŋe shwie gbogbo lɛ kɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ ahe. Yehu kɛ eshwiili ni eta mli lɛ kɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ tsɔ̃ Yezebel gbonyo lɛ nɔ kɛho.

english_verse: Jehu left to get something to eat and drink. Then he told some workers, “Even though she was evil, she was a king's daughter, so make sure she has a proper burial.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehu bote maŋtsɛ we lɛ, ni eyaye nii, ni enu nɔ ko eshwie nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyakwɛa ni nyɛfua nɛkɛ yoo musumɔ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ maŋtsɛ biyoo ni.”

english_verse: But when they went out to bury her body, they found only her skull, her hands, and her feet.
translation_verse: Ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee lɛ fuu; shi amɛnaaa nɔ ko akɛ ja eyitsoŋoŋo kɛ enaji kɛ enine kɔkɔi pɛ.

english_verse: They reported this to Jehu, and he said, “The Lord told Elijah the prophet that Jezebel's body would be eaten by dogs right here in Jezreel.
translation_verse: Be ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛbabɔ Yehu amaniɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa wiemɔ ni etsɔ̃ etsulɔ Elia, Tishbinyo lɛ, nɔ ewie lɛ nɛ: ‘Yezreel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ ni gbei baaye Yezebel loo yɛ,

english_verse: And he warned that her bones would be spread all over the ground like manure, so that no one could tell who it was.”
translation_verse: ni Yezebel gbonyo baatsɔ̃ tamɔ tumo nɔ wamɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ Yezreel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko yooo lɛ ni eeekɛɛ akɛ Yezebel nɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Your town is strong, and you're protected by chariots and an armed cavalry. And I know that King Ahab's descendants live there with you. So as soon as you read this letter,
translation_verse: “Amrɔ pɛ ni nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ aaashɛ nyɛdɛŋ lɛ, akɛni nyɛnuŋtsɔ bihii lɛ yɔɔ nyɛŋɔɔ, ni shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ tawuu nii kɛ maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he hu yɔɔ nyɛdɛŋ lɛ,

english_verse: choose the best person for the job and make him the next king. Then be prepared to defend Ahab's family.
translation_verse: nyɛkwɛa nyɛnuŋtsɔ bihii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ni hi kɛ mɔ ni sa fe fɛɛ koni nyɛŋɔ lɛ nyɛta etsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛwu kɛhere nyɛnuŋtsɔ we lɛ.”

english_verse: The officials and leaders read the letters and were very frightened. They said to each other, “Jehu has already killed King Joram and King Ahaziah! We have to do what he says.”
translation_verse: Shi Samaria lumɛi lɛ she gbeyei naakpa diɛŋtsɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Naa, Maŋtsɛ Yoram kɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahazia nyɛɛɛ ehiɛ adamɔ, te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ ni wɔɔnyɛ ehiɛ wɔdamɔ hu?”

english_verse: The prime minister, the mayor of the city, as well as the other leaders and Ahab's supporters, sent this answer to Jehu, “We are your servants, Your Majesty, and we will do whatever you tell us. But it's not our place to choose someone to be king. You do what you think is best.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ kɛ mɔ ni kwɛɔ maŋ lɛ kɛ bii lɛ atsɔselɔi lɛ hu tsu Yehu ŋɔɔ akɛ, “Otsuji ji wɔ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni oookɛɛ wɔ lɛ wɔɔfee. Wɔwooo mɔ ko mɔ ko maŋtsɛ. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hi yɛ ohiɛ lɛ, feemɔ kɛkɛ.”

english_verse: Jehu then wrote another letter which said, “If you are on my side and will obey me, then prove it. Bring me the heads of the descendants of Ahab! And be here in Jezreel by this time tomorrow.” The
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehu ŋmã wolo ni ji enyɔ eyahã amɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛyɛ migbɛfaŋ, ni nyɛfee kralo akɛ nyɛaabo migbee toi lɛ, no lɛ nyɛŋɔa nyɛnuŋtsɔ bihii lɛ ayitsei ni nyɛkɛbahãa mi yɛ Yezreel wɔ́ aaafee nɛkɛ be mli pɛpɛɛpɛ.” Maŋtsɛ bihii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ, maŋ lɛ mli lumɛi lɛ ni tsɔseɔ amɛ lɛ aŋɔɔ amɛyɔɔ.

english_verse: When Jehu was told what had happened, he said, “Put the heads in two piles at the city gate, and leave them there until morning.”
translation_verse: Be ni bɔfo bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Akɛ maŋtsɛ bihii lɛ ayitsei lɛ eba lɛ,” Yehu fã akɛ, “Nyɛtoa yitsei lɛ kui enyɔ yɛ agbo lɛ naa kɛyashi leebi.”

english_verse: The next morning, Jehu went out and stood where everyone could hear him, and he said, “You people are not guilty of anything. I'm the one who plotted against Joram and had him killed. But who killed all these men?
translation_verse: Ni leebi lɛ, Yehu je kpo ebadamɔ shi yɛ agbo lɛ naa, ni ekɛɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ akɛ, “Naa, sɔ̃ ko tereee nyɛ. Mi ji mɔ ni tee minuŋtsɔ yinɔ apam, ni migbe lɛ. Shi namɔ gbegbee mɛnɛɛmɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ hu?

english_verse: Listen to me. Everything the Lord's servant Elijah promised about Ahab's family will come true.”
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Yehowa wiemɔ ni ewie yɛ Ahab we lɛ he lɛ, emli ekome folo efeŋ yaka, ejaakɛ Yehowa efee nɔ ni etsɔ̃ etsulɔ Elia nɔ ewie lɛ.”

english_verse: Then Jehu killed the rest of Ahab's relatives living in Jezreel, as well as his highest officials, his priests, and his closest friends. No one in Ahab's family was left alive in Jezreel.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yehu gbe mɛi fɛɛ ni shwɛ yɛ Ahab we lɛ yɛ Yezreel lɛ: egbɔmɛi wuji lɛ kɛ eshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ esɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eshwɛɛɛ emɔ ko mɔ ko. Agbe Maŋtsɛ Ahazia wekumɛi

english_verse: Jehu left for Samaria, and along the way, he met some relatives of King Ahaziah of Judah at a place where shepherds meet. He asked, “Who are you?” “We are relatives of Ahaziah,” they answered. “We're going to visit his family.”
translation_verse: Yehu na Maŋtsɛ Ahazia wekumɛi lɛ ekomɛi yɛ jɛi, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Namɛi ji nyɛ?” Amɛto he akɛ, “Ahazia wekumɛi ji wɔ, ni wɔmiiya wɔyasara maŋtsɛ bihii lɛ kɛ odehei krokomɛi lɛ.”

english_verse: “Take them alive!” Jehu said to his officers. So they grabbed them and led them to the well near the shepherds' meeting place, where they killed all
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehu kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛmɔmɔa amɛ hiɛkãalɔi!” Ni amɛmɔmɔ amɛ hiɛkãalɔi, ni amɛgbe amɛ yɛ Toohetsɔikuuhe bu lɛ he, hii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ, ni eshwɛɛɛ amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko. Agbe Ahab weku ni eshwɛ fɛɛ

english_verse: As Jehu went on, he saw Jehonadab son of Rechab coming to meet him. Jehu greeted him, then said, “Jehonadab, I'm on your side. Are you on mine?” “Yes, I am.” “Then give me your hand,” Jehu answered. He helped Jehonadab into his chariot
translation_verse: Ni be ni eje jɛi eŋɔ shwie nɔ lɛ, ena Yehonadab, Rekab bi lɛ, ni eeba ni ekɛ lɛ abakpe. Yehu ŋa lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani otsui mli tse hã mi tamɔ bɔ ni mitsui mli tse hã bo lɛ?” Ni Yohanadab hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Hɛɛ, nakai ni.” Yehu kɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nakai ni lɛ, no lɛ taa midɛ̃.” Kɛkɛ ni eta edɛ̃; kɛkɛ ni Yehu hã ekwɔ shwiili lɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ.

english_verse: and said, “Come with me and see how faithful I am to the Lord.” They rode together in Jehu's chariot
translation_verse: Yehu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hã ni wɔtee koni oyakwɛ bɔ ni miyeɔ Yehowa he awuŋã mihãa.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehu hã eta eshwiili lɛ mli.

english_verse: to Samaria. Jehu killed everyone there who belonged to Ahab's family, as well as all his officials. Everyone in his family was now dead, just as the Lord had promised Elijah. Jehu Kills All the Worshipers of Baal
translation_verse: Be ni Yehu shɛ Samaria lɛ, Yehu gbe Ahab weku fɛɛ ni eshwɛ lɛ yɛ Samaria; ni eshiii mɔ kome nɛkɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Elia nɔ ewie lɛ. Agbe mɛi ni jaa Baal lɛ

english_verse: Jehu called together the people in Samaria and said: King Ahab sometimes worshiped Baal, but I will be completely faithful to Baal.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehu bua Samaria maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ahab sɔ̃mɔ Baal fioo ko kɛkɛ, shi Yehu baasɔ̃mɔ lɛ jogbaŋŋ kɛwula shi.

english_verse: I'm going to offer a huge sacrifice to him. So invite his prophets and priests, and be sure everyone who worships him is there. Anyone who doesn't come will be killed. But this was a trick—Jehu was really planning to kill the worshipers of Baal.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛyakpea Baal gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ esɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ esɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ nyɛbahãa mi, akashwɛ mɔ ko; ejaakɛ miyɛ afɔle wulu ko ni mibashã mahã Baal. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baaa lɛ eyi naŋ wala.” Shi ŋaa Yehu tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni afee ni ekpãtã Baal sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: He said, “Announce a day of worship for Baal!” After the day had been announced,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehu kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtoa gbi jurɔ wulu ko ni akɛja Baal.” No hewɔ lɛ, ato gbi lɛ.

english_verse: Jehu sent an invitation to everyone in Israel. All the worshipers of Baal came, and the temple was filled from one end to the other.
translation_verse: Ni Yehu kɛ wiemɔ tsu akɛtee Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ. Ni Baal jalɔi lɛ fɛɛ ba ni eshwɛɛɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko ni baaa. Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛba Baal we lɛ, ni Baal we lɛ yi obɔ̃ tɔ.

english_verse: Jehu told the official in charge of the sacred robes to make sure that everyone had a robe to wear.
translation_verse: Ni Yehu fã mɔ ni kwɛɔ jamɔ atadei lɛ anɔ lɛ akɛ, “Yaajie atadei ohã Baal jalɔi lɛ fɛɛ!” Ni eyajie atadei lɛ ebahã amɛ.

english_verse: Jehu and Jehonadab went into the temple, and Jehu said to the crowd, “Look around and make sure that only the worshipers of Baal are here. No one who worships the Lord is allowed in.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehu kɛ Yehonadab, Rekab bi lɛ, bote Baal we lɛ mli; ni ekɛɛ Baal jalɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa ni ahia ni Yehowa jalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akabafutu nyɛ yɛ biɛ, akɛ ja nyɛ Baal jalɔi lɛ kɛkɛ.”

english_verse: As soon as Jehu finished offering the sacrifice, he told the guards and soldiers, “Come in and kill them! Don't let anyone escape.” They slaughtered everyone in the crowd and threw the bodies outside. Then they went back into the temple
translation_verse: Ni eba mli akɛ be ni eshã shãa afɔle lɛ egbe naa lɛ, Yehu kɛɛ bulɔi lɛ kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyagbea amɛ, nyɛkahãa mɔ ko mɔ ko miije kpo!” Ni amɛgbe amɛ, ni bulɔi lɛ kɛ asraafoi lɛ hole amɛ ni amɛshɛrɛ amɛ amɛshwie kpo lɛ nɔ, kɛkɛ ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee Baal we lɛ pia mli,

english_verse: and carried out the image of Baal. They burned it
translation_verse: ni amɛyahole Baal we lɛ amãgãi lɛ kɛje kpo, ni amɛyashã.

english_verse: and broke it into pieces, then they completely destroyed Baal's temple. And since that time, it's been nothing but a public toilet.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkumɔ Baal amãgã lɛ amɛshwie shi, ni amɛsaa amɛkumɔ Baal we lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu amɛshwie shi, ni amɛkɛ Baal we lɛ fee kuŋtso kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.

english_verse: But he did not stop the worship of the gold statues of calves at Dan and Bethel that Jeroboam had made for the people to worship.
translation_verse: Shi Yehu efɔ̃ɔɔ tsinabi amãgã ni Yeroboam, Nebal bi lɛ, kɛma Betel kɛ Dan, ni ekɛtɔ̃tɔ̃ Israel nane lɛ jamɔ.

english_verse: Later the Lord said, “Jehu, you have done right by destroying Ahab's entire family, just as I had planned. So I will make sure that the next four kings of Israel will come from your own family.”
translation_verse: Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yehu akɛ, “Ofee jogbaŋŋ kɛ feemɔ ni ofee nii ni sa mihiɛ, ni ofee Ahab we lɛ bɔ ni yɔɔ mitsui mli fɛɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, oshwie aaata Israel sɛi lɛ nɔ kɛyashi yinɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: But Jehu did not completely obey the commands of the Lord God of Israel. Instead, he kept doing the sinful things that Jeroboam had caused the Israelites to do. Jehu Dies
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ Yehu ediii sɛɛ ni eye Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mla lɛ nɔ kɛ etsui muu lɛ fɛɛ. Efɔ̃ɔɔ eshai ni Yeroboam fee ni ekɛtɔ̃tɔ̃ Israel nane lɛ feemɔ. Yehu gbele

english_verse: In those days the Lord began to reduce the size of Israel's territory. King Hazael of Syria defeated the Israelites and took control
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ mli Yehowa hã Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ dalɛ nɔ bɔ̃i gbɔmɔ. Hazael ni jɛ Siria lɛ ye Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ;

english_verse: of the regions of Gilead and Bashan east of the Jordan River and north of the town of Aroer near the Arnon River. This was the land where the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and Manasseh had once lived.
translation_verse: kɛjɛ Yordan Faa lɛ he bokãgbɛ aahu kɛtee wuoyigbɛ maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Aroer ni yɔɔ Arnon Faa lɛ he lɛ he. No ji Gilead kɛ Bashan shikpɔji lɛ, he ni Gadbii kɛ Rubenbii kɛ Bokã Manasebii lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Everything else Jehu did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Shi Yehu he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efee kɛ ekãa fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, aŋma yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.

english_verse: Jehu died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoahaz became king.
translation_verse: Yehu gbo ni afu lɛ yɛ Samaria, ni ebi Yehoahaz baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.

english_verse: Jehoiada brought out the swords and shields that had belonged to King David and gave them to the commanders.
translation_verse: Ni osɔfo lɛ, ekɔlɔ akplɔi kɛ tsɛŋi ni ji maŋtsɛ David nii ni yɔɔ Yehowa we lɛ ehã mɛi ohahai anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ.

english_verse: Jehoiada brought Joash outside, where he placed the crown on his head and gave him a copy of instructions for ruling the nation. Olive oil was poured on his head to show that he was now king, while the crowd clapped and shouted, “Long live the king!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehoiada jie maŋtsɛ bi, Yoash, lɛ kɛje kpo, ni ekɛ maŋtsɛ akekre lɛ fi lɛ, ni eŋɔ kpãŋmɔ wolo ni maŋtsɛyeli he mlai yɔɔ mli lɛ ewo edɛŋ; ni amɛwo lɛ maŋtsɛ, ni amɛfɔ lɛ mu; ni maŋbii lɛ tswatswaa amɛdɛ̃, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Maŋtsɛ yi ana wala!”

english_verse: Joash hid in the temple with Jehosheba for six years while Athaliah ruled as queen of Judah. Jehoiada Makes Joash King of Judah (
translation_verse: Ni Yehosheba ŋɔ lɛ eyatee yɛ Yehowa we lɛ afii ekpaa, be mli ni Atalia yeɔ maŋnyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Joash was only seven years old when this happened.
translation_verse: Yoash baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yuda be ni eye afii kpawo.

english_verse: Joash son of Ahaziah had hidden in the Lord's temple six years. Then in the seventh year, Jehoiada the priest sent for the commanders of the king's special bodyguards and the commanders of the palace guards. They met him at the temple, and he asked them to make a promise in the name of the Lord. Then he brought out Joash
translation_verse: Shi afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Osɔfo Yehoiada tsu atee ni ayaŋɔ maŋtsɛ hebulɔi lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ hebulɔi lɛ abahã lɛ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ. Ni ekɛ amɛ kpãŋ, ni ehã amɛkã lɛ kitã yɛ Yehowa we lɛ, ni eŋɔ maŋtsɛ bi lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.

english_verse: and said to them: Here's what I want you to do. Three of your guard units will be on duty on the Sabbath. I want one unit to guard the palace.
translation_verse: Ni efã amɛ akɛ bɔ ni nyɛfee nɛ, “Nyɛteŋ mɛi ni baabɔ̃i amɛnitsumɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome afee maŋtsɛ we lɛ he bulɔi,

english_verse: Another unit will guard Sur Gate, and the third unit will guard the palace gate and relieve the palace guards.
translation_verse: ni mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome hu ahi Sur Agbo lɛ naa; ni mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ hu ahi agbo ni yɔɔ bulɔi lɛ asɛɛ lɛ naa, koni nyɛbu maŋtsɛ we lɛ he, ni nyɛfã he.

english_verse: The other two guard units are supposed to be off duty on the Sabbath. But I want both of them to stay here at the temple and protect King Joash.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛteŋ asafokui enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni eyaŋ nitsumɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛ ji mɛi ni amɛbu maŋtsɛ lɛ he yɛ Yehowa we lɛ.

english_verse: Make sure they follow him wherever he goes, and tell them to keep their swords ready to kill anyone who tries to get near him.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛbɔlea maŋtsɛ Yoash he kɛkpe, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahiɛ etawuu nii yɛ edɛ̃ŋ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaabɛŋkɛ tabilɔi aku lɛ agbe lɛ. Ni kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ miije kpo jio, eeba shĩa jio, nyɛhĩa ehe.”

english_verse: Then they gave the weapons to their guards, who took their positions around the temple and the altar to protect Joash on every side.
