english_verse: Gomer was the ancestor of Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
translation_verse: Gomer shwiei ji Ashkenaz kɛ Rifat kɛ Togarma.

english_verse: Javan was the ancestor of Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
translation_verse: Yavan hu shwiei ji Elisha kɛ Tarshishbii kɛ Kiprobii kɛ Rodanimbii.

english_verse: Ham was the father of Ethiopia, Egypt, Put, and Canaan, and they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them.
translation_verse: Ham, Noa bi lɛ, bihii ji Kush kɛ Ijipt kɛ Libia kɛ Kanaan, mɛi agbɛii ni akɛtsɛɔ amɛshwiei lɛ.

english_verse: Canaan's oldest son was Sidon; his other son was Heth.
translation_verse: Ham bi Kanaan fɔ Sidon, ekromɔbi lɛ, kɛ Het, mɛi agbɛii ni akɛtsɛ amɛshwiei lɛ.

english_verse: Shem was the ancestor of Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech; they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them.
translation_verse: Shem bihii ji Elam kɛ Ashur kɛ Arpakshad kɛ Lud kɛ Aram kɛ Uz kɛ Hul kɛ Geter kɛ Meshek; ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ agbɛii akɛtsɛɔ amɛshwiei lɛ.

english_verse: Arpachshad was Shelah's father and Eber's grandfather.
translation_verse: Shem bi Arpakshad fɔ Shela, ni lɛ hu efɔ Eber.

english_verse: Eber named his first son Peleg, because in his time the earth was divided into tribal regions. Eber's second son was Joktan,
translation_verse: Eber nɛɛ fɔ bihii enyɔ. Atsɛ mɔ kome akɛ Peleg, ejaakɛ efɔmɔ kɛ je lɛ mli bii ateŋ ni gba lɛ bakpe; ni atsɛ Eber bi kome lɛ hu akɛ Yoktan.

english_verse: the ancestor of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah, Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah, Ebal, Abimael, Sheba, Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab.
translation_verse: kɛ Ofir kɛ Hawila kɛ Yoba. Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ Yoktan bii ni.

english_verse: Abraham was the father of Isaac and Ishmael.
translation_verse: Abraham fɔ bihii enyɔ, Isak kɛ Ishmael.

english_verse: Midian was the father of Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. Esau's Family (Genesis
translation_verse: Midian fɔ bihii enumɔ: Efa kɛ Efer kɛ Hanok kɛ Abida kɛ Eldaa. Shwiei ni jɛ Ketura mli ji mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ. Esau shwiei lɛ (Jɛnɛsis

english_verse: Abraham's son Isaac was the father of Esau and Jacob.
translation_verse: Abraham bi Isak fɔ bihii enyɔ, Esau kɛ Yakob.

english_verse: Esau was the father of Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
translation_verse: Esau bihii ji Elifaz kɛ Reuel kɛ Yeush kɛ Yalam kɛ Kora.

english_verse: Reuel was the father of Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. The First Edomites and Their Kings (Genesis
translation_verse: Reuel hu ji mɔ mli ni Nahat kɛ Zera kɛ Shama kɛ Miza jɛ. Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shikwɛ̃ɛbii lɛ (Jɛnɛsis

english_verse: Before kings ruled in Israel, Bela son of Beor ruled the country of Edom from its capital of Dinhabah.
translation_verse: Naa bɔ ni ato naa ni aye maŋtsɛ yɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ dani ato maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel. Bela, Boer bi lɛ ni emaŋ ji Dinhaba lɛ ji mɔ tsutsu ni ye maŋtsɛ.

english_verse: Seir was the father of Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
translation_verse: Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shikwɛ̃ɛbii lɛ, Seir shwiei ni. Seir bii ji Lotan kɛ Shobal kɛ Zibeon kɛ Ana kɛ Dishon kɛ Ezer kɛ Dishan.

english_verse: Lotan was the father of Hori and Homam; Lotan's sister was Timna.
translation_verse: Lotan fɔ Hori kɛ Homam. Lotan yɛ nyɛmiyoo ko ni gbɛi ji Timna.

english_verse: Shobal was the father of Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. Zibeon was the father of Aiah and Anah.
translation_verse: Shobal fɔ Alvan kɛ Manahat kɛ Ebal kɛ Shefi kɛ Onam.

english_verse: Anah was the father of Dishon and the grandfather of Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
translation_verse: Zebeon fɔ bihii enyɔ, Aia kɛ Ana. Ana nɛɛ fɔ Dishon, mɔ ni fɔ Hamran kɛ Eshban kɛ Itran kɛ Keran lɛ.

english_verse: Ezer was the father of Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. Dishan was the father of Uz and Aran.
translation_verse: Ezer fɔ Bilhan kɛ Zaavan kɛ Yaakan. Ni Dishan fɔ Uz kɛ Aran. Edom Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ (Jɛnɛsis

english_verse: After Bela's death, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah became king.
translation_verse: Yobab, Zera bi lɛ ni jɛ Bozra lɛ, baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Bela gbele sɛɛ.

english_verse: After Jobab's death, Husham from the land of Teman became king.
translation_verse: Husham, ni jɛ Temanbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yobab gbele sɛɛ.

english_verse: After Husham's death, Hadad son of Bedad became king and ruled from Avith. Earlier, Bedad had defeated the Midianites in the territory of Moab.
translation_verse: Hadad, Bedad bi lɛ ni jɛ Abit lɛ, baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Hushan gbele sɛɛ. Ekɛ Midianbii lɛ wu ta, ni eye amɛnɔ kunim yɛ Moab ŋã lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: After Hadad's death, Samlah from Masrekah became king;
translation_verse: Samla ni jɛ Masreka baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Hadad gbele sɛɛ.

english_verse: after Samlah's death, Shaul from the town of Rehoboth on the Euphrates River became king;
translation_verse: Shaul ni jɛ Rehobot ni kã faa lɛ naa lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Samla gbele sɛɛ.

english_verse: and after Shaul's death, Baal Hanan son of Achbor became king.
translation_verse: Baal Hanan, Akbor bi lɛ, baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Shaul gbele sɛɛ.

english_verse: After Baal Hanan's death, Hadad ruled from Pai. His wife was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred and granddaughter of Mezahab.
translation_verse: Hadad ni emaŋ ji Pau lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Baal-Hanan gbele sɛɛ. Hadad nɛɛ ŋa ji Mehetabel ni ji Me-Zahab biyoo Matred lɛ biyoo lɛ.

english_verse: The Edomite clans were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
translation_verse: Edombii akutsei lɛ ji Timna kɛ Alva kɛ Yetet,

english_verse: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
translation_verse: kɛ Oholibama kɛ Ela kɛ Pinon,

english_verse: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
translation_verse: kɛ Kenaz kɛ Teman kɛ Mibzar,

english_verse: Magdiel, and Iram.
translation_verse: kɛ Magdiel kɛ Iram.

english_verse: Jacob was the father of twelve sons: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
translation_verse: kɛ Dan kɛ Yosef kɛ Benyamin kɛ Naftali kɛ Gad kɛ Asher.

english_verse: Judah and his Canaanite wife Bathshua had three sons: Er, Onan, and Shelah. But the Lord had Er put to death, because he disobeyed and did what the Lord hated.
translation_verse: Yuda fɔ bihii enumɔ. Ekɛ eŋa Bat-Shua, Kanaanyoo lɛ, fɔ bihii etɛ̃, ni ji Er kɛ Onan kɛ Shela. Yuda kromɔbi Er lɛ fee ehe gbɔmɔ fɔŋ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni no hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa gbe lɛ.

english_verse: Judah and his daughter-in-law Tamar also had two sons: Perez and Zerah.
translation_verse: Yuda kɛ ebinuu ŋã Tamar lɛ fɔ bihii enyɔ hu, Perez kɛ Zera.

english_verse: Perez was the father of Hezron and Hamul.
translation_verse: Perez fɔ bihii enyɔ, Hezron kɛ Hamul.

english_verse: Zerah was the father of Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Darda.
translation_verse: Zera fɔ bihii enumɔ, Zimri kɛ Etan kɛ Heman kɛ Kalkol kɛ Darda.

english_verse: Achan, who was a descendant of Zerah and the son of Carmi, caused trouble for Israel, because he kept for himself things that belonged only to the Lord.
translation_verse: Karmi ni jɛ Perez mli lɛ bi ko ni egbɛi ji Akar lɛ kɛ Israelbii wo amane mli be ni efee nɔ ni esaaa yɛ nihaanii ni ajɔɔ nɔ ahã Yehowa lɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Ethan's son was Azariah. The Ancestors of King David
translation_verse: Etan fɔ binuu. Binuu nɛɛ gbɛi ji Azaria. Maŋtsɛ David wekukpãa

english_verse: Hezron was the father of Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
translation_verse: Hezron fɔ bihii etɛ̃, Yerameel kɛ Ram kɛ Kaleb.

english_verse: Ram was the father of Amminadab and the grandfather of Nahshon, a tribal leader of Judah.
translation_verse: Naa bɔ ni wekukpãa lɛ kã shi hã kɛjɛ Ram nɔ kɛyashi Yeshai nɔ: Ram fɔ Aminadab, ni Aminadab fɔ Nahashon, ni ebatsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ kpanaa yɛ Yudabii ateŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Nahshon's descendants included Salma, Boaz,
translation_verse: Nahashon fɔ Salma, ni Salma fɔ Boaz,

english_verse: Jesse had seven sons, who were born in the following order: Eliab, Abinadab, Shimea, Nethanel, Raddai, Ozem, and David.
translation_verse: Ozem ji ebi ni ji ekpaa lɛ, ni ebi ni ji kpawo lɛ ji David.

english_verse: Jesse also had two daughters: Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah was the mother of Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
translation_verse: Yeshai fɔ biyei hu ni ji Zeruia kɛ Abigail. Yeshai biyoo Zeruia nɛɛ fɔ bihii etɛ̃, Abishai kɛ Yoab kɛ Asahel.

english_verse: Abigail's husband was Jether, who was a descendant of Ishmael, and their son was Amasa. The Descendants of Hezron
translation_verse: Ebiyoo Abigail kɛ Yeter, Ishmaelnyo, lɛ hi shi ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ Amasa. Hezron shwiei

english_verse: Hezron's son Caleb married Azubah, and their daughter was Jerioth, the mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
translation_verse: Hezron binuu Kaleb kɛ Yeriotyoo, Azuba, hi shi ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ bihii etɛ̃, Yesher kɛ Shobab kɛ Ardon.

english_verse: After the death of Azubah, Caleb married Ephrath. Their son Hur
translation_verse: Azuba gbo, ni Kaleb ŋɔ Efrat, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ binuu kome ni ji Hur.

english_verse: was the father of Uri and the grandfather of Bezalel.
translation_verse: Hur fɔ Uri, ni Uri fɔ Bezaleel.

english_verse: After the death of Hezron, Caleb married Ephrath, his father's wife. Their son was Ashhur, who later settled the town of Tekoa. The Descendants of Jerahmeel
translation_verse: Be ni Hezron gbo lɛ, ebinuu Kaleb ŋɔ Efrat, etsɛ Hezron ŋa okulafo lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ Ashur mɔ ni to Tekoa maŋ lɛ. Yerameel shwiei lɛ

english_verse: Jerahmeel, Hezron's oldest son, was the father of Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
translation_verse: Yerameel, Hezron kromɔbi lɛ fɔ bihii enumɔ: Ram, ni ji ekromɔbi lɛ, kɛ Buna kɛ Oren kɛ Ozem kɛ Ahia.

english_verse: Jerahmeel had a second wife, Atarah, who gave birth to Onam.
translation_verse: Yerameel yɛ ŋa kroko hu ni gbɛi ji Atra. Ekɛ lɛ fɔ Onam.

english_verse: Ram was the father of Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
translation_verse: Ram, Yerameel kromɔbi lɛ, fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Maaz kɛ Yamin kɛ Eker.

english_verse: Onam was the father of Shammai and Jada. Shammai was the father of Nadab and Abishur.
translation_verse: Onam fɔ bihii enyɔ: Shamai kɛ Yada; ni Shamai hu fɔ bihii enyɔ: Nadab kɛ Abishur.

english_verse: Abishur married Abihail, and their two sons were Ahban and Molid.
translation_verse: Abishur nɛɛ ŋa gbɛi ji Abihail; ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ bihii enyɔ: Ahban kɛ Molid.

english_verse: Nadab was the father of Seled and Appaim. Seled had no children;
translation_verse: Nadad, Abishur nyɛminuu lɛ, fɔ bihii enyɔ: Seled kɛ Apaim. Seled fɔɔɔ ni egbo.

english_verse: Appaim's son was Ishi, the father of Sheshan and the grandfather of Ahlai.
translation_verse: Shi Apaim fɔ Ishi, ni Ishi fɔ Sheshan, ni Sheshan fɔ Ahlai.

english_verse: Jada was the father of Jether and Jonathan. Jether had no children,
translation_verse: Yada, Oman bi Shammai nyɛmi nuu lɛ, fɔ bihii enyɔ: Yeter kɛ Yonatan. Yeter fɔɔɔ ni egbo.

english_verse: but Jonathan had two sons: Peleth and Zaza.
translation_verse: Shi Yonatan fɔ bihii enyɔ: Pelet kɛ Zaza. Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ Yerameel shwiei sɔŋŋ ni.

english_verse: Sheshan had no sons, and so he let one of his daughters marry Jarha, his Egyptian slave. Their son was Attai,
translation_verse: Ekɛ ebiyei lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome hã etsulɔ Yarha nɛɛ gbãlã, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ binuu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Atai.

english_verse: Zabad's descendants included Ephlal, Obed, Jehu, Azariah, Helez, Eleasah, Sismai, Shallum, Jekamiah, and Elishama. The Descendants of Caleb
translation_verse: ni Shalum fɔ Yekamia, ni Yekamia fɔ Elishama. Kaleb shwiei krokomɛi

english_verse: and Hebron's four sons, Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
translation_verse: Hebron fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Kora kɛ Tapua kɛ Rekem kɛ Shema.

english_verse: Shema was the father of Raham and the grandfather of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai,
translation_verse: Shema fɔ Raham, mɔ ni fɔ Yorkeam lɛ; ni Rekem fɔ Shamai.

english_verse: the grandfather of Maon, and the great-grandfather of Bethzur.
translation_verse: Shamai fɔ Maon, ni Maon fɔ Bet-Zur.

english_verse: Ephah was one of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran named his son after his brother Gazez.
translation_verse: Kaleb yɛ hemɔ ko ni gbɛi ji Efa; ekɛ lɛ fɔ bihii krokomɛi etɛ̃, Haran kɛ Moza kɛ Gazez. Haran hu fɔ binuu ni ewo lɛ Gazez.

english_verse: Ephah was the daughter of Jahdai, who was also the father of Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, and Shaaph.
translation_verse: Kaleb bii lɛ eko hu ni gbɛi ji Yadai lɛ fɔ bihii ekpaa: Regem kɛ Yoatam kɛ Geshan kɛ Pelet kɛ Efa kɛ Shaaf.

english_verse: Maacah was another of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Sheber and Tirhanah.
translation_verse: Kaleb yɛ hemɔ kroko hu ni gbɛi ji Maaka; ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ bihii enyɔ, Sheber kɛ Tirhana.

english_verse: Later, they had two more sons: Shaaph the father of Madmannah, and Sheva the father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb's daughter was Achsah.
translation_verse: Maaka nɛɛ kɛ Kaleb saa fɔ bihii enyɔ krokomɛi, Shaaf mɔ ni to Madmana maŋ lɛ shishi lɛ, kɛ Sheva mɔ ni to Makbena maŋ lɛ kɛ Gibea maŋ lɛ hu shishi lɛ. Biyoo ni Kaleb fɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Aksa.

english_verse: All of these were Caleb's descendants. Hur, the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath, had three sons: Shobal, Salma, and Hareph, who settled the town of Beth-Gader.
translation_verse: Amɛbinuu ni ji enyɔ ji Salma mɔ ni to Betlehem maŋ lɛ; amɛbinuu ni ji etɛ̃ ji Haref mɔ ni to Bet-Gader maŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Shobal, who settled the town of Kiriath-Jearim, was the ancestor of Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth clan,
translation_verse: Shobal, mɔ ni to Kiriat-Yearim maŋ lɛ shwiei ji Haroebii lɛ, kɛ Menahot maŋ lɛ mli bii ayikulɛ fã ko,

english_verse: and the clans that lived near Kiriath-Jearim; they were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. The Zorathites and the Eshtaolites were descendants of the Mishraites.
translation_verse: kɛ Itribii ni yɔɔ Kiriat-Yearim maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, kɛ Putbii lɛ kɛ Shumatbii lɛ kɛ Mishrabii lɛ. Mɛnɛɛmɛi amli Zora maŋ lɛ mli bii lɛ kɛ Eshtaol maŋ lɛ hu mli bii lɛ jɛ.

english_verse: Salma settled the town of Bethlehem and was the ancestor of the Netophathites, the people of Atroth-Bethjoab, half of the Manahathite clan, and the Zorites.
translation_verse: Salma, mɔ ni to Betlehem lɛ, shwiei ji Netofatbii lɛ, Atarot-Bet-Yoabbii lɛ kɛ Zoribii ni ji Manahat maŋ lɛ mli bii lɛ fã kome lɛ.

english_verse: Salma was also the ancestor of the clans in Jabez that kept the court and government records; they were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These clans were the descendants of Hammath the Kenite, who was also the ancestor of the Rechabites.
translation_verse: Be nɛɛ mli lɛ woloŋmalɔi awekui komɛi hi shi yɛ Yabez maŋ lɛ mli. Amɛ ji Tiratbii lɛ kɛ Shimeatbii lɛ kɛ Sukatbii lɛ. Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ Kenbii ji amɛ, ni amɛjɛ Hamat mɔ ni to Rekab we lɛ shishi lɛ mli.

english_verse: more sons. His wife Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel gave birth to Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon.
translation_verse: Yotam fɔ Ahaz, ni Ahaz fɔ Hezekia, ni Hezekia fɔ Manase.

english_verse: David's other wives also gave birth to sons. Tamar was his daughter. The Descendants of King Solomon
translation_verse: David kɛ ehemɛi lɛ fɔ bihii krokomɛi hu yɛ ebihii nɛɛ asɛɛ. Amɛnyɛmi yoo ji Tamar. Maŋtsɛ Solomon shwiei lɛ

english_verse: Jehoiakim was the father of Jehoiachin and Zedekiah.
translation_verse: Ni Yehoiakim fɔ bihii enyɔ: Yehoiakin kɛ Zedekia. Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin shwiei lɛ

english_verse: Jehoiachin, who was taken to Babylon as a prisoner, had seven sons: Shealtiel,
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin, mɔ ni Babilonbii lɛ ŋɔ lɛ nom lɛ, shwiei lɛ agbɛii baa nɛɛ. Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin fɔ bihii kpawo: Shealtiel,

english_verse: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
translation_verse: kɛ Malkiram, kɛ Pedaia kɛ Shenazar kɛ Yekamia kɛ Hoshama kɛ Nedabia.

english_verse: Pedaiah had two sons: Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel was the father of Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister.
translation_verse: Pedaia fɔ bihii enyɔ: Zerubabel kɛ Shimei. Ni Zerubabel fɔ bihii enyɔ: Meshulam kɛ Hanania, kɛ yoo kome ni atsɛɔ lɛ Shelomit.

english_verse: He also had five other sons: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushabhesed.
translation_verse: Zerubabel fɔ bihii krokomɛi enumɔ hu: Hashuba kɛ Ohel kɛ Berekia kɛ Hasadia kɛ Yushab-Hesed.

english_verse: the father of Shemaiah and the grandfather of Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
translation_verse: Shekania fɔ binuu kome ni ji Shemaia, ni Shemaia fɔ bihii enumɔ: Hatush kɛ Igal kɛ Baria kɛ Nearia kɛ Shabat.

english_verse: Neariah was the father of Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam.
translation_verse: Nearia fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Elioenai kɛ Hizkia kɛ Azrikam.

english_verse: Elioenai was the father of Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.
translation_verse: Elioenai fɔ bihii kpawo: Hodavia kɛ Eliashib kɛ Pelaia kɛ Akub kɛ Yohanan kɛ Delaia kɛ Anani.

english_verse: Judah was the father of five sons: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
translation_verse: Yuda shwiei lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi nɛ: Perez kɛ Hezron kɛ Karmi kɛ Hur kɛ Shobal.

english_verse: Shobal was the father of Reaiah, the grandfather of Jahath, and the great-grandfather of Ahumai and Lahad. These men all belonged to the Zorathite clan.
translation_verse: Shobal fɔ Reaia, ni Reaia fɔ Yahat, ni Yahat fɔ Ahumai kɛ Lahad, mɛi ashwiei ni ji Zorabii lɛ.

english_verse: Hur was the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath. Some of his descendants settled the town of Bethlehem. Hur's other descendants included Etam, Penuel, and Ezer. Etam's sons were Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash, and his daughter was Hazzelelponi. Penuel settled the town of Gedor, and Ezer settled the town of Hushah.
translation_verse: Etam fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Yezreel kɛ Ishma kɛ Idbash kɛ amɛnyɛmi yoo kome ni atsɛɔ lɛ Hazelelponi. Penuel ji mɔ ni to Gedor maŋ lɛ, ni Ezer hu ji mɔ ni to Husha maŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Ashhur, who settled the town of Tekoa, had two wives: Helah and Naarah.
translation_verse: Ashur mɔ ni to Tekoa maŋ lɛ yɛ ŋamɛi enyɔ, Hela kɛ Naara.

english_verse: daughters. But his brothers did not have as many children, so the Simeon tribe was smaller than the Judah tribe.
translation_verse: Naara kɛ Ashur fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Ahuzam kɛ Hefer kɛ Temeni kɛ Haahashtari.

english_verse: Ashhur and Helah were the parents of Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
translation_verse: Ni Hela hu kɛ Ashur fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Zeret kɛ Izohar kɛ Etnan.

english_verse: Koz, the father of Anub and Zobebah, was also the ancestor of the clans of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
translation_verse: Koz fɔ Anub kɛ Zobeba kɛ mɔ mli ni Harum bi Aharhel wekui lɛ jɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Jabez was a man who got his name because of the pain he caused his mother during birth. But he was still the most respected son in his family.
translation_verse: Nuu ko ni gbɛi ji Yabez lɛ na gbɛi fe enyɛmimɛi lɛ. Tsɛbelɛ enyɛ wo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yabez ejaakɛ enyɛ lɛ kɛɛ, “Hejaramɔ mli mifɔ lɛ yɛ,”

english_verse: One day he prayed to Israel's God, “Please bless me and give me a lot of land. Be with me so I will be safe from harm.” And God did just what Jabez had asked.
translation_verse: shi Yabez sɔle etsɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Ofainɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ojɔɔ mi ni olɛɛ mihusui lɛ amli oha mi, ni obu mihe, ni obaa miyi koni nɔ fɔŋ ko akafee mi.” Nyɔŋmɔ hã Yabez nɔ ni ebi lɛ. Wekui krokomɛi

english_verse: Chelub was the brother of Shuhah and the father of Mehir. Later, Mehir had a son, Eshton,
translation_verse: Kɛlub, Shuha nyɛmi lɛ, fɔ Mehir. Mehir fɔ Eshton,

english_verse: whose three sons were Bethrapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. It was Tehinnah who settled the town of Nahash. These men and their families lived in the town of Recah.
translation_verse: ni Eshton fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Bet-Rafa kɛ Pasea kɛ Tehina. Tehina ji mɔ ni to Nahash maŋ lɛ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ashwiei lɛ hi Reka maŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: Kenaz was the father of Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel had two sons: Hathath and Meonothai,
translation_verse: Kenaz fɔ bihii enyɔ: Otniel kɛ Seraia. Otniel hu fɔ bihii enyɔ: Hatat kɛ Meonotai;

english_verse: who was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, who settled a place called “Valley of Crafts” because the people who lived there were experts in making things.
translation_verse: ni Meonotai fɔ Ofra. Seraia fɔ Yoab mɔ ni to Ge-Harashim, ni ji ŋaalɔi amaŋ lɛ. Awo jɛi gbɛi nɛɛ ejaakɛ ŋaalɔi sɔŋŋ ji mɛi ni hi jɛi.

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh had three sons: Iru, Elah, and Naam. Elah was the father of Kenaz.
translation_verse: Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ, fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Iru kɛ Ela kɛ Naam. Ela fɔ Kenaz.

english_verse: A man named Hodiah was married to the sister of Naham. Hodiah's descendants included Keilah of the Garmite clan and Eshtemoa of the Maacathite clan.
translation_verse: Hodia ŋɔ Naham nyɛmi yoo lɛ. Shwiei ni amɛwo lɛ hu ashwiei ji Garmbii awekui ni hi Keila maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, kɛ Maakatbii awekui lɛ ni hi Eshtemoa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: Shimon was the father of Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. Ishi was the father of Zoheth and Benzoheth.
translation_verse: Shimon fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Amnon kɛ Rina kɛ Ben-Hanan kɛ Tilon. Ishi fɔ bihii enyɔ: Zohet kɛ Ben-Zohet. Shela shwiei lɛ

english_verse: The members of these clans were the potters who lived in the towns of Netaim and Gederah and worked for the king. The Descendants of Simeon
translation_verse: Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ tsu nii akɛ maŋtsɛ gbɛshɔ̃lɔi, ni maji amli ni amɛhi ji Netaim kɛ Gedera. Simeon shwiei lɛ

english_verse: Simeon had five sons: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.
translation_verse: Simeon fɔ bihii enumɔ: Nemuel kɛ Yamin kɛ Yarib kɛ Zera kɛ Shaul.

english_verse: The descendants of Shaul included his son Shallum, his grandson Mibsam, and his great-grandson Mishma.
translation_verse: Shaul fɔ Shalum, ni Shalum fɔ Mibsam, ni Mibsam fɔ Mishma.

english_verse: The descendants of Mishma included his son Hammuel, his grandson Zaccur, and his great-grandson Shimei.
translation_verse: Mishma fɔ Hamuel, ni Hamuel fɔ Zakur, ni Zakur fɔ Shimei.

english_verse: They also lived in the five villages of Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan,
translation_verse: Amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛmaji enumɔ krokomɛi hu ji Etam kɛ Ain kɛ Rimon kɛ Token kɛ Ashan.

english_verse: as well as in the nearby villages as far as the town of Baal. These are the places where Simeon's descendants had settled, according to their own family records.
translation_verse: Soro amɛkrowai fɛɛ ni yɔɔ amɛmaji nɛɛ ahe kɛyashi Baalat maŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ anai lɛ. Simeon shwiei lɛ ŋmala heihei ni amɛhi lɛ kɛ amɛwekui lɛ hu ahe saji amɛfɔ̃ shi.

english_verse: As their families and clans became larger, the people of Simeon had the following leaders: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah, Joel, Jehu, Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah, and Ziza.
translation_verse: Akɛ ni gbɔmɛi atã ni atsi nɛɛ ji amɛwekui lɛ amli onukpai, ni amɛwekui lɛ hu ayi miifa hewɔ lɛ,

english_verse: When the people needed more pastureland for their flocks and herds, they looked as far as the eastern side of the valley where the town of Gerar is located,
translation_verse: amɛyi mli kɛtee aahu kɛyanina Gedor maŋ lɛ ni amɛyatao jwɛifɔ amɛha amɛkooloi lɛ yɛ jɔɔ lɛ bokãgbɛ.

english_verse: and they found a lot of good pastureland that was quiet and undisturbed. This had once belonged to the Hamites,
translation_verse: Ni amɛyana niyelihe kɛ enɔ jwɛifɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ ni hi hu; asaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ lɛɛ jogbaŋŋ, ni enɔ jɔ, ni toiŋjɔlɛ yɛ nɔ. Sa ko lɛ Hambii ashwiei ji mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: They killed the last of the Amalekites and lived there from then on.
translation_verse: Amɛyatua Amalekbii ashwiei ni eshwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni na foijee hegbɛ lɛ, ni amɛgbe amɛ ni amɛŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛhi jɛi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.

english_verse: Reuben was the oldest son of Jacob, but he lost his rights as the first-born son because he slept with one of his father's wives. The honor of the first-born son was then given to Joseph,
translation_verse: Naa Ruben, Yakob kromɔbi lɛ shwiei lɛ. (Ruben ji Yakob kromɔbi; shi ejɛ wɔɔ ni Ruben kɛ etsɛ hemɔ wɔ hewɔ lɛ, Yakob kɛ ekromɔbi gbɛnaa lɛ hã Yosef bihii lɛ. Kɛ̃lɛ abuuu Yosef akɛ lɛ ji kromɔbi yɛ weku lɛ wojiaŋ yɛ kromɔbi gbɛnaa ni akɛha lɛ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Reuben had four sons: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
translation_verse: Ruben, Yakob kromɔbi lɛ, fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Hanok kɛ Palu kɛ Hezron kɛ Karmi.

english_verse: The descendants of Joel included Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, Baal, and Beerah, a leader of the Reuben tribe. Later, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria took Beerah away as prisoner.
translation_verse: ni Baal fɔ Beera, mɔ ni Asiria Maŋtsɛ Tiglat-Pilneser baŋɔ lɛ nom kɛtee be mli ni lɛ ji Rubenbii lɛ alumɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The family records also include Jeiel, who was a clan leader, Zechariah, and Bela son of Azaz and grandson of Shema of the Joel clan. They lived in the territory around the town of Aroer, as far north as Nebo and Baal-Meon,
translation_verse: kɛ Bela, ni ji Yoel bi Shema bi Azaz bi lɛ. Amɛkutso lɛ hi shi kɛjɛ Aroer maŋ lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ ni kã shi kɛjɛ jɛi kɛtee kooyigbɛ aahu kɛyashɛ Nebo kɛ Baal-Meon he.

english_verse: and as far east as the desert just west of the Euphrates River. They needed this much land because they owned too many cattle to keep them all in Gilead.
translation_verse: Amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛhi bokãgbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛtee aahu kɛyanina shiaŋa lɛ ni kã shi kɛtee Eufrate Faa lɛ naa lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛkooloi lɛ shwere yɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: When Saul was king, the Reuben tribe attacked and defeated the Hagrites, then took over their land east of Gilead. The Descendants of Gad
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ Saul yinɔ lɛ, Rubenbii lɛ fã ta, ni amɛyatua Hagribii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛgbe amɛ ni amɛŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ Gilead bokãgbɛ niiaŋ lɛ fɛɛ. Gad shwiei lɛ

english_verse: The tribe of Gad lived in the region of Bashan, north of the Reuben tribe. Gad's territory extended all the way to the town of Salecah.
translation_verse: Gadbii lɛ hi Rubenbii lɛ akooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ ni ji Bashan lɛ nɔ kɛtee bokãgbɛ aahu kɛyashi Salka maŋ lɛ he.

english_verse: They were all descendants of Abihail, whose family line went back through Huri, Jaroah, Gilead, Michael, Jeshishai, Jahdo, and Buz.
translation_verse: Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ Abihail, ni ji Buz bi Yado bi Yeshishai bi Mikael bi Gilead bi Yaroa bi Huri lɛ bi lɛ, shwiei ji amɛ.

english_verse: Ahi, the son of Abdiel and the grandson of Guni, was the leader of their clan.
translation_verse: Ni, Ahi, ni ji Guni bi Abdiel bi lɛ, ji wekui srɔtoi nɛɛ fɛɛ anɔ onukpa.

english_verse: The people of Gad lived in the towns in the regions of Bashan and Gilead, as well as in the pastureland of Sharon.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ hi Gilead kɛ Bashan kɛ amɛhe maji lɛ amli, kɛ Sharon jwɛifɔ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ fɛɛ kɛyashwie amɛhusui lɛ anaa tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: soldiers trained to fight in battle with shields, swords, bows, and arrows.
translation_verse: ) ni he esa jogbaŋŋ kɛ tsɛŋ kɛ klante kɛ gãi kɛ tawuu.

english_verse: They fought against the Hagrites and the tribes of Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
translation_verse: Amɛfã ta, ni amɛ kɛ Hagribii ni yɔɔ Yetur kɛ Nafish kɛ Nodad lɛ yawu.

english_verse: Whenever these soldiers went to war against their enemies, they prayed to God and trusted him to help. That's why the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh defeated the Hagrites and their allies.
translation_verse: Hagribii lɛ na mɛi yafata amɛhe yɛ ta mli, kɛ̃lɛ aye amɛ kɛ mɛi ni yafata amɛhe lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kunim, ejaakɛ Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ sɔle amɛtsɛ Naa Nyɔŋmɔ koni eye ebua amɛ yɛ ta lɛ mli. Naa Nyɔŋmɔ bo amɛsɔlemɔ lɛ toi ejaakɛ amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ enɔ.

english_verse: Many of the Hagrites died in battle, because God was fighting this battle against them. The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh lived in that territory until they were taken as prisoners to Assyria. The Tribe of East Manasseh
translation_verse: Hagribii lɛ babaoo nyɔnyɔi ejaakɛ eji Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa akɛ awu nakai ta lɛ. Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ hi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aahu kɛyashi be ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ. Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ

english_verse: East Manasseh was a large tribe, so its people settled in the northern region of Bashan, as far north as Baal-Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ hi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; amɛyi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ kɛjɛ Bashan aahu kɛtee kɛyashwie Baal-Hermon kɛ Senir Gɔŋkpɔ lɛ kɛ Hermon Gɔŋ lɛ he.

english_verse: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel were their clan leaders; they were well-known leaders and brave soldiers. The Tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh Are Defeated
translation_verse: Amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ amli onukpai lɛ ji Efer kɛ Ishi kɛ Eliel kɛ Azriel; kɛ Yeremia kɛ Yodavia kɛ Yadiel. Amɛ ji hii kãkãlɔi, ni amɛyɛ gbɛi yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awebii lɛ ateŋ. Aŋɔ Bokãgbɛ Akutsei lɛ nom

english_verse: The people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh were unfaithful to the God their ancestors had worshiped, and they started worshiping the gods of the nations that God had forced out of Canaan.
translation_verse: Shi Bokãgbɛ Akutsei lɛ tɔ̃ amɛtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ. Amɛkwa lɛ, ni amɛbɔ̃i shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ amɛhewɔ lɛ ajemawɔji lɛ jamɔ moŋ.

english_verse: So God sent King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria to attack these Israelite tribes. The king led them away as prisoners to Assyria, and from then on, he forced them to live in Halah, Habor, Hara, and near the Gozan River.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ Pul ewo amɛhe, ni efã ta kɛbatua amɛ, ni ebaŋɔ Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ nom, ni eloo amɛ kɛtee eyashwie Hala kɛ Habor kɛ Hara shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ Gozan Faa lɛ hu naa, ni amɛka jɛi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohat fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Amram kɛ Izehar kɛ Hebron kɛ Uziel.

english_verse: Amram was the father of Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation_verse: Amram fɔ bihii enyɔ, Aaron kɛ Mose, kɛ biyoo kome ni ji Miriam. Aaron fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Nadad kɛ Abihu kɛ Eleazar kɛ Itamar.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia took Jehozadak to Babylon as prisoner when the Lord let the people of Judah and Jerusalem be dragged from their land.
translation_verse: Be ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar nine nɔ ni ehã aŋɔ Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛmbii lɛ nom lɛ, Yehozadak fata mɛi ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ ahe kɛtee. Levi shwiei krokomɛi

english_verse: Levi's three sons had sons of their own.
translation_verse: Levi fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Gershon kɛ Kohat kɛ Merari.

english_verse: Gershon was the father of Libni and Shimei.
translation_verse: Gershon bii ji Libni kɛ Shimei:

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohat bii ji Amram kɛ Izehar kɛ Hebron kɛ Uziel,

english_verse: Merari was the father of Mahli and Mushi. These descendants of Levi each became leaders of their own clans.
translation_verse: ni Merari bii ji Maheli kɛ Mushi. Ni bɔ ni Levibii lɛ awekui yɛ tsɛmɛi ayinɔi lɛ anaa jwere shi hã nɛ:

english_verse: Kohath's descendants included Amminadab, Korah, Assir, Elkanah, Ebiasaph, Assir, Tahath, Uriel, Uzziah, and Shaul.
translation_verse: kɛ Tahat kɛ Uriel kɛkɛ lɛ Uzia kɛ Shaul.

english_verse: Elkanah was the father of Amasai and Ahimoth.
translation_verse: Elkana fɔ bihii enyɔ: Amasai kɛ Ahimot.

english_verse: Ahimoth's descendants included Elkanah, Zophai, Nahath, Eliab, Jeroham, and Elkanah.
translation_verse: kɛ Eliab kɛ Yeroham kɛ Elkana.

english_verse: Samuel was the father of Joel and Abijah, born in that order.
translation_verse: Samuel fɔ bihii enyɔ: Yoel, ji kromɔbi, kɛ esɛɛho Abia.

english_verse: Merari's descendants included Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah, Shimea, Haggiah, and Asaiah. The Temple Musicians
translation_verse: kɛ Shimea kɛ Hagia kɛ Asaia. Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli lalanɔkwɛlɔi lɛ

english_verse: After King David had the sacred chest moved to Jerusalem, he appointed musicians from the Levi tribe to be in charge of the music at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Mɛi yɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David to koni amɛkwɛ lala ni alaa yɛ Yehowa we lɛ mli lɛ nɔ, kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni akɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ bama Yehowa we lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: Ethan was also Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Ethan belonged to the Merari clan, and his ancestors included Kishi, Abdi, Malluch, Hashabiah, Amaziah, Hilkiah, Amzi, Bani, Shemer, Mahli, Mushi, Merari, and Levi.
translation_verse: Shemer tsɛ ji Mali; Mali tsɛ ji Mushi; Mushi tsɛ ji Merari, ni Merari tsɛ ji Levi.

english_verse: The rest of the Levites were appointed to work at the sacred tent. The Descendants of Aaron
translation_verse: Amɛnyɛmimɛi Levibii krokomɛi lɛ, amɛ amɛdɛŋ akɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli nitsumɔi krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ wo. Aaron shwiei lɛ

english_verse: Only Aaron and his descendants were allowed to offer sacrifices and incense on the two altars at the sacred tent. They were in charge of the most holy place and the ceremonies to forgive sins, just as God's servant Moses had commanded.
translation_verse: Aaron kɛ eshwiei lɛ ji mɛi ni kɛ tsofakɛŋma kɛ afɔlei lɛ yaa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ amɛyashãa. Amɛnitsumɔ ji jamɔ ni ajaa yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ mli lɛ he sɔ̃ɔmɔ; asaŋ amɛkpãtãa amɛhãa maŋ lɛ koni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ tɔ̃mɔ ni Israelbii etɔ̃ lɛ afa amɛ. Amɛtsuɔ nitsumɔi nɛɛ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsulɔ Mose ewo he kitã lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Aaron's descendants included his son Eleazar, Phinehas, Abishua, Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiah, Meraioth, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, and Ahimaaz. The Towns for the Levites (Joshua
translation_verse: Ahitub fɔ Zadok, ni Zadok fɔ Ahimaaz. Maji amli ni Levibii lɛ hi

english_verse: Aaron's descendants belonged to the Levite clan of Kohath, and they were the first group chosen to receive towns to live in.
translation_verse: Maji amli ni Levibii lɛ hi yɛ shikpɔŋ ni akɛha Aaron shwiei ni jɛ Kohat mli lɛ nɛ, ejaakɛ amɛ ji mɛi anɔ ni klɛŋklɛŋ oshiki ni afɔ̃ lɛ gbee.

english_verse: They received the town of Hebron in the territory of Judah and the pastureland around it.
translation_verse: Akɛ Hebron ni yɔɔ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hã amɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ he jwɛifɔ shikpɔji lɛ hu;

english_verse: But the farmland and villages around Hebron were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
translation_verse: shi maŋ lɛ he ŋmɔji kɛ ekrowai lɛ akɛhã Yefune bi Kaleb.

english_verse: So Aaron's descendants received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Hebron, Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa, Hilen, Debir, Ashan, and Beth-Shemesh.
translation_verse: kɛ Ashan kɛ Bet-Shemesh, eko fɛɛ eko lɛ kɛ ehe jwɛifɔ shikpɔŋ.

english_verse: From the Benjamin tribe they were given the towns of Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth and the pastureland around them. Thirteen towns were given to Aaron's descendants.
translation_verse: Benyaminbii lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji ni akɛha Aaron shwiei lɛ ji Geba kɛ Alemet kɛ Anatot, eko fɛɛ eko lɛ kɛ ehe jwɛifɔ shikpɔŋ. Maji ni akɛhã Kohat shwiei lɛ awekui lɛ fɛɛ koni amɛhi amɛmli lɛ ayibɔ fee nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃.

english_verse: The rest of the Levite clan of Kohath received ten towns from West Manasseh.
translation_verse: Yɛ oshiki ni afɔ̃ lɛ naa lɛ, ahã Kohatbii awekui ni eshwɛ lɛ maji nyɔŋma yɛ Anaigbɛ Manasebii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Gershon received thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and East Manasseh in Bashan.
translation_verse: Aŋɔ maji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ kɛjɛ Isakarbii lɛ kɛ Asherbii lɛ kɛ Naftalibii kɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ ni yɔɔ Bashan lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ adɛŋ, ni akɛhã Gershon shwiei lɛ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Merari received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
translation_verse: Ni akɔlɔ maji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛjɛ Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Zebulonbii lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni akɛhã Merari shwiei lɛ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa.

english_verse: So the people of Israel gave the Levites towns to live in and the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ Israelbii lɛ tsɔ̃ amɛhã Levibii lɛ maji koni amɛhi mli.

english_verse: All the towns were chosen with the Lord's help, including those towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
translation_verse: Afɔ̃ oshiki, ni adamɔ no nɔ ni akɛ Yuda kɛ Simeon kɛ Benyamin shikpɔji lɛ anɔ maji ni atsi amɛtã nɛɛ hã Levibii lɛ.

english_verse: Some of the families of the Kohath clan received their towns from the tribe of Ephraim.
translation_verse: Ahã Kohatbii lɛ awekui lɛ ekomɛi maji kɛ amɛhe jwɛifɔ shikpɔji yɛ Efraimbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: And from West Manasseh they received Aner and Bileam, together with their pastureland.
translation_verse: Ni akɛ Anaigbɛ Manasebii hu amaji ni ji Aner kɛ Bileam kɛ amɛhe jwɛifɔ shikpɔji shi nɔ hã Kohatbii lɛ.

english_verse: The Gershonite clan received two towns from the tribe of East Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and Ashtaroth, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Naa maji kɛ amɛhe jwɛifɔ shikpɔji ni akɛha Gershonbii awekui lɛ: Yɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ akɛ Golan yɛ Bashan kɛ Ashtarot hã amɛ.

english_verse: Finally, the Gershonites received three towns from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Yɛ Naftalibii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ akɛ Kedesh yɛ Galilea kɛ Hamon kɛ Kiriataim hã amɛ.

english_verse: The rest of the Merari clan received the towns of Rimmono and Tabor and their pastureland from the tribe of Zebulun.
translation_verse: Merari shwiei lɛ ateŋ wekui ni eshwɛ lɛ, maji kɛ amɛhe jwɛifɔ shikpɔji ni akɛhã amɛ yɛ Zebulonbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ji Rimono kɛ Tabor.

english_verse: Issachar was the father of four sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
translation_verse: Isakar fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Tola kɛ Pua kɛ Yashub kɛ Shimron.

english_verse: Tola was the father of Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, who were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their clan. There were
translation_verse: Tola fɔ bihii ekpaa: Uzi kɛ Refaia kɛ Yeriel kɛ Yahemai kɛ Ibsam kɛ Shemuel. Amɛ fɛɛ amɛtsɔmɔ Tola shwiei awekui lɛ anukpai, asaŋ kɛ tatsɛmɛi wuji hu. Maŋtsɛ David yinɔ lɛ Tola shwiei nɛɛ ayibɔ ji akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai ekpaa.

english_verse: Ephraim mourned for his sons a long time, and his relatives came to comfort him.
translation_verse: Efraim, amɛtsɛ lɛ, ye amɛhe ŋkɔmɔ gbii abɔ, ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ ba ni amɛbashɛje emii.

english_verse: Uzzi was the father of Izrahiah and the grandfather of Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, who were also family leaders.
translation_verse: Uzi fɔ bi kome, ni ji Izrahia. Izrahia fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Mikael kɛ Obadia kɛ Yoel kɛ Ishia. Uzi kɛ ebihii ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ tsɔmɔ wekui ayitsei.

english_verse: Zophah was the father of Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
translation_verse: Zofa shwiei ji Sua kɛ Harnefer kɛ Shual kɛ Beri kɛ Imra,

english_verse: In fact, according to family records, the tribe of Issachar had a total of
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Isakar akutso lɛ mli tabilɔi ayikulɛ fee hii akpei nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ kpawo. Benyamin kɛ Dan shwiei

english_verse: Benjamin was the father of three sons: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
translation_verse: Benyamin fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Bela kɛ Beker kɛ Yediael.

english_verse: Bela was the father of Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their father's clan. The number of soldiers in their clan was
translation_verse: Bela fɔ bihii enumɔ: Ezbon kɛ Uzi kɛ Uziel kɛ Yeremot kɛ Iri. Amɛ fɛɛ amɛtsɔmɔ akutso lɛ mli wekui amli onukpai, asaŋ kɛ tabilɔi kãkãlɔi hu; ni hii ni eshɛ tayaa akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ejwɛ yɛ amɛshwiei ateŋ.

english_verse: Becher was the father of Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth.
translation_verse: Beker fɔ bihii nɛɛhu: Zemira kɛ Yoash kɛ Eliezer kɛ Elioenai kɛ Omri kɛ Yeremot kɛ Abia kɛ Anatot kɛ Alemet.

english_verse: Ephraim was the father of Shuthelah and the ancestor of Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath,
translation_verse: Naa Efraim shwiei lɛ ayinɔiayinɔi lɛ jɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ: Efraim fɔ Shutela, ni Shutela fɔ Bered; Bered fɔ Tahat, ni Tahat fɔ Eleada, ni Eleada fɔ Tahat.

english_verse: Jediael was the father of Bilhan and the grandfather of Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
translation_verse: Yediael fɔ binuu kome ni ji Bilhan; shi Bilhan fɔ bihii kpawo: Yeush kɛ Benyamin kɛ Ehud kɛ Kenaana kɛ Zetan kɛ Tarshish kɛ Ahishahar.

english_verse: Ulam was the father of Bedan. These were all descendants of Gilead, the son of Machir and the grandson of Manasseh.
translation_verse: ni Ulam fɔ binuu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Bedam. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Manase bi Makir bi Gilead shwiei lɛ.

english_verse: Ir was the father of Shuppim and Huppim, who also belonged to this clan. Dan was the father of Hushim. The Descendants of Naphtali
translation_verse: Ir fɔ Shupim kɛ Hupim; ni Dan fɔ binuu kome ni ji Hushim. Naftali shwiei lɛ

english_verse: Naphtali's mother was Bilhah, and he was the father of Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum. The Descendants of Manasseh
translation_verse: Naftali fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Yaziel kɛ Guni kɛ Yezer kɛ Shalum. Ekɛ Bilha bii ni. Manase shwiei lɛ

english_verse: Manasseh and his Syrian wife were the parents of Asriel and Machir the father of Gilead.
translation_verse: Manase kɛ ehemɔ Aramyoo lɛ fɔ bihii enyɔ: Asriel kɛ Makir mɔ ni tsɔ̃ Gilead tsɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Machir found a wife for Huppim and one for Shuppim. Machir had a sister named Maacah. Zelophehad was also a descendant of Manasseh, and he had five daughters.
translation_verse: Makir ŋɔ yei ehã Hupim kɛ Shupim. Makir yɛ nyɛmi yoo ni atsɛɔ lɛ Maaka. Makir binuu ni ji enyɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Zelofehad. Zelofehad fɔ biyei sɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Machir and his wife Maacah were the parents of Peresh and Sheresh. Peresh was the father of Ulam and Rekem.
translation_verse: Makir ŋa ji Maaka, ekɛ lɛ fɔ bihii enyɔ, ni ewo amɛ gbɛi akɛ Peresh kɛ Sheresh. Peresh fɔ bihii enyɔ, Ulam kɛ Rakem;

english_verse: Gilead's sister Hammolecheth was the mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
translation_verse: Gilead nyɛmi yoo Hamoleket fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Ishod kɛ Abiezer kɛ Mahela.

english_verse: Shemida, another descendant of Manasseh, was the father of Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam. The Descendants of Ephraim
translation_verse: Shemida fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Ahian kɛ Shekem kɛ Likhi kɛ Aniam. Efraim shwiei lɛ

english_verse: Zabad, and Shuthelah. Ephraim had two other sons, Ezer and Elead. But they were killed when they tried to steal livestock from the people who lived in the territory of Gath.
translation_verse: Tahat fɔ Zabad, ni Zabad fɔ Shutela. Efraim fɔ bihii enyɔ krokomɛi efata Shutela he. Amɛ ji Ezer kɛ Elead ni agbe amɛ be ni amɛtee amɛyaamɔmɔ Gatbii ni ji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɔmɔbii lɛ atsinai ekãa naa lɛ.

english_verse: Some time later his wife gave birth to another son, and Ephraim named him Beriah, because he was born during a time of misery.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Efraim kɛ eŋã lɛ wɔ, ni yoo lɛ na musu, ni efɔ binuu. Awo lɛ Beria yɛ amanehulu ni Efraim we lɛ ena lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Ephraim also had a son named Rephah, and his descendants included Resheph, Telah, Tahan,
translation_verse: Efraim fɔ bi ko hu ni gbɛi ji Refa. Refa nɛɛ fɔ Reshef; Reshef fɔ Tela, ni Tela fɔ Tahan;

english_verse: The descendants of Ephraim took over the territory as far south as Bethel, as far east as Naaran, and as far west as Gezer. Their territory included all the villages around these towns, as well as Shechem, Ayyah, and the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ni ahã amɛ koni amɛhi nɔ lɛ, no nɔ Betel maŋ wulu lɛ kɛ ehe maji lɛ kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ aahu kɛyashi Naaran yɔɔ. Yɛ anaigbɛ lɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ tee aahu kɛyashɛ Gezer maŋ wulu lɛ kɛ ehe maji lɛ ahe. Shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ Shekem maŋ wulu lɛ kɛ ehe maji lɛ kɛ Aya maŋ wulu kɛ ehe maji lɛ yɔɔ.

english_verse: The descendants of Manasseh settled in the territory that included Beth-Shan, Taanach, Megiddo, Dor, and the nearby villages. The descendants of Joseph lived in these towns and villages. The Descendants of Asher
translation_verse: Manase shwiei lɛ adɛŋ maji wuji ejwɛ nɛɛ kɛ amɛhe maji lɛ baje: Bet-Shan kɛ Taanak kɛ Megido kɛ Dor. Nɛkɛ maji nɛɛ amli Yakob bi Yosef shwiei lɛ hi. Asher shwiei lɛ

english_verse: Asher had four sons, Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and one daughter, Serah.
translation_verse: Naa Asher shwiei lɛ: Asher fɔ bihii ejwɛ, Imna kɛ Ishva kɛ Ishvi kɛ Beria, kɛ amɛnyɛmi yoo kome ni ji Sera.

english_verse: Beriah was the father of Heber and Malchiel the father of Birzaith.
translation_verse: Beria fɔ bihii enyɔ: Heber kɛ Malkiel mɔ ni to Birzait maŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Heber was the father of three sons, Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and one daughter, Shua.
translation_verse: Heber fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Yaflet kɛ Shomer kɛ Hotam kɛ amɛnyɛmi yoo kome, ni ji Shua.

english_verse: Japhlet was the father of Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath.
translation_verse: Yaflet hu fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Pasak kɛ Bimhal kɛ Ashvat.

english_verse: Shomer was the father of Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
translation_verse: Yaflet nyɛmi nuu Shomer fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Roga kɛ Yehuba kɛ Aram.

english_verse: And Japhlet's brother Hotham was the father of Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
translation_verse: Ni Shomer nyɛmi nuu Hotam fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Zofa kɛ Imna kɛ Shelesh kɛ Amal.

english_verse: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
translation_verse: kɛ Bezer kɛ Hod kɛ Shama kɛ Shilsha kɛ Itran kɛ Beera.

english_verse: Jether was the father of Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
translation_verse: Yeter shwiei ji Yefune kɛ Pispa kɛ Ara;

english_verse: Ulla was the father of Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
translation_verse: ni Ula hu shwiei ji Ara kɛ Haniel kɛ Rizia.

english_verse: These were the descendants of Asher, and they were all respected family leaders and brave soldiers. The tribe of Asher had a total of
translation_verse: Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Asher shwiei ni ji amɛtsɛmɛi ashĩai lɛ amli onukpai lɛ, hii kakabãi kɛ hiɛnaanɔ gbɔmɛi, asaŋ kɛ maŋ lumɛi lɛ ateŋ onukpai hu. Asher shwiei nɛɛ hiɛ hii akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekpaa ni eshɛ tayaa.

english_verse: Benjamin had five sons, who were born in the following order: Bela, Ashbel, Aharah,
translation_verse: Benyamin fɔ bihii enumɔ. Ekromɔbi lɛ ji Bela, ni mɔ ni ji enyɔ ji Ashbel; ebi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ji Ahara;

english_verse: Bela was the father of Addar, Gera, Abihud,
translation_verse: Bela shwiei ji Adar kɛ Gera kɛ Abihud,

english_verse: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
translation_verse: kɛ Abishua kɛ Naaman kɛ Ahoa,

english_verse: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
translation_verse: kɛ Gera kɛ Shefufan kɛ Huram.

english_verse: Ehud was the father of Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera. They were clan leaders in the town of Geba, but were later forced to move to the town of Manahath, and Gera led the way. He had two sons: Uzza and Ahihud.
translation_verse: Naa Ehud shwiei lɛ. Amɛ ji Naaman kɛ Ahia kɛ Gera. Amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ amli wekui lɛ onukpai ji amɛ fɛɛ, ni kulɛ Geba amɛyɔɔ; shi abashwie amɛ akranaŋ naa kɛje jɛi, ni amɛtee amɛyabɔ mɔfro yɛ Manahat. Gera, ni ji Uza kɛ Ahihud tsɛ, ji mɔ ni nyiɛ Geba hii lɛ ahiɛ kɛyabɔ mɔfro lɛ.

english_verse: Elpaal was the father of Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who settled the towns of Ono and Lod, as well as the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Elpaal bihii ji Eber kɛ Misham kɛ Shemed mɔ ni to Ono kɛ Lod maji lɛ kɛ akrowai ni bɔle amɛhe lɛ. Benyaminbii ni hi Gat kɛ Ayalon lɛ

english_verse: Beriah and Shema were family leaders in the clan that lived in the town of Aijalon and that forced out the people of Gath.
translation_verse: Beria kɛ Shema lɛ Ayalonbii lɛ awekui lɛ weku onukpai ji amɛ; amɛ ji mɛi ni shwie Gat maŋ lɛ mli bii lɛ.

english_verse: Beriah's descendants included Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth, Zebadiah, Arad, Eder, Michael, Ishpah, and Joha.
translation_verse: kɛ Mikael kɛ Ishpa kɛ Yoha. Benyaminbii ni hi Yerusalɛm lɛ

english_verse: Elpaal's descendants included Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber, Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab.
translation_verse: kɛ Ishmerai kɛ Izlia kɛ Yohab.

english_verse: Jeroham's descendants included Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah, Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri.
translation_verse: kɛ Yaareshia kɛ Elia kɛ Zikri.

english_verse: These were the family leaders in their ancestor's clan, and they and their descendants lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji wekui amli onukpai kɛ amɛshwiei ni hi Yerusalɛm lɛ. Benyaminbii ni hi Gibeon kɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ

english_verse: Jeiel settled the town of Gibeon. He and his wife Maacah lived there
translation_verse: Yiel ji mɔ ni yato Gibeon maŋ lɛ, ni ehi jɛi. Eŋã gbɛi ji Maaka,

english_verse: along with their sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
translation_verse: ni ekromɔbi ji Abdon. Ebihii krokomɛi lɛ ji Zur kɛ Kish kɛ Baal kɛ Ner kɛ Nadab,

english_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,
translation_verse: kɛ Gedor kɛ Ahio kɛ Zeker,

english_verse: and Mikloth the father of Shimeah. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives. The Descendants of King Saul
translation_verse: kɛ Miklot ni ji Shimea tsɛ lɛ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛ amɛ hu amɛshwiei hi Yerusalɛm yɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi Benyaminbii lɛ amasɛi. Maŋtsɛ Saul weku

english_verse: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation_verse: Ner fɔ Kish, ni Kish fɔ Saul, ni Saul fɔ Yonatan kɛ Malkishua kɛ Abinadab kɛ Esh-Baal.

english_verse: Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah,
translation_verse: Yonatan fɔ Merib-Baal, ni Merib-Baal fɔ Mika.

english_verse: and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
translation_verse: Mika fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Piton kɛ Melek kɛ Tarea kɛ Ahaz.

english_verse: Saul's other descendants were Jehoaddah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza,
translation_verse: Ahaz fɔ Yehoada, ni Yehoada fɔ bihii etɛ̃, Alemet kɛ Azmavet kɛ Zimri; ni Zimri fɔ Moza.

english_verse: as well as Azel's six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_verse: Azel fɔ bihii ekpaa: Azrikam kɛ Bokeru kɛ Ishmael kɛ Shearia kɛ Obadia kɛ Hanan.

english_verse: Azel's brother Eshek was the father of Ulam, Jeush, and Eliphelet.
translation_verse: Ni Azel nyɛmi nuu Eshek fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Ulam kɛ Yeush kɛ Elifelet.

english_verse: Ulam's sons were brave soldiers who were experts at using a bow and arrows. They had a total of
translation_verse: Ulam bihii lɛ tsɔmɔ hii kãkãlɔi kɛ gãitsɛ̃lɔi kpanakpanai; ni amɛbihii kɛ bihii abii lɛ ayibɔ fee oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ. Benyaminbii ji Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ.

english_verse: People from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh settled in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nomi lɛ ateŋ Yudabii lɛ kɛ Benyaminbii lɛ kɛ Efraimbii lɛ kɛ Manasebii lɛ ekomɛi tee Yerusalɛm ni amɛyahi jɛi.

english_verse: Here is a list of priests who settled in Jerusalem: Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jachin; Azariah, who was a temple official, and whose ancestors included Hilkiah, Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub; Adaiah son of Jeroham, whose ancestors included Pashhur and Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel, whose ancestors included Jahzerah, Meshullam, Meshillemith, and Immer.
translation_verse: kɛ Adaia ni etsɛ ji Yeroham ni eji Pashur bi kɛ Malkiya seshinyo lɛ, kɛ Maasai ni etsɛ ji Adiel, ni eji Yahazera kɛ Meshulam kɛ Meshilemit kɛ Imer seshinyo lɛ.

english_verse: Here is a list of Levites who settled in Jerusalem: Shemaiah from the Merari clan, whose ancestors included Hasshub, Azrikam, and Hashabiah; Bakbakkar; Heresh; Galal; Mattaniah son of Mica, whose ancestors included Zichri and Asaph; Obadiah son of Shemaiah, whose ancestors included Galal and Jeduthun; Berechiah son of Asa and grandson of Elkanah, who had lived in the villages near the town of Netophah. The Temple Guards Who Settled in Jerusalem
translation_verse: kɛ Obadia ni etsɛ ji Shemaia ni eseshibii ji Galal kɛ Yedutun lɛ, kɛ Berekia ni etsɛ ji Asa, ni eji Elkana ni hi Netofa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ shwie lɛ. Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hebulɔi ni hi Yerusalɛm

english_verse: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives were the guards at the temple gates. Shallum was the leader of this clan,
translation_verse: Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hebulɔi ni hi Yerusalɛm ji Shalum kɛ Akub kɛ Talmon kɛ Ahiman kɛ amɛwekui lɛ amli bii. Shalum ji amɛnukpa.

english_verse: and for a long time they had been the guards at the King's Gate on the east side of the city. Before that, their ancestors guarded the entrance to the Levite camp.
translation_verse: Kɛbashi nakai be lɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji mɛi ni buɔ maŋtsɛ agbo lɛ naa yɛ bokãgbɛ. Tsutsu ko lɛ kulɛ amɛbuɔ agboi ni yɔɔ Levibii ashihilɛhei lɛ anaa.

english_verse: Shallum son of Kore, as well as the other men in the Korahite clan, guarded the entrance to the temple, just as their ancestors had guarded the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Shalum, ni ji Ebiasaf bi Kore bi lɛ, kɛ enyɛmimɛi ni ji Kora shwiei lɛ amɛ amɛbuɔ Yehowa Shihilɛhe lɛ he.

english_verse: Phinehas son of Eleazar had supervised their work because the Lord was with him.
translation_verse: Ni Eleazar bi Finehas mɔ ni Yehowa ena lɛ mɔbɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni kwɛ amɛnɔ be ko mli.

english_verse: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was also one of the guards at the temple.
translation_verse: Zakaria, Meshelemia bi lɛ, hu ji agbonaabulɔ yɛ Yehowa Shihilɛhe lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.

english_verse: There was one full-time guard appointed to each of the four sides of the temple.
translation_verse: Agbo yɛ Shihilɛhe lɛ koŋ fɛɛ koŋ, ekooyigbɛ kɛ ewuoyigbɛ kɛ ebokãgbɛ kɛ enaigbɛ; ni agbo fɛɛ agbo yɛ agbonaabulɔnukpa.

english_verse: Their assistants lived in the villages outside the city, and every seven days a group of them would come into the city and take their turn at guard duty.
translation_verse: Daa gbii kpawo lɛ agbonaabulɔi nɛɛ awekumɛi ni yɔɔ amɛkrowai lɛ amli lɛ baa, ni amɛbatsakeɔ mɛi ni buɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The four full-time guards were Levites, and they supervised the other guards and were responsible for the rooms in the temple and the supplies kept there.
translation_verse: Agbonaabulɔinukpai ejwɛ lɛ, amɛ lɛ Levibii ji amɛ, ni amɛ amɛkwɛɔ nitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Amɛ amɛbuɔ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ mli nitoohei lɛ kɛ amɛmli nibii fɛɛ ahe akɔntaa.

english_verse: They guarded the temple day and night and opened its doors every morning. The Duties of the Levites
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ masɛi amɛshihilɛhei yɔɔ, ejaakɛ amɛnitsumɔ ji akɛ amɛbu Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ he, asaŋ ni amɛ gbele enaa agboi lɛ daa leebi. Levibii krokomɛi lɛ

english_verse: Some of the Levites were responsible for the equipment used in worship at the temple, and they had to count everything before and after it was used.
translation_verse: Levibii lɛ ekomɛi hu kwɛɔ tsɛnsii ni akɛjaa lɛ anɔ. Amɛnitsumɔ ji amɛkpa naa kɛ abahole kɛ kɛji akɛmiiba akɛbaato lɛ.

english_verse: But only the priests could mix the spices.
translation_verse: Shi osɔfoi abii lɛ ji mɛi ni futuɔ nibii srɔtoi ni akɛfeɔ tsofakɛŋma lɛ.

english_verse: Mattithiah, Shallum's oldest son, was a member of the Levite clan of Korah, and he was in charge of baking the bread used for offerings.
translation_verse: Levinyo ko ni gbɛi ji Matitia, Koranyo Shalum lɛ kromɔbi lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni kwɛɔ akpiti tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ ashãa nɔ.

english_verse: The Levites from the Kohath clan were in charge of baking the sacred loaves of bread for each Sabbath.
translation_verse: Levibii lɛ anyɛmimɛi ni ji Kohatbii lɛ hu ji mɛi ni kwɛɔ aboloo ni akɛmaa Yehowa hiɛ daa hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ shãa nɔ.

english_verse: The Levite family leaders who were the musicians also lived at the temple. They had no other responsibilities, because they were on duty day and night.
translation_verse: Levibii wekui lɛ ateŋ ekomɛi anitsumɔ ji lamɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ. Wekui nɛɛ amli wekunukpai lɛ hi Sɔlemɔ we lɛ piai amli. Akɛ nitsumɔ ko kwraa ejɛɛɛ sɛɛ gbaaa amɛnaa ejaakɛ shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ fɛɛ lɛ amɛhiɛ lamɔ mli.

english_verse: All of these men were family leaders in the Levi tribe and were listed that way in their family records. They lived in Jerusalem. King Saul's Family (
translation_verse: Mɛi atã ni atsi kɛtsɔ̃ hiɛ lɛ ji Levibii lɛ ashikwɛ̃ɛbii lɛ kɛ amɛshwiei lɛ ayinɔi lɛ amli wekunukpai lɛ, ni amɛhi Yerusalɛm lɛ. Maŋtsɛ Saul seshi kɛ eshwiei (

english_verse: the father of Shimeam. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives.
translation_verse: Miklot fɔ Shimeam. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛ amɛ hu amɛshwiei hi Yerusalɛm yɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi Benyaminbii lɛ amasɛi.

english_verse: Jeiel had settled the town of Gibeon, where he and his wife Maacah lived.
translation_verse: Yeiel ji mɔ ni yato Gibeon maŋ lɛ, ni jɛi ehi. Eŋã gbɛi ji Maaka.

english_verse: They had ten sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
translation_verse: Ekromɔbi lɛ gbɛi ji Abdon, ni ebihii krokomɛi ji Zur kɛ Kish kɛ Baal kɛ Ner kɛ Nadab,

english_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth
translation_verse: kɛ Gedor kɛ Ahio kɛ Zakaria kɛ Miklot.

english_verse: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation_verse: Ner fɔ Kish, ni Kish fɔ Saul, ni Saul fɔ Yonatan kɛ Malkishua kɛ Abinadab kɛ Esh-Baal.

english_verse: Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah, and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.
translation_verse: Mika fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Piton kɛ Melek kɛ Tarea kɛ Ahaz.

english_verse: The descendants of Ahaz included Jarah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza, Binea, Rephaiah, Eleasah, and Azel and his six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_verse: Azel fɔ bihii ekpaa: Azrikam kɛ Bokeru kɛ Ishmael kɛ Shearia kɛ Obadia kɛ Hanan.

english_verse: The Philistines fought against Israel in a battle at Mount Gilboa. Israel's soldiers ran from the Philistines, and many of them were killed.
translation_verse: Filistibii lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ wu, ni Filistibii lɛ anine tsɔ̃ Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛgbe Israelbii lɛ amɛshwie Gilboa Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Israelbii lɛ jo foi yɛ Filistibii lɛ ahiɛ;

english_verse: Saul died because he was unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord. He even asked advice from a woman who talked to spirits of the dead,
translation_verse: Anɔkwa ni Saul eyayeee lɛ hewɔ ni egbo lɛ. Saul eyayeee Yehowa anɔkwa ejaakɛ eyayeee Yehowa kitãi lɛ anɔ ejaakɛ etee eyafee nii yɛ sisatsɛlɔ ŋɔɔ ekɛbi nii,

english_verse: The Philistines closed in on Saul and his sons and killed three of them: Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.
translation_verse: shi Filistibii lɛ tiu Israelbii lɛ kɛ Saul kɛ ebihii lɛ. Amɛnine shɛ Saul bihii Yonatan kɛ Abinadab kɛ Malkishua nɔ, ni amɛgbe amɛ.

english_verse: The fighting was fierce around Saul, and he was badly wounded by enemy arrows.
translation_verse: Akɛ ta lɛ nina Saul kpaakpa. Henyɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ gãitsɛ̃lɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko yoo Saul, ni etsɛ̃ lɛ gãi, ni epila lɛ ablaŋ.

english_verse: Saul told the soldier who carried his weapons, “Kill me with your sword! I don't want those godless Philistines to torture and make fun of me.” But the soldier was afraid to kill him. Then Saul stuck himself in the stomach with his own sword and fell on the blade.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ oblanyo ni hiɛɔ etawuu nii lɛ akɛ, “Gbalamɔ oklante lɛ ni okɛdu mi bɔ ni afee ni foolɔi nɛɛ akaba amɛbagbe mi, ni amɛye mihe fɛo.” Shi oblanyo lɛ emiii nakai feemɔ, ejaakɛ gbeyei emɔ lɛ naakpa. Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Saul gbala lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eklante lɛ ni eho egbee nɔ.

english_verse: When the soldier realized that Saul was dead, he killed himself in the same way.
translation_verse: Be ni oblanyo lɛ na akɛ Saul egbo lɛ, lɛ hu eho egbee eklante lɛ nɔ, ni egbo.

english_verse: Saul, three of his sons, and all his male relatives were dead.
translation_verse: Belɛ Saul kɛ ebihii etɛ̃ lɛ fɛɛ gboi shi kome, kɛkɛ ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ sɛɛ fo.

english_verse: The Israelites who lived in Jezreel Valley learned that their army had run away and that Saul and his sons were dead. They ran away too, and the Philistines moved into the towns the Israelites left behind.
translation_verse: Be ni Israelbii ni yɔɔ Yezreel Jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ nu akɛ Israelbii lɛ ejo foi yɛ Filistibii lɛ ahiɛ, ni asaŋ Saul kɛ ebihii etɛ̃ lɛ enyɔnyɔi lɛ, amɛjojoo foi amɛshishii amɛmaji lɛ amɛshwie shi. Filistibii lɛ baŋɔ maji lɛ ni amɛhi mli.

english_verse: The next day the Philistines came back to the battlefield to carry away the weapons of the dead Israelite soldiers. When they found the bodies of Saul and his sons on Mount Gilboa,
translation_verse: Enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni Filistibii lɛ ba gbohii lɛ ahe nibii kpɔlɔmɔ lɛ, amɛna Saul kɛ ebihii etɛ̃ lɛ agbohii lɛ jwere Gilboa Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: they took Saul's weapons, pulled off his armor, and cut off his head. Then they sent messengers everywhere in Philistia to spread the news among their people and to thank the idols of their gods.
translation_verse: Amɛfo Saul yi, ni amɛkpɔlɔ edama lɛ yɛ ehe, ni atsu bɔfoi koni amɛyakpa Filistibii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kpula, koni amɛyashiɛ ta lɛ mli omanye sane lɛ yɛ amɛwɔji fɛɛ anaa, ni asaŋ amɛshiɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ maŋbii lɛ hu.

english_verse: They put Saul's armor in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of their god Dagon.
translation_verse: Filistibii lɛ kɛ Saul tawuu nii lɛ tee yato amɛjemawɔŋ lɛ eko we, ni akɛ eyitso lɛ yatsotsoro amɛjemawɔŋ Dagon we lɛ mli.

english_verse: When the people who lived in Jabesh in Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
translation_verse: Shi be ni Yabesh-Gileadbii lɛ fɛɛ nu bɔ ni Filistibii lɛ efee Saul lɛ,

english_verse: some brave men went to get his body and the bodies of his three sons. The men brought the bodies back to Jabesh, where they buried them under an oak tree. Then for seven days, they went without eating to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: amɛteŋ hii kãkãlɔi lɛ tee ni amɛyawo Saul gbonyo lɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ hu agbohii lɛ kɛba Yabesh, ni amɛbafu amɛ yɛ tso ko shishi, ni amɛhi ŋmãa gbii kpawo.

english_verse: instead of asking the Lord. So the Lord had Saul killed and gave his kingdom to David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: be mli ni Yehowa moŋ nii esa akɛ ebi lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa fo ewala sɛɛ, ni edãi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ehã Yeshai bi David.

english_verse: The Jebusites said, “You won't be able to get in here!” But David captured the fortress of Mount Zion, which is now called the City of David.
translation_verse: Yebusbii lɛ tswa David mpoa akɛ, “Onyɛŋ biɛ oshɛ!” Shi David na eshɔ̃ Zion mɔɔ ni ji Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ kɛ̃; ni fee sɛɛ lɛ maŋ lɛ gbɛi batsɔ David Maŋ.

english_verse: Israel's leaders met with David at Hebron and said, “We are your relatives,
translation_verse: Israel muu fɛɛ tee Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ yɛ Hebron, ni amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, wɔ kɛ bo jɛ lá kome.

english_verse: So we have come to crown you king of Israel.” David made an agreement with the leaders and asked the Lord to be their witness. Then the leaders poured olive oil on David's head to show that he was now king of Israel. This happened just as the Lord's prophet Samuel had said. David Captures Jerusalem (
translation_verse: Israel onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ba Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ yɛ Hebron, ni ekɛ amɛ kpãŋ; kɛkɛ ni amɛfɔ David mu, ni amɛwo lɛ Israel maŋtsɛ bɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Samuel nɔ ewo shi eto lɛ.

english_verse: David had told his troops, “The first soldier to kill a Jebusite will become my army commander.” And since Joab son of Zeruiah attacked first, he became commander.
translation_verse: David kɛɛ etabilɔi lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ tsuutsu ni aaayatswia Yebusbii lɛ nii lɛ, eeetsɔ̃ asafoiatsɛnukpa kɛ lumɔ fɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yoab, ni atsɛɔ enyɛ akɛ Zeruia lɛ, tsuutsu fã kɛtee eyatua Yebusbii lɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ asafoiatsɛnukpa.

english_verse: The Lord had promised that David would become king, and so everyone in Israel gave David their support. Certain warriors also helped keep his kingdom strong.
translation_verse: Hii kakabãi ni Maŋtsɛ David yɔɔ lɛ ateiaŋ onukpai, mɛi ni fi esɛɛ kpɛŋŋ yɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli, ni asaŋ Israel fɛɛ hu fata amɛhe ni awo David maŋtsɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ewo shi eto yɛ Israel he lɛ agbɛii kɛ amɛhe saji baa nɛɛ.

english_verse: Jerusalem was called Jebus at the time, and David led Israel's army to attack the town.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ Israel muu fɛɛ fã ta kɛtee kɛyanina Yerusalɛm. Nakai be mli lɛ atsɛɔ Yerusalɛm akɛ Yebus. Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shikwɛ̃ɛbii lɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ atsɛɔ amɛ Yebusbii.

english_verse: Later, David moved to the fortress—that's why it's called the City of David.
translation_verse: Ni akɛni Maŋtsɛ David etee eyahi Zion Mɔɔ lɛ mli hewɔ lɛ, mɔɔ lɛ gbɛi batsɔ David Maŋ.

english_verse: David became a great and strong ruler, because the Lord All-Powerful was on his side. The Three Warriors (
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ kɛjɛ nakai be lɛ kɛyaa lɛ, da kɛkɛ David hewalɛ lɛ daa, ejaakɛ Yehowa Ofe lɛ kɛ lɛ yɛ. David tabilɔi kãkãlɔi lɛ (

english_verse: Another time he killed an Egyptian who was over two meters tall and was armed with a spear. Benaiah only had a club, so he grabbed the spear from the Egyptian and killed him with it.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɔŋŋ eku sɛɛ egbe Ijiptnyo nyɛnyereŋŋ ko ni ekwɔlɛ fe mitai enyɔ. Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ hiɛ akplɔ ni etilɛ tamɔ mamaloo agba tso tilɛ, ni eba koni ekɛ Benaia nɛɛ abanɔ. Benaia hiɛ tso folo ni ekɛyatua Ijiptnyo lɛ; eshɔ̃ akplɔ lɛ ni gbɔmɔ nɛɛ hiɛ lɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni ekɛ Ijiptnyo lɛ nɔŋŋ akplɔ lɛ gbe lɛ.

english_verse: and he said, “I'm very thirsty. I wish I had a drink of water from the well by the gate to Bethlehem.”
translation_verse: David hiɛ tsɔ̃ shĩa ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Namɔ po mana ni eya Betlehem eyayɛ nubu lɛ ni yɔɔ maŋ agbo lɛ masɛi lɛ mli nu ebaha mi manu?”

english_verse: The first of these warriors was Jashobeam the son of Hachmoni, the leader of the Three Warriors. In one battle he killed
translation_verse: Klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ ji Yashobeam, Hakemonnyo lɛ, mɔ hu ni ji hii kãkãlɔi etɛ̃ fe fɛɛ lɛ ateŋ onukpa lɛ. Ewo ekpɔlɔ nɔ lɛ, ekɛgbe mɛi ohai kpaanyɔ yɛ ta kome mli.

english_verse: Another one of the Three Warriors was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite.
translation_verse: Esɛɛmɔ yɛ hii kãkãlɔi etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ ji Eleazar, Ahohinyo, Dodo bi lɛ.

english_verse: except Eleazar, who stayed with David. They took their positions in a nearby barley field and defeated the Philistines! The Lord gave Israel a great victory that day.
translation_verse: Shi Eleazar nɛɛ ho edamɔ shi akɛ nuu, ni ekpee ta lɛ naa yɛ shikpɔŋ kuku lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu efã shikpɔŋ lɛ he, ni ekɛ esɛɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ gbe Filistibii lɛ. Yehowa hã eye kunim kpeteŋkple.

english_verse: One time the Three Warriors went to meet David among the rocks at Adullam Cave. The Philistine army had set up camp in Rephaim Valley
translation_verse: Gbi ko lɛ hii kãkãlɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ mɛi etɛ̃ tee Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ yɛ Adullam Tɛkplo lɛ mli yɛ tɛsaa lɛ nɔ. No mli lɛ Filistibii lɛ ebagba ta yɛ Refaim Jɔɔ lɛ mli,

english_verse: and had taken over Bethlehem. David was in a fortress,
translation_verse: ni amɛfã ko eŋɔ Betlehem, ni amɛyɛ jɛi; David hu yɛ tɛkplo lɛ mli.

english_verse: and said, “Drinking this water would be like drinking the blood of these men who risked their lives to get it for me.” The Three Warriors did these brave deeds. The Thirty Warriors (
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “MiNyɔŋmɔ, enɛ akagbale mi fɔ̃ŋfɔ̃ akɛ manu nɛkɛ nu nɛɛ. Kɛji minu lɛ, hii nɛɛ alá minu lɛ ejaakɛ amɛshã amɛhe afɔle, ni amɛtee amɛyayɛ nu lɛ kɛba.” No hewɔ lɛ, David enuuu nu lɛ.

english_verse: and was more famous than the rest of the Thirty Warriors. He was their commander, but he never became one of the Three Warriors.
translation_verse: Egbɛi hehe fe mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ hii Kakabãi Nyɔŋmai Etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ, ni etsɔ amɛnukpa; shi moŋ ekɛ Kakabãi Etɛ̃ lɛ yeee egbɔ.

english_verse: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was a brave man from Kabzeel who did some amazing things. One time he killed two of Moab's best fighters, and one snowy day he went into a pit and killed a lion.
translation_verse: Benaia, Yehoiada bi lɛ, ni jɛ Kabzeel lɛ, hu hii kãkãlɔi lɛ eko ni; ni efee ekãa naa nibii wuji srɔtoi babaoo. Eko ji akɛ egbe Moabbii tabilɔi kpanakpanai enyɔ komɛi be ko. Be ko hu lɛ ekpeleke shi kɛtee ni eyagbe jata yɛ bu ko mli yɛ snoo be mli.

english_verse: Benaiah did things like that; he was just as brave as the Three Warriors,
translation_verse: Enɛɛmɛi ji nii ni Yehoiada bi Benaia fee, ni ekɛna gbɛi yɛ hii kãkãlɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ lɛ.

english_verse: even though he never became one of them. And he was certainly as famous as the rest of the Thirty Warriors. So David made him the leader of his own bodyguard.
translation_verse: Egbɛi hehe jogbaŋŋ yɛ hii kãkãlɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ; shi moŋ ekɛ Kakabãi Etɛ̃ lɛ yeee egbɔ.

english_verse: Men from the tribe of Gad also joined David at his fortress in the desert and served as his warriors. They were also brave soldiers—fierce as lions and quick as gazelles. They were always prepared to fight with shields and spears.
translation_verse: Gadbii lɛ ateŋ hii tabilɔi kãkãlɔi komɛi tse amɛhe kɛtee amɛyafata mɛi ni nyiɛ David sɛɛ lɛ tabilɔi lɛ ahe be mli ni David yɔɔ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ mɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ. Hii nɛɛ ahe esa kɛ tsɛŋ kɛ akplɔ kɛ nɔmɔ, ni amɛhiɛ yɛ kramakrama tamɔ jata hiɛ, ni amɛhe yɛ oya tamɔ gɔji anɔ soŋai.

english_verse: There were eleven of them, ranked in the following order: Ezer the leader, then Obadiah, Eliab, Mishmannah, Jeremiah, Attai, Eliel, Johanan, Elzabad, Jeremiah, and Machbannai.
translation_verse: mɔ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ ji Yeremia; ni mɔ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ ji Makbanai.

english_verse: All these men were army officers; some were high-ranking officers over a thousand troops, and others were officers over a hundred troops.
translation_verse: Tabilɔi lɛ amli asafoiatsɛmɛi ji Gadbii nɛɛ fɛɛ. Amɛteŋ mɔ ni ji bibioo lɛ enyɛɔ ekɛ mɛi oha kpeɔ; ni mɔ ni ji mɔ wulu lɛ ekɛ mɛi akpe kpeɔ.

english_verse: Earlier, they had crossed the Jordan River when it flooded, and they chased out the people who lived in the valleys on each side of the river. Warriors from the Benjamin and Judah tribes
translation_verse: Afi lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ, be mli ni Yordan Faa lɛ eyi ni eje ŋa lɛ, gbɔmɛi nɛɛ fo faa lɛ ni amɛyawo jɔi lɛ amli bii lɛ foi yɛ faa lɛ bokãgbɛ kɛ anaigbɛ fɛɛ lɛ. Benyaminbii krokomɛi kɛ Yudabii yafata David he

english_verse: One time a group of men from the tribes of Benjamin and Judah went to the fortress where David was staying.
translation_verse: Asaŋ Benyaminbii kɛ Yudabii lɛ ateŋ mɛi krokomɛi hu ba David ŋɔɔ yɛ mɔɔ lɛ mli he ni eyɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: David met them outside and said, “If you are coming as friends to fight on my side, then stay and join us. But if you try to turn me over to my enemies, the God our ancestors worshiped will punish you, because I have done nothing wrong.”
translation_verse: Ni David je kpo kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛji hejɔlɛ nyiɛmɔ nyɛnyiɛ kɛba koni nyɛbaye nyɛbua mi lɛ, no lɛ miyɛ he tsui akɛ mi kɛ nyɛ aaafee ekome. Shi kɛji nyɛba koni nyɛbatsɔ̃ɔ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ misɛɛgbɛ lɛ, akɛni miyeko mɔ ko sane fɔŋ ko lɛ, wɔtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaaye misane lɛ eha mi.”

english_verse: Some of the warriors who joined David were from the tribe of Manasseh. They had earlier gone with David when he agreed to fight on the side of the Philistines against King Saul. But as soon as the Philistine rulers realized that David might turn against them and rejoin Saul, they sent David away to the town of Ziklag.
translation_verse: Manasebii lɛ ateŋ hii tabilɔi komɛi tse amɛhe ni amɛbafata David he, be ni David kɛ Filistibii lɛ yaa koni amɛkɛ Saul ayawu lɛ. Moŋ David naaa ewa Filistibii lɛ ta nɛɛ wuu, ejaakɛ Filistibii lɛ alumɛi lɛ tee ajina, ni amɛwo David gbɛ akɛ eku esɛɛ kɛya Ziklag ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Kɛji wɔleee feemɔ lɛ ekɛ wɔyitsei baaya ekɛyakpãtã enuŋtsɔ Saul.”

english_verse: and brave soldiers, and so David made them officers in his army. They fought on his side when enemy troops attacked.
translation_verse: Amɛye amɛbua David ni ekɛ ojoyelɔi aku lɛ wu. Hii kãkãlɔi saŋŋ ji amɛ, ni fee sɛɛ lɛ awo amɛ tatsɛmɛi.

english_verse: Other Israelites from as far away as the territories of Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali brought cattle and sheep to slaughter for food. They also brought donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen that were loaded down with flour, dried figs and raisins, wine, and olive oil. Everyone in Israel was very happy.
translation_verse: Israelbii lɛ ananemɛi ni amɛkɛ amɛ bɛŋkɛ bake amɛ nii. Ni ajɛ aahu ajɛ Isakar kɛ Zebulon kɛ Naftali niiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ aba kɛ tejii kɛ yoomai kɛ tejiokpɔŋɔi kɛ tsinai ni akɛ niyenii srɔtoi etere amɛ: mã kɛ agbãmi kɛ wain kɛ mu. Amɛbake tsinai kɛ toi hu, ni agbe ni aye. Amɛfee enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ejaakɛ miishɛɛ eba Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: All of these soldiers voluntarily came to Hebron because they wanted David to become king of Israel. In fact, everyone in Israel wanted the same thing.
translation_verse: Tabilɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ emia hã ta, ni amɛto kɛba Hebron kɛ yiŋtoo kome koni amɛbawo David Israel fɛɛ maŋtsɛ.

english_verse: The soldiers stayed in Hebron three days, eating and drinking what their relatives had prepared for them.
translation_verse: Amɛye gbii etɛ̃ yɛ David ŋɔɔ; ni amɛyeyee nii, ni amɛnunuu dãa, ejaakɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ esara amɛsɛɛ.

english_verse: Then he led them to Baalah in Judah, which was also called Kiriath-Jearim. They went there to get the sacred chest and bring it to Jerusalem, because it belonged to the Lord God, whose throne is above the winged creatures on the lid of the chest.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ yiŋ kɛtee Baala maŋ lɛ mli ni ji Kiriat-Yearim yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, koni amɛyawo Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ni akɛ Yehowa, mɔ ni elumɔyeli sɛ̃i lɛ ma kerubim lɛ anɔ lɛ, gbɛi ewo lɛ lɛ yɛ jɛi kɛba.

english_verse: David was afraid what the Lord might do to him, and he asked himself, “Should I really be the one to take care of the sacred chest?”
translation_verse: David she Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei nakai gbi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Te mafee tɛŋŋ mato Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hu?”

english_verse: The people agreed this was the right thing to do.
translation_verse: Gwabɔɔ muu lɛ fɛɛ kpɛlɛ̃ nɔ akɛ afee nakai ejaakɛ sane lɛ sa amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: The sacred chest was still at Abinadab's house, and when David and the crowd arrived there, they brought the chest outside and placed it on a new ox cart. Abinadab's sons Uzzah and Ahio guided the cart,
translation_verse: Amɛyawo Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ Abinadab we lɛ, ni amɛkɛma shwiili hee ko nɔ, ni Uza kɛ Ahio ji mɛi ni kudɔ shwiili nɛɛ.

english_verse: while David and the crowd danced and sang praises to the Lord with all their might. They played music on small harps and other stringed instruments, and on tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.
translation_verse: Ni David kɛ Israel muu fɛɛ nya kɛ amɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ kɛ lalai kɛ saŋkui kɛ bɛji kɛ miji kɛ ŋmɛji kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi amɛkɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam.

english_verse: But when they came to Chidon's threshing place, the oxen stumbled, and Uzzah reached out and took hold of the chest to stop it from falling.
translation_verse: Be ni amɛshɛ Kidon ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ, tsinai lɛ tɛ ni eha Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kpa kɛyaagbee shi. No hewɔ lɛ, Uza kpã enine mli ni emɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ mli.

english_verse: The Lord God was very angry with Uzzah for doing this, and he killed Uzzah right there beside the chest.
translation_verse: Yehowa mli fu Uza akɛ ekpã enine mli emɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ mli, ni Yehowa tswa Uza nɔ, ni egbo yɛ enajiaŋ yɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ masɛi.

english_verse: David then got angry with God for killing Uzzah. So he named that place “Attack on Uzzah,” and it's been called that ever since.
translation_verse: Sane lɛ dɔ David akɛ Yehowa kɛ Uza ye kɛ joomɔ nakai. Atsɛɔ he ni sane lɛ ba yɛ lɛ akɛ Perez-Uza kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.

english_verse: So instead of taking it to Jerusalem, David decided to take it to the home of Obed-Edom, who lived in the town of Gath.
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, David hãaa akɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ aya Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli; shi moŋ eha awo Adeka lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ afã kɛtee Obed-Edom, Gitnyo lɛ, we lɛ mli.

english_verse: The chest stayed there for three months, and the Lord blessed Obed-Edom, his family, and everything he owned.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hi Obed-Edom bii lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ eshĩa lɛ mli nyɔji etɛ̃; ni Yehowa jɔɔ Obed-Edom we lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ.

english_verse: David and his army marched to Baal-Perazim, where they attacked and defeated the Philistines. He said, “I defeated my enemies because God broke through them like a mighty flood.” So he named the place “The Lord Broke Through.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, David fã ta kɛyanina Filistibii lɛ yɛ Baal-Perazim, ni eye amɛnɔ kunim yɛ jɛi. Ni David kɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa etsɔ̃ minine nɔ egba kɛtsɔ̃ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ tamɔ nu ni eyi kɛsram nɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, atsɛ jɛi akɛ Baal-Perazim.

english_verse: David obeyed God and he defeated the Philistines. He even chased them all the way from Gibeon to the entrance to Gezer.
translation_verse: David fee bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã lɛ lɛ, ni Israelbii lɛ gbe Filistibii lɛ kɛjɛ Gibeon aahu kɛyashwie Gezer.

english_verse: King Hiram of Tyre sent some officials to David. They brought along carpenters and stone workers, and enough cedar logs to build David a palace.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ Hiram, Tiro maŋtsɛ, wo kapintafoi kɛ gbogbotswalɔi agbɛ, ni amɛkɛ tsenedrutsei ba koni amɛbama maŋtsɛ we amɛhã David.

english_verse: After David moved to Jerusalem, he married more women and had more sons and daughters.
translation_verse: David ŋɔŋɔɔ yei hei efata eŋãmɛi lɛ ahe yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni David fɔ bihii kɛ biyei efata ebii lɛ ahe.

english_verse: His children born there were Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon, Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet. David Defeats the Philistines (
translation_verse: kɛ Elishama kɛ Beeliada kɛ Elifelet. David ye Filistibii lɛ anɔ kunim

english_verse: From then on, David became even more famous, and the Lord made all the nations afraid of him.
translation_verse: Ni David gbɛi hehe kɛtee shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei fɛɛ; ni Yehowa hã David he ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ maji lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: When the Philistines heard that David had become king of Israel, they came to capture him. But David heard about their plan and marched out to meet them in battle.
translation_verse: Be ni Filistibii lɛ nu akɛ afɔ David mu awo lɛ Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, amɛfã ta kɛba akɛ amɛmiiba amɛbatua David. Be ni David nu lɛ, efã ni ekɛ Filistibii lɛ yakpe.

english_verse: The Philistines had already camped in Rephaim Valley and were raiding the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Filistibii lɛ baye ofɔ̃ yɛ Refaim Jɔɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: David asked God, “Should I attack the Philistines? Will you help me win?” The Lord told David, “Yes, attack them! I will give you victory.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni David tee ni eyabi Nyɔŋmɔ nii akɛ, “Mifã ta kɛyanina Filistibii lɛ lo? Ooohã maye amɛnɔ kunim lo?” Yehowa here David nɔ akɛ, “Fãa ta lɛ kɛyanina amɛ ni mahã oye amɛnɔ kunim.”

english_verse: Then David ordered his troops to burn the idols that the Philistines had left behind.
translation_verse: Filistibii lɛ shi amɛmãgãi lɛ yɛ jɛi ni amɛjo foi, ni David fã, ni ashã amãgãi lɛ.

english_verse: Some time later, the Philistines came back into the hill country and camped in Rephaim Valley.
translation_verse: Shi Filistibii lɛ fã ta kɛba ekoŋŋ, ni amɛbagba ta yɛ Refaim Jɔɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: David asked God what he should do, and God answered, “Don't attack them from the front. Circle around behind them where the balsam trees are.
translation_verse: David bi Nyɔŋmɔ nii ekoŋŋ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaafã ta kɛyatua amɛ kɛjɛ biɛ; shi moŋ lɔgɔmɔ amɛ kɛyaje amɛsɛɛgbɛ koni ojɛ Balsam tsei lɛ aŋlɛnɔ obatua amɛ.
