english_verse: Wait there until you hear the treetops making the sound of marching troops. That sound will mean I have marched out ahead of you to fight the Philistine army. So you must then attack quickly!”
translation_verse: Kɛ onu gbɛɛmɔ yɛ Balsam tsei lɛ ayiteŋ tamɔ naneshigbɛɛmɔ pɛ koni ofã kɛyashwie amɛnɔ, ejaakɛ no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ eyi ohiɛ kɛmiiya ayatswia Filistibii ata lɛ nii.”

english_verse: David had several buildings built in Jerusalem, and he had a tent set up where the sacred chest would be kept.
translation_verse: David mamɔ tsui yɛ David Maŋ lɛ mli ehã ehe, asaŋ esaa he ko hu, ni eshi bui yɛ jɛi ehã Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ.

english_verse: Next, David invited everyone to come to Jerusalem and watch the sacred chest being carried to the place he had set up for it.
translation_verse: David kpee Israelbii fɛɛ, ni amɛnaa bakpe shi yɛ Yerusalɛm koni ayawo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛba he ni asaa ato lɛ lɛ.

english_verse: He also sent for Aaron's descendants and for the Levites. The Levites that came were:
translation_verse: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ David kpee Aaron bii lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ hu kɛba.

english_verse: Uriel, the leader of the Kohath clan, and
translation_verse: Uriel nyiɛ enyɛmimɛi ni ji Kohatbii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ ahiɛ kɛba.

english_verse: Joel, the leader of the Gershon clan, and
translation_verse: Yoel nyiɛ enyɛmimɛi Gershonbii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ahiɛ kɛba;

english_verse: Shemaiah, the leader of the Elizaphan clan, and
translation_verse: Shemaia nyiɛ enyɛmimɛi Elizafanbii ohai enyɔ ahiɛ kɛba;

english_verse: Eliel, the leader of the Hebron clan, and
translation_verse: Eliel nyiɛ enyɛmimɛi Hebronbii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ ahiɛ kɛba;

english_verse: Amminadab, the leader of the Uzziel clan, with
translation_verse: ni Aminadab nyiɛ enyɛmimɛi Uzielbii oha kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ahiɛ kɛba.

english_verse: David called together these six Levites and the two priests, Zadok and Abiathar.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni David tsɛ Osɔfo Abiatar kɛ Levibii lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔi ekpaa lɛ, ni ji Uriel kɛ Asaia kɛ Yoel kɛ Shemaia kɛ Eliel kɛ Aminadab,

english_verse: The first time we tried to bring the chest to Jerusalem, we didn't ask the Lord what he wanted us to do. He was angry with us, because you Levites weren't there to carry the chest.”
translation_verse: Akɛni tsutsu lɛ jeee nyɛ nyɛtere Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, ni jeee nakai ji ehe gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ, Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mli fu wɔ.”

english_verse: The priests and the Levites made themselves clean. They were now ready to carry the sacred chest
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ tsuu amɛhe amɛfee amɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ koni amɛyawo Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ.

english_verse: on poles that rested on their shoulders, just as the Lord had told Moses to do.
translation_verse: Levibii lɛ kɛ tsei bloblobii lɛ wo adeka lɛ amɛtswa amɛkɔŋ bɔ ni Yehowa ewo kitã yɛ he kɛtsɔ̃ Mose nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: David then told the leaders to choose some Levites to sing and play music on small harps, other stringed instruments, and cymbals.
translation_verse: David fã Levibii lɛ anukpai lɛ akɛ amɛhala amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ jooshwɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi koni amɛla, kɛ mɛi komɛi hu koni amɛkɛ obentai kɛ saŋkui kɛ ŋmɛji ashwɛ joo kɛwo nifeemɔ lɛ he sɔlɛ.

english_verse: Four Levites were then appointed to guard the sacred chest. They were Berechiah, Elkanah, Obed-Edom, and Jehiah. english_verse: God gave the Levites the strength they needed to carry the chest, and so they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
translation_verse: Ni akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ ye bua Levibii ni tere Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hewɔ lɛ, agbe tsina hii kpawo akɛshã afɔle.

english_verse: David, the Levites, Chenaniah the music director, and all the musicians were wearing linen robes, and David was also wearing a linen cloth.
translation_verse: David wo klala kpakpa atade, ni no eko atade nɔŋŋ Levibii ni tere Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ joobilɔi lɛ kɛ Kenania, ni ji joobilɔi lɛ atsɛ lɛ, hu wowoo. David wo klala tsitsinɔhaanii hu.

english_verse: While the sacred chest was being carried into Jerusalem, everyone was celebrating by shouting and playing music on horns, trumpets, cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Israel muu fɛɛ wo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm be mli ni aabɔ oshe hoo ni aakpã koŋ bɛji kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ, ni aatswia ŋmɛji kɛ saŋkui hu waa diɛŋtsɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Saul's daughter Michal looked out her window and watched the chest being brought into David's City. But when she saw David jumping and dancing in honor of the Lord, she was disgusted.
translation_verse: Be ni Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ shɛ Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, Mikal, ni ji Saul biyoo lɛ, yabu samflɛ naa; ni be ni ena David ni eejo, ni eehuru lɛ David he fee lɛ hiɛgbele.

english_verse: After David had finished, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord
translation_verse: Be ni David eshã shãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ shidaa afɔlei lɛ egbe naa lɛ, etsɛ Yehowa gbɛi ni ekɛjɔɔ maŋbii lɛ.

english_verse: and gave every person in the crowd a small loaf of bread, some meat, and a handful of raisins.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni eja Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ nii. Ehã nuu fɛɛ nuu kɛ yoo fɛɛ yoo aboloo akwaabɔ kome kɛ loo kukuli kome kɛ wainyibii ni aka ni egbi.

english_verse: David appointed some of the Levites to serve at the sacred chest; they were to play music and sing praises to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: David famɔ Levibii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi koni amɛla kɛsɔmɔ yɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ kɛjie Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi koni amɛda lɛ shi ni amɛkɛkafo lɛ.

translation_verse: Amɛteŋ osɔfoi enyɔ, ni ji Benaia kɛ Yahaziel, lɛ baakpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ daa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ.

translation_verse: Nyɛshwãa nyɛfɔ̃a egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ; mɛi ni taoɔ Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ lɛ atsui anyɔ amɛmli!

english_verse: Trust the Lord and his mighty power. Worship him always.
translation_verse: Nyɛyabia Yehowa dɛŋ wamɔ; nyɛyaa ehiɛ nyɛyajaa lɛ daa!

english_verse: Remember his miracles and all his wonders and his fair decisions.
translation_verse: Nyɛkaia naakpɛɛnii ni etsu lɛ; naakpɛɛnii ni efee kɛ mlai ni ewo lɛ.

english_verse: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
translation_verse: ni miitsomlo kɛjɛ maŋ nɔ kɛmiiya maŋ nɔ, kɛjɛ maŋtsɛ kome nɔyeli mli kɛmiiya nɔyeli kroko mli lɛ,

english_verse: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
translation_verse: eŋmɛɛɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko gbɛ ni efee amɛ niseniianii; ebɔ maŋtsɛmɛi kɔkɔ yɛ amɛhe,

english_verse: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkataa mɛi ni mifɔ amɛ mu lɛ ahe, nyɛkafea migbalɔi lɛ ano ko.”

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Nyɛlaa nyɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ! Nyɛshiɛa edɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ daa gbi.

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Nyɛgbaa enunyam lɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ kɛ enaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ nyɛtsɔ̃a mɛi fɛɛ kwa.

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa je agbo, ni esa yijiemɔ kpeteŋkple ni esa gbeyeishemɔ fe nyɔŋmɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ.

english_verse: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ maji lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, amãgãi ni; Shi Yehowa lɛ, lɛ ebɔ ŋwɛi.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: Woo kɛ agbojee ebɔle ehe kɛkpe, ni hewalɛ kɛ miishɛɛ eyi eshihilɛhe lɛ mli.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛkafoa Yehowa, nyɛ akutsei fɛɛ; nyɛkafoa enunyam kɛ ehewalɛ.

english_verse: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple. Worship the Lord, majestic and holy.
translation_verse: Nyɛŋɔa anunyam ni sa egbɛi lɛ nyɛhãa Yehowa; nyɛkɛ afɔle abaa; ni nyɛbaa ewe lɛ mli. Nyɛkotoa Yehowa kɛ nyɛjamɔ atadei.

english_verse: Everyone on earth, now tremble!” The world stands firm, never to be shaken.
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ he akpokpo yɛ ehiɛ. Je lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ, ni ehiŋ lɛ tsimɔ.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! And announce to the nations, “The Lord is King!”
translation_verse: Ŋwɛi anya, ni shikpɔŋ mli afili lɛ; ni agba jeŋ maji lɛ akɛ, “Yehowa miiye maŋtsɛ!”

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all of its creatures and the fields to rejoice with all of their crops.
translation_verse: Ŋshɔ kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ ahuu, ni ŋã kɛ nii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ emli abɔ oshe!

english_verse: Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth.
translation_verse: Kooŋ tsei aaala kɛ nyamɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, be mli ni ebaa ebaye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Praise the Lord because he is good to us, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Nyɛdaa Yehowa shi ejaakɛ ehi; ejaakɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.

english_verse: Say to him, “Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
translation_verse: Asaŋ nyɛkɛa akɛ, “Heremɔ wɔ, Ao wɔNyɔŋmɔ kɛ Herelɔ, ni obua wɔnaa, ni ohere wɔ yɛ jeŋ maji lɛ adɛŋ, koni wɔda bo shi ni wɔkafo ogbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni wɔshwã wɔfɔ̃ onɔ.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever.” After David finished, the people shouted, “Amen! Praise the Lord!” David Appoints Worship Leaders at Jerusalem and Gibeon
translation_verse: Ajie Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyashi naanɔ!” Kɛkɛ ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ here nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Amen!” Ni amɛ jie Yehowa yi.

english_verse: David chose Asaph and the Levites in his clan to be in charge of the daily worship at the place where the sacred chest was kept.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni David shi Asaf kɛ enyɛmimɛi Levibii lɛ yɛ he ni Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɔɔ lɛ ni amɛkwɛ jamɔ ni ajaa yɛ he ni Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɔɔ lɛ nɔ daa, bɔ ni gbi fɛɛ gbi nɔ jamɔ heɔ.

english_verse: David also chose Zadok the priest and his relatives who were priests to serve at the Lord's sacred tent at Gibeon.
translation_verse: David fã Osɔfo Zadok kɛ enyɛmimɛi osɔfoi krokomɛi lɛ, ni ekɛ jamɔ ni ayajaa Yehowa yɛ jamɔhe ni yɔɔ Gibeon lɛ wo amɛdɛŋ,

english_verse: They were to offer sacrifices on the altar every morning and evening, just as the Lord had commanded in the Law he gave Israel.
translation_verse: koni amɛshã shãa afɔlei yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ amɛhã Yehowa daa leebi kɛ gbɛkɛ, bɔ ni mla ni Yehowa ewo Israel lɛ kɛɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Heman and Jeduthun were their assistants, as well as the other men who had been chosen to praise the Lord for his never-ending love.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni ahala afata amɛhe ji Heman kɛ Yedutun kɛ mɛi krokomɛi hu ni aje gbɛ ahala amɛ akɛ amɛla kɛda Yehowa shi yɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Heman and Jeduthun were also responsible for blowing the trumpets, and for playing the cymbals and other instruments during worship at the tent. The Levites in Jeduthun's clan were the guards at Gibeon.
translation_verse: Heman kɛ Yedutun ji mɛi ni kwɛɔ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi kɛ ŋmɛji kɛ amɛgbee ŋlɛ̃ŋlɛ̃ lɛ kɛ jooshwɛmɔ nibii krokomɛi fɛɛ ni akɛshwɛɔ joo kɛji aala yijiemɔ lala krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. Ni Yedutun bii lɛ ji mɛi ni afee amɛ agbonaabulɔi.

english_verse: Soon after David moved into his new palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, “Look around! I live in a palace made of cedar, but the sacred chest is kept in a tent.”
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ David tsu atsɛ gbalɔ Natan ahã lɛ yɛ emaŋtsɛ mɔɔ lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ Natan akɛ, “Bɛ oona, mi lɛ mina tsenedrutso tsu mli mikã be mli ni Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ moŋ yɛ buu mli.”

english_verse: and yet you have promised to do even more for my descendants. You are treating me as if I am a very important person.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ enɛ jeee nɔ srɔto ko hã bo, Nyɔŋmɔ. Otsɔ̃ɔ wɔsɛɛ shɔŋŋ hu nibii ni baaba miwe lɛ nɔ, Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ; ni oobu mi tamɔ gbɔmɔ wulu ko.

english_verse: That night, the Lord told Nathan
translation_verse: Shi nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ nyɔɔŋ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Natan akɛ,

english_verse: to go to David and tell him: David, you are my servant, so listen carefully: You are not the one to build a temple for me.
translation_verse: “Yaa ni oyakɛɛ David akɛ, ‘Yehowa kɛɛ, jeee bo obaama tsu ohã mi koni mahi mli.

english_verse: I didn't live in a temple when I brought my people out of Egypt, and I don't live in one now. A tent has always been my home wherever I have gone with them.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni miyakpala Israel kɛjɛ Ijipt kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, mihiko tsu mli dã, fe akɛ buui amli mihi kɛjɛ he kome kɛtee he kroko.

english_verse: I chose special leaders and told them to be like shepherds for my people Israel. But did I ever say anything to even one of them about building a cedar temple for me?
translation_verse: Hei fɛɛ ni mi kɛ Israel fɛɛ enyiɛ lɛ, mibiko Israel maŋ hiɛnyiɛlɔi ni mifã amɛ akɛ amɛkura mimaŋ Israel lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko yɛ he ko he ko pɛŋ akɛ, mɛɛba ni nyɛmako tsenedrutsu nyɛhako mi?’

english_verse: Wherever you went, I helped you and destroyed your enemies right in front of your eyes. I have made you one of the most famous people in the world.
translation_verse: ni he fɛɛ he ni otee lɛ mifata ohe, ni miplenee ohenyɛlɔi fɛɛ yɛ ohiɛ, ni mihã ona gbɛi kpeteŋkple tamɔ gbɔmɛi wuji ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I have given my people Israel a land of their own where they can live in peace. They will no longer have to tremble with fear—evil nations won't bother them, as they did
translation_verse: Asaŋ mito he ko mihã mimaŋ Israel koni amɛyahi jɛi akɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnɔ mli, he ni agbaŋ amɛnaa yɛ dɔŋŋ, ni basabasa gbɔmɛi haoŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ tamɔ sa lɛ,

english_verse: when I let judges rule my people, and I will keep your enemies from attacking you. Now I promise that like you, your descendants will be kings.
translation_verse: be mli ni mito hiɛnyiɛlɔi koni amɛkura mimaŋ Israel lɛ. Maha ohenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahe ajɔ, ni asaŋ miiwo bo shi akɛ mibahã oshwiei ahe shi.

english_verse: I'll choose one of your sons to be king when you reach the end of your life and are buried beside your ancestors. I'll make him a strong ruler,
translation_verse: Ogbele sɛɛ lɛ matee mɔ ni jɛ omli shi akɛ maŋtsɛ, ni mahã emaŋtsɛyeli ama shi.

english_verse: and no one will be able to take his kingdom away from him. He will be the one to build a temple for me.
translation_verse: Lɛ ji mɔ ni baama tsu ehã mi lɛ, ni mahã emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ kɛya naanɔ.

english_verse: I will be like a father to him, and he will be like a son to me. I will never put an end to my agreement with him, as I put an end to my agreement with Saul, who was king before you.
translation_verse: Mibatsɔ̃ etsɛ, ni lɛ hu ebaatsɔ̃ mibi. Mifoŋ suɔmɔ ni mikɛbaasumɔ lɛ sɛɛ tamɔ mifo misuɔmɔ lɛ sɛɛ yɛ Saul, mɔ ni mikpa lɛ ni oba oyeɔ esɛɛ nɛɛ lɛ gbɛfaŋ.

english_verse: I will make sure that your son and his descendants will rule my people and my kingdom forever.
translation_verse: Shi mahã ekura mimaŋ Israel, ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ baama shi shiŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Nathan told David exactly what the Lord had said. David Gives Thanks to the Lord (
translation_verse: Natan kɛɛ David nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ba yɛ ninaa lɛ mli lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. David sɔle ekɛda Nyɔŋmɔ shi (

english_verse: I am your servant, and you know my thoughts. What else can I say, except that you have honored me?
translation_verse: Mɛni dɔŋŋ po yɔɔ minaa ni makɛɛ yɛ mihiɛ nyam ni owo nɛɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ ole mi, otsulɔ momo.

english_verse: David went into the tent he had set up for the sacred chest. He sat there and prayed: Lord God, my family and I don't deserve what you have already done for us,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David tee Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ni eyata shi ni esɔle ekɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ, namɔ ji mi, ni mɛni po mli miwe yɔɔ hewɔ ni okura mi kɛbashi benɛ nɛɛ?

english_verse: It was your choice to do these wonderful things for me and to make these promises.
translation_verse: Yehowa, gbɔmɔ he ni odɔɔ, kɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ osuɔmɔ naa ofee nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ koni ohã male nibii wuji ni oto ohã mi.

english_verse: No other god is like you, Lord—you alone are God. Everything we have heard about you is true.
translation_verse: Yehowa, yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni wɔnu naa lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni kɛ bo ye egbɔ, ni asaŋ osɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ ni ji nyɔŋmɔ ko.

english_verse: And there is no other nation on earth like Israel, the nation you rescued from slavery in Egypt to be your own. You became famous by using great and wonderful miracles to force other nations and their gods out of your land, so that your people could live here.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋ kɛ omaŋ Israel ye egbɔ akɛ maŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ, oyakpɔ̃ yɛ nyɔŋyeli mli yɛ Ijipt ni ofee lɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ omaŋ koni okɛ nibii wuji ni yɔɔ gbeyei ni otsu ohã amɛ lɛ ahe gbɛi?

english_verse: You have chosen Israel to be your people forever, and you have become their God.
translation_verse: Ofee Israel bo diɛŋtsɛ omaŋ kɛmiiya naanɔ, ni bo, Yehowa, otsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: Then you will be famous forever, and everyone will say, “The Lord All-Powerful rules Israel and is their God.” My kingdom will be strong,
translation_verse: ni ogbɛi lɛ aaada kpeteŋkple, ni aaakɛɛ kɛya naanɔ akɛ, ‘Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, lɛ ji Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.’ Ni ooohã miwe lɛ ahe shi shiŋŋ yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ mli.

english_verse: because you are my God, and you have promised that my descendants will be kings. That's why I have the courage to pray to you like this, even though I am only your servant.
translation_verse: MiNyɔŋmɔ, mi otsulɔ, toi nɔ ni owo akɛ obaahã ewe lɛ atsɔ̃ maŋtsɛmɛi awe lɛ, no hewɔ ni mina ekãa kɛsɔleɔ nɛkɛ yɛ ohiɛ nɛɛ.

english_verse: You are the Lord God, and you have made this good promise to me.
translation_verse: Yehowa, bo nɔŋŋ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni okɛ nɛkɛ nɔ kpakpa nɛɛ ewo mi shi.

english_verse: Now please bless my descendants forever, and let them always be your chosen kings. You have already blessed my family, and I know you will bless us forever.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, ofainɛ, ni ojɔɔ mishwiei koni amɛsane asa ohiɛ kɛya naanɔ, ejaakɛ mɔ ni bo, Yehowa, ojɔɔ lɛ lɛ, ajɔɔ lɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.”

english_verse: David ruled all Israel with fairness and justice.
translation_verse: David ye Israel fɛɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ, ni eye jalɛ sane ehã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ.

english_verse: While King Hadadezer of Zobah was trying to gain control of the territory near the Euphrates River, David met him in battle at Hamath and defeated him.
translation_verse: Asaŋ David fã ta ewo Siria Zoba Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer hu, ni eye enɔ kunim kɛyashwie Hamat tɔ̃ɔ, ejaakɛ Hadadezer nɛɛ fã kɛtee akɛ eyaaŋɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ he shikpɔŋ lɛ ekɛwo eshishi.

english_verse: Hadadezer's officers had carried gold shields, but David took these shields and brought them back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: David shɔ̃shɔ̃ɔ shika tsɛŋi ni Hadadezer tsuji lɛ hiɛhiɛ lɛ, ni ekɛba Yerusalɛm.

english_verse: Then David stationed some of his troops in Damascus, and the people there had to accept David as their ruler and pay taxes to him. Everywhere David went, the Lord helped him win battles.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni David jara asraafoi kuikui eto Siriabii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Damasko, ni Siriabii lɛ tsɔ̃ David tsuji, ni amɛtsuɔ onia amɛbahãa David. Yehowa hã David ye kunim yɛ he fɛɛ he ni etsɔ̃.

english_verse: King Tou of Hamath and King Hadadezer had been enemies. So when Tou heard that David had defeated Hadadezer's whole army, he sent his son Hadoram to congratulate David on his victory. Hadoram also brought him gifts made of gold, silver, and bronze.
translation_verse: etsu ebinuu Yoram lɛ Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ koni ebaŋa lɛ, ni ehã lɛ aekoo ehã lɛ, yɛ Hadadezer nɔ kunim ni eye lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ Hadadezer kɛ Tou kɛ amɛhe ewuwuu tai saŋŋ. Yoram hiɛ shika nibii kɛ jwiɛtɛi nibii kɛ akɔɔble nibii srɔtoi babaoo kɛba ekɛbake maŋtsɛ David.

english_verse: David gave these gifts to the Lord, just as he had done with the silver and gold he had captured from Edom, Moab, Ammon, Philistia, and Amalek.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ David jɔɔ nibii nɛɛ anɔ eke Yehowa, ni ekɛfata jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni eloo momo sa yɛ majimaji fɛɛ ni eye amɛnɔ kunim lɛ amli kɛba lɛ he. Maji nɛɛ ji Edom kɛ Moab kɛ Amon kɛ Filistia kɛ Amalek.

english_verse: Abishai the son of Zeruiah defeated the Edomite army in Salt Valley and killed
translation_verse: Abishai ni atsɛɔ enyɛ Zeruia lɛ, gbe Edombii akpei nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ yɛ Ŋoo Jɔɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: Then he stationed troops in Edom, and the people there had to accept David as their ruler. Everywhere David went, the Lord gave him victory in war. A List of David's Officials (
translation_verse: Nii nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Abishai jara asraafoi kuikui eto Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Edombii fɛɛ tsɔ̃ David tsuji. He fɛɛ he ni David tsɔ̃ lɛ Yehowa hã eye kunim.

english_verse: Joab the son of Zeruiah was the commander in chief of the army. Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud kept the government records.
translation_verse: Yoab, ni atsɛɔ enyɛ Zeruia lɛ, ji etatsɛnukpa fe fɛɛ; ni Yehoshafat, Ahilud bi lɛ, ji maŋtsɛ tuuŋtu woloŋmalɔ;

english_verse: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were the priests. Shavsha was the secretary.
translation_verse: ni Zadok, Ahitub bi lɛ, kɛ Ahimelek, Abiatar bi lɛ, amɛ ji osɔfoi; ni Shawesha ji woloŋmalɔ.

english_verse: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was the commander of David's bodyguard. David's sons were his highest-ranking officials.
translation_verse: Benaia, Yehoiada bi lɛ, ji tabilɔi ni yɔɔ Maŋtsɛ David he kpaakpa lɛ atsɛ, ni David bihii lɛ ji maŋtsɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ onukpai.

english_verse: David said, “Nahash was kind to me, so I will be kind to his son.” He sent some officials to Ammon to tell Hanun how sorry he was that his father had died. But when David's officials arrived at Ammon,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David to eyiŋ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mibajie mlihilɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ Nahash bi Hanun, ejaakɛ etsɛ mli hi hã mi.” No hewɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ David tsu tsuji kɛtee akɛ amɛyahã Hanun kpoo amɛhã lɛ yɛ etsɛ gbele lɛ hewɔ. Be ni David tsuji lɛ tee Hanun ŋɔɔ yɛ Amonbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛyahã lɛ kpoo lɛ,

english_verse: Joab saw that the enemy troops were lined up on both sides of him. So he picked some of the best Israelite soldiers to fight the Syrians.
translation_verse: Be ni Yoab na akɛ agba ta awo lɛ yɛ esɛɛ kɛ ehiɛ fɛɛ lɛ, ehala Israel tabilɔi kãkãlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi, ni ehã amɛgba ta koni amɛkɛ Siriabii lɛ akpe.

english_verse: Some time later, King Nahash of Ammon died, and his son Hanun became king.
translation_verse: Yɛ mli aahu lɛ Amonbii amaŋtsɛ Nahash gbo, ni ebinuu baye esɛɛ akɛ maŋtsɛ.

english_verse: When the kings who had been under Hadadezer's rule saw that Israel had defeated them, they made peace with David and accepted him as their new ruler. The Syrians never helped the Ammonites again.
translation_verse: Be ni maŋtsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ Hadadezer shishi lɛ na akɛ Israel eye amɛnɔ kunim lɛ, amɛ kɛ David bakpãtã, ni amɛsɔmɔ lɛ. Kɛjɛ no sɛɛ lɛ amɛyaaa amɛyayeee amɛbuaaa Amonbii lɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: the Ammonite leaders said to Hanun, “Do you really believe King David is honoring your father by sending these men to comfort you? He probably sent them to spy on our country, so he can come and destroy it.”
translation_verse: Amonbii lɛ alumɛi lɛ kɛɛ Hanun akɛ, “Naa, tsumɔ ni David etsu kɛba akɛ abahã bo kpoo nɛɛ lɛ kaasusu akɛ ekɛmiiwo otsɛ hiɛ nyam. Maŋ lɛ saramɔ kɛ eshikpamɔ moŋ hewɔ ni David ewo etsuji gbɛ kɛba nɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni enyɛ maŋ lɛ ebaŋɔ.”

english_verse: Hanun arrested David's officials and had their beards shaved off and their robes cut off just below the waist, and then he sent them away.
translation_verse: Enɛ ha Hanun mɔmɔ David tsuji lɛ, ni eshɛshɛɛ amɛtsɛŋi fãfãafãi eshwie, ni no sɛɛ lɛ efolɔ amɛtadei lɛ anɔ yɛ teŋ tuuŋtu kɛbata amɛdukui anɔ, kɛkɛ ni ejie bɔfoi lɛ agbɛ ni amɛtee.

english_verse: They were terribly ashamed. When David found out what had happened to his officials, he sent a message that told them, “Stay in Jericho until your beards grow back. Then you can come home.”
translation_verse: Be ni abagba David bɔ ni afee etsuji lɛ, etsu ni akɛ tsuji lɛ yakpe yɛ gbɛteŋ ejaakɛ abɔ amɛ ahora fe nine. Ekɛ shɛɛ maje yahã amɛ akɛ amɛwa Yeriko kɛyashi amɛtsɛŋ lɛ aaatsa dani amɛba shĩa.

english_verse: David heard what was happening, and he sent out Joab with his army.
translation_verse: Be ni David nu lɛ ewo Yoab kɛ hii kãkãlɔi asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ gbɛ kɛtee.

english_verse: The Ammonite troops marched to the entrance of the city and prepared for battle, while the Syrian troops took their positions in the open fields.
translation_verse: Amonbii lɛ je kpo ni amɛbagba ta yɛ amɛmaŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa. Shi maŋtsɛmɛi ni ba Amonbii lɛ awamɔ lɛ sɔŋŋ tse amɛhe, ni amɛgba amɛta lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Then he put his brother Abishai in command of the rest of the army and told them to fight against the Ammonites.
translation_verse: Etabilɔi ni shwɛ lɛ, etu amɛ fɛɛ ewo enyɛmi Abishai shishi. Amɛ lɛ, amɛgba ta lɛ koni amɛkɛ Amonbii lɛ akpe.

english_verse: Joab told his brother, “If the Syrians are too much for me to handle, come and help me. And if the Ammonites are too strong for you, I'll come and help you.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yoab kɛɛ Abishai akɛ, “Kɛji ona akɛ Siriabii lɛ anine miitsɔ̃ minɔ lɛ, ni obaye obua mi; mi hu kɛji mina akɛ Amonbii lɛ anine miitsɔ̃ onɔ lɛ mibaba mibaye mabua bo.

english_verse: Be brave and fight hard to protect our people and the towns of our Lord God. I pray he will do whatever pleases him.”
translation_verse: Feemɔ ekãa ni ohã wɔfee hii yɛ wɔmaŋbii kɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ maji lɛ ahewɔ, ni Yehowa aaahã nɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ lɛ aba mli.”

english_verse: Joab and his soldiers attacked the Syrians, and the Syrians ran from them.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yoab kɛ tabilɔi ni yɔɔ eshishi lɛ tsɛ̃ kɛyanina Siriabii lɛ; shi Siriabii lɛ jo foi.

english_verse: When the Ammonite troops saw that the Syrians had run away, they ran from Abishai's soldiers and went back into their own city. Joab then returned to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Be ni Amonbii lɛ na akɛ Siriabii lɛ ejo foi lɛ, amɛ hu amɛjo Abishai naa foi ni amɛyabote amɛmaŋ lɛ mli. Kɛkɛ ni Yoab ku esɛɛ ni eba Yerusalɛm.

english_verse: As soon as the Syrians realized they had been defeated, they sent for their troops that were stationed on the other side of the Euphrates River. Shophach, the commander of Hadadezer's army, led these troops to Ammon.
translation_verse: Be ni Siriabii lɛ na akɛ Israelbii lɛ eye amɛnɔ kunim lɛ, amɛtsu bɔfoi ni ayaŋɔ Siriabii ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ kɛba. Zoba Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer tatsɛ Shofak nyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛba.

english_verse: David found out what the Syrians were doing, and he brought Israel's entire army together. They crossed the Jordan River, and he commanded them to take their positions facing the Syrian troops. Soon after the fighting began,
translation_verse: Abagba David, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ebua Israel tabilɔi fɛɛ anaa kɛkɛ ni ekɛ amɛ fo Yordan Faa lɛ kɛbanina Siriabii lɛ, ni egba ta ewo amɛ. Kɛkɛ ni abɔ̃i wuu.

english_verse: The next spring, the time when kings go to war, Joab marched out in command of the Israelite army and destroyed towns all over the country of Ammon. He attacked the capital city of Rabbah and left it in ruins. But David stayed in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ afi, be mli ni maŋtsɛmɛi fãa ta lɛ, Yoab ŋɔ Israel ta lɛ ni efã ta ewo Amonbii lɛ, ni ekpãtã amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ. Shi Maŋtsɛ David hi shi yɛ sɛɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm. Yoab yagba ta kɛbɔle Raba maŋ lɛ, kɛkɛ ni etua maŋ lɛ, ni eye maŋ lɛ nɔ kunim.

english_verse: He forced the people of Rabbah to work with saws, iron picks, and axes. He also did the same thing with the people in all the other Ammonite towns. David then led Israel's army back to Jerusalem. The Descendants of the Rephaim (
translation_verse: Asaŋ ekpala maŋbii lɛ kɛtee, ni ehã amɛ nitsumɔ ni amɛtsu amɛhã lɛ kɛ saalai kɛ kɔi kɛ lema lɛ. Bɔ ni David fee Amonbii amaji lɛ fɛɛ nɛ. Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ etabilɔi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm. Tai ni David kɛ Filistibii gojogojoo lɛ wu (

english_verse: Some time later, Israel fought a battle against the Philistines at Gezer. During this battle, Sibbecai from Hushah killed Sippai, a descendant of the Rephaim, and the Philistines were defeated.
translation_verse: Fee sɛɛ lɛ ta te shi ekoŋŋ yɛ Gezer yɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛ Filistibii lɛ ateŋ. Sibekai, Hushanyo lɛ, gbe Sipai ni ji hii oblaŋi gojogojoo lɛ ashwiei lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome yɛ ta nɛɛ mli, ni ekɛjɔɔ Filistibii lɛ ahe.

english_verse: In another battle against the Philistines, Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath from Gath, whose spear shaft was like a weaver's beam.
translation_verse: Ta te shi ekoŋŋ yɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛ Filistibii lɛ ateŋ; ni Elhanan, ni ji Yair bi lɛ, gbe Lahemi ni enyɛmi ji Goliat, Gatnyo lɛ ni ekpɔlɔ tso tilɛ tamɔ mamalolɔ agba tso tilɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Another one of the Philistine soldiers who was a descendant of the Rephaim was as big as a giant and had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot. During a battle at Gath,
translation_verse: Awu ta ekoŋŋ yɛ Gat. Nuu nyɛnyereŋŋ ko kɛ ewaabii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ, enine waobii ekpaaekpaa kɛ enane waobii hu ekpaaekpaa, ba ta lɛ. Hii oblaŋi gojogojoo lɛ ashwiei lɛ eko ji lɛ.

english_verse: David and his soldiers killed these three men from Gath who were descendants of the Rephaim.
translation_verse: Hii oblaŋi gojogojoo ni hi shi yɛ Gat lɛ ashwiei ji gbɔmɛi nɛɛ, ni amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ David kɛ etsuji lɛ anine naa.

english_verse: But David replied, “No! I want to pay you what they're worth. I can't just take something from you and then offer the Lord a sacrifice that cost me nothing.”
translation_verse: Shi Maŋtsɛ David here Ornan nɔ akɛ, “Dabida! Mahe mawo nyɔmɔ bɔ ni ji enaa pɛpɛɛpɛ. Miŋɔŋ nii ni ji onɔ mihaŋ Yehowa, ni asaŋ mikɛ nɔ ko ni mina lɛ yaka hu eshaŋ afɔle.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Gad, one of David's prophets,
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Gad ni ji gbalɔ ni yɔɔ David he lɛ akɛ,

english_verse: Joab answered, “Your Majesty, even if the Lord made your kingdom a hundred times larger, you would still rule everyone in it. Why do you need to know how many soldiers there are? Don't you think that would make the whole nation angry?”
translation_verse: Shi Yoab kɛɛ David akɛ, “Yehowa ahã bɔ ni maŋ lɛ yifalɛ yɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ aku abɔ he toi oha! Shi minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, kwɛ jeee mikɛɛ bekɛ otsuji ji amɛ fɛɛ? Mɛɛba mɔ ni minuŋtsɔ taoɔ akɛ afee nɛkɛ nɔ ko ni baahã Israel fɛɛ atɔ̃ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: But David would not change his mind. And so Joab went everywhere in Israel and Judah and counted the people. He returned to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Shi Maŋtsɛ David eŋɔɔɔ nɔ ehãaa Yoab. No hewɔ lɛ, Yoab yiŋ etee, ni eyakpa Israel fɛɛ, ni eku esɛɛ eba Yerusalɛm,

english_verse: Joab refused to include anyone from the tribes of Levi and Benjamin, because he still disagreed with David's orders. God Punishes Israel (
translation_verse: Shi Yoab kaneee Levibii lɛ kɛ Benyaminbii lɛ eshiii nɔ, ejaakɛ nɔ ni Maŋtsɛ David ehã afee lɛ eŋɔɔɔ enaa.

english_verse: “Tell David that I will punish him in one of three ways. But he will have to choose which one it will be.”
translation_verse: “Yaa ni oyakɛɛ David akɛ, mi Yehowa, mikɛ nibii etɛ̃ miishwie ehiɛ; ekɔ amɛmli ekome, ni mafee mahã lɛ.”

english_verse: and David prayed, “It's my fault! I sinned by ordering the people to be counted. They have done nothing wrong—they are innocent sheep. Lord God, please punish me and my family. Don't let the disease wipe out your people.” David Buys Araunah's Threshing Place (
translation_verse: Ni David kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “Ataa, mi mifã akɛ ayakane maŋbii lɛ. Mi ji mɔ ni etɔ̃ ni efee efɔŋ naakpa lɛ, shi jeee maŋbii nɛɛ; amɛleee he eko, ni amɛhe bɛ mli. No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, toigbalamɔ lɛ kɛgbala mi kɛ mitsɛwe lɛ toi koni omaŋbii lɛ aye amɛhe.”

english_verse: David's order to count the people made God angry, and he punished Israel.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni afee lɛ eŋɔɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ naa, ni no hewɔ lɛ, egbala Israel toi.

english_verse: David prayed, “I am your servant. But what I did was stupid and terribly wrong. Please forgive me.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “Mitɔ̃ tɔ̃mɔ kpele kɛ nii nɛɛ ni mifee lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, miikpa bo fai ni okɛ tɔ̃mɔ lɛ afa mi, ejaakɛ miye kwashiai asane naakpa.”

english_verse: Gad went to David and told him: You must choose how the Lord will punish you:
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Gad ba David ŋɔɔ ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ. Okɔ amɛmli nɔ ni osumɔɔ:

english_verse: Will there be three years when the land won't grow enough food for its people? Or will your enemies constantly defeat you for three months? Or will the Lord send a horrible disease to strike your land for three days? Think about it and decide, because I have to give your answer to God who sent me.
translation_verse: Kɛji hɔmɔ afii etɛ̃ ni jio, loo akɛ ohenyɛlɔi baanyiɛ osɛɛ, ni obaajo amɛnaa foi nyɔji etɛ̃ ni jio, loo akɛ Yehowa baawo etsi nɔ gbii etɛ̃ yɛ Israel nɔ, ni ehã gbele hela aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbii etɛ̃ koni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ akpãtã mɛi ahiɛ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ ni jio. No hewɔ lɛ, feemɔ oyiŋ, ni ohã mi hetoo mikɛyahã mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ.”

english_verse: David was miserable and said, “It's a terrible choice to make! But the Lord is kind, and I'd rather be punished by him than by anyone else.”
translation_verse: David to he eha Gad akɛ, “Sane lɛ wa hã mi naakpa. Shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ misumɔŋ ni mayaje gbɔmɔ adesã dɛŋ. Miyɛ Yehowa dɛŋ, ejaakɛ lɛ lɛ emɔbɔnalɛ fa.”

english_verse: So the Lord sent a horrible disease on Israel, and
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa hã gbele hela ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Israelbii ateŋ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai kpawo gboi.

english_verse: Then he sent an angel to destroy the city of Jerusalem. But just as the angel was about to do that, the Lord felt sorry for all the suffering he had caused the people, and he told the angel, “Stop! They have suffered enough.” This happened at the threshing place that belonged to Araunah the Jebusite.
translation_verse: Ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsu bɔfo kɛba koni ebafite Yerusalɛm. Shi be ni bɔfo lɛ baabɔ̃i nifitemɔ lɛ, Yehowa musuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ efɔŋ ni abaafee maŋ lɛ hewɔ, kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ bɔfo ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ lɛ akɛ, “Efa, agbɛnɛ suu onine.” Be nɛɛ mli lɛ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ damɔ Ornan, Yebusnyo lɛ, ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ masɛi.

english_verse: David saw the Lord's angel in the air, holding a sword over Jerusalem. He and the leaders of Israel, who were all wearing sackcloth, bowed with their faces to the ground,
translation_verse: David yaawo ehiɛ nɔ lɛ naa Yehowa bɔfo lɛ damɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ teŋ, ni klante hiɛ edɛŋ, ni ekpã enine mli yɛ Yerusalɛm nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ maŋ onukpai ni ekɛ amɛ bumɔ kpekpe lɛ kɛ amɛhiɛ bu shi.

english_verse: The Lord's angel told the prophet Gad to tell David that he must go to Araunah's threshing place and build an altar in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Gad akɛ ekɛɛ David akɛ eya koni eyama afɔleshãa latɛ ema he ni Ornan, Yebusnyo lɛ, ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ yɔɔ lɛ ehã Yehowa.

english_verse: Araunah and his four sons were threshing wheat at the time, and when they saw the angel, the four sons ran to hide.
translation_verse: Ornan kɛ ebihii ejwɛ lɛ miigbee ŋmãa yɛ ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ. Be ni Ornan fo ehe ni ehiɛ gba bɔfo lɛ nɔ lɛ, ebihii lɛ yatee.

english_verse: Just then, David arrived, and when Araunah saw him, he stopped his work and bowed down.
translation_verse: David miiba Ornan ŋɔɔ, ni Ornan fo ehe ni ena David. No hewɔ lɛ, eje kpo yɛ ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ ni ekoto David, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi.

english_verse: David said, “Would you sell me your threshing place, so I can build an altar on it to the Lord? Then this disease will stop killing the people. I'm willing to pay whatever you say it's worth.”
translation_verse: Ni David kɛɛ Ornan akɛ, “Okɛ oŋmãagbeemɔhe nɛɛ ahã mi mahe, koni mama afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi maha Yehowa, bɔ ni afee ni afo gbele hela lɛ sɛɛ ahã wɔ. Mibawo bo nyɔmɔ shishiishi.”

english_verse: Araunah answered, “Take it, Your Majesty, and do whatever you want with it. I'll even give you the oxen for the sacrifice and the wheat for the grain sacrifice. And you can use the threshing-boards for the fire. It's all yours!”
translation_verse: Ornan kɛɛ David akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, ŋɔɔ ni ofee nɔ ni sa ohiɛ. Naa, mikɛ tsinai lɛ miihã koni akɛshã afɔlei lɛ, ni mikɛ ŋmãagbeemɔhe tsei lɛ hu miiha koni akɛfee lai; ni naa ŋmãa hu koni akɛfee niyenii afɔle. Mikɛ fɛɛ miike!”

english_verse: David built an altar and offered sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. David prayed, and the Lord answered him by sending fire down on the altar.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni David ma afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ. Be ni ekɛ shãa afɔlei kɛ shidaa afɔlei eba sɛɛ lɛ, esɔle etsɛ Yehowa, ni Yehowa here David nɔ, ni ehã la jɛ ŋwɛi ba, ni ebasɔo afɔlei lɛ anaa la yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord commanded the angel to put the sword away.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa fã bɔfo lɛ, ni ekɛ klante lɛ wo ehebo lɛ mli.

english_verse: When David saw that the Lord had answered his prayer, he offered more sacrifices there at the threshing place,
translation_verse: David na nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ mli akɛ Yehowa ehere lɛ nɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, eshã afɔlei yɛ Ornan, Yebusnyo lɛ, ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ.

english_verse: David said, “The temple of the Lord God must be built right here at this threshing place. And the altar for offering sacrifices will also be here.” David Prepares To Build the Temple
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ akɛ, “Biɛ etsɔ̃ Yehowa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ We; ni biɛ Israel fɛɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ baahi.” Bɔ ni asaa he ahã Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ maa

english_verse: David ordered the foreigners living in Israel to come to Jerusalem. Then he assigned some to cut blocks of stone for building the temple.
translation_verse: David fã akɛ abua gbɔi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ naa. Ejara nitsumɔi ehã amɛ. Tɛgbalɔi lɛ ehã amɛko tɛi ni akɛma Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ.

english_verse: He also brought an endless supply of cedar logs from the cities of Sidon and Tyre.
translation_verse: Asaŋ ehe tsenedrutsei babaoo ni anyɛɛɛ akane ejaakɛ Sidonbii lɛ kɛ Tirobii lɛ baha Maŋtsɛ David tsenedru tsei babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.

english_verse: He said, “The temple for the Lord must be great, so that everyone in the world will know about it. But since my son Solomon is young and has no experience, I will make sure that everything is ready for the temple to be built.” That's why David did all these things before he died. David Instructs Solomon To Build the Temple
translation_verse: David kɛɛ ehe akɛ, “Mibi Solomon hiɛ fãko, asaŋ ehiɛ esako, ni tsu ni ebaama eha Yehowa lɛ, esa akɛ efee tsu kpeteŋkple diɛŋtsɛ bɔ ni ehenɔ kɛ enyam bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ko he ko. No hewɔ lɛ, mato tsu lɛ maa he nibii mashwie shi mato lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, David to tsu lɛ he nibii babaoo diɛŋtsɛ eto dani egbo.

english_verse: David sent for his son Solomon and told him to build a temple for the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni David tsu atsɛ ebi Solomon ahã lɛ, ni efã lɛ akɛ ema tsu eha Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: He said: My son, I wanted to build a temple where the Lord my God would be worshiped.
translation_verse: Ekɛɛ Solomon, ebi lɛ, akɛ, “Kulɛ mito miyiŋ akɛ mama tsu koni mikɛwo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛi hiɛ nyam.

english_verse: But some time ago, he told me, “David, you have killed too many people and have fought too many battles. That's why you are not the one to build my temple.
translation_verse: Shi Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Oshwie lá shi tsɔ̃, ni owuwuu tai wuji. Kaama tsu ni okɛmiiwo migbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam ejaakɛ oshwie lá shi babaoo yɛ mihiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tsɔ̃.

english_verse: But when your son becomes king, I will give him peace throughout his kingdom. His name will be Solomon, because during his rule I will keep Israel safe and peaceful.
translation_verse: Naa, obaafɔ binuu ko. Toiŋjɔlɛ baaba yɛ eyinɔ, ejaakɛ maha ehenyɛlɔi fɛɛ ni bɔle lɛ lɛ ahã ena toiŋjɔlɛ. Abaatsɛ lɛ Solomon, ni mahã Israel ana toiŋjɔlɛ yɛ eyinɔ.

english_verse: Solomon will build my temple. He will be like a son to me, and I will be like a father to him. In fact, one of his descendants will always rule in Israel.”
translation_verse: Lɛ ji mɔ ni baama shihilɛhe kɛwo migbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam lɛ. Ebaatsɔ̃ mibi, ni matsɔ̃ etsɛ; ni maha emaŋtsɛyeli ahe shi yɛ Israel kɛya naanɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Solomon, my son, I now pray that the Lord your God will be with you and keep his promise to help you build a temple for him.
translation_verse: “No hewɔ lɛ, mibi, Yehowa ajɔɔ bo koni onyɛ shihilɛhe lɛ oma oha Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, bɔ ni ekɛɛ yɛ ohe lɛ.

english_verse: May he give you wisdom and knowledge, so that you can rule Israel according to his Law.
translation_verse: Yehowa aduro bo nilee kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛkɛ, bɔ ni afee ni kɛji etu Israel ewo odɛ̃ŋ lɛ, onyɛ maŋ lɛ nɔ okwɛ yɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mla naa.

english_verse: If you obey the laws and teachings that the Lord gave Moses, you will be successful. Be strong and brave and don't get discouraged or be afraid of anything.
translation_verse: Kɛji ojwɛŋ nɔ ni oye akpɔi kɛ mlai ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ewo Israel lɛ anɔ lɛ, no lɛ oooshwere. Ohe awa, ni ofee ekãa. Okashe gbeyei, ni otsui akafã hu.

english_verse: I have also assigned men who will cut and lay the stone. And there are carpenters and people who are experts in working with
translation_verse: Oyɛ ŋaalɔi hu babaoo: tɛgbalɔi kɛ tsu tswalɔi kɛ kapintafoi kɛ ŋaalɔi krokomɛi babaoo ni anyɛɛɛ akane,

english_verse: gold, silver, bronze, and iron. You have plenty of workers to do the job. Now get started, and I pray that the Lord will be with you in your work.
translation_verse: ni ji shika ŋmiiŋmi kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade. Tee shi ni owo nitsumɔ lɛ nɔ! Yehowa aaaye abua bo!”

english_verse: David then gave orders for the leaders of Israel to help Solomon.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni David wo Israel lumɛi fɛɛ kitã akɛ amɛye amɛbua ebi Solomon.

english_verse: David said: The Lord our God has helped me defeat all the people who lived here before us, and he has given you peace from all your enemies. Now this land belongs to the Lord and his people.
translation_verse: Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ yɛ, ni eha nyɛtoiŋ ejɔ nyɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he, ejaakɛ ehã miye majimaji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ bii anɔ kunim, ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛyɛ nyɛshishi.

english_verse: Obey the Lord your God with your heart and soul. Begin work on the temple to honor him, so that the sacred chest and the things used for worship can be kept there.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛtsuii kɛ nyɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ asɔmɔa Yehowa. Nyɛtea shi ni nyɛmaa Yehowa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ koni akɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ tsɛnsii kɛ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi ni akɛjaa lɛ lɛ fɛɛ abamamɔ tsu ni ama ni aja Yehowa yɛ jɛi lɛ mli.”

english_verse: David was old when he chose his son Solomon to be king of Israel.
translation_verse: Be ni David egbɔ kotokoto lɛ, ewo ebi Solomon Israel maŋtsɛ. Nitsumɔ ni ahã Levibii lɛ

english_verse: Some time later, David called together all of Israel's leaders, priests, and Levites.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ David tsɛ Israel lumɛi lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ fɛɛ kɛbakpe.

english_verse: Every morning and evening, the Levites are to give thanks to the Lord and sing praises to him.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ daa leebi kɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ amɛlaa kɛdaa Yehowa shi; ni amɛkɛjieɔ eyi hu.

english_verse: David then divided the Levites into three groups according to the clans of Levi's sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
translation_verse: David jara amɛmli kuikui yɛ Levi bihii ni ji Gershon kɛ Kohat kɛ Merari lɛ anaa.

english_verse: Gershon had two sons: Ladan and Shimei.
translation_verse: Gershon fɔ bihii enyɔ: Ladan kɛ Shimei.

english_verse: Ladan was the father of Jehiel, Zetham, and Joel.
translation_verse: Ladan fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Yehiel kɛ Zetam kɛ Yoel.

english_verse: They were all family leaders among their father's descendants. Shimei was the father of Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran.
translation_verse: Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Ladan shwiei awei lɛ anɔ onukpai lɛ.

english_verse: Later, Shimei had four more sons, in the following order: Jahath, Ziza, Jeush, and Beriah. But Jeush and Beriah didn't have many children, so their descendants were counted as one family.
translation_verse: Yahat ji kromɔbi, ni esɛɛho ji Zina; akɛni Yeush kɛ Beria eyafɔɔɔ bihii pii hewɔ lɛ akane amɛshwiei lɛ akɛ tsɛwe komeŋ bii.

english_verse: Kohath had four sons: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohat fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Amram kɛ Ishar kɛ Hebron kɛ Uziel.

english_verse: Amram was the father of Aaron and Moses. Aaron and his descendants were chosen to be in charge of all the sacred things. They served the Lord by offering sacrifices to him and by blessing the people in his name.
translation_verse: Amram, Kohat kromɔbi lɛ, fɔ Aaron kɛ Mose. Ajie Aaron kɛ eshwiei lɛ ato akɛ mɛi krɛdɛɛ ni akwɛ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi ni akɛjaa lɛ anɔ kɛya naanɔ; asaŋ akɛ amɛ amɛshã tsofakɛŋma be mli ni ajaa Yehowa; ni amɛsɔmɔ Yehowa, ni amɛjɔɔ mɛi yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli.

english_verse: Gershom's oldest son was Shebuel.
translation_verse: Gershom shwiei lɛ ateŋ onukpa ji Shebuel.

english_verse: Rehabiah, who was Eliezer's only son, had many children.
translation_verse: Eliezer fɔ binuu kometoo pɛ ni ji Rehabia; shi Rehabia fɔ babaoo.

english_verse: The second son born to Kohath was Izhar, and his oldest son was Shelomith.
translation_verse: Izhar, Kohat binuu ni ji enyɔ lɛ, fɔ Shelomit. Lɛ etsɔ̃ Izhar shwiei lɛ ateŋ onukpa.

english_verse: Merari had two sons: Mahli and Mushi. Mahli was the father of Eleazar and Kish.
translation_verse: Merari fɔ bihii enyɔ: Mahli kɛ Mushi. Mahli hu fɔ bihii enyɔ: Eleazar kɛ Kish;

english_verse: Eleazar had no sons, only daughters, and they married their uncle's sons.
translation_verse: shi Eleazar gbo ni ebɛ binuu fe biyei kɛkɛ. Kish bihii lɛ ŋɔ Eleazar biyei lɛ akɛ ŋamɛi.

english_verse: Mushi the second son of Merari, was the father of Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth.
translation_verse: Mushi, Merari binuu ni ji enyɔ lɛ, fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Mahli kɛ Eder kɛ Yeremot.

english_verse: David said: The Lord God of Israel has given his people peace, and he will live in Jerusalem forever.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ David kɛɛ nɔ ko akɛ, “Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã emaŋ lɛ he ejɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ amɛaahi Yerusalɛm kɛya naanɔ.

english_verse: And so, the Levites won't need to move the sacred tent and the things used for worship from place to place.
translation_verse: Ni no hewɔ lɛ, ehe ehĩaaa akɛ Levibii lɛ atere Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ ehe nibii ni akɛjaa lɛ lɛ dɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: will serve the Lord by helping Aaron's descendants do their work at the temple, by keeping the courtyards and rooms of the temple clean, and by making sure that everything used in worship stays pure.
translation_verse: ni ahã amɛ nitsumɔi ni baa nɛɛ akɛ amɛtsu: amɛwaa Aaron shwiei ni ji osɔfoi lɛ kɛji aaja yɛ Yehowa we lɛ; amɛsaa kpoi lɛ anɔ kɛ piai lɛ amli; amɛtsumɔɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ ahe; amɛtsuɔ nitsumɔi krokomɛi fɛɛ ni kɔɔ Yehowa we lɛ mli sɔɔmɔ he;

english_verse: They will also be in charge of the sacred loaves of bread, the flour for the grain sacrifices, the thin wafers, any offerings to be baked, and the flour mixed with olive oil. These Levites will weigh and measure these offerings.
translation_verse: amɛkwɛɔ aboloo ni akɛmaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ he saji anɔ, kɛ mamu ni akɛbashãa niyenii afɔle lɛ, kɛ kaka ni akɛ ma akpiti shã lɛ, kɛ nibii ni ashã ni akɛbashãa afɔle lɛ, kɛ mamu ni akɛ mu efutu mli ni akɛbaashã afɔle lɛ. Agbɛnɛ amɛ amɛŋmɛɔ ni amɛsusuɔ nibii srɔtoi fɛɛ ni akɛbaa afɔleshãa lɛ.

english_verse: They must also give thanks and sing praises when sacrifices are offered on each Sabbath, as well as during New Moon Festivals and other religious feasts. There must always be enough Levites on duty at the temple to do everything that needs to be done.
translation_verse: Be fɛɛ be ni aashã afɔle ahã Yehowa yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbii anɔ loo yɛ nyɔji hei ajee mli kɛ gbii juji anɔ hu amɛ amɛlaa. Ato Levibii ni be fɛɛ be lɛ amɛ amɛbaatsu nitsumɔi nɛɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko kɛsɔmɔ Yehowa.

english_verse: They were once in charge of taking care of the sacred tent; now they are responsible for the temple and for helping Aaron's descendants.
translation_verse: Belɛ Levibii lɛ ji mɛi ni kwɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ nɔ; ni amɛ amɛwa Aaron shwiei ni ji amɛnyɛmimɛi osɔfoi lɛ, ni akɛsɔmɔ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ.

english_verse: Aaron's descendants were then divided into work groups. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation_verse: Shĩaishĩai ni feɔ Aaron shwiei lɛ agbɛii baa nɛɛ: Aaron fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Nadab kɛ Abihu kɛ Eleazar kɛ Itamar.

english_verse: But Nadab and Abihu died long before their father, without having any sons. That's why Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
translation_verse: Nadab kɛ Abihu gboi yɛ amɛtsɛ hiɛ, ni amɛshiii bii. No hewɔ lɛ, amɛnyɛmimɛi Eleazar kɛ Itamar baye osɔfo lɛ.

english_verse: David divided Aaron's descendants into groups, according to their assigned work. Zadok, one of Eleazar's descendants, and Ahimelech, one of Ithamar's descendants, helped David.
translation_verse: Zadok ni jɛ Eleazar shwiei lɛ ateŋ lɛ kɛ Ahimelek ni jɛ Itamar shwiei lɛ ateŋ lɛ wa Maŋtsɛ David ni ejara Aaron shwiei lɛ amli kuikui yɛ nitsumɔi ni ahã amɛ lɛ anaa.

english_verse: groups, and Ithamar's were divided into eight groups, because Eleazar's family included more family leaders.
translation_verse: Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ nɛɛhu lɛ gbee Petahia nɔ, ni nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ gbee Yehekel nɔ.

english_verse: However, both families included temple officials and priests, and so to make sure the work was divided fairly, David asked God what to do.
translation_verse: Akɛni Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli lumɛi kɛ mumɔŋ lumɛi fɛɛ yɛ Eleazarbii lɛ kɛ Itamarbii lɛ ateŋ biɛ kɛ biɛ hewɔ lɛ, afɔ̃ oshiki ni akɛja nitsumɔi lɛ ahã amɛ.

english_verse: As each group was assigned their duties, Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the Levite wrote down the name of the family leader in charge of that group. The witnesses were David and his officials, as well as Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the family leaders from the clans of the priests and the Levites.
translation_verse: Kɛji afɔ̃ shi kome ahã Eleazarwe lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ afɔ̃ shi kome hu ahã Itamar we lɛ. Ni Shemaia, Netanel bi lɛ, ni jɛ Levibii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, ji woloŋmalɔ mɔ ni ŋmala bɔ ni oshikifɔ̃ɔ lɛ fɛɛ tee nɔ hã. Eŋmala nii nɛɛ yɛ Maŋtsɛ David kɛ lumɛi lɛ kɛ Osɔfo Zadok kɛ Abiatar bi Ahimelek kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii ashĩaiaŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: Each group of priests went by the name of its family leader, and they were assigned their duties in the following order: Jehoiarib, Jedaiah, Harim, Seorim, Malchijah, Mijamin, Hakkoz, Abijah, Jeshua, Shecaniah, Eliashib, Jakim, Huppah, Jeshebeab, Bilgah, Immer, Hezir, Happizzez, Pethahiah, Jehezkel, Jachin, Gamul, Delaiah, Maaziah.
translation_verse: Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ gbee Delaia nɔ, ni nɔ ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ gbee Maazia nɔ.

english_verse: These men were assigned their duties at the temple, just as the Lord God of Israel had commanded their ancestor Aaron. The Rest of the Levites Are Assigned Their Duties
translation_verse: Bɔ ni ato gbɛjianɔ lɛ ahã gbɔmɛi nɛɛ nɛ: amɛyaa Yehowa we lɛ amɛyasɔmɔɔ bɔ ni amɛtsɛ Aaron to he gbɛjianɔ yɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fãmɔ naa lɛ. Levibii krokomɛi hu agbɛii

english_verse: Here is a list of the other descendants of Levi: Amram was the ancestor of Shubael and Jehdeiah.
translation_verse: Levibii lɛ ekomɛi hu amli onukpai lɛ agbɛii baa nɛ: Yehedeia ni jɛ Amram bi Shebael mli lɛ,

english_verse: Rehabiah was the ancestor of Isshiah, the oldest son in his family.
translation_verse: Ishia, Rehabia shwiei lɛ ateŋ onukpa lɛ,

english_verse: Izhar was the father of Shelomoth and the grandfather of Jahath.
translation_verse: Yahat, ni jɛ Izhar bi Shelomit mli lɛ.

english_verse: Uzziel was the father of Micah and the grandfather of Shamir.
translation_verse: Shamir, ni jɛ Uziel bi Mika mli lɛ.

english_verse: Isshiah, Micah's brother, was the father of Zechariah.
translation_verse: Zakaria, ni jɛ Uziel bi Mika nyɛmi Ishia mli lɛ.

english_verse: Merari was the father of Mahli, Mushi, and Jaaziah.
translation_verse: Mahli kɛ Mushi, Merari shwiei lɛ.

english_verse: Jaaziah had three sons: Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
translation_verse: Beno kɛ Shoham kɛ Zakur kɛ Ibri, ni ji Merari shwiei ni jɛ Yaazia mli lɛ.

english_verse: Mushi had three sons: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the descendants of Levi, according to their clans.
translation_verse: Mahli kɛ Eder kɛ Yerimot, Mushibii lɛ. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Levibii abihii lɛ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa.

english_verse: Each one was assigned his duties in the same way that their relatives the priests had been assigned their duties. David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the family leaders of the priests and Levites were the witnesses.
translation_verse: Shĩa fɛɛ shĩa mli onukpa lɛ fã enyɛmimɛi gbekɛbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome efata ehe kɛfɔ̃ oshiki, ni amɛkɛkɔlɔ amɛgbɛfaŋ nitsumɔi lɛ tamɔ amɛnyɛmimɛi Aaronbii lɛ fee lɛ nɔŋŋ. Amɛ hu amɛfee nii nɛɛ yɛ Maŋtsɛ David kɛ Osɔfo Zadok kɛ Ahimelek kɛ Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ atsɛmɛi awei lɛ amli onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: David and the temple officials chose the descendants of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun to be in charge of music. They were to praise the Lord by playing cymbals, harps and other stringed instruments. Here is a list of the musicians and their duties:
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ David kɛ Levibii lɛ ateiaŋ lumɛi lɛ hala mɛi komɛi yɛ Asafbii lɛ kɛ Hemanbii lɛ kɛ Yedutunbii lɛ ateŋ, ni amɛto amɛ akɛ amɛ amɛgba kɛji aaja, shi nakai be mli nɔŋŋ lɛ amɛmiitswa obenta kɛ saŋkui kɛ ŋmɛji, ni amɛmiikpã bɛji hu. Mɛi ni ahala kɛ nitsumɔi hu ni ahã amɛ lɛ baa nɛɛ.

english_verse: Asaph's four sons, Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah, were under the direction of their father and played music whenever the king told them to.
translation_verse: Asaf bihii ejwɛ lɛ: Zakur kɛ Yosef kɛ Netania kɛ Asharela. Amɛyɛ amɛtsɛ Asaf shishi. Lɛ lɛ eyɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ he, ni egbaa Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ wiemɔ etsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ.

english_verse: His sons were under his direction and played cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments during times of worship at the temple. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman took their orders directly from the king.
translation_verse: Heman bii nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ lɛ eshishi, ni amɛtswaa ŋmɛji kɛ obentai yɛ Yehowa we amɛkɛwaa jamɔ lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ mli. Shi Asaf kɛ Yedutun kɛ Heman lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛyɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ shishi.

english_verse: David assigned them their duties by asking the Lord what he wanted. Everyone was responsible for something, whether young or old, teacher or student.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni afɔ̃ oshiki ni akɛjara nitsumɔi lɛ ahã gbɔmɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ, gbekɛ kɛ onukpa, kɛ tsɔɔlɔ kɛ kaselɔ fɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Elam, Jehohanan, and Eliehoenai.
translation_verse: kɛ Elam kɛ Yehohanan kɛ Eliehoenai.

english_verse: Shemaiah was the father of Othni, Rephael, Obed, Elzabad, Elihu, and Semachiah. They were all respected leaders in their clan.
translation_verse: Shimei bii nɛɛ agbɛii yɛ fɔmɔ naa ji Otni kɛ Refael kɛ Obed kɛ Elzabad ni enyɛmimɛi ji Elihu kɛ Semakia kãkãlɔi lɛ.

english_verse: Eighteen descendants of Meshelemiah were chosen for this work.
translation_verse: Ana hii hiɛwalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ kɛhã buu nitsumɔ lɛ yɛ Meshelemia shwiei lɛ ateŋ.

english_verse: Hosah, from the Merari clan, was the father of Shimri, Hilkiah, Tebaliah, and Zechariah. Hosah had made Shimri the family leader, even though he was not the oldest son. Thirteen men from Hosah's family were chosen to be temple guards.
translation_verse: kɛ Hilkia kɛ Tebalaia kɛ Zakaria. Hosa shwiei fɛɛ ni aŋɔ awo buu nitsumɔ lɛ mli ayibɔ fee nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃.

english_verse: The guards were divided into groups, according to their family leaders, and they were assigned duties at the temple, just like the other Levites.
translation_verse: Ajara bulɔi nɛɛ amli kuikui, ku fɛɛ ku kɛ enukpa; ni ahã amɛ amɛgbɛnaa nitsumɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli tamɔ ahã amɛnyɛmimɛi Levibii krokomɛi lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Each group, no matter how large or small, was assigned a gate to guard, and they let the Lord show them what he wanted done.
translation_verse: Tsɛmɛi ashĩaishĩai lɛ fɔ̃ oshiki koni akɛna nɔ agbonaa ni shĩa fɛɛ shĩa baabu; ayakwɛɛɛ mɛi ni ayi fa kɛ mɛi ni ayi faaa.

english_verse: Shelemiah was chosen to guard the East Gate. Zechariah his son was a wise man and was chosen to guard the North Gate.
translation_verse: Oshiki ni afɔ̃ yɛ bokãgbɛ agbo lɛ hewɔ lɛ gbee Shelemia nɔ; ni nɔ ni afɔ̃ yɛ kooyigbɛ agbo lɛ hewɔ lɛ gbee Shelemia bi Zakaria, nuu nilelɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Obed-Edom was then chosen to guard the South Gate, and his sons were chosen to guard the storerooms.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni afɔ̃ wuoyigbɛ agbo lɛ, hewɔ lɛ gbee Obed-Edom nɔ; ni nitoohe lɛ nɔkwɛmɔ gbee ebihii lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Shuppim and Hosah were chosen to guard the West Gate and the Shallecheth Gate on the upper road. The guards were assigned the following work schedule:
translation_verse: Anaigbɛ agbo lɛ kɛ Shaleket agbo lɛ, nɔ ni kã gbɛjegbɛ ni yaa gɔŋ nɔ gbɛ lɛ he lɛ, anaibulɛ lɛ gbee Shupim kɛ Hosa nɔ. Aja buube lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ bɔ ni eko faaa fe eko.

english_verse: Each day six guards were on duty on the east side of the temple, four were on duty on the north side, and four were on duty on the south side. Two guards were stationed at each of the two storerooms,
translation_verse: Mɛi ekpaa buɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ daa gbi; mɛi ejwɛ buɔ kooyigbɛ lɛ, ni mɛi ejwɛ hu buɔ wuoyigbɛ lɛ; shi mɛi enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ buɔ nitoohe lɛ daa gbi.

english_verse: four were stationed along the road leading to the west courtyard, and two guards stayed in the court itself.
translation_verse: Mɛi ejwɛ buɔ he ni anaigbɛ agbo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ yɛ gbɛjegbɛ lɛ he lɛ, ni mɛi enyɔ buɔ agba lɛ diɛŋtsɛ he.

english_verse: These were the guard duties assigned to the men from the clans of Korah and Merari. Guards Are Assigned to the Treasury
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni ajara agbonaabulɔi ni jɛ Korabii lɛ kɛ Meraribii lɛ ateŋ lɛ amli kuikui ahã.

english_verse: The Levites who were relatives of the Korahites and the Merarites were in charge of guarding the temple treasury and the gifts that had been dedicated to God.
translation_verse: Levibii lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ lɛ, Ahia ji mɔ ni kwɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ nitoohei lɛ kɛ nibii ni akɛbake Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ hu atoohe lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Ladan was from the Gershon clan and was the father of Jehieli. Many of his other descendants were family leaders in the clan.
translation_verse: Gershon bi Ladan shwiei na shĩai babaoo ni eko ji ebinuu Yehiel shĩa lɛ.

english_verse: Jehieli was the father of Zetham and Joel, and they were responsible for guarding the treasury.
translation_verse: Yehiel bihii enyɔ ni ji Zetam kɛ enyɛmi Yoel ji mɛi ni kwɛɔ Yehowa we lɛ nitoohei lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Other guards at the treasury were from the Kohathite clans of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Ni Amrambii lɛ kɛ Izeharbii lɛ kɛ Hebronbii lɛ kɛ Uzielbii lɛ hu, ahã amɛ amɛ hu amɛgbɛfaŋ nitsumɔi.

english_verse: Shebuel was a descendant of Gershom the son of Moses. He was the chief official in charge of the temple treasury.
translation_verse: Shebuel ni ji Mose bi Gershom shwie lɛ ji lumɔnukpa fe fɛɛ ni kwɛɔ nitoohei lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: The descendants of Gershom's brother Eliezer included Rehabiah, Jeshaiah, Joram, Zichri, and Shelomoth.
translation_verse: Shebuel wekunyo Eliezer bi ji Rehabia, ni Rehabia bi ji Yeshaia, ni Yeshaia bi ji Yoram, ni Yoram bi ji Zikri, ni Zikri bi ji Shelomit.

english_verse: Shelomoth and his relatives were in charge of all the gifts that were dedicated to the Lord. These included the gifts that King David had dedicated, as well as those dedicated by the family leaders, army officers, and army commanders.
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ Shelomit nɛɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi ji mɛi ni buɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ atoohe lɛ he, ni ji nibii ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛ tsɛmɛiawei amli weku nukpai, kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi ni kwɛɔ mɛi akpe akui kɛ mɛi ni kwɛɔ mɛi oha akui anɔ lɛ kɛ tatsɛmɛi lɛ ejɔɔ nɔ eke Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: And whenever valuable things were captured in battle, these men brought back some of them to make repairs to the temple.
translation_verse: Amɛjɔɔ tai amli nibii ni amɛha lɛ mli eko nɔ amɛkɛke koni akɛtsu Yehowa we lɛ he nii.

english_verse: Shelomoth and his relatives were responsible for any gifts that had been given to the temple, including those from Samuel the prophet, King Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah. Other Officers Are Assigned Their Duties
translation_verse: Shelomit kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ adɛŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ake koni akɛtsu Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he nii lɛ yɔɔ. Nibii lɛ ekomɛi ji nibii ni Samuel, gbalɔ lɛ, kɛ Saul, Kish bi lɛ, kɛ Abner, Ner bi lɛ, kɛ Yoab, Zeruia bi lɛ, jɔɔ nɔ ke lɛ. Nitsumɔi ni ahã Levibii krokomɛi

english_verse: Chenaniah from the Izhar clan and his sons were government officials and judges. They did not work at the temple.
translation_verse: Akɔ Kenania kɛ ebihii lɛ yɛ Izhar shwiei lɛ ateŋ koni amɛtsu maŋbii ashihilɛ he akɔntaabuu woji lɛ ahe nii, koni amɛkwɛ maŋbii ateŋ saji hu amɛkojo.

english_verse: Joab the son of Zeruiah had begun to count the people, but he stopped when the Lord began punishing Israel. So the total number was never included in David's official records. Officials in Charge of the King's Property
translation_verse: Yoab, ni enyɛ gbɛi ji Zeruia lɛ, bɔ̃i maŋbii kanemɔ lɛ, shi eyagbeee naa. Nyɔŋmɔ gbala Israel toi yɛ mɛi kanemɔ nɛɛ hewɔ; ni no hewɔ lɛ, naagbee gbɔmɛi ayikulɛ ni ana lɛ, eyajeee Maŋtsɛ David yinɔ saji anɔ wojiaŋ. Maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ he nibii anɔkwɛlɔi

english_verse: who was the leader of the Thirty Warriors, and whose son Ammizabad was also an army commander;
translation_verse: Benaia nɛɛ nɔŋŋ ji hii kãkãlɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ anukpa, ni ebi Amizabad baye esɛɛ akɛ ku nɛɛ nɔkwɛlɔ.

english_verse: When David decided to count the people of Israel, he gave orders not to count anyone under
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ David hãaa akane mɛi ni yeko afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ ejaakɛ Yehowa ewo shi eto akɛ ebaahã Israel yi afa tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋulamii lɛ.

english_verse: years of age, because the Lord had promised long ago that Israel would have as many people as there are stars in the sky.
translation_verse: Efraimbii lɛ alumɔ ji Hoshea, Azazia bi lɛ; ni Anaigbɛ Manasebii lɛ alumɔ lɛ ji Yoel, Pedaia bi lɛ.

english_verse: Azmaveth the son of Adiel was in charge of the king's personal storage rooms. Jonathan the son of Uzziah was in charge of the king's other storerooms that were in the towns, the villages, and the defense towers in Israel.
translation_verse: Naa mɛi hu ni ato koni amɛkwɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ he nibii lɛ anɔ: Maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli nitoohei lɛ Azmavet, Adiel bi lɛ, ji mɔ ni kwɛ nɔ; ni nitoohei ni yɔɔ koi asɛɛ kɛ maji kɛ akrowai kɛ mɔji lɛ amli lɛ. Yonatan, Uzia bi lɛ, ji mɔ ni kwɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Ezri the son of Chelub was in charge of the workers who farmed the king's land.
translation_verse: Ŋmɔji lɛ amli nitsulɔi lɛ Esri, Kelub bi lɛ, ji mɔ ni kwɛ amɛnɔ;

english_verse: Shimei from Ramah was in charge of the vineyards, and Zabdi from Shepham was in charge of storing the wine.
translation_verse: ni waintromi lɛ Shimei ni jɛ Rama lɛ ji mɔ ni kwɛ nɔ; ni wain ni yɔɔ wain toohei lɛ amli lɛ, Zabdi ni jɛ Shefam lɛ ji mɔ ni kwɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Baal Hanan from Geder was in charge of the olive and sycamore trees in the western foothills, and Joash was in charge of storing the olive oil.
translation_verse: Mu tsei lɛ kɛ sikamore tsei lɛ ni yɔɔ anaigbɛ gɔji lɛ ashishi jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, Baal-Hanan ni jɛ Geder lɛ ji mɔ ni kwɛ nɔ; ni mutoohei lɛ Yoash ji mɔ ni kwɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Shitrai from Sharon was responsible for the cattle that were kept in Sharon Plain, and Shaphat son of Adlai was responsible for those kept in the valleys.
translation_verse: Tsinai ni alɛ yɛ Sharon ŋa nɔ lɛ, Shirtai ni jɛ Sharon ji mɔ ni kwɛ nɔ; ni tsinai ni alɛ yɛ jɔɔ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, Shafat, Adlai bi lɛ, ji mɔ ni kwɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels, Jehdeiah from Meronoth was in charge of the donkeys, and Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the sheep and goats.
translation_verse: Yoomai lɛ Obil, Ishmaelnyo lɛ, ji mɔ ni kwɛ amɛnɔ; ni tejii lɛ Yehedeia ni jɛ Meronot ji mɔ ni kwɛ amɛnɔ; ni gwantɛŋi kɛ abotiai lɛ Yaziz, Hegrinyo lɛ, ji mɔ ni kwɛ amɛnɔ.

english_verse: These were the men in charge of David's royal property. David's Personal Advisors
translation_verse: Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ji Maŋtsɛ David tsuji ni kwɛ sɛ̃i lɛ he nibii anɔ lɛ. Maŋtsɛ David ŋaawolɔi

english_verse: David's uncle Jonathan was a wise and intelligent advisor. He and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni taught David's sons.
translation_verse: Yonatan, Maŋtsɛ David tsɛkwɛ lɛ, ji maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋaawolɔ. Eji ehe nuu ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ, ni ele woloŋ hu. Lɛ kɛ Yehiel, Hekemoni bi lɛ, ji mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ bii nii.

english_verse: Ahithophel and Hushai the Archite were two of David's advisors.
translation_verse: Ahitofel hu maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋaawolɔ ni; ni Hushai, Arkinyo lɛ, ji maŋtsɛ lɛ shieŋtsɛ.

english_verse: Jehoiada the son of Benaiah was the king's advisor after Ahithophel, and later, Abiathar was his advisor. Joab was commander of Israel's army.
translation_verse: Ahitofel gbele sɛɛ lɛ, Yehoiada, Benaia bi lɛ, kɛ Abiatar baye esɛɛ akɛ maŋtsɛ ŋaawolɔi. Ni Yoab ji maŋtsɛ lɛ tatsɛnukpa fe fɛɛ.

english_verse: David called a meeting in Jerusalem for all of Israel's leaders, including the tribal leaders, the government officials, the army commanders, the officials in charge of the royal property and livestock, the palace officials, and the brave warriors.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ David kpee Israel lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm. No hewɔ lɛ, akutsei lɛ amli lumɛi lɛ, kɛ kuikui ni sɔ̃mɔɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ amli lumɛi lɛ, kɛ tabilɔi akpe akuikui kɛ tabilɔi oha akuikui atatsɛmɛi lɛ, kɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ he nibii lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛbii lɛ anibii lɛ kɛ tsinai lɛ anɔkwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ hii kãkãlɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa bakpe shi yɛ Yerusalɛm.

english_verse: After everyone was there, David stood up and said: Listen to me, my people. I wanted to build a place where the sacred chest would be kept, so we could go there and worship the Lord our God. I have prepared all the supplies for building a temple,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David ho edamɔ shi, ni ekɛɛ asafo ni ebabua shi lɛ akɛ, “Agoo, minyɛmimɛi kɛ mimaŋbii! Kulɛ mito miyiŋ akɛ mibama tsu diɛŋtsɛ mahã Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ naneshi maaŋoo lɛ hu, ni mito nibii ahe gbɛjianɔ hu hã tsu lɛ maa.

english_verse: but the Lord has refused to let me build it, because he said I have killed too many people in battle.
translation_verse: Shi Nyɔŋmɔ ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Kaama shĩa ohã mi ni aja mi yɛ mli, ejaakɛ tawulɔ ji bo, ni oshwie lã shi.’

english_verse: The Lord God chose Judah to be the leading tribe in Israel. Then from Judah, he chose my father's family, and from that family, he chose me to be the king of Israel, and he promised that my descendants will also rule as kings.
translation_verse: Shi Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ eŋɔ mi yɛ mitsɛwebii lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ koni mi kɛ mishwiei aye Israel maŋtsɛ kɛya naanɔ. Eŋɔ̃ Yuda yɛ akutsei lɛ ateŋ koni etsɔ̃ hiɛnyiɛlɔ; ni eŋɔ̃ mitsɛwe lɛ yɛ Yudabii awei lɛ ateŋ, ni ena mihe tsui yɛ mitsɛbii lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ, ni ewo mi Israel fɛɛ maŋtsɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has blessed me with many sons, but he chose my son Solomon to be the next king of Israel.
translation_verse: Ni Yehowa duro mi bii pii, ni bii nɛɛ fɛɛ ateŋ lɛ eŋɔ̃ mibi Solomon koni ebata Yehowa maŋtsɛyeli sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ kɛye maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Your son Solomon will build my temple, and it will honor me. Solomon will be like a son to me, and I will be like a father to him.
translation_verse: “Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Obi Solomon ji mɔ ni baama mishĩa lɛ, ejaakɛ miŋɔ lɛ mifee mibi, ni matsɔ̃ etsɛ,

english_verse: If he continues to obey my laws and commands, his kingdom will never end.”
translation_verse: ni mahã emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ama shi kɛya naanɔ kɛji ekã he eye mikitãi kɛ mimlai lɛ anɔ tamɔ efeɔ amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ.’

english_verse: My friends, you are the Lord's people. And now, with God as your witness, I want you to promise that you will do your best to obey everything the Lord God has commanded us. Then this land will always belong to you and your descendants.
translation_verse: “No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, mimaŋbii, miibi nyɛ yɛ Israel tso muu fɛɛ, ni ji Yehowa asafo ni ewo shi nɛɛ, hiɛ, ni wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hu miinu, koni nyɛye Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitãi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ; nyɛdia amɛsɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɛɛ atsɔ̃ nyɛnɔ, koni nyɛshi nyɛhã nyɛbii ni baa yɛ nyɛsɛɛ lɛ akɛ gboshinii kɛya naanɔ.

english_verse: Solomon, my son, worship God and obey him with all your heart and mind, just as I have done. He knows all your thoughts and your reasons for doing things, and so if you turn to him, he will hear your prayers. But if you ignore him, he will reject you forever.
translation_verse: “Ni bo, mibi Solomon, ole otsɛ ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ; osɔ̃mɔ lɛ kɛ otsuiŋ fɛɛ, asaŋ ojie oyitsoŋ fɛɛ hu ni okɛsɔ̃mɔ lɛ! Ejaakɛ Yehowa taoɔ adesã tsuiŋ fɛɛ, ni ele eyitsoŋ fɛɛ. Kɛji otao esɛɛgbɛ lɛ eeehã ona lɛ; shi kɛji okwa lɛ lɛ, eeeshɛ bo efɔ̃ kɛya naanɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen you to build a temple for worshiping him. Be confident and do the work you have been assigned.
translation_verse: Naa, kwɛmɔ ohe ni ahi, ejaakɛ Yehowa eŋɔ̃ bo koni oma shĩa ni akɛfee Jamɔhe Krɔŋkrɔŋ. Wajemɔ ohe, ni ofee ekãa.”

english_verse: After David finished speaking, he gave Solomon the plans for building the main rooms of the temple, including the porch, the storerooms, the rooms upstairs and downstairs, as well as the most holy place.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli tsui lɛ ahe mfoniri ni atɛŋ, hã ebi Solomon. Mfoniri nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni koi lɛ kɛ ehe tsui lɛ, kɛ nitoohei lɛ, kɛ ŋwɛigbɛ tsui lɛ, kɛ piai ni yɔɔ mligbɛ lɛ, kɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ fe Fɛɛ, he ni Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ baama lɛ, kamɔ shi hã.

english_verse: He gave Solomon his plans for the courtyards and the open areas around the temple, and for the rooms to store the temple treasures and gifts that had been dedicated to God.
translation_verse: David kɛ wolo kroko ni atɛŋ hã Solomon ni miitsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni esusu nibii ni baa nɛɛ ahe eha: Yehowa we lɛ he kpoi lɛ kɛ piai ni bɔle kpo lɛ kɛkpe lɛ, kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ mli nibii atoohei lɛ, kɛ nibii ni mɛi kɛbake Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hu atoohei lɛ.

english_verse: David also gave Solomon his plans for dividing the priests and the Levites into groups, as well as for the work that needed to be done at the temple and for taking care of the objects used for worship.
translation_verse: Asaŋ David kɛ wolo kroko hu hã Solomon ekoŋŋ ni tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni ato gbɛjianɔ ahã osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ koni amɛkɛtsu amɛnitsumɔi lɛ kɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, asaŋ kɛkwɛ tsɛnsii kɛ nibii ni akɛtsuɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli nii lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.

english_verse: He told Solomon how much gold and silver was to be used in making the sacred objects,
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ David tsɔ̃ɔ Solomon jwiɛtɛi loo shika naa bɔ ni sa akɛ aŋmɛ̃ koni akɛfee tsɛnsii fɛɛ ni akɛtsuɔ Yehowa we lɛ mli nii lɛ,

english_verse: the gold incense altar, and the gold statue of a chariot for the winged creatures which were on the lid of the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ bɔ ni shika ŋmiiŋmi tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ aŋmɛ̃; dani etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ bɔ ni atsɔ̃ afee kerub ni egbɛ amɛfijiaŋ amɛkɛha Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ nɔ lɛ ashika shwiili lɛ hu ahã.

english_verse: David then said to Solomon: The Lord showed me how his temple is to be built.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ akɛ, “Ajie nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ atsɔ̃ɔ mi kɛjɛ Yehowa dɛŋ, ni aŋmã; ni etsɔ̃ɔ mi bɔ ni atsɔ̃ akwɛ nɔkwɛmɔ nɔ nɛɛ nɔ kɛtsu nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ahã.”

english_verse: But you must see that everything is done according to these plans. Be confident, and never be afraid of anything or get discouraged. The Lord my God will help you do everything needed to finish the temple, so it can be used for worshiping him.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ ebi Solomon akɛ, “Wajemɔ ohe ni ofee ekãa; kaashe gbeyei, ni otsui akafã hu. Ejaakɛ Yehowa Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ji mi, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yɛ osɛɛ; ekwaŋ bo lɛ, eshiŋ bo hu kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ooogbe Yehowa We lɛ mãa he nitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa.

english_verse: The priests and Levites have been assigned their duties, and all the skilled workers are prepared to do their work. The people and their leaders will do anything you tell them.
translation_verse: Ni naa bɔ ni ajara Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ ahã osɔfoi akuu kɛ Levibii akuu lɛ. Ni yɛ nitsumɔ fɛɛ nitsumɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ, ayɛ mɛi ni le ŋaa srɔtoi, ni asaŋ amɛyɛ he tsui tsɔ̃ akɛ amɛaatsu nii kɛwa bo; amɛsɛɛ lɛ lumɛi lɛ kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hu yɛ odɛ̃ŋ.”

english_verse: That's why I have done my best to get everything Solomon will need to build it—gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, onyx, turquoise, colored gems, all kinds of precious stones, and marble.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, misaa nibii mito, bɔ ni manyɛ, yɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hewɔ: shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade kɛ tso ni akɛbaatsu amɛhe nibii srɔtoi, dani soro ojarawa tɛi srɔtoi kɛ tɛi ni akɛmamɔɔ nibii amli akɛyeɔ sama, kɛ tɛi ni kpɛlɛɔ kɛ tɛi ni yɔɔ ŋwãtãŋwãtã kɛ tɛi ni akɛkaa shikpɔŋ.

english_verse: and to make the gold and silver objects. Now, who else will show their dedication to the Lord by giving gifts for building his temple?
translation_verse: asaŋ koni ana eko ni ŋaalɔi lɛ kɛfee nibii fɛɛ ni esa akɛ akɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi afee lɛ. Agbɛnɛ namɔ yɔɔ biɛ ni yɔɔ he tsui akɛ eeeshã afɔle ehã Yehowa?”

english_verse: After David finished speaking, the family leaders, the tribal leaders, the army commanders, and the government officials voluntarily gave gifts
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni tsɛmɛiawei lɛ amli onukpai lɛ kɛ akutsei lɛ amli lumɛi lɛ, kɛ tabilɔi akpe akuikui kɛ tabilɔi oha akuikui atatsɛmɛi lɛ, kɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ he nibii anɔkwɛlɔi lɛ shi amɛtsitsi akɛ amɛaahã nibii lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who owned precious stones also donated them to the temple treasury, where Jehiel from the Levite clan of Gershon guarded them.
translation_verse: Maŋbii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ojarawatɛi lɛ, amɛkɛtee amɛyahã koni akɛwo Yehowa nitoohe lɛ ni Yehiel, Levinyo Gershonnyo lɛ, kwɛɔ nɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: David and the people were very happy that so much had been given to the Lord, and they all celebrated. David Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nya yɛ nii ni amɛkɛke yɛ tsuijurɔ naa lɛ hewɔ. Ejaakɛ amɛjɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ amɛkɛ nii ke Yehowa, ni Maŋtsɛ David hu nya naakpa. David jie Nyɔŋmɔ yi

english_verse: Then, in front of everyone, David sang praises to the Lord: I praise you forever, Lord! You are the God our ancestor Jacob worshiped.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David jie Yehowa yi yɛ asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Aaajie oyi, Bo Yehowa, ni ji wɔtsɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyashi naanɔ.

english_verse: Your power is great, and your glory is seen everywhere in heaven and on earth. You are king of the entire world,
translation_verse: Yehowa, oda ni Bo oyɔɔ hewalɛ kɛ anunyam; oyeɔ nii fɛɛ nɔ kunim, ni oje agbo ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ onɔ ni. Yehowa, bo ji maŋtsɛ ni ota nii fɛɛ nɔ akɛ yitso.

english_verse: We thank you, our God, and praise you.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, wɔmiida bo shi, ni wɔmiijie ogbɛi ni hiɛ yɔɔ nyam lɛ yi.

english_verse: But why should we be happy that we have given you these gifts? They belong to you, and we have only given back what is already yours.
translation_verse: “Ni namɔ po ji mi, ni namɛi po hu ji mimaŋbii, ni wɔnyɛ wɔke nii kɛ tsuijurɔ nɛkɛ nɛɛ? Ejaakɛ odɛ̃ŋ ni nii fɛɛ jɛɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni wɔkɛhã bo lɛ odɛ̃ŋ nɔŋŋ wɔna yɛ.

english_verse: We are only foreigners living here on earth for a while, just as our ancestors were. And we will soon be gone, like a shadow that suddenly disappears.
translation_verse: Ohiɛ lɛ, gbɔi kɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji ji wɔ, tamɔ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ nɔŋŋ. Wɔgbii ni wɔyeɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hoɔ eyaa tamɔ susuma ni ehiii shi daa lɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord God, we have brought all these things for building a temple to honor you. They belong to you, and you gave them to us.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, nii babaoo ni wɔbua naa wɔkɛbaama shĩa wɔkɛwo ogbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ nyam nɛɛ lɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ onii ni, ejaakɛ odɛ̃ŋ fɛɛ jɛ.

english_verse: But we are happy, because everyone has voluntarily given you these things. You know what is in everyone's heart, and you are pleased when people are honest.
translation_verse: MiNyɔŋmɔ, mile akɛ bo lɛ okaa gbɔmɔ tsui okwɛɔ, ni onaa mɛi ni yeɔ anɔkwa he miishɛɛ. Mijɛ mitsuiŋ fɛɛ kɛ suɔmɔ mli mikɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ ke, ni agbɛnɛ miina akɛ omaŋ ni jwere shi nɛɛ hu miike bo nii kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ nyamɔ.

english_verse: Always make us eager to give, and help us be faithful to you, just as our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob faithfully worshiped you.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wɔtsɛmɛi Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob aNyɔŋmɔ, hã su nɛɛ ahi owebii atsuiiaŋ kɛya naanɔ, koni amɛhi shi kɛye bo anɔkwa daa.

english_verse: And give Solomon the desire to completely obey your laws and teachings, and the desire to build the temple for which I have provided these gifts.
translation_verse: Dromɔ mibi Solomon koni ekɛ etsui fɛɛ aye okitãi kɛ okpɔi kɛ owiemɔi fɛɛ anɔ koni emã Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ni misaa ehe nibii mito lɛ.”

english_verse: David then said to the people, “Now it's your turn to praise the Lord, the God your ancestors worshiped!” So everyone praised the Lord, and they bowed down to honor him and David their king. Solomon Is Crowned King

english_verse: Solomon's wife, the daughter of the king of Egypt, moved from the part of Jerusalem called David's City to her new palace that Solomon had built. The sacred chest had been kept in David's City, which made his palace sacred, and so Solomon's wife could no longer live there.
translation_verse: Solomon yakpala eŋa Ijipt maŋtsɛ biyoo lɛ kɛjɛ David Maŋ lɛ mli kɛba shĩa ni eje gbɛ ema ehã lɛ lɛ mli ejaakɛ Solomon kɛɛ akɛ, “Ebɛ akɛ miŋa lɛ hiɔ Israel Maŋtsɛ David we lɛ mli, ejaakɛ he fɛɛ he ni ato Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ lɛ he krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.”

english_verse: Solomon offered sacrifices to the Lord on the altar he had built in front of the temple porch.
translation_verse: Solomon shã shãa afɔlei ekɛhã Yehowa yɛ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ ni ema ema Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ koi lɛ hiɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: He followed the requirements that Moses had given for sacrifices offered on the Sabbath, on the first day of each month, the Festival of Thin Bread, the Harvest Festival, and the Festival of Shelters.
translation_verse: Gbi fɛɛ gbi kɛ enɔ afɔle ni ashãa bɔ ni Mose wo he kitã akɛ ashã lɛ. Solomon shã Hejɔɔmɔgbii afɔlei lɛ, kɛ nyɔji hei ashishijee afɔlei lɛ kɛ afi mli gbii juji etɛ̃ lɛ hu anɔ afɔlei lɛ, nomɛi ji Ma Akpiti Gbijurɔ lɛ kɛ Otsii Agbijurɔ lɛ kɛ Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Solomon then assigned the priests and the Levites their duties at the temple, and he followed the instructions that his father, the man of God, had given him. Some of the Levites were to lead music and help the priests in their duties, and others were to guard the temple gates
translation_verse: Solomon ye akpɔi ni etsɛ David ewo lɛ hu anɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ekɛto daa gbi sɔɔmɔ nitsumɔi lɛ ahe gbɛjianɔ ehã osɔfoi lɛ akui lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ hu ni waa osɔfoi lɛ kɛ lalai alamɔ kɛ nitsumɔi hu lɛ, Eto gbɛjianɔ hu ni Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ hebulɔi lɛ yaa kuikui daa gbi amɛyabuɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ agboi lɛ anaa bɔ ni David, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ, wo he akpɔi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
