english_verse: Let the Jewish governor and leaders rebuild it where it stood before. And stop slowing them down!
translation_verse: Nyɛŋmɛa gbɛ koni atsu Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ he nitsumɔ lɛ; nyɛkagbaa nitsumɔ lɛ naa. Nyɛhãa Yudafoi lɛ amralo lɛ kɛ amɛ onukpai lɛ amã Nyɔŋmɔ We nɛɛ yɛ emãahe lɛ.

english_verse: And don't fail to let the priests in Jerusalem have whatever they need each day so they can offer sacrifices to the God of heaven. Give them young bulls, rams, sheep, as well as wheat, salt, wine, and olive oil.
translation_verse: Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni he hiaa gbɔmɛi nɛɛ: tsinai oblahii, ojwɛnii, toi aloo toobii ni akɛshãa shãa afɔlei ahãa ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋmãa, ŋoo, wain loo mu lɛ, ahã osɔfoi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ bɔ ni amɛtaoɔ; ahã amɛ gbi fɛɛ gbi; ni akafo mli,

english_verse: I want them to be able to offer pleasing sacrifices to God and to pray for me and my family.
translation_verse: koni amɛshã afɔlei ni jeɔ ŋma amɛhã ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni amɛkpa fai koni maŋtsɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ ayi ana wala.

english_verse: If any of you don't obey this order, a wooden beam will be taken from your house and sharpened on one end. Then it will be driven through your body, and your house will be torn down and turned into a garbage dump.
translation_verse: Asaŋ miiwo akpɔ akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsake fãmɔ ni mifã nɛɛ hiɛ lɛ, ajie etsu nɔ mplaŋ ni agbɔ naa akɛtsu emli. Ahã eshĩa lɛ atsɔ̃ tumo.

english_verse: I ask the God who is worshiped in Jerusalem to destroy any king or nation who tries either to change what I have said or to tear down his temple. I, Darius, give these orders, and I expect them to be followed carefully. The Temple Is Dedicated
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni fee shĩa nɛɛ ejamɔhe lɛ abutu maŋtsɛ fɛɛ maŋtsɛ kɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ ni aaaka akɛ eeetsake fãmɔ nɛɛ hiɛ aloo akɛ eeekumɔ nɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We nɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ. Mi, Dario, miwo akpɔ nɛɛ. Aye nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.” Agbele Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ naa

english_verse: With great success the Jewish leaders continued working on the temple, while Haggai and Zechariah encouraged them by their preaching. And so, the temple was completed at the command of the God of Israel and by the orders of kings Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes of Persia.
translation_verse: Yudafoi onukpai lɛ ma Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni etee nɔ jogbaŋŋ yɛ Hagai, gbalɔ lɛ, kɛ Zakaria, Ido bi lɛ, gbalɛ lɛ hewɔ. Amɛma, ni amɛgbe naa yɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kitã lɛ kɛ Persia maŋtsɛ Koresh kɛ Dario Artashasta akpɔ lɛ naa.

english_verse: On the third day of the month of Adar in the sixth year of the rule of Darius, the temple was finished.
translation_verse: Agbe shĩa lɛ naa yɛ Maŋtsɛ Dario maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ, yɛ Adar nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned from exile were happy and celebrated as they dedicated God's temple.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ, osɔfoi kɛ Levibii lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ ye gbi ni agbeleɔ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ naa lɛ akɛ gbijurɔ. Amɛye lɛ kɛ mliflimɔ.

english_verse: One hundred bulls, two hundred rams, and four hundred lambs were offered as sacrifices at the dedication. Also twelve goats were sacrificed as sin offerings for the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Ni Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ naagbelemɔ lɛ mli lɛ amɛkɛ tsinai oha, ojwɛnii ohai enyɔ, toobii ohai ejwɛ shã afɔle; ni amɛkɛ too kpakpoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ shã shãa afɔle amɛhã Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ ayibɔ lɛ naa.

english_verse: Then the priests and Levites were assigned their duties in God's temple in Jerusalem, according to the instructions Moses had written. The Passover
translation_verse: Ni amɛto osɔfoi lɛ kɛ amɛsafokui lɛ, kɛ Levibii yɛ amɛmlijai lɛ anaa amɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ nitsumɔ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ, taakɛ bɔ ni aŋmã yɛ Mose wolo lɛ mli lɛ. Hehoo lɛ

english_verse: Everyone who had returned from exile celebrated Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mɛi ni aŋɔ amɛ nom ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛba lɛ ye Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The priests and Levites had gone through a ceremony to make themselves acceptable to lead in worship. Then some of them killed Passover lambs for those who had returned, including the other priests and themselves.
translation_verse: Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ bluublu etsɔ̃ hiɛ amɛtsuu amɛhe, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛhe etse. Amɛgbe Hehoo toobii lɛ amɛhã mɛi ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ fɛɛ kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi osɔfoi lɛ kɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe.

english_verse: The sacrifices were eaten by the Israelites who had returned and by the neighboring people who had given up the sinful customs of other nations in order to worship the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Israelbii lɛ ni jɛ nomŋɔɔ mli ba lɛ ye Hehoo toobi lɛ. Mɛi krokomɛi hu ni ye ji mɛi fɛɛ ni etse amɛhe yɛ nii ni buleɔ mɔ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wɔŋjalɔi feɔ lɛ ahe, ni amɛkɛ amɛhe ebabɔ Israelbii lɛ ahe koni amɛtao Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, sɛɛgbɛ lɛ.

english_verse: For seven days they celebrated the Festival of Thin Bread. Everyone was happy because the Lord God of Israel had made sure that the king of Assyria would be kind to them and help them build the temple.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛ nyamɔ ye Akpiti Gbijurɔ lɛ gbii kpawo; ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã amɛmli efili amɛ, akɛni ehã Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ tsui emɔ amɛ koni ewo amɛ hewalɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ We lɛ he nitsumɔ lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: Much later, when Artaxerxes was king of Persia, Ezra came to Jerusalem from Babylonia. Ezra was the son of Seraiah and the grandson of Azariah. His other ancestors were Hilkiah, Shallum, Zadok, Ahitub, Amariah, Azariah, Meraioth, Zerahiah, Uzzi, Bukki, Abishua, Phinehas, Eleazar, and Aaron, the high priest. Ezra was an expert in the Law that the Lord God of Israel had given to Moses, and the Lord made sure that the king gave Ezra everything he asked for.
translation_verse: Ezra ni jɛ Babilon ba nɛɛ, eji mlatsɔɔlɔ, ni mla ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, wo kɛtsɔ̃ Mose nɔ lɛ, ele mli jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ. Yehowa, eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, jɔɔmɔ yɛ enɔ; hewɔ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ hãa lɛ.

english_verse: Other Jews, including priests, Levites, musicians, the temple guards, and servants, came to Jerusalem with Ezra. This happened during the seventh year that Artaxerxes was king.
translation_verse: Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛ Osɔfoi kɛ Levibii kɛ lalatsɛmɛi kɛ agbonaakwɛlɔi kɛ Sɔlemɔ we sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi hu fata Ezra he kɛba.

english_verse: God helped Ezra, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month of that seventh year, after leaving Babylonia on the first day of the first month.
translation_verse: Be ni amɛyiŋ kɛjɛ Babilon ji klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ, ni nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ amɛbashɛ Yerusalɛm, yɛ Ezra Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yelikɛbuamɔ naa.

english_verse: Ezra was a priest and an expert in the laws and commands that the Lord had given to Israel. One day King Artaxerxes gave Ezra a letter which said:
translation_verse: Wolo ni Maŋtsɛ Artashasta kɛhã Ezra, osɔfo kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔ lɛ ni le Yehowa kitãi kɛ akpɔi ni ewo Israel lɛ amli jogbaŋŋ lɛ mli sane nɛ,

english_verse: Greetings from the great King Artaxerxes to Ezra the priest and expert in the teachings of the God of heaven.
translation_verse: “Artashasta, maŋtsɛmɛi amaŋtsɛ lɛ, ŋmã ehã osɔfo Ezra ni ji mlatsɔɔlɔ ni le ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla lɛ mli jogbaŋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: When you go, take the silver and gold that I and my advisors are freely giving to the God of Israel, whose temple is in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni maŋtsɛ kɛ ejinafoi lɛ eke Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni eshihilɛhe yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ yɛ tsuijurɔ naa lɛ, ŋɔɔ kɛya.

english_verse: Take the silver and gold that you collect from everywhere in Babylonia. Also take the gifts that your own people and priests have so willingly contributed for the temple of your God in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ŋɔɔ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika fɛɛ hu ni ooona yɛ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ kɛya. Asaŋ, nikeenii ni maŋbii lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ aaake yɛ tsuijurɔ naa yɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ no hu kɛya.

english_verse: Use the money carefully to buy the best bulls, rams, lambs, grain, and wine. Then sacrifice them on the altar at God's temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: “Nɛkɛ shika nɛɛ kwɛmɔ ni akɛhe tsinai, ojwɛnii, toobii kɛ amɛhe niyenii afɔlei kɛ dãa afɔle, koni okɛyashã afɔle yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni yɔɔ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: If any silver or gold is left, you and your people may use it for whatever pleases your God.
translation_verse: Jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni aaashwɛ lɛ nyɛkɛfea nɔ ni sa okɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ ahiɛ ni nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sumɔɔ.

english_verse: Give your God the other articles that have been contributed for use in his temple.
translation_verse: Asaŋ nibii ni akɛhã bo ni akɛsɔmɔ yɛ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ, tuu ohã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: If you need to get anything else for the temple, you may have the money you need from the royal treasury.
translation_verse: Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni he aaahia lolo yɛ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ hewɔ ni sa akɛ ohã lɛ, jɛɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ fotro lɛ mli ohe.

english_verse: Ezra, you are a priest and an expert in the laws of the God of heaven, and I order all treasurers in Western Province to do their very best to help you.
translation_verse: “Mi, Maŋtsɛ Artashasta, miiwo jwetritolɔi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ faa lɛ anaigbɛ biɛgbɛ lɛ akpɔ akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni osɔfo Ezra, mlatsɔɔlɔ ni le ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla lɛ mli jogbaŋŋ lɛ, aaabi nyɛ lɛ, aye oyai ni afee,

english_verse: tons of silver,
translation_verse: Zerahia kɛ Uzi kɛ Buki kɛ

english_verse: They must provide whatever the God of heaven demands for his temple, so that he won't be angry with me and with the kings who rule after me.
translation_verse: Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ŋwɛi maŋtsɛ lɛ ewo he akpɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa ni afea fɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ yɛ ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ We lɛ he koni emli akafu maŋtsɛ kɛ ebii ni baaye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: We want you to know that no priests, Levites, musicians, guards, temple servants, or any other temple workers will have to pay any kind of taxes.
translation_verse: Asaŋ wɔmiihã nyɛna nyɛle akɛ osɔfoi kɛ Levibii kɛ lalɔi kɛ agbonaakwɛlɔi kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli sɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ tsuji ni yɔɔ nɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We nɛɛŋ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ hegbɛ akɛ etsuɔ amɛ onia loo too loo gbɛjee shika ko.

english_verse: Ezra, use the wisdom God has given you and choose officials and leaders to govern the people of Western Province. These leaders should know God's laws and have them taught to anyone who doesn't know them.
translation_verse: “Ni bo, Ezra hu, yɛ nilee ni oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ehã bo lɛ naa lɛ, fãamɔ mɛi ni kwɛɔ sane amɛyeɔ kɛ kojolɔi fɛɛ ni le oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla lɛ koni amɛkojo mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ biɛgbɛ lɛ ateŋ saji. Mɛi ni leee lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃a amɛ ni amɛle.

english_verse: Everyone who fails to obey God's Law or the king's law will be punished without pity. They will either be executed or put in prison or forced to leave their country, or have all they own taken away. Ezra Praises God
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeee oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ mla lɛ nɔ lɛ, akojo lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ koni toigbalamɔ ni sa lɛ akɛhã lɛ. Gbele jio, naneshitutswaa jio, nii anaatsii jio, tsuŋwoo jio.” Ezra jie Nyɔŋmɔ yi

english_verse: Because King Artaxerxes was so kind, Ezra said: Praise the Lord God of our ancestors! He made sure that the king honored the Lord's temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Ezra kɛɛ, “Ajie Yehowa, wɔtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi akɛ ekɛ nɛkɛ nɔ ko wo maŋtsɛ lɛ yiŋ akɛ ewula Yehowa we ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: God has told the king, his advisors, and his powerful officials to treat me with kindness. The Lord God has helped me, and I have been able to bring many Jewish leaders back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yɛ mɔbɔ ni lɛ Yehowa ena mi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mina hiɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ ejinafoi lɛ kɛ elumɛi agboi lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ. Hewalɛ ni ewo mi hewɔ lɛ mina ekãa mikɛbua Israelbii lɛ ateŋ onukpai lɛ anaa koni amɛkɛ mi afã kɛba.”

english_verse: Artaxerxes was king of Persia when I led the following chiefs of the family groups from Babylonia to Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Mɛi ni kɛ mi, Ezra, fã kɛjɛ Babilon, be mli ni Artashasta yeɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ atsɛmɛi awei lɛ onukpai nɛ:

english_verse: Gershom of the Phinehas family; Daniel of the Ithamar family; Hattush son of Shecaniah of the David family; Zechariah and
translation_verse: Bigewai we lɛ, Utai kɛ Zakur; ni hii nyɔŋmai kpawo shi amɛnɔ. Ezra tao Levibii hã Sɔlemɔ We lɛ nitsumɔ

english_verse: I said to the priests: You belong to the Lord, the God of your ancestors, and these things also belong to him. The silver and gold were willingly given as gifts to the Lord.
translation_verse: Mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhe tse krɔŋkrɔŋ nyɛhã Yehowa, ni nibii lɛ hu he tse krɔŋkrɔŋ. Jwiɛtɛi lɛ kɛ shika lɛ tsuijurɔ naa akɛhã Yehowa, wɔtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I brought everyone together by the river that flows to the town of Ahava where we camped for three days. Not one Levite could be found among the people and priests.
translation_verse: Mibua amɛnaa kɛtee faa ko ni hoɔ kɛyaa Ahawa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ toi. Wɔhi jɛi gbii etɛ̃. Be ni mikpa maŋbii lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ lɛ minaaa Levinyo ko yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: So I sent for the leaders Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam. I also sent for Joiarib and Elnathan, who were very wise counselors.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mitsu ayatsɛ Eliezer kɛ Ariel kɛ Shemaia kɛ Elnatan kɛ Yarib Elnatan kɛ Natan kɛ Zakaria kɛ Meshulam ni ji hiɛnaanɔbii, kɛ Yoiarib kɛ Elnatan ni ji tsɔɔlɔi hu lɛ kɛba.

english_verse: Then I sent them to Iddo, the leader at Casiphia, and I told them to ask him and his temple workers to send people to serve in God's temple.
translation_verse: Mitsu amɛ Ido, Kasifia maŋ lɛ mli onukpa lɛ ŋɔɔ. Mihã amɛ wiemɔ ni amɛkɛyahã Ido kɛ enanemɛi Sɔlemɔ We sɔ̃ɔlɔi ni yɔɔ Kasifia maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, koni amɛwo mɛi agbɛ kɛba Kasifia maŋ lɛ mli ni amɛbasɔmɔ yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ.

english_verse: God was kind to us and caused them to send a skillful man named Sherebiah, who was a Levite from the family of Mahli. Eighteen of his relatives came with him.
translation_verse: WɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ dromɔ naa lɛ, amɛkɛ Sherebia, nuu ko ni hiɛ kã shi ni jɛ Maheli ni ji Levi bi kɛ Israel nabi lɛ tsɛmɛiawebii lɛ ateŋ, kɛ ebii kɛ enyɛmimɛi ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛfeɔ gbɔmɛi nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ bahã wɔ.

english_verse: We were also sent Hashabiah and Jeshaiah from the family of Merari along with
translation_verse: Amɛkɛ Hashabia kɛ Yeshaia ni jɛ Meraribii lɛ ateŋ kɛ mɛi nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni ji enyɛmimɛi kɛ ebii hu bahã wɔ.

english_verse: Beside the Ahava River, I asked the people to go without eating and to pray. We humbled ourselves and asked God to bring us and our children safely to Jerusalem with all of our possessions.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mishiɛ yɛ jɛi akɛ ahi ŋmãa yɛ Ahawa Faa lɛ naa, koni wɔba wɔhe shi wɔhã wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni wɔkpa lɛ fai koni ehã wɔ kɛ wɔbii kɛ wɔnabii fɛɛ afee shweshweeshwe yɛ wɔgbɛfãa lɛ mli.

english_verse: So we went without food and asked God himself to protect us, and he answered our prayers. The Gifts for the Temple
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, wɔhi ŋmãa, ni wɔkpa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ fai yɛ enɛ hewɔ, ni efee nɔ ni wɔbi lɛ lɛ ehã wɔ. Nibii ni ake yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hewɔ

english_verse: I chose twelve of the leading priests—Sherebiah, Hashabiah and ten of their relatives.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mifamɔ osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ onukpai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ: Sherebia kɛ Hashabia kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋma.

english_verse: Then I weighed the gifts that had been given for God's temple, and I divided them among the twelve priests I had chosen. There were gifts of silver and gold, as well as the articles that the king, his advisors and officials, and the people of Israel had contributed. In all there were:
translation_verse: Nɔ ni miŋmɛ miwo amɛdɛŋ lɛ nɛ: Jwiɛtɛi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ; jwiɛtɛi tsɛnsii ni tsiimɔ ji talentai oha kɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai oha; shika kpuji nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni tsiimɔ ji dalei akpe kome, tsɛnsii enyɔ ni akɛ akɔɔble kaŋkaŋ ni jara wa tamɔ shika fee.

english_verse: Be sure to guard them and keep them safe until you reach Jerusalem. Then weigh them inside God's temple in the presence of the chief priests, the Levites, and the heads of the Israelite families.
translation_verse: Nyɛbua he ni nyɛkɛtoa kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaaŋmɛ yɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ onukpai lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ ahiɛ, yɛ Yehowa we lɛ piai lɛ amli.”

english_verse: The priests and Levites then took charge of the gifts that had been weighed, so they could take them to the temple of our God in Jerusalem. The Return to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ loo jwiɛtɛi lɛ kɛ shika lɛ kɛ nibii ni aŋmɛ lɛ koni amɛkɛya wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm. Wɔku wɔsɛɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm

english_verse: On the twelfth day of the first month, we left the Ahava River and started for Jerusalem. Our God watched over us, and as we traveled along, he kept our enemies from ambushing us.
translation_verse: Klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, wɔfã yɛ Ahawa Faa lɛ naa kɛmiiya Yerusalɛm. WɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ bu wɔhe, ni ejie wɔ yɛ henyɛlɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi abɔ ni yawo wɔ ka yɛ gbɛteŋ lɛ hu adɛŋ.

english_verse: After arriving in Jerusalem, we rested for three days.
translation_verse: Wɔshɛ Yerusalɛm, ni wɔye gbii etɛ̃ yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: Then on the fourth day we went to God's temple, where the silver, the gold, and the other things were weighed and given to the priest Meremoth son of Uriah. With him were Eleazar son of Phinehas and the two Levites, Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui.
translation_verse: Gbi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aŋmɛ jwiɛtɛi lɛ kɛ shika lɛ kɛ nibii lɛ yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ, ni atu awo Meremot, Uria bi ni ji osɔfo lɛ, kɛ Eleazar, Finehas bi ni fata ehe lɛ adɛŋ. Mɛi ni fata amɛhe ji Levibii enyɔ ni ji Yozabad, Yeshua bi lɛ, kɛ Noadia, Binui bi lɛ.

english_verse: Those who had returned from exile offered sacrifices on the altar to the God of Israel. Twelve bulls were offered for all Israel. Ninety-six rams and
translation_verse: Mɛi ni ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba lɛ bashã shãa afɔlei amɛhã Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ: tsinahii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ha Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ ojwɛnii nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ ekpaa, kɛ toobii nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ kpawo, kɛ esha he afɔle tookpakpoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ. Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ akɛshã shãa afɔle ahã Yehowa.

english_verse: goats were sacrificed for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Azgad we lɛ, Yohanan, Hakatan bi lɛ; ni hii oha kɛ nyɔŋma shi enɔ.

english_verse: Some of those who had returned took the king's orders to the governors and officials in Western Province. Then the officials did what they could for the people and for the temple of God.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ mlai lɛ hã amraloi lɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ ni yɔɔ Eufrate lɛ anaigbɛ biɛgbɛ lɛ, ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ye amɛbua maŋ lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ.

english_verse: Later the Jewish leaders came to me and said: Many Israelites, including priests and Levites, are living just like the people around them. They are even guilty of some of the horrible sins of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
translation_verse: Enɛɛmɛi asɛɛ lɛ, onukpai lɛ ba miŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ mi akɛ, Israel maŋbii lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ tseko amɛhe yɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ bii lɛ ahe, yɛ nii ni amɛfeɔ ni Yudafoi hiɔ lɛ agbɛfaŋ. Nii nɛɛ ji nii ni Kanaanbii kɛ Hitbii kɛ Perizbii kɛ Yebusbii kɛ Amonbii kɛ Moabbii kɛ Ijiptbii kɛ Amorbii lɛ feɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Some Israelite men have married foreign women and have let their sons do the same thing. Our own officials and leaders were the first to commit this disgusting sin, and now God's holy people are mixed with foreigners.
translation_verse: Yudahii eŋɔŋɔɔ maŋsɛɛ yei amɛhã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe akɛ ŋamɛi, ni amɛbihii hu efee nakai nɔŋŋ. Belɛ jaku ni he tse lɛ ebule amɛhe. Onukpai lɛ kɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ titri tɔ̃ɔ mla nɛɛ.

english_verse: This news made me so angry that I ripped my clothes and tore hair from my head and beard. Then I just sat in shock
translation_verse: Be ni minu nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ, migbala mihe atade kɛ mihebo, ni mifãmɔ miyiteŋ tsɔi kɛ mitsɛŋ; ni mihe jɔ̃ mihe kɛta shi.

english_verse: until the time for the evening sacrifice. Many of our people were greatly concerned and gathered around me, because the God of Israel had warned us to stay away from foreigners. Ezra's Prayer
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mɛi fɛɛ ni gbeyei emɔmɔ amɛ yɛ wiemɔi ni Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ wie yɛ mɛi ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ mla ni amɛtɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ babua amɛhe naa yɛ miŋɔɔ. Shi mi lɛ, mihe jɔ̃ mihe kɛta shi aahu kɛyashi gbɛkɛ afɔleshãa be lɛ mli.

english_verse: At the time of the evening sacrifice, I was still sitting there in sorrow with my clothes all torn. So I got down on my knees, then lifted my arms,
translation_verse: Be ni gbɛkɛ afɔleshãa be lɛ shɛ lɛ, mite shi kɛ ŋkɔmɔ ni miyeɔ lɛ kɛ mihe atade kɛ mihebo ni etserɛ lɛ, ni miho mikula minakutsei anaa. Migbɛ minijiaŋ mitsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ,

english_verse: and prayed: I am much too ashamed to face you, Lord God. Our sins and our guilt have swept over us like a flood that reaches up to the heavens.
translation_verse: ni mikɛɛ “Ao, miNyɔŋmɔ, mihiɛ egbo, ni eefee mi hiɛgbele akɛ mawo mihiɛ nɔ makwɛ ohiɛ, miNyɔŋmɔ; ejaakɛ wɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ esu wɔ, ni wɔfɔ ni wɔye lɛ da ni ekwɔ tamɔ ŋwɛi.

english_verse: Since the time of our ancestors, all of us have sinned. That's why we, our kings, and our priests have often been defeated by other kings. They have killed some of us and made slaves of others; they have taken our possessions and made us ashamed, just as we are today.
translation_verse: Fɔbuu kã wɔnɔ kɛjɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ayinɔ aahu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ. Wɔnishaianii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ ohã shikpɔji lɛ anɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ anine eshɛ wɔ kɛ wɔmaŋtsɛmɛi kɛ wɔsɔfoi lɛ anɔ. Akɛ klante ekpãtã wɔhiɛ, aŋɔ wɔ nom, wɔnibii ni wɔyɔɔ lɛ aha, ni ashwie wɔhiɛ shi tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ.

english_verse: But for now, Lord God, you have shown great kindness to us. You made us truly happy by letting some of us settle in this sacred place and by helping us in our time of slavery.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, oduro wɔ be kukuoo ko. Ohã wɔteŋ mɛi komɛi eye amɛhe kɛjɛ nyɔŋyeli mli, ni ohã wɔ he ko yɛ ohe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni wɔfee shweshweeshwe yɛ jɛi; koni wɔhiŋmɛii agbele, ni wɔyi ana wala be mli ni wɔyɔɔ nyɔŋyeli mli lɛ.

english_verse: We are slaves, but you have never turned your back on us. You love us, and because of you, the kings of Persia have helped us. It's as though you have given us new life! You let us rebuild your temple and live safely in Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɔji ji wɔ; shimɔ kɛkɛ oshiko wɔ yɛ wɔnyɔŋyeli lɛ mli; shi moŋ ohã Persia maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ena wɔ mɔbɔ, ni ohã wɔyi ena wala koni wɔma oshĩa lɛ ni wɔsaa emli tsukoi lɛ. Okɛ ohewalɛ lɛ efo afabaŋ ewo wɔhe yɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛm, koni wɔfee shweshweeshwe.”

english_verse: Our God, what can we say now? Even after all this, we have disobeyed the commands
translation_verse: “No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, mɛni wɔɔɔkɛɛ yɛ enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ? Wɔyeee okitãi lɛ ni otsɔ̃ otsuji, gbalɔi lɛ, anine nɔ owo lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: that were given to us by your servants the prophets. They said the land you are giving us is full of sinful and wicked people, who never stop doing disgusting things.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɛ wɔ akɛ shikpɔŋ ni wɔyaa ni wɔyaŋɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ ni enɔ bii lɛ kɛ amɛnifeemɔnii ni ahiɔ lɛ ebule lɛ. Amɛkɛ amɛnihiinii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ ehã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi obɔ̃ kɛ muji yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ he fɛɛ he.

english_verse: And we were warned not to let our daughters and sons marry their sons and daughters. Your prophets also told us never to help those foreigners or even let them live in peace. You wanted us to become strong and to enjoy the good things in the land, then someday to leave it to our children forever.
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, ogbalɔi lɛ kɛɛ wɔ akɛ wɔkɛ wɔbiyei akahã shikpɔji lɛ anɔ bii agbãla; ni asaŋ, wɔkaŋɔ amɛbiyei wɔhã wɔbihii. Gbalɔi lɛ kɛɛ wɔ akɛ wɔkatao hejɔlɛ loo shweremɔ wɔhã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ gbi ko gbi ko. Amɛkɛɛ wɔfee nakai bɔ ni afee ni wɔhe awa ni wɔye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nii kpakpai lɛ ni wɔshi wɔhã wɔbii akɛ gboshinii kɛya naanɔ.

english_verse: You punished us because of our terrible sins. But you did not punish us nearly as much as we deserve, and you have brought some of us back home.
translation_verse: Nii ni ba wɔnɔ akɛ toigbalamɔ yɛ wɔnishaianii kɛ wɔfɔ kpeteŋkple ni wɔye lɛ hewɔ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, bo wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, owoko wɔ nyɔmɔ bɔ ni sa wɔnifɔ̃jianii lɛ, ni ohã wɔhiɛ kã.

english_verse: Why should we disobey your commands again by letting our sons and daughters marry these foreigners who do such disgusting things? That would make you angry enough to destroy us all!
translation_verse: Aso wɔɔku okitãi lɛ amli ekoŋŋ, ni wɔkɛ wɔhe ayabɔ maji ni feɔ nihiinii nɛɛ ahe ni wɔkɛ amɛ aye yooŋɔɔ lo? Aso omli fuŋ wɔ kɛyashiŋ beyinɔ ni oookpãtã wɔhiɛ ogbe naa bɔ ni eshwɛŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko aloo mɔ ko mɔ ko hu ejeŋ mli lo?

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you have been more than fair by letting a few of us survive. But once again, our sins have made us ashamed to face you.
translation_verse: Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, jalɔ ji bo; ejaakɛ ashi wɔ akɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ ni eje hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ mli tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ. Naa, wɔyɛ ohiɛ akɛ mɛi ni eye fɔ. Ejaakɛ wɔfɔ ni wɔye lɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ ohiɛ adamɔ.”

english_verse: While Ezra was down on his knees in front of God's temple, praying with tears in his eyes and confessing the sins of the people of Israel, a large number of men, women, and children gathered around him and cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Shi be mli ni Ezra sɔleɔ ekpaa fai ni ekɛ ehe tswiaa shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ hiɛ, ni ejajeɔ eshai ni Israel efee lɛ, Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ, hii kɛ yei kɛ gbekɛbii, babua amɛhe naa kɛbɔle lɛ. Amɛmiifo blobloblo.

english_verse: Shecaniah son of Jehiel from the family of Elam said: Ezra, we have disobeyed God by marrying these foreign women. But there is still hope for the people of Israel,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Shekania, Yehiel bi lɛ ni jɛ Elam tsɛmɛiawebii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, kɛ Ezra wie ekɛɛ, “Wɔtɔ̃ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ akɛ wɔyaŋɔ maŋsɛɛ yei yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ateŋ; shi kɛ̃lɛ amrɔ nɛɛ tete hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ hã Israel yɛ enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ.

english_verse: if we follow your advice and the advice of others who truly respect the laws of God. We must promise God that we will divorce our foreign wives and send them away, together with their children.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛhãa wɔkɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ akpãŋa, koni wɔshwie yei lɛ kɛ bii lɛ hu yɛ minuŋtsɔ kɛ mɛi ni sheɔ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kitã lɛ gbeyei lɛ aŋaawoo naa, koni wɔye mla lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Ezra, it's up to you to do something! We will support whatever you do. So be brave!
translation_verse: Kwɛmɔ ni ofee, ejaakɛ bo osane ni. Wɔfĩ osɛɛ; feemɔ ekãa ni otsu he nii.”

english_verse: Ezra stood up and made the chief priests, the Levites, and everyone else in Israel swear that they would follow the advice of Shecaniah.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Ezra te shi, ni ebi osɔfoi kɛ Levibii lɛ nukpai lɛ kɛ Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ koni amɛkãmɔ kitã akɛ amɛbaafee bɔ ni akɛɛ lɛ ni amɛkãmɔ kitã lɛ.

english_verse: Then Ezra left God's temple and went to spend the night in the living quarters of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. He felt sorry because of what the people had done, and he did not eat or drink a thing.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Ezra te shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ hiɛ, ni eyiŋ etee Yehohanan, ni ji Eliashib bi lɛ, sɛɛtsu lɛ mli. Ehi jɛi ni eyeee nii lɛ, asaŋ enuuu nu hu, ejaakɛ eeye ŋkɔmɔ yɛ mla ni mɛi ni jɛ nomŋɔɔ mli ba lɛ etɔ̃ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: The officials and leaders sent a message to all who had returned from Babylonia and were now living in Jerusalem and Judah. This message told them to meet in Jerusalem within three days, or else they would lose everything they owned and would no longer be considered part of the people that had returned from Babylonia.
translation_verse: Akɛɛ kɛshi nɔ akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baaa kɛyashi gbii etɛ̃, tamɔ bɔ ni lumɛi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ efã akɛ aba lɛ, aaajɔɔ enii anɔ ake, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu aaajie lɛ yɛ mɛi ni jɛ nomŋɔɔ mli ba lɛ ateŋ.

english_verse: Three days later, on the twentieth day of the ninth month, everyone from Judah and Benjamin came to Jerusalem and sat in the temple courtyard. It was a serious meeting, and they sat there, trembling in the rain.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yuda kɛ Benyaminhii lɛ babua amɛhe naa kɛkpe yɛ Yerusalɛm yɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ mli, yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ nɔ. Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ baho tara he ko kpataa ko ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ hiɛ lɛ. Gbeyei emɔmɔ amɛ yɛ sane nɛɛ he, ni asaŋ nu ni nɛɔ waa lɛ ehã amɛmiikpokpo.

english_verse: Ezra the priest stood up and said: You have broken God's Law by marrying foreign women, and you have made the whole nation guilty!
translation_verse: Osɔfo Ezra te shi damɔ shi, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtɔ̃, ejaakɛ nyɛyaŋɔ maŋsɛɛ yei, ni nyɛkɛhã Israel fɔ ni eye lɛ eda.

english_verse: Now you must confess your sins to the Lord God of your ancestors and obey him. Divorce your foreign wives and don't have anything to do with the rest of the foreigners who live around here.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛjajea nyɛtsɔ̃a Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ; nyɛfea esuɔmɔnaanii, ni nyɛtsea nyɛhe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ kɛ maŋsɛɛ yei lɛ ahe.”

english_verse: Everyone in the crowd shouted: You're right! We will do what you say.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ here nɔ waa amɛkɛɛ, “Nakai ni; esa akɛ wɔfee bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: But there are so many of us, and we can't just stay out here in this downpour. A lot of us have sinned by marrying foreign women, and the matter can't be settled in only a day or two.
translation_verse: Shi wɔyi fa babaoo naakpa yɛ biɛ, ni nunɛmɔ be nɛ. Wɔnyɛŋ blohu nɛɛŋ wɔdamɔ, be mli ni nitsumɔ lɛ ejeee gbi kome loo gbii enyɔ tete nitsumɔ, ejaakɛ wɔfee efɔŋ waa yɛ nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ mli.

english_verse: Why can't our officials stay on in Jerusalem and take care of this for us? Let everyone who has sinned in this way meet here at a certain time with leaders and judges from their own towns. If we take care of this problem, God will surely stop being so terribly angry with us.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, hã wɔlumɛi lɛ aye asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ najiaŋ ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ wɔmaji lɛ amli ni amɛŋɔ maŋsɛɛ yei lɛ aba yɛ be ni ato mli. Maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli onukpai kɛ emli kojolɔi afata amɛhe kɛba, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mlifu ni naa wa ni kã wɔnɔ lɛ aaaje wɔnɔ.”

english_verse: Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah were the only ones who objected, except for the two Levites, Meshullam and Shabbethai.
translation_verse: Mɛi pɛ ni te shi shi nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ ji Yonatan, Asahel bi lɛ, kɛ Yahezeia, Tikwa bi lɛ; ni Meshulam kɛ Shabetai, Levinyo lɛ, fĩ amɛsɛɛ.

english_verse: Everyone else who had returned from exile agreed with the plan. So Ezra the priest chose men who were heads of the families, and he listed their names. They started looking into the matter on the first day of the tenth month,
translation_verse: Mɛi ni jɛ nomŋɔɔ mli ba lɛ fee tamɔ bɔ ni ato gbɛjianɔ lɛ. Afãmɔ osɔfo Ezra kɛ tsɛmɛi awei lɛ onukpai lɛ ekomɛi yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa, ni atsi amɛ fɛɛ amɛgbɛii atã. Nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛyatara shi koni amɛtao sane lɛ mli.

english_verse: and they did not finish until the first day of the first month of the next year. The Men Who Had Foreign Wives
translation_verse: Be ni shɛɔ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ hii fɛɛ ni eŋɔ maŋsɛɛ yei lɛ egbe naa. Hii ni ŋɔ maŋsɛɛ yei lɛ agbɛii

english_verse: Hanani and Zebadiah from the family of Immer;
translation_verse: Imer tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ mɛi ni hiɛ maŋsɛɛ yei ji Hanani kɛ Zebadia.

english_verse: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah from the family of Harim;
translation_verse: Harim tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Maaseia kɛ Elia kɛ Shemaia kɛ Yehiel kɛ Uzia.

english_verse: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah from the family of Pashhur.
translation_verse: Pashur tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Elioenai kɛ Maaseia kɛ Ishmael kɛ Netanel kɛ Yozabad kɛ Elasa.

english_verse: Those Levites who had foreign wives were: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah , Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
translation_verse: Levibii ateŋ lɛ, Yozabad kɛ Shimei kɛ Kelaia ni atsɛɔ lɛ akɛ Kelita hu lɛ, kɛ Petania kɛ Yuda kɛ Eliezer.

english_verse: Eliashib, the musician, had a foreign wife. These temple guards had foreign wives: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
translation_verse: Lalatsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Eliashib. Agbonaakwɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Shalum kɛ Telem kɛ Uri.

english_verse: Here is a list of the others from Israel who had foreign wives: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah, and Benaiah from the family of Parosh;
translation_verse: Parosh tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Ramia kɛ Izia kɛ Malkia kɛ Miyamin kɛ Eleazar kɛ Malkia kɛ Benaia.

english_verse: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah from the family of Elam;
translation_verse: Elam tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Matania kɛ Zakaria kɛ Yehiel kɛ Abdi kɛ Yeremot kɛ Elia.

english_verse: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza from the family of Zattu;
translation_verse: Zatu tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Elivenai kɛ Eliashib kɛ Matania kɛ Yeremot kɛ Zabad kɛ Aziza.

english_verse: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai from the family of Bebai;
translation_verse: Bebai tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Yehohanan kɛ Hanania kɛ Zabai kɛ Atlai.

english_verse: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth from the family of Bani;
translation_verse: Bani tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Meshulam kɛ Maluk kɛ Adaia kɛ Yashub kɛ Sheal kɛ Yeremot.

english_verse: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh from the family of Pahath Moab;
translation_verse: Pahat-Moab tsɛmɛi awe lɛ abii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Adna kɛ Kelal kɛ Benaia kɛ Maaseia kɛ Matania kɛ Bezaleel kɛ Binui kɛ Manase.

english_verse: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei from the family of Hashum;
translation_verse: Hashum tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Matenai kɛ Matata kɛ Zabad kɛ Elifelet kɛ Yeremai kɛ Manase kɛ Shimei.

english_verse: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah from the family of Nebo.
translation_verse: Nebo tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ: Yeiel kɛ Matitia kɛ Zabad kɛ Zebina kɛ Yadau kɛ Yoel kɛ Benaia.

english_verse: These men divorced their foreign wives, then sent them and their children away.
translation_verse: Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ eŋɔ maŋsɛɛ yei; hewɔ lɛ amɛ shwie yei lɛ kɛ amɛbii lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: I am Nehemiah son of Hacaliah, and in this book I tell what I have done. During the month of Chislev in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes ruled Persia, I was in his fortress city of Susa,
translation_verse: Nehemia, Hakalia bi lɛ, saji nɛ. Yɛ Kislev nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, miyɛ Susa, maŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ mli,

english_verse: when my brother Hanani came with some men from Judah. So I asked them about the Jews who had escaped from being captives in Babylonia. I also asked them about the city of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: ni Hanani ni ji minyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ kɛ hii komɛi jɛ Yuda ba. Mibi amɛ Yudafoi ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni hiɛ kã lolo lɛ ahe sane kɛ Yerusalɛm hu he sane.

english_verse: They told me, “Those captives who have come back are having all kinds of troubles. They are terribly disgraced, Jerusalem's walls are broken down, and its gates have been burned.”
translation_verse: Amɛto he akɛ, “Mɛi ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni hiɛ kã lolo ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ miina amanehulu kpele, ni amɛhiɛ eshwie shi. Yerusalɛm gbogbo lɛ akumɔ ashwie shi, ni enaa agboi lɛ ashã.

english_verse: When I heard this, I sat down on the ground and cried. Then for several days, I mourned; I went without eating to show my sorrow, and I prayed:
translation_verse: Be ni minu wiemɔ nɛɛ miho mita shi, ni mifo. “Miye ŋkɔmɔ gbii abɔ, ni mihi ŋmãa. Misɔle mikpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai,

english_verse: Lord God of heaven, you are great and fearsome. And you faithfully keep your promises to everyone who loves you and obeys your commands.
translation_verse: ni mikɛɛ, ‘Oo Yehowa, Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi, ni oda ni ohe yɔɔ gbeyei! Okɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee yeɔ kpãŋmɔ ni okɛ mɛi ni sumɔɔ bo, ni amɛyeɔ okitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ kpãŋɔ lɛ nɔ, ni okɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ anɔkwafo ji bo.

english_verse: I am your servant, so please have mercy on me and answer the prayer that I make day and night for these people of Israel who serve you. I, my family, and the rest of your people have sinned
translation_verse: Kwɛmɔ, ni oka otoi ohã fai ni mi, otsulɔ, mikpaa bo nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane mihãa otsuji Israelbii lɛ. Miijaje akɛ wɔ, Israelbii, wɔfee esha wɔshi bo; ni mi kɛ mitsɛwe lɛ fɛɛ yeɔ fɔ yɛ enɛ mli.

english_verse: by choosing to disobey you and the laws and teachings you gave to your servant Moses.
translation_verse: Wɔfee efɔŋ ni naa wa naakpa wɔshi bo, ejaakɛ wɔyeko kitãi kɛ akpɔi kɛ mlai ni owo kɛtsɔ̃ otsulɔ Mose nɔ lɛ anɔ.’

english_verse: Please remember the promise you made to Moses. You told him that if we were unfaithful, you would scatter us among foreign nations.
translation_verse: Kaimɔ wiemɔ ni okɛ otsulɔ Mose wie akɛ, ‘Kɛji nyɛyeee mi anɔkwa lɛ, magbɛ nyɛ mashwã maji anɔ,

english_verse: But you also said that no matter how far away we were, we could turn to you and start obeying your laws. Then you would bring us back to the place where you have chosen to be worshiped.
translation_verse: shi kɛji nyɛkpale kɛba miŋɔɔ, ni nyɛye mikitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ, kɛji mɛi ni agbɛ ashwã lɛ yaje jeŋ naagbeehe tete lɛ, mabua amɛnaa kɛaajɛ jɛi tɔ̃ɔ, ni makpala amɛ kɛaaba he ni mito ni aja mi yɛ lɛ.’

english_verse: Our Lord, I am praying for your servants—those you rescued by your great strength and mighty power.
translation_verse: “Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji otsuji kɛ omaŋ ni okɛ ohewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ kɛ nyɛmɔ ekpɔ̃ lɛ.

english_verse: Please answer my prayer and the prayer of your other servants who gladly honor your name. When I serve the king his wine today, make him pleased with me and let him do what I ask.
translation_verse: Oo Nuŋtsɔ, ka otoi ohã fai ni otsulɔ kpaa bo lɛ. Ka toi ohã fai ni otsuji ni sumɔɔ akɛ amɛshe bo gbeyei lɛ kpaa bo lɛ. Hã otsulɔ aye omanye ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, ni hã maŋtsɛ lɛ ana mi mɔbɔ.” Nɛkɛ bei nɛɛ amli lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ dãawolɔ ji mi.

english_verse: During the month of Nisan in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was king, I served him his wine, as I had done before. But this was the first time I had ever looked depressed.
translation_verse: Gbi ko yɛ Nisan nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Maŋtsɛ Artashasta yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ miiye nii, ni wain ma ehiɛ. Miwo wain lɛ, ni mikɛhã lɛ. Enako mi ni mifee mɔbɔmɔbɔ yɛ ehiɛ pɛŋ.

english_verse: So the king said, “Why do you look so sad? You're not sick. Something must be bothering you.” Even though I was frightened,
translation_verse: Ebi mi akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ni ohiɛ efee mɔbɔmɔbɔ nɛkɛ nɛɛ, ni jeee akɛ ohe hu ni yeɔ lɛ? Jeee nɔ ko nɔ ko ni fe akɛ ooye awerɛhoo yɛ otsui mli.” Mihɛle shi amrɔ nɛkɛ,

english_verse: I answered, “Your Majesty, I hope you live forever! I feel sad because the city where my ancestors are buried is in ruins, and its gates have been burned down.”
translation_verse: ni mikɛɛ, “Maŋtsɛ yi ana wala kɛya naanɔ! Nii, mɛɛba ni esaaa akɛ mihiɛ afee mɔbɔmɔbɔ be ni maŋ ni ji he ni mitsɛmɛi asaŋi yɔɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni ashã ehe agboi lɛ?”

english_verse: The king asked, “What do you want me to do?” I prayed to the God who rules from heaven.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ bi mi akɛ, “Mɛni ji nɔ ni otaoɔ?” No hewɔ lɛ, misɔle mikpa ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ fai,

english_verse: Then I told the king, “Sir, if it's all right with you, please send me back to Judah, so that I can rebuild the city where my ancestors are buried.”
translation_verse: ni mikɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji esa maŋtsɛ hiɛ, ni kɛji otsulɔ hiɛ eba nyam yɛ ohiɛ lɛ, no lɛ hã maya Yuda yɛ maŋ ni afu mitsɛmɛi yɛ mli lɛ mli, koni mayasaa mama maŋ lɛ ekoŋŋ.”

english_verse: The queen was sitting beside the king when he asked me, “How long will it take, and when will you be back?” The king agreed to let me go, and I told him when I would return.
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ, Maŋnyɛ lɛ ta maŋtsɛ lɛ masɛi, ni maŋtsɛ lɛ bi mi akɛ, “Gbii enyiɛ oyaaye, ni mɛɛbe oooku osɛɛ oba ekoŋŋ?” Esa maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ akɛ eŋmɛ mi gbɛ ni maya; ni mito lɛ be.

english_verse: Then I asked, “Your Majesty, would you be willing to give me letters to the governors of the provinces west of the Euphrates River, so that I can travel safely to Judah?
translation_verse: Asaŋ mikɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ kɛji eesumɔ lɛ, no lɛ ehã mi woji ni mikɛyahã amralofoi ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ lɛ, koni amɛŋmɛ mi gbɛ ni mafo mli kɛya Yuda.

english_verse: I will need timber to rebuild the gates of the fortress near the temple and more timber to construct the city wall and to build a place for me to live. And so, I would appreciate a letter to Asaph, who is in charge of the royal forest.” God was good to me, and the king did everything I asked.
translation_verse: Asaŋ mibi wolo ko hu ni mikɛyahã Asaf, mɔ ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ koo lɛ nɔ lɛ, koni ehã mi tsumaa tsei. Tsei nɛɛ mikɛbaakpɛ mɔɔ agboi mawo Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he, kɛ maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ kɛ shĩa ni miyahi mli lɛ he. Akɛni miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ mi yɛ hewɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ fee nɔ ni mitaoɔ lɛ fɛɛ ehã mi.

english_verse: The king sent some army officers and cavalry troops along with me, and as I traveled through the Western Provinces, I gave the letters to the governors.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ lɛ famɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi eto mihe. Miyashɛ amralofoi ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ lɛ aŋɔɔ; ni mikɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ woji lɛ hã amɛ.

english_verse: But when Sanballat from Horon and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about what had happened, they became very angry, because they didn't want anyone to help the people of Israel. Nehemiah Inspects the Wall of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Shi be ni Sanbalat, Horonnyo lɛ, kɛ Tobia, Amonnyo ni ji nyɔŋ lɛ nu lɛ, edɔ amɛ naakpa akɛ nuu ko eba ni ebatao Israelbii lɛ ejurɔyeli.

english_verse: Three days after arriving in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Mibashɛ Yerusalɛm, ni miye gbii etɛ̃ yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: I got up during the night and left my house. I took some men with me, without telling anyone what I thought God wanted me to do for the city. The only animal I took was the donkey I rode on.
translation_verse: Ni mite shi nyɔɔŋ, mi kɛ hii fioo ko ni fata mihe lɛ. Shi migbako mɔ ko mɔ ko nɔ ni miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛwo mitsui mli akɛ miyafee mihã Yerusalɛm lɛ. Asaŋ mihiɛɛɛ kooloo ko kooloo ko hu akɛ ja kooloo ni mita nɔ lɛ pɛ kɛkɛ.

english_verse: I went through Valley Gate on the west, then south past Dragon Spring, before coming to Garbage Gate. As I rode along, I took a good look at the crumbled walls of the city and the gates that had been torn down and burned.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ̃ jɔɔ lɛ mli agbo lɛ naa nyɔɔŋ kɛje kpo kɛtsɔ̃ Drako Nubu lɛ he kɛtee Tumo Agbo lɛ naa. Misra Yerusalɛm gbogboi lɛ mikwɛ bɔ ni amɛkumɔ amɛshwie shi, kɛ enaa agboi ni ashã lɛ.

english_verse: On the east side of the city, I headed north to Fountain Gate and King's Pool, but then the trail became too narrow for my donkey.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mifoŋ kɛtee Nubu Agbo lɛ naa kɛ Maŋtsɛ Kpaakpo lɛ hu naa; shi kooloo ni mita nɔ lɛ naaa he ko etsɔ̃ yɛ nikikiŋkoi lɛ amli kɛho.

english_verse: So I went down to Kidron Valley and looked at the wall from there. Then before daylight I returned to the city through Valley Gate.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɔɔŋ mli lɛ mitsɔ̃ faa lɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli kɛtee miyakwɛ gbogbo lɛ; ni miku misɛɛ kɛtsɔ̃ jɔɔ lɛ mli agbo lɛ naa kɛtee maŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: None of the city officials knew what I had in mind. And I had not even told any of the Jews—not the priests, the leaders, the officials, or any other Jews who would be helping in the work.
translation_verse: Shi nɔyelɔi lɛ leee he ni mitee kɛ nɔ ni miyafee. Yudafoi lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ abladei lɛ kɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ ni ji mɛi ni baatsu nii lɛ hu, migbako amɛ.

english_verse: But when I got back, I said to them, “Jerusalem is truly in a mess! The gates have been torn down and burned, and everything is in ruins. We must rebuild the city wall so that we can again take pride in our city.”
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛmiina nɔ amane mli ni wɔyɔɔ, bɔ ni Yerusalɛm ekumɔ kɛbua shi, ni ehe agboi lɛ hu ashã. Nyɛbaa ni nyɛhãa wɔtswaa Yerusalɛm gbogbo lɛ koni wɔhiɛshishwiemɔ nɛɛ sɛɛ afo.”

english_verse: Then I told them how kind God had been and what the king had said. Immediately, they replied, “Let's start building now!” So they got everything ready.
translation_verse: Ni migba amɛ akɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ mi yɛ. Migba amɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ wiemɔ ni ekɛ mi wie lɛ hu. Amɛhere nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔbɔia gbogbo lɛ tswaa! Ni amɛsaa amɛhe amɛhã nitsumɔ kpakpa lɛ.”

english_verse: When Sanballat, Tobiah, and Geshem the Arab heard about our plans, they started insulting us and saying, “Just look at you! Do you plan to rebuild the walls of the city and rebel against the king?”
translation_verse: Shi be ni Sanbalat, Horonnyo lɛ, kɛ Tobia, Amonnyo ni ji nyɔŋ lɛ kɛ Geshem, Arabianyo lɛ, nu lɛ, amɛŋmɔ wɔ, ni amɛye wɔhe fɛo amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛɛ sane nyɛyeɔ nɛɛ? Aso nyɛmitse Maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ atua?”

english_verse: I answered, “We are servants of the God who rules from heaven, and he will make our work succeed. So we will start rebuilding Jerusalem, but you have no right to any of its property, because you have had no part in its history.”
translation_verse: Mito he akɛ, “Ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ eeehã wɔnyɛ wɔfee. No hewɔ lɛ, wɔ, ni ji etsuji lɛ, wɔbaawo gbogbo lɛ tswaa nɔ; shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛbɛ gbɛfaŋ nɔ ko loo hegbɛ ko loo kaimɔ nɔ ko yɛ Yerusalɛm.”

english_verse: These are the people who helped rebuild the wall and gates of Jerusalem: The high priest Eliashib and the other priests rebuilt Sheep Gate and hung its doors. Then they dedicated Sheep Gate and the section of the wall as far as Hundred Tower and Hananel Tower.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni osɔfonukpa Eliashib, kɛ enyɛmimɛi osɔfoi lɛ tswa Toi Agboi lɛ agbogbo lɛ; amɛtara enaa shinai lɛ, ni amɛjɔɔ nɔ kɛfee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ amɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ. Amɛfee gbogbo lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ aahu kɛyashi Hamea mɔɔ gojoo lɛ kɛ Hananel mɔɔ gojoo lɛ he.

english_verse: The people of Jericho rebuilt the next section of the wall, and Zaccur son of Imri rebuilt the section after that.
translation_verse: Yeriko hii lɛ tswa gbogbo kɛtsa nɔ; ni Zakur, Imri bi lɛ, hu tswa kɛtsa Yeriko hii lɛ anɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The family of Hassenaah built Fish Gate. They put the beams in place and hung the doors, then they added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Hasenabii lɛ tswa Loi Agboi lɛ agbogbo lɛ. Amɛsɛŋ nɔ, ni amɛtara enaa shinai kɛ sai kɛ adabaŋi lɛ.

english_verse: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, completed the next section of the wall. Meshullam, son of Berechiah and grandson of Meshezabel, rebuilt the next section, and Zadok son of Baana rebuilt the section beside that.
translation_verse: Meremot, Hakoz bi ni ji Uria nabi lɛ, saa gbogbo ni tsa nɔ lɛ. Amɛnɔtsamɔ lɛ Meshulam ni ji Meshezabel bi Berekia bi lɛ basaa. Nɔ ni tsa enɛ hu nɔ lɛ, Bana bi Zadok tswa.

english_verse: The next section was to be repaired by the men of Tekoa, but their town leaders refused to do the hard work they were assigned.
translation_verse: Enɛ nɔtsamɔ lɛ Tekoa hii lɛ ji mɛi ni tswa, shi abladei ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛhe wooo amɛNuŋtsɔ lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah restored Ancient Gate. They put the beams in place, hung the doors, and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Agbo Momo lɛ, Yoiada, Pasea bi lɛ, kɛ Meshulam, Besodeia bi lɛ, basaa. Amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛsɛŋ nɔ, ni amɛtara enaa shinai lɛ kɛ amɛhe sai lɛ kɛ amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ.

english_verse: Melatiah from Gibeon, Jadon from Meronoth, and the men from Gibeon and Mizpah rebuilt the next section of the wall. This section reached as far as the house of the governor of West Euphrates Province.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni tsa enɛ nɔ kɛyashi faa lɛ anaiagbɛ, he ni amralo lɛ shihilɛhe lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, Melatia, Gibeonnyo lɛ, kɛ Yadon, Meronotnyo lɛ, kɛ Gibeon kɛ Mizpabii lɛ ji mɛi ni basaa.

english_verse: Uzziel son of Harhaiah the goldsmith rebuilt the next section. Hananiah the perfume maker rebuilt the section next after that, and it went as far as Broad Wall.
translation_verse: Enɔtsamɔ lɛ, Harhaia bi Uziel ni jɛ shika ŋaalɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ ji mɔ ni basaa. Nɔ ni tsa enɛ nɔ lɛ, Hanania, ojeŋmafeelɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni batswa. Amɛsaa Yerusalɛm gbogbo lɛ kɛyashi Agbo Lɛkɛtɛɛ lɛ he.

english_verse: Rephaiah son of Hur ruled half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni tsa nɔ lɛ, Refaia, Hur bi lɛ ni ji Yerusalɛm mlijaa fã lumɔ lɛ, ji mɔ ni basaa.

english_verse: The section after that was close to the home of Jedaiah son of Harumaph, and he rebuilt it. Hattush son of Hashabneiah constructed the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Enɛ nɔtsamɔ lɛ, Yedaia, Harumaf bi lɛ, basaa; eyɛ eshĩa lɛ ŋlɛnɔ. Nɔ ni tsa nɔ lɛ, Hashabneia bi Hatush ji mɔ ni basaa.

english_verse: Malchijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath Moab rebuilt the section after that, and they also built Oven Tower.
translation_verse: Malkia, Harim bi lɛ, kɛ Hashub, Pahat-Moab bi lɛ, basaa nɔ ni tsa nɔ lɛ kɛ Flɔnɔi Amɔɔ lɛ hu.

english_verse: Shallum son of Hallohesh ruled the other half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. Shallum's daughters also worked with him.
translation_verse: Enɔtsamɔ lɛ Shalum, Halohesh bi lɛ, ni ji Yerusalɛm mlija fã lumɔ lɛ basaa; ebiyei lɛ ye bua lɛ kɛsaa.

english_verse: Hanun and the people who lived in the town of Zanoah rebuilt Valley Gate. They hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. They also rebuilt the wall for
translation_verse: Hanun kɛ Zanoa maŋ lɛ mli bii basaa Jɔɔ Agbo lɛ. Amɛma ni amɛtara enaa shinai lɛ kɛ amɛhe sai lɛ kɛ amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ. Amɛtswa gbogbo ninetalɔi akpe kɛyashi Tumo Agbo lɛ naa.

english_verse: Malchijah son of Rechab ruled the district of Beth-Haccherem, and he rebuilt Garbage Gate. He hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Tumo Agbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ mɔ ni saa ji Malkia, Rekab bi lɛ ni ji Bet-Hakerem mlijaa fã lumɔ lɛ. Lɛ ema ni etara enaa shinai lɛ kɛ amɛhe sai kɛ amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ.

english_verse: Shallum son of Colhozeh ruled the district of Mizpah, and he rebuilt Fountain Gate. He put a cover over the gateway, then hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. He also rebuilt the wall at Shelah Pool. This section was next to the king's garden and went as far as the stairs leading down from David's City.
translation_verse: Nubu Agbo lɛ Shallum, Kol-Hoze bi lɛ ni ji Mizpa mlijaa fã lumɔ lɛ, ji mɔ ni basaa. Lɛ ema, ni eha nɔ, ni etara enaa shinai lɛ kɛ amɛhe sai kɛ amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ. Lɛ nɔŋŋ etswa Shela Kpaakpo lɛ he gbogbo lɛ ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ trom lɛ masɛi lɛ, aahu kɛyashi atrakpoi ni kpelekeɔ shi kɛjɛɔ David maŋ lɛ mli lɛ he.

english_verse: Nehemiah son of Azbuk ruled half of the district of Beth-Zur, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. It went as far as the royal cemetery, the artificial pool, and the army barracks. Levites Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Nɔ ni tsa enɛ nɔ lɛ, Nehemia, Azbuk bi lɛ ni ji Bet-Zur mlijaa fã lumɔ lɛ, basaa. Esaa kɛyashi David saŋi lɛ kɛ kpaakpo ni aje gbɛ afee lɛ kɛ tabilɔi ashihilɛhe lɛ ŋlɛnɔ. Levibii ni tswa gbogbo lɛ eko lɛ

english_verse: The Levites who worked on the next sections of the wall were Rehum son of Bani; Hashabiah, who ruled half of the district of Keilah and did this work for his district;
translation_verse: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Levibii ni abaatsi amɛgbɛii atã nɛɛ batswa gbogbo lɛ hei komɛi: Rehum, Bani bi lɛ, batswa fã ko; Hashabia, Keila kpokpai anɔ mlijaa fã lumɔ lɛ, batswa he ni yɔɔ enɔ mli.

english_verse: Binnui son of Henadad, who ruled the other half of the district of Keilah;
translation_verse: Esɛɛ lɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ batswa eko: Bawai, Henadad bi lɛ, ni ji Keila mlijaa fã kome lɛ lumɔ lɛ, basaa fã,

english_verse: Ezer son of Jeshua, who ruled Mizpah, rebuilt the section of the wall that was in front of the armory and reached to the corner of the wall;
translation_verse: ni Ezer, Yeshua bi lɛ ni ji Mizpa lumɔ lɛ, basaa fã hu yɛ he ni atsɔ̃ɔ akwɔɔ kɛyaa tawuunii toohe lɛ yɛ gbogbo lɛ koŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Baruch son of Zabbai eagerly rebuilt the section of the wall that went all the way to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest;
translation_verse: Esɛɛ lɛ, Baruk, Zabai bi lɛ, basaa gbogbo lɛ fã kroko kɛjɛ gbogbo lɛ koŋ kɛyashi osɔfonukpa Eliashib shĩa lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.

english_verse: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, built up to the far end of Eliashib's house. Priests Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Baruk sɛɛ lɛ, Meremot, ni ji Hakoz bi Uria bi lɛ, basaa fã kroko kɛjɛ Eliashib we lɛ shinaa lɛ naa kɛyashi Eliashib we lɛ naagbeehe lɛ tɔ̃ɔ. Levi Osɔfoi ni tswa gbogbo lɛ eko lɛ

english_verse: Here is a list of the priests who worked on the wall: Priests from the region around Jerusalem rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, osɔfoi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm kpokpai anɔ lɛ basaa gbogbo lɛ fã ni tsa nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Benjamin and Hasshub rebuilt the wall in front of their own houses. Azariah, who was the son of Maaseiah and the grandson of Ananiah, rebuilt the section in front of his house.
translation_verse: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Benyamin kɛ Hashub basaa fã ni yɔɔ amɛshĩai lɛ ahiɛ lɛ. Maaseia bi Azaria ni enii ji Anania basaa fã ni tsa nɔ ni yɔɔ eshĩa lɛ hiɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Binnui son of Henadad rebuilt the section of the wall from Azariah's house to the corner of the wall.
translation_verse: Azaria sɛɛ lɛ Binui, Hanadad bi lɛ, basaa fã kroko kɛjɛ Azaria shĩa lɛ he kɛyashi gbogbo lɛ koŋ kɛ he ni gbogbo lɛ dɔ eyi yɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Palal son of Uzai rebuilt the next section, which began at the corner of the wall and the tower of the upper palace near the court of the guard. Pedaiah son of Parosh rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Palal, Uzai bi lɛ, batswa gbogbo lɛ fã ni kwɛɔ koŋ lɛ kɛ mɔɔ ni etsɛ̃ kɛje kpo yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ shĩa lɛ sɔɔdo ni ji enyɔ lɛ he yɛ bulɔi akpo lɛ masɛi lɛ.

english_verse: He stopped at a place near the Water Gate on the east and the tower guarding the temple. This was close to a section in the city called Ophel, where the temple workers lived. Other Builders Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Palal sɛɛ lɛ, Pedaia, Parosh bi lɛ, kɛ Sɔlemɔ we sɔ̃ɔlɔi ni hiɔ Ofel lɛ basaa gbogbo lɛ fã kroko kɛyashi he ko ni yɔɔ Nu Agbo lɛ bokãgbɛ kɛ mɔɔ ni etsɛ̃ kɛje kpo lɛ masɛi. Gbogbotswalɔi krokomɛi

english_verse: The men from Tekoa rebuilt the next section of the wall, and it was their second section. It started at a place across from the large tower that guarded the Temple, and it went all the way to the wall near Ophel.
translation_verse: Pedaia sɛɛ lɛ, Tekoabii lɛ basaa gbogbo lɛ fã ni kwɛɔ mɔɔ wulu somromoo ni etsɛ̃ kɛje kpo lɛ. Amɛsaa gbogbo lɛ aahu kɛyashi Ofel gbogbo lɛ he.

english_verse: Some priests rebuilt the next section of the wall. They began working north of Horse Gate, and each one worked on a section in front of his own house.
translation_verse: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ basaa fã kroko. Amɛsaa kɛjɛ Okpɔŋɔi Agbo lɛ sɛɛ kɛtee kooyigbɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tswa gbogbo lɛ fã ni yɔɔ eshĩa hiɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Zadok son of Immer rebuilt the wall in front of his house. Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, who looked after the East Gate, rebuilt the section after that.
translation_verse: Osɔfoi lɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Zadok, Imer bi lɛ, basaa fã ni yɔɔ eshĩa lɛ hiɛ lɛ. Esɛɛ lɛ, Shemaia, Shekania bi lɛ ni kwɛɔ Bokãgbɛ Agbo lɛ nɔ lɛ, basaa gbogbo lɛ fã kroko lɛ.

english_verse: Hananiah and Hanun rebuilt the next section, which was the second section for them. Meshullam son of Berechiah rebuilt the next section, which happened to be in front of his house.
translation_verse: Shemaia sɛɛ lɛ, Hanania, Shelemia bi lɛ, kɛ Hanun, Zalaf bi ni ji ekpaa lɛ, basaa fã kroko. Amɛsɛɛ lɛ, Meshulam, Berekia bi lɛ, basaa fã ni yɔɔ esɛɛtsu lɛ ŋlɛnɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Malchijah, a goldsmith, rebuilt the next section, as far as the house used by the temple workers and merchants. This area was across from Gathering Gate, near the room on top of the wall at the northeast corner.
translation_verse: Esɛɛ lɛ Malkia ni ji shika ŋaalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ batswa gbogbo lɛ fã kroko lɛ. Etswa kɛyashi Sɔlemɔ we sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛ jarayelɔi lɛ awe lɛ he, yɛ Henaabuamɔ Agbo lɛ ŋlɛnɔ. Malkiya nɛɛ nɔŋŋ saa gbogbo lɛ kɛyashi ŋwɛitsu ni ma gbogbo lɛ koŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ he.

english_verse: The goldsmiths and merchants rebuilt the last section of the wall, which went from the corner room all the way to Sheep Gate.
translation_verse: Gbogbo lɛ naagbee fã ni kã ŋwɛitsu lɛ kɛ Toi Agboi lɛ teŋ lɛ, mɛi ni saa no ji shika ŋaalɔi lɛ kɛ jarayelɔi lɛ.

english_verse: When Sanballat, the governor of Samaria, heard that we were rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem, he became angry and started insulting our people.
translation_verse: Be ni Sanbalat nu akɛ wɔ, Yudafoi lɛ, wɔmiitswa gbogbo lɛ, emli fu ni emli wo la naakpa. Eye wɔhe fɛo,

english_verse: In front of his friends and the Samaritan army he said, “What is this feeble bunch of Jews trying to do? Are they going to rebuild the wall and offer sacrifices all in one day? Do they think they can make something out of this pile of scorched stones?”
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ yɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ Samaria tabilɔi lɛ ahiɛ akɛ, “Mɛni nɛkɛ Yudafoi wudɔwudɔi nɛɛ feɔ nɛɛ? Ani aŋmɛ amɛ gbɛ? Ani amɛsusuɔ akɛ kɛji amɛshã afɔlei lɛ amɛaanyɛ nitsumɔ lɛ naa amɛgbe gbi kome jenamɔ lo? Kolɛ amɛaanyɛ amɛ jie tɛi lɛ yɛ tsu koi ni ashã ni bua shi kuikui lɛ amli lo?”

english_verse: Tobiah from Ammon was standing beside Sanballat and said, “Look at the wall they are building! Why, even a fox could knock over this pile of stones.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Tobia, Amonnyo ni damɔ emasɛi lɛ, kɛɛ, “Tɛ gbogbo tete po ni amɛtswaa nɛɛ lɛ, kɛ osɔ tete tu eyi nɔ lɛ, eeekumɔ eshwie shi.”

english_verse: But I prayed, “Our God, these people hate us and have wished horrible things for us. Please answer our prayers and make their insults fall on them! Let them be the ones to be dragged away as prisoners of war.
translation_verse: Misɔle mikɛɛ, “Bo toi, wɔNyɔŋmɔ. Bo bɔ ni agbeɔ wɔhe guɔ toi. Hã ni ahora ni amɛbɔɔ wɔ lɛ aku sɛɛ abua amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiteŋ; hã aŋɔ amɛ nom, ni aha amɛnii.

english_verse: The people worked hard, and we built the walls of Jerusalem halfway up again.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, wɔtswa gbogbo lɛ kɛkpe kɛyashi enɔkwɔlɛ lɛ mlijaa, ejaakɛ maŋ lɛ yɛ nitsumɔ lɛ he tsui.

english_verse: But Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, the Ammonites, and the people from the city of Ashdod saw the walls going up and the holes being repaired. So they became angry
translation_verse: Shi be ni Sanbalat kɛ Tobia kɛ Arabiabii kɛ Amonbii kɛ Ashdodbii lɛ nu akɛ atsara Yerusalɛm gbogboi lɛ kɛkpe, ni abɔ̃i fɔji lɛ tsiimɔ lɛ, amɛmli wo la naakpa.

english_verse: and decided to stir up trouble, and to fight against the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Amɛ fɛɛ tswɛm amɛtee apam akɛ amɛmiiba ni amɛbatua Yerusalɛm ni amɛhã jɛi afee basabasa.

english_verse: But we kept on praying to our God, and we also stationed guards day and night.
translation_verse: Shi wɔsɔle wɔkpa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ fai, ni wɔto bulɔi wɔto amɛhe koni amɛbu nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the people of Judah were singing a sorrowful song: “So much rubble for us to haul! Worn out and weary, will we ever finish this wall?”
translation_verse: Yudabii yɛ lala ko ni amɛlaa akɛ, “Wɔhewalɛ nɔ miigbɔ kɛ wɔjatsui ni wɔtere lɛ. Tsu gbogbo kukuji ni sa akɛ aloo lɛ fa tsɔ̃. Hewɔ lɛ wɔnyɛɛɛ gbogbo lɛ wɔtswa dɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: Our enemies were saying, “Before those Jews know what has happened, we will sneak up and kill them and put an end to their work.”
translation_verse: Wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ susu akɛ wɔleŋ, ni asaŋ wɔnaŋ amɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛaabote wɔteŋ ni amɛmiigbe wɔ koni nitsumɔ lɛ yi ahɛ shi.

english_verse: On at least ten different occasions, the Jews living near our enemies warned us against attacks from every side,
translation_verse: Shi Yudafoi ni kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ ba shii abɔ amɛbatswa wɔ adafi akɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ baajɛ hei srɔtoi ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ amɛbatua wɔ.

english_verse: and so I sent people to guard the wall at its lowest places and where there were still holes in it. I placed them according to families, and they stood guard with swords and spears and with bows and arrows.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ mɛi to gbogbo lɛ sɛɛ hei ni kwɔɔɔ ni kã shi kplanaa lɛ. Mito maŋ lɛ yɛ amɛwekui anaa; amɛhiɛ amɛklantei kɛ amɛkpɔlɔi kɛ amɛgãii.

english_verse: Then I looked things over and told the leaders, the officials, and the rest of the people, “Don't be afraid of your enemies! The Lord is great and fearsome. So think of him and fight for your relatives and children, your wives and homes!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mikwɛ bɔ ni nibii yɔɔ hãa, ni mikɛɛ maŋ lɛ mli abladei lɛ kɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkashea henyɛlɔi lɛ agbeyei; shi moŋ nyɛkaia Nuŋtsɔ kpeteŋkple ni he yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ, ni nyɛwua nyɛhãa nyɛnyɛmimɛi kɛ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei kɛ nyɛŋamɛi kɛ nyɛshĩaiaŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Our enemies found out that we knew about their plot against us, but God kept them from doing what they had planned. So we went back to work on the wall.
translation_verse: Be ni wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ nu akɛ abatswa wɔ adafi, ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehã amɛ jina lɛ efee yaka lɛ, wɔ fɛɛ tswɛm wɔku wɔsɛɛ kɛba gbogbo lɛ he ekoŋŋ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee enitsumɔhe.

english_verse: From then on, I let half of the young men work while the other half stood guard. They wore armor and had spears and shields, as well as bows and arrows. The leaders helped the workers
translation_verse: Kɛjɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, miwebii lɛ ateŋ mɛi fã tsuɔ nii lɛ, ni mɛi fã hiɛɔ akplɔi kɛ tsɛŋi kɛ gaii ni amɛwo damai. Onukpai lɛ fi Yudawe lɛ fɛɛ ni tswaa gbogbo lɛ sɛɛ.

english_verse: who were rebuilding the wall. Everyone who hauled building materials kept one hand free to carry a weapon.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni tswaa gbogbo lɛ kɛ mɛi ni tereɔ nibii ni akɛtswaa lɛ tete ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enine kome miitsu nii, belɛ ekɛ ekome hiɛ tawuunii.

english_verse: Even the workers who were rebuilding the wall strapped on a sword. The worker who was to blow the signal trumpet stayed with me.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni tswaa gbogbo lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ klante ŋmɔ ehɛ, ni ekɛtswaa gbogbo lɛ; ni mɔ ni kpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ yɛ mimasɛi.

english_verse: I told the people and their officials and leaders, “Our work is so spread out, that we are a long way from one another.
translation_verse: Mikɛɛ maŋ lɛ mli abladei lɛ kɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nitsumɔ lɛ fa, ni egbɛ eshwã, ni wɔmli kã haŋŋhaŋŋ yɛ gbogbo lɛ nɔ, mɔ kɛ enaanyo teŋ jɛkɛ.

english_verse: If you hear the sound of the trumpet, come quickly and gather around me. Our God will help us fight.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, he fɛɛ he ni nyɛaanu tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɛmɔ yɛ lɛ, nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa kɛbaa wɔŋɔɔ yɛ jɛi; wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaawu ahã wɔ.”

english_verse: Every day from dawn to dark, half of the workers rebuilt the walls, while the rest stood guard with their spears.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni wɔtsu nii lɛ nɛ, mɛi lɛ fã hiɛɔ akplɔi kɛjɛɔ hulu shitee kɛyashiɔ beyinɔ ni ŋulamii pueɔ yɛ ŋwɛi.

english_verse: I asked the men in charge and their workers to stay inside Jerusalem and stand guard at night. So they guarded the city at night and worked during the day.
translation_verse: Asaŋ nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, mikɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ ewebii awɔ Yerusalɛm koni amɛbu wɔhe nyɔɔŋ, ni shwane lɛ amɛtsu nii lɛ.

english_verse: I even slept in my work clothes at night; my relatives, the workers, and the guards slept in theirs as well. And we always kept our weapons close by.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mi jio, minanemɛi nitsulɔi lɛ jio, miwebii lɛ kɛ mihebulɔi lɛ jio, wɔjieee wɔtadei; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tawuunii yɛ emasɛi.”

english_verse: Some of the men and their wives complained about the Jews in power
translation_verse: Maŋbii lɛ kɛ amɛŋamɛi lɛ wie amɛshi amɛnyɛmimɛi Yudafoi lɛ yɛ sane ni eŋɔɔɔ ni amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛyeɔ amɛ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: and said, “We have large families, and it takes a lot of grain merely to keep us alive.”
translation_verse: Maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɔ akɛ, “Wɔ kɛ wɔbii lɛ, wɔyi fa yɛ wɔshĩai amli. Ahã wɔ abele bɔ ni sa ni wɔye koni wɔyi ana wala.”

english_verse: Others said, “During the famine we even had to mortgage our fields, vineyards, and homes to them in order to buy grain.”
translation_verse: Mɛi krokomɛi hu kɛɔ akɛ, “Hɔ̃mɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔkɛ wɔŋmɔji kɛ wɔwain tromi kɛ wɔshĩai totoɔ awaba koni wɔna shika wɔkɛhe abele.”

english_verse: Then others said, “We had to borrow money from those in power to pay the government tax on our fields and vineyards.
translation_verse: Asaŋ mɛi komɛi hu kɛɔ akɛ, “Maŋtsɛ onia lɛ tsumɔ hewɔ lɛ wɔyafala shika, ni wɔkɛ wɔŋmɔji kɛ wɔwain tromi lɛ eto naa.

english_verse: We are Jews just as they are, and our children are as good as theirs. But we still have to sell our children as slaves, and some of our daughters have already been raped. We are completely helpless; our fields and vineyards have even been taken from us.”
translation_verse: Wɔkɛ wɔnyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ hewolo kome, ni wɔbii lɛ tamɔ amɛbii lɛ, shi wɔtsiɔ wɔbii lɛ wɔwoɔ nyɔŋyeli mli, koni amɛtsɔmɔ nyɔji; ni wɔbiyei lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi lɛ, afee amɛ nyɔji momo. Wɔnyɛɛɛ enɛ he nɔ ko wɔfee; ni wɔŋmɔji kɛ wɔwain tromi yɛ mɛi krokomɛi adɛŋ.”

english_verse: When I heard their complaints and their charges, I became very angry.
translation_verse: Be ni minu saji ni eŋɔɔɔ amɛnaa kɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, mimli wo la naakpa,

english_verse: So I thought it over and said to the leaders and officials, “How can you charge your own people interest?” Then I called a public meeting and accused the leaders
translation_verse: ni mito miyiŋ nɔ ni sa akɛ mafee. Saji ni ayɔɔ yɛ abladei lɛ kɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ ahe lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ heɔ enyɛmi hekpa ni fe nine.” Mibɔ gwa kpeteŋkple miwo amɛ;

english_verse: by saying, “We have tried to buy back all of our people who were sold into exile. But here you are, selling more of them for us to buy back!” The officials and leaders did not say a word, because they knew this was true.
translation_verse: ni mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ, wɔkpɔ̃ wɔnyɛmimɛi Yudafoi ni ahɔ̃ɔ ahã jeŋmaji lɛ bɔ ni wɔɔnyɛ, shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛmiihɔ̃ɔ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ? Nyɛmiihɔ̃ɔ amɛ nyɛhã wɔ!” Amɛhãaa hetoo; amɛnãaa nɔ ni amɛkɛɔ.

english_verse: I continued, “What you have done is wrong! We must honor our God by the way we live, so the Gentiles can't find fault with us.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mitsa miwiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni mikɛɛ, “Nɔ ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ ejaaa. Ani esaaa akɛ nyɛkɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ he gbeyeishemɔ baa nyɛjeŋ koni wɔkɛku wɔhe fɛo ni jemajiaŋbii ni ji wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ yeɔ lɛ naa lo?

english_verse: My relatives, my friends, and I are also lending money and grain, but we must no longer demand payment in return.
translation_verse: Mi kɛ minyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ miwebii lɛ hu, wɔfaa wɔnyɛmimɛi Yudafoi lɛ shika kɛ abele. Nyɛhãa wɔkɛ nɛkɛ hekpawoo nɛɛ akea.

english_verse: The leaders answered, “We will do whatever you say and return their property, without asking to be repaid.” So I made the leaders promise in front of the priests to give back the property.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔkɛbaaku sɛɛ wɔhã amɛ ni wɔheŋ nɔ ko yɛ amɛdɛŋ. Wɔɔɔfee tamɔ bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ.” Mitsɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛba, ni mihã maŋhiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ kamɔ kitã akɛ amɛaafee bɔ ni amɛwo shi nɛɛ.

english_verse: Then I emptied my pockets and said, “If you don't keep your promise, that's what God will do to you. He will empty out everything you own, even taking away your houses.” The people answered, “We will keep our promise.” Then they praised the Lord and did as they had promised. Nehemiah Is Generous
translation_verse: Asaŋ mitswa mimlifiinɔ lɛ mli, ni mikɛɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeee nɛkɛ shiwoo nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaatswa emli kɛjie lɛ kɛjɛ ewe kɛ enitsumɔ mli nɛ; bɔ nɔŋŋ ni aaatswa emli ni afee lɛ shwɛm nɛ.” Asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ here nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Amen!” Ni amɛ jie Yehowa yi. Maŋ lɛ ye amɛshiwoo nɛɛ nɔ. Nehemia fooo ekome enɔ mli

english_verse: I was governor of Judah from the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was king until the thirty-second year. And during these entire twelve years, my relatives and I refused to accept the food that I was allowed.
translation_verse: Kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni awo mi amralo ni kwɛɔ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ Maŋtsɛ Artashasta yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ nɔ kɛyashi afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ, no ji afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ sɔŋŋ nɛ lɛ, mi kɛ minyɛmimɛi lɛ wɔheko niyenii ni ahãa amralo fɛɛ amralo akɛ egbɛnaa niyenii lɛ eko.

english_verse: Each governor before me had been a burden to the people by making them pay for his food and wine and by demanding forty silver coins a day. Even their officials had been a burden to the people. But I respected God, and I didn't think it was right to be so hard on them.
translation_verse: Shi sa amraloi ni nyiɛ mihiɛ lɛ hã etɔ maŋ lɛ yɛ shika ni naa shiɔ jwiɛtɛi talentai nyɔŋmai ejwɛ ni amɛheɔ kɛshiɔ aboloo kɛ wain ni amɛheɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hewɔ. Amraloi nɛɛ atsuji tete gbaa maŋ lɛ naa. Shi mi lɛ, gbeyei ni misheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hewɔ lɛ, mifeee nakai.

english_verse: I spent all my time getting the wall rebuilt and did not buy any property. Everyone working for me did the same thing.
translation_verse: Asaŋ mikɛ mihewalɛ fɛɛ wo gbogbo lɛ he nitsumɔ lɛ mli, ni mitaooo shikpɔŋ ko mihãaa mihe; ni miwebii lɛ fɛɛ bakpeɔ yɛ gbogbo lɛ he kɛhã nitsumɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Each day one ox, six of the best sheep, and lots of chickens were prepared. Then every ten days, a large supply of wine was brought in. I knew what a heavy burden this would have been for the people, and so I did not ask for my food allowance as governor.
translation_verse: Nii ni ahoɔ ahãa mi gbi kome ji tsinanuu kome kɛ toi ni eshwi ekpaa kɛ wuɔi; ni daa gbii nyɔŋma sɛɛ lɛ, akɛ wain srɔtoi fɛɛ hu babaoo baa, migbɛnaa niyenii lɛ, mibiii shi, ejaakɛ onia ni atsuɔ maŋ lɛ efee jatsu ehã maŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless me for everything I have done for my people.
translation_verse: MiNyɔŋmɔ, nibii fɛɛ ni mifee mihã nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, kaimɔ mi ni ahi ahã mi.

english_verse: Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem, and our other enemies learned that I had completely rebuilt the wall. All I lacked was hanging the doors in the gates.
translation_verse: Sanbalat kɛ Tobia kɛ Geshem, Arabianyo lɛ, kɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi krokomɛi lɛ nu akɛ mitswa gbogbo lɛ, ni ehe ko ni ekumɔ bɛ dɔŋŋ; ni eshwɛ agboi lɛ anaa shinai lɛ pɛ ni matara.

english_verse: Then Sanballat and Geshem sent a message, asking me to meet with them in one of the villages in Ono Valley. I knew they were planning to harm me in some way.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Sanbalat kɛ Geshem tsu aba miŋɔɔ kɛ wiemɔ akɛ mikɛ lɛ abakpe yɛ Ono ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ akrowai lɛ eko mli. Shi efɔŋ amɛtaoɔ mi amɛfee.

english_verse: So I sent messengers to tell them, “My work is too important to stop now and go there. I can't afford to slow down the work just to visit with you.”
translation_verse: Mitsu mɛi kɛtee amɛŋɔɔ koni ayakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nitsumɔ ni mitsuɔ lɛ da, hewɔ lɛ minyɛŋ maba. Mɛɛ hewɔ ni esa akɛ mahã afɔ̃ɔ nitsumɔ lɛ ni mashi maba nyɛŋɔɔ?”

english_verse: They invited me four times, but each time I refused to go.
translation_verse: Amɛtsu kɛba miŋɔɔ shii ejwɛ sɔŋŋ kɛ nakai wiemɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni mito he mihã amɛ nakai nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Finally, Sanballat sent an official to me with an unsealed letter,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Sanbalat tsu miŋɔɔ nɔ ni ji shii enumɔ. Mɔ ni etsu lɛ hiɛ wolo ni asɔoko naa yɛ edɛŋ.

english_verse: which said: A rumor is going around among the nations that you and the other Jews are rebuilding the wall and planning to rebel, because you want to be their king. And Geshem says it's true!
translation_verse: Wolo lɛ mli sane nɛ, “Aatã yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ amli, ni Geshem hu kɛɛ akɛ akɛɛ Yudafoi lɛ miitao atse atua, ni no hewɔ otswaa gbogbo lɛ. Asaŋ akɛɛ ootao maŋtsɛ oye.

english_verse: You even have prophets in Jerusalem, claiming you are now the king of Judah. You know the Persian king will hear about this, so let's get together and talk it over.
translation_verse: Akɛɛ hu akɛ owo mɛi komɛi gbalɔi ni amɛshiɛ yɛ ohe yɛ Yerusalɛm akɛ, ‘Maŋtsɛ ko yɛ Yuda!’ Agbɛnɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ baaya ayashɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ toiŋ. No hewɔ lɛ, ba ni wɔya he ajina.”

english_verse: I sent a message back to Sanballat, saying, “None of this is true! You are making it all up.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mitsu Sanbalat ŋɔɔ kɛ wiemɔ akɛ, “Nibii ni okɛɔ nɛɛ, afeko nakai nɔ ko; bo diɛŋtsɛ okɛ ojwɛŋmɔ fo otã.”

english_verse: Our enemies were trying to frighten us and to keep us from our work. But I asked God to give me strength.
translation_verse: Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ, wɔhe gbeyei kɛkɛ amɛtaoɔ amɛwo, ni amɛsusuɔ akɛ wɔnijiaŋ baaje wui yɛ nitsumɔ lɛ he koni egɔ̃. Shi misɔle mikɛɛ, “Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, wo mi ekãa.”

english_verse: One day I went to visit Shemaiah. He wasn't supposed to leave his house, but he said, “Let's hurry to the holy place of the temple and hide there. We will lock the temple doors, because your enemies are planning to kill you tonight.”
translation_verse: Gbi ko lɛ mitee Shemaia ni ji Delaia bi ni asaŋ eji Mehetabel nabi lɛ shĩa; shi eŋa eyi, ni ekɛɛ, “Hã wɔyakpe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ, yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, ni wɔŋamɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ shinai lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛbaaba ni amɛbagbe bo. Amɛbaaba amɛbagbe bo nyɔɔŋ tete.”

english_verse: I answered, “Why should someone like me have to run and hide in the temple to save my life? I won't go!”
translation_verse: Shi mikɛɛ, “Aso nuu tamɔ mi baajo foi? Ani nuu tamɔ mi aaajo foi kɛya Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, koni eyi ana wala? Miyaaa!”

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that God had not given Shemaiah this message. But Tobiah and Sanballat had paid him to trick me
translation_verse: Miyoo akɛ jeee Nyɔŋmɔ ni tsu Shemaia, shi moŋ Tobia kɛ Sanbalat ni ebɔ lɛ apaa hewɔ ni egba nɛkɛ gbalɛ nɛɛ eshi mi lɛ.

english_verse: and to frighten me into doing something wrong, because they wanted to ruin my good name.
translation_verse: Amɛbɔ lɛ apaa bɔ ni afee ni ewo mihe gbeyei ni mafee nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ koni mafee esha. Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛbaana sane fɔŋ ko yɛ mihe amɛyatã kɛbɔ mi ahora.

english_verse: Then I asked God to punish Tobiah and Sanballat for what they had done. I prayed that God would punish the prophet Noadiah and the other prophets who, together with her, had tried to frighten me. The Work Is Finished
translation_verse: Misɔle mikɛɛ, “MiNyɔŋmɔ, kaimɔ ni okɛ Tobia kɛ Sanbalat aye kɛ joomɔ yɛ nibii ni amɛfee lɛ naa. Kaimɔ gbalɔyoo Noadia kɛ gbalɔi krokomɛi lɛ hu koni okɛ amɛ aye; amɛ amɛtaoɔ ni kulɛ amɛwo mihe gbeyei lɛ.” Nitsumɔ lɛ naagbee

english_verse: On the twenty-fifth day of the month Elul, the wall was completely rebuilt. It had taken
translation_verse: Gbii nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enyɔ sɛɛ lɛ, agbe nitsumɔ lɛ naa. Agbe naa yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji Elul lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: When our enemies in the surrounding nations learned that the work was finished, they felt helpless, because they knew that our God had helped us rebuild the wall.
translation_verse: Be ni wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ nu lɛ, jeŋmaji ni bɔle wɔ lɛ fɛɛ she gbeyei, ni amɛhiɛ gboi wo amɛyitseiaŋ, ejaakɛ amɛyoo akɛ, nitsumɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ yelikɛbuamɔ naa ni anyɛ atsu.

english_verse: All this time the Jewish leaders and Tobiah had been writing letters back and forth.
translation_verse: Shi nɛkɛ bei amli fɛɛ lɛ, Yuda abladei lɛ miiŋmala woji pii amɛmiimaje Tobia, ni Tobia hu miiŋmala amɛ woji.

english_verse: Many people in Judah were loyal to Tobiah for two reasons: Shecaniah son of Arah was his father-in-law, and Tobiah's son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berechiah.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛi pii yɛ Yuda ni kɛ Tobia ji ekome, ejaakɛ Ara bi Shekania shaanuu ji lɛ, ni asaŋ, lɛ Tobia lɛ, ebinuu Yehohanan ebaŋɔ Meshulam biyoo ni ji Berekia nabi akɛ ŋa.

english_verse: The people would always tell me about the good things Tobiah had done, and then they would tell Tobiah everything I had said. So Tobiah kept sending letters, trying to frighten me.
translation_verse: Mɛi bawieɔ Tobia he ekpakpa amɛhãa mi, ni amɛyagbaa lɛ nɔ ni mi hu mikɛɔ. Tobia ŋmalaa mi woji, ni ekɛwoɔ mihe gbeyei.

english_verse: Although Jerusalem covered a large area, not many people lived there, and no new houses had been built.
translation_verse: Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ da, ni emli lɛɛ hu, shi mɛi ni yɔɔ mli lɛ faaa, ni tsui lɛ hu amamɔko.
