english_verse: My Creator, you would want me; you would call out, and I would answer.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ ooobo otsɛ mi, ni mahere bo nɔ; ni oootao oninenaa bɔɔnii lɛ sɛɛgbɛ.

english_verse: You would take care of me, but not count my sins—
translation_verse: Ni ohiŋmɛi baakã minyiɛmɔ he, ni obuŋ minifɔɔjianii ahe akɔntaa;

english_verse: you would put them in a bag, tie it tight, and toss them away.
translation_verse: aaasɔo minifɔɔjianii anaa awo kotoku mli, ni obaatsimɔ minifɔɔjianii lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: But in the real world, mountains tumble, and rocks crumble;
translation_verse: Shi bɔ ni gɔŋ tete gbeɔ shi, ni efufluɔ, ni atsiɔ tɛsaa kɛjeɔ eshimaahe,

english_verse: streams wear away stones and wash away soil. And you destroy our hopes!
translation_verse: ni nu yeɔ tɛi ahe, ni eloɔ shikpɔŋ su kɛyaa lɛ, nakai ofiteɔ gbɔmɔ adesa hiɛnɔkãmɔ.

english_verse: You change the way we look, then send us away, wiped out forever.
translation_verse: Oyeɔ gbɔmɔ hewalɛ nɔ kɛyaa naanɔ, otsakeɔ ehiɛ, ni oshwieɔ lɛ kɛyaa, ni ehoɔ eyaa.

english_verse: We never live to know if our children are praised or disgraced.
translation_verse: Kɛji ebii ahiɛ miiba nyam lɛ, eleee; ni kɛji amɛhiɛ miishwie shi hu eleee.

english_verse: We feel no pain but our own, and when we mourn, it's only for ourselves.
translation_verse: Lɛ diɛŋtsɛ pɛ egbɔmɔtsoŋ piŋmɔ he enuɔ, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ pɛ ehe ŋkɔmɔ eyeɔ.”

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said: *
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Elifaz, Temannyo lɛ, here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ,

english_verse: you would stop spreading all of this hot air.
translation_verse: Aso ekɛ wiemɔ ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ baajie enaa; aloo eeejie enaa kɛ wiemɔ ni shishinumɔ bɛ he?

english_verse: Your words are enough to make others turn from God and lead them to doubt.
translation_verse: Ojie Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ yɛ ojwɛŋmɔŋ, ni ootsi sɔlemɔ naa yɛ ehiɛ;

english_verse: And your sinful, scheming mind is the source of all you say.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ odaaŋ wiemɔ miijie onifɔ̃jianii lɛ kpo, ni ohiɛ shishiulɔi alilɛi.

english_verse: I am not here as your judge; your own words are witnesses against you.
translation_verse: Bo diɛŋtsɛ odaaŋ wiemɔ miibu bo fɔ, shi jeee mi; bo diɛŋtsɛ odaaŋ wiemɔ miiye odase miishi bo.

english_verse: Were you the first human? Are you older than the hills?
translation_verse: Ani bo ji klɛŋklɛŋ gbɔmɔ ni afɔ yɛ je nɛɛŋ? Aloo aŋɔ bo hɔ dani abɔ gɔji lɛ?

english_verse: Have you ever been present when God's council meets? Do you alone have wisdom?
translation_verse: Ani ona onu Nyɔŋmɔ ajinaŋ sane? Ani bo pɛ odɛ̃ŋ nilee yɔɔ?

english_verse: We have the benefit of wisdom older than your father.
translation_verse: Wajiatsɛmɛi kɛ hiimeji fɛɛ yɛ wɔteŋ ni amɛye otsɛ ni fɔ bo onukpa kwraa.

english_verse: And you have been offered comforting words from God. Isn't this enough?
translation_verse: Omii ni Nyɔŋmɔ shɛjeɔ lɛ, efaaa lo? Aloo wiemɔ ni akɛ bo wieɔ kɛ naajɔlɛ lɛ jeee nɔ ko hã bo?

english_verse: Your emotions are out of control, making you look fierce;
translation_verse: Mɛɛba otsui sha bo, ni mɛɛba ohiŋmɛii tswaa kpɛlɛkpɛlɛ,

english_verse: that's why you attack God with everything you say.
translation_verse: ni ote shi owo Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ omumɔ mli, ni ohãa wiemɔi ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi jeɔ onaa?

english_verse: and neither are angels— not in the sight of God. If God doesn't trust his angels,
translation_verse: Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ehe efɔ̃ɔɔ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ tete anɔ; ni ŋwɛi tete he tseee yɛ ehiɛ.

english_verse: what chance do humans have? We are so terribly evil that we thirst for sin. Just Listen to What I Know
translation_verse: Te aaafee tɛŋŋ mɔ, ni mɔ ni feɔ musubɔɔnii, asaŋ ni efite adesa ni nifɔɔjianiifeemɔ ji enu ni enuɔ lɛ, ekɛ ehe aaafɔ̃ enɔ lɛ?

english_verse: Just listen to what I know, and you will learn
translation_verse: Hiob, bo mi toi; mibagba bo nɔ ni mina yɛ jeŋ,

english_verse: wisdom known by others since ancient times.
translation_verse: nɔ ni nilelɔi egba, ni ji nɔ ni amɛtsɛmɛi kɛteee amɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Those who gained such insights also gained the land, and they were not influenced by foreign teachings.
translation_verse: Amɛ tuuŋtu aŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ ahã; gbɔi futuuu amɛ.

english_verse: But suffering is in store each day for those who sin.
translation_verse: Yiwalɔ, mɔ ni waa mɛi krokomɛi ayi lɛ, piŋɔ ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Even in times of success, they constantly hear the threat of doom.
translation_verse: Gbee ni yɔɔ gbeyei gbɛɔ yɛ etoiiaŋ, ni julɔ batuaa lɛ be mli ni ehe ejɔ lɛ.

english_verse: They scrounge around for food, all the while dreading the approaching darkness.
translation_verse: ni akpaŋai miimɛ ni amɛye eloo. Ele akɛ gbi fɔŋ lɛ ebɛŋkɛ lɛ etã.

english_verse: They are overcome with despair, like frightened soldiers facing a fearsome king in battle.
translation_verse: Jaramɔ kɛ fimɔ woɔ ehe gbeyei; amɛyeɔ enɔ tamɔ maŋtsɛ ni efã ta.

english_verse: This is because they rebelled against God All-Powerful
translation_verse: Ete shi ewo Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ewo ehe nɔ yɛ Ofe lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: and have attacked him with their weapons.
translation_verse: Ehiɛ tsɛŋ kpakpataa, ni etsɛ̃ kɛ kuɛŋtimɔ kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ.

english_verse: They may be rich and fat,
translation_verse: Eshwi kɛbamɔ ehiɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: but they will live in the ruins of deserted towns.
translation_verse: Maji amaŋfɔ̃i amli ehi, yɛ shĩai ni esaaa akɛ gbɔmɔ aaahi mli, hei ni baatsɔmɔ koikoi lɛ.

english_verse: Their property and wealth will shrink and disappear.
translation_verse: Enaŋ nii, ni enii ni eyɔɔ lɛ tete etsɛŋ, asaŋ etsɛ̃ŋ fã yɛ su mli.

english_verse: They won't escape the darkness, and the blazing breath of God will set their future aflame. *
translation_verse: Ejeŋ duŋ lɛ mli; la baashã niji ni etsɛ̃rɛ lɛ; ni kɔɔyɔɔ baakpala efɔfɔi ashwie.

english_verse: They have put their trust in something worthless; now they will become worthless
translation_verse: Ekaŋɔ ehiɛ efɔ̃ yakanii anɔ ni ekɛmiilaka ehe, ejaakɛ yakanii nɔŋŋ ebaakpa.

english_verse: like a date palm tree without a leaf.
translation_verse: Eshɛŋ ebe ni ebaaŋala tamɔ tso nine, ni eyi baa frɔkeŋ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Or like vineyards or orchards whose blossoms and unripe fruit drop to the ground.
translation_verse: Eyibii ŋmilikiti lɛ eeekpala eshwie shi tamɔ waintso;

english_verse: Yes, the godless and the greedy will have nothing but flames feasting on their homes,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji woŋ shwiei, ni shĩai ni akɛ nyɔɔŋnihemɔ mamɔ lɛ, la aaakpãtã hiɛ.

english_verse: because they are the parents of trouble and vicious lies.
translation_verse: Nifɔ̃ji ahe ŋaa amɛtoɔ, ni amɛfeɔ nifɔ̃jianii; ni mɔshishiumɔ eyi amɛtsuiiaŋ tɔ.”

english_verse: I have often heard this, and it offers no comfort.
translation_verse: “Minu saji ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi aahu; miishɛjelɔ gbohii ji nyɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: So why don't you keep quiet? What's bothering you?
translation_verse: Aso yaka wiemɔi nɛɛ agbeŋ naa? Ni mɛni ta omli hewɔ ni ohere wiemɔ lɛ nɔ nɛɛ?

english_verse: If I were in your place, it would be easy to criticize or to give advice.
translation_verse: Eji nyɛgbɔmɔtso baje migbɔmɔtso mli jikulɛ, mi hu mawie tamɔ nyɛwieɔ nɛɛ; mawie mashi nyɛ, ni mahoso miyitso mawo nyɛ.

english_verse: If I speak, or if I don't, I hurt all the same. My torment continues.
translation_verse: Kɛji miwie lɛ, mipiŋmɔ lɛ ejɔɔɔ, ni kɛji mifee dioo hu, enɔ enyiɛ po ni gbɔɔ?

english_verse: God has worn me down and destroyed my family;
translation_verse: Anɔkwa, Nyɔŋmɔ ehã eje mitsine; ehã mihe gbɔmɛi fɛɛ etã.

english_verse: my shriveled up skin proves that I am his prisoner.
translation_verse: Ehã mikũakũai ni enɛ yeɔ odase eshiɔ mi; milootãa lɛ yeɔ odase shiɔ mi faŋŋ.

english_verse: God is my hateful enemy, glaring at me and attacking with his sharp teeth.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mlifu etserɛ mimli; ebɛ mi ewo emli; ekpe enyanyɔji ashi ewo mi; etsu ehiŋmɛi eshwie minɔ tamɔ henyɛlɔ feɔ.

english_verse: Everyone is against me; they sneer and slap my face.
translation_verse: Mɛi gbɛɔ amɛdaaŋ amɛwoɔ mi kɛ naakpɛɛ; amɛgbalaa mitoiiaŋ ma kɛbɔɔ mi ahora; amɛbuaa amɛhe naa amɛwoɔ mi.

english_verse: And God is the one who handed me over to this merciless mob. Everything Was Going Well
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ eŋɔ mi ehã mɛi fɔ̃ji, ni etu mi ewo yiwalɔi adɛŋ.

english_verse: Everything was going well, until God grabbed my neck and shook me to pieces. God set me up as the target
translation_verse: Kulɛ mihe ejɔ mi, ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɔ miyinɔ tɛ; emɔ mikuɛ, ni ekɛ mi tswia shi, ni ekumɔ mi dukuduku.

english_verse: for his arrows, and without showing mercy, he slashed my stomach open, spilling out my insides.
translation_verse: Egãitsɛ̃lɔi lɛ bɔle mi kɛkpe kpula; ekɛ kakla gbala misabai amli, ni ekɔ̃ɔɔ efiliii kwraa; efɔse midrɔ eshwie shikpɔŋ.

english_verse: and so, in my sorrow I dress in sackcloth and sit in the dust.
translation_verse: Mikpɛ kpekpe miha miheloo he. Naa mi, mita mlu mli tamɔ mɔ ni aye enɔ kunim.

english_verse: My face is red with tears, and dark shadows circle my eyes,
translation_verse: Yaafo ehã mihiɛ etsu fɔɔ, ni mihiŋmɛii anaa etitii, ni edi tuŋŋ;

english_verse: though I am not violent, and my prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: tsɛbelɛ mikɛ minine yeko awui ko, ni misɔleɔ mikpaa Nyɔŋmɔ fai kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ.

english_verse: If I should die, I beg the earth not to cover my cry for justice.
translation_verse: Oo shikpɔŋ, kaaha milá lɛ nɔ! Oo, shikpɔŋ, kaatsimɔ sane fɔŋ ni aye mi lɛ nɔ; hã miyaafo ashɛ hei fɛɛ.

english_verse: Even now, God in heaven is both my witness and my protector.
translation_verse: Naa, amrɔmrɔ nɛɛ tete midasefonyo yɛ ŋwɛi; mɔ ni baawie ehã mi lɛ yɛ ŋwɛi flooflo.

english_verse: My friends have rejected me, but God is the one I beg
translation_verse: Minanemɛi miiye mihe fɛo; shi miifo miitsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: to show that I am right, just as a friend should.
translation_verse: Mina mɔ ko ni ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ awie ahã mi, tamɔ bɔ ni gbɔmɔ damɔɔ mli hãa enaanyo gbɔmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Because in only a few years, I will be dead and gone.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ biɛ afii fioo ko sɛɛ lɛ, mibaya he ni mikuŋ misɛɛ kɛjɛŋ kɛbaŋ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: My hopes have died, my time is up, and the grave is ready.
translation_verse: “Misusuma etɔ bahao; miwala gbii lɛ etã, gbonyobu miimɛ mi!

english_verse: All I can see are angry crowds, making fun of me.
translation_verse: Anɔkwa ji akɛ hefɛoyelɔi ebɔle mi, ni mihiŋmɛii jwere mlilawoo nibii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: If you, Lord, don't help, who will pay the price for my release?
translation_verse: Miiye bo anɔkwa, Nyɔŋmɔ, he mi oye!

english_verse: My friends won't really listen, all because of you, and so you must be the one to prove them wrong.
translation_verse: Akɛni oŋamɔ amɛjwɛŋmɔi anaa koni amɛkanu sane shishi hewɔ lɛ, ohaŋ amɛye minɔ kunim ko.

english_verse: They have condemned me, just to benefit themselves; now blind their children.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ enanemɛi asɛɛgbɛ, bɔ ni afee ni kɛji aja amɛnii lɛ, ena eko lɛ, ebii ahiŋmɛii tete aaafite.

english_verse: You, God, are the reason I am insulted and spit on.
translation_verse: Efee mi nɔ ni akɛbuɔ abɛ ehã maŋbii, ni mitsɔ̃ mɔ ni afɛ̃ɔ lajɔ̃ ashwieɔ ehiɛ.

english_verse: I am almost blind with grief; my body is a mere shadow.
translation_verse: Awerɛho sɔŋŋ ehã mihiŋmɛi nɔ efee kusuu, ni miniji kɛ mi naji efee kanyakanya, amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ hɔ̃ɔŋ.

english_verse: People who are truly good would feel so alarmed, that they would become angry with my worthless friends.
translation_verse: Enɛ hãa mɛi ni feɔ jalɛ nii ahe jɔ̃ɔ amɛhe; ni mɔ ni efeko nɔ fɔŋ griɔ ewoɔ mɔ fɔŋ.

english_verse: They would do the right thing and because they did, they would grow stronger.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ jalɔ lɛ fiɔ shi yɛ egbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni mɔ ni niji ahe tse hewalɛ shwereɔ kɛyaa naanɔ.

english_verse: But none of my friends show any sense.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛ, nyɛ fɛɛ, nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ kɛbaa; shi minaŋ nilelɔ ko nilelɔ ko yɛ nyɛteŋ.

english_verse: My life is drawing to an end; hope has disappeared.
translation_verse: Migbii lɛ eho etee; miyiŋtoi, ni ji nɔ ni mitsui shwe lɛ, fɛɛ efee yaka.

english_verse: But all my friends can do is offer empty hopes.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛ gbɛkɛ feɔ shwane, ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “La ebɛŋkɛ”.

english_verse: I could tell the world below to prepare me a bed.
translation_verse: Kɛji miŋɔ miwe lɛ akɛ gbohiiaje, kɛ miŋmɛ misaa lɛ yɛ duŋ lɛ mli,

english_verse: Then I could greet the grave as my father and say to the worms, “Hello, mother and sisters!”
translation_verse: ni kɛji mikɛɛ bu lɛ akɛ, “Mitsɛ ji bo”, ni mikɛɛ gɔgɔmi akɛ, “Minyɛ loo minyɛmi yoo ji bo lɛ”,

english_verse: But what kind of hope is that?
translation_verse: no lɛ nɛgbɛ mihiɛnɔkãmɔ yɔɔ? Namɔ baana mihiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ?

english_verse: Will it keep me company in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Ani hiɛnɔkãmɔ hu aaaya Gbohiiaje? Ani wɔ kɛ lɛ fɛɛ baakpleke shi kɛya su mli lo?”

english_verse: How long will you talk? Be sensible! Let us speak.
translation_verse: “Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ooogbe wiemɔ naa? Susumɔ he koni wɔwie.

english_verse: Or do you think that we are dumb animals?
translation_verse: Mɛɛba obuɔ wɔ tamɔ tsinai? Mɛɛba wɔtamɔ mɛi ni bɛ yitseiaŋ yɛ ohiɛ lɛ?

english_verse: You cut yourself in anger. Will that shake the earth or even move the rocks? *
translation_verse: Bo diɛŋtsɛ okɛ omlifu yeɔ bo nɔŋŋ ohe awui. Aso ootao akɛ ashi je lɛ ahã bo, aloo ohewɔ lɛ abaafamɔ tɛsai ashwie?

english_verse: The lamps of sinful people soon are snuffed out,
translation_verse: Hɛɛ, abaagbe mɔ fɔŋ kane lɛ, ni ela lɛ etsoŋ dɔŋŋ!

english_verse: Their powerful legs become weak, and they stumble on schemes of their own doing. *
translation_verse: Enaji ni efamɔɔ waawaa lɛ nɔ baagbɔ, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiŋtoi baatsi lɛ atswa shi.

english_verse: they are trapped in a net,
translation_verse: Enanetsitsi aaadu jwao, ni kpãa ni akɛtsɔ tsɔne aaadu lɛ.

english_verse: Terror strikes and pursues from every side.
translation_verse: Ehewɔ nibii fɛɛ ni bɔle lɛ ehã ŋmiŋmi emɔ lɛ, ni amɛnyiɛ esɛɛ kpaakpa.

english_verse: Starving, they run, only to meet disaster,
translation_verse: Ehewalɛ baatã, ni amanehulu efee kralo eto etɛmɔ kɛ shigbeemɔ.

english_verse: then afterwards to be eaten alive by death itself.
translation_verse: Hela baakpãtã ehewolo hiɛ, gbele kromɔbi lɛ baaye eniji kɛ enaji.

english_verse: Those sinners are dragged from the safety of their tents to die a gruesome death.
translation_verse: Aaakpɔ lɛ yɛ shĩa ni ehiɛ kã nɔ lɛ mli; ni akɛ lɛ aaatee maŋtsɛ ni hãa ŋmiŋmi mɔɔ lɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Then their tents and possessions are burned to ashes,
translation_verse: Mɔkpɔŋ aaayahi ewe lɛ mli kɛji ashwã mli swɔɔ kɛgbe emli muawa sɛɛ.

english_verse: and they are left like trees, dried up from the roots.
translation_verse: Eshishifãi lɛ aaagbi yɛ shishigbɛ ni eniji hu aaaŋala yɛ eyiteŋ.

english_verse: thrown far from the light into a world of darkness,
translation_verse: Ashwie lɛ kɛje la hiɛ kɛtee duŋ mli, ni ashwie lɛ kɛje jeŋ.

english_verse: without any children to carry on their name.
translation_verse: Ebi loo eshwie bɛ emaŋbii ateŋ, ni eshwɛko mɔ ko mɔ ko yɛ shihilɛhe lɛ mli.

english_verse: Everyone, from east to west, is overwhelmed with horror.
translation_verse: Anaigbɛbii ahe aaajɔ̃ amɛhe, yɛ nɔ ni eba enɔ lɛ hewɔ, ni ŋmiŋmi aaamɔmɔ bokãgbɛbii hu.

english_verse: Such is the fate of sinners and their families who don't know God.
translation_verse: Anɔkwa, bɔ pɛ ni mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei ashĩai feɔ nɛ; mɔ ni leee Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɛkɛ eshihilɛhe tsɔ̃ɔ.”

english_verse: How long will you torture me with your words?
translation_verse: “Mɛɛ beyinɔ nyɛaagba minaa, ni nyɛkɛ wiemɔ aaasu mitsui kɛaayashi?

english_verse: Isn't ten times enough for you to accuse me? Aren't you ashamed?
translation_verse: Shii abɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛmiibɔ mi ahora; efeee nyɛ hiɛgbele akɛ nyɛmiitɔ̃ minɔ?

english_verse: Even if I have sinned, you haven't been harmed.
translation_verse: Kɛji eyɛ mli tete akɛ mifee efɔŋ lɛ, mɛni no kɔɔ yɛ nyɛhe?

english_verse: You boast of your goodness, claiming I am suffering because I am guilty.
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛmiiwo nyɛhe nɔ yɛ minɔ, ni nyɛmiiŋɔ mimanehului lɛ akɛ minɔ fɔŋ lɛ he okadi lɛ,

english_verse: But God is the one at fault for finding fault with me.
translation_verse: no lɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ebu mi fɔ, ni ekɛ eyaa lɛ ebɔle mi kɛsa miyi.

english_verse: Though I pray to be rescued from this torment, no whisper of justice answers me.
translation_verse: Naa, mibolɔɔ akɛ aawa mi yi, shi ahereee mi nɔ; miboɔ koni aye abua mi, shi ayeee mi jalɛ sane.

english_verse: God has me trapped with a wall of darkness
translation_verse: Etswa gbogbo ekɛsa minaa, ni no hewɔ lɛ, minyɛɛɛ maho; ni ehã migbɛ lɛ nɔ ewo duŋ.

english_verse: and attacks with fierce anger, as though I were his enemy.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ mli ewo la ewo mi, ni ebuɔ mi akɛ ehenyɛlɔ.

english_verse: His entire army advances, then surrounds my tent. I Am Forgotten *
translation_verse: Etabilɔi lɛ ba kutuu, amɛfo sa amɛwo mihe, ni amɛbɔle miwe lɛ kɛkpe.

english_verse: God has turned relatives and friends against me,
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ ehã minyɛmimɛi ekwa mi, ni mɛi ni le mi etsɔ̃mɔ amɛhe mɛi kpɔji amɛhã mi.

english_verse: My guests and my servants consider me a stranger,
translation_verse: mishĩa mli gbɔi ahiɛ ekpa minɔ, mitsuji yei buɔ mi akɛ gbɔ, mitsɔ̃ mɔkpɔŋ yɛ amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: and when I call my servants, they pay no attention.
translation_verse: Kɛji mitsɛ mitsulɔ lɛ, efooo midaaŋ; kɛji mikpa lɛ fai tete, nakai nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: My breath disgusts my wife; everyone in my family turns away.
translation_verse: Midaaŋ lamɔ eje fu ewo miŋa, minyɛ musuŋbii tete nyɛɛɛ mihe fu naa amɛdamɔ.

english_verse: Young children can't stand me, and when I come near, they make fun.
translation_verse: Mihe guɔ egbo yɛ gbekɛbii tete ahiɛ, ni amɛshwieɔ shi kɛ ŋmɔlɔ kɛji amɛna mi.

english_verse: My best friends and loved ones have turned from me.
translation_verse: Mishieŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ miinyaŋe mi, ni mɛi ni misumɔɔ etsɔ̃mɔ amɛhiɛ amɛwo mi.

english_verse: I am skin and bones— just barely alive.
translation_verse: Miwui ekpɛtɛ mihewolo, ni dromɔ naa kɛkɛ ni miyɔɔ wala mli nɛɛ.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you for pity! God has made me his target.
translation_verse: Oo, minanemɛi, nyɛnaa mi mɔbɔ! Nyɛnaa mi mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nine eta mihe!

english_verse: Hasn't he already done enough? Why do you join the attack?
translation_verse: Mɛɛba nyɛwaa mi yi tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efee mi lɛ?

english_verse: I wish that my words could be written down
translation_verse: Oo, mina ni kulɛ aŋmã minaa wiemɔi lɛ! Oo, mina ni kulɛ aŋmã awo wolo mli!

english_verse: I know that my Protector lives, and at the end he will stand on this earth.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mile akɛ, mikpɔlɔ lɛ hiɛ kã, ni naagbee mli lɛ eeedamɔ misɛɛ;

english_verse: My flesh may be destroyed, yet from this body I will see God.
translation_verse: ni kɛji mihewolo hiɛ kpãtã nɛkɛ sɛɛ, ni heloo bɛ mihe lɛ, mana Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: Yes, I will see him for myself, and I long for that moment.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ mana, ni mayoo lɛ; ejeee mɔkpɔŋ ko. Mitsui miitse yɛ mimli!

english_verse: My friends, you think up ways to blame and torment me, saying I brought it on myself.
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛmiikɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni wɔɔtsɔ̃ wɔwa lɛ yi!” Kɛ “Sane tso muu fɛɛ lɛ jɛ lɛ” lɛ,

english_verse: But watch out for the judgment, when God will punish you!
translation_verse: nyɛshea klante gbeyei, klante lɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu kɛ kojomɔ kɛbaa lɛ, koni nyɛna nyɛle akɛ kojomɔ ko yɛ.”

english_verse: Your words are disturbing; now I must speak.
translation_verse: “Miyiŋ kɛ mi ewie, ni mihe miitswa shi ni mahã bo hetoo.

english_verse: You have accused and insulted me, and reason requires a reply.
translation_verse: Minu jɛmɔi ni ojɛ mi lɛ, ni mile hetoo ni mahã bo.

english_verse: Since the time of creation, everyone has known
translation_verse: Aso oleee kɛjɛ teteete, kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni abɔ gbɔmɔ adesa ato shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: that sinful people are happy for only a while.
translation_verse: akɛ efɔŋfeelɔi anyamɔ sɛɛ etsɛɛɛ, ni mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei amiishɛɛ yeɔ hiŋmɛitswaa kɛkɛ!

english_verse: Though their pride and power may reach to the sky,
translation_verse: Egbojee aaakwɔ kɛshɛ ŋwɛi, ni eyitso tete aaashɛ atatuiaŋ;

english_verse: they will disappear like dust, and those who knew them will wonder what happened.
translation_verse: kɛ̃lɛ amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã kɛya naanɔ tamɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwamɔ. Mɛi ni ena amɛ pɛŋ lɛ aaabi akɛ, ‘Nɛgbɛ amɛtee?’

english_verse: They will be forgotten like a dream
translation_verse: Ebaalaaje tamɔ lamɔ, ni anaŋ lɛ; ebaalaaje tamɔ nyɔɔŋ ninaa.

english_verse: and vanish from the sight of family and friends.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni ena lɛ lɛ, enaŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ, ni eshihilɛhe lɛ enaŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Their children will have to repay what the parents took from the poor.
translation_verse: Ekɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ eniji baadãi enii ni ena kɛjɛ ohiafoi adɛŋ lɛ ehã amɛ. Ebii baatao koni ohiafoi ana amɛhe tsuijurɔ.

english_verse: Indeed, the wicked will die and go to their graves in the prime of life. Sinners Love the Taste of Sin
translation_verse: Egbɔmɔtso yɛ kpiŋtiŋkpliŋŋ kɛ oblahiiaŋ hewalɛ nɛ, shi fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ sũ.

english_verse: Sinners love the taste of sin; they relish every bite
translation_verse: Yɛ mli akɛ nɔfɔŋfeemɔ ŋɔɔ enaa, ni ekɛteɔ yɛ elilɛi shishi,

english_verse: But their food will turn sour and poison their stomachs.
translation_verse: kɛ̃lɛ eniyenii lɛ tsakeɔ yɛ emusuŋ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ shinɔi adrɔ yɛ emli.

english_verse: Then God will make them lose the wealth they gobbled up.
translation_verse: Emimiɔ mɛi ajwetrii shi eshweɔ fɛɛ ekoŋŋ. Nyɔŋmɔ jieɔ fɛɛ kɛjɛɔ emusuŋ.

english_verse: They will die from the fangs of poisonous snakes
translation_verse: Eeeshwɔ shinɔi anaa ebɔɔ, ni no aaagbe lɛ tamɔ nɔ ni blikã ekɔ̃ lɛ.

english_verse: and never enjoy rivers flowing with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Ehiŋmɛi enaŋ fai lɛ ekwɛ, fai ni hoɔ ni eyi kɛ wo kɛ fufɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Their hard work will result in nothing gained,
translation_verse: Eeedãi nibii ni egbo he deŋme fɛɛ ehã, ni enaŋ hegbɛ eye eninenaa nitsumɔ mli ŋɔɔmɔ,

english_verse: because they cheated the poor and took their homes.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ ewa ohiafoi ayi, ni ekwa amɛ, ni shĩa ni jeee lɛ ema lɛ, eshɔ̃ɔ ekãa naa.

english_verse: Greedy people want everything and are never satisfied.
translation_verse: Akɛni fufeemɔ leee mitɔ hewɔ lɛ, eyeee nii ni ŋɔɔ enaa ni eshwɛ eko.

english_verse: But when nothing remains for them to grab, they will be nothing.
translation_verse: Kɛji eye nii lɛ eshwɛɛɛ eko, no hewɔ lɛ, eninamɔ sɛɛ etsɛŋ.

english_verse: Once they have everything, distress and despair will strike them down,
translation_verse: Enii ni ena babaoo lɛ mli po, eeefĩ lɛ, ni hejaramɔ ni baaba enɔ lɛ naa baawa pam.

english_verse: While running from iron spears, they will be killed by arrows of bronze,
translation_verse: Ebaajo dade tawuunii anaa foi; shi akɔɔble gãi aaagbu emli kɛho.

english_verse: whose shining tips go straight through their bodies. They will be trapped by terror,
translation_verse: Abaagbala gãi lɛ, ni ebaaje kpo yɛ egbɔmɔtso lɛ mli; gãi lɛ naa kaŋkaŋ lɛ fãa kɛjɛɔ edɔrɔ mli; ni gbele ŋmiŋmi mɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: and what they treasure most will be lost in the dark. God will send flames to destroy them in their tents with all their property.
translation_verse: Ejwetri ni ena fɛɛ hiɛ aaakpãtã; la ni mɔ ko mɔ ko huuu baashã enii ni eshwɛ yɛ eshĩa mli fɛɛ.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth will testify against them,
translation_verse: Ŋwɛi aaajie enifɔɔji anii kpo etsɔ̃ɔ, ni je lɛ aaate shi awo lɛ.

english_verse: and all their possessions will be dragged off when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: Enii ni ena fɛɛ hiɛ aaakpãtã, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: This is what God has decided for those who are evil.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ eto ehã gbɔmɔ fɔŋ nɛ, gboshinii ni Nyɔŋmɔ yɔɔ hã lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: If you want to offer comfort, then listen to me.
translation_verse: “Nyɛboa nɔ ni miyɔɔ kɛɛmɔ toi jogbaŋŋ, ni no afee nɔ ni nyɛkɛaashɛje mimii.

english_verse: And when I have finished, you can start your insults all over again.
translation_verse: Nyɛnaa tsui nyɛhãa mi, ni mi hu mawie; ni kɛji miwie migbe naa lɛ, koni nyɛye mihe fɛo.

english_verse: My complaint is against God; that's why I am impatient.
translation_verse: Ani gbɔmɔ mikɛna lɛ? Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mato tsui shi?

english_verse: Just looking at me is enough to make you sick,
translation_verse: Nyɛkwɛa mi, ni nyɛhe aaajɔ̃ nyɛhe; ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnine aaato nyɛnaabu.

english_verse: and the very thought of myself fills me with disgust.
translation_verse: Kɛji mijwɛŋ he lɛ, miwerɛ hoɔ, ni ŋmiŋmi mɔɔ mi.

english_verse: Why do evil people live so long and gain such power?
translation_verse: Mɛni hewɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji ayi naa wala, amɛgbɔlɔɔ, ni amɛjeɔ agbo kɛ hewalɛ?

english_verse: Why are they allowed to see their children grow up?
translation_verse: Amɛnaa amɛbii ashweremɔ, ni amɛnabii daraa yɛ amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: They have no worries at home, and God never punishes them.
translation_verse: Asheee gbeyei yɛ amɛshĩai amli, ni Nyɔŋmɔ edɔɔɔ kpãa etooo amɛnɔ.

english_verse: Their cattle have lots of calves without ever losing one;
translation_verse: Amɛtsina hii lɛ kwɔɔ; ni efeee yaka, ni amɛtsina yei lɛ sharakeee.

english_verse: their children play and dance safely by themselves.
translation_verse: Amɛhãa amɛbii jeɔ kpo, ni amɛtumɔɔ kɛ shwɛmɔ tamɔ toobii.

english_verse: These people sing and celebrate to the sound of tambourines, small harps, and flutes,
translation_verse: Amɛlaa kɛnyiɛɔ milɛ̃ kɛ saŋku sɛɛ; ni amɛnyaa kɛji blɛ gbɛɛ.

english_verse: and they are successful, without a worry, until the day they die. Leave Us Alone!
translation_verse: Amɛyeɔ ejurɔ yɛ amɛwala mli, ni amɛyaa gbohiiaje kpoo kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ.

english_verse: Those who are evil say to God All-Powerful, “Leave us alone! Don't bother us with your teachings.
translation_verse: Yiwalɔi kɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “Jee wɔnɔ! Wɔtaooo wɔle bɔ ni otaoɔ akɛ aba jeŋ ahã.

english_verse: We succeeded all on our own.” And so, I keep away from them and their evil schemes.
translation_verse: Naa, amɛshweremɔ lɛ aso jeee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhewalɛ mli eyɔɔ? Shi yiwalɔi asusumɔ nɛɛ lɛ, mi lɛ miŋɔɔɔ nɔ.

english_verse: How often does God become angry and send disaster and darkness to punish sinners?
translation_verse: Shii enyiɛ agbe mɛi fɔ̃ji akane lɛ, ni amanehulu eba amɛnɔ, aloo Nyɔŋmɔ ehã amɛpiŋ yɛ emlifu naa

english_verse: How often does he strike them like a windstorm that scatters straw?
translation_verse: ni amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ jwɛi yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ naa, loo tutuu ni kɔɔyɔɔ loɔ kɛyaa?

english_verse: You say, “God will punish those sinners' children in place of those sinners.” But I say, “Let him punish those sinners themselves until they really feel it.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ etĩa amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ anaa eto ehã amɛbii. Dabida! Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala efɔŋfeelɔ toi yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ fɔŋ lɛ hewɔ, koni amɛna amɛle nɔ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛfee lɛ.’

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful force them to drink their own destruction from the cup of his anger.
translation_verse: Hã ena lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛ ehiŋmɛii ni esa enaa Ofe lɛ mlifu lɛ eko.

english_verse: Because after they are dead, they won't care what happens to their children.” Who Can Tell God What To Do?
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛɛ ŋkɔmɔ eyeɔ yɛ ebii ni eshi he, kɛji egbii asɛɛ efo yɛ jeŋ?

english_verse: Who can tell God what to do? He judges powerful rulers. *
translation_verse: Aso mɔ ko aaanyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nilee etsɔ̃ɔ, lɛ mɔ ni ekojoɔ ŋwɛibii tete po lɛ?

english_verse: while others die in poverty, having known only pain.
translation_verse: Mɔ ko hu gboɔ yɛ awerɛhoo mli, ni eyeko ŋɔɔmɔ ko kwraa dã.

english_verse: But we all end up dead, beneath a blanket of worms.
translation_verse: Amɛ fɛɛ amɛyajwereɔ su mli, ni gɔgɔmii haa amɛhe.

english_verse: My friends, I know that you are plotting against me.
translation_verse: Naa, mile nyɛjwɛŋmɔi kɛ ŋaa ni nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ kɛgba minaa fɛɛ.

english_verse: You ask, “Where is the home of that important person who does so much evil?”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɛbiɔ akɛ, ‘Nɛgbɛ lumɔ lɛ we lɛ yɔɔ agbɛnɛ, gbɔmɔ ni ji yiwalɔ lɛ?’

english_verse: that those who do wrong never suffer disaster, when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: akɛ abaa yiwalɔ yi yɛ amanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ; ni mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ ahereɔ eyiwala?

english_verse: No one points out their sin or punishes them.
translation_verse: Namɔ kãa yiwalɔ hiɛ, ni namɔ woɔ lɛ nɔ ni efee he nyɔmɔ?

english_verse: Then at their funerals, they are highly praised;
translation_verse: Kɛji atere lɛ ni ayaafu lɛ, abuɔ esaŋ lɛ he tete.

english_verse: the earth welcomes them home, while crowds mourn.
translation_verse: Nakai mɛi fɛɛ aaanyiɛ esɛɛ; ni mɛi ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ kɛtee ayifa babaoo.

english_verse: But empty, meaningless words are the comfort you offer me.
translation_verse: Mɛɛba mɔ nyɛaasumɔ akɛ nyɛkɛ yaka wiemɔi ashɛje mimii lɛ? Nyɛwiemɔi lɛ amale sɔŋŋ ni.”

english_verse: What use are we humans to God, even the wisest of us?
translation_verse: “Aso adesa ko he yɛ sɛɛnamɔ hã Nyɔŋmɔ? Anɔkwa, nilelɔ lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe sɛɛ enaa.

english_verse: If you were completely sinless, that would still mean nothing to God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ani eji miishɛɛ sane hã Ofe lɛ kɛji ofeɔ nii ni ja? Aloo Nyɔŋmɔ naa he sɛɛ kɛji ohi shi ni shwamɔ ko bɛ ohe?

english_verse: Is he correcting you for worshiping him?
translation_verse: Ani gbeyei ni osheɔ lɛ hewɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kãa ohiɛ, ni ekojoɔ bo nɛɛ?

english_verse: No! It's because of your terrible and endless sins.
translation_verse: Ani jeee oyiwalɛ nifeemɔi ni naa wa kɛ onifɔɔjianii ni aleee naa lɛ hewɔ ekɛ bo yeɔ nɛɛ?

english_verse: To guarantee payment of a debt, you have taken clothes from innocent people.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ onyɛ onyɛmimɛi anɔ, ni amɛto bo awaba yakatswaa; ni oshɔ̃ amɛheboi oŋmɛ amɛyayai.

english_verse: And you refused bread and water to the hungry and thirsty,
translation_verse: Mɔ ni etɔ lɛ lɛ, ohãaa lɛ nu ni enu; ni mɔ ni hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ hu okamaa lɛ niyenii.

english_verse: You have turned away widows and have broken the arms of orphans.
translation_verse: Yei okulafoi lɛ, ashwieɔ amɛ, amɛyaa kɛ amɛdɛ̃ folo.

english_verse: That's why you were suddenly trapped by terror,
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, tsɔnei ebɔle bo kɛkpe, ni ŋmiŋmi emɔ bo trukaa,

english_verse: blinded by darkness, and drowned in a flood. God Lives in the Heavens
translation_verse: duŋ ewo bo, ni no hewɔ lɛ, onaaa nii, ni nu afua eha onɔ.

english_verse: God lives in the heavens above the highest stars, where he sees everything.
translation_verse: Aso Nyɔŋmɔ bɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ? Kwɛmɔ bɔ ni ŋulamii lɛ ekomɛi yɔɔ shɔŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ hã.

english_verse: Do you think the deep darkness hides you from God?
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, okɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛni ji nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ le? Ani eeenyɛ etsɔ̃ duŋ kpii lɛ mli ekojo lo?’

english_verse: Do thick clouds cover his eyes, as he walks around heaven's dome high above the earth?
translation_verse: Osusuɔ akɛ atatui kabitii etsimɔ enɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, enaaa nii, ni ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ husu lɛ naa esharaa shi yɛ?

english_verse: Give up those ancient ideas believed by sinners,
translation_verse: Ani obaaba blema jeŋba gbonyo ni yiwalɔi lɛ ba lɛ eko?

english_verse: They rejected God All-Powerful, feeling he was helpless,
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, ‘Jee wɔnɔ!’ Ni ‘Mɛni Ofe lɛ baanyɛ wɔ efee?’

english_verse: although he had been kind to their families. The beliefs of these sinners are truly disgusting.
translation_verse: Tsɛbelɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni hã amɛshĩai shwere kɛ nii. Minuuu mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ ashishi!

english_verse: When God's people see the godless swept away, they celebrate,
translation_verse: Mɛi ni feɔ jalɛnii naa, ni efeɔ amɛ miishɛɛ; mɛi ni efeko efɔŋ ko lɛ yeɔ amɛhe fɛo.

english_verse: saying, “Our enemies are gone, and fire has destroyed their possessions.” Surrender to God All-Powerful
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Anɔkwa, akpãtã wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ, ni nii ni amɛshi hu la ekpãtã hiɛ.’

english_verse: Surrender to God All-Powerful! You will find peace and prosperity.
translation_verse: Okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akpãtã, koni otoiŋ ajɔ bo; no nɔ aaatsɔ̃ ni oooye ejurɔ.

english_verse: Listen to his teachings and take them to heart.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ enaa wiemɔi lɛ amli, ni okɛ ewiemɔi lɛ ato otsuiŋ.

english_verse: If you return to God and turn from sin, all will go well for you.
translation_verse: Kpalemɔ kɛya Ofe lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni oba ohe shi. Kpa nibii ni ejaaa feemɔ lɛ yɛ owe lɛ mli.

english_verse: So get rid of your finest gold, as though it were sand.
translation_verse: Kɛ okɛ oshika yawo mlu mli, ni okɛ Ofir shika yawo faa ni hoɔ shishi tɛi amli,

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful be your silver and gold,
translation_verse: ni oŋɔ Ofe lɛ ofee oshika, kɛ ojwiɛtɛi ni jara wa lɛ,

english_verse: and you will find happiness by worshiping him.
translation_verse: no dani omli aaafli bo yɛ Ofe lɛ hiɛ, ni ooowo ohiɛ nɔ okwɛ Nyɔŋmɔ!

english_verse: God will answer your prayers, and you will keep the promises you made to him.
translation_verse: Sɔlemɔ okpa lɛ fai ni eeebo bo toi; ni oooye oshiwoi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: He will do whatever you ask, and life will be bright.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni oooto oyiŋ akɛ ooofee lɛ eeeye omanye ehã bo, ni la aaakpɛ ahã bo yɛ ogbɛ nɔ!

english_verse: When others are disgraced, God will clear their names in answer to your prayers.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ baa mɔ ni woɔ ehe nɔ shi, ni heshibalɔ lɛ, ehereɔ eyiwala.

english_verse: Even those who are guilty will be forgiven, because you obey God.
translation_verse: Ehereɔ mɔ ni efeko efɔŋ ko yiwala. Eeehere oyiwala kɛji ofeko esha.”

english_verse: Today I complain bitterly, because God has been cruel and made me suffer.
translation_verse: “Ŋmɛnɛ hu mikɔmɔyeli lɛ naa wa; minyɛɛɛ mitsɔidɔɔmɔ lɛ naa mamɔ.

english_verse: If I knew where to find God, I would go there
translation_verse: Oo, mile he ni mana lɛ yɛ kulɛ maya esɛi lɛ hiɛ tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: Then I would discover what he wanted to say.
translation_verse: Mana male nɔ hetoo ni eeehã mi ni mana manu nɔ ni eeekɛɛ mi lɛ shishi.

english_verse: Would he overwhelm me with his greatness? No! He would listen
translation_verse: Aso Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mi aaatao naa yɛ ehewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ naa? Dabida; eeebo mi toi kɛ̃.

english_verse: because I am innocent, and he would say, “I now set you free!”
translation_verse: Mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaayiyi yɛ jɛi; ni mikojolɔ lɛ aaabu mi bem ni maye mihe kɛaatee naanɔ.

english_verse: I cannot find God anywhere— in front or back of me,
translation_verse: Naa, kɛji mitee bokãgbɛ lɛ, ebɛ jɛi, ni miba anaigbɛ hu, minaaa lɛ.

english_verse: to my left or my right. God is always at work, though I never see him.
translation_verse: Mitao lɛ yɛ kooyigbɛ, shi minaaa lɛ; mitsɔ̃ mihe kɛtee wuoyigbɛ hu, shi mihiŋmɛi gbaaa enɔ.

english_verse: But he knows what I am doing, and when he tests me, I will be pure as gold. *
translation_verse: Shi Nyɔŋmɔ le minanefaamɔi fɛɛ; kɛji eka mi ekwɛ lɛ ebaana mi akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi.

english_verse: I have never refused to follow any of his commands,
translation_verse: Minyiɛ enanefãamɔ sɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ; no mli minyiɛ; migbako afã.

english_verse: and I have always treasured his teachings.
translation_verse: Mitswako Nyɔŋmɔ naa wiemɔ ko mifɔ̃ko afã dã; mikɛto mitsui shishi tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: But he alone is God, and who can oppose him? God does as he pleases,
translation_verse: Etsakeee; ni Lɛ lɛ eyɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ kɛjɛ sa, ni namɔ aaanyɛ enaa eku. Nɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ, no efeɔ.

english_verse: and he will do exactly what he intends with me. *
translation_verse: Nɔ ni eto ehã mi lɛ, ebaafee kɛgbe naa; ni nibii ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi pii yɛ eyiŋ.

english_verse: makes me tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ ehã mitsui efã; Ofe lɛ ewo mihe gbeyei,

english_verse: God has covered me with darkness, but I refuse to be silent.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ duŋ ebɔle mi kɛkpe ni duŋ kabitii ha mihiɛ.

english_verse: Why doesn't God set a time for court? Why don't his people know where he can be found?
translation_verse: “Mɛɛba Ofe lɛ etooo be pɔtɛ̃ɛ ni ekojoɔ, ni mɛɛba mɛi ni sɔmɔɔ lɛ tete leee ekojomɔ bei lɛ?

english_verse: Sinners remove boundary markers and take care of sheep they have stolen.
translation_verse: Mɛi tsirɛɔ husui kɛyaa sɛɛ, amɛshɔ̃ɔ mɛi akooloi ni amɛkɛshiɔ amɛkooloi anɔ amɛlɛɔ.

english_verse: They cheat orphans and widows by taking their donkeys and oxen.
translation_verse: Amɛshɔ̃ɔ awusãi atejii yɛ amɛdɛŋ kɛyaa; amɛhãa okulafo kɛ etsina toɔ amɛ awaba.

english_verse: The poor are trampled and forced to hide
translation_verse: Amɛtsirɛɔ ohiafoi kɛjeɔ gbɛteŋ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shitswialɔi fɛɛ teeteɔ amɛhe.

english_verse: in the desert, where they and their children must live like wild donkeys and search for food.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, naa, ohiafoi lɛ nyiɛ ŋa nɔ ni amɛmiitao niyenii tamɔ ŋaŋ teji amɛhã amɛbii koni amɛye.

english_verse: If they want grain or grapes, they must go to the property of these sinners.
translation_verse: Ŋa nɔ amɛfolɔɔ kooloi aniyenii yɛ; ni yiwalɔi awaintromi amli amɛyeɔ kpɛkpɛo yɛ.

english_verse: They sleep naked in the cold, because they have no cover,
translation_verse: Amɛkamɔɔ shi nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ kɛ amɛhe yayai, ni fɛ̃i be hu amɛbɛ hehaanɔ.

english_verse: and during a storm their only shelters are caves among the rocky cliffs.
translation_verse: Gɔji lɛ anɔ nyɔŋmɔ eyi amɛ, ni amɛhɔlɔ tɛkploi amli, ejaakɛ amɛbɛ abobaahe yɛ he ko he ko.

english_verse: Children whose fathers have died are taken from their mothers as payment for a debt.
translation_verse: Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi tseɔ abifao ni kã fufɔ naa awusã; ni amɛbiɔ, ni ohiafo kɛ ebi abifao tete batoɔ amɛ awaba.

english_verse: Then they are forced to work naked in the grain fields because they have no clothes, and they go hungry.
translation_verse: Ohiafoi nyiɛ yayai ni mama bɛ amɛhe; ni amɛtereɔ jatsu kɛ hɔmɔ.

english_verse: They crush olives to make oil and grapes to make wine— but still they go thirsty.
translation_verse: Amɛfeɔ mu yɛ yiwalɔi amutsei ateŋ; amɛŋaa wain kɛ wain tsɔnei nɛ, shi kumai yeɔ amɛ.

english_verse: And along the city streets, the wounded and dying cry out, yet God does nothing. Some Reject the Light
translation_verse: Aanu mɛi ni miigboi akɛ̃ɛmɔ kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni pilafoi miibolɔ kɛmiitsɛ yelikɛbuamɔ; kɛ̃lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ booo amɛfaikpamɔ toi.

english_verse: Soon after sunset they murder the poor and the needy, and at night they steal.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ teɔ shi leebi mra ni eyaa eyagbeɔ ohiafo kɛ shitswialɔ, ni kɛji je na hu lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ julɔ.

english_verse: Others wait for the dark, thinking they won't be seen if they sleep with the wife or husband of someone else.
translation_verse: Ni gbãlãfitelɔ hu mɛ̃ɔ hiɛbulɛ ni ekɛ nɔhaanɔ haa ehiɛ ni ekɛɔ akɛ, “Mɔ ko yooŋ mi.”

english_verse: Robbers hide during the day, then break in after dark because they reject the light.
translation_verse: Amɛjwaraa shĩai yɛ duŋ mli nyɔɔŋ; ni shwaneshwane lɛ amɛŋmɛɔ amɛyi amɛwoɔ tsuŋ; ni amɛkɛ hulu la lɛ bɛ sane ko.

english_verse: They prefer night to day, since the terrors of the night are their friends. Sinners Are Filthy Foam
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɔɔŋ duŋ kpii lɛ ji amɛleebi; ejaakɛ duŋ kpii mli gbeyei nibii lɛ ji amɛnanemɛi. [Zofa]

english_verse: Those sinners are filthy foam on the surface of the water. And so, their fields and vineyards will fall under a curse and won't produce.
translation_verse: Yiwalɔ lɛ, faa shaa lɛ kɛyaa shwiaa, ni Nyɔŋmɔ lomɔɔ eshikpɔŋ ni eshi lɛ; eyaaa ewaintrom lɛ mli gbɛ dɔŋŋ eyaŋaaa wain.

english_verse: Just as the heat of summer swallows the snow, the world of the dead swallows those who sin.
translation_verse: Jeŋ gbimɔ kɛ dɔlɛ hereŋŋ hãa snoo nu miiɔ, nakai gbohiiaje hu loɔ eshafeelɔi kɛyaa.

english_verse: Forgotten here on earth, and with their power broken, they taste sweet to worms.
translation_verse: Hiɛkpaa amɛ nɔ yɛ blohuiaŋ, akaiii amɛgbɛii tete dɔŋŋ; ni no hewɔ lɛ, akuɔ yiwalɛ mli tamɔ tso.

english_verse: Sinners take advantage of widows and other helpless women.
translation_verse: Amɛyeɔ yoo kene ni bɛ bi dɛŋ nii, ni amɛfeee yoo okulafo ejurɔ ko kwraa.

english_verse: But God's mighty strength destroys those in power. Even if they seem successful, they are doomed to fail.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ɔ ehewalɛ nɔ ehãa hewalɔi awala sɛɛ tsɛɔ; amɛteɔ shi ni amɛgboiɔ, kɛji jeŋshihilɛ je amɛtsine.

english_verse: God may let them feel secure, but they are never out of his sight.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ hãa amɛhiɔ shi shweshweeshwe, ni amɛkɛ amɛhe fɔ̃ɔ no nɔ, shi ehiŋmɛi kã amɛjeŋba he daa.

english_verse: Great for a while; gone forever! Sinners are mowed down like weeds, then they wither and die.
translation_verse: Awoɔ amɛ nɔ be kukuoo ko, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛlaaje; amɛgbiɔ tamɔ jwɛi, ni afolɔɔ amɛ ashwieɔ tamɔ akuɔ abele.

english_verse: God is the one to fear, because God is in control and rules the heavens.
translation_verse: “Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ hewalɛ fɛɛ yɔɔ, mɛi fɛɛ ashe lɛ gbeyei; ehã toiŋjɔlɛ ehe shi yɛ eŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.

english_verse: Who can count his army of stars? Isn't God the source of light?
translation_verse: Ani aaanyɛ etabilɔi ayibɔ akane? Namɔ kwraa nɔ ela lɛ etsooo yɛ?

english_verse: To him, not even the light of the moon and stars can ever be pure.
translation_verse: Naa, yɛ ehiɛ lɛ nyɔɔŋtsere kpɛɛɛ, ni ŋulamii lɛ hu ahe tseee;

english_verse: So how can we humans, when we are merely worms?
translation_verse: mbasroo adesa ni ji omlɛgɛ, adesa fɔmɔbi ni ji gɔgɔmi nɛɛ?”

english_verse: You have really been helpful to someone weak and weary.
translation_verse: “Ei, bɔ ni oyeɔ obuaa mɔ ni bɛ hewalɛ nɛ? Ei, bɔ ni ohereɔ mɔ ni egbɔjɔ lɛ yiwala nɛ?

english_verse: You have given great advice and wonderful wisdom to someone truly in need.
translation_verse: Kwɛ, bɔ ni owoɔ mɔ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ ŋaa ni ojieɔ nilee babaoo kpo otsɔ̃ɔ nɛ?

english_verse: How can anyone possibly speak with such understanding?
translation_verse: Namɔ wa bo kɛwie lɛ, ni namɔ mumɔ jɛ omli je kpo nɛɛ? [Bildad]

english_verse: Remember the terrible trembling of those in the world of the dead below the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Gbohii asusumai lɛ miikpokpo, ni fai lɛ kɛ amɛmli nibii fɛɛ miikpokpo.

english_verse: Nothing in that land of death and destruction is hidden from God,
translation_verse: Gbohiiaje kã shi kpetekplee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; nɔ ko nɔ ko ehaaa nɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.

english_verse: who hung the northern sky and suspended the earth on empty space.
translation_verse: Elɛɛ kooyigbɛ ŋwɛi lɛ mli eha shi yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ mli, ni eŋɔ je lɛ etsotsoro shi ni etsotsorooo nɔ ko nɔ ko nɔ.

english_verse: God stores water in clouds, but they don't burst,
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ tiaa nu naa yɛ atatu mli, kɛ̃lɛ nu lɛ tsiimɔ fɛɛɛ atatu lɛ.

english_verse: and he wraps them around the face of the moon.
translation_verse: Ehãa atatu lɛɔ shi, ni ehaa nyɔɔŋtsere hiɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: On the surface of the ocean, God has drawn a boundary line between light and darkness.
translation_verse: Efo akrabatsa yɛ ŋshɔ sɛɛ ni no etsɔ̃ husu ni kã la kɛ duŋ lɛ teŋ.

english_verse: And columns supporting the sky tremble at his command.
translation_verse: Akulashiŋi ni hiɛ ŋwɛi lɛ ahe kpokpoɔ, ni amɛhe jɔ̃ɔ amɛhe kɛji ekã amɛhiɛ lɛ.

english_verse: By his power and wisdom, God conquered the force of the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Ejɔɔ ŋshɔ he yɛ ehewalɛ naa, ni ekɛ enilee kpãtãa sasabonsam lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: The heavens became bright when he breathed, and the escaping sea monster died at his hands.
translation_verse: Emumɔ ji nɔ ni hãa ŋwɛi tseɔ, ni ekɛ enine kpãtãa onufu ni miijo foi ni eya lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: These things are merely a whisper of God's power at work. How little we would understand if this whisper ever turned into thunder!
translation_verse: Naa, ehewalɛ lɛ he okadii nyɔkɔsiɔ̃ɔi komɛi kɛkɛ nɛ; ni ewiemɔ ablɛbi fioo kɛkɛ wɔnuɔ lɛ. Shi namɔ aaanyɛ ele Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ lɛ kɛwula shi.”

english_verse: I am desperate because God All-Powerful refuses to do what is right. As surely as God lives,
translation_verse: “Mina Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, mɔ ni tswa misane lɛ efɔ̃ lɛ, kɛ Ofe lɛ, mɔ ni hã miwerɛ ho mihe lɛ, akɛ,

english_verse: and while he gives me breath,
translation_verse: gbii abɔ ni wala yɔɔ mimli, ni Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ hãa mimuɔ nɛɛ,

english_verse: I will tell only the truth.
translation_verse: amale ejeŋ minaa, ni mililɛi lakaŋ mɔ ko.

english_verse: Until the day I die, I will refuse to do wrong by saying you are right,
translation_verse: Enɛ akagbale mi akɛ mabu nyɛ bem; kɛyaashi magbo lɛ, miŋmɛŋ mibemyeli lɛ he.

english_verse: because each day my conscience agrees that I am innocent.
translation_verse: Mihiɛ mijalɛ lɛ mli kpɛŋŋ, ni miŋmɛŋ he; mihenilee ebuuu mi fɔ yɛ miwalaŋ gbii lɛ eko kwraa ahe.

english_verse: I pray that my enemies will suffer no less than the wicked.
translation_verse: Hã mihenyɛlɔ atsɔ̃ tamɔ yiwalɔ, ni hã mɔ ni teɔ shi ewoɔ mi lɛ atsɔ̃ tamɔ mɔ fɔŋ.

english_verse: Such people are hopeless, and God All-Powerful will cut them down,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛni ji mɔ ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ, be ni Nyɔŋmɔ efo ewala sɛɛ, ni eshɔ̃ ewala yɛ edɛŋ lɛ?

english_verse: without listening when they beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Kɛji fimɔ ba enɔ lɛ, ani Nyɔŋmɔ aaabo ebolɔmɔ toi?

english_verse: And that is what God should do, because they don't like him or ever pray.
translation_verse: Ani emii shɛɔ yɛ Ofe lɛ hewɔ, aloo esɔleɔ ebiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ be fɛɛ be?

english_verse: Now I will explain in detail what God All-Powerful does.
translation_verse: Matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ tsuɔ; mikɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ Ofe lɛ he eteŋ nyɛ.

english_verse: All of you have seen these things for yourselves. So you have no excuse. How God Treats the Wicked
translation_verse: Naa, nyɛ fɛɛ tswɛm nyɛna; mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ ni nyɛwieee wiemɔi ni ahe yɔɔ sɛɛnamɔ?

english_verse: Here is how God All-Powerful treats those who are wicked and brutal.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni mɔfɔŋ naa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ nɛ; nɔ ni Ofe lɛ yɔɔ hã yiwalɔ nɛ.

english_verse: They may have many children, but most of them will go hungry or suffer a violent death.
translation_verse: Kɛji ebii ayi fa babaoo lɛ, klante amɛyi fa amɛhã, ni eshwiei lɛ aboloo shɛŋ amɛnaa.

english_verse: Others will die of disease, and their widows won't be able to weep.
translation_verse: Bii ni eshiɔ yɛ esɛɛ lɛ, gbele hela gbeɔ amɛ; ni amɛkulafoi lɛ foŋ amɛ tete.

english_verse: The wicked may collect riches and clothes in abundance as easily as clay.
translation_verse: Yiwalɔ buaa jwiɛtɛi naa tamɔ mlu, ni eeebua atadei anaa eto tamɔ mɛ;

english_verse: But God's people will wear clothes taken from them and divide up their riches.
translation_verse: eeebua naa nɛ, shi mɔ ni baawo ji jalɔ, ni mɔ ni fɔbuu bɛ ehe ji mɔ ni baaja ejwiɛtɛi lɛ.

english_verse: No homes built by the wicked will outlast a cocoon or a shack.
translation_verse: Shĩa ni emaa lɛ etamɔ anaanu ntaŋ, loo asese ni bulɔ efee.

english_verse: Those sinners may go to bed rich, but they will wake up poor.
translation_verse: Eyakãa shi akɛ niiatsɛ, shi ebaŋ lɛ nakai dɔŋŋ; be ni eeegbele ehiŋmɛi lɛ enii ni eyɔɔ lɛ bɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Terror will strike at night like a flood or a storm.
translation_verse: Ŋmiŋmi mɔɔ lɛ tamɔ faa ni eje ŋa loɔ nibii; ahum woɔ lɛ kɛyaa nyɔɔŋ.

english_verse: Then a scorching wind will sweep them away
translation_verse: Bokã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ woɔ lɛ kɛyaa, ebɛɔ lɛ kɛjeɔ eshĩaŋ kɛyaa.

english_verse: without showing mercy, as they try to escape.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ̃ɔ kɛbaa enɔ ni enaaa lɛ mɔbɔ, be ni etaoɔ foi ejo kɛjɛ edɛŋ lɛ.

english_verse: At last, the wind will celebrate because they are gone.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ tswaa edɛŋ eshwieɔ enɔ, ni eboɔ lɛ ‘tsiaa!’ kɛjɛ eshihilɛhe lɛ mli.

english_verse: the same is done with iron and copper.
translation_verse: Atsaa dade yɛ shikpɔŋ ni asereɔ akɔɔble kɛjɛɔ tɛ mli.

english_verse: Miners carry lanterns deep into the darkness to search for these metals.
translation_verse: Mɛi sheee duŋ gbeyei, ni amɛboteɔ duŋ mli amɛyataoɔ tɛi ni yɔɔ duŋ kabitii lɛ mli kɛyaa duŋ lɛ shishi tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: They dig tunnels in distant, unknown places, where they dangle by ropes.
translation_verse: Mɛi yatsaa shika bui yɛ hei ni gbɔmɔ bɛ. Gbɛfalɔi ahiɛ kpaa amɛnɔ; amɛtsotsoroɔ kpãa naa kɛyaa kɛbaa yɛ shika bui lɛ amli.

english_verse: Far beneath the grain fields, fires are built to break loose those rocks
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ mli niyenii jɛɔ; shi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔŋŋ shishi lɛ, efee tamɔ nɔ ni la eshã.

english_verse: Miners go to places unseen by the eyes of hawks;
translation_verse: Okropɔŋ leee jɛigbɛ lɛ, akroma ko hiŋmɛi enako jɛi dã.

english_verse: they walk on soil unknown to the proudest lions.
translation_verse: Kooloi kakawuai lɛ eko kwraa nane yiko gbɛ lɛ nɔ dã, ni jata tsɔ̃ko enɔ kɛhoko dã.

english_verse: With their own hands they remove sharp rocks and uproot mountains.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ kɛ enine tsaa tswɛrɛbo tɛ, ni etsaa gɔji ashishi ekɛwuleɔ amɛ eshwieɔ shi.

english_verse: They dig through the rocks in search of jewels and precious metals.
translation_verse: Be mli ni ekpɛɔ gbɛ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ tɛsai amli lɛ, ehiŋmɛi naa ojarawatɛi fɛɛ.

english_verse: They also uncover the sources of rivers and discover secret places. Where Is Wisdom Found?
translation_verse: Etsĩɔ fai anaa koni amɛkanyɛ amɛho, ni nii ni akɛtee shishi lɛ, ejieɔ lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: Nor can it be discovered in the deepest sea. *
translation_verse: Ŋshɔŋ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ, ‘Ebɛ mimli!’ Ni ŋshɔ hu kɛɛ, ‘Ebɛ miŋɔɔ!’

english_verse: It is worth much more than silver or pure gold
translation_verse: Atseee shika aheee, ni anyɛŋ aŋmɛ jwiɛtɛi ni baashɛ enyɔmɔwo.

english_verse: Nothing is its equal— not gold or costly glass.
translation_verse: Shika kɛ ashwishwɛ kɛ lɛ yeee hegbɔ; ni akɛtsakeŋ shika jwinei kpakpai diɛŋtsɛ.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than coral, jasper, or rubies.
translation_verse: Atsiŋ tɛ̃ŋlɛ̃o kɛ kɔli tã yɛ he ni eyɔɔ; nilee jara wa fe adiagba.

english_verse: All the topaz of Ethiopia and the finest gold cannot compare with it.
translation_verse: Etiopia ojarawatɛ topasiɔn kɛ lɛ yeee hegbɔ, ni anyɛŋ aŋmɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni baashɛ ejara.

english_verse: It is hidden from human eyes and even from birds.
translation_verse: Aŋɔ tee, ni hiɛkãalɔ ko hiŋmɛi enaŋ; akɛtee loofɔji ni filikiɔ yɛ ŋwɛi tete.

english_verse: Death and destruction have merely heard rumors about where it is found.
translation_verse: Gbele kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛɛ, ‘He kɛkɛ wɔnu kɛ wɔtoi ni aawie.’

english_verse: God is the only one who knows the way to wisdom;
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ pɛ ni le gbɛ ni kã kɛyaa he; ni lɛ ele he ni eyɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: When God divided out the wind and the water,
translation_verse: Be ni eŋmɛ kɔɔyɔɔ hewalɛ ehã lɛ, ni esusu ŋshɔi kɛ fai afalɛ,

english_verse: and when he decided the path for rain and lightning,
translation_verse: be ni etsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni nu anɛ ahã, kɛ bɔ ni srawa agba kɛnyiɛ ŋwɛi ahã lɛ;

english_verse: God told us, “Wisdom means that you respect me, the Lord, and turn from sin.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ adesã akɛ, ‘Naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbeyeishemɔ lɛ, no ji nilee, ni hewii kɛ efɔŋ hejee ji jwɛŋmɔ.’ ”

english_verse: I long for the past, when God took care of me,
translation_verse: “Oo, mina ni kulɛ mitsɔ̃ tamɔ bɔ ni miyɔɔ be ko ni eho lɛ, be mli ni Nyɔŋmɔ buɔ mihe lɛ,

english_verse: and the light from his lamp showed me the way through the dark.
translation_verse: be ni ela lɛ kpɛɔ yɛ miyiteŋgbɛ ni minaa nii yɛ duŋ mli lɛ.

english_verse: I was in the prime of life, God All-Powerful was my closest friend,
translation_verse: No be mli lɛ, minibii shwere, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naanyobɔɔ bu miwe lɛ he.

english_verse: and all of my children were nearby.
translation_verse: Ofe lɛ kɛ mi yɛ, ni mimusuŋbii hu bɔle mihe kɛkpe.

english_verse: My herds gave enough milk to bathe my feet, and from my olive harvest flowed rivers of oil. *
translation_verse: Mitsinai kɛ mitoi hãa mi fufɔ babaoo, ni mimutsei shwere yɛ tɛsai amli.

english_verse: When I sat down at the meeting of the city council,
translation_verse: Kɛji mije kpo kɛtee maŋ koi lɛ shi, ni miyata shi yɛ blohuŋ lɛ,

english_verse: while the older ones stood
translation_verse: lumɛi tete fɔ̃ɔ wiemɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛniji toɔ amɛnaabu;

english_verse: and remained silent. Everyone Was Pleased
translation_verse: abladei agbei laajeɔ, ni amɛlilɛi kpɛtɛɔ amɛdaaŋ.

english_verse: Everyone was pleased with what I said and did.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɛɛ ni nuɔ mihe lɛ jɔɔ mi, ni kɛji amɛna mi lɛ, amɛkafoɔ mi.

english_verse: When poor people or orphans cried out for help, I came to their rescue.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mihereɔ ohiafo ni foɔ kɛ awusã ni bɛ bualɔ lɛ.

english_verse: And I was highly praised for my generosity to widows and others in poverty.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni hiɛ heɔ akpãtã lɛ jɔɔmɔ baninaa mi, ni mihãa okulafo tsui nyɔɔ emli kɛ nyamɔ.

english_verse: Kindness and justice were my coat and hat;
translation_verse: Jalɛ ji mimama ni mibuɔ, ni mijalɛ saneyeli ji mitade kɛ akekre.

english_verse: I was helpful to the blind and to the lame.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ̃ hiŋmɛi mihã shwilafo, ni mitsɔ̃ naji mihã obubuafo.

english_verse: I was a father to the needy, and I defended them in court, even if they were strangers.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ̃ tsɛ mihã ohiafoi ni mɛi ni mileee amɛ tete mitao amɛsaji amli mihã amɛ.

english_verse: When criminals attacked, I broke their teeth and set their victims free.
translation_verse: Mikumɔ mɔfɔŋ lɛ nyanyɔji yɛ edaaŋ, ni ehã eŋmɛɛ nɔ ni kɔ̃ enaa ni eyaaye lɛ he efɔ̃ shi.

english_verse: I felt certain that I would live a long and happy life, then die in my own bed.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ mihe akɛ, “Mishĩa teŋ magbo yɛ ni migbii baafa tamɔ shia.

english_verse: In those days I was strong like a tree with deep roots and with plenty of water,
translation_verse: Mitamɔ tso ni efãi etsɛ̃rɛ kɛtee kɛyanina nu, ni bɔ nyɔɔ ebai anɔ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Everyone listened in silence to my welcome advice,
translation_verse: Mɛi bo mi toi, ni amɛmɛ, ni amɛfee kpoo kɛmɛ nɔ ni miyɔɔ kɛɛmɔ.

english_verse: and when I finished speaking, nothing needed to be said.
translation_verse: Kɛji miwie sɛɛ lɛ, mɔ ko ewieee dɔŋŋ; ni miwiemɔi lɛ boteɔ amɛmli.

english_verse: My words were eagerly accepted like the showers of spring,
translation_verse: Amɛkwɛɔ miwiemɔ gbɛ tamɔ okwaafonyo kwɛɔ nunɛmɔ gbɛ.

english_verse: and the smile on my face renewed everyone's hopes.
translation_verse: Miŋmɔɔ kɛji mina akɛ amɛtsui miiye, ni mihiɛ ŋmɔlɔ lɛ woɔ amɛ hewalɛ.

english_verse: My advice was followed as though I were a king leading my troops, or someone comforting those in sorrow.
translation_verse: Mi, mito amɛshihilɛ lɛ he gbɛjianɔ, ni mihi shi mihã amɛ akɛ yitso; mihi shi yɛ etabilɔi ateŋ akɛ maŋtsɛ. Mihi shi akɛ mɔ ni shɛjeɔ ŋkɔmɔyelɔi amii.

english_verse: Young people now insult me, although their fathers would have been a disgrace to my sheep dogs.
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ mɛi ni miye amɛ onukpa miiŋmɔ mi; mɛi ni mibuŋ amɛtsɛmɛi bɔ ni maŋɔ amɛ mafata gbei ni buɔ tookui tete ahe lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: And those who insult me are helpless themselves.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ sɛɛ mibana yɛ mɛi ni egbɔlɔ ahe?

english_verse: They must claw the desert sand in the dark for something to satisfy their hunger.
translation_verse: Ohia kɛ hɔmɔ ni naa wa hãa amɛkpeɔ ŋa gbiŋ nɔ tsei ashishifãi.

english_verse: They gather tasteless shrubs for food and firewood,
translation_verse: Amɛfamɔɔ shiaŋaŋ tsei, ni amɛtsɛrɛɔ koowie bai ni amɛshɛreɔ blɔtsei amɛwereɔ.

english_verse: and they are run out of towns, as though they were thieves.
translation_verse: Ashwieɔ amɛ kɛjeɔ gbɔmɛi ateŋ, ni awɔɔ amɛyi tamɔ awɔɔ julɔ yi.

english_verse: Their only homes are ditches or holes between rocks,
translation_verse: Nujɔi ajɔi amli kɛ shikpɔŋ bui kɛ tɛkploi amli amɛaahi.

english_verse: where they bray like donkeys gathering around shrubs.
translation_verse: Koowiei ashishi amɛbolɔɔ yɛ; sɔŋsrɔ shishi amɛbuaa amɛhe naa yɛ.

english_verse: And like senseless donkeys they are chased away. Those Worthless Nobodies
translation_verse: Kwashiai yakagbɔmɛi abii; ayi amɛ, ashwie amɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Those worthless nobodies make up jokes and songs to disgrace me.
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ, mitsɔ̃ amɛdaaŋ kotsa, ni mitsɔ̃ fɛoyeli wiemɔ mihã amɛ.

english_verse: They are hateful and keep their distance, even while spitting in my direction.
translation_verse: Amɛnyaŋeɔ mi; amɛwiɔ amɛhe yɛ mihe, kɛji amɛna mi lɛ amɛtsɛ̃ɔ lajɔ̃.

english_verse: God has destroyed me, and so they don't care what they do.
translation_verse: Akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ ehã migbɔjɔ ni eba mi shi hewɔ lɛ, amɛhiɛ gbooo nɔ ni amɛfeɔ he yɛ mihiɛ.

english_verse: Their attacks never stop, though I am defenseless, and my feet are trapped.
translation_verse: Yakagbɔmɛi teɔ shi yɛ mininejurɔ nɔ, ni amɛshwieɔ mi kɛyaa sɛɛ, ni amɛkaa mihiɛ kpãtãmɔ tete.

english_verse: Without any help, they prevent my escape, destroying me completely
translation_verse: Amɛtsimɔɔ migbɛ ni matsɔ̃ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛbɔɔ mihiɛkpãtãmɔ he mɔdɛŋ, ni mɔ ko ebooo amɛ tswai!

english_verse: Terror has me surrounded; my reputation and my riches have vanished like a cloud. I Am Sick at Heart
translation_verse: Adɔ gbeyei nibii ayi kɛba minɔ, minunyam etã oookɛɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni etswa kɛtee; kɔɔyɔɔ etswa nii ni mina fɛɛ kɛtee tamɔ atatu.

english_verse: I am sick at heart! Pain has taken its toll.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ eshɛ migbele be, ni mikã nɔnaa mli gbii abɔ nɛɛ.

english_verse: Night chews on my bones, causing endless torment,
translation_verse: Duŋ lɛ hãa miwui amli kpeɔ mi, mipiŋmɔ lɛ ejɔɔɔ.

english_verse: and God has shrunk my skin, choking me to death.
translation_verse: Enaawalɛ lɛ kpitiɔ mitade lɛ: efiɔ lɛ kɛmɔɔ misɛ̃.

english_verse: I have been thrown in the dirt and now am dirt myself.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ eshɛ mi efɔ̃ ŋmɔtɔ mli, ni mitsɔ̃ tamɔ mlu kɛ lamlu.

english_verse: I beg God for help, but there is no answer; and when I stand up, he simply stares.
translation_verse: Mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ bo, shi ohereee mi nɔ; mihoɔ midamɔɔ shi misɔleɔ; shi okwɛɛɛ mi po.

english_verse: God has turned brutal,
translation_verse: Oowa mi yi; okɛ ohewalɛ fɛɛ miipiŋ mi.

english_verse: Soon he will send me home to the world of the dead, where we all must go.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ, mile akɛ okɛ mi baaya ayahã gbele, ni ji shĩa ni ato ahã hiɛkãalɔi fɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: No one refuses help to others, when disaster strikes.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ aso mɔ ni kã hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli kpãaa enineŋ yɛ emanehulu lɛ mli ni ebi yelikɛbuamɔ lo?

english_verse: I mourned for the poor and those who suffered.
translation_verse: Ani mifooo mihãaa mɔ ni yɔɔ haomɔ mli? Ani misusuma werɛ hooo hãaa ohiafo?

english_verse: But when I beg for relief and light, all I receive are disaster and darkness.
translation_verse: Shi be ni mikwɛ nɔ kpakpa gbɛ lɛ, nɔ fɔŋ moŋ ni ba; ni be ni mimɛ la lɛ, duŋ moŋ wo mi.

english_verse: My stomach is tied in knots; pain is my daily companion.
translation_verse: Mitsui miitswa kɛ hejaramɔ, ni enyɔɔɔ shi; amanehulu gbii enina mi.

english_verse: My days are dark and gloomy and in the city council I stand and cry out,
translation_verse: Duŋ ewo mi kɛmiiya kɛmiiba; ni hulu etsooo ehãaa mi kwraa, mihoɔ midamɔɔ shi yɛ maŋ, ni mibiɔ yelikɛbuamɔ.

english_verse: making mournful sounds like jackals and owls.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ̃ ŋaŋgbei anyɛmi kɛ okpɔŋɔloofɔji anaanyo.

english_verse: My skin is so parched, that it peels right off, and my bones are burning.
translation_verse: Mihewolo edĩ, ni eekpɔlɔ yɛ mihe eeshwie shi; ni miwui amli miishã mi.

english_verse: My only songs are sorrow and sadness.
translation_verse: Mikpãa saŋku lɛ gbɛɛmɔ etsɔ̃ ŋkɔmɔyeli, ni mibɛlɛ gbɛɛmɔ etsɔ̃ yaafolɔi agbee.

english_verse: I promised myself never to stare with desire at a young woman.
translation_verse: Mikã mihiŋmɛi kitã ni no hewɔ lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ mahã oblayoo foro he afee mi akɔnɔ hu?

english_verse: In fact, God sends disaster on all who sin,
translation_verse: Ani jeee hiɛkpãtãmɔ kã shi hã mɛi ni feɔ nɔ fɔŋ? Kɛ osharã hã mɛi ni feɔ nishaianii?

english_verse: and he keeps a close watch on everything I do.
translation_verse: Ani Nyɔŋmɔ leee mijeŋba, ni ekaneee minanefaamɔi?

english_verse: I am not dishonest or deceitful,
translation_verse: Kɛji miba mijeŋ kɛ kutumpɔo, ni miye oyai mishishiu mɔ ko lɛ,

english_verse: and I beg God to prove my innocence.
translation_verse: no lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ nsɛni ni ja aŋmɛ mi koni ena akɛ kpako bɛ mihe.

english_verse: If I have disobeyed him or even wanted to,
translation_verse: Kɛji migba afã yɛ minyiɛmɔŋ, ni mitsui eyadi mihiŋmɛi sɛɛ, ni muji ko kpɛtɛ miniji ahe lɛ,

english_verse: then others can eat my harvest and uproot my crops.
translation_verse: no lɛ nii ni madu lɛ, mɔ kroko aaaye, ni ŋmɔshinii ni aaakwɛ̃ ahã mi lɛ, afãmɔ ashwie.

english_verse: If I have desired someone's wife and chased after her,
translation_verse: Kɛji minaanyo ŋa he efee mi akɔnɔ pɛŋ, ni miyawo ka yɛ minaanyo shinaa shi pɛŋ lɛ,

english_verse: then let some stranger steal my wife from me.
translation_verse: no lɛ hã miŋa ahoo nii ahã nuu kroko, ni mɛi krokomɛi kɛ lɛ ana bɔlɛ.

english_verse: If I took someone's wife, it would be a horrible crime,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ hiɛgbeji asane kpeteŋkple ni; eji nɔ fɔŋ ni kojolɔi lɛ baagbala etoi,

english_verse: sending me to destruction and my crops to the flames.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ tɔ̃mɔ lɛ baatsɔ̃ la ni baashã nii kɛshɛ abonsamiiaje, ni ebaashã nii ni miyɔɔ fɛɛ wɛɛ kɛmɔ shi.

english_verse: When my servants complained against me, I was fair to them.
translation_verse: Kɛji miyeee mitsulɔ nuu loo mitsulɔ yoo jalɛ sane be ni amɛ kɛ mi ena lɛ,

english_verse: Otherwise, what answer would I give to God when he judges me?
translation_verse: no lɛ te mafee tɛŋŋ kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ te shi wo mi lɛ? Kɛji eba kojomɔ lɛ, te majie minaa makɛɛ tɛŋŋ?

english_verse: After all, God is the one who gave life to each of us before we were born. I Have Never Cheated Anyone
translation_verse: Ani mɔ ni bɔ mi ewo musuŋ lɛ jeee lɛ nɔŋŋ ebɔ amɛ? Ani jeee mɔ koome shɔ̃ wɔ fɛɛ yɛ musuŋ?

english_verse: I have never cheated widows or others in need,
translation_verse: Kɛji mikãma ohiafoi anii ni amɛtaoɔ, aloo mihã jeŋ fee okulafo awerɛho,

english_verse: and I have always shared my food with orphans.
translation_verse: aloo miye nii mikome pɛ, ni mihãaa awusãi eko

english_verse: Since the time I was young, I have cared for orphans and helped widows.
translation_verse: tsɛbelɛ mi mihiɛ lɛ akɛ tsɛ kɛjɛ eblahiiaŋ, ni kɛjɛ enyɛ musuŋ beebe lɛ mi miwa lɛ.

english_verse: and I was praised for supplying woolen garments to keep them warm.
translation_verse: no lɛ mahã lɛ mama ni akɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mitoo he tsɔi lo koni ehe afee kulɔɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ ebaajie miyi kɛ etsuiŋ fɛɛ.

english_verse: If I have ever raised my arm to threaten an orphan when the power was mine,
translation_verse: Kɛji miwo minine nɔ yɛ awusã ko nɔ, ejaakɛ mile akɛ abaabu mi bem yɛ kojomɔhe lɛ,

english_verse: I could not have been abusive; I was terrified at the thought that God might punish me.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ misheɔ Ofe lɛ dɛŋ hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ gbeyei. Ni minyɛŋ Ofe lɛ hiɛ madamɔ.

english_verse: I have never trusted the power of wealth,
translation_verse: Kɛji miŋɔ shika mifee mihiɛnɔkãmɔ, aloo mitsɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi mihiɛnɔkãmɔ,

english_verse: or taken pride in owning many possessions. *
translation_verse: ni minya ejaakɛ minii ni mina fa babaoo, ni minine eshɛ nii babaoo nɔ

english_verse: I have never openly or secretly
translation_verse: kɛji mikwɛ hulu ni eetso, loo nyɔɔŋtsere bɔ ni ekpɛɔ fɛɛfɛo kɛhoɔ.

english_verse: I have never laughed when my enemies were struck by disaster.
translation_verse: Minyako yɛ osharã ni esharã mihenyɛlɔ hewɔ, ni mimli efiliko mi be ni amanehulu eba enɔ.

english_verse: Neither have I sinned by asking God to send down on them the curse of death.
translation_verse: Miŋmɛko minaabu gbɛ ni efee esha, ni mitaoko egbele kɛ kitãkãmɔ.

english_verse: No one ever went hungry at my house,
translation_verse: Mishĩaŋbii ekɛŋ akɛ, ‘Wɔteŋ namɔ yeko edɛŋ niyenii etɔko dã?’

english_verse: Many have attempted to hide their sins from others— but I refused.
translation_verse: Mitsimɔko mitɔ̃mɔi anɔ tamɔ Adam, ni mikɛ minɔsha lɛ etoko mimli.

english_verse: And the fear of public disgrace never forced me to keep silent about what I had done. Why Doesn't God Listen?
translation_verse: Miishe mɛi asafo lɛ gbeyei, ni bɔ ni wekui baanyaŋe mi hu woɔ mihe gbeyei, ni no hewɔ ni mifee diŋŋ, ni mishiii shĩa mijeee kpo ejaakɛ miishe amɛ gbeyei.

english_verse: Why doesn't God All-Powerful listen and answer? If God has something against me, let him speak up or put it in writing!
translation_verse: Oo, mina mɔ ko ni aaabo mi toi! Naa, minine naa okadi! Ofe lɛ ahã mi hetoo! Oo, mina ni kulɛ mɔ ni kɛ mi ena lɛ eŋmala saji ni ekɛshiɔ mi lɛ ewo wolo hiɛ!

english_verse: Then I would wear his charges on my clothes and forehead.
translation_verse: Anɔkwa, kulɛ makɔ matswa mikɔŋ, ni mikɛbaafee akekre mafi miyitso.

english_verse: And with my head held high, I would tell him everything I have ever done.
translation_verse: Kulɛ matsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nibii fɛɛ ni mifee, ni matsi mabɛŋkɛ lɛ tamɔ lumɔ

english_verse: I have never mistreated the land I farmed and made it mourn.
translation_verse: kɛji shikpɔŋ ni mihu nɔ bolɔ wo mi ni enɔ akofii wo yara kutuu;

english_verse: Nor have I cheated my workers and caused them pain.
translation_verse: kɛji mikpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yibii miye ni miwooo nyɔmɔ, ni no nɔ tsɔ̃ ni nɔtsɛmɛi lɛ gboi lɛ,

english_verse: If I had, I would pray for weeds instead of wheat to grow in my fields. After saying these things, Job was silent.
translation_verse: no lɛ ŋmei akwɛ̃ yɛ ŋmãa najiaŋ, ŋmei gbohii akwɛ̃ yɛ abele najiaŋ.” Hiob wiemɔ lɛ naagbee nɛ.

english_verse: Finally, these three men stopped arguing with Job, because he refused to admit he was guilty.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni hii etɛ̃ lɛ fɔ̃ɔ Hiob hetoohãmɔ, ejaakɛ amɛna akɛ Hiob wiemɔ lɛ miitsɔ̃ɔ akɛ efeko nɔ fɔŋ ko.

english_verse: Elihu from Buz was there, and he had become upset with Job for blaming God instead of himself.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Elihu, Buznyo Barakel ni jɛ Ram weku lɛ mli lɛ, mli wo la. Emli wo la ewo Hiob, ejaakɛ Hiob bu ehe jalɔ ni eshwa Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: He was also angry with Job's three friends for not being able to prove that Job was wrong.
translation_verse: Emlifu Hiob nanemɛi etɛ̃ lɛ hu, ejaakɛ amɛnaaa hetoo ko amɛhã Hiob, tsɛbelɛ amɛtsɔ̃ hiɛ amɛbua he akɛ Hiob yeɔ fɔ.

english_verse: Elihu was younger than these three, and he let them speak first.
translation_verse: Elihu mɛ be fioo dani ekɛ Hiob wie, ejaakɛ Hiob nanemɛi lɛ ye lɛ onukpa.

english_verse: But he became irritated when they could not answer Job,
translation_verse: Be ni Elihu na akɛ hii etɛ̃ nɛɛ bɛ nɔ ko dɔŋŋ ni amɛkɛɔ Hiob lɛ, emli wo la.

english_verse: and he said to them: I am much younger than you, so I have shown respect by keeping silent.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Elihu, Buznyo Barakel bi lɛ, here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Gbekɛ ji mi yɛ afii amli, shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛdara; no hewɔ lɛ, mishe gbeyei ni mikɛ misusumɔ aŋmɛ nyɛhiɛ.

english_verse: I once believed age was the source of wisdom;
translation_verse: Mikɛɛ mihe akɛ nyɛ ji mɛi ni esa akɛ nyɛwie; nyɛ waŋtsɛmɛi nyɛwieɔ ni akaseɔ nii kɛjɛɔ nyɛdɛŋ.

english_verse: Age is no guarantee of wisdom and understanding.
translation_verse: Jeee dalɛ ni hãa mɔ leɔ nii, ni jeee gbɔlɛ hu ni hãa anuɔ sane shishi.

english_verse: That's why I ask you to listen to me. I Eagerly Listened *
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛboa mi toi koni mi hu mawie mijwɛŋmɔ.

english_verse: I eagerly listened to each of your arguments,
translation_verse: Naa, mito mitsui shi mibo nyɛwiemɔi lɛ atoi, mimɛ beiaŋ ni nyɛtaoɔ nɔ ni nyɛaakɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: You shouldn't say, “We know what's right! Let God punish him.”
translation_verse: Nyɛkwɛa ni nyɛkakɛa akɛ, ‘Wɔle nii. Nyɔŋmɔ ni aaaku enaa, shi jeee gbɔmɔ.’

english_verse: Job hasn't spoken against me, and so I won't answer him with your arguments.
translation_verse: Ewieko eshiko mi, ni mikɛ nyɛnaa wiemɔi lɛ haŋ lɛ hetoo.

english_verse: All of you are shocked; you don't know what to say.
translation_verse: Ashi amɛ shi, amɛhãaa hetoo dɔŋŋ; amɛbɛ nɔ ko ni amɛkɛɔ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: But am I to remain silent, just because you have stopped speaking?
translation_verse: Ni esa akɛ mimɛɔ ejaakɛ amɛwieee; amɛdamɔ shi diŋŋ ni amɛhãaa wiemɔ ko hetoo dɔŋŋ?

english_verse: No! I will give my opinion,
translation_verse: Mi hu makɛɛ minɔ; ni mi hu mawie nɔ ni misusuɔ.

english_verse: because I have so much to say, that I can't keep quiet.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ minyɛɛɛ mamua minaa dɔŋŋ; mumɔ ni yɔɔ mimli lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ mi dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: I am like a swollen wineskin, and I will burst
translation_verse: Naa, mitsui etsɔ̃ tamɔ wain ni atsi naa kpɛŋŋ, ni ebɛ mumɔhe, etamɔ wain wolotɔi hei ni heɔ aflɛ.

english_verse: if I don't speak. *
translation_verse: Mawie koni mana hejɔlɛ. Ja migbele minaa mihã hetoo.

english_verse: I don't know how to be unfair or to flatter anyone—
translation_verse: Mikwɛŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko hiɛ, ni midɔkɔŋ minaa mihaŋ mɔ ko.

english_verse: if I did, my Creator would quickly destroy me!
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mileee mɔhɔlɔmɔ; nakai ni kulɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, miBɔlɔ lɛ, aaafo miwala sɛɛ biɛ be kukuoo mli.”

english_verse: Job, listen to me! Pay close attention. *
translation_verse: “Ni agbɛnɛ, Hiob, bo toi, ni ofee toi ohã miwiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Everything I will say
translation_verse: Naa, migbele minaa ni mawie nɔ ni misusuɔ.

english_verse: just as surely as the Spirit of God All-Powerful gave me the breath of life.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ lɛ ji nɔ ni bɔ mi, ni Ofe lɛ mumɔ lɛ hãa miyi naa wala.

english_verse: Now line up your arguments and prepare to face me.
translation_verse: Kɛji ooonyɛ lɛ, too he ohã mi; saamɔ ohe; saamɔ nɔ ni obaakɛɛ lɛ oto.

english_verse: We each were made from clay, and God has no favorites,
translation_verse: Naa, mi kɛ bo yeɔ hegbɔ yɛ Yehowa gbɛfaŋ; mi hu sũ nɔŋŋ akɛshɔ̃ mi.

english_verse: so don't be afraid of me or what I might do. I Have Heard You Argue
translation_verse: Naa, mihe ŋmiŋmi akawo ohe gbeyei; minyɛŋ onɔ.

english_verse: I have heard you argue
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛŋ, owie owo mitoiiaŋ, ni minu owiemɔi lɛ.

english_verse: that you are innocent, guilty of nothing.
translation_verse: Okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mihe tse, tɔ̃mɔ ko bɛ mihe; miyeɔ bem, ni mifeko esha ko.

english_verse: You claim that God has made you his enemy,
translation_verse: Naa, eetao sane efo eŋmɛ minɔ; ebuɔ mi akɛ ehenyɛlɔ.

english_verse: that he has bound your feet and blocked your path.
translation_verse: Ebɔ minaji apã, ejie ehiɛ eka mi.’

english_verse: But, Job, you're wrong— God is greater than any human.
translation_verse: Naa, miikɛɛ bo akɛ, enɛ mli lɛ osane lɛ ejaaa; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ da aahu fe adesa.

english_verse: So why do you challenge God to answer you?
translation_verse: Mɛni hewɔ oshwaa Nyɔŋmɔ ni okɛɔ akɛ, ‘Ehãaa miwiemɔi lɛ eko kwraa hetoo lɛ.’

english_verse: God speaks in different ways, and we don't always recognize his voice. *
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wieɔ shii abɔ, fɛɛ ni adesa ediii sɛɛ.

english_verse: God does this to make us turn from sin and pride
translation_verse: koni ehã adesa akpale kɛjɛ enifeemɔnii ahe, ni ehã adesa akpa ehenɔwomɔ lɛ.

english_verse: and to protect us from being swept away to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Etsiɔ adesa susuma naa koni ekayagbee bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli; ebuɔ ewala hu he koni akakpãtã hiɛ kɛ klante.

english_verse: Sometimes we are punished with a serious illness and aching joints.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ gbalaa adesa toi kɛ saa mli piŋmɔ kɛ ewuiaŋ kpemɔ,

english_verse: Merely the thought of our favorite food makes our stomachs sick,
translation_verse: ni no hãa edaaŋ gboɔ kɛ niyeli, ni ekpoɔ niyenii ni kpɔɔ ewɔlɔmɔ tete.

english_verse: and we become so skinny that our bones stick out.
translation_verse: Etãa loo ni ehiii lɛ kwɛmɔ, ni egbɔmɔtsoŋ wui ni kulɛ anaaa lɛ bajwereɔ shi faŋŋ.

english_verse: We feel death and the grave taking us in their grip.
translation_verse: Ebɛŋkɛɔ gbohiiaje, ni ewala bɛŋkɛɔ gbele bɔfoi lɛ.

english_verse: One of a thousand angels then comes to our rescue by saying we are innocent.
translation_verse: Kɛji ena bɔfoi akpe lɛ ateŋ eko damɔ mli hã lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɔ nɔ ni hi hã lɛ,

english_verse: The angel shows kindness, commanding death to release us, because the price was paid.
translation_verse: ni ena gbɔmɔ mɔbɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Jiemɔ lɛ kɛjɛ gbohiiajeyaa mli, mina eyinii ni akɛkpɔ̃ lɛ.’

english_verse: Our health is restored, we feel young again,
translation_verse: No lɛ eheloo aaatsɔ̃ efɔ́ tamɔ gbekɛ nɔ, ni eeeku sɛɛ etsɔ̃ oblanyo ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: and we ask God to accept us. Then we joyfully worship God, and we are rewarded because we are innocent.
translation_verse: Eeekpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai, ni eeeduro lɛ; ni eeeba Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kɛ nyamɔ. Eeegba eyiwalaheremɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi.

english_verse: When that happens, we tell everyone, “I sinned and did wrong, but God forgave me
translation_verse: Ni eeela yɛ adesai ahiɛ, ni eeekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mifee esha, ni mikɔ̃dɔ̃ nɔ ni ja; ni akɛ mihe fa mi;

english_verse: and rescued me from death! Now I will see the light.”
translation_verse: Ehere misusuma kɛjɛ gbohiiaje ni mihiɛ kã lolo.’

english_verse: God gives each of us chance after chance
translation_verse: Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ feɔ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ shii abɔ ehãa gbɔmɔ,

english_verse: to be saved from death and brought into the light that gives life.
translation_verse: koni ehere eyiwala kɛjɛ gbohiiaje, koni wala afee enɔ.

english_verse: So, Job, pay attention and don't interrupt,
translation_verse: Oo Hiob, ka otoi! Bo mi toi, feemɔ diŋŋ, mibawie!

english_verse: though I would gladly listen to anything you say that proves you are right.
translation_verse: Kɛji oyɛ nɔ ko ni oookɛɛ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ mi! Wiemɔ, shi miitao bo bem mabu.

english_verse: Otherwise, listen in silence to my wisdom.
translation_verse: Kɛjeee nakai lɛ, bo moŋ bo mi toi; feemɔ diŋŋ, ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo nilee.”

english_verse: You men think you are wise, but just listen to me!
translation_verse: “Nyɛ nilelɔi kɛ jwɛŋlɔi, nyɛboa miwiemɔ toi, nyɛfea toi nyɛhãa mi,

english_verse: Think about my words, as you would taste food.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ toi akɛŋmɛɔ wiemɔ akwɛɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni akɛ lilɛi saa niyenii anaa akwɛɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Then we can decide the case and give a just verdict.
translation_verse: Nyɛhãa wɔkɔa nɔ ni ja, nyɛhãa wɔsusua he yɛ wɔteŋ wɔna nɔ ni hi.

english_verse: Job claims he is innocent and God is guilty of mistreating him.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Hiob ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Miyeɔ bem’ shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mi yeee yɛ jalɛ naa;

english_verse: Job also argues that God considers him a liar and that he is suffering severely in spite of his innocence.
translation_verse: bem ni miyeɔ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, abu mi amalelɔ: Mifala lɛ bɛ tsabaa, tsɛbelɛ tɔ̃mɔ ko bɛ mihe.

english_verse: But to tell the truth, Job is shameless!
translation_verse: Namɔ ena mɔ ko tamɔ Hiob, mɔ ni bɔɔ musu tamɔ anuɔ nu pɛŋ?

english_verse: because he has said, “It doesn't pay to please God.” If Any of You Are Smart
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ hã gbɔmɔ akɛ ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaabɔ naanyo!’

english_verse: If any of you are smart, you will listen and learn that God All-Powerful does what is right.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, nyɛboa mi toi. Enɛ akagbale Nyɔŋmɔ fɔɔŋfɔ akɛ eeefee nɔ fɔŋ, aloo Ofe lɛ, eeefee nɔ ko ni ejaaa hu.

english_verse: God always treats everyone the way they deserve,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ woɔ gbɔmɔ nyɔmɔ yɛ enitsumɔ naa, ni ekɛ gbɔmɔ yeɔ yɛ ejeŋba naa.

english_verse: From the very beginning, God has been in control of all the world.
translation_verse: Namɔ ji mɔ ni kɛ je lɛ nɔkwɛmɔ hã lɛ? Namɔ kɛ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hã lɛ?

english_verse: If God took back the breath that he breathed into us,
translation_verse: Kɛji eeeŋɔ emumɔ lɛ yɛ je lɛŋ, ni eeehã mumɔ lɛ akpale kwraa kɛba eŋɔɔ lɛ,

english_verse: we humans would die and return to the soil.
translation_verse: no lɛ heloo fɛɛ heloo hiɛ aaakpãtã; ni gbɔmɔ aaatsɔ̃ sũ ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: The mighty God is the one who brings about justice, and you are condemning him.
translation_verse: Ani mɔ ni taooo jalɛ saneyeli baanyɛ mɛi anɔ eye? Ani ooobu mɔ ni ja ni eyɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ fɔ?

english_verse: Indeed, God is the one who condemns unfair rulers.
translation_verse: Ani ooobu mɔ ni kɛɔ maŋtsɛ akɛ ‘Yakagbɔmɔ’ kɛ lumɛi hu akɛ, ‘Yitsoŋwalɔi?’

english_verse: And God created us all; he has no favorites, whether rich or poor.
translation_verse: Ni ekwɛɛɛ lumɛi ahiɛ ni ebuuu niiatsɛ fe ohiafo, ejaakɛ lɛ eninenaa nitsumɔnii ji amɛ fɛɛ kwa lɛ bem?

english_verse: Even powerful rulers die in the darkness of night when they least expect it, just like the rest of us. God Watches Everything We Do
translation_verse: Trukaa gbɔmɔ gboɔ; ahosoɔ gbɔmɔ nyɔɔŋ, ni ehoɔ eyaa; hewalɔi hoɔ amɛyaa, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ adesa nine nɔ.

english_verse: No evil person can hide in the deepest darkness.
translation_verse: Duŋ kabitii bɛ he ko he ko ni mɛi ni tsuɔ nishaianii aaanyɛ atee amɛhe yɛ mli.

english_verse: And so, God doesn't need to set a time for judgment.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ etoko be pɔtɛɛ ko ehãko adesa ko ni eeeya kojomɔ yɛ lɛ ehiɛ.

english_verse: Without asking for advice, God removes mighty leaders and puts others in their place.
translation_verse: Ekpãtãa hewalɔi ahiɛ ni etaooo amɛsaji amli, ni eholeɔ mɛi krokomɛi etoɔ amɛnajiaŋ.

english_verse: He knows what they are like, and he wipes them out in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Akɛni ele amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ, ebutuɔ amɛ nyɔɔŋ, ni amɛhiɛ kpãtãa.

english_verse: And while others look on, he punishes them because they were evil
translation_verse: Egbalaa mɛi fɔ̃ji atoi yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: and refused to obey him.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ amɛkpale yɛ esɛɛ, ni amɛbuuu egbɛi lɛ ekoeko;

english_verse: The persons they mistreated had prayed for help, until God answered their prayers.
translation_verse: ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛhã ohiafoi ayaafo yashɛ eŋɔɔ; ni enu mɛi ni efĩ amɛ lɛ abolɔmɔ.

english_verse: When God does nothing, can any person or nation find fault with him?
translation_verse: Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ fee diŋŋ lɛ, namɔ baanyɛ lɛ ashwa? Kɛji ekɛ ehiɛ tee lɛ namɔ baanyɛ ehiɛ lɛ ena?

english_verse: But still, he punishes rulers who abuse their people.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ afee koni gbɔmɔ fɔŋ akaye maŋ nɔ, ni ekahã maŋbii bote kaa mli.

english_verse: Job, you should tell God that you are guilty and promise to do better.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ani mɔ ko ekɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dã akɛ ‘Agbala mitoi. Mifeŋ nɔ ni ehiii dɔŋŋ;

english_verse: Then ask him to point out what you did wrong, so you won't do it again.
translation_verse: tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi nibii ni minaaa; koni kɛji mifee nɔ ni ehiii lɛ mikafee nakai dɔŋŋ?’

english_verse: Do you make the rules, or does God? You have to decide— I can't do it for you; now make up your mind.
translation_verse: Akɛni okwa egbɛi lɛ, ani Nyɔŋmɔ baafee nɔ ni otaoɔ ehã bo lo? Kɛɛmɔ nɔ ni ole lɛ, ejaakɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ esa akɛ okɔɔ nɔ ni osumɔɔ; shi jeee mi matsɔ̃ɔ bo.

english_verse: that you are speaking nonsense and lack good judgment.
translation_verse: ‘Hiob wieɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ bɛ mli; nilee bɛ ewiemɔ mli.’

english_verse: So I pray for you to suffer as much as possible for talking like a sinner.
translation_verse: Mina ni kulɛ aka Hiob akwɛ kɛyashi naagbee, ejaakɛ hetoi ni ehãa lɛ tamɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji anaa wiemɔ.
