english_verse: You have rebelled against God, time after time, and have even insulted us.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ eetse atua efata esha ni efee lɛ he, eetswa edɛ̃ eshwie wɔnɔ ni eewie babaoo eeshi Nyɔŋmɔ.”

english_verse: Job, are you really innocent in the sight of God?
translation_verse: “Aso osusuɔ akɛ eja gbɛ akɛ oookɛɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ tɔ̃mɔ ko bɛ ohe,

english_verse: Don't you honestly believe it pays to obey him?
translation_verse: hewɔ ni okɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ he? Mɛɛ ejurɔ miyeɔ kɛji mifee esha lɛ?’

english_verse: I will give the answers to you and your friends. *
translation_verse: Mahã bo kɛ onanemɛi ni fata ohe lɛ fɛɛ hetoo.

english_verse: Is any good you may have done at all helpful to him?
translation_verse: Kɛji jalɔ ji bo lɛ, mɛni okɛwa Nyɔŋmɔ, aloo mɛni enaa kɛjɛɔ odɛ̃ŋ?

english_verse: The evil or good you do only affects other humans.
translation_verse: Esha ni ofeɔ lɛ, adesa tamɔ bo awui eyeɔ, ni ojalɛ lɛ, gbɔmɔ eyeɔ ebuaa.

english_verse: In times of trouble, everyone begs the mighty God to have mercy.
translation_verse: Yiwaa babaoo hãa maŋbii lɛ bolɔɔ; amɛbolɔɔ amɛtsɛɔ yelikɛbuamɔ yɛ ojei ayiwalɛ nifeemɔnii ahewɔ.

english_verse: But after their Creator helps them through hard times, they forget about him,
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ko kwraa ekɛɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nɛgbɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, miBɔlɔ lɛ yɔɔ, mɔ ni hãa hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ fĩmɔbe mli kɛ

english_verse: God won't listen to the prayers of proud and evil people.
translation_verse: Amɛbolɔɔ amɛtsɛɔ yelikɛbuamɔ shi Nyɔŋmɔ efooo amɛdaaŋ yɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii kɛ amɛhenɔwomɔ hewɔ.

english_verse: If God All-Powerful refuses to answer their empty prayers,
translation_verse: Anɔkwa, Nyɔŋmɔ booo yaka yaafo toi, ni Ofe lɛ ebuuu hu.

english_verse: he will surely deny your impatient request to face him in court.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni wa fe fɛɛ ji akɛ, oookɛɛ akɛ onaaa lɛ, ni sane lɛ kã ehiɛ, ni oomɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Job, you were wrong to say God doesn't punish sin.
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ, akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu gbalaaa mɔ toi, ni ediii tɔ̃mɔ sɛɛ yrɛdɛɛ hewɔ lɛ,

english_verse: Everything you have said adds up to nonsense.
translation_verse: Hiob, oowie huu, oowie babaoo ni nilee bɛ mli.”

english_verse: Be patient a while longer; I have something else to say in God's defense.
translation_verse: “Na tsui ohã mi fioo, ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ko naa, ejaakɛ miyɛ nɔ ko lolo ni mibawie mahã Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: God always does right— and this knowledge comes straight from God.
translation_verse: Minilee babaoo lɛ mli majɛ matsɔ̃ɔ akɛ miBɔlɔ lɛ yeɔ jalɛ sane.

english_verse: You can rest assured that what I say is true.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ anɔkwa wiemɔ miwieɔ lɛ. Mɔ ko ni le nii jogbaŋŋ damɔ ohiɛ nɛɛ.

english_verse: Although God is mighty, he cares about everyone and makes fair decisions.
translation_verse: Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ je agbo, ni enyaŋeee mɔ ko mɔ ko; eniiashishinumɔ naa wa jogbaŋŋ.

english_verse: The wicked are cut down, and those who are wronged receive justice.
translation_verse: Ehãaa mɔ fɔŋ yi ana wala, shi ohiafoi kɛ mɛi ni naa amanehulu lɛ eyeɔ amɛsane ehãa amɛ.

english_verse: God watches over good people and places them in positions of power and honor forever.
translation_verse: Ehiŋmɛi kãa jalɔ he, ni ehãa amɛtsɔ̃mɔɔ tamɔ maŋtsɛmɛi ni tara sɛii anɔ ni awoɔ amɛnɔ gojoo.

english_verse: But when people are prisoners of suffering and pain, *
translation_verse: Kɛji awo amɛ gboklɛi ni amanehulu efĩmɔ amɛ lɛ,

english_verse: God points out their sin and their pride,
translation_verse: kɛkɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nɔ fɔŋ ni amɛfee, amɛtɔ̃mɔi kɛ amɛhenɔwomɔ lɛ.

english_verse: then he warns them to turn back to him.
translation_verse: Egbeleɔ amɛtoiiaŋ, ni amɛnuɔ kãmɔ ni ekãa amɛ akɛ amɛkpa nishaianii feemɔ lɛ.

english_verse: And if they obey, they will be successful and happy from then on.
translation_verse: Kɛji amɛbo Nyɔŋmɔ toi, ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ lɛ lɛ, amɛaaye amɛwala be lɛ yɛ ejurɔyeli mli, kɛ amɛfii lɛ hu yɛ miishɛɛ mli.

english_verse: But if they foolishly refuse, they will be rewarded with a violent death. Godless People Are Too Angry
translation_verse: Shi kɛji amɛbooo toi lɛ, no lɛ amɛleŋ nii, ni amɛaagboi yɛ klante naa.

english_verse: Godless people are too angry to ask God for help when he punishes them.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ, eŋmɛ̃ɛɛ mlifu he; kɛji efĩ amɛ tete lɛ amɛbiii Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ.

english_verse: So they die young in shameful disgrace.
translation_verse: Amɛgboiɔ yɛ amɛblahiiaŋ, ni amɛwala sɛɛ foɔ kɛ hiɛgbele kɛ tɔlɛ.

english_verse: Hard times and trouble are God's way of getting our attention!
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔseɔ gbɔmɔ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ amanehulu nɔ, ni ekɛ nɔnaa gbeleɔ mɔ hiŋmɛi.

english_verse: And at this very moment, God deeply desires to lead you from trouble and to spread your table with your favorite food.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ jie bo kɛje jaramɔ mli kɛba he ko ni ohe jɔ bo yɛ, ni okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ niyenii.

english_verse: Now that the judgment for your sins has fallen upon you,
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ aagbala otoi bɔ ni sa bo pɛpɛɛpɛ; aagbala otoi yɛ jalɛ naa.

english_verse: don't let your anger and the pain you endured make you sneer at God.
translation_verse: Kwɛmɔ ni ahi koni akɛ nyɔɔŋnihamɔ akalaka bo; ni kaahã ninamɔ miihã oodu gbɛ.

english_verse: Your reputation and riches cannot protect you from distress,
translation_verse: Aso oyaafo baanyɛ bo ahere, aloo ohewalɛ kɛ oshika aaanyɛ nɔ ko afee?

english_verse: nor can you find safety in the dark world below.
translation_verse: Kaashwe ni duŋ awo, be ni maji ahiɛ aaakpãtã lɛ.

english_verse: Be on guard! Don't turn to evil as a way of escape.
translation_verse: Kwɛmɔ jogbaŋŋ ni okabɔ̃i eshafeemɔ: ejaakɛ oosumɔ enɛ moŋ fe nɔnaa.

english_verse: God's power is unlimited. He needs no teachers
translation_verse: Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ je agbo yɛ ehewalɛ lɛ naa; ni mɛɛ tsɔɔlɔ kɛ lɛ yeɔ hegbɔ?

english_verse: Others have praised God for what he has done, so join with them.
translation_verse: Kaimɔ koni okafo enifeemɔ ni adesai fɛɛ ewo he lala lɛ.

english_verse: From down here on earth, everyone has looked up and seen
translation_verse: Adesai fɛɛ miikwɛ enifeemɔ kɛmiijɛ shɔŋŋ; shi kɛ̃lɛ adesa nuuu shishi.

english_verse: how great God is— God is more than we imagine; no one can count the years he has lived. *
translation_verse: Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ da, shi wɔleee lɛ; ni wɔnyɛŋ efii ni eye wɔkane.

english_verse: God gathers moisture into the clouds
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ egbalaa nu kulibii kɛyaa ŋwɛi, ni ehãa afua tsɔ̃ɔ nu,

english_verse: Who can understand how God scatters the clouds and speaks from his home in the thunderstorm?
translation_verse: Ani mɔ ko aaanyɛ anu bɔ ni atatui ha ŋwɛi lɛ shishi, aloo eeenu ŋwɛi shiimɔ shishi?

english_verse: And when God sends lightning, it can be seen at the bottom of the sea.
translation_verse: Naa, egbɛ ŋwɛi srawa mli kɛbɔle ehe; shi ehã ŋshɔ shishi wo duŋ.

english_verse: By producing such rainstorms, God rules the world and provides us with food.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ gbɛ nɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ elɛɔ adesai nɛ, ni ekumaa amɛ niyenii babaoo.

english_verse: Each flash of lightning is one of his arrows striking its target,
translation_verse: Ekɛ enine mɔɔ ŋwɛi srawa mli ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ he ni egba kɛyayi.

english_verse: and the thunder tells of his anger against sin.
translation_verse: Ŋwɛi srawa gbɛɛmɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni eji, akɛ mɔ ko ni mli fũɔ yɛ nishaianii hewɔ.”

english_verse: I am frightened and tremble all over,
translation_verse: “Ŋwɛi shiimɔ lɛ hãa mitsui tswaa ni tse po eheɔ etse yɛ mimli nɛɛ.

english_verse: when I hear the roaring voice of God in the thunder,
translation_verse: Nyɛboa Nyɔŋmɔ gbee ni ji ŋwɛi shiimɔ lɛ toi, kɛ shiimɔ ni jɛ edaaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and when I see his lightning flash across the sky.
translation_verse: Eŋmɛɔ he ewoɔ ŋwɛi shishi fɛɛ, ni ŋwɛi srawa gbalaa kɛyaa shikpɔŋ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: creating miracles too marvelous for us to understand.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ gbeeshiimɔ yɛ naakpɛɛ ni efeɔ nibii wuji ni wɔjwɛŋmɔ shɛɛɛ he.

english_verse: and they force animals to seek shelter.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ ŋaŋ kooloi yaa amɛbuiaŋ, ni amɛhɔlɔ amɛshihilɛhei lɛaŋ.

english_verse: The windstorms of winter strike,
translation_verse: Ahum jɛɔ wuoyigbɛ ebaa, ni fɛ̃i hu jeɔ kooyigbɛ.

english_verse: and the breath of God freezes streams and rivers.
translation_verse: Mumɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ muɔ lɛ hãa nu fĩɔ kpɔ, ni fai fɛɛ fĩɔ tɔo tsɔ̃ɔ aisi.

english_verse: Rain clouds filled with lightning appear at God's command,
translation_verse: Ehãa atatui yiɔ kɛ nu ni ehãa srawa kpɛlɛɔ yɛ atatui lɛaŋ.

english_verse: to release their cargo— sometimes as punishment for sin, sometimes as kindness. Consider Carefully
translation_verse: Bei komɛi lɛ, ehãa enɛɛmɛi baa koni egbala gbɔmɛi atoi, bei komɛi lɛ yɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ yibaamɔ hewɔ, ni bei komɛi hu koni ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ suɔmɔ ni eyɔɔ.

english_verse: Job, consider carefully the many wonders of God.
translation_verse: Oo, bo enɛ toi, Hiob, da gãa koni ojwɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ naakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ahe.

english_verse: Can you explain why lightning flashes at the orders
translation_verse: Ani ole bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ feɔ efãa amɛ ehãa, ni ehãa la kpɛɔ kɛjɛɔ atatu mli?

english_verse: of God who knows all things? Or how he hangs the clouds in empty space?
translation_verse: Ani ole bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni le nii kɛwula shi lɛ feɔ etsuɔ enaakpɛɛ nitsumɔ ni hãa atatu sɛŋɔ shi lɛ?

english_verse: You almost melt in the heat of fierce desert winds when the sky is like brass.
translation_verse: Ele bo bɔ ni otadei amli dɔɔ la, be ni ehã shikpɔŋ lɛ efee shiŋŋ yɛ wuoyigbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ?

english_verse: God can hammer out the clouds in spite of the oppressive heat, but can you?
translation_verse: Ani obaanyɛ olɛɛ ŋwɛi, ni tamɔ dade kaŋkaŋ ni ashwie nɛɛ, mli oha shi tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ efee lɛ?

english_verse: Tell us what to say to God! Our minds are in the dark, and we don't know how to argue our case.
translation_verse: Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ nɔ ni wɔkɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ; ejaakɛ wɔjwɛŋmɔ naa etã, wɔbɛ nɔ ko ni wɔbaakɛɛ.

english_verse: Should I risk my life by telling God that I want to speak?
translation_verse: Akakɛɛ lɛ akɛ masumɔ mawie; mɔ ko bɛ ni baasumɔ akɛ ekpãtã ehiɛ.

english_verse: No one can stare at the sun after a breeze has blown the clouds from the sky.
translation_verse: Ni agbɛnɛ adesa nyɛɛɛ la lɛ ekwɛ kɛ jeŋ tse tete, ejaakɛ atatui eha hiɛ; shi kɛji kɔɔyɔɔ tswa lɛ eloɔ atatui lɛ kɛyaa.

english_verse: Yet the glorious splendor of God All-Powerful is brighter by far.
translation_verse: La tsuru fɔɔ kpɛɔ kɛjɛɔ kooyigbɛ kɛbaa. Ni Nyɔŋmɔ he anunyam lɛ hãa wɔsheɔ gbeyei.

english_verse: God cannot be seen— but his power is great, and he is always fair.
translation_verse: Ofe lɛ, wɔnyɛŋ lɛ wɔna; ehewalɛ da, ni eyeɔ jalɛ sane; ekpaŋ jalɛ saneyeli.

english_verse: And so we humans fear God, because he shows no respect for those who are proud and think they know so much.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ adesai fɛɛ, nyɛshea lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ mɛi ni buɔ amɛhe nilelɔi lɛ, ebuuu amɛ.”

english_verse: From out of a storm, the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa jɛ ahum lɛ mli ehã Hiob hetoo ekɛɛ,

english_verse: Why do you talk so much when you know so little?
translation_verse: “Namɔ hu ji mɔ ni kɛ wiemɔi ni nilee bɛ mli ehã mijwɛŋmɔ hiɛ ehua nɛɛ?

english_verse: Now get ready to face me! Can you answer the questions I ask?
translation_verse: Feemɔ kralo odamɔ shi tamɔ nuu, shi mibabi bo sane ni ohã hetoo.

english_verse: How did I lay the foundation for the earth? Were you there?
translation_verse: Be ni mito je lɛ shishi lɛ, nɛgbɛ oyɔɔ? Kɛji ole he nɔ ko lɛ, kɛɛmɔ mi!

english_verse: What supports the foundation? Who placed the cornerstone,
translation_verse: Mɛni nɔ ato je lɛ shishi ama? Namɔ ji mɔ ni to ekoŋtɛ lɛ?

english_verse: When the ocean was born, I set its boundaries
translation_verse: Aloo namɔ ŋamɔ agboi lɛ ekɛtsi ŋshɔ lɛ naa, be ni etue kɛjɛ je lɛ shishitoo he lɛ.

english_verse: Then I built a wall around it, locked the gates,
translation_verse: Be ni mito je lɛ husui ni mikɛ agboi kɛ amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi tsi enaa,

english_verse: and said, “Your powerful waves stop here! They can go no farther.” Did You Ever Tell the Sun To Rise?
translation_verse: ni mikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Biɛ nɛɛ obaawa, ni okafo mli; ni biɛ oshɔkei wuji lɛ baawa.’

english_verse: Did you ever tell the sun to rise? And did it obey?
translation_verse: Hiob, ni oba jeŋ nɛɛ, ofã ni je etsɛre dã? Ni otsɔ̃ɔ jetsɛremɔ egbɛhe pɛŋ?

english_verse: Did it take hold of the earth and shake out the wicked like dust from a rug?
translation_verse: Ani ofã jetsɛremɔ ni emɔmɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbee hei lɛ amli koni ehwanya mɛi fɔ̃ji fɛɛ kɛjɛ nɔ eshwie dã lo?

english_verse: Early dawn outlines the hills like stitches on clothing or sketches on clay.
translation_verse: Jetsɛremɔ hãa gɔji kɛ jɔi jeɔ shi faŋŋ tamɔ atade ni akumɔ mli loo tamɔ naasɔomɔnɔ ni ta magbɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: But its light is too much for those who are evil, and their power is broken.
translation_verse: Ehãa mɛi fɔɔji enãaa hei ni amɛaatsɔ̃, ni amɛniji ni amɛkɛtsuɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ kumɔɔ yɛ amɛhe.

english_verse: Job, have you ever walked on the ocean floor?
translation_verse: Aso oshɛ he ni ŋshɔ jɛɔ lɛ pɛŋ; ni oshara shi kɛnyiɛ ŋshɔ shishi dã?

english_verse: Have you seen the gate to the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Ani ajie gbohiiaje agboi lɛ akpo atsɔ̃ɔ bo, aloo ajie duŋ kpii lɛ naa agboi lɛ akpo atsɔ̃ɔ bo?

english_verse: And how large is the earth? Tell me, if you know!
translation_verse: Ani ole je lɛ dalɛ? Kɛji ole nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, wiemɔ!

english_verse: Where is the home of light, and where does darkness live?
translation_verse: Nɛgbɛ atsɔ̃ɔ kɛyaa he ni la jɛɔ, loo nɛgbɛ ji duŋ shihilɛhe,

english_verse: I'm certain you must be able to, since you were already born when I created everything.
translation_verse: Bɛ ole, ejaakɛ ofii fa babaoo ni no mli lɛ afɔ bo!

english_verse: Have you been to the places where I keep snow and hail,
translation_verse: Obote tsui ni mito snoo yɛ mli, lɛ mli pɛŋ loo ona tsui ni mito nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi yɛ mli,

english_verse: until I use them to punish and conquer nations?
translation_verse: ni ji nii ni mito mihã amanehulu be loo nɔmɔ kɛ ta be lɛ?

english_verse: Who carves out a path for thunderstorms? Who sends torrents of rain
translation_verse: Namɔ egba nujɔɔ efɔ̃ shi koni nu ni miinɛ anyiɛ mli, ni eje gbɛ ehã srawa,

english_verse: Rain that changes barren land to meadows green with grass.
translation_verse: Namɔ hãa shikpɔŋ olɛŋlɛ ni kã shi efolo naa ofɔ̃, ni jwɛi kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ nɔ?

english_verse: Who is the father of the dew and of the rain?
translation_verse: Ani nu ni nɛɔ yɛ tsɛ, loo namɔ ni fɔ bɔ́?

english_verse: Who gives birth to the sleet and the frost
translation_verse: Namɔ musuŋ aisi jɛ, ni namɔ fɔ ŋwɛi bɔ́ ni efimɔ kpɔbii.

english_verse: that fall in winter, when streams and lakes freeze solid as a rock? Can You Arrange Stars?
translation_verse: Nu fiɔ, ni ewaa tamɔ tɛ, ni ŋshɔ hiɛ fɛɛ waa keketee.

english_verse: Can you arrange stars in groups such as Orion and the Pleiades?
translation_verse: “Ani obaanyɛ okɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ afimɔ Wuɔ kɛ ebii? Aloo obaanyɛ kpãi ni fimɔ Oŋwɛ ofɛne?

english_verse: Do you control the stars or set in place the Big Dipper and the Little Dipper?
translation_verse: Ani obaanyɛ otsɔ̃ɔ ŋulamii ni kpɛlɛɔ lɛ he ni amɛtsɔ̃ kɛya kɛji amɛje, aloo obaanyɛ otsɔ̃ɔ Jeŋ Kpawo kɛ ebii lɛ gbɛ?

english_verse: Do you know the laws that govern the heavens, and can you make them rule the earth?
translation_verse: Ani ole akpɔi ni hiɛ ŋwɛi, aloo obaanyɛ ohã nakai akpɔi lɛ aye shikpɔŋ lɛ hu nɔ?

english_verse: Can you order the clouds to send a downpour,
translation_verse: Ani obaanyɛ owo ogbee nɔ ni ofã atatui lɛ koni amɛnɛ nu amɛshwie onɔ?

english_verse: Did you teach birds to know that rain or floods are on their way?
translation_verse: Namɔ tsɔ̃ɔ loofɔlɔ ibis be ni Nilo baasraŋ nɔ? Aloo namɔ tsɔ̃ɔ wuɔ nuu akɛ nu baanɛ?

english_verse: Can you count the clouds or pour out their water
translation_verse: Namɔ yɔɔ nilee ni ekɛbaanyɛ atatui lɛ ekane? Aloo ebaanyɛ ekpoo amɛnaa shi koni amɛnɛ nu

english_verse: on the dry, lumpy soil?
translation_verse: ni baahã su akpɔtɔ ni efimɔ kukulibii efee tɔo?

english_verse: When lions are hungry, do you help them hunt?
translation_verse: Ani bo omiɔ milɛloo ohãa jata, aloo ohãa jatabii loo amɛyeɔ shɛɔ amɛnaa

english_verse: Do you send an animal into their den?
translation_verse: be ni amɛbumɔ amɛbui amli, aloo amɛhɔlɔ odɔtɔi amli amɛwo ka lɛ?

english_verse: And when starving young ravens cry out to me for food, do you satisfy their hunger?
translation_verse: Namɔ hã kwãakwãalabite niyenii, be ni ebii bibii bolɔɔ amɛtsɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛtsomloɔ ejaakɛ niyenii bɛ lɛ?

english_verse: When do mountain goats and deer give birth? Have you been there when their young are born? *
translation_verse: “Ani ole be mli ni afɔɔ gɔji anɔ abotiai lo? Ona ofrote ni eefɔ dã?

english_verse: How long are they pregnant
translation_verse: Ole nyɔji abɔ ni amɛhiɛɔ musu? Ole amɛfɔmɔ be lo?

english_verse: Soon their young grow strong and then leave to be on their own.
translation_verse: Amɛbii lɛ naa hewalɛ, ni amɛdaraa yɛ jwɛiiaŋ; amɛjeɔ kpo, ni amɛkuuu amɛsɛɛ amɛbaaa dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: They stay far from crowded cities and refuse to be tamed.
translation_verse: Esumɔɔɔ hoo ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, ni enuuu mɔ ko ni miikpala lɛ gbee.

english_verse: Instead, they roam the hills, searching for pastureland.
translation_verse: Gɔji lɛ anɔ tsɔ̃ɔ eniyelihe, ni etaoɔ nii ni yɔɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ yɛ jɛi eyeɔ.

english_verse: Would a wild ox agree to live in your barn and labor for you?
translation_verse: Ani koo mli tsina aaakpɛ̃lɛ ni esɔ̃mɔ bo? Aloo eeesumɔ ni ebawɔ kooloi awɔɔhe?

english_verse: Could you force him to plow or to drag a heavy log to smooth out the soil?
translation_verse: Ani obaanyɛ owo tsinanuu kpãa ni etsa akofii, aloo eninɛ ŋmɔ yɛ jɔi amli kɛnyiɛ osɛɛ?

english_verse: Can you depend on him to use his great strength and do your heavy work?
translation_verse: Ani okɛ ohe aaafɔ̃ enɔ yɛ ehewalɛ kpele lɛ hewɔ, aloo oooshi nitsumɔ muu lɛ fɛɛ oŋmɛ enɔ?

english_verse: Can you trust him to harvest your grain or take it to your barn from the threshing place? An Ostrich Proudly Flaps Her Wings
translation_verse: Ani oheɔ lɛ oyeɔ akɛ ekɛ onikpamɔnii lɛ baaku esɛɛ; naa, ni ebua obele lɛ naa ewo aboŋo mli?

english_verse: An ostrich proudly flaps her wings, but not because she loves her young.
translation_verse: Duguma tswaa efijiaŋ kɛ ntɛŋ; shi hewalɛ kome nɛkɛ bɛ mli ni ekɛaa sumɔ bo.

english_verse: She abandons her eggs and lets the dusty ground keep them warm.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ eshiɔ ewɔji lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ koni shikpɔŋ mlu mli dɔlɛ lɛ ahã amɛhe adɔ la.

english_verse: And she doesn't seem to worry that the feet of an animal could crush them all.
translation_verse: Ni ehiɛ kpaa nɔ akɛ mɔ ko kɛ enane aaanyɛ ajwara amɛ; ni ŋaŋ kooloi aaanyɛ amɛnaanaa nɔ.

english_verse: She treats her eggs as though they were not her own, unconcerned that her work might be for nothing.
translation_verse: Ewaa ebii bibii lɛ ayi, tamɔ nɔ ni jeee ebii ni; etɔlɛ lɛ aaanyɛ afee yaka kɛ̃lɛ esheee no gbeyei.

english_verse: I myself made her foolish and without common sense.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehã nilee ebɔ lɛ, ni jwɛŋmɔ hu ehãaa lɛ eko.

english_verse: But once she starts running, she laughs at a rider on the fastest horse. Did You Give Horses Their Strength?
translation_verse: Kɛji ewo ehe nɔ, ni ebaabɔ̃i foijee lɛ, eŋmɔɔ okpɔŋɔ kɛ mɔ ni ta nɔ lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Did you give horses their strength and the flowing hair along their necks?
translation_verse: “Hiob, bo ji mɔ ni hã okpɔŋɔ hewalɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ? Ekuɛ he tsɔi funyaŋŋ lɛ bo ohã lɛ?

english_verse: Did you make them able to jump like grasshoppers or to frighten people with their snorting?
translation_verse: Ani bo ohãa okpɔŋɔ huluɔ tamɔ baalabi tuɔ lɛ? Etsinemɔ gbɛɛmɔ yɛ gbeyei!

english_verse: Before horses are ridden into battle, they paw at the ground, proud of their strength.
translation_verse: Ekɛ enane gbɛɔ shi yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli, eshwaa efɔɔ ehewalɛ nɔ; ejeɔ kpo ekɛ tabilɔi yakpeɔ.

english_verse: Laughing at fear, they rush toward the fighting,
translation_verse: Eleee nɔ ni ji gbeyei, no haaa ekpokpo tete; ejooo foi yɛ klante naa.

english_verse: while the weapons of their riders rattle and flash in the sun.
translation_verse: Gãimlibii gbɛɔ woɔ lɛ, akplɔ kɛ damfojai kpɛlɛɔ woɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Unable to stand still, they gallop eagerly into battle when trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Ekɛ hiɛdɔɔ kɛ grimɔ kpitiɔ shi; enyɛɛɛ shi edamɔ kɛji tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɛ.

english_verse: Stirred by the distant smells and sounds of war, they snort in reply to the trumpet.
translation_verse: Kɛji tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Yiɛ, eshɛ!’ Enyiɛ shɔŋŋ ni enuɔ ta he fu, kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ afaamɔi kɛ blɔmɔ he.

english_verse: Did you teach hawks to fly south for the winter? *
translation_verse: Ani bo onilee naa ni laalɔɔ filikiɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi, ni egbɛɔ efijiaŋ etsɔ̃ɔ wuoyigbɛ?

english_verse: where they can look down to spot their next meal?
translation_verse: Jɛi ejɛɔ ni enaa kooloo ni eeemɔ; ehiŋmɛi naa shɔŋŋ nii.

english_verse: Then their young gather to feast wherever the victim lies.
translation_verse: He ni gbohii jwere lɛ, jɛi okropɔŋ yɔɔ; ni ebii bibii lɛ nuɔ gbohii lɛ alá.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Hiob akɛ,

english_verse: but you have argued that I am wrong. Now you must answer me.
translation_verse: “Aso mɔ ni miitao mɔ he tɔ̃mɔ ekɛɛ lɛ, ebaanyɛ ekɛ Ofe lɛ ataa naa? Mɔ ni kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ miitaa naa lɛ, hã ehã hetoo.”

english_verse: Job said to the Lord:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Hiob here Yehowa nɔ ni ekɛɛ,

english_verse: Who am I to answer you?
translation_verse: “Naa, mijeee mɔ ko; mɛɛ hetoo mahã? Mikɛ minine eto minaabu.

english_verse: I did speak once or twice, but never again.
translation_verse: Miwie shi kome, ni mitoŋ nɔ dɔŋŋ. Miwie shii enyɔ; ni miyaŋ nɔ dɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: Then out of the storm the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa jɛ ahum lɛ mli ekɛ Hiob wie ekoŋŋ,

english_verse: Face me and answer the questions I ask!
translation_verse: “Miamɔ tamɔ nuu; mibabi bo sane koni ojie mi naa.

english_verse: Are you trying to prove that you are innocent by accusing me of injustice?
translation_verse: Aso ooka ni otsɔ̃ɔ akɛ mitɔ̃? Oobu mi fɔ koni oye bem?

english_verse: Do you have a powerful arm and a thundering voice that compare with mine?
translation_verse: Aso ohewalɛ shɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ lɛ, ni obaanyɛ ohã ogbee ashi tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ lɛ lo?

english_verse: If so, then surround yourself with glory and majesty. *
translation_verse: Kɛji nakai lɛ, no lɛ wulamɔ ohe koni ogbojee akwɔ ni onunyam ada kpele.

english_verse: Show your furious anger! Throw down and crush
translation_verse: Grimɔ kɛ mlifu ni okɛnina hewolɔ fɛɛ hewolɔ koni oba lɛ shi;

english_verse: Wrap them in grave clothes and bury them together in the dusty soil.
translation_verse: Tsiimɔ amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ owo shikpɔŋ, ni ofimɔ amɛhiɛiaŋ yɛ gbohiiaje,

english_verse: Do this, and I will agree that you have won this argument. I Created You
translation_verse: kɛkɛ lɛ mi hu makplɛ̃ nɔ mahã bo akɛ oyɛ hewalɛ ni baanyɛ ehã oye kunim.

english_verse: I created both you and the hippopotamus. It eats only grass like an ox,
translation_verse: Kwɛmɔ nuŋshwuɔ; mi mibɔ lɛ tamɔ mibɔ bo. Ekpeɔ jwɛi tamɔ tsina,

english_verse: but look at the mighty muscles in its body
translation_verse: shi kwɛmɔ hewalɛ ni yɔɔ ehɛ mli, kɛ hewalɛ ni yɔɔ ehewojiaŋ fãi lɛ mli.

english_verse: and legs. Its tail is like a cedar tree, and its thighs are thick.
translation_verse: Ehãa elei shɔ̃ɔ keketee tamɔ tsenedru, ni atswɛ̃tswɛ̃ fãi ni yɔɔ eshuɔji amli lɛ.

english_verse: The bones in its legs are like bronze or iron.
translation_verse: Ewui wa tamɔ akɔɔble, ni eniji kɛ enaji tamɔ dade adabãŋ.

english_verse: I made it more powerful than any other creature, yet I am stronger still.
translation_verse: Lɛ ji Yehowa ninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ ateŋ titri ko; mɔ ni bɔ lɛ lɛ pɛ nyɛɔ enɔ eyeɔ,

english_verse: Undisturbed, it eats grass while the other animals play nearby. *
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ŋmei tsei lɛ hãa lɛ hɔ̃ɔŋ yɛ he ni ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ yashwɛɔ yɛ lɛ.

english_verse: It rests in the shade of trees along the riverbank
translation_verse: Ehoɔ ekãa shi yɛ ŋmei tsei ashishi, ni eteɔ ehe yɛ glãi amli yɛ ŋmiamɔ mli,

english_verse: It remains calm and unafraid with the Jordan River rushing and splashing in its face.
translation_verse: Naa, kɛji faa lɛ fee hamahama tete ewooo ehe gbeyei; kɛji Yordan yi kɛbata esɛ̃ tete po eyoyrooo.

english_verse: There is no way to capture a hippopotamus— not even by hooking its nose or blinding its eyes.
translation_verse: Ani mɔ ko aaanyɛ eje ehiɛgbɛ ni emɔ lɛ, aloo ekɛ tsɔne adu egugɔ?”

english_verse: Can you catch a sea monster by using a fishhook? Can you tie its mouth shut with a rope?
translation_verse: “Obaanyɛ okɛ kpoŋ asha leviatan aloo okɛ kpãa afi elilɛi akpɛtɛ edaaŋ?

english_verse: Can it be led around by a ring in its nose or a hook in its jaw?
translation_verse: Ani ooonyɛ owo egugɔŋ taŋkpee aloo okɛ kpoŋ ala ekadaa?

english_verse: Will it surrender as a slave for life?
translation_verse: Ani ekɛ bo aaakpãŋ akɛ oŋɔ lɛ ofee otsulɔ kɛya naanɔ lo?

english_verse: Can it be tied by the leg like a pet bird for little girls?
translation_verse: Ani okɛ lɛ baashwɛ tamɔ akɛ loofɔlɔ shwɛɔ, aloo obaafi lɛ ohã oblayei lo?

english_verse: Is it ever chopped up and its pieces bargained for in the fish-market?
translation_verse: Ani wolɛi baaba amɛbaye enaa? Ani amɛfolɔ emli amɛhã jarayelɔi lo?

english_verse: Can it be killed with harpoons or spears?
translation_verse: Ani ooonyɛ otsulɔ akplɔi owo ehewojiaŋ obɔ̃, aloo oootsulɔ eyitso kɛ wuoyaa akplɔ?

english_verse: Wrestle it just once— that will be the end.
translation_verse: Kɛ onine ata ehe okwɛ, ni ofeŋ nakai ekoŋŋ; ohiɛ kpaŋ nɔmɔ ni nyiɛ sɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Merely a glimpse of this monster makes all courage melt.
translation_verse: Naa, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baana leviatan lɛ enijiaŋ jeɔ wui, ni egbeɔ shi.

english_verse: And if it is too fierce for anyone to attack, who would dare oppose me?
translation_verse: Kãkãlɔ ko kãkãlɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ awo ehiɛ la. Belɛ namɔ ji mɔ ni aaanyɛ mi mihiɛ adamɔ mɔ?

english_verse: I am in command of the world and in debt to no one.
translation_verse: Namɔ kwraa etsɔ̃ hiɛ efee nɔ ko ehã mi, koni mato lɛ najiaŋ? Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ jeŋ lɛ, minɔ ni.

english_verse: What powerful legs, what a stout body this monster possesses!
translation_verse: Mibawie eniji kɛ enaji kɛ ehewalɛ kpele kɛ egbɔmɔtso he daa.

english_verse: Who could strip off its armor or bring it under control with a harness?
translation_verse: Mɔ ko bɛ ni baanyɛ ehewolo lɛ ekpɔ; aloo eta enyanyɔji nta lɛ ahe.

english_verse: Who would try to open its jaws, full of fearsome teeth? *
translation_verse: Namɔ baanyɛ agbele edaa kɛyanina enyanyɔji ni yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ.

english_verse: than breath to breath. When This Monster Sneezes
translation_verse: Akɛ eko etsa eko nɔ, amɛkpɛtɛ amɛhe bɔ ni ehiii amɛteŋ tsemɔ.

english_verse: When this monster sneezes, lightning flashes, and its eyes glow like the dawn.
translation_verse: Kɛji etsine lɛ ekpɛlɛɔ la, ni ehiŋmɛiiaŋ tamɔ leebi hulu haai.

english_verse: Sparks and fiery flames explode from its mouth.
translation_verse: La fãa kɛjɛɔ edaaŋ tamɔ haai; la srɛmii fɛlɛɔ kɛjɛɔ edaaŋ.

english_verse: And smoke spews from its nose like steam from a boiling pot,
translation_verse: Egugɔŋ fãa lasu tamɔ lamɔ fãa kɛjɛɔ kukwɛi ni ma la nɔ mli, loo tamɔ jwɛi ni miishã lasu.

english_verse: while its blazing breath scorches everything in sight.
translation_verse: Egugɔŋ mumɔ tsɛ̃ɔ ŋai, ni edaaŋ fãa la.

english_verse: Its neck is so tremendous that everyone trembles,
translation_verse: Ekuɛ mli ehewalɛ yɔɔ, hewɔ lɛ eyɛ gbeyei kɛji oyaje ehiɛgbɛ.

english_verse: the weakest parts of its body are harder than iron,
translation_verse: Eheloo lɛ kpɛtɛ ehe kpɛŋŋ bɔ ni anyɛɛɛ akpɔ.

english_verse: and its heart is stone.
translation_verse: Etsui wa tamɔ tɛ, ewa tamɔ wiɛ.

english_verse: When this noisy monster appears, even the most powerful turn and run in fear.
translation_verse: Kɛji ewo ehe nɔ lɛ, kãkãlɔi sheɔ gbeyei; ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔɔ amɛ kɛji ekãnya ehe.

english_verse: and weapons of bronze or iron are as useless as straw or rotten wood.
translation_verse: Dade tamɔ jwɛi ni egbi, ni akɔɔble tamɔ tso ni ekpɔtɔ hã lɛ.

english_verse: Rocks thrown from a sling cause it no more harm than husks of grain. This monster fears no arrows,
translation_verse: Gãimlibi wooo lɛ foi; ni aklomia mli tɛ tsɔ̃ɔ gbetseli hãa lɛ.

english_verse: it simply smiles at spears, and striking it with a stick is like slapping it with straw.
translation_verse: Tsokpoti tamɔ gbetseli, ni efeɔ lɛ ŋmɔlɔ kɛji atsɛ̃rɛ lɛ akplɔ.

english_verse: As it crawls through the mud, its sharp and spiny hide tears the ground apart.
translation_verse: Emlishi totoi lɛ tamɔ gbɛ ko naabu sakasaka lɛ, ni ehoɔ ekãa ŋmɔtɔ lɛ mli tamɔ ŋmãagbeemɔ tso.

english_verse: And when it swims down deep, the sea starts churning like boiling oil,
translation_verse: Ehãa ŋshɔ lɛ tswaa tamɔ nula; ni afui ni etswaa lɛ tamɔ mu ni ma la nɔ.

english_verse: and it leaves behind a trail of shining white foam.
translation_verse: Esɛɛ mo kpɛɔ ni ehãa ŋshɔ lɛ tswaa afui tamɔ waŋ.

english_verse: No other creature on earth is so fearless.
translation_verse: Esaso kooloo ni sheee nɔ ko nɔ ko gbeyei bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: It is king of all proud creatures, and it looks upon the others as nothing.
translation_verse: Ebuuu nɔ ko nɔ ko ni he wa, lɛ ji kooloi hewalɔi fɛɛ atsɛ.”

english_verse: No one can oppose you, because you have the power to do what you want.
translation_verse: “Yehowa, mile akɛ onyɛɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ofeɔ, ni oyiŋtoo ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ naa aku.

english_verse: You asked why I talk so much when I know so little. I have talked about things that are far beyond my understanding.
translation_verse: Namɔ hu ji mɔ ni kɛ wiemɔi ni nilee bɛ mli teɔ nilee nɔ? No hewɔ lɛ, miwie nibii ni minuuu shishi, nibii ni ahe yɔɔ naakpɛɛ tsɔ̃ hã mi bɔ ni minuuu amɛshishi.

english_verse: You told me to listen and answer your questions.
translation_verse: Okɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Bo toi; ni mawie. Mibabi bo sane koni ohã mi hetoo!’

english_verse: I heard about you from others; now I have seen you with my own eyes.
translation_verse: Mitoi kɛkɛ mikɛnu ohe, shi agbɛnɛ mihiŋmɛi ena bo.

english_verse: The Lord said to Eliphaz: What my servant Job has said about me is true, but I am angry with you and your two friends for not telling the truth.
translation_verse: Be ni Yehowa kɛ Hiob ewie nɛkɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Elifaz, Temannyo lɛ, akɛ, “Mimli ewo bo kɛ onanemɛi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ ala, ejaakɛ nyɛwieee mihe bɔ ni ja tamɔ mitsulɔ Hiob fee lɛ.

english_verse: So I want you to go over to Job and offer seven bulls and seven goats on an altar as a sacrifice to please me. After this, Job will pray, and I will agree not to punish you for your foolishness.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛmɔmɔa tsinahii kpawo kɛ ojwɛnii hu kpawo kɛyaa mitsulɔ Hiob ŋɔɔ koni nyɛkɛyashãa shãa afɔle nyɛhãa nyɛhe. Mitsulɔ Hiob baakpa fai ehã nyɛ ni mibabo efaikpamɔ lɛ toi, ni mikɛ nyɛ yeŋ yɛ nyɛkooloofeemɔ lɛ naa, ejaakɛ nyɛwieee mihe bɔ ni ja tamɔ Hiob fee lɛ.”

english_verse: After Job had prayed for his three friends, the Lord made Job twice as rich as he had been before.
translation_verse: Be ni Hiob ekpa fai ehã enanemɛi lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa hã Hiob saa eshwere ekoŋŋ. Yehowa ku nii fɛɛ ni Hiob yɔɔ sa lɛ ebɔ he toi enyɔ ehã lɛ.

english_verse: Then Job gave a feast for his brothers and sisters and for his old friends. They expressed their sorrow for the suffering the Lord had brought on him, and they each gave Job some silver and a gold ring.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Hiob nyɛmimɛi hii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi yei lɛ fɛɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni le lɛ sa lɛ ba eŋɔɔ; ni amɛ kɛ lɛ ye nii, ni amɛye lɛ ŋkɔmɔ, ni amɛshɛje emii yɛ sane fɔŋ ni Yehowa hã ye lɛ lɛ hewɔ. Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ke Hiob jwiɛtɛi kuku kɛ shika ga.

english_verse: In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters,
translation_verse: Esaa efɔ bihii kpawo kɛ biyei etɛ̃.

english_verse: They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.
translation_verse: Yoo ko kwraa bɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ ni ehe yɛ fɛo tamɔ amɛ. Amɛtsɛ Hiob hã amɛ egboshinii lɛ eko tamɔ ehã amɛnyɛmimɛi hii lɛ.

english_verse: and when he finally died, he was very old.
translation_verse: Ni Hiob gbo be ni eji nuumo kotokoto ni eye afii babaoo diɛŋtsɛ lɛ.

english_verse: God blesses those people who refuse evil advice and won't follow sinners or join in sneering at God.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ mɔ ni booo mɛi fɔ̃ji aŋaawoo toi, ni ekɛ eshafeelɔi ebɔɔɔ, ni etaaa hefɛoyelɔi ateŋ.

english_verse: ) The Way to Happiness
translation_verse: ) Miishɛɛ Krɔŋŋ

english_verse: Instead, they find happiness in the Teaching of the Lord, and they think about it day and night.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ emii shɛɔ Yehowa Mla lɛ he, ni ejwɛŋɔ he daa shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ.

english_verse: They are like trees growing beside a stream, trees that produce fruit in season and always have leaves. Those people succeed in everything they do.
translation_verse: Etamɔ tsei ni atɛo yɛ fai atoi, ni woɔ yibii yɛ amɛbe mli, ni amɛbai kpalaaa, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni efeɔ lɛ shwereɔ.

english_verse: That isn't true of those who are evil— they are like straw blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɔ̃ji bɛ nakai; amɛ lɛ amɛtamɔ tutuu ni kɔɔyɔɔ loɔ kɛyaa.

english_verse: Sinners won't have an excuse on the day of judgment, and they won't have a place with the people of God.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, eshafeelɔi nyɛŋ kojomɔ naa amɛdamɔ; amɛnaŋ gbɛhe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ ateŋ.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who follows him, but the wicked follow a road that leads to ruin.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa kudɔɔ jalɔi agbɛ lɛ, shi mɛi fɔ̃ji agbɛ lɛ ekɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji yaa hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli.

english_verse: Why do the nations plot, and why do their people make useless plans?
translation_verse: Mɛɛba majimaji lɛ toɔ atuatsemɔ he ajina? Ni maŋbii lɛ kpãŋɔ kpãŋmɔi fɔ̃ji?

english_verse: The kings of this earth have all joined together to turn against the Lord and his chosen king.
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ tseɔ atua, ni lumɛi lɛ hu feɔ ekome; amɛkpãŋɔ Yehowa kɛ maŋtsɛ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ yinɔ.

english_verse: They say, “Let's cut the ropes and set ourselves free!”
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔkumɔa amɛgboklɛi lɛ; ni wɔtserɛ amɛkpai lɛ yɛ wɔhe.”

english_verse: In heaven the Lord laughs as he sits on his throne, making fun of the nations.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni ta ŋwɛi lɛ miiŋmɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ miiye amɛhe fɛo po; ni eyeɔ amɛhe fɛo hu.

english_verse: The Lord becomes furious and threatens them. His anger terrifies them as he says,
translation_verse: Ekɛ amɛ aaawie yɛ emlifu naa, ni ekɛ mlila aaawo amɛhe gbeyei.

english_verse: “I've put my king on Zion, my sacred hill.”
translation_verse: Ekɛɛ, “Miwo mimaŋtsɛ yɛ Zion, migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: I will tell the promise that the Lord made to me: “You are my son, because today I have become your father.
translation_verse: “Mashiɛ akpɔ ni Yehowa ewo mi lɛ,” Ekɛɛ, “Mibi ji bo, ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ mifɔ bo.

english_verse: Ask me for the nations, and every nation on earth will belong to you.
translation_verse: Bi mi, ni maŋɔ majimaji lɛ mahã bo akɛ ogboshinii; ni shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ ogbɛfaŋnɔ.

english_verse: You will smash them with an iron rod and shatter them like dishes of clay.”
translation_verse: Okɛ dade dɛhiɛmɔtso aaakumɔ amɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ, ni ooojwara amɛ tamɔ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ gbɛ.”

english_verse: Be smart, all you rulers, and pay close attention.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Oo, nyɛ maŋtsɛmɛi, nyɛlea nii; Oo, nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɔyelɔi, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ.

english_verse: Show respect to his son because if you don't, the Lord might become furious and suddenly destroy you. But he blesses and protects everyone who runs to him.
translation_verse: nyɛkɛ hekpokpomɔ akotoa lɛ; kɛjeee nakai lɛ emli baafu nyɛ oya, ni nyɛhiɛ aaakpãtã. Ajɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni baa lɛ abo lɛ.

english_verse: I have a lot of enemies, Lord. Many fight against
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, kwɛ mɛi abɔ sɔŋŋ ni haoɔ mi! Mɛi babaoo ni teɔ shi woɔ mi!

english_verse: But you are my shield, and you give me victory and great honor.
translation_verse: Shi Yehowa, bo ji mihebuu tsɛŋ, bo ji minunyam, bo ohãa mihiɛ baa nyam.

english_verse: I pray to you, and you answer from your sacred hill.
translation_verse: Miwoɔ migbee nɔ, mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ Yehowa, ni ejɛɔ egɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ ehereɔ mi nɔ.

english_verse: I sleep and wake up refreshed because you, Lord, protect me.
translation_verse: Mikãa shi miwɔɔ, ni mihiɛ tsɛ̃ɔ; ejaakɛ Yehowa buɔ mihe nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Ten thousand enemies attack from every side, but I am not afraid.
translation_verse: Misheee mɛi akpeiakpei abɔ ni ebɔ nsra ewo mihe lɛ gbeyei.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God! Break my enemies' jaws and shatter their teeth,
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, tee shi, miNyɔŋmɔ, baahere miyiwala, ejaakɛ bo otswiaa mihenyɛlɔi anii; ni okumɔɔ amɛnyanyɔji owoɔ amɛdaaŋ.

english_verse: because you protect and bless your people.
translation_verse: Kunimyeli lɛ Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛɔ, Yehowa, ojɔɔmɔ aba omaŋ lɛ nɔ. Sela

english_verse: You are my God and protector. Please answer my prayer. I was in terrible distress, but you set me free. Now have pity and listen as I pray.
translation_verse: Mijalɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, kɛ mitsɛ lɛ heremɔ mi nɔ. Kɛ efi mi lɛ bo ofɛneɔ mi. Naa mi mɔbɔ, ni obo mifaikpamɔ toi.

english_verse: How long will you people refuse to respect me? You love foolish things, and you run after what is worthless.
translation_verse: Nyɛ gbɔmɛi adesai, mɛɛ beyinɔ nyɛaagbe minunyam lɛ he guɔ kɛyaashi? Shii enyiɛ nɔŋŋ ni nyɛaasumɔ yakanii ni nyɛaatao amale sɛɛgbɛ?

english_verse: The Lord has chosen everyone who is faithful to be his very own, and he answers my prayers.
translation_verse: Nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Yehowa eŋɔ jalɔ lɛ ehã ehe; hewɔ lɛ kɛ́ mitsɛ lɛ lɛ, eboɔ mi toi.

english_verse: But each of you had better tremble and turn from your sins. Silently search your heart as you lie in bed.
translation_verse: Kɛji agba nyɛnaa lɛ, nyɛkafea esha; nyɛjwɛŋa enɛ he jogbaŋŋ yɛ nyɛsai anɔ, ni nyɛfea dioo.

english_verse: Offer the proper sacrifices and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛshãa afɔlei ni sa, ni nyɛŋɔa nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔa Yehowa nɔ.

english_verse: There are some who ask, “Who will be good to us?” Let your kindness, Lord, shine brightly on us.
translation_verse: Mɛi pii kɛɔ akɛ, “Namɔ aaafee wɔ ejurɔ! Oo Yehowa, tse ohiɛ ohã wɔ.”

english_verse: You brought me more happiness than a rich harvest of grain and grapes.
translation_verse: Ohã mimli efili mi aahu fe bɔ ni amɛbele kɛ amɛwain pii aaanyɛ ahã amɛmli afili amɛ.

english_verse: I can lie down and sleep soundly because you, Lord, will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Hejɔlɛ mli makã shi mawɔ yɛ, ejaakɛ bo, Yehowa, okoome pɛ ohãa mihiɔ shi shweshweeshwe.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! Pay attention when I groan.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, bo miwiemɔi lɛ toi, koni onu mikɔmɔ ni miyeɔ lɛ he ohã mi!

english_verse: You are my King and my God. Answer my cry for help because I pray to you.
translation_verse: Mimaŋtsɛ kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ, feemɔ toi ohã mibolɔmɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ bo fai mikpaa nɛɛ.

english_verse: Each morning you listen to my prayer, as I bring my requests to you and wait for your reply.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, leebi lɛ bo migbee toi; leebi lɛ bo fai mikpaa, ni bo ohetoo gbɛ mikwɛɔ.

english_verse: You are not the kind of God who is pleased with evil. Sinners can't stay with you.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ojeee Nyɔŋmɔ ni naa efɔŋfeemɔ he tsui; ni mɔ fɔŋ hu kɛ bo ehiii shi.

english_verse: No one who boasts can stand in your presence, Lord, and you hate evil people.
translation_verse: Hewolɔi nyɛɛɛ ohiɛ amɛdamɔ, ni onyɛɔ efɔŋfeelɔi fɛɛ.

english_verse: You destroy every liar, and you despise violence and deceit.
translation_verse: Okpãtãa amalelɔi ahiɛ. Lashishwielɔi kɛ shishiulɔi lɛ Yehowa miihi amɛ.

english_verse: Because of your great mercy, I come to your house, Lord, and I am filled with wonder as I bow down to worship at your holy temple.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ naa lɛ maba owe lɛ; mikɛ woo aaaja bo yɛ oSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ.

english_verse: You do what is right, and I ask you to guide me. Make your teaching clear because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Oo, Yehowa, kplamɔ mi yɛ ojalɛ lɛ naa yɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ahewɔ. Hã ogbɛ akã shi faŋŋ ahã mi.

english_verse: Nothing they say is true! They just want to destroy. Their words are deceitful like a hidden pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ anɔkwa kome nɛkɛ bɛ amɛdaaŋ; amɛtsuiiaŋ eyi obɔ̃ kɛ fitemɔ; amɛsɛ̃ lɛ gbonyobu ni agbele naa ni; amɛkɛ amɛlilɛi wieɔ dɔkɔbii.

english_verse: Punish them, God, and let their own plans bring their downfall. Get rid of them! They keep committing crimes and turning against you.
translation_verse: Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, hã amɛsɔ̃ abua amɛyiteŋ. Hã amɛyiŋshai lɛ nɔŋŋ akpãtã amɛhiɛ. Shɛrɛmɔ amɛ oshwie, ejaakɛ amɛtɔ̃ onɔ babaoo, ni amɛtse ohiɛ atua.

english_verse: Let all who run to you for protection always sing joyful songs. Provide shelter for those who truly love you and let them rejoice.
translation_verse: Shi mɛi fɛɛ ni baa bo abo lɛ, amɛmli filiɔ amɛ. Hã amɛla lalai be fɛɛ be kɛ miishɛɛ. Mɛi fɛɛ ni sumɔɔ ogbɛi lɛ, fã amɛhe ni ohã amɛnya.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who live right, and you shield them with your kindness.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bo Yehowa lɛ jalɔ ojɔɔ, ni okɛ mlihilɛ buɔ ehe tamɔ tsɛŋ.

english_verse: Don't punish me, Lord, or even correct me when you are angry!
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, kaakã mihiɛ yɛ omlifu mli, ni okɛ mlila hu akagbala mitoi.

english_verse: Have pity on me and heal my feeble body. My bones tremble with fear,
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, naa mi mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ miigbɔjɔ. Oo Yehowa, tsa mi ejaakɛ miikpokpo kɛ gbeyei.

english_verse: and I am in deep distress. How long will it be?
translation_verse: Misusuma hu miikpokpo naakpa. Shi ao Yehowa, kɛyaashi mɛɛbe?

english_verse: Turn and come to my rescue. Show your wonderful love and save me, Lord.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, kuu osɛɛ, heremɔ miyiwala, baakpɔ̃ mi yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: If I die, I cannot praise you or even remember you.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ akaiii bo yɛ gbele mli; ni gbohiiaje hu namɔ aaajie oyi yɛ jɛi?

english_verse: My groaning has worn me out. At night my bed and pillow are soaked with tears.
translation_verse: Etɔ mi kɛ kɛ̃ɛmɔ; mifɔɔ misaa tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ daa nyɔɔŋ kɛ yaafonu.

english_verse: Sorrow has made my eyes dim, and my sight has failed because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Awerɛhoo ehã mihiŋmɛi eshiu, ni mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, mihiŋmɛii anɔ eha.

english_verse: You, Lord, heard my crying, and those hateful people had better leave me alone.
translation_verse: Nyɛjea minɔ nyɛyaa, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛtsuɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ; ejaakɛ Yehowa enu miyaafo gbee lɛ.

english_verse: You have answered my prayer and my plea for mercy.
translation_verse: Yehowa enu mifaikpamɔ lɛ, Yehowa ebo misɔlemɔ toi.

english_verse: My enemies will be ashamed and terrified, as they quickly run away in complete disgrace.
translation_verse: Mihenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ aaagboi, ni amɛaahao naakpa. Amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ, ni amɛhiɛ aaagboi yɛ be kuku mli.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my protector. Rescue me and keep me safe from all who chase me.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, bo abo mibaa! Heremɔ miyiwala ni ojie mi yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyiɛ misɛɛ lɛ adɛŋ.

english_verse: Or else they will rip me apart like lions attacking a victim, and no one will save me.
translation_verse: Heremɔ mi koni henyɛlɔi lɛ akagbala mi kɛtee he ni jielɔ ko bɛ, ni amɛyatserɛ mimli tamɔ jata.

english_verse: I have not betrayed a friend or had pity on an enemy who attacks for no reason.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa miNyɔŋmɔ, kɛji mitɔ̃ mɔ ko nɔ, kɛji mifee naanyo ko efɔŋ, kɛji miwa mɛi ni he tsɛ̃ɔ mi yakatswaa lɛ ayi lɛ,

english_verse: If I have done any of this, then let my enemies chase and capture me. Let them trample me to death and leave me in the dirt.
translation_verse: no lɛ, hã mihenyɛlɔi lɛ atiu mi ni amɛmɔ mi, ni amɛnaanaa minɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni magbo, ni makã mlu mli.

english_verse: Get angry, Lord God! Do something! Attack my furious enemies. See that justice is done.
translation_verse: Oo, Yehowa, tee shi kɛ mlila, wo ohe nɔ yɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ agirimɔ lɛ hewɔ; Oo miNyɔŋmɔ, ohiɛ atsɛ̃; bo ni oto kojomɔ ofɔ shi.

english_verse: Make the nations come to you, as you sit on your throne above them all.
translation_verse: Buamɔ asafokui lɛ anaa kɛbɔle ohe kɛkpe, ni ojɛ ŋwɛi oye amɛnɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, judge the nations! Judge me and show that I am honest and innocent.
translation_verse: Yehowa, bo okojoɔ mɛi fɛɛ! Oo Yehowa, kojomɔ mi yɛ mijalɛ lɛ naa, ejaakɛ mi lɛ, mifeko efɔŋ ko.

english_verse: You know every heart and mind, and you always do right. Now make violent people stop, but protect all of us who obey you.
translation_verse: Oo, hã mɛi fɔ̃ji anɔfɔŋfeemɔ lɛ sɛɛ afo; Shi jalɔi lɛ, ojuro amɛ; ejaakɛ bo ji jalɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, ni okaa tsui kɛ jwɛŋmɔ okwɛɔ.

english_verse: You, God, are my shield, the protector of everyone whose heart is right.
translation_verse: Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ji mitsɛŋ! Lɛ ehereɔ mɛi ni ja yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You see that justice is done, and each day you take revenge.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ jalɛ naa kojolɔ ni; ebuɔ efɔŋfeelɔ fɔ be fɛɛ be.

english_verse: Whenever your enemies refuse to change their ways, you sharpen your sword and string your bow.
translation_verse: Kɛji gbɔmɔ tsakeee etsui lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ejɔ eklante naa; ni edɔ egãi lɛ mli ni eta.

english_verse: Your deadly arrows are ready with flaming tips.
translation_verse: Esaa emɔgbee dadei lɛ eto bo, ni ehã egãimlibii lɛ miikpɛlɛ tamɔ la.

english_verse: An evil person is like a woman about to give birth to a hateful, deceitful, and rebellious child.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɔ̃ji jwɛŋɔ efɔŋ, ni amɛŋɔɔ efɔŋ hɔ, ni amɛfɔɔ amale.

english_verse: Such people dig a deep hole, then fall in it themselves.
translation_verse: Etsaa bu, ni ehãa emli kwɔɔ, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ egbeɔ bu ni etsa lɛ mli;

english_verse: The trouble they cause comes back on them, and their heads are crushed by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: emusu buaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiteŋ, ni eyiwalɛ lɛ wulaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ eyiteŋ.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You always do right. I will sing about you, the Lord Most High.
translation_verse: Mada Yehowa shi yɛ ejalɛ naa, ni mala majie Yehowa, Ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ gbɛi lɛ yi.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth! You let your glory be seen in the heavens above.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, wɔNuŋtsɔ, Ogbɛi lɛ je agbo yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ! Okɛ onunyam eha ŋwɛi flooflo.

english_verse: With praises from children and from tiny infants, you have built a fortress. It makes your enemies silent, and all who turn against you are left speechless.
translation_verse: Ohenyɛlɔi ahewɔ lɛ, osaa hewalɛ oto yɛ gbekɛbii kɛ abifabii anaa, bɔ ni afee ni ohã ohenyɛlɔi lɛ amua amɛnaa ni amɛfee diŋŋ.

english_verse: I often think of the heavens your hands have made, and of the moon and stars you put in place.
translation_verse: Kɛ mikwɛ oŋwɛi kɛ onine naa nitsumɔi lɛ, nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii ni obɔ lɛ,

english_verse: Then I ask, “Why do you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for us weaklings?”
translation_verse: mɛni ji gbɔmɔ adesa ni ojwɛŋɔ ehe? Namɔ po ji gbɔmɔbi ni ogbaa ohenaa yɛ ehe?

english_verse: You made us a little lower than you yourself, and you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ, shwɛ shrao ni ohã ekɛ bo Nyɔŋmɔ aye hegbɔ; ni okɛ anunyam kɛ woo efi lɛ akekre.

english_verse: You let us rule everything your hands have made. And you put all of it under our power—
translation_verse: Bo ohã lɛ hegbɛ ni ekɛyeɔ onine naa nitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. Oŋɔ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ oto enajiaŋshi ni eye amɛnɔ:

english_verse: the sheep and the cattle, and every wild animal,
translation_verse: toi kɛ tsinai fɛɛ tswɛm kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi hu,

english_verse: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and all ocean creatures.
translation_verse: kɛ ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ ŋshɔŋ loi fɛɛ kɛ bɔɔ nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋshɔ mli hu.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth!
translation_verse: Yehowa, wɔNuŋtsɔ, Ogbɛi lɛ je agbo yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart and tell about the wonders you have worked.
translation_verse: Mada Yehowa shi kɛ mitsui fɛɛ, ni magba onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: God Most High, I will rejoice; I will celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Ohewɔ lɛ manya; ni mimli aaafli mi. Bo Ofe ni oyɔɔ ŋwɛi flooflo, mala, ni majie ogbɛi lɛ yi.

english_verse: When my enemies face you, they run away and stumble and are destroyed.
translation_verse: Mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ; amɛgbeegbee shi, ni amɛplene yɛ ohiɛ.

english_verse: You take your seat as judge, and your fair decisions prove that I was in the right.
translation_verse: Anɔkwale kɛ jalɛ saneyelɔ ji bo yɛ okojomɔ mli. Ota omaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ ni oye jalɛ sane ohã mi.

english_verse: You warn the nations and destroy evil people; you wipe out their names forever and ever.
translation_verse: Okã majimaji lɛ ahiɛ, okpãtã mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ ahiɛ. Ogbe amɛgbɛi kwrakwra kɛmiiya naanɔi anaanɔ.

english_verse: Our enemies are destroyed completely for all time. Their cities are torn down, and they will never be remembered again.
translation_verse: Henyɛlɔi lɛ asɛɛ efo kɛmiiya naanɔ; obutu amɛmaji wuji lɛ; ni kaimɔ po, akaiŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: You rule forever, Lord, and you are on your throne, ready for judgment.
translation_verse: Shi Yehowa lɛ, lɛ lɛ, eeye maŋtsɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ; emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ kɛhã kojomɔ.

english_verse: You judge the world fairly and treat all nations with justice.
translation_verse: Ekojoɔ je lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa, ekwɛɛɛ hiɛaŋ ekojooo mɛi.

english_verse: The poor can run to you because you are a fortress in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Yehowa ji abobaahe hã mɛi ni awaa amɛ yi lɛ, eji abobaahe yɛ fimɔ bei amli.

english_verse: Everyone who honors your name can trust you, because you are faithful to all who depend on you.
translation_verse: Ni mɛi ni le ogbɛi lɛ ŋɔɔ amɛhiɛ amɛfɔ̃ɔ onɔ; ejaakɛ bo Yehowa, okwaaa mɛi ni taoɔ osɛɛgbɛ lɛ.

english_verse: You rule from Zion, Lord, and we sing about you to let the nations know everything you have done.
translation_verse: Nyɛlaa nyɛjiea Yehowa ni yɔɔ Zion lɛ yi! Nyɛgbaa enitsumɔi lɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ amli.

english_verse: You did not forget to punish the guilty or listen to the cries of those in need.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ lɛ mɔ ni etɔɔ lá he owele lɛ, ekaiɔ mɛi ni piŋɔ; ni ehiɛ kpaaa nɔnalɔi abolɔmɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! My enemies mistreat me. Keep me from the gates that lead to death,
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, naa mi mɔbɔ! Kwɛmɔ mimanehulu ni minaa yɛ mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ adɛŋ. Oo, bo mɔ ni owoɔ minɔ kɛjɛɔ gbohiiaje agboi lɛ amli,

english_verse: and I will sing about you at the gate to Zion. I will be happy there because you rescued me.
translation_verse: koni majaje oyijiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yerusalɛmbii lɛ agboi lɛ amli, mimli aaafli mi, ejaakɛ ohere miyiwala.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations fell into their own pits, and their feet were caught in their own traps.
translation_verse: Jeŋ maji lɛ egbee bu ni amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛtsa lɛ mli. Tsɔne ni amɛtsɔ̃ amɛtee lɛ edu amɛ.

english_verse: You showed what you are like, and you made certain that justice is done, but evil people are trapped by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ ejalɛ kojomɔ ehã ale lɛ; mɛi fɔ̃ji edu tsɔne ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛtsɔ̃ lɛ.

english_verse: The wicked will go down to the world of the dead to be with those nations that forgot about you.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɔ̃ji kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni hiɛ kpaa Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ lɛ baaya gbohiiaje.

english_verse: The poor and the homeless won't always be forgotten and without hope.
translation_verse: Shi ohiafo lɛ, jeee daa hiɛ aaakpa enɔ, ohiafo hiɛnɔkãmɔ efeŋ yaka, kɛyaŋ naanɔ.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Don't let the nations win. Make them stand trial in your court of law.
translation_verse: Oo, Yehowa, tee shi; kaahã adesa miiye kunim. Hã ni akojo majimaji lɛ yɛ ohiɛ.

english_verse: Make the nations afraid and let them all discover just how weak they are.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, wo amɛhe gbeyei koni majimaji lɛ ana ale akɛ gbɔmɛi adesai kɛkɛ ji amɛ.

english_verse: Why are you far away, Lord? Why do you hide yourself when I am in trouble?
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, mɛɛba okɛ mi teŋ ejekɛ nɛkɛ? Mɛɛba otee ohe yɛ fimɔ bei amli nɛɛ?

english_verse: Proud and brutal people hunt down the poor. But let them get caught by their own evil plans!
translation_verse: Mɛi fɔ̃ji kɛ ntɛŋ haoɔ ohiafoi. Hã mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ adu amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛtsɔne ni amɛtsɔ̃ lɛ.

english_verse: The wicked brag about their deepest desires. Those greedy people hate and curse you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ eshwãa efɔ̃ɔ etsuiŋ sɛɛdii nibii anɔ; ni amimyelɔ lomɔɔ, ni ekwaa Yehowa.

english_verse: The wicked are too proud to turn to you or even think about you.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɔŋ hewoo mli lɛ etaooo Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ; eyiŋ fɛɛ lɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ.”

english_verse: They are always successful, though they can't understand your teachings, and they keep sneering at their enemies.
translation_verse: Egbɛi fɛɛ shwereɔ be fɛɛ be; okojomɔ lɛ kwɔ fe lɛ, ejwɛŋmɔ shɛɛɛ he; eyeɔ ehenyɛlɔi ahe fɛo.

english_verse: In their hearts they say, “Nothing can hurt us! We'll always be happy and free from trouble.”
translation_verse: Ekɛɔ ehe akɛ, “Eshiii mi kpu! Amanehulu ko baŋ minɔ gbi ko gbi ko.”

english_verse: They curse and tell lies, and all they talk about is how to be cruel or how to do wrong.
translation_verse: Loomɔ kɛ kutumpɔo kɛ yiwaa eyi edaaŋ obɔ̃; haomɔ kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ hɔ elilɛi shishi.

english_verse: They hide outside villages, waiting to strike and murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Ewoɔ ka yɛ akrowai amli; egbeɔ mɔ ni efeko nɔ ko yɛ nififiaŋ; ejieɔ ehiɛ ekaa mɔ ni efĩ lɛ.

english_verse: They are hungry lions hiding in the bushes, hoping to catch some helpless passerby. They trap the poor in nets and drag them away.
translation_verse: Edɛkeɔ shi tamɔ jata yɛ olɔtɔ mli; ewoɔ ka koni emɔ ohiafo; ekɛ akpa duɔ ohiafo; ni eshãtãa lɛ kɛyaa.

english_verse: They crouch down and wait to grab a victim.
translation_verse: Ekotoɔ shi, edɛkeɔ shi, ni mɛi ni he waaa lɛ gbeɔ ekaa mli.

english_verse: They say, “God can't see! He's got on a blindfold.”
translation_verse: Mɔ fɔŋ susuɔ yɛ etsuiŋ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ekpa nɔ, ekɛ ehiɛ etee; ni enaŋ gbi ko gbi ko.”

english_verse: Do something, Lord God, and use your powerful arm to help those in need.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, tee shi! Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, jiemɔ ohewalɛ kpo, ohiɛ akakpa nɔnalɔi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: The wicked don't respect you. In their hearts they say, “God won't punish us!”
translation_verse: Mɛni hewɔ ni mɔ fɔŋ kwaa Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ekɛɔ yɛ etsuiŋ akɛ, “Etsɛŋ wɔ akɔntaabuu?”

english_verse: But you see the trouble and the distress, and you will do something. The poor can count on you, and so can orphans.
translation_verse: Shi bo lɛ onaa nii, lɛɛlɛŋ bo lɛ okadiɔ haomɔ kɛ awerɛhoo fɛɛ, koni kɛ mɔ ni bɛ mɔ ko lɛ tu ehe ewo odɛ̃ŋ lɛ, oye obua lɛ, ejaakɛ bo ji awusai abualɔ.

english_verse: Now break the power of all merciless people. Punish them for doing wrong and make them stop.
translation_verse: Fitemɔ yiwalɔ kɛ efɔŋfeelɔ hewalɛ lɛ; kolimɔ enifɔɔjianii lɛ amli kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni onaaa eko dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will always rule, but every godless nation will vanish from the earth.
translation_verse: Yehowa ji maŋtsɛ kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyaashi naanɔ. Jeŋmaji lɛ ahiɛ aaakpãtã kɛaaje eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: You listen to the longings of those who suffer. You offer them hope, and you pay attention to their cries for help.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, oboɔ humii asɔlemɔ toi; owoɔ amɛ hewalɛ; ni obaa otoi shi ohãa mi,

english_verse: You defend orphans and everyone else in need, so that no one on earth can terrify others again.
translation_verse: koni oye awusai kɛ mɛi ni awaa amɛyi lɛ asane ohã amɛ, koni gbɔmɔ adesa ni jɛ su mli, akawo mɔ he gbeyei dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: The Lord is my fortress! Don't say to me, “Escape like a bird to the mountains!”
translation_verse: Yehowa, bo abo mibaa; mɛɛba nyɛkɛɔ mi akɛ, “Filikimɔ tamɔ loofɔlɔ kɛya gɔji lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: You tell me, “Watch out! Those evil people have put their arrows on their bows, and they are standing in the shadows, aiming at good people.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ naa, yiwalɔi edɔrɔ amɛgãii, ni amɛkɛ gãimlibii lɛ emamɔ kpãi lɛ anɔ koni amɛtsɛ̃rɛ̃ mɛi kpakpai yɛ dujiaŋ.

english_verse: What can an honest person do when everything crumbles?”
translation_verse: Kɛji afite shishitoo lɛ, mɛni jalɔ aaanyɛ afee dɔŋŋ?”

english_verse: The Lord is sitting in his sacred temple on his throne in heaven. He knows everything we do because he sees us all.
translation_verse: Yehowa yɛ eSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ, Ŋwɛi emaŋtsɛ Sɛi lɛ ma. Ehiŋmɛi jwere nɔ ni gbɔmɛi adesaiabii feɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord tests honest people, but despises those who are cruel and love violence.
translation_verse: Yehowa kaa jalɔ kɛ mɔ fɔŋ fɛɛ ekwɛɔ, shi yiwalɔ lɛ, Yehowa miihi lɛ.

english_verse: He will send fiery coals and flaming sulfur down on the wicked, and they will drink nothing but a scorching wind.
translation_verse: Eeehã la ni tsoɔ glegle kɛ swɔɔ anɛ ashwie mɔ fɔŋ nɔ; kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ la ekɛaagbala etoi.

english_verse: The Lord always does right and wants justice done. Everyone who does right will see his face.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa lɛ, jalɔ ni, ni esumɔɔ jalɛ saneyeli; mɔ ni ja aaana ehiɛ.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord! All who were faithful and all who were loyal have disappeared.
translation_verse: Yehowa, ye obua wɔ! Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ; ni anɔkwafoi etã yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies, and no one is sincere.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lakaa enaanyo. Amɛnaa dɔkɔbii kɛ amɛlilɛi nta.

english_verse: Won't you chop off all flattering tongues that brag so loudly?
translation_verse: Yehowa ahã mɛi ni wieɔ dɔkɔbii lɛ afee dioo, kɛ lilɛi ni shwãa nibii wuji lɛ,

english_verse: They say to themselves, “We are great speakers. No one else has a chance.”
translation_verse: mɛi hu ni kɛɔ akɛ, “Wɔkɛ wɔlilɛi aaana nɔ ni wɔtaoɔ. Wɔnaabui lɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔnɔ ni. Namɔ yeɔ wɔnɔ Nuŋtsɔ?”

english_verse: But you, Lord, tell them, “I will do something! The poor are mistreated and helpless people moan. I'll rescue all who suffer.”
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Akɛni awaa ohiafoi ayi, ni mɛi ni efĩ amɛ lɛ kɛ̃mɔɔ hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, mate shi, ni mɔ ni shweɔ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ mahere eyiwala.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you are true to your promises, and your word is like silver heated seven times in a fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Yehowa shiwoi lɛ, shiwoi ni yɔɔ krɔŋŋ ni; amɛtamɔ jwiɛtɛi ni aka yɛ shikpɔŋ flɔnɔɔ mli, ni atsuu he nɔtoonɔtoo shii kpawo.

english_verse: You will protect us and always keep us safe from those people.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, buu wɔhe; baamɔ wɔyi daa kɛjɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ adɛŋ.

english_verse: But all who are wicked will keep on strutting, while everyone praises their shameless deeds.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɔ̃ji foɔ sa kɛkpeɔ, ni mɛi fɔ̃ji nyaa yaka saji ahe yɛ gbɔmɛi abii ateŋ.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord, will you forget about me? Will it be forever? How long will you hide?
translation_verse: Yehowa, kɛyaashi mɛɛ beyinɔ po ni ohiɛ aaakpa minɔ? Kɛyaashi naanɔ tɔ̃ɔ lo? Okɛ ohiɛ baatee mi kɛyaashi mɛɛbe?

english_verse: How long must I be confused and miserable all day? How long will my enemies keep beating me down?
translation_verse: Mɛɛbe misusuma aaapiŋ, ni maye awerɛho yɛ mitsuiŋ gbi muu fɛɛ. Mɛɛbe mihenyɛlɔ aaawo ehe nɔ yɛ minɔ kɛyashi?

english_verse: Please listen, Lord God, and answer my prayers. Make my eyes sparkle again, or else I will fall into the sleep of death.
translation_verse: Oo, Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, kwɛmɔ mi ni ohere mi nɔ; tsiɛ̃mɔ mi koni mikawɔ gbele wɔ.

english_verse: My enemies will say, “Now we've won!” They will be greatly pleased when I am defeated.
translation_verse: Kaahã mihenyɛlɔ miikɛɛ akɛ, “Miye enɔ”, ni mihaolɔi lɛ akanya yɛ mishigbeemɔ hewɔ.

english_verse: I trust your love, and I feel like celebrating because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ nɔ mihiɛ kã. Manya kɛ mitsui fɛɛ, ejaakɛ obaahere miyiwala.

english_verse: You have been good to me, Lord, and I will sing about you.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, mala mahã O, ejaakɛ ofee mi ejurɔ.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless; they are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Kwashiai kɛɔ yɛ amɛtsuiŋ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ!” Amɛfite, ni amɛfeɔ nyaŋemɔ nii; mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni feɔ nɔ̃ kpakpa.

english_verse: From heaven the Lord looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Yehowa jɛɔ ŋwɛi ekwɛɔ gbɔmɛi abii, akɛ aleee nɔ eeena akɛ mɔ ko yɛ ni le nii ni etaoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sɛɛgbɛ lo?

english_verse: Won't you evil people learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Ani nɔfɔŋfeelɔi lɛ amɛleee nii? Mɛi ni yeɔ mimaŋbii tamɔ ayeɔ kɔmi, ni amɛsɔleee amɛtsɛɛɛ Yehowa lɛ, amɛbɛ jwɛŋmɔ!

english_verse: But you will be frightened, because God is on the side of every good person.
translation_verse: Gbeyei kpele aaamɔmɔ amɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ jalɔi lɛ yɛ.

english_verse: You may spoil the plans of the poor, but the Lord protects them.
translation_verse: Nɔfɔŋfeelɔi aaanyɛ afite ohiafo yiŋtoo nɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ Yehowa ji ebobaahe.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our Lord, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: Oo, kulɛ Israel yiwalaheremɔ lɛ ajɛ Zion aba! Kɛji Yehowa hã emaŋ lɛ ku sɛɛ na nii ekoŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ Yakob aaanya, ni Israel mii aaashɛ ehe.

english_verse: Who may stay in God's temple or live on the holy mountain of the Lord?
translation_verse: Yehowa, namɔ aaabote obuu lɛŋ? Namɔ aaaja yɛ Zion, ogɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ?

english_verse: Only those who obey God and do as they should. They speak the truth
translation_verse: Namɔ baaba ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ, ni efeɔ nɔ ni ja, ni ewieɔ anɔkwale kɛ etsuiŋ fɛɛ;

english_verse: and don't spread gossip; they treat others fairly and don't say cruel things.
translation_verse: mɔ ni kɛ elilɛi yeee mɔ he osheku ni efeee enaanyo efɔŋ ko; ni ebɔɔɔ enaanyo gbɔmɔ ahora.

english_verse: They hate worthless people, but show respect for all who worship the Lord. And they keep their promises, no matter what the cost.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni nyɛɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekwa amɛ, shi moŋ ewoɔ mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ ahiɛ nyam; mɔ ni kɛ ekã kitã ni eeena amane yɛ he po lɛ, etsakeee.

english_verse: They lend their money without charging interest, and they don't take bribes to hurt the innocent. Those who do these things will always stand firm.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kɛ eshika efaaa eheee hekpa ni fe nine; ni eheee nyɔɔŋnii koni ewie eshi mɔ ni yeɔ bem. Mɔ ni feɔ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ, edidãŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord God! I run to you for safety,
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, buu mihe, ejaakɛ bo abo mibaa.

english_verse: and I have said, “Only you are my Lord! Every good thing I have is a gift from you.”
translation_verse: Mikɛɔ Yehowa akɛ, “Bo ji miNuŋtsɔ; osɛɛ lɛ mibɛ nɔ kpakpa ko.”

english_verse: Your people are wonderful, and they make me happy,
translation_verse: Hetselɔi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛ lɛ, anunyam gbɔmɛi ji amɛ, ni miyɛ amɛhe tsuijurɔ.

english_verse: but worshipers of other gods will have much sorrow. I refuse to offer sacrifices of blood to those gods or worship in their name.
translation_verse: Shi mɛi ni yanyiɛɔ nyɔŋmɔ kroko sɛɛ lɛ, amɛhaomɔi faa. Mifɔseŋ lá ni amɛkɛba afɔleshãa lɛ mishwieŋ shi akɛ afɔle; ni mikɛ minaabu etsiŋ amɛgbɛii atã tete.

english_verse: You, Lord, are all I want! You are my choice, and you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Yehowa, bo ji minɔ fɛɛ nɔ, bo ohãa mi mihiamɔ nii fɛɛ. Bo odɛ̃ŋ miwala yɔɔ.

english_verse: You make my life pleasant, and my future is bright.
translation_verse: Mihusu kpãi eyaje he ni yɔɔ fɛo ehã mi; lɛɛlɛŋ, mina gboshinii ni hi naakpa.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for being my guide. Even in the darkest night, your teachings fill my mind.
translation_verse: Majie Yehowa mɔ ni woɔ mi ŋaa lɛ yi; Mitsui tete kɛ mi wieɔ nyɔɔŋ.

english_verse: I will always look to you, as you stand beside me and protect me from fear.
translation_verse: Mikɛ Yehowa ema mihiɛ daa; akɛni eyɔɔ mininejurɔ nɔ nɛɛ, mididaŋ.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will celebrate, and I can safely rest.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mitsui enyɔ mimli, ni misusuma tete miinya; migbɔmɔtso hu yɛ shweshweeshwe.

english_verse: I am your chosen one. You won't leave me in the grave or let my body decay.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ oŋmɛŋ mihe ohaŋ gbohiiaje, ni mɔ ni heɔ onɔ eyeɔ lɛ enaŋ gbohiiaje.

english_verse: You have shown me the path to life, and you make me glad by being near to me. Sitting at your right side, I will always be joyful.
translation_verse: Bo otsɔ̃ɔ mi wala gbɛ. Ohiɛ lɛ, miishɛɛ sɔŋŋ; ni mimii eshɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord! Won't you listen as I pray and beg for help? I am honest! Please hear my prayer.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, bo jalɛ sane toi; too otoi ohã mibolɔmɔ lɛ. Feemɔ toi ohã misɔlemɔ ni jeee amale ni lɛ.

english_verse: Only you can say that I am innocent, because only your eyes can see the truth.
translation_verse: Bo diɛŋtsɛ buu mi bem, ejaakɛ bo onaa nɔ ni ja.

english_verse: You know my heart, and even during the night you have tested me and found me innocent. I have made up my mind never to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Kɛji oka mitsui okwɛ, kɛ otao mimli nyɔɔŋ, ni oka mi okwɛ lɛ, onaŋ nɔ fɔŋ ko kwraa yɛ mimli; mikɛ minaabu efeee efɔŋ.

english_verse: I don't do like others. I obey your teachings and am not cruel.
translation_verse: Yɛ gbɔmɛi adesai anifeemɔnii agbɛfaŋ lɛ, mibo odaaŋ wiemɔ toi, ni minyiɛɛɛ yiwalɔi agbɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: I have followed you, without ever stumbling.
translation_verse: Minane emɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ anɔ, ni mishaneko.

english_verse: I pray to you, God, because you will help me. Listen and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, miibo miitsɛ bo, ejaakɛ ooohere mi nɔ; ba otoi shi ohã mi ni obo miwiemɔi lɛ atoi.

english_verse: Show your wonderful love. Your mighty arm protects those who run to you for safety from their enemies.
translation_verse: Jiemɔ onaakpɛɛ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kpo otsɔ̃ɔ mi. Oo, bo yiwalaherelɔ ni okɛ ohewalɛ hereɔ mɛi ni taoɔ abobaa lɛ ayiwala kɛjɛɔ amɛhenyɛlɔi adɛŋ.

english_verse: Protect me as you would your very own eyes; hide me in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Baamɔ miyi tamɔ abaa hiŋmɛi mli ajaŋmalaatɛ yi. Okɛ mi atee ofiji ashishi hɔɔŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies attack from all sides and kill me.
translation_verse: Jiemɔ mi kɛjɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji ni waa mi yi, kɛ mihenyɛlɔi kakawuai ni ebɔle mi kɛkpe lɛ adɛŋ.

english_verse: They refuse to show mercy, and they keep bragging.
translation_verse: Amɛkpliŋ amɛtsui, ni amɛnaaa mɔbɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛnaabui wieɔ hewoo wiemɔi.

english_verse: They have caught up with me! My enemies are everywhere, eagerly hoping to smear me in the dirt.
translation_verse: Amɛjaa misɛɛ mo, amɛbɔleɔ mihe kɛkpeɔ kpula; amɛ jie amɛhiɛ amɛka mi koni amɛtsi mi amɛtswa shi.

english_verse: They are like hungry lions hunting for food, or like young lions hiding in ambush.
translation_verse: Amɛtamɔ jata ni kɛ hiɛdɔɔ baatserɛ emilɛ loo; amɛtamɔ jatabi ni ewo antɛo yɛ odɔtɔ mli.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Attack and defeat them. Take your sword and save me from those evil people.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, tee shi owo mihenyɛlɔi lɛ, ni obutu amɛ. Okɛ oklante lɛ ajie misusuma yɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ.

english_verse: Use your powerful arm and rescue me from the hands of mere humans whose world won't last. You provide food for those you love. Their children have plenty, and their grandchildren will have more than enough.
translation_verse: Yehowa, kɛ onineshiwalɛ ajie mi kɛjɛ gbɔmɛi ni amɛna amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ wala be nɛɛ mli lɛ adɛŋ. Hã amɛmusui ayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ toigbalamɔ ni osaa oto ohã amɛ lɛ; ni pii ashwɛ ahã amɛbii kɛ amɛbii abii.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord, and I will see your face! When I awake, all I want is to see you as you are.
translation_verse: Mi lɛ, mana ohiɛ, yɛ jalɛ mli; ni kɛ mihiɛ tsɛ̃ lɛ, mitsui aaatɔ, ejaakɛ mina bɔ ni oyɔɔ.

english_verse: I love you, Lord God, and you make me strong.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, miisumɔ bo; bo ji mihewalɛ.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock, my fortress, my protector, the rock where I am safe, my shield, my powerful weapon, and my place of shelter.
translation_verse: Yehowa ji mitɛsaa kɛ mimɔɔ ni wa, kɛ mijielɔ. MiNyɔŋmɔ kɛ mitɛsaa, mɔ mli ni mibaa abo yɛ; bo ji mitsɛŋ kɛ miyiwalaheremɔ akloŋto. Bo ji mimɔɔ ni wa.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! I prayed, and you rescued me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Mibo mitsɛ Yehowa, mɔ ni sa yijiemɔ lɛ, ni ehere miyiwala kɛjɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ.

english_verse: Death had wrapped its ropes around me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.
translation_verse: Gbele kpãi lalaa mi, ni ŋshɔkei wuji lota mi.

english_verse: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Mifĩmɔ mli lɛ, mitsɛ Yehowa; mibo mitsɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, koni eye ebua mi. Ejɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ tɔ̃ɔ ni enu migbee; ni mibolɔmɔ lɛ bote etoiŋ.

english_verse: The earth shook and shivered, and the mountains trembled down to their roots. You were angry
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ kpokpo, ni gɔji lɛ ashishitoo lɛ hu hoso, ni amɛjo bliblibli; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli efu.

english_verse: and breathed out smoke. Scorching heat and fiery flames spewed from your mouth.
translation_verse: Lasu fã kɛjɛ egugɔ mli kɛtee ŋwɛi; ni la ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ jɛ edaaŋ; ŋai ni miitso jɛ edaaŋ.

english_verse: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ hã ŋwɛi kpoo enaa shi, kɛkɛ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebayi shi ni duŋ kabitii yɛ enajiaŋshi.

english_verse: You rode on the backs of flying creatures and swooped down with the wind as wings.
translation_verse: Eta kerub nɔ, ni efiliki; eta kɔɔyɔɔ fiji anɔ kɛkpeleke shi oya.

english_verse: Darkness was your robe; thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.
translation_verse: Ekɛ duŋ ha ehe; oblɔtu kpii ni eshi lutulutu eshi yɛ eyiteŋ tamɔ akatamanso.

english_verse: Hailstones and fiery coals lit up the sky in front of you.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi kɛ ŋai ni miitso kpɛlɛ kɛtsɔ̃ oblɔtu kabitii lɛ mli kɛnyiɛ ehiɛ.

english_verse: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens, as hailstones and fiery coals poured down like rain.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa shi yɛ ŋwɛi tamɔ ŋwɛi shiimɔ, ni ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ wo egbee.

english_verse: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, oyiŋaa naa kɛ ogugɔŋ mumɔ gbɛɛmɔ naa hã ŋshɔ mli ŋkajai lɛ je kpo, ni je lɛ shishitoo lɛ bakamɔ shi faŋŋ.

english_verse: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.
translation_verse: Ekpã enine mli kɛjɛ ŋwɛi ni ebawo mi, ni egbala mi kɛjɛ nui babaoo mli.

english_verse: You rescued me from enemies, who were hateful and too powerful for me.
translation_verse: Ejie mi kɛjɛ mihenyɛlɔi ni he wa lɛ kɛ mɛi hu ni hetsɛ̃ɔ mi lɛ adɛŋ; ejaakɛ amɛhe wa fe mi kwraa.

english_verse: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.
translation_verse: Amɛbatua mi yɛ mimanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ; shi Yehowa ji mɔ ni fã mihe.

english_verse: When I was fenced in, you freed and rescued me because you love me.
translation_verse: Ejie mi kɛtee he ni lɛɛ lɛkɛtɛɛ. Ejie mi, ejaakɛ eyɛ mihe tsui.

english_verse: You are good to me, Lord, because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.
translation_verse: Yehowa to mi najiaŋ yɛ mijalɛ lɛ naa; ejuro mi, ejaakɛ muji ko bɛ mihe.

english_verse: I do what you want and never turn to do evil.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ miba mijeŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni mijeko miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ yɛ gbɛ fɔŋ ko nɔ.

english_verse: I keep your laws in mind and never look away from your teachings.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ miye emlai lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni mikuko ekpɔi lɛ ekoeko mli.

english_verse: I obey you completely and guard against sin.
translation_verse: Shwamɔ ko bɛ mihe yɛ ehiɛ, ni miwiɔ mihe kɛjeɔ nɔsha he.

english_verse: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Yehowa to mi najiaŋ yɛ mijalɛ naa, ejaakɛ muji ko bɛ midɛŋ yɛ ehiɛ.

english_verse: With all who are sincere, you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni he tse lɛ, ojieɔ ohe kpo otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ oyɛ krɔŋŋ; ni mɔ ni bɛ eŋɛlɛnɔ lɛ, okɛ lɛ yeee.

english_verse: You rescue the humble, but you put down all who are proud.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni baa amɛhe shi lɛ, ohereɔ amɛ; shi hiŋmɛii ni woɔ amɛhe nɔ lɛ, obaa amɛ shi.

english_verse: You, the Lord God, keep my lamp burning and turn darkness to light.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, lɛɛlɛŋ bo ohãa mi kane; ni ohãa miduŋ mli kpɛɔ kɛ la.

english_verse: You help me defeat armies and capture cities.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛŋ, ohewalɛ naa lɛ, mabutu henyɛlɔi asafo. MiNyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ naa lɛ, mahuru gbogbo.

english_verse: Your way is perfect, Lord, and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ nɛɛ, enifeemɔinii fɛɛ hi kɛwula shi. Yehowa yeɔ eshiwoi anɔ. Eji tsɛŋ kɛhã mɛi fɛɛ ni baa lɛ abo lɛ.

english_verse: You alone are God! Only you are a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Shi namɔ ji Nyɔŋmɔ kɛjɛ Yehowa sɛɛ? Ni namɔ ji wɔbobaahe yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ.

english_verse: You give me strength and guide me right.
translation_verse: Lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ ni miãa mi kɛ hewalɛ; ni ehãa mifeɔ shweshweeshwe yɛ migbɛi fɛɛ amli.

english_verse: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.
translation_verse: Ehã minajiaŋ wa tamɔ ofrote, ni eŋɔ mi edamɔ gɔji anɔ shweshweeshwe.

english_verse: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.
translation_verse: Etsɔ̃ɔ mi tawuu, koni manyɛ akɔɔble gãi po mli madɔ.

english_verse: You alone are my shield. Your right hand supports me, and by coming to help me, you have made me famous.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, okɛ oyiwalaheremɔ tsɛŋ lɛ ehere miyiwala; ni ohewalɛ hiɛ mimli, ni oyibaamɔ lɛ ehã mije agbo.

english_verse: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.
translation_verse: Ohãa mifamɔɔ minaji zãaŋzãaŋ, ni mishaneee.

english_verse: I kept chasing my enemies, until I caught them and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Mitiu mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ni minina amɛ; mikpaleee kɛjeee amɛsɛɛ kɛyashi miplenee amɛ.

english_verse: I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.
translation_verse: Mitswia amɛ nii bɔ ni amɛnyɛɛɛ shi amɛte dɔŋŋ. Amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ minaji anaa.

english_verse: You helped me win victories, and you forced my attackers to fall victim to me.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ omia mi, ni mina hewalɛ kɛhã tawuu, ni ohã mihenyɛlɔi lɛ nyɔnyɔɔi yɛ mihiɛ.

english_verse: You made my enemies run, and I killed them.
translation_verse: Ohã mihenyɛlɔi lɛ tsɔ̃ amɛsɛɛ amɛhã mi, ni mikpãtã mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
translation_verse: Amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ yelikɛbuamɔ; shi mɔ ko mɔ ko yeee buaaa amɛ. Amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa, shi efooo amɛdaaŋ.

english_verse: I ground them to dust blown by the wind, and I poured them out like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Miwiɛ amɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ ni amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ mlu ni kɔɔyɔɔ loɔ kɛyaa. Miloo amɛ mishwie tamɔ blohuŋ ŋmɔtɔ.

english_verse: You rescued me from stubborn people, and you made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.
translation_verse: Ohãaa maŋsɔ̃ aba mi kɛ maŋbii ateŋ. Ofee mi majimaji lɛ atsɛ; mɛi ni mileee amɛ po basɔmɔ mi.

english_verse: They have lost all courage, and from their fortresses, they come trembling.
translation_verse: Maŋsɛɛbii atsui fã, ni amɛkɛ hekpokpomɔ je kpo kɛjɛ amɛmɔji lɛ amli kɛba.

english_verse: You are the living Lord! I will praise you. You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Yehowa hiɛ kã; ajie mitɛsaa lɛ yi; ni awo miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam.

english_verse: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ ni tɔɔ mihe owele, ni ebaa maji ashi ewoɔ mishishi lɛ.

english_verse: You protected me from violent enemies and made me much greater than all of them.
translation_verse: Lɛ mɔ ni ehereɔ mi kɛjɛɔ mihenyɛlɔi adɛŋ. Hɛɛ, bo owoɔ minɔ yɛ mihenyɛlɔi anɔ; bo ojieɔ mi yɛ yiwalɔi adɛŋ.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and I will honor you among the nations.
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa, majie oyi yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ, ni mala majie ogbɛi lɛ yi.

english_verse: You give glorious victories to your chosen king. Your faithful love for David and for his descendants will never end.
translation_verse: Yehowa hãa emaŋtsɛ lɛ yeɔ kunim kpelekplei, ni ejieɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ; ni ji David kɛ eshwiei lɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.

english_verse: The heavens keep telling the wonders of God, and the skies declare what he has done.
translation_verse: Ŋwɛi gbaa Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ, ni atatu jieɔ eninenaa nitsumɔ lɛ kpo.

english_verse: Each day informs the following day; each night announces to the next.
translation_verse: Gbi fɛɛ gbi gbaa anunyam lɛ, ni nyɔɔŋ fɛɛ nyɔɔŋ shiɛɔ enilee lɛ.

english_verse: They don't speak a word, and there is never the sound of a voice.
translation_verse: Anuuu gbee ko, anuuu wiemɔ ko. Ni anuuu amɛgbee ko nɛ,

english_verse: Yet their message reaches all the earth, and it travels around the world. In the heavens a tent is set up for the sun.
translation_verse: shi kɛ̃lɛ nɔ ni amɛwieɔ lɛ kpeleɔ jeŋ fɛɛ, ni anuɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he. Nyɔŋmɔ eshi buu yɛ ŋwɛi ehã hulu, ni hulu fãa kɛjeɔ kpo,

english_verse: It rises like a bridegroom and gets ready like a hero eager to run a race.
translation_verse: tamɔ ayɛmforowu jeɔ kpo kɛjɛɔ epia mli; ni emliflimɔ lɛ, etamɔ foidalɔ mliflimɔ ni ekɛdaa foi.

english_verse: It travels all the way across the sky. Nothing hides from its heat.
translation_verse: Ejeɔ yɛ ŋwɛi naagbeehe kome, ni ebɔleɔ shi kɛyaa naagbeehe kroko, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko eteee ehe yɛ enaa la lɛ hiɛ. Yehowa Mla lɛ

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is perfect; it gives us new life. His teachings last forever, and they give wisdom to ordinary people.
translation_verse: Yehowa mla lɛ hi kɛwula shi; ehãa gbɔmɔ susuma naa hewalɛ hee. Yehowa mla lɛ maa shi shiŋŋ; ehãa humii leɔ nii.
