english_verse: The Lord's instruction is right; it makes our hearts glad. His commands shine brightly, and they give us light.
translation_verse: Yehowa akpɔi lɛ ja pɛ, amɛhãa mɔ tsui nyaa. Yehowa kitãi lɛ yɛ krɔŋŋ, amɛhãa mɔ hiŋmɛi gbeleɔ.

english_verse: Worshiping the Lord is sacred; he will always be worshiped. All his decisions are correct and fair.
translation_verse: Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ lɛ he tse, ehiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ. Yehowa kojomɔi lɛ anɔkwale ni, fɛɛ ja kɛmɔ shi.

english_verse: They are worth more than the finest gold and are sweeter than honey from a honeycomb.
translation_verse: Amɛyɛ akɔnɔ fe shika, amɛfe shika krɔŋŋ tete; amɛŋɔɔ fe wo hu, amɛŋɔɔ fe wo agbaku po.

english_verse: By your teachings, Lord, I am warned; by obeying them, I am greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Asaŋ nomɛi bɔɔ otsulɔ kɔkɔ; amɛnɔyeli lɛ, sɛɛnamɔ kpele yɛ mli.

english_verse: None of us know our faults. Forgive me when I sin without knowing it.
translation_verse: Namɔ aaanyɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etɔmɔi ena? Yehowa, jiemɔ mi kɛjɛ midujiaŋ tɔ̃mɔi amli.

english_verse: Don't let me do wrong on purpose, Lord, or let sin have control over my life. Then I will be innocent, and not guilty of some terrible fault.
translation_verse: Baamɔ mi otsulɔ, miyi kɛjɛ eshai ni gbɔmɔ hiɛ kã he ni efeɔ lɛ mli. Kaahã eshai lɛ miiye minɔ; no dani mahi kɛwula shi, ni mihe aaaje tɔ̃mɔi kpelei amli.

english_verse: Let my words and my thoughts be pleasing to you, Lord, because you are my mighty rock and my protector.
translation_verse: Yehowa, hã midaaŋ wiemɔ kɛ mitsuiŋ susumɔi asa ohiɛ; bo mitɛsaa kɛ mikpɔlɔ lɛ!

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will listen when you are in trouble, and that the God of Jacob will keep you safe.
translation_verse: Yehowa abo bo toi yɛ ofimɔ gbi lɛ nɔ! Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ abu ohe.

english_verse: May the Lord send help from his temple and come to your rescue from Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Ejɛ ehe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eye ebua bo, ni ejɛ Zion ewaje bo.

english_verse: May he remember your gifts and be pleased with what you bring.
translation_verse: Ekai afɔlei lɛ fɛɛ kwa, ni oshãa afɔlei lɛ asa ehiɛ.

english_verse: May God do what you want most and let all go well for you.
translation_verse: Ehã bo nii ni otsui shweɔ lɛ, ni ehã oyiŋtoi fɛɛ aba mli.

english_verse: Then you will win victories, and we will celebrate, while raising our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord answer all your prayers!
translation_verse: Wɔɔbɔ oshe kɛ nyamɔ yɛ okunimyeli hewɔ; ni wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi mli wɔɔshi wɔflaŋai yɛ. Yehowa ahã bo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni obiɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I am certain, Lord, that you will help your chosen king. You will answer my prayers from your holy place in heaven, and you will save me with your mighty arm.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ mina mile akɛ Yehowa yeɔ ebuaa maŋtsɛ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ, ni eeejɛ eŋwɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ebo lɛ toi, ni Yehowa aaahã lɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛye kunim.

english_verse: Some people trust the power of chariots or horses, but we trust you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Mɛi komɛi shwãa fɔ̃ɔ tayaa shwiilii anɔ, ni mɛi komɛi hu okpɔŋɔi anɔ; shi wɔ lɛ, Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hewalɛ nɔ wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: Others will stumble and fall, but we will be strong and stand firm.
translation_verse: Nakai mɛi lɛ, amɛaatswia shi, ni amɛaanyɔnyɔi; shi wɔ lɛ, wɔɔte shi, wɔɔdamɔ shi shiŋŋ.

english_verse: Give the king victory, Lord, and answer our prayers.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, hã maŋtsɛ lɛ aye kunim; kɛ wɔfo wɔtsɛ bo lɛ, heremɔ wɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, your mighty power makes the king glad, and he celebrates victories that you have given him.
translation_verse: Yehowa, ohewalɛ lɛ mli maŋtsɛ lɛ naa miishɛɛ yɛ; ni oyelikɛbuamɔ mli maŋtsɛ lɛ nyaa yɛ.

english_verse: You did what he wanted most and never told him “No.”
translation_verse: Nɔ ni etsui shweɔ lɛ, ohãa lɛ; ni nɔ ni ebiɔ lɛ, okamãaa lɛ.

english_verse: You truly blessed the king, and you placed on him a crown of finest gold.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ okɛ nii kpakpai amli jɔɔmɔi kumaa lɛ, ni okɛ shika krɔŋŋ akekre fiɔ eyitso.

english_verse: He asked to live a long time, and you promised him life that never ends.
translation_verse: Eba wala yɛ odɛ̃ŋ, ni ohã lɛ; wala kakadaŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ.

english_verse: The king is highly honored. You have let him win victories that have made him famous.
translation_verse: Oyelikɛbuamɔ hewɔ lɛ, enunyam lɛ da; oduro lɛ woo kɛ agbojee.

english_verse: You have given him blessings that will last forever, and you have made him glad by being so near to him.
translation_verse: Ojɔɔ lɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ. Na ni enaa bo hãa emii shɛɔ ehe.

english_verse: Lord Most High, the king trusts you, and your kindness keeps him from defeat.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ kã Yehowa nɔ; ni ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ lɛ, edidãŋ.

english_verse: With your mighty arm, Lord, you will strike down all of your hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ lɛ nine aaashɛ ehenyɛlɔi fɛɛ anɔ; mɛi ni nyɛɔ bo lɛ, onine aaashɛ amɛnɔ.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by fire once you are here, and because of your anger, flames will swallow them.
translation_verse: Kɛ ojie ohe kpo lɛ, oooŋala amɛ tamɔ flɔɔnɔɔ mli la. Yehowa aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ emlifu lɛ naa, ni la lɛ aaashã amɛ wɛɛ.

english_verse: You will wipe their families from the earth, and they will disappear.
translation_verse: Oookpãtã amɛshwiei lɛ ahiɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; oookpãtã amɛbii lɛ hu ahiɛ kɛje gbɔmɛi adesai ateŋ.

english_verse: All their plans to harm you will come to nothing.
translation_verse: Kɛ amɛjwɛŋ ohe efɔŋ, ni amɛto ohe ŋaa gbonyo lɛ, amɛyeŋ kunim.

english_verse: You will make them run away by shooting your arrows at their faces.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ooota ogãi lɛ oma amɛhiɛ ni amɛaatsɔ̃ amɛsɛɛ amɛjo foi.

english_verse: Show your strength, Lord, so that we may sing and praise your power.
translation_verse: Oo, Yehowa, wɔmiiwo onɔ gojoo yɛ ohewalɛ kpele lɛ hewɔ! Wɔbaala kɛjie ohewalɛ lɛ yi.

english_verse: My God, my God, why have you deserted me? Why are you so far away? Won't you listen to my groans and come to my rescue?
translation_verse: MiNyɔŋmɔ, miNyɔŋmɔ, mɛɛba okwa mi? Mɛɛba okɛ miyelikɛbuamɔ teŋ jɛkɛ nɛkɛ? Mɛɛba okɛ mikɛ̃ɛmɔ teŋ jɛkɛ nɛkɛ?

english_verse: I cry out day and night, but you don't answer, and I can never rest.
translation_verse: Oo, miNyɔŋmɔ, mibolɔɔ shwane, shi ohereee mi nɔ. Mibolɔɔ nyɔɔŋ hu, ni mijɔɔɔ mihe.

english_verse: Yet you are the holy God, ruling from your throne and praised by Israel.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ, mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ji bo; mɔ koome pɛ yi ni Israel jieɔ kɛ lalai lɛ.

english_verse: Our ancestors trusted you, and you rescued them.
translation_verse: Wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ he bo ye, ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ onɔ ni ojie amɛ.

english_verse: When they cried out for help, you saved them, and you did not let them down when they depended on you.
translation_verse: Bo amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ, ni ohere amɛ. Bo onɔ amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ ni amɛhiɛ gboiii!

english_verse: But I am merely a worm, far less than human, and I am hated and rejected by people everywhere.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, gɔgɔmi kɛkɛ ji mi, mishɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ. Mɛi bɔɔ mi ahora, ni mɛi nyaŋeɔ mi.

english_verse: Everyone who sees me makes fun and sneers. They shake their heads,
translation_verse: Mɛi fɛɛ ni naa mi lɛ yeɔ mihe fɛo; amɛgbɛɔ amɛdaaŋ, ni amɛhosoɔ amɛyitsei,

english_verse: and say, “Trust the Lord! If you are his favorite, let him protect you and keep you safe.”
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Tuu osane lɛ owo Yehowa dɛŋ; hã ni lɛ ehere bo, hã ni lɛ ehere mɔ he miishɛɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: You, Lord, brought me safely through birth, and you protected me when I was a baby at my mother's breast.
translation_verse: Bo ojie mi kɛjɛ minyɛ musu mli, ohiɛ mi shweshweeshwe, be ni mikã minyɛ fufɔ naa.

english_verse: From the day I was born, I have been in your care, and from the time of my birth, you have been my God.
translation_verse: Kɛjɛ mifɔmɔ mli beebe, aŋɔ mi aŋmɛ onɔ. Kɛjɛ be ni minyɛ fɔ mi nɛɛ bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: Don't stay far off when I am in trouble with no one to help me.
translation_verse: Okɛ mi teŋ akajekɛ, ejaakɛ shi haomɔ ebɛŋkɛ, ni bualɔ ko bɛ.

english_verse: Enemies are all around like a herd of wild bulls. Powerful bulls from Bashan are everywhere.
translation_verse: Henyɛlɔi babaoo ebɔle mi kɛkpe kpula, tamɔ tsina hii, amɛtamɔ Bashan tsina hii hewalɔi, ni efo sa ewo mihe.

english_verse: My enemies are like lions roaring and attacking with jaws open wide.
translation_verse: Amɛgbɛɔ amɛdaaŋ hatohatoo amɛwoɔ mi; amɛtamɔ jata kramakrama ni miihuu.

english_verse: I have no more strength than a few drops of water. All my bones are out of joint; my heart is like melted wax.
translation_verse: Aloo mi ashwie tamɔ nu, ni mitalɔi amli egoi: ni mitsui esere yɛ mimli tamɔ wo agbaku.

english_verse: My strength has dried up like a broken clay pot, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You, God, have left me to die in the dirt.
translation_verse: Misɛŋ egbi tamɔ ŋɛsuko mli, mililɛi ekpɛtɛ midaaŋ; ni oshi mi oŋmɛ su mli tamɔ gbonyo.

english_verse: Brutal enemies attack me like a pack of dogs, tearing at my hands and my feet.
translation_verse: Henyɛlɔi ebɔle mi kɛkpe tamɔ shifɔji; mɛi fɔ̃ji asafo efo sa ewo mihe kpula, amɛtserɛ miniji kɛ minaji.

english_verse: I can count all my bones, and my enemies just stare and sneer at me.
translation_verse: Manyɛ makane mimli wui fɛɛ; mihenyɛlɔi lɛ taa gãa amɛkwɛɔ mi.

english_verse: They took my clothes and gambled for them.
translation_verse: Amɛja mitadei lɛ amli amɛhã amɛhe, ni mihebo lɛ, amɛfɔ̃ nɔ oshiki.

english_verse: Don't stay far away, Lord! My strength comes from you, so hurry and help.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, kaahi sɛɛ shɔŋŋ. Oo, bo mihewalɛ, feemɔ oya ni oye obua mi.

english_verse: Rescue me from enemy swords and save me from those dogs.
translation_verse: Jiemɔ misusuma kɛjɛ klante naa gbele mli, heremɔ miyiwala kɛjɛ shifɔji lɛ adɛŋ.

english_verse: Don't let lions eat me. You rescued me from the horns of wild bulls,
translation_verse: Jiemɔ mi kɛjɛ jatai adaaŋ, heremɔ miyiwala kɛje wuoi akoji ateŋ.

english_verse: and when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Majaje onifeemɔi lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ minyɛmimɛi lɛ, ni majie oyi yɛ asafo lɛ mli.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, now praise him! You belong to Jacob's family and to the people of Israel, so fear and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Nyɛ Yehowa gbeyeishelɔi, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi. Nyɛ Yakob shwiei fɛɛ, nyɛwoa ehiɛ nyam; ni nyɛ Israel shwiei bluublu, nyɛkɛ woo ahãa lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't hate or despise the helpless in all of their troubles. When I cried out, he listened and did not turn away.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ekwaaa nɔnalɔ nɔnaa lɛ, ni ekuuu ehiɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ nɔnalɔ nɔ. Shi be ni nɔnalɔ bo etsɛ lɛ lɛ, ehere lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: When your people meet, you will fill my heart with your praises, Lord, and everyone will see me keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Bo ohãa mijieɔ oyi yɛ asafo kpele lɛ mli; maye mishiwoi lɛ anɔ yɛ mɛi ni sheɔ bo gbeyei ni amɛjaa bo lɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: The poor will eat and be full, and all who worship you will be thankful and live in hope.
translation_verse: Ohiafoi aaaye nii, ni amɛaatɔrɔ; mɛi ni taoɔ Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ lɛ, aaajie eyi. Amɛyi ana wala kɛya naanɔ.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth will remember you, Lord. People all over the world will turn and worship you,
translation_verse: Jeŋ koji kpawo lɛ aaakai, ni amɛaakpale kɛaaba Yehowa ŋɔɔ; ni majimaji lɛ amli akutsei lɛ fɛɛ aaakula shi amɛja lɛ.

english_verse: because you are in control, the ruler of all nations.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ Yehowa nɔ ni, ni lɛ eyeɔ majimaji lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: All who are rich and have more than enough will bow down to you, Lord. Even those who are dying and almost in the grave will come and bow down.
translation_verse: Lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hewolɔi lɛ fɛɛ aaakoto. Mɛi ni egboi momo, kɛ mɛi ni baagboi fɛɛ baakoto lɛ.

english_verse: In the future, everyone will worship and learn about you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Yinɔbii fɛɛ aaasɔmɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi baagba Nuŋtsɔ lɛ he sane atsɔ̃ɔ yinɔbii ni baa lɛ.

english_verse: People not yet born will be told, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Abaajaje atsɔ̃ɔ yinɔbii ni afɔko tete lɛ akɛ lɛ, Yehowa lɛ, ehere maŋ lɛ yiwala.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my shepherd. I will never be in need.
translation_verse: Yehowa ji mikwɛlɔ nɔ ko nɔ ko ehiaŋ mi.

english_verse: You let me rest in fields of green grass. You lead me to streams of peaceful water,
translation_verse: Ehãa mibuɔ shi yɛ lɛɛhei ni yɔɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃. Ewaa mi kɛyaa nui ni he jɔ lɛ ahe.

english_verse: and you refresh my life. You are true to your name, and you lead me along the right paths.
translation_verse: Ehãa minaa hewalɛ hee. Ekpalaa mi kɛtsɔ̃ɔ jalɛ gbɛi anɔ yɛ egbɛi lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: I may walk through valleys as dark as death, but I won't be afraid. You are with me, and your shepherd's rod makes me feel safe.
translation_verse: Asaŋ kɛ minyiɛ gbele hɔ̃ɔŋ jɔɔ lɛŋ tete lɛ, misheŋ efɔŋ ko gbeyei, ejaakɛ okɛ mi yɛ. Otookplamɔtso kɛ odɛhiɛmɔtso lɛ, nomɛi shɛjeɔ mimii.

english_verse: You treat me to a feast, while my enemies watch. You honor me as your guest, and you fill my cup until it overflows.
translation_verse: Oŋmɛɔ mi okplɔ̃ yɛ mihenyɛlɔi ahiɛ. Okɛ mu fɔɔ miyitso mikpulu lɛ eyi kɛteke nɔ.

english_verse: Your kindness and love will always be with me each day of my life, and I will live forever in your house, Lord.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛŋ, ejurɔyeli kɛ omɔbɔnalɛ aaanyiɛ misɛɛ yɛ miwala be lɛ fɛɛ mli; ni asaŋ, mahi Yehowa we lɛ miwala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: The earth and everything on it, including its people, belong to the Lord. The world and its people belong to him.
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ enɔ nii fɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa nɔ ni; ni je lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ, enɔ ni.

english_verse: The Lord placed it all on the oceans and rivers.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ lɛ eto shishi yɛ ŋshɔi ashishi tɔ̃ɔ̃ ni ehã ema shi shiŋŋ yɛ fai anɔ.

english_verse: Who may climb the Lord's hill or stand in his holy temple?
translation_verse: Namɔ aaakwɔ Yehowa gɔŋ lɛ? Ni namɔ aaadamɔ ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ?

english_verse: Only those who do right for the right reasons, and don't worship idols or tell lies under oath.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni amɛdɛŋ bɛ esha ko ni amɛtsuii amli tse. Mɛi ni kɛ amɛgbɔmɔtsei hãaa yakayaka nifeemɔ, ni amɛkãaa amale kitã.

english_verse: The Lord God, who saves them, will bless and reward them,
translation_verse: Gbɔmɛi ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, amɛaana jɔɔmɔ kɛaajɛ Yehowa dɛŋ. Amɛaana bembuu kɛaajɛ amɛyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ.

english_verse: because they worship and serve the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji gbɔmɛi ni taoɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ, mɛi ni baa Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Oo nyɛ agboi, nyɛholea nyɛyitsei anɔ! Oo nyɛ blema shinai, nyɛholea nyɛhe nɔ koni anunyam maŋtsɛ lɛ aba mli.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, a strong and mighty warrior.
translation_verse: Namɔ ji anunyam maŋtsɛ nɛɛ? Lɛ ji Yehowa, hewalɔ kɛ kãkãlɔ lɛ. Lɛ ji Yehowa, ta mli kunimyelɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Nyɛgbelea agboi lɛ nyɛfɔ̃a, nyɛgbelea blema shinai lɛ, koni anunyam maŋtsɛ lɛ aba mli.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, the All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Namɔ ji anunyam maŋtsɛ nɛɛ? Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ ni. Lɛ ji anunyam maŋtsɛ lɛ.

english_verse: I offer you my heart, Lord God,
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, bo miwoɔ misusuma nɔ mihãa.

english_verse: and I trust you. Don't make me ashamed or let enemies defeat me.
translation_verse: Oo miNyɔŋmɔ, bo onɔ mihiɛ kã, kaahã mihiɛ miishwie shi, kaahã mihenyɛlɔi lɛ miiye mi yɔɔ.

english_verse: Show me your paths and teach me to follow;
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, hã male ogbɛ̃i lɛ; tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi otempɔ̃ŋi lɛ.

english_verse: guide me by your truth and instruct me. You keep me safe, and I always trust you.
translation_verse: Kplamɔ mi kɛnyiɛ onɔkwale lɛ mli, ni otsɔ̃ɔ mi nii; ejaakɛ bo ji miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Bo onɔ mihiɛ kã daa nɛɛ.

english_verse: Please, Lord, remember, you have always been patient and kind.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, kaimɔ omɔbɔnalɛ kɛ omlihilɛ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛyɛ kɛjɛ blema beebe.

english_verse: Forget each wrong I did when I was young. Show how truly kind you are and remember me.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, kaakai miblahiaŋ eshai kɛ tɔ̃mɔi lɛ; shi moŋ kaimɔ mi yɛ omlihilɛ kɛ okpakpafeemɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: You are honest and merciful, and you teach sinners how to follow your path.
translation_verse: Yehowa hi, ni jalɔ ji lɛ, hewɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ eshafeelɔi gbɛ ni ja.

english_verse: You lead humble people to do what is right and to stay on your path.
translation_verse: Ekpalaa heshibalɔi kɛnyiɛɔ jalɛ gbɛ nɔ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni he jɔ lɛ egbɛ lɛ.

english_verse: In everything you do, you are kind and faithful to everyone who keeps our agreement with you.
translation_verse: Suɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo, kɛ anɔkwayeli sɔŋŋ ji Yehowa gbɛi fɛɛ, kɛhã mɛi fɛɛ ni yeɔ ekpãŋmɔ lɛ kɛ ekpɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, by forgiving each one of my terrible sins.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ mihe esha lɛ ofa mi, ejaakɛ eda.

english_verse: You will show the right path to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ, lɛ Yehowa aaatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ gbɛ ni enyiɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Then they will have plenty, and their children will receive the land.
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ eeeshwere, ni eshwiei aaaye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the friend of your worshipers, and you make an agreement with all of us.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ, amɛ ekɛbɔɔ naanyo, ni ehãa amɛleɔ ekpãŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I always look to you, because you rescue me from every trap.
translation_verse: Mihiŋmɛii kwɛɔ Yehowa gbɛ daa nɛɛ; ejaakɛ lɛ eeejie minaji kɛaaje yaa mli.

english_verse: I am lonely and troubled. Show that you care and have pity on me.
translation_verse: Tsɔ̃ ohiɛ ohã mi, ni ona mi mɔbɔ! Ejaakɛ mɔ kome mɔ ji mi; minii yɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: My awful worries keep growing. Rescue me from sadness.
translation_verse: Mitsui mli haomɔi lɛ fa; jiemɔ mi kɛjɛ mifimɔi lɛ amli!

english_verse: See my troubles and misery and forgive my sins.
translation_verse: Kwɛmɔ minɔnaai lɛ, kɛ mihaomɔi lɛ; ni okɛ mihe eshai lɛ fɛɛ afa mi.

english_verse: Look at all my enemies! See how much they hate me.
translation_verse: Kwɛmɔ mihenyɛlɔi, ejaakɛ amɛyi fa; kwɛ bɔ ni amɛkɛ yiwaa nyɛɔ mi yakatswaa lɛ.

english_verse: I come to you for shelter. Protect me, keep me safe, and don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Oo, buu miwala he ni ohere mi; kaahã mihiɛ miishwie shi, ejaakɛ bo abo mibaa.

english_verse: I obey you with all my heart, and I trust you, knowing that you will save me.
translation_verse: Emuuyeli kɛ jalɛ abaa miyi; ejaakɛ bo gbɛ mikwɛɔ.

english_verse: Our God, please save Israel from all its troubles.
translation_verse: Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, kpɔ̃ Israel kɛje ehaomɔi lɛ fɛɛ mli.

english_verse: Show that I am right, Lord! I stay true to myself, and I have trusted you without doubting.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, buu mi bem, ejaakɛ miiba mijeŋ jogbaŋŋ, ni mikɛ mihiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ kwraa ni migbaŋ afã.

english_verse: Test my thoughts and find out what I am like.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, taomɔ mimli ni oka mi okwɛ. Kaa mitsui kɛ mijwɛŋmɔ,

english_verse: I never forget your kindness, and I am always faithful to you.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ yɛ mihiɛ be fɛɛ be, ni minyiɛɔ yɛ onɔkwale lɛ mli.

english_verse: I don't spend my time with worthless liars
translation_verse: Mikɛ yakayaka gbɔmɛi taraaa shi; ni mikɛ osatofoi hu ebɔɔɔ.

english_verse: I wash my hands, Lord, to show my innocence, and I worship at your altar,
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, mifɔɔ midɛ̃ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ miyeko sɔ̃ ko, ni mibɔleɔ ofɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mijaa bo.

english_verse: while gratefully singing about your wonders.
translation_verse: Milaa shidaa lala waa, ni migbaa onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: I love the temple where you live, and where your glory shines.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, misumɔɔ owe he ni ohiɔ lɛ, kɛ he ni onunyam lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't sweep me away, as you do sinners. Don't punish me with death as you do those people who are brutal
translation_verse: Kaakpãtã mihiɛ oshi eshafeelɔi anɔ, ni kaakpãtã miwala hiɛ ofata láshishwielɔi ahe.

english_verse: or full of meanness or who bribe others.
translation_verse: Kaaŋɔ mi ofata mɛi ni feɔ nifɔɔjianii, ni amɛheɔ nyɔɔŋnii lɛ ahe.

english_verse: I stay true to myself. Be kind and rescue me.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, mibaa mijeŋ jogbaŋŋ yɛ emuuyeli mli; heremɔ mi, ni ona mi mɔbɔ.

english_verse: Now I stand on solid ground! And when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Midamɔ he ni yɔɔ shweshweeshwe. Majie Yehowa yi, yɛ gwabɔɔ kpele lɛ mli.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the light that keeps me safe. I am not afraid of anyone. You protect me, and I have no fears.
translation_verse: Yehowa ji mila kɛ miyiwalaheremɔ, namɔ po gbeyei mashe? Yehowa ji miwala hewalɛ ni wa, namɔ hiɛ po mihe aaakpokpo yɛ?

english_verse: Brutal people may attack and try to kill me, but they will stumble. Fierce enemies may attack, but they will fall.
translation_verse: Kɛji efɔŋfeelɔi ni ji mihaolɔi kɛ mihenyɛlɔi ba amɛbatua mi, ni amɛmiitao mi amɛgbe po, amɛaatɛrɛ, ni amɛaagbeegbee shi.

english_verse: Armies may surround me, but I won't be afraid; war may break out, but I will trust you.
translation_verse: Kɛji asafo ko gba ta ewo mi po, mitsui efaŋ. Kɛji ta te shi wo mi tete lɛ, no mli po lɛ, mana ekãa.

english_verse: I ask only one thing, Lord: Let me live in your house every day of my life to see how wonderful you are and to pray in your temple.
translation_verse: Nɔ koome mibiɔ yɛ Yehowa dɛŋ, ni no sɛɛgbɛ mitiuɔ: akɛ mahi shi yɛ Yehowa we lɛ, miwala gbii abɔ fɛɛ; ni mana Yehowa lɛ, ni makase nii hu yɛ eSɔlemɔ we lɛ.

english_verse: In times of trouble, Lord, you will protect me. You will hide me in your tent and keep me safe on top of a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ fimɔ gbi nɔ lɛ, eeeŋɔ mi ehɔ ebuu lɛ mli; eeeŋɔ mi etee ebuu lɛŋ teemɔhe lɛ, eeewo mi edamɔ tɛsaa nɔ.

english_verse: You will let me defeat all my enemies. Then I will celebrate, as I enter your tent with animal sacrifices and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Ni eeewo minɔ yɛ mihenyɛlɔi ni ebɔle mi lɛ anɔ; ni mikɛ mliflimɔ aaabɔ oshe, ni mashã afɔle yɛ ebuu lɛŋ. Mala, ni matswa saŋku mahã Yehowa.

english_verse: Please listen when I pray! Have pity. Answer my prayer.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, kɛji mibo mitsɛ bo lɛ, bo mi toi. Naa mi mɔbɔ, ni ohere mi nɔ.

english_verse: My heart tells me to pray. I am eager to see your face,
translation_verse: Owiemɔ lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, “Nyɛtaoa mihiɛgbɛ.” “Yehowa, bo ohiɛgbɛ lɛ mitaoɔ nɛɛ.”

english_verse: so don't hide from me. I am your servant, Lord, and you have helped me. Don't turn from me in anger. You alone keep me safe. Don't reject or desert me.
translation_verse: Kaaŋɔ ohiɛ otee mi. Kaashwie otsulɔ yɛ mlifu naa. Bo ji miyelikɛbualɔ. Kaashɛ mi ofɔ̃, ni kaakwa mi hu, miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: Even if my father and mother should desert me, you will take care of me.
translation_verse: Kɛji mitsɛ kɛ minyɛ kwa mi tete lɛ, bo Yehowa ooobaa miyi.

english_verse: Teach me to follow, Lord, and lead me on the right path because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi ogbɛ lɛ, ni okpala mi kɛtsɔ̃ tɛmpɔŋ ni kã shi faŋŋ nɔ; ejaakɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ayi fa.

english_verse: Don't let them do to me what they want. People tell lies about me and make violent threats,
translation_verse: Kaaŋmɛɛ mihe ohã tamɔ bɔ ni mihenyɛlɔi lɛ taoɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ amale odasefoi ete shi ewo mi, ni amɛmiishwe ni amɛwa mi yi.

english_verse: but I know I will live to see how kind you are.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ, miheɔ miyeɔ akɛ mana Yehowa mlihilɛ lɛ yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Trust the Lord! Be brave and strong and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Kwɛmɔ Yehowa gbɛ; wajemɔ ohe, ni ona tsui, ni okwɛ Yehowa gbɛ.

english_verse: Only you, Lord, are a mighty rock! Don't refuse to help me when I pray. If you don't answer me, I will soon be dead.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, bo mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ nɛɛ, bo mitɛsaa, kaatsimɔ otoi. Kɛji ofooo midaaŋ lɛ, matamɔ mɛi ni kpelekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbohiiaje lɛ.

english_verse: Please listen to my prayer and my cry for help, as I lift my hands toward your holy temple.
translation_verse: Kɛji mibo mitsɛ bo koni ohere mi, ni mihole miniji anɔ mitsɔ̃ɔ ohe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, bo mifaikpamɔ gbee lɛ toi.

english_verse: Don't drag me away, Lord, with those cruel people, who speak kind words, while planning trouble.
translation_verse: Kaaloo mi kɛ yiwalɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni feɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ oshwie. Mɛi ni kɛ amɛnanemɛi wieɔ toiŋjɔlɛ wiemɔi shi amɛtsuiiaŋ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ nɔ fɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: They don't pay any attention to your wonderful deeds. Now you will destroy them and leave them in ruin.
translation_verse: Akɛni amɛbuuu Yehowa nitsumɔi lɛ kɛ eninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, eeebutu amɛ, ni amɛteŋ shi dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for answering my prayers.
translation_verse: Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa, ejaakɛ ebo mifaikpamɔ gbee toi.

english_verse: You are my strong shield, and I trust you completely. You have helped me, and I will celebrate and thank you in song.
translation_verse: Yehowa ji mihewalɛ kɛ mitsɛŋ; enɔ mikɛ mitsui fɔ̃ɔ, ni eyeɔ ebuaa mi ni minaa tsuijurɔ. Mikɛ milala aaada lɛ shi.

english_verse: You give strength to your people, Lord, and you save and protect your chosen ones.
translation_verse: Yehowa ji ewebii lɛ ahewalɛ, ni lɛ ji mɔ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ yiwalaheremɔ mɔɔ.

english_verse: Come save us and bless us. Be our shepherd and always carry us in your arms.
translation_verse: Yehowa, heremɔ omaŋbii lɛ ayiwala, ni ojɔɔ owebii ni oŋɔ akɛ onɔ lɛ. Lɛɛ amɛ tamɔ tookwɛlɔ, ni ohiɛ amɛ mli kɛya naanɔ.

english_verse: All you angels in heaven, honor the glory and power of the Lord!
translation_verse: Oo nyɛ ŋwɛibii, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi; nyɛkɛ anunyam kɛ hewalɛ ahãa Yehowa.

english_verse: Honor the wonderful name of the Lord, and worship the Lord most holy and glorious.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ anunyam ni sa Yehowa gbɛi lɛ ahãa lɛ. Nyɛkɛ hewulamɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ajaa Yehowa.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord echoes over the oceans. The glorious Lord God thunders above the roar of the raging sea,
translation_verse: Anuɔ Yehowa gbee yɛ ŋshɔ nɔ. Anunyam Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ miishi; Yehowa yɛ ŋshɔi wuji anɔ tete.

english_verse: and his voice is mighty and marvelous.
translation_verse: Yehowa gbee lɛ yɛ hewalɛ. Yehowa gbee eyi obɔ̃ kɛ agbojee.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord destroys the cedar trees; the Lord shatters cedars on Mount Lebanon.
translation_verse: Yehowa gbee lɛ kumɔɔ tsenedrui lɛ, Yehowa kumɔɔ Lebanon tsenedrui lɛ.

english_verse: God makes Mount Lebanon skip like a calf and Mount Hermon jump like a wild ox.
translation_verse: Ehãa Lebanon gɔji lɛ tumɔɔ tamɔ tsinabii; ni Hermon Gɔŋ lɛ tumɔɔ tamɔ tsina oblanyo.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes lightning flash
translation_verse: Yehowa gbee lɛ hãa srawai gbalaa.

english_verse: and the desert tremble. And because of the Lord, the desert near Kadesh shivers and shakes.
translation_verse: Yehowa gbee hosoɔ shiaŋa lɛ, Yehowa hosoɔ Kadesh ŋa lɛ.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes deer give birth before their time. Forests are stripped of leaves, and the temple is filled with shouts of praise.
translation_verse: Yehowa gbee hãa odum hosoɔ ni ehãa koo mli tsei ayibai kpalaa; ni yɛ eSɔlemɔ we lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ bolɔɔ akɛ, “Anunyam!”

english_verse: The Lord rules on his throne, king of the flood forever.
translation_verse: Yehowa ta nu afua nɔ eeye maŋtsɛ; Yehowa miiye maŋtsɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.

english_verse: Pray that our Lord will make us strong and give us peace.
translation_verse: Yehowa aaahã ewebii lɛ hewalɛ; Yehowa aaajɔɔ emaŋ lɛ kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You saved me from the grave and kept my enemies from celebrating my death.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, makafo O, ejaakɛ ojie mi, ni ohãaa mihenyɛlɔi aye mi yɔɔ.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord God, and you healed me,
translation_verse: Yehowa miNyɔŋmɔ, mibolɔ mitsɛ bo, ni otsa mi.

english_verse: Your faithful people, Lord, will praise you with songs and honor your holy name.
translation_verse: Nyɛlaa nyɛjiea Yehowa yi, nyɛ mɛi ni ji emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni nyɛjiea egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yi.

english_verse: Your anger lasts a little while, but your kindness lasts for a lifetime. At night we may cry, but when morning comes we will celebrate.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ hiŋmɛitswaa kɛkɛ emlifu hiɔ shi; shi emlihilɛ lɛ hiɔ shi ewala be fɛɛ. Yaafo toɔ mɔ gbɛkɛ, shi miishɛɛ baa leebi.

english_verse: I felt secure and thought, “I'll never be shaken!”
translation_verse: Mi lɛ, mikɛɛ yɛ mishweremɔ lɛ mli akɛ, “Mididaŋ gbi ko gbi ko.”

english_verse: You, Lord, were my friend, and you made me strong as a mighty mountain. But when you hid your face, I was crushed.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, omlihilɛ naa lɛ, ohã mima shi shiŋŋ tamɔ gɔŋ. Shi moŋ be ni okɛ ohiɛ tee mi pɛ, ni mitsui fã.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord, and in my prayer I said,
translation_verse: Bo Yehowa mibolɔ mitsɛ, ni bo Yehowa fai mikpa.

english_verse: “What good will it do you if I am in the grave? Once I have turned to dust, how can I praise you or tell how loyal you are?
translation_verse: “Mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ migbele he, kɛji mikpeleke shi kɛbote gbonyobu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli? Ani su aaajie oyi lo? Aloo eeejaje onɔkwale lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ?

english_verse: You have turned my sorrow into joyful dancing. No longer am I sad and wearing sackcloth.
translation_verse: Ohã mikɔmɔyeli lɛ etsɔ̃ miishɛɛ joo ehã mi. Ojie mihe kpekpe lɛ, ni okɛ miishɛɛ ebu mi tamɔ mama.

english_verse: I thank you from my heart, and I will never stop singing your praises, my Lord and my God.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, misusuma aaajie oyi, ni emuaŋ enaa. Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, mada bo shi daa kɛya naanɔ.

english_verse: I come to you, Lord, for protection. Don't let me be ashamed. Do as you have promised and rescue me.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, bo abo mibaa, kaahã mihiɛ miigbo gbi ko gbi ko. Okɛ ojalɛ lɛ ahere mi.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hurry to save me. Be my mighty rock and the fortress where I am safe.
translation_verse: Ba otoi shi ohã mi. Feemɔ oya ni ohere mi. Tsɔ̃ mibobaahe tɛsaa, kɛ mɔɔ ni wa ni okɛhere miyiwala.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my mighty rock and my fortress. Lead me and guide me, so that your name will be honored.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ! Bo ji mitɛsaa kɛ mimɔ̃ɔ. Ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyiɛmɔ mihiɛ, ni otsɔ̃ɔ mi gbɛ.

english_verse: Protect me from hidden traps and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Jiemɔ mi kɛjɛ tsɔne ni amɛtsɔ̃ yɛ teemɔ mli lɛ mli; ejaakɛ bo nɔŋŋ pɛ ji mibobaahe.

english_verse: You are faithful, and I trust you because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Miitu mimumɔ miiwo bo odɛ̃ŋ, ejaakɛ bo okpɔ̃ mi. Oo Yehowa, bo Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwafo.

english_verse: I hate the worshipers of worthless idols, but I trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Minyɛɔ mɛi ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ yaka amãgãi anɔ lɛ, shi mi lɛ, Yehowa nɔ mihiɛ kã.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because you are kind. You saw all my suffering, and you cared for me.
translation_verse: Mimli aaafli mi, ni manya yɛ osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ hewɔ. Ejaakɛ ona minɔnaa lɛ, ni ole mihaomɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You kept me from the hands of my enemies, and you set me free.
translation_verse: Oŋmɛko mihe owoko henyɛlɔ lɛ dɛŋ; shi moŋ, ohã minane ena maahe.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! I am hurting and almost blind. My whole body aches.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, naa mi mɔbɔ, shi efi mi; mihiŋmɛii kɛ mikla kɛ migbɔmɔtso fɛɛ egbɔjɔ kɛ awerɛho sɔŋŋ.

english_verse: I have known only sorrow all my life long, and I suffer year after year. I am weak from sin, and my bones are limp.
translation_verse: Shi miyeɔ ŋkɔmɔ miwalabeiaŋ fɛɛ, ni midɔmɔɔ ŋtsɔi yɛ mifii lɛ amli. Mihe esha hewɔ lɛ, mihewalɛ nɔ egbɔ ni miwui lɛ amli hu egbɔjɔ.

english_verse: My enemies insult me. Neighbors are even worse, and I disgust my friends. People meet me on the street, and they turn and run.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ̃ ahorabɔɔnɔ mihã mihenyɛlɔi. Mitsɔ̃ jatsu kpele mihã mihe gbɔmɛi; mitsɔ̃ gbeyei nɔ yɛ minanemɛi ahiɛ. Mɛi ni naa mi yɛ blohuiaŋ lɛ, joɔ minaa foi.

english_verse: I am completely forgotten like someone dead. I am merely a broken dish.
translation_verse: Hiɛ ekpa minɔ tamɔ gbonyo ni ajie jwɛŋmɔ yɛ enɔ, Mitsɔ̃ tamɔ gbɛ́ ko.

english_verse: I hear the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid!” They are plotting and scheming to murder me.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ! Miinu mɛi pii miiwie ablɛbi. Gbeyei ebɔle mi kɛkpe be ni amɛtee miyi nɔ ajina ni amɛkpãŋɔ miyi nɔ koni amɛkpãtã mihiɛ lɛ.

english_verse: But I trust you, Lord, and I claim you as my God.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, bo Yehowa onɔ mihiɛ kã. Mikɛɔ akɛ, “Bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ!”

english_verse: My life is in your hands. Save me from enemies who hunt me down.
translation_verse: Miwala be lɛ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ; jiemɔ mi kɛje mihenyɛlɔi kɛ mɛi ni waa mi yi lɛ adɛŋ.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant. Have pity and rescue me.
translation_verse: Osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ hewɔ lɛ, heremɔ miyiwala. Kwɛmɔ mi otsulɔ koni ona mi mɔbɔ.

english_verse: I pray only to you. Don't disappoint me. Disappoint my cruel enemies until they lie silent in their graves.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, kaahã ashwie mihiɛ shi, ejaakɛ bo miboɔ mitsɛɔ. Hã miyiwalɔi lɛ moŋ ahiɛ ashwie shi. Hã amɛtɔ mu kɛya gbohiiaje.

english_verse: Silence those proud liars! Make them stop bragging and insulting your people.
translation_verse: Hã amalelɔi lɛ amua amɛnaa, mɛi ni kɛ hewoo kɛ heguɔgbee wieɔ wiemɔi ni esaaa shiɔ jalɔi lɛ.

english_verse: You are wonderful, and while everyone watches, you store up blessings for all who honor and trust you.
translation_verse: Oo, kwɛ bɔ ni omlihilɛ ni oyɔɔ kɛhã mɛi ni sheɔ bo gbeyei lɛ fa babaoo hã. Ojieɔ otsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni baa bo abo lɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ.

english_verse: You are their shelter from harmful plots, and you are their protection from vicious gossip.
translation_verse: Oŋɔɔ amɛ oteɔ yɛ ohiɛ teemɔhe lɛ mli. Kɛjeɔ mɛi ayinɔ kpãŋmɔi amli, ni okɛ amɛ toɔ shweshweeshwe yɛ obuu lɛ mli.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for showing great kindness when I was like a city under attack.
translation_verse: Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa ejaakɛ ejie enaakpɛɛ suɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi, be ni atua mi tamɔ maŋ ko ni asa eyi lɛ.

english_verse: I was terrified and thought, “They've chased me far away from you!” But you answered my prayer when I shouted for help.
translation_verse: Yɛ mitsuifãa mli lɛ, mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ashwie mi kɛje ohiɛ kɛtee sɛɛ shɔŋŋ.” Kɛ̃lɛ, be ni mibo mitsɛ bo lɛ, obo mifaikpamɔ toi.

english_verse: All who belong to the Lord, show how you love him. The Lord protects the faithful, but he severely punishes everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Nyɛsumɔa Yehowa, nyɛ hetselɔi fɛɛ. Yehowa baa anɔkwafoi ayi, shi henɔwolɔi lɛ, ewoɔ amɛ nyɔmɔ babaoo.

english_verse: All who trust the Lord, be cheerful and strong.
translation_verse: Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛhiɛ kã Yehowa nɔ lɛ, nyɛwajea nyɛhe, ni nyɛfea ekãa.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone whose sins you forgive and wipe away.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ mɔ ni akɛ etɔmɔ efa lɛ, ni atsumɔ ehe eshai lɛ.

english_verse: You bless them by saying, “You told me your sins, without trying to hide them, and now I forgive you.”
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ mɔ ni Yehowa enaaa nɔ sha ko yɛ ehe; ni ebɛ mɔlakamɔ mumɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Before I confessed my sins, my bones felt limp, and I groaned all day long.
translation_verse: Be ni mitsimɔ mihe esha nɔ lɛ, mitã loo yɛ huumɔ ni mihuuɔ daa jenamɔ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Night and day your hand weighed heavily on me, and my strength was gone as in the summer heat.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ fɛɛ lɛ, onine tsii yɛ minɔ. Mimli hewalɛ fɛɛ tã tamɔ bɔ ni latsaa be mli jeŋ dɔlɛ hãa nii amli nu ŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: So I confessed my sins and told them all to you. I said, “I'll tell the Lord each one of my sins.” Then you forgave me and took away my guilt.
translation_verse: Mijaje mihe esha lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ bo, ni minifɔɔjianii lɛ mitsimɔ̃ɔɔ nɔ. Mikɛɛ akɛ, “Majaje mitɔmɔi lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa.” Kɛkɛ ni okɛ mihe esha kɛ tɔ̃mɔ lɛ fa mi.

english_verse: We worship you, Lord, and we should always pray whenever we find out that we have sinned. Then we won't be swept away by a raging flood.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, hã anɔkwafoi fɛɛ asɔle atsɛ bo; ni kɛji haomɔ babaoo ba tamɔ faa ni etue lɛ, eninaŋ amɛ.

english_verse: You are my hiding place! You protect me from trouble, and you put songs in my heart because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Bo ji mibobaahe. Amanehulu mli lɛ, bo obaa miyi. Okɛ miishɛɛ oshebɔɔ ebɔle mihe kɛkpe.

english_verse: You said to me, “I will point out the road that you should follow. I will be your teacher and watch over you.
translation_verse: Mi, Yehowa, mawo bo ŋaa, ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo gbɛ ni onyiɛ nɔ; mihiŋmɛi aaakã ohe.

english_verse: Don't be stupid like horses and mules that must be led with ropes to make them obey.”
translation_verse: Nyɛkatamɔa okpɔŋɔ loo tejiokpɔŋɔ ni leee nii ni akɛ manyoflɛ kɛ esɛɛ kpãa woɔ amɛ dani amɛhiɔ kudɔmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: All kinds of troubles will strike the wicked, but your kindness shields those who trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Piŋmɔi babaoo yɛ hã mɔ fɔŋ lɛ; shi mɔ ni hiɛ kã Yehowa nɔ lɛ, suɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo ebɔle ehe kɛkpe.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people. Obey him and celebrate! He deserves your praise.
translation_verse: Nyɛ jalɔi, nyɛnyaa Yehowa he! Jalɔi anɔ ji akɛ amɛ jie Yehowa yi.

english_verse: Praise the Lord with harps! Use harps with ten strings to make music for him.
translation_verse: Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi kɛ saŋku; nyɛlaa nyɛjiea eyi kɛ kpãanyɔŋma saŋku.

english_verse: Sing a new song. Shout! Play beautiful music.
translation_verse: Nyɛlaa lala hee nyɛhãa lɛ, nyɛtswaa kpãa saŋku jogbaŋŋ ni nyɛbɔa oshe waa.

english_verse: The Lord is truthful; he can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ anɔkwale ni, ni etsuɔ enitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli.

english_verse: He loves justice and fairness, and he is kind to everyone everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Esumɔɔ jalɛ kɛ jalɛ saneyeli; Yehowa mlihilɛ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ, eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ̃ tɔ.

english_verse: The Lord made the heavens and everything in them by his word.
translation_verse: Yehowa wiemɔ naa abɔ ŋwɛi yɛ, ni ekɛɛmɔ naa abɔ hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii fɛɛ yɛ.

english_verse: Everyone in this world should worship and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Hã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ ashe Yehowa gbeyei. Hã je lɛŋ bii fɛɛ he akpokpo yɛ ehiɛ.

english_verse: As soon as he spoke the world was created; at his command, the earth was formed.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ lɛ ewie ni eba mli; lɛ efã ni je lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the plans and spoils the schemes of the nations.
translation_verse: Yehowa hãa majimaji lɛ ayiŋtoi lɛ feɔ yaka; ni etswaa ayiŋtoi lɛ efɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: But what the Lord has planned will stand forever. His thoughts never change.
translation_verse: Yehowa yiŋtoi lɛ, hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ; ni etsuiŋ susumɔi lɛ yɛ hã yinɔbii fɛɛ.

english_verse: The Lord blesses each nation that worships only him. He blesses his chosen ones.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ maŋ ni eNyɔŋmɔ ji Yehowa kɛ maŋ ni ehala akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord looks at the world
translation_verse: Yehowa jɛɔ ŋwɛi ekwɛɔ, ni enaa gbɔmɛi abii fɛɛ.

english_verse: from his throne in heaven, and he watches us all.
translation_verse: Ejɛɔ he ni eta yɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ enaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ.

english_verse: The Lord gave us each a mind, and nothing we do can be hidden from him.
translation_verse: Lɛ eshɔ̃ mɛi fɛɛ atsuii, ni enaa amɛnifeemɔi fɛɛ.

english_verse: Mighty armies alone cannot win wars for a king; great strength by itself cannot keep a soldier safe.
translation_verse: Jeee tabilɔi babaoo hãa maŋtsɛ yeɔ kunim; jeee tawulɔ ekãalɔ hewalɛ kpele lɛ hereɔ eyiwala.

english_verse: In war the strength of a horse cannot be trusted to take you to safety.
translation_verse: Yakatswaa ni akɛ hiɛ fɔ̃ɔ tayaa okpɔŋɔ nɔ kɛhã kunimyeli; ehewalɛ kpele lɛ nyɛŋ mɔ yiwala ahere

english_verse: But the Lord watches over all who honor him and trust his kindness.
translation_verse: Yehowa hiŋmɛii yɛ mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei ni amɛhiɛ kã esuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ nɔ lɛ ahe.

english_verse: We depend on you, Lord, to help and protect us.
translation_verse: Wɔmiikwɛ Yehowa gbɛ; lɛ ji wɔbualɔ kɛ wɔtsɛŋ.

english_verse: You make our hearts glad because we trust you, the only God.
translation_verse: Emli wɔnaa miishɛɛ yɛ, ejaakɛ egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ wɔhiɛ kã.

english_verse: I will always praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Majie Yehowa yi be fɛɛ be; eyijiemɔ aaakã midaaŋ daa nɛɛ.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will praise the Lord. Let all who are helpless, listen and be glad.
translation_verse: Mishwãa mifɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ. Mɛi ni ayeɔ amɛ amim anu he, koni amɛmii ashɛ amɛhe.

english_verse: Honor the Lord with me! Celebrate his great name.
translation_verse: Oo, nyɛ kɛ mi akafoa Yehowa agbojee, ni nyɛhãa wɔfea ekome kɛjiea egbɛi lɛ yi!

english_verse: I asked the Lord for help, and he saved me from all my fears.
translation_verse: Mitao Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ, ni ehere mi nɔ; ni ejie mi kɛje migbeyeishemɔ fɛɛ mli.

english_verse: Keep your eyes on the Lord! You will shine like the sun and never blush with shame.
translation_verse: Ŋɔɔ ohiɛ ofɔ̃ enɔ, ni ohiɛ eshwieŋ shi gbi ko gbi ko, shi moŋ ohiɛ aaaba nyam.

english_verse: I was a nobody, but I prayed, and the Lord saved me from all my troubles.
translation_verse: Ohiafo bolɔ etsɛ Yehowa, ebo lɛ toi, ni ehere lɛ kɛjɛ ehaomɔi fɛɛ amli.

english_verse: If you honor the Lord, his angel will protect you.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ bɔleɔ amɛhe kɛkpeɔ, ni ejieɔ amɛ.

english_verse: Discover for yourself that the Lord is kind. Come to him for protection, and you will be glad.
translation_verse: Nyɛsaa nyɛnaa nyɛkwɛa, ni nyɛaana akɛ Yehowa ŋɔɔ. Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni baa lɛ abo lɛ.

english_verse: Honor the Lord! You are his special people. No one who honors the Lord will ever be in need.
translation_verse: Nyɛshea Yehowa gbeyei, nyɛ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko fiŋ amɛ.

english_verse: Young lions may go hungry or even starve, but if you trust the Lord, you will never miss out on anything good.
translation_verse: Efĩɔ jatabii ni hɔmɔ yeɔ amɛ; shi mɛi ni taoɔ Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ lɛ, nɔ kpakpa ko ehiaŋ amɛ.

english_verse: Come, my children, listen as I teach you to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Oo mibii, nyɛbaa, nyɛboa mi toi; mibatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ bɔ ni asheɔ Yehowa gbeyei ahãa.

english_verse: Do you want to live and enjoy a long life?
translation_verse: Namɔ taoɔ akɛ eyi ana wala? Namɔ sumɔɔ akɛ etsɛ yɛ jeŋ ni ena nɔ kpakpa?

english_verse: Then don't say cruel things and don't tell lies.
translation_verse: Mɔ olilɛi mli ni ekafee efɔŋ; mɔ onaabu hu mli ni ekamale.

english_verse: Do good instead of evil and try to live at peace.
translation_verse: Wii ohe kɛje efɔŋ he, ni ofee ekpakpa. Taomɔ toiŋjɔlɛ ni onyiɛ no sɛɛ.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, he will watch over you and answer your prayers.
translation_verse: Yehowa hiŋmɛi kã jalɔi ahe, ni efeɔ toi ehãa amɛblɔmɔi.

english_verse: But God despises evil people, and he will wipe them all from the earth, till they are forgotten.
translation_verse: Yehowa jieɔ ehiɛ ekaa efɔŋfeelɔi, koni akakai amɛ kwraa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: When his people pray for help, he listens and rescues them from their troubles.
translation_verse: Kɛ jalɔi fo tsɛ Yehowa lɛ, eboɔ amɛ toi; ni ehereɔ amɛ kɛjɛɔ amɛfimɔi fɛɛ amli.

english_verse: The Lord is there to rescue all who are discouraged and have given up hope.
translation_verse: Yehowa bɛŋkɛɔ mɛi ni hiɛnɔkãmɔ etã, ni ehereɔ mɛi ni werɛ eho amɛhe lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord's people may suffer a lot, but he will always bring them safely through.
translation_verse: Jalɔ naa amanehulu babaoo, shi Yehowa jieɔ lɛ kɛjɛɔ fɛɛ mli.

english_verse: Not one of their bones will ever be broken.
translation_verse: Ebaa ewui ayi shweshweeshwe; ewu kome folo nɛkɛ ekuŋ.

english_verse: Wicked people are killed by their own evil deeds, and if you hate God's people you will be punished.
translation_verse: Efɔŋ nɔŋŋ aaagbe efɔŋfeelɔ, ni mɔ ni nyɛɔ jalɔ lɛ aaabu lɛ fɔ.

english_verse: The Lord saves the lives of his servants. Run to him for protection, and you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Yehowa hereɔ etsuji ayiwala; ni mɛi ni baa lɛ abo lɛ, ebuŋ amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko fɔ.

english_verse: Aim your spear at everyone who hunts me down, but promise to save me.
translation_verse: Gbalamɔ akplɔ kɛ lema owo mɛi ni nyiɛ misɛɛ lɛ. Kɛɛmɔ misusuma akɛ, “Mi ji oyiwalaheremɔ.”

english_verse: Let all who want to kill me be disgraced and put to shame. Chase away and confuse all who plan to harm me.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni nyiɛ misɛɛ ni taoɔ mi agbe lɛ, hã amɛhiɛ ashwie shi, ni amɛhe guɔ agbo. Mɛi ni jwɛŋɔ mihe efɔŋ lɛ, hã ashwie amɛ kɛku sɛɛ kɛ hiɛgbele.

english_verse: Send your angel after them and let them be like straw in the wind.
translation_verse: Be ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ shwieɔ amɛ kɛyaa lɛ hã amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ tutuu yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ naa.

english_verse: Make them run in the dark on a slippery road, as your angel chases them.
translation_verse: Be ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ, hã amɛgbɛ nɔ awo duŋ ni enɔ ashãmɔ.

english_verse: I did them no harm, but they hid a net to trap me, and they dug a deep pit to catch and kill me.
translation_verse: Mifeko amɛ efɔŋ ko kwraa shi amɛtsɔ mi tsɔne amɛtee; koni edu mi, ni amɛtsa bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ koni magbee mli ni magbo.

english_verse: Surprise them with disaster! Trap them in their own nets and let them fall and rot in the pits they have dug.
translation_verse: Hã amɛhiɛ akpãtã trukaa. Hã tsɔne ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛtsɔ̃ lɛ nɔŋŋ adu amɛ. Hã amɛgbee bu ni amɛtsa lɛ mli ni amɛhiɛ akpãtã.

english_verse: I will celebrate and be joyful because you, Lord, have saved me.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ, misusuma mli aaafli lɛ yɛ Yehowa hewɔ, mimii aaashɛ mihe, ejaakɛ ehere mi.

english_verse: Every bone in my body will shout: “No one is like the Lord!” You protect the helpless from those in power; you save the poor and needy from those who hurt them.
translation_verse: Migbɔmɔtso muu lɛ fɛɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, “Oo Yehowa, namɔ tamɔ bo, bo mɔ ni ohereɔ gbɔjɔlɔi kɛjɛɔ mɛi ni he wawaa fe amɛ lɛ adɛŋ; ni ohereɔ gbedelɔi kɛ ohiafoi kɛjeɔ mɛi ni yeɔ amɛ amim lɛ adɛŋ.”

english_verse: Liars accuse me of crimes I know nothing about.
translation_verse: Odasefoi yiwalɔi teɔ shi woɔ mi. Amɛbiɔ mi nibii ni mileee he nɔ ko.

english_verse: They repay evil for good, and I feel all alone.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛ efɔŋ toɔ mi ekpakpa najiaŋ; mikla tete etɔ biti.

english_verse: When they were sick, I wore sackcloth and went without food. I truly prayed for them,
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, be ni amɛhe yeɔ lɛ, mibu kpekpe; mikɛ ŋmaahilɛ wa mihe yi, ni mima miyi shi misɔle,

english_verse: as I would for a friend or a relative. I was in sorrow and mourned, as I would for my mother.
translation_verse: tamɔ nɔ ni minaanyo loo minyɛminuu he ŋkɔmɔ miyeɔ lɛ. Minyiɛ mɔbɔmɔbɔ ni mima miyi shi, tamɔ mɔ ko ni enyɛ egbo ni eeye enyɛ he ŋkɔmɔ.

english_verse: I have stumbled, and worthless liars I don't even know surround me and sneer.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, kɛ mitɛ lɛ, amɛbuaa amɛhe naa kɛ miishɛɛ; amɛbuaa amɛhe naa amɛwoɔ mi; niiahetswialɔi ni mileee amɛ lɛ, kpaaa miheguɔ gbee.

english_verse: Worthless people make fun and never stop laughing.
translation_verse: Amɛyeɔ mihe fɛo ni amɛfɔ̃ɔɔ; amɛkpeɔ amɛnyanyɔji ashishi amɛwoɔ mi.

english_verse: But all you do is watch! When will you do something? Save me from the attack of those vicious lions.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, mɛɛbe oookwɛ enɛ kɛyashi? Jiemɔ mi kɛje amɛdɛŋ hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli, heremɔ miyiwala kɛjɛ jatai nɛɛ adɛŋ.

english_verse: And when your people meet, I will praise you and thank you, Lord, in front of them all.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ mada bo shi yɛ asafo kpele lɛ mli; majie oyi yɛ mɛi pii ahiɛ.

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies be glad because of me. They hate me for no reason. Don't let them wink behind my back.
translation_verse: Kaahã mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi yakatswaa lɛ miiye mi yɔɔ; ni kaahã mɛi ni he tsɛ̃ɔ mi yakatswaa lɛ mikpɛkpɛɛ mi.

english_verse: They say hurtful things, and they lie to people who want to live in peace.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ amɛwieee hejɔlɛ wiemɔ; shi moŋ amɛfoɔ saji amɛshwieɔ mɛi ni he jɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: They are quick to accuse me. They say, “You did it! We saw you ourselves.”
translation_verse: Amɛgbɛɔ amɛdaaŋ hatoo amɛwoɔ mi; amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Yiɛ, yiɛ, wɔna kɛ wɔhiŋmɛi.”

english_verse: You see everything, Lord! Please don't keep silent or stay so far away.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, bo diɛŋtsɛ ona, kaafee diŋŋ! Oo Yehowa, okɛ mi teŋ akajekɛ kwraa.

english_verse: and prove that I am right by your standards. Don't let them laugh at me
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, buu mi bem yɛ ojalɛ lɛ naa, ni kaahã mihenyɛlɔi lɛ miiye mi yɔɔ.

english_verse: or say to each other, “Now we've got what we want! We'll gobble him up!”
translation_verse: Kaahã amɛmiikɛɛ yɛ amɛyiŋ akɛ, “Gbeebi akle, nɔ ni wɔtaoɔ nɛ.” Kaahã amɛmiikɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔnine egbe lɛ.”

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who are glad to see me in trouble; disgrace and embarrass my proud enemies who say to me, “You are nothing!”
translation_verse: Mɛi ni nyaa yɛ mimanehulu hewɔ lɛ hã ashwie amɛhiɛ shi ni amɛhiɛ agboi. Mɛi ni woɔ amɛhe nɔ, ni amɛtsɛɔ amɛhe yɛ minɔ lɛ, hã amɛhiɛgbele kɛ heguɔgbee lɛ atsɔ̃ amɛhe bo.

english_verse: Let all who want me to win be happy and joyful. From now on let them say, “The Lord is wonderful! God is glad when all goes well for his servant.”
translation_verse: Mɛi ni taoɔ mi ejurɔ lɛ, hã amɛbɔ oshe kɛ nyamɔ ni amɛkɛɛ daa akɛ, “Naa Nyɔŋmɔ je agbo; lɛ enyaa etsulɔ ejurɔyeli he kɛ miishɛɛ.”

english_verse: Then I will shout all day, “Praise the Lord God! He did what was right.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ, majaje ojalɛ lɛ, ni majie oyi daa nɛɛ.

english_verse: Sinners don't respect God; sin is all they think about.
translation_verse: Efɔŋ kɛ mɔ fɔŋ wieɔ yɛ etsuiŋ tɔ̃ɔ; Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ kome folo nɛkɛ bɛ yiwalɔ mli.

english_verse: They like themselves too much to hate their own sins or even to see them.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɔ fɔŋ lakaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe akɛ anaŋ enifɔɔji anii lɛ ni anyaŋe.

english_verse: They tell deceitful lies, and they don't have the sense to live right.
translation_verse: Edaaŋ wiemɔi fɛɛ lɛ, efɔŋ kɛ shishiumɔ sɔŋŋ ni; eshi nilee kɛ ekpakpafeemɔ sɛɛ.

english_verse: Those people stay awake, thinking up mischief, and they follow the wrong road, refusing to turn from sin.
translation_verse: Etoɔ efɔŋfeemɔ he ŋaa be ni ekã esaa nɔ; ni eyiɔ gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ; nɔ fɔŋ ko kwraa bɛ ni enyaŋeɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ Mlihilɛ

english_verse: Your love is faithful, Lord, and even the clouds in the sky can depend on you.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ, kwɔ kɛshɛɔ ŋwɛi tɔ̃ɔ. Onɔkwayeli lɛ shɛɔ atatuiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: Your decisions are always fair. They are firm like mountains, deep like the sea, and all people and animals are under your care.
translation_verse: Ojalɛ nɔkwɔlɛ tamɔ gɔŋ, ni okojomɔ mlikwɔlɛ tamɔ ŋshɔ mli kwɔlɛ. Oo Yehowa, bo ohereɔ gbɔmɔ kɛ kooloo fɛɛ yiwala.

english_verse: Your love is a treasure, and everyone finds shelter in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ jara wa naakpa, ni gbɔmɛi abii baa abo yɛ ofiji ashishi hɔ̃ɔŋ lɛŋ.

english_verse: You give your guests a feast in your house, and you serve a tasty drink that flows like a river.
translation_verse: Amɛyeɔ owe lɛŋ nii babaoo amɛtɔrɔɔ naakpa; ni amɛnuɔ omlihilɛ lɛ tamɔ faa ni hoɔ.

english_verse: The life-giving fountain belongs to you, and your light gives light to each of us.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bo ji wala fɛɛ nubu; ni ola lɛ hãa wɔnaa nii faŋŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord, keep showing love to everyone who knows you, and use your power to save all whose thoughts please you.
translation_verse: Oo, hã osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ ahi shi daa ahã mɛi ni le bo, ni oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ hu ahi shi daa ahã mɛi ni ja kɛmɔ shi lɛ.

english_verse: Don't let those proud and merciless people kick me around or chase me away.
translation_verse: Kaahã hewolɔ lɛ naanaa minɔ, ni kaahã yiwalɔ hu miiwo mi foi.

english_verse: Look at those wicked people! They are knocked down, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Efɔŋfeelɔi lɛ jwere shi butuu nɛɛ; atsirɛ amɛ atswia shi, ni amɛnyɛɛɛ shi amɛte dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Don't be annoyed by anyone who does wrong, and don't envy them.
translation_verse: Kaawo otsui he la yɛ efɔŋfeelɔi ahewɔ; asaŋ ohiɛ akakɔ̃ mɛi ni feɔ nii ni ejaaa gbɛ lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: They will soon disappear like grass without rain.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ eyeŋ be ko ni aaafolɔ amɛ ashwie tamɔ jwɛi; ni amɛaaŋala tamɔ baa fɔ.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and live right! The land will be yours, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Ŋɔɔ ohiɛ ofɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ ni ofee nɔ kpakpa, bɔ ni afee ni ohi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shweshweeshwe.

english_verse: Do what the Lord wants, and he will give you your heart's desire.
translation_verse: Hã omii ashɛ ohe yɛ Yehowa hewɔ, ni eeehã bo nii ni otsui shweɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Let the Lord lead you and trust him to help.
translation_verse: Tuu ohe owo Yehowa dɛŋ. Hemɔ lɛ oye, ni eeeye ebua bo.

english_verse: Then it will be as clear as the noonday sun that you were right.
translation_verse: Eeehã ojalɛ akpɛ hɛŋŋ tamɔ hulu la; ni obemyeli hu aaaje kpo faŋŋ tamɔ shwane.

english_verse: Be patient and trust the Lord. Don't let it bother you when all goes well for those who do sinful things.
translation_verse: Feemɔ dioo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni oto otsui shi omɛ lɛ. Kaawo otsui he la yɛ mɔ ni egbɛ eja ehã lɛ lɛ hewɔ. Kaawo otsui he la yɛ mɔ ni toɔ ŋaai fɔ̃ji ni etsuɔ amɛhenii hu lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Don't be angry or furious. Anger can lead to sin.
translation_verse: Kaahã omli miifu, ni omli akawo la kwraa. Kaawo otsui he la, efɔŋfeemɔ mli pɛ ekɛ mɔ yaa.

english_verse: All sinners will disappear, but if you trust the Lord, the land will be yours.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ efɔŋfeelɔi lɛ, aaafolɔ amɛ ashwie; shi mɛi ni mɛɔ Yehowa lɛ, amɛaahi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: but the poor will take the land and enjoy a big harvest.
translation_verse: Shi mɛi ni he jɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ; ni amɛmii aaashɛ amɛhe yɛ amɛshweremɔ babaoo hewɔ.

english_verse: Merciless people make plots against good people and snarl like animals,
translation_verse: Mɛi fɔ̃ji kpãŋɔ jalɔi ayinɔ, ni amɛkpeɔ amɛnyanyɔjiashi amɛwoɔ amɛ;

english_verse: but the Lord laughs and knows their time is coming soon.
translation_verse: shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋmɔɔ yiwalɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ enaa akɛ enaagbee miiba.

english_verse: The wicked kill with swords and shoot arrows to murder the poor and the needy and all who do right.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɔ̃ji egbala klante ni amɛdɔrɔ amɛgãi lɛ, ni amɛtsɛ̃rɛ̃ nɔnalɔi kɛ ohiafoi ni amɛgbe mɛi ni feɔ nɔ ni ja.

english_verse: But they will be killed by their own swords, and their arrows will be broken.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛ amɛklante lɛ aaagbegbee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe, ni aaakumɔ amɛgãii lɛ amli dukuduku.

english_verse: It is better to live right and be poor than to be sinful and rich.
translation_verse: Nii fioo ni jalɔ yɔɔ lɛ hi fe mɛi fɔ̃ji babaoo anii.

english_verse: The wicked will lose all of their power, but the Lord gives strength to everyone who is good.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji ahewalɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baakpãtã hiɛ, shi jalɔi lɛ Yehowa hiɛɔ amɛmli shweshweeshwe.

english_verse: Those who obey the Lord are daily in his care, and what he has given them will be theirs forever.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni shwamɔ bɛ amɛhe lɛ, Yehowa le amɛwalabe, ni amɛshwiei aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ.

english_verse: They won't be in trouble when times are bad, and they will have plenty when food is scarce.
translation_verse: Fimɔ bei amli lɛ, amɛhiɛ gboŋ, ni hɔmɔ bei amli hu lɛ, amɛaatɔrɔ.

english_verse: Wicked people are enemies of the Lord and will vanish like smoke from a field on fire.
translation_verse: Shi mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ, amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã! Yehowa henyɛlɔi lɛ amɛnunyam tamɔ jwɛiaŋ fɔfɔi, amɛaatã tamɔ lasu.

english_verse: An evil person borrows and never pays back; a good person is generous and never stops giving.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ fɔŋ faa shika yɛ mɔ dɛŋ, ni ewooo; shi jalɔ dɛŋ kpɔɔ, ni ehãa mɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Everyone the Lord blesses will receive the land; everyone the Lord curses will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni Yehowa ejɔɔ amɛ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ; shi mɛi ni alomɔ amɛ lɛ, aaaplenee amɛ.

english_verse: If you do what the Lord wants, he will make certain each step you take is sure.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ nanefaamɔi fɛɛ lɛ Yehowa dɛŋ eyɔɔ, ni mɔ ni Yehowa miishɛɔ ehe lɛ, ehãa enane mɔɔ shi.

english_verse: The Lord will hold your hand, and if you stumble, you still won't fall.
translation_verse: Kɛ nakai gbɔmɔ gbee shi lɛ, ekãŋ jɛi, ejaakɛ Yehowa hiɛ enine mli.

english_verse: As long as I can remember, good people have never been left helpless, and their children have never gone begging for food.
translation_verse: Sa lɛ, gbekɛ ji mi, ni agbɛnɛ mitsɔ̃ nuumo; shi minako jalɔ ko ni akwa lɛ, ni eshwiei miisisɛ̃ aboloo pɛŋ.

english_verse: They gladly give and lend, and their children turn out good.
translation_verse: Ehãa mɔ nɔ daa nɛɛ, ni efaa mɔ nɔ, ni eshwiei tsɔ̃ɔ jɔɔmɔ.

english_verse: If you stop sinning and start doing right, you will keep living and be secure forever.
translation_verse: Wii ohe kɛje efɔŋ he, ni ofee ekpakpa; ni ooohi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛaatee naanɔ.

english_verse: The Lord loves justice, and he won't ever desert his faithful people. He always protects them, but destroys the children of the wicked.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa sumɔɔ jalɛ saneyeli; ekwaŋ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ. Abaabaa jalɔi ayi kɛya naanɔ, shi mɛi fɔ̃ji ashwiei lɛ, aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: God's people will own the land and live here forever.
translation_verse: Jalɔi lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ, ni amɛaahi nɔ kɛya naanɔ.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come when good people speak for justice.
translation_verse: Jalɔ naabu wieɔ nilee wiemɔ, ni elilɛi wieɔ nɔ ni ja.

english_verse: They remember God's teachings, and they never take a wrong step.
translation_verse: Etoɔ eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla lɛ yɛ etsui mli, ni eshiii sɛɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: The wicked try to trap and kill good people,
translation_verse: Efɔŋfeelɔ gbɔbiɔ jalɔ, ni etaoɔ lɛ egbe;

english_verse: but the Lord is on their side, and he will defend them when they are on trial.
translation_verse: shi Yehowa eŋmɛŋ jalɔ lɛ he ewoŋ ehenyɛlɔ lɛ dɛŋ; ni abuŋ jalɔ lɛ fɔ hu yɛ kojomɔ mli.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and follow him. He will give you the land, and you will see the wicked destroyed.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ Yehowa ni onyiɛ egbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni eeewo onɔ koni shikpɔŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ onɔ; ni ooona mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ ahiɛkpãtãmɔ.

english_verse: I have seen brutal people abuse others and grow strong like trees in rich soil.
translation_verse: Mina mɔ fɔŋ yiwalɔ ko ni eewa yi ni eewo ehe nɔ tamɔ Lebanon tsenedrutso.

english_verse: Suddenly they disappeared! I looked, but they were gone and no longer there.
translation_verse: Fee sɛɛ lɛ mitsɔ̃ jɛi ekoŋŋ kɛho, ni naa, ebɛ jɛi; mitao lɛ moŋ shi anaaa lɛ.

english_verse: Think of the bright future waiting for all the families of honest, innocent, and peace-loving people.
translation_verse: Kadimɔ mɔ ni hi kɛwula shi; ni okwɛ mɔ ni ja; toiŋjɔlɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ eshwiei shwereɔ babaoo.

english_verse: But not a trace will be left of the wicked or their families.
translation_verse: Shi efɔŋfeelɔi lɛ aaakpãtã amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ, ni efɔŋfeelɔi ashwiei lɛ hu aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: The Lord protects his people, and they can come to him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Yehowa hereɔ jalɔi ayiwala. Lɛ ji amɛbobaahe yɛ haomɔ be mli.

english_verse: The Lord helps his people and saves them from the wicked because they run to him.
translation_verse: Yehowa yeɔ buaa amɛ, ni ehereɔ amɛyiwala. Ekpɔ̃ɔ amɛ kɛjɛɔ yiwalɔi adɛŋ, ni ehereɔ amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛbaa lɛ abo.

english_verse: When you are angry, Lord, please don't punish me or even correct me.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, kaakã mi yɛ omlifu naa, ni kaagbala mitoi yɛ omlila naa,

english_verse: You shot me with your arrows, and you struck me with your hand.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ ogãimlibii lɛ etsulɔ mimli, ni onine etsii yɛ minɔ.

english_verse: My body hurts all over because of your anger. Even my bones are in pain, and my sins
translation_verse: Omlifu hewɔ lɛ, mihewojiaŋ ejɔɔɔ mi; mihe eshai ewo mi hela.

english_verse: are so heavy that I am crushed.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ minishaianii lɛ esu mi, etamɔ jatsu ni tsii yɛ minɔ.

english_verse: Because of my foolishness, I am covered with sores that stink and spread.
translation_verse: Mikwashiafeemɔ hewɔ lɛ, mifaji lɛ ekpɔtɔ, amɛmiije fu.

english_verse: My body is twisted and bent, and I groan all day long.
translation_verse: Midɔ kɔmɔɔ ni mikumɔ, jenamɔ muu fɛɛ lɛ minyiɛ mɔbɔmɔbɔ.

english_verse: Fever has my back in flames, and I hurt everywhere.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mihɛ mli miishã mi, ni mibɛ gbɔmɔtsoŋ hewalɛ.

english_verse: I am worn out and weak, moaning and in distress.
translation_verse: Migbɔjɔ, ni mikumɔ kwraa; mitsui miiwa mihe, no hewɔ ni mikɛ̃mɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, know every one of my deepest desires, and my noisy groans are no secret to you.
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ, ole mishwee nii fɛɛ; mihuumɔ lɛ, akɛ teko bo.

english_verse: My heart is beating fast. I feel weak all over, and my eyes are red.
translation_verse: Mitsui tswaa kplakpla; mihewalɛ miitã; ni mihiŋmɛii amli la egbo.

english_verse: Because of my sickness, no friends or neighbors will come near me.
translation_verse: Minanemɛi kɛ misuɔlɔi tsiɔ amɛhe kɛjeɔ mihe yɛ mihe faji lɛ ahewɔ; ni miwekumɛi hu damɔɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ.

english_verse: All who want me dead set traps to catch me, and those who want to harm and destroy me plan and plot all day.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni taoɔ mihiɛ akpãtã lɛ, etsɔ̃ amɛtsɔnei lɛ. Mɛi ni taoɔ mi awui aye lɛ amɛkɛ amɛlilɛi fiteɔ mi, ni amɛkpãŋɔ miyinɔ be fɛɛ be.

english_verse: I am not able to hear or speak a word;
translation_verse: Mitamɔ toimulɔ, minuuu nii; ni mitamɔ mumui, minyɛɛɛ mawie.

english_verse: I am completely deaf and can't make a sound.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ! Mitamɔ mɔ ko ni nuuu nii, mɔ ni nyɛɛɛ sane po naa ejie.

english_verse: I trust you, Lord God, and you will do something.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ, bo Yehowa, onɔ mihiɛ kã. Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, bo obaahã mi hetoo.

english_verse: I said, “Don't let them laugh or brag when I slip and fall.”
translation_verse: Shi mifaikpamɔ ji akɛ, kɛ mishane migbee shi lɛ, kaahã mihenyɛlɔi, mɛi ni woɔ amɛhe nɔ yɛ minɔ lɛ, miiye mi yɔɔ.

english_verse: I am about to collapse from constant pain.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, miihe magbee shi, ni mikãhe miipiŋ lolo.

english_verse: I told you my sins, and I am sorry for them.
translation_verse: Miijaje mitɔ̃mɔ lɛ; mihe esha lɛ miidɔ mi naakpa.

english_verse: and they repay evil for good because I try to do right.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni ŋɔɔ efɔŋ toɔ ekpakpa ni mifeɔ najiaŋ lɛ, ete shi ewo mi; ejaakɛ mi lɛ, mifeɔ ekpakpa.

english_verse: You are the Lord God! Stay nearby and don't desert me.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, kaakwa mi; Oo miNyɔŋmɔ, okɛ mi teŋ akajekɛ.

english_verse: You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Oo Nuŋtsɔ, miyiwalaherelɔ, ofainɛ, ba mramra ni obaye obua mi.

english_verse: I told myself, “I'll be careful not to sin by what I say, and I'll muzzle my mouth when evil people are near.”
translation_verse: Mikɛɛ akɛ, “Male mihenɔkwɛmɔ koni mikɛ mililɛi akafee esha. Mawo minaabu manyoflɛ; be mli ni mɛi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ mihiɛ nɛɛ.”

english_verse: I kept completely silent, but it did no good, and I hurt even worse.
translation_verse: Mitɔ mu, ni mitswaaa misɛŋ; mimua minaa, shi fɛɛ yakatswaa, mipiŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ mi.

english_verse: I felt a fire burning inside, and the more I thought, the more it burned, until at last I said:
translation_verse: Mitsui mli miishã mi. Babaoo ni misusuɔ miyiŋ lɛ, babaoo ni mitsuimlishãa lɛ woɔ wu ji no; Kɛkɛ ni migbele minaa mikɛɛ

english_verse: “Please, Lord, show me my future. Will I soon be gone?
translation_verse: “Yehowa, hã male minaagbee, kɛ miwala gbii lɛ ayibɔ, bɔ ni ji, hã male tsɛ ni mitsɛŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: You made my life short, so brief that the time means nothing to you. “Human life is but a breath,
translation_verse: Naa, ofee miwala gbii kuku lɛ tamɔ dɛ̃ lɛɛmɔ, ni miwala be lɛ, jeee nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ ohiɛ. Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni gbɔmɔ adesa yɔɔ lɛ, kɛ efee floŋŋ tamɔ mɛ, lamɔ kɛkɛ ji lɛ.

english_verse: and it disappears like a shadow. Our struggles are senseless; we store up more and more, without ever knowing who will get it all.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛŋ, gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ, ehoɔ eyaa tamɔ hɔɔŋ. Anɔkwa, egbaa ehe naa yakatswaa. Etĩaa nii anaa, tsɛbelɛ eleee mɔ ni baaye.

english_verse: “What am I waiting for? I depend on you, Lord!
translation_verse: “Ni agbɛnɛ, Nuŋtsɔ, mɛni mimɛɔ? Mihiɛnɔkãmɔ fɛɛ ji bo.

english_verse: Save me from my sins. Don't let fools sneer at me.
translation_verse: Kpɔ̃ mi yɛ mitɔ̃mɔi lɛ fɛɛ amli; kaahã kwashia miibɔ mi ahora.

english_verse: You treated me like this, and I kept silent, not saying a word.
translation_verse: Mitɔ mu: mitswaaa misɛŋ, ejaakɛ bo ohã mipiŋ.

english_verse: “Won't you stop punishing me? You have worn me down.
translation_verse: Kaagwao mi dɔŋŋ; yii ni oyiɔ mi lɛ, ehã migbede.

english_verse: You punish us severely because of our sins. Like a moth, you destroy what we treasure most. We are as frail as a breath.
translation_verse: Okãa gbɔmɛi adesai ahiɛ yɛ esha hewɔ, ni ofiteɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni jara wa hã amɛ tamɔ omlɛgɛ fiteɔ nii. Lɛɛ lɛŋ, gbɔmɔ lɛ lamɔ kɛkɛ ji lɛ. Sela

english_verse: “Listen, Lord, to my prayer! My eyes are flooded with tears, as I pray to you. I am merely a stranger visiting in your home as my ancestors did.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, bo mifaikpamɔ lɛ toi ni ofee toi ohã mikɔmɔyeli lɛ. Mihiɛ yaafonu lɛ hewɔ lɛ kaamua onaa; ejaakɛ oshikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ gbɔ kɛkɛ ji mi, mɔkpɔŋ tamɔ mitsɛmɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Stop being angry with me and let me smile again before I am dead and gone.”
translation_verse: Foo omlifu lɛ sɛɛ koni mana miishɛɛ fioo dani mashi biɛ maya.”

english_verse: I patiently waited, Lord, for you to hear my prayer. You listened
translation_verse: Mikɛ tsuishitoo kwɛ Yehowa gbɛ; eba etoi shi, ni enu mibolɔmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: and pulled me from a lonely pit full of mud and mire. You let me stand on a rock with my feet firm,
translation_verse: Efã mi kɛje hiɛkpãtãmɔ bu lɛ mli, ejie mi kɛjɛ ŋmiamɔ lɛ mli, ni ekɛ minaji mamɔ tɛsaa nɔ, ni ehã minane mɔ shi.

english_verse: and you gave me a new song, a song of praise to you. Many will see this, and they will honor and trust you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Etsɔ̃ɔ mi lala hee ko lamɔ, no ji lala ni akɛjieɔ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi. Mɛi babaoo aaana, ni amɛaashe gbeyei; ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ aaafɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ.

english_verse: You bless all of those who trust you, Lord, and refuse to worship idols or follow false gods.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni ŋɔɔ ehiɛ efɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ, ni ekɛ hewolɔi ebɔɔɔ, ni ekɛ mɛi ni duɔ gbɛ kɛyanyiɛɔ amale nyɔŋmɔi asɛɛ lɛ hu ebɔɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord God, have done many wonderful things, and you have planned marvelous things for us. No one is like you! I would never be able to tell all you have done.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, Onaakpɛɛ nibii lɛ fa babaoo hã wɔ; ni ojwɛŋmɔ ni oyɔɔ yɛ wɔhe lɛ hu fa naakpa. Mɔ ko bɛ ni akɛ lɛ aaato ohe. Kɛji majaje ni mawie he lɛ, amɛfa fe bɔ ni aaanyɛ akane.

english_verse: Sacrifices and offerings are not what please you; gifts and payment for sin are not what you demand. But you made me willing to listen and obey.
translation_verse: Lá afɔle kɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ, onyaaa he, shi moŋ ogbele mitoiŋ faŋŋ. Shãa afɔle kɛ esha afɔle hu otaooo.

english_verse: And so, I said, “I am here to do what is written about me in the book, where it says,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Naa mi; miba; mi ni aŋma mihe sane yɛ wolo kpo lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: ‘I enjoy pleasing you. Your Law is in my heart.’ ”
translation_verse: MiNyɔŋmɔ, eŋɔɔ minaa akɛ mafee osuɔmɔnaanii; Omla lɛ yɛ mitsui mli.”

english_verse: When your people worshiped, you know I told them, “Our Lord always helps!”
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, mijaje kpɔ̃mɔ jurɔ sane lɛ, yɛ asafo kpele lɛ mli; naa, ole hu akɛ mimuako minaa.

english_verse: When all your people met, I did not keep silent. I said, “Our Lord is kind. He is faithful and caring, and he saves us.”
translation_verse: Oyelikɛbuamɔ ni okɛhereɔ yiwala lɛ, mitsimɔko nɔ yɛ mitsui mli. Mijaje onɔkwayeli kɛ oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ; Mishiuko osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ onɔkwale lɛ nɔ yɛ asafo kpele lɛŋ.

english_verse: You, Lord, never fail to have pity on me; your love and faithfulness always keep me secure.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, kaakãmã mi omɔbɔnalɛ lɛ; hã osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ onɔkwale lɛ abaa miyi daa. Yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ (Lalai

english_verse: I have more troubles than I can count. My sins are all around me, and I can't find my way. My sins outnumber the hairs on my head, and I feel weak.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ efɔ̃ji ni anyɛŋ akane ebɔle mi kɛkpe. Mihe eshai lɛ fa fe mi, bɔ sɔŋŋ ni minyɛɛɛ mihiɛ nɔ mawo. Amɛfa fe miyiteŋ tsɔi, mitsui po efã yɛ mimli.

english_verse: Please show that you care and come to my rescue. Hurry and help me!
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, ofainɛ ni ojie mi. Oo Yehowa, ye obua mi oya.

english_verse: Disgrace and confuse all who want me dead; turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni taoɔ mihiɛ akpãtã lɛ, hã amɛhiɛ agboi; ni amɛhiɛ ashwie shi. Mɛi ni taoɔ mi awui aye lɛ, hã amɛku amɛsɛɛ ni amɛheguɔ agbo.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame everyone who says, “Just look at you now!”
translation_verse: Mɛi ni kɛɔ mi akɛ, “Gbeebi akle” lɛ, hã amɛhe ajɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ amɛhiɛgbele lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, let your worshipers rejoice and be glad. They love you for saving them, so let them always say, “The Lord is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Shi moŋ, hã mɛi fɛɛ ni taoɔ osɛɛgbɛ lɛ anya, ni amɛmii ashɛ amɛhe yɛ omli. Mɛi ni sumɔɔ odɛ̃ŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ akɛɛ daa akɛ, “Yehowa je agbo.”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but, Lord God, you care about me, and you come to my rescue. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Tsɛbelɛ, ohiafo ji mi ni efi mi moŋ nɛ shi kɛ̃lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jwɛŋɔ minɔ. Oo, miNyɔŋmɔ, bo ji mibualɔ kɛ mikpɔlɔ, kaatsɛ kwrakwra!

english_verse: You, Lord God, bless everyone who cares for the poor, and you rescue those people in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ mɔ ni jwɛŋɔ ohiafo he; gbi fɔŋ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa aaahere lɛ.

english_verse: You protect them and keep them alive. You make them happy here in this land, and you don't hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Yehowa aaabaa eyi, ni eeena wala, ni aaajɔɔ lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni oŋɔŋ lɛ owoŋ ehenyɛlɔi ni taoɔ lɛ lɛ adɛŋ.

english_verse: You always heal them and restore their strength when they are sick.
translation_verse: Yehowa aaatsɔmɔ lɛ yɛ ehela saa nɔ, ni eeetsa ehelai lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm ehã lɛ.

english_verse: I prayed, “Have pity, Lord! Heal me, though I have sinned against you.”
translation_verse: Mi lɛ, mikɛɛ akɛ, “Oo Yehowa, naa mi mɔbɔ ni otsa mi, ejaakɛ mifee esha mishi bo.”

english_verse: My vicious enemies ask me, “When will you die and be forgotten?”
translation_verse: Mihenyɛlɔi lɛ wieɔ mihe kɛ jwɛŋmɔ fɔŋ. Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Mɛɛbe eeegbo ni egbɛi aaalaaje kwraa hu!”

english_verse: When visitors come, all they ever bring are worthless words, and when they leave, they spread gossip.
translation_verse: Kɛji mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ba mi saramɔ lɛ, amɛkwaa amɛwieɔ osato wiemɔi, be mli ni amɛmiijwɛŋ efɔŋ yɛ amɛtsuiaŋ, ni kɛ amɛje kpo lɛ, amɛyagbaa no.

english_verse: My enemies whisper about me. They think the worst,
translation_verse: Mɛi fɛɛ kwa ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ, amɛwieɔ mihe ablɛbi, ni amɛsusuɔ efɔŋ amɛhãa mi.

english_verse: and they say, “You have some fatal disease! You'll never get well.”
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Gbele hela ni emɔ lɛ lɛ, ni shi ni ekã nɛɛ eteŋ shi.”

english_verse: My most trusted friend has turned against me, though he ate at my table.
translation_verse: Mi diɛŋtsɛ mishieŋtsɛ po ni miheɔ lɛ miyeɔ, mɔ ni yeɔ midɛŋ aboloo lɛ efã ntia eshi mi.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! Heal me, so I can pay them back.
translation_verse: Shi bo Yehowa, naa mi mɔbɔ, ni otee mi shi, koni mawo amɛ he nyɔmɔ.

english_verse: Then my enemies won't defeat me, and I will know that you really care.
translation_verse: Enɛ mikɛaale akɛ oyɛ mihe tsuijurɔ lɛɛlɛŋ, ejaakɛ mihenyɛlɔi yeko minɔ kunim.

english_verse: You have helped me because I am innocent, and you will always be close to my side.
translation_verse: Owoɔ minɔ, ejaakɛ mifeɔ nɔ ni ja; ni oto mi yɛ ohiɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.

english_verse: You, the Lord God of Israel, will be praised forever! Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Ajie Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyashi naanɔ. Amen! Amen!

english_verse: As a deer gets thirsty for streams of water, I truly am thirsty for you, my God.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni ofrote shweɔ faa ni hoɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ misusuma shweɔ bo, Naa Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: In my heart, I am thirsty for you, the living God. When will I see your face?
translation_verse: Misusuma miiye bo Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ he kumai. Te be po ni maba, ni mabana Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ hu?

english_verse: Day and night my tears are my only food, as everyone keeps asking, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Mihiɛ yaafonu etsɔ̃ miniyenii shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ, be mli ni mɛi biɔ mi akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ?”

english_verse: Sorrow floods my heart, when I remember leading the worshipers to your house. I can still hear them shout their joyful praises.
translation_verse: Miwerɛ hoɔ mihe, kɛji mikai enɛɛmɛi: bɔ ni mi kɛ asafo yuu nyiɛɔ, bɔ ni amɛtoɔ yuu, ni minyiɛɔ amɛhiɛ kɛyaa Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ; bɔ ni asafo lɛ bɔɔ oshe kɛ miishɛɛ, ni amɛkɛ shidaa lalai yeɔ gbijurɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I should trust you, Lord. I will praise you again because you help me,
translation_verse: Oo misusuma, mɛɛba ofee mɔbɔmɔbɔ nɛkɛ? Mɛɛ yeyeeye ofee yɛ mimli nɛɛ? Okɛ ohiɛ afɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ, ejaakɛ majie eyi ekoŋŋ kɛ̃, mɔ ni ji miyelikɛbualɔ kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: and you are my God. I am deeply discouraged, and so I think about you here where the Jordan begins at Mount Hermon and at Mount Mizar.
translation_verse: Misusuma efee mɔbɔmɔbɔ yɛ mimli, no hewɔ ni mikaiɔ bo, yɛ Yordan shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ Hermon gɔji lɛ, kɛ Mizar gɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɛɛ.

english_verse: Your vicious waves have swept over me like an angry ocean or a roaring waterfall.
translation_verse: Onujɔi lɛ agbɛɛmɔ jijeɔ, eko nyiɛ eko sɛɛ. Oshɔkei kɛ omlɛ̃mlɛ̃i lɛ fɛɛ ekumɔ eshwie minɔ, ni esu miyi.

english_verse: Every day, you are kind, and at night you give me a song as my prayer to you, the God of my life.
translation_verse: Shwane lɛ, Yehowa jieɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi; ni nyɔɔŋ lɛ milaa Yehowa he lala; ni misɔleɔ mitsɛɔ miNyɔŋmɔ, mɔ dɛŋ ni miwala yɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock. Why have you forgotten me? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Mikɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mitɛsaa lɛ, akɛ, “Mɛɛba ohiɛ ekpa minɔ? Mɛɛba sa akɛ manyiɛ mɔbɔmɔbɔ yɛ haomɔ ni henyɛlɔ haoɔ mi lɛ hewɔ?”

english_verse: Even my bones are in pain, while all day long my enemies sneer and ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Ahora ni mihenyɛlɔi lɛ bɔɔ mi lɛ, shãa mi tamɔ fala, be mli ni amɛbiɔ mi daa akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ?” lɛ.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Oo misusuma, mɛɛba ofee mɔbɔmɔbɔ yɛ mimli nɛkɛ? Ni mɛɛ yeyeeye ofee yɛ mimli nɛɛ? Okɛ ohiɛ afɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ, ejaakɛ majie eyi ekoŋŋ kɛ̃, mɔ ni ji miyelikɛbualɔ kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Show that I am right, God! Defend me against everyone who doesn't know you; rescue me from each of those deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, ye misane lɛ ohã mi; ni obu mi bem. Fã mihe yɛ maŋbii ni sheee bo gbeyei lɛ adɛŋ. Jiemɔ mi yɛ shishiulɔi kɛ mɛi ni yeee anɔkwa lɛ adɛŋ!

english_verse: I run to you for protection. Why do you turn me away? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ abo ni mibaa. Mɛɛba oshɛ mi ofɔ̃? Mɛɛba sa akɛ manyiɛ mɔbɔmɔbɔ yɛ haomɔ ni henyɛlɔ haoɔ mi lɛ hewɔ?

english_verse: Send your light and your truth to guide me. Let them lead me to your house on your sacred mountain.
translation_verse: Oo, hã ola kɛ onɔkwale lɛ aba; koni amɛbatsɔ̃ɔ mi gbɛ. Hã amɛ kɛ mi aba Zion ogɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛ oSɔlemɔwe lɛŋ.

english_verse: Then I will worship at your altar because you make me joyful. You are my God, and I will praise you. Yes, I will praise you as I play my harp.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ maya Nyɔŋmɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he; maya Nyɔŋmɔ ni hãa mi miishɛɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ ŋɔɔ; ni matswa saŋku mikɛaajie oyi. Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, miNyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Oo misusuma, mɛɛba ofee mɔbɔmɔbɔ nɛkɛ? Ni mɛɛ yeyeeye ofee yɛ mimli nɛɛ? Okɛ ohiɛ afɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ; shi majie eyi ekoŋŋ kɛ̃, mɔ ni ji miyelikɛbualɔ kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Our God, our ancestors told us what wonders you worked and we listened carefully.
translation_verse: Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔnu kɛ wɔtoi; wɔblematsɛmɛi lɛ egba wɔ nibii ni otsu yɛ amɛyinɔ, yɛ blema bei lɛ amli.

english_verse: You chased off the nations by causing them trouble with your powerful arm. Then you let our ancestors take over their land.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni bo diɛŋtsɛ oshwie maji lɛ, ni otɛo owebii yɛ jɛi; bɔ ni ohao maji krokomɛi lɛ, shi owebii lɛ ohã amɛshwere.

english_verse: Their strength and weapons were not what won the land and gave them victory! You loved them and fought with your powerful arm and your shining glory.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ jeee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛklante nɔ amɛtsɔ̃ amɛŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ; asaŋ jeee amɛnineshiwalɛ hã amɛye kunim; shi moŋ ohewalɛ kɛ onyɛmɔ naa, kɛ ohiɛ ni kã amɛhe lɛ hã amɛye kunim; ejaakɛ oyɛ amɛhe tsuijurɔ.

english_verse: You are my God and King, and you give victory to the people of Jacob.
translation_verse: Bo ji mimaŋtsɛ kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ, bo ohã Israel ye kunim srɔtoi lɛ.

english_verse: By your great power, we knocked our enemies down and trampled on them.
translation_verse: Ohewalɛ naa wɔtsirɛɔ wɔhenyɛlɔi wɔtswiaa shi yɛ; ogbɛi mli wɔnaanaa mɛi ni teɔ shi woɔ wɔ lɛ anɔ yɛ.

english_verse: I don't depend on my arrows or my sword to save me.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ jeee migãi nɔ mihiɛ kã, asaŋ jeee miklante aaahere miyiwala.

english_verse: But you saved us from our hateful enemies, and you put them to shame.
