translation_verse: Shi moŋ bo ohere wɔyiwala yɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi adɛŋ, ni ohã mɛi ni he tsɛ̃ɔ wɔ lɛ ahiɛ gboi.

english_verse: We boast about you, our God, and we are always grateful.
translation_verse: Bo Nyɔŋmɔ, onɔ wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ daa nɛɛ, ni wɔɔɔda bo shi daa kɛaatee naanɔ.

english_verse: But now you have rejected us; you don't lead us into battle, and we look foolish.
translation_verse: Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, okwa wɔ, ni oba wɔ shi; ni okɛ wɔ efãaa ta dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: You made us retreat, and our enemies have taken everything we own.
translation_verse: Ohãa wɔjoɔ wɔhenyɛlɔi anaa foi, ni wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ haa wɔnii.

english_verse: You let us be slaughtered like sheep, and you scattered us among the nations.
translation_verse: Ofee wɔ tamɔ toi ni akɛ amɛ miiya gbeehe; ni ogbɛ wɔ oshwã majimaji lɛ amli.

english_verse: You sold your people for little or nothing, and you earned no profit.
translation_verse: Ohɔ̃ɔ omaŋbii lɛ ofoo, ni ahe amɛ mlɛo.

english_verse: You made us look foolish to our neighbors; people who live nearby insult us and sneer.
translation_verse: Ohã mɛi ni bɔle wɔ lɛ bɔɔ wɔ ahora, mɛi ni bɔle wɔ lɛ yeɔ wɔhe fɛo ni amɛŋmɔɔ wɔ.

english_verse: Foreigners joke about us and shake their heads.
translation_verse: Ohã wɔtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni abuuu amɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ; wɔtsɔ̃mɔ hefɛoyelinii wɔhã majimaji lɛ.

english_verse: I am embarrassed every day, and I blush with shame.
translation_verse: Minaa mihiɛshishwiemɔ lɛ daa jenamɔ tuu; ni hiɛgbele hu emɔ mi,

english_verse: But others mock and sneer, as they watch my enemies take revenge on me.
translation_verse: yɛ ahorabɔlɔi lɛ kɛ sopalɔi lɛ awiemɔi ahewɔ ni hiɛgbele hu mɔɔ mi kɛ mina mihenyɛlɔ kɛ oweletɔlɔ lɛ.

english_verse: All this happened to us, though we didn't forget you or break our agreement.
translation_verse: Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ eba wɔnɔ moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔhiɛ kpako onɔ, ni wɔkuko wɔkɛ bo teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: We always kept you in mind and followed your teaching.
translation_verse: Wɔkwako bo, ni jeee akɛ wɔbako wɔjeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni otaoɔ lɛ,

english_verse: But you crushed us, and you covered us with deepest darkness where wild animals live.
translation_verse: shi kɛ̃lɛ okumɔ wɔ butubutu yɛ ŋaŋgbei ahilɛhe ni okɛ duŋ kabitii eha wɔnɔ nɛɛ.

english_verse: We did not forget you or lift our hands in prayer to foreign gods.
translation_verse: Eji wɔhiɛ ekpa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ nɔ, ni wɔyaja maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko kulɛ,

english_verse: You would have known it because you discover every secret thought.
translation_verse: ani bo Nyɔŋmɔ oleŋ lo? Ejaakɛ ole tsuiiaŋ teemɔŋnii.

english_verse: We face death all day for you. We are like sheep on their way to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Naa, ohewɔ lɛ akpãtãa wɔhiɛ be fɛɛ be, ni abuɔ wɔ tamɔ toi ni ayaagbe amɛ.

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord! Why are you sleeping? Don't desert us forever.
translation_verse: Oo Nuŋtsɔ, tee shi, mɛɛba owɔɔ? Ohiɛ atsɛ̃, kaashɛrɛ wɔ oshwie kɛmiiya naanɔ.

english_verse: Why do you keep looking away? Don't forget our sufferings and all our troubles.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ hewɔ okɛ ohiɛ etee? Mɛɛba ohiɛ ekpa wɔmanehulu kɛ yi ni awaa wɔ lɛ nɔ?

english_verse: We are flat on the ground, holding on to the dust.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ anaanaa wɔnɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ; ni wɔgbɔmɔtso eka su mli.

english_verse: Do something! Help us! Show how kind you are and come to our rescue.
translation_verse: Tee shi ni obaye obua wɔ. Yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ lɛ heremɔ wɔyiwala.

english_verse: My thoughts are filled with beautiful words for the king, and I will use my voice as a writer would use pen and ink.
translation_verse: Mitsui eyi tɔ kɛ wiemɔi kpakpai. Maŋtsɛ lala nɛ. Mililɛi tamɔ niŋmalɔ ni he esa niŋmaatso.

english_verse: No one is as handsome as you! Your words are always kind. That is why God will always bless you.
translation_verse: Ohe yɛ fɛo fe gbɔmɛi abii fɛɛ. Odaaŋ wiemɔ he tse, hewɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ejɔɔ bo kɛmiiya naanɔ.

english_verse: Mighty king, glorious ruler, strap on your sword
translation_verse: Oo, bo hewalɛtsɛ maŋtsɛ, miamɔ kɛ oklante yɛ ogbojee kɛ onunyam mli.

english_verse: and ride out in splendor! Win victories for truth and mercy and justice. Do fearsome things with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Fãa kɛ agbojee kɛyaye kunim, kɛfã anɔkwale kɛ jalɛ he. Ohewalɛ aaahã oye kunim wulu.

english_verse: Send your sharp arrows through enemy hearts and make all nations fall at your feet.
translation_verse: Ogãimlibii anaa ba; amɛgbulɔɔ maŋtsɛ henyɛlɔi atsuiiaŋ; ni majimaji pleneeɔ yɛ onaji anaa.

english_verse: You are God, and you will rule forever as king. Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Omaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛ sɛi ni, ni ema shi kɛmiiya naanɔ. Olumɔyeli tsi lɛ, jalɛ saneyeli tsi ni.

english_verse: You love justice and hate evil. And so, your God chose you and made you happier than any of your friends.
translation_verse: Osumɔɔ jalɛ saneyeli, ni onyɛɔ efɔŋfeemɔ. No hewɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã oyi obɔ̃ kɛ miishɛɛ fe onanemɛi maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The sweet aroma of the spices myrrh, aloes, and cassia covers your royal robes. You enjoy the music of harps in palaces decorated with ivory.
translation_verse: Otadei amli eyi obɔ̃ kɛ krɔbɔo kɛ anuatrɛ kɛ kashia ŋma. Kpãa saŋkui atswaa akɛshɛjeɔ omii yɛ shuɔwu mɔji amli.

english_verse: Daughters of kings are here, and your bride stands at your right side, wearing a wedding gown trimmed with pure gold.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛmɛi abiyei futu oyei hiɛnaanɔbii ateŋ. Maŋnyɛ lɛ ewula kɛ Ofir shika kɛdamɔ oninejurɔ nɔ

english_verse: Bride of the king, listen carefully to me. Forget your own people and your father's family.
translation_verse: Ee! biyoo, bo toi, jwɛŋmɔ he; ohiɛ akpa bo diɛŋtsɛ omaŋbii kɛ otsɛ we lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: The king adores you. He is your master, so do what he desires.
translation_verse: Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ aaakɔ̃ ohefɛo lɛ nɔ. Akɛni lɛ ji onuŋtsɔ lɛ, kotomɔ lɛ.

english_verse: All of the richest people from the city of Tyre will try to influence you
translation_verse: Tirobii kɛ maŋ lɛŋ niiatsɛmɛi lɛ tete kɛ nikeenii aaaba koni amɛkɛtao ohiɛ gbɛ?

english_verse: with precious treasures. Your bride, my king, has inward beauty, and her wedding gown is woven with threads of gold.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ biyoo lɛ ewula kiŋkaŋŋ yɛ opia lɛŋ. Etade lɛ akɛ shika kpãa elo mli.

english_verse: Wearing the finest garments, she is brought to you, followed by her young friends, the bridesmaids.
translation_verse: Ewula kɛ atadei ni aye ŋaabii kɛ amɛsui srɔtoi awo mli; ni akpala lɛ kɛyahã maŋtsɛ lɛ, esɛɛbii enanemɛi oblayei froi krokomɛi nyiɛ esɛɛ.

english_verse: Everyone is excited, as they follow you to the royal palace.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛ nyamɔ kɛ mliflimɔ boteɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛŋ.

english_verse: Your sons and your grandsons will also be kings as your ancestors were. You will make them rulers everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Obihii lɛ aaabaye oblematsɛmɛi lɛ asɛɛ. Ooowo amɛ lumɛi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: I will make your name famous from now on, and you will be praised forever and ever.
translation_verse: Mahã akai onumnyam gbɛi lɛ yinɔi fɛɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, jeŋ gbɔmɛiabii fɛɛ aaajie oyi daa kɛaatee naanɔ.

english_verse: God is our mighty fortress, always ready to help in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ji wɔbobaahe kɛ wɔhewalɛ, wɔyelikɛbualɔ krɔŋŋ yɛ fimɔ mli.

english_verse: And so, we won't be afraid! Let the earth tremble and the mountains tumble into the deepest sea.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji shikpɔŋ hiɛ tsɔ̃ bu shi, kɛji gɔji famɔ yagbee ŋshɔŋ teŋteŋ tete po lɛ, wɔsheŋ gbeyei.

english_verse: Let the ocean roar and foam, and its raging waves shake the mountains.
translation_verse: Kɛji ŋshɔ lɛ hũu, ni efee hamahama; kɛji gɔji tete hoso yɛ ŋshɔ grimɔ naa po lɛ, wɔsheŋ gbeyei.

english_verse: A river and its streams bring joy to the city, which is the sacred home of God Most High.
translation_verse: Faa ko yɛ ni eniji lɛ hãa Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ lɛ mii shɛɔ ehe. Ehãa Ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ shihilɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mii shɛɔ ehe.

english_verse: God is in that city, and it won't be shaken. He will help it at dawn.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ emaŋ lɛ mli; nɔ ko nɔ ko haŋ maŋ lɛ afite. Nyɔŋmɔ aaaye abua lɛ leebi maaŋkpa.

english_verse: Nations rage! Kingdoms fall! But at the voice of God the earth itself melts.
translation_verse: Majimaji lɛ feɔ hoo; maŋtsɛyelii lɛ hosoɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ woɔ egbee ni shikpɔŋ lɛ sereɔ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ wɔ yɛ; Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji wɔbobaahe;

english_verse: Come! See the fearsome things the Lord has done on earth.
translation_verse: Nyɛbaa nyɛbakwɛa Yehowa nitsumɔi lɛ; Nyɛbakwɛa bɔ ni ehã hiɛkpãtãmɔ eba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: God brings wars to an end all over the world. He breaks the arrows, shatters the spears, and burns the shields.
translation_verse: Ehãa tawuu sɛɛ foɔ kɛyashɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei lɛ. Ekumɔɔ gãii amli ni efiteɔ akplɔi. Ekɛ la shãa tsɛŋi lɛ.

english_verse: Our God says, “Calm down, and learn that I am God! All nations on earth will honor me.”
translation_verse: “Nyɛfea dioo, ni nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ mi, mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ; Awo minɔ gojoo yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ, Awo minɔ gojoo yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ wɔ yɛ; Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji wɔbobaahe.

english_verse: All of you nations, clap your hands and shout joyful praises to God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ maji fɛɛ tswɛm, nyɛtswaa nyɛdɛ̃; nyɛkɛ nyamɔ lala abɔa oshe waa ahãa Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is fearsome, the ruler of all the earth.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa, mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi flooflo lɛ, ehe yɛ gbeyei. Maŋtsɛ kpele ji lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: God has put every nation under our power,
translation_verse: Eba maŋbii ashi ewo wɔshishi, ni ehã wɔye majimaji anɔ.

english_verse: and he chose for us the land that was the pride of Jacob, his favorite.
translation_verse: Eŋɔ wɔgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ ehã wɔ, Yakob, mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ lɛ, shwãanii lɛ.

english_verse: God goes up to his throne, as people shout and trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ etee ŋwɛi kɛ oshebɔɔ. Yehowa kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ jijemɔ etee ŋwɛi.

english_verse: the ruler of all the earth! Praise God with songs.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji maŋtsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Nyɛjiea eyi kɛ lalai!

english_verse: God rules the nations from his sacred throne.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ yeɔ majimaji fɛɛ anɔ maŋtsɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ ta emaŋtsɛ sɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Their leaders come together and are now the people of Abraham's God. All rulers on earth surrender their weapons, and God is greatly praised!
translation_verse: Maji lɛ amli lumɛi lɛ ebua amɛhe naa kɛba; ni amɛbatsɔ̃mɔ Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ webii. Ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tawuu nibii lɛ, Naa Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ ni. Awo enɔ gojoo.

english_verse: The Lord God is wonderful! He deserves all praise in the city where he lives. His holy mountain,
translation_verse: Yehowa je agbo, ni esa yijiemɔ kpele, yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ maŋ lɛŋ, yɛ egɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: beautiful and majestic, brings joy to all on earth. Mount Zion, truly sacred, is home for the Great King.
translation_verse: Egɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ Zion shimaa yɛ fɛo. Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ tsui he nɔ ni. Zion Gɔŋ ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ, ji maŋtsɛ wulu lɛ maŋ.

english_verse: God is there to defend it and has proved to be its protector.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ ehã ale akɛ kɛji oyɛ emaŋ lɛŋ mɔji lɛ amli lɛ, oyɛ abobaahe shweshweeshwe.

english_verse: Kings joined forces to attack the city,
translation_verse: Shi naa, maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ bua amɛhe naa amɛba kutuu kɛba Zion Gɔŋ lɛ he.

english_verse: but when they saw it, they were terrified and ran away.
translation_verse: Amrɔ ni amɛna Zion lɛ, amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe; ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ amɛ, Kɛkɛ ni tswrao amɛjo foi.

english_verse: They trembled all over like women giving birth
translation_verse: Gbeyei mɔmɔ amɛ yɛ jɛi; amɛhe jara amɛ tamɔ yoo ni miikɔmɔ,

english_verse: or like seagoing ships wrecked by eastern winds.
translation_verse: loo tamɔ bokã kɔɔyɔɔ, ni miijwara Tarshish lɛji.

english_verse: We had heard about it, and now we have seen it in the city of our God, the Lord All-Powerful. This is the city that God will let stand forever.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni wɔnu lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔna yɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, maŋ wulu lɛŋ. Nyɔŋmɔ aaahã emaŋ lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ kɛya naanɔ.

english_verse: Our God, here in your temple we think about your love.
translation_verse: Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔsusu osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ he yɛ oSɔlemɔ we lɛŋ.

english_verse: You are famous and praised everywhere on earth, as you win victories with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, bɔ ni ogbɛi lɛ jijeɔ lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ oyijiemɔ jijeɔ, kɛyaa shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei. Oninejurɔ eyi obɔ kɛ kunimyeli.

english_verse: Mount Zion will celebrate, and all Judah will be glad, because you bring justice.
translation_verse: Hã Zion Gɔŋ lɛ anya, hã Yuda maji lɛ amli afili amɛ yɛ ejalɛ kojomɔi lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: Let's walk around Zion and count its towers.
translation_verse: Nyɛnyiɛa kɛbɔlea Zion he kpula; nyɛkanea emli mɔji ni kwɔlɔ lɛ.

english_verse: We will see its strong walls and visit each fortress. Then you can say to future generations,
translation_verse: Nyɛtɛ̃jea nyɛhiɛ nyɛkwɛa gbogboi lɛ; nyɛkpaa emli mɔji wuji lɛ amli, koni nyɛgbaa yinɔbii ni baaba lɛ akɛ,

english_verse: “Our God is like this forever and will always guide us.”
translation_verse: “Nyɔŋmɔ nɛɛ lɛ ji wɔNyɔŋmɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ. Lɛ nɔŋŋ eeetsɔ̃ɔ wɔ gbɛ kɛaatee naanɔ.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Nyɛboa enɛ toi, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ! Nyɛ jeŋ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ, nyɛfea toi,

english_verse: Listen, no matter who you are, rich or poor.
translation_verse: nyɛ mɛi ni abuɔ kɛ mɛi ni abuuu, niiatsɛmɛi kɛ ohiafoi fɛɛ!

english_verse: I speak words of wisdom, and my thoughts make sense.
translation_verse: Nilee wiemɔ baajɛ midaaŋ; mitsuiŋ susumɔ lɛ niiashishinumɔ ni.

english_verse: I have in mind a mystery that I will explain while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Mafee toi mahã abɛbuaiaŋ wiemɔ, ni mikɛ saŋku aaatsɔ̃ɔ mijenu lɛ shishi.

english_verse: Why should I be afraid in times of trouble, when I am surrounded by vicious enemies?
translation_verse: Mɛni hewɔ mashe gbeyei yɛ haomɔ bei amli; be ni mishishinyiɛlɔi kɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii ebɔle mi,

english_verse: They trust in their riches and brag about all their wealth.
translation_verse: mɛi ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ amɛninamɔ nɔ ni amɛshwãa akɛ amɛyɛ shika babaoo?

english_verse: It costs far too much to buy back your life. You can never pay God enough
translation_verse: ejaakɛ wala kpɔ̃mɔ nii lɛ ejara wa tsɔ̃, bɔ ni enyɛŋ he nyɔmɔ ewo kɔkɔɔkɔ,

english_verse: to stay alive forever and safe from death.
translation_verse: koni ehi shi kɛya naanɔ ni ekana gbohiiaje.

english_verse: We see that wise people die, and so do stupid fools. Then their money is left for someone else.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ! Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ naa akɛ nilelɔi tete gboiɔ; asaŋ kwashia kɛ buulu fɛɛ hu gboiɔ; ni amɛshĩɔ amɛjwetrii fɛɛ amɛhãa mɛi krokomɛi.

english_verse: The grave will be their home forever and ever, although they once had land of their own.
translation_verse: Amɛyiŋ fɛɛ lɛ, amɛgbonyobui lɛ ji amɛshĩai kɛmiiya naanɔ. Jɛi ji amɛshihilɛhei kɛmiiya yinɔi fɛɛ anɔ; tsɛbelɛ, amɛtsɛ shikpɔji krokomɛi akɛ amɛnɔ pɛŋ.

english_verse: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ adesa, ekaŋ enunyam mli, ebaagbo tamɔ kooloo nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Here is what happens to fools and to those who trust the words of fools:
translation_verse: Mɛi ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhewalɛ nɔ, ni nɔ ni amɛyɔɔ sa amɛhiɛ lɛ, bɔ ni amɛnaagbee yɔɔ nɛ:

english_verse: They are like sheep with death as their shepherd, leading them to the grave. In the morning God's people will walk all over them, as their bodies lie rotting in their home, the grave.
translation_verse: gbohiiaje kã shi hã amɛ tamɔ toi, gbele baatsɔ̃ amɛkpalalɔ. Amɛaakpeleke shi oya kɛaatee gbonyobu mli; ni amɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ aaakpɔtɔ. Gbohiiaje aaatsɔ̃ amɛwe

english_verse: But God will rescue me from the power of death.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaakpɔ̃ misusuma kɛjɛ gbohiiaje hewalɛ dɛŋ. Ejaakɛ eeehe mi eto.

english_verse: Don't let it bother you when others get rich and live in luxury.
translation_verse: Kaashe mɔ ko ni etsɔ̃ niiatsɛ, ni ewe lɛŋ anunyam efa babaoo lɛ gbeyei.

english_verse: Soon they will die and all their wealth will be left behind.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ egbo lɛ, eŋɔŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛyaŋ. Eninamɔ lɛ ekoeko enyiɛŋ esɛɛ kɛyaŋ.

english_verse: We humans are praised when we do well, and all of us are glad to be alive.
translation_verse: Eyɛ mli akɛ be ni eyɔɔ wala mli lɛ, ebuɔ ehe akɛ eyi tɔ kɛ miishɛɛ; ni mɛi hu jieɔ eyi akɛ “eyɛ jogbaŋŋ” moŋ nɛ;

english_verse: But we each will go down to our ancestors, never again to see the light of day.
translation_verse: shi kɛ̃lɛ, eeetee etsɛmɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ gbohiiaje; mɛi ni enaŋ la kɔkɔɔkɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ adesa nyɛŋ ehi enunyam shihilɛ mli sɔŋŋ; etamɔ kooloo ni hiɛ kpãtãa pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: From east to west, the powerful Lord God has been calling together everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ, Yehowa Ofe lɛ, miiwie, ni eetsɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛmiijɛ hulu shiteehe kɛyaashi eshinyɔɔhe.

english_verse: God shines brightly from Zion, the most beautiful city.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ miikpɛ kɛmiijɛ Zion ni yɔɔ fɛo kɛwula shi lɛ mli.

english_verse: Our God approaches, but not silently; a flaming fire comes first, and a storm surrounds him.
translation_verse: WɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ miiba, ebaaa lɛ kpoo. La ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ nyiɛ ehiɛ; ni ahum kpele bɔle ehe.

english_verse: God comes to judge his people. He shouts to the heavens and to the earth,
translation_verse: Etsɛ ŋwɛi, ni etsɛ shikpɔŋ, akɛ ebaakojo emɛi lɛ.

english_verse: “Call my followers together! They offered me a sacrifice, and we made an agreement.”
translation_verse: Ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbuaa mimɛi anɔkwafoi lɛ anaa nyɛhãa mi; mɛi ni etsɔ̃ afɔle nɔ amɛkɛ mi ekpãŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The heavens announce, “God is the judge, and he is always honest.”
translation_verse: Ŋwɛi tete jajeɔ ejalɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ ji kojolɔ lɛ.

english_verse: My people, I am God! Israel, I am your God. Listen to my charges against you.
translation_verse: Oo mimɛi, nyɛboa toi, mibawie. Oo Israel, maye odase mashi bo. Mi ji Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Although you offer sacrifices and always bring gifts,
translation_verse: Jeee afɔlei lɛ ahewɔ mikãa bo; oshãa afɔlei lɛ yɛ mihiɛ daa!

english_verse: I won't accept your offerings of bulls and goats.
translation_verse: Mitaooo owe lɛŋ tsinanuu ko loo otoi atsu lɛŋ too kpakpo ko.

english_verse: Every animal in the forest belongs to me, and so do the cattle on a thousand hills.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni yɔɔ koo mli, kɛ tsinai ni yɔɔ gɔji akpe nɔ lɛ, mi, minɔ ni.

english_verse: I know all the birds in the mountains, and every wild creature is in my care.
translation_verse: Mile ŋwɛi loofɔji fɛɛ, ni kooloi ni nyiɛ ŋa mli fɛɛ lɛ, minɔ ni.

english_verse: If I were hungry, I wouldn't tell you, because I own the world and everything in it.
translation_verse: Kɛji hɔmɔ miiye mi lɛ, mikɛŋ bo, ejaakɛ je lɛ kɛ emli nii fɛɛ lɛ, minɔ ni.

english_verse: I don't eat the meat of bulls or drink the blood of goats.
translation_verse: Ani miyeɔ tsina loo, aloo minuɔ too abotiai alá?

english_verse: I am God Most High! The only sacrifice I want is for you to be thankful and to keep your word.
translation_verse: Ŋɔɔ shidaa afɔle ohã Nyɔŋmɔ; koni oye oshi ni owo ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ nɔ;

english_verse: Pray to me in time of trouble. I will rescue you, and you will honor me.
translation_verse: Tsɛ mi yɛ fimɔ gbi lɛ nɔ! Majie bo, ni ooowo mihiɛ nyam.”

english_verse: But to the wicked I say: “You don't have the right to mention my laws or claim to keep our agreement!
translation_verse: Shi mɔ fɔŋ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ miikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni hegbɛ oyɔɔ akɛ ojaje mikpɔi lɛ aloo akɛ ohã mikpãŋmɔ lɛ akã olilɛi nɔ?”

english_verse: You refused correction and rejected my commands.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ osumɔɔɔ tsɔsemɔ, ni otswaa miwiemɔ ofɔ̃ɔ afã.

english_verse: You made friends with every crook you met, and you liked people who break their wedding vows.
translation_verse: Kɛji ona julɔ ko lɛ, onaanyo ni; ni okɛ gbãlãfitelɔi bɔɔ.

english_verse: You talked only about violence and told nothing but lies;
translation_verse: Ohãa onaabu gbɛ, ni ewieɔ nɔ fɔŋ; ni olilɛi foɔ amale etãa.

english_verse: you sat around gossiping, ruining the reputation of your own relatives.”
translation_verse: Otaa shi oyeɔ onyɛmi he osheku; onyɛ musuŋbi tete po, ofiteɔ egbɛi.

english_verse: When you did all this, I didn't say a word, and you thought, “God is just like us!” But now I will accuse you.
translation_verse: Enɛɛmɛi ofee, shi akɛni mifee dioo hewɔ lɛ, osusuɔ akɛ mitamɔ bo nɔŋŋ. Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ, miikã ohiɛ, ni mikɛmiimamɔ ohiɛ faŋŋ.

english_verse: You have ignored me! So pay close attention or I will tear you apart, and no one can help you.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛhiɛ ekpa Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkadia enɛ kɛjeee nakai lɛ, mibatserɛ nyɛmli dukuduku ni mɔ ko bɛ ni baahere nyɛyiwala.

english_verse: The sacrifice that honors me is a thankful heart. Obey me, and I, your God, will show my power to save.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni shãa shidaa afɔle lɛ, eewo mihiɛ nyam. Mɔ ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ lɛ, mibahere eyiwala.

english_verse: You are kind, God! Please have pity on me. You are always merciful! Please wipe away my sins.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, naa mi mɔbɔ yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ. Omɔbɔnalɛ babaoo lɛ naa lɛ, gbee mitɔmɔi lɛ.

english_verse: Wash me clean from all of my sin and guilt.
translation_verse: Fɔ mihe nishaianii lɛ fɛɛ oshwie, koni ohã mihe atse,

english_verse: I know about my sins, and I cannot forget the burden of my guilt.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mitɔmɔi lɛ, mi diɛŋtsɛ mile; ni mihe eshai fɛɛ ma mihiɛ daa.

english_verse: You are really the one I have sinned against; I have disobeyed you and have done wrong. So it is right and fair for you to correct and punish me.
translation_verse: Bo okoome pɛ mifee esha mishi, ni mifee efɔŋ yɛ ohiɛ. Oyeɔ bem kɛji ooobu mi fɔ, ni tɔ̃mɔ bɛ okojomɔ he.

english_verse: I have sinned and done wrong since the day I was born.
translation_verse: Naa, afɔ mi yɛ esha mli, ni esha mli minyɛ ŋɔ mi hɔ yɛ.

english_verse: But you want complete honesty, so teach me true wisdom.
translation_verse: Naa, nɔ ni otaoɔ yɛ midɛŋ ji anɔkwayeli; no hewɔ lɛ, hã male nii yɛ mimligbɛ tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: Wash me with hyssop until I am clean and whiter than snow.
translation_verse: Mihe esha lɛ okɛ awrɔke afɔ, koni mihe atse; juu mihe, ni mayɛ futaa fe ayilɔ.

english_verse: Let me be happy and joyful! You crushed my bones, now let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Hã manu nyamɔ kɛ miishɛɛ he; hã wui ni bo okumɔ lɛ amli afili amɛ.

english_verse: Turn your eyes from my sin and cover my guilt.
translation_verse: Kaakwɛ eshai ni mifee lɛ; fɔ mihe eshai lɛ fɛɛ oshwie.

english_verse: Create pure thoughts in me and make me faithful again.
translation_verse: Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, bɔɔ tsui ni mli tse ohã mi; dromɔ mi mumɔ hee ni gbugbãaa.

english_verse: Don't chase me away from you or take your Holy Spirit away from me.
translation_verse: Kaashwie mi yɛ ohiɛ, ni kaajie oMumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ mimli.

english_verse: Make me as happy as you did when you saved me; make me want to obey!
translation_verse: Hã manu miishɛɛ ni yɔɔ oyiwalaheremɔ mli lɛ he ekoŋŋ; baamɔ mimli toiboo mumɔ lɛ yi,

english_verse: I will teach sinners your Law, and they will return to you.
translation_verse: Koni matsɔ̃ɔ tɔ̃lɔi okitãi lɛ, koni eshafeelɔi aku amɛsɛɛ kɛba oŋɔɔ

english_verse: Keep me from any deadly sin. Only you can save me! Then I will shout and sing about your power to save.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, bo miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, kpɔ̃ mi kɛjɛ lashishwiemɔ he fɔyeli mli, ni mala waa kɛjaje okpɔ̃mɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Help me to speak, and I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Oo Nuŋtsɔ, gbelemɔ minaa, ni minaabu ajaje oyijiemɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: Offerings and sacrifices are not what you want.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ onyaaa afɔle he; kɛji mishã shãa afɔle tete lɛ onyaŋ he.

english_verse: The way to please you is to be truly sorry deep in our hearts. This is the kind of sacrifice you won't refuse.
translation_verse: Afɔle ni sa ohiɛ ji mumɔ ni werɛ eho ehe. Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, tsui ni tswiaa shi kɛ dɔlɛ lɛ, okpooŋ.

english_verse: Please be willing, Lord, to help the city of Zion and to rebuild its walls.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, feemɔ Zion ejurɔ yɛ oduromɔ naa; tswaa Yerusalɛm gbogboi lɛ ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: Then you will be pleased with the proper sacrifices, and we will offer bulls on your altar once again.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ ooona afɔlei ni sa ahe tsui, shãa afɔlei jio, kooloo muu afɔle ni jio, no ni akɛ tsina hii baashã afɔle yɛ ofɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: You people may be strong and brag about your sins, but God can be trusted day after day.
translation_verse: Oo bo gbɔmɔ kãkãlɔ, mɛɛba okɛ onifɔɔjianii ni ofee oshi mɔ ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ shwãa lɛ?

english_verse: You plan brutal crimes, and your lying words cut like a sharp razor.
translation_verse: Bo yiŋshatsɛ, olilɛi naa ba tamɔ asooyi; gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ, nifitemɔ he kpãŋmɔ okpãŋɔ.

english_verse: You would rather do evil than good, and tell lies than speak the truth.
translation_verse: Onyaa efɔŋ he fe ekpakpa; onyaa amale he fe anɔkwale.

english_verse: You love to say cruel things, and your words are a trap.
translation_verse: Oo, amalelɔ, onyaa mɔfitemɔ wiemɔi ahe!

english_verse: God will destroy you forever! He will grab you and drag you from your homes. You will be uprooted and left to die.
translation_verse: Shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ bo aaatswa shi; ni oteŋ shi dɔŋŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ. Ebaasha bo kɛjɛ obuu lɛ mli, ni ebaatserɛ omli. Ebaafã bo kɛ oshishi fã kɛaaje hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: When good people see this fearsome sight, they will laugh and say,
translation_verse: Jalɔi lɛ aaana, ni amɛaashe gbeyei, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaaŋmɔ lɛ amɛkɛɛ,

english_verse: “Just look at them now! Instead of trusting God, they trusted their wealth and their cruelty.”
translation_verse: “Naa nuu lɛ ni eŋɔɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ efeee ebobaahe lɛ, shi moŋ eŋɔ ehiɛ efɔ̃ eninamɔ babaoo lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ eshweshweeshwefeemɔ fɔ̃ eninamɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: But I am like an olive tree growing in God's house, and I can count on his love forever and ever.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, mitamɔ mutso kɛ enɔ baa ŋmɔŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ mɔbɔnalɛ ni tsakeee lɛ nɔ mihiɛ kã kɛmiiya naanɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: I will always thank God for what he has done; I will praise his good name when his people meet.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, mibada bo shi kɛya naanɔ, yɛ nɔ ni ofee lɛ hewɔ. Mibakafo ogbɛi yɛ owebii ahiɛ ejaakɛ ohi.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless! They are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Kwashiai kɛɔ yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ.” Amɛfite, ni nibii ni ahiɔ pɛ amɛfeɔ, amɛteŋ mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni feɔ nɔ kpakpa.

english_verse: From heaven God looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ jɛɔ ŋwɛi ekwɛɔ gbɔmɛi abii, akɛ eeena mɛi komɛi ni le nii, mɛi ni taoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sɛɛgbɛ lo?

english_verse: But all of them are crooked and corrupt. Not one of them does right.
translation_verse: Amɛ fɛɛ amɛgba afã, amɛ fɛɛ amɛje amɛŋlɛ nɔ; amɛteŋ mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni feɔ nɔ kpakpa. Dabida! Mɔ kome nɛkɛ folo bɛ.

english_verse: Won't you lawbreakers learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the people of God.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ miibi akɛ, “Aso nakai efɔŋfeelɔi lɛ ni yeɔ mimaŋbii lɛ tamɔ ayeɔ aboloo, ni amɛjaaa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, amɛleee nii?

english_verse: But you will be terrified worse than ever before. God will scatter the bones of his enemies, and you will be ashamed when God rejects you.
translation_verse: Naa amɛ ni ŋmiŋmi emɔmɔ amɛ, ŋmiŋmi ni anako ehenɔ dã! Ejaakɛ mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ baagbɛ amɛwui lɛ eshwã. Abaahã amɛhiɛ agboi ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ekwa amɛ.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our God, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: Oo, kulɛ ajɛ Zion ahere Israel yiwala! Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ hã ewebii ba amɛblema ekoŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ Yakob aaanya, ni Israel mii aaashɛ!

english_verse: Save me, God, by your power and prove that I am right.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛ ohewalɛ lɛ ahere miyiwala, ni okɛ ohewalɛ lɛ aye misane lɛ ohã mi.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hear what I say.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, bo misɔlemɔ toi, feemɔ toi ohã midaaŋ wiemɔi lɛ.

english_verse: Cruel strangers have attacked and want me dead. Not one of them cares about you.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ntɛŋfeelɔi ete shi ewo mi, yiwalɔi miitao mihiɛ amɛkpãtã, ejaakɛ jeee amɛhe sane ko ji Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: You will help me, Lord God, and keep me from falling;
translation_verse: Shi Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ji miyelikɛbualɔ; Yehowa dɛŋ miwala yɔɔ.

english_verse: you will punish my enemies for their evil deeds. Be my faithful friend and destroy them.
translation_verse: Eeewo mihenyɛlɔi lɛ anyɔmɔ, yɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ ahewɔ. Ebaakpãtã amɛhiɛ, ejaakɛ anɔkwafo ji lɛ.

english_verse: I will bring a gift and offer a sacrifice to you, Lord. I will praise your name because you are good.
translation_verse: Mibashã tsuijurɔ naa afɔle mahã bo. Oo Yehowa, majie ogbɛi lɛ yi, ejaakɛ omli hi.

english_verse: You have rescued me from all my troubles, and my own eyes have seen my enemies fall.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ohere mi kɛjɛ mihaomɔi lɛ fɛɛ amli, ni mihiŋmɛi ena mihenyɛlɔi anɔ kunim ni aye lɛ.

english_verse: Listen, God, to my prayer! Don't reject my request.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, feemɔ toi ohã misɔlemɔ, ni kɛji mikpa bo fai lɛ, hã mana bo.

english_verse: Please listen and help me. My thoughts are troubled, and I keep groaning
translation_verse: Bo mi toi, ni ohã mi hetoo; mihejaramɔ lɛ eye minɔ.

english_verse: because my enemies attack with loud shouts. They treat me terribly and hold angry grudges.
translation_verse: Henyɛlɔi lɛ abolɔmɔ lɛ ehã mitsui efã; yiwalɔi lɛ adɛŋ piŋmɔ ehã mifee yeyeeye; ejaakɛ amɛmiiba amɛbawo mi hejaramɔ; amɛmli efu mi, ni amɛmiinyɛ mi naakpa.

english_verse: My heart is racing fast, and I am afraid of dying.
translation_verse: Mitsui ehao yɛ mimli; gbele he ŋmiŋmi emɔ mi.

english_verse: I am trembling with fear, completely terrified.
translation_verse: Gbeyei emɔ mi, ni mihe miikpokpo, ni tsuifãa esu miyi.

english_verse: I wish I had wings like a dove, so I could fly far away and be at peace.
translation_verse: Ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Mina ni miyɛ fiji tamɔ okpo, kulɛ mafliki kɛaatee koni mayajɔɔ mihe.

english_verse: I would go and live in some distant desert.
translation_verse: Naa, kulɛ! Majo foi kɛya shɔŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, ni mayato shiaŋa lɛ nɔ. Sela

english_verse: I would quickly find shelter from howling winds and raging storms.
translation_verse: Kulɛ maye oyai majo lasuogbele kɛ ahum lɛ naa foi, mayatao abobaahe mahã mihe.”

english_verse: Confuse my enemies, Lord! Upset their plans. Cruelty and violence are all I see in the city,
translation_verse: Oo Nuŋtsɔ, futumɔ amɛjwɛŋmɔi lɛ, kaahã amɛmiikpã gbee, ejaakɛ miina basabasafeemɔ kɛ nɔmɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: and they are like guards on patrol day and night. The city is full of trouble, evil,
translation_verse: Amɛnyiɛɔ maŋ gbogboi lɛ anɔ kɛbɔleɔ maŋ lɛ, shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ; nifɔɔjianii kɛ haomɔ sɔŋŋ yɔɔ maŋ lɛŋ.

english_verse: and corruption. Troublemakers and liars freely roam the streets.
translation_verse: Akpãtã nibii ahiɛ yɛ mli, yiwalɛ kɛ shishiumɔ kpaaa yɛ eblohui lɛ amli.

english_verse: My enemies are not the ones who sneer and make fun. I could put up with that or even hide from them.
translation_verse: Henyɛlɔ ni bɔɔ mi ahora lɛ kulɛ, mamɔ mli nakai; ni asaŋ mɔ ni he tsɛ̃ɔ mi lɛ ni kulɛ, maŋɔ mihe matee lɛ.

english_verse: But it was my closest friend, the one I trusted most.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ bo, mitipɛŋfonyo, bo, minaanyo, mishieŋtsɛ ni.

english_verse: We enjoyed being together, when we went with others to your house, our God.
translation_verse: Mikɛ bo yeɔ yitsoŋ sane, ni bo ji mɔ ni mikɛnyiɛɔ kɛyaa Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ.

english_verse: All who hate me are controlled by the power of evil. Sentence them to death and send them down alive to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Hã amɛgboi, hã amɛya gbohiiaje hiɛkãalɔi, ejaakɛ amɛshĩaiaŋ kɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ eyi kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ.

english_verse: I ask for your help, Lord God, and you will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, miitsɛ bo Nyɔŋmɔ, ni bo Yehowa ooohere mi.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night you hear my concerns and my complaints.
translation_verse: Leebi kɛ shwane kɛ gbɛkɛ fɛɛ lɛ, mikɛ miwerɛho lɛ aaaŋmɛ ehiɛ kɛ kɛ̃ɛmɔ, ni eeebo mi toi.

english_verse: I am attacked from all sides, but you will rescue me unharmed by the battle.
translation_verse: Eeehere misusuma shweshweeshwe yɛ ta ni miwuɔ lɛŋ, ejaakɛ mɛi ni kɛ mi ena lɛ ayi fa.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you will hear me. You will defeat my enemies because they won't turn and worship you.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni yeɔ je lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ teteete lɛ, aaabo mi toi; ni eeeba amɛ shi ejaakɛ amɛtsakeee, ni amɛsheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei.

english_verse: My friend turned against me and broke his promise.
translation_verse: Mitsutsu naanyo lɛ ewo enine nɔ yɛ enanemɛi anɔ; ni eku eshiwoo lɛ mli.

english_verse: His words were smoother than butter, and softer than olive oil. But hatred filled his heart, and he was ready to attack with a sword.
translation_verse: Enaa jɔ fe shwie, shi ebɔɔ yɛ etsui mli; ewiemɔ he jɔ fe mlɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ klante ni naa ba ni.

english_verse: Our Lord, we belong to you. We tell you what worries us, and you won't let us fall.
translation_verse: Shɛ ojatsu lɛ ofɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ, ni lɛ eeehiɛ omli; eŋmɛŋ gbɛ gbi ko gbi ko ni jalɔ adidãa.

english_verse: But what about those people who are cruel and brutal? You will throw them down into the deepest pit long before their time. I trust you, Lord!
translation_verse: Shi, ao, bo Nyɔŋmɔ, obaashɛrɛ amɛ oshwie bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli. Mɔgbelɔi kɛ kutumpɔfoi lɛ, amɛyeŋ amɛwala gbii amli fã tete. Shi, mi lɛ, bo onɔ maŋɔ mihiɛ mafɔ̃.

english_verse: Have pity, God Most High! My enemies chase me all day.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, naa mi mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ mɛi miinaanaa minɔ, henyɛlɔi miihao mi gbi muu fɛɛ.

english_verse: Many of them are pursuing and attacking me,
translation_verse: Be fɛɛ be lɛ, mihenyɛlɔi lɛ naanaa minɔ; mɛi pii kɛ mi tswaa kɛ henɔwomɔ.

english_verse: but even when I am afraid, I keep on trusting you.
translation_verse: Kɛji gbeyei mɔ mi lɛ, mikɛ mihiɛ fɔ̃ɔ bo onɔ.

english_verse: I praise your promises! I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni daaŋ wiemɔ ni mijieɔ yi lɛ, Lɛ enɔ mikɛ mihiɛ efɔ̃; ni misheee gbeyei. Mɛni gbɔmɔ adesa aaanyɛ mi afee?

english_verse: Enemies spend the whole day finding fault with me; all they think about is how to do me harm.
translation_verse: Gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ, mi awui pɛ amɛtaoɔ amɛye; efɔŋ sɔŋŋ pɛ amɛjwɛŋɔ yɛ mihe.

english_verse: They attack from ambush, watching my every step and hoping to kill me.
translation_verse: Amɛbuaa amɛhe naa ni amɛwoɔ mi antɛo, ni amɛjaa misɛɛ mo koni amɛgbe mi.

english_verse: They won't get away with these crimes, God, because when you get angry, you destroy people.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, wo amɛ esha ni amɛfee lɛ he nyɔmɔ. Okɛ mlifu atsirɛ amɛ atswia shi.

english_verse: You have kept record of my days of wandering. You have stored my tears in your bottle and counted each of them.
translation_verse: Ole bɔ ni mitsomloɔ mihãa, Ole miyaafonu falɛ. Ani aŋmãko yɛ owolo mli lo?

english_verse: When I pray, Lord God, my enemies will retreat, because I know for certain that you are with me.
translation_verse: Gbi ni mibabolɔ matsɛ bo lɛ, mihenyɛlɔi lɛ baaku amɛsɛɛ; mile krɛdɛɛ akɛ bo, Nyɔŋmɔ, oyɛ misɛɛ.

english_verse: I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ nɔ ni mihiɛ kã; misheee gbeyei. Mɛni gbɔmɔ adesã aaanyɛ mi afee?

english_verse: I will keep my promises to you, my God, and bring you gifts.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, maye shii ni miwo bo lɛ anɔ. Mibashã shidaa afɔlei mahã bo.

english_verse: You protected me from death and kept me from stumbling, so that I would please you and follow the light that leads to life.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ohere misusuma kɛje gbele mli, ni ohãaa aye minɔ, koni manyiɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ yɛ wala la lɛ mli.

english_verse: God Most High, have pity on me! Have mercy. I run to you for safety. In the shadow of your wings, I seek protection till danger dies down.
translation_verse: Naa mi mɔbɔ! Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, naa mi mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ bo abo misusuma baa nɛɛ. Ofiji ashishi hɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ mli maba abo yɛ kɛyaashi hiɛkpãtãmɔ ahum lɛ aaaho.

english_verse: You will send help from heaven and save me, but you will bring trouble on my attackers. You are faithful, and you can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ebaatsu kɛjɛ ŋwɛi koni abahere miyiwala; ebaawo mɛi ni haoɔ mi lɛ hiɛgbele. Nyɔŋmɔ baajie esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ enɔkwale lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce, much worse than lions! They have spears and arrows instead of teeth, and they have sharp swords instead of tongues.
translation_verse: Mikã jatai ni kɛ hɔmɔ tserɛɔ gbɔmɛi amli ateŋ. Amɛnyanyɔji lɛ akplɔi kɛ gãimlibii ni; ni amɛlilɛii lɛ klantei ni naa ba ni.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, awo onɔ gojoo kɛteke ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi. Hã onunyam lɛ akple jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Enemies set traps for my feet and struck me down. They dug a pit in my path, but fell in it themselves.
translation_verse: Mihenyɛlɔi ŋmɛ mi yaa koni amɛdu mi; misusuma edɔ kɔmɔɔ kɛ awerɛho. Amɛtsa bu yɛ migbɛ nɔ, shi amɛ diɛŋtsɛ moŋ amɛyagbee mli.

english_verse: I am faithful to you, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you, my God.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, omli hemɔkɛyeli ni miyɔɔ lɛ, ema shi shiŋŋ etsakeko kwraa! Mala, majie oyi!

english_verse: I feel wide awake! I will wake up my harp and wake up the sun.
translation_verse: Ohiɛ atsɛ̃, misusuma! Nyɛhiɛ atsɛ̃a, obenta kɛ saŋku! Mibahã je atsɛre mra.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear, and I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: Oo Nuŋtsɔ, mibada bo shi yɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ. Mibala kɛjie oyi yɛ jeŋ majimaji lɛ ateŋ.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens; your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kwɔ kɛyashɛɔ ŋwɛi; ni onɔkwayeli yashɛɔ atatuiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, awo onɔ gojoo kɛteke ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi. Hã onunyam lɛ akple jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Do you mighty people talk only to oppose justice? Don't you ever judge fairly?
translation_verse: Nyɛ lumɛi, aso nyɛbuɔ atɛŋ yɛ jalɛ naa lo? Ani nyɛkojoɔ gbɔmɛi abii fɛɛ yɛ jalɛ naa lo?

english_verse: You are always planning evil, and you are brutal.
translation_verse: Dabida! Nɔ fɔŋ ni nyɛbaafee he nyɛjwɛŋɔ; yiwalɛ nii nyɛfeɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: You have done wrong and lied from the day you were born.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɔ̃ji gbaa jwɛi kɛjɛɔ musuŋ beebe; kɛji ashwie amɛ shi nɔŋŋ pɛ amɛbɔi malemɔ.

english_verse: Your words spread poison like the bite of a cobra
translation_verse: Ebɔɔ yɛ amɛmli tamɔ onufu, amɛtsimɔɔ amɛtoi tamɔ ble

english_verse: that refuses to listen to the snake charmer.
translation_verse: koni amɛkanu ŋkunyaayelɔ gbee loo ashwãifeelɔ tsɛmɔ.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce as lions, Lord God! Shatter their teeth. Snatch out their fangs.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, kuumɔ amɛdaaŋ nyanyɔji. Oo Yehowa, fãamɔ jata oblahii atsoji.

english_verse: Make them disappear like leaking water, and make their arrows miss.
translation_verse: Hã amɛlaaje tamɔ nu ni hoɔ kɛyaa, ni anaanaa amɛnɔ tamɔ jwɛi koni amɛgboi.

english_verse: Let them dry up like snails or be like a child that dies before seeing the sun.
translation_verse: Hã amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ waa mli nu kplãnaa; amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ bi ni ashrake ni enaaa hulu.

english_verse: Wipe them out quicker than a pot can be heated by setting thorns on fire.
translation_verse: Dani nyɛkukwɛi aaanu laitso dɔlɛ he lɛ, tso ŋmɔŋ jio, tso ni la efu he momo jio, Yehowa abɛɛ amɛ fɛɛ ashwie.

english_verse: Good people will be glad when they see the wicked getting what they deserve, and they will wash their feet in their enemies' blood.
translation_verse: Jalɔi aaanya be ni amɛaana oweletɔɔ lɛ; amɛaanyiɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji ala mli kɛho.

english_verse: Everyone will say, “It's true! Good people are rewarded. God does indeed rule the earth with justice.”
translation_verse: Mɛi aaakɛɛ akɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ nyɔmɔwoo ko yɛ hã jalɔ; lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ko yɛ ni kojoɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: Keep me safe from brutal people who want to kill me.
translation_verse: Heremɔ mi yɛ mihenyɛlɔi adɛŋ; heremɔ miyiwala yɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔi adɛŋ.

english_verse: Merciless enemies, Lord, are hiding and plotting, hoping to kill me. I have not hurt them in any way at all.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ naa, amɛwo ka yɛ mi mihewɔ; yiwalɔi ebua amɛhe naa amɛwo mi.

english_verse: But they are ready to attack. Do something! Help me! Look at what's happening.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, jeee esha ni mifee loo tɔ̃mɔ ko ni mitɔ̃ hewɔ ni amɛjoɔ foi kɛyaa amɛyafeɔ kralo amɛtoɔ mi. Wo ohe nɔ, baakwɛ ni oye obua mi.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you are the God of Israel. Punish the other nations and don't pity those terrible and rebellious people.
translation_verse: Yehowa, bo Nyɔŋmɔ Taiatsɛ, bo ji Israel Nyɔŋmɔ. Wo ohe nɔ koni ogbala maji fɛɛ atoi; kaana efɔŋfeelɔi kutumpɔfoi lɛ ekoeko kwraa mɔbɔ.

english_verse: My enemies return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Daa gbɛkɛ lɛ, amɛkuɔ amɛsɛɛ amɛbaa; amɛbolɔɔ tamɔ gbei, ni amɛnyiɛɔ tsoŋtsoŋ yɛ maŋ lɛŋ.

english_verse: They curse, and their words cut like swords, as they say to themselves, “No one can hear us!”
translation_verse: Amɛ amɛyɔɔ jɛi lɛ, amɛwieɔ amɛdaa obɔ̃. Amɛnaa jaraa tamɔ klante, ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Namɔ nuɔ nɔ ni wɔkɛɔ lɛ?”

english_verse: You, Lord, laugh at them and sneer at the nations.
translation_verse: Shi Oo, bo Yehowa, oŋmɔɔ amɛ; oyeɔ jeŋ maji fɛɛ ahe fɛo.

english_verse: You are my mighty fortress, and I depend on you.
translation_verse: Oo miHewalɛ, bo pɛ gbɛ mikwɛɔ. Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ejaakɛ bo ji mimɔɔ.

english_verse: You love me and will let me see my enemies defeated.
translation_verse: MiNyɔŋmɔ aaabakpee mi; kɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ; miNyɔŋmɔ aaahã mihiŋmɛi ana mihenyɛlɔi anɔ kunimyeli lɛ.

english_verse: Don't kill them, or everyone may forget! Just use your mighty power to make them tremble and fall. You are a shield for your people.
translation_verse: Ao Nuŋtsɔ, wɔtsɛ, kaagbe amɛ, no lɛ mimaŋ lɛ hiɛ aaakpa nɔ; shi moŋ gbɛɛ amɛ oshwã yɛ ohewalɛ naa, ni okɛ amɛ atswia shi.

english_verse: My enemies are liars! So let them be trapped by their boastful lies.
translation_verse: Esha wiemɔi ni jeɔ amɛnaa lɛ hewɔ lɛ, hã amɛhewoo lɛ afimɔ amɛ nɔŋŋ. Loomɔ kɛ amale wiemɔi ni amɛwieɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ,

english_verse: Get angry and destroy them. Leave them in ruin. Then all the nations will know that you rule in Israel.
translation_verse: okɛ mlifu akpãtã amɛhiɛ. Kpãtãmɔ amɛhiɛ kɛyaashi amɛyi aaatã, koni mɛi ni yɔɔ jeŋ naagbeehei fɛɛ ana ale akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni yeɔ Israel nɔ.

english_verse: Those liars return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Daa gbɛkɛ lɛ, amɛkuɔ amɛsɛɛ amɛbaa; amɛbolɔɔ tamɔ gbei, ni amɛnyiɛɔ tsoŋtsoŋ yɛ maŋ lɛŋ.

english_verse: They search for scraps of food, and they snarl until they are stuffed.
translation_verse: Amɛkpaa shi amɛtaoɔ niyenii, ni kɛ eshɛɛɛ amɛnaa lɛ, amɛhuuɔ kɛ mlifu.

english_verse: But I will sing about your strength, my God, and I will celebrate because of your love. You are my fortress, my place of protection in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, mala ohewalɛ lɛ he lala; leebi lɛ, mala osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ he lala; ejaakɛ otsɔ̃ mɔɔ ohã mi, ni otsɔ̃ abobaahe ohã mi, yɛ mifimɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: I will sing your praises! You are my mighty fortress, and you love me.
translation_verse: Oo, miHewalɛ, mala majie oyi, ejaakɛ, Oo, bo Nyɔŋmɔ, bo ji mimɔ̃ɔ. Bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ ni ojieɔ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kpo otsɔ̃ɔ mi.

english_verse: You, God, are angry with us! We are rejected and crushed. Make us strong again!
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, okwa wɔ, okumɔ wɔhe afabaŋ, omli efu wɔ. Kuu osɛɛ oba wɔŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: You made the earth shake and split wide open; now heal its wounds and stop its trembling.
translation_verse: Ohã shikpɔŋ lɛ ehoso, ni ohã emli egbala; tsaramɔ hei ni egbala lɛ, ejaakɛ ewɔtsɔ.

english_verse: You brought hard times on your people, and you gave us wine that made us stagger.
translation_verse: Ohã owebii lɛ ena nɔ naakpa. Wɔmiililaa shi tamɔ mɛi ni etɔ wain.

english_verse: You gave a signal to those who worship you, so they could escape from enemy arrows.
translation_verse: Oshi aflaŋaa akɛ okadi ohã mɛi ni sheɔ bo gbeyei lɛ, koni amɛje hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli kɛbaanyiɛ anɔkwale lɛ sɛɛ.

english_verse: Answer our prayers, God! Use your powerful arm and give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Okɛ ohewalɛ lɛ ahere wɔyiwala. Bo wɔ toi bɔ ni afee ni mɛi ni osumɔɔ lɛ ahere amɛyiwala.

english_verse: Our God, you solemnly promised, “I would gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ ejɛ ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mikɛ miishɛɛ baaja Shekem mli, ni majara Sukot Jɔɔ lɛ mahã mimaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is the symbol of my royal power.
translation_verse: Minɔ ji Gilead, ni minɔ ji Manase; Efraim ji miyitso dade fai; Yuda ji mimaŋtsɛ tsi.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin. Edom belongs to me, and I shout in triumph over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Moab ji mihejuu goga; majie mitokota mashwie Edom kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ mi, minɔ ni, ni mabɔ kunimyeli oshe mashwie Filistia nɔ.”

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress, or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Namɔ aaaŋɔ mi kɛaatee maŋ ni awaje lɛ lɛ mli? Namɔ aaanyiɛ mihiɛ kɛaaya Edom?

english_verse: Have you rejected us and deserted our armies?
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ani okwako wɔ? Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛ wɔta lɛ efãaa ta dɔŋŋ?

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Oo, ye obua wɔ koni wɔkɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ akpe; ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ adesã dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ jeee fɛifɛi.

english_verse: Please listen, God, and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, bo mibolɔmɔ toi, feemɔ toi ohã misɔlemɔ.

english_verse: I feel hopeless, and I cry out to you from a faraway land. Lead me to the mighty rock high above me.
translation_verse: Kɛ mitsui miisu lɛ, mabo matsɛ bo, kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehe. Wa mi kɛya tɛsaa ni kwɔ fe mi lɛ nɔ,

english_verse: You are a strong tower, where I am safe from my enemies.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ bo ji mibobaahe, mɔɔ ko ni wa fe henyɛlɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Let me live with you forever and find protection under your wings, my God.
translation_verse: Hã mahi obuu lɛŋ kɛya naanɔ, koni mafee shweshweeshwe yɛ ofiji ashishi hɔɔŋ lɛŋ.

english_verse: You heard my promises, and you have blessed me, just as you bless everyone who worships you.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ejaakɛ onu mishiwoi lɛ. Okɛ mɛi ni sheɔ bo gbeyei lɛ agbɛnaanii ehã mi.

english_verse: Let the king have a long and healthy life.
translation_verse: Hã maŋtsɛ lɛ wala sɛɛ atsɛ, ni ehi shi kɛya yinɔi fɛɛ!

english_verse: May he always rule with you, God, at his side; may your love and loyalty watch over him.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ, hã eye lumɔ yɛ ohiɛ kɛya naanɔ; ni okɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ anɔkwayeli lɛ abu ehe.

english_verse: I will sing your praises forever, God, and will always keep my promises.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ mala majie ogbɛi lɛ yi daa nɛɛ, be ni miyeɔ mishiwoi lɛ anɔ daa nɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Only God can save me, and I calmly wait for him.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ pɛ ji mɔ ni misusuma efee kpoo emɛɔ nɛɛ; lɛ edɛŋ miyiwalaheremɔ jɛɔ.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe and the fortress where I am secure.
translation_verse: Ekoome pɛ ji mitɛsaa kɛ miyiwalaheremɔ, mimɔɔ ni wa. Mididaŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: I feel like a shaky fence or a sagging wall. How long will all of you attack and assault me?
translation_verse: Mɛɛ beyinɔ po, nyɛ fɛɛ, nyɛaahao gbɔmɔ kome kɛyashi? Kɛyaashi mɛɛ be po, nyɛ fɛɛ, nyɛaatswia lɛ nii, mɔ ko ni tamɔ gbogbo loo afabaŋ ni ekpa kɛyaagbee shi lɛ?

english_verse: You want to bring me down from my place of honor. You love to tell lies, and when your words are kind, hatred hides in your heart.
translation_verse: Eyi nɔ ajina sɔŋŋ amɛyaa koni amɛkpa lɛ ni egbojee aŋmɛɛ lɛ. Amɛnyaa amale he; amɛkɛ amɛnaabu jɔɔ, shi amɛlomɔɔ yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ.

english_verse: Only God gives inward peace, and I depend on him.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ pɛ ji mɔ ni misusuma efee kpoo emɛɔ; ejaakɛ lɛ ji mihiɛnɔkãmɔ.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe, and he is the fortress where I feel secure.
translation_verse: Lɛ ekoome ji mitɛsaa kɛ miyiwalaheremɔ, mimɔɔ ni wa. Mididaŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: God saves me and honors me. He is that mighty rock where I find safety.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ miyiwalaheremɔ kɛ minunyam jɛɔ; mitɛsaa ni wa kɛ mibobaahe ji Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: Trust God, my friends, and always tell him each of your concerns. God is our place of safety.
translation_verse: Nyɛ maŋbii, nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ afɔ̃a Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ be fɛɛ be; nyɛfɔsea nyɛtsuiiaŋ saji fɛɛ nyɛshwiea ehiɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji wɔbobaahe.

english_verse: We humans are only a breath; none of us are truly great. All of us together weigh less than a puff of air.
translation_verse: Mɛi bibii fɛɛ tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ, mɛi wuji hu jeee fɛifɛi kɛji aŋmɛ amɛ yɛ nsɛni mli lɛ, amɛtsiii. Amɛ fɛɛ amɛtsiimɔ shɛɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko, amɛtamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ.

english_verse: Don't trust in violence or depend on dishonesty or rely on great wealth.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ akafɔ̃a amimyeli nɔ; nyɛyitsei hu akafũa yɛ juukɛfɔ̃ nibii agbɛfaŋ. Kɛji nii ni nyɛna miifa tete lɛ, nyɛkɛ nyɛtsuii akafɔ̃a nɔ.

english_verse: I heard God say two things: “I am powerful,
translation_verse: Minu ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekɛɛ fe shii abɔ akɛ Lɛ edɛŋ hewalɛ fɛɛ yɔɔ.

english_verse: and I am very kind.” The Lord rewards each of us according to what we do.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, bo oyɔɔ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee, ejaakɛ owoɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɔmɔ yɛ enitsumɔi anaa.

english_verse: You are my God. I worship you. In my heart, I long for you, as I would long for a stream in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ, miitao bo! Misusuma miiye ohe kumai, migbɔmɔtso miishwe bo, tamɔ shikpɔŋ ni egbi keketee shweɔ nu.

english_verse: I have seen your power and your glory in the place of worship.
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ mikwɛ bo gbɛ yɛ he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, koni mana ohewalɛ kɛ onunyam lɛ.

english_verse: Your love means more than life to me, and I praise you.
translation_verse: Osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee ni hi fe wala tete po hewɔ lɛ makafo bo.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will pray to you.
translation_verse: Bei abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, majie oyi; mahole miniji anɔ masɔle matsɛ bo.

english_verse: I will sing joyful praises and be filled with excitement like a guest at a banquet.
translation_verse: Misusumɔ aaaye wuiaŋ fɔ etɔ, ni minaabu aaala miishɛɛ lala kɛjie oyi.

english_verse: I think about you, God, before I go to sleep, and my thoughts turn to you during the night.
translation_verse: Kɛji mikai bo yɛ misaa nɔ lɛ, mijwɛŋɔ ohe nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ,

english_verse: You have helped me, and I sing happy songs in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ bo ji miyelikɛbualɔ daa, ni ofiji ashishi hɔ̃ɔŋ lɛŋ mala kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ.

english_verse: I stay close to you, and your powerful arm supports me.
translation_verse: Misusuma kpɛtɛ bo gbagbalii, ni oninejurɔ hiɛ mimli tswɛ.

english_verse: All who want to kill me will end up in the ground.
translation_verse: Shi mɛi ni taoɔ misusuma hiɛ amɛkpãtã lɛ, aaaya gbohiiaje bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛŋ.

english_verse: Swords will run them through, and wild dogs will eat them.
translation_verse: Amɛaanyɔnyɔi yɛ ta mli, ni amɛgbɔmɔtsei aaatsɔ̃mɔ ŋaŋgbei anaa loo.

english_verse: Because of you, our God, the king will celebrate with your faithful followers, but liars will be silent.
translation_verse: Shi maŋtsɛ lɛ aaanya yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hewɔ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni woɔ shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛi mli aaanya, ejaakɛ aaahã amalelɔi amua amɛnaa.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns, God, and protect me from my enemies' threats.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, bo migbee toi, yɛ mikɔmɔyeli lɛ mli. Gbeyei ni misheɔ henyɛlɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ baamɔ miwala yi.

english_verse: Keep me safe from secret plots of corrupt and evil gangs.
translation_verse: Ŋɔɔ mi otee yɛ ajina fɔŋ ni efɔŋfeelɔi yaa yɛ teemɔ mli lɛ hewɔ, yɛ nɔshafeelɔi ayiŋtoo fɔŋ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Their words cut like swords, and their cruel remarks sting like sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Amɛjɔ amɛlilɛii anaa tamɔ klante; amɛkɛ amɛdaaŋ wiemɔi ni joɔ gbulɔɔ mi tamɔ gãimlibii.

english_verse: They are determined to do evil, and they tell themselves, “Let's set traps! No one can see us.”
translation_verse: Amɛkpliŋ amɛtsuii yɛ yiŋtoo fɔŋ nɛɛ mli; amɛkpɛɔ mli koni amɛtsɔ̃tsɔ̃ɔ mɛi atsɔne yɛ teemɔ mli; ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Namɔ po aaana wɔ?”

english_verse: They make evil plans and say, “We'll commit a perfect crime. No one knows our thoughts.”
translation_verse: Namɔ aaanyɛ ajie nishaianii ni wɔfee wɔtee lɛ kpo? Wɔkɛ ŋaa kpɛ mli jogbaŋŋ. Ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ yitsoŋ kwɔ, ni etsui mli hu ewo duŋ.

english_verse: But God will shoot his arrows and quickly wound them.
translation_verse: Shi Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsɛ̃rɛ̃ amɛ gãi, ni eeepila amɛ trukaa.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by their own words, and everyone who sees them will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Ebaakpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ amɛlilɛi hewɔ; ni mɛi fɛɛ ni aaana amɛ lɛ aaahoso amɛyitso.

english_verse: They will be afraid and say, “Look at what God has done and keep it all in mind.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ kwa aaashe gbeyei, ni amɛaagba nii ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsu lɛ; ni amɛaasusu enifeemɔnii lɛ he.

english_verse: May the Lord bless his people with peace and happiness and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Hã jalɔi lɛ anya yɛ Yehowa hewɔ, ni amɛba lɛ abo! Hã mɛi fɛɛ ni atsuiiaŋ tse lɛ anya.

english_verse: Our God, you deserve praise in Zion, where we keep our promises to you.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, esa akɛ ajieɔ oyi yɛ Zion; ni bo abaaye shiwoi anɔ ahã!

english_verse: Everyone will come to you because you answer prayer.
translation_verse: Oo, bo ni oboɔ sɔlemɔ toi, bo oŋɔɔ adesai fɛɛ baa.

english_verse: When our sins get us down, you forgive us.
translation_verse: Kɛji wɔnishaianii miipiŋ wɔ lɛ, bo okɛfaa wɔ.

english_verse: You bless your chosen ones, and you invite them to live near you in your temple. We will enjoy your house, the sacred temple.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ mɔ ni ohala ni ohãa ebɛŋkɛɔ bo, koni ehi ohe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ lɛ. Wɔɔtɔrɔ kɛ owe lɛŋ nibii kpakpai lɛ, ni ji oSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ nibii lɛ.

english_verse: Our God, you save us, and your fearsome deeds answer our prayers for justice! You give hope to people everywhere on earth, even those across the sea.
translation_verse: Oo wɔyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, otsɔ̃ɔ onifeemɔ nii ni yɔɔ gbeyei anɔ ohereɔ wɔyiwala! Bo ji shikpɔŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi kɛ ŋshɔ sɛɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ahiɛnɔkãmɔ.

english_verse: You are strong, and your mighty power put the mountains in place.
translation_verse: Bo mɔ ni ojɛ ohewalɛ kpele lɛ mli obɔ gɔji lɛ, ohã amɛmamɔ shi shiŋŋ kɛ hewalɛ.

english_verse: You silence the roaring waves and the noisy shouts of the nations.
translation_verse: Bo ji mɔ ni ojɔɔ ŋshɔhũumɔ he, kɛ ŋshɔkei ahũumɔ he, ni ojɔɔ adesai ahoofeemɔ hu he.

english_verse: People far away marvel at your fearsome deeds, and all who live under the sun celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei shɔŋŋshɔŋŋ lɛ sheɔ naakpɛɛ nii ni ofeɔ lɛ gbeyei. Onifeemɔnii lɛ hãa anyaa yɛ jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: You take care of the earth and send rain to help the soil grow all kinds of crops. Your rivers never run dry, and you prepare the earth to produce abundant grain.
translation_verse: Ohãa nu nɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni okɛtsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni odɔɔ ehe ohãa, ni ebaa nii babaoo. Nyɔŋmɔ faa lɛ eyi tɔ kɛ nu. Ohãa abele baa hãa gbɔmɛi, ejaakɛ nakai ji bɔ ni oto.

english_verse: You water all its fields and level the lumpy ground. You send showers of rain to soften the soil and help the plants sprout.
translation_verse: Oshwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akofii lɛ anɔ nu babaoo, ni ohãa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ su kukulii lɛ kpɔtɔɔ. Ohãa nu nɛɔ shwieɔ nɔ, ni emli jɔɔ, ni ebaa nii.

english_verse: Wherever your footsteps touch the earth, a rich harvest is gathered.
translation_verse: Omlihilɛ hãa afi lɛ yiɔ obɔ kɛ niyenii babaoo. He fɛɛ he ni oootsɔ̃ kɛho lɛ, niyenii babaoo baa jɛi.

english_verse: Desert pastures blossom, and mountains celebrate.
translation_verse: Ŋa nɔ jwɛi fũɔ babaoo, ni gɔji lɛ nyaa kɛ miishɛɛ.

english_verse: Meadows are filled with sheep and goats; valleys overflow with grain and echo with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Ŋa nɔ jwɛi fɔ lɛ ewula kɛ too kui ni jɔi lɛ hu ewula kɛ abele; amɛmiibɔ oshe, ni amɛmiila kɛ miishɛɛ.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to shout praises to God!
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ nyamɔ abɔa oshe nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ, nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ!

english_verse: Sing about his glorious name. Honor him with praises.
translation_verse: Nyɛlaa kɛkafoa enunyam gbɛi lɛ; nyɛkɛ yijiemɔ ni sa lɛ lɛ awoa ehiɛ nyam.

english_verse: Say to God, “Everything you do is fearsome, and your mighty power makes your enemies come crawling.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛa Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “Onitsumɔi lɛ yɛ gbeyei pam! Ohewalɛ lɛ dalɛ naa sɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ, ohenyɛlɔi kotoɔ bo kɛ gbeyeishemɔ.

english_verse: You are worshiped by everyone! We all sing praises to you.”
translation_verse: Hã je lɛŋ bii fɛɛ kwa aja bo, amɛla kɛjie oyi, amɛla kɛkafo ogbɛi lɛ.”

english_verse: Come and see the fearsome things our God has done!
translation_verse: Nyɛbaa nyɛbakwɛa nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsu, naakpɛɛnii ni etsu yɛ gbɔmɛi abii ateŋ!

english_verse: When God made the sea dry up, our people walked across, and because of him, we celebrated there.
translation_verse: Ehã ŋshɔ tsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ, ni wɔblema tsɛmɛi lɛ nyiɛ nɔ kɛfo ŋshɔ lɛ. Jɛi wɔnya yɛ, yɛ nɔ ni efee lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: His mighty power rules forever, and nothing the nations do can be hidden from him. So don't turn against God.
translation_verse: Eeye maŋtsɛ kɛ hewalɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ, ni ehiŋmɛii kã majimaji fɛɛ ahe. Atuatselɔi akawo amɛhe nɔ!

english_verse: All of you people, come praise our God! Let his praises be heard.
translation_verse: Nyɛ majimaji fɛɛ, nyɛjiea wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi! Nyɛhãa anua eyijiemɔ gbɛɛmɔ he.

english_verse: God protects us from death and keeps us steady.
translation_verse: Lɛ ehã wɔhiɛ kã nɛɛ, ni eŋmɛko gbɛ ni wɔshane tete.

english_verse: Our God, you tested us, just as silver is tested.
translation_verse: Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, oka wɔ okwɛ; bɔ ni akaa jwiɛtɛi akwɛɔ lɛ nakai oka wɔ okwɛ.

english_verse: You trapped us in a net and gave us heavy burdens.
translation_verse: Ohã wɔyadu yaa, ni okɛ jatsui ni tsiitsii tere wɔ.

english_verse: You sent war chariots to crush our skulls. We traveled through fire and through floods, but you brought us to a land of plenty.
translation_verse: Ohã wɔhenyɛlɔi naanaa wɔnɔ; wɔtsɔ̃mɔ la kɛ fai amli, shi ojie wɔ kɛba he ni wɔfee shweshweeshwe yɛ.

english_verse: I will bring sacrifices into your house, my God, and I will do what I promised
translation_verse: Mikɛ shãa afɔlei aaaba owe lɛ; mibaye mishiwoi anɔ mahã bo!

english_verse: I will sacrifice my best sheep and offer bulls and goats on your altar.
translation_verse: Mikɛ gwantɛŋi ni ewo fɔ aaashã shãa afɔle; ni ojwɛnii ni akɛshãa afɔle lɛ alasu lɛ aaakwɔ kɛya ŋwɛi. Mikɛ tsina hii kɛ abotiai hu aaashã afɔle.

english_verse: All who worship God, come here and listen; I will tell you everything God has done for me.
translation_verse: Nyɛbaa, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni magba nyɛ nɔ ni efee ehã mi!

english_verse: I prayed to the Lord, and I praised him.
translation_verse: Mibo waa mitsɛ lɛ, mikafo lɛ kɛ mililɛi!

english_verse: If my thoughts had been sinful, he would have refused to hear me.
translation_verse: Eji minya nɔ sha ko he yɛ mitsuiŋ kulɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ boŋ mi toi.

english_verse: But God did listen and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Shi anɔkwa, Nyɔŋmɔ ebo mi toi, efee toi ehã misɔlemɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Let's praise God! He listened when I prayed, and he is always kind.
translation_verse: Yijiemɔ ahã Nyɔŋmɔ, ejaakɛ etswaaa misɔlemɔ lɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ, ni ehãaa esuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ abɔ mi.

english_verse: Our God, be kind and bless us! Be pleased and smile.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ ana wɔ mɔbɔ, ni ejɔɔ wɔ, ni efee wɔ ejurɔ

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will learn to follow you, and all nations will see your power to save us.
translation_verse: koni je lɛ fɛɛ ale osuɔmɔnaanii koni majimaji fɛɛ ale oyiwalaheremɔ hewalɛ lɛ!

english_verse: Make everyone praise you and shout your praises.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, hã gbɔmɛi adesai fɛɛ ajie oyi; hã adesai fɛɛ kwa ajie oyi!

english_verse: Let the nations celebrate with joyful songs, because you judge fairly and guide all nations.
translation_verse: Hã majimaji lɛ amii ashɛ amɛhe, koni amɛla kɛ miishɛɛ; ejaakɛ okojoɔ majimaji lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa, ni otsɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ majimaji lɛ agbɛ.

english_verse: Make everyone praise you, God, and shout your praises.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, hã adesãi ajie oyi, hã adesãi fɛɛ kwa ajie oyi!

english_verse: Our God has blessed the earth with a wonderful harvest!
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ lɛ eba enii. Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ajɔɔ wɔ!

english_verse: Pray for his blessings to continue and for everyone on earth to worship our God.
translation_verse: Naa Nyɔŋmɔ aya nɔ ajɔɔ wɔ! Hã adesãi ni yɔɔ je lɛŋ hei fɛɛ awo lɛ.

english_verse: Do something, God! Scatter your hateful enemies. Make them turn and run.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ woɔ ehe nɔ, ni egbɛɔ ehenyɛlɔi eshwãa. Mɛi ni nyɛɔ lɛ lɛ joɔ enaa foi.

english_verse: Scatter them like smoke! When you come near, make them melt like wax in a fire.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni ahuuɔ lasu kɛyaa lɛ, nakai ehuuɔ amɛ kɛyaa; bɔ ni wo agbaku sereɔ yɛ la he lɛ, nakai mɛi fɔ̃ji ahiɛ kpãtãa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.

english_verse: But let your people be happy and celebrate because of you.
translation_verse: Shi jalɔi lɛ nyaa, ni amɛlaa kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; amɛmli filiɔ amɛ kɛ nyamɔ!

english_verse: Our God, you are the one who rides on the clouds, and we praise you. Your name is the Lord, and we celebrate as we worship you.
translation_verse: Nyɛlaa nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ, nyɛlaa nyɛkɛjiea egbɛi lɛ yi. Nyɛjea gbɛ nyɛhãa mɔ ni ta shwiili mli kɛbaa yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ. Egbɛi ji Yehowa; nyɛnyãa yɛ ehiɛ!

english_verse: Our God, from your sacred home you take care of orphans and protect widows.
translation_verse: Awusaiatsɛ kɛ okulafoi ahebulɔ ji Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni yɔɔ eshihilɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You find families for those who are lonely. You set prisoners free and let them prosper, but all who rebel will live in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ hãa mɔ kome mɔ lɛ shihilɛhe. Ekpalaa gboklɛfoi, ni ehãa amɛyeɔ ejurɔ; shi atuatselɔi lɛ, shikpɔŋ gbiŋ keketee nɔ amɛhiɔ.

english_verse: You set your people free, and you led them through the desert.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, be ni onyiɛ owebii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, be ni otsɔ̃ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: God of Israel, the earth trembled, and rain poured down. You alone are the God who rules from Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: shikpɔŋ lɛ hoso, ni ŋwɛi nɛ nu shwie shi, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, yɛ bo Sinai Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ. Shikpɔŋ lɛ hoso yɛ bo, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ohiɛ.

english_verse: When your land was thirsty, you sent showers to refresh it.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ohã nu babaoo nɛ, ni okɛtsĩɛ shikpɔŋ ni egbo lɛ hiɛ ohã owebii ni etɔ biti lɛ.

english_verse: Your people settled there, and you were generous to everyone in need.
translation_verse: Owebii lɛ na shihilɛhe yɛ jɛi. Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, omlihilɛ naa lɛ, osaa nibii kpakpai ohã mɛi ni ehĩa amɛ.

english_verse: You gave the command, Lord, and a chorus of women told what had happened:
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fã, ni yei babaoo diɛŋtsɛ gbɛ kunimyeli wiemɔ lɛ shwã.

english_verse: “Kings and their armies retreated and ran, and everything they left is now being divided.
translation_verse: “Naa, tai lɛ anɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ejo foi, amɛjwa saŋ!” Yei ni ashi yɛ shĩaŋ lɛ, ja haanii lɛ;

english_verse: And for those who stayed back to guard the sheep, there are metal doves with silver-coated wings and shiny gold feathers.”
translation_verse: tsɛbelɛ too kui lɛ anɔ amɛkwɛ. Nibii ni amɛha lɛ ji okpo fiji ni ashwie he jwiɛtɛi, kɛ etsɛji ni akɛ shika fɛɛfɛo eha he.

english_verse: God All-Powerful, you scattered the kings like snow falling on Mount Zalmon.
translation_verse: Be ni Ofe lɛ gbɛ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ shwã yɛ Zalmon Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, snoo nɛ jɛi.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, Bashan is a mighty mountain covered with peaks.
translation_verse: Oo Bashan Gɔŋ kpeteŋkple! Gɔŋ kɛ onɔ gɔŋkpɔi gojogojoo.

english_verse: Why is it jealous of Zion, the mountain you chose as your home forever?
translation_verse: Mɛɛba ojɛɔ ogɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ okɛ hiŋmɛitsuu kwɛɔ gɔŋ lɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ akɛ ehi jɛi lɛ? Yehowa baahi jɛi kɛya naanɔ.

english_verse: When you, Lord God, appeared to your people at Sinai, you came with thousands of mighty chariots.
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jɛ Sinai eba He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ kɛ tayaa shwiilii wuji akpe toi akpei abɔ.

english_verse: When you climbed the high mountain, you took prisoners with you and were given gifts. Your enemies didn't want you to live there, but they gave you gifts.
translation_verse: Okwɔ kɛtee gɔŋ grɔŋŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛ nomii ni nyiɛ osɛɛ, ohe nikee kɛjɛ mɛi, mɛi tete ni te shi wo bo lɛ adɛŋ, Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baahi jɛi.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God! You treat us with kindness day after day, and you rescue us.
translation_verse: Ajie Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yi, mɔ ni hiɛ wɔmli daa lɛ; Nyɔŋmɔ ji wɔyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, your terrible enemies are ready for war, but you will crush their skulls.
translation_verse: Shi Nyɔŋmɔ aaajwara ehenyɛlɔi lɛ ayitsei, mɛi ni baa jeŋ fɔŋ ni amɛto amɛyi kusukusuu lɛ.

english_verse: You promised to bring them from Bashan and from the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Mibakpala amɛ kɛaajɛ Bashan kɛba ekoŋŋ; mibakpala amɛ kɛaajɛ ŋshɔ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ shishi kɛba ekoŋŋ,

english_verse: Then we could wash our feet in their blood, and our dogs could chew on their bones.
translation_verse: bɔ ni afee ni nyɛkɛ amɛlá afɔ nyɛnaji ahe, koni nyɛgbei ana henyɛlɔi lɛ alá amɛlɛmɔ.”

english_verse: We have seen crowds marching to your place of worship, our God and King.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, anaa oyaakɛbaa kpoo lɛ, MiNyɔŋmɔ, miMaŋtsɛ lɛ, nyiɛmɔ kɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yaa lɛ, anaa.

english_verse: Singers come first, and then the musicians, surrounded by young women playing tambourines.
translation_verse: Lalɔi lɛ nyiɛ hiɛ, saŋkutswalɔi lɛ nyiɛ sɛɛ, ni oblayei ni shaa fabii lɛ nyiɛ teŋ.

english_verse: They come shouting, “People of Israel, praise the Lord God!”
translation_verse: Ajie Nyɔŋmɔ yi yɛ asafo kpele lɛ mli. Oo, nyɛ Yakob shwiei, nyɛjiea Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yi.

english_verse: The small tribe of Benjamin leads the way, followed by the leaders from Judah. Then come the leaders from Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Benyamin, amɛteŋ gbekɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ, nyiɛ hiɛ; kɛkɛ lɛ Yuda lumɛi lɛ kɛ amɛsafoi lɛ; ni Zebulon lumɛi lɛ kɛ Naftali lumɛi lɛ nyiɛ sɛɛ.

english_verse: Our God, show your strength! Show us once again.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ohewalɛ lɛ, hewalɛ ni okɛtsu nii ohã wɔ pɛŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then kings will bring gifts to your temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: OSɔlemɔ we ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ hewɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi tereɔ nikeenii amɛkɛbahãa bo.

english_verse: Punish that animal that lives in the swamp! Punish that nation whose leaders and people are like wild bulls. Make them come crawling with gifts of silver. Scatter those nations that enjoy making war.
translation_verse: Kã Ijipt hiɛ; nakai ŋaŋ kooloo ni hɔ glãi lɛ amli lɛ. Kã majimaji lɛ ni lɛɔ tsina hii kɛ tsinabii lɛ kɛyashi amɛ fɛɛ amɛaakoto bo, ni amɛkɛ amɛjwiɛtɛi aaahã bo. Gbɛɛ majimaji lɛ ni sumɔɔ ta lɛ oshwã.

english_verse: Force the Egyptians to bring gifts of bronze; make the Ethiopians hurry to offer presents.
translation_verse: Hã lumɛi kɛ akɔɔble ajɛ Ijipt aba; ni Kushbii ahe afee oya ni amɛhole amɛniji anɔ ni amɛja Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: Now sing praises to God! Every kingdom on earth, sing to the Lord!
translation_verse: Oo, nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛyelii, nyɛlaa nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ! Nyɛlaa nyɛjiea Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yi,

english_verse: Praise the one who rides across the ancient skies; listen as he speaks with a mighty voice.
translation_verse: mɔ ni taa okpɔŋɔ nɔ kɛnyiɛɔ ŋwɛi amli ŋwɛi lɛ. Nyɛboa toi, ewoɔ egbee, egbee ni wa lɛ.

english_verse: Tell about God's power! He is honored in Israel, and he rules the skies.
translation_verse: Nyɛshiɛa Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ lɛ, mɔ ni egbojee teke Israel agbojee, ni ehewalɛ lɛ yɔɔ atatui lɛ amli lɛ!

english_verse: The God of Israel is fearsome in his temple, and he makes us strong. Let's praise our God!
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ he yɛ gbeyei kɛji eeba kɛjɛ ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ ehãa ewebii ahewalɛ ni ewoɔ amɛ ekãa. Ajie Nyɔŋmɔ yi!

english_verse: Save me, God! I am about to drown.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, heremɔ miyiwala, shi nu lɛ ebata misɛ̃!

english_verse: I am sinking deep in the mud, and my feet are slipping. I am about to be swept under by a mighty flood.
translation_verse: Miishiu yɛ ŋmiamɔ ni mli kwɔ ni shidaamɔhe bɛ mli mli. Miyaje nu kwɔŋkwɔŋ mli, ni nu lɛ miisu mi.

english_verse: I am worn out from crying, and my throat is dry. I have waited for you till my eyes are blurred.
translation_verse: Etɔ mi kɛ blɔmɔ, ni misɛŋ egbi. Mikwɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛ aahu; agbɛnɛ mihiŋmɛii eshiu.

english_verse: There are more people who hate me for no reason than there are hairs on my head. Many terrible enemies want to destroy me, God. Am I supposed to give back something I didn't steal?
translation_verse: Mɛi ni he tsɛ̃ɔ mi yakatswaa lɛ, amɛyi fa fe miyiteŋ tsɔi; mihenyɛlɔi ni maleɔ mihe, mɛi ni taoɔ mihiɛ amɛkpãtã lɛ amɛyi fa. Nɔ ni mijuko lɛ aso esa akɛ mato najiaŋ lo?

english_verse: You know my foolish sins. Not one is hidden from you.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ole mikwashiafeemɔ; tɔ̃mɔi ni mitɔ̃ lɛ, akɛteko bo.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, ruler of Israel, don't let me embarrass anyone who trusts and worships you.
translation_verse: Oo Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ, kaahã mɛi ni hiɛ kã onɔ lɛ ahiɛ miigboi yɛ mi, mihewɔ. Oo Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, kaahã mɛi ni jaa bo lɛ ahiɛ miishwie shi yɛ mi mihewɔ.

english_verse: It is for your sake alone that I am insulted and blush with shame.
translation_verse: Bo ohewɔ ni abɔ mi ahora, ni mihiɛ egbo kpɔtɔɔ nɛɛ.

english_verse: I am like a stranger to my relatives and like a foreigner to my own family.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ̃ gbɔ mihã miwekumɛi, kɛ mɔkpɔŋ yɛ minyɛbii ateŋ,

english_verse: My love for your house burns in me like a fire, and when others insult you, they insulted me as well.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ owe lɛ he hiɛdɔɔ tsoɔ yɛ mimli tamɔ la; ni ahorai ni mɛi bɔɔ bo lɛ ebashwie minɔ.

english_verse: I cried and went without food, but they still insulted me.
translation_verse: Kɛji mifo, ni mikɛ ŋmaahilɛ piŋ misusuma po, no hu tsɔ̃ɔ ahorabɔɔ hãa mi.

english_verse: They sneered at me for wearing sackcloth to show my sorrow.
translation_verse: Kɛji mibu kpekpe po, amɛboɔ mi “tsia!”

english_verse: Rulers and judges gossip about me, and drunkards make up songs to mock me.
translation_verse: Nɔyelɔi kɛ kojolɔi yɛ koishi, tãa mihe sane ni dãatɔlɔi tete foɔ mihe lala.

english_verse: But I pray to you, Lord. So when the time is right, answer me and help me with your wonderful love.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, shi mi lɛ, masɔle matsɛ bo. Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, be ni sa mli lɛ, jɛɛ osuɔmɔ kpeteŋkple ni tsakeee lɛ naa ohã mi hetoo. Yɛ onɔkwayeli naa lɛ

english_verse: Don't let me sink in the mud, but save me from my enemies and from the deep water.
translation_verse: heremɔ mi koni mikashiu yɛ ŋmiamɔ lɛ mli. Heremɔ mi yɛ mihenyɛlɔi adɛŋ, kɛjɛ nu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ hu mli.

english_verse: Don't let me be swept away by a flood or drowned in the ocean or swallowed by death.
translation_verse: Kaahã nu lɛ miisu mi, kaahã mishiu yɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛŋ, loo gbonyobu miimi mi.

english_verse: Answer me, Lord! You are kind and good. Pay attention to me! You are truly merciful.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, heremɔ mi nɔ, yɛ osuɔmɔ kpakpa ni tsakeee lɛ naa. Omɔbɔnalɛ ni fa babaoo lɛ naa lɛ, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ ohã mi.

english_verse: Don't turn away from me. I am your servant, and I am in trouble. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Okɛ ohiɛ akatee otsulɔ, ejaakɛ miyɛ jaramɔ mli, heremɔ mi nɔ mra.

english_verse: Come and save me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Tsi obɛŋkɛ mi ni okpɔ̃ mi; mihenyɛlɔi ahewɔ lɛ, heremɔ mi.

english_verse: You know how I am insulted, mocked, and disgraced; you know every one of my enemies.
translation_verse: Ole ahora ni abɔɔ mi, mihiɛgbele kɛ mihe guɔ ni egbo lɛ. Ole mihenyɛlɔi fɛɛ.

english_verse: I am crushed by insults, and I feel sick. I had hoped for mercy and pity, but there was none.
translation_verse: Ahorabɔɔ ehã mitsui ekumɔ, ni ehã miyoyoro. Mikwɛ mɔbɔnalɛ gbɛ, shi eko baaa; mikwɛ miishɛjelɔi hu gbɛ, shi mɔ ko mɔ ko baaa.

english_verse: Enemies poisoned my food, and when I was thirsty, they gave me vinegar.
translation_verse: Amɛhãa mi ebɔɔ akɛ niyenii, ni be ni kumai ye mi lɛ amɛhã mi ashiŋ akɛ minu.

english_verse: Make their table a trap for them and their friends.
translation_verse: Hã okplɔ̃ ni amɛŋmɛ lɛ atsɔ̃ tsɔne ahã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ, ni amɛgbiijuji anɔ niyenii lɛ atsɔ̃ akpa ahã amɛ.

english_verse: Blind them with darkness and make them tremble.
translation_verse: Hã amɛhiŋmɛii anɔ afee kusuu koni amɛkana nii; ni ohã amɛhɛ agbɔjɔ be fɛɛ be.

english_verse: Show them how angry you are! Be furious and catch them.
translation_verse: Fɔsemɔ omlila lɛ oshwie amɛnɔ, ni okɛ omlifu ni naa wa lɛ anina amɛ.

english_verse: Destroy their camp and don't let anyone live in their tents.
translation_verse: Amɛshitoohe atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kaahã mɔ ko miihi amɛbui amli.

english_verse: They cause trouble for people you have already punished; their gossip hurts those you have wounded.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ amɛwaa mɔ ni otswia lɛ nii momo lɛ yi; ni mɔ ni opila lɛ momo lɛ, amɛyaa nɔ amɛpiŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Make them guiltier than ever and don't forgive them.
translation_verse: Too amɛtoigbalamɔ lɛ nɔ ohã amɛ; amɛkaye amɛhe kɔkɔɔkɔ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ!

english_verse: Wipe their names from the book of the living; remove them from the list of the innocent.
translation_verse: Hã agbe amɛgbɛii yɛ wala wolo lɛ mli; akaŋmala amɛgbɛii ashi jalɔi anɔ nɔ.

english_verse: I am mistreated and in pain. Protect me, God, and keep me safe!
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, apila mi, ni miipiŋ. Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, wo minɔ koni ohere miyiwala.

english_verse: I will praise the Lord God with a song and a thankful heart.
translation_verse: Mikɛ lala aaajie Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛi lɛ yi! Mikɛ shidaa aaakafo lɛ!

english_verse: This will please the Lord better than offering an ox or a full-grown bull.
translation_verse: Enɛ aaasa Yehowa hiɛ pam fe tsina oblayoo, loo tsinanuu kɛ eklontoi.

english_verse: When those in need see this, they will be happy, and the Lord's worshipers will be encouraged.
translation_verse: Hã mɛi ni awaa amɛ yi lɛ ana koni amɛmii ashɛ. Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtaoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ, nyɛhãa nyɛtsui anyɔa nyɛ mli;

english_verse: The Lord will listen when the homeless cry out, and he will never forget his people in prison.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Yehowa boɔ ohiafoi atoi, ni enyaŋeee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi ni yɔɔ gboklɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: Heaven and earth will praise our God, and so will the oceans and everything in them.
translation_verse: Hã ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔi kɛ bɔɔnii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ ajie eyi.

english_verse: God will rescue Jerusalem, and he will rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there on their own land,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ baahere Zion yiwala, ni eeesaa Yuda maji wuji lɛ ema; etsuji lɛ aaahi amɛmli, ni eeetsɔ̃ amɛnɔ.

english_verse: and when the time comes, their children will inherit the land. Then everyone who loves God will also settle there.
translation_verse: Maji lɛ aaatsɔ̃ etsuji lɛ ashwiei anɔ, ni mɛi ni sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ aaahi amɛmli.

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ofainɛ heremɔ miyiwala! Oo Yehowa, ye obua mi nɔŋŋ!

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Hã mɛi ni taoɔ mi agbe lɛ ahiɛ agboi, ni amɛhiɛ ashwie shi. Mɛi ni taoɔ mi efɔŋ lɛ, hã ashwie amɛ koni amɛhe guɔ agbo.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Hã mɛi ni kɛɔ akɛ, “Yiɛ, Yiɛ!” lɛ aku amɛsɛɛ kɛ hiɛgbele.

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Hã mɛi fɛɛ ni taoɔ osɛɛgbɛ lɛ anya; ni amɛmli afili amɛ yɛ ohewɔ. Hã mɛi fɛɛ ni sumɔɔ oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ akɛɛ daa akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ je agbo.”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, minii yɛ mɔbɔ, ni efĩ mi. Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ba miŋɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ. Bo ji mibualɔ kɛ miherelɔ! Oo Yehowa, kaatsɛ kwraa!

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ofainɛ heremɔ miyiwala! Oo Yehowa, ye obua mi nɔŋŋ!

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Hã mɛi ni taoɔ mi agbe lɛ ahiɛ agboi, ni amɛhiɛ ashwie shi. Mɛi ni taoɔ mi efɔŋ lɛ, hã ashwie amɛ koni amɛhe guɔ agbo.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Hã mɛi ni kɛɔ akɛ, “Yiɛ, Yiɛ!” lɛ aku amɛsɛɛ kɛ hiɛgbele.

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Hã mɛi fɛɛ ni taoɔ osɛɛgbɛ lɛ anya; ni amɛmli afili amɛ yɛ ohewɔ. Hã mɛi fɛɛ ni sumɔɔ oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ akɛɛ daa akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ je agbo.”
