english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, minii yɛ mɔbɔ, ni efĩ mi. Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ba miŋɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ. Bo ji mibualɔ kɛ miherelɔ! Oo Yehowa, kaatsɛ kwraa!

english_verse: I run to you, Lord, for protection. Don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, bo abo mibaa; kaahã mihiɛ miigbo gbi ko gbi ko!

english_verse: You do what is right, so come to my rescue. Listen to my prayer and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Akɛni jalɔ ji bo hewɔ lɛ, ye obua mi koni ohere mi. Ba otoi shi ohã mi ni ohere miyiwala.

english_verse: Be my mighty rock, the place where I can always run for protection. Save me by your command! You are my mighty rock and my fortress.
translation_verse: Tsɔ̃ abobaa tɛkplo ohã mi, kɛ mɔɔ ni wa ni okɛhere miyiwala, ejaakɛ mitɛsaa kɛ mimɔ̃ɔ ji bo!

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God, from vicious and cruel and brutal enemies!
translation_verse: Oo miNyɔŋmɔ, heremɔ mi yɛ yiwalɔ lɛ dɛŋ, yɛ nɔshafeelɔ lɛ kɛ yitsoŋwalɔ lɛ dɛŋ.

english_verse: I depend on you, and I have trusted you since I was young.
translation_verse: Oo Nuŋtsɔ, ejaakɛ bo ji mihiɛnɔkãmɔ. Oo Yehowa, bo onɔ mikɛ mihiɛ efɔ̃ kɛjɛ miblahiaŋ.

english_verse: I have relied on you from the day I was born. You brought me safely through birth, and I always praise you.
translation_verse: Bo mikpasa kɛjɛ fɔmɔ mli. Bo nɔŋŋ obu mihe be mli ni afɔɔ mi. Bo oyi majie daa.

english_verse: Many people think of me as something evil. But you are my mighty protector,
translation_verse: Mitsɔ̃ naakpɛɛ nɔ ko mihã mɛi pii; ejaakɛ bo ji mibobaahe ni yɔɔ shweshweeshwe.

english_verse: and I praise and honor you all day long.
translation_verse: Midaa eyi obɔ̃ kɛ oyijiemɔ gbi muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni majaje onunyam lɛ.

english_verse: Don't throw me aside when I am old; don't desert me when my strength is gone.
translation_verse: Kaashɛ mi ofɔ̃ yɛ migbɔlɛ beiaŋ; kaakwa mi be ni migbɔjɔɔ,

english_verse: My enemies are plotting because they want me dead.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ wie mihe; mɛi ni taoɔ mi agbe lɛ yaa miyinɔ apam,

english_verse: They say, “Now we'll catch you! God has deserted you, and no one can save you.”
translation_verse: ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ ekwa lɛ; nyɛtiua lɛ, ni nyɛmɔa lɛ, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni aaahere lɛ.”

english_verse: Come closer, God! Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛ mi teŋ akajekɛ! Oo miNyɔŋmɔ, heremɔ mi nɔŋŋ!

english_verse: Embarrass and destroy all who want me dead; disgrace and confuse all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Hã mɛi ni foɔ sane fɔ̃ɔ minɔ lɛ ahiɛ agboi, ni amɛhiɛ akpãtã. Mɛi ni taoɔ mi efɔŋ lɛ, hã amɛhiɛ ashwie shi, ni amɛhe guɔ agbo;

english_verse: I will never give up hope or stop praising you.
translation_verse: kɛ̃lɛ mi lɛ, mihiɛ aaakã onɔ daa, ni majie oyi kɛteke nɔ.

english_verse: All day long I will tell the wonderful things you do to save your people. But you have done much more than I could possibly know.
translation_verse: Minaabu aaagba jalɛ nibii ni ofeɔ lɛ, kɛ oyiwalaheremɔ nifeemɔi lɛ gbi muu fɛɛ; tsɛbelɛ mijwɛŋmɔ kpleee he.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord God, for your mighty deeds and your power to save.
translation_verse: Maba mabagba naakpɛɛnii wuji ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ efee lɛ; mibakafo bo okoome too ojalɛ lɛ.

english_verse: You have taught me since I was a child, and I never stop telling about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, otsɔ̃ɔ mi nii kɛjɛ miblahiaŋ; ni miijaje onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ lolo.

english_verse: Don't leave me when I am old and my hair turns gray. Let me tell future generations about your mighty power.
translation_verse: Belɛ migbɔlɛ kɛ miwaŋjee nɛɛ mli lɛ, Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, kaakwa mi, kɛyaashi majaje ohewalɛ lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ yinɔbii ni baa lɛ.

english_verse: Your deeds of kindness are known in the heavens. No one is like you!
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ojalɛ kɛ ohewalɛ lɛ kwɔ kɛshɛɔ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi. Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, bo ofee nibii wuji osaso bɛ.

english_verse: You made me suffer a lot, but you will bring me back from this deep pit and give me new life.
translation_verse: Bo mɔ ni ohã mina amanehului babaoo ni jaraa lɛ, bo nɔŋŋ ooowo mi hewalɛ ekoŋŋ. Ooojie mi kɛje gbonyo bu mli, ni okɛ mi aaaba kpo nɔ ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: You will make me truly great and take my sorrow away.
translation_verse: Ooohã minunyam afa, ni oooshɛje mimii ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: I will praise you, God, the Holy One of Israel. You are faithful. I will play the harp and sing your praises.
translation_verse: Oo miNyɔŋmɔ, matswa saŋku hu mikɛjie oyi yɛ onɔkwayeli hewɔ. Oo Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ matswa obenta mikɛkafo bo.

english_verse: You have rescued me! I will celebrate and shout, singing praises to you with all my heart.
translation_verse: Be ni milaa mijieɔ oyi lɛ minaabu kɛ misusuma ni okpɔ̃ lɛ, aaanya babaoo.

english_verse: All day long I will announce your power to save. I will tell how you disgraced and disappointed those who wanted to hurt me.
translation_verse: Gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ, mililɛi aaagba ojalɛ, mɔyelikɛbuamɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi ni ka mi efɔŋ feemɔ lɛ, awo amɛ hiɛgbele, ni amɛhiɛ eshwie shi.

english_verse: Please help the king to be honest and fair just like you, our God.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ, koni ekɛ ojalɛ akojo; ni otsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛbi lɛ ojalɛ saneyeli lɛ.

english_verse: Let him be honest and fair with all your people, especially the poor.
translation_verse: Hã ekojo omaŋ lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa koni eye jalɛ sane ehã omɛi ni ji ohiafoi.

english_verse: Let peace and justice rule every mountain and hill.
translation_verse: Hã hejɔlɛ ajɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ aba ahã omaŋ lɛ; ni jalɛ sane ajɛ ŋmeŋmei lɛ anɔ aba.

english_verse: Let the king defend the poor, rescue the homeless, and crush everyone who hurts them.
translation_verse: Efã maŋbii ohiafoi lɛ ahe, ehere ohiafoi ayiwala; ni wieyelɔ lɛ, ekpãtã ehiɛ butubutu.

english_verse: Let him be as helpful as rain that refreshes the meadows and the ground.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ atsɔ̃ tamɔ nu ni nɛɔ jwɛi ni ashwao nɔ; etsɔ̃ tamɔ futufuli ni shwãa shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ.

english_verse: Let the king be fair with everyone, and let there be peace until the moon falls from the sky.
translation_verse: Jalɛ saneyeli ashwere yɛ elumɔyeli be lɛŋ, ni toiŋjɔlɛ aba babaoo kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni nyɔɔŋtsere bɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Let his kingdom reach from sea to sea, from the Euphrates River across all the earth.
translation_verse: Elumɔyeli aaahe shi kɛaajɛ ŋshɔnaa kɛyagbee ŋshɔnaa; kɛaajɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa kɛyashi je lɛ naagbeehei kɛ̃.

english_verse: Force the desert tribes to accept his rule, and make his enemies crawl in the dirt.
translation_verse: Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ bii aaakoto lɛ, ni ehenyɛlɔi lɛ kɛ amɛhe aaakoklo shi yɛ mlu mli.

english_verse: Force the rulers of Tarshish and of the islands to pay taxes to him. Make the kings of Sheba and of Seba bring gifts.
translation_verse: Tarshish kɛ ŋshɔkpɔi lɛ anɔ maŋtsɛmɛi aaatsu onia abahã lɛ. Sheba kɛ Seba maŋtsɛmɛi aaabake nii.

english_verse: Make other rulers bow down and all nations serve him.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ aaakoto lɛ, majimaji fɛɛ kwa aaasɔmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Do this because the king rescues the homeless when they cry out, and he helps everyone who is poor and in need.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ekpɔ̃ɔ mɔ ni efĩ lɛ kɛji ebolɔ etsɛ lɛ lɛ, ekpɔ̃ɔ ohiafo kɛ mɛi ni bɛ yelikɛbualɔ ko.

english_verse: The king has pity on the weak and the helpless and protects those in need.
translation_verse: Enaa mɔ ni egbɔjɔ kɛ mɔ ni efĩ lɛ lɛ mɔbɔ, ni ehereɔ mɔ ni efi lɛ lɛ yiwala.

english_verse: He cares when they hurt, and he saves them from cruel and violent deaths.
translation_verse: Ehereɔ amɛyiwala kɛjeɔ yiwalɛ kɛ nɔnyɛɛ mli; amɛwala jara wa yɛ ehiɛ.

english_verse: Long live the king! Give him gold from Sheba. Always pray for the king and praise him each day.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ yi ana wala! Ajɛ Sheba abake lɛ shika! Asɔle ahã lɛ be fɛɛ be; ni aba jɔɔmɔ ahã lɛ jenamɔ tuu.

english_verse: Let cities overflow with food and hills be covered with grain, just like Mount Lebanon. Let the people in the cities prosper like wild flowers.
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ lɛ aba abele babaoo kɛyashwie gɔji lɛ anɔ; eba nii tamɔ Lebanon. Gbɔmɛi afrɔke yɛ maji lɛ amli tamɔ ŋa nɔ jwɛi.

english_verse: May the glory of the king shine brightly forever like the sun in the sky. Let him make nations prosper and learn to praise him.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ lɛ gbɛi ahe shi kɛya naanɔ; gbii abɔ ni hulu yɔɔ nɛɛ, enunyam akagbo. Gbɔmɛi aaanya yɛ ehewɔ; ni majimaji fɛɛ aaajɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, we praise you. Only you can work miracles.
translation_verse: Ajie Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi! Lɛ ekoome too efeɔ naakpɛɛnii.

english_verse: We will always praise your glorious name. Let your glory be seen everywhere on earth. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Ajie enunyam gbɛi lɛ yi kɛya naanɔ! Jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ayi tɔ kɛ enunyam lɛ! Amen! Amen!

english_verse: This ends the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: David, Ishai bi lɛ, sɔlemɔi lɛ anaagbee nɛ.

english_verse: ) God Is Good
translation_verse: ) Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ saneyeli Asaf lala ko.

english_verse: God is truly good to Israel, especially to everyone with a pure heart.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛŋ, Nyɔŋmɔ hi hã Israel; ehi ehã mɛi ni atsuiiaŋ tse lɛ.

english_verse: But I almost stumbled and fell,
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ eshwɛ shrao ni minane atɔ̃tɔ̃; shwɛ shrao kulɛ mishane.

english_verse: because it made me jealous to see proud and evil people and to watch them prosper.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ be ni mina bɔ ni mɛi fɔ̃ji eshwere lɛ, mihiɛ kɔ̃ yiwalɔi lɛ aninamɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: They never have to suffer, they stay healthy,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ amɛbɛ piŋmɔ ko lɛ, amɛgbɔmɔtsei yɛ hewalɛ kpiŋtiŋkpliŋŋ.

english_verse: and they don't have troubles like everyone else.
translation_verse: Adesãi ahaomɔ lɛ eko kwraa gbaaa amɛnaa lɛ, amɛpiŋŋ tamɔ adesãi krokomɛi.

english_verse: Their pride is like a necklace, and they commit sin more often than they dress themselves.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, hewoo etsɔ̃ kuɛnii ni amɛwo, ni yiwaa ji amɛhebo.

english_verse: Their eyes bulge with fat, and their minds are flooded with foolish thoughts.
translation_verse: Fɔ sɔŋŋ ehã amɛhiŋmɛii ekɛ̃lɛ̃ emamɔ shi; amɛtsuii eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ kwashiaianii.

english_verse: They sneer and say cruel things, and because of their pride, they make violent threats.
translation_verse: Amɛyeɔ mɛi ahe fɛo, ni nishaianii he amɛwieɔ; amɛfaa amɛhe amɛwieɔ, ni mɛi apiŋmɔ pɛ he amɛjwɛŋɔ.

english_verse: They dare to speak against God and to order others around.
translation_verse: Amɛhãa amɛnaa yasaa Nyɔŋmɔ tete he; amɛdaaŋ wiemɔi ekpele shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ;

english_verse: God will bring his people back, and they will drink the water he so freely gives.
translation_verse: hewɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ ekpale kɛtee amɛŋɔɔ, ni amɛkafoɔ amɛ; ni amɛnaaa tɔ̃mɔ ko yɛ amɛhe.

english_verse: Only evil people would say, “God Most High cannot know everything!”
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Te Nyɔŋmɔ aaafee tɛŋŋ ni ele hu? Ani Ŋwɛinyo lɛ aaale?”

english_verse: Yet all goes well for them, and they live in peace.
translation_verse: Naa, bɔ ni mɛi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ nɛ: Daa nɛɛ amɛhe ejɔ amɛ, ni nii lɛ, na kɛkɛ amɛnaa.

english_verse: What good did it do me to keep my thoughts pure and refuse to do wrong?
translation_verse: Yakatswaa po mihiɛ mitsuiŋ keŋkeŋ, ni miwooo miniji ahe muji kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ ko lɛ.

english_verse: I am sick all day, and I am punished each morning.
translation_verse: Minaa nɔ daa jenamɔ, ni agbalaa mitoi daa leebi.

english_verse: If I had said evil things, I would not have been loyal to your people.
translation_verse: Eji mikɛɛ akɛ, “Mawie nɛkɛ” kulɛ, miyeŋ owebii lɛ ashwiei lɛ anɔkwa.

english_verse: Then I went to your temple, and there I understood what will happen to my enemies.
translation_verse: Kɛyashi mibote Nyɔŋmɔ he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ, dani mina bɔ ni amɛnaagbee tamɔ hã.

english_verse: You will make them stumble, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ okɛ amɛ eto hei ni shamɔɔ trotro; ohãa amɛtswiaa shi, ni amɛhiɛ kpãtãa.

english_verse: They will be terrified, suddenly swept away and no longer there.
translation_verse: Amɛhiɛ kpãtãa shwiaa, ni ŋmiŋmi loɔ amɛ kɛyaa kwrakwra.

english_verse: They will disappear, Lord, despised like a bad dream the morning after.
translation_verse: Amɛtamɔ lamɔ ni alaa. Kɛji hiɛ tsɛ̃ kɛjɛ wɔ lɛ mli lɛ, amɛjeee fɛifɛi dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Once I was bitter and brokenhearted.
translation_verse: Be ni edɔ mi, ni mitsui mli shã mi lɛ,

english_verse: I was stupid and ignorant, and I treated you as a wild animal would.
translation_verse: asomoaŋ kwashia mifee lɛ, ni mileee nii. Mitamɔ kooloo yɛ ohiɛ.

english_verse: But I never really left you, and you hold my right hand.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ miyɛ omasɛi daa, ni ohiɛ mininejurɔ mli.

english_verse: Your advice has been my guide, and later you will welcome me in glory.
translation_verse: Okɛ oŋaawoo tsɔ̃ɔ mi gbɛ; ni kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ ooohere mi owo onunyam mli.

english_verse: In heaven I have only you, and on this earth you are all I want.
translation_verse: Namɔ miyɔɔ yɛ ŋwɛi fe bo? Ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ ni mitaoɔ yɛ bo osɛɛ.

english_verse: My body and mind may fail, but you are my strength and my choice forever.
translation_verse: Miheloo kɛ mitsui aaagbɔjɔ nɛ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ ji mitsui hewalɛ kɛ migbɛfaŋnɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ;

english_verse: All-Powerful Lord God, those who stay far from you will be lost, and you will destroy those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ mɛi ni ekwa bo lɛ, ahiɛ aaakpãtã. Okpãtãa mɛi ni yeee bo anɔkwa lɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: It is good for me to be near you. I choose you as my protector, and I will tell about your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ masɛi hilɛ hi hã mi. Mikɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ efee mibobaahe, bɔ ni afee ni magba onitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Our God, why have you completely rejected us? Why are you so angry with the ones you care for?
translation_verse: Oo, Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛɛba oshɛrɛ wɔ oshwie kwraa nɛkɛ? Mɛɛba omlifu lɛ jɛleɔ woɔ olɛɛhe lɛ toi nɛɛ?

english_verse: Remember the people you rescued long ago, the tribe you chose for your very own. Think of Mount Zion, your home;
translation_verse: Kaimɔ osafo ni oŋɔ fee onɔ kɛjɛ blema lɛ! Kaimɔ Zion Gɔŋ, he ni obahiɔ lɛ.

english_verse: walk over to the temple left in ruins forever by those who hate us.
translation_verse: Dɔɔ ohe kɛya naanɔ amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ amli. Henyɛlɔ lɛ efite nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Your enemies roared like lions in your holy temple, and they have placed their banners there.
translation_verse: Ohenyɛlɔi lɛ ebɔ kunimyeli oshe yɛ Ohe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ; amɛshi amɛflaŋaai yɛ jɛi akɛ kunimyeli he okadi.

english_verse: It looks like a forest chopped to pieces.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛ lemai miikumɔ yiteŋgbɛ agbo lɛ he tsei lɛ;

english_verse: They used axes and hatchets to smash the carvings.
translation_verse: ni agbo lɛ tsei ni ayeyee samai awo he lɛ, amɛkɛ lemai kɛ hamle ekumɔ.

english_verse: They burned down your temple and badly disgraced it.
translation_verse: Ni amɛma Ohe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ naa la, ni amɛbule he ni ajaa bo yɛ lɛ kwrakwra.

english_verse: They said to themselves, “We'll crush them!” Then they burned every one of your meeting places all over the country.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Wɔbaaye amɛnɔ kɛwula shi.” Amɛshãshãa Nyɔŋmɔ kpeehei fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: There are no more miracles and no more prophets. Who knows how long it will be like this?
translation_verse: Wɔnaaa wɔkadii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ! Gbalɔ ko gbalɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa bɛ wɔteŋ ni ele bɔ ni sane nɛɛ naa aaayakpa ahã.

english_verse: Our God, how much longer will our enemies sneer? Won't they ever stop insulting you?
translation_verse: Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ni henyɛlɔ lɛ aaabɔ ahora kɛyashi? Ani henyɛlɔ lɛ aaagbe ogbɛi lɛ he guɔ kɛaaya naanɔ lo?

english_verse: Why don't you punish them? Why are you holding back?
translation_verse: Mɛɛba osu onine? Mɛɛba osu ohewalɛ ninejurɔ lɛ owo omlishi?

english_verse: Our God and King, you have ruled since ancient times; you have won victories everywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ kɛjɛ blema beebe lɛ, miNyɔŋmɔ, mimaŋtsɛ lɛ, lɛ etsuɔ yiwalaheremɔ nitsumɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: By your power you made a path through the sea, and you smashed the heads of sea monsters.
translation_verse: Ogba ŋshɔ lɛ mli yɛ ohewalɛ naa; ojwara ŋshɔŋ bonsoi lɛ ayitsei.

english_verse: You crushed the heads of the monster Leviathan, then fed him to wild creatures in the desert.
translation_verse: Ojwara kooloo leviatan lɛ yitsei lɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ; ni oŋɔ egbɔmɔtso lɛ ohã ŋaŋ kooloi koni amɛye.

english_verse: You opened the ground for streams and springs and dried up mighty rivers.
translation_verse: Ohã nuhiŋmɛii kɛ faa niji tue; ni ohã faa ni hoɔ daa lɛ ŋala.

english_verse: You rule the day and the night, and you put the moon and the sun in place.
translation_verse: Shwane lɛ onɔ ni, ni nyɔɔŋ hu onɔ ni. Bo obɔ ŋulamii kɛ hulu.

english_verse: You made summer and winter and gave them to the earth.
translation_verse: Bo oto shikpɔŋ lɛ husui lɛ fɛɛ; bo obɔ latsaa be kɛ fɛ̃i be fɛɛ.

english_verse: You treat us like pet doves, but they mistreat us. Don't keep forgetting us and letting us be fed to those wild animals.
translation_verse: Kaaŋmɛɛ omɛi ni ahe waaa lɛ ahe ohã kooloi kakawuai lɛ; ohiɛ akakpa omɛi nɔnalɔi lɛ anɔ kwraa.

english_verse: Remember the agreement you made with us. Violent enemies are hiding in every dark corner of the earth.
translation_verse: Ohiɛ akakpa okpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei ni ewowoo duŋ lɛ eyimɔ tɔ kɛ yiwalɛ.

english_verse: Don't disappoint those in need or make them turn from you, but help the poor and homeless to shout your praises.
translation_verse: Kaahã mɔ ni awaa lɛ yi lɛ hiɛ miishwie shi. Hã ohiafo kɛ mɔ ni efi lɛ fɛɛ ajie ogbɛi lɛ yi.

english_verse: Do something, God! Defend yourself. Remember how those fools sneer at you all day long.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, wo ohe nɔ koni ofã ohe. Kaimɔ bɔ ni mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei bɔɔ bo ahora gbi muu fɛɛ.

english_verse: Don't forget the loud shouts of your enemies.
translation_verse: Ohiɛ akakpa ohenyɛlɔi lɛ abolɔmɔ lɛ, amɛhoofeemɔ ni kwɔɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi be fɛɛ be lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Our God, we thank you for being so near to us! Everyone celebrates your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔmiida bo shi! Wɔmiida bo shi! Ejaakɛ obɛŋkɛ wɔ; wɔgbaa onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ.

english_verse: You have set a time to judge with fairness.
translation_verse: “Kɛji be ni mito lɛ shɛ lɛ, mibakojo yɛ jalɛ naa.

english_verse: The earth trembles, and its people shake; you alone keep its foundations firm.
translation_verse: Kɛji je lɛ hoso kɛ enɔ bɔɔnii fɛɛ lɛ, mi, mihiɛ ekulashii lɛ amli kpɛŋŋ.”

english_verse: You tell every bragger, “Stop bragging!” And to the wicked you say, “Don't boast of your power!
translation_verse: Mikɛɔ mɛi ni shwãa lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkashwãa!” Ni mikɛɔ yiwalɔi lɛ akɛ,

english_verse: Stop bragging! Quit telling me how great you are.”
translation_verse: “Nyɛkafea ntɛŋ; nyɛkafea ntɛŋ kwraa, nyɛkawiea kɛ kuɛŋtilɛ.”

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, victory doesn't come from the east or the west or from the desert.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kojomɔ jɛɛɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ, ejɛɛɛ anaigbɛ; asaŋ ejɛɛɛ ŋanɔgbɛ hu ebaaa.

english_verse: You are the one who judges. You can take away power and give it to others.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ ji kojolɔ! Ebaa mɔ ko shi, ni ewoɔ mɔ ko nɔ.

english_verse: You hold in your hand a cup filled with wine, strong and foaming. You will pour out some for every sinful person on this earth, and they will have to drink until it is gone.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa hiɛ kpulu ko yɛ edɛŋ kɛ emli wain kpakpa ni miitswa afui. Ebaafo eko ehã, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yiwalɔi lɛ fɛɛ baanu; amɛaashoo wain lɛ kɛ eshishi fɛɛ.

english_verse: But I will always tell about you, the God of Jacob, and I will sing your praise.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, mibanya kɛaatee naanɔ. Mala majie Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will destroy the power of evil people, but you will give strength to those who are good.
translation_verse: Ebaaba yiwalɔi ahewalɛi fɛɛ shi; shi jalɔi ahewalɛ lɛ ebaawo nɔ.

english_verse: You, our God, are famous in Judah and honored in Israel.
translation_verse: Ale Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ Yuda! Egbɛi tsii yɛ Israel.

english_verse: Your home is on Mount Zion, the city of peace.
translation_verse: Eshihilɛhe yɛ Salem, ni Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyɔɔ.

english_verse: There you destroyed fiery arrows, shields, swords, and all the other weapons.
translation_verse: Jɛi ekumɔ henyɛlɔ lɛ gãimlibii lɛ kɛ tsɛŋi lɛ kɛ klantei lɛ kɛ tawuu nibii lɛ amli yɛ.

english_verse: You are more glorious than the eternal mountains.
translation_verse: Ohiɛ yɛ nyam, ni ogbojee kwɔ fe naanɔ gɔji lɛ.

english_verse: Brave warriors were robbed of what they had taken, and now they lie dead, unable to lift an arm.
translation_verse: Nibii fɛɛ ni hii kãkãlɔi lɛ ha lɛ, ashɔ̃ yɛ amɛdɛŋ; tabilɔi lɛ gboi, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ enine nɔ ewo ekɛfã ehe.

english_verse: God of Jacob, when you roar, enemy chariots and horses drop dead in their tracks.
translation_verse: Oo Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ, oŋa amɛyi, okpɔŋɔ kɛ enɔtalɔ fɛɛ tswia shi ni amɛgboi.

english_verse: Our God, you are fearsome, and no one can oppose you when you are angry.
translation_verse: Shi bo lɛ, ohe yɛ gbeyei naakpa. Kɛji omli efu lɛ, namɔ aaanyɛ ohiɛ adamɔ?

english_verse: From heaven you announced your decisions as judge! And all who live on this earth were terrified and silent
translation_verse: Ojɛ ŋwɛi tɔ̃ɔ obu atɛŋ; je lɛ she gbeyei ni efee diŋŋ,

english_verse: when you took over as judge, ready to rescue everyone in need.
translation_verse: be ni Bo, Nyɔŋmɔ, ote shi okojo kɛhere shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɔnalɔi lɛ fɛɛ ayiwala lɛ.

english_verse: Even the most angry people will praise you when you are furious.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ adesã mlila tete aaajie oyi. Mɛi ni aaaje gbele mli yɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ, aaaye ogbii juji lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone, make your promises to the Lord your God and do what you promise. The Lord is fearsome, and all his servants should bring him gifts.
translation_verse: Nyɛwoa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi; ni nyɛyea nyɛshiwoi lɛ anɔ. Nyɛhãa mɛi fɛɛ ni bɔle lɛ lɛ kɛ nikeenii abahã, mɔ ni he yɔɔ gbeyei naakpa lɛ,

english_verse: God destroys the courage of rulers and kings and makes cowards of them.
translation_verse: lɛ mɔ ni ebaa lumɛi ashi, ni ehãa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord God, and I beg you to listen.
translation_verse: Mibolɔɔ waa mitsɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mitsɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ waa akɛ ebo mi toi!

english_verse: In days filled with trouble, I search for you. And at night I tirelessly lift my hands in prayer, refusing comfort.
translation_verse: Mihaomɔ gbi nɔ lɛ, mitaoɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ; nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ lɛ, miholeɔ miniji anɔ yɛ sɔlemɔ mli, ni etɔɔɔ mi; misusuma ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ miishɛjemɔ.

english_verse: When I think of you, I feel restless and weak.
translation_verse: Kɛji misusu Nyɔŋmɔ he lɛ, midɔmɔɔ ŋtsɔi; ni kɛji mishwie miyiŋ lɛ, mimumɔ tɔɔ biti.

english_verse: Because of you, Lord God, I can't sleep. I am restless and can't even talk.
translation_verse: Okɔ wɔ yɛ mihiŋmɛi mli; haomɔ sɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ, minyɛɛɛ mawie.

english_verse: I think of times gone by, of those years long ago.
translation_verse: Mijwɛŋɔ blema gbii lɛ ahe, ni mikaiɔ teteete afii lɛ hu.

english_verse: Each night my mind is flooded with questions:
translation_verse: Mitaoɔ mitsuiŋ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ; mishwieɔ miyiŋ, ni mikpaa mimli.

english_verse: “Have you rejected me forever? Won't you be kind again?
translation_verse: “Aso Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kpooɔ mɔ kɛyaa naanɔ, ni enaŋ mɔbɔ dɔŋŋ lo?

english_verse: Is this the end of your love and your promises?
translation_verse: Aso esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ sɛɛ efo kwraa kɛmiiya naanɔ lo? Aso eshiwoi lɛ hu asɛɛ efo kɛmiiya naanɔ lo?

english_verse: Have you forgotten how to have pity? Do you refuse to show mercy because of your anger?”
translation_verse: Aso Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ekpa edromɔ lɛ nɔ lo? Aso emlifu ehã ekpa mɔ mɔbɔnalɛ lo?”

english_verse: Then I said, “God Most High, what hurts me most is that you no longer help us with your mighty arm.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Midɔlɛ sane ji akɛ, Ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ hewalɛ lɛ etsake.”

english_verse: Our Lord, I will remember the things you have done, your miracles of long ago.
translation_verse: Mibakai Yehowa nitsumɔi lɛ! Hɛɛ! Mibakai oblema naakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ.

english_verse: I will think about each one of your mighty deeds.
translation_verse: Majwɛŋ onitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahe; masusu onitsumɔi wuji lɛ ahe.

english_verse: Everything you do is right, and no other god compares with you.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ogbɛ lɛ he tse krɔŋkrɔŋ. Mɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko je agbo tamɔ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ?

english_verse: You alone work miracles, and you have let nations see your mighty power.
translation_verse: Bo ji Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ni tsuɔ naakpɛɛ nii, Bo mɔ ni ohã ana ohewalɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ.

english_verse: With your own arm you rescued your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.
translation_verse: Okpɔ̃ owebii ni ji Yakob shwiei kɛ Yosef shwiei lɛ yɛ ohewalɛ lɛ naa.

english_verse: The ocean looked at you, God, and it trembled deep down with fear.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, be ni nu lɛ na bo! Hɛɛ be ni nu lɛ na bo, eshe gbeyei; Ni, bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ kpokpo kɛtee eshishi tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: Water flowed from the clouds. Thunder was heard above as your arrows of lightning flashed about.
translation_verse: Atatui lɛ nɛ nu shwie shi, ni ŋwɛi shimɔ, ni srawai gbala yɛ he fɛɛ he.

english_verse: Your thunder roared like chariot wheels. The world was made bright by lightning, and all the earth trembled.
translation_verse: Oŋwɛi shiimɔ lɛ gbɛɛ kɛnyiɛ lasuogbele mli kɛho, ni osrawai kpɛlɛ ni je lɛ mli tse, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ kpokpo, ni ehoso.

english_verse: You walked through the water of the mighty sea, but your footprints were never seen.
translation_verse: Ofo ŋshɔ kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ. Onyiɛ kɛtsɔ̃ ŋshɔkei lɛ amli; shi anaaa onanemaamɔhei.

english_verse: You guided your people like a flock of sheep, and you chose Moses and Aaron to be their leaders.
translation_verse: Otsɔ̃ Mose kɛ Aaron nɔ, okpala omaŋbii lɛ tamɔ akpalaa tooku.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to listen as I teach.
translation_verse: Oo mimaŋ, nyɛboa mitsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ atoi; nyɛfea toi nyɛhãa midaaŋ wiemɔi lɛ!

english_verse: I will give instruction and explain the mystery of what happened long ago.
translation_verse: Magbele minaa mawie yɛ abɛbuaiaŋ, magbala blema teemɔŋ saji amli,

english_verse: These are things we learned from our ancestors,
translation_verse: nii ni wɔnu, ni wɔle, ni wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ gba wɔ lɛ.

english_verse: and we will tell them to the next generation. We won't keep secret the glorious deeds and the mighty miracles of the Lord.
translation_verse: Wɔshiuŋ amɛbii lɛ saji lɛ ekoeko nɔ; shi wɔɔgba yinɔbii ni baa lɛ Yehowa anunyam nitsumɔi lɛ kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ kɛ naakpɛɛ nii ni efee lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: God gave his Law to Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel. And he told our ancestors to teach their children,
translation_verse: Ewo mlai ehã Yakob shwiei kɛ akpɔi ehã Israelbii. Ewo amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kitã akɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛbii mlai nɛɛ;

english_verse: so that each new generation would know his Law and tell it to the next.
translation_verse: bɔ ni afee ni nyɛbii ni baaba lɛ ana ale nii nɛɛ; bii ni anako afɔ tete, koni amɛ hu amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛbii.

english_verse: Then they would trust God and obey his teachings, without forgetting anything God had done.
translation_verse: Ewo mlai nɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ afɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ, koni amɛhiɛ akakpa Nyɔŋmɔ nitsumɔi lɛ anɔ, shi amɛye ekitãi lɛ anɔ,

english_verse: They would be different from their ancestors, who were stubborn, rebellious, and unfaithful to God.
translation_verse: koni amɛkatamɔ amɛtsɛmɛi kaniŋkajelɔi kɛ yinɔbii atuatselɔi lɛ, yinɔbii ni amɛhemɔkɛyeli yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli fiii shi kpɛŋŋ, ni amɛyeee Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa yɛ mumɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The warriors from Ephraim were armed with arrows, but they ran away when the battle began.
translation_verse: Tawuu gbi lɛ, Efraimbii ni emia kɛ gãi lɛ jo foi.

english_verse: They broke their agreement with God, and they turned their backs on his teaching.
translation_verse: Amɛyeee Nyɔŋmɔ kpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ amɛaaba amɛjeŋ yɛ emla lɛ naa.

english_verse: They forgot all he had done, even the mighty miracles
translation_verse: Amɛhiɛ kpa nɔ ni etsu kɛ naakpɛɛnii ni efee etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: he did for their ancestors near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: Efee naakpɛɛnii yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ahiɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ Zoan ŋa lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: God made a path in the sea and piled up the water as he led them across.
translation_verse: Egba ŋshɔ lɛŋ, ni ehã amɛtsɔ̃ mli kɛho; ni ehã ŋshɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ gbogbo ni ma shi.

english_verse: He guided them during the day with a cloud, and each night he led them with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Shwane lɛ ekɛ atatu tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ, ni nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ lɛ ekɛ la gboŋaa tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ.

english_verse: God made water flow from rocks he split open in the desert, and his people drank freely, as though from a lake.
translation_verse: Ehã tɛsai amli gbalagbalai yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni ehã amɛ nu babaoo ni jɛ shikpɔŋ kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛŋ amɛnu.

english_verse: He made streams gush out like rivers from rocks.
translation_verse: Ehã nuhiŋmɛi tsɛ̃ kɛjɛ tɛsaa lɛŋ, ni ehã nu ho tamɔ faa.

english_verse: But in the desert, the people of God Most High kept sinning and rebelling.
translation_verse: Shi amɛkã he amɛfee esha amɛshi Nyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛtse Ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ hiɛ atua yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: They stubbornly tested God and demanded from him what they wanted to eat.
translation_verse: Amɛka Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ kɛ niyenii ni baa amɛtsine ni amɛbi lɛ.

english_verse: They challenged God by saying, “Can God provide food out here in the desert?
translation_verse: Amɛwie amɛshi Nyɔŋmɔ amɛkɛɛ: “Ani Nyɔŋmɔ aaanyɛ aŋmɛ okplɔ̃ yɛ ŋa nɛɛ nɔ lo?

english_verse: It's true God struck the rock and water gushed out like a river, but can he give his people bread and meat?”
translation_verse: Etswa tɛsaa lɛ nɔ, ni nuhiŋmɛi tsɛ̃ kɛjɛ mli; ni eyi kɛteke nɔ etsɔ̃ faa tete. Ani eeenyɛ niyenii hu eduro, aloo ehã emaŋ lɛ loo lo?”

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he was angry and furious with Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Yehowa nu lɛ, emli fu naakpa eje la ewo Israel he; emlifu te shi ewo Israel naakpa,

english_verse: They had refused to trust him, and they had doubted his saving power.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ amɛheee Nyɔŋmɔ amɛyeee, ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ eyiwalaheremɔ hewalɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: But God gave a command to the clouds, and he opened the doors in the skies.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ efã ŋwɛi, ni egbele ŋwɛi agboi lɛ anaa,

english_verse: From heaven he sent grain that they called manna.
translation_verse: ni enɛ mana eshwie amɛnɔ koni amɛye; ehã amɛ ŋwɛiŋmãa lɛ eko.

english_verse: He gave them more than enough, and each one of them ate this special food.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ adesã ye ŋwɛi bɔfoi aniyenii; ehã amɛ niyenii babaoo amɛye amɛtɔrɔ.

english_verse: God's mighty power sent a strong wind from the southeast,
translation_verse: Ehã bokã kɔɔyɔɔ tswa yɛ ŋwɛi, ehã wuoyigbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ tswa yɛ ehewalɛ naa.

english_verse: and it brought birds that covered the ground, like sand on the beach.
translation_verse: Enɛ loo eshwie amɛnɔ tamɔ mlu; enɛ loofɔji hu tamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia.

english_verse: Then God made the birds fall in the camp of his people near their tents.
translation_verse: Ehã loofɔji lɛ shwie shi yɛ amɛshitoohe lɛ teŋ kɛbɔle amɛwɔɔhei lɛ.

english_verse: God gave his people all they wanted, and each of them ate until they were full.
translation_verse: Amɛye, ni amɛtɔrɔ kɛteke nɔ, ejaakɛ ehã amɛ nɔ ni baa amɛtsine lɛ.

english_verse: But before they had swallowed the last bite,
translation_verse: Shi amɛtsinebaanii lɛ nako eje amɛtsine, amɛmiiye nii lɛ lolo,

english_verse: God became angry and killed the strongest and best from the families of Israel.
translation_verse: kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu lɛ te shi wo amɛ, ni egbe amɛteiaŋ oblaŋi lɛ, ni ji Israel oblahii kãkãlɔi lɛ.

english_verse: But the rest kept on sinning and would not trust God's miracles.
translation_verse: Enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛkã he amɛfee esha; enaakpɛɛnii lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛheee lɛ amɛyeee.

english_verse: So he cut their lives short and made them terrified.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, ehã amɛwala sɛɛ fo tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ; amɛfii lɛ yi obɔ̃ kɛ haomɔ.

english_verse: After he killed some of them, the others turned to him with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Kɛ egbe amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi lɛ, fãbii lɛ taoɔ esɛɛgbɛ; amɛshwaa amɛhe, ni amɛtaoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sɛɛgbɛ kɛ hiɛdɔɔ.

english_verse: They remembered God Most High, the mighty rock that kept them safe.
translation_verse: Amɛkaiɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji amɛbobaahe, ni Nyɔŋmɔ, Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ, ji amɛkpɔ̃lɔ.

english_verse: But they tried to flatter God, and they told him lies;
translation_verse: Shi amɛhɔlɔ lɛ kɛ amɛdaaŋ wiemɔi, ni amɛmale amɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.

english_verse: they were unfaithful and broke their promises.
translation_verse: Amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛfi shi kɛye lɛ anɔkwa, amɛyeee ekɛ amɛteŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli anɔkwa.

english_verse: Yet God was kind. He kept forgiving their sins and didn't destroy them. He often became angry, but never lost his temper.
translation_verse: Shi lɛ lɛ, akɛni mlitsɔ̃lɔ ji lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ekɛ amɛnɔsha lɛ fa amɛ, ni ekpãtãaa amɛhiɛ. Bei pii lɛ, emiɔ ŋɔɔ, ni ehãaa emli awo la kɛteke nɔ.

english_verse: God remembered that they were made of flesh and were like a wind that blows once and then dies down.
translation_verse: Ekai akɛ adesai kɛkɛ ji amɛ, kɔɔyɔɔ ni hoɔ eyaa ni ekuuu esɛɛ ebaaa dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: While they were in the desert, they often rebelled and made God sad.
translation_verse: Kwɛ shii abɔ ni amɛtse ehiɛ atua yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni amɛfee lɛ nidɔɔnii yɛ shiaŋa lɛŋ.

english_verse: They kept testing him and caused terrible pain for the Holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Amɛka Nyɔŋmɔ nɔtoonɔtoo, ni amɛwo Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli la.

english_verse: They forgot about his power and how he had rescued them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Amɛhiɛ kpa ehewalɛ lɛ, kɛ gbi ni ekpɔ̃ amɛ yɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ nɔ;

english_verse: God showed them all kinds of wonderful miracles near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: amɛhiɛ kpa ekadii lɛ ni efee yɛ Ijipt, kɛ enaakpɛɛ nibii lɛ yɛ Zoan ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: He turned the rivers of Egypt into blood, and no one could drink from the streams.
translation_verse: Ehã amɛfai lɛ tsɔ̃mɔ lá ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛnyɛɛɛ fai lɛ amli nu amɛnu.

english_verse: He sent swarms of flies to pester the Egyptians, and he sent frogs to cause them trouble.
translation_verse: Ehã ofɔii bashwie amɛnɔ, ni amɛye amɛ; ni ehã kɔkɔdenei hu, kpãtã amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: God let worms and grasshoppers eat their crops.
translation_verse: Ehã gɔgɔmii ye amɛŋmɔshinii, ni baalabii kpãtã amɛnitsumɔnii ahiɛ.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees with hail and floods.
translation_verse: Ekɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi bibii kpãtã amɛwaintsei lɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi wuji gbe amɛsikamore tsei lɛ.

english_verse: Then he killed their cattle with hail and their other animals with lightning.
translation_verse: Ekpãtã amɛtsinai lɛ ahiɛ kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi, ni ekpãtã amɛtoi ahiɛ kɛ srawai.

english_verse: God was so angry and furious that he went into a rage and caused them great trouble by sending swarms of destroying angels.
translation_verse: Ehã emlifu ni naa wa lɛ, kɛ egrimɔ kɛ emlila kɛ hejaramɔ ba amɛnɔ; ehã bɔfoi fɔ̃ji asafo bakpãtã amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: God released his anger and slaughtered them in a terrible way.
translation_verse: Ekɔ̃ɔɔ efiliii kwraa, ni ekɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko he ekeee lɛ, shi ejɔɔ amɛnɔ ehã gbele hela.

english_verse: He killed the first-born son of each Egyptian family.
translation_verse: Egbe Ijiptbii akromɔbii fɛɛ, Ham shwiei akromɔbii lɛ fɛɛ hu lɛ.

english_verse: Then God led his people out of Egypt and guided them in the desert like a flock of sheep.
translation_verse: Ejie emaŋbii lɛ kɛje kpo tamɔ toi, ni ekpala amɛ kɛnyiɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ tamɔ tooku.

english_verse: He led them safely along, and they were not afraid, but their enemies drowned in the sea.
translation_verse: Ekpala amɛ shweshweeshwe bɔ ni amɛsheee gbeyei; shi ŋshɔ lɛ gbe amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ,

english_verse: God brought his people to the sacred mountain that he had taken by his own power.
translation_verse: ni ekɛ amɛ ba Gɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ, gɔŋ ni ekɛ ehewalɛ shɔ̃ lɛ he.

english_verse: He made nations run from the tribes of Israel, and he let the tribes take over their land.
translation_verse: Eshwie majimaji lɛ yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni eja shikpɔŋ lɛ ehã amɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnii, ni ehã Israel akutsei lɛ hi nɔ akɛ amɛshihilɛhe.

english_verse: But the people tested God Most High, and they refused to obey his laws.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ amɛka Nyɔŋmɔ, Ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ, ni amɛtse ehiɛ atua, ni amɛyeee ekitãi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: They were as unfaithful as their ancestors, and they were as crooked as a twisted arrow.
translation_verse: Amɛgba afã, ni amɛyeee anɔkwa tamɔ bɔ ni amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ nɔŋŋ; amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ gãi ni ekɔ̃dɔ̃.

english_verse: God demanded all their love, but they made him angry by worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ wo emli la, ni amɛkɛ amɛmãgãi lɛ hã eye awuŋã.

english_verse: So God became furious and completely rejected the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ mli wo la be ni ena amãgãi lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, ekwa Israel kwrakwra.

english_verse: Then he deserted his home at Shiloh, where he lived here on earth.
translation_verse: Ekwa eshihilɛhe ni yɔɔ Shilo lɛ, ni ji buu mli ni ehi yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ lɛ.

english_verse: He let enemies capture the sacred chest and let them dishonor him.
translation_verse: Eŋmɛ gbɛ ni henyɛlɔi shɔ̃ kpãŋmɔ adeka lɛ, enunyam kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ he okadi lɛ, kɛtee.

english_verse: God took out his anger on his chosen ones and let them be killed by enemy swords.
translation_verse: Emli wo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi lɛ la, ni ehã amɛgboi yɛ klante naa.

english_verse: Fire destroyed the young men, and the young women were left with no one to marry.
translation_verse: La kpãtã oblahii lɛ ahiɛ, ni amɛblayei lɛ, alaaa yookpeemɔ lala ko ahãaa amɛ.

english_verse: Priests died violent deaths, but their widows were not allowed to mourn.
translation_verse: Amɛsɔfoi nyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa, ni amɛkulafoi lɛ wooo yara amɛfooo amɛ.

english_verse: Finally the Lord woke up, like a soldier startled from a drunken sleep.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ te shi, tamɔ mɔ ko ni jɛ wɔ mli, oookɛɛ kãkãlɔ ni dãa eba ehiɛ.

english_verse: God scattered his enemies and made them ashamed forever.
translation_verse: Eshwie ehenyɛlɔi lɛ, ewo amɛ naanɔ hiɛgbele.

english_verse: Then the Lord decided not to make his home with Joseph's descendants in Ephraim.
translation_verse: Shi egbɛ Yosef shwiei lɛ eshwã, ni eŋɔ̃ɔɔ Efraim akutso lɛ hu.

english_verse: Instead he chose the tribe of Judah, and he chose Mount Zion, the place he loves.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ eŋɔ Yuda akutso lɛ, Zion Gɔŋ lɛ ni esumɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: There he built his temple as lofty as the mountains and as solid as the earth he made to last forever.
translation_verse: Ehe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ jɛi tamɔ shihilɛhe ni yɔɔ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi lɛ. Eto lɛ ema shi shiŋŋ tamɔ ebɔ je lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God chose David to be his servant and took him from tending sheep
translation_verse: Ehala etsulɔ David, eŋɔ lɛ kɛje ŋa lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: and from caring for lambs. Then God made him the leader of Israel, his own nation.
translation_verse: Ekpala lɛ kɛjɛ toi yei ni hãa fufɔ lɛ asɛɛ, koni ebakpala emaŋ Israelbii, Israelbii ni ji egbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ.

english_verse: David treated the people fairly and guided them with wisdom.
translation_verse: David jie etsuiŋ fɛɛ kɛlɛ amɛ, ni ekɛŋaa kpakpa kpala amɛ.

english_verse: Our God, foreign nations have taken your land, disgraced your temple, and left Jerusalem in ruins.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, jeŋmajiaŋbii ebabote oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; amɛbule oSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛfee Yerusalɛm koikoi.

english_verse: They have fed the bodies of your servants to flesh-eating birds; your loyal people are food for savage animals.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛ otsuji lɛ agbohii hã ŋwɛi loofɔji, ni amɛye; amɛkɛ omɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ agbohii hã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi.

english_verse: All Jerusalem is covered with their blood, and there is no one left to bury them.
translation_verse: Amɛshwie omɛi lɛ alá shi tamɔ nu kɛbɔle Yerusalɛm; ni anaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko po afu amɛ.

english_verse: Every nation around us sneers and makes fun.
translation_verse: Wɔhewɔ maji lɛ miibɔ wɔ ahora; amɛŋmɔɔ wɔ, ni amɛyeɔ wɔhe fɛo.

english_verse: Our Lord, will you keep on being angry? Will your angry feelings keep flaming up like fire?
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, mɛɛ beyinɔ omli aaafu kɛyaashi? Ani omli aaafu kɛya naanɔ lo? Ani owuŋayeli atso tamɔ la lo?

english_verse: Get angry with those nations that don't know you and won't worship you!
translation_verse: Okɛ omlila lɛ atua maji ni leee bo lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛyelii fɛɛ ni jaaa bo lɛ,

english_verse: They have gobbled up Jacob's descendants and left the land in ruins.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ amɛgbe omaŋbii, Israelbii lɛ, ni amɛfee amɛshihilɛhe lɛ amaŋfɔ̃.

english_verse: Don't make us pay for the sins of our ancestors. Have pity and come quickly! We are completely helpless.
translation_verse: Kaakwɛ wɔblema tsɛmɛi lɛ anishaianii lɛ ahewɔ ni ogbala wɔtoi. Naa wɔ mɔbɔ, ni oba wɔŋɔɔ mra, ejaakɛ aba wɔ shi naakpa.

english_verse: Our God, you keep us safe. Now help us! Rescue us. Forgive our sins and bring honor to yourself.
translation_verse: Oo wɔyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, ogbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam hewɔ lɛ, heremɔ wɔyiwala! Ni okɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ afa wɔ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Why should nations ask us, “Where is your God?” Let us and the other nations see you take revenge for your servants who died a violent death.
translation_verse: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ maji lɛ akɛɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ?” Hã majimaji lɛ ale, ni hã wɔ hu wɔna kɛ wɔhiŋmɛi, nɔ owele ni obaatɔ yɛ otsuji lɛ ala shi ni ashwie lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Listen to the prisoners groan! Let your mighty power save all who are sentenced to die.
translation_verse: Bo gboklɛfoi lɛ ŋtsɔidɔɔmɔi atoi; ni yɛ ohewalɛ lɛ naa lɛ, heremɔ mɛi ni abu amɛ gbele fɔ lɛ ayiwala.

english_verse: Each of those nations sneered at you, our Lord. Now let others sneer at them, seven times as much.
translation_verse: Oo Nuŋtsɔ, ahora ni maji ni yɔɔ wɔmasɛi ebɔ bo lɛ, bɔɔ he nakai toi kpawo oshãkã amɛtsitsi.

english_verse: Then we, your people, will always thank you. We are like sheep with you as our shepherd, and all generations will hear us praise you.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ, wɔ owebii, olɛɛhe lɛ toi lɛ, wɔɔda bo shi kɛaatee naanɔ; ni wɔɔgba onifeemɔi lɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ kɛjie oyi kɛjɛ yinɔ kɛyashi yinɔ.

english_verse: Shepherd of Israel, you lead the descendants of Joseph, and you sit on your throne above the winged creatures. Listen to our prayer and let your light shine
translation_verse: Oo Israel Kpalalɔ, bo toi! Bo ni okpala Yosef tamɔ tooku, Bo ni ota kerubim anɔ, baajie ohe shi faŋŋ otsɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: for the tribes of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Save us by your power.
translation_verse: Yɛ Efraim kɛ Benyamin kɛ Manase hiɛ. Teemɔ ohewalɛ lɛ shi ni oba obahere wɔ!

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛ wɔ ato wɔtoohe lɛ ekoŋŋ! Naa wɔ mɔbɔ koni wɔyi ana wala!

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, how much longer will the prayers of your people make you angry?
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, Tai aNyɔŋmɔ, kɛyaashi mɛɛ beyinɔ po ni omlifu aaajɛle awo omaŋ, ni oboŋ omaŋbii asɔlemɔ toi?

english_verse: You gave us tears for food, and you made us drink them by the bowlful.
translation_verse: Ohã yaafo tsɔ̃ amɛdaaŋ ŋmaa, ni ohã yaafonu pii tsɔ̃ amɛnu ni amɛnu.

english_verse: Because of you, our enemies who live nearby laugh and joke about us.
translation_verse: Ohã wɔhewɔ maji lɛ pele wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ he; ni wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ ŋmɔ wɔ.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Oo Tai aNyɔŋmɔ, okɛ wɔ ato wɔtoohe lɛ ekoŋŋ! Naa wɔ mɔbɔ koni wɔyi ana wala.

english_verse: We were like a grapevine you brought out of Egypt. You chased other nations away and planted us here.
translation_verse: Wɔba tamɔ waintso kɛjɛ Ijipt; oshwie maji lɛ, ni obatɛo wɔ yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: Then you cleared the ground, and we put our roots deep, spreading over the land.
translation_verse: Osaa shikpɔŋ ohã lɛ; etsɛ̃rɛ fãi kɛtee shikpɔŋ tɔ̃ɔ, ni ekpele shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Shade from this vine covered the mountains. Its branches climbed the mighty cedars
translation_verse: Ehɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ ha gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni eniji lɛ ha tsenedrui wuji lɛ anɔ;

english_verse: and stretched to the sea; its new growth reached to the river.
translation_verse: ekpã eniji lɛ amli kɛyamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ, aahu kɛyanina Eufrate Faa lɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, why have you torn down the wall from around the vineyard? You let everyone who walks by pick the grapes.
translation_verse: Mɛni hewɔ mɔ okumɔ waintso lɛ he afabaŋ lɛ, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni hoɔ tserɛɔ enɔ yibii nɛɛ?

english_verse: Now the vine is gobbled up by pigs from the forest and other wild animals.
translation_verse: Batafo jeɔ koo mli ebakpãtãa ehiɛ, ni ŋaŋ kooloi hu miiye eyibii.

english_verse: God All-Powerful, please do something! Look down from heaven and see what's happening to this vine.
translation_verse: Oo Tai aNyɔŋmɔ, kwɛmɔ wɔ! Jɛɛ ŋwɛi okwɛ ni ohere omaŋbii ayiwala.

english_verse: With your own hands you planted its roots, and you raised it as your very own.
translation_verse: Ba koni obabaa waintso lɛ ni otɛo yɛ ohewalɛ naa lɛ yi!

english_verse: Enemies chopped the vine down and set it on fire. Now show your anger and destroy them.
translation_verse: Wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ ema enaa la amɛshã, ni amɛtoo amɛfɔ̃ shi. Tsɔ̃ ohiɛ owo amɛ kɛ mlifu koni okpãtã amɛhiɛ!

english_verse: But help the one who sits at your right side, the one you raised to be your very own.
translation_verse: Baamɔ omaŋbii ni ji owebii ni bo diɛŋtsɛ ohala lɛ ayi, maŋ ni ohã ena hewalɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Then we will never turn away. Put new life into us, and we will worship you.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ wɔkpaleŋ yɛ osɛɛ dɔŋŋ! Hã wɔyi ana wala, ni wɔɔja bo.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, Tai aNyɔŋmɔ, okɛ wɔ ato wɔtoohe lɛ ekoŋŋ ni ona wɔ mɔbɔ, koni wɔyi ana wala.

english_verse: Be happy and shout to God who makes us strong! Shout praises to the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Nyɛlaa waa nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni ji wɔhewalɛ lɛ; nyɛbɔa oshe kɛ nyamɔ nyɛhãa Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ!

english_verse: Sing as you play tambourines and the lovely sounding stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Nyɛwoa lala, ni nyɛtswaa ŋoŋo; nyɛkɛ saŋku kɛ obenta atswaa lala kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and start the New Moon Festival. We must also celebrate when the moon is full.
translation_verse: Nyɛkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ yɛ wɔgbijurɔyeli gbi lɛ nɔ, be ni nyɔŋ hee eje, kɛ be hu ni nyɔŋ lɛ eye emuu,

english_verse: This is the law in Israel, and it was given to us by the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ eji akpɔ hã Israel, akpɔ ni jɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ.

english_verse: The descendants of Joseph were told to obey it, when God led them out from the land of Egypt. In a voice unknown to me, I heard someone say:
translation_verse: Eŋɔ hã Israelbii lɛ, be ni ete shi ewo Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ. Minu gbee ko ni mileee kɛɛ akɛ,

english_verse: “I lifted the burden from your shoulder and took the heavy basket from your hands.
translation_verse: “Miwo jatsu lɛ yɛ nyɛkɔ̃ji anɔ, ni mijie nyɛniji yɛ kɛntɛŋ he.

english_verse: When you were in trouble, I rescued you, and from the thunderclouds, I answered your prayers. Later I tested you at Meribah Spring.
translation_verse: Nyɛhaomɔ mli lɛ, nyɛtsɛ mi, ni mihere nyɛ. Mihere nyɛ yɛ ŋwɛi shiimɔhe lɛ. Mika nyɛ mikwɛ yɛ Meriba nu lɛ he.

english_verse: “Listen, my people, while I, the Lord, correct you! Israel, if you would only pay attention to me!
translation_verse: Oo mimaŋbii, nyɛboa toi, be mli ni mibɔɔ nyɛ kɔkɔ! Oo Israel, mina ni obo mi toi!

english_verse: Don't worship foreign gods or bow down to gods you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ kroko ko kwraa akahi nyɛteŋ; nyɛkajaa maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko kwraa.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt. Just ask, and I will give you whatever you need.
translation_verse: Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie nyɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. Gbɛɛ odaaŋ hatoo ni mawo lɛ obɔ̃ mahã bo.

english_verse: “But, my people, Israel, you refused to listen, and you would have nothing to do with me!
translation_verse: “Shi mimaŋ lɛ booo migbee toi; Israel baaa ehe shi ehãaa mi.

english_verse: So I let you be stubborn and keep on following your own advice.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛɛ amɛhe koni amɛhi shi yɛ amɛtsuiwalɛ lɛ mli, koni amɛhi shi bɔ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsumɔɔ.

english_verse: “My people, Israel, if only you would listen and do as I say!
translation_verse: Mina ni mimaŋ lɛ bo mi toi, ni Israel ba ejeŋ bɔ ni, mi, mitaoɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, would quickly defeat your enemies with my mighty power.
translation_verse: Kulɛ etsɛŋ ni mibaba amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ashi, ni maye amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me would come crawling, and that would be the end of them.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni nyɛɔ Yehowa lɛ, aaaba abakoto lɛ, ni amɛtoigbalamɔ lɛ aaakã he aya nɔ kɛaatee naanɔ tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: But I would feed you with the finest bread and with the best honey until you were full.”
translation_verse: Malɛ nyɛ kɛ ŋmãa kpakpa fe fɛɛ, ni mahã nyɛ tɛsaa mli wo ni nyɛye nyɛtɔrɔ.”

english_verse: When all the other gods have come together, the Lord God judges them and says:
translation_verse: Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ta ŋwɛi gwabɔɔ wulu lɛŋ; eta nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ateŋ eekojo.

english_verse: “How long will you keep judging unfairly and favoring evil people?
translation_verse: “Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ nyɛaaye toikɔdɔmɔ sane, ni nyɛaakwɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji ahiɛiaŋ kɛyaashi?

english_verse: Be fair to the poor and to orphans. Defend the helpless and everyone in need.
translation_verse: Nyɛyea ohiafo kɛ awusã sane nyɛhãa amɛ; nyɛfãa nɔnalɔ kɛ mɔ ni bɛ mɔ ko lɛ he.

english_verse: Rescue the weak and homeless from the powerful hands of heartless people.
translation_verse: Nyɛherea gbɔjɔlɔ kɛ mɔ ni efi lɛ lɛ; nyɛjiea amɛ yɛ yiwalɔi adɛŋ.

english_verse: “None of you know or understand a thing. You live in darkness, while the foundations of the earth tremble.
translation_verse: “Amɛleee nii lɛ, amɛnuuu nii ashishi hu; dujiaŋ amɛnyiɛ ni jalɛ saneyeli etã yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: “I, the Most High God, say that all of you are gods and also my own children.
translation_verse: Mi lɛ mikɛɛ akɛ, ‘nyɔŋmɔi ji nyɛ; Ŋwɛinyo lɛ bii ji nyɛ blublu kwa;’

english_verse: But you will die, just like everyone else, including powerful rulers.”
translation_verse: kɛ̃lɛ nyɛbaagboi tamɔ gbɔmɛi adesai gboiɔ, nyɛbaanyɔnyɔɔ tamɔ abladei lɛ ekomɛi nɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: Do something, God! Judge the nations of the earth; they belong to you.
translation_verse: Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, ba! Ba ni obaye je lɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ majimaji lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, onɔ ni.

english_verse: Our God, don't just sit there, silently doing nothing!
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, kaafee dioo! Kaamua onaa, ni kaafee kpoo, Naa Nyɔŋmɔ!

english_verse: Your hateful enemies are turning against you and rebelling.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ, naa, ohenyɛlɔi lɛ mifee hoo; mɛi ni he tsɛ̃ɔ bo lɛ amɛhole amɛhe nɔ.

english_verse: They are sly, and they plot against those you treasure.
translation_verse: Amɛyaa omaŋ lɛ yinɔ apam yɛ ŋaa mli; amɛkpãŋɔ mɛi ni obuɔ amɛhe lɛ ayinɔ.

english_verse: They say, “Let's wipe out the nation of Israel and make sure that no one remembers its name!”
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa koni wɔkpãtãa amɛhiɛ, koni amɛkafee maŋ dɔŋŋ; ni akakai Israel gbɛi lɛ dɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: All of them fully agree in their plans against you, and among them are
translation_verse: Naa, amɛkpãŋ, amɛfee gbee kome, amɛkpãŋ oyinɔ:

english_verse: Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagrites;
translation_verse: Edombii lɛ kɛ Ishmaelbii lɛ kɛ Moabbii lɛ kɛ Hagarbii lɛ,

english_verse: Even Assyria has joined forces with Moab and Ammon.
translation_verse: Asiriabii lɛ hu eyafata amɛhe; amɛwo mli nine amɛhã Lot shwiei lɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, punish all of them as you punished Midian. Destroy them, as you destroyed Sisera and Jabin at Kishon Creek
translation_verse: Feemɔ amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ofee Midianbii lɛ kɛ Sisera kɛ Yabin lɛ yɛ Kishon Faa lɛ naa lɛ,

english_verse: near Endor, and let their bodies rot.
translation_verse: mɛi ni akpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ En-Dor ni amɛtsɔ̃ tumo amɛhã shikpɔŋ.

english_verse: Treat their leaders as you did Oreb and Zeeb, Zebah and Zalmunna.
translation_verse: Feemɔ amɛlumɛi lɛ tamɔ ofee Oreb kɛ Zeeb lɛ; ye amɛlumɛi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kunim tamɔ ofee Zeba kɛ Zalmuna,

english_verse: All of them said, “We'll take God's valuable land!”
translation_verse: mɛi ni kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔŋɔa Yehowa ŋa shikpɔŋ lɛ wɔfea wɔnɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: Our God, scatter them around like dust in a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Oo miNyɔŋmɔ, gbɛɛ amɛ oshwã tamɔ lasuogbele mlu, tamɔ tutuu yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ naa.

english_verse: Just as flames destroy forests on the mountains,
translation_verse: Bɔ ni la shãa koo wɛɛ, bɔ ni lalilɛi maa gɔji anaa la lɛ,

english_verse: pursue and terrify them with storms of your own.
translation_verse: nakai okɛ ahum ashwie amɛ, ni okɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni naa wa lɛ awo amɛhe gbeyei.

english_verse: Make them blush with shame, until they turn and worship you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Hã amɛhiɛ agboi bɔ ni afee ni amɛtao bo, Yehowa, ogbɛi sɛɛgbɛ.

english_verse: Let them be forever ashamed and confused. Let them die in disgrace.
translation_verse: Hã amɛhiɛ agboi koni amɛye hejaramɔ kɛya naanɔ; hã amɛgboi kɛ hiɛgbele.

english_verse: Make them realize that you are the Lord Most High, the only ruler of earth!
translation_verse: Hã amɛna amɛle akɛ bo mɔ ni ogbɛi ji Yehowa lɛ, bo pɛ ji Ofe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, your temple is so lovely!
translation_verse: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, kwɛ bɔ ni oSɔlemɔ we lɛ yɔɔ akɔnɔ hã!

english_verse: Deep in my heart I long for your temple, and with all that I am I sing joyful songs to you.
translation_verse: Misusuma hiɛ miitse Yehowa kpoi lɛ anɔ; hiɛtselɛ lɛ hãa misusuma tɔɔ biti po. Mikɛ mitsui kɛ migbɔmɔtso fɛɛ laa kɛ miishɛɛ hãa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, my King and my God, sparrows find a home near your altars; swallows build nests there to raise their young.
translation_verse: Aflimata po naa eshihilɛhe; ni nyɔŋmɔbitɛte hu naa etsu he ni ekɛ ebii aaato yɛ ofɔleshãa latɛi lɛ ahe! Oo Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, mimaŋtsɛ kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ,

english_verse: You bless everyone who lives in your house, and they sing your praises.
translation_verse: kwɛ bɔ ni mɛi ni hiɔ owe lɛ yɔɔ miishɛɛ hã, ni amɛlaa daa kɛjieɔ oyi.

english_verse: You bless all who depend on you for their strength and all who deeply desire to visit your temple.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ mɛi ni odɛ̃ŋ amɛhewalɛ jɛɔ, mɛi ni gbɛfãa kɛyaa Zion Gɔŋ nɔ lɛ kã amɛtsui nɔ.

english_verse: When they reach Dry Valley, springs start flowing, and the autumn rain fills it with pools of water.
translation_verse: Kɛji amɛnyiɛ Baka jɔɔ lɛŋ kɛmiiho lɛ, amɛhãa jɛi tsɔ̃ɔ nuhiŋmɛi; ni Agbiɛnaa nu taraa shi yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: Your people grow stronger, and you, the God of gods, will be seen in Zion.
translation_verse: Amɛnyiɛɔ ni amɛhewalɛ nɔ gbɔɔɔ; amɛyanaa nyɔŋmɔi amli Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɛ Zion.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Jacob, please answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, Tai aNyɔŋmɔ, bo misɔlemɔ lɛ toi! Oo Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ, feemɔ toi ohã mi!

english_verse: You are the shield that protects your people, and I am your chosen one. Won't you smile on me?
translation_verse: Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, jɔɔmɔ wɔmaŋtsɛ lɛ, jɔɔmɔ mɔ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ.

english_verse: One day in your temple is better than a thousand anywhere else. I would rather serve in your house, than live in the homes of the wicked.
translation_verse: Gbi kometoo shihilɛ yɛ oSɔlemɔ we lɛ, ehi fe gbii akpe ni aaaye yɛ he kroko. Masumɔ matsɔ̃ shinaa naabulɔ yɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ, fe nɔ ni mahi efɔŋfeelɔi awe mli.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you are like the sun and also like a shield. You treat us with kindness and with honor, never denying any good thing to those who live right.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hulu kɛ tsɛŋ fɛɛ ji lɛ; eduroɔ mɔ, ni ewoɔ mɔ hiɛ nyam. Mɛi ni feɔ nɔ ni ja gbɛ lɛ Yehowa kãmãaa amɛ nɔ kpakpa ko nɔ kpakpa ko.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you bless everyone who trusts you.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ onɔ lɛ!

english_verse: Our Lord, you have blessed your land and made all go well for Jacob's descendants.
translation_verse: Yehowa, ona oshikpɔŋ lɛ mɔbɔ; ohã Israel esaa eshwere ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: You have forgiven the sin and taken away the guilt of your people.
translation_verse: Okɛ omaŋ lɛ he eshai lɛ efa amɛ, ni okɛ amɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ fɛɛ efa amɛ.

english_verse: Your fierce anger is no longer aimed at us.
translation_verse: Ofo omli ni fu amɛ lɛ sɛɛ, ni oŋmɛɛ omlila kpele lɛ he.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you save us! Please bring us back home and don't be angry.
translation_verse: Oo wɔyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, ŋɔɔ wɔ oto wɔtoohe ekoŋŋ ni ofo omli ni efu wɔ lɛ sɛɛ!

english_verse: Will you always be angry with us and our families?
translation_verse: Aso omli aaafu wɔ kɛaatee naanɔ? Oookã omlifu lɛ he kɛaaya yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ?

english_verse: Won't you give us fresh life and let your people be glad because of you?
translation_verse: Aso ohaŋ wɔyi ana wala ekoŋŋ, koni omaŋ lɛ anya kɛkafo bo?

english_verse: Show us your love and save us!
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, hã wɔna osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ, ni ohã wɔyi ana wala!

english_verse: I will listen to you, Lord God, because you promise peace to those who are faithful and no longer foolish.
translation_verse: Hã mabo nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaawie toi, ejaakɛ ekɛ emaŋ lɛ kɛ ehetselɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni kuɔ amɛsɛɛ kɛbaa eŋɔɔ kɛ amɛtsui fɛɛ lɛ, baawie hejɔlɛ wiemɔ.

english_verse: You are ready to rescue everyone who worships you, so that you will live with us in all your glory.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛŋ efee kralo kɛbaahere mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ ayiwala koni anunyam ahi wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Love and loyalty will come together; goodness and peace will unite.
translation_verse: Suɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛ anɔkwayeli baakpe; ni jalɛ kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ aaafua amɛhe atuu.

english_verse: Loyalty will sprout from the ground; justice will look down from the sky above.
translation_verse: Anɔkwayeli aaakwɛ̃ kɛaajɛ shikpɔŋ, ni jalɛ aaajɛ ŋwɛi egboo ehiɛ shi ekwɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will bless us; our land will produce wonderful crops.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ! Yehowa aaaŋɔ nɔ kpakpa ehã, ni wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ aaaba nii babaoo.

english_verse: Justice will march in front, making a path for you to follow.
translation_verse: Jalɛ saneyeli aaatsɔ̃ Yehowa hiɛ eba; ni ebaasaa gbɛ ehã lɛ.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord, and answer my prayer! I am poor and helpless.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, gboo otoi shi ohã mi, ni ohã mi hetoo! Ejaakɛ ohiafo ji mi, ni efĩ mi!

english_verse: Protect me and save me because you are my God. I am your faithful servant, and I trust you.
translation_verse: Baamɔ miwala yi, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔ ji mi. Heremɔ otsulɔ ni hiɛ kã onɔ lɛ yiwala.

english_verse: Be kind to me! I pray to you all day.
translation_verse: Oo Nuŋtsɔ, bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ; naa mi mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ bo mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ daa jenamɔ.

english_verse: Make my heart glad! I serve you, and my prayer is sincere.
translation_verse: Hã otsulɔ susuma mii ashɛ, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ, bo misɔleɔ mitsɛɔ.

english_verse: You willingly forgive, and your love is always there for those who pray to you.
translation_verse: Oo Nuŋtsɔ, ejaakɛ ohi, ni oŋɔɔ tɔ̃mɔ ofaa; ni suɔmɔ ni osumɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni sɔleɔ tsɛɔ bo lɛ fa babaoo.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord! Answer my prayer for help.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, feemɔ toi ohã misɔlemɔ, ni obo mifaikpamɔ blɔmɔ toi!

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray, knowing you will listen.
translation_verse: Mihaomɔ gbi nɔ lɛ, mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ bo, ejaakɛ ohereɔ mi nɔ.

english_verse: You created each nation, and they will all bow down to worship and honor you.
translation_verse: Oo Nuŋtsɔ, jeŋ majimaji fɛɛ ni bo obɔ lɛ aaaba abakoto bo; ni amɛbaawo ogbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam.

english_verse: You perform great wonders because you alone are God.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ oje agbo, ni ofeɔ naakpɛɛnii. Bo okoome pɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: Teach me to follow you, and I will obey your truth. Always keep me faithful.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi bɔ ni miba mijeŋ mihã koni maba mijeŋ yɛ onɔkwale lɛ naa. Hã mikɛ mitsui muu lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm ashe bo gbeyei.

english_verse: With all my heart I thank you. I praise you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Oo Nuŋtsɔ, miNyɔŋmɔ, miida bo shi kɛ mitsui fɛɛ, ni mawo ogbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam kɛaatee naanɔ.

english_verse: Your love for me is so great that you protected me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ kpele ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ fa hã mi. Ohere misusuma kɛje gbohiiaje tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: Proud and violent enemies, who don't care about you, have ganged up to attack and kill me.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, hewolɔi ete shi ewo mi; yiwalɔi asafo miitao misusuma sɛɛgbɛ, ni amɛkwɛɛɛ bo kwraa.

english_verse: But you, the Lord God, are kind and merciful. You don't easily get angry, and your love can always be trusted.
translation_verse: Oo Nuŋtsɔ, shi bo lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ musuŋtsɔlɔ kɛ durolɔ ji bo! Omli fuuu mra, ni osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ onɔkwayeli lɛ fa babaoo.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord, and I am the child of one of your servants. Look on me with kindness. Make me strong and save me.
translation_verse: Kwɛmɔ mi ni oduro mi, ŋɔɔ ohewalɛ ohã otsulɔ; heremɔ oweyoo bi lɛ yiwala.

english_verse: Show that you approve of me! Then my hateful enemies will feel like fools, because you have helped and comforted me.
translation_verse: Too mi suɔmɔ ni okɛsumɔɔ mi lɛ he okadi ko, koni mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ ana, ni amɛhiɛ agboi; ejaakɛ bo, Yehowa, oye obua mi, ni oshɛje mimii.

english_verse: Zion was built by the Lord on the holy mountain,
translation_verse: Gɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ to lɛ ma!

english_verse: and he loves that city more than any other place in all of Israel.
translation_verse: Yehowa sumɔɔ Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ fe Israel shihilɛhei fɛɛ!

english_verse: Zion, you are the city of God, and wonderful things are told about you.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ, agbaa ohe anunyam saji lɛ.

english_verse: Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia, Phoenicia, and Ethiopia are some of those nations that know you, and their people all say, “I was born in Zion.”
translation_verse: Matsi Ijipt kɛ Babilon tã mafata maji ni le mi lɛ ahe. Makane Filistibii kɛ Tirobii kɛ Kush mafata mɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ ahe. Ejaakɛ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ: “Mɔnɛ lɛ, lɛ lɛ, jɛi afɔ lɛ yɛ.”

english_verse: God Most High will strengthen the city of Zion. Then everyone will say, “We were born here too.”
translation_verse: Shi Zion lɛ, aaakɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, “Majimaji fɛɛ anɔ bii yɛ ni jɛi afɔ amɛ yɛ;” ni Ŋwɛinyo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baahã ema shi shiŋŋ.

english_verse: The Lord will make a list of his people, and all who were born here will be included.
translation_verse: Yehowa aaaŋmala maŋ lɛŋ bii agbɛii ewo woloŋ akɛ Yerusalɛmbii.

english_verse: All who sing or dance will say, “I too am from Zion.”
translation_verse: Mɛi ni laa kɛ mɛi ni joɔ fɛɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ: “Wɔjɔmɔi fɛɛ kwa jɛɔ Zion.”

english_verse: You keep me safe, Lord God. So when I pray at night,
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane fɛɛ lɛ, mibolɔɔ yɛ ohiɛ.

english_verse: please listen carefully to each of my concerns.
translation_verse: Hã misɔlemɔ ashɛ ohiɛ; gboo otoi shi ohã mibolɔmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I am deeply troubled and close to death;
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ haomɔi babaoo eba minɔ, ni miwala miibɛŋkɛ gbohiiaje.

english_verse: I am as good as dead and completely helpless.
translation_verse: Abuɔ mi ashiɔ mɛi ni yaa gbohiiaje anɔ. Mihewalɛ fɛɛ etã.

english_verse: I am no better off than those in the grave, those you have forgotten and no longer help.
translation_verse: Mitamɔ mɛi ni akwa amɛ yɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ eko. Mitamɔ mɛi ni nyɔnyɔɔi ni amɛkamɔ amɛgbonyobuiaŋ, tamɔ mɛi ni ohiɛ ekpa amɛnɔ kwraa lɛ eko, ejaakɛ obɛ wamɔ ko ni okɛbaawa amɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: You have put me in the deepest and darkest grave;
translation_verse: Oshɛ mi ofɔ gbonyobu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛŋ, he ni mli kwɔ ni ewo duŋ kpii lɛ.

english_verse: your anger rolls over me like ocean waves.
translation_verse: Omlifu lɛ kã minɔ, ni ohã oshɔkei lɛ fɛɛ ekumɔ eshwie minɔ.

english_verse: You have made my friends turn in horror from me. I am a prisoner who cannot escape,
translation_verse: Ohã minanemɛi ekwa mi; ohã mitsɔ̃ musumɔ mihã amɛ; aŋa miyi koni mikanyɛ kpo mije.

english_verse: and I am almost blind because of my sorrow. Each day I lift my hands in prayer to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Awerɛho ehã mihiŋmɛi eshiu. Oo Yehowa, mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ bo daa gbi, ni mikpãa miniji amli mihãa bo.

english_verse: Do you work miracles for the dead? Do they stand up and praise you?
translation_verse: Ani ofeɔ naakpɛɛnii ohãa gbohii lo? Ani sisai teɔ shi amɛ jieɔ oyi lo?

english_verse: Are your love and loyalty announced in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Ani agbaa omlihilɛ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ he sane yɛ gbonyobu mli lo? Aloo awieɔ onɔkwayeli lɛ he yɛ he ni hiɛkpãtãmɔ yɔɔ?

english_verse: Do they know of your miracles or your saving power in the dark world below where all is forgotten?
translation_verse: Ani anaa onaakpɛɛnii yɛ he ni ewo duŋ lo? Aloo akaiɔ oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni hiɛ kpaa nii anɔ yɛ nɔ lɛ?

english_verse: Each morning I pray to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, mi lɛ mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ bo; daa leebi maŋkpa lɛ misɔleɔ mitsɛɔ bo.

english_verse: Why do you reject me? Why do you turn from me?
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, mɛɛba oshɛ mi ofɔ̃? Mɛɛba ni okɛ ohiɛ etee mi?

english_verse: Ever since I was a child, I have been sick and close to death. You have terrified me and made me helpless.
translation_verse: Kɛjɛ migbekɛbiiashi beebe lɛ minii yɛ mɔbɔ; ni miihe magbo. Ohe ŋmiŋmi emɔ mi, ni mijijaa.

english_verse: Your anger is like a flood! And I am shattered by your furious attacks
translation_verse: Omlifu ni naa wa lɛ esu mi! Ohe ŋmiŋmi ekpãtã mihiɛ!

english_verse: that strike each day and from every side.
translation_verse: Gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ, ohe ŋmiŋmi lɛ ebɔle mihe tamɔ nu afua, efo mihe sa kɛkpe.

english_verse: My friends and neighbors have turned against me because of you, and now darkness is my only companion.
translation_verse: Ohã shieŋtsɛmɛi kɛ nanemɛi fɛɛ ekwa mi, ni duŋ pɛ ji minaanyo ni eshwɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, I will sing of your love forever. Everyone yet to be born will hear me praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, mala osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ he lala kɛya naanɔ fɛɛ. Mikɛ minaabu baajaje onɔkwayeli lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ yinɔi fɛɛ.

english_verse: I will tell them, “God's love can always be trusted, and his faithfulness lasts as long as the heavens.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ yɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ, ni onɔkwayeli lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ tamɔ ŋwɛi.

english_verse: You said, “David, my servant, is my chosen one, and this is the agreement I made with him:
translation_verse: Okɛɛ akɛ, “Mikɛ mɔ ni mihala lɛ ekpãŋ. Mikã mitsulɔ David kitã akɛ,

english_verse: Our Lord, let the heavens now praise your miracles, and let all your angels praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, hã ŋwɛi ajie onaakpɛɛnii yi; ni mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ajie onɔkwayeli lɛ hu yi yɛ asafo lɛ mli!

english_verse: None who live in the heavens can compare with you.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ namɔ yɔɔ atatuiaŋ ni ekɛ bo, Yehowa, ye hegbɔ? Ŋwɛibii lɛ ateŋ namɔ yɔɔ ni etamɔ Yehowa?

english_verse: You are the most fearsome of all who live in heaven; all the others fear and greatly honor you.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ ni asheɔ lɛ gbeyei yɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi agwabɔɔ lɛŋ, Nyɔŋmɔ kpeteŋkple ni he yɔɔ gbeyei fe mɛi fɛɛ ni bɔle lɛ kɛkpe lɛ.

english_verse: You are Lord God All-Powerful! No one is as loving and faithful as you are.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ Taiatsɛ, Oo! Namɔ ji hewalɛtsɛ tamɔ bo, Yehowa? Onɔkwayeli ebɔle ohe kpula kɛkpe!

english_verse: You rule the roaring sea and calm its waves.
translation_verse: Oyɛ ŋshɔ grimɔ nɔ hewalɛ! Kɛji emli ŋshɔkei lɛ hole amɛhe nɔ lɛ, bo ojɔɔ amɛhe.

english_verse: You crushed the monster Rahab, and with your powerful arm you scattered your enemies.
translation_verse: Otserɛ Rehab ni ji ŋshɔŋ kooloo awuiyelɔ lɛ mli, ni ogbe lɛ, ni okɛ ohewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ gbɛ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ oshwã.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth belong to you. And so does the world with all its people because you created them
translation_verse: Ŋwɛi lɛ onɔ ni, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ hu onɔ ni; je lɛ kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ lɛ, bo nɔŋŋ obɔ.

english_verse: and everything else. Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon gladly praise you.
translation_verse: Bo obɔ kooyi kɛ wuoyi fɛɛ. Tabor Gɔŋ lɛ kɛ Hermon Gɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ kɛ miishɛɛ jieɔ ogbɛi lɛ yi.

english_verse: Your kingdom is ruled by justice and fairness with love and faithfulness leading the way.
translation_verse: Omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ato shishi ama jalɛ kɛ jalɛ saneyeli nɔ. Anaa suɔmɔ kɛ anɔkwayeli yɛ onɔ fɛɛ nɔ feemɔ mli.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who join in the festival and walk in the brightness of your presence.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ mɛi ni le gbijurɔyeli lala lɛ, mɛi ni baa amɛjeŋ bɔ ni sa bo, Yehowa, ohiɛ lɛ;

english_verse: We are happy all day because of you, and your saving power brings honor to us.
translation_verse: mɛi ni amɛmli filiɔ amɛ gbi muu fɛɛ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ ni amɛkafoɔ ojalɛ lɛ;

english_verse: Your own glorious power makes us strong, and because of your kindness, our strength increases.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ bo ji amɛhewalɛ lɛ nyam. Oduromɔ hãa wɔyeɔ kunim.

english_verse: Our Lord and our King, the Holy One of Israel, you are truly our shield.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bo Yehowa ji mɔ ni fã wɔhe lɛ; ni bo, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, bo owo maŋtsɛ ohã wɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ wo David shi

english_verse: In a vision, you once said to your faithful followers: “I have helped a mighty hero. I chose him from my people and made him famous.
translation_verse: Blema ko lɛ okɛ otsuji anɔkwafoi lɛ wie yɛ ninaa mli akɛ, “Miye mibua kãkãlɔ ko, miŋɔ mɔ ko yɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ ni miwo enɔ.

english_verse: David, my servant, is the one I chose to be king,
translation_verse: Mina mitsulɔ David; mifɔ lɛ mimu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mikɛto lɛ maŋtsɛ.

english_verse: and I will always be there to help and strengthen him.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, minine aaahiɛ emli daa; mihewalɛ lɛ aaahã efi shi.

english_verse: “No enemy will outsmart David, and he won't be defeated by any hateful people.
translation_verse: Ehenyɛlɔ nine tsɔŋ enɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ; yiwalɔ ko yeŋ enɔ kunim.

english_verse: I will strike down and crush his troublesome enemies.
translation_verse: Mibakpãtã ehenyɛlɔi ahiɛ yɛ ehiɛ, ni mibatswia mɛi ni nyɛɔ lɛ lɛ nii.

english_verse: He will always be able to depend on my love, and I will make him strong with my own power.
translation_verse: Maye lɛ anɔkwa, ni masumɔ lɛ kɛ misuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ; ni migbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ehewalɛ lɛ nɔ aaakwɔ.

english_verse: I will let him rule the lands across the rivers and seas.
translation_verse: Mibagbele emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli kɛjɛ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ naa kɛyamɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ.

english_verse: He will say to me, ‘You are my Father and my God, as well as the mighty rock where I am safe.’
translation_verse: Eeebo, ni eeekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Bo ji miTsɛ kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ kɛ mihebuu Tɛsaa!’

english_verse: “I have chosen David as my first-born son, and he will be the ruler of all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Mafee lɛ mikromɔbi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ wulu fe fɛɛ.

english_verse: My love for him will last, and my agreement with him will never be broken.
translation_verse: Majɛ misuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ mli mana lɛ mɔbɔ kɛaatee naanɔ; ni mi kɛ lɛ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ aaama shi shiŋŋ.

english_verse: “One of David's descendants will always be king, and his family will rule until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: Mahã eseshi ahi shi daa, ni emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ aaahi shi, beiaŋ ni ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ yɔɔ nɛɛ.

english_verse: Suppose some of his children should reject my Law and refuse my instructions.
translation_verse: Kɛji eshwiei lɛ kwa mimla lɛ, ni amɛbaaa amɛjeŋ yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa,

english_verse: Or suppose they should disobey all of my teachings.
translation_verse: kɛji amɛbule mikpɔi lɛ, ni amɛyeee mikitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ,

english_verse: Then I will correct and punish them because of their sins.
translation_verse: no lɛ mikɛ dade tete aaagwao amɛ, yɛ amɛtɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ; ni mikɛ kpelebi aaayi amɛ, yɛ amɛnishaianii lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: But I will always love David and faithfully keep all of my promises to him.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ misuɔmɔ ni tsakeee ni miyɔɔ hã David lɛ sɛɛ efoŋ, ni shi ni miwo lɛ lɛ, mikwaŋ.

english_verse: “I won't break my agreement or go back on my word.
translation_verse: Mikuŋ mi kɛ lɛ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, ni nɔ ni eje minaa lɛ, mikpaleŋ.

english_verse: I have sworn once and for all by my own holy name, and I won't lie to David.
translation_verse: “Mina mikɛ migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ekã mihe kitã momo; milakaŋ David.

english_verse: His family will always rule. I will let his kingdom last as long as the sun
translation_verse: Eshwiei aaahi shi daa kɛaatee naanɔ, ni emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ aaahi shi gbii abɔ ni hulu teɔ shi ni enyɔɔ shi nɛɛ.

english_verse: You are now angry, Lord, and you have turned your back on your chosen king.
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ okwa lɛ, ni oshɛ lɛ ofɔ̃; omli efu mɔ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ.

english_verse: You broke off your agreement with your servant, the king, and you completely destroyed his kingdom.
translation_verse: Oku okɛ otsulɔ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, okɛ ekekre lɛ eshwishwia shikpɔŋ, ni obule lɛ.

english_verse: The walls of his city have been broken through, and every fortress now lies in ruins.
translation_verse: Okumɔ emaŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ oshwie shi, ni ofee emɔji lɛ koikoi.

english_verse: All who pass by take what they want, and nations everywhere joke about the king.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɛɛ ni hoɔ lɛ haa enii; ni ehe gbɔmɛi tete bɔɔ lɛ ahora.

english_verse: You made his enemies powerful and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Ohã ehenyɛlɔi anine etsɔ̃ enɔ; ohã ehenyɛlɔi fɛɛ miinya.

english_verse: But you forced him to retreat because you did not fight on his side.
translation_verse: Ohã eklante lɛ naa fee kutuushii yɛ ta mli, ni owaaa lɛ yɛ ta naa.

english_verse: You took his crown and threw his throne in the dirt.
translation_verse: Oshɔ̃ maŋtsɛyeli tsi lɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni oŋɔ emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ otswa shi.

english_verse: You made an old man of him and put him to shame.
translation_verse: Ohã esha egbɔ; ohã hiɛgbele eloo lɛ. Kpɔmɔ he sɔlemɔ

english_verse: How much longer, Lord? Will you hide forever? How long will your anger keep burning like fire?
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, kɛyaashi mɛɛbe? Oooŋɔ ohe otee kɛyashi naanɔ lo? Mɛɛbe omlifu lɛ aaatso tamɔ la kɛyashi?

english_verse: Remember, life is short! Why did you empty our lives of all meaning?
translation_verse: Oo Nuŋtsɔ, kaimɔ akɛ gbɔmɔ wala be shɛɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko, ni obɔ adesã akɛ yaka nɔ ko kɛkɛ.

english_verse: No one can escape the power of death and the grave.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ adesã yɔɔ jeŋ, ni lɛ lɛ esaŋ enaa gbele? Namɔ aaanyɛ ehe ehere yɛ gbohiiaje dɛŋ?

english_verse: Our Lord, where is the love you have always shown and that you promised so faithfully to David?
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ, nɛgbɛ oblema suɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ yɔɔ? Nɔ ni ojɛ onɔkwayeli lɛ mli okã David ehe kitã lɛ?

english_verse: Remember your servant, Lord! People make jokes about me, and I suffer many insults.
translation_verse: Oo Nuŋtsɔ, kaimɔ bɔ ni abɔɔ otsulɔ ahora ahãa lɛ, bɔ ni mɛi adɛŋ ahorabɔɔ hãa migbigbliɔ mimli lɛ.

english_verse: I am your chosen one, but your enemies chase and make fun of me.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, ohenyɛlɔi lɛ bɔɔ mɔ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ ahora; amɛbɔɔ lɛ ahora yɛ he fɛɛ he ni etsɔ̃ɔ kɛhoɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, we praise you forever. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa kɛya naanɔ! Amen! Amen!

english_verse: ) God Is Eternal
translation_verse: ) Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ Mose sɔlemɔ Mose sɔlemɔ ko.

english_verse: Our Lord, in all generations you have been our home.
translation_verse: Oo Nuŋtsɔ, bo ji wɔbobaahe yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ mli.

english_verse: You have always been God— long before the birth of the mountains, even before you created the earth and the world.
translation_verse: Be ni onako obɔ gɔji lɛ, ni onako obɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ jeŋ lɛ, bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: At your command we die and turn back to dust,
translation_verse: Okɛɔ akɛ, “Nyɛ gbɔmɛi abii, nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nyɛbaa!” Ni ohãa adesa kuɔ esɛɛ etsɔ̃ɔ sũ.

english_verse: but a thousand years mean nothing to you! They are merely a day gone by or a few hours in the night.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ohiɛ lɛ, afii akpe tamɔ nyɛ kpaakpa nyɛ, ni ebaho kɛtee; etamɔ nyɔɔŋ buu be pɛ.

english_verse: You bring our lives to an end just like a dream. We are merely tender grass
translation_verse: Oloɔ adesai kɛyaa tamɔ faa loɔ nii; amɛtsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ lamɔ ni alaa; amɛtamɔ jwɛi ni feɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ leebi mli;

english_verse: that sprouts and grows in the morning, but dries up by evening.
translation_verse: amɛfeɔ floŋŋ, ni amɛgbaa afofro; gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ amɛgbiɔ, ni amɛkpalaa.

english_verse: Your furious anger frightens and destroys us,
translation_verse: Wɔhiɛ miikpãtã yɛ omlifu lɛ naa; ni omlila lɛ he ŋmiŋmi emɔ wɔ.

english_verse: and you know all our sins, even those we do in secret.
translation_verse: Oŋɔ wɔnishaianii lɛ oto ohiɛ, ni wɔdujiaŋ eshai lɛ, yɛ ohiɛ faŋŋ.

english_verse: Your anger is a burden each day we live, then life ends like a sigh.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔgbii lɛ hoɔ oya yɛ omlifu lɛ naa; wɔyeɔ wɔfii lɛ hiŋmɛitswaa mli.

english_verse: We can expect seventy years, or maybe eighty, if we are healthy, but even our best years bring trouble and sorrow. Suddenly our time is up, and we disappear.
translation_verse: Wɔwalaŋ afii lɛ, afii nyɔŋmai kpawo ni. Kɛji efa aahu lɛ, afii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ, kɛji gbɔmɔtsoŋ hewalɛ yɛ; shi amɛmli shwãanii lɛ, tɔlɛ kɛ deŋme sɔŋŋ ni. Wɔwala sɛɛ foɔ oya, ni wɔlaajeɔ kwraa.

english_verse: No one knows the full power of your furious anger, but it is as great as the fear that we owe to you.
translation_verse: Namɔ le omlifu lɛ mli walɛ? Namɔ le gbeyei ni esa akɛ asheɔ bo yɛ omlila lɛ hewɔ?

english_verse: Teach us to use wisely all the time we have.
translation_verse: Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ koni wɔle wɔwalagbii lɛ ayibɔ koni wɔhiɛ akã shi?

english_verse: Help us, Lord! Don't wait! Pity your servants.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, mɛɛ be yinɔ nɔŋŋ omli aaafu kɛyashi? Naa otsuji mɔbɔ.
