english_verse: When morning comes, let your love satisfy all our needs. Then we can celebrate and be glad for what time we have left.
translation_verse: Hã wɔtɔrɔ leebi kɛ osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ, koni wɔnya ni wɔmii ashɛ, wɔwala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Do wonderful things for us, your servants, and show your mighty power to our children.
translation_verse: Hã wɔ ni ji otsuji lɛ ana onitsumɔi wuji lɛ, ni wɔshwiei hu ana onunyam kpele lɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, treat us with kindness and let all go well for us. Please let all go well!
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ana wɔ mɔbɔ; ehã wɔniji anaa nitsumɔi ashwere ahã wɔ! Hɛɛ! Wɔniji anaa nitsumɔi lɛ hã amɛshwere.

english_verse: Live under the protection of God Most High and stay in the shadow of God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni hiɔ Ŋwɛinyo lɛ teemɔhe lɛ, ni ehiɔ Ofe lɛ hɔɔŋ lɛ shishi lɛ,

english_verse: Then you will say to the Lord, “You are my fortress, my place of safety; you are my God, and I trust you.”
translation_verse: eeekɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Mibobaahe kɛ mimɔɔ ji bo, miNyɔŋmɔ hu ni mihiɛ kã enɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord will keep you safe from secret traps and deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ lɛ ebaajie bo kɛje henyɛlɔi adujiaŋ tsɔne kɛ gbele hela ni naa wa mli.

english_verse: He will spread his wings over you and keep you secure. His faithfulness is like a shield or a city wall.
translation_verse: Ekɛ etsɛji aaaha onɔ, ni ooona abobaahe yɛ efiji ashishi. Enɔkwayeli lɛ, tsɛŋ kɛ dama ni.

english_verse: You won't need to worry about dangers at night or arrows during the day.
translation_verse: Osheŋ nyɔɔŋ ŋmiŋmi loo gãimlibi ni atsɛ̃ shwane gbeyei;

english_verse: And you won't fear diseases that strike in the dark or sudden disaster at noon.
translation_verse: loo gbele hela ni nyiɛɔ duŋ mli, loo hela ni kpãtãa mɔ hiɛ shwane lɛ.

english_verse: You will not be harmed, though thousands fall all around you.
translation_verse: Kɛji mɛi akpe nyɔ yɛ omasɛi, ni mɛi akpei nyɔŋma nyɔ yɛ oninejurɔ nɔ po lɛ, bo lɛ ebɛŋkɛŋ bo.

english_verse: And with your own eyes you will see the punishment of the wicked.
translation_verse: Ohiŋmɛi kɛkɛ okɛaakwɛ, ni ooona mɛi fɔ̃ji anyɔmɔwo.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is your fortress. Run to him for safety,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ okɛ Yehowa efee ohebulɔ; Ofee Ŋwɛinyo lɛ oteemɔhe,

english_verse: and no terrible disasters will strike you or your home.
translation_verse: no hewɔ lɛ, nɔ fɔŋ ko efeŋ bo, ni haomɔ ko haomɔ ko bɛŋkɛŋ oshihilɛhe lɛ.

english_verse: God will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaawo ebɔfoi lɛ kitã yɛ ohewɔ ni amɛbu ohe, koni amɛbaa oyi yɛ he fɛɛ he ni oyaa.

english_verse: They will carry you in their arms, and you won't hurt your feet on the stones.
translation_verse: Amɛaahiɛ bo yɛ amɛdɛ̃, koni okaŋɔ onane oshi tɛ ko.

english_verse: You will overpower the strongest lions and the most deadly snakes.
translation_verse: Ooonyiɛ jata kɛ shikpãa nɔ po, ooonaanaa jatabi kɛ jeŋ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord says, “If you love me and truly know who I am, I will rescue you and keep you safe.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni sumɔɔ mi lɛ, majie amɛ, ni mɛi ni le migbɛi lɛ mabu amɛhe.

english_verse: When you are in trouble, call out to me. I will answer and be there to protect and honor you.
translation_verse: Kɛji amɛtsɛ mi lɛ, mahere amɛ nɔ. Mi kɛ amɛ aaahi shi yɛ haomɔ mli; mahere amɛ, ni mawo amɛhiɛ nyam.

english_verse: You will live a long life and see my saving power.”
translation_verse: Mahã amɛtɔ kɛ walasɛɛtsɛlɛ, ni mahã amɛna miyiwalaheremɔ lɛ.

english_verse: It is wonderful to be grateful and to sing your praises, Lord Most High!
translation_verse: Ehi akɛ ada Yehowa shi, ni ala kɛjie, bo Ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ, ogbɛi lɛ yi.

english_verse: It is wonderful each morning to tell about your love and at night to announce how faithful you are.
translation_verse: Ehi akɛ ashiɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ he sane daa leebi, koni agba onɔkwayeli lɛ he sane daa gbɛkɛ

english_verse: I enjoy praising your name to the music of harps,
translation_verse: kɛ kpãa saŋku kɛ obenta.

english_verse: because everything you do makes me happy, and I sing joyful songs.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ, bo Yehowa, onifeemɔ nii ehã mimii eshɛ mihe, ni oninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ hãa milaa kɛ miishɛɛ.

english_verse: You do great things, Lord. Your thoughts are too deep
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, kwɛ bɔ ni onitsumɔi lɛ dara hã! Ni ojwɛŋmɔ mli kwɔ naakpa.

english_verse: for an ignorant fool to know or understand.
translation_verse: Enɛ ji nɔ ko ni buulu nyɛɛɛ ale, ni kwashia hu nyɛɛɛ shishi anu,

english_verse: Though the wicked sprout and spread like grass, they will be pulled up by their roots.
translation_verse: akɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji miifu gblɔ̃gblɔ̃ tamɔ jwɛi, ni efɔŋfeelɔi miishwere; kɛ̃lɛ naanɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛkɛ ji nɔ ni kã shi hã amɛ;

english_verse: But you will rule over all of us forever,
translation_verse: ejaakɛ, bo, Yehowa ji Ofe kɛmiiya naanɔ.

english_verse: and your hateful enemies will be scattered and then destroyed.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Oo Yehowa! Ohenyɛlɔi lɛ, Ohenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ baakpãtã kɛ̃. Mɛi fɛɛ ni tsuɔ nishaianii lɛ, aaagbɛ amɛ ashwã.

english_verse: You have given me the strength of a wild ox, and you have chosen me to be your very own.
translation_verse: Shi ohã mihe ewa tamɔ wuo, ni ohã mimii eshɛ mihe.

english_verse: My eyes have seen, and my ears have heard the doom and destruction of my evil enemies.
translation_verse: Mina mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ashigbeemɔ kɛ mihiŋmɛi, ni mikɛ mitoi hu enu mɛi ni te shi wo mi lɛ ahiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Good people will prosper like palm trees, and they will grow strong like the cedars of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Jalɔ aaafrɔke tamɔ tɛŋ, ni eeeda tamɔ tsenedru ni ma Lebanon.

english_verse: They will take root in your house, Lord God, and they will do well.
translation_verse: Amɛtamɔ tsei ni atɛo yɛ Yehowa we lɛŋ; amɛfrɔkeɔ yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kpoi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: They will be like trees that stay healthy and fruitful, even when they are old.
translation_verse: Amɛaakã he amɛwo yibii yɛ amɛgbɔlɛ beiaŋ tete, ni amɛaahi frɔ̃frɔ̃ kɛ amɛmli nu daa

english_verse: And they will say about you, “The Lord always does right! God is our mighty rock.”
translation_verse: koni amɛkɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Yehowa lɛ jalɔ ni. Lɛ ji mitɛsaa, ni nɔ ko ni ejaaa gbɛ bɛ egbɛfaŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! Majesty and power are your royal robes. You put the world in place, and it will never be moved.
translation_verse: Yehowa miiye maŋtsɛ; ewula kɛ agbojee; Yehowa ewula; emia kɛ hewalɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, je lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ, ni anyɛŋ ahoso.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you are eternal.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, omaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ema shi shiŋŋ kɛjɛ teteete, ni bo oyɔɔ kɛjɛ naanɔ beebe.

english_verse: The ocean is roaring, Lord! The sea is pounding hard.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, fai lɛ ewo amɛhe nɔ; fai lɛ ewo amɛgbee nɔ, fai lɛ ewo amɛhũumɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Its mighty waves are majestic, but you are even more majestic, and you rule over all.
translation_verse: Yehowa ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ je agbo fe fɛɛ. Eje agbo fe nui babaoo lɛ agbɛɛmɔ; efe ŋshɔkei ahewalɛ.

english_verse: Your decisions are firm, and your temple will always be beautiful and holy.
translation_verse: Yehowa, okpɔi lɛ anɔkwale ni, Owe lɛ he tse krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛyaashi naanɔ.

english_verse: Lord God, you punish the guilty. Show what you are like and punish them now.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, bo Nuŋtsɔ ni otɔɔ owele, bo Nyɔŋmɔ ni otɔɔ owele, hã ana omlifu.

english_verse: You judge the earth. Come and help us! Pay back those proud people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Oo je lɛ kojolɔ, wo ohe nɔ, koni owo hewolɔi lɛ nyɔmɔ bɔ ni sa amɛ.

english_verse: How long will the wicked celebrate and be glad?
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, mɛɛ beyinɔ, mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ni mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ aaanya kɛyashi?

english_verse: All of those cruel people strut and boast,
translation_verse: Amɛwieɔ amɛdaa obɔ̃, amɛwieɔ hewoo wiemɔi; mɛi ni feɔ nishaianii lɛ fɛɛ shwãa.

english_verse: and they crush and wound your chosen nation, Lord.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, amɛmiinaanaa owebii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛmiipiŋ omɛi lɛ.

english_verse: They murder widows, foreigners, and orphans.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, amɛgbeɔ yoo okulafo kɛ gbɔi, ni amɛgbeɔ awusai hu,

english_verse: Then they say, “The Lord God of Jacob doesn't see or know.”
translation_verse: ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ “Yehowa enaaa, ni Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yooo sɛɛ.”

english_verse: Can't you fools see? Won't you ever learn?
translation_verse: Oo, nyɛ maŋ lɛŋ kwashiai, nyɛyoa sɛɛ! Ni nyɛ, buului, te be ni nyɛaale nii lɛ?

english_verse: God gave us ears and eyes! Can't he hear and see?
translation_verse: Lɛ mɔ ni ebɔ toi lɛ, aso enuuu nii? Lɛ mɔ ni ebɔ hiŋmɛi lɛ, aso enaaa nii?

english_verse: God instructs the nations and gives knowledge to us all. Won't he also correct us?
translation_verse: Lɛ mɔ ni ekuneɔ jeŋ maji lɛ, aso etsɔseee mɔ lo?

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone that you instruct and teach by using your Law.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni bo, Yehowa, otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nii, gbɔmɔ ni ojɛɔ omla lɛ mli otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nii lɛ,

english_verse: You give them rest from their troubles, until a pit can be dug for the wicked.
translation_verse: bɔ ni afee ni ohã ehe ajɔ lɛ fioo, yɛ fimɔ gbii amli, kɛyaashi aaatsa bu ni akɛdu mɔ fɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You won't turn your back on your chosen nation.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa kwaŋ emaŋ lɛ, ejeŋ emɛi lɛ asɛɛ,

english_verse: Justice and fairness will go hand in hand, and all who do right will follow along.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ aaaku sɛɛ aye jalɛ sane yɛ kojomɔhei lɛ, ni jalɔi fɛɛ aaafĩ sɛɛ kɛ amɛtsuiŋ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Who will stand up for me against those cruel people?
translation_verse: Namɔ aaate shi awo efɔŋfeelɔi ahã mi? Namɔ aaadamɔ shi ashi mɛi ni tsuɔ nishaianii ahã mi?

english_verse: If you had not helped me, Lord, I would soon have gone to the land of silence.
translation_verse: Kɛjeee Yehowa ni ye bua mi lɛ, kulɛ benɛ misusuma yɛ gbohiiaje kpoo.

english_verse: When I felt my feet slipping, you came with your love and kept me steady.
translation_verse: Be ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Miishane lɛ!” Yehowa, osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ mɔ mimli.

english_verse: And when I was burdened with worries, you comforted me and made me feel secure.
translation_verse: Kɛji mikɔmɔyeli fa yɛ mimli lɛ, oshɛjeɔ mimii, ni mimii shɛɔ mihe.

english_verse: who gang up to murder innocent victims.
translation_verse: Amɛkpãŋɔ jalɔ yinɔ, ni amɛbuɔ lá ni efeko efɔŋ ko gbele fɔ.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my fortress, that mighty rock where I am safe.
translation_verse: Shi Yehowa ji mimɔɔ ni wa, ni miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji mibobaa tɛsaa.

english_verse: You will pay back my enemies, and you will wipe them out for the evil they did.
translation_verse: Ebaahã amɛnishaianii lɛ abua amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiteŋ; ni eeekpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ ahewɔ. Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaabɛɛ amɛ ashwie.

english_verse: Sing joyful songs to the Lord! Praise the mighty rock where we are safe.
translation_verse: Oo nyɛbaa, nyɛhãa wɔlaa wɔhãa Yehowa! Nyɛhãa wɔbɔa oshe wɔhãa wɔYiwalaheremɔ Tɛsaa lɛ!

english_verse: Come to worship him with thankful hearts and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Nyɛhãa wɔbaa ehiɛ kɛ shidaa, wɔkɛ lala abɔa oshe kɛjiea eyi.

english_verse: The Lord is the greatest God, king over all other gods.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kpeteŋkple ji Yehowa, Maŋtsɛ ni fe nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ.

english_verse: He holds the deepest part of the earth in his hands, and the mountain peaks also belong to him.
translation_verse: Edɛŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi yɔɔ, gɔji grɔŋŋi lɛ ayiteiaŋ hu enɔ ni.

english_verse: The ocean is the Lord's because he made it, and with his own hands he formed the dry land.
translation_verse: Ŋshɔ lɛ enɔ ni, ni lɛ ebɔ; ni shikpɔŋ gbiŋ lɛ hu eniji ni shɔ̃.

english_verse: Bow down and worship the Lord our Creator!
translation_verse: Oo, nyɛbaa! Nyɛhãa wɔkotoa lɛ, ni wɔjaa lɛ! Nyɛhãa wɔkulaa shi yɛ Yehowa, wɔBɔlɔ lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and we are his people, the sheep he takes care of in his own pasture. Listen to God's voice today!
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ lɛ ji wɔNyɔŋmɔ, ni wɔji elɛɛhe lɛŋ mɛi kɛ edɛŋ toi. Oo, mina ni kulɛ ŋmɛnɛ nyɛbo egbee toi!

english_verse: Don't be stubborn and rebel as your ancestors did at Meribah and Massah out in the desert.
translation_verse: Nyɛkawajea nyɛtsuii tamɔ eba lɛ yɛ Meriba lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni amɛfee yɛ Masa gbi lɛ nɔ, yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: For forty years they tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: Be ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tsɔ̃ minaa, amɛka mi amɛkwɛ, tsɛbelɛ, amɛna nibii ni mifee mihã amɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Then God got tired of them and said, “You never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.”
translation_verse: Afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ, nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ asane je mitsine, ni mikɛɛ akɛ “amɛ ji maŋ ko ni yeee anɔkwa, ni amɛbuuu mimlai lɛ.”

english_verse: In his anger, God told them, “You people will never enter my place of rest.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mikã kitã yɛ mimlifu mli akɛ, “Kɛ amɛna amɛshɛ hejɔlɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ fĩĩ!”

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord,
translation_verse: Oo, nyɛlaa lala hee nyɛhãa Yehowa! Jeŋ fɛɛ, nyɛlaa nyɛhãa Yehowa!

english_verse: sing and praise his name. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Nyɛlaa nyɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛjiea egbɛi lɛ yi! Nyɛgbaa wɔyiwala ni ehere he sane lɛ gbi fɛɛ gbi.

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Nyɛshiɛa enunyam lɛ, yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ! Nyɛgbaa naakpɛɛnii ni efee lɛ nyɛtsɔa mɛi fɛɛ!

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa je agbo, ni esa yijiemɔ babaoo, ni esa akɛ asheɔ lɛ gbeyei fe nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ.

english_verse: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ maji krokomɛi anyɔŋmɔi lɛ, amãgãi ni; shi Yehowa ji mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi lɛ.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: Anunyam kɛ agbojee ebɔle ehe, hewalɛ kɛ fɛo eyi ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ obɔ̃.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Oo maji amli wekui, nyɛkafoa Yehowa; nyɛkafoa enunyam kɛ hewalɛ lɛ!

english_verse: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ anunyam ni sa Yehowa gbɛi lɛ ahãa lɛ; nyɛhiɛa afɔlei kɛbaa, nyɛbaa ekpoi lɛ anɔ!

english_verse: Everyone on earth, now tremble and worship the Lord, majestic and holy.”
translation_verse: Je lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛkotoa kɛjaa Yehowa kɛji epue yɛ egbojeiaŋ! Nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ, nyɛhe akpokpoa yɛ ehiɛ!

english_verse: Announce to the nations, “The Lord is King! The world stands firm, never to be shaken, and he will judge its people with fairness.”
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛa yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ akɛ, “Yehowa miiye maŋtsɛ! No hewɔ je lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ, ni anyɛŋ lɛ ahoso. Eeekojo gbɔmɛi yɛ jalɛ naa.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures
translation_verse: Ŋwɛi anya! Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ mli afili lɛ! Hã ŋshɔ ahũu kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ!

english_verse: and the fields to rejoice with all their crops. Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs
translation_verse: Ŋa abɔ oshe kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ emli! Kɛkɛ lɛ kooŋ tsei fɛɛ aaala kɛ miishɛɛ,

english_verse: to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth with fairness and truth.
translation_verse: yɛ Yehowa hiɛ ejaakɛ eeba; eeba koni ebakojo shikpɔŋ lɛ. Ebaakojo je lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa; ebaakojo adesa yɛ anɔkwayeli naa.

english_verse: The Lord is King! Tell the earth to celebrate and all islands to shout.
translation_verse: Yehowa miiye maŋtsɛ! Shikpɔŋ lɛ mli afili lɛ! Ŋshɔkpɔi babaoo lɛ anya!

english_verse: Dark clouds surround him, and his throne is supported by justice and fairness.
translation_verse: Oblɔtu kɛ duŋ kpii ebɔle lɛ kɛkpe! Emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ma jalɛ kɛ jalɛ saneyeli nɔ.

english_verse: Fire leaps from his throne, destroying his enemies,
translation_verse: La tsoɔ kɛnyiɛɔ ehiɛ, ni ekpãtãa ehenyɛlɔi ni bɔle lɛ lɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: and his lightning is so bright that the earth sees it and trembles.
translation_verse: Esrawai lɛ hãa jeŋ tseɔ, je lɛ naa enɛ, ni ekpokpoɔ.

english_verse: Mountains melt away like wax in the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Gɔji lɛ sereɔ tamɔ wo agbaku yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: The heavens announce, “The Lord brings justice!” Everyone sees God's glory.
translation_verse: Ŋwɛi jajeɔ ejalɛ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ, ni maji fɛɛ tswɛm naa enunyam lɛ.

english_verse: Those who brag about the useless idols they worship are terribly ashamed, and all the false gods bow down to the Lord.
translation_verse: Amãgã jalɔi fɛɛ, mɛi ni shwãa fɔ̃ɔ yakayaka amãgãi anɔ lɛ, ahiɛ aaagboi. Nyɛ nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ tswɛm, nyɛkotoa Yehowa.

english_verse: When the people of Zion and of the towns of Judah hear that God brings justice, they will celebrate.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, Zion nu he, ni emii shɛ ehe; ni Yuda maji lɛ amli fili amɛ, yɛ okojomɔi lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: The Lord rules the whole earth, and he is more glorious than all the false gods.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa, bo ji Ofe, mɔ ni kwɔ fe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Awo onɔ gojoo kɛteke nyɔŋmɔi lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Love the Lord and hate evil! God protects his loyal people and rescues them from violence.
translation_verse: Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛsumɔɔ Yehowa lɛ, nyɛnyɛa efɔŋ! Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baa emɛi anɔkwafoi lɛ awala yi; ehereɔ amɛyiwala kɛjeɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji adɛŋ.

english_verse: If you obey and do right, a light will show you the way and fill you with happiness.
translation_verse: La aaakpɛ ahã jalɔ, ni miishɛɛ aaaba ahã mɔ ni ja yɛ etsuiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people! So celebrate and praise the only God.
translation_verse: Oo, nyɛ jalɔi, nyɛnyaa yɛ nɔ ni Yehowa efee hewɔ! Ni nyɛjiea egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yi kɛ shidaa.

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! He has worked miracles, and with his own powerful arm, he has won the victory.
translation_verse: Oo, nyɛlaa lala hee nyɛhãa Yehowa, ejaakɛ efee naakpɛɛnii. Ejɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehewalɛ krɔŋŋ lɛŋ eye kunim ehã ehe.

english_verse: The Lord has shown the nations that he has the power to save and to bring justice.
translation_verse: Yehowa ehã ale kunim ni eye lɛ; ejie edɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ kpo faŋŋ etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ majimaji lɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: God has been faithful in his love for Israel, and his saving power is seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ekai esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ enɔkwayeli ni eyɔɔ hã Israel we lɛ. Je lɛ naagbeehei fɛɛ ena kunim ni wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ye lɛ.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to sing happy songs in praise of the Lord.
translation_verse: Je lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛbɔa oshe kɛ miishɛɛ nyɛhãa Yehowa; nyɛlaa miishɛɛ lalai, nyɛlaa yijiemɔ lalai!

english_verse: Make music for him on harps. Play beautiful melodies!
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ kpãa saŋku alaa yijiemɔ lalai nyɛhãa Yehowa. Hɛɛ! Nyɛtswaa kpãa saŋku kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and horns and celebrate with joyful songs for our Lord and King!
translation_verse: Nyɛkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi, nyɛkpãa koofɛŋi! Ni nyɛkɛ miishɛɛ abɔa oshe yɛ wɔmaŋtsɛ Yehowa hiɛ!

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures, and the earth to shout with all its people.
translation_verse: Ŋshɔ ahũu kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ; je lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mli abɔ oshe!

english_verse: Order the rivers to clap their hands, and all the hills to sing together.
translation_verse: Fai atswa amɛdɛ̃, ni gɔji bluublu ala kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ;

english_verse: Let them worship the Lord! He is coming to judge everyone on the earth, and he will be honest and fair.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ eeba ebaye je lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ. Ebaakojo je lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa, ni ebaakojo gbɔmɛi bɔ ni sa pɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! You rule from your throne above the winged creatures, as people tremble and the earth shakes.
translation_verse: Yehowa miiye maŋtsɛ; maji lɛ ahe akpokpo! Eta maŋtsɛ sɛi nɔ yɛ kerubim anɔ. Shikpɔŋ lɛ ahoso!

english_verse: You are praised in Zion, and you control all nations.
translation_verse: Yehowa je agbo yɛ Zion, awo enɔ gojoo fe gbɔmɛi fɛɛ.

english_verse: Only you are God! And your power alone, so great and fearsome, is worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Aaajie ogbɛi kpeteŋkple ni he yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ yi. Ehe tse krɔŋkrɔŋ!

english_verse: You are our mighty King, a lover of fairness, who sees that justice is done everywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ Ofe ni sumɔɔ jalɛ saneyeli, ohã jalɛ saneyeli ema shi; ni aafee nɔ ni ja yɛ Israel.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, we praise you and kneel down to worship you, the God of holiness!
translation_verse: Nyɛkafoa Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ; nyɛjaa yɛ enaneshi maaŋoo lɛ hiɛ! Ehe tse krɔŋkrɔŋ.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron were two of your priests. Samuel was also one of those who prayed in your name, and you, our Lord, answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Mose kɛ Aaron fata osɔfoi lɛ ahe; ni Samuel hu shi mɛi ni ja Yehowa lɛ anɔ. Amɛbo amɛtsɛ Yehowa, ni ehere amɛ nɔ.

english_verse: You spoke to them from a thick cloud, and they obeyed your laws.
translation_verse: Ekɛ amɛ wie yɛ atatu kutuu lɛ mli; amɛye emlai kɛ akpɔi ni eŋɔ hã amɛ lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you answered their prayers and forgave their sins, but when they did wrong, you punished them.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, ohere amɛ nɔ; otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ŋɔ̃ɔ tɔ̃mɔ efaa ji bo; tsɛbelɛ ogbala amɛtoi yɛ eshai ni amɛfeefee ahewɔ.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God, and we worship you at your sacred mountain. Only you are God!
translation_verse: Nyɛkafoa Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ! Nyɛjaa yɛ egɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehe tse krɔŋkrɔŋ.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord, everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛbɔa oshe nyɛhãa Yehowa!

english_verse: Be joyful and sing as you come in to worship the Lord!
translation_verse: Nyɛsɔmɔa Yehowa kɛ miishɛɛ; nyɛbaa ehiɛ kɛ nyamɔ lala!

english_verse: You know the Lord is God! He created us, and we belong to him; we are his people, the sheep in his pasture.
translation_verse: Nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Yehowa lɛ, lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ! Lɛ ebɔ wɔ, ni lɛ enii ji wɔ; emaŋ kɛ elɛɛhe lɛ toi ji wɔ.

english_verse: Be thankful and praise the Lord as you enter his temple.
translation_verse: Nyɛbotea egboi lɛ amli kɛ shidaa! Nyɛbaa ekpoi lɛ anɔ kɛ yijiemɔ! Nyɛdaa lɛ shi, nyɛjiea egbɛi lɛ yi!

english_verse: The Lord is good! His love and faithfulness will last forever.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa hi; esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ yɛ kɛyaa naanɔ; ni enɔkwayeli lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa yinɔi fɛɛ anɔ!

english_verse: I will sing to you, Lord! I will celebrate your kindness and your justice.
translation_verse: Mala anɔkwayeli kɛ jalɛ saneyeli he lala! Hɛɛ, bo Yehowa, oyi mala majie.

english_verse: Please help me learn to do the right thing, and I will be honest and fair in my own kingdom.
translation_verse: Mikɛ nilee baaba mijeŋ koni shwamɔ ko akahi mihe. Te be ni manyɛ enɛ he mashɛ hu? Mikɛ tsui krɔŋŋ aaaba mijeŋ yɛ miwe lɛŋ.

english_verse: I refuse to be corrupt or to take part in anything crooked,
translation_verse: Mikɛ nɔ ko gbonyo ko emaŋ mihiɛ. Mihiɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji anifeemɔnii; egbaleŋ mi fɔŋfɔ̃.

english_verse: and I won't be dishonest or deceitful.
translation_verse: Tsui ni yeee anɔkwa akagbale mi fɔŋfɔ̃. Miyeŋ kɛyaŋ gbɛ fɔŋ ko nɔ.

english_verse: Anyone who spreads gossip will be silenced; no one who is conceited will be my friend.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yeɔ enaanyo he osheku yɛ teemɔ mli lɛ, makpãtã ehiɛ. Mɔ ni yɔɔ gegeege kɛ henɔwomɔ tsui lɛ mikɛ lɛ yeŋ.

english_verse: I will find trustworthy people to serve as my advisors; only an honest person will serve as an official.
translation_verse: Mana shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ anɔkwafoi lɛ mɔbɔ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛkɛ mi ahi shi. Mɔ ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ ni shwamɔ ko bɛ ehe lɛ, lɛ eeesɔmɔ mi.

english_verse: No one who cheats or lies will have a position in my royal court.
translation_verse: Shishiulɔ ko ehiŋ miwe lɛŋ; ni amalelɔ ko damɔŋ mihiɛ.

english_verse: Each morning I will silence any lawbreakers I find in the countryside or in the city of the Lord.
translation_verse: Daa leebi lɛ, makpãtã mɛi fɔ̃ji fɛɛ ahiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; mɛi ni feɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ, mafolɔ amɛ fɛɛ mashwie kɛje Yehowa maŋ lɛŋ.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen.
translation_verse: Oo, Yehowa, bo misɔlemɔ toi; hã mibolɔmɔ lɛ ashɛ oŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Don't hide from me in my time of trouble. Pay attention to my prayer and quickly give an answer.
translation_verse: Mifimɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, kaaŋɔ ohiɛ otee mi. Ba otoi shi ohã mi. Gbi nɔ ni mabɔlɔ matsɛ bo lɛ, heremɔ mi nɔ nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: My days disappear like smoke, and my bones are burning as though in a furnace.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ migbii lɛ hoɔ yaa tamɔ lasu, ni miwui ahe edɔ tamɔ latɛŋ.

english_verse: I am wasting away like grass, and my appetite is gone.
translation_verse: Mitsui eboo, ni egbi tamɔ jwɛi. Mihiɛ kpaa miniyeli tete po nɔ.

english_verse: I am like a lonely owl in the desert
translation_verse: Mitsɔ ŋa nɔ patu, mitsɔ̃ tamɔ amaŋfɔ̃i amli patu.

english_verse: or a restless sparrow alone on a roof.
translation_verse: Mibɛɛɛ mihiŋmɛi nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ. Mitsɔ̃ tamɔ loofɔlɔ ni ekome too eyɔɔ tsu yiteŋ.

english_verse: My enemies insult me all day, and they use my name for a curse word.
translation_verse: Mihenyɛlɔi bɔɔ mi ahora gbi muu fɛɛ. Mɛi ni yeɔ mihe fɛo lɛ kɛ migbɛi lomɔɔ.

english_verse: Instead of food, I have ashes to eat and tears to drink,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ lamlu etsɔ̃ miniyenii tamɔ aboloo; ni midãa lɛ mikɛ yaafonu futuɔ mli,

english_verse: because you are furious and have thrown me aside.
translation_verse: yɛ omlila kɛ omlifu lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ owo mi, ni oshɛ mi ofɔ̃.

english_verse: My life fades like a shadow at the end of day and withers like grass.
translation_verse: Miwala gbii hoɔ tamɔ gbɛkɛnaashi hɔɔŋ ni migbi tamɔ jwɛi;

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King forever and will always be famous.
translation_verse: shi, bo Yehowa, ooye maŋtsɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ. Ogbɛi lɛ hiɔ shi kɛmiiya yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: You will show pity to Zion because the time has come.
translation_verse: Obaate shi, ni obaana Zion mɔbɔ; ejaakɛ omɔbɔnalɛ be nɛ; be ni ato lɛ eshɛ.

english_verse: We, your servants, love each stone in the city, and we are sad to see them lying in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Zion mli tɛi lɛ ajara wa yɛ otsuji lɛ ahiɛ; ni amɛmusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ yɛ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations will honor you, and all kings on earth will praise your glory.
translation_verse: Majimaji lɛ aaashe Yehowa gbɛi lɛ gbeyei, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ aaashe onunyam lɛ.

english_verse: You will rebuild the city of Zion. Your glory will be seen,
translation_verse: Kɛji Yehowa tswa Zion ema shi ekoŋŋ lɛ, eeepue yɛ enunyam mli.

english_verse: and the prayers of the homeless will be answered.
translation_verse: Eeegboo etoi shi ehã shitswialɔi asɔlemɔ; ni enyaŋeŋ amɛfaikpamɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Future generations must also praise the Lord, so write this for them:
translation_verse: Hã aŋma enɛ afɔ shi ahã yinɔbii ni baa lɛ, koni mɛi ni afɔko amɛ tete po ajie Yehowa yi.

english_verse: “From his holy temple, the Lord looked down at the earth.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa jɛɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ, ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ekwɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: He listened to the groans of prisoners, and he rescued everyone who was doomed to die.”
translation_verse: Koni ebo gboklɛfoi lɛ akɛ̃ɛmɔ toi koni ekpɔ̃ mɛi ni abu amɛ gbele fɔ lɛ.

english_verse: when people from every nation meet to worship you.
translation_verse: be mli ni majimaji kɛ maŋtsɛyelii aaabuabua amɛhe naa amɛja Yehowa lɛ.

english_verse: I should still be strong, but you, Lord, have made an old person of me.
translation_verse: Yehowa egbɔjɔ mi yɛ miblahiaŋ; etse miwala gbii lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: You will live forever! Years mean nothing to you. Don't cut my life in half!
translation_verse: Mikɛɛ akɛ, “Oo miNyɔŋmɔ, Bo mɔ ni oyɔɔ kɛjɛ yinɔ kɛmiiya yinɔi fɛɛ lɛ, kaaŋɔ mi kɛmiiya yɛ miwala be lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu.

english_verse: In the beginning, Lord, you laid the earth's foundation and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Blema beebe oto shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi, ni ŋwɛi lɛ, onijianaa nitsumɔ ni.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes. You change them, as you would a coat, but you last forever.
translation_verse: Nomɛi ahiɛ aaakpãtã, shi bo lɛ oyɛ daa. Amɛ fɛɛ amɛaatserɛ tamɔ atade; otsakeɔ amɛ tamɔ mama, ni amɛhoɔ amɛyaa.

english_verse: You are always the same. You are God for all time.
translation_verse: Shi bo lɛ oyɛ bɔ ni oyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni ofii lɛ bɛ naagbee.

english_verse: Every generation of those who serve you will live in your presence.
translation_verse: Otsuji abii aaahi shi, ni amɛshwiei hu aaahi shi shweshweeshwe yɛ ohiɛ.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord, and with all that I am I praise his holy name!
translation_verse: Jiemɔ Yehowa yi misusuma, ni nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mimli, nyɛjiea egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yi.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord! I will never forget how kind he has been.
translation_verse: Oo, misusuma, jiemɔ Yehowa yi, ni ohiɛ akakpa nibii juji ni efeɔ lɛ fiaa nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord forgives our sins, heals us when we are sick,
translation_verse: Lɛ ji mɔ ni kɛ onishaianii fɛɛ faa; ni etsaa ohelai fiaa kwa lɛ.

english_verse: and protects us from death. His kindness and love are a crown on our heads.
translation_verse: Lɛ ehereɔ oyiwala kɛjeɔ gbonyobu mli, ni ekɛ mlihilɛ kɛ musuŋtsɔlɛ fiɔ bo akekre.

english_verse: Each day that we live, he provides for our needs and gives us the strength of a young eagle.
translation_verse: Lɛ ekɛ nii kpakpai duroɔ bo owalabeiaŋ fɛɛ; ni oblahiiaŋ tsɔ̃ɔ ehee tamɔ okropɔŋ.

english_verse: For all who are mistreated, the Lord brings justice.
translation_verse: Yehowa kojoɔ, ni eyeɔ jalɛ sane ehãa mɛi ni ayeɔ amɛ amim.

english_verse: He taught his Law to Moses and showed all Israel what he could do.
translation_verse: Lɛ ehã Mose le eyiŋtoi lɛ, ni ehã Israelbii lɛ le enifeemɔnii lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is merciful! He is kind and patient, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Mɔbɔnalɔ kɛ durolɔ ji Yehowa, emli fuuu mra, ni esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ fa babaoo.

english_verse: The Lord won't always be angry and point out our sins;
translation_verse: Jeee be fɛɛ be ekãa mɔ, ni ebɛɛɛ mɔ ewooo emli.

english_verse: he doesn't punish us as our sins deserve.
translation_verse: Ekɛ wɔ yeee yɛ wɔhe eshai anaa, ni ewooo wɔ nyɔmɔ yɛ wɔnishaianii lɛ anaa.

english_verse: How great is God's love for all who worship him? Greater than the distance between heaven and earth!
translation_verse: Shi moŋ, bɔ ni ŋwɛi kwɔ fe shikpɔŋ lɛ, nakai esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ fa hã mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ.

english_verse: How far has the Lord taken our sins from us? Farther than the distance from east to west!
translation_verse: Bɔ ni bokã kɛ anai teŋ jɛkɛ lɛ, nakai ehãa wɔ kɛ wɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ateŋ jekɛɔ.

english_verse: Just as parents are kind to their children, the Lord is kind to all who worship him,
translation_verse: Bɔ ni tsɛ musuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ ebii ahe lɛ, nakai Yehowa musuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ ebii ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ ahe.

english_verse: because he knows we are made of dust.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ele wɔsu kɛ wɔbaŋ; ekaiɔ akɛ sũ kɛkɛ ji wɔ.

english_verse: We humans are like grass or wild flowers that quickly bloom.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ adesa lɛ, egbii tamɔ jwɛi; efeɔ floŋŋ tamɔ jwɛiiaŋ fɔfɔi.

english_verse: But a scorching wind blows, and they quickly wither to be forever forgotten.
translation_verse: Kɛji kɔɔyɔɔ tswa nɔ kɛho pɛ, ebɛ dɔŋŋ; ni he ni ema lɛ leee lɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: The Lord is always kind to those who worship him, and he keeps his promises to their descendants
translation_verse: Shi Yehowa suɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ eyɛ kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ. Eyɛ hã mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ, ni ejalɛ lɛ yɛ hã bii abii.

english_verse: God has set up his kingdom in heaven, and he rules the whole creation.
translation_verse: Yehowa lɛ, ekɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ yɛ ŋwɛi; ni lɛ eyeɔ jeŋ fɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: All of you mighty angels, who obey God's commands, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Oo, nyɛ ebɔfoi ni he wa, ni nyɛyeɔ ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛboɔ egbee toi, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

english_verse: All of you thousands who serve and obey God, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Nyɛ etai lɛ fɛɛ kwa, nyɛ esɔ̃ɔlɔi ni feɔ esuɔmɔnaanii, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

english_verse: All of God's creation and all that he rules, come and praise your Lord! With all my heart I praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Nyɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa bɔ ni yɔɔ enɔyelihei lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi. Oo mikla, jiemɔ Yehowa yi!

english_verse: I praise you, Lord God, with all my heart. You are glorious and majestic, dressed in royal robes
translation_verse: Oo, misusuma, jiemɔ Yehowa yi! Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, oda naakpa! Owula naakpa kɛ woo kɛ agbojee.

english_verse: and surrounded by light. You spread out the sky like a tent,
translation_verse: Oha la tamɔ ahaa mama, ni olɛɛ ŋwɛi mli oha shi tamɔ buu.

english_verse: and you built your home over the mighty ocean. The clouds are your chariot with the wind as its wings.
translation_verse: Oma oshĩa lɛ yɛ nui anɔ; oŋɔ atatui okɛfee oshwiilii; otaa kɔɔyɔɔ fiji anɔ okɛsheraa shi.

english_verse: The winds are your messengers, and flames of fire are your servants.
translation_verse: Oŋɔɔ kɔɔyɔɔ ofeɔ otsuji; ni oŋɔɔ la kɛ la srɛmi ofeɔ osɔ̃ɔlɔi.

english_verse: You built foundations for the earth, and it will never be shaken.
translation_verse: Oto shikpɔŋ lɛ oma shi shiŋŋ yɛ shishitoo nɔ koni ekahoso kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: You covered the earth with the ocean that rose above the mountains.
translation_verse: Okɛ nu ha he tamɔ mama, ni nu lɛ su gɔji lɛ ayi.

english_verse: Then your voice thundered! And the water flowed
translation_verse: Oŋa nui lɛ ayi, ni amɛjo foi; oŋwɛi shiimɔ naa lɛ, amɛjo foi oya.

english_verse: down the mountains and through the valleys to the place you prepared.
translation_verse: Gɔji lɛ holeholee amɛhe nɔ, ni jɔi lɛ hu babaa shi kɛtee he ni oto ohã amɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Now you have set boundaries, so that the water will never flood the earth again.
translation_verse: Oto husu ohã nui koni amɛkateke ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛbaha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: You provide streams of water in the hills and valleys,
translation_verse: Ohãa nuhiŋmɛii tueɔ kɛjɛɔ jɔi amli, ni amɛhoɔ yɛ gɔji lɛ ateŋ.

english_verse: so that the donkeys and other wild animals can satisfy their thirst.
translation_verse: Amɛhãa ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ nu amɛnuɔ, ni ŋaŋ tejii lɛ kɛgbeɔ amɛkumai.

english_verse: Birds build their nests nearby and sing in the trees.
translation_verse: Loofɔji feɔ amɛtsui yɛ fai lɛ ahe; ni amɛlaa yɛ tsei aniji lɛ ateŋ.

english_verse: From your home above you send rain on the hills and water the earth.
translation_verse: Ojɛɔ oshihilɛhe ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ, onɛɔ nu oshwieɔ gɔji lɛ anɔ. Onitsumɔi amli yibii lɛ hãa shikpɔŋ lɛ tɔɔ.

english_verse: You let the earth produce grass for cattle, plants for our food,
translation_verse: Ohãa jwɛi kwɛ̃ɔ hãa kooloi ni tsei kwɛ̃ɔ hãa gbɔmɛi koni niyenii ajɛ shikpɔŋ aba;

english_verse: wine to cheer us up, olive oil for our skin, and grain for our health.
translation_verse: kɛ wain ni hãa adesa tsui nyɔɔ emli, kɛ mu ni hãa gbɔmɔ hiɛ kpɛɔ; kɛ aboloo ni hãa gbɔmɔ adesa hewalɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, your trees always have water, and so do the cedars you planted in Lebanon.
translation_verse: Lebanon tsei lɛ ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ tɛo lɛ, eshwie amɛnɔ nu jogbaŋŋ.

english_verse: Birds nest in those trees, and storks make their home in the fir trees.
translation_verse: Tsei nɛɛ anɔ loofɔji feɔ amɛtsui yɛ. Gɔ̃dɔ̃i lɛ, sɛsɛoi lɛ amli amɛtsui yɔɔ.

english_verse: Wild goats find a home in the tall mountains, and small animals can hide between the rocks.
translation_verse: Gɔji somromoi lɛ anɔ ji duji abobaahe; ni afutuɔkɔi anɔ ji tɛsai amli.

english_verse: You created the moon to tell us the seasons. The sun knows when to set,
translation_verse: Oto nyɔɔŋtsere koni ekadi nyɔji lɛ; hulu hu le eshinyɔɔ be.

english_verse: and you made the darkness, so the animals in the forest could come out at night.
translation_verse: Ohãa duŋ woɔ, ni je naa; no mli kooŋ kooloi fɛɛ jeɔ kpo.

english_verse: Lions roar as they hunt for the food you provide.
translation_verse: Jatabii hũɔ kɛtaoɔ milɛ loo; amɛkɛtaoɔ amɛniyenii kɛjɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ.

english_verse: But when morning comes, they return to their dens,
translation_verse: Kɛji hulu je lɛ amɛgbalaa amɛhe shi; ni amɛyabumɔɔ amɛwɔɔhei.

english_verse: then we go out to work until the end of day.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ gbɔmɔ jeɔ kpo eyaa enitsumɔ, ni eyagboɔ deŋme kɛyashiɔ gbɛkɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, by your wisdom you made so many things; the whole earth is covered with your living creatures.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, onitsumɔi lɛ fa naakpa, fɛɛ jɛ onilee mli. Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ onibɔɔnii sɔŋŋ.

english_verse: But what about the ocean so big and wide? It is alive with creatures, large and small.
translation_verse: Ŋshɔ nɛ, eda, ni elɛɛ tɛtɛrɛɛ; nibii ni anyɛɛɛ akane wamɔɔ yɛ mli, loi bibii kɛ ewuji fɛɛ.

english_verse: And there are the ships, as well as Leviathan, the monster you created to splash in the sea.
translation_verse: Lɛji nyiɛɔ ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ; emli nɔŋŋ leviatan ni obɔ lɛ shwɛɔ yɛ.

english_verse: All of these depend on you to provide them with food,
translation_verse: Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ bo pɛ gbɛ amɛkwɛɔ, koni ohã amɛ amɛniyenii yɛ be ni sa mli.

english_verse: and you feed each one with your own hand, until they are full.
translation_verse: Ohãa amɛ nii, ni amɛbuaa naa; Ogbeleɔ odɛ̃, ni amɛtɔrɔɔ kɛ nii kpakpai.

english_verse: But when you turn away, they are terrified; when you end their life, they die and rot.
translation_verse: Kɛ okɛ ohiɛ tee lɛ, amɛhaoɔ, kɛ oŋɔ amɛmumɔ lɛ, amɛgboiɔ; ni amɛkuɔ amɛsɛɛ kɛyaa amɛsu ni amɛjɛ mli lɛŋ ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: You created all of them by your Spirit, and you give new life to the earth.
translation_verse: Kɛji okɛ omumɔ lɛ wo amɛmli lɛ, wala baa amɛmli; ni wala hee baa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, we pray that your glory will last forever and that you will be pleased with what you have done.
translation_verse: Yehowa anunyam lɛ aaahi shi kɛya naanɔ. Yehowa aaanya enitsumɔi lɛ ahe!

english_verse: You look at the earth, and it trembles. You touch the mountains, and smoke goes up.
translation_verse: Lɛ ji mɔ ni kɛ ekwɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ hosoɔ, kɛ eta gɔji lɛ ahe lɛ, amɛjeɔ lasu.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will sing and praise you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ, mala mahã Yehowa. Gbii abɔ ni miyɔɔ wala mli nɛɛ, mala majie miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi.

english_verse: I hope my thoughts will please you, because you are the one who makes me glad.
translation_verse: Miyiŋsusumɔ asa Yehowa hiɛ, ejaakɛ lɛ ehãa minaa miishɛɛ.

english_verse: Destroy all wicked sinners from the earth once and for all. With all my heart I praise you, Lord! I praise you!
translation_verse: Hã eshafeelɔi atã yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni efɔŋfeelɔi akahi shi dɔŋŋ. Oo misusuma, jiemɔ Yehowa yi! Jiemɔ Yehowa yi!

english_verse: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
translation_verse: Oo, nyɛdaa Yehowa shi, Nyɛtsɛa lɛ, nyɛjaa lɛ. Nyɛhãa alea enifeemɔnii lɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ.

english_verse: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
translation_verse: Nyɛlaa nyɛhãa lɛ; nyɛlaa nyɛjiea eyi. Nyɛgbaa enaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ fiaa.

english_verse: Celebrate and worship his holy name with all your heart.
translation_verse: Nyɛshwãa nyɛfɔ̃a egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Mɛi ni taoɔ Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ lɛ atsui anyɔ amɛmli.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and his mighty power.
translation_verse: Nyɛtaoa Yehowa kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ; nyɛtaoa ehiɛgbɛ daa.

english_verse: You belong to the family of Abraham, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: Oo nyɛ, etsulɔ Abraham shwiei, nyɛ Yakobbii ni ehala, nyɛkaia naakpɛɛ nitsumɔi ni etsu lɛ; kɛ kojomɔi ni ekojo lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Lɛ ji Yehowa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, emlai lɛ yɛ hã jeŋ muu fɛɛ.

english_verse: He will never forget his agreement or his promises, not in thousands of years. *
translation_verse: Ehiɛ yɛ ekpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ. Ehiɛ yɛ ewiemɔ ni ekɛ ma shi ehã yinɔi akpe lɛ nɔ;

english_verse: when he said, “I'll give you the land of Canaan.”
translation_verse: Ekɛɛ akɛ, “Bo maŋɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ mahã akɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋnɔ kɛ gboshinii.”

english_verse: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
translation_verse: No be mli be ni amɛyi faaa ko, ni amɛyi shɛɛɛ nɔ ko, ni gbɔi ji amɛ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,

english_verse: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
translation_verse: ni amɛtsomlo kɛjɛ maŋ kome nɔ kɛtee maŋ kroko nɔ; kɛjɛ maŋtsɛyelihe kome nɔ kɛtee ekroko mli lɛ.

english_verse: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
translation_verse: Yehowa eŋmɛɛɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko gbɛ, ni efee amɛ efɔŋ ko; ni ekã majiatsɛmɛi ahiɛ yɛ amɛhewɔ.

english_verse: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
translation_verse: Ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkataa mimɛi ni mifɔ amɛmu lɛ ahe; ni migbalɔi lɛ hu, nyɛkafea amɛ efɔŋ ko.”

english_verse: God kept crops from growing until food was scarce everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Be ni Yehowa hã hɔmɔ ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni anaaa nii aye lɛ,

english_verse: But he had already sent Joseph, sold as a slave into Egypt,
translation_verse: etsu nuu ko kɛtsɔ̃ amɛhiɛ, Yosef mɔ ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ nyɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: with chains of iron around his legs and neck.
translation_verse: Awo enaji gboklɛ, ni apiŋ lɛ, ni awo ekuɛ dade kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ,

english_verse: Joseph remained a slave until his own words had come true, and the Lord had finished testing him.
translation_verse: kɛyashi beyinɔ ni ewiemɔ lɛ ba mli, ni Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ ma ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ mi.

english_verse: Then the king of Egypt set Joseph free
translation_verse: Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu ni ayafɛne lɛ; maji anɔyelɔ lɛ hã eye ehe tswaa.

english_verse: and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: Ewo lɛ onukpa yɛ ewe lɛ, ni efee lɛ enibii fɛɛ nɔyelɔ;

english_verse: Joseph was in command of the officials, and he taught the leaders how to use wisdom.
translation_verse: koni etsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ lumɛi lɛ nɔ ni sa akɛ amɛfee, ni etsɔ̃ɔ emaŋ onukpai lɛ hu nilee.

english_verse: Jacob and his family came and settled in Egypt as foreigners.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yakob tee Ijipt, ni eyato gbɔ yɛ Ham shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: They were the Lord's people, so he let them grow stronger than their enemies.
translation_verse: Ni Yehowa hã Yakobbii lɛ shwere naakpa; ni ehã amɛhe wa hu fe amɛhenyɛlɔi kwraa.

english_verse: They served the Lord, and he made the Egyptians plan hateful things against them.
translation_verse: Yehowa hã Ijiptbii lɛ nyɛ Yakob webii lɛ, ni amɛkɛ amɛ ye ŋaa mli.

english_verse: God sent his servant Moses. He also chose and sent Aaron
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni etsu etsulɔ Mose kɛ Aaron, mɛi ni ehala lɛ.

english_verse: to his people in Egypt, and they worked miracles and wonders there.
translation_verse: Amɛtsu Nyɔŋmɔ naakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ yɛ Ijipt; amɛfee naakpɛɛ nii lɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron obeyed God, and he sent darkness to cover Egypt.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ hã duŋ wo, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wo duŋ; shi kɛ̃lɛ Ijiptbii lɛ booo efamɔ lɛ toi.

english_verse: God turned their rivers into streams of blood, and the fish all died.
translation_verse: Ehã amɛfai amli nui lɛ tsɔ̃ lá, ni amɛmli loi lɛ gboi.

english_verse: Frogs were everywhere, even in the royal palace.
translation_verse: Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yi tɔ kɛ kɔkɔdenei; amɛbote amɛmaŋtsɛ we lɛ piai amli tete.

english_verse: When God gave the command, flies and gnats swarmed all around.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ fã, kɛkɛ ni adɔdɔji kɛ ofɔii bayi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ.

english_verse: In place of rain, God sent hailstones and flashes of lightning.
translation_verse: Ehã nyɔŋmɔŋtɛ nɛ yɛ nu najiaŋ; ni srawa gbala yɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei fɛɛ.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees, and he made splinters of all the other trees.
translation_verse: Ekumɔ amɛwaintsei kɛ agbãmitsei lɛ; ekpãtã amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tsei fɛɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: God gave the command, and more grasshoppers came than could be counted.
translation_verse: Efã, kɛkɛ ni baalabii kɛ otukpɛi ni aleee amɛyibɔ ba.

english_verse: They ate every green plant and all the crops that grew in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Amɛye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bai fɛɛ, ni amɛ ye ŋmɔjiashi nii fɛɛ hu.

english_verse: Then God took the life of every first-born son.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ kpãtã kromɔbi fɛɛ ni ji amɛhewalɛ fɛɛ shishijee lɛ ahiɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: When God led Israel from Egypt, they took silver and gold, and no one was left behind.
translation_verse: Ni ejie Israelbii lɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni amɛhiɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika, ni Israelbii lɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ hewalɛ kpiŋtiŋkpliŋŋ

english_verse: The Egyptians were afraid and gladly let them go.
translation_verse: Ijipt nya yɛ amɛjɛijee lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe ŋmiŋmi emɔmɔ amɛ.

english_verse: God hid them under a cloud and guided them by fire during the night.
translation_verse: Yehowa lɛɛ atatu mli ekɛha amɛnɔ. Ehã amɛ la ni hã jeŋ tse nyɔɔŋ.

english_verse: When they asked for food, he sent more birds than they could eat.
translation_verse: Amɛbi, ni ehã trakɔkɔi ba; ni ehã amɛ niyenii, babaoo ni jɛ ŋwɛi.

english_verse: God even split open a rock, and streams of water gushed into the desert.
translation_verse: Egbele tɛsaa naa, ni nu tue kɛho; nu lɛ ho kɛnyiɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ tamɔ faa.

english_verse: God never forgot his sacred promise to his servant Abraham.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ekai eshiwoo krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni ewo etsulɔ Abraham lɛ.

english_verse: When the Lord rescued his chosen people from Egypt, they celebrated with songs.
translation_verse: Hewɔ lɛ ejie emaŋ lɛ kɛje kpo kɛ miishɛɛ, ehalamɔbii lɛ kɛ nyamɔ lala.

english_verse: The Lord gave them the land and everything else the nations had worked for.
translation_verse: Eŋɔ majimaji lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ ehã amɛ, ni amɛŋɔ mɛi lɛ adeŋmegbomɔ mli nitsumɔnii lɛ amɛfee amɛnɔ,

english_verse: He did this so that his people would obey all his laws. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: bɔ ni afee ni amɛto ekpɔi lɛ ni amɛye nɔ. Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

english_verse: We will celebrate and praise you, Lord! You are good to us, and your love never fails.
translation_verse: Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi! Nyɛdaa Yehowa shi, ejaakɛ ehi, ejaakɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.

english_verse: No one can praise you enough for all the mighty things you have done.
translation_verse: Namɔ aaanyɛ Yehowa hewalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ agba? Namɔ aaanyɛ eyijiemɔ lɛ agba kɛwula shi?

english_verse: You bless those people who are honest and fair in everything they do.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ mɛi ni yeɔ jalɛ sane ni amɛfeɔ nɔ ni ja be fɛɛ be lɛ.

english_verse: Remember me, Lord, when you show kindness by saving your people.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, kaimɔ mi kɛji ona omaŋ lɛ mɔbɔ. Kɛji oohere amɛyiwala lɛ, ye obua mi,

english_verse: Let me prosper with the rest of your chosen ones, as they celebrate with pride because they belong to you.
translation_verse: koni mana ohalamɔbii lɛ ashweremɔ, bɔ ni afee ni mi kɛ omaŋ lɛ mli afili lɛ, koni mi kɛ omaŋ lɛ fɛɛ anya kɛ yijiemɔ.

english_verse: We and our ancestors have sinned terribly.
translation_verse: Wɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ, wɔfee esha; wɔfee efɔŋ, ni wɔye yiwalɛ sane.

english_verse: When they were in Egypt, they paid no attention to your marvelous deeds or your wonderful love. And they turned against you at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Be ni wɔblematsɛmɛi lɛ yɔɔ Ijipt lɛ, amɛyooo onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ asɛɛ, amɛkaiii osuɔmɔ babaoo ni tsakeee lɛ; shi moŋ, amɛtse Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ hiɛ atua, yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa.

english_verse: But you were true to your name, and you rescued them to prove how mighty you are.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ ehere amɛyiwala yɛ egbɛi lɛ hewɔ; koni ehã ale ehewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ.

english_verse: You said to the Red Sea, “Dry up!” Then you led your people across on land as dry as a desert.
translation_verse: Eŋa Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ yi, ni egbi; ni enyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛtsɔ̃ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli, oookɛɛ shiaŋa nɔ.

english_verse: and drowned every one of their enemies.
translation_verse: Nu lɛ su amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ayi gbidigbidi, eshwɛɛɛ amɛteŋ mɔ kome folo nɛkɛ.

english_verse: Then your people trusted you and sang your praises.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amɛhe ewiemɔi lɛ amɛye; amɛla amɛ jie eyi.

english_verse: But they soon forgot what you had done and rejected your advice.
translation_verse: Shi yeee be ko, ni amɛhiɛ kpa nii ni etsu ehã amɛ lɛ anɔ, ni amɛmɛɛɛ eŋaawoo dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: They became greedy for food and tested you there in the desert.
translation_verse: Amɛyadi amɛkɔnɔnii asɛɛ fe nine yɛ ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ, ni amɛka Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: So you gave them what they wanted, but later you destroyed them with a horrible disease.
translation_verse: Ehã amɛ amɛnitaomɔnii lɛ, shi ehã lootãa hela ko ni naa wa babote amɛteŋ.

english_verse: Everyone in camp was jealous of Moses and of Aaron, your chosen priest.
translation_verse: Amɛkɔlɔ Mose kɛ Aaron, Yehowa Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, lɛ nɔ, yɛ shitoohe lɛŋ,

english_verse: Dathan and Abiram rebelled, and the earth opened up and swallowed them.
translation_verse: ni shikpɔŋ gba, ni emi Datan, ni etsimɔ Abiram kɛ eŋa kɛ eshwiei fɛɛ anɔ gbidigbidi.

english_verse: Then fire broke out and destroyed all of their followers.
translation_verse: La je yɛ amɛsafo lɛ mli, ni la lilɛi shã mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ.

english_verse: At Horeb your people made and worshiped the statue
translation_verse: Amɛfee shika tsinabi amãgã hu yɛ Sinai, ni amɛja amãgã ni ashwie lɛ.

english_verse: of a bull, instead of you, their glorious God.
translation_verse: Amɛŋɔ anunyam lɛ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ amɛhã tsina ni kpeɔ jwɛi amãgã lɛ moŋ.

english_verse: You worked powerful miracles to save them from Egypt, but they forgot about you
translation_verse: Amɛhiɛ kpa Nyɔŋmɔ, amɛyiwalaherelɔ lɛ, mɔ ni fee nii wuji yɛ Ijipt lɛ, nɔ.

english_verse: and the fearsome things you did at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni efee naakpɛɛnii yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni efee gbeyei nibii yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You were angry and started to destroy them, but Moses, your chosen leader, begged you not to do it.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ to akɛ ebaakpãtã amɛhiɛ; shi etsulɔ Mose, mɔ ni eŋɔ lɛ lɛ, damɔ mli ehã amɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni ejɔɔ mlifu lɛ he koni ekakpãtã amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: They would not trust you, Lord, and they did not like the promised land.
translation_verse: Amɛgbe shikpɔŋ fɛɛfɛo lɛ he guɔ, ejaakɛ amɛheee Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoo lɛ amɛyeee.

english_verse: They would not obey you, and they grumbled in their tents.
translation_verse: Amɛwie huhuuhu yɛ amɛbuui amli; ni amɛbooo Yehowa gbee toi.

english_verse: So you threatened them by saying, “I'll kill you out here in the desert!
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, ekpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: I'll scatter your children everywhere in the world.”
translation_verse: Ni eshɛrɛ amɛshwiei lɛ eshwã majimaji lɛ amli; egbɛ amɛ eshwã shikpɔji lɛ anɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Your people became followers of a god named Baal Peor, and they ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛ amɛhe yabɔ jemawɔŋ Baal jalɔi lɛ ahe yɛ Peor; ni amɛye nii ni akɛshã afɔle ahã gbohii.

english_verse: They did such terrible things that you punished them with a deadly disease.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛ amɛnifeemɔnii wo Yehowa mlifu; ni gbele hela bote amɛteŋ.

english_verse: But Phinehas helped them, and the sickness stopped.
translation_verse: Shi Finehas te shi, ni edamɔ mli ehã amɛ; kɛkɛ ni gbele hela lɛ sɛɛ fo.

english_verse: At Meribah Spring they turned against you and made you furious.
translation_verse: Amɛwo Yehowa mlifu yɛ Meriba nu lɛ he, ni amɛhewɔ lɛ, Mose na amane.

english_verse: Then Moses got into trouble for speaking in anger.
translation_verse: Amɛwo Mose mli la, ni amɛhã enaa tɛ shi.

english_verse: Our Lord, they disobeyed you by refusing to destroy the nations.
translation_verse: Amɛkpãtãaa jeŋbii lɛ ahiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã amɛ lɛ,

english_verse: Instead they were friendly with those foreigners and followed their customs.
translation_verse: shi moŋ amɛfutu amɛ ni amɛkase amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ.

english_verse: Then they fell into the trap of worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Yehowa webii lɛ ja maŋsɛɛbii amãgãi lɛ, ni no hã amɛnane tɔ̃tɔ̃.

english_verse: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons
translation_verse: Amɛŋɔ amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei lɛ, amɛkɛshãshãa afɔlei amɛhã wɔji.

english_verse: and to the gods of Canaan. Then they poured out the blood of these innocent children and made the land filthy.
translation_verse: Amɛshwie amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei ni efeko efɔŋ ko lɛ alá shi amɛkɛshã afɔle amɛhã Kanaan amãgãi lɛ ni amɛkɛ lá lɛ bule shikpɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: By doing such gruesome things, they also became filthy.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛ amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ wo amɛhe muji, ni amɛyeee Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa.

english_verse: Finally, Lord, you were angry and terribly disgusted with your people.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa mli fu emaŋ lɛ, ni enyaŋe lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewebii lɛ.

english_verse: So you put them in the power of nations that hated them.
translation_verse: Etu amɛ ewo jeŋbii adɛŋ, no hewɔ lɛ, amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ye amɛnɔ.

english_verse: They were mistreated and abused by their enemies,
translation_verse: Amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ wa amɛyi waa, ni amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ba amɛ shi amɛwo amɛhewalɛ shishi.

english_verse: but you saved them time after time. They were determined to rebel, and their sins caused their downfall.
translation_verse: Yehowa jie amɛ shii abɔ, shi amɛkɛ amɛkuɛŋtilɛ tse ehiɛ atua; ni aba amɛ shi yɛ amɛhe esha lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: You answered their prayers when they were in trouble.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ, be ni enu amɛbolɔmɔ lɛ, enu amɛhaomɔ lɛ he ehã amɛ.

english_verse: You kept your agreement and were so merciful
translation_verse: Ekai ekɛ amɛteŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ, ni emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ esuɔmɔ babaoo ni tsakeee lɛ naa.

english_verse: that their enemies had pity on them.
translation_verse: Ehã majimaji fɛɛ ni ŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ na amɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, heremɔ wɔyiwala; ni obua wɔnaa kɛjɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ kɛba, koni wɔda bo shi, ni wɔjie ogbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yi.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever. Let everyone say, “Amen! Shout praises to the Lord!”
translation_verse: Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyashi naanɔ; ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛɛ akɛ, “Amen!” Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

english_verse: ) The Lord Is Good to His People
translation_verse: ) Nyɔŋmɔ mlihilɛ kafomɔ

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! He is good to us, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Nyɛdaa Yehowa shi, ejaakɛ ehi ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa.

english_verse: Everyone the Lord has rescued from trouble should praise him,
translation_verse: Mɛi ni Yehowa ekpɔ̃ amɛ lɛ akɛɛ nakai, mɛi ni akpɔ̃ amɛ kɛjɛ haomɔ mli lɛ.

english_verse: everyone he has brought from the east and the west, the north and the south.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni ebua amɛnaa kɛjɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ kɛ anaigbɛ lɛ, kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ kɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ, akɛɛ nakai.

english_verse: You were hungry and thirsty and about to give up.
translation_verse: Hɔmɔ kɛ kumai ye amɛ, ni amɛtɔ biti.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa yɛ amɛfimɔ lɛ mli, ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛmanehului lɛ amli;

english_verse: At once he brought you to a town.
translation_verse: ni enyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛtsɔ̃ gbɛ trɔmɔɔ nɔ, kɛyashɛ maŋ ni gbɔmɔ hiɔ mli mli.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Esa akɛ amɛda Yehowa shi, yɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ, yɛ enaakpɛɛnii ni etsuɔ ehãa gbɔmɛi abii lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: To everyone who is thirsty, he gives something to drink; to everyone who is hungry, he gives good things to eat.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kumai yeɔ lɛ lɛ, ehãa lɛ nu enuɔ; ni mɔ ni hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ lɛ, ehãa etɔɔ kɛ nii kpakpai.

english_verse: Some of you were prisoners suffering in deepest darkness and bound by chains,
translation_verse: Mɛi komɛi hu tara duŋ kɛ awerɛho mli, gboklɛfoi ni awo amɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ ni amɛyɔɔ amanehulu mli.

english_verse: because you had rebelled against God Most High and refused his advice.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ amɛte shi amɛshi Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ, ni amɛnyaŋe Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ ŋaawoo lɛ.

english_verse: You were worn out from working like slaves, and no one came to help.
translation_verse: Akɛ nitsumɔ keketee jɔɔ amɛhe; amɛgbeegbee shi ni bualɔ ko bɛ.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Ni amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa yɛ amɛfimɔ lɛ mli; ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛmanehului lɛ amli.

english_verse: He brought you out of the deepest darkness and broke your chains.
translation_verse: Ejie amɛ kɛjɛ duŋ kɛ awerɛhoo mli, ni etserɛ amɛkɔsɔŋkɔsɔi lɛ amli.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Esa akɛ amɛda Yehowa shi yɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛ enaakpɛɛnii ni etsuɔ ehãa gbɔmɛi adesai abii lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: He breaks down bronze gates and shatters iron locks.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ekumɔ akɔɔble agboi lɛ, ni efolɔ dade adabaŋi lɛ amli.

english_verse: Some of you had foolishly committed a lot of sins and were in terrible pain.
translation_verse: Mɛi komɛi lɛ, amɛnishaianii wo amɛ hela; ni amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ ahewɔ amɛna nɔ.

english_verse: The very thought of food was disgusting to you, and you were almost dead.
translation_verse: Niyenii ko niyenii ko baaa amɛtsine, ni amɛbɛŋkɛ gbonyobu naa kpaakpa,

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: ni amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa yɛ amɛfimɔ lɛ mli; ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛmanehului lɛ amli.

english_verse: By the power of his own word, he healed you and saved you from destruction.
translation_verse: Efã, ni ewiemɔ lɛ tsa amɛ; ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Esa akɛ amɛda Yehowa shi, yɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛ enaakpɛɛnii ni etsuɔ ehãa gbɔmɛi adesai abii lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: You should celebrate by offering sacrifices and singing joyful songs to tell what he has done.
translation_verse: Hã amɛshã shidaa afɔlei, ni amɛkɛ nyamɔ lalai agba enitsumɔi lɛ.

english_verse: Some of you made a living by sailing the mighty sea,
translation_verse: Mɛi komɛi kɛ lɛji yanyiɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ, ni amɛtsu nii yɛ nui wuji lɛ ahiɛ;

english_verse: and you saw the miracles the Lord performed there.
translation_verse: amɛ amɛna Yehowa nitsumɔi lɛ; amɛna enaakpɛɛnii lɛ yɛ ŋshɔ kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: At his command a storm arose, and waves covered the sea.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ lɛ efã ni ehã ahum ni naa wa tswa; ni ehã ŋshɔkei lɛ fee hamahama.

english_verse: You were tossed to the sky and to the ocean depths, until things looked so bad that you lost your courage.
translation_verse: Ŋshɔkei lɛ holeɔ amɛhe nɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi, ni amɛnyɔɔ shi kɛyaa ŋshɔ kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛŋ, ni amlakui lɛ atsui fãa yɛ amɛmanehulu lɛ mli.

english_verse: You staggered like drunkards and gave up all hope.
translation_verse: Amɛkpaa, ni amɛdidãa tamɔ dãatɔlɔi, ni amɛŋaa fɛɛ laajeɔ amɛ.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Ni amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa yɛ amɛfimɔ lɛ mli, ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛmanehului lɛ amli.

english_verse: He made the storm stop and the sea be quiet.
translation_verse: Ehã ahum lɛ fɔ̃ɔ tswaa kwraa, ni ŋshɔkei lɛ ŋmɛ dɛŋŋ.

english_verse: You were happy because of this, and he brought you to the port where you wanted to go.
translation_verse: Amɛmii shɛ amɛhe ejaakɛ haomɔi lɛ asɛɛ efo, ni ekɛ amɛ eshɛ amɛbele ni amɛshweɔ lɛ mli shweshweeshwe.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Esa akɛ amɛda Yehowa shi yɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛ enaakpɛɛnii ni etsuɔ ehãa gbɔmɛi adesai abii lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Honor the Lord when you and your leaders meet to worship.
translation_verse: Hã amɛkafo lɛ yɛ maŋ asafo lɛŋ, ni amɛ jie eyi yɛ onukpai akpee lɛŋ.

english_verse: If you start doing wrong, the Lord will turn rivers into deserts,
translation_verse: Ehãa fai tsɔ̃mɔɔ shiaŋa; ni ehãa he ni nuhiŋmɛi baa yɛ tsɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ.

english_verse: flowing streams into scorched land, and fruitful fields into beds of salt.
translation_verse: Ehãa shikpɔŋ ni baa nii tsɔ̃ɔ ŋoo shikpɔŋ yɛ mɛi ni hiɔ jɛi lɛ anifeemɔnii hewɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord can also turn deserts into lakes and scorched land into flowing streams.
translation_verse: Ehãa shiaŋa tsɔ̃ɔ kpaakpo ni ehãa nuhiŋmɛi tueɔ kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ mli.

english_verse: If you are hungry, you can settle there and build a town.
translation_verse: Ehãa mɛi ni hɔmɔ yeɔ amɛ lɛ hiɔ jɛi, ni amɛtoɔ maŋ amɛhiɔ mli.

english_verse: You can plant fields and vineyards that produce a good harvest.
translation_verse: Amɛfeɔ ŋmɔji, ni amɛduɔ nii; amɛfeɔ waintromi, ni amɛkpaa nii babaoo.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you with many children and with herds of cattle.
translation_verse: Ejɔɔ amɛ, ni amɛyi faa naakpa; ehãaa amɛtsinai ayifalɛ nɔ agbɔ.

english_verse: Sometimes you may be crushed by troubles and sorrows, until only a few of you are left to survive.
translation_verse: Kɛji akɛ yiwalɛ kɛ haomɔ kɛ awerɛho hã amɛnɔ gbɔ, ni aba amɛshi tete lɛ,

english_verse: But the Lord will take revenge on those who conquer you, and he will make them wander across desert sands.
translation_verse: egbeɔ lumɛi ahiɛ, ni ehãa amɛtsomloɔ yɛ shiaŋa ni gbɛ kadimɔ nɔ bɛ nɔ;

english_verse: You will see this because you obey the Lord, but everyone who is wicked will be silenced.
translation_verse: Jalɔi naa kɛ amɛhiŋmɛi, ni amɛmii shɛɔ amɛhe, shi efɔŋfeelɔi tɔɔ mu.

english_verse: Be wise! Remember this and think about the kindness of the Lord.
translation_verse: Hã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ji nilelɔ lɛ ekase nii kɛjɛ enɛɛmɛi amli; Hã amɛsusu Yehowa suɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ he.

english_verse: Our God, I am faithful to you with all my heart, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you with all that I am.
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, mitsui enyɔ mimli! Mala lala kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ mahã bo. Misusuma, ohiɛ atsɛ̃!

english_verse: I will start playing my harps before the sun rises.
translation_verse: Obenta kɛ saŋku, nyɛhiɛ atsɛ̃a! Mahã leebi hiɛ atsɛ̃ mra!

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear; I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, mada bo shi, yɛ maji lɛ ateŋ, ni majie oyi yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ!

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens, and your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kwɔ kɛteke ŋwɛi, ni onɔkwayeli lɛ shɛɔ atatuiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: Our God, may you be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, awo onɔ kɛteke ŋwɛi, ni onunyam lɛ ekpele shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Answer my prayers and use your powerful arm to give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Okɛ ohewalɛ lɛ ahere wɔyiwala. Bo mifaikpamɔ toi, bɔ ni afee ni ohere mɛi ni osumɔɔ lɛ ayiwala.

english_verse: Our God, from your holy place you made this promise: “I will gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ ewie yɛ Ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ: Ekɛɔ akɛ, “Mikɛ miishɛɛ aaaja Shekem mli, ni maja Sukot Jɔɔ lɛ mahã miwebii.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is my symbol of royal power.
translation_verse: Minɔ ji Gilead; ni minɔ ji Manase; Efraim ji midade fai, ni Yuda lɛ, mimaŋtsɛ tsi ni.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin, and Edom belongs to me. I shout with victory over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Moab ji mihejuu goga; majie mitokota matswa Edom; Mabɔ kunimyeli oshe mawo Filistia.”

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Namɔ aaaŋɔ mi kɛaatee maŋ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ mli? Namɔ aaanyiɛ mihiɛ kɛaatee Edom?

english_verse: Have you rejected us? You don't lead our armies.
translation_verse: Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, ani okwa wɔ lɛɛlɛŋ? Onyiɛɛɛ wɔtai lɛ ahiɛ kɛyaaa ta dɔŋŋ?

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Oo, ye obua wɔ koni wɔkɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi awu; ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ yelikɛbuamɔ jeee fɛifɛi.

english_verse: Only you give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ yelikɛbuamɔ naa lɛ wɔɔye kunim, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ aaanaanaa wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kɛmɔ shi.

english_verse: I praise you, God! Don't keep silent.
translation_verse: Oo bo Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ yi ni mijieɔ, kaamua onaa!

english_verse: Destructive and deceitful lies are told about me,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji kɛ osatofoi miitswa mi lilɛi; amɛmiimale mihe.

english_verse: and hateful things are said for no reason.
translation_verse: Amɛhetsɛ̃ wiemɔi efo sa ewo mihe; amɛtua mi yakatswaa ni mifeko nɔ ko.

english_verse: I had pity and prayed for my enemies, but their words to me were harsh and cruel.
translation_verse: Be ni miisumɔ amɛ ni miisɔle miihã amɛ lɛ, amɛ lɛ amɛmiinyɛ mi moŋ.

english_verse: For being friendly and kind, they paid me back with meanness and hatred.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛ efɔŋ toɔ mi ekpakpa najiaŋ, ni amɛkɛ nyɛɛ toɔ misuɔmɔ lɛ najiaŋ.

english_verse: My enemies said, “Find some worthless fools to accuse him of a crime.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Fãa yiwalɔ ko owo ehe, hã naafolɔlɔ ko afolɔ enaa.

english_verse: Try him and find him guilty! Consider his prayers a lie.
translation_verse: Kɛ akojo lɛ lɛ, hã abu lɛ fɔ; ni aŋɔ esɔlemɔ po akɛ eshafeemɔ.

english_verse: Cut his life short and let someone else have his job.
translation_verse: Afo ewala gbii anɔ kuku; ni enii fɛɛ atsɔ̃ mɔ kroko nɔ.

english_verse: Make orphans of his children and a widow of his wife;
translation_verse: Hã ebii atsɔ̃mɔ awusãi, ni eŋa atsɔ̃ okulafo.

english_verse: make his children beg for food and live in the slums.
translation_verse: Hã ebii akpa shi amɛsisɛ̃; hã ashwie amɛ yɛ amaŋfɔ̃i tete ni amɛyɔɔ mli lɛ amli.

english_verse: “Let the people he owes take everything he owns. Give it all to strangers.
translation_verse: Enyɔmɔtsɛ ashɔ̃ nii ni eyɔɔ fɛɛ yɛ edɛŋ; ni gbɔi hu aha edeŋmegbomɔ lɛ mli nii fɛɛ.

english_verse: Don't let anyone be kind to him or have pity on the children he leaves behind.
translation_verse: Mɔ ko mɔ ko akafee lɛ ejurɔ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko hu akana ebii awusãi lɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: Bring an end to his family, and from now on let him be a forgotten man.
translation_verse: Hã aplenee eshwiei fɛɛ, ni agbe egbɛi yɛ yinɔi ni baaba lɛ ateŋ.

english_verse: “Don't let the Lord forgive the sins of his parents and his ancestors.
translation_verse: Yehowa akai etsɛmɛi lɛ anishaianii lɛ, ni akɛ enyɛ he esha lɛ hu akafa lɛ.

english_verse: Don't let the Lord forget the sins of his family, or let anyone remember his family ever lived.
translation_verse: Yehowa akai amɛhe eshai lɛ daa; amɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, akakai amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: He was so cruel to the poor, homeless, and discouraged that they died young.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ ejwɛŋŋ ejurɔfeemɔ he; shi moŋ ewa ohiafo kɛ mɔ ni efi lɛ kɛ mɔ ni ewerɛ eho ehe lɛ yi, kɛyashiɔ egbele mli.

english_verse: “He cursed others. Now place a curse on him! He never wished others well. Wish only trouble for him!
translation_verse: Esumɔɔ loomɔ; hewɔ lɛ loomɔ aba enɔ; esumɔɔɔ jɔɔmɔ; hewɔ lɛ ekɛ jɔɔmɔ teŋ ajekɛ.

english_verse: He cursed others more often than he dressed himself. Let his curses strike him deep, just as water and olive oil soak through to our bones.
translation_verse: Ewo loomɔ tamɔ atade; loomɔ lɛ abote ehewojiaŋ tamɔ nu, ni ebote ewuiaŋ tamɔ mu.

english_verse: Let his curses surround him, just like the belt and clothes he wears each day.”
translation_verse: Loomɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ mama ni ebu daa; kɛ mlifiinɔ, ni ekɛfi emli daa.

english_verse: Those are the cruel things my enemies wish for me. Let it all happen to them!
translation_verse: Hã enɛ afee nyɔmɔwoo ni aaajɛ Yehowa dɛŋ ahã minaaflɔlɔi kɛ mɛi ni wieɔ mihe efɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord God! Show your great kindness and rescue me.
translation_verse: Oo miNuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ ye misane lɛ ohã mi; ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ lɛ heremɔ mi.

english_verse: I am poor and helpless, and I have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ohiafo ji mi, ni minii yɛ mɔbɔ; ni mitsui ekumɔ yɛ mimli.

english_verse: I am fading away like an evening shadow; I am tossed aside like a crawling insect.
translation_verse: Milaaje tamɔ gbɛkɛnaashi hɔ̃ɔŋ ahwanya mi tamɔ baalabi.

english_verse: I have gone without eating, until my knees are weak, and my body is bony.
translation_verse: Ŋmaahilɛ sɔŋŋ ehã minakutseiaŋ egbɔjɔ, mitã loo, ni mifee kanyakanya.

english_verse: When my enemies see me, they say cruel things and shake their heads.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ̃ ahorabɔɔnɔ mihã minaaflɔlɔi lɛ; ni kɛji amɛna mi lɛ, amɛhosoɔ amɛyitsei.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord God! Come and save me because of your love.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, ye obua mi. Heremɔ miyiwala yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ naa.

english_verse: Let others know that you alone have saved me.
translation_verse: Hã amɛle akɛ, bo Yehowa, oninenaa nitsumɔ nɛ, akɛ bo ohere miyiwala.

english_verse: I don't care if they curse me, as long as you bless me. You will make my enemies fail when they attack, and you will make me glad to be your servant.
translation_verse: Hã amɛ lɛ, amɛlomɔ mi; shi bo lɛ ojɔɔ mi! Hã mɛi ni heɔ mi agbe lɛ ahiɛ agboi. Shɛjemɔ otsulɔ mii.

english_verse: You will cover them with shame, just as their bodies are covered with clothes.
translation_verse: Hã minaaflɔlɔi lɛ awula kɛ hiɛshishwiemɔ; ni amɛhiɛgbele lɛ akpɛtɛ amɛhe tamɔ mama.

english_verse: I will sing your praises and thank you, Lord, when your people meet.
translation_verse: Mikɛ minaabu aaada Yehowa shi babaoo, ni majie eyi yɛ mɛi babaoo ateŋ,

english_verse: You help everyone in need, and you save them from death.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ lɛ efãa ohiafo he, ni ehereɔ eyiwala kɛjɛɔ mɛi ni buɔ lɛ gbele fɔ lɛ adɛŋ.

english_verse: The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right side, until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.”
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ minuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ta mininejurɔ nɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋɔ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ mafee onajiashi maaŋoo.”

english_verse: The Lord will let your power reach out from Zion, and you will rule over your enemies.
translation_verse: Yehowa aaajɛ Zion ekɛ omaŋtsɛ tsi wulu lɛ ahã bo. Eeekɛɛ akɛ, “Ye lumɔ yɛ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ.”

english_verse: Your glorious power will be seen on the day you begin to rule. You will wear the sacred robes and shine like the morning sun in all of your strength.
translation_verse: Gbi nɔ ni ooofã ta lɛ, omaŋbii lɛ aaaba oŋɔɔ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsuɔmɔ naa. Oblahii lɛ aaaba oŋɔɔ tamɔ leebi bɔ yɛ ogɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has made a promise that will never be broken: “You will be a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Yehowa ekã kitã, ni etsakeŋ ejwɛŋmɔ, “Bo ji osɔfo kɛmiiya naanɔ yɛ Melkizedek gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ naa.”

english_verse: The Lord is at your right side, and when he gets angry he will crush the other kings.
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yɛ oninejurɔ nɔ; eeetswia maŋtsɛmɛi ashi yɛ emlifu gbi lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: He will judge the nations and crack their skulls, leaving piles of dead bodies all over the earth.
translation_verse: Eeekojo yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ, ni amɛmli aaayimɔ tɔ kɛ gbohii. Eeeplenee maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: He will drink from any stream that he chooses, while winning victory after victory.
translation_verse: Eeenu faa ni yɔɔ gbɛ toi mli nu, no hewɔ lɛ, eeeye omanye.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all my heart I will thank the Lord when his people meet.
translation_verse: Jiemɔ Yehowa yi! Mada Yehowa shi kɛ mitsui fɛɛ, yɛ jalɔi agwabɔɔ lɛ mli, yɛ asafo lɛ mli.

english_verse: The Lord has done many wonderful things! Everyone who is pleased with God's marvelous deeds will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Yehowa nitsumɔi lɛ yɛ naakpɛɛ; ni mɛi fɛɛ ni naa he tsui lɛ kaseɔ.

english_verse: Everything the Lord does is glorious and majestic, and his power to bring justice will never end.
translation_verse: Enitsumɔ lɛ eyi obɔ̃ kɛ woo kɛ agbojee; ni ejalɛ lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God is famous for his wonderful deeds, and he is kind and merciful.
translation_verse: Ehãa akaiɔ enaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ. Durolɔ kɛ mɔbɔnalɔ ji Yehowa.

english_verse: He gives food to his worshipers and always keeps his agreement with them.
translation_verse: Ehãa mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ yeɔ nii tɔrɔɔ; be fɛɛ be lɛ ekaiɔ ekpãŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: He has shown his mighty power to his people and has given them the lands of other nations.
translation_verse: Ehãa emaŋ lɛ leɔ ehewalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ; ejaakɛ ekɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ hãa emaŋ lɛ akɛ amɛgboshinii.

english_verse: God is always honest and fair, and his laws can be trusted.
translation_verse: Eninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ, anɔkwale kɛ jalɛ saneyeli ni; ni ekpɔi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ anɔkwale ni.

english_verse: They are true and right and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Amɛma shi shiŋŋ daa kɛmiiya naanɔi anaanɔ; koni akɛ anɔkwaleyeli kɛ jalɛ atsu he nii.

english_verse: God rescued his people, and he will never break his agreement with them. He is fearsome and holy.
translation_verse: Ehã akpɔ̃ ewebii lɛ, ni ekɛ amɛkpãŋ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ, Egbɛi lɛ he tse, ni egbɛi lɛ he yɛ gbeyei.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the first step to wisdom and good sense. God will always be respected.
translation_verse: Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ ji nilee shishijee. Mɛi fɛɛ ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ amɛnaa niiashishinumɔ kpakpa. Eyijiemɔ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! The Lord blesses everyone who worships him and gladly obeys his teachings.
translation_verse: Jiemɔ Yehowa yi! Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei, ni eyɔɔ ekitãi lɛ ahe tsuijurɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Their descendants will have great power in the land, because the Lord blesses all who do right.
translation_verse: Eshwiei aaatsɔ̃mɔ gbɔmɛi wuji yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; aaajɔɔ jalɔ lɛ shwiei.

english_verse: They will get rich and prosper and will always be remembered for their fairness.
translation_verse: Ninamɔ kɛ shika aaahi ewe lɛ, ni ejalɛ lɛ aaahi shi kɛaaya naanɔ.

english_verse: They will be so kind and merciful and good, that they will be a light in the dark for others who do the right thing.
translation_verse: Jalɔi lɛ, la tsoɔ yɛ duŋ mli hãa amɛ; durolɔ kɛ mɔbɔnalɔ kɛ jalɔ ji lɛ.

english_verse: Life will go well for those who freely lend and are honest in business.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni mli hi, ni efaa mɔ nɔ, ni ekɛ anɔkwayeli feɔ enii fɛɛ lɛ, aaahi ahã lɛ.

english_verse: They won't ever be troubled, and the kind things they do will never be forgotten.
translation_verse: Jalɔ lɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko tsakeŋ lɛ gbi ko gbi ko; aaakai lɛ kɛaatee naanɔ.

english_verse: Bad news won't bother them; they have decided to trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Esheee sane fɔŋ ko he adafitswaa gbeyei, ehemɔkɛyeli mli wa, ni ehiɛ kãa Yehowa nɔ.

english_verse: They are dependable and not afraid, and they will live to see their enemies defeated.
translation_verse: Etsui efãaa, ni esheŋ gbeyei kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni eeena ehenyɛlɔi lɛ anaagbee.

english_verse: They will always be remembered and greatly praised, because they were kind and freely gave to the poor.
translation_verse: Edɛŋ kpɔɔ pam hãa ohiafoi, ejalɛ lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ; aaahã ena hewalɛ, ni ehiɛ aaaba nyam.

english_verse: When evil people see this, they angrily bite their tongues and disappear. They will never get what they really want.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɔ̃ji naa enɛ, ni amɛmli woɔ la, amɛkpeɔ amɛnyanyɔji ashishi, ni amɛlaajeɔ; mɛi fɔ̃ji ataomɔnii fɛɛ feɔ yaka.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Everyone who serves him, come and praise his name.
translation_verse: Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi! Oo nyɛ Yehowa tsuji fɛɛ, nyɛjiea, nyɛjiea Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi!

english_verse: Let the name of the Lord be praised now and forever.
translation_verse: Ajie Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi, kɛjɛ benɛ mli aahu kɛyaashi naanɔ!

english_verse: From dawn until sunset the name of the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Esa akɛ ajie Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi kɛjɛ hulu shiteehe aahu kɛyaashi eshinyɔɔhe!

english_verse: The Lord is far above all of the nations; he is more glorious than the heavens.
translation_verse: Yehowa kwɔ gojoo kɛteke majimaji fɛɛ, ni enunyam lɛ teke ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi.

english_verse: No one can compare with the Lord our God. His throne is high above,
translation_verse: Namɔ tamɔ Yehowa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi,

english_verse: and he looks down to see the heavens and the earth.
translation_verse: ni emaa ehiɛ shi, ni ekwɛɔ nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ lɛ?

english_verse: God lifts the poor and needy from dust and ashes,
translation_verse: Eteɔ ohiafo shi kɛjɛɔ mlu mli, ni ewoɔ mɔ ni efi lɛ nɔ kɛjɛɔ tumo nɔ,

english_verse: and he lets them take part in ruling his people.
translation_verse: koni ehã ekɛ abladei ni ji emaŋ lɛ mli abladei lɛ atara shi.

english_verse: When a wife has no children, he blesses her with some, and she is happy. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ehãa yoo kene tsɔ̃ɔ shĩanyɛ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ biianyɛ ni yɔɔ miishɛɛ. Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

english_verse: God brought his people out of Egypt, that land with a strange language.
translation_verse: Be ni Israelbii lɛ je Ijipt ni Yakob shwiei lɛ je maŋ ni wieɔ maŋsɛɛ wiemɔ lɛŋ lɛ,

english_verse: He made Judah his holy place and ruled over Israel.
translation_verse: Yuda tsɔ̃ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni Israel tsɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ.

english_verse: When the sea looked at God, it ran away, and the Jordan River flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ na, ni ejo foi; Yordan hu kpa hoo.

english_verse: The mountains and the hills skipped around like goats.
translation_verse: Gɔji lɛ tumɔ tamɔ ojwɛnii, ni gɔŋkpɔi lɛ hu tumɔ tamɔ gwantɛŋbii.

english_verse: Ask the sea why it ran away or ask the Jordan why it flowed upstream.
