translation_verse: Oo Ŋshɔ, te aye tɛŋŋ, ni ojoɔ foi nɛɛ? Bo Yordan hu, ni okpa hoo nɛɛ?

english_verse: Ask the mountains and the hills why they skipped like goats!
translation_verse: Oo nyɛ gɔji, mɛni eba ni nyɛtumɔɔ tamɔ ojwɛnii nɛɛ?

english_verse: Earth, you will tremble, when the Lord God of Jacob comes near,
translation_verse: Bo shikpɔŋ, ohe akpokpo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, yɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ,

english_verse: because he turns solid rock into flowing streams and pools of water.
translation_verse: mɔ ni hãa tɛsaa tsɔ̃ɔ kpaakpo, ni ehãa tswɛrɛbo tsɔ̃ɔ nuhiŋmɛi lɛ!

english_verse: We don't deserve praise! The Lord alone deserves all of the praise, because of his love and faithfulness.
translation_verse: Jeee wɔ, Yehowa, jeee wɔ, shi ogbɛi lɛ moŋ aŋɔ anunyam ahã, yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛ onɔkwayeli lɛ hewɔ!

english_verse: Why should the nations ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Mɛɛba majimaji lɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ?”

english_verse: Our God is in the heavens, doing as he chooses.
translation_verse: WɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi lɛ eyɔɔ; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ, no efeɔ.

english_verse: The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Amɛmãgãi lɛ, jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni; gbɔmɔ adesa ninenaa nitsumɔ ni.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Amɛyɛ naabui, shi amɛwieee; amɛyɛ hiŋmɛii, shi amɛnaaa nii.

english_verse: Their ears can't hear, and their noses can't smell.
translation_verse: Amɛyɛ toii, shi amɛnuuu nii; amɛyɛ gugɔji, shi amɛfuuu nii.

english_verse: Their hands have no feeling, their legs don't move, and they can't make a sound.
translation_verse: Amɛyɛ niji, shi amɛmɔ̃ɔɔ nɔ mli; amɛyɛ naji hu, shi amɛnyiɛɛɛ; ni amɛtswaaa amɛsɛŋ tete.

english_verse: Everyone who made the idols and all who trust them are just as helpless as those useless gods.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni fee amɛ lɛ tamɔ amɛ nɔŋŋ; nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ amɛnɔ lɛ hu tamɔ amɛ.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Oo Israelbii, nyɛŋɔa nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔ̃a Yehowa nɔ! Lɛ ji nyɛbualɔ kɛ nyɛtsɛŋ.

english_verse: Family of Aaron the priest, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Oo Aaronwe, nyɛŋɔa nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔa Yehowa nɔ! Lɛ ji nyɛbualɔ kɛ nyɛtsɛŋ!

english_verse: All of you worship the Lord, so you must trust him to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛsheɔ Yehowa gbeyei, nyɛŋɔa nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔa Yehowa nɔ. Lɛ ji nyɛbualɔ kɛ nyɛtsɛŋ.

english_verse: The Lord will not forget to give us his blessing; he will bless all of Israel and the family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Yehowa ekai wɔ, ni eeejɔɔ wɔ; Eeejɔɔ Israel we lɛ; eeejɔɔ Aaron we lɛ.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, no matter who they are, will receive his blessing.
translation_verse: Eeejɔɔ mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ, mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji fɛɛ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will let your family and your descendants always grow strong.
translation_verse: Yehowa aaahã nyɛshwere babaoo, nyɛ kɛ nyɛbii fɛɛ.

english_verse: May the Lord who created the heavens and the earth give you his blessing.
translation_verse: Yehowa, ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ bɔlɔ lɛ aaajɔɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has kept the heavens for himself, but he has given the earth to us humans.
translation_verse: Ŋwɛi lɛ, Yehowa ŋwɛi ni; shi shikpɔŋ lɛ, eŋɔ ehã gbɔmɛi abii.

english_verse: The dead are silent and cannot praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Jeee gbohii jieɔ Yehowa yi, ni jeee mɛi ni kpelekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbohiiaje lɛ;

english_verse: but we will praise him now and forevermore. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: shi wɔ, hiɛkãalɔi lɛ moŋ wɔɔjie Yehowa yi, kɛjɛ be nɛɛ mli, aahu kɛyaashi naanɔ fɛɛ. Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

english_verse: I love you, Lord! You answered my prayers.
translation_verse: Miisumɔ Yehowa, ejaakɛ ebo migbee kɛ mifaikpamɔ lɛ toi.

english_verse: You paid attention to me, and so I will pray to you as long as I live.
translation_verse: Akɛni egboo etoi shi ehã mi hewɔ lɛ, gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, lɛ mabolɔ matsɛ.

english_verse: Death attacked from all sides, and I was captured by its painful chains. But when I was really hurting,
translation_verse: Gbele tsɔnei lɛ bɔle mi kɛkpe, gbohiiaje gbeyei lɛ mɔ mi; mina nɔ̃, ni miwerɛ ho mihe.

english_verse: I prayed and said, “Lord, please don't let me die!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mibo mitsɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Oo Yehowa, miikpa bo fai, heremɔ miyiwala!”

english_verse: You are kind, Lord, so good and merciful.
translation_verse: Durolɔ kɛ jalɔ ji Yehowa; wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mɔbɔnalɔ ni.

english_verse: You protect ordinary people, and when I was helpless, you saved me
translation_verse: Yehowa baa humii ayi; be ni aba mi shi lɛ ehere miyiwala.

english_verse: and treated me so kindly that I don't need to worry anymore.
translation_verse: Oo, misusuma, kuu osɛɛ ni oyajɔɔ ohe, ejaakɛ Yehowa efee bo ejurɔ pii.

english_verse: You, Lord, have saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ojie mi yɛ gbele dɛŋ, ofo mihiŋmɛiŋ yaafonu sɛɛ, ni ohãaa mashane ni magbee shi.

english_verse: Now I will walk at your side in this land of the living.
translation_verse: Yehowa hiŋmɛi aaakã mihe yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: I was faithful to you when I was suffering,
translation_verse: Mihiɛ mihemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli kpɛŋŋ, be ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ahao mi naakpa” lɛ.

english_verse: though in my confusion I said, “I can't trust anyone!”
translation_verse: Mikɛ tsuifãa kɛɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni aaaŋɔ he afɔ enɔ.”

english_verse: What must I give you, Lord, for being so good to me?
translation_verse: Mɛni maŋɔ to Yehowa najiaŋ, yɛ ejuji fɛɛ ni efee mi lɛ hewɔ?

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people meet.
translation_verse: Maye mishiwoi lɛ anɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: You are deeply concerned when one of your loyal people faces death.
translation_verse: Yehowa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ agbele jara wa yɛ ehiɛ.

english_verse: I worship you, Lord, just as my mother did, and you have rescued me from the chains of death.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, otsulɔ ji mi; otsulɔ kɛ oweyoo bi ji mi. Okpɔlɔ migboklɛi lɛ.

english_verse: I will offer you a sacrifice to show how grateful I am, and I will pray.
translation_verse: Mashã shidaa afɔle mahã bo, ni maja Yehowa.

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people
translation_verse: Maye mishiwoi lɛ anɔ mahã Yehowa yɛ emaŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ,

english_verse: gather at your temple in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: yɛ Yehowa we lɛ kpoi lɛ anɔ yɛ bo omli. Oo Yerusalɛm! Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi.

english_verse: All of you nations, come praise the Lord! Let everyone praise him.
translation_verse: Nyɛ majimaji fɛɛ, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi! Nyɛ maji anɔ bii fɛɛ, nyɛkafoa lɛ!

english_verse: God's love for us is wonderful; his faithfulness never ends. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ esuɔmɔ kpele ni tsakeee lɛ fa yɛ wɔnɔ; ni Yehowa anɔkwayeli lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ. Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Oo, nyɛdaaa Yehowa shi, ejaakɛ ehi, ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa.

english_verse: Let Israel shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Hã Israelbii akɛɛ akɛ, “Naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa.”

english_verse: Let the family of Aaron the priest shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Hã Aaronwe lɛ akɛɛ akɛ, “Naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa.”

english_verse: Let every true worshiper of the Lord shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Hã mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ akɛɛ akɛ, “Naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa.”

english_verse: When I was really hurting, I prayed to the Lord. He answered my prayer, and took my worries away.
translation_verse: Mimanehulu lɛ mli lɛ mibolɔ mitsɛ Yehowa, ni Yehowa here mi nɔ, ni ehã miye mihe.

english_verse: The Lord is on my side, and I am not afraid of what others can do to me.
translation_verse: Akɛni Yehowa yɛ misɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, misheee gbeyei! Mɛni gbɔmɔ aaanyɛ mi afee?

english_verse: With the Lord on my side, I will defeat my hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Yehowa damɔ mimasɛi akɛ mibualɔ; ni mana mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ anaagbee.

english_verse: It is better to trust the Lord for protection than to trust anyone else,
translation_verse: Ehi akɛ abaa Yehowa abo, fe nɔ ni akɛ hiɛ aaafɔ̃ gbɔmɔ adesa nɔ.

english_verse: Nations surrounded me, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Majimaji bɔle mihe kɛkpe kpula; Yehowa gbɛi mli lɛ, mifolɔ amɛmli mishwie.

english_verse: They attacked from all sides, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Amɛbɔle mi, hɛɛ, amɛbɔle mi kɛkpe kpula; Yehowa gbɛi mli lɛ, mifolɔ amɛmli mishwie.

english_verse: They swarmed around like bees, but by the power of the Lord, I got rid of them and their fiery sting.
translation_verse: Amɛbɔle mi tamɔ wobii; amɛtso grigri tamɔ ŋmei la; Yehowa gbɛi mli lɛ, mifolɔ amɛmli mishwie.

english_verse: Their attacks were so fierce that I nearly fell, but the Lord helped me.
translation_verse: Atsi mi waa, ni kulɛ miyagbee shi; shi Yehowa ye ebua mi.

english_verse: My power and my strength come from the Lord, and he has saved me.
translation_verse: Yehowa ji mihewalɛ kɛ milala; Yehowa etsɔ̃ miyiwalaheremɔ.

english_verse: From the tents of God's people come shouts of victory: “The Lord is powerful!
translation_verse: Nyɛboa toi, kunimyeli nyamɔ lalai miigbɛɛ yɛ jalɔi abuui amli.

english_verse: With his mighty arm the Lord wins victories! The Lord is powerful!”
translation_verse: Yehowa hewalɛ kpele lɛ ni fee enɛ! Yehowa hewalɛ lɛ ehã wɔye kunim. Ehewalɛ kpele lɛ ehã wɔye ta mli kunim.

english_verse: And so my life is safe, and I will live to tell what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Migboŋ, shi moŋ miyi aaana wala, ni majaje Yehowa nitsumɔi lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: He punished me terribly, but he did not let death lay its hands on me.
translation_verse: Yehowa egbala mitoi waa moŋ, shi eŋɔko mi ehãko gbele.

english_verse: Open the gates of justice! I will enter and tell the Lord how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Nyɛgbelea jalɛ agboi lɛ nyɛhãa mi, koni matsɔ̃ mli ni mayada Yehowa shi.

english_verse: Here is the gate of the Lord! Everyone who does right may enter this gate.
translation_verse: Yehowa agbo lɛ nɛ. Jalɔi lɛ baatsɔ̃ mli kɛbote mli.

english_verse: I praise the Lord for answering my prayers and saving me.
translation_verse: Miida bo shi akɛ ohere mi nɔ, ni otsɔ̃ miyiwalaheremɔ.

english_verse: The stone that the builders tossed aside has now become the most important stone.
translation_verse: Tɛ lɛ ni tsutswalɔi lɛ kwa lɛ etsɔ̃ koŋtɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has done this, and it is amazing to us.
translation_verse: Yehowa nifeemɔnii nɛ; eyɛ naakpɛɛ yɛ wɔhiɛ.

english_verse: This day belongs to the Lord! Let's celebrate and be glad today.
translation_verse: Ŋmɛnɛ ji gbi ni Yehowa fee lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔmli afilia wɔ, ni wɔnyaa yɛ mli.

english_verse: We'll ask the Lord to save us! We'll sincerely ask the Lord to let us win.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, ofainɛ, heremɔ wɔyiwala koo! Oo Yehowa, hã omanye aba koo!

english_verse: God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! We praise you from here in the house of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ mɔ ni baa yɛ Yehowa gbɛi lɛŋ lɛ! Wɔmiijɔɔ nyɛ kɛmiijɛ Yehowa we lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and he has given us light! Start the celebration! March with palm branches all the way to the altar.
translation_verse: Yehowa lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ehã la etso ehã wɔ. Nyɛhiɛa gbijurɔ blɛo lɛ kɛyaa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji lɛ ahe tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is my God! I will praise him and tell him how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ, mada bo shi. Bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ, makafo bo.

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Oo, nyɛdaa Yehowa shi, ejaakɛ ehi; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone who lives right and obeys your Law.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ mɛi ni shwamɔ ko bɛ amɛjeŋba he, ni amɛyeɔ Yehowa mla lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You bless all those who follow your commands from deep in their hearts
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ mɛi ni yeɔ ekpɔi lɛ anɔ ni amɛkɛ amɛtsui muu fɛɛ taoɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ,

english_verse: and who never do wrong or turn from you.
translation_verse: mɛi ni efeee nɔ ni ejaaa gbɛ hu, shi amɛbaa amɛjeŋ yɛ Yehowa gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You have ordered us always to obey your teachings;
translation_verse: Yehowa, okɛ omlai lɛ hã wɔ, ni ofã wɔ akɛ wɔye nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: I don't ever want to stray from your laws.
translation_verse: Oo, mina ni kulɛ mikɛ anɔkwayeli aaaye omlai lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Thinking about your commands will keep me from doing some foolish thing.
translation_verse: Kɛji mikɛ okitãi lɛ fɛɛ eto mihiɛ lɛ, no lɛ mihiɛ eshwieŋ shi.

english_verse: I will do right and praise you by learning to respect your perfect laws.
translation_verse: Mikɛ tsui krɔŋŋ aaajie oyi kɛji mikase ojalɛ mlai lɛ.

english_verse: I will obey all of them! Don't turn your back on me.
translation_verse: Maye okpɔi lɛ anɔ, Oo, kaakwa mi kwrakwra. Yehowa Mla lɛ nɔyeli

english_verse: Young people can live a clean life by obeying your word.
translation_verse: Te oblanyo aaafee tɛŋŋ, ni eeehã ejeŋba he atse hu? No ji akɛ ekwɛ ehe nɔ jogbaŋŋ yɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa.

english_verse: I worship you with all my heart. Don't let me walk away from your commands.
translation_verse: Mitaoɔ osɛɛgbɛ kɛ mitsui muu lɛ fɛɛ; kaahã migba afã kɛje okitãi lɛ ahe.

english_verse: I treasure your word above all else; it keeps me from sinning against you.
translation_verse: Mikɛ owiemɔ lɛ eto mitsui mli koni mikafee esha mishi bo.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, majie oyi, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi okpɔi lɛ.

english_verse: With my own mouth, I tell others the laws that you have spoken.
translation_verse: Mikɛ minaabu jajeɔ omlai lɛ fɛɛ ni jɛɔ onaa lɛ.

english_verse: Obeying your instructions brings as much happiness as being rich.
translation_verse: Minaa okpɔi lɛ ahe miishɛɛ fe bɔ ni mimli filiɔ mi yɛ ninamɔ kpɔtɔɔ he.

english_verse: I will study your teachings and follow your footsteps.
translation_verse: Majwɛŋ okpɔi lɛ ahe, ni mihiɛ aaakã otsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: I will take pleasure in your laws and remember your words.
translation_verse: Mimli aaafli mi yɛ okpɔi lɛ ahe; mihiɛ kpaŋ owiemɔ lɛ nɔ. Yehowa Mla lɛ he miishɛɛnamɔ

english_verse: Treat me with kindness, Lord, so that I may live and do what you say.
translation_verse: Okɛ otsulɔ aye mlihilɛ naa koni miyi ana wala, koni maye owiemɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Open my mind and let me discover the wonders of your Law.
translation_verse: Gbelemɔ mihiŋmɛii koni mana omla lɛ mli naakpɛɛnii lɛ.

english_verse: I live here as a stranger. Don't keep me from knowing your commands.
translation_verse: Gbɔ ji mi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; kaaŋɔ okitãi lɛ otee mi.

english_verse: What I want most and at all times is to honor your laws.
translation_verse: Shwee ni mishweɔ omlai lɛ be fɛɛ be lɛ, ewo misusuma hela.

english_verse: You punish those boastful, worthless nobodies who turn from your commands.
translation_verse: Okãa hewolɔi, ni mɛi ni duɔ gbɛ kɛjeɔ okitãi lɛ ahe lɛ, alomɔ amɛ.

english_verse: Don't let them sneer and insult me for following you.
translation_verse: Jiemɔ mi kɛje ahorabɔlɔi kɛ heguɔgbelɔi adɛŋ, ejaakɛ miye omlai lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: I keep thinking about your teachings, Lord, even if rulers plot against me.
translation_verse: Lumɛi tete po taraa shi amɛkpãŋɔ miyi nɔ; shi mi, otsulɔ lɛ, majwɛŋ okpɔi lɛ ahe.

english_verse: Your laws are my greatest joy! I follow their advice.
translation_verse: Otsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ hãa mimli filiɔ mi, nomɛi woɔ mi ŋaa. Yehowa Mla lɛ nɔyeli he hiɛdɔɔ

english_verse: I am at the point of death. Let your teachings breathe new life into me.
translation_verse: Misusuma kã mlu mli; hã miyi ana wala yɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa.

english_verse: When I told you my troubles, you answered my prayers. Now teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Be ni mijaje mijeŋba fɛɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ bo lɛ, obo mi toi; tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi okpɔi lɛ.

english_verse: Help me to understand your teachings, and I will think about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Hã manu omlai lɛ ashishi koni majwɛŋ onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ahe.

english_verse: I am overcome with sorrow. Encourage me, as you have promised to do.
translation_verse: Miwerɛ eho kɛteke nɔ; wo mi hewalɛ yɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa.

english_verse: Keep me from being deceitful, and be kind enough to teach me your Law.
translation_verse: Kaahã amale jeŋba miigbale mi; ni omlihilɛ naa lɛ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi omla lɛ.

english_verse: I am determined to be faithful and to respect your laws.
translation_verse: Miŋɔ anɔkwayeli gbɛ, mikɛ omlai lɛ eto mihiɛ.

english_verse: I follow your rules, Lord. Don't let me be ashamed.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, mikpɛtɛ omlai lɛ, kaahã mihiɛ miishwie shi.

english_verse: I am eager to learn all that you want me to do; help me to understand more.
translation_verse: Manyiɛ okitãi agbɛ lɛ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛji ogbele mijwɛŋmɔ mli. Niiashishinumɔ he Sɔlemɔ

english_verse: Point out your rules, Lord, and I won't disobey even one of them.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi omlai lɛ ashishi; koni maye nɔ be fɛɛ be.

english_verse: Help me to understand your Law; I promise to obey it with all my heart.
translation_verse: Dromɔ mi niiashishinumɔ, bɔ ni afee ni maye omla lɛ nɔ kɛ mitsui muu lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Direct me by your commands! I love to do what you say.
translation_verse: Kplamɔ mi kɛnyiɛ okitãi lɛ agbɛ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ nomɛi ahe mimii shɛɔ.

english_verse: Make me want to obey you, rather than to be rich.
translation_verse: Hã mashwe omlai lɛ anɔyeli fe ninamɔ.

english_verse: Take away my foolish desires, and let me find life by walking with you.
translation_verse: Kaahã minya yakanii kwɛmɔ he, shi moŋ hã mana wala yɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa.

english_verse: I am your servant! Do for me what you promised to those who worship you.
translation_verse: Shi ni owo mɛi ni sheɔ bo gbeyei lɛ, hã aba mli nakai ahã mi, otsulɔ.

english_verse: Your wonderful teachings protect me from the insults that I hate so much.
translation_verse: Hã ahorabɔɔ ni misheɔ lɛ akagbale mi, ejaakɛ okpɔi lɛ fɛɛ hi.

english_verse: I long for your teachings. Be true to yourself and let me live.
translation_verse: Naa, miishwe omlai lɛ; ni ojalɛ naa lɛ hã miyi ana wala. Yehowa Mla lɛ nɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ

english_verse: Show me your love and save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, hã osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ, kɛ oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ afee minɔ yɛ oshiwoo lɛ naa;

english_verse: Then I will have an answer for everyone who insults me for trusting your word.
translation_verse: kɛkɛ lɛ, mana hetoo mahã mɛi ni bɔɔ mi ahora lɛ; ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã owiemɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: I rely on your laws! Don't take away my chance to speak your truth.
translation_verse: Asaŋ kaajie anɔkwa wiemɔ lɛ kɛmiije midaaŋ kwrakwra; ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã omlai lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: I will keep obeying your Law forever and ever.
translation_verse: Maye omla lɛ nɔ daa kɛyaashi naanɔi anaanɔ;

english_verse: I have gained perfect freedom by following your teachings,
translation_verse: ni maye mihe kɛnyiɛ, ejaakɛ otsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ asɛɛgbɛ mitao.

english_verse: and I trust them so much that I tell them to kings.
translation_verse: Majaje okpɔi lɛ yɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ahiɛ, ni mihiɛ gboŋ he;

english_verse: I love your commands! They bring me happiness.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ mimii shɛɔ mihe yɛ okitãi ni misumɔɔ lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: I love and respect them and will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Mibuɔ okitãi ni misumɔɔ lɛ, ni mijwɛŋɔ okpɔi lɛ ahe. Yehowa Mla lɛ mli ekãanamɔ

english_verse: Don't forget your promise to me, your servant. I depend on it.
translation_verse: Kaimɔ owiemɔ ni okɛ otsulɔ wie ni ehã mina hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: When I am hurting, I find comfort in your promise that leads to life.
translation_verse: Enɛ ji mimiishɛjemɔ yɛ mimanehulu lɛ mli, akɛ owiemɔ lɛ hãa miyi naa wala.

english_verse: Conceited people sneer at me, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei yeɔ mihe fɛo naakpa; kɛ̃lɛ mijeko omla lɛ sɛɛ.

english_verse: I find true comfort, Lord, because your laws have stood the test of time.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, kɛji mikai oteteete mlai lɛ, ehãa mimii shɛɔ mihe.

english_verse: I get furious when evil people turn against your Law.
translation_verse: Mimli ewo la naakpa yɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji ni kwaa omla lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: No matter where I am, your teachings fill me with songs.
translation_verse: Okpɔi lɛ ji lalai ni milaa yɛ migbɔtoo be yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Even in the night I think about you, Lord, and I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, nyɔɔŋ tete mikaiɔ ogbɛi, ni miyeɔ omla lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: You have blessed me because I have always followed your teachings.
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ jɔɔmɔ nɛɛ feɔ minɔ, ejaakɛ miyeɔ okpɔi lɛ anɔ. Yehowa Mla lɛ nɔyeli

english_verse: You, Lord, are my choice, and I will obey you.
translation_verse: Yehowa, bo ji migbɛfaŋnɔ; miiwo shi akɛ maye owiemɔi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: With all my heart I beg you to be kind to me, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Mikɛ mitsui muu lɛ fɛɛ miikpa fai koni ona mi mɔbɔ yɛ oshiwoo lɛ naa.

english_verse: I pay careful attention as you lead me, and I follow closely.
translation_verse: Kɛji mijwɛŋ mijeŋba he lɛ, mikuɔ misɛɛ kɛbaa okpɔi lɛ ahe.

english_verse: As soon as you command, I do what you say.
translation_verse: Mihe feɔ oya koni maye okitãi lɛ anɔ, ni mishashaooo shi.

english_verse: Evil people may set a trap, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɔ̃ji akpãi lɛ fimɔɔ mi moŋ nɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ mihiɛ kpaaa omla lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Your laws are so fair that I wake up and praise you in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Miteɔ shi nyɔɔŋteŋ mijieɔ oyi yɛ ojalɛ kojomɔi lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: I choose as my friends everyone who worships you and follows your teachings.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɛɛ ni sheɔ bo gbeyei lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yeɔ okpɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ anaanyo ji mi.

english_verse: Our Lord, your love is seen all over the world. Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ; tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi koni male omlai lɛ. Yehowa Mla lɛ jarawalɛ

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord, and you have kept your promise to treat me with kindness.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, ofee otsulɔ ejurɔ yɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa.

english_verse: Give me wisdom and good sense. I trust your commands.
translation_verse: Hã mi jwɛŋmɔ kpakpa kɛ nilee, ejaakɛ miheɔ okitãi lɛ miyeɔ.

english_verse: Once you corrected me for not obeying you, but now I do obey.
translation_verse: Midu gbɛ dani agbala mitoi lɛ, shi agbɛnɛ lɛ, mibo owiemɔ lɛ toi.

english_verse: You are kindhearted, and you do good things, so teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Ohi, ni ofeɔ ejurɔ; tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi okpɔi lɛ.

english_verse: My reputation is being ruined by conceited liars, but with all my heart I follow your teachings.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei folɔɔ amale saji shwieɔ minɔ; shi mi lɛ, mikɛ mitsui muu lɛ fɛɛ yeɔ otsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Those liars have no sense, but I find happiness in your Law.
translation_verse: Hewolɔi nɛɛ, amɛtsui wa, shi mi lɛ, omla lɛ he mimii shɛɔ.

english_verse: When you corrected me, it did me good because it taught me to study your laws.
translation_verse: Ehi akɛ agbala mitoi, koni makase okpɔi lɛ.

english_verse: I would rather obey you than to have a thousand pieces of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Mla ni jɛ onaa lɛ, ehi hã mi fe shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi akpei abɔ. Yehowa Mla lɛ jalɛ

english_verse: You created me and put me together. Make me wise enough to learn what you have commanded.
translation_verse: Bo obɔ mi, ni okɛ oniji shɔ̃ mi; hã mi niiashishinumɔ koni makase okitãi lɛ.

english_verse: Your worshipers will see me, and they will be glad that I trust your word.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni sheɔ bo gbeyei lɛ aaana mi, ni amɛaana miishɛɛ; ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã owiemɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Your decisions are correct, and you were right to punish me.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, mile akɛ okojomɔi lɛ ja, ni anɔkwayeli okɛgbala mitoi!

english_verse: I serve you, Lord. Comfort me with your love, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Hã osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ ashɛje mimii, tamɔ bɔ ni owo otsulɔ shi lɛ.

english_verse: I love to obey your Law! Have mercy and let me live.
translation_verse: Naa mi mɔbɔ koni miyi ana wala; ejaakɛ omla lɛ he mimii shɛɔ.

english_verse: Put down those proud people who hurt me with their lies, because I have chosen to study your teachings.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni sheee bo, Nyɔŋmɔ, gbeyei lɛ, hã amɛhiɛ ashwie shi; ejaakɛ yakatswaa amɛfolɔ minaa lɛ; shi mi lɛ, majwɛŋ otsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ ahe.

english_verse: Let your worshipers come to me, so they will learn to obey your rules.
translation_verse: Hã mɛi ni sheɔ bo gbeyei lɛ akpale kɛba miŋɔɔ koni amɛbale okpɔi lɛ.

english_verse: Let me truly respect your laws, so I won't be ashamed.
translation_verse: Kaahã kpa ko miihi mitsui mli yɛ omlai lɛ agbɛfaŋ, koni mihiɛ akashwie shi. Kpɔmɔ he sɔlemɔ

english_verse: I long for you to rescue me! Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Misusuma miiye oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ he kumai, ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã owiemɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: I am worn out from waiting for you to keep your word. When will you have mercy?
translation_verse: Mihiŋmɛi miiye oshiwoo lɛ he kumai. Mibiɔ akɛ, “Te be ni oooshɛje mimii hu?”

english_verse: My life is wasting away like a dried-up wineskin, but I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mitsɔ̃ tamɔ wain wolo tɔ momo yɛ lasu mli; kɛ̃lɛ mihiɛ kpaaa okpɔi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: I am your servant! How long must I suffer? When will you punish those troublemakers?
translation_verse: Mɛɛbe otsulɔ aaamɛ kɛyashi? Mɛɛbe ooogbala mɛi ni waa mi yi lɛ atoi.

english_verse: Those proud people reject your teachings, and they dig pits for me to fall in.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni sheee bo gbeyei, mɛi ni yeee omlai lɛ anɔ lɛ, etsatsaa bui amɛto mi.

english_verse: Your laws can be trusted! Protect me from cruel liars.
translation_verse: Okitãi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, anɔkwale sɔŋŋ ni; amɛkɛ amale folɔɔ minaa; ye obua mi.

english_verse: They have almost killed me, but I have been faithful to your teachings.
translation_verse: Shwɛ shrao ni amɛplenee mi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; shi mi lɛ, mikwako okpɔi lɛ.

english_verse: Show that you love me and let me live, so that I may obey your commands.
translation_verse: Yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ naa lɛ hã miyi ana wala, koni maye okpɔi ni jɛ onaa lɛ anɔ. Yehowa Mla lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ

english_verse: Our Lord, you are eternal! Your word will last as long as the heavens.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, owiemɔ lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ yɛ ŋwɛi kɛmiiya naanɔ.

english_verse: You remain faithful in every generation, and the earth you created will keep standing firm.
translation_verse: Onɔkwayeli lɛ yɛ kɛmiiya yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ. Bo oto shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi, ni ema shi shiŋŋ nɛɛ.

english_verse: All things are your servants, and the laws you made are still in effect today.
translation_verse: Bo ofãmɔ naa lɛ, amɛyɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ; ejaakɛ otsuji ji nibii fɛɛ kwa.

english_verse: If I had not found happiness in obeying your Law, I would have died in misery.
translation_verse: Eji jeee omla lɛ he mimii shɛɔ kulɛ, be nɛ mihiɛ ekpãtã momo, yɛ mimanehulu lɛ mli.

english_verse: I won't ever forget your teachings, because you give me new life when I follow them.
translation_verse: Mihiɛ kpaŋ omlai lɛ anɔ gbi ko gbi ko; ejaakɛ nomɛi anɔ otsɔ̃ ni ohã miyi na wala.

english_verse: I belong to you, and I have respected your laws, so keep me safe.
translation_verse: Onɔ ji mi, heremɔ mi, ejaakɛ mitao omlai lɛ asɛɛgbɛ.

english_verse: Brutal enemies are waiting to ambush and destroy me, but I obey your rules.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɔ̃ji woɔ mi ka koni amɛkpãtã mihiɛ, shi mi lɛ, mijwɛŋɔ omlai lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: I deeply love your Law! I think about it all day.
translation_verse: Oo, misumɔɔ omla lɛ akɛ nɔ ko! Gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ, no he mijwɛŋɔ.

english_verse: Your laws never leave my mind, and they make me much wiser than my enemies.
translation_verse: Okitãi lɛ hãa mileɔ nii fe mihenyɛlɔi lɛ; ejaakɛ mihiɛ mli kpɛŋŋ.

english_verse: Thinking about your teachings gives me better understanding than my teachers,
translation_verse: Miyɛ niiashishinumɔ fe mitsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ okpɔi lɛ ahe mijwɛŋɔ.

english_verse: and obeying your laws makes me wiser than those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Minuɔ niiashishi kwraa fe hiimeji tete po, ejaakɛ miyeɔ okpɔi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: I obey your word instead of following a way that leads to trouble.
translation_verse: Mikɔ minane kɛje gbɛ fɔŋ fɛɛ gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ, koni maye owiemɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: You have been my teacher, and I won't reject your instructions.
translation_verse: Migbako afã kɛjeko owiemɔi lɛ ahe, ejaakɛ bo otsɔ̃ɔ mi nii.

english_verse: Your teachings are sweeter than honey.
translation_verse: Owiemɔi lɛ ŋɔɔ minaa akɛ nɔ ko; eŋɔɔ minaa fe wo tete!

english_verse: Your word is a lamp that gives light wherever I walk.
translation_verse: Owiemɔ ji kane hã minanefaamɔ, kɛ la ni kpɛɔ yɛ migbɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Your laws are fair, and I have given my word to respect them all.
translation_verse: Mikã kitã, ni mima nɔ mi akɛ maye ojalɛ mlai lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: I am in terrible pain! Save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Miina nɔ naakpa! Oo Yehowa, hã miyi ana wala yɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa!

english_verse: Accept my offerings of praise and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, ŋɔɔ oyi ni mijieɔ lɛ akɛ afɔle, koni otsɔ̃ɔ mi omlai lɛ.

english_verse: I never forget your teachings, although my life is always in danger.
translation_verse: Mihiɛ miwala yɛ midɛŋ be fɛɛ be; shi omla lɛ mihiɛ kpaaa nɔ.

english_verse: Some merciless people are trying to trap me, but I never turn my back on your teachings.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɔ̃ji etsɔ̃ mi tsɔne moŋ nɛ, shi miduko gbɛ kɛjeko otsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ ahe.

english_verse: They will always be my most prized possession and my source of joy.
translation_verse: Miŋɔ omlai lɛ mifee migbɛfaŋnɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ, ejaakɛ nomɛi ahe miishɛɛ mitsui naa.

english_verse: I have made up my mind to obey your laws forever, no matter what.
translation_verse: Mikpɛ miyiŋ akɛ maye omlai lɛ anɔ daa kɛyaashi naanɔ. Shweshweeshwe yɛ Yehowa Mla lɛ naa

english_verse: I hate anyone whose loyalty is divided, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Jwɛŋmɔ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔtsɛmɛi lɛ miihi amɛ; shi misumɔɔ omla lɛ.

english_verse: You are my place of safety and my shield. Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Bo ji miteemɔhe kɛ mitsɛŋ; owiemɔ lɛ nɔ mihiɛ kã.

english_verse: All you worthless people, get away from me! I am determined to obey the commands of my God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ efɔŋfeelɔi, nyɛjea minɔ nyɛyaa, koni maye miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kitãi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Be true to your word, Lord. Keep me alive and strong; don't let me be ashamed because of my hope.
translation_verse: Hiɛmɔ mimli yɛ oshiwoo lɛ naa, koni miyi ana wala; ni mihiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ kaahã mihiɛ miishwie shi.

english_verse: Keep me safe and secure, so that I will always respect your laws.
translation_verse: Hiɛmɔ mimli koni mafee shweshweeshwe, koni maye okpɔi lɛ anɔ be fɛɛ be.

english_verse: You reject all deceitful liars because they refuse your teachings.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɛɛ ni duɔ gbɛ kɛjeɔ okpɔi lɛ ahe lɛ, okwaa amɛ; ejaakɛ amɛnilee fɛɛ lɛ shishiumɔ ni.

english_verse: As far as you are concerned, evil people are garbage, and so I follow your rules.
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji fɛɛ lɛ, oshɛrɛɔ amɛ oshwieɔ tamɔ dadefei; no hewɔ lɛ, miisumɔ okitãi lɛ.

english_verse: I tremble all over when I think of you and the way you judge.
translation_verse: Ohe gbeyei naa lɛ, mihe kpokpoɔ; ni miishe odɛ̃ŋ kojomɔi lɛ agbeyei. Yehowa Mla lɛ nɔyeli

english_verse: I did what was fair and right! Don't hand me over to those who want to mistreat me.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni ja ni hi lɛ, mifee; kaaŋmɛɛ mihe ohã mɛi ni waa mi yi lɛ.

english_verse: Take good care of me, your servant, and don't let me be harmed by those conceited people.
translation_verse: Daamɔ mli ohã otsulɔ, koni ahi ahã lɛ; kaahã mɛi ni sheee bo, Nyɔŋmɔ, gbeyei miiwa mi yi.

english_verse: My eyes are weary from waiting to see you keep your promise to come and save me.
translation_verse: Etɔ mi kɛ oyiwalaheremɔ kɛ ojalɛ shiwoo lɛ gbɛkwɛmɔ.

english_verse: Show your love for me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Okɛ otsulɔ aye yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ naa; ni tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi omlai lɛ.

english_verse: I serve you, so let me understand your teachings.
translation_verse: Otsulɔ ji mi; dromɔ mi niiashishinumɔ, koni male omlai lɛ.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! They have broken your Law.
translation_verse: Be ni Yehowa baafee nɔ ko lɛ eshɛ; ejaakɛ akwa omla lɛ.

english_verse: Your laws mean more to me than the finest gold.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, miisumɔ okitãi lɛ fe shika; hɛɛ fe shika krɔŋŋ.

english_verse: I follow all your commands, but I hate anyone who leads me astray.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mibaa mijeŋ yɛ okpɔi lɛ anaa. Miihi kutumpɔo gbɛi fɛɛ. Ashweɔ Yehowa Mla lɛ nɔyeli

english_verse: Your teachings are wonderful, and I respect them all.
translation_verse: Omlai lɛ yɛ naakpɛɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, misusuma yeɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Understanding your word brings light to the minds of ordinary people.
translation_verse: Owiemɔi lɛ amlitsɔ̃ɔmɔ, gbeleɔ jwɛŋmɔ mli fãŋŋ, ni ehãa mɔ ni leee nii leɔ nii.

english_verse: I honestly want to know everything you teach.
translation_verse: Migbɛɔ midaaŋ kɛ tsuisuu, yɛ shwee ni mishweɔ okitãi lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: Think about me and be kind, just as you are to everyone who loves your name.
translation_verse: Tsɔ̃ ohiɛ okwɛ mi, ni ona mi mɔbɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni ofeɔ ohãa mɛi ni sumɔɔ ogbɛi lɛ.

english_verse: Keep your promise and don't let me stumble or let sin control my life.
translation_verse: Hã minane amɔ shi yɛ oshiwoo lɛ naa, ni kaahã nɔsha ko miiye minɔ.

english_verse: Protect me from abuse, so I can obey your laws.
translation_verse: Heremɔ mi kɛjɛ adesa yiwalɛ mli, koni maye omlai lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Tse ohiɛ ohã otsulɔ koni otsɔ̃ɔ mi omlai lɛ.

english_verse: When anyone disobeys you, my eyes overflow with tears.
translation_verse: Mihiŋmɛiŋ yaafonu hoɔ tamɔ faa, ejaakɛ ayeee omlai lɛ anɔ. Yehowa Mla lɛ naa jalɛ saneyeli

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and your decisions are fair.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, jalɔ ji bo, ni okojomɔi lɛ hu ja kɛmɔ shi.

english_verse: All your teachings are true and trustworthy.
translation_verse: Kitãi ni awo yɛ omlai lɛ ahe lɛ, jalɛ kɛ anɔkwale sɔŋŋ ni.

english_verse: It upsets me greatly when my enemies neglect your teachings.
translation_verse: Mihiɛdɔɔ hãa mimli woɔ la fe nine; ejaakɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ kpaa owiemɔi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Your word to me, your servant, is like pure gold; I treasure what you say.
translation_verse: Aka oshiwoo lɛ akwɛ, ni ana akɛ anɔkwale ni; no hewɔ ni otsulɔ sumɔɔ oshiwoi lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone calls me a nobody, but I remember your laws.
translation_verse: Mi lɛ, fufɔoo ji mi, ni abuuu mi; shi kɛ̃lɛ mihiɛ kpaaa omlai lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: You will always do right, and your teachings are true.
translation_verse: Ojalɛ lɛ, naanɔ jalɛ ni, ni omla lɛ, anɔkwale ni.

english_verse: I am in deep distress, but I love your teachings.
translation_verse: Haomɔ kɛ piŋmɔ kã minɔ, shi kɛ̃lɛ okitãi lɛ ji nɔ ni shɛjeɔ mimii.

english_verse: Your rules are always fair. Help me to understand them and live.
translation_verse: Omlai lɛ ja kɛmiiya naanɔ. Hã mi niiashishinumɔ koni miyi ana wala. Kpɔ̃mɔ he sɔlemɔ

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please answer me. I promise to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Mikɛ mitsui muu lɛ fɛɛ bolɔɔ tsɛɔ bo! Oo Yehowa, heremɔ mi nɔ, ni maye omlai lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: I beg you to save me, so I can follow your rules.
translation_verse: Miibolɔ miitsɛ bo! Heremɔ miyiwala koni maye omlai lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Even before sunrise, I pray for your help, and I put my hope in what you have said.
translation_verse: Miteɔ shi maŋkɛ mra mibolɔɔ. Hɛɛ, mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ bo kɛhã yelikɛbuamɔ! Mihiɛ kã owiemɔi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: I lie awake at night, thinking of your promises.
translation_verse: Mibɛɛɛ mihiŋmɛi nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ; koni majwɛŋ oshiwoi lɛ ahe.

english_verse: Show that you love me, Lord, and answer my prayer. Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Bo mi toi yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ naa. Oo Yehowa, yɛ ojalɛ naa lɛ baamɔ miyi!

english_verse: People who disobey your Law have made evil plans and want to hurt me,
translation_verse: Mɛi ni kɛ yiŋsha waa mi yi lɛ miibɛŋkɛ mi. Amɛ lɛ amɛkɛ omla lɛ tsuuu nii.

english_verse: but you are with me, and all your commands can be trusted.
translation_verse: Shi Yehowa, bo lɛ obɛŋkɛ mi, ni okitãi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ anɔkwale ni.

english_verse: From studying your laws, I found out long ago you made them to last forever.
translation_verse: Mile kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ beebe, kɛtsɔ̃ omlai lɛ anɔ, akɛ oto omlai lɛ oma shi shiŋŋ kɛmiiya naanɔ. Yelikɛbuamɔ he faikpamɔ

english_verse: I have not forgotten your Law! Look at the trouble I am in, and rescue me.
translation_verse: Kwɛmɔ mimanehulu, ni ohere mi; ejaakɛ mihiɛ kpaaa omla lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Be my defender and protector! Remember your promise and save my life.
translation_verse: Ye misane lɛ ohã mi ni okpɔ̃ mi; hã miyi ana wala yɛ oshiwoo lɛ naa.

english_verse: Evil people won't obey you, and so they have no hope of being saved.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ ahereŋ amɛyiwala; ejaakɛ amɛdiii omlai lɛ asɛɛ.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, omɔbɔnalɛ fa babaoo, ojalɛ saneyeli naa lɛ, hã miyi ana wala.

english_verse: I have a lot of brutal enemies, but still I never turn from your laws.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni waa mi yi kɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ayi fa naakpa; kɛ̃lɛ mishiko omlai lɛ.

english_verse: Those unfaithful people who refuse to obey you are disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Mikwɛɔ mɛi ni bɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ, ni amɛnii feɔ mi taŋ; ejaakɛ amɛyeee okitãi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Remember how I love your laws, and show your love for me by keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Kwɛ bɔ ni misumɔɔ omlai lɛ! Hã miyi ana wala, yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ naa.

english_verse: All you say can be trusted; your teachings are true and will last forever.
translation_verse: Owiemɔ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, anɔkwale sɔŋŋ ni; ni ojalɛ kojomɔi lɛ fɛɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ. Henɔjɔɔmɔ kɛ Yehowa Mla lɛ hãmɔ

english_verse: Rulers are cruel to me for no reason. But with all my heart I respect your words,
translation_verse: Lumɛi folɔɔ minaa yakatswaa kɛ yiwalɛ shi mijɛɔ mitsui mli mibuɔ owiemɔi lɛ.

english_verse: because they bring happiness like treasures taken in war.
translation_verse: Minaa owiemɔ lɛ he miishɛɛ tamɔ mɔ ko ni eto jwetri wulu ahuu.

english_verse: I can't stand liars, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Minyɛɔ, ni mihiɔ apasa; shi misumɔɔ omla lɛ.

english_verse: I praise you seven times a day because your laws are fair.
translation_verse: Mijieɔ oyi shii kpawo daa gbi, yɛ ojalɛ mlai lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: You give peace of mind to all who love your Law. Nothing can make them fall.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni sumɔɔ omla lɛ, amɛyɛ toiŋjɔlɛ babaoo naakpa ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni woɔ amɛnajiaŋ.

english_verse: You are my only hope for being saved, Lord, and I do all you command.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, mihiɛ kã oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ nɔ; ni miyeɔ okitãi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: I love and obey your laws with all my heart.
translation_verse: Misusuma yeɔ omlai lɛ anɔ; miisumɔ mlai lɛ naakpa.

english_verse: You know everything I do. You know I respect every law you have given.
translation_verse: Miyeɔ omlai kɛ okpɔi lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ ohiŋmɛi jwere nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mifeɔ nɔ. Yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ

english_verse: Please, Lord, hear my prayer and give me the understanding that comes from your word.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, bo mibolɔmɔ toi; hã mi niiashishinumɔ yɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns and keep me safe, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Hã mifaikpamɔ lɛ ashɛ oŋɔɔ; heremɔ mi yɛ oshiwoo lɛ naa.

english_verse: If you will teach me your laws, I will praise you
translation_verse: Minaabu aaafɔse oyijiemɔ, ejaakɛ otsɔ̃ɔ mi omlai lɛ.

english_verse: and sing about your promise, because all your teachings are what they ought to be.
translation_verse: Mililɛi aaala omla lɛ he lala, ejaakɛ okitãi lɛ fɛɛ ja.

english_verse: Be ready to protect me because I have chosen to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Feemɔ kralo ni oye obua mi, ejaakɛ miŋɔ omlai lɛ.

english_verse: I am waiting for you to save me, Lord. Your Law makes me happy.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, miishwe odɛ̃ŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ; ni omla lɛ ji nɔ ni shɛjeɔ mimii.

english_verse: Keep me alive, so I can praise you, and let me find help in your teachings.
translation_verse: Hã miyi ana wala bɔ ni afee ni majie oyi; ni ohã omlai lɛ aye abua mi.

english_verse: I am your servant, but I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Please come after me, because I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Midu gbɛ tamɔ too ni elaaje; blɛ baatao mi, otsulɔ, ejaakɛ okitãi lɛ mihiɛ kpako nɔ.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray,
translation_verse: Mifimɔ lɛ mli lɛ mibo mitsɛ Yehowa, koni ebo mi toi.

english_verse: “Come and save me, Lord, from deceitful liars!”
translation_verse: Mikɛɛ akɛ, “Oo Yehowa, heremɔ miyiwala kɛje amalelɔi kɛ shishiulɔi adɛŋ.

english_verse: What punishment is fitting for you deceitful liars?
translation_verse: Bo shishiulɔ, mɛni Yehowa baahã bo, ni mɛni hu ebaafee efata he ehã bo?

english_verse: Your reward should be sharp and flaming arrows!
translation_verse: Etamɔ tabilɔ gãimlibii ni naa ba kɛ ŋai la ni tsoɔ!

english_verse: But I must live as a foreigner among the people of Meshech and in the tents of Kedar.
translation_verse: Kpoo hã mi akɛ mibato gbɔ yɛ Mesek, ni mibahi Kedar bui lɛ amasɛi.

english_verse: I have spent too much time living among people who hate peace.
translation_verse: Mibahi mɛi ni miihi toiŋjɔlɛ ateŋ be babaoo tsɔ̃.

english_verse: I am in favor of peace, but when I speak of it, all they want is war.
translation_verse: Mi lɛ toiŋjɔlɛ gbɔmɔ ji mi; shi kɛji miwie pɛ, amɛ lɛ, amɛto ta amɛwo mi.

english_verse: I look to the hills! Where will I find help?
translation_verse: Miiwo mihiɛ nɔ makwɛ gɔji lɛ; nɛgbɛ miyelikɛbuamɔ aaajɛ aba?

english_verse: It will come from the Lord, who created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Miyelikɛbuamɔ jɛɔ Yehowa, mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ŋɔɔ!

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, and he won't go to sleep or let you stumble.
translation_verse: Ehaŋ oshane; mɔ ni buɔ ohe lɛ, ewɔɔɔ wɔdɔ̃i.

english_verse: The protector of Israel doesn't doze or ever get drowsy.
translation_verse: Naa, mɔ ni buɔ Israel he lɛ, ewɔɔɔ wɔdɔ̃i, ni esaa ewɔŋ gbi ko gbi ko.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, there at your right side to shade you from the sun.
translation_verse: Yehowa ji ohebulɔ! Yehowa ji ohɔ̃ɔŋ yɛ oninejurɔ nɔ.

english_verse: You won't be harmed by the sun during the day or by the moon at night.
translation_verse: Shwane lɛ hulu eshaŋ bo, ni nyɔɔŋ hu nyɔɔŋtsere efeŋ bo nɔ ko nɔ ko.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you and keep you safe from all dangers.
translation_verse: Yehowa aaabu ohe kɛje efɔŋ fɛɛ mli. Eeebu owala he shweshweeshwe.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you now and always wherever you go.
translation_verse: Yehowa aaabu okpojee kɛ omlibaa he, kɛjɛ be nɛɛ mli kɛyaashi naanɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: It made me glad when they said, “Let's go to the house of the Lord!”
translation_verse: Mimii shɛɔ mihe kɛji akɛɛ mi akɛ, “Ba ni wɔtee Yehowa we lɛ.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, we are standing inside your gates.
translation_verse: Oo Yerusalɛm, wɔnaji mamɔ ogboi lɛ mli.

english_verse: Jerusalem, what a strong and beautiful city you are!
translation_verse: Yerusalɛm, bo maŋ ni atswa ama shi kɛtsara nɔ kɛkpe maŋ ni ama lɛ kɛbɔle kɛkpe.

english_verse: Every tribe of the Lord obeys him and comes to you to praise his name.
translation_verse: Jɛi akutsei ni ji Yehowa akutsei lɛ yaa, taakɛ bɔ ni awo amɛ mla lɛ, koni amɛyada Yehowa shi.

english_verse: David's royal throne is here where justice rules.
translation_verse: Jɛi akɛ kojomɔ sɛii emamɔ, David we lɛ kojomɔ sɛii lɛ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we pray that you will have peace, and that all will go well for those who love you.
translation_verse: Nyɛbaa hejɔlɛ nyɛhãa Yerusalɛm. “Mɛi ni sumɔɔ bo lɛ ashwere.”

english_verse: May there be peace inside your city walls and in your palaces.
translation_verse: Toiŋjɔlɛ ahi ogbogboi lɛ amli, ni shweshweeshwefeemɔ ahi omɔji lɛ amli.

english_verse: Because of my friends and my relatives, I will pray for peace.
translation_verse: Minyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ minanemɛi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, makɛɛ bo Yerusalɛm akɛ, “Toiŋjɔlɛ ahi omli.”

english_verse: And because of the house of the Lord our God, I will work for your good.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, we lɛ hewɔ lɛ, matao bo ekpakpa.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, I turn my eyes to you, on your throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Oo, bo miwoɔ mihiɛ nɔ mikwɛɔ, bo mɔ ni ota maŋtsɛ sɛi nɔ yɛ ŋwɛi amli ŋwɛi lɛ.

english_verse: Servants look to their master, but we will look to you, until you have mercy on us.
translation_verse: Naa, bɔ ni tsuji kɛ amɛhe fɔ̃ɔ amɛnuŋtsɔ nɔ, ni weyoo hu kɛ ehe fɔ̃ɔ ewula nɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ wɔ hu wɔkwɛɔ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni eeena wɔ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! We have been insulted more than we can stand,
translation_verse: Naa wɔ mɔbɔ! Oo Yehowa, naa wɔ mɔbɔ! Ejaakɛ agbe wɔhe guɔ babaoo kɛteke nɔ.

english_verse: and we can't take more abuse from those proud, conceited people.
translation_verse: Wɔhe fɛo ni mɛi ni he ejɔ amɛ lɛ yeɔ, kɛ wɔhe guɔ ni hewolɔi lɛ gbeɔ lɛ miisu wɔtsui fe nine.

english_verse: The Lord was on our side! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: Kɛjeee Yehowa ni yɔɔ wɔsɛɛ lɛ, hã Israel akɛɛ akɛ,

english_verse: “The Lord was on our side! Otherwise, the enemy attack
translation_verse: “Kɛjeee Yehowa ni yɔɔ wɔsɛɛ lɛ kulɛ be ni wɔhenyɛlɔi te shi wo wɔ,

english_verse: would have killed us all, because it was furious.
translation_verse: ni amɛmli wo la wo wɔ lɛ, amɛaamimii wɔ hiɛkãalɔi;

english_verse: We would have been swept away in a violent flood
translation_verse: kulɛ nu afua lɛ su wɔyi, ni fai lɛ ha wɔnɔ;

english_verse: of high and roaring waves.”
translation_verse: kulɛ fai ni fee hamahama lɛ su wɔyi.”

english_verse: Let's praise the Lord! He protected us from enemies who were like wild animals,
translation_verse: Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa akɛ ekɛ wɔ hãaa ni wɔtsɔ̃mɔ amɛnyanyɔji anaa loo.

english_verse: and we escaped like birds from a hunter's torn net.
translation_verse: Wɔwala eje amɛdɛŋ tamɔ loofɔlɔ jeɔ loofɔlɔdulɔi atsɔne mli. Tsɔne kpãa lɛ etse ni wɔje mli.

english_verse: The Lord made heaven and earth, and he is the one who sends us help.
translation_verse: Wɔyelikɛbuamɔ yɛ Yehowa, mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ.

english_verse: Everyone who trusts the Lord is like Mount Zion that cannot be shaken and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni hiɛ kã Yehowa nɔ lɛ, amɛtamɔ Zion Gɔŋ ni hosooo, shi moŋ ema shi kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Just as Jerusalem is protected by mountains on every side, the Lord protects his people by holding them in his arms now and forever.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni gɔji ebɔle Yerusalɛm kɛkpe kpula lɛ, nakai Yehowa hu ebɔle emɛi lɛ ahe kɛkpe, kɛjɛ benɛ mli kɛmiiya naanɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: He won't let the wicked rule his people or lead them to do wrong.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ, eyeŋ jalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lumɔ, koni jalɔi lɛ akafee efɔŋ.

english_verse: Let's ask the Lord to be kind to everyone who is good and completely obeys him.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, feemɔ mɛi ni hi kɛ mɛi ni ja yɛ amɛtsuii amli lɛ ejurɔ.

english_verse: When the Lord punishes the wicked, he will punish everyone else who lives an evil life. Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Shi mɛi ni kpaleɔ kɛyaa amɛgbɛi gbohii anɔ lɛ, Yehowa aaaloo amɛ kɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ kɛaatee. Toiŋjɔlɛ aba Israel!

english_verse: It seemed like a dream when the Lord brought us back to the city of Zion.
translation_verse: Be ni Yehowa kpala wɔ, Zion nomii lɛ kɛku sɛɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm ekoŋŋ lɛ, efee wɔ tamɔ nɔ ni lamɔ wɔlaa.

english_verse: We celebrated with laughter and joyful songs. In foreign nations it was said, “The Lord has worked miracles for his people.”
translation_verse: No mli lɛ wɔdaaŋ yimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmɔlɔ, ni wɔbɔ oshe hu kɛ nyamɔ lala. Kɛkɛ lɛ, akɛɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ amli akɛ, “Yehowa efee nibii wuji ehã amɛ.”

english_verse: And so we celebrated because the Lord had indeed worked miracles for us.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛŋ, Yehowa efee nibii wuji ehã wɔ, ni wɔmii eshɛ wɔhe nɛɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, we ask you to bless our people again, and let us be like streams in the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, kpalemɔ wɔblema nibii ni ŋmɛɛ wɔ lɛ kɛba, tamɔ nunɛmɔ hãa faa ni emli egbi yiɔ ekoŋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: We cried as we went out to plant our seeds. Now let us celebrate as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Hã mɛi ni duɔ nii kɛ amɛhiɛ yaafonu lɛ, akpa kɛ nyamɔ lala.

english_verse: We cried on the way to plant our seeds, but we will celebrate and shout as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni kɛ hiɛ yaafonu hiɛɔ dumɔ wui kɛyaa dumɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ ŋmãa yiteremɔi aaaba shĩa kɛ nyamɔ.

english_verse: Without the help of the Lord it is useless to build a home or to guard a city.
translation_verse: Kɛjeee Yehowa ni mãa tsu lɛ, no lɛ yakatswaa mɛi ni mãa lɛ gboɔ he deŋme lɛ! Kɛjeee Yehowa ni buɔ maŋ lɛ he lɛ, no lɛ yakatswaa bulɔ lɛ shiɔ he kpe lɛ.

english_verse: It is useless to get up early and stay up late in order to earn a living. God takes care of his own, even while they sleep.
translation_verse: Yakatswaa nyɛteɔ shi maŋkɛ mra, ni nyɛgboɔ deŋme aahu dani nyɛyawɔɔ. Nyɛgboɔ deŋme kɛtaoɔ nyɛdaaŋ ŋmaa; shi mɛi ni Yehowa sumɔɔ amɛ lɛ, ehãa amɛ amɛhiamɔ nibii kɛji amɛwɔ po tete.

english_verse: Children are a blessing and a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Naa, Yehowa gboshinii ni ehãa ji bii; nikeenii kpele ji musuŋbii.

english_verse: Having a lot of children to take care of you in your old age is like a warrior with a lot of arrows.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni gãimlibii yɔɔ yɛ tabilɔ dɛŋ lɛ, nakai oblahiiaŋ bihii ji.

english_verse: The more you have, the better off you will be, because they will protect you when your enemies attack you in court.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ nuu ni nɛkɛ gãimlibii eyi ekotoku mli tɔ lɛ. Kɛji ekɛ ehenyɛlɔi kpe yɛ koishi lɛ, ehiɛ eshwieŋ shi.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you if you respect him and obey his laws.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa, ni eyeɔ emlai lɛ anɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Your fields will produce, and you will be happy— all will go well.
translation_verse: Oooye oninenaa nitsumɔ mli nii, omii aaashɛ, ni aaahi ahã bo!

english_verse: Your wife will be as fruitful as a grapevine, and just as an olive tree is rich with olives, your home will be rich with healthy children.
translation_verse: Oŋa aaatamɔ waintso ni woɔ yibii yɛ owe lɛ. Obii aaatamɔ mutsei bibii kɛaabɔle okplɔ̃ lɛ he.

english_verse: This is how the Lord will bless everyone who respects him.
translation_verse: Naa, nuu ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ, bɔ ni abaajɔɔ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion and let Jerusalem prosper as long as you live.
translation_verse: Yehowa aaajɛ Zion ajɔɔ bo! Ooona Yerusalɛm shweremɔ lɛ owala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: May you live long enough to see your grandchildren. Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Ooohi shi, ni ooona obii abii. Toiŋjɔlɛ aba Israel!

english_verse: Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: “Amɛwa mi yi aahu kɛjɛ miblahiaŋ!” Israel akɛɛ akɛ,

english_verse: “Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! But they have not defeated me,
translation_verse: “Amɛwa mi yi aahu kɛjɛ miblahiaŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ mi.

english_verse: though my back is like a field that has just been plowed.”
translation_verse: Amɛkplebii fãmɔ mikotosɛɛ, ni faji lɛ tamɔ ŋmɔ mli akofii kakadaji.”

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and he has set me free from the ropes of those cruel people.
translation_verse: Yehowa lɛ, jalɔ ji lɛ; efolɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji ataŋkpei lɛ amli.

english_verse: I pray that all who hate the city of Zion will be made ashamed and forced to turn and run.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛɔ Zion lɛ ahiɛ aaagboi, ni amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaatee.

english_verse: May they be like grass on the flat roof of a house, grass that dries up as soon as it sprouts.
translation_verse: Hã amɛfee tamɔ tsu yiteŋ jwɛi ni ŋalaa dani edaa lɛ.

english_verse: Don't let them be like wheat gathered in bundles.
translation_verse: Amɛtsɔ̃ jwɛi ni yiii jwɛiflɔlɔ kɔkɔŋ, ni mɔ ni fimɔɔ lɛ hu kɛshakãaa etsitsiŋ.

english_verse: And don't let anyone who passes by say to them, “The Lord bless you! I give you my blessing in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Mɛi ni hoɔ tete ekɛɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa ajɔɔ nyɛ! Wɔmiijɔɔ nyɛ yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli!”

english_verse: From a sea of troubles I cry out to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛŋ mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ bo kɛjɛɔ nɛɛ.

english_verse: Won't you please listen as I beg for mercy?
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ, bo migbee toi; ka otoi ohã migbee ni mikɛkpaa bo fai lɛ.

english_verse: If you kept record of our sins, no one could last long.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, kɛji okɛɛ ooodi wɔnishaianii lɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ, namɔ po aaaŋɔ ehe eye?

english_verse: But you forgive us, and so we will worship you.
translation_verse: Shi bo odɛ̃ŋ eshaifaa yɔɔ, bɔ ni afee ni ashe bo gbeyei.

english_verse: With all my heart, I am waiting, Lord, for you! I trust your promises.
translation_verse: Miikwɛ Yehowa gbɛ! Misusuma miikwɛ Yehowa gbɛ! Ni ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ mihiɛ kã.

english_verse: I wait for you more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn. Yes, I wait more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn.
translation_verse: Misusuma miimɛ Yehowa fe bɔ ni bulɔi mɛɔ jetsɛremɔ. Eemɛ fe bɔ ni bulɔi mɛɔ jetsɛremɔ.

english_verse: Israel, trust the Lord! God is always merciful and has the power to save you.
translation_verse: Oo Israel, ŋɔɔ ohiɛ ofɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ; ejaakɛ Yehowa dɛŋ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee yɔɔ, ni edɛŋ kpɔmɔ ni fa yɔɔ.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord will save you from all your sins.
translation_verse: Lɛ eeekpɔ̃ Israel kɛaajɛ enishaianii lɛ fɛɛ mli.

english_verse: I am not conceited, Lord, and I don't waste my time on impossible schemes.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, mitsui wooo ehe nɔ, ni mitsɛɛɛ mihe hu. Ni misaa minyiɛɛɛ nibii wuji loo nibii ni yɔɔ naakpɛɛ tsɔ̃ hã mi lɛ asɛɛ.

english_verse: But I have learned to feel safe and satisfied, like a young child in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ, migbe mitsui, ni misusuma efee kpoo tamɔ abifao feɔ yɛ enyɛ kpɔkɔiaŋ. Misusuma efee kpoo yɛ mimli tamɔ abifao ni atse lɛ fufɔ.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord now and forever.
translation_verse: Oo Israel, ŋɔɔ ohiɛ ofɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ, kɛjɛ be nɛɛ mli kɛyashi naanɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget David and how he suffered.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, kaimɔ David kɛ amanehului fɛɛ ni ena lɛ:

english_verse: Mighty God of Jacob, remember how he promised:
translation_verse: bɔ ni ekã bo Yehowa kitã, ni ewo bo, Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ Hewalɔ Koome lɛ shi akɛ,

english_verse: “I won't go home or crawl into bed
translation_verse: “Miboteŋ miwe lɛ mli, ni mikwɔŋ misaatso lɛ hu;

english_verse: or close my eyelids,
translation_verse: mibɛŋ mihiŋmɛi, ni mijieŋ mihiŋmɛi sɛɛ

english_verse: until I find a home for you, the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
translation_verse: kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni mana he ko mahã Yehowa. Hɛɛ, kɛyaashi mana shihilɛhe mahã Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ Hewalɔ Koome lɛ.”

english_verse: When we were in Ephrath, we heard that the sacred chest was somewhere near Jaar.
translation_verse: Naa, wɔnu Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ he yɛ Betlehem, ni wɔyana yɛ Yearim ŋa lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Then we said, “Let's go to the throne of the Lord and worship at his feet.”
translation_verse: Wɔkɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔbotea Yehowa we lɛŋ; nyɛhãa wɔjaa yɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ hiɛ!”

english_verse: Come to your new home, Lord, you and the sacred chest with all its power.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, wo ohe nɔ ni oya ohejɔɔmɔhe lɛ, bo kɛ ohewalɛ Adeka lɛ.

english_verse: Let victory be like robes for the priests; let your faithful people celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Hã osɔfoi lɛ awula kɛ jalɛ tamɔ atade, ni omɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ abɔ oshe kɛ nyamɔ.

english_verse: David is your chosen one, so don't reject him.
translation_verse: Otsulɔ David hewɔ lɛ, kaakwa maŋtsɛ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ.

english_verse: You made a solemn promise to David, when you said, “I, the Lord, promise that someone in your family will always be king.
translation_verse: Yehowa kã David kitã yɛ anɔkwale mli, ni ekuŋ mli. Ekɛɛ akɛ, “Maŋɔ omusuŋbii lɛ eko mata omaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: If they keep our agreement and follow my teachings, then someone in your family will rule forever.”
translation_verse: Kɛji obii lɛ ye mikpãŋmɔi lɛ kɛ mimlai ni matsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ amɛ hu amɛbii aaata omaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ daa.”

english_verse: You have gladly chosen Zion as your home, our Lord.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa eŋɔ Zion, ni eesumɔ akɛ ekɛfee eshihilɛhe.

english_verse: You said, “This is my home! I will live here forever.
translation_verse: “Mihejɔɔmɔhe nɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ; biɛ mahi, ejaakɛ biɛ misumɔɔ.

english_verse: I will bless Zion with food, and even the poor will eat until they are full.
translation_verse: Majɔɔ niyenii babaoo nɔ mahã Zion, ni ohiafoi lɛ hu, mahã amɛtɔrɔ kɛ ŋmaa.

english_verse: Victory will be like robes for the priests, and its faithful people will celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Esɔfoi lɛ, mikɛ miyiwalaheremɔ aaawo amɛ tamɔ atade; ni emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ aaabɔ oshe kɛ nyamɔ.

english_verse: I will give mighty power to the kingdom of David. Each of my chosen kings will shine like a lamp
translation_verse: Mahã Maŋtsɛ wulu ko ajɛ David shwiei lɛ amli, ni mahã mɔ ni mifɔ lɛ mu lɛ lumɔyeli lɛ ama shi.

english_verse: and wear a sparkling crown. But I will disgrace their enemies.”
translation_verse: Ehenyɛlɔi lɛ, mawo amɛ hiɛgbele, shi lɛ lɛ, ekekre lɛ aaakpɛlɛ.”

english_verse: It is truly wonderful when the people of God live together in peace.
translation_verse: Kwɛ bɔ ni ehi, bɔ ni eyɔɔ fɛo, kɛji nyɛmimɛi fee ekome kɛhi shi lɛ!

english_verse: It is as beautiful as olive oil poured on Aaron's head and running down his beard and the collar of his robe.
translation_verse: Etamɔ mu kpakpa ni jara wa ni yɔɔ yiteŋ ni tsereɔ eshwieɔ tsɛŋ mli, ni ji Aaron tsɛŋ lɛ. Etsereɔ kɛbashwieɔ etade yuu lɛ naamuu lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: It is like the dew from Mount Hermon, falling on Zion's mountains, where the Lord has promised to bless his people with life forevermore.
translation_verse: Etamɔ Hermon bɔ ni nyɔɔ Zion gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ. Ejaakɛ Yehowa ewo Zion jɔɔmɔ kɛ wala he shi kɛyaashi naanɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who serves the Lord, come and offer praises. Everyone who has gathered in his temple tonight,
translation_verse: Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi, nyɛ Yehowa tsuji fɛɛ ni sɔmɔɔ nyɔɔŋ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ!

english_verse: lift your hands in prayer toward his holy place and praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛholea nyɛniji anɔ yɛ sɔlemɔ mli yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ; ni nyɛjiea Yehowa yi.

english_verse: The Lord is the Creator of heaven and earth, and I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion.
translation_verse: Yehowa ni bɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ajɛ Zion ajɔɔ bo!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! You are his servants, so praise his name.
translation_verse: Nyɛjiea Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi! Nyɛ Yehowa tsuji fɛɛ, nyɛjiea eyi,

english_verse: All who serve in the temple of the Lord our God,
translation_verse: nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛdamɔɔ Yehowa we lɛ yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ kpoi lɛ anɔ lɛ.

english_verse: come and shout praises. Praise the name of the Lord! He is kind and good.
translation_verse: Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi, ejaakɛ Yehowa hi! Nyɛlaa nyɛjiea egbɛi lɛ yi, ejaakɛ emli hi!

english_verse: He chose the family of Jacob and the people of Israel for his very own.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa eŋɔ Yakob ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe, eŋɔ Israel efee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is much greater than any other god.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mile akɛ Yehowa je agbo, ni wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, efe nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ.

english_verse: He does as he chooses in heaven and on earth and deep in the sea.
translation_verse: Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni sa Yehowa hiɛ, yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ ŋshɔ kɛ bui voovoi lɛ amli lɛ, no efeɔ.

english_verse: The Lord makes the clouds rise from far across the earth, and he makes lightning to go with the rain. Then from his secret place he sends out the wind.
translation_verse: Lɛ ji mɔ ni hãa atatui woɔ kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei lɛ. Lɛ ehãa srawa gbalaa kɛfataa nunɛmɔ he ni ehãa kɔɔyɔɔ fãa kɛjɛɔ enitoohe lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord killed the first-born of people and animals in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Etswia Ijipt kromɔbii lɛ nii kɛjɛ gbɔmɔ nɔ kɛyashi kooloo nɔ.

english_verse: God used miracles and wonders to fight the king of Egypt and all of his officials.
translation_verse: Ijipt lɛ efee okadii kɛ naakpɛɛ nii yɛ mli ekɛgbala Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ fɛɛ toi;

english_verse: He destroyed many nations and killed powerful kings,
translation_verse: ni etswia majimaji pii anii; ni egbegbee majiatsɛmɛi hewalɔi.

english_verse: including King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan. He conquered every kingdom in the land of Canaan
translation_verse: Egbe Sihon, Amorbii lɛ amaŋtsɛ, kɛ Og, Bashan maŋtsɛ lɛ hu, kɛ Kanaan maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: and gave their property to his people Israel.
translation_verse: Eŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ ehã akɛ gboshinii, akɛ gboshinii ehã emaŋ Israelbii lɛ.

english_verse: The name of the Lord will be remembered forever, and he will be famous for all time to come.
translation_verse: Oo, Yehowa, ogbɛi lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ! Oo Yehowa, ohiɛ nyam lɛ yɛ kɛmiiya yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will bring justice and show mercy to all who serve him.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa aaabu emaŋbii lɛ bem, ni emusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ etsuji lɛ ahe.

english_verse: Idols of silver and gold are made and worshiped in other nations.
translation_verse: Jeŋmaji lɛ amãgãi lɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni, gbɔmɛi aninenaa nitsumɔi ni.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Amɛyɛ naabui, shi amɛwieee; amɛyɛ hiŋmɛii, shi amɛnaaa nii.

english_verse: They are completely deaf, and they can't breathe.
translation_verse: Amɛyɛ toii, shi amɛnuuu nii, asaŋ wala bɛ amɛmli.

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who trust them will end up as helpless as their idols.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni fee amɛ lɛ tamɔ amɛ nɔŋŋ; nakai nɔŋŋ ji mɛi ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ amɛnɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel, come praise the Lord! All the family of Aaron
translation_verse: Oo Israel we, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi! Oo Aaron we, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

english_verse: and all the tribe of Levi, come praise the Lord! All of his worshipers, come praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Oo Levi we, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi! Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛsheɔ Yehowa gbeyei, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

english_verse: Praise the Lord from Zion! He lives here in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ajɛ Zion ajie Yehowa yi, lɛ mɔ ni eyɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ! Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

english_verse: Praise the Lord! He is good. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Oo, nyɛdaa Yehowa shi, ejaakɛ ehi; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Oo, nyɛdaa nyɔŋmɔi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: Praise the Lord of lords. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Oo, nyɛdaa nuŋtsɔmɛi aNuŋtsɔ lɛ shi; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: Only God works great miracles. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Mɔ koome ni efeɔ naakpɛɛnii wuji lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: With wisdom he made the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ mɔ ni ekɛ nilee bɔ ŋwɛi amli ŋwɛii lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: The Lord stretched the earth over the ocean. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ mɔ ni elɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli eha nui lɛ anɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: He made the bright lights in the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ mɔ ni ebɔ hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: He lets the sun rule each day. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ebɔ hulu koni eye shwane nɔ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ebɔ nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii koni amɛye nyɔɔŋ nɔ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: God struck down the first-born in every Egyptian family. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ mɔ ni etswia Ijipt kromɔbii lɛ nii lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: He rescued Israel from Egypt. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ ejie Israelbii lɛ kɛje Ijipt lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: God used his great strength and his powerful arm. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ekɛ nineshiwalɛ kɛ kpɔiaŋwalɛ tsu enɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: He split the Red Sea apart. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ mɔ ni egba Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ mli lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa;

english_verse: The Lord brought Israel safely through the sea. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ni ekpala Israelbii kɛtsɔ̃ teŋ kɛho lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: He destroyed the Egyptian king and his army there. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Shi eplenee Farao kɛ eta lɛ yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛŋ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: The Lord led his people through the desert. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ mɔ ni ekpala emaŋ lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: Our God defeated mighty kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ mɔ ni etswia maŋtsɛmɛi wuji nii lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: And he killed famous kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ni egbegbee maŋtsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ gbɛi lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: One of them was Sihon, king of the Amorites. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Sihon, Amorbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: Another was King Og of Bashan. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Kɛ Og, Bashan maŋtsɛ lɛ, hu; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: God took away their land. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ni eŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ ehã ewebii akɛ gboshinii lɛ ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eŋɔ ehã etsulɔ Israel akɛ gboshinii; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: God saw the trouble we were in. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ ji mɔ ni ekai wɔ be ni wɔfee butuu lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: He rescued us from our enemies. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ ejie wɔ yɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: He gives food to all who live. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Lɛ elɛɔ heloo fɛɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: Praise God in heaven! God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Oo, nyɛdaa Ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!

english_verse: Beside the rivers of Babylon we thought about Jerusalem, and we sat down and cried.
translation_verse: Babilon fai lɛ anaa wɔ ho wɔtara shi yɛ ni wɔfofoo, be ni wɔkai Zion lɛ.

english_verse: We hung our small harps on the willow trees.
translation_verse: Jɛi faa naa gãlãi lɛ anɔ wɔŋɔ wɔsaŋkui lɛ wɔtsotsoro.

english_verse: Our enemies had brought us here as their prisoners; now they wanted us to sing and entertain them. They insulted us and shouted, “Sing about Zion!”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ jɛi mɛi ni ŋɔ wɔ nom lɛ bi wɔ koni wɔla lalai yɛ. Wɔhaolɔi lɛ tao akɛ wɔjie amɛhiɛtserɛ: Amɛkɛɛ, “Nyɛlaa Zion lalai lɛ eko nyɛtsɔ̃a wɔ!”

english_verse: Here in a foreign land, how can we sing about the Lord?
translation_verse: Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni wɔɔla Yehowa lala yɛ mɛi kpɔji aje hu?

english_verse: Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand go limp.
translation_verse: Oo Yerusalɛm, kɛji mihiɛ kpa onɔ lɛ, no lɛ, hã mininejurɔ agbo yɛ mihe.

english_verse: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I don't think about you above all else.
translation_verse: Yerusalɛm, kɛji mikaiii bo, ni mibuuu bo fe mimiishɛɛ nɔ titri ko lɛ, hã mililɛi akpɛtɛ midaaŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord, punish the Edomites! On the day Jerusalem fell, they shouted, “Completely destroy the city! Tear down every building!”
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, kaimɔ bɔ ni Edombii lɛ fee lɛ, gbi nɔ ni aŋɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ, bɔ ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkumɔa, nyɛkumɔa kɛyamɔa eshishitoo lɛ tɔ̃ɔ” lɛ!

english_verse: Babylon, you are doomed! I pray the Lord's blessings on anyone who punishes you for what you did to us.
translation_verse: Oo, Babilon, abaakpãtã ohiɛ; Aaajɔɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatɔ nɔ ni ofee wɔ lɛ he owele.

english_verse: May the Lord bless everyone who beats your children against the rocks!
translation_verse: Aaajɔɔ mɔ ni aaaŋɔ obii bibii lɛ atswia tɛsaa lɛ!

english_verse: With all my heart I praise you, Lord. In the presence of angels I sing your praises.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, mikɛ mitsui muu lɛ fɛɛ miida bo shi, mala majie oyi yɛ nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ahiɛ!

english_verse: I worship at your holy temple and praise you for your love and your faithfulness. You were true to your word and made yourself more famous than ever before.
translation_verse: Matsɔ̃ mihiɛ mahã oSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni makula shi, ni majie ogbɛi lɛ yi, yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ onɔkwayeli lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ ohã ogbɛi lɛ kɛ owiemɔ lɛ ehehe fe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: When I asked for your help, you answered my prayer and gave me courage.
translation_verse: Gbi nɔ ni mitsɛ bo lɛ, ohere mi nɔ; owo mi ekãa, ni misusuma na hewalɛ.

english_verse: All kings on this earth have heard your promises, Lord, and they will praise you.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ aaajie oyi; ejaakɛ amɛnu onaa wiemɔi lɛ.

english_verse: You are so famous that they will sing about the things you have done.
translation_verse: Amɛaala Yehowa nifeemɔi lɛ ahe lala, ejaakɛ Yehowa anunyam lɛ da!

english_verse: Though you are above us all, you care for humble people, and you keep a close watch on everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Yehowa yɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ ehiɛ kã humi he; shi hewolɔ nyɛɛɛ ehe etee yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: I am surrounded by trouble, but you protect me against my angry enemies. With your own powerful arm you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Kɛji minyiɛ haomɔ mli lɛ, ohãa miyi naa wala. Kɛji mihenyɛlɔi amli fu mi lɛ, owoɔ onine nɔ yɛ amɛnɔ, ni okɛ ohewalɛ lɛ hereɔ miyiwala.

english_verse: You, Lord, will always treat me with kindness. Your love never fails. You have made us what we are. Don't give up on us now!
translation_verse: Yehowa aaahã eyiŋtoo lɛ aba mli ahã mi. Oo Yehowa, naanɔ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa; gbee bo diɛŋtsɛ oninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ anaa.

english_verse: You have looked deep into my heart, Lord, and you know all about me.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, taomɔ mimli koni ole mi.

english_verse: You know when I am resting or when I am working, and from heaven you discover my thoughts.
translation_verse: Ole mishitamɔ kɛ mishitee mli fɛɛ; oyoɔ miyiŋtoo yɛ shɔŋŋ beebe.

english_verse: You notice everything I do and everywhere I go.
translation_verse: Ole minyiɛmɔ kɛ mishikãmɔ fɛɛ mli, ni ole minifeemɔi fɛɛ.

english_verse: Before I even speak a word, you know what I will say,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wiemɔ ko wiemɔ ko bɛ mililɛi nɔ ni bo Yehowa oleee oto.

english_verse: and with your powerful arm you protect me from every side.
translation_verse: Ofo afabaŋ owo mihe kɛkpe, ni okɛ onine eŋmɛ minɔ.

english_verse: I can't understand all of this! Such wonderful knowledge is far above me.
translation_verse: Onilee nɛɛ miifee mi naakpɛɛ tsɔ̃; emli kwɔ, ni mijwɛŋmɔ shɛɛɛ he.

english_verse: Where could I go to escape from your Spirit or from your sight?
translation_verse: Nɛgbɛ maje omumɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛaatee; ni nɛgbɛ majo foi kɛaajɛ ohiɛ kɛaatee?

english_verse: If I were to climb up to the highest heavens, you would be there. If I were to dig down to the world of the dead you would also be there.
translation_verse: Kɛji mikwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi lɛ, oyɛ jɛi; ni kɛji miyaŋmɛ misaa yɛ gbohiiaje tete, oyɛ jɛi.

english_verse: Suppose I had wings like the dawning day and flew across the ocean.
translation_verse: Kɛji miŋɔ leebi fiji ni miyahi ŋshɔ sɛɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ,

english_verse: Even then your powerful arm would guide and protect me.
translation_verse: jɛi tete lɛ, onine aaakpala mi, ni oninejurɔ aaamɔ mimli tswɛ.

english_verse: Or suppose I said, “I'll hide in the dark until night comes to cover me over.”
translation_verse: Kɛji mikɛɛ akɛ, “Duŋ kabitii abaha minɔ, ni la ni bɔle mihe lɛ atsɔ̃ duŋ” lɛ,

english_verse: But you see in the dark because daylight and dark are all the same to you.
translation_verse: no tete po lɛ, duŋ wooo duŋ yɛ ohiɛ, ni nyɔɔŋ tseɔ heŋŋ tamɔ shwane nɔŋŋ yɛ ohiɛ; ejaakɛ duŋ jio, la jio fɛɛ lɛ ekome ni yɛ ohiɛ.

english_verse: You are the one who put me together inside my mother's body,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bo obɔ mimli nibii fɛɛ; bo oshɔ̃ mi yɛ minyɛ musuŋ.

english_verse: and I praise you because of the wonderful way you created me. Everything you do is marvelous! Of this I have no doubt.
translation_verse: Miijie oyi, ejaakɛ bɔ ni obɔ mi lɛ, eyɛ naakpɛɛ kɛ gbeyei fɛɛ. Onitsumɔi lɛ yɛ naakpɛɛ; mile enɛ krɛdɛɛ.

english_verse: Nothing about me is hidden from you! I was secretly woven together out of human sight,
translation_verse: Aŋɔɔɔ mi ateee bo, be ni abɔɔ migbɔmɔtso lɛ yɛ teemɔ mli, ni ashɔ̃ɔ mi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi tɔ̃ɔ lɛ.

english_verse: but with your own eyes you saw my body being formed. Even before I was born, you had written in your book everything about me.
translation_verse: Be ni mi ji lá kukuli tete po lɛ, ohiŋmɛi ena mi momo. Wala gbii ni ato ahã mi lɛ, aŋma fɛɛ yɛ owolo lɛ mli dani mije wala shishi tete.

english_verse: Your thoughts are far beyond my understanding, much more than I could ever imagine.
translation_verse: Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, oyiŋtoi lɛ ajara wa yɛ mihiɛ akɛ nɔ ko; efa babaoo naakpa.

english_verse: I try to count your thoughts, but they outnumber the grains of sand on the beach. And when I awake, I will find you nearby.
translation_verse: Kɛji mika akɛ makane lɛ, amɛyi fa fe ŋshɔnaa shia. Be ni mihiɛ aaatsɛ̃ lɛ omasɛi nɔŋŋ miyɔɔ.

english_verse: How I wish that you would kill all cruel and heartless people and protect me from them!
translation_verse: Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, mina ni ogbe mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ, gbɔmɛi lashishwielɔi akabɛŋkɛ mi fɔ̃ŋfɔ̃.

english_verse: They are always rebelling and speaking evil of you.
translation_verse: Amɛwieɔ ohe kɛ yiŋsha, ni amɛteɔ shi amɛwoɔ bo.

english_verse: You know I hate anyone who hates you, Lord, and refuses to obey.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, aso mɛi ni nyɛɔ bo lɛ mikanyɛ amɛ? Ni mɛi ni teɔ shi woɔ bo lɛ, mikate shi miwo amɛ?

english_verse: They are my enemies too, and I truly hate them.
translation_verse: Minyɛɔ amɛ naakpa, miŋɔɔ amɛ mihenyɛlɔi.

english_verse: Look deep into my heart, God, and find out everything I am thinking.
translation_verse: Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, taomɔ mimli koni ole mitsuiŋ. Kaa mi okwɛ, koni ole mijwɛŋmɔi.

english_verse: Don't let me follow evil ways, but lead me in the way that time has proven true.
translation_verse: Kwɛmɔ akɛ minyiɛ gbɛ fɔŋ ko nɔ lo, koni okpala mi kɛya naanɔ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Rescue me from cruel and violent enemies, Lord!
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, jiemɔ mi yɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji adɛŋ; baamɔ miyi yɛ yiwalɔi lɛ adɛŋ.

english_verse: They think up evil plans and always cause trouble.
translation_verse: Amɛkpãŋɔ nifɔɔjianii yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ, ni amɛhãa ta teɔ shi daa.

english_verse: Their words bite deep like the poisonous fangs of a snake.
translation_verse: Amɛjɔ amɛlilɛii anaa tamɔ onufu, ni shikpãi anaa ebɔɔ yɛ amɛnyanyɔji ashishi.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord, from cruel and brutal enemies, who want to destroy me.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, buu mihe kɛje mɔ fɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ, ni obaa miyi kɛje gbɔmɛi yiwalɔi adɛŋ, mɛi ni ekpãŋ koni amɛtɔ̃tɔ̃ minane lɛ.

english_verse: Those proud people have hidden traps and nets to catch me as I walk.
translation_verse: Hewolɔi etsɔ̃ mi tsɔne; ni amɛŋmɛ mi yaa, ni amɛtsɔ̃tsɔ̃ɔ mi akpa yɛ gbɛ toi.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! Please listen to my prayer.
translation_verse: Mikɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ.” Oo Yehowa, bo mifaikpamɔ gbee lɛ toi!

english_verse: You have the power to save me, and you keep me safe in every battle.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, miyiwalaherelɔ ni he wa, bo obaa miyi yɛ ta gbi nɔ.

english_verse: Don't let the wicked succeed in doing what they want, or else they might never stop planning evil.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, kaahã mɔ fɔŋ nine shɛ nɔ ni eshweɔ lɛ nɔ; ni kaahã eyiŋtoo fɔŋ lɛ miiba mli miihã lɛ.

english_verse: They have me surrounded, but make them the victims of their own vicious lies.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni efo sa ewo mihe lɛ, hã efɔŋ ni jɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnaa lɛ abua amɛyiteŋ.

english_verse: Dump flaming coals on them and throw them into pits where they can't climb out.
translation_verse: Hã ŋãi la atso yɛ amɛyiteŋ, hã ashɛrɛ amɛ ashwie bui kwɔŋkwɔŋi amli, ni amɛkate shi dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Chase those cruel liars away! Let trouble hunt them down.
translation_verse: Kaahã oshekuyelɔ ko he shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; hã efɔŋ akpãtã yiwalɔ lɛ hiɛ mra.

english_verse: Our Lord, I know that you defend the homeless and see that the poor are given justice.
translation_verse: Mile akɛ Yehowa yeɔ nɔnalɔ sane ehãa lɛ; ni eyeɔ jalɛ sane ehãa mɔ ni efi lɛ.

english_verse: Your people will praise you and will live with you because they do right.
