translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛŋ, jalɔi aaajie oyi, ni mɛi ni feɔ jalɛnii aaahi shi yɛ ohiɛ.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen when I pray and hurry to help me.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, bo mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ nɛɛ; ba miŋɔɔ mra! Ba otoi shi ohã mi kɛji mitsɛ bo lɛ.

english_verse: Think of my prayer as sweet-smelling incense, and think of my lifted hands as an evening sacrifice.
translation_verse: Hã mifaikpamɔ afee tamɔ tsofakɛŋma yɛ ohiɛ; ni miniji anɔholemɔ afee tamɔ gbɛkɛ afɔle!

english_verse: Help me to guard my words whenever I say something.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, wo mililɛi manyoflɛ; ni ahã mamɔ minaabu mli.

english_verse: Don't let me want to do evil or waste my time doing wrong with wicked people. Don't let me even taste the good things they offer.
translation_verse: Kaadɔ mitsui kɛmiiya nɔ fɔŋ ko he, ni mikafata mɛi fɔ̃ji ahe kɛtsu yiwalɛnii; ni kaahã miye amɛdɔkɔdɔkɔ nii lɛ eko.

english_verse: Let your faithful people correct and punish me. My prayers condemn the deeds of those who do wrong, so don't let me be friends with any of them.
translation_verse: Hã jalɔ agbala mitoi kɛ mlihilɛ; hã anɔkwafoi akã mi; shi kɛji mɔ fɔŋ miiwo mihiɛ nyam lɛ, hã makwa; ejaakɛ misɔleɔ daa mishiɔ amɛnifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone will admit that I was right when their rulers are thrown down a rocky cliff,
translation_verse: Kɛji aŋɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji ahã kojolɔi, ni amɛbu amɛ fɔ lɛ, no dani amɛaale akɛ miwiemɔi lɛ anɔkwale ni.

english_verse: and their bones lie scattered like crushed rocks on top of a grave.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni kɛ mɔ ko miihu ni egbɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ, nakai agbɛ wɔwui ashwã gbonyobu toi.

english_verse: You are my Lord and God, and I look to you for safety. Don't let me be harmed.
translation_verse: Shi bo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, bo onɔ mikɛ mihiɛ fɔ̃ɔ. Bo nɔŋŋ abo mibaa! Kaashi mi tamɔ mɔ ni bɛ hefãlɔ.

english_verse: and make them fall into their own traps while you help me escape.
translation_verse: Hã mɛi fɔ̃ji adu amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛtsɔne lɛ, ni mi lɛ, hã maje mli sɔkee.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord. I beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Miiwo migbee nɔ miibolɔ miitsɛ Yehowa, mikɛ migbee miikpa Yehowa fai.

english_verse: I tell you all my worries and my troubles,
translation_verse: Miifɔse mikɔmɔi lɛ miishwie ehiɛ, miijaje mihaomɔi lɛ yɛ ehiɛ.

english_verse: and whenever I feel low, you are there to guide me. A trap has been hidden along my pathway.
translation_verse: Be ni mimumɔ tɔ biti yɛ mimli lɛ, bo ole migbɛ lɛ. Mihenyɛlɔi etsɔ̃ tsɔne kɛtee mi yɛ gbɛ ni minyiɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Even if you look, you won't see anyone who cares enough to walk beside me. There is no place to hide, and no one who really cares.
translation_verse: Kwɛ mininejurɔgbɛ, ni ooona akɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni le mi. Abobaahe ebɔ mi; Mɔ ko mɔ ko jwɛŋŋ mihe.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! You are my place of safety, and you are my choice in the land of the living. Please answer my prayer. I am completely helpless.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, miibolɔ miitsɛ bo! Mikɛɛ akɛ bo ji mibobaahe, bo ji migbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Rescue me from this prison, so I can praise your name. And when your people notice your wonderful kindness to me, they will rush to my side.
translation_verse: Jiemɔ mi kɛje gboklɛfoi atsuŋ, koni mada bo shi. Jalɔi aaabɔle mi kɛkpe, ejaakɛ ofee mi ejurɔ.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! You are faithful and honest and will answer my prayer.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, bo misɔlemɔ toi, feemɔ toi ohã mifaikpamɔ lɛ; heremɔ mi nɔ yɛ onɔkwayeli kɛ ojalɛ lɛ naa.

english_verse: I am your servant. Don't try me in your court, because no one is innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Okɛ otsulɔ akakojo, ejaakɛ hiɛkãalɔ ko hiɛkãalɔ ko yeŋ bem yɛ ohiɛ.

english_verse: My enemies are chasing me, crushing me in the ground. I am in total darkness, like someone long dead.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ etiu mi, ekpãtã miwala hiɛ kɛmɔ shi; ehã mita duŋ mli tamɔ mɛi ni egboi jeeŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I have given up hope, and I feel numb all over.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mimumɔ etɔ biti yɛ mimli; mitsui efee shikplikpii yɛ mimli.

english_verse: I remember to think about the many things you did in years gone by.
translation_verse: Mikaiɔ blema gbii lɛ, mijwɛŋɔ nii ni ofee lɛ fiaa he; misusuɔ oninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ ahe.

english_verse: Then I lift my hands in prayer, because my soul is a desert, thirsty for water from you.
translation_verse: Miholeɔ miniji anɔ mihãa bo yɛ sɔlemɔ mli; ohe kumai yeɔ misusuma tamɔ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ.

english_verse: Please hurry, Lord, and answer my prayer. I feel hopeless. Don't turn away and leave me here to die.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, heremɔ mi nɔ oya; mimumɔ miitɔ biti; kaaŋɔ ohiɛ otee mi, kɛjee nakai lɛ, matamɔ mɛi ni kpelekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbohiiaje lɛ.

english_verse: Each morning let me learn more about your love because I trust you. I come to you in prayer, asking for your guidance.
translation_verse: Leebi lɛ hã manu osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ he, ejaakɛ bo onɔ mihiɛ kã. Hã male gbɛ ni sa akɛ manyiɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ bo miŋɔɔ misusuma mihãa.

english_verse: Please rescue me from my enemies, Lord! I come to you for safety.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, jiemɔ mi yɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ! Bo oŋɔɔ mijoɔ foi kɛbaa mibatee yɛ!

english_verse: You are my God. Show me what you want me to do, and let your gentle Spirit lead me in the right path.
translation_verse: Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi koni mafee osuɔmɔnaanii, ejaakɛ bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ. Hã omumɔ kpakpa lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ mi gbɛ kɛnyiɛ gbɛ tɛ̃ɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, and keep my life safe. Use your saving power to protect me from trouble.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, hã miyi ana wala! Ojalɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, jiemɔ mi kɛje haomɔ mli.

english_verse: I am your servant. Show how much you love me by destroying my enemies.
translation_verse: Osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee hã mi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, folɔmɔ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ oshwie; ni okpãtã mɛi ni waa mi yi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ; ejaakɛ otsulɔ ji mi.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! You are my mighty rock, and you teach me how to fight my battles.
translation_verse: Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa, mitɛsaa lɛ, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ miniji tawuu kɛ miwaobii nɔmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You are my friend, my fortress, where I am safe. You are my shield, and you made me the ruler of our people.
translation_verse: Lɛ ji mitɛsaa kɛ mimɔ̃ɔ, mibobaa mɔɔ ni wa, kɛ mijielɔ, mitsɛŋ kɛ mɔ abo ni mibaa lɛ. Lɛ ebaa mimaŋbii shi ewoɔ mishishi.

english_verse: Why do we humans mean anything to you, our Lord? Why do you care about us?
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, mɛɛ ji gbɔmɔ adesa ni obuɔ ehe akɔntaa, loo gbɔmɔ bi ni ojwɛŋɔ ehe?

english_verse: We disappear like a breath; we last no longer than a faint shadow.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ lɛ etamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ, egbii lɛ tamɔ hɔ̃ɔŋ ni hoɔ.

english_verse: Open the heavens like a curtain and come down, Lord. Touch the mountains and make them send up smoke.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, kpoo oŋwɛi lɛ naa shi koni oyi shi! Taramɔ gɔji lɛ ahe koni amɛje lasu!

english_verse: Use your lightning as arrows to scatter my enemies and make them run away.
translation_verse: Hã srawai agbala, koni ogbɛ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ oshwã. Tsɛ̃rɛ̃mɔ ogãimlibii lɛ koni owo amɛ foi.

english_verse: Reach down from heaven and set me free. Save me from the mighty flood
translation_verse: Kpã onine mli kɛjɛ ŋwɛi; shɔ̃ mi koni ojie mi kɛjɛ nu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli, kɛjɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji adɛŋ,

english_verse: of those lying foreigners who never tell the truth.
translation_verse: mɛi ni maleɔ, ni amɛwoɔ amɛninejurɔ nɔ amɛkãa amale kitã lɛ.

english_verse: In praise of you, our God, I will sing a new song, while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Oo, Nyɔŋmɔ, mala lala hee mahã bo! Kpãi nyɔŋma saŋku matswa kɛjie oyi.

english_verse: By your power, kings win wars, and your servant David is saved from deadly swords.
translation_verse: Bo ohãa maŋtsɛmɛi yeɔ kunim, ni ohereɔ otsulɔ David yiwala.

english_verse: Won't you keep me safe from those lying foreigners who never tell the truth?
translation_verse: Shɔ̃ mi kɛje yiwalɔ klante naa; kpɔ̃ mi kɛje mɛi kpɔ̃ji adɛŋ, mɛi ni maleɔ, ni amɛwoɔ amɛninejurɔ nɔ amɛkãa amale kitã lɛ.

english_verse: Let's pray that our young sons will grow like strong plants and that our daughters will be as lovely as columns in the corner of a palace.
translation_verse: Wɔbihii adara yɛ amɛblahiiaŋ, tamɔ tsei ni atɛo ni amɛdara; ni wɔbiyei lɛ hu atãmɔ koŋtɛ ni ako ni akɛmaa maŋtsɛ we.

english_verse: May our barns be filled with all kinds of crops. May our fields be covered with sheep by the thousands,
translation_verse: Wɔboŋoi lɛ ayimɔ obɔbɔ̃, kɛ niyenii srɔtoi fɛɛ; wɔtoi hu afɔfɔɔ akpekpei, kɛ akpei nyɔŋmanyɔŋmai yɛ ŋa nɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you give these blessings to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ maŋ ni naa nɛkɛ jɔɔmɔ nɛɛ! Ajɔɔ maŋ ni Yehowa ji eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I will praise you, my God and King, and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Makafo bo, miNyɔŋmɔ kɛ miMaŋtsɛ, ni majie ogbɛi lɛ yi daa kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ.

english_verse: I will praise you each day and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Daa gbi lɛ majie oyi, ni majie ogbɛi lɛ yi daa kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ.

english_verse: You are wonderful, Lord, and you deserve all praise, because you are much greater than anyone can understand.
translation_verse: Yehowa je agbo; ni esa yijiemɔ babaoo, ni egbojee lɛ anaaa naa.

english_verse: Each generation will announce to the next your wonderful and powerful deeds.
translation_verse: Yinɔ kome aaakafo onitsumɔi lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ yinɔ kroko; ni amɛaajaje ohewalɛ nifeemɔi lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: I will keep thinking about your marvelous glory and your mighty miracles.
translation_verse: Majwɛŋ onunyam falɛ kɛ ogbojee kɛ onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ahe.

english_verse: Everyone will talk about your fearsome deeds, and I will tell all nations how great you are.
translation_verse: Mɛi aaagba ohewalɛ nitsumɔi ni yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ, ni majaje ogbojee lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: They will celebrate and sing about your matchless mercy and your power to save.
translation_verse: Amɛaajaje omlihilɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ; amɛaala ojalɛ lɛ he lala waa.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! You are kind and patient and always loving.
translation_verse: Durolɔ kɛ mɔbɔnalɔ ji Yehowa; emli fuuu mra, ni esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ fa babaoo.

english_verse: You are good to everyone, and you take care of all your creation.
translation_verse: Yehowa hi hã mɛi fɛɛ, ni emusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ ebɔɔnii lɛ fɛɛ he.

english_verse: All creation will thank you, and your loyal people will praise you.
translation_verse: Yehowa, obɔɔnii lɛ fɛɛ aaada bo shi; ni omɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ aaajie oyi.

english_verse: They will tell about your marvelous kingdom and your power.
translation_verse: Amɛaawie omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ anunyam lɛ he, ni amɛaagba ohewalɛ lɛ,

english_verse: Then everyone will know about the mighty things you do and your glorious kingdom.
translation_verse: koni amɛhã gbɔmɛi adesai abii ale ohewalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ, kɛ omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ nyam kɛ egbojee.

english_verse: Your kingdom will never end, and you will rule forever. Our Lord, you keep your word and do everything you say.
translation_verse: Omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ, naanɔ maŋtsɛyeli ni; ni olumɔyeli lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: When someone stumbles or falls, you give a helping hand.
translation_verse: Yehowa sɔoɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni miigbee shi lɛ, ni eholeɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni edɔrɔ kɔmɔɔ lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Everyone depends on you, and when the time is right, you provide them with food.
translation_verse: Bɔɔnii fɛɛ kwɛɔ bo gbɛ, ni bo ohãa amɛ niyenii yɛ be ni sa mli.

english_verse: By your own hand you satisfy the desires of all who live.
translation_verse: Ogbɛɔ odɛ̃ŋ, ni ohãa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã tɔɔ kɛ nii ni etaoɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, everything you do is kind and thoughtful,
translation_verse: Yehowa ja yɛ egbɛi fiaa mli, ni emli hi yɛ enifeemɔi fiaa mli.

english_verse: and you are near to everyone whose prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: Yehowa bɛŋkɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɛɔ lɛ lɛ; ebɛŋkɛɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɛɔ lɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ.

english_verse: You satisfy the desires of all your worshipers, and you come to save them when they ask for help.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ, efeɔ amɛnitaomɔnii ehãa amɛ; eboɔ amɛbolɔmɔ toi ni ehereɔ amɛyiwala.

english_verse: You take care of everyone who loves you, but you destroy the wicked.
translation_verse: Yehowa baa mɛi fɛɛ ni sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ ayi; shi yiwalɔi lɛ, eeekpãtã amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and everyone will respect your holy name forever.
translation_verse: Minaabu aaajie Yehowa yi ni bɔɔnii fɛɛ aaajie egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yi daa kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all that I am, I will shout his praises.
translation_verse: Jiemɔ Yehowa yi! Oo misusuma, jiemɔ Yehowa yi!

english_verse: I will sing and praise the Lord God as long as I live.
translation_verse: Gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ, majie Yehowa yi! Mala majie miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi miwala be fɛɛ.

english_verse: You can't depend on anyone, not even a great leader.
translation_verse: Nyɛkaŋɔa nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔa lumɛi loo gbɔmɔ adesa bi ko ni yelikɛbuamɔ bɛ edɛŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Once they die and are buried, that will be the end of all their plans.
translation_verse: Kɛji emumɔ je emli lɛ, ekuɔ esɛɛ kɛyaa esu lɛ mli ekoŋŋ; nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ eyiŋtoo fɛɛ laajeɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God of Jacob blesses everyone who trusts him and depends on him.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji eyelikɛbualɔ, mɔ ni ehiɛ kãa Yehowa, eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: God made heaven and earth; he created the sea and everything else. God always keeps his word.
translation_verse: Lɛ ebɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ; lɛ lɛ eyeɔ anɔkwa kɛyaa naanɔ.

english_verse: He gives justice to the poor and food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free
translation_verse: Mɛi ni ayeɔ amɛ amim lɛ, eyeɔ amɛsane ehãa amɛ; mɛi ni hɔmɔ yeɔ amɛ lɛ, ehãa amɛ niyenii. Yehowa fɛneɔ gboklɛfoi agboklɛi.

english_verse: and heals blind eyes. He gives a helping hand to everyone who falls. The Lord loves good people
translation_verse: Yehowa gbeleɔ shwilafoi ahiŋmɛii; Yehowa holeɔ mɛi ni edɔrɔ kɔmɔɔ lɛ anɔ; Yehowa sumɔɔ jalɔi.

english_verse: and looks after strangers. He defends the rights of orphans and widows, but destroys the wicked.
translation_verse: Yehowa baa gbɔi ayi; efĩɔ awusa kɛ okulafo sɛɛ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ji agbɛ lɛ, ebutuɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God of Zion will rule forever! Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Yehowa baaye maŋtsɛ kɛaatee naanɔ, Zion, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaaye maŋtsɛ kɛaatee yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ. Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Our God is kind, and it is right and good to sing praises to him.
translation_verse: Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi! Ehi akɛ ala ajie wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi; ejaakɛ durolɔ ji lɛ, ni yijiemɔ lala sa lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem and brings the people of Israel back home again.
translation_verse: Yehowa ji mɔ ni maa Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ; ebuaa Israelbii ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã lɛ anaa.

english_verse: He renews our hopes and heals our bodies.
translation_verse: Lɛ etsaa mɛi ni tsuii ekumɔ lɛ, ni efimɔɔ amɛpilamɔi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: He decided how many stars there would be in the sky and gave each one a name.
translation_verse: Lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ ŋulamii lɛ ayibɔ, ni ewoɔ eko fɛɛ eko gbɛi lɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord is great and powerful! He understands everything.
translation_verse: WɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ je agbo; ni ehewalɛ fa naakpa, ni enilee lɛ anaaa naa.

english_verse: The Lord helps the oppressed, but he smears the wicked in the dirt.
translation_verse: Yehowa woɔ heshibalɔi anɔ, shi yiwalɔi lɛ etsirɛɔ amɛ etswiaa shi.

english_verse: Celebrate and sing! Play your harps for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Nyɛlaa shidaa lala nyɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛkɛ saŋku alaa kɛjiea wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi.

english_verse: He fills the sky with clouds and sends rain to the earth, so that the hills will be green with grass.
translation_verse: Lɛ ekɛ atatui haa ŋwɛi, ni ehãa nu nɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ehãa jwɛi kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi anɔ.

english_verse: He provides food for cattle and for the young ravens, when they cry out.
translation_verse: Lɛ ehãa kooloi niyenii, ni elɛɔ kwãakwãalabitei abii ni bolɔɔ lɛ hu.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't care about the strength of horses or powerful armies.
translation_verse: Emiishɛɛnamɔ bɛ okpɔŋɔ hewalɛ mli, ni ebɛ tabilɔi ahewalɛ he miishɛɛ hu.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased only with those who worship him and trust his love.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ Yehowa naa mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ ahe miishɛɛ, kɛ mɛi hu ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ esuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, come and praise the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Oo Yerusalɛm, kafomɔ Yehowa! Oo Zion, jiemɔ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi!

english_verse: He makes your city gates strong and blesses your people.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ lɛ ewajeɔ ogboi lɛ asɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ kpɛŋŋ; ejɔɔ obii ni yɔɔ omli lɛ.

english_verse: God lets you live in peace, and he gives you the very best wheat.
translation_verse: Ehãa ohusui anɔ jɔɔ; ehãa otɔɔ kɛ ŋmãa kpakpa.

english_verse: As soon as God speaks, the earth obeys.
translation_verse: Efãa shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni nɔ ni ekɛɔ lɛ afeɔ lɛ oya.

english_verse: He covers the ground with snow like a blanket of wool, and he scatters frost like ashes on the ground.
translation_verse: Ehãa snoo nyɔɔ futaa tamɔ too he tsɔi yɛŋ; egbɛɔ bɔ́ ni efĩ eshwãa tamɔ lamlu.

english_verse: God sends down hailstones like chips of rocks. Who can stand the cold?
translation_verse: Eshɛrɛɔ enutɛi lɛ eshwieɔ shi tamɔ fɔbitɛi. Namɔ aaanyɛ efɛ̃i lɛ naa edamɔ?

english_verse: At his command the ice melts, the wind blows, and streams begin to flow.
translation_verse: Efãa, ni ewiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ, nutɛi lɛ sereɔ. Ehãa ekɔɔyɔɔ lɛ tswaa, ni nui lɛ hoɔ.

english_verse: God gave his laws and teachings to the descendants of Jacob, the nation of Israel.
translation_verse: Ejajeɔ ewiemɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Israel, ekɛ ekpɔi kɛ emlai lɛ hãa Israel.

english_verse: But he has not given his laws to any other nation. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Efeko nakai nɔ ko ehãko maŋ ko maŋ ko dã; emlai lɛ hu, amɛleee. Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Shout the Lord's praises in the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Nyɛjiea Nyɔŋmɔ yi! Nyɛjɛa ŋwɛi nyɛjiea Yehowa yi; nyɛjiea eyi yɛ ŋwɛi flooflo!

english_verse: All of you angels, and all who serve him above, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Nyɛ, ebɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ nyɛjiea eyi! Nyɛ, etai lɛ fɛɛ nyɛjiea eyi!

english_verse: Sun and moon, and all of you bright stars, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere, nyɛjiea eyi! Nyɛŋulamii ni kpɛlɛɔ fiaa, nyɛjiea eyi!

english_verse: Highest heavens, and the water above the highest heavens, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi, kɛ nui ni yɔɔ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi lɛ, nyɛjiea eyi!

english_verse: Let all things praise the name of the Lord, because they were created at his command.
translation_verse: Hã amɛ jie Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi, ejaakɛ lɛ efã, ni abɔ amɛ.

english_verse: He made them to last forever, and nothing can change what he has done.
translation_verse: Eŋɔ amɛ emamɔ shi kɛmiiya naanɔ; ewo amɛ akpɔ, ni amɛnyɛŋ nɔ amɛku.

english_verse: All creatures on earth, you obey his commands, so come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Nyɛjɛa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɛjiea Yehowa yi! Nuŋ loi wuji ni he yɔɔ gbeyei, bui ni mli kwɔlɔ fɛɛ,

english_verse: Sea monsters and the deep sea, fire and hail, snow and frost, and every stormy wind, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: la kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛ, snoo kɛ afua, ahum ni yeɔ efãmɔ nɔ.

english_verse: All mountains and hills, fruit trees and cedars,
translation_verse: Nyɛjiea eyi nyɛ gɔji kɛ gɔŋkpɔi fiaa, tsei ni woɔ yibii kɛ tsenedrui fɛɛ!

english_verse: every wild and tame animal, all reptiles and birds, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Ŋaŋ kooloi kɛ shĩa kooloi fɛɛ, waamɔ nibii kɛ loofɔji.

english_verse: Every king and every ruler, all nations on earth,
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ nɔ majiatsɛmɛi kɛ majimaji anɔ bii fɛɛ, lumɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kojolɔi fɛɛ,

english_verse: every man and every woman, young people and old, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: oblahii kɛ oblayei fɛɛ, onukpai kɛ gbekɛbii bluublu,

english_verse: All creation, come praise the name of the Lord. Praise his name alone. The glory of God is greater than heaven and earth.
translation_verse: hã amɛ jie Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi, ejaakɛ ekoome egbɛi lɛ nɔ awo gojoo fe gbɛii fɛɛ. Lɛ enunyam lɛ kwɔ fe shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋwɛi fɛɛ tete.

english_verse: Like a bull with mighty horns, the Lord protects his faithful nation Israel, because they belong to him. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ekɛ ehewalɛ kpele lɛ ewo emaŋbii anɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ajie eyi, Israelbii, ni ji emaŋ ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ lɛ, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Sing him a new song of praise when his loyal people meet.
translation_verse: Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi! Nyɛlaa lala hee nyɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛjiea eyi yɛ anɔkwafoi agwabɔɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: People of Israel, rejoice because of your Creator. People of Zion, celebrate because of your King.
translation_verse: Hã Israel anya ebɔlɔ lɛ he, ni Zion bihii lɛ amli afili amɛ yɛ emaŋtsɛ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Praise his name by dancing and playing music on harps and tambourines.
translation_verse: Hã amɛkɛ joo ajie egbɛi lɛ yi, ni amɛkɛ miji kɛ saŋku ala amɛkɛjie eyi.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with his people, and he gives victory to those who are humble.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa naa emaŋbii lɛ ahe tsuijurɔ; ehãa humii yeɔ ta mli kunim.

english_verse: All of you faithful people, praise our glorious Lord! Celebrate and worship.
translation_verse: Hã anɔkwafoi lɛ anya yɛ anunyam mli; hã amɛla nyamɔ lala yɛ amɛsai anɔ.

english_verse: Praise God with songs on your lips and a sword in your hand.
translation_verse: Hã Nyɔŋmɔ kafomɔ akã amɛlilɛi nɔ, ni amɛhiɛ klante kɛ enaa nta yɛ amɛdɛ̃,

english_verse: Take revenge and punish the nations.
translation_verse: koni amɛkɛtɔ owele yɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ, koni amɛkɛgbala maŋbii lɛ atoi,

english_verse: Put chains of iron on their kings and rulers.
translation_verse: koni amɛkɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi afimɔ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, ni amɛwo amɛbladei lɛ dade gboklɛi,

english_verse: Punish them as they deserve; this is the privilege of God's faithful people. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: koni amɛkɛ toigbalamɔ ni aŋma ato agbala amɛtoi. Enɛ ji anunyam hã emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ. Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Praise God in his temple. Praise him in heaven, his mighty fortress.
translation_verse: Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi! Nyɛjiea Nyɔŋmɔ yi yɛ ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ; nyɛjiea eyi yɛ ehewalɛ atatu lɛŋ!

english_verse: Praise our God! His deeds are wonderful, too marvelous to describe.
translation_verse: Nyɛjiea eyi yɛ ehewalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ahewɔ; nyɛjiea eyi yɛ egbojee kpeteŋkple lɛ hewɔ!

english_verse: Praise God with trumpets and all kinds of harps.
translation_verse: Nyɛjiea eyi kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ kpãmɔ; nyɛjiea eyi kɛ obenta kɛ saŋku!

english_verse: Praise him with tambourines and dancing, with stringed instruments and woodwinds.
translation_verse: Nyɛjiea eyi kɛ miji kɛ joo, nyɛjiea eyi kɛ kpãa saŋku kɛ bɛji!

english_verse: Praise God with cymbals, with clashing cymbals.
translation_verse: Nyɛjiea eyi kɛ ŋoŋo ni naa wa; nyɛjiea eyi kɛ ŋoŋoi ni jijeɔ!

english_verse: Let every living creature praise the Lord. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Nyɛhãa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni muɔ ajiea Yehowa yi! Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

english_verse: These are the proverbs of King Solomon of Israel, the son of David.
translation_verse: Israel Maŋtsɛ Solomon, David bi lɛ, abɛi nɛ.

english_verse: Proverbs will teach you wisdom and self-control and how to understand sayings with deep meanings.
translation_verse: Abɛi nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ mɔ nilee, ni amɛhãa mɔ naa tsɔsemɔ. Amɛhãa mɔ nuɔ wiemɔi ni jwɛŋmɔ yɔɔ mli ashishi faŋŋ hu.

english_verse: You will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: Amɛhãa mɔ leɔ nii, eleɔ nɔ ni ja, ni eleɔ anɔkwayeli.

english_verse: From these, an ordinary person can learn to be smart, and young people can gain knowledge and good sense.
translation_verse: Abɛi nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni nako jwɛŋmɔ lɛ hiɛtɛ̃ɛ; ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ oblanyo hu nilee kɛ jwɛŋmɔ.

english_verse: If you are already wise, you will become even wiser. And if you are smart, you will learn to understand
translation_verse: Nilelɔ hu nuɔ, ni ekaseɔ nii efataa enilee he. Amɛhãa mɔ ni nuɔ niiashishi hu leɔ ŋaa.

english_verse: proverbs and sayings, as well as words of wisdom, and all kinds of riddles.
translation_verse: Ebaanu abɛi kɛ wiemɔi ni amɛshishinumɔ wa kɛ nilelɔi awiemɔi kɛ amɛjenui ashishi. Ŋaawoo kɛhã oblahii

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of knowledge. Only a fool rejects wisdom and good advice. Warnings against Bad Friends
translation_verse: Nilee fɛɛ shishijee ji Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ; shi kwashiai gbeɔ nilee kɛ tsɔsemɔ he guɔ.

english_verse: My child, obey the teachings of your parents,
translation_verse: Mibi, bo otsɛ tsɔsemɔ toi, ni kaashɛ mla ni onyɛ woɔ bo lɛ ofɔ̃.

english_verse: and wear their teachings as you would a pretty hat or a lovely necklace.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nomɛi ji anunyam akekre ni fi oyitso kɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ ni kã okuɛ.

english_verse: Don't be tempted by sinners or listen
translation_verse: Mibi, kɛji eshafeelɔi miilaka bo lɛ, kaakpɛlɛ̃.

english_verse: when they say, “Come on! Let's gang up and kill somebody, just for the fun of it!
translation_verse: Kɛji amɛkɛɛ bo akɛ, “Ba wɔtee ni wɔyawo mɔ ko antɛo, ni wɔyawo mɔ ko lá ni efeko nɔ ko fɔŋ ko ka yakatswaa lɛ kaakpɛlɛ̃.

english_verse: They're well and healthy now, but we'll finish them off once and for all.
translation_verse: Kɛji amɛaakɛɛ bo akɛ hã wɔmĩĩ amɛ hiɛkãalɔi tamɔ bɔ ni gbohiiaje mĩiɔ mɛi emuu, aloo tamɔ akpelekeɔ shi aboteɔ gbonyobu mli, ni akuuu sɛɛ abaaa dɔŋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: We'll take their valuables and fill our homes with stolen goods.
translation_verse: Kɛji amɛaakɛɛ akɛ no wɔbaana nibii srɔtoi wɔwo wɔshĩai amli obɔ̃bɔ̃ lɛ kaakpɛlɛ̃.

english_verse: Don't follow anyone like that or do what they do.
translation_verse: Mibi, okɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi akabɔ. Tsi ohe kɛje amɛhe kwraa.

english_verse: They are in a big hurry to commit some crime, perhaps even murder.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɛi ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, amɛhe yɛ oya kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ; amɛhe feɔ oya kɛ láshishwiemɔ.

english_verse: They are like a bird that sees the bait, but ignores the trap.
translation_verse: Eji yaka nɔ ko feemɔ akɛ aaatsɔ̃ loofɔlɔ tsɔne be mli ni eekwɛ.

english_verse: They gang up to murder someone, but they are the victims.
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi lɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe tsɔne amɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, amɛwoɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwala antɛo.

english_verse: Wisdom shouts in the streets wherever crowds gather.
translation_verse: Bo toi! Nilee miibolɔ waa yɛ blohuiaŋ, ni eewo egbee yɛ jaji anɔ.

english_verse: She shouts in the marketplaces and near the city gates as she says to the people,
translation_verse: Ebolɔɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ anaa kɛ he fɛɛ he ni mɛi ebua amɛhe naa kutuu yɛ.

english_verse: “How much longer will you enjoy being stupid fools? Won't you ever stop sneering and laughing at knowledge?
translation_verse: Oo, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛjwɛŋmɔ naa waaa, mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ nyɛaahiɛ nyɛkwashiafeemɔ nɛɛ mli kɛyashi? Ni mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ kwashiai hu aaanyɛ nilee kɛyashi?

english_verse: Listen as I correct you and tell you what I think.
translation_verse: Kɛji mikã nyɛ lɛ, nyɛboa toi. Naa, mafɔse mimumɔ mawo nyɛmli, ni mahã nyɛyoo minilee wiemɔi lɛ hu.

english_verse: You completely ignored me and refused to listen;
translation_verse: Mitsɛ nyɛ, ni nyɛbooo mi toi; mikpã miniji amli ni mɔ ko mɔ ko mɔɔɔ mli.

english_verse: you rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: Miŋaawoo lɛ hu nyɛkwa fɛɛ, ni nyɛbuuu mikãmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: or when trouble and distress surround you like a whirlwind, I will laugh and make fun.
translation_verse: Kɛji tsuifãa nɔ ko batua nyɛ tamɔ ahum, ni nyɛmanehulu te shi tamɔ lasuogbele; ni kɛji hejaramɔ kɛ tsuiyeli ba nyɛnɔ lɛ,

english_verse: You will ask for my help, but I won't listen; you will search, but you won't find me.
translation_verse: no mli lɛ nyɛaatsɛ mi, shi mihereŋ nɔ; nyɛaatao misɛɛgbɛ kpɛ̃kpɛ̃ɛkpɛ̃, shi nyɛnaŋ mi.

english_verse: No, you would not learn, and you refused to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Akɛni amɛsumɔɔ nilee, ni amɛsheee Yehowa gbeyei;

english_verse: You rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: asaŋ akɛni amɛsumɔ̃ɔɔ ŋaa ni miwoɔ amɛ lɛ ekoeko, ni amɛgbe mikãmɔ lɛ fɛɛ he guɔ

english_verse: “Now you will eat the fruit of what you have done, until you are stuffed full with your own schemes.
translation_verse: hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni amɛdu lɛ, no yibii amɛaakpa, ni ŋaa ni amɛtotoo lɛ he sɛɛ amɛaana.

english_verse: But if you listen to me, you will be safe and secure without fear of disaster.”
translation_verse: Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni boɔ mi toi lɛ eeehi shi shweshweeshwe, ehe aaajɔ lɛ, ni esheŋ efɔŋ ko gbeyei.

english_verse: My child, you must follow and treasure my teachings and my instructions.
translation_verse: Mibi, mɔ miwiemɔi lɛ amli, ni okɛ mikitãi lɛ ato.

english_verse: Keep in tune with wisdom and think what it means to have common sense.
translation_verse: Ba otoi shi ohã nilee, ni oto otsui shi ohã sanesɛɛkɔmɔ.

english_verse: Beg as loud as you can for good common sense.
translation_verse: Mibi, fo otsɛ́ niiasɛɛyoomɔ, ni odi niiashishinumɔ sɛɛ.

english_verse: Search for wisdom as you would search for silver or hidden treasure.
translation_verse: Taomɔ nilee sɛɛgbɛ tamɔ ataoɔ jwiɛtɛi aloo jwetri ko ni akɛtee.

english_verse: Then you will understand what it means to respect and to know the Lord God.
translation_verse: No dani ooonu Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ shishi, ni ooona Nyɔŋmɔ he nilee;

english_verse: All wisdom comes from the Lord, and so do common sense and understanding.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Yehowa hãa aleɔ nii; edaaŋ nilee kɛ niiashishinumɔ jɛɔ.

english_verse: God gives helpful advice to everyone who obeys him and protects those who live as they should.
translation_verse: Ehãa jalɔi leɔ nii jogbaŋŋ ni eji tsɛŋ hã mɛi ni yɔɔ jeŋba kpakpa lɛ.

english_verse: God sees that justice is done, and he watches over everyone who is faithful to him.
translation_verse: Ebuɔ jalɔi ajalɛ saneyeli he, ni ebaa emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ agbɛi ayi.

english_verse: With wisdom you will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: No dani obaanu jalɛ kɛ jalɛ saneyeli kɛ anɔkwayeli kɛ nɔ ni ji jeŋba kpakpa shishi.

english_verse: Wisdom will control your mind, and you will be pleased with knowledge.
translation_verse: Ni obaana jwɛŋmɔ, ni nilee baahã osusuma mii ashɛ ehe.

english_verse: Sound judgment and good sense will watch over you.
translation_verse: Jwɛŋmɔ aaabaa oyi, ni niiashishinumɔ aaabu ohe.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from evil schemes and from those liars
translation_verse: Eeejie bo kɛjɛ jeŋba fɔŋ gbɛ nɔ, kɛaajɛ mɛi ni wieɔ yaka wiemɔ adɛŋ,

english_verse: who turned from doing good to live in the darkness.
translation_verse: kɛ mɛi ni ekwa jalɛ gbɛi ni amɛyanyiɛɔ dujiaŋ gbɛi anɔ lɛ.

english_verse: They are dishonest themselves, and so are all their deeds. Wisdom and Sexual Purity
translation_verse: Eeejie bo kɛjɛ mɛi ni amɛgbɛi ekɔ̃dɔ̃ ni amɛbaaa amɛjeŋ jogbaŋŋ lɛ adɛŋ.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from the smooth talk of a sinful woman,
translation_verse: Nilee baajie bo kɛjɛ yoo ni bɛ jeŋba dɛŋ; nilee baajie bo kɛjɛ maŋsɛɛ yoo kɛ enaa dɔkɔbii lɛ dɛŋ.

english_verse: who breaks her wedding vows and leaves the man she married when she was young.
translation_verse: Eeejie bo kɛjɛ yoo ni ekwa eblayeiaŋ wu, ni ehiɛ ekpa kpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ lɛ kpãŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ dɛŋ.

english_verse: The road to her house leads down to the dark world of the dead.
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ yoo lɛ, ewe lɛ gbele gbɛ ni; egbɛi fɛɛ anaa kã kɛmiiya gbohiiaje.

english_verse: Visit her, and you will never find the road to life again.
translation_verse: Mɔ ko mɔ ko eyaaa eŋɔɔ, ni eku esɛɛ eba pɛŋ, walagbɛ bɔɔ mɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Follow the example of good people and live an honest life.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, kasemɔ mɛi kpakpai ajeŋba koni ojeŋba atamɔ jalɔi anɔ.

english_verse: if you do wrong and can never be trusted, you will be rooted out.
translation_verse: Shi yiwalɔi lɛ aaafolɔ amɛ kɛaajɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ashwie, ni kutumpɔfoi lɛ aaafamɔ amɛ kɛ amɛshishifãi kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: My child, remember my teachings and instructions and obey them completely.
translation_verse: Mibi, ohiɛ akakpa mimlai lɛ anɔ, shi moŋ okɛ mikitãi lɛ ato otsui mli,

english_verse: They will help you live a long and prosperous life.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ mitsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ baahã owala sɛɛ atsɛ afii babaoo, ni obaashwere yɛ wala mli.

english_verse: Let love and loyalty always show like a necklace, and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Kaahã mlihilɛ kɛ anɔkwayeli miishi bo; ŋɔɔ ofi okuɛ, ŋmãa yɛ otsuiŋ tao lɛ nɔ;

english_verse: God and people will like you and hold you in high esteem.
translation_verse: no dani ooona nyam kɛ bulɛ kpakpa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ.

english_verse: With all your heart you must trust the Lord and not your own judgment.
translation_verse: Okɛ ohiɛ afɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ kɛ otsui fɛɛ, ni okɛ ohe akakpasa bo diɛŋtsɛ ojwɛŋmɔ;

english_verse: Always let him lead you, and he will clear the road for you to follow.
translation_verse: kaimɔ lɛ yɛ ogbɛi fɛɛ amli, ni lɛ eeetsɔ̃ɔ bo gbɛ ni ja ni onyiɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Don't ever think that you are wise enough, but respect the Lord and stay away from evil.
translation_verse: Kaabu ohe nilelɔ; she Yehowa gbeyei, ni owi ohe kɛje efɔŋ he.

english_verse: This will make you healthy, and you will feel strong.
translation_verse: Enɛ aaafee tsamɔ ahã bo, ni eeewo owui amli hewalɛ.

english_verse: Honor the Lord by giving him your money and the first part of all your crops.
translation_verse: Okɛ onii ni oyɔɔ kɛ onibaanii fɛɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ awo Yehowa hiɛ nyam;

english_verse: Then you will have more grain and grapes than you will ever need.
translation_verse: no dani aaahã oboŋoi lɛ ayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmãa, ni owain gbɛi lɛ hu aaayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ wain.

english_verse: My child, don't turn away or become bitter when the Lord corrects you.
translation_verse: Mibi, kaagbe Yehowa tsɔsemɔ lɛ he guɔ, ni kaahã ekãmɔ hu miije otsine.

english_verse: The Lord corrects everyone he loves, just as parents correct a child they dearly love. The Value of Wisdom
translation_verse: Bɔ ni tsɛ kãa ebi ni eyɔɔ ehe tsuijurɔ lɛ, nakai pɛ Yehowa kãa ebi ni esumɔɔ lɛ hu.

english_verse: God blesses everyone who has wisdom and common sense.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni leɔ nii, ni enaa niiashishinumɔ hu lɛ,

english_verse: Wisdom is worth more than silver; it makes you much richer than gold.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ sɛɛnamɔ ni yɔɔ no mli lɛ, ehi fe sɛɛnamɔ ni yɔɔ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika mli.

english_verse: Wisdom is more valuable than precious jewels; nothing you want compares with her.
translation_verse: Nilee kɛ niiashishinumɔ jara wa aahu fe tɛ̃ŋlɛ̃o; ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ akɛto nilee he.

english_verse: In her right hand Wisdom holds a long life, and in her left hand are wealth and honor.
translation_verse: Wala sɛɛtsɛlɛ yɛ eninejurɔ kɔkɔŋ, ni ninamɔ kɛ anunyam yɛ ebɛku kɔkɔŋ.

english_verse: Wisdom makes life pleasant and leads us safely along.
translation_verse: Miishɛɛ yɛ etɛmpɔŋi anɔ, ni toiŋjɔlɛ yɛ egbɛi anɔ.

english_verse: Wisdom is a life-giving tree, the source of happiness for all who hold on to her.
translation_verse: Nilee lɛ wala tso ni hã mɛi ni kɛ amɛhe kpɛtɛɔ lɛ, ni mɛi ni hiɛ emli kpɛŋŋ lɛ, ajɔɔ amɛ.

english_verse: By his wisdom and knowledge the Lord created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ nilee to shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi, ni jwɛŋmɔ ni mli kwɔ ekɛhã ŋwɛi ma shi shiŋŋ.

english_verse: By his understanding he let the ocean break loose and clouds release the rain.
translation_verse: Enilee naa hãa fai tueɔ, ni ehãa atatui lɛ nyɔɔ bɔ shwieɔ shi.

english_verse: My child, use common sense and sound judgment! Always keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Mibi, kɛ nilee kɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ ato; kaahã ohiɛ miije nɔ kwraa,

english_verse: They will help you to live a long and beautiful life.
translation_verse: ni eeehã ona wala kɛ hewulamɔnii.

english_verse: You will walk safely and never stumble;
translation_verse: No dani ooonyiɛ ogbɛ lɛ nɔ shweshweeshwe, ni otɛŋ onane.

english_verse: you will rest without a worry and sleep soundly.
translation_verse: Kɛ oho okã shi lɛ, osheŋ gbeyei; shi moŋ oookã shi, ni owɔ lɛ aaaŋɔɔ.

english_verse: So don't be afraid of sudden disasters or storms that strike those who are evil.
translation_verse: Kaashe kpatu nɔ ko ni baahã otsui afã, aloo bɔ ni ahum fɔŋ tswaa mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ gbeyei,

english_verse: You can be sure that the Lord will protect you from harm.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Yehowa ji ohiɛnɔkãmɔ, ni lɛ eeebu ohe, ni ooofee shweshweeshwe.

english_verse: Do all you can for everyone who deserves your help.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni esa amɛ ejurɔfeemɔ lɛ, kaakãmã amɛ, kɛji eyɛ ohewalɛ mli akɛ ooonyɛ ofee lɛ.

english_verse: Don't tell your neighbor to come back tomorrow, if you can help today.
translation_verse: Kɛji nɔ ko yɛ odɛ̃ŋ ni ooonyɛ okɛfee onaanyo lɛ ejurɔ lɛ, kaafee lɛ “Yaa ni oba, yaa ni oba”.

english_verse: Don't try to be mean to neighbors who trust you.
translation_verse: Kaato onaanyo ko he ŋaa fɔŋ, be mli ni lɛ lɛ ehiɛ kã onɔ akɛ eyɛ shweshweeshwe yɛ omasɛi.

english_verse: Don't argue just to be arguing, when you haven't been hurt.
translation_verse: Okɛ mɔ ko akabe yakatswaa, kɛji efeko bo efɔŋ ko.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of cruel people or follow their example.
translation_verse: Ohiɛ akakɔ̃ yiwalɔ ko nɔ, ni egbɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ hu kaakɔ amɛmli ekoeko;

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is dishonest, but he lets good people be his friends.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Yehowa miihi nɔfɔŋfeelɔ, shi jalɔi lɛ eheɔ amɛ eyeɔ.

english_verse: He places a curse on the home of everyone who is evil, but he blesses the home of every good person.
translation_verse: Yehowa loomɔ kã mɛi fɔ̃ji awe nɔ; shi jalɔi awe lɛ, ejɔɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord sneers at those who sneer at him, but he is kind to everyone who is humble.
translation_verse: Yehowa yeɔ hefɛoyelɔi ahe fɛo, shi mɛi ni baa amɛhe shi lɛ enaa amɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: My child, listen closely to my teachings and learn common sense.
translation_verse: Bii, nyɛboa nyɛtsɛ tsɔsemɔ lɛ toi, ni nyɛfea toi ni nyɛlea sanesɛɛkɔmɔ.

english_verse: My advice is useful, so don't turn away.
translation_verse: Jeŋba kpakpa he ŋaa miwoɔ nyɛ nɛɛ; nyɛkakwaa mitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: When I was still very young and my mother's favorite child, my father
translation_verse: Be ni mi ji gbekɛnuu yɛ mitsɛ masɛi, ni minyɛ bi koome ni eshwɛɛɛ ehe ji mi lɛ, mitsɛ tsɔ̃ɔ mi nii, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ,

english_verse: said to me: “If you follow my teachings and keep them in mind, you will live.
translation_verse: “Hã otsui amɔ miwiemɔi amli, ye mikitãi ni miwoɔ bo lɛ anɔ, ni oyi aaana wala.

english_verse: Be wise and learn good sense; remember my teachings and do what I say.
translation_verse: Na nilee kɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ. Ohiɛ akakpa midaaŋ wiemɔi lɛ anɔ, ni kaaŋmɛɛ he hu.

english_verse: “If you love Wisdom and don't reject her, she will watch over you.
translation_verse: Kaakwa nilee, ni eeebaa oyi; suɔmɔ lɛ, ni eeebu ohe.

english_verse: The best thing about Wisdom is Wisdom herself; good sense is more important than anything else.
translation_verse: Nilee shishijee ji ona nilee, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ona lɛ okɛtao sanesɛɛkɔmɔ sɛɛgbɛ.

english_verse: If you value Wisdom and hold tightly to her, great honors will be yours.
translation_verse: Buu nilee akɛ nɔ ko ni jara wa, ni eeewo onɔ; kɛji oloo lɛ atuu lɛ, eeewo ohiɛ nyam.

english_verse: It will be like wearing a glorious crown of beautiful flowers.” The Right Way and the Wrong Way
translation_verse: Nilee aaafi bo anunyam akekre, ni eeebu bo maŋtsɛ fai ni yɔɔ fɛo.”

english_verse: My child, if you listen and obey my teachings, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Mibi, bo toi, ni omɔ miwiemɔi lɛ amli koni owala sɛɛ atsɛ.

english_verse: I have shown you the way that makes sense; I have guided you along the right path.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ̃ɔ bo nilee gbɛ lɛ; mikɛ bo etsɔ̃ jalɛ tɛmpɔŋi anɔ.

english_verse: Your road won't be blocked, and you won't stumble when you run.
translation_verse: Kɛji onyiɛ gbɛi nɛɛ anɔ lɛ onane etɔ̃tɔ̃ŋ, ni kɛji ojo foi yɛ nɔ po, otɛŋ.

english_verse: Hold firmly to my teaching and never let go. It will mean life for you.
translation_verse: Mɔ tsɔsemɔ mli waa, kaaŋmɛɛ he. Okɛto jogbaŋŋ, shi no ji owala.

english_verse: Don't follow the bad example of cruel and evil people.
translation_verse: Kaayi yiwalɔi agbɛ nɔ, ni mɛi fɔ̃ji agbɛ hu okanyiɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Turn aside and keep going. Stay away from them.
translation_verse: Wii ohe kɛje gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ, kaayi nɔ; tsi ohe kɛje nɔ kwraa, ni ofo mli kɛya.

english_verse: They can't sleep or rest until they do wrong or harm some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji wɔɔɔ akɛ ja amɛfee efɔŋ dã. Wɔ po tseɔ yɛ amɛhiɛ ja amɛna mɔ ko awui amɛye dã.

english_verse: Their food and drink are cruelty and wickedness.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ efɔŋfeelɔi aŋmãa ji yiwalɛ, ni amɛwain ji basabasafeemɔ.

english_verse: The lifestyle of good people is like sunlight at dawn that keeps getting brighter until broad daylight.
translation_verse: Shi jalɔi agbɛ lɛ etamɔ leebi la ni kpɛɔ, ni eyaa nɔ ekpɛɔ aahu kɛyashiɔ shwane.

english_verse: The lifestyle of the wicked is like total darkness, and they will never know what makes them stumble.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɔ̃ji agbɛ lɛ etamɔ duŋ kabitii; amɛtɛrɛɔ, ni amɛnaaa nibii ni amɛtɛrɛɔ lɛ.

english_verse: My child, listen carefully to everything I say.
translation_verse: Mibi, ka otoi ohã miwiemɔi lɛ; ba otoi shi ohã nɔ ni mikɛɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't forget a single word, but think about it all.
translation_verse: Ohiɛ akaje nɔ. Kɛto otsui mli tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: Knowing these teachings will mean true life and good health for you.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wala eji hã mɔ ni nine shɛɔ nɔ, ni eji tsabaa hã ehewojiaŋ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Carefully guard your thoughts because they are the source of true life.
translation_verse: Ohiɛ akã otsui he fe nii fɛɛ; ejaakɛ no mli wala jɛɔ.

english_verse: Never tell lies or be deceitful in what you say.
translation_verse: Wiemɔ gbonyo akaje onaa; ni kaaye kutumpɔo.

english_verse: Keep looking straight ahead, without turning aside.
translation_verse: Too ohiɛ tɛ̃ɛ, ohiɛ ama he ni oyaa lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Know where you are headed, and you will stay on solid ground.
translation_verse: Le onanefãamɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ ogbɛi fɛɛ aaaja ahã bo.

english_verse: Don't make a mistake by turning to the right or the left.
translation_verse: Kaagba ejurɔ loo abɛku. Tsi ohe kɛje efɔŋ he.

english_verse: My son, if you listen closely to my wisdom and good sense,
translation_verse: Mibi, bo minilee lɛ toi, ni oka otoi ohã miniiashishinumɔ;

english_verse: you will have sound judgment, and you will always know the right thing to say.
translation_verse: koni ole sanesɛɛkɔmɔ, ni odaaŋ wiemɔi aaajie onilee kpo.

english_verse: The words of an immoral woman may be as sweet as honey and as smooth as olive oil.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ yoo ni bɛ jeŋba lɛ, enaa ŋɔɔ tamɔ wo, ni edaaŋ shamɔɔ fe eŋmɔmi.

english_verse: But all that you really get from being with her is bitter poison and pain.
translation_verse: Ni naagbee mli lɛ ejoɔ tamɔ taatso; enaaba tamɔ klante kɛ enaa nta.

english_verse: If you follow her, she will lead you down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Enyiɛ gbele gbɛ, ni ebaakpala bo kɛya gbohiiaje.

english_verse: She has missed the path that leads to life and doesn't even know it.
translation_verse: Enyiɛɛɛ wala gbɛ, hewɔ lɛ eduɔ gbɛ ni eleee.

english_verse: My son, listen to me and do everything I say.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, mibi, bo mi toi, ni kaashi miwiemɔi lɛ asɛɛ.

english_verse: Stay away from a bad woman! Don't even go near the door of her house.
translation_verse: Tsi ohe kɛje nɛkɛ yoo he kwraa. Kaabɛŋkɛ ewe lɛ shinaa lɛ naa tete.

english_verse: You will lose your self-respect and end up in debt to some cruel person for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Kɛjeee nakai lɛ obulɛ baalaaje, ni yiwalɔi aaafo owala sɛɛ;

english_verse: Strangers will get your money and everything else you have worked for.
translation_verse: asaŋ nii ni okɛ ohewalɛ tsu lɛ gbɔi baaye amɛtɔrɔ; ni nibii ni ogbo deŋme yɛ amɛhe lɛ aaaya mɔkpɔŋ ko we.

english_verse: When it's all over, your body will waste away, as you groan
translation_verse: Ni onaagbee mli lɛ, be ni ohewolo kɛ ogbɔmɔtso hiɛ ekpãtã lɛ obaakɛ̃mɔ.

english_verse: I paid no attention to my teachers,
translation_verse: Mibooo mitsɔ̃ɔlɔi atoi, ni mikaaa mitoi mihãaa mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ mi nii lɛ.

english_verse: and now I am disgraced in front of everyone.”
translation_verse: Shwɛ shrao ni mihiɛ akpãtã kwraa yɛ asafo lɛ mli.”

english_verse: You should be faithful to your wife, just as you take water from your own well.
translation_verse: Ye oŋa anɔkwa, ni oŋɔ suɔmɔ ohã lɛ ekoome pɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mɔ nuɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛ mli nu lɛ.

english_verse: And don't be like a stream from which just any woman may take a drink.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bii ni okɛ yei krokomɛi aaafɔ lɛ, onaŋ amɛhe sɛɛ.

english_verse: Save yourself for your wife and don't have sex with other women.
translation_verse: Obii lɛ adara yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ owe, koni amɛye amɛbua bo diɛŋtsɛ, shi jeee mɛi kpɔ̃ji.

english_verse: Be happy with the wife you married when you were young.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, na oŋa he miishɛɛ koni omii ashɛ oblahiiaŋ yoo ni oyakpee lɛ he.

english_verse: She is beautiful and graceful, just like a deer; you should be attracted to her and stay deeply in love.
translation_verse: Ehe fɛo tamɔ ofrote, ni ehe yɛ akɔnɔ tamɔ yɔɔ; ehe akɔnɔ lɛ ashɛje omii be fɛɛ be; hã ni esuɔmɔ aŋɔ bo nom.

english_verse: Don't go crazy over a woman who is unfaithful to her own husband!
translation_verse: Shi mibi, mɛɛba yoo ni bɛ jeŋba he feɔ bo akɔnɔ, ni oloɔ yoo mɔkpɔŋ atuu?

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, and he watches us closely.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa lɛ, enaa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni afeɔ, ni eekwɛ oyaa kɛ obaa fɛɛ.

english_verse: They get lost and die because of their foolishness and lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Egboɔ ejaakɛ ebɛ tsɔsemɔ, ni ekwashiafeemɔ babaoo hewɔ lɛ ehiɛ kpãtãa.

english_verse: My child, suppose you agree to pay the debt of someone, who cannot repay a loan.
translation_verse: Mibi, kɛji owo onaanyo ko shi yɛ sane ko mli, aloo okɛ mɔ ko ta abasa yɛ onaanyo ko hewɔ,

english_verse: Then you are trapped by your own words,
translation_verse: ni atsɔ̃ olilɛi nɔ adu bo, aloo atsɔ̃ odaaŋ wiemɔ nɔ amɔ bo lɛ,

english_verse: and you are now in the power of someone else. Here is what you should do: Go and beg for permission to call off the agreement.
translation_verse: mibi, feemɔ enɛ ni okɛjie ohe; ejaakɛ onaanyo lɛ nine egbe bo. Yaa oya mramra ni oyakpa onaanyo lɛ fai.

english_verse: Do this before you fall asleep or even get sleepy.
translation_verse: Kaahã ohiŋmɛii miina wɔ miiwɔ. Kaahã wɔ miiba ohiɛsɛɛ kwraa.

english_verse: Save yourself, just as a deer or a bird tries to escape from a hunter.
translation_verse: Jiemɔ ohe kɛjɛ edɛŋ tamɔ soŋai jieɔ ehe yɛ gbɔbilɔ dɛŋ, aloo tamɔ loofɔlɔ jieɔ ehe yɛ loofɔlɔdulɔ dɛŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You lazy people can learn by watching an anthill.
translation_verse: Hejɔ̃lɔ, yaa tsatsu ŋɔɔ, jwɛŋmɔ enifeemɔi ahe ni ole nii.

english_verse: but they store up food during harvest season.
translation_verse: etaoɔ eniyenii etoɔ yɛ latsaa be mli, ni ebuaa eŋmãa naa yɛ nikpamɔ be mli.

english_verse: How long will you lie there doing nothing at all? When are you going to get up and stop sleeping?
translation_verse: Hejɔ̃lɔ, mɛɛbe oookã shi owɔ kɛyashi? Mɛɛbe nɔŋŋ ooote shi kɛaajɛ owɔ mli?

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: Hejɔ̃lɔ kɛɔ akɛ, “Mawɔ fioo; majie mihiɛsɛɛ fioo; makota miniji majɔɔ mihe fioo.”

english_verse: Suddenly, everything is gone, as though it had been taken by an armed robber.
translation_verse: Be ni ooohɛle shi lɛ, ohia ebatua bo tamɔ ojotswalɔ; ni fimɔ aaatua bo tamɔ tabilɔ ni hiɛ tsɛŋ.

english_verse: Worthless liars go around
translation_verse: Yakagbɔmɔ, nɔfɔŋfeelɔ yɔɔ nɛɛ, enyiɛɔ eyeɔ kutumpɔo.

english_verse: winking and giving signals to deceive others.
translation_verse: Ebɛɔ mɔ hiŋmɛi, ekɛ enaji tete wieɔ, ni ekɛ ewaobii toɔ okadi.

english_verse: They are always thinking up something cruel and evil, and they stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Etoɔ nibii fɔ̃ji yɛ etsui mli, eshwieɔ eyiŋ ŋaa fɔŋ daa, bei sɔŋŋ ewoɔ.

english_verse: But they will be struck by sudden disaster and left without a hope.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, ehiɛ aaakpãtã trukaa, ni aaakumɔ lɛ trukaa ashwie shi bɔ ni ebɛ tsabaa.

english_verse: Those who are too proud or tell lies or murder,
translation_verse: hewoo; amale lilɛi kɛ niji ni shwieɔ lá ni efeko efɔŋ ko shi.

english_verse: those who make evil plans or are quick to do wrong,
translation_verse: Tsui ni shwieɔ yiŋ fɔŋ, naji ni he yɔɔ oya kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ.

english_verse: those who tell lies in court or stir up trouble in a family.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yeɔ amale odase, ni efoɔ sane ni bɛ mli etãa; mɔ ni woɔ nanemɛi ateŋ bei. Gbãlãfitemɔ he kɔkɔbɔɔ

english_verse: always keep it in mind and never forget it.
translation_verse: Ŋɔɔ kitãi lɛ amli wiemɔi lɛ oto otsui mli daa nɛɛ; ŋɔɔ ofi okuɛ.

english_verse: Their teaching will guide you when you walk, protect you when you sleep, and talk to you when you are awake.
translation_verse: Kɛji onyiɛ lɛ eeetsɔ̃ɔ bo gbɛ; kɛji okã shi owɔ lɛ, eeebu ohe, ni kɛji ohiɛ tsɛ̃ lɛ, ekɛ bo aaagba sane.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is a lamp, and its teachings shine brightly. Correction and self-control will lead you through life.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kitã lɛ, kane ni, ni mla lɛ, la ni, ni tsɔsemɔkãmɔ lɛ, wala gbɛ ni.

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ aaabaa oyi kɛje yoo fɔŋ dɛŋ, eeekpɔ̃ bo kɛje yoo ni bɛ jeŋba lilɛi dɔkɔbii lɛ dɛŋ.

english_verse: Don't let yourself be attracted by the charm and lovely eyes of someone like that.
translation_verse: Kaadi ehe fɛo sɛɛ yɛ otsui mli, ni kaahã ekɛ ehiɛsɛɛ miimɔ bo.

english_verse: A woman who sells her love can be bought for as little as the price of a meal. But making love to another man's wife will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Abaanyɛ akɛ aboloo akwaabɔ abɔ yoo ajwamãŋ apaa, shi yoo gbãlãfitelɔ aaahã nuu wala tete abɔ lɛ.

english_verse: If you carry burning coals, you burn your clothes;
translation_verse: Aso mɔ ko aaaje la ashwie emiinaa, ni etadei eshãŋ?

english_verse: if you step on hot coals, you burn your feet.
translation_verse: Aloo mɔ ko aaanyiɛ ŋai kɛ la nɔ, ni enaji eshaŋ?

english_verse: And if you go to bed with another man's wife, you pay the price.
translation_verse: Nakai eji hã nuu ni nyiɛɔ mɔ kroko ŋa sɛɛ; mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni aaata ehe ni eeeye ehe kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: We don't put up with thieves, not even with one who steals for something to eat.
translation_verse: Kɛji hɔmɔ naa kɛkɛ ni julɔ yaju lɛ, agbeee ehe guɔ.

english_verse: And thieves who get caught must pay back seven times what was stolen and lose everything.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji amɔ lɛ lɛ, ani ahaŋ eto najiaŋ toi kpawo lo? Ekɛ ewe nii fɛɛ tswɛm hãa.

english_verse: But if you go to bed with another man's wife, you will destroy yourself by your own stupidity.
translation_verse: Shi nuu ni fiteɔ gbãlã lɛ ebɛ yitsoŋ; mɔ ni feɔ nakai lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe efiteɔ.

english_verse: You will be beaten and forever disgraced,
translation_verse: Pilamɔ kɛ heguɔgbee eeena, ni ehiɛshishwiemɔ lɛ, anyɛŋ atsumɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: because a jealous husband can be furious and merciless when he takes revenge.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ awuŋayeli hãa nuu mlifu naa waa, ni kɛji eetɔ owele lɛ, ekɔ̃ɔɔ efiliii.

english_verse: He won't let you pay him off, no matter what you offer.
translation_verse: Eheŋ kpãtãmɔ nii ko, ni nyɔɔŋnii pii po ebaakwa.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention and don't forget what I tell you to do.
translation_verse: Mibi, ye miwiemɔi lɛ anɔ, ni okɛ mikitãi lɛ ato.

english_verse: Obey me, and you will live! Let my instructions be your greatest treasure.
translation_verse: Ye mikitãi lɛ anɔ ní oyi ana wala; ni obu mitsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ tamɔ ohiŋmɛi mli ajaŋmalaatɛ.

english_verse: Keep them at your fingertips and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Hã ehi owaobii anaa. Ŋmãa yɛ otsuiŋ tao lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Let wisdom be your sister and make common sense your closest friend.
translation_verse: Tsɛ nilee akɛ, “Minyɛmi yoo,” koni otsɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ akɛ oshieŋnyɛ.

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Amɛ amɛaabaa oyi kɛjɛ yoo ni bɛ jeŋba dɛŋ, amɛaakpɔ̃ bo kɛjɛ yoo ni naa yɔɔ dɔkɔbii lɛ dɛŋ. Yoo ni bɛ jeŋba lɛ

english_verse: From the window of my house, I once happened to see
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mitsɔ̃ miwe lɛ samflɛ lɛ mli mikwɛ,

english_verse: One of these young men turned the corner and was walking by the house of an unfaithful wife.
translation_verse: Gbɛkɛ ni, ni hiɛ efee tuutuu, ni duŋ kpii miihe awo.

english_verse: She was dressed fancy like a woman of the street with only one thing in mind.
translation_verse: Ni naa, yoo ko kɛ oblanyo lɛ bakpe. Yoo lɛ wo ajwamãŋ atade, ni etsui esa.

english_verse: She was one of those women who are loud and restless and never stay at home,
translation_verse: Enaa wa, ni etoi egbo, ni etaaa shĩa.

english_verse: who walk street after street, waiting to trap a man.
translation_verse: Bianɛbianɛ etee agbo lɛ naa; bianɛbianɛ etee jara lɛ nɔ, ni ewoɔ ka yɛ tsu koŋ fɛɛ tsu koŋ.

english_verse: She grabbed him and kissed him, and with no sense of shame, she said:
translation_verse: Yoo nɛɛ mɔ oblanyo lɛ ni eshwɔ enaa, ni yoo lɛ mia ehiɛ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,

english_verse: “I had to offer a sacrifice, and there is enough meat left over for a feast.
translation_verse: “Kulɛ esa akɛ mashã afɔle, shi ŋmɛnɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ miyawo mishiwoonii lɛ.

english_verse: So I came looking for you, and here you are!
translation_verse: No hã mije kpo koni mabɔ mɔdɛŋ matao bo ni mikɛ bo akpe, ni trukaa mibana bo nɛɛ.

english_verse: The sheets on my bed are bright-colored cloth from Egypt.
translation_verse: Mikɛ saanɔboi ni akɛ kpãi sui srɔtoi ni akɛjɛ Ijipt loo eha misaa lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: And I have covered it with perfume made of myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
translation_verse: Mikɛ mire kɛ aloe kɛ sinamon ewo misaa lɛ mli ŋma.

english_verse: “Let's go there and make love all night.
translation_verse: Ba ni wɔkɛ suɔmɔ ajie wɔkɔnɔ kɛyashi leebi. Wɔkɛ suɔmɔ anya kɛ miishɛɛ.

english_verse: My husband is traveling, and he's far away.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ miwu bɛ, efã gbɛ kɛtee shɔŋŋ.

english_verse: He took a lot of money along, and he won't be back home before the middle of the month.”
translation_verse: Ehiɛ shika pii kɛ kotoku kɛtee. Nyɔɔŋtsere lɛ baaye emuu dani ebaaba.”

english_verse: And so, she tricked him with all of her sweet talk and her flattery.
translation_verse: Yoo lɛ kɛ ewiemɔ kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ kɔne oblanyo lɛ yiŋ, ni eyitsoŋ tsɔ̃. Ekɛ enaa dɔkɔbii lɛ kpala lɛ kɛtee ewe.

english_verse: At once he followed her like an ox on the way to be slaughtered, or like a fool on the way to be punished
translation_verse: Oblanyo lɛ nyiɛ yoo lɛ sɛɛ amrɔ nɔŋŋ kɛtee ewe lɛ tamɔ tsina ni ayaagbe lɛ, aloo ofrote ni tsɔne edu lɛ kpɛŋŋ

english_verse: and killed with arrows. He was no more than a bird rushing into a trap, without knowing it would cost him his life.
translation_verse: kɛyashi beyinɔ ni gãimlibi tsuɔ emusuŋ nii amli. Etamɔ loofɔlɔ ni shaa foi kɛyaduɔ tsɔne ni eleee akɛ lɛ ewala hewɔ atsɔ̃ tsɔne lɛ.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Oo, mibii, nyɛboa mi toi agbɛnɛ. Nyɛfea toi nyɛhãa midaaŋ wiemɔi lɛ.

english_verse: Don't even think about that kind of woman or let yourself be misled by someone like her.
translation_verse: Kaahã otsui mɔ nɛkɛ yoo. Kaadu gbɛ kɛyaje egbɛ nɔ;

english_verse: Such a woman has caused the downfall and destruction of a lot of men.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ yoo ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ ekpãtã mɛi pii ahiɛ, mɛi ni egbe lɛ ayi fa naakpa.

english_verse: Her house is a one-way street leading straight down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ewe lɛ, gbohiiaje gbɛ ni, ekã kɛmiiya gbele piai amli tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: With great understanding, Wisdom is calling out
translation_verse: Ani jeee blɔmɔ nilee bolɔɔ kɛtsɛɔ lɛ; ni jeee niiashishinumɔ hu woɔ egbee lɛ?

english_verse: as she stands at the crossroads and on every hill.
translation_verse: Edamɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ he yɛ ŋmaŋmashai lɛ.

english_verse: She stands by the city gate where everyone enters the city, and she shouts:
translation_verse: Ebolɔɔ gegeege yɛ maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ anaa yɛ maŋ lɛ klotia yɛ shinaa lɛ shi akɛ,

english_verse: “I am calling out to each one of you!
translation_verse: “Oo, nyɛ hii, nyɛ mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ, ni nyɛ gbɔmɛi abii, nyɛ miwoɔ migbee nɔ mihãa.

english_verse: Good sense and sound judgment can be yours.
translation_verse: Oo, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛnako jwɛŋmɔ, nyɛkasea hiɛtɛ̃ɛ. Oo, nyɛ hii kwashiai hu, nyɛboa toi jogbaŋŋ.

english_verse: I always speak the truth and refuse to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ anɔkwale wiemɔ aaajɛ midaaŋ; minaabu miihi nɔ fɔŋ.

english_verse: Every word I speak is honest, not one is misleading or deceptive.
translation_verse: Midaaŋ wiemɔi fɛɛ lɛ, jalɛ ni, ekoeko bɛ mli ni ji amale loo kutumpɔo.

english_verse: “If you have understanding, you will see that my words are just what you need.
translation_verse: Fɛɛ kã shi faŋŋ hã mɔ ni kɔɔ sane sɛɛ lɛ, ni amɛja yɛ nilelɔ hiɛ.

english_verse: Let instruction and knowledge mean more to you than silver or the finest gold.
translation_verse: Nyɛmɔa mitsɔsemɔ lɛ moŋ mli fe jwiɛtɛi, kɛ nilee hu mli fe shika ŋmiiŋmi.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than precious jewels or anything else you desire.” Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nilee hi fe tɛ̃ŋlɛ̃o, ni nɔ ko bɛ ni obaatao ni kɛ lɛ ye hegbɔ.

english_verse: I am Wisdom—Common Sense is my closest friend; I possess knowledge and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Mi, nilee, mihiɛ tɛ̃; mile nii, ni mibuɔ atɛŋ kpakpa.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will hate evil. I hate pride and conceit and deceitful lies.
translation_verse: Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ ji ohi nɔ fɔŋ. Hewoo kɛ hetsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ jeŋba fɔŋ kɛ kutumpɔo wiemɔ lɛ miihi.

english_verse: I am strong, and I offer sensible advice and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Minɔ ji ŋaawoo kɛ nilee kpakpa, miyɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ; miyɛ hewalɛ hu.

english_verse: By my power kings govern, and rulers make laws that are fair.
translation_verse: Minɔ maŋtsɛmɛi tsɔ̃ɔ yeɔ maŋtsɛ, ni nɔyelɔi hu woɔ jalɛ mla.

english_verse: Every honest leader rules with help from me.
translation_verse: Minɔ lumɛi tsɔ̃ɔ yeɔ lumɔ, ni abladei yeɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: I love everyone who loves me, and I will be found by all who honestly search.
translation_verse: Misumɔɔ mɛi ni sumɔɔ mi; ni mɛi ni bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ taoɔ mi lɛ, naa mi.

english_verse: I can make you rich and famous, important and successful.
translation_verse: Ninamɔ kɛ anunyam fɛɛ yɛ midɛŋ; ninamɔ ni sɛɛ tsɛɔ kɛ shweremɔ fɛɛ yɛ midɛŋ.

english_verse: What you receive from me is more valuable than even the finest gold or the purest silver.
translation_verse: Miyibii hi fe shika, efe shika ŋmiiŋmi; ni minibaanii lɛ hu hi fe jwiɛtɛi krɔŋŋ.

english_verse: I always do what is right,
translation_verse: Minyiɛɔ jalɛ gbɛ nɔ, ni mikojoɔ jalɛ naa.

english_verse: and I give great riches to everyone who loves me.
translation_verse: Ni mɛi ni sumɔɔ mi lɛ, mifeɔ amɛ niiatsɛmɛi, ni miwoɔ amɛfotroi lɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃.

english_verse: From the beginning, I was with the Lord. I was there before he began
translation_verse: Mi Yehowa bɔ kɛje enitsumɔ shishi; mi ji klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ yɛ eblema nitsumɔi lɛ ateŋ.

english_verse: to create the earth. At the very first, the Lord gave life to me.
translation_verse: Kɛjɛ naanɔ beebe abɔ mi klɛŋklɛŋ dani aje jeŋbɔɔ shishi.

english_verse: When I was born, there were no oceans or springs of water.
translation_verse: Be ni ŋshɔ tete po bɛ lɛ, afɔ mi momo, be ni nuhiŋmɛi bɛ lɛ, miyɛ momo.

english_verse: My birth was before mountains were formed or hills were put in place.
translation_verse: Dani ashɔ̃ gɔji lɛ kɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ, afɔ mi momo.

english_verse: It happened long before God had made the earth or any of its fields or even the dust.
translation_verse: Be ni Nyɔŋmɔ nako ebɔ shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ jwɛii kɛ je lɛ mli mlu tete lɛ, mi lɛ, abɔ mi momo.

english_verse: I was there when the Lord put the heavens in place and stretched the sky over the surface of the sea.
translation_verse: Be ni ebɔ ŋwɛi lɛ, miyɛ jɛi; be ni efo ŋshɔ he akrabatsa lɛ, miyɛ.

english_verse: I was with him when he placed the clouds in the sky and created the springs that fill the ocean.
translation_verse: Be ni eŋɔ atatui lɛ esɛŋ shi shiŋŋ yɛ ŋwɛi, ní etsi ŋshɔ lɛ mli nu lɛ naa lɛ, miyɛ.

english_verse: I was there when he set boundaries for the sea to make it obey him, and when he laid foundations to support the earth.
translation_verse: Be ni efo husu ewo ŋshɔ lɛ he, ni nu akaku ekitã lɛ nɔ, be ni eto shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi lɛ,

english_verse: I was right beside the Lord, helping him plan and build. I made him happy each day, and I was happy at his side.
translation_verse: miyɛ emasɛi akɛ ŋaawolɔ. Ni mi ji emiishɛjelɔ daa. Ni mimii shɛɔ mihe yɛ ehiɛ.

english_verse: I was pleased with his world and pleased with its people.
translation_verse: Minaa je lɛ he miishɛɛ, minaa gbɔmɛiabii ahe tsuijurɔ.

english_verse: Pay attention, my children! Follow my advice, and you will be happy.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mibii nyɛboa mi toi! Ajɔɔ mɛi ni yeɔ mimlai anɔ lɛ!

english_verse: Listen carefully to my instructions, and you will be wise.
translation_verse: Nyɛboa tsɔsemɔ toi koni nyɛle nii; ni nyɛkakwaa lɛ kwraa.

english_verse: Come to my home each day and listen to me. You will find happiness.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni boɔ mi toi ni ebuɔ migboi lɛ anaa daa ní emɛɔ daa yɛ mishinai lɛ anaa lɛ.

english_verse: By finding me, you find life, and the Lord will be pleased with you.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɔ ni aaaná mi lɛ, ena wala ni ehiɛ aaaba nyam yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: But if you don't find me, you hurt only yourself, and if you hate me, you are in love with death.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni nine shɛɛɛ minɔ lɛ, eeye lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esusuma awui. Mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ, amɛmiisumɔ gbele.”

english_verse: Wisdom has built her house with its seven columns.
translation_verse: Nilee ema etsu kɛ ehe akulashiŋi kpawo.

english_verse: She has prepared the meat and set out the wine. Her feast is ready.
translation_verse: Egbe elɛɛ kooloi; efutu ewain lɛ, ni eŋmɛ ekpɔlɔ̃ lɛ hu.

english_verse: She has sent her servant women to announce her invitation from the highest hills:
translation_verse: Etsu etsuji yei lɛ kɛtee maŋ lɛ mli hei grɔŋŋi fe fɛɛ lɛ, ni amɛyatsɛ mɛi akɛ,

english_verse: “Everyone who is ignorant or foolish is invited!
translation_verse: “Mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ esako lɛ, ebatsɔ̃ biɛ,” ni mɔ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, ekɛɔ lɛ akɛ,

english_verse: All of you are welcome to my meat and wine.
translation_verse: “Ba ni obaye miniyenii lɛ eko ni obanu wain ni mifutu lɛ eko.

english_verse: If you want to live, give up your foolishness and let understanding guide your steps.” True Wisdom
translation_verse: Kaaŋɔ ohe obɔ kwashia he, koni oyi ana wala; ni dii sanesɛɛkɔmɔ sɛɛ.”

english_verse: Correct a worthless bragger, and all you will get are insults and injuries.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni jajeɔ hefɛoyelɔ jeŋba lɛ, enaa jɛmɔ; ni mɔ ni kãa yiwalɔ lɛ, enaa pilamɔ.

english_verse: Any bragger you correct will only hate you. But if you correct someone who has common sense, you will be loved.
translation_verse: Hɛfɛoyelɔ lɛ kɛ okã ehiɛ lɛ, ebaanyɛ bo; shi nilelɔ lɛ kɛji okã ehiɛ lɛ, ebaasumɔ bo.

english_verse: If you have good sense, instruction will help you to have even better sense. And if you live right, education will help you to know even more.
translation_verse: Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nilelɔ nii, ni eeele nii efata nɔ ni ele momo lɛ he; tsɔ̃ɔmɔ jalɔ nii, ni enilee aaafa.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of wisdom. To have understanding, you must know the Holy God.
translation_verse: Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ ji nilee shishijee; ni Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ lee ji sanesɛɛkɔmɔ.

english_verse: I am Wisdom. If you follow me, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ minɔ baatsɔ̃ ni ogbii baafa; ni owala afii lɛ asɛɛ baatsɛ.

english_verse: Good sense is good for you, but if you brag, you hurt yourself. A Foolish Invitation
translation_verse: Kɛ ole nii lɛ, ole ohã ohe; shi kɛ hefɛoyelɔ ji bo lɛ, bo okome obaatere.

english_verse: Stupidity is reckless, senseless, and foolish.
translation_verse: Yoo kwashia lɛ, naawalɔ ni, ebɛ jwɛŋmɔ, ni ehiɛgbele tɔ ejwa.

english_verse: She sits in front of her house and on the highest hills in the town.
translation_verse: Etaa shi yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshinaa shi; etaa hei grɔŋŋi lɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli;

english_verse: She shouts to everyone who passes by,
translation_verse: ni etsɛɔ mɛi ni hoɔ ni amɛnyiɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbɛ nɔ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ.

english_verse: “If you are stupid, come on inside!” And to every fool she says,
translation_verse: Ekɛɔ akɛ, “Mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ esako lɛ, eba biɛ,” ni mɔ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ ekɛɔ lɛ akɛ,

english_verse: “Stolen water tastes best, and the food you eat in secret tastes best of all.”
translation_verse: “Nu ni ayaju lɛ, enumɔ ŋɔɔ. Ni aboloo ni ateɔ ayeɔ lɛ eyɛ akɔnɔ.”

english_verse: None who listen to Stupidity understand that her guests are as good as dead.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni ekpeɔ kɛyaa ewe lɛ leee akɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yaa jɛi lɛ gboiɔ; amɛleee akɛ mɛi ni akpee kɛtee jɛi momo lɛ gbohiiaje tɔ̃ɔ amɛyɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Here are some proverbs of Solomon: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children make them sad.
translation_verse: Bi nilelɔ hãa etsɛ naa miishɛɛ; shi bi kwashia lɛ, ehãa enyɛ tsui yeɔ.

english_verse: What you gain by doing evil won't help you at all. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Efɔŋfeemɔ mli ninamɔ lɛ ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ; shi jalɛ hereɔ mɔ yiwala yɛ gbele dɛŋ.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you won't go hungry; if you are wicked, God won't let you have what you want.
translation_verse: Yehowa hãaa hɔmɔ aye jalɔi; shi nɔ ni efɔŋfeelɔi shweɔ akɛ amɛna lɛ, etswaa yɛ amɛdɛŋ.

english_verse: Laziness leads to poverty; hard work makes you rich.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni nijiaŋ ŋɔɔ lɛ lɛ, ohia hiaa lɛ, shi mɔ ni nine kãaa shi lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ niiatsɛ.

english_verse: Everyone praises good people, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ mɛi ni feɔ jalɛ nii, shi efɔŋfeelɔi kɛ amɛdaaŋ wiemɔ haa amɛyitsoŋwalɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Good people are remembered long after they are gone, but the wicked are soon forgotten.
translation_verse: Kɛ akai jalɔ lɛ, ajɔɔ lɛ; shi efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ atsiŋ egbɛi tã ajɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You will be safe, if you always do right, but you will get caught, if you are dishonest.
translation_verse: Anɔkwayelɔ hiɔ shi shweshweeshwe, shi mɔ ni bɛ jeŋba lɛ, aaayoo lɛ.

english_verse: Deceit causes trouble, and foolish talk will bring you to ruin.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni bɛɔ mɔ hiŋmɛi lɛ ewoɔ bei; shi mɔ ni kɛ ekãa kãa mɔ lɛ hãa toiŋjɔlɛ baa.

english_verse: The words of good people are a source of life, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Jalɔ daaŋ wiemɔ lɛ, wala nubu ni; shi efɔŋfeelɔ daaŋ wiemɔ haa yitsoŋwalɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Hatred stirs up trouble; love overlooks the wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛ teɔ bei shi; shi suɔmɔ haa tɔ̃mɔi fɛɛ anɔ.

english_verse: If you have good sense, it will show when you speak. But if you are stupid, you will be beaten with a stick.
translation_verse: Niiashishinulɔ daaŋ anaa nilee yɛ; shi mɔ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ kpãa kã ekotosɛɛ.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will learn all you can, but foolish talk will soon destroy you.
translation_verse: Nilelɔ tiaa nilee, shi kwashia daaŋ wiemɔ lɛ ekɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ baa.

english_verse: Great wealth can be a fortress, but poverty is no protection at all.
translation_verse: Niiatsɛ nii ji emɔ̃ɔ ni wa lɛ, shi ohia kpãtãa ohiafo hiɛ.

english_verse: If you live right, the reward is a good life; if you are evil, all you have is sin.
translation_verse: Jalɛ nitsumɔ he nyɔmɔwoo lɛ wala ni, efɔŋfeemɔ he sɛɛnamɔ ji esha.

english_verse: Accept correction, and you will find life; reject correction, and you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni boɔ tsɔsemɔ toi lɛ, enyiɛɔ gbɛ ni kɛ mɔ yaa wala mli nɔ; shi mɔ ni kwaa kãmɔ lɛ, eduɔ gbɛ.

english_verse: You can hide your hatred by telling lies, but you are a fool to spread lies.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kɛ nyɛɛ teɔ lɛ, amalelɔ ni; mɔ ni yeɔ mɔ he osheku lɛ, kwashia ji lɛ.

english_verse: You will say the wrong thing if you talk too much— so be sensible and watch what you say.
translation_verse: Wiemɔ babaoo yɔɔ nɛɛ tɔ̃mɔ kpaaa yɛ mli; shi mɔ ni le enaabu mli mɔmɔ lɛ, nilelɔ ni.

english_verse: The words of a good person are like pure silver, but the thoughts of an evil person are almost worthless.
translation_verse: Jalɔ lilɛi lɛ, etamɔ jwiɛtɛi krɔŋŋ; shi mɔ fɔŋ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko bɛ he.

english_verse: Many are helped by useful instruction, but fools are killed by their own stupidity.
translation_verse: Jalɔ naabu lɛɔ mɛi babaoo, shi kwashia lɛ, jwɛŋmɔ ni ebɛ hewɔ lɛ egboɔ.

english_verse: When the Lord blesses you with riches, you have nothing to regret.
translation_verse: Yehowa jɔɔmɔ lɛ, no feɔ mɔ niiatsɛ; shi odeŋmegbomɔ nyɛŋ ekɛ nɔ ko afata he.

english_verse: Fools enjoy doing wrong, but anyone with good sense enjoys acting wisely.
translation_verse: Kwashia lɛ efɔŋfeemɔ feɔ lɛ miishɛɛ, shi mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, nilee feɔ lɛ miishɛɛ.

english_verse: What evil people dread most will happen to them, but good people will get what they want most.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni mɔ fɔŋ sheɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ baaba enɔ; shi jalɔ lɛ enine aaashɛ etaomɔnii anɔ.

english_verse: Those crooks will disappear when a storm strikes, but God will keep safe all who obey him.
translation_verse: Kɛ ahum tswa pɛ, mɔ fɔŋ yi etã, shi jalɔ hiɔ shi shweshweeshwe kɛyaa naanɔ tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: Having a lazy person on the job is like a mouth full of vinegar or smoke in your eyes.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni ashiŋ feɔ nyanyɔji ni lasu feɔ hiŋmɛi lɛ, nakai anihaolɔ feɔ mɛi ni tsu lɛ lɛ.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will live longer; if you keep doing wrong, your life will be cut short.
translation_verse: Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ hãa wala sɛɛ tsɛɔ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ji afii lɛ, aaafo nɔ.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will be happy, but there is no future for the wicked.
translation_verse: Jalɔi ahiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ baafee miishɛɛ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ji agbɛkwɛmɔ lɛ baafee yaka.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who lives right, but he destroys anyone who does wrong.
translation_verse: Yehowa ji mɔɔ ni wa hã mɔ ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ, shi eji hiɛkpãtãmɔ hã efɔŋfeelɔ.

english_verse: Good people will stand firm, but the wicked will disappear from the land.
translation_verse: Jalɔ lɛ eeehi shi shweshweeshwe; shi mɔ fɔŋ lɛ ehiŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Honest people speak sensibly, but deceitful liars will be silenced.
translation_verse: Jalɔi alilɛi wieɔ nilee wiemɔi; shi kutumpɔo lilɛi lɛ, aaafo ashɛ afɔ̃.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will always know the right thing to say. But no one will trust you if you tell lies.
translation_verse: Jalɔi anaabu le nɔ ni sa wiemɔ; shi mɔ fɔŋ wieɔ kutumpɔo wiemɔ.

english_verse: The Lord hates anyone who cheats, but he likes everyone who is honest.
translation_verse: Yehowa miihi shishiumɔ nsɛni, shi nsɛnitɛ shishiishi lɛ enaa he miishɛɛ.

english_verse: Too much pride can put you to shame. It's wiser to be humble.
translation_verse: Kɛ hewoo ba pɛ, hiɛgbele nyiɛɔ esɛɛ, shi heshibalɔ lɛ nilelɔ ni.

english_verse: If you do the right thing, honesty will be your guide. But if you are crooked, you will be trapped by your own dishonesty.
translation_verse: Jalɔ lɛ enɔkwayeli tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ gbɛ; shi kutumpɔfo lɛ eshishiumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ kpãtãa ehiɛ.

english_verse: When God is angry, money won't help you. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ninamɔ he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko; shi jalɛ jieɔ mɔ kɛjɛɔ gbele dɛŋ.

english_verse: If you are truly good, you will do right; if you are wicked, you will be destroyed by your own sin.
translation_verse: Jalɔ lɛ enɔkwayeli hãa egbɛ jaa ehãa lɛ; shi mɔ fɔŋ lɛ, enifɔjianii lɛ gbeɔ lɛ shi.

english_verse: Honesty can keep you safe, but if you can't be trusted, you trap yourself.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni ja lɛ amɛjalɛ lɛ aajie amɛ, shi kutumpɔfoi lɛ, amɛkɔnɔ ŋɔɔ amɛ nom.

english_verse: When the wicked die, their hopes die with them.
translation_verse: Kɛ mɔ fɔŋ gbo lɛ; ehiɛnɔkãmɔ laajeɔ; ni mɔ ni leee Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ efeɔ yaka.

english_verse: Trouble goes right past the Lord's people and strikes the wicked.
translation_verse: Ajieɔ jalɔi kɛjɛɔ haomɔ mli; shi mɛi fɔ̃ji yanyɔɔ haomɔ mli.

english_verse: Dishonest people use gossip to destroy their neighbors; good people are protected by their own good sense.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni leee Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛdaaŋ wiemɔi fiteɔ amɛnanemɛi; shi atsɔ̃ɔ nilee nɔ, ni ajieɔ jalɔi.

english_verse: Good people bring prosperity to their city, but deceitful liars can destroy a city.
translation_verse: Jalɔi adɛŋ jɔɔmɔ woɔ maŋ nɔ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ji anaabu butuɔ maŋ.

english_verse: It's stupid to say bad things about your neighbors. If you are sensible, you will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni gbeɔ enaanyo he guɔ lɛ, ebɛ yitsoŋ; shi mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ efeɔ diŋŋ.

english_verse: A gossip tells everything, but a true friend will keep a secret.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni tãa sane kɛfoɔ shi lɛ, ejieɔ teemɔŋ saji akpo; shi mɔ ni yɔɔ anɔkwale mumɔ lɛ etsimɔɔ sane nɔ.

english_verse: A city without wise leaders will end up in ruin; a city with many wise leaders will be kept safe.
translation_verse: He ni maŋ kudɔmɔ bɛ lɛ, maŋ gbeɔ shi; shi he ni ŋaawolɔi pii yɔɔ lɛ, maŋ feɔ shweshweeshwe.

english_verse: It's a dangerous thing to guarantee payment for someone's debts. Don't do it!
translation_verse: Mɔ ni damɔɔ gbɔ sɛɛ lɛ, eeeshwa ehe; shi mɔ ni kɛ ehe wooo mli lɛ ehi hã lɛ.

english_verse: A gracious woman will be respected, but a ruthless man will only get rich.
translation_verse: Yoo ni hiɛ yɔɔ nyam tiuɔ woo sɛɛ, ni nuu yiwalɔ tiuɔ ninamɔ sɛɛ.

english_verse: Kindness is rewarded— but if you are cruel, you hurt yourself.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni naa mɔbɔ lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe ejurɔ efeɔ; shi mɔ ni yitsoŋ wa lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe efɔŋ efeɔ.

english_verse: Always do the right thing, and you will live; keep on doing wrong, and you will die.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni fiɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ jalɛ mli lɛ, eyi aaana wala; shi mɔ ni nyiɛɔ efɔŋfeemɔ sɛɛ lɛ egboɔ.

english_verse: The Lord hates sneaky people, but he likes everyone who lives right.
translation_verse: Yehowa miihi mɛi ni hiɛ yitso fɔŋ; shi Yehowa sumɔɔ mɛi ni shwamɔ bɛ amɛjeŋba he.

english_verse: You can be sure of this: All crooks will be punished, but God's people won't.
translation_verse: Na ole akɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ efɔŋfeelɔ yeŋ ehe; shi jalɔ lɛ aaahere eyiwala.

english_verse: A beautiful woman who acts foolishly is like a gold ring on the snout of a pig.
translation_verse: Yoo ni he yɔɔ fɛo ni ebɛ jeŋba kpakpa lɛ etamɔ kplotoo ni awo egugɔ mli shika ga.

english_verse: Good people want what is best, but troublemakers hope to stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Jalɔi shweɔ nibii kpakpai sɔŋŋ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ji agbɛkwɛmɔnii lɛ mlifu ni.

english_verse: Sometimes you can become rich by being generous or poor by being greedy.
translation_verse: Mɔ ko yɛ ni edɛŋ kpɔɔ, shi eyaa nɔ eshwereɔ kɛtekeɔ nɔ kɛ̃, mɔ ko hu feɔ kpɛkpɛɛ, shi eyeɔ ohia moŋ.

english_verse: Generosity will be rewarded: Give a cup of water, and you will receive a cup of water in return.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni edɛŋ kpɔɔ lɛ, enaa nii, ni mɔ ni hãa mɛi tɔrɔɔ lɛ, lɛ hu etɔɔ.

english_verse: Charge too much for grain, and you will be cursed; sell it at a fair price, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni tiaa abele etoɔ lɛ, maŋ lomɔɔ lɛ; shi mɔ ni hɔ̃ɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ maŋ jɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Try hard to do right, and you will win friends; go looking for trouble, and you will find it.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni tiuɔ nɔ kpakpa sɛɛ kɛ hiɛdɔɔ naa nɔ kpakpa; shi mɔ ni diɔ efɔŋ sɛɛ lɛ efɔŋ blaa lɛ.

english_verse: Trust in your wealth, and you will be a failure, but God's people will prosper like healthy plants.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ eninamɔ nɔ lɛ, etamɔ baa gbiŋ ni kpalaa; shi jalɔ aaafrɔke tamɔ baa ŋmɔŋ.

english_verse: Fools who cause trouble in the family won't inherit a thing. They will end up as slaves of someone with good sense.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni gbaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshĩaŋbii anaa lɛ, eyeɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔ; ni buulu tsɔ̃ɔ tsulɔ hãa nilelɔ be fɛɛ be.

english_verse: Live right, and you will eat from the life-giving tree. And if you act wisely, others will follow.
translation_verse: Jalɛ yibii lɛ wala ni; shi mla kwamɔ lɛ wala hiɛkpãtãmɔ ni.

english_verse: If good people are rewarded here on this earth, all who are cruel and mean will surely be punished.
translation_verse: Kɛji jalɔ lɛ enaa enyɔmɔwoo yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ, mɔ fɔŋ kɛ eshafeelɔ lɛ te amɛnyɔmɔwoo aaatamɔ tɛŋŋ?

english_verse: To accept correction is wise, to reject it is stupid.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni sumɔɔ tsɔsemɔ lɛ, esumɔɔ nilee; shi mɔ ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ kãmɔ lɛ, kwashia ni.

english_verse: The Lord likes everyone who lives right, but he punishes everyone who makes evil plans.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ kpakpa hiɛ baa nyam yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, shi mɔ ni toɔ yiŋ fɔŋ lɛ, ebuɔ lɛ fɔ.

english_verse: Sin cannot offer security! But if you live right, you will be as secure as a tree with deep roots.
translation_verse: Efɔŋfeemɔ hãaa mɔ afi shi; shi jalɔi ashishi fã lɛ, anyɛŋ afã kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: A helpful wife is a jewel for her husband, but a shameless wife will make his bones rot.
translation_verse: Yoo kpakpa lɛ ewu akekre ji lɛ; shi yoo ni shwieɔ ewu hiɛ shi lɛ, etamɔ wuiaŋ sasabro.

english_verse: Good people have kind thoughts, but you should never trust the advice of someone evil.
translation_verse: Jalɔ jwɛŋmɔ ja; shi mɔ fɔŋ ŋaawoo lɛ, kutumpɔo ni.

english_verse: Bad advice is a deadly trap, but good advice is like a shield.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɔ̃ji woɔ lá antɛo, shi jalɔi awiemɔ hereɔ mɔ yiwala.

english_verse: Once the wicked are defeated, they are gone forever, but no one who obeys God will ever be thrown down.
translation_verse: Abutuɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji kɛ amɛshishi fɛɛ; shi jalɔi awe maa shi shiŋŋ.

english_verse: Good sense is worthy of praise, but stupidity is a curse.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ nilee akɛjieɔ eyi, shi mɔ ni hiɛ jwɛŋmɔ fɔŋ lɛ, abuuu lɛ.
