english_verse: It's better to be ordinary and have only one servant than to think you are somebody and starve to death.
translation_verse: Ohiafo humi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ, ehi fe mɔ ni feɔ ehe niiatsɛ, tsɛbelɛ ebɛ nɔ ko.

english_verse: Good people are kind to their animals, but a mean person is cruel.
translation_verse: Jalɔ nuɔ he ehãa eshĩa kooloo tete; shi mɔ fɔŋ musuŋtsɔlɛ tete lɛ, yiwaa ni.

english_verse: Hard working farmers have more than enough food; daydreamers are nothing more than stupid fools.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni huɔ eŋmɔ lɛ eeetɔ kɛ ŋmãa pii; shi mɔ ni nyiɛɔ yakanii asɛɛ lɛ ebɛ jwɛŋmɔ.

english_verse: An evil person tries to hide behind evil; good people are like trees with deep roots.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɔŋ mɔɔ ni wa lɛ hiɛ kpãtãa; shi jalɔ shishifã maa shi shiŋŋ.

english_verse: We trap ourselves by telling lies, but we stay out of trouble by living right.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɔŋ diɛŋtsɛ daaŋ wiemɔ nɔŋŋ ni duɔ lɛ; shi jalɔ lɛ, ejeɔ haomɔ mli.

english_verse: We are rewarded or punished for what we say and do.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ daaŋ wiemɔ aaahã etɔ kɛ nii kpakpai, ni nɔ ni gbɔmɔ tsuɔ lɛ no he nyɔmɔ awoɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Fools think they know what is best, but a sensible person listens to advice.
translation_verse: Kwashia yɔɔ nɛɛ, egbɛ ja yɛ ehiɛ; shi nilelɔ lɛ, eboɔ ŋaawoo toi.

english_verse: Losing your temper is foolish; ignoring an insult is smart.
translation_verse: Kwashia yɔɔ nɛɛ anaa emlifu oya; shi nilelɔ lɛ ebuuu jɛmɔ tete.

english_verse: An honest person tells the truth in court, but a dishonest person tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni wieɔ anɔkwale lɛ, eyeɔ anɔkwa odase; shi amale odasefonyo lɛ mɔ elakaa.

english_verse: Sharp words cut like a sword, but words of wisdom heal.
translation_verse: Mɔ ko yɛ ni ewiemɔ bambam dumɔɔ mɔ tamɔ kakla; shi nilelɔ daaŋ wiemɔ lɛ etsaa mɔ.

english_verse: Truth will last forever; lies are soon found out.
translation_verse: Anɔkwale wiemɔ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ; shi amale lɛ, ehiɔ shi hiŋmɛitswaa kɛkɛ.

english_verse: An evil mind is deceitful, but gentle thoughts bring happiness.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni toɔ ŋaa fɔŋ lɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ eyi kɛ mɔshishiumɔ; shi mɛi ni toɔ ŋaa kpakpa lɛ amɛmii shɛɔ amɛhe.

english_verse: Good people never have trouble, but troublemakers have more than enough.
translation_verse: Haomɔ baaa jalɔ nɔ; shi mɔ fɔŋ lɛ be fɛɛ be lɛ haomɔi jwere enɔ.

english_verse: The Lord hates every liar, but he is the friend of all who can be trusted.
translation_verse: Yehowa miihi amalelɔ; shi mɔ ni yeɔ anɔkwa lɛ enaa ehe miishɛɛ.

english_verse: Be sensible and don't tell everything you know— only fools spread foolishness everywhere.
translation_verse: Nilelɔ kɛ enilee teɔ; shi kwashia jieɔ ekwashiafeemɔ kpo.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will be a leader; be lazy, and you will end up a slave.
translation_verse: Mɔdɛŋbɔlɔ yeɔ onukpa; shi hejɔ̃lɔ lɛ ayeɔ lɛ nyɔŋ.

english_verse: Worry is a heavy burden, but a kind word always brings cheer.
translation_verse: Mligbigblimɔ dɔɔ mɔ kɔmɔɔ; shi wiemɔ kpakpa yɔɔ nɛɛ ehãa mɔ mii shɛɔ ehe.

english_verse: You are better off to do right, than to lose your way by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Jalɔ tsɔ̃ɔ enaanyo gbɛ; shi mɔ fɔŋ hãa mɛi duɔ gbɛ moŋ.

english_verse: Anyone too lazy to cook will starve, but a hard worker is a valuable treasure.
translation_verse: Hejɔ̃lɔ lɛ, enine shɛɛɛ nɔ ni etaoɔ nɔ; shi mɔdɛŋbɔlɔ lɛ enaa nii ni jara wa.

english_verse: Living right is a pathway that leads to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Jalɛ lɛ wala gbɛ ni; shi gbɛ gbonyo lɛ, gbele gbɛ ni.

english_verse: Children with good sense accept correction from their parents, but stubborn children ignore it completely.
translation_verse: Bi nilelɔ boɔ etsɛ tsɔsemɔ toi; hefɛoyelɔ lɛ ebooo kãmɔ toi.

english_verse: You will be well rewarded for saying something kind, but all some people think about is how to be cruel and mean.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ kpakpa daaŋ wiemɔ aaahã etɔ kɛ nii kpakpai; shi nɔ ni kutumpɔfoi taoɔ ji basabasafeemɔ.

english_verse: Keep what you know to yourself, and you will be safe; talk too much, and you are done for.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni mɔɔ enaabu mli lɛ, eebaa ewala yi; shi mɔ ni mɔɔɔ enaabu mli lɛ, eekpãtã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hiɛ.

english_verse: No matter how much you want, laziness won't help a bit, but hard work will reward you with more than enough.
translation_verse: Hejɔ̃lɔ shweɔ nɔ ko, ni enaaa; shi mɔdɛŋbɔlɔ naa nii kɛtekeɔ nɔ.

english_verse: A good person hates deceit, but those who are evil cause shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Jalɔ miihi amale, shi mɔ fɔŋ feɔ hiɛgbejianii, ni ebɔɔ ehe ahora.

english_verse: Live right, and you are safe! But sin will destroy you.
translation_verse: Jalɛ buɔ mɔ ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ he; shi eshafeemɔ butuɔ mɔ fɔŋ.

english_verse: Some who have nothing may pretend to be rich, and some who have everything may pretend to be poor.
translation_verse: Mɔ ko yɛ ni feɔ ehe niiatsɛ, tsɛbelɛ ebɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko; mɔ ko hu yɛ ni feɔ ehe ohiafo, tsɛbelɛ eyɛ nii babaoo.

english_verse: The rich may have to pay a ransom, but the poor don't have that problem.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ kpɔ̃mɔ nii ji enii ni eyɔɔ; shi ohiafo bɛ nɔ ko ni ekɛkpɔ̃ɔ ehe.

english_verse: The lamp of a good person keeps on shining; the lamp of an evil person soon goes out.
translation_verse: Jalɔi akane tsoɔ hɛŋŋ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ji akane lɛ aaagbo.

english_verse: Too much pride causes trouble. Be sensible and take advice.
translation_verse: Hewoo lɛ bei kɛkɛ ekɛbaa; shi mɛi ni boɔ ŋaawoo toi lɛ, amɛleɔ nii.

english_verse: Money wrongly gained will disappear bit by bit; money earned little by little will grow and grow.
translation_verse: Nii ni anaa oya lɛ, ehiɛ kpãtãa; shi nii ni akpɛteɔ shi anaa lɛ eshwereɔ.

english_verse: Not getting what you want can break your heart, but a wish that comes true is a life-giving tree.
translation_verse: Hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni baaa mli mra lɛ, ewoɔ mɔ tsui hela; shi kɛji nɔ ni ashweɔ lɛ na ba mli lɛ, ehãa wala.

english_verse: If you reject God's teaching, you will pay the price; if you obey his commands, you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni gbeɔ wiemɔ lɛ he guɔ lɛ, ekpãtãa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hiɛ; shi mɔ ni buɔ kitã lɛ, ebaana he sɛɛ.

english_verse: Sensible instruction is a life-giving fountain that helps you escape all deadly traps.
translation_verse: Nilelɔ nitsɔɔmɔ lɛ, wala nubu ni; ejieɔ mɔ kɛjɛɔ gbele akpa mli.

english_verse: Sound judgment is praised, but people without good sense are on the way to disaster.
translation_verse: Nilee kpakpa hãa mɔ hiɛ baa nyam; shi kutumpɔfoi agbɛ lɛ ekpãtãa amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will act sensibly, but fools act like fools.
translation_verse: Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ hiɛtɛ̃lɔ feɔ enii kɛ nilee; shi kwashia gbɛɔ ebuulufeemɔ eshwãa.

english_verse: Whoever delivers your message can make things better or worse for you.
translation_verse: Tsulɔ fɔŋ lɛ ekɛ mɛi woɔ haomɔ mli; shi bɔfo anɔkwafo lɛ ekɛ toiŋjɔlɛ baa.

english_verse: All who refuse correction will be poor and disgraced; all who accept correction will be praised.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ tsɔsemɔ lɛ ohia kɛ hiɛgbele ji enɔ; shi mɔ ni buɔ kãmɔ lɛ awoɔ ehiɛ nyam.

english_verse: It's a good feeling to get what you want, but only a stupid fool hates to turn from evil.
translation_verse: Kɛji susuma na nɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ, enaa miishɛɛ; shi kwashiai sumɔɔɔ akɛ amɛjeɔ efɔŋ he.

english_verse: Wise friends make you wise, but you hurt yourself by going around with fools.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kɛ nilelɔ nyiɛɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ nilelɔ; shi mɔ ni kɛ kwashiai bɔɔ lɛ eeena jaramɔ.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you sin, but you will be rewarded if you live right.
translation_verse: Eshafeelɔi lɛ efɔŋ nyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ; shi jalɔi lɛ amɛshwereɔ.

english_verse: If you obey God, you will have something to leave your grandchildren. If you don't obey God, those who live right will get what you leave.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ kpakpa shiɔ gboshinii ehãa ebii abii; shi eshafeelɔ nii lɛ jalɔ atiaa ahãa.

english_verse: Even when the land of the poor produces good crops, they get cheated out of what they grow.
translation_verse: Ohiafoi ashikpɔŋ ni kã shi efolo baa niyenii pii; shi jalɛ sane ni ayeee hewɔ lɛ, nii lɛ ŋmɛɔ amɛ.

english_verse: If you love your children, you will correct them; if you don't love them, you won't correct them.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni emiii ni etsɔseɔ ebi kɛ kpãa lɛ, eenyɛ ebi lɛ; shi mɔ ni sumɔɔ ebi lɛ, ejeɔ mra etsɔseɔ lɛ.

english_verse: If you live right, you will have plenty to eat; if you don't live right, you will go away empty.
translation_verse: Jalɔ yɛ nii pii ni eyeɔ etɔɔ; shi mɔ fɔŋ lɛ musuŋ hɔmɔ po yeɔ lɛ.

english_verse: A woman's family is held together by her wisdom, but it can be destroyed by her foolishness.
translation_verse: Yoo nilelɔ kpɛɔ eshĩa; shi yoo kwashia jwaa eshĩa.

english_verse: By living right, you show that you respect the Lord; by being deceitful, you show that you despise him.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ efeɔ jalɛnii; shi mɔ ni gbeɔ Yehowa he guɔ lɛ efeee jalɛ nii.

english_verse: Proud fools are punished for their stupid talk, but sensible talk can save your life.
translation_verse: Buulu daaŋ wiemɔ gwaoɔ lɛ; shi nilelɔ daaŋ wiemɔ baa eyi.

english_verse: Without the help of an ox there can be no crop, but with a strong ox a big crop is possible.
translation_verse: He ni tsina hii bɛ lɛ, niyenii bɛ jɛi; shi he ni tsinanuu hewalɔ yɔɔ lɛ jɛi ŋmãa babaoo yɔɔ.

english_verse: An honest witness tells the truth; a dishonest witness tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Odasefonyo anɔkwafo maleee; shi apasa odasefonyo maleɔ pam.

english_verse: Make fun of wisdom, and you will never find it. But if you have understanding, knowledge comes easily.
translation_verse: Hefɛoyelɔ taoɔ nilee, shi enaaa; shi nilee taomɔ waaa hãaa niiashishinulɔ.

english_verse: Stay away from fools, or you won't learn a thing.
translation_verse: Jee kwashia hiɛ; ejaakɛ onaŋ nilee wiemɔ yɛ edaaŋ.

english_verse: Wise people have enough sense to find their way, but stupid fools get lost.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ ni ehiɛ tɛ̃ lɛ, ele he ni eyaa; shi kwashiai abuulufeemɔ hãa amɛduɔ gbɛ.

english_verse: Fools don't care if they are wrong, but God is pleased when people do right.
translation_verse: Kwashia ebuuu eshafeemɔ akɛ eji nɔ fɔŋ; shi jalɔi tiuɔ eshaifaa sɛɛ.

english_verse: No one else can really know how sad or happy you are.
translation_verse: Tsui pɛ ni le enidɔɔnii; ni nɔ ni ji emiishɛɛ lɛ ekɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko ejaaa.

english_verse: The tent of a good person stands longer than the house of someone evil.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɔŋ we hiɛ aaakpãtã; shi jalɔ we aaashwere.

english_verse: You may think you are on the right road and still end up dead.
translation_verse: Gbɛ ko yɛ ni ja yɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ; shi enaagbee lɛ gbele gbɛ ni.

english_verse: Sorrow may hide behind laughter, and happiness may end in sorrow.
translation_verse: Ŋmɔlɔ mli tete lɛ, tsui werɛ hoɔ ehe; ni miishɛɛ naagbee lɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli baa.

english_verse: You harvest what you plant, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɔŋ lɛ eeena ejeŋba he nyɔmɔwoo; ni mɔ kpakpa lɛ, eeena enifeemɔnii kpakpa he nyɔmɔwoo.

english_verse: Don't be stupid and believe all you hear; be smart and know where you are headed.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ mli kwɔɔɔ heɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ eyeɔ; shi hiɛtɛ̃lɔ leɔ enanenaa kwɛmɔ.

english_verse: Only a stupid fool is never cautious— so be extra careful and stay out of trouble.
translation_verse: Nilelɔ sheɔ ehe gbeyei, ni ewiɔ ehe kɛjeɔ efɔŋ he; shi kwashia feɔ kakampu ni efeɔ anyagbã.

english_verse: Fools have quick tempers, and no one likes you if you can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni mli etsɛɛɛ fumɔ lɛ, efeɔ kwashiaianii, ni yitsofɔŋtsɛ lɛ anyɛɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The wicked will come crawling to those who obey God.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɔ̃ji kotoɔ mɛi kpakpai, ni efɔŋfeelɔi kotoɔ jalɔi yɛ agboi anaa.

english_verse: You have no friends if you are poor, but you have lots of friends if you are rich.
translation_verse: Ohiafo lɛ, enaanyo tete sumɔɔɔ lɛ, shi niiatsɛ lɛ, esuɔlɔi faa babaoo.

english_verse: It's wrong to hate others, but God blesses everyone who is kind to the poor.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni nyaŋeɔ enaanyo lɛ, eshafeelɔ ni; shi mɔ ni feɔ ohiafo ekpakpa lɛ ajɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: It's a mistake to make evil plans, but you will have loyal friends if you want to do right.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ ŋaa fɔŋ lɛ ani jeee tɔ̃ etɔ̃ɔ lɛ lo? Shi mɔ ni toɔ ŋaa kpakpa lɛ, afiɔ esɛɛ, ni ayeɔ lɛ anɔkwa.

english_verse: Hard work is worthwhile, but empty talk will make you poor.
translation_verse: Sɛɛnamɔ yɛ deŋmegbomɔ mli; shi ohia kɛkɛ ji nɔ ni yɔɔ naabu folo wiemɔ mli.

english_verse: Wisdom can make you rich, but foolishness leads to more foolishness.
translation_verse: Nilelɔi akekre ji amɛnilee. Shi kwashiai akekre ji amɛbuulufeemɔ.

english_verse: An honest witness can save your life, but liars can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Anɔkwa odasefonyo lɛ ehereɔ gbɔmɛi ayiwala; shi amalelɔ lɛ mɔsɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ ni.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you and your children have a strong fortress
translation_verse: Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ mli hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni mli wa yɔɔ; ni mɔ ni yɔɔ no lɛ ebii naa abobaahe.

english_verse: and a life-giving fountain that keeps you safe from deadly traps.
translation_verse: Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ lɛ nuhiŋmɛi ni hãa wala ni, ejieɔ mɔ kɛjeɔ gbele tsɔnei amli.

english_verse: Rulers of powerful nations are held in honor; rulers of weak nations are nothing at all.
translation_verse: Maŋbii ayifalɛ ji maŋtsɛ anunyam; shi kɛji maŋbii bɛ lɛ, lumɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ ni.

english_verse: It's smart to be patient, but it's stupid to lose your temper.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni mli fuuu mra lɛ, eyɛ niiashishinumɔ kpele; shi mɔ ni mli fuɔ mramra lɛ ejieɔ ebuulufeemɔ kpo.

english_verse: It's healthy to be content, but envy can eat you up.
translation_verse: Toiŋjɔlɛ hãa gbɔmɔtso naa hewalɛ; shi awuŋayeli woɔ wuiaŋ hela.

english_verse: If you mistreat the poor, you insult your Creator; if you are kind to them, you show him respect.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni waa ohiafo yi lɛ, eebɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ahora; shi mɔ ni naa ohiafo mɔbɔ lɛ, eewo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam.

english_verse: In times of trouble the wicked are destroyed, but even at death the innocent have faith.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɔŋ lɛ, enifɔjianii lɛ nɔŋŋ butuɔ lɛ; shi jalɔ lɛ, ejalɛ ji ebobaahe.

english_verse: Wisdom is found in the minds of people with good sense, but fools don't know it.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yɔɔ niiashishinumɔ lɛ ele nii; shi kwashia lɛ, ebɛ niiashishinumɔ.

english_verse: Doing right brings honor to a nation, but sin brings disgrace.
translation_verse: Jalɛ woɔ maŋ nɔ; shi esha lɛ, maŋ ahorabɔɔ ni.

english_verse: Kings reward servants who act wisely, but they punish those who act foolishly.
translation_verse: Tsulɔ nilelɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ hiɛ sɔɔ lɛ; shi mɔ ni feɔ hiɛgbejianii lɛ, emli fuɔ lɛ.

english_verse: A kind answer soothes angry feelings, but harsh words stir them up.
translation_verse: Naajɔlɛ hetoo kuɔ mlila naa; shi mlila wiemɔ teɔ mlifu shi.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come from the wise, but fools speak foolishness.
translation_verse: Nilelɔi wieɔ nilee wiemɔi; shi buului awiemɔi jɛɔ kwashiai adaaŋ.

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Yehowa hiŋmɛi yɛ he fɛɛ he; ni ekwɛɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji kɛ mɛi kpakpai fɛɛ.

english_verse: Kind words are good medicine, but deceitful words can really hurt.
translation_verse: Naajɔlɛ wiemɔ lɛ walatso ni; shi kutumpɔo wiemɔ lɛ efiteɔ mɔ mumɔ.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and disobey your parents. Be smart! Accept correction.
translation_verse: Kwashia gbeɔ etsɛ tsɔsemɔ he guɔ; shi mɔ ni kpɛlɛ̃ɔ kãmɔ lɛ ehiɛ tɛ̃ɔ.

english_verse: Good people become wealthy, but those who are evil will lose what they have.
translation_verse: Jwetri babaoo yɛ jalɔ we, shi mɔ fɔŋ ninamɔ lɛ, ehiɛ kpãtãa.

english_verse: Words of wisdom make good sense; the thoughts of a fool make no sense at all.
translation_verse: Nilelɔi awiemɔ gbɛɔ nilee shwãa; shi kwashiai anɔ efeee nakai.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted by gifts from the wicked, but it makes him happy when his people pray.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɔ̃ji afɔle lɛ, Yehowa miihi; shi jalɔi asɔlemɔ lɛ, enaa he miishɛɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with all who do wrong, but he loves everyone who does right.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɔŋ jeŋba lɛ, Yehowa miihi; shi mɔ ni tiuɔ jalɛ sɛɛ lɛ, esumɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: If you turn from the right way, you will be punished; if you refuse correction, you will die.
translation_verse: Toigbalamɔ kpele kã shi hã mɔ ni tɔ̃ɔ, ni mɔ ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ kãmɔ lɛ, gbo eeegbo.

english_verse: If the Lord can see everything in the world of the dead, he can see in our hearts.
translation_verse: Gbohiiaje kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ bu lɛ tete po naa kã yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; aahu ni gbɔmɛi adesai atsuii.

english_verse: Those who sneer at others don't like to be corrected, and they won't ask help from someone with sense.
translation_verse: Hefɛoyelɔ yɔɔ nɛɛ, esumɔɔɔ akɛ akãa lɛ; ni ebɛŋkɛɛɛ nilelɔi hu.

english_verse: Anyone with good sense is eager to learn more, but fools are hungry for foolishness.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ ni yɔɔ niiashishinumɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, etiuɔ nilee sɛɛgbɛ; shi kwashiai anaabu tiuɔ buulufeemɔ sɛɛgbɛ.

english_verse: The poor have a hard life, but being content is as good as an endless feast.
translation_verse: Nɔnalɔ gbii fɛɛ lɛ, gbii fɔ̃ji sɔŋŋ ni; shi mɔ ni tsui enyɔ emli lɛ, lɛ lɛ daa nɛɛ eeye gbijurɔ.

english_verse: It's better to obey the Lord and have only a little, than to be very rich and terribly anxious.
translation_verse: Nii fioo ni Yehowa he gbeyeishemɔ yɔɔ he lɛ, ehi fe jwetri babaoo ni haomɔ yɔɔ he.

english_verse: A simple meal with love is better than a feast where there is hatred.
translation_verse: Shwie folo ni akɛŋmɛ okplɔ̃ ni suɔmɔ yɔɔ he lɛ, ehi fe tsina ni ewo fɔ ni nyɛɛ yɔɔ he.

english_verse: Losing your temper causes a lot of trouble, but staying calm settles arguments.
translation_verse: Mlilatsɛ teɔ bei shi; shi mɔ ni mli fuuu mra lɛ, ekpãtãa bei.

english_verse: A lazy person refuses to clear a thorny path, but everyone who does right walks on a smooth road.
translation_verse: Anihaolɔ gbɛ tsaa kɛ ŋmei; shi jalɔ gbɛ lɛ gbɛjegbɛ ni.

english_verse: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children despise them.
translation_verse: Bi nilelɔ hãa etsɛ naa miishɛɛ; shi kwashia gbeɔ enyɛ he guɔ.

english_verse: Stupidity brings happiness to senseless fools, but everyone with good sense follows the straight path.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, buulufeemɔ feɔ lɛ miishɛɛ; shi mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, ebaa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ.

english_verse: Without good advice everything goes wrong— it takes careful planning for things to go right.
translation_verse: He ni ajinatoo bɛ lɛ, yiŋtoi feɔ yaka; shi ŋaawolɔi pii hãa yiŋtoi yeɔ omanye.

english_verse: Giving the right answer at the right time makes everyone happy.
translation_verse: Wiemɔ hetoohãmɔ ni sa lɛ, ehãa mɔ naa miishɛɛ; ni wiemɔ ni awie yɛ be ni sa mli lɛ, ehi pam.

english_verse: All who are wise follow a road that leads upward to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Nilelɔ gbɛ lɛ, wala gbɛ ni kɛ mɔ yaa ŋwɛi ni; ni ejieɔ mɔ kɛjeɔ gbohiiaje bu lɛ mli.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the homes of those who are proud, but he protects the property of widows.
translation_verse: Yehowa wuleɔ hewolɔ we; shi ehãa okulafo husu hiɔ shi.

english_verse: The Lord hates evil thoughts, but kind words please him.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɔ̃ji ayiŋtoi lɛ, Yehowa miihi; shi wiemɔi ni he tse lɛ, enaa he miishɛɛ.

english_verse: Being greedy causes trouble for your family, but you protect yourself by refusing bribes.
translation_verse: Hiɛjoolɔ hãa haomɔ baa ewe nɔ; shi mɔ ni sumɔɔɔ nyɔɔŋnii hemɔ lɛ, eyi aaana wala.

english_verse: Good people think before they answer, but the wicked speak evil without ever thinking.
translation_verse: Jalɔ jwɛŋɔ bɔ ni eeehã sane hetoo ehã; shi wiemɔi gbohii jɛɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji adaaŋ.

english_verse: The Lord never even hears the prayers of the wicked, but he answers the prayers of all who obey him.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji ateŋ jɛkɛ; shi eboɔ jalɔi afaikpamɔ toi.

english_verse: A friendly smile makes you happy, and good news makes you feel strong.
translation_verse: Hiɛtsemɔ kɛ mɔhamɔ lɛ, ehãa mɔ mii shɛɔ ehe; ni sanekpakpa hãa mɔ wuiaŋ woɔ fɔ.

english_verse: Healthy correction is good, and if you accept it, you will be wise.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni boɔ kãmɔ krɔŋŋ toi lɛ, ehiɔ nilelɔi ateŋ.

english_verse: You hurt only yourself by rejecting instruction, but it makes good sense to accept it.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni booo tsɔsemɔ toi lɛ, egbeɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe guɔ; shi mɔ ni boɔ kãmɔ toi lɛ, enaa niiashishinumɔ.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord will make you wise, and being humble will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ ji tsɔsemɔ ni hãa mɔ leɔ nii; ni anunyam yɔɔ nɛɛ heshibaa nyiɛɔ ehiɛ.

english_verse: We humans make plans, but the Lord has the final word.
translation_verse: Yiŋtoo lɛ gbɔmɔ adesa nɔ ni; shi nɔ ni lilɛi wieɔ lɛ, Yehowa ŋɔɔ ejɛɔ.

english_verse: We may think we know what is right, but the Lord is the judge of our motives.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ gbɛi fɛɛ ja yɛ ehiɛ; shi Yehowa lɛ, ekwɛɔ mumɔ ni yɔɔ sɛɛ.

english_verse: Share your plans with the Lord, and you will succeed.
translation_verse: Tuu onitsumɔi owo Yehowa dɛŋ, ni oyiŋtoi aaama shi shiŋŋ.

english_verse: The Lord has a reason for everything he does, and he lets evil people live only to be punished.
translation_verse: Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yehowa fee lɛ, eyɛ nɔ hewɔ ni efee; gbi fɔŋ tete lɛ, ekã shi ehã mɔ fɔŋ.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is conceited— you can be sure they will be punished.
translation_verse: Yehowa miihi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni woɔ ehe; kɛ ata abasa yɛ nɔ po, abaagbala etoi.

english_verse: If we truly love God, our sins will be forgiven; if we show him respect, we will keep away from sin.
translation_verse: Anɔkwayeli nɔ Yehowa damɔɔ ni ekɛ eshai faa; ni mɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ, ewiɔ ehe kɛjeɔ efɔŋ he.

english_verse: When we please the Lord, even our enemies make friends with us.
translation_verse: Kɛji gbɔmɔ adesa jeŋba sa Yehowa hiɛ lɛ, ehãa ehenyɛlɔi tete kɛ lɛ kpãtãa.

english_verse: It's better to be honest and poor than to be dishonest and rich.
translation_verse: Nii fioo ni ana yɛ anɔkwayeli mli lɛ, ehi fe nii babaoo ni atsɔ̃ gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ ana.

english_verse: We make our own plans, but the Lord decides where we will go.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ adesa toɔ egbɛi ahe ŋaa; shi Yehowa ji mɔ ni kudɔɔ enanefãamɔi.

english_verse: Rulers speak with authority and are never wrong.
translation_verse: Ŋwɛi hewalɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ wiemɔ mli; ni maŋtsɛ naa kpaaa yɛ atɛŋbuu mli.

english_verse: The Lord watches to see if we are fair or if we cheat others.
translation_verse: Nsɛni kɛ nsɛnitɛ ni yɔɔ shishiishi lɛ, Yehowa nii ni; ni kotoku lɛ mli nsɛnitɛi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, enitsumɔnii ni.

english_verse: Justice makes rulers powerful. They should hate evil
translation_verse: Eji nihiinii akɛ maŋtsɛ aaafee efɔŋ; ejaakɛ jalɛ ni hãa maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i maa shi shiŋŋ.

english_verse: An angry ruler can put you to death. So be wise! Don't make one angry.
translation_verse: Kɛji maŋtsɛ mli fu lɛ, gbele aaanyɛ ajɛ mli aba; shi nilelɔ jɔɔ maŋtsɛ tsui he.

english_verse: When a ruler is happy and pleased with you, it's like refreshing rain, and you will live.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ hiɛ ni etseɔ ehãa mɔ lɛ, no mli wala yɔɔ, ni emɔhetsuinamɔ tamɔ atatu ni nɛɔ gbo nu.

english_verse: It's much better to be wise and sensible than to be rich.
translation_verse: Kɛji ole nii lɛ ehi aahu fe shika; ni kɛji oyɛ niiashishinumɔ lɛ, ehi fe jwiɛtɛi.

english_verse: God's people avoid evil ways, and they protect themselves by watching where they go.
translation_verse: Jalɔi agbɛ gbaa kɛjeɔ efɔŋ he; mɔ ni kwɛɔ ejeŋba jogbaŋŋ lɛ, ebaa ewala yi.

english_verse: Too much pride will destroy you.
translation_verse: Hewoo tsɔ̃ɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ hiɛ; ni hetsɔ̃ɔmɔ mumɔ tsɔ̃ɔ shigbeemɔ hiɛ.

english_verse: You are better off to be humble and poor than to get rich from what you take by force.
translation_verse: Ehi akɛ ohi shi akɛ humi yɛ ohiafoi ateŋ, fe nɔ ni okɛ hewolɔi aaaja nomŋɔɔnii.

english_verse: If you know what you're doing, you will prosper. God blesses everyone who trusts him.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yeɔ Yehowa wiemɔ nɔ lɛ, eeeshwere; ni mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ lɛ, enaa miishɛɛ.

english_verse: Good judgment proves that you are wise, and if you speak kindly, you can teach others.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni le nii lɛ, atsɛɔ lɛ hiɛtɛ̃lɔ; ni wiemɔ ni ŋɔɔ lɛ, no tsakeɔ mɔ jwɛŋmɔ.

english_verse: Good sense is a fountain that gives life, but fools are punished by their foolishness.
translation_verse: Nilee lɛ wala nubu ni hã nilelɔ; shi mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ buulu nii lɛ, eefee kwashiaianii.

english_verse: You can persuade others if you are wise and speak sensibly.
translation_verse: Nilelɔ susuɔ nii ahe dani ewieɔ, ni ehãa ewiemɔ ŋɔɔ mɔ naa.

english_verse: Kind words are like honey— they cheer you up and make you feel strong.
translation_verse: Naajɔlɛ wiemɔ lɛ, etamɔ wo agbaku; eŋɔɔ susuma naa, ni ehãa gbɔmɔtso hewalɛ.

english_verse: Sometimes what seems right is really a road to death.
translation_verse: Gbɛ ko yɛ ni ja yɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ; shi enaagbee lɛ gbele gbɛ ni.

english_verse: Worthless people plan trouble. Even their words burn like a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Yakagbɔmɔ toɔ efɔŋfeemɔ he ŋaa fɔŋ, ni edaaŋ wiemɔ shãa mɔ tamɔ la.

english_verse: Gossip is no good! It causes hard feelings and comes between friends.
translation_verse: Kutumpɔfo gbɛɔ bei eshwãa, ni oshekuyelɔ tserɛɔ nanemɛi ateŋ.

english_verse: Don't trust violent people. They will mislead you to do the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Basabasafeelɔ lakaa ehe gbɔmɔ, ni ekpalaa lɛ kɛyaa gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ.

english_verse: When someone winks or grins behind your back, trouble is on the way.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni bɛɔ mɔ hiŋmɛi lɛ, etoɔ yiŋ fɔŋ; ni mɔ ni kɔ̃ɔ enaa ablafa lɛ, ehãa efɔŋ baa mli.

english_verse: Gray hair is a glorious crown worn by those who have lived right.
translation_verse: Waŋ lɛ, anunyam akekre ni; jalɛ shihilɛ mli pɛ anaa yɛ.

english_verse: Controlling your temper is better than being a hero who captures a city.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni mli fuuu mra lɛ ehi fe kãkãlɔ; ni mɔ ni yeɔ emumɔ nɔ lɛ, ehi fe mɔ ni yeɔ maŋ nɔ kunim.

english_verse: We make our own decisions, but the Lord alone determines what happens.
translation_verse: Afɔ̃ɔ oshiki kɛtaoɔ nii anaa; shi bɔ ni eeetamɔ lɛ, Yehowa ji mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: A dry crust of bread eaten in peace and quiet is better than a feast eaten where everyone argues.
translation_verse: Atrɔma gbiŋ ni toiŋjɔlɛ yɔɔ he lɛ, ehi fe niyenii kpɔtɔɔ ni yɔɔ shĩa ni bei yɔɔ mli lɛ mli.

english_verse: A wise slave will be placed in charge of a no-good child, and that slave will be given the same inheritance that each child receives.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋ ni le nii lɛ, eeeye bi ni feɔ hiɛgbejianii lɛ nɔ; ni eeena gboshinii lɛ eko tamɔ musuŋbi lɛ.

english_verse: Silver and gold are tested by flames of fire; our thoughts are tested by the Lord.
translation_verse: Akɛ kukwɛi kaa jwiɛtɛi akwɛɔ, ni akɛ flɔnɔɔ kaa shika; shi gbɔmɔ tsui lɛ Yehowa ji mɔ ni kaa ekwɛɔ.

english_verse: Troublemakers listen to troublemakers, and liars listen to liars.
translation_verse: Efɔŋfeelɔi boɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji awiemɔ toi, ni amalelɔ kaa etoi ehãa wiemɔi ni fiteɔ mɔ.

english_verse: By insulting the poor, you insult your Creator. You will be punished if you make fun of someone in trouble.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yeɔ ohiafo he fɛo lɛ, eebɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ni bɔ ohiafo lɛ ahora; ni mɔ ni naa miishɛɛ yɛ mɔ ko amanehulu he lɛ, eyeŋ ehe.

english_verse: Grandparents are proud of their grandchildren, and children should be proud of their parents.
translation_verse: Hiimeji akekre ji amɛnabii; ni bii ahiɛnyam ji amɛtsɛmɛi.

english_verse: It sounds strange for a fool to talk sensibly, but it's even worse for a ruler to tell lies.
translation_verse: Wiemɔ ni bɛ hiŋmɛi nɔ esaaa kwashia po, aahu ni apasa wiemɔ aaasa ablade.

english_verse: A bribe works miracles like a magic charm that brings good luck.
translation_verse: Nyɔɔŋnihamɔ yɛ mɔ ni hãa lɛ hiɛ lɛ, etamɔ ashwã awuja; ni he fɛɛ he ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, efeɔ lɛ akɛ ebaashwere.

english_verse: You will keep your friends if you forgive them, but you will lose your friends if you keep talking about what they did wrong.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kɛ tɔ̃mɔ faa lɛ, lɛ ehãa naanyobɔɔ mli waa; shi mɔ ni niɔ sane he lɛ, efiteɔ shieŋtsɛmɛi ateŋ.

english_verse: A sensible person accepts correction, but you can't beat sense into a fool.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kɔɔ sane sɛɛ lɛ, enuɔ kãmɔ he fe kwashia ni amãmɔ lɛ atswɛrɛi oha.

english_verse: Cruel people want to rebel, and so vicious attackers will be sent against them.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ atuatsemɔ pɛ amɛtaoɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, tsulɔ ni yitsoŋ wa atsuɔ kɛyaninaa amɛ.

english_verse: A bear robbed of her cubs is far less dangerous than a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Ehi akɛ gbɔmɔ kɛ oshishibrishi yoo ni amɔ ebi akpe, fe nɔ ni ekɛ kwashia moŋ aaakpe yɛ ebuulufeemɔ mli.

english_verse: You will always have trouble if you are mean to those who are good to you.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kɛ efɔŋ toɔ ekpakpa najiaŋ lɛ, efɔŋ kpaŋ yɛ ewe.

english_verse: The start of an argument is like a water leak— so stop it before real trouble breaks out.
translation_verse: Beibɔ̃imɔ lɛ etamɔ nu ni miitsere kɔikɔi; no hewɔ lɛ, be ni naataamɔ mli wako nɛɛ lɛ, ŋmɛɛmɔ he.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like those who defend the guilty or condemn the innocent.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni buɔ efɔŋfeelɔ bem, kɛ mɔ ni buɔ jalɔ fɔ lɛ, Yehowa miihi amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Why should fools have money for an education when they refuse to learn?
translation_verse: Mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ kwashia baana, kɛji ekɛ shika yahe nilee; ejaakɛ ebɛ yitsoŋ.

english_verse: A friend is there to help, in any situation, and relatives are born to share our troubles.
translation_verse: Naanyo sumɔɔ mɔ be fɛɛ be; ni nyɛmi hu fimɔ be hewɔ ni afɔ lɛ.

english_verse: It's stupid to guarantee someone else's loan.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni bɛ yitsoŋ lɛ, lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɔ nɔ akɛ eeedamɔ enaanyo sɛɛ.

english_verse: The wicked and the proud love trouble and keep begging to be hurt.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni sumɔɔ eshafeemɔ lɛ, esumɔɔ bei; ni mɔ ni yɔɔ pupuupu lɛ, ejieɔ amane.

english_verse: Dishonesty does you no good, and telling lies will get you in trouble.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ fɔŋ lɛ, ehiŋ haŋ lɛ; ni mɔ ni yeɔ kutumpɔo lɛ egbeɔ haomɔ mli.

english_verse: It's never pleasant to be the parent of a fool and have nothing but pain.
translation_verse: Bi kwashia lɛ eji awerɛho kɛhã etsɛ; ni tsɛ ni efɔ bi kwashia lɛ enaaa miishɛɛ ko.

english_verse: If you are cheerful, you feel good; if you are sad, you hurt all over.
translation_verse: Tsuijurɔ lɛ tsofa kpakpa ni; shi ŋkɔmɔyeli lɛ egbeɔ mɔ blɛoo.

english_verse: Crooks accept secret bribes to keep justice from being done.
translation_verse: Efɔŋfeelɔ heɔ nyɔɔŋnii koni etsɔ̃ jalɛ hiɛ ebu shi.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom knows what makes good sense, but fools can never make up their minds.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yɔɔ niiashishinumɔ lɛ, etiuɔ nilee sɛɛgbɛ, shi kwashia woɔ ehiɛ emaa he fɛɛ he.

english_verse: Foolish children bring sorrow and pain to their parents.
translation_verse: Bi kwashia lɛ etsɛ awerɛho ji lɛ; ni eji tsuiyeli hã enyɛ ni fɔ lɛ.

english_verse: It isn't fair to punish the innocent and those who do right.
translation_verse: Ehiii akɛ agbala jalɔ toi aloo ayi ablade yɛ jalɛ sane hewɔ.

english_verse: It makes a lot of sense to be a person of few words and to stay calm.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni wiemɔ faaa lɛ ele nii, ni mɔ ni mumɔ he jɔ lɛ, enuɔ nii ashishi.

english_verse: It's selfish and stupid to think only of yourself and to sneer at people who have sense.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni tseɔ ehe kɛjeɔ mɛi ahe lɛ, lɛ pɛ enɔ mli efoɔ; ni jalɛ sane ko bɛ ni abaawie ni ebaaŋɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Fools have no desire to learn, instead they would rather give their own opinion.
translation_verse: Kwashia naaa mɛi ashishinumɔ he miishɛɛ, fe akɛ eeewie nɔ ni etsui kɛɔ lɛ kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Wrongdoing leads to shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Be ni efɔŋfeemɔ baa lɛ, heguɔgbee hu miiba.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are a stream that flows from a deep fountain.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ daaŋ wiemɔ lɛ nubu ni mli kwɔ ni; nilee hu tamɔ nuhiŋmɛi ni tueɔ.

english_verse: It's wrong to favor the guilty and keep the innocent from getting justice.
translation_verse: Ehiii akɛ akwɛ efɔŋfeelɔ hiɛ ni abu lɛ bem, aloo atsɔ̃ jalɔ sane hiɛ abu shi.

english_verse: Foolish talk will get you into a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Kwashia daaŋ wiemɔ woɔ bei; ni ewiemɔ hãa ayiɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Saying foolish things is like setting a trap to destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Kwashia daaŋ wiemɔ kpãtãa ehiɛ, ni ewiemɔ nɔŋŋ duɔ lɛ tamɔ tsɔne.

english_verse: There's nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Ablɛbiwielɔ wiemɔ ŋɔɔ tamɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔnii; ekpelekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbɔmɔ musuŋ tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: Being lazy is no different from being a troublemaker.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kɛ enitsumɔ shashaoɔ shi lɛ, nifitelɔ nyɛmi ni.

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty tower where his people can run for safety—
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ni wa ji Yehowa gbɛi lɛ, ni no mli jalɔ shaa foi kɛyaa, ni ehiɔ shi shweshweeshwe.

english_verse: the rich think their money is a wall of protection.
translation_verse: Niiatsɛ nii ni eyɔɔ lɛ ji emɔɔ ni wa; ni etamɔ gbogbo grɔŋŋ ni buɔ ehe?

english_verse: Pride leads to destruction; humility leads to honor.
translation_verse: Henɔwomɔ tsɔ̃ɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ hiɛ; shi heshibaa tsɔ̃ɔ hiɛnyam hiɛ.

english_verse: It's stupid and embarrassing to give an answer before you listen.
translation_verse: Bo sane toi jogbaŋŋ dani ohã hetoo, kɛjee nakai lɛ, obaafee kwashia kɛ buulu.

english_verse: Being cheerful helps when you are sick, but nothing helps when you give up.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ mli ekãa hãa enyɛɔ hela naa edamɔɔ; shi mumɔ ni egbɔjɔ lɛ, mɛni no aaanyɛ etsu?

english_verse: Everyone with good sense wants to learn.
translation_verse: Jwɛŋmɔ ni hiɛ kã shi naa nilee; ni nilelɔ toi tiuɔ nilee sɛɛgbɛ.

english_verse: A gift will get you in to see anyone.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ dɛŋ nikee jeɔ gbɛ hãa lɛ; ni ekɛ lɛ yaa mɛi wuji ahiɛ.

english_verse: Drawing straws is one way to settle a difficult case.
translation_verse: Oshikifɔ̃ɔ hãa bei sɛɛ foɔ, ni ebuɔ atɛŋ ehãa kãkãlɔi ni peleɔ nɔ ko he.

english_verse: Making up with a friend you have offended is harder than breaking through a city wall.
translation_verse: Kɛ ofee onyɛmi ekpakpa lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ maŋ ni wa ehãa bo; shi kɛji okɛ lɛ be lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ agbo sɛɛ adabãŋ ehãa bo.

english_verse: Make your words good— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ daaŋ wiemɔ woɔ yibii hãa lɛ; ni edaaŋ wiemɔ hãa etɔɔ.

english_verse: Words can bring death or life! Talk too much, and you will eat everything you say.
translation_verse: Gbele kɛ wala yɛ gbɔmɔ lilɛi dɛŋ; amɛteŋ nɔ ni gbɔmɔ sumɔɔ lɛ no eŋɔɔ.

english_verse: A man's greatest treasure is his wife— she is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni naa ŋa lɛ, ena nɔ kpakpa, ni ehiɛ baa nyam yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: The poor must beg for help, but the rich can give a harsh reply.
translation_verse: Ohiafo lɛ fai ekpaa kɛ naajɔlɛ; shi niiatsɛ lɛ ewieɔ kpɛŋkpɛŋ.

english_verse: Some friends don't help, but a true friend is closer than your own family.
translation_verse: Nanemɛi komɛi yɛ ni amɛfeɔ amɛnii oookɛɛ nanemɛi ji amɛ; shi naanyo krɔŋŋ lɛ ekpɛtɛɔ mɔ gbãgbãlii fe nyɛmi tete.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right than to be a stupid liar.
translation_verse: Ohiafo anɔkwafo lɛ, ehi fe kwashia kutumpɔfo.

english_verse: Willingness and stupidity don't go well together. If you are too eager, you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Shwe ni ashweɔ nɔ ko ni nilee bɛ mli lɛ ehiii; ni mɔ ni nyiɛɔ kplakpla lɛ eduɔ gbɛ.

english_verse: We are ruined by our own stupidity, though we blame the Lord.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ buulufeemɔ kɛ lɛ woɔ haomɔ mli, ni eshwaa Yehowa moŋ.

english_verse: The rich have many friends; the poor have none.
translation_verse: Ninamɔ hãa anaa nanemɛi pii; shi ohiafo lɛ enaanyo tete tsiɔ ehe yɛ ehe.

english_verse: Dishonest witnesses and liars won't escape punishment.
translation_verse: Amale odasefonyo yeŋ ehe; ni amalelɔ he ejeŋ sane mli.

english_verse: Everyone tries to be friends of those who can help them.
translation_verse: Mɛi pii taoɔ yelikɛbuamɔ kɛjɛɔ mlijɔlɔ dɛŋ; ni mɔ ni dɛŋ kpɔɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ naanyo ni.

english_verse: If you are poor, your own relatives reject you, and your friends are worse. When you really need them, they are not there.
translation_verse: Ohiafo nyɛmimɛi tete nyɛɔ lɛ; enyiɛ nɔŋŋ ni enanemɛi tsiŋ amɛhe kɛyaŋ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ? Enyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ kɛ wiemɔ, shi amɛfooo mli.

english_verse: Do yourself a favor by having good sense— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni sumɔɔ nilee lɛ, esumɔɔ ehe; ni mɔ ni sumɔɔ niiashishinumɔ lɛ eshwereɔ.

english_verse: Dishonest witnesses and liars will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Amale odasefonyo yeŋ ehe; ni amalelɔ hiɛ aaakpãtã.

english_verse: It's wise to be patient and show what you are like by forgiving others.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ mlifũuu mra; ni ehiɛ ni ekuɔ efɔ̃ɔ tɔ̃mɔ nɔ lɛ woɔ ehiɛ nyam.

english_verse: An angry king roars like a lion, but when a king is pleased, it's like dew on the crops.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ mlifu tamɔ jata huumɔ; shi kɛ ena mɔ he tsui lɛ, etamɔ bɔ ni jwere jwɛi nɔ.

english_verse: Foolish children bring disgrace to their fathers. A nagging wife goes on and on like the drip, drip, drip of the rain.
translation_verse: Bi kwashia lɛ ekpãtãa etsɛ hiɛ; ni yoo beilɔ lɛ etamɔ tsu yiteŋ nu ni tsereɔ kɔikɔi eshwieɔ shi.

english_verse: You may inherit all you own from your parents, but a sensible wife is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Shĩa kɛ nii lɛ, fɔlɔi ni gboɔ shiɔ hãa mɔ; shi yoo nilelɔ lɛ, Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛɔ.

english_verse: If you are lazy and sleep your time away, you will starve.
translation_verse: Anihaofeemɔ hãa wɔ ni tsii nyɔɔ mɔ nɔ; ni hejɔ̃lɔ lɛ, hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Obey the Lord's teachings and you will live— disobey and you will die.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yeɔ kitã lɛ nɔ lɛ, ebaa ewala yi; shi mɔ ni kwaa wiemɔ lɛ, eeegbo.

english_verse: Caring for the poor is lending to the Lord, and you will be well repaid.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni naa ohiafo mɔbɔ lɛ, ekɛ miifa Yehowa; ni ejurɔ ni efee lɛ, Yehowa aaato lɛ najiaŋ kɛteke nɔ.

english_verse: Correct your children before it's too late; if you don't punish them, trouble will come their way.
translation_verse: Tsɔsemɔ obi egbekɛbiiashi be ni hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɔɔ lɛ; shi ekaba oyiŋ akɛ oookpãtã ehiɛ.

english_verse: People with bad tempers are always in trouble, and they need help over and over again.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni mlifu naa wa lɛ, enaa he nyɔmɔwoo; kɛji ojie lɛ kɛje haomɔ kome mli lɛ, ebaabote ekroko hu mli.

english_verse: Pay attention to advice and accept correction, so you can live sensibly.
translation_verse: Bo ŋaawoo toi, ni okpɛ̃lɛ tsɔsemɔ koni wɔsɛɛ lɛ, ole nii.

english_verse: We may make a lot of plans, but the Lord will do what he has decided.
translation_verse: Yiŋtoi pii yɛ gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔŋ; shi nɔ ni Yehowa eto lɛ, no baa mli obɔ̃.

english_verse: What matters most is loyalty. It's better to be poor than to be a liar.
translation_verse: Anɔkwayeli ataoɔ yɛ gbɔmɔ dɛŋ; ni ohiafo hi fe amalelɔ.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord brings true life— if you do it, you can relax without fear of danger.
translation_verse: Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ kɛ mɔ yaa wala mli, ni mɔ ni yɔɔ enɛ lɛ etsui tɔɔ; efɔŋ ko baŋ enɔ.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to lift a hand to feed themselves.
translation_verse: Anihaolɔ kɛ enine tĩɔ nii yɛ kã mli, ni emiii po ni ekɛ enine lɛ woɔ edaaŋ tete.

english_verse: Stupid fools learn good sense by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being corrected.
translation_verse: Tswaa hefɛoyelɔ nɔ, ni mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ esako lɛ eeekase nɔ ko yɛŋ. Kã mɔ ni yɔɔ niiashishinumɔ hiɛ, ni eeele nii.

english_verse: If you stop learning, you will forget what you already know.
translation_verse: Mibi, tsɔsemɔ ni hãa aduɔ gbɛ kɛjeɔ nilee he lɛ, kpa toiboo.

english_verse: A lying witness makes fun of the court system, and criminals think crime is really delicious.
translation_verse: Odasefonyo fɔŋ ŋmɔɔ jalɛ saneyeli; ni efɔŋfeelɔ naabu nyaa nɔ fɔŋ he.

english_verse: A stupid fool should expect to be punished.
translation_verse: Fɔbuu kã shi hã hefɛoyelɔi; ni kpãa hu kã shi hã kwashiai akotosɛɛ.

english_verse: It isn't smart to get drunk! Drinking makes a fool of you and leads to fights.
translation_verse: Wain lɛ hefɛoyelɔ ni, ni dãa ni wa lɛ hoofeelɔ ni; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni dãa hãa eduɔ gbɛ lɛ, eleee nii.

english_verse: An angry ruler is like a roaring lion— make either one angry, and you are dead.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ mlifu ni naawa lɛ etamɔ jata huumɔ; mɔ ni woɔ maŋtsɛ mlifu lɛ, ewala ŋmɛɔ lɛ.

english_verse: It makes you look good when you avoid a fight— only fools love to quarrel.
translation_verse: Eji hiɛ nyam kɛhã nuu kɛji enyaaa bei he; shi kwashia fɛɛ kwashia lɛ, bei ebeɔ.

english_verse: If you are too lazy to plow, don't expect a harvest.
translation_verse: Hejɔ̃lɔ ni huuu yɛ humɔ be mli lɛ, nikpamɔ be mli lɛ enaŋ nɔ ko ekpa.

english_verse: Someone's thoughts may be as deep as the ocean, but if you are smart, you will discover them.
translation_verse: Adesa yiŋtoo mlikwɔ tamɔ nubu, shi nilelɔ jieɔ yiŋtoi lɛ kpo.

english_verse: There are many who say, “You can trust me!” But can they be trusted?
translation_verse: Mɛi babaoo tsɛɔ amɛhe anɔkwafoi; shi anɔkwafo lɛ namɔ yoɔ lɛ?

english_verse: Good people live right, and God blesses the children who follow their example.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ ni ji jalɔ ni eye emuu lɛ ajɔɔ eshwiei.

english_verse: When rulers decide cases, they weigh the evidence.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ ni taa kojomɔ sɛi nɔ lɛ, enaa efɔŋ fɛɛ efɔŋ.

english_verse: Can any of us really say, “My thoughts are pure, and my sins are gone”?
translation_verse: Namɔ aaanyɛ akɛɛ akɛ, “Mi lɛ, mitsuu mitsui he, ni esha ko be mihe?”

english_verse: Two things the Lord hates are dishonest scales and dishonest measures.
translation_verse: Nsɛnitɛi srɔtoi kɛ susumɔ nii srɔtoi lɛ Yehowa miihi fɛɛ.

english_verse: The good or bad that children do shows what they are like.
translation_verse: Gbekɛbii tete hãa akɛ amɛnifeemɔnii yoɔ amɛ, nifeemɔnii lɛ he tse jio, eja jio.

english_verse: If you sleep all the time, you will starve; if you get up and work, you will have enough food.
translation_verse: Wɔ akaŋɔɔ onaa, kɛjeee nakai lɛ obaaye ohia. Gbelemɔ ohiŋmɛii, ni ooona nii oye otɔ.

english_verse: Sensible words are better than gold or jewels.
translation_verse: Shika kɛ ojarawatɛi babaoo yɛ; shi nilee wiemɔ lɛ tɛ̃ŋlɛ̃o ni.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni damɔɔ gbɔ sɛɛ lɛ, hã ekɛ etade ato bo awaba; ni mɔ ni damɔɔ maŋsɛɛnyo sɛɛ lɛ, hã ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe ato awaba.

english_verse: The food you get by cheating may taste delicious, but it turns to gravel.
translation_verse: Ŋmaa ni akɛ kutumpɔo na lɛ eŋɔɔ; shi kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ daaŋ yiɔ tɔ kɛ ŋmlitsa.

english_verse: Be sure you have sound advice before making plans or starting a war.
translation_verse: Ŋaawoo akɛtoɔ yiŋ, ni nilee akɛwuɔ ta.

english_verse: Stay away from gossips— they tell everything.
translation_verse: Sanetãlɔ lɛ, ejieɔ teemɔŋ saji akpo; no hewɔ lɛ, okɛ naa blɛblɛtsɛ akabɔ.

english_verse: Children who curse their parents will go to the land of darkness long before their time.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni lomɔɔ etsɛ loo enyɛ lɛ, ewala sɛɛ foɔ tamɔ kane ni agbe yɛ duŋ kpii mli.

english_verse: Getting rich quick may turn out to be a curse.
translation_verse: Gboshinii ni ana lɛ gidigidi yɛ shishijee mli lɛ, jɔɔmɔ baaa nɔ yɛ naagbee mli.

english_verse: Don't try to get even. Trust the Lord, and he will help you.
translation_verse: Kaakɛɛ akɛ, “Matɔ efɔŋ he owele.” Mɛɛ Yehowa, ni eeeye ebua bo.

english_verse: The Lord hates dishonest scales and dishonest weights. So don't cheat!
translation_verse: Nsɛnitɛi ni shɛɛɛ lɛ Yehowa miihi. Shishiumɔ nsɛnii ehiii.

english_verse: How can we know what will happen to us when the Lord alone decides?
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ nanefaamɔi lɛ Yehowa dɛŋ eyɔɔ; te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni eeele nɔ ni yɔɔ egbɛ nɔ hu?

english_verse: A wise ruler severely punishes every criminal.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ nilelɔ shaa efɔŋfeelɔi amli, ni ekɛ shwiili nane tsɔ̃ɔ amɛnɔ kɛgbɛlɛɔ amɛ.

english_verse: Our inner thoughts are a lamp from the Lord, and they search our hearts.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ mumɔ ni yɔɔ emli lɛ, Yehowa kane ni; ni ekpaa gbɔmɔ mligbɛ fɛɛ ekwɛɔ.

english_verse: Rulers are protected by God's mercy and loyalty, but they must be merciful for their kingdoms to last.
translation_verse: Anɔkwayeli baa maŋtsɛ yi, ni jalɛ saneyeli hãa emaŋtsɛ sɛi maa shi shiŋŋ.

english_verse: Young people take pride in their strength, but the gray hairs of wisdom are even more beautiful.
translation_verse: Oblahii anunyam ji amɛhewalɛ; shi hiimeji ahefɛo ji amɛyiteŋ waŋ lɛ.

english_verse: A severe beating can knock all of the evil out of you!
translation_verse: Yii pilamɔ fala lɛ etsumɔɔ esha; ni kpãa yii hu tsuɔ tsui mli fɛɛ.

english_verse: The Lord controls rulers, just as he determines the course of rivers.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ tsui lɛ etamɔ faa ni hoɔ yɛ Yehowa dɛŋ. Etsɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ bɔ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esumɔɔ.

english_verse: We may think we are doing the right thing, but the Lord always knows what is in our hearts.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ gbɛ fɛɛ gbɛ ja yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ; shi Yehowa lɛ, lɛ lɛ, tsui mli ekwɛɔ.

english_verse: Doing what is right and fair pleases the Lord more than an offering.
translation_verse: Jalɛ saneyeli kɛ kojomɔ kpakpa lɛ, esa Yehowa hiɛ fe afɔleshãa.

english_verse: Evil people are proud and arrogant, but sin is the only crop they produce.
translation_verse: Henɔwomɔ kɛ hewoo tsui lɛ, efɔŋfeelɔi akane ni, ni esha ni.

english_verse: If you plan and work hard, you will have plenty; if you hurry to get rich, you will end up poor.
translation_verse: Hiɛshikãlɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ ekɛ shweremɔ baa; shi mɔ ni kɛ hejojomɔ feɔ nɔ lɛ, ekɛ ohia baa.

english_verse: Cheating to get rich is a foolish dream and no less than suicide.
translation_verse: Jwetri ni akɛ lakamɔ na lɛ, lamɔ ni hoɔ ni, ni gbele taomɔ ni.

english_verse: You destroy yourself by being cruel and violent and refusing to live right.
translation_verse: Efɔŋfeelɔi anifeemɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ, no nɔŋŋ kpãtãa amɛhiɛ; ejaakɛ amɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ ni amɛfee nɔ ni ja.

english_verse: All crooks are liars, but anyone who is innocent will do right.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni eye fɔ lɛ, lɛ lɛ, egbɛ ejaaa; shi bemyelɔ lɛ, lɛ egbɛ ja.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Faŋ nɔ ni oyahi tsu yiteŋ kpokplobiiaŋ, fe nɔ ni okɛ yoo beilɔ aaahi shĩa komeŋ.

english_verse: Evil people want to do wrong, even to their friends.
translation_verse: Yiwalɔi nyaa efɔŋfeemɔ he, amɛnanemɛi po anii efeee amɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: An ignorant fool learns by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being instructed.
translation_verse: Kɛ agbala hefɛoyelɔ toi lɛ, mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ esako kaseɔ nii kɛjɛɔ mli; ni kɛ atsɔ̃ɔ nilelɔ nii lɛ, eleɔ nii.

english_verse: God is always fair! He knows what the wicked do and will punish them.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔjalɔ lɛ, enaa nɔ ni yaa nɔ yɛ mɔ fɔŋ we; etsiɔ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ etswaa shi, ni ekpãtãa ehiɛ.

english_verse: If you won't help the poor, don't expect to be heard when you cry out for help.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni tsimɔɔ etoi ni ekanu ohiafo blɔmɔ lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, eeebolɔ ni aboŋ lɛ toi.

english_verse: A secret bribe will save you from someone's fierce anger.
translation_verse: Teemɔŋ nikeenii kpãtãa mlifu; ni nikeenii ni jɛ tsui mli hu kuɔ mlila ni naa wa naa.

english_verse: When justice is done, good citizens are glad and crooks are terrified.
translation_verse: Kɛ aye jalɛ sane lɛ, jalɔi naa miishɛɛ; shi edɔɔ efɔŋfeelɔi.

english_verse: If you stop using good sense, you will find yourself in the grave.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kɔɔɔ sane sɛɛ lɛ, enaagbeehe ji gbohiiaje; eeeyahi gbohii agwabɔɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: Heavy drinkers and others who live only for pleasure will lose all they have.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni daaŋ ŋɔɔ lɛ, ni eyeɔ pɔkũu nii lɛ, ohĩa hiaa lɛ; ni mɔ ni sumɔɔ wain lɛ, enaŋ nii.

english_verse: God's people will escape, but all who are wicked will pay the price.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ fɔŋ lɛ, jalɔ kpɔ̃mɔnii ni; ni kutumpɔfo lɛ, mɔ ni eye emuu kpɔ̃mɔnii ni.

english_verse: It's better out in the desert than at home with a nagging, complaining wife.
translation_verse: Faŋ nɔ ni oyahi shiaŋa nɔ moŋ fe nɔ ni okɛ yoo beilɔ yrɛdɛɛ aaahi shi.

english_verse: Be sensible and store up precious treasures— don't waste them like a fool.
translation_verse: Abaa jwetri ni jara wa kɛ mu yi yɛ nilelɔ we; shi kwashia lɛ, kpãtãmɔ ekpãtãa hiɛ.

english_verse: If you try to be kind and good, you will be blessed with life and goodness and honor.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni nyiɛɔ jalɛ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ sɛɛ lɛ, enaa wala kɛ hiɛnyam.

english_verse: One wise person can defeat a city full of soldiers and capture their fortress.
translation_verse: Nilelɔ kwɔɔ kãkãlɔi amaŋ he gbogbo, ni ekumɔɔ mɔɔ ni amɛhiɛ kã nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Watching what you say can save you a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni mɔɔ enaabu kɛ elilɛi mli lɛ, ejieɔ ehe kɛjeɔ haomɔ mli.

english_verse: If you are proud and conceited, everyone will say, “You're a snob!”
translation_verse: Mɔ ni woɔ ehe, ni etsɛɔ ehe, ni etsɔ̃ɔ ehe lɛ, atsɛɔ lɛ “hefɛoyelɔ.”

english_verse: If you want too much and are too lazy to work, it could be fatal.
translation_verse: Anihaolɔ nitaomɔnii gbeɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ eniji ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ nitsumɔ.

english_verse: But people who obey God are always generous.
translation_verse: Daa gbi lɛ, mɔ fɔŋ hiɛ miikɔ̃ nii nɔ; shi jalɔ lɛ ehãa, ni ekãmãaa.

english_verse: The Lord despises the offerings of wicked people with evil motives.
translation_verse: Efɔŋfeelɔ afɔle lɛ, nihiinii ni; blɔblɔ ni ekɛba kɛ yiŋsha.

english_verse: If you tell lies in court, you are done for; only a reliable witness can do the job.
translation_verse: Amale odasefonyo hiɛ aaakpãtã; shi wiemɔ ni jɛɔ mɔ ni nu sane daaŋ lɛ, ehiɔ shi daa.

english_verse: Wicked people bluff their way, but God's people think before they take a step.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɔŋ kwaa ehãhãa ehiɛ, shi jalɔ toɔ egbɛjianɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: No matter how much you know or what plans you make, you can't defeat the Lord.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ nilee loo eniiashishinumɔ, loo eŋaawoo ko bɛ ni kɛ Yehowa nɔ lɛ aaafu daa.

english_verse: Even if your army has horses ready for battle, the Lord will always win.
translation_verse: Asaa okpɔŋɔ atoɔ tawuu gbi; shi kunimyeli lɛ, Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛɔ.

english_verse: Teach your children right from wrong, and when they are grown they will still do right.
translation_verse: Tsɔsemɔ gbekɛ bɔ ni eba ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ ehã, ni edalɛ mli lɛ etsakeŋ.

english_verse: The poor are ruled by the rich, and those who borrow are slaves of moneylenders.
translation_verse: Niiatsɛ yeɔ ohiafo nɔ; ni mɔ ni yafaa nii tsɔ̃ɔ nyɔŋ ehãa mɔ ni fa lɛ nii lɛ.

english_verse: Troublemakers get in trouble, and their terrible anger will get them nowhere.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yeɔ toikɔdɔmɔ sane lɛ, enaa amanehulu, ni eyitsoŋwalɛ lɛ sɛɛ foɔ.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who freely gives food to the poor.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni mli jɔ lɛ aaajɔɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛ eniyenii lɛ eko kumaa ohiafo.

english_verse: Arguments and fights will come to an end, if you chase away those who insult others.
translation_verse: Shwiemɔ hefɛoyelɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ blɔmɔ kɛ bei kɛ jɛmɔ sɛɛ aaafo.

english_verse: The king is the friend of all who are sincere and speak with kindness.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni tsui mli tse, ni ewiemɔ he tse lɛ, maŋtsɛ kɛ lɛ bɔɔ naanyo.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who shows good sense, but he frustrates the plans of deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Yehowa hiŋmɛii baa nilee yi; shi amalelɔi awiemɔi lɛ ebaaa yi.

english_verse: Don't be so lazy that you say, “If I go to work, a lion will eat me!”
translation_verse: Anihaolɔ kɛɔ akɛ, “Jata yɛ agbo lɛ naa; kɛji mije kpo kɛtee blohuŋ lɛ magbo.”

english_verse: The words of a bad woman are like a deep pit; if you make the Lord angry, you will fall right in.
translation_verse: Yoo ni bɛ jeŋba lɛ edaa tamɔ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ, mɔ ni Yehowa mli efu lɛ lɛ eeegbee mli.

english_verse: All children are foolish, but firm correction will make them change.
translation_verse: Buulufeemɔ kpɛtɛ gbekɛ tsui he; shi tsɔsemɔ kpãa lɛ aaashwie buulufeemɔ lɛ kɛaaje ehe kɛya sɛɛ flooflo.

english_verse: Cheat the poor to make profit or give gifts to the rich— either way you lose. Thirty Wise Sayings
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yeɔ ohiafo amim koni ekɛna nii, shi ekeɔ niiatsɛ nii lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ ohia kɛ̃ hiaa lɛ. Nilee wiemɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃

english_verse: Here are some sayings of people with wisdom, so listen carefully as I teach.
translation_verse: Ba otoi shi koni obo nilelɔi awiemɔi toi; ni okɛ ojwɛŋmɔ akase nii kɛjɛ minilee lɛ mli.

english_verse: You will be glad that you know these sayings and can recite them.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛji okɛto ojwɛŋmɔ mli, ni onyɛ okai yɛ owiemɔi amli lɛ, eyɛ fɛo pam.

english_verse: I am teaching them today, so that you may trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Miihã bo tuuŋtu ole enɛɛmɛi ŋmɛnɛ, bɔ ni afee ni ona hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ Yehowa mli.

english_verse: I have written thirty sayings filled with sound advice.
translation_verse: Miŋma nilee wiemɔi kɛ ŋaawoi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ miha bo.

english_verse: You can trust them completely to give you the right words for those in charge of you. –
translation_verse: Wiemɔi ni baatsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni ja kɛ nɔ ni ji anɔkwale; koni okɛ anɔkwa hetoo ayahã mɛi ni tsu bo lɛ. -

english_verse: Don't take advantage of the poor or cheat them in court.
translation_verse: Kaatswa ohiafo ojo yɛ ohiafo ni eji lɛ hewɔ; asaŋ kaagba nɔnalɔ naa yɛ saneyelihe;

english_verse: The Lord is their defender, and what you do to them, he will do to you. –
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Yehowa yeɔ amɛsane ehãa amɛ; ni mɛi ni haoɔ amɛ lɛ amɛ hu Yehowa aaahao amɛ. -

english_verse: Don't make friends with anyone who has a bad temper.
translation_verse: Okɛ mlifutsɛ akabɔ naanyo, ni okɛ mlilatsɛ akanyiɛ;

english_verse: You might turn out like them and get caught in a trap. –
translation_verse: koni okɔ amɛjeŋba lɛ ni oyadu tsɔne. -

english_verse: Don't guarantee to pay someone else's debt.
translation_verse: Kaafee ohe mɛi ni woɔ shi, loo mɛi ni damɔɔ nyɔmɔtsɛ sɛɛ lɛ eko;

english_verse: If you don't have the money, you might lose your bed. –
translation_verse: kɛji obɛ nɔ ko ni okɛaawo nyɔmɔ lɛ, aaashɔ̃ osaa tete yɛ odɛ̃ŋ. -

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker set up by your ancestors. –
translation_verse: Kaatsi blema shikpɔŋ husu kadimɔ nɔ ni otsɛmɛi lɛ eto efɔ̃ shi lɛ kɛtee sɛɛ. -

english_verse: If you do your job well, you will work for a ruler and never be a slave.
translation_verse: Nuu ni bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ, ni ele ŋaa jogbaŋŋ yɛ enitsumɔ mli lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi ahiɛ tete eeedamɔ; edamɔŋ mɛi ni abuuu amɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: Don't accept an invitation to eat a selfish person's food, no matter how good it is.
translation_verse: Kaaye kpɛkpɛɛlɔ dɛŋ nii, ni kaaha edɔkɔdɔkɔnii lɛ miiba otsine.

english_verse: When you are invited to eat with a king, use your best manners.
translation_verse: Kɛ ota shi, ni okɛ lumɔ ko baaye nii lɛ, jwɛŋmɔ mɔ hiɛ ni ota lɛ he jogbaŋŋ.

english_verse: Don't go and stuff yourself! That would be just the same as cutting your throat.
translation_verse: Kɛ oji mɔ ni yeɔ ŋmaa lɛ, kaaye pii, tse nɔ.

english_verse: Don't be greedy for all of that fancy food! It may not be so tasty. –
translation_verse: Kaaha edɔkɔdɔkɔnii lɛ miitsɛ̃ onaa, ejaakɛ niyenii ni lakaa mɔ ni. -

english_verse: People like that take note of how much you eat. They say, “Take all you want!” But they don't mean it.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ etamɔ mɔ ko ni buɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ he akɔntaa yɛ eyitsoŋ. Ekɛɔ bo akɛ, “Ye ni onu!” Shi jeee kɛ etsui mli fɛɛ.

english_verse: Give up trying so hard to get rich.
translation_verse: Kaagbo deŋme yɛ ninamɔ he; Okɛ jwɛŋmɔ ato he.

english_verse: Your money flies away before you know it, just like an eagle suddenly taking off. –
translation_verse: Ohiŋmɛi ni aaagba nɔ pɛ etee; ejaakɛ ekwɛ̃ɔ fiji oya, ni efilikiɔ tamɔ okropɔŋ kɛyaa ŋwɛi. -

english_verse: Each bite will come back up, and all your kind words will be wasted. –
translation_verse: Atrɔmai abɔ ni oye lɛ oooshwe oshwie, ni owiemɔi dɔkɔbii lɛ aaafee yaka. -

english_verse: Don't talk to fools— they will make fun of you. –
translation_verse: Kaawie ni kwashia nu; ejaakɛ eeegbe onilee wiemɔi lɛ ahe guɔ. -

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker or take the land that belongs to orphans.
translation_verse: Kaatsi blema husu nɔ̃ okadi hu kɛtee sɛɛ, ni kaaŋɔ awusãi ashikpɔŋ yɛ amɛdɛ̃.

english_verse: Listen to me, my children! Be wise and have enough sense to follow the right path.
translation_verse: Mibi, bo lɛ, bo toi, koni ole nii, ni oba ojeŋ jogbaŋŋ.

english_verse: Don't be a heavy drinker or stuff yourself with food.
translation_verse: Okɛ ohe akabɔ dãatɔlɔi loo ŋmaayelɔi ahe.

english_verse: It will make you feel drowsy, and you will end up poor with only rags to wear. –
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ dãatɔlɔi kɛ ŋmaayelɔi lɛ amɛaaye ohia, ni wɔdɔiwɔlɔi aaabu mama shwɛishwɛi. -

english_verse: Pay attention to your father, and don't neglect your mother when she grows old.
translation_verse: Bo otsɛ ni fɔ bo lɛ toi, ni kaagbe onyɛ he guɔ kɛji egbɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Invest in truth and wisdom, discipline and good sense, and don't part with them.
translation_verse: Tse shika ohe anɔkwale kɛ nilee kɛ tsɔsemɔ kɛ niiashishinumɔ, ni okahɔ̃ɔ eko eko.

english_verse: Make your father truly happy by living right and showing sound judgment.
translation_verse: Jalɔ tsɛ aaanya babaoo, ni mɔ ni fɔɔ bi nilelɔ lɛ aaana ebi lɛ he miishɛɛ.

english_verse: Make your parents proud, especially your mother. –
translation_verse: Hã otsɛ kɛ onyɛ mii ashɛ amɛhe, ni hã onyɛ ni fɔ bo lɛ anya. -

english_verse: My son, pay close attention, and gladly follow my example.
translation_verse: Mibi ŋɔɔ otsui ohã mi, ni okɔ minane.

english_verse: Bad women and unfaithful wives are like a deep pit—
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ yoo ni bɛ jeŋba lɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ ni, ni mɔ kroko ŋa lɛ bu kplokotoo ni.

english_verse: they are waiting to attack you like a gang of robbers with victim after victim. –
translation_verse: Ewoɔ ka tamɔ ojotswalɔ, ni ehãa mɛi ni yeee anɔkwa ayi faa yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ. -

english_verse: Who is always in trouble? Who argues and fights? Who has cuts and bruises? Whose eyes are red?
translation_verse: Namɔ naa nɔ? Namɔ yeɔ awerɛho? Namɔ naa bei? Namɔ naa sane? Namɔ naa pilamɔ yakatswaa? Namɔ hiŋmɛii tsuɔ faa?

english_verse: Everyone who stays up late, having just one more drink.
translation_verse: Mɛi nɛɛ ji mɛi ni tsɛɔ yɛ wain he lɛ; mɛi ni yaa yasaa amɛnaa wain ni afutu mli lɛ.

english_verse: Don't even look at that colorful stuff bubbling up in the glass! It goes down so easily,
translation_verse: Kaakwɛ wain bɔ ni etsu faa lɛ, bɔ ni ehiɛ yɔɔ fɛo yɛ kpulu lɛ mli lɛ, bɔ ni eyaa kpoo lɛ.

english_verse: but later it bites like a poisonous snake.
translation_verse: Kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ, ekɔ̃ɔ mɔ tamɔ onufu, ni efɛ̃ɔ mɔ tamɔ blikã.

english_verse: You will see weird things, and your mind will play tricks on you.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ ohiŋmɛii ebɔi naakpɛɛ nibii namɔ, ni wiemɔi gbohii aaaje onaa.

english_verse: You will feel tossed about like someone trying to sleep on a ship in a storm.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ ooofee tamɔ mɔ ko ni kã ŋshɔ teŋ, loo tamɔ mɔ ko ni kã aŋmala nɔ yɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ.

english_verse: You will be bruised all over, without even remembering how it all happened. And you will lie awake asking, “When will morning come, so I can drink some more?”
translation_verse: Kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ nɔ ni oookɛɛ ji, “Amɛtswia mi nii, shi ewaaa mihe; amɛyi mi, shi minuuu he. Mɛɛbe mihiɛ aaatsɛ̃? Mibaya ekoŋŋ.”

english_verse: Don't let evil people worry you or make you jealous.
translation_verse: Kaawo otsui he la yɛ efɔŋfeelɔi ahewɔ, ni ohiɛ akakɔ̃ mɛi fɔ̃ji anɔ.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of crooks or want to be their friends.
translation_verse: Ohiɛ akakɔ̃ gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji anɔ, ni okashwe hu akɛ okɛ amɛ aaabɔ naanyo tete.

english_verse: All they think about and talk about is violence and cruelty. –
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ be fɛɛ be lɛ yiwalɛ nifeemɔi ahe ŋaa amɛjwɛŋmɔ toɔ, ni amɛwieɔ wiemɔi gbohii. -

english_verse: They will soon be gone like the flame of a lamp that burns out. –
translation_verse: Nɔ kpakpa ko bɛ hã mɔ fɔŋ wɔsɛɛ, ni efɔŋfeelɔi akane lɛ hu aaagbe. -

english_verse: Use wisdom and understanding to establish your home;
translation_verse: Nilee akɛmaa tsu, ni niiashishinumɔ akɛhãa emaa shi.

english_verse: let good sense fill the rooms with priceless treasures. –
translation_verse: Ni nilee akɛhãa piai amli yimɔɔ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni jara wa ni yɔɔ fɛo. -

english_verse: My children, you must respect the Lord and the king, and you must not make friends with anyone who rebels against either of them.
translation_verse: Mibi, she Yehowa gbeyei, kɛ maŋtsɛ hu; ni kaatse amɛteŋ mɔ ko hiɛ atua.

english_verse: Battles are won by listening to advice and making a lot of plans. –
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ŋaa akɛwuɔ ta, ni ŋaawolɔi pii aŋaawoo akɛyeɔ kunim. -

english_verse: Who knows what sudden disaster the Lord or a ruler might bring? More Sayings That Make Good Sense
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ amɛaanyɛ amɛkpãtã ohiɛ trukaa; ni namɔ le nɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ ni aaajɛ amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ? Nilee wiemɔi krokomɛi hu nɛ

english_verse: Wisdom is too much for fools! Their advice is no good. –
translation_verse: Nilee mli kwɔ tsɔ̃ hã kwashia, hewɔ lɛ etswaaa esɛŋ yɛ koi shi. -

english_verse: Here are some more sayings that make good sense: When you judge, you must be fair.
translation_verse: Nilelɔi awiemɔi lɛ ekomɛi hu nɛ. Hiɛaŋkwɛmɔ yɛ kojomɔ mli lɛ, ehiii.

english_verse: No one but troublemakers think up trouble.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni toɔ efɔŋfeemɔ he ŋaa lɛ, lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ ablofo.

english_verse: Everyone hates senseless fools who think up ways to sin. –
translation_verse: Mɔ buulufeemɔ he ŋaatoo lɛ esha ni; ni hefɛoyelɔ hu gbɔmɛi miihi. -

english_verse: If you let the guilty go free, people of all nations will hate and curse you.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kɛɔ efɔŋfeelɔ akɛ, “Oye bem” lɛ, mɛi aaalomɔ lɛ; majimaji aaanyaŋe lɛ.

english_verse: Don't give up and be helpless in times of trouble. –
translation_verse: Kɛji otɔ biti yɛ haomɔ gbi nɔ lɛ, no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ohewalɛ faaa. -

english_verse: But if you punish the guilty, things will go well for you, and you will prosper.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni kãa efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ aaana miishɛɛ; ni jɔɔmɔ kpakpa aaaba amɛnɔ.

english_verse: Don't say, “I didn't know it!” God can read your mind. He watches each of us and knows our thoughts. And God will pay us back for what we do. –
translation_verse: Kɛji okɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔleee enɛ wɔto” lɛ, ani mɔ ni naa tsuiaŋnii lɛ, mɔ ni buɔ osusuma he lɛ, eleee, eleee akɛ ole oto lo? Ani ewooo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɔmɔ yɛ enitsumɔ naa? -

english_verse: Giving an honest answer is a sign of true friendship.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni hãa hetoo ni ja lɛ, ohe suɔlɔ ni.

english_verse: Wisdom is like honey for your life— if you find it, your future is bright. –
translation_verse: Kɛ ona nilee lɛ aaahi aha bo wɔsɛɛ, ni ohiɛnɔkãmɔ efeŋ yaka. -

english_verse: Get your fields ready and plant your crops before starting a home.
translation_verse: Too onitsumɔ he gbɛjianɔ jogbaŋŋ, feemɔ oŋmɔshinii fɛɛ kralo, no sɛɛ dani obɔi otsu maa.

english_verse: Don't be a cruel person who attacks good people and hurts their families.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ fɔŋ, kaawo jalɔ shihilɛhe lɛ he ka, ni kaahao ehejɔɔmɔhe lɛ hu.

english_verse: Even if good people fall seven times, they will get back up. But when trouble strikes the wicked, that's the end of them. –
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ jalɔ gbeɔ shi shii kpawo, ni eteɔ shi ekoŋŋ; shi efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ amanehulu butuɔ lɛ kwrakwra. -

english_verse: Don't accuse anyone who isn't guilty. Don't ever tell a lie
translation_verse: Kaaye odase oshi onaanyo yakatswaa, ni okɛ onaabu hu akashishiu mɔ ko.

english_verse: Don't be happy to see your enemies trip and fall down.
translation_verse: Kɛji ohenyɛlɔ gbee shi lɛ, kaanya, ni kɛji etɛ lɛ, omli akafili bo.

english_verse: The Lord will find out and be unhappy. Then he will stop being angry with them. –
translation_verse: No lɛ, Yehowa aaana, ni eeedɔ lɛ, ni ebaafo emli ni efu lɛ lɛ sɛɛ. -

english_verse: I once walked by the field and the vineyard of a lazy fool.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ̃ anihaolɔ ko ŋmɔ he, kɛ mɔ ni bɛ yitsoŋ waintrom he;

english_verse: When I saw this, it taught me a lesson:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mikwɛ gãa, ni mijwɛŋ he jogbaŋŋ. Mikwɛ, ni mikase nɔ ko kɛjɛ mli.

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: Mawɔ fioo, majie mihiɛsɛɛ fioo, makota miniji fioo;

english_verse: Here are some more of Solomon's proverbs. They were copied by the officials of King Hezekiah of Judah.
translation_verse: Solomon abɛi lɛ ekrokomɛi hu ni Yuda maŋtsɛ Hezekia webii lɛ ŋmala nɛ:

english_verse: God is praised for being mysterious; rulers are praised for explaining mysteries.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam ji akɛ ekɛ sane atee; shi maŋtsɛmɛi anunyam ji akɛ amɛtao sane mli.

english_verse: Who can fully understand the thoughts of a ruler? They reach beyond the sky and go deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni ŋwɛi kwɔ, ni shikpɔŋ hu mli kwɔ lɛ, nakai maŋtsɛmɛi ayitsoŋ kwɔ; anyɛɛɛ ana emli nii.

english_verse: Silver must be purified before it can be used to make something of value.
translation_verse: Jiemɔ jwiɛtɛi fei lɛ kɛje jwiɛtɛi lɛ mli, ni ŋaalɔ lɛ baana jwiɛtɛi krɔŋŋ ni ekɛtsu nii lɛ.

english_verse: Evil people must be removed before anyone can rule with justice.
translation_verse: Jiemɔ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ kɛje maŋtsɛ he, ni jalɛ sane aaahi sɛi lɛ he.

english_verse: Don't try to seem important in the court of a ruler.
translation_verse: Kɛji oyɛ maŋtsɛ hiɛ lɛ, kaafee pupuupu; ni kaadamɔ mɛi wuji agbɛhe.

english_verse: It's better for the ruler to give you a high position than for you to be embarrassed in front of royal officials. Be sure you are right
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ehi moŋ akɛ aaakɛɛ bo akɛ, “Ba yitsogbɛ nɛɛ,” fe nɔ ni aaatsi bo kɛaatee najiashigbɛ ni lumɔ lɛ miikwɛ.

english_verse: before you sue someone, or you might lose your case and be embarrassed.
translation_verse: Kaaye oyai ni okɛ nɔ ni okɛ ohiŋmɛi kɛkɛ na tee saneyelihe, ejaakɛ naagbee mli kɛji onaanyo lɛ wo bo hiɛgbele lɛ, te obaafee tɛŋŋ?

english_verse: When you and someone else can't get along, don't gossip about it.
translation_verse: Kɛji okɛ onaanyo na sane lɛ, bo kɛ lɛ sɔŋŋ atao naa; shi kaajie mɔ kroko teemɔŋ sane kpo;

english_verse: Others will find out, and your reputation will then be ruined.
translation_verse: koni mɔ ni aaanu he lɛ akabawo bo hiɛgbele ni ogbɛi gbonyo lɛ miika ohe.

english_verse: The right word at the right time is like precious gold set in silver.
translation_verse: Wiemɔ ni aaawie be ni sa mli lɛ, etamɔ shika kpɔbii ni tara jwiɛtɛi mli.

english_verse: Listening to good advice is worth much more than jewelry made of gold.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni shika ga kɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi hewulamɔnii yɔɔ hã mɔ lɛ, nakai kãlɔ ni le nii yɔɔ hã toibolɔi.

english_verse: A messenger you can trust is just as refreshing as cool water in summer.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni snoo mli jɔɔ ŋanii yɛ nikpamɔ be mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ji bɔfo anɔkwafo hã mɛi ni tsu lɛ lɛ. Ehãa enuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ atsui nyɔɔ amɛmli.

english_verse: Broken promises are worse than rain clouds that don't bring rain.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni woɔ nikee he shi, tsɛ, eyeee shiwoo lɛ nɔ lɛ, etamɔ oblɔtu kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni nu bɛ mli.

english_verse: Patience and gentle talk can convince a ruler and overcome any problem.
translation_verse: Aaanyɛ akɛ tsuishitoo blɛoo atsake nɔyelɔ jwɛŋmɔ; ni naajɔlɛ wiemɔ kuɔ wu.

english_verse: Eating too much honey can make you sick.
translation_verse: Kɛ ona wo lɛ, kaaye fe nine, koni eti bo, ni oshwe oshwie.

english_verse: Don't visit friends too often, or they will get tired of it and start hating you.
translation_verse: Kaafɔ onaanyo we shwɛmɔ koni osane miije etsine, ni ehe miitsɛ̃ bo.

english_verse: Telling lies about friends is like attacking them with clubs and swords and sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yeɔ amale odase yɛ enaanyo he lɛ, etamɔ tsokpoti loo klante loo gãimlibi ni naa ba.

english_verse: A friend you can't trust in times of trouble is like having a toothache or a sore foot.
translation_verse: Hiɛ ni akɛfɔ̃ɔ kutumpɔfo nɔ yɛ fimɔ be mli lɛ, etamɔ nyanyɔŋ ni ewɔtsɔ loo nane ni elɔŋe.

english_verse: If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink.
translation_verse: Kɛji hɔmɔ miiye ohenyɛlɔ lɛ, hã lɛ nii eye, ni kɛji kumai miiye lɛ lɛ, hã lɛ nu enu.

english_verse: This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads. And the Lord will reward you.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛji ofee nakai lɛ, ooowo lɛ hiɛgbele kpɔtɔɔ, ni Yehowa aaawo bo he nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: As surely as rain blows in from the north, anger is caused by cruel words.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni kooyigbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ kɛ nunɛmɔ baa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mɔhewiemɔ kɛ hiɛtumɔ baa.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Faŋ nɔ ni oyahi tsu yiteŋ kpokplobiiaŋ, fe nɔ ni okɛ yoo beilɔ aaahi shĩa kome mli.

english_verse: Good news from far away refreshes like cold water when you are thirsty.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni nu hɔɔŋ yɔɔ hã mɔ ni kumai yeɔ lɛ lɛ, nakai ji sanekpakpa ni akɛjɛ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ kɛba.

english_verse: When a good person gives in to the wicked, it's like dumping garbage in a stream of clear water.
translation_verse: Jalɔ ni nyɛɛɛ shi afi yɛ mɔ fɔŋ hiɛ lɛ, etamɔ nuhiŋmɛi ní anyiɛ mli kɛ nubu ni akpɔtɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't eat too much honey or always want praise.
translation_verse: Woyeli tsɔ̃ ehiii, hiɛtaomɔ tsɔ̃ hu ehiii.

english_verse: Losing self-control leaves you as helpless as a city without a wall.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni nyɛɛɛ ehe nɔ eye lɛ, etamɔ maŋ ni akumɔ ehe gbogboi ashwie shi.

english_verse: Expecting snow in summer and rain in the dry season makes more sense than honoring a fool.
translation_verse: Snoo enɛɛɛ yɛ latsa be mli, ni nu enɛɛɛ yɛ nikpamɔ beiaŋ, nakai hiɛnyam esaaa kwashia.

english_verse: A curse you don't deserve will take wings and fly away like a sparrow or a swallow.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni aflimata filikiɔ ni nyɔŋmɔbitɛte filikiɔ lɛ, nakai yaka loomɔ mɔɔɔ mɔ.

english_verse: Horses and donkeys must be beaten and bridled— and so must fools.
translation_verse: Kpelebi sa okpɔŋɔ, ni manyoflɛ sa teji, ni kpãa sa kwashia kotosɛɛ.

english_verse: Don't make a fool of yourself by answering a fool.
translation_verse: Kaakwɛ kwashia sanebimɔ ni ohã lɛ nakai hetoo, no lɛ oootsɔ̃ tamɔ lɛ.

english_verse: But if you answer any fools, show how foolish they are, so they won't feel smart.
translation_verse: Kwɛmɔ kwashia sanebimɔ ni oha lɛ hetoo, koni ekabu ehe nilelɔ.

english_verse: Sending a message by a fool is like chopping off your foot just to spite yourself.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kɛ shɛɛ tsuɔ kwashia lɛ, eetɔ̃tɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enane, ni eetao sane ehã ehe.

english_verse: A fool with words of wisdom is like an athlete with legs that can't move.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni obubuafo naji tsotsoroɔ ehe ni hewalɛ bɛ mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kwashia daaŋ abɛ yɔɔ efolo.

english_verse: Are you going to honor a fool? Why not shoot a slingshot with the rock tied tight?
translation_verse: Mɔ ni woɔ kwashia hiɛ nyam lɛ, etamɔ mɔ ko ni ekɔ tɛ ewo akromia mli.

english_verse: A thornbush waved around in the hand of a drunkard is no worse than a proverb in the mouth of a fool.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni ŋmei tso yɔɔ yɛ dãatɔlɔ dɛŋ lɛ, nakai abɛ yɔɔ yɛ kwashia daaŋ.

english_verse: It's no smarter to shoot arrows at every passerby than it is to hire a bunch of worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni bɔɔ kwashia loo dãatɔlɔ ni miiho apaa lɛ, etamɔ gãitsɛ̃lɔ ni miipila mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Dogs return to eat their vomit, just as fools repeat their foolishness.
translation_verse: Kwashia ni kuɔ esɛɛ eyafeɔ ebuuluianii ekoŋŋ lɛ, etamɔ gbee ni kuɔ esɛɛ kɛyaa eshwee he.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who says, “I'm really smart!”
translation_verse: Hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ ha kwashia fe gbɔmɔ ni buɔ ehe nilelɔ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ.

english_verse: Don't be lazy and keep saying, “There's a lion outside!”
translation_verse: Anihaolɔ ji mɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ, “Jata yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ; jata yɛ blohui lɛ amli.”

english_verse: A door turns on its hinges, but a lazy person just turns over in bed.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni shinaa tsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ esɛɛ sai anɔ pɛ lɛ, nakai anihaolɔ hetsɔ̃ɔmɔ yɔɔ yɛ esaa mli.

english_verse: Some of us are so lazy that we won't lift a hand to feed ourselves.
translation_verse: Anihaolɔ kɛ enine woɔ kã mli, shi ewaa ehãa lɛ akɛ, ekɛ enine lɛ aaawo edaaŋ tete.

english_verse: A lazy person says, “I am smarter than everyone else.”
translation_verse: Anihaolɔ buɔ ehe nilelɔ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ, fe nilelɔi kpawo ni hãa sane hetoo ni ja.

english_verse: It's better to take hold of a mad dog by the ears than to take part in someone else's argument.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kɛ ehe woɔ bei ni kɔɔɔ ehe eko mli lɛ, etamɔ mɔ ko ni mɔɔ gbee gbɔ ni miiho toi mli.

english_verse: Where there is no fuel a fire goes out; where there is no gossip arguments come to an end.
translation_verse: Kɛji lai tã lɛ, la gboɔ; ni kɛji ablɛbiwielɔ bɛ lɛ bei sɛɛ foɔ.

english_verse: Troublemakers start trouble, just as sparks and fuel start a fire.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni ŋai hãaa lasrɛmi agbo, ni lai hãaa la agbo lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ beilɔ hãa bei mli waa.

english_verse: There is nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Ablɛbiwielɔ wiemɔ tamɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔnii ni ŋɔɔ jogbaŋŋ ni wɔsumɔɔ akɛ wɔye wɔwo wɔmusuŋ obɔ̃.

english_verse: Hiding hateful thoughts behind smooth talk is like coating a clay pot with a cheap glaze.
translation_verse: Naa dɔkɔbii wiemɔ ni jɛɛɛ tsuijurɔ mli lɛ, etamɔ ŋɛsuko ni akɛ jwiɛtɛi ekpa he.

english_verse: The pleasant talk of an enemy hides more evil plans
translation_verse: Nyɛlɔ kɛ enaabu saa ewiemɔ he, shi etsuiŋ lɛ, eelaka mɔ.

english_verse: than can be counted— so don't believe a word!
translation_verse: Kɛji eewie dɔkɔbii lɛ, kaahe lɛ oye, ejaakɛ yiŋtoi fɔ̃ji eyi etsui mli obɔ̃.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you will fall in; if you start a stone rolling, it will roll back on you.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kɛ yiŋtoo fɔŋ tsaa bu lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ eeegbee mli; ni mɔ ni kɛ yiŋsha kokloɔ tɛ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ enɔ tɛ lɛ aaaku sɛɛ agbee.

english_verse: Watch out for anyone who tells lies and flatters— they are out to get you.
translation_verse: Kɛji oonyɛ mɔ ko lɛ, no owieɔ omaleɔ ehe efɔŋ; ni mɔ yiteŋ mluwoo lɛ ekɛ shigbeemɔ baa.

english_verse: Don't brag about tomorrow! Each day brings its own surprises.
translation_verse: Kaashwã ofɔ̃ wɔ nɔ; ejaakɛ oleee nɔ ni baaba wɔ.

english_verse: Stones and sand are heavy, but trouble caused by a fool is a much heavier load.
translation_verse: Tɛ tsii, ni shia hu, jatsu kɛ tsiimɔ ni; shi buulu mlifu tsii fe nibii enyɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: An angry person is dangerous, but a jealous person is even worse.
translation_verse: Mlila yi wa, ni mlifu tamɔ faa ni esram nɔ; shi namɔ aaanyɛ awuŋayeli hiɛ adamɔ?

english_verse: You can trust a friend who corrects you, but kisses from an enemy are nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Naanyo anɔkwafo ejeee gbɛ epilaaa mɔ; shi henyɛlɔ mɔ atuuloomɔ lɛ, shishiumɔ ni.

english_verse: If you have had enough to eat, honey doesn't taste good, but if you are really hungry, you will eat anything.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni eye nii etɔ lɛ, ekwaa wo agbaku tete; shi mɔ ni hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni joɔ po ŋɔɔ yɛ edaaŋ.

english_verse: When you are far from home, you feel like a bird without a nest.
translation_verse: Nuu ni jeɔ ewe eyakpaa shi lɛ, etamɔ loofɔlɔ ni jeɔ etsu mli eyatsomloɔ.

english_verse: The sweet smell of incense can make you feel good, but true friendship is better still.
translation_verse: Muŋma kɛ ojeŋma hãa mɔ mii shɛɔ ehe, shi haomɔ hãa mɔ tsui yeɔ.

english_verse: Don't desert an old friend of your family or visit your relatives when you are in trouble. A friend nearby is better than relatives far away.
translation_verse: Kaakwa bo diɛŋtsɛ onaanyo kɛ otsɛ naanyo. Ofimɔ gbi nɔ lɛ, kaaya onyɛmi we. Ohe gbɔmɔ ni bɛŋkɛ bo lɛ, ehi aahu fe onyɛmi ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ.

english_verse: My child, show good sense! Then I will be happy and able to answer anyone who criticizes me.
translation_verse: Mibi, feemɔ nilelɔ, ni ohã mitsui anyɔ mimli; bɔ ni afee ni mana hetoo mahã mɔ ni bɔɔ mi ahora lɛ.

english_verse: Be cautious and hide when you see danger— don't be stupid and walk right into trouble.
translation_verse: Hiɛtɛ̃lɔ naa efɔŋ ni baa, ni ewiɔ ehe; shi mɛi ni jwɛŋmɔ naa waaa lɛ, amɛyaboteɔ mli.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni damɔɔ gbɔ sɛɛ lɛ, hã ekɛ etade ato bo awaba; ni mɔ ni damɔɔ maŋsɛɛnyo sɛɛ lɛ, hã ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe ato awaba.

english_verse: A loud greeting early in the morning is the same as a curse.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kɛ gbee ni wa jɔɔ enaanyo leebi maŋkpa lɛ, aaasusu akɛ loomɔ moŋ elomɔɔ lɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The steady dripping of rain and the nagging of a wife are one and the same.
translation_verse: Yoo beilɔ lɛ etamɔ tsu yiteŋ nu ni tsereɔ shwieɔ shi kɔikɔi pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛji nu miinɛ.

english_verse: It's easier to catch the wind or hold olive oil in your hand than to stop a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Kɛji aaaka akɛ aaatsi enaa ni efɔ̃ɔ bei lɛ, etamɔ nɔ ni aatsi kɔɔyɔɔ naa ni ekatswa, aloo aamia mu yɛ ninejurɔ dɛ̃kɔkɔ mli.

english_verse: Just as iron sharpens iron, friends sharpen the minds of each other.
translation_verse: Dade jɔɔ dade naa, ni gbɔmɔ hu hãa enyɛmi gbɔmɔ leɔ nii.

english_verse: Take care of a tree, and you will eat its fruit; look after your master, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni baa yelitso yi lɛ, eyeɔ eyibii lɛ eko; ni mɔ ni buɔ enuŋtsɔ he lɛ, enuŋtsɔ lɛ woɔ ehiɛ nyam.

english_verse: You see your face in a mirror and your thoughts in the minds of others.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni gbɔmɔ naa ehiɛ yɛ nu mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔ hãa enaa bɔ ni eji.

english_verse: Death and the grave are never satisfied, and neither are humans.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni gbohiiaje kɛ gbonyobu etɔko dã lɛ, nakai gbɔmɔ hiŋmɛi hu etɔko dã.

english_verse: Gold and silver are tested in a red-hot furnace, but we are tested by praise.
