translation_verse: Niiahetsuumɔ kukwɛi lɛ, eyɛ kɛhã jwiɛtɛi, ni flɔnɔɔ hu yɛ kɛhã shika, ni gbɔmɔ lɛ eyijiemɔ akɛyoɔ lɛ.

english_verse: No matter how hard you beat a fool, you can't pound out the foolishness.
translation_verse: Kɛji okɛshi buulu yɛ fufuitso mli tamɔ ashiɔ abele tete lɛ, ebuulufeemɔ lɛ ejeŋ ehe kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: You should take good care of your sheep and goats,
translation_verse: Bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ ni ole bɔ ni otoi lɛ yɔɔ, ni okwɛ okooloo kui lɛ jogbaŋŋ.

english_verse: After the hay is cut and the new growth appears and the harvest is over,
translation_verse: Kɛji jwɛi gbiŋ be ho, ni jwɛi fɔ ba, ni tsei fu bai lɛ, afolɔɔ, ni abuaa naa yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: you can sell lambs and goats to buy clothes and land.
translation_verse: Onaa omama kɛjɛɔ too gwantɛŋbii lɛ amli, ni onaa shika kɛjɛɔ too abotiai ni ohɔ̃ɔ lɛ mli okɛheɔ shikpɔŋ.

english_verse: From the milk of the goats, you can make enough cheese to feed your family and all your servants.
translation_verse: Ooona abotia fufɔ bɔ ni aaashɛ bo kɛ owe lɛ yeli, kɛ nɔ ni okɛaalɛ otsuji yei lɛ.

english_verse: Wicked people run away when no one chases them, but those who live right are as brave as lions.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɔ̃ji joɔ foi be mli ni mɔ ko enyiɛɛɛ amɛsɛɛ, shi jalɔi lɛ amɛfeɔ ekãa tamɔ jata.

english_verse: In time of civil war there are many leaders, but a sensible leader restores law and order.
translation_verse: Nɔsha hãa shikpɔŋ ko nɔ lumɛi ayi faa; shi kɛ emli mɛi lɛ yɛ niiashishinumɔ kɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, lumɔyeli maa shi shiŋŋ, ni esɛɛ tsɛɔ.

english_verse: When someone poor takes over and mistreats the poor, it's like a heavy rain destroying the crops.
translation_verse: Ohiafo ni waa enaanyo ohiafo yi lɛ, etamɔ nunɛmɔ ni loɔ nii kɛyaa, ni ehãaa niyenii aba.

english_verse: Criminals don't know what justice means, but all who respect the Lord understand it completely.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɔ̃ji nuuu jalɛ shishi; shi mɛi ni jaa Yehowa lɛ, amɛnuɔ shishi jogbaŋŋ.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right, than to be rich and dishonest.
translation_verse: Ohiafo ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ lɛ, ehi fe niiatsɛ ni bɛ jeŋba.

english_verse: It makes good sense to obey the Law of God, but you disgrace your parents if you make friends with worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yeɔ mla nɔ lɛ, bi nilelɔ ni; shi mɔ ni kɛ fulɔi bɔɔ naanyo lɛ, ewoɔ etsɛ hiɛgbele.

english_verse: If you make money by charging high interest rates, you will lose it all to someone who cares for the poor.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kɛ hekpa ni fe nine kɛ wieyeli hãa enii faa lɛ, eebua naa ehã mɔ ni naa ohiafo mɔbɔ lɛ.

english_verse: God cannot stand the prayers of anyone who disobeys his Law.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni booo mla toi ni eye nɔ lɛ, esɔlemɔ tete lɛ, nihiinii ni.

english_verse: By leading good people to sin, you dig a pit for yourself, but all who live right will have a bright future.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hãa jalɔ nane tɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ kɛyaa gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ lɛ, eeegbee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebu mli; shi mɛi ni shwamɔ ko bɛ amɛhe lɛ aaana gboshinii kpakpa.

english_verse: The rich think highly of themselves, but anyone poor and sensible sees right through them.
translation_verse: Niiatsɛ buɔ ehe nilelɔ; shi ohiafo ni yɔɔ niiashishinumɔ kpaa lɛ shi.

english_verse: When an honest person wins, it's time to celebrate; when crooks are in control, it's best to hide.
translation_verse: Kɛ jalɔi ye kunim lɛ, eyɛ nyam naakpa; shi kɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji wo amɛhe nɔ lɛ, mɛi teeteɔ amɛhe.

english_verse: If you don't confess your sins, you will be a failure. But God will be merciful if you confess your sins and give them up.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni tsimɔɔ etɔ̃mɔi anɔ lɛ, eshwereŋ; shi mɔ ni jajeɔ, ni efɔ̃ɔ efɔŋfeemɔ lɛ, anaa lɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who is afraid to do evil, but if you are cruel, you will end up in trouble.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ mɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei daa; shi mɔ ni wajeɔ etsui lɛ, egbeɔ haomɔ mli.

english_verse: A ruler who mistreats the poor is like a roaring lion or a bear hunting for food.
translation_verse: Nɔyelɔ fɔŋ ni yeɔ maŋbii ni anii yɔɔ mɔbɔ nɔ lɛ, etamɔ jata ni huuɔ loo oshishibrishi ni hiɛ ewo la.

english_verse: A heartless leader is a fool, but anyone who refuses to get rich by cheating others will live a long time.
translation_verse: Nɔyelɔ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, yiwalɔ kpele ji lɛ; shi mɔ ni nyɛɔ hiɛjoomɔ lɛ, ehãa egbii asɛɛ tsɛɔ.

english_verse: Don't give help to murderers! Make them stay on the run for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ko eye mɔ ko lá yi sɔ̃ lɛ, etsɔ̃ kobɔfo kɛmiiya gbonyobu mli; mɔ ko akaye ebua lɛ.

english_verse: Honesty will keep you safe, but everyone who is crooked will suddenly fall.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ lɛ, aaahere eyiwala; shi mɔ ni bɛ jeŋba lɛ, eeegbee bu mli.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will have a lot of food; waste time, and you will have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni hũɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ, eeena nii eye etɔ; shi mɔ ni nyiɛɔ yakayaka nii asɛɛ lɛ eeeye ohia kadikadi.

english_verse: God blesses his loyal people, but punishes all who want to get rich quick.
translation_verse: Nuu anɔkwafo aaana jɔɔmɔ babaoo; shi mɔ ni yeɔ oyai koni ena nii lɛ, eyeŋ ehe.

english_verse: It isn't right to be unfair, but some people can be bribed with only a piece of bread.
translation_verse: Hiɛaŋkwɛmɔ ehiii, ejaakɛ aboloo atrɔma kome pɛ hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɔ aaafee efɔŋ.

english_verse: Don't be selfish and eager to get rich— you will end up worse off than you can imagine.
translation_verse: Kpɛkpɛɛlɔ yeɔ oya ni ena nii; shi eleee akɛ ohia miiba enɔ.

english_verse: If you cheat your parents and don't think it's wrong, you are a common thief.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni tswaa etsɛ loo enyɛ ojo ni ekɛɔ akɛ, “Enɛ jeee esha” lɛ, mɔ hiɛkpãtãlɔ naanyo ji lɛ.

english_verse: Selfish people cause trouble, but you will live a full life if you trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Hiɛjoolɔ lɛ, ewoɔ bei; shi mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ lɛ, enaa nii.

english_verse: Only fools would trust what they alone think, but if you live by wisdom, you will do all right.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe nɔ lɛ, kwashia ni; shi mɔ ni nyiɛɔ yɛ nilee mli lɛ, aaahere eyiwala.

english_verse: Giving to the poor will keep you from poverty, but if you close your eyes to their needs, everyone will curse you.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni hãa ohiafo nɔ lɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko he ehiaŋ lɛ; shi mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ ehiɛ etoɔ afã lɛ, aaalomɔ lɛ babaoo.

english_verse: When crooks are in control, everyone tries to hide, but when they lose power, good people are everywhere.
translation_verse: Kɛji yiwalɔi te shi lɛ, mɛi teeteɔ amɛhe; shi be ni amɛhiɛ kpãtãa lɛ, belɛ jalɔi ayi miifa.

english_verse: If you keep being stubborn after many warnings, you will suddenly discover you have gone too far.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni afɔɔ lɛ kãmɔ, shi loloolo lɛ ekuɛŋ ti lɛ, trukaa ni aaakumɔ lɛ bɔ ni anaŋ ehe tsabaa.

english_verse: When justice rules a nation, everyone is glad; when injustice rules, everyone groans.
translation_verse: Kɛji jalɔi miiye maŋ nɔ lɛ, maŋbii lɛ nyaa; shi kɛji mɛi fɔ̃ji miiye nɔ lɛ, maŋbii lɛ dɔ̃mɔɔ ŋtsɔi.

english_verse: If you love wisdom your parents will be glad, but chasing after bad women will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni sumɔɔ nilee lɛ, ehãa etsɛ naa miishɛɛ; shi mɔ ni kɛ ajwamãŋi bɔɔ lɛ, ekpãtãa enii ahiɛ.

english_verse: An honest ruler makes the nation strong; a ruler who takes bribes will bring it to ruin.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ kɛ jalɛ saneyeli hãa maŋ damɔɔ shi, mɔ ni balaa maŋbii adɛŋ nii lɛ, ebutuɔ maŋ.

english_verse: Flattery is nothing less than setting a trap.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni woɔ enaanyo yiteŋ mlu lɛ, eeŋmɛ yaa ehã mɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Your sins will catch you, but everyone who lives right will sing and celebrate.
translation_verse: Efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe esha nɔŋŋ duɔ lɛ tsɔne; shi jalɔ lɛ, elaa, ni enyaa.

english_verse: The wicked don't care about the rights of the poor, but good people do.
translation_verse: Jalɔ le ohiafoi agbɛnaa; shi mɔ fɔŋ lɛ, enuuu ohiafoi agbɛnaa nɛɛ shishi.

english_verse: Be wise and don't sue a fool. You won't get satisfaction, because all the fool will do is sneer and shout.
translation_verse: Kɛji nilelɔ kɛ buulu gba kadaa lɛ, buulu lɛ griɔ ni eŋmɔɔ kɛkɛ, ni hejɔlɛ baaa.

english_verse: A murderer hates everyone who is honest and lives right.
translation_verse: Lashishwielɔi nyɛɔ mɔ ni tɔ̃mɔ ko bɛ ehe; ni efɔŋfeelɔi taoɔ egbele.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and quickly lose your temper— be sensible and patient.
translation_verse: Kwashia jieɔ emlifu fɛɛ kpo; shi nilelɔ miɔ ŋɔɔ.

english_verse: A ruler who listens to lies will have corrupt officials.
translation_verse: Nɔyelɔ ni boɔ amale toi lɛ, etsuji fɛɛ tsɔ̃mɔɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji.

english_verse: The poor and all who abuse them must each depend on God for light.
translation_verse: Ohiafo kɛ yiwalɔ kpeɔ; Yehowa ni hãa amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛhiŋmɛii naa nii.

english_verse: Kings who are fair to the poor will rule a long time.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ ni kojoɔ ohiafo yɛ jalɛ naa lɛ, emaŋtsɛsɛi lɛ aaama shi kɛaatee naanɔ.

english_verse: Correct your children, and they will be wise; children out of control disgrace their mothers.
translation_verse: Kpãa kɛ kãmɔ hãa mɔ leɔ nii; shi gbekɛ ni akpoo ejeŋ ahã lɛ lɛ, ewoɔ enyɛ hiɛgbele.

english_verse: Crime increases when crooks are in power, but law-abiding citizens will see them fall.
translation_verse: Kɛji mɛi fɔ̃ji miiye mɛi anɔ lɛ, efɔŋfeemɔ faa: shi jalɔi aaana amɛshigbeemɔ lɛ kɛ amɛhiŋmɛi.

english_verse: If you correct your children, they will bring you peace and happiness.
translation_verse: Tsɔsemɔ obi, ni eeehã ohe ajɔ bo; eeehã otsui anyɔ omli.

english_verse: Without guidance from God law and order disappear, but God blesses everyone who obeys his Law.
translation_verse: He ni gbalɛ wiemɔ ko bɛ lɛ, maŋbii ebuuu nɔ; shi ajɔɔ mɔ ni yeɔ mla nɔ.

english_verse: Even when servants are smart, it takes more than words to make them obey.
translation_verse: Akɛ wiemɔ kɛkɛ tsɔseee tsulɔ; ejaakɛ enuɔ shishi moŋ, shi ebuuu.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who speaks without thinking.
translation_verse: Ani ona nuu ni enaa yɔɔ blɛblɛ kɛ wiemɔ lo? Hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ hã kwashia fe lɛ.

english_verse: Slaves that you treat kindly from their childhood will cause you sorrow.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni hiɛɔ etsulɔ fɔfɔɔle kɛjɛ egbekɛbiiashi lɛ, naagbee lɛ ebuuu nɔ.

english_verse: A person with a quick temper stirs up arguments and commits a lot of sins.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni mli fuɔ lɛ, eteɔ bei shi; ni mɔ ni mli etsɛɛɛ fumɔ lɛ, etɔ̃ɔ babaoo.

english_verse: If you take part in a crime you are your worst enemy, because even under oath you can't tell the truth.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kɛ julɔ jaa nii lɛ, eenyɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewala; enuɔ akɛ aalomɔ nɛ, shi enyɛɛɛ ejaje.

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of being a coward— trust the Lord, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ gbeyeishemɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ tsɔne ehãa mɔ; shi mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ lɛ, eyɛ shweshweeshwe.

english_verse: Many try to make friends with a ruler, but justice comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɛi pii taoɔ mɔbɔnalɛ kɛjɛɔ nɔyelɔi adɛŋ; shi jalɛ saneyeli lɛ Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛɔ.

english_verse: Good people and criminals can't stand each other.
translation_verse: Jalɔi miihi mɛi fɔ̃ji; ni mɛi fɔ̃ji hu miihi jalɔi.

english_verse: These are the sayings and the message of Agur son of Jakeh. Someone cries out to God, “I am completely worn out! How can I last?
translation_verse: Yake bi Agur abɛi nɛ. Nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ kɛɛ Itiel kɛ Ukal akɛ,

english_verse: I am far too stupid to be considered human.
translation_verse: “Lɛɛlɛŋ, mifaŋ kooloo; mijeee gbɔmɔ, ni mibɛ gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔ hu.

english_verse: I never was wise, and I don't understand what God is like.”
translation_verse: Mikaseko nilee, ni asaŋ mileee Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nɔ ko.

english_verse: Has anyone gone up to heaven and come back down? Has anyone grabbed hold of the wind? Has anyone wrapped up the sea or marked out boundaries for the earth? If you know of any who have done such things, then tell me their names and their children's names.
translation_verse: Namɔ ekwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi, ni esaa ekpeleke shi? Namɔ ebua kɔɔyɔɔ naa yɛ ekɔkɔŋ dã? Namɔ efi nu yɛ emama mli dã? Namɔ ŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ koji lɛ emamɔ shi? Te egbɛi hu? Ni mɛni ji ebi lɛ hu gbɛi? Bɛ ole?

english_verse: Everything God says is true— and it's a shield for all who come to him for safety.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ fɛɛ wiemɔ lɛ, anɔkwale ni; Nyɔŋmɔ ji tsɛŋ kɛhã mɛi ni baa lɛ abo lɛ.

english_verse: Don't change what God has said! He will correct you and show that you are a liar.
translation_verse: Kaaŋɔ nɔ ko ofata ewiemɔi lɛ ahe, kɛjeee nakai lɛ, eeekã ohiɛ, ni oootsɔ̃ amalelɔ.” Abɛi krokomɛi hu

english_verse: There are two things, Lord, I want you to do for me before I die:
translation_verse: Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, bo odɛ̃ŋ mibiɔ nibii enyɔ yɛ; kaakãmã mi dani migbo.

english_verse: Make me absolutely honest and don't let me be too poor or too rich. Give me just what I need.
translation_verse: Hã mi kɛ kutumpɔo kɛ nablaba teŋ ajekɛ. Kaahã miye ohia lɛ, asaŋ kaahã mina nii hu. Lɛɛ mi kɛ niyenii pɛ ni ehĩa mi,

english_verse: If I have too much to eat, I might forget about you; if I don't have enough, I might steal and disgrace your name.
translation_verse: koni mikatɔ tsɔ̃, ni mikwa bo, ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Namɔ ji Yehowa”. Ni kaahã miye ohia, ni miyaju, ni mikɛgbe miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi he guɔ.

english_verse: Don't tell a slave owner something bad about one of the slaves. That slave will curse you, and you will be in trouble.
translation_verse: Kaaye tsulɔ ko he osheku ohã enuŋtsɔ, koni tsulɔ lɛ akabalomɔ bo, ni ebu bo fɔ.

english_verse: Some people curse their father and even their mother;
translation_verse: Mɛi komɛi yɛ ni amɛlomɔɔ amɛtsɛmɛi, ni amɛjɔɔɔ amɛnyɛmɛi hu.

english_verse: others think they are perfect, but they are stained by sin.
translation_verse: Mɛi komɛi yɛ ni amɛbuɔ amɛhe akɛ amɛ lɛ, amɛhe tse; tsɛbelɛ, amɛhe ewo muji kpɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: Some people are stuck-up and act like snobs;
translation_verse: Mɛi komɛi yɛ ni woɔ amɛhe nɔ; lɛɛlɛŋ amɛsusuɔ akɛ gbɔmɛi wuji ji amɛ.

english_verse: Greed has twins, each named “Give me!” There are three or four things that are never satisfied:
translation_verse: Shiti yɛ biyei enyɔ, atsɛɔ amɛ akɛ, “Hã mi, Hã mi”. Nibii etɛ̃ etɔɔɔ amɛ, ni nɔ ni ji ejwɛ tete kplokaaa amɛ.

english_verse: The world of the dead and a childless wife, the thirsty earth and a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Nibii ejwɛ komɛi yɛ ni amɛtɔrɔko dã; nomɛi ji gbohiiaje kɛ musu ni fɔɔɔ, kɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ ni etɔɔɔ nu, kɛ la ni esraŋ nɔ.

english_verse: Don't make fun of your father or disobey your mother— crows will peck out your eyes, and buzzards will eat the rest of you.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yeɔ etsɛ he fɛo ni egbeɔ enyɛ tsɔsemɔ he guɔ lɛ, kwãakwãalabitei aaafãmɔ ehiŋmɛii, ni akpaŋai aaaye eloo.

english_verse: There are three or four things I cannot understand:
translation_verse: Nibii etɛ̃ yɛ ni feɔ mi naakpɛɛ tsɔ̃, ni nɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ minuuu shishi;

english_verse: How eagles fly so high or snakes crawl on rocks, how ships sail the ocean or people fall in love.
translation_verse: nomɛi ji, okropɔŋ filikimɔ yɛ ŋwɛi, kɛ onufu nyiɛmɔ yɛ tɛsaa nɔ, kɛ meele nyiɛmɔ yɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ, kɛ bɔ ni feɔ ni suɔmɔ baa nuu kɛ yoo teŋ.

english_verse: An unfaithful wife says, “Sleeping with another man is as natural as eating.”
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ pɛ yoo ajwamãŋ yɔɔ; eyeɔ nii ni etsumɔɔ enaa, ni ekɛɔ akɛ, “Mifeko efɔŋ ko.”

english_verse: There are three or four things that make the earth tremble and are unbearable:
translation_verse: Nibii etɛ̃ hãa shikpɔŋ hosoɔ, ni nɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ, enyɛɛɛ mli emɔ,

english_verse: A slave who becomes king, a fool who eats too much,
translation_verse: Nomɛi ji, nyɔŋ ni etsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ; kɛ buulu ni eye nii etɔ;

english_verse: a hateful woman who finds a husband, and a slave who takes the place of the woman who owns her.
translation_verse: kɛ yoo ni akpoo lɛ, ni ena wu; kɛ tsulɔyoo ni etsɔ̃ enuŋtsɔ ŋa.

english_verse: On this earth four things are small but very wise:
translation_verse: Nibii ejwɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni amɛdaraaa; shi amɛle nii pam.

english_verse: Ants, who seem to be feeble, but store up food all summer long;
translation_verse: Amɛ ji tsatsubii; amɛ lɛ kooloi bibii ni he waaa ni, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛtaoɔ amɛniyenii amɛtoɔ yɛ latsaa be mli.

english_verse: badgers, who seem to be weak, but live among the rocks;
translation_verse: Afutuɔkɔi hu kooloi ni he waaa ni, kɛ̃lɛ amɛfeɔ amɛtsui yɛ tɛsai amli.

english_verse: locusts, who have no king, but march like an army;
translation_verse: Baalabii hu amɛbɛ maŋtsɛ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛfãa yɛ amɛnɔkwɔlɛi anaa.

english_verse: lizards, which can be caught in your hand, but sneak into palaces.
translation_verse: Ooonyɛ okɛ onine amɔ tsunyɛ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ maŋtsɛmɛi amɔjiaŋ ehiɔ.

english_verse: those proud roosters, those mountain goats, and those rulers who have no enemies.
translation_verse: kɛ wuɔnuu saase, kɛ too kpakpo kɛ maŋtsɛ ni nyiɛ ewebii ahiɛ abladeiaŋ.

english_verse: If you are foolishly bragging or planning something evil, then stop it now!
translation_verse: Kɛji ofee buuluianii, ni owo ohe nɔ, aloo ojwɛŋ jwɛŋmɔ fɔŋ lɛ, okɛ onine ato onaabu.

english_verse: If you churn milk you get butter; if you pound on your nose, you get blood— and if you stay angry, you get in trouble.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛji osha fufɔ yɛ tɔ mli lɛ, onaa butru; kɛji oka gugɔ̃ atswɛrɛ lɛ lá jeɔ; ni kɛji owo mɔ ko mli la lɛ bei baa.

english_verse: These are the sayings that King Lemuel of Massa was taught by his mother.
translation_verse: Gbalɛ wiemɔi ni Maŋtsɛ Lemuel nyɛ kɛtsɔse lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: My son Lemuel, you were born in answer to my prayers, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: Ao mibi! Ao mimusuŋbi! Ao mishiwoi abi,

english_verse: Don't waste your life chasing after women! This has ruined many kings.
translation_verse: kaafite ohewalɛ yɛ yei ahe, ni kaanyiɛ maŋtsɛmɛi afitemɔ gbɛi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Kings and leaders should not get drunk or even want to drink.
translation_verse: Oo, Lemuel, esaaa maŋtsɛmɛi akɛ amɛnu wain; aloo nɔyelɔi akɛ amɛaadi dãa ni wa sɛɛ.

english_verse: Drinking makes you forget your responsibilities, and you mistreat the poor.
translation_verse: Kɛji amɛnu lɛ amɛhiɛ aaakpa mla nɔ, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ nɔnalɔi fɛɛ asane hiɛ amɛbu shi.

english_verse: Beer and wine are only for the dying or for those who have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Okɛ dãa ni wa ahã mɔ ni hiɛ heɔ akpãtã, ni okɛ wain ahã mɛi ni amɛwerɛ eho amɛhe lɛ;

english_verse: Let them drink and forget how poor and miserable they feel.
translation_verse: hã amɛnu koni amɛhĩɛ akpa amɛhia nɔ, ni amɛkakai amɛhaomɔ lɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: But you must defend those who are helpless and have no hope.
translation_verse: Wiemɔ ohã mumuii ni nyɛɛɛ awie lɛ; ni ofã mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛɛɛ amɛhe amɛfã lɛ ahe.

english_verse: Be fair and give justice to the poor and homeless. In Praise of a Good Wife
translation_verse: Wiemɔ ni okojo ohã amɛ yɛ jalɛ naa; ye ohiafoi kɛ mɛi ni efi amɛ lɛ asane ohã amɛ. Yoo kpakpa

english_verse: A truly good wife is the most precious treasure a man can find!
translation_verse: Yoo kpakpa lɛ namɔ aaana? Ejara wa aahu fe tɛ̃ŋlɛ̃o.

english_verse: Her husband depends on her, and she never lets him down.
translation_verse: Ewu kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ enɔ; ni lɛ wu lɛ, sɛɛnamɔ ko ebɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: She is good to him every day of her life,
translation_verse: Yoo lɛ, ewalabeiaŋ fɛɛ lɛ, ejurɔ efeɔ ewu lɛ; shi jeee efɔŋ.

english_verse: and with her own hands she gladly makes clothes.
translation_verse: Ebɔɔ toohetsɔi kɛ odonti he mɔdɛŋ; ekɛ enine tsuɔ nii kɛ tsuijurɔ.

english_verse: She is like a sailing ship that brings food from across the sea.
translation_verse: Etamɔ jarayeli lɛji ni yaa shɔŋŋ yaŋɔɔ niyenii kɛbaa.

english_verse: She gets up before daylight to prepare food for her family and for her servants.
translation_verse: Be ni je tsɛreko po lɛ, eteɔ shi ni efeɔ niyenii ehãa eshĩaŋbii, ni etsɔ̃ɔ eweyei lɛ amɛgbɛnaa nitsumɔ.

english_verse: She knows how to buy land and how to plant a vineyard,
translation_verse: Ekwɛɔ shikpɔŋ ni hi ni eheɔ, ni ejɛɔ eninenaa nitsumɔ mli efeɔ abɔɔ.

english_verse: and she always works hard.
translation_verse: Emiaa, ni etsuɔ nii kɛ ehewalɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: She knows when to buy or sell, and she stays busy until late at night.
translation_verse: Ekwɛɔ jogbaŋŋ dani eheɔ jarayeli nii ni sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ he; ekane tete gbooo nyɔɔŋ.

english_verse: and she helps the poor and the needy.
translation_verse: Egbeleɔ edɛŋ ehãa nɔnalɔ, ni ekpãa enine mli ehãa ohiafo.

english_verse: Her family has warm clothing, and so she doesn't worry when it snows.
translation_verse: Esheee snoo gbeyei yɛ eshĩaŋbii lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ shĩaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ bumɔɔ mama tsuji fɛɛfɛji.

english_verse: She does her own sewing, and everything she wears is beautiful.
translation_verse: Eloɔ saanɔboi ehãa ehe; klala fɛɛfɛo kɛ afaseo mama ji ehe bo.

english_verse: Her husband is a well-known and respected leader in the city.
translation_verse: Ayoɔ ewu yɛ koi shi, kɛji ekɛ maŋ onukpai tara shi lɛ.

english_verse: She makes clothes to sell to the shop owners.
translation_verse: Ekpɛɔ klala atadei kɛ hɛfiinɔ, ni ehɔ̃ɔ ehãa guɔyelɔ.

english_verse: She is strong and graceful, as well as cheerful about the future.
translation_verse: Ehewulamɔ mli ehewalɛ kɛ ehiɛnyam yɔɔ; ni eŋmɔɔ be ni baaba lɛ.

english_verse: Her words are sensible, and her advice is thoughtful.
translation_verse: Ewieɔ nilee wiemɔ, ni etsɔseɔ mɔ kɛ mlihilɛ wiemɔ.

english_verse: She takes good care of her family and is never lazy.
translation_verse: Ekwɛɔ eshĩaŋbii lɛ ayaa kɛ baa jogbaŋŋ, ni efeee hejɔ̃ kwraa.

english_verse: Her children praise her, and with great pride her husband says,
translation_verse: Ebii teɔ shi ni amɛjɔɔ lɛ daa; ni ewu hu kafoɔ lɛ.

english_verse: “There are many good women, but you are the best!”
translation_verse: Ewu kɛɔ lɛ akɛ, “Yei pii ebɔ mɔdɛŋ moŋ, shi bo lɛ ota amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ!”

english_verse: Charm can be deceiving, and beauty fades away, but a woman who honors the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Hiɛnyam lɛ lakamɔ ni; ni hefɛo hu, yakayakanɔ ni; shi yoo ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ, aaakafo lɛ.

english_verse: Show her respect— praise her in public for what she has done.
translation_verse: Nyɛŋɔa eninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ eko nyɛhãa lɛ, ni hã enitsumɔi lɛ ajie eyi yɛ koii lɛ ashi.

english_verse: When the son of David was king in Jerusalem, he was known to be very wise, and he said:
translation_verse: Nilelɔ lɛ, ni ji David binuu lɛ, ni ye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ wiemɔi nɛ,

english_verse: Nothing makes sense! Everything is nonsense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense!
translation_verse: “Yakanii amli yakanɔ!” Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Yakanii amli yakanɔ! Fɛɛ lɛ yakanii ni.”

english_verse: What is there to show for all of our hard work here on this earth?
translation_verse: Mɛni gbɔmɔ naa yɛ deŋme fɛɛ ni egboɔ yɛ jeŋ he?

english_verse: People come, and people go, but still the world never changes.
translation_verse: Yinɔ hoɔ eyaa, ni yinɔ baa; shi je lɛ yɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛmiiya naanɔ.

english_verse: The sun comes up, the sun goes down; it hurries right back to where it started from.
translation_verse: Hulu lɛ teɔ shi, ni hulu lɛ saa eyanyɔɔ shi, ni eyeɔ oyai kɛyaa he ni eteɔ shi yɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The wind blows south, the wind blows north; round and round it blows over and over again.
translation_verse: Kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ tswaa kɛyaa wuoyigbɛ; ni kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ tswaa kɛbaa kooyigbɛ; kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ bɔleɔ shi kɛyaa kɛbaa.

english_verse: All rivers empty into the sea, but it never spills over; one by one the rivers return to their source.
translation_verse: Faa fɛɛ faa naa yaboteɔ ŋshɔ mli, kɛ̃lɛ ŋshɔ yiii. Hei ni fai lɛ hoɔ kɛyaa lɛ, jɛi nɔŋŋ amɛhoɔ kɛyaa be fɛɛ be.

english_verse: All of life is far more boring than words could ever say. Our eyes and our ears are never satisfied with what we see and hear.
translation_verse: Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ, henaagbamɔ sɔŋŋ ni; shi adesa nyɛɛɛ ekɛɛ. Etɔɔɔ hiŋmɛi kɛ nikwɛmɔ, ni etɔɔɔ toi hu kɛ ninumɔ.

english_verse: Someone might say, “Here is something new!” But it happened before, long before we were born.
translation_verse: Ani nɔ ko yɛ jeŋ ni aaanyɛ akɛɛ yɛ he akɛ, “Kwɛmɔ, enɛ lɛ nɔ hee ni?” Eba jeeŋmɔ yɛ yinɔi ni etsɔ̃ wɔhiɛ lɛ amli.

english_verse: No one who lived in the past is remembered anymore, and everyone yet to be born will be forgotten too. It Is Senseless To Be Wise
translation_verse: Akaiii blema nibii, ni akaiŋ nii ni baaba, ni yinɔi ni baaba lɛ kaiŋ ŋmɛnɛ kɛ wɔ mli sane. Jajelɔ lɛ niiashikpamɔ

english_verse: I said these things when I lived in Jerusalem as king of Israel.
translation_verse: Mi, Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ, miye Israel maŋtsɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm.

english_verse: With all my wisdom I tried to understand everything that happens here on earth. And God has made this so hard for us humans to do.
translation_verse: Mikɛma mihiɛ akɛ mikɛ nilee baagbugbuu shi, kɛtao nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni afeɔ yɛ jeŋ; ni naa, eko fɛɛ eko lɛ yakanii ni.

english_verse: If something is crooked, it can't be made straight; if something isn't there, it can't be counted.
translation_verse: Nii ni ekɔ̃dɔ̃ lɛ ehiii jajemɔ trɔmɔɔ dɔŋŋ; ni nii ni eko bɛ lɛ anyɛɛɛ akane efalɛ.

english_verse: I said to myself, “You are by far the wisest person who has ever lived in Jerusalem. You are eager to learn, and you have learned a lot.”
translation_verse: Mikɛɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe akɛ, “Mile nii jogbaŋŋ fe mɛi fɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ mihiɛ eye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm dã lɛ, ni nibii ashi ni mikpa egbele mijwɛŋmɔ kɛ nilee mli pam.”

english_verse: Then I decided to find out all I could about wisdom and foolishness. Soon I realized that this too was as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Mikɛma mihiɛ akɛ mibatao male nɔ ni ji nilee kɛ nɔ ni ji sɛkɛyeli kɛ nɔ ni ji kwashiafeemɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: The more you know, the more you hurt; the more you understand, the more you suffer.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nilee tuutu lɛ, ekɛ naagba nyiɛ, ni mɔ ni hãa nilee faa lɛ, ehaomɔi hu faa.

english_verse: I said to myself, “Have fun and enjoy yourself!” But this didn't make sense.
translation_verse: Mikɛɛ mihe akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ maka nɔ ni ji mliflimɔ makwɛ; shwɛ oyinɔ!” Shi naa, enɛ hu lɛ yakanii ni.

english_verse: Laughing and having fun is crazy. What good does it do?
translation_verse: Mikɛɛ yɛ ŋmɔlɔ he akɛ, “Sɛkɛyeli ni”; ni mikɛɛ yɛ miishɛɛ hu he akɛ, “Mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ he?”

english_verse: I wanted to find out what was best for us during the short time we have on this earth. So I decided to make myself happy with wine and find out what it means to be foolish, without really being foolish myself.
translation_verse: Mikɛ mijwɛŋmɔ tao mli mikwɛ akɛ wain baahã mana miishɛɛ lo? Asaŋ mikɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ nilee tao mli bɔ ni mafee mamɔ buulufeemɔ koŋ mli kɛdamɔ shi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni mana nɔ ni hi hã gbɔmɛi abii akɛ amɛfee yɛ jeŋ, yɛ amɛwala be kukuoo lɛ mli.

english_verse: I did some great things. I built houses and planted vineyards.
translation_verse: Mitsu nitsumɔi wuji: mimamɔ shĩai mihã mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe, ni mifee waintromi hu mihã mihe;

english_verse: I had flower gardens and orchards full of fruit trees.
translation_verse: mifee abɔi kɛ tromi mihã mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe, ni mitɛo aduawa tsei srɔtoi lɛ eko fɛɛ eko yɛ mli;

english_verse: And I had pools where I could get water for the trees.
translation_verse: mije bukoi ni akɛ amɛmli nu shwieɔ tsei ni atɛo lɛ anɔ;

english_verse: I owned slaves, and their sons and daughters became my slaves. I had more sheep and goats than anyone who had ever lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: mihe hii nyɔji kɛ yei nyɔji fɛɛ, ni afɔfɔɔ nyɔji hu ahã mi yɛ miwe lɛ mli; mina toi kɛ tsinai fe mɛi fɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ mihiɛ amɛhi Yerusalɛm.

english_verse: Foreign rulers brought me silver, gold, and precious treasures. Men and women sang for me, and I had many wives who gave me great pleasure.
translation_verse: Mibua shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ mishishi maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ shikpɔji anɔ bii adɛŋ jwetri naa mihã mihe. Mina hii lalɔi kɛ yei lalɔi fɛɛ ni laa kɛjieɔ mihiɛtserɛ; ni miyɛ nuu tsuinaa nii ni ji shieŋnyɛmɛi babaoo hu.

english_verse: I was the most famous person who had ever lived in Jerusalem, and I was very wise.
translation_verse: Mibatsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ wulu, ni migbojee bakwɔ fe mɛi fɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ mihiɛ amɛhi Yerusalɛm dã lɛ, ni nilee hu ebɔɔɔ mi.

english_verse: I got whatever I wanted and did whatever made me happy. But most of all, I enjoyed my work.
translation_verse: Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni fee mi akɔnɔ lɛ, mikamaaa mihe. Mitsiii mihe naa yɛ miishɛɛ ko miishɛɛ ko gbɛfaŋ, ejaakɛ mina nibii fɛɛ ni migbo amɛhe deŋme lɛ ahe miishɛɛ. Deŋme ni migbo lɛ he sɛɛnamɔ ji no.

english_verse: Then I thought about everything I had done, including the hard work, and it was simply chasing the wind. Nothing on earth is worth the trouble. Wisdom Comes from God
translation_verse: Shi be ni misusu nibii fɛɛ ni mikɛ minine etsu, kɛ tɔlɛ ni etɔ mi kɛtsu nii lɛ hu fɛɛ he lɛ, nɔ ni mina ji akɛ fɛɛ lɛ yakanii ni, ni etamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔyeli. Anɔkwa, nɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni adesa naa he sɛɛ yɛ jeŋ.

english_verse: I asked myself, “What can the next king do that I haven't done?” Then I decided to compare wisdom with foolishness and stupidity.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛni po maŋtsɛ ni ebaye maŋtsɛ kroko sɛɛ baanyɛ efee? Nɔ ni mɛi ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ lɛ fee lɛ, no nɔŋŋ pɛ lɛ hu ebaafee. No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, miku sɛɛ misusu nilee kɛ sɛkɛyeli kɛ kwashiafeemɔ he.

english_verse: And I discovered that wisdom is better than foolishness, just as light is better than darkness.
translation_verse: Mina akɛ nilee hi fe kwashiafeemɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni la hi fe duŋ lɛ,

english_verse: Wisdom is like having two good eyes; foolishness leaves you in the dark. But wise or foolish, we all end up the same.
translation_verse: ni nilelɔ lɛ enyiɛɔ kɛ hiɛshikãmɔ; shi kwashia lɛ, enyiɛɔ duŋduŋ tamɔ mɔ ni nyiɛ duŋ mli; shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛshɛɛ mli ekome.

english_verse: Finally, I said to myself, “Being wise got me nowhere! The same thing will happen to me that happens to fools. Nothing makes sense.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ mihe akɛ, “Sane koome ni baa kwashia nɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ ni baaba minɔ. Nɛgbɛ mɔ mikɛ nilee pii nɛɛ yaa?” Mikɛɛ mihe akɛ, “Enɛ hu lɛ yakanii ni.”

english_verse: This made me hate life. Everything we do is painful; it's just as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, jeŋshihilɛ je mitsine, ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni afeɔ yɛ jeŋ hao mi, ejaakɛ fɛɛ lɛ yakanii ni, ni etamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔyeli.

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that others would someday get everything I had worked for so hard, then I started hating it all.
translation_verse: Deŋme fɛɛ ni migbo yɛ jeŋ je mitsine, ejaakɛ mina akɛ mibashi fɛɛ kwa mibahã mɔ ni baaba ebaye misɛɛ.

english_verse: Who knows if those people will be sensible or stupid? Either way, they will own everything I have earned by hard work and wisdom. It doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ baafee nilelɔ jio, kwashia ni jio, namɔ le? Ni kɛ̃lɛ nii fɛɛ ni migbo he deŋme ni mina yɛ nilee naa, yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ, lɛ ebaaye. Enɛ hu yakanii ni.

english_verse: I thought about all my hard work, and I felt depressed.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, minijiaŋ je wui akɛ migbo deŋme kɛtsu nii nɛkɛ yɛ je nɛɛ mli;

english_verse: When we use our wisdom, knowledge, and skill to get what we own, why do we have to leave it to someone who didn't work for it? This is senseless and wrong.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ bei komɛi lɛ mɔ ko ni egbo deŋme kɛ nilee kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ ŋaa shiɔ egboshinii lɛ ehãa mɔ ni gboko nii lɛ he deŋme ko, ni ebayeɔ. Enɛ hu lɛ yakanii kɛ nɔ fɔŋ kpele ni.

english_verse: What do we really gain from all of our hard work?
translation_verse: Mɛni ji nɔ ni gbɔmɔ naa yɛ deŋme ni egboɔ kɛ etɔlɛ he yɛ je nɛɛ mli?

english_verse: Our bodies ache during the day, and work is torture. Then at night our thoughts are troubled. It just doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ewala gbii fɛɛ lɛ piŋmɔ ni, ni enitsumɔ fɛɛ lɛ mlifu sɔŋŋ tɔ, ni nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ tete ewɔɔɔ kɛ jwɛŋmɔ sɔŋŋ. Enɛ hu yakanii ni.

english_verse: The best thing we can do is to enjoy eating, drinking, and working. I believe these are God's gifts to us,
translation_verse: Nɔ ko bɛ hã gbɔmɔ adesa fe akɛ nii ni egbo he deŋme ni ena lɛ, eye eko, ni enu eko, ni ena ehe miishɛɛ. Enɛ hu mina akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ ejɛ,

english_verse: and no one enjoys eating and living more than I do.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ namɔ ji mɔ ni baanyɛ eye nii aloo ena miishɛɛ ko kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ nine bɛ mli?

english_verse: If we please God, he will make us wise, understanding, and happy. But if we sin, God will make us struggle for a living, then he will give all we own to someone who pleases him. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ ni feɔ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ duroɔ lɛ nilee kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ miishɛɛ fɛɛ; shi eshafeelɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hãa ebuaa, ni etĩaa nii anaa emaa shi, shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhãa mɔ ni feɔ esuɔmɔnaanii lɛ. Enɛ hu lɛ yakanii ni, ni etamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔyeli.

english_verse: There is a time for birth and death, planting and reaping,
translation_verse: Fɔmɔ be yɛ, ni gbele be hu yɛ; nidumɔ be yɛ, ni nikpamɔ be hu yɛ.

english_verse: There is also a time for love and hate, for war and peace. What God Has Given Us To Do
translation_verse: Suɔmɔ be yɛ, ni nyɛɛ be hu yɛ; ta be yɛ, ni toiŋjɔlɛ be hu yɛ.

english_verse: What do we gain by all our hard work?
translation_verse: Mɛɛ sɛɛ gbɔmɔ naa yɛ deŋme ni egboɔ he?

english_verse: I have seen what difficult things God demands of us.
translation_verse: Mina nitsumɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛfɔ̃ adesai anɔ koni amɛgbo he deŋme lɛ.

english_verse: God makes everything happen at the right time. Yet none of us can ever fully understand all he has done, and he puts questions in our minds about the past and the future.
translation_verse: Ehãa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ feɔ akɔnɔ yɛ ebe mli, asaŋ ekɛ naanɔ he susumɔ ewo adesa mli, kɛ̃lɛ adesa nyɛŋ ena ele nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsu kɛjɛ jeŋ shishitoo kɛyaagbee naanɔ.

english_verse: because God's gift to us is the happiness we get from our food and drink and from the work we do.
translation_verse: asaŋ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ jɔɔmɔ ji akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aye, ni enu, ni ena deŋme ni egboɔ lɛ he miishɛɛ.

english_verse: So I told myself that God has set a time and a place for everything. He will judge everyone, both the wicked and the good.
translation_verse: Mikɛɛ mihe akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ baakojo jalɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ eto be ehã sane fɛɛ sane kɛ nitsumɔ fɛɛ nitsumɔ.”

english_verse: I know God is testing us to show us that we are merely animals.
translation_verse: Mikɛɛ mihe akɛ, yɛ adesai agbɛfaŋ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ miika amɛ koni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ akɛ amɛtamɔ kooloi nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Like animals we breathe and die, and we are no better off than they are. It just doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ adesa naagbee kɛ kooloo hu naagbee lɛ fɛɛ ekome; bɔ ni mɔ nɛ gboɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ nɛ hu gboɔ. Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ mumɔ kome amɛyɔɔ, ni gbɔmɔ ehiii fe kooloo, ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ lɛ yakanii ji amɛ.

english_verse: All living creatures go to the same place. We are made from earth, and we return to earth.
translation_verse: Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ he koome lɛ nɔŋŋ amɛyaa; amɛ fɛɛ lɛ su mli amɛjɛ, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛbaatsɔ̃ su ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: Who really knows if our spirits go up and the spirits of animals go down into the earth?
translation_verse: Namɔ aaanyɛ ekɛɛ akɛ adesa mumɔ lɛ eyaa ŋwɛi, ni kooloo mumɔ lɛ eyaa su mli?

english_verse: We were meant to enjoy our work, and that's the best thing we can do. We can never know the future.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, miyoo akɛ nɔ ko ehiii fe enɛ akɛ gbɔmɔ aye enitsumɔ mli ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ eko, ejaakɛ no ji egbɛfaŋ nɔ. Namɔ baanyɛ ekɛ adesa aku sɛɛ kɛba jeŋ koni ebana nɔ ni yaa nɔ yɛ egbele sɛɛ?

english_verse: I looked again and saw people being mistreated everywhere on earth. They were crying, but no one was there to offer comfort, and those who mistreated them were powerful.
translation_verse: Asaŋ mikwɛ yiwalɛ nibii ni afeɔ yɛ je lɛ mli lɛ. Naa yaafonui jwere mɛi ni awaa amɛ yi lɛ ahiɛ, shi amɛbɛ mɔ ko ni shɛjeɔ amɛmii. Mɛi ni waa amɛ yi lɛ yɛ hewalɛ ko yɛ amɛsɛɛ, ni mɔ ko bɛ ni shɛjeɔ amɛmii.

english_verse: I said to myself, “The dead are better off than the living.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni misusu ji akɛ mɛi ni egboi momo lɛ anɔ hi fe mɛi ni yɔɔ wala mli lolo nɛɛ.

english_verse: But those who have never been born are better off than anyone else, because they have never seen the terrible things that happen on this earth.”
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni nɔ hi fe mɛi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ anɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni anako afɔ lɛ, ni ebanako nibii fɔ̃ji ni afeɔ yɛ jeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then I realized that we work and do wonderful things just because we are jealous of others. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ miyoo akɛ deŋme ni gbɔmɔ gboɔ fɛɛ, kɛ tɔlɛ ni etɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, fɛɛ jɛɔ ehiɛ ni kɔ̃ɔ enaanyo nɔ. Enɛ hu yakanii ni, ni etamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔyeli.

english_verse: Fools will fold their hands and starve to death.
translation_verse: Kwashia kotaa eniji ekɛtaa shi, ni hɔmɔ gbeɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Yet a very little food eaten in peace is better than twice as much earned from overwork and chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Dɛ̃kɔkɔ kome mli nii ni toiŋjɔlɛ yɛ mli lɛ, ehi fe niji enyɔ ni akɛmiigbo yaka deŋme tamɔ ayeɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔ.

english_verse: Once again I saw that nothing on earth makes sense.
translation_verse: Asaŋ mina yakanii ko yɛ jeŋ.

english_verse: For example, some people don't have friends or family. But they are never satisfied with what they own, and they never stop working to get more. They should ask themselves, “Why am I always working to have more? Who will get what I leave behind?” What a senseless and miserable life! It Is Better To Have a Friend
translation_verse: No ji mɔ ko ni ebɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko, ebɛ bi lɛ, ebɛ nyɛminuu hu, kɛ̃lɛ ekpaaa deŋmegbomɔ, ni nii ni ena hu esaaa ehiɛ. Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ biko ehe dã akɛ, “Kwɛ, namɔ kwraa hewɔ ni migboɔ deŋme, ni mikamaa mihe jeŋ ŋɔɔmɔ nɛɛ?” Enɛ hu yakanii ni, kɛ awerɛho sane fɛɛ.

english_verse: You are better having a friend than to be all alone, because then you will get more enjoyment out of what you earn.
translation_verse: Mɛi enyɔ hi fe mɔ kome, ejaakɛ mɛi enyɔ naa deŋme ni amɛgboɔ lɛ he sɛɛ.

english_verse: If you fall, your friend can help you up. But if you fall without having a friend nearby, you are really in trouble.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛji shi amɛgbee lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ kome kɛ̃ aaawo enaanyo nɔ. Shi mɔ ni ekoome lɛ, kpoo hã lɛ ejaakɛ kɛji egbee shi lɛ, mɔ ko bɛ ni aaawo enɔ.

english_verse: If you sleep alone, you won't have anyone to keep you warm on a cold night.
translation_verse: Asaŋ kɛji mɛi enyɔ kamɔ shi lɛ, amɛhe dɔɔ la; shi te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni mɔ ni ekome lɛ ehe aaadɔ la hu?

english_verse: Someone might be able to beat up one of you, but not both of you. As the saying goes, “A rope made from three strands of cord is hard to break.”
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ko tua mɔ ni ekome lɛ, mɔ lɛ nine nyɛɔ etsɔ̃ɔ enɔ; shi kɛji mɛi enyɔ ni lɛ, amɛbaaye mɔ ni tua amɛ lɛ nɔ. Kpãa ni akɛ kpãa blawai etɛ̃ elo lɛ emlitsemɔ wa.

english_verse: Even if you were not born into the royal family and have been a prisoner and poor, you can still be king.
translation_verse: tsɛbelɛ gboklɛfoiatsuŋ ejɛ ni ebaye maŋtsɛ lɛ, aloo afɔ lɛ ohiafo yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.

english_verse: I once saw everyone in the world follow a young leader who came to power after the king was gone.
translation_verse: Misusu gbɔmɛi hiɛkãalɔi fɛɛ ni yaa baa yɛ jeŋ kɛ oblanyo hu, mɔ ni baaba ebaye maŋtsɛ sɛɛ lɛ he.

english_verse: His followers could not even be counted. But years from now, no one will praise him—this makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ayi fa bɔ ni anyɛŋ amɛ akane, shi maŋtsɛ ta amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ. Kɛ̃lɛ yinɔ ni baaba lɛ nyaŋ maŋtsɛ lɛ he. Anɔkwa, enɛ hu lɛ yakanii ni, ni etamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔyeli.

english_verse: Be careful what you do when you enter the house of God. Fools go there to offer sacrifices, because all they do is sin. But it's best just to listen when you go to worship.
translation_verse: Kwɛmɔ jogbaŋŋ kɛji ooya Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ. Kɛji ooya jɛi oyabo wiemɔ toi lɛ, ehi fe oooya jɛi oyashã afɔle ni kwashiai yaa amɛyashãa lɛ; ejaakɛ amɛleee akɛ amɛmiifee nɔ fɔŋ.

english_verse: Don't talk before you think or make promises to God without thinking them through. God is in heaven, and you are on earth, so don't talk too much.
translation_verse: Kaahã onaa miifee blɛblɛ, ni kaahã otsui miihã osha ohe owie yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋwɛi eyɔɔ, ni bo lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ oyɔɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, kaahã owiemɔ miifa.

english_verse: If you keep thinking about something, you will dream about it. If you talk too much, you will say the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛji odi lamɔ sɛɛ lɛ, okɛ nitsumɔ pii shwieɔ onɔ; wiemɔ pii akɛyoɔ kwashia.

english_verse: God doesn't like fools. So don't be slow to keep your promises to God.
translation_verse: Kɛ owo Nyɔŋmɔ shi lɛ, kaahã shiwoo lɛ nɔyeli sɛɛ miitsɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bɛ kwashiai ahe tsui; shi ni owo lɛ ye nɔ.

english_verse: It's better not to make a promise at all than to make one and not keep it.
translation_verse: Faŋ nɔ ni owooo shi kwraa, fe nɔ ni owo shi ni oyeee nɔ.

english_verse: Don't let your mouth get you in trouble! And don't say to the worship leader, “I didn't mean what I said.” God can destroy everything you have worked for, so don't say something that makes God angry.
translation_verse: Kaaŋmɛ onaabu gbɛ ni ehã ofee esha; ni kaakɛɛ yɛ bɔfo lɛ hiɛ akɛ onaa ni etɛ shi. Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli afu yɛ owiemɔ hewɔ ni efite oninenaa nitsumɔ lɛ?

english_verse: Respect and obey God! Daydreaming leads to a lot of senseless talk.
translation_verse: Kɛji lamɔi fa pɛ, wiemɔi hu efa; shi bo lɛ oshe Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei. Wala lɛ yaka nɔ ko ni

english_verse: Don't be surprised if the poor of your country are abused, and injustice takes the place of justice. After all, the lower officials must do what the higher ones order them to do.
translation_verse: Kɛji ona akɛ aawa ohiafo ko yi, asaŋ aatsɔ̃ jalɛ saneyeli hiɛ aaabu shi, ni afeee nɔ ni ja yɛ shikpɔŋ ko nɔ lɛ, kaahã enɛ miifee bo naakpɛɛ, ejaakɛ tsulɔnukpa lɛ, tsulɔnukpa ko ni fe lɛ yɛ ni kwɛɔ enɔ, ni tsulɔi krokomɛi hu yɛ lolo ni amɛgbɛnaa kwɔlɔ fe klɛŋklɛŋ tsulɔi lɛ.

english_verse: And since the king is the highest official, he benefits most from the taxes paid on the land.
translation_verse: Shi enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ maŋtsɛ he yɛ sɛɛnamɔ kɛ̃ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni ŋmɔji yɔɔ nɔ nɔ.

english_verse: If you love money and wealth, you will never be satisfied with what you have. This doesn't make a bit of sense.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni sumɔɔ shika lɛ, etɔɔɔ shika; ni mɔ ni sumɔɔ ninamɔ etɔɔɔ ninamɔ. Enɛ hu lɛ yakanii ni.

english_verse: The more you have, the more everyone expects from you. Your money won't do you any good—others will just spend it for you.
translation_verse: Kɛ ninamɔ fa lɛ, naabui ni yeɔ nii lɛ hu faa. Mɛɛ sɛɛ nɔtsɛ lɛ naa? Sɛɛ ni enaa ji akɛ kɛji ekɛ ehiŋmɛi kwɛ enii lɛ, enaa miishɛɛ.

english_verse: If you have to work hard for a living, you can rest well at night, even if you don't have much to eat. But if you are rich, you can't even sleep.
translation_verse: Apaafonyo na nii babaoo eye jio, fioo ena eye jio, ewɔɔ kɛ miishɛɛ; shi niiatsɛ nii ni ena lɛ he jwɛŋmɔ hãaa ena wɔ ewɔ.

english_verse: I have seen something terribly unfair. People get rich, but it does them no good.
translation_verse: Awerɛho sane ko ni mina yɛ jeŋ nɛ: gbɔmɔ adesa tiaa nii naa ehãa ehe, shi no nɔŋŋ moŋ ni yeɔ lɛ awui.

english_verse: Suddenly they lose everything in a bad business deal, then have nothing to leave for their children.
translation_verse: Nii nɛɛ fɛɛ hiɛ kpãtãa kɛji akɛtee jarayeli. Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ yɛ bi nɛ, shi nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ edɛŋ ni ebaashi ehã ebi lɛ.

english_verse: They came into this world naked, and when they die, they will be just as naked. They can't take anything with them, and they won't have anything to show for all their work.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni ejɛ enyɛ musuŋ eba kɛ ehe yayai lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ eeeku esɛɛ kɛaatee bɔ ni eba lɛ, ni ekɔŋ edeŋmegbomɔ lɛ mli nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛyaŋ.

english_verse: That's terribly unfair. They leave the world just as they came. They gained nothing from running after the wind.
translation_verse: Awerɛho sane nɛ: bɔ pɛ ni eba lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ eeetee. Mɛɛ sɛɛ ena fe akɛ egbo deŋme folo;

english_verse: Besides all this, they are always gloomy at mealtime, and they are troubled, sick, and bitter.
translation_verse: ni ewala gbii fɛɛ amli lɛ, ehi duŋ kɛ awerɛho kɛ mlila kpele kɛ hela mli, ni jeŋshihilɛ je etsine?

english_verse: What is the best thing to do in the short life God has given us? I think we should enjoy eating, drinking, and working hard. This is what God intends for us to do.
translation_verse: Naa, nɔ ni mikpa shi mina akɛ ehi, ni esa hã gbɔmɔ adesa feemɔ ji akɛ eye, ni enu; ni deŋme fɛɛ ni egboɔ yɛ ewala kukuoo ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehã lɛ yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ, eye emli ŋɔɔmɔ koni ena miishɛɛ, ejaakɛ no ji egbɛfaŋ nɔ.

english_verse: Suppose you are very rich and able to enjoy everything you own. Then go ahead and enjoy working hard—this is God's gift to you.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hu ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehã ena shika kɛ nii kɛ hewalɛ koni eye eninamɔ lɛ mli ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ, emɔ egbɛfaŋ nɔ lɛ mli, ni emii ashɛ edeŋmegbomɔ he. Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ nikeenii ni.

english_verse: God will keep you so happy that you won't have time to worry about each day.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ esusuŋ ewala gbii lɛ ahe tsɔ̃, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehã etsui eyi obɔ kɛ miishɛɛ.

english_verse: There is something else terribly unfair, and it troubles everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Nɔ fɔŋ ko yɛ ni mina yɛ jeŋ ni ebu yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ.

english_verse: God may give you everything you want—money, property, and wealth. Then God doesn't let you enjoy it, and someone you don't even know gets it all. That's senseless and terribly unfair!
translation_verse: Mɔ ko hiɔ shi, ni Nyɔŋmɔ hãa enaa shika kɛ nii kɛ anunyam bɔ ni nɔ ko bɛ ni eshweɔ ni enaaa; shi kɛ̃lɛ edurooo lɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛye eninamɔ lɛ mli ŋɔɔmɔ; shi moŋ mɔkpɔŋ ji mɔ ni bayeɔ eninamɔ lɛ mli ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ. Enɛ lɛ yakanii ni, ni eji hejaramɔ sane kpele.

english_verse: You may live a long time and have a hundred children. But a child born dead is better off than you, unless you enjoy life and have a decent burial.
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ko fɔ bii oha, ni ewala sɛɛ tsɛ, ni eye afii babaoo, shi eyeee jeŋ nibii kpakpai amli ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ eko, ni enaaa fuu kpakpa hu lɛ, miikɛɛ akɛ abifao ni ashrake tete nɔ hi fe lɛ.

english_verse: That child will never live to see the sun or to have a name, and it will go straight to the world of darkness. But it will still find more rest than you,
translation_verse: Enaaa hulu lɛ, eleee nɔ ko nɔ ko hu; kɛ̃lɛ lɛ moŋ enaa hejɔlɛ fe mɔ ni

english_verse: even if you live two thousand years and don't enjoy life. As you know, we all end up in the same place.
translation_verse: aaaye afii akpei enyɔ tete, shi eyeee jeŋ nibii kpakpai lɛ amli ŋɔɔmɔ ko. Ani jeee he koome mɛi enyɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ yaa lo?

english_verse: We struggle just to have enough to eat, but we are never satisfied.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ tɔlɛ kɛ deŋme fɛɛ lɛ, emusu kɛkɛ hewɔ; kɛ̃lɛ gbɔmɔ leee mitɔ.

english_verse: We may be sensible, yet we are no better off than a fool. And if we are poor, it still doesn't do us any good to try to live right.
translation_verse: Mɛni ji nɔ ni nilelɔ kɛfe kwashia? Ni mɛni ohiafo naa kɛji ele bɔ ni ahiɛɔ he ahãa yɛ mɛi ahiɛ?

english_verse: It's better to enjoy what we have than to always want something else, because that makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni onaa kɛ ohiŋmɛii lɛ, ehi fe nɔ ni oshweɔ. Enɛ hu lɛ yakanii kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔyeli ni.

english_verse: Everything that happens was decided long ago. We humans know what we are like, and we can't argue with God, because he is too strong for us.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni eba dã lɛ, awo lɛ gbɛi momo; ni ale nɔ ni ji gbɔmɔ, asaŋ akɛ gbɔmɔ nyɛɛɛ ekɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ fe lɛ afu daa.

english_verse: The more we talk, the less sense we make, so what good does it do to talk?
translation_verse: Wiemɔ pii lɛ ekɛ yakanii pii nyiɛ; ni mɛni ji sɛɛnamɔ ni yɔɔ mli hã gbɔmɔ?

english_verse: Life is short and meaningless, and it fades away like a shadow. Who knows what is best for us? Who knows what will happen after we are gone?
translation_verse: Namɔ le nɔ ni hi hã gbɔmɔ adesa ni eyɔɔ yaka wala be kukuoo nɛɛ ni hoɔ tamɔ lamɔ nɛɛ mli? Ni namɔ baanyɛ egba gbɔmɔ nɔ ni baaba jeŋ yɛ egbele sɛɛ?

english_verse: A good reputation at the time of death is better than loving care at the time of birth.
translation_verse: Gbɛi kpakpa hi fe mu ni jara wa, ni gbele gbi hi fe fɔmɔ gbi.

english_verse: It's better to go to a funeral than to attend a feast; funerals remind us that we all must die.
translation_verse: Kɛji otee shĩa ni aafee yara yɛ mli lɛ, ehi fe nɔ ni otee shĩa ni aŋmɛ okplɔ̃ yɛ jɛi, ejaakɛ esa akɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ ahi nɔ akɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ anaagbee ji gbele.

english_verse: Choose sorrow over laughter because a sad face may hide a happy heart.
translation_verse: Awerɛho hi fe ŋmɔlɔ; ejaakɛ awerɛho baahã ohiɛ afee mɔbɔmɔbɔ moŋ nɛ, shi ehãa jwɛŋmɔ mli gbeleɔ.

english_verse: Correction from someone wise is better by far than praise from fools.
translation_verse: Ehi akɛ ooonu ni nilelɔi miikã bo, fe nɔ ni ooonu ni kwashiai miila kɛmiikafo bo.

english_verse: Foolish laughter is stupid. It sounds like thorns crackling in a fire.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kwashiai aŋmɔlɔ lɛ, etamɔ ŋmei fɛlɛmɔ yɛ kukwɛi shishi la mli. No hu yakanii ni.

english_verse: Corruption makes fools of sensible people, and bribes can ruin you.
translation_verse: Niseniianii hãa nilelɔ tsɔ̃ɔ kwashia, ni nyɔɔŋnihamɔ fiteɔ gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔ.

english_verse: Something completed is better than something just begun; patience is better than too much pride.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko naagbee hi fe eshishijee; ni tsuishitoo mumɔ hi fe hewoo mumɔ.

english_verse: Only fools get angry quickly and hold a grudge.
translation_verse: Kaahã omli fu oya, ejaakɛ kwashiai amiinaa ji he ni mlifu yɔɔ.

english_verse: It isn't wise to ask, “Why is everything worse than it used to be?”
translation_verse: Kaakɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛsɛɛ ŋɔɔ fe ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ?” Ejaakɛ jeee nilee mli obaajɛ obi nɛkɛ sane.

english_verse: Having wisdom is better than an inheritance.
translation_verse: Nilee ni gboshinii fata he he yɛ sɛɛnamɔ hã hiɛkãalɔi;

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you just like money; knowledge with good sense will lead you to life.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ nilee baa mɔ yi tamɔ shika baa mɔ yi lɛ, shi nɔ ni nilee kɛfe shika ji akɛ nilee baa mɔ ni yɔɔ eko yi.

english_verse: Think of what God has done! If God makes something crooked, can you make it straight?
translation_verse: Susumɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nitsumɔ he. Namɔ baanyɛ ejaje nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ ekɔ̃dɔ̃ lɛ.

english_verse: When times are good, you should be cheerful; when times are bad, think about what it means. God makes them both to keep us from knowing what will happen next. Some of Life's Questions
translation_verse: Be ni nibii eshwere lɛ, nya; ni kɛji joomɔ be ba lɛ susumɔ he; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ jɛ, bɔ ni afee ni gbɔmɔ adesa akanyɛ ele nɔ ni baaba wɔsɛɛ.

english_verse: I have seen everything during this senseless life of mine. I have seen good citizens die for doing the right thing, while criminals live and prosper.
translation_verse: Mina mihiɛ nii yɛ yaka je nɛɛ mli. Jalɔ gboɔ yɛ ejalɛ nifeemɔ mli, ni gbɔmɔ fɔŋ lɛ moŋ wala sɛɛ tsɛɔ yɛ efɔŋ ni efeɔ mli.

english_verse: So don't destroy yourself by being too good or acting too smart!
translation_verse: Kaafee ohe jalɔ tuutu; asaŋ kaafee ohe nilelɔ tuutu. Mɛɛba oookpãtã bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiɛ?

english_verse: Don't die before your time by being too evil or acting like a fool.
translation_verse: Kaafee ohe yiwalɔ tuutu, ni asaŋ kaafee kwashia. Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ ogbo be ni ogbele be shɛko.

english_verse: Keep to the middle of the road. You can do this if you truly respect God.
translation_verse: Ehi akɛ omɔɔ enɛ mli, ni kaajie onine yɛ he; ejaakɛ mɔ ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ebaaje fɛɛ mli shweshweeshwe.

english_verse: Wisdom will make you stronger than the ten most powerful leaders in your city.
translation_verse: Nilee hãa nilelɔ kome naa hewalɛ ni fe nɔyelɔi nyɔŋma ahewalɛ yɛ maŋ.

english_verse: No one in this world always does right.
translation_verse: Anɔkwa, adesa ko bɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ ni ekpakpa sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ efeɔ, ni efeee esha.

english_verse: Don't listen to everything that everyone says, or you might hear your servant cursing you.
translation_verse: Kaadi gbɔmɛi anaa wiemɔi fɛɛ asɛɛ, kɛjeee nakai lɛ ooonu ni otsulɔ miilomɔ bo;

english_verse: I told myself that I would be smart and try to understand all this, but it was too much for me.
translation_verse: Mikɛ nilee eka enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ mikwɛ. Mitswa fai shi akɛ male nii; shi miyanyɛɛɛ.

english_verse: The truth is beyond us. It's far too deep.
translation_verse: Namɔ baanyɛ ena? Esɛɛ jɛkɛ, ni emli kwɔ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ.

english_verse: So I decided to learn everything I could and become wise enough to discover what life is all about. At the same time, I wanted to understand why it's stupid and senseless to be an evil fool.
translation_verse: Mikɛ mijwɛŋmɔ fɔ̃ nɔ akɛ mibagbɛlɛ shi matao nilee kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli. Mitao akɛ male yitsoŋwalɛ ni yɔɔ buulufeemɔ mli, kɛ bɔ ni buulufeemɔ lɛ sɛkɛyeli ni.

english_verse: Here is what I discovered: A bad woman is worse than death. She is a trap, reaching out with body and soul to catch you. But if you obey God, you can escape. If you don't obey, you are done for.
translation_verse: Mina nɔ ko ni joɔ fe gbele tete; no ji yoo. Etsui mli eyi kɛ tsɔnei kɛ yai ni akɛduɔ mɔ, ni eniji lɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ ni fimɔɔ mɔ ni. Mɔ ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei jeɔ yoo akpa mli; shi eshafeelɔ lɛ yoo duɔ lɛ.

english_verse: With all my wisdom I have tried to find out how everything fits together,
translation_verse: Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, mihiɛ taomɔ mli ekomekome lɛ, nɔ ni mina nɛ.

english_verse: but so far I have not been able to. I do know there is one good man in a thousand, but never have I found a good woman.
translation_verse: Nibii ni mikɛ mijwɛŋmɔ etao aahu lɛ, minako. Mɛi akpe mli lɛ, mina nuu kome pɛ ni yɔɔ hiɛsɔɔ; shi minaaa yoo kome nɛkɛ yɛ amɛteŋ.

english_verse: I did learn one thing: We were completely honest when God created us, but now we have twisted minds.
translation_verse: Naa, nɔ ni kɛkɛ ni mina ji akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ gbɔmɔ adesa koni ehi shi krɔŋŋ; shi gbɔmɔ adesa ni eto ŋai srɔtoi.

english_verse: Who is smart enough to explain everything? Wisdom makes you cheerful and gives you a smile. Obey the King
translation_verse: Namɔ kɛ nilelɔ ye egbɔ; ni namɔ nuɔ nibii ashishi? Nilee hãa gbɔmɔ saa ehiɛ kɛ ŋmɔlɔ, ni ehiɛtumɔ laajeɔ. Ye Maŋtsɛ gbee nɔ

english_verse: If you promised God that you would be loyal to the king, I advise you to keep that promise.
translation_verse: Ye maŋtsɛ lɛ fãmɔ nɔ; yɛ okitã krɔŋŋ ni okã lɛ hewɔ lɛ kaahã enɔyeli hao bo.

english_verse: Don't quickly oppose the king or argue when he has already made up his mind.
translation_verse: Kɛji sane lɛ eŋɔɔɔ enaa lɛ kaashashao shi; oshi ehiɛ oya, ejaakɛ maŋtsɛ feɔ nɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ.

english_verse: The king's word is law. No one can ask him, “Why are you doing this?”
translation_verse: Kɛji maŋtsɛ kɛɛ lɛ, akɛɛɛ dɔŋŋ; ni namɔ po baanyɛ lɛ ebi akɛ, “Mɛni po ofeɔ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: If you obey the king, you will stay out of trouble. So be wise and learn what to do and when to do it.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yeɔ famɔ nɔ lɛ, enaaa amane. Nilelɔ le beyinɔ kɛ gbɛ nɔ ni eeetsɔ̃ efee nɔ ni yɔɔ feemɔ;

english_verse: Life is hard, but there is a time and a place for everything,
translation_verse: ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ yɛ be kɛ gbɛ nɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ atsuɔ ehenii; kɛ̃lɛ naagba kpaaa yɛ gbɔmɔ adesa nɔ.

english_verse: I noticed all this and thought seriously about what goes on in the world. Why does one person have the power to hurt another? Who Can Understand the Ways of God?
translation_verse: Be ni mitao nii fɛɛ ni afeɔ yɛ jeŋ ni gbɔmɔ adesa kpɔfuɔ enyɛmi gbɔmɔ yɛ mli nɛɛ mli fitsofitso lɛ, nɔ ni mina nɛ:

english_verse: I saw the wicked buried with honor, but God's people had to leave the holy city and were forgotten. None of this makes sense.
translation_verse: Mina mɛi fɔ̃ji ni egboi ni afu amɛ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ awalabeiaŋ lɛ, anaa amɛ amɛyaa amɛbaa yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ; shi amɛgbele mli lɛ, ajie amɛyi yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, he nɔŋŋ ni amɛfee nakai efɔ̃ji lɛ yɛ lɛ. Enɛ hu shishinumɔ bɛ he.

english_verse: When we see criminals commit crime after crime without being punished, it makes us want to start a life of crime.
translation_verse: Akɛ ni awooo esha he nyɔmɔ oya hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi ahe ehomɔ kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ.

english_verse: They commit hundreds of crimes and live a long time, in spite of the saying: Everyone who lives right and respects God will prosper,
translation_verse: Yɛ mli akɛ eshafeelɔ feɔ esha shii oha, ni ewala sɛɛ tsɛɔ moŋ nɛ, kɛ̃lɛ mile akɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ ebaahi ehã amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛsheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei;

english_verse: but no one who sins and rejects God will prosper or live very long.
translation_verse: shi yiwalɔ lɛ ehiŋ ehaŋ lɛ, ni ewala sɛɛ etsɛŋ tamɔ hɔ̃ɔŋ, ejaakɛ esheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei.

english_verse: There is something else that doesn't make sense to me. Good citizens are treated as criminals, while criminals are honored as though they were good citizens.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko hu ni yaa nɔ yɛ je nɛɛŋ ni shishinumɔ bɛ he nɛ: gbɔmɛi kpakpai komɛi naa amanehului ni sa gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji moŋ; ni yiwalɔi komɛi yɛ ni amɛna dromɔ ni sa gbɔmɛi kpakpai moŋ. Nɔ ni mikɛɛ ji akɛ enɛ hu lɛ shishinumɔ bɛ he.

english_verse: So I think we should get as much out of life as we possibly can. There is nothing better than to enjoy our food and drink and have a good time. Then we can make it through this troublesome life that God has given us here on earth.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mikafo miishɛɛ ejaakɛ nɔ kpakpa ko bɛ hã gbɔmɔ yɛ hulu shishi nɛɛ, fe akɛ eye nii ni enu nɔ ko, ni ena miishɛɛ. Eeenyɛ ekã he efee enɛ be mli ni eyɔɔ wala ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehã lɛ yɛ je nɛɛŋ.

english_verse: Day and night I went without sleep, trying to understand what goes on in this world.
translation_verse: Be ni mikɛ mijwɛŋmɔ fɔ̃ nɔ akɛ matao male nii koni manu nii ni yaa nɔ, yɛ je nɛɛŋ shishi, hewɔ ni nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane fɛɛ lɛ gbɔmɔ naaa wɔ ewɔ lɛ,

english_verse: I saw everything God does, and I realized no one can really understand what happens. We may be very wise, but no matter how much we try or how much we claim to know, we cannot understand it all.
translation_verse: mina mile Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ nitsumɔi fɛɛ; shi mina akɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni gbɔmɔ baagba ehe naa ehã lɛ, enuŋ nii ni yaa nɔ yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ shishi kɔkɔɔkɔ. Tsɛbelɛ nilelɔ aaakɛɛ akɛ ena ele nii fɛɛ nɛ, shi anɔkwale ji akɛ enyɛŋ ele nɔ fɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: I thought about these things. Then I understood that God has power over everyone, even those who are wise and live right. Anything can happen to any one of us, and so we never know if life will be good or bad.
translation_verse: Mikɛ mitsui fɔ̃ nibii nɛɛ anɔ, ni mitao fɛɛ mli. Nɔ ni mina ji akɛ jalɔi kɛ nilelɔi kɛ amɛnifeemɔi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ fɛɛ yɔɔ; suɔmɔ ni jio, nyɛɛ ni jio, gbɔmɔ ko leee. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kã gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ yakanii ni,

english_verse: But exactly the same thing will finally happen to all of us, whether we live right and respect God or sin and don't respect God. Yes, the same thing will happen if we offer sacrifices to God or if we don't, if we keep our promises or are afraid to make them.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ jalɔ kɛ mɔ ni ejaaa, kɛ gbɔmɔ kpakpa kɛ gbɔmɔ fɔŋ, kɛ mɔ ni he tse kɛ mɔ ni he tseee, kɛ mɔ ni shãa afɔle kɛ mɔ ni eshãaa afɔle fɛɛ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ lɛ amɛnaagbee kome. Nɔ ni baa gbɔmɔ kpakpa nɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ baa efɔŋfeelɔ nɔ, ni nakai nɔŋŋ baa mɔ ni kãa kitã kɛ mɔ ni kãaa kitã fɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: It's terribly unfair for the same thing to happen to each of us. We are mean and foolish while we live, and then we die.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko ni ejaaa yɛ nii fɛɛ ni afeɔ yɛ je nɛɛŋ ji akɛ mɛi fɛɛ anaagbee afee ekome. Gbɔmɛi atsuiiaŋ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ efɔŋ kɛ sɛkɛyeli nifeemɔi, beiaŋ ni amɛyɔɔ walaŋ, shi no sɛɛ lɛ amɛgboiɔ, ni amɛyaa gbohiiaje.

english_verse: As long as we are alive, we still have hope, just as a live dog is better off than a dead lion.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ, eyɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ko kɛ̃ ejaakɛ gbee hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, ehi fe jata ni egbo.

english_verse: We know we will die, but the dead don't know a thing. Nothing good will happen to them—they are gone and forgotten.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ hiɛkãalɔi lɛ amɛle akɛ amɛbaagboi, shi gbohii lɛ amɛleee nɔ ko nɔ ko, ni amɛbɛ nɔ ko hu ni amɛbaana dɔŋŋ, ni hiɛ kpaa amɛnɔ kwraa.

english_verse: Their loves, their hates, and their jealous feelings have all disappeared with them. They will never again take part in anything that happens on this earth.
translation_verse: Amɛsuɔmɔ kɛ amɛnyɛɛ kɛ amɛwuŋayeli fɛɛ eho etee momo; ni kɛyaashi naanɔ lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yaa nɔ yɛ je nɛɛŋ lɛ amɛhe bɛ mli dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: So be happy and enjoy eating and drinking! God decided long ago that this is what you should do.
translation_verse: Yaa nɔ oye oboloo kɛ miishɛɛ, ni onu owain hu kɛ mliflimɔ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ejɔɔ nɔ ni ofeɔ lɛ nɔ momo.

english_verse: Dress up, comb your hair, and look your best.
translation_verse: Hã otadei ahiɛ ayɛ be fɛɛ be; wo oyiteŋ mu be fɛɛ be hu.

english_verse: Life is short, and you love your wife, so enjoy being with her. This is what you are supposed to do as you struggle through life on this earth.
translation_verse: Okɛ oŋa ni osumɔɔ lɛ ahi shi yɛ miishɛɛ mli, bei abɔ ni oyɔɔ yaka wala ni Nyɔŋmɔ eduro bo yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ mli lɛ, ejaakɛ deŋme ni ogbo yɛ je nɛɛŋ lɛ, ogbɛfaŋ nɔ ni ona yɛ jeŋ ji no.

english_verse: Work hard at whatever you do. You will soon go to the world of the dead, where no one works or thinks or reasons or even knows anything.
translation_verse: Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ tsumɔ ni ooomɔ mli lɛ, tsu kɛ onyɛmɔ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ gbohiiaje he ni oyaa lɛ, nɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ nitsumɔ loo yiŋshwiemɔ loo nilee loo jwɛŋmɔ lɛ eko bɛ jɛi.

english_verse: Here is something else I have learned: The fastest runners and the greatest heroes don't always win races and battles. Wisdom, intelligence, and skill don't always make you healthy, rich, or popular. We each have our own share of misfortune.
translation_verse: Asaŋ mina akɛ jeŋ ni ayɔɔ mli nɛɛ lɛ, jeee be fɛɛ be mɔ ni najiaŋ wa yeɔ foidamɔ mli kunim, aloo kãkãlɔ yeɔ ta mli kunim; aloo nilelɔ naa edaaŋŋmaa, aloo hiɛshikãlɔ tsɔ̃ɔ niiatsɛ, aloo mɔ ni he esa yɛ nitsumɔ ko mli hiɛ baa nyam; shi amɛ fɛɛ lɛ dromɔ naa kɛkɛ ni.

english_verse: None of us know when we might fall victim to a sudden disaster and find ourselves like fish in a net or birds in a trap. Better To Be Wise than Foolish
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ adesa leee ebe. Kɛji be lɛ banina lɛ trukaa lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ faaŋ loo ni ahiɛ, loo loofɔji ni akɛ tsɔne edu amɛ. Nilee kɛ Kwashiafeemɔ he susumɔ

english_verse: Once I saw what people really think of wisdom, and it made an impression on me.
translation_verse: Nilee sane ko hu ni mina yɛ jeŋ ni enɔ bɛ hã mi nɛ:

english_verse: It happened when a powerful ruler surrounded and attacked a small city where only a few people lived. The enemy army was getting ready to break through the city walls.
translation_verse: Be ko lɛ maŋtsɛ wulu ko tee akɛ eyaatua maŋ bibioo kɛ emli bii fioo ko. Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ sa maŋ bibioo lɛ yi, ni etswa kawoo gbogboi ekɛbɔle maŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But the city was saved by the wisdom of a poor person who was soon forgotten.
translation_verse: Nuu ohiafo ko yɛ maŋ bibioo lɛ mli, ni lɛ etsɔ̃ enilee nɔ ehere maŋ lɛ yiwala. Shi mɔ ko mɔ ko kaiii nuu ohiafo nɛɛ.

english_verse: So I decided that wisdom is better than strength. Yet if you are poor, no one pays any attention to you, no matter how smart you are.
translation_verse: Shi nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji akɛ nilee hi fe hewalɛ, tsɛbelɛ abuuu ohiafo nilee, ni akɛ ewiemɔ efeee nɔ ko.

english_verse: Words of wisdom spoken softly make much more sense than the shouts of a ruler to a crowd of fools.
translation_verse: Nilelɔ wiemɔ ni ewieɔ lɛ ablɛbi lɛ, anuɔ, ni ehi fe bolɔmɔ ni nɔyelɔ bolɔɔ yɛ kwashiai ateŋ.

english_verse: Wisdom is more powerful than weapons, yet one mistake can destroy all the good you have done.
translation_verse: Nilee he yɛ sɛɛnamɔ fe tawuu nii; shi eshafeelɔ kome kpãtãa nii kpakpai babaoo hiɛ.

english_verse: A few dead flies in perfume make all of it stink, and a little foolishness outweighs a lot of wisdom.
translation_verse: Adɔdɔji ni egboi hãa ojeŋma feelɔ ojeŋma tete shaa, ni ejeɔ fu; no hewɔ lɛ, buulufeemɔ fioo lɛ efiteɔ nilee kɛ nyam nitsumɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Sensible thoughts lead you to do right; foolish thoughts lead you to do wrong.
translation_verse: Nilelɔ tsui kpalaa lɛ kɛyaa nɔ ni ja he; shi kwashia tsui kpalaa lɛ kɛyaa nɔ ni ejaaa he.

english_verse: Fools show their stupidity by the way they live; it's easy to see they have no sense.
translation_verse: Kɛji kwashia nyiɛ tɛmpɔŋ nɔ tete po lɛ, enaaa jwɛŋmɔ, ni ehãa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ naa akɛ kwashia ji lɛ.

english_verse: Don't give up your job when your boss gets angry. If you stay calm, you'll be forgiven.
translation_verse: Kɛji onɔyelɔ mli fu bo lɛ, no akahã oshi ogbɛnaa ni ohiɛ yɛ eshishi lɛ, ejaakɛ saneheŋmɛɛmɔ lɛ ejɔɔ tɔ̃mɔi wuji tete ahe.

english_verse: Rulers do some things that are terribly unfair:
translation_verse: Mina nɔ ko ni ejaaa gbɛ yɛ je nɛɛ mli ni nɔyelɔi feɔ.

english_verse: They honor fools, but dishonor the rich;
translation_verse: Aholeɔ kwashiai anɔ ataraa hei grɔŋgrɔŋŋ; ni akɛ niiatsɛmɛi taraa hei ni bɛ nyam.

english_verse: they let slaves ride on horses, but force slave owners to walk.
translation_verse: Ni mina nyɔji tara okpɔŋɔi anɔ be ni lumɛi nyiɛ amɛnane nɔ tamɔ nyɔji.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you might fall in; if you break down a wall, a snake might bite you.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni tsaa bu lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ eeegbee mli, ni mɔ ni gbuɔ gbogbo ewoɔ mli lɛ, lɛ onufu aaakɔ̃.

english_verse: You could even get hurt by chiseling a stone or chopping a log.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni tsaa tɛ lɛ, lɛ tɛ pilaa, ni mɔ hu ni gbaa lai lɛ, lɛ awui lai yeɔ.

english_verse: If you don't sharpen your ax, it will be harder to use; if you are wise, you'll know what to do.
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ko lema naa egbo, ni ejɔɔɔ naa lɛ, no lɛ ja emia ekpɔiaŋ waa. Nilee akɛtoɔ nifeemɔ he dani ayeɔ kunim.

english_verse: The power to charm a snake does you no good if it bites you anyway.
translation_verse: Akamɛ ni onufu kɔ̃ mɔ dani akɛ ŋkunyaayeli kũ enaa; no lɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko bɛ he.

english_verse: If you talk sensibly, you will have friends; if you talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Nilelɔ daaŋ wiemɔ hãa ehiɛ baa nyam, shi kwashia naabu kpãtãa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ.

english_verse: Fools begin with nonsense, and their stupid chatter ends with disaster.
translation_verse: Ejeɔ ewiemɔ shishi kɛ kwashiai awiemɔi, ni egbeɔ naa kɛ sɛkɛyelɔi awiemɔ.

english_verse: They never tire of talking, but none of us really know what the future will bring.
translation_verse: Kwashia wieɔ babaoo. Gbɔmɔ ko leee nɔ ni baaba; ni mɔ ko hu nyɛŋ egba lɛ nɔ ni baaba yɛ esɛɛ.

english_verse: Fools wear themselves out— they don't know enough to find their way home.
translation_verse: Kwashia deŋmegbomɔ hãa etɔɔ lɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni maŋ gbɛ tete laajeɔ lɛ.

english_verse: A country is in for trouble when its ruler is childish, and its leaders party all day long.
translation_verse: Kpoo hã bo, maŋ ni omaŋtsɛ lɛ gbekɛ ni, ni olumɛi tsɛɔ yelikɛnumɔ leebi.

english_verse: But a nation will prosper when its ruler is mature, and its leaders don't party too much.
translation_verse: Shi ajɔɔ bo, bo maŋ ni omaŋtsɛ lɛ abladei abi ni, ni olumɛi lɛ tsɛɔ okplɔ̃ yɛ be ni sa mli koni amɛye nii ni amɛna gbɔmɔtsoŋ hewalɛ, shi jeee koni amɛtɔrɔ dãa.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to fix a leaky roof— then the house collapses.
translation_verse: Hejɔ̃ hãa tsu duɔ, ni anihao hãa tsu wuleɔ ewoɔ mli.

english_verse: Eating and drinking make you feel happy, and money can buy everything you need.
translation_verse: Ŋmaa hãa mɔ miishɛɛ, ni wain hãa mɔ mli filiɔ lɛ, shi eko fɛɛ eko lɛ shika akɛfeɔ.

english_verse: Don't let yourself think about cursing the king; don't curse the rich, not even in secret. A little bird might hear and tell everything.
translation_verse: Kaalomɔ maŋtsɛ yɛ oyitsoŋ tete, ni kaalomɔ niiatsɛ hu yɛ osɛɛtsu mli, ejaakɛ gbogbo he yɛ folɔ.

english_verse: Be generous, and someday you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Feemɔ ejurɔ oto, ni wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ aaafee bo ejurɔ.

english_verse: Share what you have with seven or eight others, because you never know when disaster may strike.
translation_verse: Feemɔ mɛi kpawo loo kpaanyɔ ejurɔ, ejaakɛ oleee sane gbonyo ni nyiɛ gbɛ baa yɛ jeŋ.

english_verse: If you worry about the weather and don't plant seeds, you won't harvest a crop.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni saraa kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ, eduŋ nii, ni mɔ hu ni kwɛɔ atatui lɛ, ekpaŋ nii.

english_verse: No one can explain how a baby breathes before it is born. So how can anyone explain what God does? After all, God created everything.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni onyɛŋ ole bɔ ni feɔ ni mumɔ baa bi ni yɔɔ yoohɔlɔ musuŋ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ onyɛŋ ole bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ɔ tsuɔ enii fɛɛ.

english_verse: Plant your seeds early in the morning and keep working in the field until dark. Who knows? Your work might pay off, and your seeds might produce. Youth and Old Age
translation_verse: Du odumɔwui leebi kɛ gbɛkɛ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ onyɛŋ ole wui lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni baahi, enɛ loo enɛ, loo kɛji fɛɛ aaahi.

english_verse: Nothing on earth is more beautiful than the morning sun.
translation_verse: La ŋɔɔ, ni kɛji hiŋmɛi miina hulu lɛ, gbɔmɔ naa miishɛɛ.

english_verse: Even if you have a very long life, you should try to enjoy each day, because darkness will come and will last a long time. Nothing makes sense.
translation_verse: Kɛji gbɔmɔ ye afii babaoo lɛ, ena miishɛɛ yɛ fɛɛ mli; shi moŋ ekai akɛ gbele duŋ be fa. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni baa lɛ yakanii ni. Ŋaa kɛhã Oblahii kɛ Oblayei

english_verse: Be cheerful and enjoy life while you are young! Do what you want and find pleasure in what you see. But don't forget that God will judge you for everything you do.
translation_verse: Oblanyo, nya yɛ oblahiiaŋ; hã omii ashɛ ohe yɛ oblahiiaŋ fɛɛ; ye otsui naa sane; feemɔ nɔ ni hi yɛ ohiɛ; shi moŋ kaimɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ bo baakojo yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni ofee lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: Rid yourself of all worry and pain, because the wonderful moments of youth quickly disappear.
translation_verse: Jiemɔ mlifu kɛje oyiŋ, ni kaapiŋ ohe yɛ nɔ ko hewɔ, ejaakɛ ogbekɛbiiashi kɛ oblahiiaŋ lɛ yakanii be ni.

english_verse: Keep your Creator in mind while you are young! In years to come, you will be burdened down with troubles and say, “I don't enjoy life anymore.”
translation_verse: Kaimɔ obɔlɔ lɛ yɛ oblahiiaŋ, be ni gbii fɔ̃ji lɛ kɛ afii fɔ̃ji lɛ nako ashɛ, be mli ni obaakɛɛ akɛ, “Jeŋshihilɛ eŋɔɔɔ” lɛ.

english_verse: Someday the light of the sun and the moon and the stars will all seem dim to you. Rain clouds will remain over your head.
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ hulu la lɛ kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere lɛ kɛ ŋulamii lɛ baafee sulii, ni atatui baabua amɛhe naa ekoŋŋ yɛ nunɛmɔ sɛɛ.

english_verse: The noisy grinding of grain and the voices of singers will be shut out by your deaf ears, but even the song of a bird will keep you awake.
translation_verse: Toii lɛ ni anaa kamɔ ni boɔ blohuiaŋ toi lɛ nuŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko dɔŋŋ; amɛnuŋ nigbɛlɛmɔ tsɔne lɛ gbɛɛmɔ ni naa eba shi lɛ he ekpakpa ko. Loofɔlɔ gbee aaatsĩɛ bo yɛ wɔ mli moŋ, shi ooonu yei lalɔi agbei, ejaakɛ osharãi sɔŋŋ yɔɔ gbɛteŋ.

english_verse: You will be afraid to climb up a hill or walk down a road. Your hair will turn as white as almond blossoms. You will feel lifeless and drag along like an old grasshopper. We each go to our eternal home, and the streets here are filled with those who mourn.
translation_verse: Oooshe hei ni kwɔlɔ gbeyei, ni onyiɛmɔ tete baatsɔ̃ osharã ahã bo. Oyiteŋ baayɛ tamɔ odonti ni egba, ni ohetsimɔ baawa ahã bo, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko efeŋ bo akɔnɔ dɔŋŋ. Akɛni gbɔmɔ adesa miiya enaanɔ shĩa lɛ, no hewɔ ni yarafeelɔi foɔ shi yɛ blohuiaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The silver cord snaps, the golden bowl breaks; the water pitcher is smashed, and the pulley at the well is shattered.
translation_verse: Jwiɛtɛi kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ lɛ baatse, ni shika kane lɛ baatswa shi ni ejwa, ni faaŋyaa gbɛ lɛ baajwa yɛ nubu lɛ naa.

english_verse: Nothing makes sense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense. Respect and Obey God
translation_verse: Yakanii mli yakanii, Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ; fɛɛ lɛ yakanii ni. Wiemɔi lɛ anaamuu

english_verse: I was a wise teacher with much understanding, and I collected a number of proverbs that I had carefully studied.
translation_verse: Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ le nii, ni etsɔ̃ɔ emaŋbii lɛ nii ni ele lɛ eko. Ekase abɛi ahe nii, ejwɛŋ amɛhe ni ekɛ amɛ to shihilɛ he ekwɛ kɛ hiɛshikãmɔ.

english_verse: Then I tried to explain these things in the best and most accurate way.
translation_verse: Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ bɔ mɔdɛŋ etao wiemɔi ni ŋɔɔ, asaŋ ni ja, ni eŋmala anɔkwale wiemɔi.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are like the stick a farmer uses to make animals move. These sayings come from a shepherd, and they are like nails that fasten things together.
translation_verse: Nilelɔ daaŋ wiemɔi lɛ etamɔ kplamɔ tso. Tookwɛlɔ koome ni yɔɔ lɛ, ewiemɔi ni abua naa lɛ yɛ kpɛŋŋ tamɔ plɛkoo ni aka awo tso mli.

english_verse: My child, I warn you to stay away from any teachings except these. There is no end to books, and too much study will wear you out.
translation_verse: Mibi, kwɛmɔ ni ahi yɛ enɛɛmɛi asɛɛ. Woloŋmaa bɛ naagbee, ni nikasemɔ tuutu lɛ gbɔmɔtso tɔlɛ ni.

english_verse: Everything you were taught can be put into a few words: Respect and obey God! This is what life is all about.
translation_verse: Sane tso muu lɛ ni onu lɛ fɛɛ naagbee nɛ. She Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni oye ekitãi lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ enɛ ji nitsumɔ kwraa ni gbɔmɔ yɔɔ tsumɔ.

english_verse: God will judge everything we do, even what is done in secret, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ baakojo wɔ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wɔfee gbɛfaŋ, ehi jio, ehiii jio, teemɔŋ nibii fɛɛ fata he.

english_verse: This is Solomon's most beautiful song. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Solomon lalai amli lala nɛ. Klɛŋklɛŋ lala Yoo lɛ

english_verse: Kiss me tenderly! Your love is better than wine,
translation_verse: Ao, mina ni kulɛ ooobashwɔ minaa; ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ fe wain.

english_verse: and you smell so sweet. All the young women adore you; the very mention of your name is like spreading perfume. *
translation_verse: Omui ni okpaa jeɔ ŋma naakpa, ogbɛi jeɔ ŋma tamɔ muŋma ni afɔse ashwie shi. No hewɔ ni oblayei lɛ sumɔɔ bo lɛ.

english_verse: Hurry, my king! Let's hurry. Take me to your home. The Young Women Speak: We are happy for you! And we praise your love even more than wine. She Speaks: Young women of Jerusalem, it is only right that you should adore him.
translation_verse: MiMaŋtsɛ, hã manyiɛ osɛɛ; hã wɔye wɔhe oyai kɛya opiai lɛ amli. Wɔɔnya, ni wɔmii aaashɛ. Wɔɔkafo osuɔmɔ lɛ fe wain; ŋwanejee ko bɛ he akɛ, no hewɔ yei sumɔɔ bo lɛ.

english_verse: My skin is dark and beautiful, like a tent in the desert or like Solomon's curtains.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Yerusalɛm biyei, midiɔ nɛ, shi mihe yɛ fɛo; midiɔ tamɔ Kedar bui lɛ, mitamɔ muhɔi ni yɔɔ Solomon we lɛ.

english_verse: Don't stare at me just because the sun has darkened my skin. My brothers were angry with me; they made me work in the vineyard, and so I neglected my complexion.
translation_verse: Kaakwɛ mi gãa yɛ dimɔ ni midiɔ, kɛ hulu ni eshã mi hewɔ. Minyɛ bihii lɛ amli fu mi, ni amɛfee mi waintromi anɔkwɛlɔ. Tsɛbelɛ, mi diɛŋtsɛ minɔ lɛ, mikwɛɛɛ.

english_verse: My darling, I love you! Where do you feed your sheep and let them rest at noon? Don't let the other shepherds think badly of me. I'm not one of those women who shamelessly follow after shepherds. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Bo mɔ ni mitsui sumɔɔ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi otoi alɛɛhe lɛ, kɛ he ni ohãa amɛbumɔɔ shwane. Mɛni hewɔ matamɔ mɔ ni tsomloɔ kɛtaoɔ bo yɛ onanemɛi atookui ahe? Nuu lɛ

english_verse: My dearest, if you don't know, just follow the path of the sheep. Then feed your young goats near the shepherds' tents.
translation_verse: Bo yoo ni ohe yɔɔ fɛo fe yei fɛɛ, kɛ oleee jɛi lɛ, bo lɛ jaa tooku lɛ asɛɛ mo kɛya, ni oyalɛ abotiai abii lɛ yɛ tookwɛlɔi abuui lɛ amasɛi.

english_verse: You move as gracefully as the pony that leads the chariot of the king.
translation_verse: Mishieŋnyɛ, mikɛ bo toɔ okpɔŋɔi ni yɔɔ Farao shwiilii lɛ ateŋ eko he.

english_verse: Earrings add to your beauty, and you wear a necklace of precious stones.
translation_verse: Odabii yɛ fɛo kɛ wulamɔnii; okuɛ hu yɛ fɛo kɛ jwinei ni atsɛ̃rɛ.

english_verse: Let's make you some jewelry of gold, woven with silver. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Wɔbaafee shika hewulamɔnii ni akɛ jwiɛtɛi eholɔ mli wɔhã bo. Yoo Lɛ

english_verse: My king, while you were on your couch, my aroma was a magic charm.
translation_verse: Be ni maŋtsɛ kã ekpasa mli lɛ, belɛ minuatrɛ lɛ miije ŋma.

english_verse: My darling, you are perfume between my breasts;
translation_verse: Misuɔlɔ lɛ he jeɔ ŋma krɔbɔo kɛji ekã mifufɔi ateŋ lɛ.

english_verse: you are flower blossoms from the gardens of En-Gedi. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Misuɔlɔ lɛ tamɔ ŋaŋ fɔfɔi yɛ En-Gedi waintromii lɛ amli hã mi. Nuu Lɛ

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely, so very lovely— your eyes are those of a dove. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Naa, ohe yɛ fɛo, mishieŋnyɛ! Naa, ohe yɛ fɛo. Ohiŋmɛi tamɔ okpo hiŋmɛi. Yoo lɛ

english_verse: My love, you are handsome, truly handsome— the fresh green grass will be our wedding bed
translation_verse: Naa, ohe yɛ fɛo, misuɔlɔ, ohe yɛ akɔnɔ hu; jwɛifɔ ji wɔsaa ni wɔkãa nɔ.

english_verse: in the shade of cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: Wɔtsu mplaŋi lɛ tsenedru ni. Ni wɔŋmɔŋmloi lɛ sɛsɛo ni.

english_verse: I am merely a rose from the land of Sharon, a lily from the valley. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Mi lɛ, Sharon fɔfɔi ji mi, mi ji jɔi amli oflɔ fɔfɔi. Nuu lɛ

english_verse: My darling, when compared with other young women, you are a lily among thorns. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Bɔ ni oflɔ fɔfɔi yɔɔ yɛ ŋmei ateŋ lɛ, nakai mishieŋnyɛ yɔɔ yɛ oblayei ateŋ. Yoo lɛ

english_verse: And you, my love, are an apple tree among trees of the forest. Your shade brought me pleasure; your fruit was sweet.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni akututso yɔɔ yɛ kooŋtsei ateŋ lɛ, nakai misuɔlɔ yɔɔ yɛ oblahii ateŋ. Miishɛɛ mikɛtaa ehɔ̃ɔŋ, ni eyibii lɛ ŋɔɔ minaa.

english_verse: You led me to your banquet room and showered me with love.
translation_verse: Ekɛ mi ba shĩa ni aŋmɛ okplɔ̃ yɛŋ ni ekɛ suɔmɔɔ aflaŋaa ha minɔ.

english_verse: Refresh and strengthen me with raisins and apples. I am hungry for love!
translation_verse: Kɛ wainyibii ni aka lɛ fã kɛ fã awaje mi; kɛ aduawai ajɔɔ mitsui he; ejaakɛ suɔmɔ ewo mi hela.

english_verse: Put your left hand under my head and embrace me with your right arm.
translation_verse: Mina ni kulɛ, enine abɛku hɔ miyitso shishi, ni ekɛ eninejurɔ efua mi atuu.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me by the power of deer and gazelles never to awaken love before it is ready. Winter Is Past She Speaks:
translation_verse: Nyɛ Yerusalɛm biyei, mina soŋai kɛ ŋa nɔ ofrote yei akɛ, nyɛkagbaa wɔsuɔmɔ lɛ naa; ni nyɛkatsĩɛa ehiɛ kɛjɛ ewɔ mli, kɛyaashi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsui aaatɔ. Lala ni ji enyɔ Yoo lɛ

english_verse: I hear the voice of the one I love, as he comes leaping over mountains and hills
