translation_verse: Minu misuɔlɔ lɛ gbee! Naa, eeba, eehuru yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, ehiɛ foi waa yɛ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: like a deer or a gazelle. Now he stands outside our wall, looking through the window
translation_verse: Misuɔlɔ lɛ tamɔ soŋai, loo ofrote oblanyo. Naa, edamɔ wɔgbogbo lɛ sɛɛ; eekwɛ samfɛji lɛ amli gãa, eefili kɛ miitsɔ̃ samfɛji fɔji lɛ amli.

english_verse: and speaking to me. He Speaks: My darling, I love you! Let's go away together.
translation_verse: Misuɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, Nuu lɛ “Mishieŋnyɛ, mimɔ ni he yɔɔ fɛo! Tee shi, ni oba wɔtee.

english_verse: Winter is past, the rain has stopped;
translation_verse: Shi, naa, fɛ̃i be lɛ eho etee; nunɛmɔ be lɛ sɛɛ efo kwraa.

english_verse: flowers cover the earth, it's time to sing. The cooing of doves is heard in our land.
translation_verse: Fɔfɔii egba yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; lala be lɛ eshɛ, ni aanu kosɛɛ okpo gbee yɛ wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Fig trees are bearing fruit, while blossoms on grapevines fill the air with perfume. My darling, I love you! Let's go away together.
translation_verse: Agbãmitso miiwo yibii, ni waintsei lɛ hu egba afofroi kɛ ŋma. No hewɔ lɛ, misuɔlɔ, tee shi ni oba wɔtee, bo ji mimɔ ni he yɔɔ fɛo.

english_verse: You are my dove hiding among the rocks on the side of a cliff. Let me see how lovely you are! Let me hear the sound of your melodious voice.
translation_verse: Mikosɛɛ okpo ni hiɔ tɛsaa fɔjiaŋ, yɛ gɔŋ grɔŋŋ hɔ̃ɔŋ, hã mana ohiɛ, ni manu ogbee; ejaakɛ ogbee ŋɔɔ, ni ohiɛ hu yɛ fɛo.

english_verse: Our vineyards are in blossom; we must catch the little foxes that destroy the vineyards. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Nyɛmɔmɔa osɔi lɛ, osɔi bibii ni fiteɔ waintromii lɛ, ejaakɛ wɔwaintsei lɛ egba afofro.” Yoo lɛ

english_verse: My darling, I am yours, and you are mine, as you feed your sheep among the lilies.
translation_verse: Minɔ ji misuɔlɔ lɛ, ni lɛ hu enɔ ji mi. Elɛɔ etoi lɛ yɛ oflɔ fɔfɔii ateŋ.

english_verse: Pretend to be a young deer dancing on mountain slopes until daylight comes and shadows fade away.
translation_verse: Kuu osɛɛ, misuɔlɔ, tamɔ soŋai loo ofrote oblanyo, yɛ Beta gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni oba dani je atsɛre, ni duŋ alaaje.

english_verse: While in bed at night, I reached for the one I love with heart and soul. I looked for him, but he wasn't there.
translation_verse: Be ni mikã misaa nɔ nyɔɔŋ lɛ, mitao mɔ ni mitsui sumɔɔ lɛ; mitao lɛ, shi minaaa lɛ. Mitsɛ lɛ, shi ehereee mi nɔ.

english_verse: So I searched through the town for the one I love. I looked on every street, but he wasn't there.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ mate shi mayakpa maŋ lɛ mli gbɛjegbɛi kɛ blohuiaŋ. Mayatao mɔ ni mitsui sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ. Mitao lɛ, shi minaaa lɛ.

english_verse: I even asked the guards patrolling the town, “Have you seen the one I love so much?”
translation_verse: Bulɔi ni buɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, na mi. Mibi amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛna mɔ ni mitsui sumɔɔ lɛ lo?”

english_verse: Right after that, I found him. I held him and would not let go until I had taken him to the home of my mother.
translation_verse: Miho amɛhe fioo pɛ, kɛkɛ ni mina mɔ ni mitsui sumɔɔ lɛ. Mimɔ emli; ni miŋmɛɛɛ ehe kwraa kɛyashi mikɛ lɛ ba minyɛwe lɛ, kɛtee minyɛ, mɔ ni fɔ mi lɛ sɛɛtsuŋ.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me by the power of deer and gazelles, never to awaken love before it is ready. The Groom and the Wedding Party Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Nyɛ Yerusalɛm biyei, mina soŋai kɛ ŋa nɔ ofrote akɛ nyɛkagbaa wɔsuɔmɔ lɛ naa, ni nyɛkatsĩɛa ehiɛ kɛjɛ ewɔ mli kɛyaashi be ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsui aaatɔ. Lala ni ji etɛ̃ Yoo lɛ

english_verse: What do we see approaching from the desert like a cloud of smoke? With it comes the sweet smell of spices, including myrrh and frankincense.
translation_verse: Mɛni ji nɔ ni jɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ baa tamɔ lasu kusuu ni teɔ shi nɛɛ? Namɔ nɛ ni mire kɛ krɔbɔo kɛ jarayelɔi atsofãi srɔtoi fɛɛ jeɔ ŋma yɛ ehe nɛɛ?

english_verse: It is King Solomon carried on a throne, surrounded by sixty of Israel's best soldiers.
translation_verse: Naa, Solomon ji mɔ ni atere yɛ akpãkãi lɛ mli lɛ. Asraafoi kakabãŋi nyɔŋmai ekpaa ni jɛ Israel kãkãalɔi ateŋ lɛ ebɔle ehe.

english_verse: Each of them wears a sword. They are experts at fighting, even in the dark.
translation_verse: Amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛmia kɛ tawuu klantei, ni amɛhe esa kɛ tawuu. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ klante ŋmɔ ehɛ, yɛ nyɔɔŋ tuamɔ hewɔ.

english_verse: The throne is made of trees from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ Solomon kɛ Lebanon tsei fee akpakãi hã ehe.

english_verse: Its posts are silver, the back is gold, and the seat is covered with purple cloth. You women of Jerusalem have taken great care to furnish the inside.
translation_verse: Ehe tsei lɛ akɛ jwiɛtɛi fee. Emli kpasamɔnɔ lɛ akɛ shika fee. Emli sɛi lɛ akɛ mama afaseo ha he. Yerusalɛm biyei lɛ kɛ suɔmɔ wula emligbɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Now come and see the crown given to Solomon by his mother on his happy wedding day.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Zion biyei, nyɛjea kpo nyɛbakwɛa Maŋtsɛ Solomon, kɛ akekre ni enyɛ kɛfi lɛ yɛ eyookpeemɔ gbi kɛ emliflimɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely, so very lovely— as you look through your veil, your eyes are those of a dove. Your hair tosses about as gracefully as goats coming down from Gilead.
translation_verse: Naa, ohe yɛ fɛo, misuɔlɔ, naa, ohe yɛ fɛo. Ohiŋmɛiŋ kpɛlɛɔ kɛ suɔmɔ tamɔ okpo hiŋmɛii, kɛtsɔ̃ɔ ohiɛhaanɔ lɛ mli. Oyitsɔi bua onɔ tamɔ abotiai aku ni bua shi yɛ Gilead gɔji lɛ ahe.

english_verse: Your teeth are whiter than sheep freshly washed; they match perfectly, not one is missing.
translation_verse: Onyanyɔji yɛɔ futafuta tamɔ gwantɛŋi ni aku amɛhetsɔi ni aju amɛhe. Amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛfɔfɔɔ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ ni eko eko gboko.

english_verse: Your lips are crimson cords, your mouth is shapely; behind your veil are hidden beautiful rosy cheeks.
translation_verse: Onaabu tamɔ kpãa tsuru, ni onaabu yɛ fɛo kɛ wiemɔ. Odabii yɛ ohiɛhaanɔ lɛ mli tamɔ maŋo tsuru.

english_verse: Your neck is more graceful than the tower of David, decorated with thousands of warriors' shields.
translation_verse: Okuɛ tamɔ David mɔɔ ni kwɔ, ni ato tawuunii yɛ mli lɛ, ni tawulɔi atsɛŋi bibii kɛ ewuji tsotsoro shi yɛ mli fɛɛ tamɔ kuɛnii.

english_verse: Your breasts are perfect; they are twin deer feeding among lilies.
translation_verse: Ofufɔi tamɔ soŋai bii enyɔ. Tamɔ ofrotebii hãaji ni yeɔ nii yɛ oflɔ fɔfɔii ateŋ.

english_verse: I will hasten to those hills sprinkled with sweet perfume and stay there till sunrise.
translation_verse: Mayatee mihe yɛ mire gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mayashera shi yɛ krɔbɔo gɔŋkpɔ lɛ nɔ, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni je aaana ni hiɛ aaabu.

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely in every way.
translation_verse: Mishieŋnyɛ, ohe yɛ fɛo kɛmɔ shi; kpa ko kpa ko bɛ ohe.

english_verse: My bride, together we will leave Lebanon! We will say goodbye to the peaks of Mount Amana, Senir, and Hermon, where lions and leopards live in the caves.
translation_verse: Miyɛmfro, okɛ mi ajɛ Lebanon; okɛ mi ajɛ Lebanon ni wɔya. Jɛɛ Amana gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ oba; Jɛɛ Senir kɛ Hermon gɔji lɛ anɔ, jatai kɛ mlaŋtswii ashihilɛhe lɛ, oba ni wɔtee.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, you have stolen my heart! With one glance from your eyes and the glow of your necklace, you have stolen my heart.
translation_verse: Minyɛmi yoo, miyɛmfro, oŋɔ mitsui; okɛ okwɛmɔ ni okwɛ mi shi kome kɛ ojarawatɛ kome ni yɔɔ okuɛnii lɛ mli lɛ eŋɔ mitsui kwraa.

english_verse: Your love is sweeter than wine; the smell of your perfume is more fragrant than spices.
translation_verse: Minyɛmi yoo, miyɛmfro, osuɔmɔ yɛ akɔnɔ. Osuɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ aahu fe wain. Omui lɛ jeɔ ŋma aahu fe tsofakɛŋmai srɔtoi fɛɛ.

english_verse: Your lips are a honeycomb; milk and honey flow from your tongue. Your dress has the aroma of cedar trees from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Miyɛmfro, onaabu tsereɔ wo shwieɔ shi; wo kɛ fufɔ yɛ olilɛi shishi. Ohebo mli ŋma tamɔ Lebanon ŋma.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, you are a garden, a fountain closed off to all others.
translation_verse: Minyɛmi yoo, miyɛmfro lɛ, etamɔ trom ni aŋmɛ naa; etamɔ abɔɔ ni aŋmɛ naa; etamɔ nuhiŋmɛi ni tueɔ ni asɔo naa.

english_verse: Your arms are vines, covered with delicious fruits and all sorts of spices— henna, nard,
translation_verse: Otsei fɔbii lɛ tamɔ trom ni maŋo tsei yɔɔ mli, ni amɛwoɔ yibii srɔtoi ni yɔɔ fɛo naakpa tamɔ kofer fɔfɔi kɛ nardo fiaa.

english_verse: You are a spring in the garden, a fountain of pure water, and a refreshing stream from Mount Lebanon. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Bo oji abɔɔ ni nuhiŋmɛi kɛ wala nubu yɔɔ omli, fai ni hoɔ kɛjɛɔ Lebanon ji bo. Yoo lɛ

english_verse: Let the north wind blow, the south wind too! Let them spread the aroma of my garden, so the one I love may enter and taste its delicious fruits.
translation_verse: Bo, kooyigbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ, ohiɛ atsɛ̃, ni bo wuoyigbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ, ba ni obatswa yɛ mitrom lɛ mli, koni anu emli ŋma gbalaŋŋ lɛ yɛ hei fɛɛ. Hã misuɔlɔ lɛ aba ebɔɔ lɛ mli ni ebaye etsei ayibii ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, I come to my garden and enjoy its spices. I eat my honeycomb and honey; I drink my wine and milk. Their Friends Speak: Eat and drink until you are drunk with love. Another Dream She Speaks:
translation_verse: Minyɛmi yoo, miyɛmfro, miba mitrom lɛ mli, miibua mimire kɛ tsofaikɛŋmai anaa. Miiye miwo agbaku kɛ emli wo lɛ. Miinu miwain kɛ mifufɔ lɛ. Yoo lɛ Minanemɛi, nyɛyea ni nyɛnua, ni nyɛ, suɔlɔi, nyɛnua ni nyɛtɔrɔa! Lala ni ji ejwɛ Yoo lɛ

english_verse: I was asleep, but dreaming: The one I love was at the door, knocking and saying, “My darling, my very own, my flawless dove, open the door for me! My head is drenched with evening dew.”
translation_verse: Be ni miwɔ lɛ, mitsui hiɛ kã. Naa! Mishieŋtsɛ miishi shinaa lɛ. Nuu lɛ Minyɛmi yoo, misuɔlɔ! Mikosɛɛ okpo, misuɔlɔ ni fe fɛɛ, bɔ efɔ miyitsei ahe fɛɛ; miyitsɔi akuklui lɛ eyi obɔ̃ kɛ nyɔɔŋ bɔ. Yoo lɛ

english_verse: But I had already undressed and bathed my feet. Should I dress again and get my feet dirty?
translation_verse: Mijie mitade lɛ; mɛni hewɔ mawo ekoŋŋ? Mifɔ minaji ahe, mɛni hewɔ mawo amɛhe muji ekoŋŋ?

english_verse: Then my darling's hand reached to open the latch, and my heart stood still.
translation_verse: Misuɔlɔ lɛ kpã enine mli ekɛmɔ klɔklɔ lɛ mli, kɛkɛ ni mitsui tswa kɛ miishɛɛ.

english_verse: When I rose to open the door, my hands and my fingers dripped with perfume.
translation_verse: Mite shi ni mayagbele misuɔlɔ lɛ, mire tsere yɛ miniji ahe, mire ŋleŋle tsere yɛ miwaobii ahe shwie shinaa klɔklɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: And I yearned for him while he spoke to me, but when I opened the door, my darling had disappeared. I searched and shouted, but I could not find him— there was no answer.
translation_verse: Shi be ni migbele misuɔlɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ ehe etee momo. Mishwe akɛ manu egbee. Mitao lɛ, shi minaaa lɛ. Mitsɛ lɛ, shi ehereee mi nɔ hu.

english_verse: Then I was found by the guards patrolling the town and guarding the wall. They beat me up and stripped off my robe.
translation_verse: Bulɔi lɛ na mi be ni amɛnyiɛ amɛbuɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ. Amɛtswia mi nii, ni amɛpila mi. Gbogbo nɔ bulɔi lɛ shɔ̃ mihiɛhaanɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, if you find the one I love, please say to him, “She is weak with desire.” Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Nyɛ Yerusalɛm biyei, nyɛwoa mi shi veveeve akɛ kɛji nyɛna misuɔlɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛa lɛ akɛ, suɔmɔ ewo mi hela. Yei lɛ

english_verse: Most beautiful of women, why is the one you love more special than others? Why do you ask us to tell him how you feel? She Speaks:
translation_verse: Bo yoo ni ohe yɔɔ fɛo fe yei fɛɛ, Mɛni osuɔlɔ lɛ kɛfe suɔlɔ kroko, hewɔ ni obiɔ akɛ wɔwo bo shi veveeve nɛɛ? Yoo lɛ

english_verse: He is handsome and healthy, the most outstanding among ten thousand.
translation_verse: Misuɔlɔ lɛ he yɛ fɛo, ni ehewolo kã. Esoro lɛ yɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma he.

english_verse: His head is purest gold; his hair is wavy, black as a raven.
translation_verse: Ehiɛ tsuɔ oo, eyitsɔi edɔrɔdrɔi; ni ediɔ tamɔ kwãakwãalabite.

english_verse: His eyes are a pair of doves bathing in a stream flowing with milk.
translation_verse: Ehiŋmɛii tamɔ fai ahe okpoi ahiŋmɛii; okpoi ni amɛju amɛhe kɛ fufɔ ni amɛdamɔ fai atoi.

english_verse: His face is a garden of sweet-smelling spices; his lips are lilies dripping with perfume.
translation_verse: Edabii tamɔ tsofakɛŋma akofii ni miije ŋma. Enaabu yɛ fɛo tamɔ Oflɔ fɔfɔi ni efɔ kɛ krɔbɔo ŋleŋle.

english_verse: His arms are branches of gold covered with jewels; his body is ivory decorated with sapphires.
translation_verse: Eniji yɛ fɛo, ni ewo gai ni ojarawatɛi tara mli. Egbɔmɔtso tamɔ nɔ ko ni akɛ shuɔ wu fee, ni akɛ safiro etara he.

translation_verse: Edaaŋ wiemɔ ŋɔɔ naakpa, ni enɔ fɛɛ nɔ yɛ akɔnɔ. Naa, nyɛ Yerusalɛm biyei, bɔ ni misuɔlɔ, mishieŋtsɛ lɛ yɔɔ nɛ.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, I come to my garden and enjoy its spices. I eat my honeycomb and honey; I drink my wine and milk. Their Friends Speak: Eat and drink until you are drunk with love. Another Dream She Speaks:

english_verse: I was asleep, but dreaming: The one I love was at the door, knocking and saying, “My darling, my very own, my flawless dove, open the door for me! My head is drenched with evening dew.”
translation_verse: Be ni miwɔ lɛ, mitsui hiɛ kã. Naa! Mishieŋtsɛ miishi shinaa lɛ. Nuu lɛ Minyɛmi yoo, misuɔlɔ! Mikosɛɛ okpo, misuɔlɔ ni fe fɛɛ, bɔ efɔ miyitsei ahe fɛɛ; miyitsɔi akuklui lɛ eyi obɔ̃ kɛ nyɔɔŋ bɔ. Yoo lɛ

english_verse: But I had already undressed and bathed my feet. Should I dress again and get my feet dirty?
translation_verse: Mijie mitade lɛ; mɛni hewɔ mawo ekoŋŋ? Mifɔ minaji ahe, mɛni hewɔ mawo amɛhe muji ekoŋŋ?

english_verse: Then my darling's hand reached to open the latch, and my heart stood still.
translation_verse: Misuɔlɔ lɛ kpã enine mli ekɛmɔ klɔklɔ lɛ mli, kɛkɛ ni mitsui tswa kɛ miishɛɛ.

english_verse: When I rose to open the door, my hands and my fingers dripped with perfume.
translation_verse: Mite shi ni mayagbele misuɔlɔ lɛ, mire tsere yɛ miniji ahe, mire ŋleŋle tsere yɛ miwaobii ahe shwie shinaa klɔklɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: And I yearned for him while he spoke to me, but when I opened the door, my darling had disappeared. I searched and shouted, but I could not find him— there was no answer.
translation_verse: Shi be ni migbele misuɔlɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ ehe etee momo. Mishwe akɛ manu egbee. Mitao lɛ, shi minaaa lɛ. Mitsɛ lɛ, shi ehereee mi nɔ hu.

english_verse: Then I was found by the guards patrolling the town and guarding the wall. They beat me up and stripped off my robe.
translation_verse: Bulɔi lɛ na mi be ni amɛnyiɛ amɛbuɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ. Amɛtswia mi nii, ni amɛpila mi. Gbogbo nɔ bulɔi lɛ shɔ̃ mihiɛhaanɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, if you find the one I love, please say to him, “She is weak with desire.” Their Friends Speak:

english_verse: He is handsome and healthy, the most outstanding among ten thousand.
translation_verse: Misuɔlɔ lɛ he yɛ fɛo, ni ehewolo kã. Esoro lɛ yɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma he.

english_verse: His head is purest gold; his hair is wavy, black as a raven.
translation_verse: Ehiɛ tsuɔ oo, eyitsɔi edɔrɔdrɔi; ni ediɔ tamɔ kwãakwãalabite.

english_verse: His eyes are a pair of doves bathing in a stream flowing with milk.
translation_verse: Ehiŋmɛii tamɔ fai ahe okpoi ahiŋmɛii; okpoi ni amɛju amɛhe kɛ fufɔ ni amɛdamɔ fai atoi.

english_verse: His face is a garden of sweet-smelling spices; his lips are lilies dripping with perfume.
translation_verse: Edabii tamɔ tsofakɛŋma akofii ni miije ŋma. Enaabu yɛ fɛo tamɔ Oflɔ fɔfɔi ni efɔ kɛ krɔbɔo ŋleŋle.

english_verse: His arms are branches of gold covered with jewels; his body is ivory decorated with sapphires.
translation_verse: Eniji yɛ fɛo, ni ewo gai ni ojarawatɛi tara mli. Egbɔmɔtso tamɔ nɔ ko ni akɛ shuɔ wu fee, ni akɛ safiro etara he.

english_verse: His legs are columns of marble on feet of gold. He stands there majestic like Mount Lebanon and its choice cedar trees.

translation_verse: Misuɔlɔ lɛ etee etrom lɛ mli, yɛ tsofakɛŋma akofii lɛ ahe, koni eyalɛ etooku lɛ yɛ jɛi, koni etserɛ oflɔ fɔfɔii hu.

translation_verse: Misuɔlɔ lɛ nɔ ji mi, ni mi hu minɔ ji lɛ. Lɛ mɔ ni elɛɔ etooku lɛ yɛ oflɔ fɔfɔii ateŋ lɛ. Nuu lɛ

english_verse: My dearest, the cities of Tirzah and Jerusalem are not as lovely as you. Your charms are more powerful than all of the stars in the heavens.
translation_verse: Mishieŋnyɛ, ohe yɛ fɛo tamɔ Tirza maŋ, ni ohe yɛ akɔnɔ tamɔ Yerusalɛm. Ohe yɛ gbeyei tamɔ tabilɔi ni hiɛ aflaŋai.

english_verse: Turn away your eyes— they make me melt. Your hair tosses about as gracefully as goats coming down from Gilead.
translation_verse: Tsɔ̃ ohiɛ oto afã ejaakɛ ohiŋmɛii gbaa minaa. Oyitsɔi tamɔ abotiai aku ni miikpeleke Gilead gɔji lɛ ahetsɔi.

english_verse: Your teeth are whiter than sheep freshly washed; they match perfectly, not one is missing.
translation_verse: Onyanyɔji yɛɔ futaa tamɔ gwantɛŋi ni aju amɛhe ni amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛfɔfɔɔ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ ni amɛteŋ ekome folo gboko.

translation_verse: Odabii yɛ fɛo tamɔ maŋo ni etsu yɛ ohiɛhaanɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: What if I could have sixty queens, eighty wives, and thousands of others!
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ aaahi maŋnyɛmɛi nyɔŋmai ekpaa, kɛ hemɛi nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ, kɛ oblayei ni aleee amɛyibɔ moŋ nɛ;

english_verse: You would be my only choice, my flawless dove, the favorite child of your mother. The young women, the queens, and all the others tell how excited you are as they sing your praises:
translation_verse: shi mɔ koome pɛ ji misuɔlɔ, ni ehe yɛ fɛo tamɔ okpo. Enyɛ suɔmɔ bi koome ji lɛ. Enyɛ enaaa kpa ko yɛ ehe. Oblayei lɛ na lɛ, ni amɛna ehe miishɛɛ. Maŋnyɛmɛi kɛ lumɛi jie eyi.

translation_verse: Namɔ pueɔ tamɔ leebi hulu nɛɛ, ni ehe yɔɔ fɛo tamɔ nyɔɔŋtsere, ni ehe tse tamɔ hulu, ni ehe yɔɔ gbeyei tamɔ tabilɔi ni hiɛ aflaŋai nɛɛ?

translation_verse: Mikpeleke shi kɛtee tsoyibii atrom lɛ mli koni mayakwɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli jwɛi frɔ̃frɔ̃ lɛ. Mitee koni mayakwɛ akɛ waintsei lɛ kɛ maŋotsei lɛ hu egba afofro lo?

english_verse: You are a princess, and your feet are graceful in their sandals. Your thighs are works of art, each one a jewel;
translation_verse: Bo lumɔ biyoo, Onajifãamɔi yɛ otokotai amli yɛ fɛo naakpa! Oshuɔji yɛ fɛo tamɔ jwinei ni ŋaalɔ nukpa kɛ eniji fee.

english_verse: your navel is a wine glass filled to overflowing. Your body is full and slender like a bundle of wheat bound together by lilies.
translation_verse: Olaŋmɔ tamɔ likɔlikɔ kokroo ni wain ni ŋɔɔ etãko yɛ mli dã. Omusu tamɔ ŋmãa ku, ni akɛ oflɔ fɔfɔii etserɛ he.

english_verse: Your breasts are like twins of a deer.
translation_verse: Ofufɔi tamɔ ofrote bii enyɔ, loo tamɔ soŋaibii hãaji.

english_verse: Your neck is like ivory, and your eyes sparkle like the pools of Heshbon by the gate of Bath-Rabbim. Your nose is beautiful like Mount Lebanon above the city of Damascus.

english_verse: Your head is held high like Mount Carmel; your hair is so lovely it holds a king prisoner.
translation_verse: Oyitso ni ma onɔ tamɔ Karmel Gɔŋ; Oyitsɔi akuklui tamɔ mama afaseo. Oyitsɔi fɛo lɛ ŋɔɔ maŋtsɛ nom.

english_verse: You are very beautiful, so desirable!
translation_verse: Mishieŋnyɛ, ohe yɛ fɛo, ni ohe yɛ akɔnɔ akɛ nɔ ko.

english_verse: You are tall and slender like a palm tree, and your breasts are full.
translation_verse: Oje oblaŋ tamɔ tɛŋ, ni ofufɔi tamɔ ŋmedurui.

english_verse: I will climb that tree and cling to its branches. I will discover that your breasts are clusters of grapes, and that your breath is the aroma of apples.
translation_verse: Mikɛɛ, “Makwɔ tɛŋ lɛ, ni mamɔmɔ eniji lɛ amli. Ao, mina ofufɔi tamɔ waintso yibii ŋmedurui, ni mumɔ ni jɛɔ ogugɔ mli jeɔ ŋma tamɔ aadɔŋ.” Yoo lɛ

english_verse: Kissing you is more delicious than drinking the finest wine. How wonderful and tasty! She Speaks:
translation_verse: Mina ni onaashwɔmɔ ŋɔɔmɔ tamɔ wain kpakpa fe fɛɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔ naabu kɛ nyanyɔŋ teŋ, kɛyaa omusuŋ tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: My darling, I am yours, and you desire me.
translation_verse: Mi lɛ, misuɔlɔ lɛ nɔ ji mi. Ni mi ji mɔ ni eshweɔ.

english_verse: Let's stroll through the fields and sleep in the villages.
translation_verse: Misuɔlɔ, ba ni wɔtee ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni wɔyato gbɔ yɛ akrowai lɛ amli.

english_verse: At dawn let's slip out and see if grapevines and fruit trees are covered with blossoms. When we are there, I will give you my love.
translation_verse: Hã wɔte shi maŋkɛ mra, ni wɔya waintromii lɛ amli, ni wɔyakwɛ akɛ waintso lɛ miifrɔke ni eegba afofro, ni maŋotsei lɛ hu egba afofro lo? Jɛi mikɛ misuɔmɔ baahã bo yɛ.

english_verse: Perfume from the magic flower fills the air, my darling. Right at our doorstep I have stored up for you all kinds of tasty fruits.
translation_verse: Ao! Misuɔlɔ suɔmɔ yibii lɛ miije ŋma, ni tso yibii ni jara wa srɔtoi fɛɛ yɛ wɔshinaa lɛ shi. Mikɛ ememeji kɛ ehei fɛɛ eto ehã bo.

english_verse: If you were my brother, I could kiss you whenever we happen to meet, and no one would say I did wrong.
translation_verse: Ao, mina ni kulɛ minyɛmi nuu ni ye minyɛ fufɔ ji bo. Kulɛ kɛ mina bo yɛ agbo naa ni mishwɔ onaa lɛ, mɔ ko shwaŋ mi po.

english_verse: I could take you to the home of my mother, who taught me all I know. I would give you delicious wine and fruit juice as well.
translation_verse: Kulɛ manyiɛ ohiɛ kɛya minyɛ we lɛ, manyiɛ ohiɛ kɛya minyɛ awo ni fɔ mi sɛɛtsuŋ. Ni mahã bo wain ni jeɔ ŋma onu; ni tamɔ migranata dãa.

english_verse: Put your left hand under my head and embrace me with your right arm.
translation_verse: Mina ni kulɛ miyitso tsɔle enine abɛku ni ekɛ eninejurɔ efua mi atuu.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me never to awaken love before it is ready. Their Friends Speak:

translation_verse: Namɔ ji yoo nɛɛ ni jɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ baa ni ekɛ esuɔlɔ ela kɛ baa nɛɛ? Mi mitsiɛ̃ ohiɛ yɛ akututso lɛ shishi, jɛi ji he ni onyɛ kɔ̃mɔ bo yɛ, jɛi onyɛ ni fɔ bo lɛ kɔ̃mɔ bo yɛ. Yoo lɛ

english_verse: Always keep me in your heart and wear this bracelet to remember me by. The passion of love bursting into flame is more powerful than death, stronger than the grave.
translation_verse: Sɔomɔ minaa owo otsui mli tamɔ adikiɔ nine he lɛ. Okɛ yoo ko yoo ko akala, ja mi pɛ. Ejaakɛ suɔmɔ he wa tamɔ gbele; ni awuŋayeli hu yi wa tamɔ gbele. Ehereɔ tamɔ la, ni etsoɔ grigri.

translation_verse: Wɔyɛ nyɛmi yoo fioo ko ni ejeko fufɔ. Mɛni wɔɔfee wɔhã wɔnyɛmi yoo nɛɛ, gbi ni aaaba akɛ abaatsɛ ehebaa lɛ?

english_verse: She isn't a wall that we can defend behind a silver shield. Neither is she a room that we can protect behind a wooden door. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Eji gbogbo ji lɛ kulɛ wɔɔma jwiɛtɛi mɔɔ ni kwɔ wɔma enɔ. Eji shinaa ji lɛ kulɛ wɔkɛ tsenedrutsei ŋmoŋmolo aaaha ehe. Yoo lɛ

english_verse: I am a wall around a city, my breasts are towers, and just looking at me brings him great pleasure.

translation_verse: Miwaintrom, ni ji mi diɛŋtsɛ minɔ lɛ, mikoome minɔ ni. Bo Solomon, ooona akpe lɛ, ni mɛi ni ji apaafoi lɛ aaana ohai enyɔ.

english_verse: You are in the garden with friends all around. Let me hear your voice! She Speaks:
translation_verse: Ao, bo mɔ ni oyɔɔ abɔi lɛ amli, minanemɛi lɛ miibo ogbee toi. Hã mi hu manu ogbee lɛ. Yoo lɛ

english_verse: Hurry to me, my darling! Run faster than a deer to mountains of spices.
translation_verse: Ohe afee oya, misuɔlɔ, ofoi awa tamɔ soŋai, tamɔ ofrote oblanyo yɛ tsofakɛŋma gɔji lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: I am Isaiah, the son of Amoz. And this is the message that I was given about Judah and Jerusalem when Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah: A Guilty Nation
translation_verse: Ninaa ni ajie atsɔ̃ Yesaia, Amoz bi lɛ, yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ hu he, yɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ, Uzia kɛ Yotam kɛ Ahaz kɛ Hezekia, ayinɔ nɛ: Nyɔŋmɔ kã ewebii ahiɛ

english_verse: The Lord has said, “Listen, heaven and earth! The children I raised have turned against me.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Ŋwɛi, bo toi, ni shikpɔŋ bo hu feemɔ toi, ejaakɛ mi Yehowa, miiwie. Milɛ bii ni amɛdara, shi amɛ lɛ, amɛtse mihiɛ atua.

english_verse: Israel, you are a sinful nation loaded down with guilt. You are wicked and corrupt and have turned from the Lord, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ao! Eshafeelɔi amaŋ, gbɔmɛi ni eyi tɔ kɛ eshafeemɔ, efɔŋfeelɔi ashwiei, gbɔmɛi nifitelɔi ni amɛkwa Yehowa, ni amɛgbe Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he guɔ, ni amɛ kɛ lɛ teŋ etserɛ kwraa.

english_verse: Why be punished more? Why not give up your sin? Your head is badly bruised, and you are weak all over.
translation_verse: Mɛni hewɔ nyɛyaa nɔ nyɛtseɔ atua koni aya nɔ agbala nyɛtoi lolo nɛɛ? Nyɛyitso muu lɛ fɛɛ he miiye, ni nyɛtsui fɛɛ hu etɔ biti.

english_verse: From your head to your toes there isn't a healthy spot. Bruises, cuts, and open sores go without care or oil to ease the pain. A Country in Ruins
translation_verse: Kɛjɛ yiteŋ aahu kɛyashi naneshi lɛ, he ko he ko bɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ he ni atswã bɛ jɛi fe pilamɔi kɛ faji kɛ faji ni amɛmli miihohoo lá. Anyamɔko faji lɛ, afimɔko lɛ, akɛ mu etoko amɛnɔ hu.

english_verse: Your country lies in ruins; your towns are in ashes. Foreigners and strangers take and destroy your land while you watch.
translation_verse: Nyɛjaku shikpɔŋ lɛ kã shi amaŋfɔ̃, ni amãmɔ nyɛmaji wuji lɛ anaa la ashãshãai. Gbɔi miiye nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nii yɛ nyɛhiɛ; amɛbutu nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛhã etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃.

english_verse: Enemies surround Jerusalem, alone like a hut in a vineyard or in a cucumber field.
translation_verse: Yerusalɛm pɛ eshwɛ, ni lɛ hu asa eyi. Etsɔ̃ tamɔ asese ko yɛ waintrom mli, loo agba ni ma kukumba ŋmɔ mli.

english_verse: Zion would have disappeared like Sodom and Gomorrah, if the Lord All-Powerful had not let a few of its people survive. Justice, Not Sacrifices
translation_verse: Yehowa eshwɛɛɛ hiɛkãalɔi fioo ko hãaa wɔ kulɛ, wɔsane lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ Sodom kɛ Gomora.

english_verse: You are no better than the leaders and people of Sodom and Gomorrah! So listen to the Lord God:
translation_verse: Nyɛ Sodom maŋnɔyelɔi, nyɛboa Yehowa wiemɔ toi; ni nyɛ Gomorabii, nyɛboa nɔ ni wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ nyɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ toi.

english_verse: “Your sacrifices mean nothing to me. I am sick of your offerings of rams and choice cattle; I don't like the blood of bulls or lambs or goats.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Mɛni nyɛfɔlei babaoo lɛ ji hã mi? Shãa afɔlei ni nyɛkɛ gwantɛŋ hii shãa lɛ kɛ kooloi ni eshwishwii afɔi lɛ eje mitsine. Tsinahii kɛ gwantɛŋbii kɛ tookpakpoi alá lɛ, mitaooo dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: “Who asked you to bring all this when you come to worship me? Stay out of my temple!
translation_verse: Namɔ kɛɛ nyɛ akɛ kɛji nyɛba mi jamɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ enɛɛmɛi aba mikpoi lɛ anɔ? Nyɛkabanyiɛa mikpoi lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ!

english_verse: Your sacrifices are worthless, and your incense disgusting. I can't stand the evil you do on your New Moon Festivals or on your Sabbaths and other times of worship.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ nyɛyakayaka afɔlei akabaa dɔŋŋ; amɛhe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ. Miihi tsofakɛŋma ni ashãa lɛ kɛ nyɔŋ hee gbii juji lɛ, kɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi kɛ gwai ni nyɛbɔɔ lɛ. Eshai efite gbii juji ni nyɛyeɔ lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, mitaooo.

english_verse: I hate your New Moon Festivals and all others as well. They are a heavy burden I am tired of carrying.
translation_verse: Misusuma miihi nyɔŋ hee gbii juji kɛ gbii juji krokomɛi ni nyɛyeɔ lɛ; amɛtsɔ̃mɔ jatsu amɛhã mi, ni etɔ mi kɛ teremɔ.

english_verse: “No matter how much you pray, I won't listen. You are too violent.
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛhole nyɛniji anɔ nyɛmiisɔle lɛ, mibatsɔ̃ mihiɛ mato afã; nyɛbaasɔle kakadaŋŋ nɛ, shi miboŋ nyɛ toi. Lá ewu nyɛniji ahe tsɔ̃.

english_verse: Wash yourselves clean! I hate your filthy deeds. Stop doing wrong
translation_verse: Nyɛjua nyɛhe koni nyɛhãa nyɛhe atsea; nyɛkɛ nyɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ ajea mihiɛ, ni nyɛkpaa efɔŋfeemɔ.

english_verse: and learn to live right. See that justice is done. Defend widows and orphans and help the oppressed.” An Invitation from the Lord
translation_verse: Nyɛkasea ekpakpafeemɔ, nyɛtaoa jalɛ sane sɛɛgbɛ; nyɛkwɛa koni akayea amim, nyɛfãa awusa he, ni nyɛwiea nyɛhãa okulafo.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, invite you to come and talk it over. Your sins are scarlet red, but they will be whiter than snow or wool.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa agbɛnɛ; nyɛhãa wɔtaoa naa. Kɛji nyɛhe eshai lɛ tsuɔ tamɔ lá tete po, amɛbaayɛ futaa tamɔ snoo; ni kɛji amɛtsuɔ fɔɔ tamɔ kɔɔjaŋ po, amɛbaatsɔ̃ tamɔ too he tsɔ̃i yɛŋ.

english_verse: If you willingly obey me, the best crops in the land will be yours.
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛmiisumɔ, ni nyɛfee toibolɔi lɛ, no lɛ nyɛbaaye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nii kpakpai lɛ.

english_verse: But if you turn against me, your enemies will kill you. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Condemns Jerusalem
translation_verse: Shi kɛji nyɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ, ni nyɛtse atua lɛ, no lɛ akɛ klante baakpãtã nyɛhiɛ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Maŋ ni eyi kɛ eshafeelɔi

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are like an unfaithful wife. Once your judges were honest and your people lived right; now you are a city full of murderers.
translation_verse: Te fee tɛŋŋ ni maŋ ni kulɛ eyeɔ anɔkwa lɛ etsɔ̃ ehe ajwamãŋ nɛɛ. Sa lɛ aye jalɛ sane yɛ ehe fɛɛ he, ni jalɛ saneyelɔi pɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi; shi agbɛnɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔi sɔŋŋ yɔɔ jɛi.

english_verse: Your silver is fake, and your wine is watered down.
translation_verse: Ojwiɛtɛi lɛ etsɔ̃ jwiɛtɛi shishi, ni owain lɛ ashi mli nu.

english_verse: Your leaders have rejected me to become friends of crooks; your rulers are looking for gifts and bribes. Widows and orphans never get a fair trial.
translation_verse: Omli lumɔi lɛ etsɔ̃mɔ atuatselɔi kɛ julɔi ananemɛi. Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miinya nyɔɔŋnihamɔ he ni amɛhiŋmɛii etsu kɛnyiɛ mɛi adɛŋ nikee sɛɛ. Amɛfãaa awusa he lɛ, amɛyeee okulafo sane amɛhãaa lɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the mighty ruler of Israel, and I make you a promise: You are now my enemy, and I will show my anger by taking revenge on you.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, Israel Ofe Koome lɛ kɛɔ nɛ, “Mikɛ mimlifu lɛ baashãkã mihenyɛlɔi anɔ, ni mibatɔ mihe owele yɛ nyɛ, mihenyɛlɔi lɛ, anɔ.

english_verse: I will punish you terribly and burn away everything that makes you unfit to worship me.
translation_verse: Mikɛ bo baaye, ni mibasere ojwiɛtɛifei lɛ fɛɛ, ni majie omli muji nii fɛɛ mashwie.

english_verse: Jerusalem, I will choose judges and advisors like those you had before. Your new name will be “Justice and Faithfulness.” The Lord Will Save Jerusalem
translation_verse: Mato kojolɔi mahã bo tamɔ eyɔɔ tsutsu ko lɛ, kɛ ajinafoi hu tamɔ blema lɛ. No sɛɛ lɛ, bo Yerusalɛm, aaatsɛ bo jalɛ maŋ.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, you will be saved by showing justice; Zion's people who turn to me will be saved by doing right.
translation_verse: Jalɛ saneyeli ji nɔ ni aaahere Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ kɛ emli mɛi fɛɛ ni aaashwa amɛhe lɛ ayiwala.

english_verse: But those rebellious sinners who turn against me, the Lord, will all disappear.
translation_verse: Shi maŋ lɛ atuatselɔi lɛ kɛ eshafeelɔi lɛ aaakpãtã amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ, ni mɛi ni baakwa Yehowa lɛ, abaaplene amɛ.

english_verse: You will be made ashamed of those groves of trees where you worshiped idols.
translation_verse: Ebaafee nyɛ hiɛgbele akɛ nyɛja tsei wuji; asaŋ nyɛhiɛ aaashwie shi akɛ nyɛfeefee tromi komɛi,

english_verse: You will be like a grove of trees dying in a drought.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ nyɛaatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ tso wulu, ni eyi baa eboo loo trom ni nu bɛ mli.

english_verse: Your strongest leaders will be like dry wood set on fire by their idols. No one will be able to help, as they all go up in flames.
translation_verse: Hewalɔ hewalɛ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ anaanu kpãa; enifeemɔnii baatsɔ̃ lasrɛmi, ni lasrɛmi nɛɛ nɔŋŋ baasɔo anaanu kpãa lɛ naa la, ni mɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ agbe.

english_verse: This is the message I was given about Judah and Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛm he sane ni Amoz bi Yesaia na nɛ.

english_verse: In the future, the mountain with the Lord's temple will be the highest of all. It will reach above the hills; every nation will rush to it.
translation_verse: Ebaaba mli akɛ naagbee mli lɛ, gɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ma nɔ lɛ baatsɔ̃ gɔŋ ni kwɔ fe gɔji fɛɛ. Abaawo enɔ fe gɔji lɛ fɛɛ, ni aaajɛ jeŋjeŋ fɛɛ aba jɛi.

english_verse: Many people will come and say, “Let's go to the mountain of the Lord God of Jacob and worship in his temple.” The Lord will teach us his Law from Jerusalem, and we will obey him.
translation_verse: Ni mɛi babaoo baakɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Nyɛbaa, nyɛhãa wɔyaa Yehowa gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni wɔyaa Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ We lɛ, koni etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ bɔ ni etaoɔ akɛ wɔhi shi wɔhã, koni wɔba wɔjeŋ nakai, Ejaakɛ mla lɛ, Zion ebaajɛ, ni Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ, Yerusalɛm ebaajɛ.”

english_verse: He will settle arguments between nations. They will pound their swords and their spears into rakes and shovels; they will never make war or attack one another.
translation_verse: Ni ebaakojo majimaji lɛ ateŋ, ni ebaakã mɛi babaoo ahiɛ, ni ebaabu atɛŋ ehã mɛi babaoo. Amɛbaatswia amɛklantei lɛ amɛkɛsɔ̃ kɔii ni amɛkɛ amɛkpɔlɔi lɛ hu baasɔ̃ adidai. Maŋ ko kɛ maŋ ko wuŋ ta, ni amɛkaseŋ tawuu dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: People of Israel, let's live by the light of the Lord. Following Sinful Customs
translation_verse: Ao, nyɛ Yakob we, nyɛbaa agbɛnɛ koni wɔnyiɛ Yehowa la lɛ mli. Abaaba Henɔwolɔi ashi

english_verse: Our Lord, you have deserted your people, Israel, because they follow customs of nations from the east. They worship Philistine gods and are close friends of foreigners.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa ekwa ewebii ni ji Yakob shwiei lɛ, ejaakɛ bokãgbɛ shikpɔji klalɔi babaoo ebafutu amɛ, ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ klalɔi tamɔ Filistibii lɛ, ni maŋsɛɛbii moŋ amɛkɛbɔɔ.

english_verse: They have endless treasures of silver and gold; they have countless horses and war chariots.
translation_verse: Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi obɔ̃ kɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi ni anyɛɛɛ naa abu. Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi kɛ okpɔŋɔi, ni amɛtayaa shwiilii lɛ anyɛɛɛ naa akpa.

english_verse: Everywhere in the country they worship the idols they have made.
translation_verse: Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ yakayaka amãgãi, ni amɛkotoɔ shi amɛjaa amɛninenaa nitsumɔnii, nii ni amɛkɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛniji fee lɛ.

english_verse: And so, all of them will be ashamed and disgraced. Don't forgive them! A Day of Judgment
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, adesa diɛŋtsɛ ebɔ ehe ahora ni eba ehe shi kwraa. Nuŋtsɔ, kɛ enɛ akafa amɛ.

english_verse: Every one of you, go hide among the rocks and in the ground, because the Lord is fearsome, marvelous, and glorious.
translation_verse: Botemɔ tɛsaa tɛkplo mli, ni yaatee ohe yɛ su mli ni ojo Yehowa he gbeyei lɛ kɛ egbojee anunyam lɛ naa foi.

english_verse: When the Lord comes, everyone who is proud will be made humble, and the Lord alone will be honored.
translation_verse: Gbi ko miiba, ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaaba gbɔmɔ adesa hewoo kɛ henɔwomɔ fɛɛ shi, ni gbi lɛ Yehowa koome pɛ hiɛ baaba nyam, ni aaawo enɔ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has chosen a day when those who are proud and conceited will be put down.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, yɛ gbi ko ni eto ni ekɛbaaba ntɛŋfeemɔ kɛ henɔwomɔ kɛ hetsɔ̃ɔmɔ fɛɛ shi.

english_verse: The tall and towering cedars of Lebanon will be destroyed. So will the oak trees of Bashan,
translation_verse: Gbi nɛɛ lɛ abaaba Lebanon tsenedrutsei gojogojoo lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Bashan tsei wuji lɛ fɛɛ,

english_verse: all the seagoing ships, and every beautiful boat.
translation_verse: ni abaashwie Tarshish lɛji lɛ kɛ amɛmli ŋaa nibii fɛɛfɛji lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: When that day comes, everyone who is proud will be put down. Only the Lord will be honored.
translation_verse: Gbi lɛ abaaba gbɔmɔ adesa hetsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ ntɛŋfeemɔ fɛɛ shi, ni Yehowa koometoo pɛ nɔ abaawo gojoo,

english_verse: Idols will be gone for good.
translation_verse: ni yakayaka amãgãi lɛ baaho aya kwraa.

english_verse: You had better hide in caves and holes— the Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth.
translation_verse: Gbi nɔ ni Yehowa aaaba ebahoso shikpɔŋ lɛ, gbɔmɛi baabote tɛsaa tɛkploi kɛ shikpɔŋ bui amli koni amɛtee amɛhe yɛ Yehowa he gbeyei kɛ egbojee anunyam lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: On that day everyone will throw to the moles and bats their idols of silver and gold they made to worship.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ gbɔmɛi baasherɛ amɛshika amãgãi kɛ jwiɛtɛi amãgãi ni amɛfee amɛhã amɛhe ni amɛjaa lɛ amɛshwie amɛhã obishii kɛ aputupatai.

english_verse: The Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth— they will hide in caves and in the hills.
translation_verse: Amɛbaaya amɛyabote tɛkploi kɛ tɛsaa amli fɔji amli bɔ ni afee ni amɛnyɛ amɛjo foi yɛ Yehowa he gbeyei kɛ egbojee anunyam lɛ naa be ni Yehowa aaate shi ebahoso shikpɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Stop trusting the power of humans. They are all going to die, so how can they help?
translation_verse: Nyɛwia nyɛhe kɛjea gbɔmɔ ni wala mumɔ yɔɔ emli nɛɛ he, ejaakɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, ebɛ nɔ ko mli.

english_verse: The mighty Lord All-Powerful is going to take away from Jerusalem and Judah everything you need— your bread and water, *
translation_verse: Naa, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, baajie mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yerusalɛm kɛ Yuda kpasa akɛ sɛɛtso lɛ kɛya. Ebaajie amɛdaaŋ ŋmãa, ni ebaahã amɛye nuhɔmɔ.

english_verse: soldiers and heroes, judges and prophets, leaders and army officers,
translation_verse: Ebaajie nuu ekãalɔ lɛ kɛ tabilɔ lɛ kɛ kojolɔ lɛ kɛ gbalɔ lɛ kɛ okɔmfo lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpa lɛ.

english_verse: He will let children and babies become your rulers.
translation_verse: Mi Yehowa, mibahã gbekɛbii hii atsɔmɔ amɛnɔ lumɛi, ni fufɔbii baaye amɛnɔ.

english_verse: You will each be cruel to friends and neighbors. Young people will insult their elders; no one will show respect to those who deserve it.
translation_verse: Maŋbii lɛ aaawawaa amɛhe yi, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baawa enyɛmi yi. Oblahii ebuŋ amɛnukpai, ni maŋ bii yakagbɔmɛi ebuŋ mɛi ni hiɛ yɔɔ nyam.

english_verse: Some of you will grab hold of a relative and say, “You still have a coat. Be our leader and rule this pile of ruins.”
translation_verse: Be miiba, be ni tsɛmɛi awe bii baamɔ amɛteŋ mɔ kome, ni amɛaakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Anyɛmi, bo lɛ oyɛ hebo, no hewɔ lɛ, obaaye wɔlumɔ koni okwɛ wɔwe ni ekumɔ nɛɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: But the answer will be, “I can't do you any good. Don't make me your leader. There's no food or clothing left in my house.”
translation_verse: Shi gbɔmɔ nɛɛ baakɛɛ yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Mibɛ niyenii loo hehaabo yɛ mishĩaŋ ni mikɛaanyɛ mikɛwa nyɛ. Nyɛkafea mi nyɛlumɔ.”

english_verse: Jerusalem and Judah, you rebelled against your glorious Lord— your words and your actions, made you stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yerusalɛm ejwa, ni Yuda hu egbee shi, ejaakɛ amɛdaaŋ wiemɔ kɛ amɛnifeemɔnii fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ amɛte shi amɛwo Yehowa, ni amɛhiɛ eshwieee ehiɛiaŋ tete.

english_verse: The look on your faces shows that you are sinful as Sodom, and you don't try to hide it. You are in for trouble, and you have brought it all on yourselves. The Wrong Kind of Leaders
translation_verse: Amɛmɛiahiɛiaŋkwɛmɔ baaye odase eshi amɛ. Eshai ni amɛfeɔ lɛ amɛkɛteee, shi moŋ amɛkɛshwãa tamɔ Sodom fee lɛ. Kpoo hã amɛ! Ejaakɛ amɛfee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ amɛhe efɔŋ.

english_verse: Tell those who obey God, “You're very fortunate— you will be rewarded for what you have done.”
translation_verse: Kɛɛmɔ jalɔi lɛ akɛ ebaahi ehã amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛbaaye amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ mli yibii.

english_verse: Tell those who disobey, “You're in big trouble— what you did to others will come back to you.”
translation_verse: Shi kpoo ha efɔŋfeelɔ; ehiŋ ehaŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ nɔ ni ekɛfee mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, no nɔŋŋ akɛbaafee lɛ.

english_verse: Though you are God's people, you are ruled and abused by women and children. You are confused by leaders who guide you down the wrong path.
translation_verse: Naa, shikafalɔi miiwa mimaŋbii lɛ ayi, ni amɛnyɔjiatsɛmɛi lɛ shishiuɔ amɛ. Ao! Miwebii, nyɛmaŋhiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ miihã nyɛmiidu gbɛ, ni amɛmiihã nyɛnane miitɔ̃tɔ̃. Yehowa kojo ewebii lɛ

english_verse: The Lord is ready to accuse and judge all nations.
translation_verse: Yehowa eho eta esɛi nɔ, ni ekɛ ewebii lɛ baaye sane.

english_verse: He will even judge you rulers and leaders of his own nation. You destroyed his vineyard and filled your houses by robbing the poor.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ emaŋ onukpai kɛ maŋ lumɛi lɛ miikojo akɛ, “Nyɛ ji mɛi ni nyɛkpa waintrom lɛ mli nii ni nyɛye lɛ. Ohiafoi adɛŋ nibii ni nyɛhahaa lɛ yɛ nyɛshĩai lɛ amli.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says, “You have crushed my people and rubbed in the dirt the faces of the poor.” The Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Te nyɛjwɛŋɔ tɛŋŋ hewɔ ni nyɛmiaa mimaŋ lɛ, ni nyɛkɛ ohiafoi ahiɛ shwishwiaa shi nɛɛ lɛ? Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ, miibi nyɛ!” Abɔ Yerusalɛm yei lɛ kɔkɔ

english_verse: The Lord says: The women of Jerusalem are proud and strut around, winking shamelessly. They wear anklets that jingle and call attention to the way they walk.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Yerusalɛm yei lɛ woɔ amɛhe, amɛtsĩaa kɛ amɛkuɛkuumɔ kɛ ahoshwibɔɔ hiŋmɛii kɛ amɛnanetalɔŋ gai ni miigbɛɛ.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, will cover their heads with sores, and I will uncover their private parts.
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, mi Yehowa, mibahã gbɛ̃i ashwie Yerusalɛm biyei ayiteiaŋ, ni ebaahã amɛyitsei ahe akpekpei, ni mi Yehowa, mahã amɛnyiɛ yayai.”

english_verse: In place of perfume, there will be a stink; in place of belts, there will be ropes; in place of fancy hairdos, they will have bald heads. Instead of expensive clothes, they will wear sackcloth; instead of beauty, they will have ugly scars.
translation_verse: Amɛjeŋmai lɛ baatsɔ̃ nɔ ko ni jeɔ fu, amɛkɛ taŋkpee baafi amɛmli yɛ mlifiinii najiaŋ, ni yiteŋ ni ekpe aaabaye yi ni ahɔ najiaŋ, ni kpekpe aaabaye atade wuyaa najiaŋ, ni amɛhe fɛo lɛ baatsɔ̃ hiɛgbele nɔ.

english_verse: The fighting men of Jerusalem will be killed in battle.
translation_verse: Omli hii lɛ baanyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa, ni ohii kãkãlɔi lɛ hu yɛ ta mli.

english_verse: The city will mourn and sit in the dirt, emptied of its people.
translation_verse: Maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ baaye ŋkɔmɔ kɛ awerɛho, ni maŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ yoo ni afee lɛ shwɛm ni eshwata shikpɔŋ.

english_verse: When this happens, seven women will grab the same man, and each of them will say, “I'll buy my own food and clothes! Just marry me and take away my disgrace.” The Lord Will Bless His People Who Survive
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ yei kpawo baamɔ nuu kome kɛ hiɛdɔɔ, ni amɛbaakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔɔnyɛ wɔlɛ wɔhe, ni wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔɔnyɛ wɔhe mama wɔbu. Nɔ ni wɔtaoɔ kɛkɛ ji akɛ akɛ ogbɛi atsɛ wɔ koni okɛjie wɔhiɛgbele.” Yerusalɛm baaba eblema ekoŋŋ

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will make his land fruitful and glorious again, and the people of Israel who survive will take great pride in what the land produces.
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ Yehowa tso nine lɛ baafee fɛo, ni ebaashwere, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii aaafee shwãanɔ kɛ nyam ahã Israelbii ni eje hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: after the Lord sends a fiery judgment to clean the city and its people of their violent deeds.
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewalɛ naa lɛ ebaakojo ni ebaatsuu Israelbii ahe, ebaafɔ Yerusalɛm he muji lɛ kɛ lá shi ni ashwie yɛ jɛi lɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord will cover the whole city and its meeting places with a thick cloud each day and with a flaming fire each night. God's own glory will be like a huge tent that covers everything.
translation_verse: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa baahã atatu aha Zion Gɔŋ lɛ kɛ asafoi ni yɔɔ jɛi anɔ shwane, ni gbɛkɛ lɛ ebaahã amɛ lasu ni kpɛɔ tamɔ la, ejaakɛ enunyam lɛ baaha amɛnɔ tamɔ agba.

english_verse: It will provide shade from the heat of the sun and a place of shelter and protection from storms and rain.
translation_verse: Ebaatsɔ̃ hɔ̃ɔŋ shwane koni hulu akashã amɛ, ni eeefee abobaahe kɛ teemɔhe yɛ ahum kɛ nunɛmɔ mli.

english_verse: I will sing a song about my friend's vineyard that was on the side of a fertile hill.
translation_verse: Hã mala suɔmɔ lala mahã mishieŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ ewaintrom lɛ he. Mishieŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ waintrom yɛ gɔŋ ni baa nii jogbaŋŋ nɔ.

english_verse: My friend dug the ground, removed the stones, and planted the best vines. He built a watchtower and dug a pit in rocky ground for pressing the grapes. He hoped they would be sweet, but bitter grapes were all it produced.
translation_verse: Etsa mli, ni efamɔ emli tɛi ni etɛo waintsei kpakpai yɛ mli; ema mɔɔ yɛ teŋ, ni etsa wain bu hu yɛ mli. Ehiɛ kã nɔ akɛ trom lɛ baawo wainyibii kpakpai, shi ewo kooŋ wainyibii moŋ.

english_verse: Listen, people of Jerusalem and of Judah! You be the judge of me and my vineyard.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni mishieŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɔ nɛ, “Agbɛnɛ nyɛ Yerusalɛmbii kɛ nyɛ Yudabii, nyɛ fai nɛ, nyɛkojoa mi kɛ miwaintrom lɛ teŋ.

english_verse: What more could I have done for my vineyard? I hoped for sweet grapes, but bitter grapes were all that grew.
translation_verse: Mɛni esa akɛ afee mitrom lɛ lolo ni mifeko? Be ni mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ ewo wainyibii kpakpai lɛ, mɛni hewɔ ni ewo kooŋ wainyibii moŋ nɛɛ?

english_verse: Now I will let you know what I am going to do. I will cut down the hedge and tear down the wall. My vineyard will be trampled and left in ruins.
translation_verse: “Agbɛnɛ mibatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ ni mibafee miwaintrom lɛ. Mibajie ehe afabaŋ lɛ koni kooloi akpãtã ehiɛ. Mibakumɔ ehe gbogbo lɛ hu koni anaanaa enɔ kɛho.

english_verse: It will turn into a desert, neither pruned nor hoed; it will be covered with thorns and briars. I will command the clouds not to send rain.
translation_verse: Mibahã emli atsa; akpɔlɔŋ emli tsei lɛ ahe, ni ahuŋ he; kpitikpitii kɛ ŋmeii baatsa yɛ mli. Mibawo atatui lɛ kitã akɛ amɛkanɛ nu amɛshwie nɔ.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful! Israel is the vineyard, and Judah is the garden I tended with care. I had hoped for honesty and for justice, but dishonesty and cries for mercy were all I found. Isaiah Condemns Social Injustice
translation_verse: Israel ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, waintrom lɛ, ni Yudabii lɛ ji waintsei kpakpai ni etɛo lɛ; ni ekwɛ jalɛ saneyeli gbɛ ni naa lashishwiemɔ moŋ ena, ni yɛ ekpakpafeemɔ najiaŋ lɛ, yaafo moŋ afo! Efɔŋ ni adesa feɔ

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You take over house after house and field after field, until there is no room left for anyone else in all the land.
translation_verse: Kpoo hã nyɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛheheo mɛi ashĩai nyɛfataa shĩai ni nyɛyɔɔ ahe, ni nyɛŋɔɔ mɛi aŋmɔji nyɛfataa nyɛŋmɔji ahe. Nyɛhiɛ nɛkɛ ni eshwɛŋ shikpɔŋ ko dɔŋŋ yɛ he ko ni abaashi nyɛ pɛ koni nyɛhi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful has made this promise to me: Those large and beautiful homes will be left empty, with no one to take care of them.
translation_verse: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, wie yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mitoiŋ akɛ, “Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, shĩai pii baatsɔmɔ amaŋfɔ̃, shĩai wuji fɛɛfɛji baakamɔ shi ni gbɔmɛi bɛ mli.

english_verse: None of them are tired. They don't sleep or get drowsy, and they run without stumbling. Their belts don't come loose; their sandal straps don't break.
translation_verse: Etɔŋ amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko tɛŋ; amɛteŋ mɔ ko hɛfiinii fɛneŋ, mɔ ko mɔ ko tokota naa kpãa tseŋ.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! The lies you tell are like ropes by which you drag along sin and evil.
translation_verse: Kpoo hã mɛi ni kɛ amale kpãa gbalaa nɔsha, ni amɛkɛ shwiili he taŋkpee diɛŋtsɛ gbalaa esha lɛ.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You get up early to start drinking, and you keep it up late into the night.
translation_verse: Ni kpoo hã mɛi ni teɔ shi maŋkɛ mra ni amɛyanyiɛɔ dãatseiaŋ, mɛi ni taraa shi yɛ dãa he kɛyashiɔ jenamɔ yi waa, ni wain hãa amɛhiɛ feɔ laŋlaŋ.

english_verse: At your drinking parties you have the music of stringed instruments, tambourines, and flutes. But you never even think about all the Lord has done,
translation_verse: Amɛkɛ saŋku kɛ obenta kɛ milɛ̃ kɛ blɛ kɛ wain yeɔ amɛgbiijuji lɛ, shi amɛbuuu Yehowa, nifeemɔnii, ni amɛnãaa eninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ hu.

english_verse: and so his people know nothing about him. That's why many of you will be dragged off to foreign lands. Your leaders will starve to death, and everyone else will suffer from thirst.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, abaaŋɔ miwebii lɛ nom, ejaakɛ amɛleee nii. Hɔmɔ miigbe amɛhiɛnaanɔbii lɛ, ni maŋbii babaoo baagboi kɛ kumai.

english_verse: The world of the dead has opened its mouth wide and is eagerly waiting for the leaders of Jerusalem and for its noisy crowds, especially for those who take pride in that city.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, gbohiiaje elɛɛ esɛŋ, ni egbɛ edaaŋ hatoo fe nine kɛmiimɛ Yerusalɛm lumɛi lɛ kɛ esafo yuu lɛ kɛ mɛi ni feɔ hoo lɛ kɛ mɛi ni mli filiɔ amɛ lɛ koni emi amɛ.

english_verse: Its citizens have been put down, and its proud people have been brought to shame.
translation_verse: Abaawo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛgbele, ni abaaba nuu fɛɛ nuu shi, ni hewolɔi lɛ hu aaaba amɛ shi.

english_verse: But the holy Lord God All-Powerful is praised, because he has shown who he is by bringing justice.
translation_verse: Shi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, jieɔ egbojee kpo kɛtsɔ̃ jalɛnii ni efeɔ nɔ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ehe tse krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛɛlɛŋ kɛtsɔ̃ jalɛ sane ni eyeɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: His people will be like sheep grazing in their own pasture, and they will take off what was left by others.
translation_verse: Too gwantɛŋbii aaaye nii yɛ ŋa nɔ he ni jwɛifɔ yɔɔ, ni abotiabii ni eshwishwii aaaye nii kɛnyiɛ amaŋfɔ̃ tsui koi lɛ ateŋ.

english_verse: And you say, “Let the holy God of Israel hurry up and do what he has promised, so we can see it for ourselves.”
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Yehowa he afee oya; nɔ ni eto akɛ ebaafee lɛ, efee koni wɔkwɛ. Ha ni Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Koome lɛ yiŋ ni eto lɛ abɛŋkɛ wɔ ni aba mli koni wɔle.”

english_verse: You think you are clever and smart.
translation_verse: Kpoo hã mɛi ni buɔ amɛhe nilelɔi kɛ mɛi ni tsɛɔ amɛhe hiɛtɛ̃lɔi lɛ!

english_verse: And you are great at drinking and mixing drinks. But you are in for trouble.
translation_verse: Kpoo hã mɛi ni feɔ ekãa kɛ wainnumɔ! Kpoo hã mɛi ni waa amɛ kɛ dãa ni wa futumɔ!

english_verse: You accept bribes to let the guilty go free, and you cheat the innocent out of a fair trial.
translation_verse: Kpoo hã mɛi ni heɔ nyɔɔŋnii ni no hãa amɛŋmɛɔ mɔ ni efe efɔŋ he tswaa lɛ, ni amɛhãa mɔ ni sane ja gbɛnaanii ŋmɛɔ lɛ lɛ!

english_verse: You will go up in flames like straw and hay! You have rejected the teaching of the holy Lord God All-Powerful of Israel. Now your roots will rot, and your blossoms will turn to dust.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni lalilɛi shãa gbetseli, ni la ni tsoɔ shãa jwɛi gbiŋ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ amɛfãi lɛ aaakpɔtɔ, ni kɔɔyɔɔ baatswa amɛfofro lɛ ashwie, ejaakɛ amɛkwa Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, mla lɛ, ni amɛgbe Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Koome lɛ wiemɔ lɛ he guɔ.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people, but you made him terribly angry, and he struck you with his mighty arm. Mountains shook, and dead bodies covered the streets like garbage. The Lord is still angry, and he is ready to strike you again. Foreign Nations Will Attack
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa mli fu ewebii lɛ, ni ewo enine nɔ yɛ amɛnɔ, ni egbala amɛtoi. Gɔji lɛ hoso, ni amɛgbohii lɛ jwere blohui amli oookɛɛ shĩaŋ jwɛi ni abɛɛ ashwie. Shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa mlifu lɛ naa bako shi, shi ekpã enine lɛ mli lolo.

english_verse: The Lord has signaled for the foreign nations to come and attack you. He has already whistled, and they are coming as fast as they can.
translation_verse: Yehowa baato okadi ekɛtsɛ maŋ ko ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ; ebaakpã blɛ ekɛtsɛ lɛ kɛjɛ jeŋ naagbeehe lɛ. Ni naa, maŋ nɛɛ baafee oya aba mramra.

english_verse: Their arrows are sharp, and their bows are ready. The hoofs of their horses are hard as flint; the wheels of their war chariots turn as fast as a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Amɛgãimlibii anaa ba, ni amɛtataa amɛgãi lɛ; amɛkpɔŋɔ akoklotoi tamɔ tswɛrɛbo, ni amɛshwiilii anaji lɛ tsɔ̃mɔɔ amɛhe oyaoya tamɔ lasuogbele.

english_verse: They roar and growl like fierce young lions as they grab their victims and drag them off where no one can rescue them.
translation_verse: Amɛhuuɔ tamɔ jata, amɛhuuɔ tamɔ jata oblahii pɛ; amɛshiɔ amɛsɛŋ ni amɛyeɔ kooloo ni amɛgbɔbiɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛmɔɔ lɛ kɛyaa, ni mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ kooloo ni amɛmɔ lɛ yiwala ahere.

english_verse: On the day they attack, they will roar like the ocean. And across the land you will see nothing but darkness and trouble, because the light of day will be covered by thick clouds.
translation_verse: Amɛaashi amɛsɛŋ amɛwo Israel nakai gbi lɛ, ni amɛsɛŋshimɔ lɛ aaagbɛɛ tamɔ ŋshɔ gbɛɛmɔ. Ni kɛji akwɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nɔ ni aaana ji duŋ kɛ awerɛhoo sɔŋŋ, ni oblɔtu aaaha hulu la hiɛ.

english_verse: In the year that King Uzziah died, I had a vision of the Lord. He was on his throne high above, and his robe filled the temple.
translation_verse: Afi nɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Uzia gbo lɛ, mina Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni eta maŋtsɛ sɛi ni kwɔ gojoo ko nɔ. Atade yuu ni ewo lɛ eyi Sɔlemɔ we lɛ obɔ̃.

english_verse: Flaming creatures with six wings each were flying over him. They covered their faces with two of their wings and their bodies with two more. They used the other two wings for flying,
translation_verse: Serafim damɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ he kɛbɔle. Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ fiji ekpaaekpaa. Ekɛ enyɔ haa ehiɛ, ni ekɛ enyɔ haa enaji ahe, ni ekɛ enyɔ hu filikiɔ.

english_verse: as they shouted, “Holy, holy, holy, Lord All-Powerful! The earth is filled with your glory.”
translation_verse: Mɔnɛ boɔ ekɛɔ mɔnɛ akɛ, “Krɔŋkrɔŋ, krɔŋkrɔŋ, krɔŋkrɔŋ ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ! Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ eyi obɔ kɛ enunyam lɛ.”

english_verse: As they shouted, the doorposts of the temple shook, and the temple was filled with smoke.
translation_verse: Serafim lɛ abolɔmɔ lɛ ha Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shinai lɛ ashishi hoso, ni Sɔlemɔ we lɛ yi tɔ kɛ lasu.

english_verse: Then I cried out, “I'm doomed! Everything I say is sinful, and so are the words of everyone around me. Yet I have seen the King, the Lord All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Kpoo hã mi, shi milaaje! Ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ ni naabu he tseee ji mi; ni miyɛ maŋ ni emli bii awiemɔi ahe tseee ateŋ, ejaakɛ mihiŋmɛii ena maŋtsɛ ni ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ!”

english_verse: One of the flaming creatures flew over to me with a burning coal that it had taken from the altar with a pair of metal tongs.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni serafim lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome filiki kɛba miŋɔɔ. Ehiɛ ŋai ni miitso ni ekɛ abɛɛle yakɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: It touched my lips with the hot coal and said, “This has touched your lips. Your sins are forgiven, and you are no longer guilty.”
translation_verse: Ekɛ ŋai ni tsoɔ lɛ sa minaabu he, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, akɛni enɛ esa onaabu he nɛɛ lɛ, ajie onɔsha lɛ, ni akɛ ohe esha efa bo.”

english_verse: After this, I heard the Lord ask, “Is there anyone I can send? Will someone speak for us?” “I'll go,” I answered. “Send me!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni minu Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbee ni miikɛɛ akɛ, “Namɔ matsu, ni namɔ aaatee ahã wɔ?” Mikɛɛ akɛ, “Naa mi! Tsu mi!”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to go and speak this message to the people: “You will listen and listen, but never understand. You will look and look, but never see.” The Lord also said,
translation_verse: Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yaa koni oyakɛɛ maŋbii nɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkɛ nyɛtoi aaanu nɛ, shi nyɛnuŋ shishi, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhiŋmɛii aaana nɛ, shi nyɛnaŋ shishi.’ ”

english_verse: “Make these people stubborn! Make them stop up their ears, cover their eyes, and fail to understand. Don't let them turn to me and be healed.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Hã nɛkɛ maŋbii nɛɛ akpliŋ amɛtsui, ni ohã amɛtoi awa; asaŋ shwilamɔ amɛhiŋmɛii koni amɛkana nii; amɛkanu nii, asaŋ amɛkanu sane shishi ni amɛmiikpale ni amɛna tsamɔ.”

english_verse: Then I asked the Lord, “How long will this last?” The Lord answered: Until their towns are destroyed and their houses are deserted, until their fields are empty,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, Nuŋtsɔ, kɛyaashi mɛɛ beyinɔ?” Eto he akɛ, “Kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni maji lɛ aaatsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃i ni adesa ko bɛ amɛmli, ni shĩai lɛ aaajwere shi efoji ni gbɔmɛi bɛ mli, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kwraa.

english_verse: and I have sent them far away, leaving their land in ruins.
translation_verse: Yehowa aaakpala maŋbii lɛ kɛaatee shɔŋŋ, ni hei pii aaakamɔ shi efoji yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: If only a tenth of the people are left, even they will be destroyed. But just as stumps remain after trees have been cut down, some of my chosen ones will be left.
translation_verse: Ni kɛji eshwɛ maŋbii lɛ amlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome tete yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaaku sɛɛ akpãtã amɛhiɛ. Shi amɛaatsɔ tamɔ tso kpele ni atoo agbee shi ni eshwɛ ekuku yɛ su mli. Tso kuku nɛɛ lɛ dumɔ wu krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.”

english_verse: When news reached the royal palace that Syria had joined forces with Israel, King Ahaz and everyone in Judah were so terrified that they shook like trees in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Be ni Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ nu akɛ Aram kɛ Efraim efee ekome lɛ, Ahaz kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ atsui fã, ni amɛkpokpo tamɔ kooŋ tsei ni ahum ebote amɛteŋ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said to me: Take your son Shearjashub and go see King Ahaz. You will find him on the road near the cloth makers' shops at the end of the canal that brings water from the upper pool.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yesaia akɛ, “Bo kɛ obi Shear-Yashub nyɛyaa. Nyɛ kɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahaz baakpe yɛ yiteŋgbɛ kpaakpo lɛ naa, yɛ niiahefɔlɔi abɔɔ lɛ tɛmpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Tell Ahaz to stop worrying. There's no need for him to be afraid of King Rezin and King Pekah. They are very angry, but they are nothing more than a dying fire. Ahaz doesn't need to fear
translation_verse: Kɛɛmɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Kwɛ ohe ni ahi, ni ofee dioo; kaashe gbeyei, ni otsui hu akafã yɛ grimɔ waa ni Maŋtsɛ Rezin kɛ Siriabii kɛ Remalia bi Maŋtsɛ Peka egri lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ amɛtamɔ tsei kukuji ni miije lasu kɛkɛ.

english_verse: to invade and defeat Judah and Jerusalem and to let the son of Tabeel be king in his place.
translation_verse: amɛbaatua Yuda koni amɛwo ehe gbeyei ni amɛŋɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ amɛhã amɛhe koni amɛto Tabeel binuu akɛ maŋtsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise that this will never happen.
translation_verse: “Shi mi, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, miikɛɛ akɛ yiŋtoo nɛɛ baŋ mli kɔkɔɔkɔ,

english_verse: Damascus is just the capital of Syria, and King Rezin rules only in Damascus. Samaria is just the capital of Israel, and King Pekah rules only in Samaria. But in less than
translation_verse: Israel he waaa fe Samaria, emaŋ wulu lɛ, ni Samaria he waaa fe Maŋtsɛ Peka, Remalia binuu lɛ. Kɛji nyɛheee nyɛyeee lɛ, no lɛ nyɛhiŋ shi akɛ maŋ.” Imanuel he Okadi lɛ

english_verse: Once again the Lord God spoke to King Ahaz. This time he said,
translation_verse: Yehowa saa ekɛ wiemɔ tsu yaha Maŋtsɛ Ahaz akɛ,

english_verse: “Ask me for proof that my promise will come true. Ask for something to happen deep in the world of the dead or high in the heavens above.”
translation_verse: “Bi Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, dɛŋ okadi. Ooonyɛ oyabi yɛ gbohiiaje tɔ̃ɔ, loo yɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ tete.”

english_verse: “No, Lord,” Ahaz answered. “I won't test you!”
translation_verse: Shi Ahaz to he akɛ, “Mibiŋ ni ahã mi okadi ko, ni mikaŋ Yehowa mikwɛŋ.”

english_verse: Then I said: Listen, every one of you in the royal family of David. You have already tried my patience. Now you are trying God's patience by refusing to ask for proof.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yesaia to he akɛ, “Nyɛboa toi koo, agbɛnɛ, nyɛ Maŋtsɛ David shwiei! Aso gbɔmɛi ni nyɛhao lɛ faaa hãaa nyɛ hewɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ nyɛhao miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hu nɛɛ?

english_verse: But the Lord will still give you proof. A virgin is pregnant; she will have a son and will name him Immanuel.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ okadi. Naa, Oblayoo foro ko baana musu, ni ebaafɔ binuu, ni eeewo lɛ gbɛi Imanuel

english_verse: Even before the boy is old enough to know how to choose between right and wrong, he will eat yogurt and honey, and the countries of the two kings you fear will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ be ni gbekɛ nɛɛ aaada ni ekwa nɔ fɔŋ ni ekɔ nɔ kpakpa lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi enyɔ ni osheɔ amɛ gbeyei nɛɛ lɛ ashi amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ amaŋfɔ̃.

english_verse: But the Lord will make more trouble for your people and your kingdom than any of you have known since Israel broke away from Judah. He will even bring the king of Assyria to attack you. The Threat of an Invasion
translation_verse: “Yehowa baahã bo kɛ omaŋbii lɛ kɛ David shwiei fɛɛ atsɔ̃ gbii kɛ joomɔ komɛi amli ni eko bako dã kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni Israel tse ehe yɛ Yuda he nɛɛ, eeekpala Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛbanina nyɛ.

english_verse: When that time comes, the Lord will whistle, and armies will come from Egypt like flies and from Assyria like bees.
translation_verse: “Nakai be lɛ Yehowa baakpã blɛ kɛtsɛ Ijiptbii, ni amɛaabu kɛba tamɔ adɔdɔji kɛjɛ Nilo Faa lɛ jɛɛhe kɛ̃. Ni ebaatsɛ Asiriabii, ni amɛaake tamɔ wobii kɛjɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba.

english_verse: They will settle everywhere—in the deep valleys and between the rocks, on every thornbush and all over the pastureland.
translation_verse: Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛaaba amɛbasɔmɔ jɔi voovoi kɛ tɛsai amli fɔji lɛ amli kɛ ŋmei tsei fɛɛ anɔ amɛbaatsĩ jwɛi fɛɛ jwɛi nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will pay the king of Assyria to bring a razor from across the Euphrates River and shave your head and every hair on your body, including your beard.
translation_verse: “Nakai be lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaabɔ Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ apaa kɛjɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ sɛɛ tamɔ asooyi, ni eeebashɛ nyɛyiteiaŋ tsɔi kɛ nyɛnaji ahe tsɔi kɛ nyɛtsɛŋi hu fɛɛ.

english_verse: Anyone who is able to save only one young cow and two sheep,
translation_verse: “Nakai be lɛ mɔ ni aaalɛ tsina biyoo kome kɛ gwantɛŋi enyɔ lɛ,

english_verse: will have enough milk to make yogurt. In fact, everyone left in the land will eat yogurt and honey.
translation_verse: fufɔ ni eeena lɛ falɛ naa sɔŋŋ lɛ, eeena butru eye, ejaakɛ butru kɛ wo sɔŋŋ ji nɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshwɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaaye.

english_verse: You will go there to hunt with your bow and arrows, because the whole country will be covered with thornbushes.
translation_verse: Mɛi kɛ gãi kɛ gãimlibii aaaya ayagbɔbi yɛ jɛi, ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ etsɔ̃ kpitikpitii kɛ ŋmeii shikpɔŋ.

english_verse: The hills where you once planted crops will be overgrown with thorns and thistles. You will be afraid to go there, and your cattle, sheep, and goats will be turned loose on those hills.
translation_verse: Ni gɔji fɛɛ ni akɛ kɔi hu amɛnɔ sa lɛ, nyɛyaŋ amɛnɔ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ nyɛbaashe kpitikpiti kɛ ŋmei lɛ gbeyei. Jɛi baatsɔ̃ tsinai kɛ gwantɛŋi aniyelihe.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “Isaiah, get something to write on. Then write in big clear letters the name, MAHER-SHALAL-HASH-BAZ.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kɔ tao kpeteŋkple koni akɛ niŋmaa okadii ni dara aŋma wiemɔ nɛɛ yɛ nɔ, ‘Haanii yaa oya! Ofɔ̃yelinii yaa mramra.’ ”

english_verse: I will tell Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberechiah to serve as witnesses to this.”
translation_verse: Mina odasefoi anɔkwafoi enyɔ, ni ji Osɔfo Uria kɛ Zakaria, Yeberekia bi lɛ, ye mi odase.

english_verse: Sometime later, my wife and I had a son, and the Lord said, “Name him Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.
translation_verse: Mitee yoo, ni ji gbalɔyoo lɛ ŋɔɔ ni ena musu, ni efɔ binuu. Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Wo lɛ gbɛi akɛ ‘Oya Haanii,’ ‘Ofɔ̃yeli mramra,’

english_verse: Because before he can say ‘Mommy’ or ‘Daddy,’ the king of Assyria will attack and take everything of value from Damascus and Samaria.”
translation_verse: ejaakɛ dani gbekɛ lɛ aaale ‘Ataa loo Awo tsɛmɔ lɛ,’ aaaloo nii ni Damasko yɔɔ kɛ haanii ni Samaria yɔɔ hu kɛnyiɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ hiɛ kɛaatee.” Asiria Maŋtsɛ miiba

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me again and said:
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ,

english_verse: These people have refused the gentle waters of Shiloah and have gladly gone over to the side of King Rezin and King Pekah.
translation_verse: “Maŋ nɛɛ kwa Shiloa Faa lɛ mli nu ni hoɔ blɛoo lɛ, ni amɛkpokpo yɛ Maŋtsɛ Rezin kɛ Maŋtsɛ Peka, Remalia bi lɛ, hiɛ.

english_verse: Now I will send the king of Assyria against them with his powerful army, which will attack like the mighty Euphrates River overflowing its banks.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ kɛ eta lɛ fɛɛ miiba koni amɛbatua amɛ.

english_verse: Enemy soldiers will cover Judah like a flood reaching up to your neck. But God is with us. He will spread his wings and protect our land.
translation_verse: Amɛbaashwie amɛnɔ tamɔ faa wulu Eufrate. Emli nu babaoo lɛ aaasram nɔ boboobo, ni eeeha nujɔi fɛɛ anɔ, ni eeeje ŋa kɛaayabote Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ebaayi kɛyaashi eeeyata gbɔmɔ kuɛ, ni eeekple shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ fɛɛ, Ao Imanuel.”

english_verse: All of you foreign nations, go ahead and prepare for war, but you will be crushed.
translation_verse: Nyɛ majimaji, nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa kɛ tsuifãa! Nyɛ majimaji ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ, nyɛboa toi, ni nyɛhe ajɔ̃a nyɛhe.

english_verse: Get together and make plans, but you will fail because God is with us.
translation_verse: Nyɛkpãŋa; shi fɛɛ aaafee yaka. Nyɛkɛa nɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ kɛɛmɔ, shi fɛɛ aaafee yaka, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔ yɛ. Yehowa bɔ Gbalɔ lɛ kɔkɔ

english_verse: The Lord took hold of me with his powerful hand and said: I'm warning you! Don't act like these people.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ mi wie kɛ hiɛdɔɔ, ni ebɔ mi kɔkɔ akɛ mikaba mijeŋ tamɔ maŋbii lɛ. Ekɛɛ mi akɛ,

english_verse: Don't call something a rebellious plot, just because they do, and don't be afraid of something, just because they are.
translation_verse: “Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni maŋbii nɛɛ tsɛɔ lɛ apam lɛ, nyɛkatsɛa lɛ apam; asaŋ nyɛkashea nɔ ni amɛsheɔ lɛ gbeyei, ni nyɛtsuii akafãa hu.

english_verse: I am the one you should fear and respect. I am the holy God, the Lord All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Shi moŋ nyɛbua Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, akɛ Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni lɛ moŋ gbeyei nyɛshea, ni lɛ ehe ŋmiŋmi amɔa nyɛ,

english_verse: Run to me for protection. I am a rock that will make both Judah and Israel stumble and break their bones. I am a trap that will catch the people of Jerusalem—they will be captured and dragged away. Isaiah and His Followers
translation_verse: Mɛi babaoo aaatɛrɛ tɛsaa nɛɛ, ni amɛaagbeegbee shi, ni amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã. Aaadu amɛ yɛ tsɔne mli, ni aaamɔmɔ amɛ.” Abɔ Sisatsɛmɔ he kɔkɔ

english_verse: My message and my teachings are to be sealed and given to my followers.
translation_verse: Nyɛ mikaselɔi lɛ, nyɛbaa tsɔsemɔ wiemɔi lɛ ayi yɛ nyɛteŋ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, I patiently trust the Lord, even though he is no longer pleased with Israel.
translation_verse: Miikwɛ Yehowa, mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ etee Yakob we lɛ gbɛ, ni mikɛ mihiɛ aaafɔ enɔ.

english_verse: My children and I are warning signs to Israel from the Lord All-Powerful, who lives on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Naa, mi kɛ bii ni Yehowa ehã mi lɛ, wɔji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mɔ ni hiɔ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, dɛŋ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii hã Israel.

english_verse: Someone may say to you, “Go to the fortunetellers who make soft chirping sounds or ask the spirits of the dead. After all, a nation ought to be able to ask its own gods
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ko aaakɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyabia okɔmfoi kɛ klamɔfoi ni wieɔ gugɔjiaŋ kɛ akroma gbee lɛ nii lɛ, nyɛkɛa akɛ aso esaaa akɛ maŋbii biɔ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ moŋ nii? Aso esa akɛ abiɔ gbohiinii ahaa hiɛkãalɔi moŋ?”

english_verse: what it should do.” None of those who talk like that will live to see the light of day!
translation_verse: Nyɛtoa he akɛ, “Nyɛmɔa Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ kɛ ehe odaseyeli lɛ mli. Anɔkwa, nɔ ni nifeelɔi lɛ kɛɔ nyɛ lɛ, nɔ kpakpa ko ejɛŋ mli.” Haomɔ be

english_verse: They will go around in great pain and will become so hungry that they will angrily curse their king and their gods. And when they try to find help in heaven
translation_verse: Amɛaakpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ hejaramɔ kɛ hɔmɔ ni naa wa, ni amɛbaalomɔ amɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Amɛaawo amɛhiɛ nɔ amɛkwɛ ŋwɛi,

english_verse: and on earth, they will find only trouble and darkness, terrible trouble and deepest darkness.
translation_verse: ni amɛaakwɛ shikpɔŋ hu. Shi naa, amɛnaŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko fe hejaramɔ kɛ duŋ kabitii; ni aaatsi amɛ awo duŋ kabitii lɛ mli.

english_verse: But those who have suffered will no longer be in pain. The territories of Zebulun and Naphtali in Galilee were once hated. But this land of the Gentiles across the Jordan River and along the Mediterranean Sea will be greatly respected. War Is Over
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ duŋ kabitii lɛ woŋ mɔ ni aaahi jaramɔ mli lɛ he gbeyei. Wɔsɛɛ Maŋtsɛ lɛ Sa lɛ eha Zebulon kɛ Naftali fɛɛ hiɛ shwie shi; shi agbɛnɛ eeewo ŋshɔnaa shikpɔŋ lɛ, Yordan sɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ, jeŋmaji Galilea lɛ, hiɛ nyam.

english_verse: Those who walked in the dark have seen a bright light. And it shines upon everyone who lives in the land of darkest shadows.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni nyiɛ duŋ mli lɛ, ena la kpeteŋkple ko; mɛi ni hi duŋ kabitii shikpɔŋ nɔ lɛ, la ekpɛ ehã amɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you have made your nation stronger. Because of you, its people are glad and celebrate like workers at harvest time or like soldiers dividing up what they have taken.
translation_verse: Ohã maŋbii lɛ ayi efa, Ohã amɛnyamɔ efa. Amɛmiinya yɛ ohiɛ tamɔ anyaa yɛ nikpamɔ be mli, loo tamɔ mɛi nyaa kɛji amɛmiija haanii.

english_verse: You have broken the power of those who abused and enslaved your people. You have rescued them just as you saved your people from Midian.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ amɛkɔŋtso ni tsɔ̃ jatsu lɛ, kɛ amɛkpalamɔ tso lɛ kɛ amɛnɔyelɔ lɛ dɛŋ kpãa lɛ okumɔ fɛɛ mli, tamɔ ofee Midian ta lɛ.

english_verse: The boots of marching warriors and the blood-stained uniforms have been fed to flames and eaten by fire. A Child Has Been Born
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ aspaatre fɛɛ aspaatre ni tabilɔ kɛbaashimɔ shi yɛ ta lɛ mli kɛ atade fɛɛ atade ni lá ewu mli lɛ, akɛbaafee lai ni ashã.

english_verse: A child has been born for us. We have been given a son who will be our ruler. His names will be Wonderful Advisor and Mighty God, Eternal Father and Prince of Peace.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ afɔ bi ahã wɔ! Afɔ binuu ahã wɔ. Elumɔyeli kã ekɔŋ. Abaatsɛ lɛ “Naakpɛɛ Ŋaawolɔ,” “Nyɔŋmɔ Hewalɔ, Naanɔtsɛ, Hejɔlɛ Lumɔ.”

english_verse: His power will never end; peace will last forever. He will rule David's kingdom and make it grow strong. He will always rule with honesty and justice. The Lord All-Powerful will make certain that all of this is done. God Will Punish Israel
translation_verse: Emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ shweremɔ kɛ edɛŋ toiŋjɔlɛ lɛ, esɛɛ efoŋ yɛ David maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ, kɛ emaŋtsɛyeli hei fɛɛ. Ekɛ jalɛ saneyeli kɛ nɔ ni ja feemɔ baahã emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ama shi kɛya naanɔ. Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ hiɛdɔɔ baafee enɛ. Yehowa baagbala Israel toi

english_verse: The Lord had warned the people of Israel,
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ wiemɔ emaje ekɛmiishi Israel, ni ji Yakob shwiei lɛ,

english_verse: and all of them knew it, including everyone in the capital city of Samaria. But they were proud and stubborn and said,
translation_verse: ni Efraimbii kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Samaria fɛɛ aaana ale, amɛ mɛi ni amɛkɛ henɔwomɔ kɛ hewoo jwɛŋmɔ kɛɔ akɛ,

english_verse: “Houses of brick and sycamore have fallen to the ground, but we will build houses with stones and cedar.”
translation_verse: “Brikisi tsui lɛ ekumɔ, shi wɔ lɛ wɔkɛ tɛ ni ako baatswa tsui lɛ, ni atoo sikamore tsei lɛ ashwie shi, shi wɔ lɛ, wɔɔtɛo tsenedru tsei yɛ amɛnajiaŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord made their enemies attack them.
translation_verse: Yehowa aaatee henyɛlɔi ashi awo amɛ.

english_verse: He sent the Arameans from the east and the Philistines from the west, and they swallowed up Israel. But even this did not stop him from being angry, so he kept on punishing them.
translation_verse: Siriabii miijɛ bokãgbɛ, ni Filistibii hu miijɛ anaigbɛ amɛba kɛ amɛdaaŋ ni amɛgbɛ hatoo amɛkɛbami Israel. Kɛ̃lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa mlifu lɛ naa ejɔŋ; etoigbalamɔ nine lɛ ekpã mli lolo.

english_verse: The people of Israel still did not turn back to the Lord All-Powerful and worship him.
translation_verse: Israelbii lɛ kpaleee amɛbaaa mɔ ni gbala amɛtoi lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛtaooo Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, sɛɛgbɛ.

english_verse: In one day he cut off their head and tail, their leaves and branches.
translation_verse: Hewɔ lɛ gbi kometoo nɔ lɛ Yehowa baafo Israel yitso kɛ elei fɛɛ; ebaafo blɛo kɛ glã fɛɛ gbi kome.

english_verse: Their rulers and leaders were the head, and the lying prophets were the tail.
translation_verse: Maŋ onukpa kɛ hiɛnaanɔ gbɔmɔ ji yitso lɛ, ni gbalɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ amale tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, lɛ ji lei lɛ.

english_verse: They had led the nation down the wrong path, and the people were confused.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ maŋbii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ ehã maŋbii lɛ edu gbɛ, ni amɛ mɛi ni anyiɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ ahiɛ ekpãtã.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with his people and kept punishing them, because they had turned against him. They were evil and spoke foolishly. That's why he did not have pity on their young people or on their widows and orphans.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ naŋ amɛblahii lɛ ahe miishɛɛ, ni emusuŋ etsɔŋ lɛ yɛ amɛwusãi kɛ amɛkulafoi lɛ ahe. Ejaakɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, ebɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ, ni asaŋ efɔŋfeelɔ ni, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ wieɔ kwashiai awiemɔ. Kɛ̃lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa mlifu lɛ ejɔŋ; etoigbalamɔ nine lɛ ekpã mli lolo.

english_verse: Evil had spread like a raging forest fire sending thornbushes up in smoke.
translation_verse: Maŋbii lɛ ayitsoŋwalɛ tsoɔ tamɔ la. Eshãa kpitikpitii kɛ ŋmeii fɛɛ; esɔoɔ koo hayii anaa la, ni elasu pukɔŋŋ lɛ teɔ shi kɛyaa ŋwɛi.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful was angry and used the people as fuel for a fire that scorched the land. They turned against each other
translation_verse: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mlifu lɛ naa lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ shã. Maŋbii lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ latso ni tsoɔ; mɔ ko mɔ ko yeee buaa enyɛmi.

english_verse: like wild animals attacking and eating everyone around them, even their own relatives. But still they were not satisfied.
translation_verse: Amɛaashara nii amɛye yɛ ninejurɔgbɛ, shi hɔmɔ aaaye amɛ kɛ̃, ni amɛaaye nii yɛ amɛbɛkugbɛ hu, shi amɛtɔrɔŋ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaaye enaanyo loo.

english_verse: The tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh turned against each other, then joined forces to attack Judah. But the Lord was still angry and ready to punish the nation even more.
translation_verse: Manase aaate shi awo Efraim, ni Efraim hu aaatua Manase, ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaate shi amɛwo Yuda. Kɛ̃lɛ enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa mlifu lɛ ejɔŋ, ni etoigbalamɔ nine lɛ ekpã mli lolo.

english_verse: You people are in for trouble! You have made cruel and unfair laws
translation_verse: Kpoo ha mlawolɔi ni woɔ mlai ni ejaaa, kɛ mɛi ni ŋmalaa mlai ni akɛfeɔ mɛi niseniianii lɛ.

english_verse: But what will you do when you are fiercely attacked and punished by foreigners? Where will you run for help? Where will you hide your valuables?
translation_verse: Te nyɛaafee tɛŋŋ yɛ nakai toigbalamɔ gbi lɛ nɔ, be ni ahum baatswa kɛjɛ shɔŋŋ kɛba lɛ? Namɔ ŋɔɔ nyɛaajo foi kɛaaya nyɛyatao yelikɛbuamɔ; ni nɛgbɛ nyɛaashi nyɛnii ni nyɛna lɛ yɛ?

english_verse: How will you escape being captured or killed? The Lord is still angry, and he isn't through with you yet! The Lord's Purpose and the King of Assyria
translation_verse: Eshwɛŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko feemɔ fe akɛ amɛdɔ kɔmɔɔ yɛ gboklɛfoi ateŋ, aloo amɛ hu amɛnyɔnyɔi. Kɛ̃lɛ enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa mlifu lɛ ejɔŋ; ni etoigbalamɔ nine lɛ ekpã mli lolo. Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ baatsu nii

english_verse: to beat down you godless people. I am angry with you, and I will send him to attack you. He will take what he wants and walk on you like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Mifã lɛ miwo maŋ ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ he. Mifã lɛ koni eyatua mɛi ni mimli efu amɛ lɛ, koni eyaha amɛ, koni eshɔ̃ amɛdɛŋ nii, koni enaanaa amɛnɔ tamɔ anaa blohuŋ ŋmiamɔ.

english_verse: The king of Assyria says: My army commanders are kings!
translation_verse: ejaakɛ nɔ ni ekɛɔ ji akɛ, “Ani mitatsɛmɛi lɛ jeee maŋtsɛmɛi sɔŋŋ ni?

english_verse: They have already captured the cities of Calno, Carchemish, Hamath, Arpad, Samaria, and Damascus.
translation_verse: Ani Kalno tamɔɔɔ Karkemish, ni Hamat tamɔɔɔ Arpad, ni Samaria tamɔɔɔ Damasko hã mi?

english_verse: The gods of Jerusalem and Samaria are weaker than the gods of those powerful nations. And I will destroy Jerusalem, together with its gods and idols, just as I did Samaria.
translation_verse: enyiɛ nɔŋŋ ni mifeŋ Yerusalɛm kɛ emli amãgãi lɛ tamɔ mifee Samaria kɛ emli amãgãi lɛ?”

english_verse: The Lord will do what he has planned against Jerusalem and Mount Zion. Then he will punish the proud and boastful king of Assyria,
translation_verse: Kɛji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbe enitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ naa yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ, ebaagbala Asiria maŋtsɛ toi yɛ eshwãa kɛ ehewoo lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: who says: I did these things by my own power because I am smart and clever. I attacked kings like a wild bull, and I took the land and the treasures of their nations.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mi diɛŋtsɛ mihewalɛ kɛ minilee naa mitsu enɛ yɛ, ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã shi, Mitsirɛ majimaji ahusui kɛtee sɛɛ, ni mishɔ̃shɔ̃ɔ amɛmli jwetri; mitsirɛ mɛi ni tara maŋtsɛ sɛii anɔ mitswia shi tamɔ tsina feɔ.

english_verse: I have conquered the whole world! And it was easier than taking eggs from an unguarded nest. No one even flapped a wing or made a peep.
translation_verse: Minine eshɛ majimaji lɛ anii ni amɛna anɔ tamɔ aloɔ loofɔlɔ wɔji yɛ etsu mli be ni ebɛ jɛi lɛ, nakai minine eshɛ majimaji lɛ anii anɔ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni baatswa efijiaŋ aloo etswa esɛŋ ekɛɛ nɔ ko.”

english_verse: The mighty Lord All-Powerful will send a terrible disease to strike down your army, and you will burn with fever under your royal robes.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, lootãa hela aye etabilɔi ni eshwishwii lɛ, ni aaawo enyam lɛ shishi la, ni eeetso tamɔ la.

english_verse: The holy God, who is the light of Israel, will turn into a fire, and in one day you will go up in flames, just like a thornbush.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ, Israel kane lɛ atsɔ̃ la, ni Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ la lilɛi, ni ebaatso, ni ebaashã ŋmeii kɛ kpitikpitii ni yɔɔ Israel lɛ fɛɛ gbi ko.

english_verse: There will be so few trees that even a young child can count them. Only a Few Will Come Back
translation_verse: Kooŋ tsei ni aaashwɛ afalɛ shɛŋ nɔ ko bɔ sɔŋŋ ni gbekɛ tete aaanyɛ amɛyibɔ akane. Mɛi fioo kɛ̃ aaaku amɛsɛɛ amɛba

english_verse: A time is coming when the survivors from Israel and Judah will completely depend on the holy Lord of Israel, instead of the nation that defeated them.
translation_verse: Be miiba, ni nakai be lɛ gbɔmɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ Israel kɛ Yakob shwiei ni ahe eje gbele mli lɛ kɛ amɛhiɛ efɔŋ mɔ ni tswia amɛ nii lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ aaafɔ Yehowa, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Koome lɛ, nɔ yɛ anɔkwale mli.

english_verse: There were as many people as there are grains of sand along the seashore, but only a few will survive to come back to Israel's mighty God. This is because he has threatened to destroy their nation, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Eyɛ mli akɛ nyɛwebii, Israelbii, ayi fa tamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia moŋ, shi nyɛyi fioo ko pɛ ni aaaku amɛsɛɛ aba. Hiɛkpãtãmɔ ni ato miimɛ nyɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ jalɛ yɛ mli.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has promised that everyone on this earth will be punished.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, baakpãtã nibii ahiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kɛmɔ shi tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ. Yehowa baagbala Asiria toi

english_verse: Now the Lord God All-Powerful says to his people in Jerusalem: The Assyrians will beat you with sticks and abuse you, just as the Egyptians did. But don't be afraid of them.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, “Ao mimɛi ni yɔɔ Zion, nyɛkashea Asiriabii lɛ gbeyei kɛji amɛkɛ dadei kɛ amɛdɛ̃hiɛmɔtsei tswia nyɛ tamɔ Ijiptbii lɛ fee nyɛ lɛ.
