english_verse: Soon I will stop being angry with you, and I will punish them for their crimes.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ eshwɛ be fioo, kɛkɛ lɛ mimli ni efu nyɛ lɛ sɛɛ baafo, ni mibatsɔ̃ mlifu lɛ mahã amɛ, ni makpãtã amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: I will beat the Assyrians with a whip, as I did the people of Midian near the rock at Oreb. And I will show the same mighty power that I used when I made a path through the sea in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ni mi, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mibadɔ kpelebi mato amɛnɔ magwao amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mifee Midianbii lɛ yɛ Oreb Tɛsaa lɛ nɔ lɛ. Mibawó tso nɛɛ nɔ yɛ ŋshɔ nɔ tamɔ mifee yɛ Ijipt lɛ.

english_verse: Then they will no longer rule your nation. All will go well for you, and your burden will be lifted.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ mibawo Asiria jatsu lɛ kɛje nyɛkɔŋ, ni abaakumɔ apã ni kã nyɛkuɛ lɛ.” Henyɛlɔi lɛ ebatua

english_verse: Enemy troops have reached the town of Aiath. They have gone through Migron, and they stored their supplies at Michmash,
translation_verse: Henyɛlɔ lɛ ejɛ Rimon ebashɛ Ai. Etsɔ̃ Migron kɛho, ni ekɛ Mikmash efee ejatsutoohe.

english_verse: before crossing the valley and spending the night at Geba. The people of Ramah are terrified; everyone in Gibeah, the hometown of Saul, has run away.
translation_verse: Amɛtsɔ̃ gɔji ateŋ tsɔ̃mɔhe lɛ, ni amɛwɔ yɛ Geba. Rama miikpokpo, ni Maŋtsɛ Saul maŋ Gebea ejo foi.

english_verse: Loud crying can be heard in the towns of Gallim, Laishah, and sorrowful Anathoth.
translation_verse: Ao Galimbii, nyɛbolɔa! Ao Laishabii, bo toi! Anatotbii, nyɛhãa amɛ hetoo.

english_verse: No one is left in Madmenah or Gebim.
translation_verse: Madmenabii hiɛ foi, ni Gebim maŋ lɛ mli bii miijo foi kɛyatao abobaahe.

english_verse: Today the enemy will camp at Nob and shake a threatening fist at Mount Zion in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ ebaato shi yɛ Nob, ni ebaawo atswɛrɛ nɔ ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ Zion Gɔŋ, ni ji Yerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful will use his fearsome might to bring down the tallest trees and chop off every branch.
translation_verse: Naa, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ hewalɛ ko baafolɔ tsei aniji lɛ eshwie shi. Nii ni ekwɔlɔ gojogojoo lɛ, abaafolɔ amɛ ashwie shi; ni nii ni ehole amɛhe nɔ lɛ, abaafolɔ nɔ.

english_verse: With an ax, the glorious Lord will destroy every tree in the forests of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ lema baagba koo hayii lɛ, ni Lebanon baagbee shi kɛ etsei wujiwuji lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Like a branch that sprouts from a stump, someone from David's family will someday be king.
translation_verse: Tso fɔ aaakwɛ̃ kɛaajɛ Ishai tso kuku lɛ mli, ni tso nine ko aaahere kɛaajɛ eshishi fã lɛ mli awo yibii.

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord will be with him to give him understanding, wisdom, and insight. He will be powerful, and he will know and honor the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ baahi enɔ, ni ebaaduro lɛ nilee kɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ mumɔ kɛ ŋaawoo kɛ hewalɛ mumɔ kɛ Yehowa he nilee kɛ lɛ gbeyeishemɔ mumɔ.

english_verse: His greatest joy will be to obey the Lord. This king won't judge by appearances or listen to rumors.
translation_verse: Eeena Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ he miishɛɛ. Bɔ ni ehiŋmɛii naa lɛ, jeee nakai ebaakojo; bɔ ni etoi nuɔ lɛ, jeee nakai ebaakojo.

english_verse: The poor and the needy will be treated with fairness and with justice. His word will be law everywhere in the land, and criminals will be put to death.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ eeekojo ohiafoi lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa; ni eeebu shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ humii lɛ atɛŋ yɛ jalɛ naa. Ekɛ edaaŋ wiemɔ aaaplene shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii, ni ekɛ emumɔ lɛ aaagbe mɔ fɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Honesty and fairness will be his royal robes.
translation_verse: Ni eeeye emaŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ jalɛ kɛ anɔkwayeli.

english_verse: Leopards will lie down with young goats, and wolves will rest with lambs. Calves and lions will eat together and be cared for by little children.
translation_verse: Klaŋ kɛ gwantɛŋbi baahi shi, ni kootsɛ kɛ abotiabi baabumɔ shi, ni tsinabi kɛ jatabi baahi he kome, ni gbekɛ bibioo baakpala amɛ.

english_verse: Cows and bears will share the same pasture; their young will rest side by side. Lions and oxen will both eat straw.
translation_verse: Tsinayoo kɛ oshishibrishi baaye nii yɛ he kome, ni amɛbii hu baabumɔ shi yɛ he kome, ni jata baakpe jwɛi tamɔ tsina nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Little children will play near snake holes. They will stick their hands into dens of poisonous snakes and never be hurt.
translation_verse: Gbekɛ fufɔoo baashwɛ yɛ shikpãa bu naa, ni bi ni atse lɛ fufɔ kɛ enine baawo onufu bu mli, ni efeŋ lɛ nɔ ko.

english_verse: Nothing harmful will take place on the Lord's holy mountain. Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord. God's People Will Come Back Home
translation_verse: Afeŋ efɔŋ, ni afiteŋ nii yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Gɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, Zion, nɔ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ Yehowa he nilee baayi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ŋshɔ eyi obɔ kɛ nu lɛ. Nomii baaku amɛsɛɛ amɛba

english_verse: The time is coming when one of David's descendants will be the signal for the people of all nations to come together. They will follow his advice, and his own nation will become famous.
translation_verse: Be miiba be ni maŋtsɛ ni aaajɛ Ishai mli lɛ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ aflaŋaa ni ashi ahã majimaji lɛ. Lɛ esɛɛgbɛ maji lɛ fɛɛ aaatao, ni eshihilɛhe lɛ hiɛ baaba nyam.

english_verse: When that day comes, the Lord will again reach out his mighty arm and bring home his people who have survived in Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Ethiopia, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, and the land along the coast.
translation_verse: Nakai be mli lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ hewalɛ baakpɔ̃ ewebii ni eshwɛ lolo lɛ, nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ, kɛjɛ Asiria kɛ Ijipt kɛ Patros kɛ Kush kɛ Elam kɛ Babilon kɛ Hamat, asaŋ kɛ ŋshɔnaa shikpɔji lɛ anɔ kɛaaba.

english_verse: He will give a signal to the nations, and he will bring together the refugees from Judah and Israel, who have been scattered all over the earth.
translation_verse: Yehowa aaashi aflaŋaa etsɔ̃ɔ maji lɛ kɛto okadi akɛ eebua Israelbii ni ashɛrɛ amɛ ashwie lɛ kɛ Yudabii ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã lɛ anaa kɛjɛ jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ kɛbakpe.

english_verse: Israel will stop being jealous of Judah, and Judah will no longer be the enemy of Israel.
translation_verse: Ni Israel yeŋ Yuda he awuŋã dɔŋŋ, ni Yuda hu efeŋ Israel henyɛlɔ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Instead, they will get together and attack the Philistines in the west. Then they will defeat the Edomites, the Moabites, and the Ammonites in the east. They will rule those people and take from them whatever they want.
translation_verse: Shi amɛbaafee ekome amɛyatua Filistibii yɛ anaigbɛ, ni amɛbaafee ekome amɛyaha bokãgbɛbii lɛ anibii. Amɛbaaye Edom kɛ Moab nɔ kunim, ni Amonbii baabo amɛtoi.

english_verse: The Lord will dry up the arm of the Red Sea near Egypt, and he will send a scorching wind to divide the Euphrates River into seven streams that anyone can step across.
translation_verse: Yehowa baafite he ni Ijipt Faa lɛ kɛ enaa woɔ ŋshɔŋ yɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ ehewalɛ baahã kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ atswa yɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ nɔ, ni ebaaŋala Faa lɛ niji kpawo lɛ, ni mɛi aaanyiɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ kɛfo.

english_verse: Then for his people who survive, there will be a good road from Assyria, just as there was a good road for their ancestors when they left Egypt.
translation_verse: Ni eeetsɔ̃ tɛmpɔŋ ehã emaŋ lɛ mli mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, mɛi ni eshwɛ ni aaajɛ Asiria aba lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni jɛi tsɔ̃ gbɛ ha Israel be ni amɛje Ijipt lɛ.

english_verse: At that time you will say, “I thank you, Lord! You were angry with me, but you stopped being angry and gave me comfort.
translation_verse: Be ko miiba, ni nakai gbi lɛ obaala okɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa, miida bo shi, ejaakɛ omlifu mi moŋ, shi omlifu lɛ enaa ejɔ, ni oshɛje mimii.

english_verse: I trust you to save me, Lord God, and I won't be afraid. My power and my strength come from you, and you have saved me.”
translation_verse: Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ji miyiwalaherelɔ. Mihiɛ baakã enɔ, ni misheŋ gbeyei ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ji mihewalɛ kɛ milala, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ etsɔ̃ miyiwalaheremɔ.

english_verse: With great joy, you people will get water from the well of victory.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ nyamɔ aaayɛ nu yɛ yiwalaheremɔ bui lɛ amli.’

english_verse: At that time you will say, “Our Lord, we are thankful, and we worship only you. We will tell the nations how glorious you are and what you have done.
translation_verse: Ni nakai gbi lɛ, nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛdaa Yehowa shi, nyɛtsɛa egbɛi lɛ. Nyɛhãa majimaji lɛ alea nibii ni efee; nyɛhãa alea akɛ egbɛi tsii.

english_verse: Because of your wonderful deeds we will sing your praises everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Nyɛlaa kɛkafoa Yehowa, ejaakɛ efee nibii wuji. Nyɛhãa alea enɛ yɛ jeŋ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Sing, people of Zion! Celebrate the greatness of the holy Lord of Israel. God is here to help you.
translation_verse: Ao, nyɛ Zion maŋbii, nyɛbolɔa, ni nyɛnyaa, ejaakɛ Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Koome ni da lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.”

english_verse: This is the message that I was given about Babylon:
translation_verse: Babilon toigbalamɔ he gbalɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛtsɔ̃ Amoz bi Yesaia nɔ nɛ.

english_verse: From high on a barren hill give a signal, shout the orders, and point the way to enter the gates of Babylon's proud rulers.
translation_verse: Nyɛshĩa aflaŋaa yɛ gɔŋ kɛ eyiteŋ kpataa nɔ, nyɛbolɔa nyɛtsɛa amɛ, nyɛfɔa amɛ nine, koni amɛbabote lumɛi agboi amli.

english_verse: The Lord has commanded his very best warriors and his proud heroes to show how angry he is.
translation_verse: Mi diɛŋtsɛ mifã mimɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni ji mitabilɔi kakabãi lɛ, koni amɛkɛ mɛi ni nyaa kɛ hewoo lɛ aye yɛ mimlifu lɛ naa.

english_verse: Listen to the noisy crowds on the mountains! Kingdoms and nations are joining forces. The Lord All-Powerful is bringing together an army for battle.
translation_verse: Nyɛboa toi! Aafee hoo yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ tamɔ mɛi babaoo ahoofeemɔ. Naa jeŋ majimaji ni jɛ maŋtsɛyeli shikpɔji anɔ ahoofeemɔ ni; Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, miibua tabilɔi asafo naa kɛha tawuu.

english_verse: From a distant land the Lord is coming fierce and furious— he brings his weapons to destroy the whole earth.
translation_verse: Amɛjɛ shikpɔji ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ yɛ jeŋ naagbeehei lɛ anɔ; Yehowa miiba kɛ mlifu kɛ tawuunii koni ebakpãtã je lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: Cry and weep! The day is coming when the mighty Lord will bring destruction. *
translation_verse: Nyɛwɔa lele ejaakɛ gbi ni Yehowa to lɛ eshɛ shi etã. Akɛni niiahiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ jɛ Ofe lɛ dɛŋ lɛ, ebaaba mli kɛ̃.

english_verse: All people will be terrified. Hands will grow limp; courage will melt away.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ niji baagboi yɛ ehe, gbɔmɛi adesai fɛɛ atsuii baafã,

english_verse: Everyone will tremble with pain like a woman giving birth; they will stare at each other with horror on their faces. There Will Be No Mercy
translation_verse: ni amɛbaajijaa; ŋmiŋmi baamɔmɔ amɛ, ni amɛbaababla shi tamɔ yoo ni miikɔmɔ; amɛaakwɛkwɛɛ amɛhiɛiaŋ kɛ naakpɛɛ, ni amɛhiŋmɛii aaatsu tamɔ lá.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will show no mercy or pity when that time comes. In my anger I will destroy the earth and every sinner who lives on it.
translation_verse: Naa, gbi ni Yehowa eto lɛ miiba. Gbi lɛ baafee yiwalɛ gbi ni jɛ mlila kɛ mlifu ni naa wa mli. Ebaaha je lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni aaakpãtã emli eshafeelɔi lɛ ahiɛ kɛje je lɛ mli.

english_verse: Light will disappear from the stars in the sky; the dawning sun will turn dark, and the moon will lose its brightness.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ gbi lɛ ŋulamii krokomɛi lɛ kɛ oŋwɛ̃i fɛɛ kpɛŋ, ni hulushitee mli tɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ehiɛ aaawo duŋ, ni nyɔɔŋtsere hu kpɛŋ.

english_verse: I will punish this evil world and its people because of their sins. I will crush the horrible pride of those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Mibagbala je lɛ toi yɛ emli nifɔɔjianii hewɔ, ni mibagbala mɛi fɔ̃ji atoi yɛ amɛnɔshai lɛ ahewɔ. Mibaha hewolɔi ahetsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ sɛɛ afo, ni mibaba yiwalɔi ahenɔwomɔ lɛ shi.

english_verse: Survivors will be harder to find than the purest gold.
translation_verse: Mibahã gbɔmɔ adesa he asɛ̃ fe shika ŋmiiŋmi; adesa he baasɛ̃ fe Ofir shika ŋmiiŋmi.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am terribly angry— I will make the sky tremble and the earth shake loose.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mlifu ni naa wa lɛ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, yɛ emlila naa lɛ, ebaahã ŋwɛi he akpokpo, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ aaakpokpo kɛjɛ egbɛhe.

english_verse: Those men who are captured will be killed by a sword.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaana lɛ lɛ, aaatsu lɛ nɔ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaamɔ lɛ lɛ, eeenyɔ yɛ klante naa.

english_verse: They will see their children beaten against rocks, their homes robbed, and their wives abused.
translation_verse: Amɛmiikwɛ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni aaaŋɔ amɛbii atswia shi yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni amɛshĩa lɛ, aaahahaa amɛmli nii, ni amɛŋamɛi lɛ abaato amɛ kabonaa.”

english_verse: The Medes can't be bought off with silver or gold, and I'm sending them to attack Babylonia.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, miitee Midiabii ashi mawo Babilon. Amɛ lɛ amɛbuuu jwiɛtɛi, ni shika ekɔ̃ɔ amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: Their arrows will slaughter the young men; no pity will be shown to babies and children. The Lord Will Destroy Babylon
translation_verse: Amɛgãii baagbe oblahii lɛ, amɛmusuŋ etsɔŋ amɛ yɛ bii ni yɔɔ musuŋ tete he, ni amɛnaŋ gbekɛbii mɔbɔ.

english_verse: The city of Babylon is glorious and powerful, the pride of the nation. But it will be like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah after I, the Lord, destroyed them.
translation_verse: Babilon, maŋtsɛyelii amli oje lɛ ni ji Babilonbii anunyam kɛ shwãanii lɛ, baatsɔ tamɔ Sodom kɛ Gomora be ni Nyɔŋmɔ butu amɛ lɛ.

english_verse: No one will live in Babylon. Even nomads won't camp nearby, and shepherds won't let their sheep rest there.
translation_verse: Mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ jɛi kɔkɔɔkɔ dɔŋŋ, asaŋ akɛ jɛi efeŋ shihilɛhe yɛ yinɔ ko yinɔ ko nɔ dɔŋŋ. Arabnyo ko eshiŋ ebuu yɛ jɛi lɛ, tookwɛlɔ ko kɛ etoi eyaŋ niyeli yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: Only desert creatures, hoot owls, and ostriches will live in its ruins, and goats will leap about.
translation_verse: Jɛi aaatsɔ̃ ŋaŋ kooloi ashibumɔhe, ni tsui ni yɔɔ jɛi aaayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ patui. Dugumai kɛ jɛi aaafee amɛshihilɛhe, ni sasabonsami aaajo kɛnyiɛ jɛi.

english_verse: Hyenas and wolves will howl from Babylon's fortresses and beautiful palaces. Its time is almost up!
translation_verse: Klãji aaabolɔ yɛ emaŋtsɛmɛi ashĩai fɛɛfɛji lɛ amli. Babilon be lɛ eshɛ etã; atsiŋ ebe lɛ kɛyaŋ sɛɛ ahaŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord will have mercy on Israel and will let them be his chosen people once again. He will bring them back to their own land, and foreigners will join them as part of Israel.
translation_verse: Yehowa musuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ Yakob he, ni eeena Israel he tsuijurɔ ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛ Israelbii lɛ aaaba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ. Maŋsɛɛbii aaabafata amɛhe, ni amɛaadɔmɔ Yakob we lɛ.

english_verse: Other nations will lead them home, and Israel will make slaves of them in the land that belongs to the Lord. Israel will rule over those who once governed and mistreated them. Death to the King of Babylonia!
translation_verse: Maŋsɛɛbii aaawa Israelbii lɛ kɛaayashɛ Israelbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ hii nyɔji kɛ yei nyɔji aha Israelbii lɛ. Israelbii lɛ aaaŋɔ mɛi ni ŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ nom, ni amɛaaye mɛi ni fee amɛ niseniianii lɛ anɔ akɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi. Babilon Maŋtsɛ yɛ gbohiiaje

english_verse: The Lord will set you free from your sorrow, suffering, and slavery.
translation_verse: Kɛji Yehowa ha nyɛ hejɔlɛ kɛjɛ piŋmɔ kɛ tɔlɛ kɛ nyɔŋ keketee ni aye nyɛ lɛ mli lɛ,

english_verse: Then you will make fun of the King of Babylonia by singing this song: That cruel monster is done for! He won't attack us again.
translation_verse: nyɛkɛ wiemɔi aaabɔ Babilon maŋtsɛ ahora akɛ, “Te aye tɛŋŋ ni mlifu ni shimɔɔ shi lɛ sɛɛ efo nɛɛ? Te aye tɛŋŋ ni haolɔ lɛ bɛ dɔŋŋ nɛɛ?

english_verse: The Lord has crushed the power of those evil kings,
translation_verse: Yehowa efo yiwalɔ lɛ hewalɛ lɛ sɛɛ, ni Yehowa ekumɔ nɔyelɔi adɛŋ tsi lɛ mli,

english_verse: who were furious and never stopped abusing the people of other nations.
translation_verse: mɔ ni kɛ mlila tswia majimaji lɛ nii babaoo ni etooo enine shi lɛ, yɛ maji ni eye amɛnɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Now all the world is at peace; its people are celebrating with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ena hejɔlɛ, ni enɔ ejɔ; ni amɛmiila nyamɔ lalai.

english_verse: King of Babylonia, even the cypress trees and the cedars of Lebanon celebrate and say, “Since you were put down, no one comes along to chop us down.”
translation_verse: Sɛsɛoi lɛ miiye bo yɔɔ, ni Lebanon tsenedru lɛ miikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛjɛ ni aba bo shi nɛɛ lɛ, tsotoolɔ ko bɛŋkɛko wɔ.’

english_verse: The world of the dead eagerly waits for you. With great excitement, the spirits of ancient rulers hear about your coming.
translation_verse: “Gbohiiaje ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi esaa ehe eeba ebakpee bo. Ekanya mɛi fɛɛ ni ye onukpa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ yɛ ohewɔ; ni mɛi ni ye maŋtsɛ yɛ maji amli miihole amɛhe nɔ kɛmiijɛ amɛmaŋtsɛ sɛ̃ii anɔ.

english_verse: Each one of them will say, “Now you are just as weak as any of us!
translation_verse: Amɛ fɛɛ tswɛm amɛbaabi bo akɛ, ‘Bo hu ogbɔjɔ nɛkɛ tamɔ wɔ nɔŋŋ? Otsɔ̃ tamɔ wɔ nɔŋŋ, pɛpɛɛpɛ?’

english_verse: Your pride and your music have ended here in the world of the dead. Worms are your blanket, maggots are your bed.”
translation_verse: Aba ogbojee shi kɛba gbohiiaje, bo kɛ osaŋkui lɛ agbɛɛmɔ lɛ hu. Omlɛgɛ ji saa ni obaakã nɔ, ni gɔgɔmii ji mama ni obaaha.

english_verse: You, the bright morning star, have fallen from the sky! You brought down other nations; now you are brought down.
translation_verse: “Bo Tooloo, Jetsɛremɔ okadi, te aye tɛŋŋ ni ojɛ ŋwɛi obaagbee shi nɛɛ? Te aye tɛŋŋ ni, bo ni oba majimaji ashi lɛ, akɛ bo etswa shi nɛɛ?

english_verse: You said to yourself, “I'll climb to heaven and place my throne above the highest stars. I'll sit there with the gods far away in the north.
translation_verse: Shi bo lɛ okɛɛ ohe akɛ, ‘Mibakwɔ kɛya ŋwɛi kɛho Nyɔŋmɔ ŋulamii lɛ ahe. Mawo mimaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ kɛya ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ, ni mata nɔ yɛ kpee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: I'll be above the clouds, just like God Most High.”
translation_verse: Makwɔ kɛteke atatui lɛ, ni mibafee mihe tamɔ Ŋwɛi Grɔŋŋnyo lɛ.’

english_verse: But now you are deep in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ aaaba bo shi kɛaatee gbohiiaje, kɛaatee bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ shishi tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: Those who see you will stare and wonder, “Is this the man who made the world tremble and shook up kingdoms?
translation_verse: “Mɛi ni aaana bo lɛ, aaakwɛ bo gãa, ni amɛaabi amɛhe akɛ, ‘Kwɛɛ nuu lɛ ni hã shikpɔŋ lɛ hoso, ni ehã maŋtsɛyelii ahe kpokpo lɛ,

english_verse: Did he capture every city and make earth a desert? Is he the one who refused to let prisoners go home?”
translation_verse: mɔ ni kpãtã maji ahiɛ, ni ehã je lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ shiaŋa kpataa, ni eŋmɛɛɛ enomii ahe koni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛya amɛjaku shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ nɛ?’

english_verse: When kings die, they are buried in glorious tombs.
translation_verse: Jeŋ maji lɛ amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kamɔ shi kɛ anunyam, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ egbonyobu mli.

english_verse: But you will be left unburied, just another dead body lying underfoot like a broken branch. You will be one of many killed in battle and gone down to the deep rocky pit.
translation_verse: Shi bo lɛ ashɛ bo afɔ̃ kɛjɛ ogbonyobu lɛ mli tamɔ bi ni ashrake lɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, aaanyaŋe lɛ. Nɔ ni ona okɛha ohe ji mɛi ni akɛ klante egbe amɛ lɛ agbohii, ni amɛkpeleke shi kɛtee bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛtsɔmɔ tamɔ gbohii ni anaanaa amɛnɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You won't be buried with kings; you ruined your country and murdered your people. You evil monster! We hope that your family will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Akɛ bo fataŋ amɛhe afuŋ, ejaakɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ okpãtã oshikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni ogbe omaŋbii lɛ. Atsiŋ efɔŋfeelɔi ashwiei atã dɔŋŋ gbi ko gbi ko.

english_verse: We will slaughter your sons to make them pay for the crimes of their ancestors. They won't take over the world or build cities anywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Nyɛsaa gbɛhe nyɛtoa maŋtsɛ nɛɛ bii lɛ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi anɔsha lɛ hewɔ koni amɛkate shi amɛmiiŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ amɛmiifee amɛnɔ, ni amɛmiimamɔ maji amɛmiiwo je lɛ mli obɔ̃.” Nyɔŋmɔ baakpãtã Babilon hiɛ

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has promised to attack Babylonia and destroy everyone there, so that none of them will ever be remembered again.
translation_verse: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, “Mibate shi mawo Babilonbii, ni makpãtã amɛhiɛ, egbɛi kɛ enii ni eyɔɔ kɛ eshwiei fɛɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will sweep out the people, and the land will become a swamp for wild animals. Assyria Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Mibahã jɛi atsɔ̃ shadeboai ashihilɛhe kɛ kpaakpoi ashikpɔŋ. Mikɛ bolɔ baabɛɛ lɛ mashwie.” Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, kɛɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ baakpãtã Asiriabii ahiɛ

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has made this promise: Everything I have planned will happen just as I said.
translation_verse: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ekã kitã akɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ bɔ ni misusu lɛ, nakai ebaaba mli; ni bɔ ni mito miyiŋ lɛ, ja ena eba mli nakai.

english_verse: I will wipe out every Assyrian in my country, and I will crush those on my mountains. I will free my people from slavery to the Assyrians.
translation_verse: No ji akɛ mibakpãtã Asiriabii ni yɔɔ mishikpɔŋ, Israel, nɔ lɛ ahiɛ. Mibanaanaa amɛnɔ yɛ migɔji lɛ anɔ, ni mikɛbaawó Asiriabii apã ni kã Israelbii anɔ lɛ kɛje amɛkuɛ.”

english_verse: I have planned this for the whole world, and my mighty arm controls every nation.
translation_verse: Enɛ ji yiŋ ni ato yɛ je lɛ fɛɛ he lɛ, ni ji minine ni akpã mli kɛtee maji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have made these plans. No one can stop me now! The Philistines Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, eto eyiŋ, ni namɔ baaku naa? Ekpã enine mli, ni namɔ aaanyɛ enaa aku? Nyɔŋmɔ baakpãtã Filistibii ahiɛ

english_verse: This message came from the Lord in the year King Ahaz died:
translation_verse: Afi nɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahaz gbo lɛ, ajie ninaa nɛɛ ahã.

english_verse: Philistines, don't be happy just because the rod that punished you is broken. That rod will become a poisonous snake, and then a flying fiery dragon.
translation_verse: Ao Filistia, kaanya, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛkanyaa akɛ tso ni yi nyɛ lɛ eku; ejaakɛ blikã baajɛ klɛŋklɛŋ onufu lɛ mli eba, ni lɛ ebi lɛ aaafee onufu filikilɔ.

english_verse: The poor and needy will find pastures for their sheep and will live in safety. But I will starve some of you, and others will be killed.
translation_verse: Ohiafoi amli ohiafo lɛ aaana nii eye, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni ehia lɛ aaakamɔ shi yɛ hejɔlɛŋ shweshweeshwe; shi mikɛ hɔmɔ baagbe nyɛ, ni nyɛmɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ mibagbe amɛ.

english_verse: Cry and weep in the gates of your towns, you Philistines! Smoke blows in from the north, and every soldier is ready.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Filistia maji fɛɛ, nyɛwoa yara; nyɛbolɔa, nyɛfoa, nyɛtsui afãa, ejaakɛ lasu ko efã kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ; ni tabilɔi ni baa lɛ, yakagbɔmɔ ko bɛ amɛteŋ.

english_verse: If a messenger comes from a distant nation, you must say: “The Lord built Zion. Even the poorest of his people will find safety there.”
translation_verse: Mɛɛ hetoo aaahã Filistia bɔfoi lɛ? Aaakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Yehowa eto Zion shishi akɛ maŋ, ni jɛi ewebii shitswialɔi lɛ aaababa abo yɛ.”

english_verse: This is a message about Moab: The towns of Ar and Kir were destroyed in a night. Moab is left in ruins!
translation_verse: Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ toigbalamɔ he gbalɛ nɛ: Akɛni akpãtã Ar maŋ lɛ hiɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ jetsɛremɔ hewɔ lɛ, Moab bɛ nɔ ko mli dɔŋŋ. Ni Kir maŋ lɛ hiɛ ni akpãtã nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ jetsɛremɔ hewɔ lɛ Moab bɛ nɔ ko mli dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Everyone in Dibon has gone up to the temple and the shrines to cry and weep. All of Moab is crying. Heads and beards are shaved because of what happened at Nebo and Medeba.
translation_verse: Dibonbii lɛ ekwɔ kɛtee amɛwɔŋjamɔhei lɛ koni amɛyafo. Moabbii ewɔ lele yɛ Nebo kɛ Medeba maji lɛ ahewɔ. Amɛshɛ yi fɛɛ yi kɛ tsɛŋ fɛɛ tsɛŋ.

english_verse: In the towns and at home, everyone wears sackcloth and cries loud and long.
translation_verse: Amɛbumɔ kpekpe kɛnyiɛ blohuiaŋ, ni amɛwo lele kɛ yaafo tsoo yɛ tsui ayiteiaŋ kɛ jaji anɔ.

english_verse: From Heshbon and Elealeh, weeping is heard in Jahaz; Moab's warriors scream while trembling with fear. Pity Moab
translation_verse: Heshbon kɛ Eleale majiaŋbii lɛ miibolɔ, ni aanu amɛgbee yɛ Yahaz tɔ̃ɔ. Moab tabilɔi lɛ miibolɔ waa; amɛyoyro.

english_verse: I pity Moab! Its people are running to Zoar and to Eglath-Shelishiyah. They cry on their way up to the town of Luhith; on the road to Horonaim they tell of disasters.
translation_verse: Mitsui miiye miihã Moab. Emli foijelɔi eshɛ Zoar kɛ Eglat Shelishiya; mɛi kɛ yaafo miikwɔ kɛmiiya Luhit, ni mɛi hu ewo maŋ lɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ he yara yɛ Horonaim gbɛjegbɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The streams of Nimrim and the grasslands have dried up. Every plant is parched.
translation_verse: Nimrim Faa lɛ egbi; jɛi jwɛi eŋala, ni jwɛfɔ bɛ he ko he ko, ni baa ŋmɔŋ hu bɛ he ko he ko.

english_verse: The people of Moab are leaving, crossing over Willow Creek, taking everything they own and have worked for.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtereteree nii babaoo ni amɛyɔɔ kɛ nii ni amɛtĩa fɛɛ kɛmiifo faa naa kpãi ajɔɔ lɛ kɛya.

english_verse: In the towns of Eglaim and of Beerelim and everywhere else in Moab mournful cries are heard.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Moab husui anaa fɛɛ lɛ yaafo sɔŋŋ. Yaafo lɛ shɛ Eglaim kɛ Beer-Elim tɔ̃ɔ,

english_verse: The streams near Dimon are flowing with blood. But the Lord will bring even worse trouble to Dimon, because all in Moab who escape will be attacked by lions.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Dibon Faa lɛ eyi kɛ lá. Shi mibahã Dibon ana amanehulu ni naa wa fe nakai. Mɛi ni na foijee hegbɛ kɛje Moab lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, mibafã jata mawo amɛhe.

english_verse: Send lambs as gifts to the ruler of the land. Send them across the desert from Sela to Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛ toobii emaje kɛjɛ Sela maŋ lɛ mli, yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, koni akɛyahã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔyelɔ lɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The women of Moab crossing the Arnon River are like a flock of birds scattered from their nests.
translation_verse: Moabbii lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ loofɔji ni miitsomlo kɛmiiya kɛmiiba, amɛtamɔ loofɔji abii ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã yɛ Arnon Faa lɛ faafoohe lɛ.

english_verse: Moab's messengers say to the people of Judah, “Be kind and help us! Shade us from the heat of the noonday sun. Hide our refugees! Don't turn them away.
translation_verse: Amɛmiikɛɛ Yudabii akɛ, “Nyɛwoa wɔ ŋaa, ni nyɛyea jalɛ sane nyɛhãa wɔ. Nyɛfea tamɔ shwane fintiŋŋ hɔ̃ɔŋ nyɛhãa wɔ, ni nyɛkɛ mɛi ni ashwie amɛ lɛ atea, ni nyɛkatsɔa foijelɔi lɛ asɛɛgbɛ.

english_verse: Let our people live in your country and find safety here.” Moab, your cruel enemies will disappear; they will no longer attack and destroy your land.
translation_verse: Nyɛhãa Moabbii ni ashwie amɛ lɛ abato nyɛ gbɔ; nyɛfea nyɛhe teemɔhe nyɛhãa amɛ yɛ hiɛkpãtãlɔ lɛ dɛŋ. Kɛji mɔ ni haoɔ amɛ lɛ bɛ dɔŋŋ, ni niiahiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ sɛɛ efo, ni mɔ ni naanaa mɛi anɔ lɛ elaaje yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: Then a kingdom of love will be set up, and someone from David's family will rule with fairness. He will do what is right and quickly bring justice. Moab's Pride Is Destroyed
translation_verse: abaajɛ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee mli afo maŋtsɛyeli sɛ̃i ko ama shi. Mɔ ko baajɛ David shwiei ateŋ eta sɛ̃i nɛɛ nɔ, ni ebaaye maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ anɔkwayeli; ebaaye jalɛ sane yɛ kojomɔ mli, ni ebaakwɛ akɛ aaye jalɛ sane.”

english_verse: We have heard of Moab's pride. Its people strut and boast, but without reason.
translation_verse: Yudabii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔnu bɔ ni Moab wo ehe ehã; ewo ehe tsɔ̃. Wɔnu ehetsɔɔmɔ kɛ ehewoo kɛ ehetsɛmɔ. Shwãa ni eshwã lɛ fɛɛ asomoaŋ efolo ni.”

english_verse: Tell everyone in Moab to mourn for their nation. Tell them to cry and weep for those fancy raisins of Kir-Hareseth.
translation_verse: Belɛ nyɛhãa Moab awoa yara; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ awo yara ahã Moab. Aye ŋkɔmɔ waa yɛ Kir-Heres wainyibii ni abɔlɔ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Vineyards near Heshbon and Sibmah have turned brown. The rulers of nations used to get drunk on wine from those vineyards that spread to Jazer, then across the desert and beyond the sea.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Heshbon ŋmɔji lɛ ahiɛ ekpãtã, ni Sibma waintsei lɛ hu ahiɛ ekpãtã. Waintso ni eyibii hã majimaji alumɔ tɔrɔ dãa lɛ niji eyashɛ Yazer tɔ̃ɔ, ni egba bokãgbɛ kɛtee shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni etee anaigbɛ kɛyashɛ Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ.

english_verse: Now I mourn like Jazer for the vineyards of Sibmah. I shed tears for Heshbon and for Elealeh. There will be no more harvest celebrations
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mifo miha Sibma waintsei lɛ taakɛ mifo miha Yazer wainyibii lɛ. Ao Heshbon kɛ Eleale, mikɛ yaafonu baaju nyɛhe, ejaakɛ miishɛɛ ni okɛkpaa wainyibii kɛ oŋmãa lɛ sɛɛ efo.

english_verse: or joyful and happy times, while bringing in the crops. Singing and shouting are gone from the vineyards. There are no joyful shouts where grapes were pressed. God has silenced them all.
translation_verse: Nyamɔ kɛ miishɛɛ etã yɛ ŋmɔji lɛ amli, ni alaaa yɛ waintromi lɛ amli lɛ, abɔɔɔ oshe yɛ jɛi; wainŋalɔ ko eŋaaa wain lɛ, lala emu shi kɔ̃i yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: Deep in my heart I hurt for Moab and Kir-Heres.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, misusuma miifo emli tamɔ kpãa saŋku yɛ Moab hewɔ, ni mitsui mli miishã mi miihã Kir-Heres.

english_verse: It's useless for Moab's people to wear themselves out by going to their altars to worship and pray.
translation_verse: Kɛji Moabbii gba amɛhe naa kɛtee amɛwɔjamɔhei lɛ koni amɛyasɔle yɛ amɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, nɔ ko jɛŋ mli baŋ.

english_verse: The Lord has already said all of this about Moab.
translation_verse: Wiemɔ ni Yehowa wie yɛ Moab he nyɛsɛɛ ko nɛ.

english_verse: Now he says, “The contract of a hired worker is good for three years, but Moab's glory and greatness won't last any longer than that. Only a few of its people will survive, and they will be left helpless.”
translation_verse: Shi amrɔ nɛɛ Yehowa miikɛɛ akɛ, “Biɛ afii etɛ̃ mli lɛ, tamɔ afii ni apaafonyo yeɔ yɛ apaayelihe lɛ, Moab anunyam lɛ he guɔ baagbo, tsɛbelɛ amɛyi fa babaoo, ni emɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ ayifalɛ shɛŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko, ni amɛnaŋ hewalɛ ko.”

english_verse: This is a message about Damascus: Damascus is doomed! It will end up in ruins.
translation_verse: Damasko he gbalɛ nɛ, “Naa, abuŋ Damasko ashiŋ maji lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ, shi ebaatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃.

english_verse: The villages around Aroer will be deserted, with only sheep living there and no one to bother them.
translation_verse: Abaashi Siria maji lɛ ashwie shi kɛya naanɔ. Toi kɛ tsinai kɛ jɛi baafee amɛniyelihe, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko woŋ amɛhe gbeyei.

english_verse: Israel will lose its fortresses. The kingdom of Damascus will be destroyed; its survivors will suffer the same fate as Israel. The Lord All-Powerful has promised this. Sin and Suffering
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ko mɔɔ ko ni wa eshwɛŋ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Damasko yeŋ maŋ ko maŋ ko nɔ dɔŋŋ; ni mɛi ni baashwɛ yɛ Siria lɛ ahiɛ aaashwie shi tamɔ Israel. Mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɛ.”

english_verse: When that time comes, the glorious nation of Israel will be brought down; its prosperous people will be skin and bones.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Gbi miiba, ni nakai gbi lɛ Israel anunyam lɛ nɔ baagbɔ, ni eninamɔ ni ehã eshwi lɛ baatsɔ̃ ohia, ni ebaatã loo.

english_verse: It will be like an olive tree beaten with a stick, leaving two or three olives or maybe four or five on the highest or most fruitful branches. The Lord God of Israel has promised this.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ eeeshwɛ mɛi fioo yɛ Israel tamɔ bɔ ni kɛji ahoso mutso ni eshwɛɔ yibii enyɔ loo etɛ̃ kɛ̃ yɛ tso lɛ yiteŋ fɔfɔoo lɛ; loo bɔ ni eshwɛɔ yibii ejwɛ loo enumɔ oo ko yɛ aduawa tso ni ewo babaoo nɔ lɛ. Mi Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ.”

english_verse: At that time the people will turn and trust their Creator, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ mɛi ahiɛ baasɔ amɛ-Bɔlɔ lɛ; ni amɛbaakwɛ Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ gbɛ.

english_verse: They have built altars and places for burning incense to their goddess Asherah, and they have set up sacred poles for her. But they will stop worshiping at these places.
translation_verse: Amɛbuŋ afɔleshãa latɛi ni amɛkɛ amɛniji fee lɛ amɛhaŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko. Amɛkɛ nii ni amɛkɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛniji fee tamɔ Asherim wɔŋkoi lɛ loo tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛi lɛ efeŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Israel captured powerful cities and chased out the people who lived there. But these cities will lie in ruins, covered over with weeds and underbrush.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛmaji ni he wa lɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ maji ni Hivbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ jo foi shi ni amɛtsɔmɔ amaŋfɔ̃i be ni amɛjoɔ Israelbii lɛ anaa foi lɛ, ni nibii ahiɛ baakpãtã lɛ.

english_verse: Israel, you have forgotten the God who saves you, the one who is the mighty rock where you find protection. You plant the finest flowers to honor a foreign god.
translation_verse: Israel, ohiɛ ekpa oyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni okaiii obobaa Tɛsaa lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, yɛ mli akɛ oootɛo tsei fɛɛfɛji, ni ooofee wɔŋkoo oha maŋsɛɛ wɔŋ,

english_verse: The plants may sprout and blossom that very same morning, but it will do you no good, because you will suffer endless agony. God Defends His People
translation_verse: ni ooohã tsei nɛɛ ahere gbi nɔŋŋ ni otɛo amɛ lɛ, ni ooohã tsei nɛɛ agba afofro gbi leebi lɛ nɔŋŋ ni otɛo amɛ lɛ nɔ, shi nikpamɔ lɛ baaje odɛ̃ŋ, ni gbi lɛ aaatsɔ ŋkɔmɔyeli kɛ hejaramɔ ni naa wa gbi. Aye Henyɛlɔi amaji anɔ

english_verse: But even if they roar like a fearsome flood, God will give the command to turn them back. They will be like dust, or like a tumbleweed blowing across the hills in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Maji lɛ ahoofeemɔ lɛ tamɔ ŋshɔi agbɛɛmɔ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ aaaŋa amɛyi, ni amɛaajo foi kɛaatee sɛɛ shɔŋŋ, ni aaawo amɛ foi tamɔ gɔŋ nɔ tutuu yɛ lasuogbele mli.

english_verse: In the evening their attack is fierce, but by morning they are destroyed. This is what happens to those who raid and rob us.
translation_verse: Ni gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ aaahã ŋmiŋmi amɔmɔ mɛi, shi be ni je aaatsɛre lɛ anaŋ amɛ yɛ he ko he ko dɔŋŋ! Mɛi fɛɛ ni tswaa wɔ ojo kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni haa wɔ nii lɛ, nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni amɛnaagbee aaatamɔ ahã.

english_verse: Downstream from Ethiopia lies the country of Egypt, swarming with insects.
translation_verse: Ao! Shikpɔŋ ko yɛ Kush fai lɛ asɛɛ ni anuɔ fijiaŋtswaa yɛ nɔ,

english_verse: Egypt sends messengers up the Nile River on ships made of reeds. Send them fast to Ethiopia, whose people are tall and have smooth skin. Their land is divided by rivers; they are strong and brutal, feared all over the world.
translation_verse: ni etsuɔ ebɔfoi ni taraa ada lɛji amli kɛtsɔ̃ɔ Nilo faa lɛ hiɛ. Nyɛ bɔfoi ni nyɛhe yɔɔ oya, nyɛyaa maŋ ko ni emli bii kwɔlɔ ni amɛhe yɔɔ trotro lɛ aŋɔɔ. Asheɔ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ gbeyei yɛ kpaakpa kɛ shɔŋŋ, jaku ko ni he wa pam ni naanaa mɛi anɔ ji amɛ. Fai ejara amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, listen with care! A signal will be given on the mountains, and you will hear a trumpet.
translation_verse: Nyɛ jeŋ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛji ashi aflaŋaa yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa, ni kɛji akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ nyɛboa toi.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “I will calmly look down from my home above— as calmly as the sun at noon or clouds in the heat of harvest season.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Majɛ mishihilɛhe lɛ makwɛ kpoo tamɔ hulutsoo mli dɔlɛ, loo tamɔ atatu mli bɔ yɛ nikpamɔ be mli.

english_verse: Before the blossoms can turn into grapes, God will cut off the sprouts and hack off the branches.
translation_verse: Dani aaashɛ nikpamɔ be lɛ, be ni afofro lɛ ekpala, ni wainyibii bibii lɛ epue lɛ, ekɛ klante aaafolɔ niji lɛ ni etsɛ̃rɛ lɛ kɛ niji ni egbalagbalai lɛ eshwie.

english_verse: Ethiopians will be food for mountain vultures during the summer and for wild animals during the winter.
translation_verse: Abaashi gbohii lɛ ashwie shi ahã gɔji lɛ anɔ loofɔji kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi; ni loofɔji lɛ baaye amɛ hulutsoobe mli, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi lɛ baaye amɛ yɛ fɛibe mli.”

english_verse: Those Ethiopians are tall and their skin is smooth. They are feared all over the world, because they are strong and brutal. But at that time they will come from their land divided by rivers, and they will bring gifts to the Lord All-Powerful, who is worshiped on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ gbɔmɛi ni kwɔlɔ ni amɛhe yɔɔ trotro ni asheɔ amɛ gbeyei yɛ kpaakpa kɛ shɔŋŋ, jaku ko ni he wa pam ni naanaa mɛi anɔ, ni fai ejara amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ mli baatere nikeenii kɛbaha Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ni ajaa Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ yɛ lɛ.

english_verse: This is a message about Egypt: The Lord comes to Egypt, riding swiftly on a cloud. The people are weak from fear. Their idols tremble as he approaches and says,
translation_verse: Ijipt toigbalamɔ he gbalɛ nɛ. Naa, Yehowa ta atatu ni hiɛ foi nɔ kɛmiiba Ijipt. Ijipt amãgãi lɛ atsui efã yɛ ehiɛ.

english_verse: “I will punish Egypt with civil war— neighbors, cities, and kingdoms will fight each other.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mahã Ijiptbii ate shi awo Ijiptbii nɔŋŋ, ni amɛ kɛ amɛhe baawu: mɔ kɛ enyɛmi, mɔ kɛ enaanyo, maŋ kɛ maŋ kɛ maŋtsɛyeli kɛ maŋtsɛyeli.

english_verse: “Egypt will be discouraged when I confuse their plans. They will try to get advice from their idols, from the spirits of the dead, and from fortunetellers.
translation_verse: Mahã Ijiptbii awerɛ aho amɛhe fe nine, ni amɛyiŋtoi fɛɛ baafee yaka. Amɛbaaya amãgãi kɛ klamɔfoi kɛ sisai aŋɔɔ amɛyabi nii.

english_verse: I will put the Egyptians under the power of a cruel, heartless king. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have promised this.” Trouble along the Nile
translation_verse: Mibaŋɔ Ijiptbii mawo nɔyelɔ yitsoŋwalɔ ko dɛŋ, ni maŋtsɛ ko ni esane wa baaye amɛnɔ. Mi Yehowa, ni ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ.”

english_verse: The Nile River will dry up and become parched land.
translation_verse: Nilo Faa lɛ mli nu baaŋala, ni faa lɛ baagbi;

english_verse: Its streams will stink, Egypt will have no water, and the reeds and tall grass will dry up.
translation_verse: nujɔi ni agbala awo faa lɛ he lɛ amli nu baasha; ni Ijipt Nilo Faa lɛ niji lɛ amli nu baakpɔŋ ni ebaagbi, ni neŋ kɛ glãi lɛ hu baakpɔtɔ.

english_verse: None of the cloth makers will know what to do, and they will turn pale.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni kpooɔ ananaŋse anijiaŋ baaje wui, ni mɛi fɛɛ hu ni loɔ klala aaaye jaramɔ.

english_verse: Weavers will be confused; paid workers will cry and mourn. Egypt's Helpless Leaders
translation_verse: Mamalolɔi kɛ ninenaa nitsulɔi fɛɛ atsui baaye.

english_verse: The king's officials in Zoan are foolish themselves and give stupid advice. How can they say to him, “We are very wise, and our families go back to kings of long ago?”
translation_verse: Zoan maŋ lɛ mli lumɛi lɛ kwashiai sɔŋŋ ni. Farao ŋaawolɔi ni le nii jogbaŋŋ lɛ aŋaawoo lɛ etsɔ buuluiaŋaawoo. Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛkɛɔ Farao akɛ, “Nilelɔi abii ji wɔ, ni blema maŋtsɛmɛi ashwiei ji wɔ lɛ?”

english_verse: Where are those wise men now? If they can, let them say what the Lord All-Powerful intends for Egypt.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ Ijipt, nɛgbɛ onilelɔi lɛ yɔɔ? Hã amɛgba koni amɛhã ole nɔ yiŋtoo ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, eto yɛ ohe.

english_verse: The royal officials in Zoan and in Memphis are foolish and deceived. The leaders in every state have given bad advice to the nation.
translation_verse: Zoan lumɛi lɛ etsɔmɔ kwashiai, ni Memfis lumɛi hu alaka amɛ. Mɛi ni ji Ijipt akutsei lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ ehã Ijipt edu gbɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has confused Egypt; its leaders have made it stagger and vomit like a drunkard.
translation_verse: Yehowa ehã awo Ijipt ŋaa gbonyo, ni no hewɔ lɛ, Ijipt yiŋ feɔ lɛ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ, ni edidãa tamɔ dãatɔlɔ didãa kɛji eeshwe.

english_verse: When the Lord All-Powerful punishes Egypt with his mighty arm, the Egyptians will become terribly weak and will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Be miiba ni Ijiptbii baatsɔmɔ tamɔ yei. Amɛhe baakpokpo kɛ gbeyei yɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, nine nɔ ni ebaawo yɛ amɛnɔ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: They will be so terrified of Judah that they will be frightened by the very mention of its name. This will happen because of what the Lord All-Powerful is planning against Egypt. The Lord Will Bless Egypt, Assyria, and Israel
translation_verse: Yudabii ahe baaba gbeyei ahã Ijiptbii. Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aatsĩ Yuda gbɛi tã yɛ etoiŋ lɛ, eeeshe gbeyei yɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, yiŋ ni eto yɛ Ijiptbii ahe lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: The time is coming when Hebrew will be spoken in five Egyptian cities, and their people will become followers of the Lord. One of these cities will be called City of the Sun.
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ abaawie Hebribii awiemɔ lɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji enumɔ amli; ni amɛaakã Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ kitã. Abaatsɛ nɛkɛ maji nɛɛ ateŋ ekome akɛ, “Hulu Maŋ.”

english_verse: In the heart of Egypt an altar will be set up for the Lord; at its border a shrine will be built to honor him.
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, abaama afɔleshãa latɛ ahã Yehowa yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu, ni abaatswa akulashiŋ amã shikpɔŋ lɛ husu nɔ ahã Yehowa.

english_verse: These will remind the Egyptians that the Lord All-Powerful is with them. And when they are in trouble and ask for help, he will send someone to rescue them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Akulashiŋ nɛɛ baatsɔ̃ okadi kɛ odaseyeli nɔ ahã Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni kɛji amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, yɛ mɛi ni waa amɛ yi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, eeetsu yiwalaherelɔ kɛba amɛŋɔɔ, ni eeebafã amɛhe, ni eeehere amɛyiwala.

english_verse: The Lord will show the Egyptians who he is, and they will know and worship the Lord. They will bring him sacrifices and offerings, and they will keep their promises to him.
translation_verse: Yehowa aaajie ehe shi etsɔ̃ɔ Ijiptbii, ni Ijiptbii aaana ale Yehowa nakai be lɛ, ni amɛkɛ afɔle kɛ shãa afɔle aaabasɔmɔ lɛ, ni amɛaawo Yehowa shi, ni amɛaye nɔ.

english_verse: After the Lord has punished Egypt, the people will turn to him. Then he will answer their prayers, and the Egyptians will be healed.
translation_verse: Yehowa aaagbala Ijiptbii atoi, eeetswia amɛ nii, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ eeetsa amɛ ekoŋŋ, ni amɛaakpale kɛaaba Yehowa ŋɔɔ, ni eeebo amɛfaikpamɔ toi, ni eeetsa amɛ.

english_verse: At that time a good road will run from Egypt to Assyria. The Egyptians and the Assyrians will travel back and forth from Egypt to Assyria, and they will worship together.
translation_verse: Kɛji eshɛ nakai be lɛ, gbɛjegbɛ aaakã shi kɛaajɛ Ijipt kɛya Asiria; ni Asirianyo aaaba Ijipt, ni Ijiptnyo hu aaaya Asiria, ni Ijiptbii kɛ Asiriabii aaaja Yehowa yɛ he kome.

english_verse: Israel will join with these two countries. They will be a blessing to everyone on earth,
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ Israel kɛ Ijipt kɛ Asiria aaatsɔ̃mɔ tipɛŋfoi; ni maji etɛ̃ nɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ jɔɔmɔ ahã je lɛ mli maji fɛɛ.

english_verse: then the Lord All-Powerful will bless them by saying, “The Egyptians are my people. I created the Assyrians and chose the Israelites.”
translation_verse: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, aaajɔɔ amɛ akɛ, “Ajɔɔ Ijipt, ni ji mimaŋ lɛ, kɛ Asiria, ni ji mininenaa nitsumɔnii lɛ, kɛ Israel, mi diɛŋtsɛ mimaŋ ni mihala lɛ.”

english_verse: King Sargon of Assyria gave orders for his army commander to capture the city of Ashdod.
translation_verse: Afi nɔ ni Asiria Maŋtsɛ Sargon tsu etatsɛnukpa fe fɛɛ lɛ kɛba, ni ebatua Filistibii amaŋ Ashdod, ni eŋɔ maŋ lɛ,

english_verse: About this same time the Lord had told me, “Isaiah, take off everything, including your sandals!” I did this and went around naked and barefoot
translation_verse: Yehowa etsɔ̃ hiɛ afii etɛ̃ momo ekɛɛ Amoz bi Yesaia akɛ, “Yaa koni oyajie kpekpe lɛ yɛ ohɛ, ni ojie otokotai lɛ hu.” Yesaia fee nakai, ni enyiɛ yayai kɛ enane folo hu.

english_verse: for three years. Then the Lord said: What Isaiah has done is a warning to Egypt and Ethiopia.
translation_verse: Be ni aŋɔ Ashdod sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni mitsulɔ Yesaia nyiɛ yayai kɛ enane folo afii etɛ̃ ekɛto Ijipt kɛ Kush naakpɛɛ okadi lɛ,

english_verse: Everyone in these two countries will be led away naked and barefoot by the king of Assyria. Young or old, they will be taken prisoner, and Egypt will be disgraced.
translation_verse: nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ aaakpala Ijipt kɛ Kush akɛ nomii kɛaatee. Abaakpala gbekɛbii kɛ onukpai fɛɛ kɛ amɛhe yayai kɛ amɛdukui ahe ni kã kɛ amɛnane folo hu; ni Ijipt hiɛ aaashwie shi.

english_verse: They will be confused and frustrated, because they depended on Ethiopia and bragged about Egypt.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaahao ni amɛnaa aaakpɛ amɛhe yɛ Kush ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ enɔ lɛ kɛ agbɛnɛ Ijipt hu ni amɛshwã amɛfɔ enɔ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: When this happens, the people who live along the coast will say, “Look what happened to them! We ran to them for safety, hoping they would protect us from the king of Assyria. But now, there is no escape for us.”
translation_verse: Ni nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, nɛkɛ ŋshɔ nɛɛ naa bii lɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Naa nɔ ni eba mɛi ni wɔhiɛ kã amɛnɔ lɛ anɔ, mɛi ni wɔjo foi kɛtee wɔyaba abo yɛ amɛŋɔɔ koni ahere wɔ yɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ anɔ. Belɛ, wɔ lɛ, te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ ni wɔje mli hu?’ ”

english_verse: This is a message about a desert beside the sea: Enemies from a hostile nation attack like a whirlwind from the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Babilon he gbalɛ nɛ. Bɔ ni lasuogbele tswaa kɛjɛɔ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ, nakai haomɔ aaajɛ shikpɔŋ ko ni he yɔɔ gbeyei nɔ aba.

english_verse: What a horrible vision was shown to me— a vision of betrayal and destruction. Tell Elam and Media to surround and attack the Babylonians. The Lord has sworn to end the suffering they caused.
translation_verse: Ajie ninaa ko ni yɔɔ gbeyei atsɔ̃ɔ mi: mɔsɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ ni miitsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ko sɛɛgbɛ, kɛ nifitelɔ ni miifite nii. Elam, kwɔɔ kɛya! Media, yaasa maji lɛ ayi! Mahã ŋkɔmɔi fɛɛ ni Babilon eha eyeɔ lɛ sɛɛ afo!

english_verse: I'm in terrible pain like a woman giving birth. I'm shocked and hurt so much that I can't hear or see.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mihɛ mli eyi obɔ̃ kɛ piŋmɔ, kɔ̃ɔmɔ eta mihe; kɔ̃ɔmɔ eta mihe tamɔ yoo ni baafɔ. Mishɔ kwekweekwe, hewɔ lɛ minuuu nii. Mijijaa hewɔ lɛ minaaa nii.

english_verse: My head spins; I'm horrified! Early evening, my favorite time, has become a nightmare.
translation_verse: Mihiɛ miidi mi; ŋmiŋmi emɔ mi; gbɛkɛ ni mishweɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ gbeyei nɔ moŋ ehã mi.

english_verse: In Babylon the high officials were having a feast. They were eating and drinking, when someone shouted, “Officers, take your places! Grab your shields.”
translation_verse: Ninaa lɛ mli lɛ mina ni aŋmɛ okplɔ̃, akɛ kuŋtui lɛɛ shi, aaye nii, ni aanu nii. Trukaa lɛ abo akɛ, “Tatsɛmɛi, nyɛtea shi; nyɛfɔa tsɛŋi lɛ ahe mu.”

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Send guards to find out what's going on.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi nɛ, “Yaa! Hã ni mɔ ko ayabu, ni nɔ ni eeena lɛ, ehã ni ale.

english_verse: When they see cavalry troops and columns of soldiers on donkeys and camels, tell them to be ready!”
translation_verse: Kɛji ena mɛi tara okpɔŋɔi anɔ, ni amɛnyiɛ mɛi enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ, ni ena mɛi hu ni tara tejii kɛ yoomai anɔ lɛ, etɛ̃je ehiɛ, ni ebo nɔ ni ebaanu lɛ toi jogbaŋŋ.”

english_verse: Then a guard said, “I have stood day and night on this watchtower, Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni bulɔ lɛ bo waa ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, midamɔ buuhe nɛɛ gbi muu fɛɛ, ni mibu nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ hu.

english_verse: Now I see column after column of cavalry troops.” At once someone shouted, “Babylon has fallen! Every idol in the city lies broken on the ground.”
translation_verse: Trukaa lɛ, naa okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi komɛi ni miiba; amɛnyiɛ mɛi enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ!” Nuŋtsɔ lɛ here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Babilon egbee shi! Hɛɛ! Egbee shi! Emãgãi lɛ fɛɛ akumɔ ashwie shi nɛɛ!”

english_verse: Then I said, “My people, you have suffered terribly, but I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.” How Much Longer?
translation_verse: Ao mimaŋ Israel, ni otamɔ ŋmãa ni agbee ni asha mli. Nɔ ni minu yɛ Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ naa lɛ, no mikɛɛ bo nɛɛ. Edom he gbalɛ

english_verse: This is a message about Dumah: From the country of Seir, someone shouts to me, “Guard, how much longer before daylight?”
translation_verse: Edom he ninaa nɛ. Abo atsɛ mi kɛjɛ Edom akɛ, “Bulɔ, mɛɛ nyɔɔŋ ŋmɛlɛtswaa be mli nɛ? Bulɔ, mɛɛ nyɔɔŋ ŋmɛlɛtswaa be mli nɛ?”

english_verse: From my guard post, I answered, “Morning will soon be here, but night will return. If you want to know more, come back later.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni bulɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Je miitsɛre shi moŋ je baana ekoŋŋ. Kɛji nɔ ko otaoɔ obi lɛ, bi! Kuu osɛɛ ni obabi!” Arabia he gbalɛ

english_verse: This is a message for Arabs who live in the barren desert in the region of Dedan: You must order your caravans
translation_verse: Arabia he ninaa nɛ. Nyɛ Dedan gbɛnyiɛlɔi asafo, Arabia ŋa lɛ mli nyɛbaaya nyɛyato shi yɛ.

english_verse: to bring water for those who are thirsty. You people of Tema must bring food for the hungry refugees.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Temabii, nyɛhaa mɛi ni kumai yeɔ amɛ lɛ nu ni amɛnu, ni nyɛhaa abobalɔi lɛ niyenii ni amɛye,

english_verse: They are worn out and weary from being chased by enemies with swords and arrows.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ amɛjo foi kɛjɛ ta mli gbele naa, kɛjɛ klante ni agbala awo amɛ kɛ gãi ni abaatsɛ̃ kɛ ta mli osharãi fɛɛ anaa.

english_verse: The Lord said to me: A year from now the glory of the people of Kedar will all come to an end, just as a worker's contract ends after a year.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Biɛ afi mli, tamɔ apaafonyo apaayeli afi be lɛ, Kedar anunyam fɛɛ sɛɛ baafo.

english_verse: Only a few of their warriors will be left with bows and arrows. This is a promise that I, the Lord God of Israel, have made.
translation_verse: Kedar hii kãkãlɔi gãitsɛ̃lɔi ni aaashwɛ lɛ ayi faŋ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ekɛɛ.”

english_verse: This is a message about Vision Valley: Why are you celebrating on the flat roofs of your houses?
translation_verse: Ninaa ni kɔɔ Ninaa Jɔɔ lɛ he nɛ. Mɛni ji tsui ayiteŋ ni bo kɛ omɛi fɛɛ ekwɔ kɛtee nɛɛ?

english_verse: Your city is filled with noisy shouts. Those who lie drunk in your streets were not killed in battle.
translation_verse: Maŋ kɛ emli kiŋkaŋŋ, maŋ ni mli efili lɛ, omli eyi kɛ hoofeemɔ. Omɛi ni nyɔnyɔɔi lɛ, jeee klante naa amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ, ni jeee ta mli hu amɛgboi yɛ.

english_verse: Your leaders ran away, but they were captured without a fight. No matter how far they ran, they were found and caught.
translation_verse: Olumɛi lɛ fɛɛ kwa ejo foi; ahiɛɛɛ gãi tete ni amɔmɔ amɛ. Mɛi fɛɛ ni ana amɛ lɛ, amɔmɔ amɛ, tsɛbelɛ amɛjojoo foi kɛtee shɔŋŋshɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Then I said, “Leave me alone! Let me cry bitter tears. My people have been destroyed, so don't try to comfort me.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ akɛ, nyɛfɔa mi kwɛmɔ; nyɛhãa mafoa kɛ dɔlɛ. Nyɛkagbaa nyɛhe naa nyɛshɛjea mimii yɛ maŋbii ahiɛ ni ekpãtã lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful had chosen a time for noisy shouts and confusion to fill Vision Valley, and for everyone to beg the mountains for help.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ gidigidifeemɔ kɛ nibii ni anaanaa nɔ kɛho kɛ nibii ni afee basaa yɛ Ninaa Jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ jɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ lɛ, dɛŋ. Akumɔ gbogboi ashwie shi, ni blɔmɔ ni maŋbii lɛ bolɔ kɛhã yelikɛbuamɔ lɛ, ejije kɛtee gɔji lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: The people of Elam and Kir attacked with chariots and carried shields.
translation_verse: Elam tabilɔi ba kɛ tayaa shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi kɛ gãi kɛ gãimlibii; ni Kirbii hu ba ni amɛhiɛ amɛtsɛŋi.

english_verse: Your most beautiful valleys were covered with chariots; your cities were surrounded by cavalry troops.
translation_verse: Ojɔi kpakpai lɛ yimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ tayaa shwiilii, ni okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ gba sa yɛ Yerusalɛm agboi lɛ anaa.

english_verse: Judah was left defenseless. At that time you trusted in the weapons you had stored in Forest Palace.
translation_verse: Akpa Yuda he mama. Nakai gbi lɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ fɔ̃ tawuu nibii ni yɔɔ tawuu nibii atoohe lɛ anɔ,

english_verse: You saw the holes in the outer wall of Jerusalem, and you brought water from the lower pool.
translation_verse: nyɛna akɛ David maŋ Yerusalɛm hei ni agbugbuu awo mli lɛ fa, ni nyɛtswa nubu koni nyɛkɛto nu ni hoɔ kɛjɛɔ shishigbɛ kpaakpo lɛ mli lɛ eko.

english_verse: You counted the houses in Jerusalem and tore down some of them, so you could get stones to repair the city wall.
translation_verse: Nyɛkane Yerusalɛm shĩai lɛ, ni nyɛkumɔ shĩai lɛ ekomɛi koni nyɛna tɛ nyɛkɛwaje maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ.

english_verse: Then you built a large tank between the walls to store the water. But you refused to trust the God who planned this long ago and made it happen. A Time To Weep
translation_verse: Nyɛgba nujɔɔ yɛ gbogboi enyɔ lɛ ateŋ koni nyɛkɛbua kpaakpo momo lɛ mli nu lɛ naa yɛ jɛi. Shi nyɛyakwɛɛɛ ni nyɛyabuuu Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni to nɔ ni ba lɛ hegbɛjianɔ kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ, ni asaŋ ehã eba mli lɛ.

english_verse: When all of this happened, the Lord All-Powerful told you to weep and mourn, to shave your heads, and wear sackcloth.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ lɛ, tsɛ koni nyɛfo ni nyɛye ŋkɔmɔ ni nyɛshɛshɛɛ nyɛyi ni nyɛmia kɛ kpekpe.

english_verse: But instead, you celebrated by feasting on beef and lamb and by drinking wine, because you said, “Let's eat and drink today! Tomorrow we may die.”
translation_verse: Shi moŋ nyɛnya, ni nyɛmli fili nyɛ. Nyɛgbegbee tsinai kɛ toi, ni nyɛye, ni nyɛnu dãi, ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔyea nii ni wɔnua dãi ejaakɛ wɔ bɛnɛ wɔgboi.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has spoken to me this solemn promise: “I won't forgive them for this, not as long as they live.” Selfish Officials Are Doomed
translation_verse: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ ni wie, ni minu kɛ mitoi, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwa, aŋɔŋ nɛkɛ nɔsha nɛɛ afaŋ nyɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaagboi.” Abɔ Shebna kɔkɔ

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is sending me with this message for Shebna, the prime minister:
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, “Ba, yaa Shebna, tsulɔnukpa ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ nɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ; ni okɛɛ lɛ akɛ,

english_verse: Shebna, what gives you the right to have a tomb carved out of rock in this burial place of royalty? None of your relatives are buried here.
translation_verse: mɛɛ hegbɛ oyɔɔ yɛ biɛ; ni namɛi ji owekumɛi yɛ biɛ, hewɔ ni okpɛɔ yɛ he grɔŋŋ nɛɛ, ni okpɛɔ tɛsaa mli otoɔ okɛfeɔ ofũuhe lɛ?

english_verse: You may be powerful, but the Lord is about to snatch you up and throw you away.
translation_verse: Naa, bo nuu hewalɔ, Yehowa baawo bo eshɛ efɔ̃. Ebaamɔ omli tswɛ, ni eeefɔ̃ bo kɛbɔle yɛ kɔɔyɔŋ,

english_verse: He will roll you into a ball and throw you into a wide open country, where you will die and your chariots will be destroyed. You're a disgrace to those you serve.
translation_verse: ni eeeshɛ bo efɔ̃ tamɔ bɔɔlo ni ashɛ afɔ̃ shikpɔŋ kplanaa nɔ. Jɛi ooogbo yɛ, bo, onuŋtsɔ we lɛ mli hiɛgbejiatsɛ; ni jɛi otayaa shwiilii fɛɛfɛji lɛ aaaka.

english_verse: The Lord is going to take away your job!
translation_verse: Mashwie bo yɛ onitsumɔ lɛ mli, ni oyelihe aaabɔ bo.”

english_verse: He will give your official robes and your authority to his servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah. Eliakim will be like a father to the people of Jerusalem and to the royal family of Judah.
translation_verse: ni maŋɔ otade yuu lɛ mawo lɛ, ni mikɛ ohɛfiinɔ lɛ baafi ehɛ, ni maŋɔ ohewalɛ lɛ mahã lɛ, ni ebaatsɔ̃ tsɛ eha Yerusalɛmbii kɛ Yuda we lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will put him in charge of the key that belongs to King David's family. No one will be able to unlock what he locks, and no one will be able to lock what he unlocks.
translation_verse: Maŋɔ David we lɛ hewalɛ lɛ fɛɛ naa samfee mawo edɛŋ: kɛji egbele lɛ, mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni aaanyɛ aŋa; ni kɛji eŋa lɛ mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni aaanyɛ agbele.

english_verse: The Lord will make him as firm in his position as a tent peg hammered in the ground, and Eliakim will bring honor to his family.
translation_verse: Mahã emã shi shiŋŋ tamɔ shiŋmlitso ni aka sɛɛ kpɛŋŋ; ni ebaahã etsɛ we lɛ hiɛ aba nyam.

english_verse: His children and relatives will be supported by him, like pans hanging from a peg on the wall.
translation_verse: “Eweku lɛ mli bii kɛ hɔi asaji fɛɛ baakã enɔ. Amɛbaatsotsro enɔ tamɔ kɔɔpoi bibii kɛ ewuji tsotsoro tso nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: That peg is fastened firmly now, but someday it will be shaken loose and fall down. Then everything that was hanging on it will be destroyed. This is what the Lord All-Powerful has promised.
translation_verse: Kɛji nakai be lɛ shɛ lɛ, shiŋmlitso lɛ ni aka akɛma shi shiŋŋ lɛ, aaawɔtsɔ, ni ebaagbee shi, ni jatsu ni tsotsoro nɔ lɛ hiɛ baakpãtã.” Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ.

english_verse: This is a message from distant islands about the city of Tyre: Cry, you seagoing ships! Tyre and its houses lie in ruins.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Tiro lɛji amli asrɛfoi, nyɛwoa yara nyɛfoa, ejaakɛ akpãtã nyɛmaŋ Tiro lɛji amaamɔhe lɛ hiɛ. Ajɛ Kipro shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ahã amɛle nɔ ni eba lɛ.

english_verse: Mourn in silence, you shop owners of Sidon, you people on the coast. Your sailors crossed oceans, making your city rich.
translation_verse: Ao nyɛ ŋshɔnaabii, Ao Sidon jarayelɔi, nyɛfea kpoo! Nyɛtsulɔi lɛ tsɔ̃ ŋshɔ hiɛ,

english_verse: Your merchants sailed the seas, making you wealthy by trading with nation after nation. They brought back grain that grew along the Nile.
translation_verse: ni amɛnyiɛ fai wuji hu ahiɛ amɛye jara. Amɛye Shihor abele, ni ji Nilo Faa lɛ he nikpamɔnii lɛ, jara. Nyɛ kɛ majimaji ye jara.

english_verse: Sidon, you are a mighty fortress built along the sea. But you will be disgraced like a married woman who never had children.
translation_verse: Ao Sidon, ohiɛ agbo; ejaakɛ ŋshɔ ewie, ŋshɔ shishi diɛŋtsɛ ewie akɛ, “Mikɔ̃mɔko dã, asaŋ mifɔko dã. Milɛko oblahii dã lɛ, milɛko oblayei hu dã.”

english_verse: When Egypt hears about Tyre, it will tremble.
translation_verse: Kɛji sane lɛ yashɛ Ijipt lɛ, jɛibii baahao yɛ Tiro sane ni abagba lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: All of you along the coast had better cry and sail far across the ocean.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Foinikiabii ni kã ŋshɔnaa, nyɛwoa lele, nyɛjoa foi kɛyaa Tarshish.

english_verse: Can this be the happy city that has stood for centuries? Its people have spread to distant lands;
translation_verse: Kwɛ, nyɛmaŋ ni ji blema maŋ Tiro kɛ emli miishɛɛ babaoo lɛ ni yato gbɔ yɛ maŋsɛɛ nɔŋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful planned it to bring shame and disgrace to those who are honored by everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ni to nɛkɛ yiŋ. Eto yiŋ nɛɛ koni ekɛba amɛhe ni amɛwoɔ, yɛ hiɛnyam ni amɛna hewɔ lɛ shi, bɔ ni afee ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ anunyam gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ agboi.

english_verse: People of Tyre, your harbor is destroyed! You will have to become farmers just like the Egyptians. Tyre Will Be Forgotten
translation_verse: Ao Tarshishbii, nyɛyaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni nyɛyahua; nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni tsĩɔ nyɛ gbɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: The Lord's hand has reached across the sea, upsetting the nations. He has given a command to destroy fortresses in the land of Canaan.
translation_verse: Yehowa ewo enine nɔ yɛ ŋshɔ nɔ, ni ehoso maŋtsɛyelii. Efã akɛ afite Kanaan mɔji lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has said to the people of Sidon, “Your celebrating is over— you are crushed. Even if you escape to Cyprus, you won't find peace.”
translation_verse: Ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ao Sidon, ni awaa obii yi, omli akafili bo dɔŋŋ! Sidonbii, nyɛtea shi koni nyɛyaa Kipro, shi jɛi hu nyɛnaŋ hejɔlɛ.”

english_verse: Look what the Assyrians have done to Babylonia! They have attacked, destroying every palace in the land. Now wild animals live among the ruins.
translation_verse: Naa Babilonbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ. Babilonbii lɛ ji mɛi ni hã jwɛiaŋ kooloi kakawuai kpãtã Tiro maŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, shi jeee Asiriabii lɛ. Babilonbii lɛ mamɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmɔji ni kwɔlɔ, ni amɛkumɔ Tiro mɔji ni yɔɔ sa lɛ, ni amɛhã Tiro fee koikoi.

english_verse: Not a fortress will be left standing, so tell all the seagoing ships to mourn.
translation_verse: Ao Tarshish lɛji amli bii, nyɛwoa lele, ejaakɛ akpãtã nyɛmɔji lɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: You're gone and forgotten, you evil woman! So strut through the town, singing and playing your favorite tune to be remembered again.
translation_verse: “Ajwamãŋ ni hiɛ ekpa onɔ, kɔ saŋku koni okɛyakpa maŋ lɛ mli. Tswaa saŋku lɛ jogbaŋŋ, ni ola lalai babaoo bɔ ni afee ni akai bo ekoŋŋ.”

english_verse: but none of what is earned will be kept in the city. That money will belong to the Lord, and it will be used to buy more than enough food and good clothes for those who worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Tiro baajɔɔ ejarayeli mli nii kɛ apaa ni abaabɔ lɛ mli nii hu nɔ ehã Yehowa. Atĩaŋ esɛɛnamɔ lɛ naa amaŋ shi, shi ejarayeli lɛ mli nii baahã ana niyenii babaoo kɛ mamai fɛɛfɛji ahã mɛi ni sɔmɔɔ Yehowa lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is going to twist the earth out of shape and turn it into a desert. Everyone will be scattered,
translation_verse: Naa, Yehowa baakpãtã je lɛ hiɛ koni efee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃? Ebaatsɔ̃ je lɛ hiɛ ebu shi, ni ebaagbɛ enɔ bii lɛ eshwã.

english_verse: The earth will be stripped bare and left that way. This is what the Lord has promised.
translation_verse: Abaakpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ butuu, ni abaashi lɛ shwɛm, ejaakɛ Yehowa ekɛɛ, ni ja ena eba mli.

english_verse: The earth wilts away; its mighty leaders melt to nothing.
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ lɛ miigbi, ni eeŋala; je lɛ miigbede, ni eeŋala; ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ miigbede.

english_verse: The earth is polluted because its people disobeyed the laws of God, breaking their agreement that was to last forever.
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ewo shikpɔŋ lɛ he muji, ejaakɛ amɛtɔ̃ mlai lɛ anɔ, ni amɛyeee akpɔi lɛ anɔ, ni amɛku naanɔ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: The earth is under a curse; its people are dying out because of their sins.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, loomɔ miikpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni enɔ bii miina nɔ yɛ amɛfɔyeli hewɔ. Enɛ ehã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi etã ni eshwɛ mɛi fioo ko kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Grapevines have dried up: wine is almost gone— mournful sounds are heard instead of joyful shouts.
translation_verse: Wain tete miiye ŋkɔmɔ, ni waintso lɛ miigbi. Mɛi ni mli fili amɛ fɛɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ.

english_verse: No one plays tambourines or stringed instruments; all noisy celebrating has come to an end.
translation_verse: Miji kɛ kpãa saŋkui agbɛɛmɔi kɛ nyamɔ lɛ ejɔ, ni mliflilɔi lɛ abolɔmɔ sɛɛ efo.

english_verse: They no longer sing as they drink their wine, and it tastes sour.
translation_verse: Wainnumɔ kɛ lala sɛɛ efo, ni dãa ni wa miijoo yɛ dãanulɔ daaŋ.

english_verse: Towns are crushed and in chaos; houses are locked tight.
translation_verse: Maŋ kɛ emli basabasa nifeemɔ lɛ hiɛ ekpãtã; aŋamɔ emli shĩai fɛɛ ashinai koni mɔ ko akabote eko mli.

english_verse: Happy times have disappeared from the earth, and people shout in the streets, “We're out of wine!”
translation_verse: Aabolɔ yɛ blohui lɛ amli yɛ wain hewɔ; miishɛɛ fɛɛ naa eba shi; afo miishɛɛ sɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Cities are destroyed; their gates are torn down.
translation_verse: Afee maŋ lɛ amaŋfɔ̃, ni akumɔ agboi lɛ amli dukuduku.

english_verse: Nations will be stripped bare, like olive trees or vineyards after the harvest season. Praise the God of Justice
translation_verse: Nɔ ni baaba shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ nɛ. Amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ mutso ni akpa enɔ yibii loo waintso ni akpa enɔ wainyibii atã.

english_verse: People in the west shout; they joyfully praise the majesty of the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ aaahole amɛgbei anɔ amɛaala kɛ miishɛɛ. Mɛi aaajɛ anaigbɛ amɛbɔ oshe kɛkafo Yehowa agbojee,

english_verse: And so, everyone in the east and those on the islands should praise the Lord, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛwoa Yehowa hiɛ nyam yɛ bokãgbɛ. Ŋshɔnaa maji, nyɛwoa Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam.

english_verse: From all over the world songs of praise are heard for the God of justice. But I feel awful, terribly miserable. Can anyone be trusted? So many are treacherous! There's No Escape
translation_verse: Wɔmiinu yijiemɔ kɛ Jalɔ Koome lɛ hiɛ nyamwoo lalai kɛmiijɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei fɛɛ. Shi mi lɛ mikɛɛ akɛ, “Miitã loo! Miitã loo! Kpoo ha mi, ejaakɛ kutumpɔfoi miiye mihe kutumpɔo! Kutumpɔfoi miiye mihe kutumpɔo waa diɛŋtsɛ!

english_verse: If you are terrified and run, you will fall into a pit; if you crawl out of the pit, you will get caught in a trap. The sky has split apart like a window thrown open. The foundations of the earth have been shaken;
translation_verse: Mɔ ni baajo foi kɛji anu gbeyei sane lɛ, ebaagbee bu lɛ mli; ni mɔ ni baakwɔ kɛje kpo yɛ bu lɛ mli lɛ, ebaadu tsɔne; ejaakɛ aaagbele ŋwɛi samfɛji lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ shishitoo lɛ aaahoso.

english_verse: the earth is shattered, ripped to pieces.
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ lɛ ewule, shikpɔŋ lɛ egbala, shikpɔŋ lɛ ehoso waa diɛŋtsɛ.

english_verse: It staggers and shakes like a drunkard or a hut in a windstorm. It is burdened down with sin; the earth will fall, never again to get up.
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ dãatɔlɔ ni miididãa, ebaahoso tamɔ aboŋo yɛ ahum mli. Etɔmɔ lɛ tsii yɛ enɔ, ni ebaatsi lɛ egbee shi, ni eteŋ shi dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: On that day the Lord will punish the powers in the heavens and the kings of the earth.
translation_verse: “Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa baagbala ŋwɛi asafo lɛ toi yɛ ŋwɛi, ni ebaagbala shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ hu atoi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: He will put them in a pit and keep them prisoner. Then later on, he will punish them.
translation_verse: Abaabua amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa awo bu ko mli tamɔ gboklɛfoi. Abaaŋa amɛyi awo gboklɛfoi atsu ko mli, ni be kplaŋŋ sɛɛ lɛ, abaagbala amɛtoi.

english_verse: Both the moon and sun will be embarrassed and ashamed. The Lord All-Powerful will rule on Mount Zion in Jerusalem, where he will show its rulers his wonderful glory.
translation_verse: Nyɔɔŋtsere kpɛŋ, ni hulu etsoŋ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, baaye nɔ yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni ebaajie enunyam lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ.”

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! I will praise you for doing the wonderful things you had planned and promised since ancient times.
translation_verse: Ao Yehowa, bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ; mibakafo bo, mibajie ogbɛi lɛ yi. Ejaakɛ otsu naakpɛɛnii. Oyiŋ ni oto kɛjɛ blema beebe lɛ oye ehe anɔkwa.

english_verse: You have destroyed the fortress of our enemies, leaving their city in ruins. Nothing in that foreign city will ever be rebuilt.
translation_verse: Oha maŋ lɛ fee koikoi; maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he lɛ etsɔ̃ koikoi; Maŋsɛɛbii amaŋtsɛ we lɛ ekumɔ, ni akuŋ sɛɛ amaŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: Now strong and cruel nations will fear and honor you.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, maŋ ko ni he wa baawo ohiɛ nyam; ni yiwalɔi amaji lɛ baashe bo gbeyei.

english_verse: You have been a place of safety for the poor and needy in times of trouble. Brutal enemies pounded us like a heavy rain or the heat of the sun at noon, but you were our shelter.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ otsɔ̃ abobaahe ohã ohiafo, otsɔ̃ abobaahe ohã mɔ ni ehĩa yɛ ehĩamɔ be mli. Otsɔ̃ abobaahe yɛ ahum mli, kɛ hɔ̃ɔŋ yɛ latsa be mli; ejaakɛ yiwalɔi amlifu lɛ, etamɔ ahum ni miitswa,

english_verse: Those wild foreigners struck like scorching desert heat. But you were like a cloud, protecting us from the sun. You kept our enemies from singing songs of victory. The Lord Has Saved Us
translation_verse: loo lamɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ. Shi bo Yehowa, ojɔɔ wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ ahoofeemɔ lɛ he, ni yiwalɔ lɛ he ejɔ tamɔ bɔ ni atatu jɔɔ jeŋ dɔlɛ he lɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ ŋmɛ okplɔ̃

english_verse: On this mountain the Lord All-Powerful will prepare for all nations a feast of the finest foods. Choice wines and the best meats will be served.
translation_verse: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ fɔŋ niyenii sɔkɔɔ kɛ wain momo ni adoo nɔ jogbaŋŋ baaŋmɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ okplɔ̃ yɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will destroy the power of death and wipe away all tears. No longer will his people be insulted everywhere. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: Eeekpãtã gbele hiɛ kɛaatee nanɔ, ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsumɔ hiɛiaŋ yaafonui fɛɛ. Ebaafo emaŋ lɛ hiɛgbele lɛ sɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ wiemɔ nɛ.

english_verse: At that time, people will say, “The Lord has saved us! Let's celebrate. We waited and hoped— now our God is here.”
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɛ. Wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ efɔ̃ enɔ akɛ eeehere wɔ. Yehowa ni wɔhiɛ kã enɔ lɛ nɛ; nyɛhãa wɔmii ashɛa, ni wɔnyaa yɛ edɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ hewɔ.” Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala Moab toi

english_verse: The powerful arm of the Lord will protect this mountain. The Moabites will be put down and trampled on like straw in a pit of manure.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ baafã gɔŋ nɛɛ he. Shi Moabbii lɛ abaanaanaa amɛnɔ tamɔ anaa jwɛi nɔ yɛ bu ni yɔɔ tumo nɔ.

english_verse: They will struggle to get out, but God will humiliate them no matter how hard they try.
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Moabbii aaakpã amɛniji amli yɛ bu lɛ mli tamɔ serelɔ kpãa eniji amli ekɛsereɔ lɛ. Shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa baaba Moab hewoo kɛ edeŋmegbomɔ lɛ fɛɛ shi.

english_verse: The walls of their fortresses will be knocked down and scattered in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ebaakumɔ Moab mɔji grɔŋŋi kɛ ehe gbogboi lɛ; eeekumɔ fɛɛ eshwie shi shwɛtɛɛ, ni ekɛ shikpɔŋ mlu aaaye egbɔ.

english_verse: The time is coming when the people of Judah will sing this song: “Our city is protected. The Lord is our fortress, and he gives us victory.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ aaala lala nɛɛ yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Wɔmaŋ ni wa, Yehowa tswaa kunimyeli tamɔ gbogboi kɛ kawoohei ewoɔ he.

english_verse: Open the city gates for a law-abiding nation that is faithful to God.
translation_verse: Nyɛgbelea maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ koni maŋ ni emli bii feɔ jalɛnii asaŋ yeɔ anɔkwa lɛ abote mli.

english_verse: The Lord gives perfect peace to those whose faith is firm.
translation_verse: Yehowa ohãa maŋ ni hiɛ kã onɔ lɛ naa toiŋjɔlɛ krɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ bo onɔ amɛhiɛkãa.

english_verse: So always trust the Lord because he is forever our mighty rock.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ afɔa Yehowa nɔ daa ejaakɛ Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, naanɔ tɛsaa ni.

english_verse: God has put down our enemies in their mountain city and rubbed it in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ eba mɛi ni tara hei grɔŋŋi lɛ ashi; ni maŋ ni kwɔ lɛ, eba lɛ shi, ni ekɛ shikpɔŋ eye egbɔ; ewo lɛ etswa mlu mli.

english_verse: Now the poor and abused trample all over that city.” The Lord Can Be Trusted
translation_verse: Mɛi ni aye amɛnɔ kɛ yiwalɛ lɛ, amɛmiinaanaa enɔ agbɛnɛ; ohiafoi miinaanaa enɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and you make the path smooth for those who obey you.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii lɛ, egbɛ jaa hãa lɛ. Ao, Jalɔ Koome, ohãa jalɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ feɔ trɛtrɛ hãa lɛ.

english_verse: You are the one we trust to bring about justice; above all else we want your name to be honored.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wɔmiikwɛ bo gbɛ yɛ okojomɔi lɛ amli; wɔmiishwe ogbɛ́i ni kaiɔ wɔ saji lɛ.

english_verse: Throughout the night, my heart searches for you, because your decisions show everyone on this earth how to live right.
translation_verse: Nyɔɔŋ lɛ, misusuma shweɔ bo, mimumɔ ni yɔɔ mimli taoɔ bo kɛ hiɛdɔɔ. Ejaakɛ ojalɛ saneyeli yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, je lɛ mli bii kɛkaseɔ jalɛ nifeemɔ.

english_verse: Even when the wicked are treated with mercy in this land of justice, they do wrong and are blind to your glory, our Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛji ana efɔŋfeelɔi amɔbɔ lɛ, amɛkɛkaseee nɔ ni ja feemɔ; shi moŋ amɛyeɔ saji fɔ̃ji yɛ he ni afeɔ jalɛnii yɛ, ni enaaa Yehowa agbojee lɛ.

english_verse: Your hand is raised and ready to punish them, but they don't see it. Put them to shame! Show how much you care for us and throw them into the fire intended for your enemies.
translation_verse: Ao Yehowa, owo onine nɔ, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛnaaa. Hã amɛna joomɔ ni ojoɔ yɛ omaŋbii ahe lɛ koni amɛhiɛ agboi. Hã la ni oto hã ohenyɛlɔi lɛ akpãtã amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: You will give us peace, Lord, because everything we have done was by your power.
translation_verse: Ao Yehowa, oooha wɔna toiŋjɔlɛ ejaakɛ nitsumɔi fɛɛ ni wɔtsu lɛ, bo ji mɔ ni otsu.

english_verse: Others have ruled over us besides you, our Lord God, but we obey only you.
translation_verse: Ao Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, nuŋtsɔmɛi krokomɛi ebaye wɔnɔ kɛho; shi bo pɛ ogbɛi lɛ kɛkɛ wɔle.

english_verse: Those enemies are now dead and can never live again. You have punished them— they are destroyed, completely forgotten.
translation_verse: Amɛgboi, ni amɛhiɛ etsɛ̃ŋ; amɛtsɔmɔ sisai ni eteŋ shi dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ ogbala amɛtoi, ni okpãtã amɛhiɛ, ni akaiŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Our nation has grown because of you, our Lord. We have more land than before, and you are honored. The Lord Gives Life to the Dead
translation_verse: Ao Yehowa, ohá maŋ lɛ eshwere, olɛɛ maŋ lɛ husui amli ni enɛ ewo ohiɛ nyam.

english_verse: When you punished our people, they turned and prayed to you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Ao Yehowa, amɛhejaramɔ mli lɛ, amɛtao osɛɛgbɛ; amɛsɔle amɛkpa bo fai be ni ogbalaa amɛtoi lɛ.

english_verse: Because of what you did to us, we suffered like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Ao Yehowa, bɔ ni yoo ni hiɛ musu kɛ̃mɔɔ ni ebolɔɔ yɛ enɔnaa lɛ mli kɛji fɔ̃mɔ eshɛ shi etã lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔyɔɔ yɛ ohiɛ nɛɛ.

english_verse: But instead of having a child, our terrible pain produced only wind. We have won no victories, and we have no descendants to take over the earth.
translation_verse: Wɔhiɛ musu, ni wɔmiikɛ̃mɔ; wɔfɔɔɔ gbɔmɔ; shi wɔfɔ kɔɔyɔɔ. Wɔnyɛko shikpɔŋ lɛ yiwala wɔhere; wɔnyɛko nɔ ko wɔtsu.

english_verse: Your people will rise to life! Tell them to leave their graves and celebrate with shouts. You refresh the earth like morning dew; you give life to the dead.
translation_verse: Omɛi ni egboi lɛ ahiɛ aaatsɛ̃, ni amɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ aaate shi. Ao nyɛ su mli bii, nyɛhiɛ atsɛ̃a, ni nyɛlaa kɛ miishɛɛ! Ejaakɛ obɔ ni nyɔɔ lɛ, bɔ ni kpɛlɛɔ ni, ni ooohã gbohii lɛ ate shi.

english_verse: Go inside and lock the doors, my people. Hide there for a little while, until the Lord is no longer angry. The Earth and the Sea Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Mimaŋbii, nyɛbaa! Mimaŋbii, nyɛbotea nyɛpiai lɛ amli, ni nyɛŋamɔa nyɛshinai lɛ nyɛwoa nyɛyi. Nyɛtea nyɛhe hiŋmɛitswaa fioo ko kɛyaashi Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu lɛ sɛɛ aaafo.

english_verse: The Lord will come out to punish everyone on earth for their sins. And when he does, those who did violent crimes will be known and punished.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ, naa, Yehowa miije kpo kɛmiijɛ eshihilɛhe lɛ koni ebagbala je lɛ mli bii atoi yɛ amɛnishaianii lɛ ahewɔ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ aaajie lá shi ni ashwie yɛ enɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ, ni ehaŋ mɛi ni agbe yɛ enɔ lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: On that day, Leviathan, the sea monster, will squirm and try to escape, but the Lord will kill him with a cruel, sharp sword. Protection and Forgiveness The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ klante agbo ni naa ba ni wa hu baabamɔ Leviatan, onufu lɔgɔligi lɛ, ni eeegbe ogboole ni yɔɔ ŋshɔ lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: At that time you must sing about a fruitful vineyard.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛlaa yɛ waintrom fɛɛfɛo lɛ he nyɛkɛa akɛ,

english_verse: I, the Lord, will protect it and always keep it watered. I will guard it day and night to keep it from harm.
translation_verse: “Mi, Yehowa, misaa mli; mishwieɔ enɔ nu be fɛɛ be. Mibuɔ ehe nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane fɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ko akafite emli nɔ ko.

english_verse: I am no longer angry. But if it produces thorns, I will go to war against it and burn it to the ground.
translation_verse: Mimli fuko. Eji ŋmeii kɛ kpitikpitii baawo mi naagba kulɛ, mate shi mawo amɛ, ni mibashã fɛɛ tswɛm.

english_verse: Yet if the vineyard depends on me for protection, it will become my friend and be at peace with me.
translation_verse: Kɛji miwebii ahenyɛlɔi lɛ miitao mihebuu lɛ, ja amɛbaba mi abo, ni amɛkɛ mi kpãtã. Hɛɛ! Ja amɛna amɛkɛ mi kpãtã!”

english_verse: Someday Israel will take root like a vine. It will blossom and bear fruit that covers the earth.
translation_verse: Wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ Israel aaatsɛ̃rɛ̃ fãi tamɔ tso, ni Israel aaagba afofro hu, ni eyibii aaayi jeŋ fɛɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, didn't punish and kill the people of Israel as fiercely as I punished and killed their enemies.
translation_verse: Ani Yehowa eyi Israel tamɔ eyi mɛi ni yi Israel lɛ? Aloo egbe Israel tamɔ egbe mɛi ni gbe Israel lɛ?

english_verse: I carefully measured out Israel's punishment and sent the scorching heat to chase them far away.
translation_verse: Okɛ amɛ ye bɔ ni ja gbɛ kɛtsɔ̃ amɛnomŋɔɔ nɔ. Yehowa kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni naa wa lɛ loo amɛ kɛtee be ni bokã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ tswa lɛ.

english_verse: There's only one way that Israel's sin and guilt can be completely forgiven: They must crush the stones of every pagan altar and place of worship. The Lord Will Bring His People Together
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji Yakob gbɛlɛ afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ amli tɛi lɛ munyɔmunyɔ tamɔ kaaloo tɛi ni afuflu, ni Ashera wɔŋkoi kɛ tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛi bɛ he ko he ko dɔŋŋ lɛ, no nɔ baatsɔ̃ ni akɛ Yakob tɔ̃mɔ lɛ baafa lɛ, ni no aaatsɔ̃ yibii ni etɔ̃mɔkɛfaa lɛ aaawo ahã lɛ.

english_verse: Fortress cities are left like a desert where no one lives. Cattle walk through the ruins, stripping the trees bare.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he lɛ etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛ shihilɛhe ni ashi afɔ shi ni akwa lɛ tamɔ shiaŋa. Tsinabii miiye nii yɛ jɛi; amɛbumɔɔ shi yɛ jɛi, ni amɛyeɔ nii.

english_verse: When broken branches fall to the ground, women pick them up to feed the fire. But these people are so stupid that the God who created them will show them no mercy.
translation_verse: Kɛji emli tsei aniji lɛ gbi lɛ, akumɔɔ ni yei baa ni amɛbalɛɔ akɛ lai kɛyaa, ni amɛyashãa. Ejaakɛ amɛjeee maŋ ni nuɔ nii ashishi. No hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni bɔ amɛ lɛ musuŋ etsɔŋ lɛ yɛ amɛhe, ni enaŋ amɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will shake the land between the Euphrates River and the border of Egypt, and one by one he will bring all of his people together.
translation_verse: Ao Israel, nakai gbi lɛ, Yehowa aaahala nyɛ ekomekome kɛjɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa kɛyaashi Ijipt husu lɛ nɔ, tamɔ mɔ ko ni miigbee ŋmãa.

english_verse: A loud trumpet will be heard. Then the people of Israel who were dragged away to Assyria and Egypt will return to worship the Lord on his holy mountain in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Aaakpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ wulu ko nakai gbi lɛ, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni elaaje yɛ Asiria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni ashwie amɛ kɛtee Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaaba, ni amɛaabaja Yehowa yɛ Gɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm.

english_verse: The city of Samaria above a fertile valley is in for trouble! Its leaders are drunkards, who stuff themselves with food and wine. But they will be like flowers that dry up and wilt.
translation_verse: Kpoo hã Israel dãatɔlɔi hewolɔi lɛ! Kpoo hã Israel anunyam fɔfɔi fɛɛfɛo ni kã ekuɛ lɛ! Kpoo hã fɔfɔi akekre ni yɔɔ Israel lumɛi ni etɔrɔ kɛ ŋmãa kɛ wain lɛ ayitsei ahe lɛ.

english_verse: Only the Lord is strong and powerful! His mighty hand will strike them down with the force of a hailstorm or a mighty whirlwind or an overwhelming flood.
translation_verse: Naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yɛ hewalɔ kɛ kãkãlɔ ko; etamɔ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛ ni miinɛ kɛ ahum ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ; etamɔ nu ni eje ŋa ni eeho boboobo, ni ekɛ ehewalɛ baaloo nibii etswia shi.

english_verse: Every drunkard in Ephraim takes pride in Samaria, but it will be crushed.
translation_verse: Nibii ni Efraim dãatɔlɔi lɛ kɛwulaa amɛhe lɛ akɛ nane aaanaanaa nɔ;
