english_verse: Samaria above a fertile valley will quickly lose its glory. It will be gobbled up like the first ripe fig at harvest season.
translation_verse: ni Efraim lumɛi lɛ anunyam fɛɛfɛo ni ŋalaa lɛ baalaaje tamɔ agbãmi ni shaa etsuɔ dani eshɛɔ etsulɛ be, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaana nɔŋŋ lɛ, etseɔ eyeɔ oya.

english_verse: When this time comes, the Lord All-Powerful will be a glorious crown for his people who survive.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, aaatsɔ̃ anunyam fɔfɔi kɛ akekre fɛɛfɛo ehã ewebii ni aaashwɛ lɛ.

english_verse: He will see that justice rules and that his people are able to defend their cities. Corrupt Leaders Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Eeehã kojolɔ lɛ mumɔ ni hãa ayeɔ jalɛ sane; ni eeewo mɛi ni fãa maŋ agbo lɛ he hewalɛ. Yesaia kɛ Yuda gbalɔi dãatɔlɔi lɛ wie

english_verse: Their tables are covered, completely covered, with their stinking vomit.
translation_verse: Amɛshwe amɛkpa okpɔlɔi ni amɛtara sɛɛ lɛ anɔ kpɔtɔɔ; he ko kwraa bɛ ni muji bɛ jɛi.

english_verse: You drunken leaders are like babies! How can you possibly understand or teach the Lord's message?
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Namɔ kwraa nii ebaatsɔ̃ɔ mɔ, ni namɔ kwraa ebaagbala sane mli etsɔ̃ɔ? Abifabii ni atse amɛ fufɔ, loo mɛi ni ayahole amɛ yɛ fufɔ naa?

english_verse: You don't even listen— all you hear is senseless sound after senseless sound.
translation_verse: Ebaatsɔ̃ɔ nii bɔ ni mla nyiɛ mla sɛɛ, ni akpɔ nyiɛ akpɔ sɛɛ, biɛ fioo kɛ jɛi hu fioo lo?”

english_verse: So, the Lord will speak to his people in strange sounds and foreign languages.
translation_verse: Dabida; shi mɛi ni naa tseee kɛ maŋsɛɛbii anɔ Yehowa baatsɔ̃ ekɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ awie.

english_verse: He promised you perfect peace and rest, but you refused to listen.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Hejɔlɛ nɛ. Nyɛhãa mɛi ni etɔ amɛ anaa hejɔlɛ; ni naa tsuiwoohe, kɛ̃lɛ amɛbooo toi.”

english_verse: You rulers of Jerusalem do nothing but sneer; now you must listen to what the Lord says.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhefɛoyelɔi ni yeɔ Yerusalɛm maŋbii anɔ, nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi!

english_verse: Do you think you have an agreement with death and the world of the dead? Why do you trust in your lies to keep you safe from danger and the mighty flood?
translation_verse: Akɛni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Wɔ kɛ gbele ekpãŋ, ni wɔ kɛ gbohiiaje hu eye efua, no hewɔ lɛ, kɛji ekpelebii ni naa wa lɛ miigwao mɛi kɛmiiho lɛ, ebaŋ he ni wɔyɔɔ, ejaakɛ wɔkɛ amale efee wɔbobaahe, ni wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ teɔ kutumpɔo sɛɛ.”

english_verse: And so the Lord says, “I'm laying a firm foundation for the city of Zion. It's a valuable cornerstone proven to be trustworthy; no one who trusts it will ever be disappointed.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, “Naa, mikɛ tɛ ko miima shi akɛ Zion shishitoo tɛ; eji tɛ ni aka akwɛ, koŋtɛ ni jara wa ni ma shi shiŋŋ; ni aŋma yɛ nɔ akɛ, ‘Mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ ehe kpokpoŋ.’ ”

english_verse: Justice and fairness will be the measuring lines that help me build.” Hailstones and floods will destroy and wash away your shelter of lies.
translation_verse: Mikɛ jalɛ saneyeli baafee nɔ ni akɛbaasusu shishitoo lɛ, ni mikɛ jalɛ nifeemɔ baafee kpãa ni akɛbaana ejalɛ. Nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi baaloo amalei ni nyɛkɛfee abobaahe lɛ kɛya, ni nu baafite nyɛteemɔhe lɛ.

english_verse: Your agreement with death and the world of the dead will be broken. Then angry, roaring waves will sweep over you.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ aaafo nyɛ kɛ gbele teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, ni bɔ ni nyɛ kɛ gbohiiaje eye efua lɛ sɛɛ baafo, ni kɛji ekpelebii ni naa wa lɛ miiho lɛ, ebaagwao nyɛ.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night an overwhelming flood will wash you away. The terrible things that happen will teach you this lesson:
translation_verse: Shii abɔ ni ebaaho lɛ, ebaagwao nyɛ ejaakɛ ebaaho daa leebi kɛ daa shwane kɛ daa nyɔɔŋ, ni sane lɛ shishinumɔ lɛ ebaafee gbeyei pam.

english_verse: The Lord will fiercely attack as he did at Mount Perazim and in Gibeon Valley. But this time the Lord will do something surprising, not what you expect.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa aaaho edamɔ shi tamɔ bɔ ni efee yɛ Perazim Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ; ni eeegri tamɔ egri yɛ Gibeon Jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, ni eeetsu enaakpɛɛ nii.

english_verse: So you had better stop sneering or you will be in worse shape than ever before. I heard the Lord All-Powerful threaten the whole country with destruction. All Wisdom Comes from the Lord
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛkɛkafea fɛoyeli dɔŋŋ koni akamia kpãi ni fimɔ nyɛ lɛ amli kpɛŋŋ moŋ; ejaakɛ minu akpɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ, wo yɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ he lɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ Nilee

english_verse: Pay close attention to what I am saying.
translation_verse: Nyɛboa toi koni nyɛnu migbee; nyɛfea diŋŋ koni nyɛnu nɔ ni mawie lɛ!

english_verse: When a field is ready, they scatter the seeds of dill and cumin; they plant the seeds of wheat and barley in the proper places and sow other grains around the edges.
translation_verse: Kɛji amɛsaa shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, ani amɛshwãaa kowɛ, ni amɛduuu sulu? Ani amɛduuu ŋmãa lɛ srɛnɛɛ kɛ akoko lɛ yɛ gbɛhe ni sa lo? Ani amɛduuu abele yɛ husui lɛ anɔ lo?

english_verse: They learn this from their God.
translation_verse: Amɛduɔ, ejaakɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii, ni egbalaa mli etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.

english_verse: After dill and cumin have been harvested, the stalks are pounded, not run over with a wagon.
translation_verse: Akɛ ŋmãagbeemɔ tso egbeee kowɛ, ni akɛ shwiili nane tsɔ̃ɔɔ sulu nɔ kɛhooo; shi moŋ akɛ tso gbeɔ kowɛ lɛ, ni akɛ dɛhiɛmɔtso gbeɔ sulu lɛ.

english_verse: Wheat and barley are pounded, but not beaten to pulp; they are run over with a wagon, but not ground to dust.
translation_verse: Agbɛlɛɔ abele akɛshãa aboloo; agbɛlɛɔ lɛ kɛ ŋaa. Kɛji aha okpɔŋɔi gbala shwiili kɛtsɔ ŋmãa nɔ kɛho blɛoo lɛ, eflɛɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: This wonderful knowledge comes from the Lord All-Powerful, who has such great wisdom.
translation_verse: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ji mɔ dɛŋ ni nilee nɛɛ hu jɛ. Enilee yɛ naakpɛɛ, ni ejwɛŋmɔ mli kwɔ naakpa.

english_verse: Jerusalem, city of David, the place of my altar, you are in for trouble! Celebrate your festivals year after year.
translation_verse: Ni Yehowa kɛɛ, “Kpoo hã Nyɔŋmɔ afɔleshãa latɛ ni ji Yerusalɛm diɛŋtsɛ lɛ. Kpoo hã maŋ he ni David kɛ etabilɔi lɛ to shi yɛ lɛ! Nyɛyea afi mli gbii juji lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ; daa afi lɛ nyɛyea!

english_verse: I will still make you suffer, and your people will cry when I make an altar of you.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ mi, Nyɔŋmɔ mahã hejaramɔ aba Yerusalɛm nɔ. Ŋkɔmɔyeli kɛ kɛ̃ɛmɔ aaaba maŋtso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni Yerusalɛm baayi obɔ̃ kɛ lá tamɔ afɔleshãa latɛ ni lá ewu he kpɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: I will surround you and prepare to attack from all sides.
translation_verse: Ni tamɔ bɔ ni David fee lɛ, mibatua bo, ni mibabɔle ohe kɛkpe, ni mibasa oyi, ni mibatswa kawoo gbogbo mabɔle ohe.

english_verse: From deep in the earth, you will call out for help with only a faint whisper.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ ooojɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi tɔ̃ɔ owie; owiemɔi lɛ aaajɛ su mli agbɛɛ blɛoo; ogbee aaajɛ shikpɔŋ egbɛɛ tamɔ sisa gbee, ni obaawie ablɛbi kɛajɛ su mli.

english_verse: Then your cruel enemies will suddenly be swept away like dust in a windstorm.
translation_verse: “Ohenyɛlɔi gbɔi lɛ ayifalɛ aaatamɔ mlu, ni yiwalɔi lɛ aaafee tamɔ tutuu ni kɔɔyɔɔ tswaa. Ni trukaa, hiŋmɛitswaa mli lɛ,

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will come to your rescue with a thundering earthquake and a fiery whirlwind.
translation_verse: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ ŋwɛi shiimɔ kɛ shikpɔŋhosomɔ kɛ gbɛɛmɔ kpeteŋkple kɛ lasuogbele kɛ ahum kɛ la ni kpãtãa nii hiɛ aaakpɔ̃ bo.

english_verse: Every brutal nation that attacks Jerusalem and makes it suffer will disappear like a dream when night is over.
translation_verse: Ni maji fɛɛ ni kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ he ni afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mã lɛ wuɔ, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni ebatua lɛ kɛ emɔji ni amɛhaoɔ lɛ lɛ, asane lɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ lamɔ̃, tamɔ nyɔɔŋ ninaa kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Those nations that attack Mount Zion will suffer from hunger and thirst. They will dream of food and drink but wake up weary and hungry and thirsty as ever. Prophets Who Fool Themselves
translation_verse: Bɔ ni mɔ ni hɔmɔ miiye lɛ laa ni ena nii eeye, shi be ni ehiɛ aaatsɛ̃ lɛ hɔmɔ lɛ miiye lɛ lolo, aloo bɔ ni mɔ ni kumai miiye lɛ laa ni eenu nu, shi be ni ehiɛ aaatsɛ̃ lɛ efee gbedee, ni kumai lɛ miiye lɛ lolo lɛ, nakai maji fɛɛ ni kɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ wuɔ lɛ asane aaafee.

english_verse: Be shocked and stunned, you prophets! Refuse to see. Get drunk and stagger, but not from wine.
translation_verse: “Nyɛhãa nyɛhe ajɔ̃a nyɛhe, ni nyɛlua! Nyɛshwilaa nyɛhe koni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔa shwilafoi! Nyɛtɔrɔa dãa, shi jeee kɛ wain; nyɛdidãa, shi jeee kɛ dãa ni wa.

english_verse: The Lord has made you drowsy; he put you into a deep sleep and covered your head.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã wɔ ni mli tsii mumɔ enyɔ nyɛnɔ. Nyɛ gbalɔi, Yehowa eŋamɔ nyɛhiŋmɛii; ni nyɛ ninalɔi, Yehowa kɛ nɔ̃ eha nyɛhiɛ.

english_verse: Now his message is like a sealed letter to you. Some of you say, “We can't read it, because it's sealed.”
translation_verse: Enɛɛmɛi ahe ninaa lɛ etsɔ̃ tamɔ wolo ni asɔo naa mli wiemɔi eha nyɛ. Kɛji akɛ wolo lɛ hã mɔ ko ni eeenyɛ ekane, ni afã lɛ akɛ, ‘Kanemɔ’ lɛ, ebaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Minyɛŋ, ejaakɛ asɔo naa.’

english_verse: Others say, “We can't read it, because we don't know how to read.”
translation_verse: Ni kɛji akɛ wolo lɛ hã mɔ ko ni nyɛŋ ekane, ni afã lɛ akɛ, ‘Kanemɔ wolo nɛɛ’ lɛ, ebaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Minyɛŋ makane.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord has said: “These people praise me with their words, but they never really think about me. They worship me by repeating rules made up by humans.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Akɛni maŋbii nɛɛ bɛŋkɛɔ mi kɛ amɛnaabu kɛkɛ, ni amɛkɛ amɛnaabu kɛkɛ woɔ mi, shi amɛtsui kɛ miteŋ jɛkɛ kwraa, ni jamɔ ni amɛjaa mi lɛ ejeee fɛifɛi fe wiemɔi ni amɛkase amɛwo amɛyitseiaŋ kɛkɛ amɛwieɔ

english_verse: So once again I will do things that shock and amaze them, and I will destroy the wisdom of those who claim to know and understand.”
translation_verse: hewɔ lɛ, naa, mibafee naakpɛɛ nibii yɛ nɛkɛ maŋbii nɛɛ ahiɛ ekoŋŋ, ni amɛhe baajɔ̃ amɛhe. Amɛhii nilelɔi lɛ anilee lɛ baafee yaka, ni amɛhii hiɛtɛ̃lɔi lɛ ahiɛtɛ̃ɛ lɛ aaaŋmɛɛɛ amɛ.” Wɔsɛɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ

english_verse: You are in for trouble, if you try to hide your plans from the Lord! Or if you think what you do in the dark can't be seen.
translation_verse: Kpoo hã mɛi ni kaa akɛ amɛkɛ amɛyiŋtoi aaatee Yehowa, ni amɛfeɔ dujiaŋnii, mɛi ni kɛɔ akɛ, “Namɔ naa wɔ?” loo “Namɔ le wɔ? lɛ!”

english_verse: You have it all backwards. A clay dish doesn't say to the potter, “You didn't make me. You don't even know how.” Hope for the Future
translation_verse: Nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ nibii ahiɛ nyɛbuɔ shi. Ani abaaŋɔ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ akɛ nishɔ̃ɔ su? Ani nɔ ko ni mɔ ko fee aaanyɛ ekɛɛ yɛ mɔ ni fee nɔ lɛ he akɛ, “Jeee lɛ efee mi!” lo? Aloo nɔ ko ni ashɔ̃ aaakɛɛ yɛ mɔ ni shɔ̃ nɔ lɛ he akɛ, “Eleee nɔ ko?”

english_verse: Soon the forest of Lebanon will become a field with crops, thick as a forest.
translation_verse: Te etsɛŋ ni Lebanon koo lɛ baatsɔ ŋa nɔ humɔhe ni baa nii, ni aaaŋɔ ŋa nɔ humɔhe lɛ akɛ koo?

english_verse: The deaf will be able to hear whatever is read to them; the blind will be freed from a life of darkness.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, toimulɔi tete baanu wolo lɛ mli wiemɔi ni shwilafoi ahiŋmɛii anɔ ni ewo duŋ lɛ aaatse, ni amɛaana nii.

english_verse: The poor and the needy will celebrate and shout because of the Lord, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Humii baana miishɛɛ hee yɛ Yehowa hewɔ, ni ohiafoi amli aaafli amɛ yɛ Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: All who are cruel and arrogant will be gone forever. Those who live by crime will disappear,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ yiwalɔi aaatã, ni hefɛoyelɔi asɛɛ aaafo, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni shiɔ efɔŋfeemɔ he kpe lɛ, aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ,

english_verse: The Lord who rescued Abraham has this to say about Jacob's descendants: “They will no longer be ashamed and disgraced.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa mɔ ni kpɔ̃ Abraham lɛ kɛɔ yɛ Yakob we lɛ he nɛ, “Agbɛnɛ Yakob we lɛ hiɛ gboŋ dɔŋŋ, ni ehiɛ eshwieŋ shi dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: When they see how great I have made their nation, they will praise and honor me, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛji ena ebii lɛ, ni ji mininenaa nitsumɔnii lɛ yɛ amɛteŋ lɛ, amɛaakpɛlɛ̃ Yakob Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ eyɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛɛlɛŋ, ni amɛaashe Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbeyei.

english_verse: Everyone who is confused will understand, and all who have complained will obey my teaching.”
translation_verse: Ni mɛi ni duɔ gbɛ yɛ mumɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ aaana jwɛŋmɔ, ni mɛi ni wieɔ huhuuhu lɛ aaakase nii.”

english_verse: This is the Lord's message for his rebellious people: “You follow your own plans instead of mine; you make treaties without asking me, and you keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Kpoo hã bii kaniŋkajelɔi ni yaa ajina ni mi, mibɛ mli, ni amɛkpãŋɔ kpãŋmɔi ni jeee mitsui naa yiŋtoi ni, ni amɛkɛfeɔ esha amɛshiɔ esha nɔ.

english_verse: You trust Egypt for protection. So you refuse my advice and send messengers to Egypt to beg their king for help.
translation_verse: Amɛyiŋ amɛtee Ijipt, be mli ni amɛbiii mi ŋaawoo, koni amɛyaba Ijipt maŋtsɛ abo koni amɛyatao teemɔhe yɛ Ijipt.

english_verse: “You will be disappointed, completely disgraced for trusting Egypt.
translation_verse: Shi Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ hewalɛ lɛ aaahã nyɛhiɛ agboi, ni Ijipt abo ni nyɛyaabɔ lɛ aaahã nyɛhiɛ agboi.

english_verse: The king's power reaches from the city of Zoan as far south as Hanes.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ eyɛ mli akɛ amɛlumɛi lɛ eshɛ Zoan, ni amɛbɔfoi lɛ hu eshɛ Hanes, ni ji Ijipt maji wuji lɛ anɔ nɛ,

english_verse: This is a message about the animals of the Southern Desert: “You people carry treasures on donkeys and camels. You travel to a feeble nation through a troublesome desert filled with lions and flying fiery dragons.
translation_verse: Kooloi ni yɔɔ wuoyigbɛ shiaŋa lɛ mli lɛ ahe ninaa nɛ, “Amɛtsɔ̃ɔ haomɔ kɛ hejaramɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni jatayoo kɛ jatanuu hũuɔ yɛ, he ni shinɔ kɛ onufu filikilɔ yɔɔ lɛ, ni amɛloɔ amɛnii ni amɛna lɛ amɛtereɔ tejibii ni amɛkɛ amɛjwetrii tereɔ yoomai kɛyaa maŋ ko ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ kɛha amɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Egypt can't help you! That's why I call that nation a helpless monster.” Israel Refuses To Listen
translation_verse: Akɛni Ijipt dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ lɛ bɛ fɛifɛi, ni enyɛɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko etsu hewɔ lɛ, mitsɛɔ lɛ ‘Naafuutsɛ ni etĩii ehe.’ ” Maŋbii toigbolɔi

english_verse: The Lord told me to write down his message for his people, so that it would be there forever.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ yaa ni oyaŋma yɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii anɔ yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni oŋma owo wolo mli koni ekã shi akɛ odaseyelinɔ ehã wɔsɛɛ be kɛya naanɔ.

english_verse: They have turned against the Lord and can't be trusted. They have refused his teaching
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ gbɔmɛi atuatselɔi, bii amalelɔi ni amɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ Yehowa toiboo ji amɛ.

english_verse: and have said to his messengers and prophets: Don't tell us what God has shown you and don't preach the truth. Just say what we want to hear, even if it's false.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɔ ninalɔi lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkanaa nii’ ni amɛkɛɔ gbalɔi lɛ hu akɛ, ‘Nyɛkagbaa anɔkwale gbalɛ nyɛtsɔa wɔ; shi moŋ nyɛkɛ wɔ awiea wiemɔi ni ŋɔɔ; nyɛgbaa shishiumɔ gbalɛi moŋ;

english_verse: Stop telling us what God has said! We don't want to hear any more about the holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: nyɛshĩa gbɛ lɛ, nyɛgbaa afã kɛjea tɛmpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; nyɛ kɛ wɔ akawiea Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he dɔŋŋ.’ ”

english_verse: Now this is the answer of the holy One of Israel: “You rejected my message, and you trust in violence and lies.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nɔ ni Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɔ nɛ, “Akɛni nyɛkwa wiemɔ nɛɛ, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ fɔ̃ yiwalɛ kɛ kutumpɔo nɔ, asaŋ nyɛshwãa hu nyɛfɔɔ nɔ,

english_verse: and shatter like a crushed bowl. There's not a piece left big enough to carry hot coals or to dip out water.” Trust the Lord
translation_verse: Ekuumɔ lɛ aaafee tamɔ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ gbɛ ni ajwara lɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ bɔ ni anaaa eŋɛsuko kome po nɛkɛ kɛkɛ yɛ ekoi lɛ amli ni aaanyɛ akɛje la yɛ latɛ mli, aloo akɛyɛ nu yɛ dudɔ mli tete.”

english_verse: The holy Lord God of Israel had told all of you, “I will keep you safe if you turn back to me and calm down. I will make you strong if you quietly trust me.” Then you stubbornly
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, “Sɛɛkuu kɛbaa kɛ diŋŋfeemɔ mli nyɛyi aaana wala yɛ; kpoofeemɔ kɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ mli nyɛhewalɛ yɔɔ. Shi moŋ nyɛkwa,

english_verse: As few as five of them, or even one, will be enough to chase a thousand of you. Finally, all that will be left will be a few survivors as lonely as a flag pole on a barren hill. The Lord Will Show Mercy
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ kometoo yiŋaa naa lɛ, mɛi akpe aaajo foi; nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛaajo foi kɛji mɛi enumɔ ŋa nyɛyi kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni aaashwɛ mɛi fioo tamɔ aflaŋaa tso ni ma gɔŋ yiteŋ, loo tamɔ aflaŋaa ni ma gɔŋkpɔ yiteŋ.

english_verse: The Lord God is waiting to show how kind he is and to have pity on you. The Lord always does right; he blesses those who trust him.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa miimɛ koni eduro nyɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, efee kralo koni ena nyɛ mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni yeɔ jalɛ sane ni. Ajɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni hiɛ kã enɔ lɛ.” Nyɔŋmɔ baajɔɔ emɛi lɛ

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, you don't need to cry anymore. The Lord is kind, and as soon as he hears your cries for help, he will come.
translation_verse: Ao nyɛ Zionbii ni nyɛyɔɔ Yerusalɛm, nyɛwoŋ yara nyɛfoŋ dɔŋŋ. Emusuŋ baatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ nyɛhe kɛji nyɛbolɔ nyɛtsɛ lɛ. Kɛji enu blɔmɔ lɛ, eeehã nyɛ hetoo.

english_verse: The Lord has given you trouble and sorrow as your food and drink. But now you will again see the Lord, your teacher, and he will guide you.
translation_verse: Yɛ mli akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ehã amanehulu kɛ haomɔ eba nyɛnɔ moŋ nɛ, shi nyɛ-Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ eteŋ ehe dɔŋŋ, shi nyɛhiŋmɛii aaana nyɛ-Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Whether you turn to the right or to the left, you will hear a voice saying, “This is the road! Now follow it.”
translation_verse: Ni ninejurɔgbɛ esa akɛ nyɛtsɔ jio, abɛkugbɛ esa akɛ nyɛtsɔ jio, nyɛtoii aaanu wiemɔ ko yɛ nyɛsɛɛgbɛ akɛ, “Gbɛ lɛ nɛ, nyɛyia nɔ!”

english_verse: Then you will treat your idols of silver and gold like garbage; you will throw them away like filthy rags.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛaabule nyɛmãgãi ni ashwie he jwiɛtɛi kɛ amãgãi ni ashwie he shika lɛ hu. Nyɛaashɛrɛ amɛ nyɛshwie tamɔ nibii ni ahe tseee; nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, “Aloo amɛ ashwie kɛje wɔhiɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord will send rain to water the seeds you have planted—your fields will produce more crops than you need, and your cattle will graze in open pastures.
translation_verse: Eeehã nu anɛ ashwie nyɛdumɔ wui ni nyɛdu lɛ nɔ, kɛ ŋmãa ni ekwɛ̃ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛaawo yibii babaoo. Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛtsinai lɛ aaaye nii yɛ ŋa ni lɛɛ nɔ,

english_verse: Even the oxen and donkeys that plow your fields will be fed the finest grain.
translation_verse: ni nyɛtsinai kɛ tejii ni akɛhuɔ lɛ aaaye nii ni ŋoo yɔɔ mli, ní akɛ sofi kɛ ŋmɔshi faka esha mli.

english_verse: On that day people will be slaughtered and towers destroyed, but streams of water will flow from high hills and towering mountains.
translation_verse: Ni gbi nɔ ni aaaplene gbɔmɛi babaoo, ni amɛmɔji lɛ aaagbeegbee shi lɛ, faa baaho yɛ gɔji grɔŋŋi fɛɛ kɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi ni kwɔlɔ fɛɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord will bandage his people's injuries and heal the wounds he has caused. The moon will shine as bright as the sun, and the sun will shine seven times brighter than usual. It will be like the light of seven days all at once. Assyria Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Ni nyɔɔŋtsere aaakpɛ tamɔ hulu tsoɔ, ni hulu aaatso bɔ ni etsoɔ daa lɛ toi kpawo, tamɔ gbii kpawo mli hulutsoo ni abua naa, gbi ni Yehowa aaafimɔ emaŋ lɛ pilamɔi anɔ, ni eeetsa faji ni ewo amɛ be ni etswia amɛ nii lɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala Asiria toi

english_verse: The Lord is coming from far away with his fiery anger and thick clouds of smoke. His angry words flame up like a destructive fire;
translation_verse: Naa Yehowa hewalɛ jɛ shɔŋŋ miiba! Emlifu miitso, ni eeje lasu kpɔŋŋ; enaa miitswa afui kɛ mlila, ni elilɛi tamɔ la ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ.

english_verse: he breathes out a flood that comes up to the neck. He sifts the nations and destroys them. Then he puts a bridle in every foreigner's mouth and leads them to doom.
translation_verse: Emumɔ ni emuɔ lɛ tamɔ faa ni eyi kɛbata kuɛ, ni ebaakpãtã maji ahiɛ koni ekɛsha amɛmli tamɔ akɛ shaanii shaa nii amli lɛ. Ebaawo majimaji lɛ adaaŋ manyoflɛ koni ekpala amɛ kɛya.

english_verse: The Lord's people will sing as they do when they celebrate a religious festival at night. The Lord is Israel's mighty rock, and his people will be as happy as they are when they follow the sound of flutes to the mountain where he is worshiped.
translation_verse: Nyɛaala lala ko tamɔ bɔ ni alaa nyɔɔŋ kɛji aaye gbijurɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ko lɛ. Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛtsui aaayimɔ kɛ miishɛɛ tamɔ mɛi ni aakpã blɛ aahã amɛ, be mli ni amɛnyiɛ kɛyaa Yehowa, ni ji Israel Tɛsaa lɛ, we lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will get furious. His fearsome voice will be heard, his arm will be seen ready to strike, and his anger will be like a destructive fire, followed by thunderstorms and hailstones.
translation_verse: Ni Yehowa aaahã anu enunyam gbee lɛ, ni eeehã ana ehewalɛ nine ni kpelekeɔ shi lɛ kɛ emlifu ni naa wa lɛ; la ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ aaatso, ni atatui aaaflɛ, ni nu kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi aaanɛ.

english_verse: When the Assyrians hear the Lord's voice and see him striking with his iron rod, they will be terrified.
translation_verse: Asiriabii aaayoyoro kɛji amɛnu Yehowa gbee lɛ, be ni ebaatswa amɛ nɔ kɛgbala amɛtoi lɛ.

english_verse: He will attack them in battle, and each time he strikes them, it will be to the music of tambourines and harps.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni miji kɛ saŋkui agbɛɛmɔ nyiɛɔ lɛ, nakai Yehowa baatswa amɛ kpãa kɛgbala amɛtoi. Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ kɛ Asiriabii lɛ baawu.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord got a place ready for burning the body of the dead king. The place for the fire is deep and wide, the wood is piled high, and the Lord will start the fire by breathing out flaming sulfur.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ beebe ni asaa he ko ato kɛha Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ shãa. Jɛi kwɔ, ni elɛɛ, ni eyi kɛ la kɛ lai babaoo. Ni Yehowa mumɔ ni emuɔ ni tamɔ la lɛ baama laii lɛ anaa la.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you go to Egypt for help, or if you depend on an army of chariots or a powerful cavalry. Instead you should depend on and trust the holy Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Kpoo hã mɛi ni yaa Ijipt amɛyataoɔ yelikɛbuamɔ ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ okpɔŋɔi anɔ, mɛi ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ tayaa shwiilii anɔ ejaakɛ amɛfa, kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi hu anɔ, ejaakɛ amɛhe wa naakpa, shi amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ moŋ nɔ, loo amɛbiii Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ po!

english_verse: The Lord isn't stupid! He does what he promises, and he can bring doom. If you are cruel yourself, or help those who are evil, you will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Tsɛbelɛ, lɛ ji nilelɔ, ni ehãa efɔŋ baa, ni ekpaleee enaa, shi eteɔ shi ewoɔ efɔŋfeelɔi kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ buaa efɔŋfeelɔi.

english_verse: The Egyptians are mere humans. They aren't God. Their horses are made of flesh; they can't live forever. When the Lord shows his power, he will destroy the Egyptians and all who depend on them. Together they will fall.
translation_verse: Ijiptbii lɛ gbɔmɛi adesai kɛkɛ ji amɛ; jeee Nyɔŋmɔ ji amɛ, ni amɛkpɔŋɔi lɛ heloo kɛ lá ni, shi jeee mumɔi ni. Kɛji Yehowa wo enine nɔ lɛ, mɔ ni yeɔ buaa mɔ lɛ aaatɛ, ni mɔ ni ayeɔ abuaa lɛ lɛ hu aaagbee shi, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said to me, “I will roar and attack like a fearless lion not frightened by the shouts of shepherds trying to protect their sheep. That's how I will come down and fight on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi nɛ, “Bɔ ni kɛji jata loo jatabi miihũu yɛ emilɛ loo he, ni atsɛ tookwɛlɔi asafo tete awo ehe, ni amɛbolɔmɔ wooo ehe gbeyei, ni ebuuu hoo ni amɛaafee lɛ tete lɛ, nakai Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, aaaba abawu yɛ Zion Gɔŋ kɛ ehewɔ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will protect Jerusalem like a mother bird circling over her nest.” Come Back to the Lord
translation_verse: Bɔ ni loofɔji filikiɔ kɛbɔleɔ shi yɛ ŋwɛi kɛbuɔ amɛtsui ahe lɛ, nakai Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, baabu Yerusalɛm he; ebaabu ehe, ni ebaabaa eyi, ekɛ ehe baake lɛ, ni ebaahere lɛ.

english_verse: People of Israel, come back! You have completely turned from the Lord.
translation_verse: “Ao Israelbii, nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nyɛbaa mɔ ni nyɛtse ehiɛ atua lɛ ŋɔɔ.

english_verse: The time is coming when you will throw away your idols of silver and gold, made by your sinful hands.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baashɛrɛ ejwiɛtɛi amãgãi kɛ eshika amãgãi ni ekɛ eniji fee ni no hã nyɛfee esha lɛ eshwie.

english_verse: The Assyrians will be killed, but not by the swords of humans. Their young men will try to escape, but they will be captured and forced into slavery.
translation_verse: Asiria hiɛ baakpãtã yɛ klante ni jɛɛɛ adesa dɛŋ naa; klante ni jeee adesa ko sɔ̃ baakpãtã ehiɛ, ni ebaajo klante naa foi; ni eblahii lɛ aaanyɛ amɛnɔ koni amɛtsu nii keketee.

english_verse: Their fortress will fall when terror strikes; their army officers will be frightened and run from the battle. This is what the Lord has said, the Lord whose fiery furnace is built on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Emaŋtsɛ lɛ baajo foi kɛ tsuifãa, ni elumɛi lɛ aaajo foi kɛ hekpokpomɔ amɛshi amɛflaŋaa lɛ.” Yehowa, mɔ ni ajaa lɛ yɛ Zion ni efɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mli la tsoɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ ekɛɛ.

english_verse: A king and his leaders will rule with justice.
translation_verse: Naa, maŋtsɛ ko baaba ebaye nɔ; ebaaye jalɛ sane; ni lumɛi hu baaba abaye jalɛ sane.

english_verse: They will be a place of safety from stormy winds, a stream in the desert, and a rock that gives shade from the heat of the sun.
translation_verse: Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ teemɔhe be mli ni kɔɔyɔɔ miitswa, loo abobaahe be mli ni ahum miitswa; eeetsɔ̃ tamɔ faa yɛ shiaŋa nɔ, loo tamɔ tɛsaa kpele hɔ̃ɔŋ yɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ.

english_verse: Then everyone who has eyes will open them and see, and those who have ears will pay attention.
translation_verse: Amɛteŋ mɛi ni hiŋmɛi nɔ tse baana nɔ fɛɛ nɔ faŋŋ, ni mɛi hu ni toiiaŋ tse baabo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ toi jogbaŋŋ.

english_verse: All who are impatient will take time to think; everyone who stutters will talk clearly.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni kulɛ amɛtsuii yɔɔ floflo lɛ aaakase nilee kpakpa, ni mumɔhalɔi awiemɔ mli aaatse pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni amɛlilɛii tɛrɛŋ shi dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Fools will no longer be highly respected, and crooks won't be given positions of honor.
translation_verse: Atsɛŋ kwashia akɛ ablade dɔŋŋ ni shishiulɔ hu abuŋ lɛ oje dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Fools talk foolishness. They always make plans to do sinful things, to lie about the Lord, to let the hungry starve, and to keep water from those who are thirsty.
translation_verse: Kwashia wieɔ kwashiai awiemɔ, ni nishaianii ahe ejwɛŋɔ, ni enifeemɔ etsɔ̃ɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ; ewieɔ eshiɔ Yehowa. Ehãaa mɔ ni hɔmɔ miiye lɛ niyenii, ni egbeɔ mɔ ni kumai miiye lɛ kumai.

english_verse: Cruel people tell lies— they do evil things, and make cruel plans to destroy the poor and needy, even when they beg for justice.
translation_verse: Shishiulɔ nifeemɔ lɛ nɔ fɔŋ ni; etoɔ efɔŋfeemɔ he ŋaa koni ekɛ amale wiemɔi akpãtã ohiafo hiɛ kɛji ohiafo sane ja tete po lɛ.

english_verse: But helpful people can always be trusted to make helpful plans. Punishment for the Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni ji ablade lɛ, efeɔ abladei anii, ni efãa nɔ kpakpa he hu. Toigbalamɔ kɛ Shweremɔ ekoŋŋ

english_verse: Listen to what I say, you women who are carefree and careless!
translation_verse: Nyɛ yei ni nyɛhe ejɔ nyɛ, nyɛtea shi, nyɛboa mi toi! Nyɛ biyei hu ni nyɛyitsei kãmɔ̃ nyɛyisɛɛ, nyɛfea toi nyɛhãa miwiemɔ lɛ!

english_verse: You may not have worries now, but in about a year, the grape harvest will fail, and you will tremble.
translation_verse: Nyɛ yei ni nyɛyitsei kãmɔ nyɛyisɛɛ, biɛ afi kɛ nɔ ko fioo mli lɛ, nyɛhe aaakpokpo, ejaakɛ wainyibii aaakpala, ni eko baŋ dɔŋŋ ni aaana atse.

english_verse: Shake and shudder, you women without a care! Strip off your clothes— put on sackcloth.
translation_verse: Nyɛ yei ni nyɛhe ejɔ nyɛ, nyɛhe akpokpoa! Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyitsei kãmɔ nyɛyisɛɛ, nyɛhe akpokpoa! Nyɛkpɔlɔa nyɛtadei koni nyɛnyiɛ yayai koni nyɛkɔlɔa kpekpe nyɛŋmɔlɔ nyɛhɛ.

english_verse: Slap your breasts in sorrow because of what happened to the fruitful fields and vineyards,
translation_verse: Nyɛyia nyɛtsitsi nɔ ma yɛ ŋmɔji ni yɔɔ fɛo kɛ waintsei ni woɔ yibii pii lɛ ahewɔ;

english_verse: and to the happy homes in Jerusalem. The land of my people is covered with thorns.
translation_verse: yɛ ŋmei kɛ kpitikpiti ni aaakwɛ̃ yɛ mimaŋbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hewɔ. Hɛɛ! Yɛ shĩai ni eyimɔ kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ maji ni miishɛɛ yɔɔ mli lɛ lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: The palace will be deserted, the crowded city empty. Fortresses and towers will forever become playgrounds for wild donkeys and pastures for sheep. God's Spirit Makes the Difference
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ aaajo foi ashi mɔɔ, ni aaashi maŋ ni emli eyi kɛ gbɔmɛi lɛ afɔ̃ shi. Gɔŋkpɔ kɛ buumɔ̃ɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ kooloi abui kɛ ŋaŋ tejii amiishɛɛnamɔhe kɛ toi hu aniyelihe kɛaatee naanɔ.

english_verse: When the Spirit is given to us from heaven, deserts will become orchards thick as fertile forests.
translation_verse: Be miiba ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaafɔse Mumɔ lɛ kɛaajɛ ŋwɛi eshwie wɔnɔ, ni shiaŋa lɛ aaatsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ ni baa nii, ni shikpɔŋ ni baa nii aaatsɔ̃ koo.

english_verse: and justice will produce lasting peace and security.
translation_verse: Jalɛ saneyeli lɛ hesɛɛnamɔ baafee toiŋjɔlɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ shihilɛ kɛ nyɛmi hemɔkɛyeli.

english_verse: You, the Lord's people, will live in peace, calm and secure,
translation_verse: Mimaŋbii ashihilɛhei baayi kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ, amɛaahi shi shweshweeshwe kɛ kpoo.

english_verse: even if hailstones flatten forests and cities.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔŋtɛ aaanɛ koo lɛ nɔ, ni ebaatsɔ̃ lakpatsa, ni aaafite maŋ lɛ kwrakwra.

english_verse: You will have God's blessing, as you plant your crops beside streams, while your donkeys and cattle roam freely about.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛduduu nii yɛ fai fɛɛ atoii, ni nyɛŋmɛɛ tsina kɛ teji he koni amɛyanyiɛ hei ni amɛsumɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You defeated my people. Now you're in for trouble! You've never been destroyed, but you will be destroyed; you've never been betrayed, but you will be betrayed. When you have finished destroying and betraying, you will be destroyed and betrayed in return.
translation_verse: Kpoo hã bo, fitelɔ, bo mɔ ni bo diɛŋtsɛ lɛ afiteko bo. Kpoo hã bo, bo mɔshishinyiɛlɔ ni mɔ ko enyiɛko oshishi. Kɛji ogbe onifitemɔ lɛ naa lɛ, bo hu abaakpãtã ohiɛ; ni kɛji ogbe mɔshishinyiɛmɔ lɛ naa lɛ, bo hu abaanyiɛ oshishi.

english_verse: Please, Lord, be kind to us! We depend on you. Make us strong each morning, and come to save us when we are in trouble.
translation_verse: Ao Yehowa, dromɔ wɔ, shi bo pɛ gbɛ wɔkwɛɔ. Daa gbi lɛ bo ofeɔ wɔhewalɛ kɛ wɔyiwalaherelɔ yɛ fimɔ be mli.

english_verse: Nations scatter when you roar and show your greatness.
translation_verse: Kɛji oshi yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ, mɛi joɔ foi; ni kɛji owo ohe nɔ lɛ maji gbɛɔ shwãa.

english_verse: We attack our enemies like swarms of locusts; we take everything that belongs to them.
translation_verse: Aaaha nyɛnomŋɔɔnii tamɔ baalabii; ni abaake kɛba onɔ tamɔ otukpɛi.

english_verse: You, Lord, are above all others, and you live in the heavens. You have brought justice and fairness to Jerusalem;
translation_verse: Awo Yehowa nɔ, ejaakɛ lɛ eyeɔ nii fɛɛ nɔ. Eeehã Yerusalɛm ayi obɔ̃ tɔ kɛ jalɛ saneyeli kɛ jalɛ nifeemɔ,

english_verse: you are the foundation on which we stand today. You always save us and give true wisdom and knowledge. Nothing means more to us than obeying you. The Lord Will Do Something
translation_verse: ni eeehã nyɛyinɔ afee shweshweeshwe, ni eeeduro nyɛ nilee kɛ ŋaa babaoo. Ninamɔ kpele ji Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ.

english_verse: Listen! Our bravest soldiers are running through the streets, screaming for help. Our messengers hoped for peace, but came home crying.
translation_verse: Naa, kãkãlɔi lɛ miibolɔ yɛ blohuiaŋ, ni bɔfoi ni bɔ mɔdɛŋ koni toiŋjɔlɛ aba lɛ miifo bloblo.

english_verse: No one travels anymore; every road is empty. Treaties are broken, and no respect is shown to any who keep promises.
translation_verse: Gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ kã efolo, ni gbɛnyiɛlɔi eyaaa baaa. Akumɔ kpãŋmɔi amli, ni abuuu fuamɔi ni aye afua, ni abuuu gbɔmɔ adesa ahãaa fɛifɛi.

english_verse: Fields are dry and barren; Mount Lebanon wilts with shame. Sharon Valley is a desert; the forests of Bashan and Carmel have lost their leaves.
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ, ni eeŋala. Labanon kooŋ tsei ayibii ekpala, ekoi lɛ miigbi. Sharon jɔɔ shikpɔŋ frɔ̃frɔ̃ lɛ etsɔ̃ shiaŋa, ni Bashan kɛ Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ tsei ayibai miikpala. Yehowa miibɔ ehenyɛlɔi kɔkɔ

english_verse: But the Lord says, “Now I will do something and be greatly praised.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ, mibate shi! Agbɛnɛ mibawo mihe nɔ! Agbɛnɛ abaawo minɔ!

english_verse: Your deeds are straw that will be set on fire by your very own breath.
translation_verse: Nyɛhiɛ tutuu musu, ni nyɛbaafɔ jwɛi; mumɔ ni jɛɔ nyɛgugɔŋ lɛ, la ni, ni no nɔŋŋ baashã nyɛ.

english_verse: You will be burned to ashes like thorns in a fire.
translation_verse: Maŋbii lɛ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ kaaloo ni ashã; amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ ŋmei ni afolɔ ashwie shi ni awoɔ mli la ni ashãa.

english_verse: Everyone, both far and near, come look at what I have done. See my mighty power!” Punishment and Rewards
translation_verse: Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyɔɔ shɔŋŋ, nyɛboa nɔ ni mifee lɛ toi, ni nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛbɛŋkɛ, nyɛkpɛlɛa mihewalɛ lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: Those terrible sinners on Mount Zion tremble as they ask in fear, “How can we possibly live where a raging fire never stops burning?”
translation_verse: Eshafeelɔi ni yɔɔ Zion lɛ miishe gbeyei, ni mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ ahe miikpokpo. Amɛkɛɛmɔ ji, “Wɔteŋ namɔ baanyɛ la naa edamɔ kɛyashi naanɔ?”

english_verse: But there will be rewards for those who live right and tell the truth, for those who refuse to take money by force or accept bribes, for all who hate murder and violent crimes.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii, ni ewieɔ nɔ ni ja, mɔ ni nyaaa wieyeli mli nii he, ni eheee nyɔɔŋ nii, mɔ ni tsimɔɔ etoi koni ekanu láshishwiemɔ yiŋtoi ahe, ni eŋamɔɔ ehiŋmɛii koni ekana nɔfɔŋfeemɔ lɛ,

english_verse: They will live in a fortress high on a rocky cliff, where they will have food and plenty of water. The Lord Is Our King
translation_verse: lɛ ji mɔ ni baahi gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni tɛsai aaatsɔ̃ mɔji ahã lɛ. Ebaana nii eye, ni ebaana nu enu. Wɔsɛɛ shihilɛ kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ

english_verse: With your own eyes you will see the glorious King; you will see his kingdom reaching far and wide.
translation_verse: Okɛ ohiŋmɛii baana maŋtsɛ lɛ he fɛo, kɛ shikpɔŋ ko ni kã shi shwaŋŋ kɛtee shɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Then you will ask yourself, “Where are those officials who terrified us and forced us to pay such heavy taxes?”
translation_verse: Kaimɔ kɛkɛ oookai nyɛsɛɛ ko gbeyei ni oshe lɛ. Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni kane shika lɛ yɔɔ? Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni ŋmɛ too ni aye lɛ yɔɔ? Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni kane mɔji lɛ yɔɔ?

english_verse: You will never again have to see the proud people who spoke a strange and foreign language you could not understand.
translation_verse: Onaŋ gbɔmɛi hetsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ dɔŋŋ, mɛi ni wieɔ wiemɔ ni wa ni anuuu shishi, ni amɛwieɔ kɛ mumɔhaa ni anuuu shishi lɛ.

english_verse: Look to Mount Zion where we celebrate our religious festivals. You will see Jerusalem, secure as a tent with pegs that cannot be pulled up and fastened with ropes that can never be broken.
translation_verse: Kwɛmɔ Zion, maŋ he ni wɔyeɔ wɔgbii juji lɛ yɛ lɛ! Ohiŋmɛii aaana Yerusalɛm akɛ toiŋjɔlɛ maŋ ni yɔɔ shweshweeshwe. Eyɛ tamɔ buu ni ma shi shiŋŋ, buu ni afamɔŋ ehe shiŋmlitsei lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ, ni ehe taŋkpei lɛ ekoeko tseŋ.

english_verse: Our wonderful Lord will be with us! There will be deep rivers and wide streams safe from enemy ships. The Lord Is Our Judge
translation_verse: Jɛi Yehowa aaahi yɛ enunyam mli ahã wɔ. Fai wuji kɛ bibii fɛɛ aaahi jɛi; shi moŋ lɛlɛ agbo ni awiriɔ ko kɛ meele ko nyɛŋ fai lɛ ekoeko mli etsɔ̃ kɛho.

english_verse: The Lord is our judge and our ruler; the Lord is our king and will keep us safe.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa ji wɔkojolɔ, Yehowa ji wɔnɔyelɔ. Yehowa ji wɔmaŋtsɛ; lɛ nɔŋŋ ebaahere wɔyiwala.

english_verse: But your nation is a ship with its rigging loose, its mast shaky, and its sail not spread. Someday even you that are lame will take everything you want from your enemies.
translation_verse: Otaŋkpei lɛ amli egbɔjɔ, amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛhã shimaatso lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ; amɛnyɛɛɛ abalaa lɛ amɛshi. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛshwiea amɛnɔ, nyɛhaa amɛnii; nyɛjaa nyɛhãa bɔ ni obubuafoi tete aaana amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will forgive your sins, and none of you will say, “I feel sick.”
translation_verse: Maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ekɛŋ akɛ, “Mihe miiye.” Akɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ahe eshai aaafa amɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is terribly angry with the nations; he has condemned them to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa mli efu majimaji lɛ fɛɛ; egri ewo amɛtai lɛ, ni ejɔɔ amɛ nɔ, ni eŋɔ amɛ eha koni akpãtã amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: Their dead bodies will be left to rot and stink; their blood will flow down the mountains.
translation_verse: Abaashɛrɛ amɛgbohii lɛ ashwie, ni gbohii lɛ aaaje fu, ni amɛlá aaakpa gɔji lɛ anɔ kpɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: Each star will disappear— the sky will roll up like a scroll. Everything in the sky will dry up and wilt like leaves on a vine or fruit on a tree. Trouble for Edom
translation_verse: Hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii aaasere, ni aaakota ŋwɛi tamɔ wolo. Amɛtabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ aaatswiatswia shi tamɔ baa kpalaa yɛ waintso nɔ loo agbãmitso nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: After the sword of the Lord has done what it wants to the skies above, it will come down on Edom, the nation that the Lord has doomed for destruction.
translation_verse: Yehowa esaa klante lɛ eto yɛ ŋwɛi. Naa, klante lɛ baayi Edom nɔ, maŋ ni ajɔɔ enɔ aha hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The sword of the Lord is covered with blood from lambs and goats, together with fat from kidneys of rams. This is because the Lord will slaughter many people and make a sacrifice of them in the city of Bozrah and everywhere else in Edom.
translation_verse: Yehowa klante lɛ amɛlá kɛ fɔ ewu he kpɔtɔɔ; tamɔ too gwantɛŋi kɛ too kpakpoi alá kɛ agbɛnɛ ojwɛnii asabai ahe fɔ ni akɛshã afɔle. Ejaakɛ Yehowa miishã afɔle yɛ Bozra, ni ebaakpãtã wala hiɛ waa diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Edom.

english_verse: Edom's leaders are wild oxen. They are powerful bulls, but they will die with the others. Their country will be soaked with their own blood, and its soil made fertile with their own fat.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɛi baanyɔnyɔi tamɔ wuoi kɛ tsina hii kɛ tsina ajebui. Lá baakpa amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kpɔtɔɔ, ni amɛshikpɔŋ su baafee ŋɛlɛŋŋ kɛ fɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen the year and the day, when he will take revenge and come to Zion's defense.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa oweletɔɔ be lɛ ni, be ni ebaaye Zion sane lɛ ehã lɛ koni eto lɛ najiaŋ pɛpɛɛpɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Edom's streams will turn into tar and its soil into sulfur— then the whole country will go up in flames.
translation_verse: Edom fai lɛ baadi tuŋŋ tamɔ kootaa, ni eshikpɔŋ lɛ su aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ swɔɔ. Eshikpɔŋ tso muu aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ kootaa ni miitso.

english_verse: It will burn night and day and never stop smoking. Edom will be a desert, generation after generation; no one will ever travel through that land.
translation_verse: Ebaatso nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane fɛɛ, ni ebaaje lasu kɛya naanɔ. Shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ yinɔi fɛɛ; mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔŋ jɛi kɛhoŋ dɔŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ.

english_verse: Owls, hawks, and wild animals will make it their home. God will leave it in ruins, merely a pile of rocks. The End of Edom
translation_verse: Jɛi aaatsɔ̃ kpokukpokui kɛ kɔtɔkɔi agboshinii; ni patui kɛ kwãakwãalabitei aaahi jɛi. Yehowa baaha eshikpɔŋ lɛ agbo koni etsɔ̃ olɛŋlɛ, ni nɔ kpakpa ko ehiŋ nɔ.

english_verse: Edom will be called “Kingdom of Nothing.” Its rulers will also be nothing.
translation_verse: Aaawo jɛi akɛ, “Maŋnɔyeli bɛ”, ni akɛ emli lumɛi fɛɛ efeŋ fɛifɛi.

english_verse: Its palaces and fortresses will be covered with thorns; only wolves and ostriches will make their home there.
translation_verse: Ŋmei kɛ sansrɔ kɛ aŋlɛŋlɛ fɛɛ aaakwɛ̃kwɛ̃ɛ yɛ amɛmɔji lɛ kɛ amɛmaji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe lɛ amli. Jɛi aaatsɔ̃ ŋaŋgbei ashihilɛhe kɛ dugumai hu ahilɛhe.

english_verse: Wildcats and hyenas will hunt together, demons will scream to demons, and creatures of the night will live among the ruins.
translation_verse: Ŋaŋ kooloi kɛ klãji aaabakpe yɛ jɛi, ni sasabonsami hu aaatsɛtsɛɛ amɛhe yɛ jɛi. Jɛi nɔŋŋ sisai aaaya koni amɛyatao hejɔɔmɔhe.

english_verse: Owls will nest there to raise their young among its shadows, while families of vultures circle around.
translation_verse: Patu aaafee etsu yɛ jɛi, eeeŋmɛ yɛ jɛi ni eeebu nɔ; eeefɛlɛ, ni eeebu ebii lɛ anɔ yɛ hɔ̃ɔŋ mli. Akromai aaayabua amɛhe naa yɛ jɛi ekomekome.

english_verse: In The Book of the Lord you can search and find where it is written, “The Lord brought together all of his creatures by the power of his Spirit. Not one is missing.”
translation_verse: Nyɛtaoa yɛ Yehowa wolo lɛ mli koni nyɛkanea. Kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ ekome folo nɛkɛ eshwɛŋ ni eyaŋ jɛi, ni eko eko hefatalɔ ebɔŋ lɛ. Ejaakɛ eje Yehowa naa, ni efã, ni Emumɔ lɛ ji nɔ ni baabua amɛnaa.

english_verse: The Lord has decided where they each should live; they will be there forever, generation after generation.
translation_verse: Lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ efɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ oshiki eha amɛ. Shikpɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ kɛaatee naanɔ, ni amɛaahi nɔ yinɔi fɛɛ.

english_verse: Thirsty deserts will be glad; barren lands will celebrate and blossom with flowers.
translation_verse: Shiaŋa lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ lɛ aaanya, shiaŋa lɛ mii aaashɛ ehe ni eeegba afofro tamɔ fɔfɔi.

english_verse: Deserts will bloom everywhere and sing joyful songs. They will be as majestic as Mount Lebanon, as glorious as Mount Carmel or Sharon Valley. Everyone will see the wonderful splendor of the Lord our God. God Changes Everything *
translation_verse: Shiaŋa lɛ aaagba afofro babaoo, ni emli aaafli lɛ, ni eeenya kɛ lala. Aaaŋɔ Lebanon anunyam lɛ ahã lɛ, kɛ Karmel kɛ Sharon wulamɔ lɛ hu. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaana Yehowa anunyam lɛ, kɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ agbojee lɛ.

english_verse: Here is a message for all who are weak, trembling, and worried:
translation_verse: Nyɛwajea mɛi ni anijiaŋ eje wui lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni anakutseiaŋ egbɔjɔ lɛ.

english_verse: “Cheer up! Don't be afraid. Your God is coming to punish your enemies. God will take revenge on them and rescue you.”
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛa mɛi ni tsui fãa lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfea ekãa, nyɛkashea gbeyei! Naa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ baaba koni ebatɔ nyɛhe owele. Ebaaba koni ebahere nyɛyiwala.”

english_verse: The blind will see, and the ears of the deaf will be healed.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ aaagbele shwilafoi ahiŋmɛii, ni aaagbele toimulɔi hu atoii;

english_verse: Those who were lame will leap around like deer; tongues once silent will shout for joy. Water will rush through the desert.
translation_verse: obubuafoi aaatumɔ tamɔ ofrote, ni mumuii baala kɛ nyamɔ; ejaakɛ nu aaatue, ni eeeho tamɔ faa yɛ shiaŋa lɛ mli.

english_verse: Scorching sand will turn into a lake, and thirsty ground will flow with fountains. Grass will grow in deserts, where packs of wild dogs once made their home. God's Sacred Highway
translation_verse: Shiaŋa ni enɔ edɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ kpaakpo, ni shikpɔŋ ni nu bɛ nɔ lɛ baayi obɔ̃ kɛ nuhiŋmɛii. Ŋaŋgbei ashibumɔhei lɛ baatsɔmɔ hei ni nu tara, ni glã kɛ ntoo aaakwɛ̃ yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: A good road will be there, and it will be named “God's Sacred Highway.” It will be for God's people; no one unfit to worship God will walk on that road. And no fools can travel on that highway.
translation_verse: Gbɛjegbɛ aaakã jɛi, ni aaatsɛ gbɛ lɛ, “Gbɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ.” Mɔ ko ni he tseee enyiɛŋ nɔ, ni kwashiai tete eduŋ gbɛ yɛ nɔ.

english_verse: No lions or other wild animals will come near that road; only those the Lord has saved will travel there.
translation_verse: Jata ko jata ko ehiŋ jɛi; kooloo kakawua ko kwraa tsɔŋ jɛi kɛhoŋ, akɛ ja mɛi ni Yehowa ehere amɛyiwala lɛ kɛkɛ.

english_verse: The people the Lord has rescued will come back singing as they enter Zion. Happiness will be a crown everyone will always wear. They will celebrate and shout because all sorrows and worries will be gone far away.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni Yehowa ehere amɛ lɛ, aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaaba ekoŋŋ, ni amɛaaba Zion kɛ nyamɔ lala. Amɛmii aaashɛ kɛya naanɔ; amɛaayi kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ nyamɔ, amɛyeŋ ŋkɔmɔ, ni amɛdɔmɔŋ ŋtsɔi dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Hezekiah claims the Lord will save you. But don't be fooled by him. Were any other gods able to defend their land against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Nyɛkahãa Hezekia miilakaa nyɛ akɛ Yehowa baahere nyɛyiwala.’ Ani jeŋmaji lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ eko ehere eshikpɔŋ yiwala kɛje Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ pɛŋ?

english_verse: Then, in a voice loud enough for everyone to hear, he shouted out in Hebrew: Listen to what the great king of Assyria says!
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni tsulɔnukpa lɛ ho edamɔ shi, ni ewo egbee nɔ waa, ni ekɛɛ yɛ Hebri wiemɔ mli akɛ, “Nyɛboa maŋtsɛ kpeteŋkple ni ji Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ toi!

english_verse: What happened to the gods of Hamath, Arpad, and Sepharvaim? Were the gods of Samaria able to protect their land against the Assyrian forces?
translation_verse: Nɛgbɛ Hamat kɛ Arpad nyɔŋmɔi lɛ yɔɔ? Nɛgbɛ Sefarwaim nyɔŋmɔi lɛ yɔɔ? Ani amɛhere Samaria yiwala kɛjɛ midɛŋ?

english_verse: Don't be fooled by Hezekiah. He can't save you.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Nyɛkahãa Hezekia miilakaa nyɛ, ejaakɛ enyɛŋ nyɛyiwala ehere.’

english_verse: Three of the king's highest officials came out of Jerusalem to meet him. One of them was Hilkiah's son Eliakim, who was the prime minister. The other two were Shebna, assistant to the prime minister, and Joah son of Asaph, keeper of the government records.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni tsuji nɛɛ, Eliakim, Hilkia bi lɛ, mɔ ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ shĩa tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ Shebna, maŋtsɛ we lɛ woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ Yoa, Asaf bi lɛ, mɔ ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ woji ni aŋmala lɛ anɔ lɛ, je kpo kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli kɛtee eŋɔɔ.

english_verse: The Assyrian commander told them: I have a message for Hezekiah from the great king of Assyria. Ask Hezekiah why he feels so sure of himself.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Asiria maŋtsɛ tsulɔnukpa lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyakɛa Hezekia akɛ, bɔ ni maŋtsɛ kpeteŋkple ni ji Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɔ nɛ, ‘Mɛni po nɔ ohiɛ kã nɛɛ?’

english_verse: Does he think he can plan and win a war with nothing but words? Who is going to help him, now that he has turned against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Osusuɔ akɛ naabu wiemɔ kɛkɛ ji ŋaa kɛ hewalɛ ni akɛwuɔ ta lo? Namɔ po nɔ ohiɛ kã hewɔ ni otse mihiɛ atua nɛɛ?

english_verse: Is he depending on Egypt and its king? That's the same as leaning on a broken stick, and it will go right through his hand.
translation_verse: Ohiɛ kã Ijipt nɔ. Naa, Ijipt lɛ glã dɛhiɛmɔtso ni eku ni, ni mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ enɔ lɛ, etsuɔ edɛ̃. Nakai Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ ji hã mɛi fɛɛ ni hiɛ kãa enɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: Is Hezekiah now depending on the Lord, your God? Didn't Hezekiah tear down all except one of the Lord's altars and places of worship? Didn't he tell the people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship at that one place?
translation_verse: Asiria maŋtsɛ tsulɔnukpa lɛ tee nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Shi kɛji oookɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nɔ wɔhiɛ kã lɛ’, ani jeee lɛ ehei grɔŋŋi kɛ efɔleshãa latɛi lɛ Hezekia kumɔ be ni ekɛɛ Yudabii kɛ Yerusalɛmbii akɛ, ‘Nɛkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ koome nɛɛ he nyɛbaaja yɛ lɛ?’

english_verse: The king of Assyria wants to make a bet with you people! He will give you
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ ba koni okɛ minuŋtsɔ, Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ, abata abasa. Maha bo okpɔŋɔi akpei enyɔ kɛji obaana bo diɛŋtsɛ omɛi, hii tabilɔi, otara amɛnɔ.

english_verse: How could you even defeat our lowest ranking officer, when you have to depend on Egypt for chariots and cavalry?
translation_verse: Te ooofee tɛŋŋ onyɛ minuŋtsɔ tsuji, asafoiatsɛmɛi bibii fe fɛɛ, lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome po hiɛ odamɔ be mli ni okɛ ohiɛ efɔ̃ Ijipt tayaa shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi anɔ lɛ?

english_verse: Don't forget that it was the Lord who sent me here with orders to destroy your nation!
translation_verse: Osusuɔ akɛ ba ni miba mibatua shikpɔŋ nɛɛ koni makpãtã hiɛ lɛ, Yehowa fataaa mihe? Yehowa moŋ ni kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Fãa kɛya koni oyatua shikpɔŋ lɛ ni okpãtã hiɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said, “Sir, we don't want the people listening from the city wall to understand what you are saying. So please speak to us in Aramaic instead of Hebrew.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Eliakim kɛ Shebna kɛ Yoa kɛɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ tsulɔnukpa lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, okɛ otsuji awie yɛ Aram wiemɔ mli moŋ, ejaakɛ wɔnuɔ no hu. Okɛ wɔ akawie yɛ Hebri wiemɔ mli yɛ maŋbii ni jwere gbogbo lɛ nɔ lɛ atoiŋ.”

english_verse: The Assyrian army commander answered, “My king sent me to speak to everyone, not just to you leaders. These people will soon have to eat their own body waste and drink their own urine! And so will the three of you!”
translation_verse: Shi tsulɔnukpa lɛ to he ekɛɛ akɛ, “Aso nyɛ kɛ nyɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛkɛ ŋɔɔ minuŋtsɔ tsu mi kɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ? Dabida! Miba maŋbii nɛɛ ni tara gbogbo lɛ nɔ lɛ hu kɛ wiemɔ. Ejaakɛ amɛ hu amɛbaaye amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwamɔ ni amɛbaanu amɛshãmɔ tamɔ nyɛ nɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: Don't trust him when he tells you that the Lord will protect you from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Nyɛkahãa Hezekia miihã nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ miifɔ Yehowa nɔ, ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ Yehowa baahere wɔyiwala; atuŋ maŋ nɛɛ awoŋ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.’

english_verse: Stop listening to Hezekiah. Pay attention to my king. Surrender to him. He will let you keep your own vineyards, fig trees, and cisterns
translation_verse: Nyɛkaboa Hezekia toi. Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Asiria Maŋtsɛ kɛɔ nɛ, ‘Nyɛjea kpo nyɛbaa koni nyɛ kɛ mi abakpãtãa, koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aye ewaintso kɛ egbamitso yibii, ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ anu enubu mli nu,

english_verse: for a while. Then he will come and take you away to a country just like yours, where you can plant vineyards and raise your own grain.
translation_verse: kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni maba mabaloo nyɛ kɛya shikpɔŋ ni tamɔ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, shikpɔŋ ko ni abelei kɛ wain yɔɔ nɔ, aboloo kɛ waintromi ashikpɔŋ.

english_verse: None of those gods kept their people safe from the king of Assyria. Do you think the Lord, your God, can do any better?
translation_verse: Te nyɔŋmɔi nɛɛ ateŋ nɔ ni ehere amɛshikpɔŋ yiwala kɛje midɛŋ pɛŋ, hewɔ ni Yehowa lɛ, lɛ lɛ eeehere Yerusalɛm yiwala kɛjɛ midɛŋ lɛ?”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah had been warned by King Hezekiah not to answer the Assyrian commander. So they tore their clothes in sorrow and reported to Hezekiah everything the commander had said.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Eliakim, Hilkia bi lɛ ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ Shebna, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ Yoa, Asaf bi lɛ, blema woji ni aŋmala anɔkwɛlɔ lɛ, ba Hezekia ŋɔɔ kɛ amɛhe atadei ni egbala, ni amɛbagba lɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ tsulɔnukpa lɛ wiemɔi lɛ.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah heard the news, he tore off his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he went into the temple of the Lord.
translation_verse: Be ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia nu sane lɛ, egbala ehe atadei, ni ekɔ kpekpe ebu, ni eyiŋ kɛtee Yehowa we lɛ.

english_verse: The kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah have all disappeared. Hezekiah Prays (
translation_verse: Nɛgbɛ Hamat maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Arpad maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Sefarwaim maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Hena maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Iva maŋtsɛ lɛ yɔɔ?”

english_verse: Isaiah, these are difficult and disgraceful times. Our nation is like a woman too weak to give birth, when it's time for her baby to be born.
translation_verse: Amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Hezekia kɛɛ nɛ, “Haomɔ kɛ ahorabɔɔ kɛ hiɛshishwiemɔ gbi ji ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ. Wɔtsɔ̃ tamɔ yoo ni fɔmɔ eshɛ elagbaŋ, shi ebɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛbaafɔ.

english_verse: Please pray for those of us who are left alive. The king of Assyria sent his army commander to insult the living God. Perhaps the Lord heard what he said and will do something, if you will pray.
translation_verse: Ekolɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, enu tsulɔnukpa lɛ, mɔ ni enuŋtsɔ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu lɛ koni ebaye Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ he fɛo lɛ, wiemɔi lɛ. Aba mli akɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, enu ahorabɔɔ wiemɔi lɛ, ni ebaagbala mɔ ni wie lɛ toi. No hewɔ lɛ, sɔlemɔ okpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai yɛ wɔmaŋbii ni eshwɛ lɛ ahewɔ.”

english_verse: When these leaders came to me,
translation_verse: Be ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia tsuji lɛ ba Yesaia ŋɔɔ lɛ,

english_verse: I told them that the Lord had this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord. Don't worry about the insulting things that have been said about me by these messengers from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Yesaia kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyakɛa nyɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, Kaashe gbeyei yɛ wiemɔi ni onu ni Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ tsuji lɛ kɛbabɔ mi ahora lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: I will upset him with rumors about what's happening in his own country. He will go back, and there I will make him die a violent death.
translation_verse: Naa, mi diɛŋtsɛ mikɛ mumɔ ko baawo emli ni aaahã enu sane ko, ni no aaahã eku esɛɛ kɛya lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni mibahã enyɔ yɛ klante naa yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.’ ” Asiria bafã Hezekia tsui ekoŋŋ (

english_verse: Meanwhile the commander of the Assyrian forces heard that his king had left the town of Lachish and was now attacking Libnah. So he went there.
translation_verse: Asiria maŋtsɛ tsulɔnukpa lɛ ku esɛɛ etee, ejaakɛ enu akɛ emaŋtsɛ lɛ eshi Lakish. Eyanina Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ ni ekɛ Libna miiwu.

english_verse: About this same time, the king of Assyria learned that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was on his way to attack him. Then the king of Assyria sent some messengers with this note for Hezekiah:
translation_verse: Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ nu akɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ kɛ Kush Maŋtsɛ Tirhaka efã kɛmiiba koni amɛkɛ lɛ abawu. Be ni enu sane nɛɛ lɛ, Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu bɔfoi kɛ wolo kɛtee Hezekia ŋɔɔ kɛ wiemɔ akɛ,

english_verse: Don't trust your God or be fooled by his promise to defend Jerusalem against me.
translation_verse: “Nyɛyakɛa Hezekia, Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ, akɛ, ‘Kaahã oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni ohiɛ kã enɔ lɛ miilaka bo akɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ yeŋ Yerusalɛm nɔ kunim.’

english_verse: You have heard how we Assyrian kings have completely wiped out other nations. What makes you feel so safe?
translation_verse: Bɛ onu nɔ ni Asiria maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ efee shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ, bɔ ni amɛkpãtãa hiɛ butuu lɛ? Ani osusuɔ akɛ abahere oyiwala?

english_verse: The Assyrian kings before me destroyed the towns of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and everyone from Eden who lived in Telassar. What good did their gods do them?
translation_verse: Majimaji lɛ ni mitsɛmɛi lɛ kpãtã amɛhiɛ lɛ, ani amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ ehere amɛyiwala? Ekomɛi ji Gozan kɛ Haran kɛ Rezef kɛ Betlehembii lɛ ni kulɛ amɛhi Telasar lɛ?

english_verse: After Hezekiah had read the note from the king of Assyria, he took it to the temple and spread it out for the Lord to see.
translation_verse: Hezekia he wolo lɛ yɛ bɔfoi lɛ adɛŋ, ni ekane, kɛkɛ ni eyiŋ kɛtee Yehowa we lɛ, ni eyagbele wolo lɛ mli efɔ̃ Yehowa hiɛ,

english_verse: Then he prayed:
translation_verse: ni esɔle ekɛɛ,

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful of Israel, your throne is above the winged creatures. You created the heavens and the earth, and you alone rule the kingdoms of this world.
translation_verse: “Ao Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ ni omaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ma kerubim anɔ, bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ hã maŋtsɛyelii fɛɛ, bo okoome pɛ obɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ.

english_verse: It is true, our Lord, that Assyrian kings have turned nations into deserts.
translation_verse: Ao Yehowa, eyɛ mli lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ ekpãtã majimaji lɛ fɛɛ kɛ amɛshikpɔji lɛ ahiɛ,

english_verse: As surely as I am the Lord, he will return by the way he came and will never enter Jerusalem.
translation_verse: He ni etsɔ̃ kɛba lɛ, jɛi nɔŋŋ eeetsɔ̃ kɛaaku esɛɛ kɛaatee; ni eboteŋ maŋ nɛɛ mli.’ Yehowa kɛɛ.

english_verse: Sennacherib, you cursed, shouted and sneered at me, the holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Namɔ ahora obɔ, ni asaŋ ojɛ lɛ lɛ? Namɔ obolɔ owo, ni ogbɛ ohiŋmɛiŋ owo lɛ lɛ? Mi, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni.

english_verse: You let your officials insult me, the Lord. And here is what you have said about yourself, “I led my chariots to the highest heights of Lebanon's mountains. I went deep into its forest, cutting down the best cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: Otsɔ̃ otsuji anɔ, ni obabɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ahora, ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mikwɔ kɛtee gɔji lɛ ayiteiaŋ, kɛtee Lebanon sɛɛ tɔ̃ɔ. Mifolɔ emli tsenedrui ni kwɔlɔ lɛ kɛ emli sɛsɛoi kpakpai ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ. Mibote ekoo ni mli ti lɛ diɛŋtsɛ mli.

english_verse: I dried up every stream in the land of Egypt, and I drank water from wells I had dug.”
translation_verse: Mitsatsaa bui, ni minu amɛmli nu, ni mikɛ minaneshi hã Ijipt shikpɔŋ nɔ fai fɛɛ tswɛm ŋala.’

english_verse: Sennacherib, now listen to me, the Lord. I planned all of this long ago. And you don't even know that I alone am the one who decided that you would do these things. I let you make ruins of fortified cities.
translation_verse: “Ani onuko kwraa akɛ mi, mito nibii nakai kɛjɛ blema beebe lo? Ni nibii ni mito kɛjɛ blema lɛ mihã eba mli agbɛnɛ nɛɛ akɛ okpãtã maji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe ahiɛ koni amɛtsɔmɔ nii ni akumɔ abua shi kuikui.

english_verse: Their people became weak, terribly confused. They were like wild flowers or like tender young grass growing on a flat roof or like a field of grain before it matures.
translation_verse: Amɛmli bii ahewalɛ eyashɛɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko; amɛtsui fã, ni amɛyoyro, ni amɛtsɔmɔ tamɔ ŋa nɔ jwɛi loo bai fɔbii ni etsɛ̃ yɛ tsu yiteŋ ni amɛdaraaa, shi amɛŋalaa oya lɛ.

english_verse: I know all about you, even how fiercely angry you are with me.
translation_verse: “Mile oshitee kɛ oshitamɔ, kɛ oyaa kɛ obaa mli fɛɛ, kɛ ogrimɔ ni ogri owo mi lɛ.

english_verse: I have seen your pride and the tremendous hatred you have for me. Now I will put a hook in your nose, a bit in your mouth, then I will send you back to where you came from.
translation_verse: Akɛni ogri owo mi, ni minu shwãa ni oshwã lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ kpoŋ baatsɛ̃rɛ ogugɔ mli, ni mikɛ mimanyoflɛ baawo odaaŋ, ni mibakpale bo kɛku osɛɛ kɛya; mikɛ bo baatsɔ̃ gbɛ ni otsɔ̃ nɔ kɛba lɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ.”

english_verse: Hezekiah, I will tell you what's going to happen. This year you will eat crops that grow on their own, and the next year you will eat whatever springs up where those crops grew. But the third year, you will plant grain and vineyards, and you will eat what you harvest.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yesaia kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Hezekia akɛ, “Nɔ ni baaba lɛ he okadi mitoɔ bo nɛɛ: afi nɛɛ mli lɛ nyɛbaaye ŋmãa ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekwɛ̃; wɔsɛɛ afi hu nakai ŋmãa nɔŋŋ nyɛaaye. Shi afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛdua nii ni nyɛkpaa, ni nyɛfea waintromii hu, ni nyɛyea amɛmli yibii.

english_verse: Those who survive in Judah will be like a vine that puts down deep roots and bears fruit.
translation_verse: Yudabii ni eshwɛ, ni ji mɛi ni eje gbele mli lɛ, baashwere tamɔ tsei ni etsɛ̃rɛ fãi kɛtee shikpɔŋ ni amɛwo yibii.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will see to it that some who live in Jerusalem will survive.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ eeeshwɛ mɛi kɛ̃ yɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni aaaje gbele mli. Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, hiɛdɔɔ lɛ baatsu enɛ.”

english_verse: I promise that the king of Assyria won't get into Jerusalem, or shoot an arrow into the city, or even surround it and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: “No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ he nɛ, ‘Ebaŋ maŋ nɛɛ mli, ni etsɛ̃ŋ gãi kome nɛkɛ tete ewoŋ mli, ni ekɛ etsɛŋ ko baŋ jɛi, ni asaŋ etswaŋ kpoku ko ewoŋ he.

english_verse: After this, King Sennacherib went back to Assyria and lived in the city of Nineveh.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Asiria Maŋtsɛ Sankerib gbala ehe shi, ni eku esɛɛ etee shĩa, ni eyahi Nineve.

english_verse: One day he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, when his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords. They escaped to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon became king.
translation_verse: Ni gbi ko pɛ ni etee ejaa yɛ enyɔŋmɔ ni egbɛi ji Nisrok we lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ ebihii, Adramelek kɛ Sharezer, kɛ klante gbe lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni ebihii nɛɛ jo foi kɛtee Ararat shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni bihii lɛ eko ni egbɛi ji Esa-Hardon lɛ baye Sankerib sɛɛ akɛ maŋtsɛ.

english_verse: Hezekiah turned toward the wall and prayed,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Hezekia tsɔ̃ ehiɛ eha gbogbo lɛ, ni esɔle ekpa Yehowa fai,

english_verse: You, Lord, will save me, and every day that we live we will sing in your temple to the music of stringed instruments. Isaiah's Advice to Hezekiah
translation_verse: Yehowa ohere miyiwala, ni no hewɔ lɛ, wɔkɛ saŋku aaala milalai lɛ, wɔwala gbii abɔ fɛɛ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ.

english_verse: About this time, Hezekiah got sick and was almost dead. So I went in and told him, “The Lord says you won't ever get well. You are going to die, and so you had better start doing what needs to be done.”
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, hela mɔ̃ Maŋtsɛ Hezekia, ni eehe egbo. Gbalɔ Yesaia, Amoz bi lɛ, tee eyasara lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Too owe lɛ he gbɛjianɔ, ejaakɛ oyi naŋ wala; obaagbo.’ ”

english_verse: I thought I would never again see you, my Lord, or any of the people who live on this earth.
translation_verse: Misusu akɛ minaŋ Yehowa dɔŋŋ yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Minaŋ gbɔmɔ adesa ko hu dɔŋŋ yɛ jeŋ.

english_verse: “Don't forget that I have been faithful to you, Lord. I have obeyed you with all my heart, and I do whatever you say is right.” After this, he cried hard.
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ao Yehowa, miikpa bo fai, kaimɔ bɔ ni misɔmɔ bo kɛ anɔkwa kɛ mitsuiŋ fɛɛ, ni mifee nɔ ni hi yɛ ohiɛ!” Kɛkɛ ni Hezekia fo blobloblo.

english_verse: Then the Lord sent me
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yesaia akɛ,

english_verse: with this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord God, who was worshiped by your ancestor David. I heard you pray, and I saw you cry. I will let you live
translation_verse: “Yaa koni oyakɛɛ Hezekia akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Yehowa, otsɛ David Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ: Minu ofaikpamɔ lɛ, ni mina oyaafo lɛ; maŋɔ afii nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ mafata owala be lɛ he.

english_verse: There's nothing I can say in answer to you, since you are the one who has done this to me. My life has turned sour; I will limp until I die.
translation_verse: Te makɛɛ tɛŋŋ? Ejaakɛ ekɛ mi ewie; ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ efee nɔ ni ba lɛ. Ehiii mi wɔɔ, ejaakɛ misusuma miiye awerɛhoo.

english_verse: while I protect you and your city from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Asaŋ mahere bo kɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ fɛɛ yiwala kɛjɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ. Ni mabu maŋ nɛɛ he.’ ”

english_verse: Now I will prove to you that I will keep my promise.
translation_verse: “Enɛ ji okadi ni tsɔ̃ɔ bo akɛ mibafee nii ni mikɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Do you see the shadow made by the setting sun on the stairway built for King Ahaz? I will make the shadow go back ten steps. Then the shadow went back ten steps. King Hezekiah's Song of Praise
translation_verse: Naa, mibahã atrakpoi lɛ asusuma ni hulu ni nyɔɔ shi hãa ebakãa atswere ni Maŋtsɛ Ahaz tswa lɛ nɔ lɛ atsi kɛya sɛɛsɛɛ nanefaamɔi nyɔŋma.” Kɛkɛ ni susuma lɛ tsi kɛtee sɛɛ nanefaamɔi nyɔŋma.

english_verse: This is what Hezekiah wrote after he got well:
translation_verse: Be ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia he eye, ni ehe ewa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, eŋma yijiemɔ lala nɛɛ:

english_verse: I thought I would die during my best years and stay as a prisoner forever in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Misusu akɛ miwala teŋ tuuŋtu lɛ, mashi kɛya gbohiiaje agboi lɛ anaa, mayaye mifii ni eshwɛ lɛ yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: My life was taken from me like the tent that a shepherd pulls up and moves. You cut me off like thread from a weaver's loom; you make a wreck of me day and night.
translation_verse: Afo miwala sɛɛ tamɔ akpaa tookwɛlɔ buu ni ashi, tamɔ mamalolɔ kotaa ni efoɔ mama nɔ yɛ mamaloo tsɔne nɔ. Gbi kome jenamɔ lɛ miwala sɛɛ efo.

english_verse: Until morning came, I thought you would crush my bones just like a hungry lion; both night and day you make a wreck of me.
translation_verse: Mifo mitsɛ yelikɛbuamɔ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ kɛyashi jetsɛremɔ. Ojwara miwui amli tamɔ jata, Ofo miwala sɛɛ gbi kome jenamɔ.

english_verse: I cry like a swallow; I mourn like a dove. My eyes are red from looking to you, Lord. I am in terrible trouble. Please come and help me.
translation_verse: Mibolɔ tamɔ nyɔŋmɔbitɛte loo kpokukpoku; miye ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ okpo. Ŋwɛikwɛmɔ sɔŋŋ hã mihiŋmɛii shiu. Ao Yehowa, efĩ mi, daamɔ mli oha mi.

english_verse: Your words and your deeds bring life to everyone, including me. Please make me healthy and strong again.
translation_verse: Ao Nuŋtsɔ, enɛɛmɛi anɔ adesai tsɔ̃ɔ amɛhiɔ shi; ni enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ amli mimumɔ yɔɔ. Ao tsa mi, ni oha miyi ana wala.

english_verse: It was for my own good that I had such hard times. But your love protected me from doom in the deep pit, and you turned your eyes away from my sins.
translation_verse: Naa, mijurɔyeli hewɔ jɛ ni mina hejaramɔ babaoo lɛ, Ojie miwala kɛje hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli, ejaakɛ osherɛ mihe eshai lɛ fɛɛ oshwie osɛɛ.

english_verse: Only the living can thank you, as I am doing today. Each generation tells the next about your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Hiɛkãalɔi hɛɛ, hiɛkãalɔi moŋ ji mɛi ni jieɔ oyi, tamɔ bɔ ni mifeɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ. Tsɛmɛi ni hãa bii leɔ onɔkwayeli lɛ.

english_verse: I had told King Hezekiah's servants to put some mashed figs on the king's open sore, and he would get well.
translation_verse: Yesaia kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Hezekia akɛ eŋɔ agbãmi ni awiɛ eto esane lɛ nɔ, ni ehe baawa lɛ,

english_verse: Then Hezekiah asked for proof that he would again worship in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ Hezekia bi Yesaia akɛ, “Mɛɛ okadi tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ manyɛ maya Yehowa we lɛ ekoŋŋ?”

english_verse: Hezekiah welcomed the messengers and showed them all the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fine oils that were in his storehouse. He even showed them where he kept his weapons. Nothing in his palace or in his entire kingdom was kept hidden from them.
translation_verse: Hezekia here tsuji lɛ atuu, ni eŋɔ amɛ kɛtee shĩa ni etoɔ ejwetri yɛ mli lɛ mli, ni ekɛ jɛi nii yatsɔ̃ɔ amɛ: jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika kɛ tsofaikɛŋmai kɛ mu ni jara wa kɛ etawuunii fɛɛ. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ enitoohei lɛ ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ. Nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ enitoohei loo enɔyelihe lɛ mli ni ekɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ amɛ.

english_verse: Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, was now king of Babylonia. And when he learned that Hezekiah was well, he sent messengers with letters and a gift for him.
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, Babilon maŋtsɛ, Merodak-Baladan, Baladan bi lɛ, tsu tsuji koni amɛkɛ woji ni eŋmala kɛ nikeenii baha Hezekia, ejaakɛ enu akɛ Maŋtsɛ Hezekia he eye, ni ehe ewa lɛ.

english_verse: I asked Hezekiah, “Where did these men come from? What did they want?” “They came all the way from Babylonia,” Hezekiah answered.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Gbalɔ Yesaia ba Maŋtsɛ Hezekia ŋɔɔ, ni ebabi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ jɛ ba oŋɔɔ nɛɛ, ni mɛɛ amaniɛ amɛkɛba?” Hezekia here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Shɔŋŋ he ko amɛjɛ amɛba miŋɔɔ nɛɛ; amɛjɛ Babilon.”

english_verse: Then I told Hezekiah: I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yesaia kɛɛ Hezekia akɛ, “Bo nɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɔ toi,

english_verse: One day everything you and your ancestors have stored up will be taken to Babylonia. The Lord has promised that nothing will be left.
translation_verse: ‘Naa gbii miiba, ni abaaloo nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ owe lɛ mli kɛ nii ni otsɛmɛi lɛ ebua naa eto kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ kɛaatee Babilon bɔ ni ashiŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko, Yehowa kɛɛ.

english_verse: Some of your own sons will be taken to Babylonia, where they will be disgraced and made to serve in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Asaŋ aaaŋɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ obii ni ooofɔ lɛ ateŋ ekomɛi kɛaatee, ni amɛaatsɔmɔ piafoi yɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli.”

english_verse: Hezekiah thought, “At least our nation will be at peace for a while.” So he told me, “The message you brought from the Lord is good.”
translation_verse: Hezekia to he ha Yesaia ekɛɛ, “Yehowa naa wiemɔ ni owie nɛɛ hi,” ejaakɛ esusu akɛ elumɔyeli be lɛ baafee shweshweeshwe kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ.

english_verse: Our God has said: “Encourage my people! Give them comfort.
translation_verse: “Nyɛshɛjea, nyɛshɛjea mimaŋ lɛ mii!” WɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ.

english_verse: Speak kindly to Jerusalem and announce: Your slavery is past; your punishment is over. I, the Lord, made you pay double for your sins.”
translation_verse: “Nyɛkɛ Yerusalɛmbii awiea tsuijurɔ naa; ni nyɛkɛa Yerusalɛmbii akɛ amɛtawuu be lɛ sɛɛ efo, ni akɛ amɛnishaianii lɛ efa. Eshai ni amɛfee lɛ amɛna he nyɔmɔwoo toi enyɔ kɛjɛ Yehowa dɛŋ.”

english_verse: Someone is shouting: “Clear a path in the desert! Make a straight road for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Gbee ko miibo akɛ, “Nyɛsaa gbɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ nyɛhãa Yehowa; nyɛjajea gbɛjegbɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ nyɛhãa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Fill in the valleys; flatten every hill and mountain. Level the rough and rugged ground.
translation_verse: Awó jɔɔ fɛɛ jɔɔ nɔ, ni aba gɔŋ fɛɛ gɔŋ shi; Ahã hei ni yɔɔ dokoidokoi lɛ afee trɛnɛɛ, ni hei ni yɔɔ gɔjigɔji lɛ afee kplanaa.

english_verse: Then the glory of the Lord will appear for all to see. The Lord has promised this!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ abaajie Yehowa anunyam kpo, ni gbɔmɛi adesai fɛɛ baana, ejaakɛ enɛ jɛ Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ naa.”

english_verse: Someone told me to shout, and I asked, “What should I shout?” We humans are merely grass, and we last no longer than wild flowers.
translation_verse: Gbee ko miibo akɛ, “bolɔmɔ!” Ni mikɛɛ, “Te mibolɔ mikɛɛ tɛŋŋ?” “Bolɔmɔ akɛ heloo fɛɛ heloo lɛ jwɛi ni; ni ehoɔ eyaa tamɔ ŋa nɔ fɔfɔi.

english_verse: At the Lord's command, flowers and grass disappear, and so do we.
translation_verse: Jwɛi gbiɔ, ni fɔfɔi hu kpalaa kɛji Yehowa hã kɔɔyɔɔ tswa kɛtsɔ̃ nɔ. Eji anɔkwale akɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ lɛ jwɛi ni.

english_verse: Flowers and grass fade away, but what our God has said will never change. Your God Is Here!
translation_verse: Jwɛi gbiɔ, ni fɔfɔi hu kpalaa shi wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ.”

english_verse: There is good news for the city of Zion. Shout it as loud as you can from the highest mountain. Don't be afraid to shout to the towns of Judah: “Your God is here!”
translation_verse: Ao Zion, miishɛɛ saneshiɛlɔ, kwɔɔ kɛya gɔŋ ni kwɔ ko nɔ. Yerusalɛm, miishɛɛ saneshiɛlɔ, wo ogbee nɔ kɛ hewalɛ, wo nɔ, kaashe gbeyei! Kɛɛmɔ Yuda maji lɛ akɛ “Naa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ miiba!”

english_verse: Look! The powerful Lord God is coming to rule with his mighty arm. He brings with him what he has taken in war, and he rewards his people.
translation_verse: Naa, Nuŋtsɔ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ miibaa kɛ hewalɛ, ni eeeye nɔ kɛ nineshiwalɛ. Mɛi fɛɛ ni ehere amɛyiwala lɛ nyiɛ ehiɛ kɛmiiba.

english_verse: The Lord cares for his nation, just as shepherds care for their flocks. He carries the lambs in his arms, while gently leading the mother sheep. Who Compares with God?
translation_verse: Eeelɛ etooku lɛ tamɔ tookwɛlɔ; eeehiɛ etoobii lɛ yɛ ekpɔkɔiaŋ; Eeeloo amɛ eshãkã etsitsiŋ ni eeekpala toonyɛmɛi lɛ blɛoo. Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ saso bɛ

english_verse: Did any of you measure the ocean by yourself or stretch out the sky with your own hands? Did you put the soil of the earth in a bucket or weigh the hills and mountains on balance scales?
translation_verse: Namɔ kɛ edɛ̃ kɔkɔ esusu ŋshɔ falɛ pɛŋ; ni ekɛ edɛ̃lɛɛmɔ esusu ŋwɛi dã? Namɔ kɛ nikaakpolu eka shikpɔŋ su pɛŋ, ni eŋmɛ gɔji lɛ kɛ ŋmeŋmei lɛ yɛ nsɛni mli dã?

english_verse: Has anyone told the Lord what he must do or given him advice?
translation_verse: Namɔ etsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ bɔ ni efee dã, loo namɔ etsɔ̃ eŋaawolɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nii dã?

english_verse: Did the Lord ask anyone to teach him wisdom and justice? Who gave him knowledge and understanding?
translation_verse: Namɔ Yehowa kɛtoɔ ajina bɔ ni afee ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nii, ni namɔ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ jalɛ saneyeli? Namɔ etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nilee pɛŋ; namɔ etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ dã?

english_verse: To the Lord, all nations are merely a drop in a bucket or dust on balance scales; all of the islands are but a handful of sand.
translation_verse: Naa, majimaji lɛ tete tamɔ nu kɔi kome yɛ goga mli ha Yehowa, ebuɔ amɛ tamɔ nsɛni he mlu. Ŋshɔkpɔi lɛ tamɔ mlu kulibii yɛ ehiɛ.

english_verse: The cattle on the mountains of Lebanon would not be enough to offer as a sacrifice to God, and the trees would not be enough for the fire.
translation_verse: Lebanon kooloi lɛ afalɛ lɛ efaaa ha shãa afɔle, ni emli tsei shɛɛɛ lai ni akɛshãa afɔle.

english_verse: Who compares with God? Is anything like him?
translation_verse: Belɛ namɔ nyɛkɛaato Nyɔŋmɔ he, ni mɛni yɔɔ su ni tamɔ esu?

english_verse: Is an idol at all like God? It is made of bronze with a thin layer of gold, and decorated with silver.
translation_verse: Amãgã? No lɛ ŋaalɔ ni shwieɔ, ni shikaŋaalɔ kɛ shika haa he; ni esɔ̃ɔ jwiɛtɛi kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi ewoɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Or special wood may be chosen because it doesn't rot— then skilled hands take care to make an idol that won't fall on its face. God Rules the Whole Earth
translation_verse: Mɔ ni bɛ jwiɛtɛi loo shika lɛ, eŋɔɔ tso ni wa, ni etaoɔ ŋaalɔ ni he esa, ni egbɔɔ amãgã ni nyɛɛɛ ehe etsi.

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? Hasn't it been clear since the time of creation?
translation_verse: Ani nyɛleee? Ani nyɛnuko dã? Ani agbako nyɛ je lɛ shishijee sane? Ani nyɛnuko bɔ ni ato eshishi ahã?

english_verse: God is the one who rules the whole earth, and we that live here are merely insects. He spread out the heavens like a curtain or an open tent.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni ta emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ yɛ je lɛ yiteŋ, yɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ ni enaa je lɛ mli gbɔmɛi tamɔ agãi pɛ lɛ, lɛ efee, mɔ ni kpa ŋwɛi mli eha shi tamɔ muhɔɔ, ni elɛɛ ŋwɛi mli tamɔ buu ni ahiɔ mli lɛ.

english_verse: God brings down rulers and turns them into nothing.
translation_verse: Lɛ ehãa lumɛi feɔ shwɛm, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɔyelɔi lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ yaka nɔ ko.

english_verse: They are like flowers freshly sprung up and starting to grow. But when God blows on them, they wilt and are carried off like straw in a storm.
translation_verse: Amrɔ pɛ ni aaatɛo amɛ, amrɔ pɛ ni aaadu amɛ, amrɔ pɛ ni amɛaatsɛ̃ fã yɛ su mli lɛ, Yehowa tswaa kɔɔyɔɔ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛnɔ, ni amɛŋalaa, ni ahum loɔ amɛ kɛyaa tamɔ tutuu.

english_verse: The holy God asks, “Who compares with me? Is anyone my equal?”
translation_verse: Namɔ nyɛkɛaato mi mihe, ni ekɛ mi aaaye egbɔ? Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ.

english_verse: Look at the evening sky! Who created the stars? Who gave them each a name? Who leads them like an army? The Lord is so powerful that none of the stars are ever missing. The Lord Gives Strength
translation_verse: Nyɛwoa nyɛhiɛ nɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi ni nyɛkwɛa! Namɔ bɔ ŋulamii nɛɛ? Lɛ mɔ ni ejieɔ amɛsafoi lɛ kpo, ni ekaneɔ amɛyibɔ, ni ewoɔ amɛ fɛɛ gbɛi lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni fee. Ehewalɛ kpele kɛ enyɛmɔ naa lɛ, amɛteŋ ekome folo nɛkɛ elaajeee.

english_verse: You people of Israel say, “God pays no attention to us! He doesn't care if we are treated unjustly.” But how can you say that?
translation_verse: Ao Israel, mɛɛba okɛɔ akɛ, “Yehowa leee mihaomɔi, ni miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kwɛɛɛ koni aye mi jalɛ sane” lɛ?

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? The Lord is the eternal God, Creator of the earth. He never gets weary or tired; his wisdom cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Ani oleee? Ani onuko dã Yehowa ji naanɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, jeŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ bɔlɔ lɛ. Etɔɔɔ lɛ, ni egbɔjɔɔɔ hu, ni aleee ejwɛŋmɔ mlikwɔlɛ.

english_verse: The Lord gives strength to those who are weary.
translation_verse: Ehãa mɔ ni egbɔjɔ naa hewalɛ, ni mɔ ni bɛ nyɛmɔ lɛ, ehãa lɛ nyɛmɔ ni mli wa.

english_verse: Even young people get tired, then stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Oblahii bibii aaagbɔjɔ, ni eeetɔ amɛ; ni oblahii ni edara saŋŋ tete aaagbeegbee shi, ni amɛaafee bliboo.

english_verse: But those who trust the Lord will find new strength. They will be strong like eagles soaring upward on wings; they will walk and run without getting tired.
translation_verse: Shi mɛi ni hiɛ kã Yehowa nɔ lɛ, amɛaana hewalɛ hee: amɛaafliki tamɔ okropɔŋ amɛaajo foi, ni etɔŋ amɛ amɛaanyiɛ hu, ni amɛgbɔjɔŋ.

english_verse: Be silent and listen, every island in the sea. Have courage and come near, every one of you nations. Let's settle this matter!
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ: “Ao nyɛ ŋshɔnaa maji ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ, nyɛfea diŋŋ, nyɛboa mi toi! Majimaji anɔ bii ana hewalɛ hee! Hã amɛtsi amɛbɛŋkɛ koni amɛwie amɛsane lɛ. Nyɛhãa wɔ fɛɛ wɔkpea koni wɔkojoa!

english_verse: Who appointed this ruler from the east? Who puts nations and kings in his power? His sword and his arrows turn them to dust blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Namɔ ji mɔ ni tee mɔ ko shi kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ, mɔ ni yeɔ kunim yɛ he fɛɛ he ni eyaa lɛ? Namɔ hãa eyeɔ maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ majimaji anɔ lɛ? Ekɛ eklante lɛ hãa amɛtsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ mlu, ni egãi lɛ gbɛɔ amɛ eshwãa tamɔ tutuu yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ hiɛ.

english_verse: He goes after them so quickly that his feet barely touch the ground— he doesn't even get hurt.
translation_verse: Enyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ, ni ehoɔ amɛhe shweshweeshwe ni enane esaaa shikpɔŋ tete.

english_verse: Who makes these things happen? Who controls human events? I do! I am the Lord. I was there at the beginning; I will be there at the end.
translation_verse: Namɔ tsu enɛ, ni namɔ fee enɛ? Namɔ tsɛɔ yinɔbii kɛjɛɔ jeŋ shishitoohe tɔ̃ɔ? Mi, Yehowa, mi ji klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ; ni mi, Yehowa, mi kɛ naagbee mɔ aaafee naagbelɔ.

english_verse: Islands and foreign nations saw what I did and trembled as they came near. What Can Idols Do?
translation_verse: Ŋshɔnaa maji lɛ ena, ni amɛmiishe gbeyei! Shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei lɛ miikpokpo! Amɛtsi amɛbɛŋkɛ, ni amɛba.

english_verse: Worshipers of idols comfort each other, saying, “Don't worry!”
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miiye miibua enaanyo. Amɛmiikɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Na tsui.’

english_verse: Woodcarvers, goldsmiths, and other workers encourage one another and say, “We've done a great job!” Then they nail the idol down, so it won't fall over. The Lord's Chosen Servant
translation_verse: Kapintafonyo woɔ shikaŋaalɔ ekãa, ni mɔ ni kɛ hamle jajeɔ nii ahiɛ lɛ hu feɔ mɔ ni tswiaa nii yɛ sɔ̃ŋmɛtɛ nɔ nakai nɔŋŋ. Ekɛɔ yɛ nii ni asɔ̃ɔ lɛ he akɛ ‘Ehi!’ Ni amɛkalaa mli plɛkoo koni ekakpɔ!

english_verse: Israel, you are my servant. I chose you, the family of my friend Abraham.
translation_verse: Shi bo Israel, mitsulɔ Yakob, mishieŋtsɛ Abraham shwie, ni miŋɔ bo;

english_verse: From far across the earth I brought you here and said, “You are my chosen servant. I haven't forgotten you.”
translation_verse: bo ni miŋɔ bo kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei kɛba, bo ni mitsɛ bo kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ koji shɔŋŋ, ni mikɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Mitsulɔ ji bo, miŋɔ bo; ni mishɛŋ bo mifɔŋ.’

english_verse: Don't be afraid. I am with you. Don't tremble with fear. I am your God. I will make you strong, as I protect you with my arm and give you victories.
translation_verse: Kaashe gbeyei, shi mi mi kɛ bo yɔɔ; kaakwɛkwɛɛ ohe ejaakɛ mi ji oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ!” Mibawaje bo, mibaye mabua bo; mibahiɛ omli kɛ mikunimyeli ninejurɔ lɛ!

english_verse: Everyone who hates you will be terribly disgraced; those who attack will vanish into thin air.
translation_verse: “Naa, mɛi fɛɛ ni mli efu bo lɛ, ahiɛ aaagboi, ni amɛhiɛ aaashwie shi! Mɛi ni kɛ bo tswaa lɛ, aaafee shwɛm, ni amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã.
