english_verse: You will look around for those brutal enemies, but you won't find them— they will be gone.
translation_verse: Obaatao mɛi ni kɛ bo ena lɛ, shi onaŋ amɛ; mɛi ni kɛ bo wuɔ lɛ aaafee shwɛm.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I am holding your hand, so don't be afraid. I am here to help you.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mihiɛ oninejurɔ mli. Mi, mikɛɔ bo akɛ, ‘Kaashe gbeyei, mibaye mabua bo lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: People of Israel, don't worry, though others may say, “Israel is only a worm!” I am the holy God of Israel, who saves and protects you.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei, bo gɔgɔmi Yakob! Kaashe gbeyei, bo Israel, gɔgɔmi bibioo! Miikɛɛ bo akɛ maye mabua bo! Okpɔlɔ lɛ ji Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I will let you be like a log covered with sharp spikes. You will grind and crush every mountain and hill until they turn to dust.
translation_verse: Naa, mibafee bo gbɛlɛmɔ tsɔne kɛ enyanyɔji hei ni naa ba; ni obaagbɛlɛ gɔji lɛ, ni oooshimɔ amɛ muɛmuɛ, ooohã gɔŋkpɔi lɛ atsɔ̃ tamɔ tutuu.

english_verse: A strong wind will scatter them in all directions. Then you will celebrate and praise me, your Lord, the holy God of Israel. The Lord Helps the Poor
translation_verse: Ooosha amɛmli ni kɔɔyɔɔ aaaloo amɛ kɛaatee, ni ahum aaagbɛ amɛ ashwã. Shi bo lɛ, omii aaashɛ ohe yɛ Yehowa hewɔ, ni oooshwã ofɔ̃ Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: When the poor and needy are dying of thirst and cannot find water, I, the Lord God of Israel, will come to their rescue. I won't forget them.
translation_verse: “Kɛji ohiafoi kɛ mɛi ni efi amɛ ye nu he kumai, shi nu bɛ, ni amɛlilɛii anɔ gbi kɛ kumai lɛ, Mi, Yehowa, mibabo amɛ toi, kɛji amɛtsɛ mi. Mi, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mikwaŋ amɛ.

english_verse: I will make rivers flow on mountain peaks. I will send streams to fill the valleys. Dry and barren land will flow with springs and become a lake.
translation_verse: Mibahã fai aho yɛ gɔŋ kpataai anɔ, ni nuhiŋmɛii baatsɛ̃rɛ yɛ nujɔi lɛ amli, Mahã kpaakpo abua shi yɛ shiaŋa lɛ mli, ni nu baaho yɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ.

english_verse: I will fill the desert with all kinds of trees— cedars, acacias, and myrtles; olive and cypress trees; fir trees and pines.
translation_verse: Mahã tsenedru kɛ yɔɔyi kɛ mirtotsei kɛ mu tso akwɛ̃ yɛ shiaŋa nɔ. Mibatɛo sɛsɛo kɛ papao kɛ wawa koni amɛtsɔ̃ koo yɛ shiaŋa nɔ.

english_verse: Everyone will see this and know that I, the holy Lord God of Israel, created it all. Idols Are Useless
translation_verse: Ni mɛi baana, ni amɛaasusu he, ni amɛaanu shishi, ni amɛaale akɛ Yehowa ninenaa nitsumɔ ni, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ji mɔ ni fee.” Yehowa tswa amale nyɔŋmɔi lɛ mpoa

english_verse: I am the Lord, the King of Israel! Come argue your case with me. Present your evidence.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ nyɛsane lɛ abaa, nyɛ jemawɔji!” Yakob Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ, “Nyɛkɛ nyɛklamɔ nibii lɛ abaa

english_verse: Come near me, you idols. Tell us about the past, and we will think about it. Tell us about the future, so we will know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: koni amɛgba nɔ ni baaba amɛtsɔ̃ɔ wɔ. Nyɛtsɔ̃a wɔ blema nibii lɛ, nɔ ni amɛ ji, koni wɔsusu he, koni wɔle nɔ ni baajɛ mli aba, aloo nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛgbaa wɔ nibii ni baaba lɛ.

english_verse: Prove that you are gods by making your predictions come true. Do something good or evil, so we can be amazed and terrified.
translation_verse: Nyɛtsɔ̃a wɔ wɔsɛɛ nibii ni baaba koni wɔkɛna wɔle akɛ nyɔŋmɔi ji nyɛ. Nyɛfea nɔ kpakpa loo nɔ fɔŋ ko koni wɔtsui afã ni wɔshe gbeyei.

english_verse: You idols are nothing, and you are powerless. To worship you would be disgusting.
translation_verse: Naa, nyɛjeee nɔ ko nɔ ko ni nyɛnitsumɔ lɛ hu jeee fɛifɛi. Mɔ ni jaa nyɛ lɛ, musubɔlɔ ni.

english_verse: I, the Lord, appointed a ruler in the north; now he comes from the east to honor my name. He tramples kings like mud, as potters trample clay.
translation_verse: “Mitee mɔ ko shi kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ, ni eeba; eeeja mi kɛjɛ hulu shitee mli, ni eeenaa nɔyelɔi anɔ tamɔ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ naa su.

english_verse: Did any of you idols predict what would happen? Did any of you get it right? None of you told about this or even spoke a word.
translation_verse: Namɔ gba kɛjɛ shishijee mli koni wɔle? Ni namɔ tsɔ̃ hiɛ egba dani eba mli, koni wɔkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Ewiemɔ lɛ ja.’ Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni lɛ ekɛɛ; mɔ ko kwraa ejajeko nɔ ko; mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni nuɔ nyɛwiemɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I was the first to tell the people of Jerusalem, “Look, it's happening!” I was the one who announced this good news to Zion.
translation_verse: Mi tsuutsu mikɛɛ Zion akɛ, “Mitsu bɔfo kɛ sane kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ kɛtee Yerusalɛm akɛ ebii miiba.

english_verse: They are nothing, and they can do nothing— they are merely a passing breeze.
translation_verse: Naa, nyɔŋmɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, lakamɔnii ni; amɛnitsumɔi lɛ hu jeee fɛifɛi, ni amɛmãgãi lɛ hu kɔɔyɔɔ folo ni.”

english_verse: Here is my servant! I have made him strong. He is my chosen one; I am pleased with him. I have given him my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa mitsulɔ, mɔ ni mihiɛ emli, mɔ ni miŋɔ lɛ, ni minaa ehe tsuijurɔ lɛ. Mihã eyi obɔ̃ kɛ mimumɔ lɛ, Ebaahã majimaji lɛ ale nɔ ni ji jalɛ saneyeli.

english_verse: He won't shout or yell or call out in the streets.
translation_verse: Ebolɔŋ, ni ewoŋ egbee nɔ, ni ehaŋ anu egbee yɛ blohuiaŋ.

english_verse: He won't break off a bent reed or put out a dying flame, but he will make sure that justice is done.
translation_verse: Glã ni edɔ lɛ, ekuŋ, ni kane ni tsoɔ sulii lɛ, egbeŋ; eeejie jalɛ kpo anɔkwayeli mli.

english_verse: He won't quit or give up until he brings justice everywhere on earth, and people in foreign nations long for his teaching.
translation_verse: Enitsumɔ naa baŋ shi, ni enijiaŋ ejeŋ wui kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni eeehã jalɛ saneyeli amã shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Ŋshɔnaa maji lɛ miikwɛ emla gbɛ.”

english_verse: I am the Lord God. I created the heavens like an open tent above. I made the earth and everything that grows on it. I am the source of life for all who live on this earth, so listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni ji Yehowa lɛ, mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi, ni ekpã mli, mɔ ni bɔ shikpɔŋ elɛɛ shi, kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ, mɔ ni hãa mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ mumɔ, kɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ nɔ lɛ wala lɛ kɛɛ nɛ,

english_verse: I chose you to bring justice, and I am here at your side. I selected you and sent you to bring light and my promise of hope to the nations.
translation_verse: “Mi ji Yehowa; mi mitsɛ bo yɛ jalɛ naa. Mimɔ onine mli, ni mibaa oyi; miŋɔ bo mifee kpãŋmɔ mihã maŋ lɛ kɛ la hã majimaji lɛ,

english_verse: You will give sight to the blind; you will set prisoners free from dark dungeons.
translation_verse: koni ogbele shwilafoi ahiŋmɛii, ni ojie gboklɛfoi yɛ gboklɛfoi atsuŋ; koni ojie gboklɛfoi ni tara kpabuŋ duŋ mli lɛ.

english_verse: My name is the Lord! I won't let idols or humans share my glory and praise.
translation_verse: “Mi, mi ji Yehowa, migbɛi ji no; mikɛ minunyam haŋ mɔ kroko, ni mikɛ miyijiemɔ haŋ amãgãi.

english_verse: Everything has happened just as I said it would; now I will announce what will happen next. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: Naa, tsuutsunii ni migba lɛ eba mli; agbɛnɛ nii hee mikɛɔ nyɛ nɛɛ; miikɛɛ nyɛ dani eba mli.” Yijiemɔ Lala

english_verse: Tell the whole world to sing a new song to the Lord! Tell those who sail the ocean and those who live far away to join in the praise.
translation_verse: Nyɛlaa lala hee nyɛhãa Yehowa; nyɛlaa nyɛkɛjiea eyi kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei lɛ! Nyɛjiea eyi, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛnyiɛɔ ŋshɔ hiɛ; nyɛjiea eyi, nyɛ ŋshɔ mli bɔɔnii fɛɛ! Nyɛlaa, nyɛ ŋshɔ naa shikpɔji, ni nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyɔɔ ŋshɔ naa shikpɔji lɛ anɔ hu, nyɛjiea eyi!

english_verse: The Lord is marching out like an angry soldier, shouting with all his might while attacking his enemies. The Lord Will Help His People
translation_verse: Yehowa efã tamɔ tabilɔ; etee emlifu shi tamɔ kãkãlɔ. Eebo waa; eebɔ oshe! Eetsɔ̃ɔ ehenyɛlɔi lɛ ehewalɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ wo shi akɛ ebaaye ebua ewebii

english_verse: For a long time, I, the Lord, have held my temper; now I will cry out and groan like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Mimua minaa be kplaŋŋ nɛ, mifee dioo; migbe mitsui. Shi agbɛnɛ mibabolɔ tamɔ yoo ni miikɔmɔ; mamu kɛ tsuisuu, mimumɔ shiŋ shi.

english_verse: I will destroy the mountains and what grows on them; I will dry up rivers and ponds.
translation_verse: Makpãtã gɔji kɛ gɔŋkpɔi ahiɛ, ni mahã amɛnɔ jwɛi fɛɛ agbi, mahã fai atsɔ̃mɔ faakpɔi, ni mahã kpaakpoi hu amii.

english_verse: I will lead the blind on roads they have never known; I will guide them on paths they have never traveled. Their road is dark and rough, but I will give light to keep them from stumbling. This is my solemn promise.
translation_verse: Ni makpala shwilafoi kɛtsɔ̃ tɛmpɔŋi ni amɛtsɔ̃ko nɔ dã nɔ; mabu amɛhe kɛtsɔ̃ nanegbɛ ni aleee nɔ. Mahã amɛhiɛ duŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ la, ni hei ni yɔɔ dokoidokoi lɛ afee trɛnɛɛ. Nii nɛɛ mafee mahã amɛ, ni mikwaŋ amɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who worships idols as though they were gods will be terribly ashamed. God's People Won't Obey
translation_verse: Shi mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔɔ amãgãi anɔ, ni amɛkɛɔ amãgãi ni ashwie lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ ji wɔnyɔŋmɔi lɛ,” aaashwie amɛ kɛku amɛsɛɛ, ni amɛhiɛ aaagboi. Israel nyɛɛɛ nii ekase

english_verse: You people are deaf and blind, but the Lord commands you to listen and to see.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ toimulɔi, nyɛboa toi! Ni nyɛ shwilafoi, nyɛwoa nyɛhiɛ nɔ koni nyɛna nii!

english_verse: who sees and hears so much, but pays no attention.
translation_verse: Israel, ona nibii babaoo, shi otɛ̃jeee ohiɛ okwɛɛɛ amɛ. Otoii anaa kã nɛ, shi onuuu nii.”

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and so he wanted his Law to be greatly praised.
translation_verse: Esa Yehowa hiɛ, yɛ ejalɛ lɛ hewɔ akɛ egbala mla lɛ mli koni ehã mla lɛ hiɛ aba nyam.

english_verse: But his people were trapped and imprisoned in holes with no one to rescue them. All they owned had been taken, and no one was willing to give it back.
translation_verse: Shi emaŋbii lɛ aju amɛ, ni aha amɛ, ni amɔmɔ amɛ awo bui amli, ni aŋɔ amɛ atee gboklɛfoi atsuiaŋ; amɔmɔ amɛ ni jielɔ ko bɛ he ko ni mɔ ko hu bɛ ni kɛɔ akɛ, “Akɛ amɛnii ni aha lɛ ahã amɛ”.

english_verse: Why won't his people ever learn to listen?
translation_verse: Nyɛteŋ namɔ baabo enɛ toi, namɔ eka etoi koni enu nii ni baaba lɛ?

english_verse: Israel sinned and refused to obey the Lord or follow his instructions. So the Lord let us be robbed of everything we owned.
translation_verse: Namɔ ŋɔ Israel ehã nihalɔ lɛ; ni namɔ ŋɔ Yakob ehã ojotswalɔi lɛ? Ani jeee Yehowa? Mɔ ni wɔfee esha wɔshi lɛ, mɔ ni wɔkpɛ̃lɛɛɛ egbɛi lɛ anɔ nyiɛmɔ, ni wɔbooo emla lɛ toi lɛ ni?

english_verse: He was furious with us and punished our nation with the fires of war. Still we paid no attention. We didn't even care when we were surrounded and scorched by flames.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, efɔse emlifu ni naa wa lɛ eshwie wɔnɔ, ni ehã wɔna ta joomɔ. Eshɛre la ewo wɔhe kpula, shi wɔnuuu shishi, eshã wɔ, shi no gbaaa wɔnaa.

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I, the Lord, created you and formed your nation. Israel, don't be afraid. I have rescued you. I have called you by name; now you belong to me.
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ Yakob, bɔ ni Yehowa mɔ ni bɔ bo lɛ kɛɛ nɛ. Ao Israel, bɔ ni mɔ ni shɔ̃ bo lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei ejaakɛ makpɔ̃ bo. Mikɛ ogbɛi etsɛ bo; mi, minɔ ji bo!

english_verse: When you cross deep rivers, I will be with you, and you won't drown. When you walk through fire, you won't be burned or scorched by the flames.
translation_verse: Kɛji oofo faa ni mli kwɔ lɛ, mikɛ bo yɛ; ni oofo faa hu nu lɛ esuŋ bo; Kɛji onyiɛ la mli lɛ, eshaŋ bo, ni lalilɛi lɛ kpãtãŋ ohiɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your God, the Holy One of Israel, the God who saves you. I gave up Egypt, Ethiopia, and the region of Seba in exchange for you.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, oYiwalaherelɔ lɛ. Miŋɔ Ijipt miha akɛ okpɔmɔnii; miŋɔ Kush kɛ Sheba miha mikɛtsake bo.

english_verse: To me, you are very dear, and I love you. That's why I gave up nations and people to rescue you.
translation_verse: Akɛni ojara wa ha mi, ni ohiɛ yɛ nyam, ni misumɔɔ osane hewɔ lɛ, maŋɔ gbɔmɛi maha yɛ onajiaŋ ni maŋɔ majimaji maha kɛtsake bo.

english_verse: Don't be afraid! I am with you. From both east and west I will bring you together.
translation_verse: Kaashe gbeyei, ejaakɛ mi mikɛ bo yɔɔ. Maŋɔ oshwiei kɛaajɛ bokã kɛba, ni mabua onaa kɛaajɛ anai.

english_verse: I will say to the north and to the south, “Free my sons and daughters! Let them return from distant lands.
translation_verse: Makɛɛ kooyigbɛ akɛ, ‘Ŋmɛɛmɔ amɛhe!’ Ni makɛɛ wuoyigbɛ akɛ, ‘Kaatsi amɛnaa;’ ŋɔɔ mibihii lɛ kɛjɛ shɔŋŋ kɛ mibiyei lɛ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei kɛba,

english_verse: They are my people— I created each of them to bring honor to me.” The Lord Alone Is God The Lord said:
translation_verse: mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aŋɔ mi, migbɛi awo lɛ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mi, mibɔ lɛ, koni ehã mihiɛ aba nyam lɛ.” Israel ji Yehowa odasefonyo

english_verse: Bring my people together. They have eyes and ears, but they can't see or hear.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, “Tsɛ mimaŋbii lɛ kɛba kojomɔ. Amɛyɛ hiŋmɛii shi amɛnaaa nii; amɛyɛ toii, shi amɛnuuu nii.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation to gather around. None of them can honestly say, “We told you so!” If someone heard them say this, then tell us about it now.
translation_verse: Ha majimaji fɛɛ naa abakpe ni gbɔmɛi fɛɛ abua amɛhe naa. Te amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni aaanyɛ agba nɔ ni baa hu? Te amɛteŋ nɔ ni tsɔ̃ hiɛ egba nɔ ni yaa nɔ amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ? Amɛhã amɛdasefoi lɛ aba amɛbatsɔ̃ɔ koni abu amɛ bem; asaŋ amɛbaye odase akɛ amɛwiemɔ lɛ eba mli anɔkwaleŋ.”

english_verse: My people, you are my witnesses and my chosen servant. I want you to know me, to trust me, and understand that I alone am God. I have always been God; there can be no others.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Israelbii, nyɛ ji midasefoi, mɛi ni miŋɔ akɛ mitsuji koni nyɛle mi ni nyɛhe mi nyɛye, ni nyɛnu shishi akɛ, mi, mi koome ji Nyɔŋmɔ. Mi, misɛɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ko Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ; eko bako dã ni ekoeko baŋ hu.

english_verse: I alone am the Lord; only I can rescue you.
translation_verse: “Mi, mi nɔŋŋ mi ji Yehowa lɛ, ni misɛɛ lɛ yiwalaherelɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: I promised to save you, and I kept my promise. You are my witnesses that no other god did this. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mikɛɛ nɔ ni baaba mito, ni mibahere nyɛyiwala Maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko efeko nakai dã; nyɛ ji midasefoi.”

english_verse: I am God now and forever. No one can snatch you from me or stand in my way. The Lord Will Prepare the Way
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ mi ni. Mɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ ashɔ̃ mɔ ko yɛ midɛŋ. Kɛji miifee nɔ ko lɛ, namɔ aaanyɛ naa atsi?” Israel je Babilon dɛŋ

english_verse: I, the Lord, will rescue you! I am Israel's holy God, and this is my promise: For your sake, I will send an army against Babylon to drag its people away, crying as they go.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Kpɔlɔ, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Nyɛ, nyɛhewɔ lɛ, mibatsu ta kɛya koni eyatua Babilon. Mibakumɔ amɛgboi lɛ fɛɛ mashwie shi, ni Babilonbii anyamɔ lɛ baatsɔ̃ awerɛhoo.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your holy God, Israel's Creator and King.
translation_verse: Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛMɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nyɛMaŋtsɛ, mɔ ni bɔ Israel lɛ.”

english_verse: I am the one who cut a path through the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Be ko lɛ Yehowa gba gbɛ kɛtsɔ̃ ŋshɔ lɛ mli; egba tɛmpɔŋ kɛtsɔ̃ nu hamahama mli.

english_verse: I sent an army to chase you with chariots and horses; now they lie dead, unable to move. They are like an oil lamp with the flame snuffed out. Forget the Past The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ekpala ta kpele kɛtee hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli, tawuu shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔi babaoo. Amɛjwere shi, amɛnyɛŋ shi amɛte dɔŋŋ; amɛgboi tamɔ kane mli odonti.”

english_verse: Forget what happened long ago! Don't think about the past.
translation_verse: Shi Yehowa kɛɛ, “Nyɛjiea nyɛjwɛŋmɔ yɛ tsutsu saji lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛkahiɛa blema nibii lɛ amli.

english_verse: I am creating something new. There it is! Do you see it? I have put roads in deserts, streams in thirsty lands.
translation_verse: Naa, mibafee nɔ ko hee ko. Amrɔ nɛɛ po epue. Aso nyɛnaaa lo? Mibaje gbɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ mli, ni mahã faa atue yɛ shiaŋa lɛ mli.

english_verse: Every wild animal honors me, even jackals and owls. I provide water in deserts— streams in thirsty lands for my chosen people.
translation_verse: Ŋaŋkooloi tete aaawo mihiɛ nyam, ŋaŋ gbei kɛ okpɔŋɔ loofɔji fɛɛ, ejaakɛ mahã nu aba ŋa lɛ nɔ; ni fai hu baatue yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, koni mimaŋ, mɛi ni mihala lɛ, ana nu amɛnu.

english_verse: I made them my own nation, so they would praise me.
translation_verse: Koni mɛi ni mibɔ mihã mihe lɛ ajie miyi.” Israel fee esha

english_verse: I, the Lord, said to Israel: You have become weary of me, but not from worshiping me.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Israel, ojaaa mi! Israel, ogbaaa ohe naa yɛ mihe!

english_verse: You have not honored me by sacrificing sheep or other animals. And I have not burdened you with demands for sacrifices or sweet-smelling incense.
translation_verse: Okɛ otoo lɛ ebahãaa mi koni akɛshã shãaafɔle; ni okɛ oshãa afɔlei lɛ wooo mihiɛ nyam. Mikɛ niyenii afɔle gbako onaa, ni mihãaa etɔ bo kɛ krɔbɔohamɔ.

english_verse: You have not brought delicious spices for me or given me the best part of your sacrificed animals. Instead, you burden me down with your terrible sins.
translation_verse: Okɛ oshika heee tsofakɛŋma obahãaa mi; ni okɛ okooloi amli fɔ lɛ ebashɛjeee mimii. Moŋ okɛ ohe eshai lɛ ehao mi, ni okɛ onishaianii lɛ eha etɔ mi.”

english_verse: But I wipe away your sins because of who I am. And so, I will forget the wrongs you have done.
translation_verse: “Kɛ̃lɛ mi, mi nɔŋŋ ji mɔ ni ŋɔɔ ohe eshai lɛ efaa, yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihewɔ, ni mikaiŋ ohe eshai lɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Meet me in court! State your case and prove that you are right.
translation_verse: Kaimɔ mi. Ha ni wɔkojo. Jajemɔ osane lɛ akɛ aaabu bo bem lo!

english_verse: Your earliest ancestor and all your leaders rebelled against me.
translation_verse: Oklɛŋklɛŋ tsɛ fee esha, ni mɛi ni damɔɔ mli hãa bo lɛ tɔ̃ minɔ.

english_verse: That's why I don't allow your priests to serve me; I let Israel be destroyed and your people disgraced.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mibule He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli lumɛi lɛ. Mikɛ Israel hã ni akpãtã ehiɛ, Israel he guɔ gbo.”

english_verse: People of Israel, I have chosen you as my servant.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Ao mitsulɔ Israel, Yakob shwiei, miwebii ni mihala, nyɛboa toi agbɛnɛ.

english_verse: I am your Creator. You were in my care even before you were born. Israel, don't be terrified! You are my chosen servant, my very favorite.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa mɔ ni bɔ bo, mɔ hu ni shɔ̃ bo yɛ onyɛ musuŋ beebe, ni ebaaye ebua bo lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, Kaashe gbeyei, mitsulɔ Yakob, miwebii ni mihala, ni misumɔɔ,

english_verse: I will bless the thirsty land by sending streams of water; I will bless your descendants by giving them my Spirit.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mibanɛ nu mashwie shikpɔŋ ni yeɔ nu kumai nɔ, ni mahã fai atue yɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ lɛ nɔ. Mahã oshwiei ayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ mimumɔ lɛ, ni mijɔɔmɔ aaahi oshwiei anɔ.

english_verse: They will spring up like grass or like willow trees near flowing streams.
translation_verse: Amɛaakwɛ̃ tamɔ jwɛi ni ena nu, tamɔ faa toi ŋɔi.

english_verse: They will worship me and become my people. They will write my name on the back of their hands.
translation_verse: Mɔnɛ baakɛɛ mɔnɛ akɛ, ‘Yehowa nɔ ji mi;’ ni mɔ kroko aaaŋɔ Yehowa gbɛi awo ehe, ni mɔ ko hu aaaŋma yɛ enine he akɛ, ‘Yehowa nɔ nɛ’, ni eeeŋɔ Yehowa gbɛi ewo ehe.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the first and the last, the one and only God. Israel, I have rescued you! I am your King.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel maŋtsɛ, Israel Kpɔlɔ, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, “Mi ji klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ kɛ naagbee mɔ; kɛjɛ mi, misɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ko Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Can anyone compare with me? If so, let them speak up and tell me now. Let them say what has happened since I made my nation long ago, and let them tell what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Namɔ kɛ mi ye egbɔ? Ha mɔ lɛ akɛɛ, ha ejaje yɛ mihiɛ. Kɛjɛ blema, namɔ egba nii ni nyiɛ gbɛ kɛbaa dã. Amɛgba wɔ nii ni baaba hu.

english_verse: Don't tremble with fear! Didn't I tell you long ago? Didn't you hear me? I alone am God— no one else is a mighty rock. Idols Can't Do a Thing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nyɛhe akakpokpoa ni nyɛkashea gbeyei! Ani jeee blema beebe mijɛ mikɛɛ nyɛ, ni nyɛnu kɛjɛ minaa? Nyɛ ji midasefoi! Ani misɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ko yɛ? Tɛsaa ko bɛ he ko he ko, mileee eko.” Jwɛŋmɔ bɛ amãgãjamɔ mli

english_verse: Those people who make idols are nothing themselves, and the idols they treasure are just as worthless. Worshipers of idols are blind, stupid, and foolish.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni feɔ amãgã bɛ nɔ ko mli, ni nibii ni amɛnaa he miishɛɛ lɛ ahe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ. Mɛi ni jaa amãgãi nɛɛ lɛ eshwila, ni amɛleee nii, ni aaawo amɛ hiɛgbele.

english_verse: Why make an idol or an image that can't do a thing?
translation_verse: Namɔ hu gbaa ehe naa efeɔ nyɔŋmɔ aloo eshwieɔ amãgã ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ?

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who worship them are mere humans, who will end up sadly disappointed. Let them face me in court and be terrified. Idols and Firewood
translation_verse: Naa, amɛjalɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ aaagboi. Mɛi fɛɛ ni feɔ amãgãi lɛ, adesai kɛkɛ ji amɛ. Hã amɛ fɛɛ amɛbabua amɛhe naa; hã amɛ jie amɛhiɛ; amɛbaakpokpo, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ aaashwie shi.

english_verse: A metalworker shapes an idol by using a hammer and heat from the fire. In his powerful hand he holds a hammer, as he pounds the metal into the proper shape. But he gets hungry and thirsty and loses his strength.
translation_verse: Sɔ̃lɔ ji mɔ ni sɔ̃ɔ. Ekɛ ŋai kɛ la tsuɔ he nii, ni ekɛ hamle tswiaa kɛ ekɔjiaŋ hewalɛ, ni esɔ̃ɔ. Hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ, ni ehewalɛ tãa, shi enuuu nu, ni no hewɔ lɛ, etɔɔɔ biti.

english_verse: Some woodcarver measures a piece of wood, then draws an outline. The idol is carefully carved with each detail exact. At last it looks like a person and is placed in a temple.
translation_verse: Kapintafonyo ŋmɔɔ kpãa yɛ tso he; eyereɔ kpãa lɛ mli, ni ekɛ pɛnsil kadiɔ he. Egbɔɔ tso lɛ he kɛ dade, ni ekɛ kɔmpas tɛŋɔ nii yɛ tso lɛ nɔ; egbɔɔ tso lɛ gbɔmɔ su pɛpɛɛpɛ fɛɛfɛo, ni ekɛyawoɔ gbatsu mli.

english_verse: Either cedar, cypress, oak, or any tree from the forest may be chosen. Or even a pine tree planted by the woodcarver and watered by the rain.
translation_verse: Etoɔ tsenedrutsei, aloo eyahalaa kooŋ tsei loo odum, ni ehaa edaa ni enaa hewalɛ yɛ kooŋ tsei lɛ ateŋ. Etɛoɔ tsenedrutso, ni nu nɛɔ shwieɔ nɔ, ni edaa.

english_verse: Some of the wood is used to make a fire for heating or for cooking. One piece is made into an idol, then the woodcarver bows down and worships it.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ ŋɔɔ tso lɛ eko ekɛfeɔ lai, ni ekɛ eko hu feɔ amãgã. Ekɛ eko shɛreɔ la ewereɔ, ni ekɛshãa aboloo hu; kɛkɛ lɛ ekɛ tso lɛ eko nɔŋŋ feɔ nyɔŋmɔ, ni ejaa. Ekɛ eko gbɔɔ amãgã, ni ekotoɔ shi ejaa lɛ.

english_verse: He enjoys the warm fire and the meat that was roasted over the burning coals.
translation_verse: Ekɛ tso lɛ eko shɛreɔ la, ni ekɛshãa loo eyeɔ ni etɔɔ; asaŋ ewereɔ tso lɛ la, ni ekɛɔ akɛ, “Yiɛ, mihe edɔ, mina la!”

english_verse: Afterwards, he bows down to worship the wooden idol. “Protect me!” he says. “You are my god.”
translation_verse: Tso ni eshwɛ lɛ ekɛgbɔɔ amãgã efeɔ enyɔŋmɔ, ni ekotoɔ lɛ, ni ejaa lɛ, ni esɔleɔ etsɛɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɔ akɛ, “Heremɔ mi, ejaakɛ bo ji minyɔŋmɔ.”

english_verse: They don't have enough sense to say to themselves, “I made a fire with half of the wood and cooked my bread and meat on it. Then I made something worthless with the other half. Why worship a block of wood?”
translation_verse: Mɔ ko mɔ ko jwɛŋmɔ baaa nɔ, asaŋ nilee loo sanesɛɛkɔmɔ hɛleee mɔ ko kwra shi ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mikɛ tso lɛ fã shã ŋai, ni mikɛ ŋai lɛ shã aboloo kɛ loo fɛɛ ni miye. Esa akɛ makoto tsoku lɛ lo?”

english_verse: How can anyone be stupid enough to trust something that can be burned to ashes? No one can save themselves like that. Don't they realize that the idols they hold in their hands are not really gods? The Lord Won't Forget His People
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yeɔ lamlu tete po, aaanu lɛ shishi. Esusumɔ kɔɔdɔŋ lɛ eha edu gbɛ, ni enyɛŋ eyiwala ehere, ni ekpɛlɛŋ nɔ, ni eeekɛɛ akɛ, “Kwɛ, nɔ ni yɔɔ mininejurɔ mli lɛ, jeee lakamɔnii ni lo?” Yehowa ji Bɔlɔ kɛ Kpɔlɔ

english_verse: People of Israel, you are my servant, so remember all of this. Israel, I created you, and you are my servant. I won't forget you.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Ao Israel, kaimɔ enɛ, kaimɔ akɛ mitsulɔ ji bo. Mi mibɔ bo; mitsulɔ ji bo. Ao Israel, mihiɛ kpaŋ onɔ!

english_verse: Turn back to me! I have rescued you and swept away your sins as though they were clouds. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: Mihã ohe eshai lɛ ekpalaŋ kɛtee tamɔ atatu, ohe eshai lɛ emii tamɔ afua. Kpalemɔ kɛba miŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ mi, mikpɔ̃ bo.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to start singing! Tell the mountains and every tree in the forest to join in the song! The Lord has rescued his people; now they will worship him. The Lord Created Everything
translation_verse: Ao ŋwɛi, la ejaakɛ Yehowa etsu enii! Ao shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi, bɔɔ oshe! Ao gɔji, nyɛwoa lala nɔ! Ao koo kɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni yɔɔ mli, nyɛlaa! Ejaakɛ Yehowa ekpɔ̃ Israel ni aawo ehiɛ nyam yɛ Israel.”

english_verse: Israel, I am your Lord, the source of your life, and I have rescued you. I created everything from the sky above to the earth below.
translation_verse: “Bɔ ni Yehowa, oKpɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Mi ji Yehowa, mɔ ni bɔ nii fɛɛ, mɔ ni ekome too ekpã ŋwɛi mli eha shi, ni ekome pɛ elɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: I make liars of false prophets and fools of fortunetellers. I take human wisdom and turn it into nonsense.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni hãa amalelɔi agbalɛi feɔ yaka, ni ehãa klamɔi tsɔ̃ɔ kwashiai, mɔ ni kũɔ nilelɔi anaa, ni ehãa amɛnilee lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ kwashiai anii lɛ.

english_verse: I will make the message of my prophets come true. They are saying, “Jerusalem will be filled with people, and the Lord will rebuild the towns of Judah.”
translation_verse: Emaa etsulɔ wiemɔ nɔ mi, ni ehãa ebɔfoi agbalɛ baa mli taakɛ ekɛɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm he akɛ, ‘Mɛi baahi mli ekoŋŋ’, ni ekɛɛ yɛ Yuda maji wuji lɛ ahe akɛ, ‘Abaasaa amãmɔ amɛ, ni maha tsui ni akumɔ ate shi ekoŋŋ’ lɛ.

english_verse: I am the one who commands the sea and its streams to run dry.
translation_verse: Lɛ ekɛɔ ŋshɔ akɛ, ‘Omli nu agbi, mibahã ofai lɛ hu amii?’

english_verse: I am also the one who says, “Cyrus will lead my people and obey my orders. Jerusalem and the temple will be rebuilt.”
translation_verse: Ekɛɛ yɛ Koresh he akɛ, ‘Mitookwɛlɔ ji lɛ, ni ebaafee nii ni sa mihiɛ’; ni ekɛɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm he akɛ, ‘Abaasaa ama’, ni ekɛɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hu he akɛ, ‘Abaato oshishi ekoŋŋ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord said to Cyrus, his chosen one: I have taken hold of your right hand to help you capture nations and remove kings from power. City gates will open for you; not one will stay closed.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ Koresh mɔ ni efɔ lɛ mu, mɔ ni mimɔ eninejurɔ mli koni maba majimaji ashi yɛ ehiɛ, koni maba maŋtsɛmɛi ashi, ni magbele shinai yɛ ehiɛ, koni akaŋamɔ agboi awo lɛ lɛ nɛ,

english_verse: As I lead you, I will level mountains and break the iron bars on bronze gates of cities.
translation_verse: “Manyiɛ ohiɛ, ni maha hei ni yɔɔ dokoidokoi afee trɛnɛɛ, ni majwara akɔɔble agboi lɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ, ni makumɔ amɛsɛɛ dade adabaŋi lɛ amli.

english_verse: I will give you treasures hidden in dark and secret places. Then you will know that I, the Lord God of Israel, have called you by name.
translation_verse: Maŋɔ jwetrii ni aŋɔ tee duŋ mli kɛ ojarawa nibii ni akɛtee yɛ teemɔhei lɛ mahã bo, koni ona ole akɛ mi ji Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kɛ ogbɛi tsɛ bo lɛ.

english_verse: Cyrus, you don't even know me! But I have called you by name and highly honored you because of Israel, my chosen servant.
translation_verse: Mitsulɔ Yakob ni ji Israel, mɔ ni miŋɔ lɛ lɛ hewɔ ni Kuros, mikɛ ogbɛi tsɛ bo, ni miwo bo gbɛi, tsɛbelɛ oleee mi lɛ.”

english_verse: Only I am the Lord! There are no other gods. I have made you strong, though you don't know me.
translation_verse: “Mi ji Yehowa, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ; mi misɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ko Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ. Mahã ona hewalɛ tsɛbelɛ oleee mi,

english_verse: Now everyone from east to west will learn that I am the Lord. No other gods are real.
translation_verse: koni kɛjɛ hulushiteehe kɛyashwie anaigbɛ fɛɛ lɛ, adesa ana ale akɛ mi misɛɛ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: I create light and darkness, happiness and sorrow. I, the Lord, do all this.
translation_verse: Mi mihãa la kɛ duŋ fɛɛ baa; mihãa anaa hejɔlɛ, ni mihãa jaramɔ baa. Mi ji Yehowa, mɔ ni feɔ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens to send down justice like showers of rain. Prepare the earth for my saving power to sprout and produce justice that I, the Lord, create. The Lord's Mighty Power The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Ao Ŋwɛi, nɛɛ nu kɛjɛ ŋwɛi! Ha atatui afɔse jalɛ ashwie shi! Shikpɔŋ agbele enaa koni yiwalaheremɔ aba, koni eha jalɛ saneyeli hu akwɛ̃ Mi, Yehowa, mafee enɛ! Adebɔɔ kɛ Jeŋ sane Nuŋtsɔ

english_verse: Israel, you have no right to argue with your Creator. You are merely a clay pot shaped by a potter. The clay doesn't ask, “Why did you make me this way? Where are the handles?”
translation_verse: Kpoo hã mɔ ni kɛ Ebɔlɔ lɛ fuɔ daa! Sũ ni yɔɔ nishɔ̃lɔ dɛŋ ji lɛ. Ani shikpɔŋ sũ biɔ nishɔ̃lɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛni okɛ mi shɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ?’ Aloo, ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni oshɔ̃ lɛ niji bɛ he?’

english_verse: Children don't have the right to demand of their parents, “What have you done to make us what we are?”
translation_verse: Kpoo ha bi ni kɛɔ etsɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛni bi obaafɔ?’ Aloo ebiɔ yoo ni miikɔmɔ akɛ, ‘Ni okɔmɔɔ nɛɛ mɛɛ bi obaafɔ?’

english_verse: I am the Lord, the Creator, the holy God of Israel. Do you dare question me about my own nation or about what I have done?
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ Ebɔlɔ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, “Mɛɛ hegbɛ nyɛyɔɔ akɛ nyɛaabi mi mibii lɛ ahe sane, aloo nyɛaatsɔ̃ɔ mi nɔ ni esa akɛ mikɛ miniji afee?’

english_verse: I created the world and covered it with people; I stretched out the sky and filled it with stars.
translation_verse: Mi mibɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ, mi mibɔ gbɔmɔ mito nɔ. Mi mikɛ minine kpã ŋwɛi mli miha shi. Hulu, nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii, ŋwɛi nibii lɛ, mi mifamɔ naa ni amɛba.

english_verse: I have done the right thing by placing Cyrus in power, and I will make the roads easy for him to follow. I am the Lord All-Powerful! Cyrus will rebuild my city and set my people free without being paid a thing. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Alone Can Save
translation_verse: Mi diɛŋtsɛ mitee Koresh shi koni etsu miyiŋtoo lɛ he nii, asaŋ koni ejaje nibii. Mahã egbɛi fɛɛ aja aha lɛ; eeesaa etswa mimaŋ lɛ, ni eeeŋmɛɛ minomii lɛ ahe jeee yɛ yinii loo sɛɛnamɔ ko hewɔ.” Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ.

english_verse: My people, I, the Lord, promise that the riches of Egypt and the treasures of Ethiopia will belong to you. You will force into slavery those tall people of Seba. They will bow down and say, “The only true God is with you; there are no other gods.”
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ Israel nɛ, “Nii ni Ijipt yɔɔ lɛ kɛ Kush hu jarayeli mli sɛɛnamɔnii lɛ fɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ onii; ni Sebahii, hii gojogojoo lɛ, aaatsɔmɔ onyɔji. Amɛaakamɔ gboklɛi amli kɛaanyiɛ osɛɛ; amɛaaba ni amɛaakoto bo. Amɛaakpa bo fai amɛkɛɛ, ‘Bo pɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ yɔɔ, ni Lɛ esɛɛ lɛ, mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: People of Israel, your God is a mystery, though he alone can save.
translation_verse: Anɔkwale mli lɛ, bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ ni etee ehe. Ao, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, Yiwalaherelɔ!

english_verse: Anyone who makes idols will be confused and terribly disgraced.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɛɛ ni feɔ amãgãi lɛ, amɛhiɛ aaagboi, ni amɛhiɛ aaashwie shi, amɛ fɛɛ amɛaanyiɛ kɛ hiɛgbele.

english_verse: But Israel, I, the Lord, will always keep you safe and free from shame. Everyone Is Invited
translation_verse: Shi Yehowa aaahere Israel yiwala kɛya naanɔ; nyɛhiɛ gboiŋ, ni asaŋ nyɛhiɛ eshwieŋ shi kɔkɔɔkɔ kɛyaashi naanɔ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord alone is God! He created the heavens and made a world where people can live, instead of creating an empty desert. The Lord alone is God; there are no others.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni shɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni ewaje lɛ ema shi shiŋŋ, ni ebɔɔɔ lɛ koni ekã shi efolo, shi ebɔ lɛ koni ahi nɔ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Mi ji Yehowa, ni kɛjɛ mi, misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord did not speak in a dark secret place or command Jacob's descendants to search for him in vain. The Lord speaks the truth, and this is what he says
translation_verse: Jeee teemɔ mli miwie yɛ, yɛ shikpɔŋ ni enɔ ewo duŋ ko nɔ. Mikɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtaoɔ mi yaka; nyɛtaoɔ mi yɛ he ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ. Mi Yehowa, miwieɔ anɔkwale. Nɔ ni ja lɛ, no mikɛɔ.” Je lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ Babilon Amãgãi lɛ

english_verse: to every survivor from every nation: “Gather around me! Learn how senseless it is to worship wooden idols or pray to helpless gods.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa koni nyɛbaa, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛbaa kutuu, nyɛ, maji lɛ amli bii ni nyɛje hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli! Mɛi ni tereɔ amɛtso amãgãi lɛ kɛnyiɛɔ, ni amɛsɔleɔ amɛhãa nyɔŋmɔ ni nyɛɛɛ mɔ yiwala ehere lɛ, amɛleee nii.

english_verse: “Why don't you get together and meet me in court? Didn't I tell you long ago what would happen? I am the only God! There are no others. I bring about justice, and have the power to save.
translation_verse: Nyɛbaa koni nyɛbajajea nyɛsane lɛ; nyɛhãa amɛyaa ajina! Namɔ ji mɔ ni jeeŋmɔ ko lɛ egba nɔ ni eba nɛɛ? Namɔ kɛɛ enɛ kɛjɛ blema? Aso jeee mi, Yehowa, ni? Ni misɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ jalɔ kɛ Yiwalaherelɔ? Misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: “I invite the whole world to turn to me and be saved. I alone am God! No others are real.
translation_verse: “Jeŋ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ, nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ kɛbaa miŋɔɔ, koni ahere nyɛyiwala. Ejaakɛ mi pɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni kɛjɛ misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: I have made a solemn promise, one that won't be broken: Everyone will bow down and worship me.
translation_verse: Mikɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ migbɛi ekã mihe kitã: Jalɛ wiemɔ ko eje minaa, ni ekuŋ esɛɛ efolo. Nakutso fɛɛ nakutso aaakũla mi, ni lilɛi fɛɛ lilɛi aaakã kitã akɛɛ akɛ,

english_verse: They will admit that I alone can bring about justice. Everyone who is angry with me will be terribly ashamed and will turn to me.
translation_verse: “Yehowa kɛkɛ mli jalɛ kɛ hewalɛ yɔɔ. Mɛi fɛɛ ni te shi wo lɛ lɛ, aaaba eŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ kɛ hiɛgbele.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will give victory and great honor to the people of Israel.”
translation_verse: Yehowa mli Israel shwiei fɛɛ aaaye bem yɛ, ni enɔ amɛaashwã amɛfɔ̃.

english_verse: The gods Bel and Nebo are down on their knees, as wooden images of them are carried away on weary animals.
translation_verse: “Babilon nyɔŋmɔi lɛ anaagbee nɛ! Be ko ni eho lɛ, aja Bel kɛ Nebo. Shi amrɔ nɛɛ afimɔ amɛ ashwie tejii akotosɛɛ akɛ jatsu ni kooloi tere ni etɔ amɛ.

english_verse: They are down on their knees to rescue the heavy load, but the images are still taken to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Amãgãi lɛ kotokotoo shi amɛ fɛɛ amɛmamɔmamɔɔ amɛhiɛ shi; amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛhe amɛfɛne, ni aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛmiiya.

english_verse: You survivors in Israel, listen to me, the Lord. Since the day you were born, I have carried you along.
translation_verse: “Ao, Yakob shwiei, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni eshwɛ, nyɛboa mi toi. Nyɛ mɛi ni mihiɛ nyɛ kɛjɛ nyɛfɔmɔ mli, ni mikura nyɛ kɛjɛ nyɛhɔŋɔɔ mli beebe,

english_verse: I will still be the same when you are old and gray, and I will take care of you. I created you. I will carry you and always keep you safe.
translation_verse: ni kɛyaashi gbɔlɛ mli lɛ mi nɔŋŋ ni; ni kɛyaashi nyɛwaŋjee mli tete mi nɔŋŋ ni. Mi, mibɔ nyɛ, ni mi nɔŋŋ mahiɛ nyɛ; mi miwa nyɛ, ni mahere nyɛyiwala.

english_verse: Can anyone compare with me? Is anyone my equal?
translation_verse: Namɔ nyɛkɛbaato mihe, ni ekɛ mi aaaye egbɔ? Namɔ nyɛkɛbaato mihe, ni ekɛ mi aaafee pɛ?

english_verse: Some people hire a goldsmith and give silver and gold to be formed into an idol for them to worship.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni fɔseɔ shika kɛjɛɔ flɔtɔ mli shwieɔ shi, ni amɛŋmɛɔ jwiɛtɛi yɛ nsɛni mli lɛ, amɛbɔɔ shikaŋaalɔ apaa, ni efeɔ nyɔŋmɔ ko ehãa amɛ, ni amɛhoɔ amɛkotoɔ shi, ni amɛjaa lɛ.

english_verse: They carry the idol on their shoulders, then put it on a stand, but it cannot move. They call out to the idol when they are in trouble, but it doesn't answer, and it cannot help.
translation_verse: Amɛwoɔ lɛ amɛtswaa amɛkɔŋ, ni amɛtereɔ lɛ kɛyaa; amɛkɛ lɛ yamaa shi yɛ he ko, ni jɛi emaa; enyɛɛɛ ehe etsi kɛjɛ emaahe lɛ. Kɛji abolɔ atsɛ lɛ lɛ, ehereee mɔ nɔ; ni ehereee mɔ yiwala kɛjɛɛɛ ehaomɔ mli.

english_verse: Now keep this in mind, you sinful people. And don't ever forget it. The Lord Alone Is God
translation_verse: “Nyɛ eshafeelɔi, nyɛkaia sane nɛɛ, ni nyɛsusua he. Nyɛkaia lɛ jogbaŋŋ.

english_verse: I alone am God! There are no other gods; no one is like me. Think about what happened many years ago.
translation_verse: Nyɛkaia blema teteetenii lɛ. Mi nɔŋŋ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ sɛɛ dɔŋŋ. Mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni tamɔ mi.

english_verse: From the very beginning, I told what would happen long before it took place. I kept my word
translation_verse: Mi, mijɛ shishijee lɛ mli ni mitsɔ̃ɔ naagbee mli nibii ni baaba; Mi, mijɛ blema beebe mitsɔ̃ɔ nibii ni anako afee tete. Mi, mikɛɔ akɛ; ‘Miyiŋtoi aaaba mli, ni mibafee nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ miyiŋ.’

english_verse: and brought someone from a distant land to do what I wanted. He attacked from the east, like a hawk swooping down. Now I will keep my promise and do what I planned.
translation_verse: Miitsɛ miyiŋtoo naa nuu ko kɛmiijɛ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ. Ebaagba shi kɛba tamɔ okropɔŋ. Mina miwie, ni mahã eba mli; mito miyiŋ, ni mafee hu.

english_verse: You people are stubborn and far from being safe, so listen to me.
translation_verse: Nyɛ tsuisalɔi, nyɛboa mi toi, nyɛ ni nyɛkɛ yiwalaheremɔ teŋ ejekɛ!

english_verse: I will soon come to save you. I am not far away and will waste no time; I take pride in Israel and will save Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Miha miyiwalaheremɔ ebɛŋkɛ; ebɛ shɔŋŋ. Midɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ etsɛŋ. Mibahere Yerusalɛm, ni mahã Israel hiɛ aba nyam.”

english_verse: City of Babylon, You are delicate and untouched, but that will change. Surrender your royal power and sit in the dirt.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Babilon, oblayoo foro, kpelekemɔ shi koni obata mlu mli! Ta shikpɔŋ; maŋtsɛ sɛi ko bɛ ha bo, bo Kaldeabii abiyoo, ejaakɛ atsɛŋ bo oje kɛ mɔ ni ahiɛɔ lɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Start grinding grain! Take off your veil. Strip off your fancy clothes and wade across rivers.
translation_verse: Kɔlɔmɔ wiɛbii ni owiɛ ma, jiemɔ ohiɛhaa nɔ lɛ, jiemɔ otade yuu lɛ, dɔrɔmɔ onaji ahe mama kɛya ŋwɛi koni ofo faa lɛ.

english_verse: You will suffer the shame of going naked, because I will take revenge, and no one can escape.
translation_verse: Aaajie oyayaiaŋ kpo, ni ohiɛgbele aaabakã shi. Matɔ owele, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko etsiŋ minaa.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the holy God of Israel. I am their Savior.
translation_verse: Wɔ-Kpɔ̃lɔ lɛ ni gbɛi ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, lɛ ji Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Babylon, be silent! Sit in the dark. No longer will nations accept you as their queen.
translation_verse: Ao Babilon, ta shi kpoo yɛ duŋ mli, ejaakɛ atsɛŋ bo nɔyelihei amaŋnyɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: I was angry with my people. So I let you take their land and bring disgrace on them. You showed them no mercy, but were especially cruel to those who were old.
translation_verse: Mimli wo mimaŋ lɛ la, ni mibule minɔyeli nɔ lɛ, ni miŋɔ amɛ miwo odɛ̃ŋ. Omusuŋ etsɔ̃ɔɔ bo yɛ amɛhe; hiimeji tete po okɛ amɛ ye kɛ joomɔ.

english_verse: You thought that you would be queen forever. You didn't care what you did; it never entered your mind that you might get caught.
translation_verse: Osusu akɛ obaaye maŋnyɛ kɛya naanɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, okɛ sane nɛɛ wooo otsuiŋ, ni oyajwɛŋŋ bɔ ni naagbee lɛ aaatamɔ ahã.

english_verse: You think that you alone are all-powerful, that you won't be a widow or lose your children. All you care about is pleasure, but listen to what I say.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, bo enɛ toi, bo ni onyaa jeŋ ŋɔɔmɔyeli he, ni ota shi ni ohe ejɔ bo, ni okɛɔ ohe akɛ, “Mi ji mi, ni mi, misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ, mitsɔŋ okulafo, ni migboŋ bi hu.”

english_verse: Your magic powers and charms will suddenly fail, then you will be a widow and lose your children.
translation_verse: Nibii enyɔ nɛɛ aaaba onɔ trukaa yɛ gbi kome nɔ. Okunyaayeli babaoo kɛ osɛbɛi babaoo lɛ ahewalɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, aaakpakpaa obii yɛ ohe, ni oootsɔ̃ okulafo hu.

english_verse: You hid behind evil like a shield and said, “No one can see me!” You were fooled by your wisdom and your knowledge; you felt sure that you alone were in full control.
translation_verse: Onifɔɔjianii lɛ mli lɛ, efee bo akɛ oyɛ shweshweeshwe; ni okɛɛ ohe akɛ, “Mɔ ko enaaa mi.” Oŋaa kɛ onilee lɛ ha odu gbɛ, ni okɛɛ ohe akɛ, “Mi ji mi, ni mi, misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: But without warning, disaster will strike— and your magic charms won't help at all.
translation_verse: Shi sane fɔŋ baaye bo, ni oleŋ bɔ ni ooofee ni oje mli. Osharã aaasharã bo, ni onyɛŋ okpa oshwie. Hiɛkpãtãmɔ aaabanina bo trukaa bɔ ni okpaaa gbɛ.

english_verse: Keep using your magic powers and your charms as you have always done. Maybe—just maybe— you will frighten somebody!
translation_verse: “Yaa nɔ kɛ okablɛfiimɔ kɛ okunyaayeli babaoo ni ogbo he deŋme kɛjɛ oblahiiaŋ lɛ, akɛ aleee nɔ eeenyɛ eye ebua bo lo; akɛ aleee nɔ ohe aaafee gbeyei.

english_verse: You have worn yourself out, asking for advice from those who study the stars and tell the future month after month. Go ask them how to be saved from what will happen.
translation_verse: Ŋaawoo pii lɛ eje otsine. Ha mɛi ni le ŋwɛi nibiiaŋ lɛ kɛ ŋulamiiaŋkwɛlɔi lɛ, mɛi ni kɛji nyɔŋ je ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nii ni baaba onɔ lɛ, ate shi koni amɛhere oyiwala!

english_verse: People who trust the stars are as helpless as straw in a flaming fire. No one can even keep warm, sitting by a fire that feeds only on straw.
translation_verse: Naa, amɛtamɔ gbetseli, ni la aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ wɛɛ; amɛnyɛŋ amɛhe amɛhere kɛje la lɛ naawalɛ mli. Enɛ jeee ŋai la ni awereɔ, loo la ni ataa he awereɔ.

english_verse: These are the fortunetellers you have done business with all of your life. But they don't know where they are going, and they can't save you.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni ogbo amɛhe deŋme lɛ, bɔ ni amɛaatsɔ̃ amɛha bo nɛ; oŋulamiiaŋkwɛlɔi ni wo bo ŋaa lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛaashi bo; mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni aaahere oyiwala.”

english_verse: People of Israel, you come from Jacob's family and the tribe of Judah. You claim to worship me, the Lord God of Israel, but you are lying.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Israelbii, nyɛ mɛi ni akɛ Israel gbɛi ewo nyɛ, ni nyɛjɛ Yuda mli, nyɛboa enɛ toi! Nyɛkɛ Yehowa gbɛi lɛ kãa kitã, ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, shi anɔkwale kome nɛkɛ bɛ mli.

english_verse: You call Jerusalem your home and say you depend on me, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: Nyɛtsɛɔ nyɛhe maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli bii, ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ nyɛkpasa Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Mɔ ni gbɛi ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Long ago I announced what was going to be, then without warning, I made it happen.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Mijɛ jeeŋmɔ ko mitsɔ̃ɔ nii ni baaba. Eje minaa, ni miha ana ale, ni trukaa lɛ mifee, ni amɛba mli.

english_verse: And I told you these things, so that when they happened you would not say, “The idols we worship did this.”
translation_verse: mijɛ jeeŋmɔ ni migba bo. Mikɛɛ bo dani aba mli, koni okakɛɛ akɛ, mimãgã ni akɛ tso gbɔ loo amãgã ni ashwie lɛ fã, ni enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ba.

english_verse: You heard what I said, and you have seen it happen. Now admit it's true! I will show you secrets you have never known.
translation_verse: Onu momo, ni agbɛnɛ ona nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ. Belɛ bɛ obaakpɛlɛ nɔ? Kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ mibaha onu nibii hei, nibii ni akɛtee nibii ni oleee.

english_verse: Today I am doing something new, something you cannot say you have heard before.
translation_verse: Kpaako mifeɔ, amɛbɛ sa. Onuko amɛhe sane lɛ dã ja ŋmɛnɛ, koni okakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, mile mito’.

english_verse: You have never been willing to listen to what I say; from the moment of your birth, I knew you would rebel. The Lord Warns Israel
translation_verse: Onuko dã, ni oleee otooo sa; otoi egbeko dã kɛjɛ blema beebe; ejaakɛ mile akɛ kutumpɔfoi anii ofeɔ, ni kɛjɛ ofɔmɔ mli beebe lɛ ale bo akɛ atuatselɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am true to myself; I will be praised for not punishing and destroying you.
translation_verse: Migbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, miitsi mimlifu lɛ mato. Mi, miyijiemɔ hewɔ lɛ, miito mitsui shi maha bo koni mikakpãtã ohiɛ.

english_verse: I tested you in hard times just as silver is refined in a heated furnace.
translation_verse: Naa, mitsuu ohe, shi oshɛɛɛ jwiɛtɛi. Mikɛ amanehulu fee la mikɛtsuu ohe, ni mikɛka bo mikwɛ akɛ oshɛɔ lo.

english_verse: I did this because of who I am. I refuse to be dishonored or share my praise with any other god.
translation_verse: Mi diɛŋtsɛ mihewɔ, mi diɛŋtsɛ mihewɔ ni mifeɔ enɛ, ejaakɛ mɛni hewɔ aaagbe migbɛi lɛ he guɔ? Mikɛ minunyam lɛ haŋ mɔ kroko.” Kuros ji Hiɛnyiɛlɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efã

english_verse: Israel, my chosen people, listen to me. I alone am the Lord, the first and the last.
translation_verse: “Ao, Yakob, bo mi toi; Israel, bo mɔ ni mitsɛ, bo mi toi. Mi ni, mi ji klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ, ni mi nɔŋŋ ji naagbee mɔ lɛ!

english_verse: With my own hand I created the earth and stretched out the sky. They obey my every command. The Lord Speaks to the Nations
translation_verse: Mi, minine to shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi, ni mi, mihewalɛ lɛɛ ŋwɛi mli ha shi. Kɛji mitsɛ amɛ lɛ amɛ fɛɛ blublu amɛbadamɔɔ mihiɛ.

english_verse: Gather around me, all of you! Listen to what I say. Did any of your idols predict this would happen? Did they say that my friend would do what I want done to Babylonia?
translation_verse: “Nyɛ fɛɛ, nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa koni nyɛbaboa toi. Te nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni egba enɛɛmɛi eko lɛ? Mɔ ni Yehowa sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ, lɛ ebaatsu yiŋ ni Yehowa eto yɛ Babilon he lɛ he nii; ebaate shi ewo Babilon.

english_verse: I was the one who chose him. I have brought him this far, and he will be successful.
translation_verse: Mi, mi nɔŋŋ miwie, ni mifɔ̃ minaa mitsɛ lɛ. Mi nɔŋŋ mikɛ lɛ ba, ni egbɛ aaaja aha lɛ.

english_verse: Come closer and listen! I have never kept secret the things I have said, and I was here before time began. It Is Best To Obey the Lord By the power of his Spirit the Lord God has sent me
translation_verse: Nyɛtsia nyɛbɛŋkɛa mi nyɛbaboa enɛ toi. Kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ miwieee yɛ dujiaŋ; ni dani nɔ ko baaba mli lɛ, miyɛ jɛi. Ni agbɛnɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ etsu mi kɛ Emumɔ lɛ.” Yehowa yiŋtoo yɛ Ewebii ahe

english_verse: with this message: People of Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. For your own good, I teach you, and I lead you along the right path.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa, bo-Kpɔ̃lɔ, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Mi ji Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni tsɔɔ bo nii ni hi ha bo, mɔ ni tsɔɔ bo gbɛ ni esa akɛ onyiɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: How I wish that you had obeyed my commands! Your success and good fortune would then have overflowed like a flooding river.
translation_verse: Ao, eji oye mikitãi lɛ anɔ kulɛ, oooshwere tamɔ faa; ni okunimyeli aaatsara nɔ tamɔ ŋshɔkei.

english_verse: Your nation would be blessed with more people than there are grains of sand along the seashore. And I would never have let your country be destroyed.
translation_verse: Omusuŋbii aaafa tamɔ shia, ni oshwiei aaafa tamɔ mlu. Agbeŋ amɛgbɛi, ni akpãtãŋ amɛhiɛ yɛ mihiɛ.”

english_verse: Now leave Babylon! Celebrate as you go. Be happy and shout for everyone to hear, “The Lord has rescued his servant Israel!
translation_verse: Nyɛshia Babilon nyɛjoa foi kɛjea Kaldea nyɛyaa. Nyɛbɔa oshe kɛ miishɛɛ; nyɛhaa anua yɛ je lɛ naagbeehe akɛ, “Yehowa ekpɔ̃ etsulɔ Israel.”

english_verse: He led us through the desert and made water flow from a rock to satisfy our thirst.
translation_verse: Be ni ekɛ amɛ nyiɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, kumai yeee amɛ. Eha nu jɛ tɛsaa mli ho hã amɛ; egba tɛsaa lɛ mli, ni nu lɛ tue kɛje kpo.

english_verse: But the Lord has promised that none who are evil will live in peace.”
translation_verse: “Hejɔlɛ ko bɛ hã mɛi fɔ̃ji” Yehowa kɛɛ.

english_verse: Everyone, listen, even you foreign nations across the sea. The Lord chose me and gave me a name before I was born.
translation_verse: Ao, nyɛ ŋshɔnaa maji, nyɛboa mi toi; ni nyɛ majimaji ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ, nyɛfea toi. Yehowa tsɛ mi dani afɔ mi. Be ni miyɔɔ minyɛ musuŋ beebe ni Yehowa wo mi gbɛi.

english_verse: He made my words pierce like a sharp sword or a pointed arrow; he kept me safely hidden in the palm of his hand.
translation_verse: Ehã miwiemɔ naa ba tamɔ klante; ekɛ mi tee yɛ dɛkɔkɔ teŋ. Eha mitsɔ tamɔ gãimlibi ni asha he kaŋkaŋ; ni eŋɔ mi etee egãimlibii akotoku lɛ mli.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Israel, you are my servant; and because of you I will be highly honored.”
translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Israel, mitsulɔ ji bo; bo onɔ baatsɔ̃ ni abaawo mihiɛ nyam.

english_verse: I said to myself, “I'm completely worn out; my time has been wasted. But I did it for the Lord God, and he will reward me.”
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ mikɛɛ akɛ, “Migbo deŋme yakatswaa; mifite mihewalɛ efolo yakatswaa.” Kɛ̃lɛ mihiɛ kã Yehowa nɔ, ni minyɔmɔwo yɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ.

english_verse: Even before I was born, the Lord God chose me to serve him and to lead back the people of Israel. So the Lord has honored me and made me strong.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛɛ, Yehowa mɔ ni shɔ̃ mi yɛ musuŋ koni mibatsɔ̃ etsulɔ ni maŋɔ Israel kɛba eŋɔɔ, koni abua Israel naa abaha lɛ. Akɛni mihiɛ eba nyam yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ etsɔ mihewalɛ.

english_verse: Now the Lord says to me, “It isn't enough for you to be merely my servant. You must do more than lead back survivors from the tribes of Israel. I have placed you here as a light for other nations; you must take my saving power to everyone on earth.” The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: Ekɛɛ, “Efaaa akɛ ooofee mitsulɔ ni otee Israel akutsei lɛ ashi, ni okɛ Israelbii ni abaa amɛyi lɛ aku sɛɛ kɛba amɛjaku shikpɔŋ nɔ kɛkɛ; shi moŋ miiŋɔ bo mafee jeŋ majimaji lɛ ala, koni midɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ ayashɛ je lɛ naagbeehe.”

english_verse: Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. You are slaves of rulers and of a nation who despises you. Now this is what I promise: Kings and rulers will honor you by kneeling at your feet. You can trust me! I am your Lord, the holy God of Israel, and you are my chosen ones. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Kpɔ̃lɔ, kɛ eMɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, kɛɔ mɔ ni agbe ehe guɔ, ni jeŋ majimaji lɛ hi ehiɛ, nɔyelɔi anyɔŋ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, “Maŋtsɛmɛi aaana lɛ ni amɛaate shi amɛhã lɛ; ni lumɛi hu aaana lɛ ni amɛaakamɔ shi yɛ ehiɛ ejaakɛ Yehowa ehala lɛ, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, eji anɔkwafo.” Abaasaa atswa Yerusalɛm

english_verse: This is what the Lord says: I will answer your prayers because I have set a time when I will help by coming to save you. I have chosen you to take my promise of hope to other nations. You will rebuild the country from its ruins, then people will come and settle there.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mibo bo toi yɛ be ni sa mli, ni yiwalaheremɔ gbi nɔ hu miye mibua bo yɛ, ni mibaa oyi koni kɛtsɔ̃ onɔ lɛ, mi kɛ maji fɛɛ akpãŋ, koni otee shikpɔŋ lɛ shi oma shi, ni oja amɛgboshinii ni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ lɛ oha amɛ.

english_verse: You will set prisoners free from dark dungeons to see the light of day. On their way home, they will find plenty to eat, even on barren hills.
translation_verse: Okɛɛ mɛi ni awo amɛ tsuŋ lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛjea kpo koni nyɛye nyɛhe;’ ni mɛi ni yɔɔ duŋ mli lɛ kɛɛmɔ amɛ hu akɛ, ‘Nyɛbaa la hiɛ.’ Amɛaaye nii yɛ gbɛjegbɛi atoi, ni gɔji ni koo bɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛniyelihe.

english_verse: They won't go hungry or get thirsty; they won't be bothered by the scorching sun or hot desert winds. I will be merciful while leading them along to streams of water.
translation_verse: Hɔmɔ yeŋ amɛ, ni kumai hu yeŋ amɛ. Hulu eshaŋ amɛ, ni shiaŋa nɔ kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ hu esaŋ amɛhe, ejaakɛ mɔ ni musuŋtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ amɛhe lɛ aaakpala amɛ, ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ kɛaatee nubui ahe.

english_verse: I will level the mountains and make roads.
translation_verse: “Maha migɔji lɛ anɔ atsɔ gbɛ, ni aaasaa migbɛjegbɛi lɛ afee amɛ tɛmpɔŋi.

english_verse: Then my people will return from distant lands in the north and the west and from the city of Syene. The Lord's Mercy
translation_verse: Naa, miwebii aaajɛ shɔŋŋ aba; ni naa, aaajɛ kooyigbɛ kɛ anaigbɛ hu aba, ni mɛi aaajɛ Aswan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ wuoyigbɛ aba.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to celebrate and sing; command every mountain to join in the song. The Lord's people have suffered, but he has shown mercy and given them comfort.
translation_verse: “Ŋwɛi, lá kɛ miishɛɛ! Shikpɔŋ, bɔɔ oshe kɛ nyamɔ! Gɔji, nyɛlaa nyamɔ lala! Ejaakɛ Yehowa eshɛje emaŋ lɛ mii; ni emɛi ni nii yɔɔ mɔbɔ lɛ, emusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amɛhe.

english_verse: The people of Zion said, “The Lord has turned away and forgotten us.”
translation_verse: Shi Yerusalɛm kɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa ekwa mi, miNuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ ekpa minɔ!”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Could a mother forget a child who nurses at her breast? Could she fail to love an infant who came from her own body? Even if a mother could forget, I will never forget you.
translation_verse: Yehowa to he akɛ, “Aso yoofɔyoo hiɛ aaakpa ebi fufɔoo nɔ, ni emusuŋ etsɔŋ lɛ yɛ emusuŋbi he? Kɛji yoofɔyoo tete hiɛ aaakpa ebi nɔ lɛ, mi lɛ, mihiɛ kpaŋ onɔ.

english_verse: A picture of your city is drawn on my hand. You are always in my thoughts!
translation_verse: Yerusalɛm, naa, miŋma ogbɛi yɛ midɛkɔkɔŋ; mihiɛ kpaŋ onɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ.”

english_verse: “Your city will be built faster than it was destroyed— those who attacked it will retreat and leave.
translation_verse: “Mɛi ni baasaa atswa bo ama shi lɛ miiba nɔŋŋ, ni mɛi ni fee bo amaŋfɔ̃ lɛ baashi omli ni amɛya.

english_verse: Look around! You will see your people coming home. As surely as I live, I, the Lord, promise that your city with its people will be as lovely as a bride wearing her jewelry.” Jerusalem's Bright Future
translation_verse: Wo ohiɛ nɔ ni okwɛ ohe kɛkpe; Owebii lɛ miibua amɛhe naa; amɛmiiba oŋɔɔ. Gbii abɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mihiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, amɛaatsɔ tamɔ jwine, ni okɛ amɛaawula ohe tamɔ ayɛmforo feɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: Jerusalem is now in ruins! Nothing is left of the city. But it will be rebuilt and soon overcrowded; its cruel enemies will be gone far away.
translation_verse: “Eyɛ mli akɛ afite oshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni afee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃ moŋ nɛ, shi agbɛnɛ, mɛi baaba omli aahu bɔ ni onaŋ gbɛ ohã amɛ; ni mɛi ni ha afee bo amaŋfɔ̃ lɛ kɛ bo teŋ aaajekɛ shɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Jerusalem is a woman whose children were born while she was in deep sorrow over the loss of her husband. Now those children will come and seek room in the crowded city,
translation_verse: Bii ni ofɔ yɛ ojaramɔ be lɛ mli lɛ aaakɛɛ yɛ otoiŋ akɛ, ‘Shikpɔŋ nɛɛ yɛ fintɔŋŋ tsɔ ha wɔ; tsi oya koni wɔna shihilɛhe.’

english_verse: and Jerusalem will ask, “Am I really their mother? How could I have given birth when I was still mourning in a foreign land? Who raised these children? Where have they come from?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ ooobi ohe akɛ ‘Namɔ fɔ bii nɛɛ ha mi? Akpakpaa mibii yɛ mihe ni mitsɔ̃ kene ni bɛ bi. Aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee. No hewɔ lɛ, namɔ lɛ amɛ? Naa, ashi mi koome pɛ kɛkɛ; belɛ nɛgbɛ Mɛnɛɛmɛi jɛ mɔ?’ ”

english_verse: The Lord God says: “I will soon give a signal for the nations to return your sons and your daughters to the arms of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, “Naa, mawo minine nɔ mafɔ majimaji lɛ anine, ni amɛaahiɛ obihii lɛ yɛ amɛkpɔkɔiaŋ kɛaaba.

english_verse: The kings and queens of those nations where they were raised will come and bow down. They will take care of you just like a slave taking care of a child. Then you will know that I am the Lord. You won't be disappointed if you trust me.” The Lord Is on Our Side
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛmɛi aaatsɔmɔ tamɔ tsɛmɛi aha nyɛ, ni maŋnyɛmɛi aaatsɔmɔ tamɔ yei fufɔhalɔi ahã nyɛ. Amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ aaabumɔ shi, amɛaakoto nyɛ, ni amɛaalɛmɔ nyɛnaji ahe mlu. Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi ji Yehowa. Mɛi ni hiɛ kã minɔ lɛ, amɛhiɛ gboiŋ.”

english_verse: Is it possible to rescue victims from someone strong and cruel?
translation_verse: Ani anyɛɔ ashɔ̃ɔ nii ni kãkãlɔ eyaha yɛ edɛŋ? Aloo anyɛɔ ashɔ̃ɔ nomii ni hewalɔ emɔmɔ yɛ edɛŋ?

english_verse: But the Lord has promised to fight on our side and to rescue our children from those strong and violent enemies.
translation_verse: Shi bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Aashɔ̃ kãkãlɔ dɛŋ nomii lɛ, ni hewalɔ haanii lɛ, aaahe yɛ edɛŋ, ejaakɛ mɔ ni kɛ bo aaana lɛ, mi kɛ lɛ ena, ni mahere bii lɛ ayiwala.

english_verse: He will make those cruel people dine on their own flesh and get drunk from drinking their own blood. Then everyone will know that the Lord is our Savior; the powerful God of Israel has rescued his people.
translation_verse: Maha ohaolɔi lɛ agbegbee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe, ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛlá aaatɔ amɛ dãa. Kɛkɛ lɛ adesai fɛɛ aaana ale akɛ Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛ-Kpɔ̃lɔ kɛ Yiwalaherelɔ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord says, “Children, I didn't divorce your mother or sell you to pay debts; I divorced her and sold you because of your sins.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Nɛgbɛ nyɛnyɛ shwiemɔ wolo ni mikɛshwie lɛ lɛ yɔɔ? Minyɔjiatsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ namɔ mihɔɔ nyɛ miha? Dabida! Nyɛnishaianii lɛ ahewɔ ni ahɔɔ nyɛ, ni nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ahewɔ ashwie nyɛnyɛ.

english_verse: I came and called out, but you didn't answer. Have I lost my power to rescue and save? At my command oceans and rivers turn into deserts; fish rot and stink for lack of water.
translation_verse: “Mɛɛba miba, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ? Mɛɛba mibo mitsɛ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko hereee mi nɔ lɛ? Ani minine efo kuku bɔ ni minyɛɛɛ mɔ yiwala mahere? Aloo mibɛ hewalɛ ni mikɛaakpɔ̃ mɔ? Naa, mifãa, ni ŋshɔ miiɔ. Mihãa fai gbiɔ ni amɛtsɔmɔɔ tamɔ shiaŋa, ni amɛmli loi gboiɔ ni amɛshaa, ejaakɛ amɛnaaa nu.

english_verse: I make the sky turn dark like the sackcloth you wear at funerals.” God's Servant Must Suffer
translation_verse: Mihãa ŋwɛi dĩɔ, ni ebuɔ kpekpe.” Su ni sa ni Yehowa Tsulɔ ahi

english_verse: The Lord God gives me the right words to encourage the weary. Each morning he awakens me eager to learn his teaching;
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ eha mi nilelɔ lilɛi bɔ ni afee ni male bɔ ni mikɛ miwiemɔ akanya mɔ ni egbede aha. Daa leebi lɛ, ehɛleɔ mi shi, ni egbeleɔ mitoiŋ koni mibo nɔ ni eyɔɔ mi tsɔ̃ɔmɔ toi akɛ kaselɔ.

english_verse: he made me willing to listen and not rebel or run away.
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ eha mi niiashishinumɔ, ni mitseko ehiɛ atua, asaŋ minaaa sɛɛsɛɛ.

english_verse: I let them beat my back and pull out my beard. I didn't turn aside when they insulted me and spit in my face.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ mikotosɛɛ miha yilɔi kɛ midabii hu miha mɛi ni famɔɔ tsɛŋ; ni mijooo hiɛgbele kɛ lajɔ̃ naa foi.

english_verse: But the Lord God keeps me from being disgraced. So I refuse to give up, because I know God will never let me down.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ yeɔ ebuaa mi; no hewɔ lɛ, mihiɛ eshwieko shi; no hewɔ ni mimia mihiɛ kɛdamɔ naa; ni mile akɛ mihiɛ eshwieŋ shi.

english_verse: My protector is nearby; no one can stand here to accuse me of wrong.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni buɔ mi bem lɛ ebɛŋkɛ. Namɔ kɛ mi aaaye sane? Ha wɔ fɛɛ wɔdamɔ shi. Namɔ ji mɔ ni ekɛ mi ena? Ha ekɛ mi akpe!

english_verse: The Lord God will help me and prove I am innocent. My accusers will wear out like moth-eaten clothes.
translation_verse: Naa, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni yeɔ buaa mi. Namɔ aaabu mi fɔ? Naa, amɛ fɛɛ amɛaasuu tamɔ atade ni omlɛgɛ aaaye amɛ.

english_verse: None of you respect the Lord or obey his servant. You walk in the dark instead of the light; you don't trust the name of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Nyɛteŋ namɔ sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei? Namɔ boɔ etsulɔ lɛ gbee toi? Kɛji mɔ lɛ nyiɛ duŋ mli, ni la etsooo hãaa lɛ po, hã ekɛ ehiɛ afɔ Yehowa gbɛi lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ ehe akpasa eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Go ahead and walk in the light of the fires you have set. But with his own hand, the Lord will punish you and make you suffer.
translation_verse: Naa, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛwoɔ la koni eshã mɛi, nyɛ moŋ nyɛhiɛ aaakpãtã. Nɔ ni nyɛbaana kɛaajɛ midɛŋ nɛ, Haomɔ mli nyɛaajwere. Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ moŋ nyɛaanyiɛ la ni nyɛwo lɛ mli.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey the Lord, follow Abraham's example. He was the rock from which you were chipped.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtaoɔ ni akpɔ̃ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛboa mi toi! Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtaoɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ, nyɛjwɛŋa tɛsaa ni agba nyɛ kɛjɛ mli lɛ, kɛ tɛ bu ni atsa nyɛ kɛjɛ mli lɛ he.

english_verse: God chose Abraham and Sarah to be your ancestors. The Lord blessed Abraham, and from that one man came many descendants.
translation_verse: Nyɛkwɛa nyɛtsɛ Abraham kɛ Sara, mɛi amli ni nyɛjɛ lɛ. Be ni mitsɛ Abraham lɛ, ekome ni; shi mijɔɔ lɛ, ni mihã ewo shwiei babaoo.

english_verse: Though Zion is in ruins, the Lord will bring comfort, and the city will be as lovely as the garden of Eden that he provided. Then Zion will celebrate; it will be thankful and sing joyful songs. The Lord's Victory Will Last
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa baashɛje Yerusalɛm mii; ebaashɛje hei fɛɛ ni efee koikoi lɛ amii; ebaahã eŋa lɛ nɔ atsɔ̃ tamɔ Eden; ni eshiaŋa lɛ baatsɔ tamɔ Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ abɔɔ. Jɛi baasɔ kɛ mliflimɔ kɛ nyamɔ kɛ shidaa lalai.

english_verse: The Lord says: You are my people and nation! So pay attention to me. My teaching will cause justice to shine like a light for every nation.
translation_verse: “Mimaŋbii, nyɛboa mi toi! Mimaŋ, nyɛfea toi nyɛhãa mi! Ejaakɛ mibawo mla, ni mijalɛ saneyeli aaatso la aha majimaji lɛ.

english_verse: Those who live across the sea are eagerly waiting for me to rescue them. I am strong and ready; soon I will come to save and to rule all nations.
translation_verse: Midɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ be lɛ ebɛŋkɛ etã; miyiwalaheremɔ lɛ baaje kpo, ni mi diɛŋtsɛ maye majimaji lɛ anɔ. Ŋshɔnaa shikpɔji lɛ miikwɛ mi gbɛ, ni amɛhiɛ kã mihewalɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Look closely at the sky! Stare at the earth. The sky will vanish like smoke; the earth will wear out like clothes. Everyone on this earth will die like flies. But my victory will last; my saving power never ends.
translation_verse: Nyɛwoa nyɛhiɛ nɔ nyɛkwɛa ŋwɛi; ni nyɛkwɛa shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shishi hu. Ejaakɛ ŋwɛi baalaaje tamɔ lasu, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baasuu tamɔ atade ni enɔ gbɔmɛi aaagboi tamɔ adɔdɔji; shi miyiwalaheremɔ lɛ aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ, ni mikpɔmɔ lɛ bɛ naagbee.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey my teaching with all your heart, then pay close attention. Don't be discouraged when others insult you and say hurtful things.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni le nɔ ni ji jalɛ, nyɛboa toi, nyɛ maŋbii ni mimla lɛ yɔɔ nyɛtsuiiaŋ, nyɛkashea adesa dɛŋ ahorabɔɔ gbeyei! Asaŋ nyɛtsuii akafãa yɛ limɔ ni aaali nyɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: They will be eaten away like a moth-eaten coat. But my victory will last; my saving power will never end. A Prayer for the Lord's Help
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã tamɔ mama ni omlɛgɛ eye, loo kuŋtu ni gɔgɔmii eye. Shi mikpɔmɔ lɛ aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ; ni miyiwalaheremɔ lɛ aaahi shi yinɔi fɛɛ.

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord. Be strong and ready. Wake up! Do what you did for our people long ago. Didn't you chop up Rahab the monster?
translation_verse: Tee shi, tee shi koo! Yehowa, wo ohewalɛ nine lɛ nɔ. Tee shi tamɔ ofee blema ko lɛ, tamɔ yɛ jeeŋmɔ yinɔi komɛi anɔ lɛ. Aso jeee bo ofolɔ ŋshɔŋ kooloo Rahab lɛ mli dukuduku lɛ? Aso jeee bo ofolɔ kooloo drako gbeyeigbeyei lɛ mli lɛ?

english_verse: Didn't you dry up the deep sea and make a road for your people to follow safely across?
translation_verse: Aso jeee bo oha ŋshɔ mii lɛ? Ani jeee bo oha bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli nu mii, ni ogba gbɛ yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli oha mɛi ni okpɔ̃ amɛ lɛ, ni amɛfo mli kɛho lɛ?

english_verse: Now those you have rescued will return to Jerusalem, singing on their way. They will be crowned with great happiness, never again to be burdened with sadness and sorrow. The Lord Gives Hope
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mɛi ni Yehowa ekpɔ̃ amɛ lɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ, ni amɛaaba Zion kɛ lala. Amɛaanya, ni amɛmii aaashɛ; amɛyeŋ awerɛho lɛ, amɛdɔmɔŋ ŋtsɔi dɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: I am the Lord, the one who encourages you. Why are you afraid of mere humans? They dry up and die like grass.
translation_verse: Yehowa miikɛɛ akɛ, “Mi mishɛjeɔ nyɛmii! Mɛɛba osheɔ adesa ni baagbo, adesa ni etamɔ jwɛi gbeyei,

english_verse: I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. But you have forgotten me, your Lord and Creator. All day long you were afraid of those who were angry and hoped to oppress you. Where are they now?
translation_verse: ni ohiɛ ekpa Yehowa, obɔlɔ lɛ, moŋ nɔ? Ohiɛ ekpa mɔ ni lɛɛ ŋwɛi mli eha shi, ni eto je lɛ shishi lɛ nɔ? Mɛɛba osheɔ gbeyei jenamɔ tuu yɛ haolɔ lɛ grimɔ kɛ ehe ni esaa kɛkpãtã ohiɛ lɛ hewɔ? Ni nɛgbɛ haolɔ lɛ grimɔ lɛ yɔɔ po?

english_verse: Everyone crying out in pain will be quickly set free; they will be rescued from the power of death and never go hungry.
translation_verse: Etsɛŋ kwraa ni aaaŋmɛɛɛ gboklɛfoi lɛ ahe; amɛgboiŋ, ni amɛwala sɛɛ baatsɛ, ni nɔ ni amɛaaye ebɔŋ amɛ.

english_verse: I will help them because I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful, who makes the ocean roar.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni teɔ ŋshɔ shi, ni emli ŋshɔkei feɔ hamahama lɛ. Migbɛi ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ.

english_verse: I have told you what to say, and I will keep you safe in the palm of my hand. I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. Now I say, “Jerusalem, your people are mine.” A Warning to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Mi milɛɛ ŋwɛi mli miha shi, ni mito je lɛ shishi. Mikɛɛ Yerusalɛm akɛ, ‘Miwebii ji nyɛ! Mikɛ miwiemɔi lɛ ewo nyɛnaa, ni mikɛ minine miibu nyɛhe.’ ” Yerusalɛm nɔnaa naagbee

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up! You've drunk too much from the cup filled with the Lord's anger. You have swallowed every drop, and you can't walk straight.
translation_verse: Ao Yerusalɛm, wo ohe nɔ! Wo ohe nɔ! Tee shi odamɔ shi! Onu toigbalamɔ kpulu lɛ mli dãa ni jɛ Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ dɛŋ lɛ. Ni onu owo omli, ni olɛmɔ kpulu lɛ mli, ni eha oodidãa.

english_verse: Not one of your many children is there to guide you or to offer a helping hand.
translation_verse: Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ebii ni efɔ lɛ ateŋ ni aaatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ gbɛ; mɔ kome folo nɛkɛ bɛ bii ni elɛ lɛ ateŋ ni aaamɔ enine mli.

english_verse: You have been destroyed by war and by famine; I cannot comfort you.
translation_verse: Saji enyɔ nɛɛ eba onɔ: ta ekpãtã oshikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni hɔmɔ hu eye omaŋbii. Namɔ aaashɛje omii?

english_verse: The Lord your God is angry, and on every street corner your children lie helpless, like deer trapped in nets.
translation_verse: Obii lɛ etɔ biti; amɛkamɔkamɔɔ shi yɛ blohui lɛ fɛɛ akoji tamɔ baayelɔ ni adu lɛ yɛ tsɔne mli. Amɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ Yehowa mlila kɛ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kãmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You are in trouble and drunk, but not from wine. So pay close attention
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ Yerusalɛm nɔnalɔi ni nyɛdidãa tsɛbelɛ nyɛtɔrɔko dãa, nyɛboa toi,

english_verse: to the Lord your God, who defends you and says, “I have taken from your hands the cup filled with my anger that made you drunk. You will never be forced to drink it again.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni yeɔ emaŋ lɛ sane ehaa lɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Naa, mihe didãamɔ dãa kpulu lɛ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ; nyɛnuŋ mimlifu naa kpulu lɛ mli dãa lɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Instead I will give it to your brutal enemies, who treated you like dirt and walked all over you.”
translation_verse: Maŋɔ maha nyɛhaolɔi lɛ, mɛi ni kɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkamɔa shi koni wɔnyiɛa nyɛnɔ kɛhoa.’ Ni nyɛtsɔ tamɔ gbɛjegbɛ koni wɔnyiɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up and be strong. Holy city of Zion, dress in your best clothes. Those foreigners who ruined your sacred city won't bother you again.
translation_verse: Ao Yerusalɛm, ohiɛ atsɛ̃! Ohiɛ atsɛ̃! Teemɔ ohewalɛ lɛ shi! Ao Yerusalɛm, maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ, wulamɔ kɛ otadei fɛɛfɛji lɛ, ejaakɛ foolɔi kɛ mɛi ni he tseee boteŋ ogboi lɛ mli dɔŋŋ!

english_verse: Zion, rise from the dirt! Free yourself from the rope around your neck. Suffering Will End
translation_verse: Ao Yerusalɛm ni aŋɔ bo nom, tee shi? Kpokpomɔ ohe mlu lɛ, Tee shi ota shi! Zion biyoo ni aŋɔ bo nom, fɛnemɔ kpãa ni yɔɔ okuɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord says: My people, you were sold, but not for money; now you will be set free, but not for a payment.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Be ni ahɔɔ nyɛ lɛ aheee nyɛyi shika ko; ni jeee shika hu akɛbaakpɔ nyɛ. Shi bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ,

english_verse: Long ago you went to Egypt where you lived as foreigners. Then Assyria was cruel to you,
translation_verse: “Jeeŋmɔ ko lɛ, mimaŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ tee Ijipt ni eyahi jɛi akɛ gbɔi. Shi Asiriabii lɛ wa amɛyi yakatswaa.

english_verse: and now another nation has taken you prisoner for no reason at all. Your leaders groan with pain, and day after day my own name is cursed.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ mɛni mafee yɛ he akɛni miina mimaŋ lɛ ni Babilonbii ŋɔ amɛ nom yakatswaa lɛ? Amɛnɔyelɔi lɛ shwãa kɛkɛ amɛshwãa, Yehowa kɛɛ, ni gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ amɛgbeɔ migbɛi lɛ he guɔ.

english_verse: My people, you will learn who I am and who is speaking because I am here. A Message of Hope for Jerusalem
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mimaŋbii lɛ aaale migbɛi lɛ; ejaakɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛaale akɛ mi ji mɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Naa, mi nɛ lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: What a beautiful sight! On the mountains a messenger announces to Jerusalem, “Good news! You're saved. There will be peace. Your God is now King.”
translation_verse: Kwɛ bɔ ni sanekpakpashiɛlɔ ni shiɛɔ hejɔlɛ, sanekpakpashiɛlɔ ni shiɛɔ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ naji yɔɔ fɛo yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, mɔ ni kɛɔ Zion akɛ, “Naa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni yeɔ maŋtsɛ agbɛnɛ.”

english_verse: Everyone on guard duty, sing and celebrate! Look! You can see the Lord returning to Zion.
translation_verse: Bo toi! Omɛi ni buɔ maŋ lɛ he lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm ehole amɛgbei anɔ, ni amɛmiila kɛ miishɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛmiina faŋŋ akɛ Yehowa eku esɛɛ kɛmiiba Zion!

english_verse: Jerusalem, rise from the ruins! Join in the singing. The Lord has given comfort to his people; he comes to your rescue.
translation_verse: Yerusalɛm tsui koikoi, nyɛ fɛɛ tswɛm nyɛwoa nyamɔ lala nɔ! Ejaakɛ Yehowa eshɛje emaŋ lɛ mii, ehere Yerusalɛm yiwala.

english_verse: The Lord has shown all nations his mighty strength; now everyone will see the saving power of our God. A Command To Leave Babylon
translation_verse: Yehowa ejie ehewalɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ majimaji lɛ fɛɛ, ni jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ aaana wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Leave the city of Babylon! Don't touch anything filthy. Wash yourselves. Be ready to carry back everything sacred that belongs to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛtereɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ nibii lɛ, nyɛkataa nɔ ko ni he tseee he; nyɛtsuua nyɛhe, ni nyɛshĩa, nyɛshĩa Babilon nyɛyaa.

english_verse: You won't need to run. No one is chasing you. The Lord God of Israel will lead and protect you from enemy attacks. The Suffering Servant
translation_verse: Shi moŋ nyɛshĩŋ nyɛyaŋ yɛ hejojomɔ naa; ni asaŋ jeee yɛ foijee naa hu; ejaakɛ Yehowa baanyiɛ nyɛhiɛ ni Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ baanyiɛ nyɛsɛɛ. Tsulɔ Nɔnalɔ lɛ

english_verse: The Lord says: My servant will succeed! He will be given great praise and the highest honors.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Naa, mitsulɔ lɛ baashwere, aaawo ehiɛ nyam, ni aaawo enɔ; aaawo enɔ gojoo.

english_verse: Many were horrified at what happened to him. But everyone who saw him was even more horrified because he suffered until he no longer looked human.
translation_verse: Mɛi babaoo ahe aaajɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ ehewɔ; ejaakɛ ehiɛ efite bɔ ni ehiɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ dɔŋŋ; egbɔmɔtso su tamɔɔɔ gbɔmɛi adesai anɔ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: My servant will make nations worthy to worship me; kings will be silent as they bow in wonder. They will see and think about things they have never seen or thought about before.
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ eeehã maji babaoo anaa akpɛ amɛhe; Maŋtsɛmɛi aaamua amɛnaa yɛ ehewɔ, ejaakɛ amɛbaana nii ni agbako amɛ dã, ni amɛbaanu nɔ ni amɛnuko dã lɛ shishi.”

english_verse: Has anyone believed us or seen the mighty power of the Lord in action?
translation_verse: Maŋbii lɛ to he akɛ, “Namɔ aaahe sane ni wɔnu lɛ eye? Ni namɔ Yehowa ejie ehewalɛ nine lɛ kpo etsɔɔ?

english_verse: Like a young plant or a root that sprouts in dry ground, the servant grew up obeying the Lord. He wasn't some handsome king. Nothing about the way he looked made him attractive to us.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ekwɛ̃ yɛ ehiɛ tamɔ tso fɔ, tamɔ tso shishi fã ni etsɛ̃ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ mli. Ehe bɛ nyam lɛ, ebɛ su ko hu ni aaaha wɔkwɛ lɛ; ni ehe bɛ fɛo ko hu ni aaaha ehe afee wɔ akɔnɔ.

english_verse: He was hated and rejected; his life was filled with sorrow and terrible suffering. No one wanted to look at him. We despised him and said, “He is a nobody!”
translation_verse: Agbe ehe guɔ, ni gbɔmɛi kwa lɛ, eye awerɛho, ni ele hejaramɔ etamɔ mɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ hiɛ atoɔ afã kɛ ana lɛ lɛ. Agbe ehe guɔ, ni wɔbuuu lɛ wɔhãaa fɛifɛi.

english_verse: He suffered and endured great pain for us, but we thought his suffering was punishment from God.
translation_verse: “Anɔkwa, wɔhelai lɛ, lɛ etere, ni wɔhejaramɔi lɛ, lɛ ehole eshwie enɔ. Shi wɔ lɛ, wɔbu lɛ akɛ mɔ ko kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbala etoi, ni ena nɔ.

english_verse: He was wounded and crushed because of our sins; by taking our punishment, he made us completely well.
translation_verse: Shi apila lɛ yɛ wɔ moŋ wɔtɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ; atswia lɛ nii yɛ wɔnishaianii lɛ ahewɔ. Agbala etoi koni wɔna hejɔlɛ, ni ehe faji lɛ akɛtsaa wɔ.

english_verse: All of us were like sheep that had wandered off. We had each gone our own way, but the Lord gave him the punishment we deserved.
translation_verse: Wɔ fɛɛ tswɛm wɔtamɔ toi ni edu gbɛ. Wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ekɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛ, ni Yehowa kɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔnɔsha lɛ fɔ̃ enɔ.

english_verse: He was painfully abused, but he did not complain. He was silent like a lamb being led to the butcher, as quiet as a sheep having its wool cut off.
translation_verse: Afee lɛ niseniianii, ni apiŋ lɛ, kɛ̃lɛ etswaaa esɛŋ. Bɔ ni too gwantɛŋbi ni akɛ lɛ yaa ayagbe lɛ, loo too gwantɛŋbi feɔ dioo yɛ ehetsɔikulɔi ahiɛ lɛ, nakai etswaaa esɛŋ lɛ.

english_verse: He was condemned to death without a fair trial. Who could have imagined what would happen to him? His life was taken away because of the sinful things my people had done.
translation_verse: Aye lɛ toikɔdɔmɔ sane, ni aŋɔ lɛ kɛtee. Namɔ aaanyɛ asusu nɔ ni aaaba enɔ? Ejaakɛ asha lɛ kɛje hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛtee. Mimaŋbii lɛ atɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ apiŋ lɛ lɛ!

english_verse: He wasn't dishonest or violent, but he was buried in a tomb among cruel, rich people.
translation_verse: Atsa ebu yɛ eshafeelɔi ateŋ, tsɛbelɛ efeko esha ko lɛ, emaleko hu dã, ni afu lɛ yɛ niiatsɛmɛi ateŋ.

english_verse: The Lord decided his servant would suffer as a sacrifice to take away the sin and guilt of others. Now the servant will live to see his own descendants. He did everything the Lord had planned.
translation_verse: “Eji Yehowa yiŋtoo akɛ atswa lɛ nɔ, ni apila lɛ. Kɛji eŋɔ ehe eshã afɔle yɛ esha hewɔ lɛ, ebaana shwiei ni ewala sɛɛ aaatsɛ, ni kɛtsɔ̃ lɛ enɔ lɛ, nɔ ni sa Yehowa hiɛ lɛ aaashwere.

english_verse: By suffering, the servant will learn the true meaning of obeying the Lord. Although he is innocent, he will take the punishment for the sins of others, so that many of them will no longer be guilty.
translation_verse: Esusuma haomɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, eeena nii ni aaahã etsui anyɔ emli. Kɛtsɔ̃ mitsulɔ jalɔ lɛ nilee nɔ lɛ, eeehã aŋɔ mɛi babaoo akɛ jalɔi, ni eeetere amɛnishaianii lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will reward him with honor and power for sacrificing his life. Others thought he was a sinner, but he suffered for our sins and asked God to forgive us.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, maha lɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ mɛi wuji ateŋ; ni ekɛ hewalɔi aaaja haanii, ejaakɛ eŋɔ ehe eha gbele, ni abu lɛ ashi mlanɔtɔlɔi anɔ, kɛ̃lɛ etere mɛi pii ahe eshai, ni edamɔ mli eha eshafeelɔi.”

english_verse: Sing and shout, even though you have never had children! The Lord has promised that you will have more children than someone married for a long time.
translation_verse: “Yerusalɛm, yoo kene, wó nyamɔ lala nɔ! Bo ni okɔ̃mɔko dã, blɔmɔ kɛ miishɛɛ! Ejaakɛ mɔ ni ewu kwa lɛ lɛ, ebii ayi baafa fe mɔ ni yɔɔ wu lɛ bii.”

english_verse: Make your tents larger! Spread out the tent pegs; fasten them firmly.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Lɛɛmɔ obuu lɛ mli, kpã oshihilɛhe lɛ mamai lɛ amli. Kaalɛte he; ha etaŋkpei lɛ akɛlɛ, ni okala oshiŋmlitsei lɛ ni awa.

english_verse: You and your descendants will take over the land of other nations. You will settle in towns that are now in ruins.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ooolɛɛ shi kɛya ninejurɔgbɛ kɛ abɛkugbɛ fɛɛ; ni oshwiei aaaye majimaji anɔ, ni amɛaahe shi yɛ maji ni kamɔ shi amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ amli.

english_verse: Don't be afraid or ashamed and don't be discouraged. You won't be disappointed. Forget how sinful you were when you were young; stop feeling ashamed for being left a widow.
translation_verse: Kaashe gbeyei! Ejaakɛ ohiɛ eshwieŋ shi; ni ohe akajara bo, ejaakɛ agbeŋ ohiɛ dɔŋŋ. Ejaakɛ ohiɛ aaakpa oblayeiaŋ hiɛgbele lɛ nɔ, ni okulafeemɔ mli hejaramɔ lɛ okaiŋ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the Holy God of Israel, rules all the earth. He is your Creator and husband, and he will rescue you.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ obɔlɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ wu aha bo. Yehowa Taiatsɛ ji egbɛi, ni Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Koome lɛ ji Okpɔ̃lɔ lɛ. Je lɛ fɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji egbɛi.

english_verse: You were like a young wife, brokenhearted and crying because her husband had divorced her. But the Lord your God says, “I am taking you back!
translation_verse: Yehowa miitsɛ bo kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Israel, otamɔ yoo ni ewu ekwa lɛ, ni eeye ŋkɔmɔ yɛ mumɔ mli, tamɔ oblahiiaŋ ŋa ni ashwie lɛ.

english_verse: I rejected you for a while, but with love and tenderness I will embrace you again.
translation_verse: Hiŋmɛitswaa kɛkɛ mikwa bo, shi mikɛ mlitsɔlɛ kpele baabua onaa.

english_verse: For a while, I turned away in furious anger. Now I will have mercy and love you forever! I, your protector and Lord, make this promise.” The Lord Promises Lasting Peace
translation_verse: Mikɛ mihiɛ tee bo hiŋmɛitswaa yɛ mlifu ni eteke nɔ naa; shi mikɛ naanɔ suɔmɔ aaahã mimusuŋ atsɔ̃ mi yɛ ohewɔ.” Bɔ ni Yehowa, bo-Kpɔ̃lɔ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ,

english_verse: I once promised Noah that I would never again destroy the earth by a flood. Now I have promised that I will never again get angry and punish you.
translation_verse: “Be nɛɛ tamɔ Noa be lɛ ha mi. Bɔ ni mikã kitã akɛ Noa be lɛ mli nu afua lɛ ebahaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ, nakai mikãa kitã akɛ mimli fuŋ bo, ni mikaŋ ohiɛ.

english_verse: Every mountain and hill may disappear. But I will always be kind and merciful to you; I won't break my agreement to give your nation peace. The New Jerusalem
