translation_verse: Gɔji lɛ aaaje amɛshihilɛhei lɛ aya, ni gɔŋkpɔi lɛ hu aaafamɔ kɛaatee nɛ, shi suɔmɔ ni miyɔɔ ha bo lɛ tsakeŋ, ni mi kɛ bo teŋ toiŋjɔlɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ hu mikuŋ mli.” Bɔ ni Yehowa mɔ ni musuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ ohe lɛ kɛɛ nɛ,

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are sad and discouraged, tossed around in a storm. But I, the Lord, will rebuild your city with precious stones; for your foundation I will use blue sapphires.
translation_verse: “Ao Yerusalɛm ni apiŋ bo, maŋ ni ahum tswa bo, shi ashɛjeee omii, naa, mikɛ ojarawatɛi baatswa bo mama shi, ni mikɛ safiro tɛ baatswa oshishitoo lɛ.

english_verse: Your fortresses will be built of rubies, your gates of jewels, and your walls of gems.
translation_verse: Mikɛ rubi tɛ baatswa omɔji lɛ, ni mikɛ ojarawa tɛ baafee ogboi lɛ, ni ohe gbogbo lɛ hu, mikɛ tɛi ni jara wa baatswa.

english_verse: I will teach your children and make them successful.
translation_verse: Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ ni baatsɔ̃ɔ omli bii lɛ nii, ni amɛbaashwere jogbaŋŋ.

english_verse: You will be built on fairness with no fears of injustice; every one of your worries will be taken far from you.
translation_verse: Jalɛ shihilɛ aaahe shi yɛ omli. Yiwalɛ nifeemɔ kɛ bo teŋ baajekɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, osheŋ gbeyei; ni tsuifãa nifeemɔ bɛŋkɛŋ bo; no hewɔ lɛ otsui efaŋ.

english_verse: I will never send anyone to attack your city, and you will make prisoners of those who do attack.
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ko aaabatua bo lɛ, jeee mi ejɛ; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaate shi awo bo lɛ, lɛ moŋ ebaagbee shi.

english_verse: Don't forget that I created metalworkers who make weapons over burning coals. I also created armies that can bring destruction.
translation_verse: “Naa, mi, mibɔ sɔ̃lɔ mɔ ni huɔ ŋai la ekɛsɔ̃ɔ tawuunii lɛ. Ni mi nɔŋŋ mibɔ tabilɔ mɔ ni kpãtãa nibii ahiɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Weapons made to attack you won't be successful; words spoken against you won't hurt at all. My servants, Jerusalem is yours! I, the Lord, promise to bless you with victory.
translation_verse: Shi tawuunii ko kwraa bɛ ni asɔ̃ ni aaanyɛ bo awui aye. Ooona hetoo oha wiemɔ fɛɛ wiemɔ ni aaawie ashi bo. Enɛ ji nɔ ni asaa ato. Yehowa tsuji agboshinii kɛ amɛjalɛ ni jɛ midɛŋ lɛ.” Yehowa kɛɛ.

english_verse: If you are thirsty, come and drink water! If you don't have any money, come, eat what you want! Drink wine and milk without paying a cent.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Huui! Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni kumai yeɔ nyɛ, nyɛbaa nu he! Nyɛ mɛi hu ni bɛ shika, nyɛbaa nyɛbahea ŋmãa nyɛyea! Nyɛbaa! Nyɛbahea wain kɛ fufɔ, jeee kɛ shika shi moŋ kɛ nyɛdɛ folo.

english_verse: Why waste your money on what really isn't food? Why work hard for something that doesn't satisfy? Listen carefully to me, and you will enjoy the very best foods.
translation_verse: Mɛɛba nyɛkɔɔ shika nyɛkɛheɔ nɔ ni jeee ŋmãa? Ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnitsumɔŋ nyɔmɔwoo heɔ nɔ ni hãaa mɔ atɔ? Nyɛboa mi toi jogbaŋŋ, ni nyɛfea nɔ ni makɛɛ nyɛ lɛ, ni nyɛaaye niyenii kpakpa fe fɛɛ, ni nyɛmii aaashɛ.

english_verse: Pay close attention! Come to me and live. I will promise you the eternal love and loyalty that I promised David.
translation_verse: “Nyɛfea toi, ni nyɛbaa miŋɔɔ! Nyɛboa mi toi, ni nyɛyi aaana wala. Mi kɛ nyɛ baakpãŋ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ, ni ji mimɔbɔnalɛ ni sɛɛ efooo ni mikɛwo David shi lɛ.

english_verse: I made him the leader and ruler of the nations; he was my witness to them.
translation_verse: Naa, mifee lɛ majimaji lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ kɛ tatsɛ, koni etsɔ̃ mihe odaseyelɔ ehã majimaji lɛ.

english_verse: You will call out to nations you have never known. And they have never known you, but they will come running because I am the Lord, the holy God of Israel, and I have honored you. God's Words Are Powerful
translation_verse: Naa, ooofɔ̃ nine otsɛ maji ni oleee; ni maji ni leee bo hu aaahiɛ foi kɛaaba oŋɔɔ, yɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ ewo ohiɛ nyam!

english_verse: Turn to the Lord! He can still be found. Call out to God! He is near.
translation_verse: Nyɛtaoa Yehowa be mli ni eeehã ana lɛ. Nyɛtsɛa lɛ be mli ni ebɛŋkɛ.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and your evil thoughts. Return to the Lord our God. He will be merciful and forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Ha mɔ fɔŋ lɛ akwa ejeŋba fɔŋ lɛ; ni nɔshafeelɔ atsake ejwɛŋmɔ. Ha eku esɛɛ kɛba Yehowa ŋɔɔ ni emusuŋ aaatsɔ lɛ yɛ ehewɔ. Ekpale kɛba wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni ekɛaafa lɛ aahu.

english_verse: The Lord says: “My thoughts and my ways are not like yours.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Ejaakɛ jeee mijwɛŋmɔi ji nyɛjwɛŋmɔi lɛ, ni jeee nyɛgbɛi lɛ ji migbɛi lɛ.

english_verse: Just as the heavens are higher than the earth, my thoughts and my ways are higher than yours.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bɔ ni ŋwɛi kwɔ fe shikpɔŋ lɛ, nakai migbɛi lɛ kwɔ fe nyɛgbɛi lɛ, ni mijwɛŋmɔ kwɔ fe nyɛjwɛŋmɔi lɛ.

english_verse: “Rain and snow fall from the sky. But they don't return without watering the earth that produces seeds to plant and grain to eat.
translation_verse: “Ejaakɛ bɔ ni nu kɛ snoo nɛɔ kɛjɛɔ ŋwɛi shwieɔ shi, ni ekuuu esɛɛ kɛyaaa ŋwɛi, akɛ ja eha shikpɔŋ lɛ nu, ni eha eba nii, ni ewo yibii, ni eha nidulɔ wui, ni ekɛ niyenii eha mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ.

english_verse: That's how it is with my words. They don't return to me without doing everything I send them to do.” God's People Will Celebrate
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ ni wiemɔ ni jɛɔ midaaŋ lɛ hu aaafee. Ekuŋ esɛɛ kɛbaŋ miŋɔɔ efolo, shi moŋ eeetsu nɔ ni mito mihã lɛ lɛ; ni eeeye kunim yɛ nɔ hewɔ ni mitsu lɛ lɛ mli.

english_verse: When you are set free, you will celebrate and travel home in peace. Mountains and hills will sing as you pass by, and trees will clap.
translation_verse: “Ejaakɛ nyɛbaashi Babilon kɛ nyamɔ, ni aaakpala nyɛ kɛshi yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ mli. Gɔji lɛ kɛ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ aaawo nyamɔ lala nɔ yɛ nyɛhiɛ, ni ŋa nɔ tsei lɛ fɛɛ aaatswa amɛdɛ̃ kɛ miishɛɛ.

english_verse: Cypress and myrtle trees will grow in fields once covered by thorns. And then those trees will stand as a lasting witness to the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋmeitso najiaŋ lɛ, sɛsɛo aaakwɛ̃, ni aklati najiaŋ lɛ, shɔ̃ aaakwɛ̃. Enɛ baatsɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kaimɔ nɔ, kaimɔ nɔ ni aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ tɔ̃ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Be honest and fair! Soon I will come to save you; my saving power will be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Nyɛyea jalɛ sane, ni nyɛfea nɔ ni ja, ejaakɛ midɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ eshɛ shi etã, ni abaajie lɛ kpo atsɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: Foreigners who worship me must not say, “The Lord won't let us be part of his people.” Men who are unable to become fathers must no longer say, “We are dried-up trees.”
translation_verse: Gbɔ ni kɛ ehe ebakpɛtɛ Yehowa lɛ ekakɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa baajie mi yɛ emɛi lɛ ateŋ.” Osai hu akakɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, tso gbiŋ kɛkɛ ji mi, ni abuŋ mi ashiŋ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ anɔ.”

english_verse: To them, I, the Lord, say: Respect the Sabbath, obey me completely, and keep our agreement.
translation_verse: Osaii ni yeɔ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ, ni amɛfeɔ nii ni sa mihiɛ, ni amɛhiɛɔ mikpãŋmɔ lɛ mli tswɛ lɛ,

english_verse: Then you will be like monuments in my temple with your names written on them. This will be much better than having children, because these monuments will stand there forever.
translation_verse: maha amɛna gbɛi yɛ miSɔlemɔ we lɛ kɛ mimaŋbii lɛ ateŋ, gbɛi ni hi fe bihii kɛ biyei. Maha amɛna gbɛi ni baahi shi kɛya naanɔ fɛɛ, ni agbeŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: Foreigners will follow me. They will love me and worship in my name; they will respect the Sabbath and keep our agreement.
translation_verse: Gbɔi ni kɛ amɛhe baakpɛtɛ Yehowa koni amɛsɔmɔ lɛ ni amɛsumɔ egbɛi lɛ, asaŋ koni amɛtsɔmɔ etsuji lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ ni toɔ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ, ni amɛhiɛɔ mikpãŋmɔ lɛ mli kpɛŋŋ lɛ,

english_verse: I will bring them to my holy mountain, where they will celebrate in my house of worship. Their sacrifices and offerings will always be welcome on my altar. Then my house will be known as a house of worship for all nations.
translation_verse: amɛ ji mɛi ni mikɛaaba Zion, ni ji migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni maha amɛnya yɛ miSɔlemɔ we lɛ. Amɛshãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ amɛfɔlei krokomɛi lɛ aaasa mihiɛ yɛ mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Ejaakɛ aaatsɛ miwe lɛ akɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ aSɔlemɔ we.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to bring together my people who were taken away, and let them join the others. God Promises To Punish Israel's Leaders
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa Ofe mɔ ni kpala emaŋ Israel kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ mli kɛku sɛɛ kɛba lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Masaa makpala mɛi krokomɛi kɛba kɛbafata mɛi ni mikpala kɛba momo lɛ ahe.” Abu Israel Maŋhiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ fɔ

english_verse: Come from the forest, you wild animals! Attack and gobble up your victims.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ŋa nɔ kooloi kɛ nyɛ koo mli kooloi hu fɛɛ, nyɛbaa nyɛbayea nii!

english_verse: You leaders of Israel should be watchdogs, protecting my people. But you can't see a thing, and you never warn them. Dozing and daydreaming are all you ever do.
translation_verse: Israel maŋhebulɔi lɛ eshwila; amɛleee nii. Gbei mumui ji amɛ; amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛbolɔ; amɛwieɔ yɛ wɔ mli; amɛkamɔɔ shi, ni amɛsumɔɔ wɔdɔiwɔɔ.

english_verse: You stupid leaders are a pack of hungry and greedy dogs that never get enough. You are shepherds who mistreat your own sheep for selfish gain.
translation_verse: Gbei fulɔi ni; amɛleee mitɔ! Nɛkɛ tookwɛlɔi ni ji maŋhiɛnyiɛlɔi nɛɛ lɛ hu, amɛbɛ jwɛŋmɔ; amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɔlɔ amɛgbɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miifo ekome enɔ mli.

english_verse: You say to each other, “Let's drink till we're drunk! Tomorrow we'll do it again. We'll really enjoy ourselves.”
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa, nyɛhaa wɔwoa wain wɔmaa shi ni wɔnua bɔ ni wɔɔnyɛ. Wɔ hu baatamɔ ŋmɛnɛ, ni eeeteke nɔ po.”

english_verse: but in death they find peace for obeying God. The Lord Condemns Idolatry
translation_verse: Mɛi ni ba amɛjeŋ yɛ jalɛ naa lɛ, amɛyɛ toiŋjɔlɛ mli yɛ gbohiiaje.

english_verse: You people are unfaithful! You go to fortunetellers, and you worship idols. Now pay close attention!
translation_verse: Shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛtsia nyɛbaa biɛ, nyɛ klamɔfoi abii kɛ gbalafitelɔi abii kɛ ajwamãŋi abii.

english_verse: Who are you making fun of? Who are you sneering at? Look how your sins have made fools of you.
translation_verse: Namɛi ahe fɛo nyɛyeɔ lɛ. Namɛi nyɛgbɛɔ nyɛdaaŋ hatoo nyɛwoɔ, ni nyɛliɔ lɛ? Ani jeee toigbolɔi kɛ amalelɔi ashwiei ji nyɛ lo?

english_verse: All you think about is sex under those green trees where idols are worshiped. You sacrifice your children on altars built in valleys under rocky slopes.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ heloo akɔnɔ fɔŋ feɔ yakayakanii yɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni ebu kusuu shishi. Nyɛgbeɔ nyɛmusuŋbii nyɛkɛshãa afɔle yɛ jɔi amli kɛ tɛsaa fɔji amli.

english_verse: You have chosen to worship idols made of stone; you have given them offerings of wine and grain. Should I be pleased?
translation_verse: Nyɛkɔlɔɔ fai anaa fɔbitɛi, ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛjaa amɛ akɛ wɔŋ. Nyɛfɔseɔ dãa nyɛshwieɔ shi nyɛhaa amɛ akɛ afɔle, ni nyɛshãa niyenii afɔle nyɛkɛhaa amɛ. Aso mitsui aaanyɔ mimli yɛ enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ?

english_verse: You have spread out your beds on the tops of high mountains, where you sacrifice to idols.
translation_verse: Nyɛyaa gɔji ni kwɔlɔ somromoo lɛ anɔ nyɛyashãa afɔle, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhe wɔɔ yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: Even in your homes you have placed pagan symbols all around your huge beds. Yes, you have rejected me, sold yourselves to your lovers, and gone to bed with them.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ nyɛmãgãi ni anyaŋeɔ lɛ mamɔɔ nyɛshinai ashi. Nyɛkwaa mi, nyɛjieɔ nyɛyayai amli, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛsuɔlɔi kwɔɔ kɛyaa nyɛsaatsei ni lɛɛlɛɛ anɔ; nyɛwoɔ amɛ nyɔmɔ koni amɛkɛ nyɛ awɔ; jɛi nyɛgbeɔ nyɛkɔnɔ yɛ.

english_verse: You smear on olive oil and all kinds of perfume to worship the god Molech. You even seek advice from spirits of the dead.
translation_verse: Nyɛwoɔ ojeŋmai, ni nyɛkpaa muŋma kɛyaa, ni nyɛyajaa wɔŋ Molek. Otsuɔ obɔfoi kɛyaa shɔŋŋ, kɛyaa gbohiiaje tete.

english_verse: Though you tired yourself out by running after idols, you refused to stop. Your desires were so strong that they kept you going.
translation_verse: Ogba ohe naa kɛtao wɔji krokomɛi, shi okɛɛɛ ohe akɛ, “Sɛɛnamɔ ko bɛ he. Ona hewalɛ hee, no hewɔ lɛ, ogbɔjɔɔɔ.

english_verse: Did you forget about me and become unfaithful because you were more afraid of someone else? Have I been silent so long that you no longer fear me?
translation_verse: “Namɔ gbeyei oshe, ni otsui fã, hewɔ ni omale, ni okaiii mi, ni oyasusuuu mihe lɛ? Aso diŋŋ ni mifee ni miŋamɔ mihiŋmɛii nɛɛ lɛ hewɔ ni osheee mi gbeyei lɛ?

english_verse: You think you're so good, but I'll point out the truth.
translation_verse: Mibajaje ojalɛ ni osusuɔ akɛ oja lɛ kɛ onifeemɔnii hu fɛɛ matsɔ̃ɔ, shi ooona akɛ onaŋ sɛɛ ko yɛ mli.

english_verse: Ask your idols to save you when you are in trouble. Be careful though— it takes only a faint breath to blow them over. But if you come to me for protection, this land and my holy mountain will always belong to you. The Lord Helps the Helpless
translation_verse: Kɛji obolɔ waa lɛ, ha owɔji lɛ ni obua naa lɛ ahere bo! Kɔɔyɔɔ aaaloo amɛ kɛaatee; gugɔ mli kɔɔyɔɔ tete aaaloo amɛ kɛaatee. Shi mɛi ni baa mi abo lɛ aaaŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ amɛye, ni migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ, Zion, lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ.” Nyɔŋmɔ baaye ebua

english_verse: The Lord says, “Clear the road! Get it ready for my people.”
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛjea gbɛ lɛ, nyɛjea! Nyɛjajea gbɛ lɛ. Nyɛjiea pampi fɛɛ pampi yɛ mimaŋbii lɛ agbɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Our holy God lives forever in the highest heavens, and this is what he says: Though I live high above in the holy place, I am here to help those who are humble and depend only on me.
translation_verse: “Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Mɔ Koome ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi flooflo, naanɔ Mɔ ni gbɛi ji Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ kɛ He krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mihiɔ; asaŋ mikɛ mɔ ni tswiaa shi kɛ dɔlɛ ni ebaa ehe shi yɛ mumɔ mli lɛ hiɔ shi,’ koni maha heshibalɔi amumɔ ana wala hee, ni mɛi ni tswiaa shi kɛ dɔlɛ lɛ atsuii ana wala hee.’

english_verse: My people, I won't stay angry and keep on accusing you. After all, I am your Creator. I don't want you to give up in complete despair.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mibeŋ kɛyaŋ naanɔ, ni jeee daa mimli aaawo la, ejaakɛ mi midɛŋ mumɔ jɛɔ, ni mi mibɔ wala mumɔ.

english_verse: Your greed made me furious. That's why I punished you and refused to be found, while you kept returning to your old sinful ways.
translation_verse: Nɔ sha ni yɔɔ ehiɛkɔ̃ɔ lɛ mli hewɔ lɛ, mimli wo la; migwao lɛ, ni mikɛ mihiɛ tee lɛ, ni mimli fu; shi etee nɔ ekwa mi, ni eye etsui naa sane.

english_verse: I know what you are like! But I will heal you, lead you, and give you comfort, until those who are mourning
translation_verse: “Mina gbɛ fɔŋ ni enyiɛ lɛ, shi mibatsa lɛ. Mibakpala lɛ, ni mibashɛje lɛ kɛ mɛi ni ekɛyeɔ ŋkɔmɔ lɛ amii.

english_verse: start singing my praises. No matter where you are, I, the Lord, will heal you and give you peace.
translation_verse: Hejɔlɛ, hejɔlɛ aha mɔ ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ kɛ mɔ ni bɛŋkɛ fɛɛ. Mibatsa miwebii lɛ.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, have promised that none who are evil will live in peace.
translation_verse: Hejɔlɛ ko bɛ ha mɛi fɔ̃ji.” MiNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ.

english_verse: Shout the message! Don't hold back. Say to my people Israel: You've sinned! You've turned against the Lord.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Bolɔmɔ waa! Kaaha onaa miiba shi. Wo ogbee nɔ tamɔ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ. Jajemɔ mimaŋbii lɛ ahe eshai lɛ otsɔɔ amɛ; tsɔɔmɔ Israel we lɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ.

english_verse: Day after day, you worship him and seem eager to learn his teachings. You act like a nation that wants to do right by obeying his laws. You ask him about justice, and say you enjoy worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Tsɛbelɛ gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ amɛtaoɔ misɛɛgbɛ, ni amɛshweɔ akɛ amɛle migbɛi lɛ tamɔ maŋ ni yeɔ jalɛ sane, ni amɛkwako amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mlai lɛ. Amɛtaoɔ akɛ mabu amɛ bem akɛ jalɔi, ni amɛsumɔɔ akɛ amɛtsi amɛbɛŋkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ.”

english_verse: You wonder why the Lord pays no attention when you go without eating and act humble. But on those same days that you give up eating, you think only of yourselves and abuse your workers.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Mɛɛba wɔhiɔ ŋmaa, ni bo, Yehowa, onaaa lɛ? Mɛɛba wɔhumiɔ shi, ni onaaa lɛ?” Shi Yehowa kɛɛ, “Naa, nyɛŋmãahilɛ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛnɔ mli nyɛfoɔ, ni nyɛwaa nyɛnitsulɔi fɛɛ ayi.

english_verse: You even get angry and ready to fight. No wonder God won't listen to your prayers!
translation_verse: Naa, nyɛŋmãahilɛ be mli lɛ, nɔ ni eshwɛ nyɛ kɛkɛ ji bei kɛ nɔmɔ, ni nyɛmamɔɔ nyɛhe atswɛrɛi kɛ yiwalɛ. Nɛkɛ ŋmãa ni nyɛhiɔ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ haŋ anu nyɛgbee yɛ ŋwɛi.

english_verse: Do you think the Lord wants you to give up eating and to act as humble as a bent-over bush? Or to dress in sackcloth and sit in ashes? Is this really what he wants on a day of worship?
translation_verse: Ani nɛkɛ ŋmaahilɛ mito lɛ? Enɛ ji ŋmaahilɛ ni gbɔmɔ kɛhumiɔ shi lɛ? Ani no ji yishimaa kɛ kpekpebumɔ kɛ lamlumlikamɔ lo? Enɛ nyɛtsɛɔ lɛ ŋmaahilɛ gbi ni sa Yehowa hiɛ lɛ?

english_verse: I'll tell you what it really means to worship the Lord. Remove the chains of prisoners who are bound unjustly. Free those who are abused!
translation_verse: “Ani jeee enɛ moŋ ji ŋmaahilɛ ni mito lɛ: akɛ akpa toikɔdɔmɔ saneyeli koni akplɔ toikɔdɔmɔ saneyeli kɔŋtso lɛ he ŋmei lɛ koni aha mɛi ni awaa amɛ yi lɛ aye amɛhe koni akumɔ apã fɛɛ apã?

english_verse: Share your food with everyone who is hungry; share your home with the poor and homeless. Give clothes to those in need; don't turn away your relatives.
translation_verse: Ani jeee no ji akɛ okɛ oboloo akuma mɔ ni hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ, ni oŋɔ ohiafoi ni bɛ shihilɛhe lɛ kɛba owe lɛ, ni kɛji ona mɔ ko ni nyiɛ yayai lɛ ohã lɛ mama, ni okɛ ohe akatee bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe gbɔmɔ.

english_verse: Then your light will shine like the dawning sun, and you will quickly be healed. Your honesty will protect you as you advance, and the glory of the Lord will defend you from behind.
translation_verse: “No lɛ ojalɛ aaakpɛ tamɔ leebi hulu, ni otsamɔ hu aaafee oya, ni ojalɛ lɛ aaanyiɛ ohiɛ, ni Yehowa anunyam lɛ aaanyiɛ osɛɛ.

english_verse: When you beg the Lord for help, he will answer, “Here I am!” Don't mistreat others or falsely accuse them or say something cruel.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ ooobo otsɛ, ni Yehowa aaahere bo nɔ; ooobo otsɛ yelikɛbuamɔ, ni eeekɛɛ akɛ ‘Naa mi!’ “Kɛji nyɛkpa mɛi gboklɛwoo yɛ nyɛteŋ, ni nyɛkpa wao kɛmɔtsɔɔmɔ kɛ mɔ he efɔŋ wiemɔ,

english_verse: Give your food to the hungry and care for the homeless. Then your light will shine in the dark; your darkest hour will be like the noonday sun.
translation_verse: kɛji oha mɔ ni hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ niyenii, ni oha mɔ ni ehĩa lɛ lɛ nɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ, no dani ola lɛ aaakpɛ yɛ duŋ lɛ mli, ni oduŋ kpii lɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ shwane.

english_verse: The Lord will always guide you and provide good things to eat when you are in the desert. He will make you healthy. You will be like a garden that has plenty of water or like a stream that never runs dry.
translation_verse: Ni Yehowa aaakpala bo daa, ni eeeha bo ohiamɔnii yɛ fimɔ be mli, ni eeeha bo hewalɛ, ni oootsɔ̃ tamɔ trom ni nu hoɔ yɛ mli, loo tamɔ nuhiŋmɛi ni nu kpaaa yɛ mli.

english_verse: You will rebuild those houses left in ruins for years; you will be known as a builder and repairer of city walls and streets.
translation_verse: Omɛi lɛ aaasaa oblema tsui koi lɛ atswa; amɛaatswa tsui lɛ amɛmamɔ blema shishitoo srɔtoi lɛ anɔ. Aaatsɛ nyɛ mɛi ni saa gbogboi lɛ amɛtswa kɛ mɛi ni saa gbɛjegbɛi lɛ koni mɛi anyɛ nɔ ahi.” Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ he sɛɛnamɔ

english_verse: Then you will truly enjoy knowing the Lord. He will let you rule from the highest mountains and bless you with the land of your ancestor Jacob. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: no lɛ maha oye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei grɔŋŋi fɛɛ anɔ, ni omii aaashɛ Yehowa he, ni oooye otsɛ Yakob gboshinii lɛ!” Yehowa kɛ enaabu ekɛɛ.

english_verse: The Lord hasn't lost his powerful strength; he can still hear and answer prayers.
translation_verse: Naa, Yehowa nine efoko kuku bɔ ni no hewɔ lɛ, enyɛɛɛ yiwala ehere; asaŋ etoii hu tsimɔko bɔ ni enuuu nii.

english_verse: Your sins are the roadblock between you and your God. That's why he doesn't answer your prayers or let you see his face.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ nyɛnishaianii lɛ ji nii ni egbala nyɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ lɛ. Nyɛhe eshai lɛ ji nii ni etsĩ nyɛhiɛ, hewɔ ni ebooo nyɛ toi lɛ.

english_verse: Your talk is filled with lies and plans for violence; every finger on your hands is covered with blood.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɛkɛ lá ebule nyɛniji, ni nyɛkɛ nishaianii ebule nyɛwaobii; nyɛnaabu wieɔ amale wiemɔi, kutumpɔo wiemɔi ji nɔ ni kã nyɛlilɛi nɔ.

english_verse: You eat the deadly eggs of poisonous snakes, and more snakes crawl out from the eggs left to hatch. You weave spider webs,
translation_verse: Yiŋ shai ni amɛtoɔ lɛ yeɔ awui tamɔ shinɔ ni naa joɔ wɔji. Kɛji wɔji lɛ eko fɛ lɛ, onufu ji nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ wɔlɔ lɛ eko lɛ gbo egboɔ. Amɛnifeemɔ tamɔ anaanu ntaŋ;

english_verse: but you can't make clothes with those webs or hide behind them. You're sinful and brutal.
translation_verse: ni ntaŋi lɛ nyɛɛɛ atsɔ̃ mama ni aaanyɛ aha. Nishaianii pɛ amɛfeɔ, ni niseniianii pɛ amɛkɛ amɛniji tsuɔ.

english_verse: You hurry off to do wrong or murder innocent victims. All you think about is sin; you leave ruin and destruction wherever you go.
translation_verse: Amɛhe yɛ oya kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ, ni amɛyeɔ oyai kɛshwieɔ mɔ ni fɔbuu ko bɛ ehe lɛ lá shi. Nɔ he pɛ ni amɛjwɛŋɔ ji nɔsha, ni nifitemɔ kɛ niihiɛkpãtãmɔ anaa yɛ he ni amɛyɔɔ.

english_verse: You don't know how to live in peace or to be fair with others. The roads you make are crooked; your followers cannot find peace. The People Confess Their Sins
translation_verse: Toiŋjɔlɛ ni ji toiŋjɔlɛ lɛ amɛleee eko, ni jalɛ saneyeli bɛ he ni amɛyɔɔ. Amɛkɔ̃dɔkɔdɔ̃ɔ amɛgbɛi, ni mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ nakai gbɛi lɛ anɔ lɛ he ejɔɔɔ lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ. Maŋbii lɛ jaje amɛhe esha

english_verse: No one has come to defend us or to bring about justice. We hoped for a day of sunshine, but all we found was a dark, gloomy night.
translation_verse: Maŋbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “No hewɔ ni jalɛ saneyeli kɛ wɔteŋ jɛkɛ lɛ, ni yiwalaheremɔ bɛŋkɛɛɛ wɔ lɛ. Wɔkwɛɔ gbɛ akɛ la akpɛ aha wɔ, shi moŋ duŋ mli wɔnyiɛɔ.

english_verse: We feel our way along, as if we were blind; we stumble at noon, as if it were night. We can see no better than someone dead.
translation_verse: Wɔtatraa yɛ gbogbo he tamɔ shwilafoi, ni wɔgbugbuɔ shi tamɔ mɛi ni bɛ hiŋmɛii; wɔtɛrɛɔ shwane fintiŋŋ tamɔ nɔ ni hiɛ ebu, ni wɔnyiɛɔ hiɛkãalɔi ateŋ tamɔ mɛi ni egboi.

english_verse: We growl like bears and mourn like doves. We hope for justice and victory, but they escape us.
translation_verse: Wɔ fɛɛ wɔhuuɔ tamɔ oshishibrishii, wɔyeɔ ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ okpoi; wɔkwɛɔ jalɛ saneyeli gbɛ, shi ekoeko ejeee gbɛ; wɔshweɔ yiwalaheremɔ, shi ekɛ wɔteŋ jɛkɛ.

english_verse: How often have we sinned and turned against you, the Lord God? Our sins condemn us! We have done wrong.
translation_verse: “Nuŋtsɔ, wɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ fa tsɔ yɛ ohiɛ, ni wɔhe eshai lɛ yeɔ odase shiɔ wɔ, ejaakɛ wɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ jwere wɔhiɛ, ni wɔnishaianii lɛ hu wɔle fɛɛ.

english_verse: We have rebelled and refused to follow you. Our hearts were deceitful, and so we lied; we planned to abuse others and turn our backs on you.
translation_verse: Wɔtɔ̃, ni wɔkwa Yehowa, ni wɔkpale yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ. Yiwalɛ kɛ atuatsemɔ wiemɔi wɔwieɔ; amale wiemɔi ni wɔtoɔ yɛ wɔtsuiiaŋ lɛ jeɔ kpo yɛ wɔnaa.

english_verse: Injustice is everywhere; justice seems far away. Truth is chased out of court; honesty is shoved aside.
translation_verse: Jalɛ saneyeli ekpale kɛtee sɛɛ, ni jalɛ eyadamɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ, ejaakɛ anɔkwale etã yɛ blohuŋ, ni anɔkwale bɛ nɔ ko mli.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies; those who turn from crime end up ruined. The Lord Will Rescue His People When the Lord noticed that justice had disappeared, he became very displeased.
translation_verse: Anɔkwale elaaje, ni mɔ ni wiɔ ehe kɛjɛɔ efɔŋ he lɛ ayɔseɔ moŋ akɛ lɛ moŋ etɔ̃.” Yehowa saa Emaŋbii aheremɔ eto Yehowa na, ni edɔ lɛ akɛ ayeee jalɛ sane.

english_verse: It disgusted him even more to learn that no one would do a thing about it. So with his own powerful arm, he won victories for truth.
translation_verse: Ena, ni enaa kpɛ ehe akɛ mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni edamɔ mli eha mɔ ni ayeɔ lɛ amim; ni no hewɔ lɛ, ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehewalɛ here eyiwala, ni ejalɛ lɛ ye bua lɛ.

english_verse: Justice was the Lord's armor; saving power was his helmet; anger and revenge were his clothes.
translation_verse: Jalɛ aaatsɔ dama ni eeewo, ni yiwalaheremɔ aaatsɔ dade fai ni eeebu, ni oweletɔɔ aaatsɔ bo ni eeeha, ni hiɛdɔɔ ni naa wa ekɛaafee emama.

english_verse: Now the Lord will get furious and do to his enemies, both near and far, what they did to his people.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni amɛfee lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ebaafee amɛ eto najiaŋ. Emli aaawo la awo mɛi ni kɛ lɛ ena lɛ, ni eeewo henyɛlɔi lɛ anyɔmɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛyanina ŋshɔnaa maji lɛ tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: He will attack like a flood in a mighty windstorm. Nations in the west and the east will then honor and praise his wonderful name.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, amɛaashe Yehowa gbɛi lɛ gbeyei yɛ anaigbɛ; aaashe ehewalɛ lɛ gbeyei yɛ hulushiteehe, ejaakɛ ebaaba tamɔ faa ni etue ni Yehowa mumɔ lɛ etsi eyisɛɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has promised to rescue the city of Zion and Jacob's descendants who turn from sin.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ emaŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Mibaba Zion taakɛ kpɔ̃lɔ, akɛ kpɔ̃lɔ ha Yakob shwiei ni ekpale kɛje nifɔɔjianiifeemɔ mli lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord says: “My people, I promise to give you my Spirit and my message. These will be my gifts to you and your families forever. I, the Lord, have spoken.”
translation_verse: Ni naa, mi lɛ kpãŋmɔ ni mi kɛ nyɛ kpãŋɔ nɛ: Mimumɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ omli lɛ, kɛ miwiemɔi ni mikɛwo onaa lɛ, ha akã bo kɛ oshwiei ashwiei fɛɛ anaa kɛjɛ be nɛɛ mli kɛyashi naanɔi anaanɔ.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, stand up! Shine! Your new day is dawning. The glory of the Lord shines brightly on you.
translation_verse: Tee shi ni otso ejaakɛ ola lɛ eshɛ shi etã, ni Yehowa anunyam lɛ miikpɛ yɛ onɔ.

english_verse: The earth and its people are covered with darkness, but the glory of the Lord is shining upon you.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ naa, duŋ baaha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni duŋ kpii aaaha majimaji lɛ anɔ. Shi bo lɛ, Yehowa la aaate lɛ shi aha bo, ni enunyam lɛ aaakpɛ yɛ onɔ.

english_verse: Nations and kings will come to the light of your dawning day. Crowds Are Coming to Jerusalem The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ni maji aaatsi kɛbɛŋkɛ ola lɛ, ni maŋtsɛmɛi aaaba ola ni kpɛɔ yɛ onɔ lɛ he.

english_verse: Open your eyes! Look around! Crowds are coming. Your sons are on their way from distant lands; your daughters are being carried like little children.
translation_verse: Wo ohiɛ nɔ, koni okwɛ ohe kɛkpe; ooona amɛ fɛɛ ni amɛbua amɛhe naa kɛmiiba oŋɔɔ. Obihii lɛ aaajɛ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ aba, ni obiyei lɛ, aaahiɛ amɛ yɛ ŋmawuiaŋ kɛaaba.

english_verse: When you see this, your faces will glow; your hearts will pound and swell with pride. Treasures from across the sea and the wealth of nations will be brought to you.
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ ohiŋmɛi aaana; ooona miishɛɛ kɛteke nɔ, ni otsui aaatɔ, ni ooonya. Ejaakɛ akɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ajwetrii aaabahã bo; akɛ amɛjwetrii lɛ aaajɛ ŋshɔsɛɛ aaabahã bo.

english_verse: Your country will be covered with caravans of young camels from Midian and Ephah. The people of Sheba will bring gold and spices in praise of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Yoomai asafo yuu aaabua ohe kutuu, ni ji Midian kɛ Efa yoomai oblahii lɛ. Amɛaatere shika kɛ krɔbɔo kɛaajɛ Sheba kɛaaba; ni mɛi aaagba nɔ ni Yehowa efee lɛ he sane kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Every sheep of Kedar will come to you; rams from Nebaioth will be yours as well. I will accept them as offerings and bring honor to my temple.
translation_verse: Aaabua Kedar toi fɛɛ anaa abaha bo, kɛ Nebaiot too ojwɛnii lɛ hu akɛ afɔle. Akɛ amɛ aaashã afɔle ni sa mihiɛ yɛ mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni mawo minunyam Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hiɛ nyam.

english_verse: What is that sailing by like clouds or like doves flying home?
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ji nibii nɛɛ ni hoɔ tamɔ atatu loo tamɔ okpoi ni eku amɛsɛɛ kɛmiiba amɛtsu naa nɛɛ?

english_verse: On those distant islands your people are waiting for me, the Lord. Seagoing ships lead the way to bring them home with their silver and gold. I, the holy Lord God of Israel, do this to honor your people, so they will honor me. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt The Lord said:
translation_verse: Lɛji ni jɛ maŋsɛɛ shikpɔji anɔ ni kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii miiba ni. Amɛkɛ obihii lɛ kɛ amɛjwiɛtɛii kɛ amɛshika miiba kɛbawo Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ji Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, gbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam; ejaakɛ eha ohiɛ eba nyam.

english_verse: Jerusalem, your city walls will be rebuilt by foreigners; their rulers will become your slaves. I punished you in my anger; now I will be kind and treat you with mercy.
translation_verse: Yehowa miikɛɛ Yerusalɛm akɛ, “Gbɔi aaatswa ohe gbogboi lɛ, ni amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ aaasɔmɔ bo; ejaakɛ mitswa bo nɔ yɛ mimlifu mli; shi mimusuŋ etsɔ̃ mi yɛ ohe yɛ mimlihilɛ lɛ naa.

english_verse: Your gates will be open day and night to let the rulers of nations lead their people to you with all their treasures.
translation_verse: Ogboi lɛ anaa aaakamɔ be fɛɛ be; shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ lɛ, aŋamɔŋ, koni maŋtsɛmɛi anyiɛ amɛwebii ahiɛ, koni amɛkɛ majimaji lɛ ajwetrii lɛ abaha bo.

english_verse: Any nation or kingdom that refuses to serve you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Shi maji ni sɔmɔɔɔ bo lɛ aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ; nakai maji lɛ, kpãtãmɔ aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ butuu.

english_verse: Wood from Lebanon's best trees will be brought to you— the pines, the firs, and the cypress trees. It will be used in my temple to make beautiful the place where I rest my feet.
translation_verse: Lebanon kooŋ tsei kpakpai, ni ji sɛsɛo kɛ odum kɛ odanta, akɛaaba akɛbawula mihe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, ni mawo he ni midamɔɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam.

english_verse: The descendants of enemies who hated and mistreated you will kneel at your feet. They will say, “You are Zion, the city of the Lord, the holy One of Israel.”
translation_verse: Mɛi ni wa bo yi lɛ abii lɛ hu aaaba abakoto bo; ni mɛi fɛɛ ni gbe ohe guɔ aaaba abakula onaji anaa. Amɛaatsɛ bo ‘Yehowa maŋ wulu,’ ‘Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ Zion lɛ.’

english_verse: You were hated and deserted, rejected by everyone. But I will make you beautiful, a city to be proud of for all time to come.
translation_verse: “Kulɛ akwa bo, ni anyɛ bo; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ omli kɛhooo; shi no najiaŋ lɛ, maha oje agbo, ofee naanɔ anunyam kɛ naanɔ nyamɔ kɛjɛ yinɔ kɛya yinɔ.

english_verse: You will drain the wealth of kings and foreign nations. You will know that I, the mighty Lord God of Israel, have saved and rescued you.
translation_verse: Oooye majimaji kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi anii tamɔ abifao yeɔ enyɛ fufɔ, ni okɛaana ole akɛ, mi, Yehowa, mi ji oyiwalaherelɔ; ni Israel Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ ji okpɔ̃lɔ.

english_verse: I will bring bronze and iron in place of wood and stone; in place of bronze and iron, I will bring gold and silver. I will appoint peace and justice as your rulers and leaders.
translation_verse: “Maha bo shika yɛ akɔɔble najiaŋ, ni maha bo jwiɛtɛi yɛ dade najiaŋ; tso najiaŋ lɛ, maha bo akɔɔble; ni tɛi anajiaŋ lɛ, maha bo dade. Onɔyelɔi lɛ waŋ bo yi dɔŋŋ, ni maha amɛkɛ jalɛ saneyeli kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ aye onɔ.

english_verse: Violence, destruction, and ruin will never again be heard of within your borders. “Victory” will be the name you give to your walls; “Praise” will be the name you give to your gates.
translation_verse: Anuŋ yiwalɛ he dɔŋŋ yɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, loo nifitemɔ loo niiahiɛkpãtãmɔ he yɛ ohusui amli he ko he ko; mafa ohe ni mabu ohe; matsɔ yiwalaheremɔ gbogbo maha bo. Ni ooojie miyi, ejaakɛ mikpɔ̃ bo.

english_verse: You won't need the light of the sun or the moon. I, the Lord your God, will be your eternal light and bring you honor.
translation_verse: “Jeee hulu ni baatso la dɔŋŋ aha bo shwane, ni jeee nyɔɔŋtsere ni baakpɛ koni jeŋ atse aha bo gbɛkɛ; shi moŋ Yehowa ni aaatsɔ̃ ola kɛaatee naanɔ, ni oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ onunyam.

english_verse: Your sun will never set or your moon go down. I, the Lord, will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will come to an end.
translation_verse: Ohulu lɛ enyɔŋ shi dɔŋŋ, ni onyɔɔŋtsere lɛ hu woŋ duŋ; ejaakɛ Yehowa aaatsɔ̃ ola kɛaatee naanɔ, ni okɔmɔyeli gbii lɛ hu sɛɛ aaafo.

english_verse: Your people will live right and always own the land; they are the trees I planted to bring praise to me.
translation_verse: Omaŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ aaafee nɔ ni ja, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ kɛya naanɔ, amɛ ji tso ni mitɛo akɛ mi mininenaa nitsumɔ nii koni akɛwo mihiɛ nyam.

english_verse: Even the smallest family will be a powerful nation. I am the Lord, and when the time comes, I will quickly do all this.
translation_verse: Mɔ bibioo fe fɛɛ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ weku muu, ni weku bibioo lɛ aaatsɔ̃ jaku muu. Kɛji be lɛ shɛ lɛ, Mi, Yehowa, maha eba mli oya.”

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord God has taken control of me! The Lord has chosen and sent me to tell the oppressed the good news, to heal the brokenhearted, and to announce freedom for prisoners and captives.
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa mumɔ lɛ yɛ minɔ. Efɔ mi mu, ni etsu mi koni mibashiɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ ohiafoi. Etsu mi koni mibashɛje mɛi ni efee bliboo kɛ awerɛho lɛ amii, koni mishiɛ heyeli mitsɔ̃ɔ nomii lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni awo amɛ tsuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: This is the year when the Lord God will show kindness to us and punish our enemies. The Lord has sent me to comfort those who mourn,
translation_verse: Etsu mi koni mibashiɛ akɛ Yehowa dromɔ afi lɛ kɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ oweletɔɔ gbi lɛ eshɛ, koni mishɛje ŋkɔmɔyelɔi fɛɛ amii.

english_verse: especially in Jerusalem. He sent me to give them flowers in place of their sorrow, olive oil in place of tears, and joyous praise in place of broken hearts. They will be called “Trees of Justice,” planted by the Lord to honor his name.
translation_verse: Etsu mi koni mɛi ni yeɔ ŋkɔmɔ yɛ Zion lɛ mibaha amɛ ayilɔ yɛ lamlu najiaŋ, ni yɛ awerɛho najiaŋ lɛ, mibaha amɛmii ashɛ. Amɛaafee tamɔ tsei ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ tɛo. Amɛ fɛɛ amɛaafee nii ni ja, ni aaajie Nyɔŋmɔ yi yɛ nii ni efee lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Then they will rebuild cities that have been in ruins for many generations.
translation_verse: Amɛaatswa blema tsui koi lɛ; ni amɛaasaa tsutsubii lɛ amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ, ni amɛaato maji ni efite lɛ ehee ekoŋŋ ni ji yinɔi pii anɔ amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ.

english_verse: They will hire foreigners to take care of their sheep and their vineyards.
translation_verse: Maŋsɛɛbii aaalɛ nyɛtoi lɛ, ni mɛi kpɔji aaahu nyɛŋmɔji amɛha nyɛ, ni amɛaasaa nyɛwaintsei ahe aha nyɛ.

english_verse: But they themselves will be priests and servants of the Lord our God. The treasures of the nations will belong to them, and they will be famous.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛ lɛ, aaatsɛ nyɛ Yehowa osɔfoi, ni mɛi aaatsɛ nyɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi. Nyɛaabaye jeŋ maji lɛ anii, ni nyɛmii aaashɛ yɛ jeŋ majiaŋbii lɛ anii lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: They were terribly insulted and horribly mistreated; now they will be greatly blessed and joyful forever. The Lord Loves Justice
translation_verse: Nyɛhiɛgbele kɛ hiɛshishwiemɔ lɛ sɛɛ aaafo, nyɛmii aaashɛ nyɛhe, yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni nyɛninamɔ lɛ aaaku abɔ he, ni nyɛaana miishɛɛ kɛaatee naanɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, love justice! But I hate robbery and injustice. My people, I solemnly promise to reward you with an eternal agreement.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, misumɔɔ jalɛ saneyeli; miihi juu kɛ nɔ ni ejaaa gbɛ feemɔ. Mibato amɛ najiaŋ shishiishi, ni mi kɛ amɛ aaakpãŋ kpãŋmɔ ni aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ.

english_verse: Your descendants will be known in every nation. All who see them will realize that they have been blessed, by me, the Lord. Celebrate and Shout
translation_verse: Amɛshwiei agbɛi aaahehe yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ, ni amɛbii hu aaana gbɛi yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ. Mɛi fɛɛ ni aaana amɛ aaakpɛ̃lɛ nɔ akɛ mɛi ni Yehowa ejɔɔ amɛ ji amɛ.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because of my Lord God. His saving power and justice are the very clothes I wear. They are more beautiful than the jewelry worn by a bride or groom.
translation_verse: Manya waa yɛ Yehowa hewɔ; ni misusuma mli aaafli lɛ yɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ ewo mi yiwalaheremɔ atade, ni ekɛ jalɛ mama eha mi, tamɔ bɔ ni ayɛmforo wu wulaa ehe loo bɔ ni ayɛmforo wulaa kɛ jwine lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will bring about justice and praise in every nation on earth, like flowers blooming in a garden.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bɔ ni shikpɔŋ hãa nii kwɛ̃ɔ, ni trom hãa nii ni adu yɛ mli lɛ kwɛ̃ɔ lɛ, nakai Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaahã jalɛ kɛ yijiemɔ akwɛ̃ yɛ majimaji lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, I will speak up for your good. I will never be silent till you are safe and secure, sparkling like a flame.
translation_verse: Zion hewɔ lɛ mimuaŋ minaa, ni Yerusalɛm hewɔ lɛ mijɔŋ mihe kɛyaashi bem ni eye lɛ aaaje kpo faŋŋ tamɔ leebi hulu, ni eyiwala ni ahere lɛ aaatso tamɔ kɔti.

english_verse: Your great victory will be seen by every nation and king; the Lord will even give you a new name.
translation_verse: Jeŋ maji lɛ aaana obemyeli lɛ, ni maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ aaana onunyam; ni akɛ gbɛi hei ni Yehowa aaawo bo lɛ aaatsɛ bo.

english_verse: You will be a glorious crown, a royal headband for the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Oootsɔ̃ tamɔ akekre fɛɛfɛo yɛ Yehowa dɛŋ; oootsɔ̃ tamɔ maŋtsɛ fai yɛ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ.

english_verse: Your name will no longer be “Deserted and Childless,” but “Happily Married.” You will please the Lord; your country will be his bride.
translation_verse: Atsɛŋ bo “Mɔ ni akwa lɛ” dɔŋŋ; shi moŋ aaatsɛ bo “Mitsui naa gbɔmɔ”; ni aaatsɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ hu “Kpeemɔ yoo”; ejaakɛ Yehowa ena ohe tsuijurɔ ni oshikpɔŋ lɛ hu aaakpee lɛ.

english_verse: Your people will take the land, just as a young man takes a bride. The Lord will be pleased because of you, just as a husband is pleased with his bride.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bɔ ni oblanyo kpeɔ oblayoo lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ ni bɔ bo lɛ aaakpee bo; ni bɔ ni ayɛmforo wu nyaa ayɛmforo he lɛ, nakai oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaanya ohe.

english_verse: Jerusalem, on your walls I have stationed guards, whose duty it is to speak out day and night, without resting. They must remind the Lord
translation_verse: Ao Yerusalɛm, mito bulɔi yɛ ogbogboi lɛ anɔ. Shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ lɛ, amɛmuaŋ amɛnaa. Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛkaiɔ Yehowa shiwoi lɛ, nyɛkajɔa nyɛhe;

english_verse: and not let him rest till he makes Jerusalem strong and famous everywhere.
translation_verse: ni nyɛkahãa ejɔa ehe kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeehã Yerusalɛm ama shi, ni eeehã ena gbɛi yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has given his word and made this promise: “Never again will I give to your enemies the grain and grapes for which you struggled.
translation_verse: Yehowa ewo ehewalɛ nine lɛ nɔ ekɛkã ehe kitã akɛ, “Anɔkwa, mikɛ obele lɛ haŋ ohenyɛlɔi amɛye dɔŋŋ, ni maŋsɛɛbii enuŋ owain ni ogbo he deŋme lɛ dɔŋŋ;

english_verse: As surely as you harvest your grain and grapes, you will eat your bread with thankful hearts, and you will drink your wine in my temple.”
translation_verse: shi mɛi ni buaa naa woɔ aboŋo mli lɛ, amɛ amɛaaye, ni amɛaajie Yehowa yi; ni mɛi ni buaa wainyibii lɛ anaa kɛbaa shĩa lɛ, amɛ amɛaanu wain lɛ, yɛ mihe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kpoi lɛ anɔ.”

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, open your gates! Repair the road to the city and clear it of stones; raise a banner to help the nations find their way.
translation_verse: Nyɛjea kpo, nyɛjea kpo nyɛtsɔa agboi lɛ amli; nyɛjea maŋ lɛ gbɛ lɛ nyɛtoa maŋbii lɛ. Nyɛsaa, nyɛsaa gbɛjegbɛ lɛ; nyɛkɔlɔa enɔ tɛi lɛ; nyɛshia aflaŋaa kɛtoa okadi nyɛhãa maŋbii lɛ.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord has said for all the earth to hear: “Soon I will come to save the city of Zion and to reward you.
translation_verse: Naa, Yehowa eha ashiɛ kɛtee shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehe lɛ akɛ, Nyɛkɛa Zion bi yoo lɛ akɛ, “Naa, oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ miiba; naa, ehiɛ enyɔmɔwoo kɛmiiba, ni mɛi ni ekpɔ̃ amɛ lɛ nyiɛ ehiɛ kɛmiiba.”

english_verse: Then you will be called, ‘The Lord's Own People, The Ones He Rescued!’ Your city will be known as a good place to live and a city full of people.”
translation_verse: Ni ebaatsɛ amɛ akɛ “Maŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, Mɛi ni Yehowa ekpɔ̃ amɛ,” ni bo hu aaatsɛ bo, “Mɔ ni ataoɔ esɛɛgbɛ Maŋ ni akwaŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: Who is this coming from Bozrah in Edom with clothes stained red? Who is this hero marching in his glorious uniform? “It's me, the Lord! I have won the battle, and I can save you!”
translation_verse: Namɔ ji mɔ ni jɛ Bozra, maŋ ni yɔɔ Edom lɛ, baa nɛɛ? Namɔ nɛ, ni ewula kɛ atade ni tsuɔ faa, ni etsĩaa yɛ ehewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ mli nɛɛ? Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mi Yehowa ni; mɔ ni wieɔ yɛ jalɛ mli, mɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ni ekɛhereɔ yiwala lɛ.”

english_verse: What are those red spots? Your clothes look stained from trampling on grapes.
translation_verse: Mɛɛba ohe bo lɛ tsuɔ nɛkɛ; mɛɛba otadei lɛ tamɔ mɔ ni ŋaa wain atade nɛɛ?

english_verse: “I alone trampled the grapes! None of the nations helped. I trampled nations in my anger and stained my clothes with their blood.
translation_verse: Yehowa to he akɛ, “Mi koome too miŋa, minaanaa jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ tamɔ anaa wain lɛ. Minaanaa amɛnɔ yɛ mimlifu lɛ mli, ni amɛmli nu tsɛŋe wo mitadei lɛ amli, ni ewu mitadei lɛ amli fɛɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I did this because I wanted to take revenge— the time had come to rescue my people.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ oweletɔɔ gbi ko yɛ mitsui mli, ni mikpɔ̃mɔ afi lɛ eshɛ.

english_verse: No one was there to help me or to give support; my mighty arm won the battle, strengthened by my anger.
translation_verse: Mikwɛ mihe, shi yelikɛbualɔ ko bɛ; ni minaa kpɛ mihe akɛ mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni mɔɔ mli haa mi. No hewɔ lɛ, mi diɛŋtsɛ mihewalɛ ni here miyiwala, ni mimlila lɛ ni mɔ mli hã mi.

english_verse: In my fury I trampled on nations and made them drunk; their blood poured out everywhere on earth.” The Lord's Goodness to His People
translation_verse: Minaanaa majimaji lɛ anɔ yɛ mimlifu lɛ mli, mikpɔtɔ amɛ yɛ mimlila lɛ mli, ni mifɔse amɛlá mishwie shikpɔŋ.” Akai Yehowa mlihilɛ lɛ

english_verse: I will tell about the kind deeds the Lord has done. They deserve praise! The Lord has shown mercy to the people of Israel; he has been kind and good.
translation_verse: Mibagba Yehowa mlihilɛ lɛ kɛ Yehowa yijiemɔ lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ, yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa efee eha wɔ lɛ kɛ ejurɔ pii ni efee Israel we lɛ yɛ emusuŋtsɔlɛ kɛ emlihilɛ ni fa lɛ naa lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: The Lord rescued his people, and said, “They are mine. They won't betray me.”
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Mimaŋ ji amɛ, bii ni lakaŋ mi.” No hewɔ ehere amɛ

english_verse: It troubled the Lord to see them in trouble, and his angel saved them. The Lord was truly merciful, so he rescued his people. He took them in his arms and carried them all those years.
translation_verse: yɛ amɛhaomɔi fɛɛ amli lɛ. Jeee tsulɔ loo ŋwɛi bɔfo ni here amɛyiwala, shi Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ jɛ esuɔmɔ kɛ emɔbɔnalɛ mli ehere amɛyiwala, ni ehole amɛ, ni ehiɛ amɛ yɛ blema beiaŋ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord's people turned against him and made his Holy Spirit sad. So he became their enemy and attacked them.
translation_verse: Shi amɛ lɛ amɛtse atua, ni amɛfee Emumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nidɔɔnii. No hewɔ lɛ, etsɔ amɛhenyɛlɔ, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekɛ amɛ wu.

english_verse: But his people remembered what had happened during the time of Moses. Didn't the Lord bring them and their leaders safely through the sea? Didn't he give them his Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni emaŋ lɛ kai Mose blema be lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni jie amɛ kɛ amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ lɛ kɛjɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli lɛ yɔɔ? Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni to Emumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ amɛteŋ lɛ yɔɔ?

english_verse: The glorious power of the Lord marched beside Moses. The Lord will be praised forever for dividing the sea.
translation_verse: Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni ha enunyam hewalɛ lɛ tsɔ Mose nɔ etsu nibii wuji lɛ yɔɔ? Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni gba ŋshɔ lɛ mli yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni ekɛna naanɔ gbɛi eha ehe lɛ,

english_verse: He led his people across like horses running wild without stumbling.
translation_verse: mɔ ni kpala amɛ kɛtsɔ̃ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ yɔɔ? Amɛtɛrɛɛɛ tamɔ okpɔŋɔ tɛrɛɔ yɛ shiaŋa nɔ.”

english_verse: His Spirit gave them rest, just as cattle find rest when led into a valley. The name of the Lord was praised for doing these things. A Prayer for Mercy and Help
translation_verse: Yehowa mumɔ lɛ ha amɛna hejɔlɛ tamɔ tsinai ni kpelekeɔ shi kɛyaa jɔɔ mli jwɛfɔ he. Nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Yehowa kpala emaŋ lɛ, ni ekɛna anunyam gbɛi ehã ehe. Mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ

english_verse: Please, Lord, look down from your holy and glorious home in the heavens and see what's going on. Have you lost interest? Where is your power? Show that you care about us and have mercy!
translation_verse: Yehowa, maa oyi shi kɛjɛ ŋwɛi koni ojɛ ohe krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ onunyam shihilɛhe lɛ okwɛ! Nɛgbɛ ohiɛdɔɔ kɛ ohewalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ yɔɔ? Otsuiŋshãlɛ kɛ omusuŋtsɔlɛ babaoo lɛ eŋmɛɛ wɔ.

english_verse: Our ancestors Abraham and Jacob have both rejected us. But you are still our Father; you have been our protector since ancient times.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bo nɔŋŋ ji wɔtsɛ, tsɛbelɛ Abraham leee wɔ, ni Israel hu eŋɔɔɔ wɔ akɛ bii; shi bo Yehowa lɛ bo nɔŋŋ ji wɔtsɛ kɛ wɔkpɔ̃lɔ kɛjɛ blema beebe ejaakɛ nakai ji ogbɛi.

english_verse: Why did you make us turn away from you, our Lord? Why did you make us want to disobey you? Please change your mind! We are your servants, your very own people.
translation_verse: Ao Yehowa, mɛɛba ohaa wɔduɔ gbɛ kɛjɛɔ ogbɛi lɛ anɔ? Mɛɛba owajeɔ wɔtsui koni wɔkashe bo gbeyei lɛ? Otsuji kɛ okutsei lɛ ahewɔ lɛ kuu osɛɛ.

english_verse: For a little while, your temple belonged to us; and now our enemies have torn it down.
translation_verse: Be fioo pɛ Ohe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hi omɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ adɛŋ; shi agbɛnɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ enaanaa Ohe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: We act as though you had never ruled us or called us your people.
translation_verse: Wɔtsɔmɔ tamɔ mɛi ni oyeko amɛnɔ akɛ nuŋtsɔ pɛŋ, kɛ mɛi ni akɛ ogbɛi tsɛko amɛ dã.

english_verse: Rip the heavens apart! Come down, Lord; make the mountains tremble.
translation_verse: Ao, kulɛ otserɛ ŋwɛi mli, ni okpeleke shi koni gɔji lɛ ana bo ni amɛhe akpokpo yɛ ohiɛ,

english_verse: Be a spark that starts a fire causing water to boil. Then your enemies will know who you are; all nations will tremble because you are nearby.
translation_verse: tamɔ bɔ ni la hãa lai tsoɔ, ni ehaa nu tswaa lɛ, koni eha ohenyɛlɔi ale ogbɛi. Ba koni obajie ohewalɛ lɛ kpo otsɔ̃ɔ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ, koni eha jeŋ maji lɛ ahe akpokpo yɛ ohiɛ!

english_verse: Your fearsome deeds have completely amazed us; even the mountains shake when you come down.
translation_verse: Be ni ofee naakpɛɛnii ni yɔɔ gbeyei ni wɔhiɛ kãaa nɔ lɛ, okpeleke shi, ni gɔji lɛ kpokpo yɛ ohiɛ.

english_verse: You help all who gladly obey and do what you want, but sin makes you angry. Only by your help can we ever be saved.
translation_verse: Ohereɔ mɛi ni kɛ miishɛɛ feɔ jalɛnii, mɛi ni kaiɔ bɔ ni otaoɔ akɛ amɛba amɛjeŋ amɛha lɛ atuu. Omli fu wɔ, shi wɔkã he wɔfee esha lɛ lolo. Yɛ omlifu lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, wɔkã he wɔfee esha lɛ lolo.

english_verse: We are unfit to worship you; each of our good deeds is merely a filthy rag. We dry up like leaves; our sins are storm winds sweeping us away.
translation_verse: Wɔ fɛɛ wɔtsɔmɔ tamɔ mɔ ko ni he tseee, ni wɔjalɛ nifeemɔnii lɛ tamɔ takoshwɛ. Wɔnishaianii lɛ ehã wɔfee tamɔ baa gbiŋ, ni kɔɔyɔɔ tswaa wɔ kɛyaa.

english_verse: No one worships in your name or remains faithful. You have turned your back on us and let our sins melt us away.
translation_verse: Mɔ ko bɛ ni sɔleɔ tsɛɔ bo; mɔ ko bɛ ni baa odɛ̃ŋ yelikɛbuamɔ, ejaakɛ okɛ ohiɛ etee wɔ, ni oŋmɛɛ wɔhe oha wɔnishaianii lɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, are our Father. We are nothing but clay, but you are the potter who molded us.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ bo, Yehowa, bo nɔŋŋ ji wɔtsɛ. Wɔ lɛ su ji wɔ, ni bo ji wɔshɔ̃lɔ, ni oninenaa nitsumɔ ji wɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Don't be so furious or keep our sins in your thoughts forever! Remember that all of us are your people.
translation_verse: Ao Yehowa, kaaha omli miifu wɔ fe nine, ni kaakai wɔhe eshai lɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ. Omaŋbii ji wɔ; naa wɔ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: Every one of your towns has turned into a desert, especially Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Omaji krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ etsɔmɔ ŋa nɔ: Zion etsɔ ŋa nɔ, Yerusalɛm etsɔ amaŋfɔ̃.

english_verse: Zion's glorious and holy temple where our ancestors praised you has been destroyed by fire. Our beautiful buildings are now a pile of ruins.
translation_verse: Wɔsɔlemɔ we ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ fɛo lɛ, nɔ mli ni wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ jie oyi yɛ lɛ, ama naa la ashã. Akpãtã wɔhei fɛɛfɛji lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: When you see these things, how can you just sit there and make us suffer more?
translation_verse: Ao Yehowa, aso enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ooosu ohe lo, ooofee diŋŋ, ni ooowa wɔ yi tuutu lo?

english_verse: I, the Lord, was ready to answer even those who were not asking and to be found by those who were not searching. To a nation that refused to worship me, I said, “Here I am!”
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Mihaa mɛi ni biko mi nii lɛ hetoo, ni mi diɛŋtsɛ mihaa mɛi ni taoko mi lɛ naa mi. Mikɛɔ maŋ ni sɔleko tsɛko mi lɛ akɛ, Naa mi! Naa mi!

english_verse: All day long I have reached out to stubborn and sinful people going their own way.
translation_verse: Migbɛɔ miniji amli daa nɛɛ mihaa maŋ atuatselɔi ni nyiɛɔ gbɛ ni ehiii nɔ, mɛi ni nyiɛɔ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛjwɛŋmɔi anaa lɛ.

english_verse: They keep making me angry by sneering at me, while offering sacrifices to idols in gardens and burning incense to them on bricks.
translation_verse: Atuatselɔi nɛɛ jeɔ kpetekplee amɛwoɔ mimli la daa. Amɛshãa afɔle yɛ abɔi amli amɛhaa wɔji, ni amɛshãa tsofakɛŋma yɛ ntayai anɔ amɛhãa wɔji.

english_verse: They spend their nights hiding in burial caves; they eat the meat of pigs, cooked in sauces made of stuff unfit to eat.
translation_verse: Amɛyataraa tɛkploi ni afu gbohii yɛ mli amli, ni amɛyatsɛɔ sisai gbɛkɛgbɛkɛ yɛ jɛi; amɛyeɔ kplotoo loo tete, ni amɛfaa wonu ni akɛ wɔŋ naa loo hoo.

english_verse: And then they say to others, “Don't come near us! We're dedicated to God.” Such people are like smoke, irritating my nose all day.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Tsi ohe kɛya sɛɛ. Kaabɛŋkɛ mi ejaakɛ mihe tse fe bo.’ Mɛnɛɛmɛi lɛ amɛsukɔɔ mi, amɛtamɔ la ni tsoɔ gbi muu fɛɛ.

english_verse: I have written this down; I won't keep silent. I'll pay them back just as their sins deserve.
translation_verse: “Naa, aŋma afɔ̃ mihiɛ akɛ, ‘Mifeŋ dioo; mibatɔ he owele; mikuŋ mihiɛ mifɔŋ nɔ ni amɛfee lɛ nɔ; mibawo amɛ he nyɔmɔ kɛ̃

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make them pay for their sins and for those of their ancestors— they have disgraced me by burning incense on mountains.
translation_verse: yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ hu anishaianii lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ,’ ” Yehowa kɛɛ.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord says: A cluster of grapes that produces wine is worth keeping! So, because of my servants, I won't destroy everyone.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa saa ekɛɛ nɛ, “Bɔ ni anaa yɛ wainyibii amli, ni no hewɔ lɛ, akɛɔ akɛ, ‘Akafite lɛ, ejaakɛ abaana ehe sɛɛ’ lɛ, nakai mafee yɛ mitsuji lɛ ahewɔ; mikpãtãŋ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: I have chosen the people of Israel and Judah, and I will bless them with many descendants. They will settle here in this land of mountains, and it will be theirs.
translation_verse: Mibajɔɔ Israelbii ni jɛ Yuda mli lɛ, ni amɛshwiei aaabaŋɔ migɔji ashikpɔŋ lɛ akɛ amɛnɔ, ni jɛi mitsuji ni sɔmɔɔ mi lɛ aaahi.

english_verse: My people will worship me. Then the coastlands of Sharon and the land as far as Achor Valley will turn into pastureland where cattle and sheep will feed and rest.
translation_verse: Amɛaaja mi, ni amɛaakpala amɛtoi kɛ tsinai kɛya Sharon ŋa ni yɔɔ anaigbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛkooloi aaaya Akor Jɔɔ ni yɔɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ hu mli koni amɛyaye nii.

english_verse: What will I, the Lord, do if any of you reject me and my holy mountain? What will happen to you for offering food and wine to the gods you call “Good Luck” and “Fate”?
translation_verse: “Shi nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛkwa Yehowa, ni nyɛhiɛ ekpa egɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ Zion lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛŋmɛɔ okplɔ̃ nyɛkɛhãa shade wɔŋ, ni nyɛfɔseɔ wain ni afutu mli nyɛshwieɔ shi nyɛhãa shɛɛ mli wɔŋ lɛ,

english_verse: Your luck will end! I will see to it that you are slaughtered with swords. You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong.
translation_verse: mibajɔɔ nyɛnɔ mahã klante. Nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛbaagbo otɔfo gbele, ejaakɛ mitsɛ nyɛ, shi nyɛhereee minɔ, miwie ni nyɛbooo toi; shi nyɛfee nɔ fɔŋ yɛ mihiɛ, ni nyɛkɔ nɔ ni nyɛle akɛ misumɔɔɔ lɛ moŋ.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will give food and drink to my servants, and they will celebrate. But all of you sinners will go hungry and thirsty, overcome with disgrace.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ. Naa, mitsuji lɛ aaaye nii atɔ, shi nyɛ lɛ hɔmɔ baaye nyɛ. Naa, mitsuji lɛ aaana nu amɛnu, shi nyɛ lɛ kumai aaaye nyɛ Naa mitsuji lɛ aaanya, shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛhiɛ aaagboi.

english_verse: My servants will laugh and sing, but you will be sad and cry out in pain.
translation_verse: Naa, mitsuji lɛ aaala kɛ tsuijurɔ, shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛaafo kɛ tsuiŋshãlɛ, ni nyɛaafo yoo kɛ mumɔ ni werɛ eho ehe.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, promise to see that you are killed and that my chosen servants use your names as curse words. But I will give new names to my servants.
translation_verse: Mihalamɔbii lɛ aaatsi nyɛtã amɛkɛlomɔ, ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaagbe nyɛ. Shi etsuji lɛ eeewo amɛ gbɛi kroko.

english_verse: I am God! I can be trusted. Your past troubles are gone; I no longer think of them. When you pray for someone to receive a blessing, or when you make a promise, you must do it in my name. I alone am the God who can be trusted. The Lord's New Creation
translation_verse: Koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baa jɔɔmɔ aha ehe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ajɔɔ lɛ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kãa kitã yɛ shikpɔŋ, akã anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kitã, ejaakɛ mihiɛ ekpa tsuutsu haomɔi lɛ anɔ, ni aŋɔ atee yɛ mihiɛ.” Jeŋ hee lɛ

english_verse: I am creating new heavens and a new earth; everything of the past will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, miibɔ ŋwɛi hee kɛ shikpɔŋ hee, ni akaiŋ tsuutsu nii lɛ dɔŋŋ, ni asaŋ ebaŋ gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔ mli dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Celebrate and be glad forever! I am creating a Jerusalem, full of happy people.
translation_verse: Nyɛnyaa, ni nyɛmli afilia nyɛ kɛya naanɔ, yɛ nii ni mibɔɔ lɛ hewɔ. Ejaakɛ naa, miibɔ Yerusalɛm hee koni etsɔ̃ mliflimɔ kɛ emli bii hu ni yɔɔ miishɛɛ.

english_verse: I will celebrate with Jerusalem and all its people; there will be no more crying or sorrow in that city.
translation_verse: Mimli aaafli mi yɛ Yerusalɛm he, ni manya mimaŋbii lɛ ahe, ni anuŋ yaafo kɛ blɔmɔ he yɛ Yerusalɛm dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: No child will die in infancy; everyone will live a very long life. Anyone a hundred years old will be considered young, and to die younger than that will be considered a curse.
translation_verse: Bi fufɔoo ko bɛ jɛi ni aaaye gbii fioo kɛkɛ yɛ wala mli, loo onukpa ko ni eyi yɛŋ yɛ jeŋ. Gbɔmɔ kpakpa aaaye afii oha nɛ, shi aaana lɛ akɛ oblanyo; ni mɔ fɔŋ ni naa afii oha lɛ, aaaŋɔ lɛ akɛ mɔ ni alomɔ lɛ.

english_verse: My people will live in the houses they build; they will enjoy grapes from their own vineyards.
translation_verse: Amɛaamamɔ shĩai, ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛaahi mli; amɛaafee wain abɔi, ni amɛaaye amɛmli wain tsei lɛ ayibii.

english_verse: No one will take away their homes or vineyards. My chosen people will live to be as old as trees, and they will enjoy what they have earned.
translation_verse: Amɛmamɔŋ shĩai ni mɛi krokomɛi moŋ ahi mli, ni amɛhuŋ hu ni mɛi krokomɛi moŋ aye, ejaakɛ bɔ ni odum tsɛɔ yɛ koo mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mimaŋbii awala sɛɛ aaatsɛ; ni mihalamɔbii lɛ aaaye amɛnine naa nitsumɔ mli nii daa.

english_verse: Their work won't be wasted, and their children won't die of dreadful diseases. I will bless their children and their grandchildren.
translation_verse: Amɛgboŋ yaka deŋme, ni amɛfɔŋ bii amɛhaŋ osharã, ejaakɛ mɛi ni Yehowa ejɔɔ lɛ ashwiei ji amɛ, ni ajɔɔ amɛ hu amɛshwiei.

english_verse: Wolves and lambs will graze together; lions and oxen will feed on straw. Snakes will eat only dirt! They won't bite or harm anyone on my holy mountain. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Klaŋ kɛ too gwantɛŋbi aaakpe nii yɛ he kome, ni jata aaaye jwɛi tamɔ tsina; ni onufu lɛ sũ aaafee eniyenii. Ayeŋ awui ko, ni akpãtãŋ nii ahiɛ dɔŋŋ yɛ Zion, migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ,” Yehowa kɛɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said: Heaven is my throne; the earth is my footstool. What kind of house could you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Ŋwɛi lɛ, mimaŋtsɛ sɛi ni; ni shikpɔŋ lɛ, minaneshi maaŋoo ni; belɛ mɛɛ tsu nyɛaama nyɛha mi mɔ, ni nɛgbɛ aaafee mihejɔɔmɔ he?

english_verse: I have made everything; that's how it all came to be. I, the Lord, have spoken. The people I treasure most are the humble— they depend only on me and tremble when I speak.
translation_verse: Mi, minine bɔ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ minɔ ni,” Yehowa kɛɛ. “Shi mɔ he tsui ni minaa nɛ, mɔ ni ji humi, ni eshwaa ehe yɛ etsui mli, ni ehe kpokpoɔ yɛ miwiemɔ lɛ naa.”

english_verse: You sacrifice oxen to me, and you commit murder; you sacrifice lambs to me and dogs to other gods; you offer grain to me and pigs' blood to idols; you burn incense to me and praise your idols. You have made your own choice to do these disgusting things that you enjoy so much.
translation_verse: “Mɔ ni gbeɔ tsina lɛ, etamɔ mɔ ni gbeɔ gbɔmɔ nɔŋŋ; mɔ ni kɛ toobi shãa afɔle lɛ, etamɔ mɔ ni kɛ gbee shãa afɔle nɔŋŋ; mɔ ni shãa niyenii afɔle lɛ, etamɔ mɔ ni kɛ kplotoo lá bahãa nɔŋŋ; mɔ ni shãa krɔbɔo afɔle lɛ, etamɔ mɔ ni jaa wɔŋ nɔŋŋ. Mɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ ekɔlɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbɛi, ni amɛnaa nihiinii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ he miishɛɛ.

english_verse: You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong. Now I will punish you in a way you dread the most. The Lord Will Help Jerusalem
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mi hu maha amanehulu aba amɛ nɔ, ni maha nɔ gbeyei ni amɛsheɔ lɛ aba amɛnɔ. Ejaakɛ mitsɛ, shi mɔ ko mɔ ko hereee nɔ; miwie ni amɛbooo toi; shi moŋ amɛfee nɔ ni ji efɔŋ yɛ mihiɛ, ni amɛfee nɔ moŋ ni esaaa mihiɛ.”

english_verse: If you tremble when the Lord speaks, listen to what he says: “Some of your own people hate and reject you because of me. They make fun and say, ‘Let the Lord show his power! Let us see him make you truly happy.’ But those who say these things will be terribly ashamed.”
translation_verse: Nyɛboa Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ toi, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛhe kpokpoɔ yɛ ewiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ. “Nyɛnyɛmimɛi ni miihi nyɛ, ni amɛkwa nyɛ yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, yeɔ nyɛ he fɛo amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛwoa Yehowa hiɛ nyam akɛ ehere nyɛ, koni wɔna nyamɔ ni nyɛaanya lɛ.’ Shi amɛ moŋ ji mɛi ni amɛhiɛ aaagboi.

english_verse: Do you hear that noise in the city and those shouts coming from the temple? It is the Lord shouting as he punishes his enemies.
translation_verse: Nyɛboa toi, aafee hoo yɛ maŋ lɛ mli. Gbee ko miijɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ. Yehowa mɔ ni baawo ehenyɛlɔi lɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ gbee ni.

english_verse: Have you ever heard of a woman who gave birth to a child before having labor pains?
translation_verse: “Mimaŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tamɔ yoohɔlɔ ni dani eeebɔ̃i kɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ efɔ momo, mɔ ni dani fɔmɔ piŋmɔ lɛ aaata ehe lɛ, efɔ binuu momo.

english_verse: Who ever heard of such a thing or imagined it could happen? Can a nation be born in a day or come to life in a second? Jerusalem is like a mother who gave birth to her children as soon as she was in labor.
translation_verse: Namɔ enu nɛkɛ sane pɛŋ? Namɔ ena nɛkɛ nɔ ko pɛŋ? Ani gbi kome abɔɔ maŋ lo? Ani gbi kome akɛnaa jaku lo? Kɛ̃lɛ amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni Zion bɔi kɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ pɛ, kɛkɛ ni efɔ ebii lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is the one who makes birth possible. And he will see that Zion has many more children. The Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Aso mahã ajwa awoso, ni mihaŋ afɔ? Aso mi ni mihãa afɔɔ lɛ, maŋa musu lɛ naa lo?” oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ.

english_verse: If you love Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! If you were in sorrow because of the city, you can now be glad.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm anyaa, ni nyɛmli afilia nyɛ yɛ ehewɔ. Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛsumɔɔ lɛ lɛ, nyɛ kɛ lɛ anaa miishɛɛ, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛye lɛ ŋkɔmɔ lɛ!

english_verse: She will nurse and comfort you, just like your own mother, until you are satisfied. You will fully enjoy her wonderful glory.
translation_verse: Nyɛbaana eshweremɔ lɛ eko nyɛye nyɛtɔrɔ, tamɔ abifao yeɔ enyɛ fufɔ etɔɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord has promised: “I will flood Jerusalem with the wealth of nations and make the city prosper. Zion will nurse you at her breast, carry you in her arms, and hold you in her lap.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Maha nyɛshwere babaoo tamɔ faa ni hoɔ, ni majimajiaŋbii lɛ anii ni amɛna lɛ aaayiridi, tamɔ faa ni eyi kɛteke nɔ, kɛba nyɛdɛŋ. Nyɛaatamɔ abifao ni yeɔ enyɛ fufɔ; aaahiɛ nyɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ kɛ suɔmɔ yɛ kpɔkɔiaŋ.

english_verse: I will comfort you there like a mother comforting her child.”
translation_verse: Bɔ ni binyɛ shɛjeɔ ebi mii lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mi hu mashɛje nyɛmii, ni nyɛmii aaashɛ nyɛhe yɛ Yerusalɛm.

english_verse: When you see this happen, you will celebrate; your strength will return faster than grass can sprout. Then everyone will know that the Lord provides help for his servants, but he is angry with his enemies.
translation_verse: Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛaana kɛ nyɛhiŋmɛii, ni nyɛtsui aaanyɔ nyɛmli, ni nyɛgbɔmɔtsei aaafrɔke tamɔ jwɛifɔ, ni aaana ale akɛ Yehowa nine kã etsuji ahe, shi ehenyɛlɔi lɛ emli aaafu amɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord will come down like a whirlwind with his flaming chariots. He will be furiously angry and punish his enemies with fire.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ naa, Yehowa aaaba kɛ la, ni eshwiilii lɛ aaanyiɛ lasuogbele mli kɛaaba, ni ekɛ mlila kpele aaawo ehenyɛlɔi lɛ anyɔmɔ; ni ekɛ la lilɛii aaakã ehenyɛlɔi.

english_verse: The Lord's fiery sword will bring justice everywhere on this earth and execute many people. A Threat and a Promise
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ la Yehowa kɛbaakojo, ni ekɛ klante aaakojo jeŋ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ, ni mɛi ni Yehowa aaagbe lɛ ayi aaafa babaoo naakpa.

english_verse: Some of you get yourselves ready and go to a garden to worship a foreign goddess. You eat the meat of pigs, lizards, and mice. But I, the Lord, will destroy you for this.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛi ni feɔ amɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni amɛtsuuɔ amɛhe kɛha tsei kɛ tɛi ajamɔ ni amɛtoɔ srɛnɛɛ kɛyaa wɔkoiaŋ, ni amɛyayeɔ kplotoo kɛ obishi kɛ kwakwe loo lɛ, amɛnaagbee eshɛ.

english_verse: I know everything you do and think! The time has now come to bring together the people of every language and nation and to show them my glory
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mile amɛnitsumɔi kɛ amɛsusumɔi, ni miiba koni mibabua jeŋ maji fɛɛ anaa, ni amɛaaba, ni amɛaabana minunyam lɛ;

english_verse: by proving what I can do. I will send the survivors to Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Meshech, Tubal, Javan, and to the distant islands. I will send them to announce my wonderful glory to nations that have never heard about me.
translation_verse: ni amɛaana okadi ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ mi ji mɔ ni gbalaa amɛtoi lɛ. “Ni matsu mɛi ni ahe baaje toigbalamɔ lɛ mli lɛ kɛaatee Tarshish kɛ Libia kɛ Lud, ni ji gãitsɛ̃lɔi amaŋ lɛ. Matsu kɛya Tubal kɛ Helabii ŋshɔkpɔi ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ ni amɛnuko mihe, asaŋ amɛnako minunyam lɛ bii hu aŋɔɔ. Amɛaajaje minunyam lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ.

english_verse: They will bring your relatives from the nations as an offering to me, the Lord. They will come to Jerusalem, my holy mountain, on horses, chariots, wagons, mules, and camels. It will be like the people of Israel bringing the right offering to my temple.
translation_verse: Ni amɛ kɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ ni jɛ jeŋmaji lɛ amli lɛ aaaba akɛ nikee abahã Yehowa. Amɛaatara okpɔŋɔi anɔ kɛ shwiilii kɛ akpakãii amli kɛ teji kɛ yoomai anɔ kɛba Yerusalɛm, migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ, taakɛ bɔ ni Israelbii hiɛɔ amɛnikeenii yɛ nibii ni mli tse amli kɛbaa Yehowa we lɛ,” Yehowa kɛɛ.

english_verse: I also promise that you will always have descendants and will never be forgotten, just as the new heavens and the new earth that I create will last forever.
translation_verse: “Bɔ ni ŋwɛi hee kɛ shikpɔŋ hee ni mafee lɛ aaahi shi yɛ mihiɛ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛshwiei kɛ nyɛgbɛi aaahi shi yɛ mihiɛ.”

english_verse: On the first day of each month and on each Sabbath, everyone will worship me. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Ni aaaba mli akɛ nyɔŋ hee fɛɛ nyɔŋ hee kɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi fɛɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi nɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi fɛɛ aaaba abaja yɛ mihiɛ,” Yehowa kɛɛ.

english_verse: My people will go out and look at the dead bodies of those who turned against me. The worms there never die, the fire never stops burning, and the sight of those bodies will be disgusting to everyone.
translation_verse: “Ni amɛaaje kpo amɛyakwɛ mɛi ni tse mihiɛ atua lɛ agbohii lɛ. Gɔgɔmii ni yeɔ amɛ lɛ gboiŋ, ni la ni baashã amɛ lɛ agbeŋ. Amɛhe aaafee heloo fɛɛ heloo nyaŋemɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord first spoke to me in the thirteenth year that Josiah was king of Judah,
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yosia, Amon binuu lɛ, maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: and he continued to speak to me during the rule of Josiah's son Jehoiakim. The last time the Lord spoke to me was in the fifth month of the eleventh year that Josiah's son Zedekiah was king. That was also when the people of Jerusalem were taken away as prisoners. The Lord Chooses Jeremiah
translation_verse: Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim, Yosia binuu lɛ, yinɔ hu lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie ekoŋŋ kɛyashi Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia, Yosia binuu lɛ, maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ naagbee. Nakai afi lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ mli aŋɔ Yerusalɛm maŋbii lɛ nom. Yeremia tsɛmɔ

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ,

english_verse: “Jeremiah, I am your Creator, and before you were born, I chose you to speak for me to the nations.”
translation_verse: “Dani mibɔ bo yɛ onyɛ musuŋ beebe lɛ, mile bo; ni dani afɔ bo lɛ, mifee bo krɔŋkrɔŋ momo, ni miwo bo gbalɔ mihã majimaji lɛ.”

english_verse: I replied, “I'm not a good speaker, Lord, and I'm too young.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mito he akɛ, “Ao! Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ! Naa, mileee wiemɔ, ejaakɛ gbekɛ̃ kɛkɛ ji mi.”

english_verse: “Don't say you're too young,” the Lord answered. “If I tell you to go and speak to someone, then go! And when I tell you what to say, don't leave out a word!
translation_verse: Shi Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Gbekɛ kɛkɛ ji mi’, shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ŋɔɔ ni mibatsu bo lɛ, yaa, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mafã bo akɛ owie lɛ, no ji nɔ ni owie.

english_verse: I promise to be with you and keep you safe, so don't be afraid.”
translation_verse: Kaashe mɛi aŋɔɔ ni obaaya lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ, mikɛ bo yɛ koni mahere bo. Mi, Yehowa mikɛɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord reached out his hand, then he touched my mouth and said, “I am giving you the words to say,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kpã enine mli, ni ekɛta minaabu he, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Naa, mikɛ miwiemɔi lɛ ewo onaa.

english_verse: and I am sending you with authority to speak to the nations for me. You will tell them of doom and destruction, and of rising and rebuilding again.”
translation_verse: Ni kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, mihã bo hewalɛ yɛ maji lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛyelii lɛ anɔ, koni ofãmɔ nii, ni okumɔ oshwie shi, koni okpãtã hiɛ, ni obutu, ni osaa otswa oma shi ni otɛo ekoŋŋ.” Ninai Enyɔ komɛi

english_verse: The Lord showed me something in a vision. Then he asked, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” I answered, “A branch of almonds that ripen early.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bi mi akɛ, “Yeremia, mɛni onaa nɛɛ?” Mihere lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Blɔfoŋkatiɛtso nine ni.”

english_verse: “That's right,” the Lord replied, “and I always rise early to keep a promise.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Anɔkwale ni, ejaakɛ miishi miwiemɔi lɛ ahe kpe bɔ ni afee ni mahã aba mli.”

english_verse: Then the Lord showed me something else and asked, “What do you see now?” I answered, “I see a pot of boiling water in the north, and it's about to spill out toward us.”
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ mi wie nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ, ni ebi mi akɛ, “Mɛni onaa lɛ?” Mihere lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Miina kukwɛi ko ni emli nii miitswa. Kukwɛi lɛ hiɛ miikwɛ biɛgbɛ kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will pour out destruction all over the land.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Sane fɔŋ baajɛ kooyigbɛ aba shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Just watch while I send for the kings of the north. They will attack and capture Jerusalem and other towns, then set up their thrones at the gates of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ naa, miitsɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji srɔtoi lɛ anɔ bii koni amɛba, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛi aaama Yerusalɛm agboi lɛ anaa kɛ egbogboi lɛ ahe kɛkpe. Amɛbaatua Yuda maji wuji lɛ fɛɛ hu.

english_verse: I will punish my people, because they are guilty of turning from me to worship idols.
translation_verse: Mibagbala miwebii lɛ atoi yɛ amɛnifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ hewɔ akɛni amɛkwa mi, ni amɛyashã tsofakɛŋmai amɛhã nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi, ni amɛkɛ amɛniji efee amãgãi, ni amɛja amɛ.

english_verse: Jeremiah, get ready! Go and tell the people what I command you to say. Don't be frightened by them, or I will make you terrified while they watch.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, bo Yeremia miamɔ, tee shi koni oyakɛɛ amɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mibafã bo akɛ okɛɛ lɛ. Otsui akafã yɛ amɛhewɔ, kɛjeee nakai lɛ mahã ojija yɛ amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: My power will make you strong like a fortress or a column of iron or a wall of bronze. You will oppose all of Judah, including its kings and leaders, its priests and people.
translation_verse: Naa, ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ mihã otsɔ̃ tamɔ maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he, tamɔ dade akulashiŋ, tamɔ akɔɔble gbogbo koni okɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ elumɛi kɛ esɔfoi kɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ ana.

english_verse: They will fight back, but they won't win. I, the Lord, give my word— I won't let them harm you.
translation_verse: Amɛbaate shi amɛwo bo, shi amɛyeŋ onɔ kunim, ejaakɛ mikɛ bo yɛ koni mahere bo. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord told me
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ,

english_verse: to go to Jerusalem and tell everyone that he had said: When you were my young bride, you loved me and followed me through the barren desert.
translation_verse: “Yaa, koni oyashiɛ owo Yerusalɛmbii atoiiaŋ, ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Mikaiɔ oblayeiaŋ anɔkwa ni oye mi lɛ, kɛ osuɔmɔ tamɔ ayɛmforo suɔmɔ lɛ. Mikaiɔ bɔ ni onyiɛ misɛɛ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni ji shikpɔŋ ni aduko nii yɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You belonged to me alone, like the first part of the harvest, and I severely punished those who mistreated you.
translation_verse: Mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji Israel hã Yehowa, eŋmãakpamɔ mli klɛŋklɛŋ yibii ni. Mɛi fɛɛ ni aaata ehe lɛ baaye sɔ̃. Ni sane fɔŋ baaye amɛ, Mi, Yehowa, mi mikɛɛ.’ ” Esha ni Israelbii ablema tsɛmɛi lɛ fee

english_verse: and I, the Lord, will speak. I was never unfair to your ancestors, but they left me and became worthless by following worthless idols.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ tɔ̃mɔ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ na yɛ mihe; hewɔ ni amɛtse amɛhe yɛ mihe kɛtee flɛŋŋ, ni amɛyadi yakayakanii asɛɛ ni ehã amɛtsɔ̃mɔ yakayakanii nɛɛ?

english_verse: I brought you here to my land, where food is abundant, but you made my land filthy with your sins.
translation_verse: Mikɛ nyɛ ba shikpɔŋ ni baa nii nɔ koni nyɛye enɔ ŋmãa kɛ enɔ nibii kpakpai lɛ. Shi be ni nyɛbashɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛbule mishikpɔŋ lɛ, ni nyɛhã migboshinii lɛ tsɔ̃ musubɔɔnii.

english_verse: The priests who teach my laws don't care to know me. Your leaders rebel against me; your prophets give messages from Baal and worship false gods. The Lord Accuses His People
translation_verse: Osɔfoi lɛ po biii akɛ, ‘Nɛgbɛ Yehowa yɔɔ?’ Mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ mɛi mla lɛ tete leee mi; maŋnɔyelɔi lɛ tɔ̃ minɔ, ni gbalɔi lɛ gba yɛ Baal hewalɛ naa; ni amɛyadi nibii ni ahe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ lɛ asɛɛ.” Sane ni Yehowa kɛshiɔ ewebii

english_verse: I will take you to court and accuse you and your descendants *
translation_verse: “Enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ lɛ mi, Yehowa, mikɛ nyɛ yɛ nɔ ko ni mikɛɔ, ni mikɛ nyɛbii abii hu baatao naa.

english_verse: of a crime that no nation has ever committed before. Just ask anyone, anywhere, from the eastern deserts to the islands in the west.
translation_verse: Nyɛfoa mli kɛyaa Kipro ŋshɔnaa maji amli nyɛyakwɛa, aloo nyɛtsua kɛyaa Kedar hu, ni nyɛyatao mli fitsofitso nyɛkwɛa akɛ nɛkɛ sane ko eba jɛi dã lo?

english_verse: You will find that no nation has ever abandoned its gods even though they were false. I am the true and glorious God, but you have rejected me to worship idols.
translation_verse: Ani maŋ ko yɛ ni etsake enyɔŋmɔi pɛŋ? Tsɛbelɛ nakai nyɔŋmɔi lɛ jeee fɛifɛi! Shi miwebii lɛ kɛ amɛnunyam lɛ etsake nii ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ.

english_verse: You, my people, have sinned in two ways— you have rejected me, the source of life-giving water, and you've tried to collect water in cracked and leaking pits dug in the ground.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ miwebii lɛ efee nifɔɔjianii srɔtoi enyɔ: amɛkwa mi, mi, ni mi ji wala nu fɛɛ jɛɛhe lɛ; ni amɛyakpɛkpɛɛ nubui amɛhã amɛhe, nubui ni ejwra ni nyɛɛɛ nu ato.” Nɔ ni anɔkwa ni Israel yeee lɛ gbala kɛba

english_verse: Enemies roared like lions and destroyed your land; towns lie burned and empty.
translation_verse: Jatai bolɔ wo lɛ; amɛbolɔ waa diɛŋtsɛ. Amɛkpãtã eshikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, emaji lɛ kamɔ shi amaŋfɔ̃i ni gbɔmɛi bɛ mli.

english_verse: Soldiers from the Egyptian towns of Memphis and Tahpanhes have cracked your skulls.
translation_verse: Asaŋ Memfis kɛ Tahpanhes hii lɛ ejwa opampam.

english_verse: It's all your own fault! You stopped following me, the Lord your God,
translation_verse: Israel, aso jeee bo diɛŋtsɛ oyatao nɛkɛ sane ohã ohe akɛ okwa Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, be mli ni ekpalaa bo yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ?

english_verse: Your own sins will punish you, because it was a bitter mistake for you to reject me without fear of punishment. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken.
translation_verse: Bo diɛŋtsɛ onifɔɔjianii lɛ baagbala otoi, ni kwamɔ ni okwa mi lɛ baabu bo fɔ. Na ole, ni oyoo akɛ kwamɔ ni okwa mi, Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nɔ fɔŋ ni, ni ebaajoo ehã bo. Mihe gbeyeishemɔ bɛ omli. Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ, mikɛɛ.” Israel ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ ejaa Yehowa

english_verse: Long ago you left me and broke all ties between us, refusing to be my servant. Now you worship other gods by having sex on hilltops or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: “Blema ko beebe ni oku opã lɛ, ni otserɛ kpãi ni fimɔ bo lɛ mli, ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Misɔ̃mɔɔɔ mɔ ko mɔ ko!’ Shi gɔŋkpɔ fɛɛ gɔŋkpɔ yiteŋ kɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni ebu kusuu shishi oyakotoɔ shi ojaa, ni okwaa mi yɛ.

english_verse: You were a choice grapevine, but you have become a wild, useless vine. Israel Is Stained with Guilt
translation_verse: Mitɛo bo akɛ wain tso kpakpa ni jɛ wu kpakpa mli. Shi te fee tɛŋŋ ni ofite otsɔ̃ kooŋ wain tso kwraa nɛɛ?

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Israel, you are stained with guilt, and no soap or bleach can wash it away.
translation_verse: Kɛji oju ohe ni osha ohe kɛ samla ni naa wa akɛ mɛ tete, mibana otɔ̃mɔ lɛ ni ekadi ohe kɛ̃. Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mikɛɛ.

english_verse: You deny your sins and say, “We aren't unclean. We haven't worshiped Baal.” But think about what you do in Hinnom Valley. You run back and forth like young camels, as you rush to worship one idol after another.
translation_verse: Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni okɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mibuleko mihe, miyajako wɔŋ Baal lɛ?’ Kwɛmɔ ojeŋ ni oba yɛ gɔji ateŋ jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, ni ooona ole nɔ ni ofee. Otamɔ ŋaŋ yooma oblayoo ni hiɛ foi kɛmiiya biɛ kɛ biɛ.

english_verse: You are a female donkey sniffing the desert air, wanting to mate with just anyone. You are an easy catch!
translation_verse: Otamɔ ŋaŋ teji yoo ni ele ŋanɔhilɛ, ni miifu kɔɔyɔɔ mli kɛmitao nuu. Namɔ baanyɛ ekɔnɔ naa etsi? Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni miitao lɛ ni etɔɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ kɛji etsuiasɛɛyaa be shɛ pɛ, mɛi anine shɛɔ enɔ.

english_verse: Your shoes are worn out, and your throat is parched from running here and there to worship foreign gods. “Stop!” I shouted, but you replied, “No! I love those gods too much.”
translation_verse: Israel, kwɛmɔ koni okahiɛ onane folo, asaŋ koni osɛ̃ŋ akagbi kɛ kumai. Shi okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Hiɛnɔkãmɔ ko bɛ? Ejaakɛ maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔi misumɔɔ, ni amɛsɛɛ manyiɛ.’ ” Israel sa toigbalamɔ

english_verse: You and your leaders are more disgraceful than thieves— you and your kings, your priests and prophets
translation_verse: “Bɔ ni kɛji amɔ julɔ ni ehiɛ gboɔ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Israelbii ahiɛ baagbo, maŋbii lɛ kɛ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi kɛ amɛlumɛi kɛ amɛsɔfoi kɛ amɛgbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ,

english_verse: worship stone idols and sacred poles as if they had created you and had given you life. You have rejected me, but when you're in trouble, you cry to me for help.
translation_verse: mɛi ni kɛɔ tso akɛ, ‘Mitsɛ ji bo’ kɛ mɛi hu ni kɛɔ tɛ akɛ, ‘Bo ofɔ mi’ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ baagbo, ejaakɛ amɛtsɔ̃ amɛsɛɛ, shi jeee amɛhiɛ amɛhã mi. Shi amɛfimɔ be mli lɛ amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Tee shi, ni ohere wɔyiwala.’

english_verse: Go cry to the gods you made! There should be enough of them to save you, because Judah has as many gods as it has towns. Israel Rebels against the Lord
translation_verse: “Shi Yuda, nɛgbɛ nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ni ofee ohã ohe lɛ yɔɔ? Amɛte shi akɛ amɛaanyɛ oyiwala amɛhere yɛ ofimɔ be lɛ mli lo? Ao! Yuda, te nyɔŋmɔi ni oyɔɔ lɛ ayifalɛ tamɔ maji ni oyɔɔ lɛ ayibɔ nɔŋŋ?

english_verse: The Lord said to Israel: You accuse me of not saving you, but I say you have rebelled.
translation_verse: Mɛɛba mɔ nyɛwieɔ nyɛshiɔ mi lɛ? Nyɛ fɛɛ tswɛm nyɛtse mihiɛ atua.” Yehowa kɛɛ.

english_verse: I tried punishing you, but you refused to come back to me, and like fierce lions you killed my prophets.
translation_verse: Yakatswaa po ni mitswia nyɛbii lɛ anii lɛ ejaakɛ no tsakeee amɛ. Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛdɛŋ klante ni gbegbee nyɛgbalɔi lɛ tamɔ jata kakawua ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ.

english_verse: Now listen to what I say! Did I abandon you in the desert or surround you with darkness? You are my people, yet you have told me, “We'll do what we want, and we refuse to worship you!”
translation_verse: Nyɛ, yinɔ nɛɛ nɔ bii, nyɛjwɛŋa Yehowa wiemɔi lɛ ahe. Ani mitsɔ̃ ŋa nɔ mihã Israelbii lo; loo shikpɔŋ ni enɔ ewo duŋ kpii? Mɛni hewɔ mɔ, ni miwebii lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, “Wɔye wɔhe; wɔbaaa oŋɔɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ?”

english_verse: A bride could not forget to wear her jewelry to her wedding, but you have forgotten me day after day.
translation_verse: Ani oblayoo hiɛ kpaa ehewulamɔnii anɔ, ani ayɛmforo hiɛ kpaa ekpeemɔ atade nɔ? Shi mi lɛ miwebii lɛ ahiɛ ekpa minɔ kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ.

english_verse: You are so clever at finding lovers that you could give lessons to a prostitute.
translation_verse: Anɔkwa, ole gbɛ nɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ ni nine shɛɔ suɔlɔ nɔ, no hewɔ lɛ, yei fɔ̃ji tete po ekase nii kɛjɛ odɛ̃ŋ.

english_verse: You killed innocent people for no reason at all. And even though their blood can be seen on your clothes,
translation_verse: Ohiafoi ni efeko nɔ ko lɛ alá yɛ otade namui lɛ amli, jeee nififiaŋ mina enɛ yɛ shi moŋ, he fɛɛ he; ni

english_verse: you claim to be innocent, and you want me to stop being angry with you. So I'll take you to court, and we'll see who is right.
translation_verse: okɛɔ akɛ, “Mifeko efɔŋ ko. Eji anɔkwale akɛ Yehowa efo emli ni fu mi lɛ sɛɛ.” Shi naa, mi Yehowa, mibagbala otoi yɛ kɛɛmɔ ni okɛɔ akɛ, “Mifeko esha ko lɛ hewɔ.”

english_verse: When Assyria let you down, you quickly ran to Egypt, but you'll find no help there,
translation_verse: Mɛɛba ni olilaa shi sɔŋŋ nɛkɛ, ni otsakeɔ onane nakai? Ijipt baahã ohiɛ agbo tamɔ bɔ ni Asiria hã ohiɛ gbo lɛ.

english_verse: and you will leave in great sadness. I won't let you find help from those you trust.
translation_verse: Obaajɛ Ijipt oba ni oniji jwere oyiteŋ kɛ awerɛhoo, ejaakɛ mɛi ni ohiɛ kã amɛnɔ lɛ, Yehowa ekwa amɛ, ni nɔ kpakpa ko bɛ ni obaana yɛ amɛdɛŋ.
