english_verse: The Lord said to the people of Israel: If a divorced woman marries, can her first husband ever marry her again? No, because this would pollute the land. But you have more gods than a prostitute has lovers. Why should I take you back?
translation_verse: Mi, mibi akɛ, “Kɛji nuu ko shwie eŋa, ni yoo lɛ shi nuu lɛ, ni eyatsɔ̃ nuu kroko ŋa lɛ, ani nuu lɛ kuɔ esɛɛ eyaŋɔɔ nakai yoo lɛ ekoŋŋ? Nɔ ko ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ ebuleɔ shikpɔŋ, nɔ ni mimɛi lɛ yɔɔ nɔ lɛ. Israel te okɛ shieŋtsɛmɛi babaoo eyabɔ ajwamãŋ, ni ooku osɛɛ oba miŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ?

english_verse: Just try to find one hilltop where you haven't gone to worship other gods by having sex. You sat beside the road like a robber in ambush, except you offered yourself to every passerby. Your sins of unfaithfulness have polluted the land.
translation_verse: Wo ohiɛ nɔ ni okwɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ hei ni yɔɔ kpataa lɛ. Te amɛteŋ he ni akɛ bo ebɔko ajwamãŋ yɛ lɛ? Otaa gbɛi atoii omɛɔ shieŋtsɛmɛi tamɔ Arabianyo woɔ ka yɛ shiaŋa mli kɛmɛɔ gbɛnyiɛlɔ. Okɛ ojwamaŋbɔɔ ni naa wa ebule shikpɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: So I, the Lord, refused to let the spring rains fall. But just like a prostitute, you still have no shame for what you have done.
translation_verse: No hewɔ ni atsi nunɛmɔ naa; ni gbo nu enɛɛɛ nɛɛ; shi ohiɛ yoo ajwamãŋ hiŋmɛi lolo, ni ohiɛ gbooo he.

english_verse: You call me your father or your long-lost friend;
translation_verse: “Ani otsɛko mi amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ akɛ, ‘Mitsɛ Ataa, bo ji mitsɛ kɛjɛ migbekɛbiiashi,

english_verse: you beg me to stop being angry, but you won't stop sinning. The Lord Asks Israel To Come Back to Him
translation_verse: omli fuŋ mi kɛyaŋ naanɔ, ni obɛŋ mi owoŋ omli kɛyaŋ naanɔ?’ Israel, nɔ ni okɛɔ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ ofee nɔ fɔŋ fɛɛ nɔ fɔŋ ni obaanyɛ ofee.” Esa akɛ Israel kɛ Yuda aje amɛhe sɛɛ

english_verse: When Josiah was king, the Lord said: Jeremiah, the kingdom of Israel was like an unfaithful wife who became a prostitute on the hilltops and in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Yehowa bi mi yɛ Maŋtsɛ Yosia yinɔ akɛ, “Bɛ ona nɔ ni Israel ni yeee anɔkwa lɛ fee lɛ? No ji bɔ ni etee gɔŋ fɛɛ gɔŋ ni kwɔ nɔ, kɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni ebu kusuu shishi eyabɔ ajwamãŋ yɛ jɛi lɛ?

english_verse: I knew that the kingdom of Israel had been unfaithful and committed many sins, yet I still hoped she might come back to me. But she didn't, so I divorced her and sent her away. Her sister, the kingdom of Judah, saw what happened, but she wasn't worried in the least, and I watched her become unfaithful like her sister.
translation_verse: Ena akɛ ajwamãŋ ni Israel ni yeee anɔkwa bɔ hewɔ lɛ mishwie lɛ akɛ miŋa. Shi kɛ̃lɛ Israel nyɛmiyoo Yuda ni yeee anɔkwa lɛ, eyasheee gbeyei; shi moŋ lɛ hu etee ni eyabɔ ajwamãŋ lɛ eko.

english_verse: The kingdom of Judah wasn't sorry for being a prostitute, and she didn't care that she had made both herself and the land unclean by worshiping idols of stone and wood.
translation_verse: Shi akɛni ajwamãŋbɔɔ efeee lɛ hiɛgbele hewɔ lɛ ekɛ tsei kɛ tɛi fɛɛ fite gbãlã, ni ebule shikpɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: And worst of all, the people of Judah pretended to come back to me.
translation_verse: Ni yɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ Yuda, Israel nyɛmiyoo ni yeee anɔkwa lɛ, kpaleee kɛbaaa miŋɔɔ kɛ etsui fɛɛ, shi moŋ kwa ekwa eba miŋɔɔ. Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.”

english_verse: Even the people of Israel were honest enough not to pretend.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Israel ni yeee ewu anɔkwa po etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ etɔ̃mɔ lɛ yɛ mlɛo fe Yuda nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Jeremiah, shout toward the north: Israel, I am your Lord— come back to me! You were unfaithful and made me furious, but I am merciful, and so I will forgive you.
translation_verse: Yaa kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni oyashiɛ yɛ jɛi, ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Israel ni yeee ewu anɔkwa, kpalemɔ kɛba miŋɔɔ! Mituŋ mihiɛ miwoŋ nyɛ ejaakɛ mɔbɔnalɔ ji mi. Mi, Yehowa mikɛɛ. Mibɛŋ nyɛ miwoŋ mimli kɛyaŋ naanɔ.

english_verse: You are unfaithful children, but you belong to me. Come home! I'll take one or two of you from each town and clan and bring you to Zion.
translation_verse: Ao! Nyɛ bii ni yeee anɔkwa, nyɛkpalea nyɛbaa, ejaakɛ mi ji nyɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ; ni nyɛmaŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli lɛ maŋɔ gbɔmɔ kome, ni weku fɛɛ weku mli lɛ maŋɔ gbɔmɛi enyɔ, ni mikɛ amɛ baaba Yerusalɛm. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.

english_verse: Then I'll appoint wise rulers who will obey me, and they will care for you like shepherds.
translation_verse: Ni mahã nyɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mitsui naa nɔkwɛlɔi. Amɛbaalɛ nyɛ kɛ nilee kɛ jwɛŋmɔ.

english_verse: You will increase in numbers, and there will be no need to remember the sacred chest or to make a new one.
translation_verse: Mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ nakai be mli, be ni nyɛfɔfɔi, ni nyɛyi efa pii yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, awieŋ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ he dɔŋŋ; ajwɛŋ ehe lɛ, akaiŋ lɛ ni ataoŋ lɛ, ni akpɛŋ ekroko dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: The whole city of Jerusalem will be my throne. All nations will come here to worship me, and they will no longer follow their stubborn, evil hearts.
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ abaatsɛ Yerusalɛm akɛ Yehowa Maŋtsɛ Sɛi, ni majimaji bluublu aaabua amɛhe naa kɛaaba Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm amɛbaja mi. Amɛkɛ kuɛŋtilɛ efeŋ nɔ ni amɛtsui fɔŋ kɛɔ amɛ lɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Then, in countries to the north, you people of Judah and Israel will be reunited, and you will return to the land I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, Yuda akutso lɛ baaya ayafata Israel akutso lɛ he ni amɛaajɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kutuu kɛaaba shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ akɛ amɛgboshinii lɛ nɔ.’ ” Nyɔŋmɔ Webii lɛ amãgãjamɔ

english_verse: I have always wanted to treat you as my children and give you the best land, the most beautiful on earth. I wanted you to call me “Father” and not turn from me.
translation_verse: “Misusu he bɔ ni maŋɔ bo mashi mibii anɔ, ni mahã bo shikpɔŋ fɛɛfɛo, gboshinii ko ni yɔɔ fɛo fe majimaji fɛɛ anɔ. Ni efee mi akɛ oootsɛ mi akɛ, “Mitsɛ Ataa,” ni okpaleŋ yɛ misɛɛ dɔŋŋ;

translation_verse: Amɛkɛɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Nyɛhãa wɔshea Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyei, lɛ mɔ ni ehãa nu nɛɔ Gbo kɛ Agbiɛnaa yɛ ebe mli hãa wɔ lɛ, ni ehãa nikpamɔ bei baninaa wɔ lɛ.’

english_verse: A hunter traps birds and puts them in a cage, but some of you trap humans and make them your slaves.
translation_verse: “Ejaakɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji yɛ mimaŋbii lɛ ateŋ; amɛwoɔ gbɔmɛi ka tamɔ loofɔlɔdulɔi woɔ antɛo lɛ; ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ tsɔnei amɛkɛduɔ gbɔmɛi.

english_verse: You are evil, and you lie and cheat to make yourselves rich. You are powerful
translation_verse: Amɛshĩai amli eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ mɔshishiumɔ tamɔ loofɔlɔ tsu ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ loofɔji. No hewɔ lɛ, amɛna nii, ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi wuji,

english_verse: You need to be punished, and so I will take revenge.
translation_verse: “Mi, Yehowa, miibi akɛ, ‘Mikagbala amɛtoi yɛ enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ, ni mikatɔ mihe owele yɛ maŋ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ nɔ lo?

english_verse: Look at the terrible things going on in this country. I am shocked!
translation_verse: Afee naakpɛɛnii kɛ gbeyeinii yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Prophets give their messages in the name of a false god, my priests don't want to serve me, and you—my own people— like it this way! But on the day of disaster, where will you turn for help?
translation_verse: Gbalɔi lɛ gbaa amale gbalɛi, ni nɔ ni amɛkɛɔ osɔfoi lɛ no osɔfoi lɛ feɔ, ni nɔ ni afeɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ mimaŋbii lɛ hu anaa. Shi kɛji naagbee be lɛ shɛ lɛ, te nyɛbaafee tɛŋŋ?’ ”

english_verse: Run for your lives, people of Benjamin. Get out of Jerusalem. Sound a trumpet in Tekoa and light a signal fire in Beth-Haccherem. Soon you will be struck by disaster from the north.
translation_verse: Ao! Nyɛ Benyaminbii, nyɛjoa foi kɛjea Yerusalɛm ni nyɛhere nyɛyiwala. Akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ yɛ Tekoa, nyɛkɛ lasu pukɔŋŋ atoa okadi yɛ Bet-Hakerem, ejaakɛ sane fɔŋ ni ji hiɛkpãtãmɔ kpeteŋkple miibu tamɔ oblɔtu kɛmiijɛ kooyigbɛ kɛmiiba.

english_verse: but shepherds will surround it and divided up, then let their flocks eat all the grass.
translation_verse: Lumɛi kɛ amɛwebii baaba abatua lɛ; amɛbashishii amɛbuui kɛbɔle Yerusalɛm kpula, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baato eniyenii he ni esumɔɔ.

english_verse: Kings will tell their troops, “If we reach Jerusalem in the morning, we'll attack at noon. But if we arrive later,
translation_verse: Amɛbaakɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhoa ta nyɛwoa lɛ; nyɛtea shi koni wɔfã ta lɛ kɛyatua lɛ shwane!” Shi amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, “Kpoo hã wɔ kɛji wɔtee benɛ ejaakɛ je miina, ni hiɛ miibu ni gbɛkɛ hɔɔŋ lɛ elɛɛ shi kɛtee shɔŋŋ.

english_verse: we'll attack after dark and destroy its fortresses.”
translation_verse: Belɛ nyɛhãa wɔtea shi, ni wɔfã nyɔɔŋ kɛyatuaa lɛ, ni wɔkpãtã emɔji fɛɛfɛji lɛ ahiɛ!”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I will command these armies to chop down trees and build a ramp up to the walls of Jerusalem. People of Jerusalem, I must punish you for your injustice.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, “Nyɛtoa Yerusalɛm he tsei lɛ nyɛshwiea shi, koni nyɛkɛtswaa kpokui nyɛkɛsaa Yerusalɛm yi. Maŋ ni abaagbala etoi ni, ejaakɛ anaaa nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ mli fe yiwalɛ saneyeli sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Evil pours from your city like water from a spring. Sounds of injustice and violence echo within your walls; victims are everywhere, wounded and dying.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni nubu baa emli nu yi koni ehi krɔŋŋ lɛ, nakai Yerusalɛm baa enifɔɔji anii lɛ ayi. Henitswiamɔ kɛ niiahiɛkpãtãmɔ he anuɔ yɛ mli; ni hela kɛ pilamɔi sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ minaa yɛ mli.

english_verse: Listen to me, you people of Jerusalem and Judah. I will abandon you, and your land will become an empty desert.
translation_verse: Ao, Yerusalɛm, kwɛmɔ ni ahi; kɛjeee nakai lɛ mibashi bo, ni mibafee bo amaŋfɔ̃, ni oootsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ nɔ.” Israel tse atua

english_verse: I will tell your enemies to leave your nation bare like a vine stripped of grapes. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah's Anger
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, “Abɛɛ Israelbii ni eshwɛ lɛ ashishi kwraa tamɔ ayeɔ kpɛkpɛo yɛ waintsei anɔ lɛ. Nyɛkpaa tso niji lɛ anɔ ekoŋŋ koni nyɛtserɛ yibii fɛɛ yibii yɛ tsei lɛ anɔ tamɔ bɔ ni wainyibiitselɔ feɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I have told the people that you, Lord, will punish them, but they just laugh and refuse to listen.
translation_verse: “Namɛi mikɛaawie, ni mabɔ amɛ kɔkɔ, ni amɛaabo mi toi? Naa, amɛtoii etsimɔ no hewɔ lɛ, amɛnuuu nɔ. Naa, Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ hefɛoyeli sane ehã amɛ, ni amɛnaaa he miishɛɛ.

english_verse: Your anger against Judah flames up inside me, and I can't hold it in much longer. The Lord's Anger Will Sweep Everyone Away The Lord answered: Don't hold back my anger! Let it sweep away everyone— the children at play and all adults, young and old alike.
translation_verse: Hewɔ lɛ mi hu mimli ewo la naakpa tamɔ Yehowa nɔŋŋ; ni mlila lɛ naatsii etɔ mi.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Fɔsemɔ mimlila lɛ oshwie gbekɛbii ni yɔɔ blohuiaŋ kɛ oblahii akui lɛ hu fɛɛ anɔ. Abaamɔmɔ nuu kɛ eŋa fɛɛ kɛya, ni hiimeji kɛ mɛi ni egbɔlɔ kotokoto hu abaamɔmɔ amɛ.

english_verse: I'll punish the people of Judah and give to others their houses and fields, as well as their wives. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Amɛshĩai kɛ amɛŋmɔji kɛ amɛŋamɛi fɛɛ aaatsɔ̃mɔ mɛi krokomɛi moŋ anii, ejaakɛ mibagbala shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ bii lɛ atoi. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.

english_verse: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.
translation_verse: Amɛtsaa miwebii lɛ apilamɔ lɛ jabejabe ko kɛkɛ, ni amɛkɛɔ amɛ akɛ, ‘Omanye ei! Omanye ei!’ Be mli ni omanye ko kwraa bɛ.

english_verse: They should be ashamed of their disgusting sins, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Rejected God's Way of Life
translation_verse: Kɛji amɛfee nihiinii lɛ, ani amɛhiɛ gboɔ he? Dabida, amɛhiɛ gbooo he ekome folo nɛkɛ; amɛhiɛgbele tɔ ejwa. No hewɔ lɛ, be mli ni mibagbala miwebii lɛ atoi lɛ, amɛbaafata mɛi ni baanyɔnyɔi lɛ ahe. No baafee amɛnaagbee. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Israel kwa Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛ lɛ

english_verse: The Lord said: My people, when you stood at the crossroads, I told you, “Follow the road your ancestors took, and you will find peace.” But you refused.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyadamɔa gbɛjegbɛi lɛ ahe, ni nyɛkwɛ. Nyɛbia he ni blema gbɛi ni ja lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni ji gbɛ kpakpa lɛ yɔɔ koni nyɛnyiɛ no nɔ, ni nyɛsusumai atsuii aaanyɔ amɛmli.” Shi hetoo ni amɛhã ji, “Wɔnyiɛŋ nɔ!”

english_verse: I also sent prophets to warn you of danger, but when they sounded the alarm, you paid no attention.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, miito bulɔi mahã nyɛ, ni miikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛboa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɛmɔ toi, ni nyɛye nɔ.’ Shi amɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Wɔboŋ toi!’ ”

english_verse: So I tell all nations on earth, “Watch what I will do!
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ, majimaji kɛ asafoi, nyɛboa nɔ ni baaba gbɔmɛi nɛɛ anɔ lɛ toi.

english_verse: My people ignored me and rejected my laws. They planned to do evil, and now the evil they planned will happen to them.”
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ, bo toi! Miihã hiɛkpãtãmɔ abanina gbɔmɛi nɛɛ, ejaakɛ no ji yibii ni amɛjeŋba ewo; ejaakɛ miwiemɔi lɛ amɛboko toi, ni amɛkwa mimlai lɛ.

english_verse: People of Judah, you bring me incense from Sheba and spices from distant lands. You offer sacrifices of all kinds. But why bother? I hate these gifts of yours!
translation_verse: Mɛni mifeɔ krɔbɔo ni jɛ Sheba, kɛ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ sinamon ni jeɔ ŋma he? Shãa afɔlei ni nyɛshãa nyɛhãa mi lɛ, miheee; nyɛkooloo afɔlei lɛ hu esaa mihiɛ.

english_verse: So I will put stumbling blocks in your path, and everyone will die, including parents and children, neighbors and friends. An Army from the North
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, ‘Naa, mato gbɔmɛi nɛɛ pampi, ni amɛbatɛrɛ ni tsɛmɛi kɛ bii kɛ kuuŋnyo kɛ naanyo fɛɛ ahiɛ baakpãtã.’ ” Aaajɛ kooyigbɛ abatua Yerusalɛm

english_verse: The Lord said, “Look toward the north, where a powerful nation has prepared for war.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Naa, mɛi komɛi miijɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛmiiba; maŋ wulu ko miifã kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehe tɔ̃ɔ kɛba.

english_verse: Its well-armed troops are cruel and never show mercy. Their galloping horses sound like ocean waves pounding on the shore. This army will attack you, lovely Jerusalem.”
translation_verse: Amɛhiɛ gãi kɛ akplɔ, amɛyi wa, ni amɛnaaa mɔbɔ ni amɛnyiɛmɔ gbɛɔ hoo tamɔ ŋshɔ. Amɛtara okpɔŋɔi anɔ, ni amɛgba ta kɛmiiba; amɛkɛ bo Zion, miiba abawu.”

english_verse: Then the people said, “Just hearing about them makes us tremble with fear, and we twist and turn in pain like a woman giving birth.”
translation_verse: Yerusalɛm kɛɛ, “Wɔnu amɛhe momo; ni no ehã wɔnijiaŋ eje wui, ni wɔtsui efã, ni tamɔ yoo ni miikɔmɔ ni ebaafɔ!

english_verse: The Lord said, “Don't work in your fields or walk along the roads. It's too dangerous. The enemy is well armed
translation_verse: Ehiii wɔ kpojee kɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ yaa, tɛmpɔŋi lɛ anɔ nyiɛmɔ hu ebɔ wɔ, ejaakɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ efã klante, ni he fɛɛ he efee gbeyei.”

english_verse: and attacks without warning. So mourn, my people, as though your only child had died. Wear clothes made of sackcloth and roll in the ash pile.” The Lord's People Must Be Tested The Lord said:
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Ao, mimaŋbii, nyɛkɔlɔa kpekpe nyɛbumɔa, nyɛkokloa shi yɛ lamlu mli, nyɛwoa yara nyɛfoa waa tamɔ afoɔ bi koome ni egbo, ejaakɛ hiɛkpãtãlɔ lɛ baaba ebatua nyɛ trukaa.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, test my people as though they were metal.
translation_verse: “Mifee bo tamɔ shikakalɔ yɛ mimaŋbii lɛ ateŋ koni okpa amɛ shi ni ona bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ.

english_verse: And you'll find they are hard like bronze and iron. They are stubborn rebels, always spreading lies. *
translation_verse: Kaniŋkajelɔi kpanakui sɔŋŋ ji amɛ, ni amɛtsui wa tamɔ akɔɔble loo dade. Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ mɔfitelɔi ji amɛ, amɛyeɔ mɛi ahe osheku kɛfoɔ shi.

english_verse: But you have ignored me and become even more stubborn and sinful than your ancestors ever were! Slaughter Valley The Lord said:
translation_verse: shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ amɛbooo mi toi, ni amɛyeee migbee nɔ; shi moŋ amɛfee amɛhe kuɛŋtilɔi, ni amɛfee nifɔɔjianii fe amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tete.

english_verse: The Lord told me to stand by the gate of the temple and tell the people who were going in that the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, had said: Pay attention, people of Judah! Change your ways and start living right, then I will let you keep on living in your own country.
translation_verse: “Yaadamɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ agbo lɛ mli koni owie wiemɔ nɛɛ yɛ jɛi. Nyɛ Yudabii fɛɛ ni nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ nɛkɛ agboi nɛɛ amli nyɛyajaa Yehowa, nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɔ toi. Nyɛsaa nyɛjeŋba kɛ nyɛnifeemɔnii hu, ni mahã nyɛhi shi yɛ biɛ.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! My temple is here in Jerusalem, but that doesn't mean I will protect you.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ akafɔ̃a nɛkɛ lakamɔ wiemɔi nɛɛ anɔ akɛ, ‘Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we nɛ! Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we nɛ! Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we nɛ!’

english_verse: I will keep you safe only if you change your ways and are fair and honest with each other.
translation_verse: “Shi moŋ kɛji nyɛtsake nyɛjeŋba kɛ nyɛnifeemɔnii lɛɛlɛŋ, kɛji nyɛkojo mɔ kɛ enaanyo teŋ yɛ jalɛ naa,

english_verse: Then I will let you enjoy a long life in this land I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: no lɛ mahã nyɛhi shi yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ni mijɛ jeeŋmɔ mikɛhã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ kɛya naanɔ.

english_verse: But just look at what is happening! You put your trust in worthless lies.
translation_verse: “Naa, nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ lakamɔ wiemɔi ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ anɔ.

english_verse: You steal and murder; you lie in court and are unfaithful in marriage. You worship idols and offer incense to Baal, when these gods have never done anything for you.
translation_verse: Aso nyɛaaju, ni nyɛaagbe gbɔmɔ, ni nyɛaafite gbãlã, ni nyɛaakãmɔ amale kitãi, ni nyɛaashã tsofakɛŋma nyɛkɛhã Baal, ni nyɛaayaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni nyɛleee,

english_verse: And then you come into my temple and worship me! Do you think I will protect you so that you can go on sinning?
translation_verse: kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛba nyɛbadamɔ mihiɛ yɛ mishĩa nɛɛ ni nyɛmiikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Wɔhe eje mli;’ kɛkɛ lɛ no sɛɛ lɛ nyɛtee nyɛyafee nihiinii ni mihiɔ lɛ ekoŋŋ lo?

english_verse: You are thieves, and you have made my temple your hideout. But I've seen everything you have done.
translation_verse: Aso nɛkɛ mishĩa nɛɛ etsɔ̃ julɔi ateemɔhe yɛ nyɛhiɛ lo?

english_verse: Go to Shiloh, where my sacred tent once stood. Take a look at what I did there. My people Israel sinned, and so I destroyed Shiloh!
translation_verse: Naa, mi diɛŋtsɛ mina nɔ ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ momo. Nyɛyaa miwe lɛ ni yɔɔ Shilo lɛ, he ni aja mi yɛ tsuutsu lɛ, nyɛyakwɛa nɔ ni mifee yɛ jɛi yɛ mimaŋ Israelbii lɛ anifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: While you have been sinning, I have been trying to talk to you, but you refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ akɛni nyɛ hu nyɛfee nibii gbohii nɛɛ fɛɛ eko, ni mikɛ nyɛ ewie aahu, shi nyɛbooo mi toi, ni mitsɛ nyɛ hu nyɛhereee mi nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: Don't think this temple will protect you. Long ago I told your ancestors to build it and worship me here, but now I have decided to tear it down, just as I destroyed Shiloh.
translation_verse: hewɔ lɛ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni mifee Shilo lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ mibafee mishĩa nɛɛ ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ nɔ, kɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ni mikɛhã nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ.

english_verse: And as for you, people of Judah, I'm going to send you away from my land, just as I sent away the people of Ephraim and the other northern tribes. Punishment for Worshiping Other Gods
translation_verse: Mibashwie nyɛ kɛje mihiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mishwie nyɛnyɛmimɛi ni ji Efraim shwiei lɛ fɛɛ kɛje mihiɛ lɛ.” Maŋbii lɛ atoigbele lɛ

english_verse: Do you see what the people of Judah are doing in their towns and in the streets of Jerusalem?
translation_verse: Ani onaaa nibii ni amɛfeɔ yɛ Yuda maji lɛ amli, kɛ nɔ ni amɛfeɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm blohui lɛ amli lɛ?

english_verse: Children gather firewood, their fathers build fires, and their mothers mix dough to bake bread for the goddess they call the Queen of Heaven. They even offer wine sacrifices to other gods, just to insult me.
translation_verse: Gbekɛbii lɛ yalɛɔ lai kɛbaa, ni amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shɛreɔ la lɛ, ni yei lɛ kpɔtɔɔ ma lɛ ni akɛshãa aboloo akɛyahãa jemawɔŋ yoo ni amɛtsɛɔ lɛ Ŋwɛi Maŋnyɛ lɛ, ni amɛfɔseɔ dãa amɛshwieɔ shi akɛ afɔle amɛkɛhãa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi koni amɛkɛwo mimli la.

english_verse: But they are not only insulting me; they are also harming themselves by doing these shameful things.
translation_verse: Shi mi, Yehowa, miibi akɛ, ‘Aso mi, mimli la amɛwoɔ lɛ lo?’ Ani jeee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe mlila amɛwoɔ, ni amɛkɛwoɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe hiɛgbele lo?

english_verse: And now, I, the Lord All-Powerful, will flood Judah with my fiery anger until nothing is left—no people or animals, no trees or crops. It Is Useless To Offer Sacrifices
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mi, Yehowa, bɔ ni mikɛɔ nɛ, ‘Naa, mimli baafu, ni mimli baawo Sɔlemɔ we nɛɛ, gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi kɛ ŋa nɔ tsei kɛ ŋmɔshi niyenii fɛɛ la. Mimlila lɛ naa baawa tamɔ la ni miitso, ni anyɛŋ agbe.’ ”

english_verse: At the time I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I didn't command them to offer sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ be ni miyajie nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, mikɛ amɛ ewieee he, ni asaŋ miwooo amɛ kitã ko yɛ shãa afɔle kɛ kooloo afɔle shãa he.

english_verse: Instead, I told them, “If you listen to me and do what I tell you, I will be your God, you will be my people, and all will go well for you.”
translation_verse: Shi moŋ miwo amɛ kitã akɛ, ‘Nyɛyea migbee nɔ, ni matsɔ̃ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ, ni nyɛ hu nyɛbaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ; nyɛbaa nyɛjeŋ yɛ kitãi ni miwo nyɛ lɛ anaa, bɔ ni afee ni ahi ahã nyɛ.’

english_verse: But your ancestors refused to listen. They were stubborn, and whenever I wanted them to go one way, they always went the other.
translation_verse: Shi amɛbooo mi toi lɛ, amɛyeee migbee nɔ hu; shi moŋ amɛyanyiɛ nɔ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛjwɛŋmɔ kɛ amɛtsuii fɔ̃ji ni wa lɛ kɛɛ amɛ lɛ sɛɛ; ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛ amɛjeŋba fite fe tsutsu lɛ.

english_verse: Ever since your ancestors left Egypt, I have been sending my servants the prophets to speak for me.
translation_verse: Kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aahu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, mikã he miitsu mitsuji ni ji gbalɔi lɛ amɛŋɔɔ be fɛɛ be,

english_verse: So you must say to them: People of Judah, I am the Lord your God, but you have refused to obey me, and you didn't change when I punished you. And now, you no longer even pretend to be faithful to me.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛtsɔ̃ nyɛhe maŋ ni booo Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ toi, ni nyɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ tsɔsemɔ. Anɔkwale egbo yɛ nyɛteŋ, atsiii tã dɔŋŋ po.’ ” Eshai ni afeɔ yɛ Hinom Jɔɔ lɛ mli

english_verse: Shave your head bald and throw away the hair. Sing a funeral song on top of a barren hill. You people have made me angry, and I have abandoned you.
translation_verse: “Yerusalɛmbii, nyɛkua nyɛyi nyɛshwiea, nyɛwoa yara yɛ gɔji kpataai lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa ekwa, ni ekpoo yinɔbii ni emli efu amɛ nɛɛ!

english_verse: You have disobeyed me by putting your disgusting idols in my temple, and now the temple itself is disgusting to me.
translation_verse: “Ejaakɛ Yudabii lɛ efee nɔ fɔŋ yɛ mihiɛ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ. Amɛkɛ amɛmãgãi ni mihiɔ lɛ eyamamɔ miSɔlemɔ we ni ajaa mi yɛ mli lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛbule jɛi.

english_verse: At Topheth in Hinnom Valley you have built altars where you kill your children and burn them as sacrifices to other gods. I would never think of telling you to do this.
translation_verse: Ni amɛyama afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ Tofet yɛ Hinom Jɔɔ lɛ mli, koni amɛgbe amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei amɛkɛshã afɔle. Enɛ ji nɔ ko ni mifãko akɛ afee; ebako miyiŋ tete po.

english_verse: So watch out! Someday that place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley, because you will bury your dead there until you run out of room,
translation_verse: Naa, gbii miiba, ni atsɛŋ jɛi akɛ Tofet loo Hinom Jɔɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ abaatsɛ jɛi Gbɔmɔgbee Jɔɔ, akɛni jɛi abaafu gbohii yɛ; ejaakɛ he kroko bɛ ni aaafu amɛ yɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: and then bodies will lie scattered on the ground. Birds and wild animals will come and eat, and no one will be around to scare them off.
translation_verse: Ni nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ gbohii lɛ baatsɔ̃ niyenii ahã ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ kooloi, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko eshwieŋ amɛ.

english_verse: When I am finished with your land, there will be deathly silence in the empty ruins of Jerusalem and the towns of Judah—no happy voices, no sounds of parties or wedding celebrations.
translation_verse: Mafo nyamɔ kɛ miishɛɛ sɛɛ yɛ Yuda maji lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm blohui fɛɛ amli. Anuŋ ayɛmforo kɛ ayɛmforo wu gbee dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃.”

english_verse: Then the bones of the dead kings of Judah and their officials will be dug up, along with the bones of the priests, the prophets, and everyone else in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, abaaloo Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ maŋ lumɛi lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛmbii akromɔbii fɛɛ awui yɛ amɛgbonyobui lɛ amli.

english_verse: who loved and worshiped the sun, moon, and stars. These bones will be scattered and left lying on the ground like trash, where the sun and moon and stars can shine on them.
translation_verse: Abaagbɛ wui nɛɛ amli aka hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii, ni ji nibii ni amɛsumɔ ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛyanyiɛ amɛsɛɛ ni amɛja amɛ lɛ. Abuaŋ amɛwui nɛɛ anaa, ni afuŋ hu; shi moŋ amɛbaatsɔ̃ tamɔ wamɔ yɛ tumo nɔ.

english_verse: Some of you people of Judah will be left alive, but I will force you to go to foreign countries, and you will wish you were dead. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken. The People Took the Wrong Road
translation_verse: Jaku fɔŋ nɛɛ mli bii fɛɛ ni aaashwɛ yɛ hei fɛɛ ni mishwie amɛ kɛtee lɛ, amɛaashwe akɛ amɛgboi fe nɔ ni amɛaahi wala mli. Mi, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ mikɛɛ.” Esha kɛ ehe toigbalamɔ

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Jerusalem, when you stumble and fall, you get back up, and if you take a wrong road, you turn around and go back.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ mikɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Aso kɛji agbee shi lɛ, ateee shi? Aloo kɛji adu gbɛ lɛ akuuu sɛɛ?

english_verse: So why do you refuse to come back to me? Why do you hold so tightly to your false gods?
translation_verse: Mɛni hewɔ mɔ, ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ egba afã, ni amɛka jɛi kwraa nɛɛ? Amɛhiɛ shishiumɔ mli kpɛŋŋ, ni amɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ kpalemɔ.

english_verse: I listen carefully, but none of you admit that you've done wrong. Without a second thought, you run down the wrong road like horses running blindly into battle.
translation_verse: Mikɛ tsuishitoo bo amɛ toi; shi amɛwieee anɔkwale. Mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni nifɔɔjianii ni efee lɛ edɔ lɛ, ni no ehã etsake etsui. Shi moŋ ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛni mifee?’ Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ekɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛ tamɔ bɔ ni okpɔŋɔ shaa foi kitikiti kɛboteɔ ta mli lɛ.

english_verse: Storks, doves, swallows, and thrushes all know when it's time to fly away for the winter and when to come back. But you, my people, don't know what I demand.
translation_verse: Klitso ni ji loofɔlɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi tete le be ni esa akɛ eku esɛɛ eba; nakai nɔŋŋ kosɛɛ okpo hu kɛ nyɔŋmɔbitɛte kɛ kpokukpoku fɛɛ le amɛbaabe; shi mimɛi lɛ leee mi, Yehowa, mimlai lɛ.

english_verse: You say, “We are wise because we have the teachings and laws of the Lord.” But I say that your teachers have turned my words into lies!
translation_verse: Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Wɔ lɛ wɔle nii, ni Yehowa mla lɛ yɛ wɔdɛŋ’ lɛ? Naa, woloŋmalɔi lɛ kɛ amɛmale niŋmaa ehã mla lɛ etsɔ̃ amale mla.

english_verse: Your wise men have rejected what I say, and so they have no wisdom. Now they will be trapped and put to shame; they won't know what to do.
translation_verse: Nilelɔi nɛɛ abaawo amɛ hiɛgbele, amɛbaajijaa, ni abaaŋɔ amɛ nom, ejaakɛ amɛkwa Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ. Belɛ nɛgbɛ amɛnilee lɛ yɔɔ mɔ?

english_verse: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.
translation_verse: Amɛmiitsa mimaŋbii lɛ apilamɔ lɛ jabejabe ko kɛkɛ, ni amɛkɛɔ amɛ akɛ, ‘Omanye ei! Omanye!’ Be mli ni omanye ko kwraa bɛ.

english_verse: They should be ashamed of the way they live, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else.
translation_verse: Ani kɛji amɛfee musubɔɔnii lɛ, efeɔ amɛ hiɛgbele? Dabida! Efeee amɛ hiɛgbele kome folo nɛkɛ, ejaakɛ amɛhiɛgbele tɔ ejwa. Be mli ni mibagbala amɛtoi lɛ, abaabutu amɛ, ni amɛbaafata mɛi ni baanyɔnyɔi lɛ ahe. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.”

english_verse: I will wipe them out. They are vines without grapes; fig trees without figs or leaves. They have not done a thing that I told them! I, the Lord, have spoken. The People and Their Punishment
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ, “Be ni miba miwebii lɛ anaabuamɔ lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ waintsei ni wainyibii bɛ nɔ, loo agbãmi tsei ni agbãmi bɛ nɔ, ni amɛnɔ bai tete eŋãla; ni nii ni mikɛhã amɛ lɛ hu eje amɛdɛŋ.”

english_verse: The people of Judah say to each other, “What are we waiting for? Let's run to a town with walls and die there. We rebelled against the Lord, and we were sentenced to die by drinking poison.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba mɔ wɔtara shi nɛkɛ lolo? Nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa; nyɛhãa wɔbotea maji ni atswa gbogboi awo amɛhe lɛ amli koni wɔhiɛ ayakpãtã yɛ jɛi; ejaakɛ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋmɛɛ wɔhe ehã hiɛkpãtãmɔ, ehã wɔ nu ni awo mli ebɔɔ koni wɔnu, ejaakɛ wɔtɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ.

english_verse: We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Wɔkwɛ toiŋjɔlɛ gbɛ, shi nɔ kpakpa ko baaa, wɔkwɛ tsamɔ gbɛ, shi naa, tsuifãa moŋ ni pue.

english_verse: Our enemies have reached the town of Dan in the north, and the snorting of their horses makes us tremble with fear. The enemy will destroy Jerusalem and our entire nation. No one will survive.”
translation_verse: Anuɔ henyɛlɔi lɛ akpɔŋɔi lɛ atsinemɔ kɛjɛɔ Dan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ kpokpoɔ kɛji amɛkpɔŋɔhii lɛ bolɔ. Amɛmiiba amɛbakpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ enɔ nibii fɛɛ ahiɛ, wɔmaŋ lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mli.”

english_verse: “Watch out!” the Lord says. “I'm sending poisonous snakes to attack you, and no one can stop them.” Jeremiah Mourns for His People
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Ejaakɛ, naa, miiwo onufui agbɛ kɛba nyɛteŋ, ni ji blikai, ni ŋkunyaayeli ko ŋkunyaayeli ko nyɛɛɛ amɛhe ajɔɔ koni amɛbakɔ̃mɔ nyɛ.” Yeremia ye emaŋbii ahe ŋkɔmɔ

english_verse: I'm burdened with sorrow and feel like giving up.
translation_verse: Mikɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ anyɛŋ atsa, mitsui ekumɔ yɛ mimli.

english_verse: In a foreign land my people are crying. Listen! You'll hear them say, “Has the Lord deserted Zion? Is he no longer its king?” I hear the Lord reply, “Why did you make me angry by worshiping useless idols?”
translation_verse: Naa, kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei fɛɛ, minuɔ mimaŋbii abolɔmɔ akɛ, “Ani Yehowa bɛ Zion lo? Zion maŋtsɛ lɛ bɛ Zion?” Yehowa, amɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ, to he akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛwo mi mlifu kɛ maŋsɛɛ amãgãi ni nyɛkotoɔ ni nyɛjaa lɛ?”

english_verse: The people complain, “Spring and summer have come and gone, but still the Lord hasn't rescued us.”
translation_verse: Maŋbii lɛ bolɔ akɛ, “Nikpamɔbe lɛ eho, ni atse nii agbe naa, ni ahereko wɔyiwala.”

english_verse: My people are crushed, and so is my heart. I am horrified and mourn.
translation_verse: Mitsui ekumɔ yɛ mimli, yɛ mimaŋbii ahejaramɔ lɛ hewɔ. Miiye ŋkɔmɔ; mihe ejɔ̃ mihe.

english_verse: If medicine and doctors may be found in Gilead, why aren't my people healed?
translation_verse: Ani tsofa bɛ Gilead lo? Tsofatsɛmɛi bɛ jɛi lo? Mɛni hewɔ mɔ ni atsako mimaŋbii lɛ?

english_verse: I wish that my eyes were fountains of tears, so I could cry day and night for my people who were killed.
translation_verse: Mina ni kulɛ miyitso lɛ nubu ni; ni mihiŋmɛii hu nuhiŋmɛii ni koni mikɛfo mimaŋbii ni enyɔnyɔi lɛ shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.

english_verse: I wish I could go into the desert and find a hiding place from all who are treacherous and unfaithful to God. The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: Mina ni kulɛ miyɛ gbɛnyiɛlɔi atoohe yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ he ko, koni mashi mimaŋbii ateŋ maya jɛi. Ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ lɛ gbãlãfitelɔi ji amɛ; kutumpɔfoi asafo ji amɛ.

english_verse: The Lord replied: Lies come from the mouths of my people, like arrows from a bow. With each dishonest deed their power increases, and not one of them will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: Amɛlilɛi edɔrɔ tamɔ gãitso; amale ehe shi waa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fe anɔkwayeli moŋ. “Amɛjɛɔ nɔ fɔŋ kome he kɛyaa ekroko he, ni amɛleee mi po.” Yehowa kɛɛ.

english_verse: They wear themselves out, always looking for a new way to cheat their friends.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shishiuɔ enaanyo, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa ewieee anɔkwale; amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛlilɛi malemɔ; amɛfeɔ efɔŋ, ni amɛmiii tsuitsakemɔ.

english_verse: Everyone takes advantage of everyone else, and no one will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: Yiwalɛ kɛ shishiumɔnii ni amɛfeɔ nɔtoonɔtoo hewɔ lɛ, amɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ amɛaale mi. Yehowa kɛɛ.

english_verse: And so I will purify the hearts of my people just as gold is purified in a furnace. I have no other choice.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, “Naa, matsuu amɛhe koni maka amɛ yɛ la mli makwɛ, ejaakɛ mɛni dɔŋŋ manyɛ mafee yɛ miwebii nɛɛ ahewɔ?

english_verse: They say they want peace, but this lie is deadly, like an arrow that strikes when you least expect it.
translation_verse: Gãimlibi ni gbeɔ mɔ ji amɛlilɛi; kutumpɔo wiemɔ pɛ ele. Mɔ kɛ enaanyo wieɔ kɛ naajɔlɛ tsɛbelɛ ewo lɛ ka yɛ etsuiŋ.

english_verse: Give me one good reason not to punish them as they deserve. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah Weeps for His People
translation_verse: Aso mikagbala amɛtoi yɛ enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ? Mikatɔ mihe owele yɛ maŋ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ nɔ lo? Mi, Yehowa, miibi.”

english_verse: I weep for the pastureland in the hill country. It's so barren and scorched that no one travels there. No cattle can be found there, and birds and wild animals have all disappeared.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Mawo yara mafo gɔji lɛ waa, ni maye ŋkɔmɔ yɛ ŋa nɔ kooloi aniyelihei lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ jɛi fɛɛ eŋãla, ni mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ jɛi kɛhooo dɔŋŋ. Anuuu tsinai agbee yɛ jɛi; ni jwɛiaŋ loofɔji kɛ kooloi tete ejo foi kɛshi jɛi amɛtee.”

english_verse: I heard the Lord reply, “When I am finished, Jerusalem and the towns of Judah will be piles of ruins where only jackals live.” Why the Land Was Destroyed
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mahã Yerusalɛm atsɔ̃ maŋ koikoi, ebaatsɔ̃ ŋaŋgbei ashihilɛhe. Yuda maji lɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ jɛi.”

english_verse: I said to the Lord, “None of us can understand why the land has become like an uncrossable desert. Won't you explain why?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mibi akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ mɛɛ hewɔ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ ekpãtã, ni etsɔ̃ shiaŋa ni mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ nɔ kɛhooo nɛɛ? Namɔ ji nilelɔ ni aaanu enɛ shishi? Namɔ ji mɔ ni bo Yehowa ojie otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ni egba?”

english_verse: The Lord said: I destroyed the land because the people disobeyed me and rejected my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Yehowa here nɔ akɛ, “Enɛ fɛɛ hewɔ ni mimɛi lɛ ekwa mimlai ni miwo amɛ lɛ; ni amɛbooo migbee toi, ni amɛfeee bɔ ni mikɛɛ amɛ lɛ.

english_verse: So I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, promise them poison to eat and drink.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ kɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɔ ji enɛ, “Naa, mibalɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ kɛ taatso, ni mahã amɛ nu ni ebɔɔ yɔɔ mli amɛnu.

english_verse: I'll scatter them in foreign countries that they and their ancestors have never even heard of. Finally, I will send enemy soldiers to kill every last one of them. The Women Who Are Paid To Weep
translation_verse: Mibagbɛ amɛ mashwã maji anɔ, hei ni amɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tete leee; mahã henyɛlɔi afã klante kɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maplenee amɛ kwraa.” Yerusalɛm maŋbii bolɔ amɛtsɛ yelikɛbuamɔ

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said, “Make arrangements now for the women who are paid to weep at funerals, especially the women who can cry the loudest.”
translation_verse: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛjwɛŋa sane lɛ he, ni nyɛtsɛa yarayei kɛbaa; nyɛtsua koni ayaŋɔa yei ni ahe esa kɛ yara nɔ lala kɛba.”

english_verse: The people answered, “Let them come quickly and cry for us, until our own eyes are flooded with tears.
translation_verse: Maŋbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa amɛhe afea oya ni amɛla yarafeemɔ lala yɛ wɔ wɔhewɔ, koni wɔhiŋmɛii afɔse yaafonu ashwie shi, ni wɔhiŋmɛinaatsɔi atsere kɛ yaafonu.”

english_verse: Now those of us on Zion cry, ‘We are ruined! We can't stand the shame. Our homes have been destroyed, and we must leave our land.’
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔnu yaafo blɔmɔ kɛjɛ Zion akɛ, “Kwɛ bɔ ni akpãtã wɔhiɛ ahã. Ashwie wɔhiɛ shi naakpa, akɛ ahã wɔshi wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni akumɔ wɔshĩai lɛ fɛɛ.”

english_verse: “We ask you women to pay attention to what the Lord says. We will teach you a funeral song that you can teach your daughters and friends:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Awomɛi nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi, ni nyɛhãa ewiemɔ lɛ abotea nyɛtoiiaŋ. Nyɛtsɔ̃a nyɛbiyei lɛ yarawoo, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ atsɔ̃ɔ enaanyo yaafo lala.

english_verse: ‘We were in our fortress, but death sneaked in through our windows. It even struck down children at play and our strongest young men.’
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ gbele ekwɔ kɛtsɔ̃ samfɛji amli kɛbatua wɔ, ni ebote wɔmaŋtsɛ wei amli ebaplenee gbekɛbii yɛ gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ, ni ekpãtã oblahii hu ahiɛ yɛ blohui amli.”

english_verse: “The Lord has told us the ground will be covered with dead bodies, like ungathered stalks of grain or manure in a field.” What the Lord Likes Best
translation_verse: Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mikɛɛ nɛ, “Gbɔmɛi agbohii baajwere shi yɛ ŋa nɔ tamɔ tumo ni ashwã awo ŋmɔ mli, loo tamɔ ŋmaa nyaŋkui jwereɔ shi yɛ ŋmaakpalɔi asɛɛ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni aaabua naa.

english_verse: The Lord says: Don't brag about your wisdom or strength or wealth.
translation_verse: Nilelɔ akashwã kɛmiifɔ̃ enilee nɔ. Hewalɔ hu akashwã kɛmiifɔ̃ ehewalɛ nɔ, ni niiatsɛ akashwã kɛmiifɔ̃ eninamɔ nɔ;

english_verse: If you feel you must brag, then have enough sense to brag about worshiping me, the Lord. What I like best is showing kindness, justice, and mercy to everyone on earth.
translation_verse: shi mɔ ni shwãa lɛ, eshwã efɔ̃, enɛ moŋ nɔ; akɛ ele mi, ni enuɔ mi shishi, akɛ mi ji Yehowa ni misuɔmɔ sɛɛ efooo, ni miyeɔ jalɛ sane yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Enɛɛmɛi ahe moŋ minyaa. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.”

english_verse: Someday I will punish the nations of Egypt, Edom, Ammon, and Moab, and the tribes of the desert. The men of these nations are circumcised, but they don't worship me. And it's the same with you people of Judah. Your bodies are circumcised, but your hearts are unchanged.
translation_verse: Mibagbala Ijipt kɛ Yuda kɛ Edombii kɛ Amonbii kɛ Moabbii kɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ bii ni shɛɔ amɛyitsei ahe lɛ hu atoi, ejaakɛ maji nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ foolɔi ni, ni Israelbii lɛ hu tsuiŋ foolɔi ji amɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Listen to me, you people of Israel. Don't follow the customs of those nations who become frightened when they see something strange happen in the sky.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkakasea maji krokomɛi lɛ ajeŋba, ni nyɛkashea ŋwɛi okadii gbeyei, ejaakɛ majimaji lɛ ji mɛi ni sheɔ nomɛi gbeyei.

english_verse: Their religion is worthless! They chop down a tree, carve the wood into an idol,
translation_verse: Amɛkusumi lɛ lakamɔ ni; amɛyafoɔ tso yɛ koo mli kɛbaa ni ŋaalɔ kɛ lema gbɔɔ,

english_verse: cover it with silver and gold, and then nail it down so it won't fall over.
translation_verse: amɛkɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika shwieɔ he kɛwulaa lɛ, ni akɛ hamle kɛ plɛkoo kalaa lɛ kpɛtɛɔ shi koni ekagbee shi.

english_verse: An idol is no better than a scarecrow. It can't speak, and it has to be carried, because it can't walk. Why worship an idol that can't help or harm you? Jeremiah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Amɛmãgãi nɛɛ tamɔ blantu ni akɛshwieɔ kooloi yɛ waatrɛ ŋmɔ mli, amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛwie; ni holemɔ aholeɔ amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛnyiɛ. Nyɛkashea amɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ efɔŋ ko amɛfee lɛ, amɛnyɛɛɛ ekpakpa hu amɛfee.

english_verse: You are King of the nations. Everyone should worship you. No human anywhere on earth is wiser than you.
translation_verse: Bo majimaji fɛɛ amaŋtsɛ, namɔ po ni sheŋ bo gbeyei? Ejaakɛ bo nɔŋŋ pɛ osa woo. Majimaji lɛ anɔ nilelɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, kɛ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi anɔyelihei lɛ fɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni tamɔ bo.

english_verse: Idols are worthless, and anyone who worships them is a fool!
translation_verse: Buului kɛ kwashiai sɔŋŋ ji amɛ; yakanii amɛkaseɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ tso amãgã dɛŋnii amɛkaseɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Idols are made by humans. A carver shapes the wood. A metalworker hammers out a covering of gold from Uphaz or of silver from Tarshish. Then the idol is dressed in blue and purple clothes.
translation_verse: Akɛ jwiɛtɛi ni atswia jɛɔ Tarshish baa, ni akɛ shika jeɔ Ufaz baa. Tsoŋaalɔ kɛ shikaŋaalɔ ninenaa nitsumɔi ni. Abuɔ amɛ mama bluu kɛ mama afaseo tsuru, ŋaalɔi ni ahe esa aninenaa nitsumɔ sɔŋŋ ni.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the only true and living God. You will rule for all time. When you are angry the earth shakes, and nations are destroyed.
translation_verse: Shi Yehowa ji anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ. Lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ kɛ Naanɔ Maŋtsɛ lɛ. Emlifu hãa shikpɔŋ hosoɔ, ni maji nyɛɛɛ emlila lɛ naa adamɔ.

english_verse: You told me to say that idols did not create the heavens and the earth, and that you, the Lord, will destroy every idol.
translation_verse: “Bɔ ni nyɛkɛɛ amɛ nɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ni jeee amɛ amɛbɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ baakpãtã yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ atatuiaŋ fɛɛ.’ ” Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ lala

english_verse: With your wisdom and power you created the earth and spread out the heavens.
translation_verse: Yehowa ji mɔ ni bɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ ehewalɛ naa, ni ebɔ je lɛ yɛ enilee naa, ni elɛɛ ŋwɛi mli eha nɔ yɛ eŋaa naa.

english_verse: The waters in the heavens roar at your command. You make clouds appear— you send the winds from your storehouse and make lightning flash in the rain.
translation_verse: Kɛji ewo egbeiaŋ lɛ, nu shimɔɔ yɛ ŋwɛiniiaŋ; ni ehãa afua teɔ shi kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei lɛ kɛbaa. Lɛ ehãa srawa gbalaa yɛ nunɛmɔ mli, ahum fãa kɛjɛɔ hei ni ekɛ lɛ eto.

english_verse: People who make idols are so stupid! They will be disappointed, because their false gods are not alive.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ kwashia ni leee nii ni; shikaŋaalɔ fɛɛ shikaŋaalɔ hiɛ shwieɔ shi yɛ emãgã hewɔ, ejaakɛ emãgãi ni eshwie lɛ apasa ni; ni wala mumɔ bɛ amɛmli.

english_verse: Idols are merely a joke, and when the time is right, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Yakayaka nibii ni; mɔ akɛlakaa, be ni abaagbala amɛtoi lɛ, amɛhiɛ baakpãtã.

english_verse: But you, Israel's God, created all things, and you chose Israel to be your very own. Your name is the Lord All-Powerful. Judah Will Be Thrown from Its Land
translation_verse: Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ tamɔɔɔ enɛɛmɛi, ejaakɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni bɔ nii fɛɛ; ni eŋɔ Israel ekɛfee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ ni egbɛi ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ. Nomŋɔɔ miiba

english_verse: I said to the people of Judah, “Gather your things; you are surrounded.
translation_verse: Bo mɔ ni oyɔɔ maŋ ni asa eyi mli, buamɔ onibii ni jwere shikpɔŋ anaa,

english_verse: The Lord said these troubles will lead to your capture, and he will throw you from this land like a rock from a sling.”
translation_verse: ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Mibafɔ̃ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ bii tamɔ afɔ̃ɔ aklomia mli tɛ amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ; ni mibahã amɛhe ajara amɛ bɔ ni amɛbaanu he.”

english_verse: The people answered, “We are wounded and doomed to die. Why did we say we could stand the pain?
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yerusalɛm maŋbii lɛ bolɔ akɛ, “Kpoo hã wɔ! Wɔpilamɔ lɛ naa wa!” Shi wɔkɛɛ akɛ, “Hejaramɔ nɛ moŋ; shi esa akɛ wɔdamɔ naa.”

english_verse: But I told them, “Our leaders were stupid failures, because they refused to listen to the Lord. And so we've been scattered like sheep.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mihere nɔ akɛ, “Wɔmaŋ hiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ kwashiai ni; amɛbiii Yehowa dɛŋ gbɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ, no hewɔ ni jeŋ ehiii hãaa amɛ, ni wɔmaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ egbɛ eshwã lɛ.

english_verse: “Sounds of destruction rumble from the north like distant thunder. Soon our towns will be ruins where only jackals live.” Jeremiah Prays
translation_verse: Naa, sane eba, onu he? Kooyigbɛ maŋ ko miihũu kɛmiiba, eeba koni ebafee Yuda maji lɛ amaŋfɔ̃ koni maji lɛ atsɔ̃ ŋaŋgbei ashihilɛhe.”

english_verse: I know, Lord, that we humans are not in control of our own lives.
translation_verse: Ao! Yehowa, mile akɛ gbɔmɔ adesã gbɛ bɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ; ni adesa bɛ ewala nɔ hewalɛ.

english_verse: Correct me, as I deserve, but not in your anger, or I will be dead.
translation_verse: Ao! Yehowa, kã owebii; shi bɔ ni sa kɛkɛ; jeee yɛ omlifu naa, koni okaplenee wɔ.

english_verse: Our enemies refuse to admit that you are God or to worship you. They have wiped out our people and left our nation lying in ruins. So get angry and sweep them away!
translation_verse: Gbalamɔ majimaji lɛ ni leee bo lɛ atoi, ni okɛ mɛi hu ni jaaa bo lɛ aye, ejaakɛ amɛkpãtã Yakob shwiei lɛ ahiɛ, amɛplenee amɛ butuu, ni amɛfee amɛshihilɛhei lɛ amaŋfɔ̃.

english_verse: My commands haven't changed since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, a nation that seemed like a blazing furnace where iron ore is melted. I told your ancestors that if they obeyed my commands, I would be their God, and they would be my people.
translation_verse: Kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ ji kpãŋmɔ ni mi kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ, asaŋ ni miwo amɛ kitã yɛ he be ni mijie amɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni amɛhe dɔ la yɛ, tamɔ dade flɔnɔɔŋ lɛ. Mifã nyɛ akɛ nyɛbo migbee toi, ni nyɛye nibii ni mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, koni nyɛtsɔ̃ mimaŋ, ni mi hu matsɔ̃ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ,

english_verse: Then I did what I had promised and gave them this wonderful land, where you now live. “Yes, Lord,” I replied, “that's true.”
translation_verse: bɔ ni afee ni matsu kitã ni mikã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ he nii, no ji akɛ mahã amɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii koni amɛhi nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni mihere nɔ akɛ, “Yehowa, aba mli nakai.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to everyone on the streets of Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah: Pay attention to the commands in my agreement with you.
translation_verse: Ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yaashiɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yuda maji kɛ Yerusalɛm blohuiaŋ ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛboa nɛkɛ kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ toi, ni nyɛyea nɔ.

english_verse: Ever since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I have been telling your people to obey me. But you and your ancestors
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mikpã miwo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ atoiŋ gbi nɔ ni mijie amɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni mikã he miikpã miiwo amɛtoiŋ lolo kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ akɛ, nyɛboa migbee toi.

english_verse: have always been stubborn. You have refused to listen, and instead you have done whatever your sinful hearts have desired. You have not kept the agreement we made, so I will make you suffer every curse that goes with it.
translation_verse: Shi amɛbuuu, ni amɛbooo toi hu, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ tsuiwalɛ fee nɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ kpãŋmɔ kome too nɛɛ nɔŋŋ ni miwo amɛ kitã yɛ he akɛ amɛye nɔ, shi amɛyeee nɔ lɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ nɔŋŋ gbala amɛtoi.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Jeremiah, the people of Judah and Jerusalem are plotting against me.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ mi ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Yudabii kɛ Yerusalɛmbii lɛ etse mihiɛ atua.

english_verse: They have sinned in the same way their ancestors did, by turning from me and worshiping other gods. The northern kingdom of Israel broke the agreement I made with your ancestors, and now the southern kingdom of Judah has done the same.
translation_verse: Amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛmiifee nibii fɔ̃ji ni amɛblematsɛmɛi ni booo miwiemɔ toi lɛ fee lɛ nɔŋŋ. Amɛtee amɛmiija nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi. Israelbii kɛ Yudabii lɛ fɛɛ ekũ mikpãŋmɔ ni mi kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: Here is what I've decided to do. I will bring suffering on the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and no one will escape. They will beg me to help, but I won't listen to their prayers.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, naa, nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ ji akɛ mibahã sane fɔŋ aye amɛ, ni amɛhe ejeŋ mli. Amɛbaablɔ amɛtsɛ mi nɛ, shi miboŋ amɛ toi.

english_verse: Then they will offer sacrifices to their other gods and ask them for help. After all, the people of Judah have more gods than towns, and more shameful altars for Baal than there are streets in Jerusalem. But those gods won't be able to rescue the people of Judah from disaster.
translation_verse: Ao! Yuda, onyɔŋmɔi lɛ ayi efa tamɔ omaji lɛ ayifalɛ, ni bɔ ni gbɛjegbɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli lɛ fa lɛ, nakai nyɛmamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi nyɛkɛfeɔ hiɛgbejianii, no ji nyɛkɛshãa tsofakɛŋma nyɛhãa Baal.

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't pray for these people or beg me to rescue them. If you do, I won't listen, and I certainly won't listen if they pray!
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, bo, Yeremia, kaakpa mi fai ohã gbɔmɛi nɛɛ; asaŋ kaabolɔ osɔle ohã amɛ, ejaakɛ miboŋ toi be mli ni amɛaatsɛ mi yɛ amɛfimɔ mli lɛ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: You are my chosen people, but you have no right to be here in my temple, doing such evil things. The sacrifices you offer me won't protect you from disaster, so stop celebrating.
translation_verse: Etee nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ gbɛnaa misuɔlɔ yɔɔ yɛ miSɔlemɔ we be mli ni eyafee nifɔɔjianii ni mihiɔ lɛ? Ani naashiwoo kɛ kooloo afɔleshãa baanyɛ atsi hiɛkpãtãmɔ ni baa lɛ naa lo? Ani omii aaashɛ ohe lo?

english_verse: Once you were like an olive tree covered with fruit. But soon I will send a noisy mob to break off your branches and set you on fire.
translation_verse: Nyɛsɛɛ ko lɛ Yehowa wo bo gbɛi, ‘Mutso ni ebu fɛɛfɛo ni woɔ yibii kpakpai.’ Shi agbɛnɛ Yehowa baahã ahum kpeteŋkple ko agba ni ebaasɔo tso nɛɛ naa la, ni ebaashã kɛ ehe niji fɛɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful. You people of Judah were like a tree that I had planted, but you have made me angry by offering sacrifices to Baal, just as the northern kingdom did. And now I'm going to pull you up by the roots. The Plot To Kill Jeremiah *
translation_verse: “Naa, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, mɔ ni batɛo bo yɛ biɛ lɛ ewie efɔŋ eshi bo, ejaakɛ Israelbii kɛ Yudabii efee nɔ fɔŋ, no ji akɛ amɛshã tsofakɛŋma amɛhã Baal amɛkɛwo mimli la.” Akpãŋ Yeremia yinɔ

english_verse: Some people plotted to kill me. And like a lamb being led to the butcher, I knew nothing about their plans.
translation_verse: Yehowa hã mile, ni esaa eka nɔ ehã mi ekoŋŋ akɛ atee miyinɔ apam, ni miyoo yiŋtoo lɛ.

english_verse: But then the Lord told me that they had planned to chop me down like a tree— fruit and all— so that no one would ever remember me again.
translation_verse: Mitamɔ too gwantɛŋ ni he jɔ, ni akpala lɛ kɛtee koni ayagbe lɛ. Shi mileee kwraa akɛ mi mihe ŋaa fɔŋ amɛto be ni akɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔkpatãa tso lɛ kɛ eyibii lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ; nyɛhãa wɔjiea lɛ yɛ hiɛkãalɔi aje lɛ mli koni akakai lɛ kwrakwra dɔŋŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: I prayed, “Lord All-Powerful, you always do what is right, and you know every thought. So I trust you to help me and to take revenge.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni misɔle nɛkɛ, “Ao! Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, bo ni okojoɔ yɛ jalɛ naa, bo ni okaa gbɔmɔ susumɔ kɛ etsui fɛɛ okwɛɔ, hã mana owele ni obaatɔ yɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ anɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ bo odɛ̃ŋ mitu misane lɛ fɛɛ miwo.”

english_verse: Then the Lord said: Jeremiah, some men from Anathoth say they will kill you, if you keep on speaking for me.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Anatotbii lɛ ni tao mi amɛgbe, ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Kaagba yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli dɔŋŋ, no lɛ wɔbaagbe bo” lɛ,

english_verse: But I will punish them. Their young men will die in battle, and their children will starve to death.
translation_verse: nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ amɛhe nɛ, “Naa, mibagbala amɛtoi, amɛblahii lɛ baagboi yɛ ta mli, ni amɛbihii lɛ kɛ amɛbiyei lɛ baagboi kɛ hɔmɔ,

english_verse: And when I am finished, no one from their families will be left alive.
translation_verse: bɔ ni eshwɛŋ mɔ ko ehaŋ amɛ, ejaakɛ afi nɔ ni mibagbala Anatotbii lɛ atoi lɛ, mibahã sane fɔŋ aye amɛ pam.”

english_verse: Whenever I complain to you, Lord, you are always fair. But now I have questions about your justice. Why is life easy for sinners? Why are they successful?
translation_verse: Yehowa, kɛji mi kɛ bo taa naa tete lɛ onɔ jaa; kɛ̃lɛ mikɛ mi sane nɛɛ miifɔ̃ ohiɛ. Mɛni hewɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji agbɛ jaa hãa amɛ, ni kutumpɔfoi shwereɔ lɛ?

english_verse: You plant them like trees; you let them prosper and produce fruit. Yet even when they praise you, they don't mean it.
translation_verse: Otɛoɔ amɛ, ni amɛfãi mɔmɔɔ shi, amɛdaraa, ni amɛwoɔ yibii. Amɛwieɔ ohe ekpakpa kɛ amɛnaabu shi amɛtsui mli lɛ, amɛ kɛ bo teŋ jɛkɛ.

english_verse: But you know, Lord, how faithful I've always been, even in my thoughts. So drag my enemies away and butcher them like sheep!
translation_verse: Shi, Yehowa, mi lɛ ole mi, ni onaa minifeemɔnii; ni okaa bɔ ni mijwɛŋɔ yɛ ohe okwɛɔ. Shatãmɔ amɛ kɛya tamɔ toi ni ayaagbe amɛ, ni ojɔɔ amɛnɔ oto kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni abaagbe amɛ lɛ.

english_verse: How long will the ground be dry and the pasturelands parched? The birds and animals are dead and gone. And all of this happened because the people are so sinful. They even brag, “God can't see the sins we commit.” The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ po shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aaagbi, ni ŋa lɛ nɔ jwɛi aaaŋalã kɛyashi? Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ anifɔ̃ɔjianii ehã enɔ kooloi kɛ loofɔji fɛɛ etã; ejaakɛ amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Enaŋ bɔ ni wɔnaagbee aaatamɔ.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, if you get tired in a race against people, how can you possibly run against horses? If you fall in open fields, what will happen in the forest along the Jordan River?
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Yeremia, kɛji okɛ gbɔmɛi da foi ni amɛhã eje otsine lɛ, te ooofee tɛŋŋ okɛ okpɔŋɔi ashi mple hu? Ni kɛji shikpɔŋ trɛnɛɛ nɔ tete ogbee shi yɛ lɛ, te ooofee tɛŋŋ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ he koo hayii lɛ amli hu?

english_verse: Even your own family has turned against you. They act friendly, but don't trust them. They're out to get you, and so is everyone else. The Lord Is Furious with His People
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ onyɛmimɛi kɛ otsɛ we lɛ, amɛ tete po amɛkwa bo; ni amɛmiitao bo efɔŋ waa diɛŋtsɛ. Kɛji amɛdɔkɔ amɛnaa amɛhã bo tete lɛ, kaahe amɛ oye.” Yehowa ye ewebii lɛ ahe ŋkɔmɔ

english_verse: I loved my people and chose them as my very own. But now I will reject them and hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mikwa mimaŋ Israel, mishi migbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ sɛɛ, miŋmɛɛ mimaŋ ni misumɔɔ kɛ mitsui fɛɛ lɛ he miwo ehenyɛlɔi adɛŋ.

english_verse: My people have turned against me and roar at me like lions. That's why I hate them.
translation_verse: Mimɛi lɛ etsɔ̃ amɛhe amɛwo mi tamɔ koo mli jata, ni amɛbolɔɔ amɛwoɔ mi, no hewɔ lɛ, minyɛɔ amɛ.

english_verse: My people are like a hawk surrounded and attacked by other hawks. Tell the wild animals to come and eat their fill.
translation_verse: Ani mimɛi lɛ etsɔ̃ loofɔlɔ looyelɔ kɛ ehe ŋwãtãŋwãtã ehã mi lo? Ani loofɔji looyelɔi ebɔle lɛ kɛkpe kpula? Yaa koni oyabua ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ anaa ni okɛ amɛ aba koni amɛbaye nii.

english_verse: My beautiful land is ruined like a field or a vineyard trampled by shepherds and stripped bare by their flocks.
translation_verse: Tookwɛlɔi babaoo ekpãtã miwain abɔɔ lɛ hiɛ, amɛnaanaa migbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɔ; amɛhã migbɛfaŋnɔ fɛɛfɛo lɛ etsɔ̃ ŋa kpataa.

english_verse: A destroying army marches along desert roads and attacks everywhere. They are my deadly sword; no one is safe from them.
translation_verse: Niiahiɛkpãtãlɔi eba shiaŋa lɛ nɔ gɔji kpataai lɛ anɔ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã klante miiye nii kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehe kome kɛyagbee enaagbeehe kome; adesa ko adesa ko kwraa bɛ toiŋjɔlɛ.

english_verse: My people, you planted wheat, but because I was furious, I let only weeds grow. You wore yourselves out and gained only shame! The Lord Will Have Pity on Other Nations
translation_verse: Mimɛi lɛ du ŋmaa; shi amɛkpa ŋmei. Amɛgbo deŋme; shi amɛnaaa he sɛɛ ko. Yehowa mlifu lɛ naawalɛ hewɔ lɛ, nii ni amɛbaakpa lɛ baafee amɛ hiɛgbele.” Yehowa wo Israel maji lɛ shi

english_verse: The Lord said: I gave this land to my people Israel, but enemies around it have attacked and robbed it. So I will uproot them from their own countries just as I will uproot Judah from its land.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Miyɛ nɔ ko ni mikɛɔ yɛ Israel hewɔ maji fɔ̃ji ni efite shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã mimaŋ Israel lɛ ahe. Naa, mibashwie nakai gbɔmɛi lɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ nɔ he ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ, ni mibahere Yudabii lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ.

english_verse: But later, I will have pity on these nations and bring them back to their own lands.
translation_verse: Shi be ni mishwie amɛ sɛɛ lɛ, mimusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ mi yɛ amɛhe, ni mibaku sɛɛ mikɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aba lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ kɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: They once taught my people to worship Baal. But if they admit I am the only true God, and if they let my people teach them how to worship me, these nations will also become my people.
translation_verse: Ni kɛji be ni aaashɛ nakai be lɛ amɛkase mimɛi lɛ ajeŋba, ni amɛkɛ migbɛi aaakã kitã akɛ, ‘Mina Yehowa, tamɔ bɔ ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mimaŋbii lɛ Baal gbɛi kɛ kitãkãmɔ lɛ, no lɛ mibaŋɔ amɛ mashi mimɛi lɛ anɔ.’

english_verse: However, if they don't listen to me, I will uproot them from their lands and completely destroy them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji maŋ ko booo toi lɛ, no lɛ mafã nakai maŋ lɛ kɛ eshishi fɛɛ, ni mibakpãtã ehiɛ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Go and buy a pair of linen shorts. Wear them for a while, but don't wash them.”
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yaa koni oyahe hɛŋmɔɔ bo koni okɛŋmɔ ohɛ; okɛ mama nɛɛ akatsɔ nu mli.”

english_verse: So I bought a pair of shorts and put them on.
translation_verse: Yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ naa lɛ, mitee miyahe hɛŋmɔɔ bo lɛ, ni mikɛŋmɔ mihɛ.

english_verse: “Take off the shorts. Go to Parah and hide the shorts in a crack between some large rocks.”
translation_verse: “Yaa Eufrate Faa lɛ naa koni okɛ hɛŋmɔɔ bo lɛ ni oyahe ni ŋmɔ ohɛ lɛ ayatee tɛsaa fɔlɔ ko mli yɛ jɛi.”

english_verse: I went back and dug the shorts out of their hiding place, but the cloth had rotted, and the shorts were ruined.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni miyiŋ mitee Eufrate Faa lɛ naa, ni miyatsa hɛŋmɔɔ bo lɛ yɛ he ni mikɛyato lɛ; ni naa bo lɛ efite bɔ ni ehiii hãaa nɔ ko nɔ ko feemɔ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: No sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ,

english_verse: Jeremiah, I will use Babylonia to destroy the pride of the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: “Bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ nɛ. Nɛkɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ji bɔ ni mibafo Yuda hewoo lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm hu hewoo babaoo lɛ sɛɛ mahã.

english_verse: The people of Judah are evil and stubborn. So instead of listening to me, they do whatever they want and even worship other gods. When I am finished with these people, they will be good for nothing, just like this pair of shorts.
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ efee amɛhe gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji ni booo miwiemɔi toi. Amɛkɛ kuɛŋtimɔ feɔ nɔ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsumɔɔ, ni amɛyanyiɛ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi asɛɛ, ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛ, ni amɛja amɛ moŋ. No hewɔ lɛ, amɛbaatsɔ̃ tamɔ hɛŋmɔɔ bo nɛɛ ni ehiii hãaa nɔ ko nɔ ko feemɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: These shorts were tight around your waist, and that's how tightly I held onto the kingdoms of Israel and Judah. I wanted them to be my people. I wanted to make them famous, so that other nations would praise and honor me, but they refused to obey me. Wine Jars The Lord said:
translation_verse: Bɔ ni hɛŋmɔɔ bo kpɛtɛɔ mɔ he lɛ, nakai mihã Israel kɛ Yuda fɛɛ kpɛtɛ mihe koni amɛtsɔ̃ mimaŋ, koni amɛhã mana gbɛi kɛ yijiemɔ, koni amɛhã mihiɛ aba nyam; shi amɛbooo miwiemɔ toi. Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ.” Wain Kpulu he abɛ lɛ

english_verse: Jeremiah, tell the people of Judah, “The Lord God of Israel orders you to fill your wine jars with wine.” They will answer, “Of course we fill our wine jars with wine! Why are you telling us something we already know?”
translation_verse: “Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ: Awo kpulu fɛɛ kpulu obɔ̃ kɛ wain. Amɛbaakɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Aso wɔ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ wɔleee akɛ kpulu fɛɛ kpulu baayi obɔ̃ kɛ wain lo?’

english_verse: Then say to them: I am the Lord, and what I'm going to do will make everyone in Judah and Jerusalem appear to be full of wine. And the worst ones will be the kings of David's family and the priests and the prophets.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ obaakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ ji akɛ, ‘Naa, mibahã shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ atɔrɔ dãa kpɔtɔɔ, kɛjɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ni ji David shwiei ni bayeɔ esɛɛ anɔ kɛyashi osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm maŋbii fɛɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Then I will smash them against each other like jars. I will have no pity on the young or the old, and they will all be destroyed. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Will Be Taken Away
translation_verse: Ni mibamɔmɔ tsɛmɛi kɛ bii fɛɛ mikɛtswiatswia amɛhe; ni mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ minaŋ mɔbɔ, ni mikɔ̃ŋ mifiliŋ, ni mimusuŋ etsɔ̃ŋ mi akɛ mikpãtã amɛhiɛ.’ ” Yeremia bɔ hewoo he kɔkɔ

english_verse: People of Judah, don't be too proud to listen to what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Nyɛfea toi ni nyɛbo toi! Nyɛkawoa nyɛhe ejaakɛ Yehowa ewie.

english_verse: You hope for light, but God is sending darkness. Evening shadows already deepen in the hills. So return to God and confess your sins to him before you trip and fall.
translation_verse: Nyɛwoa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ nyam, be ni ehãko duŋ awo nyɛ, be ni nyɛbɔ̃iko tɛrɛmɔ yɛ gɔji ni anɔ ewo duŋ lɛ anɔ; ni be mli ni okwɛɔ la gbɛ lɛ, ehãa duŋ moŋ woɔ, ni duŋ lɛ woɔ kabitii.

english_verse: If you are too proud to listen, I will weep alone. Tears will stream from my eyes when the Lord's people are taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji nyɛbooo toi lɛ, mibafo yɛ teemɔ mli yɛ nyɛhewoo lɛ hewɔ; mibafo bloblo kɛ dɔlɛ, ejaakɛ aŋɔ Yehowa webii lɛ nom.

english_verse: The Lord told me to tell you that your king and his mother must surrender their thrones and remove their crowns.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ maŋnyɛ lɛ hu akɛ, ‘Nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi, ejaakɛ akpa nyɛ lumɔyeli. Nyɛtaraa humi sɛ̃i nɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛnunyam akekre lɛ eje nyɛyitso egbee shi.

english_verse: The cities in the Southern Desert are surrounded; no one can get in or out. Everyone in Judah will be taken away.
translation_verse: Asa Yuda wuoyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ ayi, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ amɛ ahere. Aŋɔ Yuda fɛɛ nom; aŋɔ amɛ fɛɛ tswɛm nom kɛtee.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you were so proud of ruling the people of Judah. But where are they now? Look north, and you will see your enemies approaching.
translation_verse: “Yerusalɛm, wo ohiɛ nɔ koni okwɛ henyɛlɔi ni jɛ kooyigbɛ baa nɛɛ. Nɛgbɛ mɛi ni akɛhã bo akɛ okwɛ amɛnɔ lɛ yɔɔ, mɛi ni ji onunyam lɛ?

english_verse: You once trusted them to help, but now I'll let them rule you. What do you say about that? You will be in pain like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Mɛni oookɛɛ kɛji mɛi ni bo diɛŋtsɛ otsɔse amɛ koni amɛfee onanemɛi lɛ, awo amɛ moŋ onukpa yɛ onɔ? Ani ewaŋ ohe tamɔ yoo ni miikɔmɔ piŋɔ lɛ?

english_verse: Do you know why your clothes were torn off and you were abused? It was because of your terrible sins.
translation_verse: Ni kɛji obi ohe akɛ, ‘Mɛɛba ni nɛkɛ sane eba minɔ?’ lɛ, na ole akɛ onishaianii ni naa wa lɛ hewɔ ni akpa ohe mama, ni ashwie ohiɛ shi nɛɛ.

english_verse: Can you ever change and do what's right? Can people change the color of their skin, or can a leopard remove its spots? If so, then maybe you can change and learn to do right.
translation_verse: Ani mɔdiŋ aaanyɛ ehewolo su etsake, aloo mlaŋtswi aaanyɛ ehe truntrãi lɛ etsake? Kɛji amɛaanyɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛ mɛi ni efɔŋfeemɔ eka nyɛnɔ nɛɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛaanyɛ ekpakpa nyɛfee.

english_verse: I will scatter you, just as the desert wind blows husks from grain tossed in the air.
translation_verse: Mibagbɛ nyɛ mashwã tamɔ tutuu ni kɔɔyɔɔ etswa kɛjɛ shiaŋa nɔ.

english_verse: I won't change my mind. I, the Lord, have spoken. You rejected me and worshiped false gods. *
translation_verse: Enɛ ji nɔ ni mito akɛ mibafee bo, ejaakɛ ohiɛ kpa minɔ, ni okɛ ohiɛ fɔ̃ amale nyɔŋmɔi moŋ anɔ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.

english_verse: You were married to me, but you were unfaithful. You even became a prostitute by worshiping disgusting gods on hilltops and in fields.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mi diɛŋtsɛ mibawo ohiɛ mama nɔ koni ohiɛ ashwie shi.

english_verse: So I'll rip off your clothes and leave you naked and ashamed for everyone to see. You are doomed! Will you ever be worthy to worship me again?
translation_verse: Mina nii ni mihiɔ ni ofeɔ lɛ, kɛ misɛɛ ni ojeɔ ni oyajaa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi lɛ, kɛ onyɛnyɛŋtswi ni obɔɔ lɛ, kɛ ajwamãŋ ni obɔɔ nyaŋemɔnyaŋemɔ yɛ ŋa nɔ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ. Kpoo hã bo, bo Yerusalɛm! Mɛɛbe abaakã he atsuu ohe kɛyashi?”

english_verse: When there had been no rain for a long time, the Lord told me to say to the people:
translation_verse: Wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie yɛ nu hɔmɔ he nɛ,

english_verse: Judah and Jerusalem weep as the land dries up.
translation_verse: “Yuda miiye ŋkɔmɔ, egboi anaabulɔi lɛ etɔ biti; amɛjwere shikpɔŋ amɛmiiye ŋkɔmɔ, ni Yerusalɛm miibolɔ waa.

english_verse: Rulers send their servants to the storage pits for water. But there's none to be found; they return in despair with their jars still empty.
translation_verse: Emaŋ abladei lɛ tsuɔ amɛtsuji lɛ faŋŋ; amɛyashɛɔ nubui lɛ anaa, shi amɛnaaa nu; ni amɛkuɔ amɛsɛɛ kɛbaa; kɛ amɛgbɛi foji; amɛhiɛ gboiɔ, amɛluɔ ni amɛhaa amɛyiteiaŋ.

english_verse: There has been no rain, and farmers feel sick as they watch cracks appear in the dry ground.
translation_verse: Akɛni nu enɛɛɛ, ni shikpɔŋ egbi keketee hewɔ lɛ, okwaafoi ahiɛ egboi; no hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛnine etsi amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: A deer gives birth in a field, then abandons her newborn fawn and leaves in search of grass.
translation_verse: Ofrote yoo tete shiɔ ebi ŋmɔŋ, ejaakɛ jwɛi bɛ he ko he ko ni ayeɔ.

english_verse: Wild donkeys go blind from starvation. So they stand on barren hilltops and sniff the air, hoping to smell green grass. The Lord's People Pray
translation_verse: Ŋaŋ tejii damɔɔ gɔji kpataai anɔ, ni amɛhakuɔ kɔɔyɔɔ tamɔ ŋaŋgbei; amɛhiŋmɛii eshiu, ejaakɛ baa kome folo bɛ he ko he ko.

english_verse: We rejected you and did evil, so we deserve to be punished. But if you rescue us, Lord, everyone will see how great you are.
translation_verse: ‘Wɔnishaianii lɛ miibu wɔ fɔ moŋ; shi Yehowa, ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, feemɔ he eko ohã wɔ; tsɛbelɛ wɔsɛɛsɛɛyaa lɛ fa tsɔ̃, ni wɔfee esha wɔshi bo.

english_verse: You're our only hope; you alone can save us now. You help us one day, but you're gone the next.
translation_verse: Ao! Israel hiɛnɔkãmɔ, bo ni ohereɔ eyiwala yɛ fimɔ be mli, mɛɛba ofee tamɔ gbɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, loo tamɔ gbɛnyiɛlɔ ni gbaa eyatoɔ gbɛkɛ toohe nɛɛ?

english_verse: Did this disaster take you by surprise? Are you a warrior with your hands tied? You have chosen us, and your temple is here. Don't abandon us! The Lord's Answer
translation_verse: Mɛɛba ofee tamɔ nuu ni elu tamɔ kãkãlɔ ni nyɛɛɛ mɔ yiwala ehere nɛɛ? Ao! Yehowa oyɛ wɔteŋ tuuŋtu ni ogbɛi akɛwo wɔ; kaashi wɔ.’ ”

english_verse: My people, you love to wander away; you don't even try to stay close to me. So now I will reject you and punish you for your sins. I, the Lord, have spoken. Lying Prophets
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe nɛ, “Nɛkɛ amɛsumɔ akɛ amɛkpa shi, ni etɔɔɔ amɛ kɛ shikpaa lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, mi Yehowa, mihereŋ amɛ atuu dɔŋŋ. Agbɛnɛ mibakai amɛnishaianii lɛ moŋ, ni mibagbala amɛtoi yɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “Jeremiah, don't ask me to help these people.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kaakpa ejurɔyeli he fai ohã maŋ nɛɛ.

english_verse: They may even go without eating and offer sacrifices to please me and to give thanks. But when they cry out for my help, I won't listen, and I won't accept their sacrifices. Instead, I'll send war, starvation, and disease to wipe them out.”
translation_verse: Tsɛbelɛ amɛbaahi ŋmaa nɛ, shi miboŋ amɛfaikpamɔ blɔmɔ lɛ toi; ni amɛbaashã shãa afɔlei kɛ niyenii afɔle hu nɛ, shi mimɔŋ mli; ni mikɛ ta kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ hela baaplenee amɛ.”

english_verse: I replied, “The other prophets keep telling everyone that you won't send starvation or war, and that you're going to give us peace.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao! Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, naa, gbalɔi lɛ kɛɔ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛnaŋ ta ko, ni nyɛnaŋ hɔmɔ ko; shi moŋ mahã nyɛ toiŋjɔlɛ ni sɛɛ efooo yɛ biɛ nɛɛ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord answered: They claim to speak for me, but they're lying! I didn't even speak to them, much less choose them to be my prophets. Their messages come from worthless dreams, useless fortunetelling, and their own imaginations.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbalɔi lɛ miigba amale gbalɛi yɛ migbɛi mli. Jeee mi mitsu amɛ lɛ, jeee mi mifã amɛ lɛ, jeee mi, mikɛ amɛ ewie hu. Amɛmiigba amale ninai kɛ yaka klamɔi kɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiŋ lakamɔi amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: Those lying prophets say there will be peace and plenty of food. But I say that those same prophets will die from war and hunger.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ yɛ gbalɔi nɛɛ ni gbaa yɛ mi migbɛi mli, tsɛbelɛ mitsuko amɛ, ni kɛ̃lɛ amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Ta kɛ hɔmɔ ko baŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,’ lɛ ahe nɛ: Ta kɛ hɔmɔ nɔŋŋ nɔ abaatsɔ̃ akpãtã gbalɔi nɛɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: And everyone who listens to them will be killed, just as they deserve. Their dead bodies will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem, because their families will also be dead, and no one will be left to bury them.
translation_verse: Ni ta kɛ hɔmɔ nɔŋŋ nɔ abaatsɔ̃ akpãtã mɛi ni amɛgbaa amɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ hu ahiɛ. Ni abaashɛrɛ amɛ kɛ amɛŋamɛi kɛ amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei agbohii ashwie Yerusalɛm gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ, ni anaŋ mɛi ni baafu amɛ tete. Mibawo amɛ amɛnifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ he nyɔmɔ.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, go and tell the people how you feel about all this. So I told them: “Tears will flood my eyes both day and night, because my nation suffers from a deadly wound.
translation_verse: Yehowa fã mi akɛ mikɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Ahã mihiŋmɛiiaŋ akpala nu shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ ni esɛɛ akafo; ejaakɛ mimaŋbii lɛ epila, aye amɛ awui ablaŋ.

english_verse: In the fields I see the bodies of those killed in battle. And in the towns I see crowds dying of hunger. But the prophets and priests go about their business, without understanding what has happened.” Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: Kɛji miyiŋ mitee ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, naa, gbohii ni enyɔnyɔɔi yɛ ta mli, kɛji miku misɛɛ kɛba maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, naa, gbɔmɛi ni hɔmɔ egbe amɛ. Ni gbalɔi lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ miitsu amɛnitsumɔi lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɛ; shi amɛleee nɔ ni amɛfeɔ lɛ.” Maŋbii lɛ kpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai

english_verse: Have you rejected Judah, Lord? Do you hate Jerusalem? Why did you strike down Judah with a fatal wound? We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Yehowa, aso oshɛ Yuda ofɔ̃ kwrakwra? Ani onyaŋe Zionbii lo? Mɛɛba mɔ otswia wɔ nii ni opila wɔ bɔ ni ehiii tsamɔ nɛɛ? Wɔkwɛ hejɔlɛ gbɛ, shi nɔ kpakpa ko baaa; wɔhiɛ kã tsamɔ nɔ; shi gbeyei nii moŋ ba.

english_verse: We and our ancestors are guilty of rebelling against you.
translation_verse: Ao! Yehowa, wɔmiikpɛ̃lɛ wɔnifɔ̃ɔjianii kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ hu anifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ wɔfee esha wɔshi bo.

english_verse: If you save us, it will show how great you are. Don't let our enemies disgrace your temple, your beautiful throne. Don't forget that you promised to rescue us.
translation_verse: Ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, kaakwa wɔ; kaahã Yerusalɛm hiɛ miishwie shi; he ni ogbojee maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ yɔɔ lɛ. Kaimɔ kpãŋmɔ ni okɛ wɔ kpãŋ lɛ; ni okaku mli.

english_verse: Idols can't send rain, and showers don't fall by themselves. Only you control the rain, so we put our trust in you, the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Ani majimaji lɛ alagbãalagbã wɔji lɛ ateŋ eko nyɛɔ ehãa nu nɛɔ? Loo ŋwɛi tete nyɛɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehãa nu nɛɔ? Ao! Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, bo pɛ gbɛ wɔkwɛɔ, ejaakɛ bo pɛ otsuɔ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ kwa.

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Even if Moses and Samuel were here, praying with you, I wouldn't change my mind. So send the people of Judah away.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kɛji Mose kɛ Samuel tete po damɔ mihiɛ lɛ, minaŋ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe tsui. Shwiemɔ amɛ kɛje mihiɛ ni amɛya!

english_verse: And when they ask where they are going, tell them that I, the Lord, have said: Some of you are going to die of horrible diseases. Others are going to die in war or from starvation. The rest will be led away to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Ni kɛji amɛbi bo akɛ, ‘Nɛgbɛ wɔya?’ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, Nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ ji enɛ, ‘Nyɛteŋ mɛi ni ajɔɔ amɛnɔ ahã gbele hela lɛ, gbele hela nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ baagbe amɛ. Nyɛteŋ mɛi ni ajɔɔ amɛnɔ ahã klante lɛ, klante nɔŋŋ baagbe amɛ. Ni mɛi ni ajɔɔ amɛnɔ ahã hɔmɔ lɛ, hɔmɔ naa nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ amɛbaagboi yɛ. Nyɛteŋ mɛi ni ajɔɔ amɛnɔ ahã nomŋɔɔ lɛ, nomŋɔɔ mli nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ amɛaate.

english_verse: I will punish you in four different ways: You will be killed in war and your bodies dragged off by dogs, your flesh will be eaten by birds, and your bones will be chewed on by wild animals.
translation_verse: Mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ, mibahã nibii srɔtoi ejwɛ komɛi aba amɛnɔ. Ta baaba abakpãtã amɛhiɛ, ni gbei baashãtã amɛ, ni ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi baaye amɛloo.

english_verse: This punishment will happen because of the horrible things your King Manasseh did. And you will be disgusting to all nations on earth.
translation_verse: Mahã jeŋ majimaji fɛɛ ahe ajɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ nɔ ni Hezekia bi Manase, ni ji Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ, fee yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ hewɔ.’ ”

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, who will feel sorry for you? Will anyone bother to ask if you are well?
translation_verse: Yehowa tee nɔ akɛ, “Ao Yerusalɛm, namɔ baana bo mɔbɔ, ni namɔ baaye bo ŋkɔmɔ? Namɔ baaba ebabi oshi?

english_verse: My people, you abandoned me and walked away. I am tired of showing mercy; that's why I'll destroy you
translation_verse: Okwa mi, ni sɛɛsɛɛ kɛkɛ oyaa; no hewɔ ni miwo minine nɔ yɛ onɔ ni mikpãtã ohiɛ lɛ; ohe musuŋtsɔlɛ etɔ mi.

english_verse: by scattering you like straw blown by the wind. I will punish you with sorrow and death, because you refuse to change your ways.
translation_verse: Misha nyɛmli yɛ agbonaa tamɔ ashaa ŋmãa mli koni kɔɔyɔɔ abaloo nyɛ yɛ majimaji fɛɛ amli kɛya tamɔ tutuu. Migbe miwebii abii yɛ amɛhe, mikpãtã miwebii lɛ ahiɛ, ejaakɛ amɛtsakeee amɛjeŋba gbonyo lɛ.

english_verse: There will be more widows in Judah than grains of sand on a beach. A surprise attack at noon! And the mothers in Jerusalem mourn for their children.
translation_verse: Mihã amɛyei okulafoi ayi efa fe ŋshɔnaa shia. Mihã sane fɔŋ eye oblahii anyɛmɛi, ejaakɛ mihã hiɛkpãtãlɔ lɛ ekpãtã amɛblahii ahiɛ shwane fintiŋŋ. Mihã ŋmiŋmi kɛ tsuifãa sane eba amɛnɔ trukaa.

english_verse: A mother is in deep despair and struggles for breath. Her daylight has turned to darkness— she has suffered the loss of her seven sons. I will kill anyone who survives. I, the Lord, have spoken. Jeremiah Complains
translation_verse: Yoo ni efɔ kpawo lɛ etɔ biti; nɔ nyɔ enɔ, ni egbo; ehulu enyɔ shi shwane fintiŋŋ; awo lɛ hiɛgbele, ni ashwie ehiɛ shi. Ni amɛteŋ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, majɔɔ amɛnɔ mahã amɛhenyɛlɔi aklante. Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Yeremia ye ŋkɔmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa

english_verse: I wish I had never been born! I'm always in trouble with everyone in Judah. I never lend or borrow money, but everyone curses me just the same.
translation_verse: Minyɛ Awo, kpoo hã mi akɛ ofɔ mi! Naa mi ni shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ mi miibe, ni akɛ mi miitaa naa sɔŋŋ. Mifako mɔ ko nɔ ko lɛ, mɔ ko hu efako nɔ ko yɛ midɛŋ; shi loomɔ sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lomɔɔ mi.

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “I promise to protect you, and when disaster comes, even your enemies will beg you for help.” The Enemy Cannot Be Defeated The Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Ao! Yehowa, kɛji mikpako bo fai mihãko amɛ bɔ ni afee ni ahi ahã amɛ; aloo eji yɛ amɛfimɔ kɛ hejaramɔ bei amli lɛ, mitutɔko bo mihãko amɛ kulɛ, hã amɛloomɔ lɛ aba mli.

english_verse: People of Judah, just as you can't break iron mixed with bronze, you can't defeat the enemies that will attack from the north.
translation_verse: Ani mɔ ko baanyɛ kooyigbɛ dade ni akɛ akɔɔble efutu mli lɛ mli aku lo?

english_verse: I will give them everything you own, because you have sinned everywhere in your country.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Eshai fɛɛ ni amɛfee yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he fɛɛ he hewɔ lɛ, mahã henyɛlɔi abaha amɛjwetri kɛ amɛnii fɛɛ yaka.

english_verse: My anger is a fire that cannot be put out, so I will make you slaves of your enemies in a foreign land. Jeremiah Complains Again
translation_verse: Mahã amɛyasɔ̃mɔ amɛhenyɛlɔi yɛ maŋsɛɛ shikpɔŋ ni amɛleee jɛi nɔ, ejaakɛ mimlifu lɛ tamɔ la ni ashɛre, ni ebaatso kɛya naanɔ.”

english_verse: You can see how I suffer insult after insult, all because of you, Lord. Don't be so patient with my enemies; take revenge on them before they kill me.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao! Yehowa, ole misane lɛ fɛɛ. Kaimɔ mi koni obaye obua mi, ni otɔ mihe owele yɛ mɛi ni waa mi yi lɛ anɔ. Kaaŋmɛ otsui shi ohã amɛ, ni no hã amɛnine shɛ minɔ. Kaimɔ akɛ bo ohewɔ abɔɔ mi ahora nɛɛ.

english_verse: When you spoke to me, I was glad to obey, because I belong to you, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ao! Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, be ni minu owiemɔi lɛ mimɔ mli, ni ehã mina miishɛɛ, ni mimli fili mi, ejaakɛ akɛ ogbɛi ewo mi.

english_verse: I don't go to parties and have a good time. Instead, I keep to myself, because you have filled me with your anger.
translation_verse: Mitaaa mɛi ni amɛmli efili amɛ ateŋ, ni mimli efiliii mi. Mi koome mita shi yɛ ofãmɔ naa, ejaakɛ ohã mimli efu naakpa.

english_verse: I am badly injured and in constant pain. Are you going to disappoint me, like a stream that goes dry in the heat of summer? The Lord Replies
translation_verse: Mɛɛba minɔnaa nɛɛ kã he daa, ni mifala lɛ ehiii tsamɔ, ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ tãlɛ nɛɛ. Ani ofee tamɔ faa ni lakaa mɔ loo faa ni ŋalaa ohã mi?”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Stop talking like a fool! If you turn back to me and speak my message, I will let you be my prophet once again. I hope the people of Judah will accept what you say. But you can ignore their threats, *
translation_verse: Shi Yehowa to he akɛ, “Kɛji okpale lɛ, mibaŋɔ bo ekoŋŋ, ni obaasɔ̃mɔ mi. Kɛji owie wiemɔi ni ahe yɔɔ sɛɛnamɔ, shi jeee nɔ ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ lɛ, no lɛ obaawie minaa ekoŋŋ. Amɛ amɛaakpale kɛba oŋɔɔ, shi jeee bo ni obaakpale kɛya amɛŋɔɔ.

english_verse: because I am making you strong, like a bronze wall. They are evil and violent, but when they attack,
translation_verse: Mahã otsɔ̃ tamɔ gbogbo ni wa, tamɔ akɔɔble ohã gbɔmɛi nɛɛ; amɛkɛ bo baawu nɛ, shi amɛyeŋ onɔ kunim, ejaakɛ mikɛ bo yɛ, ni mibahere oyiwala.

english_verse: I will be there to rescue you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mibahere bo yɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji adɛŋ, ni mibakpɔ̃ bo yɛ yiwalɔi adɛŋ. Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ,

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't get married and have children—Judah is no place to raise a family.
translation_verse: “Kaakpee yoo yɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ, ni okafɔ bihii loo biyei yɛ biɛ nɛɛ,

english_verse: I'll tell you what's going to happen to children and their parents here.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ nɔ ni baaba bihii kɛ biyei ni afɔ yɛ biɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amɛnyɛmɛi lɛ ni fɔfɔɔ amɛ yɛ biɛ lɛ fɛɛ anɔ nɛ.

english_verse: They will die of horrible diseases and of war and starvation. No one will give them a funeral or bury them, and their bodies will be food for the birds and wild animals. And what's left will lie on the ground like manure.
