translation_verse: Gbele helai baagbegbee amɛ; ayeŋ amɛhe ŋkɔmɔ, ni afuŋ amɛgbohii lɛ tete; ni amɛbaajwere shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tamɔ wamɔ. Amɛbaanyɔnyɔi yɛ klante kɛ hɔmɔ naa, ni amɛgbohii lɛ baatsɔ̃ niyenii ahã loofɔji kɛ jwɛiiaŋ kooloi.

english_verse: When someone dies, don't visit the family or show any sorrow. I will no longer love or bless or have any pity on the people of Judah.
translation_verse: “Kaaya shĩa ko ni afeɔ yara yɛ mli mli, ni kaaye ŋkɔmɔ, ni kaaye amɛ ŋkɔmɔ hu, ejaakɛ hejɔlɛ ni mihã amɛ kɛ mimlihilɛ kɛ mimusuŋtsɔlɛ ni miyɔɔ hã amɛ lɛ mifo fɛɛ sɛɛ.

english_verse: Rich and poor alike will die and be left unburied. No one will mourn and show their sorrow by cutting themselves or shaving their heads.
translation_verse: Amɛteŋ mɛi wuji kɛ mɛi bibii lɛ fɛɛ baagboi yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ. Afuŋ amɛ, ni afeŋ amɛyara hu. Mɔ ko mɔ ko bãmɔŋ ehe kɛ kakla aloo eshɛŋ eyiteŋ kɛyeŋ amɛgbohii lɛ ahe ŋkɔmɔ.

english_verse: No one will bring food and wine to help comfort those who are mourning the death of their father or mother.
translation_verse: Mɔ ko mɔ ko eyaŋ ekɛ ŋkɔmɔyelɔ ko ayaye nii koni ekɛshɛje emii yɛ mɔ ko ni egbo hewɔ. Nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko haŋ mɔ ko ni etsɛ loo enyɛ egbo nɔ ko ni enu ekɛsheje mɔ lɛ mii.

english_verse: Don't even set foot in a house where there is eating and drinking and celebrating.
translation_verse: “Kaaya shĩa ko ni aŋmɛ okplɔ̃ yɛ mli mli ni okɛ mɛi yata shi oye nii ni ayeɔ lɛ eko, ni onu nɔ ni anuɔ lɛ hu eko.

english_verse: Warn the people of Judah that I, the Lord All-Powerful, will put an end to all their parties and wedding celebrations.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nɔ ni mi, Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, ‘Naa, mibahã nyamɔ kɛ miishɛɛ gbee kɛ ayɛmforowu kɛ ayɛmforo gbee fɛɛ sɛɛ afo yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ yɛ nyɛhiɛ, kɛ nyɛyinɔ nɛɛ.’

english_verse: They will ask, “Why has the Lord our God threatened us with so many disasters? Have we done something wrong or sinned against him?”
translation_verse: “Kɛji okɛ maŋbii lɛ wie wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ ni amɛbi bo akɛ, ‘Mɛni hewɔ ni Yehowa to eyiŋ ni egbala wɔtoi waa nɛkɛ? Mɛni tɔ̃mɔ wɔtɔ̃? Mɛɛ esha po ji nɔ ni wɔfee wɔshi Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ?’ lɛ,

english_verse: Then tell them I have said: People of Judah, your ancestors turned away from me; they rejected my laws and teachings and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: no lɛ okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kwa mi, ni amɛtee amɛyanyiɛ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi asɛɛ, ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛ, ni amɛja amɛ; amɛkwa mi ni amɛyeee mimla lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: And you have done even worse! You are stubborn, and instead of obeying me, you do whatever evil comes to your mind.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛfee efɔŋ fe nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tete, ejaakɛ naa nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyiɛɔ nɔ ni etsui fɔŋ lɛ kɛɔ lɛ lɛ sɛɛ, ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ eboɔ mi toi.

english_verse: So I will throw you into a land that you and your ancestors know nothing about, a place where you will have to worship other gods both day and night. And I won't feel the least bit sorry for you.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mashɛrɛ nyɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ mashwie shikpɔŋ ko nɔ, he ni nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tete leee koni nyɛyasɔ̃mɔ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ yɛ jɛi, ejaakɛ minaŋ nyɛ mɔbɔ.’ ” Abaajɛ Nomŋɔɔ mli aba

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living Lord who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, be miiba ni akɛ Yehowa gbɛi kãŋ kitã lɛ, akɛŋ hu dɔŋŋ akɛ, ‘Mina Yehowa, mɔ ni jie Israelbii kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ,’

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living Lord who rescued you from that country in the north and from the other countries where I had forced you to go. Someday I will bring you back to this land that I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: shi moŋ abaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mina Yehowa, mɔ ni jie Israelbii kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ shikpɔji fɛɛ ni eshwie amɛ kɛtee nɔ lɛ anɔ kɛba ekoŋŋ lɛ.’ Ejaakɛ mibakpala amɛ kɛba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ, ni ji shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ.” Toigbalamɔ ni baa lɛ

english_verse: But for now, I am sending enemies who will catch you like fish and hunt you down like wild animals in the hills and the caves.
translation_verse: “Naa, miitsu koni ayaŋɔ wolɛimɛi pii abahã mi koni amɛbahɛ amɛ. No sɛɛ lɛ, mibatsu koni ayaŋɔ gbɔbilɔi abahã mi ni amɛbagbɔbi amɛ yɛ gɔji kɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi kɛ tɛkploi afɔji blublu amli.

english_verse: I can see everything you are doing, even if you try to hide your sins from me.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛfeɔ lɛ mihiŋmɛii jwere nɔ, eko eko bɛ ni minaaa.

english_verse: I will punish you double for your sins, because you have polluted my own land. You have filled it with lifeless idols that remind me of dead bodies. The Lord Gives Strength I prayed to the Lord:
translation_verse: Mibawo tɔ̃mɔi ni amɛtɔ̃ kɛ eshai ni amɛfee lɛ ahe nyɔmɔ toi enyɔ, ejaakɛ amɛkɛ amɛyakayaka amãgãi foji lɛ ebule mishikpɔŋ lɛ; amɛhã enɔ eyi tɔ kɛ amɛmusubɔɔ nii lɛ.” Yeremia sɔle kɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the one who gives me strength and protects me like a fortress when I am in trouble. People will come to you from distant nations and say, “Our ancestors worshiped false and useless gods,
translation_verse: “Yehowa, bo ji mihewalɛ kɛ mimɔɔ ni wa kɛ mibobaahe yɛ fimɔ be mli. Bo oŋɔɔ maji aaajɛ je lɛ naagbeehei aba, ni amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, Wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ebanaaa gboshinii ko akɛ ja lakamɔ kɛ yaka nibii ni ahe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko.

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “That's why I will teach them about my power, and they will know that I truly am the Lord.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, naa, mibahã amɛna amɛle shi kome nɛɛ kɛwula shi nɔ hewalɛ kɛ nyɛmɔ ni miyɔɔ koni amɛna amɛle akɛ mi ji Yehowa.”

english_verse: People of Judah, your sins cannot be erased. They are written on your hearts like words chiseled in stone or carved on the corners of your altars. *
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Yuda he esha lɛ akɛ dade niŋmaatso kɛ enaa daiamɔnd piɔpiɔ kpɛ wo amɛtsui tao lɛ nɔ; akpɛ yɛ amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ akoji lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: One generation after another has set up pagan altars and worshiped the goddess Asherah everywhere in your country— on hills and mountains, and under large trees.
translation_verse: Amɛbii lɛ kaiɔ amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ kɛ amɛnyɔŋmɔ Ashera lɛ amãgãi ni yɔɔ tsei ni ebu kusukusuu ashishi kɛ gɔŋkpɔi anɔ,

english_verse: You will lose the land that I gave you, and I will make you slaves in a foreign country, because you have made my anger blaze up like a fire that won't stop burning. Trust the Lord
translation_verse: Obaaŋmɛɛ ogboshinii ni mikɛhã bo lɛ he ofɔ̃ shi, ni mibahã oyasɔ̃mɔ ohenyɛlɔi yɛ maŋsɛɛ shikpɔŋ ni oleee nɔ, ejaakɛ mimlifu lɛ tamɔ la ni ashɛre, ni ebaatso kɛya naanɔ.” Wiemɔi Srɔtoi

english_verse: I, the Lord, have put a curse on those who turn from me and trust in human strength.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Alomɔ mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɔ adesa nɔ, mɔ ni shiɔ Yehowa sɛɛ, ni ekɛ ehe kpasaa adesa hewalɛ.

english_verse: They will dry up like a bush in salty desert soil, where nothing can grow.
translation_verse: Etamɔ tso fɔ ni ma shiaŋa nɔ; yɛ shikpɔŋ ni egbi nɔ, shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋooŋoo ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ jɛi; ebɛ ekpakpa ko ni ebaafee.

english_verse: But I will bless those who trust me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ, mɔ ni Yehowa ji ehiɛnɔkãmɔ.

english_verse: They will be like trees growing beside a stream— trees with roots that reach down to the water, and with leaves that are always green. They bear fruit every year and are never worried by a lack of rain.
translation_verse: Etamɔ tso ni atɛo yɛ faa toi; etsɛ̃rɛɔ eshishi fãi kɛyaninaa nu lɛ. Esheee gbeyei kɛji jeŋdɔlɛ be shɛ, ejaakɛ lɛ lɛ eyaa nɔ ewoɔ yibii, etsui yeee kɛji nu enɛɛɛ, ejaakɛ eyibaa hiɔ shi frɔ̃frɔ̃.

english_verse: You people of Judah are so deceitful that you even fool yourselves, and you can't change.
translation_verse: Tsui yɔɔ nɛɛ elakaa mɔ fe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ; efite kwraa. Namɔ aaanu lɛ shishi?

english_verse: But I know your deeds and your thoughts, and I will make sure you get what you deserve.
translation_verse: Mi, Yehowa, mitaoɔ gbɔmɔ yitsoŋ, ni mikaa tsui mikwɛɔ. Mikɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yeɔ yɛ ejeŋba naa; mikɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yeɔ yɛ yibii ni ewoɔ naa.

english_verse: You cheated others, but everything you gained will fly away, like birds hatched from stolen eggs. Then you will discover what fools you are. Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: Mɔ ni taoɔ nii ni jeee gbɛ kpakpa nɔ etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, etamɔ afi ni yabuɔ wɔji ni jeee lɛ eŋmɛ nɔ. Eninamɔ lɛ ŋmɛɔ lɛ yɛ ewala teŋ, ni enaagbee mli lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ kwashia.

english_verse: Our Lord, your temple is a glorious throne that has stood on a mountain from the beginning.
translation_verse: He ni wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ anunyam maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i gojoo lɛ ma kɛjɛ teteete lɛ, jɛi ji wɔjamɔhe lɛ.

english_verse: You are a spring of water giving Israel life and hope. But if the people reject what you have told me, they will be swept away like words written in dust.
translation_verse: Ao! Yehowa, bo Israel hiɛnɔkãmɔ, mɛi fɛɛ ni kwaa bo lɛ ahiɛ baagboi; mɛi ni kpaleɔ yɛ osɛɛ lɛ agbɛi aaalaaje tamɔ nɔ ni aŋma yɛ mlu mli, ejaakɛ amɛshi Yehowa ni ji wala nubu lɛ sɛɛ.” Yeremia bi Yehowa dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ

english_verse: You, Lord, are the one I praise. So heal me and rescue me! Then I will be completely well and perfectly safe.
translation_verse: Ao! Yehowa, tsa mi, ni mihe aaatã; heremɔ miyiwala koni miyi ana wala, ejaakɛ bo oyi mijieɔ.

english_verse: The people of Judah say to me, “Jeremiah, you claimed to tell us what the Lord has said. So why hasn't it come true?”
translation_verse: Naa, maŋbii lɛ biɔ mi akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ Yehowa wiemɔi lɛ yɔɔ? Hã aba mli koo!”

english_verse: Our Lord, you chose me to care for your people, and that's what I have done. You know everything I have said, and I have never once asked you to punish them.
translation_verse: Yehowa, minyɛko onɔ pɛŋ akɛ ohã nɔ fɔŋ aba maŋ nɛɛ nɔ, ni mishweko hu akɛ gbi fɔŋ lɛ aba. Yehowa, bo ole enɛ, ni nii fɛɛ ni je minaa lɛ jwere ohiɛ.

english_verse: I trust you for protection in times of trouble, so don't frighten me.
translation_verse: Kaawo mihe gbeyei, ejaakɛ gbi fɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ bo ji mibobaahe.

english_verse: Keep me from failure and disgrace, but make my enemies fail and be disgraced. Send destruction to make their worst fears come true. Resting on the Sabbath
translation_verse: Hã mɛi ni waa mi yi lɛ ahiɛ agboi; shi mi lɛ kaahã mihiɛ miigbo. Hã amɛtsui afã, shi mi lɛ kaahã mitsui miifã. Hã gbi fɔŋ lɛ abanina amɛ; kpãtãmɔ amɛhiɛ, ni oku sɛɛ okpãtã amɛhiɛ butuu. Hejɔɔmɔgbiyeli

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, stand at each city gate in Jerusalem, including the one the king uses, and speak to him and everyone else. Tell them I have said: I am the Lord, so pay attention.
translation_verse: koni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ toi, nyɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ Yudabii kɛ nyɛ Yerusalɛm maŋbii, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔ agboi nɛɛ amli lɛ.

english_verse: If you value your lives, don't do any work on the Sabbath. Don't carry anything through the city gates or through the door of your house, or anywhere else. Keep the Sabbath day sacred! I gave this command to your ancestors, but they were stubborn and refused to obey or to be corrected. But if you obey,
translation_verse: “Shi mi, Yehowa miikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛji nyɛbo mi toi, ni nyɛkɛ jatsu ko jatsu ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ maŋ nɛɛ agbo ko mli kɛboteee maŋ lɛ mli yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ, shi moŋ nyɛye hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ akɛ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni nyɛtsuuu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko yɛ nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: then Judah and Jerusalem will always be ruled by kings from David's family. The king and his officials will ride through these gates on horses or in chariots, and the people of Judah and Jerusalem will be with them. There will always be people living in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: no lɛ nyɛmaŋtsɛmɛi ni taa David maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ baaya nɔ atsɔ̃ agboi nɛɛ amli ni amɛtara tayaa shwiilii amli kɛ okpɔŋɔi anɔ, ni amɛshishi lumɛi lɛ hu aaatara okpɔŋɔi anɔ kɛtsɔ̃ maŋ nɛɛ agboi lɛ amli kɛba maŋ lɛ mli; ni Yudabii kɛ Yerusalɛmbii hu aaafee nakai, ni gbɔmɛi baahi Yerusalɛm maŋ nɛɛ mli kɛaate naanɔ.

english_verse: and others will come here from the nearby villages, from the towns of Judah and Benjamin, from the hill country and the foothills to the west, and from the Southern Desert. They will bring sacrifices to please me and to give me thanks, as well as offerings of grain and incense.
translation_verse: Mɛi kɛ shãa afɔle kɛ kooloi afɔlei kɛ niyenii afɔlei kɛ tsofakɛŋmai aaaba kɛaajɛ Yuda maji lɛ anɔ kɛ heihei ni bɔle Yerusalɛm lɛ; mɛi baajɛ Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ kooyigbɛ kɛ anaigbɛ kɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ kɛ wuoyigbɛ ŋa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aba Yehowa we lɛ abada lɛ shi.

english_verse: But if you keep on carrying things through the city gates on the Sabbath and keep treating it as any other day, I will set fire to these gates and burn down the whole city, including the fortresses.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji nyɛbooo mi toi akɛ nyɛye hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ akɛ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni no gbi lɛ nɔ, mɔ ko tere jatsu ko kɛtsɔ̃ Yerusalɛm agboi lɛ eko mli kɛba maŋ lɛ mli yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ mibama maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ anaa la, ni la nɛɛ baashã Yerusalɛm mli mɔji lɛ, ni mɔ ko nyɛŋ agbe.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord told me,
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,

english_verse: “Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop, and when you get there, I will tell you what to say to the people.”
translation_verse: “Tee shi ni oya gbɛshɔ̃lɔ lɛ shĩa lɛ mli, ni jɛi mikɛ bo baawie yɛ.”

english_verse: I went there and saw the potter making clay pots on his pottery wheel.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, miyiŋ mitee gbɛshɔ̃lɔ lɛ shĩa lɛ mli, ni miyanina lɛ ni eta egbɛshɔ̃ɔ tsɔne lɛ sɛɛ eetsu nii.

english_verse: And whenever the clay would not take the shape he wanted, he would change his mind and form it into some other shape.
translation_verse: Mina akɛ kɛji nɔ krɛdɛɛ ni gbɛshɔ̃lɔ lɛ shɔ̃ɔ lɛ fite yɛ edɛŋ lɛ, esaa ekpɔtɔɔ su lɛ mli ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛshɔ̃ɔ nɔ kroko ni saa ehiɛ bɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ,

english_verse: People of Israel, I, the Lord, have power over you, just as a potter has power over clay.
translation_verse: “Ao! Israelbii, aso esaaa akɛ mifeɔ nyɛ tamɔ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ lɛ fee sũ lɛ lo? Israelbii, naa, nyɛtamɔ sũ ni gbɛshɔ̃lɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ yɛ midɛŋ.

english_verse: but its people start disobeying me and doing evil, then I will change my mind and not help them at all.
translation_verse: kɛji nakai maŋ lɛ loo maŋtsɛyeli lɛ fee efɔŋ yɛ mihiɛ, ni ebooo migbee toi lɛ, no lɛ mibafo ekpakpa ni mito akɛ mibafee lɛ lɛ mli.

english_verse: So listen to me, people of Judah and Jerusalem! I have decided to strike you with disaster, and I won't change my mind unless you stop sinning and start living right.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ kɛɛmɔ Yudabii lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm maŋbii lɛ akɛ nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ amɛ nɛ, ‘Naa, misusu nyɛhe efɔŋ, ni mikɔ nyɛyi tɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akpa ejeŋba gbonyo lɛ, ni etsake esu kɛ enifeemɔnii fɔŋ lɛ.’

english_verse: But I know you won't listen. You might as well answer, “We don't care what you say. We have made plans to sin, and we are going to be stubborn and do as we please!”
translation_verse: Shi amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Oowie efolo; nɔ ni wɔfeɔ lɛ, wɔbaafee ŋmɛnɛ wɔbaafee wɔ. Wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baaye lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsui naa sane bɔ ni esumɔɔ.’ ” Maŋbii lɛ kwa Yehowa

english_verse: So I, the Lord, command you to ask the nations, and find out if they have ever heard of such a horrible sin as what you have done.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbia yɛ majimaji lɛ amli akɛ namɔ enu nɛkɛ sane dã? Israel, oblayoo foro lɛ efee nɔ fɔŋ ni yɔɔ gbeyei.

english_verse: The snow on Lebanon's mountains never melts away, and the streams there never run dry.
translation_verse: Ani snoo ekpa nyɔɔ yɛ Lebanon gɔji anɔ pɛŋ? Ani gɔji lɛ anɔ nu egbi dã, ani nu ŋanii ni hoɔ lɛ sɛɛ efo dã?

english_verse: But you, my people, have turned from me to burn incense to worthless idols. You have left the ancient road to follow an unknown path where you stumble over idols.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, mimaŋ lɛ hiɛ ekpa minɔ, ni amɛshãa tsofakɛŋma amɛhãa yaka nyɔŋmɔi. Amɛtɛrɛtɛrɛɛ yɛ blema gbɛ ni amɛnyiɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛje tɛmpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛyanyiɛ nane gbɛi anɔ.

english_verse: Your land will be ruined, and every passerby will look at it with horror and make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: Amɛhã amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ etsɔ̃ nyaŋemɔnɔ, ni abaabo lɛ ‘tsia!’ daa. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsɔ̃ jɛi kɛho lɛ he aaajɔ̃ ehe, ni eeehoso eyitso.

english_verse: When your enemies attack, I will scatter you like dust blown by an eastern wind. Then, on that day of disaster, I will turn my back on you. The Plot against Jeremiah
translation_verse: Mibagbɛ amɛ mashwã yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ, tamɔ mlu ni bokã kɔɔyɔɔ etswa. Mibatsɔ̃ mihiɛ mato afã, ni mikwɛŋ amɛ kwraa yɛ amɛmanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ.” Atee Yeremia yinɔ apam

english_verse: Some of the people said, “Let's get rid of Jeremiah! We will always have priests to teach us God's laws, as well as wise people to give us advice, and prophets to speak the Lord's messages. So, instead of listening to Jeremiah any longer, let's accuse him of a crime.” Jeremiah Prays about His Enemies
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa koni wɔkpãŋa Yeremia yinɔ, akɛni osɔfoi yɔɔ nɛɛ lɛ, wɔyɛ mɛi ni baatsɔ̃ɔ wɔ mla lɛ naa, ni nilelɔi yɛ ni baawo wɔ ŋaa, ni gbalɔi hu baahi shi amɛgba amɛhã wɔ. Nyɛbaa koni wɔkɛ wɔlilɛi afite lɛ, ni nyɛkahãa wɔbo ewiemɔ kome folo toi.”

english_verse: Please, Lord, answer my prayer. Make my enemies stop accusing me of evil.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, misɔle mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao! Yehowa, ofainɛ, bo mi toi; asaŋ obo mɛi ni kɛ mi ena lɛ hu toi.

english_verse: I tried to help them, but they are paying me back by digging a pit to trap me. I even begged you not to punish them.
translation_verse: Aso efɔŋ moŋ akɛtoɔ ekpakpa najiaŋ? Shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛtsa bu amɛhã mi koni migbee mli. Yehowa, kaimɔ bɔ ni midamɔ ohiɛ ni mikpa fai mihã amɛ koni omli ni efu amɛ lɛ sɛɛ afo.

english_verse: But now I am asking you to let their children starve or be killed in war. Let women lose their husbands and sons to disease and violence.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, hã amɛbii lɛ aye hɔmɔ, ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa; hã amɛŋamɛi lɛ atsɔ̃mɔ okulafoi kɛ mɛi ni amɛmusuŋbii egboi yɛ amɛhe. Gbele hela abagbe amɛteŋ hii lɛ, ni amɛblahii lɛ anyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa yɛ ta mli.

english_verse: These people have dug pits and set traps for me, Lord. Make them scream in fear when you send enemy troops to attack their homes.
translation_verse: Be ni ooohã henyɛlɔi aaabashwie amɛnɔ trukaa lɛ, hã ni anu blɔmɔ yɛ amɛshĩaiaŋ, ejaakɛ amɛtsa bu amɛhã mi koni migbee mli, ni amɛtsɔ̃tsɔ̃ɔ mi tsɔnei hu koni madu.

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop and buy a clay jar. Then take along some of the city officials and leading priests
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yaa ni oyahe gbɛshɔ̃lɔ sũ kpulu, ni oŋɔ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ofata ohe,

english_verse: and go to Hinnom Valley, just outside Potsherd Gate. Tell the people that I have said:
translation_verse: ni okɛ amɛ atsɔ̃ Gbɛshɔ̃lɔ Agbo lɛ mli kɛya Hinom bi lɛ Jɔɔ lɛ mli, koni oshiɛ wiemɔi ni makɛɛ bo lɛ yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and you kings of Judah and you people of Jerusalem had better pay attention. I am going to bring so much trouble on this valley that everyone who hears about it will be shocked.
translation_verse: Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ Yerusalɛm maŋbii, nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ toi. Mi Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ akɛ, mibahã sane fɔŋ aye maŋ nɛɛ bɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baanu nɔ ni ba lɛ he baajɔ̃ ehe.

english_verse: The people of Judah stopped worshiping me and made this valley into a place of worship for Baal and other gods that have never helped them or their ancestors or their kings. And they have committed murder here, burning their young, innocent children as sacrifices to Baal. I have never even thought of telling you to do that.
translation_verse: Ni amɛmamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi yɛ Baal jamɔhei lɛ, ni amɛshãa amɛmusuŋbii yɛ nɔ akɛ shãa afɔle amɛhãa Baal. Mifãko amɛ, ni nakai nɔ ko bako mijwɛŋmɔ mli tete dã.

english_verse: So watch out! Someday this place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley!
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, naa, be miiba, ni atsɛŋ he ni wɔyɔɔ nɛɛ Tofet loo Hinom Jɔɔ dɔŋŋ; shi moŋ abaatsɛ biɛ akɛ Gbɔmɔgbee Jɔɔ.

english_verse: You people of Judah and Jerusalem may have big plans, but here in this valley I'll ruin those plans. I'll let your enemies kill you, and I'll tell the birds and wild animals to eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Mahã Yudabii kɛ Yerusalɛm maŋbii ayiŋtoi fɛɛ afee yaka yɛ biɛ. Mahã amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi kɛ mɛi ni taoɔ amɛ efɔŋ amɛfee lɛ ahiɛ. Mahã ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ kooloi aye amɛgbohii lɛ.

english_verse: I will turn Jerusalem into a pile of rubble, and every passerby will be shocked and horrified and will make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: Mahã maŋ nɛɛ atsɔ̃ nyaŋemɔnɔ, ni abaabo lɛ ‘tsia!’ Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsɔ̃ jɛi kɛho lɛ he aaajɔ̃ ehe, ni ebaabo ‘tsia’ yɛ amanehulu ni maŋ lɛ ena lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: And while your enemies are trying to break through your city walls to kill you, the food supply will run out. You will become so hungry that you will eat the flesh of your friends and even of your own children.
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ henyɛlɔi baasa maŋ lɛ yi, ni ebaafĩ maŋbii lɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni fɔlɔi baaye amɛmusuŋ bihii kɛ amɛbiyei, ni mɛi baagbe amɛnanemɛi amɛye.’

english_verse: Jeremiah, as soon as you have said this, smash the jar while the people are watching.
translation_verse: “No sɛɛ lɛ, ojwa kpulu lɛ yɛ hii ni kɛ bo baaya jɛi lɛ ahiɛ,

english_verse: Then tell them that I have also said: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I warn you that I will shatter Judah and Jerusalem just like this jar that is broken beyond repair. You will bury your dead here in Topheth, but so many of you will die that there won't be enough room.
translation_verse: ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ. ‘Nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ majwa maŋ nɛɛ, ni mibakpãtã emli bii ahiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ajwaa gbɛshɔ̃lɔ kpulu ni ehiii tsaramɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ. Tofet nɛɛ baatsɔ̃ he ni mɛi baafu amɛgbohii yɛ, ejaakɛ anaŋ he ko he ko ni abaafu gbohii yɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: I will make Jerusalem as unclean as Topheth, by filling the city with your dead bodies. I will do this because you and your kings have gone up to the roofs of your houses and burned incense to the stars in the sky, as though they were gods. And you have given sacrifices of wine to foreign gods. Jeremiah Speaks in the Temple Courtyard
translation_verse: Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli shĩai kɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi awei fɛɛ he ni ashãshãa tsofakɛŋma yɛ amɛtsui lɛ ayiteiaŋ akɛhã ŋulamii, asaŋ ni akɛ dãa shwie shi ahã nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi yɛ jɛi lɛ, abaabule amɛ fɛɛ tswɛm tamɔ Tofet.’ ”

english_verse: I went to Topheth, where I told the people what the Lord had said. Then I went to the temple courtyard and shouted to the people,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yeremia jɛ Tofet, he ni Yehowa tsu lɛ akɛ eyagba yɛ lɛ eba, ni ebadamɔ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kpo lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ akɛ,

english_verse: “Listen, everyone! Some time ago, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, warned you that he would bring disaster on Jerusalem and all nearby villages. But you were stubborn and refused to listen. Now the Lord is going to bring the disaster he promised.”
translation_verse: “Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Naa, efɔŋ fɛɛ ni mito miyiŋ akɛ mibafee maŋ nɛɛ kɛ ehe majimaji lɛ, mibafee amɛ kɛ̃, ejaakɛ amɛfee amɛhe kuɛŋtilɔi, ni amɛbooo miwiemɔ toi.’ ”

english_verse: Pashhur son of Immer was a priest and the chief of temple security. He heard what I had said,
translation_verse: Be ni Yeremia gba nɛkɛ gbalɛi nɛɛ lɛ, Osɔfo Pashur, Imer bi lɛ, ni lɛ ji Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli tsulɔnukpa fe fɛɛ lɛ, nu nɔ ni Yeremia kɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: and so he hit me. Then he had me arrested and put in chains at the Benjamin Gate in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Pashur hã agwao Gbalɔ Yeremia, ni no sɛɛ lɛ abɔ lɛ apã yɛ Benyamin Agbo lɛ ni yɔɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ yiteŋgbɛ lɛ naa.

english_verse: The next day, when Pashhur let me go free, I told him that the Lord had said: No longer will I call you Pashhur. Instead, I will call you Afraid-of-Everything.
translation_verse: Enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni Pashur fɛne Yeremia yɛ apã lɛ mli sɛɛ lɛ, Yeremia kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yehowa tsɛŋ ogbɛi akɛ Pashur dɔŋŋ; shi moŋ abaatsɛ bo ‘Gbeyeinɔ,’ yɛ he fɛɛ he;

english_verse: You will be afraid, and you will bring fear to your friends as well. You will see enemies kill them in battle. Then I will let the king of Babylonia take everyone in Judah prisoner, killing some and dragging the rest away to Babylonia.
translation_verse: ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, mahã otsɔ̃ gbeyeinɔ ohã bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe kɛ onanemɛi fɛɛ, ni ohiŋmɛi jwere nɔ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni amɛaanyɔnyɔi yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi aklante naa. Majɔɔ Yuda fɛɛ nɔ mawo Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ, ni ebaaŋɔ maŋbii lɛ kɛaatee Babilon ni ebaaya eyagbe amɛ kɛ klante.

english_verse: Pashhur, you are guilty of telling lies and claiming they were messages from me. That's why I will let the Babylonians take you, your family, and your friends as prisoners to Babylonia, where you will all die and be buried. Jeremiah Complains to the Lord
translation_verse: Ni bo Pashur tuuŋtu lɛ, abaaŋɔ bo kɛ oshĩa mli bii fɛɛ nom kɛaatee Babilon. Jɛi oooyagbo yɛ, ni jɛi nɔŋŋ aaafu bo kɛ onanemɛi fɛɛ ni ogba amale gbalɛ otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ yɛ. Yeremia ye ŋkɔmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa

english_verse: You tricked me, Lord, and I was really fooled. You are stronger than I am, and you have defeated me. People never stop sneering and insulting me.
translation_verse: Ao! Yehowa, olaka mi, ni mitsɔ̃ mɔ ni alaka lɛ. Oyɛ hewalɛ fe mi, ni oye minɔ. Mitsɔ̃ mɔ ni aŋmɔɔ lɛ daa jenamɔ; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ po yeɔ mihe fɛo.

english_verse: You have let me announce only injustice and death. Your message has brought me nothing but insults and trouble.
translation_verse: Be fɛɛ be ni miwieɔ lɛ, ja mibolɔ; mibolɔɔ akɛ, “Yiwalɛ sɔŋŋ!” Kɛ “niiahiɛkpãtãmɔ.” Ejaakɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ abɔɔ mi ahora, ni ayeɔ mihe fɛo daa jenamɔ.

english_verse: Sometimes I tell myself not to think about you, Lord, or even mention your name. But your message burns in my heart and bones, and I cannot keep silent.
translation_verse: Kɛji mikɛɛ akɛ, “Mitsiŋ Yehowa tã, ni miwieŋ yɛ egbɛi mli dɔŋŋ lɛ,” minuɔ he yɛ mitsuiŋ akɛ nɔ ko miitso tamɔ la ni atsi naa awo miwui amli. La nɛɛ naatsii etɔ mi, ni minyɛɛɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: I heard the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid. Now's our chance to accuse Jeremiah!” All of my so-called friends are just waiting for me to make a mistake. They say, “Maybe Jeremiah can be tricked. Then we can overpower him and get even at last.”
translation_verse: Minuɔ akɛ aawie ablɛbi akɛ, “He fɛɛ he efee gbeyei. Nyɛfolɔa enaa, nyɛhãa wɔfolɔ enaa!” Minanemɛi tete ni kɛɔ enɛ nɛɛ, ni amɛmiikwɛ akɛ minane aaatɔ̃tɔ̃ lo. Amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Eko lɛ aaalaka lɛ ni wɔnine aaashɛ enɔ, ni wɔɔtɔ wɔhe owele yɛ enɔ.”

english_verse: But you, Lord, are a mighty soldier, standing at my side. Those troublemakers will fall down and fail— terribly embarrassed, forever ashamed.
translation_verse: Shi Yehowa kɛ mi yɛ eji kãkãlɔ ni asheɔ lɛ gbeyei. No hewɔ lɛ, miyiwalɔi lɛ baatɛrɛ; amɛhiɛ baagbo kpɔtɔkpɔtɔɔ, ejaakɛ amɛyeŋ minɔ kunim. Amɛhiɛgbele lɛ, hiɛ kpaŋ nɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: Lord All-Powerful, you test those who do right, and you know every heart and mind. I have told you my complaints, so let me watch you take revenge on my enemies.
translation_verse: Ao, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ ni okaa jalɔ okwɛɔ, ni onaa etsuiŋ kɛ eyitsoŋ saji fɛɛ, hã mana amɛnɔ owele ni obaatɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ mitu misane lɛ miwo odɛ̃ŋ.

english_verse: I sing praises to you, Lord. You rescue the oppressed from the wicked.
translation_verse: Nyɛlaa nyɛhãa Yehowa. Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi. Ehereɔ ohiafo yiwala yɛ yiwalɔi adɛŋ.

english_verse: Put a curse on the day I was born! Don't bless that day.
translation_verse: Alomɔ gbi ni afɔ mi lɛ, gbi nɔ ni minyɛ fɔ mi lɛ akajɔɔ nakai gbi lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: Put a curse on the man who told my father, “Good news! You have a son.”
translation_verse: Alomɔ nuu ni bakɛɛ mitsɛ akɛ, “Afɔ binuu ahã bo,” ni no hã emii shɛ ehe lɛ.

english_verse: May that man be like the towns you destroyed without pity. Let him hear shouts of alarm in the morning and battle cries at noon.
translation_verse: Nakai nuu lɛ atsɔ̃ tamɔ maji ni Yehowa kpãtã amɛhiɛ, ni amɛnii efeee lɛ mɔbɔ lɛ. Hã enu blɔmɔ he leebi kɛ tayaa oshebɔɔ he shwane,

english_verse: He deserves to die for not killing me before I was born. Then my mother's body would have been my grave.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ egbeee mi ewooo minyɛ musuŋ koni minyɛ musuŋ atsɔ̃ migbonyobu koni musu lɛ ahi ehe kɛya naanɔ.

english_verse: Why did I have to be born? Was it just to suffer and die in shame?
translation_verse: Mɛɛba kwraa mijɛ musuŋ mije kpo koni mibagbo deŋme ni maye awerɛhoo ni mijeŋshihilɛ naagbee afee hiɛgbele nɛkɛ?

translation_verse: Wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie nɛ, be ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia tsu Malkia bi Pashur kɛ Maaseia bi Osɔfo Zefania kɛtee Yeremia ŋɔɔ ni amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ,

english_verse: “King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked Judah. Please ask the Lord to work miracles for our people, as he has done in the past, so that Nebuchadnezzar will leave us alone.”
translation_verse: “Ofainɛ, bi Yehowa nii ohã wɔ, ejaakɛ Nebukadnezar, Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ efã ta ebatua wɔ. Eko lɛ aleenɔ Yehowa aaafee enaakpɛɛnii lɛ eko yɛ wɔhewɔ koni no ahã Nebukadnezar kɛ eta lɛ aku esɛɛ kɛya.”

english_verse: Then I told them that the Lord had said: People of Jerusalem, I, the Lord, give you the choice of life or death.
translation_verse: “Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ mikɛɛ Yerusalɛmbii lɛ akɛ, nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Naa, mikɛ wala gbɛ kɛ gbele gbɛ fɛɛ miishwie nyɛhiɛ.

english_verse: The Lord sent me to the palace of the king of Judah to speak to the king, his officials, and everyone else who was there. The Lord told me to say: I am the Lord, so pay attention! You have been allowing people to cheat, rob, and take advantage of widows, orphans, and foreigners who live here. Innocent people have become victims of injustice, and some of them have even been killed. But now I command you to do what is right and see that justice is done. Rescue everyone who has suffered from injustice.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ nyɛkojo yɛ jalɛ naa, ni nyɛye jalɛ sane; ni nyɛhere mɔ ni aaye lɛ amim lɛ yɛ mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ amim lɛ dɛŋ; ni nyɛkafee gbɔ loo awusa loo okulafo efɔŋ; asaŋ nyɛkawa amɛyi; ni nyɛkashwie mɔ ni efeko nɔ fɔŋ ko lá shi yɛ biɛ.

english_verse: If you obey me, the kings from David's family will continue to rule Judah from this palace. They and their officials will ride in and out on their horses or in their chariots.
translation_verse: Anɔkwa, kɛji nyɛye wiemɔ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ David shwiei lɛ baaya nɔ ata David maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ akɛ maŋtsɛmɛi, ni amɛ kɛ amɛtsuji lɛ kɛ amɛmaŋbii lɛ baaya nɔ atara tayaa shwiilii amli kɛ okpɔŋɔi anɔ kɛtsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ we nɛɛ agboi nɛɛ amli kɛya kɛba.

english_verse: But if you ignore me, I promise in my own name that this palace will lie in ruins.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji nyɛbuuu nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ mi Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ, mikã mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe kitã akɛ maŋtsɛ we nɛɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃.’ ”

english_verse: Listen to what I think about it: The palace of Judah's king is as glorious as Gilead or Lebanon's highest peaks. But it will be as empty as a ghost-town when I'm through with it.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ we nɛɛ he ji akɛ, “Maŋtsɛ we nɛɛ, otamɔ Gilead kɛhã mi; asaŋ otamɔ Lebanon gɔji lɛ hu moŋ nɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ mahã otsɔ̃ shiaŋa, maŋ ni adesa ko adesa ko ehiii mli.

english_verse: I'll send troops to tear it apart, and its beautiful cedar beams will be used for firewood.
translation_verse: Majie nifitelɔi ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ elema mawo bo; ni amɛbaatoo otsenedru tsei fɛɛfɛji lɛ, ni amɛbaaloo amɛwo la mli.

english_verse: People from different nations will pass by and ask, “Why did the Lord do this to such a great city as Jerusalem?”
translation_verse: “Ni majimaji anɔ bii pii aaabatsɔ̃ maŋ nɛɛ he kɛho, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaabi akɛ, ‘Mɛni hewɔ ni Yehowa fee maŋ kpeteŋkple nɛɛ nɛkɛ nɛɛ?’

english_verse: Others will answer, “It's because the people worshiped foreign gods and broke the agreement that the Lord their God had made with them.” King Jehoahaz The Lord said:
translation_verse: Abaajie naa akɛ, ‘Ejaakɛ amɛkwa kpãŋmɔ ni yɔɔ amɛ kɛ Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, teŋ lɛ, ni amɛyaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi moŋ, ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛ.’ ” Maŋtsɛ Yoahaz he wiemɔ ni Yeremia wie

english_verse: King Josiah is dead, so don't mourn for him. Instead, mourn for his son King Jehoahaz, dragged off to another country, never to return.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Yudabii, nyɛkafoa Maŋtsɛ Yosia mɔ ni egbo lɛ, ni nyɛkayea ehe ŋkɔmɔ hu. Shi moŋ nyɛfoa waa nyɛhãa Yoahaz mɔ ni yaa nomŋɔɔ mli lɛ, ejaakɛ ekuŋ esɛɛ ebaŋ dɔŋŋ. Ni enaŋ ejaku shikpɔŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Jehoahaz became king of Judah after his father King Josiah died. But Jehoahaz was taken as a prisoner to a foreign country. Now I, the Lord, promise that he will die there without ever seeing his own land again. King Jehoiakim The Lord told me to say: *
translation_verse: shi he ni aŋɔ lɛ nom kɛtee lɛ jɛi eeegbo yɛ, ni ehiŋmɛi enaŋ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ dɔŋŋ!” Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim he wiemɔ ni Yeremia wie

english_verse: You put in big windows and used cedar paneling and red paint. But you were unfair and forced the builders to work without pay. *
translation_verse: Kpoo hã mɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ, “Mama shĩa kpeteŋkple kɛ emli ŋwɛitsui ni dara.” Ejieɔ samfɛji ewoɔ he ni ekɛ tsenedrutso kaa mli, ni eshaa he kɛ ama tsuru fɔɔ.

english_verse: More cedar in your palace doesn't make you a better king than your father Josiah. He always did right— he gave justice to the poor and was honest.
translation_verse: Ani osusuɔ akɛ tsenedru mple ni oshiɔ lɛ no feɔ bo maŋtsɛ? Otsɛ hi shi, ni eye nii, ni enu nii, ni ekojo jalɛ naa, ni eye jalɛ sane, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ehi ehã lɛ!

english_verse: That's what it means to truly know me. So he lived a comfortable life and always had enough to eat and drink.
translation_verse: Eye nɔnalɔ kɛ ohiafo sane ehã lɛ; ni no hã ehi ehã lɛ lɛ.

english_verse: But all you think about is how to cheat or abuse or murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Shi bo lɛ, ohiŋmɛi kɛ otsui kã juukɛfɔ̃ nii kɛ mɛi ni efeko efɔŋ lá shishwiemɔ nɔ. Ni owaa mɛi ayi keketee.

english_verse: Jehoiakim, no one will mourn at your funeral. They won't turn to each other and ask, “Why did our great king have to die?”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yosia bi Yehoakim he nɛ, “Awoŋ yara afoŋ lɛ; akɛŋ lɛ akɛ ‘Kpoo Nuŋtsɔ! Ao, kpoo, Maŋtsɛ!’

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, the nations you trusted have been crushed. Go to Lebanon and weep; cry in the land of Bashan and in Moab.
translation_verse: Yerusalɛm maŋbii, nyɛkwɔa nyɛyaa Lebanon ni nyɛyabolɔa; nyɛyaa Bashan nyɛyabolɔa, kɛ Moab gɔji lɛ hu anɔ, ejaakɛ akpãtã nyɛsuɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: When times were good, I warned you. But you ignored me, just as you have done since Israel was young.
translation_verse: Be ni oyɔɔ nii pii lɛ, mikɛ bo wie; shi okɛɛ akɛ obooo mi toi. Ojeŋba kwraa nɛ kɛjɛ oblahiiaŋ, oboko mi toi dã.

english_verse: Now you will be disgraced because of your sins. Your leaders will be swept away by the wind, and the nations you trusted will be captured and dragged to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ baaloo olumɛi lɛ kɛya, abaaloo onanemɛi akɛ nomii kɛya; kɛkɛ lɛ ohiɛ aaagbo ni ohiɛ aaashwie shi yɛ onifɔɔjianii lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: Those who live in the palace paneled with cedar will groan with pain like women giving birth.
translation_verse: Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛkãmɔ Lebanon tsenedru tsui amli shweshweeshwe ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ, kɛji hejaramɔ ba lɛ, nyɛaana nɔ tamɔ yoo ni baafɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ gbala Yehoiakim toi

english_verse: King Jehoiachin, son of Jehoiakim, even if you were the ring I wear as the sign of my royal power, I would still pull you from my finger.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, kɛji bo Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim bi Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin tete po ji wolonaasɔomɔ ga ni yɔɔ mininejurɔ lɛ, mibakpɔ bo yɛ miwao,

english_verse: I would hand you over to the enemy you fear, to King Nebuchadnezzar and his army, who want to kill you.
translation_verse: ni matu bo mawo Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛ emaŋbii Babilonbii ni taoɔ bo amɛgbe ni osheɔ amɛ gbeyei hu lɛ adɛŋ.

english_verse: You and your mother were born in Judah, but I will throw both of you into a foreign country, where you will die,
translation_verse: Mibashɛ bo kɛ onyɛ ni fɔ bo lɛ fɛɛ mafɔ̃ shikpɔŋ ko nɔ, he ni jeee jɛmɛ afɔ nyɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ, ni jɛi nyɛbaagboi yɛ.

english_verse: Jehoiachin, you are unwanted like a broken clay pot. So you and your children will be thrown into a country you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Aso Yehoiakin etsɔ̃ mɔ ni abuuu tamɔ nu gbɛ ko ni mɔ ko taooo dɔŋŋ lo? Mɛni hewɔ mɔ ni ashwie lɛ kɛ ebii ni ashɛrɛ amɛ ashwie shikpɔŋ ko ni amɛleee nɔ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: Land of Judah, I am the Lord. Now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Ao Shikpɔŋ, Shikpɔŋ, Shikpɔŋ! Bo nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ toi.

english_verse: Erase the names of Jehoiachin's children from the royal records. He is a complete failure, and so none of them will ever be king. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛŋɔa nuu nɛɛ akɛ mɔ ko ni bɛ bi; mɔ ko ni shwereŋ ewala be mli fɛɛ, ejaakɛ eshwie ko eshwie ko naŋ David sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ eta eye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yuda dɔŋŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.”

english_verse: You leaders of my people are like shepherds that kill and scatter the sheep.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Kpoo hã lumɛi ni kpãtãa miwebii lɛ ahiɛ, ni amɛgbɛɔ mitoi lɛ amɛshwãa lɛ.

english_verse: You were supposed to take care of my people, but instead you chased them away. So now I'll punish you severely and make you pay for your crimes!
translation_verse: Bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mikɛɔ yɛ lumɛi ni kwɛɔ miwebii lɛ anɔ lɛ ahe nɛ, ‘Nyɛkuraaa miwebii lɛ, ni nyɛgbɛ amɛ nyɛshwã, ni nyɛshwie amɛ kɛtee. No hewɔ lɛ, naa, mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ akɛ mibawo nyɛ nyɛnifeemɔnii fɔ̃ji lɛ ahe nyɔmɔ.

english_verse: I will bring the rest of my people home from the lands where I have scattered them, and they will grow into a mighty nation.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ mibabua miwebii ni eshwɛshwɛɛ yɛ majimaji ni mishwie amɛ kɛtee lɛ fɛɛ anɔ lɛ anaa, ni mikɛ amɛ baaba amɛjaku shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ; ni amɛaafɔfɔi, ni amɛyi aaafa pii.

english_verse: I promise to choose leaders who will care for them like real shepherds. All of my people will be there, and they will never again be frightened.
translation_verse: Mato lumɛi, mɛi ni baalɛ amɛ jogbaŋŋ; ni amɛsheŋ gbeyei, ni amɛtsui hu efaŋ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko elaajeŋ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.’

english_verse: Someday I will appoint an honest king from the family of David, a king who will be wise and rule with justice.
translation_verse: “Mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ, naa be ko miiba ni matee maŋtsɛ jalɛ saneyelɔ ko shi ni jɛ David mli. Ebaaye maŋtsɛ yɛ nilee naa, ni ebaakojo jalɛ naa ni ebaaye jalɛ sane yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: As long as he is king, Israel will have peace, and Judah will be safe. The name of this king will be “The Lord Gives Justice.”
translation_verse: Lɛ eyinɔ lɛ abaahere Yuda yiwala, ni Israel baahi shi shweshweeshwe; ni gbɛi ni akɛbaatsɛ lɛ ji, ‘Yehowa ji wɔjalɛ.’ ”

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living God who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “No hewɔ lɛ, naa, be ko miiba ni akɛŋ dɔŋŋ akɛ, ‘Mina Yehowa mɔ ni jie Israelbii lɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ;’

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living God who rescued you from the land in the north and from all the other countries where I had forced you to go. And you will once again live in your own land. Jeremiah Thinks about Unfaithful Prophets
translation_verse: shi moŋ abaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mina Yehowa, mɔ ni jie ni ekpala Israelbii ashwiei lɛ kɛje kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ shikpɔji krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, hei ni eshwie amɛ kɛtee lɛ kɛba lɛ.’ Nakai be mli lɛ amɛbaahi amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛjaku shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Nɔ ni Yeremia wie yɛ osɔfoi lɛ ahe

english_verse: When I think of the prophets, I am shocked, and I tremble like someone drunk, because of the Lord and his sacred words.
translation_verse: Mitsui fɛɛ ejwra, ni miwui miikpokpo bliblibli. Mitsɔ̃ tamɔ dãatɔlɔ, mɔ ni dãa ekploka lɛ yɛ Yehowa kɛ ewiemɔi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told me to say: You prophets and priests think so little of me, the Lord, that you even sin in my own temple!
translation_verse: Gbalɔ kɛ osɔfo fɛɛ lɛ, amɛjeee Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɛi; ni minaa amɛnifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ yɛ miwe lɛ mli tete. Yehowa kɛɛ.

english_verse: Now I will punish you with disaster, and you will slip and fall in the darkness. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Amɛnyiɛmɔhei fɛɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ shikpɔŋ ni shamɔɔ yɛ duŋ mli ahã amɛ; jɛi abaatsirɛ amɛ awo, ni amɛbaatswiatswia shi, ejaakɛ afi nɔ ni abaagbala amɛtoi lɛ mahã sane gbonyo aye amɛ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.

english_verse: The prophets in Samaria were repulsive to me, because they preached in the name of Baal and led my people astray.
translation_verse: Mina esha ni Samaria gbalɔi lɛ fee lɛ; amɛtsɔ̃ Baal nɔ amɛgba, ni amɛhã mimaŋ Israel du gbɛ.

english_verse: And you prophets in Jerusalem are even worse. You're unfaithful in marriage and never tell the truth. You even lead others to sin instead of helping them turn back to me. You and the people of Jerusalem are evil like Sodom and Gomorrah.
translation_verse: Shi nɔ ni mina yɛ Yerusalɛm gbalɔi lɛ ahe lɛ, eyɛ gbeyei. Amɛfiteɔ gbãlã, ni amɛmaleɔ; amɛwo efɔŋfeelɔi hewalɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko kpaaa efɔŋ feemɔ. Amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ Sodom, ni maŋbii lɛ tamɔ Gomora hã mi.

english_verse: You prophets in Jerusalem have spread evil everywhere. That's why I, the Lord, promise to give you bitter poison to eat and drink. The Lord Gives a Warning The Lord said:
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ mikɛɔ yɛ gbalɔi lɛ ahe nɛ, “Naa, mibahã amɛ tatso akɛ amɛniyenii, ni mibahã amɛ nu ni ebɔɔ yɔɔ mli amɛnu, ejaakɛ Yerusalɛm gbalɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ efɔŋfeemɔ jɛ ni egbɛ eshwã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: Don't listen to the lies of these false prophets, you people of Judah! The message they preach is something they imagined; it did not come from me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, kɛɔ maŋbii nɛ, “Nyɛkaboa gbalɔi ni gbaa tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ awiemɔi lɛ toi; amɛmiihã nyɛ yaka hiɛnɔkãmɔ. Nɔ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛjwɛŋmɔi kɛɔ amɛ lɛ, no amɛgbaa lɛ, shi jeee nɔ ni jɛ mi, Yehowa, minaa.

english_verse: These prophets go to people who refuse to respect me and who are stubborn and do whatever they please. The prophets tell them, “The Lord has promised everything will be fine.”
translation_verse: Nɔ ni amɛkɛɔ mɛi ni ebuuu mi, Yehowa, miwiemɔ lɛ ji, ‘Nɔ ko gbaŋ nyɛnaa;’ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni efee ehe kuɛŋtilɔ lɛ, amɛkɛɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Nɔ fɔŋ ko nɔ fɔŋ ko bɛ ni baaba onɔ.’ ”

english_verse: But I, the Lord, tell you that these prophets have never attended a meeting of my council in heaven or heard me speak.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Amɛteŋ namɔ Yehowa kɛto ajina dã, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ena, ni enu Yehowa naa wiemɔ? Loo amɛteŋ namɔ ebo owiemɔ lɛ toi, ni eye nɔ?

english_verse: They are evil! So in my anger I will strike them like a violent storm.
translation_verse: Naa, Yehowa mlifu lɛ, ahum ni, ni efã kɛje kpo tamɔ lasuogbele, ni ebaawula mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ ayi.

english_verse: I won't calm down, until I have finished what I have decided to do. Someday you will understand exactly what I mean.
translation_verse: Yehowa mlifu lɛ sɛɛ efoŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nɔ ni eto eyiŋ akɛ ebaafee lɛ, ena efee egbe naa. Wɔsɛɛ ko dani nyɛaanu sane nɛɛ shishi jogbaŋŋ.”

english_verse: I did not send these prophets or speak to them, but they ran to find you and to preach their message.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mitsuko gbalɔi nɛɛ; amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛkɔ amɛfɔ̃ amɛnɔ ni amɛgbaa; mikɛ wiemɔ ko woko amɛnaa; shi amɛmiigba yɛ migbɛi mli.

english_verse: If they had been in a meeting of my council in heaven, they would have told you people of Judah to give up your sins and come back to me.
translation_verse: Eji mikɛ amɛ eto ajina lɛɛlɛŋ kulɛ, amɛaahã maŋbii lɛ anu minaa wiemɔi lɛ, ni kulɛ amɛaahã maŋbii lɛ akpa amɛjeŋba fɔŋ kɛ amɛnifeemɔnii gbohii lɛ.

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim that I have given them a dream or a vision, and then they tell lies in my name.
translation_verse: Minu nɔ ni gbalɔi ni gbaa amale gbalɛi yɛ mi, migbɛi mli ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mila lamɔ ko; mila lamɔ ko lɛ.’

english_verse: But everything they say comes from their own twisted minds. How long can this go on?
translation_verse: Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ po ni gbalɔi nɛɛ baajɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ amɛgba amale gbalɛ kɛyashi?

english_verse: They tell each other their dreams and try to get my people to reject me, just as their ancestors left me and worshiped Baal.
translation_verse: Ani amɛsusuɔ akɛ amɛkɛ lamɔi ni amɛgbaa amɛnanemɛi lɛ baahã mimaŋ lɛ hiɛ akpa minɔ tamɔ bɔ ni amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ahiɛ kpa minɔ, ni amɛtsɔ̃ amɛhã Baal lɛ?

english_verse: Their dreams and my truth are as different as straw and wheat. But when prophets speak for me, they must say only what I have told them.
translation_verse: Gbalɔ ni ela lamɔ ko lɛ, egba lamɔ lɛ; ni gbalɔ ni mikɛ miwiemɔ ewo enaa lɛ, ewie wiemɔ lɛ anɔkwale mli. Mɛni tutuu kɛ abele yɔɔ jaa?

english_verse: My words are a powerful fire; they are a hammer that shatters rocks.
translation_verse: Ani miwiemɔ lɛ etamɔɔɔ la; ni etamɔɔɔ hamle ni jwaraa tɛsaa mli wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ lo?

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim I give them their dreams, but it isn't true. I didn't choose them to be my prophets, and yet they babble on and on, speaking in my name, while stealing words from each other. And when my people hear these liars, they are led astray instead of being helped. So I warn you that I am now the enemy of these prophets. I, the Lord, have spoken. News and Nuisance The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: “Naa, mi Yehowa, mikɛ gbalɔi ni gbaa amale lamɔi lɛ ena. Malemɔ ni amɛmaleɔ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ miwebii lɛ kɛ amɛyiŋ flɛflɛ lɛ hãa miwebii lɛ duɔ gbɛ. Mitsuko amɛ, ni mifãko amɛ nɛkɛ nitsumɔ hu. No hewɔ lɛ, amɛhe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko kwraa hã maŋ nɛɛ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, when a prophet or a priest or anyone else comes to you and asks, “Does the Lord have news for us?” tell them, “You people are a nuisance to the Lord, and he will get rid of you.”
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yeremia, kɛji maŋ nɛɛ mli bii lɛ eko loo gbalɔ ko loo osɔfo ko bi bo akɛ, ‘Mɛni ji Yehowa jatsu lɛ’, ohere nɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛ, nyɛ nɔŋŋ ji jatsu lɛ; ni Yehowa baashɛ nyɛ efɔ̃.’

english_verse: If any of you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” I will punish you and your families, even if you are a prophet or a priest.
translation_verse: Ni gbalɔ loo osɔfo loo maŋnyo ni kɛ wiemɔ ‘Yehowa jatsu lɛ’ baafee edaaŋ kotsa lɛ, mibagbala mɔ lɛ kɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ toi yɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Instead, you must ask your friends and relatives, “What answer did the Lord give?” or “What has the Lord said?”
translation_verse: Nɔ ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ abi enaanyo kɛ enyɛmi moŋ ji akɛ, ‘Mɛɛ hetoo Yehowa hã,’ loo ‘Te Yehowa kɛɛ tɛŋŋ?’

english_verse: It seems that you each have your own news! So if you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” you are twisting my words into a lie. Remember that I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Wiemɔ ni ji ‘Yehowa jatsu’ lɛ, ekaje mɔ ko naa kwraa dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ no etsɔ̃ mɛi fɛɛ adaaŋ kotsa, ejaakɛ nyɛtsɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ, ni ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, lɛ wiemɔi lɛ ahiɛ nyɛbu shi.

english_verse: If you go to a prophet, it's all right to ask, “What answer did the Lord give to my question?” or “What has the Lord said?”
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yeremia, bi gbalɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛɛ hetoo Yehowa ehã nyɛ?’ loo ‘Te Yehowa kɛɛ tɛŋŋ?’

english_verse: I will pick you up and throw you far away. And I will abandon this city of Jerusalem that I gave to your ancestors.
translation_verse: naa, nyɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ ni mikɛhã nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ mibawo mashɛ mafɔ̃ kɛje mihiɛ.

english_verse: You will never be free from your shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Nyɛhe ahora ni nyɛbaabɔ kɛ nyɛhiɛ ni baagbo kɛya naanɔ lɛ hiɛ ejeŋ nɔ gbi ko gbi ko.”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me in a vision after King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had come to Judah and taken King Jehoiachin, his officials, and all the skilled workers back to Babylonia. In this vision I saw two baskets of figs in front of the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Be ni Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar ebaŋɔ Yehoiakim bi Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin kɛ Yuda lumɛi lɛ kɛ ŋaalɔi lɛ kɛ sɔ̃lɔi lɛ nom kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm kɛtee Babilon sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa jie ninaa nɛɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mi: Mina agbãmi kɛ kɛntɛŋi enyɔ mamɔ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: One basket was full of very good figs that ripened early, and the other was full of rotten figs that were not fit to eat.
translation_verse: Kɛntɛŋi lɛ ateŋ ekome lɛ agbãmii kpakpai ni tamɔ agbãmi ni tsu klɛŋklɛŋ sɔŋŋ yɔɔ mli. Shi kɛntɛŋ kroko lɛ agbãmii gbohii yɔɔ mli, ni hilɛ ni amɛhiii sɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ amɛhiii yeli tete.

english_verse: “Jeremiah,” the Lord asked, “what do you see?” “Figs,” I said. “Some are very good, but the others are too rotten to eat.”
translation_verse: Yehowa bi mi akɛ, “Yeremia, mɛni onaa nɛɛ?” Mihere nɔ akɛ, “Agbãmii; ni amɛteŋ agbãmii kpakpai lɛ, amɛhi jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ; shi amɛteŋ gbohii lɛ, amɛhiii, ni hilɛ ni amɛhiii sɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ amɛhiii yeli tete.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ,

english_verse: where I am watching over them. Then someday I will bring them back to this land. I will plant them, instead of uprooting them, and I will build them up, rather than tearing them down.
translation_verse: Mahã mihiŋmɛi akã amɛhe ni mafee amɛ ekpakpa; ni mikɛ amɛ baaku sɛɛ kɛba nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ. Matswa amɛ mamã shi tamɔ amãa tsu, ni mikumɔŋ amɛ; matɛo amɛ tamɔ atɛoɔ tso, ni mifamɔŋ amɛ mishwieŋ.

english_verse: I will give them a desire to know me and to be my people. They will want me to be their God, and they will turn back to me with all their heart.
translation_verse: Mibahã amɛ tsui ni baahã amɛle mi akɛ mi ji Yehowa; ni amɛbaatsɔ̃ miwebii, ni mibatsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ, ejaakɛ amɛbaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛba miŋɔɔ kɛ amɛtsui fɛɛ.

english_verse: The rotten figs stand for King Zedekiah of Judah, his officials, and all the others who were not taken away to Babylonia, whether they stayed here in Judah or went to live in Egypt.
translation_verse: “Shi nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ nɛ, bɔ ni mibafee agbãmii gbohii nɛɛ ni hilɛ ni amɛhiii sɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ amɛhiii yeli tete lɛ, nakai mibafee Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia kɛ elumɛi lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni shwɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli ni yɔɔ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ, kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: I will punish them with a terrible disaster, and everyone on earth will tremble when they hear about it. I will force the people of Judah to go to foreign countries, where they will be cursed and insulted.
translation_verse: Mibahã amɛtsɔ̃ gbeyei nɔ amɛhã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛyelihei fɛɛ; ni abaaye amɛhe fɛo, ni abaabɔ amɛ ahora, ni amɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni alomɔ amɛ yɛ hei fɛɛ ni mibagbɛ amɛ mashwã kɛya lɛ.

english_verse: War and hunger and disease will strike them, until they finally disappear from the land that I gave them and their ancestors.
translation_verse: Mibahã ta kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela abote amɛteŋ kɛyashi abaakpãtã amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã amɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord has sent prophets to you time after time, but you refused to listen.
translation_verse: Yehowa etsu etsuji fɛɛ ni ji gbalɔi lɛ kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ nɔŋŋ; shi nyɛbooo toi lɛ, nyɛyeee nɔ hu.

english_verse: They told you that the Lord had said: Change your ways! If you stop doing evil, I will let you stay forever in this land that I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Amɛbakɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akpa ejeŋba gbonyo kɛ enifeemɔnii gbohii lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛhi shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa kɛhã nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛjɛ naanɔ aahu kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: I don't want to harm you. So don't make me angry by worshiping idols and other gods.
translation_verse: Nyɛkasɔ̃mɔa ni nyɛkajaa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi, asaŋ nyɛkɛ nyɛniji akafee amãgãi ni nyɛja amɛ nyɛkɛwo mimli la, ni mifee nyɛ efɔŋ.’

english_verse: But you refused to listen to my prophets. So I, the Lord, say that you have made me angry by worshiping idols, and you are the ones who were hurt by what you did.
translation_verse: ‘Shi Yehowa kɛɛ nyɛbooo lɛ toi, shi moŋ nyɛkɛ nyɛninenaa amãgãi ni nyɛfee lɛ wo emli la, ni nyɛkɛye nyɛ nɔŋŋ nyɛhe awui.’

english_verse: and now I will let you be attacked by nations from the north, and especially by my servant, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia. You and other nearby nations will be destroyed and left in ruins forever. Everyone who sees what has happened will be shocked, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: naa, mibatsu koni ayaŋɔ kooyigbɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ bii lɛ kɛ Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar hu abahã mi, ni mahã amɛfã ta kɛbatua Yuda shikpɔŋ nɛɛ kɛ enɔ bii lɛ kɛ shikpɔji krokomɛi fɛɛ ni bɔle lɛ lɛ. Mibakpãtã amɛhiɛ butuu, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ nyaŋemɔnɔ ni aboɔ lɛ ‘tsia!’ Ni amɛhiɛ aaashwie shi kɛya naanɔ.

english_verse: I will put an end to your parties and wedding celebrations; no one will grind grain or be here to light the lamps at night.
translation_verse: Asaŋ mibahã nyamɔ kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ ayɛmforowu kɛ ayɛmforo gbee lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ afo yɛ jɛi; anaŋ mɔ ko ni koto wiɛ sɛɛ yɛ jɛi lɛ, anaŋ kane ni asu yɛ jɛi he ko he ko.

english_verse: This country will be as empty as a desert, because I will make all of you the slaves of the king of Babylonia for
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ tso muu nɛɛ fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛ shiaŋa tete; ni majimaji nɛɛ baasɔ̃mɔ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ afii nyɔŋmai kpawo.

english_verse: When that time is up, I will punish the king of Babylonia and his people for everything they have done wrong, and I will turn that country into a wasteland forever.
translation_verse: Shi afii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, mibagbala Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ toi yɛ nifɔɔjianii ni amɛbaafee lɛ hewɔ; ni mahã amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛya naanɔ. Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.

english_verse: My servant Jeremiah has told you what I said I will do to Babylonia and to the other nations, and he wrote it all down in this book. I will do everything I threatened.
translation_verse: Mahã wiemɔi fɛɛ ni miwie mishi shikpɔŋ nɛɛ, ni ji nii fɛɛ ni Yeremia gba shi majimaji lɛ, ni aŋmã yɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ, aba mli.

english_verse: I will pay back the Babylonians for every wrong they have done. Great kings from many other nations will conquer the Babylonians and force them to be slaves. The Cup Full of God's Anger
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mawo Babilonbii lɛ nyɔmɔ yɛ amɛnifeemɔnii kɛ amɛninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ majimaji kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi wuji baaye amɛ nyɔŋ.’ ” Fɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ bu maji lɛ

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel showed me a vision in which he said, “Jeremiah, here is a cup filled with the wine of my anger. Take it and make every nation drink some.
translation_verse: Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Hemɔ wain kpulu nɛɛ yɛ midɛŋ; mlifu ji wain ni yɔɔ mli lɛ; ni ohã majimaji fɛɛ ni mibatsu bo amɛŋɔɔ lɛ anu eko.

english_verse: They will vomit and act crazy, because of the war this cup of anger will bring to them.”
translation_verse: Amɛbaanu, ni amɛbaadidãa, ni amɛbaaye sɛkɛ tete yɛ ta ni mibahã afã kɛbatua amɛ lɛ hewɔ.”

english_verse: I took the cup from the Lord's hand, and I went to the kings of the nations and made each of them drink some.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mihe kpulu lɛ yɛ Yehowa dɛŋ; ni mihã majimaji fɛɛ ni Yehowa tsu mi amɛŋɔɔ lɛ nu wain lɛ. Mɛi ni nu ji,

english_verse: I started with Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, and the king and his officials were removed from power in disgrace. Everyone still makes insulting jokes about them and uses their names as curse words.
translation_verse: Yerusalɛm kɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji wuji lɛ kɛ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi kɛ lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ koni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛ shiaŋa kɛ nɔ ni aboɔ lɛ ‘tsia!’ Kɛ loomɔnɔ tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ.

english_verse: The second place I went was Egypt, where everyone had to drink from the cup, including the king and his officials, the other government workers, the rest of the Egyptians,
translation_verse: Mɛi krokomɛi hu ni nu Yehowa mlifu lɛ eko nɛ: Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ etsuji lɛ kɛ elumɛi lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ,

english_verse: and all the foreigners who lived in the country. Next I went to the king of Uz, and then to the four kings of Philistia, who ruled from Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and what was left of Ashdod.
translation_verse: kɛ maŋsɛɛbii ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ hu. Uz shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ni yɔɔ Ashkelon kɛ Gaza kɛ Ekron kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ Ashdod maŋ lɛ mli lɛ hu fɛɛ nu eko.

english_verse: Then I went to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon,
translation_verse: Mɛi komɛi hu ji Edombii kɛ Moabbii kɛ Amonbii lɛ,

english_verse: and to the kings of Tyre, Sidon, and their colonies across the sea.
translation_verse: kɛ Tiro maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Sidon maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ ŋshɔnaa maji lɛ amli maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ,

english_verse: After this, I went to the kings of Dedan, Tema, Buz, the tribes of the Arabian Desert,
translation_verse: Mɛi krokomɛi hu ji Arabia maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ futufutu gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ shiaŋa lɛ mli lɛ amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ,

english_verse: and the countries in the north, both near and far. I went to all the countries on earth, one after another, and finally to Babylonia.
translation_verse: kɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ, mɛi ni bɛŋkɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ, eko nyiɛ eko sɛɛ. Je lɛ mli maŋtsɛyelihei fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ asa amɛnaa mlifu wain lɛ eko. Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ hu aaanu eko.

english_verse: The Lord had said to tell each king, “The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, commands you to drink from this cup that is full of the wine of his anger. It will make you so drunk that you will vomit. And when the Lord sends war against the nations, you will be completely defeated.”
translation_verse: “Kɛkɛ lɛ okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, nyɛnua, nyɛtɔrɔa dãa, ni nyɛshwea, ni nyɛgbegbea shi ni nyɛkanyɛ shi nyɛte dɔŋŋ yɛ ta ni mibahã afã kɛbatua nyɛ lɛ hewɔ.’

english_verse: The Lord told me that if any of them refused to drink from the cup, I must tell them that he had said, “I, the Lord All-Powerful, command you to drink.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji amɛmiii akɛ amɛaahe kpulu lɛ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ ni amɛnu lɛ, no lɛ, okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, lɛ, kɛɛ ji, ‘Ja nyɛna nyɛnu kɛ̃!

english_verse: Starting with my own city of Jerusalem, everyone on earth will suffer from war. So there is no way I will let you escape unharmed.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ naa, kɛ mije shishi miifee maŋ wulu ni akɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ migbɛi ewo lɛ lɛ efɔŋ lɛ, te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛ lɛ ni nyɛŋɔɔ nyɛhe nyɛyeɔ tswaa hu?’ Nyɛŋɔŋ nyɛhe nyɛyeŋ nakai, ejaakɛ miihã afã ta kɛbatua nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ. Mi Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ mikɛɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told me to say: From my sacred temple I will roar like thunder, while I trample my people and everyone else as though they were grapes.
translation_verse: “No hewɔ lɛ, bo Yeremia, gbaa nɛkɛ gbalɛ nɛɛ oshi gbɔmɛi nɛɛ. Okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Yehowa aaajɛ ŋwɛi ehũu, ni ebaawo egbee kɛaajɛ eshihilɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. Eeehũu waa ewo ewebii lɛ ni eeebolɔ tamɔ wainŋalɔi, eeehũu ewo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ.

english_verse: My voice will be heard everywhere on earth, accusing nations of their crimes and sentencing the guilty to death. Disaster Is Coming
translation_verse: Ehũumɔ lɛ aaajije kɛaashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei fɛɛ; ejaakɛ Yehowa yɛ sane ni ekɛbaashi majimaji lɛ. Ekɛ heloo fɛɛ baakojo, ni eeehã mɛi fɔ̃ji anyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa. Yehowa kɛɛ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says: You can see disaster spreading from far across the earth, from nation to nation like a horrible storm.
translation_verse: Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa sane fɔŋ miijɛ maŋ kome nɔ kɛyanina maŋ kroko. Ahum kpeteŋkple ko aaate shi kɛaajɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehe tɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: When it strikes, I will kill so many people that their bodies will cover the ground like manure. No one will be left to bury them or to mourn. The Leaders of Judah Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Ni Yehowa baagbe mɛi yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehe kome kɛyashi enaagbeehe kroko. Afoŋ amɛ, ni abuaŋ amɛnaa, ni afuŋ amɛ tete; amɛaatsɔ̃ wamɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord's people are his flock, and you leaders were the shepherds. But now it's your turn to be butchered like sheep. You'll shatter like fine pottery dropped on the floor. So roll on the ground, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ maŋ onukpai, ni ji miwebii lɛ akwɛlɔi, nyɛwoa yara nyɛfoa, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhe akoklo lamlu mli ejaakɛ be ni abaagbegbee nyɛ, asaŋ be ni abaagbɛ nyɛ ashwã lɛ eshɛ; ni nyɛbaagboi tamɔ too gwantɛŋi osaii.

english_verse: You have nowhere to run, nowhere to hide. *
translation_verse: Maŋ onukpai lɛ naŋ abobaahe ko lɛ, miwebii lɛ alumɛi lɛ naŋ he ko atsɔ̃ kɛjo foi hu.

english_verse: Listen to the cries of the shepherds, as the Lord's burning anger turns peaceful meadows into barren deserts.
translation_verse: ni ewebii ni yɔɔ kpoo lɛ ahiɛ ekpãtã yɛ Yehowa mlifu ni naa wa lɛ naa.

english_verse: Like a lion leaving its den, the Lord has abandoned his people to the destruction of war.
translation_verse: Yehowa eshi emɛi lɛ tamɔ jata shiɔ ebu efɔ̃ɔ shi; ejaakɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ yɛ klante ni henyɛlɔ fã yɛ amɛnɔ kɛ Yehowa mlifu ni naa wa lɛ hewɔ.”

english_verse: The priests, the prophets, and everyone else in the temple heard what I said,
translation_verse: Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nu akɛ Yeremia miiwie wiemɔi nɛɛ yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.

english_verse: Soon after Jehoiakim became king of Judah, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Yosia bi Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shishijee mli lɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ jɛ Yehowa ŋɔɔ ba;

english_verse: But if you put me to death, you and everyone else in Jerusalem will be guilty of murdering an innocent man, because everything I preached came from the Lord.
translation_verse: shi moŋ nyɛnaa nyɛlea krɛdɛɛ akɛ kɛji nyɛgbe mi lɛ, no lɛ mɔ ko ni efeko nɔ fɔŋ ko lá yi sɔ̃ nyɛbaaloo nyɛbua nyɛ kɛ maŋ nɛɛ kɛ emli bii bluublu ayiteŋ, ejaakɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ, Yehowa ji mɔ ni tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ akɛ mibawie nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ nyɛtoiaŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, I have a message for everyone who comes from the towns of Judah to worship in my temple. Go to the temple courtyard and speak every word that I tell you.
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yaadamɔ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kpo lɛ nɔ, koni okɛ wiemɔi fɛɛ ni mifã bo akɛ owie lɛ ashwie Yuda maji lɛ amli bii fɛɛ ni baa amɛbajaa yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ahiɛ. Kaashi wiemɔ ko wiemɔ ko.

english_verse: Maybe the people will listen this time. And if they stop doing wrong, I will change my mind and not punish them for their sins.
translation_verse: Eko lɛ aleenɔ amɛaabo toi, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baakpa ejeŋba fɔŋ lɛ koni efɔŋ ni mito akɛ mafee amɛ yɛ amɛnifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ mafo mli.”

english_verse: Tell them that I have said: You have refused to listen to me and to obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ mikɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Esa ni nyɛboɔ mi toi koni nyɛba nyɛjeŋ yɛ mimla ni miwo nyɛ lɛ naa,

english_verse: Again and again I have sent my servants the prophets to preach to you, but you ignored them as well. Now I am warning you that if you don't start obeying me at once,
translation_verse: koni nyɛye mitsuji gbalɔi lɛ ni mitsuɔ amɛ nyɛŋɔɔ kɛ hiɛdɔɔ lɛ awiemɔi lɛ anɔ, shi nyɛbooo amɛ toi,

english_verse: I will destroy this temple, just as I destroyed the town of Shiloh. Then everyone on earth will use the name “Jerusalem” as a curse word. Jeremiah on Trial
translation_verse: hewɔ lɛ mafee Sɔlemɔ we nɛɛ tamɔ mifee Shilo lɛ, ni mahã maŋ nɛɛ atsɔ̃ loomɔ nɔ̃ ahã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji fɛɛ.’ ”

english_verse: and as soon as I finished, they all crowded around me and started shouting, “Why did you preach that the Lord will destroy this temple, just as he destroyed Shiloh? Why did you say that Jerusalem will be empty and lie in ruins? You ought to be put to death for saying such things in the Lord's name!” Then they had me arrested.
translation_verse: Mɛɛba ogba yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli akɛ, ‘Nɛkɛ Sɔlemɔ we nɛɛ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ Shilo, ni maŋ nɛɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ ni gbɔmɔ ehiŋ mli dɔŋŋ lɛ?’ ” Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ kpe wo Yeremia he yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.

english_verse: The royal officers heard what had happened, and they came from the palace to the new gate of the temple to be the judges at my trial.
translation_verse: Be ni Yuda lumɛi lɛ nu wiemɔi ni eje Yeremia naa lɛ, amɛjɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ kɛba Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni amɛbatara shi yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ agbo ni gbɛi ji Agbo Hee lɛ naa.

english_verse: While they listened, the priests and the prophets said to the crowd, “All of you have heard Jeremiah prophesy that Jerusalem will be destroyed. He deserves the death penalty.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ kɛɛ maŋ lumɛi lɛ akɛ, “Nuu nɛɛ sa gbele, ejaakɛ egba yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛtoiŋ eshi maŋ nɛɛ.”

english_verse: Then I told the judges and everyone else: The Lord himself sent me to tell you about the terrible things he will do to you, to Jerusalem, and to the temple. But if you change your ways and start obeying the Lord, he will change his mind.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, nyɛtsakea nyɛjeŋba kɛ nyɛnifeemɔnii; asaŋ nyɛboa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi, ni lɛ hu ebaatsake ejwɛŋmɔ yɛ efɔŋ ni eto eyiŋ akɛ ebaafee nyɛ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: You must decide what to do with me. Just do whatever you think is right.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, naa miyɛ nyɛdɛŋ. Nyɛfea mi nɔ ni hi, kɛ nɔ ni ja yɛ nyɛhiɛ;

english_verse: The judges and the other people told the priests and prophets, “Since Jeremiah only told us what the Lord our God had said, we don't think he deserves to die.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni lumɛi lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ kɛɛ osɔfoi lɛ akɛ, “Nuu nɛɛ esaaa gbele, ejaakɛ ekɛ wɔ wie yɛ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛi mli.”

english_verse: Then some of the leaders from other towns stepped forward. They told the crowd that
translation_verse: Maŋ onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi te shi, ni amɛkɛɛ asafo muu ni ebabɔ gwa lɛ fɛɛ akɛ,

english_verse: years ago when Hezekiah was king of Judah, a prophet named Micah from the town of Moresheth had said: “I, the Lord All-Powerful, say Jerusalem will be plowed under and left in ruins. Thorns will cover the mountain where the temple now stands.”
translation_verse: “Be ko lɛ Mika ni jɛ Moreshet lɛ gba yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia yinɔ, ni ekɛɛ Yudabii fɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ ji,’ ‘Abaahu Zion tamɔ ahuɔ ŋmɔ, Yerusalɛm baatsɔ̃ koikoi, ni Sɔlemɔ we lɛ gɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ koo ni etsa sulaŋŋ.’

english_verse: Then the leaders continued: No one put Micah to death for saying that. Instead, King Hezekiah prayed to the Lord with fear and trembling and asked him to have mercy. Then the Lord decided not to destroy Jerusalem, even though he had already said he would. People of Judah, if Jeremiah is killed, we will bring a terrible disaster on ourselves.
translation_verse: Ani gbe Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia kɛ Yuda fɛɛ gbe Mika lo? Ani jeee gbeyei moŋ Hezekia she Yehowa ni efee nɔ ni hã Yehowa na ehe tsui, ni no hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa tsake ejwɛŋmɔ ni efee akɛ ebaakpãtã amɛhiɛ lɛ? Shi wɔ lɛ wɔmiitao wɔloo musu kpele nɛɛ wɔbua wɔyiteŋ.”

english_verse: Not long after Zedekiah became king of Judah, the Lord told me: Jeremiah, make a wooden yoke with leather straps, and place it on your neck.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi ji akɛ, “Okɛ kooloo wolo ni afolɔ lɛ blawai blawai kɛ tso afee kɔŋtso koni okɛfɔ̃ okuɛ.

english_verse: Then send a message to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon. Some officials from these countries are in Jerusalem, meeting with Zedekiah.
translation_verse: No sɛɛ lɛ, okɛ wiemɔ amaje Maŋtsɛmɛi abɔfoi ni eba Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia ŋɔɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ koni amɛkɛyahã Edom maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Amonbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Tiro maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Sidon maŋtsɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: So have them tell their kings that I have said: I am the All-Powerful Lord God of Israel,
translation_verse: Okɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛyakɛɛ amɛnuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ akɛ Yehowa Taiatsɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ,

english_verse: and with my power I created the earth, its people, and all animals. I decide who will rule the earth,
translation_verse: “Mi, Yehowa, mi mibɔ je lɛ kɛ gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi bluublu ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ mihewalɛ kpeteŋkple kɛ minineshiwalɛ naa; ni mikɛhãa mɔ ni misumɔɔ.

english_verse: and I have chosen my servant King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to rule all nations, including yours. I will even let him rule the wild animals. All nations will be slaves of Nebuchadnezzar, his son, and his grandson. Then many nations will join together, and their kings will make slaves of the Babylonians.
translation_verse: Majimaji fɛɛ aaasɔ̃mɔ lɛ kɛ ebinuu kɛ enabi nuu tete kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni lɛ Babilon Maŋtsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu, eshikpɔŋ lɛ be aaashɛ; kɛkɛ lɛ maji babaoo kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi wuji baaye lɛ nyɔŋ.

english_verse: This yoke stands for the power of King Nebuchadnezzar, and I will destroy any nation that refuses to obey him. Nebuchadnezzar will attack, and many will die in battle or from hunger and disease.
translation_verse: “Naa, kɛji maŋ ko loo maŋtsɛyeli shikpɔŋ ko emiii akɛ esɔ̃mɔ Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar nɛɛ koni ekɛ ehe awo enɔyeli shishi lɛ, no lɛ, mikɛ ta kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela baagbala nakai maŋ lɛ toi, kɛyashi mahã Nebukadnezar akpãtã nakai maŋ lɛ hiɛ butuu. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.

english_verse: You might have people in your kingdom who claim they can tell the future by magic or by talking with the dead or by dreams or messages from a god. But don't pay attention if any of them tell you not to obey Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkaboa nyɛgbalɔi lɛ kɛ nyɛklalɔi lɛ kɛ nyɛlalɔi lɛ kɛ nyɛkɔmfoi lɛ kɛ nyɛkunyaayelɔi lɛ ni kɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛsɔ̃mɔŋ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ toi.’

english_verse: If you listen to such lies, I will have you dragged far from your country and killed.
translation_verse: “Ejaakɛ gbalɛi ni amɛgbaa amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, amale sɔŋŋ ni. Nɔ ni no kɛbaaba ji akɛ abaaloo nyɛ kɛje nyɛshikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ kɛya maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ. Mibashwie nyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni nyɛhiɛ baakpãtã.

english_verse: But if you and your nation are willing to obey Nebuchadnezzar, I will let you stay in your country, and your people will continue to live and work on their farms.
translation_verse: Shi maŋ fɛɛ maŋ ni aaaŋɔ ehe ewo Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔyeli shishi, ni eeesɔ̃mɔ lɛ lɛ, mahã ehi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ, ni ehu nɔ, ni ehi nɔ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.”

english_verse: After I had spoken to the officials from the nearby kingdoms, I went to King Zedekiah and told him the same thing. Then I said: Zedekiah, if you and the people of Judah want to stay alive, you must obey Nebuchadnezzar and the Babylonians.
translation_verse: Mikɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ shwie Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia hiɛ, ni mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nii, nyɛŋɔa nyɛhe nyɛwoa Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔyeli shishi, koni nyɛsɔ̃mɔ lɛ kɛ ewebii lɛ; ni nyɛyi aaana wala!

english_verse: But if you refuse, then you and your people will die from war, hunger, and disease, just as the Lord has warned.
translation_verse: Mɛni hewɔ ta kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela aaakpãtã bo kɛ omaŋbii ahiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ewie yɛ maŋ ni sɔ̃mɔŋ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ he lɛ?

english_verse: Your prophets have told you that you don't need to obey Nebuchadnezzar, but don't listen to their lies.
translation_verse: Kaabo gbalɔi lɛ ni kɛɔ bo akɛ, ‘Nyɛsɔ̃mɔŋ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ’ awiemɔi lɛ toi, ejaakɛ gbalɛi ni amɛgbaa lɛ amale sɔŋŋ ni.

english_verse: Those prophets claim to be speaking for the Lord, but he didn't send them. They are lying! If you do what they say, he will have both you and them dragged off to another country and killed. The Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ mitsuko amɛ. Amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmiigba amale gbalɛi yɛ migbɛiŋ. Nɔ ni baaba ji akɛ mibashwie nyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛhiɛ aaakpatã, nyɛ kɛ nyɛgbalɔi lɛ ni gbaa tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ fɛɛ.”

english_verse: When I finished talking to the king, I told the priests and everyone else that the Lord had said: Don't listen to the prophets when they say that very soon the Babylonians will return the things they took from my temple. Those prophets are lying!
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ nyɛkaboa nyɛgbalɔi ni gbaa ni amɛkɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, ‘etsɛŋ ni akɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli nibii ni aloo kɛtee Babilon lɛ baaku sɛɛ kɛba,’ lɛ awiemɔi lɛ toi, ejaakɛ amale gbalɛ amɛgbaa amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ.

english_verse: If you choose to obey the king of Babylonia, you will live. But if you listen to those prophets, this whole city will be nothing but a pile of rubble.
translation_verse: Nyɛkaboa amɛ toi; nyɛsɔ̃mɔa Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni nyɛyi aaana wala. Mɛɛba aaahã maŋ nɛɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃?

english_verse: If I really had spoken to those prophets, they would know what I am going to do. Then they would be begging me not to let everything else be taken from the temple and the king's palace and the rest of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kɛji gbalɔi ji amɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli, ni mi Yehowa, mikɛ miwiemɔi ewo amɛnaa lɛ, no lɛ amɛkpa mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, fai koni nibii ni eshwɛ yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli kɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli kɛ Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli hu lɛ akaŋɔ kɛmiiya Babilon.”

english_verse: will be taken to Babylonia, where they will remain until I decide to bring them back to Jerusalem. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: “Abaaloo amɛ kɛya Babilon, ni amɛbaahi jɛi kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni makai amɛ, ni mikɛ nibii nɛɛ baaku sɛɛ kɛba amɛtsuutsu toohe lɛ mli yɛ biɛ ekoŋŋ.” Yehowa kɛɛ.

english_verse: Later that same year, in the fifth month of the fourth year that Zedekiah was king, the prophet Hananiah son of Azzur from Gibeon came up to me in the temple. And while the priests and others in the temple were listening,
translation_verse: Nakai afi lɛ mli nɔŋŋ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shishijee mli, yɛ afi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ mli nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Azur bi Hanania ni ji gbalɔ ko ni jɛ Gibeon maŋ lɛ mli lɛ kɛɛ mi yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli yɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ maŋbii muu lɛ ahiɛ akɛ,

english_verse: he told me that the Lord had said: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I will smash the yoke that Nebuchadnezzar put on the necks of the nations to make them his slaves.
translation_verse: “Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Mifite Babilon maŋtsɛ hewalɛ ni tamɔ apã ni kã nyɛkuɛ lɛ.

english_verse: And within two years, I will bring back to Jerusalem everything that he took from my temple and carried off to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Biɛ afii enyɔ sɛɛ lɛ, mibaŋɔ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli nibii fɛɛ ni Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar baloo yɛ biɛ kɛtee Babilon lɛ kɛba biɛ nɛɛ ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: King Jehoiachin and the other people who were taken from Judah to Babylonia will be allowed to come back here as well. All this will happen because I will smash the power of the king of Babylonia!
translation_verse: Asaŋ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yekonia, Yehoiakim bi lɛ, kɛ Yudabii fɛɛ ni aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛjɛ Yuda kɛtee Babilon lɛ, mikɛ amɛ baaku sɛɛ kɛba biɛ nɛɛ ekoŋŋ, ejaakɛ mibafite Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ hewalɛ ni tamɔ apã lɛ. Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Hananiah, I hope the Lord will do exactly what you said. I hope he does bring back everything the Babylonians took from the temple, and that our people who were taken to Babylonia will be allowed to return home.
translation_verse: ni mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Amen! Yehowa aaafee nakai. Yehowa ahã ogbalɛ ni ogba nɛɛ aba mli akɛ ebaaŋɔ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli nibii lɛ kɛ nomii lɛ fɛɛ kɛjɛ Babilon kɛba biɛ nɛɛ ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: But let me remind you and everyone else
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ agbɛnɛ bo wiemɔ ni miwieɔ yɛ bo kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ toiŋ nɛɛ toi.

english_verse: that long before we were born, prophets were saying powerful kingdoms would be struck by war, disaster, and disease.
translation_verse: Gbalɔi ni tsɔ̃ mi kɛ bo fɛɛ wɔhiɛ kɛjɛ teteete lɛ, amɛgba tai kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela ni baaba shikpɔji babaoo kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi wuji amaŋtsɛyelihei anɔ ahe gbalɛi.

english_verse: Now you are saying we will have peace. We will just have to wait and see if that is really what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Gbalɔ ni gbaa hejɔlɛ he gbalɛ lɛ, nɔ ni akɛleɔ akɛ Yehowa ni tsu lɛ lɛɛlɛŋ mli ji kɛji egbalɛ lɛ na eba mli anɔkwaleŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Hananiah grabbed the wooden yoke from my neck and smashed it.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Gbalɔ Hanania wo kɔŋtso lɛ yɛ Gbalɔ Yeremia kuɛ, ni ekumɔ mli;

english_verse: Then he said, “The Lord says this is the way he will smash the power Nebuchadnezzar has over the nations, and it will happen in less than two years.” I left the temple,
translation_verse: ni Gbalɔ Hanania wie yɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ akɛ, “Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nɛkɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ mibakumɔ Nebukadnezar, Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ apã lɛ yɛ majimaji fɛɛ akuɛ biɛ afii enyɔ mli.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Yeremia shi jɛi ni etee.

english_verse: Hananiah, I have never sent you to speak for me. And yet you have talked my people into believing your lies and rebelling against me. So now I will send you—I'll send you right off the face of the earth! You will die before this year is over.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Naa, mibajie bo yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ. Afi nɛɛ nɔŋŋ mli lɛ obaagbo, ejaakɛ owie atuatsemɔ wiemɔ oshi Yehowa.’ ”

english_verse: I had been left in Jerusalem when King Nebuchadnezzar took many of the people of Jerusalem and Judah to Babylonia as prisoners, including King Jehoiachin, his mother, his officials, and the metal workers and others in Jerusalem who were skilled in making things. So I wrote a letter to the priests, the prophets, the leaders, and the rest of our people in Babylonia.
translation_verse: Aŋma wolo nɛɛ be ni amɔmɔ Maŋtsɛ Yekonia kɛ emaŋnyɛ lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ piafoi lɛ kɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛm abladei hu kɛ ŋaalɔi srɔtoi lɛ kɛ sɔ̃lɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛtee nomŋɔɔ mli sɛɛ.

english_verse: I gave the letter to Elasah and Gemariah, two men that King Zedekiah of Judah was sending to Babylon to talk with Nebuchadnezzar. In the letter, I wrote
translation_verse: Mikɛ wolo nɛɛ maje Shafan bi Elasa kɛ Hilkia bi Gemaria, ni ji bɔfoi komɛi ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia etsu amɛ Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar ŋɔɔ yɛ Babilon lɛ. Wolo lɛ mli wiemɔ nɛ,

english_verse: that the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, had said: I had you taken from Jerusalem to Babylonia. Now I tell you
translation_verse: “Nɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɔ nomi fɛɛ ni ehã aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm kɛtee Babilon nɛ,

english_verse: to settle there and build houses. Plant gardens and eat what you grow in them.
translation_verse: ‘Nyɛmamɔa tsui, ni nyɛhi mli; nyɛfea abɔi ni nyɛye amɛmli yibii;
