english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, the true King, promise that the officials and advisors, the governors and leaders, and the soldiers of Babylon will get drunk, fall asleep, and never wake up.
translation_verse: Mibahã Babilon lumɛi lɛ kɛ nilelɔi lɛ kɛ amraloi lɛ kɛ tatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ tabilɔi kãkãlɔi lɛ fɛɛ atɔrɔ dãa, ni naanɔ wɔ baanyɔ amɛnɔ, ni amɛhiɛ etsɛ̃ŋ dɔŋŋ. Mi, Maŋtsɛ, mɔ ni gbɛi ji Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɛ.

english_verse: The thick walls of that city will be torn down, and its huge gates burned. Everything that nation worked so hard to gain will go up in smoke. Jeremiah Gives Seraiah a Scroll
translation_verse: Abaakumɔ Babilon gbogbo lɛkɛtɛɛ lɛ ashwie shi shwɛtɛɛ, ni egboi gojogojoo lɛ abaashã. Majimaji lɛ miigbo deŋme yaka, ni amɛhenaagbamɔ lɛ la baashã. Mi, Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɛ.” Yeremia wiemɔ yashɛ Babilon

english_verse: During Zedekiah's fourth year as king of Judah, he went to Babylon. And Baruch's brother Seraiah went along as the officer in charge of arranging for places to stay overnight.
translation_verse: Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia yinɔ afi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ etee Babilon. Ekɛ epiafonyonukpa Seraia ni ji Maseia bi Neria bi lɛ tee. Gbalɔ Yeremia kɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ maje Seraia.

english_verse: Before they left, I wrote on a scroll all the terrible things that would happen to Babylon.
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Gbalɔ Yeremia ŋma efɔ̃ɔji fɛɛ ni baaba Babilon nɔ lɛ ewo wolo mli; wiemɔi fɛɛ ni eŋmala lɛ kɔɔ Babilon he.

english_verse: I gave the scroll to Seraiah and said: When you get to Babylon, read this scroll aloud,
translation_verse: Yeremia kɛɛ Seraia akɛ, “Kɛji oshɛ Babilon lɛ kwɛmɔ koni okane wolo nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ otsɔ̃ɔ maŋbii lɛ.

english_verse: then pray, “Our Lord, you promised to destroy this place and make it into a desert where no people or animals will ever live.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ osɔle akɛ, ‘Ao Yehowa, okɛɛ yɛ maŋ nɛɛ he akɛ obaakpãtã ehiɛ butubutu kɛmɔ shi bɔ ni adesa loo kooloo ko ehiŋ mli, ni ebaakã shi amaŋfɔ̃ kɛya naanɔ.’

english_verse: When you finish praying, tie the scroll to a rock and throw it in the Euphrates River. Then say,
translation_verse: Kɛji okane wolo nɛɛ ogbe naa lɛ, fii wolo lɛ okpɛtɛ tɛ, koni oshɛ ofɔ̃ Eufrate Faa lɛ teŋ tɔ̃ɔ,

english_verse: “This is how Babylon will sink when the Lord destroys it. Everyone in the city will die, and it won't have the strength to rise again.” The End of Jeremiah's Writing Jeremiah's writing ends here.
translation_verse: ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni Babilon baashiu, ni eteŋ shi dɔŋŋ yɛ ehiɛ ni mi, Yehowa, mibakpãtã lɛ hewɔ.’ ” He ni Yeremia kɛ ewiemɔ lɛ wa nɛ.

english_verse: Next, Nebuzaradan arrested Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah his assistant, and three temple officials.
translation_verse: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ maŋtsɛ hebulɔi asafoiatsɛ Nebuzaradan mɔmɔ Osɔfonukpa Seraia kɛ esɛɛmɔ Osɔfo Zefania kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ agbo lɛ naabulɔi etɛ̃ lɛ.

english_verse: then his eyes were poked out. He was put in chains, then dragged off to Babylon and kept in prison until he died.
translation_verse: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Nebukadnezar hã afamɔ Maŋtsɛ Zedekia hiŋmɛii, ni ewo lɛ gboklɛ, ni ekpala lɛ kɛtee Babilon, ni eyawo lɛ tsuŋ yɛ jɛi kɛyashi Zedekia gbo. Akumɔ Yerusalɛm Sɔlemɔ we lɛ

english_verse: meters around. They were hollow, but the bronze was about
translation_verse: Asa Yerusalɛm yi aahu kɛyashi Zedekia maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: After a year and a half, all the food in Jerusalem was gone. Then on the ninth day of the fourth month,
translation_verse: Afi nɛɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ lɛ, hɔmɔ ni eba Yerusalɛm lɛ naa bawa bɔ sɔŋŋ ni maŋbii naaa nɔ ko nɔ ko amɛye.

english_verse: the Babylonian troops broke through the city wall. That same night, Zedekiah and his soldiers tried to escape through the gate near the royal garden, even though they knew the enemy had the city surrounded. They headed toward the Jordan River valley,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni agbu gbɛ awo maŋ gbogbo lɛ mli, ni maŋ lɛ mli hii tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ jo foi kɛje maŋ lɛ mli nyɔɔŋ. Amɛtsɔ̃ agbo ko ni enaa kã maŋ lɛ he gbogboi enyɔ ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ trom lɛ masɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ mli, tsɛbelɛ Babilon tabilɔi lɛ ebɔle Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ kɛkpe nɔŋŋ. Tabilɔi foijelɔi nɛɛ tsɔ̃ Yordan Jɔɔ lɛ mli gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛtee.

english_verse: Zedekiah was taken to Riblah in the land of Hamath, where Nebuchadnezzar put him on trial and found him guilty.
translation_verse: Amɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni akɛ lɛ bahã Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar yɛ Ribla, yɛ Hamat shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekojo Zedekia.

english_verse: Zedekiah's sons and the officials of Judah were killed while he watched,
translation_verse: Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ gbe Zedekia bihii lɛ yɛ ehiɛ; asaŋ egbe Yuda lumɛi lɛ hu fɛɛ yɛ Ribla.

english_verse: Jerusalem was captured during Nebuchadnezzar's nineteenth year as king of Babylonia. About a month later, Nebuchadnezzar's officer in charge of the guards arrived in Jerusalem. His name was Nebuzaradan,
translation_verse: Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ, Nebuzaradan ni ji Nebukadnezar hebulɔi ni sɔmɔɔ lɛ lɛ asafoiatsɛ lɛ bote Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli,

english_verse: and he burned down the Lord's temple, the king's palace, and every important building in the city, as well as all the houses.
translation_verse: ni eshã Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm shĩai fɛɛ. Eshã shĩa wulu fɛɛ shĩa wulu,

english_verse: Then he ordered the Babylonian soldiers to break down the walls around Jerusalem.
translation_verse: ni Babilon tabilɔi ni fata maŋtsɛ hebulɔi asafoiatsɛ Nebuzaradan he lɛ kumɔ gbogboi fɛɛ ni bɔle Yerusalɛm he kɛkpe lɛ amɛshwie shi.

english_verse: He led away the people left in the city, including everyone who had become loyal to Nebuchadnezzar, the rest of the skilled workers, and even some of the poor people of Judah.
translation_verse: Nebuzaradan ŋɔ maŋbii lɛ ekomɛi nom kɛtee Babilon: ohiafoi kposakposai lɛ ateiaŋ mɛi komɛi, kɛ maŋbii ni shwɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ ekomɛi, kɛ tabilɔi ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛtee amɛkɛ amɛhe yahã Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ, kɛ maŋ lɛ mli ŋaalɔi ni eshwɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Only the very poorest were left behind to work the vineyards and the fields.
translation_verse: Shi Nebuzaradan, maŋtsɛ hebulɔi asafoiatsɛ lɛ, shi maŋ lɛ mli ohiafoi kposakposai lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ni amɛtsɔmɔ waintrom mlisaalɔi kɛ okwaafoi.

english_verse: Evil Merodach was kind to Jehoiachin and honored him more than any of the other kings held prisoner there.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ Ewil-merodak hiɛ sɔ Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin pam, ni ehã lɛ gbɛnaa ni nɔ kwɔ fe maŋtsɛmɛi nomii krokomɛi ni amɛ hu amɛkɛ lɛ yɔɔ Babilon lɛ.

english_verse: Jehoiachin was allowed to wear regular clothes instead of a prison uniform, and he even ate at the king's table every day.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yehoiakin tsake gboklɛfoi atade lɛ yɛ ehe; ni ekɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ yeɔ nii yɛ ekpɔlɔ̃ he daa gbi ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: As long as Jehoiachin lived, he was paid a daily allowance to buy whatever he needed.
translation_verse: Daa gbi lɛ, Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ hãa lɛ shika fioo ko ni ekɛheɔ nii ni he hiaa lɛ kɛyashi egbele be.

english_verse: Jerusalem, once so crowded, lies deserted and lonely. This city that was known all over the world is now like a widow. This queen of the nations has been made a slave.
translation_verse: Kwɛ bɔ ni maŋ ni kulɛ emli bii fa babaoo lɛ, ta shi ekometoo! Kwɛ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ okulafo; lɛ maŋ ni kulɛ eje agbo yɛ majimaji ateŋ lɛ. Lɛ ni kulɛ lumɔ ji lɛ yɛ maji ateŋ lɛ, ŋmɛnɛ, etsɔ̃ mɔ ni atsuɔ lɛ onia.

english_verse: Each night, bitter tears flood her cheeks. None of her former lovers are there to offer comfort; her friends have betrayed her and are now her enemies.
translation_verse: Fo sɔŋŋ efoɔ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ; yaafonu jwere ehiɛ be fɛɛ be; shi enaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko yɛ esuɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ ni shɛjeɔ emii. Enanemɛi lɛ fɛɛ yeee lɛ anɔkwa; amɛtsɔ̃mɔ ehenyɛlɔi.

english_verse: The people of Judah are slaves, suffering in a foreign land, with no rest from sorrow. Their enemies captured them and were terribly cruel.
translation_verse: Yuda eshi eshikpɔŋ nɔ yɛ amanehulu kɛ nyɔŋyeli tuutu hewɔ; eyahi majimaji lɛ ateŋ; shi enaaa hejɔlɛ yɛ he ko he ko. Ehenyɛlɔi ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ anine eshɛ enɔ yɛ nififiaŋ.

english_verse: The roads to Zion mourn because no one travels there to celebrate the festivals. The city gates are deserted; priests are weeping. Young women are raped; Zion is in sorrow!
translation_verse: Gbɛjegbɛi ni yaa Zion lɛ miiye awerɛho, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko baaa ebayeee gbii juji ni ato lɛ. Emaŋ agboi lɛ kãmɔ efolo esɔfoi lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ, eblayei lalɔi lɛ efee mɔbɔmɔbɔ, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, eena nɔ naakpa.

english_verse: Enemies now rule the city and live as they please. The Lord has punished Jerusalem because of her awful sins; he has let her people be dragged away.
translation_verse: Ehenyɛlɔi lɛ etsɔ̃ yitso agbɛnɛ, ni amɛmiishwere, ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã eena nɔ yɛ etɔ̃mɔi babaoo lɛ ahewɔ. Ebii etee; amɛnyiɛ henyɛlɔi ahiɛ kɛtee akɛ nomii.

english_verse: Zion's glory has disappeared. Her leaders are like deer that cannot find pasture; they are hunted down till their strength is gone.
translation_verse: Yerusalɛm anunyam fɛɛ etã. Elumɛi lɛ etsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ ofrotei ni naaa niyelihe ko; amɛjo foi yɛ henyɛlɔi ni nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ ahiɛ wrɔmiiwrɔmii kɛtee.

english_verse: Her people recall the good life that once was theirs; now they suffer and are scattered. No one was there to protect them from their enemies who sneered when their city was taken.
translation_verse: Yerusalɛm kaiɔ, yɛ emanehulu kɛ haomɔ gbii lɛ amli, ojarawa nibii ni eyɔɔ kɛjɛ blema beebe lɛ. Be ni emaŋbii gbee henyɛlɔi adɛŋ, ni bualɔ ko bualɔ ko bɛ lɛ, henyɛlɔi lɛ ye ehe fɛo ni amɛŋmɔ lɛ yɛ eshigbeemɔ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem's horrible sins have made the city a joke. Those who once admired her now hate her instead— she has been disgraced; she groans and turns away.
translation_verse: Yerusalɛm fee esha kpele ni no hewɔ lɛ, ehe wo muji. Mɛi fɛɛ ni kulɛ amɛwoɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ miibu lɛ shikpɔŋ agbɛnɛ, ejaakɛ amɛna eyayaiaŋ. Naa, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ eekɛ̃mɔ ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ eto afã.

english_verse: Her sins had made her filthy, but she wasn't worried about what could happen. And when Jerusalem fell, it was so tragic. No one gave her comfort when she cried out, “Help! I'm in trouble, Lord! The enemy has won.”
translation_verse: Ehe muji kpa etadei amli; shi ejwɛŋŋ bɔ ni enaagbee baatamɔ. Eshigbeemɔ lɛ yɛ gbeyei, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni shɛjeɔ emii! “Ao! Yehowa, kwɛ bɔ ni minaa amanehulu, ejaakɛ henyɛlɔi eye kunim.”

english_verse: Zion's treasures were stolen. Jerusalem saw foreigners enter her place of worship, though the Lord had forbidden them to belong to his people.
translation_verse: Ehenyɛlɔ ekpã enine mli ewo Yuda nibiiaŋ, ni eloo ejwetri ni jara wa fɛɛ kɛtee. Ena jeŋbii bote Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, mɛi ni ogu amɛ owebii ateŋ futumɔ tete po lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone in the city groans while searching for food; they trade their valuables for barely enough scraps to stay alive. Jerusalem Speaks: Jerusalem shouts to the Lord, “Please look and see how miserable I am!”
translation_verse: Emaŋbii lɛ bluublu dɔmɔɔ ŋtsɔi be ni amɛtao niyenii; amɛkɛ amɛjwetri tsakeɔ niyenii, bɔ ni afee ni amɛkagboi; “Ao! Nuŋtsɔ, kwɛmɔ mi ni mihe guɔ egbo.

english_verse: No passerby even cares. Why doesn't someone notice my terrible sufferings? You were fiercely angry, Lord, and you punished me worst of all.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔ biɛ kɛhoɔ, ani jeee nyɛhe sane ko ni lo? Nyɛkwɛa akɛ nyɛaana akɛ awerɛho ko yɛ ni etamɔ miwerɛho ni kã minɔ nɛɛ, awerɛho ni Yehowa ehã eba minɔ yɛ emlifu ni naa wa gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: From heaven you sent a fire that burned in my bones; you set a trap for my feet and made me turn back. All day long you leave me in shock from constant pain.
translation_verse: “Ehã la jɛ ŋwɛi ebote miwui amli; ekɛ yaa lɛɛ shi etsɔ̃ mi tsɔne; ehã mikpale; eshi mi, ni mifee butuu, ni gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ mifee vii.

english_verse: You have tied my sins around my neck, and they weigh so heavily that my strength is gone. You have put me in the power of enemies too strong for me.
translation_verse: “Abua mitɔ̃mɔi lɛ anaa afee apã, ekɛ enine fi amɛ ke, ni ewo efɔ̃ mikuɛ; ehã mihewalɛ gbɔjɔ. Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jie mi ewo mɛi ni minyɛŋ amɛhiɛ madamɔ lɛ adɛŋ.

english_verse: You, Lord, have turned back my warriors and crushed my young heroes. Judah was a woman untouched, but you let her be trampled like grapes in a wine pit.
translation_verse: “Nuŋtsɔ tsɔ̃ɔ mi hii kãkãlɔi ni yɔɔ mimli lɛ akɛ amɛhewalɛ jeee fɛifɛi; ni etsɛ asafo ewo mihe koni amɛbakpãtã miblahii lɛ ahiɛ. Nuŋtsɔ enaanaa Yuda biyoo oblayoo lɛ nɔ tamɔ waintsɔne ŋaa wain.

english_verse: Because of this, I mourn, and tears flood my eyes. No one is here to comfort or to encourage me; we have lost the war— my people are suffering. The Prophet Speaks:
translation_verse: “Enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ mifoɔ, ni yaafonu tsereɔ yɛ mihiŋmɛii amli shwieɔ shi lɛ; ejaakɛ miishɛjelɔ ni aaawo mi ekãa ekoŋŋ lɛ, ekɛ mi teŋ ejɛkɛ. Mibii lɛ efee pasaa ejaakɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ eye amɛnɔ.

english_verse: Zion reaches out her hands, but no one offers comfort. The Lord has turned the neighboring nations against Jacob's descendants. Jerusalem is merely a filthy rag to her neighbors. Jerusalem Speaks:
translation_verse: “Migbɛ mifijiaŋ; shi mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni shɛjeɔ mimii. Yehowa efã akɛ Yakob nanemɛi maji ni bɔle lɛ lɛ atsɔ̃mɔ ehenyɛlɔi. Yerusalɛm etsɔ̃ muji nii yɛ maji nɛɛ ateŋ.

english_verse: The Lord was right, but I refused to obey him. Now I ask all of you to look at my sufferings— even my young people have been dragged away.
translation_verse: “Yehowa sane ja, ejaakɛ miyeee ewiemɔ nɔ. Nyɛ majimaji fɛɛ, nyɛboa mi toi, ni nyɛkwɛa nɔnaa mli ni miyɔɔ. Miblahii kɛ miblayei lɛ, aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee.

english_verse: I called out to my lovers, but they betrayed me. My priests and my leaders died while searching the city for scraps of food.
translation_verse: “Mitsɛ misuɔlɔi lɛ shi amɛlaka mi. Misɔfoi lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ ahiɛ kpãtã yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, be ni amɛtaoɔ niyenii amɛye koni amɛkagboi lɛ.

english_verse: Won't you look and see how upset I am, our Lord? My stomach is in knots, and my heart is broken because I betrayed you. In the streets and at home, my people are slaughtered.
translation_verse: “Ao! Yehowa, kwɛmɔ mi, ejaakɛ miyɛ hejaramɔ mli; misusuma miina nɔ, ni mitsui miitse yɛ mimli ejaakɛ mitse ohiɛ atua fe nine. Klante miikpãtã mɛi ahiɛ yɛ blohuŋ, ni shĩa teŋ hu, gbele miimɛ.

english_verse: Everyone heard my groaning, but no one offered comfort. My enemies know of the trouble that you have brought on me, and it makes them glad. Hurry and punish them, as you have promised.
translation_verse: “Bo bɔ ni mikɛ̃mɔɔ toi ni mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni shejeɔ mimii. Mihenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ enu mimanehulu lɛ he, ni amɛmiinya akɛ bo odɛ̃ŋ ejɛ. Hã gbi ni owo ehe shi lɛ aba, koni amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ mi.

english_verse: Don't let their evil deeds escape your sight. Punish them as much as you have punished me because of my sins. I never stop groaning— I've lost all hope!
translation_verse: “Kwɛmɔ nifɔɔjianii fɛɛ ni amɛfee lɛ koni okɛ amɛ aye tamɔ bɔ ni okɛ mi ye yɛ minifɔɔjianii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ. Mikɛ̃ɛmɔ lɛ naa wa, ni mitɔ biti.”

english_verse: The Lord was angry! So he disgraced Zion though it was Israel's pride and his own place of rest. In his anger he threw Zion down from heaven to earth.
translation_verse: Kwɛ bɔ ni Yehowa eŋɔ atatu eha Zion nɔ yɛ emlifu naa. Eshɛ Israel anunyam lɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi efɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Emlifu gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ekaiii Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni ji enajiaŋshi maaŋoo lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord had no mercy! He destroyed the homes of Jacob's descendants. In his anger he tore down every walled city in Judah; he toppled the nation together with its leaders, leaving them in shame.
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ekpãtã Yuda shihilɛhei fɛɛ ahiɛ, ni enaaa mɔbɔ. Ekumɔ Yuda biyoo lɛ mɔji eshwie shi yɛ emlifu naa. Etsi emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ kɛ emli lumɛi etswia shi, ni ewo amɛ hiɛgbele.

english_verse: The Lord was so furiously angry that he wiped out the whole army of Israel by not supporting them when the enemy attacked. He was like a raging fire that swallowed up the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: Efite Israel hewalɛ fɛɛ yɛ mlifu ni naa wa lɛ naa. Wamɔ ni ekɛbawa Israel lɛ ehã eŋmɛɛ Israel, yɛ Israel henyɛlɔi ahiɛ. Ekpãtã nibii fɛɛ ahiɛ yɛ Israel tamɔ la ni miitso grigri.

english_verse: He attacked like an enemy with a bow and arrows, killing our loved ones. He has burned to the ground the homes on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Egbala egãi tamɔ henyɛlɔ feɔ; ekɛ eninejurɔ eta gãi lɛ tamɔ henyɛlɔi, ni egbe mɛi fɛɛ ni ji wɔshwãanii. Ejie emlifu kpo etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm shĩai lɛ amli tamɔ la.

english_verse: The Lord was like an enemy! He left Israel in ruins with its palaces and fortresses destroyed, and with everyone in Judah moaning and weeping.
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ tamɔ henyɛlɔ, ni ekpãtã Israel hiɛ. Efite emaŋtsɛ wei lɛ fɛɛ, ni ekpãtã emɔji ni wa lɛ ahiɛ; efee amɛ koikoi, ni ehã ŋkɔmɔyeli kɛ yaafo efa yɛ Yuda.

english_verse: He shattered his temple like a hut in a garden; he completely wiped out his meeting place, and did away with festivals and Sabbaths in the city of Zion. In his fierce anger he rejected our king and priests.
translation_verse: Ekumɔ ejamɔhe lɛ eshwie shi tamɔ trom mli asese. Ekpãtã he ni ayeɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbiijuji ni eto yɛ lɛ hiɛ. Yehowa efo gbii juji kɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbii asɛɛ yɛ Zion, ni ekwa maŋtsɛ kɛ osɔfo fɛɛ yɛ mlifu ni naa wa lɛ naa.

english_verse: The Lord abandoned his altar and his temple; he let Zion's enemies capture her fortresses. Noisy shouts were heard from the temple, as if it were a time of celebration.
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nyaŋe afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ; ni ekwa Ehe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni eŋɔ ehe mɔji fɛɛfɛji lɛ ehã henyɛlɔ lɛ. Abolɔ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ mli tamɔ abolɔɔ yɛ gbijurɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord had decided to tear down the walls of Zion stone by stone. So he started destroying and did not stop until walls and fortresses mourned and trembled.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ etswa efai shi akɛ ebaakpãtã Zion maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ hiɛ. Eŋmɔ kpãa ekɛsusu gbogbo lɛ, eŋmɛko efitemɔ he kwraa. Ehã kpoku kɛ gbogbo fɛɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ; amɛjwere shi butuu.

english_verse: Zion's gates have fallen facedown on the ground; the bars that locked the gates are smashed to pieces. Her king and royal family are prisoners in foreign lands. Her priests don't teach, and her prophets don't have a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Zion agboi lɛ enyɔ kɛbote su mli, akumɔ ni afite amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ. Emaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ elumɛi lɛ eyaje jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ. Mla lɛ bɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, egbalɔi lɛ enaaa Yehowa dɛŋ ninaa ko dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Zion's leaders are silent. They just sit on the ground, tossing dirt on their heads and wearing sackcloth. Her young women can do nothing but stare at the ground.
translation_verse: Zion maŋ onukpai lɛ shwata shikpɔŋ, ni amɛfee diŋŋ. Amɛloo mlu amɛwo amɛyiteiaŋ, ni amɛbumɔ kpekpe. Yerusalɛm oblayei lɛ emamɔ amɛhiɛ shi.

english_verse: My eyes are red from crying, my stomach is in knots, and I feel sick all over. My people are being wiped out, and children lie helpless in the streets of the city.
translation_verse: Mihiŋmɛiŋ nu etã kɛ yaafo, ni misusuma miifo emli. Mitsui ekumɔ kɛ ŋkɔmɔ, ejaakɛ akpãtã mimaŋbii ahiɛ; ejaakɛ gbekɛbii kɛ abifabii etɔ biti yɛ maŋ lɛ blohui amli.

english_verse: A child begs its mother for food and drink, then blacks out like a wounded soldier lying in the street. The child slowly dies in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: Amɛmiifo amɛmiitsɛ amɛnyɛmɛi akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ aboloo kɛ wain yɔɔ?” Be mli ni amɛtɔtɔɔ biti, tamɔ pilafoi yɛ maŋ lɛ blohui amli, ni amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ amɛnyɛmɛi lɛ akpɔkɔiaŋ lɛ?

english_verse: Zion, how can I comfort you? How great is your pain? Lovely city of Jerusalem, how can I heal your wounds, gaping as wide as the sea?
translation_verse: Ao! Yerusalɛm biyoo, mɛni makɛɛ yɛ ohe, ni mɛni he mikɛ bo baato? Ao! Zion biyoo, oblayoo foro, mɛni he mikɛ bo aaato bɔ ni afee ni manyɛ omii mashɛje? Ejaakɛ ohiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ falɛ lɛɛ tamɔ ŋshɔ dalɛ, ni namɔ po aaanyɛ bo atsa?

english_verse: Your prophets deceived you with false visions and lying messages— they should have warned you to leave your sins and be saved from disaster.
translation_verse: Ninai ni ogbalɔi lɛ egba bo lɛ, apasa kɛ shishiumɔ sɔŋŋ ni; amɛkpako onifɔɔjianii lɛ ahe mama koni no ahã oje nomŋɔɔ mli; shi moŋ amale kɛ lakamɔ ninai sɔŋŋ amɛna.

english_verse: Those who pass by shake their heads and sneer as they make fun and shout, “What a lovely city you were, the happiest on earth, but look at you now!”
translation_verse: Mɛi fɛɛ ni hoɔ tswaa amɛdɛŋ amɛshwieɔ onɔ; amɛboɔ Yerusalɛm biyoo lɛ “tsiaa”. Amɛbiɔ akɛ, “Maŋ lɛ ni akɛɔ akɛ ehe yɛ fɛo lɛ nɛ, jeŋ fɛɛ nyamnii lɛ nɛ?”

english_verse: Zion, your enemies curse you and snarl like wild animals, while shouting, “This is the day we've waited for! At last, we've got you!”
translation_verse: Ohenyɛlɔi fɛɛ ŋmɔɔ bo, ni amɛboɔ bo ‘tsiaa!’ Amɛkpeɔ amɛnyanyɔji ashishi, ni amɛbolɔɔ akɛ, “Wɔkpãtã ehiɛ pɛ! Yiɛ! Gbi lɛ ni wɔshwe aahu lɛ nɛ; eshɛ wɔdɛŋ, ni wɔna hu!”

english_verse: The Lord has done everything that he had planned and threatened long ago. He destroyed you without mercy and let your enemies boast about their powerful forces.
translation_verse: Yehowa etsu eyiŋtoo lɛ he nii; nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ efee tamɔ bɔ ni eto jeeŋmɔ ko lɛ. Ekpãtã nibii ahiɛ ni mɔbɔnalɛ bɛ mli; ehã henyɛlɔ lɛ eye bo yɔɔ. Ni ehã ohenyɛlɔi lɛ ena onɔ hewalɛ.

english_verse: Zion, deep in your heart you cried out to the Lord. Now let your tears overflow your walls day and night. Don't ever lose hope or let your tears stop.
translation_verse: Ao! Yerusalɛm biyoo blɔmɔ waa otsɛ Yehowa! Hã yaafonu aho yɛ ohiŋmɛiŋ tamɔ faa, shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ fɛɛ. Kaajɔɔ ohe; kaafɔ̃ɔ yaafo!

english_verse: Get up and pray for help all through the night. Pour out your feelings to the Lord, as you would pour water out of a jug. Beg him to save your people, who are starving to death at every street crossing. Jerusalem Speaks:
translation_verse: Tee shi koni obo yaafo nyɔɔŋ be fɛɛ be ni bulɔi jeɔ buu shishi. Fɔsemɔ otsuiŋ fɛɛ oshwie Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ, tamɔ afɔseɔ nu ashwieɔ shikpɔŋ. Holemɔ oniji anɔ otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ obii bibii ni hɔmɔ ehã amɛtɔ biti yɛ blohu fɛɛ blohu koŋ lɛ awala hewɔ.

english_verse: Think about it, Lord! Have you ever been this cruel to anyone before? Is it right for mothers to eat their children, or for priests and prophets to be killed in your temple?
translation_verse: Ao! Yehowa, kwɛmɔ koni oyoo mɔ ni ofee lɛ nɛkɛ nɛɛ lɛ. Aso ehi akɛ yeifɔyei aye amɛmusuŋbii ni ahiɛ amɛ yɛ fufɔ naa lɛ? Aso ehi akɛ agbe osɔfo kɛ gbalɔ fɛɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli lo?

english_verse: My people, both young and old, lie dead in the streets. Because you were angry, my young men and women were brutally slaughtered.
translation_verse: Gbekɛbii kɛ onukpai fɛɛ jwere mlu mli yɛ blohuiaŋ; miblayei kɛ miblahii lɛ enyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa. Oye awui yɛ omlifu gbi lɛ nɔ; ogbe amɛ ni mɔbɔnalɛ bɛ mli.

english_verse: When you were angry, Lord, you invited my enemies like guests for a party. No one survived that day; enemies killed my children, my own little ones.
translation_verse: Okpee henyɛlɔi ni misheɔ lɛ tamɔ akpeɔ mɛi kɛyaa gbijurɔyeli okɛbabɔle mi kpula; ni omlifu gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɔ ko ejeee mli, ni hiɛkãalɔ ko hu eshwɛɛɛ. Henyɛlɔ lɛ plene mɛi ni milɛ misumɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I have suffered much because God was angry.
translation_verse: Mi ji gbɔmɔ ni mina amanehulu yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu lɛ naa.

english_verse: He chased me into a dark place, where no light could enter.
translation_verse: Ekpala mi, ni ekɛ mi ba duŋ ni la ko kwraa bɛ mli lɛ mli.

english_verse: I am the only one he punishes over and over again, without ever stopping.
translation_verse: Anɔkwa, be fɛɛ be nɛɛ lɛ, mi pɛ minɔ ewoɔ enine nɔ yɛ daa.

english_verse: God caused my skin and flesh to waste away, and he crushed my bones.
translation_verse: Ehã miheloo diɛŋtsɛ etã yɛ migbɔmɔtso he, ni ekumɔ miwui yɛ mimli

english_verse: He attacked and surrounded me with hardships and trouble;
translation_verse: Ehã saji kɛ joomɔ kɛ nɔnaa ebɔle mi kpula kɛsa miyi.

english_verse: he forced me to sit in the dark like someone long dead.
translation_verse: Ehã mihi duŋ mli tamɔ mɛi ni egboi jeeŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: God built a fence around me that I cannot climb over, and he chained me down.
translation_verse: Etswa gbogbo ekɛsa miyi bɔ ni minyɛŋ foi maje; ekɛ gboklɛi ni tsii ewo mi.

english_verse: Even when I shouted and prayed for help, he refused to listen.
translation_verse: Tsɛbelɛ mibo mitsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ koni ebawa mi, shi ebooo mifaikpamɔ lɛ toi.

english_verse: God put big rocks in my way and made me follow a crooked path.
translation_verse: Ekɛ tɛi ni ako eshwie migbɛ nɔ; ehã migbɛ ekɔdɔ̃; tsɔ̃mɔhe bɛ.

english_verse: God was like a bear or a lion waiting in ambush for me;
translation_verse: Etamɔ oshishibrishi ni ewo ka, loo jata ni etee ehe.

english_verse: he dragged me from the road, then tore me to shreds.
translation_verse: Ekpala mi kɛje migbɛ nɔ, ni etserɛ mimli dukuduku, ni efee mi pasaa.

english_verse: God took careful aim and shot his arrows
translation_verse: Eta egãi lɛ ema minɔ ni ebaatsɛ̃ mi.

english_verse: I am a joke to everyone— no one ever stops making fun of me.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ̃ hefɛoyeli nɔ mihã mɛi fɛɛ, kɛ amɛdaaŋ lala gbi muu fɛɛ.

english_verse: God has turned my life sour.
translation_verse: Ehã miyi obɔ̃ kɛ joomɔ; ehã jeŋshihilɛ ejoo ewo mi tamɔ taatso.

english_verse: He made me eat gravel and rubbed me in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ehã mikpe ŋmlitsa; ehã mikoklo shi yɛ lamlu mli.

english_verse: I cannot find peace or remember happiness.
translation_verse: Mileee nɔ ni toiŋjɔlɛ ji lɛ, mihiɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekpa nɔ ni ji miishɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: I tell myself, “I am finished! I can't count on the Lord to do anything for me.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ akɛ, minunyam etã, ni mibɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ko dɔŋŋ yɛ Yehowa dɛŋ.

english_verse: Just thinking of my troubles and my lonely wandering makes me miserable.
translation_verse: Kaimɔ minɔnaa kɛ mishitwiamɔ ni joɔ tamɔ taatso kɛ kɔlikɔ lɛ.

english_verse: That's all I ever think about, and I am depressed.
translation_verse: Misusuma jwɛŋɔ he daa nɛɛ, ni ehã misusuma edɔ kɔmɔɔ kɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli yɛ mimli.

english_verse: Then I remember something that fills me with hope.
translation_verse: Shi miyɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ kɛ̃ kɛ mikai akɛ.

english_verse: The Lord's kindness never fails! If he had not been merciful, we would have been destroyed.
translation_verse: Yehowa suɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ sɛɛ efooo kɔkɔɔkɔ, ni emɔbɔnalɛ bɛ naagbee.

english_verse: The Lord can always be trusted to show mercy each morning.
translation_verse: Daa leebi lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nɔ hee; Yehowa anɔkwayeli da kpele.

english_verse: Deep in my heart I say, “The Lord is all I need; I can depend on him!”
translation_verse: Misusuma kɛɔ akɛ, “Migbɛfaŋnɔ ji Yehowa ni no hewɔ lɛ, mihiɛ baakã enɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord is kind to everyone who trusts and obeys him.
translation_verse: Yehowa mli hi hã mɛi fɛɛ ni kwɛɔ lɛ gbɛ, kɛ mɔ ni taoɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ hu.

english_verse: It is good to wait patiently for the Lord to save us.
translation_verse: Ehi akɛ atoɔ tsui shi kpoo amɛɔ Yehowa yiwalaheremɔ lɛ.

english_verse: When we are young, it is good to struggle hard
translation_verse: Ehi hã gbɔmɔ akɛ etereɔ ekɔŋtso lɛ yɛ eblahiiaŋ.

english_verse: and to sit silently alone, if this is what the Lord intends.
translation_verse: Kɛji awo kɔŋtso lɛ atere lɛ, ekome eta shi, ni efee dioo.

english_verse: Being rubbed in the dirt can teach us a lesson;
translation_verse: Eba ehe shi kpoo, ejaakɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ kɛ̃ aaahi shi.

english_verse: we can also learn from insults and hard knocks.
translation_verse: Agbala etoiiaŋ ma, ni abɔ lɛ ahora kpɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord won't always reject us!
translation_verse: Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ shɛɛɛ mɔ efɔ̃ɔɔ kɛyaaa naanɔ;

english_verse: He causes a lot of suffering, but he also has pity because of his great love.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ ehãa mɔ he jaraa lɛ moŋ, kɛ̃lɛ emusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't enjoy sending grief or pain.
translation_verse: Jeee esuɔmɔnaa ji akɛ ehã gbɔmɔ he ajara lɛ, asaŋ akɛ efee gbɔmɔ nidɔɔnii.

english_verse: or cheat anyone out of what is rightfully theirs. God Most High sees everything,
translation_verse: Ele kɛji aye mɔ ko toikɔdɔmɔ sane;

english_verse: and he knows when you refuse to give someone a fair trial.
translation_verse: Kɛji atsɔ̃ mɔ ko sane hiɛ abu shi lɛ. Nuŋtsɔ lɛ le.

english_verse: No one can do anything without the Lord's approval.
translation_verse: Namɔ efã ni eba mli pɛŋ akɛ ja Nuŋtsɔ lɛ eŋmɛ gbɛ dã?

english_verse: Good and bad each happen at the command of God Most High.
translation_verse: Ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋ fɛɛ lɛ, jeee Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ daaŋ ejeɔ?

english_verse: We're still alive! We shouldn't complain when we are being punished for our sins.
translation_verse: Mɛni hewɔ gbɔmɔ gbigbliɔ emli kɛji agbala etoi yɛ ehe eshai ahewɔ lɛ?

english_verse: Instead, we should think about the way we are living, and turn back to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛhãa wɔtaoa wɔjeŋba mli wɔkwɛa koni wɔkpale kɛba Yehowa ŋɔɔ.

english_verse: When we lift our hands in prayer to God in heaven, we should offer him our hearts and say,
translation_verse: Nyɛhãa wɔgbelea wɔtsuii amli ni wɔholea wɔniji anɔ wɔhãa Nuŋtsɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ ni wɔkɛhã akɛ,

english_verse: “We've sinned! We've rebelled against you, and you haven't forgiven us!
translation_verse: “Wɔtɔ̃, ni wɔtse atua, ni, Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛfako wɔ.

english_verse: Anger is written all over you, as you pursue and slaughter us without showing pity.
translation_verse: “Okɛ mlifu ha ohe, ni onyiɛ wɔsɛɛ, ni ogbe wɔ ni mɔbɔnalɛ bɛ mli.

english_verse: You are behind a wall of clouds that blocks out our prayers.
translation_verse: Okɛ mlifu ha ohe, koni faikpamɔ ko akanyɛ egbu kɛtsɔ̃ mli kɛbashɛ oŋɔɔ.

english_verse: You allowed nations to treat us like garbage;
translation_verse: Ohã wɔtsɔ̃ kponɔ muji kɛ tumo yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ.

english_verse: our enemies curse us.
translation_verse: “Wɔhenyɛlɔi fɛɛ miibɔ wɔ ahora; ni amɛmiijɛ wɔ.

english_verse: We are terrified and trapped, caught and crushed.”
translation_verse: Wɔyoyoro, wɔtsɔ̃mɔ osharãi amli wɔtswia shi, ni wɔnibii ahiɛ ekpãtã kɛho.

english_verse: My people are destroyed! Tears flood my eyes,
translation_verse: “Mihiŋmɛi miifɔse yaafonu tamɔ faa yɛ mimaŋbii ahiɛ ni ekpãtã lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: and they won't stop
translation_verse: “Mihiŋmɛiŋ yaafonu baaho daa, ni efɔŋ

english_verse: until the Lord looks down from heaven and helps.
translation_verse: kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Yehowa aaajɛ ŋwɛi ema ehiɛ shi ekwɛ wɔ.

english_verse: I am horrified when I see what enemies have done to the young women of our city.
translation_verse: Miyeɔ hejaramɔ kɛji mina sane ni eye mimaŋ oblayei lɛ.

english_verse: No one had reason to hate me, but I was hunted down like a bird.
translation_verse: “Mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi yakatswaa lɛ gbɔbi mi, tamɔ agbɔbiɔ loofɔlɔ.

english_verse: Then they tried to kill me by tossing me into a pit and throwing stones at me.
translation_verse: Amɛshɛ mi, hiɛkãalɔ, amɛfɔ̃ bu mli ni amɛkɛ tɛi shwie minɔ!

english_verse: Water covered my head— I thought I was gone.
translation_verse: Nu su miyi, ni mikɛɛ akɛ, ‘milaaje’.

english_verse: From the bottom of the pit, I prayed to you, Lord.
translation_verse: “Ao! Yehowa, mijɛ bu lɛ shishi tɔ̃ɔ mibo mitsɛ bo,

english_verse: I begged you to listen. “Help!” I shouted. “Save me!” You answered my prayer
translation_verse: ni onu mifaikpamɔ lɛ. ‘Kaakɛɛ akɛ obooo mibolɔmɔ kɛhã yelikɛbuamɔ lɛ toi.’

english_verse: and came when I was in need. You told me, “Don't worry!”
translation_verse: Be ni mitsɛ bo lɛ, otsi obɛŋkɛ, ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Kaashe gbeyei!’

english_verse: You rescued me and saved my life.
translation_verse: “Ao! Yehowa, otsu misane lɛ he nii ohã mi; ohere miyiwala.

english_verse: You saw them abuse me, Lord, so make things right.
translation_verse: Ao! Yehowa, ona sane fɔŋ ni akɛye mi lɛ, ye misane lɛ ohã mi.

english_verse: You know every plot they have made against me.
translation_verse: Ona owele ni amɛtɔ kɛ yiŋshai fɛɛ ni amɛto yɛ mihe lɛ.

english_verse: Yes, you know their insults and their evil plans.
translation_verse: “Ao! Yehowa, onu ahora ni amɛbɔɔ mi lɛ, kɛ yiŋshai fɛɛ ni amɛto yɛ mihe lɛ.

english_verse: All day long they attack with words and whispers.
translation_verse: Gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ anaabu kɛ jwɛŋmɔ fɛɛ jwere minɔ.

english_verse: No matter what they are doing, they keep on mocking me.
translation_verse: Naa, leebileebi jenamɔ fɛɛ lɛ mi ji amɛdaaŋ kotsa.

english_verse: Pay them back for everything they have done, Lord!
translation_verse: “Ao! Yehowa, feemɔ amɛ otse, yɛ amɛnifeemɔ nii lɛ anaa.

english_verse: Put your curse on them and make them suffer.
translation_verse: Kaahã amɛmii shɛ amɛhe; oloomɔ akã amɛnɔ.

english_verse: Get angry and go after them until not a trace is left under the heavens.
translation_verse: Ao! Yehowa, okɛ mlifu atiu amɛ, ni okpãtã amɛhiɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: The purest gold is ruined and has lost its shine; jewels from the temple lie scattered in the streets.
translation_verse: Kwɛ bɔ ni shika edĩ tuŋŋ; bɔ ni shika ŋmiiŋmi etsake ehã! Agbɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ tɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ashwã gbɛjegbɛ fɛɛ gbɛjegbɛ koŋ.

english_verse: These are Zion's people, worth more than purest gold; yet they are counted worthless like dishes of clay.
translation_verse: Zion, oblahii ni ajara wa tamɔ shika ŋmiiŋmi lɛ, kwɛ bɔ ni amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ ninenaa nitsumɔ.

english_verse: Even jackals nurse their young, but my people are like ostriches that abandon their own.
translation_verse: Ŋaŋgbei tete hãa amɛbii fufɔ amɛkɛlɛɔ amɛ; shi mimaŋbii lɛ ayitsoŋ wa; amɛwaa amɛbii ayi, amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ shiaŋa nɔ okpɔŋɔloofɔlɔ̃.

english_verse: Babies are so thirsty that their tongues are stuck to the roof of the mouth. Children go begging for food, but no one gives them any.
translation_verse: Gbekɛ fufɔoo sɛŋ gbiɔ kɛ kumai; gbekɛbii baa niyenii, shi mɔ ko mɔ ko hãaa amɛ.

english_verse: All who ate expensive foods lie starving in the streets; those who grew up in luxury now sit on trash heaps.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni ye amɛnaa nii lɛ, ahiɛ ekpãtã yɛ blohuiaŋ; mɛi ni alɛ amɛ fɔfɔɔle lɛ jwere tumo nɔ lamlu mli.

english_verse: My nation was punished worse than the people of Sodom, whose city was destroyed in a flash without the help of human hands.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mimaŋbii ahe esha lɛ da fe Sodom he esha lɛ, Sodom ni abutu lɛ hiŋmɛitswaa mli ni gbɔmɔ adesa nine bɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: The leaders of Jerusalem were purer than snow and whiter than milk; their bodies were healthy and glowed like jewels.
translation_verse: Ebladei lɛ ahe tse keŋkeŋ, amɛyɛɔ fe ayilɔ, amɛgbɔmɔtsei yɛ hewalɛ fe teŋɛ̃lɛo, amɛhe fɛo tamɔ safiro.

english_verse: Now they are blacker than tar, and no one recognizes them; their skin clings to their bones and is drier than firewood.
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ amɛhiɛiaŋ miidi fe ŋai, ni ayooo amɛ yɛ blohuiaŋ; amɛheloo egbi ekpɛtɛ amɛwui ahe, heloo lɛ egbi keketee tamɔ tso.

english_verse: Life in the city is so bad that loving mothers have boiled and eaten their own children.
translation_verse: Be ni akpãtãa mimaŋbii ahiɛ lɛ, yeifɔyei ni yɔɔ musuŋtsɔlɛ tete hoo amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmusuŋbii amɛye.

english_verse: The Lord was so fiercely angry that he burned the city of Zion to the ground.
translation_verse: Yehowa gri kɛ mlila ni naa wa ni efã emlifu lɛ kɛ eshishi fɛɛ eshwie Zion nɔ; ni eshã maŋ lɛ kɛmɔ eshishitoo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ.

english_verse: Not a king on this earth or the people of any nation believed enemies could break through her gates.
translation_verse: Je lɛ mli maŋtsɛmɛi heee yeee, ni gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ jeŋ hu heee yeee, akɛ henyɛlɔ ko aaanyɛ Yerusalɛm agboi amli ebote.

english_verse: Jerusalem was punished because her prophets and her priests had sinned and caused the death of innocent victims.
translation_verse: Shi eba mli, ejaakɛ Yerusalɛm gbalɔi lɛ fee esha, ni esɔfoi lɛ fee nɔ fɔŋ; amɛshwie jalɔi ala shi yɛ maŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: Yes, her prophets and priests were covered with blood; no one would come near them, as they wandered from street to street.
translation_verse: Amɛfo shi kɛnyiɛ blohui lɛ amli tamɔ shwilafoi. Lá ewu amɛhe kpɔtɔɔ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni mɔ ko kwraa nyɛɛɛ amɛtadei ahe eta.

english_verse: Instead, everyone shouted, “Go away! Don't touch us! You're filthy and unfit to belong to God's people!” So they had to leave and become refugees. But foreign nations told them, “You can't stay here!”
translation_verse: Mɛi bolɔɔ woɔ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛjea jɛi! Nyɛmɛi ni he tseee! Nyɛjea jɛi! Nyɛjea jɛi! Nyɛkataa nɔ ko he!” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃mɔ kobɔfoi, ni majimajianɔbii kɛɛkɛɛ yɛ amɛteiaŋ akɛ, “Amɛkahi wɔteŋ dɔŋŋ!”

english_verse: The Lord is the one who sent them scattering, and he has forgotten them. No respect or kindness will be shown to the priests or leaders.
translation_verse: Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ egbɛ amɛ eshwã, ni ebuuu amɛhe akɔntaa dɔŋŋ; ebuuu osɔfoi lɛ dɔŋŋ, ni ehiɛ esɔɔɔ onukpai lɛ hu dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Our eyes became weary, hopelessly looking for help from a nation that could not save us.
translation_verse: Wɔhiŋmɛi shiu kɛ yaka yelikɛbuamɔ gbɛ ni wɔkwɛɔ lɛ; wɔbu, ni wɔkwɛ jaku ko ni nyɛɛɛ wɔ ehere gbɛ.

english_verse: Enemies hunted us down on every public street. Our time was up; our doom was near.
translation_verse: Henyɛlɔi wɔɔ wɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, wɔnyɛɛɛ wɔblohuiaŋ tete wɔnyiɛ. Wɔnaagbee lɛ eshɛ, gbii lɛ etã; ejaakɛ wɔnaagbee lɛ eshɛ.

english_verse: They swooped down faster than eagles from the sky. They hunted for us in the hills and set traps to catch us out in the desert.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni nyiɛ wɔsɛɛ lɛ ahe yɛ oya fe okropɔŋ; amɛnyiɛ wɔsɛɛ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni amɛwo wɔ ka yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord's chosen leader was our hope for survival! We thought he would keep us safe somewhere among the nations, but even he was caught in one of their traps.
translation_verse: Mɔ dɛŋ ni wɔwala yɔɔ, ni ji maŋtsɛ ni Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu lɛ; amɛtsɔ̃ lɛ, ni amɛmɔ lɛ ŋaa mli. Lɛ ji mɔ ni wɔkɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, “Yɛ lɛ eshishi lɛ, wɔɔhi shi shweshweeshwe yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ” lɛ.

english_verse: You people of Edom can celebrate now! But your time will come to suffer and stagger around naked.
translation_verse: Edombii kɛ Uzbii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, nyɛmli afilia nyɛ, ni nyɛnyaa, shi moŋ nyɛ hu amanehulu miiba. Nyɛaatɔ dãa, ni nyɛaajie nyɛyayaiaŋ nyɛfɔ̃ shi.

english_verse: The people of Zion have paid for their sins, and the Lord will soon let them return home. But, people of Edom, you will be punished, and your sins exposed.
translation_verse: Ao! Zion, agbe otoigbalamɔ yɛ onishaianii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ naa. Nuŋtsɔ lɛ haŋ ohi nomŋɔɔ mli dɔŋŋ; shi moŋ bo Edom, ebaagbala otoi yɛ onishaianii lɛ ahewɔ; ebaahã ohe eshai lɛ abakã kpo nɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget how we have suffered and been disgraced.
translation_verse: Ao! Yehowa, kaimɔ nɔ ni eba wɔnɔ lɛ; kwɛmɔ bɔ ni wɔhiɛ eshwie shi!

english_verse: Foreigners and strangers have taken our land and our homes.
translation_verse: Wɔgboshinii etsɔ̃ gbɔi anɔ, ni wɔshĩai eyaje gbɔi adɛŋ nɛɛ.

english_verse: We are like children whose mothers are widows.
translation_verse: Wɔtsɔ̃mɔ awusãi, wɔbɛ tsɛmɛi, ni wɔnyɛmɛi etsɔ̃mɔ okulafoi.

english_verse: The water we drink and the wood we burn cost far too much.
translation_verse: Nu ni wɔnuɔ lɛ, wɔkɛ shika heɔ, ni lai hu ni wɔshãa lɛ, ja wɔhe.

english_verse: We are terribly mistreated; we are worn out and can find no rest.
translation_verse: Ataa wɔkuɛ nɔ kɛ nitsumɔ, ni etɔ wɔ, shi ahãaa wɔ mumɔhe.

english_verse: We had to surrender to Egypt and Assyria because we were hungry.
translation_verse: Daaŋŋmãa hewɔ lɛ, wɔkɛ wɔhe hã Ijipt kɛ Asiria.

english_verse: Our ancestors sinned, but they are dead, and we are left to pay for their sins.
translation_verse: Wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ fee esha, ni amɛho amɛtee; ni wɔ moŋ amɛsɔ̃ ebatere wɔ.

english_verse: Slaves are now our rulers, and there is no one to set us free.
translation_verse: Wɔnyɔji miiye wɔnɔ, ni mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni kpɔ̃ɔ wɔ yɛ amɛdɛŋ.

english_verse: We are in danger from brutal desert tribes; we must risk our lives just to bring in our crops.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔgbelɔi hiɛ klante yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, wɔkɛ wɔwala shwɛɔ asɔ dani wɔnaa nii wɔyeɔ.

english_verse: Our skin is scorched from fever and hunger.
translation_verse: Hɔmɔ ni yeɔ wɔ lɛ naawalɛ ehã wɔhe edɔ tamɔ flɔnɔɔ mli.

english_verse: On Zion and everywhere in Judah our wives and daughters are being raped.
translation_verse: Ato yei lɛ kabonaa yɛ Zion, ni Yuda oblayei froi lɛ hu ato amɛ kabonaa.

english_verse: Our rulers are strung up by their arms, and our nation's advisors are treated shamefully.
translation_verse: Amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsɛŋɔ maŋ lumɛi lɛ, ni amɛhiɛ eshwieee onukpai ahiɛiaŋ.

english_verse: Young men are forced to do the work of slaves; boys must carry heavy loads of wood.
translation_verse: Anyɛɔ oblahii anɔ ni amɛwiɛɔ yɛ wiɛ sɛɛ tamɔ nyɔji; ni gbekɛbii hii didãa yɛ lai kei ni amɛtereteree ashishi.

english_verse: Our leaders are not allowed to decide cases in court, and young people no longer play music.
translation_verse: Hiimeji ekpa koishi yaa, ni oblahii hu ekpa amɛsaŋkutswaa.

english_verse: Our hearts are sad; instead of dancing, we mourn.
translation_verse: Wɔtsuiiaŋ miishɛɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ efo, ni joo ni wɔjoɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ ŋkɔmɔyeli.

english_verse: Zion's glory has disappeared! And we are doomed because of our sins.
translation_verse: Wɔnunyam akekre eje wɔyitso egbee shi. Kpoo hã wɔ! Ejaakɛ wɔfee esha.

english_verse: We feel sick all over and can't even see straight;
translation_verse: Wɔtsui ekumɔ, ni enɛ hewɔ lɛ wɔhiŋmɛii anɔ efee tuutuu.

english_verse: our city is in ruins, overrun by wild dogs.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ kã shi amaŋfɔ̃. Jɛi etsɔ̃ ŋaŋgbei ashikpaahe.

english_verse: You will rule forever, Lord! You are King for all time.
translation_verse: Shi Ao! Yehowa, bo lɛ bo ji maŋtsɛ kɛyaa naanɔ; omaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i yɛ kɛjɛ yinɔ kɛyaa yinɔi fɛɛ.

english_verse: Bring us back to you! Give us a fresh start.
translation_verse: Ao! Yehowa, kpalemɔ wɔ kɛba oŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, ni wɔɔkpale lɛɛlɛŋ. Daimɔ wɔblema shihilɛ lɛ ohã wɔ!

english_verse: Or do you despise us so much that you don't want us?
translation_verse: Aloo okwa wɔ kwrakwra? Ani omli efu wɔ waa fe nine?

english_verse: I saw a windstorm blowing in from the north. Lightning flashed from a huge cloud and lit up the whole sky with a dazzling brightness. The fiery center of the cloud was as shiny as polished metal,
translation_verse: Be ni mikwɛɔ lɛ, naa, ahum ko ni naa wa fã kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ; ehewɔ fɛɛ miikpɛlɛ, ni la miikpɛlɛ nyramnyram kɛmiijɛ mli, nɔ ko tamɔ akɔɔble ni miitso yɛ la lɛ mli.

english_verse: and in that center I saw what looked like four living creatures. They were somewhat like humans,
translation_verse: Ni mina nibii ejwɛ komɛi yɛ ahum lɛ mli, amɛhiɛ gbɔmɔ su.

english_verse: except that each one had four faces and four wings.
translation_verse: Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ hiɛi ejwɛjwɛɛjwɛ, kɛ fiji hu ejwɛjwɛɛjwɛ.

english_verse: Their legs were straight, but their feet looked like the hoofs of calves and sparkled like bronze.
translation_verse: Amɛniji ja trɔmɔɔ, amɛnanetokotai tamɔ tsina koklotoi; ni amɛhe kpɛlɛɔ kaŋkaŋ tamɔ akɔɔble ni asha he.

english_verse: Under each of their wings, these creatures had a human hand.
translation_verse: Amɛyɛ gbɔmɔ niji yɛ amɛfiji ashishi yɛ amɛŋmawuiaŋ ejwɛ lɛ; ni amɛyi ejwɛ lɛ, bɔ ni amɛhiɛiaŋ kɛ amɛfiji lɛ yɔɔ nɛ:

english_verse: The four creatures were standing back to back with the tips of their wings touching. They moved together in every direction, without turning their bodies.
translation_verse: Amɛfiji lɛ eko kɛ eko kpeɔ; kɛ amɛmiinyiɛ lɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yaa ehiɛ tɛ̃ɛ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ ehe.

english_verse: Each creature had the face of a human in front, the face of a lion on the right side, the face of a bull on the left, and the face of an eagle in back.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni amɛhiɛi yɔɔ nɛ: amɛyi ejwɛ lɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ yɛ ehiɛgbɛ; eninejurɔ hiɛ lɛ, jata hiɛ ni; ni ebɛku hiɛ lɛ, tsina hiɛ; ni esɛɛ hiɛ lɛ, okropɔŋ hiɛ.

english_verse: Two wings of each creature were spread out and touched the wings of the creatures on either side. The other two wings of each creature were folded against its body.
translation_verse: Amɛgbɛ amɛfiji amli kɛtee ŋwɛigbɛ. Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ fiji enyɔ, ni fiji lɛ, eko fɛɛ eko saa enaanyo nɔ he; ni amɛyɛ fiji enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ hu; ni nomɛi lɛ amɛkɛ hahaa amɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ ahe.

english_verse: The four living creatures went wherever the Spirit led them, and they moved together without turning their bodies, because each creature faced straight ahead.
translation_verse: Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛi srɔtoi ejwɛ lɛ kwɛɔ hei srɔtoi ejwɛ shi kome; no hewɔ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛyaa amɛhiɛ tɛ̃ɛ shi kome; ni he fɛɛ he ni mumɔ lɛ yaa lɛ, jɛi amɛyaa; ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ ehe.

english_verse: The creatures were glowing like hot coals, and I saw something like a flaming torch moving back and forth among them. Lightning flashed from the torch every time its flame blazed up.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ nɔ ko ni tamɔ ŋai la ni miitso yɛ nibii nɛɛ ni hiɛ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ ateŋ, tuuŋtu, ni enyiɛ amɛteŋ kɛyaa kɛbaa tamɔ kɔti ni miitso; la lɛ kpɛmɔ naa wa, ni srawa gbalaa kɛjɛɔ la lɛ mli.

english_verse: The creatures themselves moved as quickly as sparks jumping from a fire.
translation_verse: Nibii nɛɛ ni hiɛ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ shaa foi kɛyaa kɛbaa tamɔ srawa.

english_verse: I then noticed that on the ground beside each of the four living creatures was a wheel,
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ be ni mikwɛɔ nibii ni hiɛ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ, mina kokolontoi ejwɛ mamɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ nii lɛ amasɛi, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nɔ ekome.

english_verse: shining like chrysolite. Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it,
translation_verse: Bɔ ni afee kokolontoi lɛ nɛ. Kɛ okwɛ amɛ lɛ, amɛtamɔ ojarawatɛ ni kpɛlɛɔ nyramnyram oookɛɛ ashwishwɛ. Amɛyi ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ henɔ kome. Ni bɔ ni afee amɛ lɛ tamɔ kokolonto ni hɔ kokolonto mli.

english_verse: so that they could move in any direction without turning.
translation_verse: Kɛji amɛmiinyiɛ lɛ amɛnyiɛɔ kɛyaa amɛkoji ejwɛ lɛ ateŋ eko nɔ, bɔ ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ ehe.

english_verse: The rims of the wheels were large and frightening, and they had eyes all the way around them.
translation_verse: Gai yɛ kokolontoi ejwɛ lɛ ahe, asaŋ gai lɛ eyimɔ tɔ kɛ hiŋmɛii ni bɔle amɛhe fɛɛ kɛkpe.

english_verse: The creatures controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the four creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels were beside them.
translation_verse: Kɛji nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ miinyiɛ lɛ, kokolontoi lɛ hu fɛɛ nyiɛɔ; ni kɛji amɛwa lɛ, kokolontoi lɛ hu waa. Shi kɛji amɛhole amɛhe nɔ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, koklolontoi lɛ hu holeɔ amɛhe nɔ kɛjeɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ, nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su lɛ mumɔ lɛ yɛ koklolontoi lɛ hu amli.

english_verse: Above the living creatures, I saw something that was sparkling like ice, and it reminded me of a dome. Each creature had two of its wings stretched out toward the creatures on either side, with the other two wings folded against its body.
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ ekpã amɛfiji amli trɔmɔɔ yɛ nɔ ni ha shi lɛ shishi, fine kɛ fine miikpe, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ fiji enyɔ ni ekɛha egbɔmɔtso he.

english_verse: Whenever the creatures flew, their wings roared like an ocean or a large army or even the voice of God All-Powerful. And whenever the creatures stopped, they folded their wings against their bodies.
translation_verse: Kɛji amɛmiifliki lɛ minuɔ ni amɛfijiaŋ miigbɛɛ tamɔ ŋshɔ gbɛɛmɔ; asaŋ etamɔ ta mli hoofeemɔ jijemɔ lɛ: etamɔ Ofe lɛ diɛŋtsɛ gbee. Kɛ amɛwa amɛdamɔ shi lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛfiji lɛ baa shi.

english_verse: When the creatures stopped flapping their wings, I heard a sound coming from above the dome.
translation_verse: Kɛji amɛwa amɛdamɔ shi, ni amɛba amɛfiji lɛ ashi lɛ, gbee ko gbɛɔ kɛjɛɔ atatu ni yɔɔ amɛyiteŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: I then saw what looked like a throne made of sapphire, and sitting on the throne was a figure in the shape of a human.
translation_verse: Nɔ ko ni tamɔ maŋtsɛ sɛi ni esu tamɔ safiro ojarawatɛ ma nɔ lɛ ni ha shi lɛ yiteŋ. Ni nɔ ko ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su ta nɔ ni tamɔ maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: From the waist up, it was glowing like metal in a hot furnace, and from the waist down it looked like the flames of a fire. The figure was surrounded by a bright light,
translation_verse: Mina akɛ kɛjɛ he ni tamɔ ehɛ lɛ kɛyaa eŋwɛigbɛ lɛ miikpɛlɛ tamɔ akɔɔble; ekpɛlɛmɔ lɛ tamɔ la ni ebɔ tɔo. Mina hu akɛ kɛjɛ nɔ ni tamɔ ehɛ lɛ kɛbaa eshishigbɛ lɛ tamɔ la. Ehewɔ fɛɛ etse haŋŋ.

english_verse: as colorful as a rainbow that appears after a storm. I realized I was seeing the brightness of the Lord's glory! So I bowed with my face to the ground, and just then I heard a voice speaking to me.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni anaa kwaabuɛtɛ su kɛji efo yɛ atatuiaŋ yɛ nunɛmɔ be mli lɛ, nakai ehe ni ekpɛ haŋŋ lɛ yɔɔ. Bɔ ni Yehowa anunyam su yɔɔ nɛ.

english_verse: After he said this, his Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Be ni ekɛ mi wie lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ bote mimli, ni ewo minɔ edamɔ shi, ni minu ni ekɛ mi miiwie. Ekɛɛ mi akɛ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, I am sending you to the people of Israel. They are just like their ancestors who rebelled against me and refused to stop.
translation_verse: “Gbɔmɔ adesa, miitsu bo Israelbii, ni ji maŋ atuatselɔi ni etse mihiɛ atua lɛ, aŋɔɔ. Amɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ etɔ̃ minɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ.

english_verse: They are stubborn and hardheaded. But I, the Lord God, have chosen you to tell them what I say.
translation_verse: Maŋbii lɛ akuɛŋ ti, ni amɛbuuu mi hu. Miitsu bo amɛŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mikɛɛ nɛ;

english_verse: Those rebels may not even listen, but at least they will know that a prophet has come to them.
translation_verse: ni akɛni toigbolɔi ji amɛ nɛɛ, amɛbo toi jio, amɛbooo toi jio, amɛaana amɛle kɛ̃ akɛ gbalɔ ko ebahi amɛteŋ.’

english_verse: Don't be afraid of them or of anything they say. You may think you're in the middle of a thorn patch or a bunch of scorpions. But be brave
translation_verse: ‘Ni bo, gbɔmɔ adesa, kaashe amɛ gbeyei, ni kaashe amɛwiemɔi lɛ hu gbeyei. Eyɛ mli akɛ oyɛ ŋmei kɛ kpitikpitii ateŋ, ni ota nyɔŋmɔŋkrakroi anɔ moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ, kaashe amɛdaaŋ wiemɔi gbeyei ni kaahã hiŋmɛi ni amɛkɛbaakwɛ bo lɛ miihao bo; ejaakɛ atuatselɔi amaŋ ni.

english_verse: and preach my message to them, whether they choose to listen or not.
translation_verse: Bo lɛ ŋɔɔ miwiemɔ lɛ ohã amɛ; amɛbo toi jio, amɛbooo toi jio, na ole akɛ toigbolɔi ji amɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Ezekiel, don't rebel against me, as they have done. Instead, listen to everything I tell you. And now, Ezekiel, open your mouth and eat what I am going to give you.
translation_verse: “Shi, bo gbɔmɔ adesa, bo nɔ ni mikɛɔ bo lɛ toi; kaafee ohe toigbolɔ tamɔ nakai toigbolɔi amaŋbii lɛ; gbɛɛ odaaŋ ni oye nɔ ni mikɛhãa bo nɛɛ.”

english_verse: Just then, I saw a hand stretched out toward me. And in it was a scroll.
translation_verse: Ni be ni mikwɛ lɛ mina nine ni akpã mli ni hiɛ wolokpo ni aŋma nii yɛ mli ni akɛmiihã mi.

english_verse: The hand opened the scroll, and both sides of it were filled with words of sadness, mourning, and grief.
translation_verse: Egbele mli elɛɛ shi yɛ mihiɛ. Aŋma nii yɛ ehiɛ kɛ esɛɛ fɛɛ; ni aŋma yaafo kɛ awerɛho kɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli wiemɔi yɛ mli.

english_verse: He handed me the scroll and said, “Eat this and fill up on it.” So I ate the scroll, and it tasted sweet as honey.
translation_verse: Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ adesa, ye wolokpo ni mikɛhã bo lɛ; ye, ni okɛwo omusu obɔ̃ tɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni miye; ni eŋɔɔ yɛ midaaŋ tamɔ wo.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, I am sending you to your own people.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ adesa, yiŋ ni oya Israelbii lɛ aŋɔɔ ni okɛ miwiemɔ lɛ ayahã amɛ;

english_verse: They are Israelites, not some strangers who speak a foreign language you can't understand. If I were to send you to foreign nations, they would listen to you.
translation_verse: Amɛjeee majimaji babaoo ni wieɔ maŋsɛɛ wiemɔ ni wa, ni onuuu shishi. Anɔkwa, kɛji nakai gbɔmɛi aŋɔɔ tete po mitsu bo lɛ, amɛaabo bo toi.

english_verse: But the people of Israel will refuse to listen, because they have refused to listen to me. All of them are stubborn and hardheaded,
translation_verse: Shi Israel we lɛ boŋ bo toi, ejaakɛ amɛsumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ amɛboɔ mi toi; ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ akuɛŋ ti ni amɛtsui hu wa.

english_verse: so I will make you as stubborn as they are.
translation_verse: Naa, mihã ohiɛ etsii hu fe amɛhiɛ, ni ohiɛ hu ewa fe amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: Listen carefully to everything I say and then think about it.
translation_verse: Gbee lɛ saa ekɛɛ mi ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ adesa, bo miwiemɔi fɛɛ ni mikɛ bo wieɔ lɛ toi, ni okɛto otsuiŋ.

english_verse: Then go to the people who were brought here to Babylonia with you and tell them you have a message from me, the Lord God. Do this, whether they listen to you or not.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ yi mli ni oya omaŋbii ni yɔɔ nomŋɔɔ mli lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni oyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ. Amɛbo bo toi jio, amɛbooo bo toi jio bo lɛ okɛɛ amɛ.’ ”

english_verse: The Spirit lifted me up, and as the glory of the Lord started to leave, I heard a loud, thundering noise behind me.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ wo mi, ni minu gbee kpeteŋkple ko gbɛɛmɔ yɛ misɛɛgbɛ tamɔ shikpɔŋ hosomɔ, ni gbee lɛ kɛɛ, “Jiemɔ miijie Yehowa ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ anunyam lɛ yi yɛ eshihilɛhe lɛ.”

english_verse: It was the sound made by the creatures' wings as they brushed against each other, and by the rumble of the wheels beside them.
translation_verse: Nibii ni hiɛ gbɔmɔ su lɛ afiji ni saa eko kɛ eko he lɛ agbɛɛmɔ kɛ kokolontoi ni yɔɔ amɛŋmawuiaŋ lɛ amli gbɛɛmɔ lɛ hu tamɔ shikpɔŋ hosomɔ kpeteŋkple.

english_verse: Then the Spirit carried me away. The Lord's power had taken complete control of me, and I was both annoyed and angry.
translation_verse: Yehowa hewalɛ lɛ ba minɔ, ni ewo mi kɛtee. Mitee kɛ mlila ni naawa naakpa.

english_verse: When I was back with the others living at Abib Hill near the Chebar River, I sat among them for seven days, shocked at what had happened to me. The Lord Appoints Ezekiel To Stand Watch (Ezekiel
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni miba nomii ni yɔɔ Kebar Faa lɛ naa yɛ Tel-Abib lɛ aŋɔɔ; ni miho mita shi yɛ amɛteŋ, ni minaa ekpɛ mihe gbii kpawo sɔŋŋ. Yehowa to Ezekiel bulɔ (Ezekiel

english_verse: Seven days after I had seen the brightness of the Lord's glory, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Gbii kpawo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I have appointed you to stand watch for the people of Israel. So listen to what I say, then warn them for me.
translation_verse: “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mito bo bulɔ mihã Israel we lɛ; ni be fɛɛ be ni ooonu minaa wiemɔ lɛ, obɔ amɛ kɔkɔ ohã mi.

english_verse: When I tell wicked people they will die because of their sins, you must warn them to turn from their sinful ways so they won't be punished. If you refuse, you are responsible for their death.
translation_verse: “Kɛji mikɛɛ efɔŋfeelɔ akɛ, gbo ooogbo, ni obɔɔɔ lɛ kɔkɔ, ni osaa owieee otsɔ̃ɔɔ efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ ni eje egbɛ fɔŋ lɛ nɔ, koni ehere eyiwala lɛ, nakai efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ baagbo yɛ ehe esha lɛ hewɔ, shi elá lɛ, bo odɛ̃ŋ mabi shi yɛ.

english_verse: However, if you do warn them, and they keep on sinning, they will die because of their sins, and you will be innocent.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji obɔ efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ kɔkɔ, ni ekpaaa efɔŋ lɛ feemɔ, ni ejeee egbɛ fɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ebaagbo yɛ ehe esha lɛ mli nɛ, shi bo lɛ ohere oyiwala.

english_verse: Now suppose faithful people start sinning, and I decide to put stumbling blocks in their paths to make them fall. They deserve to die because of their sins. So if you refuse to warn them, I will forget about the times they were faithful, and I will hold you responsible for their death.
translation_verse: “Miikɛ bo ekoŋŋ akɛ, kɛji mɔ ni feɔ nɔ ni ja kpa ejalɛ nifeemɔi lɛ, ni efee nɔ ni ejaaa lɛ, ni mito lɛ pampi lɛ, ebaagbo; ejaakɛ obɔɔɔ lɛ kɔkɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, ebaagbo yɛ ehe esha lɛ hewɔ, ni ejalɛ nii ni efee pɛŋ lɛ akaiŋ; shi elá lɛ, bo odɛ̃ŋ mabi shi yɛ.

english_verse: But if you do warn them, and they listen to you and stop sinning, I will let them live. And you will be innocent. Ezekiel Cannot Talk
translation_verse: “Shi kɛ̃lɛ, kɛji obɔ mɔ ni feɔ jalɛ nii lɛ kɔkɔ koni ekafee esha, ni efeee esha lɛ, no lɛ eyi baana wala ejaakɛ ebo kɔkɔbɔɔ toi, ni bo hu ohere oyiwala.” Ezekiel baatɔ mu

english_verse: The Lord took control of me and said, “Stand up! Go into the valley, and I will talk with you there.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa hewalɛ lɛ ba minɔ, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Tee shi ni oya jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni jɛi mikɛ bo aya wie yɛ.”

english_verse: I immediately went to the valley, where I saw the brightness of the Lord's glory, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River, and I bowed with my face to the ground.
translation_verse: Hewɔ lɛ mite shi ni mitee jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni naa, Yehowa anunyam lɛ ni tamɔ anunyam ni mina yɛ Kebar Faa lɛ naa lɛ yɛ jɛi. Kɛkɛ ni miho migbee shi ni mikɛ mihiɛ bu shi.

english_verse: His Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said: Go back and lock yourself in your house!
translation_verse: Shi Mumɔ lɛ babote mimli ni ewo minɔ edamɔ shi, ni ekɛ mi wie, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yaa ni oyaŋa oyi owo owe lɛ.

english_verse: and I will make you unable to talk or to warn those who have rebelled against me.
translation_verse: Asaŋ mahã olilɛi akpɛtɛ odaaŋ, ni otɔ mu bɔ ni afee ni okanyɛ okã amɛ; tsɛbelɛ toigbolɔi amaŋbii ji amɛ.

english_verse: But the time will come, when I will tell you what to say, and you will again be able to speak my message. Some of them will listen; others will be stubborn and refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji mikɛ bo bawie ekoŋŋ lɛ, magbele onaa ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ: Mɔ ni sumɔ akɛ enu lɛ, ebo toi, ni mɔ ni sumɔɔɔ akɛ enu lɛ, ekabo toi; ejaakɛ toigbolɔi amaŋbii ji amɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, find a brick and sketch a picture of Jerusalem on it.
translation_verse: Ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ adesa, kɔ ntayaa ni okɛfɔ ohiɛ, ni otɛŋ Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ yɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Then prepare to attack the brick as if it were a real city. Build a dirt mound and a ramp up to the top and surround the brick with enemy camps. On every side put large wooden poles as though you were going to break down the gate to the city.
translation_verse: Tɛŋmɔ nibii nɛɛ kɛbɔle maŋ lɛ he kɛkpe: kawoo gbogbo kɛ mɔji kɛ kpoku kɛ tabilɔi ni baatua maŋ lɛ, kɛ gbogbokuumɔ nibii ni mamɔ he.

english_verse: Set up an iron pan like a wall between you and the brick. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Okɛ dade ni atswia lɛ tɛtɛrɛɛ afee gbogbo koni efo bo okɛ maŋ lɛ teŋ; ni ojie ohiɛ oka lɛ. Ŋɔɔ lɛ akɛ atua maŋ lɛ, ni bo otuaa maŋ lɛ nɛɛ. Enɛ ji okadi hã Israelbii lɛ.

english_verse: The brick stands for Jerusalem, so attack it! Stare at it and shout angry warnings.
translation_verse: “Jiemɔ ohiɛ oka Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ; ni ojie onine he efolo koni ogba oshi lɛ.

english_verse: I will tie you up, so you can't leave until your attack has ended.
translation_verse: Mikɛ kpãi baafimɔ bo akpɛtɛ shi, ni onyɛŋ ohe otsɔ̃ kɛjɛ abɛku nɔ kɛya ninejurɔ nɔ kɛyashi be ni ooogbe okawoo gbii lɛ anaa dã.

english_verse: Get a large bowl. Then mix together wheat, barley, beans, lentils, and millet, and make some bread. This is what you will eat for the
translation_verse: “Agbɛnɛ, ŋɔɔ ŋmãa kɛ akoko kɛ akpatramɔ kɛ yɔɔ kɛ blɔfoakoko kɛ abele, ni okɛwo nɔ kome mli, ni okɛshã aboloo ohã ohe. Ye aboloo nɛɛ be ni okã obɛku nɔ gbii ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu lɛ.

english_verse: Eat only a small loaf of bread each day
translation_verse: Oniyenii ni obaaye lɛ ŋmɛɛ kiloi nyɔŋmai enyɔ gbi kome; ye nii shi kome daa gbi.

english_verse: and drink only two large cups of water.
translation_verse: Ni nu hu ni obaanu lɛ susumɔ kpuji enyɔ; nuu nu shi kome daa gbi.

english_verse: Use dried human waste to start a fire, then bake the bread on the coals where everyone can watch you.
translation_verse: Ni okɛ gbɔmɔ wamɔ afee lai ni okɛshã akoko aboloo lɛ, ni oye yɛ amɛhiɛ.”

english_verse: When I scatter the people of Israel among the nations, they will also have to eat food that is unclean, just as you must do.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nakai pɛ Israelbii lɛ baaye amɛniyenii ni amɛhiɔ lɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ hei, ni mashwie amɛ kɛya lɛ.”

english_verse: I said, “Lord God, please don't make me do that! Never in my life have I eaten food that would make me unacceptable to you. I've never eaten anything that died a natural death or was killed by a wild animal or that you said was unclean.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mibuleko mihe dã, kɛjɛ miblahiaŋ aahu kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ. Miyeko nɔ ko ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbo loo kooloo ko tserɛ lɛ dã. Asaŋ hu loo ko ni ahiɔ esako minaa dã.

english_verse: The Lord replied, “Instead of human waste, I will let you bake your bread on a fire made from cow manure.
translation_verse: Ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kwɛ, mahã okɛ tsina wamɔ ashã oboloo lɛ yɛ gbɔmɔ wamɔ najiaŋ.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, the people of Jerusalem will starve. They will have so little food and water that they will be afraid and hopeless.
translation_verse: Esaa ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, naa, mahã niyenii he asɛ̃ yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni amɛkɛ tsuiyeli baaŋmɛ aboloo amɛye, ni amɛkɛ hejaramɔ baasusu nu amɛnu.

english_verse: Everyone will be shocked at what is happening, and, because of their sins, they will die a slow death.”
translation_verse: Mafee enɛ koni aboloo kɛ nu he ahia amɛ, ni amɛbaakwɛkwɛɛ amɛhe kɛ hejɔ̃mɔ, ni amɛaatãra loo yɛ amɛtoigbalamɔ mli.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, get a sharp sword and use it to cut off your hair and beard. Weigh the hair and divide it into three equal piles.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ mi ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɔ klante ni naa ba ni okɛfee yikulɔi asooyi, ni okɛshɛ oyi kɛ otsɛŋ. Agbɛnɛ kɔ nsɛni ni oŋmɛ tsɔi lɛ yɛ nsɛni mli, ni oja mli etɛ̃.

english_verse: After you attack the brick that stands for Jerusalem, burn one pile of your hair on the brick. Chop up the second pile and let the small pieces of hair fall around the brick. Throw the third pile into the wind, and I will strike it with my own sword.
translation_verse: Mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ, shãa yɛ maŋ lɛ teŋ, be ni agbe kawoo gbii lɛ anaa lɛ. Kɔ mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome hu ni okɛ klante afolɔ mli dukuduku be ni obɔleɔ maŋ lɛ kɛkpe lɛ; ni okɛ mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome ni eshwɛ lɛ ashwã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli, ni magbala klante kɛnyiɛ sɛɛ.

english_verse: Keep a few of the hairs and wrap them in the hem of your clothes.
translation_verse: Ŋɔɔ yitsɔi lɛ fioo ko kɛkɛ ni okɛŋmɔ otade lɛ naa.

english_verse: Then pull out a few of those hairs and throw them in the fire, so they will also burn. This fire will spread, destroying everyone in Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋɔɔ no nɔŋŋ mli eko ni oshɛrɛ oshwie la lɛ mli ni oshã. La baajɛ enɛ mli ebote Israel we lɛ fɛɛ.”

english_verse: I am the Lord God, and I have made Jerusalem the most important place in the world, and all other nations admire it.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ, “Yerusalɛm nɛ; mikɛ lɛ ema majimaji ateŋ, ni shikpɔji krokomɛi ebɔle he kɛkpe.

english_verse: But the people of Jerusalem rebelled and refuse to obey me. They ignored my laws and have become even more sinful than the nations around them.
translation_verse: Yerusalɛm eku mimlai lɛ amli fe majimaji krokomɛi fɛɛ; eku mimlai wuji lɛ hu amli fe shikpɔji krokomɛi ni bɔle ehe kɛkpe lɛ. Ekwa mimlai lɛ ni eyeee mikpɔi lɛ hu anɔ.

english_verse: So tell the people of Jerusalem: I am the Lord God! You have refused to obey my laws and teachings, and instead you have obeyed the laws of the surrounding nations. You have become more rebellious than any of them!
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni mi, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mikɛɔ nɛ, “Nyɛfeɔ basabasa fe majimaji krokomɛi ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ, ni nyɛyeee akpɔi kɛ mlai ni miwo nyɛ lɛ anɔ, shi moŋ nyɛye jeŋmaji ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ moŋ amlai lɛ anɔ lɛ,

english_verse: Now all those nations will watch as I turn against you and punish you
translation_verse: hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, Naa, mi, mi diɛŋtsɛ mikɛ bo ena, mi magbala otoi yɛ majimaji lɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: for your sins. Your punishment will be more horrible than anything I've ever done or will ever do again.
translation_verse: Musubɔɔnii ni ofee lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mafee bo nɔ ko ni mifeko dã, ni asaŋ mifeŋ enɔ eko dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Parents will be so desperate for food that they will eat their own children, and children will eat their parents. Those who survive this horror will be scattered in every direction.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, tsɛmɛi baagbe amɛbii amɛye yɛ nyɛteŋ, ni bihii baagbe amɛtsɛmɛi amɛye; magbala nyɛtoi! Hiɛkãalɔi ni baashwɛ lɛ, magbɛ amɛ mashwã jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Your sins have disgusted me and made my temple unfit as a place to worship me. So I swear by my own life that I will cut you down and show you no pity.
translation_verse: “Asaŋ gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ, akɛni okɛ taŋtaŋnii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ musubɔɔnii lɛ fɛɛ ebule mihekrɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɛɛ, hewɔ lɛ makpãtã ohiɛ; mikuŋ mihiɛ mifɔŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko nɔ; ni minaŋ bo mɔbɔ.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.

english_verse: A third of you will die here in Jerusalem from disease or starvation. Another third will be killed in war. And I will scatter the last third of you in every direction, then track you down and kill you.
translation_verse: Gbele hela kɛ hɔmɔ baaplene oyikulɛ mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome yɛ omli, mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome baanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa yɛ maŋ lɛ sɛɛ; ni oyikulɛ mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ, magbɛ amɛ mashwã jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ ni mafã klante kɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ.

english_verse: You will feel my fierce anger until I have finished taking revenge. Then you will know that I, the Lord, was furious because of your disobedience.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni mimlifu naa aaawa ahã nɛ, ni mimli baawo amɛ la waa; ni matɔ mihe owele; koni amɛna amɛle akɛ mi, Yehowa, miwie yɛ miwuŋayeli naa, be ni mimli fu amɛ waa lɛ.

english_verse: will insult you and make fun of you, but they will also be shocked and terrified at what I did in my anger.
translation_verse: “Kɛ mikɛ mlifu kɛ mlila kojo bo lɛ, magbala otoi, ni oootsɔ̃ ahorabɔɔ nɔ kɛ heguɔgbee nɔ kɛ kɔkɔbɔɔ nɔ kɛ hejɔ̃mɔ nɔ ohã jeŋmaji ni bɔle ohe kɛkpe lɛ. Mi, Yehowa, miwie enɛ.

english_verse: I will destroy your crops until you starve to death, and disasters will strike you like arrows.
translation_verse: Be ni mikɛ hɔmɔ aaakpãtã ohiɛ tamɔ gãimlibii ni atsɛ̃rɛ kpãtãa nii ahiɛ lɛ, no ni hɔmɔ aaaye bo waa, mi mafo nyɛniyenii namɔ sɛɛ.

english_verse: Starvation and wild animals will kill your children. I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and your enemies will strike you down with their swords. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mibahã hɔmɔ kɛ kooloi awuyelɔi aba nyɛnɔ ni amɛaakpakpaa obii lɛ yɛ ohe kɛya, ni gbele hela kɛ láshishwiemɔ hu aaaba, ni mikɛ ta aaabakpãtã ohiɛ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, face the hills of Israel and tell them:
translation_verse: “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ ohã Israel gɔji lɛ, ni ogba oshi amɛ ni okɛɛ akɛ,

english_verse: Listen, you mountains and hills, and every valley and gorge! I, the Lord, am about to turn against you and crush all the places where foreign gods are worshiped.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Israel gɔji, nyɛboa Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ toi. Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ gɔji kɛ gɔŋkpɔi kɛ nujɔi kɛ jɔi voovoi lɛ nɛ. Naa, mi diɛŋtsɛ mafã klante mawo nyɛ, ni mafite nyɛjamɔhei grɔŋgrɔŋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Every altar will be smashed, and in front of the idols I will put to death the people who worship them.
translation_verse: Nyɛfɔleshãa latɛi kɛ nyɛjamɔhei aaatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni aaakumɔ nyɛtsofakɛŋma afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ. Mashɛrɛ nyɛmɛi ni enyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa lɛ mashwie nyɛwɔji lɛ ahiɛ.”

english_verse: Dead bodies and bones will be lying around the idols and the altars.
translation_verse: Mikɛ Israelbii lɛ agbohii lɛ aaashwie amɛwɔji lɛ ahiɛ, ni magbɛ gbohii lɛ awui lɛ mashwã nyɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ ahe fɛɛ kɛkpe.

english_verse: Every town in Israel will be destroyed to make sure that each shrine, idol, and altar is smashed—everything the Israelites made will be a pile of ruins.
translation_verse: Hei fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ nyɛmaji lɛ aaatsɔmɔ amaŋfɔ̃i, ni aaafite nyɛfɔleshãa latɛi kɛ nyɛjamɔhei grɔŋgrɔŋŋ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, abaafite nyɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ, ni amɛhiɛ baakpãtã. Abaakumɔ nyɛmãgãi lɛ, ni abaakpãtã hiɛ, ni nyɛtsofakɛŋma afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, abaakumɔ, ni nyɛnitsumɔi lɛ abaagu.

english_verse: All over the country, your people will die. And those who survive will know that I, the Lord, did these things.
translation_verse: Mɛi aaanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa yɛ nyɛteŋ. No nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi, mi ji, Yehowa.

english_verse: I will let some of the people live through this punishment, but I will scatter them among the nations,
translation_verse: “Shi mashwɛ nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi hiɛkãalɔi. Nyɛaana mɛi komɛi ni eje klante naa gbele mli yɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ. Kɛji agbɛ nyɛ ashwã majimaji lɛ anɔ lɛ,

english_verse: where they will be prisoners. And when they think of me, they will realize that they disgraced me by rebelling and by worshiping idols. They will hate themselves for the evil things they did,
translation_verse: no lɛ nyɛteŋ mɛi ni eje gbele mli lɛ aaakai mi yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ hei ni aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee lɛ. Kɛji mikumɔ amɛyiŋ flɛflɛ tsuii ni hã amɛkɛ yiŋ flɛflɛ yanyiɛ amɛmãgãi lɛ asɛɛ lɛ, amɛaanyaŋe amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe yɛ nifɔɔjianii kɛ musubɔɔ nii ni amɛfee lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: and they will know that I am the Lord and that my warnings must be taken seriously.
translation_verse: No dani amɛaana amɛle lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa, jeee wiemɔ folo kɛkɛ miwie akɛ mafee amɛ efɔŋ nɛɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord God then said: Ezekiel, beat your fists together and stomp your feet in despair! Moan in sorrow, because the people of Israel have done disgusting things and now will be killed by enemy troops, or they will die from starvation and disease.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Tswaa odɛ̃ ni okɛ onane ashi shi, ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Kpoo ha Israel we lɛ yɛ amɛmusubɔɔnii fɔ̃ji lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ. Amɛaanyɔnyɔi yɛ klante kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela naa.’

english_verse: Those who live far away will be struck with deadly diseases. Those who live nearby will be killed in war. And the ones who are left will starve to death. I will let loose my anger on them!
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yɔɔ sɛɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ gbele hela baagbe lɛ, ni mɔ ni bɛŋkɛ hu baagbo yɛ klante naa, ni mɔ ni abaa eyi ni eshwɛ lɛ hu, hɔmɔ baagbe lɛ. Bɔ ni mimlifu ni naawa lɛ baatsu amɛhe nii kɛyata nɛ.

english_verse: These people used to offer incense to idols at altars built on hills and mountaintops and in the shade of large oak trees. But when they see dead bodies lying around those altars, they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛaana nyɛle mi, akɛ mi ji Yehowa, be ni nyɛ mɛi ni enyɔnyɔɔ lɛ jwere nyɛwɔji lɛ ateŋ yɛ amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ ahe fɛɛ kɛkpe; ekomɛi aaajwere gɔŋkpɔ fɛɛ gɔŋkpɔ ni kwɔ nɔ, kɛ gɔji fɛɛ ayiteiaŋ hu, kɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni ebu kusuu shishi, kɛ blɔfo oduŋ tso fɛɛ blɔfo oduŋ tso kusuu shishi; he fɛɛ he ni amɛshãa tsofakɛŋma amɛhãa amɛwɔji lɛ fɛɛ yɛ lɛ mɛi aaajwere jɛi.

english_verse: I will make their country a barren wasteland, from the Southern Desert to the town of Diblah in the north. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Mawo minine nɔ yɛ amɛnɔ yɛ amɛshihilɛhei lɛ fiaa kwa, ni mafite amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni mafee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛjɛ shiaŋa ni yɔɔ ŋshɔnaagbɛ lɛ kɛyaashi Ribla yɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ; no dani amɛaana amɛle akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel that I am saying: Israel will soon come to an end! Your whole country is about to be destroyed
translation_verse: “Bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ ohã Israel gɔji lɛ ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mikɛɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɛ: Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ naagbee lɛ eshɛ! Shikpɔŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ anaagbee lɛ eshɛ etã.

english_verse: that I will show no pity. I will punish you for the evil you've done, and you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Bei abɔ ni nyɛmusubɔɔ nibii lɛ yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ, mihiŋmɛi baakã nyɛhe, ni minaŋ mɔbɔ; shi magbala otoi yɛ ojeŋba hewɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.

english_verse: There's never been anything like the coming disaster.
translation_verse: “Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, amanehulu nyiɛ amanehulu sɛɛ kɛmiiba.

english_verse: And when it comes, your life will be over.
translation_verse: Naa eeba, naagbee lɛ eshɛ; naagbee lɛ eba kɛ̃, eshɛ etã, ete shi ewo bo. Naa eeba.

english_verse: You people of Israel are doomed! Soon there will be panic on the mountaintops instead of celebration.
translation_verse: Naa eeba! Nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii nyɛhiɛkpãtãmɔ be lɛ enina nyɛ! Be lɛ eshɛ; gbi lɛ ebɛŋkɛ, gbi ni abaanu bolɔmɔ, ni ejeee miishɛɛ bolɔmɔ, shi moŋ hejaramɔ bolɔmɔ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I will let loose my anger and punish you for the evil things you've done. You'll get what you deserve.
translation_verse: “Agbɛnɛ etsɛŋ ni mafɔse mimlila lɛ mashwie onɔ, ni mafã mimlifu kɛ eshishi fɛɛ mashwie onɔ, ni magbala otoi yɛ ojeŋba naa, ni mikɛ bo aaaye kɛ joomɔ yɛ omusubɔɔ nibii lɛ fia ahewɔ.

english_verse: Your sins are so terrible, that you'll get no mercy from me. Then you will know that I, the Lord, have punished you.
translation_verse: Be abɔ ni nyɛmusubɔɔ nibii lɛ yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ, mihiŋmɛi baakã nyɛhe, ni minaŋ mɔbɔ; shi magbala otoi yɛ ojeŋba hewɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa ni tswaa mɔ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: and violent criminals run free. None of you will survive the disaster, and everything you own and value will be shattered.
translation_verse: Yitsoŋwalɛ eda aahu esa etsɔ̃ dade. Amɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ amɛninamɔ kɛ amɛnunyam fɛɛ lɛ ekoeko eshwɛŋ.

english_verse: The time is coming when everyone will be ruined. Buying and selling will stop,
translation_verse: Be lɛ eshɛ, gbi lɛ ebɛŋkɛ. Nihelɔ akanya, ni nihɔɔlɔ lɛ hu akaye ŋkɔmɔ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu kã asafo lɛ mli mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nɔ.

english_verse: and people who sell property will never get it back, because all of you must be punished for your sins. And I won't change my mind!
translation_verse: Jarayelɔ ko ni yɔɔ wala mli lolo lɛ eyaŋ nɔ ni ehɔ̃ɔ lɛ he dɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu kã asafo mu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu nɛɛ ekpaleŋ; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko hereŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiwala yɛ nishaianii ni efee lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: A signal has been blown on the trumpet, and weapons are prepared for battle. But no one goes to war, because in my anger I will strike down everyone in Israel. Israel Is Surrounded The Lord said to the people of Israel:
translation_verse: Akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ, afee kralo hu atã; shi mɔ ko mɔ ko eyaaa ta lɛ, ejaakɛ mimli efu asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ.” Israel maŋ lɛ he eshai ahenyɔmɔwoo

english_verse: War, disease, and starvation are everywhere! People who live in the countryside will be killed in battle, and those who live in towns will die from starvation or deadly diseases.
translation_verse: “Aawuu yɛ gbɛjegbɛi anɔ, gbele hela kɛ hɔmɔ yɛ shĩa mli; mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋa nɔ lɛ nyɔɔ yɛ klante naa; mɔ ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela kpãtãa ehiɛ.

english_verse: Anyone who survives will escape into the hills, like doves who leave the valleys to find safety. All of you will moan because of your sins.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji hiɛkãalɔi komɛi aaaje mli lɛ, amɛaayahi gɔji lɛ anɔ tamɔ okpoi ni jɛ jɔɔ mli. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baaye ehe esha he ŋkɔmɔ.

english_verse: Your hands will tremble, and your knees go limp.
translation_verse: Nijiaŋ fɛɛ tswɛm baaje wui, ni nakutsei fɛɛ tswɛm baakpokpo tamɔ ayawa mli nu.

english_verse: Your silver and gold will be thrown into the streets like garbage, because those are the two things that led you into sin, and now they cannot save you from my anger. They are not even worth enough to buy food.
translation_verse: Amɛjwiɛtɛi lɛ amɛaashɛrɛ amɛshwie blohuiaŋ, ni amɛaabu amɛshika lɛ akɛ nɔ ko ni anyaŋeɔ. Amɛjwiɛtɛi kɛ amɛshika lɛ nyɛŋ amɛyiwala ahere yɛ Yehowa mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ. Nomɛi haŋ amɛtɔrɔ, ni ehaŋ amɛmusu ayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃, ejaakɛ amɛjwiɛtɛi kɛ shika lɛ etsɔ̃ pampi ehã amɛ.

english_verse: You took great pride in using your beautiful jewelry to make disgusting idols of foreign gods. So I will make your jewelry worthless.
translation_verse: Amɛjwinei fɛɛfɛji ni amɛkɛsaa amɛhe kɛtaoɔ yaka anunyam lɛ, amɛkɛfee amɛmusubɔɔ amãgãi kɛ nibii ni ahiɔ lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, mi, Yehowa, miha etsɔ̃ nɔ ko ni he tseee ehã amɛ.

english_verse: They will break into my temple and leave it unfit as a place to worship me, but I will look away and let it happen.
translation_verse: Matsɔ̃ mihiɛ mato afã koni amɛbule mihe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ; julɔi aaabote mli ni amɛaabule lɛ ni amɛaafee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃.

english_verse: Your whole country is in confusion! Murder and violence are everywhere in Israel,
translation_verse: “Akɛni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ lashishwiemɔ, ni maŋ lɛ mli eyi tɔ kɛ yiwalɛ lɛ,

english_verse: so I will tell the most wicked nations to come and take over your homes. They will put an end to the pride you have in your strong army, and they will make your places of worship unfit to use.
translation_verse: mahã majimaji lɛ ateŋ mɛi fɔ̃ji fe fɛɛ abaŋɔ amɛshĩai lɛ amɛfee amɛnɔ. Mibafo amɛhewalɛ ni amɛkɛshwãa lɛ sɛɛ; ni aaabule amɛhei krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ.

english_verse: You will be terrified and will desperately look for peace—but there will be no peace.
translation_verse: Kɛ hejaramɔ ba lɛ amɛaatao toiŋjɔlɛ, shi amɛnaŋ eko.

english_verse: One tragedy will follow another, and you'll hear only bad news. People will beg prophets to give them a message from me. Priests will stop teaching my Law, and wise leaders won't be able to give advice.
translation_verse: Amanehulu aaanyiɛ amanehulu sɛɛ; akɛɛ akɛɛ sane aaanyiɛ akɛɛ akɛɛ sane sɛɛ. Amɛbaabi gbalɔ lɛ ni egba amɛ ninaa, nɔ ni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ. Osɔfoi lɛ tete ahiɛ lɛ, mla lɛ jeee fɛifɛi, ni onukpai lɛ wooo ŋaa kpakpa.

english_verse: Even your king and his officials will lose hope and cry in despair. Your hands will tremble with fear. I will punish you for your sins and treat you the same way you have treated others. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ lɛ aaaye ŋkɔmɔ. Ni lumɔ lɛ nijiaŋ aaaje wui, ni gbeyei aaahã gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ he aaakpokpo. Bɔ ni amɛjeŋba yɔɔ lɛ nakai mikɛ amɛ baaye; ni bɔ ni amɛkojoɔ mɛi lɛ nakai makojo amɛ; ni amɛaana amɛle akɛ, mi mi ji Yehowa.”

english_verse: Six years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the leaders of Judah were meeting with me in my house. On the fifth day of the sixth month, the Lord God suddenly took control of me,
translation_verse: Israelbii anomŋɔɔ afi ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ, nyɔŋ ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ, gbi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, be ni mita miwe lɛ, ni Yuda onukpai lɛ tara mihiɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa hewalɛ yi minɔ yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: and I saw something in the shape of a human. This figure was like fire from the waist down, and it was bright as polished metal from the waist up.
