translation_verse: Kɔɔyɔɔ fɔŋ ko baatswa amɛ waa, ni ebaahã amɛhiɛ agboi yɛ wɔŋjamɔ afɔleshãa hewɔ.”

english_verse: Listen, you priests! Pay attention, Israel! Listen, you members of the royal family. Justice was your duty. But at Mizpah and Mount Tabor you trapped the people.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ Osɔfoi, nyɛboa sane nɛɛ toi! Nyɛ Israelbii, nyɛkaa toi! Nyɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli bii, nyɛfea toi, shi naa, abaakojo nyɛ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛfee nyɛhe tamɔ akpa ni atsɔ̃ yɛ Mizpa, kɛ yaa ni akɛlɛɛ shi yɛ Tabor Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: At the place of worship you were a treacherous pit, and I will punish you.
translation_verse: Efɔŋfeelɔi lɛ ebote nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ mli vii yɛ Akasia maŋ lɛ mli, mibagbala amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ toi waa diɛŋtsɛ.

english_verse: Israel, I know all about you, and because of your unfaithfulness, I find you unacceptable.
translation_verse: Mile Efraim bɔ ni eyɔɔ tsɔ̃; no hewɔ lɛ, Israel kɛ ehe eteko mi. Ejaakɛ amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ, Efraim, oje misɛɛ, ni Israel ebule ehe.” Hosea bɔ wɔŋjamɔ he kɔkɔ

english_verse: Your evil deeds are the reason you won't return to me, your Lord God. And your constant craving for sex keeps you from knowing me.
translation_verse: “Amɛnifeemɔnii hewɔ lɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛsɛɛ amɛku kɛba amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ mumɔ ebote amɛmli, ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛleee mi, Yehowa dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Israel, your pride testifies to your guilt; it makes you stumble, and Judah stumbles too.
translation_verse: Israel shwãa nii lɛ miiye odase moŋ eeshi lɛ nɔŋŋ. Israel kɛ Efraim hiɛ baakpãtã, ni Yuda hu kɛ amɛ fɛɛ hiɛ baakpãtã.

english_verse: You offer sheep and cattle as sacrifices to me, but I have turned away and refuse to be found.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛ amɛtoi kɛ amɛtsinai baaya ayashã afɔle kɛtao Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ, shi amɛnaŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa egbala ehe shi eshi amɛ.

english_verse: You have been unfaithful to me, your Lord; you have had children by prostitutes. So at the New Moon Festival, you and your crops will be destroyed. The Lord Warns Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Akɛni amɛje Yehowa sɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, amɛyafɔ gbɔi abii. Shi nyɔŋ hee ni baaje lɛ mli lɛ abaakpãtã amɛ kɛ amɛshikpɔŋ fɛɛ hiɛ.” Yuda kɛ Israel kɛ amɛhe wu ta

english_verse: Give a warning on the trumpet! Let it be heard in Gibeah, Ramah, and sinful Bethel. Benjamin, watch out!
translation_verse: “Akpã ta tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ yɛ Gibea! Akpã koofɛŋ lɛ yɛ Rama! Abɔ oshe yɛ Bet-Aven! Ohe akpokpo, Benyamin!

english_verse: I, the Lord, will punish and wipe out Israel. This is my solemn promise to every tribe of Israel.
translation_verse: Gbi nɔ ni abaagbala Efraim toi lɛ, ebaatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃. Naa, nɔ ni baaba Israel akutsei lɛ anɔ lɛ no mikɛɛ nɛɛ.

english_verse: Judah's leaders are like crooks who move boundary markers; that's why I will flood them with my anger.
translation_verse: “Yuda lumɛi lɛ tsiɔ husu kɛyaa sɛɛ kɛjuɔ shikpɔŋ. Mahã mimlifu ate shi awo amɛ tamɔ nu ni etue.

english_verse: Israel was brutally crushed. They got what they deserved for worshiping useless idols.
translation_verse: Efraim kã piŋmɔ mli. Nyɔŋmɔ ebu lɛ fɔ ejaakɛ etswa efai shi akɛ eyaanyiɛ yaka nii asɛɛ.

english_verse: Now I, the Lord, will fill Israel with maggots and make Judah rot.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mi diɛŋtsɛ mitsɔ̃ omlɛgɛ ni baaye Efraim, kɛ fala ni baakpãtã Yuda hiɛ.

english_verse: When Israel and Judah saw their sickness and wounds, Israel asked help from Assyria and its mighty king. But the king cannot cure them or heal their wounds.
translation_verse: “Be ni Israel na hela ni emɔ lɛ lɛ, ni Yuda hu na fala ni efã lɛ, Efraim tee Asiria maŋtsɛ kpanaa lɛ ŋɔɔ eyabi edɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ, shi Asiria nyɛɛɛ amɛ tsofa efee aloo etsa amɛ.

english_verse: So I'll become a fierce lion attacking Israel and Judah. I'll snatch and carry off what I want, and no one can stop me.
translation_verse: Mibahuru tamɔ jata mayi Israel kɛ Yuda hu nɔ, ni mi diɛŋtsɛ mibatserɛ amɛmli, kɛkɛ lɛ mishi amɛ mitee. Mashãtã amɛ kɛya ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ amɛyiwala ehere.

english_verse: Then I'll return to my temple until they confess their guilt and worship me, until they are desperate and beg for my help.
translation_verse: “Mibagbala mihe shi mashi amɛ kɛyaashi amɛaakpɛlɛ̃ amɛtɔ̃mɔ nɔ, ni amɛaabatao misɛɛgbɛ. Ekolɛ fimɔ be lɛ mli lɛ amɛaatao mi.”

english_verse: Let's return to the Lord. He has torn us to shreds, but he will bandage our wounds and make us well.
translation_verse: Maŋbii lɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa koni wɔkpalea kɛyaa Yehowa ŋɔɔ. Akɛni lɛ etserɛ wɔmli lɛ, lɛ eeetsa wɔ; ni akɛni lɛ etswia wɔ nii lɛ, lɛ eeefi nɔ ehã wɔ.

english_verse: In two or three days he will heal us and restore our strength that we may live with him.
translation_verse: Gbii enyɔ sɛɛ lɛ, eeetsĩɛ wɔ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ eeetee wɔ shi, ni wɔ kɛ lɛ aaahi shi.

english_verse: Let's do our best to know the Lord. His coming is as certain as the morning sun; he will refresh us like rain renewing the earth in the springtime. The Lord Speaks to Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Nyɛhãa wɔbɔa mɔdɛŋ wɔlea Yehowa. Bɔ ni ŋwanejee ko bɛ he akɛ daa gbi lɛ je tsɛreɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ŋwanejee ko bɛ he akɛ Yehowa baajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ. Ebaaba wɔŋɔɔ tamɔ Agbiɛnaa nunɛmɔ tueɔ shwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: People of Israel and Judah, what can I do with you? Your love for me disappears more quickly than mist or dew at sunrise.
translation_verse: Shi Yehowa kɛɔ akɛ, “Ao! Israel, mɛni mafee ohe? Ao! Yuda, te mafee bo tɛŋŋ? Ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ lɛ etamɔ leebi atatu; etamɔ leebi bɔ ni kpalaa oya.

english_verse: That's why I slaughtered you with the words of my prophets. That's why my judgments blazed like the dawning sun.
translation_verse: No hewɔ ni mitsɔ̃ gbalɔi lɛ anɔ migbala amɛtoi, ni mikɛ midaaŋ wiemɔi lɛ kã amɛ, ni kojomɔ ni mikojo amɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ kane.

english_verse: I'd rather for you to be faithful and to know me than to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nɔ ni mitaoɔ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ ji suɔmɔ ni tsakeee shi jeee afɔle; nɔ ni mitaoɔ ji lee ni aleɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shi jeee shãaafɔle.

english_verse: At a place named Adam, you betrayed me by breaking our agreement.
translation_verse: “Shi amɛ lɛ amɛtɔ̃ kpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Adam fee lɛ, ni amɛyeee mi anɔkwa.

english_verse: Everyone in Gilead is evil; your hands are stained with the blood of victims.
translation_verse: Gilead lɛ nɔfɔŋfeelɔi amaŋ ni, ni lá ewu amɛhe.

english_verse: You priests are like a gang of robbers in ambush. On the road to Shechem you murder and commit other horrible crimes.
translation_verse: Tamɔ bɔ ni ojotswalɔi woɔ mɔ ka lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ pɛ osɔfoi lɛ efee ekome amɛgbeɔ mɛi, ni amɛfeɔ nishaianii yɛ Shekem gbɛteŋ.

english_verse: I have seen a terrible thing in Israel— you are unfaithful and unfit to worship me.
translation_verse: Mina gbeyei nii ko yɛ Israel: Efraim kɛ amãgãjamɔ miibɔ ajwamãŋ yɛ jɛi; abule Israel.

english_verse: People of Judah, your time is coming too. The Lord Wants To Help Israel I, the Lord, would like to make my nation prosper again
translation_verse: “Ni bo, Yuda, hu mito be ni nɔ ni oduɔ amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ, obaakpa eyibii.

english_verse: and to heal its wounds. But then I see the crimes in Israel and Samaria. Everyone is deceitful; robbers roam the streets.
translation_verse: “Kɛ mito miyiŋ akɛ matsa mimɛi Israelbii lɛ koni amɛshwere pɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ Efraim kɛ Samaria nifɔɔjianii lɛ eje kpo: no ji mɔshishiumɔ kɛ juu kɛ ojotswaa yɛ gbɛteŋ.

english_verse: No one realizes that I have seen their sins surround them like a flood.
translation_verse: Efeee amɛ kwraa akɛ miina amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ fɛɛ. Shi naa amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ ebɔle amɛ, ni miikwɛ.” Atoɔ yitso fɔŋ nigii yɛ Maŋtsɛ we lɛ

english_verse: The king and his officials take great pleasure in their sin and deceit.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Amɛkɛ yiwalɛ nifeemɔi lɛ hãa maŋtsɛ lɛ mii shɛɔ ehe, ni amɛkɛ mɔshishinyiɛmɔ wiemɔ hãa lumɛi hu naa miishɛɛ.

english_verse: On the day their king was crowned, his officials got him drunk, and he joined in their foolishness.
translation_verse: Gbi nɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ye egbi jurɔ lɛ, lumɛi lɛ kɛ dãatɔɔ wo amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛhe hela. Maŋtsɛ ta fɛoyelɔi tete po adɛ̃.

english_verse: Their anger is a fire that smolders all night, then flares up at dawn.
translation_verse: Yitso fɔŋ ni amɛto yɛ amɛtsui mli lɛ sukɔɔ yɛ amɛmli nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ, ni leebi lɛ etsoɔ grigri tamɔ flɔnɔɔ mli la.

english_verse: They are flames destroying their leaders. And their kings are powerless; none of them trust me.
translation_verse: “Amɛkɛ mlila ni yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ gbegbee amɛnɔyelɔi lɛ. Amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ nyɔnyɔi, shi amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa ebooo etsɛɛɛ mi.” Israel kɛ maji krokomɛi lɛ

english_verse: The people of Israel have mixed with foreigners; they are a thin piece of bread scorched on one side.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Bɔ ni Israel kɛ ehe fufuaa maŋsɛɛ maji anɔbii lɛ, ehã etsɔ̃ tamɔ aboloo ni ebe fã kɛ fã.

english_verse: They don't seem to realize how weak and feeble they are; their hair has turned gray, while foreigners rule.
translation_verse: Gbɔi lɛ ehã ehewalɛ etã, shi eyooko; eyiteŋ eje waŋ, shi ekɔɔɔ sɛɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord, their God, but in all of their troubles their pride keeps them from returning to me. No Help from Foreign Nations The Lord said:
translation_verse: Israel shwãanii lɛ miiye odase miishi lɛ moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ maŋbii lɛ kpaleee koni amɛba mi, Yehowa amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ, aloo koni amɛtao misɛɛgbɛ.

english_verse: Israel is a senseless bird, fluttering back and forth between Egypt and Assyria.
translation_verse: Israel etsɔ̃ tamɔ okpo kwashia ni bɛ yitso: ŋmɛnɛ lɛ eetsɛ Ijipt koni ebawa lɛ; wɔ lɛ eetsɛ Asiria.

english_verse: But I will catch them in a net as hunters trap birds; I threatened to punish them, and indeed I will.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji amɛshi kɛmiiya nɔŋŋ lɛ mibafɔ̃ amɛ nɔ yaa madu amɛ tamɔ aduɔ loofɔlɔ, ni mibagbala amɛtoi yɛ nifɔɔjianii ni amɛfee lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: Trouble and destruction will be their reward for rejecting me. I would have rescued them, but they told me lies.
translation_verse: “Kpoo hã amɛ ejaakɛ amɛshi mi, ni amɛbɔ ko. Amɛhiɛ ekpãtã ejaakɛ amɛtse mihiɛ atua. Mi lɛ mitao akɛ mahere amɛyiwala; shi amɛ lɛ amɛmalemaleɔ mihe.

english_verse: They don't really pray to me; they just howl in their beds. They have rejected me for Baal and slashed themselves, in the hope that Baal will bless their crops.
translation_verse: Amɛfooo amɛtsɛɛɛ mi kɛjɛɛɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ; shi moŋ amɛsai anɔ amɛfoɔ waa yɛ. Kɛji amɛmiisɔle yɛ abele kɛ wain he lɛ, amɛkɛ kakla folɔɔ amɛhe tamɔ wɔŋjalɔi lɛ feɔ lɛ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ etse mihiɛ atua.

english_verse: I taught them what they know, and I made them strong. Now they plot against me
translation_verse: Yɛ mli akɛ mi ji mɔ ni tsɔse amɛ, ni mihã amɛna hewalɛ nɛ, shi daa nɛɛ lɛ efɔŋ pɛ amɛjwɛŋɔ yɛ mihe.

english_verse: and refuse to obey. They are more useless than a crooked arrow. Their leaders will die in war for saying foolish things. Egyptians will laugh at them.
translation_verse: Amɛkã he amɛmiija Baal lolo, ni amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ gãitso ni waaa. Naafuu wiemɔi ni amɛlumɛi lɛ wieɔ lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, amɛaanyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa. Ni enɛ aaatsɔ̃ nɔ ni akɛaaye amɛhe fɛo yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: Sound a warning! Israel, you broke our agreement and ignored my teaching. Now an eagle is swooping down to attack my land.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Kpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ okɛhɛle mɛi ashi. Henyɛlɔ miiba tamɔ okropɔŋ ebayi Yehowa we lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ mimaŋbii lɛ eku mi kɛ amɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛtɔ̃ mimla lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Israel, you say, “We claim you, the Lord, as our God.”
translation_verse: Mi amɛbolɔɔ amɛtsɛɔ akɛ, ‘WɔNyɔŋmɔ, bo ji mɔ ni wɔ, Israelbii, wɔle.’

english_verse: But your enemies will chase you for rejecting our good agreement.
translation_verse: Israelbii ekwa nɔ kpakpa lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, henyɛlɔi aaanyiɛ amɛsɛɛ.

english_verse: You chose kings and leaders without consulting me; you made silver and gold idols that led to your downfall.
translation_verse: “Amɛto maŋtsɛmɛi, shi jeee mi minɔ amɛtsɔ̃; ni amɛhole lumɛi hu ni mileee mli eko kwraa. Amɛkɛ amɛjwiɛtɛi kɛ amɛshika fee amãgãi ni baakpãtã amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: City of Samaria, I'm angry because of your idol in the shape of a calf. When will you ever be innocent again?
translation_verse: Mitaooo tsinabi ni ajaa yɛ Samaria maŋ lɛ mli lɛ kwrakwra. Mimli ewo amɛ la naakpa. Mɛɛ beyinɔ po amɛaaba amɛjeŋ jogbaŋŋ yɛ Israel?

english_verse: Someone from Israel built that idol for you, but only I am God. And so it will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Ŋaalɔ ko ni fee tsinabi lɛ; shi naa, jeee Nyɔŋmɔ ni. Nakai tsinabi lɛ ni ajaa yɛ Samaria lɛ, aaajwara lɛ dukuduku.

english_verse: If you scatter wind instead of wheat, you will harvest a whirlwind and have no wheat. Even if you harvest grain, enemies will steal it all.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ akɛni amɛdu kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ lasuogbele ji yibii ni amɛbaakpa. Abele ekpɛŋ bi kome nɛkɛ ni aaana aye. Ni kɛji abele lɛ aaaba tete lɛ, gbɔi moŋ aaabaye.

english_verse: Israel, you are ruined, and now the nations consider you worthless.
translation_verse: Majimaji lɛ emi Israel momo, ni enɛ ehã etsɔ̃ tamɔ tsɛnsi ko ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ.

english_verse: You are like a wild donkey that goes its own way. You've run off to Assyria and hired them as allies.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Israel tsɔ̃ tamɔ ŋaŋ teji ni miifo shi. Etee eyabi Asiria dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ; asaŋ Efraim bɔ maŋsɛɛbii apaa koni amɛbu ehe.

english_verse: You can bargain with nations, but I'll catch you anyway. Soon you will suffer abuse by kings and rulers.
translation_verse: Amɛbɔ majimaji apaa moŋ, shi agbɛnɛ mibabua amɛnaa kɛkpe, ni magbala amɛtoi. Biɛ be kukuoo mli lɛ amɛbaakpa maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ lumɛi too.

english_verse: Israel, you have built many altars where you offer sacrifices for sin. But these altars have become places for sin.
translation_verse: “Israelbii mamɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛi koni amɛkɛdãi esha ni amɛfee lɛ, shi afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ moŋ etsɔ̃ eshafeemɔ nɔ.

english_verse: My instructions for sacrifices were written in detail, but you ignored them.
translation_verse: Kɛji miŋma mimlai lɛ shii akpei abɔ tete mihã amɛ lɛ, amɛbaaŋɔ mlai lɛ akɛ mɔkpɔŋ dɛŋ nii.

english_verse: You sacrifice your best animals and eat the sacrificial meals, but I, the Lord, refuse your offerings. I will remember your sins and punish you. Then you will return to Egypt.
translation_verse: Amɛsumɔɔ afɔleshãa. Amɛgbeɔ kooloi amɛkɛshãa mifɔlei lɛ akɛ loo kɛkɛ ni ayeɔ. Eji nɔ ko ni esaaa mihiɛ. Ni no hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ mibakai eshai ni amɛfee lɛ ni mibawo amɛ he nyɔmɔ. Ijipt kɛ̃ amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaatee.

english_verse: Israel, I created you, but you forgot me. You and Judah built palaces and many strong cities. Now I will send fire to destroy your towns and fortresses.
translation_verse: “Ejaakɛ Israel hiɛ kpa ebɔlɔ lɛ nɔ, ni emamɔ mɔji moŋ ehã ehe; ni Yuda hu tswa gbogbo ewo emaji pii ahe. Shi mawo amɛmaji lɛ amli la ni mashã amɛmɔji lɛ.”

english_verse: Israel, don't celebrate or make noisy shouts like other nations. You have been unfaithful to your God. Wherever grain is threshed, you behave like prostitutes because you enjoy the money you receive.
translation_verse: Israel, omli akafili bo, ni kaanya tamɔ wɔŋjalɔi lɛ. Ejaakɛ bo lɛ oje oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ, ni oyeee lɛ anɔkwa. Ohɔ̃ɔ ohe tamɔ ajwamãŋ yɛ he fɛɛ he ohã jemawɔŋ Baal lɛ, ejaakɛ osusuɔ akɛ no hãa anaa abele lɛ.

english_verse: But you will run short of grain and wine,
translation_verse: Biɛ be kukuoo mli lɛ abele kɛ mu lɛ shɛŋ nyɛnaa, ni anaŋ wain hu.

english_verse: and you will have to leave the land of the Lord. Some of you will go to Egypt; others will go to Assyria and eat unclean food.
translation_verse: Asaŋ Israel ehiŋ Yehowa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, shi ebaaku sɛɛ eya Ijipt nyɔŋyeli mli; ni amɛaayaye nii ni he tseee yɛ Asiria.

english_verse: You won't be able to offer sacrifices of wine to the Lord. None of your sacrifices will please him— they will be unclean like food offered to the dead. Your food will only be used to satisfy your hunger; none of it will be brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Amɛnyɛŋ amɛfɔse wain amɛshwie shi yɛ maŋsɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛhã Yehowa, aloo amɛshã afɔlei ni sa amɛhã lɛ. Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, nii ni amɛaaye lɛ aaabule mɛi fɛɛ ni aaaye eko tamɔ yara nɔ nii buleɔ mɔ lɛ. Ejaakɛ nii ni amɛaaye lɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhɔmɔ kɛkɛ amɛkɛaagbe, shi ekoeko shɛŋ Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: You will no longer be able to celebrate the festival of the Lord.
translation_verse: Te nyɛbaafee tɛŋŋ kɛji eshɛ gbijurɔyeli be loo Yehowa gbijurɔ lɛ hu?

english_verse: Even if you escape alive, you will end up in Egypt and be buried in Memphis. Your silver treasures will be lost among weeds; thorns will sprout in your tents.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ amɛbaashi kɛya Asiria, ni Ijipt aaabua amɛgbohii lɛ anaa ni aaafu amɛ yɛ Memfis. Hei ni amɛkɛ amɛjwiɛtɛi nibii fɛɛfɛji lɛ toɔ lɛ amli baatsa kɛ sɔ̃nsɔ̃rɔ̃i, ni ŋmeitsei hu aaatsa yɛ amɛshĩai amli.

english_verse: Israel, the time has come. You will get what you deserve, and you will know it. “Prophets are fools,” you say. “And God's messengers are crazy.” Your terrible guilt has filled you with hatred.
translation_verse: Toigbalamɔ gbii lɛ eshɛ, be ni abaawo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɔmɔ bɔ pɛ ni sa lɛ lɛ eshɛ. Israel baana ele akɛ gbalɔ lɛ buulu ni, ni mumɔŋ gbɔmɔ lɛ sɛkɛyelɔ ni yɛ enishaianii hewɔ.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord sent me to look after you. But you trap his prophets and flood his temple with your hatred.
translation_verse: Gbalɔ lɛ ato lɛ akɛ bulɔ ahã Israel, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ webii lɛ. Shi he fɛɛ he ni eeetsɔ̃ lɛ atsɔ̃ lɛ tsɔne, ni eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shĩa diɛŋtsɛ mli lɛ nyɛɛ anyɛɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You are brutal and corrupt, as were the men of Gibeah. But God remembers your sin, and you will be punished. Sin's Terrible Results
translation_verse: Amɛbote eshafeemɔ mli vii tamɔ bɔ ni eba yɛ Gibea lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ mibani eshai ni amɛfee lɛ ahe, ni mibawo amɛ nyɔmɔ. Esha ni Israel fee lɛ kɛ ehe nyɔmɔwoo lɛ

english_verse: Israel, when I, the Lord, found you long ago it was like finding grapes in a barren desert or tender young figs. Then you worshiped Baal Peor, that disgusting idol, and you became as disgusting as the idol you loved.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Klɛŋklɛŋ be ni mina Israel lɛ etamɔ wain yibii ni atoɔ lɛ ahuu yɛ ŋa nɔ. Mina nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tamɔ klɛŋklɛŋ yibii ni tsu yɛ agbãmi tso nɔ. Shi be ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shɛ Poer Gɔŋ le he lɛ, amɛbɔ̃i jemawɔŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Poer lɛ jamɔ. Enɛ hã amɛsane je migugɔŋ fu tamɔ wɔji ni amɛjaa lɛ nɔŋŋ asane.

english_verse: And so, Israel, your glory will fly away like birds— your women will no longer be able to give birth.
translation_verse: Israel agbojee sɛɛ aaafo tamɔ loofɔlɔ filikiɔ lɛ. Afɔŋ bi dɔŋŋ lɛ, ahiɛŋ musu dɔŋŋ, asaŋ anaŋ musu tete dɔŋŋ yɛ amɛteŋ.

english_verse: Even if you do have children, I will take them all and leave you to mourn. I will turn away, and you will sink down in deep trouble.
translation_verse: Ni kɛji amɛna bii amɛlɛ tete mibagbe bii nɛɛ, ni mishwɛŋ ekome nɛkɛ. Anɔkwa, kɛji miŋmɛɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe lɛ sane kɛ joomɔ baaye amɛ pam.

english_verse: Israel, when I first met you, I thought of you as palm trees growing in fertile ground. Now you lead your people out, only to be slaughtered. Hosea's Advice
translation_verse: “Nɔ nɔŋŋ ni minaa kã shi hã Efraimbii ji hiɛkpãtãmɔ; ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ eeekpala ebii lɛ eyahã koni akpãtã amɛhiɛ.”

english_verse: Our Lord, do just one thing for your people— make their women unable to have children or to nurse their babies. The Lord's Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: Mɛni masumɔ akɛ ofee gbɔmɛi nɛɛ? Yehowa, hã amɛmusu ashrake, ni amɛfufɔi fɛɛ agbi. Yehowa bu Israel fɔ

english_verse: Israel, I first began to hate you because you did evil at Gilgal. Now I will chase you out of my house. No longer will I love you; your leaders betrayed me.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Amɛto amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ fɛɛ feemɔ shishi yɛ Gilgal, ni jɛi mibɔ̃i amɛ nyɛɛ yɛ. Amɛnifeemɔnii gbohii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ mibashwie amɛ kɛje mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Misumɔŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ! Amɛlumɛi lɛ fɛɛ etse mihiɛ atua.

english_verse: Israel, you are a vine with dried-up roots and fruitless branches. Even if you had more children and loved them dearly, I would slaughter them all. Hosea Warns Israel
translation_verse: Israel lɛ etsɔ̃ tamɔ tso ni egbo; hela emɔ lɛ, ni eha eshishi fãi fɛɛ egboi; ni no hewɔ lɛ, ewooo yibii dɔŋŋ. Kɛji amɛna amɛfɔ lɛ, mibagbe amɛmusuŋbii ni amɛsumɔɔ lɛ.” Gbalɔ lɛ miiwie Israel he

english_verse: Israel, you disobeyed my God. Now he will force you to roam from nation to nation.
translation_verse: MiNyɔŋmɔ ni misɔmɔɔ lɛ lɛ, baakwa emɛi lɛ ejaakɛ amɛbooo lɛ toi. Amɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ kobɔfoi yɛ je lɛ mli maji lɛ anɔ bii lɛ ateŋ.

english_verse: You were a healthy vine covered with grapes. But the more grapes you grew, the more altars you built; the better off you became, the better shrines you set up for pagan gods.
translation_verse: Israel tamɔ wain tso ni efũ baa ni eewo. Babaoo ni Israelbii lɛ shwereɔ lɛ babaoo ni amɛmamɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛi ji no. Bɔ ni amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ baa nii lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ amɛsaa shiui ni amɛkɛjaa lɛ hu ahe.

english_verse: You are deceitful and disloyal. So you will pay for your sins, because the Lord will destroy your altars and images.
translation_verse: Amɛyeee anɔkwa, ni no hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, amɛbaana he nyɔmɔwoo. Yehowa baakumɔ amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ eshwie shi, ni ebaafite amɛshiui lɛ.

english_verse: “We don't have a king,” you will say. “We don't fear the Lord. And what good are kings?”
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔbɛ maŋtsɛ ejaakɛ wɔsheee Yehowa gbeyei. Shi kɛji wɔyɛ maŋtsɛ po lɛ mɛni ebaanyɛ efee ehã wɔ?”

english_verse: All who live in Samaria tremble with concern for the idols at sinful Bethel. The idol there was the pride of the priests, but it has been put to shame; now everyone will cry.
translation_verse: Samaria maŋ bii lɛ aaashe gbeyei, ni amɛbaaye ŋkɔmɔ yɛ Bet-Aven shika tsinabi lɛ hewɔ. Amɛ kɛ wulɔmɛi lɛ ni jaa tsinabi lɛ baawo yara amɛfo yɛ enyam ni afo sɛɛ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: It will be taken to Assyria and given to the great king. Then Israel will be disgraced for worshiping that idol.
translation_verse: Anɔkwa, abaawo shika tsinabi lɛ kɛya koni akɛyake Asiria maŋtsɛ kpele lɛ. Ni no baahã hiɛgbele amɔ Israel, ni ehiɛ baashwie shi yɛ ŋaa gbonyo toi ni ebo lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Like a twig in a stream, the king of Samaria will be swept away.
translation_verse: Samaria maŋtsɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ tso kuku ni kplaŋɔ yɛ faa hiɛ.

english_verse: The altars at sinful Bethel will be destroyed for causing Israel to sin; they will be grown over with thorns and thistles. Then everyone will beg the mountains and hills to cover and protect them. The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
translation_verse: Betel gɔji lɛ ayiteiaŋ hei ni Israelbii lɛ jaa amãgãi yɛ ni amɛkɛgbo toi lɛ, aaakpãtã fɛɛ hiɛ. Ŋmei kɛ aŋlɛŋlɛi baakwɛ̃ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ anɔ yɛ jɛi. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ baabolɔ amɛkɛɛ gɔji lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhaa wɔnɔ!” Ni amɛaakɛɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ hu akɛ, “Nyɛbashwiea wɔnɔ!” Yehowa bu Israel fɔ

english_verse: Israel, you have never stopped sinning since that time at Gibeah. That's why you will be attacked at Gibeah.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Israel, ofee esha kɛjɛ Gibea esha lɛ nɔ beebe, ni ohiɛ esha lɛ mli oofee lolo. Mɛni hewɔ esaaa akɛ ta ni afã ashi nɔshafeelɔi lɛ ninaa bo yɛ Gibea?

english_verse: Your sins have doubled, and you are rebellious. Now I have decided to send nations to attack and put you in chains.
translation_verse: Mibate shi mawo toigbolɔi lɛ, ni mibagbala amɛtoi bɔ ni misumɔɔ. Maji baafee ekome awo Israelbii, ni abaagbala amɛtoi yɛ eshai enyɔ lɛ ni amɛfee lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: Once you were obedient like a calf that loved to thresh grain. But I will put a harness on your beautiful neck; you and Judah must plow and cultivate the ground.
translation_verse: “Nyɛsɛɛ ko lɛ Israel tamɔ tsina oblayoo ni atsɔse lɛ, ni enyaa he kɛ̃, akɛ akɛ lɛ miigbee ŋmaa lɛ. Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, miwooo ekuɛ fɛɛfɛo lɛ kɔŋtso. Shi agbɛnɛ mibawo Israel kuɛ kɔŋtso. Yuda baashãtã tsina kɔi ekɛhu; ni Israel baaninɛ nɔ ni ehu lɛ.”

english_verse: Plow your fields, scatter seeds of justice, and harvest faithfulness. Worship me, the Lord, and I will send my saving power down like rain.
translation_verse: Nyɛfea nii ni ja tamɔ aduɔ wu kpakpa, ni nyɛaakpa misuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ yibii. Nyɛjea wala hee shishi tamɔ asaa shikpɔŋ atoɔ nidumɔ, ejaakɛ be yɛ lolo bɔ ni sa ni nyɛkɛaatao Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ kɛyaashi eeeba ebajɔɔ nyɛ tamɔ nu nɛɔ shwieɔ nii anɔ.

english_verse: You have planted evil, harvested injustice, and eaten the fruit of your lies. You trusted your own strength and your powerful forces.
translation_verse: Nyɛdu efɔŋ, ni nyɛkpa nɔsha, ni nyɛye yibii ni amale wo: “Ejaakɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ fɔ̃ nyɛtayaa shwiilii lɛ kɛ hii kãkãlɔi lɛ ayifalɛ nɔ.

english_verse: So war will break out, and your fortresses will be destroyed. Your enemies will do to you what Shalman did to the people of Beth-Arbel— mothers and their children will be beaten to death against rocks.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, ta aaabanina nyɛ, ni aaakpãtã nyɛmɔji lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Shalman kpãtã Bet-Arbel maŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ ta mli, ni eplenee emli yeifɔyei kɛ amɛbii fɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Bethel, this will be your fate because of your evil. Israel, at dawn your king will be killed.
translation_verse: Nakai nɔ ko pɛpɛɛpɛ baaba nyɛnɔ, nyɛ Betelbii. Efɔŋ kpeteŋkple ni nyɛfee lɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛmaŋtsɛ baagbo leebi maŋkpa.”

english_verse: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and I called my son out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Israel gbekɛbiashi beebe misumɔ lɛ kɛjɛ; Ijipt tɔ̃ɔ eyɔɔ ni mitsɛ lɛ akɛ mibi.

english_verse: But as the saying goes, “The more they were called, the more they rebelled.” They never stopped offering incense and sacrifices to the idols of Baal.
translation_verse: Shi shii abɔ ni mitsɛɔ lɛ lɛ, shii abɔ ni eyaa sɛɛsɛɛ moŋ eshiɔ mi ji no; ni amɛyaa nɔ amɛshãa afɔlei amɛhãa Baal, ni amɛshãa tsofakɛŋma amɛhãa amãgãi.

english_verse: I took Israel by the arm and taught them to walk. But they would not admit that I was the one who had healed them.
translation_verse: Tsɛbelɛ mi mifee Israel tataa ni ele nyiɛmɔ. Mihole amɛ mifɔ̃ mikpɔkɔiaŋ, shi amɛŋɔɔɔ nɔ akɛ mi mihere amɛ.

english_verse: I led them with kindness and with love, not with ropes. I held them close to me; I bent down to feed them.
translation_verse: Mikɛ suɔmɔ kɛ mlitsɔlɛ gbala amɛ kɛba miŋɔɔ; ni mitsɔ̃ tamɔ mɔ ni fãa amɛdaaŋ manyoflɛ, ni mikɛ niyenii ma amɛhiɛ.”

english_verse: But they rejected me, and so must return to Egypt; now Assyria will rule them.
translation_verse: “Amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaatee Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Asiria aaaye amɛnɔ, ejaakɛ amɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ amɛkpaleɔ kɛbaa miŋɔɔ.

english_verse: My people are determined to reject me for a god they think is stronger, but he can't help.
translation_verse: Beiaŋ ni mimɛi lɛ ekã akɛ shimɔ nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ amɛaashi mi lɛ, kɛ̃ɛmɔ nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ amɛaakɛ̃mɔ yɛ amɛkɔŋtso ni kã amɛkuɛ lɛ hewɔ, shi mɔ ko woŋ yɛ amɛnɔ.

english_verse: Israel, I can't let you go. I can't give you up. How could I possibly destroy you as I did the towns of Admah and Zeboiim? I just can't do it. My feelings for you are much too strong.
translation_verse: “Ao Israel, te mafee tɛŋŋ maŋmɛɛ ohe hu? Te mafee tɛŋŋ makwa bo hu? Aso manyɛ ohiɛ makpãtã tamɔ bɔ ni mifee Adma lɛ; aloo tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛ Zeboim ye lɛ? Mitsui miitswa yɛ mimli, ni mimusuŋ miitsɔ̃ mi yɛ ohe.

english_verse: Israel, I won't lose my temper and destroy you again. I am the Holy God— not merely some human, and I won't stay angry.
translation_verse: Mikɛ mlifu yeŋ osane lɛ. Mikpãtãŋ Israel hiɛ dɔŋŋ ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi, shi jeee gbɔmɔ. Mi, Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ, mibaŋ nyɛŋɔɔ kɛ mlifu.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will roar like a lion, and my children will return, trembling from the west.
translation_verse: “Mimɛi lɛ baanyiɛ, mi Yehowa, misɛɛ; beyinɔ ni mabo tamɔ jata lɛ amɛaaba kɛ hekpokpomɔ. Amɛhe aaakpokpo kɛaajɛ anaigbɛ kɛba.

english_verse: They will come back, fluttering like birds from Egypt or like doves from Assyria. Then I will bring them back to their homes. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel and Judah Compared
translation_verse: Amɛaaba kɛaajɛ Ijipt kɛ hekpokpomɔ tamɔ loofɔji; amɛaaba tamɔ okpoi kɛaajɛ Asiria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni mikɛ amɛ aaaku sɛɛ kɛaaba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshĩai amli ekoŋŋ. Mi, Yehowa, mi mikɛɛ.” Abu Yuda kɛ Israel fɔ

english_verse: Israel is deceitful to me, their loyal and holy God; they surround me with lies, and Judah worships other gods.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Israelbii ebɔle mihe kɛkpe kɛ amale kɛ mɔshishiumɔ, ni Yudabii kã he amɛmiitse miihiɛ atua, mi ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwafo kɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: All day long Israel chases wind from the desert; deceit and violence are found everywhere. Treaties are made with Assyria; olive oil is taken to Egypt. Israel and Judah Condemned
translation_verse: “Israelbii agbi muu mli tɔlɛ kɛ deŋme lɛ, ehe baaa sɛɛnamɔ ko, shi moŋ efiteɔ nii. Amɛhã amale kɛ yiwalɛ ebu yɛ amɛteŋ. Amɛ kɛ Asiria ekpãŋ, ni amɛ kɛ Ijipt miiye mu jara.”

english_verse: The Lord also brings charges against the people of Judah, the descendants of Jacob. He will punish them for what they have done.
translation_verse: “No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Yudabii lɛ yɛ sane. Ebaawo Israelbii nyɔmɔ yɛ amɛjeŋba naa; eeegbala amɛtoi yɛ amɛnifeemɔnii anaa.

english_verse: Even before Jacob was born, he cheated his brother, and when he grew up, he fought against God.
translation_verse: Amɛtsɛ Yakob lɛ ekɛ enyɛmi lɛ na be ni ekɛ lɛ fɛɛ yɔɔ musuŋ; ni be ni eda lɛ Yakob kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ hu.

english_verse: At Bethel, Jacob wrestled with an angel and won; then with tears in his eyes, he asked for a blessing, and God spoke to us there.
translation_verse: Yakob kɛ bɔfo lɛ nɔ, ni eye kunim; efo etsɔ̃ɔ bɔfo lɛ ni ebi edɛŋ jɔɔmɔ. Yakob kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kpe yɛ Betel, ni jɛi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ lɛ wie yɛ.

english_verse: God's name is the Lord, the Lord God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ni Yehowa, ji Tai aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni Yakob kɛwie lɛ, ni egbɛi ji Yehowa, ni no akɛkaiɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Israel, you enjoy cheating and taking advantage of others.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “jarayelɔ ni kɛ nsɛni ni atse etɛ nɔ ŋmɛɔ nii lɛ, shishiulɔ ji lɛ.

english_verse: You say to yourself, “I'm rich! I earned it all on my own, without committing a sin.” The Lord Is Still the God of Israel
translation_verse: Israel kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Shi bɛ mitsɔ̃ niiatsɛ, bɛ mina nii babaoo?’ Mideŋmegbomɔ mli nii lɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ anaaa tɔ̃mɔ ko ni tamɔ esha yɛ mihe?

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, am still your God, just as I have been since the time you were in Egypt. Now I will force you to live in tents once again, as you did in the desert.
translation_verse: Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kɛ nyɛ jɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ beebe kɛba lɛ. Mahã nyɛhi bui amli ekoŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛfee yɛ gbii juji anɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I spoke to the prophets— often I spoke in visions. And so, I will send my prophets with messages of doom.
translation_verse: “Mi mikɛ gbalɔi lɛ wie, ni mijie ninaa srɔtoi mitsɔ̃ɔ amɛ; asaŋ mitsɔ̃ amɛnɔ mibubuu mimɛi lɛ abɛi lɛ.

english_verse: Gilead is terribly sinful and will end up ruined. Bulls are sacrificed in Gilgal on altars made of stones, but those stones will be scattered in every field.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ aaja amãgãi yɛ Gilead; shi mɛi fɛɛ ni jaa amɛ lɛ aaagboi. Aagbe tsinai akɛmiishã afɔle yɛ Gilgal; shi afɔleshãa latɛi nɛɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ tɛi kuikui kɛkɛ yɛ amɛŋmɔjiashi akofii lɛ ateŋ.”

english_verse: Jacob escaped to Syria where he tended sheep to earn himself a wife.
translation_verse: Yakob jo foi kɛtee Mesopotamia. Eyasɔ̃mɔ yɛ jɛi yɛ ŋa hewɔ; eyakwɛ mɔ ko toi yɛ ŋa hewɔ.

english_verse: I sent the prophet Moses to lead Israel from Egypt and to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Yehowa tsu gbalɔ ni eyahere Israelbii lɛ ayiwala kɛje Ijipt kɛba, ni gbalɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ etsɔ̃ ekura amɛ.

english_verse: Israel, I will make you pay for your violent crimes and for insulting me.
translation_verse: Israelbii ewo Yehowa mli la naakpa; ni no hewɔ lɛ, esa akɛ amɛgboi; ni amɛmusu aaatere amɛ. Yehowa baagbala amɛtoi ejaakɛ amɛwo lɛ hiɛgbele.

english_verse: When your leaders spoke, everyone in Israel trembled and showed great respect. But you sinned by worshiping Baal, and you were destroyed.
translation_verse: Kulɛ kɛji Efraim shwiei lɛ wie lɛ, mɛi ahe kpokpoɔ yɛ Israel. Awo Efraim nɔ yɛ Israel; shi kɛtsɔ̃ jemawɔŋ Baal jamɔ nɔ lɛ, Efraim shwiei lɛ tɔ̃, ni no hewɔ amɛgboi.

english_verse: Now you continue to sin by designing and making idols of silver in the shape of calves. You are told to sacrifice to these idols— yes, even to kiss them.
translation_verse: Amɛkã he amɛmiifee esha lɛ lolo kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ ejaakɛ amɛkɛ amɛjwiɛtɛii yahãa ŋaalɔi, ni amɛhãa akɛ jwiɛtɛi lɛ shwieɔ amãgãi kɛ wɔji ahãa amɛ. Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Ashã afɔle ahã amɛ!” Mɛi ni yashãa afɔlei lɛ shwɔɔ tsinabi amãgãi lɛ anaa.

english_verse: And so, all of you will vanish like the mist or the dew of early morning, or husks of grain in the wind or smoke from a chimney.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi nɛɛ baalaaje tamɔ tutuu ni kɔɔyɔɔ loɔ kɛjɛɔ ŋmãagbeemɔhe kɛyaa lɛ, aloo tamɔ leebi bɔ ni kpalaa, loo afua ni hoɔ oya.

english_verse: I, the Lord, have been your God since the time you were in Egypt. I am the only God you know, the only one who can save.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni here nyɛyiwala kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ beebe lɛ. Nyɛleee Nyɔŋmɔ ko akɛ ja mi; ni mi misɛɛ hu lɛ yiwalaherelɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: I took care of you in a thirsty desert.
translation_verse: Mikwɛ nyɛnɔ yɛ shiaŋa ni nu bɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ,

english_verse: I fed you till you were satisfied, then you became proud and forgot about me.
translation_verse: shi be ni nyɛna nii nyɛye ni nyɛtɔrɔ pɛ, kɛkɛ ni nyɛwo nyɛhe nɔ ni nyɛhiɛ kpa minɔ.

english_verse: Now I will attack like a lion, ambush you like a leopard,
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mibahuru mayi nyɛnɔ tamɔ jata; mibawo nyɛ ka tamɔ mlaŋtswi yɛ gbɛtoi.

english_verse: and rip you apart like a bear robbed of her cubs. I will gnaw on your bones, as though I were a lion or some other wild animal.
translation_verse: Mibatua nyɛ oookɛɛ oshishibrishi ni amɔmɔ ebii yɛ ehe tuaa mɔ, ni mibatserɛ nyɛmli maye yɛ minajiaŋ tamɔ jata. No ji akɛ mibatserɛ nyɛmli mɛnyɛmɛnyɛ tamɔ ŋaŋ kooloo awuyelɔ tsɛrɛɔ loo mli lɛ.

english_verse: Israel, you are done for. Don't expect help from me.
translation_verse: “Kwɛ, Israel! Mibakpãtã ohiɛ; ni namɔ aaanyɛ oyiwala ahere?

english_verse: You wanted a king and rulers. Where is your king now? What cities have rulers?
translation_verse: Nɛgbɛ omaŋtsɛ lɛ yɔɔ koni ehere oyiwala; aloo nɛgbɛ nyɛlumɛi lɛ ni baafã nyɛhe lɛ yɔɔ, mɛi ahewɔ ni nyɛbi akɛ, ‘Ahã wɔ maŋtsɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ?’

english_verse: In my anger, I gave you a king; in my fury, I took him away. Israel's Terrible Fate The Lord said:
translation_verse: Mihã nyɛ maŋtsɛmɛi, shi yɛ mlifu naa; ni miŋɔ amɛ kɛtee yɛ mlila naa.

english_verse: Israel, your terrible sins are written down and stored away.
translation_verse: “Abua Israel nishaianii lɛ kɛ etɔ̃mɔi lɛ anaa ato ahã lɛ.

english_verse: You are like a senseless child who refuses to be born at the proper time.
translation_verse: Yoofɔyoo kɔ̃ɔmɔ be miiba ehã Israel; shi ehe bi kwashia ni eji hewɔ lɛ, emaaa eyi shi ebaaa awosojwaahe lɛ.

english_verse: Should I, the Lord, rescue you from death and the grave? No! I call death and the grave to strike you like a plague. I refuse to show mercy.
translation_verse: Mibahereŋ amɛ yɛ gbohiiaje dɛŋ; mibaŋ amɛyi yɛ gbele mli? Gbele, nɛgbɛ otsɛŋemɔ hela yɔɔ; ni Gbohiiaje, nɛgbɛ oniiahiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ yɔɔ? Minaŋ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ mɔbɔ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: No matter if you prosper more than the other tribes, I, the Lord, will wipe you out, just as a scorching desert wind dries up streams of water. I will take away your precious treasures.
translation_verse: Israel aaafrɔke tamɔ ŋɔi, shi bokã kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ la lɛ, ni ji Yehowa kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ, baafã kɛjɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ kɛba; ebaŋala amɛnuhiŋmɛii kɛ nubui fɛɛ amli nu; asaŋ eeekpãtã amɛnɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ jara hiɛ.

english_verse: Samaria will be punished for turning against me. It will be destroyed in war— children will be beaten against rocks, and pregnant women will be ripped open.
translation_verse: Samaria yi sɔ̃ lɛ baatere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ; emli bii lɛ ahiɛ aaakpãtã yɛ ta mli, akɛ emli abifabii lɛ aaatswiatswia shi; ni aaagbala amɛyeihɔlɔi lɛ amli.”

english_verse: Israel, return! Come back to the Lord, your God. Sin has made you fall.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Israelbii, nyɛkpalea kɛbaa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ. Nyɛnishaianii lɛ ehã nyɛtɛrɛ, ni nyɛgbee shi.

english_verse: Return to the Lord and say, “Please forgive our sins. Accept our good sacrifices of praise instead of bulls.
translation_verse: Nyɛkpalea kɛyaa Yehowa ŋɔɔ, nyɛyakpaa lɛ fai kɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛ efɔŋ ni wɔfee lɛ afa koni omɔ wɔfaikpamɔ nɛɛ mli, ni wɔɔkafo bo.

english_verse: Assyria can't save us, and chariots can't help. So we will no longer worship the idols we have made. Our Lord, you show mercy to orphans.” The Lord Promises To Forgive
translation_verse: Asiria nyɛŋ wɔyiwala ahere gbi ko gbi ko; ni tayaa okpɔŋɔi hu nyɛŋ afã wɔhe. Asaŋ amãgã ni wɔkɛ wɔniji fee lɛ wɔtsɛŋ lɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ dɔŋŋ. Yehowa, bo lɛ omusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ bo yɛ awusãi ahe.” Yehowa wo Israel shi yɛ wala hee he

english_verse: Israel, you have rejected me, but my anger is gone; I will heal you and love you without limit.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Mibahã amɛkpa anɔkwa ni amɛyeee lɛ. Mibasumɔ amɛ kɛ mitsui fɛɛ, ejaakɛ miŋmɛɛ mimli ni fu amɛ lɛ he.

english_verse: I will be like the dew— then you will blossom like lilies and have roots like a tree.
translation_verse: Mibatsɔ̃ tamɔ bɔ ni enyɔ shiaŋa nɔ mahã Israelbii. Amɛbaagba floŋŋ tamɔ fɔfɔi; ni amɛfãi aaaya su mli shɔŋŋ tamɔ Lebanon tsei.

english_verse: Your branches will spread with the beauty of an olive tree and with the aroma of Lebanon Forest.
translation_verse: Eniji ni ebaatsɛ̃rɛ aaalɛɛ shi, ni ehe fɛo aaatamɔ mu tso nɔ. Eeeje ŋma tamɔ Lebanon seda tsei lɛ.

english_verse: You will rest in my shade, and your grain will grow. You will blossom like a vineyard and be famous as the wine from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Amɛbaaba amɛbahi mifiji ashishi hɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ mli ekoŋŋ. Amɛaafɛo tamɔ abɔɔ, ni amɛaafrɔke tamɔ wain tso, ni amɛgbɛi aaahehe tamɔ Lebanon wain.

english_verse: Israel, give up your idols! I will answer your prayers and take care of you. I am that glorious tree, the source of your fruit.
translation_verse: Israelbii kɛ wɔji naŋ nɔ ko feemɔ dɔŋŋ. Mibabo amɛsɔlemɔ toi. Mibatsɔ̃ tso ni eyi baa kpalaaa mahã amɛ, ni mibabaa amɛyi; nyɛjɔɔmɔi fɛɛ baajɛ mi midɛŋ.” Sane lɛ naamuu

english_verse: If you are wise, you will know and understand what I mean. I am the Lord, and I lead you along the right path. If you obey me, we will walk together, but if you are wicked, you will stumble.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni le nii lɛ, enu saji nɛɛ ashishi; ni hiɛshikãlɔ lɛ ekɔ sɛɛ. Naa, Yehowa gbɛi fɛɛ ja, ni nomɛi mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii kɛbaa ejeŋ; nomɛi anaa mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii hiɔ shi yɛ; shi eshafeelɔi tswaa egbɛi lɛ amɛfɔ̃ɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛtɛrɛɔ, ni amɛgbeɔ shi.

english_verse: I am Joel the son of Pethuel. And this is the message the Lord gave to me. Locusts Cover the Land
translation_verse: Naa shɛɛ ni Yehowa kɛhã Yoel, Penuel binuu lɛ. Maŋbii lɛ ye ŋmɔshinii ni afite he ŋkɔmɔ

english_verse: Listen, you leaders and everyone else in the land. Has anything like this ever happened before?
translation_verse: Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛdara, nyɛboa toi, nyɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ, nyɛfea toi. Nɔ ni eba nɛɛ, ani eko eba dã yɛ nyɛyinɔ, loo yɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi ayinɔ tete?

english_verse: Tell our children! Let it be told to our grandchildren and their children too.
translation_verse: Nyɛgbaa nyɛbii, koni nyɛbii lɛ agba amɛbii, ni amɛbii lɛ hu agba yinɔ ni baa yɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Swarm after swarm of locusts has attacked our crops, eating everything in sight.
translation_verse: Baalabii baha wɔŋmɔshinii; nɔ ni ku kome shwɛ lɛ, ku ni nyiɛ sɛɛ baye.

english_verse: Sober up, you drunkards! Cry long and loud; your wine supply is gone.
translation_verse: Nyɛ gaalei, nyɛhiɛ atsɛ̃a ni nyɛfoa; nyɛ wainnulɔi, nyɛwɔa lele, ejaakɛ nyɛwain dɔkɔdɔkɔ lɛ eje nyɛdaaŋ.

english_verse: A powerful nation with countless troops has invaded our land. They have the teeth and jaws of powerful lions.
translation_verse: Baalabii, ta muu, ebatua wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ; amɛhe wa, ni anyɛɛɛ amɛ akane; amɛnyanyɔji anaa ba tamɔ jata nyanyɔji.

english_verse: Our grapevines and fig trees are stripped bare; only naked branches remain.
translation_verse: Amɛkpãtã wɔwaintsei lɛ ahiɛ; amɛkpe wɔgbãmitsei lɛ ahe. Amɛkpɔlɔ tsei lɛ ahe totoi lɛ, kɛyashi niji lɛ ahe yɛ sakoo.

english_verse: Grieve like a young woman mourning for the man she was to marry.
translation_verse: Wo yara tamɔ oblayoo ni foɔ eblayeiaŋ wu.

english_verse: Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple. His servants, the priests, are deep in sorrow.
translation_verse: Niyenii afɔle kɛ dãa sɛɛ efo yɛ Yehowa we lɛ. Osɔfoi ni ji Yehowa sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ, ejaakɛ afɔlei bɛ hã Yehowa.

english_verse: Barren fields mourn; grain, grapes, and olives are scorched and shriveled.
translation_verse: Akpãtã ŋmɔji lɛ ahiɛ; shikpɔŋ lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ, ejaakɛ akpãtã ŋmaa lɛ hiɛ; wainyibii lɛ egbi, mutsei lɛ eŋala.

english_verse: Mourn for our farms and our vineyards! There's no wheat or barley growing in our fields.
translation_verse: Nyɛ okwaafoi, nyɛyea ŋkɔmɔ. Nyɛ waintromkwɛlɔi, nyɛwoa yara yɛ ŋmaa kɛ akoko hewɔ, ejaakɛ ŋmɔshinii lɛ hiɛ ekpãtã.

english_verse: Grapevines have dried up and so has every tree— figs and pomegranates, date palms and apples. All happiness has faded away. Return to God
translation_verse: Waintsei lɛ eŋala; agbãmitsei lɛ egboi; akututsei kɛ tɛŋi kɛ atĩatsei, yelitsei fɛɛ egbigbii. Nyamɔ etã yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ.

english_verse: Mourn, you priests who serve at the altar of my God. Spend your days and nights wearing sackcloth. Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Osɔfoi, nyɛbua kpekpe, ni nyɛwoa yara; Nyɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he sɔ̃ɔlɔi, nyɛwɔa lele. Nyɛbotea Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni nyɛyea ŋkɔmɔ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ, nyɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi, ejaakɛ niyenii afɔle kɛ dãa afɔle ni akɛyaa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ, atsi naa.

english_verse: Tell the leaders and people to come together at the temple. Order them to go without eating and to pray sincerely.
translation_verse: Nyɛfãa koni ahi ŋmaa krɔŋkrɔŋ, nyɛtsɛa kpee hu. Nyɛbuaa onukpai lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ anaa kɛyaa Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ, ni nyɛbolɔa nyɛtsɛa lɛ.

english_verse: We are in for trouble! Soon the Lord All-Powerful will bring disaster.
translation_verse: Yehowa gbi lɛ eshɛ shi etã! Gbi ni Ofe lɛ kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ baa lɛ, nakai gbi lɛ baafee gbeyei!

english_verse: Our food is already gone; there's no more celebrating at the temple of our God.
translation_verse: Bɛ wɔhiŋmɛi kã nɔ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni akpãtãa wɔniyenii hiɛ, ni nyamɔ kɛ mliflimɔ hu sɛɛ efo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ?

english_verse: Seeds dry up in the ground; no harvest is possible. Our barns are in bad shape, with no grain to store in them.
translation_verse: Dumɔwui lɛ egboi yɛ su kukulii lɛ ashishi, aboŋoi lɛ kamɔ efolo, ŋmaatoohei lɛ ekumɔ, ejaakɛ ŋmaa lɛ eŋala.

english_verse: Our cattle wander aimlessly, moaning for lack of pasture, and sheep are suffering.
translation_verse: Kwɛ bɔ ni tsina kui lɛ kɛ̃mɔɔ kɛ nɔnaa, ejaakɛ amɛbɛ jwɛifɔ, ni toikui lɛ hu miina nɔ.

english_verse: I cry out to you, Lord. Grasslands and forests are eaten by the scorching heat.
translation_verse: Bo, Yehowa, mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ la ekpãtã ŋa nɔ jwɛifɔ lɛ hiɛ, ni lalilɛi eshã ŋa lɛ nɔ tsei lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Wild animals have no water because of you; rivers and streams are dry, and pastures are parched.
translation_verse: Ŋaŋ kooloi tete miibolɔ miitsɛ bo, ejaakɛ fai lɛ egbi, ni la ekpãtã ŋa nɔ jwɛifɔ hiɛ.

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion, the Lord's sacred hill. Warn everyone to tremble! The judgment day of the Lord is coming soon.
translation_verse: Nyɛkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ yɛ Zion; nyɛbɔa oshe yɛ migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ! Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ ahe akpokpo, ejaakɛ Yehowa gbi lɛ miiba; eshɛ shi etã.

english_verse: It will be dark and gloomy with storm clouds overhead. Troops will cover the mountains like thunderclouds. No army this powerful has ever been gathered before or will be gathered again.
translation_verse: Duŋ kɛ jeŋ tuutuufeemɔ gbi ni, atatu kɛ oblɔtu kpii gbi ni. Baalabii ta muu miiba tamɔ duŋ gbɛɔ shwãa gɔji anɔ lɛ. Nɔ ko ni tamɔ enɛ bako dã, ni asaŋ esɛɛ lɛ eko baŋ dɔŋŋ kɛaatee yinɔi ayinɔ.

english_verse: Fiery flames surround them; no one escapes. Before they invaded, the land was like Eden; now only a desert remains.
translation_verse: Baalabii lɛ yeɔ tsei lɛ tamɔ la yeɔ nii. Amɛhiɛgbɛ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ tamɔ Eden trom, shi amɛsɛɛgbɛ lɛ etamɔ ŋa kpataa. Nɔ ko nɔ ko ejeee amɛdɛŋ.

english_verse: They look like horses and charge like cavalry.
translation_verse: Amɛsu tamɔ okpɔŋɔi, amɛshaa foi tamɔ ta okpɔŋɔi.

english_verse: They roar over mountains like noisy chariots, or a mighty army ready for battle. They are a forest fire that feasts on straw.
translation_verse: Kɛji amɛmiitumɔ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, egbɛɔ tamɔ shwiilii; egbɛɔ tamɔ lalilɛi ni miishã gbetseli fɛlɛɔ; amɛtamɔ ta kpeteŋkple ni eto kɛbaagba ta.

english_verse: The very sight of them is frightening.
translation_verse: Kɛ amɛmiiba lɛ, maji ahe kpokpoɔ, ni hiɛiaŋ fɛɛ shaleɔ.

english_verse: They climb over walls like warriors; they march in columns and never turn aside.
translation_verse: Amɛtsɛ̃ɔ kɛbaa tamɔ kãkãlɔi, amɛkwɔɔ gbogboi tamɔ tabilɔi. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyiɛɔ egbɛ nɔ; amɛtsakeee amɛgbɛ koni eeeba akɛ mɔ ko aaayaje mɔ ko gbɛ nɔ;

english_verse: They charge straight ahead, without pushing each other; even arrows and spears cannot make them retreat.
translation_verse: mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyiɛ egbɛ nɔ. Amɛgbaa shi kutuu kɛtsɔ̃ɔ tawuu afabaŋi amli, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko etsiii amɛ gbɛ.

english_verse: They swarm over city walls and enter our homes; they crawl in through windows, just like thieves.
translation_verse: Amɛyatuaa maŋ; amɛjoɔ foi yɛ gbogboi anɔ; amɛkwɔɔ kɛboteɔ shĩai amli, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ samfɛji amli tamɔ julɔi.

english_verse: They make the earth tremble and the heavens shake; the sun and moon turn dark, and stars stop shining.
translation_verse: Kɛji amɛmiiba lɛ, shikpɔŋ hosoɔ, ni ŋwɛi kpokpoɔ bliblibli. Hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere woɔ duŋ, ni ŋulamii fɔ̃ɔ kpɛmɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God leads this army of countless troops, and they obey his commands. The day of his judgment is so terrible that no one can stand it. The Lord's Invitation
translation_verse: Yehowa woɔ egbee, ni efãa eta lɛ. Esra lɛ da naakpa, ni mɛi ni yeɔ efãmɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ, anyɛɛɛ amɛ akane. Yehowa gbi lɛ, ebaafee gbeyei! Namɔ po aaanyɛ naa adamɔ? Aatsɛ mɛi koni amɛtsake amɛtsui

english_verse: The Lord said: It isn't too late. You can still return to me with all your heart. Start crying and mourning! Go without eating.
translation_verse: “Shi amrɔ nɛɛ po Yehowa kɛɛ, nyɛshwaa nyɛhe anɔkwale mli, ni nyɛkpalea kɛbaa miŋɔɔ kɛ ŋmaahilɛ kɛ yaafo kɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli.”

english_verse: Don't rip your clothes to show your sorrow. Instead, turn back to me with broken hearts. I am merciful, kind, and caring. I don't easily lose my temper, and I don't like to punish.
translation_verse: Nyɛtsɛrɛa nyɛtsuii, shi jeee nyɛtadei; nyɛkpalea kɛbaa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ durolɔ kɛ mlitsɔ̃lɔ ji lɛ; emli fuu mra, ni eyeɔ eshiwoo nɔ; ni emɔbɔnalɛ fa, ni eshwaa ehe yɛ nɔ fɔŋ hewɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. Perhaps I will change my mind and treat you with mercy. Then you will be blessed with enough grain and wine for offering sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Ekolɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaatsake ejwɛŋmɔ, ni eeejɔɔ nyɛŋmɔshinii, ni nyɛkɛ niyenii afɔle kɛ dãa afɔle aaabahã Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion! Call the people together. Show your sorrow by going without food.
translation_verse: Nyɛkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ yɛ Zion; nyɛfãa akɛ ahi ŋmaa krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni nyɛtsɛa kpee ni mli wa.

english_verse: Make sure that everyone is fit to worship me. Bring adults, children, babies, and even bring newlyweds from their festivities.
translation_verse: Nyɛbuaa maŋ lɛ naa, nyɛsaa amɛ nyɛhãa kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ; nyɛbuaa gbekɛbii kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ fufɔ lɛ anaa! Ayɛmforo wu tete aje kpo yɛ esɛɛtsuŋ, ni ayɛmforo hu aje kpo yɛ epiaŋ.

english_verse: Tell my servants, the priests, to cry inside the temple and to offer this prayer near the altar: “Save your people, Lord God! Don't let foreign nations make jokes about us. Don't let them laugh and ask, ‘Where is your God?’ ” The Lord Will Bless the Land
translation_verse: Osɔfoi ni ji Yehowa sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ afo, ni amɛsɔle yɛ koi lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ amɛkɛɛ, “Yehowa, naa bo diɛŋtsɛ omaŋ lɛ mɔbɔ; kaahã maji krokomɛi miiye wɔhe fɛo amɛkɛɛ. ‘Nɛgbɛ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ?’ ” Nyɔŋmɔ hã shikpɔŋ lɛ ba nii ekoŋŋ

english_verse: The Lord was deeply concerned about his land and had pity on his people.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa ye shikpɔŋ lɛ he awuŋã ni ena emaŋ lɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: In answer to their prayers he said, “I will give you enough grain, wine, and olive oil to satisfy your needs. No longer will I let you be insulted by the nations.
translation_verse: Ehere amɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ mibahã nyɛ abele kɛ wain kɛ mu, koni nyɛye nyɛtɔrɔ; maji krokomɛi ebɔŋ nyɛ ahora dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: and does great things. So tell the soil to celebrate
translation_verse: “Shikpɔŋ, kaashe gbeyei, omii ashɛ ohe ni onya, ejaakɛ Yehowa etsu nii wuji.

english_verse: and wild animals to stop being afraid. Grasslands are green again; fruit trees and fig trees are loaded with fruit. Grapevines are covered with grapes.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ŋaŋ kooloi, nyɛkashea gbeyei, ejaakɛ niyelihe lɛ jwɛifɔ lɛ miifrɔke, ni tsei miiwo amɛyibii, agbãmi kɛ waintso hu ewo pii.

english_verse: People of Zion, celebrate in honor of the Lord your God! He is generous and has sent the autumn and spring rains in the proper seasons.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ Zionbii, nyɛmli afilia nyɛ yɛ nɔ ni nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ efee ehã nyɛ lɛ hewɔ. Ehã nu enɛ ehã nyɛ bɔ ni sa, ehã Gbo kɛ Agbiɛnaa enɛ ehã nyɛ tamɔ efeɔ daa lɛ.

english_verse: Grain will cover your threshing places; jars will overflow with wine and olive oil. The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: Ŋmãagbeemɔhei lɛ aaayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmaa, amɛhe bui lɛ aaateke nɔ kɛ wain kɛ mu.

english_verse: I, the Lord your God, will make up for the losses caused by those swarms and swarms of locusts I sent to attack you.
translation_verse: Nii ni baalabii kɛ otukpɛi kɛ gɔgɔmii lɛ eye, yɛ afii ni amɛba lɛ mli lɛ, mato nyɛ najiaŋ. Mi mihã baalabii ta babaoo lɛ ba batua nyɛ.

english_verse: My people, you will eat until you are satisfied. Then you will praise me for the wonderful things I have done. Never again will you be put to shame.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ nyɛaana nii pii nyɛaaye nyɛaatɔrɔ. Nyɛaajie Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛi lɛ yi, ejaakɛ etsu naakpɛɛ nii ehã nyɛ. Agbeŋ mimaŋ lɛ he guɔ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Israel, you will know that I stand at your side. I am the Lord your God— there are no other gods. Never again will you be put to shame. The Lord Will Work Wonders The Lord said:
translation_verse: No lɛ Israelbii, nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ miyɛ nyɛteŋ; nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi ji nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ. Agbeŋ mimaŋ lɛ he guɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ dɔŋŋ. Yehowa Gbi lɛ

english_verse: Later, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your old men will have dreams, and your young men will see visions.
translation_verse: “Enɛɛmɛi asɛɛ lɛ mafɔse mimumɔ lɛ mashwie gbɔmɛi fɛɛ anɔ; nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei lɛ aaagba, nyɛhiimeji lɛ aaala lamɔi, ni nyɛblahii lɛ aaana ninai.

english_verse: In those days I will even give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women.
translation_verse: Nyɛtsuji hii tete kɛ nyɛtsuji yei hu mafɔse mimumɔ lɛ mashwie amɛnɔ yɛ nakai be lɛ mli.

english_verse: I will work wonders in the sky above and on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: “Mahã ana gbi lɛ he okadii yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, láshishwiemɔ kɛ la kɛ lasu kpɔŋŋ.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before that great and terrible day when I appear.
translation_verse: Hulu aaawo duŋ, ni nyɔɔŋtsere aaatsu faa tamɔ lá. Dani Yehowa gbi wulu ni yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ aaaba.

english_verse: Then I, the Lord will save everyone who faithfully worships me. I have promised there will be survivors on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and among them will be my chosen ones.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaasɔle atsɛ Yehowa gbɛi lɛ, aaahere eyi wala. Ni tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ lɛ. Mɛi komɛi ahe aaaje mli, yɛ Zion Gɔŋ, Yerusalɛm; mɛi ni mahala lɛ ayi aaana wala.”

english_verse: At that time I, the Lord, will make Judah and Jerusalem prosperous again.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Nakai be lɛ mahã Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛm aku sɛɛ ashwere ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: Then in Judgment Valley I will bring together the nations that scattered my people Israel everywhere in the world, and I will bring charges against those nations. They divided up my land
translation_verse: Mabua maji lɛ fɛɛ anaa ni mikɛ amɛ aaakpeleke shi kɛaatee Kojomɔ Jɔɔ lɛ mli. Makojo amɛ yɛ jɛi yɛ nii fɛɛ ni amɛfee mimaŋ lɛ hewɔ. Amɛgbɛ mimaŋ Israelbii lɛ amɛshwã maji lɛ amli, ni amɛja Israel shikpɔŋ ni ji mishikpɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and gambled to see who would get my people; they sold boys and girls to pay for prostitutes and wine.
translation_verse: Amɛfɔ̃ oshiki amɛkɛja nomii lɛ amɛhã amɛhe. Amɛhɔ̃ɔ gbekɛbii hii amɛkɛhe ajwamãŋi, ni amɛhɔ̃ɔ gbekɛbii yei amɛkɛhe wain amɛnu.

english_verse: You people of Tyre and Sidon and you Philistines, why are you doing this? Are you trying to get even with me? I'll strike back before you know what's happened.
translation_verse: “Tiro kɛ Sidon kɛ Filistia shikpɔji fɛɛ, mɛni nyɛtaoɔ nyɛfee mi? Ani nɔ ko ni mifee najiaŋ nyɛtaoɔ nyɛto mi? Kɛji nakai ni lɛ, no lɛ shwiaa, ni mahã nii ni nyɛfee lɛ aku sɛɛ ababua nyɛyiteŋ;

english_verse: You've taken my prized possessions, including my silver and gold, and carried them off to your temples.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ nyɛŋɔ mijwiɛtɛi kɛ mishika lɛ, ni minibii ni jara wa lɛ nyɛloo kɛtee nyɛjamɔhei lɛ.

english_verse: You have dragged the people of Judah and Jerusalem from their land and sold them to the Greeks.
translation_verse: Nyɛhɔ̃ɔ Yudabii kɛ Yerusalɛmbii lɛ nyɛhã Helabii, ni nyɛjie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ kɛtee shɔŋŋ.

english_verse: But I'll make the people of Judah determined to come home, and what happened to them will happen to you.
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ mibahã amɛshi he ni nyɛhɔ̃ɔ amɛ kɛtee lɛ. Mibafee nyɛ nɔ ni nyɛfee amɛ lɛ.

english_verse: I'll hand over your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, who live far away. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment in Judgment Valley
translation_verse: Mahã ahɔ̃ɔ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei lɛ ahã Yudabii lɛ, ni Yudabii lɛ aaahɔ̃ɔ amɛ ahã Shebabii ni ji maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ bii lɛ. Mi, Yehowa, miwie enɛ.

english_verse: Say to the nations: “Get ready for war! Be eager to fight. Line up for battle and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: “Nyɛshiɛa shiɛmɔ nɛɛ yɛ maji lɛ ateŋ akɛ, ‘Nyɛsaa nyɛhe nyɛhãa ta; nyɛtsɛa nyɛtabilɔi lɛ; nyɛbuaa nyɛtabilɔi fɛɛ anaa ni nyɛfãa.

english_verse: Make swords out of plows and spears out of garden tools. Strengthen every weakling.”
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ nyɛkɔii asɔ̃a klantei ni nyɛkɛ adɔi lɛ asɔ̃a akplɔi; mɔ ni yɔɔ wudɔwudɔ tete akɛɛ akɛ, Mihe wa.’

english_verse: Hurry, all you nations! Come quickly. Ask the Lord to bring his warriors along.
translation_verse: Nyɛ jeŋmaji fɛɛ ni jwere shi kɛkpe, nyɛhe afea oya kɛbaa, ni nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli.’ ” Yehowa, hã ota lɛ aba abatua amɛ.

english_verse: You must come now to Judgment Valley, where the Lord will judge the surrounding nations.
translation_verse: “Maji lɛ asaa amɛhe koni amɛba Kojomɔ Jɔɔ lɛ mli. Jɛi, mi Yehowa, mibata makojo maji fɛɛ ni jwere shi kɛbɔle lɛ yɛ.

english_verse: They are a field of ripe crops. Bring in the harvest! They are grapes piled high. Start trampling them now! If our enemy's sins were wine, every jar would overflow.
translation_verse: Nyɛfolɔa amɛ nyɛshwiea shi tamɔ afolɔɔ ŋmaa yɛ nikpamɔ be mli lɛ; nyɛnaanaa amɛ tamɔ aŋaa wainyibii yɛ wain tsɔne ni eyi tɔ mli kɛyashiɔ wain lɛ bɔ̃iɔ hoo lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛyitsoŋ wa tsɔ̃.”

english_verse: Crowds fill Decision Valley. The judgment day of the Lord will soon be here—
translation_verse: Gbɔmɛi akpeiakpei abɔ yɛ Kojomɔ Jɔɔ lɛ mli. Jɛi ji he ni Yehowa Gbi ni eshɛ etã lɛ baaba yɛ.

english_verse: no light from the sun or moon, and stars no longer shine.
translation_verse: Hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere ewo duŋ, ni ŋulamii efɔ̃ɔ kpɛmɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ aaajɔɔ emaŋ lɛ

english_verse: From the heart of Jerusalem the Lord roars like a lion, shaking the earth and sky. But the Lord is a fortress, a place of safety for his people Israel. God Will Bless His People
translation_verse: Yehowa miihuu kɛjɛ Zion, ni egbee miijije kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm; ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ miihoso. Shi Yehowa ji abobaahe hã emaŋ lɛ, kɛ mɔɔ ni wa hu hã Israelbii lɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. And you will know I live on Zion, my sacred hill, because Jerusalem will be sacred, untouched by foreign troops.
translation_verse: “Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ, mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Mihiɔ Zion, migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Yerusalɛm aaatsɔ̃ maŋ wulu krɔŋkrɔŋ; gbɔi nyɛŋ enɔ amɛye kɔkɔɔkɔ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: On that day, fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains. And your cattle and goats that graze on the hills will produce a lot of milk. Streams in Judah will never run dry; a stream from my house will flow in Acacia Valley.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ, gɔji lɛ anɔ aaayi tɔ kɛ waintromii, ni aaana tsinai yɛ gɔŋ fɛɛ gɔŋ nɔ; ni nu aaaho yɛ Yuda jɔi lɛ fɛɛ amli. Nuhiŋmɛi aaaho kɛaajɛ Yehowa We lɛ, ni eeeyahã Akasia Jɔɔ lɛ nu.

english_verse: Egypt and Edom were cruel and brutal to Judah, without a reason. Now their countries will become a barren desert,
translation_verse: “Ijipt aaatsɔ̃ shiaŋa, ni Edom aaatsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ ni egbo; ejaakɛ amɛbatua Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛshwie enɔ bii ni efeko efɔŋ ko lɛ alá shi.

english_verse: I am Amos. And I raised sheep near the town of Tekoa when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel. Two years before the earthquake, the Lord gave me several messages about Israel,
translation_verse: Amos, ni ji tookwɛlɔ ko ni jɛ Tekoa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, gbalɛ wiemɔi nɛ. Naa Nyɔŋmɔ jie ninaa nɛɛ yɛ Israel he etsɔ̃ɔ Amos afii enyɔ dani shikpɔŋ hoso, be mli ni Uzia yeɔ Yuda maŋtsɛ, ni Yeroboam, Yehoash bi lɛ, hu yeɔ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ.

english_verse: and I said: When the Lord roars from Jerusalem, pasturelands and Mount Carmel dry up and turn brown. Judgment on Syria
translation_verse: Amos kɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa miihũu tamɔ jata yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni egbee miishi yɛ Yerusalɛm. Shikpɔji lɛ anɔ jwɛi fɔ aaaŋala, ni Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ aaagbi.” Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala mɛi ni bɔle Israel he lɛ atoi

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Syria for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged logs with spikes over the people of Gilead.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Damaskobii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛgbɛlɛ Gileadbii tamɔ akɛ dade gbɛlɛɔ nii.

english_verse: Now I will burn down the palaces and fortresses of King Hazael and of King Benhadad.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mibama Maŋtsɛ Hazael maŋtsɛ we lɛ naa la, ni la nɛɛ baashã Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad mɔji fɛɛfɛji lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: I will break through the gates of Damascus. I will destroy the people of Wicked Valley and the ruler of Beth-Eden. Then the Syrians will be dragged as prisoners to Kir. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Philistia
translation_verse: Mibakumɔ Damasko maŋ lɛ naa agboi lɛ mashwie shi; mibaplene Aven Jɔɔ lɛ mli gbɔmɛi lɛ kɛ lumɔ ni yeɔ Bet-eden nɔ lɛ hu, ni mibaŋɔ Siria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ anom kɛya Kir shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Yehowa ni kɛɛ.” Filistia

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Philistia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Gazabii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛŋɔ jaku muu fɛɛ nom kɛtee amɛyahã Edombii.

english_verse: That's why I will burn down the walls and fortresses of the city of Gaza.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mibama Gaza maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ naa la, ni ebaashã maŋ lɛ mli mɔji lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the ruler of Ashkelon. I will strike down Ekron, and that will be the end of the Philistines. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Phoenicia
translation_verse: Mibaplene Ashdod maŋ lɛ mli bii kɛ lumɔ ni yeɔ Ashkelon nɔ lɛ hu; ni mibatsɔ̃ mihiɛ mawo Ekron hu, ni mibakpãtã Filistibii ni baashwɛ lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.” Tiro

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Phoenicia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They broke their treaty and dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Tiro etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛŋɔ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ amɛwo Edom dɛŋ, ni amɛkaiii kwraa nyɛmimɛi akpãŋmɔ ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ.

english_verse: That's why I will send flames to burn down the city of Tyre along with its fortresses. Judgment on Edom
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mibama Tiro maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ naa la, ni ebaashã maŋ lɛ mli mɔji fɛɛfɛji lɛ fɛɛ.” Edom

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Edom for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They killed their own relatives and were so terribly furious that they showed no mercy.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Edombii tɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛtse klante yɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛgbe amɛ bɔ ni musuŋtsɔlɛ ko bɛ mli kwraa; amɛniŋ nii ahe aahu, ni amɛŋmɛɛɛ mlifu he kwrakwra.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to wipe out the fortresses of Teman and Bozrah. Judgment on Ammon
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mibama Teman maŋ lɛ naa la, ni la nɛɛ baashã Bazra mɔji lɛ fɛɛ.” Amon

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Ammon for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. In Gilead they ripped open pregnant women, just to take the land.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Amonbii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ taitai ni amɛfãfãa bɔ ni afee ni amɛlɛɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ husui amli hewɔ lɛ, amɛgbalagbalaa Gilead yeihɔlɔi amusui amli, ni bii lɛ je shwie shi.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to destroy the walls and fortresses of Rabbah. Enemies will shout and attack like a whirlwind.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mibama Raba maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ naa la, ni ebaashã emli mɔji lɛ. Gbi lɛ abaabɔ tawuu oshe, ni ta lɛ naa baawa tamɔ ahum ni efã.

english_verse: Ammon's king and leaders will be dragged away. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Abaaŋɔ amɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ elumɛi lɛ fɛɛ nom kɛaatee. Yehowa ni kɛɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Moab for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They made lime from the bones of the king of Edom.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Moabbii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛshã Edom maŋtsɛ gbonyo wui kɛyashi etsɔ̃ lamlu, ni amɛkɛshwie ehiɛ shi.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to destroy the fortresses of Kerioth. Battle shouts and trumpet blasts will be heard as I destroy Moab
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mibama Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ naa la, ni la nɛɛ baashã Keriot maŋ lɛ mli mɔji lɛ fɛɛ. Moabbii lɛ baagboi yɛ oshebɔɔ kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɛmɔ kɛ hoofeemɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: with its king and leaders. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: Mibaplene Moab maŋ nɔyelɔi lɛ, ni mibagbe emli lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ hu mafata he.” Yuda

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Judah for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They have rejected my teachings and refused to obey me. They were led astray by the same false gods their ancestors worshiped.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Yudabii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛkwa Yehowa mlai lɛ, ni amɛyeee ekpɔi lɛ anɔ. Apasa jemawɔji asɛɛ ni amɛyanyiɛ, tamɔ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ yanyiɛ lɛ, hã amɛdu gbɛ.

english_verse: Now I will send fire on Judah and destroy the fortresses of Jerusalem. Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mibama Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ naa la, ni ebaashã Yerusalɛm mɔji lɛ fɛɛ.” Israel toigbalamɔ

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Israel for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They sell honest people for money, and the needy are sold for the price of sandals.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Israelbii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛhɔ̃ɔ jalɔi amɛhe jwiɛtɛi, ni ohiafo lɛ amɛhɔ̃ɔ lɛ tokota jara naa.

english_verse: They smear the poor in the dirt and push aside those who are helpless. My holy name is dishonored, because fathers and sons sleep with the same young women.
translation_verse: Amɛnaanaa ohiafoi ayitsei anɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ mlu mli, ni amɛtsirɛɔ mɛi ni ehao kɛyaa gbɛsɛɛ. Mɔ kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsɛ fɛɛ kɛ oblayoo kome lɛ nɔŋŋ naa bɔlɛ, ni amɛkɛbuleɔ migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: They lie down beside altars on clothes taken as security for loans. And they drink wine in my temple, wine bought with the money they received from fines.
translation_verse: Amɛkãmɔɔ atadei ni akɛbato amɛ awaba anɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ fɛɛ afɔleshãa latɛ naa, ni amɛnuɔ wain ni ahe yɛ mɛi ni abu amɛ fɔ adɛŋ yɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.

english_verse: Israel, the Amorites were there when you entered Canaan. They were tall as cedars and strong as oaks. But I wiped them out— I destroyed their branches and their roots.
translation_verse: “Shi kɛ̃lɛ mikpãtã Amorbii ni kwɔlɔ tamɔ tsenedru tsei, ni amɛhe wa hu tamɔ odum lɛ ahiɛ yɛ amɛ, Israelbii, ahiɛ. Mikpãtã amɛnɔ yibii lɛ ahiɛ, ni mifite amɛshishi fãi lɛ fɛɛ hu.

english_verse: I had rescued you from Egypt, and for forty years I had led you through the desert. Then I gave you the land of the Amorites.
translation_verse: Mijie nyɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mikpala nyɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ kɛba koni nyɛbaŋɔ Amorbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I chose some of you to be prophets and others to be Nazirites. People of Israel, you know this is true. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Mitee nyɛbihii lɛ ekomɛi ashi, ni mifee amɛ gbalɔi, ni mifee nyɛblahii lɛ ekomɛi hu Nazirifoi. Israelbii, ebɛ mli nakai lo? Mi Yehowa mikɛɛ.

english_verse: But you commanded the prophets not to speak their message, and you pressured the Nazirites into drinking wine.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛhã Nazirifoi lɛ bɔ̃i dãanumɔ, ni amɛkɛku kitã ni amɛkã Nyɔŋmɔ mli, ni nyɛwo gbalɔi lɛ akitã akɛ amɛkagba gbalɛ ni mikɛhã amɛ lɛ.

english_verse: And so I will crush you, just as a wagon full of grain crushes the ground.
translation_verse: Naa, mibamia nyɛ makpɛtɛ shi tamɔ shwiili ni ewo ŋmaa tɔtɔɔtɔ miaa nii kpɛtɛɔ shi.

english_verse: No matter how fast you run, you won't escape. No matter how strong you are, you will lose your strength and your life.
translation_verse: Foijee aaalaaje mɔ ni he yɔɔ oya kɛ foijee, hewalɛ aaaŋmɛɛɛ hewalɔ, ni kãkãlɔ hu nyɛŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiwala po ehere.

english_verse: Even if you are an expert with a bow and arrow, you will retreat. And you won't get away alive, not even if you run fast or ride a horse.
translation_verse: Gãitsɛ̃lɔi nyɛŋ shi amɛdamɔ lɛ, foijelɔ he ejeŋ mli lɛ, mɔ ni ta okpɔŋɔ nɔ hu hereŋ eyiwala.

english_verse: You may be brave and strong, but you will run away, stripped naked. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ kãkãlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ni tsui esa tete aaajo foi kɛ ehe yayai.” Yehowa ni kɛɛ.

english_verse: People of Israel, I rescued you from Egypt. Now listen to my judgment against you.
translation_verse: Israelbii, nyɛboa nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ ni Yehowa wie yɛ nyɛhe lɛ toi, nyɛ ni nyɛ ji jaku muu ni eyajie kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba lɛ,

english_verse: Of all nations on earth, you are the only one I have chosen. That's why I will punish you because of your sins. The Work of a Prophet
translation_verse: “Jeŋ maji fɛɛ ateŋ lɛ, nyɛ pɛ ji maŋ ni mile, ni no hewɔ lɛ, mibawo nyɛ nibii gbohii ni nyɛfee lɛ ahe nyɔmɔ.” Gbalɔ gbɛnaa nitsumɔ

english_verse: Can two people walk together without agreeing to meet?
translation_verse: Ani mɛi enyɔ feɔ ekome kɛnyiɛɔ gbɛ kɛji amɛkpãŋko he?

english_verse: Does a lion roar in the forest unless it has caught a victim? Does it growl in its den unless it is eating?
translation_verse: Ani jata hũuɔ yɛ koo mli be mli ni enako kooloo ko ni eeemɔ lo? Ani jata oblayoo woɔ egbee yɛ ebu mli kɛji emɔko loo ko lo?

english_verse: How can anyone catch a bird without using a net? Does a trap spring shut unless something is caught?
translation_verse: Ani loofɔlɔ duɔ tsɔne yɛ shikpɔŋ kɛji atsɔ̃ko lɛ tsɔne yɛ jɛi lo? Ani tsɔne fɛɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ be mli ni eduko nɔ ko?

english_verse: Isn't the whole city frightened when the trumpet signals an attack? Isn't the Lord the one who brings disaster on a city?
translation_verse: Ani tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɔ yɛ maŋ ni maŋbii lɛ hɛleee shi lo? Ani amane baa maŋ ko nɔ ni jeee Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛ lo?

english_verse: Whatever the Lord God plans to do, he tells his servants, the prophets.
translation_verse: Eji anɔkwale akɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ efeee nɔ ko ni ejieee eyiŋtoo lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔɔ etsuji gbalɔi lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone is terrified when a lion roars— and ordinary people become prophets when the Lord God speaks. Samaria Is Doomed
translation_verse: Kɛji jata miihuu lɛ, namɔ sheee gbeyei? Kɛji Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ewie lɛ, namɔ baakwa akɛ eshiɛɛɛ gbalɛ ni akɛhã lɛ lɛ? Samaria hiɛkpãtãmɔ

english_verse: Here is a message for the leaders of Philistia and Egypt— tell everyone to come together on the hills of Samaria. Let them see the injustice and the lawlessness in that city.
translation_verse: Kɛɛmɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Ashdod kɛ Ijipt mɔji lɛ amli lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyabuaa nyɛhe naa yɛ Samaria gɔji lɛ anɔ koni nyɛkwɛa basabasa ni afeɔ kɛ niseniianii ni yaa nɔ yɛ Samaria.”

english_verse: The Lord has said that they don't even know how to do right. They have become rich from violence and robbery.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Amɛkɛ yiwalɛ kɛ juu buaa nibii anaa yɛ mɔji lɛ amli. Amɛleee nɔ ni ja gbɛ feemɔ tete.

english_verse: And so the Lord God has sworn that they will be surrounded. Enemies will break through their defenses and steal their treasures.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Henyɛlɔi aaabɔle shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛaakpe, ni amɛaakumɔ nibii ni akɛfãa shikpɔŋ lɛ he lɛ amɛshwie shi, ni amɛaaha mɔji lɛ amli nii ofɔ̃ kɛya.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord has promised that only a few from Samaria will escape with their lives and with some broken pieces of their beds and couches. It will be like when a shepherd rescues two leg bones and part of a sheep's ear from the jaws of a lion. The Altars at Bethel
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni tookwɛlɔ shɔ̃ɔ too shuɔji enyɔ loo etoi kuku kɛkɛ po yɛ jata daaŋ lɛ, nakai kɛji eshwɛ saatso tso kuku kɛkɛ loo saashwɛ tete akɛbaahere Israelbii ni yɔɔ Samaria lɛ ayiwala.”

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful told me to speak this message against Jacob's descendants:
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛboa toi, ni nyɛkɛa Yakob shwiei lɛ

english_verse: When I, the Lord, punish Israel for their sins, I will destroy the altars at Bethel. Even the corners of the altar will be left in the dirt.
translation_verse: akɛ, gbi nɔ ni mibagbala Israelbii atoi yɛ amɛtoigbele hewɔ lɛ, mibakpãtã Betel afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ hu ahiɛ. Abaakumɔ akloŋtoi ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛi nɛɛ akoji lɛ ashwie shi.

english_verse: I will tear down winter homes and summer homes. Houses decorated with ivory and all other mansions will be gone forever. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Shĩa ni ama ato fɛ̃i be kɛ nɔ ni ama ato latsaa be hu mibakpãtã fɛɛ hiɛ shi kome; shĩai ni akɛ shuɔ wu esaa amɛmli fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃; ni shĩa wulu fɛɛ shĩa wulu hiɛ baakpãtã,” Yehowa kɛɛ.

english_verse: You women of Samaria are fat cows! You mistreat and abuse the poor and needy, then you say to your husbands, “Bring us more drinks!”
translation_verse: Nyɛ Samaria yei ni nyɛshwishwii tamɔ Bashan tsinayei ni yɔɔ Samaria gɔji anɔ lɛ, nyɛboa wiemɔ nɛɛ toi. Te nyɛwaa ohiafoi ayi, ni nyɛshwishwiaa mɛi ni efĩ amɛ shi, ni nyɛkɛɔ nyɛwumɛi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyataoa nɔ ni wɔɔnu kɛba!”

english_verse: I, the Lord God, have sworn by my own name that your time is coming. Not one of you will be left— you will be taken away by sharp hooks.
translation_verse: Naa, beiaŋ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ekã kitã akɛ, “Gbii miiba ni akɛ kpoŋ baalalaa nyɛ, ni akpala nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛya. Nyɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ loi ni tsɛ̃rɛ kpoji anaa.

english_verse: You will be dragged through holes in your city walls, and you will be thrown toward Harmon. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel Refuses To Obey The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baanyiɛ kɛya ehiɛ tɛ̃ɛ, kɛyashɛ fɔji ni egbulɔ yɛ maŋ gbogboi lɛ amli lɛ ahe, ni aaahole nyɛ kɛtsɔ̃ fɔji nɛɛ amli atsirɛ ashwie Harmon,” Yehowa kɛɛ. Israel ekaseee nii

english_verse: Come to Bethel and Gilgal. Sin all you want! Offer sacrifices the next morning and bring a tenth of your crops on the third day.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ Israelbii, nyɛbaa Betel nyɛbatɔ̃a mla; nyɛyaa Gilgal nyɛyahãa mlanɔtɔ̃mɔ lɛ afaa; nyɛkɛ nyɛfɔlei abaa koni ashã daa leebi; ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnibii amlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ abaa daa gbii etɛ̃.

english_verse: Bring offerings to show me how thankful you are. Gladly bring more offerings than I have demanded. You really love to do this. I, the Lord God, have spoken! How the Lord Warned Israel
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ ma ni esha abashãa shidaa fɔlei lɛ, ni nyɛshiɛa kɛfoa shi akɛ nyɛshãa tsuijurɔ naa afɔlei hu, ejaakɛ nakai feemɔ ji nɔ ni ŋɔɔ nyɛnaa. Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, took away the food from every town and village, but still you rejected me.
translation_verse: “Mi, mihã hɔmɔ ye nyɛ, ni daaŋtaa bɔ nyɛ yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ; aboloo hɔmɔ ye nyɛ, shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ nyɛkpaleko kɛbako miŋɔɔ.” Yehowa kɛɛ.

english_verse: Three months before harvest, I kept back the rain. Sometimes I would let it fall on one town or field but not on another, and pastures dried up.
translation_verse: “Asaŋ be ni eshwɛ nyɔji etɛ̃ ni akɛkpaa ŋmɔshinii lɛ tete mihãaa nu anɛ nyɛ. Mihã nu nɛ maŋ kome ko nɔ, shi mihãaa enɛ maŋ ko hu nɔ. Nu nɛ ŋmɔ ko shi, ni nu enɛɛɛ ŋmɔ ko hu shi, no hewɔ lɛ, ŋmɔ ni enɛɛɛ mli lɛ mli nii ŋala.

english_verse: People from two or three towns would go to a town that still had water, but it wasn't enough. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Maji enyɔ loo etɛ̃ mli bii didãa kɛ kumai kɛyagbee maŋ ko nɔ koni amɛyatao nu ni amɛnu; shi nu ni amɛyana lɛ eyashɛɛɛ amɛnaa. Shi kɛ̃lɛ nyɛkpaleko kɛbako miŋɔɔ,” Yehowa kɛɛ.

english_verse: I dried up your grain fields; your gardens and vineyards turned brown. Locusts ate your fig trees and olive orchards, but even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: “Mihã kɔɔyɔɔ kɛ emli dɔlɛ fã, ni eŋala nyɛŋmɔshinii, ni baalabii kpãtã nyɛbɔ̃ɔi kɛ nyɛwain tromi kɛ nyɛgbami tsei kɛ nyɛmu tsei bluublu ahiɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ nyɛkpaleko kɛbako miŋɔɔ.” Yehowa kɛɛ.

english_verse: I did terrible things to you, just as I did to Egypt— I killed your young men in war; I let your horses be stolen, and I made your camp stink with dead bodies. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: “Mihã gbele hela tamɔ Ijipt hela lɛ bote nyɛteŋ, ni mihã nyɛblahii lɛ nyɔnyɔɔ yɛ ta mli, ni ashɔ̃shɔ̃ɔ nyɛkpɔŋɔi yɛ nyɛdɛŋ kɛtee. Mihã nyɛgbohii ni jwere nyɛnsrai amli lɛ je fu wo nyɛ. Shi fɛɛ lɛ nyɛkpaleko kɛbako miŋɔɔ.”

english_verse: I destroyed many of you, just as I did the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. You were a burning stick I rescued from the fire. But even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mikpãtã nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ahiɛ tamɔ mifee Sodom kɛ Gomora lɛ. Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyi na wala lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ la tso ni afã yɛ la naa; ni kɛ̃lɛ nyɛkpaleko kɛbako miŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Now, Israel, I myself will deal with you. Get ready to face your God!
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii, agbɛnɛ mibagbala nyɛ toi. Ni akɛni mibafee nyɛ nakai hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsaa nyɛhe nyɛkɛkpea nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ toigbalamɔ naa.”

english_verse: I created the mountains and the wind. I let humans know what I am thinking. I bring darkness at dawn and step over hills. I am the Lord God All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Naa, mɔ ni shɔ̃ gɔji lɛ, ni ebɔ kɔɔyɔɔ, ni egbaa gbɔmɔ nɔ ni ji lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ eyiŋtoo. Lɛ mɔ ni ehãa jetsɛremɔ tsɔ̃ɔ duŋ, ni enyiɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ, Egbɛi ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ.

english_verse: Listen, nation of Israel, to my mournful message:
translation_verse: Israelbii, nyɛboa yaafo lala ni miwoɔ nɔ yɛ nyɛhe nɛɛ toi.

english_verse: You, dearest Israel, have fallen, never to rise again— you lie deserted in your own land, with no one to help you up.
translation_verse: Israel oblayeiaŋ etã, egbee shi, ni eteŋ shi dɔŋŋ. Akwa lɛ yɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ, ni mɔ ko bɛ ni woɔ enɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God has warned, “From every ten soldiers only one will be left; from a thousand troops, only a hundred will survive.”
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Maŋ ni baawo asraafoi akpe gbɛ kɛya ta lɛ, eeeshwɛ asraafoi oha pɛ ahã lɛ, ni maŋ ni woɔ asraafoi oha gbɛ lɛ, eeeshwɛ emɛi nyɔŋma pɛ ni aaaku amɛsɛɛ aba Israel we lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord keeps saying, “Israel, turn back to me and you will live!
translation_verse: Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ Israelbii ji akɛ, “Nyɛtaoa mi misɛɛgbɛ, ni nyɛyi aaana wala,

english_verse: Don't go to Gilgal or Bethel or even to Beersheba. Gilgal will be dragged away, and Bethel will end up as nothing.”
translation_verse: shi nyɛkataoa Betel sɛɛgbɛ, ni nyɛkayaa Gilgal hu, aloo nyɛmitse mli kɛmiiya Beersheba; ejaakɛ abaaŋɔ Gilgalbii nom, ni Betel hiɛ baakpãtã.”

english_verse: Turn back to the Lord, you descendants of Joseph, and you will live. If you don't, the Lord will attack like fire. Bethel will burn to the ground, and no one can save it.
translation_verse: Nyɛtaoa Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ, ni nyɛyi baana wala. Kɛjeee nakai lɛ Yehowa aaaba tamɔ la ni eje yɛ Israelbii ateŋ, ni eeeshã nii. La nɛɛ baakpãtã Betel hiɛ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ agbe ahã Betel.

english_verse: You people are doomed! You twist the truth and trample on justice.
translation_verse: Kpoo hã nyɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni jalɛ saneyeli joɔ hãa nyɛ tamɔ taatso, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛkɛ jalɛ saneyeli shwishwia shikpɔŋ!

english_verse: But the Lord created the stars and put them in place. He turns darkness to dawn and daylight to darkness; he scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth.
translation_verse: Naa, mɔ ni bɔ ŋulamii, “Wuɔ kɛ ebii kɛ Oŋwɛ” mɔ ni hãa duŋ kpii tsɔ̃ɔ jetsɛremɔ, ni ehãa shwane woɔ duŋ ni etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ nyɔŋ. Lɛ mɔ ni efãa ŋshɔ mli nu, ni efɔseɔ eshwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, Yehowa ji egbɛi.

english_verse: God destroys mighty soldiers and strong fortresses. Choose Good Instead of Evil! The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ehãa hewalɔ hiɛ kpãtãa kɛkɛ lɛ mɔɔ ni wa lɛ hu hiɛ ekpãtã.
