english_verse: you abuse the poor and demand heavy taxes from them. You have built expensive homes, but you won't enjoy them; you have planted vineyards, but you will get no wine.
translation_verse: Akɛni nyɛnaanaa ohiafo nɔ, ni nyɛtsuɔ lɛ abele onia fe bɔ ni sa hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ tɛ ni ako emamɔ shĩai; shi moŋ nyɛhiŋ amɛmli; ni nyɛfeefee wain tromi fɛɛfɛji moŋ, shi nyɛnuŋ amɛmli wain.

english_verse: I am the Lord, and I know your terrible sins. You cheat honest people and take bribes; you rob the poor of justice.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mile akɛ nyɛmlanɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ fa, ni mile eshai ni nyɛfeefee anaawalɛ. Nyɛgbaa jalɔ naa, ni nyɛheɔ nyɔŋnii, ni nyɛŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ koni ohiafo kɛ esane ashɛ koishi koni aye ahã lɛ.

english_verse: Times are so evil that anyone with good sense will keep quiet.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni le nii lɛ, efeɔ diŋŋ nɛkɛ be mli, ejaakɛ be lɛ be fɔŋ ni.

english_verse: Choose good instead of evil! See that justice is done. Maybe I, the Lord All-Powerful, will be kind to what's left of your people. Judgment Is Coming
translation_verse: Nyɛtaoa nɔ kpakpa, shi jeee nɔ fɔŋ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛyi ana wala, kɛkɛ lɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ aaahi shi kpakpa; ni nyɛyea jalɛ sane yɛ koishi akɛ aleee nɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, aaadro Yosef shwiei ni eshwɛ lɛ lo!

english_verse: You look forward to the day when the Lord comes to judge. But you are in for trouble! It won't be a time of sunshine; all will be darkness.
translation_verse: Kpoo hã nyɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛshweɔ Yehowa gbi lɛ. Mɛni nyɛbaana yɛ Yehowa gbi lɛ nɔ? Naa, duŋ gbi ni, shi jeee la gbi ni:

english_verse: You will run from a lion, only to meet a bear. You will escape to your house, rest your hand on the wall, and be bitten by a snake.
translation_verse: nɔ ni baaba lɛ etamɔ mɔ ko ni joɔ jata naa foi, ni ekɛ oshishibrishi kpeɔ, loo be ni eba shĩa ni ekɛ enine mɔ gbogbo mli lɛ onufu kɔ̃ lɛ.

english_verse: The day when the Lord judges will be dark, very dark, without a ray of light. What the Lord Demands
translation_verse: Naa, Yehowa gbi lɛ duŋ aaawo, ni hulu etsoŋ; nakai gbi lɛ duŋ kpii aaawo bɔ ni la bɛ he ko he ko.

english_verse: I, the Lord, hate and despise your religious celebrations and your times of worship.
translation_verse: Miihi nyɛgbii juji lɛ; amɛjeee nɔ ko kɛhã mi; ni nyɛhe naa ni nyɛbuaa kɛjaa mi lɛ tete, mibɛ he miishɛɛ.

english_verse: I won't accept your offerings or animal sacrifices— not even your very best.
translation_verse: Nyɛshãa shãa afɔlei kɛ nyɛniyenii afɔlei tete nyɛhãa mi nɛ, shi miheee. Shidaa afɔlei ni nyɛkɛ nyɛkooloi ni eshwishwii shãa lɛ hu, mikwɛɛɛ po.

english_verse: No more of your noisy songs! I won't listen when you play your harps.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ nyɛlalai lɛ ajea minɔ; mitaooo nyɛsaŋkui lɛ agbɛɛmɔ hu toi mabo.

english_verse: But let justice and fairness flow like a river that never runs dry.
translation_verse: Nyɛyea jalɛ sane moŋ koni etsɔ̃ tamɔ nu ni hoɔ; nyɛhãa jalɛ ahea shi, ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ faa ni hoɔ daa.

english_verse: Israel, for forty years you wandered in the desert, without bringing offerings or sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: “Israelbii, mɛɛ kooloi afɔlei kɛ niyenii afɔlei nyɛshã nyɛhã mi yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ?

english_verse: I will force you to march as captives beyond Damascus. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: ni mahã aŋɔ nyɛ nom kɛya Damasko sɛɛ.” Nɔ ni Yehowa, mɔ ni gbɛi ji Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Do you rulers in Jerusalem and in the city of Samaria feel safe and at ease? Everyone bows down to you, and you think you are better than any other nation. But you are in for trouble!
translation_verse: Kpoo hã mɛi ni ahe ejɔ amɛ yɛ Zion, kɛ mɛi ni nyɛsusuɔ akɛ amɛyɛ shweshweeshwe yɛ Samaria Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, mɛi ni ji lumɛi wuji yɛ maŋ wulu, Israel mli lɛ, mɛi aŋɔɔ ni Israelbii lɛ baa lɛ.

english_verse: Look what happened to the cities of Calneh, powerful Hamath, and Gath in Philistia. Are you greater than any of those kingdoms?
translation_verse: Nyɛhoa kɛyaa Kalne maŋ lɛ mli nyɛyakwɛa jɛi; ni nyɛjɛa jɛi nyɛyaa Hamat maŋ wulu lɛ mli; nyɛtsaa nɔ kɛkpelekea shi kɛyaa Filistibii amaŋ ni ji Gat lɛ mli hu. Ani amɛhi fe maŋtsɛyelihei nɛɛ lo; aloo amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ da fe nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ,

english_verse: You are cruel, and you forget the coming day of judgment.
translation_verse: nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtsiɔ gbi fɔŋ lɛ kɛyaa sɛɛ shɔŋŋ, ni nyɛkɛ nakai feemɔ moŋ hãa gbi fɔŋ lɛ bɛŋkɛɔ nyɛ lɛ?

english_verse: You rich people lounge around on beds with ivory posts, while dining on the meat of your lambs and calves.
translation_verse: Kpoo hã mɛi ni kãmɔɔ shuɔ wu saatsei anɔ amɛwɔɔ, ni amɛkpãa amɛmli yɛ saatsei bibii anɔ, ni amɛyeɔ too ku lɛ mli gwantɛŋbii kɛ tsina tsui amli tsinabii lɛ.

english_verse: You sing foolish songs to the music of harps, and you make up new tunes, just as David used to do.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni kɛ saŋku laa yakayaka lalai, ni amɛsɔ̃ɔ saŋkui tamɔ David nɔ lɛ amɛhãa amɛhe.

english_verse: You drink all the wine you want and wear expensive perfume, but you don't care about the ruin of your nation.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni kɛ kpuji wuji nuɔ wain, ni mu ni hi fe fɛɛ amɛkpaa, shi Israel hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ edɔɔɔ amɛ kwraa lɛ.

english_verse: So you will be the first to be dragged off as captives; your good times will end.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, amɛ tsutsu aaaŋɔ amɛ nom kɛaatee, ni no baahã ahoshwibɔlɔi lɛ ahoofeemɔ lɛ sɛɛ afo.

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful has sworn by his own name: “You descendants of Jacob make me angry by your pride, and I hate your fortresses. And so I will surrender your city and possessions to your enemies.”
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ekã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kitã. Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, “Miihi Israelbii ahewoo lɛ; ni miinyaŋe amɛmɔji fɛɛfɛji lɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, maŋɔ amɛmaŋ lɛ kɛ emli nii lɛ fɛɛ mahã.”

english_verse: If only ten of you survive by hiding in a house you will still die.
translation_verse: Aaaba mli akɛ kɛji shwɛ shĩa kome mli hii nyɔŋma kɛkɛ po lɛ, amɛbaagboi kɛ̃.

english_verse: As you carry out a corpse to prepare it for burial, your relative in the house will ask, “Are there others?” You will answer, “No!” Then your relative will reply, “Be quiet! Don't dare mention the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ni kɛji mɛi ni egbo lɛ eko wekunyo, mɔ ni fuɔ lɛ, baaba koni ebawo gbonyo lɛ kɛje shĩa lɛ, wekunyo nɛɛ baabi mɔ ni yɔɔ shĩa lɛ mli akɛ, “Ani eshwɛ mɔ ko lolo hɔ shĩa lɛ mli fata ohe lo?” Mɔ lɛ aaahere nɔ akɛ, “Dabida!” Gbonyo lɛ wekunyo lɛ baakɛɛ akɛ, “Feemɔ diŋŋ. Wɔkwɛ jogbaŋŋ ni wɔkatsi Yehowa gbɛi tã.”

english_verse: At the Lord's command, houses great and small will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yehowa efã ni shĩa wulu fɛɛ shĩa wulu baawule butuu, ni shĩa bibioo hu baajwa.

english_verse: Horses can't gallop on rocks; oceans can't be plowed. But you have turned justice and fairness into bitter poison.
translation_verse: Ani okpɔŋɔ joɔ foi yɛ tɛsaa nɔ, aloo akɛ tsinahii huɔ yɛ ŋshɔ mli? Shi nyɛhã jalɛ etsɔ̃ ebɔɔ, ni jalɛ yibii etsɔ̃ taatso.

english_verse: You celebrate the defeat of Lo-Debar and Karnaim, and you boast by saying, “We did it on our own.”
translation_verse: Nyɛnyaa yɛ Lo-Debar maŋ lɛ mli akɛ, “Ani jeee wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhewalɛ mli wɔjɛ ni wɔshɔ̃ Karnaim maŋ lɛ?”

english_verse: But the Lord God All-Powerful will send a nation to attack you people of Israel. They will capture Lebo-Hamath in the north, Arabah Creek in the south, and everything in between.
translation_verse: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ kɛɛmɔ ji akɛ, “Israelbii, naa, mibatee maŋ ko shi mawo nyɛ koni amɛbaŋɔ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ. Maŋ nɛɛ baahao nyɛ kɛjɛ Lebo-Hamat yɛ kooyigbɛ, aahu kɛyashi ŋa kplenee ni atsɛɔ lɛ Araba Nujɔɔ lɛ naa yɛ wuoyigbɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord God showed me that he is going to send locusts to attack your crops. It will happen after the king has already been given his share of the grain and before the rest of the grain has been harvested.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jie etsɔ̃ɔ mi nɛ. Mina akɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ baalabii ku ko. Be nɛɛ mli lɛ afɛ̃ maŋtsɛ jwɛi momo, ni jwɛi lɛ eje shishi eefu kɛmiiba ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: In my vision the locusts ate every crop in the land, and I said to the Lord, “Please forgive your nation. It's so weak. How can it survive?”
translation_verse: Be ni baalabii lɛ eye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jwɛfɔ lɛ amɛgbe naa lɛ, mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao! Yehowa Ofe, ofainɛ, okɛ Israelbii ahe ake amɛ. Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni amɛyi aaana wala hu? Ejaakɛ amɛhe waaa.”

english_verse: Then the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of Fire
translation_verse: Yehowa tsake eyiŋtoo lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni ona nɛɛ baŋ mli.” La he ninaa

english_verse: The Lord showed me that he is going to send a ball of fire to burn up everything on earth, including the ocean.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jie etsɔ̃ɔ mi nɛ. Mina akɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ miitao akɛ ekɛ la agbala ewebii lɛ atoi. La lɛ ŋala nu ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi lɛ, kɛkɛ ni la lɛ bɔ̃i shikpɔŋ lɛ hu shãa.

english_verse: Then I said, “Won't you please stop? How can our weak nation survive?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao! Yehowa, ofainɛ, foo sɛɛ. Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni Israelbii, owebii lɛ, ayi aaana wala hu? Ejaakɛ amɛhe waaa.”

english_verse: Again the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of a Measuring Line
translation_verse: Yehowa tsake eyiŋtoo, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Enɛ hu baŋ mli.” Plomo he ninaa

english_verse: The Lord showed me a vision of himself standing beside a wall and holding a string with a weight tied to the end of it. The string and weight had been used to measure the straightness of the wall.
translation_verse: Yehowa jie ninaa nɛɛ hu etsɔ̃ɔ mi. Mina Yehowa ni edamɔ gbogbo ni akɛ plomo susu ni atswa he; ni ehiɛ plomo yɛ edɛŋ.

english_verse: Then he asked, “Amos, what do you see?” “A measuring line,” I answered. The Lord said, “I'm using this measuring line to show that my people Israel don't measure up, and I won't forgive them any more.
translation_verse: Yehowa bi mi akɛ, “Amos, mɛni onaa nɛɛ?” Mito he akɛ, “Plomo.” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, mikɛ plomo nɛɛ miisusu mimaŋ Israelbii ajalɛ. Mihaŋ amɛye amɛhe dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Their sacred places will be destroyed, and I will send war against the nation of King Jeroboam.” Amos and Amaziah
translation_verse: Hei ni Isak shwie lɛ jaa yɛ lɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃, ni hei ni Israelbii jaa yɛ lɛ hu baafee koikoi; ni mibafã ta mawo Yeroboam we lɛ.” Amos kɛ Osɔfo Amazia

english_verse: Amaziah the priest at Bethel sent this message to King Jeroboam of Israel, “Amos is plotting against you in the very heart of Israel. Our nation cannot put up with his message for very long.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Amazia, Betel osɔfo lɛ, tsu kɛtee Yeroboam, Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, ŋɔɔ akɛ, “Amos etee oyinɔ apam yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ. Ewiemɔi lɛ baafite maŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Here is what he is saying: ‘Jeroboam will be put to death, and the people will be taken to a foreign country.’ ”
translation_verse: Nɔ ni Amos kɛɛ ji, “Yeroboam baanyɔ yɛ ta mli, ni nom kɛ̃ aaaŋɔ Israelbii kɛaaje amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ kɛaatee.”

english_verse: Then Amaziah told me, “Amos, take your visions and get out! Go back to Judah and earn your living there as a prophet.
translation_verse: Osɔfo Amazia kɛɛ Amos akɛ, “Gbalɔ, jee biɛ ni oya Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni oyaye nii yɛ jɛi koni ogba yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: I answered: I'm not a prophet! And I wasn't trained to be a prophet. I am a shepherd, and I take care of fig trees.
translation_verse: Amos here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ Osɔfo Amazia akɛ, “Jeee gbalɔ ji mi, ni asaŋ jeee gbalɔ bi hu ji mi. Shi moŋ koolookwɛlɔ ji mi, ni misaa sikamore tsei ahe hu;

english_verse: But the Lord told me to leave my herds and preach to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: ni kooloo mikpalaa ni Yehowa tsɛ mi; ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Yaa, ni oyagba otsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii lɛ.’

english_verse: Now, listen to what the Lord says about you: Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, your sons and daughters will be killed in war, and your land will be divided among others. You will die in a country of foreigners, and the people of Israel will be dragged from their homeland.
translation_verse: Amazia, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Oŋa baatsɔ̃ ajwamãŋ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni obihii kɛ obiyei lɛ baanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ ta naa; abaaŋɔ oshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni abaaja ahã mɛi kpɔji. Bo diɛŋtsɛ lɛ maŋsɛɛ obaaya oyagbo yɛ, yɛ shikpɔŋ ko nɔ ni ajaaa Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ; ni Israelbii lɛ nom kɛ̃ aaaŋɔ amɛ kɛaaje amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ kɛaatee.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord God showed me a basket of ripe fruit
translation_verse: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, jie ninaa nɛɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mi, Mina kɛntɛŋ kɛ emli tsei ayibii ni etsu.

english_verse: and asked, “Amos, what do you see?” “A basket of ripe fruit,” I replied. Then he said, “This is the end for my people Israel. I won't forgive them again.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bi mi akɛ, “Amos, mɛni onaa nɛɛ?” Mihere nɔ akɛ, “Kɛntɛŋ kɛ emli tsei ayibii ni etsu.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Mimaŋ Israelbii akpulu eyi agbɛnɛ; mikɛ amɛhe ekeŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ; mibagbala amɛtoi.

english_verse: Instead of singing in the temple, they will cry and weep. Dead bodies will be everywhere. So keep silent! I, the Lord, have spoken!” Israel Is Doomed The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ, lalai ni amɛlaa yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli lɛ baatsɔ̃ yara ni awo. Gbɔmɛi babaoo baaplene, ni abaashɛrɛ gbohii ashwie hei fɛɛ nigii, shi mɛi baafee diŋŋ kɛkwɛ.” Israel hiɛkpãtãmɔ

english_verse: You people crush those in need and wipe out the poor.
translation_verse: Nyɛboa toi, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛnaanaa mɛi ni efi amɛ lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛkpãtãa ohiafoi ahiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: You say to yourselves, “How much longer before the end of the New Moon Festival? When will the Sabbath be over? Our wheat is ready, and we want to sell it now. We can't wait to cheat and charge high prices for the grain we sell. We will use dishonest scales
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Mɛɛbe po nyɔŋ hee lɛ aaanyɔ shi koni wɔbɔ̃i ŋmaa hɔ̃ɔmɔ? Ni mɛɛbe po abaagbe hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ yeli naa koni wɔbɔ̃i wɔŋmaa hɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ susumɔnɔ ni shɛɛɛ, asaŋ kɛ nsɛnitɛ ni atse nɔ?

english_verse: and mix dust in the grain. Those who are needy and poor don't have any money. We will make them our slaves for the price of a pair of sandals.”
translation_verse: Wɔkɛ jwiɛtɛi aaahe ohiafo nyɔmɔtsɛ, ni wɔkɛ tokota aaahe mɔ ni efi lɛ, ni ŋmaa shishi tutuu tete wɔɔhɔ̃ɔ lɛ kɛ jarawalɛ.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, won't forget any of this, though you take great pride in your ancestor Jacob.
translation_verse: Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ekã kitã akɛ; “Anɔkwa, mihiɛ kpaŋ amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ eko nɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: Your country will tremble, and you will mourn. It will be like the Nile River that rises and overflows, then sinks back down.
translation_verse: Ni no hewɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ baahoso, ni enɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ baaye awerɛhoo. Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ baafee hamahama tamɔ bɔ ni Nilo Faa lɛ yiɔ, ni ekuɔ, ni asaŋ ekpɔŋɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: On that day, I, the Lord God, will make the sun go down at noon, and I will turn daylight into darkness.
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mibahã hulu anyɔ shi shwane koni duŋ awo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shwane fintiŋŋ.

english_verse: Your festivals and joyful singing will turn into sorrow. You will wear sackcloth and shave your heads, as you would at the death of your only son. It will be a horrible day.
translation_verse: Mahã gbii juji ni nyɛyeɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ yarafeemɔ, ni lalai kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ ni nyɛlaa lɛ baatsɔ̃ yaafo. Nyɛbaabumɔ kpekpe, ni nyɛaashɛshɛɛ nyɛyi, ni nyɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ fɔlɔi ni miiye amɛbi koome ni egbo he awerɛho. Nakai gbi lɛ naagbee mli baajoo pam.

english_verse: I, the Lord, also promise you a terrible shortage, but not of food and water. You will hunger and thirst to hear my message.
translation_verse: “Naa, gbii miiba, ni mahã hɔ̃mɔ aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Jeee daaŋŋmãa hɔ̃mɔ mɛi baaye lɛ, ni jeee nu hɔ̃mɔ hu, shi moŋ abaaye Yehowa wiemɔi lɛ he kumai.

english_verse: You will search everywhere— from north to south, from east to west. You will go all over the earth, seeking a message from me, the Lord. But you won't find one.
translation_verse: Mɛi baafo shi kɛjɛ ŋshɔnaa kɛya ŋshɔnaa, ni amɛaajɛ kooyigbɛ kɛya bokãgbɛ ni amɛmiitao Yehowa naa wiemɔ lɛ, shi amɛnaŋ.

english_verse: Your beautiful young women and your young men will faint from thirst.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, oblayei hefɛotsɛmɛi kɛ oblahii fɛɛ baatɔtɔɔ biti kɛ kumai,

english_verse: You made promises to the goddess Ashimah at Samaria; you made vows to other gods at the shrines of Dan and Beersheba. So now you will fall and never get up.
translation_verse: ni mɛi ni kɛ Samaria jemawɔji lɛ kãa kitã amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mina Dan jemawɔŋ lɛ,’ loo ‘Mina Beersheba jemawɔŋ lɛ,’ amɛbaanyɔnyɔi.”

english_verse: I saw a vision of the Lord standing by the temple altar, and he said, “Shake the columns until the tops fall loose, and the doorposts crumble. Then make the pieces fall on the people below. I will take a sword and kill anyone who escapes.
translation_verse: Mina Yehowa damɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he. Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Okɛ nii atswia Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ ayiteiaŋ kpɔbii lɛ waa koni kpokui lɛ ahoso, ni ewule eshwie mɛi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. Mɛi ni ahe baaje mli lɛ mibagbe amɛ yɛ ta mli. Mɔ ko mɔ ko ejoŋ minaa foi lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko hu he ejeŋ mli.

english_verse: “If they dig deep into the earth or climb to the sky, I'll reach out and get them.
translation_verse: Kɛji amɛtsa shi kɛtee gbohiiaje tete lɛ, minine baashɛ amɛnɔ yɛ jɛi; ni amɛkwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi hu, mibamɔmɔ amɛ kɛkpeleke shi kɛjɛ jɛi.

english_verse: If they escape to the peaks of Mount Carmel, I'll search and find them. And if they hide from me at the bottom of the ocean, I'll command a sea monster to bite them.
translation_verse: Kɛji amɛyatee amɛhe yɛ Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ tete lɛ, mibatao amɛ, ni mibamɔmɔ amɛ; ni kɛ amɛtee ŋshɔ shishi amɛyatee mi yɛ jɛi hu, mibafã ŋshɔŋ onufu gbeyeigbeyei lɛ, ni ebaakɔ̃mɔ amɛ.

english_verse: I'll send a sword to kill them, wherever their enemies drag them off as captives. I'm determined to hurt them, not to help them.” His Name Is the Lord
translation_verse: Ni kɛji amɛhenyɛlɔi baŋɔ amɛ nom tete lɛ, mibafã, ni henyɛlɔi lɛ baafã klante yɛ amɛnɔ ni amɛaagbe amɛ. Mijie mihiɛ mika amɛ koni makpãtã amɛhiɛ; ejurɔ ko bɛ ni mibafee amɛ.”

english_verse: When the Lord God All-Powerful touches the earth, it melts, and its people mourn. God makes the earth rise and then fall, just like the Nile River.
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kɛ́ enine sa je lɛ he kɛkɛ lɛ je lɛ miihoso, ni emli gbɔmɛi fɛɛ yeɔ awerɛhoo, mɔ ni hãa je lɛ yiɔ ni ekpɔ̃ŋɔ tamɔ Nilo Faa lɛ,

english_verse: He built his palace in the heavens and let its foundations rest on the earth. He scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth. His name is the Lord. The Lord Is God
translation_verse: mɔ ni ŋwɛiniiaŋ ji he ni epiai yɔɔ, ni ekɛ ŋwɛi ebu shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni etsɛɔ ŋshɔŋ nu lɛ kɛyaa ŋwɛi, ni efɔseɔ eshwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Egbɛi ji Yehowa!

english_verse: Israel, I am the Lord God, and the Ethiopians are no less important to me than you are. I brought you out of Egypt, but I also brought the Philistines from Crete and the Arameans from Kir.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Israelbii, mijwɛŋɔ nyɛhe tamɔ mijwɛŋɔ Etiopiabii ahe lɛ. Bɔ ni mijie Israelbii kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nakai mijie Filistibii lɛ kɛjɛ Kreta kɛ Siriabii lɛ hu kɛjɛ Kir.

english_verse: My eyes have seen what a sinful nation you are, and I'll wipe you out. But I will leave a few of Jacob's descendants. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Naa, mi, Yehowa Ofe, mijie mihiɛ mika Israel, maŋ ni feɔ esha lɛ, ni mibakpãtã ehiɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Shi moŋ mikpãtãŋ Yakob shwiei lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ kwrakwra, Yehowa kɛɛ.

english_verse: At my command, all of you will be sifted like grain. Israelites who remain faithful will be scattered among the nations. And the others will be trapped like trash in a sifter.
translation_verse: “Naa, mibafã, ni mibasha Israelbii lɛ amli yɛ je lɛ mli maji lɛ ateŋ tamɔ akɛ shaanii shaa ŋmaa mli lɛ, ni ŋmaa kuli nɛkɛ egbeŋ shi.

english_verse: Some of you are evil, and you deny that you will ever get caught. But you will be killed. The Lord's Promise to Israel
translation_verse: Mimaŋbii lɛ ateŋ gbɔmɛi eshafeelɔi ni kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ haŋ nɔ fɔŋ ko anina wɔ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛbaanyɔnyɔi yɛ ta mli.’ ” Abaasaa Israel wɔsɛɛ

english_verse: In the future, I will rebuild David's fallen kingdom. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again, just as it used to be.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Be ko miiba, ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mibatee David maŋtsɛyeli ni egbee shi lɛ shi mama shi ekoŋŋ. Mibatsimɔ fɔji ni eba maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ, ni masaa matswa lɛ mama shi tamɔ eyɔɔ blema lɛ.

english_verse: Then you will capture Edom and the other nations that are mine. I, the Lord, have spoken, and my words will come true.
translation_verse: Ni Israelbii lɛ baaku amɛsɛɛ amɛbashɔ̃ Edom shikpɔŋ ni eshwɛ lɛ, kɛ shikpɔji krokomɛi fɛɛ ni tsutsu ko lɛ migbɛi kã amɛnɔ lɛ.” Nɔ ni Yehowa, mɔ ni baatsu nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ, ekɛɛ nɛ,

english_verse: You will have such a harvest that you won't be able to bring in all of your wheat before plowing time. You will have grapes left over from season to season; your fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains.
translation_verse: “Naa, gbii miiba,” Yehowa kɛɛ “ni nidulɔi kɛ nidumɔ baanina nikpalɔ ni ekpako nii egbeko naa; ni wain yibii baawo babaoo bɔ ni wainŋalɔ nyɛŋ fɛɛ eŋa, ni wain baatsere kɛbaajɛ gɔji lɛ amli, ni eeeho yɛ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ tamɔ faa.

english_verse: I'll make Israel prosper again. You will rebuild your towns and live in them. You will drink wine from your own vineyards and eat the fruit you grow.
translation_verse: Mibakpale mimaŋ Israelbii lɛ kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ mli kɛba koni amɛbasaa amɛmaji ni efee koikoi lɛ ni amɛhi mli ekoŋŋ; amɛaafee wain tromi ni amɛaanu amɛmli wain; ni amɛaahu abɔi ni amɛaaye abɔi lɛ amli nii.

english_verse: I'll plant your roots deep in the land I have given you, and you won't ever be uprooted again. I, the Lord God, have spoken!
translation_verse: Mibadu amɛ yɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni anyɛŋ amɛ afã yɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ.” Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ena ekɛɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God gave Obadiah a message about Edom, and this is what we heard: “I, the Lord, have sent a messenger with orders for the nations to attack Edom.”
translation_verse: Gbalɔ Obadia gbalɛ lɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛhã lɛ yɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ he lɛ nɛ. Yehowa baagbala Edom toi Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ tsu bɔfo kɛtee majimaji lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni wɔnu wiemɔ ni ekɛtee lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtea shi! Nyɛhãa wɔyaa wɔ kɛ Edom ayawua ta!”

english_verse: The Lord said to Edom: I will make you the weakest and most despised nation.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ Edom akɛ, “Naa, mibaba ohewalɛ shi yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ebuŋ bo kwraa.

english_verse: You live in a mountain fortress, because your pride makes you feel safe from attack, but you are mistaken.
translation_verse: Ohenɔwomɔ lɛ elaka bo. Omaŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ yɛ tɛsaa nɔ, ni oshihilɛhe lɛ yɛ gɔŋ grɔŋŋ nɔ; ni no hewɔ ni okɛɔ ohe akɛ, ‘Namɔ aaanyɛ mi shi aba?’

english_verse: I will still bring you down, even if you fly higher than an eagle or nest among the stars. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Kɛji oyato oshihilɛhe yɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ tamɔ okropɔŋ tsu, ni shihilɛhe lɛ hɔ ŋulamii ateŋ tete, kɛ̃lɛ majie bo yɛ jɛi kɛyi shi.

english_verse: If thieves break in at night, they steal only what they want. And people who harvest grapes always leave some unpicked. But, Edom, you are doomed!
translation_verse: “Kɛji julɔi ba bo juu nyɔɔŋ, loo ojotswalɔi bashwie onɔ nyɔɔŋ lɛ, te amɛaakpãtã onii ahiɛ tɛŋŋ? Ani julɔi lɛ ejuŋ onii bɔ pɛ ni aaashɛ amɛnaa? Kɛji wainyibii kpalɔi ni ba lɛ, ani amɛshiŋ yibii lɛ kpɛkpɛbii lo? Shi naa, bo lɛ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ ekpãtã ohiɛ butuu.

english_verse: Everything you treasure most will be taken from you.
translation_verse: Esau shwiei, kwɛ bɔ ni aha nyɛ, kwɛ bɔ ni afãmɔ nyɛjwetrii ni akɛtee lɛ.

english_verse: Your allies can't be trusted. They will force you out of your own country. And your best friends will trick and trap you, even before you know it.
translation_verse: Nyɛhefatalɔi lɛ elaka nyɛ; amɛshwie nyɛ kɛtee husu lɛ nɔ tɔ̃ɔ; mɛi ni kɛ nyɛ yɔɔ gbee jurɔ lɛ hu eye nyɛnɔ kunim. Nanemɛi ni nyɛkɛye nii lɛ tsɔ̃ nyɛ tsɔne; nɔ ko ni anuuu shishi.

english_verse: Edom, when this happens, I, the Lord, will destroy all your marvelous wisdom.
translation_verse: Ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nakai gbi lɛ magbala Edom toi, mibakpãtã enilelɔi lɛ ahiɛ, ni mahã amɛnilee hiɛ akpãtã.

english_verse: Warriors from the city of Teman will be terrified, and you descendants of Esau will be wiped out. The Lord Condemns Edom's Cruelty
translation_verse: Ŋmiŋmi baamɔmɔ Teman hii kãkãlɔi lɛ, ni Edom tabilɔi fɛɛ baanyɔnyɔi.” Edom toigbalamɔ lɛ shishi

english_verse: You were cruel to your relatives, the descendants of Jacob. Now you will be destroyed, disgraced forever.
translation_verse: “Efɔŋ ni nyɛfee nyɛnyɛmimɛi ni ji Yakob shwiei lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ohe baafee hiɛgbele, ni aaakpãtã ohiɛ kɛaatee naanɔ.

english_verse: You stood there and watched as foreigners entered Jerusalem and took what they wanted. In fact, you were no better than those foreigners.
translation_verse: Odamɔ shi yɛ afã banee, gbi ni gbɔi baloo ejwetri kɛtee lɛ. Odamɔ afã ni gbɔi bote maŋ lɛ mli ni amɛfɔ̃ oshiki kɛja emlinii amɛhã amɛhe lɛ.

english_verse: Why did you celebrate when such a dreadful disaster struck your relatives? Why were you so pleased when everyone in Judah was suffering?
translation_verse: Kulɛ esaaa akɛ bo hu oyi awa tamɔ amɛ nɔŋŋ. Oyeɔ onyɛmimɛi Yudabii lɛ ayɔɔ yɛ amanehulu ni banina amɛ lɛ hewɔ; ni ebɛ akɛ ooonya yɛ amɛhiɛkpãtãmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ; ni esaaa akɛ oshwãa yɛ haomɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: They are my people, and you were cruel to them. You went through their towns, sneering and stealing whatever was left.
translation_verse: Kulɛ esaaa akɛ oboteɔ miwebii lɛ amaŋ lɛ mli, yɛ amɛmanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ; ebɛ akɛ oyeɔ amɛ yɔɔ yɛ amɛmanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ; ni esaaa akɛ oyahaa amɛnii yɛ amɛmanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: In their time of torment, you ambushed refugees and handed them over to their attackers. The Lord Will Judge the Nations
translation_verse: Kulɛ esaaa akɛ nyɛdamɔɔ gbɛnta ni nyɛgbegbeɔ mɛi ni joɔ foi lɛ; ni esaaa akɛ nyɛkɛ gbɔmɛi hiɛkãalɔi lɛ hãa henyɛlɔi lɛ yɛ hejaramɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.” Nyɔŋmɔ baakojo maji lɛ

english_verse: The day is coming when I, the Lord, will judge the nations. And, Edom, you will pay in full for what you have done.
translation_verse: “Ejaakɛ be lɛ eshɛ etã, be ni, mi, Yehowa mibakojo majimaji lɛ. Bɔ ni ofee lɛ, nakai aaafee bo, Esau. Onifeemɔnii lɛ baaku sɛɛ abawula oyiteŋ.

english_verse: I forced the people of Judah to drink the wine of my anger on my sacred mountain. Soon the neighboring nations must drink their fill— then vanish without a trace. Victory for Israel
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bɔ ni nyɛnunuu dãi yɛ migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nakai majimaji ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ aaamiimii dãa, ni amɛaadidãa, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ mɛi ni ebablako dã.” Israel baaye kunim

english_verse: The Lord's people who escape will go to Mount Zion, and it will be holy. Then Jacob's descendants will capture the land of those who took their land.
translation_verse: “Shi mɛi ni aaaje mli lɛ, aaayato maŋ yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Eeetsɔ̃ maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni Yakob shwiei lɛ anine aaashɛ amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: Israel will be a fire, and Edom will be straw going up in flames. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: Yakob shwiei lɛ aaatsɔ̃ là, ni Yosef shwiei lɛ aaatsɔ̃ là lilɛi, ni Esau shwiei lɛ aaatsɔ̃ gbetselii, ni aaashã amɛ ni aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ bɔ ni eshwɛŋ mɔ ko yɛ Esau we lɛ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.

english_verse: The people of Israel who live in the Southern Desert will take the land of Edom. Those who live in the hills will capture Philistia, Ephraim, and Samaria. And the tribe of Benjamin will conquer Gilead.
translation_verse: “Yuda wuoyigbɛbii lɛ aaabashɔ̃ Edom Gɔŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ; ni mɛi ni yɔɔ anaigbɛ gɔji lɛ ashishi lɛ baashɔ̃ Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ. Amɛbaaŋɔ Efraim shikpɔŋ lɛ, kɛ Samaria hu; ni Benyamin baaŋɔ Gilead.

english_verse: Those who return from captivity will control Phoenicia as far as Zarephath. Captives from Jerusalem who were taken to Sepharad will capture the towns of the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Israelbii ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ baaŋɔ Kanaanbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ, kɛjɛ Foinikia kɛyashi Zarefat; ni nomii ni jɛ Yerusalɛm ni akɛ amɛ etee Sarde lɛ baaŋɔ wuoyigbɛ maji lɛ.

english_verse: Those the Lord has saved will live on Mount Zion and rule over Edom. Then the kingdom will belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Tabilɔi kunimyelɔi aaajɛ Yerusalɛm ayatua Edom, ni amɛaaye enɔ; ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ aaaye Maŋtsɛ.”

english_verse: One day the Lord told Jonah, the son of Amittai,
translation_verse: Gbi ko lɛ Yehowa kɛ Yona, Amitai bi lɛ wie, ni ekɛɛ Yona akɛ,

english_verse: to go to the great city of Nineveh and say to the people, “The Lord has seen your terrible sins. You are doomed!”
translation_verse: “Tee shi ni oya Nineve maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ mli koni oyashiɛ oshi maŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ nifɔɔjianii fɛɛ ni emli bii lɛ feɔ lɛ miina fɛɛ.”

english_verse: Instead, Jonah ran from the Lord. He went to the seaport of Joppa and found a ship that was going to Spain. So he paid his fare, then got on the ship and sailed away to escape.
translation_verse: Shi be ni Yona yi mli lɛ, ewo ehiɛ ema Tarshish gbɛ moŋ. Eyiŋtoo ji akɛ eejo Yehowa tsumɔ lɛ naa foi. Etee Yopa; eyana lɛlɛ ko yɛ jɛi ni miiya Tarshish. No hewɔ lɛ, ewo lɛlɛ lɛ mlitamɔ he nyɔmɔ, kɛkɛ ni ebote mli koni ekɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli bii lɛ aya Tarshish, koni ejo foi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord made a strong wind blow, and such a bad storm came up that the ship was about to be broken to pieces.
translation_verse: Shi Yehowa hã kɔɔyɔɔ ko ni naa wa jogbaŋŋ tswa yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ. Ahum fã waa, ni efee tamɔ nɔ ni lɛlɛ lɛ baajwa.

english_verse: The sailors were frightened, and they all started praying to their gods. They even threw the ship's cargo overboard to make the ship lighter. All this time, Jonah was down below deck, sound asleep.
translation_verse: Amlakui lɛ she gbeyei, kɛkɛ ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ bolɔ etsɛ nɔ ni ejaa akɛ ebahere amɛ. Fee sɛɛ lɛ amlakui lɛ jie lɛlɛ lɛ mli jatsu lɛ amɛwo ŋshɔ lɛ mli, bɔ ni afee ni lɛlɛ lɛ afee huyɛhuyɛ ahã amɛ. Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Yona etee lɛlɛ lɛ shishigbɛ eyakã shi, ni lɛ lɛ, ewɔ vii diɛŋtsɛ.

english_verse: The ship's captain went to him and said, “How can you sleep at a time like this? Get up and pray to your God! Maybe he will have pity on us and keep us from drowning.”
translation_verse: Lɛlɛtsɛ lɛ yana Yona yɛ eshikamɔhe lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ataa, bo lɛ wɔɔ owɔɔ lo? Tee shi ni osɔle otsɛ nɔ ni ojaa akɛ aleenɔ emusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ wɔhe koni ebahere wɔ koni wɔhiɛ akakpãtã lo.”

english_verse: Finally, the sailors got together and said, “Let's ask our gods to show us who caused all this trouble.” It turned out to be Jonah.
translation_verse: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ amlakui lɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔfɔ̃a oshiki kɛtao mɔ koome hewɔ ni nɛkɛ sane fɔŋ nɛɛ eba wɔnɔ nɛɛ.” Amɛfɔ̃ oshiki lɛ; ni oshiki lɛ gbee Yona nɔ.

english_verse: They started asking him, “Are you the one who brought all this trouble on us? What business are you in? Where do you come from? What is your country? Who are your people?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amlakui lɛ kɛɛ Yona akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ gbaa wɔ. Te bo ohewɔ jɛ ni osharã nɛɛ fɛɛ ebasharã wɔ nɛɛ? Mɛni otsuɔ? Nɛgbɛ ojɛ yɛ biɛ nɛɛ? Mɛɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ ojɛ, ni mɛɛ maŋ nɔ fɔmɔbi ji bo?”

english_verse: Jonah answered, “I'm a Hebrew, and I worship the Lord God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.”
translation_verse: Yona jie naa akɛ, “Hebrinyo ji mi; ni Yehowa mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi ni lɛ ebɔ ŋshɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ fɛɛ lɛ mijaa.”

english_verse: When the sailors heard this, they were frightened, because Jonah had already told them he was running from the Lord. Then they said, “Do you know what you have done?”
translation_verse: Be ni Yona egba amɛ akɛ eejo foi yɛ Yehowa tsumɔ naa lɛ, amlakui lɛ she gbeyei jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ. Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛɛ Yona akɛ, “Mɛni ofee nɛɛ?”

english_verse: The storm kept getting worse, until finally the sailors asked him, “What should we do with you to make the sea calm down?”
translation_verse: Nakai be mli fɛɛ lɛ ŋshɔ lɛ miiya nɔ eefee hamahama sɔŋŋ. Kɛkɛ ni amlakui lɛ kɛɛ Yona akɛ, “Mɛni kɛ̃ wɔfee bo, ni eeeha ŋshɔ lɛ aŋmɛ ahã wɔ?”

english_verse: Jonah told them, “Throw me into the sea, and it will calm down. I'm the cause of this terrible storm.”
translation_verse: Yona hã hetoo akɛ, “Nyɛwoa mi, ni nyɛshɛa mi nyɛfɔa ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ni ŋshɔ lɛ baaŋmɛ ahã nyɛ, ejaakɛ mile akɛ mi mihewɔ ni nɛkɛ ahum kpeteŋkple nɛɛ tswaa nyɛ nɛɛ.”

english_verse: The sailors tried their best to row to the shore. But they could not do it, and the storm kept getting worse every minute.
translation_verse: Amlakui lɛ mia amɛhiɛ amɛwiri kɛ amɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ akɛ amɛkɛ lɛlɛ lɛ aaaku sɛɛ kɛba shikpɔŋ; shi amɛnyɛɛɛ ejaakɛ ŋshɔ lɛ tee nɔ efee hamahama ekpee amɛ.

english_verse: So they prayed to the Lord, “Please don't let us drown for taking this man's life. Don't hold us guilty for killing an innocent man. All of this happened because you wanted it to.”
translation_verse: Enɛ hã amlakui lɛ sɔle amɛtsɛ Yehowa, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, Yehowa, wɔmiikpa bo fai, kaahã wɔhiɛ miikpãtã yɛ nuu nɛɛ wala hewɔ. Ela yi sɔ̃ akatere wɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, wɔle akɛ bo lɛ, ofeɔ nɔ ni osumɔɔ.”

english_verse: Then they threw Jonah overboard, and the sea calmed down.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amlakui lɛ wo Yona, ni amɛshɛ lɛ amɛfɔ̃ ŋshɔ lɛ mli; kɛkɛ ni ŋshɔ lɛ ŋmɛ.

english_verse: The sailors were so terrified that they offered a sacrifice to the Lord and made all kinds of promises.
translation_verse: Amlakui lɛ she Yehowa gbeyei bɔ sɔŋŋ ni ehã amɛshã afɔle amɛhã Yehowa, asaŋ mɛi wowoo shii srɔtoi hu.

english_verse: The Lord sent a big fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was inside the fish for three days and three nights.
translation_verse: Yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa lɛ, ŋshɔŋloo kpeteŋkple ko mi Yona, ni Yona hi loo nɛɛ musuŋ shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii etɛ̃.

english_verse: From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the Lord his God:
translation_verse: Yona yɛ ŋshɔŋloo lɛ musuŋ, kɛkɛ ni esɔle ekpa Yehowa eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ fai,

english_verse: When I was in trouble, Lord, I prayed to you, and you listened to me. From deep in the world of the dead, I begged for your help, and you answered my prayer.
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mifimɔ lɛ mli lɛ, mibolɔ mitsɛ Yehowa, ni ehere mi nɔ; mibolɔ kɛjɛ gbohiiaje musuŋ tɔ̃ɔ, ni Yehowa, obo migbee toi.

english_verse: You threw me down to the bottom of the sea. The water was churning all around; I was completely covered by your mighty waves.
translation_verse: Oshɛ mi ofɔ̃ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli kɛtee ŋshɔ shishi tɔ̃ɔ, ni nu babaoo bɔle mihe kɛkpe; ni oshɔkei kɛ omlɛ̃mɛ̃i lɛ kumɔ shwie minɔ.

english_verse: I thought I was swept away from your sight, never again to see your holy temple.
translation_verse: Misusu akɛ ashwie mi kɛje ohiɛ, ni te mafee tɛŋŋ mana oSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ?

english_verse: I was almost drowned by the swirling waters that surrounded me. Seaweed had wrapped around my head.
translation_verse: Nu lɛ su mi, ni mitsui bɔ̃i suu; ŋshɔ lɛ su mi emuu, ni wosuma bla miyitso fɛɛ.

english_verse: I had sunk down deep below the mountains beneath the sea. I knew that forever, I would be a prisoner there. But, you, Lord God, rescued me from that pit.
translation_verse: Mikpeleke shi kɛtee gɔji ashishitoo hei diɛŋtsɛ po, shikpɔŋ ni enaa agboi lɛ sa miyi kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ. Shi Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, ohere miyiwala kɛjɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: When my life was slipping away, I remembered you— and in your holy temple you heard my prayer.
translation_verse: Be ni misusuma tɔ biti yɛ mimli lɛ, mikai Yehowa, ni misɔle, ni onu misɔlemɔ lɛ yɛ oSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: All who worship worthless idols turn from the God who offers them mercy.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni jaa yaka amãgãi lɛ, amɛyeee bo anɔkwa.

english_verse: But with shouts of praise, I will offer a sacrifice to you, my Lord. I will keep my promise, because you are the one with power to save.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, mala makafo bo, ni mashã afɔle mahã bo; shi ni miwo lɛ, maye nɔ. Yiwalaheremɔ lɛ, Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord commanded the fish to vomit up Jonah on the shore. And it did.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa fã ŋshɔŋ loo lɛ, ni eyashwe Yona eŋmɛ shikpɔŋ.

english_verse: to go to that great city of Nineveh and preach his message of doom.
translation_verse: “Tee shi ni oya Nineve maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ mli, koni okɛ wiemɔ ni mikɛhã bo lɛ ayahã amɛ.”

english_verse: Jonah obeyed the Lord and went to Nineveh. The city was so big that it took three days just to walk through it.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yona te shi, ni eyiŋ etee Nineve yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa. Nineve lɛ, maŋ kpeteŋkple jogbaŋŋ ni, ejaakɛ ayeɔ gbii etɛ̃ dani anyiɛɔ kɛjɛɔ maŋ lɛ krotia kome kɛyashɛɔ ekrotia kroko.

english_verse: After walking for a day, Jonah warned the people, “Forty days from now, Nineveh will be destroyed!”
translation_verse: Yona je shishi koni etsɔ̃ maŋ lɛ mli kɛho. Be ni enyiɛ gbi kome gbɛ lɛ, ewo eshiɛmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, biɛ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɛɛ lɛ, abaabutu Nineve.”

english_verse: They believed God's message and set a time when they would go without eating to show their sorrow. Then everyone in the city, no matter who they were, dressed in sackcloth.
translation_verse: Ninevebii lɛ he Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ amɛye; ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛfã akɛ, kɛjɛ mɔ wulu nɔ aahu kɛyashi mɔ bibioo nɔ lɛ, ahi ŋmaa, ni abu kpekpe kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ amɛje amɛhe sɛɛ.

english_verse: When the king of Nineveh heard what was happening, he also dressed in sackcloth; he left the royal palace and sat in dust.
translation_verse: Be ni Nineve maŋtsɛ lɛ nu wiemɔ lɛ, ete shi yɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ, ni ejie etade fɛɛfɛo ni ewo lɛ yɛ ehe efɔ̃ shi, ni ekɔ kpekpe ebu, ni eho eta lamlu mli.

english_verse: When God saw that the people had stopped doing evil things, he had pity and did not destroy them as he had planned.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ na nɔ ni Ninevebii lɛ fee lɛ akɛ amɛtsake amɛjeŋba fɔŋ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hu ŋmɛɛ efɔŋ ni eto eyiŋ akɛ ebaafee amɛ lɛ he, ni egbalaaa amɛtoi.

english_verse: So he prayed: Our Lord, I knew from the very beginning that you wouldn't destroy Nineveh. That's why I left my own country and headed for Spain. You are a kind and merciful God, and you are very patient. You always show love, and you don't like to punish anyone.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, esɔle, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, Yehowa, ani jeee nɔ ni mikɛɛ be mli ni miyɔɔ mimaŋ lɛ eba mli nɛɛ? Enɛ hewɔ nɔŋŋ ni mijɛ mra mijo foi kɛmiiya Tarshish lɛ. Ejaakɛ mile akɛ bo lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ durolɔ kɛ musuŋtsɔlɔ ji bo; omli fuuu mra, ni omɔbɔnalɛ fa, ni otsakeɔ oyiŋtoo yɛ toigbalamɔ he.

english_verse: The Lord replied, “What right do you have to be angry?”
translation_verse: Yehowa bi Yona akɛ, “Kolɛ omli ni ewo la nɛɛ lɛ, eja bɛɛ?”

english_verse: Jonah then left through the east gate of the city and made a shelter to protect himself from the sun. He sat under the shelter, waiting to see what would happen to Nineveh.
translation_verse: Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yona shi Nineve maŋ lɛ mli. Etee ni eyafee asese fioo ko yɛ maŋ lɛ bokãgbɛ, ni eho eta eshishi hɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ mli koni emɛ kɛyashi eeena nɔ ni baaba maŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord made a vine grow up to shade Jonah's head and protect him from the sun. Jonah was very happy to have the vine,
translation_verse: Yehowa hã adedeŋkruma ko kwɛ̃, ni eha Yona yiteŋ koni ehã lɛ hɔɔŋ koni efo ehehiamɔ lɛ sɛɛ ehã lɛ. Yona na adedeŋkruma lɛ he miishɛɛ naakpa.

english_verse: but early the next morning the Lord sent a worm to chew on the vine, and the vine dried up.
translation_verse: Shi gbi lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hã gɔgɔmi baye adedeŋkruma lɛ, ni egbe lɛ.

english_verse: During the day the Lord sent a scorching wind, and the sun beat down on Jonah's head, making him feel faint. Jonah was ready to die, and he shouted, “I wish I were dead!”
translation_verse: Ni be ni hulu te shi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hã bokã kɔɔyɔɔ ko ni mli edɔ batswa, ni Yona tɔ biti yɛ hulu ni shã epampam lɛ naawalɛ hewɔ. Kɛkɛ ni Yona shwe gbele, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Faŋ nɔ ni migbo moŋ fe nɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ.”

english_verse: But the Lord asked, “Jonah, do you have the right to be angry about the vine?” “Yes, I do,” he answered, “and I'm angry enough to die.”
translation_verse: Shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Yona akɛ, “Kolɛ omli ni ewo la yɛ adedeŋkruma lɛ he nɛɛ lɛ, eja bɛɛ?” Yona here nɔ akɛ, “Eja gbɛ akɛ mimli awo la bɔ sɔŋŋ po ni kɛji gbele tete lɛ magbo.”

english_verse: But the Lord said: You are concerned about a vine that you did not plant or take care of, a vine that grew up in one night and died the next.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yona akɛ, “Adedeŋkruma lɛ ni gbi kome nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ jetsɛremɔ ni ekwɛ̃, asaŋ ni nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ jetsɛremɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ ehiɛ ekpãtã, tso ni ogboko ehe deŋme ko, ni jeee bo hu ohã ekwɛ̃ lɛ, esane miidɔ bo.

english_verse: I am Micah from Moresheth. And this is the message about Samaria and Jerusalem that the Lord gave to me when Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah. Judgment on Samaria
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ Yotam kɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahaz kɛ Maŋtsɛ Hezekia ni ji Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, ayinɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ shɛɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ hã Mika ni jɛ maŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Moreshet lɛ mli lɛ. Yehowa jie nibii ni kɔɔ Samaria kɛ Yerusalɛm he nɛɛ fɛɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Mika. Samaria kɛ Yerusalɛm he ŋkɔmɔ

english_verse: Listen, all of you! Earth and everything on it, pay close attention. The Lord God accuses you from his holy temple.
translation_verse: Nyɛ majimaji fɛɛ kwa, nyɛboa toi; shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ bii fɛɛ, nyɛfea toi! Nyɔŋmɔ, Yehowa, aaajɛ eSɔlemɔtsu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli eye odase eshi nyɛ.

english_verse: And he will come down to crush underfoot every pagan altar.
translation_verse: Naa, Yehowa miije kpo kɛjɛ ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni eeeyi shi ni ebanyiɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gɔji lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Mountains will melt beneath his feet like wax beside a fire. Valleys will vanish like water rushing down a ravine.
translation_verse: Gɔji lɛ aaasere yɛ enaneshi tamɔ wo-agbaku sereɔ yɛ la hiɛ lɛ; gɔji lɛ aaayiridi awo jɔi lɛ amli ni jɔi lɛ aaagbalagbalai tamɔ nu ni jɛ gɔŋ yiteŋ eebote jɔɔ mli.

english_verse: This will happen because of the terrible sins of Israel, the descendants of Jacob. Samaria has led Israel to sin, and pagan altars at Jerusalem have made Judah sin.
translation_verse: Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ baaba yɛ esha ni Israelbii efee eshi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ehiɛ atua ni amɛtse lɛ hewɔ. Israelbii atuatsemɔ lɛ, namɔ ejɛ? Ani jeee Samaria, maŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ? Wɔŋjamɔ ni yɔɔ Yuda lɛ, namɔ ejɛ? Ani jeee Yerusalɛm?

english_verse: So the Lord will leave Samaria in ruins— merely an empty field where vineyards are planted. He will scatter its stones and destroy its foundations.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ, “Mahã Samaria akumɔ abua shi yɛ ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ tamɔ he ko ni atɛoɔ waintsei yɛ. Matsi egbogbo koi lɛ mawo jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni mahã tɛi ni akɛto maŋ lɛ gbogboi lɛ ashishi lɛ ahe akã.

english_verse: Samaria's idols will be smashed, and the wages of temple prostitutes will be destroyed by fire. Silver and gold from those idols will then be used by foreigners as payment for prostitutes. Judah Is Doomed
translation_verse: Aaajwara emãgãi lɛ fɛɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ, ni nii ni akɛbawoɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ajwamãŋi anyɔmɔ lɛ, aaashã fɛɛ. Makumɔ ewɔji lɛ fɛɛ mabua shi ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ gɔŋ. Ajwamãŋi anyɔmɔwo mli Samaria bua nii nɛɛ anaa kɛjɛ, ni agbɛnɛ Samaria henyɛlɔi aaaloo fɛɛ kɛaatee amɛjamɔhei yɛ hei krokomɛi.”

english_verse: Because of this tragedy, I go barefoot and naked. My crying and weeping sound like howling wolves or ostriches.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Mika kɛɛ, “Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, maye ŋkɔmɔ ni mawo yara; manyiɛ pasaa kɛ mihe yayai. Mawo yara tamɔ ŋaŋgbei, ni maye ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ okpɔŋɔ loofɔlɔ,

english_verse: Don't tell it in Gath! Don't even cry. Instead, roll in the dust at Beth-Leaphrah.
translation_verse: Nyɛkagbaa yɛ Gat; nyɛkahãa amɛnaa nyɛ ni nyɛmiifo. Bet-Leafrabii, nyɛkokloa mlu mli.

english_verse: Depart naked and ashamed, you people of Shaphir. The town of Bethezel mourns because no one from Zaanan went out to help.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Shafirbii, nyɛjea kpo kɛhoa kɛ hiɛgbele kɛ nyɛhe yayai. Zaananbii lɛ nyɛɛɛ kpo aje. Kɛji nyɛnu ni Bet-Ezelbii miiye ŋkɔmɔ lɛ, nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ abobaahe bɛ jɛi.

english_verse: Everyone in Maroth hoped for the best, but the Lord sent disaster down on Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Marotbii lɛ miishwe heremɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã efɔŋ eshɛ Yerusalɛm agbo lɛ naa etã.

english_verse: Get the war chariots ready, you people of Lachish. You led Jerusalem into sin, just as Israel did.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Lakishbii, nyɛfimɔa shwiilii nyɛkpɛtɛa okpɔŋɔi ni he yɔɔ oya ahe. Israel eshai lɛ nyɛkase feemɔ, ni nyɛkɛhã Yerusalɛm efee esha.

english_verse: Now you will have to give a going-away gift to Moresheth. Israel's kings will discover that they cannot trust the town of Achzib.
translation_verse: Belɛ agbɛnɛ, nyɛ Yudabii, nyɛkɛ Moreshet-Gat maŋ lɛ ayea shɛɛ. Israel maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ naŋ yelikɛbuamɔ kɛjɛŋ Akzib maŋ lɛ mli shĩai adɛŋ.

english_verse: People of Mareshah, the Lord will send someone to capture your town. Then Israel's glorious king will be forced to hide in Adullam Cave.
translation_verse: Mareshabi, Yehowa baajie mɔ ehã ni ebaye nyɛnɔ kunim. Ebaaŋɔ nyɛmaŋ lɛ, ni Israel hiɛnaanɔbii lɛ aaajo foi ayatee yɛ Abdulam tɛkplo lɛ mli.

english_verse: Judah, shave your head as bald as a vulture and start mourning. Your precious children will be dragged off to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Yudabii, nyɛshɛa nyɛyi kɛyea ŋkɔmɔ yɛ nyɛbii ni nyɛsumɔ lɛ ahewɔ. Nyɛkpɔa nyɛyi kuekue tamɔ akpaŋa yiteŋ, ejaakɛ abaaŋɔ nyɛbii lɛ anom kɛaaje nyɛhe kɛya.

english_verse: Doomed! You're doomed! At night you lie in bed, making evil plans. And when morning comes, you do what you've planned because you have the power.
translation_verse: Kpoo hã mɛi ni toɔ efɔŋ he ŋaa yɛ amɛsai anɔ lɛ. Kɛji je tsɛre, ni amɛna hegbɛ lɛ, amɛfeɔ efɔŋ ni amɛto he ŋaa amɛfɔ shi lɛ ejaakɛ efɔŋ lɛ nɔ hewalɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ.

english_verse: You grab any field or house that you want; you cheat families out of homes and land.
translation_verse: Amɛhiɛ kɔ̃ɔ ŋmɔji anɔ, ni amɛshɔ̃ɔ; amɛhiɛ kɔ̃ɔ shĩai anɔ, ni amɛŋɔɔ. Mɔ ko mɔ ko gboshinii kɛ ewe fɛɛ bɛ shweshweeshwe.

english_verse: But here is what the Lord says: “I am planning trouble for you. Your necks will be caught in a noose, and you will be disgraced in this time of disaster.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Mito ni mibahã sane fɔŋ aye nyɛ ni nyɛnyɛŋ enaa foi nyɛjo; amanehulu baaba nyɛnɔ, ni nyɛnyɛŋ nyɛnyiɛ kɛ nyɛhetsɔ̃ɔmɔ.

english_verse: When that happens, this sorrowful song will be sung about you: “Ruined! Completely ruined! The Lord has taken our land and given it to traitors.”
translation_verse: Kɛji nakai be lɛ shɛ lɛ, mɛi kɛ nyɛsane lɛ aaabu abɛ, ni amɛaala nijiaŋwujee lala amɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Wɔhiɛ ekpãtã kwrakwra! Yehowa ehe wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ wɔdɛŋ; ni ekɛhã mɛi ni ŋɔ wɔ nom lɛ, ni eja wɔŋmɔji ehã mɛi ni ŋɔ wɔ nom lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: “Enough of your preaching!” That's what you tell me. “We won't be disgraced, so stop preaching!”
translation_verse: Mɛi shiɛɔ ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Kaashiɛ owo wɔ. Kaashiɛ enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ owo wɔ; hiɛgbele ko bɛ ni baaba wɔnɔ.

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, is it right for you to claim that the Lord did what he did because he was angry? Doesn't he always bless those who do right?
translation_verse: Ani osusuɔ akɛ alomɔ Israelbii? Ani Yehowa tsuishitoo lɛ etã? Ani ebaafee nibii ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi? Mɛi ni feɔ nɔ ni ja lɛ, ani jeee hi miwiemɔ lɛ hi hã amɛ?”

english_verse: My people, you have turned against one another! You have even stolen clothes right off the backs of innocent neighbors who pass by in peace.
translation_verse: Yehowa to he akɛ, “Nyɛteɔ shi nyɛwoɔ mimaŋ lɛ tamɔ ateɔ shi awoɔ henyɛlɔi. Mɛi kuɔ amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛɔ ta naa kɛbaa, ni amɛsusuɔ akɛ amɛfee shweshweeshwe yɛ shĩa. Shi naa nyɛ ni nyɛmiimɛ amɛ koni nyɛkpɔlɔ amɛtadei yɛ amɛhe.

english_verse: You take over lovely homes that belong to the women of my nation. Then you cheat their children out of the inheritance that comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛshwieɔ mimaŋ lɛ mli yei lɛ yɛ amɛshĩai ni amɛsumɔɔ lɛ; ni jɔɔmɔi ni mikɛjɔɔ amɛbii lɛ, nyɛshɔ̃ yɛ amɛdɛŋ kɛmiiya naanɔ.

english_verse: Get out of here, you crooks! You'll find no rest here. You're not fit to belong to the Lord's people, and you will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nyɛtea shi ni nyɛyaa. Biɛ bɛ shweshweeshwe dɔŋŋ yɛ nyɛhe eshai ni kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ baaba lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: The only prophet you want is a liar who will say, “Drink and get drunk!” A Promise of Hope
translation_verse: “Gbalɔ ni maŋ nɛɛ sumɔɔ ji gbalɔ ni nyiɛɔ ni ewieɔ fuu ni emaleɔ ni ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Wain kɛ dãa ni wa baabu ahã nyɛ.’

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to bring together the people of Israel who have survived. I will gather them, just as a shepherd brings sheep together, and there will be many.
translation_verse: “Shi bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, mabua nyɛnaa, nyɛ Israelbii fɛɛ ni eshwɛ. Mabua nyɛnaa tamɔ too gwantɛŋ ku kome; mabua nyɛnaa tamɔ too ku yɛ amɛniyelihe yɛ ŋa nɔ; nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ baashi hoo ekoŋŋ kɛ gbɔmɛi.”

english_verse: Listen to me, you rulers of Israel! You know right from wrong,
translation_verse: Nyɛ Israel onukpai ni ji Israel nɔyelɔi, nyɛboa toi! Ani jeee nyɛgbɛnaa ji akɛ nyɛaale nɔ ni ja?

english_verse: but you prefer to do evil instead of what is right. You skin my people alive. You strip off their flesh,
translation_verse: Shi nyɛnyɛɔ ekpakpa, ni nyɛsumɔɔ efɔŋ. Nyɛkpɔɔ mimaŋbii lɛ ahe wolo yɛ amɛhe be mli ni amɛhiɛ kã; ni nyɛjieɔ amɛheloo yɛ amɛwui ahe.

english_verse: break their bones, cook it all in a pot, and gulp it down.
translation_verse: Nyɛyeɔ mimaŋbii lɛ aloo. Nyɛkpɔɔ amɛhe wolo yɛ amɛhe; nyɛkumɔɔ amɛwui, ni nyɛdukuɔ mli tamɔ loo ni akɛyaawo kukwɛi wulu mli.

english_verse: Someday you will beg the Lord to help you, but he will turn away because of your sins.
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ nyɛaablɔ nyɛtsɛ Yehowa, shi efoŋ nyɛdaaŋ; shi moŋ ekɛ ehiɛ aaatee nyɛ yɛ efɔŋ ni nyɛfee lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: You lying prophets promise security for anyone who gives you food, but disaster for anyone who refuses to feed you. Here is what the Lord says to you prophets:
translation_verse: Gbalɔi lɛ lakaa mimaŋ lɛ. Mɛi ni hãa gbalɔi nɛɛ nɔ ko lɛ, gbalɔi lɛ shiɛɔ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ akɛ hejɔlɛ miiba; shi mɛi ni hãaa amɛ nɔ ko lɛ, amɛwoɔ amɛhe gbeyei akɛ ta baaba abatua amɛ. Yehowa miikɛɛ gbalɔi nɛɛ akɛ,

english_verse: “You will live in the dark, far from the sight of the sun, with no message from me.
translation_verse: “Gbalɔi, eshwɛ fioo kɛkɛ ni nyɛbe baaho. Hulu aaanyɔ shi yɛ nyɛnɔ. Akɛni nyɛhã mimaŋ lɛ du gbɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnaŋ ninaa ko dɔŋŋ, ni nyɛnyɛŋ gbalɛ ko hu nyɛgba dɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: But the Lord has filled me with power and his Spirit. I have been given the courage to speak about justice and to tell you people of Israel that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, Yehowa kɛ emumɔ kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ woɔ mimli obɔ̃, ni ehãa mileɔ nɔ ni ji jalɛ, ni ehãa mi ekãa ni akɛkɛɔ Israelbii lɛ nɔ ni hi kɛ nɔ ni ji eshai ni amɛfeɔ lɛ.

english_verse: So listen to my message, you rulers of Israel! You hate justice and twist the truth.
translation_verse: Nyɛ Yakob we onukpai, nyɛ Israel nɔyelɔi, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛhiɔ jalɛ, ni nyɛhãa jalɛ tsɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni ejaaa, nyɛboa toi koo!

english_verse: You make cruelty and murder a way of life in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nyɛmiima Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ wulu ni ji Yerusalɛm lɛ, nyɛmiima lashishwiemɔ kɛ kutumpɔo.

english_verse: You leaders accept bribes for dishonest decisions. You priests and prophets teach and preach, but only for money. Then you say, “The Lord is on our side. No harm will come to us.”
translation_verse: Maŋ onukpai lɛ, nyɔɔŋnii amɛheɔ dani amɛbuaa sane he; osɔfoi lɛ, nyɔmɔwoo hewɔ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ, ni gbalɔi lɛ shika hewɔ amɛgbaa nɔ ni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ. Kɛ̃lɛ amɛkɛ amɛhe kpasaa Yehowa ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Yehowa kɛ wɔ yɛ; nɔ fɔŋ ko nɔ fɔŋ ko baŋ wɔnɔ.”

english_verse: And so, because of you, Jerusalem will be plowed under and left in ruins. Thorns will cover the mountain where the temple now stands.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ, aaatsa Zion ashwie shi tamɔ atsaa ŋa akɛfeɔ ŋmɔ. Yerusalɛm aaatsɔ̃ tsu koi ni bua shi tamɔ gɔŋ, ni Sɔlemɔ we lɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ aaatsa atsɔ̃ koo hayii.

english_verse: In the future, the mountain with the Lord's temple will be the highest of all. It will reach above the hills, and every nation will rush to it.
translation_verse: Wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ Sɔlemɔ We lɛ gɔŋ lɛ aaakwɔ fe gɔŋkpɔi lɛ fɛɛ, ni eeeta gɔŋkpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. Majimaji aaabu kɛaaba enɔ.

english_verse: People of many nations will come and say, “Let's go up to the mountain of the Lord God of Jacob and worship in his temple.” The Lord will teach us his Law from Jerusalem, and we will obey him.
translation_verse: Ni maji amli bii pii aaaba abakɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa ni nyɛhãa wɔyakwɔa Yehowa gɔŋ lɛ, kɛya Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ; ejaakɛ eeetsɔ̃ɔ wɔ nɔ ni etaoɔ ni wɔfee; koni wɔnyiɛ egbɛi lɛ anɔ. Ejaakɛ Yehowa Mla lɛ, Yerusalɛm ebaajɛ; ekɛ emaŋ lɛ wieɔ kɛjɛɔ Zion.”

english_verse: He will settle arguments between distant and powerful nations. They will pound their swords and their spears into rakes and shovels; they will never again make war or attack one another.
translation_verse: Eeekojo maji pii ateŋ, eeebua maji wuji ni bɛŋkɛ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ fɛɛ anaa. Amɛkɛ amɛklantei aaasɔ̃ kɔii, ni amɛkɛ amɛkpɔlɔi lɛ hu aaasɔ̃ kaklai adɔi ni akɛkpɔlɔɔ tso he. Maŋ ko woŋ klante nɔ yɛ maŋ ko nɔ ni amɛsaŋ amɛhe amɛhaŋ tawuu dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Everyone will find rest beneath their own fig trees or grape vines, and they will live in peace. This is a solemn promise of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaata lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewaintsei kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbãmitsei ashishi yɛ hejɔlɛ mli. Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ ni kɛɛ enɛ.

english_verse: Others may follow their gods, but we will always follow the Lord our God. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: Maŋ fɛɛ maŋ jaa, ni eboɔ enyɔŋmɔ toi; shi wɔ lɛ wɔɔja ni wɔɔbo Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ toi kɛaatee naanɔ. Israelbii lɛ aaajɛ nomŋɔɔ mli aba

english_verse: The Lord said: At that time I will gather my people— the lame and the outcasts, and all others into whose lives I have brought sorrow.
translation_verse: “Be miiba,” Yehowa kɛɛ, “Ni mabua obubuafoi ni egbɔjɔ kɛ mɛi ni ashwie amɛ, mɛi ni migbala amɛtoi lɛ fɛɛ anaa kɛaaba.

english_verse: Then the lame and the outcasts will belong to my people and become a strong nation. I, the Lord, will rule them from Mount Zion forever.
translation_verse: Ni mikɛ akpaketsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ, kɛ maŋ, mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ baaje shishi, ni mafee amɛ maŋ ni da agbo. Ni Yehowa aaaye amɛnɔ maŋtsɛ yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛaajɛ nakai be lɛ kɛaatee naanɔ fɛɛ.”

english_verse: Mount Zion in Jerusalem, guardian of my people, you will rule again.
translation_verse: Ni bo, Yerusalɛm, tooku lɛ mɔɔ ni kwɔ, Zion biyoo lɛ gɔŋkpɔ, oootsɔ̃ maŋtsɛmaŋ ekoŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni oyɔɔ tsutsu lɛ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, why are you crying? Don't you have a king? Have your advisors gone? Are you suffering like a woman in childbirth?
translation_verse: Mɛɛba obolɔɔ? Mɛɛba okɛ̃mɔɔ tamɔ yoo ni baafɔ? Maŋtsɛ ni obɛ hewɔ ni, aloo oŋaawolɔ ni egbo hewɔ ni?

english_verse: Keep on groaning with pain, you people of Jerusalem! If you escape from your city to the countryside, you will still be taken as prisoners to Babylonia. But later I will rescue you from your enemies.
translation_verse: Yerusalɛmbii, nyɛkɛ̃mɔa, ni nyɛkɔ̃mɔa tamɔ yoo ni fɔmɔ eta ehe; ejaakɛ nyɛbaashi maŋ lɛ mli ni nyɛaayahi ŋa lɛ nɔ; nyɛbaaya Babilon tɔ̃ɔ. Shi jɛi lɛ Yehowa aaahere nyɛ yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ.

english_verse: Zion, because of your sins you are surrounded by many nations who say, “We can hardly wait to see you disgraced.”
translation_verse: Maji pii ekpe ewo nyɛhe, ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Afite Yerusalɛm koni wɔna ni ejwere shi koikoi.”

english_verse: But they don't know that I, the Lord, have gathered them here to grind them like grain.
translation_verse: Shi maji nɛɛ leee Yehowa jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, amɛyooo eyiŋtoo lɛ sɛɛ hu akɛ Yehowa ebua amɛnaa tamɔ abuaa ŋmãakei anaa yɛ ŋmãagbeemɔhe.

english_verse: Smash them to pieces, Zion! I'll let you be like a bull with iron horns and bronze hoofs. Crush those nations and bring their wealth to me, the Lord of the earth.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Yerusalɛmbii, nyɛtea shi; ni nyɛgbea nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ tamɔ agbeɔ ŋmãa! Mahã nyɛhe awa tamɔ tsinanuu kɛ eklontoi ni wa tamɔ dade kɛ ekoklotoi hu ni wa tamɔ akɔɔble. Nyɛaaye maji pii anɔ kunim; ni nyɛaajɔɔ haanii ni amɛshɔ̃ aklanaŋ naa lɛ nɔ nyɛhã mi, mi ni ji je lɛ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, enemy troops have surrounded you; they have struck Israel's ruler in the face with a stick.
translation_verse: Yerusalɛmbii, nyɛbuaa nyɛtabilɔi anaa! Asa wɔyi! Atua Israelbii ahiɛnyiɛlɔ lɛ! Nyɔŋmɔ wo nɔyelɔ ni baajɛ Betlehem he shi

english_verse: Bethlehem Ephrath, you are one of the smallest towns in the nation of Judah. But the Lord will choose one of your people to rule the nation— someone whose family goes back to ancient times.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Betlehem Efrata, maji bibii fe fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ ekome ji bo, shi omli majie Israel nɔyelɔ kɛaajɛ. Nɔyelɔ nɛɛ weku kpãa aaajɛ blema beebe.”

english_verse: The Lord will abandon Israel only until this ruler is born, and the rest of his family returns to Israel.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa aaaŋmɛɛ emaŋ lɛ he ehã amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni yoofɔyoo lɛ aaafɔ ebinuu lɛ, ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni eshwɛ ni yɔɔ nomŋɔɔ mli lɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaaba amɛnyɛmɛi Israelbii lɛ aŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Like a shepherd taking care of his sheep, this ruler will lead and care for his people by the power and glorious name of the Lord his God. His people will live securely, and the whole earth will know his true greatness,
translation_verse: Kɛ nɔyelɔ lɛ ba lɛ, eeeye emaŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eeelɛ amɛ kɛ hewalɛ ni jɛ Yehowa dɛŋ; eeeye nɔ kɛ agbojee hu ni ji Yehowa, eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ agbojee. Nɔyelɔ lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ aaahi shi shweshweeshwe, ejaakɛ aaakpɛ̃lɛ nɔ akɛ eje agbo yɛ je lɛ mli he fɛɛ he;

english_verse: because he will bring peace. Assyria Will Be Defeated Let Assyria attack our country and our palaces. We will counterattack, led by a number of rulers
translation_verse: ni ekɛ hejɔlɛ aaaba. Jiemɔ kɛ Toigbalamɔ Kɛji Asiriabii lɛ aaabatua wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ, kɛji amɛaafite wɔmɔji ni buɔ wɔhe lɛ ni amɛaatsɔ̃ mli kɛho lɛ, no lɛ wɔɔtee hiɛnyiɛlɔi kãkãlɔi babaoo shi wɔwo amɛ.

english_verse: whose strong army will defeat the nation of Assyria. Yes, our leaders will rescue us, if those Assyrians dare to invade our land. The Survivors Will Be Safe
translation_verse: Amɛkɛ klante aaaye Asiria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, Nimrod Shikpɔŋ lɛ. Amɛaahere wɔ kɛaajɛ Asiriabii lɛ adɛŋ, kɛji amɛba amɛbashimɔshimɔɔ shi yɛ wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: A few of Jacob's descendants survived and are scattered among the nations. But the Lord will let them cover the earth like dew and rain that refreshes the soil.
translation_verse: Israelbii ni aaashwɛ lɛ aaatamɔ ŋwɛi bɔ ni Yehowa hãa enyɔɔ maji pii anɔ lɛ. Mɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ aaatamɔ futufuli ni shwãa jwɛfɔ nɔ. Amɛkɛ amɛhe aaafɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ, shi jeee gbɔmɔ adesa ko nɔ.

english_verse: At present they are scattered, but later they will attack, as though they were fierce lions pouncing on sheep. Their enemies will be torn to shreds, with no one to save them;
translation_verse: Israelbii ni aaashwɛ yɛ maji lɛ ateŋ lɛ aaatamɔ jata yɛ kooŋ kooloi ateŋ, aloo tamɔ jata oblanyo yɛ tookui ateŋ. Kɛji eegbɔbi kɛbote kooloi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, ehuruɔ eyiɔ amɛnɔ, ni etserɛɔ amɛmli, ni jielɔ ko bɛ.

english_verse: they will be helpless, completely destroyed. Idols Will Be Destroyed in Israel
translation_verse: Israelbii lɛ aaaye amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kunim, ni amɛaakpãtã amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said: At that time I will wipe out your cavalry and chariots,
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ makpãtã okpɔŋɔi lɛ ahiɛ, ni mafite oshwiilii lɛ.

english_verse: I will stop you from telling fortunes and practicing witchcraft.
translation_verse: Makpãtã okunyaayelɔi lɛ ahiɛ, ni okɔmfo kome nɛkɛ eshwɛŋ haŋ bo.

english_verse: You will no longer worship the idols or stone images you have made— I will destroy them,
translation_verse: Mafite omãgãi lɛ kɛ owɔŋtɛi lɛ, ni ojaŋ nibii ni okɛ oniji fee lɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: together with the sacred poles and even your towns.
translation_verse: Wɔŋyoo Ashera wɔŋkoi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, makwao mashwie shi, ni mafite omaji lɛ.

english_verse: I will become furious and take revenge on the nations that refuse to obey me.
translation_verse: Mikɛ mlifu kpele kɛ mlila aaatɔ owele yɛ maji fɛɛ ni booo mi toi ni egbo minɔ toi lɛ anɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to his people: Come and present your case to the hills and mountains.
translation_verse: Nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi, “Tee shi ni okɔlɔ ogbee! Hã gɔji kɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ anu osane lɛ.

english_verse: Israel, I am bringing charges against you— I call upon the mountains and the earth's firm foundation to be my witnesses.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ gɔji, nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishitoo ni yɔɔ daa, nyɛboa Yehowa sane lɛ toi! Yehowa kɛ emaŋ Israel ena; ekɛ sane ni eyɔɔ yɛ amɛhe lɛ baashi lɛ.”

english_verse: My people, have I wronged you in any way at all? Please tell me.
translation_verse: Yehowa miibi emaŋ lɛ akɛ, “Mimaŋ, mɛni mifee bo? Mɛni mli mihã etɔ bo yɛ? Hã mi hetoo.

english_verse: I rescued you from Egypt, where you were slaves. I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to be your leaders.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mi mijie bo kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mikpɔ̃ bo yɛ nyɔŋyeli mli. Mitsu Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Miriam kɛba akɛ ohiɛnyiɛlɔi.

english_verse: Don't forget the evil plans of King Balak of Moab or what Balaam son of Beor said to him. Remember how I, the Lord, saved you many times on your way from Acacia to Gilgal. True Obedience
translation_verse: Mimaŋbii, nyɛkaia nɔ yiŋ ni Moab maŋtsɛ Balak to yɛ nyɛhe, kɛ nɔ hetoo ni Bileam, Beor bi lɛ, hã lɛ. Nyɛkaia nibii ni ba yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ Akasia shitoohe lɛ kɛtee Gilgal tɔ̃ɔ lɛ. Nyɛkaia nibii nɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni nyɛna nibii ni mi, Yehowa, mitsu ni mikɛhere nyɛyiwala lɛ.” Nɔ ni Yehowa taoɔ

english_verse: What offering should I bring when I bow down to worship the Lord God Most High? Should I try to please him by sacrificing calves a year old?
translation_verse: Mɛni mikɛaaba Yehowa hiɛ, ni mɛni mikɛaabakoto Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ hiɛ? Miba ehiɛ kɛ shãa afɔlei? Mikɛ tsinabii ni eye afifi abashã shãa afɔlei ahã lɛ?

english_verse: Will thousands of sheep or rivers of olive oil make God satisfied with me? Should I sacrifice to the Lord my first-born child as payment for my terrible sins?
translation_verse: Ani toi agboi akpekpei aloo mu tsɛnsii akpei nyɔŋmai abɔ aaasa Yehowa hiɛ? Aso mikɛ mikromɔbi, mimusuŋbi lɛ ahã yɛ mihe esha hewɔ?

english_verse: The Lord God has told us what is right and what he demands: “See that justice is done, let mercy be your first concern, and humbly obey your God.” Cheating and Violence
translation_verse: Dabida! Ao Adesa, Yehowa etsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni hi. Nɔ ni ebiɔ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ nɛ, akɛ ofee nɔ ni ja gbɛ, osumɔ onyɛmimɛi, okɛ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ anyiɛ yɛ heshibaa mli.

english_verse: I am the Lord, and you are wise to respect my power to punish. So listen to my message for the city of Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Ehi akɛ ashe Yehowa gbeyei. Eeetsɛ maŋ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛboa toi, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa kɛkpeɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli!

english_verse: But I, the Lord, will punish you for cheating with weights and with measures.
translation_verse: Ani mikɛ mɛi ni kɛ susumɔnii kɛ nsɛnitɛi ni shɛɛɛ ŋmɛɔ nii lɛ ahe esha aaafa amɛ lo?

english_verse: You rich people are violent, and everyone tells lies.
translation_verse: Niiatsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ shishiuɔ ohiafoi lɛ; ni nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ amalelɔi ji nyɛ.

english_verse: Because of your sins, I will wound you and leave you ruined and defenseless.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mije nyɛ nitswiamɔ kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ shishi momo yɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: You will eat, but still be hungry; you will store up goods, but lose everything— I, the Lord, will let it all be captured in war.
translation_verse: Nyɛaaye nii, shi nyɛtɔrɔŋ; ni hɔmɔ aaakã he aye nyɛ. Nyɛaaloo nii nyɛto, shi efeŋ shweshweeshwe, ni nɔ ni nyɛaabaa yi tete lɛ, makpãtã hiɛ yɛ ta mli.

english_verse: You won't harvest what you plant or use the oil from your olive trees or drink the wine from grapes you grow.
translation_verse: Nyɛaadu nii, shi nyɛkpaŋ eko. Nyɛaaŋa mu, shi nyɛnaŋ mu nyɛkpa, ni nyɛaaŋa wain hu, shi nyɛnuŋ wain.

english_verse: Jerusalem, this will happen because you followed the sinful example of kings Omri and Ahab. Now I will destroy you and your property. Then the people of every nation will make fun and insult you.
translation_verse: Enɛ baaba mli, ejaakɛ Maŋtsɛ Omri nibii gbohii lɛ kɛ ebi Ahab nibii fɔ̃ji lɛ, nomɛi anɔ nyɛtsa. No hewɔ lɛ, mahã nyɛmaji lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni abuŋ nyɛ, ni aaabo nyɛ ‘tsia’!”

english_verse: I feel so empty inside— like someone starving for grapes or figs, after the vines and trees have all been picked clean.
translation_verse: Kpoo hã mi! Mitsɔ̃ tamɔ mɔ ko ni hɔmɔ miiye lɛ ni eetao tsoyibii loo wainyibii ko eye, ejaakɛ akpa wainyibii kɛ agbãmii ni ŋɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ atã, ni shao ko bɛ ni aaana aye; agbãmi hee ni mitsui shweɔ lɛ eko bɛ.

english_verse: No one is loyal to God; no one does right. Everyone is brutal and eager to deceive everyone else.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔ ko bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ; mɔ ko bɛ ni yeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miitao akɛ ena hegbɛ ni eshwie lá shi. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miigbɔbi enaanyo.

english_verse: Don't trust anyone, not even your best friend, and be careful what you say to the one you love.
translation_verse: Kaahe onaanyo oye; ni kɛ ohiɛ akafɔ̃ oshieŋtsɛ nɔ. Yoo ni kãa osɛɛ tete po lɛ, jwɛŋmɔ he jogbaŋŋ dani okɛɛ lɛ nɔ ko.

english_verse: Sons refuse to respect their own fathers, daughters rebel against their own mothers, and daughters-in-law despise their mothers-in-law. Your family is now your enemy.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ binuu ebuuu etsɛ, biyoo teɔ shi woɔ enyɛ; ni shaayoo teɔ shi woɔ eshaayoo. Gbɔmɔ henyɛlɔi ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshĩa teŋ bii.

english_verse: But I trust the Lord God to save me, and I will wait for him to answer my prayer. The Nation Turns to God
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, makwɛ Yehowa gbɛ; mamɛ miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ; ni miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaabo mi toi. Yehowa kɛ Yiwalaheremɔ eba

english_verse: My enemies, don't be glad because of my troubles! I may have fallen, but I will get up; I may be sitting in the dark, but the Lord is my light.
translation_verse: Ao mihenyɛlɔ, kaaye mi yɔɔ. Kɛ migbee shi lɛ, mibate shi ekoŋŋ; kɛ duŋ wo mi lɛ, Yehowa aaatsɔ̃ la ahã mi.

english_verse: I have sinned against the Lord. And so I must endure his anger, until he comes to my defense. But I know that I will see him making things right for me and leading me to the light.
translation_verse: Makplɛ̃ Yehowa mli ni efu mi lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ mifee esha mishi lɛ; mamɛ kɛyashi eeefã mihe, ni eeebu mi bem. Eeejie mi kɛaaba la hiɛ ni mana ekpɔmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You, my enemies, said, “The Lord God is helpless.” Now each of you will be disgraced and put to shame. I will see you trampled like mud in the street. A Bright Future
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ mihenyɛlɔ mɔ ni ebi mi akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ” lɛ? Aaana, ni ehiɛ aaagbo kpɔtɔɔ. Mihiŋmɛi aaana lɛ; agbɛnɛ aaanaanaa enɔ tamɔ blohuŋ ŋmɔtɔ.

english_verse: Towns of Judah, the day is coming when your walls will be rebuilt, and your boundaries enlarged.
translation_verse: Yerusalɛmbii, be miiba ni aaasaa maŋ lɛ gbogboi lɛ atswa ni aaalɛɛ ehusui amli kɛaatee sɛɛ.

english_verse: Those nations will suffer disaster because of what they did. Micah's Prayer and the Lord's Answer
translation_verse: Shi shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ shiaŋa yɛ enɔ bii lɛ anifɔ̃ɔjianii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ ahewɔ. Yehowa aaana Israel mɔbɔ

english_verse: Lead your people, Lord! Come and be our shepherd. Grasslands surround us, but we live in a forest. So lead us to Bashan and Gilead, and let us find pasture as we did long ago.
translation_verse: Yehowa, feemɔ tookwɛlɔ ohã omaŋ lɛ, ni olɛ amɛ, maŋ ni bo diɛŋtsɛ ohala lɛ. Amɛyɛ ŋa kplanaa nɔ banee yɛ Gɔŋ Karmel lɛ yiteŋ, tsɛbelɛ shikpɔŋ ni baa nii bɔle amɛ kɛkpe. Hã ni amɛhi Bashan kɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ frɔ̃frɔ̃ lɛ nɔ; ni amɛye enɔ nii tamɔ blema ko lɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will work miracles just as I did when I led you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Mafee naakpɛɛnii matsɔ̃ɔ amɛ tamɔ be ni mijie amɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Nations will see this and be ashamed because of their helpless armies. They will be in shock, unable to speak or hear,
translation_verse: Maji lɛ aaana, ni yɛ amɛhewalɛ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛnijiaŋ aaaje wui. Amɛkɛ amɛnine aaato amɛnaabu ni amɛaatsimɔ amɛtoii.

english_verse: because of their fear of me, your Lord and God. Then they will come trembling, crawling out of their fortresses like insects or snakes, lapping up the dust. No One Is Like God The people said:
translation_verse: Amɛaalɛmɔ shikpɔŋ su, ni amɛaawamɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ tamɔ onufu. Amɛaajɛ amɛmɔji lɛ amli amɛaaba kɛ hekpokpomɔ. Yehowa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ he ŋmiŋmi aaamɔmɔ amɛ, ni amɛaashe bo gbeyei.

english_verse: Our God, no one is like you. We are all that is left of your chosen people, and you freely forgive our sin and guilt. You don't stay angry forever; you're glad to have pity
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ ni kɛ esha faa tamɔ bo. Okuɔ ohiɛ ofɔ̃ɔ omaŋbii ni eshwɛ lɛ amlatɔ̃mɔ nɔ. Ohiɛɛɛ mlifu mli kɛyaaa naanɔ, ejaakɛ onaa mɔbɔnalɛ he tsui.

english_verse: and pleased to be merciful. You will trample on our sins and throw them in the sea.
translation_verse: Oooku sɛɛ omusuŋ atsɔ̃ bo yɛ wɔhe. Okɛ onane aaashwishwia wɔnishaianii lɛ anɔ ni osherɛ oshwie ŋshɔ shishi bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: You will keep your word and be faithful to Jacob and to Abraham, as you promised our ancestors many years ago.
translation_verse: Obaajie onɔkwayeli kɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kpo otsɔ̃ɔ omaŋ lɛ, ni ji Abraham kɛ Yakob shwiei lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni owo wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ashi blema bei lɛ amli beebe lɛ.

english_verse: I am Nahum from Elkosh. And this is the message that I wrote down about Nineveh. The Fierce Anger of the Lord
translation_verse: Nineve shigbeemɔ he gbalɛ nɛɛ, ajie atsɔ̃ɔ Gbalɔ Nahum, Elkoshnyo lɛ. Yehowa mli efu Nineve

english_verse: The Lord is powerful, yet patient; he makes sure that the guilty are always punished. He can be seen in storms and in whirlwinds; clouds are the dust from his feet.
translation_verse: Yehowa mli fuuu mra, ni ehewalɛ da kpele; ehãaa tɔ̃lɔ aŋɔ ehe aye. Ahum kɛ lasuogbele teɔ shi yɛ he ni Yehowa etsɔ̃ kɛho, ni enaneshi mlu ji atatui.

english_verse: At the Lord's command, oceans and rivers dry up. Bashan, Mount Carmel, and Lebanon wither, and their flowers fade.
translation_verse: Eŋãa ŋshɔ yi, ni emiɔ; ehãa fai fɛɛ miɔ. Bashan kɛ Karmel gɔji lɛ anɔ ŋãlãa, ni Lebanon ŋã floŋŋ lɛ hu ŋãlãa.

english_verse: At the sight of the Lord, mountains and hills tremble and melt; the earth and its people shudder and shake.
translation_verse: Gɔji hosoɔ yɛ ehiɛ, gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ sereɔ: Shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ kpãtãa yɛ ehiɛ, ni je lɛ kɛ emli bii fɛɛ hu ahiɛ kpãtãa.

english_verse: Who can stand the heat of his furious anger? It flashes out like fire and shatters stones. The Power of Assyria Will Be Broken
translation_verse: Namɔ aaanyɛ emlila naa adamɔ? Namɔ aaanyɛ emlifu ni naa wa lɛ naa ekpee? Emlifu tsɛ̃ɔ kɛbaa tamɔ la, ni efɛlɛɔ tɛsai amli.

english_verse: The Lord is good. He protects those who trust him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Yehowa hi, etsɔ̃ɔ teemɔhe yɛ amanehulu be mli, ni ebaa mɛi ni baa lɛ abo lɛ ayi.

english_verse: But like a roaring flood, the Lord chases his enemies into dark places and destroys them.
translation_verse: Shi ebaa tamɔ faa ni eje ŋã, ni ebakpãtãa ehenyɛlɔi ahiɛ; etiuɔ ehenyɛlɔi kɛyashiɔ egbeɔ amɛ.

english_verse: So don't plot against the Lord! He wipes out his enemies, and they never revive.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ shi nyɛte nyɛwo Yehowa lɛ? Ebaakpãtã nyɛhiɛ kwraa. Etɔɔɔ owele shii enyɔ.

english_verse: They are like drunkards overcome by wine, or like twisted thornbushes burning in a fire.
translation_verse: Abaashã amɛ wɛɛ tamɔ ŋmei ni eloloo, loo gbetseli gbiŋ.

english_verse: Assyria, one of your rulers has made evil plans against the Lord.
translation_verse: Nineve, ani mɔ ko jɛɛɛ omli ni jwɛŋ Yehowa he efɔŋ, ni to ehe yiŋ fɔŋ?

english_verse: But the Lord says, “Assyria, no matter how strong you are, you will be cut down! My people Judah, I have troubled you before, but I won't do it again.
translation_verse: Israelbii, nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Yɛ mli akɛ Asiriabii lɛ ayi fa po nɛ, shi amɛhiɛ baakpãtã; ni amɛsɛɛ baafo. Mipiŋ nyɛ kɛho; mipiŋŋ nyɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: I'll snap your chains and set you free from the Assyrians.”
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ, apã lɛ ni Asiria kɛfɔ̃ nyɛkuɛ lɛ mibakumɔ mli; ni mibatserɛ kpãai ni fimɔ nyɛ lɛ amli.”

english_verse: Assyria, this is what else the Lord says to you: “Your name will be forgotten. I will destroy every idol in your temple, and I will send you to the grave, because you are worthless.”
translation_verse: Kitã ni Yehowa ewo yɛ Asiria he ji enɛ, “Onaŋ shwiei ni baahã akai ogbɛi. Makumɔ sũ amãgãi kɛ dade amãgãi lɛ ni yɔɔ ojemawɔji lɛ awei lɛ amli lɛ. Masaa gbonyobu mato bo, Asiria ejaakɛ ohiii kwraa.”

english_verse: Look toward the mountains, people of Judah! Here comes a messenger with good news of peace. Celebrate your festivals. Keep your promises to God. Your evil enemies are destroyed and will never again invade your country.
translation_verse: Naa, bɔfo ko miiba yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ kɛ sane kpakpa; eeba kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ sane. Yudabii, nyɛyea nyɛgbii juji lɛ; ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛfaŋnii ni nyɛwo he shi lɛ, nyɛkɛbahãa lɛ. Yitsoŋwalɔi lɛ baŋ abatuaŋ nyɛ dɔŋŋ; akpãtã amɛhiɛ butuu.

english_verse: Nineveh, someone is coming to attack and scatter you. Guard your fortresses! Watch the road! Be brave! Prepare for battle!
translation_verse: Nineve, nifitelɔ lɛ eba ebaatua bo! Mɔ ni baakpãtã ohiɛ lɛ eshɛ shi. Abu maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ he! Nyɛmiaa; buamɔ otabilɔi blublu anaa!

english_verse: An officer gives a command. But his soldiers stumble, as they hasten to build a shelter to protect themselves against rocks thrown down from the city wall.
translation_verse: Atsɛɔ tabilɔi asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ; shi amɛnaji tɛrɛɔ shi kɛyaa, be mli ni henyɛlɔi lɛ tsɛ̃ɔ kɛbaninaa maŋ gbogbo lɛ; ni amɛmamɔɔ nibii kɛtsĩɔ amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: The river gates fly open, and panic floods the palace.
translation_verse: Agbele faa lɛ naagbɛ agboi lɛ, maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli yiɔ kɛ hejaramɔ.

english_verse: Nineveh is disgraced. The queen is dragged off. Her servant women mourn; they moan like doves, and they beat their breasts in sorrow.
translation_verse: Aŋɔ maŋnyɛ lɛ nom kɛtee, ni eweyei lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ; amɛgbei etsɔ̃ tamɔ okpoi agbee; amɛmiiyi amɛtsitsii anɔ mã.

english_verse: Nineveh is like a pond with leaking water. Shouts of “Stop! Don't go!” can be heard everywhere. But everyone is leaving.
translation_verse: Ninevebii eke kɛ foi tamɔ faa ni etue, amɛke kɛ blɔmɔ akɛ, “Nyɛdamɔa shi! Nyɛdamɔa shi!” Shi mɔ ko mɔ ko ekuuu esɛɛ.

english_verse: Enemy soldiers shout, “The city is full of treasure and all kinds of wealth. Steal her silver! Grab her gold!”
translation_verse: Nyɛhaa jwiɛtɛi! Nyɛhaa shika! Jwinei srɔtoi ni abua naa ato yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, jeee hiɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Nineveh is doomed! Destroyed! Her people tremble with fear; their faces turn pale.
translation_verse: Akpãtã Nineve hiɛ, afee lɛ butuu etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃! Gbeyei emɔmɔ tsuii, nakutsei miikpokpo hewalɛ etã yɛ mɛi amli, ni hiɛiaŋ fɛɛ eshale.

english_verse: What happened to this city? They were safer there than powerful lions in a den, with no one to disturb them.
translation_verse: Nɛgbɛ maŋ lɛ ni tsɔ̃ tamɔ jata oblahii ashihilɛhe lɛ yɔɔ, he ni jata shãtã eniyenii kɛtee ebii aŋɔɔ yɛ, ni mɔ ko gbaaa enaa lɛ?

english_verse: These are the same lions that ferociously attacked their victims, then dragged away the flesh to feed their young.
translation_verse: Jata nuu lɛ gbe loo bɔ ni baashɛ jata yoo kɛ ebii anaa; ewo etɛkplo lɛ mli obɔ̃, kɛ ebui lɛ amli kɛ loo ni egbe.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is against you, Nineveh. God will burn your chariots and send an army to kill those young lions of yours. You will never again make victims of others or send messengers to threaten everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, mikɛ nyɛ ena. Mibama nyɛtayaa shwiilii lɛ anaa la mashã. Nyɛtabilɔi ni tamɔ jata lɛ baanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ ta mli. Mashɔ̃ nibii fɛɛ ni nyɛshɔ̃shɔ̃ɔ yɛ mɛi adɛŋ lɛ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ, asaŋ anuŋ ohewalɛ he yɛ je lɛ mli dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Doom to the crime capital! Nineveh, city of murder and treachery,
translation_verse: Kpoo hã maŋ ni shwieɔ lá shi ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ amale kɛ yiwalɛ kɛ mɛi anii ni ayaha.

english_verse: here is your fate— cracking whips, churning wheels; galloping horses, roaring chariots;
translation_verse: Bo toi! Okpɔŋɔ gwaomɔ kpãa miigbɛɛ, tayaa shwiilii anaji miigbɛɛ; okpɔŋɔi esha foi, ni tayaa shwiilii miihɛlɛ shi!

english_verse: You were nothing more than a prostitute using your magical charms and witchcraft to attract and trap nations.
translation_verse: Fɛɛ jɛ Nineve ajwamãŋbɔɔ. Ehe yɛ fɛo bɔ ni ekɛ ehe fɛo duɔ maji kɛ gbɔmɛi ni ekɛyeɔ amɛ nyɔŋ.

english_verse: But I, the Lord All-Powerful, am now your enemy. I will pull up your skirt and let nations and kingdoms stare at your nakedness.
translation_verse: Yehowa, Tatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ ji, “Naa, Nineve, mi kɛ bo ena! Mibawo ohiɛ mama nɔ, ni mahã maji ana oyayaiaŋ; amɛbaana ohiɛshishwiemɔ.

english_verse: I will cover you with garbage, treat you like trash, and rub you in the dirt.
translation_verse: Mibanyaŋe bo, ni matsi muji mashwie onɔ, ni mɛi aaakwɛ bo gãa.

english_verse: Everyone who sees you will turn away and shout, “Nineveh is done for! Is anyone willing to mourn or to give her comfort?” Nineveh's Fate Is Sealed
translation_verse: Mɛi fɛɛ ni baana bo baasu amɛhe kɛya sɛɛ. Amɛbaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nineve etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃! Namɔ yeɔ lɛ ŋkɔmɔ koo! Nɛgbɛ mana mɛi aaajɛ abashɛje emii?’ ”

english_verse: Nineveh, do you feel safer than the city of Thebes? The Nile River was its wall of defense.
translation_verse: Nineve, ani ohi fe Tebes, Nilo Faa lɛ toi maŋ lɛ ni nu efo ehe sa kɛbɔle lɛ kɛkpe, ni ŋshɔ ewaje lɛ kɛfo ehe, ni nu etsɔ̃ gbogbo ehã lɛ lɛ lo?

english_verse: Thebes trusted the mighty power of Ethiopia and Egypt; the nations of Put and Libya were her allies.
translation_verse: Tebes na hewalɛ kɛjɛ Kush kɛ Ijipt fɛɛ dɛŋ, nakai ehewalɛ lɛ anyɛɛɛ naa adamɔ. Putbii kɛ Libiabii fɛɛ ye bua lɛ.

english_verse: But she was captured and taken to a foreign country. Her children were murdered at every street corner. The members of her royal family were auctioned off, and her high officials were bound in chains.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ ana aŋɔ lɛ nom hu, ni akɛ emli bii abifabii tswiatswia shi, ni agbɛgbɛɛ amɛ ashwãshwãa gbɛjegbɛi lɛ atoii fɛɛ. Emli hiɛnaanɔmɛi lɛ, amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ fɔ̃ amɛnɔ oshiki kɛja amɛ hã amɛhe, ni awo amɛ gboklɛ, ni akpala amɛ kɛtee nomŋɔɔ mli.

english_verse: Nineveh, now it's your turn! You will get drunk and try to hide from your enemy.
translation_verse: Nineve, nakai bo hu obaatɔ dãa, ni ohiɛ baaha; ni obaatao abobaahe kɛjo ohenyɛlɔ lɛ naa foi.
