english_verse: Your fortresses are fig trees with ripe figs. Merely shake the trees, and fruit will fall into every open mouth.
translation_verse: Omɔji lɛ, naa, amɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ agbãmitsei ni amɛklɛŋklɛŋ yibii etsu yɛ amɛnɔ. Hosomɔ nɛkɛ ni aaahoso tsei lɛ, yibii lɛ baakpala ashwie yelɔ lɛ daaŋ.

english_verse: Your army is weak. Fire has destroyed the crossbars on your city gates; now they stand wide open to your enemy.
translation_verse: Naa, otabilɔi lɛ yei sɔŋŋ ji amɛ. Oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ anaa agboi lɛ anaa kãmɔ hã ohenyɛlɔi lɛ. La baashã ogboi nɛɛ asɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ.

english_verse: Your city is under attack. Haul in extra water! Strengthen your defenses! Start making bricks! Stir the mortar!
translation_verse: Nyɛyɛa numɔ nu nyɛtoa be ni abaasa nyɛmaŋ lɛ yi lɛ; nyɛwajeɔ nyɛmɔji lɛ; nyɛnaa su ni akɛfoɔ brikisi lɛ, ni asaa brikisifoo adeka lɛ ato.

english_verse: You will still go up in flames and be cut down by swords that will wipe you out like a field attacked by grasshoppers. So, go ahead and increase like a swarm of locusts!
translation_verse: Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ nyɛbaanyɔnyɔɔ, kɛjeee yɛ la mli lɛ no lɛ yɛ ta mli. Abaaplene nyɛ tamɔ baalabii kpãtãa ŋmɔshinii ahiɛ. Nyɛhãa nyɛyi afaa tamɔ baalabii, nyɛyi afaa tamɔ otukpɛi.

english_verse: More merchants are in your city than there are stars in the sky— but they are like locusts that eat everything, then fly away.
translation_verse: Nyɛhã nyɛteiaŋ jarayelɔi ayi efa fe ŋwɛi ŋulamii tete! Shi bɛ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ amɛnɔ egbɔ tamɔ baalabii ni bayeɔ nii ni amɛflikiɔ kɛyaa lɛ?

english_verse: Your guards and your officials are swarms of locusts. On a chilly day they settle on a fence, but when the sun comes out, they take off to who-knows-where.
translation_verse: Nyɛlumɛi lɛ tamɔ agãi, ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tamɔ baalabii ni basɔ̃mɔɔ afabaŋi ahe gbi nɔ ni fɛi miiye. Kɛji hulu lɛ te shi pɛ amɛfliki kɛtee, ni aleee he ni amɛyaa.

english_verse: King of Assyria, your officials and leaders are sound asleep, while your people are scattered in the mountains. Yes, your people are sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Ao! Asiria Maŋtsɛ, omraloi lɛ egboi; ni wɔ enyɔ ohiɛnaanɔbii lɛ anɔ. Agbɛ owebii lɛ ashwã gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni buaa amɛnaa.

english_verse: You're fatally wounded. There's no hope for you. But everyone claps when they hear this news, because your constant cruelty has caused them pain.
translation_verse: Pilamɔ ni opila lɛ bɛ tsabaa; ni ofaji lɛ ehiŋ tsamɔ. Mɛi fɛɛ ni nuɔ ohiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ he lɛ tswaa amɛdɛ̃ amɛshwieɔ onɔ kɛ nyamɔ; ejaakɛ namɔ po ni yɔɔ ni oyeko lɛ sane fɔŋ dã?

english_verse: I am Habakkuk the prophet. And this is the message that the Lord gave me. Habakkuk Complains to the Lord
translation_verse: Ninaa ni Yehowa jie etsɔ̃ɔ Gbalɔ Habakuk lɛ nɛ. Habakuk wie eshi toikɔdɔmɔ saneyeli

english_verse: Our Lord, how long must I beg for your help before you listen? How long before you save us from all this violence?
translation_verse: “Ao, Yehowa, mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ mabɔlɔ kɛyashi dani ooobo mi toi? Mɛɛ beyinɔ matsɛ bo kɛyashi dani ooobahere wɔ kɛje yiwalɛ mli?

english_verse: Why do you make me watch such terrible injustice? Why do you allow violence, lawlessness, crime, and cruelty to spread everywhere?
translation_verse: Mɛɛba ohãa minaa nifɔɔjianii nɛɛ, ni bo hu okwɛɔ haomɔi nɛɛ lɛ? Nifitemɔ kɛ henitswiamɔ sɔŋŋ ebɔle mihe kɛkpe, ni nɔmɔ kɛ bei ete shi yɛ he fɛɛ he.

english_verse: Laws cannot be enforced; justice is always the loser; criminals crowd out honest people and twist the laws around. The Lord Answers Habakkuk
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mla lɛ hewalɛ egbo, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ayeee jalɛ sane. Mɛi fɔ̃ji ebɔle jalɔ lɛ kɛkpe, ni no hewɔ lɛ, atsɔ̃ jalɛ sane hiɛ abu shi.” Hetoo ni Yehowa hã

english_verse: Look and be amazed at what's happening among the nations! Even if you were told, you would never believe what's taking place now.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ emɛi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa majimaji lɛ ateŋ, ni nyɛhe baajɔ̃ nyɛhe jogbaŋŋ yɛ nii ni nyɛbaana lɛ hewɔ. Ejaakɛ miitsu nitsumɔ ko yɛ amɛteŋ yɛ nyɛyinɔ nɛɛ, ni kɛji agba nyɛ lɛ nyɛheŋ nyɛyeŋ!

english_verse: I am sending the Babylonians. They are fierce and cruel— marching across the land, conquering cities and towns.
translation_verse: Naa, mitee Babilonbii lɛ ni yi wa, asaŋ ni amɛhe ejɔɔɔ lɛ ashi. Amɛfãa kɛkpaa je lɛ mli shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kɛyaŋɔɔ shikpɔji lɛ.

english_verse: How fearsome and frightening. Their only laws and rules are the ones they make up.
translation_verse: Amɛhe ŋmiŋmi kɛ gbeyei mɔmɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ, ni nɔ ni amɛ amɛsumɔɔ lɛ, no amɛfeɔ, ni no ji nɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ mla.

english_verse: Their cavalry troops are faster than leopards, more ferocious than wolves hunting at sunset, and swifter than hungry eagles suddenly swooping down.
translation_verse: “Amɛkpɔŋɔi ahe yɛ oya fe mlaŋtswi, ni amɛhiɛ yɛ kramakrama fe klãji ni je ena amɛ kɛ hɔmɔ. Amɛkpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ jɛɔ shɔŋŋ amɛbaa; amɛshaneɔ shi kɛ foi tamɔ okropɔŋ shaneɔ shi eshaa eniyenii.

english_verse: They are eager to destroy, and they gather captives like handfuls of sand.
translation_verse: “Amɛtai lɛ fãa kɛbaa kɛ yiwalɛ kɛbayeɔ shikpɔji anɔ; ni amɛhe ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔɔ mɛi kɛji amɛmiiba. Amɛnomii ni amɛbuaa naa lɛ ayifalɛ tamɔ shia.

english_verse: They make fun of rulers and laugh at fortresses, while building dirt mounds so they can capture cities.
translation_verse: Amɛyeɔ maŋtsɛmɛi ahe fɛo; ni lumɛi ahe feɔ amɛŋmɔlɔ. Mɔɔ ko mɔɔ ko shɔ̃mɔ waaa hãaa amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛtereɔ sũ amɛkɛbaa mɔɔ lɛ he kɛkɛ lɛ amɛshɔ̃.

english_verse: Then suddenly they disappear like a gust of wind— those sinful people who worship their own strength. Habakkuk Complains Again
translation_verse: Ni amɛfoɔ mli kɛhoɔ shwiaa kɛyaa tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ, amɛ ji amɛhe efɔŋfeelɔi, ni hewalɛ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ no ji nɔ ni amɛjaa.” Habakuk gbigbli emli etsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa ekoŋŋ

english_verse: Holy Lord God, mighty rock, you are eternal, and we are safe from death. You are using those Babylonians to judge and punish others.
translation_verse: “Yehowa, kɛjɛ naanɔ beebe lɛ bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ kɛ Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Koome! Ohaŋ wɔgboi! Ao, Yehowa, okɔ Babilonbii lɛ, ni bo ohã amɛma shi shiŋŋ kɛhã wɔtoigbalamɔ.

english_verse: But you can't stand sin or wrong. So don't sit by in silence while they gobble up people who are better than they are.
translation_verse: Shi te aaafe tɛŋŋ ni okwɛ ni efɔŋ aya nɔ hu? Ohiŋmɛi yɛ krɔŋŋ tsɔ̃ fe bɔ ni okɛaakwɛ koni nifɔɔjianii aya nɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, mɛɛba ni ofee dioo be mli ni efɔŋfeelɔi kpãtãa mɛi ni hi fe amɛ hiɛ?

english_verse: The people you put on this earth are like fish or reptiles without a leader.
translation_verse: “Ejaakɛ ohã gbɔmɛi etsɔ̃ tamɔ ŋshɔŋloo loo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ waamɔnii ni bɛ nɔyelɔ.

english_verse: Then an enemy comes along and takes them captive with hooks and nets. It makes him so happy
translation_verse: Babilonbii lɛ kɛ kpoŋ shaa gbɔmɛi oookɛɛ loi ji amɛ; amɛfɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɛi anɔ yaa, ni amɛgbalaa amɛ tamɔ adrã; ni amɛnyaa ni amɛmli filiɔ amɛ.

english_verse: that he offers sacrifices to his fishing nets, because they make him rich and provide choice foods.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, amɛshãa afɔle amɛkɛjaa amɛyaa lɛ, ni amɛshãa tsofakɛŋma amɛkɛhãa amɛtsãani lɛ, ejaakɛ nomɛi hãa amɛnaa nii kpɔtɔɔ amɛyeɔ.

english_verse: While standing guard on the watchtower, I waited for the Lord's answer, before explaining the reason for my complaint.
translation_verse: Mibakwɔ mayadamɔ shi kɛbu yɛ mɔɔ lɛ yiteŋ koni makwɛ nɔ ni Yehowa baakɛɛ mi, kɛ nɔ hetoo ni ebaahã mi yɛ mikɔmɔyeli lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: “I will give you my message in the form of a vision. Write it clearly enough to be read at a glance.
translation_verse: Yehowa hã mi hetoo nɛɛ, “Kpɛ ninaa nɛɛ faŋŋ yɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii anɔ koni anyɛ akane oya.

english_verse: At the time I have decided, my words will come true. You can trust what I say about the future. It may take a long time, but keep on waiting— it will happen!
translation_verse: Ninaa nɛɛ be lɛ shɛko moŋ, shi eeye ehe oyai kɛba. Kɛji eshashao shi tete po jiŋŋ, bo lɛ mɛɛ, ejaakɛ ebaaba kɛ̃ ni etsɛŋ.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, refuse to accept anyone who is proud. Only those who live by faith are acceptable to me.” Trouble for Evil People
translation_verse: Ni shɛɛ wiemɔ lɛ nɛ: ‘Naa, mɔ ni efeee jalɛnii lɛ, eyi naŋ wala; shi mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii lɛ ehemɔkɛyeli nɔ ebaatsɔ̃ ni eyi ana wala.’ ” Mɛi ni efeee jalɛnii ahiɛkpãtãmɔ

english_verse: Wine is treacherous, and arrogant people are never satisfied. They are no less greedy than death itself— they open their mouths as wide as the world of the dead and swallow everyone.
translation_verse: Naa, wain lakaa mɔ. Gbɔmɔ ni woɔ ehe lɛ, enyɛɛɛ shi ehi. Efeɔ fuu tamɔ gbohiiaje; ni etamɔ gbele, etɔko dã. Ebuaa majimaji fɛɛ anɔ bii anaa kɛbaa, ni etiãa amɛ ehãa ehe.

english_verse: But they will be mocked with these words: You're doomed! You stored up stolen goods and cheated others of what belonged to them.
translation_verse: Aso majimaji nɛɛ fɛɛ yeŋ lɛ yɔɔ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Kpoo hã mɔ ni haa nii ni ele faŋŋ akɛ jeee enɔ ni, kɛ mɔ ni loɔ awabatoonii eshwieɔ enɔ lɛ. Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ni?”

english_verse: But without warning, those you owe will demand payment. Then you will become a frightened victim.
translation_verse: Naa, trukaa ni onyɔjiatsɛmɛi lɛ aaate shi awo bo. Mɛi ni hiɛ etsɛ̃ lɛ aaaha onii.

english_verse: You robbed cities and nations everywhere on earth and murdered their people. Now those who survived will be as cruel to you.
translation_verse: Akɛ ni oha majimaji babaoo anii hewɔ lɛ, bo hu majimaji lɛ amli mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ baaha onii yɛ gbɔmɛi ala shi ni oshwie, kɛ yi ni owa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ kɛ amɛmli bii lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: You're doomed! You made your family rich at the expense of others. You even said to yourself, “I'm above the law.”
translation_verse: Kpoo hã mɔ ni etsɔ̃ gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ ena nii ehã ewe, ni ebɔ mɔdɛŋ eyama etsu yɛ he ko grɔŋŋ bɔ ni afee ni efee shweshweeshwe koni efɔŋ ko akasa ehe lɛ.

english_verse: But you will bring shame on your family and ruin to yourself for what you did to others.
translation_verse: Ogbɛjianɔtoo lɛ eyagbala hiɛgbele ebashwie owe lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ majimaji lɛ ni oplenee lɛ ehã bo diɛŋtsɛ owala hiɛ ekpãtã moŋ.

english_verse: The very stones and wood in your home will testify against you.
translation_verse: Gbogbo mli tɛ tete miibolɔ kɛmiishi nyɛ, ni tsu yiteŋ mplaŋ lɛ hu miihere tɛ lɛ blɔmɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: You're doomed! You built a city on crime and violence.
translation_verse: Kpoo hã mɔ ni kɛ lashishwiemɔ toɔ maŋ, ni ekɛ efɔŋfeemɔ tswaa maŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful sends up in flames what nations and people work so hard to gain.
translation_verse: Naa, aso jeee Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, dɛŋ sane nɛ, akɛ gbɔmɔ atsu nii, ni là abakpãtã hiɛ lo, ni majimaji lɛ agbo deŋme yaka lo?

english_verse: Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord.
translation_verse: Moŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ baayi tɔ kɛ Yehowa anunyam lɛ he nilee, tamɔ bɔ ni ŋshɔ eyi tɔ kɛ nu lɛ.

english_verse: You're doomed! You get your friends drunk, just to see them naked.
translation_verse: Kpoo hã bo mɔ ni ojɛɔ mlifu mli ohãa onaanyo dãa enuɔ, ni etɔɔ, bɔ ni afee ni okwɛ eyayaiaŋ.

english_verse: Now you will be disgraced instead of praised. The Lord will make you drunk, and when others see you naked, you will lose their respect.
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ bo hu, yɛ hiɛnyam najiaŋ lɛ, hiɛgbele baamɔ bo. Bo hu obaanu eko koni odidãã. Kpulu ni yɔɔ Yehowa ninejurɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ kɛbashɛ onɔ, ni ohiɛnyam lɛ baatsɔ̃ hiɛgbele ni naa wa.

english_verse: You destroyed trees and animals on Mount Lebanon; you were ruthless to towns and people everywhere. Now you will be terrorized. Idolatry Is Foolish
translation_verse: Awui ni nyɛye Lebanon lɛ baasu nyɛtsui fe nine; emli kooloi lɛ hiɛ ni nyɛkpãtã lɛ baahã nyɛshe gbeyei, ejaakɛ nyɛshwie gbɔmɛi alá shi, ni nyɛwa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ kɛ amɛmli bii lɛ fɛɛ ayi.

english_verse: What is an idol worth? It's merely a false god. Why trust a speechless image made from wood or metal by human hands?
translation_verse: Mɛni ji amãgã he sɛɛnamɔ? Ŋaalɔ ninenaa nitsumɔ kɛkɛ ni; ni egbaaa mɔ ko nɔ ko fe amale. Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mɔ ni fee amãgã lɛ kɛ ehiɛ afɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eninenaa nitsumɔnii, ni ji amãgã mumui nɔ?

english_verse: What can you learn from idols covered with silver or gold? They can't even breathe. Pity anyone who says to an idol of wood or stone, “Get up and do something!”
translation_verse: Kpoo hã bo mɔ ni okɛɔ tso akɛ, “Ohiɛ atsɛ̃!” Ni okɛɔ tɛ mumui hu akɛ, “Tee shi!” Ani amãgã baanyɛ ejie ninaa atsɔ̃ɔ bo? Naa, akɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi baaha ehe nɛ, shi moŋ wala kome nɛkɛ bɛ emli.

english_verse: Let all the world be silent— the Lord is present in his holy temple.
translation_verse: Naa, Yehowa yɛ eSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ afee diŋŋ yɛ ehiɛ.

english_verse: This is my prayer:
translation_verse: Sɔlemɔ ni Gbalɔ Habakuk sɔle nɛ,

english_verse: I know your reputation, Lord, and I am amazed at what you have done. Please turn from your anger and be merciful; do for us what you did for our ancestors.
translation_verse: “Ao Yehowa, minu nii ni otsu lɛ he, ni miishe gbeyei. Yehowa, tsu onitsumɔi wuji lɛ ekoŋŋ yɛ wɔyinɔ nɛɛ hu nɔ. Hã ale yɛ afii nɛɛ amli nɔŋŋ. Omlifu mli tete lɛ, hã omusuŋ atsɔ̃ bo!

english_verse: You are the same Holy God who came from Teman and Paran to help us. The brightness of your glory covered the heavens, and your praises were heard everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Naa Nyɔŋmɔ jɛ Edom kɛmiiba; Nyɔŋmɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ miiba kɛjɛ Paran Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Enunyam lɛ ha ŋwɛi, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ eyijiemɔ.

english_verse: Your glory shone like the sun, and light flashed from your hands, hiding your mighty power.
translation_verse: Ekpɛmɔ lɛ tamɔ la; la kpɛlɛɔ kɛjɛɔ edɛŋ he ni ji ehewalɛ teemɔhe lɛ.

english_verse: Dreadful diseases and plagues marched in front and followed behind.
translation_verse: Tsɛŋemɔ hela nyiɛɔ ehiɛ, ni gbele hela nyiɛ esɛɛ tuuŋtu.

english_verse: When you stopped, the earth shook; when you stared, nations trembled; when you walked along your ancient paths, eternal mountains and hills crumbled and collapsed.
translation_verse: Ewa edamɔ shi, ni shikpɔŋ hoso, Ekwɛ, ni maji lɛ ahe kpokpo. Naanɔ gɔji lɛ gbɛ shwã ni naanɔ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ ba shi, yɛ hei ni enyiɛ blema ko lɛ.

english_verse: The tents of desert tribes in Cushan and Midian were ripped apart.
translation_verse: Mina, Kushanbii miishe gbeyei, ni Midianbii ahe miikpokpo.

english_verse: Our Lord, were you angry with the monsters of the deep? You attacked in your chariot and wiped them out.
translation_verse: Yehowa, ani fai omli wo la wo? Fai ni omli fu, loo ŋshɔ ni ogri owo? No hewɔ ota kunimyeli okpɔŋɔ kɛ tayaa shwiili mli kɛbaa nɛɛ?

english_verse: Your arrows were ready and obeyed your commands. You split the earth apart with rivers and streams;
translation_verse: Ojie ogãi lɛ hebo lɛ, ni ofee kralo kɛbaatsɛ̃. Okɛ fai egbala shikpɔŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: mountains trembled at the sight of you; rain poured from the clouds; ocean waves roared and rose.
translation_verse: Gɔji lɛ na bo, ni amɛhosohosoo; nu tue kɛbaho yoo. Bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ wo egbee; ehole eniji anɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi.

english_verse: The sun and moon stood still, while your arrows and spears flashed like lightning.
translation_verse: La ni ogãimlibii lɛ kpɛlɛ kɛ okpɔlɔi lɛ hu akpɛlɛmɔ hã hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere wa damɔ shi.

english_verse: to rescue your people and save your chosen one. You crushed a nation's ruler and stripped his evil kingdom of its power.
translation_verse: Otee oyahere omɛi lɛ ayiwala, koni oyahere mɔ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ yiwala. Ojwara mɔ fɔŋ lɛ weku lɛ yitso, ni oŋmɛ lɛ yayai kɛjɛ eshuɔ kɛyata ekuɛ.

english_verse: His troops had come like a storm, hoping to scatter us and glad to gobble us up. To them we were refugees in hiding— but you smashed their heads with their own weapons.
translation_verse: Okɛ okpɔlɔ lɛ gbulɔ etabilɔi ni ba tamɔ lasuogbele koni amɛbagbɛ mi amɛshwã kɛ mliflimɔ, tamɔ nɔ ni amɛba ohiafo piŋmɔ yɛ teemɔ mli lɛ.

english_verse: Then your chariots churned the waters of the sea. Habakkuk's Response to God's Message
translation_verse: Okɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ naanaa ŋshɔ ni ji nu kpeteŋkple ni kumɔɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: When I heard this message, I felt weak from fear, and my lips quivered. My bones seemed to melt, and I stumbled around. But I will patiently wait. Someday those vicious enemies will be struck by disaster. Trust in a Time of Trouble
translation_verse: Minu enɛɛmɛi, ni mihe kpokpo; gbɛɛmɔ lɛ hã minaabu jo bliblibli. Mikpɔiaŋ fee gbedee, ni minaji tɔ̃tɔ̃ yɛ shikpɔŋ. Mibata shi kpoo mamɛ gbi ni abaahao mɛi ni baa koni amɛkɛ maŋ lɛ abawu lɛ.

english_verse: Fig trees may no longer bloom, or vineyards produce grapes; olive trees may be fruitless, and harvest time a failure; sheep pens may be empty, and cattle stalls vacant—
translation_verse: Eyɛ mli akɛ agbãmi tso gbaŋ afofro, ni yibii ehiŋ wain tsei anɔ; eyɛ mli akɛ mu tsei ayibii baafee yaka, ni anaŋ ŋmɔshi niyenii; eyɛ mli akɛ toi fɛɛ aaagboi, ni tsinai aaatã yɛ tsina tsui amli nɛ.

english_verse: but I will still celebrate because the Lord God is my Savior.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ mi lɛ mibanya, ni mimli aaafli mi yɛ Yehowa miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: The Lord gives me strength. He makes my feet as sure as those of a deer, and he helps me stand on the mountains. To the music director: Use stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ woɔ mi hewalɛ; ehãa minaji feɔ tamɔ ofrote naji kɛnyiɛɔ shweshweeshwe yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: I am Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the grandson of Gedaliah, the great-grandson of Amariah, and the great-great-grandson of Hezekiah. When Josiah son of Amon was king of Judah, the Lord gave me this message. Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: Wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Zefania wie be mli ni Amon bi Yosia yeɔ Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ nɛ. Zefania Kush bi lɛ, enii ji Gedalia, Maŋtsɛ Hezekia bi Amaria bi lɛ. Yehowa Kojomɔ gbi lɛ

english_verse: I, the Lord, now promise to destroy everything on this earth—
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, Mibakpãtã nibii fɛɛ ahiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: people and animals, birds and fish. Everyone who is evil will crash to the ground, and I will wipe out the entire human race.
translation_verse: “Mibakpãtã gbɔmɔ kɛ kooloo hiɛ; mibakpãtã loofɔji kɛ ŋshɔŋ loi fɛɛ ahiɛ, mibakpãtã yiwalɔi ahiɛ; mibaplene gbɔmɛi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.

english_verse: I will reach out to punish Judah and Jerusalem— nothing will remain of the god Baal; nothing will be remembered of his pagan priests.
translation_verse: “Mibagbala gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm kɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ atoi. Mibafã Baal jamɔ shishi fɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ, ni akaiŋ wulɔmɛi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ jemawɔji lɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Not a trace will be found of those who worship stars from their rooftops, or bow down to the god Milcom, while claiming loyalty to me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Mibakpãtã mɛi fɛɛ ni kwɔɔ kɛyaa tsui ayiteiaŋ amɛyajaa hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii yɛ jɛi lɛ ahiɛ. Mibakpãtã mɛi hu ni kotoɔ Yehowa lɛ, ni amɛkãa lɛ kitã akɛ amɛbaaye lɛ anɔkwa, shi amɛkɛ jemawɔŋ Molek gbɛi lɛ kãa kitã ahiɛ.

english_verse: Be silent! I am the Lord God, and the time is near. I am preparing to sacrifice my people and to invite my guests.
translation_verse: Naa, Yehowa gbi lɛ eshɛ etã, no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛfea diŋŋ yɛ ehiɛ. Yehowa esaa afɔle lɛ eto, ni etsuu emɛi ni ekpee lɛ ahe.

english_verse: On that day I will punish national leaders and sons of the king, along with all who follow foreign customs.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Gbi ni mibaplene mɛi lɛ, mibagbala maŋ lumɛi lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ bihii lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni feɔ maŋsɛɛbii akusum lɛ atoi.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise that on that day noisy crying will be heard from Fish Gate, New Town, and Upper Hills.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, abaanu yaafo he kɛbaajɛ Loo Agbo lɛ naa yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni abaawo lele yɛ maŋ lɛ akutso hee lɛ mli, ni gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ ayiteiaŋ baashimɔ.

english_verse: Everyone in Lower Hollow will mourn loudly, because merchants and money changers will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Nyɛ, maŋ lɛ Jɔɔnaabii, nyɛwoa yara nyɛfoa kɛji nyɛnu gbɛɛmɔi nɛɛ; ejaakɛ akpãtã jarayelɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ, ni aplene mɛi ni yeɔ jwiɛtɛi jara lɛ.

english_verse: I'll search Jerusalem with lamps and punish those people who sit there unworried while thinking, “The Lord won't do anything, good or bad.”
translation_verse: “Nakai be lɛ mikɛ kane baakpa Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli, ni mibagbala emli mɛi ni amɛtsui enyɔ amɛmli, ni amɛheɔ amɛhe amɛyeɔ lɛ atoi. No ji mɛi ni kɛɔ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Yehowa efeŋ ekpakpa, ni esaa efeŋ efɔŋ hu lɛ’.

english_verse: Their possessions will be taken, their homes left in ruins. They won't get to live in the houses they build, or drink wine from the grapes in their own vineyards. A Terrible Day
translation_verse: Abaaha amɛjarayeli nibii, ni amɛshĩai hu baatsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃. Amɛaamamɔ tsui nɛ, shi amɛwɔŋ mli, ni amɛaafee waintromi, shi amɛnuŋ amɛmli wain lɛ eko.”

english_verse: The great day of the Lord is coming soon, very soon. On that terrible day, fearsome shouts of warriors will be heard everywhere.
translation_verse: Yehowa gbi wulu lɛ ebɛŋkɛ etã, eeba nɔŋŋ. Gbi lɛ baajoo naakpa, ejaakɛ nakai gbi lɛ, kãkãlɔi tete baafo waa.

english_verse: It will be a time of anger— of trouble and torment, of disaster and destruction, of darkness and despair, of storm clouds and shadows,
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ, mlifu kɛ amanehulu gbi ni, nifitemɔ kɛ nihiɛkpãtãmɔ gbi ni; duŋ baawo, ni jeŋ baafee kpii; atatu kɛ oblɔtu kabitii hu gbi ni.

english_verse: of trumpet calls and battle cries against fortified cities and mighty fortresses.
translation_verse: Gbi lɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ baagbɛɛ, ni abaabɔ oshe kɛtua maji ni atswatswaa gbogboi awo amɛhe lɛ kɛ mɔji ni kwɔlɔ lɛ hu.

english_verse: The Lord warns everyone who has sinned against him, “I'll strike you blind! Then your blood and your insides will gush out like vomit.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mibahao gbɔmɛi, ni amɛbaanyiɛ tamɔ shwilafoi. Akɛni amɛgbo Yehowa nɔ toi lɛ, aaashwie amɛlá shi tamɔ nu, ni amɛgbohii lɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ wamɔ.”

english_verse: Not even your silver or gold can save you on that day when I, the Lord, am angry. My anger will flare up like a furious fire scorching the earth and everyone on it.”
translation_verse: Nakai Yehowa mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi ajwiɛtɛi kɛ shika fɛɛ nyɛŋ amɛyiwala ahere. Emlifu ni jɛ awuŋayeli mli lɛ naa la lɛ naawalɛ baakpãtã je lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ; ejaakɛ trukaa ni eeeplene shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ.

english_verse: before it's too late. The Lord has set a time when his fierce anger will strike like a storm and sweep you away.
translation_verse: dani aba mli akɛ aaakpala nyɛ kɛya tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ tswaa tutuu, dani Yehowa mlifu ni naa wa lɛ aba nyɛnɔ, dani ashɛ Yehowa mlifu gbi lɛ!

english_verse: If you humbly obey the Lord, then come and worship him. If you do right and are humble, perhaps you will be safe on that day when the Lord turns loose his anger. Judgment on Philistia
translation_verse: Nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ heshibalɔi fɛɛ ni feɔ Yehowa suɔmɔnaa nii, nyɛtaoa Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ; nyɛtaoa jalɛ sɛɛgbɛ; ni nyɛtaoa heshibaa sɛɛgbɛ, ni eko lɛ aaaŋɔ nyɛ atee yɛ Yehowa mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ. Israel hewɔ maji lɛ ahiɛkpãtãmɔ

english_verse: Gaza and Ashkelon will be deserted and left in ruins. Ashdod will be emptied in broad daylight, and Ekron uprooted.
translation_verse: Abaashi Gaza maŋ lɛ afɔ̃ shi, ni Ashkelon baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃. Abaashwie Ashdod maŋbii lɛ shwane fintiŋŋ, ni abaafã Ekronbii lɛ hu kɛ amɛshishi fɛɛ.

english_verse: To you people of Philistia who live along the coast, the Lord has this to say: “I am now your enemy, and I'll wipe you out!”
translation_verse: Kpoo ha nyɛ, nyɛŋshɔnaabii, bo Keretibii amaŋ. Kanaan, Filistibii ashikpɔŋ, Yehowa ebu bo fɔ; ni mibakpãtã ohiɛ, bɔ ni eshwɛŋ omɔ ko mɔ ko dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Your seacoast will be changed into pastureland and sheep pens.
translation_verse: Ni bo, ŋshɔnaa niiaŋ, obaatsɔ shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ kooloi alɛɛhei kɛ tookwɛlɔi asesei kɛ toi atsui kɛkɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God hasn't forgotten those survivors in Judah, and he will help them— his people will take your land to use for pasture. And when evening comes, they will rest in houses at Ashkelon. Judgment on Moab and Ammon *
translation_verse: Ŋshɔnaa shikpɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ Yudabii ni eshwɛ lɛ anɔ. Jɛi amɛbaalɛ amɛkooloi yɛ, ni Ashkelon maŋ lɛ shĩai lɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ kooloi lɛ awɔɔhei; ejaakɛ Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, musuŋ baatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amɛhe, ni ebaahã amɛshwere ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, said: I've heard Moab and Ammon insult my people and threaten their nation.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Minu jɛmɔi ni Moabbii jɛɔ mimaŋbii lɛ, kɛ ahora ni Amonbii hu bɔɔ miwebii lɛ, kɛ shwãa ni amɛshwãa akɛ amɛbaashɔ̃ mimaŋbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ.

english_verse: And so, I swear by my very life that Moab and Ammon will end up like Sodom and Gomorrah— covered with thornbushes and salt pits forever. Then my people who survive will take their land.
translation_verse: Beiaŋ ni mi tuuŋtu ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ akɛ ja Moab tsɔ̃ tamɔ Sodom, ni Amonbii lɛ hu tsɔ̃ tamɔ Gomora. Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ ŋoo bui ashikpɔŋ kɛ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛya naanɔ; ni sansrɔ baatsa yɛ enɔ. Mimaŋbii ni aaashwɛ lɛ aaaha Moabbii lɛ kɛ Amonbii lɛ hu anii, ni amɛaaŋɔ amɛshikpɔji lɛ.”

english_verse: This is how Moab and Ammon will at last be repaid for their pride— and for sneering at the nation that belongs to me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Enɛ akɛaagbala Moabbii lɛ kɛ Amonbii lɛ atoi yɛ amɛhenɔ ni amɛwo lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ amɛbɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, webii lɛ ahora.

english_verse: I will fiercely attack. Then every god on this earth will shrink to nothing, and everyone of every nation will bow down to me, right where they are. Judgment on Ethiopia
translation_verse: Amɛbaashe Yehowa gbeyei naakpa. Yehowa baashwie shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jemawɔji fɛɛ ahiɛ shi; ni kɛkɛ lɛ maji fɛɛ baaja Yehowa yɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ diɛŋtsɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ.

english_verse: People of Ethiopia, the sword of the Lord will slaughter you! Judgment on Assyria
translation_verse: Ni nyɛ, Etiopiabii, Yehowa baaplene nyɛ hu.

english_verse: The Lord will reach to the north to crush Assyria and overthrow Nineveh.
translation_verse: Yehowa baakpã enine mli kɛshɛ kooyigbɛ kɛkpãtã Asiria hiɛ; ni ebaahã Nineve maŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni enɔ baagbi wesewese tamɔ shiaŋa nɔ.

english_verse: Herds of wild animals will live in its rubble; all kinds of desert owls will perch on its stones and hoot in the windows. Noisy ravens will be heard inside its buildings, stripped bare of cedar.
translation_verse: Jɛi baatsɔ̃ kooloi kui kɛ kooloi srɔtoi fɛɛ ashibuumɔhe. Akpaŋai kɛ shadeboai kɛ tsui koi lɛ amli baafee amɛshihilɛhei. Patui baabolɔ yɛ samfɛji lɛ anaa, ni kwãakwãalabitei baabolɔ yɛ shinaa kpokui lɛ anaa, ejaakɛ shĩai lɛ fɛɛ ewulewulee ewowoo mli.

english_verse: This is the glorious city that felt secure and said, “I am the only one!” Now it's merely ruins, a home for wild animals. Every passerby simply sneers and makes vulgar signs.
translation_verse: Naa, maŋ lɛ ni emli fili lɛ, ni esusu akɛ eyɛ shweshweeshwe, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ ehe akɛ, “Mi ji mi, ni mi misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ lɛ, te tɛŋŋ ni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛ kooloi kakawuai ashihilɛhe nɛɛ? Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsɔ̃ ehe kɛho lɛ aaahoso eyitso, ni ehe aaajɔ̃ ehe.”

english_verse: Too bad for that disgusting, corrupt, and lawless city!
translation_verse: Kpoo ha Yerusalɛm, maŋ ni yi wa, maŋ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebule ehe!

english_verse: Forever rebellious and rejecting correction, Jerusalem refuses to trust or obey the Lord God.
translation_verse: Ebooo mɔ ko mɔ ko wiemɔ toi lɛ, ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ tsɔsemɔ hu; ekɛ ehiɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ Yehowa nɔ lɛ, etsiii ebɛŋkɛɛɛ eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Its officials are roaring lions, its judges are wolves; in the evening they attack, by morning nothing is left.
translation_verse: Emli lumɛi lɛ jatai ni huuɔ ni, emli kojolɔi lɛ hu klãji hɔmɔwɔlɔi ni shiii niyenii ko niyenii ko ni je atsɛre nɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem's prophets are proud and not to be trusted. The priests have disgraced the place of worship and abused God's Law.
translation_verse: Emli gbalɔi lɛ yiŋflɛflɛtsɛmɛi kɛ kutumpɔfoi sɔŋŋ ni; ni emli osɔfoi lɛ ebule nii ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni amɛtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mla lɛ hiɛ amɛbu shi.

english_verse: All who do evil are shameless, but the Lord does right and is always fair. With the dawn of each day, God brings about justice.
translation_verse: Yehowa mɔ ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, nɔ ni ja pɛ efeɔ; efeee nɔ ko ni ejaaa. Daa leebi lɛ efeɔ nɔ ni ja yɛ maŋ lɛ hiɛ, leebi ko kwraa bɛ ni efɔ̃ɔ jalɛ nii feemɔ. Shi nɔshafeelɔi lɛ ahiɛgble tɔ ejwa.

english_verse: The Lord wiped out nations and left fortresses crumbling in the dirt. Their streets and towns were reduced to ruins and emptied of people.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mikpãtã maji ahiɛ dã. Mikumɔ amɛtabilɔi atasui lɛ mishwie shi; ni amɛblohui amli kamɔ shi efoji, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko hooo yɛ mli; afite amɛmaji lɛ bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ mli, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ amɛmli dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: God felt certain that Jerusalem would learn to respect and obey him. Then he would hold back from punishing the city and not wipe it out. But everyone there was eager to start sinning again. Nations Will Turn to the Lord
translation_verse: Mikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Anɔkwa, eeeshe mi gbeyei, ni eeekpɛlɛ̃ mitsɔsemɔ lɛ, ni ekuŋ ehiɛ efɔŋ mimlai ni miwo lɛ lɛ eko eko nɔ.’ Shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ babaoo moŋ ni amɛfee nibii gbohiigbohii ji no.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Just wait for the day when I accuse you nations. I have decided on a day, when I will bring together every nation and kingdom and punish them all in my fiery anger. I will become furious and destroy the earth.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa mi gbɛ kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni mate shi maye odase mashi jeŋ maji lɛ; ejaakɛ mito miyiŋ akɛ mabua majimaji lɛ anaa, ni mabua maŋtsɛmɛi hu anaa kɛkpe, koni amɛsa mimlifu kɛ mimlila ni naa wa lɛ naa amɛkwɛ, ejaakɛ mikɛ miwuŋayeli lɛ mli mlifu la lɛ baakpãtã jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: I will purify each language and make those languages acceptable for praising me. Then, with hearts united, everyone will serve only me, the Lord.
translation_verse: “Nakai be lɛ mibatsake majimaji lɛ adaaŋ wiemɔ koni amɛwiemɔ he atse; ni amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛbaaja mi, Yehowa, kɛ wiemɔ ni he tse.

english_verse: From across the rivers of Ethiopia, my scattered people, my true worshipers, will bring offerings to me.
translation_verse: Mijalɔi ni ji mimɛi ni agbɛ ashwã lɛ ashwiei baajɛ Kush fai lɛ asɛɛ niiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ amɛkɛ afɔlei abahã mi.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't rebel against me and be put to shame. I'll do away with those who are proud and arrogant. Never will any of them strut around on my holy mountain.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛhiɛ gboŋ dɔŋŋ yɛ nibii ni nyɛfeefee nyɛkɛtse mihiɛ atua lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ majie ntɛŋfeelɔi ni woɔ amɛhe nɔ fɛɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ, ni nyɛwoŋ nyɛhe nɔ dɔŋŋ yɛ migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ,

english_verse: But I, the Lord, won't destroy any of your people who are truly humble and turn to me for safety.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ mibashi gbɔmɛi omlɛfoi kɛ humii pɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ. Amɛbaatao abobaahe yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli,

english_verse: The people of Israel who survive will live right and refuse to tell lies. They will eat and rest with nothing to fear. A Song of Celebration

translation_verse: Mi, Yehowa, matsɔ̃ la kɛbɔle maŋ lɛ he kɛkpe, tamɔ gbogbo, ni matsɔ̃ emli anunyam. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Atsɛ Nomii lɛ akɛ amɛba shĩa

english_verse: The Lord says to his people, “Run! Escape from the land in the north, where I scattered you to the four winds.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ, “Huui! Nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ kɛjɛa kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛbaa Yerusalɛm; ejaakɛ mi, migbɛ nyɛ mishwã tamɔ ŋwɛi kɔɔyɔi ejwɛ lɛ.” Yehowa kɛɛ,

english_verse: Leave Babylonia and hurry back to Zion.”
translation_verse: “Huui! Kuu osɛɛ oba Zion, bo mɔ ni okɛ Babilon biyoo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: Then the glorious Lord All-Powerful ordered me to say to the nations that had raided and robbed Zion: Zion is as precious to the Lord as are his eyes. Whatever you do to Zion, you do to him.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Enunyam lɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsu mi kɛtee maji ni hahaa nyɛnii lɛ aŋɔɔ; ejaakɛ kɛji mɔ ko ta nyɛhe lɛ eta mi diɛŋtsɛ mihiŋmɛiŋ ajaŋmalaatɛ he.

english_verse: And so, he will put you in the power of your slaves, and they will raid and rob you. Then you will know that I am a prophet of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Naa, mawo minine nɔ yɛ amɛnɔ, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ haanii amɛhã amɛtsuji ni sɔ̃mɔ amɛ lɛ. No nyɛkɛaale akɛ Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ ni tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ.”

english_verse: City of Zion, sing and celebrate! The Lord has promised to come and live with you.
translation_verse: “Nyɛlaa, ni nyɛmii ashɛa, nyɛ Yerusalɛmbii, shi naa, miba mibahi nyɛteŋ.”

english_verse: When he does, many nations will turn to him and become his people. At that time you will know that I am a prophet of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, maji babaoo kɛ amɛhe aaahã Yehowa ni amɛaatsɔ̃ mimɛi, ni mahi amɛteŋ. No nyɛkɛaale akɛ Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ ni tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Then Judah will be his part of the holy land, and Jerusalem will again be his chosen city.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ hu Yehowa aaaŋɔ Yuda akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ; asaŋ eeeŋɔ Yerusalɛm hu akɛ emaŋ ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: Everyone, be silent! The Lord is present and moving about in his holy place.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɛi fɛɛ afee dioo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ejaakɛ ete shi kɛjɛ eshihilɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I was given another vision. This time Joshua the high priest was standing in front of the Lord's angel. And there was Satan, standing at Joshua's right side, ready to accuse him.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ ehã mina Yoshua ni ji osɔfonukpa lɛ ni edamɔ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ hiɛ, ni satan hu damɔ Yoshua ninejurɔ ni ebaafolɔ enaa.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Satan, you are wrong. Jerusalem is my chosen city, and this man was rescued like a stick from a flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Satan akɛ, “Satan, Yehowa akã ohiɛ. Yehowa mɔ ni eŋɔ Yerusalɛm akɛ enɔ lɛ aaakã ohiɛ. Ani oleee akɛ latso ni afã yɛ la naa ji mɔ nɛ?”

english_verse: So the angel told some of the people to remove Joshua's filthy clothes. Then he said to Joshua, “This means you are forgiven. Now I will dress you in priestly clothes.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni bɔfo lɛ fã mɛi ni damɔ ehiɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛjiea atadei mujimuji lɛ yɛ ehe.” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Yoshua hu akɛ, “Bɔ ni ajie ohe atadei nɛɛ lɛ, nakai ajie ohe eshai lɛ ashwie, ni mawula bo kɛ atadei ni jara wa.”

english_verse: I spoke up and said, “Also put a clean priestly turban on his head.” Then they dressed him in priestly clothes and put the turban on him, while the Lord's angel stood there watching.
translation_verse: Ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Akɛ fai ni he tse abu lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ fai ni he tse bu lɛ, ni amɛwula lɛ kɛ atadei. Ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ damɔ shi yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: If you truly obey me, I will put you in charge of my temple, including the courtyard around it, and you will be allowed to speak at any time with the angels standing beside me.
translation_verse: “Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Kɛji oooba ojeŋ bɔ ni mitaoɔ, ni oooye mimlai ni miwo lɛ anɔ lɛ, no lɛ bo obaakwɛ misɔlemɔ we lɛ kɛ ehe kpoi lɛ anɔ. Asaŋ mahã bo hegbɛ ni ofata mimɛi ni damɔɔ biɛ lɛ ahe.

english_verse: Listen carefully, High Priest Joshua and all of you other priests. You are a sign of things to come, because I am going to bring my servant, the Chosen King.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ, bo osɔfonukpa Yoshua, bo toi, bo kɛ onanemɛi osɔfoi krokomɛi ni yɔɔ oshishi lɛ fɛɛ. Mɛi nɛɛ ji shade ni baaba lɛ he okadi lɛ. Naa, mibawo mitsulɔ, ni atsɛɔ lɛ Tsonine, gbɛ kɛba.

english_verse: Joshua, I have placed in front of you a stone with seven sides. I will engrave something on that stone, and in a single day I will forgive this guilty country.
translation_verse: Asaŋ mikɛ tɛ koome ni yɛ hiɛi kpawo ema Yoshua hiɛ, ni makpɛ niŋmaa yɛ nakai tɛ lɛ nɔ, Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ. Ni mikɛ gbi kome baagbe shikpɔŋ lɛ tɔ̃mɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Then each of you will live at peace and entertain your friends in your own vineyard and under your own fig trees.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaakpee enaanyo kɛaaba ewaintso kɛ agbãmitso shishi, Yehowa kɛɛ.’ ”

english_verse: The angel who explained the visions woke me from what seemed like sleep.
translation_verse: Bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ batsiɛ mi ekoŋŋ tamɔ atsiɛɔ mɔ yɛ ewɔ mli.

english_verse: Then he asked, “What do you see?” “A solid gold lampstand with an oil container above it,” I answered. “On the stand are seven lamps, each with seven flames.
translation_verse: Ni ebi mi akɛ, “Mɛni onaa nɛɛ?” Mihã hetoo akɛ, “Miina kanetso ni akɛ shika sɔŋŋ fee; ni emutɔ ko ma eyiteŋ. Kanetso nɛɛ yɛ kanei kpawo mamɔ eyiteŋ; ni kanei nɛɛ, eko fɛɛ eko hu yɛ odontii kpawo ni asuɔ.

english_verse: One olive tree is on the right side and another on the left of the oil container.
translation_verse: Asaŋ mutsei enyɔ mamɔ kanetso lɛ masɛi; ekome yɛ mutɔ lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ, ni ekome hu yɛ ebɛku nɔ.”

english_verse: So the angel explained that it was the following message of the Lord to Zerubbabel: I am the Lord All-Powerful. So don't depend on your own power or strength, but on my Spirit.
translation_verse: Bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Shɛɛ ni Yehowa kɛhãa Zerubabel nɛ, ‘Jeee onyɛmɔ baahã oye kunim, loo ohewalɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ mimumɔ lɛ ni baahã oye kunim,’ Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.”

english_verse: Zerubbabel, that mountain in front of you will be leveled to the ground. Then you will bring out the temple's most important stone and shout, “God has been very kind.”
translation_verse: Shi bo gɔŋ kpeteŋkple, mɛni mli oyɔɔ? Obaatsɔ ŋa kplanaa yɛ Zerubabel hiɛ. Ebaakɔ oyiteŋ tɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛba, ni aaabɔ oshe kɛaaba akɛ, “Dromɔ, dromɔ naa sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me again and said:
translation_verse: Yehowa saa ekɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ,

english_verse: Zerubbabel laid the foundation for the temple, and he will complete it. Then everyone will know that you were sent by me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: “Zerubabel eto shĩa nɛɛ shishi, ni ebaatswa egbe naa hu. No nyɛkɛaale akɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ni tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Those who have made fun of this day of small beginnings will celebrate when they see Zerubbabel holding this important stone. Those seven lamps represent my eyes—the eyes of the Lord—and they see everything on this earth.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni gbe nitsumɔ lɛ ni eyaaa nɔ lɛ he guɔ lɛ baana Zerubabel ni ehiɛ tsumalɔi akulomulo lɛ yɛ edɛŋ ekɛ miitswa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni amɛbaanya. Kanetsei kpawo nɛɛ ji Yehowa hiŋmɛii ni ekɛkwɛɔ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: Then I asked the angel, “What about the olive trees on each side of the lampstand? What do they represent?
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ mibi bɔfo lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni ji mutsei enyɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ kanetso lɛ ninejurɔ kɛ abɛku lɛ?

english_verse: And what is the meaning of the two branches from which golden olive oil flows through the two gold pipes?”
translation_verse: Misaa mibi lɛ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ akɛ, te mutsei enyɔ ni yɔɔ shika bɛji enyɔ lɛ ni mu hoɔ yɛ mli lɛ ashishi hu?”

english_verse: “Don't you know?” he asked. “No sir, I don't,” was my answer.
translation_verse: Bɔfo lɛ bi mi akɛ, “Ani oleee enɛɛmɛi ashishi?” Mihã hetoo akɛ, “MiNuŋtsɔ Dabida.”

english_verse: Then he told me, “These branches are the two chosen leaders who stand beside the Lord of all the earth.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Nibii nɛɛ damɔ shi hã mɛi enyɔ ni ahala amɛ, ni afɔ amɛ mu koni amɛsɔmɔ Yehowa mɔ ni ji jeŋ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: When I looked the next time, I saw a flying scroll,
translation_verse: Miwo mihiɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ ni mina wolo kpo ko ni miifiliki.

english_verse: and the angel asked, “What do you see?” “A flying scroll,” I answered. “About nine meters long and four and a half meters wide.”
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo lɛ bi mi akɛ, “Mɛni onaa nɛɛ?” Mihã lɛ hetoo mikɛɛ akɛ, “Miina wolo kpo ko ni miifiliki; ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋma.”

english_verse: Then he told me: This scroll puts a curse on everyone in the land who steals or tells lies. The writing on one side tells about the destruction of those who steal, while the writing on the other side tells about the destruction of those who lie.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Enɛ ji loomɔ ni gbɛɔ eshwãa shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ. No ji akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni juɔ lɛ aaakpãtã ehiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakã kitã ni eyeŋ nɔ lɛ aaana nakai toigbalamɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has said, “I am sending this scroll into the house of everyone who is a robber or tells lies in my name, and it will remain there until every piece of wood and stone in that house crumbles.” Seventh Vision: A Woman in a Basket
translation_verse: Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Miihã loomɔ nɛɛ asa julɔ fɛɛ julɔ we he, kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsɛɔ migbɛi ekɛkãa kitã ni eyeee nɔ lɛ hu we he. Loomɔ nɛɛ aaahi mɔ lɛ we lɛ nɔ kɛyaashi eeekpatã shĩa lɛ kɛ emli tsei kɛ tɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ.” Yoo ni yɔɔ kɛntɛŋ lɛ mli lɛ he ninaa

english_verse: Now the angel who was there to explain the visions came over and said, “Look up and tell me what you see coming.”
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ ba ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Wo ohiɛ nɔ ni okwɛ nɔ ni baa lɛ.”

english_verse: “I don't know what it is,” was my reply. “It's a big basket,” he said. “And it shows what everyone in the land has in mind.”
translation_verse: Mibi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni ni?” Ni ehere nɔ akɛ, “Kɛntɛŋ ni, ni edamɔ shi hã je lɛ fɛɛ he esha lɛ.”

english_verse: The lead cover of the basket was opened, and in the basket was a woman.
translation_verse: No sɛɛ lɛ, agbele kɛntɛŋ lɛ naa; enaanɔ lɛ sumui akɛfee; ni yoo ko ta shi yɛ kɛntɛŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: “This woman represents evil,” the angel explained. Then he threw her back into the basket and slammed the heavy cover down tight.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni bɔfo lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ naa akɛ, “Mɔ nɛ damɔ shi hã yiwalɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni enyɛ yoo lɛ nɔ ewo kɛntɛŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛ kɛntɛŋ lɛ naanɔ ni akɛ sumui fee lɛ bu kɛntɛŋ lɛ naa.

english_verse: Right after this I saw two women coming through the sky with wings outstretched like a stork in the wind. Suddenly they lifted the basket into the air,
translation_verse: Miwo mihiɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ ni mina yei enyɔ ni miifiliki kɛmiiba kɛ fiji ni tamɔ faanaa oka nɔ. Amɛbawo kɛntɛŋ lɛ kɛnyiɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ teŋ kɛtee.

english_verse: and I asked the angel, “Where are they taking the basket?”
translation_verse: Mibi bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ amɛkɛ kɛntɛŋ lɛ yaa nɛɛ?”

english_verse: “To Babylonia,” he answered, “where they will build a house for the basket and set it down inside.”
translation_verse: Ehã mi hetoo ekɛɛ akɛ, “Amɛkɛmiiya Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; koni amɛyama tsu yɛ jɛi amɛha lɛ. Kɛji agbe tsu lɛ maa naa lɛ amɛkɛ kɛntɛŋ lɛ baayi shi kɛyama egbɛhe.”

english_verse: Finally, I looked up and saw four chariots coming from between two bronze mountains.
translation_verse: Misaa miwo mihiɛ nɔ ni mina tayaa shwiilii ejwɛ komɛi fã kpo kɛjɛ akɔɔble gɔji enyɔ komɛi ateŋ kɛba.

english_verse: The first chariot was pulled by red horses, and the second by black horses;
translation_verse: Klɛŋklɛŋ tayaa shwiili lɛ okpɔŋɔi tsuji ni gbalaa; ni shwiili ni ji enyɔ lɛ okpɔŋɔi diji ni gbalaa;

english_verse: the third chariot was pulled by white horses, and the fourth by spotted gray horses.
translation_verse: shwiili ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ okpɔŋɔi yɛji ni gbalaa; ni nɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ okpɔŋɔi truntrãi ni he wa gbalaa.

english_verse: “Sir,” I asked the angel. “What do these stand for?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mibi bɔfo lɛ ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ akɛ, “MiNuŋtsɔ, mɛni ji enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ?”

english_verse: Then he explained, “These are the four winds of heaven, and now they are going out, after presenting themselves to the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Bɔfo lɛ hã mi hetoo ekɛɛ akɛ, “Enɛɛmɛi damɔ shi hã ŋwɛi kɔɔyɔi ejwɛ lɛ. Amɛmiiya amɛkɛ amɛhe ayatsɔ̃ɔ jeŋ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, koni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛya ŋwɛi kɔɔyɔi ejwɛ lɛ aŋɔɔ.”

english_verse: The chariot with black horses goes toward the north, the chariot with white horses goes toward the west, and the one with spotted horses goes toward the south.”
translation_verse: Tayaa shwiili lɛ ni okpɔŋɔi diji lɛ gbalaa lɛ miiya kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; nɔ ni okpɔŋɔi yɛji lɛ gbalaa lɛ miiya anaigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni nɔ ni okpɔŋɔi truntrãi lɛ gbalaa lɛ miiya wuoyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The horses came out eager to patrol the earth, and the angel told them, “Start patrolling the earth.” When they had gone on their way,
translation_verse: Shi be ni okpɔŋɔi tsuji ni he wa lɛ fã kpo lɛ, amɛhe tswa shi koni amɛyakpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni bɔfo lɛ fã amɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyakpaa shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtee amɛyakpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: he shouted to me, “Those that have gone to the country in the north will do what the Lord's Spirit wants them to do there.” The Chosen Leader
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Naa, okpɔŋɔi ni yaa kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ejɔɔ mi, Yehowa, mitsui he yɛ nakai kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ gbɛfaŋ.” Afã akɛ abu Yoshua akekre

english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ,

english_verse: Tell him that I, the Lord All-Powerful, say, “Someone will reach out from here like a branch and build a temple for me. I will name him ‘Branch,’ and he will rule with royal honors. A priest will stand beside his throne, and the two of them will be good friends.
translation_verse: Lɛ ji mɔ ni ebaama Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni abaawo ehiɛ nyam akɛ lumɔ, ni ebaata emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ kɛye elumɔ lɛ. Osɔfo ko hu baahi emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ he, ni shishinumɔ kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ baahi amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛteŋ.’

english_verse: This crown will be kept in my temple as a reminder and will be taken care of by Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Josiah.”
translation_verse: Ato nɛkɛ maŋtsɛ fai nɛɛ yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli, koni akɛkai Heldai kɛ Tobia kɛ Yedaia kɛ Yosia ni ji Zefania bi lɛ.”

english_verse: When people from distant lands come and help build the temple of the Lord All-Powerful, you will know that the Lord is the one who sent me. And this will happen, if you truly obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Mɛi baajɛ maji asɛɛ shɔŋŋ abaye abua kɛma Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ. No nyɛkɛaale akɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ni tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ. Kɛji nyɛaabo Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi lɛɛlɛŋ lɛ, enɛ aaaba mli ahã nyɛ.

english_verse: On the fourth day of Chislev, the ninth month of the fourth year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord again spoke to me.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ Dario yinɔ afi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji nɛɛhu, ni ji Kislev nyɔŋ, lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Zakaria wie.

english_verse: It happened after the people of Bethel had sent Sharezer with Regem-Melech and his men to ask the priests in the Lord's temple and the prophets to pray for them. So they prayed, “Should we mourn and go without eating during the fifth month, as we have done for many years?”
translation_verse: Asaŋ koni amɛbi osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ akɛ, “Ani wɔfo ni wɔhi ŋmãa yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ hu nɔ tamɔ wɔfeɔ yɛ afii babaoo ni eho lɛ amli lɛ lo?”

english_verse: And when you eat and drink, isn't it for your own enjoyment?
translation_verse: Be ni nyɛye nii ni nyɛnu nii lɛ, ani jeee nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe nyɛye nii ni nyɛnu nii nyɛhã lɛ?”

english_verse: My message today is the same one I commanded the earlier prophets to speak to Jerusalem and its villages when they were prosperous, and when all of Judah, including the Southern Desert and the hill country, was filled with people.
translation_verse: Be ni mɛi yɔɔ Yerusalɛm ni ekɛ emaji kɛ eshikpɔji ni bɔle ehe lɛ shwereɔ lɛ, be mli ni mɛi yɔɔ wuoyigbɛ kɛ ŋa nɔ gbɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, ani jeee nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɔŋŋ Yehowa hã ashiɛ kɛtsɔ̃ eklɛŋklɛŋ gbalɔi lɛ anɔ ahã amɛ lo?

english_verse: So once again, I, the Lord All-Powerful, tell you, “See that justice is done and be kind and merciful to one another!
translation_verse: “Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Nyɛkojoa yɛ jalɛ naa, ni nyɛkɛ musuŋtsɔlɛ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ ahia shi akɛ nyɛmimɛi.

english_verse: Don't mistreat widows or orphans or foreigners or anyone who is poor, and stop making plans to hurt each other.”
translation_verse: Nyɛkawaa okulafo loo awusa loo gbɔ loo ohiafo yi. Ni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akasusu enyɛmi he efɔŋ ko yɛ emli.’

english_verse: But everyone who heard those prophets, stubbornly refused to obey. Instead, they turned their backs on everything my Spirit had commanded the earlier prophets to preach. So I, the Lord, became angry
translation_verse: Amɛkpliŋ amɛtsui koni amɛkabo mla lɛ kɛ wiemɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛtsɔ̃ emumɔ lɛ nɔ ekɛtsu eklɛŋklɛŋ gbalɔi lɛ ni eŋɔ hã lɛ toi. No hewɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ mlifu amɛ naakpa lɛ.

english_verse: and said, “You people paid no attention when I called out to you, and now I'll pay no attention when you call out to me.”
translation_verse: Akɛni mitsɛ amɛ shi amɛfooo mli lɛ, no hewɔ ni amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ mi ni mi hu mibooo amɛ toi lɛ. Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, lɛ kɛɛ nɛ.

english_verse: That's why I came with a whirlwind and scattered them among foreign nations, leaving their lovely country empty of people and in ruins.
translation_verse: Ni no hã mi kɛ lasuogbele gbɛ amɛshwã kɛtee majiasɛɛ hei ni amɛleee lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ ni amɛshi nɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ yɛ amɛsɛɛ bɔ ni mɔ ko eyaaa mli, ni mɔ ko ejeee mli hu lɛ. Amɛshikpɔŋ fɛɛfɛo lɛ tsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃.”

english_verse: I will return to Jerusalem and live there on Mount Zion. Then Jerusalem will be known as my faithful city, and Zion will be known as my holy mountain.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ ekoŋŋ nɛ, mibaku misɛɛ kɛba Zion, ni mibahi Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli, ni abaatsɛ Yerusalɛm akɛ anɔkwale maŋ, kɛ Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ gɔŋ lɛ hu akɛ, ‘Krɔŋkrɔŋ.’

english_verse: Very old people with walking sticks will once again sit around in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ tee nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, hiimeji kɛ yeimeji ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ dɛhiɛmɔtso yɛ egbɔlɛ hewɔ baatara Yerusalɛm blohuiaŋ ekoŋŋ;

english_verse: while boys and girls play in the streets.
translation_verse: Ni maŋ lɛ mli blohuiaŋ aaayimɔ tɔ kɛ gbekɛbii hii kɛ gbekɛbii yei ni miishwɛ.

english_verse: This may seem impossible for my people who are left, but it isn't impossible for me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Kɛji gbalɛ nɛɛ yɛ naakpɛɛ yɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ bei nɛɛ amli yɛ maŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, ani mi hu eeefee naakpɛɛ yɛ mihiɛ lo? Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ.

english_verse: I will save those who were taken to lands in the east and the west,
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, naa, mibahere mimaŋbii lɛ ayiwala kɛaajɛ bokã kɛ anai shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ;

english_verse: and I will bring them to live in Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, faithful to bring about justice.
translation_verse: ni mikɛ amɛ aaaba koni amɛbahi Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ, ni matsɔ amɛNyɔŋmɔ yɛ anɔkwale kɛ jalɛ mli.” Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ,

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful! So don't give up. Think about the message my prophets spoke when the foundation of my temple was laid.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛnuɔ gbalɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ yɛ nɛkɛ bei nɛɛ amli yɛ gbalɔi lɛ anaa kɛjɛ be ni ato Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, Sɔlemɔ we lɛ maa shishi nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛnijiaŋ akajea wui bɔ ni afee ni anyɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ama.

english_verse: Before that time, neither people nor animals were rewarded for their work, and no one was safe anywhere, because I had turned them against each other.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ be ni nakai be lɛ shɛko lɛ gbɔmɔ nitsumɔ feɔ yaka, ni kooloo nitsumɔ hu feɔ yaka, ni mɔ ni jeɔ kpo loo ebaa mli lɛ naaa hejɔlɛ yɛ haolɔ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ mihã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ete shi ewo enaanyo.

english_verse: My people, only a few of you are left, and I promise not to punish you as I did before.
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ mikɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ nɛɛ yeŋ kɛ joomɔ tamɔ mifee tsutsu bii lɛ.” Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ.

english_verse: Instead, I will make sure that your crops are planted in peace and your vineyards are fruitful, that your fields are fertile, and the dew falls from the sky.
translation_verse: “Ejaakɛ aaadu nii yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ mli, waintsei lɛ aaawo yibii, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ aaaba nii, bɔ aaajɛ ŋwɛi anyɔ ashwie nɔ, ni mibahã enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ atsɔ̃ maŋ lɛ mli mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: People of Judah and Israel, you have been a curse to the nations, but I will save you and make you a blessing to them. So don't be afraid or lose courage.
translation_verse: Naa, Yuda we kɛ Israel we, bɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ gbɛ akɛ majimaji, ni amɛkɛ nyɛgbɛi lomɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mahere nyɛyiwala, ni nyɛaatsɔ̃ jɔɔmɔ ni akɛ nyɛgbɛi baajɔɔ. Nyɛkashea gbeyei, shi moŋ nyɛwajea nyɛhe ni nyɛfea ekãa kɛkɛ.”

english_verse: When your ancestors made me angry, I decided to punish you with disasters, and I didn't hold back.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, “Bɔ ni mito miyiŋ ni mafee nyɛ efɔŋ ni mishwaŋ mihe be ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ wo mi mlifu lɛ,

english_verse: Now you no longer need to be afraid. I have decided to treat Jerusalem and Judah with kindness.
translation_verse: nakai mito miyiŋ bei nɛɛ amli akɛ mibafee Yerusalɛm kɛ Yuda we ejurɔ. Hewɔ lɛ nyɛkashea gbeyei.

english_verse: But you must be truthful with each other, and in court you must give fair decisions that lead to peace.
translation_verse: Nyɛfea nibii nɛɛ: nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enaanyo awiea anɔkwale; asaŋ nyɛyea jalɛ sane yɛ nyɛkoii ashi bɔ ni baahã toiŋjɔlɛ aba.

english_verse: Don't ever plan evil things against others or tell lies under oath. I, the Lord, hate such things. A Time of Celebration
translation_verse: Nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akabɛ enaanyo ewo emli. Nyɛkasumɔa amale kitãkãmɔ; ejaakɛ enɛɛmɛi ji nibii ni minyɛɔ. Mi, Yehowa mikɛɛ.”

english_verse: People of Judah, I, the Lord, demand that whenever you go without food as a way of worshiping me, it should become a time of celebration. No matter if it's the fourth month, the fifth month, the seventh month, or the tenth month, you should have a joyful festival. So love truth and live at peace.
translation_verse: “Ŋmãa ni nyɛhiɔ yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ, kɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ, kɛ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ, kɛ nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ baatsɔ̃ nyamɔ kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ mliflimɔ gbii juji ahã Yudabii. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsumɔa anɔkwale kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ.”

english_verse: I tell you that people will come here from cities everywhere.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ ekoŋŋ nɛ, “Mɛi aaakã he ajɛ majimaji babaoo anɔ aba.

english_verse: Those of one town will go to another and say, “We're going to ask the Lord All-Powerful to treat us with kindness. Come and join us.”
translation_verse: Ni maŋ kome mli bii aaaya maŋ kroko mli ayakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛhãa wɔyaa wɔyakpaa Yehowa fai, ni asaŋ wɔyatao esɛɛ gbɛ hu. Mi hu maya.’

english_verse: Many people from strong nations will come to Jerusalem to worship me and to ask me to treat them with kindness.
translation_verse: Mɛi babaoo kɛ majimaji ni ahe wa tete aaba Yerusalɛm abatao Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, sɛɛgbɛ ni amɛaakpa lɛ fai.”

english_verse: When this happens, ten people from nations with different languages will grab a Jew by his clothes and say, “Let us go with you. We've heard that God is on your side.” I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ ekoŋŋ nɛ, “Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ mɛi nyɔŋma ni jɛ majimaji ni wieɔ wiemɔi srɔtoi anɔ baamɔ Yudanyo kome atade mli, ni amɛaakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Ha wɔkɛ bo aya, ejaakɛ wɔnu akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ nyɛ yɛ.’ ”

english_verse: This is a message from the Lord: His eyes are on everyone, especially the tribes of Israel. So he pronounces judgment against the cities of Hadrach and Damascus.
translation_verse: Yehowa wie eshi Hadrak shikpɔŋ lɛ ni nakai wiemɔ lɛ saa Damasko hu he; ejaakɛ Siria maji wuji lɛ hu Yehowa nɔ ji fɛɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni enɔ ji Israel akutsei lɛ.

english_verse: Judgment will also fall on the nearby city of Hamath, as well as on Tyre and Sidon, whose people are clever.
translation_verse: Enɔ ji Hamat hu ni kɛ Hadrak shikpɔŋ lɛ je husu lɛ, kɛ Tiro kɛ Sidon fɛɛ, tsɛbelɛ amɛnilee naa wa naakpa.

english_verse: Tyre has built a fortress and piled up silver and gold, as though they were dust or mud from the streets.
translation_verse: Tiro etswa gbogbo ewo ehe ni ebua jwiɛtɛi naa tamɔ mlu kɛ shika tsuru hu naa tamɔ blohuŋ shia.

english_verse: Now the Lord will punish Tyre with poverty; he will sink its ships and send it up in flames.
translation_verse: Shi naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baashɔ̃ enii ni ena nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni aaashɛrɛ enii kpakpai lɛ fɛɛ ashwie ŋshɔ mli; ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu lɛ akɛ la aakpãtã ehiɛ.

english_verse: Both Ashkelon and Gaza will tremble with fear; Ekron will lose all hope. Gaza's king will be killed, and Ashkelon emptied of its people.
translation_verse: Ashkelon maŋ lɛ aaana ni eeeshe gbeyei; Gaza hu aaana ni ehe aaakpokpo naakpa. Ekron hu aaana ejaakɛ ehiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ aaafee yakatswaa. Gaza maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ aaakpãtã, ni Ashkelon hu baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃.

english_verse: A mob of half-breeds will settle in Ashdod, and the Lord himself will rob Philistia of pride.
translation_verse: Yoo ajwamãŋbii aaahi Ashdod; Filistibii lɛ ahewoo lɛ, mafo sɛɛ.

english_verse: No longer will the Philistines eat meat with blood in it or any unclean food. They will become part of the people of our God from the tribe of Judah. And God will accept the people of Ekron, as he did the Jebusites.
translation_verse: Mahã amɛkpa loo ni emli lá fɛɛ tsereko yeli kwraa, ni amɛnihiinii tekeŋ amɛtsɛ̃ŋ, ni emli mɛi komɛi kɛ̃ aaashwɛ ahã wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ Yuda akutsei lɛ eko; ni Ekronbii hu aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ Yebusbii.

english_verse: God says, “I will stand guard to protect my temple from those who come to attack. I know what's happening, and no one will mistreat my people ever again.” The Lord Tells about the Coming King
translation_verse: No sɛɛ lɛ, mabu miwebii lɛ ahe tamɔ bulɔ, koni asraafoi akuu ko kuu ko akatsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛtee kɛba. Miŋmɛŋ gbɛ ni haolɔ ko agba miwebii lɛ anaa dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ agbɛnɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihiŋmɛi kã amɛhe. Wɔsɛɛ ko Maŋtsɛ

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! Your king has won a victory, and he is coming to you. He is humble and rides on a donkey; he comes on the colt of a donkey.
translation_verse: Omli afili bo, bo Zion biyoo; Bɔɔ oshe waa, bo Yerusalɛm biyoo! Naa, omaŋtsɛ lɛ miiba oŋɔɔ; Eeba kɛ agbojee kɛ kunimyeli. Eta teji oblanyo ni ji teji yoo bi ko nɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will take away war chariots and horses from Israel and Jerusalem. Bows that were made for battle will be broken. I will bring peace to nations, and your king will rule from sea to sea. His kingdom will reach from the Euphrates River across the earth. The Lord Promises To Rescue Captives
translation_verse: Makpãtã ta shwiilii fɛɛ ni aaajɛ Efraim aba lɛ ahiɛ; ni majie ta okpɔŋɔ lɛ hu kɛje Yerusalɛm. Makumɔ tawuu gãii lɛ amli dukuduku. Eeeshi maji lɛ toiŋjɔlɛ ni elumɔyeli aaajɛ ŋshɔnaa kɛyagbee ŋshɔnaa. Ni eeejɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa kɛyashi je lɛ naagbee hei tɔ̃ɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ akpɔ̃mɔ

english_verse: When I made a sacred agreement with you, my people, we sealed it with blood. Now some of you are captives in waterless pits, but I will come to your rescue
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ lɛ saa kɛɛ, “Bo Zion biyoo hu, Milá ni mikɛsɔo mikɛo teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ naa hewɔ lɛ, majie obii ni etsɔ̃mɔ gboklɛfoi lɛ yɛ bu ni nu bɛ mli lɛ mli.

english_verse: and offer you hope. Return to your fortress, because today I will reward you with twice what you had.
translation_verse: Nyɛ gboklɛfoi ni nyɛyɔɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ, nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nyɛbaa mɔɔ ni wa lɛ mli. Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mibato nyɛ najiaŋ toi enyɔ.

english_verse: I will use Judah as my bow and Israel as my arrow. I will take the people of Zion as my sword and attack the Greeks. The Lord Will Protect His People
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ midɔ Yuda mli tamɔ gãitso, ni mikɛ Efraim efee egãimlibi. Bo Zion, matee obihii lɛ ashi, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ tatsɛ klante yɛ midɛŋ, yɛ bo, Hela, obihii lɛ anɔ.”

english_verse: Like a cloud, the Lord God will appear over his people, and his arrows will flash like lightning. God will sound his trumpet and attack in a whirlwind from the south.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ Yehowa aaapue yɛ ewebii lɛ anɔ ni egãimlibii lɛ aafliki tamɔ srawa gbalaa lɛ. Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ni aaakpã eta tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ, ni eeefã tamɔ wuoyigbɛ lasuogbele.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will protect his people, and they will trample down the sharpshooters and their slingshots. They will drink and get rowdy; they will be as full as a bowl at the time of sacrifice.
translation_verse: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, aaabu emɛi ahe; Amɛaatserɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi amli, ni amɛaanaanaa amɛ nɔ. Amɛaashwie amɛhenyɛlɔi alá shi ni lá lɛ aaaho tamɔ afɔleshãa kooloo lá ni afɔse kɛmiijɛ okpolu mli aashwie afɔleshãa latɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God will save them on that day, because they are his people, and they will shine on his land like jewels in a crown.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaahere amɛyiwala; ejaakɛ etooku ji amɛ; Amɛaakpɛlɛ yɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tamɔ akekre he ojarawatɛi.

english_verse: How lovely they will be. Young people will grow there like grain in a field or grapes in a vineyard.
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aaaŋɔɔ, eeefee fɛo; abele aaahã oblahii afrɔke ni wain hee hu aaahã oblayei afrɔke.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am the one who sends storm clouds and showers of rain to make fields produce. So when the crops need rain, you should pray to me.
translation_verse: Nyɛbia Yehowa koni ehã Agbiɛnaa nu anɛ nyɛ. Nyɛbia Yehowa mɔ ni hãa ahum fãa ni ehãa nu nɛɔ gbɔmɛi kɛ ŋa nɔ tsei fɛɛ anɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You can't believe idols and fortunetellers, or depend on the hope you receive from witchcraft and interpreters of dreams. But you have tried all of these, and now you are like sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni amãgãi lɛ kɛɔ lɛ jwɛŋmɔ bɛ mli, ni klamɔfoi lɛ aninaa lɛ apasa sɔŋŋ ni. Mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ lamɔi ashishi lɛ maleɔ, ni amɛshɛjeɔ mɔ mii yakatswaa; no hewɔ lɛ, maŋbii lɛ kpaa shi tamɔ toi, amɛnaa nɔ, ejaakɛ amɛbɛ kwɛlɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am fiercely angry with you leaders, and I will punish you. I care for my people, the nation of Judah, and I will change this flock of sheep into charging war horses.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mimli efu tookwɛlɔi ni ji maŋsɛɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ, ni magbala amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ atoi; ejaakɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, jwɛŋɔ etooku ni ji Yudabii lɛ ahe; ni eeehã amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ etayaa okpɔŋɔ ni eshwãa efɔ̃ɔ enɔ lɛ.

english_verse: From this flock will come leaders who will be strong like cornerstones and tent pegs and weapons of war.
translation_verse: Koŋtɛ lɛ aaajɛ Yuda mli, emli nɔŋŋ buu lɛ shiŋmlitso lɛ hu aaajɛ, kɛ tawuu gãitso lɛ kɛ lumɛi srɔtoi fɛɛ hu.

english_verse: They will join in the fighting, and together they will trample their enemies like mud. They will fight, because I, the Lord, will be on their side. And they will crush the enemy cavalry.
translation_verse: Yudabii lɛ aaatsɔmɔ kãkãlɔi yɛ ta mli, ni amɛaanaanaa amɛhenyɛlɔi anɔ yɛ blohuiaŋ tamɔ anaa ŋmiamɔ. Amɛbaawu tai ni amɛaahã amɛhenyɛlɔi tabilɔi okpɔŋɔianɔtralɔi ahiɛ ashwie shi, ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛ amɛ yɛ.

english_verse: I will strengthen the kingdoms of Judah and Israel. And I will show mercy because I am the Lord, their God. I will answer their prayers and bring them home. Then it will seem as though I had never rejected them.
translation_verse: “Mibahã Yuda he awa, ni mahere Israel yiwala. Mikɛ amɛ aaaku sɛɛ kɛba ejaakɛ mimusuŋ etsɔ̃ mi yɛ amɛhe. Amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ mɛi ni mikwako amɛ dã, ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni mabo amɛfaikpamɔ toi.

english_verse: Israel will be like a tribe of warriors celebrating with wine. When their children see this, they will also be happy because of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ Efraim aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ tatsɛ kpaanaa, ni emlibii amli aaafli amɛ tamɔ mɛi ni enu wain. Amɛshwiei aaana nɔ ni Yehowa etsu lɛ; ni amɛmii aaashɛ amɛhe; ni amɛmli aaafli amɛ.

english_verse: I will give a signal for them to come together because I have rescued them. And there will be as many as ever before.
translation_verse: “Mikɛ okadi aaatsɛ amɛ, ni mabua amɛnaa ejaakɛ mi mikpɔ̃ amɛ, ni amɛyi aaafa ekoŋŋ tamɔ sa.

english_verse: Although I scattered my people in distant countries, they won't forget me. Once their children are raised, they will return—
translation_verse: Migbɛ amɛ mishwã maŋsɛɛ maji anɔ moŋ; shi kɛ̃lɛ, amɛaakai mi, yɛ hei ni amɛyɔɔ yɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ. Amɛ kɛ amɛbii fɛɛ yi aaana wala, ni amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ amɛaaba ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: I will bring them home from Egypt and Assyria, then let them settle as far as Gilead and Lebanon, until the land overflows with them.
translation_verse: Makpala amɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt kɛba. Mabua amɛnaa kɛjɛ Asiria hu. Mikɛ amɛ aaaba Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛ Lebanon shikpɔŋ lɛ hu nɔ kɛyaashi anaŋ gbɛ yɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ ahã amɛ.

english_verse: My people will go through an ocean of troubles, but I will overcome the waves and dry up the deepest part of the Nile. Assyria's great pride will be put down, and the power of Egypt will disappear.
translation_verse: Amɛbaafo amanehulu ŋshɔ lɛ, mahã ŋshɔkei lɛ aŋmɛ dɛŋŋ. Nilo Faa lɛ fɛɛ kwa baagbi. Abaaba Asiria hetsɛmɔ lɛ shi, ni Ijipt hewalɛ lɛ sɛɛ baafo.

english_verse: I'll strengthen my people because of who I am, and they will follow me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Mawo amɛ hewalɛ lɛ yɛ Yehowa mli, ni amɛbaanya yɛ egbɛi mli. Mi, Yehowa, mi mikɛɛ.”

english_verse: Lebanon, open your gates! Let the fire come in to destroy your cedar trees.
translation_verse: “Ao, Lebanon, gbelemɔ oshinai lɛ, koni la ashã otsenedrui lɛ.

english_verse: Cry, you cypress trees! The glorious cedars have fallen and are rotting. Cry, you oak trees of Bashan! The dense forest has been chopped down.
translation_verse: Ao, sɛsɛo, wo yara ni ofo, ejaakɛ tsenedru lɛ eku egbee shi; ejaakɛ tsei ni yɔɔ nyam lɛ ahiɛ ekpãtã. Bashan odum, wo yara nyɛfoa, ejaakɛ agba koo haii lɛ tete.

english_verse: Listen! Shepherds are crying. Their glorious pastures have been ruined. Listen! Lions are roaring. The forests of the Jordan Valley are no more to be found. Worthless Shepherds
translation_verse: Bo toi, tookwɛlɔi lɛ ewo yara. Bo toi, jatai miihuu, Naa, Yordan he koo lɛ hiɛ ekpãtã. ejaakɛ amɛnunyam sɛɛ efo. Tookwɛlɔi enyɔ lɛ

english_verse: The Lord my God said to me: Tend those sheep doomed for slaughter!
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Feemɔ ohe tamɔ tookwɛlɔ ni kwɛɔ tooku ni ayaagbe amɛ.

english_verse: The people who buy and butcher them go unpunished, while everyone who sells them says, “Praise the Lord! I'm rich.” Not even their shepherds have pity on them.
translation_verse: Mɛni hewɔ tookwɛlɔi lɛ gbeɔ toi nɛɛ ni agbalaaa amɛ toi. Mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ toi nɛɛ hu kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Ajie Yehowa yi ejaakɛ wɔtsɔmɔ niiatsɛmɛi.’ Ni amɛkwɛlɔi lɛ tete po enaaa kooloi lɛ amɔbɔ.”

english_verse: Tend those sheep because I, the Lord, will no longer have pity on the people of this earth. I'll turn neighbor against neighbor and make them slaves of a king. They will bring disaster on the earth, and I'll do nothing to rescue any of them.
translation_verse: “No hewɔ lɛ, minaŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko mɔbɔ dɔŋŋ yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ; naa, maŋmɛɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ he mawo enɔkwɛlɔ kɛ emaŋtsɛ hu dɛŋ. Ni nɔkwɛlɔi nɛɛ baakpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ ni mihereŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko yiwala.

english_verse: So I became a shepherd of those sheep doomed to be slaughtered by the sheep dealers. And I gave names to the two sticks I used for tending the sheep: One of them was named “Mercy” and the other “Unity.”
translation_verse: “Hewɔ lɛ mitsɔ̃ toi ni abaagbe ahã tookwɛlɔi nɛɛ akwɛlɔ. Mikɔlɔ kplamɔtsei enyɔ. Miwo ekome gbɛi akɛ, ‘Dromɔ’ kɛ ekome hu akɛ, ‘Ekomefeemɔ!’ Nomɛi mikɛkpalaa tooku lɛ.

english_verse: In less than a month, I became impatient with three shepherds who didn't like me, and I got rid of them.
translation_verse: Mikpãtã tookwɛlɔi etɛ̃ ahiɛ yɛ nyɔŋ kome mli, ejaakɛ minaaa amɛhe tsui, ni amɛ hu amɛnyaŋe mi.

english_verse: Then I said, “I refuse to be your shepherd. Let the sheep that are going to die, go on and die, and those that are going to be destroyed, go on and be destroyed. Then let the others eat one another alive.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ ni mikɛɛ akɛ mifeŋ nyɛkwɛlɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ. Too ni baagbo lɛ, egbo, nɔ ni hiɛ baakpãtã hu, ehiɛ akpãtã; ni nɔ ni aaashwɛ lɛ, amɛyeyee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi aloo.”

english_verse: On that same day, I broke the stick named “Mercy” to show that the Lord had canceled his agreement with all people.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mikɔ mikplamɔtso ni gbɛi ji ‘Dromɔ’ lɛ, ni miku mli, ni mikɛku kpãŋmɔ ni mikɛ miwebii lɛ ekpãŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: The sheep dealers who saw me knew at once that this was a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Hewɔ lɛ aku kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ. Ni too jarayelɔi lɛ ni kwɛɔ mi lɛ nu shishi akɛ Yehowa wiemɔ naanii ni.

english_verse: I told them, “Pay me my wages, if you think you should; otherwise, forget it.” So they handed me my wages, a measly
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Okɛyawo Sɔlemɔ we lɛ fotro lɛ mli.” No hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ jwiɛtɛi talentai nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ni amɛkɛwo mi nyɔmɔ lɛ yawo Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ fotro lɛ mli.

english_verse: Then I broke the stick named “Unity” and canceled the ties between Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ miku kplamɔtso ni ji enyɔ lɛ ni gbɛi ji ‘Ekomefeemɔ’ lɛ mli, ni mikɛfo nyɛmimɛi anaanyobɔɔ ni kã Yuda kɛ Israel teŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: Next, the Lord said to me, “Act like a shepherd again—this time a worthless shepherd.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “kɔlɔmɔ tookwɛlɔ yakagbɔmɔ nitsumɔ nibii ohiɛ,

english_verse: Once more I am going to let a worthless nobody rule the land—one who won't care for the strays or search for the young or heal the sick or feed the healthy. He will just dine on the fattest sheep, leaving nothing but a few bones.”
translation_verse: Shi naa, miitee tookwɛlɔ ko shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; lɛ lɛ, jeee ehe sane ko ji too ni miigbo lɛ. Toi ni egbɛ eshwã lɛ ebuaŋ amɛnaa. Nɔ ni epila lɛ, etsaŋ lɛ; ni toi ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ lɛ ehaŋ amɛ niyenii amɛyeŋ; shi moŋ gbe eeegbe toi ni ewowoi fɔ lɛ eye, belɛ eekpɔlɔ amɛnaji ahe koklotoi lɛ eeshwie.

english_verse: You worthless shepherd, deserting the sheep! I hope a sword will cripple your arm and blind your right eye.
translation_verse: Kpoo hã mitookwɛlɔ yakagbɔmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni shiɔ etooku lɛ; lɛ lɛ, aaafo eninejurɔ yɛ ta mli, ni aaajwa eninejurɔ hiŋmɛi hu yɛ ta mli. Enine agbo kwraa yɛ ehe, ni eninejurɔ hiŋmɛi lɛ hu ashwila kwrakwra.”

english_verse: This is a message from the Lord about Israel: I am the Lord! I stretched out the heavens; I put the earth on its foundations and gave breath to humans.
translation_verse: Wiemɔ ni Yehowa wie yɛ Israel he lɛ nɛ. Bɔ ni Yehowa mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi ni ha shi nɛɛ, ni bɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni ebɔ mumɔ ni yɔɔ gbɔmɔ mli lɛ kɛɛ nɛ,

english_verse: I have decided that Jerusalem will become a bowl of wine that makes the neighboring nations drunk. And when Jerusalem is attacked, Judah will also be attacked.
translation_verse: “Naa, mahã Yerusalɛm atsɔ̃ tamɔ dãa yɛ kpulu mli mahã maji ni bɔle lɛ lɛ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaabasa enaa ekwɛ lɛ aaadidãa tamɔ dãatɔlɔ. Kɛji maŋ ko fã ta basa Yerusalɛm yi lɛ, belɛ ekɛ ta lɛ etua Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ hu.

english_verse: But I will turn Jerusalem into a heavy stone that crushes anyone who tries to lift it. When all nations on earth surround Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ mahã Yerusalɛm atsɔ̃ tɛ ni tsii mahã maji ni bɔle lɛ lɛ. Maŋ fɛɛ maŋ ni aaaka tɛ nɛɛ nɔ womɔ lɛ aaapila. Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ majimaji krokomɛi fɛɛ aaafee ekome amɛte shi amɛwo Yerusalɛm.

english_verse: I will blind every horse and make them panic, and every rider will be confused. But at the same time, I will watch over Judah.
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ mahã henyɛlɔi lɛ akpoŋɔi fɛɛ ajijaa, ni okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ hu aye sɛkɛ. Shi be ni mashwila henyɛlɔi lɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ ahiŋmɛii lɛ mahã mihiŋmɛii akã Yudabii lɛ ahe. Mi Yehowa, mi, mikɛɛ.

english_verse: Then every clan in Judah will realize that I, the Lord All-Powerful, am their God, and that I am the source of their strength.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ Yuda akutsei lɛ baakɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Yerusalɛmbii lɛ ahewalɛ lɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, ni ji amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ ejɛ.’

english_verse: At that time I will let the clans of Judah be like a ball of fire in a wood pile or a fiery torch in a hay stack. Then Judah will send the surrounding nations up in smoke. And once again the city of Jerusalem will be filled with people.
translation_verse: “Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, mahã Yuda akutsei lɛ atsɔ̃ tamɔ la kɛ ŋɛsu yɛ laii ateŋ; amɛaatamɔ jatɛŋ ni tsoɔ ni shãa abelebaa gbiŋ; ni amɛaakpãtã maji krokomɛi ni yɔɔ amɛninejurɔ kɛ amɛbɛku gbɛ lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ. Yerusalɛmbii aaafee shweshweeshwe yɛ Yerusalɛm.

english_verse: But I will first give victory to Judah, so the kingdom of David and the city of Jerusalem in all of their glory won't be thought of more highly than Judah itself.
translation_verse: “Yehowa baahã Yuda akutso lɛ mli tabilɔi tsutsu aye amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kunim, bɔ ni afee ni hiɛ akasɔ David shwiei lɛ, kɛ Yerusalɛmbii lɛ hu akunim ni amɛye lɛ fe kunim ni Yudabii baaye lɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will protect Jerusalem. Even the weakest person there will be as strong as David, and David's kingdom will rule as though my very own angel were its leader.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛ tsɛŋ ko aaabu Yerusalɛmbii lɛ ahe, ni mɔ ni he waaa kwraa yɛ amɛteŋ he aaawa tamɔ David; ni David shwiei lɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ; amɛaatamɔ Yehowa bɔfo ni nyiɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ.

english_verse: I am determined to wipe out every nation that attacks Jerusalem. Mourning for the One Pierced with a Spear
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ maji fɛɛ ni aaate shi awo Yerusalɛm lɛ makpãtã amɛhiɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make the descendants of David and the people of Jerusalem feel deep sorrow and pray when they see the one they pierced with a spear. They will mourn and weep for him, as parents weep over the death of their only child or their first-born.
translation_verse: “Mafɔse mimɔbɔnalɛ kɛ sɔlemɔ mumɔ mashwie David shwiei lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm maŋbii lɛ anɔ bɔ ni kɛ amɛna mɔ ko ni amɛye lɛ awui ko lɛ, amɛaaye mɔ lɛ ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ ayeɔ bi koome ni egbo he ŋkɔmɔ; ni amɛaafo lɛ kɛ mlishãlɛ tamɔ afoɔ kromɔbi ni egbo.

english_verse: On that day the people of Jerusalem will mourn as much as everyone did for Hadad Rimmon on the flatlands near Megiddo.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ yara ni abaawo yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ baatamɔ yara ni awo kɛfo Hadad-Rimmon yɛ Megido ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone of each family in the land will mourn, and the men will mourn separately from the women. This includes those from the family of David, and the families of Nathan,
translation_verse: Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ baawo yara wekuiaŋwekuiaŋ. Davidwe lɛ baawo yara lɛ enɔ aŋkro ni amɛŋamɛi lɛ hu bawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro; Nakai nɔŋŋ Natanwe lɛ baawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro ni amɛŋamɛi lɛ hu baawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro.

english_verse: In the future there will be a fountain, where David's descendants and the people of Jerusalem can wash away their sin and guilt.
translation_verse: “Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ abaagbele nu hiŋmɛi naa ahã David we lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ, koni akɛfɔ amɛhe eshai kɛ amɛhe muji ashwie.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says: When that time comes, I will get rid of every idol in the country, and they will be forgotten forever. I will also do away with their prophets and those evil spirits that control them.
translation_verse: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ tee nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ mibagbe wɔji lɛ agbɛii kwraa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, bɔ ni afee ni akakai amɛ dɔŋŋ; nakai nɔŋŋ majie gbalɔi lɛ kɛ mumɔi ni ahe tseee lɛ hu kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: If any such prophets ever appear again, their own parents must warn them that they will die for telling lies in my name—the name of the Lord. If those prophets don't stop speaking, their parents must then kill them with a sword.
translation_verse: Ni kɛji mɔ ko aaaba ekoŋŋ akɛ gbalɔ ji lɛ lɛ, etsɛ kɛ enyɛ ni fɔ lɛ tete aaakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Gbalɔ amalelɔ ji bo, ni osa gbele, ejaakɛ oomale yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli.’ Ni kɛji ekã he eegba lolo lɛ etsɛ kɛ enyɛ ni fɔ lɛ lɛ baatsu lɛ nɔ̃, koni amɛgbe lɛ.

english_verse: Those prophets will be ashamed of their so-called visions, and they won't deceive anyone by dressing like a true prophet.
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ gbalɔ fɛɛ gbalɔ hiɛ baagbo yɛ eninaa ni egba lɛ hewɔ, ni ewoŋ gbalɔi atade kɛ ehiɛ fɛŋfɛŋ ni amɛwoɔ kɛshishiuɔ mɛi lɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Instead, they will say, “I'm no prophet. I've been a farmer all my life.”
translation_verse: Shi moŋ nɔ ni ebaakɛɛ ji akɛ, ‘Jeee gbalɔ ji mi, okwaafonyo ji mi, mibɔ̃i humɔ kɛjɛ miblahiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ.’

english_verse: And if any of them are asked why they are wounded, they will answer, “It happened at the house of some friends.” A Wounded Shepherd and Scattered Sheep
translation_verse: Ni kɛji mɔ ko bi lɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛni faji anaa yɔɔ osɛɛ nɛɛ lɛ?’ Eeehã hetoo akɛ, ‘Minanemɛi ni pila mi nɛɛ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: My sword, wake up! Attack my shepherd and friend. Strike down the shepherd! Scatter the little sheep, and I will destroy them.
translation_verse: Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Bo klante, wo ohe nɔ owo mitookwɛlɔ lɛ, mɔ ni ji misɛɛ mɔ lɛ, koni toi lɛ agbɛ ashwã. Mawo minine nɔ yɛ too bibiibii tete anɔ ni maplenee amɛ.

english_verse: Nowhere in the land will more than a third of them be left alive.
translation_verse: Aaakpãtã mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ amlijaa etɛ̃ mli enyɔ hiɛ, ni amɛaagboi; ni mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome ni aaashwɛ lɛ yi aaana wala.

english_verse: Then I will purify them and put them to the test, just as gold and silver are purified and tested. They will pray in my name, and I will answer them. I will say, “You are my people,” and they will reply, “You, Lord, are our God!”
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome ni aaashwɛ nɛɛ lɛ, mikɛ amɛ baawo la mli ni matsuu amɛhe, tamɔ akɛ la tsuɔ jwiɛtɛi he; makpa amɛ shi makwɛ tamɔ akpaa shika shi akwɛɔ lɛ. Amɛaasɔle kɛtsɛ mi, ni mahere amɛ nɔ. Makɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mimɛi ji amɛ,’ ni amɛ hu amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Yehowa ji wɔNyɔŋmɔ.’ Mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, mikɛɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord will have his day. And when it comes, everything that was ever taken from Jerusalem will be returned and divided among its people.
translation_verse: Naa, Yehowa gbi ko miiba, ni ta mli nii ni henyɛlɔi ha yɛ bo Yerusalɛm omli lɛ, abaaja yɛ bo nɔŋŋ omli.

english_verse: But first, he will bring many nations to attack Jerusalem—homes will be robbed, women raped, and half of the population dragged off, though the others will be allowed to remain.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, mabua maji lɛ anaa koni amɛte shi amɛwo Yerusalɛm ni amɛkɛ lɛ awu. Amɛbaaŋɔ maŋ lɛ, ni abaashã shĩai lɛ amli nii, ni amɛbaato amɛmli yei lɛ kabonaa. Abaaŋɔ maŋ lɛ mlijaa fã nom, shi mlijaa fã ni baashwɛ lɛ abaashi amɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, afeŋ amɛ nɔ ko.

english_verse: The Lord will attack those nations like a warrior fighting in battle.
translation_verse: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛ nakai maji lɛ baawu tamɔ efeɔ yɛ ta beiaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: He will take his stand on the Mount of Olives east of Jerusalem, and the mountain will split in half, forming a wide valley that runs from east to west.
