translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ Yehowa baadamɔ Mugɔŋ lɛ ni ma Yerusalɛm bokãgbɛ lɛ nɔ. Mugɔŋ nɛɛ mli baagba enyɔ kɛjɛ bokã kɛyashi anai, ni jɔɔ kpeteŋkple diɛŋtsɛ baakã teŋ. Gɔŋ lɛ fã baaye kooyigbɛ, ni fã hu baaye wuoyigbɛ.

english_verse: Then you people will escape from the Lord's mountain, through this valley, which reaches to Azal. You will run in all directions, just as everyone did when the earthquake struck in the time of King Uzziah of Judah. Afterwards, the Lord my God will appear with his holy angels.
translation_verse: Nyɛbaajo foi kɛtsɔ̃ jɔɔ ni kã migɔŋ ni emli egba enyɔ lɛ mli. Nyɛbaajo foi tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ jo foi be ni shikpɔŋ hoso yɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ Uzia yinɔ lɛ. No sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ baaba abapue.

english_verse: It will be a bright day that won't turn cloudy or cold.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛ̃i yeŋ, ni afua hu woŋ.

english_verse: And the Lord has decided when it will happen—this time of unending day.
translation_verse: Asaŋ je naŋ; anaŋ be ni ji shwane kɛ be ni ji gbɛkɛ, ejaakɛ gbɛkɛ tete lɛ hulu miitso. .

english_verse: In both summer and winter, life-giving streams will flow from Jerusalem, half of them to the Dead Sea in the east and half to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ wala nu baaho kɛaajɛ Yerusalɛm; fã kome kɛ enaa baaya ayawo Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ni fã kome lɛ hu kɛ enaa baaya ayawo Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ mli. Hulutsoobe kɛ fɛ̃ibe mli fɛɛ lɛ nu nɛɛ baakã he eho.

english_verse: Then there will be only one Lord who rules as King and whose name is worshiped everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ aaale lɛ akɛ Yehowa kome kɛ egbɛi hu koome; ejaakɛ lɛ ebaaye shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord will do to those who attack Jerusalem: While they are standing there, he will make their flesh rot and their eyes fall from their sockets and their tongues drop out.
translation_verse: Majimaji fɛɛ ni baafa tã kɛtua Yerusalɛm lɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛ amɛ baaye ahã nɛ: amɛheloo baakpɔtɔ be mli ni amɛhiɛ kamɔ; amɛhiŋmɛii baakpɔtɔ yɛ amɛyitsei ahe, ni amɛlilɛii baakpɔtɔ yɛ amɛdaaŋ.

english_verse: The Lord will make them go into a frenzy and start attacking each other,
translation_verse: Ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ Yehowa baahã ehe ŋmiŋmi kpeteŋkple amɔ̃mɔ amɛ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baawo enine nɔ yɛ enaanyo ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Afterwards, the survivors from those nations that attacked Jerusalem will go there each year to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful, and to celebrate the Festival of Shelters.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ maji ni kulɛ amɛte shi amɛwo Yerusalɛm lɛ mli mɛi ni baashwɛ lɛ baaya Yerusalɛm daa afi koni amɛyaja maŋtsɛ, ni ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, koni amɛye Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ hu.

english_verse: No rain will fall on the land of anyone in any country who refuses to go to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Kɛji maŋ ko yɛ ni emli bii lɛ eyaaa Yerusalɛm koni amɛyaja maŋtsɛ, Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, nu enɛŋ amɛ.

english_verse: This horrible disaster will strike the Egyptians and everyone else who refuses to go there for the celebration.
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni abaagbala Ijiptbii kɛ maji fɛɛ ni amɛyayeee Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ eko lɛ atoi.

english_verse: At that time the words “Dedicated to the Lord” will be engraved on the bells worn by horses. In fact, every ordinary cooking pot in Jerusalem will be just as sacred to the Lord All-Powerful as the bowls used at the altar. Any one of them will be acceptable for boiling the meat of sacrificed animals, and there will no longer be a need to sell special pots and bowls.
translation_verse: Kukwɛi fɛɛ kukwɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm kɛ Yuda fɛɛ hu baatsɔ̃ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ; bɔ ni afee ni mɛi fɛɛ ni baashã afɔle ahole amɛ kɛhoo afɔleshãa loo lɛ. Ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ jarayelɔ ko jarayelɔ ko eyayeŋ jara yɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ we lɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: I am Malachi. And this is the message that the Lord gave me for Israel. The Lord's Love for Israel
translation_verse: Gbalɛ wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛtsɔ̃ Gbalɔ Maleaki nɔ koni ekɛhã Israelbii lɛ nɛ. Suɔmɔ ni Yehowa yɔɔ hã Israel

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, have loved you. And yet you ask in what way have I loved you. Don't forget that Esau was the brother of your ancestor Jacob, but I chose Jacob
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ ewebii lɛ akɛ, “Misumɔ nyɛ.” Shi amɛto he akɛ, “Mɛni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ osumɔ wɔ?” Yehowa here amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Te Esau nyɛmi nuu ji Yakob; shi bɛ misumɔ Yakob kɛ eshwiei,

english_verse: instead of Esau. And I turned Esau's hill country into a barren desert where jackals roam.
translation_verse: ni minyɛ Esau kɛ eshwiei fɛɛ. Mihã egbɛfaŋ gɔŋ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ tsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni ashi jɛi, ni jɛi tsɔ̃ ŋaŋgbei ashihilɛhe?”

english_verse: Esau's descendants may say, “Although our nation Edom is in ruins, we will rebuild it.” But I, the Lord All-Powerful, promise to tear down whatever they build. Then everyone will know that I will never stop being angry with them as long as they are so sinful.
translation_verse: Kɛji Esau shwiei, ni ji Edombii, lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Akpãtã wɔhiɛ moŋ, shi wɔbaaku wɔsɛɛ kɛya ni wɔyasaa wɔtswa wɔtsui ni efee koikoi lɛ,” no lɛ Yehowa baato he akɛ, “Amɛbaanyɛ amɛsaa tsui lɛ amɛmamɔ nɛ, shi mi hu makumɔ tsui lɛ mashwie shi kɛyaashi mɛi aaatsɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Maŋ gbonyo ni Yehowa mli efu amɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ nɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Israel, when you see this, you will shout, “The Lord's great reputation reaches beyond our borders.” Judgment against Priests
translation_verse: Nyɛbaana nɔ ni baaba lɛ kɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhiŋmɛii; ni nyɛbaakɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa da kɛteke Israel kɛ ehusui fɛɛ.” Yehowa kã osɔfoi lɛ ahiɛ

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something to say to you priests. Children respect their fathers, and servants respect their masters. I am your father and your master, so why don't you respect me? You priests have insulted me, and now you ask, “How did we insult you?”
translation_verse: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, miikɛɛ osɔfoi lɛ akɛ, “Bi woɔ etsɛ, ni tsulɔ woɔ enuŋtsɔ. Kolɛ, kɛji tsɛ ji mi lɛ, nɛgbɛ miwoo lɛ yɔɔ? Ni kɛji nuŋtsɔ hu ji mi lɛ, nɛgbɛ gbeyei ni nyɛsheɔ mi yɔɔ? Nyɛgbeɔ migbɛi lɛ he guɔ; shi nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛni wɔfeɔ kɛgbeɔ ogbɛi lɛ he guɔ lɛ?’

english_verse: You embarrass me by offering worthless food on my altar. Then you ask, “How have we embarrassed you?” You have done it by saying, “What's so great about the Lord's altar?”
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ aboloo ni abule bashãa afɔle yɛ mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Agbɛnɛ hu nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛni wɔfeɔ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ wɔhiɛ esɔɔɔ bo?’ Nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji akɛ, ‘Nyɛnifeemɔ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nyɛbuuu mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ.’

english_verse: But isn't it wrong to offer animals that are blind, lame, or sick? Just try giving those animals to your governor. That certainly wouldn't please him or make him want to help you.
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛkɛ kooloi shwilafoi bashã afɔle lɛ aso ejeee nɔ fɔŋ lo? Ni kɛji nyɛkɛ kooloo akpaketsɛ loo helatsɛ bashã afɔle lɛ, no hu ejeee nɔ fɔŋ lo? Kɛji omɔ nakai kooloo okɛyake amralo lɛ, ani eeena ohe tsuijurɔ, aloo eeekwɛ ohiɛ?”

english_verse: I am the Lord God All-Powerful, and you had better try to please me. You have sinned. Now see if I will have mercy on any of you.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, osɔfoi, agbɛnɛ nyɛkpaa Naa Nyɔŋmɔ fai koni eduro wɔ. Ani nɛkɛ nikeenii ni jɛ nyɛdɛŋ nɛɛ baahã ekwɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ ko hiɛ?

english_verse: I wish someone would lock the doors of my temple, so you would stop wasting time building fires on my altar. I am not pleased with you priests, and I refuse to accept any more of your offerings.
translation_verse: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Mina ni kulɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ ko ŋamɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shinai lɛ koni nyɛkayashɛre la yakatswaa yɛ mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ. Minaaa nyɛhe miishɛɛ, ni mimɔŋ nikeenii ni nyɛkɛbahãa mi lɛ hu mli.

english_verse: From dawn until dusk my name is praised by every nation on this earth, as they burn incense and offer the proper sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Kɛjɛ hulu shitee mli aahu kɛyashi eshinyɔɔ mli lɛ, mɛi miikafo mi yɛ jeŋ majimaji amli. Ni aashãshãa tsofakɛŋma aahã mi, ni akɛ nibii ni ahe tsetsee miishãshãa afɔle miihã mi, ejaakɛ migbɛi ehehe yɛ jeŋ majimaji lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: But even you priests insult me by saying, “There's nothing special about the Lord's altar, and these sacrifices are worthless.”
translation_verse: Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛbuleɔ mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛji nyɛkɛɛ akɛ abule Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ momo, ni no hewɔ ni nyɛkɛ niyenii ni nyɛnyaŋeɔ baa bashãa afɔle yɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You get so disgusted that you even make vulgar signs at me. And for an offering, you bring stolen animals or those that are lame or sick. Should I accept these?
translation_verse: Nɔ ni nyɛkɛɔ ji, ‘Mɛɛ tɔlɛ po ji enɛ, ni nyɛshoɔ nyɛgugɔŋ nyɛwoɔ mi.’ Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, ‘Mɔ ko nii ni ayashɔ̃ akranaŋ naa, loo kooloo akpaketsɛ loo helatsɛ nyɛkɛbahãa akɛ nyɛfɔle. Aso nyɛsusuɔ akɛ mamɔ nɛkɛ afɔle mli kɛ miishɛɛ lo?

english_verse: Instead of offering the acceptable animals you have promised, you bring me those that are unhealthy. I will punish you for this, because I am the great King, the Lord All-Powerful, and I am worshiped by nations everywhere.
translation_verse: Alomɔ shishiulɔ ni yɔɔ too nuu yɛ etoo ku mli, shi kɛji ewo shi lɛ, ekɛ kooloo ni kpa yɔɔ ehe moŋ bashãa afɔle ehãa Yehowa lɛ, ejaakɛ Maŋtsɛ kpeteŋkple ji mi,’ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ, ‘Ni jeŋ majimaji anɔ bii fɛɛ sheɔ mi gbeyei.’ ”

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something else to say to you priests.
translation_verse: “Agbɛnɛ nyɛ, osɔfoi, kitã ni miwoɔ nyɛ nɛ.

english_verse: You had better take seriously the need to honor my name. Otherwise, when you give a blessing, I will turn it into a curse. In fact, I have already done this, because you haven't taken to heart your duties as priests.
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛbooo wiemɔ nɛɛ toi ni nyɛkɛaato nyɛtsui mli, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛkɛ nyɛjeŋba awo migbɛi hiɛ nyam lɛ, no lɛ mibalomɔ nyɛ; mibalomɔ nibii ni ahãa nyɛ ni nyɛkɛkwɛɔ nyɛhe lɛ fɛɛ. Anɔkwale mli lɛ, milomɔ nibii nɛɛ momo ejaakɛ nyɛbuuu mikitã lɛ.

english_verse: I will punish your descendants and rub your faces in the manure from your animal sacrifices, and then be done with you.
translation_verse: Naa, mibakã nyɛshwiei ahiɛ, ni mikɛ nyɛfɔleshãa kooloi lɛ awamɔ lɛ aaakpa nyɛhiɛ; ni aaaloo nyɛ kɛ wamɔ lɛ fɛɛ ayashwie tumo nɔ.

english_verse: I blessed him with a full life, as I had promised, and he kept his part of the agreement by honoring me and respecting my name.
translation_verse: “Mi kɛ amɛ kpãŋmɔ mli lɛ, miwo shi akɛ madro amɛ wala kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ, ni mifee hu, bɔ ni afee ni amɛshe mi gbeyei, ni amɛhiɛ hu asɔ migbɛi lɛ.

english_verse: He taught the truth and never told lies, and he led a lot of people to turn from sin, because he obeyed me and lived right.
translation_verse: Amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi nii ni ja, shi jeee nii ni ejaaa; ni amɛkɛ mi hi shi yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ kɛ jalɛ mli. Amɛfee nii ni ja, ni amɛkpale mɛi babaoo kɛje nɔsha he.

english_verse: You priests should be eager to spread knowledge, and everyone should come to you for instruction, because you speak for me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ osɔfoi agbɛnaa nitsumɔ ji akɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi Nyɔŋmɔ he nilee krɔŋŋ lɛ. Amɛ amɛŋɔɔ esa akɛ mɛi aya koni amɛyakase mla lɛ he nii, ejaakɛ amɛ ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, bɔfoi lɛ.

english_verse: But you have turned your backs on me. Your teachings have led others to do sinful things, and you have broken the agreement I made with your ancestor Levi.
translation_verse: “Shi nyɛ, osɔfoi lɛ, nyɛgba afã kɛje gbɛ ni ja lɛ nɔ. Nyɛkɛ nyɛnitsɔ̃ɔmɔ ehã mɛi babaoo etɔ̃ mimlai lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛku mi kɛ nyɛ, Levi shwiei ateŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli.” Yehowa kɛɛ.

english_verse: So I caused everyone to hate and despise you, because you disobeyed me and failed to treat all people alike. A Broken Agreement
translation_verse: “No hewɔ lɛ, bei abɔ ni nyɛyeee mimlai lɛ anɔ, shi moŋ nyɛkwɛɔ mɛi ahiɛiaŋ yɛ nyɛnifeemɔ mli lɛ, mibahã nyɛhe guɔ agbo yɛ Israelbii fɛɛ ahiɛ.” Anɔkwa ni maŋbii yeee Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ

english_verse: Don't you know that we all have God as our Father? Didn't the one God create each of us? Then why do you cheat each other by breaking the agreement God made with your ancestors?
translation_verse: Ani jeee tsɛ kome wɔ fɛɛ wɔyɔɔ lo? Aso jeee Nyɔŋmɔ kome ni bɔ wɔ lo? Mɛni hewɔ mɔ ni wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yeee enyɛmi anɔkwa, ni wɔyeee kpãŋmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ?

english_verse: You people in Judah and Jerusalem have been unfaithful to the Lord. You have disgraced the temple that he loves, and you have committed the disgusting sin of marrying the worshipers of other gods.
translation_verse: Yuda yeee Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa, ni musubɔɔ nibii sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ afeɔ yɛ Israel kɛ Yerusalɛm. Yuda ebule Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni esumɔɔ lɛ. Yudahii lɛ eyaŋɔŋɔɔ ŋamɛi ni jaa maŋsɛɛ wɔji.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will no longer let those who are guilty belong to his people, even if they eagerly decide to offer the Lord a gift.
translation_verse: Yehowa aaaplene nuu fɛɛ nuu ni feɔ nɛkɛ nɔ ko yɛ Israelbii ateŋ, koni ekahã ena hegbɛ efata he dɔŋŋ kɛshã afɔlei ni maŋbii lɛ shãa hãa Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, lɛ.

english_verse: And what else are you doing? You cry noisily and flood the Lord's altar with your tears, because he isn't pleased with your offerings and refuses to accept them.
translation_verse: Asaŋ nɔ ni ji enyɔ hu ni nyɛfeɔ nɛ. Nyɛwoɔ yara ni nyɛdɔmɔɔ ŋtsɔi, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛyaafonu fɔɔ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛfɔleshãa nibii lɛ esaaa Yehowa hiɛ dɔŋŋ aahu po ni eeemɔ mli kɛ tsuijurɔ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ.

english_verse: And why isn't God pleased? It's because he knows that each of you men has been unfaithful to the wife you married when you were young. You promised that she would be your partner, but now you have broken that promise.
translation_verse: Nyɛbiɔ nɔ hewɔ ni nibii baa lɛ nakai akɛ Yehowa mɔɔɔ nikeenii lɛ amli lɛ. Ejaakɛ be ni okɛ oblahiiaŋ ŋa lɛ kpãŋɔ lɛ, Yehowa ji nyɛdasefonyo. Owo oŋa lɛ shi akɛ obaaye lɛ anɔkwa, shi onyɛɛɛ lɛ anɔkwa lɛ oye; tsɛbelɛ lɛ ji onaanyo kɛ oŋa fɛɛ yɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ naa.

english_verse: Didn't God create you and your wife to become like one person? And why did he do this? It was so you would have children, and then lead them to become God's people. Don't ever be unfaithful to your wife.
translation_verse: Aso jeee Nyɔŋmɔ kome lɛ ji mɔ ni bɔ wala, asaŋ ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ebaa wala mumɔ lɛ yi ehã wɔ lɛ lo? Ni mɛni etaoɔ yɛ wɔdɛŋ mɔ? Eekwɛ gbɛ akɛ nyɛbaafɔ bii ni baatsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ webii anɔkwale mli. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni ahia koni shi ni nyɛwo nyɛblahiiaŋ ŋamɛi lɛ nyɛkaku mli kɛtsɔ̃ anɔkwa ni nyɛyeee nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful of Israel hates anyone who is cruel enough to divorce his wife. So take care never to be unfaithful!
translation_verse: Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ ji akɛ, “Miihi mligbalamɔ. Miihi kɛji nyɛteŋ mɔ ko ye eŋa nɛkɛ sane. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni ahia, koni shi ni nyɛwo lɛ nyɛkakwaa.” Kojomɔ gbi lɛ ebɛŋkɛ

english_verse: You have worn out the Lord with your words. And yet, you ask, “How did we do that?” You did it by saying, “The Lord is pleased with evil and doesn't care about justice.”
translation_verse: “Nyɛhã etɔ Yehowa kɛ nyɛwiemɔi lɛ.” Shi nyɛbiɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛni wɔkɛhã etɔ lɛ?’ Ejɛ ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ efɔŋ lɛ, ehi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni Yehowa yɛ mɔ lɛ he tsuijurɔ, ni esumɔɔ lɛ lɛ.’ Ni nyɛbiɔ hu akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni yeɔ jalɛ sane lɛ yɔɔ?”

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will send my messenger to prepare the way for me. Then suddenly the Lord you are looking for will appear in his temple. The messenger you desire is coming with my promise, and he is on his way. A Day of Change
translation_verse: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, miitsu mibɔfo lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ mihiɛ koni ebasaa gbɛ lɛ eto mi. Kɛkɛ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ lɛ lɛ baaba Sɔlemɔ we lɛ trukaa. Kpãŋmɔ Bɔfo lɛ ni nyɛshwe lɛ aahu lɛ aaashɛ shi.”

english_verse: On the day the Lord comes, he will be like a furnace that purifies silver or like strong soap in a washbasin. No one will be able to stand up to him.
translation_verse: Shi namɔ baanyɛ ekpee ebaa lɛ naa? Ni namɔ aaanyɛ shi adamɔ be ni eeebapue lɛ? Ejaakɛ etamɔ niiahetsuulɔ la loo niiahefɔlɔ samla.

english_verse: The Lord will purify the descendants of Levi, as though they were gold or silver. Then they will bring the proper offerings to the Lord,
translation_verse: Ebaata shi tamɔ jwiɛtɛi hetsuulɔ ni hãa jwiɛtɛi he tseɔ keŋkeŋ lɛ. Nakai ebaatsuu osɔfoi ni ji Levi shwiei lɛ ahe keŋkeŋ tamɔ atsuɔ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi he lɛ. Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaanyɛ amɛkɛ afɔleshãa nikeenii ni kpa bɛ he aba abahã Yehowa.

english_verse: and the offerings of the people of Judah and Jerusalem will please him, just as they did in the past. Don't Cheat God
translation_verse: No dani Yudabii kɛ Yerusalɛmbii anikeenii ni amɛkɛbaahã Yehowa baasa ehiɛ tamɔ esa ehiɛ blema yɛ tsutsu afii lɛ amli lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: I'm now on my way to judge you. And I will quickly condemn all who practice witchcraft or cheat in marriage or tell lies in court or rob workers of their pay or mistreat widows and orphans or steal the property of foreigners or refuse to respect me.
translation_verse: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, “Mibatsi mabɛŋkɛ nyɛ koni makojo gbɔmɛi abii; mikɛ sane baashi mɛi ni sheee mi gbeyei lɛ oya nɔŋŋ, ŋkunyaayelɔi kɛ gbãlãfitelɔi kɛ mɛi ni kãmɔɔ amale kitã lɛ. Nakai nɔŋŋ maye odase mashi mɛi ni shishiuɔ apaafoi yɛ nyɔmɔwoo mli kɛ mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ yoo okulafo kɛ awusa kɛ gbɔ sane hiɛ buɔ shi lɛ.”

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I never change. That's why you haven't been wiped out,
translation_verse: “Yehowa ji mi, mitsakeee; ni no hewɔ ni nyɛ, Yakob shwiei, nyɛpleneko kɛbashi benɛ nɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: even though you have ignored and disobeyed my laws ever since the time of your ancestors. But if you return to me, I will return to you. And yet you ask, “How can we return?”
translation_verse: Nyɛgba afã yɛ mikpɔi lɛ agbɛfaŋ, tamɔ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ hu fee kɛjɛ blema lɛ, ni nyɛyeee amɛnɔ. Nyɛkpalea kɛbaa miŋɔɔ, ni mi hu mibakpale kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ.” Yehowa kɛɛ. “Shi nyɛbiɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛɛ gbɛ nɔ wɔɔtsɔ̃ wɔkpale?’

english_verse: You people are robbing me, your God. And, here you are, asking, “How are we robbing you?” You are robbing me of the offerings and of the ten percent that belongs to me.
translation_verse: Shi nɔ ni mibiɔ nyɛ ji akɛ, aso eja gbɛ akɛ gbɔmɔ adesa ashishiu Nyɔŋmɔ lo? Dabida! Shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛmiishishiu mi. Nyɛaabi akɛ, ‘Yɛ mɛni mli?’ Yɛ nibii amlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ kɛ afɔlei ni nyɛkɛbahãa lɛ mli.

english_verse: That's why your whole nation is under a curse.
translation_verse: Naa, nyɛmiilomɔ nyɛhe, ejaakɛ nyɛ maŋtso muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛmiishishiu mi.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I challenge you to put me to the test. Bring the entire ten percent into the storehouse, so there will be food in my house. Then I will open the windows of heaven and flood you with blessing after blessing.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ fɛɛ abaa nitoohe lɛ koni niyenii ahi miwe lɛ! Nyɛkɛ enɛ akaa mi nyɛkwɛa akɛ migbeleŋ ŋwɛi samfɛji lɛ, ni mifɔseŋ jɔɔmɔ mishwieŋ nyɛnɔ ni ateke nɔ lo?

english_verse: I will also stop locusts from destroying your crops and keeping your vineyards from producing.
translation_verse: Nyɛhewɔ lɛ mibatsi baalabii ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ lɛ anaa mahã nyɛ koni amɛkafite nyɛŋmɔshi nibii; ni nyɛwain tsei ni yɔɔ ŋa nɔ lɛ baawo babaoo.

english_verse: Everyone of every nation will talk about how I have blessed you and about your wonderful land. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ je lɛ mli majimaji fɛɛ baabu nyɛ akɛ mɛi ni ajɔɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛbaatsɔ̃ maŋ ni mii eshɛ ehe.” Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ Musuŋ baatsɔ̃ lɛ

english_verse: You have said horrible things about me, and yet you ask, “What have we said?”
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛwie wiemɔi ni naa wa yɛ mihe. Shi nyɛbiɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛni mli wɔwieɔ wɔshiɔ bo yɛ?’

english_verse: Here is what you have said: “It's foolish to serve the Lord God All-Powerful. What do we get for obeying God and from going around looking sad?
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Sɛɛnamɔ bɛ he akɛ asɔmɔ Nyɔŋmɔ. Kɛji wɔye egbee nɔ, aloo wɔnyiɛ mɔbɔmɔbɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kwraa po tamɔ mɛi ni agbo yɛ amɛnɔ lɛ, mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ mli?

english_verse: See how happy those arrogant people are. Everyone who does wrong is successful, and when they put God to the test, they always get away with it.” Faithfulness Is Rewarded
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ bɔ ni wɔnaa jeŋ moŋ ji akɛ mɛi ni woɔ amɛhe lɛ, amɛ ji mɛi ni yɔɔ miishɛɛ. Ni jeee shweremɔ kɛkɛ mɛi ni feɔ nifɔɔjianii shwereɔ, shi moŋ amɛkɛ amɛnifɔɔji lɛ kaa Nyɔŋmɔ amɛkwɛɔ, ni amɛjeɔ toigbalamɔ mli sɔkee.’ ”

english_verse: All those who truly respected the Lord and honored his name started discussing these things, and when God saw what was happening, he had their names written as a reminder in his book.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ kɛ amɛhe wie. Yehowa bo amɛ toi, ni enu nɔ ni amɛtao. Mɛi fɛɛ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei, ni asaŋ amɛjwɛŋɔ egbɛi lɛ hiɛnyamwoo he lɛ aŋmala amɛgbɛii awo wolo mli koni akɛkai amɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord All-Powerful said: You people are precious to me, and when I come to bring justice, I will protect you, just as parents protect an obedient child.
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ mimɛi, mi diɛŋtsɛ minɔ krɛdɛɛ, gbi nɔ ni mibatsu minii lɛ. Mikɛ amɛhe baake amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni tsɛ Ataa kɛ ebi ni sɔmɔɔ lɛ lɛ he keɔ lɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Then everyone will once again see the difference between those who obey me by doing right and those who reject me by doing wrong.
translation_verse: No dani nyɛbaana ekoŋŋ nɔ srɔto ni yɔɔ jalɔ kɛ efɔŋfeelɔ teŋ, kɛ srɔto ni yɔɔ mɔ ni sɔ̃mɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mɔ ni sɔ̃mɔɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ.”

english_verse: The day of judgment is certain to come. And it will be like a red-hot furnace with flames that burn up proud and sinful people, as though they were straw. Not a branch or a root will be left. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, gbi ko miiba; ni emli edɔ la tamɔ flɔnɔɔ. Eshishɛɛ lɛ gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji fɛɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ abele gbetselii; ebaashã amɛ bɔ ni eshwɛŋ eko eko shishifã loo tso nine.

english_verse: But for you that honor my name, victory will shine like the sun with healing in its rays, and you will jump around like calves at play.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni sheɔ mi gbeyei lɛ, mihewalɛ lɛ baate shi tamɔ jalɛ hulu ahã nyɛ, ni eeetsa nyɛ. Nyɛaaje kpo kɛ nyamɔ kɛ tuumɔ tamɔ tsinabii ni agbele amɛ.

english_verse: When I come to bring justice, you will trample those who are evil, as though they were ashes under your feet. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Gbi nɔ ni mibatsu minii nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛbaanaanaa mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ yɛ nyɛnajiashi ejaakɛ amɛtsɔ̃mɔ lamlu.” Yehowa kɛɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to send the prophet Elijah before that great and terrible day comes.
translation_verse: “Shi dani nakai Yehowa gbi wulu ni yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ baashɛ lɛ, mibatsu Gbalɔ Elia kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ.

english_verse: He will lead children and parents to love each other more, so that when I come, I won't bring destruction to the land.
translation_verse: Ebaahã tsɛmɛi asumɔ amɛbii ekoŋŋ, ni bii hu aaasumɔ amɛtsɛmɛi ekoŋŋ, koni mikaba mibakpãtã shikpɔŋ muu lɛ hiɛ.”

english_verse: “A virgin will have a baby boy, and he will be called Immanuel,” which means “God is with us.”
translation_verse: “Naa, oblayoo foro lɛ aaana musu, Ni eeefɔ binuu, ni amɛaawo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Imanuel, eshishi ji Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔ yɛ.”

english_verse: more to the birth of the Messiah. The Birth of Jesus (Luke
translation_verse: Azor fɔ Sadok, Sadok fɔ Akim, ni Akim fɔ Eliud;

english_verse: This is how Jesus Christ was born. A young woman named Mary was engaged to Joseph from King David's family. But before they were married, she learned that she was going to have a baby by God's Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ bɔ ni Yesu Kristo fɔmɔ lɛ yɔɔ nɛ. Enyɛ Maria lɛ, be ni Yosef etsɛ ehe baa ni amɛnako amɛhi shi lɛ, ana akɛ ehiɛ musu kɛjɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: Joseph was a good man and did not want to embarrass Mary in front of everyone. So he decided to quietly call off the wedding.
translation_verse: Shi Yosef, ewu lɛ, akɛni jalɔ ji lɛ ni etaooo akɛ ebɔ lɛ ahora lɛ eto eyiŋ akɛ eeeŋmɛɛ ehe kpoo.

english_verse: While Joseph was thinking about this, an angel from the Lord appeared to him in a dream. The angel said, “Joseph, the baby that Mary will have is from the Holy Spirit. Go ahead and marry her.
translation_verse: Shi be ni ejwɛŋɔ nii nɛɛ ahe lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ wɔlamɔ mli, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yosef, David bi, kaashe oŋa Maria lɛ ŋɔɔ gbeyei, shi musu ni ehiɛ nɛɛ ejɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli,

english_verse: Then after her baby is born, name him Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.”
translation_verse: ebaafɔ binuu, ni ooowo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yesu, ejaakɛ lɛ ebaahere emaŋ lɛ yiwala kɛjɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ amli.”

english_verse: So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said,
translation_verse: Shi enɛ fɛɛ ba, koni nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wie yɛ gbalɔ lɛ naa lɛ aba mli akɛ,

english_verse: After Joseph woke up, he and Mary were soon married, just as the Lord's angel had told him to do.
translation_verse: Ni be ni Yosef te shi kɛjɛ wɔ lɛ mli lɛ, efee bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ lɛ, ni eŋɔ eŋa lɛ;

english_verse: But they did not sleep together before her baby was born. Then Joseph named him Jesus.
translation_verse: shi eleee lɛ aahu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni efɔ binuu. Ni Yosef wo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yesu.

english_verse: When Jesus was born in the village of Bethlehem in Judea, Herod was king. During this time some wise men from the east came to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Be ni afɔ Yesu yɛ Betlehem yɛ Yudea, yɛ Maŋtsɛ Herode yinɔ lɛ, nilelɔi jɛ bokã ba Yerusalɛm babi akɛ,

english_verse: and said, “Where is the child born to be king of the Jews? We saw his star in the east and have come to worship him.”
translation_verse: “Nɛgbɛ Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ ni afɔ lɛ yɔɔ? Wɔna eŋulami lɛ yɛ bokã ni wɔba ni wɔbaja lɛ.”

english_verse: When King Herod heard about this, he was worried, and so was everyone else in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Shi be ni Maŋtsɛ Herode nu enɛ lɛ, ekɛ Yerusalɛm fɛɛ yoyoro;

english_verse: Herod brought together the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses and asked them, “Where will the Messiah be born?”
translation_verse: ni ebua maŋ lɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa, ni ebi amɛ he ni aaafɔ Kristo lɛ yɛ.

english_verse: They told him, “He will be born in Bethlehem, just as the prophet wrote,
translation_verse: Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yɛ Betlehem yɛ Yudea; shi bɔ ni gbalɔ lɛ ŋma nɛ,

english_verse: ‘Bethlehem in the land of Judea, you are very important among the towns of Judea. From your town will come a leader, who will be like a shepherd for my people Israel.’ ”
translation_verse: ‘Ni bo, Betlehem ni oyɔɔ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, jeee bo ji bibioo fe fɛɛ yɛ Yuda lumɛi lɛ ateŋ kwraa, shi omli lumɔ ni aaakwɛ mimaŋ Israel lɛ aaajɛ!’ ”

english_verse: Herod secretly called in the wise men and asked them when they had first seen the star.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Herode tsɛ nilelɔi lɛ nigii, ni ebi amɛ fitsofitso beyinɔ ni ŋulami lɛ pue.

english_verse: He told them, “Go to Bethlehem and search carefully for the child. As soon as you find him, let me know. I also want to go and worship him.”
translation_verse: Ni ehã amɛtee Betlehem ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyataoa abifao lɛ fitsofitso; ni kɛ nyɛna lɛ lɛ, nyɛbakɛa mi, koni mi hu maya ni mayaja lɛ.”

english_verse: The wise men listened to what the king said and then left. And the star they had seen in the east went on ahead of them until it stopped over the place where the child was.
translation_verse: Be ni amɛnu maŋtsɛ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ, amɛyiŋ amɛtee. Ni ŋulami lɛ ni amɛna yɛ bokã lɛ nyiɛ amɛhiɛ aahu, kɛyashi ebadamɔ he ni abifao lɛ yɔɔ lɛ yiteŋ.

english_verse: They were thrilled and excited to see the star.
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛna ŋulami lɛ, amɛna miishɛɛ babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.

english_verse: When the men went into the house and saw the child with Mary, his mother, they knelt down and worshiped him. They took out their gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh and gave them to him.
translation_verse: Ni amɛtee shĩa lɛ, ni amɛna abifao lɛ kɛ enyɛ Maria lɛ; ni amɛkula shi amɛja lɛ. Amɛfɛne amɛkotokui anaa, ni amɛkekee lɛ nii: shika kɛ krɔbɔo kɛ mire.

english_verse: Later they were warned in a dream not to return to Herod, and they went back home by another road. The Escape to Egypt
translation_verse: Ni akɛni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ yɛ wɔlamɔ mli akɛ amɛkaku amɛsɛɛ amɛtee Herode ŋɔɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ gbɛ kroko nɔ kɛtee amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ. Foijee kɛ Ijipt yaa

english_verse: After the wise men had gone, an angel from the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, “Get up! Hurry and take the child and his mother to Egypt! Stay there until I tell you to return, because Herod is looking for the child and wants to kill him.”
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛtee lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Yosef yɛ wɔlamɔ mli ni ekɛɛ, “Tee shi; ŋɔɔ abifao lɛ kɛ enyɛ lɛ, ni ojo foi oya Ijipt, ni ohi jɛi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni makɛɛ bo nɔ ko; shi Herode baatao abifao lɛ ni egbe lɛ,”

english_verse: That night, Joseph got up and took his wife and the child to Egypt,
translation_verse: Ni ete shi eŋɔ abifao lɛ kɛ enyɛ lɛ nyɔɔŋ, ni eyiŋ etee Ijipt.

english_verse: where they stayed until Herod died. So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said, “I called my son out of Egypt.” The Killing of the Children
translation_verse: Ni ehi shi yɛ jɛi kɛyashi Herode gbo; koni nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wie yɛ gbalɔ lɛ naa lɛ aba mli akɛ, “Ijipt mitsɛ mibi lɛ kɛjɛ.” Betlehem abifabii lɛ ahiɛkpãtãmɔ

english_verse: When Herod found out that the wise men from the east had tricked him, he was very angry. He gave orders for his men to kill all the boys who lived in or near Bethlehem and were two years old and younger. This was based on what he had learned from the wise men.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ be ni Herode na akɛ nilelɔi lɛ yeee lɛ anɔkwa lɛ, emli fu waa, ni etsu ayagbe gbekɛbii hii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Betlehem kɛ jɛi niiaŋ fɛɛ, mɛi ni eye afii enyɔ kɛ mɛi ni yeko nakai lɛ, kɛji abu kɛjɛ be ni ebi nilelɔi lɛ sane lɛ fitsofitso lɛ.

english_verse: So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet Jeremiah had said,
translation_verse: No ni nɔ ni gbalɔ Yeremia kɛɛ lɛ ba mli akɛ,

english_verse: “In Ramah a voice was heard crying and weeping loudly. Rachel was mourning for her children, and she refused to be comforted, because they were dead.” The Return from Egypt
translation_verse: “Anu gbee ko yɛ Rama, yaafo kɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli babaoo; Rahel miifo ebii, ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ miishɛjemɔ, ejaakɛ amɛbɛ.” Sɛɛkuu kɛ Ijipt jɛɛ

english_verse: After King Herod died, an angel from the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph while he was still in Egypt.
translation_verse: Shi be ni Herode egbo lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Yosef yɛ wɔlamɔ mli yɛ Ijipt,

english_verse: The angel said, “Get up and take the child and his mother back to Israel. The people who wanted to kill him are now dead.”
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ, “Tee shi ni oŋɔ abifao lɛ kɛ enyɛ lɛ ni oya Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; shi mɛi ni taoɔ abifao lɛ amɛgbe lɛ amɛgboi.”

english_verse: Joseph got up and left with them for Israel.
translation_verse: Ni Yosef te shi ni eŋɔ abifao lɛ kɛ enyɛ lɛ, ni eba Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: But when he heard that Herod's son Archelaus was now ruler of Judea, he was afraid to go there. Then in a dream he was told to go to Galilee,
translation_verse: Shi be ni enu akɛ Arkelao miiye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yudea yɛ etsɛ Herode sɛɛ lɛ, eshe jɛiyaa gbeyei; ni akɛni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ wɔlamɔ mli lɛ, edɔ eyi kɛtee Galilea niiaŋ.

english_verse: and they went to live there in the town of Nazareth. So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said, “He will be called a Nazarene.”
translation_verse: Ni eba ebahi maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Nazaret lɛ mli, koni nɔ ni gbalɔi lɛ wie lɛ aba mli akɛ, “Aaatsɛ lɛ Nazarenyo.”

english_verse: Do something to show you have really given up your sins.
translation_verse: Belɛ nyɛwoa yibii ni sa tsuitsakemɔ mɔ!

english_verse: He said, “Turn back to God! The kingdom of heaven will soon be here.”
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui; shi ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ebɛŋkɛ.”

english_verse: John wore clothes made of camel's hair. He had a leather strap around his waist and ate grasshoppers and wild honey.
translation_verse: Shi lɛ Yohane lɛ, yooma hetsɔi akɛlo etade, ni wolo kpãa fĩ emliteŋ, ni eniyenii ji baalabii kɛ ŋa nɔ wo.

english_verse: From Jerusalem and all Judea and from the Jordan River Valley crowds of people went to John.
translation_verse: Ni mɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm kɛ Yudea fɛɛ kɛ Yordan niiaŋ fɛɛ ba eŋɔɔ;

english_verse: They told how sorry they were for their sins, and he baptized them in the river.
translation_verse: ni ebaptisi amɛ yɛ Yordan faa lɛ mli, be ni amɛjajeɔ emɛhe eshai lɛ.

english_verse: Many Pharisees and Sadducees also came to be baptized. But John said to them: You bunch of snakes! Who warned you to run from the coming judgment?
translation_verse: Shi be ni ena Farisifoi kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii baa ebaptisimɔ lɛ he lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ “Shinɔi ashwiei, namɔ tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ nyɛjo mlifu ni baaba lɛ naa foi?

english_verse: An ax is ready to cut the trees down at their roots. Any tree that doesn't produce good fruit will be chopped down and thrown into a fire.
translation_verse: Shi lema lɛ kã tsei lɛ ashishifã lɛ nɔ momo; hewɔ lɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni wooo yibii kpakpai lɛ atoɔ afɔɔ shi, ni ashɛɔ afɔɔ la mli.

english_verse: His threshing fork is in his hand, and he is ready to separate the wheat from the husks. He will store the wheat in a barn and burn the husks in a fire that never goes out. The Baptism of Jesus (Mark
translation_verse: Ehiɛ eshaatsene yɛ edɛŋ, ni ebaabɛɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ fitsofitso, ni ebaabua eŋmaa lɛ naa eto eboŋo mli; shi tutuu lɛ, ekɛ la ni gbooo baashã.” Yesu baptisimɔ (Marko

english_verse: Jesus left Galilee and went to the Jordan River to be baptized by John.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yesu jɛ Galilea eba Yohane ŋɔɔ yɛ Yordan naa, koni ebaptisi lɛ.

english_verse: But John kept objecting and said, “I ought to be baptized by you. Why have you come to me?”
translation_verse: Shi Yohane tsi lɛ gbɛ ekɛɛ, “Mi moŋ ni ehia mi akɛ bo obaptisiɔ mi lɛ, ni bo obaa miŋɔɔ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “For now this is how it should be, because we must do all God wants us to do.” Then John agreed.
translation_verse: Shi Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kpɛlɛ̃mɔ kɛkɛ, ejaakɛ nɛkɛ sa akɛ wɔgbeɔ jalɛ fɛɛ naa.” Kɛkɛ ni ekpɛlɛ̃.

english_verse: So Jesus was baptized. And as soon as he came out of the water, the sky opened, and he saw the Spirit of God coming down on him like a dove.
translation_verse: Ni be ni abaptisi Yesu lɛ, ejɛ nu lɛ mli amrɔ eje kpo; ni naa, agbele ŋwɛi naa ahã lɛ, ni ena Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ miikpeleke shi tamɔ okpo kɛmiiba enɔ.

english_verse: Then a voice from heaven said, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: Ni naa, gbee ko jɛ ŋwɛi kɛɛ, “Mɔ nɛ ji misuɔmɔ Bi ni mina ehe tsui lɛ.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he went to Galilee.
translation_verse: Shi be ni Yesu nu akɛ amɔ Yohane lɛ, eyiŋ etee Galilea.

english_verse: But instead of staying in Nazareth, Jesus moved to Capernaum. This town was beside Lake Galilee in the territory of Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Ehiii shi yɛ Nazaret shi moŋ ebahi Kapernaum maŋ ko ni kã ŋshɔ naa, yɛ Zebulon kɛ Naftali niiaŋ,

english_verse: Then the devil came to him and said, “If you are God's Son, tell these stones to turn into bread.”
translation_verse: Ni abonsam lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji bo lɛ, fã koni tɛi nɛɛ atsɔ̃mɔ aboloo.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “The Scriptures also say, ‘Don't try to test the Lord your God!’ ”
translation_verse: Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Aŋma ekoŋŋ akɛ, ‘Kaaka Nuŋtsɔ, bo Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Finally, the devil took Jesus up on a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms on earth and their power.
translation_verse: Asaŋ abonsam lɛ ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee gɔŋ ni kwɔ somromoo ko nɔ, ni ekɛ jeŋ maŋtsɛyelii fɛɛ kɛ amɛnunyam lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ;

english_verse: The devil said to him, “I will give all this to you, if you will bow down and worship me.”
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mikɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ baahã bo, kɛji okula shi oja mi lɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Go away Satan! The Scriptures say: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve only him.’ ”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Jee mihiɛ, Satan! Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ oja, ni lɛ kɛkɛ osɔ̃mɔ!’ ”

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet Isaiah had said,
translation_verse: koni gbalɔ Yesaia wiemɔ lɛ aba mli akɛ,

english_verse: “Listen, lands of Zebulun and Naphtali, lands along the road to the sea and across the Jordan. Listen Galilee, land of the Gentiles!
translation_verse: “Zebulon shikpɔŋ kɛ Naftali shikpɔŋ, Ŋshɔnaagbɛ lɛ, yɛ Yordan sɛɛ lɛ, Galilea, jeŋmaji ashikpɔŋ lɛ,

english_verse: Right then the two brothers dropped their nets and went with him.
translation_verse: Ni amrɔ lɛ amɛshi amɛyai lɛ, ni amɛbanyiɛ esɛɛ.

english_verse: While Jesus was walking along the shore of Lake Galilee, he saw two brothers. One was Simon, also known as Peter, and the other was Andrew. They were fishermen, and they were casting their net into the lake.
translation_verse: Be ni Yesu kpaa shi yɛ Galilea Ŋshɔ lɛ naa lɛ, ena nyɛmimɛi enyɔ, Simon ni atsɛɔ lɛ Petro, kɛ enyɛmi Andrea, ni amɛmiihɛ yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ejaakɛ wolɛi ji amɛ.

english_verse: Jesus walked on until he saw James and John, the sons of Zebedee. They were in a boat with their father, mending their nets. Jesus asked them to come with him.
translation_verse: Ni be ni eje jɛi eyaa lɛ, ena nyɛmimɛi krokomɛi enyɔ, Zebedeo bi Yakobo kɛ enyɛmi Yohane, ni amɛkɛ amɛtsɛ Zebedeo yɛ lɛlɛ mli amɛmiikpɛ amɛyai lɛ; ni etsɛ amɛ.

english_verse: At once they left the boat and their father and went with Jesus. Jesus Teaches, Preaches, and Heals (Luke
translation_verse: Ni amrɔ lɛ amɛshi lɛlɛ lɛ kɛ amɛtsɛ lɛ ni amɛbanyiɛ esɛɛ. Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ nii, eshiɛ ni etsa helai

english_verse: Jesus went all over Galilee, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the good news about God's kingdom. He also healed every kind of disease and sickness.
translation_verse: Ni Yesu kpa Galilea muu lɛ fɛɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ amɛkpeehei lɛ, ni eshiɛɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ, ni etsaa hela fɛɛ hela kɛ hejaramɔ fɛɛ hejaramɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: News about him spread all over Syria, and people with every kind of sickness or disease were brought to him. Some of them had a lot of demons in them, others were thought to be crazy, and still others could not walk. But Jesus healed them all.
translation_verse: Ni ehe sane gbɛ shwã Siria fɛɛ, ni akɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni bɛ hewalɛ ni helai kɛ piŋmɔi srɔtoi hiɛ amɛ kɛ mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ gbligbli kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ kuumɔhela ba eŋɔɔ, ni etsa amɛ.

english_verse: Large crowds followed Jesus from Galilee and the region around the ten cities known as Decapolis. They also came from Jerusalem, Judea, and from across the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Ni asafoi pii jɛ Galilea kɛ Dekapoli kɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ Yudea kɛ Yordan sɛɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ.

english_verse: When Jesus saw the crowds, he went up on the side of a mountain and sat down. Blessings (Luke
translation_verse: Shi be ni ena mɛi pii lɛ, ekwɔ kɛtee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Eho eta shi ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ.

english_verse: You must obey God's commands better than the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law obey them. If you don't, I promise you will never get into the kingdom of heaven. Anger
translation_verse: Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛjalɛ lɛ faaa kɛtekeee mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi lɛ anɔ lɛ, nyɛboteŋ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli kwraa.” Mlifu he nitsɔɔmɔ

translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji okɛ onɔkeenɔ lɛ baaŋmɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni okai yɛ jɛi akɛ onyɛmi kɛ bo yɛ sane ko lɛ,

translation_verse: Ni egbele enaa etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii ekɛɛ,

english_verse: God blesses those people who depend only on him. They belong to the kingdom of heaven!
translation_verse: “Ajɔɔ mumɔ lɛ mli ohiafoi lɛ; shi amɛnɔ ji ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.”

english_verse: God blesses those people who grieve. They will find comfort!
translation_verse: “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni yeɔ ŋkɔmɔ lɛ; shi aaashɛje amɛmii.”

english_verse: God blesses those people who are humble. The earth will belong to them!
translation_verse: “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni he jɔ lɛ; shi shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ.”

english_verse: God blesses those people who are merciful. They will be treated with mercy!
translation_verse: “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni naa mɔbɔ; shi aaana amɛ mɔbɔ.”

english_verse: God blesses those people whose hearts are pure. They will see him!
translation_verse: “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni tsuii amli tse lɛ; shi amɛaana Nyɔŋmɔ.”

english_verse: You are the light for the whole world. A city built on top of a hill cannot be hidden,
translation_verse: Nyɛ ji je lɛ mli la lɛ. Maŋ ni ma gɔŋ nɔ lɛ, anyɛŋ akɛtee.

english_verse: But I tell you not to swear by anything when you make a promise! Heaven is God's throne, so don't swear by heaven.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛkakãa kitã kwraa! Kaakã ŋwɛi, shi Nyɔŋmɔ sɛi ni;

english_verse: The earth is God's footstool, so don't swear by the earth. Jerusalem is the city of the great king, so don't swear by it.
translation_verse: loo shikpɔŋ, shi enajiaŋshi maaŋoo ni; loo Yerusalɛm, shi Maŋtsɛ agbo lɛ maŋ ni.

english_verse: You are the salt for everyone on earth. But if salt no longer tastes like salt, how can it make food salty? All it is good for is to be thrown out and walked on.
translation_verse: “Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ŋoo ji nyɛ. Shi kɛji ŋoo naanu gbo lɛ, mɛni akɛaawo lɛ ŋoo dɔŋŋ? Ehiii hãaa nɔ ko dɔŋŋ, akɛ ja atsi ashwie, ni gbɔmɛi naanaa nɔ.

english_verse: and no one lights a lamp and puts it under a clay pot. Instead, it is placed on a lampstand, where it can give light to everyone in the house.
translation_verse: Asaŋ asuuu kane amaaa tsese shishi; shi moŋ akɛmaa kanetso nɔ, ni etsoɔ ehãa mɛi ni yɔɔ shĩa lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Don't suppose I came to do away with the Law and the Prophets. I did not come to do away with them, but to give them their full meaning.
translation_verse: “Nyɛkasusua akɛ miba Mla lɛ loo gbalɔi lɛ aguu; mibaaa guu shi moŋ miba ni mabahã eye emuu.

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Do not murder” and “A murderer must be brought to trial.”
translation_verse: “Nyɛnu akɛ akɛɛ blemabii lɛ akɛ, ‘Kaagbe gbɔmɔ! Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaagbe gbɔmɔ lɛ eeeye fɔ yɛ kojomɔ lɛ mli.’

english_verse: But I promise you if you are angry with someone, you will have to stand trial. If you call someone a fool, you will be taken to court. And if you say that someone is worthless, you will be in danger of the fires of hell.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mli fuɔ enyɛmi lɛ, eeeye fɔ yɛ kojomɔ lɛ mli; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakɛɛ enyɛmi akɛ, ‘Yaka gbɔmɔ’ lɛ eeeye gwabɔɔ lɛ hiɛ fɔ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Buulu’ lɛ eeeye abonsamiiaje la lɛ mliyaa fɔ.

english_verse: leave your gift there in front of the altar. Make peace with that person, then come back and offer your gift to God.
translation_verse: shi onɔkeenɔ lɛ yɛ jɛi yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ, ni oya okɛ onyɛmi lɛ ayakpãtã dã, koni oba ni okɛ onɔkeenɔ lɛ abahã.

english_verse: Before you are dragged into court, make friends with the person who has accused you of doing wrong. If you don't, you will be handed over to the judge and then to the officer who will put you in jail.
translation_verse: Okɛ obelɔ lɛ atsa mra, be ni okɛ lɛ nyiɛ gbɛ lɛ, koni obelɔ lɛ kɛ bo akahã kojolɔ lɛ, ni kojolɔ lɛ kɛ bo hã tsuŋwolɔ lɛ, ni akɛ bo wo tsuŋ.

english_verse: I promise you will not get out until you have paid the last cent you owe. Marriage
translation_verse: Miikɛɛ bo anɔkwale mli akɛ ojeŋ jɛi ojeŋ kpo kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ooowo naagbee pesewa lɛ.” Gbãlãfitemɔ he nitsɔɔmɔ

english_verse: You have been taught that a man who divorces his wife must write out divorce papers for her.
translation_verse: “Asaŋ akɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaashwie eŋa lɛ ehã lɛ shwiemɔ wolo.’

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Don't use the Lord's name to make a promise unless you are going to keep it.”
translation_verse: “Asaŋ nyɛnu akɛ akɛɛ blemabii lɛ akɛ, ‘Kaakã amale kitã, shi ye okitãi lɛ anɔ ohã Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.’

english_verse: When you make a promise, say only “Yes” or “No.” Anything else comes from the devil. Revenge (Luke
translation_verse: Shi nyɛhãa nyɛwiemɔ afea: ‘Hɛɛ, hɛɛ!’ ‘Dabi, dabi!’ Shi nɔ ni fe enɛɛmɛi lɛ ejɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ mli.” Oweletɔɔ (Luka

english_verse: You know you have been taught, “An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.”
translation_verse: “Nyɛnu akɛ akɛɛ akɛ, ‘Hiŋmɛi yɛ hiŋmɛi najiaŋ; nyanyɔŋ yɛ nyanyɔŋ najiaŋ.’

english_verse: But I tell you not to try to get even with a person who has done something to you. When someone slaps your right cheek, turn and let that person slap your other cheek.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛkatsia mɔ fɔŋ lɛ gbɛ, shi moŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaagba oninejurɔ toiŋ lɛ, tsɔ̃ ekome lɛ hu ohã lɛ.

english_verse: If someone sues you for your shirt, give up your coat as well.
translation_verse: Ni kɛji mɔ ko tao akɛ ekɛ bo aye sane ni eshɔ̃ oflaka lɛ, hã eŋɔ ohebo lɛ hu.

english_verse: If a soldier forces you to carry his pack one kilometer, carry it two kilometers.
translation_verse: Ni kɛji mɔ ko aaanyɛ onɔ akɛ okɛ lɛ anyiɛ shitoo kome lɛ, okɛ lɛ aya enyɔ.

english_verse: When people ask you for something, give it to them. When they want to borrow money, lend it to them. Love (Luke
translation_verse: Mɔ ni baa bo nɔ ko lɛ hã lɛ, ni mɔ ni taoɔ akɛ ofa lɛ nɔ ko lɛ, kaatsɔ̃ ohe oshi lɛ.” Henyɛlɔi asuɔmɔ (Luka

english_verse: You have heard people say, “Love your neighbors and hate your enemies.”
translation_verse: “Nyɛnu akɛ akɛɛ, ‘Suɔmɔ onaanyo, ni onyɛ ohenyɛlɔ.’

english_verse: But I tell you to love your enemies and pray for anyone who mistreats you.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛsumɔa nyɛhenyɛlɔi, ni nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa mɛi ni waa nyɛ yi lɛ,

english_verse: Then you will be acting like your Father in heaven. He makes the sun rise on both good and bad people. And he sends rain for the ones who do right and for the ones who do wrong.
translation_verse: koni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ bii, ejaakɛ ehãa ehulu teɔ shi yɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji kɛ mɛi kpakpai anɔ. Ni ehaa nyɔŋmɔ nɛɔ yɛ jalɔi kɛ mɛi ni ejaaa lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: If you love only those people who love you, will God reward you for this? Even tax collectors love their friends.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji nyɛsumɔɔ mɛi ni sumɔɔ nyɛ lɛ, mɛɛ nyɔmɔwoo nyɛyɔɔ? Ani toohelɔi lɛ tete efeee nakai nɔŋŋ?

english_verse: If you greet only your friends, what's so great about this? Don't even unbelievers do that?
translation_verse: Ni kɛji nyɛ ŋaa nyɛnyɛmimɛi kɛkɛ lɛ, mɛni nyɛfeɔ ni teke nɔ? Ani jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ tete efeee nakai nɔŋŋ?

english_verse: But you must always act like your Father in heaven.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhia kɛwulaa shi, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hi kɛwula shi lɛ.”

english_verse: When you do good deeds, don't try to show off. If you do, you won't get a reward from your Father in heaven.
translation_verse: “Nyɛkwɛa ni ahĩa ni nyɛkafea nyɛjalɛnii lɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ koni amɛna nyɛ; no lɛ, nyɛbɛ nyɔmɔwoo ko yɛ nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ dɛŋ.

english_verse: When you give to the poor, don't let anyone know about it.
translation_verse: Shi bo lɛ, kɛ oofee ejurɔ lɛ, kaahã obɛku le nɔ ni oninejurɔ feɔ,

english_verse: When you pray, don't be like those show-offs who love to stand up and pray in the synagogues and on the street corners. They do this just to look good. I can assure you that they already have their reward.
translation_verse: “Ni kɛ nyɛmiisɔle lɛ, nyɛkafea nyɛnii tamɔ osatofoi lɛ; shi amɛsumɔɔ akɛ amɛdamɔ kpeehei lɛ kɛ gbɛjegbɛi lɛ atoi amɛsɔle, koni mɛi ana amɛ. Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ amɛnine eshɛ amɛnyɔmɔwoo nɔ momo.

english_verse: When you pray, go into a room alone and close the door. Pray to your Father in private. He knows what is done in private and will reward you.
translation_verse: Shi bo lɛ, kɛ oosɔle lɛ, botemɔ opia mli, ni oŋa oshinaa lɛ, ni osɔle otsɛ oTsɛ yɛ teemɔ mli; ni oTsɛ ni naa teemɔ mli nii lɛ aaawo bo nyɔmɔ.

english_verse: When you pray, don't talk on and on as people do who don't know God. They think God likes to hear long prayers.
translation_verse: “Shi kɛji nyɛmiisɔle lɛ, nyɛkawiea trilii tamɔ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ; shi amɛsusuɔ akɛ amɛwiemɔ babaoo lɛ hewɔ aaabo amɛ toi.

english_verse: Don't be like them. Your Father knows what you need even before you ask.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkafea nyɛnii tamɔ amɛ; shi nyɛTsɛ lɛ le nii ni hiaa nyɛ dani nyɛbiɔ lɛ.” Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔ lɛ (Luka

english_verse: You should pray like this: Our Father in heaven, help us to honor your name.
translation_verse: “No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsɔlea nɛkɛ, ‘WɔTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi, ogbɛi lɛ he atse;

english_verse: Come and set up your kingdom, so that everyone on earth will obey you, as you are obeyed in heaven.
translation_verse: omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ aba. Afee nɔ ni osumɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ afeɔ yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ.

english_verse: If you forgive others for the wrongs they do to you, your Father in heaven will forgive you.
translation_verse: “Shi kɛji nyɛkɛ mɛi atɔ̃mɔi fa amɛ lɛ, nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ kɛaafa nyɛ hu.

english_verse: But if you don't forgive others, your Father will not forgive your sins. Worshiping God by Going without Eating
translation_verse: Shi kɛji nyɛkɛ mɛi atɔ̃mɔi efaaa amɛ lɛ, nyɛTsɛ lɛ hu kɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ efaŋ nyɛ.” Ŋmaahilɛ

english_verse: Instead, comb your hair and wash your face.
translation_verse: Shi bo lɛ, kɛ oohi ŋmaa lɛ, kpa oyi mli mu ni ofɔ ohiɛ;

english_verse: Then others won't know you are going without eating. But your Father sees what is done in private, and he will reward you. Treasures in Heaven (Luke
translation_verse: koni mɔ ko akana akɛ oohi ŋmaa, akɛ ja oTsɛ ni anaaa lɛ lɛ; ni oTsɛ ni naa teemɔ mli nii lɛ aaawo bo nyɔmɔ.” Ŋwɛi jwetri (Luka

english_verse: But more than anything else, put God's work first and do what he wants. Then the other things will be yours as well.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛtaoa Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ kɛ ejalɛ lɛ tsutsu ni akɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ aaafata he ahã nyɛ.

english_verse: Don't worry about tomorrow. It will take care of itself. You have enough to worry about today.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkahaoa nyɛhe nyɛtoa wɔ; ejaakɛ wɔ aaahao yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe. Gbi fɛɛ gbi nɔ efɔŋ lɛ fa hã lɛ.”

english_verse: Don't store up treasures on earth! Moths and rust can destroy them, and thieves can break in and steal them.
translation_verse: “Nyɛkabɔa jwetri nyɛhãa nyɛhe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni omlɛgɛ kɛ ŋkanale fiteɔ nii ni julɔi gbuɔ kɛboteɔ mli kɛbajuɔ yɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Instead, store up your treasures in heaven, where moths and rust cannot destroy them, and thieves cannot break in and steal them.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛbɔa jwetri nyɛhãa nyɛhe yɛ ŋwɛi, he ni omlɛgɛ kɛ ŋkanale fiteee nii ni julɔi egbuuu kɛboteee mli kɛyajuuu yɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Your heart will always be where your treasure is. Light (Luke
translation_verse: Shi he ni ojwetri yɔɔ lɛ jɛi otsui aaahi.” Gbɔmɔtso lɛ kane (Luka

english_verse: But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark. If the light inside you is dark, you surely are in the dark. Money (Luke
translation_verse: Shi kɛji ohiŋmɛi nɔ tseee lɛ, ogbɔmɔtso muu lɛ aaawo duŋ. No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji la ni yɔɔ omli lɛ ji duŋ lɛ, te no duŋ lɛ aaafa ahã tɛŋŋ!” Henaagbamɔ kɛ yeyeeyefeemɔ (Luka

english_verse: You cannot be the slave of two masters! You will like one more than the other or be more loyal to one than the other. You cannot serve both God and money. Worry (Luke
translation_verse: “Mɔ ko nyɛŋ nuŋtsɔmɛi enyɔ asɔ̃mɔ; ejaakɛ no lɛ eeenyɛ mɔ kome ni eeesumɔ mɔ kroko lɛ; aloo eeekpɛtɛ mɔ kome he, ni eeebu mɔ kroko lɛ akɛ ejeee mɔ ko. Nyɛnyɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mamona nyɛsɔ̃mɔ.

english_verse: Don't worry and ask yourselves, “Will we have anything to eat? Will we have anything to drink? Will we have any clothes to wear?”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkahaoa nyɛhe nyɛkɛa akɛ, ‘Mɛni wɔɔye, aloo mɛni wɔɔnu, mɛni hu wɔkɛ aha wɔhe?’

english_verse: I tell you not to worry about your life. Don't worry about having something to eat, drink, or wear. Isn't life more than food or clothing?
translation_verse: “No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɛkafea yeyeeye yɛ nyɛwala he, yɛ nɔ ni nyɛaanu hewɔ, aloo yɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtso lɛ he, yɛ nɔ ni nyɛaawo hewɔ. Ani wala efeee ŋmaa, ni gbɔmɔtso efeee atade?

english_verse: Look at the birds in the sky! They don't plant or harvest. They don't even store grain in barns. Yet your Father in heaven takes care of them. Aren't you worth much more than birds?
translation_verse: Nyɛkwɛa ŋwɛi loofɔji lɛ: amɛduuu nii, asaŋ amɛkpaaa nii, asaŋ amɛbuaaa naa amɛwooo aboŋoi amli; shi nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ lɛɔ amɛ kɛ̃. Ani nyɛhiii aahu fe amɛ?

english_verse: Can worry make you live longer?
translation_verse: Shi nyɛteŋ namɔ kɛ yeyeeyefeemɔ aaanyɛ atsa ekwɔlɛ nɔ ninetalɔ kome?

english_verse: Why worry about clothes? Look how the wild flowers grow. They don't work hard to make their clothes.
translation_verse: Ni mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛfeɔ yeyeeye yɛ atade hewɔ? Nyɛjwɛŋa ŋa nɔ fɔfɔii lɛ ahe, bɔ ni amɛdaraa; amɛgbooo deŋme, asaŋ amɛtsɛ̃ɛɛ kpãa.

english_verse: But I tell you that Solomon with all his wealth wasn't as well clothed as one of them.
translation_verse: Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Solomon kɛ enunyam lɛ fɛɛ tete ewulaaa tamɔ enɛɛmɛi ateŋ ekome.

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. God will surely do even more for you! Why do you have such little faith?
translation_verse: Shi kɛji ŋa nɔ jwɛi ni ŋmɛnɛ eyɛ ni wɔ ni ashɛ afɔ̃ flɔnɔɔ mli lɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ wulaa nɛkɛ lɛ, ani efeŋ nɔ ni fe enɛ ehaŋ nyɛ, nyɛ ni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli faaa lɛ lo?

english_verse: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father in heaven knows you need all of these.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ diɔ. Shi nyɛTsɛ lɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ le akɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ he miihia nyɛ.

english_verse: Don't condemn others, and God won't condemn you.
translation_verse: “Nyɛkakojoa, koni akakojo nyɛ.

english_verse: God will be as hard on you as you are on others! He will treat you exactly as you treat them.
translation_verse: Shi nɔ kojomɔ ni nyɛkɛkojoɔ lɛ, akɛaakojo nyɛ; ni nɔ susumɔnɔ ni nyɛkɛsusuɔ lɛ, akɛasusu ahã nyɛ.

english_verse: You can see the speck in your friend's eye, but you don't notice the log in your own eye.
translation_verse: Shi mɛɛba onaa kuli ni yɔɔ onyɛmi hiŋmɛi mli lɛ, shi bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛi mli mplaŋ lɛ oyooo lɛ?

english_verse: How can you say, “My friend, let me take the speck out of your eye,” when you don't see the log in your own eye?
translation_verse: Aloo te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni oookɛɛ onyɛmi akɛ, ‘Hã majie kuli lɛ yɛ ohiŋmɛi mli,’ be mli ni mplaŋ lɛ yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛi mli lɛ?

english_verse: As bad as you are, you still know how to give good gifts to your children. But your heavenly Father is even more ready to give good things to people who ask.
translation_verse: Belɛ kɛji nyɛ ni nyɛ ji mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ nyɛle bɔ ni nyɛfeɔ nyɛkɛ nikpakpai hãa nyɛbii lɛ, enyiɛ nɔŋŋ nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ eŋɔŋ nikpakpai ehaŋ mɛi ni biɔ lɛ lɛ? Mla ni jara wa lɛ

english_verse: Would any of you give your hungry child a stone, if the child asked for some bread?
translation_verse: Aloo nyɛteŋ namɔ ni kɛji ebi bi lɛ aboloo, ni eeehã lɛ tɛ?

english_verse: Ask, and you will receive. Search, and you will find. Knock, and the door will be opened for you.
translation_verse: “Nyɛbia, ni aaahã nyɛ; nyɛtaoa, ni nyɛaana; nyɛshia, ni aaagbele ahã nyɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who asks will receive. Everyone who searches will find. And the door will be opened for everyone who knocks.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni biɔ lɛ, enine shɛɔ nɔ; ni mɔ ni taoɔ lɛ, enaa; ni mɔ ni shiɔ lɛ aaagbele ahã lɛ.

english_verse: Would you give your child a snake if the child asked for a fish?
translation_verse: Aloo kɛji ebi lɛ ŋshɔŋloo, ni eeehã lɛ onufu?

english_verse: Treat others as you want them to treat you. This is what the Law and the Prophets are all about. The Narrow Gate (Luke
translation_verse: “No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ mɛi afee nyɛ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfea amɛ nakai nɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ enɛ ji Mla lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ.” Agbo fintɔŋŋ lɛ

english_verse: Anyone who hears and obeys these teachings of mine is like a wise person who built a house on solid rock.

translation_verse: Tso kpakpa nyɛɛɛ awo yibii gbohii, ni asaŋ tso gbonyo nyɛɛɛ awo yibii kpakpai.

translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, amɛyibii lɛ nyɛkɛale amɛ.” Mileee nyɛ kwraa

english_verse: When Jesus finished speaking, the crowds were surprised at his teaching.

english_verse: That evening many people with demons in them were brought to Jesus. And with only a word he forced out the evil spirits and healed everyone who was sick.
translation_verse: Shi be ni shɛ gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ, akɛ mɛi pii ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli ba eŋɔɔ. Ni ekɛ ewiemɔ fãmɔ mumɔi lɛ, ni etsa mɛi ni he yeɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Suddenly a man with leprosy came and knelt in front of Jesus. He said, “Lord, you have the power to make me well, if only you wanted to.”
translation_verse: Ni naa, kpitiyelɔ ko ba ebakoto lɛ ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, kɛji oosumɔ lɛ, ooonyɛ ohã mihe atse!”

english_verse: Jesus put his hand on the man and said, “I want to! Now you are well.” At once the man's leprosy disappeared.
translation_verse: Ni Yesu kpã enine mli eta ehe ni ekɛɛ, “Miisumɔ, ohe atse!” Ni amrɔ lɛ ekpiti lɛ tã.

english_verse: “I will go and heal him,” Jesus replied.
translation_verse: Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Miiba ni mabatsa lɛ.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he was so surprised that he turned and said to the crowd following him, “I tell you in all of Israel I've never found anyone with this much faith!
translation_verse: Shi be ni Yesu nu enɛ lɛ, ehiɛ fee lɛ yaa, ni ekɛɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ minako hemɔkɛyeli ni da tamɔ enɛ yɛ Israel!

english_verse: “Lord, my servant is at home in such terrible pain that he can't even move.”
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, miwenuu kã shi yɛ shĩa kɛ kuumɔhela, eena nɔ naakpa.”

english_verse: Many people will come from everywhere to enjoy the feast in the kingdom of heaven with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mɛi pii aaajɛ bokã kɛ anai aba, ni amɛkɛ Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob aaabatara okplɔ̃ he yɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.

english_verse: Then Jesus said to the officer, “You may go home now. Your faith has made it happen.” Right then his servant was healed. Jesus Heals Many People (Mark
translation_verse: Ni Yesu kɛɛ asraafoiohaatsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa, bɔ ni ohe oye lɛ, afee nakai ahã bo.” Ni atsa ewenuu lɛ yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ. Petro shaayoo tsamɔ (Marko

english_verse: Suddenly they shouted, “Jesus, Son of God, what do you want with us? Have you come to punish us before our time?”
translation_verse: Ni naa, amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛɛ sane wɔkɛ bo yɔɔ, bo Yesu Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ? Ani oba biɛ ni obawo wɔ hejaramɔ dani be lɛ ashɛ?”

english_verse: Everyone in town came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged him to leave their part of the country.
translation_verse: Ni naa, maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ je kpo ni amɛkɛ Yesu ayakpe; ni be ni amɛna lɛ lɛ, amɛkpa lɛ fai akɛ eje amɛkpokpai lɛ anɔ eya.

english_verse: Jesus went to the home of Peter, where he found that Peter's mother-in-law was sick in bed with fever.
translation_verse: Ni be ni Yesu ba Petro we lɛ, ena eshaayoo lɛ kã shi kɛ atridii.

english_verse: He took her by the hand, and the fever left her. Then she got up and served Jesus a meal.

translation_verse: Koni nɔ ni gbalɔ Yesaia wie lɛ aba mli akɛ, “Lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewo wɔhejaramɔi lɛ, ni etere wɔhelai lɛ.” Mɛi ni taoɔ Yesu sɛɛ anyiɛ (Luka

english_verse: When Jesus saw the crowd, he went across Lake Galilee.
translation_verse: Shi be ni Yesu na mɛi pii yɛ ehewɔ lɛ, efã akɛ afo ŋshɔ lɛ kɛya esɛɛgbɛ.

english_verse: A teacher of the Law of Moses came up to him and said, “Teacher, I'll go anywhere with you!”
translation_verse: Ni mlatsɔɔlɔ ko ba eŋɔɔ ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, manyiɛ osɛɛ kɛya he fɛɛ he ni oyaa.”

english_verse: Another disciple said to Jesus, “Lord, let me wait till I bury my father.”
translation_verse: Ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kroko hu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ; ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ ni mayafu mitsɛ dã.”

english_verse: so the disciples went over to him and woke him up. They said, “Lord, wake up! Save us before we drown!”
translation_verse: Ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛbatsiɛ̃ lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, heremɔ wɔyiwala, wɔhiɛ miikpãtã!”

english_verse: After Jesus left in a boat with his disciples,
translation_verse: Ni ebote lɛlɛ ko mli ni ekaselɔi lɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ.

english_verse: a terrible storm suddenly struck the lake, and waves started splashing into their boat. Jesus was sound asleep,
translation_verse: Ni naa; ŋshɔ lɛ fee hamahama aahu ni ŋshɔkei miikumɔ miiwo lɛlɛ lɛ mli; shi Yesu, ewɔ.

english_verse: The men in the boat were amazed and said, “Who is this? Even the wind and the waves obey him.” Two Men with Demons in Them (Mark
translation_verse: Shi gbɔmɛi lɛ ahiɛ fee amɛ yaa amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛɛ gbɔmɔ srɔto nɛ, ni kɔɔyɔɔ kɛ ŋshɔ tete boɔ lɛ toi nɛɛ?” Yesu tsa hii enyɔ ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli (Marko

english_verse: After Jesus had crossed the lake, he came to shore near the town of Gadara and started down the road. Two men with demons in them came to him from the tombs. They were so fierce that no one could travel that way.
translation_verse: Be ni eyashɛ sɛɛ lɛ gbɛ yɛ Gadarabii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mɛi enyɔ ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli ni amɛjɛ gbohii afũuhe lɛ kɛ lɛ bakpe; amɛhiɛ ewo la tsɔ̃ bɔ ni mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ nakai gbɛ lɛ nɔ atsɔ̃.

english_verse: Not far from there a large herd of pigs was feeding.
translation_verse: Ni kplotoi akuu kpele ko miiye nii yɛ shɔŋŋ.

english_verse: So the demons begged Jesus, “If you force us out, please send us into those pigs!”
translation_verse: Ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ kpa lɛ fai amɛkɛɛ, “Kɛji ofã wɔ lɛ hã wɔyabote kplotoi akuu lɛ mli.”

english_verse: Jesus told them to go, and they went out of the men and into the pigs. All at once the pigs rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned.
translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa!” Ni amɛje kpo amɛyabote kplotoi akuu lɛ mli; ni naa, kuu muu lɛ fɛɛ wo foi kɛjɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛyashwie ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛgboi yɛ nu lɛ mli.

english_verse: The people taking care of the pigs ran to the town and told everything, especially what had happened to the two men.
translation_verse: Ni mɛi ni kwɛɔ amɛ lɛ jo foi, amɛtee maŋ lɛ mli ni amɛyagba saji lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ anɔ lɛ hu.

english_verse: Jesus got into a boat and crossed back over to the town where he lived.
translation_verse: Yesu bote lɛlɛ mli, ni efo ŋshɔ lɛ, ni eba lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: Jesus heard them and answered, “Healthy people don't need a doctor, but sick people do.
translation_verse: Shi be ni Yesu nu lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛi ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ, tsofatsɛ he ehiaaa amɛ, shi moŋ mɛi ni he yeɔ lɛ.

english_verse: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. The wine would swell and burst the old skins. Then the wine would be lost, and the skins would be ruined. New wine must be put into new wineskins. Both the skins and the wine will then be safe. A Dying Girl and a Sick Woman (Mark
translation_verse: Asaŋ akɛ wain hee wooo wolo tɔi memeji amli; no lɛ, wolo tɔi lɛ aaaflɛ, ni wain lɛ aaashwie shi, ni wolo tɔi lɛ aaafite; shi wain hee lɛ, wolo tɔi hei amli moŋ akɛwoɔ, ni enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ feɔ shweshweeshwe.” Onukpa lɛ biyoo lɛ kɛ yoo ni ta Yesu atade he lɛ (Marko

english_verse: News about this spread all over that part of the country. Jesus Heals Two Blind Men
translation_verse: Ni nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ jije yɛ jɛi shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Shwilafoi enyɔ lɛ atsamɔ

translation_verse: Ni mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɛ yɛ amɛmli akɛ, “Musu mɔ nɛ bɔɔ nɛɛ.”

translation_verse: Ni be ni Yesu na amɛjwɛŋmɔi lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ni nyɛjwɛŋɔ nii fɔ̃ji yɛ nyɛtsuii amli nɛɛ?

translation_verse: Shi be ni afee ni nyɛna akɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ yɛ hegbɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ ekɛ eshai faa lɛ,” — kɛkɛ lɛ ekɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ kuumɔ hela lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi, wo osaa lɛ ni oya shĩa!”

translation_verse: Ni ete shi etee shĩa.

english_verse: As Jesus and his disciples were on their way, some people brought to him a man who could not talk because a demon was in him.
translation_verse: Shi be ni Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ jeɔ kpo lɛ, akɛ mumui ko ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli ba eŋɔɔ.

english_verse: As Jesus was leaving, he saw a tax collector named Matthew sitting at the place for paying taxes. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.” Matthew got up and went with him.
translation_verse: Ni be ni Yesu je jɛi eyaa lɛ ena nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Mateo ta toohemɔhe lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ!” Ni ete shi enyiɛ esɛɛ.

translation_verse: Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni eta niyenii ashi yɛ shĩa lɛ, toohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi babaoo ba, ni amɛkɛ Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ batara okplɔ̃ lɛ he.

english_verse: Some Pharisees asked Jesus' disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and other sinners?”
translation_verse: Ni be ni Farisifoi lɛ na lɛ, amɛbi ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ kɛ toohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi yeɔ nii nɛɛ?”

english_verse: While Jesus was still speaking, an official came and knelt in front of him. The man said, “My daughter has just now died! Please come and place your hand on her. Then she will live again.”
translation_verse: Be ni ekɛ amɛ wieɔ wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, onukpa ko ba bakoto lɛ ekɛɛ, “Mibiyoo eje mli amrɔ nɛɛ, shi ba ni okɛ onine abaŋmɛ enɔ, ni ehiɛ aaatsɛ̃.”

english_verse: Jesus turned. He saw the woman and said, “Don't worry! You are now healed because of your faith.” At that moment she was healed.
translation_verse: Shi Yesu tsɔ̃ ehe, ni be ni ena lɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Biyoo, hã otsui anyɔ omli, ohemɔkɛyeli lɛ ehere oyiwala!” Ni yoo lɛ he wa lɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: After Jesus had forced the demon out, the man started talking. The crowds were so amazed they began saying, “Nothing like this has ever happened in Israel!”
translation_verse: Ni be ni efã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ, mumui lɛ wie. Ni asafoi lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe amɛkɛɛ, “Anako nɛkɛ nɔ ko pɛŋ yɛ Israel!”

translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yohane kaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ wɔ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ fɔɔ ŋmaahilɛ, shi okaselɔi lɛ ehiii ŋmaa lɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: The friends of a bridegroom aren't sad while he is still with them. But the time will come when he will be taken from them. Then they will go without eating.
translation_verse: Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani yookpeemɔ he bialɔi lɛ aaanyɛ aye ŋkɔmɔ gbii abɔ ni ayɛmforowu lɛ kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ? Shi gbii aaaba momo ni aaaŋɔ ayɛmforowu lɛ kɛaaje amɛteŋ kɛaatee, ni no dani amɛaahi ŋmaa.

english_verse: No one uses a new piece of cloth to patch old clothes. The patch would shrink and tear a bigger hole.
translation_verse: “Shi mɔ ko kɛ mamanaa hee taaa atade momo; ejaakɛ nɔ ni akɛta lɛ yeɔ atade lɛ, ni folɔ lɛ lɛɔ moŋ fe tsutsu lɛ.

english_verse: She had said to herself, “If I can just touch his clothes, I will be healed.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ekɛɛ yɛ eyiŋ akɛ, “Kɛji mina mita etade lɛ he kɛkɛ lɛ, mihe aaawa mi.”

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples got up and went with the man.
translation_verse: Ni Yesu te shi ni ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ.

english_verse: A woman who had been bleeding for twelve years came up behind Jesus and barely touched his clothes.
translation_verse: Ni naa, yoo ko ni eye láfɔsemɔ hela afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ baje esɛɛgbɛ eta etade naamuu lɛ he.

english_verse: When Jesus went into the home of the official and saw the musicians and the crowd of mourners,
translation_verse: Ni be ni Yesu ba onukpa lɛ we lɛ ni ena blɛkpalɔi kɛ mɛi pii ni feɔ hoo lɛ,

english_verse: he said, “Get out of here! The little girl isn't dead. She is just asleep.” Everyone started laughing at Jesus.
translation_verse: ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa sɛɛ, ejaakɛ oblayoo lɛ gboko, shi wɔ kɛkɛ ewɔɔ.” Ni amɛŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: But after the crowd had been sent out of the house, Jesus went to the girl's bedside. He took her by the hand and helped her up.
translation_verse: Shi be ni ashwie mɛi lɛ, etee tsu lɛ mli, ni emɔ oblayoo lɛ nineshi, ni ete shi.

translation_verse: Ni be ni ebote shĩa lɛ, shwilafoi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ; ni Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛheɔ nyɛyeɔ akɛ manyɛ enɛ mafee lo?” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ!”

english_verse: Jesus touched their eyes and said, “Because of your faith, you will be healed.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni etara amɛhiŋmɛii lɛ ahe ni ekɛɛ, “Bɔ ni nyɛheɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ, afee nakai ahã nyɛ.”

english_verse: They were able to see, and Jesus strictly warned them not to tell anyone about him.
translation_verse: Ni amɛhiŋmɛii lɛ gbele. Ni Yesu bɔ amɛ kɔkɔ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa ni mɔ ko akalea!”

translation_verse: “Shi nyɛhĩɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ gbɔmɛi ahewɔ; ejaakɛ amɛaaŋɔ nyɛ kɛaatee kojomɔhei, ni amɛaayi nyɛ yɛ amɛkpeehei lɛ.

translation_verse: Shi kɛ amɛmiiwa nyɛ yi yɛ maŋ ko mli lɛ, nyɛjoa foi nyɛyaa ekroko mli; shi miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ nyɛgbeŋ Israel maji lɛ fɛɛ naa dani Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaaba.

translation_verse: Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kwaa mi yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ, mi hu makwa lɛ yɛ miTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hiɛ.” Jeee hejɔlɛ, shi klante (Luka

translation_verse: bɔ ni ebote Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ, ni eyaye aboloi ni akɛmãa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ni aŋmɛɛɛ lɛ gbɛ loo mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ yeɔ, akɛ ja osɔfoi lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ?

english_verse: Don't you know what the Scriptures mean when they say, “Instead of offering sacrifices to me, I want you to be merciful to others?” If you knew what this means, you would not condemn these innocent disciples of mine.
translation_verse: Shi eji nyɛle wiemɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɔbɔnalɛ mitaoɔ shi jeee afɔle’ lɛ shishi kulɛ, nyɛbuŋ mɛi ni yeee fɔ lɛ afɔ.

english_verse: But when Peter saw how strong the wind was, he was afraid and started sinking. “Save me, Lord!” he shouted.
translation_verse: Shi be ni ena akɛ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ miitswa waa lɛ, eshe gbeyei ni ebɔ̃i shiumɔ, ni ebo ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, heremɔ mi!”

english_verse: After Jesus heard about John, he crossed Lake Galilee to go to some place where he could be alone. But the crowds found out and followed him on foot from the towns.
translation_verse: Shi be ni Yesu nu lɛ, etsɔ̃ lɛlɛ mli kɛje jɛi kɛtee ŋa nɔ he ko banee. Ni be ni asafoi lɛ nu lɛ, amɛje maji lɛ amli amɛnyiɛ amɛnane kɛtiu lɛ.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “They don't have to leave. Why don't you give them something to eat?”
translation_verse: Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ehiaaa akɛ amɛaatee; nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhãa amɛ nii amɛyea.”

english_verse: Jesus asked his disciples to bring the food to him,
translation_verse: Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛbahãa mi yɛ biɛ!”

translation_verse: Ni efã asafoi lɛ akɛ amɛtaratara shi yɛ jwɛi lɛ anɔ. Ni ekɔlɔ aboloi enumɔ lɛ kɛ loi enyɔ lɛ, ni ekwɛ ŋwɛi ni ejɔɔ nɔ; ni ekumɔ aboloi lɛ amli ni ekɛhã ekaselɔi lɛ ni ekaselɔi lɛ hu kɛhã asafoi lɛ.

english_verse: Then he went up on a mountain where he could be alone and pray. Later in the evening, he was still there.
translation_verse: Ni be ni ewo asafoi lɛ agbɛ lɛ, ekwɔ kɛtee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ko banee ni eyasɔle. Be ni je na lɛ, ekometoo eyɔɔ jɛi. Yesu nyiɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ (Marko

english_verse: By this time the boat was a long way from the shore. It was going against the wind and was being tossed around by the waves.
translation_verse: Shi lɛlɛ lɛ eshɛ ŋshɔ lɛ teŋ momo ni ŋshɔkei lɛ miihɛlɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ eekpee kɔɔyɔɔ.

english_verse: A little while before morning, Jesus came walking on the water toward his disciples.
translation_verse: Ni maŋkɛ hima, aaafee ŋmɛji etɛ̃ loo nɔ mli lɛ, Yesu nyiɛ ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛba amɛŋɔɔ.

english_verse: When they saw him, they thought he was a ghost. They were terrified and started screaming.
translation_verse: Ni be ni ekaselɔi lɛ na lɛ ni enyiɛ ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, amɛtsui fã, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Sisaŋ!” Ni amɛbolɔ kɛ gbeyeishemɔ.

english_verse: At once, Jesus said to them, “Don't worry! I am Jesus. Don't be afraid.”
translation_verse: Shi amrɔ lɛ Yesu fã enaa ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛnaa tsui, miŋ; nyɛkashea gbeyei.”

english_verse: Peter replied, “Lord, if it really is you, tell me to come to you on the water.”
translation_verse: Shi Petro here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, kɛji bo ni lɛ, fã mi koni matsɔ̃ nu lɛ hiɛ kɛba oŋɔɔ.”

english_verse: At once, Jesus reached out his hand. He helped Peter up and said, “You surely don't have much faith. Why do you doubt?”
translation_verse: Ni amrɔ lɛ Yesu kpã enine mli esɔo lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo ni ohemɔkɛyeli faaa, mɛni hewɔ oje ŋwane?”

english_verse: When Jesus and Peter got into the boat, the wind died down.
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛbote lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ, kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ fɔ̃ɔ tswaa.

translation_verse: Ni mɛi ni yɔɔ lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ bakoto lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji bo lɛɛlɛŋ!” Yesu tsa helatsɛmɛi yɛ Genesaret (Marko

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples crossed the lake and came to shore near the town of Gennesaret.
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛfo ŋshɔ lɛ, amɛba Genesaret shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The people found out he was there, and they sent word to everyone who lived in this part of the country. So they brought all the sick people to Jesus.
translation_verse: Ni be ni jɛibii lɛ yoo lɛ lɛ, amɛtsu atee jɛi niiaŋ fɛɛ, ni ayaŋɔ helatsɛmɛi fɛɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ;

english_verse: They begged him just to let them touch his clothes, and everyone who did was healed.
translation_verse: ni amɛkpa lɛ fai akɛ ehã amɛna etade lɛ naamuu lɛ he amɛtara kɛkɛ; ni mɛi abɔ fɛɛ ni tara he lɛ he wa amɛ kwraa.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Every plant that my Father in heaven did not plant will be pulled up by the roots.
translation_verse: Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, “Tso fɛɛ tso ni jeee miŋwɛi-Tsɛ lɛ tɛoɔ lɛ, fã aaafã.

english_verse: “Why don't your disciples obey what our ancestors taught us to do? They don't even wash their hands before they eat.”
translation_verse: “Mɛɛ hewɔ ni okaselɔi lɛ tɔ̃ɔ onukpai lɛ ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ? Ejaakɛ amɛfɔɔɔ amɛdɛ̃ dani amɛyeɔ nii.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: Why do you disobey God and follow your own teaching?
translation_verse: Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ni nyɛ hu nyɛkɛ nyɛblema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ tɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kitã lɛ nɔ lɛ?

english_verse: But you let people get by without helping their parents when they should. You let them say that what they have has been offered to God.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakɛɛ etsɛ loo enyɛ akɛ, nɔ ni kulɛ ooona yɛ midɛŋ lɛ, mikɛke Nyɔŋmɔ’ lɛ, tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ekawo etsɛ loo enyɛ dɔŋŋ.

translation_verse: Shi yakatswaa amɛjaa mi lɛ, Ejaakɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ni ji gbɔmɛi akitãi.’ ” Nibii ni buleɔ mɔ (Marko

english_verse: Jesus did not say a word. But the woman kept following along and shouting, so his disciples came up and asked him to send her away.

translation_verse: Jeee nɔ ni boteɔ mɔ daaŋ lɛ buleɔ gbɔmɔ; shi moŋ nɔ ni jeɔ mɔ daaŋ lɛ, no buleɔ gbɔmɔ.”

english_verse: Then his disciples came over to him and asked, “Do you know you insulted the Pharisees by what you said?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ole akɛ be ni Farisifoi lɛ nu nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ, ewo amɛ mlila waa?”

english_verse: Peter replied, “What did you mean when you talked about the things that make people unclean?”
translation_verse: Ni Petro here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ abɛ nɛɛ shishi!”

english_verse: Jesus then said: Don't any of you know by now what I am talking about?
translation_verse: Ni Yesu kɛɛ, “Ani nyɛ hu nyɛnako nii ashishi lolo?

english_verse: Don't you know that the food you put into your mouth goes into your stomach and then out of your body?
translation_verse: Ani nyɛkpako shi akɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni boteɔ mɔ daaŋ lɛ, musuŋ eyaa ni ajieɔ awoɔ tiafi mli?

english_verse: But the words that come out of your mouth come from your heart. And they are what make you unfit to worship God.

translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “O yoo, ohemɔkɛyeli da! Afee ahã bo tamɔ bɔ ni otaoɔ lɛ!” Ni atsa ebiyoo lɛ yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ. Yesu tsa mɛi pii

translation_verse: Ni asafoi lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe, be ni amɛna akɛ mumuii miiwie, ni obubuafoi ahe ewa amɛ, ni akpaketsɛmɛi miinyiɛ, ni shwilafoi miina nii lɛ; ni amɛwo Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam. Yesu hã mɛi akpei ejwɛ niyenii (Marko

english_verse: Jesus called his disciples together and told them, “I feel sorry for these people. They have been with me for three days, and they don't have anything to eat. I don't want to send them away hungry. They might faint on their way home.”
translation_verse: Shi Yesu tsɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛba ni ekɛɛ, “Mimusuŋ miitsɔ̃ mi yɛ asafoi lɛ ahe, akɛ amɛkɛ mi ehi shi gbii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ, ni amɛbɛ nɔ ko ni amɛyeɔ; ni misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ miwoɔ amɛ gbɛ kɛ musuŋ hɔ̃mɔ, ni ekolɛ amɛyatɔ biti yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.”

translation_verse: Ni Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, “Aboloi enyiɛ nyɛyɔɔ?” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kpawo, kɛ loi bibii fioo ko.”

translation_verse: Ni efã asafoi lɛ akɛ amɛtara shi yɛ shikpɔŋ.

translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ amɛyoo akɛ jeee aboloo masha hewɔ ekɛɛ amɛhiɛ ahi amɛhe nɔ lɛ, shi moŋ Farisifoi kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ atsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ hewɔŋ. Petro odase ni eye yɛ Yesu he (Marko

english_verse: He told them: If the sky is red in the evening, you say the weather will be good.

english_verse: The disciples answered, “Some people say you are John the Baptist or maybe Elijah or Jeremiah or some other prophet.”
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛi komɛi kɛɔ akɛ Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ ni; ni mɛi komɛi kɛɔ akɛ Elia ni; ni mɛi krokomɛi hu kɛɔ akɛ Yeremia loo gbalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni.”
