translation_verse: Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ ni nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ Farisifoi kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ amasha lɛ he!”

english_verse: The disciples talked this over and said to each other, “He must be saying this because we didn't bring along any bread.”
translation_verse: Shi amɛwiewie he yɛ amɛteŋ amɛkɛɛ, “Aboloo ni wɔhiɛɛɛ lɛ hewɔŋ!”

english_verse: The Son of Man will soon come in the glory of his Father and with his angels to reward all people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baaba yɛ eTsɛ anunyam lɛ mli kɛ ebɔfoi lɛ; ni no mli lɛ eeewo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɔmɔ yɛ enitsumɔ naa.

english_verse: So I will call you Peter, which means “a rock.” On this rock I will build my church, and death itself will not have any power over it.
translation_verse: Ni mi hu miikɛɛ bo akɛ, bo ji Petro lɛ, ni nɛkɛ tɛsaa nɛɛ nɔ matswa misafo lɛ mama, ni gbohiiaje agboi lɛ nyɛŋ enɔ aye.

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “But who do you say I am?”
translation_verse: Ebi amɛ akɛ, “Shi nyɛ lɛ, namɔ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ mi ji?”

english_verse: Simon Peter spoke up, “You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God.”
translation_verse: Simon Petro here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Bo ji Kristo lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ Bi lɛ!”

english_verse: Jesus told him: Simon, son of Jonah, you are blessed! You didn't discover this on your own. It was shown to you by my Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Ni Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ajɔɔ bo, Simon, Yona bi; ejaakɛ jeee heloo kɛ lá jie enɛ tsɔ̃ɔ bo, shi moŋ miTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ.

english_verse: I will give you the keys to the kingdom of heaven, and God in heaven will allow whatever you allow on earth. But he will not allow anything you don't allow.
translation_verse: Ni maŋɔ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ naa samfei lɛ mahã bo; nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooofi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaafi yɛ ŋwɛi; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooofɛne yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaafɛne yɛ ŋwɛi.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples not to tell anyone he was the Messiah. Jesus Speaks about His Suffering and Death (Mark
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni etswa ekaselɔi lɛ anaa mã akɛ amɛkakɛɛ mɔ ko akɛ lɛ ji Kristo lɛ.” Yesu wie egbele kɛ eshitee he (Marko

english_verse: Peter took Jesus aside and told him to stop talking like that. He said, “God would never let this happen to you, Lord!”
translation_verse: Ni Petro ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee afa, ebɔ̃i lɛ kɔkɔbɔɔ ekɛɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ akahã enɛ ba mli, Nuŋtsɔ; enɛ akagbale bo fɔ̃ŋfɔ̃!”

english_verse: Then Jesus said to his disciples: If any of you want to be my followers, you must forget about yourself. You must take up your cross and follow me.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ akɛ enyiɛ misɛɛ lɛ, ekwa ehe ni ewo esɛŋmɔtso lɛ ni enyiɛ misɛɛ.

english_verse: If you want to save your life, you will destroy it. But if you give up your life for me, you will find it.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taoɔ akɛ ebaa esusuma yi lɛ, eeelaaje lɛ; shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni laajeɔ esusuma yɛ mihewɔ lɛ, enine aaashɛ nɔ.

english_verse: What will you gain, if you own the whole world but destroy yourself? What would you give to get back your soul?
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛɛ sɛɛ gbɔmɔ baana, kɛji enine shɛ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, shi elaaje esusuma lɛ? Aloo mɛni gbɔmɔ kɛaahã ni ekɛkpɔ̃ esusuma lɛ?

english_verse: I promise you some of those standing here will not die before they see the Son of Man coming with his kingdom.
translation_verse: Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɛi komɛi yɛ mɛi ni damɔ biɛ nɛɛ ateŋ ni amɛsaŋ amɛnaa gbele kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛaana Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ miiba yɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.”

english_verse: There in front of the disciples, Jesus was completely changed. His face was shining like the sun, and his clothes became white as light.
translation_verse: Ni egbɔmɔtso su tsake yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni ehiɛ kpɛ tamɔ hulu, ni etadei lɛ yɛ tamɔ la.

english_verse: Then the disciples understood Jesus was talking to them about John the Baptist. Jesus Heals a Boy (Mark
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni kaselɔi lɛ kɔ sɛɛ akɛ Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ he ekɛ amɛ wieɔ lɛ. Yesu tsa gbekɛ nuu ko ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli (Marko

english_verse: Six days later Jesus took Peter and the brothers James and John with him. They went up on a very high mountain where they could be alone.
translation_verse: Gbii ekpaa sɛɛ lɛ, Yesu ŋɔ Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ enyɛmi Yohane, ni ekɛ amɛ tee gɔŋ ni kwɔ ko nɔ, ekɛ amɛ pɛ.

english_verse: All at once Moses and Elijah were there talking with Jesus.
translation_verse: Ni naa, Mose kɛ Elia bajie amɛhe kpo amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ ni amɛkɛ lɛ miiwie.

english_verse: So Peter said to him, “Lord, it is good for us to be here! Let us make three shelters, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
translation_verse: Ni Petro here nɔ ni ekɛɛ Yesu akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ehi akɛ wɔyɛ biɛ! Kɛji oosumɔ lɛ, mafee bui etɛ̃ yɛ biɛ, onɔ ekome, kɛ Mose nɔ ekome, kɛ Elia nɔ ekome.”

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, the shadow of a bright cloud passed over them. From the cloud a voice said, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him. Listen to what he says!”
translation_verse: Be ni ewieɔ lolo lɛ, naa, atatu halaŋŋ ko bakete amɛnɔ, ni gbee ko jɛ atatu lɛ mli kɛɛ, “Mɔ nɛ ji misuɔmɔ Bi ni minaa ehe tsui lɛ; nyɛboa lɛ toi!”

english_verse: When the disciples heard the voice, they were so afraid they fell flat on the ground.
translation_verse: Ni be ni kaselɔi lɛ nu lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi, ni amɛshe gbeyei naakpa.

english_verse: But Jesus came over and touched them. He said, “Get up and don't be afraid!”
translation_verse: Ni Yesu ba ni ebatara amɛhe ekɛɛ, “Nyɛtea shi, nyɛkashea gbeyei!”

english_verse: When they opened their eyes, they saw only Jesus.
translation_verse: Shi be ni amɛwo amɛhiɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛnaaa mɔ ko akɛ ja Yesu kome pɛ.

english_verse: The disciples asked Jesus, “Don't the teachers of the Law of Moses say Elijah must come before the Messiah does?”
translation_verse: Ni ekaselɔi lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ ni mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, ja Elia eba dã lɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus told them, “Elijah certainly will come and get everything ready.
translation_verse: Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Eyɛ mli lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ Elia miiba, ni ebaato nibii fɛɛ gbɛjianɔ ekoŋŋ;

english_verse: In fact, he has already come. But the people did not recognize him and treated him just as they wanted to. They will soon make the Son of Man suffer in the same way.”
translation_verse: shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Elia eba momo, ni amɛyooo lɛ, shi moŋ amɛfee lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛsumɔɔ. Nakai nɔŋŋ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hu baana amanehulu yɛ amɛdɛŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples returned to the crowd. A man knelt in front of him
translation_verse: Be ni amɛshɛ asafo lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, nuu ko ba eŋɔɔ, ni ebakula shi yɛ ehiɛ,

english_verse: and said, “Lord, have pity on my son! He has a bad case of epilepsy and often falls into a fire or into water.
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, naa mibi nuu lɛ mɔbɔ, shi eeye gbligbli ni eena nɔ po ni ehiii, ejaakɛ bianɛ bianɛ eyagbee la mli, ni bianɛ bianɛ eyagbee nu mli.

english_verse: I brought him to your disciples, but none of them could heal him.”
translation_verse: Ni mikɛ lɛ ba okaselɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ, shi amɛnyɛɛɛ lɛ amɛtsa.”

english_verse: Jesus said, “You people are too stubborn to have any faith! How much longer must I be with you? Why do I have to put up with you? Bring the boy here.”
translation_verse: Shi Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Ao yinɔbii ni heee yeee ni bɛ amɛŋlɛnɔ! Mɛɛ beyinɔ mikɛ nyɛ aaahi shi kɛyashi? Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ mato mitsui shi mahã nyɛ kɛyashi? Nyɛkɛ lɛ abaa biɛ nyɛbahãa mi!”

english_verse: Then Jesus spoke sternly to the demon. It went out of the boy, and right then he was healed.
translation_verse: Ni Yesu fã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ yi, ni mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ jɛ emli je kpo, ni gbekɛ lɛ he wa lɛ yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Later the disciples went to Jesus in private and asked him, “Why couldn't we force out the demon?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ yɛ afã, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛɛba wɔ lɛ wɔnyɛɛɛ lɛ wɔfã lɛ?”

english_verse: While Jesus and his disciples were going from place to place in Galilee, he told them, “The Son of Man will be handed over to people
translation_verse: Shi be ni amɛkpaa Galilea lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Abaaŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ awo gbɔmɛi adɛŋ,

english_verse: who will kill him. But three days later he will rise to life.” All of this made the disciples very sad. Paying the Temple Tax
translation_verse: ni amɛaagbe lɛ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaatee lɛ shi.” Ni amɛwerɛ ho amɛhe tsɔ̃. Sɔlemɔtsu onia

english_verse: When Jesus and the others arrived in Capernaum, the collectors for the temple tax came to Peter and asked, “Does your teacher pay the temple tax?”
translation_verse: Be ni amɛba Kapernaum lɛ, oniatsulɔi lɛ ba Petro ŋɔɔ babi akɛ, “Ani nyɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ wooo Sɔlemɔtsu onia lɛ?”

english_verse: “Yes, he does,” Peter answered. After they had returned home, Jesus went up to Peter and asked him, “Simon, what do you think? Do the kings of this earth collect taxes and fees from their own people or from foreigners?”
translation_verse: Ekɛɛ, “Ewoɔ.” Ni be ni eba shĩa lɛ, Yesu tsɔ̃ hiɛ ekɛɛ, “Te osusuɔ tɛŋŋ, Simon? Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, namɛi adɛŋ amɛheɔ too loo onia yɛ? Yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛbii adɛŋ loo mɛi kpɔ̃ji adɛŋ?”

english_verse: Peter answered, “From foreigners.” Jesus replied, “Then their own people don't have to pay.
translation_verse: Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji adɛŋ.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Belɛ bii lɛ yeɔ amɛhe mɔ.

english_verse: But we don't want to cause trouble. So go cast a line into the lake and pull out the first fish you hook. Open its mouth, and you will find a coin. Use it to pay your taxes and mine.”
translation_verse: Shi bɔ ni afee ni wɔkato amɛ pampi lɛ, yaa ŋshɔ lɛ naa oyafɔ̃ kpoŋ, ni loo klɛŋklɛŋ ni aaabakɔ kpoŋ lɛ, sha lɛ, ni kɛ ogbɛ edaaŋ lɛ, ooona shika ni naa shiɔ yii enyɔ; kɔ ni okɛhã amɛ, ohã mi kɛ bo fɛɛ.”

english_verse: If your eye causes you to sin, poke it out and get rid of it. You would be better off to go into life with only one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fires of hell. The Lost Sheep (Luke
translation_verse: Ni kɛji ohiŋmɛi miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ, fãa yɛ ohe oshɛ ofɔ̃; faŋ nɔ ni okɛ hiŋmɛi kome bote wala mli fe nɔ ni oyɛ hiŋmɛii enyɔ ni aaashɛ bo afɔ̃ abonsamiiaje.” Too ni laaje lɛ he abɛ lɛ (Luka

english_verse: Don't you think you should show pity to someone else, as I did to you?”
translation_verse: Ani kulɛ jeee bo hu ogbɛnaa ji akɛ ona onaanyo tsulɔ lɛ mɔbɔ, bɔ ni mi hu mina bo mɔbɔ lɛ?’

english_verse: But if you are as humble as this child, you are the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baa ehe shi tamɔ gbekɛ nɛɛ lɛ, lɛ ji agbo fe fɛɛ yɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.

english_verse: And when you welcome one of these children because of me, you welcome me. Temptations To Sin (Mark
translation_verse: Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hereɔ gbekɛ fioo kome ni tamɔ mɔ nɛ yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, ehereɔ mi. Nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ he kɔkɔbɔɔ (Marko

english_verse: If the follower refuses to listen to them, report the matter to the church. Anyone who refuses to listen to the church must be treated like an unbeliever or a tax collector. Allowing and Not Allowing
translation_verse: Ni kɛji amɛ hu ebooo amɛ toi lɛ, yaakɛɛ asafo lɛ, ni kɛji ebooo asafo lɛ hu toi lɛ, buu lɛ tamɔ wɔŋjalɔ kɛ toohelɔ.

english_verse: It will be terrible for people who cause even one of my little followers to sin. Those people would be better off thrown into the deepest part of the ocean with a heavy stone tied around their necks!
translation_verse: “Shi mɔ ni tɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ bibii nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni heɔ minɔ yeɔ lɛ nane lɛ, faŋ nɔ ni akɛ teji wiɛ ŋmɔ ekuɛ ni akɛ lɛ yawo ŋshɔŋ.

english_verse: If your hand or foot causes you to sin, chop it off and throw it away! You would be better off to go into life paralyzed or lame than to have two hands or two feet and be thrown into the fire that never goes out.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji onine loo onane miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ, foo yɛ ohe oshɛ ofɔ̃; faŋ nɔ ni oyɛ niji enyɔ loo naji enyɔ ni aaashɛ bo afɔ̃ naanɔ la lɛ mli.

english_verse: If one of my followers sins against you, go and point out what was wrong. But do it in private, just between the two of you. If that person listens, you have won back a follower.
translation_verse: “Shi kɛji onyɛmi ko tɔ̃ onɔ lɛ, yaa ni oyatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ etɔ̃mɔ lɛ, okɛ lɛ yi enyɔ kɛkɛ. Kɛji ebo bo toi lɛ, nyɛmi efee nyɛmi.

english_verse: I am sure that finding it would make you happier than having the
translation_verse: Ni kɛji ena lɛ lɛ, anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, emii shɛɔ ehe yɛ no he fe nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ nɛɛhu ni eduko gbɛ lɛ.

english_verse: That's how it is with your Father in heaven. He doesn't want any of these little ones to be lost. When Someone Sins (Luke
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ sumɔɔɔ akɛ bibii nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome laajeɔ.” Mɔ kɛ enyɛmi ni etɔ̃ enɔ teŋsaamɔ

english_verse: But if that one refuses to listen, take along one or two others. The Scriptures teach that every complaint must be proven true by two or more witnesses.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji ebooo bo toi lɛ, kɛ mɔ kome loo mɛi enyɔ afata ohe, koni odasefoi enyɔ loo etɛ̃ daaŋ wiemɔ naa lɛ sane fɛɛ sane ama shi.

english_verse: I promise you God in heaven will allow whatever you allow on earth, but God will not allow anything you don't allow.
translation_verse: Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛaafi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaafi yɛ ŋwɛi; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛaafɛne yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaafɛne yɛ ŋwɛi.

english_verse: I promise that when any two of you on earth agree about something you are praying for, my Father in heaven will do it for you.
translation_verse: Asaŋ anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛteŋ mɛi enyɔ kpãa gbee yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ yɛ sane fɛɛ sane ni amɛbiɔ lɛ he lɛ, miTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ aaafee ahã amɛ.

english_verse: Whenever two or three of you come together in my name, I am there with you. An Official Who Refused To Forgive
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ he ni mɛi enyɔ loo mɛi etɛ̃ ebua amɛhe naa yɛ, yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, miyɛ amɛteŋ yɛ jɛi.” Tsulɔ ni enaaa mɔbɔ lɛ he abɛ lɛ

english_verse: Peter came up to the Lord and asked, “How many times should I forgive someone who does something wrong to me? Is seven times enough?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Petro ba eŋɔɔ ni ebabi lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, shii enyiɛ minyɛmi atɔ̃ minɔ ni mikɛfa lɛ? Kɛyashi shii kpawo lo?”

english_verse: As he was doing this, one official was brought in who owed him
translation_verse: Ni be ni ebɔ̃i buu lɛ, akɛ mɔ ko ni hiɛ lɛ nyɔmɔ talentai akpei nyɔŋma ba eŋɔɔ.

english_verse: But he didn't have any money to pay what he owed. The king ordered him to be sold, along with his wife and children and all he owned, in order to pay the debt.
translation_verse: Shi akɛni ebɛ nɔ ko ni ekɛaawo lɛ lɛ, enuŋtsɔ lɛ fã akɛ ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ kɛ eŋa kɛ ebii kɛ nii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ, ni akɛwo nyɔmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The official got down on his knees and began begging, “Have pity on me, and I will pay you every cent I owe!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni tsulɔ lɛ ho gbee enaji anaa ni ekpa lɛ fai ekɛɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, too otsui shi ohã mi, ni mawo bo nyɔmɔ lɛ fɛɛ!’

english_verse: The king felt sorry for him and let him go free. He even told the official that he did not have to pay back the money.
translation_verse: Ni tsulɔ nɛɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ musuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ ni eŋmɛɛ ehe, ni ekɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ ke lɛ.

english_verse: The man got down on his knees and began begging, “Have pity on me, and I will pay you back.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni enaanyo tsulɔ lɛ ho kula shi ekpa lɛ fai ekɛɛ, ‘Too otsui shi ohã mi, ni mawo bo nyɔmɔ lɛ fɛɛ!’

english_verse: But the first official refused to have pity. Instead, he went and had the other official put in jail until he could pay what he owed.
translation_verse: Shi lɛ lɛ ekpɛlɛɛɛ; shi moŋ eyawo lɛ tsuŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeewo lɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: When some other officials found out what had happened, they felt sorry for the man who had been put in jail. Then they told the king what had happened.
translation_verse: Shi be ni enanemɛi tsuji lɛ na nɔ ni ba lɛ, edɔ amɛ tsɔ̃, ni amɛbagba amɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: The king called the first official back in and said, “You're an evil man! When you begged for mercy, I said you did not have to pay back a cent.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni enuŋtsɔ lɛ hã ayatsɛ lɛ kɛba, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Tsulɔ fɔŋ! Akɛni okpa mi fai hewɔ lɛ mikɛ nɛkɛ nyɔmɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ ke bo.

english_verse: The king was so angry that he ordered the official to be tortured until he could pay back everything he owed.
translation_verse: Ni enuŋtsɔ lɛ mli fu, ni ekɛ lɛ hã ni apiŋ lɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeebawo lɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: That is how my Father in heaven will treat you, if you don't forgive each of my followers with all your heart.
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ miTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hu aaafee nyɛ, kɛji nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enyɛmi tɔ̃mɔ ekeee lɛ kɛjɛɛɛ etsuiŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: When Jesus finished teaching, he left Galilee and went to the part of Judea east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni Yesu egbe wiemɔi nɛɛ anaa lɛ, eje Galilea eba Yudea kpokpai lɛ anɔ yɛ Yordan sɛɛ;

english_verse: Some people are unable to marry because of birth defects or because of what someone has done to their bodies. Others stay single in order to serve God better. Anyone who can accept this teaching should do so.” Jesus Blesses Little Children (Mark
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ osaii komɛi yɛ ni afɔ amɛ nakai kɛjɛ amɛnyɛmɛi amusu mli; ni osaii komɛi yɛ ni gbɔmɛi sa amɛ; ni osaii lɛ ekrokomɛi hu yɛ ni ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ hewɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsa amɛhe. Mɔ ni aaanyɛ mli amɔ lɛ, emɔ mli!” Yesu jɔɔ gbekɛbii (Marko

english_verse: Large crowds followed him, and he healed their sick.
translation_verse: ni mɛi pii nyiɛ esɛɛ ni etsatsaa amɛ yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: Some Pharisees wanted to test Jesus. They came up to him and asked, “Is it right for a man to divorce his wife for just any reason?”
translation_verse: Ni Farisifoi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛbatsɔ̃ lɛ amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Ani eja akɛ nuu shwieɔ eŋa yɛ sane fɛɛ sane hewɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Don't you know in the beginning the Creator made a man and a woman?
translation_verse: Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛkaneko akɛ, mɔ ni bɔ gbɔmɔ yɛ shishijee lɛ mli lɛ, nuu kɛ yoo ebɔ amɛ?

english_verse: That's why a man leaves his father and mother and gets married. He becomes like one person with his wife.
translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ, ‘Enɛ hewɔ ni nuu aaashi etsɛ kɛ enyɛ ni eeekpɛtɛ eŋa he, ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaatsɔ̃ heloo kome lɛ.’

english_verse: Then they are no longer two people, but one. And no one should separate a couple God has joined together.”
translation_verse: Belɛ agbɛnɛ amɛjeee mɛi enyɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ heloo kome; no hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛtsa lɛ, akahã gbɔmɔ miigbala mli.”

english_verse: The Pharisees asked Jesus, “Why did Moses say a man could write out divorce papers and send his wife away?”
translation_verse: Amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ ni Mose wo kitã akɛ ahã shwiemɔ wolo ni ashwie lɛ lɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “You are so heartless! That's why Moses allowed you to divorce your wife. But from the beginning God did not intend it to be that way.
translation_verse: Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsuiwalɛ hewɔ ni Mose hã nyɛ hegbɛ akɛ nyɛshwie nyɛŋamɛi lɛ; shi shishijee lɛ mli lɛ ebɛ nakai.

english_verse: I say if your wife has not committed some terrible sexual sin, you must not divorce her to marry someone else. If you do, you are unfaithful.”
translation_verse: Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jeee ajwamãŋbɔɔ hewɔ jɛ ni eeeshwie eŋa ni eyaŋɔ yoo kroko lɛ efite gbãlã; [ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ŋɔɔ yoo ni ashwie lɛ lɛ, lɛ hu efiteɔ gbãlã.”]

english_verse: Jesus told them, “Only those people who have been given the gift of staying single can accept this teaching.
translation_verse: Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Jeee mɛi fɛɛ aaanyɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ mli amɔ, ja mɛi ni akɛhã lɛ kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Some people brought their children to Jesus, so he could place his hands on them and pray for them. His disciples told the people to stop bothering him.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni akɛ gbekɛbii bibii ba eŋɔɔ, koni ekɛ eniji ashwie amɛnɔ ni esɔle ehã amɛ. Shi ekaselɔi lɛ fãmɔ amɛ.

english_verse: A man came to Jesus and asked, “Teacher, what good thing must I do to have eternal life?”
translation_verse: Ni mɔ ko ba eŋɔɔ ni ebabi lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, mɛɛ nɔ kpakpa po mafee ni mana naanɔ wala?”

english_verse: After Jesus had placed his hands on the children, he left. A Rich Young Man (Mark
translation_verse: Ni ekɛ eniji shwie amɛnɔ; ni eje jɛi. Oblanyo niiatsɛ lɛ (Marko

english_verse: Jesus said to him, “Why do you ask me about what is good? Only God is good. If you want to have eternal life, you must obey his commandments.”
translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba obiɔ mi nɔ kpakpa he sane? Mɔ kome yɔɔ ni ji mɔ kpakpa [lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ]. Shi kɛji ootao akɛ obote wala mli lɛ, ye kitãi lɛ anɔ.”

english_verse: But Jesus said, “Let the children come to me, and don't try to stop them! People who are like these children belong to God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Shi Yesu kɛɛ, “Nyɛhãa gbekɛbii lɛ abaa miŋɔɔ, ni nyɛkatsia amɛ gbɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi ni tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi anɔ ji ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.”

english_verse: But many who are now first will be last, and many who are last will be first.
translation_verse: Shi klɛŋklɛŋ bii pii aaatsɔ̃mɔ sɛɛkpee bii, ni sɛɛkpee bii aaatsɔ̃mɔ klɛŋklɛŋ bii.”

english_verse: Respect your father and mother. And love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ; kɛ suɔmɔ onaanyo gbɔmɔ tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe lɛ.”

english_verse: The young man said, “I have obeyed all of these. What else must I do?”
translation_verse: Oblanyo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ miye nɔ kɛjɛ migbekɛbiiashi. Mɛni shwɛɔ mi lolo?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If you want to be perfect, go sell everything you own! Give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven. Then come and be my follower.”
translation_verse: Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji ootao akɛ ohi kɛwula shi lɛ, yaa ni oyahɔ̃ɔ nii ni oyɔɔ lɛ, ni okɛhã ohiafoi, ni ooona jwetri yɛ ŋwɛi; ni oba obanyiɛ misɛɛ.”

english_verse: When the young man heard this, he went away sad, because he was very rich.
translation_verse: Shi be ni oblanyo lɛ nu wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, eyiŋ etee kɛ dɔlɛ; ejaakɛ eyɛ nii babaoo.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “I tell you, it's terribly hard for rich people to get into the kingdom of heaven!
translation_verse: Ni Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ ewa hã niiatsɛ akɛ eeebote ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.

english_verse: In fact, it's easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Shi asaŋ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ ejaraaa hãaa yooma akɛ eeetsɔ̃ abui hiŋmɛi mli, tamɔ bɔ ni ejaraa hãa niiatsɛ akɛ eeebote Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ.”

english_verse: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly surprised and asked, “How can anyone ever be saved?”
translation_verse: Ni be ni ekaselɔi lɛ nu lɛ, amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe tsɔ̃ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Belɛ namɔ yiwala aaanyɛ ahere mɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus looked straight at them and said, “There are some things people cannot do, but God can do anything.”
translation_verse: Shi Yesu kwɛ amɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɛi agbɛfaŋ lɛ anyɛŋ enɛ afee; shi Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ aaanyɛ nii fɛɛ afee.” Yesu sɛɛnyiɛmɔ mli nyɔmɔwoo (Marko

english_verse: Peter replied, “Remember, we have left everything to be your followers! What will we get?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Petro here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Naa, wɔ lɛ wɔshi nii fɛɛ, ni wɔbanyiɛ osɛɛ; belɛ mɛni wɔbaana?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: Yes, all of you have become my followers. And so in the future world, when the Son of Man sits on his glorious throne, I promise you will sit on twelve thrones to judge the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛnyiɛ misɛɛ nɛɛ, be ni Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaata enunyam sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ yɛ jeŋ hee lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛaatara sɛ̃ii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ nɔ, ni nyɛaakojo Israel akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ.

english_verse: All who have given up home or brothers and sisters or father and mother or children or land for me will be given
translation_verse: Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshi shĩai loo nyɛmimɛi hii loo nyɛmimɛi yei loo tsɛ loo nyɛ loo ŋa loo bii loo shikpɔji yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, aaato lɛ najiaŋ toi oha, ni eeena naanɔ wala.

english_verse: As Jesus was telling what the kingdom of heaven would be like, he said: Early one morning a man went out to hire some workers for his vineyard.
translation_verse: “Ejaakɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ nuu shĩatsɛ ko ni je kpo maŋkɛ mra ni eyabɔ nitsulɔi apaa kɛya ewaintrom mli.

english_verse: After he had agreed to pay them the usual amount for a day's work, he sent them off to his vineyard.
translation_verse: Ni be ni ekɛ nitsulɔi lɛ eye naa denario kome jenamɔ lɛ, ewo amɛ gbɛ kɛtee ewaintrom lɛ mli.

english_verse: About nine that morning, the man saw some other people standing in the market with nothing to do.
translation_verse: Ni kɛbaa ŋmɛlɛ nɛɛhu mli lɛ, eje kpo ekoŋŋ ni eyana mɛi krokomɛi damɔ shi efolo yɛ jaa lɛ nɔ;

english_verse: He promised to pay them what was fair, if they would work in his vineyard.
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi hu akɛ, ‘Nyɛ hu nyɛyaa waintrom lɛ mli, ni nɔ ni sa lɛ, mahã nyɛ,’ ni amɛtee.

english_verse: So they went. At noon and again about three in the afternoon he returned to the market. And each time he made the same agreement with others who were loafing around with nothing to do.
translation_verse: Asaŋ kɛbaa ŋmɛlɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ mli kɛ ŋmɛji etɛ̃ mli lɛ eje kpo, ni eyafee nakai nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Finally, about five in the afternoon the man went back and found some others standing there. He asked them, “Why have you been standing here all day long doing nothing?”
translation_verse: Ni kɛbaa gbɛkɛ ŋmɛji enumɔ mli lɛ eje kpo ni eyana mɛi krokomɛi hu damɔ shi efolo, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛɛba ni nyɛdamɔ shi efolo yɛ biɛ jenamɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ nɛɛ?’

english_verse: “Because no one has hired us,” they answered. Then he told them to go work in his vineyard.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Akɛni mɔ ko ebɔko wɔ apaa lɛ hewɔŋ.’ Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛ hu nyɛyaa waintrom lɛ mli.’

english_verse: That evening the owner of the vineyard told the man in charge of the workers to call them in and give them their money. He also told the man to begin with the ones who were hired last.
translation_verse: “Agbɛnɛ be ni shɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, waintromtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ etsulɔ nukpa lɛ akɛ, ‘Tsɛ nitsulɔi lɛ ni owo amɛ nyɔmɔ, ni obɔ̃i kɛjɛ sɛɛkpee bii lɛ anɔ kɛyashi klɛŋklɛŋ bii lɛ anɔ.’

english_verse: When the workers arrived, the ones who had been hired at five in the afternoon were given a full day's pay.
translation_verse: Ni be ni gbɛkɛ ŋmɛji enumɔ bii lɛ ba lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛna denario komekome.

english_verse: they began complaining to the owner of the vineyard.
translation_verse: Shi be ni eshɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ, amɛshɛ tɔkemɔ kɛ shĩatsɛ lɛ woo

english_verse: They said, “The ones who were hired last worked for only one hour. But you paid them the same that you did us. And we worked in the hot sun all day long!”
translation_verse: akɛ, ‘Sɛɛkpee bii nɛɛ; ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome kɛkɛ amɛtsu nii, ni ohã amɛ kɛ wɔ ni wɔtsu nii jenamɔ ni etɔ wɔ ni latsaa etsa wɔ lɛ fɛɛ pɛ!’

english_verse: The owner answered one of them, “Friend, I didn't cheat you. I paid you exactly what we agreed on.
translation_verse: Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛteŋ mɔ kome akɛ, ‘Naanyo, mifeko bo efɔŋ ko; ani jeee denario okɛ mi ye naa?

english_verse: Take your money now and go! What business is it of yours if I want to pay them the same that I paid you?
translation_verse: Ŋɔɔ nɔ ni ji onɔ lɛ ni oya. Shi miisumɔ akɛ mahã sɛɛkpee mɔ nɛɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mihã bo lɛ nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Don't I have the right to do what I want with my own money? Why should you be jealous, if I want to be generous?”
translation_verse: Aloo mibɛ hegbɛ akɛ mikɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ minii feɔ nɔ ni misumɔɔ? Ani mimlihilɛ lɛ hewɔ ohiŋmɛi etsu nɛɛ?’

english_verse: Jesus then said, “So it is. Everyone who is now last will be first, and everyone who is first will be last.” Jesus Again Tells about His Death (Mark
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ ni sɛɛkpeebii aaatsɔ̃mɔ klɛŋklɛŋbii, ni klɛŋklɛŋbii aaatsɔ̃mɔ sɛɛkpeebii; [ejaakɛ atsɛ mɛi pii, shi mɛi fioo ahala.]” Yesu wie egbele kɛ eshitee he nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃ (Marko

english_verse: When Jesus heard them, he stopped and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?”
translation_verse: Ni Yesu wa damɔ shi ni etsɛ amɛ, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ mifee mihã nyɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus felt sorry for them and touched their eyes. At once they could see, and they became his followers.
translation_verse: Ni Yesu musuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ, ni etara amɛhiŋmɛii lɛ ahe, ni amrɔ lɛ amɛna nii, ni amɛnyiɛ esɛɛ.

english_verse: The crowd told them to be quiet, but they shouted even louder, “Lord and Son of David, have pity on us!”
translation_verse: Shi asafo lɛ famɔ amɛyi akɛ amɛmua amɛnaa; shi amɛbolɔ moŋ fe tsutsu lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ David Bi, naa wɔ mɔbɔ!”

english_verse: As Jesus was on his way to Jerusalem, he took his twelve disciples aside and told them in private:
translation_verse: Ni be ni Yesu yaa Yerusalɛm lɛ, ekɛ ekaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ tee afã yɛ gbɛteŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ amɛ nigii akɛ,

english_verse: and then they will hand him over to foreigners who will make fun of him. They will beat him and nail him to a cross. But on the third day he will rise from death. A Mother's Request (Mark
translation_verse: Ni amɛkɛ lɛ aaahã jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ ni amɛye ehe fɛo ni amɛkɛ kpelebii ayi lɛ ni amɛsɛŋ lɛ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ aaatee lɛ shi.” Yakobo kɛ Yohane nibimɔ lɛ (Marko

english_verse: The mother of James and John came to Jesus with her two sons. She knelt down and started begging him to do something for her.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Zebedeo bii lɛ anyɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ebakula shi ni eba lɛ nɔ ko.

english_verse: Jesus asked her what she wanted, and she said, “When you come into your kingdom, please let one of my sons sit at your right side and the other at your left.”
translation_verse: Ni Yesu bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni otaoɔ?” Ehere lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ ni mibii enyɔ nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ata oninejurɔ nɔ, ni mɔ kome hu ata obɛku nɔ yɛ omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Not one of you knows what you are asking. Are you able to drink from the cup that I must soon drink from?” James and John said, “Yes, we are!”
translation_verse: Shi Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ bii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛleee nɔ ni nyɛbiɔ lɛ. Ani nyɛaanyɛ kpulu ni mibanu lɛ nyɛnu?” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔɔnyɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “You certainly will drink from my cup! But it isn't for me to say who will sit at my right side and at my left. This is for my Father to say.”
translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mikpulu lɛ nyɛaanu moŋ shi mininejurɔ kɛ mibɛku nɔ tamɔ lɛ, ejeee minɔ ni mikɛhãa, shi moŋ mɛi ni miTsɛ esaa eto amɛ lɛ anɔŋ.”

english_verse: When the ten other disciples heard this, they were angry with the two brothers.
translation_verse: Ni be ni mɛi nyɔŋma lɛ nu lɛ, amɛmli wo nyɛmimɛi enyɔ lɛ la.

english_verse: But Jesus called the disciples together and said: You know foreign rulers like to order their people around. And their great leaders have full power over everyone they rule.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu tsɛ amɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛle akɛ jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ lumɛi lɛ yeɔ amɛnɔ akɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi, ni amɛteŋ gbɔmɛi agboi lɛ hu yɛ amɛnɔ hewalɛ.

english_verse: But don't act like them. If you want to be great, you must be the servant of all the others.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛ lɛ ebɛ nyɛ nakai; shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taoɔ agbo atsɔ̃ yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, efee ehe nyɛsɔ̃ɔlɔ;

english_verse: And if you want to be first, you must be the slave of the rest.
translation_verse: ni mɔ ni taoɔ nyɛteŋ onukpa atsɔ̃ lɛ, efee ehe nyɛtsulɔ.

english_verse: The Son of Man did not come to be a slave master, but a slave who will give his life to rescue many people. Jesus Heals Two Blind Men (Mark
translation_verse: Tamɔ bɔ ni Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baaa ni asɔmɔ lɛ, shi eba sɔ̃ɔmɔ moŋ ni ekɛ esusuma lɛ ahã yɛ mɛi pii akpɔ̃mɔ hewɔ lɛ.” Yesu tsa shwilafoi enyɔ (Marko

english_verse: Jesus was followed by a large crowd as he and his disciples were leaving Jericho.
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛjɛ Yeriko amɛyaa lɛ, asafo babaoo nyiɛ esɛɛ.

english_verse: Two blind men were sitting beside the road. And when they heard that Jesus was coming their way, they shouted, “Lord and Son of David, have pity on us!”
translation_verse: Ni hii shwilafoi enyɔ tara gbɛ lɛ toi, ni be ni amɛnu akɛ Yesu miiho lɛ, amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ David Bi, naa wɔ mɔbɔ!”

english_verse: They answered, “Lord, we want to see!”
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, akɛ agbele wɔhiŋmɛii lɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus said: I will tell you a story about a man who had two sons. Then you can tell me what you think. The father went to the older son and said, “Go work in the vineyard today!”
translation_verse: “Shi agbɛnɛ te nyɛsusuɔ tɛŋŋ? Nuu ko yɛ bii enyɔ; ni etee mɔ kome ŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, ‘Mibi; ŋmɛnɛ yaatsu nii yɛ miwaintrom lɛ mli.’

english_verse: But when they saw the man's son, they said, “Someday he will own the vineyard. Let's kill him! Then we can have it all for ourselves.”
translation_verse: Shi hulɔi lɛ, be ni amɛna binuu lɛ moŋ lɛ, amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Niyelɔ lɛ nɛ! Nyɛbaa, nyɛhãa wɔgbea lɛ, koni wɔŋɔ egboshinii lɛ.’

english_verse: If anyone asks why you are doing this, just say, ‘The Lord needs them.’ He will at once let you have the donkeys.”
translation_verse: Ni kɛ mɔ ko bi nyɛ sane ko lɛ, nyɛkɛa lɛ akɛ, ‘Amɛhe miihia Nuŋtsɔ lɛ;’ ni amrɔ lɛ eeehã nyɛkɛ amɛ aba.”

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet had said,
translation_verse: Shi afee enɛ fɛɛ koni nɔ ni gbalɔ lɛ wie lɛ aba mli akɛ,

english_verse: “Announce to the people of Jerusalem: ‘Your king is coming to you! He is humble and rides on a donkey. He comes on the colt of a donkey.’ ”
translation_verse: “Nyɛkɛa Zion biyoo lɛ akɛ, naa, omaŋtsɛ lɛ miiba oŋɔɔ. Ehe jɔ, ni eta teji nɔ kɛ teji ni ji nitsumɔ kooloo lɛ bi nɔ.”

english_verse: The disciples left and did what Jesus had told them to do.
translation_verse: Ni kaselɔi lɛ tee amɛyafee bɔ ni Yesu fã amɛ lɛ.

english_verse: They brought the donkey and its colt and laid some clothes on their backs. Then Jesus got on.
translation_verse: Ni amɛkɛ teji lɛ kɛ ebi lɛ ba, ni amɛkɛ amɛtadei lɛ shwie amɛnɔ, ni eho eta nɔ.

english_verse: When Jesus came to Jerusalem, everyone in the city was excited and asked, “Who can this be?”
translation_verse: Ni be ni ebote Yerusalɛm lɛ, maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ bu hoo amɛkɛɛ, “Namɔ nɛ?”

english_verse: But the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses were angry when they saw his miracles and heard the children shouting praises to the Son of David.
translation_verse: Shi be ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ na naakpɛɛnii ni efee kɛ gbekɛbii lɛ ni bolɔɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ akɛ, “Hosiana David Bi!” lɛ, amɛmli wo la,

english_verse: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard these stories, they knew Jesus was talking about them.
translation_verse: Ni be ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ nu ebɛi lɛ, amɛkɔ sɛɛ akɛ amɛ amɛhe ewieɔ lɛ.

english_verse: He told them, “The Scriptures say, ‘My house should be called a place of worship.’ But you have turned it into a place where robbers hide.”
translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Aŋma akɛ, ‘Aaatsɛ miwe lɛ Sɔlemɔ we,’ shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛfee ojotswalɔi abu.”

english_verse: If you have faith when you pray, you will be given whatever you ask for.” A Question about Jesus' Authority (Mark
translation_verse: Ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛaasɔle nyɛbi kɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ, nyɛnine aaashɛ nɔ.” Hegbɛ ni Yesu yɔɔ (Marko

english_verse: The men said to Jesus, “Don't you hear what those children are saying?” “Yes, I do!” Jesus answered. “Don't you know that the Scriptures say, ‘Children and infants will sing praises’?”
translation_verse: ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Oonu nɔ ni mɛnɛɛmɛi kɛɔ nɛɛ lo?” Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Hɛɛ, ani nyɛkaneko dã akɛ, ‘Abifabii kɛ fufɔbii anaa osaa yijiemɔ oto yɛ?’ ”

english_verse: Then Jesus left the city and went out to the village of Bethany, where he spent the night. Jesus Puts a Curse on a Fig Tree (Mark

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You travel over land and sea to win one follower. And when you have done so, you make that person twice as fit for hell as you are.
translation_verse: “Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, osatofoi! Nyɛbɔleɔ ŋshɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ kpula, koni nyɛfee mɔ kome Yudafonyo; ni be ni mɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ nakai lɛ, nyɛfeɔ lɛ abonsamiiaje bi toi enyɔ fe nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You are supposed to lead others, but you are blind. You teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the temple. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gold in the temple.
translation_verse: “Kpoo hã nyɛ, gbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔi shwilafoi! Nyɛ ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɔ ni aaakã Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ kitã lɛ, no jeee nɔ ko; shi mɔ ni aaakã Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ he shika ŋmiiŋmi lɛ kitã lɛ, efiɔ lɛ.’

english_verse: You blind fools! Which is greater, the gold or the temple that makes the gold sacred?
translation_verse: Shwilafoi kwashiai! Te nɔ ni feŋ, shika ŋmiiŋmi lɛ, loo Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ni hãa shika ŋmiiŋmi lɛ feɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ?

english_verse: You also teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the altar. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gift on the altar.
translation_verse: Ni asaŋ, ‘Mɔ ni aaakã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kitã lɛ, no jeee nɔ ko; shi mɔ ni aaakã enɔ afɔle lɛ kitã lɛ, efiɔ lɛ.’

english_verse: Are you blind? Which is more important, the gift or the altar that makes the gift sacred?
translation_verse: Shwilafoi kwashiai! Te nɔ ni feŋ, afɔle lɛ, loo afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni hãa afɔle lɛ feɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ?

english_verse: And anyone who swears by the temple also swears by God, who lives there.
translation_verse: Ni mɔ ni kãa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ kitã lɛ, ekã no kɛ mɔ ni hiɔ mli lɛ kitã.

english_verse: To swear by heaven is the same as swearing by God's throne and by the one who sits on that throne.
translation_verse: Ni mɔ ni kãa ŋwɛi kitã lɛ, ekã Nyɔŋmɔ sɛ̃i lɛ kɛ mɔ ni ta nɔ lɛ hu kitã.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You give God a tenth of the spices from your garden, such as mint, dill, and cumin. Yet you neglect the more important matters of the Law, such as justice, mercy, and faithfulness. These are the important things you should have done, though you should not have left the others undone either.
translation_verse: “Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, osatofoi! Nyɛhãa kowɛ kɛ anisi kɛ kumino mlijaa nyɔŋmanyɔŋma, shi Mla lɛ mli nii ni he jaraa ni ji jalɛ saneyeli kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ nyɛshiɔ; enɛɛmɛi sa akɛ nyɛfeɔ kɛshiɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: You blind leaders! You strain out a small fly but swallow a camel.
translation_verse: Gbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔi shwilafoi nyɛtsereɔ nɔ nɔ adɔ̃dɔ̃ŋ, shi nyɛmiɔ yooma!

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You wash the outside of your cups and dishes, while inside there is nothing but greed and selfishness.
translation_verse: “Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, osatofoi! Nyɛtsumɔɔ kpulu he kɛ kã sɛɛ; shi amɛmligbɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ojotswaa kɛ adufudeyeli.

english_verse: You blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of a cup, and then the outside will also be clean.
translation_verse: “Farisifonyo shwilafo, sha kpulu lɛ kɛ kã lɛ mli ni aje tsutsu, kɛkɛ lɛ esɛɛ hu aaaje!

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You're like tombs that have been whitewashed. On the outside they are beautiful, but inside they are full of bones and filth.
translation_verse: “Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, osatofoi! Nyɛtamɔ gbohii asaŋi ni asha he ni amɛhewɔ efee fɛo moŋ, shi amɛmligbɛ lɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ gbohii awui kɛ muji nibii srɔtoi fɛɛ.

english_verse: That's what you are like. Outside you look good, but inside you are evil and only pretend to be good.
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu, yɛ kpo nɔ gbɛ lɛ, nyɛpueɔ akɛ jalɔi yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ, shi yɛ mligbɛ lɛ nyɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ osato kɛ mlatɔ̃mɔ̃.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are nothing but show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You build monuments for the prophets and decorate the tombs of good people.
translation_verse: “Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, osatofoi! Nyɛmãmɔɔ gbalɔi lɛ atoohei, ni nyɛwulaa jalɔi lɛ asaŋi lɛ,

english_verse: And you claim you would not have taken part with your ancestors in killing the prophets.
translation_verse: ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Eji wɔtsɛmɛi ayinɔ lɛ wɔyɛ jeŋ kulɛ, wɔfataŋ amɛhe kɛshwieŋ gbalɔi lɛ alá shi.’

english_verse: But you prove you really are the relatives of the ones who killed the prophets.
translation_verse: Belɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛmiiye nyɛhe odase akɛ mɛi ni gbe gbalɔi lɛ abii ji nyɛ.

english_verse: So keep on doing everything they did.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hu nyɛwoa nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ asusumɔ tsene lɛ obɔ̃ mɔ!

english_verse: You are nothing but snakes and the children of snakes! How can you escape going to hell?
translation_verse: Onufui, shikpãi ashwiei! Te nyɛaafee tɛŋŋ nyɛjo abonsamiiaje fɔbuu lɛ naa foiŋ?

translation_verse: Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ aaaba yinɔbii nɛɛ anɔ.” Yesu ye Yerusalɛm he jaramɔ

translation_verse: Ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛjɛ be nɛɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ nyɛnaŋ mi dɔŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Ajɔɔ mɔ ni baa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi mli lɛ.’ ”

translation_verse: Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Te nyɛmiina nii nɛɛ fɛɛ? Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, ashiŋ tɛ kome yɛ eko nɔ yɛ biɛ ni akpãŋ aluŋ shi.” Amanehului ashishijee (Marko

english_verse: It will be a terrible time for women who are expecting babies or nursing young children.
translation_verse: Shi kpoo hã yei ni hiɛ musu kɛ yei ni hãa fufɔ yɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ!

english_verse: But this is just the beginning of troubles.
translation_verse: Shi enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ kɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ ashishijee ni.

english_verse: You will be arrested, punished, and even killed. Because of me, you will be hated by people of all nations.
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ amɛaaŋɔ nyɛ amɛwo amanehulu mli, ni amɛaagbe nyɛ; ni migbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ jeŋmaji fɛɛ aaanyɛ nyɛ.

translation_verse: Ni nakai be lɛ mli lɛ mɛi pii anane aaatɔ̃tɔ̃ ni amɛaatsɔ̃ɔtsɔ̃ɔ amɛnanemɛi asɛɛgbɛ, ni amɛaanyɛnyɛɛ amɛhe.

translation_verse: Ni amale gbalɔi pii aaate shi, ni amɛaalaka mɛi pii.

translation_verse: No mli lɛ, kɛji mɔ ko kɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, Kristo lɛ yɛ biɛ loo biɛ lɛ’, nyɛkahea nyɛyea.

english_verse: And pray that you won't have to escape in winter or on a Sabbath.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛsɔlea, koni nyɛfoijee lɛ akaba yɛ fɛ̃i be lɛ mli aloo yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Someday you will see that “Horrible Thing” in the holy place, just as the prophet Daniel said. Everyone who reads this must try to understand!

translation_verse: No lɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Yudea lɛ ajo foi amɛya gɔji lɛ anɔ;

english_verse: If you are out in the field, don't go back for your coat.
translation_verse: ni mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋmɔshi lɛ, ekaaku esɛɛ eyakɔ etade.

english_verse: If God doesn't make the time shorter, no one will be left alive. But because of God's chosen ones, he will make the time shorter.
translation_verse: Ni kɛ afooo nakai gbii lɛ anɔ lɛ, ahereŋ heloo ko heloo ko yiwala; shi mɛi ni ahala lɛ ahewɔ lɛ aaafo nɔ.

english_verse: So when you see all these things happening, you will know the time has almost come.
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu, kɛ nyɛna nii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛlea akɛ eshɛ agboi lɛ anaa etã.

english_verse: When the Son of Man appears, things will be just as they were when Noah lived.
translation_verse: Shi bɔ ni Noa gbii lɛ fee lɛ, nakai Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baa lɛ hu aaatamɔ.

english_verse: No one knows the day or hour. The angels in heaven don't know, and the Son himself doesn't know. Only the Father knows.
translation_verse: “Shi nakai gbi lɛ kɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko leee nɔ ko yɛ he, bɔfoi ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ tete leee, ni Bi lɛ leee, ja Tsɛ lɛ kome kɛkɛ.

english_verse: People were eating, drinking, and getting married right up to the day the flood came and Noah went into the big boat.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ gbii ni nyiɛ nu afua lɛ hiɛ lɛ amli, ni mɛi lɛ hiɛ niyeli kɛ ninumɔ kɛ yooŋɔɔ kɛ gbãlãhamɔ mli aahu kɛyashi gbi ni Noa yabote adeka lɛ mli,

translation_verse: No mli lɛ mɛi enyɔ aaahi ŋmɔshi; aaaŋɔ mɔ kome, ni aaashi mɔ kome lɛ.

english_verse: So be on your guard! You don't know when your Lord will come.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsaraa, ejaakɛ nyɛleee nɔ gbi nɔ ni nyɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ baa.

english_verse: Homeowners never know when a thief is coming, and they are always on guard to keep one from breaking in.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛkaia akɛ, kɛ shĩatsɛ ko le nɔ ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɔ ni julɔ baa lɛ, kulɛ eeesra ni eŋmɛŋ gbɛ ni agbu ewe lɛ awoŋ.

english_verse: When the Son of Man comes in his glory with all his angels, he will sit on his royal throne.
translation_verse: “Shi be ni Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaaba yɛ enunyam lɛ mli, ni bɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ aaafata ehe lɛ, no mli lɛ eeeta enunyam sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ;

english_verse: The people of all nations will be brought before him, and he will separate them, as shepherds separate their sheep from their goats.
translation_verse: ni aaabua jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ anaa yɛ ehiɛ, ni eeegbala amɛmli tamɔ bɔ ni tookwɛlɔ gbalaa gwantɛŋi kɛ abotiai amli lɛ.

english_verse: He will place the sheep on his right and the goats on his left.
translation_verse: Ni ekɛ gwantɛŋi lɛ aaadamɔ eninejurɔ nɔ, shi abotiai lɛ ekɛ amɛ aaadamɔ ebɛku nɔ.

english_verse: Then the king will say to those on his right, “My father has blessed you! Come and receive the kingdom that was prepared for you before the world was created.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ Maŋtsɛ lɛ aaakɛɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ eninejurɔ nɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛbaa, nyɛ mɛi ni miTsɛ ejɔɔ nyɛ, nyɛbaŋɔa maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ni asaa ato nyɛ kɛjɛ jeŋ shishijee lɛ!

english_verse: When I was hungry, you gave me something to eat, and when I was thirsty, you gave me something to drink. When I was a stranger, you welcomed me,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ hɔ̃mɔ ye mi, ni nyɛhã mi nii miye; kumai ye mi, ni nyɛhã mi nu minu; gbɔ ji mi, ni nyɛhã mibato nyɛŋɔɔ;

english_verse: and when I was naked, you gave me clothes to wear. When I was sick, you took care of me, and when I was in jail, you visited me.”
translation_verse: minyiɛ yayai, ni nyɛwo mi atade; mihe ye, ni nyɛbasara mi; awo mi tsuŋ, ni nyɛba miŋɔɔ.’

english_verse: Then the ones who pleased the Lord will ask, “When did we give you something to eat or drink?
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ jalɔi lɛ aaahere lɛ nɔ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, te gbi ni wɔna bo akɛ hɔ̃mɔ miiye bo, ni wɔhã bo nii oyeŋ, aloo akɛ kumai miiye bo, ni wɔhã bo nɔ ko onuŋ?

english_verse: When did we welcome you as a stranger or give you clothes to wear
translation_verse: Ni te gbi ni wɔna bo akɛ gbɔ ji bo, ni wɔhã obato wɔŋɔɔŋ; aloo akɛ onyiɛ yayai ni wɔwo bo atade?

english_verse: or visit you while you were sick or in jail?”
translation_verse: Asaŋ te gbi ni wɔna bo akɛ ohe miiye aloo awo bo tsuŋ, ni wɔba oŋɔɔŋ?’

english_verse: The king will answer, “Whenever you did it for any of my people, no matter how unimportant they seemed, you did it for me.”
translation_verse: Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ aaahere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, gbii abɔ kɛ̃ ni nyɛfee nyɛhã minyɛmimɛi nɛɛ ateŋ bibioo kome lɛ, mi nɔŋŋ nyɛfee nyɛhã lɛ.’

english_verse: Then the king will say to those on his left, “Get away from me! You are under God's curse. Go into the everlasting fire prepared for the devil and his angels!
translation_verse: “Kɛkɛ lɛ eeekɛɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ ebɛku nɔ lɛ hu akɛ, ‘Nyɛjea minɔ, nyɛ mɛi ni alomɔ nyɛ, nyɛyaa naanɔ la lɛ ni asaa ato abonsam kɛ ebɔfoi lɛ mli!

english_verse: I was hungry, but you did not give me anything to eat, and I was thirsty, but you did not give me anything to drink.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ hɔ̃mɔ ye mi, ni nyɛhãaa mi nii maye; kumai ye mi, ni nyɛhãaa mi nu manu;

english_verse: I was a stranger, but you did not welcome me, and I was naked, but you did not give me any clothes to wear. I was sick and in jail, but you did not take care of me.”
translation_verse: gbɔ ji mi, ni nyɛhãaa mabato nyɛŋɔɔ; minyiɛ yayai, ni nyɛwooo mi atade; mihe ye ni asaŋ awo mi tsuŋ, ni nyɛbasaraaa mi.’

english_verse: Then the people will ask, “Lord, when did we fail to help you when you were hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in jail?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛ hu amɛaahere lɛ nɔ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, te gbi ni wɔna bo akɛ hɔmɔ miiye bo aloo kumai miiye bo aloo akɛ gbɔ ji bo aloo onyiɛ yayai aloo ohe miiye aloo awo bo tsuŋ, ni wɔbasɔmɔɔɔ bo lɛ?’

english_verse: The king will say to them, “Whenever you failed to help any of my people, no matter how unimportant they seemed, you failed to do it for me.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ eeehere amɛ nɔ eeekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, gbii abɔ ni nyɛfeee nyɛhãaa mɛi bibii kwraa nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ, nyɛfeee nyɛhãaa mi hu!’

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “Those people will be punished forever. But the ones who pleased God will have eternal life.”
translation_verse: Ni mɛnɛɛmɛi lɛ, amɛaatee naanɔ hejaramɔ mli; shi jalɔi lɛ aaatee naanɔ wala mli.”

english_verse: Corinthians
translation_verse: Korintobii

english_verse: “You know two days from now will be Passover. This is when the Son of Man will be handed over to his enemies and nailed to a cross.”
translation_verse: “Nyɛle akɛ eshwɛ gbii enyɔ ni ayeɔ Hehoo lɛ, ni aaajie Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ahã ni asɛŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Finally, Jesus returned to his disciples and said, “Are you still sleeping and resting? The time has come for the Son of Man to be handed over to sinners.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni eba ekaselɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ lɛ nyɛhe ejɔ nyɛ ni nyɛwɔɔ nɛɛ? Naa; ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ etã, ni aaŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ awo eshafeelɔi adɛŋ.

english_verse: They planned how they could sneak around and have Jesus arrested and put to death.
translation_verse: Ni amɛtee apam, bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛmɔ Yesu ŋaa mli ni agbe lɛ;

english_verse: But they said, “We must not do it during Passover, because the people will riot.” At Bethany (Mark
translation_verse: shi amɛkɛɛ, “Jeee gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ, koni maŋ lɛ mli akabafee hirihiri.” Afɔ Yesu mu yɛ Betania (Marko

english_verse: We could have sold this perfume for a lot of money and given it to the poor.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mukɛŋma nɛɛ kulɛ aaanyɛ ahɔ̃ɔ ahe shika pii ni akɛhã ohiafoi.”

english_verse: But when his disciples saw this, they became angry and complained, “Why such a waste?
translation_verse: Shi be ni ekaselɔi lɛ na lɛ; amɛmli wo la amɛkɛɛ, “Te yaka nifitemɔ nɛɛ shishiŋ?

english_verse: Then they sang a hymn and went out to the Mount of Olives. Peter's Promise (Mark
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛla yijiemɔ lala ko lɛ, amɛje kpo amɛtee Mu gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Yesu gba bɔ ni Petro baakwa lɛ eto (Marko

english_verse: and from then on he started looking for a good chance to betray Jesus. Jesus Eats the Passover Meal with His Disciples (Mark
translation_verse: Ni kɛjɛ no be lɛ nɔ lɛ etao ehe gbɛ ni eŋɔ lɛ ewo amɛdɛŋ. Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ anaagbee niyenii (Marko

english_verse: When Jesus was eating with his twelve disciples that evening, he said, “One of you will surely hand me over to my enemies.”
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ kome baatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ.”

english_verse: On the first day of the Festival of Thin Bread, Jesus' disciples came to him and asked, “Where do you want us to prepare the Passover meal?”
translation_verse: Shi akpiti gbii juji lɛ amli klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ kaselɔi lɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ osumɔɔ akɛ wɔyasaa wɔhã bo ni oyaye Hehoo lɛ yɛ jɛi?”

english_verse: During the meal Jesus took some bread in his hands. He blessed the bread and broke it. Then he gave it to his disciples and said, “Take this and eat it. This is my body.”
translation_verse: Shi be ni amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, Yesu kɔ aboloo, ni ejɔɔ nɔ ni ekumɔ mli, ni ekɛhã ekaselɔi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛhea, nyɛyea! Enɛ ji migbɔmɔtso lɛ.”

english_verse: This is my blood, and with it God makes his agreement with you. It will be poured out, so that many people will have their sins forgiven.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ enɛ ji mila ni ji kpãŋmɔ hee lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni afɔse ashwie shi yɛ mɛi pii ahewɔ hã eshaifaa lɛ.

english_verse: From now on I am not going to drink any wine, until I drink new wine with you in my Father's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛjɛ benɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ minuŋ waintso yibii nɛɛ eko dɔŋŋ, kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni mikɛ nyɛ aaanu lɛ ehee yɛ miTsɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “During this very night, all of you will reject me, as the Scriptures say, ‘I will strike down the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ lɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛnane aaatɔ̃tɔ̃ yɛ mihewɔ; ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, ‘Matswa tookwɛlɔ lɛ nɔ, ni tooku lɛ aaagbɛ ashwã.’

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I promise you before a rooster crows tonight, you will say three times that you don't know me.”
translation_verse: Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ bo akɛ, nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ nɔŋŋ, dani wuɔ aaagbɛɛ lɛ, oookpa yɛ misɛɛ shii etɛ̃.”

english_verse: Jesus went with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane. When they got there, he told them, “Sit here while I go over there and pray.”
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ba he ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi Getsemane; ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtaraa shi yɛ biɛ, koni maya ni mayasɔle yɛ jɛi.”

english_verse: and he said to them, “I am so sad that I feel as if I am dying. Stay here and keep awake with me.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Misusuma were eho ehe kɛyaashi gbele mli tɔ̃ɔ, nyɛhia shi yɛ biɛ ni nyɛkɛ mi ashia kpe!”

english_verse: Peter spoke up, “Even if all the others reject you, I never will!”
translation_verse: Shi Petro here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɛi lɛ fɛɛ nane aaatɔ̃tɔ̃ yɛ ohewɔ lɛ, mi lɛ minane etɔ̃tɔ̃ŋ gbi ko gbi ko.”

english_verse: But Peter said, “Even if I have to die with you, I will never say I don't know you.” All the others said the same thing. Jesus Prays (Mark
translation_verse: Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji gbo mikɛ bo aaagbo tete lɛ mikpãŋ yɛ osɛɛ.” Nakai nɔŋŋ kaselɔi lɛ fɛɛ hu kɛɛ. Yesu yɛ Getsemane (Marko

english_verse: Again Jesus went to pray and said, “My Father, if there is no other way, and I must suffer, I will still do what you want.”
translation_verse: Eyiŋ etee ekoŋŋ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ, ni eyasɔle ekɛɛ, “MiTsɛ, kɛji kpulu nɛɛ nyɛŋ mihe aho aya akɛ ja minu lɛ, afee bɔ ni bo osumɔɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus walked on a little way. Then he knelt with his face to the ground and prayed, “My Father, if it is possible, don't make me suffer by drinking from this cup. But do what you want, and not what I want.”
translation_verse: Ni etee hiɛ fioo, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni esɔle ekɛɛ, “MiTsɛ, kɛji aaaho lɛ, hã ni kpulu nɛɛ aho mihe aya; shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee bɔ ni mi misumɔɔ, shi moŋ bɔ ni bo osumɔɔ.”

english_verse: Get up! Let's go. The one who will betray me is already here.” Jesus Is Arrested (Mark
translation_verse: Nyɛtea shi, nyɛhãa wɔyaa; naa, mɔ ni baatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ lɛ eshɛ shi etã.” Yesu sɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ emɔmɔ (Marko

english_verse: Jesus took along Peter and the two brothers, James and John. He was very sad and troubled,
translation_verse: Ni eŋɔ Petro kɛ Zebedeo bihii enyɔ lɛ efata ehe ni ewerɛ bɔ̃i ehe hoo ni ehao.

english_verse: He came back and found his disciples sleeping. So he said to Peter, “Can't any of you stay awake with me for just one hour?
translation_verse: Ni eba kaselɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni ena akɛ amɛwɔ, ni ekɛɛ Petro akɛ, “No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnyɛɛɛ nyɛkɛ mi ashi kpe ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome pɛ?

english_verse: Stay awake and pray that you won't be tested. You want to do what is right, but you are weak.”
translation_verse: Nyɛshia kpe ni nyɛsɔlea, koni nyɛkabote kaa mli; mumɔ lɛ miikpɛ̃lɛ̃ moŋ, shi heloo lɛ egbede.”

english_verse: He left them and prayed the same prayer once more.
translation_verse: Ni esaa eshi amɛ etee ekoŋŋ, ni eyasɔle nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃, ni ewie nakai wiemɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “My friend, do what you came for.” The men grabbed Jesus and arrested him.
translation_verse: Shi Yesu bi lɛ akɛ, “Naanyo, mɛni feemɔ oba yɛ biɛ?” Kɛkɛ ni mɛi lɛ batua Yesu ni amɛmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Jesus was still speaking, when Judas the betrayer came up. He was one of the twelve disciples, and a large mob armed with swords and clubs was with him. They had been sent by the chief priests and the nation's leaders.
translation_verse: Ni be ni ewieɔ lolo lɛ, naa, Yuda, mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ ba, ni asafo pii ni jɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ, kɛ lɛ nyiɛ, ni amɛhiɛ klantei kɛ kpotii.

english_verse: Judas had told them ahead of time, “Arrest the man I greet with a kiss.”
translation_verse: Shi esɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ eto amɛ okadi akɛ, “Mɔ naa ni mashwɔ lɛ, lɛ ni; nyɛmɔa lɛ!”

english_verse: Judas walked right up to Jesus and said, “Hello, teacher.” Then Judas kissed him.
translation_verse: Ni amrɔ lɛ eba Yesu ŋɔɔ ebakɛɛ, “Oshwiee, Rabi! Ni eshwɔ enaa.”

english_verse: One of Jesus' followers pulled out a sword. He struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his ear.
translation_verse: Ni naa, mɛi ni kɛ Yesu yɔɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kpã enine mli egbala eklante, ni ekɛbã osɔfonukpa lɛ tsulɔ, ni efo etoi.

english_verse: But Jesus told him, “Put your sword away. Anyone who lives by fighting will die by fighting.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛ oklante lɛ ato etoohe; ejaakɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni kɔlɔɔ klante lɛ, klante naa amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã yɛ.

english_verse: The high priest then tore his robe and said, “This man claims to be God! We don't need any more witnesses! You have heard what he said.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni osɔfonukpa lɛ gbala etadei ni ekɛɛ, “Ebɔ musu! Mɛni wɔsaa wɔtaoɔ odasefoi wɔfee dɔŋŋ? Naa, agbɛnɛ nyɛnu emusubɔɔ lɛ!

english_verse: But Jesus did not answer. So the high priest said, “With the living God looking on, you must tell the truth. Are you the Messiah, the Son of God?”
translation_verse: Shi Yesu etswaaa esɛŋ. Ni osɔfonukpa lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mina Nyɔŋmɔ, hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, akɛ kɛji bo ji Kristo, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, kɛɛmɔ wɔ!”

english_verse: When Peter had gone out to the gate, another servant girl saw him and said to some people there, “This man was with Jesus from Nazareth.”
translation_verse: Shi be ni Petro te shi etee koi lɛ shi lɛ, mɔ kroko hu na lɛ, ni ekɛɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ nɛ hu kɛ Yesu, Nazarenyo lɛ, yɔɔ.”

english_verse: After Jesus had been arrested, he was led off to the house of Caiaphas the high priest. The nation's leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses were meeting there.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ mɛi ni mɔ Yesu lɛ kpala lɛ kɛtee Kaiafa, osɔfonukpa lɛ; ŋɔɔ, yɛ he ni mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ebua amɛhe naa yɛ lɛ.

english_verse: But Peter followed along at a distance and came to the courtyard of the high priest's palace. He went in and sat down with the guards to see what was going to happen.
translation_verse: Shi Petro nyiɛ esɛɛ yɛ shɔŋŋ kɛtee osɔfonukpa lɛ mɔɔ lɛ mli, ni ebote jɛi ekɛ tsuji lɛ yata shi, koni ekwɛ bɔ ni naagbee aaatamɔ ahã.

english_verse: The chief priests and the whole council wanted to put Jesus to death. So they tried to find some people who would tell lies about him in court.
translation_verse: Shi osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ gwabɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ tao amale odase yɛ Yesu he, koni amɛgbe lɛ;

english_verse: But they could not find any, even though many did come and tell lies. At last, two men came forward
translation_verse: shi amɛnaaa eko; tsɛbelɛ amale odasefoi pii ba. Fee sɛɛ lɛ amale odasefoi enyɔ ba

english_verse: and said, “This man claimed he could tear down God's temple and build it again in three days.”
translation_verse: amɛbakɛɛ, “Mɔ nɛ kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Manyɛ makumɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni mama lɛ gbii etɛ̃.’ ”

english_verse: “That is what you say!” Jesus answered. “But I tell all of you, ‘Soon you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right side of God All-Powerful and coming on the clouds of heaven.’ ”
translation_verse: Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛɛ. Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛjɛ be nɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ, nyɛaana Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ akɛ eta Hewalɛ lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ, ni eeba yɛ ŋwɛi atatui lɛ amli.”

english_verse: Then they spit in his face and hit him with their fists. Others slapped him
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amɛfɛ̃ lajɔ̃ amɛshwie ehiɛ, ni amɛgbala lɛ mai; ni mɛi komɛi hu tswia lɛ nii

english_verse: and said, “You think you are the Messiah! So tell us who hit you!” Peter Says He Doesn't Know Jesus (Mark
translation_verse: amɛkɛɛ, “Kristo, gbaa otsɔ̃ɔ wɔ, namɔ ji mɔ ni yi bo lɛ?” Petro kwa Yesu (Marko

english_verse: Again Peter denied it, and this time he swore, “I don't even know that man!”
translation_verse: Ni etso ekoŋŋ kɛ kitãkãmɔ ekɛɛ, “Mileee gbɔmɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: While Peter was sitting out in the courtyard, a servant girl came up to him and said, “You were with Jesus from Galilee.”
translation_verse: Shi Petro ta sɛɛ flɛŋŋ yɛ kpo te lɛ mli; ni oblayoo ko ba eŋɔɔ bakɛɛ, “Bo hu te okɛ Yesu, Galileanyo lɛ, yɔɔ!”

english_verse: But in front of everyone Peter said, “That isn't so! I don't know what you are talking about!”
translation_verse: Shi etso yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Mileee nɔ ni okɛɔ nɛɛ.”

english_verse: A little while later some people standing there walked over to Peter and said, “We know you are one of them. We can tell it because you talk like someone from Galilee.”
translation_verse: Ni fee sɛɛ fioo lɛ, mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ bakɛɛ Petro akɛ, “Anɔkwale ji akɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ kome ji bo; ejaakɛ owiemɔ tete jieɔ bo shi!”

english_verse: Peter began to curse and swear, “I don't know that man!” Right then a rooster crowed,
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni ebɔ̃i loomɔ kɛ kitãkãmɔ akɛ, “Mileee gbɔmɔ lɛ!” Ni amrɔ lɛ wuɔ gbɛɛ.

english_verse: and Peter remembered that Jesus had said, “Before a rooster crows, you will say three times you don't know me.” Then Peter went out and cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Ni Petro kai Yesu wiemɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Dani wuɔ aaagbɛ lɛ, oookpa yɛ misɛɛ shii etɛ̃” lɛ. Ni eje kpo eyafo blobloblo.

english_verse: Pilate knew the leaders had brought Jesus to him because they were jealous.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ele akɛ hetsɛ̃ naa amɛkɛ lɛ hã.

english_verse: On the way they met a man named Simon who was from Cyrene, and they forced him to carry Jesus' cross.
translation_verse: Be ni amɛyaa lɛ; amɛna nuu Kirenenyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Simon, ni amɛnyɛ enɔ ni ewo Yesu sɛŋmɔtso lɛ.

english_verse: and said, “I have sinned by betraying a man who has never done anything wrong.” “So what? That's your problem,” they replied.
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ, “Mifee esha akɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ lá ni efɔŋ ko bɛ ehe lɛ sɛɛgbɛ.” Shi amɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “No jeee wɔhe sane ko; bo diɛŋtsɛ kwɛmɔ nɔ!”

english_verse: This is why people still call that place “Field of Blood.”
