translation_verse: Shi bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei, Zakaria, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ebo ofaikpamɔ lɛ toi, ni oŋa Elizabet aaafɔ binuu ahã bo, ni ooowo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yohane.

english_verse: His birth will make you very happy, and many people will be glad.
translation_verse: Eeehã ona miishɛɛ, ni omli aafli bo, ni mɛi pii aaanya efɔmɔ lɛ he.

english_verse: Your son will be a great servant of the Lord. He must never drink wine or beer, and the power of the Holy Spirit will be with him from the time he is born.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ eeetsɔ̃ agbo yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ. Ni enuŋ wain loo dãa ni wa ko, Ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ aaayi lɛ obɔ̃ kɛaajɛ enyɛ musuŋ beebe.

english_verse: John will lead many people in Israel to turn back to the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Ni eeekpale Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii kɛaaba Nuŋtsɔ, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ; ŋɔɔ.

english_verse: He will go ahead of the Lord with the same power and spirit that Elijah had. And because of John, parents will be more thoughtful of their children. And people who now disobey God will begin to think as they ought to. This is how John will get people ready for the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni eeetsɔ̃ ehiɛ yɛ Elia mumɔ kɛ ehewalɛ mli, ni eyadɔrɔ tsɛmɛi atsuii kɛba bii ahe, kɛ toigbolɔi hu kɛba jalɔi anilee mli, ni esaa maŋ ni efee klalo eto Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: Zechariah said to the angel, “How will I know this is going to happen? My wife and I are both very old.”
translation_verse: Ni Zakaria kɛɛ bɔfo lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni mikɛaale enɛ? Mi lɛ nuumo ji mi, ni miŋa hu egbɔ.”

english_verse: The angel answered, “I am Gabriel, God's servant, and I was sent to tell you this good news.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo lɛ to he ekɛɛ, “Mi ji Gabriel ni damɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ, ni atsu mi akɛ mikɛ bo abawie ni migba bo sane kpakpa nɛɛ.

english_verse: You have not believed what I have said. So you will not be able to say a thing until all this happens. But everything will take place when it is supposed to.”
translation_verse: Ni naa, oootɔ mu ni onyɛŋ owie kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni nii nɛɛ aaaba mli, ejaakɛ oheee miwiemɔ lɛ ni baaba mli kɛ be shɛ lɛ oyeee.”

english_verse: The crowd was waiting for Zechariah and kept wondering why he was staying in the temple so long.
translation_verse: Ni maŋ lɛ miimɛ Zakaria, ni amɛhiɛ fee amɛ yaa akɛ etsɛ nɛkɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: When he did come out, he could not speak, and they knew he had seen a vision. He motioned to them with his hands, but did not say a thing.
translation_verse: Shi be ni eje kpo lɛ, enyɛɛɛ ekɛ amɛ awie, ni amɛyoo sɛɛ akɛ eyana nii yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli; ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu ekɛ enine fee okadi etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni etɔ mu lolo.

english_verse: When Zechariah's time of service in the temple was over, he went home.
translation_verse: Be ni egbe esɔ̃ɔmɔ gbii lɛ naa lɛ, eyiŋ etee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe.

english_verse: Soon after this, his wife was expecting a baby, and for five months she did not leave the house. She said to herself,
translation_verse: Shi nakai gbii lɛ asɛɛ lɛ eŋa Elizabet na musu, ni etee ehe nyɔji enumɔ ekɛɛ,

english_verse: “What the Lord has done for me will keep people from looking down on me.” An Angel Tells about the Birth of Jesus
translation_verse: “Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ efee mi nɛ akɛ agbɛnɛ ekwɛ ni ejie mihiɛgbele lɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ.” Agba Yesu fɔmɔ ato

english_verse: One month later God sent the angel Gabriel to the town of Nazareth in Galilee
translation_verse: Shi nyɔŋ ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsu bɔfo Gabriel kɛtee Galilea maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Nazaret lɛ mli ni ekɛ wiemɔ ayahã

english_verse: with a message for a virgin named Mary. She was engaged to Joseph from the family of King David.
translation_verse: oblayoo foro ko ni atsɛ ehe baa ahã nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yosef ni jɛ David we lɛ; oblayoo lɛ gbɛi ji Maria.

english_verse: The angel greeted Mary and said, “You are truly blessed! The Lord is with you.”
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Hejɔlɛ ahã bo, bo ni aduro bo, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ bo yɛ.”

english_verse: Mary was confused by the angel's words and wondered what they meant.
translation_verse: Etsui fã yɛ bɔfo lɛ wiemɔ lɛ he, ni ekɛɛ yɛ eyiŋ akɛ, “Mɛɛ ŋamɔ po nɛ!”

english_verse: Then the angel told Mary, “Don't be afraid! God is pleased with you,
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei, Maria; ejaakɛ ohiɛ eba nyam yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.

english_verse: and you will have a son. His name will be Jesus.
translation_verse: Ni naa, obaana musu, ni ooofɔ binuu ni ooowo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yesu.

english_verse: He will be great and will be called the Son of God Most High. The Lord God will make him king, as his ancestor David was.
translation_verse: Eeetsɔ̃ agbo, ni aaatsɛ lɛ Ŋwɛinyo lɛ Bi, ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaaŋɔ etsɛ David maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ahã lɛ.

english_verse: He will rule the people of Israel forever, and his kingdom will never end.”
translation_verse: Ni eeeye Yakob we lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ kɛaatee naanɔ. Ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ sɛɛ efoŋ.”

english_verse: Mary asked the angel, “How can this happen? I am not even married!”
translation_verse: Shi Maria kɛɛ bɔfo lɛ akɛ, “Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni enɛ aaaba mli, akɛni mileee nuu nɛɛ?”

english_verse: The angel answered, “The Holy Spirit will come down to you, and God's power will come over you. So your child will be called the holy Son of God.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo lɛ to he ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ aaaba onɔ. Ni Ŋwɛinyo lɛ hewalɛ aaabaha onɔ, No hewɔ lɛ, nakai bi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hu ni ooofɔ lɛ, aaatsɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi.

english_verse: Your relative Elizabeth is also going to have a son, even though she is old. No one thought she could ever have a baby, but in three months she will have a son.
translation_verse: Shi naa, owekunyo Elizabet lɛ hu, ena binuu musu yɛ egbɔlɛ mli, ni mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ kene lɛ ena nyɔji ekpaa.

english_verse: Nothing is impossible for God!”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ nyɛŋ afee.”

english_verse: Mary said, “I am the Lord's servant! Let it happen as you have said.” And the angel left her. Mary Visits Elizabeth
translation_verse: Ni Maria kɛɛ, “Naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ weyoo ji mi; bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ aba mli nakai ahã mi!” Ni bɔfo lɛ shi lɛ etee. Maria yasara Elizabet

english_verse: A short time later Mary hurried to a town in the hill country of Judea.
translation_verse: Ni yɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ Maria kɛ oyaiyeli yiŋ kɛtee Yuda maŋ ko mli yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ,

english_verse: She went into Zechariah's home, where she greeted Elizabeth.
translation_verse: ni eyabote Zakaria we lɛ ni eŋa Elizabet.

english_verse: When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, her baby moved within her. The Holy Spirit came upon Elizabeth.
translation_verse: Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni Elizabet nu Maria ŋamɔ lɛ, abifao lɛ tu yɛ Elizabet musuŋ; ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ yi Elizabet obɔ̃;

english_verse: Then in a loud voice she said to Mary: God has blessed you more than any other woman! He has also blessed the child you will have.
translation_verse: ni ebo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ, “Ajɔɔ bo yɛ yei ateŋ, ni ajɔɔ omusuŋbi lɛ!

english_verse: Why should the mother of my Lord come to me?
translation_verse: Ni nɛgbɛ mina nyam nɛɛ kɛjɛ akɛ miNuŋtsɔ nyɛbaa miŋɔɔ nɛɛ?

english_verse: As soon as I heard your greeting, my baby became happy and moved within me.
translation_verse: Shi naa, amrɔ pɛ ni oŋamɔ lɛ gbɛɛ yɛ mitoiŋ lɛ, abifao lɛ kɛ mliflimɔ tu yɛ mimusuŋ.

english_verse: The Lord has blessed you because you believed that he will keep his promise. Mary's Song of Praise
translation_verse: Ni ajɔɔ bo, bo ni ohe oye akɛ wiemɔi ni ajɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ abakɛɛ lɛ aaaba mli lɛ.” Maria yijiemɔ lala lɛ

english_verse: Mary said: With all my heart I praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Ni Maria kɛɛ, “Misusuma miikafo Nuŋtsɔ lɛ,

english_verse: and I am glad because of God my Savior.
translation_verse: ni mimumɔ mli miifili lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ miyiwalaherelɔ lɛ hewɔ,

english_verse: God cares for me, his humble servant. From now on, all people will say God has blessed me.
translation_verse: akɛ ebakwɛ mi eweyoo ni ji humi lɛ. Ejaakɛ naa, kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, yinɔi lɛ fɛɛ aaabu mi akɛ mɔ ni ajɔɔ lɛ;

english_verse: God All-Powerful has done great things for me, and his name is holy.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Ofe lɛ efee nii wuji ehã mi; ni krɔŋkrɔŋ ji egbɛi lɛ.

english_verse: He always shows mercy to everyone who worships him.
translation_verse: Emɔbɔnalɛ yɛ mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ anɔ kɛyashi yinɔi ayinɔi.

english_verse: The Lord has used his powerful arm to scatter those who are proud.
translation_verse: Ekɛ enine etsu hewalɛ nitsumɔi; mɛi ni woɔ amɛhe yɛ amɛtsuiŋ jwɛŋmɔ mli lɛ egbɛ amɛ eshwã.

english_verse: God drags strong rulers from their thrones and puts humble people in places of power.
translation_verse: Ekpa ojei kɛjɛ amɛsɛ̃ii anɔ, ni ewo mɛi ni ji humii lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: God gives the hungry good things to eat, and sends the rich away with nothing.
translation_verse: Ehã mɛi ni hɔmɔ yeɔ amɛ etɔrɔ kɛ nii kpakpai, ni niiatsɛmɛi lɛ eshwie amɛ efolo.

english_verse: God helps his servant Israel and is always merciful to his people.
translation_verse: Eye ebua ewenuu Israel, koni ekai emɔbɔnalɛ lɛ,

english_verse: The Lord made this promise to our ancestors, to Abraham and his family forever!
translation_verse: tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ, ni yɔɔ hã Abraham kɛ eshwiei lɛ kɛya naanɔ.”

english_verse: Mary stayed with Elizabeth about three months. Then she went back home. The Birth of John the Baptist
translation_verse: Ni Maria kɛ lɛ hi shi aaafee nyɔji etɛ̃ ni eku esɛɛ etee eshĩa. Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ fɔmɔ

english_verse: When Elizabeth's son was born,
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ Elizabet fɔmɔ be shɛ, ni efɔ binuu.

english_verse: her neighbors and relatives heard how kind the Lord had been to her, and they too were glad.
translation_verse: Ni ekuu lɛ mli bii kɛ ewekumɛi lɛ nu akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ena lɛ mɔbɔ babaoo, ni amɛkɛ lɛ nya.

english_verse: Eight days later they did for the child what the Law of Moses commands. They were going to name him Zechariah, after his father.
translation_verse: Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ amɛba gbekɛ lɛ ketiafoo, ni kulɛ amɛmiitao amɛkɛ etsɛ gbɛi Zakaria lɛ awo lɛ.

english_verse: But Elizabeth said, “No! His name is John.”
translation_verse: Shi enyɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Dabida, abaatsɛ lɛ Yohane moŋ!”

english_verse: The people argued, “No one in your family has ever been named John.”
translation_verse: Shi amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ko bɛ owɛku lɛ mli ni atsɛɔ lɛ nakai!”

english_verse: So they motioned to Zechariah to find out what he wanted to name his son.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ amɛnine fee okadi kɛbi etsɛ bɔ ni esumɔɔ akɛ atsɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Zechariah asked for a writing tablet. Then he wrote, “His name is John.” Everyone was amazed.
translation_verse: Ni ebi tao ko, ni eŋma akɛ, “Yohane ji egbɛi.” Ni efee amɛ fɛɛ naakpɛɛ.

english_verse: At once, Zechariah started speaking and praising God.
translation_verse: Amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ enaabu gbele ni elilɛi fɛne, ni ewie ejie Nyɔŋmɔ yi.

english_verse: All the neighbors were frightened because of what had happened, and everywhere in the hill country people kept talking about these things.
translation_verse: Ni gbeyei mɔmɔ amɛkuu lɛ mli bii lɛ fɛɛ, ni agba saji nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yudea gɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who heard about this wondered what this child would grow up to be. They knew the Lord was with him. Zechariah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni nu lɛ kɛto amɛtsuiŋ amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛni po gbekɛ nɛɛ baatsɔ̃?” Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nine kã ehe. Zakaria jie Nyɔŋmɔ yi

english_verse: The Holy Spirit came upon Zechariah, and he began to speak:
translation_verse: Ni etsɛ Zakaria yi obɔ̃ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni egba ekɛɛ,

english_verse: Praise the Lord, the God of Israel! He has come to save his people.
translation_verse: “Ajie Nuŋtsɔ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi, akɛ ebasara emaŋ lɛ, ni ekpɔ̃ amɛ.

english_verse: Our God has given us a mighty Savior from the family of David his servant.
translation_verse: Ni etee walaheremɔ aklonto shi ehã wɔ yɛ etsulɔ David we lɛ.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord promised by the words of his holy prophets
translation_verse: Tamɔ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ egbalɔi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni yɔɔ kɛjɛ blema beebe lɛ anɔ ewie lɛ;

english_verse: to save us from our enemies and from everyone who hates us.
translation_verse: akɛ eeehere wɔyiwala kɛaajɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni he tsɛ̃ɔ wɔ lɛ adɛŋ.

english_verse: God said he would be kind to our people and keep his sacred promise.
translation_verse: Ni ena wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ amɔbɔ ni ekai ekpãŋmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: He told our ancestor Abraham
translation_verse: Kitã ni ekã wɔtsɛ Abraham lɛ,

english_verse: that he would rescue us from our enemies. Then we could serve him without fear,
translation_verse: akɛ eeehã ajie wɔ yɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi adɛŋ ni wɔsɔmɔ lɛ ni gbeyeishemɔ ko bɛ mli

english_verse: by being holy and good as long as we live.
translation_verse: yɛ hetsemɔ kɛ jalɛ mli yɛ ehiɛ wɔgbii abɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: You, my son, will be called the prophet of God Most High. You will go ahead of the Lord to get everything ready for him.
translation_verse: Ni bo, gbekɛ nɛɛ, aaatsɛ bo Ŋwɛifloflonyo lɛ gbalɔ; ejaakɛ obaatsɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ ni oyasaa egbɛi lɛ oto,

english_verse: You will tell his people that they can be saved when their sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: koni okɛ walaheremɔ he nilee ahã omaŋ lɛ yɛ amɛhe eshaifaa

english_verse: God's love and kindness will shine upon us like the sun that rises in the sky.
translation_verse: ni jɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mɔbɔnalɛ ni hãa emusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ mli. No hewɔ ni jetsɛremɔ ni jɛ ŋwɛi lɛ ebasara wɔ lɛ.

english_verse: On us who live in the dark shadow of death this light will shine to guide us into a life of peace.
translation_verse: Koni ehã jeŋ atse ahã mɛi ni tara duŋ kɛ gbele hɔɔŋ mli lɛ, Ni akudɔ wɔnaji kɛya hejɔlɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: As John grew up, God's Spirit gave him great power. John lived in the desert until the time he was sent to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ni gbekɛ lɛ bada, ni ehe wa yɛ mumɔ mli, ni ehi ŋa lɛ nɔ kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni akɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ Israel.

english_verse: About that time Emperor Augustus gave orders for the names of all the people to be listed in record books.
translation_verse: Nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ akpɔ ko jɛ Kaisare Augusto ŋɔɔ ba, akɛ akane jeŋ fɛɛ ni aŋma.

english_verse: At this time a man named Simeon was living in Jerusalem. Simeon was a good man. He loved God and was waiting for him to save the people of Israel. God's Spirit came to him
translation_verse: Ni naa, nuu ko yɛ Yerusalɛm ni atsɛɔ lɛ akɛ Simeon; nakai nuu lɛ jalɔ ji lɛ, ni esheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni eekwɛ Israel yiwalaheremɔ lɛ gbɛ. Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ enɔ,

english_verse: These first records were made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
translation_verse: Enɛ ji klɛŋklɛŋ kanemɔ ni akane be mli ni Kirenio yeɔ amralo yɛ Siria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone had to go to their own hometown to be listed.
translation_verse: Ni mɛi fɛɛ tee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmaŋ koni aŋma amɛgbɛi.

english_verse: So Joseph had to leave Nazareth in Galilee and go to Bethlehem in Judea. Long ago Bethlehem had been King David's hometown, and Joseph went there because he was from David's family.
translation_verse: Ni Yosef hu jɛ Nazaret maŋ lɛ mli yɛ Galilea, ni etee David maŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Betlehem yɛ Yudea lɛ mli; ejaakɛ ejɛ David we kɛ eweku lɛ mli.

english_verse: Mary was engaged to Joseph and traveled with him to Bethlehem. She was soon going to have a baby,
translation_verse: Etee koni aŋma ekɛ Maria, yoo ni etsɛ ehe baa ni hiɛ musu lɛ, gbɛi.

english_verse: and while they were there,
translation_verse: Be ni amɛyɔɔ Betlehem lɛ ebe shɛ ni ebaafɔ.

english_verse: she gave birth to her first-born son. She dressed him in baby clothes and laid him on a bed of hay, because there was no room for them in the inn. The Shepherds
translation_verse: Ni efɔ binuu ni ji ekromɔbi lɛ, ni ekɛ mama bla ehe ni ekɛ lɛ ŋmɛ kooloi aniyenii anɔ mli, ejaakɛ amɛnaaa gbɛ yɛ gbɔiatoohe lɛ. Tookwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ bɔfoi lɛ

english_verse: That night in the fields near Bethlehem some shepherds were guarding their sheep.
translation_verse: Tookwɛlɔi komɛi yɛ ŋa nɔ yɛ jɛi niiaŋ ni amɛmiishi kpe kɛmiibu amɛtoi ahe nyɔɔŋ.

english_verse: All at once an angel came down to them from the Lord, and the brightness of the Lord's glory flashed around them. The shepherds were frightened.
translation_verse: Trukaa lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo ko badamɔ amɛmasɛi, ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ anunyam kpɛ kɛbɔle amɛ, ni amɛshe gbeyei naakpa.

english_verse: But the angel said, “Don't be afraid! I have good news for you, which will make everyone happy.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkashea gbeyei; ejaakɛ naa, mibagba nyɛ miishɛɛ sane kpeteŋkple ni ji maŋ fɛɛ nɔ;

english_verse: This very day in King David's hometown a Savior was born for you. He is Christ the Lord.
translation_verse: akɛ ŋmɛnɛ afɔ walaherelɔ ni ji Kristo, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, ahã nyɛ, yɛ David maŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: You will know who he is, because you will find him dressed in baby clothes and lying on a bed of hay.”
translation_verse: Enɛ afee okadi ahã nyɛ, nyɛaana abifao ni akɛ mama ebala ehe ni ekã kooloi aniyeniianɔ mli.”

english_verse: Suddenly many other angels came down from heaven and joined in praising God. They said:
translation_verse: Ni trukaa lɛ ŋwɛi ta kpele bafata bɔfo lɛ he, ni amɛ jie Nyɔŋmɔ yi amɛkɛɛ,

english_verse: “Praise God in heaven! Peace on earth to everyone who pleases God.”
translation_verse: “Anunyam ahã Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ ŋwɛi flooflo, ni hejɔlɛ aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ana gbɔmɛi ahe tsuijurɔ!”

english_verse: After the angels had left and gone back to heaven, the shepherds said to each other, “Let's go to Bethlehem and see what the Lord has told us about.”
translation_verse: Be ni bɔfoi lɛ eje amɛŋɔɔ amɛtee ŋwɛi lɛ, tookwɛlɔi lɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔyaa Betlehem koo, ni wɔyakwɛa nɔ ni eba ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ejie kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ nɛɛ.”

english_verse: They hurried off and found Mary and Joseph, and they saw the baby lying on a bed of hay.
translation_verse: Ni amɛtee oya, ni amɛyana Maria kɛ Yosef kɛ abifao lɛ ni ekã kooloi aniyenii anɔ mli.

english_verse: When the shepherds saw Jesus, they told his parents what the angel had said about him.
translation_verse: Be ni amɛna abifao lɛ amɛjaje sane ni agba amɛ yɛ gbekɛ lɛ he lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ fɔlɔi lɛ.

english_verse: But Mary kept thinking about all this and wondering what it meant.
translation_verse: Shi Maria kɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ to etsuiŋ ni esusuɔ he.

english_verse: As the shepherds returned to their sheep, they were praising God and saying wonderful things about him. Everything they had seen and heard was just as the angel had said.

translation_verse: Ni Simon here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Onukpa, wɔtsu nii waa nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ fɛɛ ni wɔnaaa nɔ ko; shi kɛ̃lɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ maŋmɛ yai lɛ.”

translation_verse: Ni mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ bɔ̃i susumɔ akɛ, “Namɔ ji mɔ nɛ ni wieɔ musubɔɔ wiemɔ nɛɛ? Namɔ aaanyɛ ekɛ eshai afa akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ koome pɛ.”

english_verse: Is it easier for me to tell this man that his sins are forgiven or to tell him to get up and walk?

english_verse: Jesus told them, “The friends of a bridegroom don't go without eating while he is still with them.

translation_verse: Ni ebu amɛ abɛ hu ekɛɛ, “Mɔ ko gbaaa mama hee naa ekɛtaaa atade momo; kɛji efee nakai lɛ, eeegbala ehee lɛ, ni mamanaa hee lɛ kɛ atade momo lɛ yeŋ.

english_verse: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. The new wine would swell and burst the old skins. Then the wine would be lost, and the skins would be ruined.
translation_verse: Ni mɔ ko kɛ wain hee wooo wolo tɔi memeji amli, kɛ efee nakai lɛ, wain hee lɛ aaaflɛ wolo tɔi lɛ ni eeeshwie shi, ni wolo tɔi lɛ hu aaafite.

translation_verse: Shi wain hee lɛ, wolo tɔi hei amli akɛwoɔ.

translation_verse: Shi Yesu le amɛsusumɔi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ nuu ni nine egbo lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi obadamɔ teŋ!” Ni ete shi ebadamɔ shi.

translation_verse: Shi Farisifoi lɛ ekomɛi bi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ nyɛfeɔ nɔ ni aŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ akɛ afeɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ?”

english_verse: Long ago your own people did these same things to the prophets. So when this happens to you, be happy and jump for joy! You will have a great reward in heaven.
translation_verse: Nyɛnyaa yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ ni nyɛtumɔa, ejaakɛ naa, nyɛnyɔmɔwoo fa yɛ ŋwɛi; ejaakɛ nakai nɔŋŋ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee gbalɔi lɛ.

translation_verse: Nyɛhãa ni aaahã nyɛ; nii ni asusu jogbaŋŋ ni ahoso ni anyɛmɔ nɔ ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛteke nɔ mɛi kɛaashãkã nyɛtsitsi, ejaakɛ nɔ susumɔnɔ ni nyɛkɛsusuɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ aaaku sɛɛ akɛsusu ahã nyɛ.”

translation_verse: Aloo te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni ooonyɛ okɛɛ onyɛmi akɛ, ‘Anyɛmi, hã majie kuli ni kã ohiŋmɛi nɔ lɛ,’ be ni onaaa mplaŋ ni yɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛi mli lɛ? translation_verse: Nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ lɛ Yesu mli fili lɛ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli ni ekɛɛ, “Miijie oyi, Ataa; ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ Nuŋtsɔ, akɛ oŋɔ nii nɛɛ otee nilelɔi kɛ jwɛŋlɔi, ni ojie otsɔ̃ɔ abifabii; hɛɛ, Ataa, ejaakɛ nakai sa ohiɛ.

translation_verse: “Mɛni aŋma yɛ Mla lɛ mli lɛ? Te okaneɔ tɛŋŋ?”

english_verse: Jesus said, “You have given the right answer. If you do this, you will have eternal life.”
translation_verse: Ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni oto he lɛ ja; feemɔ nakai, ni oyi aaana wala.”

english_verse: A priest happened to be going down the same road. But when he saw the man, he walked by on the other side.
translation_verse: Shi eba mli akɛ osɔfo ko batsɔ̃ nakai gbɛ lɛ nɔ; shi be ni ena lɛ lɛ, egba afã kɛho.

translation_verse: Shi Samarianyo ko ni nyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ bashɛ he ni eyɔɔ lɛ, ni be ni ena lɛ lɛ, emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ ehe,

english_verse: and went over to him. He treated his wounds with olive oil and wine and bandaged them. Then he put him on his own donkey and took him to an inn, where he took care of him.
translation_verse: ni etee eŋɔɔ ni eyafɔse mu kɛ wain eshwie epilamɔi lɛ anɔ ni efimɔ nɔ, ni esaa ewo lɛ eta lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekooloo lɛ nɔ ni ekɛ lɛ tee gbɔiatoohe ni eyakwɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The next morning he gave the innkeeper two silver coins and said, “Please take care of the man. If you spend more than this on him, I will pay you when I return.”
translation_verse: Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni eyaa lɛ, ejie denarioi enyɔ ehã gbɔiatoohetsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Kwɛmɔ lɛ jogbaŋŋ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooosaa ofite lɛ, kɛ miku misɛɛ miba lɛ mawo bo nyɔmɔ.’

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “Which one of these three people was a real neighbor to the man who was beaten up by robbers?”
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ, mɛi etɛ̃ nɛɛ ateŋ namɔ osusuɔ akɛ etsɔ̃ mɔ ni gbee ojotswalɔi ateŋ lɛ naanyo?”

english_verse: The expert in the Law of Moses answered, “The one who showed pity.” Jesus said, “Go and do the same!” Martha and Mary
translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ, “Mɔ ni na lɛ mɔbɔ lɛ ni.” Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo hu yaa ni oyafee nakai nɔŋŋ.” Marta kɛ Maria

english_verse: The Lord and his disciples were traveling along and came to a village. When they got there, a woman named Martha welcomed him into her home.
translation_verse: Be ni Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ nyiɛ gbɛ kɛyaa lɛ eyabote akrowa ko mli. Ni yoo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Marta lɛ kpee lɛ kɛtee ewe.

english_verse: She had a sister named Mary, who sat down in front of the Lord and was listening to what he said.
translation_verse: Eyɛ nyɛmi yoo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Maria; enyɛmi yoo nɛɛ bata Yesu najianaa ni ebo ewiemɔ toi.

english_verse: Martha was worried about all that had to be done. Finally, she went to Jesus and said, “Lord, doesn't it bother you that my sister has left me to do all the work by myself? Tell her to come and help me!”
translation_verse: Shi Marta gba ehe naa tuutu yɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ pii he ni eba Yesu ŋɔɔ ebakɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ni minyɛmi lɛ eshi mi ni mi kome misɔ̃mɔɔ nɛɛ, jeee ohe sane ko ni lo? No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ lɛ ni ebafata mihe.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Martha, Martha! You are worried and upset about so many things,
translation_verse: Shi Yesu to he ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Marta, Marta! Oogba ohe naa, ni oohao ohe yɛ nibii pii ahe;

english_verse: but only one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen what is best, and it will not be taken away from her.”
translation_verse: nɔ kome ehia. Nɔ ni hi lɛ no Maria ekɔ lɛ, ni no lɛ ashɔŋ yɛ edɛŋ.”

english_verse: So I tell you to ask and you will receive, search and you will find, knock and the door will be opened for you.

translation_verse: Shi nɛɛ tsɛ yɔɔ nyɛteŋ ni kɛji ebi bi lɛ aboloo, ni eeehã lɛ tɛ? Aloo kɛji ebi lɛ loo lɛ, ni eeeŋɔ onufu ehã lɛ yɛ loo najiaŋ.

translation_verse: Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni Yesu wieɔ nii nɛɛ lɛ, yoo ko ni yɔɔ asafo lɛ mli lɛ wo egbee nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ajɔɔ musu ni hiɛ bo kɛ fufɔ ni oye lɛ!”

translation_verse: Shi ehere nɔ akɛ, “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni nuɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni amɛyeɔ nɔ lɛ moŋ!” Farisifoi lɛ bi Yesu okadi (Mateo

translation_verse: Shi kpoo hã nyɛ, Farisifoi, akɛ nyɛhãa kowɛ kɛ shwie kɛ bai srɔtoi fɛɛ mlijaa nyɔŋmanyɔŋma, ni nyɛshiɔ jalɛ saneyeli kɛ suɔmɔ ni akɛsumɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ! Kulɛ esa akɛ nyɛfeɔ enɛɛmɛi hu nyɛkɛshiɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ anɔ.

translation_verse: Shi be ni asafoi lɛ ebabua amɛhe naa pii lɛ, Yesu bɔ̃i kɛɛmɔ akɛ, “Yinɔbii nɛɛ yinɔbii fɔ̃ji ni; amɛmiitao okadi, ni ahaŋ amɛ okadi ko akɛ ja gbalɔ Yona okadi lɛ.

translation_verse: Ninevehii lɛ kɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ aaate shi yɛ kojomɔ lɛ mli ni amɛaabu amɛ fɔ, ejaakɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui yɛ Yona shiɛmɔ lɛ naa; ni naa, nɔ ko ni fe Yona shiɛmɔ lɛ yɛ biɛ.” Gbɔmɔtso lɛ kane (Mateo

english_verse: No one lights a lamp and then hides it or puts it under a clay pot. A lamp is put on a lampstand, so everyone who comes into the house can see the light.
translation_verse: “Mɔ ko esuuu kane emaaa kpokplobiiaŋ loo tsese shishi, shi moŋ kanetso nɔ ekɛmaa, koni mɛi ni baa shĩa lɛŋ ana ekpɛmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Your eyes are the lamp for your body. When your eyes are good, you have all the light you need. But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark.
translation_verse: Ogbɔmɔtso lɛ kane ji ohiŋmɛi lɛ. Kɛji ohiŋmɛi nɔ tse lɛ, ogbɔmɔtso muu lɛ hu mli tseɔ; shi kɛji ohiŋmɛi ehiii lɛ, ogbɔmɔtso lɛ hu woɔ duŋ.

english_verse: When Jesus finished speaking, a Pharisee invited him home for a meal. Jesus went and sat down to eat.
translation_verse: Ni be ni Yesu wieɔ lɛ, Farisifonyo ko bakpee lɛ akɛ eba ni ekɛ lɛ abaye nii; ni etee shĩa lɛŋ, ni eyata niyenii lɛ ahe.

english_verse: So the Lord said to him: You Pharisees clean the outside of cups and dishes, but on the inside you are greedy and evil.
translation_verse: Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ Farisifoi lɛ nyɛtsumɔɔ kpulu he kɛ kã sɛɛ, shi nyɛmli eyi obɔ̃ kɛ juu kɛ fɔ̃.

english_verse: If you would only give what you have to the poor, everything you do would please God.
translation_verse: Moŋ nyɛŋɔa nibii ni yɔɔ mli lɛ nyɛfea ejurɔ, ni nibii fɛɛ he aaatse ahã nyɛ.

english_verse: But you are in for trouble! You are like unmarked graves that people walk on without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Kpoo hã nyɛ, akɛ nyɛtamɔ saŋi ni ejeee shi, ni mɛi ni nyiɛɔ nɔ lɛ leee!”

english_verse: Jesus replied: You teachers are also in for trouble! You load people down with heavy burdens, but you won't lift a finger to help them carry the loads.
translation_verse: Shi Yesu kɛɛ, “Nyɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ hu, kpoo hã nyɛ! Akɛ nyɛkɛ jatsui ni teremɔ jaraa tereɔ mɛi, ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛ nyɛwao kome tete etaaa he.

english_verse: You must think that was the right thing for your people to do, or else you would not have built monuments for the prophets they murdered.
translation_verse: belɛ nyɛmiiye nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ anitsumɔi lɛ ahe odase ni eŋɔɔ nyɛnaa; ejaakɛ amɛ amɛgbe amɛ, shi nyɛ nyɛfeɔ saŋi nyɛmamɔɔ amɛnɔ.

english_verse: Because of your evil deeds, the Wisdom of God said, “I will send prophets and apostles to you. But you will murder some and mistreat others.”
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ nɔŋŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ nilee lɛ kɛɛ, ‘Mibatsu gbalɔi kɛ bɔfoi kɛya amɛŋɔɔ, ni amɛaagbe amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ni amɛaawa mɛi komɛi ayi,’

english_verse: You people living today will be punished for all the prophets who have been murdered since the beginning of the world.

translation_verse: Ni amɛnyɛ enɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Okɛ wɔ ahi shi, ejaakɛ je miina ni eshɛ hiɛbulɛ etã.” Ni etee mli ni ekɛ amɛ yahi shi.

translation_verse: Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni ekɛ amɛ tara niyenii ahe lɛ, ekɔ aboloo lɛ ni ejɔɔ nɔ, ni ekumɔ mli ni ekɛhã amɛ;

english_verse: They said to each other, “When he talked with us along the road and explained the Scriptures to us, didn't it warm our hearts?”
translation_verse: Ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Ani nɔ ko etaaa wɔmli be ni ekɛ wɔ wieɔ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ Ŋmalɛi lɛ amli lɛ?”

translation_verse: [Ni be ni ewie nɛkɛ lɛ, ekɛ eniji kɛ enaji tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.]

english_verse: Then he helped them understand the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ egbele amɛjwɛŋmɔ naa, koni amɛna Ŋmalɛi lɛ anaa.

translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nɛkɛ aŋma, ni nɛkɛ esa akɛ Kristo lɛ ana amanehulu ni ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ yɛ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ;

translation_verse: Ni eŋɔ amɛ kɛje kpo kɛtee Betania masɛi, ni ehole eniji anɔ ni ejɔɔ amɛ.

translation_verse: ni amɛyɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ daa nɛɛ, ni amɛhiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ kɛ lɛ jɔɔmɔ.

translation_verse: Emli wala yɔɔ, ni wala lɛ ji gbɔmɛi ala lɛ;

translation_verse: Anɔkwa la lɛ ni tsoɔ hãa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ baa je lɛ mli nɛɛ.

english_verse: The Word was in the world, but no one knew him, though God had made the world with his Word.
translation_verse: Je lɛ mli la lɛ yɔɔ, ni enɔ atsɔ̃ afee je lɛ, shi je lɛ leee lɛ.

translation_verse: Lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi aŋɔɔ eba, ni mɛi ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋbii lɛ hereee lɛ.

translation_verse: Ni egba mli faŋŋ ni eshiuuu nɔ, ni egba mli akɛ, “Jeee mi ji Kristo lɛ.”

translation_verse: Ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ ji bo mɔ? Elia ji bo?” Ni ekɛɛ, “Jeee lɛ ji mi.” Gbalɔ lɛ ji bo? Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, “Dabi.”

translation_verse: Ekɛɛ, “Mi ji mɔ gbee ni boɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛjajea Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ,’ ” tamɔ bɔ ni gbalɔ Yesaia kɛɛ lɛ.

translation_verse: Ni mɛi ni atsu lɛ jɛ Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ;

translation_verse: ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Kɛjeee Kristo lɛ loo Elia loo gbalɔ lɛ ji bo lɛ, mɛɛ hewɔ obaptisiɔ mɔ?”

translation_verse: Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ Yohane na Yesu miiba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Naa Nyɔŋmɔ Toobi lɛ ni woɔ je lɛ esha lɛ kɛyaa lɛ!

english_verse: He is the one I told you about when I said, “Someone else will come, who is greater than I am, because he was alive before I was born.”
translation_verse: Mɔ nɛ ji mɔ ni mikɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, ‘Nuu ko miiba yɛ misɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ mihiɛ, ejaakɛ eyɛ dani miyɔɔ lɛ.’

translation_verse: Ni mi lɛ́ mileee lɛ, shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni ajie lɛ kpo atsɔ̃ɔ Israel hewɔ, ni miba mibaptisiɔ yɛ nu mli nɛɛ.”

english_verse: I was there and saw the Spirit come down on him like a dove from heaven. And the Spirit stayed on him.

translation_verse: Ni mi lɛ mileee lɛ, shi mɔ ni tsu mi akɛ mibaptisi yɛ nu mli lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Mɔ nɔ ni ooona akɛ Mumɔ lɛ yiɔ ni ehiɔ enɔ lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni baptisiɔ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ mli lɛ.’

translation_verse: Ni kaselɔi enyɔ lɛ nu ewiemɔ lɛ, ni amɛyanyiɛ Yesu sɛɛ.

english_verse: When Jesus turned and saw them, he asked, “What do you want?” They answered, “Rabbi, where do you live?” The Hebrew word “Rabbi” means “Teacher.”
translation_verse: Ni Yesu tsɔ̃ ehe, ni be ni ena akɛ amɛnyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ, ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛtaoɔ?” Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Rabi” , “Nɛgbɛ ohiɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Come and see!” It was already about four o'clock in the afternoon when they went with him and saw where he lived. So they stayed on for the rest of the day.
translation_verse: Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa ni nyɛbakwɛa.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtee ni amɛyana he ni ehiɔ lɛ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ hi shi nakai gbi lɛ. Ni gbɛkɛ ŋmɛji ejwɛ mli ni.

english_verse: The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother and tell him, “We have found the Messiah!” The Hebrew word “Messiah” means the same as the Greek word “Christ.”
translation_verse: Lɛ eyana lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enyɛmi Simon tsutsu, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔna Mesia loo lɛ.”

english_verse: Andrew brought his brother to Jesus. And when Jesus saw him, he said, “Simon son of John, you will be called Cephas.” This name can be translated as “Peter.” Jesus Chooses Philip and Nathanael
translation_verse: Ni ekɛ lɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ. Ni Yesu kwɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Bo ji Simon, Yona bi lɛ, aaatsɛ bo Kefa .”

translation_verse: Filipo hu na Natanael, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔna mɔ ni Mose ŋma ehe sane yɛ Mla lɛ mli, kɛ mɔ ni gbalɔi lɛ hu ŋma ehe sane lɛ, Yesu, Yosef bi ni jɛ Nazaret lɛ.”

english_verse: When Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him, he said, “Here is a true descendant of our ancestor Israel. And he isn't deceitful.”
translation_verse: Yesu na Natanael miiba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, “Naa anɔkwa Israelnyo, mɔ mli ni apasa bɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: “How do you know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus answered, “Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.”
translation_verse: Natanael bi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ ole mi yɛ?” Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mina bo fɛɛ dã ni Filipo tsɛ bo, be mli ni oyɔɔ agbãmitso lɛ shishi lɛ.”

english_verse: Nathanael said, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God and the King of Israel!”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Did you believe me just because I said that I saw you under the fig tree? You will see something even greater.
translation_verse: Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ni mikɛɛ bo akɛ mina bo yɛ agbãmitso lɛ shishi lɛ hewɔ oheɔ oyeɔ nɛɛ? Ooona nii wuji ni fe enɛ.”

english_verse: I tell you for certain you will see heaven open and God's angels going up and coming down on the Son of Man.”
translation_verse: Ni etee nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, kɛjɛ be nɛɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛaana akɛ ŋwɛi naa kã ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfoi lɛ miikwɔ miikpeleke yɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ.”

translation_verse: Enɔ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ akpee yoo yɛ Kana yɛ Galilea; ni Yesu nyɛ yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: and the man in charge drank some of the water that had now turned into wine. He did not know where the wine had come from, but the servants did. He called the bridegroom over
translation_verse: Shi be ni piafonyo lɛ sa enaa nu ni etsɔ̃ wain, ni eleee he ni jɛ, shi tsuji lɛ ni yɛ nu lɛ kɛkɛ le lɛ, etsɛ ayɛmforowu lɛ,

english_verse: and said, “The best wine is always served first. Then after the guests have had plenty, the other wine is served. But you have kept the best until last!”
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, wain kpakpa ekɛbamaa shi klɛŋklɛŋ, ni kɛ mɛi lɛ etɔrɔ lɛ, no dani ekɛ nɔ ni eŋɔɔɔ lɛ baa; shi bo lɛ okɛ wain kpakpa lɛ moŋ eto kɛbashi benɛ.”

english_verse: But Jesus was talking about his body as a temple.
translation_verse: Shi lɛ lɛ, egbɔmɔtso akɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ he ewieɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Not long before the Jewish festival of Passover, Jesus went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ Yudafoi lɛ aHehoo lɛ eshɛ etã, ni Yesu tee Yerusalɛm.

english_verse: So he took some rope and made a whip. Then he chased everyone out of the temple, together with their sheep and cattle. He turned over the tables of the moneychangers and scattered their coins.
translation_verse: Ni ekɛ taŋkpei bibii fee kpelebii ni ekɛshwie amɛ fɛɛ kɛ toi kɛ tsinai lɛ kɛje Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ shikatsakelɔi lɛ ashika lɛ eshwie shi; ni etsirɛ okpɔlɔi lɛ etswia shi;

english_verse: The disciples then remembered that the Scriptures say, “My love for your house burns in me like a fire.”
translation_verse: Shi ekaselɔi lɛ kai akɛ aŋma akɛ, “Owe lɛ he hiɛdɔɔ lɛ eye mi.”

english_verse: “Destroy this temple,” Jesus answered, “and in three days I will build it again!”
translation_verse: Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkumɔa sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ, ni gbii etɛ̃ mli lɛ mama ekoŋŋ.”

english_verse: There he found people selling cattle, sheep, and doves in the temple. He also saw moneychangers sitting at their tables.
translation_verse: Ni eyana mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ tsinai kɛ toi kɛ okpoi kɛ mɛi ni tsakeɔ shika hu tara shi yɛ amɛkpɔlɔ̃i ahe yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.

english_verse: Jesus said to the people who had been selling doves, “Get those doves out of here! Don't make my Father's house a marketplace.”
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ okpoi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛjiea nii nɛɛ kɛjea biɛ, nyɛkɛ miTsɛ we lɛ akafea jara nɔ.”

english_verse: The Jewish leaders asked Jesus, “What miracle will you work to show us why you have done this?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ okadi okɛtsɔ̃ɔ wɔ akɛ oyɛ hegbɛ akɛ ofeɔ enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ?”

english_verse: And when he was raised from death, his disciples remembered what he had told them. Then they believed the Scriptures and the words of Jesus. Jesus Knows What People Are Like
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, be ni ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kai akɛ ekɛɛ enɛ, ni amɛhe ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛ wiemɔ ni Yesu wie lɛ amɛye.

english_verse: In Jerusalem during Passover many people put their faith in Jesus, because they saw him work miracles.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ, be ni Yesu yɔɔ Yerusalɛm yɛ Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ mli lɛ, mɛi pii na okadii ni efee lɛ, ni amɛhe egbɛi lɛ nɔ amɛye.

english_verse: But Jesus knew what was in their hearts, and he would not let them have power over him.
translation_verse: Shi Yesu diɛŋtsɛ lɛ ekɛ ehe efɔ̃ɔɔ amɛnɔ, ejaakɛ ele amɛ fɛɛ amɛsu.

english_verse: No one had to tell him what people were like. He already knew.
translation_verse: Ni ehe ehĩaaa akɛ mɔ ko aye gbɔmɔ he odase ahã lɛ, ejaakɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ele nɔ ni yɔɔ gbɔmɔ tsui mli.

english_verse: There was a man named Nicodemus who was a Pharisee and a Jewish leader.
translation_verse: Nuu ko yɛ ni jɛ Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Nikodemo ni ji Yudafoi lɛ anukpa;

english_verse: One night he went to Jesus and said, “Rabbi, we know that God has sent you to teach us. You could not work these miracles, unless God were with you.”
translation_verse: lɛ eba Yesu ŋɔɔ nyɔɔŋ, ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Rabi, wɔle akɛ tsɔɔlɔ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ba ji bo; ejaakɛ mɔ ko nyɛŋ afee okadii ni ofeɔ nɛɛ, akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mɔ lɛ yɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I tell you for certain that you must be born from above before you can see God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ bo akɛ, kɛji ajɛɛɛ ŋwɛi afɔɔɔ mɔ ko lɛ, enyɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ena.”

english_verse: Nicodemus asked, “How can a grown man ever be born a second time?”
translation_verse: Nikodemo bi lɛ akɛ, “Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni be ni gbɔmɔ egbɔ lɛ ni aaafɔ lɛŋ? Ani eeenyɛ ebote enyɛ musu mli ekoŋŋ ni afɔ lɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that before you can get into God's kingdom, you must be born not only by water, but by the Spirit.
translation_verse: Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “Miikɛɛ bo anɔkwale akɛ, kɛji ajɛɛɛ nu kɛ Mumɔ mli afɔɔɔ mɔ ko lɛ, enyɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli ebote.

english_verse: Humans give life to their children. Yet only God's Spirit can change you into a child of God.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni ajɛ heloo mli afɔ lɛ, heloo ni; ni nɔ ni ajɛ Mumɔ mli afɔ lɛ, mumɔ ni.

english_verse: Don't be surprised when I say that you must be born from above.
translation_verse: Ohiɛ akafee bo yaa akɛ mikɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘ja ajɛ ŋwɛi afɔ nyɛ’ lɛ.

english_verse: Only God's Spirit gives new life. The Spirit is like the wind that blows wherever it wants to. You can hear the wind, but you don't know where it comes from or where it is going.
translation_verse: Kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ, he ni esumɔɔ etswaa kɛyaa, ni egbɛɛmɔ onuɔ, shi oleee he ni ejɛɔ kɛ he ni eyaa; nakai ji mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ajɛ Mumɔ mli afɔ lɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: How can you be a teacher of Israel and not know these things?
translation_verse: Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Te Israel tsɔɔlɔ ji bo? Ni oleee enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ?

english_verse: I tell you for certain we know what we are talking about because we have seen it ourselves. But none of you will accept what we say.
translation_verse: Miikɛɛ bo anɔkwale akɛ, nɔ ni wɔle lɛ, no wɔwieɔ; ni nɔ ni wɔna lɛ, no he odase wɔyeɔ; shi nyɛŋɔɔɔ wɔdase lɛ.

english_verse: If you don't believe when I talk to you about things on earth, how can you possibly believe if I talk to you about things in heaven?
translation_verse: Kɛ mikɛ nyɛ wie shikpɔŋ nɔ nii ahe ni nyɛheee nyɛyeee lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ kɛji mikɛ nyɛ wie ŋwɛinii ahe ni nyɛaahe nyɛyeŋ?

english_verse: No one has gone up to heaven except the Son of Man, who came down from there.
translation_verse: Ni mɔ ko ekwɔko kɛyako ŋwɛi, akɛ ja mɔ ni jɛ ŋwɛi kpeleke shi lɛ, Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ.

english_verse: And the Son of Man must be lifted up, just as the metal snake was lifted up by Moses in the desert.
translation_verse: Ni bɔ ni Mose wo onufu lɛ nɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ sa akɛ awo Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ,

english_verse: Then everyone who has faith in the Son of Man will have eternal life.
translation_verse: koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ eyeɔ lɛ ana naanɔ wala.”

english_verse: God loved the people of this world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who has faith in him will have eternal life and never really die.
translation_verse: “Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔ je lɛ, akɛ eŋɔ eBi koome lɛ ehã, koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ hiɛ akakpãtã, shi moŋ ena naanɔ wala.

english_verse: God did not send his Son into the world to condemn its people. He sent him to save them!
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsuuu eBi lɛ kɛbaaa je lɛ mli koni ebakojo je lɛ, shi moŋ koni atsɔ̃ enɔ ahere je lɛ yiwala.

english_verse: No one who has faith in God's Son will be condemned. But everyone who doesn't have faith in him has already been condemned for not having faith in God's only Son.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ, akojooo lɛ; shi mɔ ni heee yeee lɛ, akojo lɛ momo, ejaakɛ eheko Nyɔŋmɔ Bi koome lɛ gbɛi lɛ nɔ eyeko.

english_verse: The light has come into the world, and people who do evil things are judged guilty because they love the dark more than the light.
translation_verse: Shi kojomɔ lɛ nɛ, akɛ la lɛ eba je lɛ mli, ni gbɔmɛi sumɔɔ duŋ lɛ moŋ fe la lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛnitsumɔi lɛ efɔ̃ɔji ni;

english_verse: People who do evil hate the light and won't come to the light, because it clearly shows what they have done.
translation_verse: ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsuɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ nyɛɔ la lɛ, ni ebaaa la lɛ he, koni akajie enitsumɔi lɛ ashi.

english_verse: But everyone who lives by the truth will come to the light, because they want others to know that God is really the one doing what they do. Jesus and John the Baptist
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni feɔ anɔkwalenii lɛ baa la lɛ he, koni enitsumɔi lɛ aje kpo, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli atsu yɛ.” Yohane odase kroko ni eye yɛ Yesu he

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples went to Judea, where he stayed with them for a while and was baptizing people.
translation_verse: Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ba Yudea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ amɛ bahi jɛi, ni ebaptisiɔ.

english_verse: John's followers got into an argument with a Jewish man about a ceremony of washing.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ naataamɔ bate shi yɛ Yohane kaselɔi lɛ kɛ Yudafonyo ko teŋ yɛ hetsuumɔ he.

english_verse: They went to John and said, “Rabbi, you spoke about a man when you were with him east of the Jordan. He is now baptizing people, and everyone is going to him.”
translation_verse: Ni amɛba Yohane ŋɔɔ ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Rabi, mɔ ni kɛ bo hi Yordan sɛɛ ni oye ehe odase lɛ, naa, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eebaptisi, ni mɛi fɛɛ miiya eŋɔɔ.”

english_verse: John replied: No one can do anything unless God in heaven allows it.
translation_verse: Yohane here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Gbɔmɔ nyɛŋ ana nɔ ko, akɛ ja ajɛ ŋwɛi akɛhã lɛ.

english_verse: You surely remember how I told you that I am not the Messiah. I am only the one sent ahead of him.
translation_verse: Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛmiiye mi odase akɛ mikɛɛ akɛ, jeee mi ji Kristo lɛ, shi moŋ atsu mi kɛtsɔ̃ ehiɛ.

english_verse: At a wedding the groom is the one who gets married. The best man is glad just to be there and to hear the groom's voice. That's why I am so glad.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni hiɛ ayɛmforo lɛ, lɛ ji ayɛmforowu; shi ayɛmforowu lɛ shieŋtsɛ ni damɔ shi boɔ lɛ toi lɛ, nya enyaa yɛ ayɛmforowu lɛ gbee hewɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, nɛkɛ minyamɔ nɛɛ eba mli.

english_verse: Jesus must become more important, while I become less important. The One Who Comes from Heaven
translation_verse: Lɛ lɛ, ja eshwere, ni mi lɛ, minɔ gbɔ.”

english_verse: God's Son comes from heaven and is above all others. Everyone who comes from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks about earthly things. The one who comes from heaven is above all others.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni jɛ ŋwɛi ba lɛ, efe mɛi fɛɛ. Mɔ ni jɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ejɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ he ewieɔ. Mɔ ni jɛ ŋwɛi ba lɛ, efe mɛi fɛɛ,

english_verse: He speaks about what he has seen and heard, and yet no one believes him.
translation_verse: ni nɔ ni ena ni enu lɛ, no he odase eyeɔ; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko eŋɔɔɔ edase lɛ.

english_verse: But everyone who does believe him has shown that God is truthful.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni ŋɔɔ edase lɛ, esɔo naa akɛ anɔkwafo ji Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: The Son was sent to speak God's message, and he has been given the full power of God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsu lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi ewieɔ; ejaakɛ jeee susumɔ Nyɔŋmɔ susuɔ Mumɔ lɛ ehãa lɛ.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has given him everything.
translation_verse: Tsɛ lɛ sumɔɔ Bi lɛ, ni etu nii fɛɛ ewo edɛŋ.

english_verse: Everyone who has faith in the Son has eternal life. But no one who rejects him will ever share in that life, and God will be angry with them forever.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni heɔ Bi lɛ nɔ eyeɔ lɛ, eyɛ naanɔ wala; shi mɔ ni booo Bi lɛ toi lɛ, enaŋ wala; shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu hiɔ enɔ.

english_verse: But Jesus' disciples were really the ones doing the baptizing, and not Jesus himself. Jesus and the Samaritan Woman
translation_verse: tsɛbelɛ lɛ Yesu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebaptisiii; shi moŋ ekaselɔi lɛ ni baptisiɔ lɛ,

english_verse: Jesus left Judea and started for Galilee again.
translation_verse: eje Yudea ni eyiŋ etee Galilea ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: This time he had to go through Samaria,
translation_verse: Shi ja etsɔ̃ Samaria.

english_verse: “You are a Jew,” she replied, “and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink of water when Jews and Samaritans won't have anything to do with each other?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ Samariayoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Te tɛŋŋ ni bo Yudanyo lɛ obaa mi Samariayoo lɛ nu ni onuŋ?”

english_verse: “Sir,” the woman said, “you don't even have a bucket, and the well is deep. Where are you going to get this life-giving water?
translation_verse: Yoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, obɛ nɔ ni okɛaayɛ, ni bu lɛ mli kwɔ hu; nɛgbɛ ona wala nu lɛ yɛ mɔ?

english_verse: Our ancestor Jacob dug this well for us, and his family and animals got water from it. Are you greater than Jacob?”
translation_verse: Ani ofe wɔtsɛ Yakob ni hã wɔ nubu lɛ, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enu mli nu, kɛ ebii kɛ ekooloi lɛ?”

english_verse: But no one who drinks the water I give will ever be thirsty again. The water I give will become in that person a flowing fountain that gives eternal life.”
translation_verse: shi mɔ ni nuɔ nu ni mi mahã lɛ lɛ, kumai yeŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ; shi moŋ nu ni mahã lɛ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ nu hiŋmɛi ni baa kɛyaa naanɔ wala mli yɛ emli.”

english_verse: The woman replied, “Sir, please give me a drink of that water! Then I won't get thirsty and have to come to this well again.”
translation_verse: Yoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, hã mi nu nɛɛ eko, koni kumai akaye mi, ni miba biɛ mibayɛ nu dɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Go and bring your husband.”
translation_verse: Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa ni oyatsɛ owu, ni okɛ lɛ aba biɛ.”

english_verse: The woman said, “Sir, I can see that you are a prophet.
translation_verse: Yoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, mina akɛ gbalɔ ji bo.

english_verse: My ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say Jerusalem is the only place to worship.”
translation_verse: Gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ sɔle yɛ, ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛkɛɛ akɛ Yerusalɛm ji he ni sa akɛ asɔle yɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus said to her: Believe me, the time is coming when you won't worship the Father either on this mountain or in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Awo, he mi oye akɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ miiba ni jeee gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ, ni asaŋ jeee Yerusalɛm ni nyɛaaja Tsɛ lɛ yɛ.

english_verse: You Samaritans don't really know the one you worship. But we Jews do know the God we worship, and by using us, God will save the world.
translation_verse: Nyɛ lɛ, nyɛleee mɔ ni nyɛjaa; wɔ lɛ, wɔle mɔ ni wɔjaa, ejaakɛ walaheremɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ aŋɔɔ ejɛ.

english_verse: But a time is coming, and it is already here! Even now the true worshipers are being led by the Spirit to worship the Father according to the truth. These are the ones the Father is seeking to worship him.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ miiba ni eshɛ momo, be ni anɔkwa jalɔi lɛ aaaja Tsɛ lɛ yɛ mumɔ kɛ anɔkwale mli, ejaakɛ jalɔi ni tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi Tsɛ lɛ taoɔ.

english_verse: God is Spirit, and those who worship God must be led by the Spirit to worship him according to the truth.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Mumɔŋ, ni mɛi ni jaa lɛ lɛ, ja amɛja lɛ yɛ mumɔ kɛ anɔkwale mli.”

english_verse: The woman said, “I know that the Messiah will come. He is the one we call Christ. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”
translation_verse: Yoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mile akɛ Mesia ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kristo lɛ miiba; kɛ eba lɛ, eeegba wɔ nii fɛɛ.”

english_verse: “I am that one,” Jesus told her, “and I am speaking to you now.”
translation_verse: Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mi ni mikɛ bo wieɔ nɛɛ, mi ni.”

english_verse: The disciples returned about this time and were surprised to find Jesus talking with a woman. But none of them asked him what he wanted or why he was talking with her.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba, ni amɛhiɛ fee amɛ yaa akɛ ekɛ yoo miiwie, shi kɛ̃lɛ mɔ ko biii lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni obiɔ lɛ?” Aloo “Mɛni wiemɔ okɛ lɛ wieɔ?”

english_verse: The woman left her water jar and ran back into town, where she said to the people,
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ yoo lɛ shi enugbɛ lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee maŋ lɛ mli, ni eyakɛɛ mɛi lɛ akɛ,

english_verse: “Come and see a man who told me everything I have ever done! Could he be the Messiah?”
translation_verse: “Nyɛbaa nyɛbakwɛa nuu ko ni ejaje nii fɛɛ ni mifee etsɔ̃ɔ mi, akɛ jeee Kristo lɛ ni lo?”

english_verse: Everyone in town went out to see Jesus.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, amɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli amɛba eŋɔɔ.

english_verse: While this was happening, Jesus' disciples were saying to him, “Teacher, please eat something.”
translation_verse: Shi no mli lɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kpa lɛ fai amɛkɛɛ, “Rabi, ye nɔ ko.”

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I have food you don't know anything about.”
translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Miyɛ ŋmaa ni miyeɔ, ni nyɛleee.”

english_verse: His disciples started asking each other, “Has someone brought him something to eat?”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Ani mɔ ko ebahã lɛ nɔ ko eye?”

english_verse: Jesus said: My food is to do what God wants! He is the one who sent me, and I must finish the work that he gave me to do.
translation_verse: Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Miŋmaa ji akɛ mafee mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ suɔmɔnaanii, ni magbe enitsumɔ lɛ naa.

english_verse: You may say there are still four months until harvest time. But I tell you to look, and you will see that the fields are ripe and ready to harvest.
translation_verse: Ani nyɛkɛɛɛ akɛ, ‘Eshwɛ nyɔji ejwɛ ni abelekuumɔbe lɛ shɛɔ?’ Naa, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛwoa nyɛhiɛ nɔ ni nyɛkwɛa ŋmɔji lɛ bɔ ni amɛgba futaa momo ni sa kpamɔ.

english_verse: Even now the harvest workers are receiving their reward by gathering a harvest that brings eternal life. Then everyone who planted the seed and everyone who harvests the crop will celebrate together.
translation_verse: Ni mɔ ni kpaa lɛ naa enyɔmɔwoo, ni ebuaa yibii anaa etoɔ naanɔ wala, koni mɔ ni duɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni kpaa lɛ fɛɛ anya shi kome.

english_verse: So the saying proves true, “Some plant the seed, and others harvest the crop.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ enɛ mli ni wiemɔ ni awie akɛ, ‘Mɔ ko duɔ ni mɔ ko kpaa’ lɛ baa mli yɛ.

english_verse: I am sending you to harvest crops in fields where others have done all the hard work.
translation_verse: Mi lɛ mitsu nyɛ koni nyɛyakpa nɔ ni jeee nyɛ nyɛgbo he deŋme; mɛi krokomɛi egbo he deŋme, ni nyɛba amɛdeŋmegbomɔ lɛ mli.”

english_verse: A lot of Samaritans in that town put their faith in Jesus because the woman had said, “This man told me everything I have ever done.”

translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛ nyɛnaaa okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii lɛ, nyɛheee nyɛyeee.”

translation_verse: koni mɛi fɛɛ abu Bi lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni amɛbuɔ Tsɛ lɛ. Mɔ ni ebuuu Bi lɛ, ebuuu Tsɛ lɛ ni tsu lɛ lɛ hu.

translation_verse: “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ ni nuɔ miwiemɔ ni eheɔ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ eyeɔ lɛ, eyɛ naanɔ wala, ni ebaŋ kojomɔ mli, shi moŋ efo mli yɛ gbele mli kɛtee wala mli.

english_verse: I tell you for certain the time will come, and it is already here, when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God. And those who listen to it will live!
translation_verse: Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ: ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ miiba, ni eshɛ etã, ni gbohii lɛ aaanu Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ gbee, ni mɛi ni nuɔ lɛ aaana wala.

english_verse: The Father has the power to give life, and he has given that same power to the Son.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ yɔɔ wala yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ehã Bi lɛ wala yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli.

english_verse: And he has given his Son the right to judge everyone, because he is the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Ni ehã lɛ hegbɛ akɛ ekojo hu, ejaakɛ lɛ ji Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ.

english_verse: Don't be surprised! The time will come when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of Man,

english_verse: I cannot do anything on my own. The Father sent me, and he is the one who told me how to judge. I judge with fairness, because I obey him, and I don't just try to please myself. Witnesses to Jesus
translation_verse: “Mi diɛŋtsɛ minyɛŋ miyiŋ mato mafee nɔ ko; bɔ ni minuɔ lɛ nakai mikojoɔ, ni mikojomɔ lɛ jalɛ kojomɔ ni, ejaakɛ mitaooo nɔ ni mi diɛŋtsɛ misumɔɔ, shi moŋ nɔ ni mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ sumɔɔ.

english_verse: If I speak for myself, there is no way to prove I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: Kɛji mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe odase miyeɔ lɛ, midase lɛ jeee anɔkwale.

english_verse: But there is someone else who speaks for me, and I know what he says is true.
translation_verse: Mɔ kroko yɛ ni yeɔ mihe odase, ni mile akɛ odase ni eyeɔ yɛ mihe lɛ anɔkwaleŋ.

english_verse: You sent messengers to John, and he told them the truth.
translation_verse: Nyɛ lɛ nyɛtsu atee Yohane ŋɔɔ, ni eye anɔkwale lɛ he odase.

english_verse: I don't depend on what people say about me, but I tell you these things so that you may be saved.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, mikɛ mihe efɔ̃ɔɔ gbɔmɔ ko odase nɔ; shi bɔ ni afee ni ahere nyɛyiwala hewɔ miwieɔ enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ.

english_verse: John was a lamp that gave a lot of light, and you were glad to enjoy his light for a while.
translation_verse: Yohane ji kane ni tsoɔ ni ekpɛɔ lɛ, shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛsumɔ akɛ nyɛmli afili nyɛ be kukuoo kɛkɛ yɛ elá lɛ mli.

english_verse: But something more important than John speaks for me. I mean the things that the Father has given me to do! All of these speak for me and prove that the Father sent me.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, miyɛ odase ni fe Yohane nɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ni Tsɛ lɛ ehã mi akɛ migbe naa lɛ, nakai nitsumɔi ni mitsuɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ yeɔ mihe odase akɛ Tsɛ lɛ tsu mi.

english_verse: The Father who sent me also speaks for me, but you have never heard his voice or seen him face to face.
translation_verse: Ni Tsɛ lɛ ni tsu mi lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eye mihe odase. Nyɛnuko egbee dã lɛ, asaŋ nyɛnako esubaŋ dã;

english_verse: You search the Scriptures, because you think you will find eternal life in them. The Scriptures tell about me,

english_verse: but you refuse to come to me for eternal life.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛsumɔɔɔ akɛ nyɛbaa miŋɔɔ ni nyɛna wala.

english_verse: I don't care about human praise,
