translation_verse: Be ni Yesu yoo akɛ amɛbaaba ni amɛbamɔ lɛ ni amɛyawo lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, ekome too egbala ehe shi kɛtee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ. Yesu nyiɛ nu hiɛ (Mateo

english_verse: The people who had stayed on the east side of the lake knew that only one boat had been there. They also knew that Jesus had not left in it with his disciples. But the next day
translation_verse: Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, asafo ni yɔɔ ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ na akɛ lɛlɛ kroko bɛ jɛi dɔŋŋ akɛ ja ekome kɛkɛ, ni amɛna hu akɛ Yesu kɛ kaselɔi lɛ eyaaa lɛlɛ lɛ mli, shi moŋ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛkɛ yiŋ kɛtee;

english_verse: Don't work for food that spoils. Work for food that gives eternal life. The Son of Man will give you this food, because God the Father has given him the right to do so.”
translation_verse: Nyɛkatsua ŋmaa ni fiteɔ lɛ he nii, shi moŋ nyɛtsua ŋmaa ni hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ wala mli ni Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaahã nyɛ lɛ he nii, ejaakɛ lɛ enaa Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ esɔo.”

english_verse: One of the prophets wrote, “God will teach all of them.” And so everyone who listens to the Father and learns from him will come to me.
translation_verse: Aŋma yɛ gbalɔi lɛ amli akɛ, ‘Amɛ fɛɛ amɛaafee mɛi ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii.’ Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni enu enɛ yɛ Tsɛ lɛ naa ni ekase hu lɛ, ebaa miŋɔɔ.

english_verse: They started arguing with each other and asked, “How can he give us his flesh to eat?”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ taataa naa yɛ amɛteŋ amɛkɛɛ, “Te mɔ nɛ baafee tɛŋŋ ni enyɛ ekɛ eheloo ahã wɔ ni wɔyeŋ?”

english_verse: That evening, Jesus' disciples went down to the lake.
translation_verse: Be ni shɛ gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ yiŋ kɛtee ŋshɔ lɛ naa,

english_verse: and a strong wind was making the water rough.
translation_verse: ni ahum ko ni batswa hewɔ lɛ ŋshɔ lɛ fite.

english_verse: When the disciples had rowed for five or six kilometers, they saw Jesus walking on the water. He kept coming closer to the boat, and they were terrified.
translation_verse: Be ni amɛwiri aaafee shitoi etɛ̃ loo ejwɛ lɛ, amɛna Yesu ni enyiɛ ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ ni eebɛŋkɛ lɛlɛ lɛ, ni amɛshe gbeyei.

english_verse: But he said, “I am Jesus! Don't be afraid!”
translation_verse: Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Miŋ, nyɛkashea gbeyei.”

english_verse: some boats from Tiberias sailed near the place where the crowd had eaten the bread for which the Lord had given thanks.
translation_verse: tsɛbelɛ lɛji krokomɛi jɛ Tiberia ba he ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ da shi ni amɛye aboloo lɛ yɛ lɛ masɛi;

english_verse: They saw that Jesus and his disciples had left. Then they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Jesus.
translation_verse: no hewɔ lɛ, be ni asafo lɛ na akɛ Yesu loo ekaselɔi lɛ bɛ jɛi lɛ, amɛ hu amɛbote lɛji amli, ni amɛba Kapernaum amɛmiitao Yesu.

english_verse: They found him on the west side of the lake and asked, “Rabbi, when did you get here?”
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛbana lɛ yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Rabi, te be ni oba biɛŋ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that you are not looking for me because you saw the miracles, but because you ate all the food you wanted.
translation_verse: Yesu here amɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, jeee okadii lɛ ni nyɛna lɛ hewɔ nyɛtaoɔ mi nɛɛ, shi moŋ akɛni nyɛye aboloo lɛ eko ni nyɛtɔrɔ lɛ hewɔŋ.

english_verse: “What exactly does God want us to do?” the people asked.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Te wɔfee tɛŋŋ ni wɔtsu Nyɔŋmɔ nitsumɔi lɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “God wants you to have faith in the one he sent.”
translation_verse: Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ nɛ, akɛ nyɛhe mɔ ni etsu lɛ nɔ nyɛye.”

english_verse: For example, when our ancestors were in the desert, they were given manna to eat. It happened just as the Scriptures say, ‘God gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ ”
translation_verse: Wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ye mana lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, ‘Ehã amɛ aboloo kɛjɛ ŋwɛi amɛye’ lɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus then told them, “I tell you for certain that Moses wasn't the one who gave you bread from heaven. My Father is the one who gives you the true bread from heaven.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, jeee Mose ji mɔ ni hã nyɛ aboloo lɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi lɛ, shi miTsɛ moŋ hãa nyɛ anɔkwa aboloo ni jɛɔ ŋwɛi lɛ.

english_verse: And the bread that God gives is the one who came down from heaven to give life to the world.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aboloo lɛ ji mɔ ni jɛɔ ŋwɛi ekpelekeɔ shi ni eŋɔɔ wala ehãa je lɛ.”

english_verse: The people said, “Sir, give us this bread and don't ever stop!”
translation_verse: Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, hã wɔ aboloo nɛɛ daa.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am the bread that gives life! No one who comes to me will ever be hungry. No one who has faith in me will ever be thirsty.
translation_verse: Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mi ji wala aboloo lɛ; mɔ ni baa miŋɔɔ lɛ, hɔmɔ yeŋ lɛ gbi ko gbi ko, ni mɔ ni heɔ minɔ yeɔ lɛ, kumai hu yeŋ lɛ gbi ko gbi ko.

english_verse: I have told you already that you have seen me and still do not have faith in me.
translation_verse: Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nyɛna mi, ni kɛ̃lɛ nyɛheee nyɛyeee.

english_verse: Everything and everyone that the Father has given me will come to me, and I won't turn any of them away.
translation_verse: Mɛi fɛɛ ni Tsɛ lɛ kɛhãa mi lɛ aaaba miŋɔɔ, ni mɔ ni baa miŋɔɔ lɛ, mishwieŋ lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: I didn't come from heaven to do what I want! I came to do what the Father wants me to do. He sent me,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ jeee mi diɛŋtsɛ misuɔmɔnaa nifeemɔ hewɔ mijɛ ŋwɛi miba, shi moŋ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ suɔmɔnaa nifeemɔ hewɔŋ.

english_verse: and he wants to make certain that none of the ones he has given me will be lost. Instead, he wants me to raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Shi enɛ ji mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ, akɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni ekɛhã mi lɛ, mikahã amɛteŋ mɔ ko miilaaje, shi moŋ mitee lɛ shi yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: My Father wants everyone who sees the Son to have faith in him and to have eternal life. Then I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ enɛ ji mí-Tsɛ suɔmɔnaanii, akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kwɛɔ Bi lɛ ni eheɔ enɔ eyeɔ lɛ ana naanɔ wala, ni mi lɛ mitee lɛ shi yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: The people started grumbling because Jesus had said he was the bread that had come down from heaven.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ wie ehe huhuuhu akɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mi ji aboloo ni jɛ ŋwɛi lɛ;”

english_verse: They were asking each other, “Isn't he Jesus, the son of Joseph? Don't we know his father and mother? How can he say that he has come down from heaven?”
translation_verse: ni amɛkɛɛ, “Ani jeee Yosef bi Yesu lɛ ni wɔle etsɛ kɛ enyɛ lɛ nɛ? Mɛɛba mɔ ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mijɛ ŋwɛi’ lɛ?”

english_verse: The only one who has seen the Father is the one who has come from him. No one else has ever seen the Father.
translation_verse: Jeee akɛ mɔ ko ena Tsɛ lɛ pɛŋ, ja mɔ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ; lɛ ena Tsɛ lɛ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who has faith in me has eternal life.
translation_verse: Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ eyɛ naanɔ wala.

english_verse: I am the bread that gives life!
translation_verse: Mi ji wala aboloo lɛ.

english_verse: Your ancestors ate manna in the desert, and later they died.
translation_verse: Nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ye mana yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ ni amɛgboi.

english_verse: But the bread from heaven has come down, so that no one who eats it will ever die.
translation_verse: Enɛ ji aboloo ni jɛɔ ŋwɛi baa lɛ, koni gbɔmɔ aye ni ekagbo.

english_verse: I am that bread from heaven! Everyone who eats it will live forever. My flesh is the life-giving bread I give to the people of this world.
translation_verse: Mi ji aboloo ni hiɛ kã ni jɛ ŋwɛi ba lɛ; kɛji mɔ ko ye aboloo nɛɛ eko lɛ, ehiɛ aaakã kɛaatee naanɔ. Shi aboloo ni mikɛbaahã lɛ ji miheloo ni mikɛbaahã yɛ je lɛ wala hewɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that you won't live unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ kɛji nyɛyeee Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ heloo ni nyɛnuuu elá lɛ, nyɛbɛ wala yɛ nyɛmli.

english_verse: But if you do eat my flesh and drink my blood, you will have eternal life, and I will raise you to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yeɔ miheloo ni enuɔ mila lɛ, eyɛ naanɔ wala, ni mi lɛ matee lɛ shi yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: My flesh is the true food, and my blood is the true drink.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ miheloo lɛ anɔkwa ŋmaa ni, ni milá lɛ anɔkwa numɔnɔ ni.

english_verse: If you eat my flesh and drink my blood, you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yeɔ miheloo ni enuɔ mila lɛ, ehiɔ mimli, ni mi hu mihiɔ emli.

english_verse: The living Father sent me, and I have life because of him. Now everyone who eats my flesh will live because of me.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni Tsɛ, hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, tsu mi, ni Tsɛ lɛ hewɔ mihiɛ kã lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ ni yeɔ mi lɛ hu hiɛ aaakã yɛ mihewɔ.

english_verse: The bread that comes down from heaven isn't like what your ancestors ate. They died, but whoever eats this bread will live forever.
translation_verse: Aboloo ni jɛ ŋwɛi ba nɛ; etamɔɔɔ nɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ye ni amɛgboi lɛ; mɔ ni yeɔ aboloo nɛɛ lɛ, ehiɛ aaakã kɛaatee naanɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus was teaching in a synagogue in Capernaum when he said these things. The Words of Eternal Life
translation_verse: Ewie nii nɛɛ, be ni etsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ kpeehe ko yɛ Kapernaum lɛ. Naanɔ wala wiemɔi lɛ

english_verse: Many of Jesus' disciples heard him and said, “This is too hard for anyone to understand.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, be ni ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii nu enɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Wiemɔ ni wa nɛ; namɔ aaanyɛ toi abo?”

english_verse: Jesus knew that his disciples were grumbling. So he asked, “Does this bother you?
translation_verse: Be ni Yesu yoo akɛ ekaselɔi lɛ miihuhuu yɛ enɛ hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani enɛ tɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ nyɛnane nɛɛ?

english_verse: What if you should see the Son of Man go up to heaven where he came from?
translation_verse: Shi kɛji nyɛna Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ miiya ŋwɛi he ni eyɔɔ sa lɛ, no hu?

english_verse: The Spirit is the one who gives life! Human strength can do nothing. The words that I have spoken to you are from that life-giving Spirit.
translation_verse: Mumɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni hãa wala lɛ; heloo lɛ ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko. Wiemɔi ni mikɛ nyɛ wie lɛ, mumɔ ni, ni wala ni.

english_verse: But some of you refuse to have faith in me.” Jesus said this, because from the beginning he knew who would have faith in him. He also knew which one would betray him.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi yɛ ni heee yeee.” Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ Yesu le mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ kɛ mɔ hu ni baatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “You cannot come to me, unless the Father makes you want to come. That is why I have told these things to all of you.”
translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ, “Enɛ hewɔ mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mɔ ko nyɛŋ miŋɔɔ aba, ja Tsɛ lɛ ehã lɛ hegbɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: Because of what Jesus said, many of his disciples turned their backs on him and stopped following him.
translation_verse: Jɛ no nɔ lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii ku amɛsɛɛ ni amɛkɛ lɛ enyiɛɛɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Jesus then asked his twelve disciples if they also were going to leave him.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu bi mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛ hu nyɛmiisumɔ akɛ nyɛaatee?”

english_verse: Simon Peter answered, “Lord, there is no one else that we can go to! Your words give eternal life.
translation_verse: Simon Petro here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, namɔ ŋɔɔ wɔɔtee? Bo oyɔɔ naanɔ wala wiemɔi lɛ;

english_verse: We have faith in you, and we are sure that you are God's Holy One.”
translation_verse: ni wɔ lɛ wɔhe wɔye ni asaŋ wɔna wɔle akɛ bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ!”

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “I chose all twelve of you, but one of you is a demon!”
translation_verse: Yesu here amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Ani jeee nyɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ mihala? Shi nyɛteŋ mɔ kome lɛ abonsam ni!”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. He would later betray Jesus, even though he was one of the twelve disciples.
translation_verse: Shi Yuda Iskariot, Simon bi lɛ, he ewieɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ lɛ ji mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni baatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Jesus decided to leave Judea and to start going through Galilee because the leaders of the people wanted to kill him.
translation_verse: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Yesu kpa shi yɛ Galilea. Esumɔɔɔ akɛ eyakpaa shi yɛ Yudea, ejaakɛ Yudafoi lɛ miitao lɛ agbe.

english_verse: It was almost time for the Festival of Shelters,
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ Yudafoi lɛ Asesei agbijurɔ lɛ eshɛ etã.

english_verse: and Jesus' brothers said to him, “Why don't you go to Judea? Then your disciples can see what you are doing.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Jee biɛ ni oya Yudea, koni okaselɔi lɛ hu ana onitsumɔi ni otsuɔ lɛ.

english_verse: No one does anything in secret, if they want others to know about them. So let the world know what you are doing!”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɔ ko ni etao akɛ ale lɛ jogbaŋŋ lɛ efeee nɔ ko yɛ teemɔ mli. Akɛni oofee nibii nɛɛ lɛ, jiemɔ ohe shi otsɔ̃ɔ je lɛ.”

english_verse: Even Jesus' own brothers had not yet become his followers.
translation_verse: Shi enyɛmimɛi lɛ tete po heee enɔ yeee.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My time hasn't yet come, but your time is always here.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mibe lɛ nako ashɛ, shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛbe lɛ daa nɛɛ eshɛ.

english_verse: The people of this world cannot hate you. They hate me, because I tell them that they do evil things.
translation_verse: Je lɛ nyɛɛɛ nyɛ anyɛ; shi mi lɛ enyɛɔ mi, ejaakɛ miyeɔ ehe odase akɛ enitsumɔi lɛ nitsumɔi fɔ̃ji ni.

english_verse: Go on to the festival. My time hasn't yet come, and I am not going.”
translation_verse: Nyɛ lɛ nyɛyaa gbijurɔ nɛɛ yeli; shi mi lɛ minako maya, ejaakɛ mibe lɛ nako ashɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus said this and stayed on in Galilee. Jesus at the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: Be ni ekɛɛ amɛ nɛkɛ lɛ, ehi shi yɛ Galilea.

english_verse: After Jesus' brothers had gone to the festival, he went secretly, without telling anyone.
translation_verse: Shi be ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ etee gbijurɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, lɛ hu etee, shi ejieee ehe shi, shi moŋ efee tamɔ mɔ ko ni miitee ehe.

english_verse: During the festival the leaders of the people looked for Jesus and asked, “Where is he?”
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ Yudafoi lɛ bɔ̃i lɛ taomɔ yɛ gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Nɛgbɛ eyɔɔ?”

english_verse: The crowds even got into an argument about him. Some were saying, “Jesus is a good man,” while others were saying, “He is lying to everyone.”
translation_verse: Ni huhuhuhu wiemɔi pii ete shi yɛ mɛi lɛ ateŋ yɛ ehe. Mɛi komɛi kɛɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ kpakpa ji lɛ;” ni mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ akɛ, “Dabi, hã moŋ ehãa asafo lɛ duduɔ.”

english_verse: But the people were afraid of their leaders, and none of them talked in public about him.
translation_verse: Tsɛbelɛ mɔ ko ejeee faŋŋ ewieee ehe yɛ Yudafoi lɛ ashemɔ hewɔ.

english_verse: When the festival was about half over, Jesus went into the temple and started teaching.
translation_verse: Shi be ni shɛ gbijurɔ lɛ teŋ lɛ, Yesu tee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni eyatsɔ̃ɔ nii.

english_verse: The leaders were surprised and said, “How does this man know so much? He has never been taught!”
translation_verse: Ni Yudafoi lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe ni amɛkɛɛ, “Te mɔ nɛ ni ekaseko nii lɛ fee tɛŋŋ ni ele woji amli nii nɛkɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am not teaching something I thought up. What I teach comes from the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Yesu here amɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Minitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, jeee minɔŋ, shi moŋ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ nɔŋ.

english_verse: If you really want to obey God, you will know if what I teach comes from God or from me.
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ akɛ efee esuɔmɔnaanii lɛ, ebaayoo yɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ jɛ aloo mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ mitoɔ miwieɔ.

english_verse: If I wanted to bring honor to myself, I would speak for myself. But I want to honor the one who sent me. This is why I tell the truth and not a lie.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni toɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiŋ ewieɔ lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enunyam etaoɔ, shi mɔ ni taoɔ mɔ ni tsu lɛ lɛ anunyam lɛ, lɛ lɛ anɔkwafo ji lɛ, ni nɔ ni ejaaa gbɛ bɛ emli.

english_verse: Didn't Moses give you the Law? Yet none of you obey it! So why do you want to kill me?
translation_verse: Ani jeee Mose hã nyɛ Mla lɛ? Ni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko yeee Mla lɛ nɔ. Mɛni hewɔ nyɛtaoɔ mi nyɛgbe lɛ?”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “You're crazy! What makes you think someone wants to kill you?”
translation_verse: Asafo lɛ here nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Mumɔ fɔŋ yɛ omli; namɔ taoɔ bo agbe?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I worked one miracle, and it amazed you.
translation_verse: Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nitsumɔ kome mitsu, ni nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛnaa ekpɛ nyɛhe yɛ he.

english_verse: Moses commanded you to circumcise your sons. But it wasn't really Moses who gave you this command. It was your ancestors, and even on the Sabbath you circumcise your sons
translation_verse: Mose kɛ ketiafoo lɛ hã nyɛ — jeee akɛ lɛ Mose lɛ eŋɔɔ ejɛ, shi moŋ ejɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ — ni hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛfoɔ mɔ ketia.

english_verse: in order to obey the Law of Moses. Why are you angry with me for making someone completely well on the Sabbath?
translation_verse: Kɛji hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ afoɔ mɔ kɛtia bɔ ni afee ni akatɔ̃ Mose Mla lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɛɛba nyɛmli fuɔ mi akɛ mitsa gbɔmɔ muu lɛ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ?

english_verse: Don't judge by appearances. Judge by what is right.
translation_verse: Nyɛkakwɛa hiɛiaŋ nyɛkojoa, shi moŋ nyɛkojoa jalɛ kojomɔ.” Ani Kristo lɛ nɛ?

english_verse: Some of the people from Jerusalem were saying, “Isn't this the man they want to kill?
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yerusalɛmbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɛ, “Ani jeee mɔ ni amɛtaoɔ amɛgbe lɛ nɛ?

english_verse: Yet here he is, speaking for everyone to hear. And no one is arguing with him. Do you suppose the authorities know he is the Messiah?
translation_verse: Ni naa, faŋŋ ewieɔ yɛ nɛɛ, ni amɛkɛɛɛ lɛ nɔ ko. Ekolɛ benɛ onukpai lɛ ena ele lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ mɔ nɛ ji Kristo lɛ?

english_verse: But how could that be? No one knows where the Messiah will come from, but we know where this man comes from.”
translation_verse: Shi mɔ nɛ lɛ, wɔle he ni ejɛ; shi Kristo lɛ, be ni eeeba lɛ, mɔ ko leŋ he ni ejɛ.”

english_verse: As Jesus was teaching in the temple, he shouted, “Do you really think you know me and where I came from? I didn't come on my own! The one who sent me is truthful, and you don't know him.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ebo ekɛɛ, “Nyɛle mi, ni asaŋ nyɛle he ni mijɛ; ni mitooo mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ mibaaa, shi moŋ anɔkwafo ji mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ, ni nyɛleee lɛ.

english_verse: But I know the one who sent me, because I came from him.”
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ mile lɛ, ejaakɛ eŋɔɔ mijɛ, ni lɛ etsu mi.”

english_verse: Some of the people wanted to arrest Jesus right then. But no one even laid a hand on him, because his time had not yet come.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, amɛmiitao amɛmɔ lɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ mɔ ko etaaa ehe, ejaakɛ eŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ shɛko.

english_verse: A lot of people in the crowd put their faith in him and said, “When the Messiah comes, he surely won't perform more miracles than this man has done!” Officers Sent To Arrest Jesus
translation_verse: Shi asafo lɛ mli mɛi pii he enɔ amɛye, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Be ni Kristo lɛ aaaba lɛ, ani eeefee okadii pii fe nii ni mɔ nɛ feɔ nɛɛ?” Yesu gba eŋwɛiyaa eto

english_verse: When the Pharisees heard the crowd arguing about Jesus, they got together with the chief priests and sent some temple police to arrest him.
translation_verse: Farisifoi lɛ nu akɛ asafo lɛ miiwie nii nɛɛ ahe huhuhuhu yɛ ehe; ni Farisifoi lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ tsu tsuji koni amɛyamɔ lɛ.

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I will be with you a little while longer, and then I will return to the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Be fioo kɛkɛ eshwɛ ni mikɛ nyɛ baahi shi, ni mibaya mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ ŋɔɔ.

english_verse: You will look for me, but you won't find me. You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Nyɛaatao mi ni nyɛnaŋ mi, ni he ni miyɔɔ lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋ jɛi nyɛba.”

english_verse: The people asked each other, “Where can he go to keep us from finding him? Is he going to some foreign country where our people live? Is he going there to teach the Greeks?
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ mɔ nɛ baaya ni wɔnaŋ lɛ? Ani mɛi ni egbɛ eshwã Helabii lɛ ateŋ lɛ aŋɔɔ ebaaya, ni eyatsɔ̃ɔ Helabii lɛ anii?

english_verse: What did he mean by saying that we will look for him, but won't find him? Why can't we go where he is going?” Streams of Life-Giving Water
translation_verse: Mɛɛ wiemɔ ewie nɛɛ, ‘Nyɛaatao mi ni nyɛnaŋ mi, ni he ni miyɔɔ lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋ jɛi nyɛba lɛ?’ ” Wala nu lɛ he shiwoo

english_verse: On the last and most important day of the festival, Jesus stood up and shouted, “If you are thirsty, come to me and drink!
translation_verse: Shi naagbee gbi ni ji gbii juji lɛ ateŋ gbi wulu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yesu yadamɔ shi ni ebo ekɛɛ, “Kɛji kumai miiye mɔ ko lɛ, eba miŋɔɔ ni ebanu nu.

english_verse: Have faith in me, and you will have life-giving water flowing from deep inside you, just as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Mɔ ni heɔ minɔ eyeɔ lɛ, bɔ ni ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ lɛ, fai ni wala nu yɔɔ mli aaajɛ emli aho.”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the Holy Spirit, who would be given to everyone that had faith in him. The Spirit had not yet been given to anyone, since Jesus had not yet been given his full glory. The People Take Sides
translation_verse: Shi Mumɔ lɛ ni mɛi ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ baana lɛ he ewie nɛɛ; shi Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nako aba, ejaakɛ anako awo Yesu hiɛ nyam. Mligbalamɔ ba mɛi lɛ ateŋ yɛ Yesu hewɔ

english_verse: When the crowd heard Jesus say this, some of them said, “He must be the Prophet!”
translation_verse: Be ni asafo lɛ mli mɛi komɛi nu wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Gbalɔ lɛ nɛ lɛɛlɛŋ!”

english_verse: Others said, “He is the Messiah!” Others even said, “Can the Messiah come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Mɛi komɛi kɛɛ, “Kristo lɛ nɛ!” Shi mɛi krokomɛi hu kɛɛ, “Ani Kristo lɛ, Galilea ebaajɛ?

english_verse: The Scriptures say that the Messiah will come from the family of King David. Doesn't this mean that he will be born in David's hometown of Bethlehem?”
translation_verse: Ani Ŋmalɛ lɛ ekɛɛɛ akɛ David shwiei lɛ mli kɛ Betlehem maŋ he ni David hi lɛ, jɛi Kristo lɛ baajɛ?”

english_verse: The people started taking sides against each other because of Jesus.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mligbalamɔ ba asafo lɛ mli yɛ ehewɔ.

english_verse: Some of them wanted to arrest him, but no one laid a hand on him. The Leaders Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus
translation_verse: Shi kulɛ amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi miitao akɛ amɛmɔɔ lɛ shi kɛ̃lɛ mɔ ko etaaa ehe. Yudafoi anukpai lɛ sumɔɔɔ akɛ mɔ ko heɔ Yesu nɔ yeɔ

english_verse: When the temple police returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, they were asked, “Why didn't you bring Jesus here?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni tsuji lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ aŋɔɔ. Amɛbi tsuji lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛkɛ lɛ baaa?”

english_verse: They answered, “No one has ever spoken like this man!”
translation_verse: Tsuji lɛ here nɔ akɛ, “Bɔ ni gbɔmɔ nɛɛ wieɔ lɛ, mɔ ko ewieko nakai dã.”

english_verse: The Pharisees said to them, “Have you also been fooled?
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Farisifoi lɛ here amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Ani nyɛ hu alaka nyɛ?

english_verse: Not one of the chief priests or the Pharisees has faith in him.
translation_verse: Ani onukpai lɛ loo Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ehe enɔ eye?

english_verse: And these people who don't know the Law are under God's curse anyway.”
translation_verse: Shi asafo ni leee Mla nɛɛ, alomɔ amɛ.”

english_verse: Nicodemus was there at the time. He was a member of the council, and was the same one who had earlier come to see Jesus. He said,
translation_verse: Nikodemo, amɛteŋ mɔ kome ni ba Yesu ŋɔɔ be ko lɛ, kɛɛ amɛ akɛ,

english_verse: “Our Law doesn't let us condemn people before we hear what they have to say. We cannot judge them before we know what they have done.”
translation_verse: “Kɛ anuko mɔ ko daaŋ gbee ni aaale nɔ ni efee lɛ, wɔmla lɛ buɔ le fɔ lo?”

english_verse: Then they said, “Nicodemus, you must be from Galilee! Read the Scriptures, and you will find that no prophet is to come from Galilee.” A Woman Caught in Sin
translation_verse: Amɛhere nɔ amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani bo hu Galilea ojɛ? Taomɔ mli okwɛ, shi gbalɔ ko eteko shi kɛjɛko Galilea pɛŋ.” [

english_verse: Everyone else went home,
translation_verse: Ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee ewe.

english_verse: but Jesus walked out to the Mount of Olives.
translation_verse: Shi Yesu yiŋ etee Mugɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Then early the next morning he went to the temple. The people came to him, and he sat down and started teaching them.
translation_verse: Ni leebi maaŋkpa lɛ eba Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni maŋ lɛ fɛɛ ba eŋɔɔ, ni eho eta shi etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii.

english_verse: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses brought in a woman who had been caught in bed with a man who wasn't her husband. They made her stand in the middle of the crowd.
translation_verse: Ni mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ ŋɔ yoo ko ni amɔ lɛ yɛ gbãlãfitemɔ mli kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni amɛhã edamɔ teŋ,

english_verse: Then they said, “Teacher, this woman was caught sleeping with a man who isn't her husband.
translation_verse: ni amɛkɛɛ Yesu akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ, gbãlãfitemɔ mli diɛŋtsɛ amɔ lɛ yɛ amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: The Law of Moses teaches that a woman like this should be stoned to death! What do you say?”
translation_verse: Mla lɛ mli lɛ Mose wo wɔ kitã akɛ atswia nɛkɛ yei atɛi. Shi bo lɛ, te okɛɔ tɛŋŋ?”

english_verse: They asked Jesus this question, because they wanted to test him and bring some charge against him. But Jesus simply bent over and started writing on the ground with his finger.
translation_verse: Shi enɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛ amɛkɛtsɔ̃ lɛ, koni amɛna nɔ ko amɛkɛyafolɔ enaa. Ni Yesu koto shi, ni ekɛ ewao ŋma nii yɛ shikpɔŋ.

english_verse: They kept on asking Jesus about the woman. Finally, he stood up and said, “If any of you have never sinned, then go ahead and throw the first stone at her!”
translation_verse: Shi be ni amɛhiɛ lɛ bimɔ lɛ, ewo ehe nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛteŋ mɔ ni esha bɛ ehe lɛ, lɛ tsutsu etswa lɛ tɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: Once again he bent over and began writing on the ground.
translation_verse: Ni esaa ekoto shi ekoŋŋ, ni eŋma nii yɛ shikpɔŋ.

english_verse: The people left one by one, beginning with the oldest. Finally, Jesus and the woman were there alone.
translation_verse: Be ni amɛnu nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ, amɛbɔ̃i kpojee ekomekome, kɛjɛ klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ nɔ kɛyashi sɛɛkpee mɔ nɔ, ni bashwɛ Yesu kome kɛkɛ kɛ yoo lɛ ni edãmɔ te lɛ mli.

english_verse: Jesus stood up and asked her, “Where is everyone? Isn't there anyone left to accuse you?”
translation_verse: Shi be ni Yesu wo ehe nɔ ni enaaa mɔ ko akɛ ja yoo lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ, ebi lɛ akɛ, “Awo, nɛgbɛ onaafolɔlɔi lɛ yɔɔ, Ani mɔ ko ebuko bo fɔ?”

english_verse: “No sir,” the woman answered. Then Jesus told her, “I am not going to accuse you either. You may go now, but don't sin anymore.” Jesus Is the Light for the World
translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ, “Mɔ ko ebuko mi fɔ, Nuŋtsɔ.” Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mi hu mibuuu bo fɔ; yaa, shi kaafee esha dɔŋŋ.”] Yesu ye lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe odase

english_verse: Once again Jesus spoke to the people. This time he said, “I am the light for the world! Follow me, and you won't be walking in the dark. You will have the light that gives life.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛ amɛ wie ekoŋŋ ekɛɛ, “Mi ji je lɛ mli la lɛ. Mɔ ni nyiɛɔ misɛɛ lɛ, enyiɛŋ duŋ mli gbi ko gbi ko, shi moŋ eeena wala la lɛ.”

english_verse: The Pharisees objected, “You are the only one speaking for yourself, and what you say isn't true!”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Farisifoi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo lɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe odase oyeɔ; odase lɛ bɛ mli.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Even if I do speak for myself, what I say is true! I know where I came from and where I am going. But you don't know where I am from or where I am going.
translation_verse: Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Kɛ miiye mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe odase hu jiŋŋ, midase lɛ anɔkwale ni, ejaakɛ mile he ni mijɛ kɛ he ni miyaa, shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛleee he ni mijɛ aloo he ni miyaa.

english_verse: You judge in the same way that everyone else does, but I don't judge anyone.
translation_verse: Nyɛ lɛ nyɛkojoɔ bɔ ni gbɔmɛi kojoɔ; mi lɛ mikojooo mɔ ko.

english_verse: If I did judge, I would judge fairly, because I would not be doing it alone. The Father who sent me is here with me.
translation_verse: Ni kɛ mikojoɔ tete po, mikojomɔ lɛ anɔkwale ni; ejaakɛ jeee mi kome ni, shi moŋ mi kɛ Tsɛ ni tsu mi lɛ ni.

english_verse: Your Law requires two witnesses to prove that something is true.
translation_verse: Ni asaŋ nyɛmla lɛ mli hu aŋma akɛ, ‘Mɛi enyɔ odase lɛ anɔkwaleŋ.’

english_verse: I am one of my witnesses, and the Father who sent me is the other one.
translation_verse: Mi lɛ miyeɔ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe odase, ni Tsɛ ni tsu mi lɛ hu yeɔ mihe odase.”

english_verse: “Where is your Father?” they asked. “You don't know me or my Father!” Jesus answered. “If you knew me, you would know my Father.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ oTsɛ lɛ yɔɔ?” Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “Nyɛleee mi ni nyɛsaa nyɛleee miTsɛ; nyɛle mi jikulɛ, nyɛaale miTsɛ hu.”

english_verse: Jesus said this while he was still teaching in the place where the temple treasures were stored. But no one arrested him, because his time had not yet come. You Cannot Go Where I Am Going
translation_verse: Yesu wie wiemɔi nɛɛ yɛ nitoohe lɛ, be ni etsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ; ni mɔ ko mɔɔɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ eŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ shɛko.

english_verse: Jesus also told them, “I am going away, and you will look for me. But you cannot go where I am going, and you will die with your sins unforgiven.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ Yesu saa kɛɛ amɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Mi lɛ miiya, ni nyɛaatao mi, ni nyɛhe esha lɛ mli nyɛaagboi yɛ; he ni miyaa lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋ jɛi nyɛba.”

english_verse: The people asked, “Does he intend to kill himself? Is that what he means by saying we cannot go where he is going?”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛ, “Ani eyaagbe ehe hewɔ ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘he ni miyaa lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋ jɛi nyɛba’ lɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You are from below, but I am from above. You belong to this world, but I don't.
translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ lɛ nyɛjɛ shishi nɛɛ, mi lɛ mijɛ ŋwɛi; nyɛ lɛ nyɛjɛ je nɛɛ mli, mi lɛ mijɛɛɛ je nɛɛ mli.

english_verse: This is why I said you will die with your sins unforgiven. If you don't have faith in me for who I am, you will die, and your sins will not be forgiven.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nyɛaagboi yɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ amli lɛ; ejaakɛ kɛ nyɛheee nyɛyeee akɛ mi nɛɛ ji lɛ lɛ, nyɛaagboi yɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ amli.”

english_verse: “Who are you?” they asked Jesus. Jesus answered, “I am exactly who I told you at the beginning.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ ji bo?” Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nɔ nɔŋŋ ni mikɛɔ nyɛ kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ.

english_verse: There is a lot more I could say to condemn you. But the one who sent me is truthful, and I tell the people of this world only what I have heard from him.”
translation_verse: Miyɛ nyɛhe saji pii ni mawie ni mikɛaakojo nyɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ anɔkwafoŋ, ni mi lɛ, nii ni minu yɛ enaa lɛ, nomɛi nɔŋŋ miwieɔ mitsɔ̃ɔ je lɛ.”

english_verse: No one understood that Jesus was talking to them about the Father.
translation_verse: Amɛleee akɛ Tsɛ lɛ he ekɛ amɛ wieɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Jesus went on to say, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, you will know who I am. You will also know that I don't do anything on my own. I say only what my Father taught me.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Be ni nyɛaawo Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ lɛ, no mli nyɛaale akɛ mi ni, ni akɛ mitooo miyiŋ mifeee nɔ ko, shi moŋ bɔ ni miTsɛ tsɔ̃ɔ mi lɛ, nakai miwieɔ.

english_verse: The one who sent me is with me. I always do what pleases him, and he will never leave me.”
translation_verse: Ni mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ kɛ mi yɛ; Tsɛ lɛ shiko mi kome, ejaakɛ mi lɛ nɔ ni sa ehiɛ mifeɔ daa.”

english_verse: After Jesus said this, many of the people put their faith in him. The Truth Will Set You Free
translation_verse: Be ni ewieɔ nii nɛɛ lɛ, mɛi pii he enɔ ye. Anɔkwale lɛ aaahã nyɛye nyɛhe

english_verse: Jesus told the people who had faith in him, “If you keep on obeying what I have said, you truly are my disciples.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ Yudafoi ni ehe lɛ eye lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛhi shi yɛ miwiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ, minɔkwa kaselɔi ji nyɛ,

english_verse: You will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
translation_verse: ni nyɛaale anɔkwale lɛ, ni anɔkwale lɛ aaahã nyɛye nyɛhe.”

english_verse: They answered, “We are Abraham's children! We have never been anyone's slaves. How can you say we will be set free?”
translation_verse: Amɛhere lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Abraham shwiei ji wɔ, ni wɔtsɔ̃mɔ̃ko mɔ ko nyɔji pɛŋ; te tɛŋŋ ni bo okɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛaaye nyɛheŋ?’ ”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I tell you for certain that anyone who sins is a slave of sin!
translation_verse: Yesu here amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ esha lɛ, esha lɛ nyɔŋ ji lɛ.

english_verse: And slaves don't stay in the family forever, though the Son will always remain in the family.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋ ehiii shĩa kɛyaaa naanɔ; shi bi hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.

english_verse: If the Son gives you freedom, you are free!
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji Bi lɛ hã nyɛye nyɛhe lɛ, no nyɛaaye nyɛhe lɛɛlɛŋ.

english_verse: I know that you are from Abraham's family. Yet you want to kill me, because my message isn't really in your hearts.
translation_verse: Mile akɛ Abraham shwiei ji nyɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ nyɛmiitao mi nyɛgbe, ejaakɛ miwiemɔ hooo nyɛmli.

english_verse: I am telling you what my Father has shown me, just as you are doing what your father has taught you. Your Father Is the Devil
translation_verse: Mi lɛ, nɔ ni mina yɛ miTsɛ he lɛ, no miwieɔ; ni nyɛ hu, nɔ ni nyɛnu yɛ nyɛtsɛ naa lɛ, no nyɛfeɔ.”

english_verse: The people said to Jesus, “Abraham is our father!” Jesus replied, “If you were Abraham's children, you would do what Abraham did.
translation_verse: Amɛhere nɔ amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔtsɛ ji Abraham.” Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Abrahambii ji nyɛ jikulɛ, nyɛaatsu Abraham nitsumɔi.

english_verse: Instead, you want to kill me for telling you the truth that God gave me. Abraham never did anything like that.
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ nyɛmiitao mi nyɛgbe, mi gbɔmɔ ko ni mikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale ni minu yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naa lɛ; Abraham efeee enɛ.

english_verse: But you are doing exactly what your father does.” “Don't accuse us of having someone else as our father!” they said. “We just have one father, and he is God.”
translation_verse: Nyɛ lɛ, nyɛtsɛ nitsumɔi nyɛtsuɔ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ afɔɔɔ wɔ yɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ mli; Tsɛ kome wɔyɔɔ, lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: If God were your Father, you would love me, because I came from God and now I am here. He sent me. I did not come on my own.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ ji nyɛTsɛ kulɛ, nyɛaasumɔ mi; ejaakɛ mi lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ mijɛ miba; ni asaŋ mitooo mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ mibaaa, shi moŋ lɛ etsu mi.

english_verse: Why can't you understand what I am talking about? Can't you stand to hear what I am saying?
translation_verse: Shi mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛnaaa miwiemɔ naa lɛ? Ejɛ miwiemɔ toi ni nyɛbooo lɛ.

english_verse: Your father is the devil, and you do exactly what he wants. He has always been a murderer and a liar. There is nothing truthful about him. He speaks on his own, and everything he says is a lie. Not only is he a liar himself, but he is also the father of all lies.

translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ, “Kaagba enaa; efee enɛ eto mifuu gbi lɛ.

translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ohiafoi lɛ, nyɛkɛ amɛ yɛ daa; shi mi lɛ, jeee daa nyɛkɛ mi aaahi shi.” Atee Lazaro yinɔ apam

translation_verse: Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kpɛ mli akɛ amɛaagbe Lazaro hu,

translation_verse: Mɛnɛɛmɛi ba Filipo ni jɛ Betsaida yɛ Galilea lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, wɔmiitao akɛ wɔna Yesu.”

english_verse: So Father, bring glory to yourself. A voice from heaven then said, “I have already brought glory to myself, and I will do it again!”
translation_verse: Ataa, wo ogbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam!” Kɛkɛ ni gbee ko jɛ ŋwɛi kɛɛ, “Mina miwo ehiɛ nyam, ni masaa mawo ehiɛ nyam ekoŋŋ.”

english_verse: “The Lord has blinded the eyes of the people, and he has made the people stubborn. He did this so that they could not see or understand, and so that they would not turn to the Lord and be healed.”
translation_verse: “Eshwila amɛhiŋmɛii, ni ekpliŋ amɛtsui; koni amɛkana kɛ amɛhiŋmɛii, ni amɛna naa kɛ amɛtsui, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ ni mitsa amɛ.”

english_verse: The next day a large crowd was in Jerusalem for Passover. When they heard that Jesus was coming for the festival,
translation_verse: Enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni mɛi babaoo ni eba gbijurɔ lɛ nu akɛ Yesu miiba Yerusalɛm lɛ,

english_verse: “People of Jerusalem, don't be afraid! Your King is now coming, and he is riding on a donkey.”
translation_verse: “Kaashe gbeyei, Zion biyoo! Naa, omaŋtsɛ lɛ miiba. Eta tejibi nɔ.”

english_verse: At first, Jesus' disciples did not understand. But after he had been given his glory, they remembered all this. Everything had happened exactly as the Scriptures said it would.
translation_verse: Shi ekaselɔi lɛ enaaa nii nɛɛ ashishi mra mli, shi be ni awo Yesu hiɛ nyam lɛ, no dani amɛkai akɛ aŋma nii nɛɛ yɛ ehe, ni no afee ahã lɛ lɛ.

english_verse: A crowd had come to meet Jesus because they had seen him call Lazarus out of the tomb. They kept talking about him and this miracle.
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ hu ni asafo lɛ yakpee lɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛnu akɛ efee naakpɛɛnii nɛɛ.

english_verse: Some Greeks had gone to Jerusalem to worship during Passover.
translation_verse: Shi Helabii komɛi yɛ mɛi ni ba koni amɛbaja Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ.

english_verse: Philip told Andrew. Then the two of them went to Jesus and told him. The Son of Man Must Be Lifted Up
translation_verse: Filipo ba ni ebakɛɛ Andrea, ni Andrea kɛ Filipo bakɛɛ Yesu.

english_verse: Jesus said: The time has come for the Son of Man to be given his glory.
translation_verse: Ni Yesu here amɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “Ŋmɛlɛtswaa ni akɛbaawo Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hiɛ nyam lɛ eshɛ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that a grain of wheat that falls on the ground will never be more than one grain unless it dies. But if it dies, it will produce lots of wheat.
translation_verse: Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, kɛ ŋmaa kuli enyɔɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni egbo lɛ, no lɛ eyɛ akɛ ŋmaa kuli kome lɛ nɔŋŋ; shi kɛji egbo lɛ, ewoɔ yibii pii.

english_verse: If you love your life, you will lose it. If you give it up in this world, you will be given eternal life.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni dɔɔ ewala he lɛ, elaajeɔ lɛ, shi mɔ ni nyɛɔ ewala yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ, eeeto lɛ kɛaatee naanɔ wala mli.

english_verse: Now I am deeply troubled, and I don't know what to say. But I must not ask my Father to keep me from this time of suffering. In fact, I came into the world to suffer.
translation_verse: “Agbɛnɛ misusuma miihao, ni mɛni makɛɛ? Ataa, heremɔ mi kɛjɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɛɛ mli! Shi asaŋ enɛ hewɔ miba ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɛɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: When the crowd heard the voice, some of them thought it was thunder. Others thought an angel had spoken to Jesus.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni asafo ni damɔ jɛi ni nu lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ eshi!” Mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ, “Ŋwɛi bɔfo ko kɛ lɛ ewie!”

english_verse: Then Jesus told the crowd, “That voice spoke to help you, not me.
translation_verse: Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Jeee mi hewɔ gbee nɛɛ ba, shi nyɛ moŋ nyɛhewɔ.

english_verse: This world's people are now being judged, and the ruler of this world is already being thrown out!
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ je nɛɛŋ kojomɔ lɛ eshɛ; agbɛnɛ abaafã je nɛɛŋ lumɔ lɛ ashɛ afɔ̃.

english_verse: If I am lifted up above the earth, I will make everyone want to come to me.”
translation_verse: Ni mi lɛ, kɛji awo minɔ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, magbala mɛi fɛɛ kɛaaba miŋɔɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the way he would be put to death.
translation_verse: Shi enɛ lɛ ekɛɛ ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ nɔ gbele ni ebaagbo.

english_verse: The crowd said to Jesus, “The Scriptures teach that the Messiah will live forever. How can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Asafo lɛ here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ wɔnu yɛ Mla lɛ mli akɛ Kristo lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ; ni te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni bo lɛ okɛɔ akɛ ja awo Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ lɛ? Namɔ ji nɛkɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi nɛɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “The light will be with you for only a little longer. Walk in the light while you can. Then you won't be caught walking blindly in the dark.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Be kukuoo kɛkɛ eshwɛ ehã la lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ. Gbii abɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ la lɛ nɛɛ, nyɛnyiɛa koni duŋ akabanina nyɛ; shi mɔ ni nyiɛɔ duŋ mli lɛ, eleee he ni eyaa.

english_verse: Have faith in the light while it is with you, and you will be children of the light.” The People Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus After Jesus had said these things, he left and went into hiding.
translation_verse: Gbii abɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ la lɛ nɛɛ, nyɛhea la lɛ nɔ nyɛyea, koni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ la bii.” Yesu wie nii nɛɛ, ni eyiŋ etee ni ekɛ ehe tee amɛ. Yudafoi lɛ heee Yesu nɔ amɛyeee

english_verse: This happened so that what the prophet Isaiah had said would come true, “Lord, who has believed our message? And who has seen your mighty strength?”
translation_verse: koni gbalɔ Yesaia wiemɔ ni ewie lɛ ana aba mli akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, namɔ ehe wɔsane lɛ eye, Ni namɔ ajie Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewalɛ lɛ kpo atsɔ̃ɔ?”

english_verse: The people could not have faith in Jesus, because Isaiah had also said,
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ ni amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛhe amɛye lɛ, ejaakɛ Yesaia saa kɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ,

english_verse: Isaiah said this, because he saw the glory of Jesus and spoke about him.
translation_verse: Nii nɛɛ Yesaia kɛɛ, ejaakɛ ena enunyam lɛ, ni ewie ehe.

english_verse: Even then, many of the leaders put their faith in Jesus, but they did not tell anyone about it. The Pharisees had already given orders for the people not to have anything to do with anyone who had faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ onukpai lɛ tete ateŋ mɛi pii he enɔ ye; shi Farisifoi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ amɛjajeee faŋŋ, koni akashwie amɛ kɛjɛ kpeehe lɛ;

english_verse: In a loud voice Jesus said: Everyone who has faith in me also has faith in the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Shi Yesu bo ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ni heɔ minɔ yeɔ lɛ, jeee mi minɔ eheɔ eyeɔ lɛ, shi moŋ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ;

english_verse: And everyone who has seen me has seen the one who sent me.
translation_verse: ni mɔ ni naa mi lɛ naa mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ.

english_verse: I am the light that has come into the world. No one who has faith in me will stay in the dark.
translation_verse: Mi lɛ miba je lɛ mli akɛ la, koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ minɔ eyeɔ lɛ akahi duŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: I am not the one who will judge those who refuse to obey my teachings. I came to save the people of this world, not to be their judge.
translation_verse: Ni kɛji mɔ ko nu miwiemɔi lɛ ni eyeee nɔ lɛ, mikojooo lɛ; ejaakɛ mibaaa koni mibakojo je lɛ, shi moŋ miba koni mibahere je lɛ yiwala.

english_verse: But everyone who rejects me and my teachings will be judged on the last day by what I have said.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kwaa mi ni emɔɔɔ miwiemɔi lɛ amli lɛ, eyɛ mɔ ko ni kojoɔ lɛ. Wiemɔ ni miwie lɛ, no nɔŋŋ aaakojo lɛ yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: I don't speak on my own. I say only what the Father who sent me has told me to say.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mi lɛ mitooo mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ miwieee; shi Tsɛ ni tsu mi lɛ, lɛ moŋ ewo mi kitã, nɔ ni mikɛɛ kɛ nɔ ni miwie.

english_verse: I know that his commands will bring eternal life. This is why I tell you exactly what the Father has told me.
translation_verse: Ni mile akɛ ekitã lɛ naanɔ wala ni; no hewɔ lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni miwieɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ ekɛɛ mi lɛ, nakai miwieɔ.”

english_verse: It was before Passover, and Jesus knew that the time had come for him to leave this world and to return to the Father. He had always loved his followers in this world, and he loved them to the very end.
translation_verse: Dani Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ aaashɛ lɛ, akɛni Yesu le akɛ eŋmɛlɛtswaa ni ekɛbaaje je nɛɛ mli kɛya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ eshɛ hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi ni yɔɔ je lɛ mli lɛ, nakai esumɔ amɛ kɛyashi naagbee.

english_verse: Even before the evening meal started, the devil had made Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, decide to betray Jesus.
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, belɛ abonsam kɛwo Yuda Iskariot, Simon bi lɛ, tsui mli momo, akɛ etsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ —

english_verse: Jesus knew he had come from God and would go back to God. He also knew that the Father had given him complete power.
translation_verse: akɛni Yesu le akɛ Tsɛ lɛ etu nii fɛɛ ewo edɛŋ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ejɛ, ni esaa eeya Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ,

translation_verse: No sɛɛ lɛ, efɔse nu ewo okpolu mli, ni ebɔ̃i ekaselɔi lɛ anaji ahe fɔmɔ, ni ekɛ papaŋ ni ŋmɔ ehɛ lɛ tsumɔ.

english_verse: But when he came to Simon Peter, this disciple asked, “Lord, are you going to wash my feet?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni ebashɛ Simon Petro nɔ, ni Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, bo ofɔɔ minaji ahe nɛɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You don't really know what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
translation_verse: Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nɔ ni mifeɔ nɛɛ, amrɔmrɔ nɛɛ oleee, shi kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ, obaale.”

english_verse: “You will never wash my feet!” Peter replied. “If I don't wash you,” Jesus told him, “you don't really belong to me.”
translation_verse: Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaafɔ minaji ahe kɔkɔɔkɔ.” Yesu here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Kɛji mifɔɔɔ onaji ahe lɛ, obɛ gbɛfaŋ nɔ ko yɛ miŋɔɔ.”

english_verse: Peter said, “Lord, don't wash just my feet. Wash my hands and my head.”
translation_verse: Simon Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, jeee minaji ahe kɛkɛ mɔ, shi moŋ miniji kɛ miyitso hu.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “People who have bathed and are clean all over need to wash just their feet. And you, my disciples, are clean, except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ni aju ehe lɛ, ehiaaa lɛ hefɔflɔmɔ, akɛ ja enaji ahe fɔmɔ kɛkɛ, shi ehe eje kɛmɔ shi; ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛhe eje moŋ shi jeee nyɛ fɛɛ ni.”

english_verse: Jesus knew who would betray him. That is why he said, “except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ele mɔ ni baatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ; no hewɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Jeee nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhe eje lɛ.”

english_verse: After Jesus had washed his disciples' feet and had put his outer garment back on, he sat down again. Then he said: Do you understand what I have done?
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ, be ni efɔ amɛnaji ahe ni ekɔlɔ etadei lɛ ni ewo ni eho eta shi ekoŋŋ lɛ, ebi amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛnu nɔ ni mifee nyɛ nɛɛ shishi lo?

english_verse: You call me your teacher and Lord, and you should, because that is who I am.
translation_verse: Nyɛ lɛ nyɛtsɛɔ mi Tsɔɔlɔ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ; ni eja, ejaakɛ nakai ji mi.

english_verse: I have set the example, and you should do for each other exactly what I have done for you.
translation_verse: Shi okadi mito mihã nyɛ, koni bɔ ni mifee nyɛ nɛɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfee nakai.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that servants are not greater than their master, and messengers are not greater than the one who sent them.
translation_verse: Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɔŋ efeee enuŋtsɔ, ni asaŋ bɔfo efeee mɔ ni tsu lɛ lɛ.

english_verse: I am not talking about all of you. I know the ones I have chosen. But what the Scriptures say must come true. And they say, “The man who ate with me has turned against me!”
translation_verse: “Jeee nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhe miwieɔ; mi lɛ mile mɛi ni mihala; shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni nɔ ni aŋma lɛ aba mli akɛ, ‘Mɔ ni yeɔ midɛŋ aboloo lɛ, ewo enanetsitsi eshi mi.’

english_verse: I am telling you this before it all happens. Then when it does happen, you will believe who I am.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ enɛ mato dani aba mli, koni kɛ eba mli lɛ, nyɛhe nyɛye akɛ mi ni.

english_verse: So the disciple leaned toward Jesus and asked, “Lord, which one of us are you talking about?”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nakai kaselɔ lɛ ho kpasa Yesu tsitsi ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, namɔ ni?”

english_verse: After Jesus had said these things, he was deeply troubled and told his disciples, “I tell you for certain that one of you will betray me.”
translation_verse: Be ni Yesu kɛɛ nii nɛɛ lɛ, ehao yɛ mumɔ mli, ni egba mli kpoo ekɛɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɛteŋ mɔ kome baatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple was sitting next to him at the meal,
translation_verse: Shi kaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni Yesu sumɔɔ lɛ ta emasɛi kpaakpa yɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ he.

english_verse: and Simon motioned for this disciple to find out which one Jesus meant.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Simon Petro bɛ lɛ hiŋmɛi akɛ ebi lɛ mɔ he ni ewieɔ lɛ.

english_verse: But because Judas was in charge of the money, some of them thought that Jesus had told him to buy something they needed for the festival. Others thought that Jesus had told him to give some money to the poor.
translation_verse: Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi susu akɛ ni Yuda toɔ fotro lɛ, no hewɔ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ eyahe nii ni he hiaa amɛ eto gbijurɔ lɛ, aloo akɛ ekɛ nɔ ko ahã ohiafoi lɛ.

english_verse: Judas took the piece of bread and went out. It was already night. The New Command
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ, be ni ehe atrɔma lɛ, amrɔ lɛ eje kpo. Shi je ena. Kitã hee lɛ

english_verse: Then, after God is given glory because of him, God will bring glory to him, and God will do it very soon.
translation_verse: Kɛji atsɔ̃ enɔ awo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hu aaawo ehiɛ nyam yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli, ni eeewo ehiɛ nyam oya.

english_verse: My children, I will be with you for only a little while longer. Then you will look for me, but you won't find me. I tell you just as I told the people, “You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Bii bibii, be fioo kɛkɛ eshwɛ ni mikɛ nyɛ baahi shi; nyɛaatao mi, ni bɔ ni mikɛɛ Yudafoi lɛ akɛ, ‘He ni miyaa lɛ, nyɛ lɛ nyɛnyɛŋ jɛi nyɛba’ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mikɛɔ nyɛ hu agbɛnɛ nɛɛ.

english_verse: Simon Peter asked, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “You can't go with me now, but later on you will.”
translation_verse: Simon Petro bi lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, nɛgbɛ oyaa?” Yesu here lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “He ni miyaa lɛ, onyɛŋ misɛɛ onyiɛ amrɔ nɛɛ, shi ooonyiɛ misɛɛ wɔsɛɛ ko.”

english_verse: Peter asked, “Lord, why can't I go with you now? I would die for you!”
translation_verse: Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, mɛɛ hewɔ minyɛŋ osɛɛ manyiɛ amrɔ nɛɛ? Miwala tete mikɛaaŋmɛ shi yɛ ohewɔ.”

english_verse: “Would you really die for me?” Jesus asked. “I tell you for certain before a rooster crows, you will say three times that you don't even know me.”
translation_verse: Yesu here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Okɛ owala aaaŋmɛ shi yɛ mihewɔ? Anɔkwale mikɛɔ bo akɛ, wuɔ naŋ agbɛɛ ni oookwa mi shii etɛ̃.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “Don't be worried! Have faith in God and have faith in me.
translation_verse: “Nyɛkayea nyɛtsui; nyɛhea Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ nyɛyea, ni mi hu nyɛhea minɔ nyɛyea.

english_verse: There are many rooms in my Father's house. I wouldn't tell you this, unless it was true. I am going there to prepare a place for each of you.
translation_verse: Shihilɛhei pii yɛ miTsɛ we lɛ; jeee nakai ni kulɛ makɛɛ nyɛ akɛ miiya ni mayasaa gbɛhe mato nyɛ lo?

english_verse: After I have done this, I will come back and take you with me. Then we will be together.
translation_verse: Ni kɛji mitee ni miyasaa gbɛhe mito nyɛ lɛ, mibaba ekoŋŋ ni mibaŋɔ nyɛ kɛya he ni mi diɛŋtsɛ miyɔɔ lɛ, koni he ni miyɔɔ lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛhi jɛi.

english_verse: You know the way to where I am going.”
translation_verse: Ni he ni miyaa lɛ, nyɛle, ni gbɛ lɛ hu, nyɛle.”

english_verse: Thomas said, “Lord, we don't even know where you are going! How can we know the way?”
translation_verse: Toma kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, wɔleee he ni oyaa, ni te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni wɔɔnyɛ gbɛ lɛ wɔle hu?”

english_verse: “I am the way, the truth, and the life!” Jesus answered. “Without me, no one can go to the Father.
translation_verse: Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mi ji gbɛ lɛ kɛ anɔkwale lɛ kɛ wala lɛ; mɔ ko baaa Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, akɛ ja etsɔ̃ minɔ.

english_verse: If you had really known me, you would have known the Father. But from now on, you do know him, and you have seen him.”
translation_verse: Eji nyɛle mi kulɛ, nyɛaale miTsɛ hu; ni kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ nyɛle lɛ, ni nyɛna lɛ.”

english_verse: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father. That is all we need.”
translation_verse: Filipo kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ Tsɛ lɛ, ni no fa hã wɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Philip, I have been with you for a long time. Don't you know who I am? If you have seen me, you have seen the Father. How can you ask me to show you the Father?
translation_verse: Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ nɛɛ, oleko mi lolo, Filipo? Mɔ ni ena mi lɛ, ena Tsɛ lɛ, ni te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni okɛɔ akɛ ‘Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ Tsɛ lɛ?’

english_verse: Don't you believe that I am one with the Father and that the Father is one with me? What I say isn't said on my own. The Father who lives in me does these things.
translation_verse: Ani oheee oyeee akɛ miyɛ Tsɛ lɛ mli ni Tsɛ lɛ hu yɛ mimli? Wiemɔi ni mikɛ nyɛ wieɔ lɛ, jeee mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ mitoɔ miwieɔ; shi Tsɛ lɛ ni hiɔ mimli lɛ, lɛ etsuɔ enitsumɔi lɛ.

english_verse: Have faith in me when I say that the Father is one with me and that I am one with the Father. Or else have faith in me simply because of the things I do.
translation_verse: Nyɛhea mi nyɛyea akɛ miyɛ Tsɛ lɛ mli ni Tsɛ lɛ hu yɛ mimli; shi kɛji nyɛheee mi nyɛyeee lɛ, nyɛhea mi nyɛyea yɛ minitsumɔi lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you have faith in me, you will do the same things I am doing. You will do even greater things, now that I am going back to the Father.
translation_verse: Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ ni heɔ minɔ eyeɔ lɛ, nitsumɔi ni mitsuɔ lɛ, lɛ hu eeetsu, ni eeetsu nii ni fe nomɛi tete, ejaakɛ miiya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Ask me, and I will do whatever you ask. This way the Son will bring honor to the Father.
translation_verse: Ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛɛakpa he fai yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, mafee, koni Tsɛ lɛ hiɛ aba nyam kɛtsɔ̃ Bi lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: I will do whatever you ask me to do. The Holy Spirit Is Promised
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛkpa nɔ ko he fai yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, mafee.” Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he shiwoo

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: If you love me, you will do as I command.
translation_verse: “Kɛji nyɛmiisumɔ mi lɛ nyɛaaye mikitãi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Then I will ask the Father to send you the Holy Spirit who will help you and always be with you.
translation_verse: Ni mi lɛ mabi Tsɛ lɛ ni eeehã nyɛ Hefatalɔ kroko, koni ekɛ nyɛ ahi shi kɛya naanɔ;

english_verse: The Spirit will show you what is true. The people of this world cannot accept the Spirit, because they don't see or know him. But you know the Spirit, who is with you and will keep on living in you.
translation_verse: Hefatalɔ ni ji anɔkwale Mumɔ lɛ ni je lɛ nyɛɛɛ lɛ aŋɔ, ejaakɛ enaaa lɛ ni asaŋ eleee lɛ lɛ; shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛle lɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛ nyɛ yɔɔ, ni eyɛ nyɛmli.

english_verse: In a little while the people of this world won't be able to see me, but you will see me. And because I live, you will live.
translation_verse: Eshwɛ fioo kɛkɛ ni je lɛ enaŋ mi dɔŋŋ; shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛaana mi; ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã, ni nyɛ hu nyɛhiɛ aaakã.

english_verse: Then you will know I am one with the Father. You will know you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛaale akɛ miyɛ miTsɛ mli, ni nyɛ hu nyɛyɛ mimli, ni mi hu miyɛ nyɛmli.

english_verse: If you love me, you will do what I have said, and my Father will love you. I will also love you and show you what I am like.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni ŋɔɔ mikitãi lɛ ni eyeɔ nɔ lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni sumɔɔ mi; ni mɔ ni sumɔɔ mi lɛ, miTsɛ aaasumɔ lɛ, ni mi hu masumɔ lɛ, ni majie mihe shi matsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: The other Judas, not Judas Iscariot, then spoke up and asked, “Lord, what do you mean by saying that you will show us what you are like, but you will not show the people of this world?”
translation_verse: Yuda, jeee Iskariot, bi lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, mɛni eba hewɔ ni wɔ pɛ obaajie ohe shi otsɔ̃ɔ, ni jeee je lɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: If anyone loves me, they will obey me. Then my Father will love them, and we will come to them and live in them.
translation_verse: Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ mi lɛ, eeeye miwiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni miTsɛ aaasumɔ lɛ, ni wɔɔba eŋɔɔ, ni wɔkɛ lɛ aaahi shi.

english_verse: But anyone who doesn't love me, won't obey me. What they have heard me say doesn't really come from me, but from the Father who sent me.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni sumɔɔɔ mi lɛ, eyeee miwiemɔi lɛ anɔ; ni wiemɔ ni nyɛnuɔ lɛ jeee minɔŋ, shi moŋ Tsɛ ni tsu mi lɛ nɔŋ.

english_verse: I have told you these things while I am still with you.
translation_verse: “Miikɛɛ nyɛ nii nɛɛ be mli ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ nɛɛ.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come and help you, because the Father will send the Spirit to take my place. The Spirit will teach you everything and will remind you of what I said while I was with you.
translation_verse: Shi Hefatalɔ lɛ ni ji Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, mɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ baatsu yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, lɛ eeetsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nii fɛɛ, ni eeekai nyɛ nii fɛɛ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ.

english_verse: I give you peace, the kind of peace only I can give. It isn't like the peace this world can give. So don't be worried or afraid.
translation_verse: “Hejɔlɛ mishiɔ mahã nyɛ, hejɔlɛ ni ji minɔ lɛ mikɛhãa nyɛ, jeee bɔ ni je lɛ hãa lɛ mihãa nyɛ nɛɛ. Nyɛtsui akayea, ni asaŋ nyɛkashea gbeyei.

english_verse: You have already heard me say I am going and I will also come back to you. If you really love me, you should be glad I am going back to the Father, because he is greater than I am.
translation_verse: Nyɛnu akɛ mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Miiya, ni mibaba nyɛŋɔɔ. Nyɛmiisumɔ mi kulɛ, nyɛaana miishɛɛ akɛ miiya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ miTsɛ da fe mi.

english_verse: I am telling you this before I leave, so when it does happen, you will have faith in me.
translation_verse: Ni agbɛnɛ mikɛɛ nyɛ dani eba mli, koni kɛ eba mli lɛ, ni nyɛhe nyɛye.

english_verse: I cannot speak with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. But he has no power over me.
translation_verse: Mikɛ nyɛ ewieŋ nibii pii dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ je lɛ mli lumɔ lɛ miiba, ni ebɛ hewalɛ ko yɛ minɔ;

english_verse: I obey my Father, so everyone in the world might know that I love him. It is time for us to go now.
translation_verse: shi bɔ ni afee ni je lɛ ana ale akɛ miisumɔ Tsɛ lɛ, ni bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ wo mi kitã lɛ nakai mifeɔ lɛ. Nyɛtea shi, nyɛhãa wɔjea biɛ wɔyaa.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
translation_verse: “Mi ji anɔkwa waintso lɛ, ni miTsɛ ji okwaafonyo lɛ.

english_verse: He cuts away every branch of mine that doesn't produce fruit. But he trims clean every branch that does produce fruit, so that it will produce even more fruit.
translation_verse: Mihe nine fɛɛ nine ni wooo yibii lɛ, efolɔɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko ni woɔ yibii lɛ, ekpɔlɔɔ he, bɔ ni afee ni ewo yibii pii fe tsutsu lɛ.

english_verse: You are already clean because of what I have said to you.
translation_verse: Nyɛhe etse momo yɛ wiemɔ ni mikɛ nyɛ ewie lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Stay joined to me, and I will stay joined to you. Just as a branch cannot produce fruit unless it stays joined to the vine, you cannot produce fruit unless you stay joined to me.
translation_verse: Nyɛhia mimli, ni mi hu mahi nyɛmli. Tamɔ bɔ ni tso nine nyɛŋ awo yibii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ akɛ ja ema waintso lɛ he lɛ, nakai nyɛ hu nyɛnyɛŋ akɛ ja nyɛhi mimli.

english_verse: I am the vine, and you are the branches. If you stay joined to me, and I stay joined to you, then you will produce lots of fruit. But you cannot do anything without me.
translation_verse: “Mi ji waintso lɛ, nyɛ ji niji lɛ. Mɔ ni hiɔ mimli ni mi hu mihiɔ emli lɛ, lɛ ewoɔ yibii pii; ejaakɛ kɛjeee miŋ lɛ nyɛnyɛŋ nɔ ko nyɛfee.

english_verse: If you don't stay joined to me, you will be thrown away. You will be like dry branches that are gathered up and burned in a fire.
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ko ehiii mimli lɛ, ashɛɔ lɛ afɔ̃ɔ tamɔ tso nine, ni egbiɔ, ni abuaa naa awoɔ la mli, ni ashãa.

english_verse: Stay joined to me and let my teachings become part of you. Then you can pray for whatever you want, and your prayer will be answered.
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛhi mimli ni miwiemɔi lɛ hi nyɛmli lɛ, nyɛaakpa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ he fai, ni aaafee ahã nyɛ.

english_verse: When you become fruitful disciples of mine, my Father will be honored.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni akɛwoɔ miTsɛ hiɛ nyam ji akɛ nyɛwo yibii pii, ni nyɛfee mikaselɔi.

english_verse: I have loved you, just as my Father has loved me. So remain faithful to my love for you.
translation_verse: “Bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ sumɔ mi lɛ, nakai mi hu misumɔ nyɛ; nyɛhia misuɔmɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: If you obey me, I will keep loving you, just as my Father keeps loving me, because I have obeyed him.
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛye mikitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ, nyɛaahi misuɔmɔ lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni miye miTsɛ kitãi lɛ anɔ ni mihiɔ esuɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: I have told you this to make you as completely happy as I am.
translation_verse: “Mikɛ nyɛ ewie enɛɛmɛi, koni mimiishɛɛ lɛ ahi nyɛmli, ni nyɛmiishɛɛ lɛ aye emuu.

english_verse: Now I tell you to love each other, as I have loved you.
translation_verse: Mikitã ji akɛ nyɛsumɔsumɔa nyɛhe tamɔ bɔ ni misumɔ nyɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The greatest way to show love for friends is to die for them.
translation_verse: Mɔ ko bɛ suɔmɔ ni da fe enɛ, akɛ mɔ kɛ ewala aaaŋmɛ shi ahã eshieŋtsɛmɛi.

english_verse: And you are my friends, if you obey me.
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛfee nii ni miwoɔ nyɛ he kitã lɛ, no lɛ mishieŋtsɛmɛi ji nyɛ.

english_verse: Servants don't know what their master is doing, and so I don't speak to you as my servants. I speak to you as my friends, and I have told you everything my Father has told me.
translation_verse: Mitsɛɛɛ nyɛ tsuji dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ tsulɔ leee nɔ ni enuŋtsɔ feɔ, shi moŋ shieŋtsɛmɛi matsɛ nyɛ, ejaakɛ nii fɛɛ ni minu yɛ miTsɛ naa lɛ, mitsi tã mikɛɛ nyɛ.

english_verse: You did not choose me. I chose you and sent you out to produce fruit, the kind of fruit that will last. Then my Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: Jeee nyɛ nyɛhala mi, shi mi moŋ mihala nyɛ, ni mito nyɛ koni nyɛ hu nyɛya ni nyɛyawo yibii, ni nyɛyibii lɛ ahi shi, koni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ he fai ni nyɛaakpa Tsɛ lɛ yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, ehã nyɛ.

english_verse: So I command you to love each other. The World's Hatred
translation_verse: Enɛ ji kitã ni miwoɔ nyɛ, akɛ nyɛsumɔsumɔa nyɛhe.” Je lɛ baanyɛ Yesu sɛɛnyiɛlɔi

english_verse: If the people of this world hate you, just remember that they hated me first.
translation_verse: “Kɛji je lɛ miinyɛ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ mi tsutsu enyɛ.

english_verse: If you belonged to the world, its people would love you. But you don't belong to the world. I have chosen you to leave the world behind, and this is why its people hate you.
translation_verse: Eji je lɛ mli nyɛjɛ kulɛ, je lɛ aaasumɔ nyɛ akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi, shi akɛni nyɛjɛɛɛ je lɛ mli, shi moŋ mihala nyɛ kɛjɛ je lɛ mli hewɔ lɛ, je lɛ nyɛɔ nyɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Remember how I told you that servants are not greater than their master. So if people mistreat me, they will mistreat you. If they do what I say, they will do what you say.
translation_verse: Nyɛhiɛ ahia wiemɔ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ nɔ, akɛ, ‘Nyɔŋ efeee eNuŋtsɔ.’ Kɛ amɛwa mi yi lɛ, amɛaawa nyɛ hu yi; kɛ amɛye miwiemɔ nɔ lɛ, amɛaaye nyɛ hu nyɛnɔ nɔ.

english_verse: People will do to you exactly what they did to me. They will do it because you belong to me, and they don't know the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Shi amɛkɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ aaafee nyɛ yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ amɛleee mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ.

english_verse: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
translation_verse: Mibaaa mikɛ amɛ ebawieee jikulɛ, esha ko bɛ amɛhe; shi agbɛnɛ lɛ amɛbɛ amɛhe esha lɛ he naajiemɔ ko.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me also hates my Father.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ eenyɛ miTsɛ hu.

english_verse: I have done things no one else has ever done. If they had not seen me do these things, they would not be guilty. But they did see me do these things, and they still hate me and my Father too.
translation_verse: Eji mitsuuu nitsumɔi ni mɔ ko mɔ ko tsuko eko dã yɛ amɛteŋ kulɛ, esha ko bɛ amɛhe; shi agbɛnɛ lɛ amɛna, ni kɛ̃lɛ amɛmiinyɛ mi kɛ miTsɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: This is why the Scriptures are true when they say, “People hated me for no reason.”
translation_verse: Shi afee enɛ bɔ ni afee ni wiemɔ ni aŋma yɛ amɛMla lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Amɛnyɛ mi yakatswaa’ lɛ ana aba mli.

english_verse: I will send you the Spirit who comes from the Father and shows what is true. The Spirit will help you and will tell you about me.
translation_verse: “Shi Hefatalɔ lɛ ni mibatsu nyɛŋɔɔ kɛaajɛ Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, mɔ ni ji anɔkwale Mumɔ lɛ ni jɛɔ Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ baa lɛ, kɛ eba lɛ, eeeye mihe odase;

english_verse: Then you will also tell others about me, because you have been with me from the beginning.
translation_verse: ni nyɛ hu nyɛaaye odase, ejaakɛ nyɛkɛ mi yɔɔ kɛjɛ shishijee.”

english_verse: I am telling you these things, so that you will not turn away.
translation_verse: “Mikɛɛ nyɛ nii nɛɛ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛnane akatɔ̃tɔ̃.

english_verse: You will be chased out of the synagogues. And the time will come when people will kill you and think they are doing God a favor.
translation_verse: Amɛaashwie nyɛ kɛaajɛ kpeehei lɛ. Ni be baaba tete, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni gbeɔ nyɛ lɛ aaasusu akɛ ekɛmiija Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: They will do these things because they don't know either the Father or me.
translation_verse: Ni amɛaafee enɛɛmɛi, ejaakɛ amɛleee Tsɛ lɛ ni amɛleee mi hu.

english_verse: I am saying this to you now, so that when the time comes, you will remember what I have said. The Work of the Holy Spirit I was with you at the first, and so I didn't tell you these things.
translation_verse: Shi mikɛɛ nyɛ nii nɛɛ, koni kɛ be lɛ shɛ lɛ, ni nyɛkai akɛ mikɛɛ nyɛ. Shi kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ mikɛɛɛ nyɛ nii nɛɛ, ejaakɛ mikɛ nyɛ yɛ.” Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nitsumɔ

english_verse: But now I am going back to the Father who sent me, and none of you asks me where I am going.
translation_verse: “Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ, miiya mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko biii mi akɛ, ‘Nɛgbɛ oyaa?’

english_verse: You are very sad from hearing all of this.
translation_verse: Shi ni mitsi nii nɛɛ atã mikɛɛ nyɛ hewɔ lɛ; ŋkɔmɔyeli eyi nyɛtsuiiaŋ obɔ̃.

english_verse: But I tell you I am going to do what is best for you. This is why I am going away. The Holy Spirit cannot come to help you until I leave. But after I am gone, I will send the Spirit to you.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale, ehi hã nyɛ akɛ matee; ejaakɛ kɛji miyaaa lɛ, Hefatalɔ lɛ baŋ nyɛŋɔɔ; shi kɛji mitee lɛ, matsu lɛ kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ.

english_verse: The Spirit will come and show the people of this world the truth about sin and God's justice and the judgment.
translation_verse: Ni lɛ lɛ, kɛji eba lɛ, eeekã je lɛ yɛ esha kɛ jalɛ kɛ kojomɔ he.

english_verse: The Spirit will show them that they are wrong about sin, because they didn't have faith in me.
translation_verse: Eeekã je lɛ yɛ esha he, ejaakɛ amɛheee minɔ amɛyeee;

english_verse: They are wrong about God's justice, because I am going to the Father, and you won't see me again.
translation_verse: eeekã je lɛ yɛ jalɛ he, ejaakɛ miiya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni nyɛnaŋ mi dɔŋŋ;

english_verse: And they are wrong about the judgment, because God has already judged the ruler of this world.
translation_verse: eeekã je lɛ yɛ kojomɔ he, ejaakɛ akojo je nɛɛŋ lumɔ lɛ momo.

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but right now it would be more than you could understand.
translation_verse: “Miyɛ nibii pii lolo ni makɛɛ nyɛ, shi nyɛnyɛŋ mli nyɛmɔ amrɔ nɛɛ.

english_verse: The Spirit shows what is true and will come and guide you into the full truth. The Spirit doesn't speak on his own. He will tell you only what he has heard from me, and he will let you know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji lɛ, anɔkwale Mumɔ lɛ, ena eba lɛ, eeetsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ anɔkwale lɛ fɛɛ mli gbɛ; ejaakɛ etoŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiŋ ewieŋ; shi moŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eeenu lɛ, no eeewie, ni nii ni baa lɛ, eeetsi tã etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: The Spirit will bring glory to me by taking my message and telling it to you.
translation_verse: Lɛ ebaawo mihiɛ nyam, ejaakɛ eeeŋɔ minɔ lɛ eko ni eeetsi tã etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: Everything the Father has is mine. This is why I have said that the Spirit takes my message and tells it to you. Sorrow Will Turn into Joy
translation_verse: Nii fiaa ni Tsɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, minɔŋ; no hewɔ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, ebaaŋɔ minɔ lɛ eko, ni etsi tã etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ.” Haomɔ sɛɛ lɛ, miishɛɛ

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “For a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.”
translation_verse: “Eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛnaŋ mi, ni asaŋ eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛbaana mi, ejaakɛ miiya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.”

english_verse: They said to each other, “What does Jesus mean by saying that for a little while we won't see him, but after a while we will see him? What does he mean by saying he is going to the Father?
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi bibii amɛhe akɛ, “Mɛni ji nɔ ni ekɛɔ wɔ nɛɛ, ‘Eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛnaŋ mi, ni asaŋ eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛbaana mi kɛ ejaakɛ miiya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ?’ ”

english_verse: What is this ‘little while’ that he is talking about? We don't know what he means.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛni ji ‘eshwɛ fioo’ lɛ ni ekɛɔ lɛ? Wɔleee nɔ ni ekɛɔ nɛɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus knew they had some questions, so he said: You are wondering what I meant when I said that for a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.
translation_verse: Yesu na akɛ amɛmiitao akɛ amɛbiɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ni mikɛɛ akɛ eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛnaŋ mi, ni asaŋ eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛbaana mi lɛ, no he nii nyɛbibiɔ nyɛhe nɛɛ?

english_verse: I tell you for certain that you will cry and be sad, but the world will be happy. You will be sad, but later you will be happy.
translation_verse: Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛ lɛ nyɛbaafo ni nyɛbaawo yara, shi je lɛ baanya; nyɛ lɛ nyɛbaaye ŋkɔmɔ, shi nyɛkɔmɔyeli lɛ aaatsɔ̃ miishɛɛ.

english_verse: When a woman is about to give birth, she is in great pain. But after it is all over, she forgets the pain and is happy, because she has brought a child into the world.
translation_verse: Kɛji yoo miikɔmɔ lɛ, ehaoɔ, ejaakɛ eŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ; shi kɛ efɔ bi lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ekaiii hejaramɔ lɛ dɔŋŋ yɛ miishɛɛ ni enaa akɛ efɔ gbɔmɔ kɛba je lɛ mli lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: You are now very sad. But later I will see you, and you will be so happy that no one will be able to change the way you feel.
translation_verse: Nakai ji nyɛ hu; amrɔ nɛɛ nyɛmiiye ŋkɔmɔ; shi mibana nyɛ ekoŋŋ, ni nyɛtsui aaanyɔ nyɛmli ni nyɛmiishɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko shɔŋ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't have to ask me about anything. I tell you for certain the Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: “Ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛbiŋ mi nɔ ko nɔ ko. Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ he fai ni nyɛaakpa Tsɛ lɛ yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, eeehã nyɛ.

english_verse: You have not asked for anything in this way before, but now you must ask in my name. Then it will be given to you, so you will be completely happy.
translation_verse: Kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ nyɛbiko nɔ ko yɛ migbɛi mli; nyɛbia, ni nyɛaana, koni nyɛmiishɛɛ lɛ aye emuu.” Miye je lɛ nɔ kunim

english_verse: I have used examples to explain to you what I have been talking about. But the time will come when I will speak to you plainly about the Father and will no longer use examples like these.
translation_verse: “Nii nɛɛ, abɛbuai amli mikɛ nyɛ wieɔ yɛ nɛɛ. Be miiba, ni mikɛ nyɛ ewieŋ yɛ abɛbuai amli dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ faŋŋ majaje Tsɛ lɛ he sane matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: You will ask the Father in my name, and I won't have to ask him for you.
translation_verse: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛaabi nɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ yɛ migbɛi mli, shi mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mi mabi Tsɛ lɛ mahã nyɛ;

english_verse: God the Father loves you because you love me, and you believe I have come from him.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Tsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ miisumɔ nyɛ, akɛni nyɛsumɔ mi, ni nyɛhe nyɛye akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ mijɛ lɛ.

english_verse: I came from the Father into the world, but I am leaving the world and returning to the Father.
translation_verse: Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ mijɛ miba je lɛ mli, ni miije je lɛ mli maya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ.”

english_verse: The disciples said, “Now you are speaking plainly to us! You are not using examples.
translation_verse: Ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, agbɛnɛ oowie faŋŋ ni owieee yɛ abɛbua mli.

english_verse: At last we know that you understand everything, and we don't have any more questions. Now we believe you truly have come from God.”
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ wɔna akɛ ole nii fɛɛ ni ehiaaa bo akɛ mɔ ko biɔ bo sane ko; enɛ wɔkɛheɔ wɔyeɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ojɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Do you really believe me?

translation_verse: Naa; ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ miiba ni eshɛ po, ni nyɛbaagbɛ nyɛshwã ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaaya emaŋ, ni nyɛaashi mi kome; shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee mi kome ni, ejaakɛ Tsɛ lɛ kɛ mi yɛ.

english_verse: I have told you this, so that you might have peace in your hearts because of me. While you are in the world, you will have to suffer. But cheer up! I have defeated the world.
translation_verse: Mikɛɛ nyɛ nii nɛɛ, koni nyɛna hejɔlɛ yɛ mimli. Je lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛbaana amanehulu, shi nyɛtsui anyɔa nyɛmli, miye je lɛ nɔ kunim.”

english_verse: After Jesus had finished speaking to his disciples, he looked up toward heaven and prayed: Father, the time has come for you to bring glory to your Son, in order that he may bring glory to you.
translation_verse: Be ni Yesu wie nii nɛɛ lɛ, ewo ehiɛ nɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi, ni ekɛɛ, “Ataa, ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ; wo oBi lɛ hiɛ nyam, koni oBi lɛ hu awo ohiɛ nyam;

english_verse: Eternal life is to know you, the only true God, and to know Jesus Christ, the one you sent.
translation_verse: Shi enɛ ji naanɔ wala lɛ, akɛ amɛle bo, anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ kome lɛ, kɛ Yesu Kristo, mɔ ni otsu lɛ.

english_verse: I have brought glory to you here on earth by doing everything you gave me to do.
translation_verse: Miwo ohiɛ nyam yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, akɛni nitsumɔ lɛ ni okɛhã mi tsumɔ lɛ, migbe naa lɛ.

english_verse: Now, Father, give me back the glory I had with you before the world was created.
translation_verse: Ni agbɛnɛ, Ataa, kɛ anunyam ni miyɔɔ yɛ oŋɔɔ dani abɔ je lɛ awo mihiɛ nyam yɛ omasɛi.” Yesu sɔle hã ekaselɔi lɛ

english_verse: You have given me some followers from this world, and I have shown them what you are like. They were yours, but you gave them to me, and they have obeyed you.
translation_verse: “Mijie ogbɛi lɛ shi mitsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɛi ni okɛhã mi kɛjɛ je lɛŋ lɛ. Onii ji amɛ, ni okɛ amɛ hã mi, ni amɛye owiemɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: They know that you gave me everything I have.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ amɛle akɛ nii fiaa ni okɛhã mi lɛ, oŋɔɔ ejɛ;

english_verse: I told my followers what you told me, and they accepted it. They know I came from you, and they believe you are the one who sent me.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ wiemɔi lɛ ni okɛhã mi lɛ, mikɛhã amɛ; ni amɛmɔ mli, ni amɛna amɛle anɔkwale mli akɛ oŋɔɔ mijɛ, ni amɛhe amɛye akɛ bo otsu mi.

english_verse: I am praying for them, but not for those who belong to this world. My followers belong to you, and I am praying for them.
translation_verse: Amɛ mibiɔ mahã; jeee je lɛ mibiɔ mahã, shi moŋ mɛi ni okɛhã mi lɛ, ejaakɛ onii ji amɛ.

english_verse: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine, and they will bring glory to me.
translation_verse: Minii fɛɛ lɛ onɔŋ, ni onii fɛɛ lɛ minɔŋ, ni mihiɛ eba nyam yɛ amɛmli.

english_verse: Holy Father, I am no longer in the world. I am coming to you, but my followers are still in the world. So keep them safe by the power of the name you have given me. Then they will be one with each other, just as you and I are one.
translation_verse: Mibɛ je lɛ mli dɔŋŋ, shi mɛnɛɛmɛi yɛ je lɛ mli, ni mi lɛ miiba oŋɔɔ. Ataa Krɔŋkrɔŋ, mɛi ni okɛhã mi lɛ, too amɛ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ mli, bɔ ni afee ni amɛfee ekome tamɔ wɔ.

english_verse: While I was with them, I kept them safe by the power you have given me. I guarded them, and not one of them was lost, except the one who had to be lost. This happened so that what the Scriptures say would come true.
translation_verse: Be ni mikɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ, mito amɛ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ mli. Mɛi ni okɛhã mi lɛ, mibu amɛhe, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko elaajeko, ja laajemɔ bi lɛ, koni nɔ ni aŋma lɛ aba mli.

english_verse: I am on my way to you. But I say these things while I am still in the world, so my followers will have the same complete joy that I do.
translation_verse: Ni agbɛnɛ miiba oŋɔɔ, ni miiwie nii nɛɛ yɛ je lɛ mli, koni amɛna mimiishɛɛ lɛ ni eye emuu yɛ amɛmli.

english_verse: I have told them your message. But the people of this world hate them, because they don't belong to this world, just as I don't.
translation_verse: Mikɛ owiemɔ lɛ ehã amɛ, ni je lɛ miinyɛ amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛjɛɛɛ je lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni mi hu mijɛɛɛ je lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: Father, I don't ask you to take my followers out of the world, but keep them safe from the evil one.
translation_verse: Mibiii akɛ ojie amɛ kɛjɛ je lɛ mli, shi moŋ akɛ ojie amɛ kɛjɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ ni oto amɛ shweshweeshwe.

english_verse: They don't belong to this world, and neither do I.
translation_verse: Amɛjɛɛɛ je lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni mi hu mijɛɛɛ je lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: Your word is the truth. So let this truth make them completely yours.
translation_verse: Feemɔ amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli; owiemɔ lɛ anɔkwaleŋ.

english_verse: I am sending them into the world, just as you sent me.
translation_verse: Tamɔ bɔ ni otsu mi je lɛ mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mi hu mitsu amɛ je lɛ mli.

english_verse: I have given myself completely for their sake, so they may belong completely to the truth.
translation_verse: Ni amɛhewɔ mi diɛŋtsɛ mifeɔ mihe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, koni amɛ hu afee amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ anɔkwale mli.” Yesu sɔle hã esɛɛnyiɛlɔi ni baaba

english_verse: I am not praying just for these followers. I am also praying for everyone else who will have faith because of what my followers will say about me.

english_verse: I want all of them to be one with each other, just as I am one with you and you are one with me. I also want them to be one with us. Then the people of this world will believe that you sent me.
translation_verse: bɔ ni afee ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛfee ekome, tamɔ bɔ ni bo, Ataa, oyɔɔ mimli ni mi hu miyɔɔ omli lɛ, koni amɛ hu amɛfee ekome yɛ wɔmli, ni je lɛ ahe aye akɛ bo otsu mi.

english_verse: I have honored my followers in the same way you honored me, in order that they may be one with each other, just as we are one.
translation_verse: Ni anunyam ni okɛhã mi lɛ, mikɛhã amɛ, koni amɛfee ekome tamɔ bɔ ni wɔ hu wɔyɔɔ ekome lɛ.

english_verse: I am one with them, and you are one with me, so they may become completely one. Then this world's people will know that you sent me. They will know that you love my followers as much as you love me.
