english_verse: Father, I want everyone you have given me to be with me, wherever I am. Then they will see the glory you have given me, because you loved me before the world was created.
translation_verse: Ataa, mɛi ni okɛhã mi lɛ, miisumɔ akɛ he ni miyɔɔ lɛ amɛkɛ mi abahi jɛi, koni amɛna minunyam ni okɛhã mi lɛ, ejaakɛ osumɔ mi dani ato je lɛ shishi.

english_verse: Good Father, the people of this world don't know you. But I know you, and my followers know that you sent me.
translation_verse: Ataa Jalɔ, je lɛ leee bo, shi mi lɛ mile bo, ni mɛnɛɛmɛi le akɛ bo otsu mi;

english_verse: I told them what you are like, and I will tell them even more. Then the love you have for me will become part of them, and I will be one with them.
translation_verse: ni mijie ogbɛi lɛ kpo mitsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni masaa majie lɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ, koni suɔmɔ ni okɛsumɔ mi lɛ ahi amɛmli, ni mi hu mahi amɛmli.”

translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ esaa ebi amɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Namɔ nyɛtaoɔ?” Ni amɛkɛɛ, “Yesu, Nazarenyo lɛ.”

english_verse: This time Jesus replied, “I have already told you that I am Jesus. If I am the one you are looking for, let these others go.
translation_verse: Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “Mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ miŋ no hewɔ lɛ, kɛji mi nyɛtaoɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa mɛnɛɛmɛi ayaa.”

english_verse: Then everything will happen, just as I said, ‘I did not lose anyone you gave me.’ ”
translation_verse: koni wiemɔ ni ewie akɛ, “Mɛi ni okɛhã mi lɛ, mihako amɛteŋ mɔ ko alaaje” lɛ aba mli.

english_verse: Jesus shouted, “Friends, have you caught anything?” “No!” they answered.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, “Bii, nyɛyɛ niyenii ko lo?” Amɛhere lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Dabi.”

english_verse: So he told them, “Let your net down on the right side of your boat, and you will catch some fish.” They did, and the net was so full of fish that they could not drag it up into the boat.
translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfɔ̃a yaa lɛ yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ ninejurɔ gbɛ, ni nyɛaana nɔ ko.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛfɔ̃, ni loi lɛ afalɛ hewɔ lɛ amɛanyɛɛɛ yaa lɛ amɛgbala.

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple told Peter, “It's the Lord!” When Simon heard it was the Lord, he put on the clothes he had taken off while he was working. Then he jumped into the water.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, kaselɔ ni Yesu sumɔɔ lɛ kɛɛ Petro akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni.” Be ni Simon Petro nu akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni lɛ, ekɛ etade lɛ ŋmɔ ehɛ, ejaakɛ eta shi yayai, ni etu egbee ŋshɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: When the disciples got out of the boat, they saw some bread and a charcoal fire with fish on it.
translation_verse: Shi be ni amɛkpeleke lɛ, amɛbana ŋãi kɛ la yɛ jɛi, ni loo jwere nɔ, kɛ aboloo.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “Bring some of the fish you just caught.”
translation_verse: Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ loo ni nyɛgbe bianɛ lɛ eko abaa.”

english_verse: Jesus said, “Come and eat!” But none of the disciples dared ask who he was. They knew he was the Lord.
translation_verse: Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa nyɛbakpaa nyɛnaa nɔ ko.” Ni kaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ekaaa lɛ bimɔ akɛ, “Namɔ ji bo?” Ejaakɛ amɛle akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni.

english_verse: Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave some of it to his disciples. He did the same with the fish.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Yesu ba ni ebakɔ aboloo lɛ, ni ekɛhã amɛ, kɛ loo lɛ hu.

english_verse: This was the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from death. Jesus and Peter
translation_verse: Enɛ ji shii etɛ̃ ni Yesu jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ ekaselɔi lɛ, be ni ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ. Yesu kɛ Petro

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples had finished eating, he asked, “Simon son of John, do you love me more than the others do?” Simon Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I do!” “Then feed my lambs,” Jesus said.
translation_verse: Be ni amɛye nii lɛ tã lɛ, Yesu bi Simon Petro akɛ, “Simon, Yona bi, oosumɔ mi fe mɛnɛɛmɛi lo?” Ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ, ole akɛ miisumɔ bo.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Lɛɛ mitoobii lɛ!”

english_verse: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I love you!” “Then take care of my sheep,” Jesus told him.
translation_verse: Esaa ebi lɛ nɔ ni ji shi enyɔ akɛ, “Simon, Yona bi, oosumɔ mi lo?” Ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ, ole akɛ miisumɔ bo.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kwɛmɔ mitoi lɛ!”

english_verse: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter was hurt because Jesus had asked him three times if he loved him. So he told Jesus, “Lord, you know everything. You know I love you.” Jesus replied, “Feed my sheep.
translation_verse: Ebi lɛ nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃ akɛ, “Simon, Yona bi, oosumɔ mi lo?” Edɔ Petro akɛ ebi lɛ nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃ akɛ, “Oosumɔ mi lo?” lɛ; ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ole nii fiaa, ole akɛ miisumɔ bo.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Lɛɛ mitoi lɛ!

english_verse: I tell you for certain that when you were a young man, you dressed yourself and went wherever you wanted to go. But when you are old, you will hold out your hands. Then others will wrap your belt around you and lead you where you don't want to go.”
translation_verse: Anɔkwale mikɛɔ bo akɛ, be ni oji oblanyo lɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ omĩaa ni onyiɛɔ he ni osumɔɔ; shi kɛ ogbɔ lɛ, oookpã oniji amli, ni mɔ kroko aaamĩa bo, ni ekɛ bo aaatee he ni osumɔɔɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus said this to tell how Peter would die and bring honor to God. Then he said to Peter, “Follow me!” Jesus and His Favorite Disciple
translation_verse: Shi ekɛɛ enɛ ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ nɔ gbele ni Petro baagbo kɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam. Ni be ni ekɛɛ enɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ!” Kaselɔ ni Yesu sumɔɔ lɛ

english_verse: Peter turned and saw Jesus' favorite disciple following them. He was the same one who had sat next to Jesus at the meal and had asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”
translation_verse: Shi be ni Petro tsɔ̃ ehe lɛ, ena kaselɔ ni Yesu sumɔɔ lɛ nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ; lɛ ji mɔ ni kpasa Yesu tsitsi yɛ niyenii lɛ ashi ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ namɔ baatsɔ̃ɔ osɛɛgbɛ lɛ?”

english_verse: When Peter saw this disciple, he asked Jesus, “Lord, what about him?”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Petro na lɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ Yesu akɛ “Nuŋtsɔ, shi mɔ nɛ hu?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return? You must follow me.”
translation_verse: Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji miisumɔ akɛ ehi shi kɛyashi mibaabe lɛ, mɛni no kɔɔ yɛ ohe? Bo lɛ nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ!”

english_verse: So the rumor spread among the other disciples that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say he would not die. He simply said, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni wiemɔ nɛɛ gbɛ shwã yɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ akɛ nakai kaselɔ lɛ gboŋ; tsɛ Yesu ekɛɛɛ lɛ akɛ egboŋ, shi moŋ ekɛɛ, “Kɛji miisumɔ akɛ ehi shi kɛyashi mibaabe lɛ, mɛni no kɔɔ yɛ ohe?”

english_verse: This disciple is the one who told all of this. He wrote it, and we know he is telling the truth.
translation_verse: Mɔ nɛ ji kaselɔ ni yeɔ nii nɛɛ ahe odase lɛ, ni lɛ eŋma nii nɛɛ, ni wɔle akɛ edase lɛ anɔkwaleŋ.

english_verse: Jesus did many other things. If they were all written in books, I don't suppose there would be room enough in the whole world for all the books.
translation_verse: Shi nii krokomɛi pii hu yɛ ni Yesu fee, ni kɛji akɛɛ aaaŋma fɛɛ ekomekome lɛ, misusuɔ akɛ je lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛŋ woji ni kulɛ aaaŋma lɛ eto.

english_verse: Theophilus, I first wrote to you about all that Jesus did and taught from the very first
translation_verse: Teofilo, miklɛŋklɛŋ wolo lɛ mli lɛ, migba nii fɛɛ ni Yesu babɔ̃i feemɔ kɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ

english_verse: until he was taken up to heaven. But before he was taken up, he gave orders to the apostles he had chosen with the help of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni aŋɔ lɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi, be ni etsɔ̃ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ ewo ebɔfoi ni ehala lɛ akitãi sɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: While he was still with them, he said: Don't leave Jerusalem yet. Wait here for the Father to give you the Holy Spirit, just as I told you he has promised to do.
translation_verse: Ni be ni ekɛ amɛnaa kpe shi lɛ, ewo amɛ akpɔ akɛ, “Nyɛkajea Yerusalɛm, shi moŋ nyɛmɛa Tsɛ lɛ shiwoo lɛ ni nyɛnu yɛ minaa lɛ;

english_verse: John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit. Jesus Is Taken to Heaven
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Yohane lɛ, nu ekɛbaptisi, shi nyɛ lɛ eyeŋ gbii pii ko ni akɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ aaabaptisi nyɛ.” Yesu ŋwɛiyaa

english_verse: While the apostles were still with Jesus, they asked him, “Lord, are you now going to give Israel its own king again?”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, be ni amɛnaa bakpe shi lɛ amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ani nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli obaatee maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shi oma shi ohã Israel lɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus said to them, “You don't need to know the time of those events that only the Father controls.
translation_verse: Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Jeee nyɛnɔ ji akɛ nyɛaale bei loo gbii lɛ ni Tsɛ lɛ eto yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehewalɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come upon you and give you power. Then you will tell everyone about me in Jerusalem, in all Judea, in Samaria, and everywhere in the world.”
translation_verse: Shi moŋ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ na ba nyɛnɔ lɛ, nyɛaana hewalɛ ni nyɛaatsɔ̃mɔ midasefoi yɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ Yudea kɛ Samaria fɛɛ, kɛyashi jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: After Jesus had said this and while they were watching, he was taken up into a cloud. They could not see him,
translation_verse: Be ni ewie nii nɛɛ lɛ, amɛmiikwɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ ni awo lɛ, ni atatu ko ŋɔ lɛ kɛje amɛhiɛ kɛtee.

english_verse: but as he went up, they kept looking up into the sky. Suddenly two men dressed in white clothes were standing there beside them.
translation_verse: Ni be ni eyaa ni amɛkwɛɔ ŋwɛi gãa lɛ, naa, hii enyɔ ni wo atadei yɛji damɔ amɛmasɛi,

english_verse: They said, “Why are you men from Galilee standing here and looking up into the sky? Jesus has been taken to heaven. But he will come back in the same way you have seen him go.” Someone To Take the Place of Judas
translation_verse: ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ Galileabii, mɛɛba nyɛdamɔ shi nyɛkwɛɔ ŋwɛi nɛkɛ? Nɛkɛ Yesu nɛɛ ni aŋɔ lɛ kɛje nyɛŋɔɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi nɛɛ, ebaaba nakai nɔŋŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛna akɛ eyaa ŋwɛi nɛɛ.” Ahala Matia ni eye Yuda najiaŋ

english_verse: The Mount of Olives was about a kilometer from Jerusalem. The apostles who had gone there were Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon, known as the Eager One, and Judas the son of James. After the apostles returned to the city, they went upstairs to the room where they had been staying.
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛshɛ jɛi lɛ, amɛtee ŋwɛitsu ko mli, he ni Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane kɛ Andrea kɛ Filipo kɛ Toma kɛ Bartolomeo kɛ Mateo kɛ Alfeo bi Yakobo kɛ Simon, maŋ he hiɛdɔlɔ lɛ, kɛ Yakobo bi Yuda hiɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The apostles often met together and prayed with a single purpose in mind. The women and Mary the mother of Jesus would meet with them, and so would his brothers.
translation_verse: Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ kɛ yei lɛ kɛ Yesu nyɛ Maria kɛ enyɛmimɛi hii lɛ kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome hiɛ sɔlemɔ mli waa.

english_verse: Then Judas bought some land with the money he was given for doing that evil thing. He fell headfirst into the field. His body burst open, and all his insides came out.
translation_verse: Shi nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ ŋɔ enɔsha ni efee lɛ mli nyɔmɔwoo lɛ ehe abɔɔ, ni eyama eyi shi, ni emli gba enyɔ ni emlinii fɛɛ tue shwie shi.

english_verse: When the people of Jerusalem found out about this, they called the place Akeldama, which in the local language means “Field of Blood.”
translation_verse: Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ na le enɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, atsɛɔ nakai abɔɔ lɛ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwiemɔ mli akɛ Akeldama, eshishi ji “Lá-Abɔɔ”.

english_verse: In the book of Psalms it says, “Leave his house empty, and don't let anyone live there.” It also says, “Let someone else have his job.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ aŋma yɛ Lalai Awolo lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Eshihilɛhe lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko akahi mli,’ kɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, ‘Enɔkwɛmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ hu mɔ kroko aŋɔ.’

english_verse: Two men were suggested: One of them was Joseph Barsabbas, known as Justus, and the other was Matthias.
translation_verse: Ni amɛfamɔ mɛi enyɔ, Yosef ni atsɛɔ lɛ Barsaba ni awo lɛ Yusto hu lɛ, kɛ Matia, amɛdamɔ shi.

english_verse: Then they all prayed, “Lord, you know what everyone is like! Show us the one you have chosen
translation_verse: Ni amɛsɔle amɛkɛɛ, “Bo, Nuŋtsɔ, ni ole gbɔmɛi fɛɛ atsuiiaŋ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mɛi enyɔ nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ ni ohala

english_verse: to be an apostle and to serve in place of Judas, who got what he deserved.”
translation_verse: ni eŋɔ nɛkɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ bɔfo nitsumɔ ni Yuda eje mli koni ekɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: They drew names, and Matthias was chosen to join the group of the eleven apostles.
translation_verse: Ni amɛfɔ̃ amɛnɔ oshiki, ni oshiki lɛ yagbee Matia nɔ, ni abu lɛ ashi bɔfoi nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: On the day of Pentecost all the Lord's followers were together in one place.
translation_verse: Be ni Pentekoste gbi lɛ shɛ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa bakpe shi yɛ he kome.

english_verse: Suddenly there was a noise from heaven like the sound of a mighty wind! It filled the house where they were meeting.
translation_verse: Ni trukaa lɛ gbɛɛmɔ ko ni tamɔ ahum ni tswaa waa jɛ ŋwɛi ba, ni ebayi shĩa he ni amɛtara lɛ fɛɛ obɔ̃.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit took control of everyone, and they began speaking whatever languages the Spirit let them speak.
translation_verse: ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ bayimɔ amɛ fɛɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃, ni amɛbɔ̃i wiemɔi krokomɛi awiemɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛwo amɛnaa lɛ.

english_verse: Many religious Jews from every country in the world were living in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Shi Yudafoi Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔi komɛi yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni amɛjɛ jeŋ maji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shishi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: And when they heard this noise, a crowd gathered. But they were surprised, because they were hearing everything in their own languages.
translation_verse: Ni be ni anu nɛkɛ gbɛɛmɔ nɛɛ, mɛi babaoo babua amɛhe naa, ni amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe, ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nu akɛ amɛmiiwie lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋwiemɔ.

english_verse: They were excited and amazed, and said: Don't all these who are speaking come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe ni amɛhiɛ fee amɛ yaa, ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Ani mɛi ni wieɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, jeee Galileabii ni?

english_verse: Then why do we hear them speaking our very own languages?
translation_verse: Shi te fee tɛŋŋ ni wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nuɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ he ni afɔ lɛ yɛ lɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ?

english_verse: Some of us are from Parthia, Media, and Elam. Others are from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,
translation_verse: Partiabii kɛ Mediabii kɛ Elambii kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Mesopotamia kɛ Yudea kɛ Kapadokia, Ponto kɛ Asia,

english_verse: Everyone was excited and confused. Some of them even kept asking each other, “What does all this mean?”
translation_verse: Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe ni amɛfee yaa, ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Te enɛ shishiŋ?”

english_verse: Others made fun of the Lord's followers and said, “They are drunk.” Peter Speaks to the Crowd
translation_verse: Shi mɛi komɛi hu ye fɛo amɛkɛɛ, “Dãa dɔkɔdɔkɔ etɔrɔ amɛ.” Petro shiɛmɔ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ fɔsemɔ gbi lɛ nɔ

english_verse: Peter stood with the eleven apostles and spoke in a loud and clear voice to the crowd: Friends and everyone else living in Jerusalem, listen carefully to what I have to say!
translation_verse: Shi Petro kɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ te shi amɛdamɔ shi, ni ewo egbee nɔ ekɛ asafo lɛ wie ekɛɛ, “Yudahii kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm, nyɛnaa nyɛlea enɛ, ni nyɛboa miwiemɔi lɛ atoi.

english_verse: You are wrong to think that these people are drunk. After all, it is only nine o'clock in the morning.
translation_verse: Jeee dãa mɛnɛɛmɛi etɔrɔ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛsusuɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ leebi ŋmɛlɛ nɛɛhu kɛkɛ nɛ;

english_verse: But this is what God told the prophet Joel to say,
translation_verse: shi moŋ enɛ ji nɔ ni gbalɔ Yoel wie lɛ akɛ,

english_verse: “When the last days come, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions, and your old men will have dreams.
translation_verse: “Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, ‘Ni aaaba mli yɛ naagbee gbii lɛ anɔ akɛ, mafɔse miMumɔ lɛ eko mashwie gbɔmɛi fɛɛ anɔ, ni nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei lɛ aaagba, ni nyɛblahii lɛ aaana ninai, ni nyɛnukpai lɛ aaala lamɔi.

english_verse: In those days I will give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women, and they will prophesy.
translation_verse: Ni asaŋ mitsuji hii kɛ mitsuji yei lɛ anɔ hu mafɔse miMumɔ lɛ eko mashwie yɛ nakai gbii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛaagba.

english_verse: “I will work miracles in the sky above and wonders on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: Ni mahã naakpɛɛnii aba ŋwɛi, ni okadii hu aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, lá kɛ la kɛ lasu lamɔ.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before the great and wonderful day of the Lord appears.
translation_verse: Hulu aaatsɔ̃ duŋ, ni nyɔɔŋtsere aaatsɔ̃ lá, dani Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbi wulu ni yɔɔ nyam lɛ aaaba.

english_verse: Then the Lord will save everyone who asks for his help.”
translation_verse: Ni aaaba mli akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaabo atsɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ, aaahere eyiwala.’

english_verse: Now, listen to what I have to say about Jesus from Nazareth. God proved he sent Jesus to you by having him work miracles, wonders, and signs. All of you know this.
translation_verse: “Ataamɛi Israelbii, nyɛboa nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ atoi! Yesu Nazarenyo lɛ ji nuu ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi kɛ naakpɛɛnii kɛ okadii ni etsɔ̃ enine nɔ efee yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ ye ehe odase etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle lɛ.

english_verse: God had already planned and decided that Jesus would be handed over to you. So you took him and had evil men put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Yesu nɛɛ ni ajie lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo kɛ enii ni ele eto lɛ naa ahã lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃ mɛi ni bɛ mla lɛ anine nɔ nyɛsɛŋ lɛ ni nyɛgbe lɛ.

english_verse: But God set him free from death and raised him to life. Death could not hold him in its power.
translation_verse: Shi Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi ni efɛne lɛ kɛjɛ gbele piŋmɔi lɛ amli, akɛni gbele nyɛŋ enaa etsi lɛ.

english_verse: What David said are really the words of Jesus, “I always see the Lord near me, and I will not be afraid with him at my right side.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ David wie yɛ ehe ekɛɛ, ‘Minaa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yɛ mihiɛ daa, ejaakɛ eyɛ mininejurɔ nɔ, koni mikadidãa.

english_verse: Because of this, my heart will be glad, my words will be joyful, and I will live in hope.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mitsui nyɔ̃ mimli ni mililɛi nya, ni asaŋ migbɔmɔtso hu aaajɔɔ ehe yɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ mli;

english_verse: The Lord won't leave me in the grave. I am his holy one, and he won't let my body decay.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ oshiŋ misusuma yɛ gbohiiaje, ni ohaŋ omɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ana fitemɔ.

english_verse: He has shown me the path to life, and he makes me glad by being near me.”
translation_verse: Ohã mile wala gbɛ̃i lɛ, Ni ooowo mi obɔ̃ kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ ohiɛ.’

english_verse: My friends, it is right for me to speak to you about our ancestor David. He died and was buried, and his tomb is still here.
translation_verse: “Anyɛmimɛi, makɛɛ nyɛ faŋŋ yɛ blematsɛ David lɛ he akɛ egbo ni afu lɛ, ni asaŋ eyɛ wɔteŋ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.

english_verse: But David was a prophet, and he knew that God had made a promise he would not break. He had told David someone from his own family would someday be king.
translation_verse: Akɛni gbalɔ ji lɛ ni ele akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ekã lɛ kitã akɛ emusuŋbii lɛ eko baata esɛi lɛ nɔ hewɔ lɛ,

english_verse: David knew this would happen, and so he told us Christ would be raised to life. He said God would not leave him in the grave or let his body decay.
translation_verse: ena eto ni ewie Kristo shitee lɛ he akɛ ashiii esusuma yɛ gbohiiaje ni egbɔmɔtso hu fiteee.

english_verse: All of us can tell you that God has raised Jesus to life!
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ Yesu nɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi; no he odasefoi ji wɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Jesus was taken up to sit at the right side of God, and he was given the Holy Spirit, just as the Father had promised. Jesus is also the one who has given the Spirit to us, and this is what you are now seeing and hearing.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ akɛni awo enɔ kɛtee Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ ni ena Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he shiwoo lɛ kɛjɛ Tsɛ lɛ dɛ̃ŋ hewɔ lɛ, efɔse nɔ ni nyɛnaa ni nyɛnuɔ nɛɛ eshwie shi.

english_verse: David didn't go up to heaven. So he wasn't talking about himself when he said, “The Lord told my Lord to sit at his right side,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ David eyaaa ŋwɛi, shi lɛ nɔŋŋ ekɛɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ miNuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, ta mininejurɔ nɔ,

english_verse: until he made my Lord's enemies into a footstool for him.”
translation_verse: kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋɔ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ mafee onajiashi maaŋoo.’

english_verse: Everyone in Israel should then know for certain that God has made Jesus both Lord and Christ, even though you put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: “No hewɔ lɛ, Israel we lɛ fɛɛ ale krɛdɛɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ eŋɔ nɛkɛ Yesu ni nyɛsɛŋ lɛ nɛɛ efee Nuŋtsɔ kɛ Kristo fɛɛ.”

english_verse: When the people heard this, they were very upset. They asked Peter and the other apostles, “Friends, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Shi be ni amɛnu enɛ lɛ, etsurɔ amɛtsuiiaŋ, ni amɛkɛɛ Petro kɛ bɔfoi ni eshwɛ lɛ akɛ, “Anyɛmimɛi, te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ?”

english_verse: Peter said to them, “Turn to God and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ni Petro kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahã abaptisi lɛ awo Yesu Kristo gbɛi mli, koni akɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ afa nyɛ, ni nyɛaana Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ nɔkeenɔ lɛ.

english_verse: This promise is for you and your children. It is for everyone our Lord God will choose, no matter where they live.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ shiwoo lɛ, nyɛ kɛ nyɛbii, kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ, mɛi abɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaatsɛ kɛaaba lɛ anɔ ni.”

english_verse: Peter told them many other things as well. Then he said, “I beg you to save yourselves from what will happen to all these evil people.”
translation_verse: Ni ewie wiemɔi krokomɛi pii ekɛye odase ni ekɛwo amɛ ŋaa akɛ, “Nyɛhãa aherea nyɛyiwala kɛjea yinɔ kɔɔdɔŋ nɛɛ mli.”

english_verse: They spent their time learning from the apostles, and they were like family to each other. They also broke bread and prayed together. Life among the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Ni amɛhiɛ bɔfoi lɛ atsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ kɛ naanyobɔɔ lɛ kɛ abolookuumɔ lɛ kɛ sɔlemɔi lɛ amli.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed by the many miracles and wonders that the apostles worked.
translation_verse: Ni gbeyei mɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ, ni atsɔ̃ bɔfoi lɛ anɔ afee naakpɛɛnii kɛ okadii pii.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers often met together, and they shared everything they had.
translation_verse: Ni mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ he kome, ni amɛfee amɛnii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ ekome;

english_verse: They would sell their property and possessions and give the money to whoever was in need.
translation_verse: amɛhɔ̃ɔhɔ̃ɔ amɛshikpɔji kɛ amɛhenii, ni amɛja shika lɛ amɛhã mɛi lɛ fɛɛ bɔ ni he hiaa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ.

english_verse: Day after day they met together in the temple. They broke bread together in different homes and shared their food happily and freely,
translation_verse: Ni daa gbi lɛ amɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome yaa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni amɛkumɔkumɔɔ aboloo yɛ shĩai, ni amɛkɛ miishɛɛ kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ yeɔ nii,

english_verse: while praising God. Everyone liked them, and each day the Lord added to their group others who were being saved.
translation_verse: ni amɛ jieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ yi, ni amɛhiɛ ba nyam yɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ. Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ mɛi ni ahere amɛyiwala lɛ efataa asafo lɛ he gbi fɛɛ gbi.

english_verse: The time of prayer was about three o'clock in the afternoon, and Peter and John were going into the temple.
translation_verse: Gbi ko gbɛkɛ ŋmɛji etɛ̃ ni ji sɔlemɔ be lɛ, Petro kɛ Yohane tsa mlu kɛtee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.

english_verse: A man who had been born lame was being carried to the temple door. Each day he was placed beside this door, known as the Beautiful Gate. He sat there and begged from the people who were going in.
translation_verse: Ni nuu ko yɛ ni ji obubuafo kɛjɛ enyɛ musuŋ, ni awoɔ lɛ daa abataa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shinaa ni atsɛɔ lɛ “Shinaa Fɛɛfɛo” lɛ naa, koni ebala nii yɛ mɛi ni yaa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ adɛ̃.

english_verse: The man saw Peter and John entering the temple, and he asked them for money.
translation_verse: Ni be ni ena Petro kɛ Yohane boteɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, eba amɛ nɔ ko.

english_verse: But they looked straight at him and said, “Look up at us!”
translation_verse: Shi Petro kɛ Yohane fɛɛ kwɛ lɛ gãa, ni Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kwɛmɔ wɔhiɛ!”

english_verse: The man stared at them and thought he was going to get something.
translation_verse: Ni edɔ ehiŋmɛii eto amɛnɔ, ehiɛ kã nɔ akɛ ebaana nɔ ko yɛ amɛdɛ̃.

english_verse: But Peter said, “I don't have any silver or gold! But I will give you what I do have. In the name of Jesus Christ from Nazareth, get up and start walking.”
translation_verse: Shi Petro kɛɛ, “Jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika lɛ mibɛ eko; shi nɔ ni miyɔɔ lɛ, no mikɛhãa bo nɛɛ, Yɛ Yesu Kristo, Nazarenyo lɛ, gbɛi mli lɛ, tee shi ni onyiɛ.”

english_verse: Peter then took him by the right hand and helped him up. At once the man's feet and ankles became strong,
translation_verse: Ni emɔ̃ eninejurɔ mli ni ewo enɔ edamɔ shi; ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ enaji kɛ enanetalɔi lɛ amli wa lɛ;

english_verse: and he jumped up and started walking. He went with Peter and John into the temple, walking and jumping and praising God.
translation_verse: ni ehuru edamɔ shi ni ebɔ̃i nyiɛmɔ, ni ekɛ amɛ nyiɛ kɛbote Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kɛ tuumɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ.

english_verse: Everyone saw him walking around and praising God.
translation_verse: Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ na lɛ ni enyiɛ ni eejie Nyɔŋmɔ yi;

english_verse: They knew he was the beggar who had been lying beside the Beautiful Gate, and they were completely surprised. They could not imagine what had happened to the man. Peter Speaks in the Temple
translation_verse: ni be ni amɛyoo lɛ akɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni ta Sɔlemɔ We “Shinaa Fɛɛfɛo” lɛ naa ebalaa nii lɛ, amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe ni amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe babaoo yɛ nɔ ni afee ahã lɛ lɛ hewɔ. Petro shiɛmɔ yɛ Solomon Ablanaa lɛ nɔ

english_verse: While the man kept holding on to Peter and John, the whole crowd ran to them in amazement at the place known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Shi akɛni obubuafo ni atsa lɛ lɛ kpɛtɛ Petro kɛ Yohane hewɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ fɛɛ jo foi kutuu kɛba amɛŋɔɔ yɛ ablanaa ni atsɛɔ lɛ “Solomon Ablanaa” lɛ nɔ ni amɛhe ejɔ̃ amɛhe.

english_verse: Peter saw that a crowd had gathered, and he said: Friends, why are you surprised at what has happened? Why are you staring at us? Do you think we have some power of our own? Do you think we were able to make this man walk because we are so religious?
translation_verse: Be ni Petro na enɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ maŋ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ Israelhii, mɛɛba nyɛhiɛ feɔ nyɛ yaa yɛ enɛ hewɔ, aloo mɛɛba nyɛkwɛɔ wɔ gãa nɛkɛ, tamɔ nɔ ni wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhewalɛ loo wɔNyɔŋmɔjamɔ wɔkɛhã nuu nɛɛ nyiɛɔ nɛɛ?

english_verse: The God that Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and our other ancestors worshiped has brought honor to his Servant Jesus. He is the one you betrayed. You turned against him when he was being tried by Pilate, even though Pilate wanted to set him free.
translation_verse: Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni ji wɔtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ewo etsulɔ Yesu hiɛ nyam, Yesu mɔ ni nyɛjie lɛ nyɛhã ni nyɛkwa lɛ yɛ Pontio Pilato hiɛ, be ni lɛ lɛ ekpɛ mli akɛ eeeŋmɛɛ ehe lɛ.

english_verse: You rejected Jesus, who was holy and good. You asked for a murderer to be set free,
translation_verse: Shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkwa Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ Jalɔ lɛ, ni nyɛkpa fai akɛ akɛ gbɔmɔ awuyelɔ moŋ ake nyɛ,

english_verse: and you killed the one who leads people to life. But God raised him from death, and all of us can tell you what he has done.
translation_verse: ni Wala Lumɔ lɛ, nyɛgbe lɛ; shi Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ, ni no he odasefoi ji wɔ.

english_verse: You see this man, and you know him. He put his faith in the name of Jesus and was made strong. Faith in Jesus made this man completely well while everyone was watching.
translation_verse: Ni egbɛi lɛ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli naa, ni egbɛi lɛ tsa nuu nɛɛ ni nyɛnaa ni nyɛle lɛ; ni enɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ ehã efee kpiŋtiŋkpliŋŋ yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhiɛ nɛɛ.

english_verse: My friends, I am sure you and your leaders didn't know what you were doing.
translation_verse: “Ni agbɛnɛ, anyɛmimɛi, mile akɛ leee ni nyɛleee hewɔ ni nyɛfee, tamɔ nyɛnukpai lɛ nɔŋŋ;

english_verse: But God had his prophets tell that his Messiah would suffer, and now he has kept this promise.
translation_verse: shi nii ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekɛɛ eto momo yɛ egbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa akɛ eKristo lɛ aaana amanehulu lɛ, ehã eba mli nakai.

english_verse: So turn to God! Give up your sins, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui ni nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ, koni agbe nyɛhe eshai lɛ,

english_verse: Then the time will come when the Lord will give you fresh strength. He will send you Jesus, his chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: bɔ ni afee ni mumɔŋ hewalɛwoo ko ajɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ aba, ni eeetsu Yesu Kristo mɔ ni ejie eto ehã nyɛ momo lɛ;

english_verse: But Jesus must stay in heaven until God makes all things new, just as his holy prophets promised long ago.
translation_verse: mɔ ni sa akɛ ŋwɛi aŋɔ lɛ kɛyashi be ni aaato nibii fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ewie he yɛ egbalɔi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ anaa kɛjɛ teteete lɛ gbɛjianɔ.

english_verse: Moses said, “The Lord your God will choose one of your own people to be a prophet, just as he chose me. Listen to everything he tells you.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Mose kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaatee gbalɔ ko ni tamɔ mi shi kɛaajɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ ahã nyɛ; nyɛboa lɛ toi yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni eeewie etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ mli.

english_verse: No one who disobeys this prophet will be one of God's people any longer.”
translation_verse: Ni aaaba mli akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni boŋ nakai gbalɔ lɛ toi lɛ, aaakpãtã ehiɛ kwraa kɛaaje mɛi lɛ ateŋ!’

english_verse: Samuel and all the other prophets who came later also spoke about what is now happening.
translation_verse: Ni asaŋ gbalɔi fɛɛ hu ni wie kɛjɛ Samuel kɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛtsi nɛkɛ gbii nɛɛ atã amɛto.

english_verse: You are really the ones God told his prophets to speak to. And you were given the promise God made to your ancestors. He said to Abraham, “All nations on earth will be blessed because of someone from your family.”
translation_verse: Nyɛ ji gbalɔi lɛ kɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ bii, kpãŋmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ, be ni ekɛɛ Abraham akɛ, ‘Ni oshwei mli aaajɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wekui fɛɛ yɛ’ lɛ.

english_verse: God sent his chosen Son to you first, because God wanted to bless you and make each one of you turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Ni Nyɔŋmɔ tee etsulɔ Yesu lɛ shi lɛ, nyɛ tsutsu nyɛŋɔɔ etsu lɛ ni ebajɔɔ nyɛ ni ekpale nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛjɛ enifɔɔji anii lɛ ahe.”

english_verse: The apostles were still talking to the people, when some priests, the captain of the temple guard, and some Sadducees arrived.
translation_verse: Shi be ni amɛkɛ maŋ lɛ wieɔ lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ asafoiatsɛ lɛ kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ bashwie amɛnɔ,

english_verse: These men were angry because the apostles were teaching the people that the dead would be raised from death, just as Jesus had been raised from death.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ efee amɛ mlifu akɛ amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ nii, ni amɛmiijaje amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Yesu ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ.

english_verse: It was already late in the afternoon, and they arrested Peter and John and put them in jail for the night.
translation_verse: Ni amɛmɔmɔ amɛ, ni amɛyawo amɛ tsuŋ kɛyashi jetsɛremɔ, ejaakɛ je ena etã.

english_verse: But a lot of people who had heard the message believed it. So by now there were about
translation_verse: Shi mɛi ni nu lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii he ye, ni hii lɛ ayibɔ bashɛ aaafee akpei enumɔ.

english_verse: The next morning the leaders, the elders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Shi enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ amɛlumɛi lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ babua amɛhe naa yɛ Yerusalɛm,

english_verse: The high priest Annas was there, as well as Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and other members of the high priest's family.
translation_verse: kɛ Osɔfonukpa Ana, kɛ Kaiafa kɛ Yohane kɛ Aleksandro kɛ mɛi abɔ ni jɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ weku lɛ mli lɛ;

english_verse: They brought in Peter and John and made them stand in the middle while they questioned them. They asked, “By what power and in whose name have you done this?”
translation_verse: ni amɛyaŋɔ Petro kɛ Yohane amɛbadamɔ amɛhiɛ, ni amɛbi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewalɛ nyɛkɛfee enɛ, aloo mɛɛ gbɛi mli nyɛfee yɛ?”

english_verse: Peter was filled with the Holy Spirit and told the nation's leaders and the elders:
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Petro ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ eyi lɛ obɔ̃ lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Maŋ mli lumɛi kɛ onukpai,

english_verse: You are questioning us today about a kind deed in which a man who could not walk was healed.
translation_verse: kɛji akɛ wɔ miiye sane ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ yɛ ejurɔ ni afee nɛkɛ helatsɛ nɛɛ hewɔ akɛ namɔ nɔ atsɔ̃ atsa lɛ lɛ,

english_verse: But there is something we must tell you and everyone else in Israel. This man is standing here completely well because of the power of Jesus Christ from Nazareth. You put Jesus to death on a cross, but God raised him to life.
translation_verse: no lɛ nyɛ fɛɛ kɛ Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ana ale akɛ, Yesu Kristo, Nazarenyo lɛ, ni nyɛsɛŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ, lɛ egbɛi mli nuu nɛɛ damɔ nyɛhiɛ ni ehe ewa lɛ nɛɛ.

english_verse: He is the stone you builders thought was worthless, and now he is the most important stone of all.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɔŋŋ ji mɔ ni ŋmalɛi lɛ wie yɛ ehe akɛ, ‘Tɛ lɛ ni nyɛ ni nyɛ ji tsutswalɔi lɛ gbe ehe guɔ lɛ, no ebatsɔ̃ koŋtɛ nɛɛ.’

english_verse: Only Jesus has the power to save! His name is the only one in all the world that can save anyone.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ yiwalaheremɔ bɛ mɔ kroko mli; ni asaŋ gbɛi kroko hu bɛ ŋwɛi shishi ni akɛhã gbɔmɛi ni sa akɛ atsɔ̃ nɔ ahere wɔyiwala.”

english_verse: The officials were amazed to see how brave Peter and John were, and they knew that these two apostles were only ordinary men and not well educated. The officials were certain these men had been with Jesus.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ be ni amɛna Petro kɛ Yohane ekãa lɛ, ni amɛyoo akɛ jeee woloŋlelɔi kɛ nilelɔi komɛi ji amɛ lɛ, efee amɛhiɛ yaa, ni amɛkɔ sɛɛ akɛ amɛkɛ Yesu ehi shi.

english_verse: But they could not deny what had happened. The man who had been healed was standing there with the apostles.
translation_verse: Ni asaŋ akɛni amɛna gbɔmɔ ni atsa lɛ lɛ kɛ amɛ damɔ shi hewɔ lɛ, amɛnaaa nɔ ko amɛkɛɛ.

english_verse: The officials commanded them to leave the council room. Then the officials said to each other,
translation_verse: Shi amɛfã amɛ akɛ amɛje gwabɔɔ lɛ mli amɛje kpo fioo, ni amɛtee ajina

english_verse: “What can we do with these men? Everyone in Jerusalem knows about this miracle, and we cannot say it didn't happen.
translation_verse: amɛkɛɛ, “Te wɔɔfee gbɔmɛi nɛɛ tɛŋŋ? Ejaakɛ okadi ni yɔɔ naakpɛɛ ni atsɔ̃ amɛnɔ afee lɛ yɛ faŋŋ yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ ahiɛ, ni wɔnyɛŋ wɔtso.

english_verse: But to keep this thing from spreading, we will warn them never again to speak to anyone about the name of Jesus.”
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ bɔ ni afee ni ekahehee tuutu ko dɔŋŋ yɛ mɛi lɛ ateŋ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔwoa amɛhe gbeyei, koni amɛkawie yɛ nɛkɛ gbɛi nɛɛ mli amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ko mɔ ko dɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: So they called the two apostles back in and told them they must never, for any reason, teach anything about the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Ni amɛtsɛ amɛ kɛba, ni amɛwo amɛ kitã akɛ amɛkatsi tã ni amɛkatsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ Yesu gbɛi mli kwraa dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Peter and John answered, “Do you think God wants us to obey you or to obey him?
translation_verse: Shi Petro kɛ Yohane here nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛ eja gbɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ akɛ abo nyɛ moŋ toi fe Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nyɛkojoa.

english_verse: We cannot keep quiet about what we have seen and heard.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔ lɛ wɔnyɛŋ akɛ ja wɔwie nii ni wɔna kɛ nii ni wɔnu lɛ.”

english_verse: The officials could not find any reason to punish Peter and John. So they threatened them and let them go. The man who was healed by this miracle was more than
translation_verse: ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ ni atsa lɛ naakpɛɛ tsamɔ nɛɛ eye fe afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ. Heyelɔi lɛ sɔle ni awo amɛ ekãa

english_verse: As soon as Peter and John had been set free, they went back and told the others everything the chief priests and the leaders had said to them.
translation_verse: Shi be ni aŋmɛɛ amɛhe lɛ, amɛba amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni amɛbagba nibii fɛɛ ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛɛ amɛ lɛ.

english_verse: When the rest of the Lord's followers heard this, they prayed together and said: Master, you created heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: Be ni amɛnu lɛ, amɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome hole amɛgbei anɔ amɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, bo ni oji Nyɔŋmɔ ni fee ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔ kɛ nii fiaa ni yɔɔ amɛmli,

english_verse: And by the Holy Spirit you spoke to our ancestor David. He was your servant, and you told him to say: “Why are all the Gentiles so furious? Why do people make foolish plans?
translation_verse: bo mɔ ni otsɔ̃ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ owie yɛ wɔtsɛ David, otsulɔ lɛ, naa okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛɛba jeŋmaji lɛ feɔ hoo, ni maji lɛ hu jwɛŋɔ yakanii?

english_verse: The kings of earth prepare for war, and the rulers join together against the Lord and his Messiah.”
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ete shi edamɔ shi, ni lumɛi lɛ hu anaa ebakpe shi ewo Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ!’

english_verse: Here in Jerusalem, Herod and Pontius Pilate got together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel. Then they turned against your holy Servant Jesus, your chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: “Lɛɛlɛŋ, Herode kɛ Pontio Pilato kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ kɛ Israel maji lɛ hu ebabua amɛhe naa yɛ maŋ nɛɛŋ amɛwo otsulɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Yesu, mɔ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ,

english_verse: They did what you in your power and wisdom had already decided would happen.
translation_verse: koni amɛfee nii abɔ ni onine kɛ oyiŋtoo lɛ eto efɔ shi akɛ afee lɛ.

english_verse: Lord, listen to their threats! We are your servants. So make us brave enough to speak your message.
translation_verse: Ni agbɛnɛ hu, Nuŋtsɔ, kwɛmɔ amɛmɔhegbeyei ni amɛwoɔ lɛ, ni ohã otsuji lɛ kɛ ekãa pii ajaje owiemɔ lɛ,

english_verse: Show your mighty power, as we heal people and work miracles and wonders in the name of your holy Servant Jesus.
translation_verse: ni okpã onine mli ni ohã atsatsaa mɛi, ni atsɔ̃ otsulɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ Yesu lɛ gbɛi nɔ afee okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii.”

english_verse: After they had prayed, the meeting place shook. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and bravely spoke God's message. Sharing Possessions
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛsɔle nɛkɛ lɛ, he ni amɛnaa ebakpe shi yɛ lɛ hoso, ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ yimɔ amɛ fɛɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃; ni amɛkɛ ekãa jaje Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ. Heyelɔi lɛ fee amɛnii fɛɛ kwasafonii

english_verse: The group of followers all felt the same way about everything. None of them claimed that their possessions were their own, and they shared everything they had with each other.
translation_verse: Shi mɛi babaoo lɛ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ tsui koome kɛ susuma koome, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɛɛɛ enii ni eyɔɔ lɛ amli eko akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ, shi eyɛ hã amɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: In a powerful way the apostles told everyone that the Lord Jesus was now alive. God greatly blessed his followers,
translation_verse: Ni hewalɛ kpeteŋkple bɔfoi lɛ kɛye Nuŋtsɔ Yesu shitee lɛ he odase, ni dromɔ kpeteŋkple yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ.

english_verse: and no one went in need of anything. Everyone who owned land or houses would sell them and bring the money
translation_verse: Ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ amɛteŋ ni efiɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi abɔ ni yɔɔ shikpɔji loo shĩai lɛ hɔ̃ɔhɔ̃ɔ amɛ ni amɛkɛ nii ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ ayinii lɛ ba,

english_verse: to the apostles. Then they would give the money to anyone in need.
translation_verse: amɛkɛbashwie bɔfoi lɛ anajianaa, ni ajaa ahãa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ bɔ ni hiaa lɛ.

english_verse: Ananias and his wife Sapphira also sold a piece of property.
translation_verse: Shi nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Anania kɛ eŋa Safira lɛ yahɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ ko,

english_verse: But they agreed to cheat and keep some of the money for themselves. So when Ananias took the rest of the money to the apostles,
translation_verse: ni nuu lɛ kɛ yinii lɛ eko to sɛɛ, ni eŋa hu le he eko, ni ekɛ fã lɛ ba ni ekɛbashwie bɔfoi lɛ anajianaa.

english_verse: Peter said, “Why has Satan made you keep back some of the money from the sale of the property? Why have you lied to the Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Shi Petro kɛɛ, “Anania, mɛɛba Satan yi otsuiŋ obɔ̃, ni omale otsɔ̃ɔ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni okɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ yinii lɛ eko to sɛɛ?

english_verse: The property was yours before you sold it, and even after you sold it, the money was still yours. What made you do such a thing? You didn't lie to people. You lied to God!”
translation_verse: Ani be ni eyɔɔ lɛ, jeee bo onɔ ni? Ni be ni ohɔ̃ɔ hu lɛ, shika lɛ jee bo diɛŋtsɛ onɔ ni? Mɛɛba oto nɛkɛ yiŋ? Jeee gbɔmɛi omale otsɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ moŋ.”

english_verse: As soon as Ananias heard this, he dropped dead, and everyone who heard about it was frightened.
translation_verse: Ni be ni Anania nu nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ, egbee shi, ni egbo. Ni gbeyei kpele mɔmɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni nu lɛ.

english_verse: Some young men came in and wrapped up his body. Then they took it out and buried it.
translation_verse: Ni oblahii lɛ te shi, ni amɛbasaa lɛ kɛhã fuu, ni amɛwo lɛ kɛje kpo ni amɛyafu lɛ.

english_verse: Three hours later Sapphira came in, but she did not know what had happened to her husband.
translation_verse: Ni aaafee ŋmɛlɛtswai etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ, eba mli akɛ eŋa ni leee nɔ sane ni eba lɛ hu ba jɛi.

english_verse: Peter asked her, “Tell me, did you sell the property for this amount?” “Yes,” she answered, “that's the amount.”
translation_verse: Ni Petro bi lɛ akɛ, “Ani bɔ ni nyɛhɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛhe nɛ? Kɛɛmɔ mi.” Ni ekɛɛ, “Hɛɛ, nɛkɛŋ.”

english_verse: Then Peter said, “Why did the two of you agree to test the Lord's Spirit? The men who buried Ananias are by the door, and they will carry you out!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Te fee tɛŋŋ ni nyɛfee naabu kome koni nyɛkɛka Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ nɛɛ? Naa, mɛi ni yafu owu lɛ anaji yɔɔ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ, ni amɛaawo bo hu kɛaatee.”

english_verse: At once she fell at Peter's feet and died. When the young men came back in, they found Sapphira lying there dead. So they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ egbee shi yɛ Petro najianaa, ni egbo. Ni be ni oblahii lɛ ba lɛ amɛbana akɛ egbo ni amɛwo lɛ kɛje kpo, ni amɛyafu lɛ yɛ ewu lɛ masɛi.

english_verse: The church members were afraid, and so was everyone else who heard what had happened. Peter's Unusual Power
translation_verse: Ni gbeyei kpeteŋkple mɔ asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nu nii nɛɛ. Okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii

english_verse: The apostles worked many miracles and wonders among the people. All of the Lord's followers often met in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Shi atsɔ̃ bɔfoi lɛ anine nɔ afee okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii pii yɛ maŋ lɛ mli; ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome hi Solomon Ablanaa lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: No one outside their group dared join them, even though everyone liked them very much.
translation_verse: Shi mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko ekaaa akɛ ekɛ yiŋ flɛflɛ aaayakpɛtɛ amɛhe, shi maŋ lɛ buɔ amɛ naakpa.

english_verse: Many men and women started having faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni asaŋ akɛ mɛi ni heɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ yeɔ, hii kɛ yei babaoo, bafata amɛhe,

english_verse: Then sick people were brought out to the road and placed on mats. It was hoped that Peter would walk by, and his shadow would fall on them and heal them.
translation_verse: aahu po ni aholeɔ helatsɛmɛi kɛbaa blohui amli abashwieɔ sai kɛ saatsei anɔ, koni kɛ Petro miiho lɛ, ehɔɔŋ kɛkɛ atsɔ̃ amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi anɔ.

english_verse: A lot of people living in the towns near Jerusalem brought those who were sick or troubled by evil spirits, and they were all healed. Trouble for the Apostles
translation_verse: Ni mɛi pii jɛ maji ni jwere Yerusalɛm hewɔ lɛ amli babua amɛhe naa, ni amɛhiɛ helatsɛmɛi kɛ mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji haoɔ amɛ kɛba, ni atsa amɛ fɛɛ. Awa bɔfoi lɛ ayi

english_verse: The high priest and all the other Sadducees who were with him became jealous.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni osɔfonukpa lɛ te shi kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ ni ji Sadukifoi lɛ akuu lɛ, ni amɛhiɛ edɔ diɛŋtsɛ,

english_verse: They arrested the apostles and put them in the city jail.
translation_verse: ni amɛbamɔmɔ bɔfoi lɛ, ni amɛyawo amɛ maŋ kpabuŋ.

english_verse: But that night an angel from the Lord opened the doors of the jail and led the apostles out. The angel said,
translation_verse: Shi nyɔɔŋ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo bagbele tsu lɛ shinai lɛ, ni ejie amɛ ekɛɛ,

english_verse: “Go to the temple and tell the people everything about this new life.”
translation_verse: “Nyɛyaa nyɛyadamɔa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ nyɛjajea nɛkɛ wala nɛɛ wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ nyɛtsɔ̃a maŋ lɛ!”

english_verse: So they went into the temple before sunrise and started teaching. The high priest and his men called together their council, which included all of Israel's leaders. Then they ordered the apostles to be brought to them from the jail.
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛnu lɛ, amɛyiŋ leebi maŋkpa amɛtee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ amɛyatsɔ̃ɔ nii. Agbɛnɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ kɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ ba ni amɛbatsɛ akwaashɔŋ lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ anukpai lɛ fɛɛ kɛkpe, ni amɛtsu kɛtee tsu lɛ mli koni ayajie bɔfoi lɛ kɛba.

english_verse: The temple police who were sent to the jail did not find the apostles. They returned and said,
translation_verse: Shi be ni tsuji lɛ ba jɛi lɛ, amɛnaaa amɛ yɛ tsu lɛ mli, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛbagba

english_verse: “We found the jail locked tight and the guards standing at the doors. But when we opened the doors and went in, we didn't find anyone there.”
translation_verse: akɛ, “Tsu lɛ wɔna akɛ aŋa naa kpɛŋŋ, ni bulɔi lɛ hu damɔ shinai lɛ anaa; shi be ni wɔgbele lɛ, wɔnaaa mɔ ko yɛ mli.”

english_verse: The captain of the temple police and the chief priests listened to their report, but they did not know what to think about it.
translation_verse: Shi be ni osɔfo lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ asafoiatsɛ lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ nu nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ, amɛfee yaa yɛ bɔfoi lɛ ahe [ni amɛbi] akɛ, “Te enɛ naa yaakpa tɛŋŋ?”

english_verse: Just then someone came in and said, “Now those men you put in jail are in the temple, teaching the people!”
translation_verse: Ni mɔ ko ba bagba amɛ akɛ, “Naa, hii lɛ ni nyɛwo amɛ tsuŋ lɛ damɔ shi yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ nii.”

english_verse: The captain went with some of the temple police and brought the apostles back. But they did not use force. They were afraid that the people might start throwing stones at them.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni asafoiatsɛ lɛ kɛ tsuji lɛ yiŋ ni amɛyaŋɔ amɛ kɛba, jeee nɔnyɛɛ naa, ejaakɛ amɛmiishe maŋ lɛ gbeyei, ni akabatswia amɛ tɛi.

english_verse: When the apostles were brought before the council, the high priest said to them,
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛkɛ amɛ ba lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛ badamɔ akwaashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ; ni osɔfonukpa lɛ bi amɛ

english_verse: “We told you plainly not to teach in the name of Jesus. But look what you have done! You have been teaching all over Jerusalem, and you are trying to blame us for his death.”
translation_verse: akɛ, “Ani wɔwooo nyɛ kitã kadikadi akɛ nyɛkatsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ nɛkɛ gbɛi nɛɛ mli? Nyɛkwɛa bɔ ni nyɛhã Yerusalɛm eyi obɔ̃ kɛ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛmiitao akɛ nyɛkɛ nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ lá lɛ baa wɔnɔ.”

english_verse: Peter and the apostles replied: We don't obey people. We obey God.
translation_verse: Shi Petro kɛ bɔfoi lɛ here nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Esa akɛ aboɔ Nyɔŋmɔ moŋ toi fe gbɔmɛi.

english_verse: You killed Jesus by nailing him to a cross. But the God our ancestors worshiped raised him to life
translation_verse: Yesu ni nyɛsɛŋ lɛ yɛ tso nɔ ni nyɛgbe lɛ lɛ, wɔtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ tee lɛ shi;

english_verse: and made him our Leader and Savior. Then God gave him a place at his right side, so that the people of Israel would turn back to him and be forgiven.
translation_verse: lɛ enɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wo kɛtee eninejurɔ nɔ, ni ewo lɛ lumɔ kɛ yiwalaherelɔ, koni ehã Israel ana tsuitsakemɔ kɛ eshaifaa.

english_verse: We are here to tell you about all this, and so is the Holy Spirit, who is God's gift to everyone who obeys God.
translation_verse: Ni wɔji saji nɛɛ ahe odasefoi, nakai nɔŋŋ ji Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hu ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã mɛi ni boɔ lɛ toi lɛ.”

english_verse: When the council members heard this, they became so angry they wanted to kill the apostles.
translation_verse: Shi be ni amɛnu lɛ ewo amɛmli la ni amɛto amɛyiŋ akɛ amɛaagbe amɛ.

english_verse: But one of the members was the Pharisee Gamaliel, a highly respected teacher. He ordered the apostles to be taken out of the room for a little while.
translation_verse: Shi Farisifonyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Gamaliel, mlatsɔɔlɔ ni maŋ lɛ fɛɛ buɔ lɛ lɛ, te shi damɔ shi yɛ akwaashɔŋ lɛ teŋ, ni efã akɛ akɛ bɔfoi lɛ aje kpo fioo,

english_verse: Then he said to the council: Men of Israel, be careful what you do with these men.
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ, “Ataamɛi Israelbii, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ yɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe, bɔ ni nyɛkɛ amɛ aaaye ahã.

english_verse: Later, when the people of our nation were being counted, Judas from Galilee showed up. A lot of people followed him, but he was killed, and all his followers were scattered.
translation_verse: Mɔ nɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yuda, Galileanyo lɛ, te shi yɛ mɛi akanemɔ be lɛ mli, ni egbala asafo babaoo eshwie esɛɛ; lɛ hu ehiɛ kpãtã ni mɛi ni bo lɛ toi lɛ fɛɛ hu gbɛ shwã.

english_verse: So I advise you to stay away from these men. Leave them alone. If what they are planning is something of their own doing, it will fail.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛŋmɛa gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe ni nyɛkadia amɛsɛɛ; ejaakɛ kɛ gbɔmɛi adɛŋ nɛkɛ yiŋtoo nɛɛ loo nɛkɛ nitsumɔ nɛɛ jɛ lɛ, ebaafite;

english_verse: But if God is behind it, you cannot stop it anyway, unless you want to fight against God. The council members agreed with what he said,
translation_verse: shi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ ejɛ lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋ lɛ nyɛfite, koni nyɛkabafee nyɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wuɔ.”

english_verse: and they called the apostles back in. They had them beaten with a whip and warned them not to speak in the name of Jesus. Then they let them go.
translation_verse: Ni amɛbo lɛ toi, ni amɛtsɛ bɔfoi lɛ kɛba, ni amɛyi amɛ, ni amɛwo amɛ kitã akɛ amɛkawie yɛ Yesu gbɛi lɛ mli; ni amɛŋmɛɛ amɛhe.

english_verse: The apostles left the council and were happy, because God had considered them worthy to suffer for the sake of Jesus.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amɛje akwaashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ amɛtee kɛ miishɛɛ, akɛ Yesu gbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ abu amɛ mɛi ni sa akɛ abɔ amɛ ahora.

english_verse: Every day they spent time in the temple and in one home after another. They never stopped teaching and telling the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Ni gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ amɛfɔ̃ɔɔ nitsɔɔmɔ kɛ Yesu Kristo shiɛmɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kɛ shĩai.

english_verse: A lot of people were now becoming followers of the Lord. But some of the ones who spoke Greek started complaining about the ones who spoke Aramaic. They complained that the Greek-speaking widows were not given their share when the food supplies were handed out each day.
translation_verse: Nakai bei lɛ amli, be ni kaselɔi lɛ ayi faa lɛ, Helenibii lɛ wie huhuuhu amɛshi Hebribii lɛ, ejaakɛ Hebribii lɛ ahiɛ jeɔ Helenibii lɛ okulafoi lɛ anɔ yɛ daa kwɛmɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ.

english_verse: The twelve apostles called the whole group of followers together and said, “We should not give up preaching God's message in order to serve at tables.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ tsɛ asafo lɛ kɛba, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Esaaa akɛ wɔshiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni wɔyasɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ okpɔlɔi ahe.

english_verse: My friends, choose seven men who are respected and wise and filled with God's Spirit. We will put them in charge of these things.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛtaoa nyɛteŋ hii kpawo ni yɔɔ gbɛi kpakpa ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ nilee eyi amɛ obɔ̃, koni wɔkɛ amɛ ato nɛkɛ nitsumɔ ni he hiaa nɛɛ nɔ;

english_verse: We can spend our time praying and serving God by preaching.”
translation_verse: shi wɔ lɛ wɔɔhiɛ sɔlemɔ kɛ wiemɔ lɛ he sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli.”

english_verse: This suggestion pleased everyone, and they began by choosing Stephen. He had great faith and was filled with the Holy Spirit. Then they chose Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and also Nicolaus, who worshiped with the Jewish people in Antioch.
translation_verse: Ni wiemɔ lɛ sa asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ; ni amɛfamɔ Stefano, nuu ko ni hemɔkɛyeli kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ eyi lɛ obɔ̃, kɛ Filipo kɛ Prokoro kɛ Nikanora kɛ Timon kɛ Parmena kɛ Nikolao ni emɔ Yudafoi ajamɔ mli ni ejɛ Antiokia lɛ,

english_verse: These men were brought to the apostles. Then the apostles prayed and placed their hands on the men to show they had been chosen to do this work.
translation_verse: ni amɛkɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi badamɔ bɔfoi lɛ ahiɛ; ni amɛsɔle ni amɛkɛ amɛniji shwie amɛnɔ.

english_verse: God's message spread, and many more people in Jerusalem became followers. Even a large number of priests put their faith in the Lord. Stephen Is Arrested
translation_verse: Ni Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ shwere, ni kaselɔi lɛ ayi bafa diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni osɔfoi lɛ tete ateŋ mɛi pii mɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli. Stefano mɔ̃mɔ

english_verse: God gave Stephen the power to work great miracles and wonders among the people.
translation_verse: Ni Stefano, mɔ ni dromɔ kɛ hewalɛ eyi lɛ obɔ̃ lɛ, fee naakpɛɛnii kɛ okadii wuji yɛ maŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: But some men from Cyrene and Alexandria were members of a group who called themselves “Free Men.” They started arguing with Stephen. Some others from Cilicia and Asia also argued with him.
translation_verse: Shi mɛi komɛi ni jɛ kpeehe ni atsɛɔ lɛ “Mɛi ni eye amɛhe” akpeehe lɛ, kɛ Kirenemɛi kɛ Aleksandriamɛi kɛ mɛi ni jɛ Kilikia kɛ Asia lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi te shi ni amɛkɛ Stefano taa naa;

english_verse: But they were no match for Stephen, who spoke with the great wisdom that the Spirit gave him.
translation_verse: shi amɛnyɛɛɛ Stefano nilee kɛ mumɔ ni ekɛwieɔ lɛ naa amɛdamɔ.

english_verse: So they talked some men into saying, “We heard Stephen say terrible things against Moses and God!”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ mɛi komɛi yafi ni amɛbakɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔnu akɛ ewie musubɔɔ wiemɔi eshi Mose kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ.”

english_verse: They turned the people and their leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses against Stephen. Then they all grabbed him and dragged him in front of the council.
translation_verse: Ni amɛwo maŋbii lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ayiŋ, ni amɛte shi kɛba enɔ amɛbamɔ lɛ ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛtee akwaashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: Some men agreed to tell lies about Stephen, and they said, “This man keeps on saying terrible things about this holy temple and the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Ni amɛkɛ amale odasefoi badamɔ shi, ni mɛnɛɛmɛi kɛɛ akɛ, “Be fɛɛ be lɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ miiwie miishi he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ Mose Mla lɛ,

english_verse: We have heard him claim that Jesus from Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses gave us.”
translation_verse: ejaakɛ wɔnu akɛ ekɛɛ akɛ Yesu, Nazarenyo lɛ, aaafite biɛ, ni eeetsake kusumi ni Mose kɛhã wɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: Then all the council members stared at Stephen. They saw that his face looked like the face of an angel.
translation_verse: Ni mɛi ni tara akwaashɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ fɛɛ tsu amɛhiŋmɛii amɛshwie enɔ, ni amɛna ehiɛ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo hiɛ.

english_verse: The high priest asked Stephen, “Are they telling the truth about you?”
translation_verse: Ni osɔfonukpa lɛ bi Stefano akɛ, “Ani saji nɛɛ yɛ mli nakai lo?”

english_verse: Stephen answered: Friends, listen to me. Our glorious God appeared to our ancestor Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he had moved to Haran.
translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ, “Anyɛmimɛi kɛ Ataamɛi, nyɛboa toi! Anunyam Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔtsɛ Abraham be ni eyɔɔ Mesopotamia, ni enako ebahi Haran lɛ,

english_verse: God told him, “Leave your country and your relatives and go to a land that I will show you.”
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Jee oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ owekumɛi ateŋ kɛya shikpɔŋ ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo lɛ nɔ.’

english_verse: Then Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, Abraham came and settled in this land where you now live.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni eje Kaldeabii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni eyahi Haran. Ni be ni etsɛ gbo sɛɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ fã lɛ kɛjɛ jɛi kɛba nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyɔɔ nɔ amrɔ nɛɛ nɔ;

english_verse: God didn't give him any part of it, not even a square meter. But God did promise to give it to him and his family forever, even though Abraham didn't have any children.
translation_verse: ni ehãaa lɛ nɔyelinɔ ni ji shikpɔŋ ni shɛɔ nane tokota lɛɛmɔ tete, shi ewo lɛ shi akɛ ekɛaahã lɛ kɛ eshwiei ni baaba yɛ esɛɛ lɛ akɛ amɛnɔ, tsɛ no mli lɛ ebɛ bi kwraa po.

english_verse: God said Abraham's descendants would live for a while in a foreign land. There they would be slaves and would be mistreated
translation_verse: Shi bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ lɛ wie ji akɛ, eshwiei lɛ aaayato gbɔ yɛ maŋsɛɛ shikpɔŋ ko nɔ, ni aaafee amɛ nyɔji ni aaawa amɛ yi afii ohai ejwɛ.

english_verse: But he also said, “I will punish the nation that makes them slaves. Then later they will come and worship me in this place.”
translation_verse: Shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, ‘Makojo nakai maŋ ni amɛaayasɔ̃mɔ lɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛaaje jɛi ni amɛaabaja mi yɛ biɛ nɛɛ.’

english_verse: God said to Abraham, “Every son in each family must be circumcised to show you have kept your agreement with me.” So when Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him. Later, Isaac circumcised his son Jacob, and Jacob circumcised his twelve sons.
translation_verse: Ni ekɛ ketiafoo he kpãŋmɔ lɛ hã lɛ; ni no hewɔ efɔ Isak ni efo lɛ ketia gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ; ni Isak fɔ Yakob, ni Yakob hu fɔ blematsɛmɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ.

english_verse: and rescued him from all his troubles. God made him so wise that the Egyptian king Pharaoh thought highly of him. The king even made Joseph governor over Egypt and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: ni ejie lɛ yɛ emanehului fiaa mli, ni ehã ehiɛ ba nyam, ni efee nilelɔ yɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ Farao hiɛ, ni ewo lɛ lumɔ yɛ Ijipt kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Everywhere in Egypt and Canaan the grain crops failed. There was terrible suffering, and our ancestors could not find enough to eat.
translation_verse: “Shi hɔmɔ kɛ amanehulu kpeteŋkple ba Ijipt kɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ naaa nii amɛye.

english_verse: But when Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors there for the first time.
translation_verse: Ni be ni Yakob nu akɛ abele yɛ Ijipt lɛ, klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ etsu wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛtee.

english_verse: It was on their second trip that Joseph told his brothers who he was, and the king learned about Joseph's family.
translation_verse: Ni nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yosef hã enyɛmimɛi lɛ yoo lɛ, ni Farao hu bale Yosef weku lɛ.

english_verse: Joseph sent for his father and his relatives. In all, there were
translation_verse: Ni Yosef tsu ayakpee etsɛ Yakob kɛ eweku lɛ fɛɛ kɛba; amɛyi nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enumɔ.

english_verse: His father went to Egypt and died there, just as our ancestors did.
translation_verse: Ni Yakob yiŋ etee Ijipt, ni lɛ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ yagboi yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: Later their bodies were taken back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor.
translation_verse: Akɛ amɛgbohii lɛ ba Shekem, ni abato amɛ yɛ fuuhe ni Abraham tse shika he yɛ Hamorbii lɛ adɛŋ yɛ Shekem lɛ mli.

english_verse: Finally, the time came for God to do what he had promised Abraham. By then the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.
translation_verse: “Shi be ni bè ni Nyɔŋmɔ baaye eshi ni ewo Abraham lɛ nɔ lɛ shɛ lɛ, maŋ lɛ shwere, ni amɛyi fa yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,

english_verse: Another king was ruling Egypt, and he didn't know anything about Joseph.
translation_verse: kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋtsɛ kroko ni leee Yosef lɛ bate shi yɛ Ijipt.

english_verse: He tricked our ancestors and was cruel to them. He even made them leave their babies outside, so they would die.
translation_verse: Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ, ekɛ wɔjakubii lɛ ye ŋaa mli ni efee wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ efɔŋ, akɛ ehã amɛshɛrɛ amɛbii abifabii amɛshwie, bɔ ni afee ni amɛkahi jeŋ.

english_verse: During this time Moses was born. He was a very beautiful child, and for three months his parents took care of him in their home.
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ mli afɔ Mose, ni ehe yɛ fɛo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni alɛ lɛ yɛ etsɛ we lɛ nyɔji etɛ̃.

english_verse: Then when they were forced to leave him outside, the king's daughter found him and raised him as her own son.
translation_verse: Ni be ni ashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ lɛ, Farao biyoo lɛ yawo lɛ, ni elɛ lɛ ekɛ lɛ fee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebi.

english_verse: Moses was given the best education in Egypt. He was a strong man and a powerful speaker.
translation_verse: Ni atsɔ̃ɔ Mose Ijipt nilee fɛɛ, ni efee mɔ ko ni yɔɔ hewalɛ yɛ ewiemɔi kɛ enitsumɔi amli.

english_verse: One day he saw an Egyptian mistreating one of them. So he rescued the man and killed the Egyptian.
translation_verse: Be ni ena akɛ aafee amɛteŋ mɔ ko efɔŋ lɛ, efã ehe, ni etɔ mɔ ni afeɔ lɛ efɔŋ lɛ he owele ni egbe Ijiptnyo lɛ.

english_verse: Moses thought the rest of his people would realize God was going to use him to set them free. But they didn't understand.
translation_verse: Ni esusu akɛ kulɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ aaayoo sɛɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ miitsɔ enine nɔ ehere amɛ; shi amɛyooo sɛɛ.

english_verse: The next day Moses saw two of his own people fighting, and he tried to make them stop. He said, “Men, you are both Israelites. Why are you so cruel to each other?”
translation_verse: Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ ebanina amɛteŋ mɛi enyɔ ni amɛmiinɔ, ni ekpãtã amɛ ekɛɛ, ‘Ataamɛi, nyɛ lɛ nyɛmimɛi ji nyɛ; mɛɛba nyɛfeɔ nyɛhe efɔŋ nɛɛ?’

english_verse: But the man who had started the fight pushed Moses aside and asked, “Who made you our ruler and judge?
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni feɔ enaanyo efɔŋ lɛ tsirɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ, ‘Namɔ wo bo wɔnɔ lumɔ kɛ kojolɔ?

english_verse: Are you going to kill me, just as you killed that Egyptian yesterday?”
translation_verse: Ani ootao akɛ ogbe mi tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛ lɛ ogbe Ijiptnyo lɛ?

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he ran away to live in the country of Midian. His two sons were born there.
translation_verse: Ni wiemɔ nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ Mose jo foi, ni eyato gbɔ yɛ Midian shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni efɔ bihii enyɔ yɛ jɛi.

english_verse: Forty years later, an angel appeared to Moses from a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: “Shi be ni shɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo ko bajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ ŋmeitso ko lalilɛi mli.

english_verse: Moses was surprised by what he saw. He went closer to get a better look, and the Lord said,
translation_verse: Be ni Mose na lɛ, ehiɛ fee lɛ yaa yɛ ninaa lɛ hewɔ; ni be ni etsiɔ ebɛŋkɛ ni ekwɛ lɛ enu Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbee ni eekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,

english_verse: “I am the God who was worshiped by your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” Moses started shaking all over and didn't dare to look at the bush.
translation_verse: ‘Mi ji otsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.’ Ni Mose he kpokpo ni ekaaa akɛ eeeyakwɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Take off your sandals, because the place where you are standing is holy.
translation_verse: Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Jiemɔ otokotai lɛ yɛ onane, ejaakɛ he ni odamɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.

english_verse: With my own eyes I have seen the suffering of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groans and have come down to rescue them. Now I am sending you back to Egypt.”
translation_verse: Mina mimaŋ ni yɔɔ Ijipt lɛ amanehulu lɛ, amɛŋtsɔidɔɔmɔ lɛ hu minu; ni mikpeleke shi miba amɛ jiemɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, ba ni matsu bo Ijipt.’

english_verse: This was the same Moses that the people rejected by saying, “Who made you our leader and judge?” God's angel had spoken to Moses from the bush. And God had even sent the angel to help Moses rescue the people and be their leader.
translation_verse: “Nɛkɛ Mose nɛɛ nɔŋŋ ni amɛkwa lɛ amɛkɛɛ, ‘Namɔ wo bo wɔnɔ lumɔ kɛ kojolɔ’ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ bɔfo lɛ ni jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ koo lɛ mli lɛ nine nɔ etsu lɛ akɛ lumɔ kɛ kpɔlɔ.

english_verse: In Egypt and at the Red Sea and in the desert, Moses rescued the people by working miracles and wonders for
translation_verse: Ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ekpala amɛ kɛje kpo, ni efee naakpɛɛnii kɛ okadii yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ mli kɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Moses is the one who told the people of Israel, “God will choose one of your people to be a prophet, just as he chose me.”
translation_verse: Lɛ ji nakai Mose lɛ ni kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaatee gbalɔ ko ni tamɔ mi shi kɛaajɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ ahã nyɛ’ lɛ.

english_verse: Moses brought our people together in the desert, and the angel spoke to him on Mount Sinai. There he was given these life-giving words to pass on to us.
translation_verse: Mose ji mɔ ni kɛ asafo lɛ hi ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni edamɔ bɔfo ni kɛ lɛ wie yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ, ni ehe wala wiemɔi lɛ ni ekɛbahã wɔ lɛ.

english_verse: But our ancestors refused to obey Moses. They rejected him and wanted to go back to Egypt.
translation_verse: “Shi wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ ni amɛbo lɛ toi, ni amɛtsi lɛ amɛto afã, ni amɛtsui kpale kɛtee Ijipt ekoŋŋ;

english_verse: Then they made an idol in the shape of a calf. They offered sacrifices to the idol and were pleased with what they had done.
translation_verse: Nakai be lɛ mli amɛfee tsinabi amãgã, ni amɛshã afɔle amɛhã lɛ, ni amɛna amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnine naa nitsumɔi lɛ ahe tsuijurɔ.

english_verse: God turned his back on his people and left them. Then they worshiped the stars in the sky, just as it says in the Book of the Prophets, “People of Israel, you didn't offer sacrifices and offerings to me during those
translation_verse: Shi Nyɔŋmɔ tsi ehe kɛjɛ amɛhe ni eŋmɛɛ amɛhe akɛ amɛja ŋwɛinii, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ gbalɔi lɛ awolo lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Nyɛ Israel we, ani nyɛshã kooloi afɔle kɛ niyenii afɔle nyɛhã mi yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ?

english_verse: Instead, you carried the tent where the god Molech is worshiped, and you took along the star of your god Rephan. You made those idols and worshiped them. So now I will have you carried off beyond Babylonia.”
translation_verse: Dabida, Molok buu lɛ moŋ nyɛwo nyɛtere kɛ nyɛnyɔŋmɔ Refan lɛ ŋulami lɛ ni ji amãgãi ni nyɛshɔ ni nyɛja amɛ lɛ. Shi Babilon sɛɛ maloo nyɛ kɛaatee.’

english_verse: The tent where our ancestors worshiped God was with them in the desert. This was the same tent that God had commanded Moses to make. And it was made like the model that Moses had seen.
translation_verse: “Wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ hiɛ Odase Buu lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ. Afee lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mɔ ni kɛ Mose wie lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ efee lɛ lɛ, no ji efee lɛ tamɔ nɔ ni ena lɛ.

english_verse: Later it was given to our ancestors, and they took it with them when they went with Joshua. They carried the tent along as they took over the land from those people that God had chased out for them. Our ancestors used this tent until the time of King David.
translation_verse: Buu nɛɛ, be ni wɔtsɛmɛi ni ba yɛ sɛɛ lɛ hu anine shɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ Yoshua hiɛ kɛba jeŋmaji ni Nyɔŋmɔ shwie amɛ yɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ahiɛ lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Ni ehi shi kɛbashi David yinɔ.

english_verse: He pleased God and asked him if he could build a house of worship for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: David nɛɛ hiɛ ba nyam yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni ekpa fai ni ahã emã shihilɛhe ko eha Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: And it was finally King Solomon who built a house for God.
translation_verse: Shi Solomon ji mɔ ni mã tsu ehã lɛ.

english_verse: But the Most High God doesn't live in houses made by humans. It is just as the prophet said, when he spoke for the Lord,
translation_verse: “Tsɛbelɛ Ŋwɛinyo lɛ ehiii tsui ni akɛ niji fee amli, tamɔ bɔ ni gbalɔ lɛ hu kɛɛ lɛ,

english_verse: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: ‘Ŋwɛi lɛ, misɛ̃i ni,’ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, ‘ni shikpɔŋ lɛ, minaneshi maaŋoo ni. Mɛɛ tsu nyɛaama nyɛhã mi mɔ, Asaŋ nɛgbɛ ji mihejɔɔmɔhe lɛ?

english_verse: I have made everything.”
translation_verse: Aso jeee minine fee enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ?’

english_verse: You stubborn and hardheaded people! You are always fighting against the Holy Spirit, just as your ancestors did.
translation_verse: “Nyɛ kuɛŋtilɔi kɛ tsuiiaŋ kɛ toiiaŋ foolɔi! Nyɛ lɛ, daa nɛɛ nyɛkuɔ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ naa; bɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ, nakai nyɛ hu nyɛfeɔ.

english_verse: Is there one prophet that your ancestors didn't mistreat? They killed the prophets who told about the coming of the One Who Obeys God. And now you have turned against him and killed him.
translation_verse: Gbalɔi lɛ ateŋ namɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ waaa lɛ yi? Amɛgbe mɛi ni gba yɛ jalɔ lɛ baa lɛ he amɛto lɛ. Ni agbɛnɛ nyɛ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ ni nyɛgbe lɛ,

english_verse: Angels gave you God's Law, but you still don't obey it. Stephen Is Stoned to Death
translation_verse: nyɛ ni nyɛna Mla lɛ kɛtsɔ ŋwɛi bɔfoi anɔ, ni nyɛyeee nɔ lɛ.” Stefano gbele

english_verse: When the council members heard Stephen's speech, they were angry and furious.
translation_verse: Shi be ni amɛnu nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, etsurɔ amɛtsuiiaŋ, ni amɛkpe amɛnyanyɔji ashishi kɛ mlifu.

english_verse: But Stephen was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked toward heaven, where he saw our glorious God and Jesus standing at his right side.
translation_verse: Shi Stefano ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ eyi lɛ obɔ̃ lɛ kwɛ ŋwɛi gãa, ni ena Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ kɛ Yesu ni edamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ,

english_verse: Then Stephen said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right side of God!”
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ, “Naa, miina ŋwɛi naa ni egbele, kɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ni edamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The council members shouted and covered their ears. At once they all attacked Stephen
translation_verse: Shi amɛbolɔ kɛ gbee ni wa, ni amɛtsimɔ amɛtoii, ni amɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome ke kɛbashwie enɔ,

english_verse: and dragged him out of the city. Then they started throwing stones at him. The men who had brought charges against him put their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.
translation_verse: ni amɛtsirɛ eyi sɛɛ kɛje maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛyatswia lɛ tɛi. Ni odasefoi lɛ kɛ amɛmamai lɛ shwie oblanyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Saul lɛ najianaa.

english_verse: As Stephen was being stoned to death, he called out, “Lord Jesus, please welcome me!”
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛtswiaa Stefano tɛi lɛ, ebo etsɛ Yesu ni ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ Yesu, heremɔ mimumɔ lɛ!”

english_verse: He knelt down and shouted, “Lord, don't blame them for what they have done.” Then he died.
translation_verse: Ni ekula shi, ni ebo kɛ gbee ni wa akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, kaawo amɛ nɛkɛ esha nɛɛ he nyɔmɔ!” Ni be ni ekɛɛ nɛkɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ mli ewɔ.

english_verse: Saul started making a lot of trouble for the church. He went from house to house, arresting men and women and putting them in jail. The Good News Is Preached in Samaria
translation_verse: Shi Saul bɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ ekpãtã asafo lɛ hiɛ, ni ejɛɔ shĩa kɛyaa shĩa ni eyagbalaa hii kɛ yei ni eyawoɔ amɛ tsuŋ. Ashiɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ Samaria

english_verse: The Lord's followers who had been scattered went from place to place, telling the good news.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni mɛi ni egbɛ eshwã lɛ yakpa shi, ni amɛjaje Sanekpakpa lɛ.

english_verse: Philip went to the city of Samaria and told the people about Christ.
translation_verse: Ni Filipo tee Samaria maŋ ko nɔ, ni eyashiɛ Kristo he sane etsɔ̃ɔ jɛi bii lɛ.

english_verse: They crowded around Philip because they were eager to hear what he was saying and to see him work miracles.
translation_verse: Ni mɛi babaoo kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome bo wiemɔi ni Filipo wieɔ lɛ toi be ni amɛnu ni amɛna okadii ni efee lɛ.

english_verse: Many people with evil spirits were healed, and the spirits went out of them with a shout. A lot of paralyzed and lame people were also healed.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛi pii ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ amumɔi lɛ bolɔ kɛ gbee ni wa ni amɛje amɛmli, ni atsa mɛi ni ekumɔ kɛ obubuafoi pii hu.

english_verse: Everyone in that city was very glad because of what was happening.
translation_verse: Ni miishɛɛ babaoo ba nakai maŋ lɛ mli. Simon ŋkunyaayelɔ lɛ

english_verse: For some time a man named Simon had lived there and had amazed the people of Samaria. He practiced witchcraft and claimed to be somebody great.
translation_verse: Shi nuu ko yɛ maŋ lɛ mli momosa ni atsɛɔ lɛ Simon ni eyeɔ ŋkunyaa ni ehãa Samariabii lɛ anaa kpɛɔ amɛhe, etsɔ̃ɔ ehe akɛ gbɔmɔ agbo ji lɛ;

english_verse: Everyone, rich and poor, crowded around him. They said, “This man is the power of God called ‘The Great Power.’ ”
translation_verse: ni mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji fɛɛ boɔ lɛ toi amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Mɔ nɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Hewalɛ Kpeteŋkple lɛ.”

english_verse: For a long time, Simon had used witchcraft to amaze the people, and they kept crowding around him.
translation_verse: Ni akɛni ejɛ jeeŋmɔ beebe ekɛ ekunyaayeli lɛ ehã amɛnaa ekpɛ amɛhe hewɔ lɛ, amɛboɔ lɛ toi.

english_verse: But when they believed what Philip was saying about God's kingdom and about the name of Jesus Christ, they were all baptized.
translation_verse: Shi be ni amɛhe Filipo ni jaje Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ kɛ Yesu Kristo gbɛi lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ amɛye lɛ, abaptisi hii kɛ yei fɛɛ.

english_verse: Even Simon believed and was baptized. He stayed close to Philip, because he marveled at all the miracles and wonders.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Simon diɛŋtsɛ hu he ye, ni abaptisi lɛ, ni ekɛ ehe kpɛtɛ Filipo, ni be ni ena okadii ni afee kɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi wuji ni atsu lɛ, enaa kpɛ ehe.

english_verse: The apostles in Jerusalem heard that some people in Samaria had accepted God's message, and they sent Peter and John.
translation_verse: Be ni bɔfoi lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ nu akɛ Samariabii emɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ, amɛtsu Petro kɛ Yohane kɛtee amɛŋɔɔ.

english_verse: When the two apostles arrived, they prayed that these people would be given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛshɛ jɛi lɛ amɛkpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai amɛhã amɛ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛna Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ,

english_verse: Before this, the Holy Spirit had not been given to any of them, though some of them had been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ ebako amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko nɔ, shi baptisimɔ kɛkɛ abaptisi amɛ awo Nuŋtsɔ Yesu gbɛi mli.

english_verse: Peter and John then placed their hands on everyone who had faith in the Lord, and they were given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ amɛniji ŋmɛ̃lɛ amɛnɔ, ni amɛna Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Simon noticed that the Spirit was given only when the apostles placed their hands on the people. So he brought money
translation_verse: Shi be ni Simon na akɛ bɔfoi lɛ aniji kɛ mɛi anɔ ŋmɛ̃lɛmɔ lɛ hãa anaa Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ekɛ shika ba ebahã amɛ

english_verse: and said to Peter and John, “Let me have this power too! Then anyone I place my hands on will also be given the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: ekɛɛ, “Nyɛhãa mi hu nɛkɛ hewalɛ nɛɛ koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mikɛ miniji aaaŋmɛ̃ enɔ lɛ ana Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Peter said to him, “You and your money will both end up in hell if you think you can buy God's gift!
translation_verse: Shi Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ oshika lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ akpãtã, ejaakɛ osusuɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔkeenɔ lɛ shika akɛheɔ!

english_verse: You don't have any part in this, and God sees that your heart isn't right.
translation_verse: Obɛ gbɛnaa loo gbɛfaŋ nɔ ko yɛ nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ mli; ejaakɛ otsui ejaaa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.

english_verse: Get rid of these evil thoughts and ask God to forgive you.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ shwa ohe yɛ onɔsha nɛɛ hewɔ, ni okpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai, akɛ aleenɔ akɛ otsuiŋ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ aaafa bo lo.

english_verse: I can see that you are jealous and bound by your evil ways.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mina akɛ hiɛkɔ̃ɔ eyi bo obɔ̃ tamɔ kɔlikɔ joomɔ ni nɔ̃ sha kpãa lɛ mli oyɔɔ nɛɛ.”

english_verse: Simon said, “Please pray to the Lord, so that what you said won't happen to me.”
translation_verse: Ni Simon here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛkpaa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fai nyɛhãa mi koni nibii ni nyɛwie nɛɛ eko akaba minɔ.”

english_verse: After Peter and John had preached about the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem. On their way they told the good news in many villages of Samaria. Philip and an Ethiopian Official
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ, be ni amɛye odase ni amɛshiɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛmiiba Yerusalɛm lɛ, amɛjaje Sanekpakpa lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Samariabii akrowai pii amli. Filipo kɛ Etiopia piafonyo lɛ

english_verse: The Lord's angel said to Philip, “Go south along the desert road that leads from Jerusalem to Gaza.”
translation_verse: Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo ko kɛ Filipo bawie akɛ, “Tee shi ni oya wuoyigbɛ yɛ tɛmpɔŋ ni kã shiaŋa lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm kɛyaa Gaza lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: So Philip left. An important Ethiopian official happened to be going along that road in his chariot. He was the chief treasurer for Candace, the Queen of Ethiopia. The official had gone to Jerusalem to worship
translation_verse: Ni ete shi ni eyiŋ etee. Ni naa, Etiopiabii amaŋnyɛ Kandake lɛ piafonyo ni ji esɔ̃ɔlɔnukpa ni kwɛɔ ejwetri fɛɛ nɔ lɛ nɛ; ebaho Yerusalɛm eyaja Nyɔŋmɔ,

english_verse: and was now on his way home. He was sitting in his chariot, reading the book of the prophet Isaiah.
translation_verse: ni agbɛnɛ eku esɛɛ eta eshwiili mli kɛmiiya ni eekane gbalɔ Yesaia wolo lɛ.

english_verse: The Spirit told Philip to catch up with the chariot.
translation_verse: Mumɔ lɛ kɛɛ Filipo akɛ, “Yaa ni okɛ ohe ayakpɛtɛ shwiili lɛ he.”

english_verse: Philip ran up close and heard the man reading aloud from the book of Isaiah. Philip asked him, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
translation_verse: Shi be ni Filipo wo foi kɛtee lɛ, enu akɛ eekane Yesaia wolo lɛ, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Ani oonu nɔ ni okaneɔ lɛ shishi lo?

english_verse: The official answered, “How can I understand unless someone helps me?” He then invited Philip to come up and sit beside him.
translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ, “Te mafee tɛŋŋ ni manyɛ manu shishiŋ, akɛ ja mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔ mi dã?” Kɛkɛ ni ekpa Filipo fai akɛ eba ni ekɛ lɛ abata shi.

english_verse: The man was reading the passage that said, “He was led like a sheep on its way to be killed. He was silent as a lamb whose wool is being cut off, and he did not say a word.
translation_verse: Shi ŋmalɛ lɛ he ni ekaneɔ lɛ nɛ, “Akpala lɛ kɛtee tamɔ too gwantɛŋ ni ayaagbe lɛ, ni bɔ ni too gwantɛŋbi feɔ dioo yɛ ehetsɔikulɔ hiɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ etswaaa esɛŋ.

english_verse: He was treated like a nobody and did not receive a fair trial. How can he have children, if his life is snatched away?”
translation_verse: Be ni aba lɛ shi lɛ akojooo lɛ jalɛ naa; shi eshwiei lɛ, namɔ aaagba amɛhe sane? Ejaakɛ afo ewala sɛɛ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: The official said to Philip, “Tell me, was the prophet talking about himself or about someone else?”
translation_verse: Ni piafonyo lɛ bi Filipo akɛ, “Miikpa bo fai, namɔ he gbalɔ lɛ wieɔ nɛɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ loo mɔ kroko?”

english_verse: So Philip began at this place in the Scriptures and explained the good news about Jesus.
translation_verse: Ni Filipo gbele enaa ni eje shishi kɛjɛ ŋmalɛ nɛɛ nɔ, ni ejaje Yesu he Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
