english_verse: As they were going along the road, they came to a place where there was some water. The official said, “Look! Here is some water. Why can't I be baptized?”
translation_verse: Shi Filipo kɛɛ, “Kɛji ohe oye kɛ otsuiŋ fɛɛ lɛ, oyɛ hegbɛ.” Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, “Miihe miiye akɛ Yesu Kristo ji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ.”]

english_verse: He ordered the chariot to stop. Then they both went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.
translation_verse: Ni efã akɛ shwiili lɛ awa, ni Filipo kɛ piafonyo lɛ fɛɛ yimɔ shi kɛtee nu lɛ mli, ni ebaptisi lɛ.

english_verse: After they had come out of the water, the Lord's Spirit took Philip away. The official never saw him again, but he was very happy as he went on his way.
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛje nu lɛ mli lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ sha Filipo kɛtee; ni piafonyo lɛ enaaa lɛ dɔŋŋ, shi eyi gbɛ kɛ nyamɔ.

english_verse: Philip later appeared in Azotus. He went from town to town, all the way to Caesarea, telling people about Jesus.
translation_verse: Shi Filipo lɛ, ana lɛ yɛ Azotu; ni be ni efoɔ mli lɛ, ejaje Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ maji lɛ fɛɛ mli kɛyashi ebashɛ Kaisarea.

english_verse: Saul preached with such power that he completely confused the Jewish people in Damascus, as he tried to show them that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Shi Saul lɛ, ena hewalɛ babaoo, ni ehã Yudafoi ni yɔɔ Damasko lɛ anaa tã, ejaakɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ faŋŋ akɛ mɔ nɛ ji Kristo lɛ. Saul je Yudafoi lɛ adɛŋ

english_verse: I will show him how much he must suffer for worshiping in my name.”
translation_verse: Mibatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ amanehului abɔ ni sa akɛ ena yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ.”

english_verse: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the followers. But they were all afraid of him, because they did not believe he was a true follower.
translation_verse: Ni be ni Saul ba Yerusalɛm lɛ, eka kaselɔi lɛ ahe kpɛtɛmɔ, shi amɛ fɛɛ amɛmiishe lɛ gbeyei, amɛheee amɛyeee akɛ kaselɔ ji lɛ.

english_verse: and he has seen a vision. He saw a man named Ananias coming to him and putting his hands on him, so he could see again.”
translation_verse: ni Saul na yɛ ninaa mli akɛ nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Anania lɛ miiba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛ enine miiŋmɛ enɔ, bɔ ni afee ni ena nii ekoŋŋ.”

english_verse: Suddenly something like fish scales fell from Saul's eyes, and he could see. He got up and was baptized.
translation_verse: Ni amrɔ lɛ nibii komɛi jɛ ehiŋmɛii anɔ shwie shi tamɔ loototoi, ni ena nii, ni ete shi ni abaptisi lɛ;

english_verse: Saul kept on threatening to kill the Lord's followers. He even went to the high priest
translation_verse: Shi Saul kã he ekɛ gbele miiwo Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kaselɔi lɛ ahe gbeyei lolo, ni eyiŋ kɛtee osɔfonukpa lɛ ŋɔɔ,

english_verse: and asked for letters to the leaders of the synagogues in Damascus. He did this because he wanted to arrest and take to Jerusalem any man or woman who had accepted the Lord's Way.
translation_verse: ni eyabi lɛ woji ni ekɛya Damasko kpeehei lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni kɛji ena mɛi komɛi ni hiɛ nɛkɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ mli lɛ, hii jio, yei jio, ni efimɔ amɛ ni ekpala amɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm.

english_verse: When Saul had almost reached Damascus, a bright light from heaven suddenly flashed around him.
translation_verse: Shi be ni enyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ ni eebɛŋkɛ Damasko lɛ, trukaa lɛ la kpɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi kɛbabɔle lɛ,

english_verse: He fell to the ground and heard a voice saying, “Saul! Saul! Why are you so cruel to me?”
translation_verse: ni eflɛo egbee shi, ni enu gbee ko ni miikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Saul, Saul, mɛɛba owaa mi yi?”

english_verse: “Who are you?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus,” the Lord answered. “I am the one you are so cruel to.
translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ, “Bo namɔŋ, Nuŋtsɔ?” Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Mi Yesu, mɔ ni owaa lɛ yi lɛ. Ewa hã bo akɛ ooofã ntia oshi kooloi akpalamɔtso lɛ naa dade lɛ.”

english_verse: The men with Saul stood there speechless. They had heard the voice, but they had not seen anyone.
translation_verse: Shi hii ni kɛ lɛ nyiɛ lɛ etɔ mu kɛdamɔ shi, amɛmiinu gbee lɛ moŋ, shi amɛnaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko.

english_verse: Saul got up from the ground, and when he opened his eyes, he could not see a thing. Someone then led him by the hand to Damascus,
translation_verse: Ni Saul te shi; shi be ni egbele ehiŋmɛii lɛ, enaaa nii; ni amɛmɔ enine mli, ni amɛkɛ lɛ tee Damasko.

english_verse: and for three days he was blind and did not eat or drink.
translation_verse: Ni enaaa nii, ni asaŋ eyeee nii ni enuuu nɔ ko hu gbii etɛ̃.

english_verse: A follower named Ananias lived in Damascus, and the Lord spoke to him in a vision. Ananias answered, “Lord, here I am.”
translation_verse: Shi kaselɔ ko yɛ Damasko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Anania; ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ yɛ ninaa mli akɛ, “Anania!” Ni ekɛɛ, “Naa mi, Nuŋtsɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Get up and go to the house of Judas on Straight Street. When you get there, you will find a man named Saul from the city of Tarsus. Saul is praying,
translation_verse: Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi ni oya blohu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Trɔmɔɔ lɛ mli, ni oyabi mɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Saul ni jɛ Tarso lɛ shi yɛ Yuda we lɛ; ejaakɛ naa, eesɔle,

english_verse: Ananias replied, “Lord, a lot of people have told me about the terrible things this man has done to your followers in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Shi Anania here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, minu nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ he sane yɛ mɛi pii anaa, akɛ efee omɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ efɔŋ babaoo;

english_verse: Now the chief priests have given him the power to come here and arrest anyone who worships in your name.”
translation_verse: ni biɛ hu tete ena hegbɛ kɛjɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ adɛŋ akɛ ebafimɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɛɔ ogbɛi lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Ananias, “Go! I have chosen him to tell foreigners, kings, and the people of Israel about me.
translation_verse: Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa, ejaakɛ mɔ nɛ ji midɛŋ dade ni mihala mihã mihe koni ehiɛ migbɛi lɛ kɛya jeŋmaji lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ Israelbii lɛ hu ahiɛ.

english_verse: Ananias left and went into the house where Saul was staying. Ananias placed his hands on him and said, “Saul, the Lord Jesus has sent me. He is the same one who appeared to you along the road. He wants you to be able to see and to be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Anania yiŋ etee ni eyabote shĩa lɛ, ni ekɛ eniji shwie enɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Anyɛmi Saul! Nuŋtsɔ Yesu, mɔ ni jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ bo be ni obaa yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, etsu mi oŋɔɔ, bɔ ni afee ni ona nii ekoŋŋ ni oyi obɔ̃ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Then he ate and felt much better. Saul Preaches in Damascus For several days Saul stayed with the Lord's followers in Damascus.
translation_verse: ni eye nii, ni ehe wa lɛ. Saul shiɛmɔ yɛ Damasko

english_verse: Soon he went to the synagogues and started telling people that Jesus is the Son of God.
translation_verse: Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ eshiɛ yɛ kpeehei lɛ akɛ Yesu ji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who heard Saul was amazed and said, “Isn't this the man who caused so much trouble for those people in Jerusalem who worship in the name of Jesus? Didn't he come here to arrest them and take them to the chief priests?”
translation_verse: Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni nu lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Ani jeee mɔ nɛ kpãtã mɛi ni tsɛɔ Yesu gbɛi lɛ ahiɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ, ni jeee no hewɔ nɔŋŋ eba biɛ hu tete koni ebafimɔ amɛ ni ekpala amɛ kɛya osɔfonukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ?”

english_verse: Later some of them made plans to kill Saul,
translation_verse: Shi gbii kplaŋŋ sɛɛ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ to eyi nɔ apam akɛ amɛaagbe lɛ.

english_verse: but he found out about it. He learned that they were guarding the gates of the city day and night in order to kill him.
translation_verse: Ni Saul banu amɛkpãŋmɔ lɛ he. Shi amɛbuɔ maŋ agboi lɛ anaa daa shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛgbe lɛ.

english_verse: Then one night his followers let him down over the city wall in a large basket. Saul in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Shi ekaselɔi lɛ kɛ lɛ wo kafu mli nyɔɔŋ, ni amɛshiu lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ gbogbo lɛ nɔ kɛyayi shi. Saul yɛ Yerusalɛm

english_verse: Then Barnabas helped him by taking him to the apostles. He explained how Saul had seen the Lord and how the Lord had spoken to him. Barnabas also said when Saul was in Damascus, he had spoken bravely in the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Shi Barnaba ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee bɔfoi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni eyagba amɛ bɔ ni ena Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛ lɛ wie, kɛ bɔ ni efee ekãa yɛ Yesu gbɛi lɛ mli yɛ Damasko.

english_verse: Saul moved about freely with the followers in Jerusalem and told everyone about the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni ekɛ amɛ yaa baa yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni eshiɛ kɛ ekãa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ mli.

english_verse: He was always arguing with the Jews who spoke Greek, and so they tried to kill him.
translation_verse: Ni ekɛ Helenibii lɛ wie ni ekɛ amɛ taa naa; shi amɛka lɛ gbee.

english_verse: But the followers found out about this and took Saul to Caesarea. From there they sent him to the city of Tarsus.
translation_verse: Be ni nyɛmimɛi lɛ nu he lɛ amɛkɛ lɛ tee Kaisarea, ni amɛwo lɛ gbɛ kɛtee Tarso.

english_verse: The church in Judea, Galilee, and Samaria now had a time of peace and kept on worshiping the Lord. The church became stronger, as the Holy Spirit encouraged it and helped it grow. Peter Heals Aeneas
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ asafo lɛ na hejɔlɛ yɛ Yudea kɛ Galilea kɛ Samaria fɛɛ, ni enane mɔ shi, ni enyiɛɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbeyeishemɔ mli, ni ekɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ miishɛjemɔ lɛ shwereɔ. Petro tsa Ainea yɛ Lida

english_verse: While Peter was traveling from place to place, he visited the Lord's followers who lived in the town of Lydda.
translation_verse: Shi eba mli akɛ, be ni Petro eyakpa hei lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, eba mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni yɔɔ Lida lɛ hu aŋɔɔ.

english_verse: There he met a man named Aeneas, who for eight years had been sick in bed and could not move.
translation_verse: Ni ebana nuu ko yɛ jɛi ni atsɛɔ lɛ Ainea ni ekɛ kuumɔhela ekã saa nɔ afii kpaanyɔ sɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Peter said to Aeneas, “Jesus Christ has healed you! Get up and make up your bed.” At once he stood up.
translation_verse: Ni Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ainea, Yesu Kristo miitsa bo; tee shi ni bo diɛŋtsɛ oŋmɛ osaa lɛ!” Ni amrɔ lɛ ete shi.

english_verse: Many people in the towns of Lydda and Sharon saw Aeneas and became followers of the Lord. Peter Brings Dorcas Back to Life
translation_verse: Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Lida kɛ Sharon lɛ na lɛ, ni amɛtsake ni amɛba Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ. Petro tee Dorka shi yɛ Yopa

english_verse: In Joppa there was a follower named Tabitha. Her Greek name was Dorcas, which means “deer.” She was always doing good things for people and had given much to the poor.
translation_verse: Shi yoo kaselɔ ko yɛ Yopa ni atsɛɔ lɛ Tabita, eshishi ji Dorka. Nitsumɔi kpakpai kɛ ejurɔfeemɔ eyi yoo nɛɛ obɔ̃.

english_verse: But she got sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.
translation_verse: Shi eba mli akɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ, ehe baye ni egbo. Ni amɛju ehe ni amɛkɛ lɛ yaŋmɛ ŋwɛitsu ko mli.

english_verse: Joppa wasn't far from Lydda, and the followers heard that Peter was there. They sent two men to say to him, “Please come with us as quickly as you can!”
translation_verse: Lida kɛ Yopa jɛkɛɛɛ kwraa, ni be ni kaselɔi lɛ nu akɛ Petro yɛ Lida lɛ, amɛtsu hii enyɔ kɛtee eŋɔɔ amɛyakpa lɛ fai akɛ ekashashao shi, shi eba amɛŋɔɔ oya.

english_verse: At once, Peter went with them. The men took Peter upstairs into the room. Many widows were there crying. They showed him the coats and clothes that Dorcas had made while she was still alive.
translation_verse: Ni Petro te shi ni ekɛ amɛ tee. Ni be ni eshɛ jɛi lɛ, amɛkɛ lɛ tee ŋwɛitsu lɛ mli, ni yei okulafoi lɛ fɛɛ badamɔdamɔɔ emasɛi amɛmiifofoi, ni amɛkɛ flakai kɛ atadei ni Dorka fee be ni ekɛ amɛ yɔɔ lolo lɛ miitsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.

english_verse: After Peter had sent everyone out of the room, he knelt down and prayed. Then he turned to the body of Dorcas and said, “Tabitha, get up!” The woman opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
translation_verse: Ni Petro shwie amɛ fɛɛ kɛje kpo, ni ekula shi esɔle, ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ ehã gbonyo lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Tabita, tee shi!” Ni egbele ehiŋmɛii, ni be ni ena Petro lɛ, ete shi eta shi.

english_verse: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Peter called in the widows and the other followers and showed them that Dorcas had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Ni Petro mɔ enine mli, ni ewo enɔ; ni etsɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ kɛ okulafoi lɛ kɛba, ni ekɛ lɛ damɔ amɛhiɛ hiɛkãalɔ.

english_verse: Everyone in Joppa heard what had happened, and many of them put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni anu he yɛ Yopa fɛɛ, ni mɛi pii he Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ amɛye.

english_verse: Peter stayed on for a while in Joppa in the house of a man named Simon, who made leather.
translation_verse: Ni Petro hi Yopa gbii kplaŋŋ yɛ wolokpoolɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Simon lɛ ŋɔɔ.

english_verse: In Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, who was the captain of a group of soldiers called “The Italian Unit.”
translation_verse: Shi nuu ko yɛ Kaisarea ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kornelio ni ji asraafoiohaatsɛ yɛ asraafoi akuu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Italia kuu lɛ mli.

english_verse: Cornelius was a very religious man. He worshiped God, and so did everyone else who lived in his house. He had given a lot of money to the poor and was always praying to God.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ jalɔ ni, ni ekɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni efeɔ maŋbii lɛ ejurɔ pii, ni ekpaa Nyɔŋmɔ fai daa.

english_verse: One afternoon at about three o'clock, Cornelius had a vision. He saw an angel from God coming to him and calling him by name.
translation_verse: Aaafee gbɛkɛ ŋmɛji etɛ̃ mli lɛ, ena yɛ ninaa mli faŋŋ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo ko ba eŋɔɔ bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kornelio!”

english_verse: Cornelius was surprised and stared at the angel. Then he asked, “What is this all about?” The angel answered, “God has heard your prayers and knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: Ni ekwɛ lɛ gãa ni eshe gbeyei ni ekɛɛ; “Mɛni, Nuŋtsɔ?” Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Osɔlemɔi kɛ onijuji ni ofeɔ lɛ eshɛ ŋwɛi ni efee kaimɔnɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.

english_verse: Now send some men to Joppa for a man named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Ni agbɛnɛ lɛ tsu mɛi kɛya Yopa ni ayakpee Simon mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Petro hu lɛ kɛba;

english_verse: He is staying with Simon the leather maker, who lives in a house near the sea.”
translation_verse: eyato Simon, wolokpoolɔ ko ni shĩa yɔɔ ŋshɔ lɛ naa lɛ ŋɔɔ.”

english_verse: After saying this, the angel left. Cornelius called in two of his servants and one of his soldiers who worshiped God.
translation_verse: Be ni bɔfo ni kɛ lɛ bawie lɛ etee lɛ, etsɛ ewebii lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ kɛ asraafonyo ko ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei ni ji mɛi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome,

english_verse: He explained everything to them and sent them off to Joppa.
translation_verse: ni egba amɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ, ni etsu amɛ Yopa. Petro na ninaa ko

english_verse: The next day about noon these men were coming near Joppa. Peter went up on the roof of the house to pray
translation_verse: Enɔ jetsɛremɔ, be ni amɛnyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ ni amɛbɛŋkɛ maŋ lɛ, Petro tee sɔlemɔ yɛ tsu yiteŋ aaafee shwane ŋmɛlɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ mli.

english_verse: and became very hungry. While the food was being prepared, he fell sound asleep and had a vision.
translation_verse: Ni hɔmɔ ye lɛ naakpa, ni eetao nɔ ko eye. Shi be ni afeɔ niyenii lɛ, efee tamɔ nɔ enyɔ enɔ,

english_verse: He saw heaven open, and something came down like a huge sheet held up by its four corners.
translation_verse: ni ena akɛ ŋwɛi egbele, ni nɔ ko miikpeleke shi ni tamɔ mama kpeteŋkple, ni ahiɛ ekoji ejwɛ lɛ mli aashi kɛmiiba shikpɔŋ;

english_verse: In it were all kinds of animals, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: ni shikpɔŋ nɔ kooloi naji ejwɛjwɛɛjwɛ kɛ waamɔnii kɛ ŋwɛi loofɔji srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ eko yɛ mli.

english_verse: A voice said to him, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Ni gbee ko kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Petro, tee shi, gbee ni oye.”

english_verse: But Peter said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never eaten anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Shi Petro kɛɛ, “Dabida, Nuŋtsɔ, ejaakɛ miyeko nɔ ko ni buleɔ mɔ loo nɔ ko ni he tseee dã.”

english_verse: The voice spoke to him again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Ni gbee lɛ saa kɛɛ lɛ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ akɛ, “Nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsuu he lɛ, kaabu lɛ akɛ bulemɔnɔ.”

english_verse: This happened three times before the sheet was suddenly taken back to heaven.
translation_verse: Shi afee nakai shii etɛ̃; ni awo nɔ lɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: Peter was still wondering what all this meant, when the men sent by Cornelius came and stood at the gate. They had found their way to Simon's house
translation_verse: Be ni Petro efee yaa akɛ te nii ni ena nɛɛ shishiŋ lɛ, hii lɛ ni Kornelio tsu lɛ miibibii Simon we lɛ gbɛ; ni amɛbadamɔ agbo lɛ naa

english_verse: and were asking if Simon Peter was staying there.
translation_verse: amɛtsɛ ni amɛbi akɛ, “Ani biɛ Simon ni atsɛɔ lɛ Petro hu lɛ bato lɛ?”

english_verse: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Holy Spirit said to him, “Three men are here looking for you.
translation_verse: Shi be ni Petro jwɛŋɔ ninaa lɛ he lɛ, Mumɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, hii etɛ̃ komɛi miitao bo;

english_verse: Hurry down and go with them. Don't worry, I sent them.”
translation_verse: no hewɔ lɛ, tee shi ni okpeleke shi okɛ amɛ aya, ni okaje ŋwane ko, ejaakɛ mi mitsu amɛ.”

english_verse: Peter went down and said to the men, “I am the one you are looking for. Why have you come?”
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Petro kpeleke shi, ni eyakɛɛ hii lɛ akɛ, “Naa, mi ji mɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ lɛ; mɛɛ sane hewɔ nyɛba?”

english_verse: They answered, “Captain Cornelius sent us. He is a good man who worships God and is liked by the Jewish people. One of God's holy angels told Cornelius to send for you, so he could hear what you have to say.”
translation_verse: Ni amɛkɛɛ, “Asraafoiohaatsɛ Kornelio, ni ji nuu jalɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔ ni Yudafoi amaŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ yeɔ ehe odase lɛ, lɛ ŋwɛi bɔfo krɔŋkrɔŋ ko kɛɛ lɛ akɛ etsu ni abakpee bo kɛba ewe lɛ, koni ebo onaa toi.”

english_verse: Peter invited them to spend the night. The next morning, Peter and some of the Lord's followers in Joppa left with the men who had come from Cornelius.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni etsɛ amɛ kɛba shĩa lɛ ni ebafee amɛ gbɔ. Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ ekɛ amɛ yiŋ kɛtee ni nyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ Yopa lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi fata ehe kɛtee. Petro yɛ Kornelio we lɛ

english_verse: The next day they arrived in Caesarea where Cornelius was waiting for them. He had also invited his relatives and close friends.
translation_verse: Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ ekoŋŋ lɛ amɛyashɛ Kaisarea. Shi Kornelio miikwɛ amɛ gbɛ, ni etsɛ ewekumɛi kɛ enanemɛi juji kɛkpe.

english_verse: When Peter arrived, Cornelius greeted him. Then he knelt at Peter's feet and started worshiping him.
translation_verse: Ni be ni Petro boteɔ shĩa lɛ, Kornelio kɛ lɛ bakpe, ni eho egbee enaji anaa ni eja lɛ.

english_verse: But Peter took hold of him and said, “Stand up! I am nothing more than a human.”
translation_verse: Shi Petro wo enɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Tee shi, shi mi diɛŋtsɛ hu gbɔmɔ ji mi.”

english_verse: As Peter entered the house, he was still talking with Cornelius. Many people were there,
translation_verse: Ni ekɛ lɛ hiɛ sanegbaa kɛbote shĩa lɛ, ni eyana mɛi pii ni ebabua amɛhe naa lɛ.

english_verse: and Peter said to them, “You know that we Jews are not allowed to have anything to do with other people. But God has shown me that he doesn't think anyone is unclean or unfit.
translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle bɔ ni Yudanyo bɛ hegbɛ akɛ ekɛ mɔ ko ni ji maŋ kroko nɔ nyo bɔɔ aloo ebaa eŋɔɔ; shi mi lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ mi akɛ mikatsɛ mɔ ko mɔ ni he tseee loo mɔ ni buleɔ mɔ.

english_verse: I agreed to come here, but I want to know why you sent for me.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ hu ni be ni atsu abatsɛ mi lɛ, mijieee naa ni miba nɛɛ. Ni agbɛnɛ miibi nyɛ, ‘Mɛɛ sane hewɔ nyɛbakpee mi nɛɛ?’ ”

english_verse: Cornelius answered: Four days ago at about three o'clock in the afternoon I was praying at home. Suddenly a man in bright clothes stood in front of me.
translation_verse: Ni Kornelio kɛɛ akɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ ji gbii ejwɛ aaafee ŋmɛji etɛ̃ mli nɛkɛ pɛ, miisɔle yɛ mishĩa nɛɛ; ni naa, nuu ko ni wo atade kaŋkaŋ badamɔ mihiɛ,

english_verse: He said, “Cornelius, God has heard your prayers, and he knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ, ‘Kornelio, abo osɔlemɔ lɛ toi, ni onijuji ni ofeɔ lɛ hu Nyɔŋmɔ ena.

english_verse: Now send to Joppa for Simon Peter. He is visiting in the home of Simon the leather maker, who lives near the sea.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, tsu kɛya Yopa, ni ayatsɛ Simon ni atsɛɔ lɛ Petro hu lɛ kɛba; eyato Simon wolokpoolɔ lɛ ni shĩa kã ŋshɔ naa lɛ ŋɔɔ.’

english_verse: I sent for you at once, and you have been good enough to come. All of us are here in the presence of the Lord God, so that we can hear what he has to say.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ mitsu oŋɔɔ, ni ofee jogbaŋŋ akɛ oba. No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔyɛ biɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ koni wɔbo nibii fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efã bo akɛ okɛɛ lɛ toi.” Petro shiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Kornelio kɛ eshĩabii lɛ

english_verse: Peter then said: Now I am certain that God treats all people alike.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Petro gbele enaa ni ekɛɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ, miyoo akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jeee mɛiahĩɛiaŋkwɛlɔ;

english_verse: God is pleased with everyone who worships him and does right, no matter what nation they come from.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli lɛ, mɔ ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei ni etsuɔ jalɛnii lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni saa ehiɛ.

english_verse: This is the same message that God gave to the people of Israel, when he sent Jesus Christ, the Lord of all, to offer peace to them.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ tsu akɛ wiemɔ lɛ yahã Israelbii ni etsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ ejaje hejɔlɛ Sanekpakpa etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ. Yesu nɛɛ ji mɛi fɛɛ aNuŋtsɔ.

english_verse: You surely know what happened everywhere in Judea. It all began in Galilee after John had told everyone to be baptized.
translation_verse: Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle sane lɛ ni ba Yudea ni eje shishi kɛjɛ Galilea, yɛ baptisimɔ ni Yohane shiɛ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ,

english_verse: God gave the Holy Spirit and power to Jesus from Nazareth. He was with Jesus, as he went around doing good and healing everyone who was under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ hewalɛ fɔ Yesu ni jɛ Nazaret lɛ mu, ni ekpaa shi efeɔ ekpakpa ni etsaa mɛi fɛɛ ni abonsam haoɔ amɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ lɛ yɛ.

english_verse: We all saw what Jesus did both in Israel and in the city of Jerusalem. Jesus was put to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Ni wɔji nibii fɛɛ ni efee yɛ Yudafoi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ he odasefoi. Amɛsɛŋ lɛ yɛ tso nɔ ni amɛgbe lɛ.

english_verse: But three days later, God raised him to life and let him be seen.
translation_verse: Shi Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, ni ehã ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ;

english_verse: Not everyone saw him. He was seen only by us, who ate and drank with him after he was raised from death. We were the ones God chose to tell others about him.
translation_verse: jeee mɛi lɛ fɛɛ ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ, shi moŋ odasefoi ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehala eto momo lɛ, ni ji wɔ mɛi ni wɔkɛ lɛ ye nii ni wɔkɛ lɛ nu, be ni ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: God told us to announce clearly to the people that Jesus is the one he has chosen to judge the living and the dead.
translation_verse: Ni ewo wɔ kitã akɛ wɔshiɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ ni wɔye odase akɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efã akɛ hiɛkãalɔi kɛ gbohii fɛɛ akojolɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Every one of the prophets has said that all who have faith in Jesus will have their sins forgiven in his name.
translation_verse: Lɛ ehe odase gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ yeɔ, akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ aaana ehe eshai faa yɛ egbɛi lɛ hewɔ.” Jeŋmajiaŋbii ni asɔle klɛŋklɛŋ

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Spirit took control of everyone who was listening.
translation_verse: Be ni Petro wieɔ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ lolo lɛ, Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ba mɛi fɛɛ ni nu wiemɔ lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Some Jewish followers of the Lord had come with Peter, and they were surprised that the Holy Spirit had been given to Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ni heyelɔi abɔ ni jɛ ketiafolɔi ateŋ ni kɛ Petro ba lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe akɛ afɔse Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ nɔkeenɔ lɛ ashwie jeŋmajiaŋbii hu anɔ,

english_verse: Now they were hearing Gentiles speaking unknown languages and praising God. Peter said,
translation_verse: ejaakɛ amɛnu akɛ amɛmiiwie wiemɔi srɔtoi ni amɛmiijaje Nyɔŋmɔ agbojee lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Petro here nɔ akɛ,

english_verse: “These Gentiles have been given the Holy Spirit, just as we have! I am certain that no one would dare stop us from baptizing them.”
translation_verse: “Ani mɔ ko aaanyɛ nu naa atsi, ni akabaptisi mɛnɛɛmɛi ni na Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tamɔ wɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ?”

english_verse: Peter ordered them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ, and they asked him to stay on for a few days.
translation_verse: Ni efã akɛ abaptisi amɛ yɛ Yesu Kristo gbɛi lɛ mli. Kɛkɛ ni amɛkpa lɛ fai akɛ ekɛ amɛ ahi shi gbii fioo ko.

english_verse: The apostles and the followers in Judea heard that Gentiles had accepted God's message.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ bɔfoi lɛ kɛ nyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ Yudea lɛ fɛɛ nu akɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ hu emɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: So when Peter came to Jerusalem, some of the Jewish followers started arguing with him. They wanted Gentile followers to be circumcised, and
translation_verse: Ni be ni Petro ba Yerusalɛm lɛ, mɛi ni jɛ ketiafolɔi ateŋ lɛ kɛ lɛ ná

english_verse: they said, “You stayed in the homes of Gentiles, and you even ate with them!”
translation_verse: amɛkɛɛ, “Otee hii foolɔi aŋɔɔ ni okɛ amɛ yaye nii.”

english_verse: Then Peter told them exactly what had happened:
translation_verse: Shi Petro je shishi ni egba amɛ nibii lɛ fɛɛ ekomekome ekɛɛ,

english_verse: I was in the town of Joppa and was praying when I fell sound asleep and had a vision. I saw heaven open, and something like a huge sheet held by its four corners came down to me.
translation_verse: “Miyɛ Yopa maŋ lɛ mli miisɔle, ni efee tamɔ nɔ ni nɔ enyɔ minɔ, ni mina ninaa ko akɛ nɔ ko jɛ ŋwɛi tamɔ mama kpele ni ahiɛ ekoji ejwɛ lɛ mli aashi kɛmiiba shi, ni eba miŋɔɔ kpaakpa.

english_verse: I heard a voice saying to me, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Ni minu gbee ko hu kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Petro, tee shi, gbee ni oye!’

english_verse: But I said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never taken a bite of anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Shi mikɛɛ, ‘Dabida, Nuŋtsɔ, ejaakɛ nɔ ko ni buleɔ mɔ aloo nɔ ko ni he tseee eyako midaaŋ dã.’

english_verse: The voice from heaven spoke to me again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Shi gbee ni jɛ ŋwɛi lɛ here mi nɔ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsuu he lɛ, kaabu lɛ nɔ ni he tseee.’

english_verse: This happened three times before it was all taken back into heaven.
translation_verse: Afee nakai shii etɛ̃, ni agbala fɛɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: Suddenly three men from Caesarea stood in front of the house where I was staying.
translation_verse: Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ hii etɛ̃ badamɔ shĩa he ni miyɔɔ lɛ agbo lɛ naa ní atsu amɛ kɛjɛ Kaisarea kɛba miŋɔɔ.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit told me to go with them and not to worry. Then six of the Lord's followers went with me to the home of a man
translation_verse: Ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ mikɛ amɛ aya, ni mikashashao shi kwraa; ni nyɛmimɛi ekpaa hu kɛ mi tee, ni wɔyabote nuu lɛ we lɛ.

english_verse: who told us that an angel had appeared to him. The angel had ordered him to send to Joppa for someone named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Ni egba wɔ bɔ ni ena bɔfo lɛ yɛ ewe lɛ ni edamɔ shi eekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Tsu kɛya Yopa ni oyakpee Simon ni atsɛɔ lɛ Petro hu lɛ kɛba,

english_verse: Then Peter would tell him how he and everyone in his house could be saved.
translation_verse: ni eeebakɛɛ bo wiemɔi ni aaatsɔ̃ nɔ ahere bo kɛ owe lɛ fɛɛ yiwala.’

english_verse: After I started speaking, the Holy Spirit was given to them, just as the Spirit had been given to us at the beginning.
translation_verse: Shi be ni mibɔ̃i wiemɔ lɛ, Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ bayi amɛnɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni eyi wɔ hu wɔnɔ tsutsu lɛ.

english_verse: I remembered that the Lord had said, “John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Ni mikai Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Yohane lɛ ekɛ nu baptisi, shi nyɛ lɛ akɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ aaabaptisi nyɛ lɛ.’

english_verse: God gave those Gentiles the same gift that he gave us when we put our faith in the Lord Jesus Christ. So how could I have gone against God?
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehã amɛ nakai nɔkeenɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ ni ehã wɔ ni wɔheɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ nɔ wɔyeɔ lɛ hu lɛ, namɔ ji mi ni manyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naa matsi?”

english_verse: When they heard Peter say this, they stopped arguing and started praising God. They said, “God has now let Gentiles turn to him, and he has given life to them!” The Church in Antioch
translation_verse: Shi be ni amɛnu wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, amɛmua amɛnaa, ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam moŋ amɛkɛɛ, “Belɛ jeŋmaji lɛ hu Nyɔŋmɔ ehã amɛ tsuitsakemɔ ni akɛhere amɛyiwala!” Antiokia Asafo lɛ

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers had been scattered because of the terrible trouble that started when Stephen was killed. They went as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, but they told the message only to the Jews.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni gbɛ shwa yɛ Stefano amanehulu lɛ mli lɛ fo mli kɛtee Foinikia kɛ Kipro kɛ Antiokia tɔ̃ɔ, shi amɛjajeee wiemɔ lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ mɔ ko mɔ ko akɛ ja Yudafoi lɛ kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Some of the followers from Cyprus and Cyrene went to Antioch and started telling Gentiles the good news about the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Shi amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi lɛ, Kiprobii kɛ Kirenebii ji amɛ, ni amɛba Antiokia amɛbawie amɛtsɔ̃ɔ Helabii lɛ hu, ni amɛjaje Nuŋtsɔ Yesu he Sanekpakpa lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.

english_verse: The Lord's power was with them, and many people turned to the Lord and put their faith in him.
translation_verse: Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewalɛ fata amɛhe, ni mɛi babaoo he ye, ni amɛkpale kɛba Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.

english_verse: News of what was happening reached the church in Jerusalem. Then they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
translation_verse: Ni amɛhe sane lɛ bashɛ Yerusalɛm asafo lɛ toiŋ, ni amɛtsu Barnaba kɛtee Antiokia.

english_verse: When Barnabas got there and saw how God had blessed them with undeserved grace, he was very glad. So he begged them to remain faithful to the Lord with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Ni be ni ebashɛ jɛi ni ebana Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ, emii shɛ ehe, ni ewo amɛ fɛɛ ekãa akɛ amɛkɛ tsui ni fiɔ shi akpɛtɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ he.

english_verse: Barnabas was a good man of great faith, and he was filled with the Holy Spirit. Many more people turned to the Lord.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ kpakpa ji Barnaba ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ hemɔkɛyeli. Ni ana mɛi babaoo afata Nuŋtsɔ lɛ asafo lɛ he.

english_verse: He found Saul and brought him to Antioch, where they met with the church for a whole year and taught many of its people. There in Antioch the Lord's followers were first called Christians.
translation_verse: Ni eba mli akɛ amɛkɛ asafo lɛ hi shi afi naakplɔ, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi babaoo anii, ni Antiokia klɛŋklɛŋ awo kaselɔi lɛ agbɛi yɛ akɛ Kristofoi.

english_verse: During this time some prophets from Jerusalem came to Antioch.
translation_verse: Shi nɛkɛ bei nɛɛ amli lɛ, gbalɔi komɛi jɛ Yerusalɛm ba Antiokia.

english_verse: One of them was Agabus. Then with the help of the Spirit, he told that there would be a terrible famine everywhere in the world. And it happened when Claudius was Emperor.
translation_verse: Ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Agabo lɛ te shi damɔ shi, ni etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Mumɔ lɛ naa akɛ hɔmɔ waa baaba jeŋ fɛɛ, ni eba mli nakai yɛ Kaisare Klaudio yinɔ.

english_verse: The followers in Antioch decided to send whatever help they could to the followers in Judea.
translation_verse: Shi kaselɔi lɛ kpɛ mli akɛ amɛaabua nɔ ko naa amɛkɛyahã nyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ Yudea lɛ bɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaanyɛ.

english_verse: So they appointed Barnabas and Saul to take their gifts to the church leaders in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ni amɛfee nakai, ni amɛkɛmaje onukpai lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Barnaba kɛ Saul nine nɔ.

english_verse: At that time King Herod caused terrible suffering for some members of the church.
translation_verse: Nakai bei lɛ amli nɔŋŋ lɛ, maŋtsɛ Herode kpã enine mli eta Kristo asafo lɛ he koni efee asafo lɛ mli bii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi efɔŋ.

english_verse: He ordered soldiers to cut off the head of James, the brother of John.
translation_verse: Ni ekɛ klante gbe Yohane nyɛmi Yakobo.

english_verse: When Herod saw that this pleased the Jewish people, he had Peter arrested during the Festival of Thin Bread.
translation_verse: Ni be ni ena akɛ eŋɔɔ Yudafoi lɛ anaa lɛ, etee nɔ ni emɔ Petro hu. Shi akpiti Gbii lɛ amli ni.

english_verse: He put Peter in jail and ordered four squads of soldiers to guard him. Herod planned to put him on trial in public after the festival.
translation_verse: Ni be ni emɔ lɛ lɛ, ewo lɛ tsuŋ, ni etu lɛ ewo asraafoi akui ejwɛ ni mɛi ejwɛɛjwɛ yɔɔ mli dɛŋ ni amɛbu ehe; ni esusu akɛ Hehoo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ eeejie lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ.

english_verse: While Peter was being kept in jail, the church never stopped praying to God for him. Peter Is Rescued
translation_verse: Be mli ni atsi Petro naa yɛ tsu lɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ, asafo lɛ hiɛ sɔlemɔ mli kɛ lɛ hãmɔ waa diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. Bɔfo ko jie Petro

english_verse: The night before Peter was to be put on trial, he was asleep and bound by two chains. A soldier was guarding him on each side, and two other soldiers were guarding the entrance to the jail.
translation_verse: Shi gbi ni Herode taoɔ akɛ ekɛ Petro aba maŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, ekã asraafoi enyɔ teŋ eewɔ, ni awo lɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi enyɔ, ni bulɔi hu damɔ shinaa lɛ naa amɛmiibu tsu lɛ he.

english_verse: Suddenly an angel from the Lord appeared, and light flashed around in the cell. The angel poked Peter in the side and woke him up. Then he said, “Quick! Get up!” The chains fell off his hands,
translation_verse: Ni naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo ko badamɔ emasɛi, ni la kpɛ yɛ tsu lɛ mli ni egba Petro ŋmawu ma ni etsiɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Tee shi mramra!” Ni ekɔsɔŋkɔsɔi lɛ kpɔlɔ yɛ eniji.

english_verse: and the angel said, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” Peter did what he was told. Then the angel said, “Now put on your coat and follow me.”
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Miamɔ ni owo otokotai lɛ!” Ni efee nakai. Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛ obo lɛ akete ohe ni onyiɛ misɛɛ.”

english_verse: Peter left with the angel, but he thought everything was only a dream.
translation_verse: Ni enyiɛ esɛɛ kɛje kpo, ni eleee akɛ nɔ ni bɔfo lɛ feɔ lɛ yɛ mli, shi efeɔ lɛ akɛ nii enaa.

english_verse: They went past the two groups of soldiers, and when they came to the iron gate to the city, it opened by itself. They went out and were going along the street, when all at once the angel disappeared.
translation_verse: Shi be ni amɛho klɛŋklɛŋ bulɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni ji enyɔ lɛ ahe lɛ, amɛshɛ dade agbo ni kã kɛyaa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ he, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbele ehe ehã amɛ, ni amɛje kpo ni amɛfo blohu kome mli, ni amrɔ lɛ bɔfo lɛ shi lɛ.

english_verse: Peter now realized what had happened, and he said, “I am certain that the Lord sent his angel to rescue me from Herod and from everything the Jewish leaders planned to do to me.”
translation_verse: Ni be ni Petro hiɛ tserɛ lɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Kpaako mina mile krɛdɛɛ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ etsu ebɔfo lɛ kɛba, ni ebajie mi yɛ Herode dɛŋ kɛ nɔ ni Yudafoi lɛ amaŋ lɛ kwɛɔ gbɛ lɛ fɛɛ mli.”

english_verse: Then Peter went to the house of Mary the mother of John whose other name was Mark. Many of the Lord's followers had come together there and were praying.
translation_verse: Ni be ni eyɔse enɛ lɛ, eba Yohane ni atsɛɔ lɛ Marko hu lɛ nyɛ Maria we lɛ, he ni mɛi pii anaa ebakpe shi ni amɛsɔleɔ yɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Peter knocked on the gate, and a servant named Rhoda came to answer.
translation_verse: Ni be ni Petro shi agbo lɛ, oblayoo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Roda lɛ ba toiboo;

english_verse: When she heard Peter's voice, she was too excited to open the gate. She ran back into the house and said Peter was standing there.
translation_verse: ni be ni eyoo Petro gbee lɛ, miishɛɛ sɔŋŋ naa lɛ egbeleee agbo lɛ, shi moŋ ejo foi kɛtee tsu lɛ mli eyakɛɛ akɛ Petro damɔ agbo lɛ sɛɛ.

english_verse: “You are crazy!” everyone told her. But she kept saying it was Peter. Then they said, “It must be his angel.”
translation_verse: Shi amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Oye sɛkɛ!” Shi ema nɔ mi akɛ eyɛ mli nakai. Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Belɛ ebɔfo ni.”

english_verse: But Peter kept on knocking, until finally they opened the gate. They saw him and were completely amazed.
translation_verse: Shi Petro kã he eeshi; ni be ni amɛgbele lɛ, amɛna lɛ, ni amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe.

english_verse: Peter motioned for them to keep quiet. Then he told how the Lord had led him out of jail. He also said, “Tell James and the others what has happened.” After that, he left and went somewhere else.
translation_verse: Shi efɔ̃ amɛ nine akɛ amɛfee dioo, ni egba amɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fee ni ejie lɛ yɛ tsu lɛ mli lɛ; ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyagbaa Yakobo kɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ.” Ni eje jɛi etee he kroko.

english_verse: The next morning the soldiers who had been on guard were terribly worried and wondered what had happened to Peter.
translation_verse: Shi be ni je tsɛre lɛ, yoyoromɔ ni asraafoi lɛ yoyoro yɛ le ni amɛleee nɔ ni eba Petro nɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, jeee hiɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Herod ordered his own soldiers to search for him, but they could not find him. Then he questioned the guards and had them put to death. After this, Herod left Judea to stay in Caesarea for a while. Herod Dies
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ be ni Herode taoɔ lɛ ni enaaa lɛ lɛ, ekojo bulɔi lɛ ni efã akɛ ayagbe amɛ. Ni Herode je Yudea etee Kaisarea ni eyahi jɛi. Herode gbele

english_verse: Herod and the people of Tyre and Sidon were very angry with each other. But their country got its food supply from the region that he ruled. So a group of them went to see Blastus, who was one of Herod's high officials. They convinced Blastus that they wanted to make peace between their cities and Herod,
translation_verse: Shi Herode mli efu Tirobii kɛ Sidonbii lɛ naakpa; no hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome ba eŋɔɔ, ni amɛbatao maŋtsɛ lɛ piafonyo ni gbɛi ji Blasto lɛ hiɛgbɛ ni amɛyakpa hejɔlɛ he fai, ejaakɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛnaa amɛniyenii kɛjɛɔ.

english_verse: and a day was set for them to meet with him. Herod came dressed in his royal robes. He sat down on his throne and made a speech.
translation_verse: Gbi ni ato ko nɔ lɛ Herode wo emaŋtsɛ atade lɛ ni eyata kojomɔ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ maŋ lɛ wie.

english_verse: The people shouted, “You speak more like a god than a man!”
translation_verse: Ni mɛi lɛ bolɔ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ gbee nɛ, shi jeee gbɔmɔ gbee ni.”

english_verse: At once an angel from the Lord struck him down because he took the honor that belonged to God. Later, Herod was eaten by worms and died.
translation_verse: Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo tswa lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ ekɛ anunyam lɛ hãaa Nyɔŋmɔ, ni gɔgɔmii ye lɛ, ni egbo.

english_verse: God's message kept spreading.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni egbɛ eshwã eshwere.

english_verse: And after Barnabas and Saul had done the work they were sent to do, they went back to Jerusalem with John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Be ni Barnaba kɛ Saul egbe amɛsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ naa lɛ, amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm ni amɛŋɔ Yohane, mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Marko hu lɛ, amɛfata amɛhe.

english_verse: The church at Antioch had several prophets and teachers. They were Barnabas, Simeon, also called Niger, Lucius from Cyrene, Manaen, who was Herod's close friend, and Saul.
translation_verse: Shi gbalɔi kɛ tsɔɔlɔi komɛi yɛ Antiokia asafo lɛ mli, amɛ ji Barnaba kɛ Simeon, mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Niger hu lɛ, kɛ Lukio, Kirenenyo lɛ, kɛ Manahen, mɔ ni alɛ lɛ kɛ lumɔ Herode lɛ kɛ Saul.

english_verse: While they were worshiping the Lord and going without eating, the Holy Spirit told them, “Appoint Barnabas and Saul to do the work for which I have chosen them.”
translation_verse: Shi be ni amɛjaa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni amɛhiɔ ŋmaa lɛ, Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ, “Nyɛjiea Barnaba kɛ Saul nyɛhãa mi kɛhã nitsumɔ ni mitsɛ amɛ yɛ hewɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: After Barnabas and Saul had been sent by the Holy Spirit, they went to Seleucia. From there they sailed to the island of Cyprus.
translation_verse: Akɛni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ etsu Saul kɛ Barnaba akɛ amɛya lɛ, amɛyiŋ amɛtee Seleukia, ni amɛkɛ lɛlɛ jɛ jɛi kɛtee Kipro.

english_verse: They arrived at Salamis and began to preach God's message in the synagogues. They also had John as a helper.
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛshɛ Salami lɛ, amɛjaje Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ yɛ Yudafoi lɛ akpeehei lɛ. Amɛkɛ Yohane hu nyiɛ akɛ amɛsɔ̃ɔlɔ.

english_verse: Barnabas and Saul went all the way to the city of Paphos on the other end of the island, where they met a Jewish man named Bar-Jesus. He practiced witchcraft and was a false prophet.
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛfo mli kɛtsɔ̃ ŋshɔkpɔ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kɛtee Pafo lɛ, amɛna Yudanyo ŋkunyaayelɔ ko ni ji amale gbalɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Bar-Yesu lɛ;

english_verse: He also worked for Sergius Paulus, who was very smart and was the governor of the island. Sergius Paulus wanted to hear God's message, and he sent for Barnabas and Saul.
translation_verse: ekɛ amralo Sergio Paulo ni ji nuu nilelɔ lɛ yɔɔ. Amralo nɛɛ tsɛ Barnaba kɛ Saul kɛba eŋɔɔ, eetao akɛ enu Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ.

english_verse: But Bar-Jesus, whose other name was Elymas, was against them. He even tried to keep the governor from having faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Shi Elima ŋkunyaayelɔ lɛ ku amɛnaa, ejaakɛ eetao ni ekpale amralo lɛ kɛjɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ he.

english_verse: Then Saul, better known as Paul, was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked straight at Elymas
translation_verse: Shi Saul, mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Paulo hu, ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ eyi lɛ obɔ̃ lɛ, kwɛ Elima gãa

english_verse: and said, “You son of the devil! You are a liar, a crook, and an enemy of everything that is right. When will you stop speaking against the true ways of the Lord?
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ, “Ao, bo abonsam bi ni shishiumɔ kɛ kutumpɔo fɛɛ eyi bo obɔ̃, bo jalɛ fɛɛ henyɛlɔ, aso ofɔŋ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi trɔmɔi lɛ akɔdɔmɔ̃?

english_verse: The Lord is going to punish you by making you completely blind for a while.” Suddenly the man's eyes were covered by a dark mist, and he went around trying to get someone to lead him by the hand.
translation_verse: Naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nine kã onɔ, ni oooshwila ni onaŋ hulu kɛyaashi be ko.” Ni amrɔ̃ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ afua kɛ duŋ baha enɔ, ni egbugbuu shi eetao mɔ ko amɔ enine mli ayajie lɛ gbɛ.

english_verse: When the governor saw what had happened, he was amazed at this teaching about the Lord. So he put his faith in the Lord. Paul and Barnabas in Antioch of Pisidia
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ, be ni amralo lɛ na nɔ ni afee lɛ, ehe eye, ni ehe jɔ̃ ehe yɛ nɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ he lɛ hewɔ. Paulo kɛ Barnaba yɛ Antiokia

english_verse: Paul and the others left Paphos and sailed to Perga in Pamphylia. But John left them and went back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Shi be ni Paulo kɛ emɛi lɛ fã kɛjɛ Pafo lɛ, amɛkɛ lɛlɛ ba Perga yɛ Pamfilia; ni Yohane shi amɛ, ni eku esɛɛ kɛtee Yerusalɛm ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: The rest of them went on from Perga to Antioch in Pisidia. Then on the Sabbath they went to the synagogue and sat down.
translation_verse: Shi amɛ lɛ amɛfo mli kɛjɛ Perga kɛtee Antiokia ni yɔɔ Pisidia lɛ, ni amɛtee kpeehe lɛ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyatara shi.

english_verse: After the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the leaders sent someone over to tell Paul and Barnabas, “Friends, if you have anything to say that will help the people, please say it.”
translation_verse: Ni be ni akane Mose Mla lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, kpeehe lɛ onukpai lɛ tsu abakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anyɛmimɛi, kɛji nyɛyɛ hewalɛwoo wiemɔ ko kɛhã mɛi lɛ, nyɛkɛ amɛ awiea.”

english_verse: Paul got up. He motioned with his hand and said: People of Israel, and everyone else who worships God, listen!
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Paulo te shi edamɔ shi, ni efɔ̃ enine ekɛɛ, “Ataamɛi Israelhii kɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛsheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, nyɛboa toi!

english_verse: The God of Israel chose our ancestors, and he let our people prosper while they were living in Egypt. Then with his mighty power he led them out,
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ maŋ Israel nɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hala wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ, ni be ni amɛyato gbɔ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ewo maŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ hewalɛ jie amɛ kɛjɛ jɛi.

english_verse: Make sure what the prophets have said doesn't happen to you. They said,
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni ahia, koni nɔ ni awie yɛ gbalɔi lɛ amli lɛ akaba nyɛnɔ akɛ,

english_verse: He destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan and gave their land to our people.
translation_verse: ni ekpãtã jeŋmaji kpawo ahiɛ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eja amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ ehã amɛ akɛ amɛnɔ.

english_verse: Later, God removed Saul and let David rule in his place. God said about him, “David the son of Jesse is the kind of person who pleases me most! He does everything I want him to do.”
translation_verse: Ni be ni ekpa lɛ lɛ, etee David shi ni ewo lɛ amɛnɔ maŋtsɛ, ni eye ehe odase ekɛɛ, ‘Mina David, Ishai bi lɛ, nuu ni miyɔɔ ehe tsui ni eeefee misuɔmɔnaanii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.’

english_verse: God promised that someone from David's family would come to save the people of Israel, and this one is Jesus.
translation_verse: Mɔ nɛ shwie mli Nyɔŋmɔ jie Yesu kɛjɛ yɛ shiwoo lɛ naa ehã Israel akɛ yiwalaherelɔ.

english_verse: But before Jesus came, John was telling everyone in Israel to turn back to God and be baptized.
translation_verse: Dani Yesu ba lɛ, Yohane eshiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui ni abaptisi amɛ.

english_verse: Then, when John's work was almost done, he said, “Who do you people think I am? Do you think I am the Promised One? He will come later, and I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: Ni be ni Yohane egbe enitsumɔ lɛ naa etã lɛ, ekɛɛ, ‘Namɔ nyɛsusuɔ akɛ mi ji? Jeee mi ji lɛ; shi naa, mɔ ko miiba yɛ misɛɛ ni misaaa mɔ ni fɛneɔ etokotai yɛ enaji.’

english_verse: Now listen, you descendants of Abraham! Pay attention, all of you Gentiles who are here to worship God! Listen to this message about how to be saved, because it is for everyone.
translation_verse: “Ataamɛi kɛ anyɛmimɛi, Abraham shwiei kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔi ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ, wɔ atsu akɛ nɛkɛ yiwalaheremɔ sane nɛɛ bahã.”

english_verse: The people of Jerusalem and their leaders didn't realize who Jesus was. And they didn't understand the words of the prophets they read each Sabbath. So they condemned Jesus just as the prophets had said.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ kɛ amɛmaŋ onukpai lɛ, akɛni amɛleee Yesu, ni asaŋ amɛnuuu gbalɔi lɛ awiemɔi ni akaneɔ hejɔɔmɔ gbi fɛɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi nɔ lɛ ashishi hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛfɔ ni amɛbu lɛ lɛ ehã gbalɔi lɛ awiemɔi lɛ eba mli.

english_verse: They did exactly what the Scriptures said they would. Even though they couldn't find any reason to put Jesus to death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed. After Jesus had been put to death, he was taken down from the cross and placed in a tomb.
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛhã nibii fɛɛ ni aŋma yɛ ehe lɛ eba mli lɛ, amɛ jie lɛ yɛ tso lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyato lɛ yɛ gbonyobu ko mli.

english_verse: But God raised him from death!
translation_verse: Shi Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ;

english_verse: Then for many days Jesus appeared to his followers who had gone with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. Now they are telling our people about him.
translation_verse: Ni ejie ehe kpo gbii pii etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ jɛ Galilea ba Yerusalɛm lɛ, ni amɛ ji odasefoi ha maŋ lɛ.

english_verse: God made a promise to our ancestors. And we are here to tell you the good news
translation_verse: Ni wɔ lɛ, shi ni ewo wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ wɔjajeɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɛɛ,

english_verse: that he has kept this promise to us. It is just as the second Psalm says about Jesus, “You are my son because today I have become your Father.”
translation_verse: akɛ no nɔŋŋ Nyɔŋmɔ ehã eba mli ehã wɔ ni wɔji amɛbii lɛ, akɛni etee Yesu shi, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ lala ni ji enyɔ lɛ mli hu akɛ, ‘Mi-Bi ji bo; ŋmɛnɛ mifɔ bo lɛ.’

english_verse: God raised Jesus from death and will never let his body decay. It is just as God said, “I will make to you the same holy promises that I made to David.”
translation_verse: “Shi akɛni etee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ ni ekuŋ esɛɛ kɛyaŋ fitemɔ mli dɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Maŋɔ David dromɔnii krɔŋkrɔŋi ni he shiwoo ma shi shiŋŋ lɛ mahã nyɛ.’

english_verse: And in another psalm it says, “God will never let the body of his Holy One decay.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ hu ni ekɛɛ yɛ he kroko akɛ, ‘Ohaŋ omɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ana fitemɔ’ lɛ.

english_verse: When David was alive, he obeyed God. Then after he died, he was buried in the family grave, and his body decayed.
translation_verse: “Ejaakɛ David lɛ, be ni esɔ̃mɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo naa yɛ eyinɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ mli ewɔ, ni aŋɔ lɛ afata etsɛmɛi lɛ ahe, ni ena fitemɔ.

english_verse: But God raised Jesus from death, and his body did not decay.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi lɛ, enaaa fitemɔ.

english_verse: My friends, the message is that Jesus can forgive your sins! The Law of Moses could not set you free from all your sins.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi hii, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ mɔ nɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ ajajeɔ eshaifaa atsɔɔ nyɛ lɛ; ni nibii fɛɛ ni anyɛŋ abu nyɛ bem yɛ he yɛ Mose Mla lɛ naa lɛ,

english_verse: But everyone who has faith in Jesus is set free.
translation_verse: mɔ nɛ mli lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ, abuɔ lɛ bem.

english_verse: “Look, you people who make fun of God! Be amazed and disappear. I will do something today that you won't believe, even if someone tells you about it!”
translation_verse: ‘Nyɛkwɛa, nyɛ heguɔgbelɔi, ni nyɛhiɛ afea nyɛ yaa, ni nyɛhiɛ akpãtãa, ejaakɛ mibatsu nitsumɔ ko yɛ nyɛyinɔ, nitsumɔ ko ni kɛ mɔ ko gba nyɛ tete lɛ, nyɛheŋ nyɛyeŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.’ ”

english_verse: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people begged them to say more about these same things on the next Sabbath.
translation_verse: Shi be ni amɛje kpeehe lɛ, mɛi lɛ kpa amɛ fai akɛ amɛbajaje nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ ekoŋŋ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi ni nyiɛ no sɛɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: After the service, many Jews and a lot of Gentiles who worshiped God went with them. Paul and Barnabas begged them all to remain faithful to God, who had treated them with undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Ni be ni mɛi ni yɔɔ kpeehe lɛ ekpa lɛ, Yudafoi kɛ mɛi ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei ni emɔ Yudafoi lɛ ajamɔ lɛ mli lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ, ni Paulo kɛ Barnaba wie tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni amɛwo amɛ ŋaa akɛ amɛhi Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: When the Jewish people saw the crowds, they were very jealous. They insulted Paul and spoke against everything he said.
translation_verse: Shi be ni Yudafoi lɛ na asafoi lɛ, awuŋayeli yi amɛ obɔ̃, ni amɛkɛ musubɔɔ wiemɔi wie shi nii ni Paulo wieɔ lɛ.

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas bravely said: We had to tell God's message to you before we told it to anyone else. But you rejected the message! This proves that you don't deserve eternal life. Now we are going to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ni Paulo kɛ Barnaba wie kɛ ekãa amɛkɛɛ, “Kulɛ nyɛ tsutsu esa akɛ ajaje Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ; shi akɛni nyɛŋwã wiemɔ lɛ ni nyɛbuuu nyɛhe akɛ nyɛsa naanɔ wala lɛ hewɔ lɛ, naa, wɔdɔ wɔyi kɛmiiya jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ aŋɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has given us this command, “I have placed you here as a light for the Gentiles. You are to take the saving power of God to people everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nakai Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wo wɔ kitã akɛ, ‘Miŋɔ bo midamɔ shi akɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ala, koni otsɔ̃ yiwalaheremɔ kɛyashi shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbee hei lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: This message made the Gentiles glad, and they praised what they had heard about the Lord. Everyone who had been chosen for eternal life then put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Shi be ni jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ nu enɛ lɛ amɛna miishɛɛ, ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam, ni mɛi abɔ ni ajie ato naanɔ wala lɛ he ye.

english_verse: The message about the Lord spread all over this region.
translation_verse: Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ gbɛ shwã yɛ jɛi niiaŋ fɛɛ.

english_verse: But the Jewish leaders went to some of the important men in the town and to some respected women who were religious. They turned them against Paul and Barnabas and started making trouble for them. They even chased them out of this part of the country.
translation_verse: Shi Yudafoi lɛ wowoo yei Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔi ni abuɔ amɛ lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ mli hiɛnaanɔbii lɛ ayiŋ, ni amɛbɔ̃i Paulo kɛ Barnaba yiwaa ni amɛshwie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛkpokpai lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas shook the dust from that place off their feet and went on to the city of Iconium.
translation_verse: Shi amɛ lɛ amɛkpokpo amɛnajiashi mlu amɛshwie amɛnɔ, ni amɛyiŋ kɛtee Ikonium.

english_verse: But the Lord's followers in Antioch were very happy and were filled with the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ni kaselɔi lɛ yimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas spoke in the synagogue in Iconium, just as they had done at Antioch, and many Jews and Gentiles put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Yɛ Ikonium nɛɛ hu Paulo kɛ Barnaba tee Yudafoi lɛ akpeehe lɛ ni amɛyawie amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ bɔ ni ehã Yudafoi lɛ kɛ Helabii lɛ ateŋ mɛi babaoo he ye.

english_verse: But the Jews who did not have faith in him made the other Gentiles angry and turned them against the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Shi Yudafoi ni heee wiemɔ lɛ yeee lɛ wo jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ ayiŋ koni amɛte shi amɛwo nyɛmimɛi lɛ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas stayed there for a while, having faith in the Lord and bravely speaking his message. The Lord gave them the power to work miracles and wonders, and he showed that their message about his gift of undeserved grace was true.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, bɔfoi lɛ tsɛ yɛ jɛi ni amɛkɛ ekãa wie Nuŋtsɔ lɛ he, ni lɛ hu ehã atsɔ̃ amɛnine nɔ afee okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii pii ekɛye edromɔ wiemɔ lɛ he odase.

english_verse: The people of Iconium did not know what to think. Some of them believed the Jewish group, and others believed the apostles.
translation_verse: Shi maŋ lɛ mli bii lɛ amli gba enyɔ, fã fata Yudafoi lɛ ahe, ni fã hu fata bɔfoi lɛ ahe.

english_verse: Finally, some Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, decided to make trouble for Paul and Barnabas and to stone them to death.
translation_verse: Shi be ni jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ kɛ Yudafoi lɛ kɛ amɛnukpai lɛ bu kɛba ni amɛbafee amɛ niseniianii koni amɛbatswia amɛ tɛ lɛ,

english_verse: In Lystra there was a man who had been born with paralyzed feet and had never been able to walk.
translation_verse: Nuu ko yɛ Listra ni eji obubuafo kɛjɛ enyɛ musuŋ beebe ni enyiɛko dã, shi shi etaa.

english_verse: The man was listening to Paul speak, when Paul saw that he had faith in Jesus and could be healed. So he looked straight at the man
translation_verse: Ni be ni Paulo wieɔ lɛ, ebo toi. Paulo kwɛ lɛ gãa ni ena akɛ eyɛ hemɔkɛyeli akɛ aaatsa lɛ,

english_verse: and shouted, “Stand up!” The man jumped up and started walking around.
translation_verse: hewɔ lɛ ekɛ gbee ni wa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi odamɔ onaji lɛ anɔ trɔmɔɔ!” Ni ehuru eyi shi ni enyiɛ.

english_verse: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they yelled out in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have turned into humans and have come down to us!”
translation_verse: Ni be ni asafoi lɛ na nɔ ni Paulo efee lɛ, amɛwo amɛgbee nɔ yɛ Likaonia wiemɔ lɛ mli amɛkɛɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔi lɛ etsɔ̃mɔ amɛhe gbɔmɛi kɛyimɔ shi kɛba wɔŋɔɔ!”

english_verse: The people then gave Barnabas the name Zeus, and they gave Paul the name Hermes, because he did the talking.
translation_verse: Ni amɛtsɛ Barnaba akɛ Dio, kɛ Paulo hu akɛ Herme, ejaakɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni wieɔ amɛnaa.

english_verse: The temple of Zeus was near the entrance to the city. Its priest and the crowds wanted to offer a sacrifice to Barnabas and Paul. So the priest brought some bulls and flowers to the city gates.
translation_verse: Shi Dio amãgã ni yɔɔ amɛmaŋ lɛ mli agbo lɛ naa lɛ osɔfo lɛ hiɛ tsinahii kɛ nyanyrã akekrei kɛba agbo lɛ naa, lɛ kɛ asafo lɛ miitao amɛshã afɔle.

english_verse: When the two apostles found out about this, they tore their clothes in horror and ran to the crowd, shouting:
translation_verse: Shi be ni bɔfoi lɛ ni ji Barnaba kɛ Paulo nu he lɛ, amɛgbala amɛtadei ni amɛsha foi amɛyabote asafo lɛ teŋ amɛhiɛ blɔmɔ akɛ,

english_verse: Why are you doing this? We are humans just like you. Please give up all this foolishness. Turn to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: “Ataamɛi, mɛni nyɛfeɔ nɛɛ? Wɔ hu gbɔmɛi adesai ji wɔ tamɔ nyɛ nɔŋŋ, ni wɔmiijaje Sanekpakpa wɔmiitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, koni nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ nɛkɛ yakayakanii nɛɛ ahe kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, mɔ ni fee ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ.

english_verse: In times past, God let each nation go its own way.
translation_verse: Yinɔi ni eho lɛ amli lɛ ehã jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ nyiɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbɛi lɛ anɔ,

english_verse: But he showed he was there by the good things he did. God sends rain from heaven and makes your crops grow. He gives food to you and makes your hearts glad.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ efɔɔɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe odaseyeli, shi moŋ efeɔ ejurɔ ni ehãa nu jɛɔ ŋwɛi nɛɔ hãa nyɛ, kɛ bei ni nii baa pii hu, ni ehãa nyɛtɔrɔɔ, ni miishɛɛ yiɔ nyɛtsuiiaŋ obɔ̃bɔ̃.”

english_verse: Even after Paul and Barnabas had said all this, they could hardly keep the people from offering a sacrifice to them.
translation_verse: Ni ekpakpa ko dani amɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ tsi afɔle ni kulɛ mɛi lɛ baashã ahã amɛ lɛ naa.

english_verse: Some Jewish leaders from Antioch and Iconium came and turned the crowds against Paul. They hit him with stones and dragged him out of the city, thinking he was dead.
translation_verse: Shi Yudafoi komɛi jɛ Antiokia kɛ Ikonium ba jɛi bawo asafoi lɛ ayiŋ, ni amɛtswia Paulo tɛi, ni amɛgbala lɛ kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli ejaakɛ amɛsusu akɛ egbo.

english_verse: But when the Lord's followers gathered around Paul, he stood up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas went to Derbe. Paul and Barnabas Return to Antioch in Syria
translation_verse: Shi be ni kaselɔi lɛ babɔle ehe kɛkpe lɛ, ete shi ni etee maŋ lɛ mli. Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, ekɛ Barnaba yiŋ kɛtee Derbe. Paulo kɛ Barnaba ba Antiokia ekoŋŋ

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas preached the good news in Derbe and won some people to the Lord. Then they went back to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch in Pisidia.
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛjaje Sanekpakpa lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Derbe ni amɛfee mɛi pii kaselɔi lɛ, amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Listra kɛ Ikonium kɛ Antiokia.

english_verse: They encouraged the followers and begged them to remain faithful. They told them, “We have to suffer a lot before we can get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Amɛsaa amɛwo kaselɔi lɛ amumɔŋ hewalɛ, ni amɛwie amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, akɛ amɛhiɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli, ni asaŋ esa akɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ amanehului pii amli kɛboteɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas chose some leaders for each of the churches. Then they went without eating and prayed that the Lord would take good care of these leaders who had trusted in the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni amɛfãmɔ onukpai amɛto asafo fɛɛ asafo nɔ, ni amɛkɛ sɔlemɔ kɛ ŋmaahilɛ tu amɛ amɛwo Nuŋtsɔ, mɔ nɔ ni amɛhe amɛye lɛ dɛŋ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas went on through Pisidia to Pamphylia,
translation_verse: Ni amɛfo mli kɛtsɔ̃ Pisidia kɛba Pamfilia.

english_verse: where they preached in the town of Perga. Then they went down to Attalia
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛjaje wiemɔ lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Perga lɛ, amɛkɛshwie nɔ kɛba Atalia.

english_verse: and sailed to Antioch in Syria. It was there that they had been placed in God's care for the work they had now completed.
translation_verse: Ni amɛbote lɛlɛ mli yɛ jɛi, ni amɛfã kɛba Antiokia, he ni atu amɛ awo Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ dɛŋ kɛhã nitsumɔ ni amɛtsu amɛgbe naa nɛɛ yɛ lɛ.

english_verse: After arriving in Antioch, they called the church together. They told the people what God had helped them do and how he had made it possible for the Gentiles to believe.
translation_verse: Shi be ni amɛba jɛi ni amɛbabua asafo lɛ naa lɛ, amɛgba amɛ nii ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ amɛ eyatsu lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ bɔ ni egbele gbɛ ehã jeŋmaji lɛ ni amɛhe amɛye lɛ.

english_verse: Then they stayed there with the followers for a long time.
translation_verse: Ni amɛkɛ kaselɔi lɛ hi shi gbii kplaŋŋ.

english_verse: Some people came from Judea and started teaching the Lord's followers that they could not be saved, unless they were circumcised as Moses had taught.
translation_verse: Ni mɛi komɛi jɛ Yudea ba ni amɛbatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji afolɔɔɔ nyɛ ketia yɛ gbɛnaa ni Mose eto lɛ naa lɛ, anyɛŋ nyɛyiwala ahere.”

english_verse: This caused trouble, and Paul and Barnabas argued with them about this teaching. So it was decided to send Paul and Barnabas and a few others to Jerusalem to discuss this problem with the apostles and the church leaders. The Church Leaders Meet in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ni be ni Paulo kɛ Barnaba kɛ amɛ taa naa ni amɛkɛ amɛ je ŋwane aahu lɛ, nyɛmimɛi lɛ to akɛ Paulo kɛ Barnaba kɛ amɛteŋ mɛi krokomɛi hu aya bɔfoi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: The men who were sent by the church went through Phoenicia and Samaria, telling how the Gentiles had turned to God. This news made the Lord's followers very happy.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, be ni asafo lɛ ebajie amɛ gbɛ lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ Foinikia kɛ Samaria ni amɛgba jeŋmaji lɛ atsakemɔ lɛ, ni amɛkɛhã nyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ na miishɛɛ naakpa.

english_verse: When the men arrived in Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church, including the apostles and the leaders. They told them everything God had helped them do.
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛshɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ, asafo lɛ kɛ bɔfoi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ here amɛ atuu, ni mɛi ni atsu lɛ gba amɛ nibii ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ amɛ etsu lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: But some Pharisees had become followers of the Lord. They stood up and said, “Gentiles who have faith in the Lord must be circumcised and told to obey the Law of Moses.”
translation_verse: Shi mɛi komɛi ni jɛ Farisifoi lɛ akuu lɛ mli ni ehe eye lɛ te shi amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Ja afolɔ amɛ ketia ni awo amɛ kitã akɛ amɛye Mose Mla lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: The apostles and church leaders met to discuss this problem about Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfoi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ babua amɛhe naa, koni amɛtao nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ mli.

english_verse: They had talked it over for a long time, when Peter got up and said: My friends, you know that God decided long ago to let me be the one from your group to preach the good news to the Gentiles. God did this so they would hear and obey him.
translation_verse: Shi be ni amɛyiyii aahu lɛ, Petro te shi damɔ shi, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anyɛmimɛi hii, nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle akɛ jeeŋmɔ beebe Nyɔŋmɔ hala wɔmli, ni eto akɛ minaa jeŋmaji lɛ anu Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ ni amɛhe amɛye.

english_verse: He knows what is in everyone's heart. And he showed he had chosen the Gentiles, when he gave them the Holy Spirit, just as he had given his Spirit to us.
translation_verse: Ni Nyɔŋmɔ ni le tsuiiaŋ lɛ hã amɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ehã wɔ lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ nɔ,

english_verse: God treated them in the same way that he treated us. They put their faith in him, and he made their hearts pure.
translation_verse: ni ejieee niiaŋ yɛ wɔ kɛ amɛ teŋ, ejaakɛ ekɛ hemɔkɛyeli tsuɔ amɛtsuii ahe.

english_verse: Now why are you trying to make God angry by placing a heavy burden on these followers? This burden was too heavy for us or our ancestors.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ mɛɛba nyɛkaa Nyɔŋmɔ, ni nyɛkɛ kɔŋtso ni wɔji o, wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ji o, wɔnyɛɛɛ wɔtere lɛ fɔ̃ɔ kaselɔi lɛ akɔŋ?

english_verse: But we believe that we will be saved by the gift of undeserved grace from our Lord Jesus Christ, just as the Gentiles are.
translation_verse: Shi wɔheɔ wɔyeɔ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu dromɔ lɛ nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ ahereɔ wɔyiwala tamɔ amɛ nɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: Everyone kept quiet and listened as Barnabas and Paul told how God had given them the power to work a lot of miracles and wonders for the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ fee diŋŋ ni amɛbo Barnaba kɛ Paulo ni gbaa amɛ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii abɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ amɛnɔ efee yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ amli lɛ atoi.

english_verse: After they had finished speaking, James said: My friends, listen to me!
translation_verse: Be ni amɛwie amɛgbe naa lɛ, Yakobo here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Anyɛmimɛi hii, nyɛboa mi toi.

english_verse: Simon Peter has told how God first came to the Gentiles and made some of them his own people.
translation_verse: Simeon egba bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ basara jeŋmaji lɛ tsutsu ko ni ehala maŋ kɛjɛ amɛteŋ ehã egbɛi lɛ.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will return and rebuild David's fallen house. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again.
translation_verse: ‘Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ maku misɛɛ maba, ni masaa David buu ni egbee shi lɛ mama shi; ni etsukoi lɛ hu matswa ekoŋŋ, ni matee lɛ shi mama shi.

english_verse: Then other nations will turn to me and be my chosen ones. I, the Lord, say this.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni afee ni gbɔmɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ ni akɛ migbɛi ewo amɛ lɛ atao Nuŋtsɔ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ.’

english_verse: I promised it long ago.”
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni hã ale enɛ kɛjɛ teteete lɛ kɛɛ.

english_verse: And so, my friends, I don't think we should place burdens on the Gentiles who are turning to God.
translation_verse: “No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji akɛ akagba mɛi ni eku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ jeŋmaji lɛ amli kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ anaa tuutu;

english_verse: We must remember that the Law of Moses has been preached in city after city for many years, and every Sabbath it is read in our synagogues. A Letter to Gentiles Who Had Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ blema beebe lɛ Mose yɛ mɛi ni shiɛɔ lɛ yɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ nɔ, ni daa hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ akaneɔ ewoji lɛ yɛ kpeehei lɛ.” Wolo ni jɛ kpee lɛ mli

english_verse: The apostles, the leaders, and all the church members decided to send some men to Antioch along with Paul and Barnabas. They chose Silas and Judas Barsabbas, who were two leaders of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni esa bɔfoi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ akɛ amɛaafãmɔ hii komɛi yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛteŋ, ni atsu amɛ kɛ Paulo kɛ Barnaba kɛya Antiokia. Hii nɛɛ ji Yuda, mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Barsaba hu lɛ, kɛ Sila; gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji hiɛnaanɔbii yɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ.

english_verse: They wrote a letter that said: We apostles and leaders send friendly greetings to all of you Gentiles who are followers of the Lord in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Ni amɛŋma wolo amɛhã amɛ akɛ, “Bɔfoi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ miibi nyɛmimɛi ni jɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ ni yɔɔ Antiokia kɛ Siria kɛ Kilikia lɛ jogbaŋŋ.

english_verse: We have heard that some people from here have terribly upset you by what they said. But we did not send them!
translation_verse: Akɛni wɔnu akɛ wɔteŋ mɛi komɛi bagba nyɛnaa kɛ wiemɔi komɛi, ni amɛkɛfutu nyɛjwɛŋmɔ, tsɛ jeee wɔ wɔfã amɛ akɛ amɛbafee nakai hewɔ lɛ,

english_verse: So we met together and decided to choose some men and to send them to you along with our good friends Barnabas and Paul.
translation_verse: esa wɔhiɛ akɛ, ni wɔnaa efee ekome nɛɛ, wɔfãmɔ mɛi wɔfata Barnaba kɛ Paulo ni wɔsumɔɔ

english_verse: These men have risked their lives for our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: ni ji gbɔmɛi ni kɛ amɛwala eŋmɛ shi yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbɛi hewɔ lɛ he, ni wɔtsu amɛ nyɛŋɔɔ.

english_verse: We are also sending Judas and Silas, who will tell you in person the same things that we are writing.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, wɔtsu Yuda kɛ Sila, ni amɛ hu amɛkɛ amɛdaaŋ wiemɔ abajaje nibii nɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit has shown us that we should not place any extra burden on you.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ esa Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni esa wɔ hu wɔhiɛ akɛ wɔkɛ jatsu kroko akatere nyɛ, akɛ ja nii ni he hiaa nɛɛ nɔŋŋ;

english_verse: The four men left Jerusalem and went to Antioch. Then they called the church members together and gave them the letter.
translation_verse: Be ni awo mɛi ni atsu lɛ gbɛ lɛ, amɛba Antiokia ni amɛbabua asafo muu lɛ naa ni amɛkɛ wolo lɛ hã amɛ.

english_verse: When the letter was read, everyone was pleased and greatly encouraged.
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛkane lɛ, amɛmii shɛ amɛhe yɛ hewalɛ ni ewo amɛ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Judas and Silas were prophets, and they spoke a long time, encouraging and helping the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Shi Yuda kɛ Sila lɛ, akɛni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu gbalɔi ji amɛ hewɔ lɛ, amɛwie saŋŋ kɛshɛje nyɛmimɛi lɛ amii ni amɛkɛwo amɛ hewalɛ.

english_verse: The men from Jerusalem stayed on in Antioch for a while. And when they left to return to the ones who had sent them, the followers wished them well.
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛye be fioo yɛ jɛi lɛ, nyɛmimɛi lɛ wo amɛ gbɛ yɛ hejɔlɛ mli kɛtee mɛi ni tsu amɛ lɛ aŋɔɔ. [

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas stayed on in Antioch, where they and many others taught and preached about the Lord. Paul and Barnabas Go Their Separate Ways
translation_verse: Shi Paulo kɛ Barnaba hi Antiokia amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nii ni amɛjaje Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ, ni mɛi krokomɛi pii hu fee nakai nɔŋŋ. Paulo kɛ Barnaba gbala mli

english_verse: Sometime later Paul said to Barnabas, “Let's go back and visit the Lord's followers in the cities where we preached his message. Then we will know how they are doing.”
translation_verse: Shi gbii komɛi asɛɛ lɛ, Paulo kɛɛ Barnaba akɛ, “Hã wɔku wɔsɛɛ wɔyasara wɔnyɛmimɛi lɛ yɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ ni wɔjaje Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ yɛ mli lɛ mli, ni wɔkwɛ bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ.”

english_verse: Barnabas wanted to take along John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Ni Barnaba tao akɛ amɛŋɔ Yohane ni atsɛɔ lɛ Marko lɛ amɛfata amɛhe.

english_verse: But Paul did not want to, because Mark had left them in Pamphylia and had stopped working with them.
translation_verse: Shi Paulo lɛ, lɛ lɛ esusu akɛ esaaa akɛ amɛaaŋɔ mɔ ni kpale yɛ amɛsɛɛ yɛ Pamfilia ni ekɛ amɛ eyaaa nitsumɔ lɛ amɛfata amɛhe.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas argued, then each of them went his own way. Barnabas took Mark and sailed to Cyprus,
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, efee bei aahu po ni ehã amɛmli gbala, ni Barnaba ŋɔ Marko efata ehe ni amɛtsɔ lɛlɛ mli kɛtee Kipro.

english_verse: but Paul took Silas and left after the followers had placed them in God's care.
translation_verse: Shi Paulo lɛ, efã Sila efata ehe, ni be ni nyɛmimɛi lɛ tu lɛ wo Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ Paulo yi mli.

english_verse: They traveled through Syria and Cilicia, encouraging the churches.
translation_verse: Ni etsɔ̃ Siria kɛ Kilikia eyawo asafoi lɛ ahewalɛ.

english_verse: Paul and Silas went back to Derbe and Lystra, where there was a follower named Timothy. His mother was also a follower. She was Jewish, and his father was Greek.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni Paulo ba Derbe kɛ Listra. Kaselɔ ko yɛ jɛi ni atsɛɔ lɛ Timoteo; enyɛ lɛ Yudayoo ko ni ehe wiemɔ lɛ eye ni, shi etsɛ lɛ Helanyo ni.

english_verse: The Lord's followers in Lystra and Iconium said good things about Timothy,
translation_verse: Ni nyɛmimɛi lɛ ni yɔɔ Listra kɛ Ikonium lɛ yeɔ ehe odase kpakpa.

english_verse: and Paul wanted him to go with them. But Paul first had him circumcised, because all the Jewish people around there knew that Timothy's father was Greek.
translation_verse: Paulo miitao ni ekɛ kaselɔ nɛɛ aya, ni eŋɔ lɛ efo lɛ ketia yɛ Yudafoi ni yɔɔ jɛi niiaŋ lɛ ahewɔ; ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛle akɛ etsɛ lɛ Helanyo ni.

english_verse: As Paul and the others went from city to city, they told the followers what the apostles and leaders in Jerusalem had decided, and they urged them to follow these instructions.
translation_verse: Shi be ni amɛkpaa maji lɛ anɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ mlai ni bɔfoi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ wo lɛ hã amɛ koni amɛye nɔ.

english_verse: The churches became stronger in their faith, and each day more people put their faith in the Lord. Paul's Vision in Troas
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ asafoi lɛ na hewalɛ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli, ni amɛyi faa daa gbi. Paulo ninaa yɛ Troia

english_verse: Paul and his friends went through Phrygia and Galatia, but the Holy Spirit would not let them preach in Asia.
translation_verse: Shi akɛni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ etsi amɛ gbɛ akɛ amɛkawie wiemɔ lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Asia hewɔ lɛ, amɛfo mli yɛ Frigia kɛ Galatia shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ;

english_verse: After they arrived in Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus would not let them.
translation_verse: ni amɛba Misia niiaŋ, ni amɛka akɛ amɛaatee Bitinia, shi Yesu Mumɔ lɛ eŋmɛɛɛ amɛ gbɛ.

english_verse: So they went on through Mysia until they came to Troas.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni amɛtsɔ̃ Misia ni amɛba Troia.

english_verse: During the night, Paul had a vision of someone from Macedonia who was standing there and begging him, “Come over to Macedonia and help us!”
translation_verse: Ni nyɔɔŋ lɛ Paulo na yɛ ninaa mli akɛ nuu Makedonianyo ko damɔ shi miikpa lɛ fai akɛ, “Ba Makedonia ni obaye obua wɔ!”

english_verse: After Paul had seen the vision, we began looking for a way to go to Macedonia. We were sure that God had called us to preach the good news there. Lydia Becomes a Follower of the Lord
translation_verse: Shi be ni ena nii lɛ pɛ lɛ, amrɔ lɛ wɔtao akɛ wɔya Makedonia, ejaakɛ wɔkɔ sɛɛ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ etsɛ wɔ kɛmiiya jɛi koni wɔyajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ. Lidia tsuitsakemɔ

english_verse: We sailed straight from Troas to Samothrace, and the next day we arrived in Neapolis.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, wɔfã kɛjɛ Troia ni wɔnyiɛ tɛ̃ɛ kɛtee Samotrake, ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ wɔba Neapoli.

english_verse: From there we went to Philippi, which is a Roman colony in the first district of Macedonia. We spent several days in Philippi.
translation_verse: Wɔjɛ jɛi lɛ, wɔtee Filipi ni ji Makedonia shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋ wulu kɛ Romabii ashimɔmɔhe lɛ. Ni wɔhi nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ mli gbii kplaŋŋ.

english_verse: Then on the Sabbath we went outside the city gate to a place by the river, where we thought there would be a Jewish meeting place for prayer. We sat down and talked with the women who came.
translation_verse: Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, wɔjɛ maŋ lɛ mli wɔtee faa ko naa, he ni wɔjwɛŋmɔ kɛɛ wɔ akɛ asɔleɔ yɛ lɛ, ni wɔyatara shi, ni wɔkɛ yei ni ebabua amɛhe naa yɛ jɛi lɛ wie.

english_verse: One of them was Lydia, who was from the city of Thyatira and sold expensive purple cloth. She was a worshiper of the Lord God, and he made her willing to accept what Paul was saying.
translation_verse: Ni yoo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Lidia ni ji kɔɔjaŋhɔ̃ɔlɔ ko ni jɛ Tiatira maŋ lɛ mli ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ hu nu; lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbele etsui naa akɛ ebo nii ni Paulo wieɔ lɛ toi.

english_verse: Then after she and her family were baptized, she kept on begging us, “If you think I really do have faith in the Lord, come stay in my home.” Finally, we accepted her invitation. Paul and Silas Are Put in Jail
translation_verse: Ni be ni abaptisi lɛ kɛ ewe lɛ, ekpa wɔ fai akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛbu mi akɛ mihe Nuŋtsɔ lɛ miye anɔkwale mli lɛ, no lɛ nyɛbaa miwe lɛ, ni nyɛbahia jɛi.” Ni ehiɛ wɔ aahu, ni wɔkpɛ̃lɛ. Paulo kɛ Sila tsuŋwoo

english_verse: One day on our way to the place of prayer, we were met by a slave girl. She had a spirit in her that gave her the power to tell the future. By doing this she made a lot of money for her owners.
translation_verse: Shi gbi ko be ni wɔyaa he ni asɔleɔ yɛ lɛ, tsulɔ yoo ko ni klámɔ mumɔ yɔɔ emli kɛ wɔ bakpe; ekɛ eklámɔ lɛ hãa enuŋtsɔmɛi naa nii pii.

english_verse: The girl followed Paul and the rest of us, and she kept yelling, “These men are servants of the Most High God! They are telling you how to be saved.”
translation_verse: Enyiɛ wɔ kɛ Paulo sɛɛ ni ebolɔɔ akɛ, “Nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ tsuji ji amɛ, ni amɛmiijaje yiwalaheremɔ gbɛ lɛ amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.”

english_verse: This went on for several days. Finally, Paul got so upset that he turned and said to the spirit, “In the name of Jesus Christ, I order you to leave this girl alone!” At once the evil spirit left her.
translation_verse: Ni efee nakai gbii pii. Shi efee Paulo ahuntoo kɛho he, ni etsɔ̃ ehe ni ekɛɛ mumɔ lɛ akɛ, “Miifã bo yɛ Yesu Kristo gbɛi mli akɛ oje emli.” Ni eje emli yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: When the girl's owners realized they had lost all chances for making more money, they grabbed Paul and Silas and dragged them into court.
translation_verse: Be ni enuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ na akɛ amɛninamɔ nɔhiɛkãmɔnɔ lɛ elaaje lɛ, amɛmɔmɔ Paulo kɛ Sila ni amɛgbala amɛ kɛtee lumɛi lɛ ahiɛ yɛ jara lɛ nɔ;

english_verse: They are telling us to do things we Romans are not allowed to do.”
translation_verse: ni amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔtsɔ̃ɔ kusumi komɛi ni wɔ akɛ Romabii lɛ wɔbɛ hegbɛ akɛ wɔmɔɔ mli loo wɔyeɔ nɔ.”

english_verse: The crowd joined in the attack on Paul and Silas. Then the officials tore the clothes off the two men and ordered them to be beaten with a whip.
translation_verse: Ni maŋbii lɛ hu te shi wo amɛ, ni asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ hã akplɔ amɛtadei yɛ amɛhe, ni amɛfã akɛ ayi amɛ kpãa.

english_verse: After they had been badly beaten, they were put in jail, and the jailer was told to guard them carefully.
translation_verse: Ni be ni amɛtswia amɛ kpãi pii lɛ, amɛwo amɛ tsuŋ, ni amɛwo gboklɛfoiakwɛlɔ lɛ kitã akɛ ekɛ amɛ ato shweshweeshwe;

english_verse: The jailer did as he was told. He put them deep inside the jail and chained their feet to heavy blocks of wood.
translation_verse: ni akɛni awo lɛ nɛkɛ kitã hewɔ lɛ, etsi amɛ ewo tsu ni yɔɔ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ mli tɔɔ, ni ebɔ amɛnaji apã.

english_verse: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing praises to God, while the other prisoners listened.
translation_verse: Shi nyɔɔŋ teŋ lɛ Paulo kɛ Sila miisɔle ni amɛmiila amɛmiijie Nyɔŋmɔ yi; ni gboklɛfoi lɛ miibo amɛ toi.

english_verse: Suddenly a strong earthquake shook the jail to its foundations. The doors opened, and the chains fell from all the prisoners.
translation_verse: Ni trukaa lɛ shikpɔŋ hoso waa, ni tsu lɛ shishitoo lɛ hoso, ni amrɔ lɛ, shinai lɛ fɛɛ gbelegbelee, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛkpãi lɛ kpɔlɔke.

english_verse: When the jailer woke up and saw that the doors were open, he thought that the prisoners had escaped. He pulled out his sword and was about to kill himself.
translation_verse: Be ni gboklɛfoiakwɛlɔ lɛ hɛle shi kɛjɛ wɔ mli ni ena akɛ tsu lɛ naa shinai lɛ fɛɛ kãmɔ lɛ, egbala eklante ni kulɛ ebaagbe ehe, ejaakɛ esusu akɛ gboklɛfoi lɛ ejo foi.

english_verse: But Paul shouted, “Don't harm yourself! No one has escaped.”
translation_verse: Shi Paulo bo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ akɛ, “Kaafee ohe efɔŋ ko, shi wɔ fɛɛ wɔyɛ biɛ.”

english_verse: The jailer asked for a torch and went into the jail. He was shaking all over as he knelt down in front of Paul and Silas.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni etsɛ ni abahã lɛ kane, ni esha foi kɛbote tsu lɛ mli, ni ekɛ hekpokpomɔ ho egbee Paulo kɛ Sila hiɛ,

english_verse: After he had led them out of the jail, he asked, “What must I do to be saved?”
translation_verse: ni ekɛ amɛ je kpo ni ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔmɛi, mɛni sa ni mafee ni ahere miyiwala?”

english_verse: They replied, “Have faith in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved! This is also true for everyone who lives in your home.”
translation_verse: Ni amɛkɛɛ, “Hemɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ nɔ oye, ni aaahere bo kɛ owe lɛ fɛɛ yiwala.”

english_verse: Then Paul and Silas told him and everyone else in his house about the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni amɛjaje Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ewe lɛ.
