translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ wɔkɛ Mla lɛ bɛ sane ko dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ wɔtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ gbohii yɛ nɔ ni fi wɔ kpɛŋŋ lɛ gbɛfaŋ, bɔ ni afee ni wɔsɔ̃mɔ yɛ mumɔ ni etsɔ̃ ehee mli, shi jeee yɛ gbɛ momo lɛ ni ji Mla ni aŋma lɛ nɔ. Mla lɛ kɛ esha

english_verse: Does this mean that the Law is sinful? Certainly not! But if it had not been for the Law, I would not have known what sin is really like. For example, I would not have known what it means to want something that belongs to someone else, unless the Law had told me not to do this.
translation_verse: Belɛ te wɔɔkɛɛ tɛŋŋ? Aso Mla lɛ esha ni? Dabida! Shi moŋ jeee Mla lɛ hewɔŋ kulɛ mileee esha; ejaakɛ kulɛ mileee nɔ ni ji hiɛkɔ̃ɔ, kɛjeee Mla lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Ohiɛ akakɔ̃ nii anɔ.”

english_verse: It was sin that used this command as a way of making me have all kinds of desires. But without the Law, sin is dead.
translation_verse: Shi esha lɛ tsɔ̃ kitã lɛ nɔ ena hegbɛ ni eteɔ akɔnɔi fɛɛ ashi yɛ mimli; ejaakɛ kɛ Mla bɛ lɛ esha hu egbo.

english_verse: Before I knew about the Law, I was alive. But as soon as I heard that command, sin came to life,
translation_verse: Shi mihi shi pɛŋ ni mibɛ mla; shi be ni kitã lɛ ba lɛ, esha lɛ hiɛ tsɛ ekoŋŋ;

english_verse: and I died. The very command that was supposed to bring life to me, instead brought death.
translation_verse: shi mi lɛ migbo; ni mina akɛ kitã lɛ ni akɛhã mi yɛ wala hewɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ etsɛ gbele ehã mi.

english_verse: Sin used this command to trick me, and because of it I died.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ esha lɛ na hegbɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Mla lɛ nɔ eshishiu mi, ni ekɛ no nɔŋŋ gbe mi.

english_verse: Still, the Law and its commands are holy and correct and good.
translation_verse: Hewɔ lɛ Mla lɛ yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni kitã lɛ yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni eja ni ehi hu.

english_verse: Am I saying something good caused my death? Certainly not! It was sin that killed me by using something good. Now we can see how terrible and evil sin really is.
translation_verse: Aso belɛ nɔ kpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ gbele ehã mi lo? Dabida! Shi moŋ, bɔ ni afee ni esha lɛ aje shi akɛ esha; ni ekɛ nɔ kpakpa lɛ nɔŋŋ tsɛ gbele ehã mi, koni esha lɛ atsɔ̃ kitã lɛ nɔ atsɔ̃ esha kɛteke nɔ. Gbɔmɔfɔmɔ sui enyɔ

english_verse: We know that the Law is spiritual. But I am merely a human, and I have been sold as a slave to sin.
translation_verse: Wɔle akɛ Mla lɛ mumɔŋ nɔ ni; shi mi lɛ heloo gbɔmɔ ji mi, ni ahɔ̃ɔ mi awo esha shishi.

english_verse: In fact, I don't understand why I act the way I do. I don't do what I know is right. I do the things I hate.
translation_verse: Shi nɔ ni mifeɔ lɛ mileee, ejaakɛ nɔ ni misumɔ̃ɔ lɛ, jeee no mifeɔ, shi nɔ ni mihiɔ moŋ lɛ, no mifeɔ.

english_verse: Although I don't do what I know is right, I agree that the Law is good.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ nɔ ni misumɔɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ mifeɔ lɛ, belɛ mikpɛ̃lɛ̃ɔ akɛ Mla lɛ hi.

english_verse: So I am not the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Belɛ agbɛnɛ jeee mi mitsuɔ no dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ esha ni hiɔ mimli lɛ tsuɔ.

english_verse: I know that my selfish desires won't let me do anything that is good. Even when I want to do right, I cannot.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mile akɛ mimli, no ji migbɔmɔ su lɛ mli lɛ, nɔ ko kpakpa ko bɛ jɛi; ejaakɛ suɔmɔ lɛ miyɛ eko moŋ, shi ekpakpafeemɔ ni ebɔ mi.

english_verse: Instead of doing what I know is right, I do wrong.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ekpakpa ni misumɔɔ lɛ mifeee; shi efɔŋ ni misumɔ̃ɔɔ lɛ, no moŋ mifeɔ.

english_verse: And so, if I don't do what I know is right, I am no longer the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ nɔ ni misumɔ̃ɔɔ lɛ kɛ̃ mifeɔ lɛ, belɛ jeee mi mitsuɔ no dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ esha ni yɔɔ mimli lɛ tsuɔ.

english_verse: The Law has shown me that something in me keeps me from doing what I know is right.
translation_verse: Belɛ minaa mla ko akɛ mi ni misumɔɔ akɛ mafee nɔ ni hi lɛ, efɔŋ moŋ kpɛtɛ mihe.

english_verse: With my whole heart I agree with the Law of God.
translation_verse: Mimligbɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ miishɛɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ he;

english_verse: But in every part of me I discover something fighting against my mind, and it makes me a prisoner of sin that controls everything I do.
translation_verse: shi minaa mla kroko yɛ mihe nii lɛ amli ni kɛ mla ni kɛ mijwɛŋmɔ yaa lɛ wuɔ ta, ni eŋɔɔ mi nom ehãa esha mla lɛ ni yɔɔ mihenii lɛ amli lɛ.

english_verse: What a miserable person I am. Who will rescue me from this body that is doomed to die?
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ ni nii yɔɔ mɔbɔ ji mi! Namɔ aaajie mi kɛaajɛ gbele gbɔmɔtso nɛɛ dɛŋ?

english_verse: Thank God! Jesus Christ will rescue me. So with my mind I serve the Law of God, although my selfish desires make me serve the law of sin.
translation_verse: Shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛtsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, nɔ. Belɛ agbɛnɛ mi nɔŋŋ mikɛ mijwɛŋmɔ sɔ̃mɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ moŋ, shi mikɛ migbɔmɔ su sɔ̃mɔɔ esha Mla.

english_verse: If you belong to Christ Jesus, you won't be punished.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ fɔ ko fɔ ko bɛ ni abaabu mɛi ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit will give you life that comes from Christ Jesus and will set you free from sin and death.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mumɔ mla ni hãa wala yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ ekpɔ̃ mi yɛ esha kɛ gbele mla lɛ dɛŋ.

english_verse: The Law of Moses cannot do this, because our selfish desires make the Law weak. But God set you free when he sent his own Son to be like us sinners and to be a sacrifice for our sin. God used Christ's body to condemn sin.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nɔ ni Mla lɛ nyɛɛɛ afee yɛ gbedemɔ ni heloo lɛ ehã egbede hewɔ lɛ, no Nyɔŋmɔ fee: etsu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eBi lɛ yɛ su ni tamɔ esha heloo su mli, yɛ esha hewɔ; ni ebu esha lɛ fɔ yɛ heloo lɛ mli,

english_verse: He did this, so that we would do what the Law commands by obeying the Spirit instead of our own desires.
translation_verse: koni afee Mla lɛ taomɔnii ni ja lɛ yɛ wɔmli, wɔ mɛi ni wɔnyiɛɛɛ heloo naa, shi moŋ mumɔ naa wɔnyiɛɔ lɛ.

english_verse: People who are ruled by their desires think only of themselves. Everyone who is ruled by the Holy Spirit thinks about spiritual things.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni hiɔ shi yɛ heloo naa lɛ, heloonii ahe amɛjwɛŋɔ; shi mɛi ni hiɔ shi yɛ mumɔ naa lɛ, mumɔnii ahe amɛjwɛŋɔ.

english_verse: If our minds are ruled by our desires, we will die. But if our minds are ruled by the Spirit, we will have life and peace.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ heloo jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, gbele ni, shi mumɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, wala kɛ hejɔlɛ ni.

english_verse: Our desires fight against God, because they do not and cannot obey God's laws.
translation_verse: Heloo jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ nyɛɛ ni, akɛni ebaaa ehe shi ehãaa Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ, ni esaa enyɛŋ tete lɛ;

english_verse: If we follow our desires, we cannot please God.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ mɛi ni hiɔ shi yɛ heloo mli lɛ nyɛɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ amɛsa.

english_verse: You are no longer ruled by your desires, but by God's Spirit, who lives in you. People who don't have the Spirit of Christ in them don't belong to him.
translation_verse: Nyɛhiii shi yɛ heloo naa, shi moŋ mumɔ naa nyɛhiɔ shi yɛ, kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ hiɔ nyɛmli lɛ. Shi kɛ mɔ ko bɛ Kristo Mumɔ lɛ, belɛ jeee Kristo nɔ ji lɛ.

english_verse: But Christ lives in you. So you are alive because God has accepted you, even though your bodies must die because of your sins.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ Kristo yɛ nyɛmli lɛ, no lɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ egbo yɛ esha hewɔ nɛ, shi Mumɔ lɛ hiɛ kã, yɛ jalɔi ni abu nyɛ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Yet God raised Jesus to life! God's Spirit now lives in you, and he will raise you to life by his Spirit.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ mɔ ni tee Yesu shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ mumɔ lɛ hiɔ nyɛmli lɛ, mɔ ni tee Kristo shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ aaahã nyɛgbɔmɔtsei ni baagboi lɛ hu yi ana wala yɛ eMumɔ ni hiɔ nyɛmli lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: My dear friends, we must not live to satisfy our desires.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɔjiatsɛmɛi ji wɔ, shi jeee heloo lɛ nyɔmɔ wɔhiɛ ni wɔɔhi shi yɛ heloo naa.

english_verse: If you do, you will die. But you will live, if by the help of God's Spirit you say “No” to your desires.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ heloo naa nyɛhiɔ shi yɛ lɛ, nyɛbaagboi shi kɛ nyɛkɛ Mumɔ lɛ gbeɔ heloo lɛ nitsumɔi lɛ, nyɛhiɛ aaakãmɔ.

english_verse: Only those people who are led by God's Spirit are his children.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛi abɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ kpalaa amɛ lɛ, amɛ amɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ bii.

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make us slaves who are afraid of him. Instead, we become his children and call him our Father.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ jeee nyɔŋ mumɔ nyɛna ni aaahã nyɛshe gbeyei ekoŋŋ, shi moŋ Mumɔ ni hãa mɛi tsɔ̃mɔɔ bii ni hãa wɔboɔ wɔtsɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “Aba! Ataa!” lɛ.

english_verse: God's Spirit makes us sure that we are his children.
translation_verse: Lɛ Mumɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ wɔmumɔ lɛ yeɔ odase akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bii ji wɔ.

english_verse: His Spirit lets us know that together with Christ we will be given what God has promised. We will also share in the glory of Christ, because we have suffered with him. A Wonderful Future for God's People
translation_verse: Ni kɛ bii ji wɔ lɛ, belɛ niyelɔi hu ji wɔ, Nyɔŋmɔ niyelɔi kɛ Kristo nanemɛi niyelɔi; kɛji wɔ kɛ lɛ na amanehulu lɛ, koni awo wɔ kɛ lɛ hiɛ nyam hu. Wɔsɛɛ anunyam

english_verse: I am sure what we are suffering now cannot compare with the glory that will be shown to us.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ misusuɔ akɛ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ amanehului lɛ kɛ anunyam ni wɔsɛɛ abaajie kpo atsɔ̃ɔ wɔ lɛ yeee egbɔ.

english_verse: In fact, all creation is eagerly waiting for God to show who his children are.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bɔɔnii lɛ kɛ gbɛkwɛmɔ kpɛ̃kpɛ̃ɛkpɛ̃ miimɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bii lɛ akpojiemɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, creation is confused, but not because it wants to be confused. God made it this way in the hope
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ akɛ bɔɔnii lɛ ewo yakayakanii ashishi, jeee yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsuɔmɔ naa, shi moŋ yɛ mɔ ni ba amɛ shi lɛ suɔmɔ naa; kɛ̃lɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ

english_verse: that creation would be set free from decay and would share in the glorious freedom of his children.
translation_verse: akɛ bɔɔnii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu abaahã amɛye amɛhe kɛjɛ fitemɔ ni yeɔ amɛ nyɔŋ lɛ shishi kɛya Nyɔŋmɔ bii lɛ anunyam heyeli lɛ mli.

english_verse: We know that all creation is still groaning and is in pain, like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ bɔɔnii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ̃mɔɔ ni amɛkɔ̃mɔ̃ɔ kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ.

english_verse: The Spirit makes us sure about what we will be in the future. But now we groan silently, while we wait for God to show that we are his children. This means that our bodies will also be set free.
translation_verse: Shi jeee amɛ kɛkɛŋ, shi moŋ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ tete, wɔ ni wɔyɔɔ Mumɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ yibii lɛ, wɔ diɛŋtsɛ hu wɔkɛ̃mɔ̃ɔ yɛ wɔmli, ni wɔkwɛɔ gbɛ akɛ wɔbaatsɔ̃mɔ bii, no ji abaakpɔ̃ wɔgbɔmɔtso lɛ.

english_verse: And this hope is what saves us. But if we already have what we hope for, there is no need to keep on hoping.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ naa ahere wɔyiwala yɛ. Hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni anaa lɛ, ejeee hiɛnɔkãmɔ, ejaakɛ namɔ hiɛ kãa nɔ ni enaa nɔ?

english_verse: However, we hope for something we have not yet seen, and we patiently wait for it.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ nɔ ni wɔnaaa lɛ nɔ wɔhiɛ kã lɛ, belɛ wɔkɛ tsuishiŋmɛɛ kwɛɔ lɛ gbɛ.

english_verse: In certain ways we are weak, but the Spirit is here to help us. For example, when we don't know what to pray for, the Spirit prays for us in ways that cannot be put into words.
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ Mumɔ lɛ hu yeɔ buaa wɔ yɛ wɔgbedemɔi lɛ amli; ejaakɛ bɔ ni sa akɛ wɔsɔle lɛ wɔleee; shi moŋ Mumɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ ŋtsɔidɔɔmɔi ni anyɛŋ akɛɛ lɛ dãmɔɔ mli hãa wɔ.

english_verse: All of our thoughts are known to God. He can understand what is in the mind of the Spirit, as the Spirit prays for God's people.
translation_verse: Ni mɔ ni taoɔ tsuii amli lɛ le nɔ ni ji mumɔ lɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ edãmɔɔ mli ehãa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa.

english_verse: We know that God is always at work for the good of everyone who loves him. They are the ones God has chosen for his purpose,
translation_verse: Shi wɔle akɛ mɛi ni sumɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nibii fiaa yeɔ buaa amɛ ni ahi ahã amɛ, amɛ mɛi ni atsɛ amɛ yɛ yiŋtoo naa lɛ.

english_verse: and he has always known who his chosen ones would be. He had decided to let them become like his own Son, so his Son would be the first of many children.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛi ni ele amɛ eto momo lɛ, amɛ ejie eto ni amɛsubaŋ atamɔ eBi lɛ nɔ lɛ, koni efee nyɛmimɛi pii ateŋ kromɔbi.

english_verse: God then accepted the people he had already decided to choose, and he has shared his glory with them. God's Love
translation_verse: Shi mɛi ni ejie eto lɛ, amɛ nɔŋŋ etsɛ; ni mɛi ni etsɛ lɛ, amɛ nɔŋŋ bem ebu; ni mɛi ni ebu amɛ bem lɛ, amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛhiɛ nyam ewo. Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ ni ekɛsumɔ wɔ yɛ Yesu Kristo mli

english_verse: What can we say about all this? If God is on our side, can anyone be against us?
translation_verse: Belɛ te wɔɔkɛɛ tɛŋŋ yɛ nii nɛɛ ahewɔŋ? Kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ wɔsɛɛ lɛ, namɔ aaate shi awo wɔ?

english_verse: God did not keep back his own Son, but he gave him for us. If God did this, won't he freely give us everything else?
translation_verse: Lɛ mɔ ni kãmãaa wɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eBi lɛ, shi moŋ ekɛ lɛ hã yɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔnajiaŋ lɛ, ani eŋɔŋ nibii fiaa efataŋ ehe ekeŋ wɔ?

english_verse: If God says his chosen ones are acceptable to him, can anyone bring charges against them?
translation_verse: Namɔ aaafolɔ Nyɔŋmɔ halamɔbii lɛ anaa? Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni buɔ bem.

english_verse: Or can anyone condemn them? No indeed! Christ died and was raised to life, and now he is at God's right side, speaking to him for us.
translation_verse: Namɔ ji mɔ ni buɔ fɔ lɛ? Kristo, mɔ ni gbo, shi nɔ ni fe no lɛ, mɔ ni atee lɛ shi ni eyɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ, ni esaa edamɔɔ mli ehãa wɔ lɛ?

english_verse: Can anything separate us from the love of Christ? Can trouble, suffering, and hard times, or hunger and nakedness, or danger and death?
translation_verse: Namɔ aaagbala wɔ kɛ suɔmɔ ni Kristo kɛsumɔ wɔ lɛ mli? Amanehulu loo fimɔ loo yiwaa loo hɔ̃mɔ loo yayainyiɛmɔ loo osharã loo klante?

english_verse: It is exactly as the Scriptures say, “For you we face death all day long. We are like sheep on their way to be butchered.”
translation_verse: Tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, “Ohewɔ lɛ agbeɔ wɔ aahu jenamɔ tuu; abu wɔ akɛ toi ni ayaagbe amɛ.”

english_verse: In everything we have won more than a victory because of Christ who loves us.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ enɛɛmɛi fiaa mli lɛ, wɔtsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ni sumɔ wɔ lɛ nɔ wɔyeɔ kunim tsɔ̃.

english_verse: I am sure that nothing can separate us from God's love—not life or death, not angels or spirits, not the present or the future,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ miyɛ nɔmimaa akɛ gbele jio, wala jio; ŋwɛi bɔfoi jio, nɔyelɔi jio, nii ni yɔɔ nɛɛ jio, nii ni baaba lɛ jio, hewalɛi jio,

english_verse: and not powers above or powers below. Nothing in all creation can separate us from God's love for us in Christ Jesus our Lord!
translation_verse: ŋwɛi jio, shishi jio, aloo nibii ni abɔ lɛ amli nɔ kroko jio, amɛnyɛŋ amɛgbala wɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, mli lɛ mli.

english_verse: I am a follower of Christ, and the Holy Spirit is a witness to my conscience. So I tell the truth and I am not lying when I say
translation_verse: Miiwie anɔkwale yɛ Kristo mli, mimaleee, ni mihenilee hu miiye mi odase yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli,

english_verse: my heart is broken and I am in great sorrow.
translation_verse: akɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ babaoo, ni mitsui yeɔ daa.

english_verse: I would gladly be placed under God's curse and be separated from Christ for the good of my own people.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mina ni kulɛ ajie mi yɛ Kristo he akɛ musumɔ yɛ minyɛmimɛi ni ji miwekumɛi yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: They are the descendants of Israel, and they are also God's chosen people. God showed them his glory. He made agreements with them and gave them his Law. The temple is theirs and so are the promises that God made to them.
translation_verse: Amɛ ji Israelbii lɛ; ni amɛnɔ ji bitsɔ̃mɔ lɛ kɛ anunyam lɛ kɛ kpãŋmɔi lɛ kɛ mlahãmɔ lɛ kɛ jamɔ lɛ kɛ shiwoi lɛ,

english_verse: They have those famous ancestors, who were also the ancestors of the Christ. I pray that God, who rules over all, will be praised forever! Amen.
translation_verse: amɛnɔ ji tsɛmɛi lɛ, ni amɛmli hu Kristo tete jɛ yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ lɛ, lɛ ji nii fiaa nɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ajɔɔ lɛ kɛyashiɔ naanɔ lɛ. Amen!

english_verse: It cannot be said that God broke his promise. After all, not all of the people of Israel are the true people of God.
translation_verse: Shi jeee akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ efee yaka. Ejaakɛ jeee mɛi ni jɛ Israel mli lɛ fɛɛ ji “Israel musuŋ bii”,

english_verse: In fact, when God made the promise to Abraham, he meant only Abraham's descendants by his son Isaac. God was talking only about Isaac when he promised
translation_verse: No ji akɛ, jeee heloo naa bii lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ bii, shi shiwoo naa bii lɛ moŋ abuɔ akɛ oshwiei.

english_verse: Sarah, “At this time next year I will return, and you will already have a son.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ shiwoo wiemɔ lɛ nɛ, “Wɔsɛɛ agbɔ be nɛ lɛ maba, ni Sara aaana binuu.”

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to the twin sons of Isaac and Rebekah.
translation_verse: Shi jeee enɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ wɔtsɛ Isak kome lɛ nɔŋŋ Rebeka kɛna musu,

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say that the Lord liked Jacob more than Esau.
translation_verse: Tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, “Yakob lɛ, misumɔ lɛ, shi Esau lɛ minyɛ lɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: Are we saying God is unfair? Certainly not!
translation_verse: Belɛ te wɔɔkɛɛ tɛŋŋ? Ani Nyɔŋmɔ yeɔ sane ko ni ejaaa? Dabida!

english_verse: The Lord told Moses that he has pity and mercy on anyone he wants to.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ekɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mɔ ni minaa lɛ mɔbɔ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ mɔbɔ mibana, ni mɔ ni mimusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ mi hãa lɛ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ mimusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ mi ahã.”

english_verse: Everything then depends on God's mercy and not on what people want or do.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ jeee mɔ ko suɔmɔ loo emɔdɛŋbɔɔ naa ni, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ mɔbɔnalɛ naa ni.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says to the king of Egypt, “I let you become king, so that I could show you my power and be praised by all people on earth.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɛ Farao akɛ, “Enɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ mitee bo shi, koni majie mihewalɛ kpo kɛtsɔ̃ onɔ, koni atsi migbɛi tã yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: Everything depends on what God decides to do, and he can either have pity on people or make them stubborn. God's Anger and Mercy
translation_verse: Belɛ no hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni esumɔɔ akɛ ena lɛ mɔbɔ lɛ, enaa lɛ mɔbɔ, ni kɛ eesumɔ akɛ ewaje mɔ ko tsui lɛ, ewajeɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu kɛ emɔbɔnalɛ

english_verse: Someone may ask, “How can God blame us, if he makes us behave in the way he wants us to?”
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ ooobi mi akɛ, “Belɛ mɛɛba Nyɔŋmɔ shwaa mɔ̃ mɔ? Ejaakɛ namɔ aaanyɛ eyiŋtoo naa aku?”

english_verse: But, my friend, I ask, “Who do you think you are to question God? Does the clay have the right to ask the potter why he shaped it the way he did?
translation_verse: Shi, bo gbɔmɔ, namɔ ji bo, ni okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kaneɔ? Ani nɔ ni ashɔ̃ lɛ aaabi mɔ ni shɔ̃ lɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba oshɔ̃ mi nɛkɛ?”

english_verse: Doesn't a potter have the right to make a fancy bowl and a plain bowl out of the same lump of clay?”
translation_verse: Aloo gbɛshɔ̃lɔ bɛ hegbɛ yɛ su lɛ nɔ, akɛ ekɛ su ni akpɔtɔ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ eko aaashɔ̃ nɔ ko ni yɔɔ nyam ni ekɛ eko hu aaashɔ̃ nɔ ko ni bɛ nyam?

english_verse: God wanted to show his anger and reveal his power against everyone who deserved to be destroyed. But instead, he patiently put up with them.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ miisumɔ akɛ ejie emlifu kpo etsɔ̃ɔ ni ehã ale ehe ni wa lɛ, ni kɛ̃lɛ eŋmɛɔ etsui shi babaoo ehiɛɔ mlifu nii ni sa fitemɔ lɛ,

english_verse: He did this by showing how glorious he is when he has pity on the people he has chosen to share in his glory.
translation_verse: bɔ ni afee ni ehã ale enunyam falɛ lɛ hu yɛ emɔbɔnalɛ nii ni esaa eto ehã anunyam lɛ anɔ lɛ, mɛni obaakɛɛ?

english_verse: just as the Lord says in the book of Hosea, “Although they are not my people, I will make them my people. I will treat with love those nations that have never been loved.
translation_verse: Tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ yɛ Hoshea wolo lɛ mli akɛ, “Matsɛ mɛi ni jeee mimaŋ lɛ akɛ mimaŋ, kɛ mɔ ni asumɔɔɔ lɛ lɛ akɛ mɔ ni asumɔɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: “Once they were told, ‘You are not my people.’ But in that very place they will be called children of the living God.”
translation_verse: “Ni aaaba mli akɛ, he ni akɛɛ amɛ yɛ akɛ, ‘Jeee mimaŋ ji nyɛ’ lɛ, jɛi nɔŋŋ aaatsɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ bii yɛ.”

english_verse: And this is what the prophet Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “The people of Israel are as many as the grains of sand along the beach. But only a few who are left will be saved.
translation_verse: Shi Yesaia bo yɛ Israel he akɛ, “Kɛ Israelbii lɛ ayibɔ tamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia lɛ, mɛi fioo ni baashwɛ lɛ yiwala aaahere.

english_verse: The Lord will be quick and sure to do on earth what he has warned he will do.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsu ewiemɔ lɛ he nii kuku egbe naa pɛpɛɛpɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: Isaiah also said, “If the Lord All-Powerful had not spared some of our descendants, we would have been destroyed like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah.” Israel and the Good News
translation_verse: Ni tamɔ bɔ ni Yesaia ekɛɛ eto momo lɛ akɛ, “Eji Tai aNuŋtsɔ lɛ eshwɛɛɛ shwiei ko ehãaa wɔ kulɛ, wɔtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ Sodom, ni wɔfee tamɔ Gomora pɛ.” Israel nine shɛɛɛ jalɛ nɔ

english_verse: What does all of this mean? It means that the Gentiles were not trying to be acceptable to God, but they found that he would accept them if they had faith.
translation_verse: Belɛ te wɔɔkɛɛ tɛŋŋ? Akɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii ni ediii jalɛ sɛɛ lɛ ena jalɛ ni ji jalɛ ni jɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ;

english_verse: just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a stone to make people stumble and fall. But those who have faith in that one will never be disappointed.”
translation_verse: tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, “Naa, mikɛ tɛmɔ tɛ kɛ nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ tɛsaa ko miima shi yɛ Zion, Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ eyeɔ lɛ, ehiɛ gboŋ.”

english_verse: Dear friends, my greatest wish and my prayer to God is for the people of Israel to be saved.
translation_verse: Anyɛmimɛi, nɔ ni mitsui shweɔ kɛ fai ni mikpaa Nyɔŋmɔ mihãa Israel ji akɛ ahere amɛyiwala.

english_verse: I know they love God, but they don't understand
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ miiye amɛhe odase akɛ amɛhiɛ dɔɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he moŋ, shi jeee nilee naa.

english_verse: what makes people acceptable to him. So they refuse to trust God, and they try to be acceptable by obeying the Law.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ amɛleee Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ lɛ, shi amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛjalɛ moŋ amɛtaoɔ amɛkɛma shi, hewɔ lɛ amɛbaaa amɛhe shi amɛhãaa Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ lɛ.

english_verse: But Christ makes the Law no longer necessary for those who become acceptable to God by faith. Anyone Can Be Saved
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Kristo ji Mla lɛ naagbee, ni lɛ ji jalɛ hã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ. Yiwalaheremɔ yɛ hã mɛi fɛɛ

english_verse: Moses said a person could become acceptable to God by obeying the Law. He did this when he wrote, “If you want to live, you must do all the Law commands.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Mose ŋma yɛ jalɛ ni jɛ Mla mli lɛ he akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ ni yeɔ enɛɛmɛi anɔ lɛ yi aaana wala yɛ mli.”

english_verse: But people whose faith makes them acceptable to God will never ask, “Who will go up to heaven to bring Christ down?”
translation_verse: Shi bɔ ni jalɛ ni jɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ kɛɔ nɛ, “Kaakɛɛ yɛ otsui mli akɛ, ‘Namɔ aaakwɔ kɛaatee ŋwɛi?’ ” No ji, koni eyaŋɔ Kristo kɛkpeleke shi.

english_verse: Neither will they ask, “Who will go down into the world of the dead to raise him to life?”
translation_verse: Aloo, “Namɔ aaakpeleke shi kɛaatee bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli?” No ji, koni eyaŋɔ Kristo kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ kɛba.

english_verse: All who are acceptable because of their faith simply say, “The message is as near as your mouth or your heart.” And this is the same message we preach about faith.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ te ekɛɔ tɛŋŋ? “Bɛŋkɛmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ebɛŋkɛ bo yɛ odaa mli kɛ otsui mli fɛɛ,” no ji hemɔkɛyeli wiemɔ lɛ ni wɔshiɛɔ lɛ.

english_verse: So you will be saved, if you honestly say, “Jesus is Lord,” and if you believe with all your heart that God raised him from death.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji okɛ onaabu jaje akɛ, “Yesu ji Nuŋtsɔ” lɛ, ni ohe oye yɛ otsui mli akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ, aaahere oyi wala.

english_verse: God will accept you and save you, if you truly believe this and tell it to others.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ tsui akɛheɔ ayeɔ kɛshɛɔ jalɛ he, ni naabu akɛjajeɔ kɛshɛɔ yiwalaheremɔ he.

english_verse: The Scriptures say no one who has faith will be disappointed,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ, ehiɛ gboŋ.”

english_verse: no matter if that person is a Jew or a Gentile. There is only one Lord, and he is generous to everyone who asks for his help.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ srɔto ko bɛ Yudanyo kɛ Helanyo teŋ; ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ kome amɛ fɛɛ amɛyɔɔ, ni niiatsɛ hu ji lɛ ha mɛi fɛɛ ni boɔ tsɛɔ lɛ lɛ.

english_verse: All who call out to the Lord will be saved.
translation_verse: “Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaabo atsɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ, aaahere eyi wala.”

english_verse: How can people have faith in the Lord and ask him to save them, if they have never heard about him? And how can they hear, unless someone tells them?
translation_verse: Shi te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni amɛaabo amɛtsɛ mɔ ni amɛheko lɛ amɛyeko lɛ hu? Ni te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni amɛaahe mɔ ni amɛnuko ehe sane lɛ amɛye hu? Ni asaŋ te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni amɛaanu kɛ shiɛlɔ ko bɛ lɛ?

english_verse: And how can anyone tell them without being sent by the Lord? The Scriptures say it is a beautiful sight to see even the feet of someone coming to preach the good news.
translation_verse: Ni te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni amɛaashiɛ, kɛ atsuko amɛ lɛ? Tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, “Kwɛ bɔ ni Sanekpakpashiɛlɔi ni shiɛɔ nikpakpai lɛ anaji yɔɔ fɛo ha!”

english_verse: Yet not everyone has believed the message. For example, the prophet Isaiah asked, “Lord, has anyone believed what we said?”
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee mɛi fɛɛ bo Sanekpakpa lɛ toi, ejaakɛ Yesaia kɛɔ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, namɔ ehe wɔsane lɛ eye?”

english_verse: No one can have faith without hearing the message about Christ.
translation_verse: Belɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ, sane toiboo mli jɛɔ, ni sane toiboo hu tsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ nɔ kɛbaa.

english_verse: But am I saying that the people of Israel did not hear? No, I am not! The Scriptures say, “The message was told everywhere on earth. It was announced all over the world.”
translation_verse: Shi miibi akɛ, “Aso nu amɛnuuu?” Anɔkwale mli lɛ amɛnu, tamɔ bɔ ni ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, “Amɛgbee ejije kɛtee shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Ni amɛwiemɔi lɛ eshɛ jeŋ naagbeehei lɛ.”

english_verse: Did the people of Israel understand or not? Moses answered this question when he told that the Lord had said, “I will make Israel jealous of people who are a nation of nobodies. I will make them angry with people who don't understand a thing.”
translation_verse: Shi miibi hu akɛ, “Aso le Israel leee?” Mose etsɔ̃ hiɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mahã nyɛye maŋ ni jeee maŋ ko he awuŋã, ni mikɛ maŋ ko ni leee nɔ ko aaawo nyɛ mlila.”

english_verse: Isaiah was fearless enough to tell that the Lord had said, “I was found by people who were not looking for me. I appeared to the ones who were not asking about me.”
translation_verse: Yesaia kɛ ekãa kɛɛ, “Mihã mɛi ni taooo mi lɛ na mi, Ni mijie mihe kpo mitsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni biko mishi lɛ.”

english_verse: And Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “All day long the Lord has reached out to people who are stubborn and refuse to obey.”
translation_verse: Shi Israel lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Daa jenamɔ migbɛɔ minijiaŋ mihãa maŋ toigbolɔi kɛ sanenaajielɔi lɛ.”

english_verse: Am I saying that God has turned his back on his people? Certainly not! I am one of the people of Israel, and I myself am a descendant of Abraham from the tribe of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ miibi akɛ, “Belɛ Nyɔŋmɔ eshɛ emaŋ lɛ efɔ̃?” Dabida! Ejaakɛ mi hu Israelnyo ji mi, ni mijɛ Abraham shwiei kɛ Benyamin akutso lɛ mli.

english_verse: God did not turn his back on his chosen people. Don't you remember reading in the Scriptures how Elijah complained to God about the people of Israel?
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ shɛko emaŋ ni ele eto momo lɛ efɔ̃ko. Aloo nyɛleee nɔ ni ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɛ yɛ Elia yi nɔ lɛ, be ni edamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ni efolɔɔ Israel naa akɛ,

english_verse: He said, “Lord, they killed your prophets and destroyed your altars. I am the only one left, and now they want to kill me.”
translation_verse: “Nuŋtsɔ, ogbalɔi lɛ, amɛgbe amɛ, ni ofɔleshãalatɛi lɛ, amɛwule amɛshwie shi, ni eshwɛ mi kome too, ni amɛmiitao mi amɛgbe.”

english_verse: This means that only a chosen few of the people of Israel found what all of them were searching for. And the rest of them were stubborn,
translation_verse: Belɛ te tɛŋŋ? Nɔ ni Israel taoɔ lɛ enine shɛɛɛ nɔ; shi mɛi ni ahala lɛ anine shɛ nɔ, ni mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, awaje amɛtsui,

english_verse: It is the same way now. God treated the people of Israel with undeserved grace, and so a few of them are still his followers.
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ amrɔ nɛɛ hu eshwɛ mɛi komɛi yɛ dromɔ halamɔ naa.

english_verse: This happened because of God's undeserved kindness and not because of anything they have done. It could not have happened except for God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji dromɔ lɛ naa ni lɛ, belɛ jeee nitsumɔi anaa ni dɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ no lɛ dromɔ lɛ jeee dromɔ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “God made them so stupid that their eyes are blind, and their ears are still deaf.”
translation_verse: tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ ehã amɛ shɔ̃ɔfeemɔ ko, hiŋmɛii ni amɛkɛnaaa nii, kɛ toii ni amɛkɛnuuu nii kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: Then David said, “Turn their meals into bait for a trap, so that they will stumble and be given what they deserve.
translation_verse: Ni David kɛɛ akɛ, “Hã amɛkpɔlɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ akpa kɛ loofɔlɔduu tsɔne kɛ tɛmɔnɔ kɛ toigbalamɔ ahã amɛ.

english_verse: Blindfold their eyes! Don't let them see. Bend their backs beneath a burden that will never be lifted.” Gentiles Will Be Saved
translation_verse: Hã amɛhiɛ awo duŋ, ni amɛkana nii, ni ohã amɛdɔ kɔmɔɔ daa.”

english_verse: Do I mean that the people of Israel fell, never to get up again? Certainly not! Their failure made it possible for the Gentiles to be saved, and this will make the people of Israel jealous.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ miibi akɛ, “Belɛ amɛtɛrɛ koni amɛgbee shi?” Dabida! Shi moŋ atsɔ̃ amɛshigbeemɔ lɛ nɔ ahere jeŋmaji lɛ ayi wala, koni Israel aye awuŋã.

english_verse: But if the rest of the world's people were helped so much by their sin and loss, they will be helped even more by their full return.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ amɛshigbeemɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ je lɛ ninamɔ, ni amɛnɔgbɔmɔ lɛ hu tsɔ̃ jeŋmaji aninamɔ lɛ, belɛ amɛyifalɛ lɛ te eeehã ninamɔ lɛ afee tɛŋŋ? Jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ ayiwalaheremɔ

english_verse: I am now speaking to you Gentiles, and as long as I am an apostle to you, I will take pride in my work.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ nyɛ ni nyɛ ji jeŋmajiabii lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, “Gbii abɔ ni mi mi ji jeŋmaji abɔfo lɛ, mawo misɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam,

english_verse: I hope in this way to make some of my own people jealous enough to be saved.
translation_verse: akɛ aleenɔ mikɛaahã mijakubii lɛ aye awuŋã, ni mahere amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ayiwala lo.

english_verse: When Israel rejected God, the rest of the people in the world were able to turn to him. So when God makes friends with Israel, it will be like bringing the dead back to life.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ amɛshɛmɔkɛfɔ̃ɔ lɛ ehã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ je lɛ ekpãtã lɛ, belɛ amɛheremɔ lɛ, ani jeee wala ni jɛ gbohii ateŋ ni?

english_verse: If part of a batch of dough is made holy by being offered to God, then all of the dough is holy. If the roots of a tree are holy, the rest of the tree is holy too.
translation_verse: “Shi kɛji fioo ni ajie ahã Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, belɛ nakai masui lɛ fɛɛ hu yɔɔ; ni kɛ tso shishifã lɛ yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, belɛ nakai niji lɛ hu yɔɔ.

english_verse: You Gentiles are like branches of a wild olive tree made to be part of a cultivated olive tree. You have taken the place of some branches that were cut away from it. And because of this, you enjoy the blessings that come from being part of that cultivated tree.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji akumɔ tso niji lɛ ekomɛi, ni abatɛo bo ni oji ŋaŋmutso lɛ yɛ amɛnajiaŋ, ni ona mutso lɛ shishifã lɛ kɛ emlinu lɛ eko lɛ,

english_verse: But don't think you are better than the branches that were cut away. Just remember you are not supporting the roots of this tree. Its roots are supporting you.
translation_verse: kaashwã yɛ niji lɛ anɔ; shi kɛji oshwã yɛ amɛnɔ lɛ, naa, jeee bo ohiɛ shishifã lɛ, shi shishifã lɛ moŋ hiɛ bo.”

english_verse: Maybe you think those branches were cut away, so you could be put in their place.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ ekolɛ oookɛɛ akɛ, “Kuumɔ akumɔ niji lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni atɛo mi awo tso lɛ mli.”

english_verse: That's true enough. But they were cut away because they did not have faith, and you are where you are because you do have faith. So don't be proud, but be afraid.
translation_verse: Ojogbaŋŋ! He ni amɛheee amɛyeee hewɔ akumɔ amɛ; ni bo lɛ, hemɔkɛyeli okɛdamɔ shi lɛ. Kaawo ohe nɔ, shi moŋ she ohe gbeyei;

english_verse: If God cut away those natural branches, couldn't he do the same to you?
translation_verse: ejaakɛ, kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ebaaa tso lɛ diɛŋtsɛ niji lɛ ayi lɛ, bo hu ebaaŋ oyi.

english_verse: Now you see both how kind and how hard God can be. He was hard on those who fell, but he was kind to you. And he will keep on being kind to you, if you keep on trusting in his kindness. Otherwise, you will be cut away too.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, kwɛmɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mlihilɛ kɛ bɔ ni ekɛ mɔ yeɔ waa hu, ekɛ mɛi ni egbee shi lɛ yeɔ waa, shi bo lɛ, emli hi yɛ onɔ kɛji ohi emlihilɛ lɛ mli lɛ; kɛjeee nakai lɛ, bo hu aaafo bo ashɛ afɔ̃.

english_verse: If those other branches will start having faith, they will be made a part of that tree again. God has the power to put them back.
translation_verse: Ni amɛ hu, kɛji amɛhiɛɛɛ he ni amɛheee amɛyeee lɛ mli lɛ, aaatɛo amɛ awo mli; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaanyɛ atɛo amɛ awo mli ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: After all, it wasn't natural for branches to be cut from a wild olive tree and to be made part of a cultivated olive tree. So it is much more likely that God will join the natural branches back to the cultivated olive tree. The People of Israel Will Be Brought Back
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ, kɛji bo lɛ, fo afo bo yɛ tso ni yɛ bɔɔsu naa lɛ ŋaŋmutso ni lɛ he, ni atɛo bo awo mutso kpakpa lɛ mli, ni jeee adebɔɔ gbɛ ni lɛ, mɛnɛɛmɛi ni ji tso lɛ diɛŋtsɛ niji lɛ, enyiɛ nɔŋŋ ni atɛoŋ amɛ awoŋ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmutso lɛ mli! Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Israel baawo egbɛhe ekoŋŋ

english_verse: My friends, I don't want you Gentiles to be too proud of yourselves. So I will explain the mystery of what has happened to the people of Israel. Some of them have become stubborn, and they will stay like that until the complete number of you Gentiles has come in.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ misumɔɔɔ akɛ mishiuɔ nyɛ nɛkɛ teemɔ sane nɛɛ nɔ, anyɛmimɛi, koni nyɛkabu nyɛhe oleetei, akɛ, wajemɔ awaje Israel tsui fã kɛ fã kɛyashi beyinɔ ni jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ aaaba mli.

english_verse: In this way all of Israel will be saved, as the Scriptures say, “From Zion someone will come to rescue us. Then Jacob's descendants will stop being evil.
translation_verse: Ni nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ aaatsɔ̃ ahere Israel fɛɛ yiwala, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, “Jielɔ lɛ aaajɛ Zion aba ni eeebajie nɔshafeemɔ yɛ Yakob he eshɛ efɔ̃;

english_verse: This is what the Lord has promised to do when he forgives their sins.”
translation_verse: ni enɛ ji mi kɛ amɛ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ, akɛ majie amɛhe eshai lɛ kɛaatee.”

english_verse: The people of Israel are treated as God's enemies, so the good news can come to you Gentiles. But they are still the chosen ones, and God loves them because of their famous ancestors.
translation_verse: Yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ henyɛlɔi ji amɛ yɛ nyɛhewɔ; shi yɛ halamɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ asumɔɔ amɛ yɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: God doesn't take back the gifts he has given or disown the people he has chosen.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shwaaa ehe yɛ edromɔ nii lɛ kɛ etsɛmɔ lɛ he.

english_verse: At one time you Gentiles rejected God. But now Israel has rejected God, and you have been shown mercy.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni sa lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛbooo Nyɔŋmɔ toi, shi agbɛnɛ ana nyɛ mɔbɔ yɛ amɛtoigbele lɛ hewɔ lɛ,

english_verse: And because of the mercy shown to you, they will also be shown mercy.
translation_verse: nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ amɛ hu agbɛnɛ amɛtoi egbo, koni bɔ ni ana nyɛ mɔbɔ lɛ, amɛ hu ana amɛ mɔbɔ.

english_verse: All people have disobeyed God, and that's why he treats them as prisoners. But he does this, so that he can have mercy on all of them.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ eŋamɔ mɛi fɛɛ ayi ewo toigbele mli, bɔ ni afee ni ena amɛ fɛɛ mɔbɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ

english_verse: Who can measure the wealth and wisdom and knowledge of God? Who can understand his decisions or explain what he does?
translation_verse: Ao, Nyɔŋmɔ nifalɛ kɛ ŋaa kɛ nilee mlikwɔlɛ! Ekojomɔi lɛ anyɛɛɛ shishi ana, ni egbɛi lɛ hu anyɛɛɛ sɛɛ mo aja!

english_verse: “Has anyone known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ “Namɔ le Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, Aloo namɔ ewo lɛ ŋaa pɛŋ?

english_verse: Has anyone loaned something to the Lord that must be repaid?”
translation_verse: Aloo namɔ etsɔ̃ hiɛ ehã lɛ nɔ ko, ni kulɛ aaato lɛ najiaŋ?”

english_verse: Everything comes from the Lord. All things were made because of him and will return to him. Praise the Lord forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ edɛŋ nii fɛɛ jɛ, ni enɔ amɛtsɔ̃ kɛba, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ amɛyɔɔ amɛhã. Lɛ aaaŋɔ anunyam ahã kɛya naanɔ. Amen!

english_verse: Dear friends, God is good. So I beg you to offer your bodies to him as a living sacrifice, pure and pleasing. That's the most sensible way to serve God.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, mikɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlitsɔlɛ miikpa nyɛ fai akɛ nyɛŋɔ nyɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ nyɛdamɔ shi akɛ afɔle ni hiɛ kã ni he tse ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; enɛ ji jamɔ ni sa.

english_verse: Don't be like the people of this world, but let God change the way you think. Then you will know how to do everything that is good and pleasing to him.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛkabaa nyɛjeŋ tamɔ jeŋbii, shi moŋ nyɛkɛ nyɛjwɛŋmɔ ni etsɔ̃ ehee lɛ afea nyɛhe gbɔmɛi hei, koni nyɛyoo nii ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii kpakpai ni sa ehiɛ jogbaŋŋ ni hi kɛwula shi lɛ.

english_verse: I realize God has treated me with undeserved grace, and so I tell each of you not to think you are better than you really are. Use good sense and measure yourself by the amount of faith that God has given you.
translation_verse: Shi miitsɔ̃ dromɔ ni akɛduro mi lɛ nɔ miikɛɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akɛ, ekabu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe tuutu fe bɔ ni sa; shi moŋ ejwɛŋ kɛ hiɛshikãmɔ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehã lɛ lɛ naa.

english_verse: A body is made up of many parts, and each of them has its own use.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni gbɔmɔtso kome he lɛ wɔyɛ henii pii, shi henii lɛ fɛɛ tsuuu nitsumɔ kome lɛ,

english_verse: That's how it is with us. There are many of us, but we each are part of the body of Christ, as well as part of one another.
translation_verse: nakai nɔŋŋ wɔyi pii nɛɛ gbɔmɔtso kome ji wɔ yɛ Kristo mli, ni wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ enaanyohenɔ ji lɛ,

english_verse: God has also given each of us different gifts to use. If we can prophesy, we should do it according to the amount of faith we have.
translation_verse: ni dromɔ ni akɛhã wɔ lɛ naa lɛ, wɔyɛ dromɔ keenii srɔtoi, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enɔ; kɛji mɔ ko nɔ ji akɛ egba lɛ, egba yɛ hemɔkɛyeli bɔ ni akɛhã lɛ lɛ naa;

english_verse: If we can serve others, we should serve. If we can teach, we should teach.
translation_verse: kɛji sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni lɛ, ehiɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli; kɛ tsɔɔlɔ ji mɔ lɛ, ehiɛ nitsɔɔmɔ lɛ mli;

english_verse: If we can encourage others, we should encourage them. If we can give, we should be generous. If we are leaders, we should do our best. If we are good to others, we should do it cheerfully. Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: mɔ ni wieɔ tsɔ̃ɔ mɛi lɛ, ehiɛ wiemɔ kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli; mɔ ni kɛ enii feɔ ejurɔ lɛ, efee kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ; mɔ ni yeɔ onukpa lɛ, ebɔ mɔdɛŋ; mɔ ni naa mɔbɔ lɛ, efee kɛ tsuijurɔ. Jeŋba ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ

english_verse: Be sincere in your love for others. Hate everything that is evil and hold tight to everything that is good.
translation_verse: Suɔmɔ lɛ osato akahi mli. Nyɛhia efɔŋ kwraa; nyɛ kpɛtɛa ekpakpa he;

english_verse: Love each other as brothers and sisters and honor others more than you do yourself.
translation_verse: nyɛkɛ nyɛmimɛi asuɔmɔ ni mli wa asumɔsumɔa nyɛhe; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ atsɔ̃ hiɛ ekɛ woo ahã enaanyo.

english_verse: Never give up. Eagerly follow the Holy Spirit and serve the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛmɔdɛŋbɔɔ lɛ naa akabaa shi; nyɛmumɔ lɛ he adɔa la; nyɛsɔ̃mɔa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Let your hope make you glad. Be patient in time of trouble and never stop praying.
translation_verse: Nyɛnyãa yɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ mli; nyɛmiaa nyɛhiɛ yɛ amanehulu mli; nyɛhiɛa sɔlemɔ mli daa.

english_verse: Take care of God's needy people and welcome strangers into your home.
translation_verse: Nyɛhãa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ahiamɔ lɛ afea nyɛ hu nyɛhiamɔ; nyɛbɔa gbɔfeemɔ he mɔdɛŋ.

english_verse: Ask God to bless everyone who mistreats you. Ask him to bless them and not to curse them.
translation_verse: Nyɛjɔa mɛi ni waa nyɛ yi lɛ, nyɛjɔa ni nyɛkalomɔa.

english_verse: When others are happy, be happy with them, and when they are sad, be sad.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ mɛi ni nyãa lɛ anyãa, ni nyɛkɛ mɛi ni foɔ lɛ afoa.

english_verse: Be friendly with everyone. Don't be proud and feel that you know more than others. Make friends with ordinary people.
translation_verse: Nyɛjwɛŋjwɛŋa nyɛhe jwɛŋmɔ kome; nyɛkajwɛŋa henɔwomɔ jwɛŋmɔ, shi moŋ nyɛkɛ heshibalɔi lɛ abɔa. Nyɛkabua nyɛhe nilelɔi.

english_verse: Don't mistreat someone who has mistreated you. But try to earn the respect of others,
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ efɔŋ akatoa mɔ ko mɔ ko efɔŋ najiaŋ; nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ ni yɔɔ fɛo yɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ nyɛtoa.

english_verse: and do your best to live at peace with everyone.
translation_verse: Kɛ aaaho lɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋ lɛ, nyɛkɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ahia shi yɛ hejɔlɛ mli.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't try to get even. Let God take revenge. In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I am the one to take revenge and pay them back.”
translation_verse: Suɔlɔi, nyɛkatɔa nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe owele, shi moŋ nyɛŋmɛa Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu lɛ gbɛ; ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, “Minɔ ji oweletɔɔ, mi mato najiaŋ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink. This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji hɔ̃mɔ miiye ohenyɛlɔ lɛ, hã lɛ nii eye; kɛji kumai miiye lɛ lɛ, hã lɛ nu enu; ejaakɛ kɛ ofee nakai lɛ, obaabua ŋai kɛ la naa oshwie eyiteŋ.

english_verse: Don't let evil defeat you, but defeat evil with good.
translation_verse: Kaahã efɔŋ miiye onɔ kunim, shi moŋ okɛ ekpakpafeemɔ aye efɔŋ nɔ kunim.

english_verse: Obey the rulers who have authority over you. Only God can give authority to anyone, and he puts these rulers in their places of power.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aba ehe shi ahã hegbɛi ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ. Ejaakɛ hegbɛ ko bɛ ni jeee Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ejɛ; hegbɛi ni yɔɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ to.

english_verse: People who oppose the authorities are opposing what God has done, and they will be punished.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kuɔ hegbɛ lɛ naa lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ eteɔ shi eshiɔ lɛ; ni mɛi ni teɔ shi nakai lɛ aaana amɛkojomɔ.

english_verse: Rulers are a threat to evil people, not to good people. There is no need to be afraid of the authorities. Just do right, and they will praise you for it.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ lumɛi lɛ, amɛhe bɛ gbeyei hã mɔ ni feɔ ekpakpa, shi hã mɔ ni feɔ efɔŋ moŋ; shi kɛji otaooo akɛ nɔyelɔ lɛ he ahi gbeyei ahã bo lɛ, feemɔ ekpakpa, ni ooona yijiemɔ yɛ edɛŋ;

english_verse: After all, they are God's servants, and it is their duty to help you. If you do something wrong, you ought to be afraid, because these rulers have the right to punish you. They are God's servants who punish criminals to show how angry God is.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔlɔ ji lɛ yɛ ohewɔ, koni ahi ahã bo. Shi kɛji ofee efɔŋ lɛ, she gbeyei; ejaakɛ jeee yaka ehiɛ tsi lɛ; shi eji Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ oweletɔlɔ ni hãa Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu baa mɔ ni tsuɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: But you should obey the rulers because you know it is the right thing to do, and not just because of God's anger.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, sa akɛ abaa he shi, jeee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu lɛ kɛkɛ hewɔ, shi moŋ henilee hewɔ hu.

english_verse: You must also pay your taxes. The authorities are God's servants, and it is their duty to take care of these matters.
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ ni nyɛtsuɔ onia hu lɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsuji ji amɛ, ni nɛkɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ he amɛyɔɔ.

english_verse: Let love be your only debt! If you love others, you have done all that the Law demands.
translation_verse: Nyɛkahiɛa mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɔmɔ, akɛ ja suɔmɔ ni nyɛkɛaasumɔsumɔ nyɛhe lɛ; ejaakɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ enaanyo lɛ eye Mla lɛ nɔ kɛwula shi.

english_verse: In the Law there are many commands, such as, “Be faithful in marriage. Do not murder. Do not steal. Do not want what belongs to others.” But all of these are summed up in the command that says, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛji akɛɛ akɛ, “Kaafite gbãlã! Kaaju! Ohiɛ akakɔ̃ nɔ ko nɔ!” Ni kɛ kitã kroko hu yɛ lɛ, fɛɛ hɔ nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ ni ji “Suɔmɔ onaanyo tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe” lɛ mli.

english_verse: No one who loves others will harm them. So love is all that the Law demands. The Day When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Suɔmɔ efeee enaanyo efɔŋ ko, hewɔ lɛ suɔmɔ pɛ ji Mla lɛ fɛɛ nɔyeli. Ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ ebɛŋkɛ

english_verse: You know what sort of times we live in, and so you should live properly. It is time to wake up. You know that the day when we will be saved is nearer now than when we first put our faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛle enɛ hu, no ji be lɛ, akɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa ni nyɛkɛaate shi kɛjɛ wɔ mli lɛ eshɛ; ejaakɛ wɔyiwalaheremɔ lɛ ebɛŋkɛ agbɛnɛ fe tsutsu be ni wɔhe wɔye lɛ.

english_verse: Night is almost over, and day will soon appear. We must stop behaving as people do in the dark and be ready to live in the light.
translation_verse: Nyɔɔŋ lɛ eho etã, ni jetsɛremɔ ebɛŋkɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔjiea duŋ mli nitsumɔi lɛ wɔshwiea, ni wɔwo la tawuunii lɛ.

english_verse: So behave properly, as people do in the day. Don't go to wild parties or get drunk or be vulgar or indecent. Don't quarrel or be jealous.
translation_verse: Nyɛhãa wɔnyiɛa fɛɛfɛo bɔ ni sa shwane, jeee yɛ dãanumɔ mli basabasafeemɔ kɛ dãatɔɔ mli; jeee ajwamãŋbɔɔ kɛ nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ mli, jeee bei kɛ awuŋayeli mli;

english_verse: Let the Lord Jesus Christ be as near to you as the clothes you wear. Then you won't try to satisfy your selfish desires.
translation_verse: shi moŋ nyɛwoa Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo tamɔ dama, ni nyɛkahãa heloo lɛ nɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ miitsɔ̃ heloo lɛ sɛɛdii.

english_verse: Welcome all the Lord's followers, even those whose faith is weak. Don't criticize them for having beliefs that are different from yours.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni ji gbedelɔ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ nyɛherea lɛ atuu; shi nyɛkɛ lɛ akakojoa yɛ esusumɔi ahe.

english_verse: Some think it is all right to eat anything, while those whose faith is weak will eat only vegetables.
translation_verse: Mɔ ko yɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni ekɛyeɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ; shi mɔ ni egbede lɛ, shwie kɛkɛ eyeɔ.

english_verse: But you should not criticize others for eating or for not eating. After all, God welcomes everyone.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ akagbe mɔ ni yeee lɛ he guɔ, ni mɔ ni yeee lɛ akakojo mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehere lɛ atuu.

english_verse: What right do you have to criticize someone else's servants? Only their Lord can decide if they are doing right, and the Lord will make sure that they do right.
translation_verse: Namɔ ji bo ni okojoɔ mɔ kroko wenuu? Edamɔ shi jio, egbee shi jio, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enuŋtsɔ sane ni; shi eeedamɔ shi, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ hewalɛ ni eeehã edamɔ shi.

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers think one day is more important than another. Others think all days are the same. But each of you should make up your own mind.
translation_verse: Mɔ ko buɔ gbi ko fe gbi kroko, ni mɔ ko hu buɔ gbi fɛɛ gbi pɛpɛɛpɛ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ale nɔ krɛdɛɛ ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ejwɛŋmɔ yɛ enɛ he.

english_verse: Any followers who count one day more important than another day do it to honor their Lord. And any followers who eat meat give thanks to God, just like the ones who don't eat meat.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni buɔ gbi titri ko lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewɔ efeɔ. Mɔ ni yeɔ nii lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewɔ eyeɔ, ejaakɛ edaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi; ni mɔ ni yeee nii lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewɔ eyeee, ni lɛ hu edaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for God, rather than for ourselves.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔteŋ mɔ ko hiɛ kãaa hãaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe, ni mɔ ko gbooo hu hãaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for the Lord. Alive or dead, we still belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji wɔhiɛ kã lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wɔhiɛ kã wɔhã; ni kɛji wɔgboi hu, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wɔgboi wɔhã. No hewɔ lɛ, wɔhiɛ kã jio, wɔgboi jio, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nii ji wɔ.

english_verse: This is because Christ died and rose to life, so that he would be the Lord of the dead and of the living.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ enɛ hewɔ Kristo gbo ni ete shi ni ehiɛ kã bɔ ni afee ni etsɔ̃ gbohii kɛ hiɛkãalɔi fɛɛ aNuŋtsɔ.

english_verse: Why do you criticize other followers of the Lord? Why do you look down on them? The day is coming when God will judge all of us.
translation_verse: Shi bo, mɛɛba okojoɔ onyɛmi? Aloo bo hu, mɛɛba ogbeɔ onyɛmi he guɔ? Ejaakɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔbaadamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kojomɔ sɛi lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “I swear by my very life that everyone will kneel down and praise my name!”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, ‘Akɛni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ nakutso fɛɛ nakutso aaakula shi ahã mi, ni lilɛi fɛɛ lilɛi aaajaje Nyɔŋmɔ atsɔ̃ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: And so, each of us must give an account to God for what we do. Don't Cause Problems for Others
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baabu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe akɔntaa ehã Nyɔŋmɔ. Kaato onyɛmi pampi

english_verse: We must stop judging others. We must also make up our minds not to upset anyone's faith.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkahãa wɔkojokojoa wɔhe dɔŋŋ; shi enɛ moŋ nyɛkojoa, akɛ mɔ ko kɛ tɛmɔnɔ ko akama enyɛmi gbɛ nɔ aloo eto lɛ pampi.

english_verse: The Lord Jesus has made it clear to me that God considers all foods fit to eat. But if you think some foods are unfit to eat, then for you they are not fit.
translation_verse: Mile ni misaa miyɛ hewalɛ yɛ nɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu mli akɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni eji bulemɔnɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ. Mɔ ni buɔ nɔ ko akɛ bulemɔnɔ ni lɛ, lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ bulemɔnɔ ehãa.

english_verse: If you are hurting others by the foods you eat, you are not guided by love. Don't let your appetite destroy someone Christ died for.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji nɔ ko ni oyeɔ lɛ gbaa onyɛmi naa lɛ, belɛ jeee suɔmɔ naa obaa ojeŋ yɛ lɛ dɔŋŋ. Okɛ oniyenii lɛ akakpãtã mɔ ni Kristo gbo hã lɛ lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: Don't let your right to eat bring shame to Christ.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkahãa awiea nyɛnɔ kpakpa lɛ he efɔŋ.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't about eating and drinking. It is about pleasing God, about living in peace, and about true happiness. All this comes from the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ jeee niyeli kɛ ninumɔ ni, shi moŋ jalɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ mli miishɛɛ ni;

english_verse: If you serve Christ in this way, you will please God and be respected by people.
translation_verse: ni mɔ ni sɔ̃mɔɔ Kristo yɛ enɛɛmɛi amli lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ naa ehe tsuijurɔ ni esa gbɔmɛi ahiɛ hu.

english_verse: We should try to live at peace and help each other have a strong faith.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛhãa wɔtiua hejɔlɛ nibii kɛ nibii ni wɔkɛhã wɔnanemɛi anane amɔ shi moŋ sɛɛ.

english_verse: Don't let your appetite destroy what God has done. All foods are fit to eat, but it is wrong to cause problems for others by what you eat.
translation_verse: Kaafite Nyɔŋmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ yɛ niyenii ko hewɔ. Nibii fɛɛ he tse nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ eji efɔŋ hã gbɔmɔ ni yeɔ ekɛtoɔ pampi lɛ.

english_verse: It is best not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else that causes problems for other followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ehi akɛ okaye loo ni asaŋ okanu wain loo nɔ ko ni aaato onyɛmi pampi.

english_verse: What you believe about these things should be kept between you and God. You are fortunate, if your actions don't make you have doubts.
translation_verse: Bo lɛ oyɛ hemɔkɛyeli? Okɛto oha bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. Ajɔɔ mɔ ni ekojooo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe yɛ nɔ ni ebuɔ akɛ ehi lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: But if you do have doubts about what you eat, you are going against your beliefs. And you know that is wrong, because anything you do against your beliefs is sin.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni yiŋ etɛ̃ɛɛ lɛ lɛ, kɛji eye lɛ, eyeɔ fɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ejaakɛ ejɛɛɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli eyeee; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni jɛɛɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ esha ni.

english_verse: If our faith is strong, we should be patient with the Lord's followers whose faith is weak. We should try to please them instead of ourselves.
translation_verse: Wɔ mɛi ni wɔyɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ, esa akɛ wɔkɛ mɛi ni bɛ hewalɛ lɛ agbɔjɔmɔi lɛ kpeɔ amɛ, ni wɔhe akasa wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhiɛ.

english_verse: We should think of their good and try to help them by doing what pleases them.
translation_verse: Wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ asa enaanyo hiɛ, koni ahi ahã lɛ ni enane amɔ shi.

english_verse: Even Christ did not try to please himself. But as the Scriptures say, “The people who insulted you also insulted me.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Kristo hu hãaa ehe asa ehiɛ; shi moŋ tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ, “Mɛi ni bɔɔ bo ahora lɛ ahorabɔi lɛ ebakã minɔ.”

english_verse: And the Scriptures were written to teach and encourage us by giving us hope.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nibii abɔ ni aŋma ato momo lɛ, aŋma ni etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ nii, koni wɔkɛ hiɛmiamɔ kɛ ŋmalɛi lɛ amli miishɛjemɔ lɛ ana hiɛnɔkãmɔ.

english_verse: God is the one who makes us patient and cheerful. I pray that he will help you live at peace with each other, as you follow Christ.
translation_verse: Ni Nyɔŋmɔ ni hãa wɔnyɛɔ wɔhiɛ wɔmĩaa ni eshɛjeɔ wɔmii lɛ ahã nyɛna jwɛŋmɔ kome yɛ nyɛteŋ tamɔ Kristo Yesu,

english_verse: Then all of you together will praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. The Good News Is for Jews and Gentiles
translation_verse: koni nyɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome kɛ naabu kome awo Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ lɛ, hiɛ nyam. Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ hã Yudafoi kɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii fɛɛ

english_verse: Honor God by accepting each other, as Christ has accepted you.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhereherea nyɛhe, tamɔ bɔ ni Kristo ehere nyɛ kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: I tell you that Christ came as a servant of the Jews to show that God has kept the promises he made to their famous ancestors. Christ also came,
translation_verse: Shi miikɛɛ akɛ Yesu Kristo tsɔ̃ sɔ̃ɔlɔ ehã Yudafoi lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwale lɛ hewɔ, koni ekɛmã shiwoi ni awo tsɛmɛi lɛ anɔ mi;

english_verse: so that the Gentiles would praise God for being kind to them. It is just as the Scriptures say, “I will tell the nations about you, and I will sing praises to your name.”
translation_verse: ni jeŋmaji lɛ awo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ mɔbɔnalɛ hewɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, “Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, majie oyi yɛ jeŋmaji ateŋ, ni matsi ogbɛi tã mala.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say to the Gentiles, “Come and celebrate with God's people.”
translation_verse: Ni Ŋmalɛ lɛ saa kɛɛ, “Nyɛ jeŋmaji, nyɛ kɛ emaŋ lɛ mli afilia nyɛ!”

english_verse: Again the Scriptures say, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles. All you nations, come and worship him.”
translation_verse: Ni asaŋ, “Nyɛjiea Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yi, nyɛ jeŋmaji fɛɛ, ni nyɛkafoa lɛ, nyɛ maji fɛɛ!”

english_verse: Isaiah says, “Someone from David's family will come to power. He will rule the nations, and they will put their hope in him.”
translation_verse: Ni asaŋ Yesaia kɛɛ akɛ, “Ishai shishifã lɛ aaaba, mɔ hu ni aaate shi koni ebaye jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ lɛ; lɛ enɔ jeŋmaji lɛ kɛ amɛhiɛ aaafɔ̃.”

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives hope, will bless you with complete happiness and peace because of your faith. And may the power of the Holy Spirit fill you with hope. Paul's Work as a Missionary
translation_verse: Shi Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔhiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ fɛɛ awo nyɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃ɔbɔ̃ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli, koni nyɛna hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni ateke nɔ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ hewalɛ mli. Nɔ hewɔ ni Paulo kɛ ekãa ŋma wolo nɛɛ

english_verse: My friends, I am sure that you are very good and that you have all the knowledge you need to teach each other.
translation_verse: Shi anyɛmimɛi, mi diɛŋtsɛ hu miheɔ miyeɔ krɛdɛɛ yɛ nyɛhe akɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu nyɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ɔbɔ̃ kɛ mlihilɛ; ni nilee fɛɛ eyimɔ nyɛ tɔ, ni nyɛnyɛɔ nyɛwieɔ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛhe hu.

english_verse: But I have spoken to you plainly and have tried to remind you of some things. God treated me with undeserved grace!
translation_verse: Shi, mikɛ ekãa pii ŋmala saji nɛɛ ekomɛi mihã nyɛ, koni mikɛkai nyɛ, yɛ dromɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛduro mi lɛ hewɔ;

english_verse: He chose me to be a servant of Christ Jesus for the Gentiles and to do the work of a priest in the service of his good news. God did this so that the Holy Spirit could make the Gentiles into a holy offering, pleasing to him.
translation_verse: koni mitsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo sɔ̃ɔlɔ mihã jeŋmaji lɛ, ni mitsu Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ he nii akɛ osɔfo, ni jeŋmaji lɛ atsɔ̃mɔ afɔle ni sa ehiɛ jogbaŋŋ ni atsuu he yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ mli.

english_verse: Because of Christ Jesus, I can take pride in my service for God.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, miyɛ shwãanɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli yɛ nii ni mitsuɔ mihãa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hewɔ;

english_verse: In fact, all I will talk about is how Christ let me speak and work, so that the Gentiles would obey him.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ mikaŋ akɛ mawie nɔ ko akɛ ja nɔ ni Kristo tsɔ̃ minɔ etsu ehã jeŋmaji lɛ atoiboo yɛ wiemɔ kɛ nifeemɔnii amli,

english_verse: Indeed, I will tell how Christ worked miracles and wonders by the power of the Holy Spirit. I have preached the good news about him all the way from Jerusalem to Illyricum.
translation_verse: yɛ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii ahewalɛ mli, yɛ Mumɔ hewalɛ mli; bɔ ni fee nɛ ni mijɛ Yerusalɛm mibɔle shi aahu kɛyashi Ilirikum ni mishiɛ Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ migbe naa.

english_verse: But I have always tried to preach where people have never heard about Christ. I am like a builder who doesn't build on someone else's foundation.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni mikɛmã mihiɛ titri ji akɛ, he ni atsiko Kristo gbɛi tã yɛ lɛ, jɛi majaje Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ, bɔ ni afee ni mikayatswa mɔ kroko shishitoo nɔ;

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “All who haven't been told about him will see him, and those who haven't heard about him will understand.” Paul's Plan To Visit Rome
translation_verse: shi moŋ tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, “Mɛi ni ajajeko ehe sane ko atsɔ̃ko amɛ lɛ, amɛaana, ni mɛi ni nuko lɛ, amɛaanu shishi.” Paulo to eyiŋ akɛ eeeya Roma

english_verse: My work has always kept me from coming to see you.
translation_verse: Enɛ nɔŋŋ etsi mi gbɛ aahu ni mibako nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Now there is nothing left for me to do in this part of the world, and for years I have wanted to visit you.
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ akɛni mibɛ nɔ ko tsumɔ yɛ biɛ niiaŋ dɔŋŋ, ni misaa mije afii pii miitao akɛ mibaa nyɛŋɔɔ hewɔ lɛ,

english_verse: So I plan to stop off on my way to Spain. Then after a short, but refreshing, visit with you, I hope you will quickly send me on.
translation_verse: be fɛɛ be ni mafã gbɛ kɛaatee Tarshish lɛ, maba nyɛŋɔɔ; ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ, kɛ miiho lɛ, mabakwɛ nyɛhiɛ, koni, kɛji mina miishɛɛ fioo yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ tswɛm lɛ, nyɛyajie mi gbɛ kɛya jɛi.

english_verse: I am now on my way to Jerusalem to deliver the money that the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia collected for God's needy people.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Makedonia kɛ Akaia fɛɛ kɛ tsuijurɔ etsu onia ko kɛhã krɔŋkrɔŋbii ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ ateŋ ohiafoi lɛ.

english_verse: This is something they really wanted to do. But sharing their money with the Jews was also like paying back a debt, because the Jews had already shared their spiritual blessings with the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Tsuijurɔ naa amɛfee yɛ lɛɛlɛŋ moŋ, shi asaŋ amɛhiɛ amɛ nyɔmɔ. Ejaakɛ kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ena amɛmumɔŋ nikpakpai lɛ eko lɛ, belɛ esa akɛ amɛ hu amɛkɛ heloo nikpakpai lɛ eko asɔ̃mɔ amɛ.

english_verse: After I have safely delivered this money, I will visit you and then go on to Spain.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ mina migbe enɛ naa ni misɔo nɛkɛ yibii nɛɛ anaa mihã amɛ lɛ, mabatsɔ̃ nyɛŋɔɔ kɛya Tarshish.

english_verse: And when I do arrive in Rome, I know it will be with the full blessings of Christ.
translation_verse: Ni mile akɛ, kɛ miba nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ mli jɔɔmɔ falɛ mli maba yɛ.

english_verse: My friends, by the power of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the love that comes from the Holy Spirit, I beg you to pray sincerely with me and for me.
translation_verse: Shi miikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo hewɔ kɛ Mumɔ lɛ suɔmɔ lɛ hewɔ, akɛ nyɛfata mihe kɛpele yɛ nyɛsɔlemɔi ni nyɛsɔleɔ nyɛhãa mi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ amli,

english_verse: Pray that God will protect me from the unbelievers in Judea, and that his people in Jerusalem will be pleased with what I am doing.
translation_verse: koni ajie mi yɛ mɛi ni heee yeee ni yɔɔ Yudea lɛ adɛŋ, ni misɔ̃ɔmɔ ni miyaa miyasɔ̃mɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ asa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ahiɛ jogbaŋŋ;

english_verse: Ask God to let me come to you and have a pleasant and refreshing visit.
translation_verse: koni, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa lɛ, mikɛ miishɛɛ aba nyɛŋɔɔ, ni mabawo mitsui yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will be with all of you. Amen.
translation_verse: Hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi. Amen!

english_verse: I have good things to say about Phoebe, who is a leader in the church at Cenchreae.
translation_verse: Miijie wɔnyɛmi yoo Foibe ni ji Kenkrea asafo lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ yi mahã nyɛ,

english_verse: Welcome her in a way that is proper for someone who has faith in the Lord and is one of God's own people. Help her in any way you can. After all, she has proved to be a respected leader for many others, including me.
translation_verse: koni nyɛhere lɛ hiɛmɛɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli, bɔ ni sa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni nyɛfata ehe yɛ nitsumɔ fɛɛ nitsumɔ ni nyɛhe hiaa lɛ yɛ mli lɛ mli; ejaakɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu eji mɛi pii kɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ hu miyelikɛbualɔ.

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila. They have not only served Christ Jesus together with me,
translation_verse: Nyɛŋaa Priskila kɛ Akwila, ni ji minanemɛi nitsulɔi yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, nyɛhãa mi;

english_verse: but they have even risked their lives for me. I am grateful for them and so are all the Gentile churches.
translation_verse: amɛkɛ amɛhe wo gbele mli yɛ miyiwala hewɔ, ni jeee mi kɛkɛ midaa amɛ shi, shi moŋ jeŋmaji lɛ amli asafoi lɛ fɛɛ hu daa amɛ shi.

english_verse: Greet the church that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epaenetus, who was the first person in Asia to have faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Nyɛŋaa asafo ni yɔɔ amɛwe lɛ hu. Nyɛŋaa misuɔlɔ Epaineto ni ji mɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ni jɛ Asia ni kɛ ehe hã Kristo lɛ.

english_verse: Greet Mary, who has worked so hard for you.
translation_verse: Nyɛŋaa Maria ni gba ehe naa pii yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Greet my relatives Andronicus and Junia, who were in jail with me. They are highly respected by the apostles and were followers of Christ before I was.
translation_verse: Nyɛŋaa Androniko kɛ Yunia, miwekumɛi ni awo mi kɛ amɛ tsuŋ ni amɛyɔɔ gbɛi yɛ bɔfoi lɛ ateŋ ni amɛtsɔ̃ mihiɛ yɛ Kristo mli lɛ.

english_verse: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend whose faith is in the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛŋaa Amplia mɔ ni misumɔɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: Greet Urbanus, who serves Christ along with us. Greet my dear friend Stachys.
translation_verse: Nyɛŋaa Urbano ni ji wɔnaanyo nitsulɔ yɛ Kristo mli lɛ, kɛ misuɔlɔ Staki.

english_verse: Greet Apelles, a faithful servant of Christ. Greet Aristobulus and his family.
translation_verse: Nyɛŋaa Apele mɔ ni he emɔ shi yɛ Kristo mli lɛ. Nyɛŋaa mɛi ni jɛ Aristobulo shĩabii lɛ ateŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Greet Herodion, who is a relative of mine. Greet Narcissus and the others in his family, who have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛŋaa miwekunyo Herodion lɛ. Nyɛŋaa mɛi ni jɛ Narkiso shĩabii lɛ ateŋ ni amɛyɔɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work hard for the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis. She also works hard for the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛŋaa Trifaina kɛ Trifosa ni bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ. Nyɛŋaa Persi mɔ ni asumɔɔ ni etsu nii pii yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: Greet Rufus, that special servant of the Lord, and greet his mother, who has been like a mother to me.
translation_verse: Nyɛŋaa Rufo mɔ ni ahala lɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ, kɛ enyɛ ni ji nyɛ hã mi hu lɛ.

english_verse: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, and Hermas, as well as our friends who are with them.
translation_verse: Nyɛŋaa Asinkrito, Flegon, Herme, Patroba, Herma kɛ nyɛmimɛi ni kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all of God's people who are with them.
translation_verse: Nyɛŋaa Filologo kɛ Yulia, Nerea kɛ enyɛmi yoo lɛ, kɛ Olimpa kɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ni kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Be sure to give each other a warm greeting. All of Christ's churches greet you.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ naashwɔmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ aŋaŋaa nyɛhe. Kristo asafoi lɛ fɛɛ miibi nyɛ.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to watch out for anyone who causes trouble and divides the church by refusing to do what all of you were taught. Stay away from them!
translation_verse: Shi anyɛmimɛi, miikpa nyɛ fai ni nyɛhiɛ akã mɛi ni jeɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ni nyɛkase lɛ sɛɛ ni amɛkɛ mligbalamɔi kɛ pampitoo baa lɛ ahe, ni nyɛtsi nyɛhe kɛje amɛhe.

english_verse: They want to serve themselves and not Christ the Lord. Their flattery and fancy talk fool people who don't know any better.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, jeee wɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo amɛsɔ̃mɔɔ, shi moŋ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmusu; ni amɛkɛ naaŋɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ naadɔkɔmɔ wiemɔi lakaa mɛi ni leee efɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I am glad that everyone knows how well you obey the Lord. But still, I want you to understand what is good and not have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛtoiboo lɛ mɛi fɛɛ enu he; no hewɔ lɛ, mina nyɛhe miishɛɛ; shi miisumɔ akɛ nyɛfee nyɛhe nilelɔi yɛ ekpakpa gbɛfãŋ; shi efɔŋ gbɛfaŋ lɛ, mɛi ni leee nɔ ko.

english_verse: Then God, who gives peace, will soon crush Satan under your feet. I pray that our Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Shi etsɛŋ ni hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaanaanaa Satan nɔ kwraa yɛ nyɛnajiashi. WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi.

english_verse: Timothy, who works with me, sends his greetings, and so do my relatives, Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.
translation_verse: Minaanyo nitsulɔ Timoteo kɛ miwekumɛi Lukio kɛ Yason kɛ Sosipatre miibi nyɛ.

english_verse: I, Tertius, also send my greetings. I am a follower of the Lord, and I wrote this letter.
translation_verse: Mi Tertio ni miŋma nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ, miibi nyɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: Praise God! He can make you strong by means of my good news, which is the message about Jesus Christ. For ages and ages this message was kept secret,
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni aaanyɛ ahã nyɛfi shi shiŋŋ yɛ misanekpakpa lɛ kɛ Yesu Kristo shiɛmɔ lɛ naa, yɛ teemɔ sane ni akɛtee kɛjɛ naanɔ beebe lɛ kpojiemɔ naa,

english_verse: but now at last it has been told. The eternal God commanded his prophets to write about the good news, so that all nations would obey and have faith.
translation_verse: teemɔ sane ni agbɛnɛ ajie atsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ yɛ naanɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ famɔ naa, ni atsɔ̃ gbalɔi lɛ aŋmalɛi lɛ anɔ atsi tã atsɔ̃ɔ jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ koni amɛbo hemɔkɛyeli lɛ toi lɛ naa lɛ,

english_verse: And now, because of Jesus Christ, we can praise the only wise God forever! Amen.
translation_verse: lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji nilelɔ kometoo lɛ, aŋɔ anunyam ahã lɛ, yɛ Yesu Kristo mli kɛyashi naanɔ. Amen!

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Sosthenes, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Paulo, Yesu Kristo bɔfo ni atsɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa lɛ, kɛ wɔnyɛmi Sostene,

english_verse: To God's church in Corinth. Christ Jesus chose you to be his very own people, and you worship in his name, as we and all others do who call him Lord.
translation_verse: ŋma wolo nɛɛ yahã Nyɔŋmɔ asafo ni yɔɔ Korinto lɛ, ni ji mɛi ni atsuu amɛhe yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ. Mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni atsɛ amɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ he fɛɛ he ni tsɛɔ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo ni ji wɔ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ.

english_verse: My prayer is that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ.

english_verse: I never stop thanking my God for treating you with undeserved grace by giving you Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Miida miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi daa nɛɛ yɛ nyɛhewɔ, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni akɛhã nyɛ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Now you are certain that everything we told you about our Lord Christ Jesus is true.
translation_verse: Tamɔ bɔ ni ama Kristo he odase lɛ nɔ mi yɛ nyɛmli,

english_verse: You are not missing out on any blessings, as you wait for him to return.
translation_verse: ni dromɔ nikeenii ko eshwɛɛɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛkwɛɔ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo kpojiemɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ.

english_verse: And until the day Christ does return, he will keep you completely innocent.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɔŋŋ eeewaje nyɛ kɛaatee naagbee ni nyɛhe akaba kpa ko yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbi lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: God can be trusted, and he chose you to be partners with his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ. Taking Sides
translation_verse: Anɔkwafo ji Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni tsɛ nyɛ kɛba eBi Yesu Kristo, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, naanyobɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ. Mligbalamɔi yɛ asafo lɛ mli

english_verse: My dear friends, as a follower of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg you to get along with each other. Don't take sides. Always try to agree in what you think.
translation_verse: Shi, anyɛmimɛi, miikpa nyɛ fai yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbɛi mli, akɛ nyɛnaabu afee ekome ni mligbalamɔi akaba nyɛteŋ, shi moŋ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhiɛa jwɛŋmɔ kome kɛ susumɔ kome.

english_verse: Several people from Chloe's family have already reported to me that you keep arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Kloe webii lɛ batswa mi adafi yɛ nyɛhe, minyɛmimɛi, akɛ bei yɛ nyɛteŋ.

english_verse: They have said that some of you claim to follow me, while others claim to follow Apollos or Peter or Christ.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ ji akɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛɔ akɛ, “Mi lɛ, Paulo nɔ ji mi;” “Mi lɛ, Apolo nɔ ji mi;” “Mi lɛ, Kefa nɔ ji mi;” “mi lɛ, Kristo nɔ ji mi.”

english_verse: Has Christ been divided up? Was I nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptized in my name?
translation_verse: Ani agbala Kristo mli? Ani Paulo asɛŋ ahã nyɛ lɛ? Aloo Paulo gbɛi mli abaptisi nyɛ awo lɛ?

english_verse: I thank God that I didn't baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius.
translation_verse: Miida Nyɔŋmɔ shi akɛ mibaptisiii nyɛteŋ mɔ ko akɛ ja Krispo kɛ Gaio,

english_verse: Not one of you can say that you were baptized in my name.
translation_verse: koni mɔ ko akakɛɛ akɛ mibaptisi lɛ yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ migbɛi mli.

english_verse: I did baptize the family of Stephanas, but I don't remember if I baptized anyone else.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛŋ, mibaptisi Stefana we lɛ, shi mikaiii akɛ mibaptisi mɔ ko mifata he dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Christ did not send me to baptize. He sent me to tell the good news without using words that sound wise and would make the cross of Christ lose its power. Christ Is God's Power and Wisdom
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Kristo tsuuu mi baptisimɔ, shi moŋ Sanekpakpa lɛ shiɛmɔ, ni jeee yɛ nilee wiemɔi amli tete, koni Kristo sɛŋmɔtso lɛ akafee yaka. Kristo ji Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ kɛ enilee

english_verse: The message about the cross doesn't make any sense to lost people. But for those of us who are being saved, it is God's power at work.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ sɛŋmɔtso lɛ he sane lɛ ji kwashiai asane hã mɛi ni hiɛ kpãtãa lɛ; shi wɔ mɛi ni ahereɔ wɔyiwala lɛ, eji Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ hã wɔ.

english_verse: As God says in the Scriptures, “I will destroy the wisdom of all who claim to be wise. I will confuse those who think they know so much.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, “Mafite nilelɔi anilee, Ni ŋaalɔi aŋaa lɛ hu mahã afee yaka.”

english_verse: What happened to those wise people? What happened to those experts in the Scriptures? What happened to the ones who think they have all the answers? Didn't God show that the wisdom of this world is foolish?
translation_verse: Nɛgbɛ nilelɔ yɔɔ? Nɛgbɛ mlatsɔɔlɔ yɔɔ? Nɛgbɛ je nɛɛŋ naataalɔ yɔɔ? Ani Nyɔŋmɔ hãko je lɛ mli nilee lɛ atsɔ̃ kwashiai asane?

english_verse: God was wise and decided not to let the people of this world use their wisdom to learn about him. Instead, God chose to save only those who believe the foolish message we preach.
translation_verse: Shi akɛni yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nilee naa lɛ je lɛ nyɛɛɛ etsɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enilee nɔ kɛle Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, esa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ akɛ ekɛ kwashiai asane lɛ ni ashiɛɔ lɛ ahere mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ ayiwala.

english_verse: Jews ask for miracles, and Greeks want something that sounds wise.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yudafoi lɛ, naakpɛɛ okadii ashi amɛbiɔ, ni Helabii hu taoɔ nilee;

english_verse: But we preach that Christ was nailed to a cross. Most Jews have problems with this, and most Gentiles think it is foolish.
translation_verse: shi wɔ lɛ, Kristo ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ wɔshiɛɔ, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ pampi ehã Yudafoi, kɛ kwashiai asane ehã jɛŋmaji lɛ.

english_verse: Our message is God's power and wisdom for the Jews and the Greeks that he has chosen.
translation_verse: Shi mɛi ni atsɛ amɛ lɛ, Yudafoi jio, Helabii jio, Kristo ji Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nilee hã amɛ.

english_verse: Even when God is foolish, he is wiser than everyone else, and even when God is weak, he is stronger than everyone else.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kwashiai asane lɛ, nilee yɛ mli fe gbɔmɛi anilee, ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔjɔmɔ lɛ he wa fe gbɔmɛi ahewalɛ.

english_verse: But God chose the foolish things of this world to put the wise to shame. He chose the weak things of this world to put the powerful to shame.
translation_verse: shi moŋ je nɛɛ mli kwashiaianii lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hala, koni ekɛwo nilelɔi lɛ ahiɛgble; ni je nɛɛ mli gbɔjɔmɔnii lɛ hu Nyɔŋmɔ hala, koni ekɛwo nii ni he wa lɛ ahiɛgble;

english_verse: What the world thinks is worthless, useless, and nothing at all is what God has used to destroy what the world considers important.
translation_verse: ni je nɛɛ mli nii ni abuuu kɛ nii ni agbe he guɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hala, kɛ nibii ni bɛ lɛ tete, koni ehã nibii ni yɔɔ lɛ afee yaka;

english_verse: God did all this to keep anyone from bragging to him.
translation_verse: bɔ ni afee ni gbɔmɔ ko gbɔmɔ ko akashwã yɛ ehiɛ.

english_verse: You are God's children. He sent Christ Jesus to save us and to make us wise, acceptable, and holy.
translation_verse: Shi lɛ ejɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ Kristo Yesu, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ nilee ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ kɛ jalɛ kɛ hetsuumɔ kɛ kpɔ̃mɔ ehã wɔ lɛ mli;

english_verse: So if you want to brag, do what the Scriptures say and brag about the Lord.
translation_verse: koni, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ, “Mɔ ni shwãa lɛ, eshwã efɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: Friends, when I came and told you the mystery that God had shared with us, I didn't use big words or try to sound wise.
translation_verse: Ni mi hu, anyɛmimɛi, be ni miba nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, jeee wiemɔ flɛmii loo nilee tuutu mikɛba, ni mibajaje Nyɔŋmɔ sane lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ;

english_verse: In fact, while I was with you, I made up my mind to speak only about Jesus Christ, who had been nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ mitooo miyiŋ akɛ male nɔ ko yɛ nyɛteŋ, akɛ ja Yesu Kristo, mɔ ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ.

english_verse: At first, I was weak and trembling with fear.
translation_verse: Ni mikɛ nyɛ hi shi yɛ gbɔjɔmɔ kɛ gbeyeishemɔ kɛ hekpokpomɔ pii mli;

english_verse: When I talked with you or preached, I didn't try to prove anything by sounding wise. I simply let God's Spirit show his power.
translation_verse: ni miwiemɔ kɛ mishiɛmɔ lɛ hu jeee gbɔmɛi anilee wiemɔi ni hãa mɔ yiŋ tsɔ̃ɔ mikɛshiɛ, shi moŋ wiemɔi ni jieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ hewalɛ kpo,

english_verse: That way you would have faith because of God's power and not because of human wisdom.
translation_verse: bɔ ni afee ni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ akadamɔ gbɔmɛi anilee nɔ, shi moŋ edãmɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ nɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ nilee

english_verse: We do use wisdom when speaking to people who are mature in their faith. But it isn't the wisdom of this world or of its rulers, who will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔwieɔ nilee wiemɔ yɛ mɛi ni edara yɛ mumɔŋ lɛ ateŋ, shi jeee je nɛɛ mli nilee loo je nɛɛ mli nɔyelɔi ni jeee fɛifɛi lɛ anilee.

english_verse: We speak of God's hidden and mysterious wisdom that God decided to use for our glory long before the world began.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ wɔwieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nilee ni akɛtee yɛ teemɔ sane mli lɛ, nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ saa eto hã wɔnunyam dani aje jeŋ shishi,

english_verse: The rulers of this world didn't know anything about this wisdom. If they had known about it, they would not have nailed the glorious Lord to a cross.
translation_verse: nilee ni je nɛɛ mli nɔyelɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko leee lɛ; ejaakɛ amɛle kulɛ amɛsɛŋ anunyam Nuŋtsɔ lɛ,

english_verse: But it is just as the Scriptures say, “What God has planned for people who love him is more than eyes have seen or ears have heard. It has never even entered our minds!”
translation_verse: shi moŋ tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ, “Nii ni hiŋmɛi enako ni toi hu nuko ni ebako gbɔmɔ ko tsuiŋ dã ji nii ni Nyɔŋmɔ esaa eto mɛi ni sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: God's Spirit has shown you everything. His Spirit finds out everything, even what is deep in the mind of God.
translation_verse: Shi wɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ eMumɔ lɛ nɔ ejie kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ; ejaakɛ Mumɔ lɛ taoɔ nibii fɛɛ mli, Nyɔŋmɔ nibii ni mli kwɔlɔ tete.

english_verse: You are the only one who knows what is in your own mind, and God's Spirit is the only one who knows what is in God's mind.
translation_verse: Shi gbɔmɛi ateŋ namɔ le nii ni yɔɔ gbɔmɔ mli, akɛ ja gbɔmɔ lɛ mumɔ ni yɔɔ emli lɛ? Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ nɔ ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mli lɛ hu mɔ ko mɔ ko leee, akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ.

english_verse: But God has given us his Spirit. This is why we don't think the same way that the people of this world think. This is also why we can recognize the blessings God has given us.
translation_verse: Shi wɔ lɛ, jeee je nɛɛ mli mumɔ lɛ wɔna, shi moŋ Mumɔ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli lɛ, koni wɔle nii ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛduro wɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Every word we speak was taught to us by God's Spirit, not by human wisdom. And this same Spirit helps us teach spiritual things to spiritual people.
translation_verse: Nomɛi hu wɔwieɔ, jeee wiemɔi ni gbɔmɛi anilee tsɔ̃ɔ wɔwieɔ, shi moŋ wiemɔi ni Mumɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ, ni wɔkɛ mumɔŋnii toɔ mumɔŋnii ahe.
