english_verse: This is why only someone who has God's Spirit can understand spiritual blessings. Anyone who doesn't have God's Spirit thinks these blessings are foolish.
translation_verse: Shi gbɔmɔ su ni akɛfɔ lɛ lɛ heee Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ nii lɛ; ejaakɛ ebuɔ lɛ kwashiai asane, ni enyɛɛɛ naa ena, ejaakɛ mumɔ akɛtaoɔ naa.

english_verse: People who are guided by the Spirit can make all kinds of judgments, but they cannot be judged by others.
translation_verse: Shi mumɔŋ gbɔmɔ lɛ kojoɔ nii fiaa, shi lɛ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko ekojooo lɛ.

english_verse: The Scriptures ask, “Has anyone ever known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?” But we understand what Christ is thinking.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ “Namɔ le Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jwɛŋmɔ, ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nii?” Shi wɔ lɛ wɔhiɛ Kristo jwɛŋmɔ.

english_verse: My friends, you are acting like the people of this world. That's why I could not speak to you as spiritual people. You are like babies as far as your faith in Christ is concerned.
translation_verse: Shi, anyɛmimɛi, minyɛɛɛ mikɛ nyɛ awie tamɔ mumɔŋ gbɔmɛi, shi moŋ tamɔ helooŋ gbɔmɛi, tamɔ abifabii yɛ Kristo mli.

english_verse: So I had to treat you like babies and feed you milk. You could not take solid food, and you still cannot,
translation_verse: Fufɔ mihã nyɛ, shi jeee ŋmaa ni tsii, ejaakɛ nyɛnyɛɛɛ nyɛye; ni asaŋ amrɔ nɛɛ tete nyɛnyɛɛɛ lolo,

english_verse: because you are not yet spiritual. You are jealous and argue with each other. This proves you are not spiritual and you are acting like the people of this world.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ helooŋ gbɔmɛi ji nyɛ lolo. Shi gbii abɔ ni awuŋayeli kɛ bei yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lolo lɛ, ani jeee helooŋ gbɔmɛi ji nyɛ ni gbɔmɛi ajeŋba nyɛbaa lɛ?

english_verse: Some of you say you follow me, and others claim to follow Apollos. Isn't this how ordinary people behave?
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ mɔ ko kɛɔ akɛ, “Mi lɛ Paulo nɔ ji mi,” ni mɔ ko hu kɛɔ akɛ, “Mi lɛ Apolo nɔ ji mi,” lɛ, ani jeee helooŋ gbɔmɛi ji nyɛ?

english_verse: Apollos and I are merely servants who helped you to have faith. It was the Lord who made it all happen.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ, Namɔ ji Apolo? Namɔ ji Paulo? Amɛ ji sɔ̃ɔlɔi ni nyɛtsɔ̃ amɛnɔ nyɛhe nyɛye, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛhã lɛ.

english_verse: I planted the seeds, Apollos watered them, but God made them sprout and grow.
translation_verse: Mi lɛ, mitɛo; Apolo shwie nɔ nu; shi Nyɔŋmɔ hã eda.

english_verse: What matters isn't those who planted or watered, but God who made the plants grow.
translation_verse: Belɛ agbɛnɛ jeee mɔ ni tɛo lɛ ji nɔ ko, ni jeee mɔ ni shwie nɔ nu lɛ hu, shi moŋ mɔ ni hã eda, ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The one who plants is just as important as the one who waters. And each one will be paid for what they do.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni tɛoɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni shwieɔ nɔ nu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ ekomeŋ; shi amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaana lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enyɔmɔwoo yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edeŋmegbomɔ naa.

english_verse: Apollos and I work together for God, and you are God's garden and God's building. Only One Foundation
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hefatalɔi nitsulɔi ji wɔ; Nyɔŋmɔ ŋmɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsu ji nyɛ.

english_verse: God treated me with undeserved grace and let me become an expert builder. I laid a foundation on which others have built. But we must each be careful how we build,
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni ekɛduro mi lɛ naa lɛ, mito shishi tamɔ tsutswalɔ ko ni hiɛ yɔɔ ŋaa, shi mɔ kroko tswaa nɔ. Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akwɛ ni ahi bɔ ni etswaa nɔ ehãa lɛ.

english_verse: Whatever we build on this foundation will be tested by fire on the day of judgment. Then everyone will find out if we have used gold, silver, and precious stones, or wood, hay, and straw.
translation_verse: mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nitsumɔ baaje kpo faŋŋ; ejaakɛ Gbi lɛ aaajie lɛ kpo, ejaakɛ la mli eeeje kpo yɛ, ni bɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nitsumɔ yɔɔ lɛ, la lɛ baajie lɛ kpo.

english_verse: We will be rewarded if our building is left standing.
translation_verse: Kɛ mɔ ko nitsumɔ ni ji nɔ ni etswa ema nɔ lɛ aaahi shi lɛ, eeena nyɔmɔwoo;

english_verse: But if it is destroyed by the fire, we will lose everything. Yet we ourselves will be saved, like someone escaping from flames.
translation_verse: shi kɛ mɔ ko nitsumɔ aaashã lɛ, enine baanyɛ shi; shi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, aaahere eyiwala, shi kɛ̃lɛ tamɔ mɔ ko ni tsɔ̃ la mli.

english_verse: All of you surely know you are God's temple and his Spirit lives in you.
translation_verse: Ani nyɛleee akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu ji nyɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ hiɔ nyɛmli?

english_verse: Together you are God's holy temple, and God will destroy anyone who destroys his temple.
translation_verse: Kɛ mɔ ko fite Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ, fitemɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaafite lɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni no ji nyɛ. Kɔkɔbɔɔ yɛ je nɛɛ mli nilee he

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! If any of you think you are wise in the things of this world, you will have to become foolish before you can be truly wise.
translation_verse: Mɔ ko akalaka lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe. Kɛji mɔ ko susuɔ akɛ nilelɔ ji lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ, efee ehe kwashia, koni etsɔ̃ nilelɔ.

english_verse: This is because God considers the wisdom of this world to be foolish. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God catches the wise when they try to outsmart him.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ je nɛɛ mli nilee lɛ ji kwashiai asane yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, “Emɔɔ nilelɔi lɛ yɛ amɛŋaa fɔŋ lɛ mli.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “The Lord knows that the plans made by wise people are useless.”
translation_verse: Ni asaŋ aŋma akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ lɛ le nilelɔi ajwɛŋmɔi lɛ akɛ yakanii ni.”

english_verse: So stop bragging about what anyone has done. Paul and Apollos and Peter all belong to you. In fact, everything is yours, including the world, life, death, the present, and the future. Everything belongs to you,
translation_verse: Paulo jio, Apolo jio, Kefa jio, je lɛ jio, wala jio, gbele jio, nii ni yɔɔ nɛɛ jio, nii ni baaba lɛ jio; fɛɛ lɛ nyɛnɔ ni,

english_verse: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛ lɛ Kristo nii ji nyɛ; shi Kristo lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔŋ.

english_verse: Think of us as servants of Christ who have been given the work of explaining God's mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Bɔ pɛ ni gbɔmɛi abu wɔ nɛ, akɛ Kristo sɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teemɔ saji lɛ anɔ tsuji nukpai.

english_verse: And since our first duty is to be faithful to the one we work for,
translation_verse: Shi nɔ ni eshwɛ ni ataoɔ yɛ tsuji nukpai adɛŋ ji akɛ ana amɛ akɛ anɔkwafoi.

english_verse: it doesn't matter to me if I am judged by you or even by a court of law. In fact, I don't judge myself.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, ejeee nɔ ko titri ko hã mi akɛ nyɛkojoɔ mi aloo akɛ akɛ gbɔmɛi akojomɔ aaakojo mi; mi diɛŋtsɛ tete mikojooo mihe.

english_verse: I don't know of anything against me, but this doesn't prove I am right. The Lord is my judge.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mileee nɔ ko fɔŋ ko yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee no hewɔ aaabu mi bem; shi mɔ ni kojoɔ mi ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.

english_verse: So don't judge anyone until the Lord returns. He will show what is hidden in the dark and what is in everyone's heart. Then God will be the one who praises each of us.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkakojoa nɔ ko dani shɛ be lɛ, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaaba, mɔ ni kɛ dujiaŋ nibii ni akɛtee lɛ tete aaaba la hiɛ, ni eeejie tsuiiaŋ ajinai lɛ ashi lɛ. Ni no mli lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaana eyijiemɔ kɛaajɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ.

english_verse: Friends, I have used Apollos and myself as examples to teach you the meaning of the saying, “Follow the rules.” I want you to stop saying one of us is better than the other.
translation_verse: Shi, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛhewɔ mikɛ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ toɔ mi kɛ Apolo he lɛ, koni nyɛkwɛ wɔ ni nyɛkase nɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ “mɔ ko akajwɛŋ fe nɔ ni aŋma lɛ” koni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko kɛ henɔwomɔ akabu mɔ ko fe mɔ kroko.

english_verse: What is so special about you? What do you have that you were not given? And if it was given to you, how can you brag?
translation_verse: Shi namɔ buɔ bo akɛ esoro bo? Ni asaŋ, mɛni oyɔɔ ni jeee hã ahã bo? Shi kɛji hã ahã bo lɛ, mɛɛba oshwãa tamɔ nɔ ni jeee hã ahã bo lɛ?

english_verse: Are you already satisfied? Are you now rich? Have you become kings while we are still nobodies? I wish you were kings. Then we could have a share in your kingdom.
translation_verse: Nyɛtɔrɔ momo! Nyɛna nii momo! Nyɛshi wɔsɛɛ ni nyɛmiiye maŋtsɛ! Ni mina ni kulɛ nyɛmiiye maŋtsɛ lɛɛlɛŋ, koni wɔ hu wɔkɛ nyɛ aye! Bɔ ni wɔsane tamɔ yɛ mɛi ahiɛ

english_verse: It seems to me that God has put us apostles in the worst possible place. We are like prisoners on their way to death. Angels and the people of this world just laugh at us.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ efeɔ mi akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ eŋɔ wɔ ni ji bɔfoi lɛ moŋ efee sɛɛkpelɔi, tamɔ mɛi ni ajɔɔ amɛnɔ ahã gbele; ejaakɛ akɛ wɔ efee kwɛmɔnii ahã je lɛ kɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi kɛ gbɔmɛi.

english_verse: Because of Christ we are thought of as fools, but Christ has made you wise. We are weak and hated, but you are powerful and respected.
translation_verse: Wɔ lɛ, kwashiai ji wɔ yɛ Kristo hewɔ, shi nyɛ lɛ, nilelɔi ji nyɛ yɛ Kristo mli; wɔ lɛ, gbɔjɔlɔi ji wɔ, shi nyɛ lɛ hewalɔi ji nyɛ; nyɛ nyɛhiɛ yɔɔ nyam, shi wɔ lɛ, wɔhiɛ bɛ nyam.

english_verse: Even today we go hungry and thirsty and don't have anything to wear except rags. We are mistreated and don't have a place to live.
translation_verse: Kɛbashi be nɛ fɛɛ lɛ, hɔmɔ kɛ kumai yeɔ wɔ, ni wɔnyiɛɔ yayai, ni agbalagbalaa wɔ mãi, ni wɔbɛ hilɛhe krɛdɛɛ ko.

english_verse: We work hard with our own hands, and when people abuse us, we wish them well. When we suffer, we are patient.
translation_verse: Ni wɔgboɔ deŋme wɔkɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔniji tsuɔ nii; be ni ajɛɔ wɔ lɛ, wɔmiijɔɔ; be ni awaa wɔ yi lɛ, wɔmiɔ ŋɔɔ;

english_verse: When someone curses us, we answer with kind words. Until now we are thought of as nothing more than the trash and garbage of this world.
translation_verse: be ni afiteɔ wɔgbɛi lɛ, wɔɔwie naajɔlɛ wiemɔ; afee wɔ tamɔ je lɛ tumonɔnii, mɛi fɛɛ ajwɛi kɛbashi be nɛ. Paulo wie tsɔ̃ɔ Korintobii lɛ akɛ tsɛ

english_verse: I am not writing to embarrass you. I want to help you, just as parents help their own dear children.
translation_verse: Miŋmaaa enɛɛmɛi ni mikɛwo nyɛ hiɛgbele, shi moŋ miiwie miitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ tamɔ mibii ni misumɔɔ.

english_verse: Ten thousand people may teach you about Christ, but I am your only father. You became my children when I told you about Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛji nyɛyɛ kwɛlɔi akpei nyɔŋma tete yɛ Kristo mli lɛ, jeee tsɛmɛi pii nyɛyɔɔ; ejaakɛ mi mitsɔ̃ Sanekpakpa lɛ nɔ mifɔ nyɛ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli.

english_verse: and I want you to be like me.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, miikpa nyɛ fai ni nyɛkase mi.

english_verse: This is why I sent Timothy to you. I love him like a son, and he is a faithful servant of the Lord. Timothy will tell you what I do to follow Christ and how it agrees with what I always teach about Christ in every church.
translation_verse: No hewɔ hu ni mitsu Timoteo, ni ji misuɔmɔ bi kɛ anɔkwafo yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ nyɛŋɔɔ, ni ebakai nyɛ bɔ ni mibaa mijeŋ mihãa yɛ Kristo mli, tamɔ bɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ yɛ asafo fɛɛ asafo mli yɛ he fɛɛ he lɛ.

english_verse: Some of you think I am not coming for a visit, and so you are bragging.
translation_verse: Shi akɛni mɛi komɛi susuɔ akɛ mibaŋ nyɛŋɔɔ hewɔ lɛ, amɛwo amɛhe nɔ.

english_verse: But if the Lord lets me come, I will soon be there. Then I will find out if the ones who are doing all this bragging really have any power.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ miisumɔ lɛ, etsɛŋ ni maba ni mabana mɛi ni woɔ amɛhe nɔ lɛ ahewalɛ, shi jeee amɛwiemɔ.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't just a lot of words. It is power.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ jeee wiemɔ mli Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɔɔ, shi moŋ hewalɛ mli.

english_verse: What do you want me to do when I arrive? Do you want me to be hard on you or to be kind and gentle?
translation_verse: Te nyɛtaoɔ lɛ tɛŋŋ? Mihiɛ kpãa kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ, aloo miba yɛ suɔmɔ kɛ mlijɔlɛ mumɔ mli?

english_verse: I have heard terrible things about some of you. In fact, you are behaving worse than Gentiles. A man is even sleeping with his own stepmother.
translation_verse: Aakɛɛ kwraa po akɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ, ajwamãŋbɔɔ ni bɛ jemajiaŋbii ateŋ tete akɛ mɔ ko kɛ etsɛ ŋa wɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You are proud, when you ought to feel bad enough to chase away anyone who acts like this.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛ lɛ, nyɛhe nyɛwoɔ, ni nyɛyeee ŋkɔmɔ moŋ, bɔ ni afee ni ajie mɔ ni tsu nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ?

english_verse: You must then hand that man over to Satan. His body will be destroyed, but his spirit will be saved when the Lord Jesus returns.
translation_verse: wɔkɛ gbɔmɔ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ nɛɛ awo Satan dɛŋ, koni epiŋ egbɔmɔtso lɛ ni ahere mumɔ lɛ yiwala yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Gbi lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Stop being proud! Don't you know how a little yeast can spread through the whole batch of dough?
translation_verse: Nyɛshwãa lɛ bɛ fɛo. Nyɛleee akɛ masha bibioo shaa ma sui lɛ fɛɛ?

english_verse: Get rid of the old yeast! Then you will be like fresh bread made without yeast, and this is what you are. Our Passover lamb is Christ, who has already been sacrificed.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛjiea masha momo lɛ, koni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ ma hee, tamɔ bɔ ni akpiti ji nyɛ lɛ; ejaakɛ agbe wɔHehoo Toobi ni ji Kristo lɛ.

english_verse: So don't celebrate the festival by being evil and sinful, which is like serving bread made with yeast. Be pure and truthful and celebrate by using bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔyea Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ, jeee kɛ masha momo, ni asaŋ jeee kɛ efɔŋ loo nɔshafeemɔ masha, shi moŋ kɛ anɔkwale akpiti ŋmiiŋmi.

english_verse: In my other letter I told you not to have anything to do with immoral people.
translation_verse: Miŋma nyɛ yɛ wolo lɛ mli akɛ nyɛkɛ ajwamãŋbɔlɔi akabɔ;

english_verse: But I wasn't talking about the people of this world. You would have to leave this world to get away from everyone who is immoral or greedy or who cheats or worships idols.
translation_verse: jeee jeŋbii ateŋ ajwamãŋbɔlɔi loo hiɛjoolɔi loo amimyelɔi loo wɔŋjalɔi ahe kwraa miwieɔ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ nakai ni kulɛ ja nyɛje je lɛ mli.

english_verse: I was talking about your own people who are immoral or greedy or worship idols or curse others or get drunk or cheat. Don't even eat with them!
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ miŋma nyɛ akɛ kɛji mɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ nyɛmi lɛ ji ajwamãŋbɔlɔ loo hiɛjoolɔ loo wɔŋjalɔ loo mɔjɛlɔ loo dãatɔlɔ loo amimyelɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ lɛ akabɔa, nyɛkɛ lɛ akayea nii tete.

english_verse: Why should I judge outsiders? Aren't we supposed to judge only church members?
translation_verse: Shi mɛi ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ, mɛɛ amɛkojomɔ hu mina? Ani jeee mɛi ni yɔɔ asafo lɛ mli lɛ nyɛkojoɔ,

english_verse: God judges everyone else. The Scriptures say, “Chase away any of your own people who are evil.”
translation_verse: shi mɛi ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni kojoɔ amɛ? Nyɛjiea mɔ fɔŋ lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.

english_verse: When one of you has a complaint against another, do you take your complaint to a court of sinners? Or do you take it to God's people?
translation_verse: Te kɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ ko kɛ enaanyo na sane ko lɛ, eshiɔ etsitsi ekɛ lɛ yayeɔ sane lɛ yɛ jeŋbii akojomɔhe, shi ekɛ lɛ eyaaa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ aŋɔɔ?

english_verse: Don't you know we will judge angels? And if this is so, we can surely judge everyday matters.
translation_verse: Ani nyɛleee akɛ wɔbaakojo ŋwɛi bɔfoi tete, ni mbasroo walashihilɛ nɛɛ mli saji?

english_verse: Why do you take everyday complaints to judges who are not respected by the church?
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji nyɛyɛ walashihilɛ nɛɛ mli saji komɛi ayeli lɛ, mɛɛba nyɛhãa mɛi ni asafo lɛ ebuuu amɛ lɛ kojoɔ mɔ?

english_verse: I say this to your shame. Aren't any of you wise enough to act as a judge between one follower and another?
translation_verse: Miikɛɛ enɛ ni mikɛwo nyɛ hiɛgbele. Aso nilelɔ kome flo bɛ nyɛteŋ, mɔ ni aaanyɛ enyɛmimɛi ateŋ ekojo?

english_verse: Why should one of you take another to be tried by unbelievers?
translation_verse: Shi moŋ mɔ kɛ enyɛmi yayeɔ sane yɛ mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ aŋɔɔ po?

english_verse: When one of you takes another to court, all of you lose. It would be better to let yourselves be cheated and robbed.
translation_verse: Enɛ lɛ aye nyɛnɔ kunim momo, akɛni nyɛkɛ nyɛhe yeyeɔ saji lɛ. Mɛɛba nyɛhãaa mɛi afee nyɛ nɔ ni ejaaa gbɛ moŋ? Mɛɛba nyɛhãaa mɛi aye nyɛ amim moŋ?

english_verse: But instead, you cheat and rob other followers.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛ moŋ nyɛfeɔ nyɛmimɛi tete nɔ ni ejaaa gbɛ, ni nyɛyeɔ amɛ amim.

english_verse: Don't you know that evil people won't have a share in the blessings of God's kingdom? Don't fool yourselves! No one who is immoral or worships idols or is unfaithful in marriage or is a pervert or behaves like a homosexual
translation_verse: Ani nyɛleee akɛ efɔŋfeelɔi anine shɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ? Nyɛkahãa alakaa nyɛ! Ajwamãŋbɔlɔi loo wɔŋjalɔi loo gbãlãŋkulɔi loo hii ni tsɔ̃mɔɔ amɛhe yei hãa hii krokomɛi loo hii ni kɛ hii feɔ yakayakanii,

english_verse: will share in God's kingdom. Neither will any thief or greedy person or drunkard or anyone who curses and cheats others.
translation_verse: loo julɔi loo hiɛjoolɔi loo dãatɔlɔi loo mɛi ajɛlɔi loo ojotswalɔi anine shɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Some of you used to be like that. But now the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and the power of God's Spirit have washed you and made you holy and acceptable to God. Honor God with Your Body
translation_verse: Ni nɛkɛ nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi yɔɔ sa; shi agbɛnɛ aju nyɛhe, ni asaŋ atsuu nyɛhe, ni abu nyɛ bem hu yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbɛi kɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ mli. Nyɛkɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ awoa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do anything we want to.” But I tell you not everything is good for us. So I refuse to let anything have power over me.
translation_verse: Miyɛ nibii fɛɛ hegbɛ moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee nibii fɛɛ hi; miyɛ nibii fɛɛ hegbɛ moŋ, shi mihãŋ nɔ ko aye minɔ.

english_verse: You also say, “Food is meant for our bodies, and our bodies are meant for food.” But I tell you that God will destroy them both. We are not supposed to do indecent things with our bodies. We are to use them for the Lord who is in charge of our bodies.
translation_verse: Ŋmaa yɛ hã musu, ni musu hu yɛ hã ŋmaa; shi Nyɔŋmɔ baahã enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ afo. Shi gbɔmɔtso lɛ, jeee ajwamãŋbɔɔ hewɔ eyɔɔ, shi moŋ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewɔ eyɔɔ; ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hu yɛ hã gbɔmɔtso lɛ.

english_verse: God will raise us from death by the same power he used when he raised our Lord to life.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ tee Nuŋtsɔ lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ; ni ebaatee wɔ hu shi yɛ ehewalɛ naa.

english_verse: Don't you know that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? Is it right for me to join part of the body of Christ to a prostitute? No, it isn't!
translation_verse: Ani nyɛleee akɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ Kristo henii ni? Belɛ miŋɔ Kristo henii lɛ mifee ajwamãŋ henii lo? Dabida!

english_verse: Don't you know that a man who does that becomes part of her body? The Scriptures say, “The two of them will be like one person.”
translation_verse: Aloo nyɛleee akɛ mɔ ni kɛ ehe yabɔɔ ajwamãŋ he lɛ, ekɛ lɛ feɔ gbɔmɔtso kome? Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, “Amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaatsɔ̃ heloo kome.”

english_verse: But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one in spirit with him.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni kɛ ehe bɔɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ he lɛ, ekɛ lɛ feɔ mumɔ kome.

english_verse: Don't be immoral in matters of sex. That is a sin against your own body in a way no other sin is.
translation_verse: Nyɛjoa ajwamãŋbɔɔ naa foi! Esha fɛɛ esha ni gbɔmɔ feɔ lɛ, jeee egbɔmɔtso lɛ mli eyɔɔ; shi mɔ ni bɔɔ ajwamãŋ lɛ, efeɔ esha eshiɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɔmɔtso lɛ.

english_verse: You surely know that your body is a temple where the Holy Spirit lives. The Spirit is in you and is a gift from God. You are no longer your own.
translation_verse: Ani nyɛleee akɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtso lɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni yɔɔ nyɛmli ni nyɛna kɛjɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔtsu ni, ni nyɛjeee nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛnɔ lo?

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So use your body to honor God.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ahe nyɛ kɛ jara ni wa. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ awoa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam.

english_verse: Now I will answer the questions you asked in your letter. You asked, “Is it best for people not to marry?”
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ, yɛ nii ni nyɛŋma nyɛbahã mi lɛ ahe lɛ, ehi hã nuu akɛ ekata yoo he;

english_verse: Well, having your own husband or wife should keep you from doing something immoral.
translation_verse: shi ajwamãŋbɔɔ hewɔ lɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu ahi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eŋa, ni yoo fɛɛ yoo ahi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewu.

english_verse: Husbands and wives should be fair with each other about having sex.
translation_verse: Wu lɛ atsu eŋa lɛ gbɛnaanii ehã lɛ, ni ŋa lɛ hu afee nakai nɔŋŋ ehã ewu.

english_verse: A wife belongs to her husband instead of to herself, and a husband belongs to his wife instead of to himself.
translation_verse: Ŋa lɛ bɛ hewalɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɔmɔtso nɔ, shi moŋ ewu lɛ yɔɔ hewalɛ; nakai nɔŋŋ wu lɛ bɛ hewalɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɔmɔtso nɔ, shi eŋa lɛ yɔɔ hewalɛ.

english_verse: So don't refuse sex to each other, unless you agree not to have sex for a little while, in order to spend time in prayer. Then Satan won't be able to tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ nyɛhe akakãmaa nyɛhe, akɛ ja nyɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ nyɛkpãa gbee akɛ nyɛaafee nakai kɛyashi be ko koni nyɛna dekã nyɛsɔle; ni nyɛfee ekome ekoŋŋ, koni Satan akatsɔ̃ nyɛnaa yɛ nyɛhe nɔ ni nyɛnyɛɛɛ nyɛye hewɔ.

english_verse: In my opinion that is what should be done, though I don't know of anything the Lord said about this matter.
translation_verse: Enɛ ni miwieɔ nɛɛ, jeee kitã miwoɔ nyɛ, shi miiwie kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ gbɛŋmɛɛ yɛ he.

english_verse: I wish all of you were like me, but God has given different gifts to each of us.
translation_verse: Ka mihewɔŋ kulɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ahi shi tamɔ bɔ ni miyɔɔ nɛɛ. Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edromɔ keenɔ kɛjɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ, mɔ ko nɔ nɛkɛ, ni mɔ ko hu nɔ ekroko.

english_verse: My advice for the unmarried and for widows is that it is acceptable for them to remain single, just as I am.
translation_verse: Shi oshijafoi kɛ okulafoi lɛ, miikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ehi hã amɛ kɛji amɛhi shi tamɔ bɔ ni mi hu miyɔɔ nɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: But if you don't have enough self-control, then go ahead and get married. After all, it is better to marry than to burn with desire.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛhe nɔ amɛye lɛ, amɛbote gbãlãshihilɛ mli; ejaakɛ gbãlãshihilɛ hi fe nɔ ni akɔnɔ aaahao bo.

english_verse: I instruct married couples to stay together, and this is exactly what the Lord himself taught. A wife who leaves her husband
translation_verse: Shi mɛi ni ebote gbãlãshihilɛ mli lɛ, mi, ni jeee mi tete, shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ moŋ woɔ amɛ kitã akɛ; ŋa akatse ewu gbãlã;

english_verse: should either stay single or go back to her husband. And a husband should not leave his wife.
translation_verse: ni kɛji etse gbãlã lɛ tete lɛ, ehi shi akɛ mɔ ni bɛ wu, aloo ekɛ ewu lɛ ayakpãtã; ni wu hu akaŋmɛɛ eŋa he.

english_verse: I don't know of anything else the Lord said about marriage. All I can do is to give you my own advice. If your wife isn't a follower of the Lord, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce her.
translation_verse: Shi mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, jeee Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, shi mi miikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛmi ko yɛ ŋa ni jeee heyelɔ, ni yoo lɛ kpɛlɛ̃ akɛ ekɛ lɛ aaahi shi lɛ, ekaŋmɛɛ ehe.

english_verse: If your husband isn't a follower, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce him.
translation_verse: Ni kɛ yoo ko hu yɛ wu ni jeee heyelɔ, ni nuu lɛ kpɛlɛ̃ akɛ ekɛ lɛ aaahi shi lɛ, ekatse lɛ gbãlã.

english_verse: Your husband or wife who isn't a follower is made holy by having you as a partner. This also makes your children holy and keeps them from being unclean in God's sight.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ atsuɔ nuu ni jeee heyelɔ lɛ he yɛ eŋa lɛ mli, ni atsuɔ yoo ni jeee heyelɔ lɛ hu he yɛ ewu lɛ mli; ejaakɛ jeee nakai jikulɛ, nyɛbii lɛ hu ahe yɛ muji; shi amrɔ nɛɛ amɛhe tse.

english_verse: If your husband or wife isn't a follower of the Lord and decides to divorce you, then you should agree to it. You are no longer bound to that person. After all, God chose you and wants you to live at peace.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ mɔ ni jeee heyelɔ lɛ miigbala ehe shi lɛ, egbala ehe shi; anyɛɛɛ nyɛmi nuu loo nyɛmi yoo nɔ tamɔ nyɔŋ yɛ nɛkɛ saji nɛɛ amli; ejaakɛ hejɔlɛ mli Nyɔŋmɔ etsɛ wɔ kɛba.

english_verse: And besides, how do you know if you will be able to save your husband or wife who isn't a follower? Obeying the Lord at All Times
translation_verse: Shi, bo yoo, bo obaahere owu lɛ yiwala jio, ole? Aloo bo nuu, bo hu obaahere oŋa lɛ yiwala jio, ole? Bɔ ni atsɛ mɔ ko lɛ nakai ehi shi

english_verse: In every church I tell the people to stay as they were when the Lord Jesus chose them and God called them to be his own. Now I say the same thing to you.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ eja nikeenii ehã lɛ, kɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ lɛ lɛ, ehi shi nakai. Ni nakai mito hu yɛ asafoi lɛ fɛɛ mli.

english_verse: If you are already circumcised, don't try to change it. If you are not circumcised, don't get circumcised.
translation_verse: Kɛ afo mɔ ko ketia ni atsɛ lɛ lɛ, ekatsɔ̃ ehe foolɔ; foo mli atsɛ mɔ ko yɛ hu, ekafo ketia.

english_verse: Being circumcised or uncircumcised isn't really what matters. The important thing is to obey God's commands.
translation_verse: Ketiafoo jeee nɔ ko, ni foo hu jeee nɔ ko, shi Nyɔŋmɔ kitãi lɛ anɔyeli moŋ ji nɔ ko.

english_verse: So don't try to change what you were when God chose you.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, nɔ shihilɛ mli ni eyɔɔ ni atsɛ lɛ lɛ, no mli nɔŋŋ ehi.

english_verse: Are you a slave? Don't let that bother you. But if you can win your freedom, you should.
translation_verse: Ani nyɔŋ ji bo be ni atsɛ bo lɛ? Kaahã miidɔ bo; shi kɛ ooonyɛ ohe okpɔ̃ lɛ, bɔɔ he mɔdɛŋ.

english_verse: When the Lord chooses slaves, they become his free people. And when he chooses free people, they become slaves of Christ.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni atsɛ lɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli ni eji nyɔŋ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ odehe ni; nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ mɔ ni atsɛ lɛ ni eji odehe lɛ, Kristo nyɔŋ ni.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So don't become slaves of anyone else.
translation_verse: Jara ni wa akɛhe nyɛ; nyɛkatsɔmɔa gbɔmɛi anyɔji.

english_verse: I don't know of anything the Lord said about people who have never been married. But I will tell you what I think. And you can trust me, because the Lord has treated me with kindness.
translation_verse: Shi oblayei foroi lɛ, mibɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kitã ko yɛ amɛhe, shi nɔ ni misusuɔ mikɛɔ nɛɛ, tamɔ mɔ ko ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ena lɛ mɔbɔ koni eye anɔkwa.

english_verse: We are now going through hard times, and I think it is best for you to stay as you are.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni misusuɔ akɛ ehi ji, hejaramɔ ni yɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, ehi hã gbɔmɔ akɛ ehi shi bɔ ni eyɔɔ.

english_verse: If you are married, stay married. If you are not married, don't try to get married.
translation_verse: Mla efi bo ekpɛtɛ yoo he? Kaatao fɛnemɔ. Afɛne bo yɛ yoo he? Kaatao ŋa.

english_verse: It isn't wrong to marry, even if you have never been married before. But those who marry will have a lot of trouble, and I want to protect you from this.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji oŋɔ yoo hu, ofeko esha; ni kɛji oblayoo foro hu bote gbãlãshihilɛ mli lɛ, efeko esha; shi gbɔmɔtso gbɛfaŋ amanehulu mɛnɛɛmɛi baana; shi mi lɛ, nyɛhe mifoɔ.

english_verse: My friends, what I mean is that the Lord will soon come, and it won't matter if you are married or not.
translation_verse: Shi, anyɛmimɛi, nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji akɛ, be lɛ faaa dɔŋŋ; nɔ ni eshwɛ ji akɛ, mɛi ni yɔɔ ŋamɛi tete afee amɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni bɛ eko; ni mɛi ni foɔ lɛ hu afee amɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni fooo;

english_verse: It will be all the same if you are crying or laughing, or if you are buying or are completely broke.
translation_verse: ni mɛi ni nyaa afee amɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni nyaaa; ni mɛi ni heɔ nii lɛ afee amɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni jeee nɔtsɛmɛi;

english_verse: It won't make any difference how much good you are getting from this world or how much you like it. This world as we know it is now passing away.
translation_verse: ni mɛi ni tsuɔ je nɛɛ he nii lɛ afee amɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni tsuuu he nii; ejaakɛ je lɛ bɔ ni wɔnaa lɛ nɛɛ hoɔ eyaa.

english_verse: I want all of you to be free from worry. An unmarried man worries about how to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Shi misumɔɔɔ akɛ nyɛfee yeyeeye. Mɔ ni bɛ ŋa lɛ, ekɛ ehe fɛɛ hãa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nitsumɔ, bɔ ni eeefee ni esa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ;

english_verse: But a married man has more worries. He must worry about the things of this world, because he wants to please his wife.
translation_verse: shi mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋa lɛ, ekɛ ehe fɛɛ hãa yɛ je nɛɛ mli nii ahewɔ, bɔ ni eeefee ni esa eŋa lɛ hiɛ,

english_verse: So he is pulled in two directions. Unmarried women and women who have never been married worry only about pleasing the Lord, and they keep their bodies and minds pure. But a married woman worries about the things of this world, because she wants to please her husband.
translation_verse: ni efeɔ jwɛŋmɔ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔtsɛ. Yoo ni bɛ wu loo oblayoo foro lɛ, ekɛ ehe fɛɛ hãa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ, koni efee krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ gbɔmɔtso kɛ mumɔ fɛɛ gbɛfaŋ; shi mɔ ni yɔɔ wu lɛ, ekɛ ehe fɛɛ hãa yɛ je nɛɛ mli nii ahewɔ, bɔ ni eeefee ni esane asa ewu hiɛ.

english_verse: What I am saying is for your own good—it isn't to limit your freedom. I want to help you to live right and to love the Lord above all else.
translation_verse: Shi enɛ lɛ, nyɛ ekpakpa hewɔ mikɛɔ, jeee nyɛkuɛ kpãa miwoɔ, shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni afee fɛo, koni nyɛsɔ̃mɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni nɔ ko nɔ ko wooo nyɛ najiaŋ.

english_verse: But suppose you are engaged to someone old enough to be married, and you want her so much that all you can think about is getting married. Then go ahead and marry. There is nothing wrong with that.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji nuu ko susuɔ akɛ ebaaa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ yɛ eblayoo foro gbɛfaŋ, ni enyɛɛɛ ehe nɔ eye dɔŋŋ, ni asaŋ enyɛɛɛ he nɔ ko efee lɛ, efee bɔ ni esumɔɔ, efeee esha; amɛkpee amɛhe.

english_verse: It is perfectly all right to marry, but it is better not to get married at all.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kɛ eblayoo foro lɛ boteɔ gbãlãshihilɛ mli lɛ, efee jogbaŋŋ moŋ, shi mɔ ni boteee gbãlãshihilɛ mli lɛ, efee jogbaŋŋ fe no.

english_verse: A wife should stay married to her husband until he dies. Then she is free to marry again, but only to a man who is a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Yoo lɛ, gbii abɔ ni ewu hiɛ kã nɛɛ, akɛ mla efi lɛ; shi kɛji ewu lɛ gbo lɛ, eyɛ hegbɛ akɛ egbã mɔ ni esumɔɔ; shi belɛ afee yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: However, I think I am obeying God's Spirit when I say she would be happier to stay single.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji ehi shi bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ, eyɛ hejɔlɛ aahu. Mijwɛŋmɔ nɛ, ni efeɔ mi akɛ mi hu miyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ.

english_verse: In your letter you asked me about food offered to idols. All of us know something about this subject. But knowledge makes us proud of ourselves, while love makes us helpful to others.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ yɛ wɔji afɔle gbɛfaŋ lɛ, wɔle akɛ “wɔ fɛɛ wɔyɛ nilee.” Nilee hãa mɔ woɔ ehe nɔ, shi suɔmɔ hãa mɔ nane mɔɔ shi.

english_verse: In fact, people who think they know so much don't know anything at all.
translation_verse: Kɛ mɔ ko susuɔ akɛ ele nɔ ko lɛ, eleko bɔ ni sa akɛ ele lolo.

english_verse: But God has no doubts about who loves him.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ mɔ ko miisumɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ le lɛ.

english_verse: Even though food is offered to idols, we know that none of the idols in this world are alive. After all, there is only one God.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ nɔ ni kɔɔ wɔji afɔle nii ayeli he lɛ, wɔle akɛ wɔŋ ko wɔŋ ko jeee fɛifɛi yɛ je nɛɛ mli, ni asaŋ nyɔŋmɔ ko nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ, akɛ ja Mɔ kome kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Many things in heaven and on earth are called gods and lords, but none of them really are gods or lords.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛji nibii komɛi yɛ ni atsɛɔ amɛ nyɔŋmɔi lɛ; ŋwɛi amɛyɔɔ jio, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛyɔɔ jio, tamɔ bɔ ni asɛ̃ɛɛ nyɔŋmɔi ahe ni asɛ̃ɛɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi ahe lɛ,

english_verse: We have only one God, and he is the Father. He created everything, and we live for him. Jesus Christ is our only Lord. Everything was made by him, and by him life was given to us.
translation_verse: wɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ kome pɛ wɔyɔɔ, Tsɛ lɛ, mɔ mli ni nibii fɛɛ jɛ ni wɔyɔɔ wɔhã lɛ lɛ, kɛ Nuŋtsɔ kome hu ni ji Yesu Kristo lɛ, mɔ nɔ ni nibii fɛɛ tsɔ̃ kɛba ni wɔ hu wɔtsɔ̃ enɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Not everyone knows these things. In fact, many people have grown up with the belief that idols have life in them. So when they eat meat offered to idols, they are bothered by a weak conscience.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee mɛi fɛɛ le nii nɛɛ; shi mɛi komɛi yɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ ni wɔŋjamɔ efee amɛhenɔ, no hewɔ lɛ, kɛ amɛmiiye wɔji afɔle nii lɛ, amɛyeɔ lɛ akɛ wɔji afɔlenii, ni enɛ buleɔ amɛ ejaakɛ egbede amɛhenilee.

english_verse: But food doesn't bring us any closer to God. We are no worse off if we don't eat, and we are no better off if we do.
translation_verse: Shi jeee ŋmaa hãa wɔsaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; kɛ wɔyeee lɛ ehãaa wɔtɛ nɔ atse, ni asaŋ kɛ wɔye hu ehãaa wɔhi fe nine.

english_verse: Don't cause problems for someone with a weak conscience, just because you have the right to eat anything.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛkwɛa ni ahĩa koni nyɛhegbɛ nɛɛ akabatsɔ̃ pampi miihã gbedelɔi lɛ.

english_verse: You know all this, and so it doesn't bother you to eat in the temple of an idol. But suppose a person with a weak conscience sees you and decides to eat food that has been offered to idols.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛji mɔ ko na bo ni “ole nii” lɛ akɛ ota wɔŋtsu mli ooye nii lɛ, ani enɛ woŋ mɔ ni egbede lɛ henilee hewalɛ koni eyaye wɔji afɔlenii lɛ?

english_verse: Then what you know has destroyed someone Christ died for.
translation_verse: Ni no lɛ “onilee” lɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛmi gbedelɔ ni Kristo bagbo yɛ lɛ hu ehewɔ lɛ hiɛ baakpãtã.

english_verse: When you sin by hurting a follower with a weak conscience, you sin against Christ.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji nyɛfee nyɛmimɛi lɛ esha nɛkɛ ni nyɛkɛpila amɛhenilee ni waaa lɛ, no lɛ Kristo nyɛfeɔ esha nyɛshiɔ lɛ.

english_verse: So if I hurt one of the Lord's followers by what I eat, I will never eat meat as long as I live.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji ŋmaa aaahã minyɛmi nane atɔ̃tɔ̃ lɛ, miyeŋ loo gbi ko gbi ko dɔŋŋ, koni mikahã minyɛmi lɛ nane miitɔ̃tɔ̃.

english_verse: I am free. I am an apostle. I have seen the Lord Jesus and have led you to have faith in him.
translation_verse: Ani mihiɛɛɛ mihe? Ani jeee bɔfo ji mi? Ani minako Yesu, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ? Jeee minine naa nitsumɔ ji nyɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lo?

english_verse: Others may think that I am not an apostle, but you are proof that I am an apostle to you.
translation_verse: Kɛji mijeee bɔfo mihãaa mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, nyɛ lɛ mi ji bɔfo mihã nyɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛ ji mibɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ naasɔomɔnɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: When people question me, I tell them
translation_verse: Enɛ ji nɔ ni mikɛfãa mihe yɛ mɛi ni kojoɔ mi lɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: that Barnabas and I have the right to our food and drink.
translation_verse: Ani wɔbɛ hegbɛ akɛ wɔyeɔ nii ni wɔnuɔ?

english_verse: We each have the right to marry one of the Lord's followers and to take her along with us, just as the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Peter do.
translation_verse: Ani wɔbɛ hegbɛ akɛ wɔhiɛɔ nyɛmi yoo Kristofonyo ni ji wɔŋa lɛ kɛnyiɛɔ, tamɔ bɔfoi krokomɛi lɛ hu kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ Kefa?

english_verse: Are we the only ones who have to support ourselves by working at another job?
translation_verse: Aloo mi kɛ Barnaba kɛkɛ bɛ hegbɛ akɛ wɔhiɔ shi ni wɔtsuuu nii?

english_verse: Do soldiers pay their own salaries? Don't people who raise grapes eat some of what they grow? Don't shepherds get milk from their own goats?
translation_verse: Namɔ yaa ta ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewoɔ ehe nyɔmɔ? Namɔ feɔ waintrom ni eyeee emli yibii lɛ eko? Aloo namɔ lɛɔ kooloi ni enuuu amɛfufɔ lɛ eko?

english_verse: I am not saying this on my own authority. The Law of Moses tells us not to muzzle an ox when it is grinding grain. But was God concerned only about an ox?
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ aŋma yɛ Mose Mla lɛ mli akɛ, “Kaawo tsina ni gbɛlɛɔ abele lɛ naabu kotoku.” Ani tsinai ahe ni dɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ,

english_verse: No, he wasn't! He was talking about us. This was written in the Scriptures so that all who plow and all who grind the grain will look forward to sharing in the harvest.
translation_verse: aloo wɔhewɔ kwraa moŋ ewieɔ nɛɛ? Wɔhewɔ nɔŋŋ aŋma, ejaakɛ esa akɛ mɔ ni huɔ lɛ, ekɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ahu, ni mɔ ni kpalaa abele hu hiɛ akã nɔ akɛ ebaaye eko.

english_verse: When we told the message to you, it was like planting spiritual seed. So we have the right to accept material things as our harvest from you.
translation_verse: Kɛ wɔdu mumɔŋnii wɔhã nyɛ lɛ, ani eji nɔ ko wulu akɛ wɔɔkpa nyɛheloŋnii lo?

english_verse: If others have the right to do this, we have an even greater right. But we haven't used this right of ours. We are willing to put up with anything to keep from causing trouble for the message about Christ.
translation_verse: Kɛ maji krokomɛi yɛ nɛkɛ hegbɛ yɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ, ani wɔbɛ hegbɛ fe amɛ? Shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔfeee nɛkɛ hegbɛ nɛɛ he nɔ ko, shi moŋ wɔmiɔ ŋɔɔ yɛ nii fɛɛ mli, koni wɔkatsi Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ gbɛ.

english_verse: Don't you know that people who work in the temple make their living from what is brought to the temple? Don't you know that a person who serves at the altar is given part of what is offered?
translation_verse: Ani nyɛleee akɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, Sɔlemɔ wenii lɛ eko nɔŋŋ amɛyeɔ? Ni mɛi ni sɔmɔɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he lɛ, afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ nii lɛ eko nɔŋŋ amɛnaa?

english_verse: In the same way, the Lord wants everyone who preaches the good news to make a living from preaching this message.
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ to akɛ mɛi ni jajeɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ aye Sanekpakpa lɛ mli nii.

english_verse: But I have never used these privileges of mine, and I am not writing this because I want to start now. I would rather die than have someone rob me of the right to take pride in this.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, mifeko nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ ekome flo he nɔ ko. Ni miŋmaaa enɛ koni afee nakai ahã mi; ejaakɛ kɛ ka nɔ ni mɔ ko aaahã mishwãa lɛ afee yaka lɛ, faŋ nɔ ni migbo moŋ.

english_verse: I don't have any reason to brag about preaching the good news. Preaching is something God told me to do, and if I don't do it, I am doomed.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛji miijaje Sanekpakpa lɛ po jiŋŋ, ejeee shwãanɔ hã mi; ejaakɛ akɛfi minɔ akɛ mijaje; kɛ mijajeee Sanekpakpa lɛ, kpoo hã mi!

english_verse: If I preach because I want to, I will be paid. But even if I don't want to, it is still something God has sent me to do.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ mitsu yɛ suɔmɔ naa lɛ, miyɛ nyɔmɔwoo; shi kɛjeee suɔmɔ naa tete lɛ, kɛ̃lɛ atu tsulɔnukpayeli awo midɛŋ.

english_verse: What pay am I given? It is the chance to preach the good news free of charge and not to use the privileges that are mine because I am a preacher.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ mɛni ji minyɔmɔwoo mɔ? No ji akɛ, kɛ miijaje Sanekpakpa lɛ, majaje lɛ yaka ni miheee nɔ ko, bɔ ni afee ni mikafee nɔ ko tuutu yɛ mihegbɛ ni miyɔɔ yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ mli lɛ he. Bɔ ni Paulo fee etao mɛi ehã Kristo

english_verse: I am not anyone's slave. But I have become a slave to everyone, so I can win as many people as possible.
translation_verse: Mihiɛ mihe ni mijeee mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɔŋ, kɛ̃lɛ mifee mihe mɛi fɛɛ anyɔŋ, bɔ ni afee ni minine ashɛ mɛi babaoo anɔ.

english_verse: When I am with the Jews, I live like a Jew to win Jews. They are ruled by the Law of Moses, and I am not. But I live by the Law to win them.
translation_verse: Yudafoi lɛ, mitsɔ̃ tamɔ Yudanyo mihã amɛ, bɔ ni afee ni minine ashɛ Yudafoi anɔ; mɛi ni yɔɔ Mla shishi lɛ, mitsɔ̃ tamɔ mɔ ko ni yɔɔ Mla shishi mihã amɛ, tsɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mibɛ Mla shishi, bɔ ni afee ni minine ashɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Mla shishi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: And when I am with people who are not ruled by the Law, I forget about the Law to win them. Of course, I never really forget about the law of God. In fact, I am ruled by the law of Christ.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni bɛ Mla lɛ, mitsɔ̃ tamɔ mɔ ko ni bɛ Mla mihã amɛ, bɔ ni afee ni minine ashɛ mɛi ni bɛ Mla lɛ anɔ, tsɛ mijeee mɔ ko ni bɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla, shi moŋ miyɛ Kristo mla shishi.

english_verse: When I am with people whose faith is weak, I live as they do to win them. I do everything I can to win everyone I possibly can.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ̃ tamɔ gbedelɔ mihã gbedelɔi lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni minine ashɛ gbedelɔi lɛ anɔ; mitsɔ̃ mihe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mihã mɛi fɛɛ, koni bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ mikɛhere mɛi komɛi ayiwala.

english_verse: I do all this for the good news, because I want to share in its blessings. A Race and a Fight
translation_verse: Sanekpakpa lɛ hewɔ mifeɔ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ, bɔ ni afee ni mi hu mana emli jɔɔmɔi lɛ eko. Kristofoi akaŋshii

english_verse: You know that many runners enter a race, and only one of them wins the prize. So run to win!
translation_verse: Ani nyɛleee akɛ foidamɔ mli lɛ, foidalɔi lɛ fɛɛ daa moŋ, shi mɔ kome kɛkɛ naa emli juromɔ nɔ lɛ? Nyɛdaa foi lɛ nakai, koni nyɛnine ashɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Athletes work hard to win a crown that cannot last, but we do it for a crown that will last forever.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni shiɔ akaŋ lɛ, eyeɔ ehe nɔ yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli. Agbɛnɛ amɛ lɛ amɛfeɔ nakai, koni amɛna akekre ni fiteɔ, shi wɔ lɛ, koni wɔna nɔ ni fiteee.

english_verse: I don't run without a goal. And I don't box by beating my fists in the air.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, foi ni midaa nɛɛ, midaaa lɛ kɛkɛ ni oti emaaa mihiɛ; nɔmɔ ni minɔɔ nɛɛ, jeee kɔɔyɔɔ mikɛnɔɔ;

english_verse: I keep my body under control and make it my slave, so I won't lose out after telling the good news to others.
translation_verse: shi moŋ mitswiaa migbɔmɔtso lɛ nii, ni miyeɔ lɛ nyɔŋ, koni mi ni mishiɛɔ mitsɔ̃ɔ mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, mi diɛŋtsɛ lɛ akashɛ mi afɔ̃.

english_verse: Friends, I want to remind you that all our ancestors walked under the cloud and went through the sea.
translation_verse: Shi, anyɛmimɛi, misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ nyɛhiɛ aje nɔ akɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ hi atatu lɛ shishi, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛfo Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ,

english_verse: This was like being baptized and becoming followers of Moses.
translation_verse: ni abaptisi amɛ fɛɛ awo Mose mli yɛ atatu lɛ kɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ mli.

english_verse: All of them also ate the same spiritual food
translation_verse: Ni amɛ fɛɛ lɛ mumɔŋ niyenii kome lɛ nɔŋŋ amɛye,

english_verse: and drank the same spiritual drink, which flowed from the spiritual rock that followed them. That rock was Christ.
translation_verse: ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛnu mumɔŋ nu kome lɛ nɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ amɛnu mumɔŋ tɛsaa ni kɛ amɛ nyiɛ lɛ mli nu, ni tɛsaa lɛ ji Kristo.

english_verse: But most of them did not please God. So they died, and their bodies were scattered all over the desert.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naaa amɛteŋ mɛi pii ahe tsui, ejaakɛ aplene amɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: What happened to them is a warning to keep us from wanting to do the same evil things.
translation_verse: Shi akɛ enɛɛmɛi eto wɔ okadi, koni wɔkahã nibii fɔ̃ji miifee wɔ akɔnɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni efee amɛ lɛ.

english_verse: They worshiped idols, just as the Scriptures say, “The people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up to dance around.” So don't worship idols.
translation_verse: Asaŋ nyɛkatsɔmɔa amãgãjalɔi tamɔ amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi fee lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, “Maŋ lɛ ho tara shi ni amɛye nii ni amɛnu nii, ni amɛte shi ni amɛshwɛ.”

english_verse: Some of those people did shameful things, and in a single day about
translation_verse: Ni wɔsaa wɔkabɔ ajwamãŋ tamɔ bɔ ni amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi bɔ ajwamãŋ ni gbi kome nɔ lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ nyɔnyɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do whatever we want to!” But I tell you not everything may be good or helpful.
translation_verse: Wɔyɛ nibii fɛɛ hegbɛ, shi jeee nibii fɛɛ hi; wɔyɛ nibii fɛɛ hegbɛ, shi jeee nibii fɛɛ hãa mɔ nane mɔɔ shi.

english_verse: And don't try to test Christ, as some of them did and were later bitten by poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Ni asaŋ wɔkaka Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ka lɛ ni onufui bakpãtã amɛhiɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't even grumble, as some of them did and were killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛsaa nyɛkawiea huhuuhu tamɔ bɔ ni amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi hu wie huhuuhu ni hiɛkpãtãlɔ lɛ bakpãtã amɛhiɛ lɛ.

english_verse: These things happened to them as a warning to us. All this was written in the Scriptures to teach us who live in these last days.
translation_verse: Shi enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ba amɛnɔ ni akɛto okadi ahã wɔ, ni aŋma ni akɛbɔ wɔ kɔkɔ, wɔ mɛi ni je lɛ naagbee bei lɛ enina wɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Even if you think you can stand up to temptation, be careful not to fall.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni susuɔ akɛ edamɔ shi lɛ akwɛ ehe ni ahi koni ekagbee shi.

english_verse: You are tempted in the same way that everyone else is tempted. But God can be trusted not to let you be tempted too much, and he will show you how to escape from your temptations.
translation_verse: Kaa ko bako nyɛnɔ ni jeee gbɔmɔ he nɔ; shi anɔkwafo ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ehãŋ aka nyɛ fe bɔ ni nyɛaanyɛ; moŋ, yɛ kaa lɛ mli lɛ, ebaaje gbɛ ni nyɛkɛaaje mli koni nyɛnyɛ mli nyɛmɔ.

english_verse: My friends, you must keep away from idols.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, misuɔmɔ mɛi, nyɛjoa wɔŋjamɔ naa foi!

english_verse: I am speaking to you as people who have enough sense to know what I am talking about.
translation_verse: Mikɛ nyɛ miiwie tamɔ akɛ nilelɔi wieɔ; nɔ ni mikɛɔ lɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhalaa mli.

english_verse: When we drink from the cup we ask God to bless, isn't that sharing in the blood of Christ? When we eat the bread we break, isn't that sharing in the body of Christ?
translation_verse: Jɔɔmɔ kpulu lɛ ni wɔjɔɔ lɛ, ani jeee Kristo lá lɛ naanyobɔɔ lɛ ni? Aboloo ni wɔkumɔɔ lɛ, ani jeee Kristo gbɔmɔtso lɛ naanyobɔɔ lɛ ni?

english_verse: By sharing in the same loaf of bread, we become one body, even though there are many of us.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ aboloo kome ni, ni wɔyi pii moŋ, shi gbɔmɔtso kome ji wɔ, ejaakɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔyeɔ aboloo kome lɛ eko.

english_verse: Aren't the people of Israel sharing in the worship when they gather around the altar and eat the sacrifices offered there?
translation_verse: Nyɛkwɛa Israel! Ani mɛi ni yeɔ afɔleshãanii lɛ, jeee naanyo amɛkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ bɔɔ lɛ?

english_verse: Am I saying that either the idols or the food sacrificed to them is anything at all?
translation_verse: Belɛ mɛni mikɛɛ mɔ? Akɛ amãgã afɔle ji nɔ ko, aloo akɛ amãgã ji nɔ ko?

english_verse: No, I am not! This food is really sacrificed to demons and not to God. I don't want you to have anything to do with demons.
translation_verse: Dabi, shi moŋ miikɛɛ akɛ afɔle ni wɔŋjalɔi lɛ shãa lɛ, mumɔi fɔ̃ji amɛshãa amɛhãa, shi jeee Nyɔŋmɔ; ni misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ nyɛkɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji bɔɔ naanyo.

english_verse: You cannot drink from the cup of demons and still drink from the Lord's cup. You cannot eat at the table of demons and still eat at the Lord's table.
translation_verse: Nyɛnyɛŋ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kpulu lɛ kɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji akpulu fɛɛ nyɛnu shi kome; nyɛnyɛŋ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ nii kɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji anɔ lɛ nɔ nii fɛɛ nyɛye shi kome.

english_verse: We would make the Lord jealous if we did this. And we are not stronger than the Lord. Always Honor God
translation_verse: Aloo wɔmiifee ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aye awuŋã? Ani wɔhe wa fe lɛ? Wɔŋ loo he ŋaawoo

english_verse: We should think about others and not about ourselves.
translation_verse: Mɔ ko mɔ ko akapele miihã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe, shi moŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ apele ahã enaanyo.

english_verse: However, when you buy meat in the market, go ahead and eat it. Keep your conscience clear by not asking where the meat came from.
translation_verse: Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ahɔ̃ɔ yɛ loo jara nɔ lɛ nyɛyea; shi henilee hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkabia mli;

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.”
translation_verse: ejaakɛ “shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ emlinii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ ni.”

english_verse: If an unbeliever invites you to dinner, and you want to go, then go. Eat whatever you are served. Don't cause a problem for someone's conscience by asking where the food came from.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko kpee nyɛ okplɔ̃ he ni nyɛmiisumɔ akɛ nyɛaatee lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛaama nyɛhiɛ lɛ, nyɛyea ni nyɛkabia mli, yɛ henilee hewɔ.

english_verse: But if you are told it has been sacrificed to idols, don't cause a problem by eating it. I don't mean a problem for yourself, but for the one who told you. Why should my freedom be limited by someone else's conscience?
translation_verse: Shi henilee ni mitsɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ, jeee bo diɛŋtsɛ onɔ lɛ, shi moŋ mɔ kroko lɛ nɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ mɛɛ hewɔ sa akɛ mɔ kroko henilee akojo mihe ni mihiɛ lɛ?

english_verse: If I give thanks for what I eat, why should anyone accuse me of doing wrong?
translation_verse: Kɛ shidaa mikɛye lɛ, mɛɛba awieɔ mihe efɔŋ yɛ nii ni mida shi yɛ he lɛ hewɔ?

english_verse: When you eat or drink or do anything else, always do it to honor God.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nii nyɛyeɔ jio, nii nyɛnuɔ jio, aloo nɔ kroko nyɛfeɔ jio, nyɛfea fɛɛ nyɛkɛwoa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam.

english_verse: Don't cause problems for Jews or Greeks or anyone else who belongs to God's church.
translation_verse: Nyɛkatsɔmɔa pampii nyɛhãa Yudafoi kɛ Helabii kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ asafo lɛ fɛɛ;

english_verse: I always try to please others instead of myself, in the hope that many of them will be saved.
translation_verse: tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni mi hu misumɔɔ akɛ nibii fɛɛ mli lɛ masa mɛi fɛɛ hiɛ, ni mitaooo nɔ ni hi hã mi diɛŋtsɛ, shi moŋ nɔ ni hi hã mɛi pii koni ahere amɛyiwala lɛ.

english_verse: You must follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ. Rules for Worship
translation_verse: Nyɛkasea mi, tamɔ bɔ ni mi hu mikaseɔ Kristo lɛ.

english_verse: I am proud of you, because you always remember me and obey the teachings I gave you.
translation_verse: Shi, anyɛmimɛi, miijie nyɛyi akɛ nyɛkaiɔ mi yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli, ni nyɛhiɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ni mikɛhã nyɛ lɛ mli bɔ pɛ ni mikɛhã nyɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that Christ is the head of all men, and a man is the head of a woman. But God is the head of Christ.
translation_verse: Shi miisumɔ akɛ nyɛle akɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu yitso ji Kristo, ni yoo fɛɛ yoo hu yitso ji nuu, ni Kristo yitso ji Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: This means that any man who prays or prophesies with something on his head brings shame to his head.
translation_verse: Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni sɔleɔ loo egbaa ni ekɛ nɔ ko eha eyiteŋ lɛ, eegbe eyitso lɛ he guɔ.

english_verse: But any woman who prays or prophesies without something on her head brings shame to her head. In fact, she may as well shave her head.
translation_verse: Shi yoo fɛɛ yoo ni sɔleɔ loo egbaa ni ehiɛ eyitso folo lɛ, lɛ hu eegbe eyitso lɛ he guɔ; ejaakɛ etamɔ nɔ ni eshɛ eyi nɔŋŋ pɛ.

english_verse: A woman should wear something on her head. It is a disgrace for a woman to shave her head or cut her hair. But if she refuses to wear something on her head, let her cut off her hair.
translation_verse: Kɛ yoo lɛ ehaaa eyi nɔ lɛ, eku eyi mɔ; shi akɛni eji hiɛgbele sane hã yoo akɛ eeeku eyi loo eeeshɛ eyi lɛ, eha eyi nɔ.

english_verse: It was the woman who was made from a man, and not the man who was made from a woman.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nuu jɛɛɛ yoo mli, shi yoo moŋ jɛ nuu mli.

english_verse: He wasn't created for her. She was created for him.
translation_verse: Ni asaŋ abɔɔɔ nuu yɛ yoo hewɔ; shi yoo moŋ abɔ yɛ nuu hewɔ.

english_verse: And so, because of this, and also because of the angels, a woman ought to wear something on her head, as a sign of her authority.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, yɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, esa akɛ ana hewalɛ he okadi ko yɛ yoo lɛ yiteŋ.

english_verse: As far as the Lord is concerned, men and women need each other.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ, nuu nyɛŋ ashi yoo sɛɛ, ni yoo hu nyɛŋ ashi nuu sɛɛ.

english_verse: It is true that the first woman came from a man, but all other men have been given birth by women. Yet God is the one who created everything.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni yoo jɛ nuu mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ nuu hu tsɔ̃ yoo nɔ kɛba; shi nii fɛɛ jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli.

english_verse: Ask yourselves if it is proper for a woman to pray without something on her head.
translation_verse: Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhalaa mli yɛ nyɛteŋ. Ani eyɛ fɛo akɛ yoo aaasɔle yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ni ehaaa eyi nɔ lo?

english_verse: But long hair is a beautiful way for a woman to cover her head.
translation_verse: shi yoo lɛ, kɛji eŋmɛ eyi kusuu lɛ, eji anunyam hã lɛ? Ejaakɛ akɛ yitsɔi lɛ hã lɛ akɛ hehaanɔ.

english_verse: This is how things are done in all of God's churches, and this is why none of you should argue about what I have said. Rules for the Lord's Supper
translation_verse: Shi kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ akɛ efee ehe naataalɔ yɛ enɛ he lɛ, wɔ lɛ jeee wɔkusum ji no, ni Nyɔŋmɔ asafoi lɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ. Nuŋtsɔ Niyenii lɛ

english_verse: Your worship services do you more harm than good. I am certainly not going to praise you for this.
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ nibii ni mibatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ ni nyɛfee nɛɛ, jeee nyɛyi mikɛjieɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ kɛ nyɛkpe lɛ, jeee ekpakpa jɛɔ mli, shi moŋ efɔŋ.

english_verse: I am told you can't get along with each other when you worship, and I am sure that some of what I have heard is true.
translation_verse: Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, minu akɛ, kɛ nyɛyabua nyɛhe naa yɛ asafo lɛ mli lɛ, mligbalamɔi yɛ nyɛteŋ, ni miheɔ miyeɔ fã kɛ fã.

english_verse: You are bound to argue with each other, but it is easy to see which of you have God's approval.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ sa akɛ mligbalamɔi aba nyɛteŋ koni mɛi kpakpai lɛ ajie amɛhe shi faŋŋ yɛ nyɛteŋ.

english_verse: You even start eating before everyone gets to the meeting, and some of you go hungry, while others get drunk.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ nyɛniyeli nɛɛ mli lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tsɔ̃ɔ hiɛ yeɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eniyenii, ni be ni hɔ̃mɔ miiye mɔ ko lɛ, belɛ mɔ ko etɔ dãa.

english_verse: The Lord meant that when you eat this bread and drink from this cup, you tell about his death until he comes.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ shii abɔ ni nyɛyeɔ nɛkɛ aboloo nɛɛ ni nyɛnuɔ nɛkɛ kpulu nɛɛ hu lɛ, nyɛmiijaje Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbele lɛ nyɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeeba.

english_verse: If you fail to understand that you are the body of the Lord, you will condemn yourselves by the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɔ ni yeɔ ni enuɔ bɔ ni esaaa lɛ, kojomɔ moŋ eyeɔ ni enuɔ ehãa ehe lɛ, ejaakɛ ebuuu Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ.

english_verse: After the meal, Jesus took a cup of wine in his hands and said, “This is my blood, and with it God makes his new agreement with you. Drink this and remember me.”
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ ewo kpulu lɛ hu yɛ niyenii lɛ asɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Nɛkɛ kpulu nɛɛ ji kpãŋmɔ hee lɛ yɛ milá lɛ mli; nyɛfea enɛ, shii abɔ ni nyɛaanu lɛ ni nyɛkɛkaia mi.”

english_verse: I have already told you what the Lord Jesus did on the night he was betrayed. And it came from the Lord himself. He took some bread in his hands.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nɔ ni mikɛhã nyɛ lɛ mina kɛjɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ, akɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Yesu lɛ, nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ni atsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ, ekɔ aboloo,

english_verse: Then after he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body, which is given for you. Eat this and remember me.”
translation_verse: ni eda shi, ni ekumɔ mli, ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛhea nyɛyea, enɛ ji migbɔmɔtso ni akɛhã yɛ nyɛhewɔ; nyɛfea enɛ ni nyɛkɛkaia mi.”

english_verse: But if you eat the bread and drink the wine in a way that isn't worthy of the Lord, you sin against his body and blood.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ nɛkɛ aboloo nɛɛ ni enuɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kpulu lɛ bɔ ni esaaa lɛ, eetɔ̃ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ kɛ elá lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: This is why you must examine the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Shi gbɔmɔ aka lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe ekwɛ dani eye aboloo nɛɛ eko ni enu kpulu nɛɛ eko.

english_verse: This is why many of you are sick and weak and why a lot of others have died.
translation_verse: No hewɔ hu ni nyɛteŋ mɛi pii egbɔjɔ ni amɛhe yeɔ, ni mɛi babaoo hu egboi nɛɛ.

english_verse: If we carefully judge ourselves, we won't be punished.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji wɔka wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhe wɔkwɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ekojoŋ wɔ.

english_verse: But when the Lord judges and punishes us, he does it to keep us from being condemned with the rest of the world.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ miikojo wɔ lɛ, ekɛmiitsɔse wɔ, bɔ ni afee ni akabu wɔ kɛ je lɛ fɛɛ fɔ.

english_verse: My dear friends, you should wait until everyone gets there before you start eating.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, minyɛmimɛi, kɛ nyɛnaa bakpe shi ni nyɛbaaye nii lɛ, nyɛmɛmɛa nyɛhe.

english_verse: If you really are hungry, you can eat at home. Then you won't condemn yourselves when you meet together. After I arrive, I will instruct you about the other matters.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ hɔ̃mɔ miiye mɔ ko lɛ, eye nii yɛ shĩa dã, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛkpee lɛ akatsɛ kojomɔ miihã nyɛ. Shi nii ni eshwɛ lɛ, kɛ miba lɛ, mato amɛ gbɛjianɔ.

english_verse: My friends, you asked me about spiritual gifts.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ, anyɛmimɛi, miisumɔ akɛ mahã nyɛle mumɔŋnii ahe nɔ ko.

english_verse: I want you to remember that before you became followers of the Lord, you were led in all the wrong ways by idols that cannot even talk.
translation_verse: Nyɛle akɛ be ni nyɛ ji jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ, amãgãi mumuii lɛ aŋɔɔ akpala nyɛ kɛtee, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni akpala nyɛ ahã lɛ.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that if you are led by God's Spirit, you will say that Jesus is Lord, and you will never curse Jesus.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, miihã nyɛle akɛ mɔ ko ewieee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ naa ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Yesu ji musumɔ”; ni mɔ ko nyɛŋ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Yesu ji Nuŋtsɔ” hu, akɛ ja yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ naa.

english_verse: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but they all come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Dromɔ keenii srɔtoi yɛ, shi Mumɔ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ hãa;

english_verse: There are different ways to serve the same Lord,
translation_verse: ni sɔ̃ɔmɔ nitsumɔi srɔtoi hu yɛ, shi Nuŋtsɔ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ akɛsɔ̃mɔɔ;

english_verse: and we can each do different things. Yet the same God works in all of us and helps us in everything we do.
translation_verse: ni nitsumɔi srɔtoi hu yɛ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ ji mɔ ni tsuɔ fɛɛ yɛ mɛi fɛɛ amli.

english_verse: The Spirit has given each of us a special way of serving others.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ ahãa Mumɔ lɛ jieɔ ehe kpo yɛ emli koni ahi ahã mɛi fɛɛ.

english_verse: Some of us can speak with wisdom, while others can speak with knowledge, but these gifts come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Mɔ ko lɛ, atsɔ̃ Mumɔ lɛ nɔ ahã lɛ nilee wiemɔ; ni mɔ ko hu ahã lɛ niiashishinamɔ wiemɔ yɛ nakai Mumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ naa.

english_verse: To others the Spirit has given great faith or the power to heal the sick
translation_verse: Mɔ ko lɛ, ahã lɛ hemɔkɛyeli yɛ nakai Mumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ naa; ni mɔ kroko hu ahã lɛ tsamɔ dromɔ keenii yɛ nakai Mumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ mli.

english_verse: or the power to work mighty miracles. Some of us are prophets, and some of us recognize when God's Spirit is present. Others can speak different kinds of languages, and still others can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: Mɔ ko lɛ hewalɛnii atsumɔ; mɔ ko lɛ gbalɛ; mɔ ko hu mumɔi ashikpamɔ ni akɛnaa mumɔi amligbalamɔi; mɔ ko lɛ wiemɔi srɔtoi awiemɔ; ni mɔ ko hu wiemɔi ashishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ.

english_verse: But it is the Spirit who does all this and decides which gifts to give to each of us. One Body with Many Parts
translation_verse: Shi nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ Mumɔ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ tsuɔ, ni ejaa ehãa bɔ ni esumɔɔ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enɔ. Wɔ fɛɛ lɛ Gbɔmɔtso Kome henii ji wɔ

english_verse: The body of Christ has many different parts, just as any other body does.
translation_verse: Shi tamɔ bɔ ni gbɔmɔtso lɛ ekome ni, shi ehiɛ henii pii, ni gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii pii lɛ fɛɛ gbɔmɔtso kome ni lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ hu ji Kristo.

english_verse: Some of us are Jews, and others are Gentiles. Some of us are slaves, and others are free. But God's Spirit baptized each of us and made us part of the body of Christ. Now we each drink from that same Spirit.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yudafoi ji wɔ jio, Helabii ji wɔ jio, nyɔji ji wɔ jio, wɔhiɛ wɔhe jio, wɔ fɛɛ lɛ Mumɔ kome nɔ atsɔ abaptisi wɔ awo gbɔmɔtso kome mli; ni wɔ fɛɛ lɛ, Mumɔ kome akɛhã wɔ ni wɔnu.

english_verse: Our bodies don't have just one part. They have many parts.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ hu jeee he nɔ kome ni, shi moŋ henii pii ni.

english_verse: Suppose a foot says, “I'm not a hand, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the foot still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Kɛji nane aaakɛɛ akɛ, “Akɛni jeee nine ji mi hewɔ lɛ, jeee gbɔmɔtso lɛ he nii lɛ eko ji mi” lɛ, ani enɛ hewɔ lɛ jeee gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii lɛ eko ji lɛ?

english_verse: Or suppose an ear says, “I'm not an eye, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the ear still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Ni kɛji toi hu aaakɛɛ akɛ, “Akɛni jeee hiŋmɛi ji mi hewɔ lɛ, jeee gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii lɛ eko ji mi” lɛ, ani enɛ hewɔ lɛ jeee gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii lɛ eko ji lɛ?

english_verse: If our bodies were only an eye, we couldn't hear a thing. And if they were only an ear, we couldn't smell a thing.
translation_verse: Kɛ gbɔmɔtso muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ hiŋmɛi ni lɛ, nɛgbɛ ninumɔ yɔɔ? Kɛ ninumɔ sɔŋŋ ni lɛ, nɛgbɛ nifuu yɔɔ?

english_verse: But God has put all parts of our body together in the way that he decided is best.
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ henii lɛ eko fɛɛ eko ema gbɔmɔtso lɛ he, bɔ ni esumɔɔ.

english_verse: A body isn't really a body, unless there is more than one part.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ amɛ fɛɛ lɛ henɔ kome ni lɛ, nɛgbɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ yɔɔ?

english_verse: It takes many parts to make a single body.
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ henii pii ni moŋ, shi gbɔmɔtso kome ni.

english_verse: That's why the eyes cannot say they don't need the hands. That's also why the head cannot say it doesn't need the feet.
translation_verse: Hiŋmɛi nyɛŋ ekɛɛ nine akɛ, “Ohe ehĩaaa mi;” ni asaŋ yitso nyɛŋ ekɛɛ naji akɛ, “Nyɛhe ehĩaaa mi.”

english_verse: In fact, we cannot get along without the parts of the body that seem to be the weakest.
translation_verse: Shi gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii ni efeɔ wɔ akɛ amɛhe waaa kwraa lɛ, amɛ moŋ amɛhe hiaa wɔ titri;

english_verse: We take special care to dress up some parts of our bodies. We are modest about our personal parts,
translation_verse: ni nii ni efeɔ wɔ akɛ amɛ ji gbɔmɔtso henii ni hiɛ bɛ nyam kwraa lɛ, nomɛi titri ahiɛ nyam wɔwoɔ, ni wɔhenii ni bɛ fɛo lɛ moŋ naa hefɛo titri ko;

english_verse: but we don't have to be modest about other parts. God put our bodies together in such a way that even the parts that seem the least important are valuable.
translation_verse: shi wɔhenii ni yɔɔ fɛo momo lɛ, enɛ he ehĩaaa amɛ. Shi Nyɔŋmɔ tsara gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii lɛ, ni nɔ ni shwɛɔ lɛ nɔ ko lɛ, no titri ekɛ woo hãa

english_verse: He did this to make all parts of the body work together smoothly, with each part caring about the others.
translation_verse: koni mligbalamɔ akaba gbɔmɔtso lɛ mli, shi moŋ henii lɛ abaabaa amɛhe yi pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: If one part of our body hurts, we hurt all over. If one part of our body is honored, the whole body will be happy.
translation_verse: Ni kɛji henɔ kome miina nɔ lɛ, henii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ lɛ naa nɔ, ni kɛji henɔ kome hiɛ ba nyam hu, henii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ lɛ naa miishɛɛ.

english_verse: Together you are the body of Christ. Each one of you is part of his body.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛ lɛ, Kristo gbɔmɔtso ji nyɛ; ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ ehenii lɛ eko ji lɛ.

english_verse: First, God chose some people to be apostles and prophets and teachers for the church. But he also chose some to work miracles or heal the sick or help others or be leaders or speak different kinds of languages.
translation_verse: Ni klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ wo mɛi komɛi bɔfoi yɛ asafo lɛ mli, nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ, gbalɔi, nɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, tsɔɔlɔi, no sɛɛ lɛ, hewalɛ nitsulɔi, no sɛɛ lɛ, mɛi ni yɔɔ helaiatsamɔ he dromɔ keenii, yelikɛbualɔi, hiɛnyiɛlɔi, mɛi ni wieɔ wiemɔi srɔtoi.

english_verse: Not everyone is an apostle. Not everyone is a prophet. Not everyone is a teacher. Not everyone can work miracles.
translation_verse: Ani mɛi fɛɛ ji bɔfoi? Ani mɛi fɛɛ ji gbalɔi?

english_verse: Not everyone can heal the sick. Not everyone can speak different kinds of languages. Not everyone can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: Ani mɛi fɛɛ yɔɔ helaiatsamɔ dromɔ keenii? Ani mɛi fɛɛ wieɔ wiemɔi srɔtoi? Ani mɛi fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ wiemɔi ashishi?

english_verse: I want you to desire the best gifts. So I will show you a much better way.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛhiɛ adɔa dromɔ keenii ni fe fɛɛ lɛ ahe. Ni masaa matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ gbɛ ni hi fe fɛɛ.

english_verse: What if I could speak all languages of humans and even of angels? If I did not love others, I would be nothing more than a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
translation_verse: Kɛji mikɛ gbɔmɛi kɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi alilɛi wieɔ, shi mibɛ suɔmɔ lɛ, no lɛ mitsɔ̃ ayawa ni jijeɔ loo ŋmɛlɛ ni gbɛɔ.

english_verse: What if I could prophesy and understand all mysteries and all knowledge? And what if I had faith that moved mountains? I would be nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Ni kɛji miyɛ gbalɛ dromɔ keenii, ni minaa teemɔŋnii fɛɛ naa, ni mile nii fɛɛ, ni kɛji miyɛ hemɔkɛyeli fɛɛ hu, bɔ ni manyɛ gɔji mafãmɔ, shi mibɛ suɔmɔ lɛ, no lɛ mijeee nɔ ko.

english_verse: What if I gave away all that I owned and let myself be burned alive? I would gain nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Ni kɛji mikɛ minii fɛɛ kuma mɛi, ni kɛji mikɛ migbɔmɔtso hã ni ashã mi, shi mibɛ suɔmɔ lɛ, no lɛ minaaa sɛɛ ko.

english_verse: Love is patient and kind, never jealous, boastful, proud, or
translation_verse: Suɔmɔ toɔ etsui shi; emli hi; suɔmɔ hiɛ ekɔ̃ɔɔ mɔ nɔ; suɔmɔ eshwãaa; efeee pupuupu;

english_verse: rude. Love isn't selfish or quick tempered. It doesn't keep a record of wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: efeee nii ni esaaa; epeleee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ, emli wooo la; eniŋŋ efɔŋ he;

english_verse: Love rejoices in the truth, but not in evil.
translation_verse: enyãaa nɔ sha he; shi anɔkwale moŋ he enyãa;

english_verse: Love never fails! Everyone who prophesies will stop, and unknown languages will no longer be spoken. All that we know will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Suɔmɔ sɛɛ efooo gbi ko gbi ko. Shi kɛji gbalɛi ni lɛ, amɛsɛɛ baafo; kɛji wiemɔi ni lɛ, abaafɔ̃ɔ; kɛji nilee ni lɛ, esɛɛ baafo.

english_verse: We don't know everything, and our prophecies are not complete.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔnii ni wɔle lɛ, fã kɛ fã ni, ni wɔgbalɛ hu fã kɛ fã ni.

english_verse: But what is perfect will someday appear, and what isn't perfect will then disappear.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ nɔ ni eye emuu lɛ ba lɛ, no lɛ nɔ ni ji fã kɛ fã lɛ sɛɛ aaafo.

english_verse: When we were children, we thought and reasoned as children do. But when we grew up, we quit our childish ways.
translation_verse: Be ni mi ji abifao lɛ, miwieɔ tamɔ abifao, mijwɛŋɔ tamɔ abifao, misusuɔ tamɔ abifao; shi be ni mitsɔ̃ nuu nukpa lɛ, mishɛrɛ abifabiianii lɛ mishwie.

english_verse: Now all we can see of God is like a cloudy picture in a mirror. Later we will see him face to face. We don't know everything, but then we will, just as God completely understands us.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ amrɔ nɛɛ ashwishwɛ mli wɔtsɔ̃ɔ wɔnaa nii tuutuu, shi no mli lɛ eeefee hiɛ kɛ hiɛ; amrɔ nɛɛ mile nii fã kɛ fã, shi no mli lɛ, male nii kɛyi shi tamɔ bɔ ni ale mi kɛyi shi lɛ.

english_verse: For now there are faith, hope, and love. But of these three, the greatest is love.
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ hemɔkɛyeli, hiɛnɔkãmɔ, suɔmɔ, nɛkɛ nibii etɛ̃ nɛɛ, hiɔ shi; shi suɔmɔ ji amɛteŋ nɔ ni fe fɛɛ.

english_verse: Love should be your guide. Be eager to have the gifts that come from the Holy Spirit, especially the gift of prophecy.
translation_verse: Nyɛdia suɔmɔ sɛɛ. Ni nyɛhiɛ adɔa yɛ mumɔŋnii lɛ ahe, shi titri lɛ, gbalɛ.

english_verse: If you speak languages that others don't know, God will understand what you are saying, though no one else will know what you mean. You will be talking about mysteries that only the Spirit understands.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɔ ni wieɔ wiemɔ srɔto ko lɛ, jeee gbɔmɛi ekɛwieɔ shi Nyɔŋmɔ moŋ; ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko nuuu, akɛni mumɔ mli ewieɔ teemɔ saji yɛ lɛ.

english_verse: But when you prophesy, you will be understood, and others will be helped. They will be encouraged and made to feel better.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni gbaa lɛ, gbɔmɛi ekɛwieɔ ni ekɛhã amɛnane amɔ shi, ni ekɛwo amɛ hewalɛ, ni ekɛshɛje amɛmii.

english_verse: By speaking languages that others don't know, you help only yourself. But by prophesying you help everyone in the church.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni wieɔ wiemɔ srɔto ko lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enane ehãa mɔɔ shi; shi mɔ ni gbaa lɛ, asafo lɛ nane ehãa mɔɔ shi.

english_verse: I am glad for you to speak unknown languages, although I prefer that you would prophesy. In fact, prophesying does much more good than speaking unknown languages, unless someone can help the church by explaining what you mean.
translation_verse: Miisumɔ ni nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛwie wiemɔi srɔtoi; shi nɔ ni misumɔɔ titri ji akɛ nyɛgba; ejaakɛ mɔ ni gbaa lɛ, efe mɔ ni wieɔ wiemɔi srɔtoi, belɛ ja mɔ ni wieɔ wiemɔi srɔtoi lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ shishi bɔ ni afee ni asafo lɛ nane amɔ̃ shi.

english_verse: My friends, what good would it do, if I came and spoke unknown languages to you and didn't explain what I meant? How would I help you, unless I told you what God had shown me or gave you some knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ, anyɛmimɛi, kɛji miba nyɛŋɔɔ mibawie wiemɔi srɔtoi ni jeee kpojiemɔ loo nilee loo gbalɛ loo nitsɔɔmɔ ko ni lɛ, mɛɛ sɛɛ mibahã nyɛna?

english_verse: If all musical instruments sounded alike, how would you know the difference between a flute and a harp?
translation_verse: Tamɔ bɔ ni nii ni bɛ wala lɛ agbɛɛmɔ yɔɔ lɛ, blɛ jio, saŋku jio, kɛji egbɛɛɛ kɛ gbei srɔtoisrɔtoi lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni aaale nɔ ni akpãa loo nɔ ni atswaa lɛ?

english_verse: If a bugle call isn't clear, how would you know to get ready for battle?
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛji tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ egbɛɛɛ gbɛɛmɔ ni yɔɔ faŋŋ lɛ, namɔ aaasaa ehe ato ta?

english_verse: This is how it is when you speak unknown languages. If no one can understand what you are talking about, you will only be talking to the wind.
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ nyɛ hu, yɛ wiemɔ srɔto wiemɔ mli lɛ, kɛji nyɛwieee nɔ ni shishi yɔɔ faŋŋ lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni aaale nɔ ni akɛɔ lɛ? Ejaakɛ no lɛ nyɛbaafee tamɔ mɛi ni wieɔ tsɔ̃ɔ kɔɔyɔɔ.

english_verse: But if I don't understand the language that someone is using, we will be like foreigners to each other.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji minaaa wiemɔ lɛ shishi lɛ, belɛ mibatsɔ̃ mɔkpɔŋ yɛ mɔ ni wieɔ lɛ hiɛ, ni mɔ ni wieɔ lɛ hu baatsɔ mɔkpɔŋ yɛ mihiɛ.

english_verse: If you really want spiritual gifts, choose the ones that will be most helpful to the church.
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu, akɛni nyɛhiɛ dɔɔ yɛ mumɔŋ nii ahe lɛ, nyɛbɔa mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛtekea nɔ ni asafo lɛ nane amɔ shi.

english_verse: When we speak languages that others don't know, we should pray for the power to explain what we mean.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni wieɔ wiemɔ srɔto ko lɛ, esɔle koni enyɛ etsɔ̃ɔ shishi hu.

english_verse: For example, if I use an unknown language in my prayers, my spirit prays but my mind is useless.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛji misɔle kɛ wiemɔ srɔto lɛ, mimumɔ miisɔle nɛ, shi mijwɛŋmɔ lɛ, ewooo yibii.

english_verse: Then what should I do? There are times when I should pray with my spirit, and times when I should pray with my mind. Sometimes I should sing with my spirit, and at other times I should sing with my mind.
translation_verse: Belɛ mɛni sa akɛ mafee? Mikɛ mumɔ aaasɔle, shi mikɛ jwɛŋmɔ hu aaasɔle; mala lala kɛ mumɔ, shi mala kɛ jwɛŋmɔ hu.

english_verse: Suppose some strangers are in your worship service, when you are praising God with your spirit. If they don't understand you, how will they know to say, “Amen”?
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ okɛ mumɔ miijɔɔ lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni mɔ ni leee mli eko lɛ aahere oshidaa lɛ nɔ akɛ “Amen”, akɛni eleee nɔ ni okɛɔ lɛ?

english_verse: You may be worshiping God in a wonderful way, but no one else will be helped.
translation_verse: Bo lɛ, ooda shi jogbaŋŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ mɔ kroko lɛ nane mɔɔɔ shi.

english_verse: I thank God that I speak unknown languages more than any of you.
translation_verse: Midaa miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi akɛ mife nyɛ fɛɛ yɛ wiemɔi srɔtoi awiemɔ mli;

english_verse: But words that make sense can help the church. This is why in church I would rather speak five words that make sense than to speak
translation_verse: shi kɛ̃lɛ asafo lɛ mli lɛ, miisumɔ akɛ mikɛ mijwɛŋmɔ awie wiemɔi komekomei enumɔ, koni mikɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi krokomɛi anii moŋ, fe nɔ ni mawie wiemɔi komekomei akpei nyɔŋma yɛ wiemɔi srɔtoi amli.

english_verse: My friends, stop thinking like children. Think like mature people and be as innocent as tiny babies.
translation_verse: Anyɛmimɛi, nyɛkafea nyɛhe gbekɛbii yɛ jwɛŋmɔ gbɛfãŋ. Efɔŋ gbɛfãŋ lɛ, nyɛfea nyɛhe abifabii; shi jwɛŋmɔ gbɛfãŋ lɛ, nyɛfea nyɛhe mɛi ni edara.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I will use strangers who speak unknown languages to talk to my people. They will speak to them in foreign languages, but still my people won't listen to me.”
translation_verse: Aŋma yɛ Mla lɛ mli akɛ, “Wiemɔi krokomɛi kɛ naabui krokomɛi anɔ matsɔ̃ mikɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ aaawie, Shi no hu tete amɛboŋ mi toi, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ.”

english_verse: Languages others don't know may mean something to unbelievers, but not to the Lord's followers. Prophecy, on the other hand, is for followers, not for unbelievers.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, wiemɔi srɔtoi lɛ ejeee okadi hã heyelɔi, shi moŋ eji okadi hã mɛi ni heee yeee; ni gbalɛ lɛ, ejeee mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ anɔ, shi moŋ heyelɔi anɔ.

english_verse: Suppose everyone in your worship service started speaking unknown languages, and some outsiders or some unbelievers come in. Won't they think you are crazy?
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ kɛji asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa bakpe shi yɛ he kome, ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ miiwie wiemɔi srɔtoi, ni mɛi ni leee mli eko aloo mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi hu ba jɛi lɛ, ani amɛkɛŋ akɛ nyɛmiiye sɛkɛ?

english_verse: But suppose all of you are prophesying when those unbelievers and outsiders come in. They will realize that they are sinners, and they will want to change their ways because of what you are saying.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji mɛi lɛ fɛɛ miigba, ni mɔ ko ni heee yeee aloo eleee mli eko lɛ ba jɛi lɛ, mɛi lɛ fɛɛ agbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ, ni aaakã lɛ, ni nomɛi nɔŋŋ aaakojo lɛ,

english_verse: They will tell what is hidden in their hearts. Then they will kneel down and say to God, “We are certain that you are with these people.” Worship Must Be Orderly
translation_verse: aaajie etsuiŋ teemɔnii akpo faŋŋ, ni no aaahã ekɛ ehiɛ abu shi eja Nyɔŋmɔ, ni eeejaje akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛɛlɛŋ.” Mumɔŋ dromɔ keenii ahe gbɛjianɔtoo

english_verse: My friends, when you meet to worship, you must do everything for the good of everyone there. That's how it should be when someone sings or teaches or tells what God has said or speaks an unknown language or explains what the language means.
translation_verse: Belɛ te tɛŋŋ, anyɛmimɛi? Kɛ nyɛnaa bakpe shi ni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko yɛ lala ko, mɔ ko hu yɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ko, mɔ ko yɛ kpojiemɔ ko, mɔ ko yɛ wiemɔ srɔto ko, mɔ ko yɛ shishitsɔɔmɔ ko lɛ, afee fɛɛ bɔ ni mɛi anane aaamɔ shi.

english_verse: No more than two or three of you should speak unknown languages during the meeting. You must take turns, and someone should always be there to explain what you mean.
translation_verse: Kɛji aawie wiemɔ srɔto lɛ, daa nɛɛ mɛi enyɔ loo, kɛ efa aahu lɛ, mɛi etɛ̃ pɛ awie, mɔ kome mɔ kome, ni mɔ kome hu atsɔ̃ɔ shishi;

english_verse: If no one can explain, you must keep silent in church and speak only to yourself and to God.
translation_verse: shi kɛji shishitsɔ̃ɔlɔ ko bɛ lɛ, mɔ ni wieɔ lɛ afee dioo yɛ asafo lɛ mli, shi ewie ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: Two or three persons may prophesy, and everyone else must listen carefully.
translation_verse: Shi gbalɔi lɛ, mɛi enyɔ loo mɛi etɛ̃ awie, ni mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ ahala mli.

english_verse: If someone sitting there receives a message from God, the speaker must stop and let the other person speak.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji ajie nɔ ko kpo atsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ko ni ta shi lɛ, mɔ ni ebɔ̃i wiemɔ momo lɛ afee dioo.

english_verse: Let only one person speak at a time, then all of you will learn something and be encouraged.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ afee lɛ mɔ kome mɔ kome lɛ, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛaanyɛ nyɛgba, koni mɛi fɛɛ akase nii, ni awo mɛi fɛɛ hewalɛ.

english_verse: A prophet should be willing to stop and let someone else speak.
translation_verse: Gbalɔi amumɔi lɛ baa amɛhe shi amɛhãa gbalɔi lɛ;

english_verse: God wants everything to be done peacefully and in order. When God's people meet in church,
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ejeee sakasakafeemɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, shi moŋ hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji lɛ. Tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ hetselɔi asafoi lɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ,

english_verse: the women must not be allowed to speak. They must keep quiet and listen, as the Law of Moses teaches.
translation_verse: yei lɛ afee dioo yɛ asafoi lɛ amli, ejaakɛ aŋmɛɛɛ amɛ gbɛ ni amɛwie, shi moŋ amɛba amɛhe shi, tamɔ bɔ ni Mla lɛ kɛɔ lɛ.

english_verse: If there is something they want to know, they can ask their husbands when they get home. It is disgraceful for women to speak in church.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ amɛmiisumɔ akɛ amɛkase nɔ ko lɛ, amɛbi amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwumɛi yɛ shĩa. Ejaakɛ eyɛ hiɛgbele hã yei akɛ amɛaawie yɛ asafo mli.

english_verse: God's message did not start with you people, and you are not the only ones it has reached.
translation_verse: Aloo nyɛŋɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ jɛ? Aloo nyɛ kɛkɛ nyɛŋɔɔ eba?

english_verse: If you think of yourself as a prophet or a spiritual person, you will know I am writing only what the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Kɛ efeɔ mɔ ko akɛ gbalɔ loo mumɔŋ gbɔmɔ ji lɛ lɛ, sa akɛ ele akɛ nɔ ni miŋma nyɛ nɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kitã ni.

english_verse: So don't pay attention to anyone who ignores what I am writing.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ mɔ ko enaaa enɛ lɛ, ashi lɛ.

english_verse: My friends, be eager to prophesy and don't stop anyone from speaking languages that others don't know.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛhiɛ adɔa yɛ gbalɛ he, ni wiemɔi srɔtoi awiemɔ lɛ hu nyɛkatsĩa naa.

english_verse: But do everything properly and in order.
translation_verse: Afee nii fɛɛ bɔ ni yɔɔ fɛo kɛ gbɛnaagbɛnaa.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to remember the message I preached and that you believed and trusted.
translation_verse: Shi, anyɛmimɛi, miihã nyɛle akɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ ni mijaje mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, ni nyɛmɔ mli, ni nyɛdamɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ mli hu lɛ,

english_verse: You will be saved by this message, if you hold firmly to it. But if you don't, your faith was all for nothing.
translation_verse: no akɛhereɔ nyɛyiwala hu, kɛ nyɛmɔ mli bɔ ni mijaje mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ; kɛjeee nakai lɛ nyɛhe nyɛye yakatswaa.

english_verse: I told you the most important part of the message exactly as it was told to me. This part is: Christ died for our sins, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ saji ni he hiaa fe fɛɛ ni akɛhã mi ni mi hu mikɛhã nyɛ lɛ ji akɛ Kristo gbo yɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ yɛ ŋmalɛi lɛ anaa;

english_verse: He was buried, and three days later he was raised to life, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: ni afu lɛ, ni atee lɛ shi ekoŋŋ yɛ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ yɛ ŋmalɛi lɛ anaa;

english_verse: Christ appeared to Peter, then to the twelve.
