translation_verse: ni ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Kefa, no sɛɛ lɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ.

english_verse: After this, he appeared to more than five hundred other followers. Most of them are still alive, but some have died.
translation_verse: No sɛɛ lɛ, ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛmimɛi fe ohai enumɔ shi kome, mɛi ni amɛteŋ mɛi pii yɔɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ, shi mɛi komɛi hu ewɔ lɛ.

english_verse: He also appeared to James, then to all of the apostles.
translation_verse: No sɛɛ lɛ, ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Yakobo, no sɛɛ lɛ bɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: Finally, he appeared to me, even though I am like someone who was born at the wrong time.
translation_verse: Shi amɛ fɛɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi hu ni mitamɔ mɔ ko ni akpatu afɔ lɛ lɛ.

english_verse: I am the least important of all the apostles. In fact, I caused so much trouble for God's church that I don't even deserve to be called an apostle.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mi lɛ mi ji bibioo fe fɛɛ yɛ bɔfoi lɛ ateŋ, ni misaaa tete akɛ atsɛɔ mi bɔfo, ejaakɛ miwa Nyɔŋmɔ asafo lɛ yi.

english_verse: But God treated me with undeserved grace! He made me what I am, and his grace wasn't wasted. I worked much harder than any of the other apostles, although it was really God's grace at work and not me.
translation_verse: Shi Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ naa mi ji mɔ ni mi ji nɛɛ, ni edromɔ ni eduro mi lɛ efeee yaka; shi moŋ mitsu nii waa fe amɛ fɛɛ; shi jeee mi mitsu, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni kɛ mi yɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: But it doesn't matter if I preached or if they preached. All of you believed the message just the same. God's People Will Be Raised to Life
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, miŋ o, amɛŋ o, nakai wɔshiɛɔ ni nakai hu nyɛhe nyɛye. Gbohiiashitee

english_verse: If we preach that Christ was raised from death, how can some of you say the dead will not be raised to life?
translation_verse: Shi kɛ aashiɛ yɛ Kristo he akɛ atee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ, mɛni hewɔ nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɔ akɛ gbohiiashitee ko bɛ lɛ?

english_verse: If they won't be raised to life, Christ himself wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Kɛ gbohiiashitee ko bɛ lɛ, belɛ Kristo hu ateee lɛ shi.

english_verse: And if Christ wasn't raised to life, our message is worthless, and so is your faith.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ ateee Kristo shi lɛ, belɛ wɔshiɛmɔ lɛ efee yaka, ni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ hu efee yaka;

english_verse: If the dead won't be raised to life, we have told lies about God by saying he raised Christ to life, when he really did not.
translation_verse: ni asaŋ akpa wɔ shi akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he amale odaseyelɔi ji wɔ, ejaakɛ wɔye Nyɔŋmɔ he odase akɛ etee Kristo shi, mɔ ni kɛji eyɛ mli akɛ ateee gbohii ashi lɛ, belɛ eteee lɛ shi lɛ.

english_verse: So if the dead won't be raised to life, Christ wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ ateee gbohii ashi lɛ, belɛ Kristo hu ateee lɛ shi.

english_verse: Unless Christ was raised to life, your faith is useless, and you are still living in your sins.
translation_verse: Ni asaŋ kɛ ateee Kristo shi lɛ, no lɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ efee yaka, ni nyɛkãmɔ nyɛhe eshai lɛ amli lolo;

english_verse: And those people who died after putting their faith in him are completely lost.
translation_verse: no lɛ mɛi ni ewɔ yɛ Kristo mli lɛ hu elaaje.

english_verse: If our hope in Christ is good only for this life, we are worse off than anyone else.
translation_verse: Kɛ wala nɛɛ mli kɛkɛ wɔhiɛ kã Kristo nɔ yɛ lɛ, wɔnii yɛ mɔbɔ fe gbɔmɛi fɛɛ.

english_verse: But Christ has been raised to life! And he makes us certain that others will also be raised to life.
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ atee Kristo shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ, efee klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ yɛ mɛi ni ewɔ lɛ ateŋ.

english_verse: Just as we will die because of Adam, we will be raised to life because of Christ.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bɔ ni gbele tsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ nɔ kɛba lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ shitee hu tsɔ gbɔmɔ nɔ kɛba.

english_verse: Adam brought death to all of us, and Christ will bring life to all of us.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Adam mli ni mɛi fɛɛ gboiɔ yɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ Kristo mli lɛ aaahã mɛi fɛɛ yi ana wala yɛ.

english_verse: But we must each wait our turn. Christ was the first to be raised to life, and his people will be raised to life when he returns.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛhe. Klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ ji Kristo, no sɛɛ lɛ mɛi ni ji Kristonii lɛ, yɛ ebaa lɛ mli;

english_verse: Then after Christ has destroyed all powers and forces, the end will come, and he will give the kingdom to God the Father.
translation_verse: no sɛɛ dani naagbee lɛ baaba, be ni ekɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ aaahã Nyɔŋmɔ, Tsɛ lɛ, ni eeefo nɔyeli fɛɛ kɛ hegbɛ fɛɛ kɛ hewalɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Christ will rule until he puts all his enemies under his power,
translation_verse: Shi ja eye maŋtsɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ henyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ aaawo enajiaŋshi.

english_verse: and the last enemy he destroys will be death.
translation_verse: Naagbee henyɛlɔ ni abaakpãtã ehiɛ ji gbele.

english_verse: When the Scriptures say he will put everything under his power, they don't include God. It was God who put everything under the power of Christ.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ “ekɛ nibii fɛɛ kwa ewo enajiaŋshi”. Shi kɛ ekɛɛ akɛ “ekɛ nibii fɛɛ ewo eshishi” lɛ, belɛ ekãshi faŋŋ akɛ mɔ ni kɛ nibii fɛɛ wo eshishi lɛ bɛ mli.

english_verse: After everything is under the power of God's Son, he will put himself under the power of God, who put everything under his Son's power. Then God will mean everything to everyone.
translation_verse: Shi be ni akɛ nii fɛɛ ewo eshishi lɛ, no lɛ Bi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu kɛ ehe aaawo mɔ ni kɛ nii fɛɛ wo eshishi lɛ shishi, koni Nyɔŋmɔ afee nibii fɛɛ ayitso.

english_verse: If the dead are not going to be raised to life, what will people do who are being baptized for them? Why are they being baptized for those dead people?
translation_verse: Kɛjeee nakai lɛ, mɛi ni abaptisiɔ amɛ yɛ gbohii anajiaŋ lɛ, te amɛbaafee tɛŋŋ? Kɛ gbohii eteŋ shi kwraa lɛ, mɛɛba mɔ ni abaptisiɔ amɛ yɛ gbohii anajiaŋ lɛ:

english_verse: And why do we always risk our lives
translation_verse: Mɛɛba wɔ hu osharã sharãa wɔ ŋmɛlɛtswaa fɛɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ?

english_verse: and face death every day? The pride that I have in you because of Christ Jesus our Lord is what makes me say this.
translation_verse: Mina nyɛheshwãa ni miyɔɔ yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Kristo Yesu mli, anyɛmimɛi, akɛ migboɔ daa gbi.

english_verse: What do you think I gained by fighting wild animals in Ephesus? If the dead are not raised to life, “Let's eat and drink. Tomorrow we die.”
translation_verse: Kɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni akɛɔ lɛ, mikɛ “kooloi awuyelɔi” wu yɛ Efeso lɛ, no lɛ mɛɛ sɛɛ minaa? Kɛ gbohii eteee shi lɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔyea nii ni wɔnua nii, ejaakɛ wɔ́ lɛ wɔbaagboi!”

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves. Bad friends will destroy you.
translation_verse: Nyɛkahãa ashishiua nyɛ. “Naanyobɔɔ fɔŋ fiteɔ jeŋba kpakpa.”

english_verse: Be sensible and stop sinning. You should be embarrassed that some people still don't know about God. What Our Bodies Will Be Like
translation_verse: Nyɛhãa nyɛhiɛ akãa shi jogbaŋŋ, ni nyɛkafea esha; ejaakɛ nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi leee nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he. Miikɛɛ enɛ ni mikɛwo nyɛ hiɛgbele. Shitee gbɔmɔtso lɛ

english_verse: Some of you have asked, “How will the dead be raised to life? What kind of bodies will they have?”
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ko aaabi akɛ, “Te aaafee tɛŋŋ atee gbohii ashi? Ni asaŋ mɛɛ gbɔmɔtso amɛkɛaaba?”

english_verse: Don't be foolish. A seed must die before it can sprout from the ground.
translation_verse: Kwashia! Nɔ ni bo diɛŋtsɛ oduɔ lɛ, ja egbo fɛɛ da ni eyi naa wala.

english_verse: Wheat seeds and all other seeds look different from the sprouts that come up.
translation_verse: Ni asaŋ nɔ ni oduɔ lɛ, jeee tso ni baaba lɛ oduɔ lɛ, shi moŋ dumɔwu kuli ko kɛkɛ, kɛ ŋmaa ni jio, dumɔwu kroko ni jio;

english_verse: This is because God gives everything the kind of body he wants it to have.
translation_verse: shi Nyɔŋmɔ hãa lɛ tso bɔ ni esumɔɔ, ni wu fɛɛ wu lɛ, ehãa lɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etso.

english_verse: People, animals, birds, and fish are each made of flesh, but none of them are alike.
translation_verse: Jeee heloo fɛɛ ji heloo kome: esoro gbɔmɛi aheloo, ni esoro kooloi aheloo; esoro loofɔji aheloo, ni esoro nuŋloi anɔ.

english_verse: Everything in the heavens has a body, and so does everything on earth. But each one is very different from all the others.
translation_verse: Ni ŋwɛi gbɔmɔtsei yɛ, ni shikpɔŋ nɔ gbɔmɔtsei hu yɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ esoro ŋwɛi nii anunyam, ni esoro shikpɔŋ nɔ nii hu anɔ.

english_verse: The sun isn't like the moon, the moon isn't like the stars, and each star is different.
translation_verse: Esoro hulu anunyam, ni esoro nyɔɔŋtsere hu anunyam, ni esoro ŋulamii anunyam, ejaakɛ esoro ŋulami kome anunyam yɛ ekroko nɔ he.

english_verse: That's how it will be when our bodies are raised to life. These bodies will die, but the bodies that are raised will live forever.
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ ji gbohiiashitee lɛ hu. Aduɔ gbɔmɔtso lɛ yɛ fitemɔ mli, ateɔ lɛ shi yɛ nɔ ni fiteee mli.

english_verse: As surely as there are physical bodies, there are spiritual bodies. And our physical bodies will be changed into spiritual bodies.
translation_verse: Aduɔ susuma gbɔmɔtso, ateɔ mumɔ gbɔmɔtso shi. Kɛ susuma gbɔmɔtso yɛ lɛ, mumɔ gbɔmɔtso hu yɛ.

english_verse: The first man was named Adam, and the Scriptures tell us that he was a living person. But Jesus, who may be called the last Adam, is a life-giving spirit.
translation_verse: Nakai aŋma hu akɛ, “Adam ni ji klɛŋklɛŋ gbɔmɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ susuma ni hiɛ kã;” naagbee Adam lɛ tsɔ̃ mumɔ ni hãa mɔ yi naa wala.

english_verse: We see that the one with a spiritual body did not come first. He came after the one who had a physical body.
translation_verse: Shi jeee mumɔ nɔ lɛ ji klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ, shi moŋ susuma nɔ lɛ, no sɛɛ lɛ mumɔ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The first man was made from the dust of the earth, but the second man came from heaven.
translation_verse: Klɛŋklɛŋ gbɔmɔ lɛ ni jɛ shikpɔŋ mli lɛ, su ni; gbɔmɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ jɛ ŋwɛi.

english_verse: Everyone on earth has a body like the body of the one who was made from the dust of the earth. And everyone in heaven has a body like the body of the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni mɔ ni jɛ su mli lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mɛi ni jɛ su mli lɛ yɔɔ; ni bɔ ni ŋwɛinyo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, nakai ŋwɛibii lɛ hu yɔɔ.

english_verse: Just as we are like the one who was made out of earth, we will be like the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Ni tamɔ bɔ ni wɔhiɛ mɔ ni jɛ su mli lɛ subaŋ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ wɔbaahiɛ ŋwɛinyo lɛ hu subaŋ.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that our bodies of flesh and blood will decay. This means they cannot share in God's kingdom, which lasts forever.
translation_verse: Anyɛmimɛi, nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji akɛ, heloo kɛ lá nine shɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ, ni asaŋ fitemɔ hu nine shɛŋ nɔ ni fiteee lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: I will explain a mystery to you. Not every one of us will die, but we will all be changed.
translation_verse: Naa, teemɔ sane mikɛɔ nyɛ nɛɛ: Jeee wɔ fɛɛ wɔbaawɔ lɛ, shi abaatsake wɔ fɛɛ,

english_verse: It will happen suddenly, quicker than the blink of an eye. At the sound of the last trumpet the dead will be raised. We will all be changed, so we will never die again.
translation_verse: trukaa, hiŋmɛitswaa mli, be ni aaakpã naagbee tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ; ejaakɛ abaakpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ, ni aaatee gbohii ashi ni amɛfiteŋ dɔŋŋ, ni wɔ lɛ, abaatsake wɔ.

english_verse: Our dead and decaying bodies will be changed into bodies that won't die or decay.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ja nɛkɛ fitemɔ nɔ nɛɛ wo nɔ ni fiteee lɛ, ni nɛkɛ gbele nɔ nɛɛ wo nɔ ni gbooo lɛ.

english_verse: The bodies we now have are weak and can die. But they will be changed into bodies that are eternal. Then the Scriptures will come true, “Death has lost the battle!
translation_verse: Shi be ni nɛkɛ fitemɔ nɔ nɛɛ ewo nɔ ni fiteee lɛ, ni nɛkɛ gbele nɔ nɛɛ ewo nɔ ni gbooo lɛ, no lɛ wiemɔ ni aŋma lɛ aaaba mli akɛ, “Ami gbele yɛ kunim mli.”

english_verse: Where is its victory? Where is its sting?”
translation_verse: “Ao gbele, nɛgbɛ okunim lɛ yɔɔ? Ao gbele, nɛgbɛ ogãi lɛ yɔɔ?”

english_verse: Sin is what gives death its sting, and the Law is the power behind sin.
translation_verse: Shi gbele gãi lɛ ji esha; ni esha hewalɛ ji Mla lɛ.

english_verse: But thank God for letting our Lord Jesus Christ give us the victory!
translation_verse: Shi shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ ehãa wɔyeɔ kunim lɛ.

english_verse: My dear friends, stand firm and don't be shaken. Always keep busy working for the Lord. You know that everything you do for him is worthwhile.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, minyɛmimɛi ni misumɔɔ, nyɛfĩa shi ni nyɛkagbugbãa ni nyɛtekea nɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ mli daa nɛɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛle akɛ nyɛdeŋmegbomɔ lɛ efeŋ yaka yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: When you collect money for God's people, I want you to do exactly what I told the churches in Galatia to do.
translation_verse: Shi nɔ ni kɔɔ onia ni atsuɔ ayahã hetselɔi lɛ he lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni mito mihã Galatia asafoi lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfea nakai.

english_verse: That is, each Sunday each of you must put aside part of what you have earned. If you do this, you won't have to take up a collection when I come.
translation_verse: Daa otsi mli klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ nɔ ko ato yɛ bɔ ni enaa lɛ naa, koni mikaba dani atsu onia.

english_verse: Choose some followers to take the money to Jerusalem. I will send them on with the money and with letters which show that you approve of them.
translation_verse: Ni kɛji miba lɛ, matsu mɛi ni nyɛbuɔ akɛ amɛsa kɛ woji ni amɛkɛ nyɛnikeenii lɛ aya Yerusalɛm.

english_verse: If you think I should go along, they can go with me. Paul's Travel Plans
translation_verse: Kɛji esa akɛ mi hu matee lɛ, mikɛ amɛ aaatee. Paulo gbɛfai ahe gbɛjianɔtoo

english_verse: After I have gone through Macedonia, I hope to see you
translation_verse: Shi miyatsɔ̃ Makedonia dani maba nyɛŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ Makedonia miyatsɔ̃.

english_verse: and visit with you for a while. I may even stay all winter, so that you can help me on my way to wherever I will be going next.
translation_verse: Shi ekolɛ mahi nyɛŋɔɔ fioo, ni ekolɛ maye fɛ̃ibe lɛ hu yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ, koni he fɛɛ he ni maya lɛ, nyɛyajie mi gbɛ.

english_verse: If the Lord lets me, I would rather come later for a longer visit than to stop off now for only a short visit.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ minaa nyɛ amrɔ nɛɛ kɛ minyiɛ gbɛfãa nɔ kɛkɛ, shi mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ, kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaaŋmɛ gbɛ lɛ, matsɛ fioo yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ.

english_verse: I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
translation_verse: Shi mibahi Efeso kɛyashi Pentekoste gbi lɛ.

english_verse: because there is a wonderful opportunity for me to do some work here. But there are also many people who are against me.
translation_verse: Agbele shinaa kpeteŋkple ahã mi kɛhã nitsumɔ ni baawo yibii, shi mɛi ni kuɔ naa lɛ ayi fa.

english_verse: When Timothy arrives, give him a friendly welcome. He is doing the Lord's work, just as I am.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji Timoteo ba lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni ekɛ gbeyeishemɔ akahi shi yɛ nyɛteŋ; ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nitsumɔ etsuɔ tamɔ mi nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Don't let anyone mistreat him. I am looking for him to return to me together with the other followers. So when he leaves, send him off with your blessings.
translation_verse: Hewɔ lɛ mɔ ko akabu lɛ akɛ ejeee mɔ ko shi nyɛjiea lɛ gbɛ yɛ hejɔlɛ mli koni eba miŋɔɔ; shi miikwɛ lɛ gbɛ kɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ.

english_verse: I have tried hard to get our friend Apollos to visit you with the other followers. He doesn't want to come just now, but he will come when he can. Personal Concerns and Greetings
translation_verse: Shi wɔnyɛmi Apolo lɛ, mikpa lɛ fai aahu ni ekɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ aba nyɛŋɔɔ; shi ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ kwraa akɛ eeeba amrɔ nɛɛ, shi kɛ ena hegbɛ jiŋŋ, eeeba. Naagbee wiemɔi kɛ ŋamɔi

english_verse: Keep alert. Be firm in your faith. Stay brave and strong.
translation_verse: Nyɛbua, nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli, nyɛfea hii, ni nyɛhe awaa!

english_verse: Show love in everything you do.
translation_verse: Nyɛfea nyɛnii fɛɛ yɛ suɔmɔ mli.

english_verse: You know that Stephanas and his family were the first in Achaia to have faith in the Lord. They have done all they can for God's people. My friends, I ask you
translation_verse: Shi miikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛle Stefana shĩa bii lɛ, akɛ amɛ ji Akaia klɛŋklɛŋ yibii, ni amɛkɔ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ asɔ̃ɔmɔ amɛfɔ̃ amɛnɔ,

english_verse: to obey leaders like them and to do the same for all others who work hard with you.
translation_verse: koni nyɛ hu nyɛba nyɛhe shi nyɛhã mɛi ni tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi, kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsuɔ nii lɛ eko ni egboɔ deŋme yɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: I was glad to see Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus. Having them here was like having you.
translation_verse: Shi mina miishɛɛ akɛ Stefana kɛ Fortunato kɛ Akaiko eba, ejaakɛ ni nyɛbɛ miŋɔɔ nɛɛ, amɛ amɛbaye nyɛnajiaŋ.

english_verse: They made me feel much better, just as they made you feel better. You should appreciate people like them.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ amɛbahã mimumɔ kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛmumɔ ena ekãa. No hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ nyɛlea amɛ jogbaŋŋ.

english_verse: Greetings from the churches in Asia. Aquila and Priscilla, together with the church that meets in their house, send greetings in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Asia asafoi lɛ miibi nyɛ. Akwila kɛ Priskila kɛ asafo ni yɔɔ amɛwe lɛ miibi nyɛ jogbaŋŋ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers send their greetings. Give each other a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Nyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ miibi nyɛ. Nyɛŋaŋaa nyɛhe kɛ naashwɔmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL.
translation_verse: Mi, Paulo diɛŋtsɛ, minine naa bimɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God will put a curse on everyone who doesn't love the Lord. And may the Lord come soon.
translation_verse: Kɛ mɔ ko sumɔɔɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo sane lɛ, mɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ musumɔ! Maran-ata: Nuŋtsɔ, ba.

english_verse: I pray the Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi!

english_verse: I love everyone who belongs to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Misuɔmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi yɛ Kristo Yesu mli! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Jesus Christ, and from Timothy, who is also a follower. To God's church in Corinth and to all of God's people in Achaia.
translation_verse: Paulo, ni ji Kristo Yesu bɔfo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa lɛ, kɛ wɔnyɛmi Timoteo lɛ ŋma wolo nɛɛ yahã Nyɔŋmɔ asafo ni yɔɔ Korinto lɛ kɛ hetselɔi lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Akaia muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul Gives Thanks
translation_verse: Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ. Paulo daa Nyɔŋmɔ shi yɛ yelikɛbuamɔ hewɔ

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! The Father is a merciful God, who always gives us comfort.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ lɛ, mɔ ni ji musuŋtsɔlɛtsɛ kɛ miishɛjemɔ fɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: He comforts us when we are in trouble, so that we can share this same comfort with others in trouble.
translation_verse: Eshɛjeɔ wɔmii yɛ wɔmanehului lɛ fɛɛ mli, koni wɔ hu wɔnyɛ wɔkɛ miishɛjemɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛshɛjeɔ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔmii lɛ ashɛje mɛi ni naa amanehulu lɛ amii.

english_verse: We share in the terrible sufferings of Christ, but also in the wonderful comfort he gives.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Kristo amanehului lɛ baa wɔnɔ kɛtɛkeɔ nɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ Kristo hewɔ lɛ wɔmiishɛjemɔ hu faa kɛtɛkeɔ nɔ.

english_verse: We suffer in the hope that you will be comforted and saved. And because we are comforted, you will also be comforted, as you patiently endure suffering like ours.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji amanehulu wɔna jiŋŋ, nyɛmiishɛjemɔ kɛ yiwalaheremɔ hewɔ ni; ni kɛji wɔmii ashɛjeɔ hu jiŋŋ, nyɛmiishɛjemɔ ni hãa nyɛkɛ tsuishitoo mĩaa nyɛhiɛ kɛnaa nakai amanehului ni wɔnaa lɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ ni.

english_verse: You never disappoint us. You suffered as much as we did, and we know that you will be comforted as we were.
translation_verse: Ni wɔhiɛ ni kã nyɛnɔ lɛ gbugbãaa, ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ bɔ ni nyɛnaa amanehului lɛ eko lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ nyɛnaa miishɛjemɔ lɛ hu eko.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know what a hard time we had in Asia. Our sufferings were so horrible and so unbearable that death seemed certain.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ anyɛmimɛi, wɔsumɔɔɔ akɛ wɔkɛ wɔmanehului ni wɔna yɛ Asia lɛ atee nyɛ, akɛ wɔna nɔ tsɔ̃ fe bɔ ni wɔɔnyɛ po, ni wɔhiɛ kãaa wala nɔ tete,

english_verse: In fact, we felt sure we were going to die. But this made us stop trusting in ourselves and start trusting God, who raises the dead to life.
translation_verse: shi moŋ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔna faŋŋ akɛ gbele fɔbuu kã wɔnɔ, koni wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ akafɔ̃ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhe nɔ, shi moŋ wɔkɛfɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ ni teɔ gbohii ashi lɛ nɔ;

english_verse: God saved us from the threat of death, and we are sure that he will do it again and again.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ ni jie wɔ kɛjɛ gbele ni yɔɔ gbeyei tamɔ nɛkɛ nɛɛ mli, ni ebaajie wɔ, ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ akɛ ebaaya nɔ ejie wɔ,

english_verse: Please help us by praying for us. Then many people will give thanks for the blessings we receive in answer to all these prayers. Paul's Change of Plans
translation_verse: kɛji nyɛfata he kɛkpa fai nyɛhã wɔ, koni mɛi pii ada shi ahã wɔ yɛ dromɔ keenii ni akɛhã wɔ yɛ mɛi pii afaikpamɔ lɛ hewɔ. Paulo tsake egbɛfãa lɛ he gbɛjianɔtoo

english_verse: We can be proud of our clear conscience. We have always lived honestly and sincerely, especially when we were with you. And we were guided by God's gift of undeserved grace instead of by the wisdom of this world.
translation_verse: Shi wɔshwãa lɛ nɛ: wɔhenilee odase ni eyeɔ wɔ akɛ hetsemɔ kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ wɔkɛba wɔjeŋ yɛ je nɛɛ mli, titri lɛ yɛ wɔkɛ nyɛteŋ shihilɛ mli, ni jeee heloo gbɛfãŋ nilee naa, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ naa.

english_verse: I am not writing anything you cannot read and understand. I hope you will understand it completely,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔŋmaaa nyɛ nibii krokomɛi fe nii ni nyɛkaneɔ ni asaŋ nyɛle, ni mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ nyɛaale kɛwula shi hu,

english_verse: just as you already partly understand us. Then when our Lord Jesus returns, you can be as proud of us as we are of you.
translation_verse: tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛna nyɛle wɔ hu fã kɛ fã akɛ nyɛshwãanɔ ji wɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛ hu nyɛ ji wɔshwãanɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I was so sure of your pride in us that I had planned to visit you first of all. In this way you would have the blessing of two visits from me—
translation_verse: Enɛ nɔ mikɛ mihiɛ fɔ̃ hewɔ mito miyiŋ akɛ maba nyɛŋɔɔ tsutsu lɛ koni nyɛna dromɔ shii enyɔ,

english_verse: once on my way to Macedonia and again on my return from there. Then you could send me on to Judea.
translation_verse: no ji, ni mibatsɔ̃ nyɛŋɔɔ kɛya Makedonia, ni asaŋ maku misɛɛ kɛjɛ Makedonia maba nyɛŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, koni nyɛyajie mi gbɛ kɛya Yudea.

english_verse: Do you think I couldn't make up my mind about what to do? Or do I seem like someone who says “Yes” or “No” simply to please others?
translation_verse: Belɛ ni mito miyiŋ nakai lɛ, yiŋ flɛflɛ mikɛfee? Aloo miyiŋ ni mito lɛ, gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔ mikɛto, ni makɛɛ “hɛɛ”, “hɛɛ”, kɛ “dabi” “dabi”, fɛɛ shi kome?

english_verse: God can be trusted, and so can I, when I say our answer to you has always been “Yes” and never “No.”
translation_verse: Shi anɔkwafo ji Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ wɔwiemɔ ni wɔkɛ nyɛ wie lɛ ejeee nɔ ni kɛɔ “hɛɛ” kɛ “dabi” fɛɛ shi kome.

english_verse: This is because Jesus Christ the Son of God is always “Yes” and never “No.” And he is the one Silas, Timothy, and I told you about.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi Yesu Kristo mɔ ni mikɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo shiɛ ehe sane yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, ejeee “hɛɛ” kɛ “dabi” fɛɛ shi kome, shi moŋ eji “hɛɛ”.

english_verse: Christ says “Yes” to all God's promises. This is why we have Christ to say “Amen” for us to the glory of God.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoi abɔ ni yɔɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ “hɛɛ”; ni no hewɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ enɔ wɔkɛɔ “Amen” kɛwoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam lɛ.

english_verse: And so God makes it possible for you and us to stand firmly together with Christ. God is also the one who chose us
translation_verse: Shi Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni hãa wɔ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ fiɔ shi yɛ Kristo mli, ni efɔ wɔ mu;

english_verse: and put his Spirit in our hearts to show that we belong only to him.
translation_verse: lɛ nɔŋŋ esɔo wɔnaa, ni ekɛ Mumɔ lɛ ehã wɔ akɛ yibaafoo nɔ yɛ wɔtsuii amli hu.

english_verse: God is my witness that I stayed away from Corinth, just to keep from being hard on you.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, miitsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ebaye odase eshi mi kɛji ejeee anɔkwale akɛ nyɛyibaamɔ hewɔ minako maba Korinto lɛ.

english_verse: We are not bosses who tell you what to believe. We are working with you to make you glad, because your faith is strong.
translation_verse: Jeee akɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ nyɔŋ wɔyeɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛdamɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli, shi moŋ wɔfata nyɛhe kɛmiitsu nii kɛhã nyɛmiishɛɛnamɔ.

english_verse: I have decided not to make my next visit with you so painful.
translation_verse: Shi mikpɛ mli yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ akɛ mikɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli baŋ nyɛŋɔɔ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: If I make you feel bad, who would be left to cheer me up, except the people I had made to feel bad?
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ mihã nyɛye ŋkɔmɔ lɛ, namɔ baashɛje mimii akɛ mɔ nɔŋŋ ni mihã eye ŋkɔmɔ lɛ?

english_verse: The reason I want to be happy is to make you happy. I wrote as I did because I didn't want to visit you and be made to feel bad, when you should make me feel happy.
translation_verse: Ni miŋma nyɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ nɔŋŋ, koni kɛ miba lɛ, mɛi ni kulɛ sa akɛ amɛhã mimii ashɛ mihe lɛ akahã miye ŋkɔmɔ, ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛnɔ akɛ nyɛaana akɛ mimiishɛɛ ji nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛmiishɛɛ.

english_verse: At the time I wrote, I was suffering terribly. My eyes were full of tears, and my heart was broken. But I didn't want to make you feel bad. I only wanted to let you know how much I cared for you. Forgiveness
translation_verse: Shi mijɛ hejaramɔ pii kɛ tsuiyeli babaoo mli mikɛ yaafonui babaoo ŋma nyɛ, jeee ni nyɛwerɛ aho nyɛhe, shi moŋ ni nyɛna suɔmɔ babaoo ni misumɔɔ nyɛ. Mɔ ni etɔ̃ yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ akɛfa lɛ

english_verse: I don't want to be hard on you. But if one of you has made someone feel bad, I am not really the one who has been made to feel bad. Some of you are the ones.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ mɔ ko ehã aye ŋkɔmɔ lɛ, jeee mi ni ehã miye ŋkɔmɔ lɛ, shi, bɔ ni afee ni minaa akaya shɔŋŋ lɛ, ehã nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛye ŋkɔmɔ ko kɛ̃.

english_verse: Most of you have already pointed out the wrong that person did, and this is punishment enough for what was done.
translation_verse: Nakai mɔ lɛ, ehiɛ ni mɛi pii ekã lɛ fa hã lɛ;

english_verse: When people sin, you should forgive and comfort them, so they won't give up in despair.
translation_verse: hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ nyɛkɛfaa lɛ moŋ ni nyɛshɛjea emii koni ŋkɔmɔyeli tuutu lɛ akahã enijiaŋ je wui.

english_verse: You should make them sure of your love for them.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, miikpa nyɛ fai ni nyɛma nyɛsuɔmɔ lɛ nɔ mi nyɛhã lɛ;

english_verse: I also wrote because I wanted to test you and find out if you would follow my instructions.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ enɛ hewɔ hu ni miŋma nyɛ wolo lɛ, koni mikɛna nɔ gbɔmɛi ni ji nyɛ, akɛ nyɛboɔ toi yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ gbɛfaŋ lo.

english_verse: I will forgive anyone you forgive. Yes, for your sake and with Christ as my witness, I have forgiven whatever needed to be forgiven.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni nyɛkɛ nɔ ko faa lɛ lɛ, mi hu mikɛfaa lɛ; ejaakɛ mi hu, nɔ ni mikɛfa lɛ, kɛ mikɛ nɔ ko efa lɛ, mikɛfa yɛ nyɛhewɔ yɛ Kristo hiɛ;

english_verse: When I went to Troas to preach the good news about Christ, I found that the Lord had already prepared the way.
translation_verse: Shi be ni miba Troia ni mibashiɛ Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ ni agbele gbɛ ahã mi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ,

english_verse: But I was worried when I didn't find my friend Titus there. So I left the other followers and went on to Macedonia.
translation_verse: minaaa hejɔlɛ yɛ mimumɔ mli, ejaakɛ minaaa minyɛmi Tito hewɔ lɛ mishɛ amɛ, ni miyiŋ kɛtee Makedonia. Kunimyeli yɛ Kristo mli

english_verse: I am grateful that God always makes it possible for Christ to lead us to victory. God also helps us spread the knowledge about Christ everywhere, and this knowledge is like the smell of perfume.
translation_verse: Shi shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ nyiɛɔ wɔhiɛ be fɛɛ be yɛ ekunimyeli lɛ mli lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ wɔnɔ ehãa enilee ŋmajee lɛ jeɔ kpo yɛ he fɛɛ he lɛ.

english_verse: In fact, God thinks of us as a perfume that brings Christ to everyone. For people who are being saved, this perfume has a sweet smell and leads them to a better life. But for people who are lost, it has a bad smell and leads them to a horrible death. No one really has what it takes to do this work.
translation_verse: mɛi ni laajeɔ lɛ, eji gbele ŋma ni kɛ mɔ yaa gbele mli hã amɛ; shi mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, eji wala ŋma ni kɛ mɔ yaa wala mli hã amɛ. Ni namɔ sa hã nɛkɛ nitsumɔ?

english_verse: A lot of people try to get rich from preaching God's message. But we are God's sincere messengers, and by the power of Christ we speak our message with God as our witness.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔtamɔɔɔ mɛi pii ni kɛ nibii krokomɛi futuɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ, shi moŋ wɔwieɔ lɛ ŋmiiŋmi bɔ ni ejɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, yɛ Kristo mli.

english_verse: Are we once again bragging about ourselves? Do we need letters to you or from you to tell others about us? Some people do need letters telling about them.
translation_verse: Aso wɔbɔ̃i wɔhe yijiemɔ ekoŋŋ? Aloo ehĩa wɔ akɛ wɔhiɛɔ yijiemɔ woji kɛbahãa nyɛ loo kɛjɛɔ nyɛdɛŋ tamɔ bɔ ni ehĩaa mɛi komɛi lɛ lo?

english_verse: But you are our letter, and you are in our hearts for everyone to read and understand.
translation_verse: Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ ji wɔwolo ni aŋma yɛ wɔtsuii amli ni mɛi fɛɛ le ni amɛkaneɔ lɛ,

english_verse: You are like a letter written by Christ and delivered by us. But you are not written with pen and ink or on tablets made of stone. You are written in our hearts by the Spirit of the living God.
translation_verse: ni ajie nyɛ faŋŋ atsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nyɛ ji Kristo wolo ni wɔsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ he, ni jeee blɛgi akɛŋma, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ, jeee yɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛi anɔ, shi moŋ yɛ tsuii ni ji heloo taoi anɔ.

english_verse: We are sure about all this. Christ makes us sure in the very presence of God.
translation_verse: Shi Kristo hewɔ wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ nɛɛ.

english_verse: We don't have the right to claim that we have done anything on our own. God gives us what it takes to do all we do.
translation_verse: Jeee akɛ wɔsa yɛ wɔnyɛmɔ naa, ní wɔɔjwɛŋ akɛ nɔ ko jɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔmli, shi wɔsalɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli ejɛ;

english_verse: He makes us worthy to be the servants of his new agreement that comes from the Holy Spirit and not from a written Law. After all, the Law brings death, but the Spirit brings life.
translation_verse: lɛ ehã wɔtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni sa akɛ akɛfee kpãŋmɔ hee lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi, jeee nɔ ni aŋma shi moŋ Mumɔ nɔ; ejaakɛ nɔ ni aŋma lɛ gbeɔ mɔ; shi Mumɔ lɛ hãa mɔ yi naa wala.

english_verse: The Law of Moses brought only the promise of death, even though it was carved on stones and given in a wonderful way. Still the Law made Moses' face shine so brightly the people of Israel could not look at it, even though it was a fading glory.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ gbele sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni akpɛ yɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛi anɔ lɛ yɛ nyam bɔ ni Israelbii lɛ nyɛɛɛ Mose hiɛ akwɛ yɛ ehiɛ nyam ni sɛɛ foɔ lɛ hewɔ po lɛ,

english_verse: So won't the agreement the Spirit brings to us be even more wonderful?
translation_verse: ani Mumɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ efeŋ nyam fe no?

english_verse: If something that brings the death sentence is glorious, won't something that makes us acceptable to God be even more glorious?
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ fɔbuu sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ yɛ nyam lɛ, ani jalɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ efeŋ nyam kɛtekeŋ nɔ aahu?

english_verse: In fact, the new agreement is so wonderful that the Law is no longer glorious at all.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ anunyam lɛ ni fa babaoo tsɔ̃ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni yɔɔ nyam lɛ bɛ nyam yɛ enɛ gbɛfaŋ.

english_verse: The Law was given with a glory that faded away. But the glory of the new agreement is much greater, because it will never fade away.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ nɔ ni hoɔ kɛyaa lɛ yɛ nyam lɛ, belɛ nɔ ni hiɔ shi lɛ yɛ nyam aahu fe no.

english_verse: This wonderful hope makes us feel like speaking freely.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ akɛni wɔyɔɔ nɛkɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔfeɔ ekãa babaoo,

english_verse: We are not like Moses. His face was shining, but he covered it to keep the people of Israel from seeing the brightness fade away.
translation_verse: ni wɔfeee tamɔ Mose ni kɛ hiɛhaanɔ ha ehiɛ, koni Israelbii lɛ akwɛ nɔ ni hoɔ kɛyaa lɛ naagbee lɛ.

english_verse: The people were stubborn, and something still keeps them from seeing the truth when the Law is read. Only Christ can take away the covering that keeps them from seeing.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ aŋa amɛjwɛŋmɔ naa. Ejaakɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ nakai hiɛhaanɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ ha kpãŋmɔ momo lɛ kanemɔ lɛ nɔ; ajieko shi akɛ Kristo mli esɛɛ foɔ yɛ.

english_verse: When the Law of Moses is read, they have their minds covered over
translation_verse: Shi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, be fɛɛ be ni akaneɔ Mose wolo lɛ, hiɛhaanɔ ha amɛtsui nɔ;

english_verse: with a covering that is removed only for those who turn to the Lord.
translation_verse: shi kɛ amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, aaajie hiɛhaanɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord and the Spirit are one and the same, and the Lord's Spirit sets us free.
translation_verse: Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ji Mumɔ lɛ, ni he ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, jɛi heyeli yɔɔ.

english_verse: So our faces are not covered. They show the bright glory of the Lord, as the Lord's Spirit makes us more and more like our glorious Lord.
translation_verse: Shi wɔ fɛɛ ni wɔkɛ hiɛ kpetekplee kwɛɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ anunyam lɛ tamɔ akwɛɔ ashwishwɛ mli lɛ, wɔmiitsake wɔmiitsɔ̃mɔ nakai subaŋ lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛmiijɛ anunyam mli kɛmiiya anunyam mli, tamɔ bɔ ni ejeɔ Nuŋtsɔ ni ji Mumɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: God has been kind enough to trust us with this work. This is why we never give up.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni akɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ ehã wɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mɔbɔnalɛ naa lɛ, wɔnijiaŋ ejeee wui,

english_verse: We don't do shameful things that must be kept secret. And we don't try to fool anyone or twist God's message around. God is our witness that we speak only the truth, so others will be sure we can be trusted.
translation_verse: shi wɔkwa hiɛgbejianii ni akɛtee lɛ, ni wɔbaaa wɔjeŋ yɛ kutumpɔo mli; ni asaŋ wɔkɛ nibii futuuu Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ, shi moŋ wɔkɛ anɔkwale lɛ wiemɔ faŋŋ jieɔ wɔhe yi wɔtsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ henilee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.

english_verse: If there is anything hidden about our message, it is hidden only to someone who is lost.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ ha aha wɔsanekpakpa lɛ hiɛ tete lɛ, mɛi ni laajeɔ lɛ amli kɛkɛ aha hiɛ yɛ,

english_verse: The god who rules this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers. They cannot see the light, which is the good news about our glorious Christ, who shows what God is like.
translation_verse: amɛ ji mɛi amli ni je nɛɛ mli nyɔŋmɔ lɛ eshwila mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ ajwɛŋmɔi lɛ yɛ, koni Kristo ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ subaŋ lɛ anunyam Sanekpakpa la lɛ akakpɛ miihã amɛ.

english_verse: We are not preaching about ourselves. Our message is that Jesus Christ is Lord. He also sent us to be your servants.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ jeee wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhe wɔshiɛɔ, shi moŋ Kristo Yesu akɛ Nuŋtsɔ, kɛ wɔ hu akɛ nyɛtsuji yɛ Yesu hewɔ;

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God commanded light to shine in the dark.” Now God is shining in our hearts to let you know that his glory is seen in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni kɛɛ akɛ la ajɛ duŋ mli akpɛ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ ekpɛ yɛ wɔtsuii amli hu, koni Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam he nilee la lɛ akpɛ yɛ Yesu Kristo hiɛ.

english_verse: We are like clay jars in which this treasure is stored. The real power comes from God and not from us.
translation_verse: Shi wɔhiɛ nɛkɛ jwetri nɛɛ yɛ su kpuji amli, koni hewalɛ ni fa kɛtɛke nɔ lɛ afee Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ, ni jeee wɔnɔ.

english_verse: We often suffer, but we are never crushed. Even when we don't know what to do, we never give up.
translation_verse: Afĩfĩaa wɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he, shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔtsui esuuu; wɔfeɔ yaa, shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔnijiaŋ ejeko wui,

english_verse: In times of trouble, God is with us, and when we are knocked down, we get up again.
translation_verse: awaa wɔ yi, shi kɛ̃lɛ akwako wɔ; atswiaa wɔ shi, shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔpleneko.

english_verse: We face death every day because of Jesus. Our bodies show what his death was like, so his life can also be seen in us.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔ ni wɔhiɛ kãmɔ nɛɛ, daa nɛɛ atu wɔ awo gbele dɛŋ yɛ Yesu hewɔ, koni Yesu wala lɛ hu aje kpo yɛ wɔgbɔmɔtsei ni baagboi lɛ amli.

english_verse: This means that death is working in us, but life is working in you.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ gbele tsuɔ nii yɛ wɔmli, shi nyɛ lɛ, wala tsuɔ nii yɛ nyɛmli.

english_verse: In the Scriptures it says, “I spoke because I had faith.” We have this same kind of faith. So we speak
translation_verse: Shi akɛni wɔyɔɔ nakai hemɔkɛyeli mumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, “Mihe miye hewɔ ni miwie” lɛ, wɔ hu wɔheɔ wɔyeɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, wɔwieɔ;

english_verse: because we know that God raised the Lord Jesus to life. And just as God raised Jesus, he will also raise us to life. Then he will bring us into his presence together with you.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ mɔ ni tee Nuŋtsɔ Yesu shi lɛ, eeetee wɔ kɛ Yesu shi, ni ekɛ wɔ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ aaadamɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ehiɛ.

english_verse: All of this has been done for you, so more and more people will know how kind God is and will praise and honor him. Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɛhewɔ afeɔ fɛɛ, koni dromɔ ni fa babaoo lɛ atsɔ̃ mɛi pii ashidaa nɔ atɛke nɔ ahã Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛnyamwoo. Wɔnyiɛɔ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli naa

english_verse: We never give up. Our bodies are gradually dying, but we ourselves are being made stronger each day.
translation_verse: No hewɔ ni wɔtsui efãaa lɛ, shi moŋ kɛ wɔkponɔgbɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ fiteɔ kwraa tete lɛ, kɛ̃lɛ wɔmli gbɔmɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ ehee gbi fɛɛ gbi.

english_verse: These little troubles are getting us ready for an eternal glory that will make all our troubles seem like nothing.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔmanehulu ni jaraaa ni asaŋ esɛɛ etsɛɛɛ nɛɛ, baahã wɔna naanɔ anunyam kpele ni jara wa aahu;

english_verse: Things that are seen don't last forever, but things that are not seen are eternal. This is why we keep our minds on the things that cannot be seen.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ wɔjeee mɛi ni kwɛɔ nii ni anaa lɛ, shi moŋ nii ni anaaa lɛ wɔkwɛɔ; ejaakɛ nii ni anaa lɛ hiɔ shi be fioo kɛkɛ, shi nii ni anaaa lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyashiɔ naanɔ.

english_verse: Our bodies are like tents that we live in here on earth. But when these tents are destroyed, we know that God will give each of us a place to live. These homes will not be buildings someone has made, but they are in heaven and will last forever.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ, kɛ akumɔ wɔbuu ni wɔyɔɔ mli ni ji wɔshikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ gbɔmɔtso lɛ shĩa jiŋŋ, wɔyɛ tsu ko ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ, shĩa ko ni jeee niji akɛfee, ni hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ yɛ ŋwɛi.

english_verse: While we are here on earth, we sigh because we want to live in that heavenly home.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ, wɔdɔ̃mɔɔ ŋtsɔi tete yɛ wɔbuu nɛɛ mli, ni wɔshweɔ akɛ akɛ wɔtsu ni jɛ ŋwɛi lɛ awo wɔ,

english_verse: We want to put it on like clothes and not be naked.
translation_verse: ni kɛ akɛwo wɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, no lɛ anaŋ wɔ akɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ yayai.

english_verse: These tents we now live in are like a heavy burden, and we groan. But we don't do this just because we want to leave these bodies that will die. It is because we want to change them for bodies that will never die.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔ ni wɔyɔɔ buu lɛ mli lɛ hu, akɛni wɔhe jaraa wɔ hewɔ lɛ, wɔdɔ̃mɔɔŋtsɔi, ejaakɛ wɔsumɔɔɔ akɛ ajie wɔhenii, shi moŋ wɔsumɔɔ akɛ awo wɔ nii ashwie nɔ, koni wala lɛ ami nɔ ni gboɔ lɛ.

english_verse: God is the one who makes all this possible. He has given us his Spirit to make us certain he will do it.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni saa wɔ hã enɛ nɔŋŋ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ hu ni hã wɔ Mumɔ lɛ akɛ yibaafoo nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: So always be cheerful! As long as we are in these bodies, we are away from the Lord.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, wɔyɛ tsui daa, ni wɔle akɛ gbii abɔ ni wɔyɔɔ gbɔmɔtso lɛ mli nɛɛ wɔdom kɛjɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ;

english_verse: But we live by faith, not by what we see.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ hemɔkɛyeli naa wɔnyiɛɔ yɛ, shi jeee ninamɔ naa,

english_verse: We should be cheerful, because we would rather leave these bodies and be at home with the Lord.
translation_verse: shi wɔyɛ tsui, ni esa wɔhiɛ moŋ akɛ wɔɔdom kɛjɛ gbɔmɔtso nɛɛ mli, ni wɔyahi shĩa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.

english_verse: But whether we are at home with the Lord or away from him, we still try our best to please him.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, oti ni wɔkɛma wɔhiɛ ji akɛ, shĩa wɔyɔɔ jio, dommɔ wɔdom jio, esa ni wɔsa ehiɛ.

english_verse: After all, Christ will judge each of us for the good or the bad that we do while living in these bodies. Bringing People to God
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ja wɔ fɛɛ wɔpue faŋŋ yɛ Kristo kojomɔ sɛi lɛ hiɛ, koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ana nii ni efee yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli lɛ he nyɔmɔwobɔɔ ni efee lɛ, ekpakpa jio, efɔŋ jio. Kristo ekpãtã wɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ

english_verse: We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni wɔle Nuŋtsɔ lɛ he ni yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ, wɔwieɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɛi; shi wɔ lɛ wɔyɛ faŋŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; ni mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ wɔyɛ faŋŋ yɛ nyɛhenilee mli hu.

english_verse: We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ jeee wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhe yi wɔjieɔ wɔhãa nyɛ ekoŋŋ, shi moŋ wɔkɛmiihã nyɛ gbɛ ni nyɛkɛshwã nyɛfɔ̃ wɔnɔ, koni nyɛna eko nyɛkɛɛ mɛi ni shwãa yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ shi jeee yɛ tsui mli lɛ.

english_verse: If we seem out of our minds, it is between God and us. But if we are in our right minds, it is for your good.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ sɛkɛ wɔyeɔ jiŋŋ, Nyɔŋmɔ hewɔ wɔyeɔ, ni kɛ wɔyɛ shishiishi hu jiŋŋ, nyɛ hewɔ ni.

english_verse: We are ruled by Christ's love for us. We are certain that if one person died for everyone else, then all of us have died.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Kristo suɔmɔ lɛ nyɛɔ wɔnɔ, ni wɔkojoɔ nɛkɛ akɛ, kɛ mɔ kome gbo mɛi fɛɛ ayigbele lɛ, belɛ mɛi lɛ fɛɛ egboi.

english_verse: And Christ did die for all of us. He died so we would no longer live for ourselves, but for the one who died and was raised to life for us.
translation_verse: Ni egbo mɛi fɛɛ ayigbele, koni mɛi ni hiɛ kãmɔ lɛ ahiɛ akakãmɔ miihã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ amɛhiɛ akãmɔ ahã mɔ ni gbo ni atee lɛ shi ekoŋŋ ahã amɛ lɛ.

english_verse: We are careful not to judge people by what they seem to be, though we once judged Christ in this way.
translation_verse: Belɛ, kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ, wɔleee mɔ ko mɔ ko dɔŋŋ yɛ gbɔmɛi asusumɔ naa; ni kɛ gbɔmɛi asusumɔ naa wɔle Kristo yɛ tete lɛ, agbɛnɛ lɛ wɔleee lɛ nakai dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to Christ is a new person. The past is forgotten, and everything is new.
translation_verse: Hewɔ lɛ, kɛ mɔ ko yɛ Kristo mli lɛ, bɔɔnɔ hee ji lɛ; blema nii lɛ eho; naa, nibii fɛɛ etsɔ̃mɔ ehee.

english_verse: God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.
translation_verse: Shi nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ ekɛ wɔ kpãtã, ni ekɛ kpãtãmɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ hã wɔ lɛ dɛŋ;

english_verse: What we mean is that God was in Christ, offering peace and forgiveness to the people of this world. And he has given us the work of sharing his message about peace.
translation_verse: no ji akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ Kristo nɔ ekɛ je lɛ kpãtã, ni ebuuu amɛnɔ̃tɔ̃mɔi lɛ ehãaa amɛ, ni etu kpãtãmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ewo wɔdɛŋ.

english_verse: We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, wɔji bɔfoi yɛ Kristo najiaŋ, tamɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ wɔnɔ eewie eetsɔ̃ɔ mɛi: wɔdamɔ Kristo najiaŋ wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai akɛ, nyɛhãa akpãtã nyɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ!

english_verse: Christ never sinned! But God treated him as a sinner, so Christ could make us acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɔ ni leee esha lɛ, wɔhewɔ lɛ ehã etsɔ̃ esha, koni wɔ lɛ wɔtsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ yɛ emli.

english_verse: We work together with God, and we beg you to make good use of God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Shi akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ hefatalɔi ji wɔ yɛ enitsumɔ lɛ mli lɛ, wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai ni nyɛkahã Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni nyɛnine eshɛ nɔ lɛ fee yaka.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “When the time came, I listened to you, and when you needed help, I came to save you.” That time has come. This is the day for you to be saved.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Be ni sa mli mibo bo toi yɛ, ni yiwalaheremɔ gbi nɔ hu miye mibua bo yɛ.” Naa, be ni sa jogbaŋŋ nɛ; naa, yiwalaheremɔ gbi nɛ.

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with our work, and so we try hard not to cause problems.
translation_verse: Ni wɔtooo mɔ ko mɔ ko pampi yɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko mli, koni akagbe wɔsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he guɔ.

english_verse: But in everything and in every way we show we truly are God's servants. We have always been patient, though we have had a lot of trouble, suffering, and hard times.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ wɔkɛ wɔhe tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔlɔi ji wɔ. Wɔmĩaa wɔhiɛ babaoo. Wɔtoɔ wɔtsui shi yɛ amanehului kɛ fimɔi kɛ jaramɔi amli.

english_verse: We have been beaten, put in jail, and hurt in riots. We have worked hard and have gone without sleep or food.
translation_verse: Ayiɔ wɔ ni awoɔ wɔ tsuŋ kpitiokpitio. Afeɔ wɔ soisoi. Wɔtsuɔ nii kɛ kpeshii kɛ deŋmegbomɔ pii. Wɔhiɔ ŋmãa,

english_verse: But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real.
translation_verse: ni wɔbɔɔ hetsemɔ he mɔdɛŋ kɛ nilee. Wɔŋmɛɔ wɔtsui shi; wɔmli hi. Yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ hewalɛ naa lɛ, wɔsuɔmɔ lɛ osato bɛ mli.

english_verse: We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ naa lɛ wɔwieɔ anɔkwale. Ni wɔwoɔ jalɛ tawuunii yɛ ninejurɔ kɛ abɛku fɛɛ.

english_verse: Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not.
translation_verse: Mɛi komɛi woɔ wɔhiɛ nyam; ni mɛi komɛi gbeɔ wɔhe guɔ. Mɛi komɛi wieɔ wɔhe efɔŋ, ni mɛi komɛi wieɔ wɔhe ekpakpa. Anaa wɔ akɛ shishiulɔi, kɛ̃lɛ, anɔkwafoi ji wɔ.

english_verse: We are unknown to others, but well known to you. We seem to be dying, and yet we are still alive. We have been punished, but never killed,
translation_verse: Wɔ tamɔ mɛi ni aleee kɛ mɛi ni ale krɛdɛɛ; tamɔ mɛi ni gboiɔ, ni naa, wɔhiɛ kãmɔ. Wɔ tamɔ mɛi ni agbalaa amɛtoi, ni kɛ̃lɛ agbeko wɔ.

english_verse: and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.
translation_verse: Wɔ tamɔ ŋkɔmɔyelɔi, shi wɔmii shɛɔ daa. Wɔ tamɔ ohiafoi, shi wɔfeɔ mɛi pii niiatsɛmɛi, ni wɔ tamɔ mɛi ni bɛ nɔ ko, ni kɛ̃lɛ wɔyɛ nii fiaa. Nyɛgbelea nyɛtsui naa nyɛhãa wɔ

english_verse: We are not holding back on our love for you, but you are holding back on your love for us.
translation_verse: Gbɛ yɛ wɔmli hã nyɛ, shi nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ moŋ nyɛtsuii amli joɔ.

english_verse: I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us. The Temple of the Living God
translation_verse: Nyɛ hu nyɛgbelea nyɛtsuii amli nakai nɔŋŋ, ni nyɛkɛto wɔ najiaŋ. Mikɛ nyɛ miiwie tamɔ mibii. Kristojamɔ kɛ wɔŋjamɔ bɛ nɔ ko feemɔ

english_verse: Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same?
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ akagbalaa kɔŋtso kome, akɛni amɛkɛ nyɛ yeee hegbɔ lɛ. Ejaakɛ mɛɛ bɔɔ jalɛ kɛ mlatɔ̃mɔ yɔɔ? Aloo mɛɛ yeli la kɛ duŋ yɔɔ?

english_verse: Is Christ a friend of Satan? Can people who follow the Lord have anything in common with those who don't?
translation_verse: Ni mɛɛ gbeekpãmɔ Kristo kɛ Belial yɔɔ? Aloo mɛɛ nijaa mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ kɛ mɔ ni heee yeee yɔɔ?

english_verse: Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says, “I will live with these people and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
translation_verse: Ni asaŋ mɛɛ ekomefeemɔ yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu kɛ amãgãi ateŋ? Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔtsu ji nyɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, “Mahi amɛmli, ni manyiɛ yɛ amɛteŋ. Ni matsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛ hu amɛaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord also says, “Leave them and stay away! Don't touch anything that isn't clean. Then I will welcome you
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ, “Nyɛjea amɛteŋ, ni nyɛtsea nyɛhe, ni nyɛkataa muji nɔ ko he, ni mahere nyɛ atuu.

english_verse: and be your Father. You will be my sons and my daughters, as surely as I am God, the All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: Ni matsɔ̃ nyɛtsɛ, ni nyɛ hu nyɛaatsɔ̃mɔ mibihii kɛ mibiyei,” Yehowa, Ofe lɛ, kɛɛ.

english_verse: My friends, God has made us these promises. So we should stay away from everything that keeps our bodies and spirits from being clean. We should honor God and try to be completely like him. The Church Makes Paul Happy
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni asumɔɔ, akɛni wɔna nɛkɛ shiwoi nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔtsua wɔhe kɛjɛa heloo kɛ mumɔ muji fɛɛ mli, ni wɔhã wɔhetsemɔ aye emuu yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ mli. Paulo mii shɛ ehe akɛ asafo lɛ eshwa ehe

english_verse: Make a place for us in your hearts! We haven't mistreated or hurt anyone. We haven't cheated anyone.
translation_verse: Nyɛhãa wɔ gbɛ yɛ nyɛmli! Wɔfeko mɔ ko mɔ ko efɔŋ ko; wɔyeko mɔ ko awui, wɔyeko mɔ ko amim.

english_verse: I am not saying this to be hard on you. But, as I have said before, you will always be in our thoughts, whether we live or die.
translation_verse: Mikɛɛɛ enɛ ni mikɛbu nyɛ fɔ; ejaakɛ mikɛɛ momo akɛ wɔsumɔɔ nyɛ yɛ wɔtsui mli bɔ ni gbele mli oo, wala mli oo, wɔkɛ nyɛ ekome.

english_verse: I trust you completely. I am always proud of you, and I am greatly encouraged. In all my trouble I am still very happy.
translation_verse: Mikɛ mihe fɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ waa, ni asaŋ mishwãa mifɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ babaoo; miyi obɔ̃ kɛ miishɛjemɔ, miyi kɛtɛke nɔ kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ wɔmanehulu lɛ fɛɛ mli.

english_verse: After we came to Macedonia, we didn't have any chance to rest. We were faced with all kinds of problems. We were troubled by enemies and troubled by fears.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ shi be ni wɔba Makedonia lɛ hu, wɔnaaa wɔgbɔmɔtso hejɔlɛ kwraa; shi moŋ he fɛɛ he lɛ amanehulu sɔŋŋ wɔnaa: wɔkponɔgbɛ lɛ nɔmɔi, wɔmligbɛ lɛ gbeyeishemɔi.

english_verse: But God cheers up people in need, and this is what he did when he sent Titus to us.
translation_verse: Shi Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni shɛjeɔ mɛi ni baa amɛhe shi lɛ amii lɛ, kɛ Tito baa lɛ shɛje wɔmii;

english_verse: Of course, we were glad to see Titus, but what really made us glad is the way you cheered him up. He told how sorry you were and how concerned you were about me. And this made me even happier.
translation_verse: shi jeee ebaa lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ miishɛjemɔ ni nyɛkɛshɛje emii lɛ hu, ejaakɛ egba wɔ nyɛshwee ni nyɛshweɔ mi lɛ kɛ nyɛheshwamɔ lɛ kɛ mihe mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛbɔɔ lɛ; enɛ hã mina miishɛɛ babaoo fe tsutsu lɛ.

english_verse: I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ wolo ni miŋma nyɛ lɛ edɔ nyɛ lɛ, mishwaaa mihe; kɛji mishwa mihe po lɛ, ejaakɛ mina akɛ nakai wolo lɛ edɔ nyɛ, kɛ be kuku po,

english_verse: Now I am happy, but not because I hurt your feelings. It is because God used your hurt feelings to make you turn back to him, and none of you were harmed by us.
translation_verse: agbɛnɛ mimii eshɛ; jeee dɔ ni edɔ nyɛ lɛ hewɔ ni, shi moŋ akɛni dɔlɛ lɛ hã nyɛshwa nyɛhe lɛ hewɔ ni; ejaakɛ edɔ nyɛ bɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, koni akajɛ wɔ ni nɔ ko bɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ dɔlɛ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ tsɛɔ tsuitsakemɔ kɛbaa, tsuitsakemɔ ni kɛ mɔ yaa yiwalaheremɔ ni ashwaaa he yɛ he lɛ mli; shi je nɛɛ mli dɔlɛ lɛ tsɛɔ gbele.

english_verse: Just look what God has done by making you feel sorry! You sincerely want to prove you are innocent. You are angry. You are shocked. You are eager to see that justice is done. You have proved that you were completely right in this matter.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ dɔlɛ ni edɔ nyɛ bɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa nɔ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ, nɔ naajiemɔ, nɔ mlifu, nɔ gbeyeishemɔ, nɔ shwee, nɔ hiɛdɔɔ, nɔ jalɛ kojomɔ ni etsɛ ewo nyɛmli! Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛhe tsɔ̃ɔ wɔ akɛ nyɛhe tse yɛ nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ mli.

english_verse: When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ miŋma nyɛ tete lɛ, jeee mɔ ni tɔ̃ lɛ, asaŋ hu jeee mɔ ni atɔ̃ enɔ lɛ hewɔŋ, shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni wɔhe mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛbɔɔ lɛ apue faŋŋ ahã nyɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.

english_verse: And we were greatly encouraged. Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about.
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔmii eshɛ. Shi miishɛɛ ni wɔna yɛ Tito miishɛɛ lɛ he lɛ hã wɔmiishɛɛ lɛ tɛke nɔ babaoo, ejaakɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhã etsui enyɔ emli,

english_verse: We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ kɛ mishwã nyɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ nɔ ko mli lɛ, nyɛwooo mi hiɛgbele; shi tamɔ bɔ ni wɔwie nibii fɛɛ anɔkwale mli wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ wɔshwãa hu ni wɔshwã wɔtsɔ̃ɔ Tito lɛ efee anɔkwale,

english_verse: Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him.
translation_verse: ni eyɛ nyɛhe tsui babaoo fe tsutsu lɛ, ejaakɛ ekaiɔ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛtoiboo lɛ, bɔ ni nyɛkɛ gbeyeishemɔ kɛ hekpokpomɔ here lɛ lɛ.

english_verse: It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.
translation_verse: Mina miishɛɛ akɛ mikɛ mihe fɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli.

english_verse: My friends, we want you to know that the churches in Macedonia have shown others God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Shi, anyɛmimɛi, wɔmiihã nyɛle dromɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛduro Makedonia asafoi lɛ,

english_verse: Although they were going through hard times and were very poor, they were glad to give generously.
translation_verse: akɛ aka amɛ yɛ amanehulu babaoo mli, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛmiishɛɛ lɛ tɛke nɔ, ni amɛhĩa katekate lɛ mli po, amɛ jie mlihilɛ falɛ kpo;

english_verse: They gave as much as they could afford and even more, simply because they wanted to.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ miiye odase akɛ amɛhã bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ, ni amɛhã fe bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ tete yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsuɔmɔ naa,

english_verse: They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people.
translation_verse: ni amɛkɛ tutɔmɔ babaoo kpa wɔ fai ni ahã amɛ hu amɛna naanyobɔɔ ni akɛsumɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ mli gbɛ,

english_verse: And they did more than we had hoped. They gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, just as God wanted them to do.
translation_verse: ni jeee bɔ ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ amɛŋɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe amɛhã Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tsutsu kɛ wɔ hu, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa.

english_verse: Titus was the one who got you started doing this good thing, so we begged him to help you finish what you had begun.
translation_verse: No hã wɔkpa Tito fai, koni bɔ ni ebɔ̃i momo sa lɛ, nakai etsu dromɔ nitsumɔ nɛɛ kɛgbe naa hu yɛ nyɛteŋ.

english_verse: You do everything better than anyone else. You have stronger faith. You speak better and know more. You are eager to give, and you love us better. Now you must give more generously than anyone else.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛtɛkeɔ nɔ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli, yɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ wiemɔ kɛ nilee kɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ fɛɛ kɛ suɔmɔ ni jɛ wɔmli ni eyɔɔ nyɛmli lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛkwɛa koni nɛkɛ dromɔ nɛɛ mli hu lɛ nyɛtɛke nɔ.

english_verse: I am not ordering you to do this. I am simply testing how real your love is by comparing it with the concern that others have shown.
translation_verse: Miwieee yɛ nɔnyɛɛ naa, shi moŋ mɛi krokomɛi amɔdɛŋbɔɔ mikɛkaa nyɛ hu nyɛsuɔmɔ lɛ makwɛ akɛ eyɛ krɔŋŋ lo.

english_verse: You know our Lord Jesus Christ treated us with undeserved grace by giving up all his riches, so you could become rich.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɛle wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ, akɛ lɛ ni ji niiatsɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ ohiafo yɛ nyɛhewɔ, koni nyɛtsɔ̃ ehia lɛ nɔ nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ niiatsɛmɛi.

english_verse: A year ago you were the first ones to give, and you gave because you wanted to. So listen to my advice.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni mijwɛŋ yɛ sane nɛɛ he nɛ, enɛ hi hã nyɛ, ejaakɛ jeee feemɔ kɛkɛ, shi suɔmɔ ni akɛbaafee lɛ hu nyɛ tsutsu nyɛje shishi afi beebe nɛ.

english_verse: I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛgbea feemɔ lɛ naa, koni bɔ ni oya nɔŋŋ ni nyɛsumɔ akɛ nyɛfee lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛjɛa nɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ mli nyɛgbea naa.

english_verse: It doesn't matter how much you have. What matters is how much you are willing to give from what you have.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ tsui yɛ he lɛ, no lɛ bɔ ni mɔ ko hãa kɛjɛɔ nɔ ni eyɔɔ mli lɛ saa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; jeee kɛjɛ nɔ ni ebɛ mli.

english_verse: I am not trying to make life easier for others by making life harder for you. But it is only fair
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mikɛɛɛ enɛ ni mɛi komɛi ahe ajɔ amɛ ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛhao, shi moŋ koni fɛɛ afee pɛpɛɛpɛ;

english_verse: for you to share with them when you have so much, and they have so little. Later, when they have more than enough, and you are in need, they can share with you. Then everyone will have a fair share,
translation_verse: nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ, nɔ ni nyɛna kɛtɛke nɔ lɛ ayaye nɔ ni fimɔ hewɔ lɛ mɛi komɛi nyɛɛɛ ahã lɛ najiaŋ, koni be kroko lɛ nɔ ni amɛ hu amɛna kɛtɛke nɔ lɛ abaye nɔ ni fimɔ hewɔ lɛ nyɛnyɛɛɛ nyɛhã lɛ najiaŋ, koni aye hegbɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ;

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “Those who gathered too much had nothing left. Those who gathered only a little had all they needed.” Titus and His Friends
translation_verse: tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ni bua pii naa lɛ, enaa eko yɛ sɛɛ, ni mɔ ni bua fioo naa hu lɛ, eshwɛɛɛ lɛ eko.”

english_verse: I am grateful that God made Titus care as much about you as we do.
translation_verse: Shi shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni kɛ nyɛhedɔɔ nɛɛ wo Tito tsui mli lɛ;

english_verse: When we begged Titus to visit you, he said he would. He wanted to because he cared so much for you.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ eyɛ mli akɛ wɔkɛŋmɛ ehiɛ ni eba ni ekpɛlɛ̃, shi akɛni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ eyɛ he tsui waa hewɔ lɛ, eba nyɛŋɔɔ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esuɔmɔ naa.

english_verse: With Titus we are also sending one of the Lord's followers who is well known in every church for spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛmi ni wɔtsu wɔfata ehe nɛɛ yɛ yijiemɔ yɛ asafoi lɛ fɛɛ mli yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hewɔ;

english_verse: The churches chose this follower to travel with us while we carry this gift that will bring praise to the Lord and show how much we hope to help.
translation_verse: shi jeee enɛ kɛkɛ, shi asafoi lɛ hala lɛ hu, ni ekɛ wɔ anyiɛ ni ehiɛ nɛkɛ mɔbɔnalɛ nitsumɔ ni wɔsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ he nɛɛ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ anunyam, ni akɛtsɔ̃ɔ he tsui ni wɔyɔɔ;

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with the way we handle your generous gift.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ wɔmiikwɛ jogbaŋŋ ni mɔ ko akawie wɔhe efɔŋ yɛ tsuijurɔ naa nikee ni wɔsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ he nɛɛ hewɔ;

english_verse: But we want to do what pleases the Lord and what people think is right.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ oti ni wɔkɛma wɔhiɛ ji akɛ efee fɛo, jeee yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ hu.

english_verse: We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much.
translation_verse: Shi wɔtsu wɔnyɛmi lɛ hu wɔfata amɛhe, mɔ ni wɔka lɛ kpitiokpitio yɛ nibii pii amli, ni wɔna akɛ ebɔɔ mɔdɛŋ, shi agbɛnɛ eebɔ mɔdɛŋ po fe tsutsu lɛ, yɛ ehiɛ ni ekɛfɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ pii lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Shi Tito lɛ, mihefatalɔ ni mikɛtsuɔ nyɛhe nii ji lɛ, ni wɔnyɛmimɛi lɛ hu, asafoi lɛ abɔfoi kɛ Kristo hiɛnyam ji amɛ.

english_verse: Treat them in such a way that the churches will see your love and will know why we bragged about you.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛjiea nyɛsuɔmɔ kɛ shwãa ni wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ lɛ kpo nyɛtsɔa amɛ yɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the money you plan to give for God's people.
translation_verse: Shi nɔ ni kɔɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni akɛyaasɔ̃mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ he lɛ, ehĩaaa akɛ maŋma nyɛ nɔ ko.

english_verse: I know how eager you are to give. And I have proudly told the Lord's followers in Macedonia that you people in Achaia have been ready for a whole year. Now your desire to give has made them want to give.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mile bɔ ni nyɛna he tsui ni mishwãa mifɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ mitsɔ̃ɔ Makedoniabii lɛ akɛ Akaiabii esaa amɛhe amɛto kɛjɛ nyɛsɛɛ afi lɛ beebe; ni nyɛmɔdɛŋbɔɔ lɛ ewo mɛi pii ahiɛdɔɔ.

english_verse: This is why I am sending Titus and the two others to you. I want you to be ready, just as I promised. This will prove we were not wrong to brag about you.
translation_verse: Shi mitsu nyɛmimɛi lɛ, koni wɔshwãa ni wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ lɛ akafee yaka yɛ enɛ gbɛfaŋ, ni nyɛsaa nyɛhe bɔ ni mikɛɛ lɛ;

english_verse: Some followers from Macedonia may come with me, and I want them to find that you have the money ready. If you don't, I would be embarrassed for trusting you to do this. But you would be embarrassed even more.
translation_verse: ni kɛ Makedoniabii lɛ kɛ mi ba lɛ, amɛkabanina nyɛ akɛ nyɛsako nyɛhe, ni wɔhiɛ, misumɔɔɔ akɛ makɛɛ akɛ nyɛ nyɛhiɛ bagboi yɛ wɔhiɛ ni wɔkɛfɔ̃ nyɛnɔ nɛɛ mli.

english_verse: So I have decided to ask Titus and the others to spend some time with you before I arrive. This way they can arrange to collect the money you have promised. Then you will have the chance to give because you want to, and not because you feel forced to.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mijwɛŋ akɛ ehĩa akɛ makpa nyɛmimɛi lɛ afai ni amɛtsɔ̃ mihiɛ kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ ni amɛbasaa nɛkɛ nyɛjɔɔmɔ ni awo shi momo nɛɛ amɛto koni efee klalo akɛ jɔɔmɔ nɔ ko shi jeee nɔ ko ni akɛ hiɛjoomɔ miishɔ̃ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ.

english_verse: Remember this saying, “A few seeds make a small harvest, but a lot of seeds make a big harvest.”
translation_verse: Shi enɛ mikɛɔ akɛ, mɔ ni lɛteɔ nii ahe duɔ lɛ, ekɛ helɛtemɔ hu aaakpa; ni mɔ ni duɔ yɛ jɔɔmɔ mli lɛ, jɔɔmɔ mli nɔŋŋ eeekpa yɛ.

english_verse: Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahã bɔ ni ekpɛ mli momo yɛ etsui mli, ni ekajɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli loo nɔnyɛɛ mli, ejaakɛ tsuijurɔnaa halɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ.

english_verse: God can bless you with everything you need, and you will always have more than enough to do all kinds of good things for others.
translation_verse: Shi Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ hewalɛ akɛ eeehã dromɔ fɛɛ atɛke nɔ ahã nyɛ, koni nyɛhe atua nyɛ kwraa yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli daa nɛɛ ni nyɛna nii kɛtɛke nɔ hã nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa;

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God freely gives his gifts to the poor, and always does right.”
translation_verse: tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, “Egbɛɔ eshwãa ehãa ohiafoi lɛ; ejalɛ lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.”

english_verse: God gives seed to farmers and provides everyone with food. He will increase what you have, so you can give even more to those in need.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni kɛ dumɔwui keɔ dulɔ ni ekɛ aboloo hu hãa yeli lɛ, eeehã nyɛ dumɔwui ni afa, ni eeehã nyɛjalɛ yibii lɛ hu ashwere;

english_verse: You will be blessed in every way, and you will be able to keep on being generous. Then many people will thank God when we deliver your gift.
translation_verse: ni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ niiatsɛmɛi yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli, ni nyɛfee mlihilɔi kwraa, ni nyɛmlihilɛ lɛ ahã atsɔ wɔnɔ akɛ shidaa aha Nyɔŋmɔ;

english_verse: What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ nɛkɛ yelikɛbuamɔ nɛɛ he sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, jeee fɛnemɔ kɛkɛ efɛneɔ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ yɛ fimɔ mli, shi moŋ ehãa adaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi babaoo kɛtɛkeɔ nɔ hu.

english_verse: The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ odase kpakpa ni nɛkɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ yeɔ lɛ hãa amɛwoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ ye ni nyɛyeɔ Kristo Sanekpakpa ni nyɛjajeɔ lɛ nɔ, kɛ mlihilɛ ni nyɛkɛyeɔ nyɛbuaa amɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ lɛ hewɔ,

english_verse: Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much.
translation_verse: ni amɛbaasɔle amɛhã nyɛ, ni amɛbaashwe nyɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni yɔɔ nyɛnɔ kɛtɛke nɔ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Thank God for his gift that is too wonderful for words!
translation_verse: Shi shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ enikeenii ni anyɛŋ agba lɛ hewɔ!

english_verse: Do you think I am a coward when I am with you and brave when I am far away? Well, I ask you to listen, because Christ himself was humble and gentle.
translation_verse: Shi mi Paulo diɛŋtsɛ miikpa nyɛ fai yɛ Kristo hejɔlɛ kɛ kpoofeemɔ lɛ hewɔ, mi ni akɛɛ kɛ miyɛ nyɛhiɛ lɛ mifeɔ mihe humi yɛ nyɛteŋ, shi kɛ mibɛ nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, mijeɔ ekãa miwoɔ nyɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Some people have said we act like the people of this world. So when I arrive, I expect I will have to be firm and forceful in what I say to them. Please don't make me treat you that way.
translation_verse: Shi miikpa nyɛ fai ni kɛ miba lɛ, nyɛkahã mikɛ hewalɛ ni mito akɛ mikɛbaawie lɛ miijie ekãa kpo mitsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni susuɔ akɛ wɔtamɔ mɛi ni nyiɛɔ heloo naa lɛ.

english_verse: We live in this world, but we don't act like its people
translation_verse: Eyɛ mli akɛ gbɔmɛi adesai ji wɔ moŋ, shi wɔwuuu ta yɛ heloo naa.

english_verse: or fight our battles with the weapons of this world. Instead, we use God's power that can destroy fortresses. We destroy arguments
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔtawuunii lɛ jeee heloo mli nii ni, shi moŋ, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ, hewalɛnii ni akɛkumɔɔ mɔji ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ni,

english_verse: and every bit of pride that keeps anyone from knowing God. We capture people's thoughts and make them obey Christ.
translation_verse: ni wɔkumɔɔ jwɛŋmɔi kɛ he nɔ ni awoɔ ashiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nilee lɛ, ni wɔŋɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ fɛɛ jwɛŋmɔ nom ni ebo Kristo toi,

english_verse: And when you completely obey him, we will punish anyone who refuses to obey.
translation_verse: ni wɔsaa wɔhe wɔto koni, kɛ nyɛtoiboo lɛ ye emuu lɛ, wɔgbala toigbele fɛɛ he toi.

english_verse: You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do.
translation_verse: Nyɛkwɛa nibii bɔ ni nyɛnaa amɛ lɛ. Kɛ mɔ ko heɔ yeɔ akɛ Kristo nɔ ji lɛ lɛ, esusu he ekoŋŋ, ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni eji Kristo nɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ wɔ hu wɔji Kristo nii.

english_verse: Maybe I brag a little too much about the authority that the Lord gave me to help you and not to hurt you. Yet I am not embarrassed to brag.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ shwãa po mashwã kɛtɛke nɔ yɛ wɔhegbɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ehã wɔ ni wɔkɛhã nyɛnane amɔ shi ni jeee akɛ wɔkɛbutu nyɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mihiɛ gboŋ,

english_verse: And I am not trying to scare you with my letters.
translation_verse: koni mikafee akɛ mɔ ko ni woɔ nyɛhe gbeyei kɛ woji.

english_verse: Some of you are saying, “Paul's letters are harsh and powerful. But in person, he is a weakling and has nothing worth saying.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ akɛɔ akɛ, woji lɛ amli saji tsii ni amɛmli wa moŋ, shi kɛ lɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyɛ biɛ lɛ, no lɛ ehe waaa ni ewiemɔ he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ.

english_verse: Those people had better understand that when I am with you, I will do exactly what I say in my letters.
translation_verse: Nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ ana ale enɛ akɛ, bɔ ni wɔwiemɔ yɔɔ yɛ woji amli kɛ wɔbɛ jɛi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ kɛ wɔyɛ jɛi lɛ wɔnifeemɔnii hu yɔɔ.

english_verse: We won't dare compare ourselves with those who think so much of themselves. But they are foolish to compare themselves with themselves.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔkaaa akɛ wɔɔbu wɔhe wɔshi mɛi komɛi ni jieɔ amɛhe yi lɛ anɔ, aloo akɛ wɔkɛ wɔhe aaato amɛhe. Amɛ lɛ, akɛni amɛkɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe susuɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe ni amɛkɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe toɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe hewɔ lɛ, amɛyooo sɛɛ.

english_verse: We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work.
translation_verse: Shi wɔ lɛ, wɔshwãŋ fe nine, shi moŋ wɔshwãa yɛ susumɔ kpãa ni Nyɔŋmɔ esusu ehã wɔ ni kɛlɛ shɛɔ nyɛ hu nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ naa.

english_verse: We are not bragging more than we should. After all, we did bring the message about Christ to you.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔkpãaa wɔmli tsɔ tamɔ mɛi ni shɛɛɛ nyɛŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ wɔ klɛŋklɛŋ wɔkɛ Kristo he Sanekpakpa lɛ shɛ nyɛŋɔɔ;

english_verse: We don't brag about what others have done, as if we had done those things ourselves. But I hope as you become stronger in your faith, we will be able to reach many more of the people around you. That has always been our goal.
translation_verse: wɔshwãaa fe nine yɛ mɛi krokomɛi anitsumɔi ahewɔ; shi wɔhiɛ kã nɔ akɛ kɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ shwere lɛ, wɔnitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli baagbele kɛtɛke nɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ wɔsusumɔ kpãa lɛ naa,

english_verse: Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done.
translation_verse: koni wɔyajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ nyɛsɛɛgbɛ niiaŋ, ni wɔkashwã wɔfɔ̃ nii ni atsu momo yɛ mɔ kroko nɔ mli lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you want to brag, then brag about the Lord.”
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni shwãa lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ eshwã efɔ̃!

english_verse: You may brag about yourself, but the only approval that counts is the Lord's approval.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ jeee mɔ ni jieɔ ehe yi lɛ ji mɔ ni sa, shi moŋ mɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jieɔ eyi lɛ.

english_verse: Please put up with a little of my foolishness.
translation_verse: Mina ni kulɛ nyɛnaa nyɛhãa mikwashiafeemɔ fioo! Shi anɔkwale nyɛnaa nyɛhãa mi.

english_verse: I am as concerned about you as God is. You were like a virgin bride I had chosen only for Christ.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɛhe awuŋã ni miyeɔ lɛ, miiye lɛ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ baaye; ejaakɛ mitsɛ nyɛhe baa mihã nuu kome ni mikɛ oblayoo foro ni he tse ayahã Kristo.

english_verse: But now I fear that you will be tricked, just as Eve was tricked by that lying snake. I am afraid that you might stop thinking about Christ in an honest and sincere way.
translation_verse: Shi miishe gbeyei akɛ aleenɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni onufu lɛ kɛ ekutumpɔo lɛ laka Hawa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaafite nyɛ hu nyɛjwɛŋmɔ ni nyɛŋmɛɛ suɔmɔ krɔŋŋ ni nyɛkɛsumɔɔ Kristo lɛ he.

english_verse: We told you about Jesus, and you received the Holy Spirit and accepted our message. But you let some people tell you about another Jesus. Now you are ready to receive another spirit and accept a different message.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ mɔ ko ba ni ebashiɛ Yesu kroko ni wɔshiɛko, loo mumɔ kroko ni nyɛnako, loo Sanekpakpa kroko ni nyɛmɔko mli lɛ, no lɛ nyɛhere lɛ jogbaŋŋ.

english_verse: I think I am as good as any of those super apostles.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ misusuɔ akɛ eshwɛɛɛ mi nɔ ko nɔ ko ni mikɛ bɔfoi agboi lɛ aye hegbɔ.

english_verse: I may not speak as well as they do, but I know as much. And this has already been made perfectly clear to you.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ mi ji gbɔmɔ ko ni leee nɔ ko yɛ wiemɔ gbɛfaŋ tete lɛ, mijeee nakai yɛ nilee gbɛfaŋ; shi moŋ wɔfee enɛ faŋŋ wɔhã nyɛ, yɛ gbɛ fɛɛ gbɛ nɔ, yɛ nii fɛɛ mli.

english_verse: Was it wrong for me to lower myself and honor you by preaching God's message free of charge?
translation_verse: Aloo belɛ akɛ miba mihe shi koni awo nyɛnɔ, ejaakɛ mijaje Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ yaka lɛ mifee esha?

english_verse: I robbed other churches by taking money from them to serve you.
translation_verse: Mitswa asafoi krokomɛi ojo mihe nyɔmɔwoo yɛ amɛdɛŋ mikɛsɔ̃mɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: Even when I was in need, I still didn't bother you. In fact, some of the Lord's followers from Macedonia brought me what I needed. I have not been a burden to you in the past, and I will never be a burden.
translation_verse: Ni be ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ ni efi mi tete lɛ, mifeee jatsu mihãaa mɔ ko mɔ ko, ejaakɛ nii ni hia mi lɛ, nyɛmimɛi ni jɛ Makedonia ba lɛ hã shɛ midɛŋ, ni mile mihenɔkwɛmɔ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli, ni masaa male mihenɔkwɛmɔ, koni mikatsɔ̃ jatsu mihã nyɛ.

english_verse: As surely as I speak the truth about Christ, no one in Achaia can stop me from bragging about this.
translation_verse: Gbii abɔ ni Kristo anɔkwale lɛ yɔɔ mimli nɛɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko etsiŋ mishwãa nɛɛ gbɛ yɛ Akaia niiaŋ.

english_verse: I plan to go on doing just what I have always done. Then those people won't be able to brag about doing the same things we are doing.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni mifeɔ lɛ, mafee, koni mikɛtsi mɛi ni taoɔ mihe sane lɛ agbɛ, ni ana amɛ yɛ amɛshwãanii lɛ amli, tamɔ bɔ ni anaa wɔ hu lɛ.

english_verse: Anyway, they are no more than false apostles and dishonest workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ mɛi nɛɛ ji amale bɔfoi, nitsulɔi shishiulɔi ni tsakeɔ amɛhe amɛfeɔ Kristo bɔfoi.

english_verse: And it is no wonder. Even Satan tries to make himself look like an angel of light.
translation_verse: Ni enɛ bɛ naakpɛɛ tete ejaakɛ Satan diɛŋtsɛ tsakeɔ ehe etsɔ̃ɔ la bɔfo;

english_verse: So why does it seem strange for Satan's servants to pretend to do what is right? Someday they will get exactly what they deserve. Paul's Sufferings for Christ
translation_verse: no hewɔ lɛ, kɛ esɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ hu tsakeɔ amɛhe amɛfeɔ tamɔ jalɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ, ejeee nɔ ko wulu ko; amɛnaagbee baafee tamɔ bɔ ni amɛnitsumɔi lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I don't want any of you to think I am a fool. But if you do, then let me be a fool and brag a little.
translation_verse: Miikɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ mɔ ko akabu mi kwashia, shi kɛjeee nakai lɛ, belɛ nyɛŋɔa mi akɛ kwashia kɛkɛ mɔ, koni mi hu mawo shwãa fioo ko.

english_verse: When I do all this bragging, I do it as a fool and not for the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni miwieɔ nɛɛ, miwieee lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baawie, shi moŋ tamɔ kwashia wieɔ, yɛ nɔmimaa ni miyɔɔ akɛ miyɛ shwãa nɔ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Yet if others want to brag about what they have done, so will I.
translation_verse: Akɛni mɛi pii shwãa yɛ heloo naa hewɔ lɛ, mi hu mashwã eko.

english_verse: And since you are so smart, you will gladly put up with a fool.
translation_verse: Akɛni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ nilelɔi ji nyɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ miishɛɛ toɔ nyɛtsui shi nyɛhãa mɛi ni bɛ yitseiaŋ;

english_verse: In fact, you let people make slaves of you and cheat you and steal from you. Why, you even let them strut around and slap you in the face.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ kɛ mɔ ko miiye nyɛ nyɔŋ, kɛ mɔ ko miitswa nyɛ ojo, kɛ mɔ ko miimɔ nyɛ, kɛ mɔ ko miiwó ehe nɔ yɛ nyɛnɔ, kɛ mɔ ko miigbala nyɛhiɛ ma lɛ, nyɛkpɛlɛ̃ɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I am ashamed to say we are too weak to behave in such a way. If they can brag, so can I, but it is a foolish thing to do.
translation_verse: Miiwie kɛ hiɛgbele akɛ etamɔ nɔ ni wɔfee gbedee tsɔ̃. Shi nɔ mli ni mɔ ko feɔ ekãa yɛ lɛ, miiwie tamɔ kwashia, mi hu mifeɔ ekãa yɛ mli.

english_verse: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Jews? So am I. Are they from the family of Abraham? Well, so am I.
translation_verse: Hebribii ji amɛ? Mi hu eko ji mi. Israelbii ni? Mi hu eko ji mi. Abraham shwiei ni? Mi hu eko ji mi.

english_verse: Are they servants of Christ? I am a fool to talk this way, but I serve him better than they do. I have worked harder and have been put in jail more times. I have been beaten with whips more and have been in danger of death more often.
translation_verse: Kristo sɔ̃ɔlɔi ji amɛ? Miiwie tamɔ mɔ ni yitsoŋ kãa lɛ. Mife amɛ yɛ tɔlɛ nitsumɔi ni tɛke nɔ amli, yɛ tsuŋwoi babaoi amli, yɛ yii ni fa tsɔ̃ amli, yɛ gbelei amli kpitiokpitio.

english_verse: Three times the Romans beat me with a big stick, and once my enemies stoned me. I have been shipwrecked three times, and I even had to spend a night and a day in the sea.
translation_verse: Atswia mi kpãi shii etɛ̃, atswia mi tɛi shi kome, mikɛ lɛlɛ sha shi shii etɛ̃. Miye jenamɔ kɛ jetsɛremɔ yɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: During my many travels, I have been in danger from rivers, robbers, my own people, and foreigners. My life has been in danger in cities, in deserts, at sea, and with people who only pretended to be the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Mifã gbɛ kpitiokpitio kɛ emli osharãi yɛ fai ahiɛ, emli osharãi yɛ ojotswalɔi adɛŋ, emli osharãi yɛ mijakubii adɛŋ, emli osharãi yɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii adɛŋ, emli osharãi yɛ maŋ, emli osharãi yɛ ŋa nɔ, emli osharãi yɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ, emli osharãi yɛ nyɛmimɛi shiwodudui lɛ ateŋ.

english_verse: I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm.
translation_verse: Mitsu nii kɛ tɔlɛ, yɛ kpeshii amli kpitiokpitio, yɛ hɔ̃mɔ kɛ kumai mli, yɛ ŋmaahilɛi amli kpitiokpitio, yɛ fɛ̃i kɛ yayainyiɛmɔ mli.

english_verse: Besides everything else, each day I am burdened down, worrying about all the churches.
translation_verse: Nibii ni yɔɔ sɛɛ ayakã; shi nɔ ni haoɔ mi daa gbi ji asafoi lɛ fɛɛ ahe susumɔ.

english_verse: When others are weak, I am weak too. When others are tricked into sin, I get angry.
translation_verse: Namɔ gbedeɔ, ni mi lɛ migbedeee? Namɔ nane atɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ, ni mimli eshãaa mi?

english_verse: If I have to brag, I will brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Kɛ ehe ehĩa akɛ mashwã kɛ̃lɛ, mashwã mafɔ̃ migbedemɔnii anɔ.

english_verse: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever!
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ, mɔ ni ajɔɔ lɛ kɛyashiɔ naanɔ lɛ, le akɛ mimaleee.

english_verse: The governor of Damascus at the time of King Aretas had the city gates guarded, so he could capture me.
translation_verse: Yɛ Damasko lɛ, lumɔ ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ Areta shishi lɛ hã bulɔi bu Damaskobii amaŋ lɛ he ni amɔ mi,

english_verse: But I escaped by being let down in a basket through a window in the city wall.
