translation_verse: ni ashiu mi yɛ kafu mli kɛtsɔ̃ samflɛ ni yɔɔ gbogbo lɛ mli kɛyi shi, ni mijo foi yɛ edɛŋ.

english_verse: I have to brag. There is nothing to be gained by it, but I must brag about the visions and other things that the Lord has shown me.
translation_verse: Shwãa he ehĩa moŋ, shi ehĩii hãaa mi, kɛ̃lɛ mibawie ninai kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kpojiemɔi ahe.

english_verse: I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children.
translation_verse: Naa, enɛ ji shii etɛ̃ ni misaa mihe akɛ maba nyɛŋɔɔ, shi mikɛ mihe ebafɔŋ nyɛnɔ, ejaakɛ jeee nyɛnii lɛ mitaoɔ, shi moŋ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ. Ejaakɛ esaaa akɛ bii tiaa nii toɔ amɛfɔlɔi, shi moŋ fɔlɔi ni tiaa nii toɔ amɛbii.

english_verse: As I said, only God really knows if this man was in his body at the time.
translation_verse: Ni mile nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ akɛ ashá lɛ yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli jio, jeee yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli jio, mileee; Nyɔŋmɔ le.

english_verse: But he was taken up into paradise, where he heard things too wonderful to tell.
translation_verse: Shi akɛ asha lɛ kɛtee Paradeiso ni eyanu wiemɔi ni anyɛŋ awie, ni gbɔmɔ ko bɛ hegbɛ akɛ etsĩɔ tã lɛ, no lɛ mile.

english_verse: I will brag about that man, but not about myself, except to say how weak I am.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ hewɔ mashwã, shi mishwãŋ mihãŋ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe, akɛ ja yɛ migbedemɔi lɛ ahe.

english_verse: Yet even if I did brag, I would not be foolish. I would simply be speaking the truth. But I will try not to say too much. That way, none of you will think more highly of me than you should because of what you have seen me do and say.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛji miitao mashwã lɛ, mifeŋ kwashia, ejaakɛ anɔkwale mawie; shi mikuɔ mihiɛ mifɔ̃ɔ nɔ, koni mɔ ko akabu mi fe bɔ ni enaa mi aloo enuɔ yɛ minaa lɛ.

english_verse: Of course, I am now referring to the wonderful things I saw. One of Satan's angels was sent to make me suffer terribly, so that I would not feel too proud.
translation_verse: Shi bɔ ni afee ni mikawo mihe nɔ tuutu ko yɛ kpojiemɔi lɛ adaramɔ ni amɛdara kɛtɛke nɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ahã mi ŋmei ko yɛ miheloo mli, ni ji Satan bɔfo, koni egbala mi mai, ni mikawo mihe nɔ tuutu.

english_verse: Three times I begged the Lord to make this suffering go away.
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, mikpa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fai shii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ koni eje minɔ;

english_verse: But he replied, “My gift of undeserved grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak.” So if Christ keeps giving me his power, I will gladly brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Miduromɔ lɛ fa hã bo, ejaakɛ mihewalɛ lɛ, gbedeefeemɔ mli eyeɔ emuu yɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, misumɔɔ titri akɛ mashwã mafɔ̃ migbedeefeemɔi lɛ anɔ moŋ, koni Kristo hewalɛ lɛ abu mihe.

english_verse: Yes, I am glad to be weak or insulted or mistreated or to have troubles and sufferings, if it is for Christ. Because when I am weak, I am strong. Paul's Concern for the Lord's Followers at Corinth
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, yɛ Kristo hewɔ lɛ, mimii shɛɔ yɛ gbedeefeemɔi amli, yɛ hiɛnaanɔniinamɔi amli, yɛ fimɔ̃i amli, yɛ yiwaa mli, yɛ jaramɔ mli; ejaakɛ kɛ mifee gbedee lɛ, no minaa hewalɛ. Paulo wie asafo lɛ hiɛ

english_verse: I have been making a fool of myself. But you forced me to do it, when you should have been speaking up for me. I may be nothing at all, but I am as good as those super apostles.
translation_verse: Mifee kwashia; nyɛ nyɛnyɛ minɔ ni mifee nakai. Ejaakɛ kulɛ esa akɛ nyɛ moŋ nyɛjieɔ miyi; ejaakɛ kɛji mijeee nɔ ko tete po, eshwɛɛɛ mi nɔ ko ni mikɛ bɔfoi agboi lɛ aye hegbɔ.

english_verse: When I was with you, I was patient and worked all the powerful miracles and signs and wonders of a true apostle.
translation_verse: Okadii ni tsɔ̃ɔ bɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ afee yɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ tsuishitoo fɛɛ mli, yɛ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii kɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi amli.

english_verse: You missed out on only one blessing the other churches received. That is, you didn't have to support me. Forgive me for doing you wrong.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛni mli nyɛkpeɔ sɛɛ yɛ fe asafoi krokomɛi lɛ, fe akɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ lɛ mikãaa nyɛnɔ? Nyɛkɛ nɛkɛ tɔ̃mɔ nɛɛ afaa mi! Paulo fã ehe

english_verse: So I will gladly give all I have and all I am. Will you love me less for loving you too much?
translation_verse: Shi masumɔ babaoo akɛ mafite nii ni miyɔɔ lɛ yɛ nyɛhe, ni asaŋ mikɛ mihe ashã afɔle yɛ nyɛsusumai ahewɔ. Ani esa akɛ bɔ ni suɔmɔ ni miyɔɔ kɛhã nyɛ lɛ faa lɛ, nyɛsuɔmɔ lɛ nɔ agbɔ lo?

english_verse: You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you.
translation_verse: Nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, eyɛ mli akɛ mikãaa nyɛnɔ nɛ; shi akɛni ŋaalɔ ji mi hewɔ lɛ, mimɔ nyɛ yɛ ŋaa mli.

english_verse: Were you cheated by any of those I sent to you?
translation_verse: Ani mitsɔ̃ mɛi ni mitsu nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ eko nɔ miye nyɛ amim lo?

english_verse: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.
translation_verse: Mikpa Tito fai ni mitsu lɛ kɛ wɔnyɛmi ko; ani Tito baye nyɛ amim ko? Ani jeee nakai mumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ wɔkɛnyiɛ? Jeee nakai najiamaamɔhei lɛ amli nɔŋŋ wɔnyiɛ? Kɔkɔbɔɔ

english_verse: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
translation_verse: Asaŋ nyɛsusuɔ akɛ wɔnaa sɔŋŋ wɔjieɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɛɛ lo? Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ wɔwieɔ yɛ, yɛ Kristo mli; shi, suɔmɔmɛi, nii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛnaneshimɔmɔ hewɔ wɔwieɔ.

english_verse: I am afraid when I come, we won't be pleased with each other. I fear that some of you may be arguing or jealous or angry or selfish or gossiping or insulting each other. I even fear that you may be proud and acting like a mob.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ miishe gbeyei akɛ ekolɛ kɛ miba lɛ, mibanaŋ nyɛ bɔ ni misumɔɔ, ni nyɛ hu nyɛnaŋ mi bɔ ni nyɛsumɔɔ; bei, awuŋayeli, mlilawoo, pɛsɛŋkuminya, oshekuyeli, mɔhewiemɔ, hefaa, sakasakafeemɔ;

english_verse: I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
translation_verse: ni misaa miishe gbeyei akɛ kɛ miba ekoŋŋ lɛ, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaaba mi shi yɛ nyɛhiɛ, ni maye ŋkɔmɔ mahã mɛi ni efee esha sa ni amɛtsakeee amɛtsui lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii, yɛ amɛmujinii kɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ kɛ nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, “Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.”
translation_verse: Nyɛŋɔɔ ni mibaa nɛɛ ji nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃. Odasefoi enyɔ loo etɛ̃ adaaŋ wiemɔ naa lɛ sane fɛɛ sane ama shi.

english_verse: During my second visit I warned you that I would punish you and anyone else who doesn't stop sinning. I am far away from you now, but I give you the same warning.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni efee esha sa lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ, mikɛɛ amɛ mito momo, ni asaŋ miikɛɛ amɛ mato be mli ni mibɛ nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ akɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛɛ be ni miba nyɛŋɔɔ nɔ ni ji shi enyɔ lɛ, kɛ miba ekoŋŋ lɛ mikɛ amɛhe ekeŋ amɛ,

english_verse: This should prove to you that I am speaking for Christ. When he corrects you, he won't be weak. He will be powerful!
translation_verse: ejaakɛ nyɛmiitao naakpɛɛ okadi ko ni nyɛkɛaana akɛ Kristo wieɔ yɛ mimli, Kristo mɔ ni gbedeee yɛ nyɛmli, shi moŋ ehe waa yɛ nyɛmli lɛ.

english_verse: Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ asɛŋ lɛ yɛ gbedemɔ mli, shi Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ naa lɛ, ehiɛ kã; ni wɔ hu wɔgbedeɔ yɛ emli; shi Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ lɛ naa lɛ, wɔ kɛ lɛ hiɛ aaakãmɔ ahã nyɛ.

english_verse: Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed.
translation_verse: Nyɛkaa nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe nyɛkwɛa akɛ nyɛyɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli lo? Nyɛtaoa nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛmli nyɛkwɛa. Aloo nyɛleee yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe akɛ Yesu Kristo yɛ nyɛmli? Kɛ nyɛleee nakai lɛ, mɛi ni esaaa kwraa ji nyɛ.

english_verse: I hope you will discover we have not failed.
translation_verse: Shi mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ nyɛaale akɛ wɔ lɛ wɔjeee mɛi ni esaaa.

english_verse: We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
translation_verse: Shi miikpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai, koni nyɛkafee nɔ ko fɔŋ ko kwraa, jeee koni wɔ lɛ wɔfee tamɔ mɛi ni sa hewɔŋ, shi moŋ koni nyɛ lɛ nyɛfee ekpakpa, ni wɔ lɛ wɔfee tamɔ mɛi ni esaaa.

english_verse: All we can do is to follow the truth and not fight against it.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔnyɛŋ nɔ ko wɔfee wɔshi anɔkwale lɛ, shi moŋ kɛ nɔ ko wɔɔfee lɛ, wɔɔfee wɔhã anɔkwale lɛ.

english_verse: Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔnaa miishɛɛ kɛ wɔfee gbedee ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛyɛ hewalɛ lɛ; shi nɔ he fai ni wɔkpaa ji nyɛ emuuyeli.

english_verse: I am writing these things to you before I arrive. This way I won't have to be hard on you when I use the authority the Lord has given me. I was given this authority, so I could help you and not destroy you.
translation_verse: No hewɔ hu ni miŋmaa enɛ be ni mibɛ nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ, koni kɛ miba nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, mikɛ nyɛ akaye waa, yɛ hegbɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ehã mi ni mikɛsaa shi jeee ni mikɛfite lɛ naa.

english_verse: Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other. Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you.
translation_verse: Naagbee lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛmii ashɛa, nyɛyea emuu, nyɛshɛjea nyɛhe mii, nyɛjwɛŋmɔ afea ekome, nyɛhĩa shi yɛ hejɔlɛ mli, ni suɔmɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ aaahi shi.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. All God's people send their greetings.
translation_verse: Nyɛŋaŋaa nyɛhe kɛ naashwɔmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ. Mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ miibi nyɛ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will bless you and be kind to you! May God bless you with his love, and may the Holy Spirit join all your hearts together.
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ lɛ Kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ naanyobɔɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi. Amen.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ ahã nyɛ;

english_verse: Christ obeyed God our Father and gave himself as a sacrifice for our sins to rescue us from this evil world.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo ni kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hã yɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ, koni ejie wɔ kɛjɛ jeŋ fɔ̃ŋ ni yɔɔ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ mli, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔTsɛ lɛ suɔmɔ naa lɛ.

english_verse: God will be given glory forever and ever. Amen. The Only True Message
translation_verse: Enɔ ji anunyam lɛ kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyashiɔ naanɔ lɛ. Amen! Sanekpakpa kroko bɛ

english_verse: I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message,
translation_verse: Efee mihiɛ yaa akɛ amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ nyɛmiitsi nyɛhe kɛjɛ mɔ ni tsɛ nyɛ yɛ Kristo dromɔ mli lɛ he kɛya Sanekpakpa kroko he;

english_verse: when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ.
translation_verse: shi jeee Sanekpakpa kroko ni, fe akɛ mɛi komɛi ni yɔɔ ni hãa nyɛjwɛŋmɔ futuɔ, ni amɛtaoɔ akɛ amɛtsɔ̃ Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ hiɛ amɛbu shi.

english_verse: I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji wɔ po aloo bɔfo ni jɛ ŋwɛi tete bajaje Sanekpakpa kroko etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, yɛ nɔ ni wɔjaje wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ebɔ musu!

english_verse: I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.
translation_verse: Tamɔ bɔ ni wɔkɛɛ momo lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mikɛɔ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Kɛ mɔ ko bajaje Sanekpakpa kroko etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ yɛ nɔ ni nyɛmɔ mli nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ebɔ musu!”

english_verse: I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ. How Paul Became an Apostle
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ be nɛ lɛ, gbɔmɛi ahiɛ gbɛ mitaoɔ loo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ gbɛ? Aloo miitao gbɔmɛi ahiɛ masa? Ejaakɛ kɛ mikã he miitao masa gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ, jeee Kristo tsulɔ ji mi. Bɔ ni fee ni Paulo tsɔ̃ bɔfo

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach.
translation_verse: Shi miihã nyɛle, anyɛmimɛi, akɛ Sanekpakpa ni mijaje lɛ, ejɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ dɛŋ;

english_verse: It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ jeee gbɔmɔ ko dɛŋ mina kɛjɛ, ni jeee tsɔ̃ɔmɔ hu atsɔ̃ɔ mi, shi moŋ Yesu Kristo kpojiemɔ naa mina yɛ.

english_verse: You know how I used to live as a Jew. I was cruel to God's church and even tried to destroy it.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɛnu misa jeŋba lɛ he yɛ Yudafoi ajamɔ lɛ mli. Bɔ ni miwa Nyɔŋmɔ asafo lɛ yi fe nine ni mibɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ makpãtã ehiɛ;

english_verse: I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us.
translation_verse: ni mitee hiɛ yɛ Yudafoi ajamɔ lɛ mli fe mitipɛŋfoi pii yɛ mijakubii ateŋ, ni mihiɛ dɔ naakpa yɛ wɔtsɛmɛi ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ni akɛhã wɔ lɛ he.

english_verse: to show me his Son, so I would announce his message to the Gentiles. I didn't talk this over with anyone.
translation_verse: akɛ eeejie lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eBi lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi, koni mijaje ehe Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ, amrɔ lɛ mibiii gbɔmɔ ko ŋaawoo yɛ he,

english_verse: I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
translation_verse: ni misaa miyaaa Yerusalɛm hu yɛ mɛi ni ji bɔfoi dani mi hu mitsɔ̃ bɔfo lɛ aŋɔɔ, shi moŋ miyiŋ kɛtee Arabia ni misaa miku misɛɛ kɛba Damasko ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ no sɛɛ afii etɛ̃ lɛ, mitee Yerusalɛm ni mayale Kefa, ni mihi eŋɔɔ gbii nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ;

english_verse: The only other apostle I saw was James, the Lord's brother.
translation_verse: shi minaaa bɔfoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kroko akɛ ja Yakobo, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nyɛmi lɛ.

english_verse: And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: Shi nii ni miŋmaa nyɛ nɛɛ, naa, Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ mikɛɔ yɛ akɛ mimaleee.

english_verse: Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
translation_verse: No sɛɛ lɛ, miba Siria kɛ Kilikia niiaŋ.

english_verse: But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person.
translation_verse: Shi aleee mihiɛ yɛ Yudea asafoi ni yɔɔ Kristo mli lɛ amli;

english_verse: They had only heard that the one who had been cruel to them was now preaching the message that he had once tried to destroy.
translation_verse: shi amɛnuɔ kɛkɛ akɛ akɛɔ akɛ, “Mɔ ni be ko mli ni ewa wɔ yi lɛ, agbɛnɛ eejaje hemɔkɛyeli ni tsutsu lɛ ebɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ ekpãtã hiɛ lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ eetsɔ̃ɔ.”

english_verse: And because of me, they praised God.
translation_verse: Ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ mihewɔ.

english_verse: Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ no sɛɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ misaa mikɛ Barnaba tee Yerusalɛm, ni miŋɔ Tito hu mifata mihe.

english_verse: But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
translation_verse: Shi mitee yɛ kpojiemɔ ko naa, ni mikɛ Sanekpakpa ni mishiɛɔ yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ yaŋmɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ gbɛi lɛ sɔŋŋ ahiɛ bɔ ni afee ni foi ni midaa aloo ni mida lɛ akafee yaka.

english_verse: Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Shi Tito tete ni kɛ mi yɔɔ ni eji Helanyo lɛ, anyɛɛɛ enɔ akɛ efo ketia.

english_verse: We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni wo ketiafoo sane nɔ ji amale nyɛmimɛi komɛi ni ju shi kɛbafutu wɔ, ni amɛba nigii koni amɛbasara wɔhe ni wɔye yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, koni amɛye wɔ nyɔŋ;

english_verse: But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
translation_verse: shi wɔkpɛ̃lɛɛɛ ni wɔbo amɛ toi ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome po tete, koni Sanekpakpa lɛ anɔkwale lɛ ahi shi daa ahã nyɛ.

english_verse: Some of them were supposed to be important leaders, but I didn't care who they were. God doesn't have any favorites! None of these so-called special leaders added anything to my message.
translation_verse: Shi mɛi ni abuɔ amɛ akɛ amɛyɔɔ gbɛi lɛ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ sa lɛ, jeee mihe sane ko ni, Nyɔŋmɔ kwɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ ehalaaa lɛ, mɛi ni abuɔ amɛ lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ mi nɔ ko amɛfataaa he;

english_verse: They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews.
translation_verse: shi moŋ be ni amɛna akɛ atu foolɔi ateŋ Sanekpakpa lɛ jajemɔ lɛ awo midɛŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni atu ketiafolɔi anɔ lɛ awo Petro dɛŋ,

english_verse: God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ mɔ ni tsu nii yɛ Petro mli ni ehã eye bɔfo yɛ ketiafolɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ etsu nii yɛ mi hu mimli yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ,

english_verse: James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews.
translation_verse: be ni amɛyoo dromɔ ni akɛhã mi lɛ, Yakobo kɛ Kefa kɛ Yohane ni abuɔ amɛ akɛ akulashiŋi lɛ, amɛkɛ naanyobɔɔ ninejurɔ lɛ ta mi kɛ Barnaba dɛ̃, koni wɔ lɛ wɔya jeŋmaji lɛ aŋɔɔ, shi amɛ lɛ amɛya ketiafolɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ;

english_verse: They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do. Paul Corrects Peter at Antioch
translation_verse: shi ohiafoi kɛkɛ amɛkɛɛ wɔkai, ni no nɔŋŋ he mɔdɛŋ mibɔ akɛ mafee.

english_verse: When Peter came to Antioch, I told him face to face that he was wrong.
translation_verse: Shi be ni Kefa ba Antiokia lɛ midamɔ ehiɛ miku enaa, ejaakɛ eye sane ni ejaaa.

english_verse: He used to eat with Gentile followers of the Lord, until James sent some Jewish followers. Peter was afraid of the Jews and soon stopped eating with Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ dani mɛi komɛi aaajɛ Yakobo ŋɔɔ aba lɛ, ekɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ yeɔ nii; shi be ni amɛba lɛ, egbala ehe shi ni etse ehe, ejaakɛ eeshe mɛi ni jɛ ketiafolɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ gbeyei.

english_verse: He and the others hid their true feelings so well that even Barnabas was fooled.
translation_verse: Ni Yudafoi ni eshwɛ lɛ hu kɛ lɛ fee nakai osato lɛ, ni amɛsatofeemɔ lɛ gbala Barnaba kɛtee amɛgbɛfaŋ.

english_verse: But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said: Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
translation_verse: Shi be ni mina akɛ amɛnyiɛɛɛ trɔmɔɔ yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ anɔkwale lɛ naa lɛ, mikɛɛ Kefa yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ akɛ, “Kɛ bo ni oji Yudanyo lɛ ohiɔ shi tamɔ jeŋmajiaŋnyo ni jeee tamɔ Yudafonyo lɛ, mɛɛba onyɛɔ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ anɔ akɛ amɛhi shi tamɔ Yudafoi?” Yudafoi kɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii fɛɛ lɛ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ ahereɔ amɛyiwala

english_verse: We are Jews by birth and are not sinners like Gentiles.
translation_verse: Afɔ wɔ Yudafoi akɛ ni wɔjeee eshafeelɔi ni jɛ jeŋmaji lɛ amli,

english_verse: But we know that God accepts only those who have faith in Jesus Christ. No one can please God by simply obeying the Law. So we put our faith in Christ Jesus, and God accepted us because of our faith.
translation_verse: shi akɛni wɔle akɛ abuuu gbɔmɔ bem kɛjɛɛɛ Mla nitsumɔi amli, akɛ ja atsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ nɔ kɛkɛ lɛ, wɔ hu wɔhe Kristo Yesu nɔ wɔye, koni abu wɔ bem yɛ Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli mli, ni jeee Mla nitsumɔi amli, ejaakɛ abuŋ gbɔmɔ ko gbɔmɔ ko bem kɛjɛŋ Mla nitsumɔi amli.

english_verse: When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't!
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ kɛji wɔ ni wɔtaoɔ akɛ abu wɔ bem yɛ Kristo mli lɛ ana wɔ akɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ hu eshafeelɔi ji wɔ lɛ, belɛ Kristo ji esha sɔ̃ɔlɔ lo? Dabida!

english_verse: But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ nii ni mikumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ mimaa ekoŋŋ lɛ, belɛ mikɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nɔtɔ̃lɔ.

english_verse: It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God. I have been nailed to the cross with Christ.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mi lɛ mitsɔ̃ Mla lɛ nɔ migbo yɛ Mla lɛ gbɛfaŋ, koni mihiɛ akã ahã Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: I have died, but Christ lives in me. And I now live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave his life for me.
translation_verse: Asɛŋ mi kɛ Kristo; hewɔ lɛ jeee mi mihiɛ kã dɔŋŋ, shi Kristo ni hiɛ kã yɛ mimli; shi mihiɛ ni kã yɛ heloo mli agbɛnɛ nɛɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ ni sumɔ mi ni ekɛ ehe hã yɛ mihewɔ lɛ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli mli mihiɛ kã yɛ.

english_verse: I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
translation_verse: Mikwaaa Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ kɛ Mla nɔ jalɛ tsɔ̃ kɛba lɛ, belɛ Kristo lɛ yakatswaa egbo lɛ.

english_verse: You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you?
translation_verse: O Galatiabii ni bɛ yitsoŋ! Namɔ kpɛ nyɛ ayɛ, nyɛ ni atɛŋ Yesu Kristo yɛ nyɛhiɛ akɛ mɔ ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ?

english_verse: I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him?
translation_verse: Enɛ kɛkɛ mitaoɔ male yɛ nyɛnaa: Mumɔ lɛ ni nyɛna lɛ, Mla nitsumɔi amli nyɛna kɛjɛ, aloo hemɔkɛyeli ni nyɛkɛ bo Sanekpakpa lɛ toi mli?

english_verse: How can you be so stupid? Do you think that by yourself you can complete what God's Spirit started in you?
translation_verse: Aso nɛkɛ nyɛbɛ yitsoŋ? Ni nyɛkɛ mumɔ bɔ̃i lɛ, agbɛnɛ heloo nyɛkɛbaagbe naa lo?

english_verse: Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing?
translation_verse: Nɔ babaoo ni nyɛna nɛɛ, yakatswaa nyɛna lo ?

english_verse: God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?
translation_verse: Belɛ mɔ ni kɛ Mumɔ lɛ hãa nyɛ ni etsuɔ hewalɛ nii yɛ nyɛmli lɛ, Mla nitsumɔi ahewɔ efeɔ, aloo hemɔkɛyeli ni nyɛkɛboɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ toi lɛ hewɔ ni?

english_verse: The Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith.
translation_verse: Tamɔ bɔ ni Abraham he Nyɔŋmɔ eye, ni abu enɛ jalɛ ahã lɛ lɛ.

english_verse: And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ, amɛ ji Abrahambii.

english_verse: Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him.
translation_verse: Shi akɛni ŋmalɛ lɛ ena momo akɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli Nyɔŋmɔ aaabu jeŋmaji lɛ abem yɛ hewɔ lɛ, ejaje Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Abraham eto akɛ, “Omli aaajɔɔ jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ yɛ.”

english_verse: This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
translation_verse: Belɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ, ajɔɔ amɛ kɛ Abraham heyelɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Anyone who tries to please God by obeying the Law is under a curse. The Scriptures say, “Everyone who doesn't obey everything in the Law is under a curse.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛi abɔ ni kɛ amɛhe fɔ̃ɔ Mla nitsumɔi anɔ lɛ, loomɔ kã amɛnɔ; ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, “Alomɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eyaaa nɔ efeee nii fɛɛ ni aŋma yɛ Mla Wolo lɛ mli lɛ.”

english_verse: No one can please God by obeying the Law. The Scriptures also say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.”
translation_verse: Shi eyɛ faŋŋ akɛ Mla mli lɛ abuŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko bem yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ejaakɛ “jalɔ lɛ, hemɔkɛyeli mli eyi aaana wala yɛ;”

english_verse: The Law isn't based on faith. It promises life only to people who obey its commands.
translation_verse: shi Mla lɛ, jeee hemɔkɛyeli sane ni, shi moŋ “Mɔ ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ yi aaana wala yɛ mli.”

english_verse: But Christ rescued us from the Law's curse, when he became a curse in our place. This is because the Scriptures say that anyone who is nailed to a tree is under a curse.
translation_verse: Kristo kpɔ̃ wɔ kɛjɛ Mla lɛ loomɔ lɛ mli, akɛni etsɔ̃ loomɔ ehã wɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, “Alomɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsotsoro tso nɔ lɛ;”

english_verse: And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit. The Law and the Promise
translation_verse: koni Abraham jɔɔmɔ lɛ aba jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli, ni wɔkɛ hemɔkɛyeli ana Mumɔ ni awo he shi lɛ. Mla lɛ kɛ shiwoo lɛ

english_verse: My friends, I will use an everyday example to explain what I mean. Once someone agrees to something, no one else can change or cancel the agreement.
translation_verse: Anyɛmimɛi, miiwie lɛ gbɔmɛiaŋ: gbɔmɔ kpãŋmɔ tete, kɛji akpɛlɛ̃ nɔ lɛ, mɔ ko kwaaa, ni asaŋ mɔ ko kɛ nɔ ko fataaa he.

english_verse: That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ.
translation_verse: Shi Abraham lɛ, akɛ lɛ kɛ eshwie lɛ wie shiwoo wiemɔi lɛ. Ekɛɛɛ akɛ, “kɛ oshwiei lɛ” tamɔ nɔ ni ekɛ mɛi pii miiwie, shi moŋ tamɔ mɔ kome akɛ, “kɛ oshwie lɛ”, mɔ ni ji Kristo lɛ.

english_verse: If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ gboshinii lɛ jɛ Mla lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ jeee shiwoo lɛ mli ejɛ dɔŋŋ; shi Abraham lɛ, shiwoo nɔ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ ekɛke lɛ.

english_verse: What is the use of the Law? It was given later to show that we sin. But it was only supposed to last until the coming of that descendant who was given the promise. In fact, angels gave the Law to Moses, and he gave it to the people.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ mɛɛ ji Mla lɛ mɔ? Akɛhã ni akɛna nɔtɔmɔi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni shwie ni awo lɛ shi lɛ aaaba; ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi anɔ atsɔ̃ awo Mla lɛ, ni akɛwo mlidaamɔlɔ dɛŋ.

english_verse: There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him. Slaves and Children
translation_verse: Shi mlidaamɔlɔ sane lɛ, ejeee mɔ kome nɔ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ kome ji lɛ.

english_verse: Does the Law disagree with God's promises? No, it doesn't! If any law could give life to us, we could become acceptable to God by obeying that law.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ Mla lɛ shiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoi lɛ lo? Dabida! Ejaakɛ eji awo mla ko ni aaanyɛ wala ahã kulɛ, anɔkwale mli lɛ wɔbembuu baajɛ mla nɔyeli mli.

english_verse: But the Scriptures say that sin controls everyone, so that God's promises will be for anyone who has faith in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ; ŋmalɛ lɛ eŋa nibii fɛɛ yi ewo esha shishi, koni atsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ akɛ shiwoo lɛ ahã mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ. Hemɔkɛyeli ehã wɔye wɔhe

english_verse: The Law controlled us and kept us under its power until the time came when we would have faith.
translation_verse: Shi dani hemɔkɛyeli lɛ ba lɛ, aŋa wɔyi tamɔ gboklɛfoi awo Mla shishi kɛyashi hemɔkɛyeli ni abaajie kpo lɛ aaaba.

english_verse: In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Mla lɛ etsɔ̃ wɔtsɔselɔ kɛmiiya Kristo ŋɔɔ koni atsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ abu wɔ bem.

english_verse: All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bii ji nyɛ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli kɛtsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ nɔ;

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ nyɛ mɛi abɔ ni abaptisi nyɛ awo Kristo mli lɛ, nyɛwo Kristo.

english_verse: Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman.
translation_verse: Yudanyo bɛ lɛ, Helanyo hu bɛ dɔŋŋ; nyɔŋ bɛ lɛ, odehe hu bɛ dɔŋŋ; nuu bɛ lɛ, yoo hu bɛ dɔŋŋ: ejaakɛ nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ mɔ kome ji nyɛ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli.

english_verse: So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji Kristo nii ji nyɛ lɛ, belɛ Abraham shwiei ji nyɛ, kɛ gboshiniiyelɔi hu yɛ shiwoo lɛ naa.

english_verse: Children who are under age are no better off than slaves, even though everything their parents own will someday be theirs.
translation_verse: Shi miikɛɛ akɛ, gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni gboshiniiyelɔ lɛ ji abifao lɛ, srɔto ko bɛ ekɛ nyɔŋ teŋ, tsɛbelɛ lɛ ji nii lɛ fɛɛ tsɛ;

english_verse: This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set.
translation_verse: shi moŋ eyɛ nɔkwɛlɔi kɛ tsuji nukpai ashishi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni tsɛ lɛ eto lɛ.

english_verse: This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ wɔ hu, be ni wɔji abifabii lɛ, akɛ wɔ wo je nɛɛŋ shishijee nibii anyɔŋyeli lɛ shishi.

english_verse: But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law,
translation_verse: Shi be ni be lɛ shɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eBi lɛ kɛba, yoo fɔ lɛ, eba Mla shishi;

english_verse: so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children.
translation_verse: koni ebakpɔ̃ mɛi ni yɔɔ Mla shishi lɛ, ni wɔtsɔ̃mɔ bii.

english_verse: Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father.
translation_verse: Shi akɛni bii ji nyɛ hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsu eBi lɛ Mumɔ lɛ kɛba nyɛtsuii amli, ni eboɔ akɛ, “Aba, Ataa!”

english_verse: You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised. Paul's Concern for the Galatians
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, ojeee nyɔŋ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ bi ji bo, ni kɛji bi ji bo lɛ, belɛ Nyɔŋmɔ efee bo niyelɔ hu. Galatiabii asɛɛsɛɛyaa

english_verse: Before you knew God, you were slaves of gods that are not real.
translation_verse: Shi be mli ni nyɛleee Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nyɛfee nyɛhe nyɔji nyɛhã nibii ni yɛ amɛbɔɔsu naa lɛ jeee nyɔŋmɔi ni lɛ;

english_verse: But now you know God, or better still, God knows you. How can you turn back and become the slaves of those weak and pitiful powers?
translation_verse: shi agbɛnɛ moŋ ni nyɛle Nyɔŋmɔ, aloo ni Nyɔŋmɔ ele nyɛ lɛ, te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛkuɔ nyɛsɛɛ kɛya shishijee nibii ni nyɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ ko afee ni bɛ hewalɛ ko lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni nyɛsaa nyɛtaoɔ akɛ nyɛje shishi nyɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ?

english_verse: You even celebrate certain days, months, seasons, and years.
translation_verse: Nyɛyeɔ gbii kɛ nyɔji kɛ bei kɛ afii ahe gbɛjianɔ ni ato lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
translation_verse: Miishe gbeyei akɛ ekolɛ yakatswaa migba mihe naa yɛ nyɛhe lɛ.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to be like me, just as I once tried to be like you. Did you mistreat me
translation_verse: Miikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛtamɔa mi, ejaakɛ mi hu mitamɔ nyɛ. Nyɛfeko mi efɔŋ ko;

english_verse: when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick.
translation_verse: shi nyɛle akɛ heloo gbedemɔ mli mijaje Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ klɛŋklɛŋ be ni mijaje lɛ,

english_verse: My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself.
translation_verse: ni nɔ ni ji naatsɔ̃ɔmɔ hã nyɛ yɛ mli lɛ, nyɛgbeee he guɔ ni asaŋ nyɛnyaŋeee; shi moŋ nyɛhere mi tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo, tamɔ Kristo Yesu diɛŋtsɛ.

english_verse: Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ nɛgbɛ nyɛmiishɛɛ lɛ yɔɔ? Ejaakɛ miiye nyɛhe odase akɛ ehiɔ feemɔ jikulɛ nyɛfamɔ nyɛhiŋmɛii tete nyɛhã mi.

english_verse: Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
translation_verse: Ani mitsɔ̃ nyɛhenyɛlɔ akɛ mikɛɔ nyɛ nɔ ni ji anɔkwale lɛ?

english_verse: Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention.
translation_verse: Jeee nyɛhe mɔdɛŋ kpakpa ko mɛi komɛi bɔɔ lɛ, amɛmiitao akɛ amɛtsi nyɛ wɔŋɔɔbaa gbɛ moŋ, koni nyɛbɔ amɛ moŋ amɛhe mɔdɛŋ.

english_verse: It is always good to give your attention to something worthwhile, even when I am not with you.
translation_verse: Shi ehi akɛ abɔ nyɛhe mɔdɛŋ daa kɛji akɛ jwɛŋmɔ kpakpa fee, ni jeee be ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ kɛkɛ.

english_verse: My children, I am in terrible pain until Christ may be seen living in you.
translation_verse: Mibii bibii ni mikɔ̃mɔɔ kɛ nyɛfɔmɔ ekoŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaashɔ̃ Kristo subaŋ yɛ nyɛmli.

english_verse: I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled. Hagar and Sarah
translation_verse: Mina ni kulɛ miyɛ nyɛmasɛi amrɔ nɛɛ ni mitsake gbɛ nɔ ni matsɔ̃ ni mikɛ nyɛ awie, ejaakɛ miyiŋ feɔ mi kɔshikɔshi yɛ nyɛhewɔ! Mla lɛ kɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ

english_verse: Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says?
translation_verse: Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ nyɛhi Mla shishi lɛ, nyɛkɛa mi, ani nyɛnuuu Mla lɛ lo?

english_verse: In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ Abraham yɛ bii enyɔ, mɔ kome lɛ, ekɛ nyɔŋyoo lɛ fɔ lɛ, ni mɔ kome hu ekɛ odehe lɛ fɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ, mɔ ni ekɛ nyɔŋyoo lɛ fɔ lɛ, afɔ lɛ yɛ heloo naa; shi mɔ ni ekɛ odehe lɛ fɔ lɛ, afɔ lɛ yɛ shiwoo naa.

english_verse: All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave.
translation_verse: Nibii nɛɛ abɛ ni. Enɛɛmɛi ji kpãŋmɔi enyɔ lɛ. Ekome lɛ jɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɔŋyeli mli efɔɔ ewoɔ: no ji Hagar;

english_verse: Hagar also stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and for the present city of Jerusalem. She and her children are slaves.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Hagar ji Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ yɛ Arabia; shi ekɛ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ yaa, ejaakɛ ekɛ ebii lɛ ji nyɔji;

english_verse: But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave.
translation_verse: shi ŋwɛi Yerusalɛm lɛ ji odehe lɛ, ni ji wɔnyɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about her, “You have never had children, but now you can be glad. You have never given birth, but now you can shout. Once you had no children, but now you will have more children than a woman who has been married for a long time.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, “La nyamɔ lala, bo kene ni ofɔɔɔ; wo nyamɔ nɔ ni obolɔ kɛ miishɛɛ, bo ni okɔ̃mɔɔɔ; ejaakɛ mɔ ni bɛ mɔ ko lɛ moŋ bii fa fe mɔ ni yɔɔ wu lɛ po!”

english_verse: My friends, you were born because of this promise, just as Isaac was.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ, anyɛmimɛi, wɔ lɛ, shiwoo lɛ bii ji wɔ tamɔ Isak.

english_verse: But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today.
translation_verse: Shi tamɔ bɔ ni no be lɛ mli lɛ mɔ ni afɔ lɛ yɛ heloo naa lɛ waa mɔ ni afɔ lɛ yɛ mumɔ naa lɛ yi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ yɔɔ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ hu.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.”
translation_verse: Shi mɛni ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ? “Shwiemɔ nyɔŋyoo lɛ kɛ ebi lɛ; ejaakɛ nyɔŋyoo bi lɛ ekɛ odehe lɛ bi lɛ yeŋ gboshinii lɛ.”

english_verse: My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, wɔjeee nyɔŋyoo lɛ bii, shi moŋ odehe lɛ bii.

english_verse: Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
translation_verse: Kristo ehã wɔye wɔhe, no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ, ni nyɛkahãa abɔa nyɛ nyɔŋyeli apã lɛ dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: I, Paul, promise you that Christ won't do you any good if you get circumcised.
translation_verse: Naa, mi Paulo, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛhã afolɔ nyɛ ketia lɛ, Kristo he baŋ sɛɛnamɔ haŋ nyɛ.

english_verse: And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ abu nyɛ bem yɛ Mla mli lɛ, nyɛtse nyɛhe kɛjɛ Kristo he; nyɛjɛ dromɔ lɛ mli nyɛgbee shi.

english_verse: But the Spirit makes us sure God will accept us because of our faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔ lɛ, Mumɔ lɛ nɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ wɔkɛ hemɔkɛyeli mɛɔ jalɛ ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, jeee ketiafoo, ni asaŋ jeee foo hu ni nyɛɔ nɔ ko efeɔ, shi moŋ hemɔkɛyeli ni tsɔ̃ɔ suɔmɔ nɔ etsuɔ nii lɛ.

english_verse: You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth.
translation_verse: Kulɛ nyɛmiiya nɔ jogbaŋŋ; namɔ po tsi nyɛ gbɛ akɛ nyɛkabo anɔkwale lɛ toi?

english_verse: And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you.
translation_verse: Jwɛŋmɔ tsake mɔ nɛɛ, jeee mɔ ni tsɛɔ nyɛ lɛ mli ejɛ.

english_verse: A little yeast can change a whole batch of dough,
translation_verse: Masha bibioo hãa ma sui lɛ fɛɛ shaa.

english_verse: but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
translation_verse: Mi lɛ mikɛ mihiɛ efɔ̃ nyɛnɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli akɛ ebaŋ lɛ akɛ nyɛaajwɛŋ jwɛŋmɔ kroko; shi mɔ ni haoɔ nyɛjwɛŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ji lɛ, esɔ̃ abua eyiteŋ.

english_verse: My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, kɛji ketiafoo lɛ mishiɛɔ lolo lɛ, mɛɛba mɔ ni awaa mi yi lolo? Nakai ni kulɛ, sɛŋmɔtso lɛ he pampi lɛ sɛɛ efo.

english_verse: I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!
translation_verse: Ao mina ni kulɛ mɛi ni hãa nyɛgbugbãa lɛ folɔ amɛhenii tete po amɛshwie. Heyeli mli shihilɛ kɛ Mumɔ naa nyiɛmɔ

english_verse: My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ heyeli mli atsɛ nyɛ kɛba, anyɛmimɛi; shi nyɛheyeli lɛ kɛkɛ ni nyɛkahãa etsɔ̃a hegbɛ ehã heloo lɛ taomɔnii, shi moŋ nyɛtsɔa suɔmɔ nɔ nyɛsɔ̃mɔsɔ̃mɔa nyɛhe.

english_verse: All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Mla muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔyeli yɛ wiemɔ kome nɛɛ mli akɛ, “Suɔmɔ onaanyo tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe lɛ.”

english_verse: But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves. God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
translation_verse: Shi kɛ nyɛkɔ̃mɔkɔ̃mɔɔ nyɛhe ni nyɛyeyeɔ nyɛhe lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni nyɛkakpãtãa nyɛhe hiɛ.

english_verse: If you are guided by the Spirit, you won't obey your selfish desires.
translation_verse: Shi nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji, “Nyɛnyiɛa yɛ Mumɔ naa, ni nyɛfeŋ heloo akɔnɔi lɛ anaa nii.”

english_verse: The Spirit and your desires are enemies of each other. They are always fighting each other and keeping you from doing what you feel you should.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nii ni heloo lɛ taoɔ lɛ kɛ Mumɔ lɛ eyaaa, ni nii ni Mumɔ lɛ hu taoɔ lɛ kɛ heloo lɛ eyaaa; enɛɛmɛi kɛ amɛhe yeee, enɛ hewɔ lɛ nii ni nyɛsumɔɔ lɛ nyɛnyɛ̃ɛɛ nyɛfee.

english_verse: But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ Mumɔ lɛ kpalaa nyɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛbɛ Mla lɛ shishi.

english_verse: People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds.
translation_verse: Shi heloo lɛ nitsumɔi lɛ jeɔ kpo faŋŋ: nomɛi ji ajwamãŋbɔɔ, mujinitsumɔ, nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ,

english_verse: envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
translation_verse: hiɛkɔ̃ɔ, dãatɔɔ, dãanumɔ mli basabasafeemɔ kɛ nii ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi, nii ni miikɛɛ nyɛ mato, tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ momo lɛ, akɛ mɛi ni feɔ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ lɛ, amɛnine shɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: God's Spirit makes us loving, happy, peaceful, patient, kind, good, faithful,
translation_verse: Shi Mumɔ lɛ yibii ji suɔmɔ, miishɛɛ, hejɔlɛ, tsuishitoo, mlihilɛ, ejurɔfeemɔ, hemɔkɛyeli,

english_verse: gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways.
translation_verse: kpoofeemɔ, henɔyeli. Enɛɛmɛi lɛ mla ko eguuu.

english_verse: And because we belong to Christ Jesus, we have killed our selfish feelings and desires.
translation_verse: Shi mɛi ni ji Kristo nii lɛ, amɛsɛŋ heloo lɛ kɛ ehiɛdɔɔnii kɛ ekɔnɔi lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit.
translation_verse: Kɛji wɔhiɛ kã yɛ Mumɔ lɛ naa lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔnyiɛa yɛ Mumɔ lɛ naa hu.

english_verse: But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
translation_verse: Wɔkatao yaka anunyam ni wɔwowoo wɔhe mlila ni wɔhiɛ kɔ̃ wɔnanemɛi anɔ.

english_verse: My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself.
translation_verse: Anyɛmimɛi, kɛji mɔ ko miitɔ̃ ni amɔ lɛ lɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛ ji mumɔŋ gbɔmɛi lɛ nyɛsaa nakai mɔ lɛ ekoŋŋ kɛ mlijɔlɛ mumɔ; ni ole ohe nɔ kwɛmɔ koni bo hu akaka bo.

english_verse: You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.
translation_verse: Nyɛjatsui lɛ nyɛkpeekpea nyɛhe kɛterea, ni nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ nyɛaatsɔ nyɛye Kristo mla lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛji efeɔ mɔ ko akɛ mɔ ko ji lɛ be mli ni ejeee mɔ ko lɛ eeshishiu ehe.

english_verse: Do your own work well, and then you will have something to be proud of. But don't compare yourself with others.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aka lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enitsumɔ ekwɛ, ni no dani eeena nɔ ko yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli kɛkɛ ni eshwã efɔ̃ nɔ, ni jeee mɔ kroko nɔ́ nɔ.

english_verse: We each must carry our own load.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaatere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ejatsu.

english_verse: Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ekɛ etsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ aja nibii kpakpai fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ.

english_verse: You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant.
translation_verse: Nyɛkalakaa nyɛhe, Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aliii lɛ. Ejaakɛ nɔ pɛ ni gbɔmɔ duɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ ebaakpa.

english_verse: If you follow your selfish desires, you will harvest destruction, but if you follow the Spirit, you will harvest eternal life.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɔ ni duɔ nii yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eheloo mli lɛ, eheloo lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ebaakpa fitemɔ kɛjɛ; shi mɔ ni duɔ nii yɛ Mumɔ mli lɛ, Mumɔ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ebaakpa naanɔ wala kɛjɛ.

english_verse: Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛkahãa ekpakpafeemɔ miitɔa wɔ, ejaakɛ kɛ wɔnijiaŋ ejeee wui lɛ, wɔbaakpa hu yɛ be ni sa mli.

english_verse: We should help people whenever we can, especially if they are followers of the Lord. Final Warnings
translation_verse: Belɛ be mli ni hegbɛ yɔɔ hã wɔ nɛɛ, nyɛhãa wɔfea mɛi fɛɛ ejurɔ, shi titri lɛ mɛi ni ji hemɔkɛyeli lɛ webii lɛ. Naagbee kɔkɔbɔɔ kɛ ŋamɔ

english_verse: You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
translation_verse: Nyɛkwɛa ni ŋmaa okadii adaramɔ ni mikɛŋma nyɛ wolo kɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ minine!

english_verse: Those people who are telling you to get circumcised are only trying to show how important they are. And they don't want to get into trouble for preaching about the cross of Christ.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni taoɔ akɛ amɛ hiɛ aba nyam yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ, amɛ, amɛnyɛɔ nyɛnɔ ni afolɔ nyɛ ketia, be ni afee kɛkɛ ni akawa amɛyi yɛ Kristo sɛŋmɔtso lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: They are circumcised, but they don't obey the Law of Moses. All they want is to brag about having you circumcised.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛi ni afolɔ amɛ ketia lɛ diɛŋtsɛ tete yeee Mla lɛ nɔ; shi moŋ amɛmiitao akɛ afolɔ nyɛ ketia, koni amɛshwã amɛfɔ̃ nyɛheloo gbɛfaŋ nii nɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
translation_verse: Shi mi lɛ, akagbale mi fɔ̃ŋfɔ̃ akɛ mashwã mafɔ̃ nɔ ko nɔ akɛ ja wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo sɛŋmɔtso lɛ, nɔ nɔ ni atsɔ̃ asɛŋ je lɛ ahã mi, ni mi hu asɛŋ mi ahã je lɛ.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ ketiafoo jeee nɔ ko, ni asaŋ foo hu jeee nɔ ko, shi moŋ nɔ ni ji nɔ ko ji bɔɔnɔ hee tsɔ̃mɔ.

english_verse: If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
translation_verse: Ni mɛi abɔ ni aaanyiɛ yɛ nɛkɛ jeŋba he mla nɛɛ naa lɛ, hejɔlɛ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ aba amɛ kɛ “Nyɔŋmɔ Israel” lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
translation_verse: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko akagba minaa dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ mihiɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu pilamɔ okadii lɛ yɛ migbɔmɔtso lɛ he.

english_verse: My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
translation_verse: WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛmumɔ lɛ ahi shi, anyɛmimɛi. Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus. To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Paulo ni ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa lɛ ŋma yahã mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni ji heyelɔi yɛ Kristo Yesu mli ni yɔɔ Efeso lɛ:

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
translation_verse: Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ! Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ yɛ mumɔŋ dromɔ keenii ahewɔ

english_verse: Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ for the spiritual blessings that Christ has brought us from heaven!
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ lɛ, mɔ ni kɛ mumɔŋ jɔɔmɔ ejɔɔ wɔ yɛ ŋwɛiniiaŋ yɛ Kristo mli lɛ.

english_verse: Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ nɛɛ, lɛ ehala wɔ yɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ emli dani ato jeŋ shishi, koni wɔfee krɔŋkrɔŋ ni wɔhe akahi kpa ko yɛ ehiɛ.

english_verse: God was kind and decided that Christ would choose us to be God's own adopted children.
translation_verse: Ni ejɛ suɔmɔ mli ejie wɔ eto ni wɔtsɔ̃mɔ ebii yɛ Yesu Kristo hewɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni sa ehiɛ yɛ esuɔmɔ naa lɛ;

english_verse: God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
translation_verse: koni akɛjie edromɔ ni ekɛduro wɔ yɛ mɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ lɛ mli lɛ anunyam lɛ yi.

english_verse: and by what Christ has done, God has shown us his own mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Ehã wɔle eyiŋtoo ni ji teemɔ sane lɛ ni ekpɛ mli eto bɔ ni sa ehiɛ yɛ Kristo mli.

english_verse: Then when the time is right, God will do all he has planned, and Christ will bring together everything in heaven and on earth.
translation_verse: Ebaahã egbɛjianɔtoo lɛ aba mli yɛ be ni sa lɛ mli, koni eŋɔ nibii fɛɛ eto yitso kome shishi yɛ Kristo mli, nii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.

english_verse: He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him.
translation_verse: bɔ ni afee ni wɔ mɛi ni wɔtsɔ̃ hiɛ wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ efɔ̃ Kristo nɔ lɛ, wɔtsɔ̃mɔ enunyam lɛ yijiemɔ.

english_verse: Christ also brought you the truth, which is the good news about how you can be saved. You put your faith in Christ and were given the promised Holy Spirit to show you belong to God.
translation_verse: Lɛ emli akɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni awo he shi lɛ sɔo nyɛ hu nyɛnaa yɛ be ni nyɛnu anɔkwale lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ni ji yiwalaheremɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ ni nyɛhe nyɛye lɛ.

english_verse: The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised. Paul's Prayer
translation_verse: Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ji wɔgboshinii lɛ ayibaafoonɔ kɛyashi Nyɔŋmɔ aaakpɔ̃ mɛi ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enii lɛ hã enunyam lɛ yijiemɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ ni jeɔ kpo yɛ Kristo mli lɛ

english_verse: I have heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, mi hu, be ni minu nyɛhemɔkɛyeli ni nyɛyɔɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu mli lɛ kɛ nyɛsuɔmɔ ni nyɛkɛsumɔɔ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ he lɛ,

english_verse: So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers.
translation_verse: mifɔ̃ɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shidaa, shi mikaiɔ nyɛ yɛ misɔlemɔi amli,

english_verse: I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God.
translation_verse: koni wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni ji anunyam Tsɛ lɛ ahã nyɛ nilee kɛ kpojiemɔ mumɔ yɛ le ni nyɛaale lɛ jogbaŋŋ lɛ mli.

english_verse: My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.
translation_verse: Nyɛmligbɛ hiŋmɛii anɔ atse, koni nyɛna nyɛle nɔ ni ji hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni yɔɔ etsɛmɔ lɛ mli, kɛ egboshinii lɛ anunyam lɛ falɛ yɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi amli,

english_verse: I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used
translation_verse: kɛ nɔ ni ji ehewalɛ lɛ dalɛ ni tekeɔ nɔ babaoo hãa wɔ mɛi ni wɔheɔ wɔyeɔ lɛ yɛ enyɛmɔ hewalɛ nitsumɔ lɛ naa lɛ.

english_verse: when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven.
translation_verse: Hewalɛ nitsumɔ nɛɛ etsu yɛ Kristo mli, be ni etee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ, ni ekɛ lɛ ta eninejurɔ nɔ yɛ ŋwɛiniiaŋ,

english_verse: There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well.
translation_verse: yɛ onukpayeli kɛ hegbɛ kɛ hewalɛ lɛ nɔyeli fɛɛ kɛ gbɛi fɛɛ gbɛi ni awo, jeee be nɛ be nɛɛ mli kɛkɛ, shi be ni baaba lɛ mli hu lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything.
translation_verse: Ni ekɛ nibii fiaa ewo enajiaŋshi, ni ekɛ lɛ efee nibii fɛɛ yitso ehã asafo lɛ

english_verse: The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.
translation_verse: ni ji egbɔmɔtso lɛ kɛ lɛ mɔ ni ewoɔ mɛi fɛɛ obɔ̃ yɛ nii fɛɛ mli lɛ obɔ̃yimɔ lɛ.

english_verse: In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God.
translation_verse: Nyɛ hu kulɛ gbohii ji nyɛ yɛ nyɛ nɔtɔmɔi kɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ amli.

english_verse: You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛnyiɛ yɛ mli sa yɛ no je nɛɛŋ su lɛ naa, yɛ lumɔ ni yɔɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli hewalɛ lɛ ni ji mumɔ ni tsuɔ nii amrɔ nɛɛ yɛ toigbele bii amli lɛ naa.

english_verse: Once we were also ruled by the selfish desires of our bodies and minds. We had made God angry, and we were going to be punished like everyone else.
translation_verse: Amɛteŋ wɔ fɛɛ hu wɔhi wɔba wɔjeŋ yɛ sa yɛ wɔheloo akɔnɔi lɛ amli, ni wɔtsu nii ni heloo kɛ jwɛŋmɔ sumɔɔ lɛ, ni wɔji bii ni Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu yɔɔ wɔnɔ yɛ wɔfɔmɔsu lɛ naa, tamɔ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you.
translation_verse: ni wɔ ni kulɛ gbohii ji wɔ yɛ nɔtɔmɔi amli lɛ, etsiɛ wɔ kɛ Kristo fɛɛ hiɛ, dromɔ akɛhere nyɛyiwala!

english_verse: God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven.
translation_verse: Ni etee wɔ kɛ lɛ shi, ni eŋɔ wɔ kɛ lɛ fɛɛ eta ŋwɛiniiaŋ yɛ lɛ Kristo Yesu lɛ mli.

english_verse: God did this so in the future world he could show how truly good and kind he is to us because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: Efee enɛ koni bei ni baaba lɛ amli lɛ ejie lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edromɔ falɛ ni teke nɔ lɛ kpo yɛ emli ni hi hã wɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ mli.

english_verse: You were saved by faith in God, who treats us much better than we deserve. This is God's gift to you, and not anything you have done on your own.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ dromɔ akɛhere nyɛyiwala kɛtsɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ, ni enɛ lɛ, jeee nyɛmli ejɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ nɔkeenɔ ni,

english_verse: It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about.
translation_verse: jeee nitsumɔi amli ejɛ koni mɔ ko akashwã.

english_verse: God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are. United by Christ
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ enine naa nitsumɔnii ji wɔ, abɔ wɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli ahã nitsumɔi kpakpai ni Nyɔŋmɔ esaa eto koni wɔnyiɛ yɛ mli lɛ. Kristo mli lɛ Yudafonyo kɛ jeŋmajiaŋnyo efee ekome

english_verse: Don't forget that you are Gentiles. In fact, you used to be called “uncircumcised” by those who take pride in being circumcised.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkaia akɛ nyɛ ni sa ni nyɛ ji jeŋmajiaŋbii yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ ni mɛi ni atsɛɔ amɛ ketiafolɔi ni akɛ niji folɔ amɛ ketia yɛ heloo mli lɛ tsɛɔ nyɛ foolɔi lɛ,

english_verse: At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God,
translation_verse: nyɛbɛ Kristo nakai be lɛ mli. Ni mɛi kpɔ̃ji ji nyɛ yɛ Israel maŋ biyeli gbɛfaŋ kɛ gbɔi yɛ kpãŋmɔi ni damɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoo nɔ lɛ agbɛfaŋ hu, nyɛbɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ko, ni nyɛbɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tete yɛ je nɛɛŋ.

english_verse: and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ, Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, nyɛ ni sa ni nyɛyɔɔ shɔŋŋ lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃ Kristo lá lɛ nɔ nyɛbɛŋkɛ.

english_verse: Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ lɛ ji wɔhejɔlɛ lɛ, mɔ ni ŋɔ kui enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ efee ekome, ni ekumɔ gbogbo afabaŋ ni yɔɔ teŋ ni ji nyɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace.
translation_verse: Ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eheloo gu Mla lɛ kitãi kɛ akpɔi lɛ, koni ekɛ mɛi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ abɔ gbɔmɔ hee kome yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli ni ehã hejɔlɛ aba,

english_verse: On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body.
translation_verse: ni ekpãtã amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ gbɔmɔtso kome mli yɛ sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ, nɔ nɔ ni egbe nyɛɛ lɛ yɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God.
translation_verse: Ni eba ebajaje hejɔlɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ shɔŋŋ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ hu.

english_verse: And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ enɔ wɔyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ wɔnaa gbɛ, yɛ Mumɔ kome mli, kɛyaa Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.

english_verse: You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ jeee gbɔi kɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji ji nyɛ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ananemɛi maŋbii kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii,

english_verse: You are like a building with the apostles and prophets as the foundation and with Christ as the most important stone.
translation_verse: ni atswa nyɛ ama bɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ shishitoo lɛ ni ekoŋtɛ ji Yesu Kristo lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord.
translation_verse: Emli atswa tsu muu lɛ fɛɛ afee ekome yɛ, ni eeda eefee Sɔlemɔtsu krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli;

english_verse: And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.
translation_verse: ni emli atswaa nyɛ awoɔ afee Nyɔŋmɔ shihilɛhe yɛ Mumɔ mli lɛ.

english_verse: Christ Jesus made me his prisoner, so I could help you Gentiles.
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ ni mi, Paulo, ni mi ji Kristo Yesu gboklɛfonyo hã nyɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ,

english_verse: You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you.
translation_verse: kɛji nyɛnu akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ edromɔ ehã mi hã nyɛsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ,

english_verse: In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways.
translation_verse: kpojiemɔ nɔ etsɔ̃ ehã mile teemɔ sane lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni miŋma nyɛ fioo momo lɛ.

english_verse: As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ.
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛkane lɛ, nyɛaanyɛ nyɛyoo akɛ mina Kristo teemɔ sane lɛ shishi.

english_verse: No one knew about this mystery until God's Spirit told it to his holy apostles and prophets.
translation_verse: Teemɔ sane nɛɛ, yinɔi ni eho lɛ mli lɛ ahãaa gbɔmɛiabii ale, tamɔ bɔ ni agbɛnɛ ajie kpo atsɔ̃ɔ ebɔfoi krɔŋkrɔŋi kɛ gbalɔi lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Mumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.
translation_verse: No ji akɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ hu niyelɔi lɛ ekomɛi kɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii lɛ ekomɛi kɛ mɛi ni awo amɛ shi yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ hu ekomɛi ji amɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Sanekpakpa lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news.
translation_verse: No he sɔ̃ɔlɔ ji mi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ nikee nii ni atsɔ̃ ehewalɛ nitsumɔ nɔ akɛhã mi lɛ naa,

english_verse: I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured.
translation_verse: mi ni mi ji bibioo fe hetselɔi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, akɛ nɛkɛ dromɔ nɛɛ ehã mi, akɛ mijaje Kristo nifalɛ ni anyɛɛɛ shishi ana lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ jeŋmaji lɛ.

english_verse: God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind.
translation_verse: Ni mihã mɛi fɛɛ ana teemɔ sane lɛ he gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ faŋŋ, teemɔ sane ni akɛtee kɛjɛ yinɔi ni eho lɛ amli kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni bɔ nii fɛɛ lɛ mli lɛ,

english_verse: Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.
translation_verse: koni agbɛnɛ atsɔ̃ asafo lɛ nɔ ahã onukpai kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ hegbɛ yɛ ŋwɛiniiaŋ lɛ ale Nyɔŋmɔ nilee ni jieɔ ehe kpo yɛ gbɛi srɔtoi pii anɔ lɛ.

english_verse: God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ fee nii nɛɛ yɛ enaanɔ yiŋ ni eto yɛ Kristo Yesu, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, mli lɛ naa.

english_verse: Christ now gives us courage and confidence, so we can come to God by faith.
translation_verse: Kristo Yesu nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ wɔtsɔ̃ ni wɔna ekãa ni wɔkɛyaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kɛ hewalɛ.

english_verse: This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you. Christ's Love for Us
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, miikpa nyɛ fai, ni nyɛnijiaŋ akaje wui yɛ mimanehului ni minaa yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛnunyam ni. Kristo Suɔmɔ

english_verse: I kneel in prayer to the Father.
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ ni miyaa minakutsei anaa yɛ Tsɛ lɛ hiɛ,

english_verse: All beings in heaven and on earth receive their life from him.
translation_verse: mɔ mli ni nɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ akɛ “tsɛ” yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ jɛ lɛ.

english_verse: God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers
translation_verse: Ni yɛ enunyam falɛ naa lɛ ehã nyɛtsɔ̃ eMumɔ lɛ nɔ nyɛhe awa kpiŋtiŋŋ yɛ nyɛmli gbɔmɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ,

english_verse: and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love.
translation_verse: ni atsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ ni Kristo ahi shi yɛ nyɛtsuii amli, ni nyɛshishifã amɔ shi ni nyɛma shi shiŋŋ yɛ suɔmɔ mli.

english_verse: I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep.
translation_verse: Miisɔle ni nyɛna hewalɛ, ni nyɛkɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ ayoo Kristo suɔmɔ lɛ lɛɛmɔ kɛ ekɛlɛ kɛ enɔkwɔlɛ kɛ emlikwɔlɛ lɛ.

english_verse: I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛle esuɔmɔ ni teke nilee fɛɛ lɛ, koni Nyɔŋmɔ obɔ̃yimɔ lɛ ayimɔ nyɛ fɛɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃.

english_verse: I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.
translation_verse: lɛ aŋɔ anunyam ahã yɛ asafo lɛ mli kɛ Kristo Yesu mli yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ kɛyashi naanɔi anaanɔ. Amen!

english_verse: As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mi ni mi ji gboklɛfonyo yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ, miikpa nyɛ fai akɛ nyɛnyiɛ bɔ ni sa tsɛmɔ ni akɛtsɛ nyɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Always be humble and gentle. Patiently put up with each other and love each other.
translation_verse: Nyɛnyiɛa kɛ heshibaa fɛɛ kɛ kpoofeemɔ fɛɛ kɛ tsuishitoo fɛɛ ni nyɛnanaa nyɛhã nyɛhe kɛ suɔmɔ.

english_verse: Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛbɔa mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛkɛ hejɔlɛ kpãa ni fiɔ nyɛ lɛ ato ekomefeemɔ ni jɛɔ Mumɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔtso kome kɛ Mumɔ kome yɔɔ, tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni hiɛnɔkãmɔ kome ji nɔ ni yɔɔ tsɛmɔ ni atsɛ nyɛ lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: We have only one Lord, one faith, and one baptism.
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ kome, hemɔkɛyeli kome, baptisimɔ kome,

english_verse: There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ kome, mɛi fɛɛ aTsɛ kome mɔ ni yɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ nɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi fɛɛ mli ni eyɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: Christ has generously divided out his gifts to us.
translation_verse: Shi wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, akɛ dromɔ lɛ ehã lɛ yɛ Kristo nikeenii asusumɔ lɛ naa.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “When he went up to the highest place, he led away many prisoners and gave gifts to people.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Ekwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi, ni eŋɔ nomi anom, ni ekɛ nikeenii hã gbɔmɛi.”

english_verse: When it says, “he went up,” it means that Christ had been deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Shi ni akɛɛ ekwɔ lɛ, te eshishiŋ, kɛjeee shi hu ekpeleke kɛtee shikpɔŋ lɛ shishiniiaŋ tsutsu lɛ?

english_verse: This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kpeleke shi lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ hu ji mɔ ni kwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛii fɛɛ ayiteŋ, koni eyi nii fiaa obɔ̃ lɛ.

english_verse: Christ chose some of us to be apostles, prophets, missionaries, pastors, and teachers,
translation_verse: Ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ehã mɛi komɛi tsɔ̃mɔ bɔfoi, mɛi komɛi lɛ gbalɔi, mɛi komɛi hu Sanekpakpashiɛlɔi, ni mɛi komɛi hu nɔkwɛlɔi kɛ tsɔɔlɔi.

english_verse: so his people would learn to serve and his body would grow strong.
translation_verse: Efee enɛ koni akɛsaa hetselɔi lɛ ahã sɔ̃ɔmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ kɛ Kristo gbɔmɔtso lɛ tswaa,

english_verse: This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
translation_verse: kɛyashi beyinɔ ni wɔ fɛɛ wɔɔshɛ ekomefeemɔ ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ ehe nilee mli lɛ he. Ni wɔfee nuu ni eye emuu yɛ Kristo emuuyeli lɛ susumɔ naa;

english_verse: We must stop acting like children. We must not let deceitful people trick us by their false teachings, which are like winds that toss us around from place to place.
translation_verse: koni wɔkakã he wɔfee abifabii ni tsɔ̃ɔmɔ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ hosoɔ amɛ tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ hosoɔ nii, ni ekpalaa amɛ kɛyaa kɛbaa yɛ gbɔmɛi aŋaafɔŋtoo kɛ kutumpɔo ni akɛshishiuɔ mɛi lɛ naa.

english_verse: Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head
translation_verse: Shi moŋ wɔfee anɔkwafoi yɛ suɔmɔ mli, ni wɔdara yɛ nibii fɛɛ gbɛfaŋ tamɔ Kristo ni ji yitso lɛ.

english_verse: of the body. Christ holds it together and makes all of its parts work perfectly, as it grows and becomes strong because of love. The Old Life and the New Life
translation_verse: Lɛ emli gbɔmɔtso muu lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ talɔ fɛɛ talɔ ni ahã lɛ lɛ nɔ emɔmɔɔ ehe eshimɔshimɔɔ ehe nɔ yɛ. Ni ehe mɔɔ ehe, ni kɛ henɔ fɛɛ henɔ miitsu enii jogbaŋŋ lɛ, ehãa gbɔmɔtso lɛ daa, ni emaa ehe yɛ suɔmɔ mli. Wala hee yɛ Kristo mli

english_verse: As a follower of the Lord, I order you to stop living like stupid, godless people.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ ni miima nɔ mi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli, akɛ nyɛkanyiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni jeŋbii lɛ nyiɛɔ yɛ amɛyaka jwɛŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ dɔŋŋ,

english_verse: Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right,
translation_verse: ejaakɛ amɛjwɛŋmɔ mli ewo duŋ. Ni mɛi kpɔ̃ji ji amɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wala gbɛfaŋ, akɛni nilee ekaaa amɛ ni amɛtsui hu ekpliŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and they are so greedy they do all kinds of indecent things.
translation_verse: Amɛbɛ henumɔnii dɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ amɛŋɔ amɛhe amɛhã nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ, ni amɛkɛ hiɛjoomɔ tsuɔ nyaŋemɔ nii fɛɛ kwa.

english_verse: But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him.
translation_verse: kɛji eyɛ mli akɛ nyɛnu ehe, ni atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nii yɛ emli hu, tamɔ bɔ ni ji anɔkwale yɛ Yesu mli lɛ,

english_verse: You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits.
translation_verse: akɛ nyɛshɛ nɔ ni ji gbɔmɔ momo yɛ nyɛsa jeŋba lɛ naa gbɔmɔ ni efite yɛ shishiumɔ sɛɛdii lɛ anaa lɛ nyɛfɔ̃.

english_verse: Let the Spirit change your way of thinking
translation_verse: Ni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi hei yɛ mumɔ ni nyɛkɛjwɛŋɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ,

english_verse: and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy. Rules for the New Life
translation_verse: ni nyɛwo gbɔmɔ hee ni abɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ subaŋ nɔ yɛ anɔkwa jalɛ kɛ hetsemɔ mli, tamɔ atade.

english_verse: We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛshɛa amale nyɛfɔa ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enaanyo awie anɔkwale, ejaakɛ gbɔmɔtso kome henii ji wɔ.

english_verse: Don't get so angry that you sin. Don't go to bed angry
translation_verse: Nyɛmli afũa, shi nyɛkafea esha; hulu akanyɔ shi yɛ nyɛmlifu lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: and don't give the devil a chance.
translation_verse: Asaŋ nyɛkaŋmɛa abonsam lɛ gbɛ.

english_verse: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni juɔ lɛ ekaju dɔŋŋ, shi ebɔ mɔdɛŋ ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eniji atsu nitsumɔ kpakpa, koni ena nɔ ko ni ekɛhã mɔ ni ehia lɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.
translation_verse: Wiemɔ sha ko wiemɔ sha ko akaje nyɛnaa kwraa; shi moŋ wiemɔ ni hi ni ehia koni ehã mɔ nane amɔ shi ni akɛduro mɛi ni nuɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't make God's Spirit sad. The Spirit makes you sure that someday you will be free from your sins.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛkafea Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nidɔɔnii; lɛ emli asɔo nyɛnaa yɛ ato kpɔ̃mɔ gbi lɛ.

english_verse: Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude.
translation_verse: Nyɛhãa mlijoomɔ kɛ mlila kɛ mlifu kɛ blɔmɔ kɛ oshekuyeli kɛ efɔŋ fɛɛ sɛɛ afoa yɛ nyɛteŋ.

english_verse: Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛmli ahia ahãhãa nyɛhe, nyɛmusuŋ atsɔ̃tsɔ̃a nyɛ yɛ nyɛhe, nyɛkɛfafaa nyɛhe, tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛfa nyɛ yɛ Kristo mli lɛ.

english_verse: Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛfea nyɛhe mɛi ni kaseɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, akɛ bii ni asumɔɔ.

english_verse: Let love be your guide. Christ loved us and offered his life for us as a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛnyiɛa yɛ suɔmɔ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni Kristo hu sumɔ wɔ ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hã yɛ wɔhewɔ akɛ nikeenii kɛ afɔle ni akɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ ni jeɔ ŋma krɔŋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You are God's people, so don't let it be said that any of you are immoral or indecent or greedy.
translation_verse: Shi ajwamãŋbɔɔ kɛ nyaŋemɔ nitsumɔ fɛɛ loo hiɛjoomɔ lɛ akatsĩ tã tete yɛ nyɛteŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni sa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi.

english_verse: Don't use dirty or foolish or filthy words. Instead, say how thankful you are.
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ akatsĩ hiɛgbejianitsumɔ kɛ kwashiai awiemɔ kɛ fɛoyeli ni ji nibii ni esaaa lɛ tã yɛ nyɛteŋ, shi moŋ nyɛ daa Nyɔŋmɔ shi.

english_verse: Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God. Living as People of Light
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea enɛ akɛ, ajwamãŋbɔlɔ ko ajwamãŋbɔlɔ ko loo hiɛjoolɔ ko ni ji wɔŋjalɔ bɛ gbɛfaŋ nɔ yɛ Kristo kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.

english_verse: Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things.
translation_verse: Nyɛkahãa mɔ ko kɛ wiemɔi foji miishishiua nyɛ, ejaakɛ nii nɛɛ ahewɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu baa toigbelebii lɛ anɔ lɛ.

english_verse: So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
translation_verse: Hewɔ lɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛhe akabɔa amɛhe.

english_verse: You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ sa lɛ duŋ ji nyɛ, shi agbɛnɛ lɛ nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ la yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli; nyɛnyiɛa tamɔ la bii.

english_verse: and make your light shine. Be good and honest and truthful,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ la lɛ yibii jeɔ kpo yɛ ekpakpafeemɔ kɛ jalɛ kɛ anɔkwale fɛɛ mli.

english_verse: as you try to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛkaa nyɛkwɛa ni nyɛna nɔ ni sa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ;

english_verse: Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are.
translation_verse: ni nyɛkatsua duŋ nitsumɔi ni wooo yibii lɛ eko, shi nyɛjiea amɛ shi.

english_verse: It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nibii ni amɛfeɔ amɛteɔ lɛ, eyɛ hiɛgbele akɛ aaatsi tã tete.

english_verse: Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say, “Wake up from your sleep and rise from death. Then Christ will shine on you.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Ohiɛ atsɛ̃, bo mɔ ni owɔɔ lɛ, ni ote shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ ni Kristo aaatso ahã bo!”

english_verse: Act like people with good sense and not like fools.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ bɔ ni nyɛaanyiɛ nyɛhã, jeee tamɔ mɛi ni leee nii, shi moŋ tamɔ nilelɔi,

english_verse: These are evil times, so make every minute count.
translation_verse: mɛi ni tsuɔ amɛbe he nii, ejaakɛ gbii nɛɛ gbii fɔ̃ji ni.

english_verse: Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkafea nyɛhe mɛi ni bɛ yitsoŋ, shi moŋ nyɛyoa nii ni ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ.

english_verse: Don't destroy yourself by getting drunk, but let the Spirit fill your life.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛkatɔrɔa dãa, nɔ mli ni yakayaka jeŋba yɔɔ lɛ, shi moŋ nyɛyimɔa obɔ̃ kɛ Mumɔ lɛ,

english_verse: When you meet together, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, as you praise the Lord with all your heart.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ nyɛhe awiewiea yɛ saŋkutswai kɛ yijiemɔ lalai kɛ mumɔŋ lalai amli, nyɛlaa ni nyɛtswaa saŋku yɛ nyɛtsuii amli nyɛhãa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything. Wives and Husbands
translation_verse: Nyɛdaa Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi daa yɛ nii fiaa hewɔ yɛ wɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbɛi mli,

english_verse: A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛ yeigbãyei lɛ, nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛwumɛi lɛ, tamɔ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nyɛfeɔ nyɛhãa.

english_verse: A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wu lɛ ji ŋa lɛ yitso, tamɔ bɔ ni Kristo hu ji asafo lɛ yitso, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ji gbɔmɔtso ni ji asafo lɛ yiwalaherelɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Wives should always put their husbands first, as the church puts Christ first.
translation_verse: Shi tamɔ bɔ ni asafo lɛ baa ehe shi ehãa Kristo lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ yei lɛ hu afee ahã amɛwumɛi lɛ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli.

english_verse: A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it.
translation_verse: Nyɛ wumɛi lɛ, nyɛsumɔa nyɛŋamɛi, tamɔ bɔ ni Kristo hu sumɔ asafo lɛ ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hã yɛ ehewɔ,

english_verse: He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water.
translation_verse: koni ekɛ hejuu yɛ nu mli kɛ wiemɔ atsuu ehe ni ehã efee krɔŋkrɔŋ,

english_verse: Christ did this, so he would have a glorious and holy church, without faults or spots or wrinkles or any other flaws.
translation_verse: koni eŋɔ lɛ edamɔ shi ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe akɛ anunyam asafo ni kpa ko loo nɔ kũaikũai ko loo nakai nɔ ko bɛ ehe, shi moŋ efee krɔŋkrɔŋ ni shwamɔ ko bɛ ehe lɛ.

english_verse: In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself.
translation_verse: Nakai sa akɛ wumɛi hu asumɔ amɛŋamɛi, tamɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbɔmɔtsei. Mɔ ni sumɔɔ eŋa lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe esumɔɔ.

english_verse: None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɔ ko enyɛko lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eheloo dã, shi moŋ elɛɔ lɛ ni ehiɛɔ lɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ asafo lɛ;

english_verse: because we are each part of his body.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ egbɔmɔtso henii ji wɔ.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.”
translation_verse: “Enɛ hewɔ ni nuu aaashi etsɛ kɛ enyɛ, ni eeekpɛtɛ eŋa he, ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ heloo kome.”

english_verse: This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church.
translation_verse: Teemɔ sane ni tsii nɛ; mi lɛ mikɛtoɔ Kristo kɛ asafo lɛ he.

english_verse: So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
translation_verse: Shi ekɔɔ nyɛ hu nyɛhe ekomekome; esa akɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ asumɔ eŋa, tamɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe; koni ŋa lɛ ashe ewu.

english_verse: Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says,
translation_verse: Nyɛ bii lɛ, nyɛboa nyɛfɔlɔi lɛ atoi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli; ejaakɛ enɛ ja.

english_verse: “Obey your father and your mother,
translation_verse: “Wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ,” no ji klɛŋklɛŋ kitã ni hiɛ shiwoo akɛ,

english_verse: and you will have a long and happy life.”
translation_verse: “Koni ahi ahã bo, ni otsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. Raise them properly. Teach them and instruct them about the Lord. Slaves and Masters
translation_verse: Ni nyɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ, nyɛkawoa nyɛbii amli la, shi moŋ nyɛlɛa amɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tsɔsemɔ kɛ ewiemɔkɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli. Tsuji kɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi

english_verse: Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ.
translation_verse: Nyɛ tsuji lɛ, nyɛboa nyɛheloo gbɛfaŋ nuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ atoi kɛ gbeyeishemɔ kɛ hekpokpomɔ kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ, tamɔ akɛ nyɛmiifee nyɛhã Kristo;

english_verse: Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do.
