translation_verse: jeee kɛ hiɛiaŋhiɛiaŋ sɔ̃ɔmɔ tamɔ mɛi ni taoɔ gbɔmɛi ahiɛsalɛ, shi tamɔ Kristo tsuji ni jieɔ amɛmusuŋ amɛfeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii,

english_verse: Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people.
translation_verse: ni amɛkɛ tsuijurɔ sɔ̃mɔɔ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ amɛsɔ̃mɔɔ, shi jeee gbɔmɛi.

english_verse: You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛle akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, nyɔŋ ji lɛ jio, odehe jio, nɔ ekpakpa ni efeɔ lɛ, no he nyɔmɔwoo ebaana kɛjɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ.

english_verse: Slave owners, you must treat your slaves with this same respect. Don't threaten them. They have the same Master in heaven that you do, and he doesn't have favorites. The Fight against Evil
translation_verse: Ni nyɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ, nyɛfea amɛ nakai nɔŋŋ ni nyɛfɔ̃a amɛhe gbeyeiwoo ni nyɛle akɛ nyɛ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ yɛ ŋwɛi, ni gbɔmɛi ahiɛiaŋkwɛmɔ ko bɛ egbɛfaŋ. Nyɔŋmɔ tawuunii lɛ fɛɛ

english_verse: Finally, let the mighty strength of the Lord make you strong.
translation_verse: Naagbee lɛ, minyɛmimɛi, nyɛhe awaa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ ehewalɛ nyɛmɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks.
translation_verse: Nyɛwoa Nyɔŋmɔ tawuunii lɛ fɛɛ, koni nyɛnyɛ abonsam ŋaatsɔ̃i lɛ ana nyɛdamɔ.

english_verse: We are not fighting against humans. We are fighting against forces and authorities and against rulers of darkness and powers in the spiritual world.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ jeee gbɔmɛi wɔkɛna lɛ, shi moŋ wɔkɛ onukpayelii kɛ hegbɛi kɛ je nɛɛŋ duŋ lɛ mli lumɛi lɛ kɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji ni yɔɔ ŋwɛiniiaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɔlɔa Nyɔŋmɔ tawuunii lɛ fɛɛ, koni nyɛnyɛ amɛnaa nyɛkpee yɛ gbi fɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni be ni nyɛgbe fɛɛ naa lɛ nyɛnyɛ shi nyɛdamɔ.

english_verse: Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛdamɔa shi ni nyɛkɛ anɔkwale afia nyɛhɛ ni nyɛwo jalɛ dama lɛ

english_verse: Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
translation_verse: nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ nyɛhiɛa hemɔkɛyeli tsɛŋ lɛ mli; no nyɛkɛaanyɛ mɔfɔŋ lɛ gãimlibii ni tsoɔ lɛ fɛɛ nyɛgbe lɛ;

english_verse: Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.
translation_verse: ni nyɛŋɔa yiwalaheremɔ akɛ dadefai, kɛ mumɔŋ klante ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ Wiemɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Never stop praying, especially for others. Always pray by the power of the Spirit. Stay alert and keep praying for God's people.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛkɛ sɔlemɔ kɛ faikpamɔ fɛɛ asɔlea be fɛɛ be yɛ mumɔ mli, ni enɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛsaraa, ni nyɛkãa he daa nyɛkpaa fai nyɛhãa krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ fɛɛ

english_verse: Pray that I will be given the message to speak and that I may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news.
translation_verse: kɛ mi hu, koni kɛ migbele minaa lɛ, akɛ wiemɔ awo minaa ni mikɛ ekãa ajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ mli teemɔ sane lɛ

english_verse: I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should. Final Greetings
translation_verse: ni mitsuɔ he nii akɛ bɔfo yɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ mli nɛɛ. Nyɛkpaa fai koni yɛ ejajemɔ lɛ mli lɛ mawie kɛ ekãa bɔ ni sa akɛ mawie lɛ. Naagbee ŋamɔ

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower!
translation_verse: Hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛmimɛi lɛ, kɛ suɔmɔ kɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni jɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ lɛ.

english_verse: May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Dromɔ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni sumɔɔ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo kɛ suɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ ahi shi. Amen!

english_verse: From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus. To all God's people who belong to Christ Jesus at Philippi and to all your bishops and deacons.
translation_verse: Paulo kɛ Timoteo, Yesu Kristo tsuji lɛ; ŋma yahã mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni yɔɔ Yesu Kristo mli yɛ Filipi lɛ kɛ amɛnɔkwɛlɔi kɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
translation_verse: Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ! Paulo sɔle hã Filipibii lɛ

english_verse: Every time I think of you, I thank my God.
translation_verse: Midaa miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi be fɛɛ be ni mikaiɔ nyɛ

english_verse: And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy.
translation_verse: yɛ midaa faikpamɔi fɛɛ ni mikpaa mihãa nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ mli, ni mikɛ miishɛɛ kpaa fai,

english_verse: This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it.
translation_verse: yɛ wa ni nyɛwa yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ gbɛfaŋ kɛjɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ kɛbashi be nɛ lɛ hewɔ;

english_verse: God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
translation_verse: ni miŋɔ mihiɛ mifɔ̃ enɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ, akɛ mɔ ni bɔ̃i nitsumɔ kpakpa yɛ nyɛmli lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ eeekã he kɛyashi eeegbe naa yɛ Yesu Kristo Gbi lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: You have a special place in my heart. So it is only natural for me to feel the way I do. All of you have helped in the work God has given me, as I defend the good news and tell about it here in jail.
translation_verse: Eja akɛ mijwɛŋɔ enɛ yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhe, ejaakɛ nyɛkã mitsui nɔ, nyɛ ni yɛ migboklɛi kɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hefãmɔ kɛ enɔmimaa fɛɛ mli lɛ nyɛ kɛ mi fɛɛ lɛ dromɔ lɛ niyelɔi ji wɔ lɛ.

english_verse: God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni mikɛ Yesu Kristo mlitsɔlɛ lɛ shweɔ nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ji midasefonyo.

english_verse: I pray that your love will keep on growing and you will fully know and understand
translation_verse: Ni enɛ he fai mikpaa, akɛ nyɛsuɔmɔ lɛ afa kɛya nɔ, ni eteke nɔ yɛ nilee kɛ sɛɛyoomɔ fɛɛ gbɛfaŋ

english_verse: how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day,
translation_verse: ni nyɛyoo nii ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ, koni nyɛfee krɔŋŋ ni shwamɔ ko akahi nyɛhe kɛyashi Kristo Gbi lɛ nɔ;

english_verse: Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God. What Life Means to Paul
translation_verse: ni nyɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ jalɛ yibii ni awoɔ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ lɛ, hã Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam kɛ yijiemɔ. Kristo ji wala, ni gbele lɛ sɛɛnamɔ ni

english_verse: My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Shi, anyɛmimɛi, miisumɔ akɛ nyɛle akɛ saji ni ba minɔ lɛ ehã Sanekpakpa lɛ eshwere moŋ.

english_verse: The Roman guards and all the others know I am here in jail because I serve Christ.
translation_verse: Ni Asaŋ ehã migboklɛi lɛ eje shi faŋŋ yɛ Kaisare asraafoi amɔ̃ɔ lɛ mli fɛɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ, akɛ Kristo hewɔ awo mi tsuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help.
translation_verse: Mɛi komɛi lɛ, hetsɛ̃ kɛ bei hewɔ amɛshiɛɔ Kristo lɛ; shi mɛi komɛi hu kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kpakpa shiɛɔ.

english_verse: They love Christ and know I am here to defend the good news about him.
translation_verse: Mɛnɛɛmɛi jɛɔ suɔmɔ mli shiɛɔ, ejaakɛ amɛle akɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hefãmɔ lɛ hewɔ ni mikã biɛ nɛɛ.

english_verse: But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail.
translation_verse: Shi mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, amɛkɛ mligbalamɔ mumɔ shiɛɔ Kristo, ni jeee krɔŋŋ ni, shi moŋ amɛjwɛŋmɔ ji akɛ amɛtee amanehulu shi amɛwo mi yɛ migboklɛi lɛ amli.

english_verse: But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad. I will keep on being glad,
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mɛni? Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, kwa akwaa jio, anɔkwale naa jio, Kristo kɛ̃ ashiɛɔ lɛ, ni enɛ hewɔ lɛ miyɛ miishɛɛ. Ni asaŋ mana miishɛɛ,

english_verse: because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ mile akɛ enɛ baatsɔ̃ miyiwalaheremɔ yɛ nyɛfaikpamɔ kɛ Yesu Kristo Mumɔ lɛ yelikɛbuamɔ naa.

english_verse: I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Migbɛkwɛmɔ kɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ kɛkɛ ji akɛ mihiɛ akagbo yɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko mli, shi moŋ, bɔ ni afeɔ daa lɛ, nakai agbɛnɛ hu akɛ ekãa fɛɛ aaawo Kristo hiɛ nyam yɛ migbɔmɔtso mli, yɛ wala mli jio, gbele mli jio.

english_verse: If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ yɛ migbɛfaŋ lɛ, Kristo ji wala, ni gbele lɛ sɛɛnamɔ ni.

english_verse: I don't know what to choose. I could keep on living and doing something useful.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji wala yɛ heloo nɛɛ mli hãa mitsuɔ nii ni woɔ yibii lɛ, mileee emli nɔ ni makɔ;

english_verse: It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better.
translation_verse: shi miihao yɛ nibii enyɔ nɛɛ ateŋ; miishwe ni maje mli ni mikɛ Kristo ayahi shi, ejaakɛ no hi aahu;

english_verse: But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith.
translation_verse: Ni akɛni miŋɔ mihiɛ mifɔ̃ enɛ nɔ hewɔ lɛ, mile akɛ mahi shi, ni mikɛ nyɛ fɛɛ aaahi shi, koni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ ashwere, ni nyɛna miishɛɛ yɛ mli;

english_verse: Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
translation_verse: koni nyɛmli ni baafli nyɛ yɛ mihewɔ kɛji mikɛ nyɛ bakpe ekoŋŋ lɛ ateke nɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli.

english_verse: Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
translation_verse: Nɔ kome kɛkɛ ji akɛ, nyɛbaa nyɛjeŋ bɔ ni sa Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ, koni kɛ miba mibana nyɛ jio, mikɛ nyɛ bɛ jio, manu nyɛhe akɛ nyɛdamɔ shi yɛ mumɔ kome mli, ni nyɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome miipele Sanekpakpa lɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ he,

english_verse: Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen,
translation_verse: ni nyɛkahãa henyɛlɔi lɛ miiwoa nyɛhe gbeyei yɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko mli; nyɛgbeyei ni nyɛsheŋ lɛ ji hiɛkpãtãmɔ okadi hã amɛ; shi nyɛ lɛ, eji yiwalaheremɔ okadi hã nyɛ, ni enɛ jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ.

english_verse: and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɛ lɛ aduro nyɛ yɛ Kristo hewɔ, jeee ni nyɛhe enɔ nyɛye kɛkɛ, shi moŋ akɛ nyɛna nɔ hu yɛ ehewɔ.

english_verse: You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.
translation_verse: Ni nakai ta kome lɛ ni nyɛna ni miiwu, ni agbɛnɛ nyɛnuɔ akɛ miiwu lolo lɛ, no nɔŋŋ mli nyɛhiɛ nɛɛ.

english_verse: Christ encourages you, and his love comforts you. God's Spirit unites you, and you are concerned for others.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ Kristo mli hewalɛwoo ko yɛ, kɛ suɔmɔ miishɛjemɔ ko yɛ, kɛ mumɔŋ naanyobɔɔ ko yɛ, kɛ musuŋtsɔlɛ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ ko yɛ lɛ,

english_verse: Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person.
translation_verse: nyɛhãa mimiishɛɛ lɛ ayia obɔ̃, akɛ nyɛmiijwɛŋ nɔ kome, nyɛhiɛ suɔmɔ kome, susuma kome, mumɔ kome.

english_verse: Don't be jealous or proud, but be humble and consider others more important than yourselves.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛkafea nɔ ko kɛ mligbalamɔ mumɔ loo yaka anunyam taomɔ, shi moŋ nyɛkɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ abua nyɛnanemɛi akɛ amɛfe nyɛ.

english_verse: Care about them as much as you care about yourselves
translation_verse: Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akafo enɔ mli, shi moŋ efo enaanyo nɔ mli.

english_verse: and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:
translation_verse: Nɔ ni Kristo Yesu hu jwɛŋ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ nyɛjwɛŋa.

english_verse: Christ was truly God. But he did not try to remain equal with God.
translation_verse: Lɛ mɔ ni ehiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ su moŋ, shi ebuuu hegbɔ ni ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ye lɛ akɛ nɔ ko ni sa akɛ ehiɛ mli kpɛŋŋ,

english_verse: Instead he gave up everything and became a slave, when he became like one of us.
translation_verse: Moŋ ejie efɔ̃ shi. Eŋɔ tsulɔ su efɔ̃ enɔ, Etsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ, ni enifeemɔ gbɛfaŋ hu ana lɛ akɛ gbɔmɔ.

english_verse: Christ was humble. He obeyed God and even died on a cross.
translation_verse: Eba ehe shi ni ebo toi kɛtee gbele mli, kɛtee sɛŋmɔtso nɔ gbele mli tete.

english_verse: Then God gave Christ the highest place and honored his name above all others.
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ hu ni Nyɔŋmɔ wo enɔ gojoo, ni eduro lɛ gbɛi ni ta gbɛi fɛɛ gbɛi nɔ,

english_verse: So at the name of Jesus everyone will bow down, those in heaven, on earth, and under the earth.
translation_verse: koni mɛi ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nakutso akula shi yɛ Yesu gbɛi lɛ mli;

english_verse: And to the glory of God the Father everyone will openly agree, “Jesus Christ is Lord!” Lights in the World
translation_verse: ni lilɛi fɛɛ lilɛi agba mli kpoo akɛ Yesu Kristo ji Nuŋtsɔ, kɛwo Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam. Nyɛtamɔ kanei yɛ je lɛ mli

english_verse: My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni misumɔɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛboɔ toi daa nɛɛ, jeee be ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ titri lɛ, agbɛnɛ ni mibɛ nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ hu lɛ, nyɛkɛ gbeyeishemɔ kɛ hekpokpomɔ atsua nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛyiwalaheremɔ lɛ he nii;

english_verse: God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ suɔmɔ ni aaasumɔ jio, feemɔ ni aaafee jio, Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni tsuɔ fɛɛ yɛ nyɛ mli bɔ ni lɛ etaoɔ.

english_verse: Do everything without grumbling or arguing.
translation_verse: Nyɛfea nyɛnii fɛɛ ni huhuuhu wiemɔi kɛ naataamɔ akahi mli;

english_verse: Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world,
translation_verse: koni nyɛhe akahi shwamɔ, ni nyɛfee mɛi krɔŋŋ, Nyɔŋmɔ bii ni he bɛ kpa ko yɛ yinɔ kɔɔdɔŋ ni bɛ eŋɛlɛnɔ nɛɛ mli, mɛi ateŋ ni nyɛtsoɔ tamɔ kanei yɛ je nɛɛŋ lɛ.

english_verse: as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛhiɛ wala wiemɔ lɛ mli, koni etsɔ̃ shwãanɔ ehã mi yɛ Kristo Gbi lɛ nɔ, akɛ mifoijee lɛ efeee yaka ni mideŋmegbomɔ lɛ hu efeee efolo.

english_verse: Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji afɔse milá ashwie nyɛhemɔkɛyeli ni akɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ afɔle lɛ nɔ tete lɛ, miyɛ he tsuijurɔ, ni mikɛ nyɛ fɛɛ aaana tsuijurɔ;

english_verse: In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me. Timothy and Epaphroditus
translation_verse: nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ nyɛ hu nyɛnaa tsuijurɔ, ni nyɛkɛ mi anaa tsuijurɔ. Timoteo kɛ Epafrodito

english_verse: I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you.
translation_verse: Shi mihiɛ kã nɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu mli akɛ etsɛŋ ni matsu Timoteo nyɛŋɔɔ, koni kɛji minu bɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ, ni mi hu mitsui anyɔ mimli.

english_verse: I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mibɛ mɔ ko ni kɛ mi hiɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome ni nyɛhe sane dɔɔ lɛ krɔŋŋ tamɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnii amɛpleɔ, shi jeee Kristo Yesu nii.

english_verse: But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛle etɛ naa, akɛ ekɛ mi sɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ he tamɔ bi kɛ etsɛ.

english_verse: I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mihiɛ kã enɔ, akɛ amrɔ ni mana misane lɛ naa lɛ, matsu lɛ nyɛŋɔɔ.

english_verse: And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
translation_verse: Shi miyɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli akɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ hu, etsɛŋ ni maba.

english_verse: I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me,
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ mijwɛŋ akɛ ehĩa akɛ matsu wɔnyɛmi Epafrodito, ni ji minaanyo nitsulɔ kɛ minaanyo tabilɔ kɛ nyɛbɔfo kɛ mihiamɔnii ahe sɔ̃ɔlɔ hu lɛ, nyɛŋɔɔ;

english_verse: but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ eeshwe nyɛ fɛɛ, ni akɛni nyɛnu akɛ ehe miiye hewɔ lɛ eehao.

english_verse: In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
translation_verse: Ehe ye lɛɛlɛŋ, ni ebɛŋkɛ gbele tã, shi Nyɔŋmɔ na lɛ mɔbɔ, ni jeee lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ mi hu, koni mikaye ŋkɔmɔ mito ŋkɔmɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer.
translation_verse: No hewɔ titri mikɛ oyaiyeli tsu lɛ lɛ, koni kɛ nyɛna lɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ, ni nyɛna miishɛɛ ni mi hu mikaye ŋkɔmɔ tuutu.

english_verse: Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ miishɛɛ fɛɛ aherea lɛ atuu yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli, ni nyɛbua gbɔmɛi ni tamɔ nɛkɛ akɛ mɛi ni sa woo;

english_verse: He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Kristo nitsumɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ ebɛŋkɛ gbele kwraa, ni ekɛ ehe wo osharã mli, koni ebaye nyɛnajiaŋ kɛsɔ̃mɔ mi yɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni ehiii nyɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
translation_verse: Naagbee lɛ, minyɛmimɛi, nyɛmii ashɛa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli! Akɛ maŋma nyɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, efeee mi ahuntoo, ni ehãa nyɛfeɔ shweshweeshwe.

english_verse: Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you.
translation_verse: Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ yɛ gbei lɛ ahe, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ yɛ nitsulɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ ahe, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ yɛ gbɔmɔtso henii folɔmɔ lɛ he!

english_verse: But we are the ones who are truly circumcised, because we worship by the power of God's Spirit and take pride in Christ Jesus. We don't brag about what we have done,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔ moŋ wɔji ketiafolɔi lɛ, wɔ mɛi ni wɔjaa Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ mumɔ naa, ni wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ Kristo Yesu nɔ, ni wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ gbɔmɔtso nifeemɔ nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: although I could. Others may brag about themselves, but I have more reason to brag than anyone else.
translation_verse: tsɛbelɛ miyɛ nɔ ko yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ tete ni mikɛ mihiɛ aaafɔ̃ nɔ. Kɛ efeɔ mɔ ko akɛ eyɛ nɔ ko ni ekɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ nɔ yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ lɛ, miyɛ nɔ ni fe no.

english_verse: I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ afo mi ketia, Israel fɔmɔbi kɛ Benyamin akutso lɛ mli nyo ji mi, Hebrinyo krɛdɛɛ mli Hebrinyo, ni yɛ Mla lɛ naa lɛ, Farisifonyo,

english_verse: And I was so eager I even made trouble for the church. I did everything the Law demands in order to please God.
translation_verse: ni jamɔ he hiɛdɔɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ asafo lɛ yiwalɔ ji mi, ni yɛ jalɛ ni Mla lɛ taoɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ mihe bɛ shwamɔ ko.

english_verse: But Christ has shown me that what I once thought was valuable is worthless.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ nii ni ji sɛɛnamɔ hã mi sa lɛ, yɛ Kristo hewɔ lɛ mibu amɛ akɛ shigbeemɔ.

english_verse: Nothing is as wonderful as knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. I have given up everything else and count it all as garbage. All I want is Christ
translation_verse: Anɔkwale mli lɛ mibuɔ fɛɛ akɛ shigbeemɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu, miNuŋtsɔ lɛ, he nilee ni fe nii fɛɛ lɛ hewɔ; lɛ ehewɔ ni nii fɛɛ ebɔ mi, ni mibuɔ amɛ akɛ tumo nɔ nii, koni mana Kristo,

english_verse: and to know that I belong to him. I could not make myself acceptable to God by obeying the Law of Moses. God accepted me simply because of my faith in Christ.
translation_verse: ni ana mi yɛ emli, akɛ mibɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mijalɛ ni jɛ Mla mli, shi moŋ jalɛ ni tsɔ̃ Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli naa miyɔɔ,

english_verse: All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him to life. I want to suffer and die as he did,
translation_verse: ni male lɛ Kristo eshitee lɛ hewalɛ lɛ; ni mana emanehului lɛ eko, ni matamɔ lɛ yɛ egbele lɛ gbɛfaŋ;

english_verse: so that somehow I also may be raised to life. Running toward the Goal
translation_verse: akɛ aleenɔ mana mashɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ he lo. Foijee kɛ oti lɛ heshɛɛ

english_verse: I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize.
translation_verse: Jeee akɛ minine eshɛ nɔ momo aloo mihi kɛwula shi momo, shi miipele mihiɛ gbɛ ni minine ashɛ nɔ, gbii abɔ ni Kristo Yesu nine eshɛ mi hu minɔ lɛ.

english_verse: My friends, I don't feel I have already arrived. But I forget what is behind, and I struggle for what is ahead.
translation_verse: Anyɛmimɛi, mibuuu mihe akɛ minine eshɛ nɔ, shi nɔ kome kɛkɛ mifeɔ: Nii ni yɔɔ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ mijieɔ mihiɛ yɛ nɔ, shi nii ni yɔɔ hiɛgbɛ lɛ moŋ mikpãa mimli ni mashɛ he,

english_verse: I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: ni miitiu oti lɛ kɛyashɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛmɔ ni jɛ ŋwɛi yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ he juromɔ nɔ lɛ he.

english_verse: All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔ mɛi abɔ ni wɔdara yɛ mumɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ wɔjwɛŋa nakai. Ni kɛ nɔ ko yɛ ni nyɛjwɛŋɔ lɛ ekroko lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaajie no hu kpo faŋŋ atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: But we must keep going in the direction that we are now headed.
translation_verse: Shi nɔ ni wɔkɛba wɔjeŋ kɛbashi he ni wɔshɛ nɛɛ, wɔya nɔ wɔkɛ no nɔŋŋ aba wɔjeŋ.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you.
translation_verse: Anyɛmimɛi, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛkasea mi. Nyɛkwɛa mɛi ni nyiɛɔ tamɔ bɔ ni wɔtoɔ nyɛ okadi lɛ.

english_verse: I often warned you that many people are living as enemies of the cross of Christ. And now with tears in my eyes, I warn you again
translation_verse: Mikɛɛ nyɛ shii abɔ, ni miikɛɛ nyɛ ekoŋŋ kɛ yaafonui, akɛ mɛi pii yɛ ni baa amɛjeŋ akɛ Kristo sɛŋmɔtso lɛ henyɛlɔi.

english_verse: that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
translation_verse: Amɛnaagbee ji hiɛkpãtãmɔ, ni amɛmusu taomɔnii ji amɛnyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛhiɛgbele mli amɛnunyam yɔɔ, shikpɔŋ nɔ nii ahe amɛjwɛŋɔ.

english_verse: But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ
translation_verse: Shi wɔ lɛ, wɔmaŋ lɛ ŋwɛi eyɔɔ, he ni wɔkwɛɔ yiwalaherelɔ ni ji Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ gbɛ kɛjɛɔ lɛ.

english_verse: has power over everything, and he will make these poor bodies of ours like his own glorious body.
translation_verse: Lɛ ebaatsake wɔgbɔmɔtso ni hiɛ bɛ nyam lɛ koni etamɔ enunyam gbɔmɔtso lɛ su, yɛ ehewalɛ nitsumɔ ni ekɛnyɛɔ eŋɔɔ nibii fɛɛ ewoɔ eshishi hu lɛ naa lɛ.

english_verse: Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy. Paul Encourages the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, minyɛmimɛi ni misumɔɔ ni mishweɔ, mimishɛɛ kɛ mikekre, nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ nakai yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli, nyɛ mɛi ni misumɔɔ!

english_verse: Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Miikpa Euodia fai, ni miikpa Sintike fai, akɛ amɛjwɛŋmɔ afee ekome yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ, bo hu miibao, minaanyo sɔ̃ɔlɔ yɛ anɔkwaleŋ, ni oye obua yei nɛɛ; ejaakɛ amɛfata mihe kɛpele Sanekpakpa lɛ he, kɛ Klɛmente hu kɛ minanemɛi nitsulɔi krokomɛi ni amɛgbɛi yɔɔ wala wolo lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad.
translation_verse: Nyɛmii ashɛa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli daa! Miikɛɛ ekoŋŋ! Nyɛmii ashɛa!

english_verse: Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here.
translation_verse: Nyɛmlijɔlɛ lɛ nyɛhãa gbɔmɛi fɛɛ alea! Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ebɛŋkɛ.

english_verse: Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God.
translation_verse: Nyɛkahaoa yɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko he, shi moŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ nyɛkɛ sɔlemɔ kɛ faikpamɔ kɛ shidaa atsĩa nyɛtaomɔnii lɛ atã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.

english_verse: Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
translation_verse: Ni Nyɔŋmɔ hejɔlɛ ni fe jwɛŋmɔi fɛɛ lɛ aaabu nyɛtsuii kɛ nyɛjwɛŋmɔi lɛ ahe yɛ Kristo Yesu mli!

english_verse: Finally, my friends, keep your minds on whatever is true, pure, right, holy, friendly, and proper. Don't ever stop thinking about what is truly worthwhile and worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Naagbee lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nii abɔ ni ji anɔkwa, nii ni sa woo, nii ni ja, nii ni he tse, nii ni yɔɔ fɛo, nii ni yɔɔ gbɛi kpakpa lɛ fɛɛ, kɛji jeŋba kpakpa ko yɛ, kɛji yijiemɔ ko hu yɛ lɛ, enɛɛmɛi ahe nyɛjwɛŋa!

english_verse: You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you. Paul Gives Thanks for the Gifts He Was Given
translation_verse: Nii hu ni nyɛkase ni nyɛmɔ mli ni nyɛnu ni nyɛna yɛ mihe lɛ, nomɛi nɔŋŋ nyɛfea, ni hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ aaahi shi. Shidaa yɛ Filipibii anikeenii lɛ ahe

english_verse: The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it.
translation_verse: Shi mina miishɛɛ babaoo yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli akɛ agbɛnɛ nyɛhã mi nɔ ni nyɛjwɛŋɔ lɛ efrɔke ekoŋŋ; nyɛjwɛŋɔ he, shi hegbɛ ni nyɛyanaaa.

english_verse: I am not complaining about having too little. I have learned to be satisfied with whatever I have.
translation_verse: Jeee akɛ fimɔ ni efi mi hewɔ miwieɔ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ mi lɛ mikase akɛ shihilɛ fɛɛ shihilɛ ni miyɔɔ mli lɛ mimii ashɛ he.

english_verse: I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little.
translation_verse: Mile ohia mli shihilɛ, ni mile kpɔtɔɔyeli hu; mihe ehomɔ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ kɛ nii fɛɛ mli: tɔɔ kɛ hɔ̃mɔ, ninamɔ kɛ ohiayeli.

english_verse: Christ gives me the strength to face anything.
translation_verse: Minyɛɔ nii fɛɛ mifeɔ yɛ mɔ ni wajeɔ mi lɛ mli.

english_verse: It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time.
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛfee jogbaŋŋ, akɛ nyɛbaye nyɛbua mi yɛ mimanehulu lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛ Filipibii diɛŋtsɛ hu nyɛle akɛ, Sanekpakpa lɛ shishijee lɛ mli, be ni miyiŋ kɛjɛ Makedonia lɛ, asafo ko bɛ ni kɛ mi bɔɔ naanyo yɛ hãmɔ kɛ hemɔ gbɛfaŋ, akɛ ja nyɛ kɛkɛ;

english_verse: Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ be ni miyɔɔ Tesalonika lɛ hu nyɛtsu shi kome kɛ shii enyɔ fɛɛ abahã mi nii ni hiaa mi lɛ.

english_verse: I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
translation_verse: Jeee akɛ nikeenii mitaoɔ; shi moŋ miitao yibii ni baahã nyɛkɔntaa lɛ afa.

english_verse: I have been paid back everything, and with interest. I am completely satisfied with the gifts you sent with Epaphroditus. They are like a sweet-smelling offering or like the right kind of sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Shi mina nii fɛɛ ni eteke nɔ; ni akɛni minine eshɛ nii ni nyɛkɛmaje Epafrodito kɛbahã mi lɛ nɔ nɛɛ, mina nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mitaoɔ; eji ŋmajee kpakpa kɛ afɔle kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus!
translation_verse: MiNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaahã nyɛ nii ni hiaa nyɛ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ enifalɛ lɛ naa yɛ anunyam mli, yɛ Kristo Yesu mli.

english_verse: May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Shi anunyam ahã wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛyashi naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ. Amen! Naagbee ŋamɔi

english_verse: Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus. The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Nyɛŋaa hetselɔ fɛɛ hetselɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli nyɛhãa mi. Nyɛmimɛi ni kɛ mi yɔɔ lɛ miibi nyɛ.

english_verse: All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
translation_verse: Hetselɔi lɛ fɛɛ, shi titri lɛ mɛi ni jɛ Kaisare we lɛ, miibi nyɛ.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless your life!
translation_verse: WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛmumɔ lɛ ahi shi!

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Paulo ni ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa kɛ wɔnyɛmi Timoteo

english_verse: To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ. I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: ŋma yahã nyɛmimɛi hetselɔi kɛ heyelɔi yɛ Kristo mli ni yɔɔ Kolose lɛ. Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ. Shidaa sɔlemɔ

english_verse: Each time we pray for you, we thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Wɔdaa Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ lɛ shi yɛ nyɛhewɔ daa nɛɛ yɛ wɔsɔlemɔi amli.

english_verse: We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔnu nyɛKristo Yesu nɔ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ nyɛsuɔmɔ ni nyɛkɛ sumɔɔ hetselɔi lɛ fɛɛ he

english_verse: because what you hope for is kept safe for you in heaven. You first heard about this hope when you believed the true message, which is the good news.
translation_verse: yɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni akɛto ahã nyɛ yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ. Nyɛnu enɛ momo yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ anɔkwale wiemɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness
translation_verse: Sanekpakpa lɛ eshɛ nyɛŋɔɔ tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni eyɔɔ yɛ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ mli, ni eewo yibii ni eeshwere, tamɔ bɔ ni efeɔ yɛ nyɛ hu nyɛteŋ kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni nyɛnu ni nyɛna nyɛle Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ.

english_verse: from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you.
translation_verse: Nyɛkase enɛ yɛ Epafra, wɔnaanyo tsulɔ ni wɔsumɔɔ, ni ji Kristo anɔkwa sɔ̃ɔlɔ hã nyɛ lɛ naa.

english_verse: He is also the one who told us about the love that God's Spirit has given you. The Person and Work of Christ
translation_verse: Lɛ ebagba wɔ nyɛsuɔmɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛwoɔ nyɛmli lɛ he sane.

english_verse: We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives.
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔ hu, kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni wɔnu lɛ, wɔfɔ̃ko sɔlemɔ kɛ faikpamɔ kɛ nyɛ hãmɔ, koni nyɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ esuɔmɔnaanii alee yɛ mumɔŋ nilee kɛ shishinumɔ fɛɛ mli.

english_verse: Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better.
translation_verse: Koni nyɛnyiɛ bɔ ni sa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni asa ehiɛ kwraa ni nyɛwo yibii yɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa mli. Enɛ ahã nyɛshwere yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he nilee mli

english_verse: His glorious power will make you patient and strong enough to endure anything, and you will be truly happy.
translation_verse: ni awaje nyɛ kɛ hewalɛ fɛɛ yɛ enunyam nyɛmɔ lɛ naa. No ahã nyɛnyɛ nyɛmia nyɛhiɛ ni nyɛto nyɛtsui shi kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli.

english_verse: I pray that you will be grateful to God for letting you have part in what he has promised his people in the kingdom of light.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛdaa Tsɛ lɛ shi, mɔ ni hã wɔfee mɛi ni sa krɔŋkrɔŋbii ni yɔɔ la lɛ mli lɛ agboshinii lɛ eko yeli.

english_verse: God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son,
translation_verse: Ni ejie wɔ kɛjɛ duŋ hewalɛ lɛ mli kɛtee esuɔmɔ Bi lɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ;

english_verse: Christ is exactly like God, who cannot be seen. He is the first-born Son, superior to all creation.
translation_verse: Kristo ji Nyɔŋmɔ ni anaaa lɛ subaŋ, lɛ enɔ atsɔ abɔ nii fɛɛ.

english_verse: Everything was created by him, everything in heaven and on earth, everything seen and unseen, including all forces and powers, and all rulers and authorities. All things were created by God's Son, and everything was made for him.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ emli abɔ nii fiaa yɛ, nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi kɛ nii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, nii ni anaa kɛ nii ni anaaa, maŋtsɛ sɛii jio, nɔyelii jio, onukpayelii jio, hegbɛi jio, nii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, enɔ atsɔ̃ abɔ, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ abɔ ahã.

english_verse: God's Son was before all else, and by him everything is held together.
translation_verse: Eyɛ dani nii fiaa yɔɔ, ni emli nii fiaa yɔɔ.

english_verse: He is the head of his body, which is the church. He is the very beginning, the first to be raised from death, so that he would be above all others.
translation_verse: Ni lɛ ji gbɔmɔtso lɛ ni ji asafo lɛ yitso, lɛ ji shishijee lɛ, gbohii ateŋ kromɔbi lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni efee klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ yɛ nii fiaa mli.

english_verse: God himself was pleased to live fully in his Son.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔ akɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esu muu lɛ fɛɛ ahi emli.

english_verse: And God was pleased for him to make peace by sacrificing his blood on the cross, so that all beings in heaven and on earth would be brought back to God.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ esɛŋmɔtso nɔ lá lɛ nɔ ekɛ hejɔlɛ ba, ni etsɔ̃ enɔ ekɛ nibii fɛɛ kpãtã, nii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ.

english_verse: You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ni sa ni yɛ nyɛjwɛŋmɔ kɛ nyɛnitsumɔi fɔ̃ji ahewɔ lɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji kɛ henyɛlɔi ji nyɛ.

english_verse: But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ ekɛ egbɔmɔtso lɛ etsɔ̃ gbele nɔ ekpãtã nyɛ ni ekɛ nyɛ edamɔ shi akɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni he bɛ kpa ko ni sane ko bɛ amɛhe yɛ ehiɛ.

english_verse: But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message. Paul's Service to the Church
translation_verse: Shi esa ni nyɛhiɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli ni nyɛdamɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ shishitoo lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛkatsi nyɛhe kɛjɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ he, Sanekpakpa lɛ ni nyɛnu ni ashiɛɔ atsɔ̃ɔ bɔɔnii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shishi, ni mi Paulo misɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ he lɛ. Sɔ̃ɔmɔ nitsumɔ ni Paulo tsu hã Kristo Asafo lɛ

english_verse: I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ mimii shɛɔ yɛ mimanehului ni minaa yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ amli, ni mikɛ miheloo naa Kristo amanehului ni shwɛ lɛ mikɛwoɔ amɛ obɔ̃ hã egbɔmɔtso ni ji esafo lɛ.

english_verse: God's plan was to make me a servant of his church and to send me to preach his complete message to you.
translation_verse: Ni mitsɔ̃ esafo lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔ yɛ nitsumɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ etu ewo midɛŋ yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ naa, akɛ mashiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ kɛwula shi lɛ.

english_verse: For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people.
translation_verse: Enɛ ji teemɔ sane ni akɛtee kɛjɛ teteete kɛ yinɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ, shi agbɛnɛ lɛ ajie lɛ kpo atsɔ̃ɔ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ.

english_verse: God did this because he wanted you Gentiles to understand his wonderful and glorious mystery. And the mystery is that Christ lives in you, and he is your hope of sharing in God's glory.
translation_verse: Ni Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔ akɛ ahã amɛle nɔ ni ji nɛkɛ teemɔ sane nɛɛ anunyam falɛ lɛ yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ. Teemɔ sane nɛɛ ji akɛ Kristo yɛ nyɛmli koni nyɛna anunyam lɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: We announce the message about Christ, and we use all our wisdom to warn and teach everyone, so all of Christ's followers will grow and become mature.
translation_verse: Lɛ ehe sane wɔjajeɔ, ni wɔwoɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ ŋaa, ni wɔtsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ nilee nɛɛ fɛɛ, koni wɔkɛ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ adamɔ shi akɛ mɔ ni eye emuu yɛ Kristo mli.

english_verse: This is why I work so hard and use the mighty power he gives me.
translation_verse: No he deŋme migboɔ ni mipeleɔ yɛ ehewalɛ ni tsuɔ nii kɛ hewalɛ yɛ mimli lɛ naa.

english_verse: I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ miisumɔ akɛ nyɛle nɔ pelemɔ ni mli wa ni mipeleɔ yɛ nyɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Laodikea kɛ mɛi abɔ ni enako mi hiɛ kɛ hiɛ lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery,
translation_verse: Miifee enɛ koni amɛtsɛ amɛtsui amɛŋmɛ amɛmli ni amɛfee ekome yɛ suɔmɔ mli ni amɛna hewalɛ falɛ fɛɛ ni anaa kɛjɛɔ niiashishinumɔ mli lɛ ni amɛle Nyɔŋmɔ teemɔ sane lɛ ni ji Kristo.

english_verse: but all wisdom and knowledge are hidden away in him.
translation_verse: Mɔ mli ni akɛ ŋaa kɛ nilee jwetrii lɛ fɛɛ etee yɛ lɛ.

english_verse: I tell you these things to keep you from being fooled by fancy talk.
translation_verse: Shi miikɛɛ enɛ, koni mɔ ko kɛ naadɔkɔmɔ wiemɔ ko akashishiu nyɛ.

english_verse: Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong. Christ Brings Real Life
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ mikɛ nyɛ bɛ yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli po, mumɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ mikɛ nyɛ yɛ, ni mimii shɛɔ kɛ mikwɛ bɔ ni nyɛdamɔ shi pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ nyɛ Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ shifimɔ lɛ. Nyɛyia obɔ̃ kɛ Kristo wala

english_verse: You have accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord. Now keep on following him.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni nyɛhere Kristo Yesu, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ atuu lɛ, nyɛnyiɛa yɛ emli.

english_verse: Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛshishifã amɔ̃ shi ni atswa nyɛ ama enɔ ni nyɛfi shi yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ ni nyɛteke nɔ kɛ shidaa.

english_verse: Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.
translation_verse: Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe ni ahĩa, koni mɔ ko kɛ jeŋ nilee kɛ yaka shishiumɔ ni damɔ gbɔmɛi ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ je nɛɛŋ shishijee nibii anɔ, shi jeee Kristo nɔ lɛ, akaŋɔ nyɛ nom.

english_verse: And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority.
translation_verse: ni nyɛye emuu yɛ emli, lɛ mɔ ni ji onukpayeli kɛ hegbɛ fɛɛ yitso lɛ.

english_verse: Christ has also taken away your selfish desires, just as circumcision removes flesh from the body.
translation_verse: Lɛ emli afolɔ nyɛ ketia hu yɛ, jeee ketia ni akɛ nine fo, shi moŋ ketiafoo ni ji heloo gbɔmɔtso lɛ jiemɔ yɛ Kristo ketiafoo lɛ mli.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ afu nyɛ kɛ lɛ yɛ baptisimɔ lɛ mli; ni emli hu atee nyɛ shi yɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ hewalɛ lɛ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli naa.

english_verse: You were dead, because you were sinful and were not God's people. But God let Christ make you alive, when he forgave all our sins.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛ ni nyɛ ji gbohii yɛ nyɛnɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ kɛ nyɛheloofoo lɛ mli lɛ, ehã nyɛ kɛ lɛ fɛɛ wala, ni ekɛ nyɛnɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ fɛɛ efa nyɛ.

english_verse: God wiped out the charges that were against us for disobeying the Law of Moses. He took them away and nailed them to the cross.
translation_verse: Ni egbe wɔnyɔmɔ ni wɔhiɛ ni aŋma kɛ ekpɔi lɛ, ni ejie kɛtee, ni ekala ekpɛtɛ sɛŋmɔtso lɛ he.

english_verse: There Christ defeated all powers and forces. He let the whole world see them being led away as prisoners when he celebrated his victory.
translation_verse: Ni ekpɔlɔ onukpayelii kɛ hewalɛi lɛ ahe nii, ni ebɔ amɛ ahora faŋŋ, ni enyã yɛ amɛnɔ.

english_verse: Don't let anyone tell you what you must eat or drink. Don't let them say you must celebrate the New Moon festival, the Sabbath, or any other festival.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkahãa mɔ ko miikojoa nyɛ yɛ niyeli loo ninumɔ loo gbii juji loo nyɔji hei loo hejɔɔmɔ gbii agbɛfaŋ,

english_verse: These things are only a shadow of what was to come. But Christ is real!
translation_verse: ejaakɛ nii ni baaba lɛ asusuma kɛkɛ ni, shi nii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ji Kristo.

english_verse: Don't be cheated by people who make a show of acting humble and who worship angels. They brag about seeing visions. But it is all nonsense, because their minds are filled with selfish desires.
translation_verse: Nyɛkahãa mɔ ko kɛ taomɔ ni etaoɔ akɛ nyɛkɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ aja ŋwɛi bɔfoi miishɔ̃ nyɛjuromɔnii lɛ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ. Gbɔmɔ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, nɔ nɔ ni edamɔ ji ninai, ni eheloo jwɛŋmɔ lɛ hãa ewoɔ ehe nɔ efolo,

english_verse: They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God. Christ Brings New Life
translation_verse: ni ehiɛɛɛ Kristo ni ji yitso lɛ mli, mɔ mli ni gbɔmɔtso lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ talɔi kɛ fai lɛ anɔ enaa nii ni hiaa lɛ kɛjeɔ ni emɔmɔ̃ɔ ehe kɛshimɔ̃ɔ ehe nɔ kɛdaa bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ taoɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as,
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛkɛ Kristo egbo ni je nɛɛŋ shishijeenii bɛ nyɛnɔ hewalɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, mɛɛba mɔ ni nyɛhiɔ shi tamɔ nɔ ni nyɛhiɛ kamɔ̃ lolo yɛ je nɛɛŋ, ni nyɛhãa awoɔ nyɛ akpɔi akɛ,

english_verse: “Don't handle this. Don't taste that. Don't touch this.”?
translation_verse: “Kaamɔ mli, ni kaasa onaa, ni kaata he tete” lɛ?

english_verse: After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up?
translation_verse: Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ji nibii ni hiɛ kpãtãa yɛ amɛhe nitsumɔ mli; amɛ ji akpɔi ni awo yɛ gbɔmɛi akitãi kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi anaa.

english_verse: Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
translation_verse: Suɔmɔnaa jamɔ kɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ kɛ gbɔmɔtso yiwaa hãa nibii nɛɛ feɔ tamɔ nɔ ni nilee yɛ mli nɛ, shi yɛ heloo akɔnɔ naatsii gbɛfaŋ lɛ, ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ.

english_verse: You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ atee nyɛ kɛ Kristo shi lɛ, nyɛtaoa nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi, he ni Kristo yɔɔ ni eta Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ yɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth.
translation_verse: Nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ ahe nyɛjwɛŋa, jeee nii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: You died, which means that your life is hidden with Christ, who sits beside God.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɛgboi, ni akɛ nyɛwala lɛ kɛ Kristo etee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli.

english_verse: Christ gives meaning to your life, and when he appears, you will also appear with him in glory.
translation_verse: Be ni Kristo, mɔ ni ji wɔwala lɛ, aaapue lɛ, no lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛkɛ lɛ aaapue yɛ anunyam mli. Shihilɛ momo lɛ kɛ ehee lɛ

english_verse: And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way.
translation_verse: Enɛɛmɛi amli nyɛ hu nyɛnyiɛ sa, be ni nyɛhi shi yɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛshɛrɛa nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ nyɛshwiea: mlifu, mlila kɛ shwee ni ashweɔ mɔ efɔŋ, kɛ oshekuyeli kɛ hiɛgbejiawiemɔ ni jɛɔ nyɛdaaŋ.

english_verse: Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better.
translation_verse: ni nyɛwo gbɔmɔ hee ni aafee lɛ ehee yɛ ebɔlɔ lɛ subaŋ nɔ, koni ele lɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Enɛ mli lɛ Helanyo kɛ Yudanyo, ketiafolɔ kɛ foolɔ, gbɔ, Sikitianyo, nyɔŋ kɛ odehe ko bɛ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ Kristo ji nii fiaa yɛ mɛi fɛɛ mli.

english_verse: God loves you and has chosen you as his own special people. So be gentle, kind, humble, meek, and patient.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ halamɔbii, mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi kɛ suɔmɔ mɛi ji nyɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛwoa musuŋtsɔlɛ, mlihilɛ, heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ, kpoofeemɔ, tsuishitoo.

english_verse: Put up with each other, and forgive anyone who does you wrong, just as Christ has forgiven you.
translation_verse: Ni kɛji mɔ ko kɛ mɔ ko na sane ko lɛ, nyɛnanaa nyɛhãa nyɛhe ni nyɛkɛfafaa nyɛhe; tamɔ bɔ ni Kristo hu kɛfa nyɛ lɛ, nakai nyɛ hu nyɛfea.

english_verse: Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
translation_verse: Shi enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ nyɛwoa suɔmɔ ni ji kpãa ni fiɔ nibii fɛɛ feɔ lɛ ekome ni ehãa eyeɔ emuu lɛ.

english_verse: Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛhãa Kristo hejɔlɛ lɛ ayea lumɔ yɛ nyɛtsuii amli; nɔ he ni atsɛ nyɛ kɛba yɛ gbɔmɔtso kome mli lɛ. Ni nyɛlea shidaa.

english_verse: Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
translation_verse: Nyɛhãa Kristo wiemɔ lɛ ahia nyɛmli babaoo; ni nyɛkɛ nilee fɛɛ atsɔ̃a nyɛhe nii ni nyɛwiea nyɛtsɔ̃a nyɛhe yɛ saŋkutswai kɛ yijiemɔ lalai kɛ mumɔŋ lalai amli, ni nyɛkɛ shidaa alaa yɛ nyɛtsuii amli nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him. Some Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛfeɔ yɛ wiemɔ loo nitsumɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ, nyɛfea fɛɛ yɛ Yesu Kristo gbɛi mli, ni nyɛtsɔ̃a enɔ nyɛdaa Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji Tsɛ lɛ shi. Kristofoi ashĩa mli shihilɛ (Efesobii

english_verse: A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛ yeigbãyei lɛ, nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa nyɛwumɛi, tamɔ bɔ ni sa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
translation_verse: Nyɛ wumɛi lɛ, nyɛsumɔa nyɛŋamɛi, ni nyɛmli akajoa yɛ amɛnɔ.

english_verse: Children must always obey their parents. This pleases the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛ bii lɛ, nyɛboa nyɛfɔlɔi atoi yɛ nibii fɛɛ gbɛfaŋ; ejaakɛ no sa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
translation_verse: Nyɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ, nyɛkawoa nyɛbii amli la, koni amɛnijiaŋ akaje wui.

english_verse: Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart.
translation_verse: Nyɛ tsuji lɛ, nyɛboa nyɛheloo gbɛfaŋ nuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ atoi yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli, jeee kɛ hiɛiaŋhiɛiaŋ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, tamɔ mɛi ni taoɔ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ amɛsa, shi moŋ yɛ tsui krɔŋŋ mli akɛ mɛi ni sheɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbeyei.

english_verse: Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master.
translation_verse: Ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ, nyɛjiea nyɛmusuŋ nyɛtsua, tamɔ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nyɛtsuɔ nyɛhã ni jeee gbɔmɛi,

english_verse: In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you.
translation_verse: ni nyɛle akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ nyɛnine baashɛ gboshinii lɛ anɔ yɛ akɛ nyɛnyɔmɔwoo. Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Kristo nyɛsɔ̃mɔɔ.

english_verse: But Christ has no favorites! He will punish evil people, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni feɔ nii ni ejaaa gbɛ lɛ, nii ni ejaaa gbɛ nɔŋŋ he nyɔmɔwoo eeena, ni hiɛiaŋkwɛmɔ ko bɛŋ.

english_verse: Slave owners, be fair and honest with your slaves. Don't forget that you have a Master in heaven.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ nyɛkɛ nɔ ni ja kɛ nɔ ni sa pɛ ahãa nyɛtsuji lɛ, ni nyɛlea akɛ nyɛ hu nyɛyɛ Nuŋtsɔ yɛ ŋwɛi. Ŋaawoi

english_verse: Never give up praying. And when you pray, keep alert and be thankful.
translation_verse: Nyɛhiɛa sɔlemɔ mli, ni nyɛshia kpe yɛ mli kɛ shidaa.

english_verse: Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛsaa nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa wɔ hu, koni Nyɔŋmɔ agbele gbɛ ahã wɔ hã wiemɔ lɛ, ni wɔwie Kristo teemɔ sane lɛ, nɔ hewɔ hu ni mikã kpãa mli nɛɛ.

english_verse: Please pray that I will make the message as clear as possible.
translation_verse: Nyɛsɔlea koni majie no shi faŋŋ bɔ ni sa akɛ mawie lɛ.

english_verse: When you are with unbelievers, always make good use of the time.
translation_verse: Nyɛbaa nyɛjeŋ yɛ nilee mli yɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ ahiɛ, ni nyɛtsu nyɛbe he nii.

english_verse: Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Nyɛhãa nyɛwiemɔ he abaa nyam daa ni ŋoo ahi mli, ni nyɛle bɔ ni sa akɛ nyɛhãa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hetoo. Naagbee ŋamɔi

english_verse: Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me.
translation_verse: Tihiko, ni ji suɔmɔ nyɛmi kɛ anɔkwa sɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ naanyo tsulɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ, aaagba nyɛ mihe saji fɛɛ.

english_verse: I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along.
translation_verse: Enɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ mitsu lɛ nyɛŋɔɔ, koni nyɛle bɔ ni wɔyɔɔ, ni eshɛje nyɛmii.

english_verse: Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
translation_verse: Mitsu lɛ kɛ Onesimo ni ji anɔkwa kɛ suɔmɔ nyɛmi ni jɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ; amɛaagba nyɛ biɛ saji fɛɛ.

english_verse: Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
translation_verse: Yoshua ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yusto lɛ, ni ji mɛi ni jɛ ketiafolɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, miibi nyɛ. Mɛnɛɛmɛi pɛ ji minanemɛi nitsulɔi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ gbɛfaŋ ni etsɔ̃mɔ tsuiwoo ehã mi.

english_verse: Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely.
translation_verse: Epafra ni jɛ nyɛteŋ ni ji Kristo tsulɔ ni daa nɛɛ ekɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ hiɛ sɔlemɔi amli waa kɛhã nyɛ, koni nyɛdamɔ shi akɛ mɛi ni eye emuu ni amɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii fɛɛ feemɔ lɛ, miibi nyɛ.

english_verse: I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ miiye ehe odase akɛ ebɔɔ mɔdɛŋ naakpa yɛ nyɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Laodikea kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Hierapoli lɛ ahe.

english_verse: Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
translation_verse: Luka, tsofatsɛ ni asumɔɔ lɛ kɛ Dema miibi nyɛ.

english_verse: Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
translation_verse: Wɔmiibi nyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ Laodikea lɛ, kɛ Nimfa kɛ asafo ni yɔɔ ewe lɛ.

english_verse: After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
translation_verse: Kɛ akane nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa akanea yɛ Laodikea asafo lɛ mli hu, ni nyɛ hu nyɛkane nɔ ni jɛ Laodikea lɛ.

english_verse: Remind Archippus to do the work that the Lord has given him to do.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛkɛa Arkipo akɛ, “Kwɛmɔ ni ogbe sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni atu awo odɛ̃ŋ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ naa kwraa!”

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL. Don't forget that I am in jail. I pray that God will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Mi Paulo diɛŋtsɛ minine naa bimɔ ni miŋma nɛ. Nyɛkaia mikɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃i lɛ! Dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi!

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ. I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Paulo kɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo ŋma yahã Tesalonikabii asafo ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Tsɛ lɛ, kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo mli lɛ: Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ! Tesalonikabii ashihilɛ kɛ amɛhemɔkɛyeli

english_verse: We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray,
translation_verse: Wɔdaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi daa yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhewɔ, ni wɔfɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛtãtsii yɛ wɔsɔlemɔi amli.

english_verse: we tell God our Father about your faith and loving work and about your firm hope in our Lord Jesus Christ. The Thessalonians' Faith and Example
translation_verse: Ni wɔkaiɔ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli nitsumɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛsuɔmɔ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛhiɛ ni kã wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ lɛ mli hiɛmiamɔ lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔTsɛ lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ, anyɛmimɛi ni Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ, wɔle halamɔ ni ahala nyɛ lɛ,

english_verse: When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you.
translation_verse: akɛ wɔSanekpakpa lɛ baaa nyɛŋɔɔ yɛ wiemɔ mli kɛkɛ, shi moŋ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hewalɛ kɛ nɔmimaa babaoo mli, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛle lɛ, no ji bɔ ni wɔtsɔ̃ wɔba wɔjeŋ yɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ.

english_verse: So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛ lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni kaseɔ wɔ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, akɛni nyɛkɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ mli miishɛɛ mɔ wiemɔ lɛ mli yɛ amanehulu babaoo mli lɛ.

english_verse: You became an example for all the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia.
translation_verse: Ni no ehã nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ nyɛhã mɛi fɛɛ ni heɔ yeɔ yɛ Makedonia kɛ Akaia lɛ.

english_verse: And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɛŋɔɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ jɛ ni egbɛ eshwã, jeee yɛ Makedonia kɛ Akaia kɛkɛ, shi moŋ nyɛhe ni nyɛheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ ejije kɛtee he fɛɛ he, ni ehĩaaa wɔ nɔ ko kɛɛmɔ tete.

english_verse: Everyone is talking about how you welcomed us and how you turned away from idols to serve the true and living God.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbaa wɔhe sane bɔ ni wɔba nyɛŋɔɔ kɛ bɔ ni nyɛkpale kɛjɛ amãgãi ahe kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ni nyɛbasɔ̃mɔ anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ

english_verse: They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
translation_verse: ni nyɛkwɛ eBi lɛ ni etee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ gbɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi, Yesu ni jie wɔ kɛjɛ mlifu ni baaba lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ anyɛmimɛi, nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle akɛ nyɛŋɔɔ ni wɔba lɛ efeee yaka.

english_verse: As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble.
translation_verse: Wɔna nɔ momo, ni afee wɔ niseniianii hu yɛ Filipi, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛle lɛ, kɛ̃lɛ wɔna ekãa yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mli ni wɔkɛjaje Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, tsɛbelɛ ate shi ashi wɔ babaoo.

english_verse: We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔwiemɔ kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, jeee shishiumɔ loo nyaŋemɔ nitsumɔ loo kutumpɔo mli ejɛ;

english_verse: God was pleased to trust us with his message. We didn't speak to please people, but to please God who knows our motives.
translation_verse: shi moŋ tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ebu wɔ akɛ wɔsa akɛ atu Sanekpakpa lɛ awo wɔdɛŋ lɛ, nakai wɔwieɔ, jeee tamɔ mɛi ni taoɔ asa gbɔmɛi ahiɛ, shi moŋ tamɔ mɛi ni taoɔ asa Nyɔŋmɔ ni kaa wɔtsuii kwɛɔ lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: You also know we didn't try to flatter anyone. God himself knows what we did wasn't a cover-up for greed.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔwieko naadɔkɔmɔ wiemɔ ko pɛŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛle lɛ, ni wɔtoko hiɛjoomɔ he abla ko hu, Nyɔŋmɔ ji odasefonyo,

english_verse: We were not trying to get you or anyone else to praise us.
translation_verse: asaŋ wɔtaooo gbɔmɛi ahiɛ nyam yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ loo mɛi krokomɛi aŋɔɔ.

english_verse: But as apostles, we could have demanded help from you. After all, Christ is the one who sent us. We chose to be like children or like a mother nursing her baby.
translation_verse: Tsɛ wɔyɛ hegbɛ akɛ wɔfeɔ wɔhe agboi yɛ nyɛnɔ, akɛni Kristo bɔfoi ji wɔ lɛ; shi moŋ wɔhe jɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni bii anyɛ hiɛɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebii dɔdɔɔdɔ lɛ.

english_verse: We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
translation_verse: Ni akɛni wɔsumɔɔ nyɛ jogbaŋŋ nɛkɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔna he tsui akɛ jeee Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ kɛkɛ wɔkɛaahã nyɛ, shi moŋ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔwala tete, ejaakɛ wɔmiisumɔ nyɛ naakpa.

english_verse: My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛkaiɔ wɔtɔlɛ kɛ wɔdeŋmegbomɔ lɛ, akɛ bɔ ni afee ni wɔkatsɔ̃ jatsu wɔmiihã nyɛteŋ mɔ ko hewɔ lɛ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane fɛɛ wɔmiitsu nii, ni wɔsaa wɔmiijaje Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ wɔmiitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji odasefoi akɛ wɔjeŋ ni wɔba yɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛheɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ ateŋ lɛ eyɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ, eja, ni shwamɔ ko bɛ he.

english_verse: You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children.
translation_verse: Tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni nyɛle akɛ wɔhiɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tamɔ tsɛ hiɛɔ ebii.

english_verse: We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
translation_verse: Ni wɔwieɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, ni wɔshɛjeɔ nyɛmii hu, ni wɔkpaa nyɛ fai akɛ nyɛnyiɛ bɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ ni tsɛɔ nyɛ kɛbaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋtsɛyeli kɛ enunyam lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: We always thank God that you believed the message we preached. It came from him, and it isn't something made up by humans. You accepted it as God's message, and now he is working in you.
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ ni wɔ hu wɔdaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi ni wɔfɔ̃ɔɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ be ni nyɛnine shɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ ni nyɛnu yɛ wɔnaa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛmɔ mli akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni eji hu lɛɛlɛŋ lɛ, shi jeee akɛ gbɔmɛi awiemɔ ko. Wiemɔ nɛɛ tsuɔ hewalɛ nii yɛ nyɛ ni nyɛheɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ nyɛmli.

english_verse: My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɛ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni kaseɔ Nyɔŋmɔ asafoi ni yɔɔ Yudea yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, ejaakɛ amanehului ni nyɛna yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛmaŋbii lɛ adɛŋ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ amɛ hu amɛna yɛ Yudafoi lɛ adɛŋ;

english_verse: Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else.
translation_verse: amɛgbe Nuŋtsɔ Yesu kɛ gbalɔi lɛ hu, ni amɛwa wɔ yi. Amɛsaaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni amɛkɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ yeee.

english_verse: They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them. Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
translation_verse: Amɛtsĩɔ wɔ gbɛ hu akɛ wɔkawie wɔtsɔ̃ɔ jeŋmaji lɛ ni ahere amɛyiwala. Ni amɛkɛwoɔ amɛhe eshai lɛ obɔ̃ daa, shi mlifu lɛ enina amɛ kɛmɔ shi. Paulo shwe akɛ eyasara asafo lɛ ekoŋŋ

english_verse: My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person.
translation_verse: Shi wɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, akɛni wɔkɛ nyɛ mli egbala be kukuoo ko yɛ na ni wɔnaaa wɔhe yɛ heloo mli gbɛfaŋ, shi jeee yɛ wɔmumɔ mli hewɔ lɛ, wɔkɛ shwee pii tao akɛ wɔna nyɛhiɛ ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: We really wanted to come. I myself tried several times, but Satan always stopped us.
translation_verse: Hewɔ lɛ wɔtao akɛ wɔba nyɛŋɔɔ, mi Paulo, mitao akɛ maba shi kome kɛ shii enyɔ fɛɛ shi Satan tsĩ wɔ gbɛ.

english_verse: After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us?
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ namɔ ji wɔhiɛnɔkãmɔ loo wɔmiishɛɛ loo wɔshwãa akekre yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo hiɛ, yɛ ebaa be lɛ mli lɛ? Ani jeee nyɛ ni?

english_verse: You alone are our glory and joy!
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɛ nyɛ ji wɔnunyam kɛ wɔmiishɛɛ.

english_verse: Finally, we couldn't stand it any longer. We decided to stay in Athens by ourselves
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, be ni wɔnyɛɛɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, wɔkpɛ mli akɛ ashi wɔ kome yɛ Atene,

english_verse: and send our friend Timothy to you. He works with us as God's servant and preaches the good news about Christ. We wanted him to make you strong in your faith and to encourage you.
translation_verse: ni wɔtsu Timoteo ni ji wɔnyɛmi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ wɔnaanyo nitsulɔ yɛ Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ mli lɛ. Wɔtsu lɛ ni ebawo nyɛ hewalɛ ni eshɛje nyɛmii yɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ gbɛfaŋ,

english_verse: We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer,
translation_verse: koni nɛkɛ amanehului nɛɛ akahã mɔ ko mɔ ko miigbugbãa. Ejaakɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle akɛ nɔ ni kã shi hã wɔ nɔŋŋ ji no.

english_verse: because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ be ni wɔkɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ, wɔkɛɛ nyɛ wɔto akɛ wɔbaana amanehulu, tamɔ bɔ ni eba mli ni nyɛle lɛ.

english_verse: At last, when I could not wait any longer, I sent Timothy to find out about your faith. I hoped Satan had not tempted you and made all our work useless.
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ ni mi hu, be ni minyɛɛɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, mitsu Timoteo ni mikɛle nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ, akɛ aleenɔ kalɔ lɛ ebaka nyɛ, ni ehã wɔdeŋme ni wɔgbo lɛ efee yaka lo.

english_verse: Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ ni Timoteo jɛ nyɛŋɔɔ ba wɔŋɔɔ ni ebagba wɔ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ kɛ nyɛsuɔmɔ lɛ he sane kɛ kaimɔ kpakpa ni nyɛkɛkaiɔ wɔ daa lɛ kɛ nyɛshwee ni nyɛshweɔ akɛ nyɛaana wɔ tamɔ bɔ ni wɔ hu wɔshweɔ ni wɔna nyɛ lɛ

english_verse: My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you.
translation_verse: hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, wɔmanehulu kɛ wɔhejaramɔ lɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ, nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ ehã wɔmii eshɛ yɛ nyɛhe;

english_verse: Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ kɛji nyɛfi shi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ agbɛnɛ wɔna wala hee. Paulo da Nyɔŋmɔ shi yɛ Tesalonikabii lɛ ahewɔ

english_verse: How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us?
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛɛ shidaa po wɔɔnyɛ wɔkɛda Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ nyɛ hewɔ yɛ miishɛɛ fɛɛ ni wɔna yɛ nyɛhe yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ hewɔ?

english_verse: Day and night we sincerely pray that we will see you again and help you to have an even stronger faith.
translation_verse: Nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane fɛɛ wɔkpaa fai babaoo, koni wɔna nyɛhiɛ ni wɔhã nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ aye emuu.

english_verse: We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you.
translation_verse: Shi Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔTsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ aaahã wɔgbɛ aja kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ.

english_verse: May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown.
translation_verse: Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ awo nyɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃ ni ehã nyɛteke nɔ kɛ suɔmɔ ni nyɛkɛsumɔsumɔɔ nyɛhe kɛ mɛi fɛɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni wɔ hu wɔsumɔɔ nyɛ lɛ.

english_verse: And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni afee ni ehã nyɛtsui afi shi ni shwamɔ ko akahi nyɛhe yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋfeemɔ mli, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔTsɛ lɛ hiɛ, yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo kɛ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ abaa be lɛ mli.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder.
translation_verse: Naagbee lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛkase yɛ wɔŋɔɔ bɔ ni sa akɛ nyɛba nyɛjeŋ ni esa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. Nyɛmiifee nakai, shi wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai ni wɔmiiwo nyɛ ŋaa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu mli akɛ nyɛfee ni ateke nɔ fe tsutsu lɛ.

english_verse: Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɛle kitãi ni wɔwo nyɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu mli lɛ.

english_verse: God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ enɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii, no ji, nyɛhetsemɔ akɛ nyɛtsi nyɛhe kɛjɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ he;

english_verse: Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God.
translation_verse: jeee yɛ akɔnɔ hiɛdɔɔ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni jeŋmajiaŋbii ni leee Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ feɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things.
translation_verse: Ni mɔ ko akatɔ̃ enyɛmi nɔ ni eye lɛ amim yɛ sane nɛɛ mli, ejaakɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ahe oweletɔlɔ ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni wɔkɛɛ nyɛ wɔto ni wɔye he odase lɛ.

english_verse: God didn't choose you to be filthy, but to be pure.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛɛɛ wɔ ehãaa nyaŋemɔ nitsumɔ, shi moŋ hã hetsemɔ.

english_verse: So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, mɔ ni kwaa tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ lɛ, jeee gbɔmɔ ko ekwaa, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ ni kɛ eMumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hãa nyɛ lɛ.

english_verse: We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this,
translation_verse: Shi nɔ ni kɔɔ nyɛmimɛi asuɔmɔ he lɛ, ehĩaaa akɛ aŋma nyɛ; ejaakɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ nyɛsumɔsumɔɔ nyɛhe;

english_verse: and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ nyɛfeɔ nakai hu nyɛhãa nyɛmimɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Makedonia muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ. Shi wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, akɛ nyɛfee kɛteke nɔ fe tsutsu lɛ.

english_verse: Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛkɛfea nyɛ oti akɛ nyɛaahi shi dioo ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhe akawo mɛi asaji amli ni nyɛkɛ nyɛniji atsu nii, bɔ ni wɔwo nyɛ kitã lɛ,

english_verse: Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone. The Lord's Coming
translation_verse: koni nyɛjeŋba afee mɛi ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ fɛo, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko akahĩa nyɛ. Gbohii kɛ hiɛkãalɔi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baa be lɛ mli

english_verse: My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope.
translation_verse: Shi, anyɛmimɛi, wɔmiisumɔ akɛ nyɛle mɛi ni ewɔ lɛ ahe sane, koni nyɛkaye ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ mɛi ni eshwɛ ni bɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ko lɛ.

english_verse: We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ wɔheɔ wɔyeɔ akɛ Yesu gbo ni ete shi lɛ, belɛ nakai nɔŋŋ Nyɔŋmɔ baatsɔ̃ Yesu nɔ aŋɔ mɛi ni ewɔ lɛ hu afata ehe kɛba.

english_verse: Our Lord Jesus told us that when he comes, we won't go up to meet him ahead of his followers who have already died.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔmiikɛɛ nyɛ enɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ naa akɛ wɔ mɛi ni wɔhiɛ kãmɔ ni wɔbaashwɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baa be lɛ mli lɛ, wɔtsɔ̃ŋ mɛi ni ewɔ lɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baakpleke shi kɛjɛ ŋwɛi yɛ oshebɔɔ mli ni ŋwɛi bɔfonukpa gbee kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ baagbɛɛ, ni gbohii ni yɔɔ Kristo mli lɛ tsutsu baate shi,

english_verse: Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever.
translation_verse: no sɛɛ lɛ wɔ mɛi ni wɔhiɛ kãmɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ, aaasha wɔ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ yɛ atatui amli kɛaatee Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kpeemɔ yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ mli, ni nakai wɔkɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaayahi shi daa.

english_verse: Encourage each other with these words.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ ashɛjeshɛjea nyɛhe mii.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen.
translation_verse: Shi anyɛmimɛi, nɔ ni kɔɔ gbii lɛ kɛ bei lɛ ahe lɛ, ehe ehĩaaa akɛ aŋma nyɛ.

english_verse: You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle krɛdɛɛ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Gbi lɛ baaba tamɔ julɔ baa nyɔɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ be mli ni amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔyɛ hejɔlɛ ni wɔyɛ shweshweeshwe!” lɛ, no mli nɔŋŋ hiɛkpãtãmɔ aaabatua amɛ trukaa, tamɔ kɔ̃ɔmɔ tuaa yoo ni hiɛ musu lɛ, ni amɛjeŋ mli kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief.
translation_verse: Shi, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛ lɛ nyɛbɛ duŋ mli ni Gbi lɛ aaabati nyɛ shi tamɔ julɔ.

english_verse: You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ, labii ji nyɛ kɛ shwanebii hu, wɔjeee nyɔɔŋ loo duŋ bii.

english_verse: Others may sleep, but we should stay awake and be alert.
translation_verse: Belɛ no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkahãa wɔwɔa tamɔ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, shi moŋ nyɛhãa wɔshia kpe ni wɔhiɛ akãa shi.

english_verse: People sleep during the night, and some even get drunk.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛi ni wɔɔ lɛ, nyɔɔŋ mli amɛwɔɔ, ni mɛi ni tɔrɔɔ dãa lɛ, nyɔɔŋ mli amɛtɔrɔɔ.

english_verse: But we belong to the day. So we must stay sober and let our faith and love be like a suit of armor. Our firm hope that we will be saved is our helmet.
translation_verse: Shi wɔ lɛ, akɛni shwanebii ji wɔ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔhiɛ akãa shi ni wɔwo hemɔkɛyeli kɛ suɔmɔ dama lɛ ni wɔbumɔ dade fai ni ji yiwalaheremɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: God doesn't intend to punish us, but wants us to be saved by our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ etooo wɔ ehãaa mlifu, shi moŋ hã yiwalaheremɔnamɔ kɛtsɔ̃ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ,

english_verse: Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes.
translation_verse: mɔ ni gbo wɔyi gbele, koni wɔhiɛ kãmɔ jio, wɔwɔ jio, wɔkɛ lɛ ahi shi lɛ.

english_verse: This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing. Final Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Hewɔ lɛ nyɛshɛjeshɛjea nyɛhe mii, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahã enaanyo nane amɔ shi, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ. Naagbee ŋaawoi kɛ ŋamɔi

english_verse: My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord.
translation_verse: Shi, anyɛmimɛi, wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai akɛ nyɛle mɛi ni tsuɔ nii yɛ nyɛteŋ ni amɛyeɔ nyɛnɔ onukpa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli ni amɛwieɔ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other.
translation_verse: Nyɛbua amɛ naakpa diɛŋtsɛ yɛ suɔmɔ mli, yɛ amɛnitsumɔ lɛ hewɔ. Nyɛhãa hejɔlɛ ahĩa nyɛteŋ.

english_verse: My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone.
translation_verse: Ni wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛwiea nyɛtsɔ̃a hejɔ̃lɔi lɛ, nyɛwoa gbeyelɔi lɛ ekãa; nyɛwaa mɛi ni yɔɔ gbedee lɛ; nyɛtoa nyɛtsui shi nyɛhãa mɛi fɛɛ.

english_verse: Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
translation_verse: Nyɛkwɛa ni ahĩa koni mɔ ko kɛ efɔŋ akato efɔŋ najiaŋ, shi moŋ daa nɛɛ nyɛnyiɛa ekpakpafeemɔ sɛɛ nyɛhãhãa nyɛhe kɛ mɛi fɛɛ.

english_verse: Always be joyful
translation_verse: Nyɛnaa miishɛɛ daa,

english_verse: and never stop praying.
translation_verse: nyɛsɔlea ni nyɛkafɔa;

english_verse: Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: nyɛdaa shi yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli. Ejaakɛ enɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii yɛ Kristo Yesu mli yɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋ.

english_verse: Don't turn away God's Spirit
translation_verse: Nyɛkagbea Mumɔ lɛ;

english_verse: or ignore prophecies.
translation_verse: nyɛkagbea gbalɛi lɛ ahe guɔ.

english_verse: Put everything to the test. Accept what is good
translation_verse: Nyɛkaa nii fiaa nyɛkwɛa, ni nɔ ni hi lɛ nyɛmɔa no mli.

english_verse: and don't have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Nyɛtsia nyɛhe kɛjɛa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ efɔŋ su lɛ he.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Shi hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ atsuu nyɛhe kwraa kɛmɔ shi, ni eto nyɛmumɔ kɛ nyɛsusuma kɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtso muu lɛ fɛɛ ni shwamɔ ko akahi he yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo baa be lɛ mli.

english_verse: The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.
translation_verse: Anɔkwafo ji mɔ ni tsɛɔ nyɛ lɛ, ni eeefee hu.

english_verse: Friends, please pray for us.
translation_verse: Anyɛmimɛi, nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa wɔ hu.

english_verse: Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Nyɛŋaa nyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ naashwɔmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ.

english_verse: In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
translation_verse: Miikã nyɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kitã akɛ nyɛhãa akanea nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ atsɔ̃a nyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ!

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi!

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Paulo kɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo ŋma yahã Tesalonikabii asafo ni yɔɔ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo mli lɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ dɛŋ ahã nyɛ! Kojomɔ yɛ Kristo baa be lɛ mli

english_verse: My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time.
translation_verse: Eji wɔgbɛnaa akɛ wɔdaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi daa yɛ nyɛhewɔ, anyɛmimɛi, tamɔ bɔ ni sa lɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ miida naakpa, ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ suɔmɔ ni ekɛsumɔɔ enanemɛi lɛ miifa kɛmiiya nɔ hu.

english_verse: This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, wɔdiɛŋtsɛ tete wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ asafoi lɛ amli, yɛ nyɛhiɛmiamɔ kɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli ni nyɛhiɛ yɛ nyɛyiwalɛi kɛ nyɛmanehului ni nyɛnaa lɛ amli lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering.
translation_verse: Eji Nyɔŋmɔ kojomɔ ni ja gbɛ lɛ he okadi, koni abu nyɛ akɛ nyɛsa Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli ni nyɛnaa he nɔ lɛ,
