english_verse: It is only right for God to punish everyone who is causing you trouble,
translation_verse: akɛni eja yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ akɛ mɛi ni haoɔ nyɛ lɛ, eeehao amɛ eto najiaŋ,

english_verse: but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels
translation_verse: ni nyɛ mɛi ni ahaoɔ nyɛ lɛ, eeehã nyɛ kɛ wɔ fɛɛ hejɔɔmɔ, be ni aaajie Nuŋtsɔ Yesu kpo kɛaajɛ ŋwɛi kɛ ebɔfoi ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ.

english_verse: and with a flaming fire. Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message.
translation_verse: Ekɛ lalilɛi aaatɔ owele yɛ mɛi ni leee Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mɛi ni booo wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ toi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: Their punishment will be eternal destruction, and they will be kept far from the presence of our Lord and his glorious strength.
translation_verse: Amɛaana nyɔmɔwoo ni ji naanɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ, ni aaajie amɛ kɛaajɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ anunyam lɛ he,

english_verse: This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.
translation_verse: be ni eeeba koni awo ehiɛ nyam yɛ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ amli ni ana enaakpɛɛnii yɛ eheyelɔi lɛ fɛɛ amli yɛ nakai Gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ ahe wɔdase ni wɔye wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ aye.

english_verse: God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do.
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ hu ni wɔsɔleɔ daa wɔhãa nyɛ, koni wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ abu nyɛ akɛ mɛi ni sa tsɛmɔ lɛ ni ekɛ ehewalɛ lɛ ahã ekpakpafeemɔ he miishɛɛ fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ kɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli nitsumɔ lɛ ayi obɔ̃,

english_verse: Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: bɔ ni afee ni awo wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam yɛ nyɛmli ni nyɛ hu nyɛhiɛ aba nyam yɛ emli, yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ naa.

english_verse: When our Lord Jesus returns, we will be gathered up to meet him. So I ask you, my friends,
translation_verse: Shi wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo baa lɛ kɛ wɔnaa ni abaabua yɛ eŋɔɔ lɛ hewɔ

english_verse: not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters.
translation_verse: akɛ nyɛkahãa ahã nyɛjwɛŋmɔ futu oya, ni asaŋ nyɛkahãa akɛ mumɔ ko loo wiemɔ ko loo wolo ko ni aaakɛɛ akɛ ejɛ wɔŋɔɔ lɛ miihã nyɛhao akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Gbi lɛ eshɛ etã.

english_verse: But don't be fooled! People will rebel against God. Then before the Lord returns, the wicked one who is doomed to be destroyed will appear.
translation_verse: Nyɛkahãa mɔ ko miishishiua nyɛ yɛ gbɛ ko gbɛ ko nɔ; ejaakɛ ja jamɔkwamɔ lɛ eba fɛɛ dã ni aaajie mlakwamɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ni ji hiɛkpãtãmɔ bi lɛ kpo.

english_verse: He will brag and oppose everything holy or sacred. He will even sit in God's temple and claim to be God.
translation_verse: Eteɔ shi ewoɔ ehe nɔ eshiɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni atsɛɔ nyɔŋmɔ loo jamɔ lɛ aahu bɔ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyataa Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ ni ekɛ ehe tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
translation_verse: Nyɛkaiii akɛ be ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ nyɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ lo?

english_verse: You already know what is holding this wicked one back until it is time for him to come.
translation_verse: Ni agbɛnɛ lɛ, nɔ ni tsiɔ ekpojiemɔ lɛ gbɛ kɛyashi ebe aaashɛ lɛ, nyɛle.

english_verse: His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mlakwamɔ teemɔsane lɛ miitsu nii momo, shi kɛyashi mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ aaaje jɛi kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.
translation_verse: Ni no dani aaajie mlakwalɔ lɛ kpo; Nuŋtsɔ Yesu kɛ edaaŋ mumɔ lɛ aaagbe lɛ ni ekɛ ebaa lɛ puemɔ lɛ aaakpãtã ehiɛ.

english_verse: When the wicked one appears, Satan will pretend to work all kinds of miracles, wonders, and signs.
translation_verse: Mlakwalɔ nɛɛ, Satan nitsumɔ nɔ ebaatsɔ̃ kɛba kɛ amale hewalɛ kɛ amale okadii kɛ amale naakpɛɛnii,

english_verse: Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it.
translation_verse: kɛ efɔŋ mli shishiumɔ fɛɛ ni akɛ shishiuɔ mɛi ni hiɛ baakpãtã ejaakɛ amɛmɔ̃ɔɔ anɔkwale suɔmɔ lɛ mli ni akɛhere amɛyiwala lɛ.

english_verse: So God will make sure they are fooled into believing a lie.
translation_verse: Ni enɛ hewɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsuɔ shishiumɔ hewalɛ kɛbaa amɛŋɔɔ ni amɛhe amale amɛye,

english_verse: All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth. Be Faithful
translation_verse: koni akojo mɛi fɛɛ ni heee anɔkwale lɛ amɛyeee, shi amɛnaa efɔŋ moŋ he tsui lɛ. Ahala nyɛ kɛhã yiwalaheremɔ

english_verse: My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth.
translation_verse: Shi wɔ lɛ, esa akɛ wɔdaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi daa yɛ nyɛhewɔ, anyɛmimɛi ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ sumɔɔ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehala nyɛ akɛ klɛŋklɛŋ yibii ehã yiwalaheremɔ kɛtsɔ̃ nyɛhe ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tsuɔ kɛ he ni nyɛheɔ anɔkwale lɛ nyɛyeɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Enɛ mli etsɔ̃ wɔSanekpakpa lɛ nɔ etsɛ nyɛ kɛba, koni nyɛna wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo anunyam lɛ.

english_verse: My friends, this is why you must remain faithful and follow closely what we taught you in person and by our letters.
translation_verse: Belɛ no hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛfĩa shi, ni nyɛhiɛa nii ni wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ yɛ wiemɔ mli loo wolo mli lɛ mli.

english_verse: God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father
translation_verse: Shi lɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni sumɔ wɔ ni ekɛ naanɔ miishɛjemɔ kɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ kpakpa hã wɔ yɛ dromɔ naa lɛ,

english_verse: will encourage you and help you always to do and say the right thing.
translation_verse: lɛ nɔŋŋ eshɛje nyɛmii ni ewaje nyɛ yɛ wiemɔ kpakpa kɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ mli.

english_verse: Finally, our friends, please pray for us. This will help the message about the Lord to spread quickly, and others will respect it, just as you do.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa wɔ koni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ agbɛ ashwã oyayaayai ni awo ehiɛ nyam, tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith.
translation_verse: Ni ajie wɔ kɛjɛ yiwalɔi gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ adɛŋ, ejaakɛ jeee mɛi fɛɛ yɔɔ hemɔkɛyeli.

english_verse: But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Shi anɔkwafo ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, mɔ ni aaawaje nyɛ ni eeebu nyɛhe ni ejie nyɛ kɛjɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ.

english_verse: He has made us sure that you are obeying what we taught you and that you will keep on obeying.
translation_verse: Wɔhiɛ kã nyɛnɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli akɛ nii ni wɔwoɔ nyɛ he kitã lɛ, nyɛmiifee ni nyɛaafee hu.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ. Warnings against Laziness
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ lɛ akudɔ nyɛtsuii kɛya Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ kɛ Kristo tsuishiŋmɛɛ lɛ mli. Esa akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ atsu nii

english_verse: My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you.
translation_verse: Shi anyɛmimɛi, wɔmiiwo nyɛ kitã yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbɛi mli, akɛ nyɛtsia nyɛhe kɛjɛa nyɛmi fɛɛ nyɛmi ni feɔ hejɔ̃ ni ehiii shi yɛ nii ni wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ naa lɛ he.

english_verse: You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle akɛ esa akɛ nyɛkaseɔ wɔ; ejaakɛ wɔfeee wɔhe hejɔ̃lɔi yɛ nyɛteŋ.

english_verse: and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
translation_verse: Ni asaŋ wɔyeee mɔ ko ŋmaa yaka, shi moŋ wɔkɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ kɛ tɔlɛ tsuɔ nii nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane bɔ ni afee ni wɔkafee jatsu wɔmiihã nyɛteŋ mɔ ko.

english_verse: We had the right not to work, but we wanted to set an example for you.
translation_verse: Jeee akɛ wɔbɛ nakai hegbɛ, shi moŋ, koni wɔkɛ wɔhe afee nɔkwɛmɔnɔ wɔhã nyɛ ni nyɛkase.

english_verse: We also gave you this rule: If you don't work, you don't eat.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ be ni wɔkɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ hu, wɔwo nyɛ kitã akɛ, “Kɛ mɔ ko sumɔɔɔ akɛ etsuɔ nii lɛ, belɛ ekaye nii hu.”

english_verse: Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔnuɔ akɛ mɛi komɛi yɛ nyɛteŋ ni feɔ hejɔ̃, ni amɛtsuuu nii, shi moŋ amɛkɛ amɛhe woɔ mɛi asaji amli.

english_verse: So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living.
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ mɛi nɛɛ wɔmiiwo amɛ kitã ni wɔmiiwo amɛŋaa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo mli akɛ amɛtsu nii waa ni amɛye amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛdɛŋ ŋmaa.

english_verse: Dear friends, you must never become tired of doing right.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛkahãa ekpakpafeemɔ miitɔa nyɛ.

english_verse: Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ mɔ ko booo wɔwiemɔ ni yɔɔ wolo lɛ mli lɛ toi lɛ, nyɛkadia lɛ, ni nyɛkɛ lɛ akabɔa, koni ehiɛ agbo;

english_verse: Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower. Final Prayer
translation_verse: ni nyɛkabua lɛ akɛ henyɛlɔ, shi moŋ nyɛwiea nyɛtsɔ̃a lɛ akɛ nyɛmi. Naagbee wiemɔ

english_verse: I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.
translation_verse: Shi lɛ hejɔlɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ahã nyɛ hejɔlɛ daa yɛ gbɛ fɛɛ gbɛ nɔ. Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi.

english_verse: I always sign my letters as I am now doing: PAUL.
translation_verse: Mi Paulo diɛŋtsɛ minine naa bimɔ ni ji okadi yɛ miwolo fɛɛ wolo mli nɛ; bɔ ni miŋmaa nɛ.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul. God our Savior and Christ Jesus commanded me to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.
translation_verse: Paulo ni ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ, kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo, wɔhiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ, famɔ naa lɛ,

english_verse: Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace! Warning against False Teaching
translation_verse: ŋma yahã Timoteo ni ji ebi krɔŋŋ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ. Dromɔ, mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔTsɛ lɛ, kɛ Yesu Kristo, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, dɛŋ ahã bo! Amale tsɔ̃ɔmɔ he kɔkɔbɔɔ

english_verse: When I was leaving for Macedonia, I asked you to stay on in Ephesus and warn certain people there to stop spreading their false teachings.
translation_verse: Tamɔ bɔ ni be ni miyaa Makedonia ni mikpa bo fai akɛ ohi shi yɛ Efeso, koni obɔ mɛi komɛi akɔkɔ akɛ amɛkatsɔ̃ɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi krokomɛi.

english_verse: You needed to warn them to stop wasting their time on senseless stories and endless lists of ancestors. Such things only cause arguments. They don't help anyone to do God's work that can only be done by faith.
translation_verse: Ni asaŋ obɔ kɔkɔ akɛ amɛkadi adesãi kɛ wekukpãa tsɔ̃ɔmɔ tsralaa lɛ sɛɛ, ejaakɛ enɛɛmɛi kɛ yaka hiɛklamɔ baa fe akɛ eeewa wɔ ni wɔle Nyɔŋmɔ yiwalaheremɔ he yiŋtoo, ni hemɔkɛyeli sane ni lɛ, nakai fai mikpaa bo ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: You must teach people to have genuine love, as well as a good conscience and true faith.
translation_verse: Shi ŋaawoo lɛ oti ji suɔmɔ ni jɛ tsui ni mli tse kɛ henilee kpakpa kɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni osato ko bɛ mli lɛ mli.

english_verse: There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk.
translation_verse: Enɛɛmɛi ji nii ni mɛi komɛi eje sɛɛ, ni amɛkpale kɛtee yaka wiemɔ he.

english_verse: They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
translation_verse: Amɛmiitao amɛtsɔ̃mɔ mlatsɔɔlɔi, tsɛ amɛnaaa nii ni amɛkɛɔ lɛ loo nii ni amɛwieɔ kɛ nɔmimaa lɛ shishi.

english_verse: We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way.
translation_verse: Wɔle akɛ Mla lɛ hi kɛji mɔ ko kɛtsu nii bɔ ni Mla lɛ taoɔ lɛ.

english_verse: We also understand it wasn't given to control people who please God, but to control lawbreakers, criminals, godless people, and sinners. It is for wicked and evil people, and for murderers, who would even kill their own parents.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ale enɛ faŋŋ akɛ Mla lɛ, jeee jalɔ hewɔ awo, shi mɛi ahewɔ ni awo moŋ ji mlatɔ̃lɔi kɛ toigbolɔi, mɛi ni he tseee kɛ hebulelɔi, tsɛgbelɔi kɛ nyɛgbelɔi, gbɔmɔgbelɔi,

english_verse: The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching
translation_verse: ajwamãŋbɔlɔi, hii ni kɛ hii wɔɔ, gbɔmɔ julɔi, amalelɔi, kitãmlikulɔi, kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kpakpa lɛ yeee lɛ,

english_verse: of the good news the glorious and wonderful God has given me. Being Thankful for God's Kindness
translation_verse: yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ajɔɔ lɛ lɛ anunyam Sanekpakpa ni atu awo midɛŋ lɛ naa. Paulo daa Nyɔŋmɔ shi yɛ etsɛmɔ hewɔ

english_verse: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me the strength for my work because he knew he could trust me.
translation_verse: Miida wɔNuŋtsɔ Kristo Yesu ni wo mi hewalɛ lɛ shi, akɛ ebu mi anɔkwafo, ni eŋɔ mi ewo sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli,

english_verse: I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him.
translation_verse: mi ni tsutsu lɛ mi ji musubɔlɔ kɛ mɛi ayiwalɔ kɛ mɛi aniseniianifeelɔ lɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ ana mi mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ mileee ni mifee, yɛ he ni miheee miyeee hewɔ.

english_verse: Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
translation_verse: Shi wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ dromɔ lɛ fa hã mi aahu kɛteke nɔ, ni nɔ ni fata he kɛba ji hemɔkɛyeli kɛ suɔmɔ ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ.

english_verse: “Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all!
translation_verse: Eji anɔkwa wiemɔ ni sa akɛ amɔ mli kwraa, akɛ Kristo Yesu ba je nɛɛŋ eba eshafeelɔi ayiwalaheremɔ, mɛi ateŋ ni mi mi ji oti lɛ;

english_verse: But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life.
translation_verse: shi kɛ̃lɛ enɛ hewɔ ni ana mi mɔbɔ lɛ, koni mi tsutsu mimli Yesu Kristo ajie etsuishitoo lɛ fɛɛ kpo yɛ, ni akɛto mɛi ni baahe enɔ aye ni amɛna naanɔ wala lɛ okadi.

english_verse: I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.
translation_verse: Shi naanɔi aMaŋtsɛ lɛ, mɔ ni gbooo, mɔ ni anaaa, mɔ ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ kome lɛ, aŋɔ woo kɛ anunyam ahã kɛyashi naanɔi anaanɔ. Amen! Timoteo gbɛnaa nitsumɔ

english_verse: Timothy, my son, the instructions I am giving you are based on what some prophets once said about you. If you follow these instructions, you will fight like a good soldier.
translation_verse: Kitã ni miwoɔ bo nɛ, mibi Timoteo, yɛ gbalɛi ni agba kɛtsɔ̃ hiɛ yɛ ohe lɛ anaa, koni okɛwu ta kpakpa lɛ,

english_verse: You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences.
translation_verse: ni ohiɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ henilee kpakpa. Nɔ ni mɛi komɛi shɛrɛ shwie ni amɛyasha shi yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
translation_verse: Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ji Himeneo kɛ Aleksandro, mɛi ni mitu miwo Satan dɛŋ, koni atsɔse amɛ ni amɛkawie musubɔɔ wiemɔi dɔŋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ni miwoɔ he ŋaa ji akɛ ahiɛ faikpamɔi, sɔlemɔi, mlidaamɔi, shidai amli, ahã gbɔmɛi fɛɛ,

english_verse: Pray for kings and others in power, so we may live quiet and peaceful lives as we worship and honor God.
translation_verse: ahã maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yeɔ onukpa lɛ, koni wɔhi shi kpoo yɛ hejɔlɛ mli, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ kɛ jeŋba ni hiɛ sɔɔ fɛɛ mli.

english_verse: This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ enɛ hi ni esa Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is,
translation_verse: Esumɔɔ akɛ ehere gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ayiwala, koni amɛshɛ anɔkwale lɛ lee mli.

english_verse: There is only one God, and Christ Jesus is the only one who can bring us to God. Jesus was truly human, and he gave himself to rescue all of us.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kome yɔɔ, kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋdamɔlɔ kome hu ni ji gbɔmɔ Kristo Yesu lɛ,

english_verse: I want everyone everywhere to lift innocent hands toward heaven and pray, without being angry or arguing with each other.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, miitao akɛ hii asɔle yɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛhole niji ni he tse nɔ ni mlifu loo naataamɔ akaba mli.

english_verse: I would like for women to wear modest and sensible clothes. They should not have fancy hairdos, or wear expensive clothes, or put on jewelry made of gold or pearls.
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ yei hu, amɛkɛ atade ni sa kɛ hiɛ ni gboɔ nɔ kɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ awula amɛhe, jeee kɛ yigbɔɔ loo shika loo adiagbai loo atade ni jara wa,

english_verse: Women who claim to love God should do helpful things for others,
translation_verse: shi moŋ kɛ nitsumɔi kpakpai ni sa yei ni tsɛɔ amɛhe akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jalɔi lɛ.

english_verse: and they should learn by being quiet and paying attention.
translation_verse: Yoo afee dioo ni ekɛ heshibaa fɛɛ akase nii.

english_verse: They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do.
translation_verse: Shi mihãaa yoo hegbɛ akɛ etsɔ̃ɔ nii aloo eye nuu nɔ, shi moŋ efee dioo.

english_verse: After all, Adam was created before Eve,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Adam tsutsu abɔ, no sɛɛ lɛ Hawa.

english_verse: and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned.
translation_verse: Ni jeee Adam alaka lɛ, shi yoo lɛ alaka lɛ, ni ebote nɔtɔmɔ mli.

english_verse: But women will be saved by having children, if they stay faithful, loving, holy, and modest.
translation_verse: Shi aaahere eyiwala kɛaatsɔ̃ bifɔmɔ nɔ, kɛji ehi shi kɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ suɔmɔ kɛ hetsemɔ kɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ.

english_verse: It is true that anyone who desires to be a church official wants to be something worthwhile.
translation_verse: Anɔkwa wiemɔ nɛ: kɛ mɔ ko miitao nɔkwɛmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ, eetao nitsumɔ kpakpa.

english_verse: That's why officials must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. They must be self-controlled, sensible, well-behaved, friendly to strangers, and able to teach.
translation_verse: Shi esa akɛ nɔkwɛlɔ lɛ afee mɔ ni anaŋ ehe sane ko atã, mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋa kome, hiɛshikãlɔ, mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ mli tse, mɔ ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ, gbɔfeelɔ, mɔ ni le nitsɔɔmɔ,

english_verse: They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.
translation_verse: jeee dãanulɔ, jeee ninekpokpookpotsɛ, shi moŋ mɔ ni he jɔ, mɔ ni beee, mɔ ni hiɛ ekɔ̃ɔɔ shika nɔ,

english_verse: Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful.
translation_verse: mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe nɔ jogbaŋŋ, ni ebii boɔ lɛ toi kɛ woo fɛɛ.

english_verse: If they don't know how to control their own families, how can they look after God's people?
translation_verse: Shi kɛ mɔ ko leee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe nɔ yeli lɛ, te eeefee tɛŋŋ ekwɛ Nyɔŋmɔ asafo lɛ hu?

english_verse: They must not be new followers of the Lord. If they are, they might become proud and be doomed along with the devil.
translation_verse: Asaŋ jeee mɔ ni bote Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ mli etsɛko, koni ekawo ehe nɔ ni egbee kojomɔ ni abonsam gbee mli lɛ mli.

english_verse: Finally, they must be well-respected by people who are not followers. Then they won't be trapped and disgraced by the devil. Church Officers
translation_verse: Shi sa akɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ hu aye ehe odase kpakpa, koni ehe guɔ akagbo ni ekagbee abonsam tsɔne mli. Asafoŋ sɔ̃ɔlɔi

english_verse: Church officers should be serious. They must not be liars, heavy drinkers, or greedy for money.
translation_verse: Asafo mli sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ hu esa akɛ amɛfee gbɔmɛi ni hiɛ tsii, jeee lilɛintatsɛmɛi, jeee mɛi ni sumɔɔ dãa, jeee hiɛjoolɔi,

english_verse: And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith.
translation_verse: shi mɛi ni hiɛɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ teemɔ sane lɛ yɛ henilee ni he tse mli.

english_verse: They must first prove themselves. Then if no one has anything against them, they can serve as officers.
translation_verse: Shi mɛnɛɛmɛi hu aka amɛ akwɛ fɛɛ dã; no sɛɛ lɛ, kɛ sane ko bɛ amɛhe lɛ, amɛsɔ̃mɔ.

english_verse: Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
translation_verse: Yei lɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ; amɛfee mɛi ni hiɛ tsii, jeee oshekuyelɔi shi mɛi ni hiɛ kã shi, ni amɛyeɔ anɔkwa yɛ nii fɛɛ mli.

english_verse: Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home.
translation_verse: Asafo mli sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ amɛfee ŋa komekome tsɛmɛi, mɛi ni yeɔ amɛbii kɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshĩai anɔ jogbaŋŋ.

english_verse: Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus. The Mystery of Our Religion
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ jogbaŋŋ lɛ amɛnaa gbɛnaa kpakpa amɛhãa amɛhe, ni amɛnaa ekãa babaoo yɛ Kristo Yesu nɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli. Teemɔ sane wulu lɛ

english_verse: I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions,
translation_verse: Mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ etsɛŋ ni maba oŋɔɔ; shi miiŋma bo enɛɛmɛi

english_verse: so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.
translation_verse: koni kɛ mitsɛ lɛ, ni ole bɔ ni sa akɛ oba ojeŋ ohã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ we ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ asafo lɛ, anɔkwale lɛ akulashiŋ kɛ nɔdaamɔnɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: Here is the great mystery of our religion: Christ came as a human. The Spirit proved that he pleased God, and he was seen by angels. Christ was preached to the nations. People in this world put their faith in him, and he was taken up to glory.
translation_verse: Ni nɔ ko ni ŋwanejee ko bɛ he akɛ eda kpeteŋkple ji Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ teemɔ sane lɛ: Nyɔŋmɔ jie ehe shi faŋŋ yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli, abu lɛ bem yɛ mumɔ mli, bɔfoi na lɛ, ashiɛ lɛ yɛ jeŋmaji ateŋ, ahe enɔ aye yɛ jeŋ, aŋɔ lɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi yɛ anunyam mli.

english_verse: God's Spirit clearly says that in the last days many people will turn from their faith. They will be fooled by evil spirits and by teachings that come from demons.
translation_verse: Shi Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ faŋŋ akɛ naagbee gbii lɛ amli lɛ mɛi komɛi aaakwa hemɔkɛyeli lɛ, ni amɛaabo lakamɔ mumɔi kɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji atsɔ̃ɔmɔi atoi

english_verse: They will also be fooled by the false claims of liars whose consciences have lost all feeling. These liars
translation_verse: kɛtsɔ̃ amalelɔi asatofeemɔ nɔ; amalelɔi ni ashã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhenilee, tamɔ akɛ dade kɛ la shãa nɔ lɛ;

english_verse: will forbid people to marry or to eat certain foods. But God created these foods to be eaten with thankful hearts by his followers who know the truth.
translation_verse: amɛtsiɔ yooŋɔɔ gbɛ, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ahi ŋmaa ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ akɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ ni amɛle anɔkwale lɛ kɛ shidaa aye lɛ.

english_verse: Everything God created is good. And if you give thanks, you may eat anything.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ lɛ ehi, ni ahiii nɔ ko nɔ ko ni akɛ shidaa yeɔ lɛ,

english_verse: What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat. Paul's Advice to Timothy
translation_verse: ejaakɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ kɛ sɔlemɔ tsuɔ he. Kristo Yesu sɔ̃ɔlɔ kpakpa

english_verse: If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed.
translation_verse: Kɛji otsɔ̃ɔ nyɛmimɛi lɛ enɛɛmɛi lɛ, obaafee ohe Kristo Yesu sɔ̃ɔlɔ kpakpa, mɔ ni kɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kpakpa ni onyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ wiemɔi lɛ lɛɔ ehe.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious.
translation_verse: Shi yeimeji ayakayaka adesãi lɛ, tsi ohe kɛjɛ he. Ni otsɔse ohe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ mli moŋ.

english_verse: We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ wɔgboɔ deŋme ni wɔpeleɔ wɔhiɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ efɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɔ, mɔ ni ji gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ayiwalaherelɔ lɛ, titri lɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Teach these things and tell everyone to do what you say.
translation_verse: Wo nibii nɛɛ ahe kitã ni otsɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.
translation_verse: Kaahã mɔ ko miibu akɛ ojeee mɔ ko yɛ oblanyo ni oji lɛ hewɔ, shi moŋ okɛ ohe ato okadi ohã mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ, yɛ wiemɔ mli, yɛ hetsemɔ mli.

english_verse: Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Okɛ ojwɛŋmɔ afɔ̃ ŋmalɛi lɛ akanemɔ kɛ asafo lɛ hamɔ kɛ ŋaawoo kɛ nitsɔɔmɔ nɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maba.

english_verse: Use the gift you were given when the prophets spoke and the group of church leaders blessed you by placing their hands on you.
translation_verse: Kaaŋmɛɛ dromɔkeenɔ ni yɔɔ omli ni atsɔ̃ gbalɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ aniji ni akɛshwie onɔ lɛ nɔ akɛhã bo lɛ he.

english_verse: Remember these things and think about them, so everyone can see how well you are doing.
translation_verse: Tsu nii nɛɛ ahe nii, okɛ ohe awo mli kwraa, koni mɛi fɛɛ ana onɔyaa faŋŋ.

english_verse: Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
translation_verse: Ohiɛ ahi ohe nɔ, ohiɛ ahi tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ nɔ, hii shi yɛ nii nɛɛ amli; ejaakɛ kɛji ofee enɛ lɛ, ooohere bo diɛŋtsɛ kɛ mɛi ni boɔ bo toi lɛ fɛɛ ayiwala.

english_verse: Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother,
translation_verse: Kaafãmɔ onukpa ko, shi moŋ owie otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ tsɛ; oblahii hu akɛ nyɛmimɛi;

english_verse: and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.
translation_verse: yei onukpai lɛ akɛ nyɛmɛi; oblayei lɛ hu akɛ nyɛmimɛiyei yɛ hetsemɔ fɛɛ mli. Timoteo gbɛnaa nitsumɔ hã okulafoi

english_verse: Take care of any widow who is really in need.
translation_verse: Yei okulafoi ni ji okulafoi lɛɛlɛŋ lɛ wo amɛ.

english_verse: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ yoo okulafo ko yɛ bii loo nabii lɛ, amɛkase Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshĩa tsutsu, ni amɛto amɛfɔlɔi lɛ anajiaŋ pɛpɛɛpɛ; ejaakɛ enɛ sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.

english_verse: A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni ji yoo okulafo lɛɛlɛŋ ni eshwɛ ekome too lɛ, ekɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ ni ehiɛɔ faikpamɔi kɛ sɔlemɔi amli nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane.

english_verse: A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
translation_verse: Shi yoo okulafo ni bɔɔ ahoshwi lɛ, ehiɛ kã nɛ, shi egbo.

english_verse: Tell all this to everyone, so they will do the right thing.
translation_verse: Wo amɛ kitãi nɛɛ, koni akana amɛhe sane ko atã.

english_verse: People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ mɔ ko kwɛɛɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi, titri lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshĩabii lɛ, ekpa yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ sɛɛ, ni efaŋ mɔ ni heee yeee fe lɛ.

english_verse: For a widow to be put on the list of widows, she must be at least
translation_verse: Akaŋɔ yoo okulafo ko awo sɔ̃ɔmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ mli akɛ ja mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa ni egbã nuu kome

english_verse: She must also be well-known for doing all sorts of good things, such as raising children, giving food to strangers, welcoming God's people into her home, helping people in need, and always making herself useful.
translation_verse: ni ayeɔ enitsumɔi kpakpai ahe odase, no ji: kɛ elɛ bii, kɛ efee mɛi agbɔ, kɛ efɔ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi anaji ahe, kɛ eye ebua mɛi ni naa amanehulu lɛ, kɛ edi nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa sɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ
translation_verse: Shi yei okulafoi ni drako lɛ, kaaŋɔ amɛ; ejaakɛ kɛ akɔnɔ te shi yɛ amɛmli ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ Kristo he lɛ, amɛtaoɔ gbãlã,

english_verse: and become guilty of breaking their promise to him.
translation_verse: ni amɛnaa kojomɔ ejaakɛ amɛku amɛklɛŋklɛŋ shiwoo lɛ mli.

english_verse: Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.
translation_verse: Ni amɛsaa amɛkaseɔ hejɔ̃feemɔ, amɛkpaa shi yɛ shĩai, ni jeee hejɔ̃lɔi kɛkɛ amɛtsɔ̃mɔɔ, shi amɛwiewieɔ mɛi ahe hu, amɛkɛ amɛhe woɔ mɛi asaji amli, amɛwieɔ nii ni esaaa.

english_verse: I would prefer that young widows get married, have children, and look after their families. Then the enemy won't have any reason to say insulting things about us.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, miisumɔ akɛ yei okulafoi ni drako lɛ agbã, ni amɛfɔ bii, ni amɛye amɛwe nɔ, ni amɛkahã henyɛlɔ lɛ miina hegbɛ ko kɛmiijɛ wɔ.

english_verse: If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need. Church Leaders
translation_verse: Shi kɛ nuu loo yoo heyelɔ ko yɛ wekumɛi yei okulafoi lɛ, ekwɛ amɛ, ni jatsu akakã asafo lɛ nɔ, koni asafo lɛ akwɛ okulafoi ni ji okulafoi lɛɛlɛŋ lɛ. Timoteo gbɛnaa nitsumɔ hã asafonukpai

english_verse: Church leaders who do their job well deserve to be paid twice as much, especially if they work hard at preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Onukpai ni tsuɔ amɛnii jogbaŋŋ akɛ nɔkwɛlɔi lɛ, abu amɛ akɛ amɛsa woo toi enyɔ, titri lɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ shiɛmɔ kɛ nitsɔɔmɔ he nii waa lɛ.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, “Kaawo tsina ni gbɛlɛɔ abele naabu kotoku;” kɛ, “Nitsulɔ lɛ, enyɔmɔwoo sa lɛ.”

english_verse: Don't listen to any charge against a church leader, unless at least two or three people bring the same charges.
translation_verse: Kɛ afolɔ onukpa ko naa lɛ, kaahe okpɛ̃lɛ akɛ ja yɛ odasefoi enyɔ loo etɛ̃ naa dã.

english_verse: But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni feɔ esha lɛ, okã amɛ yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ, koni mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ hu ashe gbeyei.

english_verse: In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.
translation_verse: Miiwo bo kitã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Kristo Yesu kɛ ebɔfoi ni ehala lɛ ahiɛ, akɛ oye nii nɛɛ anɔ ni okasha ohe okojo, ni asaŋ okafee nɔ ko kɛ niiaŋkpamɔ.

english_verse: Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them. Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
translation_verse: Kɛ oniji akashwie mɔ ko nɔ oya, ni asaŋ kaafata mɛi krokomɛi ahe kɛfee esha. Too ohe krɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
translation_verse: Kaanu nu kɛkɛ dɔŋŋ, shi nuu wain fioo yɛ omusu kɛ ohelai ni yeɔ bo kpitiokpitio lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later.
translation_verse: Mɛi komɛi ahe eshai jeɔ kpo faŋŋ, ni enyiɛɔ amɛhiɛ ekɛ amɛ yaa kojomɔ mli, shi mɛi komɛi anɔ hu nyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ.

english_verse: It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ nitsumɔi kpakpai hu jeɔ kpo faŋŋ, ni nii ni ejeee kpo lɛ hu anyɛŋ akɛtee.

english_verse: If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching.
translation_verse: Tsuji abɔ ni yɔɔ apã shishi lɛ abu amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ akɛ mɛi ni sa woo fɛɛ, koni akawie Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛi lɛ kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he musubɔɔ wiemɔ.

english_verse: If any of you slaves have owners who are followers, you should show them respect. After all, they are also followers of Christ, and he loves them. So you should serve and help them the best you can. False Teaching and True Wealth These are the things you must teach and tell the people to do.
translation_verse: Shi tsuji ni yɔɔ nuŋtsɔmɛi heyelɔi lɛ akaŋɔ lɛ akɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ nyɛmimɛi ji amɛ hewɔ lɛ esaaa akɛ hiɛ sɔɔ amɛ, shi moŋ amɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛ jogbaŋŋ ejaakɛ mɛi ni naa sɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ he sɛɛ lɛ nyɛmimɛi heyelɔi kɛ suɔmɔmɛi ji amɛ. Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nii nɛɛ ni owo he ŋaa. Amale tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ anɔkwa ninamɔ

english_verse: Anyone who teaches something different disagrees with the correct and godly teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Kɛ mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kroko ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo wiemɔi ni hi lɛ kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ naa lɛ nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions,
translation_verse: no lɛ ewo ehe nɔ, eleee nɔ ko, shi moŋ eeye ŋwanejee kɛ naataamɔ hela, ni nibii ni jɛɔ mli ji hiɛkɔ̃ɔ, bei, oshekuyeli, mɛi ahe susumɔi fɔ̃ji,

english_verse: and nasty quarrels. They have wicked minds and have missed out on the truth. These people think religion is supposed to make you rich.
translation_verse: yakayaka blɔmɔi — enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ mɛi ateŋ ni anaa yɛ ji gbɔmɛi ni amɛjwɛŋmɔ efite ni ashɔ̃ anɔkwale lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ ni amɛsusuɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ ji ninamɔ lɛ.

english_verse: And religion does make your life rich, by making you content with what you have.
translation_verse: Shi lɛɛlɛŋ, ninamɔ kpeteŋkple ji Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ, kɛji mɔ ko miishɛ enii ahe lɛ.

english_verse: We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔkɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko baaa je nɛɛŋ, no hewɔ lɛ, wɔnyɛŋ wɔkɛ nɔ ko aya hu.

english_verse: So we should be satisfied just to have food and clothes.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ wɔyɛ ŋmaa kɛ hehaanii kɛkɛ lɛ, esa akɛ wɔmii ashɛ he.

english_verse: People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps. They are caught by foolish and harmful desires that drag them down and destroy them.
translation_verse: Shi mɛi ni taoɔ afee niiatsɛmɛi lɛ gbeɔ kaa kɛ tsɔne kɛ kwashiai akɔnɔi pii ni fiteɔ mɔ, ni tsiɔ mɛi ewoɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛ laajemɔ mli lɛ amli.

english_verse: The love of money causes all kinds of trouble. Some people want money so much they have given up their faith and caused themselves a lot of pain. Fighting a Good Fight for the Faith
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nibii fɔ̃ji fɛɛ ashĩshifã ji shikasuɔmɔ ni mɛi komɛi di sɛɛ ni amɛdu gbɛ kɛjɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛ piŋmɔi babaoo egbulɔ amɛtsui lɛ. Ŋaawoi

english_verse: Timothy, you belong to God, so keep away from all these evil things. Try your best to please God and to be like him. Be faithful, loving, dependable, and gentle.
translation_verse: Shi bo lɛ, Ao Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, joo nibii nɛɛ anaa foi, ni onyiɛ jalɛ, Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ, hemɔkɛyeli, suɔmɔ, hiɛmiamɔ, kɛ kpoofeemɔ sɛɛ.

english_verse: Fight a good fight for the faith and claim eternal life. God offered it to you when you clearly told about your faith, while so many people listened.
translation_verse: Wuu hemɔkɛyeli he ta kpakpa lɛ, mɔ naanɔ wala lɛ mli, nɔ he hu ni atsɛ bo kɛba ni ojaje jajemɔ fɛɛfɛo yɛ odasefoi pii ahiɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Now I ask you to make a promise. Make it in the presence of God, who gives life to all, and in the presence of Christ Jesus, who openly told Pontius Pilate about his faith.
translation_verse: Miiwo bo kitã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni hãa nibii fiaa wala lɛ kɛ Kristo Yesu ni ye jajemɔ fɛɛfɛo lɛ he odase yɛ Pontio Pilato yinɔ lɛ hiɛ,

english_verse: Promise to obey completely and fully all that you have been told until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: akɛ oye kitã lɛ nɔ, ni kpa ko loo shwamɔ ko akahi he kɛyashi wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo puemɔ lɛ mli,

english_verse: The glorious God is the only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords. At the time that God has already decided, he will send Jesus Christ back again.
translation_verse: nɔ ni nɔyelɔ kome ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ni ajɔɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi aMaŋtsɛ kɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi aNuŋtsɔ lɛ baahã aba mli yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebe ni sa mli lɛ.

english_verse: Only God lives forever! And he lives in light that no one can come near. No human has ever seen God or ever can see him. God will be honored, and his power will last forever. Amen.
translation_verse: Lɛ ekome eyɔɔ naanɔ shihilɛ ni gbele bɛ mli, ni ehiɔ la ni anyɛŋ abɛŋkɛ mli; gbɔmɔ ko gbɔmɔ ko enako lɛ dã, ni enyɛŋ lɛ ena hu lɛ. Enɔ ji woo kɛ naanɔ hewalɛ lɛ. Amen!

english_verse: Warn the rich people of this world not to be proud or to trust in wealth that is easily lost. Tell them to have faith in God, who is rich and blesses us with everything we need to enjoy life.
translation_verse: Niiatsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ je nɛɛŋ lɛ, wo amɛ kitã ni amɛkabu amɛhe tsɔ̃, ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ akafɔ̃ ninamɔ ni anyɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ he afɔ̃ nɔ lɛ nɔ, shi moŋ amɛkɛfɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ hu ni kɛ nibii fɛɛ hãa wɔ babaoo, akɛ wɔye mliŋɔɔmɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Instruct them to do as many good deeds as they can and to help everyone. Remind the rich to be generous and share what they have.
translation_verse: Ni amɛfee ejurɔ ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ niiatsɛmɛi yɛ nitsumɔi kpakpai amli, amɛsumɔ nihãmɔ, amɛdɛŋ akpɔ.

english_verse: This will lay a solid foundation for the future, so they will know what true life is like.
translation_verse: Amɛbɔ jwetri amɛhã amɛhe ni efee shishitoo kpakpa ehã be ni baaba lɛ, koni amɛmɔ anɔkwa wala lɛ mli.

english_verse: Timothy, guard what God has placed in your care! Don't pay any attention to godless and stupid talk that sounds smart but really isn't.
translation_verse: Ao Timoteo, nii ni atu awo odɛ̃ŋ lɛ, baamɔ yi ni okwa yakayaka sanegbaa ni buleɔ mɔ kɛ wiemɔi ni bɛ ekome ni jɛ apasa nilee mli.

english_verse: Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Ni mɛi komɛi tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ amɛyɔɔ ni amɛdu gbɛ kɛjɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ he lɛ. Dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. God himself chose me to be an apostle, and he gave me the promised life that Jesus Christ makes possible.
translation_verse: Paulo, ni ji Kristo Yesu bɔfo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa kɛ wala ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ he shiwoo naa lɛ,

english_verse: Timothy, you are like a dear child to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Christ Jesus will be kind and merciful to you and will bless you with peace! Do Not Be Ashamed of the Lord
translation_verse: ŋma yahã esuɔmɔ bi Timoteo. Dromɔ, mɔbɔnalɛ, hejɔlɛ ni jɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Kristo Yesu lɛ dɛŋ ahã bo!

english_verse: Night and day I mention you in my prayers. I am always grateful for you, as I pray to the God my ancestors and I have served with a clear conscience.
translation_verse: Midaa Nyɔŋmɔ ni mijaa lɛ kɛ henilee krɔŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni miniimɛi ja lɛ lɛ shi daa kɛ mikai bo yɛ mifaikpamɔi amli nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane.

english_verse: I remember how you cried, and I want to see you, because this would make me truly happy.
translation_verse: Ni kɛ mikai ohiɛ yaafonui lɛ, mishweɔ akɛ mana bo, koni mayi obɔ̃ kɛ miishɛɛ.

english_verse: I also remember the genuine faith of your mother Eunice. Your grandmother Lois had the same sort of faith, and I am sure you have it as well.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mikaiɔ ohemɔkɛyeli ni osato bɛ mli lɛ, ni yɔɔ onaa Loise kɛ onyɛ Eunike mli tsutsu, ni miyɛ nɔmimaa akɛ eyɛ bo hu omli lɛ. Timoteo kɛ edromɔ keenii

english_verse: So I ask you to make full use of the gift God gave you when I placed my hands on you. Use it well.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, miikai bo ni Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ keenɔ ni yɔɔ omli yɛ miniji ni mikɛshwie onɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, otee lɛ shi ni etso,

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make cowards out of us. The Spirit gives us power, love, and self-control.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hãaa wɔ gbeyeishemɔ mumɔ, shi moŋ hewalɛ kɛ suɔmɔ kɛ jwɛŋmɔ ni sa mumɔ ekɛhã wɔ.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, ohiɛ akagbo yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ he odaseyeli lɛ he aloo yɛ mi ni mi ji egboklɛfonyo lɛ he, shi moŋ naa Sanekpakpa lɛ he amanehulu lɛ eko yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ naa.

english_verse: God saved us and chose us to be his holy people. We did nothing to deserve this, but God planned it because he is so kind. Even before time began God planned for Christ Jesus to show kindness to us.
translation_verse: Lɛ ehere wɔyiwala ni ekɛ tsɛmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ tsɛ wɔ, jeee wɔnitsumɔi anaa, shi moŋ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiŋtoo kɛ edromɔ naa, nɔ ni ekɛ hã wɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli dani aje be shishi,

english_verse: Now Christ Jesus has come to offer us God's gift of undeserved grace. Christ our Savior defeated death and brought us the good news. It shines like a light and offers life that never ends.
translation_verse: ni agbɛnɛ atsɔ̃ wɔyiwalaherelɔ, Yesu Kristo, puemɔ lɛ nɔ ajie lɛ shi faŋŋ lɛ. Lɛ efo gbele sɛɛ, ni ejie wala kɛ naanɔ shihilɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ mli.

english_verse: My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
translation_verse: Enɛ he awo mi shiɛlɔ kɛ bɔfo kɛ tsɔɔlɔ yɛ lɛ.

english_verse: This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with.
translation_verse: No hewɔ nɔŋŋ minaa amanehului nɛɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ mihiɛ gbooo; ejaakɛ mile mɔ ni mihe miye lɛ, ni miyɛ hewalɛ yɛ nɔ akɛ eeenyɛ ebu nii ni mitu miwo edɛŋ lɛ he kɛyashi nakai Gbi lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model.
translation_verse: Hiɛmɔ wiemɔi ni hi ni onu yɛ minaa akɛ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ lɛ mli yɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ suɔmɔ ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ mli.

english_verse: You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.
translation_verse: Nɔ kpakpa ni atu awo odɛ̃ŋ lɛ buu he yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni hiɔ wɔmli lɛ hewalɛ naa! Mɛi ni kpa yɛ Paulo sɛɛ kɛ mɔ ni damɔ esɛɛ kpɛŋŋ

english_verse: You know that everyone in Asia has turned against me, especially Phygelus and Hermogenes.
translation_verse: Ole enɛ akɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Asia lɛ fɛɛ kpa yɛ misɛɛ; amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ji Figelo kɛ Hermogene.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail.
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ana Onesiforo we lɛ mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ ebahãa mi tsui kpitiokpitio, ni ehiɛ gbooo mikɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃ lɛ he;

english_verse: Then after he arrived in Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.
translation_verse: shi be ni eba Roma lɛ, ebɔ mɔdɛŋ etao mi ni ena mi.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ahã ena Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ mɔbɔnalɛ yɛ nakai Gbi lɛ nɔ. Ni bɔ ni etsɔ̃ esɔ̃mɔ mi yɛ Efeso lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, ole jogbaŋŋ.

english_verse: Timothy, my child, you must let Christ Jesus make you strong by his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ mibi, bo lɛ ohe awa yɛ dromɔ ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ mli.

english_verse: You have often heard me teach. Now I want you to tell these same things to followers who can be trusted to tell others.
translation_verse: Ni nii ni onu yɛ minaa yɛ odasefoi pii ahiɛ lɛ, tuu owo gbɔmɛi anɔkwafoi adɛŋ, mɛi ni aaanyɛ atsɔ̃ɔ mɛi krokomɛi hu lɛ.

english_verse: As a good soldier of Christ Jesus you must endure your share of suffering.
translation_verse: Naa amanehulu lɛ eko, tamɔ Kristo Yesu tabilɔ kpakpa ko.

english_verse: Soldiers on duty don't work at outside jobs. They try only to please their commanding officer.
translation_verse: Mɔ ko enyiɛɛɛ ta gbɛ ni ekɛ ehe wo shĩa saji amli, koni esa mɔ ni fã lɛ kɛtee ta lɛ lɛŋ lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: No one wins an athletic contest without obeying the rules.
translation_verse: Ni kɛji mɔ ko miishi mple hu lɛ, afiŋ lɛ kunim akekre, akɛ ja eshi lɛ mla naa.

english_verse: And farmers who work hard are the first to eat what grows in their field.
translation_verse: Okwaafonyo ni tsuɔ nii lɛ, lɛ tsutsu sa akɛ ena yibii lɛ eko. Jwɛŋmɔ nɔ ni mikɛɔ nɛɛ he,

english_verse: Keep your mind on Jesus Christ! He was from the family of David and was raised from death, just as my good news says.
translation_verse: Ohiɛ ahi Yesu Kristo ni te shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ ni jɛ David shwie mli lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛɛ yɛ mi-Sanekpakpa lɛ shiɛmɔ mli lɛ.

english_verse: And because of this message, I am locked up in jail and treated like a criminal. But God's good news isn't locked in jail,
translation_verse: No mli amane nɔŋŋ minaa, kɛyashi kpãi amli tete, tamɔ efɔŋfeelɔ ko nɛɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ awooo lɛ kpãa.

english_verse: and so I am willing to put up with anything. Then God's special people will be saved and given eternal glory because they belong to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, mimiaa mihiɛ yɛ saji fɛɛ amli yɛ mɛi ni ahala amɛ lɛ ahewɔ, koni amɛ hu amɛnine ashɛ yiwalaheremɔ ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ kɛ naanɔ anunyam lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Here is a true message: “If we died with Christ, we will live with him.
translation_verse: Anɔkwa wiemɔ nɛ, “Kɛ wɔ kɛ lɛ gbo lɛ, wɔ kɛ lɛ aaana wala hu;

english_verse: If we don't give up, we will rule with him. If we deny that we know him, he will deny that he knows us.
translation_verse: kɛ wɔmia wɔhiɛ lɛ, wɔ kɛ lɛ aaaye maŋtsɛ hu; kɛ wɔkpa yɛ esɛɛ lɛ, lɛ hu eeekpa yɛ wɔsɛɛ.

english_verse: If we are not faithful, he will still be faithful. Christ cannot deny who he is.” An Approved Worker
translation_verse: Kɛ wɔfeee wɔhe anɔkwafoi lɛ, lɛ lɛ eeehi shi anɔkwafo, Enyɛŋ ekpa yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe sɛɛ.” Nitsulɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ

english_verse: Don't let anyone forget these things. And with God as your witness, you must warn them not to argue about words. These arguments don't help anyone. In fact, they ruin everyone who listens to them.
translation_verse: Kaimɔ amɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ, ni oma nɔ mí ohã amɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ, koni amɛkawu naabu ta ni sɛɛnamɔ ko bɛ he, shi ebutuɔ mɛi ni nuɔ lɛ moŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.
translation_verse: Bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ ni okɛ ohe adamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ akɛ mɔ ko ni sa, nitsulɔ ni hiɛ gbooo, ni tsɔ̃ɔ anɔkwale wiemɔ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Keep away from worthless and useless talk. It only leads people farther away from God.
translation_verse: Shi yaka wiemɔ ni buleɔ mɔ lɛ, tsi ohe kɛjɛ he; ejaakɛ mɛi ni wieɔ nɛkɛ lɛ aaaya nɔ awo wu yɛ bu ni abuuu Nyɔŋmɔ mli.

english_verse: That sort of talk is like a sore that won't heal. And Hymenaeus and Philetus have been talking this way
translation_verse: Ni amɛwiemɔ lɛ aaafee tamɔ fala fɔŋ ni yeɔ heloo. Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ji Himeneo kɛ Fileto,

english_verse: by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.
translation_verse: mɛi ni edu gbɛ kɛjɛ anɔkwale lɛ he, ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ shitee lɛ eho momo, ni amɛbutuɔ mɛi komɛi ahemɔkɛyeli lɛ.

english_verse: But the foundation God has laid is solid. On it is written, “The Lord knows who his people are. So everyone who worships the Lord must turn away from evil.”
translation_verse: Kɛ̃lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shishitoo ni wa lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ, ni ehiɛ nɛkɛ naasɔomɔnɔ nɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ lɛ le lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi lɛ,” kɛ “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsiɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ tã lɛ atsi ehe kɛjɛ nii ni ejaaa gbɛ lɛ ahe.”

english_verse: In a large house some dishes are made of gold or silver, while others are made of wood or clay. Some of these are special, and others are not.
translation_verse: Shi shĩa wulu mli lɛ, jeee shikanii kɛ jwiɛtɛinii kɛkɛ yɔɔ jɛi, shi moŋ tsonii kɛ sunii hu yɛ mli, ni ekomɛi lɛ abuɔ amɛ, shi ekomɛi hu abuuu.

english_verse: This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ kɛji mɔ ko tsuu ehe kɛjɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ amli lɛ, eeetsɔ̃ nɔ ni akɛfeɔ nii ni yɔɔ nyam ni atsuu he krɔŋŋ, ni hi hã shĩatsɛ lɛ jogbaŋŋ, ni asaa ahã nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa.

english_verse: Run from temptations that capture young people. Always do the right thing. Be faithful, loving, and easy to get along with. Worship with people whose hearts are pure.
translation_verse: Shi oblahiiaŋ sɛɛdii lɛ hu, joo naa foi, ni okɛ mɛi ni tsɛɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛjeɔ tsui ni mli tse mli lɛ atiu jalɛ, hemɔkɛyeli, suɔmɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ sɛɛ.

english_verse: Stay away from stupid and senseless arguments. These only lead to trouble,
translation_verse: Shi kwashiai aŋwanejee ni akɛkaseee nɔ ko lɛ tsi ohe kɛjɛ he, ejaakɛ ole akɛ ekɛ bei baa;

english_verse: and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.
translation_verse: shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tsulɔ lɛ, esaaa akɛ ebeɔ, shi moŋ efee mɔ ni mli jɔ hã mɛi fɛɛ, mɔ ni le nitsɔɔmɔ, mɔ ni toɔ etsui shi,

english_verse: Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth.
translation_verse: mɔ ni kɛ mlijɔlɛ wieɔ tsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni kuɔ enaa, akɛ aleenɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ahã amɛ tsuitsakemɔ ni amɛle anɔkwale lɛ.

english_verse: They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.
translation_verse: Ni amɛhiɛ aaatserɛ amɛ ni amɛaaje abonsam tsɔne lɛ mli lo; ejaakɛ ekɛdu amɛ ni amɛfee esuɔmɔnaanii.

english_verse: You can be certain that in the last days there will be some very hard times.
translation_verse: Shi na enɛ ole akɛ naagbee gbii lɛ amli lɛ jaramɔ bei baaba.

english_verse: People will love only themselves and money. They will be proud, stuck-up, rude, and disobedient to their parents. They will also be ungrateful, godless,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ gbɔmɛi aaatsɔ̃mɔ hesuɔlɔi, shikasuɔlɔi, shwãlɔi, hewolɔi, mɔjɛlɔi, fɔlɔi anɔ toigbolɔi, trumui, mɛi ni he tseee,

english_verse: heartless, and hateful. Their words will be cruel, and they will have no self-control or pity. These people will hate everything good.
translation_verse: mɛi ni edɔɔɔ mɔ he, kpãŋmɔmlikulɔi, oshekuyelɔi, mɛi ni nyɛɛɛ amɛkɔnɔ nɔ amɛye, mɛi ni hiɛ yɔɔ la, mɛi ni sumɔɔɔ ekpakpa,

english_verse: They will be sneaky, reckless, and puffed up with pride. Instead of loving God, they will love pleasure.
translation_verse: sɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔi, mɛi ni feɔ nii ni amɛjwɛŋŋ he, henɔwolɔi, mɛi ni sumɔɔ shwɛmɔ kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ fe Nyɔŋmɔ,

english_verse: Even though they will make a show of being religious, their religion won't be real. Don't have anything to do with such people.
translation_verse: mɛi ni hiɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ kpo nɔ gbɛ su lɛ mli, shi amɛkwa emli hewalɛ lɛ. Tsi ohe kɛjɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi ahe.

english_verse: Some men fool whole families, just to get power over those women who are slaves of sin and are controlled by all sorts of desires.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi ateŋ mɛi komɛi ji mɛi ni juɔ shi boteɔ shĩai ni amɛnine shɛɔ yei ni bɛ yitseiaŋ ni esha edɔdɔɔ amɛ ni akɔnɔi srɔtoi kpalaa amɛ lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: These women always want to learn something new, but they never can discover the truth.
translation_verse: Yei ni kaseɔ nii daa, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛshɛ anɔkwale lɛ he lɛ.

english_verse: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people are enemies of the truth. Their minds are sick, and their faith isn't real.
translation_verse: Shi tamɔ bɔ ni Yane kɛ Yambre ku Mose naa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ nɛkɛ mɛi nɛɛ kuɔ anɔkwale lɛ naa; gbɔmɛi ni yitseiaŋ efite, mɛi ni jeee mɛi komɛi yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ gbɛfaŋ.

english_verse: But they won't get very far with their foolishness. Soon everyone will know the truth about them, just as Jannes and Jambres were found out. Paul's Last Instructions to Timothy
translation_verse: Shi amɛyaŋ amɛhiɛ tuutu ko; ejaakɛ amɛkwashiafeemɔ lɛ aaaje kpo fãŋŋ yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni mɛi enyɔ lɛ anɔ lɛ hu je kpo lɛ. Nibii ni baahã Timoteo afi shi

english_verse: trouble and suffering in the cities of Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. Yet the Lord rescued me from all those terrible troubles.
translation_verse: miyiwai, mimanehului ni mina yɛ Antiokia kɛ Ikonium kɛ Listra lɛ, nɔ yiwai srɔtoi abɔ ni mina ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jie mi kɛjɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: In fact, anyone who belongs to Christ Jesus and wants to live right will have trouble from others.
translation_verse: Shi mɛi fɛɛ hu ni taoɔ akɛ amɛaahi shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ naa yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, aaawa amɛyi.

english_verse: But evil people who pretend to be what they are not will become worse than ever, as they fool others and are fooled themselves.
translation_verse: Shi gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji kɛ shishiulɔi aaawo wu yɛ efɔŋ mli; amɛlakaa mɛi ni amɛ hu alakaa amɛ.

english_verse: Keep on being faithful to what you were taught and to what you believed. After all, you know who taught you these things.
translation_verse: Shi bo lɛ, hii shi yɛ nii ni okase ni oyɔɔ hewalɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ amli, ejaakɛ ole mɛi anaa ni okase yɛ,

english_verse: Since childhood, you have known the Holy Scriptures that are able to make you wise enough to have faith in Christ Jesus and be saved.
translation_verse: ni ogbekɛbiiashi ojɛ ole Ŋmalɛi Krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni aaanyɛ ahã ole nii hã yiwalaheremɔ kɛtsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ.

english_verse: Everything in the Scriptures is God's Word. All of it is useful for teaching and helping people and for correcting them and showing them how to live.
translation_verse: Ŋmalɛ fɛɛ ŋmalɛ lɛ ejɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ mli, ni ehe yɛ sɛɛnamɔ hã nitsɔɔmɔ kɛ hiɛkãmɔ kɛ mɔsaamɔ kɛ tsɔsemɔ ni yɔɔ jalɛ mli lɛ,

english_verse: The Scriptures train God's servants to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: koni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ aye emuu, ni asaa lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ahã nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa.

english_verse: When Christ Jesus comes as king, he will be the judge of everyone, whether they are living or dead. So with God and Christ as witnesses, I command you
translation_verse: Miifã bo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yesu Kristo ni baaba ebakojo hiɛkãalɔi kɛ gbohii lɛ ahiɛ, ni mikɛ epuemɔ kɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ miifã bo akɛ,

english_verse: to preach God's message. Do it willingly, even if it isn't the popular thing to do. You must correct people and point out their sins. But also cheer them up, and when you instruct them, always be patient.
translation_verse: Shiɛmɔ wiemɔ lɛ, kã he, be ni hi jio, be ni ehiii jio, kã hiɛ, wo ŋaa, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nii kɛ tsuishitoo fɛɛ.

english_verse: The time is coming when people won't listen to good teaching. Instead, they will look for teachers who will please them by telling them only what they are itching to hear.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ be ko baaba ni gbɔmɛi ekpɛlɛŋ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kpakpa lɛ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ amɛaabua tsɔɔlɔi anaa amɛwo amɛhe yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛkɔnɔi lɛ anaa, ejaakɛ amɛtoiiaŋ miifɛlɛ̃ amɛ;

english_verse: They will turn from the truth and eagerly listen to senseless stories.
translation_verse: ni amɛaakpala anɔkwale lɛ yɛ amɛtoii asɛɛ, ni amɛaakpale kɛyanyiɛ adesãi asɛɛ.

english_verse: But you must stay calm and be willing to suffer. You must work hard, telling the good news and to do your job well.
translation_verse: Shi bo lɛ, ohiɛ akã shi yɛ nii fɛɛ mli, miamɔ ohiɛ yɛ amanehului amli, tsu Sanekpakpashiɛlɔ nitsumɔ lɛ, gbee osɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ naa kwraa! Paulo miiwie enitsumɔ kɛ ewala naagbee he

english_verse: Now the time has come for me to die. My life is like a drink offering being poured out on the altar.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mi lɛ, aafɔse mila aashwie shi momo akɛ afɔle, ni mimliyimɔ be lɛ eshɛ.

english_verse: I have fought well. I have finished the race, and I have been faithful.
translation_verse: Ta kpakpa lɛ, miwu; foidamɔ lɛ, mida migbe naa; hemɔkɛyeli lɛ, mihiɛ mli tswɛ.

english_verse: So a crown will be given to me for pleasing the Lord. He judges fairly, and on the day of judgment he will give a crown to me and to everyone else who wants him to appear with power. Personal Instructions
translation_verse: Nɔ ni eshwɛ ni kã shi hã mi ji jalɛ akekre lɛ, ni Nuŋtsɔ ni ji jalɛ kojolɔ lɛ baahã mi yɛ nakai Gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni jeee mikome ebaahã, shi moŋ mɛi bluublu hu ni sumɔɔ epuemɔ lɛ. Wiemɔi ni kɔɔ Paulo kɛkɛ he

english_verse: Come to see me as soon as you can.
translation_verse: Bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ ni oba miŋɔɔ oya.

english_verse: Demas loves the things of this world so much that he left me and went to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ní Dema esumɔ amrɔmrɔ je nɛɛŋ hewɔ lɛ, eshi mi etee Tesalonika. Kreske etee Galatia, Tito etee Dalmatia.

english_verse: Only Luke has stayed with me. Mark can be very helpful to me, so please find him and bring him with you.
translation_verse: Luka pɛ kɛ mi yɔɔ. Ŋɔɔ Marko ni okɛ lɛ aba, ejaakɛ ehe yɛ sɛɛnamɔ hã mi yɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
translation_verse: Tihiko lɛ, mitsu lɛ Efeso.

english_verse: When you come, bring the coat I left at Troas with Carpus. Don't forget to bring the scrolls, especially the ones made of leather.
translation_verse: Atade lɛ ni mishi yɛ Troia yɛ Karpo ŋɔɔ lɛ, kɛ ooba lɛ okɛba, kɛ woji lɛ hu, titri lɛ amɛteŋ nii ni aŋmala yɛ kooloi ahewolo nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Alexander, the metalworker, has hurt me in many ways. But the Lord will pay him back for what he has done.
translation_verse: Aleksandro, sɔ̃lɔ lɛ, fee mi efɔŋ naakpa; Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ato lɛ najiaŋ yɛ enitsumɔi lɛ anaa.

english_verse: Alexander opposes what we preach, so you had better watch out for him.
translation_verse: Bo hu kwɛ ohe ni ahi yɛ ehe ejaakɛ eku wɔwiemɔi lɛ anaa waa naakpa.

english_verse: When I was first put on trial, no one helped me. In fact, everyone deserted me. I hope it won't be held against them.
translation_verse: Miklɛŋklɛŋ naajiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko eyawaaa mi, shi moŋ amɛ fɛɛ amɛshi mi; akabu enɛ afɔ̃ amɛnɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord stood beside me. He gave me the strength to tell his full message, so that all Gentiles would hear it. And I was kept safe from hungry lions.
translation_verse: Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fi misɛɛ ni ewo mi hewalɛ, koni atsɔ̃ minɔ ashiɛ shiɛmɔ muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ anu; ni ajie mi yɛ jata lɛ daaŋ.

english_verse: The Lord will always keep me from being harmed by evil, and he will bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. Praise him forever and ever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Ni jiemɔ kɛ̃ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaajie mi kɛaajɛ efɔŋ fɛɛ efɔŋ mli, ni eeehere miyiwala kɛaatee eŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli. Lɛ aŋɔ anunyam ahã kɛyashi naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ. Amen! Shɛɛ kɛ ŋamɔi

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and to the family of Onesiphorus.
translation_verse: Miibi Priskila kɛ Akwila kɛ Onesiforo we lɛ.

english_verse: Erastus stayed at Corinth. Trophimus was sick when I left him at Miletus.
translation_verse: Erasto yɛ Korinto lolo; shi Trofimo lɛ, mishi lɛ yɛ Mileto ni ehe miiye.

english_verse: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do the rest of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ ni oba dani fɛ̃i be lɛ ashɛ. Eubulo kɛ Pude kɛ Lino kɛ Klaudia kɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ miibi bo

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless your life and will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo kɛ omumɔ lɛ ahi shi! Dromɔ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. I encourage God's own people to have more faith and to understand the truth about religion.
translation_verse: Paulo, ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ tsulɔ kɛ Yesu Kristo bɔfo lɛ, ŋma wolo nɛɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ hala mi ni etsu mi koni mayawo Nyɔŋmɔ halamɔbii lɛ ahemɔkɛyeli kɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ anɔkwale lɛ he nilee lɛ mli hewalɛ,

english_verse: Then they will have the hope of eternal life God promised long ago. And God never tells a lie!
translation_verse: ni amɛna naanɔ wala lɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ. Naanɔ wala nɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wo he shi dani abɔ je lɛ.

english_verse: So, at the proper time, God our Savior gave this message and told me to announce what he had said.
translation_verse: Shi yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebe ni sa lɛ mli lɛ ejie ewiemɔ lɛ shi etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ shiɛmɔ sane ni atuu awo midɛŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ fãmɔ naa lɛ mli.

english_verse: Titus, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and Christ Jesus our Savior will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! What Titus Was To Do in Crete
translation_verse: Miŋma wolo nɛɛ miyahã Tito ni ji mibi krɔŋŋ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli koome ni wɔyɔɔ lɛ naa. Dromɔ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo, wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ, dɛŋ ahã bo. Tito nitsumɔ yɛ Kreta

english_verse: I left you in Crete to do what had been left undone and to appoint leaders for the churches in each town. As I told you,
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ mishi bo yɛ Kreta, koni oto nii ni eshwɛ lɛ gbɛjianɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni owowoo onukpai yɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛɛ bo momo lɛ.

english_verse: they must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. Their children must be followers of the Lord and not have a reputation for being wild and disobedient.
translation_verse: Onukpa afee mɔ ko ni kpa ko bɛ ehe, mɔ ko ni yɔɔ ŋa kome ni eyɔɔ bii ni heɔ Kristo nɔ yeɔ ni awieee amɛhe akɛ nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔlɔi loo toigbolɔi ji amɛ.

english_verse: Church officials are in charge of God's work, and so they must also have a good reputation. They must not be bossy, quick-tempered, heavy drinkers, bullies, or dishonest in business.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nɔkwɛlɔ lɛ, esaaa akɛ kpa ko hiɔ ehe, akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ we nɔ tsulɔnukpa ji lɛ lɛ. Ekafee ehe mɔ ni feɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsuinaanii, jeee mlifutsɛ, jeee dãanulɔ, jeee ninekpokpookpotsɛ, jeee hiɛjoolɔ.

english_verse: Instead, they must be friendly to strangers and enjoy doing good things. They must also be sensible, fair, pure, and self-controlled.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ efee ehe gbɔfeelɔ, mɔ ni sumɔɔ ekpakpa, nilelɔ, jalɔ, mɔ ni he tse, mɔ ni yeɔ ehe nɔ.

english_verse: They must stick to the true message they were taught, so their good teaching can help others and correct everyone who opposes it.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni hiɛɔ anɔkwa wiemɔ lɛ yɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ naa lɛ mli, koni enyɛ ekɛ nitsɔɔmɔ kpakpa lɛ awo mɛi ahewalɛ, ni ehã mɛi ni wieɔ shiɔ wiemɔ lɛ ana amɛtɔ̃mɔ.

english_verse: There are many who don't respect authority, and they fool others by talking nonsense. This is especially true of some Jewish followers.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛi pii yɛ ni ji toigbolɔi, mɛi ni wieɔ nii ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ, kɛ shishiulɔi, titri lɛ mɛi ni jɛ ketiafolɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But you must make them be quiet. They are after money, and they upset whole families by teaching what they should not.
translation_verse: Amɛ ji gbɔmɛi ni sa akɛ awo amɛnaa manyoflɛ. Amɛ, amɛbutuɔ shĩai muji fɛɛ, ni sɛɛnamɔ ni yɔɔ hiɛgbele hewɔ lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nii ni ejaaa.

english_verse: It is like one of their own prophets once said, “The people of Crete always tell lies. They are greedy and lazy like wild animals.”
translation_verse: Amɛteŋ mɔ ko ni ji amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbalɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Kretabii maleɔ daa; kooloi fɔ̃ji ni; ŋmaayelɔi hejɔ̃lɔi ni.”

english_verse: This surely is a true saying. And you should be hard on such people, so you can help them grow stronger in their faith.
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ odase nɛɛ anɔkwale ni. No hewɔ lɛ, kã amɛhiɛ veveeve, koni amɛhemɔkɛyeli afee hemɔkɛyeli kpakpa,

english_verse: Don't pay any attention to any of those senseless Jewish stories and human commands. These are made up by people who won't obey the truth.
translation_verse: ni amɛkabo Yudafoi adesai lɛ kɛ gbɔmɛi ni kpaleɔ kɛjɛɔ anɔkwale lɛ mli lɛ akitãi lɛ atoi.

english_verse: Everything is pure for someone whose heart is pure. But nothing is pure for an unbeliever with a dirty mind. That person's mind and conscience are destroyed.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni he tse lɛ, nii fɛɛ he tse hã amɛ; shi mɛi ni he tseee ni amɛheee Nyɔŋmɔ amɛyeee lɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni he tse hã amɛ, shi moŋ amɛjwɛŋmɔ mli kɛ amɛhenilee fɛɛ ewo muji.

english_verse: Such people claim to know God, but their actions prove they really don't. They are disgusting. They won't obey God, and they are too worthless to do anything good.
translation_verse: Amɛjajeɔ akɛ amɛle Nyɔŋmɔ, shi amɛkɛ amɛnitsumɔi kwaa lɛ, ni amɛ ji gbɔmɛi ni ahiɔ, kɛ toigbolɔi, mɛi ni ehiii hãaa nitsumɔ kpakpa ko kwraa.

english_verse: Titus, you must teach only what is correct.
translation_verse: Shi bo lɛ, wiemɔ nibii ni sa tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kpakpa lɛ.

english_verse: Tell the older men to have self-control and to be serious and sensible. Their faith, love, and patience must never fail.
translation_verse: Hiimeji lɛ, amɛhiɛ akã shi, amɛfee mɛi ni hiɛ tsii, amɛjwɛŋmɔ akã shi, amɛfee mɛi ni yɔɔ hemɔkɛyeli kpakpa kɛ suɔmɔ kɛ hiɛmiamɔ.

english_verse: Tell the older women to behave as those who love the Lord should. They must not gossip about others or be slaves of wine. They must teach what is proper,
translation_verse: Yeimeji hu nakai nɔŋŋ, amɛba amɛjeŋ bɔ ni sa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ. Amɛkafee amɛhe oshekuyelɔi, amɛkafee amɛhe mɛi ni dãa eŋɔ amɛ nom, amɛfee mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ nii kpakpai.

english_verse: so the younger women will be loving wives and mothers.
translation_verse: Koni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ oblayei lɛ ni amɛsumɔ amɛwumɛi, amɛsumɔ amɛbii,

english_verse: Each of the younger women must be sensible and kind, as well as a good homemaker, who puts her own husband first. Then no one can say insulting things about God's message.
translation_verse: amɛjwɛŋmɔ akã shi, amɛhe atse, amɛtsu amɛshĩa nii jogbaŋŋ, amɛmli ahi, amɛba amɛhe shi amɛhã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwumɛi, koni akawie Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ he musubɔɔ wiemɔ.

english_verse: Tell the young men to have self-control in everything.
translation_verse: Oblahii hu nakai nɔŋŋ, wiemɔ otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ koni amɛjwɛŋmɔ akã shi.

english_verse: Use clean language that no one can criticize. Do this, and your enemies will be too ashamed to say anything against you.
translation_verse: Owiemɔ ahi bɔ ni anaŋ he sane ko atã, bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ni kɛ wɔ yeee lɛ hiɛ agbo, yɛ na ni enaaa nɔsha ko ekɛɛ yɛ wɔhe lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Tell slaves always to please their owners by obeying them in everything. Slaves must not talk back to their owners
translation_verse: Tsuji lɛ, amɛba amɛhe shi amɛhã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ, amɛsa amɛhiɛ yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli. Amɛkajie sane naa,

english_verse: or steal from them. They must be completely honest and trustworthy. Then everyone will show great respect for what is taught about God our Savior. God's Kindness and the New Life
translation_verse: amɛkashara nii, shi moŋ amɛhã ana amɛ akɛ mɛi ni yeɔ anɔkwa kɛmɔ shi, koni amɛkɛwula Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli. Nɔ nɔ ni Kristofoi ajeŋba damɔ

english_verse: God has shown us undeserved grace by coming to save all people.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni akɛhereɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ayiwala lɛ epue.

english_verse: He taught us to give up our wicked ways and our worldly desires and to live decent and honest lives in this world.
translation_verse: Ni etsɔseɔ wɔ koni wɔkwa she ni asheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei kɛ je nɛɛŋ akɔnɔi lɛ ni wɔkɛ hiɛshikãmɔ kɛ jalɛ nifeemɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ ahi shi yɛ je nɛɛŋ,

english_verse: We are filled with hope, as we wait for the glorious return of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: be mli ni wɔmiikwɛ jɔɔmɔ ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ kɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ kpeteŋkple kɛ wɔyiwalaherelɔ Yesu Krito anunyam lɛ puemɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ.

english_verse: He gave himself to rescue us from everything evil and to make our hearts pure. He wanted us to be his own people and to be eager to do right.
translation_verse: Lɛ ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hã yɛ wɔnajiaŋ, koni ekpɔ̃ wɔ kɛjɛ nɔtɔmɔ fɛɛ mli, ni etsuu wɔhe ehã ehe akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ, maŋ ni hiɛ dɔɔ yɛ nitsumɔi kpakpai ahe lɛ.

english_verse: Teach these things, as you use your full authority to encourage and correct people. Make sure you earn everyone's respect.
translation_verse: Wiemɔ nii nɛɛ, ni owo amɛ ŋaa yɛ he, ni okã amɛhiɛ yɛ he kɛ hewalɛ fɛɛ. Kaahã mɔ ko miigbe ohe guɔ.

english_verse: Remind your people to obey the rulers and authorities and not to be rebellious. They must always be ready to do something helpful
translation_verse: Kaimɔ amɛ ni amɛba amɛhe shi amɛhã onukpai kɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ, amɛbo amɛ toi, amɛsaa amɛhe amɛhã nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa.

english_verse: and not say cruel things or argue. They should be gentle and kind to everyone.
translation_verse: Amɛkawie mɔ ko he efɔŋ, amɛkabe, shi moŋ amɛfee kpoo, ni amɛhã mɛi fɛɛ ana amɛ akɛ amɛhe jɔ kwraa.

english_verse: We used to be stupid, disobedient, and foolish, as well as slaves of all sorts of desires and pleasures. We were evil and jealous. Everyone hated us, and we hated everyone.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ sa lɛ, wɔ hu wɔfee wɔhe kwashiai, toigbolɔi, gbɛdulɔi, mɛi ni sɔmɔɔ akɔnɔi kɛ miishɛɛ nibii srɔtoi pii. Ni wɔba wɔjeŋ yɛ nifɔɔjianifeemɔ kɛ hetsɛ̃ mli, wɔhe yɛ taŋ, ni wɔnyɛnyɛɔ wɔhe.

english_verse: God our Savior showed us how good and kind he is.
translation_verse: Shi be ni Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ mlihilɛ kɛ egbɔmɛiahedɔɔ lɛ pue lɛ,

english_verse: He saved us because of his mercy, and not because of any good things we have done. God washed us by the power of the Holy Spirit. He gave us new birth and a fresh beginning.
translation_verse: jeee jalɛ nitsumɔi ni wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔtsu naa, shi moŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɔbɔnalɛ naa etsɔ̃ eheefɔmɔ hejuu kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ eheefeemɔ lɛ nɔ ehere wɔyiwala.

english_verse: God sent Jesus Christ our Savior to give us his Spirit.
translation_verse: Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ nɛɛ etsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo, wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ nɔ, efɔse eshwie wɔnɔ babaoo,

english_verse: Jesus treated us much better than we deserve. He made us acceptable to God and gave us the hope of eternal life.
translation_verse: koni ahã wɔtsɔ̃mɔ niyelɔi yɛ naanɔ wala lɛ gbɛfaŋ yɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ naa, akɛni abu wɔ bem yɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ edromɔ naa lɛ.

english_verse: This message is certainly true. These teachings are useful and helpful for everyone. I want you to insist that the people follow them, so that all who have faith in God will be sure to do good deeds.
translation_verse: Anɔkwa wiemɔ nɛ. Ni nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ anɔ mi mitaoɔ akɛ oma, koni mɛi ni ehe Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ amɛye lɛ akwɛ ni amɛbɔ nitsumɔi kpakpai ahe mɔdɛŋ. Enɛɛmɛi ji nii ni yɔɔ fɛo ni he yɔɔ sɛɛnamɔ hã gbɔmɛi.

english_verse: But don't have anything to do with stupid arguments about ancestors. And stay away from disagreements and quarrels about the Law of Moses. Such arguments are useless and senseless.
translation_verse: Shi kwashiai aŋwanejei kɛ wekukpãa tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ naataamɔ kɛ Mla he bei lɛ, tsi ohe kɛjɛ he, ejaakɛ ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ni ejeee fɛi hu.

english_verse: Warn troublemakers once or twice. Then don't have anything else to do with them.
translation_verse: Gbɔmɔ ko ni kɛ mligbalamɔ baa lɛ, kɛ obɔ lɛ kɔkɔ shi kome kɛ shii enyɔ lɛ, kwa lɛ.

english_verse: You know their minds are twisted, and their own sins show how guilty they are. Personal Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ole akɛ mɔ ko ni yɔɔ nakai lɛ, eje eŋɛlɛnɔ ni efeɔ esha ni ekɛaabu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe fɔ. Naagbee nibii komɛi ni Paulo taoɔ

english_verse: I plan to send Artemas or Tychicus to you. After he arrives, please try your best to meet me at Nicopolis. I have decided to spend the winter there.
translation_verse: Kɛ mitsu Artema loo Tihiko kɛba oŋɔɔ lɛ, bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ ni oba miŋɔɔ yɛ Nikopoli, ejaakɛ jɛi mikpɛ mli akɛ mibaye fɛ̃ibe lɛ yɛ.

english_verse: When Zenas the lawyer and Apollos get ready to leave, help them as much as you can, so they won't have need of anything.
translation_verse: Bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ owo Zena, mlalelɔ lɛ, kɛ Apolo gbɛ jogbaŋŋ ni nɔ ko nɔ ko he akahĩa amɛ.

english_verse: Our people should learn to spend their time doing something useful and worthwhile.
translation_verse: Shi hã ni wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔmɛi lɛ hu akase nitsumɔi kpakpai ahe mɔdɛŋbɔɔ yɛ fimɔ kɛ hiamɔ hewɔ, koni amɛkafee mɛi ni wooo yibii.

english_verse: Greetings to you from everyone here. Greet all of our friends who share in our faith. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Mɛi ni kɛ mi yɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ miibi bo. Wɔmiibi mɛi ni sumɔɔ wɔ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ. Dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi! Amen.

english_verse: and to the church that meets in your home. It is also to our dear friend Apphia and to Archippus, who serves the Lord as we do.
translation_verse: kɛ wɔnyɛmi yoo Apia, kɛ Arkipo ni ji wɔnaanyo tabilɔ lɛ, kɛ asafo ni yɔɔ owe lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Philemon's Love and Faith
translation_verse: Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ dɛŋ ahã nyɛ! Filemon suɔmɔ kɛ ehemɔkɛyeli

english_verse: Philemon, each time I mention you in my prayers, I thank God.
translation_verse: Midaa miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi daa ni mitsiɔ otã, nyɛmi nuu Filemon, yɛ misɔlemɔi amli,

english_verse: I hear about your faith in our Lord Jesus and about your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: akɛni minuɔ osuɔmɔ kɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni ohiɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu kɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ he lɛ;

english_verse: As you share your faith with others, I pray they may come to know all the blessings Christ has given us.
translation_verse: misɔleɔ akɛ naanyobɔɔ ni okɛ wɔ yɔɔ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ atsu nii ahã ekpakpa fɛɛ ekpakpa ni yɔɔ wɔmli yɛ Yesu Kristo mli lɛ lee.

english_verse: My friend, your love has made me happy and has greatly encouraged me. It has also cheered the hearts of God's people. Paul Speaks to Philemon about Onesimus
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mina miishɛɛ pii kɛ ekãa yɛ osuɔmɔ lɛ hewɔ, anyɛmi, akɛni ohã mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ atsui enyɔ amɛmli lɛ. Paulo kpa fai yɛ Onesimo hewɔ

english_verse: Christ gives me the courage to tell you what to do.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, miyɛ hewalɛ yɛ Kristo mli akɛ mawo bo kitã yɛ nɔ ni sa hewɔ,

english_verse: But I would rather ask you to do it simply because of love. Yes, as someone in jail for Christ,
translation_verse: shi kɛ̃lɛ suɔmɔ hewɔ lɛ fai moŋ mikpaa bo, mi Paulo ni mi ji nuumo ni amrɔ nɛɛ mi ji Yesu Kristo gboklɛfonyo hu lɛ.

english_verse: I beg you to help Onesimus! He is like a son to me because I led him to Christ here in jail.
translation_verse: Miikpa bo fai yɛ mibi ni mifɔ yɛ Kristo mli yɛ mikpãi lɛ amli ni ji Onesimo lɛ hewɔ,

english_verse: Before this, he was useless to you, but now he is useful both to you and to me.
translation_verse: mɔ ni sá lɛ ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko hã bo, shi agbɛnɛ lɛ ehe eba sɛɛnamɔ ehã mi kɛ bo fɛɛ jogbaŋŋ lɛ,

english_verse: Sending Onesimus back to you makes me very sad.
translation_verse: miwo lɛ gbɛ kɛmiiba oŋɔɔ, lɛ ni ji mitsui lɛ.

english_verse: I would like to keep him here with me, where he could take your place in helping me while I am here in prison for preaching the good news.
translation_verse: Kulɛ miisumɔ akɛ ekɛ mi ahi shi, koni esɔ̃mɔ mi yɛ onajiaŋ be mli ni miyɔɔ kpãi amli yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hewɔ lɛ.

english_verse: But I won't do anything unless you agree to it first. I want your act of kindness to come from your heart, and not be something you feel forced to do.
translation_verse: Shi misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ mafee nɔ ko ni okpɛ̃lɛko nɔ, bɔ ni afee ni ejurɔ ni obaafee lɛ okabafee yɛ nɔnyɛɛ naa, shi moŋ efee yɛ tsuijurɔ naa.

english_verse: Perhaps Onesimus was taken from you for a little while so you could have him back for good,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ekolɛ enɛ hewɔ agbala nyɛmli be kukuoo lɛ, koni agbɛnɛ oná lɛ ni ehi oŋɔɔ daa.

english_verse: but not as a slave. Onesimus is much more than a slave. To me he is a dear friend, but to you he is even more, both as a person and as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Jeee akɛ tsulɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ akɛ mɔ ni fe tsulɔ tete, suɔmɔ nyɛmi ni jara wa hã mi waa, shi bo lɛ ejara wa hã bo aahu fe nakai yɛ heloo kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ fɛɛ.

english_verse: If you consider me a friend because of Christ, then welcome Onesimus as you would welcome me.
translation_verse: Hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ kɛ oŋɔɔ mi akɛ onaanyo lɛ, heremɔ lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni obaahere mi diɛŋtsɛ.

english_verse: If he has cheated you or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
translation_verse: Ni kɛji eye bo sane fɔŋ ko aloo ehiɛ bo nyɔmɔ ko lɛ, buu nakai akɔntaa lɛ ohã mi.

english_verse: With my own hand I write: I, PAUL, WILL PAY YOU BACK. But don't forget you owe me your life.
translation_verse: Mi, Paulo, miiŋma kɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ minine akɛ mawo; tsɛbelɛ manyɛ makɛɛ bo akɛ ohiɛ mi bo diɛŋtsɛ tete oyi nyɔmɔ.

english_verse: My dear friend and follower of Christ our Lord, please cheer me up by doing this for me.
