translation_verse: Hɛɛ, anyɛmi, hã mana ohe sɛɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli; hã mitsui anyɔ mimli yɛ Kristo mli.

english_verse: I am sure you will do all I have asked, and even more.
translation_verse: Akɛni mihiɛ kã onɔ akɛ ooobo mi toi hewɔ miŋmaa bo nɛɛ, ejaakɛ mile akɛ ooofee fe bɔ ni mikɛɔ nɛɛ tete po.

english_verse: Please get a room ready for me. I hope your prayers will be answered, and I can visit you.
translation_verse: Shi asaŋ saamɔ gbɔiatoohe ko oto mi ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ aaatsɔ̃ nyɛsɔlemɔi lɛ anɔ akɛ mi aaake nyɛ. Ŋamɔi

english_verse: Epaphras is also here in jail for being a follower of Christ Jesus. He sends his greetings,
translation_verse: Epafra, mɔ ni ji minaanyo gboklɛfonyo yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ,

english_verse: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, who work together with me.
translation_verse: kɛ Marko kɛ Aristarko kɛ Dema kɛ Luka, mɛi ni ji minanemɛi nitsulɔi hu miibi bo.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛmumɔ lɛ ahi shi! Amen.

english_verse: Long ago in many ways and at many times God's prophets spoke his message to our ancestors.
translation_verse: Sa lɛ bei srɔtoi amli kɛ gbɛi srɔtoi anɔ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ ekɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ wie yɛ gbalɔi lɛ anaa.

english_verse: But now at last, God sent his Son to bring his message to us. God created the universe by his Son, and everything will someday belong to the Son.
translation_verse: Shi nɛkɛ bei nɛɛ anaagbee mli lɛ, eBi lɛ naa ekɛ wɔ wie yɛ. Ekɛ lɛ efee nibii fɛɛ yelɔ, ni enɔ hu etsɔ̃ efee je lɛ.

english_verse: God's Son has all the brightness of God's own glory and is like him in every way. By his own mighty word, he holds the universe together. After the Son had washed away our sins, he sat down at the right side of the glorious God in heaven.
translation_verse: Lɛ ji enunyam lɛ kpɛmɔ kɛ esu lɛ mfoniri lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehewalɛ wiemɔ lɛ hiɛɔ nibii fɛɛ. Be ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe etsuu wɔhe kɛjɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ amli lɛ, etee eyata shi yɛ anunyam-Tsɛ agbo lɛ nine jurɔ nɔ yɛ ŋwɛi,

english_verse: He had become much greater than the angels, and the name he was given is far greater than any of theirs. God's Son Is Greater than Angels
translation_verse: ni bɔ ni efe ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ hu ena gbɛi ni fe amɛnɔ lɛ. Bi lɛ fe ŋwɛi bɔfoi

english_verse: God has never said to any of the angels, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!” Neither has God said to any of them, “I will be his Father, and he will be my Son!”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ ateŋ namɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekɛɛ lɛ pɛŋ akɛ, “Mi-Bi ji bo; ŋmɛnɛ mifɔ bo?” Ni asaŋ, “Matsɔ̃ eTsɛ, ni lɛ hu eeetsɔ̃ mi-Bi.”

english_verse: When God brings his first-born Son into the world, he commands all of his angels to worship him.
translation_verse: Ni be ni ekɛ kromɔbi lɛ baa je nɛɛ mli lɛ, ekɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfoi fɛɛ aja lɛ.”

english_verse: And when God speaks about the angels, he says, “I change my angels into wind and my servants into flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ ekɛɛ yɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Mɔ ni feɔ ebɔfoi lɛ mumɔi, ni esɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ hu efeɔ amɛ lalilɛii lɛ.”

english_verse: But God says about his Son, “You are God, and you will rule as King forever! Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Shi Bi lɛ, ekɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, “Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, omaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ma shi kɛmiiya naanɔi anaanɔ, ni omaŋtsɛ tso lɛ, jalɛ maŋtsɛ tso ni.

english_verse: You loved justice and hated evil, and so I, your God, have chosen you. I appointed you and made you happier than any of your friends.”
translation_verse: Osumɔɔ jalɛ, ni onyɛɔ efɔŋfeemɔ; hewɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ mliflimɔ mu lɛ efɔ bo fe onanemɛi lɛ.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “In the beginning, Lord, you were the one who laid the foundation of the earth and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ ekoŋŋ, “Nuŋtsɔ, shishijee lɛ mli lɛ, bo oto shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi, ni ŋwɛi lɛ oninenaa nitsumɔ ni.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes, but you will last forever.
translation_verse: Amɛ lɛ, amɛhiɛ baakpãtã, shi bo lɛ, ohiɔ shi daa. Amɛ fɛɛ amɛbaasuu tamɔ atade;

english_verse: You will roll them up like a robe and change them like a garment. But you are always the same, and you will live forever.”
translation_verse: ni oookota amɛ tamɔ mama. Ni amɛaatsake; shi bo lɛ, oyɛ bɔ ni oyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni ofii lɛ etãaa.”

english_verse: God never said to any of the angels, “Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you!”
translation_verse: Shi ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ ateŋ namɔ po ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekɛɛ lɛ pɛŋ akɛ, “Ta mininejurɔ nɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋɔ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ mafee onajiashi maaŋoo?”

english_verse: Angels are merely spirits sent to serve people who are going to be saved.
translation_verse: Ani amɛ fɛɛ lɛ, jeee mumɔ bɔfoi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ ji amɛ, ni atsuɔ amɛ ni amɛbasɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni nine baashɛ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ nɔ akɛ amɛgboshinii lɛ?

english_verse: We must give our full attention to what we were told, so we won't drift away.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, esa akɛ wɔjwɛŋmɔ ahi nii ni wɔnu lɛ anɔ jogbaŋŋ, koni wɔkakplaŋ kɛje he be ko.

english_verse: The message spoken by angels proved to be true, and all who disobeyed or rejected it were punished as they deserved.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ wiemɔ ni awie yɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi anaa lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ, ni awo nɔtɔmɔ fɛɛ nɔtɔmɔ kɛ toigbele fɛɛ toigbele he nyɔmɔ bɔ ni ja lɛ,

english_verse: So if we refuse this great way of being saved, how can we hope to escape? The Lord himself was the first to tell about it, and people who heard the message proved to us that it was true.
translation_verse: te wɔ lɛ wɔbaafee tɛŋŋ wɔjo nyɔmɔwoo naa foi hu, kɛji wɔbuuu nɛkɛ yiwalaheremɔ kpeteŋkple nɛɛ lɛ? Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tsutsu wie he, ni mɛi ni nu lɛ hu ma nɔ mí amɛhã wɔ,

english_verse: God himself showed that his message was true by working all kinds of powerful miracles and wonders. He also gave his Holy Spirit to anyone he chose to. The One Who Leads Us To Be Saved
translation_verse: ni Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ hu kɛ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii kɛ hewalɛnii srɔtoi kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ hãmɔ lɛ miiye odase miishi nɔ, yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esuɔmɔ naa. Yiwalaheremɔ Tatsɛnukpa lɛ

english_verse: We know that God did not put the future world under the power of angels.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ jeee ŋwɛi bɔfoi ashishi akɛ jeŋ ni baaba ni wɔwieɔ he lɛ wo.

english_verse: Somewhere in the Scriptures someone says to God, “What makes you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for weaklings such as we?
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ko ye odase faŋŋ yɛ he ko akɛ, “Mɛni ji gbɔmɔ adesa ni okaiɔ lɛ? Aloo gbɔmɔ bi hu ni ojwɛŋɔ enɔ?

english_verse: You made us lower than the angels for a while. Yet you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Shwɛ fioo kɛkɛ ni ohã ekɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi aye egbɔ; okɛ anunyam kɛ woo efi lɛ akekre, Ni oŋɔ lɛ oto oninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: And you have put everything under our power!” God has put everything under our power and has not left anything out of our power. But we still don't see it all under our control.
translation_verse: Oŋɔ nibii fɛɛ kwa owo enajiaŋshi.” Kɛ akɛɛ “ekɛ nibii fɛɛ ewo enajiaŋshi” lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ eshwɛɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ni akɛwooo eshishi. Shi amrɔ nɛɛ wɔnako wɔna akɛ nibii fɛɛ yɛ eshishi.

english_verse: What we do see is Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels. Because of God's gift of undeserved grace, Jesus died for everyone. And now that Jesus has suffered and died, he is crowned with glory and honor!
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni be kuku ko mli lɛ ahã shwɛ fioo ni ekɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi aye egbɔ lɛ, wɔna akɛ Yesu ni, mɔ ni gbele mli nɔnaa hewɔ ni akɛ anunyam kɛ woo fi lɛ akekre lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ naa lɛ esa enaa gbele ehã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ.

english_verse: Everything belongs to God, and all things were created by his power. So God did the right thing when he made Jesus perfect by suffering, as Jesus led many of God's children to be saved and to share in his glory.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ esa Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ hewɔ ni nii fiaa yɔɔ kɛ mɔ nɔ ni tsɔ̃ ni nii fiaa yɔɔ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni afee ni eŋɔ bii babaoo kɛba anunyam mli lɛ, ehã amɛyiwalaheremɔ Tatsɛnukpa lɛ atsɔ̃ amanehului amli ahi kɛwula shi.

english_verse: Jesus and the people he makes holy all belong to the same family. This is why he isn't ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɔ ni tsuuɔ mɛi ahe lɛ kɛ mɛi ni atsuuɔ amɛhe lɛ fɛɛ jɛ mɔ ko mli; no hewɔ jɛ ni ehiɛ gbooo akɛ eeetsɛ amɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ.

english_verse: He even said to God, “I will tell them your name and sing your praises when they come together to worship.”
translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ, “Matsĩ ogbɛi lɛ tã matsɔ̃ɔ minyɛmimɛi lɛ; asafo mli hu mala majie oyi yɛ.”

english_verse: He also said, “I will trust God.” Then he said, “Here I am with the children God has given me.”
translation_verse: Ekɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Maŋɔ mihiɛ mafɔ̃ enɔ.” Ni asaŋ, “Naa mi kɛ bii ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã mi lɛ!”

english_verse: We are people of flesh and blood. This is why Jesus became one of us. He died to destroy the devil, who had power over death.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni bii lɛ hiɛ heloo kɛ lá kome hewɔ lɛ, lɛ hu eŋɔ no nɔŋŋ eko tamɔ amɛ, koni etsɔ̃ gbele nɔ ekpãtã mɔ ni yɔɔ gbele nɔ hewalɛ ni ji abonsam lɛ hiɛ,

english_verse: But he also died to rescue all of us who live each day in fear of dying.
translation_verse: ni ekpɔ̃ mɛi fɛɛ ni gbele gbeyeishemɔ hewɔ lɛ amɛtsɔ̃mɔ nyɔji yɛ amɛwala be fɛɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: Jesus clearly did not come to help angels, but he did come to help Abraham's descendants.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ lɛɛlɛŋ, jeee ŋwɛi bɔfoi eyeɔ ebuaa, shi moŋ Abraham shwiei.

english_verse: He had to be one of us, so he could serve God as our merciful and faithful high priest and sacrifice himself for the forgiveness of our sins.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nibii fɛɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ esa akɛ etamɔ enyɛmimɛi lɛ, koni etsɔ̃ mɔbɔnalɔ kɛ anɔkwa osɔfonukpa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, koni ekpãtã ehã maŋ lɛ yɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: And now that Jesus has suffered and was tempted, he can help anyone else who is tempted.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ akɛni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ ena kaa mli amanehulu hewɔ lɛ, enyɛɔ eyeɔ ebuaa mɛi ni akaa amɛ lɛ.

english_verse: My friends, God has chosen you to be his holy people. So think about Jesus, the one we call our apostle and high priest!
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni ena ŋwɛi tsɛmɔ lɛ eko, nyɛjwɛŋa wɔhemɔkɛyeli jajemɔ lɛ he bɔfo kɛ osɔfonukpa ni ji Kristo Yesu lɛ he,

english_verse: Jesus was faithful to God, who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in serving all God's people.
translation_verse: mɔ ni ye mɔ ni to lɛ nakai gbɛhe lɛ anɔkwa, tamɔ bɔ ni Mose hu ye anɔkwa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ we lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: But Jesus deserves more honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house deserves more honor than the house.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mɔ ko ni ema shĩa woo fa fe shĩa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ Yesu hu hiɛ yɔɔ nyam fe Mose.

english_verse: Of course, every house is built by someone, and God is really the one who built everything.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ shĩa fɛɛ shĩa lɛ, mɔ ko kɛ̃ ma, shi mɔ ni maa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ji Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: Moses was a faithful servant and told God's people what would be said in the future.
translation_verse: Ni Mose lɛ, eye anɔkwa yɛ eshĩa muu lɛ fɛɛ mli akɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔ, koni eye nii ni abaawie lɛ ahe odase.

english_verse: But Christ is the Son in charge of God's people. And we are those people, if we keep on being brave and don't lose hope. A Rest for God's People
translation_verse: Shi Kristo lɛ, eye anɔkwa akɛ Bi yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe; lɛ ewe ji wɔ, kɛji wɔhiɛ nɔhiɛkãmɔ mli ekãa kɛ shwãa lɛ mli kpɛŋŋ kɛyashi naagbee lɛ. Ŋwanejee he kɔkɔbɔɔ

english_verse: It is just as the Holy Spirit says, “If you hear God's voice today,
translation_verse: Hewɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ, kɛji nyɛnu egbee lɛ,

english_verse: don't be stubborn! Don't rebel like those people who were tested in the desert. *
translation_verse: nyɛkawajea nyɛtsui, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee yɛ mlilawoo gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: For forty years your ancestors tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: he ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tsɔ̃ minaa, ni amɛka mi, ni amɛna minitsumɔi lɛ, afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ lɛ.

english_verse: “Then God got tired of them and said, ‘You people never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.’
translation_verse: Hewɔ lɛ mimli wo nakai yinɔbii lɛ ala ni mikɛɛ, ‘Amɛduɔ gbɛ yɛ amɛtsui amli daa. Shi amɛleee migbɛi lɛ.’

english_verse: God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ”
translation_verse: No hã mikã kitã yɛ mimlifu lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Kɛ amɛbote mihejɔɔmɔ lɛ mli fii!’ ”

english_verse: My friends, watch out! Don't let evil thoughts or doubts make any of you turn from the living God.
translation_verse: Nyɛkwɛa ni ahia, anyɛmimɛi, koni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko akahi tsui fɔŋ ni heee yeee ni ekpale kɛje Nyɔŋmɔ, hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, he.

english_verse: You must encourage one another each day. And you must keep on while there is still a time that can be called “today.” If you don't, then sin may fool some of you and make you stubborn.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ nyɛwiea nyɛtsɔ̃tsɔ̃ɔa nyɛhe gbi fɛɛ gbi ni atsɛɔ lɛ “ŋmɛnɛ” lɛ, koni esha lakamɔ akahã nyɛteŋ mɔ ko tsui kpliŋ.

english_verse: We were sure about Christ when we first became his people. So let's hold tightly to our faith until the end.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔtsɔ̃mɔ Kristo nanemɛi niyelɔi, kɛji wɔhiɛ wɔhe ni wɔkɛfɔ̃ɔ enɔ kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ mli kpɛŋŋ kɛyashi naagbee lɛ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn like those who rebelled.”
translation_verse: Ni akɛɛ akɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ, kɛji nyɛnu egbee lɛ, Nyɛkawajea nyɛtsui, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee yɛ mlilawoo lɛ mli” lɛ,

english_verse: Who were those people that heard God's voice and rebelled? Weren't they the same ones that came out of Egypt with Moses?
translation_verse: namɛi nu ni amɛwo emli la lɛ? Ani jeee mɛi ni kɛ Mose je Ijipt lɛ fɛɛ ni?

english_verse: And who did God say would never enter his place of rest? Weren't they the ones that disobeyed him?
translation_verse: Ni namɛi akitã ekã akɛ amɛboteŋ ehejɔɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ? Ani jeee mɛi ni gbo toi lɛ?

english_verse: We see that those people did not enter the place of rest because they did not have faith.
translation_verse: Ni wɔnaa akɛ he ni amɛheee amɛyeee lɛ hewɔ amɛnyɛɛɛ mli amɛbote lɛ.

english_verse: The promise to enter the place of rest is still good, and we must take care that none of you miss out.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, ni ashi ehejɔɔmɔ lɛ mlibotemɔ he shiwoo ahã wɔ nɛɛ, nyɛhãa wɔkwɛa jogbaŋŋ koni ekaba akɛ eŋmɛɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ ko.

english_verse: We have heard the message, just as they did. But they failed to believe what they heard, and the message did not do them any good.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔ hu ajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ wɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ajaje atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ; shi kɛ̃lɛ wiemɔ ni amɛnu lɛ he eyabaaa sɛɛnamɔ ko hãaa amɛ, ejaakɛ mɛi ni nu lɛ kɛ hemɔkɛyeli mɔɔɔ mli.

english_verse: Only people who have faith will enter the place of rest. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ” God said this, even though everything has been ready from the time of creation.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔ mɛi ni wɔhe wɔye lɛ wɔmiibote nakai hejɔɔmɔ lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, “No hã mikã kitã yɛ mimlifu lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Kɛ amɛbote mihejɔɔmɔ lɛ mli fii’ ” tsɛ agbe nitsumɔi lɛ anaa kɛjɛ jeŋ shishijee.

english_verse: In fact, somewhere the Scriptures say that by the seventh day, God had finished his work, and so he rested.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ bɔ ni ewie yɛ he ko yɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ he nɛ, “Ni Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ ehe yɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ enitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ mli.”

english_verse: We also read that he later said, “You people will never enter my place of rest!”
translation_verse: Ni biɛ nɛɛ esaa ekɛɛ, “Kɛ amɛbote mihejɔɔmɔ lɛ mli fii!”

english_verse: This means that the promise to enter is still good, because those who first heard about it disobeyed and did not enter.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni ekã shi faŋŋ akɛ mɛi komɛi baabote mli, ni mɛi ni ajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ tsutsu lɛ boteee mli yɛ he ni amɛheee amɛyeee hewɔ lɛ,

english_verse: Much later God told David to make the promise again, just as I have already said, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn!”
translation_verse: esaa eto gbi ko ekoŋŋ, ni etsɛ lɛ “Ŋmɛnɛ” yɛ nɔ ni etsɔ̃ David nɔ ewie be babaoo nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ mli, ni atsĩ tã momo lɛ, akɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ, kɛji nyɛnu egbee lɛ, nyɛkawajea nyɛtsui.”

english_verse: If Joshua had really given the people rest, there would not be any need for God to talk about another day of rest.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ eji Yoshua na hã amɛ hejɔɔmɔ kulɛ, fee sɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ewieŋ yɛ gbi kroko he dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: But God has promised us a Sabbath when we will rest, even though it has not yet come.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, hejɔɔmɔ gbiyeli ko kã shi kɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ lɛ.

english_verse: On that day God's people will rest from their work, just as God rested from his work.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ebote ehejɔɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu ejɔɔ ehe kɛjɛ enitsumɔi lɛ amli, tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ ehe kɛjɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: We should do our best to enter the place of rest, so none of us will disobey and miss going there, as they did.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔbɔa mɔdɛŋ koni wɔbote nakai hejɔɔmɔ lɛ mli, ni mɔ ko akagbee toigbele ni he okadi nɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ mli.

english_verse: God's word is alive and powerful! It is sharper than any double-edged sword. His word can cut through our spirits and souls and through our joints and marrow, until it discovers the desires and thoughts of our hearts.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ hiɛ kã ni eyɛ hewalɛ ni enaa ba fe klante kɛ enaa nta, ni egbuɔ kɛboteɔ mli aahu kɛyashɛɔ susuma kɛ mumɔ lɛ, kɛ talɔi kɛ wuiaŋfɔi lɛ akpeehei lɛ ni eji tsuiiaŋ susumɔi kɛ jwɛŋmɔi lɛ akojolɔ.

english_verse: Nothing is hidden from God! He sees through everything, and we will have to tell him the truth. Jesus Is the Great High Priest
translation_verse: Ni ateee bɔɔnɔ ko yɛ ehiɛ, shi nibii fɛɛ yɛ faŋŋ ni agbele nɔ yɛ lɛ mɔ ni wɔkɛyɔɔ sane lɛ hiɛ. Wɔyɛ osɔfonukpa mɔbɔnalɔ

english_verse: We have a great high priest, who has gone into heaven, and he is Jesus the Son of God. This is why we must hold on to what we have said about him.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ, akɛni wɔyɔɔ osɔfonukpa kpeteŋkple, ni efoŋ kɛtsɔ̃ ŋwɛiiaŋ, ni ji Yesu, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ nɛɛ, nyɛhãa wɔmɔa jajemɔ lɛ mli ni awaa.

english_verse: Jesus understands every weakness of ours, because he was tempted in every way that we are. But he did not sin!
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔsɔfonukpa ni wɔyɔɔ lɛ ejeee mɔ ni nyɛ̃ɛɛ anu wɔgbedemɔi lɛ ahe ahã wɔ, shi eji mɔ ko ni aka lɛ yɛ nibii fɛɛ agbɛfaŋ tamɔ wɔ, ni kɛ̃lɛ esha ko esha ko bɛ ehe.

english_verse: So whenever we are in need, we should come bravely before the throne of our merciful God. There we will be treated with undeserved grace, and we will find help.
translation_verse: Hewɔ lɛ nyɛhãa wɔkɛ ekãa atsia abɛŋkɛa dromɔ sɛi lɛ, koni wɔnine ashɛ mɔbɔnalɛ nɔ ni wɔna dromɔ ni aaaye abua wɔ yɛ be ni sa mli.

english_verse: Every high priest is appointed to help others by offering gifts and sacrifices to God because of their sins.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ osɔfonukpa fɛɛ osɔfonukpa ni ahala kɛjɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ lɛ, awo lɛ osɔfo ni edamɔ gbɔmɛi anajiaŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nii agbɛfaŋ, koni ekɛ nikeenii kɛ afɔlei abahã yɛ eshai ahewɔ,

english_verse: A high priest has weaknesses of his own, and he feels sorry for foolish and sinful people.
translation_verse: akɛ mɔ ko ni nyɛɔ ehiɛɔ mɛi ni leee nii kɛ mɛi ni edu gbɛ lɛ blɛoo, akɛni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu lɛ gbedemɔ ebɔle lɛ kɛkpe lɛ.

english_verse: This is why he must offer sacrifices for his own sins and for the sins of others.
translation_verse: Ni enɛ hewɔ lɛ ehe ehĩa akɛ eshã eshai ahe afɔle ehã ehe, tamɔ bɔ ni efeɔ ehãa maŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But no one can have the honor of being a high priest simply by wanting to be one. Only God can choose a priest, and God is the one who chose Aaron.
translation_verse: Ni mɔ ko eŋɔɔɔ nyam nɛɛ ehãaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe, akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ etsɛ lɛ, tamɔ etsɛ Aaron hu lɛ.

english_verse: This is how it was with Christ. He became a high priest, but not just because he wanted the honor of being one. It was God who told him, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!”
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ Kristo hu, jeee lɛ ewo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe osɔfonukpa kɛna hiɛnyam, shi moŋ mɔ ni kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mi-Bi ji bo, mi, mifɔ bo ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: In another place, God says, “You are a priest forever just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ yɛ he kroko hu akɛ, “Osɔfo ji bo kɛmiiya naanɔ yɛ Melkizedek gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ naa” lɛ.

english_verse: God had the power to save Jesus from death. And while Jesus was on earth, he begged God with loud crying and tears to save him. He truly worshiped God, and God listened to his prayers.
translation_verse: Kristo lɛ, be ni eyɔɔ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ ekɛ blɔmɔ ni naa wa kɛ yaafonui ŋɔ sɔlemɔi kɛ faikpamɔi ehã mɔ ni baanyɛ eyiwala ahere kɛjɛ gbele mli lɛ, tamɔ afɔle, ni eNyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ hewɔ lɛ abo lɛ toi.

english_verse: Jesus is God's own Son, but still he had to suffer before he could learn what it really means to obey God.
translation_verse: Ni tsɛ belɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji lɛ moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ ekase toiboo kɛjɛ amanehului ni ena lɛ amli.

english_verse: Suffering made Jesus perfect, and now he can save forever all who obey him.
translation_verse: Ni be ni ehi kɛwula shi lɛ, etsɔ̃ mɔ ni naanɔ yiwalaheremɔ jeɔ emli ehã mɛi fɛɛ ni boɔ lɛ toi lɛ,

english_verse: This is because God chose him to be a high priest like Melchizedek. Warning against Turning Away
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wo lɛ osɔfonukpa yɛ Melkizedek gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ naa. Kristofoi akahi shi tamɔ gbekɛbii yɛ mumɔŋ gbɛfaŋ

english_verse: Much more could be said about this subject. But it is hard to explain, and all of you are slow to understand.
translation_verse: Wɔyɛ wiemɔi pii ni wɔɔwie yɛ enɛ he ni shishitsɔɔmɔ wa, ni nyɛyɛ shɔ̃ɔ kɛ niiashishinumɔ.

english_verse: By now you should have been teachers, but once again you need to be taught the simplest things about what God has said. You need milk instead of solid food.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɛ ni kulɛ benɛ lɛ esa akɛ nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ tsɔɔlɔi moŋ lɛ, ehe ehĩa akɛ atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi lɛ amli shishijee nibii lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni fufɔ he ehia amɛ, shi jeee niyenii ni tsii.

english_verse: People who live on milk are like babies who don't really know what is right.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ fufɔ lɛ, eleee jalɛ he nitsɔɔmɔ lɛ he nɔ ko; ejaakɛ fufɔoo ji lɛ.

english_verse: Solid food is for mature people who have been trained to know right from wrong.
translation_verse: Shi mɛi ni edara lɛ anɔ ji niyenii ni tsii, mɛi ni fɔ ni amɛfɔɔ feemɔ lɛ ehã amɛhenumɔnii lɛ ele ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋ teŋ srɔto.

english_verse: We must try to become mature and start thinking about more than just the basic things we were taught about Christ. We shouldn't need to keep talking about why we ought to turn from deeds that bring death and why we ought to have faith in God.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔshĩa Kristo he nitsɔɔmɔ lɛ shishijee nibii lɛ, ni wɔfo mli kɛya tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ni sa onukpai ahe; ni wɔkakã he wɔto nitsumɔi ni egboi ahe tsuitsakemɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli,

english_verse: And we shouldn't need to keep teaching about baptisms or about the laying on of hands or about people being raised from death and the future judgment.
translation_verse: kɛ baptisimɔi ahe nitsɔɔmɔ kɛ niji kɛ nɔshwiemɔ, kɛ gbohiiashitee kɛ naanɔ kojomɔ he saji lɛ ashishi ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: Let's grow up, if God is willing.
translation_verse: Ni wɔɔfee enɛ aahu, kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaaŋmɛ gbɛ lɛ.

english_verse: A field is useful to farmers, if there is enough rain to make good crops grow. In fact, God will bless such a field.
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ ni miiɔ nu ni nɛɔ shwieɔ enɔ kpitiokpitio ni ebaa nii ni hi hã mɛi ni huɔ nɔ lɛ, enaa Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔmɔ lɛ eko.

english_verse: But land that produces only thornbushes is worthless. It is likely to fall under God's curse, and in the end it will be set on fire.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ ŋmei kɛ aŋlɛŋlɛ ekwɛ̃ɔ lɛ, ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ, ni ebɛŋkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ loomɔ, ni enaagbee ji shãa.

english_verse: My friends, we are talking this way. But we are sure that you are doing those really good things people do when they are being saved.
translation_verse: Shi wɔsuɔmɔ mɛi, wɔmiikɛɛ nɛkɛ moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔhiɛ kã nyɛnɔ akɛ nyɛsane hi fe nakai, ni yiwalaheremɔ aaanyiɛ sɛɛ.

english_verse: God is always fair. He will remember how you helped his people in the past and how you are still helping them. You belong to God, and he won't forget the love you have shown his people.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jeee mɔ ni yeɔ sane ni ejaaa ni ehiɛ aaakpa nyɛnitsumɔ lɛ nɔ kɛ suɔmɔ ni nyɛjie kpo yɛ egbɛi lɛ hewɔ, ni nyɛkɛsɔ̃mɔ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni nyɛsaa nyɛsɔ̃mɔɔ amɛ lolo lɛ.

english_verse: We wish each of you would always be eager to show how strong and lasting your hope really is.
translation_verse: Shi wɔmiitao akɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ajie nɛkɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ kpo, koni nyɛna hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ nɔmimaa kɛyashi naagbee,

english_verse: Then you would never be lazy. You would be following the example of those who had faith and were patient until God kept his promise to them. God's Promise Is Sure
translation_verse: koni nyɛkafee kpɔkee, shi moŋ nyɛkɔ mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ tsuishitoo nɔ naa shiwoi lɛ anane. Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoo ni ma shi shiŋŋ

english_verse: No one is greater than God. So he made a promise in his own name when he said to Abraham,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ be ni Nyɔŋmɔ wo Abraham shi lɛ, akɛni ebɛ mɔ ko ni fe lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ni eeekã lɛ kitã hewɔ lɛ, ekã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kitã

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will bless you with many descendants!”
translation_verse: ekɛɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ, jɔɔmɔ majɔɔ bo ni fa hu mahã oshwiei afa.”

english_verse: Then after Abraham had been very patient, he was given what God had promised.
translation_verse: Ni akɛni Abraham to etsui shi hewɔ lɛ, enine shɛ shiwoo lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: When anyone wants to settle an argument, they make a vow by using the name of someone or something greater than themselves.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ gbɔmɛi yɔɔ nɛɛ, mɔ ni fe amɛ lɛ, lɛ kitã amɛkãa, ni amɛŋwanejee fɛɛ naagbee ji kitãkãmɔ ni akɛmaa sane nɔ aduatsɔ lɛ.

english_verse: So when God wanted to prove for certain his promise to his people could not be broken, he made a vow.
translation_verse: No hewɔ hu ni be ni Nyɔŋmɔ tao akɛ etsɔ̃ɔ shiwoo lɛ yelɔi lɛ akɛ eyiŋtoo lɛ tsakeee kwraa lɛ, ekɛ kitã damɔ mli

english_verse: God cannot tell lies! And so his promises and vows are two things that can never be changed. We have run to God for safety. Now his promises should greatly encourage us to take hold of the hope that is right in front of us.
translation_verse: koni wɔtsɔ̃ saji enyɔ ni tsakeee ni Nyɔŋmɔ nyɛŋ emale yɛ mli lɛ anɔ wɔna miishɛjemɔ ni wa, ni wɔ mɛi ni wɔyaba abo lɛ wɔkɛmɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni kã wɔhiɛ lɛ mli;

english_verse: This hope is like a firm and steady anchor for our souls. In fact, hope reaches behind the curtain and into the most holy place.
translation_verse: nɔ ni wɔhiɛ tamɔ wɔsusuma sɛkɛ ni tseee ni efi shi shiŋŋ ni ebote mli kɛtee muhɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ tɔ̃ɔ,

english_verse: Jesus has gone there ahead of us, and he is our high priest forever, just like Melchizedek.
translation_verse: he ni hiɛnyiɛlɔ lɛ ni ji Yesu, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ naanɔ osɔfonukpa yɛ Melkizedek gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ naa lɛ, bote hã wɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Melchizedek was both king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He was the one who went out and gave Abraham his blessing, when Abraham returned from killing the kings.
translation_verse: Shi Melkizedek nɛɛ, lɛ ji Salem maŋtsɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ osɔfo, ni kɛ Abraham yakpe be ni eku esɛɛ kɛjɛ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ agbee ní ejɔɔ lɛ lɛ,

english_verse: Then Abraham gave him a tenth of everything he had. The meaning of the name Melchizedek is “King of Justice.” But since Salem means “peace,” he is also “King of Peace.”
translation_verse: ni Abraham hã lɛ nomŋɔɔnii lɛ fɛɛ mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome. Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ egbɛi lɛ shishitsɔɔmɔ ji “Jalɛ Maŋtsɛ;” no sɛɛ lɛ eji Salem Maŋtsɛ hu, ni no shishi ji “Hejɔlɛ Maŋtsɛ.”

english_verse: We are not told he had a father or mother or ancestors or beginning or end. He is like the Son of God and will be a priest forever.
translation_verse: Ebɛ tsɛ lɛ, ebɛ nyɛ, ebɛ wekukpãa, ebɛ gbii ashishijee loo wala naagbee tete; shi tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, ehiɔ shi akɛ osɔfo daa nɛɛ.

english_verse: Notice how great Melchizedek was! Our famous ancestor Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had taken from his enemies.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ nyɛkwɛa bɔ ni mɔ nɛ da hã, akɛ blematsɛ Abraham lɛ tete ŋɔ nomŋɔɔnii kpakpai lɛ amlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome ehã lɛ!

english_verse: The Law teaches that even Abraham's descendants must give a tenth of what they possess. And they are to give this to their own relatives, who are the descendants of Levi and are priests.
translation_verse: Levibii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni tsuɔ osɔfoi anitsumɔ lɛ hu yɛ kitã ko akɛ amɛhe mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome yɛ maŋ lɛ dɛŋ yɛ Mla lɛ naa, no ji yɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ adɛŋ, tsɛ amɛ hu amɛjɛ Abraham mli;

english_verse: Although Melchizedek wasn't a descendant of Levi, Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had. Then Melchizedek blessed Abraham, who had been given God's promise.
translation_verse: shi mɔ ni bɛ wekukpãa ko yɛ amɛteŋ nɛɛ, ehe mlijai nyɔŋma lɛ mli ekome yɛ Abraham tete dɛŋ, ni ejɔɔ mɔ ni yɔɔ shiwoi lɛ tete.

english_verse: Everyone agrees a person who gives a blessing is greater than the one who receives the blessing.
translation_verse: Shi ebɛ ŋwanejee ko kwraa akɛ mɔ ni da fe mɔ lɛ, lɛ ejɔɔ mɔ ni edaaa lɛ.

english_verse: Priests are given a tenth of what people earn. But all priests die, except Melchizedek, and the Scriptures teach that he is alive.
translation_verse: Ni asaŋ, biɛ lɛ, gbɔmɛi ni gboiɔ lɛ ji mɛi ni heɔ mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ, shi jɛi lɛ, mɔ ko ni aye ehe odase akɛ ehiɔ shi daa lɛ he.

english_verse: Levi's descendants are now the ones who receive a tenth from people. We could even say that when Abraham gave Melchizedek a tenth, Levi also gave him a tenth.
translation_verse: Ni, kɛ makɛɛ nakai lɛ, kɛtsɔ̃ Abraham nɔ lɛ ahe mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ yɛ Levi ni heɔ no lɛ hu dɛŋ,

english_verse: This is because Levi was born later into the family of Abraham, who gave a tenth to Melchizedek.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ eyɛ etsɛ lɛ mli lolo, be ni Melkizedek kɛ lɛ bakpe lɛ. Melkizedek osɔfoyeli lɛ guɔ Levibii anɔ lɛ

english_verse: Even though the Law of Moses says the priests must be descendants of Levi, those priests cannot make anyone perfect. So there needs to be a priest like Melchizedek, rather than one from the priestly family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ kɛji emuuyeli tsɔ̃ Levibii asɔfoyeli lɛ nɔ kɛba lɛ , mɛɛ hiamɔ ehia lolo akɛ osɔfo kroko ate shi yɛ Melkizedek gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ naa, ni awooo lɛ yɛ Aaron gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ naa?

english_verse: And when the rules for selecting a priest are changed, the Law must also be changed.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ atsake osɔfoyeli lɛ, belɛ ehe ehĩa akɛ atsake Mla lɛ hu.

english_verse: The person we are talking about is our Lord, who came from a tribe that had never had anyone to serve as a priest at the altar.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɔ he ni akɛɛ nii nɛɛ yɛ lɛ ejɛ akutso kroko mli, nɔ mli ni mɔ ko jɛko ebasɔ̃mɔko yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ he pɛŋ;

english_verse: Everyone knows he came from the tribe of Judah, and Moses never said priests would come from that tribe.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ eyɛ faŋŋ akɛ Yuda mli wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ jɛ, shi nakai akutso lɛ Mose ewieee he nɔ ko yɛ osɔfoyeli hewɔ.

english_verse: All of this becomes clearer, when someone who is like Melchizedek is appointed to be a priest.
translation_verse: Ni ejeɔ kpo faŋŋ kwraa fe nɛkɛ kɛji osɔfo kroko te shi ni tamɔ Melkizedek,

english_verse: That person wasn't appointed because of his ancestors, but because his life can never end.
translation_verse: osɔfo ni jeee heloo kitã mla naa awo lɛ yɛ, shi moŋ wala ni fiteee lɛ hewalɛ naa.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about him, “You are a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ aye odase akɛ, “Osɔfo ji bo kɛmiiya naanɔ yɛ Melkizedek gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ naa.”

english_verse: In this way a weak and useless command was put aside,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kitã ni tsɔ̃ hiɛ lɛ, akɛni ebɛ hewalɛ ni ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko hewɔ lɛ agu,

english_verse: because the Law cannot make anything perfect. At the same time, we are given a much better hope, and it can bring us close to God.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Mla lɛ hãaa nɔ ko nɔ ko aye emuu, shi agbɛnɛ ahã hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni hi fe no eba, nɔ nɔ ni wɔtsɔ̃ɔ wɔbɛŋkɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ. Kristo osɔfoyeli lɛ damɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kitã nɔ

english_verse: God himself made a promise when this priest was appointed. But he did not make a promise like this when the other priests were appointed. The promise he made is, “I, the Lord, promise that you will be a priest forever! And I will never change my mind!”
translation_verse: Shi Kristo lɛ, kitãkãmɔ akɛwo lɛ, yɛ mɔ ni kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ekã kitã ni eshwaŋ ehe, akɛ, ‘Osɔfo ji bo kɛmiiya naanɔ,’ ” lɛ wiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ,

english_verse: This means that Jesus guarantees us a better agreement with God.
translation_verse: babaoo ni kpãŋmɔ ni Yesu ji sɛɛdaamɔlɔ yɛ mli lɛ hi fe no ji no.

english_verse: There have been a lot of other priests, and all of them have died.
translation_verse: Ni amɛ lɛ, akɛni gbele hãaa amɛwo shihilɛ hewɔ lɛ, amɛyi pii amɛye osɔfoi;

english_verse: But Jesus will never die, and so he will be a priest forever!
translation_verse: shi mɔ nɛ lɛ, akɛni ehiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ hewɔ lɛ, esɔfoyeli lɛ sɛɛ efooo.

english_verse: He is forever able to save the people he leads to God, because he always lives to speak to God for them.
translation_verse: No hewɔ hu lɛ enyɛɔ mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ enɔ kɛbaa Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ ayiwala ehereɔ kwraa, akɛni eyɛ daa koni edamɔ mli ehã amɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Jesus is the high priest we need. He is holy and innocent and faultless, and not at all like us sinners. Jesus is honored above all beings in heaven,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Yesu lɛ Osɔfonukpa ni sa wɔ pɛ nɛ. Mɔ ni he tse, ni efɔŋ ko bɛ ehe, ni ehe bɛ kpa ko, ni etse ehe kɛjɛ esha he, ni awo enɔ ahã ekwɔ fe ŋwɛii.

english_verse: and he is better than any other high priest. Jesus doesn't need to offer sacrifices each day for his own sins and then for the sins of the people. He offered a sacrifice once for all, when he gave himself.
translation_verse: Ehe Ehĩaaa lɛ, tamɔ nakai osɔfonukpai lɛ, akɛ gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ eshã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe eshai ahe afɔle tsutsu, dani eshã maŋ lɛ hu nɔ. Ejaakɛ efee enɛ shi kome nyɔŋlo, be ni eŋɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe eshã afɔle lɛ!

english_verse: The Law appoints priests who have weaknesses. But God's promise, which came later than the Law, appoints his Son. And he is the perfect high priest forever.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Mla lɛ, gbɔmɛi gbedelɔi eŋɔ woɔ osɔfonukpai lɛ, shi wiemɔ ni akɛkã kitã yɛ Mla lɛ sɛɛ lɛ ewo Bi ni eye emuu kɛyaa naanɔ lɛ Osɔfonukpa.

english_verse: What I mean is we have a high priest who sits at the right side of God's great throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Shi nii ni wɔwieɔ lɛ mli sane titri nɛ, nɛkɛ Osɔfonukpa wɔyɔɔ; Osɔfonukpa ni ta mɔ ni je agbo lɛ maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ yɛ ŋwɛi

english_verse: He also serves as the priest in the most holy place inside the real tent there in heaven. This tent of worship was set up by the Lord, not by humans.
translation_verse: akɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ anɔkwa Buu lɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ shi ni jeee gbɔmɔ ko shi lɛ mli sɔ̃ɔlɔ.

english_verse: Since all priests must offer gifts and sacrifices, Christ also needed to have something to offer.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ osɔfonukpa fɛɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ, awo lɛ koni eŋɔ nikeenii kɛ afɔlei ebahã; no hewɔ lɛ, ehĩa akɛ mɔ nɛ hu ana nɔ ko ni ekɛbahã.

english_verse: If he were here on earth, he would not be a priest at all, because here the Law appoints other priests to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Shi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyɔɔ kulɛ, eyeŋ osɔfo tete, ejaakɛ osɔfoi ni kɛ nikeenii yahãa yɛ Mla lɛ naa yɛ,

english_verse: But the tent where they serve is just a copy and a shadow of the real one in heaven. Before Moses made the tent, he was told, “Be sure to make it exactly like the pattern you were shown on the mountain!”
translation_verse: tsɛ amɛ lɛ ŋwɛi He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ kɛ esusuma kɛkɛ mli amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ Mose, be ni ebaafee buu lɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, “Kwɛmɔ ni ahi koni ofee nibii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ bo yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ naa.”

english_verse: Now Christ has been appointed to serve as a priest in a much better way, and he has given us much assurance of a better agreement.
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ osɔfoyeli ni Kristo ena lɛ hi kwraa fe tsutsunɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni kpãŋmɔ ni eji emlidaamɔlɔ lɛ hi fe tsutsunɔ ni adamɔ shiwoi ni hi fe tsutsunii lɛ anɔ lɛ akpãŋ lɛ.

english_verse: If the first agreement with God had been all right, there would not have been any need for another one.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ eji sane ko bɛ tsutsunɔ lɛ he kulɛ, ataooo gbɛ ahãaa nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord found fault with it and said, “I tell you the time will come, when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shwa amɛ ekɛɛ, “Naa, gbii miiba, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, ni mikɛ Israel we lɛ kɛ Yuda we lɛ aaakpãŋ kpãŋmɔ hee,

english_verse: It won't be like the agreement that I made with their ancestors, when I took them by the hand and led them out of Egypt. They broke their agreement with me, and I stopped caring about them!
translation_verse: jeee tamɔ kpãŋmɔ ni mikɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ Gbi nɔ ni mimɔ amɛnine shi ni mikɛ amɛ je Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛyeee mikpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ. Ni mi hu mijwɛŋŋ amɛnɔ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ.

english_verse: “But now I tell the people of Israel this is my new agreement: ‘The time will come when I, the Lord, will write my laws on their minds and hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Shi enɛ ji kpãŋmɔ ni mikɛ Israel we lɛ baakpãŋ yɛ nakai gbii lɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, Mikɛ mimlai aaawo amɛjwɛŋmɔ mli, Ni maŋma mawo amɛtsui mli, ni matsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛ hu amɛaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ.

english_verse: Not one of them will have to teach another to know me, their Lord.’ “All of them will know me, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko etsɔ̃ŋ emaŋnyo loo enyɛmi dɔŋŋ akɛ, ‘Le Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.’ Ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛaale mi, kɛaajɛ amɛteŋ mɔ bibioo nɔ kɛyashi mɔ wulu nɔ.

english_verse: I will treat them with kindness, even though they are wicked. I will forget their sins.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mana amɛ mɔbɔ yɛ amɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ agbɛfaŋ, ni amɛhe eshai lɛ hu mikaiŋ dɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: When the Lord talks about a new agreement, he means that the first one is out of date. And anything that is old and useless will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Ekɛ wiemɔ “ehee” ni ekɛɛ nɛɛ ehã klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ lɛ efee emomo. Shi nɔ ni efee emomo kɛ nɔ ni egbɔ lɛ, etsɛŋ ni eeelaaje.

english_verse: The first promise included rules for worship and a tent for worship here on earth.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ klɛŋklɛŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ hu yɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ he gbɛjianɔtoo kɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ he krɔŋkrɔŋ.

english_verse: The first part of the tent was called the holy place, and a lampstand, a table, and the sacred loaves of bread were kept there.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ashi buu ko amã shi, ni he ni oyiɔ klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, kanetso kɛ okplɔ̃ kɛ hiɛmaa aboloi lɛ yɔɔ jɛi; atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ.

english_verse: The gold altar for burning incense was in this holy place. The gold-covered sacred chest was also there, and inside it were three things. First, there was a gold jar filled with manna. Then there was Aaron's walking stick that sprouted. Finally, there were the flat stones with the Ten Commandments written on them.
translation_verse: Jɛi shika tsofakɛŋma shãa nɔ lɛ kɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka ni akɛ shika eha he fɛɛ lɛ yɔɔ; no mli shika kpulu kɛ emli mana lɛ kɛ Aaron tso ni gba afofro lɛ kɛ kpãŋmɔ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ yɔɔ.

english_verse: On top of the chest were the glorious creatures with wings opened out above the place of mercy. Now isn't the time to go into detail about these things.
translation_verse: Ni no nɔ anunyam kerubim ni ha kpãtãmɔ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ yɔɔ; nii ni amrɔ nɛɛ wɔnyɛŋ amɛhe wɔwie ekomekome lɛ.

english_verse: But this is how everything was when the priests went each day into the first part of the tent to do their duties.
translation_verse: Ni be ni asaa nibii nɛɛ nɛkɛ lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ yaa klɛŋklɛŋ buu lɛ mli daa gbi, amɛyatsuɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ;

english_verse: However, only the high priest could go into the second part of the tent, and he went in only once a year. Each time he carried blood to offer for his sins and for any sins that the people had committed without meaning to.
translation_verse: shi buu ni ji enyɔ lɛ, osɔfonukpa lɛ kɛkɛ yaa mli shi kome daa afi, ni eyaaa ni ehiɛɛɛ lá, ni ekɛyahãa yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ tɔ̃mɔi ni amɛleee lɛ ahewɔ lɛ.

english_verse: All of this is the Holy Spirit's way of saying no one could enter the most holy place while the tent was still the place of worship.
translation_verse: Enɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ akɛ gbii abɔ ni klɛŋklɛŋ buu lɛ mã shi lolo nɛɛ, belɛ gbɛ ni akɛyaa He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ anako ajie shi atsɔ̃ɔ.

english_verse: This also has a meaning for today. It shows we cannot make our consciences clear by offering gifts and sacrifices.
translation_verse: Eji benɛ be lɛ he okadi ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nikeenii kɛ afɔlei ni akɛbahãa lɛ nyɛŋ ahã mɔ ni jaa lɛ aye emuu yɛ henilee gbɛfaŋ,

english_verse: These rules are merely about such things as eating and drinking and ceremonies for washing ourselves. And rules about physical things will last only until the time comes to change them for something better.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ nibii nɛɛ kɔɔ niyenii kɛ ninumɔnii kɛ hejuu srɔtoi ni ji heloo gbɛnaanii ni ato akɛ afee kɛkɛ ahe kɛyashi be ni aaasaa nibii fɛɛ afee amɛ ehee. Kristo osɔfoyeli ni ye emuu lɛ

english_verse: Christ came as the high priest of the good things that are now here. He also went into a much better tent that wasn't made by humans and that doesn't belong to this world.
translation_verse: Shi Kristo ni ba akɛ nibii kpakpai ni baaba lɛ ahe Osɔfonukpa lɛ, etsɔ̃ buu ni da ni hi kɛwula shi fe klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ lɛ mli; buu ni jeee niji akɛfee, no ji akɛ jeee je nɛɛ mli bɔɔnii amli ejɛ;

english_verse: Then Christ went once for all into the most holy place and freed us from sin forever. He did this by offering his own blood instead of the blood of goats and bulls.
translation_verse: ni asaŋ jeee too kpakpoi loo tsinabii alá nɔ etsɔ̃, shi moŋ etsɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ elá lɛ nɔ ebote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli shi kome nyɔŋlo ekɛna naanɔ kpɔ̃mɔ lɛ.

english_verse: According to the Law of Moses, those people who become unclean are not fit to worship God. Yet they will be considered clean, if they are sprinkled with the blood of goats and bulls and with the ashes of a sacrificed calf.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ too kpakpo kɛ tsinai alá kɛ tsina yoo lamlu ni atsɔɔ ashwãa mɛi ni ebule amɛhe lɛ anɔ lɛ tsuuɔ amɛhe ni amɛhe tseɔ yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ lɛ,

english_verse: But Christ was sinless, and he offered himself as an eternal and spiritual sacrifice to God. This is why his blood is much more powerful and makes our consciences clear. Now we can serve the living God and no longer do things that lead to death.
translation_verse: enyiɛ nɔŋŋ ni Kristo ni tsɔ̃ naanɔ Mumɔ lɛ nɔ eŋɔ ehe ni kpa ko bɛ he lɛ ehã Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ afɔle lɛ lá lɛ tsumɔŋ wɔhenilee lɛ he kɛjɛŋ nitsumɔi gbohii amli, koni wɔsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ? Kristo ji kpãŋmɔ hee mlidaamɔlɔ

english_verse: Christ died to rescue those who had sinned and broken the old agreement. Now he brings his chosen ones a new agreement with its guarantee of God's eternal blessings!
translation_verse: Ni enɛ hewɔ ni eji kpãŋmɔ hee mlidaamɔlɔ lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni mɛi ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsɛ amɛ lɛ anine ashɛ naanɔ gboshinii lɛ ni ewo he shi lɛ nɔ, akɛni ekɛ egbele kpɔ̃ amɛ kɛjɛ klɛŋklɛŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔtɔmɔi lɛ amli lɛ.

english_verse: In fact, making an agreement of this kind is like writing a will. This is because the one who makes the will must die before it is of any use.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ he ni awo shamaŋsheo yɛ lɛ, ehe ehia akɛ atsɔ̃ɔ akɛ mɔ ni wo lɛ egbo,

english_verse: In other words, a will doesn't go into effect as long as the one who made it is still alive.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ shamaŋsheo lɛ, ja agbo dani enaa hewalɛ, akɛni kɛji mɔ ni wo lɛ hiɛ kã lolo lɛ, ebɛ hewalɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Blood was also used to put the first agreement into effect.
translation_verse: No hewɔ ni klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ lɛ hu ashiii lá sɛɛ awooo lɛ.

english_verse: Moses told the people all the Law said they must do. Then he used red wool and a hyssop plant to sprinkle the people and the book of the Law with the blood of bulls and goats and with water.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ be ni Mose ejaje kitã etsɔ̃ɔ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Mla lɛ naa lɛ, eŋɔ tsinabii kɛ too kpakpoi lɛ alá lɛ kɛ nu kɛ too gwantɛŋ hetsɔi tsuru kɛ hisopo, ni ekɛ shwã wolo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ

english_verse: He told the people, “With this blood God makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: ekɛɛ, “Naa, kpãŋmɔ lɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ wo nyɛ he kitã lɛ lá lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: Moses also sprinkled blood on the tent and on everything else used in worship.
translation_verse: Ni buu lɛ hu kɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ he nii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ lá lɛ shwã nɔ nakai nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: The Law says that almost everything must be sprinkled with blood, and no sins can be forgiven unless blood is offered. Christ's Great Sacrifice
translation_verse: Ni shwɛ fioo ni lá akɛtsuuɔ nii fɛɛ he yɛ Mla lɛ naa; ni kɛ ashwieee lá shi lɛ, akɛfaaa. Kristo kɛ ehe shã afɔle shi kome nyɔŋlo

english_verse: These things are only copies of what is in heaven, and so they had to be made holy by these ceremonies. But the real things in heaven must be made holy by something better.
translation_verse: Belɛ ehe ehĩa akɛ nii ni ji ŋwɛinii lɛ afoniri nɛɛ akɛ enɛɛmɛi atsuu he; shi ŋwɛinii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, afɔlei ni hi fe nomɛi akɛtsuuɔ he.

english_verse: This is why Christ did not go into a tent made by humans and was only a copy of the real one. Instead, he went into heaven and is now there with God to help us.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ jeee He Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛ niji fee ni ji nii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ afoniri kɛkɛ lɛ mli Kristo yabote lɛ; shi moŋ ŋwɛi diɛŋtsɛ eyabote, koni agbɛnɛ eyapue yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ehã wɔ.

english_verse: Christ did not have to offer himself many times. He wasn't like a high priest who goes into the most holy place each year to offer the blood of an animal.
translation_verse: Asaŋ eyaboteee jɛi koni eŋɔ ehe ehã shii abɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni osɔfonukpa lɛ yaboteɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ daa afi kɛ lá ni jeee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ lɛ;

english_verse: If he had offered himself every year, he would have suffered many times since the creation of the world. But instead, near the end of time he offered himself once and for all, so he could be a sacrifice that does away with sin.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ nakai ni kulɛ, esa akɛ ena amanehulu kpitiokpitio kɛjɛ jeŋ shishijee beebe; shi agbɛnɛ lɛ shi kome kɛkɛ ajie lɛ kpo yɛ bei lɛ anaagbee lɛ mli, koni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe ni ekɛshã afɔle lɛ ajie esha lɛ.

english_verse: We die only once, and then we are judged.
translation_verse: Gbii abɔ ni ekã shi ehã gbɔmɛi akɛ shi kome amɛgboiɔ, shi no sɛɛ lɛ abaakojo amɛ lɛ,

english_verse: So Christ died only once to take away the sins of many people. But when he comes again, it will not be to take away sin. He will come to save everyone who is waiting for him.
translation_verse: nakai nɔŋŋ Kristo hu, akɛni aŋɔ lɛ ahã shi kome koni etere mɛi pii ahe eshai kɛya lɛ, nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ lɛ eeeshi esha ebapue ehã mɛi ni kwɛɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ ni ehere amɛyiwala.

english_verse: The Law of Moses is like a shadow of the good things to come. This shadow isn't the good things themselves, because it cannot free people from sin by the sacrifices offered year after year.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nii kpakpai ni baaba lɛ asusuma kɛkɛ Mla lɛ hiɛ, ni jeee nibii lɛ asubaŋ diɛŋtsɛ ni, hewɔ lɛ enyɛŋ ekɛ daa afi afɔlei ni ashãa nɔtonɔto lɛ ahã mɛi ni babɛŋkɛɔ lɛ ahi kɛwula shi gbi ko gbi ko.

english_verse: If there were worshipers who already have their sins washed away and their consciences made clear, there would not be any need to go on offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Jeee nakai kulɛ ani afɔŋ afɔlei lɛ shãa? Ejaakɛ kulɛ mɛi ni bajaa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ atsuu amɛhe shi kome pɛ lɛ, amɛbɛ eshai ahe nilee kwraa dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: When Christ came into the world, he said to God, “Sacrifices and offerings are not what you want, but you have given me my body.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Yesu baa je nɛɛ mli lɛ akɛɛ, “Afɔle kɛ nikeenii lɛ osumɔɔɔ, shi gbɔmɔtso osaa ohã mi.

english_verse: No, you are not pleased with animal sacrifices and offerings for sin.”
translation_verse: Shãa afɔlei kɛ esha he afɔlei esaaa ohiɛ,

english_verse: Then Christ said, “And so, my God, I have come to do what you want, as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: No ni mikɛɛ, ‘Naa, miba, aŋma mihe sane yɛ wolokpo lɛ mli. Ni mibafee bo, Nyɔŋmɔ, osuɔmɔnaanii lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: The Law teaches that offerings and sacrifices must be made because of sin. But why did Christ mention these things and say that God did not want them?
translation_verse: Be ni ekɛɛ tsutsu lɛ akɛ, “Afɔle kɛ nikeenii kɛ shãa afɔlei kɛ esha he afɔlei lɛ osumɔɔɔ, ni esaaa ohiɛ hu,” ;

english_verse: Well, it was to do away with offerings and sacrifices and to replace them. This is what he meant by saying to God, “I have come to do what you want.”
translation_verse: ni esaa ekɛɛ, “Naa, miba ni mibafee bo, Nyɔŋmɔ, osuɔmɔnaanii lɛ,” ejie tsutsu nɔ lɛ koni ekɛ nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ ama shi.

english_verse: So we are made holy because Christ obeyed God and offered himself once for all.
translation_verse: Nakai suɔmɔnaa nii lɛ mli atsuu wɔhe yɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo gbɔmɔtso ni ekɛhã shi kome nyɔŋlo lɛ nɔ. Kristo afɔleshãa lɛ tsuɔ nii

english_verse: The priests do their work each day, and they keep on offering sacrifices that can never take away sins.
translation_verse: Ni osɔfo fɛɛ osɔfo lɛ, gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ, edamɔɔ shi esɔ̃mɔɔ, ni eshãa nakai afɔlei lɛ nɔŋŋ kpitiokpitio, nii ni nyɛɛɛ eshai ajie gbi ko gbi ko lɛ.

english_verse: But Christ offered himself as a sacrifice that is good forever. Now he is sitting at God's right side,
translation_verse: Shi Kristo lɛ, lɛ lɛ, be ni eshã eshai ahe afɔle shi kome nyɔŋlo lɛ, eyata Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ.

english_verse: and he will stay there until his enemies are put under his power.
translation_verse: Ni nɔ ni eshwɛ ji akɛ eemɛ “Kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaaŋɔ ehenyɛlɔi lɛ afee enajiaŋshi maaŋoo.”

english_verse: By his one sacrifice he has forever set free from sin the people he brings to God.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ afɔle kome ni eshã lɛ, ekɛhã mɛi ni atsuu amɛhe lɛ ehi kɛwula shi nyɔŋlo.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit also speaks of this by telling us that the Lord said,
translation_verse: Ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hu yeɔ wɔ odase; ejaakɛ ekɛɛ momo akɛ,

english_verse: “When the time comes, I will make an agreement with them. I will write my laws on their minds and hearts.
translation_verse: “Enɛ ji kpãŋmɔ ni mikɛ amɛ aaakpãŋ yɛ nakai gbii lɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ. Mikɛ mimlai lɛ aaawo amɛtsuii amli, ni maŋma mawo amɛjwɛŋmɔ mli,

english_verse: Then I will forget about their sins and no longer remember their evil deeds.”
translation_verse: Ni amɛhe eshai lɛ kɛ amɛnɔ̃tɔ̃mɔi lɛ mikaiŋ kwraa dɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: When sins are forgiven, there is no more need to offer sacrifices. Encouragement and Warning
translation_verse: Ni he ni akɛ enɛɛmɛi efa yɛ lɛ, eshai ahe afɔleshãa ko bɛ dɔŋŋ. Gbɛ ni akɛyaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ

english_verse: My friends, the blood of Jesus gives us courage to enter the most holy place
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, wɔyɛ ekãa ni wɔkɛaabote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli yɛ Yesu lá lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: by a new way that leads to life! And this way takes us through the curtain that is Christ himself.
translation_verse: Eji gbɛ hee ni ji wala gbɛ ni eje ehã wɔ kɛtsɔ̃ muhɔɔ lɛ ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eheloo lɛ mli.

english_verse: We have a great high priest who is in charge of God's house.
translation_verse: Ni asaŋ akɛni wɔyɛ Osɔfonukpa kpeteŋkple ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ we lɛ nɔ hewɔ lɛ,

english_verse: So let's come near God with pure hearts and a confidence that comes from having faith. Let's keep our hearts pure, our consciences free from evil, and our bodies washed with clean water.
translation_verse: nyɛhãa wɔkɛ anɔkwa tsui ababɛŋkɛa yɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni wɔyɔɔ hewalɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ mli, kɛ tsui hu ni atsuu he ni ebɛ henilee fɔŋ ko dɔŋŋ, kɛ gbɔmɔtso ni akɛ nu ni mli tse eju he.

english_verse: We must hold tightly to the hope we say is ours. After all, we can trust the one who made the agreement with us.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛhãa wɔmɔa wɔhiɛnɔkãmɔ jajemɔ lɛ mli ni awaa ni ekagbugbãa, ejaakɛ mɔ ni wo shi lɛ anɔkwafo ni.

english_verse: We should keep on encouraging each other to be thoughtful and to do helpful things.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛhãa wɔyɔseyɔsea wɔhe, koni wɔhiɛ adɔ suɔmɔ kɛ nitsumɔi kpakpai ahe.

english_verse: Some people have given up the habit of meeting for worship, but we must not do that. We should keep on encouraging each other, especially since you know that the day of the Lord's coming is getting closer.
translation_verse: Ni wɔkakwa wɔhe naabuamɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni mɛi komɛi fɔɔ feemɔ lɛ, shi moŋ wɔwowoo wɔhe ŋaa, ni titri lɛ akɛni nyɛmiina akɛ Gbi lɛ miibɛŋkɛ nɛɛ. Wɔkanaanaa Kristo afɔle lɛ nɔ

english_verse: No sacrifices can be made for people who decide to sin after they find out about the truth.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ kwa wɔkwaa wɔfeɔ esha, be ni wɔna wɔle anɔkwale lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, belɛ eshai ahe afɔle ko bɛ dɔŋŋ;

english_verse: They are God's enemies, and all they can look forward to is a terrible judgment and a furious fire.
translation_verse: shi kojomɔ gbɛkwɛmɔ ni yɔɔ gbeyei kɛkɛ, kɛ la grigri ni baashã henyɛlɔi lɛ.

english_verse: If two or more witnesses accused someone of breaking the Law of Moses, that person could be put to death.
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ko kwa Mose Mla lɛ, anaaa lɛ mɔbɔ, shi mɛi enyɔ loo etɛ̃ odaseyeli naa lɛ agbeɔ lɛ.

english_verse: But it is much worse to dishonor God's Son and to disgrace the blood of the promise that made us holy. And it is just as bad to insult the Holy Spirit, who shows us mercy.
translation_verse: Belɛ gbɔmɔ ko ni enaanaa Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ ni ebu kpãŋmɔ lá ni akɛtsuu ehe lɛ akɛ yaka nɔ ko, ni efee dromɔ Mumɔ lɛ niseniianii lɛ, te nyɛsusuɔ akɛ toigbalamɔ ni sa lɛ mli baawa tɛŋŋ?

english_verse: We know that God has said he will punish and take revenge. We also know that the Scriptures say the Lord will judge his people.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔle mɔ ni kɛɛ akɛ, “Minɔ ji oweletɔɔ, ni mawo he nyɔmɔ” lɛ; ni asaŋ, “Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaakojo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living God!
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ dɛŋ gbeemɔ yɛ gbeyei pam. Nyɛdamɔa shi yɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli

english_verse: Don't forget all the hard times you went through when you first received the light.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛkaia be ni eho lɛ, be ni la etso yɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ, bɔ ni nyɛmia nyɛhiɛ yɛ amanehulu ta babaoo mli.

english_verse: Sometimes you were abused and mistreated in public, and at other times you shared in the sufferings of others.
translation_verse: Eko mli lɛ akɛ jɛmɔ kɛ amanehului sɔŋŋ hã nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ kwɛmɔnii, ni eko hu mli lɛ nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni afee amɛ nakai lɛ ananemɛi nɔnalɔi;

english_verse: You were kind to people in jail. And you gladly let your possessions be taken away, because you knew you had something better, something that would last forever.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ nyɛmusuŋ shã nyɛ yɛ mɛi ni awo amɛ gboklɛi lɛ ahewɔ, ni nyɛnii ni aha lɛ hu nyɛkɛ miishɛɛ kpɛlɛ̃, akɛni nyɛle akɛ nyɛyɛ jwetri ni hi fe no aahu ni hiɔ shi daa lɛ.

english_verse: Keep on being brave! It will bring you great rewards.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkashɛa nyɛmli ekãa lɛ nyɛfɔ̃a ejaakɛ eyɛ nyɔmɔwoo kpeteŋkple.

english_verse: Learn to be patient, so you will please God and be given what he has promised.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ tsuishitoo he ehĩa nyɛ, koni, be ni nyɛfee Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ, nyɛnine ashɛ shiwoo lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “God is coming soon! It won't be very long.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ, “Be fioo kɛkɛ eshwɛ ni mɔ ni baa lɛ aaaba, ni etsɛŋ kwraa.

english_verse: The people God accepts will live because of their faith. But he isn't pleased with anyone who turns back.”
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni ja yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ, yi aaana wala; ni kɛ ekpa yɛ misɛɛ lɛ misusuma naŋ ehe tsuijurɔ.”

english_verse: We are not like those people who turn back and get destroyed. We will keep on having faith until we are saved.
translation_verse: Shi wɔ lɛ, jeee mɛi ni kpaleɔ kɛyaa hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ji wɔ, shi moŋ wɔji mɛi ni kɛ hemɔkɛyeli naa amɛsusuma yiwalaheremɔ lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi.

english_verse: Faith makes us sure of what we hope for and gives us proof of what we cannot see.
translation_verse: Shi hemɔkɛyeli ji nii ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ lɛ anɔ hewalɛnamɔ kɛ nii ni anãaa lɛ anɔmimaa.

english_verse: It was their faith that made our ancestors pleasing to God.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ no mli aye blemabii lɛ ahe odase kpakpa yɛ.

english_verse: Because of our faith, we know that the world was made at God's command. We also know that what can be seen was made out of what cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Hemɔkɛyeli wɔkɛyoɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wiemɔ bɔ je lɛ, hewɔ lɛ nibii ni anaa lɛ jɛ nibii ni anãaa lɛ mli.

english_verse: Because Abel had faith, he offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. God was pleased with him and his gift, and even though Abel is now dead, his faith still speaks for him.
translation_verse: Hemɔkɛyeli Habel kɛshã afɔle ni fe Kain nɔ lɛ ehã Nyɔŋmɔ, no hewɔ hu ni aye ehe odase akɛ jalɔ ji lɛ lɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he enikeenii lɛ; ni no nɔŋŋ nɔ etsɔ̃ɔ ewieɔ lolo, tsɛ egbo.

english_verse: Enoch had faith and did not die. He pleased God, and God took him up to heaven. This is why his body was never found.
translation_verse: Hemɔkɛyeli hewɔ aŋɔ Henok kɛtee , koni ekana gbele, ni anãaa lɛ dɔŋŋ akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee lɛ; ejaakɛ dani aaaŋɔ lɛ kɛya lɛ aye ehe odase akɛ esa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.

english_verse: But without faith no one can please God. We must believe that God is real and rewards everyone who searches for him.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji hemɔkɛyeli bɛ lɛ anyɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ asa; ejaakɛ mɔ ni baa Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ, ja ehe eye akɛ eyɛ, ni eji mɛi ni taoɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ anyɔmɔwolɔ hu.

english_verse: Because Noah had faith, he was warned about something that had not yet happened. He obeyed and built a boat that saved him and his family. In this way the people of the world were judged, and Noah was given the blessings that come to everyone who pleases God.
translation_verse: Hemɔkɛyeli Noa hu kɛbo Nyɔŋmɔ toi be ni ehã ele nii ni anako lɛ he nɔ ko lɛ, ni ekɛkpɛ adeka ehã ewe lɛ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ; no nɔ hu etsɔ̃ ebu je lɛ fɔ, ni enine shɛ jalɛ ni jɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Abraham had faith and obeyed God. He was told to go to the land that God had said would be his, and he left for a country he had never seen.
translation_verse: Hemɔkɛyeli Abraham kɛbo toi be ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ lɛ lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee he ni baatsɔ̃ enɔ lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee, tsɛ eleee he ni eyaa.

english_verse: Because Abraham had faith, he lived as a stranger in the promised land. He lived there in a tent, and so did Isaac and Jacob, who were later given the same promise.
translation_verse: Hemɔkɛyeli ekɛyahi shiwoo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ gbɔ, ni ekɛ Isak kɛ Yakob ni ekɛ amɛ ji nakai shiwoo lɛ nɔŋŋ yelɔi lɛ hi bui amli;

english_verse: Abraham did this, because he was waiting for the eternal city God had planned and built.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ eekwɛ maŋ ni yɔɔ shishitoo ni wa ni etolɔ kɛ emalɔ ji Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛ.

english_verse: Even when Sarah was too old to have children, she had faith that God would do what he had promised, and she had a son.
translation_verse: Hemɔkɛyeli Sara hu kɛna hewalɛ ni ekɛna musu, ni lɛ ni egbɔ eho he aahu lɛ efɔ, ejaakɛ mɔ ni wo shi lɛ ebu lɛ anɔkwafo.

english_verse: Her husband Abraham was almost dead, but he became the ancestor of many people. In fact, there are as many of them as there are stars in the sky or grains of sand along the seashore.
translation_verse: No hewɔ hu ni ajɛ mɔ kome ni tamɔ mɔ ni egbo momo lɛ mli afɔ mɛi ni fa babaoo tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋulamii loo ŋshɔ naa shia ni anyɛɛɛ akane lɛ.

english_verse: Every one of those people died. But they still had faith, even though they had not received what they had been promised. They were glad just to see these things from far away, and they agreed that they were only strangers and foreigners on this earth.
translation_verse: Hemɔkɛyeli mli mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ gboi yɛ. Shɔŋŋ kɛkɛ amɛna nii ni awo he shi lɛ yɛ ni amɛnya he, tsɛ amɛnine shɛko nɔ, ni amɛjaje akɛ gbɔi kɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji ji amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: When people talk this way, it is clear they are looking for a place to call their own.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɛi ni wieɔ nakai nibii lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ akɛ amɛmiishwe amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmaŋ.

english_verse: If they had been talking about the land where they had once lived, they could have gone back at any time.
translation_verse: Ni eji amɛhiɛ yɛ he ni amɛjɛ kɛba lɛ nɔ kulɛ, amɛyɛ hegbɛ ni amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaatee jɛi ekoŋŋ.

english_verse: But they were looking forward to a better home in heaven. This is why God wasn't ashamed for them to call him their God. He even built a city for them.
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ amɛmiitao maŋ ni hi fe no, ni ji ŋwɛi nɔ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, efeee Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛgbele akɛ aaatsɛ lɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ, ejaakɛ esaa maŋ eto amɛ.

english_verse: because he was sure that God could raise people to life. This was just like getting Isaac back from death.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ ebu akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛaatee lɛ shi kɛaajɛ gbohii ateŋ tete, ni lɛɛlɛŋ, kɛ aaawie lɛ abɛbuaŋ lɛ, enine shɛ enɔ ekoŋŋ kɛjɛ jɛi.

english_verse: Isaac had faith, and he promised blessings to Jacob and Esau.
translation_verse: Hemɔkɛyeli Isak kɛjɔɔ Yakob kɛ Esau yɛ nii ni baaba lɛ ahewɔ.

english_verse: Later, when Jacob was about to die, he leaned on his walking stick and worshiped. Then because of his faith he blessed each of Joseph's sons.
translation_verse: Hemɔkɛyeli Yakob kɛjɔɔ Yosef bii lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ be ni egboɔ ni ehiɛ edɛ̃hiɛmɔtso lɛ mli kɛma eyi shi esɔle lɛ.

english_verse: And right before Joseph died, he had faith that God would lead the people of Israel out of Egypt. So he told them to take his bones with them.
translation_verse: Hemɔkɛyeli Yosef hu kɛtsĩ Israelbii lɛ Ijipt jee lɛ tã be ni ejeɔ jeŋ ni ewo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewui lɛ ahe kitã lɛ.

english_verse: Because Moses' parents had faith, they kept him hidden until he was three months old. They saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid to disobey the king's orders.
translation_verse: Hemɔkɛyeli Mose fɔlɔi lɛ kɛŋɔ lɛ tee nyɔji etɛ̃ be ni afɔ lɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛna akɛ gbekɛ lɛ he yɛ fɛo, ni amɛsheee maŋtsɛ lɛ akpɔ lɛ gbeyei.

english_verse: Then after Moses grew up, his faith made him refuse to be called the king's grandson.
translation_verse: Hemɔkɛyeli hewɔ be ni Mose da lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ atsɛɔ lɛ Farao biyoo lɛ bi,

english_verse: He chose to be mistreated with God's people instead of having the good time that sin could bring for a little while.
translation_verse: eeesumɔ moŋ akɛ ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ lɛ ana amanehulu fe nɔ ni eeeye esha mli ŋɔɔmɔ be fioo ko lɛ;

english_verse: Moses knew that the treasures of Egypt were not as wonderful as what he would receive from suffering for the Messiah, and he looked forward to his reward.
translation_verse: ebuɔ Kristo hewɔ ahorabɔɔ lɛ akɛ nii babaoo fe Ijipt jwetri lɛ, ejaakɛ wɔsɛɛ nyɔmɔwoo gbɛ ekwɛɔ.

english_verse: Because of his faith, Moses left Egypt. Moses had seen the invisible God and wasn't afraid of the king's anger.
translation_verse: Hemɔkɛyeli ekɛje Ijipt ni esheee maŋtsɛ lɛ mlifu lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ emɔ mɔ ni anaaa lɛ lɛ mli tamɔ nɔ ni eena lɛ.

english_verse: His faith also made him celebrate Passover. He sprinkled the blood of animals on the doorposts, so that the first-born sons of the people of Israel would not be killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Hemɔkɛyeli ekɛto Hehoo lɛ kɛ ladikimɔ lɛ, koni mɔ ni kpãtãa kromɔbii lɛ ahiɛ akata Israelbii lɛ ahe.

english_verse: Because of their faith, the people walked through the Red Sea on dry land. But when the Egyptians tried to do it, they were drowned.
translation_verse: Hemɔkɛyeli amɛkɛfo Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ tamɔ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ, nɔ ni Ijiptbii lɛ hu ka feemɔ, ni emii amɛ lɛ.

english_verse: God's people had faith, and when they had walked around the city of Jericho for seven days, its walls fell down.
translation_verse: Hemɔkɛyeli naa Yeriko gbogboi lɛ kumɔ shwie shi be ni Israelbii bɔle lɛ gbii kpawo lɛ.

english_verse: Rahab had been a prostitute, but she had faith and welcomed the spies. So she wasn't killed with the people who disobeyed.
translation_verse: Hemɔkɛyeli hewɔ Rahab, ajwamãŋ lɛ, pleneee efataaa mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ ahe lɛ, ejaakɛ ehere saralɔi lɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ.

english_verse: What else can I say? There isn't enough time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets.
translation_verse: Ni mɛni makɛɛ dɔŋŋ? Ejaakɛ minaŋ mihe dekã bɔ ni mikɛaagba Gideon kɛ Barak, Samson kɛ Yefta, David kɛ Samuel kɛ gbalɔi lɛ ahe sane:

english_verse: Their faith helped them conquer kingdoms, and because they did right, God made promises to them. They closed the jaws of lions
translation_verse: mɛi ni tsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ amɛye maŋtsɛyelii anɔ kunim, amɛtsu jalɛnii, amɛnine shɛ shiwoi anɔ, amɛtsimɔ jatai anaa,

english_verse: and put out raging fires and escaped from the swords of their enemies. Although they were weak, they were given the strength and power to chase foreign armies away.
translation_verse: amɛgbe la hewalɛ, amɛje klantei anaa, amɛna hewalɛ kɛjɛ gbedemɔ mli, amɛhe wa yɛ ta mli, amɛwo mɛi kpɔ̃ji ata lɛ foi.

english_verse: Some women received their loved ones back from death. Many of these people were tortured, but they refused to be released. They were sure they would get a better reward when the dead are raised to life.
translation_verse: Yei anine shɛ amɛmɛi ni egboi lɛ anɔ ekoŋŋ kɛtsɔ̃ shitee nɔ. Shi mɛi krokomɛi hu, akɛ piŋmɔ gbe amɛ, ni amɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ kpɔ̃mɔ, koni amɛnine ashɛ shitee ni hi fe no lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Others were made fun of and beaten with whips, and some were chained in jail.
translation_verse: Mɛi komɛi hu aye amɛhe fɛo ni ayi amɛ kpelebii ni awo amɛ gboklɛi ni awo amɛ tsuŋ;

english_verse: Still others were stoned to death or sawed in two or killed with swords. Some had nothing but sheep skins or goat skins to wear. They were poor, mistreated, and tortured.
translation_verse: atswia amɛ tɛi, akɛ akpalala gbala amɛmli, aka amɛ, akɛ klante gbe amɛ; ahã amɛwo too gwantɛŋi kɛ too abotiai awoji kɛnyiɛ, ohĩa hia amɛ, awa amɛ yi, afee amɛ niseniianii;

english_verse: The world did not deserve these good people, who had to wander in deserts and on mountains and had to live in caves and holes in the ground.
translation_verse: mɛi ni je nɛɛŋ esaaa amɛ lɛ, amɛtsomlo yɛ shiaŋai kɛ gɔji anɔ, kɛ tɛkploi kɛ shikpɔŋ fɔ̃ji amli.

english_verse: All of them pleased God because of their faith! But still they died without being given what had been promised.
translation_verse: Ni mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ, aye amɛhe odase kpakpa yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ hewɔ moŋ, shi amɛnine shɛɛɛ shiwoonii lɛ anɔ,

english_verse: This was because God had something better in store for us. And he did not want them to reach the goal of their faith without us.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ esaa nɔ ko kpakpa eto wɔ, koni amɛkaye emuu amɛshi wɔ.

english_verse: Such a large crowd of witnesses is all around us! So we must get rid of everything that slows us down, especially the sin that just won't let go. And we must be determined to run the race that is ahead of us.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ wɔ hu, akɛni wɔyɔɔ odasefoi babaoo ni ebɔle wɔ tamɔ atatu nɛɛ, nyɛhãa wɔshɛa jatsu fɛɛ jatsu kɛ esha ni ebɔle wɔ kpula lɛ wɔfɔ̃a. Ni wɔkɛ hiɛmiamɔ ada foi ni kã wɔhiɛ lɛ.

english_verse: We must keep our eyes on Jesus, who leads us and makes our faith complete. He endured the shame of being nailed to a cross, because he knew later on he would be glad he did. Now he is seated at the right side of God's throne!
translation_verse: Ni wɔkwɛ hemɔkɛyeli shishijelɔ kɛ naagbelɔ ni ji Yesu lɛ, mɔ ni nyamɔ ni kã ehiɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ emia ehiɛ yɛ sɛŋmɔtso lɛ he amanehulu lɛ mli. Ni ebuuu hiɛgbele lɛ, ni eyata shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: So keep your mind on Jesus, who put up with many insults from sinners. Then you won't get discouraged and give up.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛjwɛŋa mɔ ni ŋmɛ etsui shi ehã nibii ni eshafeelɔi kɛɛ kɛshi lɛ lɛ he, koni ekaje nyɛtsine ni nyɛsusumai miitɔ biti. WɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔsemɔ lɛ

english_verse: None of you have yet been hurt in your battle against sin.
translation_verse: Nyɛnako nyɛgbee hiɛ kɛyashi lájee mli yɛ nyɛ kɛ esha tawuu lɛ mli;

english_verse: But you have forgotten that the Scriptures say to God's children, “When the Lord punishes you, don't make light of it, and when he corrects you, don't be discouraged.
translation_verse: ni nyɛhiɛ ekpa hewalɛwoo wiemɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ nyɛ wieɔ bɔ ni akɛ bii wieɔ lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Mibi, kaabu Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tsɔsemɔ lɛ akɛ nɔ ko bibioo, ni asaŋ, kɛ ekã ohiɛ lɛ, kaahã onijiaŋ miije wui;

english_verse: The Lord corrects the people he loves and disciplines those he calls his own.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ sumɔɔ lɛ, lɛ etsɔseɔ, ni eyiɔ bi fɛɛ bi ni ekɛfeɔ enɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: Be patient when you are being corrected! This is how God treats his children. Don't all parents correct their children?
translation_verse: Nyɛmiaa nyɛhiɛ yɛ nɔnaa lɛ mli akɛ tsɔsemɔ; Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyɛ akɛ ebii; ejaakɛ mɛɛ bi yɔɔ ni etsɛ tsɔseee lɛ?

english_verse: God corrects all his children, and if he doesn't correct you, then you don't really belong to him.
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛnaaa tsɔsemɔ ni mɛi fɛɛ naa lɛ eko lɛ, no lɛ ajwamãŋbii ji nyɛ, shi jeee kpeemɔ yoo bii.

english_verse: Our earthly fathers correct us, and we still respect them. Isn't it even better to be given true life by letting our spiritual Father correct us?
translation_verse: Asaŋ wɔyɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ tsɛmɛi ni tsɔseɔ wɔ, ni wɔbuɔ amɛ. Ani esaaa akɛ wɔba wɔhe shi fe nakai wɔhã mumɔi aTsɛ lɛ koni wɔyi ana wala?

english_verse: Our human fathers correct us for a short time, and they do it as they think best. But God corrects us for our own good, because he wants us to be holy, as he is.
translation_verse: Amɛ lɛ, gbii fioo ko kɛkɛ amɛtsɔseɔ wɔ bɔ ni sa amɛhiɛ; shi lɛ lɛ, etsɔseɔ wɔ koni ahi ahã wɔ ni wɔna ekrɔŋkrɔŋfeemɔ lɛ eko.

english_verse: It is never fun to be corrected. In fact, at the time it is always painful. But if we learn to obey by being corrected, we will do right and live at peace.
translation_verse: Shi tsɔsemɔ fɛɛ tsɔsemɔ lɛ, amrɔmrɔ nɛɛ efeee mɔ akɛ miishɛɛ nɔ ni, shi dɔlɛ nɔ moŋ; shi kɛ fee sɛɛ lɛ ewoɔ hejɔlɛ yibii ni ji jalɛ lɛ ehãa mɛi ni tsɔsemɔ lɛ esaa amɛ lɛ. Nitsɔɔmɔi kɛ kɔkɔbɔi

english_verse: Now stand up straight! Stop your knees from shaking
translation_verse: Hewɔ lɛ nyɛwajea niji ni egbede kɛ nakutsei ni egbɔjɔ lɛ.

english_verse: and walk a straight path. Then lame people will be healed, instead of getting worse. Warning against Turning from God
translation_verse: Ni nyɛfea gbɛi ni yɔɔ trɔmɔɔ nyɛhãa nyɛnaji, koni otsɔɔlɔ nane akahwaŋ, shi moŋ atsa lɛ.

english_verse: Try to live at peace with everyone! Live a clean life. If you don't, you will never see the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛtiua nyɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ateŋ hejɔlɛ sɛɛ kɛ hetsemɔ ni kɛ mɔ ko shi ni enaŋ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Make sure no one misses out on God's wonderful kindness. Don't let anyone become bitter and cause trouble for the rest of you.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛkwɛa ni ahia, koni mɔ ko akaŋmɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ he; koni shishifã kɛ joomɔ ko akakwɛ̃ ni ehao nyɛ ni akɛbule mɛi pii.

english_verse: Watch out for immoral and ungodly people like Esau, who sold his future blessing for only one meal.
translation_verse: Koni mɔ ko akafee ehe ajwamãŋbɔlɔ loo mɔ ni ebuuu Nyɔŋmɔ nii, tamɔ Esau ni hɔ̃ɔ ekromɔbi gbɛnaa lɛ ehe ŋmaa shikomeyeli lɛ.

english_verse: You know how he later wanted it back. But there was nothing he could do to change things, even though he begged his father and cried.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɛle akɛ, be ni fee sɛɛ ni etao akɛ ena jɔɔmɔ lɛ, akwa lɛ; ni enaaa, tsɛbelɛ ekɛ yaafonui tao tsuitsakemɔ hegbɛ.

english_verse: You have not come to a place like Mount Sinai that can be seen and touched. There is no flaming fire or dark cloud or storm
translation_verse: Jeee Sinai Gɔŋ ni tsoɔ kɛ la ni anaa kɛ hiŋmɛi kɛ atatu kpii kɛ duŋ kabitii kɛ ahum,

english_verse: or trumpet sound. The people of Israel heard a voice speak. But they begged it to stop,
translation_verse: kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɛmɔ kɛ wiemɔi agbɛɛmɔ ni mɛi ni nu lɛ kpa fai akɛ akawie eko afata he dɔŋŋ lɛ he nyɛba;

english_verse: because they could not obey its commands. They were even told to kill any animal that touched the mountain.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ kitã ni awo akɛ, “Kɛji kooloo ko tete ta gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ, atswia lɛ tɛ” lɛ, amɛnyɛɛ mli amɛhi.

english_verse: The sight was so frightening that Moses said he shook with fear.
translation_verse: Ni nɔ ni pue lɛ he yɛ gbeyei babaoo aahu bɔ ni Mose kɛɛ, “Miishe gbeyei, ni mihe miikpokpo.”

english_verse: You have now come to Mount Zion and to the heavenly Jerusalem. This is the city of the living God, where thousands and thousands of angels have come to celebrate.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ maŋ; ŋwɛi Yerusalɛm lɛ, kɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi akpeiakpei abɔ ahenaabuamɔ lɛ,

english_verse: Here you will find all of God's dearest children, whose names are written in heaven. And you will find God himself, who judges everyone. Here also are the spirits of those good people who have been made perfect.
translation_verse: kɛ kromɔbii ni aŋma amɛgbɛii yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ asafo lɛ he nyɛba. Kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji mɛi fɛɛ akojolɔ lɛ, kɛ jalɔi ni ehi kɛwula shi lɛ amumɔi lɛ,

english_verse: And Jesus is here! He is the one who makes God's new agreement with us, and his sprinkled blood says much better things than the blood of Abel.
translation_verse: kɛ kpãŋmɔ hee mlidaamɔlɔ Yesu lɛ, kɛ lá ni atsɔ ashwã ni wieɔ wiemɔ kpakpa fe Habel nɔ lɛ, aŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Make sure you obey the one who speaks to you. The people did not escape, when they refused to obey the one who spoke to them at Mount Sinai. Do you think you can possibly escape, if you refuse to obey the one who speaks to you from heaven?
translation_verse: Nyɛkwɛa ni ahĩa, koni nyɛkakwa mɔ ni wieɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ kɛ mɛi ni kwa mɔ ni wie tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ahe ejeee mli lɛ, belɛ wɔ lɛ, wɔhe ejeŋ mli kwraa kɛji wɔkpale kɛjɛ mɔ ni jɛɔ ŋwɛi wieɔ lɛ he.

english_verse: When God spoke the first time, his voice shook only the earth. This time he has promised to shake the earth once again, and heaven too.
translation_verse: Lɛ egbee hoso shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ no be lɛ mli, shi agbɛnɛ ewo shi ekɛɛ, “Mahoso shikpɔŋ lɛ shi kome ekoŋŋ, ni jeee shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛkɛ, shi ŋwɛi hu.”

english_verse: The words “once again” mean that these created things will someday be shaken and removed. Then what cannot be shaken will last.
translation_verse: “Shi kome ekoŋŋ” ni ekɛɛ lɛ, ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ akɛ nii ni ahosoɔ lɛ aaaho aya, ejaakɛ nii ni afee ni, koni nii ni hosoŋ lɛ ahi shi.

english_verse: We should be grateful we were given a kingdom that cannot be shaken. And in this kingdom we please God by worshiping him and by showing him great honor and respect.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni wɔna maŋtsɛyeli ni anyɛŋ ahoso lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔdaa shi ni wɔkɛsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ ni sa ehiɛ kɛ woo kɛ gbeyeishemɔ!

english_verse: Our God is like a destructive fire!
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, la ni fiteɔ nii hu ji lɛ.

english_verse: Keep being concerned about each other as the Lord's followers should.
translation_verse: Nyɛhãa nyɛmimɛi asuɔmɔ ahĩa shi daa.

english_verse: Be sure to welcome strangers into your home. By doing this, some people have welcomed angels as guests, without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Gbɔfeemɔ hu, nyɛhiɛ akakpaa nɔ; ejaakɛ no nɔ mɛi komɛi tsɔ̃ fee ŋwɛi bɔfoi agbɔ ni amɛleee.

english_verse: Remember the Lord's people who are in jail and be concerned for them. Don't forget those who are suffering, but imagine you are there with them.
translation_verse: Nyɛkaia mɛi ni awo amɛ gboklɛi lɛ tamɔ akɛ nyɛkɛ amɛ kãmɔ mli, kɛ mɛi ni afeɔ amɛ efɔŋ lɛ hu, akɛni nyɛ hu nyɛyɛ heloo mli lolo lɛ.

english_verse: Have respect for marriage. Always be faithful to your partner, because God will punish anyone who is immoral or unfaithful in marriage.
translation_verse: Awo gbãlã hiɛ nyam yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛteŋ, ni akabule gbãlã saa hu; shi ajwamãŋbɔlɔi kɛ gbãlãŋkulɔi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ baakojo amɛ.

english_verse: Don't fall in love with money. Be satisfied with what you have. The Lord has promised that he will not leave us or desert us.
translation_verse: Shikasuɔmɔ akaba nyɛjeŋba mli; ni nyɛmii ashɛ nii ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ he; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ ekɛɛ, “Mishiŋ bo ni misaa mikwaŋ bo gbi ko gbi ko.”

english_verse: This should make you feel like saying, “The Lord helps me! Why should I be afraid of what people can do to me?”
translation_verse: Bɔ ni afee ni wɔna ekãa ni wɔkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ji miyelikɛbualɔ, ni misheŋ gbeyei. Mɛni gbɔmɔ aaafee mi?” Nyɛbua nyɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔi, titri lɛ Kristo

english_verse: Don't forget about your leaders who taught you God's message. Remember what kind of lives they lived and try to have faith like theirs.
translation_verse: Nyɛkaia nyɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔi, mɛi ni wie Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ; nyɛkwɛa amɛshihilɛ lɛ naagbee, ni nyɛkasea amɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ.

english_verse: Jesus Christ never changes! He is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo lɛ, bɔ ni eyɔɔ nyɛ kɛ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ eyɔɔ kɛyaa naanɔ.

english_verse: Don't be fooled by any kind of strange teachings. It is better to receive strength from God's gift of undeserved grace than to depend on certain foods. After all, these foods don't really help the people who eat them.
translation_verse: Nyɛkahãa tsɔ̃ɔmɔi srɔtoi kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi krokomɛi kɛ nyɛ miililaa shi; ejaakɛ ehi akɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ awo tsui hewalɛ, shi jeee niyenii ni hãaa mɛi ni tsuɔ he nii lɛ ana sɛɛ ko yɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: But we have an altar where even the priests who serve in the place of worship have no right to eat.
translation_verse: Wɔyɛ afɔleshãa latɛ ko ni mɛi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ buu lɛ mli lɛ bɛ hegbɛ akɛ amɛyeɔ enɔ nii.

english_verse: After the high priest offers the blood of animals as a sin offering, the bodies of those animals are burned outside the camp.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kooloi ni osɔfonukpa lɛ ŋɔɔ amɛlá kɛyaa He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ esha hewɔ lɛ agbohii lɛ ayashãa yɛ nsra lɛ sɛɛ.

english_verse: Jesus himself suffered outside the city gate, so his blood would make people holy.
