translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu hu, bɔ ni afee ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ elá lɛ atsuu maŋ lɛ he lɛ, agbo lɛ sɛɛ ena amanehulu lɛ yɛ.

english_verse: This is why we should go outside the camp to Jesus and share in his disgrace.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, nyɛhãa wɔjea kpo kɛyaa eŋɔɔ yɛ nsra lɛ sɛɛ ni wɔtere ehorabɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: On this earth we don't have a city that lasts forever, but we are waiting for such a city.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔbɛ maŋ ni hiɔ shi yɛ biɛ, shi maŋ ni baaba lɛ moŋ sɛɛgbɛ wɔtaoɔ.

english_verse: Our sacrifice is to keep offering praise to God in the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Belɛ nyɛhãa wɔtsɔ̃a enɔ ni wɔkɛ yijiemɔ afɔle abahãa Nyɔŋmɔ daa; no ji, naabui ni jajeɔ egbɛi lɛ yibii lɛ.

english_verse: But don't forget to help others and to share your possessions with them. This too is like offering a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Shi ejurɔfeemɔ kɛ nikee lɛ, nyɛhiɛ akakpaa nɔ; ejaakɛ nakai afɔlei saa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ jogbaŋŋ.

english_verse: Obey your leaders and do what they say. They are watching over you, and they must answer to God. So don't make them sad as they do their work. Make them happy. Otherwise, they won't be able to help you at all.
translation_verse: Nyɛboa nyɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ atoi, ni nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa amɛ; ejaakɛ amɛ amɛbuɔ nyɛsusumai lɛ ahe akɛ mɛi ni baabu he akɔntaa, koni amɛkɛ miishɛɛ afee nii nɛɛ, shi jeee kɛ ŋtsɔidɔɔmɔ; ejaakɛ no ehiii hãaa nyɛ.

english_verse: Pray for us. Our consciences are clear, and we always try to live right.
translation_verse: Nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa wɔ; ejaakɛ wɔyɛ nɔmimaa akɛ wɔyɛ henilee kpakpa, ni wɔmiitao akɛ wɔba wɔjeŋ fɛɛfɛo yɛ nii fɛɛ mli.

english_verse: I especially want you to pray that I can visit you again soon. Final Prayers and Greetings
translation_verse: Ni miikpa nyɛ fai babaoo akɛ nyɛfee nakai, koni akpale mi ahã nyɛ oya. Jɔɔmɔ kɛ Ŋamɔi

english_verse: God gives peace, and he raised our Lord Jesus Christ from death. Now Jesus is like a Great Shepherd whose blood was used to make God's eternal agreement with his flock.
translation_verse: Shi hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie toi lɛ akwɛlɔ kpeteŋkple ni ji wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ yɛ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ lɛ lá lɛ mli lɛ,

english_verse: I pray God will make you ready to obey him and that you will always be eager to do right. May Jesus help you do what pleases God. To Jesus Christ be glory forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: lɛ esaa nyɛ ehã nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa, ni nyɛfee esuɔmɔnaanii, ni etsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ efee nɔ ni sa ehiɛ yɛ nyɛmli. Lɛ aŋɔ anunyam ahã kɛyashi naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ. Amen!

english_verse: My friends, I have written only a short letter to encourage you, and I beg you to pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Shi, anyɛmimɛi, miikpa nyɛ fai ni nyɛmɔ wiemɔ kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ mli, ejaakɛ wiemɔ kukuoo miŋma mimaje nyɛ nɛɛ.

english_verse: By now you surely must know that our friend Timothy is out of jail. If he gets here in time, I will bring him with me when I come to visit you.
translation_verse: Nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ aŋmɛɛ wɔnyɛmi Timoteo he, ni kɛ eba mra lɛ mikɛ lɛ aaaba mabana nyɛ.

english_verse: Please give my greetings to your leaders and to the rest of the Lord's people. His followers from Italy send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Wɔmiibi nyɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm. Mɛi ni jɛ Italia lɛ miibi nyɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi! Amen.

english_verse: From James, a servant of God and of our Lord Jesus Christ. Greetings to the twelve tribes scattered all over the world. Faith and Wisdom
translation_verse: Yakobo, ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo tsulɔ lɛ ŋma yahã akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni egbɛ eshwã lɛ. Miiŋa nyɛ! Hemɔkɛyeli kɛ nilee

english_verse: My friends, be glad, even if you have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Minyɛmimɛi, kɛji aka nyɛ yɛ nibii srɔtoi pii amli lɛ, nyɛbua lɛ miishɛɛ sɔŋŋ

english_verse: You know you learn to endure by having your faith tested.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ nyɛle akɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli kaa lɛ kɛ hiɛmiamɔ baa.

english_verse: But you must learn to endure everything, so you will be completely mature and not lacking in anything.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛhãa hiɛmiamɔ lɛ agbea enitsumɔ naa kɛwulaa shi, koni nyɛhi kɛwula shi ni nyɛye emuu ni nɔ ko akashwɛ nyɛ.

english_verse: If any of you need wisdom, you should ask God, and it will be given to you. God is generous and won't correct you for asking.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ nilee he ehia nyɛteŋ mɔ ko lɛ, ekpa Nyɔŋmɔ ni hãa mɛi fɛɛ faa ni ewieee mɔ ko hiɛ lɛ fai, ni aaahã lɛ.

english_verse: But when you ask for something, you must have faith and not doubt. Anyone who doubts is like an ocean wave tossed around in a storm.
translation_verse: Shi ekpa fai yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli, ni ekaje nɔ ko nɔ ko he ŋwane; ejaakɛ ŋwanejelɔ lɛ etamɔ ŋshɔke ni kɔɔyɔɔ tswaa kɛyaa kɛbaa.

english_verse: Any of God's people who are poor should be glad he thinks so highly of them.
translation_verse: Nyɛmi ni ji humi lɛ ashwã yɛ enɔwomɔ lɛ mli,

english_verse: But any who are rich should be glad when God makes them humble. Rich people will disappear like wild flowers
translation_verse: shi niiatsɛ lɛ eshwã yɛ eshibaa lɛ mli; ejaakɛ ebaaho eya tamɔ jwɛiaŋ fɔfɔi.

english_verse: scorched by the burning heat of the sun. The flowers lose their blossoms, and their beauty is destroyed. This is how the rich will disappear, as they go about their business. Trials and Temptations
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ hulu teɔ shi kɛ jeŋ dɔlɛ, ni eŋãlaa jwɛi lɛ, ni efɔfɔi lɛ kpalaa shwieɔ shi, ni efɛo lɛ fiteɔ; nakai nɔŋŋ niiatsɛ lɛ hu hiɛ baakpãtã yɛ egbɛi lɛ anɔ. Kaa

english_verse: God will bless you, if you don't give up when your faith is being tested. He will reward you with a glorious life, just as he rewards everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni miaa ehiɛ yɛ kaa mli lɛ, ejaakɛ kɛ aka lɛ ni esa lɛ, eeena wala akekre ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ewo mɛi ni sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ shi yɛ he lɛ.

english_verse: Don't blame God when you are tempted! God cannot be tempted by evil, and he doesn't use evil to tempt others.
translation_verse: Kɛji aaka mɔ ko lɛ, ekakɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ miika mi,” ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ akaaa lɛ ni efeee efɔŋ hu, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu ekaaa mɔ ko.

english_verse: We are tempted by our own desires that drag us off and trap us.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekɔnɔ ni gbalaa lɛ ni lakaa lɛ lɛ kaa lɛ.

english_verse: Our desires make us sin, and when sin is finished with us, it leaves us dead.
translation_verse: No sɛɛ lɛ, akɔnɔ lɛ, kɛ eŋɔ hɔ lɛ, efɔɔ esha, ni esha lɛ hu, kɛ eda egbe naa lɛ, efɔɔ gbele.

english_verse: Don't be fooled, my dear friends.
translation_verse: Nyɛkahãa alakaa nyɛ, minyɛmimɛi ni misumɔɔ.

english_verse: Every good and perfect gift comes down from the Father who created all the lights in the heavens. He is always the same and never makes dark shadows by changing.
translation_verse: Dromɔnii kpakpai fɛɛ kɛ nikeenii ni hi kɛwula shi fɛɛ lɛ; ŋwɛi ejɛɔ ekpelekeɔ shi, kɛjɛɔ ŋwɛi lai aTsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, mɔ mli ni tsakemɔ loo duŋ ni tsakemɔ kɛbaa bɛ lɛ.

english_verse: He wanted us to be his own special people, and so he sent the true message to give us new birth. Hearing and Obeying
translation_verse: Lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esuɔmɔ naa ekɛ anɔkwale wiemɔ lɛ fɔ wɔ, koni wɔfee tamɔ enibɔɔnii lɛ amli klɛŋklɛŋ yibii. Wiemɔ lɛ numɔ kɛ efeemɔ

english_verse: My dear friends, you should be quick to listen and slow to speak or to get angry.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, minyɛmimɛi ni misumɔɔ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ he afee oya kɛ ninumɔ; ehumi shi kɛ wiemɔ; ehumi shi kɛ mlifu.

english_verse: You must stop doing anything immoral or evil. Instead be humble and accept the message planted in you to save you.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛshɛrɛa nyaŋemɔ nitsumɔ kɛ efɔŋ ni afeɔ kɛtekeɔ nɔ fɛɛ nyɛshwiea, ni nyɛkɛ heshibaa aherea wiemɔ lɛ ni atɛo yɛ nyɛmli ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ni ekɛaahere nyɛsusumai ayiwala lɛ.

english_verse: Obey God's message! Don't fool yourselves by just listening to it.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛtsɔ̃mɔa wiemɔ lɛ nɔyelɔi, shi jeee wiemɔ lɛ nulɔi kɛkɛ, ni nyɛkɛmiishishiu nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe.

english_verse: If you hear the message and don't obey it, you are like people who stare at themselves in a mirror
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛji mɔ ko ji wiemɔ lɛ nulɔ kɛkɛ shi ejeee enɔyelɔ hu lɛ, nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ tamɔ mɔ ko ni kwɛɔ ehiɛ su lɛ yɛ ashwishwɛ mli;

english_verse: and forget what they look like as soon as they leave.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ ekwɛɔ ehe, ni eyaa; shi amrɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ, ehiɛ kpaa bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: But you must never stop looking at the perfect law that sets you free. God will bless you in everything you do, if you listen and obey, and don't just hear and forget.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni kwɛɔ heyeli mla ni hi kɛwula shi lɛ fitsofitso ni ekãa he efeɔ ni ejeee mɔ ni nuɔ ni ehiɛ kpaa nɔ, shi moŋ etsuɔ he nii lɛ, nakai mɔ lɛ aaajɔɔ lɛ yɛ efeemɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: If you think you are being religious, but can't control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is useless.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ efeɔ mɔ ko akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jalɔ ji lɛ, ni ewooo elilɛi manyoflɛ, shi moŋ eshishiuɔ ehe lɛ, nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ jamɔ lɛ, yaka ni.

english_verse: Religion that pleases God the Father must be pure and spotless. You must help needy orphans and widows and not let this world make you evil.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ ni he tse ni ehe bɛ muji ko yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, Tsɛ lɛ, hiɛ ji enɛ, akɛ mɔ asra awusai kɛ okulafoi yɛ amɛmanehulu lɛ mli, ni ekwɛ ehe nɔ jogbaŋŋ yɛ je nɛɛ mli koni ekawo ehe muji.

english_verse: My friends, if you have faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, you won't treat some people better than others.
translation_verse: Minyɛmimɛi, nyɛkɛ mɛi ahiɛiaŋkwɛmɔ akahiɛa wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo ni ji anunyam Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ.

english_verse: Suppose a rich person wearing fancy clothes and a gold ring comes to one of your meetings. And suppose a poor person dressed in worn-out clothes also comes.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛji nuu ko ni wo shika ga kɛ atade fɛɛfɛo babote nyɛkpeehe lɛ, ni ohiafo ko hu ni wo atade taŋtaŋ babote mli,

english_verse: You must not give the best seat to the one in fancy clothes and tell the one who is poor to stand at the side or sit on the floor.
translation_verse: ni nyɛhiɛ sɔ mɔ ni wo atade fɛɛfɛo lɛ ni nyɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Baata he kpakpa nɛɛ,” ni ohiafo lɛ, lɛ lɛ nyɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo lɛ damɔ jɛi, aloo baata minaji anaa yɛ biɛ” lɛ,

english_verse: This is the same as saying that some people are better than others, and you would be acting like a crooked judge.
translation_verse: ani jeee niiaŋ nyɛjieɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ ni kojolɔi ni hiɛ jwɛŋmɔi fɔ̃ji nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ lɛ?

english_verse: My dear friends, pay attention. God has given a lot of faith to the poor people in this world. God has also promised them a share in his kingdom that he will give to everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Minyɛmimɛi ni misumɔɔ, nyɛboa toi! Ani jeee je nɛɛ mli ohiafoi ni ji niiatsɛmɛi yɛ hemɔkɛyeli gbɛfaŋ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehala, koni maŋtsɛyeli ni ewo mɛi ni sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ shi yɛ he lɛ atsɔ̃ amɛnɔ?

english_verse: You mistreat the poor. But isn't it the rich who boss you around and drag you off to court?
translation_verse: Ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛshwieɔ ohiafo lɛ hiɛ shi. Ani jeee niiatsɛmɛi lɛ yeɔ nyɛnɔ waa, ni amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛgbalaa nyɛ kɛyaa kojomɔhei lɛ?

english_verse: Aren't they the ones who make fun of your Lord?
translation_verse: Ani jeee amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛwieɔ gbɛi kpakpa ni akɛtsɛɔ nyɛ lɛ he efɔŋ lɛ?

english_verse: You will do all right, if you obey the most important law in the Scriptures. It is the law that commands us to love others as much as we love ourselves.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji nyɛye kitã ni ji Mla lɛ mli oti ni kɛɔ akɛ, “Suɔmɔ onaanyo tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe lɛ” nɔ yɛ ŋmalɛ lɛ naa lɛ, no lɛ nyɛmiifee jogbaŋŋ.

english_verse: But if you treat some people better than others, you have done wrong, and the Scriptures teach that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji mɛi ahiɛiaŋ nyɛkwɛɔ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛmiifee esha, ni Mla lɛ kãa nyɛ akɛ mlatɔ̃lɔi.

english_verse: If you obey every law except one, you are still guilty of breaking them all.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɔ ni aaaye Mla muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ tete, shi eeetɔ̃ yɛ ekome mli lɛ, eye fɔ yɛ fɛɛ mli.

english_verse: The same God who told us to be faithful in marriage also told us not to murder. So even if you are faithful in marriage, but murder someone, you still have broken God's Law.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɔ ni kɛɛ akɛ, “Kaafite gbãlã” lɛ, ekɛɛ hu akɛ, “Kaagbe gbɔmɔ.” Ni kɛ ofiteee gbãlã shi ogbeɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ, otsɔ̃ mlatɔ̃lɔ.

english_verse: Speak and act like people who will be judged by the law that sets us free.
translation_verse: Nyɛwiea ni nyɛfea nyɛnii akɛ mɛi ni heyeli mla akɛbaakojo amɛ.

english_verse: Do this, because on the day of judgment there will be no pity for those who have not had pity on others. But even in judgment, God is merciful! Faith and Works
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kojomɔ mli lɛ, mɔ ni enaaa mɔbɔ lɛ anaŋ lɛ mɔbɔ; mɔbɔnalɛ yeɔ kojomɔ nɔ kunim ni eshwãa. Hemɔkɛyeli kɛ nitsumɔi

english_verse: My friends, what good is it to say you have faith, when you don't do anything to show you really do have faith? Can this kind of faith save you?
translation_verse: Minyɛmimɛi, kɛji mɔ ko kɛɛ eyɛ hemɔkɛyeli, shi ebɛ nitsumɔi lɛ, mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ mli? Ani hemɔkɛyeli lɛ aaanyɛ eyiwala ahere?

english_verse: If you know someone who doesn't have any clothes or food,
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛmi nuu ko loo nyɛmi yoo ko nyiɛ yayai ni enaaa edaaŋŋmaa,

english_verse: you shouldn't just say, “I hope all goes well for you. I hope you will be warm and have plenty to eat.” What good is it to say this, unless you do something to help?
translation_verse: ni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa yɛ hejɔlɛ mli, nyɛyawerea la, ni nyɛyayea nii nyɛtɔrɔa;” shi ehãaa amɛ nii ni hiaa gbɔmɔtso lɛ, mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ he?

english_verse: Faith that doesn't lead us to do good deeds is all alone and dead!
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ hemɔkɛyeli hu kɛ nitsumɔi bɛ he lɛ, eji hemɔkɛyeli ni egbo.

english_verse: Suppose someone disagrees and says, “It is possible to have faith without doing kind deeds.” I would answer, “Prove that you have faith without doing kind deeds, and I will prove that I have faith by doing them.”
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ko aaakɛɛ, “Bo lɛ, oyɛ hemɔkɛyeli, ni mi lɛ, miyɛ nitsumɔi.” Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi ohemɔkɛyeli ni nitsumɔi bɛ he lɛ ni mi hu majɛ minitsumɔi lɛ amli matsɔ̃ɔ bo mihemɔkɛyeli lɛ.

english_verse: You surely believe there is only one God. That's fine. Even demons believe this, and it makes them shake with fear.
translation_verse: Bo lɛ oheɔ oyeɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mɔ kome ni? Ofee jogbaŋŋ; mumɔi fɔ̃ji hu heɔ yeɔ ni amɛhe kpokpoɔ.

english_verse: Does some stupid person want proof that faith without deeds is useless?
translation_verse: Ao, yaka gbɔmɔ, Ootao ole akɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni nitsumɔi bɛ he lɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni egbo ni lo?

english_verse: Well, our ancestor Abraham pleased God by putting his son Isaac on the altar to sacrifice him.
translation_verse: Wɔtsɛ Abraham lɛ, ani jeee nitsumɔi amli ajɛ abu lɛ bem be ni ekɛ ebi Isak yaŋmɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ?

english_verse: Now you see how Abraham's faith and deeds worked together. He proved his faith was real by what he did.
translation_verse: Oona akɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ enitsumɔi lɛ nyiɛ ni nitsumɔi lɛ amli ejɛ ni ehemɔkɛyeli lɛ ye emuu lɛ.

english_verse: This is what the Scriptures mean by saying, “Abraham had faith in God, and God accepted him.” That's how Abraham became God's friend.
translation_verse: Ni ŋmalɛ lɛ ni kɛɔ akɛ, “Shi Abraham he Nyɔŋmɔ eye, ni abu enɛ jalɛ ahã lɛ” lɛ ba mli, ni atsɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shieŋtsɛ.

english_verse: You can now see that we please God by what we do and not only by what we believe.
translation_verse: Nyɛmiina akɛ nitsumɔi amli ajɛɔ abuɔ gbɔmɔ bem, shi jeee hemɔkɛyeli kɛkɛ mli.

english_verse: For example, Rahab had been a prostitute. But she pleased God when she welcomed the spies and sent them home by another way.
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ Rahab, ajwamãŋ lɛ hu, ani jeee nitsumɔi amli ajɛ abu lɛ bem be ni ehere bɔfoi lɛ atuu ni ejie amɛ gbɛ kɛtsɔ gbɛ kroko nɔ lɛ?

english_verse: Anyone who doesn't breathe is dead, and faith that doesn't do anything is just as dead!
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni gbɔmɔtso ni mumɔ bɛ mli lɛ ji gbonyo lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ hemɔkɛyeli ni nitsumɔi bɛ he lɛ hu ji hemɔkɛyeli ni egbo.

english_verse: My friends, we should not all try to become teachers. In fact, teachers will be judged more strictly than others.
translation_verse: Tsɔɔlɔi akafa yɛ nyɛteŋ, minyɛmimɛi, ejaakɛ nyɛle akɛ wɔbaana kojomɔ ni mli wa fe mɛi krokomɛi anɔ.

english_verse: All of us do many wrong things. But if you can control your tongue, you are mature and able to control your whole body.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔtɔ̃ɔ babaoo. Kɛji mɔ ko tɔ̃ɔɔ yɛ wiemɔ mli lɛ, lɛ lɛ gbɔmɔ ni hi kɛwula shi ji lɛ, ni eyɛ hewalɛ akɛ ekɛaawo gbɔmɔtso muu lɛ fɛɛ manyoflɛ.

english_verse: By putting a bit into the mouth of a horse, we can turn the horse in different directions.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji wɔkɛ okpɔŋɔi amanyoflɛi wo amɛdaaŋ ni amɛbo wɔ toi lɛ wɔkɛkpalaa amɛgbɔmɔtso muu lɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: It takes strong winds to move a large sailing ship, but the captain uses only a small rudder to make it go in any direction.
translation_verse: Naa, lɛji hu tsɛ amɛdara aahu, ni kɔɔyɔɔ ni naa wa kpalaa amɛ, shi kudɔɔ bibioo ko kɛkɛ akɛkudɔɔ amɛ kɛyaa he fɛɛ he ni kudɔɔtsɛ lɛ sumɔɔ.

english_verse: Our tongues are small too, and yet they brag about big things. It takes only a spark to start a forest fire!
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ lilɛi hu henɔ bibioo ni, shi eshwãa nii wuji. Naa, la bibioo hu, nyɛkwɛa koo bɔ sɔŋŋ ni eshãa!

english_verse: The tongue is like a spark. It is an evil power that dirties the rest of the body and sets a person's entire life on fire with flames that come from hell itself.
translation_verse: Ni lilɛi lɛ hu, la ni; wɔhenii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, lilɛi ji nishaianii ajeŋ muu; ni ebuleɔ gbɔmɔtso muu lɛ fɛɛ ni emaa fɔmɔŋ tsakpãa lɛ naa la, ni abonsamiiaje enaa ela lɛ kɛjɛɔ.

english_verse: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and sea creatures can be tamed and have been tamed.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kooloi kɛ loofɔji kɛ nii ni wamɔɔ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ ŋshɔ mli lɛ ahenɔ fɛɛ henɔ lɛ gbɔmɔ nyɛɔ jɔɔ amɛhe, ni ejɔɔ amɛhe.

english_verse: But our tongues get out of control. They are restless and evil, and always spreading deadly poison.
translation_verse: Shi lilɛi lɛ, gbɔmɔ ko gbɔmɔ ko nyɛɛɛ ehe ajɔɔ; nɔ fɔŋ ni eflegeje ní eyi obɔ̃ kɛ ebɔɔ ní gbeɔ mɔ ni.

english_verse: My dear friends, with our tongues we speak both praises and curses. We praise our Lord and Father, and we curse people who were created to be like God, and this isn't right.
translation_verse: Daa kome lɛ nɔŋŋ mli jɔɔmɔ kɛ loomɔ jɛɔ. Minyɛmimɛi, enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ, esaaa akɛ eba lɛ nakai.

english_verse: Can clean water and dirty water both flow from the same spring?
translation_verse: Aso nubu yɔɔ nɛɛ, ebaa nuŋma kɛ nu ni joɔ kɛjɛɔ hiŋmɛi kome lɛ nɔŋŋ mli?

english_verse: Can a fig tree produce olives or a grapevine produce figs? Does fresh water come from a well full of salt water? Wisdom from Above
translation_verse: Minyɛmimɛi, aso agbãmi tso aaanyɛ mutso yibii awo? Aloo waintso aaawo agbãmi? Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ ŋoobu nyɛŋ nu ŋma aba. Nilee ni jɛ ŋwɛi lɛ

english_verse: Are any of you wise or sensible? Then show it by living right and by being humble and wise in everything you do.
translation_verse: Namɔ ji nilelɔ kɛ sanesɛɛkɔlɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ? Ekɛ jeŋba kpakpa atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enitsumɔi lɛ yɛ nilee kpoofeemɔ mli.

english_verse: But if your heart is full of bitter jealousy and selfishness, don't brag or lie to cover up the truth.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ awuŋayeli fɔŋ kɛ bei yɛ nyɛtsui mli lɛ, nyɛkashwãa ni nyɛmalea nyɛshia anɔkwale lɛ.

english_verse: This kind of wisdom doesn't come from above. It is earthly and selfish and comes from the devil himself.
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ nilee nɛɛ, jeee ŋwɛi ejɛ, shi moŋ shikpɔŋ nɔ nɔ ni, heloo naa nɔ ni, mumɔi fɔ̃ji anɔ ni.

english_verse: Whenever people are jealous or selfish, they cause trouble and do all sorts of cruel things.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ he ni awuŋayeli kɛ bei yɔɔ lɛ, jɛi sakasakafeemɔ kɛ nishaianii fɛɛ yɔɔ.

english_verse: But the wisdom that comes from above leads us to be pure, friendly, gentle, sensible, kind, helpful, genuine, and sincere.
translation_verse: Shi nilee ni jɛ ŋwɛi lɛ, klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ ehe tse, no sɛɛ lɛ ehe jɔ, ehiɛ kã shi, eboɔ toi, eyi obɔ̃ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ yibii kpakpai, ejieee niiaŋ, efeee osato.

english_verse: When peacemakers plant seeds of peace, they will harvest justice.
translation_verse: Shi jalɛ yibii lɛ, hejɔlɛ mli aduɔ yɛ ahãa mɛi ni feɔ hejɔlɛnii lɛ.

english_verse: Why do you fight and argue with each other? Isn't it because you are full of selfish desires that fight to control your body?
translation_verse: Nɛgbɛ tawui kɛ nɔmɔi ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ jɛ? Jeee nyɛkɔnɔi ni wuɔ ta yɛ nyɛhenii lɛ amli lɛ mli ejɛ lo?

english_verse: You want something you don't have, and you will do anything to get it. You will even kill! But you still cannot get what you want, and you won't get it by fighting and arguing. You should pray for it.
translation_verse: Nyɛshweɔ nɔ ko, ni nyɛnaaa; nyɛgbeɔ mɛi ni nyɛyeɔ awuŋã, ni nyɛnine nyɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ ashɛ; nyɛnɔɔ ni nyɛwuɔ ta; nyɛnaaa nɔ ko ejaakɛ nyɛkpaaa he fai.

english_verse: Yet even when you do pray, your prayers are not answered, because you pray just for selfish reasons.
translation_verse: Nyɛkpaa he fai hu, ni nyɛnaaa, ejaakɛ fai fɔŋ nyɛkpaa, koni nyɛkɛ nyɛkɔnɔi lɛ akpãtã hiɛ.

english_verse: You people aren't faithful to God! Don't you know if you love the world, you are God's enemies? And if you decide to be a friend of the world, you make yourself an enemy of God.
translation_verse: Gbãlãfitelɔi! Nyɛleee akɛ naanyo ni akɛ je lɛ bɔɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nyɛɛ ni lo? No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ akɛ ekɛ je lɛ abɔ naanyo lɛ etsɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ henyɛlɔ.

english_verse: Do you doubt the Scriptures that say, “God truly cares about the Spirit he has put in us”?
translation_verse: Aloo nyɛsusuɔ akɛ yaka ni ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, “Hiɛkɔ̃ɔ sɛɛ mumɔ ni hiɔ wɔmli lɛ diɔ lɛ?”

english_verse: Surrender to God! Resist the devil, and he will run from you.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ. Nyɛtsĩa abonsam gbɛ ni eeejo nyɛnaa foi.

english_verse: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Clean up your lives, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you people who can't make up your mind.
translation_verse: Nyɛtsia nyɛbɛŋkɛa Nyɔŋmɔ, ni eeetsi ebɛŋkɛ nyɛ. Nyɛtsuua nyɛniji ahe, nyɛ eshafeelɔi, ni nyɛhãa nyɛtsuii ahe atsea, nyɛ jwɛŋmɔi enyɔnyɔɔnyɔtsɛmɛi.

english_verse: Be sad and sorry and weep. Stop laughing and start crying. Be gloomy instead of glad.
translation_verse: Nyɛwerɛ ahoa nyɛhe ni nyɛyea ŋkɔmɔ ni nyɛfoa. Nyɛŋmɔlɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ ŋkɔmɔyeli, ni nyɛmiishɛɛ hu atsɔ̃ gbliniifeemɔ.

english_verse: Be humble in the Lord's presence, and he will honor you. Saying Cruel Things about Others
translation_verse: Nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ, ni eeewo nyɛnɔ. Nyɛkakojoa nyɛnanemɛi

english_verse: My friends, don't say cruel things about others! If you do, or if you condemn others, you are condemning God's Law. And if you condemn the Law, you put yourself above the Law and refuse to obey either it
translation_verse: Nyɛkawiewiea nyɛhe, anyɛmimɛi. Mɔ ni wieɔ enyɛmi he aloo ekojoɔ enyɛmi lɛ, Mla lɛ ewieɔ eshiɔ ni Mla lɛ ekojoɔ lɛ. Shi kɛ ookojo Mla lɛ, jeee Mla lɛ nɔyelɔ ji bo, shi Mla lɛ kojolɔ moŋ ji bo.

english_verse: or God who gave it. God is our judge, and he can save or destroy us. What right do you have to condemn anyone? Warning against Bragging
translation_verse: Mɔ kome ji mlawolɔ kɛ kojolɔ, mɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ni ekɛhereɔ mɔ yiwala ni ekɛkpãtãa mɔ hiɛ hu lɛ. Shi bo lɛ, namɔ ji bo ni okojoɔ onaanyo? Nyɛkashwãa nyɛfɔ̃a wɔ nɔ

english_verse: You should know better than to say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to the city. We will do business there for a year and make a lot of money!”
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ nyɛ hu! Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ loo wɔ wɔɔtee maŋ nɛɛ mli loo maŋ nɛɛ mli ni wɔyaye afi kome yɛ jɛi, ni wɔɔye jara, ni wɔɔna sɛɛ;”

english_verse: What do you know about tomorrow? How can you be so sure about your life? It is nothing more than mist that appears for only a little while before it disappears.
translation_verse: tsɛ nyɛleee wɔ sane, mɛni ji nyɛwala lɛ? Eji lamɔ ni pueɔ be fioo ko, ni kɛ fee sɛɛ lɛ elaajeɔ.

english_verse: You should say, “If the Lord lets us live, we will do these things.”
translation_verse: Hewɔ lɛ sa moŋ akɛ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Kɛji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ miisumɔ ni wɔyi ana wala lɛ, no lɛ wɔɔfee enɛ loo enɛ.”

english_verse: Yet you are stupid enough to brag, and it is wrong to be so proud.
translation_verse: Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ nyɛwoɔ nyɛhe nɔ ni nyɛshwãa; nɛkɛ shwãa nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, efɔŋ ni.

english_verse: If you don't do what you know is right, you have sinned.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni le ekpakpafeemɔ ni efeee lɛ, esha ji no hã lɛ.

english_verse: You rich people should cry and weep! Terrible things are going to happen to you.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ, nyɛ niiatsɛmɛi, nyɛfoa ni nyɛwɔa lele yɛ awerɛhoianii ni baaba nyɛnɔ lɛ ahewɔ!

english_verse: Your treasures have already rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
translation_verse: Nyɛnii ni nyɛna lɛ eshara, ni nyɛtaadei lɛ hu omlɛgɛi eye.

english_verse: Your money has rusted, and the rust will be evidence against you, as it burns your body like fire. Yet you keep on storing up wealth in these last days.
translation_verse: Nyɛshika kɛ nyɛjwiɛtɛi lɛ edɔ ŋkanale, ni amɛhe ŋkanale lɛ aaaye odase ashi nyɛ, ni eeeye nyɛhewojiaŋ tamɔ lá. Nyɛbɔ jwetri yɛ naagbee gbii lɛ amli.

english_verse: You refused to pay the people who worked in your fields, and now their unpaid wages are shouting out against you. The Lord All-Powerful has surely heard the cries of the workers who harvested your crops.
translation_verse: Naa, nitsulɔi ni kpa nyɛŋmɔjiaŋnii lɛ anyɔmɔwoo ni nyɛkɛhãaa amɛ lɛ miibolɔ, ni nikpalɔi lɛ abolɔmɔi lɛ ebabote tai aNuŋtsɔ lɛ toiiaŋ.

english_verse: While here on earth, you have thought only of filling your own stomachs and having a good time. But now you are like fat cattle on their way to be butchered.
translation_verse: Nyɛye nyɛnaanii yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛbɔ ahoshwi. Nyɛ lɛ, nyɛtsuii ni ewo fɔ kɛhã gbee gbi lɛ.

english_verse: You have condemned and murdered innocent people, who couldn't even fight back. Be Patient and Kind
translation_verse: Nyɛbu jalɔ lɛ fɔ, ni nyɛgbe lɛ, etsĩii nyɛ gbɛ. Tsuishiŋmɛɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔ

english_verse: My friends, be patient until the Lord returns. Think of farmers who wait patiently for the autumn and spring rains to make their valuable crops grow.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛŋmɛa nyɛtsui shi kɛyashia Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baa be lɛ. Naa, okwaafonyo lɛ mɛɔ shikpɔŋ nɔ nibaanii ni jara wa lɛ, ni eŋmɛɔ etsui shi yɛ he kɛyashiɔ beyinɔ ni enaa Agbiɛnaa kɛ Gbo nunɛmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Be patient like those farmers and don't give up. The Lord will soon be here!
translation_verse: Nyɛ hu nyɛŋmɛa nyɛtsui shi, ni nyɛnaa hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baa be lɛ eshɛ etã.

english_verse: Don't grumble about each other or you will be judged, and the judge is right outside the door.
translation_verse: Nyɛkadɔmɔa ŋtsɔi nyɛwowoa nyɛhe, anyɛmimɛi, koni akakojo nyɛ. Naa, kojolɔ lɛ damɔ shinaa lɛ naa.

english_verse: My friends, follow the example of the prophets who spoke for the Lord. They were patient, even when they had to suffer.
translation_verse: Minyɛmimɛi, nyɛkɛ gbalɔi ni wie yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi mli lɛ afea amanehulu kɛ tsuishiŋmɛɛ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ.

english_verse: In fact, we praise the ones who endured the most. You remember how patient Job was and how the Lord finally helped him. The Lord did this because he is so merciful and kind.
translation_verse: Naa, wɔbuɔ mɛi ni mĩaa amɛhiɛ lɛ akɛ mɛi ni ajɔɔ amɛ. Nyɛnu Hiob hiɛmiamɔ lɛ he, kɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hã enaagbee fee hã; ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ babaoo, ni enaa mɔbɔ.

english_verse: My friends, above all else, don't take an oath. You must not swear by heaven or by earth or by anything else. “Yes” or “No” is all you need to say. If you say anything more, you will be condemned.
translation_verse: Shi titri lɛ, minyɛmimɛi, nyɛkakãa kitã, nyɛkakɛa akɛ “mina ŋwɛi”, aloo “mina shikpɔŋ”, aloo nyɛkã kitã kroko; shi nyɛ—“hɛɛ” lɛ afee “hɛɛ”, ni “dabi” lɛ afee “dabi”, koni nyɛkagbee kojomɔ mli.

english_verse: If you are having trouble, you should pray. And if you are feeling good, you should sing praises.
translation_verse: Nyɛteŋ mɔ ko miina amanehulu lo? Esɔle. Mɔ ko ena tsuijurɔ? Ela yijiemɔ lalai.

english_verse: If you are sick, ask the church leaders to come and pray for you. Ask them to put olive oil on you in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyɛteŋ mɔ ko nãaa hewalɛ? Etsɛ asafo lɛ mli onukpai lɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni amɛfɔ lɛ mu yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi mli ni amɛsɔle amɛhã lɛ.

english_verse: If you have faith when you pray for sick people, they will get well. The Lord will heal them, and if they have sinned, he will forgive them.
translation_verse: Ni sɔlemɔ ni jɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ aaahere helatsɛ lɛ yiwala, ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaatee lɛ shi, ni kɛji efee esha lɛ, akɛaafa lɛ.

english_verse: If you have sinned, you should tell each other what you have done. Then you can pray for one another and be healed. The prayer of an innocent person is powerful, and it can help a lot.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛjajea nyɛnɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔtsɔ̃a nyɛhe, ni nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa nyɛhe ni nyɛhe atã. Jalɔ sɔlemɔ ni mli wa lɛ nyɛɔ nii babaoo etsuɔ.

english_verse: Elijah was just as human as we are, and for three and a half years his prayers kept the rain from falling.
translation_verse: Elia ji gbɔmɔ adesa tamɔ wɔ nɔŋŋ, ni esɔle sɔlemɔ ko koni nu akanɛ, ni nu enɛɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ afii etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔji ekpaa sɔŋŋ.

english_verse: But when he did pray for rain, it fell from the skies and made the crops grow.
translation_verse: Ni esaa esɔle, ni nu jɛ ŋwɛi shwie shi, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ ba enii.

english_verse: My friends, if any followers have wandered away from the truth, you should try to lead them back.
translation_verse: Anyɛmimɛi, kɛji nyɛteŋ mɔ ko du gbɛ kɛjɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli ni mɔ ko miikpale lɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ,

english_verse: If you turn sinners from the wrong way, you will save them from death, and many of their sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: ele akɛ mɔ ni kpaleɔ eshafeelɔ kɛjɛɔ egbɛduu mli lɛ eehere gbɛdulɔ lɛ susuma yiwala kɛjɛ gbele mli, ni eeha eshai pii anɔ.

english_verse: From Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ. To God's people who are scattered like foreigners in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.
translation_verse: Petro ni ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo lɛ ŋma yahã gbɔi ni egbɛ eshwã Ponto, Galatia, Kapadokia, Asia kɛ Bitinia lɛ. Amɛ ji mɛi ni ahala

english_verse: God the Father decided to choose you as his people, and his Spirit has made you holy. You have obeyed Jesus Christ and are sprinkled with his blood. I pray that God will be kind to you and will keep on giving you peace! A Real Reason for Hope
translation_verse: yɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ le ni ele eto momo lɛ naa. Nyɔŋmɔ fee enɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Mumɔ lɛ hetsuumɔ nɔ, koni amɛkase toiboo ni akɛ Yesu Kristo lá lɛ ashwã amɛnɔ. Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ afa ahã nyɛ! Hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni gbooo

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is so good, and by raising Jesus from death, he has given us new life and a hope that lives on.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ lɛ. Efɔ wɔ ehee yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɔbɔnalɛ babaoo lɛ naa, ni ehã wɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni gbooo kɛtsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo shi ni ete kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: God has something stored up for you in heaven, where it will never decay or be ruined or disappear.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, wɔmiikwɛ gboshinii ni fiteee ni he bɛ kpa ko ni ekwaaa, ni akɛto yɛ ŋwɛi ahã wɔ lɛ gbɛ.

english_verse: You have faith in God, whose power will protect you until the last day. Then he will save you, just as he has always planned to do.
translation_verse: Ni atsɔ̃ɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ abuɔ nyɛhe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ naa atoɔ yiwalaheremɔ ni asaa ato ni abaajie kpo yɛ naagbee be lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: On that day you will be glad, even if you have to go through many hard trials for a while.
translation_verse: No hãa nyɛmli filiɔ nyɛ, tsɛbelɛ ŋmɛnɛ, kɛ efi lɛ, nyɛyeɔ ŋkɔmɔ fioo ko yɛ kai srɔtoi amli.

english_verse: Your faith will be like gold that has been tested in a fire. And these trials will prove that your faith is worth much more than gold that can be destroyed. They will show that you will be given praise and honor and glory when Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: No aaahã ana nyɛ hemɔkɛyeli salɛ lɛ akɛ ejara wa aahu fe shika ni fiteɔ ni aka yɛ la mli tete, kɛhã yijiemɔ kɛ woo kɛ anunyam yɛ Yesu Kristo kpojiemɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: You have never seen Jesus, and you don't see him now. But still you love him and have faith in him, and no words can tell how glad and happy
translation_verse: Nyɛnako lɛ moŋ nɛ, shi nyɛsumɔɔ lɛ; ni amrɔmrɔ nɛɛ hu nyɛnaaa lɛ moŋ, shi nyɛhe enɔ nyɛye. Hewɔ lɛ nyɛmli filiɔ nyɛ kɛ miishɛɛ ni anyɛɛɛ agba ni yɔɔ nyam babaoo lɛ,

english_verse: you are to be saved. This is why you have faith.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ nyɛnine miishɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli naagbee ni ji nyɛsusumai ayiwalaheremɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Some prophets told how God would treat you with undeserved grace, and they searched hard to find out more about the way you would be saved.
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ yiwalaheremɔ nɛɛ, gbalɔi ni gba yɛ dromɔ ni nyɛbaana lɛ he lɛ tao sɛɛgbɛ ni amɛtao mli fitsofitso.

english_verse: The Spirit of Christ was in them and was telling them how Christ would suffer and would then be given great honor. So they searched to find out exactly who Christ would be and when this would happen.
translation_verse: Ni amɛsaa amɛtao amɛna be lɛ ni Kristo Mumɔ ni yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, be mli ni eyeɔ amanehului ni baaba Kristo nɔ kɛ anunyam ni baaba yɛ nomɛi asɛɛ lɛ ahe odase etoɔ lɛ, kɛ bɔ ni nakai be lɛ yɔɔ.

english_verse: But they were told that they were serving you and not themselves. They preached to you by the power of the Holy Spirit, who was sent from heaven. And their message was only for you, even though angels would like to know more about it. Chosen To Live a Holy Life
translation_verse: Ni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ akɛ, jeee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhewɔ, shi moŋ nyɛhewɔ ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ ahe, nii ni agbɛnɛ mɛi ni jaje Sanekpakpa lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni atsu kɛjɛ ŋwɛi lɛ mli lɛ eshiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi tete shweɔ akɛ amɛaana mli lɛ. Atsɛ nyɛ ahã shihilɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ

english_verse: Be alert and think straight. Put all your hope in how God will treat you with undeserved grace when Jesus Christ appears.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsaa nyɛjwɛŋmɔ, nyɛhiɛ akãa shi, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ afɔa dromɔ ni akɛbaahã nyɛ yɛ Yesu Kristo kpojiemɔ mli lɛ nɔ kwraa.

english_verse: Behave like obedient children. Don't let your lives be controlled by your desires, as they used to be.
translation_verse: Nyɛfea nyɛhe bii toibolɔi ni nyɛkabaa nyɛjeŋ yɛ sa be ni nyɛleee nɔ ko lɛ mli akɔnɔi lɛ anaa dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Always live as God's holy people should, because God is the one who chose you, and he is holy.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ, bɔ ni mɔ ni tsɛ nyɛ lɛ yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfea krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ nyɛjeŋba fɛɛ mli.

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say, “I am the holy God, and you must be holy too.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ. “Nyɛfea krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji mi.”

english_verse: You say that God is your Father, but God doesn't have favorites! He judges all people by what they do. So you must honor God while you live as strangers here on earth.
translation_verse: Ni kɛ nyɛtsɛɔ mɔ ni kwɛɛɛ mɛi ahiɛiaŋ shi ekojoɔ yɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nitsumɔ naa lɛ akɛ nyɛTsɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛ gbeyeishemɔ abaa nyɛjeŋ yɛ nyɛgbɔtoo be lɛ mli.

english_verse: You were rescued from the useless way of life you learned from your ancestors. But you know you were not rescued by such things as silver or gold that don't last forever.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nyɛle akɛ jeee nibii ni fiteɔ, tamɔ jwiɛtɛi loo shika, akɛkpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛjɛ nyɛyaka jeŋba ni nyɛna kɛjɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ lɛ mli;

english_verse: You were rescued by the precious blood of Christ, that spotless and innocent lamb.
translation_verse: shi moŋ Kristo, mɔ ni tamɔ Toobi ni he bɛ kpa loo ŋmamɔ nɔ ko lɛ lá ni jara wa lɛ akɛkpɔ̃ nyɛ.

english_verse: Christ was chosen even before the world was created, but because of you, he did not come until these last days.
translation_verse: Ahala lɛ ato momosa dani ato jeŋ shishi, shi ajie lɛ kpo yɛ bei lɛ anaagbee mli yɛ nyɛhewɔ.

english_verse: And when he did come, it was to lead you to have faith in God, who raised him from death and honored him in a glorious way. This is why you have put your faith and hope in God.
translation_verse: Nyɛtsɔ̃ enɔ nyɛheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ ni ewo ehiɛ nyam lɛ nɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhemɔkɛyeli kɛ nyɛhiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli.

english_verse: You obeyed the truth, and your souls were made pure. Now you sincerely love each other. But you must keep on loving with all your heart.
translation_verse: Ni akɛni nyɛtsuu nyɛsusumai ahe yɛ anɔkwale lɛ toiboo mli nyɛhã nyɛmimɛi asuɔmɔ ni osato bɛ mli lɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ tsui krɔŋŋ asumɔsumɔa nyɛhe jogbaŋŋ.

english_verse: Do this because God has given you new birth by his message that lives on forever.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ afɔ nyɛ ehee, ni jeee wui ni fiteɔ, shi moŋ nɔ ni fiteee mli ajɛ afɔ nyɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ ni hiɔ shi daa lɛ wiemɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Humans wither like grass, and their glory fades like wild flowers. Grass dries up, and flowers fall to the ground.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ, “Heloo fɛɛ tamɔ jwɛi, ni enunyam lɛ fɛɛ tamɔ jwɛiaŋ fɔfɔi. Jwɛi gbiɔ ni emli fɔfɔi lɛ kpalaa.

english_verse: But what the Lord has said will stand forever.” Our good news to you is what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.” Enɛ ji wiemɔ ni ajaje atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ.

english_verse: Stop being hateful! Quit trying to fool people, and start being sincere. Don't be jealous or say cruel things about others.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛshɛrɛa efɔŋ fɛɛ kɛ kutumpɔo fɛɛ kɛ shishiumɔ kɛ osato kɛ hetsɛ̃ kɛ mɔhewiemɔ fɛɛ nyɛshwiea.

english_verse: Be like newborn babies who are thirsty for the pure spiritual milk that will help you grow and be saved.
translation_verse: Akɛ fufɔbii ni afɔ amɛ bianɛ lɛ, nyɛshwea wiemɔ lɛ mli fufɔ krɔŋŋ lɛ, koni nyɛdara yɛ mli kɛna yiwalaheremɔ,

english_verse: You have already found out how good the Lord really is.
translation_verse: akɛni nyɛsa nyɛnaa nyɛna akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli hi lɛ.

english_verse: Come to Jesus Christ. He is the living stone people have rejected, but which God has chosen and highly honored.
translation_verse: Lɛ eŋɔɔ nyɛba akɛ tɛ ni hiɛ kã ni gbɔmɛi ekwa lɛ moŋ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ lɛ ehala lɛ ni ejara wa yɛ ehiɛ lɛ.

english_verse: And now you are living stones being used to build a spiritual house. You are also a group of holy priests, and with the help of Jesus Christ you will offer sacrifices that please God.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛ hu nyɛhãa atswaa nyɛ akɛ tɛi ni hiɛ kãmɔ afea mumɔŋ tsu ni afee nyɛ osɔfoi aweku krɔŋkrɔŋ, koni akɛshã mumɔŋ afɔlei ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ yɛ Yesu Kristo hewɔ.

english_verse: It is just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a choice and precious cornerstone. No one who has faith in this one will be disappointed.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ hu ni eyɔɔ ŋmalɛ lɛ mli akɛ, “Naa, mikɛ koŋtɛ miiŋmɛ shi yɛ Zion, tɛ ni ahala ni ejara wa. Ni mɔ ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ hiɛ gboŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.”

english_verse: You are followers of the Lord, and this stone is precious to you. But it isn't precious to those who refuse to follow him. They are the builders who tossed aside the stone that turned out to be the most important one of all.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛheɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ ejara wa hã nyɛ; shi mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ, “Tɛ ni tsutswalɔi lɛ ekwa lɛ, No nɔŋŋ etsɔ̃ koŋtɛ”

english_verse: They disobeyed the message and stumbled and fell over this stone, because they were doomed.
translation_verse: kɛ “Tɛmɔtɛ kɛ nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ tɛsaa ehã amɛ.” Ejaakɛ akɛni amɛbooo wiemɔ lɛ toi hewɔ lɛ amɛtɛrɛ, ni no nɔŋŋ ato amɛ ahã;

english_verse: But you are God's chosen and special people. You are a group of royal priests and a holy nation. God has brought you out of darkness into his marvelous light. Now you must tell all the wonderful things he has done. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: shi nyɛ lɛ, weku ni ahala ji nyɛ, osɔfoi, maŋtsɛmɛi, jeŋmaŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ, maŋ ni ekɛfee enɔ, koni nyɛjaje mɔ ni tsɛ nyɛ kɛjɛ duŋ lɛ mli kɛba lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enaakpɛɛ la lɛ he lɛ agbojee lɛ;

english_verse: “Once you were nobody. Now you are God's people. At one time no one had mercy on you. Now God has treated you with kindness.” Live as God's Servants Should
translation_verse: nyɛ ni sa lɛ nyɛjeee maŋ, shi agbɛnɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ ji nyɛ, nyɛ ni anaaa nyɛ mɔbɔ, shi agbɛnɛ ana nyɛ mɔbɔ lɛ. Kristofoi kɛ maŋbii ateŋ shihilɛ

english_verse: Dear friends, you are foreigners and strangers on this earth. So I beg you not to surrender to those desires that fight against you.
translation_verse: Misuɔmɔmɛi, miiwie miitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ gbɔi kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ maŋsɛɛ, akɛ nyɛtsia nyɛhe kɛjɛa heloosɛɛdiinii ni kɛ susuma wuɔ ta lɛ ahe,

english_verse: Always let others see you behaving properly, even though they may still accuse you of doing wrong. Then on the day of judgment, they will honor God by telling the good things they saw you do.
translation_verse: ni nyɛba nyɛjeŋ jogbaŋŋ yɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ ateŋ, koni be mli ni amɛwieɔ nyɛhe akɛ efɔŋfeelɔi lɛ, amɛkɛ nyɛnitsumɔi kpakpai lɛ ni amɛbaana lɛ awo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ saramɔ Gbi lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord wants you to obey all human authorities, especially the Emperor, who rules over everyone.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa gbɔmɛi agbɛjianɔtoo fɛɛ gbɛjianɔtoo yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewɔ, maŋtsɛ ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ jio,

english_verse: You must also obey governors, because they are sent by the Emperor to punish criminals and to praise good citizens.
translation_verse: lumɛi ni etsu yɛ efɔŋfeelɔi anɔ oweletɔɔ hewɔ kɛ ekpakpafeelɔi ayijiemɔ hewɔ lɛ jio.

english_verse: God wants you to silence stupid and ignorant people by doing right.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nakai ji Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ, akɛ ekpakpafeemɔ nyɛkɛaatsĩ gbɔmɛi ni bɛ yitseiaŋ lɛ akwashiafeemɔ fɛɛ naa,

english_verse: You are free, but still you are God's servants, and you must not use your freedom as an excuse for doing wrong.
translation_verse: akɛ mɛi ni eye amɛhe, shi jeee mɛi ni nyɛkɛ nyɛheyeli lɛ aaafee efɔŋ nɔhaanɔ, shi moŋ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsuji.

english_verse: Respect everyone and show special love for God's people. Honor God and respect the Emperor. The Example of Christ's Suffering
translation_verse: Nyɛwoa mɛi fɛɛ; nyɛsumɔa nyɛmimɛi lɛ; nyɛshea Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, nyɛwoa maŋtsɛ. Tsuji aŋɔ Kristo amanehulu akɛ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ

english_verse: Servants, you must obey your masters and always show respect to them. Do this, not only to those who are kind and thoughtful, but also to those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Webii, nyɛkɛ gbeyeishemɔ fɛɛ abaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa nyɛnuŋtsɔmɛi, jeee mɛi kpakpai kɛ mɛi ni nuɔ nii ahe hãa mɔ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ mɛi ni enaaa mɔbɔ lɛ hu.

english_verse: God will bless you, even if others treat you unfairly for being loyal to him.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ enɛ ji dromɔ, kɛ lee ni mɔ ko le Nyɔŋmɔ hewɔ ni ena amanehulu ni ejaaa gbɛ lɛ.

english_verse: You don't gain anything by being punished for some wrong you have done. But God will bless you, if you have to suffer for doing something good.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ tɔ̃ nyɛtɔ̃ ni ayi nyɛ ni nyɛmia nyɛhiɛ yɛ mli lɛ, mɛɛ anunyam yɔɔ mli? Shi kɛ nyɛfee ekpakpa ni nyɛna he amanehulu ni nyɛmia nyɛhiɛ lɛ, no ji nɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.

english_verse: After all, God chose you to suffer as you follow in the footsteps of Christ, who set an example by suffering for you.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ enɛ hewɔ atsɛ nyɛ, ejaakɛ Kristo hu na amanehulu ehã nyɛ ni ekɛfee nɔkwɛmɔnɔ ehã nyɛ, koni nyɛnyiɛ enanemaahei lɛ asɛɛ.

english_verse: Christ did not sin or ever tell a lie.
translation_verse: Lɛ mɔ ni efeee esha ni asaŋ anaaa shishiumɔ yɛ edaaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Although he was abused, he never tried to get even. And when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he had faith in God, who judges fairly.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni be ni ajɛɔ lɛ lɛ, ejɛɛɛ mɔ ko etooo najiaŋ, be ni enaa amanehulu lɛ, elomɔɔɔ mɔ ko, shi moŋ etu esane ewo mɔ ni kojoɔ jalɛ naa lɛ dɛŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Christ carried the burden of our sins. He was nailed to the cross, so we would stop sinning and start living right. By his cuts and bruises you are healed.
translation_verse: Kristo diɛŋtsɛ etere wɔhe eshai lɛ yɛ egbɔmɔtso lɛ mli kɛtee sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ, koni wɔfee tamɔ mɛi ni egboi yɛ esha gbɛfaŋ ni wɔhiɛ akamɔ yɛ jalɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ; lɛ ehe faji akɛtsa nyɛ lɛ.

english_verse: You had wandered away like sheep. Now you have returned to the one who is your shepherd and protector.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kulɛ nyɛtamɔ toi ni elaaje, shi agbɛnɛ lɛ nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ kɛba nyɛsusumai alɛlɔ kɛ nɔkwɛlɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.

english_verse: If you are a wife, you must put your husband first. Even if he opposes our message, you will win him over by what you do. No one else will have to say anything to him,
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ yeigbãyei lɛ hu, nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛwumɛi lɛ, koni, kɛ mɛi komɛi booo wiemɔ lɛ toi tete lɛ, ashi wiemɔ lɛ sɛɛ ni atsɔ̃ yei lɛ ajeŋba nɔ ni nine ashɛ amɛnɔ,

english_verse: because he will see how you honor God and live a pure life.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ amɛnaa nyɛjeŋba ni he tse ni gbeyeishemɔ yɔɔ mli lɛ.

english_verse: Don't depend on things like fancy hairdos or gold jewelry or expensive clothes to make you look beautiful.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛhewulamɔ akafee yigbɔɔ kɛ shikawoo kɛ atadewoo yɛ kpo nɔ gbɛ.

english_verse: Be beautiful in your heart by being gentle and quiet. This kind of beauty will last, and God considers it very special.
translation_verse: Shi moŋ efee tsui mli gbɔmɔ ni akɛtee yɛ mumɔ ni he jɔ ni yɔɔ kpoo lɛ hewulamɔ ni fiteee lɛ mli lɛ; no ji nɔ ni jara wa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.

english_verse: Long ago those women who worshiped God and put their hope in him made themselves beautiful by putting their husbands first.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ sa lɛ, nakai ji bɔ ni yei krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ hu ni hiɛ kã Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ lɛ wula amɛhe, ni amɛba amɛhe shi amɛhã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwumɛi.

english_verse: For example, Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her true children, if you do right and don't let anything frighten you.
translation_verse: Tamɔ bɔ ni Sara bo Abraham toi, ni etsɛɔ lɛ “nuŋtsɔ” lɛ; ebiyei ji nyɛ, kɛ nyɛfeɔ ekpakpa ni nyɛsheee nɔ ko gbeyei lɛ.

english_verse: If you are a husband, you should be thoughtful of your wife. Treat her with honor, because she isn't as strong as you are, and she shares with you in the gift of life. Then nothing will stand in the way of your prayers. Suffering for Doing Right
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ wumɛi, nyɛkɛ nyɛŋamɛi lɛ ahia shi yɛ nilee naa, ni nyɛkɛ woo awoa yoo akɛ mɔ ni he waaa tuutu ko, akɛni amɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ji wala dromɔ lɛ niyelɔi lɛ, koni akatsĩ nyɛsɔlemɔi lɛ agbɛ. Nyɛkɛ efɔŋ akatoa efɔŋ najiaŋ

english_verse: Finally, all of you should agree and have concern and love for each other. You should also be kind and humble.
translation_verse: Shi naagbee lɛ, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhiɛa jwɛŋmɔ kome, nyɛnanaa nyɛhãa nyɛhe, nyɛsumɔsumɔa nyɛhe akɛ nyɛmimɛi, nyɛmli ashãa nyɛ ahãa nyɛhe, nyɛjwɛŋa heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ.

english_verse: Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ efɔŋ akatoa efɔŋ najiaŋ aloo jɛmɔ yɛ jɛmɔ najiaŋ, shi moŋ nyɛjɔa, ejaakɛ nyɛle akɛ enɛ hewɔ atsɛ nyɛ, koni nyɛnine ashɛ jɔɔmɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: “Do you really love life? Do you want to be happy? Then stop saying cruel things and quit telling lies.
translation_verse: Shi, “Mɔ ni taoɔ wala asumɔ ni ena gbii kpakpai lɛ, emɔ elilɛi mli kɛje efɔŋ he, kɛ enaabu hu koni ekawie shishiumɔ wiemɔ.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and do right, as you find and follow the road to peace.
translation_verse: Ewi efɔŋ ni efee ekpakpa. Etao hejɔlɛ ni enyiɛ no sɛɛ.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who obeys him, and he listens to their prayers. But he opposes everyone who does evil.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiŋmɛi kã jalɔi ahe, ni eboɔ amɛfaikpamɔ toi; shi mɛi ni feɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ejie ehiɛ eka amɛ.” Nyɛfea ekpakpa kɛ nyɛna amanehulu yɛ mli tete

english_verse: Can anyone really harm you for being eager to do good deeds?
translation_verse: Ni kɛ nyɛbɔɔ ekpakpa he mɔdɛŋ lɛ, namɔ aaafee nyɛ efɔŋ?

english_verse: Even if you have to suffer for doing good things, God will bless you. So stop being afraid and don't worry about what people might do.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ jalɛ hewɔ nyɛnaa amanehulu tete lɛ, ajɔɔ nyɛ. Shi nyɛkashea amɛ gbeyei, ni nyɛkahaoa hu.

english_verse: Honor Christ and let him be the Lord of your life. Always be ready to give an answer when someone asks you about your hope.
translation_verse: Shi Nuŋtsɔ, Kristo lɛ, nyɛbua lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ nyɛtsuii amli; ni daa nɛɛ nyɛsaa nyɛhe nyɛtoa, koni nyɛna hetoo nyɛhã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni biɔ nyɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni yɔɔ nyɛmli lɛ shi lɛ;

english_verse: Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ.
translation_verse: shi nyɛkɛ hejɔlɛ kɛ bulɛ ahãa hetoo, ni nyɛhiɛ henilee kpakpa, koni be ni aawie nyɛhe efɔŋ lɛ, mɛi ni gbeɔ nyɛjeŋba kpakpa ni nyɛyɔɔ akɛ Kristofoi lɛ he guɔ lɛ ahiɛ agboi.

english_verse: You are better off to obey God and suffer for doing right than to suffer for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ, kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ miisumɔ akɛ nyɛna amanehulu lɛ, ehi moŋ akɛ nyɛaana amanehulu akɛ ekpakpafeelɔi fe nɔ ni nyɛaana amanehulu akɛ efɔŋfeelɔi.

english_verse: Christ died once for our sins. An innocent person died for those who are guilty. Christ did this to bring you to God, when his body was put to death and his spirit was made alive.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Kristo hu na amanehulu yɛ eshai ahewɔ shi kome, lɛ jalɔ lɛ yɛ mɛi ni ejaaa lɛ anajiaŋ, koni ekɛ wɔ aya Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ. Ni agbe lɛ yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ moŋ, shi ahã lɛ wala yɛ mumɔ gbɛfaŋ.

english_verse: Christ then preached to the spirits that were being kept in prison.
translation_verse: Ni mumɔ lɛ mli etsɔ̃ kɛtee mumɔi ni awo amɛ tsuŋ lɛ aŋɔɔ, eyashiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.

english_verse: They had disobeyed God while Noah was building the boat, but God had been patient with them. Eight people went into that boat and were brought safely through the flood.
translation_verse: Amɛ mɛi ni blema lɛ amɛbooo toi, be ni Nyɔŋmɔ ŋmɛ etsui shi ni emɛ amɛ aahu yɛ Noa bei lɛ amli, be ni afeɔ adeka kpeteŋkple lɛ, nɔ mli ni ahere mɛi fioo ni ji mɛi kpaanyɔ lɛ asusumai ayiwala yɛ kɛtsɔ̃ nu mli lɛ,

english_verse: Those flood waters were like baptism that now saves you. But baptism is more than just washing your body. It means turning to God with a clear conscience, because Jesus Christ was raised from death.
translation_verse: Ni agbɛnɛ baptisimɔ ni nakai nu lɛ ji ehe okadi lɛ hereɔ nyɛ hu nyɛyiwala. Ejeee hewolo nɔ mujijiemɔ, shi moŋ eji kpãŋmɔ ni ajɛɔ henilee kpakpa mli akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kpãŋɔ, kɛtsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo shitee lɛ nɔ,

english_verse: Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.
translation_verse: mɔ ni etee ŋwɛi ni eyata Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ, ni akɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi kɛ hegbɛi kɛ hewalɛi fɛɛ ewo eshishi lɛ.

english_verse: Christ suffered here on earth. Now you must be ready to suffer as he did, because suffering shows that you have stopped sinning.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ akɛni Kristo na amanehulu ehã wɔ yɛ heloo mli hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛkɛ nakai jwɛŋmɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ amiaa akɛ tawuunii, ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ena amanehulu yɛ heloo mli lɛ, ekpa eshafeemɔ.

english_verse: It means you have turned from your own desires and want to obey God for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Koni be ni eshwɛ ehã lɛ yɛ heloo mli shihilɛ nɛɛ mli lɛ, ekahi shi yɛ gbɔmɛi akɔnɔi anaa dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii anaa.

english_verse: You have already lived long enough like people who don't know God. You were immoral and followed your evil desires. You went around drinking and partying and carrying on. In fact, you even worshiped disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ be ni eho momo lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛna be bɔ ni sa nyɛkɛtsu jeŋmajiaŋbii atsui naanii lɛ, ni nyɛba nyɛjeŋ yɛ nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ, akɔnɔi, dãanumɔ mli basabasafeemɔ, ninumɔ kɛ wɔŋjamɔ ni ahiɔ lɛ amli.

english_verse: Now your former friends wonder why you have stopped running around with them, and they curse you for it.
translation_verse: Ni agbɛnɛ ni nyɛhe etswaaa shi nyɛkɛ amɛ eyaaa nɛkɛ shihilɛ gbonyo nɛɛ nɔŋŋ mli hewɔ lɛ, efeɔ amɛ naakpɛɛ ni amɛwieɔ nyɛhe musubɔɔ wiemɔi.

english_verse: But they will have to answer to God, who judges the living and the dead.
translation_verse: Shi amɛbaabu akɔntaa amɛhã mɔ ni esaa ehe eto ni ebaakojo hiɛkãalɔi kɛ gbohii fɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The good news has even been preached to the dead, so that after they have been judged for what they have done in this life, their spirits will live with God.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ enɛ hewɔ ni ajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ gbohii tete hu, koni amɛhi shi yɛ mumɔŋ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ taoɔ, tsɛ akojo amɛ bɔ ni akojoɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ lɛ. Nyɛkɛ nyɛduromɔ keenii lɛ asɔ̃mɔsɔ̃mɔa nyɛhe

english_verse: Everything will soon come to an end. So be serious and be sensible enough to pray.
translation_verse: Shi nibii fɛɛ anaagbee lɛ eshɛ etã. Hewɔ lɛ nyɛjwɛŋmɔ mli atsea ni nyɛhiɛ akãa shi ahãa sɔlemɔi.

english_verse: Most important of all, you must sincerely love each other, because love wipes away many sins.
translation_verse: Shi titri lɛ nyɛsuɔmɔ ni nyɛkɛsumɔsumɔɔ nyɛhe lɛ mli awa, ejaakɛ suɔmɔ haa eshai babaoo nɔ.

english_verse: Welcome people into your home and don't grumble about it.
translation_verse: Nyɛfeefea nyɛhe gbɔ ni huhũumɔ akahi mli.

english_verse: Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well.
translation_verse: Nyɛduromɔ keenii lɛ, bɔ ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ena lɛ, nyɛkɛsɔ̃mɔsɔ̃mɔa nyɛhe tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni jeɔ kpo yɛ gbɛi srɔtoi anɔ lɛ nɔkwɛlɔi kpakpai.

english_verse: If you have the gift of speaking, preach God's message. If you have the gift of helping others, do it with the strength that God supplies. Everything should be done in a way that will bring honor to God because of Jesus Christ, who is glorious and powerful forever. Amen. Suffering for Being a Christian
translation_verse: Kɛ wiemɔ mɔ ko wieɔ lɛ, ewie lɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi; kɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ mɔ ko sɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ, esɔ̃mɔ akɛ hewalɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ hãa lɛ lɛ mli ejeɔ esɔ̃mɔɔ, koni atsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ awo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ nii fɛɛ mli; lɛ enɔ ji anunyam lɛ kɛ hewalɛ lɛ kɛyashiɔ naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ. Amen! Nyɛbaana amanehulu akɛ Kristofoi

english_verse: Dear friends, don't be surprised or shocked that you are going through testing that is like walking through fire.
translation_verse: Suɔmɔmɛi, nyɛkahãa amanehulu la ni akɛkãa nyɛ lɛ miifee nyɛ sane srɔto ko, tamɔ akɛ nɔ ko srɔto ko feɔ nyɛ lɛ;

english_verse: Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.
translation_verse: shi moŋ bɔbɔ ni nyɛnaa Kristo amanehului lɛ eko lɛ, nakai nyɛmii ashɛa, koni enunyam kpojiemɔ lɛ mli hu nyɛmii ashɛ ni nyɛmli afili nyɛ.

english_verse: Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you.
translation_verse: Kɛ Kristo gbɛi hewɔ ajɛɔ nyɛ lɛ, ajɔɔ nyɛ, ejaakɛ anunyam Mumɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ lɛ yɛ nyɛnɔ.

english_verse: But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akana amanehulu akɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ loo julɔ loo efɔŋfeelɔ aloo mɔ ko ni kɛ ehe woɔ mɛi krokomɛi asaji amli.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to suffer for being a Christian. Praise God that you belong to him.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ mɔ ko na amanehulu akɛ Kristofonyo lɛ, ehiɛ akagbo, shi moŋ ewo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam ejaakɛ ehiɛ Kristo gbɛi.

english_verse: God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ be ni abaaje kojomɔ shishi kɛjɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ eshɛ etã; shi kɛ wɔnɔ tsutsu ejɛ lɛ, belɛ mɛi ni booo Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ toi lɛ, te amɛnaagbee aaafee tɛŋŋ?

english_verse: “If good people barely escape, what will happen to sinners and to others who don't respect God?”
translation_verse: Ni kɛ ekpakpa ko dani aaahere jalɔ yiwala lɛ, “Mɔ ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei kɛ eshafeelɔ lɛ, nɛgbɛ amɛbaadamɔ?”

english_verse: If you suffer for obeying God, you must have complete faith in your faithful Creator and keep on doing right.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, mɛi ni naa amanehulu yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaa lɛ hu atu amɛsusumai amɛwo bɔlɔ anɔkwafo lɛ dɛŋ yɛ ekpakpafeemɔ mli.

english_verse: Church leaders, I am writing to encourage you. I too am a leader, as well as a witness to Christ's suffering, and I will share in his glory when it is shown to us.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, onukpai ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ, mi ni mi ji onukpa lɛ eko kɛ Kristo amanehului lɛ ahe odasefonyo ni baana anunyam ni abaajie kpo lɛ hu eko lɛ; ŋaa ni miwoɔ amɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Just as shepherds watch over their sheep, you must watch over everyone God has placed in your care. Do it willingly in order to please God, and not simply because you think you must. Let it be something you want to do, instead of something you do merely to make money.
translation_verse: Nyɛlɛa Nyɔŋmɔ tooku ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa nɔ, jeee nɔnyɛɛ naa, shi moŋ yɛ suɔmɔ naa; tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ taoɔ, asaŋ jeee sɛɛnamɔ ni yɔɔ hiɛgbele hewɔ, shi moŋ tsuijurɔ naa;

english_verse: Don't be bossy to those people who are in your care, but set an example for them.
translation_verse: asaŋ jeee akɛ mɛi ni yeɔ mɛi ni akɛhã nyɛ nɔkwɛmɔ lɛ anɔ akɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi, shi moŋ mɛi ni feɔ amɛhe nɔkwɛmɔnɔ amɛhãa toiku lɛ.

english_verse: Then when Christ the Chief Shepherd returns, you will be given a crown that will never lose its glory.
translation_verse: Ni be ni Tookwɛlɔnukpa lɛ aaajie ehe kpo lɛ, nyɛnine aaashɛ anunyam akekre ni ŋalaaa lɛ nɔ. Heshibaa kɛ hiɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔfɔɔ

english_verse: All of you young people should obey your elders. In fact, everyone should be humble toward everyone else. The Scriptures say, “God opposes proud people, but he helps everyone who is humble.”
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ oblahii kɛ oblayei, nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa onukpai lɛ. Ni nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛbabaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa nyɛhe ni nyɛkɛ heshibaa afee mama nyɛŋmɔa nyɛhɛ, ejaakɛ ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ kuɔ hewolɔi anaa, shi eduroɔ heshibalɔi.”

english_verse: Be humble in the presence of God's mighty power, and he will honor you when the time comes.
translation_verse: Hewɔ lɛ nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nine ni wa lɛ shishi, koni ewo nyɛnɔ yɛ be ni sa mli.

english_verse: God cares for you, so turn all your worries over to him.
translation_verse: Nyɛkɛ nyɛhaomɔ fɛɛ afɔ̃a enɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛsane kã etsui nɔ. Nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ nyɛtsia abonsam gbɛ

english_verse: Be on your guard and stay awake. Your enemy, the devil, is like a roaring lion, sneaking around to find someone to attack.
translation_verse: Nyɛhiɛ akãa shi, nyɛsaraa ejaakɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔ, abonsam lɛ, nyiɛ tamɔ jata ni huɔ eetao mɔ ko emi.

english_verse: But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are.
translation_verse: Nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli nyɛtsĩa lɛ gbɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛle akɛ nakai amanehului lɛ nɔŋŋ nyɛnyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ je lɛ mli lɛ hu naa.

english_verse: But God shows undeserved kindness to everyone. That's why he appointed Christ Jesus to choose you to share in his eternal glory. You will suffer for a while, but God will make you complete, steady, strong, and firm.
translation_verse: Shi dromɔ fɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni tsɛ nyɛ kɛba enaanɔ anunyam lɛ mli yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, kɛ nyɛna amanehulu fioo nɛɛ etã lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eeesaa nyɛ pɛ, ni eeewaje nyɛ, ni eeewo nyɛ hewalɛ ni eeehã nyɛfi shi shiŋŋ.

english_verse: God will be in control forever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Lɛ nɔŋŋ aaaŋɔ hewalɛ ahã kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ. Amen! Shɛɛ kɛ bimɔ

english_verse: Silvanus helped me write this short letter, and I consider him a faithful follower of the Lord. I wanted to encourage you and tell you how kind God really is, so you will keep on having faith in him.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ̃ wɔnyɛmi Silvano ni ji anɔkwafo tamɔ bɔ ni mibuɔ lɛ lɛ nɔ miŋma nyɛ wolo fioo nɛɛ mikɛmiiwo nyɛ ekãa, ni mikɛmiiye odase miishi sɛɛ akɛ enɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa dromɔ lɛ. Nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ yɛ mli.

english_verse: Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones. Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.
translation_verse: Asafo ni yɔɔ Babilon ni ahala amɛ tamɔ ahala wɔ lɛ kɛ mibi Marko hu miibi nyɛ.

english_verse: From Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ. To everyone who shares with us in the privilege of believing that our God and Savior Jesus Christ will do what is just and fair.
translation_verse: Simon Petro ni ji Yesu Kristo tsulɔ kɛ bɔfo lɛ ŋma yahã mɛi ni nine eshɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni jara wa tamɔ wɔnɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ kɛtsɔ̃ wɔNyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔyiwalaherelɔ Yesu Kristo jalɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus. Living as the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ afa ahã nyɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu he nilee lɛ mli. Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛɔ ni ehalaa

english_verse: We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness.
translation_verse: ENyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ lɛ kɛ nii fiaa ni hi hã wala kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ lɛ eke wɔ yɛ mɔ ni tsɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enunyam kɛ ehewalɛ nɔ etsɛ wɔ lɛ he nilee mli.

english_verse: God made great and marvelous promises, so his nature would become part of us. Then we could escape our evil desires and the corrupt influences of this world.
translation_verse: Ni etsɔ̃ nii nɛɛ anɔ hu ekɛ shiwoi kpeleikpelei ni jara wa lɛ eke wɔ, koni nyɛtsɔ̃ nɔ nyɛjo je nɛɛŋ fitemɔ ni yɔɔ akɔnɔ mli lɛ naa foi ni nyɛna Nyɔŋmɔ su lɛ eko.

english_verse: Do your best to improve your faith by adding goodness, understanding,
translation_verse: Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛbɔa mɔdɛŋ fɛɛ ni nyɛkɛ nuufeemɔ afataa nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ he; nyɛkɛ nilee afataa nuufeemɔ lɛ he;

english_verse: If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛji nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ yɛ nyɛmli ni efa lɛ, ehãŋ nyɛfee mɛi ni ebɔɔɔ mɔdɛŋ aloo mɛi ni wooo yibii yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo he nilee lɛ gbɛfaŋ.

english_verse: But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mɔ ni bɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ lɛ, lɛ lɛ shwilafo ji lɛ, ni enaaa shɔŋŋ nii, ni ehiɛ ekpa ehe ni atsuu kɛjɛ eshai ni efee sa lɛ amli lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Belɛ no hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛbɔa mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛtsɛmɔ kɛ nyɛhalamɔ lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ; ejaakɛ, kɛ nyɛfee enɛ lɛ, nyɛtɛrɛŋ gbi ko gbi ko.

english_verse: Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ nakai ni aaaŋmɛ nyɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ kɛ yiwalaherelɔ Yesu Kristo naanɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mlibotemɔ gbɛ aahu tsɔ̃.

english_verse: You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, daa nɛɛ majwɛŋ nɔ makai nyɛ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ, tsɛ nyɛle momo, ni nyɛnane emɔ shi yɛ anɔkwale ni nyɛnine eshɛ nɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body.
translation_verse: Shi gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ, mibuɔ akɛ eja akɛ mikɛ kaimɔ ahɛle nyɛ shi.

english_verse: And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mile akɛ migbele lɛ baaba nɔŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo hu ejie kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi lɛ.

english_verse: This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone. The Message about the Glory of Christ
translation_verse: Shi mabɔ he mɔdɛŋ koni mijeŋjee sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛhiɛ ahi nii nɛɛ anɔ be fɛɛ be. Kristo anunyam lɛ he odasefoi

english_verse: When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ jeee adesai ni afolɔ anɔ wɔdamɔ wɔjaje wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo hewalɛ kɛ ebaa lɛ he sane wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, shi moŋ wɔji odasefoi ni na enunyam kpeteŋkple lɛ kɛ wɔhiŋmɛii.

english_verse: God, our great and wonderful Father, truly honored him by saying, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ena woo kɛ anunyam kɛjɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, be ni nakai gbee lɛ kɛ lɛ wie kɛjɛ anunyam kpeteŋkple lɛ mli akɛ, “Mɔ nɛ ji misuɔmɔ Bi ni mina ehe tsui lɛ.”

english_verse: We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.
translation_verse: Ni nɛkɛ gbee nɛɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔnu akɛ ŋwɛi ejɛ, be ni wɔ kɛ lɛ yɔɔ gɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts.
translation_verse: Ni ama gbalɛ wiemɔ lɛ nɔ mi ahã wɔ fe tsutsu lɛ, ni kɛji nyɛkɛ nyɛjwɛŋmɔ fɔ̃ no nɔ akɛ là ni tsoɔ yɛ he ko ni woɔ duŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni je aaatsɛre ni tooloo lɛ aaate shi yɛ nyɛtsuii amli lɛ, no lɛ nyɛmiifee jogbaŋŋ.

english_verse: But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛlea enɛ tsutsu akɛ ŋmalɛ lɛ mli gbalɛ fɛɛ gbalɛ lɛ jeee mɔ ko niiashishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ ni.

english_verse: The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ gbalɛ ko bako yɛ gbɔmɔ suɔmɔ̃naa pɛŋ, shi moŋ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tsirɛ gbɔmɛi ni amɛwie wiemɔi ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã amɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Sometimes false prophets spoke to the people of Israel. False teachers will also sneak in and speak harmful lies to you. But these teachers don't really belong to the Master who paid a great price for them, and they will quickly destroy themselves.
translation_verse: Shi amalegbalɔi hu te shi yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni amaletsɔ̃ɔlɔi baaba nyɛ hu nyɛteŋ lɛ. Amɛkɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi aaaba nigii, ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni kpɔ̃ amɛ lɛ po, amɛaakwa lɛ, ni amɛkɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ ni he yɔɔ oya aaaba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnɔ.

english_verse: Many people will follow their evil ways and cause others to tell lies about the true way.
translation_verse: Ni mɛi pii aaanyiɛ amɛnyɛnyɛntswibɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ, ni amɛhewɔ lɛ aaawie anɔkwale gbɛ lɛ he musubɔɔ wiemɔi.

english_verse: They will be greedy and cheat you with smooth talk. But long ago God decided to punish them, and God doesn't sleep.
translation_verse: Ni amɛkɛ hiɛjoomɔ kɛ shishiumɔ wiemɔi aaatao ni amɛna nyɛhe sɛɛ. Shi kojomɔ ni kã shi hã amɛ kɛjɛ blema beebe lɛ aaaba amɛnɔ, ni amɛhiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ wɔɔɔ!

english_verse: God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ bɔfoi ni fee esha lɛ ahe ekeee amɛ, shi moŋ etsi amɛ ewo gbohiiaje bu kɛ emli duŋ lɛ mli, ni eŋɔ amɛ ehã akɛ akɛ amɛ ato ahã kojomɔ,

english_verse: And during Noah's time, God did not have pity on the ungodly people of the world. He destroyed them with a flood, though he did save eight people, including Noah, who preached the truth.
translation_verse: ni asaŋ kɛ ekɛ blema je lɛ he ekeee lɛ, shi moŋ Noa ni ji jalɛ shiɛlɔ lɛ, mɔ ni gbe yi fee kpaanyɔ lɛ kɛkɛ yi ebaa, ni ekɛ nu afua lɛ ba mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ aje lɛ nɔ,

english_verse: God punished the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and this is a warning to anyone else who wants to sin.
translation_verse: ni kɛji Sodom kɛ Gomora maji lɛ hu eshã ni ehã amɛtsɔ̃ lamlu, ni ekɛ butumɔ kojo amɛ ekɛto mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ okadi,

english_verse: This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
translation_verse: belɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ le bɔ ni efeɔ ejieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔi yɛ kaa mli, kɛ bɔ ni efeɔ etoɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji yɛ piŋmɔ mli kɛyashi kojomɔ gbi lɛ nɔ;

english_verse: The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven.
translation_verse: shi titri lɛ mɛi ni nyiɛɔ heloo akɔnɔ ni yɔɔ muji sɛɛ, ni amɛbuuu nɔyeli hewalɛ lɛ, tsuisalɔi kɛ yibulɔi ni kɛji amɛmiiye gbɔmɛi agboi ahe osheku ni amɛhe kpokpooo;

english_verse: Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.
translation_verse: tsɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi tete ni yɔɔ hewalɛ kɛ nyɛmɔ babaoo fe amɛ lɛ, amɛ po amɛwieee amɛhe efɔŋ kɛkojooo amɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ. Amaletsɔ̃ɔlɔi ajeŋba tuuŋtu

english_verse: These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them.
translation_verse: Shi nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ tamɔ kooloi ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ ni afɔ amɛ ahã mɔmɔ kɛ gbee lɛ, amɛwieɔ nii ni amɛleee he nɔ ko lɛ he efɔŋ, ni amɛkɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ,

english_verse: They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil. They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on.
translation_verse: ni aaafee amɛ efɔŋ akɛ efɔŋ ni amɛfee mɛi krokomɛi lɛ he nyɔmɔwoo. Amɛbuɔ shwane fintiŋŋ ahoshwibɔɔ akɛ nii ni ŋɔɔ; mujiatsɛmɛi ni he yɔɔ taŋ ni; amɛmii shɛɔ yɛ amɛshishiumɔi lɛ ahe be ni amɛkɛ nyɛ yeɔ nii lɛ.

english_verse: All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!
translation_verse: Amɛyɛ hiŋmɛii ni eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ gbãlãfitemɔ ni kpaaa eshafeemɔ. Amɛlakaa susumai ni nane mɔko shi lɛ. Amɛyɛ tsui ni he esa kɛ hiɛjoomɔ; loomɔbii ni.

english_verse: They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook.
translation_verse: Amɛje gbɛ ni ja lɛ nɔ, ni amɛdu gbɛ kɛyanyiɛ Beor bi Bileam, mɔ ni sumɔ nɔshafeemɔ mli nyɔmɔwoo lɛ, gbɛ lɛ nɔ;

english_verse: But a donkey corrected him for this evil deed. It spoke to him with a human voice and made him stop his foolishness.
translation_verse: shi akã ehiɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emlatɔ̃mɔ lɛ hewɔ, teji ni leee wiemɔ lɛ kɛ gbɔmɔ gbee wie, ni etsĩ gbalɔ lɛ kwashiafeemɔ lɛ naa.

english_verse: These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them.
translation_verse: Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji nubui ni nu bɛ mli, atatui ni ahum loɔ kɛyaa, mɛi ni akɛ duŋ kpii lɛ eto ehã amɛ.

english_verse: They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ akɛni naafuu wiemɔi wuji jeɔ amɛnaa hewɔ lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ɔ heloo akɔnɔi anɔ amɛkɛ nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ lakaa mɛi ni je mɛi ni baa amɛjeŋ yɛ shishiumɔ mli lɛ adɛŋ etsɛko lɛ;

english_verse: They promise freedom to everyone. But they are merely slaves of filthy living, because people are slaves of whatever controls them.
translation_verse: amɛwoɔ amɛ shi akɛ amɛaaye amɛhe, tsɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ fitemɔ nyɔ̃ji ji amɛ; ejaakɛ mɔ ni aye enɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ nyɔŋ ehã mɔ ni ye enɔ lɛ.

english_verse: When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ kɛ amɛtsɔ̃ Nuŋtsɔ kɛ yiwalaherelɔ Yesu Kristo he nilee lɛ nɔ amɛjo je nɛɛ mli mujinii lɛ anaa foi ni asaa adu amɛ yɛ nomɛi amli ni aye amɛnɔ lɛ, amɛnaagbee shihilɛ etsɔ̃ efɔŋ fe amɛtsutsu shihilɛ lɛ.

english_verse: They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ faŋ nɔ ni amɛnaaa amɛle jalɛ gbɛ lɛ, fe nɔ ni amɛle ni kɛ̃lɛ amɛkpale kɛjɛ kitã krɔŋkrɔŋ ni atu awo amɛdɛŋ lɛ he.

english_verse: What happened to them is just like the true saying, “A dog will come back to lick up its own vomit. A pig that has been washed will roll in the mud.”
translation_verse: Shi anɔkwa abɛ lɛ eba mli yɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Gbee kuɔ esɛɛ kɛyaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshwee he, ni kplotoo ni aju ehe lɛ yakokloɔ ŋmɔtɔ mli.”

english_verse: what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.
translation_verse: ni nyɛkai gbalɔi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ awiemɔi ni amɛwie sa kɛ Nuŋtsɔ kɛ yiwalaherelɔ lɛ kitã ni bɔfoi ni atsu nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ kɛhã nyɛ lɛ.

english_verse: But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you
translation_verse: Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ nyɛle enɛ, akɛ naagbee gbii lɛ anɔ lɛ, hefɛoyelɔi aaaba kɛ hefɛoyeli, ni amɛaanyiɛ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛkɔnɔi lɛ anaa,

english_verse: and say, “Didn't your Lord promise to come back? Yet the first leaders have already died, and the world hasn't changed a bit.”
translation_verse: ni amɛaakɛɛ, “Nɛgbɛ ebaa lɛ he shiwoo lɛ yɔɔ? Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni tsɛmɛi lɛ tee yawɔwɔi nɛɛ, bɔ ni nibii fɛɛ yɔɔ kɛjɛ jeŋbɔɔ shishijee mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ amɛyɔɔ nɛɛ.”

english_verse: They will say this because they want to forget that long ago the heavens and the earth were made at God's command. The earth came out of water and was made from water.
translation_verse: Kwa amɛkwaa amɛ jieɔ amɛhiɛ yɛ enɛ nɔ akɛ ŋwɛi yɛ kɛjɛ blema beebe, ni shikpɔŋ hu jɛ nu mli, ni etsɔ̃ nu mli ebama shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ naa;

english_verse: Later it was destroyed by the waters of a mighty flood.
translation_verse: no nɔŋŋ nɔ etsɔ̃ ni nu ŋɔ je ni yɔɔ no be lɛ mli lɛ ni ehiɛ kpãtã lɛ.

english_verse: But God has commanded the present heavens and earth to remain until the day of judgment. Then they will be set on fire, and ungodly people will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Shi ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ, nakai wiemɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ etsɔ̃ ekɛ amɛ to hã là kɛyashi kojomɔ gbi lɛ ni aaakpãtã mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ ahiɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't forget that for the Lord one day is the same as
translation_verse: Shi, suɔmɔmɛi, nyɛhiɛ akakpaa sane kome nɛɛ nɔ, akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, gbi kome tamɔ afii akpe, ni afii akpe hu tamɔ gbi kome.

english_verse: The Lord isn't slow about keeping his promises, as some people think he is. In fact, God is patient, because he wants everyone to turn from sin and no one to be lost.
translation_verse: Jeee tsɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hãa eshiwoo lɛ sɛɛ tsɛɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni mɛi komɛi susuɔ akɛ esɛɛ etsɛ lɛ, shi moŋ etsui shi etoɔ ehãa wɔ, ejaakɛ esumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ mɛi komɛi alaaje, shi moŋ akɛ mɛi fɛɛ atsake amɛtsui.

english_verse: The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
translation_verse: Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Gbi lɛ baaba tamɔ julɔ, ni no mli lɛ ŋwɛi lɛ aaaho aya kɛ gbɛɛmɔ, ni je nɛɛ mli shishijeenii lɛ aaashã ni amɛaatserɛ, ni shikpɔŋ kɛ emli nii lɛ aaashã. Nyɛhiɛ akajea jeŋ ni yɔɔ daa lɛ nɔ

english_verse: Everything will be destroyed. So you should serve and honor God by the way you live.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ, akɛni nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ baafite hewɔ lɛ, mɛɛ gbɔmɛi sa akɛ nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ yɛ jeŋba krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ mli?

english_verse: You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat.
translation_verse: Be mli ni nyɛkwɛɔ gbɛ ni nyɛshweɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Gbi lɛ baa lɛ, nɔ mli ni ŋwɛi aaahere kɛ là ni eeetsere, ni jeŋ shishijeenii hu aaasere yɛ là mli lɛ!

english_verse: But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!
translation_verse: Shi yɛ eshiwoo lɛ naa lɛ, wɔmiikwɛ ŋwɛi hee kɛ shikpɔŋ hee ni jalɛ hiɔ mli lɛ gbɛ.

english_verse: My friends, while you are waiting, you should make certain the Lord finds you pure, spotless, and living at peace.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, suɔmɔmɛi, akɛni nyɛkwɛɔ nii nɛɛ agbɛ nɛɛ, nyɛbɔa mɔdɛŋ koni ana nyɛ ni muji loo kpa ko bɛ nyɛhe yɛ ehiɛ yɛ hejɔlɛ mli;

english_verse: Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him.
translation_verse: ni nyɛbua wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ tsuishitoo lɛ akɛ yiwalaheremɔ, tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni wɔsuɔmɔ nyɛmi Paulo lɛ hu ŋma nyɛ, yɛ nilee ni akɛhã lɛ lɛ naa lɛ,

english_verse: Paul talks about these same things in all his letters, but part of what he says is hard to understand. Some ignorant and unsteady people even destroy themselves by twisting what he said. They do the same thing with other Scriptures too.
translation_verse: tamɔ bɔ ni ewieɔ enɛɛmɛi ahe yɛ ewoji lɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ. Woji nɛɛ amli nibii komɛi yɛ ni amɛshishinumɔ wa, ni mɛi ni ekaseko nɔ ko lɛ kɛ mɛi ni nane mɔko shi lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ shishi ekroko, tamɔ bɔ ni amɛfeɔ ŋmalɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ hu kɛkpãtãa amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ.

english_verse: My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance.
translation_verse: Agbɛnɛ suɔmɔmɛi, akɛni nyɛ lɛ nyɛle momosa hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsaraa, koni akɛ gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji alakamɔ sane lɛ akashãtã nyɛ hu, ni nyɛjɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛshifimɔ lɛ mli nyɛgbee shi
