english_verse: Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Shi nyɛshwerea yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ kɛ yiwalaherelɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ kɛ nilee lɛ mli. Lɛ nɔŋŋ aŋɔ anunyam ahã agbɛnɛ kɛ daa. Amen!

english_verse: The Word that gives life was from the beginning, and this is the one our message is about. Our ears have heard, our eyes have seen, and our hands have touched this Word.
translation_verse: Wala wiemɔ lɛ yɛ kɛjɛ shishijee. Wɔnu ni wɔna kɛ wɔhiŋmɛii, wɔkwɛ ni wɔniji etara he yɛ wala wiemɔ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us.
translation_verse: Ni wala lɛ jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ, ni wɔna, ni wɔyeɔ he odase ni wɔjajeɔ naanɔ wala lɛ, nɔ ni kɛ Tsɛ lɛ yɔɔ ni ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ lɛ he sane wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ.

english_verse: We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni wɔna ni wɔnu lɛ, no wɔjajeɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ hu, koni nyɛ hu nyɛkɛ wɔ abɔ naanyo. Shi wɔnaanyobɔɔ lɛ, Tsɛ lɛ kɛ eBi Yesu Kristo lɛ wɔkɛbɔɔ.

english_verse: We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy. God Is Light
translation_verse: Wɔmiiŋma nyɛ nii nɛɛ, koni nyɛmiishɛɛ lɛ ayi obɔ̃. Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ là ji lɛ

english_verse: Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.
translation_verse: Ni enɛ ji sane lɛ ni wɔnu kɛjɛ ebi lɛ ŋɔɔ ni wɔsaa wɔjajeɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ. No ji akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, là ji lɛ, ni duŋ ko kwraa bɛ emli,

english_verse: If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth.
translation_verse: Kɛji wɔkɛɛ akɛ wɔkɛ lɛ miibɔ naanyo ni wɔnyiɛɔ duŋ lɛ mli lɛ, wɔmiimale ni wɔyeee anɔkwa.

english_verse: But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away.
translation_verse: Shi kɛji wɔnyiɛɔ là lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyɔɔ là lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ wɔkɛ wɔhe miibɔ naanyo, ni eBi Yesu Kristo la lɛ tsumɔɔ wɔhe kɛjeɔ esha fɛɛ mli.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Kɛji wɔkɛɛ akɛ esha ko bɛ wɔhe lɛ, wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhe wɔshishiuɔ, ni anɔkwale lɛ bɛ wɔmli.

english_verse: But if we confess our sins to God, he can always be trusted to forgive us and take our sins away.
translation_verse: Kɛji wɔjaje wɔhe eshai lɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, anɔkwafo kɛ jalɔ ji lɛ, ni ekɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ aaafa wɔ ni eeetsumɔ wɔhe kɛjɛ nii ni ejaaa gbɛ fɛɛ mli.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Kɛji wɔkɛɛ akɛ wɔfeko esha lɛ, belɛ wɔhã Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ amalelɔ, ni ewiemɔ lɛ bɛ wɔmli.

english_verse: My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us.
translation_verse: Mibii bibii, miiŋma nyɛ nii nɛɛ koni nyɛkafee esha. Ni kɛ mɔ ko fee esha jiŋŋ, wɔyɛ mlidaamɔlɔ yɛ Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, Yesu Kristo jalɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Christ is the sacrifice that takes away our sins and the sins of all the world's people.
translation_verse: Lɛ ji wɔhe eshai lɛ ahe kpãtãmɔnɔ; shi jeee wɔnɔ lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ hu.

english_verse: When we obey God, we are sure we know him.
translation_verse: Ni kɛ wɔyeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ, no wɔkɛnaa akɛ wɔle lɛ.

english_verse: But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ, “Mile lɛ,” ni eyeee ekitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ, amalelɔ ji lɛ, ni anɔkwale lɛ bɛ emli.

english_verse: We truly love God only when we obey him as we should, and then we know we belong to him.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ lɛɛlɛŋ lɛ, lɛ emli Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ lɛ eye emuu yɛ. Enɛ wɔkɛleɔ akɛ wɔyɛ emli.

english_verse: If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ. The New Commandment
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ eyɛ emli lɛ, sa akɛ enyiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ hu enyiɛɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ. Kitã hee lɛ

english_verse: My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard.
translation_verse: Suɔmɔmɛi, jeee kitã hee ko miŋmaa nyɛ nɛɛ, shi moŋ kitã momo ni nyɛyɔɔ kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ. Kitã momo lɛ ji wiemɔ ni nyɛnu lɛ.

english_verse: But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
translation_verse: Shi asaŋ kitã hee miŋmaa nyɛ nɛɛ, nɔ ni ji anɔkwa yɛ Kristo mli kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛmli lɛ, ejaakɛ duŋ lɛ eho, ni anɔkwa là lɛ miitso momo.

english_verse: If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ eyɛ la lɛ mli ni enyɛ̃ɔ enyɛmi lɛ, eyɛ duŋ lɛ mli lolo.

english_verse: But if we love others, we are in the light, and we don't cause problems for them.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni sumɔɔ enyɛmi lɛ, eyɛ la lɛ mli, ni nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔnɔ ko bɛ emli.

english_verse: If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni nyɛɔ enyɛmi lɛ, duŋ lɛ mli eyɔɔ, ni duŋ lɛ mli enyiɛɔ, ni eleee he ni eyaa, ejaakɛ duŋ lɛ eshwila ehiŋmɛii. Nyɛkasumɔa je lɛ

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because your sins have been forgiven in the name of Christ.
translation_verse: Miiŋma nyɛ, mibii bibii, ejaakɛ akɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ efa nyɛ yɛ Kristo gbɛi lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: Miiŋma nyɛ, ataamɛi, ejaakɛ nyɛle mɔ ni yɔɔ kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ. Miiŋma nyɛ, oblahii, ejaakɛ nyɛye mɔ fɔŋ lɛ nɔ kunim.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because you have known the Father. Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you are strong. God's message is firm in your hearts, and you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: Miiŋma nyɛ, gbekɛbii, ejaakɛ nyɛle Tsɛ lɛ. Miiŋma nyɛ, ataamɛi, ejaakɛ nyɛle mɔ ni yɔɔ kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ. Miŋma nyɛ, oblahii, ejaakɛ nyɛhe wa, ni Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ yɛ nyɛmli, ni nyɛye mɔ fɔŋ lɛ nɔ kunim.

english_verse: Don't love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you cannot love the Father.
translation_verse: Nyɛkasumɔa je lɛ loo nibii ni yɔɔ je lɛ mli. Kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ je lɛ, belɛ Tsɛ lɛ suɔmɔ lɛ bɛ emli,

english_verse: Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ je lɛ mli lɛ — heloo lɛ sɛɛdiinii lɛ kɛ hiŋmɛii lɛ asɛɛdiinii lɛ kɛ shihilɛ mli hewoo lɛ — ejɛɛɛ Tsɛ lɛ mli, shi moŋ je lɛ mli ejɛ.

english_verse: The world and the desires it causes are disappearing. But if we obey God, we will live forever. The Enemy of Christ
translation_verse: Je lɛ hoɔ eyaa kɛ emli sɛɛdiinii lɛ, shi mɔ ni feɔ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ. Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe yɛ Kristo henyɛlɔi ahe

english_verse: Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here.
translation_verse: Gbekɛbii, naagbee ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɛ; ni bɔ ni nyɛnu akɛ Kristo henyɛlɔ lɛ miiba lɛ, Kristo henyɛlɔi lɛ pii eba amrɔ nɛɛ, hewɔ lɛ wɔle akɛ naagbee ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
translation_verse: Wɔteŋ amɛjɛ amɛtee, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛjeee wɔteŋ mɛi komɛi, ejaakɛ wɔteŋ mɛi komɛi ji amɛ kulɛ amɛ kɛ wɔ hi shi. Shi amɛtee bɔ ni afee ni amɛ jie amɛhe shi akɛ amɛ fɛɛ lɛ jeee wɔteŋ mɛi komɛi ji amɛ.

english_verse: Christ, the Holy One, has blessed you, and now all of you understand.
translation_verse: Ni nyɛ lɛ, nyɛna mufɔɔ kɛjɛ Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ, ni nyɛle nii fɛɛ.

english_verse: I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth.
translation_verse: Jeee akɛ nyɛleee anɔkwale lɛ hewɔ miŋma nyɛ nɛɛ, shi moŋ akɛ nyɛle, ni nyɛle akɛ amale komeflo jɛɛɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli.

english_verse: And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son.
translation_verse: Namɔ ji amalelɔ, kɛjeee mɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ Yesu jeee Kristo lɛ? Mɔ ni kwaa Tsɛ lɛ kɛ Bi lɛ, lɛ ji Kristo henyɛlɔ lɛ,

english_verse: If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kwaa Bi lɛ, ebɛ Tsɛ lɛ hu; shi mɔ ni gbaa mli kpoo akɛ eheɔ Bi lɛ nɔ eyeɔ lɛ, eyɛ Tsɛ lɛ hu.

english_verse: Keep thinking about the message you first heard, and you will always be one in your heart with the Son and with the Father.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ lɛ, nɔ ni nyɛnu kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ, nyɛhãa no ahia nyɛmli. Kɛji nɔ ni nyɛnu kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ hi nyɛmli lɛ, no lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛaahi Bi lɛ kɛ Tsɛ lɛ mli.

english_verse: The Son has promised us eternal life.
translation_verse: Ni enɛ ji shi ni ewo wɔ lɛ — naanɔ wala lɛ.

english_verse: I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni hãa nyɛduɔ gbɛ lɛ ahewɔ miŋmaa nyɛ nii nɛɛ.

english_verse: But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do. Children of God
translation_verse: Ni nyɛ lɛ, mufɔɔ ni nyɛna kɛjɛ eŋɔɔ lɛ yɛ nyɛmli, ni ehe ehĩaaa nyɛ akɛ mɔ ko atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nii, shi moŋ bɔ ni emufɔɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nii fɛɛ, ni eji anɔkwale ni jeee amale ni lɛ, bɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ nyɛhia emli.

english_verse: Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame.
translation_verse: Ni agbɛnɛ, mibii bibii, nyɛhia emli koni be ni eeebapue lɛ, wɔna ekãa ni wɔhiɛ akagboi ni wɔnyɛɛɛ ehiɛ wɔdamɔ yɛ ebaa lɛ mli.

english_verse: You know Christ always does right and everyone who does right is a child of God.
translation_verse: Kɛji nyɛle akɛ jalɔ ji lɛ lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsuɔ jalɛnii lɛ afɔ lɛ kɛjɛ emli.

english_verse: Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are.
translation_verse: Nyɛkwɛa suɔmɔ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni Tsɛ lɛ kɛsumɔ wɔ, akɛ atsɛ wɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bii, ni nakai wɔji! Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, je lɛ leee wɔ, ejaakɛ eleee Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is.
translation_verse: Suɔmɔmɛi, agbɛnɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bii ji wɔ, ni anako ajie nɔ ni wɔbaatsɔ̃mɔ lɛ shi; shi wɔle akɛ, be ni aaajie no shi lɛ, wɔɔtamɔ Kristo, ejaakɛ wɔɔna lɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ.

english_verse: This hope makes us keep ourselves holy, just as Christ is holy.
translation_verse: Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ nɛɛ yɛ emli lɛ, etsuuɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe, tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ ehe tse lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ esha lɛ eefee mlatɔ̃mɔnii hu; ni esha lɛ mlatɔ̃mɔ ni.

english_verse: You know Christ came to take away our sins. He isn't sinful,
translation_verse: Ni nyɛle akɛ Kristo jie ehe kpo, koni ewo wɔhe eshai kɛya; ni esha ko bɛ emli.

english_verse: and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hiɔ emli lɛ, efeee esha; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ esha lɛ, enako lɛ ni asaŋ eleko lɛ.

english_verse: Children, don't be fooled. Anyone who does right is good, just like Christ himself.
translation_verse: Bii bibii, nyɛkahãa mɔ ko miihã nyɛdu gbɛ. Mɔ ni tsuɔ jalɛnii lɛ, jalɔ ji lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ hu eji jalɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni feɔ esha lɛ, ejɛ abonsam mli; ejaakɛ kɛjɛ shishijee beebe lɛ, abonsam feɔ esha. Enɛ hewɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ jie ehe kpo koni efite abonsam nitsumɔi lɛ.

english_verse: God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ lɛ lɛ, efeee esha, ejaakɛ esu yɛ emli, ni enyɛŋ esha efee, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other. Love Each Other
translation_verse: Enɛ mli Nyɔŋmɔ bii lɛ kɛ abonsam bii lɛ jieɔ amɛhe shi faŋŋ yɛ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsuuu jalɛnii lɛ, ejɛɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli, nakai nɔŋŋ ji mɔ ni sumɔɔɔ enyɛmi hu. Nyɛsumɔsumɔa nyɛhe

english_verse: From the beginning you were told we must love each other.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ enɛ ji sane ni nyɛnu kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ, akɛ wɔsumɔsumɔɔ wɔhe.

english_verse: Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil.
translation_verse: Jeee tamɔ Kain ni jɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ mli ni egbe enyɛmi lɛ. Ni mɛɛ hewɔ egbe lɛ? Ejaakɛ enitsumɔi lɛ efɔ̃ɔji ni, shi enyɛmi lɛ nɔ lɛ ja.

english_verse: My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you.
translation_verse: Anyɛmimɛi, kɛji je lɛ miinyɛ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛhiɛ akafea nyɛ yaa.

english_verse: If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni nyɛɔ enyɛmi lɛ, gbɔmɔgbelɔ ji lɛ; ni nyɛle akɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ ko gbɔmɔgbelɔ ko bɛ naanɔ wala yɛ emli.

english_verse: We know what love is because Jesus gave his life for us. This is why we must give our lives for each other.
translation_verse: Enɛ mli wɔyoɔ suɔmɔ lɛ yɛ, akɛ ekɛ ewala ŋmɛ shi yɛ wɔhewɔ, ni sa akɛ wɔ hu wɔ kɛ wɔwala ŋmɛɔ shi yɛ wɔnyɛmimɛi ahewɔ.

english_verse: If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God.
translation_verse: Shi mɔ ni yɔɔ je nɛɛ mli nii, ni enaa akɛ efi enyɛmi, ni emli joɔ yɛ enɔ lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ lɛ aaahi emliŋ?

english_verse: Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.
translation_verse: Mibii bibii, nyɛkahãa wɔsumɔa mɛi yɛ wiemɔ mli loo lilɛi nɔ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ yɛ nitsumɔ kɛ anɔkwale mli hu. Wɔnaa ekãa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ

english_verse: When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Ni no wɔkɛaale akɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli wɔjɛ, ni wɔɔtsɛ wɔtsui wɔŋmɛ wɔmli yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.

english_verse: But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.
translation_verse: Kɛji wɔtsui buɔ wɔ fɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ da fe wɔtsui, ni ele nii fiaa.

english_verse: Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him.
translation_verse: Kɛji wɔtsui ebuuu wɔ fɔ lɛ, wɔnaa ekaã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.

english_verse: He will give us whatever we ask, because we obey him and do what pleases him.
translation_verse: Ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wɔbaa lɛ lɛ, wɔnaa yɛ edɛŋ, ejaakɛ wɔyeɔ ekitãi lɛ anɔ, ni wɔfeɔ nii ni sa ehiɛ.

english_verse: God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do.
translation_verse: Ni enɛ ji ekitã lɛ, akɛ wɔhe eBi Yesu Kristo gbɛi lɛ nɔ wɔye, ni wɔsumɔsumɔɔ wɔhe, tamɔ bɔ ni ewo wɔ kitã lɛ.

english_verse: If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
translation_verse: Ni mɔ ni yeɔ ekitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ hiɔ emli, ni lɛ hu ehiɔ emli; ni nɔ ni wɔkɛleɔ akɛ ehiɔ wɔmli ji Mumɔ ni ekɛhã wɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world,
translation_verse: Suɔmɔmɛi, nyɛkahea mumɔ fɛɛ mumɔ nyɛyea; shi moŋ nyɛkaa mumɔi lɛ nyɛkwɛa akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli amɛjɛ lo, ejaakɛ amalegbalɔi pii eba je lɛ mli.

english_verse: and you can know which ones come from God. His Spirit says that Jesus Christ had a truly human body.
translation_verse: Enɛ nyɛkɛaayoo Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ. Mumɔ fɛɛ mumɔ ni jajeɔ faŋŋ akɛ Yesu Kristo eba yɛ heloo mli lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ mli ejɛ.

english_verse: But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.
translation_verse: Ni mumɔ fɛɛ mumɔ ni ejajeee akɛ Yesu Kristo eba yɛ heloo mli lɛ, jeee Nyɔŋmɔ mli ejɛ, shi moŋ no ji Kristo henyɛlɔ lɛ mumɔ lɛ ni nyɛnu ehe akɛ eeba, ni agbɛnɛ tete eyɛ je lɛ mli momo lɛ.

english_verse: Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world.
translation_verse: Mibii bibii, nyɛ lɛ nyɛjɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli ni nyɛye amalegbalɔi lɛ anɔ kunim; ejaakɛ Mumɔ ni yɔɔ nyɛmli lɛ da fe mumɔ ni yɔɔ je lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: These enemies belong to this world, and the world listens to them, because they speak its language.
translation_verse: Amɛ lɛ, je lɛ mli amɛjɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, amɛwieɔ akɛ mɛi ni jɛ je lɛ mli, ni je lɛ boɔ amɛ toi.

english_verse: We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
translation_verse: Wɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ mli wɔjɛ; mɔ ni le Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eboɔ wɔ toi mɔ ni jɛɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli lɛ, ebooo wɔ toi. No wɔkɛyoɔ anɔkwale mumɔ lɛ kɛ shishiumɔ mumɔ lɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, suɔmɔ ji lɛ

english_verse: My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him.
translation_verse: Suɔmɔmɛi, nyɛhãa wɔsumɔsumɔa wɔhe; ejaakɛ suɔmɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli ejɛ. Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ mɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ lɛ ni ele Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni sumɔɔɔ mɔ lɛ, eleee Nyɔŋmɔ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, suɔmɔ ji lɛ.

english_verse: God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life.
translation_verse: Enɛ mli Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ ni ekɛsumɔɔ wɔ lɛ jeɔ kpo yɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eBi koome lɛ kɛba je lɛ mli, koni wɔtsɔ̃ enɔ wɔna wala.

english_verse: Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Enɛ mli suɔmɔ lɛ yɔɔ, jeee akɛ wɔ ni wɔsumɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, shi moŋ lɛ ni esumɔ wɔ, ni etsu eBi lɛ akɛ ebafee wɔhe eshai lɛ ahe kpãtãmɔnɔ.

english_verse: Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
translation_verse: Suɔmɔmɛi, kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔ wɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, esa akɛ wɔ hu wɔsumɔsumɔɔ wɔhe.

english_verse: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mɔ ko enako lɛ pɛŋ. Kɛji wɔsumɔɔ wɔhe lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hiɔ wɔmli, ni esuɔmɔ lɛ yeɔ emuu yɛ wɔmli.

english_verse: God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us.
translation_verse: Nɔ ni wɔkɛleɔ akɛ wɔhiɔ emli ni lɛ hu ehiɔ wɔmli ji akɛ ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eMumɔ lɛ eko ehã wɔ.

english_verse: God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him.
translation_verse: Ni wɔ lɛ wɔna ni wɔmiiye odase akɛ Tsɛ lɛ etsu eBi lɛ akɛ je lɛ yiwalaherelɔ.

english_verse: God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jajeɔ faŋŋ akɛ Yesu ji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hiɔ emli, ni lɛ hu ehiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mli.

english_verse: and are sure God loves us. God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us.
translation_verse: Ni wɔ lɛ wɔ́le, ni wɔ́he suɔmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛsumɔɔ wɔ lɛ wɔye. Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, suɔmɔ ji lɛ, ni mɔ ni hiɔ suɔmɔ mli lɛ, ehiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mli, ni Nyɔŋmɔ hu hiɔ emli.

english_verse: If we truly love others and live as Christ did in this world, we won't be worried about the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Enɛ mli suɔmɔ lɛ eye emuu yɛ, yɛ wɔmli akɛ wɔɔna ekãa yɛ Kojomɔ Gbi lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ, nakai wɔ hu wɔyɔɔ yɛ je nɛɛ mli.

english_verse: A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
translation_verse: Gbeyeishemɔ bɛ suɔmɔ mli, shi moŋ suɔmɔ ni eye emuu lɛ shwieɔ gbeyeishemɔ, ejaakɛ gbyeishemɔ mli yɛ piŋmɔ; ni mɔ ni sheɔ gbeyei lɛ, enako eye emuu yɛ suɔmɔ mli.

english_verse: We love because God loved us first.
translation_verse: Wɔsumɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, ejaakɛ lɛ tsutsu esumɔ wɔ.

english_verse: But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see?
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ko kɛɛ akɛ, “Miisumɔ Nyɔŋmɔ,” ni enyɛɔ enyɛmi lɛ, amalelɔ ji lɛ. Ejaakɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔɔ enyɛmi ni enaa lɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ni enaaa lɛ lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni eeenyɛ lɛ esumɔ hu?

english_verse: The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
translation_verse: Ni nɛkɛ kitã nɛɛ wɔna kɛjɛ eŋɔɔ, koni mɔ ni sumɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ asumɔ enyɛmi hu.

english_verse: If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ akɛ Yesu ji Kristo lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ lɛ. Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ mɔ ni fɔ lɛ lɛ, esumɔɔ mɔ ni efɔ lɛ hu. Yesu Kristo he odaseyeli

english_verse: If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children.
translation_verse: Kɛji wɔsumɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ni wɔyeɔ ekitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ, no wɔkɛleɔ akɛ wɔsumɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bii lɛ.

english_verse: We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ enɛ ji suɔmɔ ni wɔkɛsumɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ akɛ wɔye ekitãi lɛ anɔ; ni ekitãi lɛ waaa,

english_verse: Every child of God can defeat the world, and our faith is what gives us this victory.
translation_verse: ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ lɛ, eyeɔ je lɛ nɔ kunim; ni kunim ni wɔye je lɛ nɔ ji wɔhemɔkɛyeli.

english_verse: No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God. Who Jesus Is
translation_verse: Ni namɔ ji mɔ ni yeɔ je lɛ nɔ kunim lɛ, akɛ ja mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ akɛ Yesu ji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ?

english_verse: Water and blood came out from the side of Jesus Christ. It wasn't just water, but water and blood. The Spirit tells about this, because the Spirit is truthful.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo ji mɔ ni tsɔ̃ nu kɛ lá mli kɛba, jeee nu kɛkɛ mli, shi moŋ nu kɛ lá mli. Ni Mumɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni yeɔ odase lɛ, ejaakɛ Mumɔ lɛ ji anɔkwale lɛ.

english_verse: In fact, there are three who tell about it.
translation_verse: Shi mɛi etɛ̃ ji mɛi ni yeɔ odase lɛ, ejaakɛ Mumɔ lɛ ji anɔkwale lɛ.

english_verse: They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.
translation_verse: Mumɔ lɛ kɛ nu lɛ kɛ lá lɛ, ni mɛi etɛ̃ nɛɛ feɔ ekome.

english_verse: We believe what people tell us. But we can trust what God says even more, and God is the one who has spoken about his Son.
translation_verse: Kɛji wɔhe gbɔmɛi odase lɛ wɔye lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ odase lɛ da fe no; ni Nyɔŋmɔ odase lɛ ji akɛ eye odase yɛ eBi lɛ he.

english_verse: If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni heɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ eyeɔ lɛ, eyɛ odase yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli, mɔ ni heee Nyɔŋmɔ eyeee lɛ, ehã Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ amalelɔ, ejaakɛ eheko odase ni Nyɔŋmɔ ye yɛ eBi lɛ he lɛ eyeko.

english_verse: God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son.
translation_verse: Ni enɛ ji odase lɛ, akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ naanɔ wala ehã wɔ, ni nɛkɛ wala nɛɛ yɛ eBi lɛ mli.

english_verse: And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life. Knowing about Eternal Life
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yɔɔ Bi lɛ, eyɛ wala; mɔ ni bɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, ebɛ wala hu. Naanɔ wala

english_verse: All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life.
translation_verse: Miiŋma nyɛ nii nɛɛ, koni nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ gbɛi lɛ nɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ, nyɛna nyɛle akɛ nyɛyɛ naanɔ wala.

english_verse: We are certain God will hear our prayers when we ask for what pleases him.
translation_verse: Ni ekãa ni wɔyɔɔ yɛ ehiɛ lɛ ji akɛ, kɛji wɔba nɔ ko yɛ esuɔmɔ naa lɛ, eboɔ wɔ toi.

english_verse: And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.
translation_verse: Ni kɛji wɔle akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wɔbaa lɛ lɛ, eboɔ wɔ toi lɛ, belɛ wɔle akɛ nii ni wɔba lɛ lɛ, wɔnine eshɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Suppose you see one of our people commit a sin that isn't a deadly sin. You can pray, and this person will be given eternal life. But the sin must not be one that is deadly.
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ko na enyɛmi miifee esha ni jeee esha ni kɛ mɔ yaa gbele mli lɛ, eba Nyɔŋmɔ, ni eeehã lɛ wala, no ji mɛi ni feɔ esha ni jeee esha ni kɛ mɔ yaa gbele mli lɛ. Esha ko yɛ ni kɛ mɔ yaa gbele mli; jeee enɛ hewɔ mikɛɔ akɛ eba Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: Everything that is wrong is sin, but not all sins are deadly.
translation_verse: Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ejaaa gbɛ lɛ esha ni, shi esha ko yɛ ni kɛ mɔ eyaaa gbele mli.

english_verse: We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
translation_verse: Wɔle akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ lɛ lɛ, efeee esha; shi moŋ mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ lɛ lɛ, ekwɛɔ ehe nɔ, ni mɔ fɔŋ lɛ etaaa ehe.

english_verse: We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Wɔle akɛ wɔjɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli, ni jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ efɔŋ nɔyeli shishi.

english_verse: We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
translation_verse: Wɔle akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ eba, ni ehã wɔ jwɛŋmɔ koni wɔle anɔkwafo lɛ. Ni wɔyɛ anɔkwafo lɛ mli, yɛ eBi Yesu Kristo lɛ mli, mɔ ni ji anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ naanɔ wala lɛ.

english_verse: Children, you must stay away from idols.
translation_verse: Mibii bibii, nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe ni ahĩa yɛ wɔji ahe.

english_verse: From the church leader. To a very special woman and her children. I truly love all of you, and so does everyone else who knows the truth.
translation_verse: Onukpa lɛ ŋma yahã Awula ni ahala lɛ kɛ ebii lɛ, mɛi ni misumɔɔ yɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ, ni jeee mi kome kɛkɛ, shi mɛi fɛɛ hu ni le anɔkwale lɛ

english_verse: We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
translation_verse: yɛ anɔkwale ni hiɔ wɔmli ni ekɛ wɔ aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love. Truth and Love
translation_verse: Dromɔ, mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo, Tsɛ lɛ Bi lɛ, dɛŋ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi yɛ anɔkwale suɔmɔ mli! Anɔkwale kɛ suɔmɔ

english_verse: I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do.
translation_verse: Mina miishɛɛ babaoo akɛ mina obii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi nyiɛ yɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ wo wɔ kitã lɛ.

english_verse: Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do.
translation_verse: Ni agbɛnɛ miikpa bo fai, Awula, jeee akɛ belɛ miiŋma bo kitã hee ko, shi moŋ nɔ ni wɔyɔɔ kɛje shishijee lɛ, akɛ wɔsumɔsumɔɔ wɔhe.

english_verse: Love means we do what God tells us. And from the beginning, he told you to love him.
translation_verse: Ni suɔmɔ lɛ ji akɛ wɔnyiɛ yɛ ekitãi lɛ anaa; kitã lɛ ji akɛ, bɔ ni nyɛnu kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ, nyɛba nyɛjeŋ nakai.

english_verse: Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ shishiulɔi pii eba je lɛ mli, mɛi ni ejajeee akɛ Yesu Kristo eba yɛ heloo mli. Mɔ nɛ ji shishiulɔ lɛ kɛ Kristo henyɛlɔ lɛ.

english_verse: So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward.
translation_verse: Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe jogbaŋŋ koni nyɛkalaaje nii ni nyɛkɛ nitsumɔ ena lɛ, shi moŋ nyɛna nyɔmɔwoo muu.

english_verse: Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you.
translation_verse: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tekeɔ Kristo tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ ni ehiii mli lɛ, ebɛ Nyɔŋmɔ; mɔ ni hiɔ Kristo tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ, eyɛ Tsɛ lɛ kɛ Bi lɛ.

english_verse: If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them.
translation_verse: Kɛ mɔ ko ba nyɛŋɔɔ ni ehiɛɛɛ nɛkɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkaherea lɛ kɛbaa nyɛwe, ni nyɛkafalaa lɛ tete;

english_verse: Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds. Final Greetings
translation_verse: ejaakɛ mɔ ni fala lɛ lɛ, ekɛ lɛ feɔ ekome yɛ enitsumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ amli. Naagbee wiemɔi

english_verse: I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
translation_verse: Kulɛ miyɛ nibii pii ni maŋma nyɛ, shi misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ mikɛ wolo kɛ “blɛgi” ŋmaa, shi moŋ mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ maba nyɛŋɔɔ ni mikɛ nyɛ abawie hiɛ kɛ hiɛ, koni wɔmiishɛɛ lɛ ayi obɔ̃.

english_verse: Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
translation_verse: Onyɛmi yoo ni ahala lɛ bii lɛ miibi bo.

english_verse: From the church leader. To my dear friend Gaius. I love you because we follow the truth,
translation_verse: Onukpa lɛ ŋma yahã suɔlɔ Gaio, mɔ ni misumɔɔ yɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ.

english_verse: dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit.
translation_verse: Suɔlɔ, miikpa fai akɛ oshwere yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli ni ohi hewalɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni osusuma shwereɔ lɛ.

english_verse: It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mina miishɛɛ babaoo be ni nyɛmimɛi komɛi ba ni amɛbaye onɔkwale lɛ he odase, bɔ ni onyiɛɔ yɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli lɛ.

english_verse: Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth. Working Together
translation_verse: Mibɛ miishɛɛ ko ni da fe enɛ akɛ manu akɛ mibii lɛ nyiɛɔ yɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli lɛ. Gaio

english_verse: Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before.
translation_verse: Suɔlɔ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni otsuɔ ohãa nyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔkwale mli ofeɔ yɛ, tsɛbelɛ gbɔi ji amɛ.

english_verse: They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve.
translation_verse: Amɛ amɛbaye osuɔmɔ lɛ he odase yɛ asafo lɛ hiɛ; ni kɛ ooowo amɛ gbɛ bɔ ni sa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ, ooofee jogbaŋŋ.

english_verse: When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Kristo gbɛi lɛ hewɔ amɛtee, ni amɛheee nɔ ko yɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ adɛŋ.

english_verse: We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, esa akɛ wɔhereɔ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ atuu, koni wɔtsɔ̃mɔ anɔkwale lɛ he nanemɛi nitsulɔi. Diotrefe kɛ Demetrio

english_verse: I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us.
translation_verse: Miŋma wolo ko mimaje asafo lɛ, shi Diotrefe mɔ ni taoɔ amɛnɔ onukpa aye lɛ hereee wɔ.

english_verse: So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ miba lɛ mahã nyɛle enifɔɔji anii ni efeɔ lɛ, bɔ ni ewieɔ wɔhe wiemɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ, ni enɛɛmɛi tete hu faaa hãaa lɛ, shi moŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehereee nyɛmimɛi lɛ, ni asaŋ mɛi ni sumɔɔ akɛ amɛaafee nakai lɛ etsĩɔ amɛ gbɛ, ni eshwieɔ amɛ kɛjɛɔ asafo lɛ mli.

english_verse: Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
translation_verse: Suɔlɔ, kaakase nɔ ni ji efɔŋ, shi kasemɔ nɔ ni ji ekpakpa moŋ. Mɔ ni feɔ ekpakpa lɛ, ejɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli; mɔ ni feɔ efɔŋ lɛ, enako Nyɔŋmɔ.

english_verse: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Demetrio lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ miiye ehe odase, ni anɔkwale diɛŋtsɛ miiye ehe odase, ni wɔ hu wɔmiiye ehe odase, ni ole akɛ wɔdase lɛ anɔkwa ni. Naagbee ŋamɔi

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink.
translation_verse: Kulɛ miyɛ nibii pii ni maŋma bo, shi misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ mikɛ “blɛgi” kɛ niŋmaatso ŋmaa bo;

english_verse: I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
translation_verse: shi moŋ mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ eshwɛ fioo kɛkɛ ni mana bo, ni wɔɔwie hiɛ kɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless you with peace! Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.
translation_verse: Hejɔlɛ ahã bo! Wɔshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ miibi bo. Tsɛ wɔshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ agbɛii ekomekome ni oŋa amɛ.

english_verse: From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James. To all who are chosen and loved by God the Father and are kept safe by Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Yuda, ni ji Yesu Kristo tsulɔ kɛ Yakobo nyɛmi lɛ; ŋma yahã mɛi ni atsɛ amɛ ni afee amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mli ni akɛ amɛ eto ahã Yesu Kristo lɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God will greatly bless you with mercy, peace, and love! False Teachers
translation_verse: Mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ kɛ suɔmɔ afa kɛya nɔ ahã nyɛ! Amaletsɔ̃ɔlɔi

english_verse: My dear friends, I really wanted to write you about God's saving power at work in our lives. But instead, I must write and ask you to defend the faith that God has once for all given to his people.
translation_verse: Suɔmɔmɛi, be ni misaa mihe kɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ diɛŋtsɛ akɛ maŋma nyɛ yɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔyiwalaheremɔ lɛ he sane he lɛ, mina akɛ ehe ehia akɛ maŋma ni mikɛwo nyɛ ekãa, koni nyɛpele hemɔkɛyeli ni atu awo krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ adɛŋ shi kome lɛ he.

english_verse: Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ gbɔmɛi komɛi eju shi ebabote wɔteŋ, mɛi ni blema beebe ajɛ aŋma amɛhe sane afɔ̃ shi ahã nɛkɛ kojomɔ nɛɛ, mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei ni ŋɔɔ wɔNyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ amɛbɔɔ nyɛnyɛŋtswi, ni amɛkwaa Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji nɔyelɔ koome lɛ kɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ.

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to those people the Lord rescued from Egypt. Some of them did not have faith, and he later destroyed them.
translation_verse: Shi miitao akɛ makai nyɛ, nyɛ ni nyɛle enɛ fɛɛ momo lɛ, akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ here maŋ lɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt, shi no sɛɛ lɛ ekpãtã mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment.
translation_verse: Ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi hu ni ehiɛɛɛ amɛnukpayeli lɛ mli, shi moŋ amɛshi amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshihilɛhe lɛ, ekɛ naanɔ kpãi efimɔ amɛ eto duŋ kpii mli ehã Gbi Wulu lɛ nɔ kojomɔ lɛ.

english_verse: We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.
translation_verse: Kaimɔ bɔ ni Sodom kɛ Gomora kɛ maji ni jwere amɛhe lɛ, bɔ ni amɛbɔ ajwamãŋ aahu tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi nɛɛ nɔŋŋ ni amɛtao ni amɛkɛ bɔfoi lɛ afee efɔŋ lɛ. Enɛ fɛɛ kã shi akɛ okadii hã mɛi fɛɛ ni naa naanɔ la mli nyɔmɔwoo lɛ.

english_verse: The people I am talking about are behaving just like those dreamers who destroyed their own bodies. They reject all authority and insult angels.
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ mɛi ni ju shi bote mli lɛ hu buleɔ heloo lɛ yɛ amɛlamɔi amli, ni amɛbuuu nɔyeli, ni amɛwieɔ anunyamtsɛmɛi ahe wiemɔi fɔ̃ji.

english_verse: Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
translation_verse: Shi bɔfonukpa Mikael lɛ, be ni ekɛ abonsam yiyiɔ ni ekɛ lɛ taa naa yɛ Mose gbonyo lɛ he lɛ, ekaaa akɛ eeebu lɛ fɔ ko, shi moŋ ekɛɛ, “Kã Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaakã ohiɛ!”

english_verse: But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings.
translation_verse: Shi mɛnɛɛmɛi lɛ, amɛ lɛ nii fɛɛ ni amɛleee lɛ amɛyeɔ he osheku, shi nii ni amɛle yɛ amɛfɔmɔ su lɛ naa tamɔ kooloi ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, nomɛi nɔŋŋ amɛkɛfiteɔ amɛhe.

english_verse: Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Kpoo hã amɛ! Ejaakɛ amɛkɔ Kain gbɛ lɛ, ni amɛkɔ shishiumɔ amɛfɔ̃ amɛnɔ tamɔ Bileam yɛ sɛɛnamɔ hewɔ, ni amɛhiɛ ekpãtã yɛ atuatsemɔ mli tamɔ Kora.

english_verse: These people are filthy minded, and by their shameful and selfish actions they spoil the meals you eat together. They are like clouds blown along by the wind, but never bringing any rain. They are like leafless trees, uprooted and dead, and unable to produce fruit.
translation_verse: Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi ni woɔ nyɛsuɔmɔ niyenii lɛ ahe muji, ejaakɛ amɛkɛ nyɛ yeɔ nii ni amɛsheee gbeyei. Ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe amɛlɛlɛɔ. Atatui ni nu bɛ amɛmli ni kɔɔyɔɔ kpalaa amɛ kɛbɔleɔ shi ji amɛ. Tsei ni yibiiwoo be mli lɛ amɛwooo yibii, shi amɛgboi shii enyɔ ni afãmɔ amɛ kɛ amɛshishifãi.

english_verse: Their shameful deeds show up like foam on wild ocean waves. They are like wandering stars forever doomed to the darkest pits of hell.
translation_verse: Ŋshɔkei hu ni yɔɔ hamahama ni fɛ̃ɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhiɛgbejianii kɛbaa ŋwɛi tamɔ afũi ji amɛ. Amɛtamɔ ŋulamii dudulɔi, ni asaa duŋ kpii lɛ ato amɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said: Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels
translation_verse: Mɛnɛɛmɛi ahe ni Henok ni ba yɛ yinɔ ni ji kpawo mli kɛjɛ Adam nɔ lɛ gba yɛ akɛ, “Naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ miiba kɛ ekrɔŋkrɔŋbii akpei nyɔŋmanyɔŋmai abɔ

english_verse: to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
translation_verse: ni ebakojo mɛi fɛɛ, ni ekã mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ fɛɛ yɛ amɛnitsumɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ bɛ mli fɛɛ kɛ wiemɔi ni wawai fɛɛ ni eshafeelɔi Nyɔŋmɔkwalɔi ewie yɛ ehe lɛ he.”

english_verse: These people grumble and complain and live by their own selfish desires. They brag about themselves and flatter others to get what they want. More Warnings
translation_verse: Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji huhuuhu wielɔi kɛ krɔlɔi ni nɔ esaaa amɛhiɛ, ni nyiɛɔ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛkɔnɔi anaa, ni amɛnaabu wieɔ naafuu wiemɔi, ni amɛsumɔɔ mɛi ahiɛsaa yɛ sɛɛnamɔ hewɔ. Kɔkɔbɔi kɛ nitsɔɔmɔi

english_verse: My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Shi suɔmɔmɛi, nyɛ lɛ nyɛkaia wiemɔi ni wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo bɔfoi lɛ ewie eto momo lɛ.

english_verse: They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, “Naagbee be lɛ mli lɛ, hefɛoyelɔi ni nyiɛɔ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛkɔnɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ anaa lɛ aaaba.”

english_verse: And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi ni kɛ mligbalamɔi baa lɛ, mɛi ni nyiɛɔ yɛ heloo naa ni bɛ mumɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray.
translation_verse: Shi suɔmɔmɛi, nyɛ lɛ nyɛtswaa nyɛhe nyɛmaa nyɛhemɔkɛyeli ni he tse jogbaŋŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛsɔlea yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli,

english_verse: And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life.
translation_verse: ni nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe nɔ jogbaŋŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ lɛ mli, ni nyɛkwɛa wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo mɔbɔnalɛ lɛ gbɛ koni nyɛna naanɔ wala.

english_verse: Be helpful to all who may have doubts.
translation_verse: Mɛi ni ji jwɛŋmɔ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔtsɛmɛi lɛ, nyɛnaa amɛ mɔbɔ;

english_verse: Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds. Final Prayer
translation_verse: mɛi komɛi hu nyɛshaa amɛ kɛjɛa la lɛ mli kɛherea amɛyiwala; mɛi komɛi hu nyɛkɛ hegbeyeishemɔ anaa amɛ mɔbɔ, ni nyɛhĩa amɛtaade ni amɛkɛ heloo jeŋba ewo he muji lɛ tete. Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ

english_verse: Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
translation_verse: Nyɔŋmɔ koome ni ji wɔyiwalaherelɔ kɛtsɔ̃ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ lɛ, lɛ aŋɔ anunyam kɛ agbojee kɛ hewalɛ kɛ hegbɛ ahã kɛjɛ naanɔ agbɛnɛ kɛ naanɔ fɛɛ. Amen!

english_verse: This is what God showed to Jesus Christ, so that he could tell his servants what must happen soon. Christ then sent his angel with the message to his servant John.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo kpojiemɔ ní Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã lɛ ni ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ etsuji nii ní sa akɛ aba mli nɔŋŋ ní ekɛtsu ebɔfo lɛ ni ehã etsulɔ, Yohane le lɛ.

english_verse: And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.
translation_verse: Yohane ye Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ kɛ Yesu Kristo odase lɛ he odase, yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni ena lɛ he.

english_verse: God will bless everyone who reads this prophecy to others, and he will bless everyone who hears and obeys it. The time is almost here.
translation_verse: Ajɔɔ mɔ ni kaneɔ gbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni nuɔ lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ nibii ni aŋma yɛ mli lɛ anɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ be lɛ eshɛ etã. Yohane miiŋa asafoi kpawo lɛ

english_verse: From John to the seven churches in Asia. I pray that you will be blessed with kindness and peace from God, who is and was and is coming. May you receive kindness and peace from the seven spirits before the throne of God.
translation_verse: Yohane ŋma yahã asafoi kpawo ni yɔɔ Asia lɛ. Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ, kɛjɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni yɛ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni baaba lɛ dɛŋ; kɛ mumɔi kpawo ni yɔɔ emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ;

english_verse: May kindness and peace be yours from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness. Jesus was the first to conquer death, and he is the ruler of all earthly kings. Christ loves us, and by his blood he set us free from our sins.
translation_verse: kɛ Yesu Kristo ni ji odasefonyo anɔkwafo lɛ, gbohii ateŋ kromɔbi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ anɔyelɔ lɛ dɛŋ. Esumɔɔ wɔ, ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ elá etsuu wɔhe kɛjɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ amli,

english_verse: He lets us rule as kings and serve God his Father as priests. To him be glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: ni ekɛ wɔ efee maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ osɔfoi ehã eTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ aŋɔ anunyam kɛ hewalɛ ahã kɛyashi naanɔi anaanɔ. Amen!

english_verse: Look! He is coming with the clouds. Everyone will see him, even the ones who stuck a sword through him. All people on earth will weep because of him. Yes, it will happen! Amen.
translation_verse: Naa, eeba kɛ atatui lɛ, ni hiŋmɛi fɛɛ hiŋmɛi aaana lɛ kɛ mɛi ni tsulɔ lɛ nii lɛ hu. Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akutsei lɛ fɛɛ aaawo yara yɛ ehewɔ. Aba mli nakai. Amen!

english_verse: The Lord God says, “I am Alpha and Omega, the one who is and was and is coming. I am God All-Powerful!” A Vision of the Risen Lord
translation_verse: “Mi ji Alfa kɛ Omega lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni ji mɔ ni yɔɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni yɛ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni baaba lɛ,” Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ kɛɛ. Yohane na Yesu yɛ ninaa mli

english_verse: I am John, a follower together with all of you. We suffer because Jesus is our king, but he gives us the strength to endure. I was sent to Patmos Island, because I had preached God's message and had told about Jesus.
translation_verse: Mi Yohane ni ji nyɛnyɛmi kɛ nyɛnaanyo yɛ Yesu Kristo amanehulu lɛ kɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ kɛ ehiɛmiamɔ lɛ mli lɛ. Miyɛ ŋshɔkpɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Patmo lɛ nɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ kɛ Yesu Kristo he odaseyeli lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and behind me I heard a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet.
translation_verse: Miyɛ mumɔ mli yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbi lɛ nɔ, ni minu gbee kpeteŋkple ko gbɛɛmɔ yɛ misɛɛ tamɔ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ

english_verse: The voice said, “Write in a book what you see. Then send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
translation_verse: ni kɛɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni onaa lɛ; ŋmaa owo wolo mli, ni okɛmaje asafoi kpawo lɛ: Efeso kɛ Smirna kɛ Pergamo kɛ Tiatira kɛ Sarde kɛ Filadelfia kɛ Laodikea.”

english_verse: When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands.
translation_verse: Ni mitsɔ̃ mihe koni makwɛ mɔ gbee ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ. Ni be ni mitsɔ̃ mihe lɛ, mina shika kanetsei kpawo,

english_verse: There with the lampstands was someone who seemed to be the Son of Man. He was wearing a robe that reached down to his feet, and a gold cloth was wrapped around his chest.
translation_verse: kɛ mɔ ko yɛ kanetsei lɛ ateŋ ni tamɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi, ni ewo atade yuu ni ekɛ shika kpãa efi etsitsi.

english_verse: His head and his hair were white as wool or snow, and his eyes looked like flames of fire.
translation_verse: Eyitso kɛ eyitsɔi yɛɔ tamɔ toohetsɔi yɛŋ, tamɔ snoo, ni ehiŋmɛii tamɔ lalilɛi,

english_verse: His feet were glowing like bronze being heated in a furnace, and his voice sounded like the roar of a waterfall.
translation_verse: ni enaji tamɔ ayawa kaŋkaŋ ni atsuu he yɛ flɔnɔɔ mli, ni egbee tamɔ nui babaoo gbɛɛmɔ.

english_verse: He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp double-edged sword was coming from his mouth. His face was shining as bright as the sun at noon.
translation_verse: Ehiɛ ŋulamii kpawo yɛ eninejurɔ, ni tsi kɛ enaa nta ni naa ba jɛ edaaŋ, ni ehiɛ tamɔ hulu ni miitso kɛ ehewalɛ fɛɛ.

english_verse: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said: Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last,
translation_verse: Ni be ni mina lɛ lɛ, migbee shi yɛ enaji anaa tamɔ gbonyo; ni ekɛ eninejurɔ ŋmɛ minɔ, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei; mi ji klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ kɛ naagbee mɔ lɛ

english_verse: and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead.
translation_verse: kɛ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ. Migbo, ni naa, mihiɛ kã kɛmiiya naanɔi anaanɔ, ni mihiɛ gbele kɛ gbohiiaje naa samfei lɛ.

english_verse: Write what you have seen and what is and what will happen after these things.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, ŋmaa nii ni ona lɛ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ kɛ nii ni baaba yɛ nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.
translation_verse: Ŋulamii kpawo ni ona yɛ mininejurɔ lɛ kɛ shika kanetsei kpawo lɛ ahe teemɔ sane lɛ nɛ: ‘Ŋulamii kpawo lɛ ji asafoi kpawo lɛ abɔfoi, ni kanetsei kpawo lɛ ji asafoi kpawo lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Ephesus: I am the one who holds the seven stars in my right hand, and I walk among the seven gold lampstands. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Efeso asafo lɛ bɔfo lɛ; ŋmaa oyaha lɛ akɛ, ‘Nii ni mɔ ni hiɛ ŋulamii kpawo lɛ yɛ eninejurɔ ni enyiɛɔ shika kanetsei kpawo lɛ ateŋ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I know everything you have done, including your hard work and how you have endured. I know you won't put up with anyone who is evil. When some people pretended to be apostles, you tested them and found out they were liars.
translation_verse: Mile onitsumɔi lɛ kɛ odeŋmegbomɔ lɛ kɛ ohiɛmiamɔ lɛ, kɛ bɔ ni okpɛ̃lɛɛɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ; mile akɛ oka mɛi ni kɛɔ akɛ bɔfoi ji amɛ shi amɛjeee bɔfoi lɛ ni ona akɛ amalelɔi ji amɛ.

english_verse: You have endured and gone through hard times because of me, yet you have not given up.
translation_verse: Ni ohiɛ mli, ni oŋmɛɔ otsui shi yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ, ni etɔko bo.

english_verse: But I do have something against you! And it is this: You don't have as much love as you used to.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ mikɛ bo yɛ sane, no ji akɛ, oŋmɛɛ otsutsu suɔmɔ lɛ he.

english_verse: Think about where you have fallen from, and then turn back and do as you did at first. If you don't turn back, I will come and take away your lampstand.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, kaimɔ he ni ojɛ ogbee shi lɛ, ni otsake otsui, ni otsu tsutsu nitsumɔi lɛ. Shi kɛ jeee nakai lɛ, maba onɔ oya ni matsi okanetso lɛ kɛaajɛ egbɛhe lɛ, belɛ ja oshwa ohe.

english_verse: But there is one thing you are doing right. You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, and so do I.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ oyɛ nɔ ko, ni no ji akɛ onyɛɔ Nikolaimɛi lɛ anitsumɔi lɛ ni mi hu minyɛɔ lɛ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let everyone who wins the victory eat from the life-giving tree in God's wonderful garden. The Letter to Smyrna
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛ nuɔ nii lɛ, enu nɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ asafoi lɛ. Mɔ ni yeɔ kunim lɛ, mahã lɛ hegbɛ ni eye walatso lɛ ni yɔɔ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ Paradeiso lɛ mli lɛ nɔ yibii lɛ eko.’ ” Smirna asafo lɛ

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Smyrna: I am the first and the last. I died, but now I am alive! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Ni Smirna asafo lɛ bɔfo lɛ; ŋmaa oyahã lɛ akɛ, ‘Nii ni klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ kɛ naagbee mɔ lɛ, mɔ ni gbo ni ehiɛ kã ekoŋŋ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ:

english_verse: I know how much you suffer and how poor you are, but you are rich. I also know the cruel things being said about you by people who claim to be God's people. But they are not really God's people. They are a group that belongs to Satan.
translation_verse: Mile omanehulu lɛ kɛ ohia lɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ niiatsɛ ji bo, ni mile mɛi ni kɛ oshekuyeli kɛɔ akɛ Yudafoi ji amɛ, yɛ be mli ni jeee nakai ni, shi moŋ amɛ ji Satan kpeehe lɛ mli bii.

english_verse: Don't worry about what you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into jail, and you will be tested and made to suffer for ten days. But if you are faithful until you die, I will reward you with a glorious life.
translation_verse: Kaashe amanehulu ni obaana lɛ ekoeko gbeyei. Naa, abonsam baaŋɔ nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi awo tsuŋ, koni akɛka nyɛ, ni nyɛaana amanehulu gbii nyɔŋma. Feemɔ anɔkwafo kɛyashi gbele mli, ni mahã bo wala akekre lɛ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death. The Letter to Pergamum
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu nɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ asafoi lɛ. Kunimyelɔ lɛ, gbele ni ji enyɔ lɛ efeŋ lɛ efɔŋ ko.’ ” Pergamo asafo lɛ

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Pergamum: I am the one who has the sharp double-edged sword! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Ni Pergamo asafo lɛ bɔfo lɛ; ŋmaa oyahã lɛ akɛ, Nii ni mɔ ni hiɛ tsi kɛ enaa nta ni naa ba lɛ kɛɛ nɛ:

english_verse: I know you live where Satan has his throne. But you have kept true to my name. Right there where Satan lives, my faithful witness Antipas was taken from you and put to death. Even then you did not give up your faith in me.
translation_verse: Mile he ni oyɔɔ lɛ, he ni Satan maŋtsɛ sɛi yɔɔ lɛ; ni ohiɛ migbɛi lɛ mli, ni okwaaa minɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ be mli ni agbe Antipa, midasefonyo anɔkwafo lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ Satan shihilɛhe lɛ.

english_verse: I do have a few things against you. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam. Long ago he told Balak to teach the people of Israel to eat food that had been offered to idols and to be immoral.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ mikɛ bo yɛ sane fioo yɛ ohe, no ji akɛ oyɛ mɛi yɛ jɛi ni hiɛ Bileam tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli; Bileam ni tsɔ̃ɔ Balak akɛ etsɔ̃ Israelbii lɛ atsɔ̃ne ni amɛye wɔji afɔleshãanii ni amɛbɔ ajwamãŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Now some of you are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
translation_verse: Nakai nɔŋŋ hu oyɔɔ mɛi ni hiɛ Nikolaimɛi atsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: Turn back! If you don't, I will come quickly and fight against these people. And my words will cut like a sword.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, tsakemɔ otsui! Shi kɛji jeee nakai lɛ, maba onɔ oya ni mikɛ amɛ aaabawu kɛ midaaŋ tsi lɛ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To everyone who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden food. I will also give each one a white stone with a new name written on it. No one will know that name except the one who is given the stone. The Letter to Thyatira
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu nɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ asafoi lɛ. Mɔ ni yeɔ kunim lɛ, mahã lɛ mana ni akɛtee lɛ eko, ni mahã lɛ tɛ yɛŋ, ni tɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ aŋma gbɛi hee ni mɔ ko leee akɛ ja mɔ ni náa lɛ.” Tiatira asafo lɛ

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Ni Tiatira asafo lɛ bɔfo lɛ; ŋmaa oyahã lɛ akɛ, “Nii ni Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ ni ehiŋmɛii tamɔ lalilɛi ni enaji tamɔ ayawa kaŋkaŋ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I know everything about you, including your love, your faith, your service, and how you have endured. I know you are doing more now than you have ever done before.
translation_verse: Mile onitsumɔi lɛ kɛ osuɔmɔ lɛ kɛ ohemɔkɛyeli lɛ kɛ osɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ kɛ ohiɛmiamɔ lɛ, ni mile onitsumɔi lɛ akɛ sɛɛkpee nii lɛ fe tsutsunii lɛ tete.

english_verse: But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ mikɛ bo yɛ sane ko, akɛ oŋmɛ yoo Isabel ni tsɛɔ ehe gbalɔ yoo lɛ gbɛ ni etsɔ̃ɔ mitsuji lɛ anii, ni elakaa amɛ ni amɛbɔ ajwamãŋ ni amɛye wɔji afɔleshãanii.

english_verse: I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.
translation_verse: Ni mihã lɛ be koni ekɛtsake etsui, shi esumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ etsake ni efɔ̃ɔ ejwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I am going to strike down Jezebel. Everyone who does these immoral things with her will also be punished, if they don't stop.
translation_verse: Naa, mikɛ lɛ miifɔ̃ hela saa nɔ, ni mikɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ fite gbãlã lɛ hu miiwo amanehulu kpeteŋkple mli, belɛ ja amɛtsake amɛtsui ni amɛshi enitsumɔi lɛ.

english_verse: I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.
translation_verse: Ni ebii lɛ, gbe magbe amɛ; ni asafoi lɛ fɛɛ aaana ale akɛ mi ji mɔ ni taoɔ jwɛŋmɔi kɛ tsuii amli, ni mahã nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ enyɔmɔwo bɔ ni nyɛnitsumɔi lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Some of you in Thyatira don't follow Jezebel's teaching. You don't know anything about what her followers call the “deep secrets of Satan.” So I won't burden you down with any other commands.
translation_verse: “Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ Tiatira lɛ, mɛi abɔ ni ehiɛɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ mli ni amɛleee ‘Satan teemɔŋ nibii ni mli kwɔlɔ’, tamɔ bɔ ni amɛtsɛɔ lɛ lɛ, akɛ, Mikɛ jatsu kroko eŋmɛŋ nyɛnɔ;

english_verse: But until I come, you must hold firmly to the teaching you have.
translation_verse: shi nɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ, nyɛhiɛa mli kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maba.

english_verse: I will give power over the nations to everyone who wins the victory and keeps on obeying me until the end.
translation_verse: Ni kunimyelɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni hiɛɔ minitsumɔi lɛ amli kɛyashiɔ naagbee lɛ, mahã lɛ hegbɛ yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ,

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu nɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ asafoi lɛ.”

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Sardis: I have the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. Listen to what I say. I know what you are doing. Everyone may think you are alive, but you are dead.
translation_verse: “Ni Sarde asafo lɛ bɔfo lɛ; ŋmaa oyahã lɛ akɛ, ‘Nii ni mɔ ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔi kpawo lɛ kɛ ŋulamii kpawo lɛ kɛɛ nɛ: Mile onitsumɔi lɛ; mile akɛ ohiɛ gbɛi akɛ ohiɛ kã, shi ogbo.

english_verse: Wake up! You have only a little strength left, and it is almost gone. So try to become stronger. I have found that you are not completely obeying God.
translation_verse: Ohiɛ atsɛ̃, ni owaje nii ni eshwɛ ni heɔ agboi lɛ. Ejaakɛ minako onitsumɔi lɛ akɛ amɛye emuu yɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: Remember the teaching you were given and heard. Hold firmly to it and turn from your sins. If you don't wake up, I will come when you least expect it, just as a thief does.
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, kaimɔ nɔ ni ona ni onu lɛ, ni oye nɔ, ni otsake otsui. Shi kɛ ohiɛ etsɛ̃ɛɛ lɛ, maba tamɔ julɔ, ni oleŋ nɔ ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɔ ni maba onɔ kwraa.

english_verse: A few of you in Sardis have not dirtied your clothes with sin. You will walk with me in white clothes, because you are worthy.
translation_verse: Shi kɛ̃lɛ oyɛ mɛi fioo ko yɛ Sarde, mɛi ni woko amɛtadei lɛ amuji; ni amɛkɛ mi baanyiɛ yɛ atadei yɛji amli, ejaakɛ amɛsa nakai.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will wear white clothes. Their names will not be erased from the book of life, and I will tell my Father and his angels that they are my followers.
translation_verse: Kunimyelɔ lɛ aaawo lɛ atadei yɛji, ni migbeŋ egbɛi yɛ wala wolo lɛ mli gbi ko gbi ko, ni magba mli matsi egbɛi tã yɛ miTsɛ hiɛ kɛ ebɔfoi lɛ ahiɛ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Philadelphia
translation_verse: “Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu nɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ asafoi lɛ.” Filadelfia asafo lɛ

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: I am the one who is holy and true, and I have the keys that belonged to David. When I open a door, no one can close it. And when I close a door, no one can open it. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Ni Filadelfia asafo lɛ bɔfo lɛ; ŋmaa oyahã lɛ akɛ, “Nii ni mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, anɔkwafo lɛ, mɔ ni hiɛ David samfee lɛ, mɔ ni gbeleɔ ni mɔ ko ŋaaa, ni eŋaa hu ni mɔ ko gbeleee lɛ kɛɛ nɛ,

english_verse: I know everything you have done. And I have placed before you an open door no one can close. You were not very strong, but you obeyed my message and did not deny you are my followers.
translation_verse: Mile onitsumɔi lɛ; naa, mikɛ shinaa ni agbele ema ohiɛ ni mɔ ko nyɛŋ aŋa; ejaakɛ hewalɛ fioo oyɔɔ shi oye miwiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni okwako migbɛi lɛ.

english_verse: Now you will see what I will do with those people who belong to Satan's group. They claim to be God's people, but they are liars. I will make them come and kneel down at your feet. Then they will know that I love you.
translation_verse: Naa, mikɛ mɛi ni jɛ Satan kpeehe lɛ ni kɛɔ akɛ Yudafoi ji amɛ shi ebɛ mli, shi malemɔ moŋ amɛmaleɔ lɛ aaaba ni amɛbakoto onaji anaa, ni amɛle akɛ mi lɛ miisumɔ bo.

english_verse: You obeyed my message and endured. So I will protect you from the time of testing everyone in all the world must go through.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ oye miwiemɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Miamɔ ohiɛ’ lɛ nɔ hewɔ lɛ, mi hu mato bo shweshweeshwe yɛ kaa ŋmɛlɛtswaa ni baaba jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛbaaka mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli.

english_verse: I am coming soon. So hold firmly to what you have, and no one will take away the crown you will be given as your reward.
translation_verse: Naa, miiba nɔŋŋ; hiɛmɔ nɔ ni oyɔɔ lɛ mli ni awa, koni mɔ ko akashɔ̃ okekre lɛ!

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will be made into a pillar in the temple of my God, and they will stay there forever. I will write on each of them the name of my God and the name of his city. It is the new Jerusalem my God will send down from heaven. I will also write on them my own new name.
translation_verse: Kunimyelɔ lɛ, mafee lɛ akulashiŋ yɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, ni ejeŋ kpo dɔŋŋ. Ni maŋma miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi, kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ maŋ ni ji Yerusalɛm hee ni jɛɔ ŋwɛi kpelekeɔ shi kɛjɛɔ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ gbɛi kɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ migbɛi hee lɛ yɛ enɔ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Laodicea
translation_verse: Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu nɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ asafoi lɛ.” Laodikea asafo lɛ

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Laodicea: I am the one called Amen! I am the faithful and true witness and the source of God's creation. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Ni Laodikea asafo lɛ bɔfo lɛ; ŋmaa oyahã lɛ akɛ, “Nii ni Amen lɛ ni ji odasefonyo anɔkwafo lɛ kɛ anɔkwayelɔ lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nibɔɔ lɛ shishijee lɛ kɛɛ nɛ,

english_verse: I know everything you have done, and you are not cold or hot. I wish you were either one or the other.
translation_verse: Mile onitsumɔi lɛ; mile akɛ obɛ ŋanii ni obɛ klakla hu. Mina ni kulɛ ofee ŋanii loo ofee klakla!

english_verse: But since you are lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out of my mouth.
translation_verse: Shi nɛkɛ nɛɛ, akɛni kulɔkulɔ oyɔɔ ni obɛ ŋanii ni obɛ klakla hu hewɔ lɛ, mibafɛ̃ bo yɛ midaaŋ mashwie.

english_verse: You claim to be rich and successful and to have everything you need. But you don't know how bad off you really are. You are pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ okɛɔ akɛ, ‘Niiatsɛ ji mi ni miyɛ nii, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko he ehĩaaa mi.’ Ni oleee akɛ ohao ni onii hu yɛ mɔbɔ ni ohiafo kɛ shwilafo kɛ heyayaitsɛ ji bo.

english_verse: Buy your gold from me. It has been refined in a fire, and it will make you rich. Buy white clothes from me. Wear them and you can cover up your shameful nakedness. Buy medicine for your eyes, so you will be able to see.
translation_verse: Miiwo oŋaa akɛ ohe shika ni atsuu he yɛ la mli yɛ miŋɔɔ koni ona nii, kɛ atadei yɛji, koni owo ni oyayaiaŋ hiɛgbele lɛ akakã jaanɔ; ni ohe hiŋmɛi tsofa ni okɛfɔ ohiŋmɛii anɔ koni ona nii.

english_verse: I correct and punish everyone I love. So make up your minds to turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Mi lɛ, mɛi abɔ ni midɔɔ amɛhe lɛ, mikãa amɛ ni mitsɔseɔ amɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, ohiɛ adɔ ni otsake otsui.

english_verse: Listen! I am standing and knocking at your door. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and we will eat together.
translation_verse: Naa, Midamɔ shinaa lɛ naa ni miishi; kɛji mɔ ko nu migbee ni egbele shinaa lɛ, maba eŋɔɔ ni mikɛ lɛ aaabaye nii, ni lɛ hu ekɛ mi aaaye.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat with my Father on his throne.
translation_verse: Kunimyelɔ lɛ mahã ekɛ mi ata mimaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni mi hu miye kunim ni mikɛ miTsɛ ta emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: “Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu nɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ asafoi lɛ.”

english_verse: After this, I looked and saw a door that opened into heaven. Then the voice that had spoken to me at first and that sounded like a trumpet said, “Come up here! I will show you what must happen next.”
translation_verse: Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ mikwɛ, ni naa, shinaa ko ni agbele yɛ ŋwɛi; ni klɛŋklɛŋ gbee ni minu ni tamɔ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ ni kɛ mi wie lɛ kɛɛ, “Kwɔɔ kɛba biɛ nɛɛ, ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo nii ni sa akɛ aba mli yɛ nii nɛɛ asɛɛ.”

english_verse: Right then the Spirit took control of me, and there in heaven I saw a throne and someone sitting on it.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ lɛ amrɔ lɛ mumɔ lɛ yi minɔ; ni naa, maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i ko ma shi yɛ ŋwɛi, ni mɔ ko ta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: The one who was sitting there sparkled like precious stones of jasper and carnelian. A rainbow that looked like an emerald surrounded the throne.
translation_verse: Ni mɔ ni ta nɔ lɛ, kɛ aakwɛ lɛ lɛ, etamɔ yaspi kɛ sardio, ni kwaabuɛtɛ ebɔle maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ, ni kɛ aakwɛ lɛ, etamɔ smaragdo.

english_verse: Twenty-four other thrones were in a circle around that throne. And on each of these thrones there was an elder dressed in white clothes and wearing a gold crown.
translation_verse: Ni maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ he lɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃ii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ mamɔ shi kɛkpe, ni onukpai nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ tara sɛ̃ii lɛ anɔ; amɛwo atadei yɛji, ni shika akekrei fimɔ amɛyitsei.

english_verse: Flashes of lightning and roars of thunder came out from the throne in the center of the circle. Seven torches, which are the seven spirits of God, were burning in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Ni srawai kɛ gbɛɛmɔi kɛ nyɔŋmɔshimɔi jɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ mli, ni la hai kpawo ni tsoɔ ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔi kpawo lɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: Also in front of the throne was something that looked like a glass sea, clear as crystal. Around the throne in the center were four living creatures covered front and back with eyes.
translation_verse: Ni nɔ ko tamɔ ashwishwɛ ŋshɔ ni tamɔ kristalo yɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ. Ni hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ ni hiŋmɛii eyimɔ amɛhiɛ kɛ amɛsɛɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃ yɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ kɛ ehewɔ.

english_verse: The first creature was like a lion, the second one was like a bull, the third one had the face of a human, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
translation_verse: Klɛŋklɛŋ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ tamɔ jata, ni hiɛkãalɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ tamɔ tsina, ni hiɛkãalɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ hiɛ tamɔ gbɔmɔ, ni hiɛkãalɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ tamɔ okropɔŋ ni miifiliki.

english_verse: Each of the four living creatures had six wings, and their bodies were covered with eyes. Day and night they never stopped singing, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord, the all-powerful God, who was and is and is coming!”
translation_verse: Ni hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ fiji ekpaa, ni amɛhewɔ kɛ amɛmli eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ hiŋmɛii, ni amɛjɔɔɔ amɛhe nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Krɔŋkrɔŋ, krɔŋkrɔŋ, krɔŋkrɔŋ ji Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ, mɔ ni yɛ momo lɛ kɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni baaba lɛ.”

english_verse: The living creatures kept praising, honoring, and thanking the one who sits on the throne and who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ni be ni hiɛkãalɔi lɛ ŋɔɔ anunyam kɛ agbojee kɛ shidaa amɛhãa mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ ni ehiɛ kã kɛyaa naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ,

english_verse: “Our Lord and God, you are worthy to receive glory, honor, and power. You created all things, and by your decision they are and were created.”
translation_verse: “WɔNuŋtsɔ kɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ, osa akɛ oŋɔ anunyam kɛ woo kɛ hewalɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ bo obɔ nii fɛɛ, ni osuɔmɔ naa abɔ amɛ ni amɛyɔɔ wala.”

english_verse: In the right hand of the one sitting on the throne I saw a scroll that had writing on the inside and on the outside. And it was sealed in seven places.
translation_verse: Ni mina wolo ko yɛ mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ ninejurɔ, ni aŋma nii yɛ emli kɛ esɛɛ fɛɛ, ni asɔo naa kɛ naasɔomɔi kpawo.

english_verse: I saw a mighty angel ask with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?”
translation_verse: Ni mina bɔfo hewalɔ ko miishiɛ kɛ gbee wulu akɛ, “Namɔ ji mɔ ni sa akɛ egbele wolo lɛ naa ni etserɛ enaasɔomɔi lɛ?”

english_verse: No one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Ni anãaa mɔ ko mɔ ko yɛ ŋwɛi loo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ loo shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi ni aaanyɛ wolo lɛ naa agbele loo mli akwɛ.

english_verse: I cried hard because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Ni mifo aahu, ejaakɛ anãaa mɔ ko mɔ ko ni sa akɛ egbele wolo lɛ naa loo ekwɛ mli.

english_verse: Then one of the elders said to me, “Stop crying and look! The one who is called both the ‘Lion from the Tribe of Judah’ and ‘King David's Great Descendant’ has won the victory. He will open the scroll and its seven seals.”
translation_verse: Ni onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kaafo! Naa, jata lɛ ni jɛ Yuda akutso lɛ mli lɛ, mɔ ni ji David shishifã lɛ, eye kunim ni ebaanyɛ egbele wolo lɛ naa ní etserɛ enaasɔomɔi kpawo lɛ.”

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a Lamb standing in the center of the throne surrounded by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb looked as if it had once been killed. It had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God, sent out to all the earth.
translation_verse: Ni mikwɛ, ni naa, maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ kɛ hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ teŋ kɛ onukpai nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ teŋ lɛ, Toobi ko damɔ shi tamɔ nɔ ni agbe lɛ, ni eyɛ akloŋtoi kpawo kɛ hiŋmɛii kpawo ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔi kpawo lɛ ni atsu kɛtee shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lamb went over and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who sat on the throne.
translation_verse: Ni eba ni ebahe wolo lɛ yɛ mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ ninejurɔ. Mɛi ni akpɔ̃ amɛ lɛ alala hee

english_verse: Then they sang a new song, “You are worthy to receive the scroll and open its seals, because you were killed. And with your own blood you bought for God people from every tribe, language, nation, and race.
translation_verse: Ni amɛla lala hee ko amɛkɛɛ, “Osa akɛ oheɔ wolo lɛ ni otserɛɔ enaasɔomɔi lɛ, ejaakɛ agbe bo, ni okɛ olá lɛ ekpɔ̃ mɛi ehã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛjɛ akutso fɛɛ akutso kɛ wiemɔ fɛɛ wiemɔ kɛ jeŋmaŋ fɛɛ jeŋmaŋ mli.

english_verse: You let them become kings and serve God as priests, and they will rule on earth.”
translation_verse: Ni okɛ amɛ efee maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ osɔfoi ohã wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni amɛaaye maŋtsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Ŋwɛi asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ lala

english_verse: As I looked, I heard the voices of a large number of angels around the throne and the voices of the living creatures and of the elders. There were millions and millions of them,
translation_verse: Ni mikwɛ, ni minu bɔfoi pii ni ebɔle maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ kɛ hiɛkãalɔi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ kɛkpe lɛ agbee, ni amɛyibɔ huuhai abɔ kɛ akpe toi abɔ

english_verse: and they were saying in a loud voice, “The Lamb who was killed is worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise.”
translation_verse: ni amɛkɛ gbee wulu kɛɛ akɛ, “Toobi ni agbe lɛ sa hewalɛ kɛ nifalɛ kɛ nilee kɛ nyɛmɔ kɛ woo kɛ anunyam kɛ jɔɔmɔ.”

english_verse: Then I heard all beings in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and in the sea offer praise. Together, all of them were saying, “Praise, honor, glory, and strength forever and ever to the one who sits on the throne and to the Lamb!”
translation_verse: Ni minu ni bɔɔnii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi kɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Jɔɔmɔ kɛ woo kɛ anunyam kɛ nɔyeli ahã mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ Toobi lɛ kɛya naanɔi anaanɔ!”

english_verse: The four living creatures said “Amen,” while the elders knelt down and worshiped.
translation_verse: Ni hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ kɛɛ “Amen!” Ni onukpai lɛ ho gbee shi, ni amɛja.

english_verse: At the same time I saw the Lamb open the first of the seven seals, I heard one of the four living creatures shout with a voice like thunder. It said, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Ni mina akɛ Toobi lɛ tse naasɔomɔi kpawo lɛ ekome; ni minu ni hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛ gbee ni tamɔ nyɔŋmɔshimɔ gbee kɛɛ, “Ba!”

english_verse: Then I saw a white horse. Its rider carried a bow and was given a crown. He had already won some victories, and he went out to win more.
translation_verse: Ni mikwɛ, ni naa, okpɔŋɔ yɛŋ, ni mɔ ni ta enɔ lɛ hiɛ gãi, ni ahã lɛ akekre, ni eje kpo tamɔ kunimyelɔ ni miiya eyaye kunim.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Ni be ni etse naasɔomɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ, minu ni hiɛkãalɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Ba!”

english_verse: Then another horse came out. It was fiery red. And its rider was given the power to take away all peace from the earth, so people would slaughter one another. He was also given a big sword.
translation_verse: Ni okpɔŋɔ kroko ni tsuɔ je kpo, ni mɔ ni ta enɔ lɛ, ahã lɛ hegbɛ ni ejie hejɔlɛ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni mɛi agbegbee amɛhe, ni ahã lɛ klante kpeteŋkple ko.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come out!” Then I saw a black horse, and its rider had a balance scale in one hand.
translation_verse: Ni be ni etse naasɔomɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, minu ni hiɛkãalɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ kɛɛ, “Ba!” Ni mikwɛ, ni naa, okpɔŋɔ diŋ ni mɔ ni ta enɔ lɛ hiɛ nsɛni yɛ edɛŋ.

english_verse: I heard what sounded like a voice from somewhere among the four living creatures. It said, “A liter of wheat will cost you a whole day's wages! Three liters of barley will cost you a day's wages too. But don't ruin the olive oil or the wine.”
translation_verse: Ni minu gbee ko yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ ateŋ miikɛɛ, “Ŋmaa susumɔnɔ kome denario, ni abele susumɔnii etɛ̃ denario; ni mu kɛ wain lɛ kaata he!”

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Ni be ni etse naasɔomɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ, minu hiɛkãalɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ gbee miikɛɛ, “Ba!”

english_verse: Then I saw a pale green horse. Its rider was named Death, and Death's Kingdom followed close behind. They were given power over one fourth of the earth, and they could kill its people with swords, famines, diseases, and wild animals.
translation_verse: Ni mikwɛ, ni naa, okpɔŋɔ lamlulamlu ni mɔ ni ta enɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Gbele, ni Gbohiiaje nyiɛ esɛɛ kpaakpa. Ni ahã amɛ hegbɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mlijai ejwɛ mli ekome nɔ, akɛ amɛkɛ klante kɛ hɔ̃mɔ kɛ gbele hela kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi awuyelɔi agbegbee amɛ.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of everyone who had been killed for speaking God's message and telling about their faith.
translation_verse: Ni be ni etse naasɔomɔ ni ji enumɔ lɛ, mina mɛi ni agbe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ kɛ odase ni amɛye lɛ hewɔ lɛ asusumai yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi.

english_verse: They shouted, “Master, you are holy and faithful! How long will it be before you judge and punish the people of this earth who killed us?”
translation_verse: Ni amɛbolɔ kɛ gbee ni wa akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ anɔkwafo, mɛɛ beyinɔ po oookojo ni oootɔ wɔla lɛ he owele yɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ anɔ?”

english_verse: Then each of those who had been killed was given a white robe and told to rest for a little while. They had to wait until the complete number of the Lord's other servants and followers would be killed.
translation_verse: Ni akɛ atade yɛŋ hã amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ, ni akɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛjɔɔ amɛhe be fioo ko lolo, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛnanemɛi tsuji lɛ kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ hu ni abaagbe amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni agbe amɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu lɛ ayikulɛ lɛ aaashɛ.

english_verse: When I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, I looked and saw a great earthquake. The sun turned as dark as sackcloth, and the moon became red as blood.
translation_verse: Ni mina be ni etse naasɔomɔ ni ji ekpaa lɛ, ni naa, shikpɔŋ hoso waa, ni hulu tsɔ ediŋ tamɔ kpekpe ni akɛ yitsɔi fee, ni nyɔɔŋtsere muu lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ lá;

english_verse: The stars in the sky fell to earth, just like figs shaken loose by a windstorm.
translation_verse: ni ŋwɛi ŋulamii lɛ tserɛ shwie shikpɔŋ tamɔ bɔ ni agbãmitso yi agbãmii ŋmilikitii tserɛɔ shwieɔ shi kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ kpeteŋkple hoso agbãmitso lɛ.

english_verse: Then the sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all mountains and islands were moved from their places.
translation_verse: Ni ŋwɛi tsi ehe kɛtee sɛɛ tamɔ wolo ni aakota; ni atsirɛ gɔŋ fɛɛ gɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔkpɔ fɛɛ ŋshɔkpɔ kɛje egbɛhe.

english_verse: The kings of the earth, its famous people, and its military leaders hid in caves or behind rocks on the mountains. They hid there together with the rich and the powerful and with all the slaves and free people.
translation_verse: Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni ji lumɛi lɛ kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ niiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ hewalɔi lɛ kɛ nyɔji fɛɛ kɛ mɛi krokomɛi fɛɛ yateetee amɛhe yɛ bui amli kɛ gɔji atɛsai amli,

english_verse: Then they shouted to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us! Hide us from the one who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb.
translation_verse: ni amɛkɛɛ gɔji lɛ kɛ tɛsai lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbagbea wɔnɔ ni nyɛtea wɔnɔ ni wɔkana mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛ Toobi lɛ mlifu lɛ!

english_verse: That terrible day has come! God and the Lamb will show their anger, and who can face it?”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ emlifu gbi wulu lɛ eshɛ, ni namɔ aaanyɛ shi adamɔ?”

english_verse: “Don't harm the earth or the sea or any tree! Wait until I have marked the foreheads of the servants of our God.”
translation_verse: akɛ, “Nyɛkafea shikpɔŋ lɛ loo ŋshɔ lɛ loo tsei lɛ efɔŋ ko kɛyashi beyinɔ ni wɔkɛ naasɔomɔnɔ aaakadi wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ tsuji lɛ ahiɛŋtsei anɔ dã.”

english_verse: and said, “Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power, and strength belong to our God forever and ever! Amen!”
translation_verse: amɛkɛɛ, “Amen! Jɔɔmɔ kɛ anunyam kɛ nilee kɛ shidaa kɛ woo kɛ hewalɛ kɛ nyɛmɔ ahã wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛya naanɔi anaanɔ. Amen!”

english_verse: After this, I saw a large crowd with more people than could be counted. They were from every race, tribe, nation, and language, and they stood before the throne and before the Lamb. They wore white robes and held palm branches in their hands,
