translation_verse: Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ mikwɛ, ni naa, asafo kpele ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ akane ni jɛ jeŋmaŋ fɛɛ jeŋmaŋ kɛ akutsei kɛ maji kɛ maji anɔ wiemɔi amli damɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ kɛ Toobi lɛ hiɛ, ni amɛwo atadei yɛji, ni amɛhiɛ blɛoi yɛ amɛdɛŋ,

english_verse: as they shouted, “Our God, who sits upon the throne, has the power to save his people, and so does the Lamb.”
translation_verse: ni amɛbolɔ kɛ gbee ni wa amɛkɛɛ, “Yiwalaheremɔ lɛ ji wɔNyɔŋmɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ Toobi lɛ nɔ!”

english_verse: The angels who stood around the throne knelt in front of it with their faces to the ground. The elders and the four living creatures knelt there with them. Then they all worshiped God
translation_verse: Ni bɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ damɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ ahe kɛkpe, ni amɛja Nyɔŋmɔ

english_verse: One of the elders asked me, “Do you know who these people are that are dressed in white robes? Do you know where they come from?”
translation_verse: Ni onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome bi mi akɛ, “Mɛi ni wo atadei yɛji nɛɛ, namɛi ni, ni nɛgbɛ amɛjɛ?”

english_verse: “Sir,” I answered, “you must know.” Then he told me: “These are the ones who have gone through the great suffering. They have washed their robes in the blood of the Lamb and have made them white.
translation_verse: Ni mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, bo ole” Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi ni jɛ amanehulu kpeteŋkple lɛ mli lɛ, ni amɛfɔ amɛtadei lɛ ahe, ni amɛhã eyɛ futaa yɛ Toobi lɛ lá lɛ mli.

english_verse: And so they stand before the throne of God and worship him in his temple day and night. The one who sits on the throne will spread his tent over them.
translation_verse: No hewɔ ni amɛyɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ, ni amɛjaa lɛ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane yɛ eSɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli lɛ; ni mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛsɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ aaashi ebuu lɛ eto amɛnɔ.

english_verse: They will never hunger or thirst again, and they won't be troubled by the sun or any scorching heat.
translation_verse: Hɔ̃mɔ yeŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ, ni kumai hu yeŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ, ni asaŋ hulu eshaŋ amɛ ni latsaa ko etsaŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ;

english_verse: “The Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. He will lead them to streams of life-giving water, and God will wipe all tears from their eyes.”
translation_verse: ejaakɛ Toobi lɛ ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ teŋ lɛ aaalɛ amɛ, ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ kɛaatee wala nubui ahe. Ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsumɔ amɛhiɛiaŋ yaafonui fɛɛ.”

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
translation_verse: Ni be ni etse naasɔomɔnɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ, afee diŋŋ yɛ ŋwɛi aaafee ŋmɛlɛtswaa fã.

english_verse: I noticed that the seven angels who stood before God were each given a trumpet.
translation_verse: Ni mina bɔfoi kpawo lɛ ni damɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ, ni akɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛi kpawo hã amɛ.

english_verse: Another angel, who had a gold container for incense, came and stood at the altar. This one was given a lot of incense to offer with the prayers of God's people on the gold altar in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo kroko ba ni ebadamɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he, ni ehiɛ shika tsofakɛŋma shãanɔ, ni akɛ tsofakɛŋma babaoo hã lɛ, koni ekɛfata krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ fɛɛ asɔlemɔi lɛ ahe yɛ shika afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni ma maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Then the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God's people, went up to God from the hand of the angel.
translation_verse: Ni tsofakɛŋma lɛ lasu lɛ te shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kɛjɛ bɔfo lɛ dɛŋ, ni krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ asɔlemɔi lɛ fata he.

english_verse: After this, the angel filled the incense container with fire from the altar and threw it on the earth. Thunder roared, lightning flashed, and the earth shook. The Trumpets
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo lɛ kɔ tsofakɛŋma shãanɔ lɛ, ni eje efɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ la lɛ eko ewo lɛ obɔ̃, ni etsi eshwie shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɔŋmɔshiimɔi kɛ gbɛɛmɔi kɛ srawagbalamɔi kɛ shikpɔŋhosomɔ ba. Tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi ejwɛ lɛ

english_verse: The seven angels now got ready to blow their trumpets.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfoi kpawo lɛ ni hiɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi kpawo lɛ saa amɛhe koni amɛkpã.

english_verse: When the first angel blew his trumpet, hail and fire mixed with blood were thrown down on the earth. A third of the earth, a third of the trees, and a third of all green plants were burned.
translation_verse: Ni klɛŋklɛŋ bɔfo lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ, ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛ kɛ la ni lá futu mli ba ni ebashwie shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome shã, ni tsei amlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome shã, ni jwɛi fɔ fɛɛ shã.

english_verse: When the second angel blew his trumpet, something like a great fiery mountain was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood,
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo ni ji enyɔ lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ, ni ashɛ nɔ ko ni tamɔ gɔŋ kpeteŋkple ni shãa kɛ la afɔ̃ ŋshɔŋ, ni ŋshɔ lɛ mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome tsɔ̃ lá.

english_verse: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
translation_verse: Ni ŋshɔ lɛ mli bɔɔnii ni yɔɔ wala lɛ amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome gboi, ni lɛji lɛ amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome fite.

english_verse: When the third angel blew his trumpet, a great star fell from heaven. It was burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on a third of the springs of water.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ, ni ŋulami kpeteŋkple ni tsoɔ tamɔ haa jɛ ŋwɛi bagbee shi, ni egbee fai lɛ amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome kɛ nubui lɛ anɔ.

english_verse: The name of the star was Bitter, and a third of the water turned bitter. Many people died because the water was so bitter.
translation_verse: Ni ŋulami lɛ gbɛi ji taatso, ni nui lɛ amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome tsɔ̃ taatso ni gbɔmɛi pii gboi yɛ nui lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ amɛmiijoo.

english_verse: When the fourth angel blew his trumpet, a third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars were struck. They each lost a third of their light. So during a third of the day there was no light, and a third of the night was also without light.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo ni ji ejwɛ lɛ kpã etrɛtrɛmantrɛ, ni atswa hulu mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome kɛ ŋulamii amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome nɔ, amɛmlijai etɛ̃ mli ekomekome lɛ wo duŋ, ni shwane mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ jeŋ tseee ni nyɔɔŋ hu nakai nɔŋŋ.

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a lone eagle flying across the sky. It was shouting, “Trouble, trouble, trouble to everyone who lives on earth! The other three angels are now going to blow their trumpets.”
translation_verse: Ni mikwɛ, ni minu okropɔŋ ko miifiliki yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ teŋ, ni ekɛ gbee ni wa kɛɛ, “Kpoo! Kpoo! Kpoo hã mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ yɛ bɔfoi etɛ̃ ni eshwɛ lɛ atɛtrɛmantrɛi ni amɛbaakpã lɛ agbɛɛmɔi lɛ ahewɔ!”

english_verse: When the fifth angel blew his trumpet, I saw a star fall from the sky to earth. It was given the key to the tunnel that leads down to the deep pit.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo ni ji enumɔ lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ, ni mina ŋulami ko jɛ ŋwɛi bagbee shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni akɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ naa samfee lɛ hã lɛ.

english_verse: As it opened the tunnel, smoke poured out like the smoke of a great furnace. The sun and the air turned dark because of the smoke.
translation_verse: Ni egbele bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ naa, ni lasu te shi kɛjɛ bu lɛ mli tamɔ flɔɔnɔɔ kpeteŋkple mli lasu, ni hulu kɛ atatuiaŋ wo duŋ yɛ bu lɛ mli lasu lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: Locusts came out of the smoke and covered the earth. They were given the same power that scorpions have.
translation_verse: Ni baalabii jɛ lasu lɛ mli kɛba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni ahã amɛ hewalɛ tamɔ hewalɛ ni shikpɔŋ nɔ nyɔŋmɔŋkrakroi yɔɔ lɛ;

english_verse: The locusts were told not to harm the grass on the earth or any plant or any tree. They were to punish only those people who did not have God's mark on their foreheads.
translation_verse: ni akɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛkafee shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jwɛi loo baaŋmɔŋ loo tso ko efɔŋ ko, akɛ ja gbɔmɛi ni bɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naasɔomɔnɔ lɛ okadi yɛ amɛhiɛŋtsei anɔ lɛ kɛkɛ.

english_verse: The locusts were allowed to make them suffer for five months, but not to kill them. The suffering they caused was like the sting of a scorpion.
translation_verse: Ni ahãaa amɛ hegbɛ akɛ amɛgbe amɛ, shi moŋ akɛ amɛpiŋ amɛ nyɔji enumɔ. Ni amɛnaajaramɔ tamɔ nyɔŋmɔŋkrakro naajaramɔ, kɛ etsɛ̃ mɔ lɛ.

english_verse: In those days people will want to die, but they will not be able to. They will hope for death, but it will escape from them.
translation_verse: Ni nakai gbii lɛ amli lɛ gbɔmɛi aaatao gbele, shi amɛnaŋ, ni amɛaashwe ni amɛgboi, shi gbele aaajo amɛnaa foi.

english_verse: These locusts looked like horses ready for battle. On their heads they wore something like gold crowns, and they had human faces.
translation_verse: Ni baalabii lɛ asubaŋ tamɔ okpɔŋɔi ni asaa ahã ta, ni nibii komɛi fimɔ amɛyitsei tamɔ shika akekrei, ni amɛhiɛiaŋ tamɔ gbɔmɛi ahiɛiaŋ;

english_verse: Their hair was like a woman's long hair, and their teeth were like those of a lion.
translation_verse: ni amɛyitsɔi tamɔ yei ayitsɔi, ni amɛnyanyɔji tamɔ jatai anɔ;

english_verse: On their chests they wore armor made of iron. Their wings roared like an army of horse-drawn chariots rushing into battle.
translation_verse: ni amɛwo damai tamɔ dade damai, ni amɛfijiaŋ gbɛɛmɔ tamɔ okpɔŋɔ kɛ shwiilii babaoo ni hiɛ foi kɛmiiya ta agbɛɛmɔ.

english_verse: Their tails were like a scorpion's tail with a stinger that had the power to hurt someone for five months.
translation_verse: Ni amɛyɛ leii tamɔ nyɔŋmɔŋkrakroi aleii kɛ amɛnaa gãii, ni amɛyɛ hewalɛ yɛ amɛleii lɛ amli ni amɛkɛaafee gbɔmɛi efɔŋ nyɔji enumɔ.

english_verse: Their king was the angel in charge of the deep pit. In Hebrew his name was Abaddon, and in Greek it was Apollyon.
translation_verse: Ni amɛnɔ maŋtsɛ ji bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ bɔfo lɛ, ni atsɛɔ egbɛi yɛ Hebri wiemɔ lɛ mli akɛ Abadon, ni Hela wiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ atsɛɔ egbɛi akɛ Apolion.

english_verse: The first horrible thing has now happened! But wait. Two more horrible things will happen soon.
translation_verse: Kpoo kome eho; naa, kpoi enyɔ miiba lolo yɛ nii nɛɛ asɛɛ. Tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ ni ji ekpaa lɛ

english_verse: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice speak from the four corners of the gold altar that stands in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo ni ji ekpaa lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ, ni minu gbee ko kɛjɛ shika afɔleshãa latɛ ni ma Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ akloŋtoi ejwɛ lɛ mli

english_verse: The voice spoke to this angel and said, “Release the four angels who are tied up beside the great Euphrates River.”
translation_verse: ni miikɛɛ bɔfo ni ji ekpaa lɛ ni hiɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ akɛ, “Fɛnemɔ bɔfoi ejwɛ lɛ ni afimɔ amɛ yɛ Eufrate Faa kpeteŋkple lɛ naa lɛ!”

english_verse: The four angels had been prepared for this very hour and day and month and year. Now they were set free to kill a third of all people.
translation_verse: Ni afɛne bɔfoi ejwɛ lɛ ni asaa ato ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ kɛ gbi lɛ kɛ nyɔŋ lɛ kɛ afi lɛ, koni amɛgbe gbɔmɛi amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome.

english_verse: By listening, I could tell there were more than
translation_verse: Ni tabilɔi ni tara okpɔŋɔi anɔ lɛ ayibɔ ji akpe toi akpei ohai enyɔ; minu amɛyibɔ lɛ.

english_verse: In my vision their riders wore fiery-red, dark-blue, and yellow armor on their chests. The heads of the horses looked like lions, with fire and smoke and sulfur coming out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Ni bɔ ni mina okpɔŋɔi lɛ kɛ amɛnɔtaralɔi lɛ yɛ ninaa lɛ mli nɛ: amɛwo damai ni hiɛ là kɛ safiro kɛ swɔɔ su; ni okpɔŋɔi lɛ ayitsei tamɔ jatai ayitsei, ni là kɛ lasu kɛ swɔɔ fãa kɛjɛɔ amɛdaaŋ.

english_verse: One third of all people were killed by the three terrible troubles caused by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur.
translation_verse: Nɛkɛ haomɔi etɛ̃ ni ji là kɛ lasu kɛ swɔɔ ni fãa kɛjɛɔ amɛdaaŋ nɛɛ, akɛgbe gbɔmɛi amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome.

english_verse: The horses had powerful mouths, and their tails were like poisonous snakes that bite and hurt.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ ahewalɛ yɛ amɛdaaŋ kɛ amɛleii amli, ejaakɛ amɛleii lɛ tamɔ onufui aleii, ni yitsei yɛ he, ni nomɛi amɛkɛfeɔ efɔŋ.

english_verse: The people who lived through these terrible troubles did not turn away from the idols they had made, and they did not stop worshiping demons. They kept on worshiping idols that were made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood. Not one of these idols could see, hear, or walk.
translation_verse: Ni gbɔmɛi ni shwɛ ni nɛkɛ haomɔi nɛɛ egbeee amɛ lɛ, amɛtsakeee amɛtsui yɛ amɛdiɛŋtsɛ amɛnine naa nitsumɔi lɛ ahe. Amɛfɔ̃ɔɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ji kɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ ayawa kɛ tɛ kɛ tso amãgãi ni nyɛɛɛ amɛna nii loo amɛnu nii loo amɛnyiɛ lɛ ajamɔ.

english_verse: No one stopped murdering or practicing witchcraft or being immoral or stealing.
translation_verse: Ni asaŋ amɛtsakeee amɛtsui yɛ amɛgbɔmɔgbee kɛ amɛsuu kɛ amɛjwamaŋbɔɔ kɛ amɛjuu lɛ ahe.

english_verse: I saw another powerful angel come down from heaven. This one was covered with a cloud, and a rainbow was over his head. His face was like the sun, his legs were like columns of fire,
translation_verse: Ni mina bɔfo hewalɔ kroko jɛ ŋwɛi miikpeleke shi, ni eha atatu, ni kwaabuɛtɛ yɛ eyiteŋ, ni ehiɛ tamɔ hulu, ni enaji tamɔ la akulashiŋi.

english_verse: and with his hand he held a little scroll that had been unrolled. He stood there with his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
translation_verse: Ni ehiɛ wolo bibioo ko ni agbele naa yɛ edɛŋ; ni ekɛ enanejurɔ ma ŋshɔ nɔ, ni ekɛ enane abɛku hu ma shikpɔŋ nɔ.

english_verse: Then he shouted with a voice that sounded like a growling lion. Thunder roared seven times.
translation_verse: Ni ebo kɛ gbee ni wa, tamɔ jata huuɔ; ni be ni eboɔ lɛ, nyɔŋmɔshiimɔi kpawo lɛ wo amɛgbei.

english_verse: After the thunder stopped, I was about to write what it had said. But a voice from heaven shouted, “Keep it secret! Don't write these things.”
translation_verse: Ni be ni nyɔŋmɔ shiimɔi kpawo lɛ wo amɛgbei lɛ, kulɛ miiŋma; ni minu gbee ko jɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ akɛ, “Sɔomɔ nii ni nyɔŋmɔshiimɔi kpawo lɛ wie lɛ anaa oto, ni oka ŋma.”

english_verse: The angel I had seen standing on the sea and the land then held his right hand up toward heaven.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo lɛ ni mina akɛ edamɔ ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ wó eninejurɔ nɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi,

english_verse: He made a promise in the name of God who lives forever and who created heaven, earth, the sea, and every living creature. The angel said, “You won't have to wait any longer.
translation_verse: ni etsɛ mɔ ni hiɛ kã kɛyaa naanɔi anaanɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi kɛ nii ni yɔɔ mli lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ mli lɛ kɛ ŋshɔ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ mli lɛ gbɛi ekɛkã kitã akɛ, “Be ko be ko bɛ dɔŋŋ,

english_verse: God told his secret plans to his servants the prophets, and it will all happen by the time the seventh angel sounds his trumpet.”
translation_verse: shi moŋ be mli ni aaanu bɔfo ni ji kpawo lɛ gbee be ni eehé ekpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ, no lɛ agbe Nyɔŋmɔ teemɔ sane lɛ hu naa, bɔ ni ejaje etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsuji ni ji gbalɔi lɛ.”

english_verse: Once again the voice from heaven spoke to me. It said, “Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel standing on the sea and the land.”
translation_verse: Ni gbee ni minu kɛjɛ ŋwɛi lɛ kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ, “Yaa ni oyahe wolo lɛ ni agbele naa lɛ yɛ bɔfo ni damɔ ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ dɛŋ.”

english_verse: When I went over to ask the angel for the little scroll, the angel said, “Take the scroll and eat it! Your stomach will turn sour, but the taste in your mouth will be sweet as honey.”
translation_verse: Ni mitee bɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ ni miyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛ wolo bibioo lɛ ahã mi.” Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Hemɔ ni oye, ni eeejoo yɛ omusuŋ, shi odaaŋ moŋ lɛ eeeŋɔɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ tamɔ wo.”

english_verse: I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. The taste was sweet as honey, but my stomach turned sour.
translation_verse: Ni mihe wolo bibioo lɛ yɛ bɔfo lɛ dɛŋ ni miye ni eŋɔɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ yɛ midaaŋ tamɔ wo, shi be ni miye lɛ, ejoo yɛ mimusu mli.

english_verse: Then some voices said, “Keep on telling what will happen to the people of many nations, races, and languages, and also to kings.”
translation_verse: Ni akɛɛ mi akɛ, “Esa akɛ ogba gbalɛ ni kɔɔ maji kɛ jeŋmaji kɛ majianɔ wiemɔi kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi pii ahe ekoŋŋ.”

english_verse: But don't measure the courtyard outside the temple building. Leave it out. It has been given to those people who don't know God, and they will trample all over the holy city for
translation_verse: Ni kpo ni yɔɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ agbo lɛ naa lɛ, shi no sɛɛ ni okasusu no, ejaakɛ akɛhã jeŋmaji lɛ, ni amɛaanaanaa maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɔji nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ.

english_verse: My two witnesses will wear sackcloth, while I let them preach for
translation_verse: Ni mahã midasefoi enyɔ lɛ hegbɛ ni amɛgba gbii akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa ni amɛwo kpekpe.”

english_verse: These two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand in the presence of the Lord who rules the earth.
translation_verse: Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mutsei enyɔ lɛ kɛ kanetsei enyɔ lɛ ni damɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Any enemy who tries to harm them will be destroyed by the fire that comes out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Ni kɛ mɔ ko miitao afee amɛ efɔŋ lɛ, la jeɔ amɛdaaŋ ni ekpãtãa amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ; ni kɛ mɔ ko miitao akɛ efee amɛ efɔŋ lɛ, nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ nɔŋŋ agbeɔ lɛ.

english_verse: They have the power to lock up the sky and to keep rain from falling while they are prophesying. And whenever they want to, they can turn water to blood and cause all kinds of terrible troubles on earth.
translation_verse: Mɛnɛɛmɛi yɛ hegbɛ akɛ amɛŋaa ŋwɛi naa, koni nu akanɛ yɛ amɛgbalɛ bei lɛ amli; ni amɛyɛ hegbɛ hu yɛ nui lɛ anɔ akɛ amɛhãa etsɔ̃ɔ lá, ni amɛkɛ haomɔ fɛɛ haomɔ haoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ shii abɔ ni amɛsumɔɔ.

english_verse: After the two witnesses have finished preaching God's message, the beast that lives in the deep pit will come up and fight against them. It will win the battle and kill them.
translation_verse: Ni kɛ amɛgbe amɛdaseyeli lɛ naa lɛ, kooloo lɛ ni jɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ kɛ amɛ baawu ta, ni eeeye amɛnɔ kunim, ni eeegbe amɛ;

english_verse: Their bodies will be left lying in the streets of the same great city where their Lord was nailed to a cross. And this city is spiritually like the city of Sodom or the country of Egypt.
translation_verse: ni amɛgbohii lɛ aaajwere maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ blohu lɛ mli, maŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ yɛ mumɔ mli akɛ Sodom kɛ Ijipt lɛ, he ni asɛŋ amɛNuŋtsɔ lɛ yɛ lɛ.

english_verse: For three and a half days the people of every nation, tribe, language, and race will stare at the bodies of these two witnesses and refuse to let them be buried.
translation_verse: Ni mɛi komɛi ni jɛ maji lɛ kɛ akutsei lɛ kɛ maji anɔ wiemɔi lɛ kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ amli lɛ aaakwɛ amɛgbohii lɛ gbii etɛ̃ kɛ fã, ni amɛkpɛlɛ̃ŋ ni afu amɛ.

english_verse: Everyone on earth will celebrate and be happy. They will give gifts to each other, because of what happened to the two prophets who caused them so much trouble.
translation_verse: Ni mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaanya yɛ amɛnɔ ni amɛmli aaafli amɛ, ni amɛ aaamajemajee amɛhe keenii, ejaakɛ nɛkɛ gbalɔi enyɔ nɛɛ piŋ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

english_verse: But three and a half days later, God will breathe life into their bodies. They will stand up, and everyone who sees them will be terrified.
translation_verse: Ni gbii etɛ̃ kɛ fã lɛ sɛɛ lɛ wala mumɔ jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ba amɛmli, ni amɛte shi amɛdamɔ amɛnaji anɔ, ni gbeyei kpeteŋkple mɔmɔ mɛi ni na amɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The witnesses then heard a loud voice from heaven, saying, “Come up here.” And while their enemies were watching, they were taken up to heaven in a cloud.
translation_verse: Ni amɛnu gbee waa ko jɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɔa kɛbaa biɛ nɛɛ!” Ni amɛkwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi yɛ atatu mli, ni amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ na amɛ.

english_verse: At that same moment there was a terrible earthquake that destroyed a tenth of the city. Seven thousand people were killed, and the rest were frightened and praised the God who rules in heaven.
translation_verse: Ni nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ shikpɔŋ hoso waa, ni maŋ lɛ mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome wule, ni shikpɔŋ hosomɔ lɛ mli lɛ agbe gbɔmɛi akpei kpawo, ni mɛi ni shwɛ lɛ she gbeyei, ni amɛkɛ anunyam hã ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The second horrible thing has now happened! And the third one will be here soon. The Seventh Trumpet
translation_verse: Kpoo ni ji enyɔ lɛ eho; naa, kpoo ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ miiba oya. Tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ ni ji kpawo lɛ

english_verse: At the sound of the seventh trumpet, loud voices were heard in heaven. They said, “Now the kingdom of this world belongs to our Lord and to his Chosen One! And he will rule forever and ever!”
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo ni ji kpawo lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ, ni anu gbei wuji yɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ akɛ, “Je nɛɛ mli maŋtsɛyeli lɛ etsɔ̃ wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ eKristo lɛ nɔ, ni eeeye maŋtsɛ kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ!”

english_verse: They said, “Lord God All-Powerful, you are and you were, and we thank you. You used your great power and started ruling.
translation_verse: amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔmiida bo shi, bo Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ, bo mɔ ni oyɔɔ ni oyɛ ni obaaba lɛ, akɛ oŋɔ ohewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ ni oye maŋtsɛ!

english_verse: When the nations got angry, you became angry too! Now the time has come for the dead to be judged. It is time for you to reward your servants the prophets and all your people who honor your name, no matter who they are. It is time to destroy everyone who has destroyed the earth.”
translation_verse: Ni jeŋmaji lɛ amli efu. Ni omlifu be lɛ eshɛ kɛ be ni abaakojo gbohii lɛ. Ni abaawo otsuji ni ji gbalɔi lɛ kɛ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ kɛ mɛi ni sheɔ ogbɛi lɛ gbeyei, mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji lɛ anyɔmɔ. Ni abaafite mɛi ni fiteɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ!”

english_verse: The door to God's temple in heaven was then opened, and the sacred chest could be seen inside the temple. I saw lightning and heard roars of thunder. The earth trembled and huge hailstones fell to the ground.
translation_verse: Ni agbele Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ naa yɛ ŋwɛi, ni ana ekpãŋmɔ adeka lɛ yɛ eSɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, ni srawai gbala kɛ gbɛɛmɔ ni nyɔŋmɔ shimɔ ni shikpɔŋ hoso ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi babaoo nɛ.

english_verse: She was about to give birth, and she was crying because of the great pain.
translation_verse: Ehiɛ musu ni fɔmɔ kɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ nɔnaa ehã eebolɔ.

english_verse: Something else appeared in the sky. It was a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and a crown on each of its seven heads.
translation_verse: Ni ana naakpɛɛ okadi kroko yɛ ŋwɛi, ni naa, drako tsuru kpeteŋkple ni yɔɔ yitsei kpawo kɛ akloŋtoi nyɔŋma, ni maŋtsɛ faii kpawo bumɔ eyitsei lɛ.

english_verse: With its tail, it dragged a third of the stars from the sky and threw them down to the earth. Then the dragon turned toward the woman, because it wanted to eat her child as soon as it was born.
translation_verse: Ni elei miigbala ŋwɛi ŋulamii amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome; ni etsirɛ amɛ eshwie shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Ni drako lɛ badamɔ yoo ni baafɔ lɛ hiɛ, koni kɛ efɔ lɛ, ni emi ebi lɛ.

english_verse: The woman gave birth to a son, who would rule all nations with an iron rod. The boy was snatched away. He was taken to God and placed on his throne.
translation_verse: Ni yoo lɛ fɔ binuu ni kɛ dadetso baakpala jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ lɛ; ni asha ebi lɛ kɛtee Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ yɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ masɛi.

english_verse: The woman ran into the desert to a place that God had prepared for her. There she would be taken care of for
translation_verse: Ni yoo lɛ jo foi kɛtee ŋa nɔ he ko, he ni Nyɔŋmɔ esaa eto ehã lɛ lɛ, koni ayalɛ lɛ yɛ jɛi gbii akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa.

english_verse: A war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels were fighting against the dragon and its angels.
translation_verse: Ni ta te shi yɛ ŋwɛi, Mikael kɛ ebɔfoi lɛ fã drako lɛ nɔ ta. Ni drako lɛ bɔfoi fata ehe kɛwu,

english_verse: But the dragon lost the battle. It and its angels were forced out of their places in heaven
translation_verse: ni aye drako kɛ ebɔfoi lɛ anɔ, ni asaŋ amɛnaaa gbɛ dɔŋŋ yɛ ŋwɛi.

english_verse: and were thrown down to the earth. Yes, that old snake and his angels were thrown out of heaven! That snake, who fools everyone on earth, is known as the devil and Satan.
translation_verse: Ni ashɛ drako kpeteŋkple lɛ ni ji blema onufu lɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Abonsam loo Satan lɛ ni shishiuɔ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ afɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ashɛrɛ ebɔfoi lɛ hu ashwie afata ehe.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven shout, “Our God has shown his saving power, and his kingdom has come! God's own Chosen One has shown his authority. Satan accused our people in the presence of God day and night. Now he has been thrown out!
translation_verse: Ni minu gbee wulu ko yɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ, “Agbɛnɛ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ kɛ hewalɛ lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ etsɔ̃ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni hegbɛ lɛ etsɔ̃ eKristo lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ ashɛ wɔnyɛmimɛi lɛ anaaflɔlɔ lɛ ni folɔɔ amɛnaa yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane lɛ afɔ̃.

english_verse: “Our people defeated Satan because of the blood of the Lamb and the message of God. They were willing to give up their lives.
translation_verse: Ni amɛ lɛ, amɛkɛ Toobi lɛ lá lɛ kɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛdaseyeli wiemɔ lɛ eye enɔ kunim, ni amɛdɔɔɔ amɛwala he kɛyashi gbele mli tete.

english_verse: “The heavens should rejoice, together with everyone who lives there. But pity the earth and the sea, because the devil was thrown down to the earth. He knows his time is short, and he is very angry.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ ŋwɛii kɛ nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ jɛi, nyɛnaa tsuijurɔ! Shi kpoo hã shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ ŋshɔ lɛ! Ejaakɛ abonsam lɛ ekpeleke shi kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ, egri naakpa, ejaakɛ ele akɛ be fioo kɛkɛ eyɔɔ.”

english_verse: When the dragon realized it had been thrown down to the earth, it tried to make trouble for the woman who had given birth to a son.
translation_verse: Ni be ni drako lɛ na akɛ ashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ, etiu yoo lɛ ni fɔ binuu lɛ.

english_verse: But the woman was given two wings like those of a huge eagle, so she could fly into the desert. There she would escape from the snake and be taken care of for a time, two times, and half a time.
translation_verse: Ni akɛ okropɔŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ fiji enyɔ lɛ hã yoo lɛ, koni efiliki ni eshi onufu lɛ kɛya ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ egbɛhe lɛ, he ni alɛɔ lɛ yɛ afii etɛ̃ kɛ fã lɛ.

english_verse: The snake then spewed out water like a river to sweep the woman away.
translation_verse: Ni onufu lɛ fɛ̃ nu ni tamɔ faa ko kɛjɛ edaaŋ eshwie yoo lɛ sɛɛ, koni nu lɛ asha lɛ kɛya.

english_verse: But the earth helped her and swallowed the water that had come from the dragon's mouth.
translation_verse: Shi shikpɔŋ lɛ ye bua yoo lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ gbele edaaŋ ni emii faa lɛ ni drako lɛ fɛ̃ kɛjɛ edaaŋ eshwie lɛ.

english_verse: This made the dragon terribly angry with the woman. So it started a war against the rest of her children. They are the people who obey God and are faithful to what Jesus did and taught.
translation_verse: Kɛkɛ ni drako lɛ mli fu yoo lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee ni ekɛ yoo lɛ shwiei ni eshwɛ ni yeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kitãi lɛ anɔ ni amɛhiɛ Yesu Kristo odase lɛ mli lɛ ayawu.

english_verse: The dragon stood on the beach beside the sea.
translation_verse: Ni eyadamɔ ŋshɔ naa shia lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: I looked and saw a beast coming up from the sea. This one had ten horns and seven heads, and a crown was on each of its ten horns. On each of its heads were names that were an insult to God.
translation_verse: Ni mina kooloo ko miije kpo kɛmiijɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli kɛmiiba kɛ eklontoi nyɔŋma kɛ eyitsei kpawo, ni maŋtsɛ faii nyɔŋma bumɔ eklontoi lɛ, ni musubɔɔ gbɛi yɛ eyitsei lɛ ahe.

english_verse: The beast I saw had the body of a leopard, the feet of a bear, and the mouth of a lion. The dragon handed over its own power and throne and great authority to this beast.
translation_verse: Ni kooloo lɛ ni mina lɛ tamɔ mlaŋtswi, ni enaji tamɔ oshishibrishi naji, ni enaabu tamɔ jata naabu. Ni drako lɛ kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehewalɛ lɛ kɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ kɛ hegbɛ kpeteŋkple hã lɛ.

english_verse: One of its heads seemed to have been fatally wounded, but now it was well. Everyone on earth marveled at this beast,
translation_verse: Ni mina eyitsei lɛ ateŋ ekome tamɔ nɔ ni epila gbele pilamɔ, ni atsa egbele pilamɔ lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nyiɛ kooloo lɛ sɛɛ ni amɛnaa ekpɛ amɛhe,

english_verse: and they worshiped the dragon who had given its authority to the beast. They also worshiped the beast and said, “No one is like this beast! No one can fight against it.”
translation_verse: ni amɛja drako lɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛ hegbɛ lɛ ehã kooloo lɛ, ni amɛja kooloo lɛ hu amɛkɛɛ, “Namɔ tamɔ kooloo lɛ, ni namɔ aaanyɛ ekɛ lɛ awu?”

english_verse: The beast was allowed to brag and claim to be God, and for
translation_verse: Ni ahã lɛ naabu ni wieɔ wiemɔi wuji kɛ musubɔɔ wiemɔi, ni ahã lɛ hegbɛ akɛ efee enɛ nyɔji nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ.

english_verse: The beast cursed God, and it cursed the name of God. It even cursed the place where God lives, as well as everyone who lives in heaven with God.
translation_verse: Ni egbele enaa ewie musubɔɔ wiemɔi eshi Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ewie egbɛi lɛ kɛ eshihilɛhe lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ ahe musubɔɔ wiemɔi.

english_verse: It was allowed to fight against God's people and defeat them. It was also given authority over the people of every tribe, nation, language, and race.
translation_verse: Ni ahã lɛ hegbɛ ni ekɛ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ awu ni eye amɛnɔ kunim; ni ahã lɛ hegbɛ yɛ akutso fɛɛ akutso kɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ kɛ maji anɔ wiemɔi fɛɛ kɛ jeŋmaŋ fɛɛ jeŋmaŋ nɔ.

english_verse: The beast was worshiped by everyone whose name wasn't written before the time of creation in the book of the Lamb who was killed.
translation_verse: Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaaja lɛ. Ja mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aŋma egbɛi kɛjɛ jeŋ shishijee yɛ Toobi ni agbe lɛ wala wolo lɛ mli lɛ kɛkɛ.

english_verse: If you have ears, then listen!
translation_verse: Kɛji mɔ ko yɛ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu nii.

english_verse: If you are doomed to be captured, you will be captured. If you are doomed to be killed by a sword, you will be killed by a sword. This means God's people must learn to endure and be faithful!
translation_verse: Kɛji ato akɛ aŋɔ mɔ ko nom lɛ, aaaŋɔ lɛ nom; ni kɛ ato akɛ akɛ klante agbe mɔ ko lɛ, klante akɛaagbe lɛ. Biɛ wɔnaa krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ ahiɛmiamɔ lɛ kɛ amɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ yɛ.

english_verse: I now saw another beast. This one came out of the ground. It had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
translation_verse: Ni mina kooloo kroko miije kpo kɛmiijɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli kɛ eklontoi enyɔ tamɔ toobi akloŋtoi, ni wieɔ tamɔ drako.

english_verse: It worked for the beast whose fatal wound had been healed. And it used all its authority to force the earth and its people to worship that beast.
translation_verse: Ni etsuɔ klɛŋklɛŋ kooloo lɛ hegbɛ lɛ fɛɛ he nii yɛ ehiɛ, ni ehãa shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ enɔ lɛ jaa klɛŋklɛŋ kooloo lɛ ni atsa egbele pilamɔ lɛ.

english_verse: It worked mighty miracles, and while people watched, it even made fire come down from the sky.
translation_verse: Ni efeɔ okadii wuji, ni ehãa la po jɛɔ ŋwɛi baa shikpɔŋ yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ.

english_verse: This second beast fooled people on earth by working miracles for the first one. Then it talked them into making an idol in the form of the beast that did not die after being wounded by a sword.
translation_verse: Ni ekɛ okadii ni ahã lɛ hegbɛ akɛ efee yɛ kooloo lɛ hiɛ lɛ shishiuɔ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɔ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ akɛ amɛfee amãgã amɛhã kooloo lɛ ni klante naa pilamɔ yɔɔ ehe ni ehiɛ kã lɛ.

english_verse: It was allowed to put breath into the idol, so it could speak. Everyone who refused to worship the idol of the beast was put to death.
translation_verse: Ni ahã lɛ gbɛ ni ekɛ mumɔ ahã kooloo lɛ amãgã lɛ, koni kooloo lɛ amãgã lɛ awie tete, ni ehã agbe mɛi fɛɛ ni jaaa kooloo lɛ amãgã lɛ.

english_verse: All people were forced to put a mark on their right hand or forehead. Whether they were powerful or weak, rich or poor, free people or slaves,
translation_verse: Ni ehã akadiɔ mɛi fɛɛ, mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji, niiatsɛmɛi kɛ ohiafoi, odehei kɛ nyɔji yɛ amɛninejurɔ loo amɛhiɛŋtsei anɔ.

english_verse: they all had to have this mark, or else they could not buy or sell anything. This mark stood for the name of the beast and for the number of its name.
translation_verse: Koni mɔ ko nyɛŋ ehe nii aloo ehɔ̃ɔ nii, akɛ ja mɔ ni yɔɔ naakpɛɛ okadi lɛ yɛ ehe, ni ji kooloo lɛ gbɛi loo yibɔ ni damɔ shi hã egbɛi lɛ.

english_verse: You need wisdom to understand the number of the beast! But if you are smart enough, you can figure this out. Its number is
translation_verse: Biɛ nilee he ehia yɛ. Mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ abu kooloo lɛ yibɔ lɛ he akɔntaa; ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ yibɔ ni; ni eyibɔ lɛ ji ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ekpaa.

english_verse: Then I heard a sound from heaven that was like a roaring flood or loud thunder or even like the music of harps.
translation_verse: Ni minu gbee ko kɛjɛ ŋwɛi tamɔ nui pii agbɛɛmɔ, ni asaŋ etamɔ nyɔŋmɔshimɔ kpeteŋkple gbɛɛmɔ; ni gbee ni minu lɛ tamɔ saŋkutswalɔi ni miitswa amɛsaŋkui agbee.

english_verse: And a new song was being sung in front of God's throne and in front of the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn that song, except the
translation_verse: Ni amɛlaa lala hee ko yɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ahiɛ; ni mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ lala lɛ akase, akɛ ja mɛi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ ni akpɔ̃ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛkɛ.

english_verse: All of these are pure virgins, and they follow the Lamb wherever he leads. They have been rescued to be presented to God and the Lamb as the most precious people on earth.
translation_verse: Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi ni kɛ yei buleko amɛhe, ejaakɛ oblahii ni he tse ji amɛ, ni amɛnyiɛɔ Toobi lɛ sɛɛ kɛyaa he fɛɛ he ni eyaa lɛ. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi ni akpɔ̃ kɛjɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ akɛ klɛŋklɛŋ yibii kɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Toobi lɛ.

english_verse: They never tell lies, and they are innocent. The Messages of the Three Angels
translation_verse: Ni anaaa amale ko yɛ amɛdaaŋ ejaakɛ kpa ko bɛ amɛhe.

english_verse: I saw another angel. This one was flying across the sky and had the eternal good news to announce to the people of every race, tribe, language, and nation on earth.
translation_verse: Ni mina bɔfo kroko miifiliki yɛ ŋwɛi teŋ, ni ehiɛ naanɔ Sanekpakpa ni eyaajaje etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ jeŋmaŋ fɛɛ jeŋmaŋ kɛ akutso fɛɛ akutso kɛ maji anɔ wiemɔi fɛɛ kɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Worship and honor God! The time has come for him to judge everyone. Kneel down before the one who created heaven and earth, the oceans, and every stream.”
translation_verse: Ni ekɛ gbee ni wa kɛɛ, “Nyɛshea Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei ni nyɛkɛ anunyam ahãa lɛ ejaakɛ ekojomɔ ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ; ni nyɛjaa mɔ ni fee ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔ kɛ nuhiŋmɛii lɛ!”

english_verse: A second angel followed and said, “The great city of Babylon has fallen! This is the city that made all nations drunk and immoral. Now God is angry, and Babylon has fallen.”
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo kroko ni ji enyɔ nyiɛ klɛŋklɛŋ bɔfo lɛ sɛɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Egbee shi, Babilon maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ egbee shi, ejaakɛ ehã jeŋmaji fɛɛ enu ejwamaŋbɔɔ ni naa wa lɛ dãa lɛ eko.”

english_verse: Finally, a third angel came and shouted: Here is what will happen if you worship the beast and the idol and have the mark of the beast on your hand or forehead.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo kroko ni ji etɛ̃ nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ, ni ekɛ gbee wulu kɛɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko ja kooloo lɛ kɛ emãgã lɛ, ni ehe ekadi lɛ yɛ ehiɛŋtso nɔ loo enine nɔ lɛ,

english_verse: You will have to drink the wine that God gives to everyone who makes him angry. You will feel his mighty anger, and you will be tortured with fire and burning sulfur, while the holy angels and the Lamb look on.
translation_verse: lɛ hu eeenu Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu dãa ŋmiiŋmi ni akɛwo emlifu kpulu lɛ mli lɛ eko, ni aaapiŋ lɛ yɛ la kɛ swɔɔ mli yɛ bɔfoi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ahiɛ kɛ Toobi lɛ hiɛ.

english_verse: If you worship the beast and the idol and accept the mark of its name, you will be tortured day and night. The smoke from your torture will go up forever and ever, and you will never be able to rest.
translation_verse: Ni amɛpiŋmɔ lɛ lasu lɛ teɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔi anaanɔ. Ni mɛi ni jaa kooloo lɛ kɛ emãgã lɛ, kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eŋɔ egbɛi okadi lɛ, nãaa hejɔɔmɔ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane.”

english_verse: God's people must learn to endure. They must also obey his commands and have faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Biɛ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ ni hiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kitãi lɛ kɛ Yesu nɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ ahiɛmiamɔ lɛ he ehia yɛ.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, “Put this in writing. From now on, the Lord will bless everyone who has faith in him when they die.” The Spirit answered, “Yes, they will rest from their hard work, and they will be rewarded for what they have done.” The Earth Is Harvested
translation_verse: Ni minu gbee jɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ mi akɛ, “Ŋmaa: Ajɔɔ gbohii lɛ ni gboiɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ. Hɛɛ, Mumɔ lɛ kɛɛ, koni amɛjɔɔ amɛhe kɛjɛ amɛdeŋmegbomɔi lɛ amli ejaakɛ amɛnitsumɔi lɛ nyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ.” Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nikpamɔ lɛ

english_verse: I looked and saw a bright cloud, and someone who seemed to be the Son of Man was sitting on the cloud. He wore a gold crown on his head and held a sharp sickle in his hand.
translation_verse: Ni mikwɛ, ni naa, atatu yɛŋ, ni mɔ ko ta nɔ tamɔ gbɔmɔ bi, ni shika akekre fi eyitso, ni ehiɛ nikpamɔ kakla ni naa ba yɛ edɛŋ.

english_verse: An angel came out of the temple and shouted, “Start cutting with your sickle! Harvest season is here, and all crops on earth are ripe.”
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo kroko je kpo kɛjɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli ni ebolɔ kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ mɔ ni ta atatu lɛ nɔ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ onikpamɔ kakla lɛ awo mli ni okpa nii, ejaakɛ nikpamɔ ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nikpamɔnii lɛ etsu.”

english_verse: The one on the cloud swung his sickle and harvested the crops.
translation_verse: Ni mɔ ni ta atatu lɛ nɔ lɛ shɛ enikpamɔ kakla lɛ efɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni akpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nii lɛ.

english_verse: Another angel with a sharp sickle then came out of the temple in heaven.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo kroko je kpo kɛjɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ mli, ni lɛ hu ehiɛ nikpamɔ kakla ni naa ba.

english_verse: After this, an angel with power over fire came from the altar and shouted to the angel who had the sickle. He said, “All grapes on earth are ripe! Harvest them with your sharp sickle.”
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo kroko ni yɔɔ la nɔ hewalɛ je kpo kɛjɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mli, ni ebo etsɛ mɔ ni hiɛ nikpamɔ kakla ni naa ba lɛ kɛ gbee ni wa akɛ, “Okɛ okakla ni naa ba lɛ awo mli ni okpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ waintso yibii lɛ ejaakɛ ewaintso yibii lɛ etsu!”

english_verse: The angel swung his sickle on earth and cut off its grapes. He threw them into a pit where they were trampled on as a sign of God's anger.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo lɛ shɛ ekakla lɛ efɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ waintso yibii lɛ, ni ekɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ mlila lɛ wainŋaanɔ kpeteŋkple lɛ mli.

english_verse: The pit was outside the city, and when the grapes were mashed, blood flowed out. The blood turned into a river that was about
translation_verse: Ni anaanaa wainŋaanɔ lɛ nɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ ŋmaŋmasha lɛ, ni lá ho kɛjɛ wainŋaanɔ lɛ mli ni ekɛlɛ ji shitoi ohai enyɔ.

english_verse: After this, I looked at the sky and saw something else that was strange and important. Seven angels were bringing the seven last terrible troubles. When these are ended, God will no longer be angry.
translation_verse: Ni mina naakpɛɛ okadi kroko yɛ ŋwɛi, eda ni eyɛ naakpɛɛ: bɔfoi kpawo ni hiɛ haomɔi kpawo ni ji naagbeenii lɛ, ejaakɛ nomɛi akɛgbeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mlila lɛ naa.

english_verse: Then I saw something that looked like a glass sea mixed with fire, and people were standing on it. They were the ones who had defeated the beast and the idol and the number that tells the name of the beast. God had given them harps,
translation_verse: Ni mina nɔ ko tamɔ ashwishwɛ ŋshɔ ni akɛ lá efutu mli, ni mɛi ni eye kooloo lɛ kɛ emãgã lɛ kɛ ekadi lɛ kɛ egbɛi lɛ yibɔ lɛ nɔ kunim lɛ damɔ ashwishwɛ ŋshɔ lɛ naa, ni amɛhiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ saŋkui lɛ.

english_verse: and they were singing the song his servant Moses and the Lamb had sung. They were singing, “Lord God All-Powerful, you have done great and marvelous things. You are the ruler of all nations, and you do what is right and fair.
translation_verse: Ni amɛla Nyɔŋmɔ tsulɔ Mose lala lɛ kɛ Toobi lɛ lala lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Onitsumɔi lɛ dara ni amɛyɛ naakpɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe! Ogbɛi lɛ ja ni anɔkwale ni, bo jeŋmaji lɛ aMaŋtsɛ!

english_verse: Lord, who doesn't honor and praise your name? You alone are holy, and all nations will come and worship you, because you have shown that you judge with fairness.”
translation_verse: Namɔ po sheŋ bo gbeyei, Nuŋtsɔ, ni ewoŋ ogbɛ́i lɛ hiɛ nyam? Ejaakɛ bo okometoo ji Mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ; ejaakɛ jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ aaaba ni amɛbaja yɛ ohiɛ, ejaakɛ ajie ojalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ashi faŋŋ.”

english_verse: After this, I noticed something else in heaven. The sacred tent used for a temple was open.
translation_verse: Ni nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ mikwɛ, ni agbele Odase Buu lɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ naa yɛ ŋwɛi,

english_verse: And the seven angels who were bringing the terrible troubles were coming out of it. They were dressed in robes of pure white linen and wore belts made of pure gold.
translation_verse: ni bɔfoi kpawo lɛ ni hiɛ haomɔi kpawo lɛ je kpo kɛjɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, ni amɛwo klala ni he tse ni kpɛlɛɔ kaŋkaŋ, ni amɛfimɔ amɛtsitsii kɛ shika mlifiinii.

english_verse: One of the four living creatures gave each of the seven angels a bowl made of gold. These bowls were filled with the anger of God who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ni hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛ shika tɔi kpawo ni eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni hiɛ kã kɛyaa naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ mlila lɛ hã bɔfoi kpawo lɛ.

english_verse: The temple quickly filled with smoke from the glory and power of God. No one could enter it until the seven angels had finished pouring out the seven last troubles.
translation_verse: Ni Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ yi obɔ̃ kɛ lasu ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ mli lɛ, ni mɔ ko nyɛ̃ɛɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli abote kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaagbe bɔfoi kpawo lɛ ahaomɔi kpawo lɛ anaa.

english_verse: From the temple I heard a voice shout to the seven angels, “Go and empty the seven bowls of God's anger on the earth.”
translation_verse: Ni minu gbee ni wa ni jɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli miikɛɛ bɔfoi kpawo lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyafɔsea Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu tɔi kpawo lɛ nyɛshwiea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: The first angel emptied his bowl on the earth. At once ugly and painful sores broke out on everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol.
translation_verse: Ni klɛŋklɛŋ bɔfo lɛ yi mli etee, ni eyafɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ eshwie shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni mɛi ni kooloo lɛ okadi yɔɔ amɛhe lɛ kɛ mɛi ni jaa emãgã lɛ famɔ faji fɔ̃ji ni waa mɔ he.

english_verse: The second angel emptied his bowl on the sea. At once the sea turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo ni ji enyɔ lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ ewo ŋshɔ mli; ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ gbonyo lá, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli lɛ gbo.

english_verse: The third angel emptied his bowl into the rivers and streams. At once they turned to blood.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ ewo fai kɛ nuhiŋmɛii lɛ amli, ni nu lɛ tsɔ̃ lá.

english_verse: Then I heard the angel, who has power over water, say, “You have always been, and you always will be the holy God. You had the right to judge in this way.
translation_verse: Ni minu nui lɛ anɔ bɔfo lɛ miikɛɛ, “Jalɔ ji bo, bo ni oyɔɔ, ni oyɛ, ni oji Mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, akɛni okojo nɛkɛ nɛɛ.

english_verse: They poured out the blood of your people and your prophets. So you gave them blood to drink as they deserve!”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ amɛshwie krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ alá shi. Ni lá nɔŋŋ ohã amɛ ni amɛnu; esa amɛ nakai!”

english_verse: After this, I heard the altar shout, “Yes, Lord God All-Powerful, your judgments are honest and fair.”
translation_verse: Ni minu afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ miikɛɛ, “Hɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe, anɔkwa kɛ jalɛ ji okojomɔi lɛ!”

english_verse: The fourth angel emptied his bowl on the sun, and it began to scorch people like fire.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo ni ji ejwɛ lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ eshwie hulu nɔ; ni ahã lɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛ la ashã gbɔmɛi.

english_verse: Everyone was scorched by its great heat, and all of them cursed the name of God who had power over these terrible troubles. But no one turned to God and praised him.
translation_verse: Ni la dɔlɛ ni naa wa lɛ shã gbɔmɛi, ni amɛwie musubɔɔ wiemɔi amɛshi Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ yɛ nɛkɛ haomɔi nɛɛ anɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ, ni amɛtsakeee amɛtsui ni amɛwo ehiɛ nyam.

english_verse: The fifth angel emptied his bowl on the throne of the beast. At once darkness covered its kingdom, and its people began biting their tongues in pain.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo ni ji enumɔ lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ eshwie kooloo lɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ wo duŋ, ni gbɔmɛi kɔ̃mɔ amɛlilɛii yɛ nɔnaa lɛ hewɔ.

english_verse: And because of their painful sores, they cursed the God who rules in heaven. But still they did not stop doing evil things.
translation_verse: Ni amɛwie musubɔɔ wiemɔi amɛshi ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɛ nɔnai lɛ kɛ amɛfaji lɛ ahewɔ, ni amɛtsakeee amɛtsui yɛ amɛnitsumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ ahe.

english_verse: The sixth angel emptied his bowl on the great Euphrates River, and it completely dried up to make a road for the kings from the east.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo ni ji ekpaa lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ ewo Eufrate Faa agbo lɛ mli. Ni emli nu lɛ gbi, koni akɛsaa gbɛ ahã maŋtsɛmɛi ni jɛ hulu shiteehe lɛ.

english_verse: An evil spirit that looked like a frog came out of the mouth of the dragon. One also came out of the mouth of the beast, and another out of the mouth of the false prophet.
translation_verse: Ni mina mumɔi etɛ̃ ni he tseee ni tamɔ kɔkɔdenei miije kpo kɛmiijɛ drako lɛ daaŋ kɛ kooloo lɛ daaŋ kɛ amalegbalɔ lɛ daaŋ.

english_verse: These evil spirits had the power to work miracles. They went to every king on earth, to bring them together for a war against God All-Powerful. But that will be the day of God's great victory.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji amumɔi ni, ni amɛfeɔ okadii, ni amɛyaa maŋtsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ aŋɔɔ, koni amɛyabua amɛnaa amɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ gbi wulu lɛ nɔ ta lɛ.

english_verse: Remember Christ says, “When I come, it will surprise you like a thief! But God will bless you, if you are awake and ready. Then you won't have to walk around naked and be ashamed.”
translation_verse: “Naa, miiba tamɔ julɔ. Ajɔɔ mɔ ni saraa ni ekwɛɔ etadei lɛ anɔ lɛ, koni ekanyiɛ yayai ni ana ehiɛgbele lɛ.”

english_verse: Those armies came together in a place that in Hebrew is called Armagedon.
translation_verse: Ni mumɔi lɛ bua maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ anaa kɛtee he ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi yɛ Hebri wiemɔ mli akɛ Harmagedon lɛ.

english_verse: As soon as the seventh angel emptied his bowl in the air, a loud voice from the throne in the temple shouted, “It's done!”
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo ni ji kpawo lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ ewo kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni gbee ni wa ko jɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ mli yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli kɛɛ akɛ, “Agbe naa!”

english_verse: The great city of Babylon split into three parts, and the cities of other nations fell. So God made Babylon drink from the wine cup filled with his anger.
translation_verse: Ni maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ mli gbala etɛ̃, ni jeŋmaji lɛ amaji lɛ fɛɛ wule, ni akai Babilon kpeteŋkple lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, koni akɛ emlifu ni naa wa lɛ dãa kpulu lɛ ahã lɛ.

english_verse: Every island ran away, and the mountains disappeared.
translation_verse: Ni ŋshɔkpɔ fɛɛ ŋshɔkpɔ laaje, ni gɔji lɛ anãaa dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: One of the seven angels who had emptied the bowls came over and said to me, “Come on! I will show you how God will punish that shameless prostitute who sits on many oceans.
translation_verse: Bɔfoi kpawo lɛ ni hiɛ tɔi kpawo lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ba, ni ekɛ mi bawie ekɛɛ, “Ba ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo ajwamãŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ ni ta nui babaoo lɛ anɔ lɛ kojomɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Every king on earth has slept with her, and her shameless ways are like wine that has made everyone on earth drunk.”
translation_verse: Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ lɛ bɔ ajwamãŋ, ni ejwamaŋbɔɔ dãa lɛ hã mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ tɔrɔ dãa.”

english_verse: With the help of the Spirit, the angel took me into a desert, where I saw a woman sitting on a red beast. The beast was covered with names that were an insult to God, and it had seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo lɛ kpala mi yɛ mumɔ mli kɛtee ŋa nɔ. Ni mina yoo ko ta kooloo tsuru fɔɔ ko nɔ ni kooloo nɛɛ he fɛɛ lɛ musubɔɔ gbɛii sɔŋŋ, ni eyɛ yitsei kpawo kɛ akloŋtoi nyɔŋma.

english_verse: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet robes, and she wore jewelry made of gold, precious stones, and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup filled with the filthy and nasty things she had done.
translation_verse: Yoo lɛ wo atade afaseo diŋ kɛ etsuru fɔɔ, ni akɛ shika kɛ tɛi ni jara wa kɛ adiagbai ewula lɛ, ni ehiɛ shika kpulu yɛ edɛŋ ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ ejwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ mli nihiinii kɛ mujinii.

english_verse: On her forehead a mysterious name was written: I AM THE GREAT CITY OF BABYLON, THE MOTHER OF EVERY IMMORAL AND FILTHY THING ON EARTH.
translation_verse: Ni aŋma gbɛi ko ni ji teemɔ sane yɛ ehiɛŋtso nɔ, “Babilon kpeteŋkple lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ajwamãŋi lɛ kɛ nihiinii lɛ anyɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: I could tell that the woman was drunk on the blood of God's people who had given their lives for Jesus. This surprising sight amazed me,
translation_verse: Ni mina yoo lɛ akɛ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ alá lɛ kɛ Yesu he odasefoi lɛ alá lɛ etɔ lɛ dãa. Be ni mina lɛ lɛ, minaa kpɛ mihe naakpa.

english_verse: and the angel said: Why are you so amazed? I will explain the mystery about this woman and about the beast she is sitting on, with its seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ onaa ekpɛ ohe? Mibagba bo yoo lɛ kɛ kooloo ni eta nɔ ni yɔɔ yitsei kpawo kɛ akloŋtoi nyɔŋma lɛ ahe teemɔ sane lɛ.

english_verse: The beast you saw is one that used to be and no longer is. It will come back from the deep pit, but only to be destroyed. Everyone on earth whose names were not written in the book of life before the time of creation will be amazed. They will see this beast that used to be and no longer is, but will be once more.
translation_verse: Kooloo lɛ ni ona lɛ be ko mli lɛ eyɛ, shi amrɔ nɛɛ ebɛ, ni ebaajɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli eje kpo kɛya hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli. Ni mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni aŋmako amɛgbɛii yɛ wala wolo lɛ mli kɛjɛ jeŋ shishijee lɛ anaa aaakpɛ amɛhe kɛ amɛna kooloo lɛ akɛ be ko mli lɛ, eyɛ shi amrɔ nɛɛ ebɛ, ni ebaaba lɛ.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom can figure this out. The seven heads that the woman is sitting on stand for seven hills. These heads are also seven kings.
translation_verse: “Biɛ jwɛŋmɔ ni nilee yɔɔ mli he ehĩa yɛ. Yitsei kpawo lɛ ji gɔji kpawo ni yoo lɛ ta nɔ lɛ, ni asaŋ maŋtsɛmɛi kpawo hu ni.

english_verse: Five of the kings are dead. One is ruling now, and the other one has not yet come. But when he does, he will rule for only a little while.
translation_verse: Amɛteŋ mɛi enumɔ egbee shi, mɔ kome yɛ, ni mɔ kome lɛ nako aba, ni kɛ eba lɛ, ja ehi shi fioo.

english_verse: You also saw a beast that used to be and no longer is. That beast is one of the seven kings who will return as the eighth king, but only to be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ni kooloo lɛ ni be ko mli lɛ eyɛ shi amrɔ nɛɛ ebɛ lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni ji kpaanyɔ, ni ejɛ mɛi kpawo lɛ amli, ni eeya hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli.”

english_verse: The ten horns you saw are ten more kings, who have not yet come into power, and they will rule with the beast for only a short time.
translation_verse: “Ni akloŋtoi nyɔŋma lɛ ni ona lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi nyɔŋma ni, mɛi ni maŋtsɛyeli shɛko amɛdɛŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛbaana hegbɛ amɛye maŋtsɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome kɛ kooloo lɛ.

english_verse: They all think alike and will give their power and authority to the beast.
translation_verse: Amɛhiɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome, ni amɛkɛ amɛhewalɛ kɛ amɛhegbɛ lɛ hãa kooloo lɛ.

english_verse: These kings will go to war against the Lamb. But he will defeat them, because he is Lord over all lords and King over all kings. His followers are chosen and special and faithful.
translation_verse: Amɛkɛ Toobi lɛ baawu, shi Toobi lɛ baaye amɛnɔ kunim, ejaakɛ lɛ ji Nuŋtsɔmɛi aNuŋtsɔ kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi aMaŋtsɛ lɛ, ni mɛi ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ ji mɛi ni atsɛ kɛ mɛi ni ahala kɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: The oceans you saw the prostitute sitting on are crowds of people from all races and languages.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Nui lɛ ni ona ni yoo ajwamãŋ lɛ ta nɔ lɛ ji maji kɛ asafoi kɛ jeŋmaji kɛ maji anɔ wiemɔi.

english_verse: The ten horns and the beast will start hating the shameless woman. They will strip off her clothes and leave her naked. Then they will eat her flesh and throw the rest of her body into a fire.
translation_verse: Ni akloŋtoi nyɔŋma ni ona lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ amɛaanyɛ ajwamãŋ lɛ, ni amɛafee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃ ni amɛkɛ la aaashã lɛ kɛmɔ shi.

english_verse: God is the one who made these kings all think alike and decide to give their power to the beast. And they will do this until what God has said comes true.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛwo amɛtsuii amli koni amɛfee eyiŋtoonii lɛ ni amɛhiɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome ni amɛkɛ amɛmaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ahã kooloo lɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi lɛ aaaba mli.”

english_verse: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over all kings on earth.
translation_verse: “Ni yoo lɛ ni ona lɛ ji maŋ kpeteŋkple ni yeɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ anɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: I saw another angel come from heaven. This one had great power, and the earth was bright because of his glory.
translation_verse: Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ mina bɔfo kroko miikpeleke shi kɛmiijɛ ŋwɛi, ni eyɛ hegbɛ kpeteŋkple, ni enunyam lɛ hã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tse;

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Fallen! Powerful Babylon has fallen and is now the home of demons. It is the den of every filthy spirit and of all unclean birds, and every dirty and hated animal.
translation_verse: ni ekɛ̃ ehe shi ebo ekɛɛ, “Egbee shi, Babilon kpeteŋkple lɛ egbee shi, ni etsɔ̃ mumɔi fɔ̃ji ashihilɛhe, kɛ mumɔi ni he tseee fɛɛ atsu kɛ loofɔlɔ fɛɛ loofɔlɔ ni he tseee ni anyaŋeɔ hu tsu.

english_verse: Babylon's evil and immoral wine has made all nations drunk. Every king on earth has slept with her, and every merchant on earth is rich because of her evil desires.”
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ehã jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ enu ejwamaŋbɔɔ dãa ni naa wa lɛ eko, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ lɛ bɔ ajwamãŋ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jarayelɔi lɛ tsɔ̃mɔ niiatsɛmɛi yɛ enyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ lɛ hewalɛ naa.”

english_verse: Then I heard another voice from heaven shout, “My people, you must escape from Babylon. Don't take part in her sins and share her punishment.
translation_verse: Ni minu gbee kroko kɛjɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ, “Nyɛjea emli, mimaŋ, koni nyɛkɛ lɛ akafea eshai ni efeɔ lɛ, ni nyɛkana ehaomɔi lɛ eko.

english_verse: Her sins are piled as high as heaven. God has remembered the evil she has done.
translation_verse: Ejaakɛ ehe eshai lɛ anɔ ekwɔ kɛshɛ ŋwɛi tɔ̃ɔ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekai enifɔɔji anii lɛ.

english_verse: Treat her as she has treated others. Make her pay double for what she has done. Make her drink twice as much of what she mixed for others.
translation_verse: Nyɛwoa lɛ nyɔmɔ tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ hu ewo lɛ, ni nyɛkua nyɛbɔa he toi enyɔ nyɛhãa lɛ yɛ enitsumɔi lɛ anaa. Kpulu lɛ ni efutu dãa yɛ mli lɛ, nyɛfutua lɛ toi enyɔ nyɛwoa mli nyɛhãa lɛ.

english_verse: That woman honored herself with a life of luxury. Reward her now with suffering and pain. “Deep in her heart Babylon said, ‘I am the queen! Never will I be a widow or know what it means to be sad.’
translation_verse: Bɔ ni ewo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ nyam ni ebɔ nyɛnyɛŋtswi lɛ, nakai bɔ nɔŋŋ nyɛhãa epiŋmɔ kɛ ewerɛhoo lɛ afaa; ejaakɛ ekɛɔ yɛ etsui mli akɛ, ‘Mita shi akɛ maŋnyɛ, ni mijeee okulafo, ni minaŋ awerɛhoo.’

english_verse: And so, in a single day she will suffer the pain of sorrow, hunger, and death. Fire will destroy her dead body, because her judge is the powerful Lord God.”
translation_verse: No hewɔ lɛ, gbi kome nɔ ehaomɔi lɛ aaaba, gbele kɛ awerɛhoo kɛ hɔ̃mɔ, ni akɛ la aaashã lɛ butuu, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni kojoɔ lɛ he wa.” Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ayarawoo yɛ Babilon hewɔ

english_verse: Every king on earth who slept with her and shared in her luxury will mourn. They will weep, when they see the smoke from that fire.
translation_verse: Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi ni kɛ lɛ bɔ ajwamãŋ ni amɛkɛ lɛ bɔ nyɛnyɛŋtswi lɛ aaafo lɛ, ni amɛaawo yara yɛ hewɔ, be ni amɛaana eshãa lɛ lasu lɛ.

english_verse: Her sufferings will frighten them, and they will stand at a distance and say, “Pity that great and powerful city! Pity Babylon! In a single hour her judgment has come.”
translation_verse: Ni amɛaakɛɛ, “Ao! Ao! Maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ, Babilon, maŋ ni he wa lɛ! Ejaakɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome mli ni okojomɔ eba nɛɛ!”

english_verse: Every merchant on earth will mourn, because there is no one to buy their goods.
translation_verse: Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jarayelɔi lɛ aaafo lɛ ni amɛaaye lɛ ŋkɔmɔ, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko heee amɛguɔ nii lɛ dɔŋŋ:

english_verse: There won't be anyone to buy their gold, silver, jewels, pearls, fine linen, purple cloth, silk, scarlet cloth, sweet-smelling wood, fancy carvings of ivory and wood, as well as things made of bronze, iron, or marble.
translation_verse: shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi, ojarawatɛi kɛ adiagbai, kɛ klala fɛɛfɛo kɛ mama afaseo diŋ, kɛ seda kɛ mama tsuru fɔɔ kɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni jeɔ ŋma kɛ shwuɔwu nibii fɛɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni akɛ tso ni wa kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade kɛ marmaratɛ fee,

english_verse: No one will buy their cinnamon, spices, incense, myrrh, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, slaves, and other humans.
translation_verse: kɛ sinamon kɛ mrɔŋo kɛ tsofaikɛŋmai kɛ mire kɛ ohɛ kɛ wain kɛ mu kɛ shikishaŋ kɛ ŋmaa, kɛ tsinai kɛ toi kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ shwiilii kɛ nyɔji kɛ gbɔmɛi asusumai.

english_verse: Babylon, the things your heart desired have all escaped from you. Every luxury and all your glory will be lost forever. You will never get them back.
translation_verse: Jarayelɔi lɛ kɛɛ, “Ni yibii ni baa otsine lɛ eje odaaŋ, ni ŋɔɔmɔ nibii fɛɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni kpɛlɛɔ nyɛramnyɛram lɛ ebɔ bo, ni onaŋ amɛ kwraa dɔŋŋ.”

english_verse: The merchants had become rich because of her. But when they saw her sufferings, they were terrified. They stood at a distance, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Ni nibii nɛɛ aguɔyelɔi ni etsɔ̃ maŋ nɛɛ nɔ etsɔ̃mɔ niiatsɛmɛi lɛ aaadamɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ yɛ epiŋmɔ lɛ gbeyeishemɔ lɛ hewɔ, ni amɛaafo ni amɛaaye ŋkɔmɔ

english_verse: Then they shouted, “Pity the great city of Babylon! She dressed in fine linen and wore purple and scarlet cloth. She had jewelry made of gold and precious stones and pearls.
translation_verse: ni amɛaakɛɛ, “Ao! Ao! Maŋ kpeteŋkple ni buɔ klala fɛɛfɛo kɛ mama afaseo diŋ kɛ mama tsuru fɔɔ, ni ewulaa kɛ shika kɛ ojarawatɛi kɛ adiagbai lɛ!

english_verse: Yet in a single hour her riches disappeared.” Every ship captain and passenger and sailor stood at a distance, together with everyone who does business by traveling on the sea.

english_verse: When they saw the smoke from her fire, they shouted, “This was the greatest city ever!”

english_verse: They cried loudly, and in their sorrow they threw dust on their heads, as they said, “Pity the great city of Babylon! Everyone who sailed the seas became rich from her treasures. But in a single hour the city was destroyed.
translation_verse: Ni amɛkɛ mlu wo amɛyiteaŋ, ni amɛkɛ yaafo kɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli bo amɛkɛɛ, “Ao! Ao! Maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ ni emli mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ lɛji yɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ eninamɔ lɛ nɔ amɛfee niiatsɛmɛi lɛ! Ejaakɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome mli ni fɛɛ ebɔ lɛ nɛɛ!”

english_verse: A powerful angel then picked up a huge stone and threw it into the sea. The angel said, “This is how the great city of Babylon will be thrown down, never to rise again.
translation_verse: Ni bɔfo ko ni he wa wo tɛ ko ni tamɔ wiɛ wulu, ni eshɛ efɔ̃ ŋshɔŋ ni ekɛɛ, “Nɛkɛ aaatsi Babilon maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ atswa shi waa, ni anaŋ lɛ kwraa dɔŋŋ.

english_verse: The music of harps and singers and of flutes and trumpets will no longer be heard. No workers will ever set up shop in that city, and the sound of grinding grain will be silenced forever.
translation_verse: Ni anuŋ saŋkutswalɔi kɛ lalatsɛmɛi kɛ blɛkpãlɔi kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛkpãlɔi lɛ agbee kwraa dɔŋŋ yɛ omli, ni anaŋ ŋaalɔ ko ŋaalɔ ko ni le ŋaa ko kwraa dɔŋŋ yɛ omli, ni anuŋ wiɛ gbɛɛmɔ ko hu kwraa dɔŋŋ yɛ omli.

english_verse: Lamps will no longer shine anywhere in Babylon, and couples will never again say wedding vows there. Her merchants ruled the earth, and by her witchcraft she fooled all nations.
translation_verse: Ni anaŋ kane la ko kwraa dɔŋŋ yɛ omli, ni anuŋ ayɛmforo wu kɛ ayɛmforo gbee kwraa dɔŋŋ yɛ omli; ejaakɛ ojarayelɔi lɛ ji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi wuji, ni okunyaayeli lɛ akɛshishiu jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ.”

english_verse: On the streets of Babylon is found the blood of God's people and of his prophets, and everyone else.”
translation_verse: Ni emli ana gbalɔi kɛ krɔŋkrɔŋbii kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni agbe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ala lɛ yɛ.

english_verse: After this, I heard what sounded like a lot of voices in heaven, and they were shouting, “Praise the Lord! To our God belongs the glorious power to save,
translation_verse: Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, minu gbee ni wa ni tamɔ asafo babaoo gbee yɛ ŋwɛi ni miikɛɛ, “Haleluya! Yiwalaheremɔ kɛ anunyam kɛ hewalɛ lɛ ji wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ!

translation_verse: Ejaakɛ anɔkwa kɛ jalɛ ji ekojomɔi lɛ, akɛni ekojo ajwamãŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ ni kɛ ejwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ efite shikpɔŋ lɛ ni etɔ etsuji lɛ ala lɛ he owele yɛ enɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: Then the crowd shouted, “Praise the Lord! Smoke will never stop rising from her burning body.”
translation_verse: Ni amɛkɛɛ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ akɛ, “Haleluya! Ni la ni shãa maŋ lɛ lasu lɛ teɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔi anaanɔ!”

english_verse: From the throne a voice said, “If you worship and fear our God, give praise to him, no matter who you are.”
translation_verse: Ni gbee ko jɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ mli kɛɛ, “Nyɛjiea wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi, nyɛ mɛi ni ji etsuji lɛ fɛɛ kɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛsheɔ lɛ gbeyei, mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji lɛ fɛɛ!”

english_verse: Then I heard what seemed to be a large crowd that sounded like a roaring flood and loud thunder all mixed together. They were saying, “Praise the Lord! Our Lord God All-Powerful now rules as king.
translation_verse: Ni minu gbee ko tamɔ asafo kpeteŋkple gbee kɛ nui babaoo kɛ nyɔŋmɔshiimɔi ni naa wa agbɛɛmɔ miikɛɛ, “Haleluya! Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ, wɔNyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ miiye maŋtsɛ!” Toobi lɛ Yookpeemɔ lɛ

english_verse: So we will be glad and happy and give him praise. The wedding day of the Lamb is here, and his bride is ready.
translation_verse: “Nyɛhãa wɔmii ashɛa ni wɔmli afilia wɔ ni wɔwo ehiɛ nyam! Ejaakɛ Toobi lɛ yookpeemɔ lɛ eshɛ, ni eŋa lɛ esaa ehe eto.

english_verse: She will be given a wedding dress made of pure and shining linen. This linen stands for the good things God's people have done.”
translation_verse: Ni ahã lɛ hegbɛ akɛ ewo klala ni hetse ni kpɛlɛɔ nyɛramnyɛram.” Ejaakɛ klala lɛ ji krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ ajalɛnii lɛ.

english_verse: Then the angel told me, “Put this in writing. God will bless everyone who is invited to the wedding feast of the Lamb.” The angel also said, “These things God has said are true.”
translation_verse: Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Ŋmaa, Ajɔɔ mɛi ni atsɛ amɛ kɛba Toobi lɛ yookpeemɔ okplɔ̃ lɛ he lɛ.” Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa wiemɔi nɛ.”

english_verse: I knelt at the feet of the angel and began to worship him. But the angel said, “Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you and everyone else who tells about Jesus. Don't worship anyone but God. Everyone who tells about Jesus does it by the power of the Spirit.” The Rider on the White Horse
translation_verse: Ni miho migbee enaji anaa koni maja lɛ. Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kwɛ, kaafee nakai! Bo kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ ni hiɛ Yesu odase lɛ mli lɛ anaanyo tsulɔ ji mi. Já Nyɔŋmɔ!” Ejaakɛ Yesu he odase lɛ ji gbalɛ mumɔ lɛ. Tatsɛ ni ta okpɔŋɔ yɛŋ nɔ lɛ

english_verse: I looked and saw heaven was open, and a white horse was there. Its rider was called Faithful and True, and he is always fair when he judges or goes to war.
translation_verse: Ni mina ni agbele ŋwɛi naa, ni mina okpɔŋɔ yɛŋ, ni mɔ ni ta nɔ lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ akɛ Anɔkwafo kɛ Anɔkwayelɔ; ni jalɛ naa ekojoɔ ni ewuɔ ta yɛ.

english_verse: He had eyes like flames of fire, and he was wearing a lot of crowns. His name was written on him, but he was the only one who knew what the name meant.
translation_verse: Ni ehiŋmɛii tamɔ lalilɛi, ni maŋtsɛ faii pii bumɔ eyitso, ni aŋma gbɛi ko yɛ he ni mɔ ko mɔ ko leee akɛ ja lɛ diɛŋtsɛ;

english_verse: The rider wore a robe that was covered with blood, and he was known as “The Word of God.”
translation_verse: ni ewo atade ni akɛtsɔ lá mli; ni atsɛɔ egbɛi akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ Wiemɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: He was followed by armies from heaven that rode on white horses and were dressed in pure white linen.
translation_verse: Ni tai ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ tara okpɔŋɔi yɛji anɔ kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ, ni amɛwo klala yɛŋ futaa ni he tse.

english_verse: From his mouth a sharp sword went out to attack the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod and will show the fierce anger of God All-Powerful by trampling the grapes in the pit where wine is made.
translation_verse: Ni tsi ni naa ba jɛɔ edaaŋ, koni ekɛ no atswia jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ anii; ni ekɛ dadetso aaakpala amɛ. Ni eeenaanaa Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ mlifu ni naa wa lɛ wainŋaanɔ lɛ nɔ.

english_verse: On the part of the robe that covered his thigh was written, “KING OF KINGS AND Lord OF LordS.”
translation_verse: Ni aŋma gbɛi ko yɛ etade kɛ egboŋ nɔ akɛ, “Maŋtsɛmɛi aMaŋtsɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔmɛi aNuŋtsɔ.” Harmagedon Ta lɛ

english_verse: I then saw an angel standing on the sun, and he shouted to all the birds flying in the sky, “Come and join in God's great feast!
translation_verse: Ni mina bɔfo ko damɔ hulu mli, ni ebo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ loofɔji ni filikiɔ yɛ ŋwɛi teŋ lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa ni nyɛbabuaa nyɛhe naa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ okplɔ̃ kpeteŋkple lɛ he,

english_verse: You can eat the flesh of kings, rulers, leaders, horses, riders, free people, slaves, important people, and everyone else.”
translation_verse: koni nyɛbaye maŋtsɛmɛi aloo kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi aloo kɛ hewalɔi aloo kɛ okpɔŋɔi aloo kɛ mɛi ni tara amɛnɔ lɛ aloo kɛ odehei kɛ nyɔji kɛ mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji fɛɛ aloo.”

english_verse: I also saw the beast and all kings of the earth come together. They fought against the rider on the white horse and against his army.
translation_verse: Ni mina kooloo lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amɛtai lɛ ni abua amɛnaa ni amɛkɛ mɔ ni ta okpɔŋɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ eta lɛ ayawu.

english_verse: But the beast was captured and so was the false prophet. This is the same prophet who had worked miracles for the beast, so he could fool everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol. The beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into a lake of burning sulfur.
translation_verse: Ni amɔ kooloo lɛ, ni amɔ amalegbalɔ lɛ afata ehe, amalegbalɔ lɛ ni fee okadii yɛ ehiɛ ni ekɛshishiu mɛi ni ŋɔ kooloo lɛ okadi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni jaa emãgã lɛ. Ni aŋɔ kooloo lɛ kɛ amale gbalɔ lɛ ni akɛ mɛi enyɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ wo la kpaakpo lɛ ni tsoɔ kɛ swɔɔ lɛ mli ni amɛhiɛ kãmɔ.

english_verse: But the rest of their army was killed by the sword that came from the mouth of the rider on the horse. Then birds stuffed themselves on the dead bodies.
translation_verse: Ni mɛi ni shwɛ lɛ, akɛ mɔ ni ta okpɔŋɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ tsi ni jɛɔ edaaŋ lɛ gbe amɛ, ni loofɔji fɛɛ ye amɛloo lɛ amɛtɔrɔ.

english_verse: I saw thrones, and sitting on those thrones were the ones who had been given the right to judge. I also saw the souls of the people who had their heads cut off because they had told about Jesus and preached God's message. translation_verse: Ni mina maŋtsɛ sɛ̃ii ni mɛi ni akɛ kojomɔ ehã amɛ lɛ tara nɔ. Amɛtsɔ̃mɔ hiɛkãalɔi ekoŋŋ, ni amɛkɛ Kristo ye maŋtsɛ afii akpe.

english_verse: These people are the first to be raised to life, and they are especially blessed and holy. The second death has no power over them. They will be priests for God and Christ and will rule with them for
translation_verse: Mɔ ni naa gbɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ shitee lɛ mli lɛ ajɔɔ lɛ ni mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji lɛ. Gbele ni ji enyɔ lɛ bɛ hewalɛ ko yɛ nakai mɛi lɛ anɔ; moŋ amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Kristo osɔfoi, ni amɛkɛ lɛ aaaye maŋtsɛ afii akpe. Satan nɔ kunimyeli

english_verse: He will fool the countries of Gog and Magog, which are at the far ends of the earth, and their people will follow him into battle. They will have as many followers as there are grains of sand along the beach,
